text.body: <1> <1.1> śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitā nyāsāparaparyāyā kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikākhyā kāśikāvyākhyā anubandhacatuṣṭayanirūpaṇam jayanti te sadā santaḥ sarvathā yairūpārjitam| guṇānāṃ sumahadvandaṃ doṣāṇāṃ ca vimārjanam||1|| anyataḥ sāramādāya kṛtaiṣā kāśikā yathā| vṛttistasyā yathāśakti kriyate pañjikā tathā||2|| `vṛttau'ityādi| atha kimarthaḥ kāśikārambhe'sya ślokakasyopanyāsaḥ ? tasyāmaga auravaparihārārthaḥ, gauravapratipādanārthaśca| atra hyasati prāganyāsu vṛttiṣu racitāsu paścādiyaṃ raciteti punaruktatādoṣaṃ sambhāvayatāṃ tasyāmagauravaṃ syāt, na tu gauravam| asmiṃstu sati na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ, yasmādanena sa viśeṣastasyā ākhyāyate samyagaśeṣaśabdavyutpattihetuḥ, yasmin sati punaruktatādoṣasambhāvanā'gauravaheturna bhavati, gauravaṃ cotpadyate| sa punaruktatādoṣasabhbhāvanā! tasyāṃ cāsatyāṃ nāgauravaṃ bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? pūrvoktādviśeṣādgauravameva| tatra ca vṛttiḥ-pāṇinipraṇītānāṃ sūtrāṇāṃ vivaraṇaṃ cūllibhaṭṭinallūrādiviracitam| bhāṣyaṃ kātyāyanapraṇītānāṃ vākyānāṃ vivaraṇaṃ patañjalipraṇītam| `tathā' iti samuccaye| dhātunāmapārāyamādiṣu cetyarthaḥ| atha vā sādṛśye| yathā vṛttyādau viprakīrṇasya tantrasya sārasaṃgrahaḥ kriyatetathā dhātunāmapārāyaṇādiṣviti yāvat| dhātavo bhūvādayaḥ nāmāni prātipadikāni, teṣāṃ parāṃ paryantaṃ niṣṭhāmayante gacchanti yābhyāṃ śāstrābhyāṃ te dhātunāmapārāyaṇe pārāyaṇaśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate- dhātupārāyaṇaṃ nāmapārāyaṇañceti| te ādī yeṣāmiti bahubrīhiḥ| ādiśabdena śikṣādīnāṃgrahaṇam| `viprakīrṇasya' iti| vikṣiptasya, vistāritasyetyarthaḥ| tantrasya vyākaraṇa- śāstrasyetyarthaḥ| taddhi tantramiva tantram| dairdhyeṇa prasārahitāstanta- vastantramityucyante| tathā tadanekasya tiraścīnasya tantoranugrāhakam, tathedamapyanekasya lakṣyasyeti, etadasya tantreṇa sādharmyam| atha vā -tantryante vyutpādyante śabdā aneneti tantraṃ vyākaraṇam| anekārthatvādaddhātunām `tatri kuṭumbadhāraṇe(dhā.pā.1978) ityeṣa dhāturatra vyutpādane vartate| atha vā , tantraṃ siddhāntaḥ,`tantraṃpradhāne siddhānte'(3.3.185) ityamaraḥ) `sārasaṃgrahaḥ' iti| sāraśabdo'yaṃ napuṃsaka- liṅgo nyāyādanapete vartate| tathā ca arddharcādiṣu vakṣyati- `sāraśabda utkarṣe pūṃliṅgo nyāyādanapete napuṃsakam'(2.4.31) iti| samyak samastādvā gṛhyate lakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇañcāneneti saṃgrahaḥ| `grahavṛdṛniścigamaśca'(3.3.58)ṭhaiti karaṇe'p| sārañcāsau - saṃgrahaśceti sārasaṃgrahaḥ| sa punarayameva kāśikākhyo vṛttiviśeṣaḥ| atra sāraśabdena - nirdoṣatodbhāvitā| na hi sadoṣasya śāstrasya nyāyāvanapetatvamupapadyate;nyāyena tasya bodhyamānatvāt| saṃgrahaḥ śabdenāpi guṇavattā khyāpyate| na hyanyathā samyak sarvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣyañcānena śakyate saṃgrahītum| ke punaratra guṇāḥ ? iṣṭayupasaṃkhyānavattvam, śuddhagaṇatvam, vivṛtagūḍhasūtrā- rthatvam; vyutpannarūpasiddhitvañca| tathā ca vakṣyati śāstrānte-- iṣṭayupasaṃkhyānavatī suddhagaṇā vivṛttagūḍhasūtrārthā| vyutpannarūpasiddharvṛttiriyaṃ kāśikā nāma||iti| atha vā saṃgrahaśabdo'yaṃ bhāvasādhanaḥ- saṃgrahaṇaṃ saṃgrahasaṃkṣepa, śāstrabhedena viprakīrṇasya tantrasya piṇḍīkṛtyaikatrāvasthāpanamiti yāvat| sāraśabdastu pradhānavacanaḥ| yāvatā granthasandararbheṇa paripūrṇatā śabdavyutpatterbhavati sa sāraḥ| sārasya saṃgrahaḥ sāra- saṃgrahaḥ, tasya karaṇaṃ sukhodagrahaṇārtham| ekatra hi vyavasthitasya sukaramudagrahaṇaṃ bhavati, duṣkarantu viprakīrṇasya| sāragrahaṇaṃ parikarabandhanirāsārtham| sa hi tasyopakārakatvāva- ṅgam, apradhānam| itarastu tenaivopakāryatvādaṅgi,pradhanām| `atha' ityādi| athaśabdo'dhikārārthaḥ, adhikāraḥ - prastāvaḥ, śabdānuśāsana śāstraṃ prastūyata ityamumarthamathaśabdo dyotayati| `śabdānuśāsanam' ityetāvati hyabhihite sandehaḥ syāt- kiṃ śabdānuśāsanamārabhyate ? paṭhyate? śrūyate vā ? iti, athaśabdaprayoge tvarthāntaravyavacchedena prastūyata ityeṣo'rtho niścīyate| anuśiṣyante saṃskriyante vyutpādyante'nena śabdā ityanuśāsanam| śabdānāmanuśāsanaṃ śabdānuśāsanam| atra keciccodayanti-- ```ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' (2.3.66)ityanenātra ṣaṣṭhī, tataśca `karmaṇi ca ' (2.2.14) samāsapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam iti, etaccāyuktam; yatra hyubhayoḥ prāptistatrānena karmaṇi doho'śikṣitenāgopālakeneti, evaṃ nāma durdohānāṃ gavāmaśikṣitenāgopālakena dohaityāścaryabhūto'tra gavāṃ dohaḥ pratipādayitumā- ścaryaśabdaḥ, nānyatheti sāmarthyaprāptamubhayorupādānam| śabdānuśāsanamityatra tu śabdānāmidamanuśāsanam, nārthānām- ityetāvato'rthasya vivakṣitatvāt, tasyācāryasya karttṛrūpādānamantareṇāpi pratipādayituṃ śakyatvādācāryopadānamakiñcitkaram|tasmānnātrāsti dvayorati-kartṛkarmaṇooooooooḥ sāmarthyaprāptamupādānam| tataścobhayaprāptirapi nāstyeva| asatyāñca tasyāṃ na `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' (3.2.66) ityanena ṣaṣṭhī, kena tarhi? `karttṛkarmaṇooḥ kṛti' (2.3.65)ityanena| tataśceṣmapra- vraścanavat samāso bhaviṣyati| atha vā, śeṣalakṣamaiveyaṃ ṣaṣṭhītyacodyametat| vyākaraṇasyacedamanvayarthaṃ nāma śabdānuśāsanamiti| atastenaiva sūcittavāt prayojanasyānabhidhānam| ye hi śabdā anuśiṣyante, tasya taduddeśe pravṛttiḥ| yasya ca yaduddiśya pravṛttiḥ , tattasya prayojanaṃ bhavati| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati- śabdānuśiṣṭi- rasya prayojanamiti| etacca sākṣāt prayojanam, pāramparyeṇa tu vedarakṣaṇādīni prayojanāni bhāṣyādavadhāryāṇi| sambandhastu sādhyasādhanabhāvalakṣamaḥ| śabdānuśiṣṭeḥ sādhyāyāḥ; vyākaraṇasya sādhanasya ca yaḥ sambandhaḥ, sa prayojana evāntabhūtaḥ| `keṣāṃ śabdānām' iti| kathaṃ punaranuśāsane guṇībhūtānāṃ śabdānāṃ kiṃśabdena pratyavamarśo bhavati ? naiṣaḥ doṣaḥ; pradhāne hyantarbhūtasyāpyupasarjanasya buddhyā pravibhajya kiṃśabdena pratyavamarśo dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā- rājapuruṣo'yam, kasya rājña iti| kaḥ punaratra praṣṭurabhiprāyaḥ ? evaṃ manyate- śabdānuśāsanamityatra śabdaśabdaḥ sāmānya vacanaḥ| na ca sāmānyaśabda prakaraṇādirahito rviśeṣe varttitumutsahate, santi ca samudra-ghoṣādayo'pi bahavaḥ śabdāḥ, atasteṣāmapi vyutpādanaṃ prāpnotīti ? iha tu vyākaraṇaṃ prastutam, tacca bedāṅgam, aṅgañcopakārakaṃ bhavati| evañca tadvedasyopakārakaṃ bhavati yadi tenaiva vaidikāḥ śabdāḥ saṃskriyante, laukikāśca tadupakāriṇaḥ| vaidikopakāritvaṃ tu laukikānāma; taistadarthasyākhyānāt| tasmācchabdānuśāsanādhikārādviśiṣṭā evātra śabdā vyutpādayitumabhīṣṭāḥ,na tu samudraghoṣādayo'pi| tathāvidhaśabdaravyutpādane hi vyākaraṇasyāvedāṅgatāpi syāditi manyamāna āha`lokikānām' ityādi| loke viditā laukikāḥ, tatra vidita ityanuvartamāne `lokasarvalokāṭṭhañ' (5.1.44) iti ṭhañ| atha vā , loke bhavā laukikāḥ- adhyātmāditvāṭṭhañ (vā.456)| evaṃ vaidikāḥ| vaidikānāṃ laukikebhyaḥ pṛthagupādānaṃ prādhānyakhyāpanārtham| yathā- `brāhmaṇā āyātāḥ, vasiṣṭho'pyāyātaḥ' iaiiti| atra brāhmaṇatvādeva vasiṣṭhasyāpyāgamane siddhe prādhānyakhyāpanārthaṃ tasya pṛthagupādānam| prādhānyakhyāpanaṃ tu vaidikānāṃ yatnenāpabhraṃśa nirāsārtham| teṣāṃ hyapabhraṃśe yājñe karmaṇi mahān pratyavāyo dṛṣṭaḥ- `helayo helayaḥ' iti| atha vā, ye lokāyātrā hetavo bhāṣāśabdāstaireva laukikatvaṃ prasiddhamiti vaidikānāṃ pṛthagupādānam| tatra laukikā aniyatavarṇānupūrvīkāḥ- gauḥ,aśvaḥ,puruṣaḥ, hastītyevamādayaḥ| vaidikāstu niyatānupūrvīkāḥ- `śanno devīrabhiṣṭaye' (ṛ.10.9.4)ityevamādayaḥ| iha hyanvākhyāne pratipadapāṭho'bhyupeyaḥ| tasyāpi trayaḥ prakārāḥ- śabdāpa- śabdobhayopadeśabhedena| ānantyācca śabdānāṃ sa sarvathāpyasambhavaḥ| evaṃ hi śrūyate- `bṛha- spati kilendrāya divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ pratipadavihitānāṃ pārāyaṇaṃ provāca, na cāntaṃ jagāma' iti| tadīdṛśe vaktaryadhyetaryadhyayakāle ca nāntagamanamabhūdyasya, tasya kuto'- dyatve bhaviṣyati svalpāyuṣi prajayām| na cānyo'bhyupāyo'stīti manyamān āha- `katham' ityādi| kathamanuśāsanam ? na kenacit prakāreṇa śabdānāṃ vyākaraṇamanuśāsanamityarthaḥ| atha vā bhāvasādhano'trānuśāsanaśabdaḥ| anuśiṣṭiranuśāsanam- saṃskāraḥ, na kathañcicchabdānāṃ saṃskāraḥ sambhavatīti yāvat| yenālpenaiva prayatnena mahataḥ śabdaughān pratipadyeta, tadupāyantaraṃ darśayitumāha- `prakṛtyādivibhāga' parikalpanayā' ityādi| pratyayāt prathamaṃ kriyata iti prakṛtiḥ, prakṛtirādiyaṣāṃ te prakṛtyādayaḥ, ādiśabdaḥ pratyayādīnāṃ parigrahāya, teṣāṃ vibhago'saṃkīrṇarūpatā,tasya kalpanā parikalpikayā buddhyā parikalpanam; tayā parikalpanayā śabdānāmanuśāsanaṃ vyākararaṇanuśiṣṭirvā| hetāvidayaṃ tṛtīyā| na hi tayā vinā vyākaraṇamanuśāsanaṃ bhavati; nāpi tena vinānuśiṣṭiḥ śabdānāṃ śakyate kartum| parikalpanayetyanenaitat pratipādayati| kalpanāmātraṃ prakṛtyādivibhāgaḥ, paramārthavastu; pratyastamitaprakṛtyādivibhāgaḥ samudāya eva kasyacidarthasya vācaka iti| `sāmānyaviśeṣavatā lakṣaṇena' iti| karaṇa eṣā tṛtīyā| sāmānyañca viśeṣaśca sāmānyaviśeṣau tau yasmin lakṣaṇe stastat sāmānyaviśeṣavallakṣamam| tatrotsargalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyavat,yathā `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1)iti| tatra hi `dhātoḥ' ityetataanupasarga iti ca viśeṣaḥ| tatra sāmānyavatā lakṣaṇena prakṛtyādivibhāgaḥ parikalpanayā kumbhakāraḥ, kāṇḍalāvaḥ, śaralāvaḥ- ityavamādikaṃ mahāntaṃ śabdaughaṃ pratipadyate| viseṣavatā tu pārṣṇitraḥ, godaḥ, kambalada ityavamādikam| evamanyatrāpi veditavyam| pratyāhāraprakaraṇam| `atha' ityādi| evaṃ manyate- śabdānuśāsanamadhikṛtam, tatra yana śabdā anuśiṣyante tasyaivopadeśo yuktaḥ na caiṣāmupadeśena kasyacicchabdasya saṃskāraḥ kriyate; tataścāprastutabhidhānamiti praśnasyābhiprāyaḥ| `varṇānām' ita| varṇā akārādayaḥ, teṣāmādyuccāraṇamupadeśaḥ| `pratyāhārthaḥ' iti| pratyāhāraḥ `aiuṇ' (mā.sū.1) ityevamādiko viśiṣṭānupūrvīko viśiṣṭānubandhakaścākṣarasamāmnāyaḥ, pratyāhriyante saṃkṣipyante varṇā asminniti kṛtvā| sa yatā syādityevamartho varṇānāmupadeśaḥ| kasyādetat| tasyāpi prakṛtānupayogitvāt tadavastha evaiṣa doṣa ityata āha- `pratyāhāro lāghavena' ityādi| laghorbhāvo lāghavam, tat punaralpaprayāsaḥ| alpaprayāsasādhyaṃ hi vastvalpaprayatnayogāllagūcyate|tena lāghavena śāstrasya ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ(6.3.111) ityevamādeḥ pravṛttyartho'bhinirvṛtyartha ityarthaḥ| sati hi pratyahāre `ādirantyena sahetā'(1.1.71) ityetat pravarttate| tatpravṛttau cākārādīnāmaṇityevamādikāḥ saṃjñāḥ sidhyanti| tataśca yatrākārādīnāṃ grahaṇamiṣṭaṃ tatrāṇityevamādikayaiva saṃjñayā bahavo'pi te nirdiśyanta iti lāghavena śāstrasyābhinirvṛttirbhavati| tasmiścāsati `ādirantyena sahetā' ityevamādeḥ śāstrasya pravṛttirna syāt; ādyantayorabhāvāt| na hyasati sanniveśaviśeṣe tāvupapadyete, asatyāñca tatpravṛttarau pūrvoktāḥ saṃjñā na syutaḥ| tataśca yatra yatra sūtre'kā- kārādīnāṃ yāvatāṃ grahaṇamiṣṭaṃ tatra te tāvantaḥ svarūpeṇaiva nirdiśyeranniti lāghavena śāstrasya pravṛttirna syāt| tadevaṃ prakṛtasyaivālpaprayāsena niṣpādanārtha- tvānna bhavati pūrvadoṣāvasaraḥ| 1.aiuṇ| atha kasmādihād guṇādikamackārya na bhavati? 'plutapragṛhyāaci'(6.1.125) iti prakṛtibhāvāt| pragṛhyatvaṃ tu teṣāṃ 'nipāta ekājanāṅ' (1.1.14)iti pragṛhyasaṃjñāvidhānāt| nipātatvaṃ tu cājiṣu pāṭhāt| ata eva nipātatvādarthavatve cotpannāyā vibhakteḥ śravaṇaṃ na bhavati|ihānārthavatve vibhaktyutpattiranarthakasyayāpi nipātasya prātipadikasaṃjñopasaṃkhyānāddeditavyā| 'anena krameṇa'iti| anayā''nupūrvyā| kiṃ punaḥkāraṇamayameva krama āśrīyateḥ na kramāntaram? taducyateḥ ihāṇgrahaṇena trayāṇāmadhyeṣāmakārādīnāṃ grahaṇamiṣyate, iṇgrahaṇe tvakārasya grahaṇaṃ neṣyate, uṇgrahaṇe punarakārayordayorapi | etacca kramāntarāśrayaṇe na sampadyata ityeṣvevaṃ krama āśrīyate| 'varṇāta kāraḥ'(vā.320) iti kārapratyasyopasaṃkhyānādiha ca tadakaraṇannaite varṇāḥ,api tu tacchāyānukāriṇo'nya eva sandhyakṣararāvivarṇaikadeśā iti kasyacidāśaṅkākḍā syāt; atastannirākaraṇāyāha-'varṇān'iti| kārapratyayastu 'rogākhyāyāṃ ṇ‌ṇvala bahulam'(3.3.108)ityatropasaṃkhyāyate| tena 3ṣabahul‌vanacāaitalsatyapi varṇatve na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| ṇakārasya pūrvottaravarṇāntaraḥpātitvāt madhyabhāvaḥ, nāntyatvam; ata itsaṃjñayā na bhavitavyam ? athāpi kathañcidantyatvaṃ syāt? evamapi vakṣyamāṇena nyāyenāpradhānatvād yathā tatrāckāryamasya na bhavati tathetsaṃjñāpi na bhavediti yasya bhrāntiḥ syāt, taṃ pratyanta ityuktam, itamiti ca | yadyapi pūrvottaravarṇā- pekṣayā'sya madhyamabhāvaḥ, tathāpi pūrvavarṇāpekṣayāntyatvamastyeva| sati ca tasminnapradhānasyapītsaṃjñayā bhavitavyam; upadeśasāmarthyāt| anyathā hi tadupadeśa- vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| `ādirantyena sahetā' (1.1.71) ityanenāṇityevamādikāḥ saṃjñā yathā syurityevamartho ṇakārādīnāmanubandhānāmupadeśaḥ| sa ca tadartho'satyāmitsaṃjñāyāṃ na syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `tasya' ityādi| `ekena' iti sahārathayoge tṛtīyā, `tasya' iti iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| tasya ṇakārasya pradeśavākyeṣu saṃjñipratyāyanārthamekenaivākāreṇa sahopadānāṃ bhavati|sa hyakārādīnāṃ varṇānāmakārasahita eva saṃjñā, na kevalaḥ, nāpi varṇāntarasahitaḥ| tasmāt pratyāyanārthaṃ tenaiva sahopādīyate, na kevalaḥ, nāpi varṇāntarasahitaḥ| abhye tvāhuḥ - tasyeti karttari ṣaṣṭhī; ekeneti ca sahayoge tṛtīyā| tenāyamarthaḥ-ādivarṇasahito ṇakāro'nyeṣāṃ madhyapātināṃ varṇānāṃ grāhako bhavatyādivarṇasya ceti| apare āhuḥ- anekārthvāddhātūnāṃ gṛhṇātiratroccāraṇe varttate `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena' (vyā.pa.89) iti yathā| tenāyamartha-- tasyaikena sahoccāraṇaṃ bhavatīti| atha `iṇaḥ ṣīdhvam' (8.3.78) ityatrekāreṇāsya grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti kuto'vasitam ? `ati śnudhātubhruvāṃ yvoḥ' (6.4.77) itīkārokārayoḥ saṃsṛjya nirdeśāt| yadīkāreṇāsya grahaṇaṃ syāt tato lāghavārthaṃ `iṇ' ityeva nirdiśet| `yvoḥ' iti saṃsṛjya nirdeśe'rdhacatastro mātrā bhavanti, iṇiti nirdeśe tistraḥ, tatra laghīyasā nyāsena siddhe yadgarīyāsaṃ prayatnamārabhate tato jñāyate nāsya ṇakārasyekāreṇa grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti| iha tarhi `kṛvāpājimisvadisādhyaśūbhya uṇ' (da.u. 1.86) ityukāreṇa grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? ukārādanyasya grāhyasyābhāvāt, tasya ca svarūpeṇaiva nirdeśāt| `hrasvamavarṇam'ityādi| prayujyata iti prayogo dhātvādiḥ| hrasvamavarṇa prayogage saṃvṛtam| saṃvṛtaguṇayogāt saṃvṛtam| yathā śuklaguṇayogāt śukaklaḥ paṭa iti| `dīrghaplutayostu vivṛtatvam' iti| vivṛtaguṇayogitvanamityarthaḥ| tathā cāhuḥ śikṣā kārāḥ- `vivṛtakaraṇāḥ svarāḥ, tebhya e o vivṛtatarau, tābhyāmapi ai au, etābhyāmapyākāraḥ, saṃvṛto'kāraḥ'iti| `teṣām' ityādi| teṣāṃ hrasvādīnāṃ `tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ saṃvarṇam' (1.1.9) iti savarṇasaṃjñā yathāsyādityevamarthamiha śāstre hrasvo'kāro vivṛtaguṇo'bhyupagamyate| anyathā hi bhinnatvāt prayatnasyāsati sāvarṇye daṇḍāḍhakamityādau `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101) iti dīrghatvaṃ na syātat| nanu ca satyapi vivṛtatvapratijñānaiva hrasvaplutayorakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti, tasmin karttavye plutasyāsiddhatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; `siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu' ita svarasandhiṣu plutasya siddhatvātta; itarathā hi `plutapragṛhyā aci' (6.1.125) ita prakṛtibhāva- vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| atra ca yadyapi `vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyate' ityuktam, tathāpi teṣāṃ sāvarṇyaprasiddhyarthamiti vacanādvavṛtatara iti gamyate| na hi vivṛtasya vivṛtatareṇa sāvarṇyamupapadyate; prayatnabhedāt; vivṛtatvapratijñānasāmarthyādvā| avivṛtatarasyāpi vivṛtatareṇa sāvarṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati| yadi`iha' ityetāvadevocyeta, tadā pratyāsatteḥ prakṛtatvāccakṣarasamāmnāyika eva vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyata iti vijñāyet, na dhātuprātipadikapratyayanipātasthaḥ; tataḥ prayatnabhedādasati sāvarṇye ākṣarasamāmnāyikena tasyāgrahaṇādactvaṃ na syāt| tasmiścāsati śāmyatītyatrācpari- bhāṣānupasthānāt sthānino'kārasyāctvābhāvāt `śamāmaṣṭānāṃ dīrghaḥ śyani' (7.3.74) iti dīrghatvaṃ na syāt| dṛṣad ityatra prātipadikasyānta udātto bhavatīti antodāttatvaṃ nasyāt; tasyājdharmatvāt| nāyaka ityatra pratyayasyākārasyānactvāt tatrāyādeśo na syāt| avanamatītyatra `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) `upasargāścābhivarjam' (phi.sū.4.81) ityādyudāttatvaṃ na syāt| kiñca anuvṛttinirdeśasthe-nākāre ṇāsati sāvarṇye dīrghasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt| tatra ko doṣaḥ? `asya cvau' (6.4.32) itīhaiva syādīttvam śuklībhavatīti; mālībhavatītyatra tu na syāt| `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) itīhaiva syādakāralopaḥ vākṣiḥ, plākṣiritita, vālākirityatra tu na syāt| tasmādyāvat kiñcidavarṇamātramiha śāstre tasya sarvasya vivṛtatvaṃ pratijñāyata iti pradarśanārtha śāstragrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| nanu ca satyapi sāvarṇye naivānuvṛttinirdeśasthenākāreṇa savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ sidhyati; anaṇtvāt| na hyanuvṛttinirdeśe ye'kārādayaste'ṇaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? ye akṣarasamāmnāye| jātipakṣāśrayādadoṣa iti cet ? na; jātipakṣe grahaṇakaśāstrasya pratyākhyānānnaiṣa doṣaḥ| iha hi vyaktiṣu dvayamasti-- sādṛśyam,bhedaśca| tatra kadācit kiñcitprādhānyena vivakṣyate, yadā sādṛśyaṃ vivikṣyatetadā tasya bhāgasya sadṛśasya sarvāsu vyaktiṣu samānatvādaśeṣavyaktyā- kṣepo bhavati; bhedasyāparāmṛṣṭatvāt| so'yaṃ pratyāhāre sadṛśabhāgaḥ pradhāna upadeśa iti sarvāsāmavarṇavyaktīnāmanuvṛttinirdeśasthānāmaṇtvamupapadyate| kaḥ punarasya sādṛśyasyāvarṇajāteśca viśeṣaḥ ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ- etacca sādaśyaṃ hrasvāsvevāvarṇavyaktiṣu varttate, na dīrghaplutāsu| avarṇajātistu dīrghaplutā- svapi varttata iti gatametat| atha kathametadavagamyate akāra iha śāstre vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyata ityata āha- `tasya' ityādi| yadi pūrvaṃ nivṛto'kāro na pratijñāyeta, tatastasyāprayogārtham `a a' (8.4.68) ityanena pratyāpattiṃ na kuryāt| svarūpāddhi pracyutasyapunastatprāptiḥ- pratyāpattiḥ, sā kathamavicalitasvarūpasyaivopapadyeta ? atha vā, yadi vivṛtaḥ pratijñāyate, tadā tasya śāstrasya parisamāptāvapi tathābhūtasyaiva prayogaḥ syāt ? iti pūrvapakṣamāśaṅkyāha- `tasya' ityādi| arthaśabdo nivṛttivacanaḥ, yathā-maśakārtho dhūma iti| tasya vivṛtasya prayoganivṛttiryathā syādityarthaḥ| atha vā - artha- śabdaḥ prayojanavacanaḥ, tasyetyanena saṃvṛtaḥ pratyavamṛśyate, prayogo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| kriyāviśeṣaṇatvānnapuṃsakatvam| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati- tasya saṃvatasya svarūpāt pracyutasya prayoganimittaṃ pratyāpattiḥ kariṣyate; yataḥ śāstrapari- samāptau tato na bhavati tathābhūtasyaivāyaṃ prayogaḥ iti| 2.ṛlṛka| `tasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati tribhiḥ' iti| kathaṃ tribhirgrahaṇaṃ labhyate? yadi samudāyānubandhaḥ, avayavānubandho na; atha cāvayavānubandhaḥ, na tadā samudāyānubandha ityekanaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌ ? naiṣa doṣa; pratijñayā tvanubandhānāṃ vyavahāraḥ| pratijñā tu pauruṣeyī, puruṣaścobhayatra pratijñānaṃ kurvanna viramati; virodhābhāvāt| na hi samudāyānubandhatā avayavānubandhapratijñayā virudhyate, itarayā na cetareti| tasmādyuktamuktam- tribhirgrahaṇaṃ bhavatīti| evaṃ sarvatra yojanīyam| iha śāstre varṇānumupadeśaḥ prayojanavaśāt| lṛkāropadeśasya na kiñcit prayojanaṃ sambhavatītyabhiprāyeṇāha- `akārādayo varṇāḥ' iti| prayujyate iti prayogaḥ dhātvādiḥ; ananyatrabhāvo viṣayārthaḥ, pracuraḥ prabhūtaḥ prayogo viṣayo yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| atha vā, prayuktiḥ prayogaḥ uccāraṇam, tasya viṣaya iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tasya pracuraśabdena bahuvrīhiḥ| `teṣāṃ sujñānamupadeśe prayojanaṃ pṛcchayata iti, asya vacana- syāvakāśanirāsārthamuktam. yadi hyetannocyeta, lṛkārasyaiva tu kevalaṃ prayojanaṃ pracchyata iti, tadā syādasya vacanasyāvakāśaḥ| `lṛkārastu klṛpistha eva prayujyate' iti| tuśabdo'kārādibhyo viśeṣārthaḥ| syādetat- klṛpisambandhinastasya yānyackāryāṇi tadarthamupapeśaḥ karttavya ityata āha- `klupeśca' ityādi| yadyasiddhatvaṃ tataḥ kimityāha- `tatra ṛkāra eva' ityādi| `latvavidhānādyāni' ityādi| latvaṃ vidhīyate yena śāstreṇa tallatvavidhānam| karaṇe lyuṭ| atha vā-bhāve vidhirvidhānam| latvasya vidhānamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `tatadaḥ parāṇi' ityādi| etena latvasya teṣu siddhatvaṃ darśayati| pūrvatra hi paramasiddham, na tu parasmin pūrvam| `klṛ3ptaśikhaḥ' iti| klṛptā śikhā yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ|atra `guroranṛtaḥ' (8.2.86) ityādinā pluto vidhīyate| sa ca `acaśca' (2.1.88) ityevaṃ sthāninamupasthāpayati| lṛkārasyākṣvanupadeśādasatyactve sa na syāt| `pa praklṛptaḥ' iti| atra `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū. 4.80), `upasargāścā- bhivarjam' (phi.sū.4.81) iti praśabdākāra udātto bhavati| lṛkāro'pi dhātusvareṇa udātta eva| niṣṭhāpratyayasvare kṛte `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (6.1.158) iti paścāt so'nudātto bhavati| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāse kṛte samāsāntarodāttatve prasakte `katiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtibhāvena praśabad evodāttaḥ, tasmāt parasya lṛkāsya `udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' (8.4.66) iti svaritatvaṃ vidhīyate, tadasatyacatve na syāt; tasyājdhrarmatvāt| `klṛptaḥ' klṛptavān' iti| `anaci ca' (8.4.47) iti aca uttarasya yaro dvarvacanaṃ vidhīyate, tadapyanactve na syāt | yaduktam `klṛpistha eva prayujyate' iti, tadvighaṭayan prayojanāntaraṃ darśayitumāha- `yacca' ityādi sādhuśabdoccāraṇaśakteranyā śaktiḥ aśaktiḥ, tato jātam-aśaktijam| `tadanukaraṇasyāpi sādhutvamiṣyate' iti| arthabhedena śabdāntaratvāt, śiṣyaprayuktatvācca, tadanyasādhuśabdavat| nanu cānukāryasyāsādhutvādanukaraṇasyāsādhutvena bhāvyam `prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' iti vacanāt, naitadasti; śāstrīyā hi tatra prakṛtirāśrīyate| prakṛtivaditi ca śāstranibandhanameva kāryamatidiśyate| na cāśaktijamasādhuśabdarūpaṃ śāstrīyā prakṛtiḥ, nāpyapaśabdatvaṃ śāstranibandhanaṃ kāryam| na hi śakyaṃ vyākaraṇenāpyapaśabdatvamākhyātum, tasya sādhuśabdasaṃskārāyaiva pravṛttatvāt| tasmāda- paśabdasayāpyanukaraṇaṃ sādhveva| tatra tatsthasyāpi lṛkārasyāckāryāṇi na syuḥ, yadya7u tasyopadeśo na syāt| `kumārylṛtakaḥ'iti| ātrāctve sati lṛkārasya tatra parato yaṇādeśo bhayati| nanu ca `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityatra saṃkhyātānupadeśo'pi lṛkāropadeśasya prayojanamupapadyata eva| asati lṛkāropadeśe tasya yuktaṃ prayojanam ? na caitadasti; mā bhūtsaṃkhyātānudeśaḥ, asatyapi tasmin `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ'(1.1.50) iti paribhāṣayā vyavasthā bhaviṣyati| itsaṃjñā tarhyaparaṃ paryojanam, upadeśe hyasati `gamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.982,983) ityādiṣu `upadeśe'janunāsikaḥ' (1.3.2) itītsaṃjñā na syāt| tasyāṃ cāsatyāṃ `puṣāvidyutādyalṛditaḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (3.1.55) iti aṅ na syāt, naitadasti; asatyapyupadeśe asmādeva lṛdito dhātoraṅgavidhānāditsaṃjñā vidhāsyate iti nākṣu prayojanamupadeśasya| tasmāt pūrvoktānyeva prayojanāni| tāni ca ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ savarṇa- saṃjñā vaktavyetyetadanāśrityoktāni| atra hyāśrite satyastyapi lṛkāropadeśe ` aṇuditsavarṇasya ca' (1.1.69) iti ṛkāreṇa gṛhyamāṇe lṛkārasya grahaṇādeva sidhyanti| 3. eoṅ| `pūrvāśca' noktam, pūrverasya grahaṇāsambhavāt| atha `ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ' (3.3.104) ityatrākāreṇāsya kasmādgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati? tatra kecidāhuḥ-`ādirantyena sahetā' (1.1.71) ityatra `aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' (1.1.69) ityato'pratyaya- grahaṇamanuvarttate, tenāyamarthaḥ sampadyate- ādirantyena grāhako bhavati, na cet pa pratyayo bhavatīti| pratyayaścāyam, tena grāhako na bhavati| evañca `suptiṅantaṃ padam' (1.4.14) ityāvāvapi pratyayo grāhako na syāt| tasmādanabhidhānādiha pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti veditavyam| abhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā bhavanti| na ca `ṣidbhidādi- bhyo'ṅ' (3.3.104) iti akārādipratyayotpattau vivakṣitārthābhidhānaṃ bhavati| iha tarhi `śāsa idaṅhaloḥ' (6.4.34)`ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ'(7.4.16) iti cākāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ciṇsadṛśasya caṅasadṛśasya cāṅo grahaṇāt| `śāsa idaṅa- haloḥ' ityatra hi `bhañjeśca ciṇi'(6.4.33) ityanuvartate| `ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ' 97.4.16)ityatrāpi `ṇau caṅyupaṣāyā hrasvaḥ' (7.4.1)| ato maṇḍukaplutinyāyena caṅagrahaṇena samānādhikaraṇenāṅa viśeṣyate-caṅyaṅītīti, na cāṅaḥ caṅabhavati; ativilakṣaṇatvāt| tatra sāmarthyādivārtho gamyate| parapadārtheṣu hi prayujyamānāḥ śabdā antareṇāpi ivaśabda- prayogamivaśabdārtha gamayanti, yathā-agnirmāṇavakaḥ, gaurvāhīkaḥ iti|tenāyamartho bhavati- caṅīvāṅīti, caṅasadṛśo'ṅityarthaḥ| kaśca caṅasadṛśo'ṅa ? yaścleḥ sthāne vihitaḥ| tathā ca clisthānikasyaivāṅo grahaṇaṃ sampadyate, na tu pratyāhārasya| evaṃ `śāsa idaṅahaloḥ'(6.4.34)ityatrāpi cligrahaṇenāṅi viśeṣyamāṇe clisthānikasyaivāṅo grahaṇaṃ veditavyam| iha tarhi `sani ca' (2.4.47) `iṅaśca'(2.4.48) iti,`parimāṇākhyāyāṃ sarvebhyaḥ' (3.3.20) `iṅaśca' (3.3.21) iti ca kasmādikāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ na bhavati ? pūrvatra tāvanna bhavati, `iko jhal' (1.2.9) iti kittvavidhānāt| pratyāhāre hyetasmin sani gamyādeśavidhānādigantatvābhāve guṇasyāprāptyā kittvavidhānamana- rthakaṃ syāt| pūrvatra tāvanna bhavati, yadi hi syātika iti kakāreṇaiva pratyāhāraṃ kuryāt| na hyaṅantāddhātoḥ parasya sanaḥ sambhavo'sti; yataḥ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ ṅakāreṇārthavadbhavati| paratrāpi na bhavati; vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| tathā hi ikārāntebhyaḥ `erac' (3.3.56) ityacā bhavitavyam, ukārantebhyo'pi `ṛdorap'(3.3.21)ityapā| lṛkārāntā na santyeva| ejantānāṃ prāgeva pratyayotpatteḥ `ādeca upadeśe'śiti(6.1.45)ityāttvena bhavitavyam, ataste'pi pratyayavidhānakāle na santyeveti| ṛkāra eka evāvaśiṣyate, tato yadi ghañ vidhitsitaḥ,apārthakaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ syāt, urityeva brūyāt| `krīṅajīnāṃ ṇau' (6.1.48) ityatrāpi kriṇātijayatyoḥ pṛthagupādānādikareṇa grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| ikārāntānāṃ madhye tayoreva yatā syāditi niyamārthaṃ pṛthagupādānamiti cet na; evamapi kakāreṇaiva pratyāhāraṃ kuryāt, ejantānāmāttvasya sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva siddhatvāt| `iṅadhāryyoḥ śatrakṛcchriṇi' (3.2.130) ityātrāpi dhārayatinā dhātunā sāhacaryāt `iṅa' ita dhātorgrahaṇam, na pratyāhārasyeti veditavyam| 4.aiauc| iha `ādirantyena sahetā' (1.1.71) ityanena sūtreṇākārādīnāmajityeṣā saṃjñā vidhīyate| sā ca yathā ikārādīnāṃ bhavati, tathā ṇakārādīnāmapyanubaddhānāṃ syāt; teṣāmapi tatropadeśāt| tataśca tayā pradeśāntare `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityevamādau teṣu prātipadikeṣu yathā dadhyatretyādau yaṇādeśo bhavati, tathā dadhi ṇakārīyatītyādāvapi syādityabhiprāyeṇāha- `pratyāhāre' ityādi| kathamajgrahaṇeṣu neti kāryamiti śeṣaḥ| `acaḥ' ityasyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ pradeśavākyeṣu grahaṇāni uccāraṇāni ajgrahaṇāni| teṣu satsu ṇakārādīnāṃ kathamackāryaṃ na bhavet| bhavedevetyarthaḥ| `ācārāt' iti| ācaraṇamācāraḥ-ācāryaprṛttiḥ, tato jñāpakānna bhavati| yadayam `uṇādayo bahupalam' (3.3.1), `tṛṣimṛṣikṛśeḥ kāśyapasya' (1.2.25), `ṅamohrasvādaci ṅamuṇ nityam' (8.3.32), `ṅasiṅasośca' (6.1.110) iti ṇakārādiṣu parato yaṇādeśaṃ na karoti, tato jñāpayati `satyāmapyacsaṃjñāyāmackāryāṇi na bhavanti' iti| atha vā - `ajityeṣaiva saṃjñaiṣāṃ na bhavati' ityeṣo'rtho'nayā ācāryapravṛttyā jñāpyate|yadi hi saṃjñā syāt ācāryasteṣvackāryāṇi kuryāt| evaṃ jñāpakena saṃjñābhāvaṃ pratipādya, idānīṃ nyāyena pratipādayitumāha- `apradhānatvāt' iti| aṇityevamādikāḥ saṃjñāḥ praṇetuṃ tadrūpapratipādanāya anubandhā uccāryante| tataśca parārthamupādīyamānatvādapradhānyamanubhavanti| itare tu svārthamupādīyanta iti teṣāṃ prādhānyam| tena teṣāmevājiti eṣā saṃjñā bhavati, nānubandhānām| pradhānāpradhānasannidhau hi pradhānameva kāryeṇa sambandhamanubhavati, netarat| tathā cāha bhāṣyakāraḥ- `pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt siddham' iti| yadyevam, akārasyāpyeṣā saṃjñā na syāt, saṃjñāpratipādane tasyāpyaṅgabhāvo'styeva? `svasya ca rūpasya' ityanuvṛttisāmarthyāt tasya bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| etenānantaroktena kāraṇadvayena sā na bhaviṣyatīti pratipādayitumāha- `lopaśca' ityādi| balavāneva balavattaraḥ, svārthe eva tarap; `alpāctaram' (2.2.34)iti yathā| anubandhā hi itsaṃjñakāḥ, tena teṣāmacsaṃjñāyāḥ prāgeva `tasya lopaḥ' (1.3.9)iti lopena bhavitavyam; tasya balavattvāt| tadasatāṃ teṣāṃ kutaḥ saṃjñā? tasyāñcāsatyāṃ kuto'jgrahaṇeṣvackārya- sya sambhavaḥ? balavattvaṃ tu lopasya paratvānnityatvācca| saṃjñāśāstrāddhi lopa- śāstraṃ param, atastasyāpi paratvam| kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgatvānnityatvam| kṛtāyāmapi saṃjñāyāṃ lopena bhavitavyam, akṛtāyāmapi| na tu lope kṛte saṃjñā bhavati, saṃjñināma- sattvāt| yadyevam, yathā ajantaḥ patināṃ ṇakārādīnāmanubandhānāṃ prathamaṃ lopo bhavati tathā cakārasyāpi syāt, tataścājiti saṃjñā na niṣpadyate? vacanasāmarthyāt tasya prāglopo na bhaviṣyati| lupte'pi vā tasmin bhūtapūrveṇa tena sahitaḥ akāraḥ saṃjñā bhaviṣyati| ajantaḥ patināṃ tu luptānāṃ ṇakārādīnāṃ nārhita saṃjñā bhavitum; ikārādiṣu sāvakāśatvāt| ihaite akārādayo varṇā anekāvayavā iṣyante `tasyādita udāttamardhahrasvam' (12.32) `eco'pragṛhyasyādūrāddhūte pūrvasyārdhasyāduttarasyedutau' (8.2.107)iti vacanāt| santi ca keṣāñcit kecidavayavā varṇāntarasarūpāḥ, tadyathā-ṛkāre reṣaḥ lṛkāre lakāraḥ,ekāre ca aikāre cākārarekārau, okāre ca aukāre ca akārokārau| dīrgheṣvākārādiṣu hrasvā akārādayaḥ| tatra ya ete ṛkārādivarṇānāmavayavāste kiṃ varṇagrahaṇena gṛhyeranam?na vā? tatra pūrvasmin kalpe-agne iha, vāyo udakamityakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti, praṇīya, ālūyeti hrasvāśrayastuk| evamādayo'ntye'pyacasmin pakṣe doṣāḥ prasajanti, te ca bhāṣyādavadhāryāḥ| itaratra tu nuḍavidhilādeśavināmeṣu ṛkāragrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| nuḍavidhau tāvat `ṛdhu vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.1245)liṭ, anṛdhatuḥ ānudhurityatra ṛkāre rephasya halgrahaṇenāgrahaṇāt dvihaltvābhāve`tasmānnuḍa dvihalaḥ' (7.4.71) iti nuḍ na prāpnoti;lādeśavidhau-klṛptaḥ klṛptavāniti rephasya `kṛpo ro laḥ' (8.2.18) iti latvaṃ na sidhyati;vināmavidhau-mātṝṇām, pitṝṇāmiti ṇatvaṃ na syādityata āha- `varṇeṣu' ityādi| varṇeṣu ṛkārādiṣu | `varṇaikadeśāḥ' iti| rephādaya iti| varṇātmabhūtatvajñāpanārthamekadeśā ityuktam| etaduktaṃ bhavati- varṇānāmātmabhūtā ekadeśā varṇaikadeśā iti| yadi hi `ekadeśāḥ' ityetāvaducyeta, tataḥ kasyacidabhrāntiḥ syāt- `arthāntarabhūtā evaite ekadeśāḥ' iti| varṇaikadeśāstūryyādayo'pi santīti tadvayavacchedārthamāha-`varṇāntarasamānākṛtayaḥ' iti| varṇāntarasamānākṛtayaḥ iti| varṇāntaravat samānākṛtiryeṣāṃ te varṇāntarasamānākṛtayo'vayavāḥ| tato'nyairvarṇairanavayavabhūtai- stulyākṛtaya ityarthaḥ| `teṣu' iti| varṇaikadeśeṣu | `tatkāryam' iti| varṇāntara- kāryyam- akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na bhavatītyāha- `tacchāyānukāriṇo hi'ityādi| tacchāyā tadākāraḥ| varṇāntarāṇāmakārādīnāmākāramātram| te'nukurvanti; tattulyarūpatvāt, na tu ta eva| na hi tadākārānukāritvamātreṇaiva tattvaṃ bhavati| tathā hi gavi gavayāvayavānukāriṇo'vayavāḥ santi, na ca teṣāṃ tatsvabhāvatā| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ te ta eva na bhavantītyāha- `pṛthak' ityādi| prayatnaḥ prayatanaṃ sthānakaraṇavyāpāraḥ| varṇāntarahetoḥ prayatnātpṛthaganyena prakāreṇa yaṃ nirvarttyaṃ niṣpādyaṃ varṇamācāryā icchanti, tadete varṇā avayavāḥ| yadi varṇāḥ syuḥ, prayatnāntaranirvarttyāḥ syuḥ, na caivam| tathā hi- samudāyārtho yaḥ prayatnaḥ tenaiva te niṣpādyante| tadevam, agrahaṇaka- pakṣamāśrayataiva grahaṇakapakṣabhāvino ye doṣāsteṣāṃ prasaṅaḥ pratikṣitaḥ| nanu ca grahaṇa- pakṣo'pi bhāṣye vyavasthāpitaḥ; tadanuṣaṅgiṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ parihārāt, tatkasmāt sa parityaktaḥ ? bahupratividheyatvāt| agrahaṇakapakṣe tvalpaṃ pratividheyam| ataḥ sa eva vṛttikāreṇāśritaḥ| yadi tarhi gṛhyante, nuḍādividhiṣu ṛkāragrahaṇaṃ karttavyatayā sthitamevetyata āha-`nuḍ‌vidhilādeśavināmeṣu' ityādi| nuḍāvidhiṣu yaccodyamāpatati ṛkāraviṣaye tasya pratividhānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatra nuḍāvidhau tāvat-ṛkārasya repho halgrahaṇena gṛhyate| tenātrāpi dvihalo'ṅgasya nuḍbhavati- `ānudhatuḥ ānṛdhuḥ' iti| etat svayameva vṛttikāreṇa pratipadānaṃ kṛtam| atha kimayamṛkārastho repho varṇātmakaḥ ? netyāha| idānīmeva hrayuktam- `tacchāyānukāriṇo hi te, na punasta eva'iti| ye tarhi hakārādayo varṇā akṣarasamāmnāye upadiṣṭāste kiṃ varṇaātmakāḥ ? netyāha| tathā hi `hayavaraṭ' (mā.sū.5) ityādau vakṣyati- `ityetān varṇānupadiśya' iti| atha kathamidānīṃ varṇātmanāṃ halāṃ grahaṇena ṛkāsthasyāpi avarṇātmano rephasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati ? dvi- halgrahaṇasāmarthyādityabhiprāyaḥ| tatra hi `tasmānnuḍ' ityetāvadeva vaktavyam| na caivamucyamā4ne āṭatuḥ, āṭurityādāvapi prasaṅgo bhavati; `aśnoteśca' (7.4.72) ityasyaniyamārthatvāt- advihalo yadi bhavati tadaśnotereva,nānyasyeti| aśnātinivṛttyarthaṃ taditi cet ?vārttametata| yadi hyetāvat prayojanaṃ syāt, `nāśnaḥ' ityeva pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt|tadevamantareṇāpi dvihalgrahaṇaṃ siddhe yad‌dvihalgrahaṇaṃ karoti tasyaitat prayojanam-dvihalchāyānukāriṇohi yathā syāditi|yasyāpyeko mukhyo hala, aparo'vayavaḥ tatsamānākṛtitvādupacāreṇa hal‌vyapadeśarhaḥ,tasyāpi yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| etacca kathaṃ labhyate? yadi halityeṣā śrṛtistatra halchāyānukāriṇyāpi ṛkārasthāyāṃ rephavyaktau varttate, nānyathā| tasmād‌dvihalgrahaṇena ṛkārastho repho'pi gṛhyate; anyathā dvihalgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `rephaḥ' iti paraprasiddhyā tatroktam| varṇagrahaṇavādināṃ hi ṛkārabhāgo'pi `rephaḥ' iti prasiddhaḥ| sādṛśyādevamuktam| bhavati hi sādṛśyādatasminnapi tadvayapadeśa- yathā- agnirmāṇavaka iti| atha vā `rādiphaḥ'(vā.321) ityatra `varṇātkāraḥ' (vā.320) ityato `varṇāt' iti nāṇuvarttate, tenāvarṇātmakādapi rādipho bhavatati, bahulavacanādvā| ata eva lṛkārasthāllakārasarūpādavayavād avarṇātmano'pi kārapratyayo bhavatīti veditavyam| lādeśavidhāvapi -`ra' iti sāmānyamupādīyate|. tena yaḥ kevalo rephaḥ yaśca ṛkārasthaḥ- tayordvayorapi grahaṇam| `la' ityapi sāmānyameva| tato'yaṃ kevalasya rephasya sthāne kevala eva lakāra ādeśo vidhīyate| ṛkārarasyāpyekadeśavikāradvāreṇa lṛkāraḥ| cathā ca `luṭi ca klṛpaḥ' (1.3.93) ityevamādayonirdeśā upapadyanta iti| etat `kṛpo ro laḥ' (8.2.18)ityatra svayameva vṛttikṛtā pratipāditam`ra iti(1) sāmānyamupādīyate' (kāśikā. 8.2.18) iti| varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtaṃ bhedamutsṛjya yat sāmānyavarṇātmikāyāṃ ca rephavyaktau varttate yatastayorvarṇatvā- varṇatvabhedabhinnayorapi `ra' iti śabdapratyau abhinnau bhavataḥ, tāvupādīyete; na tu varṇātmikaiva rephavyaktiḥ| `tena' iti| sāmānyopādānena dvayorapi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti| tasya sāmānyasya dvayorapi sadbhāvāt| `la ityapi sāmānyameva' iti| `upādīyate' ityapekṣate| atrāpi yaśca kevalo lakāraḥ, yaśca lṛkārasthaḥ tayordvayorapi grahaṇamityetadvaya- ktavyaṃ syāt| pūrvānusāreṇa gamyamānatvānnoktam| `tato'yam' ityādi| yata evaṃ dvayorapi rephalakārayorgrahaṇam, tasmāt kevalasya rephasya sthāne lakāro'yamādeśo vidhīyate| antaratamatvādṛkārasyāpi lṛkāraḥ| nanu ca satyapi dvayorapi grahaṇe ṛkārasya sthāne lṛkāro bhavatītyetat kuto labhyate? na hi ṛkārastho repha ṛkāro bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? tadavayavaḥ| nāpi lṛkārastho lakāra ṛkāro bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? tadavayavaḥ| tatra dvayorapi grahaṇe sati ṛkārasthasyāpi rephasya lṛkārastho lakāro varṇaikadeśatayāntaratamo bhavatītyetasya codyasyāpākaraṇārthamekadeśavikāradvāreṇetyuktam|tadekadeśa ṛkārasyāvayavo rephasastasya vikāra lṛkārāvayavo lakāraḥ| atha vā ekadeśa-| atha vā ekadeśalṛkārastho lakāraḥ, sa eva vikāraḥ| ṛkārasthasya rephasya sa eva ekadeśavikāraḥ| dvāraṃ mukham, upāya iti yāvat| tena samastasyaivaṛkārasya sthāne samasta eva lṛkāra ādeśo vidhīyate| yadi hi ṛkāralṛkārābhyāṃ tatsthayośca rephalakārayoḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ sambhavet, tadā ṛkāraraikadeśasya rephasya kevalasya lṛkāraikadeśo lakāraḥ kevala śakyate vidhātum| na ca tayostataḥ pṛthagbhāva sambhavati| tasmādya- thoktena prakāreṇa ṛkārasya lṛkārādeśo vidhīyate| anantaroktasyārthasya dṛḍhīkaraṇāya `tathā ca' ityāderupanyāsaḥ| yata evamekadeśadvāreṇa ṛkārasya sthāne lṛkāra ādeśo vidhīyate| evañca sati `luṭi ca klṛpaḥ' (1.3.93) ityevamādayo nirdeśā upapadyante, nānyathā| ādiśabdena `ṛdupupadhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ' (3.1.110) `tāsi ca klṛpaḥ' (7.2.60) ityetayornirdeśayorgrahaṇam| vināmavidhāvapi `ṛvarṇācceti vaktavyam' (vā.946) ityuktvā "raśrutisāmānyanirdeśādvā siddham| avarṇabhaktyā ca vyavadhāne ṇatvaṃ bhavatīti kṣubhnādiṣu nṛnamanatṛpnoti(1) grahaṇaṃ ṇatvapratiṣedhārthaṃ draṣṭavyam| atha vā ṛvarṇādapi ṇatvaṃ bhavatītyedeva (2) tena jñāpyate" (kāśikā.8.4.1) iti vṛttikṛtā svayameva prativihitam|`raśrutisāmānyanirdeśāt siddham'iti| `ra' iti śrutiḥ upalabdhiryasyasa raśrutiḥ rephaḥ| tasya kevalasya ṛkārasthasya ca varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtabhedaṃ parityajya yat sāmānyaṃ rephamātraṃ tadiha nirdiśyate, na tu varṇatmikaiva rephavyaktiḥ| tena siddhaṃ tisṛṇām, catasṛṇām, mātṝṇām, pitṝṇām ityādāvapi ṇatvam; ṛkāre'pi tasya raśrutisāmānyasya vidyamānatvāt| syādetat- ṛkāretrayo varṇāvayavāḥ, tanmadhye repo'rdhamātrātmā, tatra raśrutisāmānyasya nirdeśenaiva sidhyati| yāsau rephāt parā'varṇabhaktistasyā vyavadhānādityasya codyasya parihārāyo- ttaro jñāpakagranthaḥ- yadayaṃ kṣubhnādiṣu ṇatvapratiṣedhāya nṛnamanaśabdaṃ tṛptanoti- śabdañca paṭhati, tenaitajjñāpyate `avarṇabhāgavyavadhāne'pi ṇatvaṃ bhavati' iti; anyathā hi tatra trayoḥ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt,prāptyabhāvāt| prāptipūrvakatvācca pratiṣedhānām| yadyapi varṇātmikaiva rephavyaktirnirdiśyate, tathāpi siddhamiti darśayitumāha- `atha vā' ityādi| pūrvasūtropāttād raśrutisāmānyacanirdeśāt parayā'varṇabhaktyā vyavahitādapi ṇatvaṃ bhavatīti jñāpitam| idānīṃ tu sūtrānupāttadṛkāradavyavahitādeve- tyeṣa viśeṣaḥ| apare tu- sarvāṇyetāni pratividhānāni varṇaikadeśagrahaṇakapakṣamāśritya vihitānītyācakṣate, etaccāsamyak; yaṃ hi pakṣamāśritya `nuḍ‌vidhilādeśavināmeṣu ṛkāre pratividhātavyam‌' (vā.1)ityuktaṃ tatraiva pratividhātuṃ yuktam; anyathā hyagrahaṇakapakṣamabhyupetya grahaṇakapakṣe'pi pratividhānaṃ kurvatā vṛttikāreṇākauśalameva kevalamā- mātmanaḥ prakaṭitaṃ syāt|| 5. hayavaraṭ| `tasya grahaṇaṃ bhavatyekena `śaścho'ṭi'ityakāreṇa iti| atra `śaścho'ṭi' (8.4.63) ityetat pradeśavākyopalakṣaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| evaṃjātīyakeṣu nirdeśeṣvakāreṇa grahaṇaṃ bhavati, na tu varṇāntareṇetyatrāyamartho'bhipretaḥ| na tvatraiva sūtre akāreṇa grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti, `aṭkupvāhanumvayavāye'pi' (8.4.2) Flf dīrghādaṭi' (8.3.9) ityatrāpyakāreṇa ghaṇasyeṣṭatvāt| atha `luṅalaṅalṛṅakṣvaḍudāttaḥ'(6.4.71) ityatrāpyakāreṇa grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? `prāksitādaḍ‌vyavāye'pi' (7.3.63) iti vacanāt| pratyāhāre hyetasminnakārādīnāṃ yo'nyamataste nālo'ntyaparibhāṣayāṅgāntarasya bhavitavyam; pratyekamaṭ‌saṃjñakatvāt, pratyekamevākārādīnāmādeśatvāt| tathā cāntyagrahaṇena grahaṇādaḍvyavadhānaṃ nopapadyate| atha pratyekamapyasaṃjñakatve samastānāmapyādeśabhāvaḥ prakalpyeta, evamanekāltvāt sarvādeśaḥ syāt, tathā ca sthānyapi sakāro na syāditi kasya kena vyavadhānānmūrdhanyo bavedabhyaṣuṇodityatra ? atha `ārdhadhātukasyeḍ valādeḥ' (7.2.35) ityatrekāreṇāsya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? `tatra vidita iti ca' (5.1.43) iti nirdeśāt| pratyāhāre hyetasmin na `ādeḥ parasya ' (1.1.54) iti ikārādīnāmanyatamastakārasyādeśaḥ syāt, tathā ca viditamiti rūpaṃ nopapadyate| atha `dīdhīvevīṭām' (1.1.54) ityatrāpīkāreṇa grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? `jayati' `sambhavati' `avaharati'ityevamādinirdeśāt| pratyāhāre hyetasmin guṇapratiṣedhādevamādayo nirdeśā na sambhaveyuḥ| yakārātparasya rephasyopadeśe sati yo doṣastamudbhāvayitukāma āha- `ayam' ityādi paropadeśastu valyantarbhāvāt `jīveradānuk' (da..1.163) jīradānuḥ, `godhāyāḥ ḍhrak' (4.1.129) gaudhera ityatra `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti vyorlopo yathā syāt, ralgrahaṇe ca vakārasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaśca | yadi hi vakārāt pūrvo repha upadiśyet, `ralo vyupadhāddhalādeḥ saṃśca' (1.2.26) iti devitvā videviṣatītyatra kitvaṃ vā syāt| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi rasya yakārāt paropadeśe prāpnotyeva vakārasya ralgrahaṇena grahaṇam, jaśāmapi madhye tasyopadeśāt ? naitadasti; ubhayorbhinnaguṇaniṣpādyatvāt bhedasya siddhatvāt| yathoktam--`(1)pṛthakprayatnanirvartyavarṇami- cchanti' iti| antaḥsthatveneṣatspṛṣṭakaraṇatvāditarasya ca sparśatvena spṛṣṭakaraṇa- tvāt| ayañca dantyoṣṭhyo vakāraḥ| yastu `jabagaḍadaś' (mā.sū.10) iṣyate, sa oṣṭhayo veditavyaḥ| nanu ca vakāreṇa vyavadhanānnayaṃ yakārāt paraḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? vakārāt para iti| tat kimucyate yakārāt para iti? vyavadhāne'pi paraśabdo varttate, yathā-bālyāt paraṃ vṛddhatvamityadoṣaḥ| atra yauvanena vyavahite'pi vṛddhabhāve paraśabdasya vṛttiḥ. yadi yakārāt para upadiśyate tataḥ kimityāha- `tasya yargrahaṇena' ityādi| yarityasyāḥ saṃjñāyā grahaṇenoccāraṇena, tathā yayitatyasyāḥ saṃjñāyā grahaṇenoccāraṇenetyartha-| atha vā- yarāṃ saṃjñānāṃ grahaṇenopadānana , yayāṃ saṃjñināṃ grahaṇenopādānenetyarthaḥ| `grahaṇe sati' iti| upādāne sati| tadgrahaṇena tu tadgrahaṇam, tasyāpi tatsaṃjñakatvāt; tadantarbhāvācca|svarnayatī- tyatra `ṛṭuraṣā mūrdhanyāḥ' iti tulyasthānatvād rephasya nakāre pare parasavarṇo ṇakārā deśo bhavati, viśeṣānabhidhānāt| nanu caivaṃ sati sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣā bādhyeta; na ha rephasyāntaratamo ṇakāraḥ prayatnabhedāt ? naitadasti; `vyaktiḥ padārthaḥ' ityetaddhi darśanamāśritya codyate| tena sthāne'ntaramaparibhāṣayā bādhānāśaṅkanīyā| yatra hyantaratamo'nantaratamaśca vidyate tatra tasyā vyāpāraḥ| na cehāntaratamo'sti, yasmādvayaktau padārthe pratilakṣyaṃ lakṣamaṃ pravarttate| ānantyāt sarvāṇi lakṣaṇāni noccāryante| tatra yadetadviṣayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tat prayatnabhedādantaratame'pi ṇakāre yadi na pravartate, tadā yasya vaiyarthyameva syāt| tasmājjātau padārthe iyaṃ paribhāṣā veditavyā,na tu dravye| `madrahdo bhadrahradaḥ' iti| aco hakārāduttaro'yaṃ repho yar bhavatīti dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, `aco rahābhyāṃ dve' (8.4.46) ityatra `yaro'nu-nāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) ityato yarityanuvarttate, tatra dvirvacane sati dvayoḥ rephayo śravaṇaṃ syāt| `ro ri' (8.3.14) ityekasya lopo bhaviṣyatīti cet? na; lope karttavye dvirvacanasyāsiddhatvāt| `halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ' (8.4.64) ityanena tarheyakasya lopo bhaviṣyati? siddhaṃ hyasmiṃllope dvirvacanam| evamapi pakṣe dvayo rephayoḥ śravaṇaṃ prasajyeta| tatra hi `jhayo ho'nyatarasyām'(8.4.62) ityato- 'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate| athāpi tannānuvartteta ? evamapi dvirvacanavidhān- sāmarthyāllopo na bhaviṣyati| anyathā hi dvirvacanavidhānamanakarthakaṃ syāt| `kuṇḍaṃ rathena' iti| `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58) iti tadanyasya parasavarṇasyāsambhavādrephasya repha eva parasavarṇaḥ syāt| `rephoṣṇaṇāṃ savarṇā na santi' iti ṭa rephasya savarṇo na bhavatītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam; varṇāntarapekṣayā taduktam, varṇāntarāṇāṃ yathāyogamatulyasthānaprayatnatvāt| rephavyaktīnāṃ tu parasparāpekṣayā sāvarṇyamastyeva; tulyasthānaprayatnatvāt| anye tu-`yayi repha anusvārasya parasavarṇo ṇakāraḥ syāt, tulyasthānatvāt' iti varṇayanti; etaccāyuktam; na hi sthānamātratulyatayā savarṇo bhavati| kiṃ tarhi ? tulyasthānatayā, tulyaprayatnatayā ca| na ca rephasya ṇakāratulyaprayatnaḥ; rephasyeṣatspṛ- tvāt, ṇakārasya ca spṛṣṭatvāt| evaṃ vyaktipadārthamāśritya pareṇa codite jāti- padārthamāśritya parihāraṃ vaktukāma āha- `naiṣa doṣaḥ' ityādi| ākṛtāviti jātāvityarthaḥ| keṣāñcit jātiḥ padārthaḥ,keṣāñcid dravyam, pāṇinestūbhayama; lakṣyānurodhāt| tat kvacit kiñcidāśrīyate| tatra jātau padārtha āśrīyamāṇe jātireva śabdenābhidhīyate, nāntarīyakatvāttu tadādhārā vyaktayaḥ pratīyante; jāterādhāramanreṇa pratyetumaśakya- tvāt| etasmin darśane tasyāstu jāteḥ sthānitvamādeśatvaṃ paratvamavyavahitatva- mityāyo dharmāḥ śabdasaṃskāropayogino vyaktidvārakāḥ| tena `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsi- ko vā' (8.4.45) ityevamādilakṣaṇaṃ pravarttamānaṃ jātimatīṣu vyaktiṣveva pravarttate, tatra pravṛtterjātau pravṛttaṃ bhavati| na ca tāsu vyaktiṣu jātiṃ prati kāsāñcidāsattirviprakarṣo vā; yataḥ kvacideva pravartteta; na sarvatra; sambandha- syāviśiṣṭatvāt| tasmāt tatra pravarttamānaṃ yatra vacanāntareṇa nyāyena vā na bādhyeta,tatra sarvatraiva pravarttate| evañca pravṛttaṃ samudāye pravṛttaṃ bhavati| `sakṛt' iti| ekavāram, na punaḥ punaḥ; sakṛtpravṛttyaiva lakṣaṇasya ca caritārthatvāt| etasmin darśane `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) ityetallakṣamaṃ kathaṃ pravartteta? kimaviśeṣeṇa sarveṣveva jātimatsu padārtheṣu pravarttate ? uta viśeṣeṇa keṣucideva ? yadyaviśeṣeṇa syāt, sa doṣastadavastha eva| atha viśeṣeṇa vācyaḥ, tarhi saviśeṣa ityata āha- `yaro'nunāsike' ityādi| etena sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣāyā upasthānāt tadvaśenāntaratameṣveva pravarttate, nānyeṣviti darśayati- `tadanena' ityādi| yata evāntaratameṣveva pravarttate, tasmādanena lakṣaṇena gakārādīnāṃ ye'ntaratamāḥ sthānaguṇābhyāmubhābhyāmapi te ṅakārādayo'nunāsikā vihitāḥ|`yathāsvam' iti| yathātmīyamiti| ye yeṣāmantaratamāste teṣāṃ vihitā ityarthaḥ| `gakārādīnām'iti| ādiśabdena jākārādīnāṃ grahaṇam|`ṅakārādayaḥ' ityatrāpi ādiśabdena ñakārādayo'nunāsikā gṛhyante| tatra sthānato guṇataścāntaratamāḥ| tadyathā- gajaḍadabānāṃ yathākramaṃ ṅañaṇanamāḥ| tathā hi- `akuhavisarjanīyāḥ kaṇṭhyāḥ' iti gakāraṅakārayostulyaṃ kaṇṭhaḥ sthānam| `icuyaśāstālavyāḥ' iti jakārañakārayostālu|`ṛṭuraṣā mūrddhanyāḥ' iti ṅakāraṇakārayo- rmūrdhā| `lutulasā dantyāḥ' iti dakāranakārayordantaḥ| `upūpadhmānīyā oṣṭhyāḥ' iti bakārakamakārayoroṣṭhaḥ| guṇastu sarveṣāmeṣavaiṣāṃ tulyaḥ; `spṛṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ sparśanām' iti| kādayo māvasānāḥ sparśāḥ| `ye tu na sthānato nāpi guṇataḥ' iti| antaratamā ityapekṣate| `te sarve nivarttitāḥ' ityanena vakṣyamāṇena samnabdhaḥ| avidhānamevaiṣāṃ nivarttanam| `sthānamātreṇa guṇamātreṇa vā' iti| tatrāpyantaratamā ityapekṣate| pūrvavacca sambandhaḥ| tatra nāpi sthānato nāpi guṇato'ntaratamā anunāsikāḥ, te yathā- gajaḍānāṃ yavalāḥ sānunāsikāḥ, niranunāsikāścāpi, te teṣāṃ sthānaguṇābhyāmanantaratamā eva| sānunāsikagrahaṇaṃ tu `yaro'nunāsike' (8.4.45) ityādau sūtre'nunāsiksayādeśatvenopādānāt| tatra gakārayakārayoryathākramaṃ kaṇṭhatālusthānatvāt sthānata āntaratamyaṃ nāsti; jakāralakārayostāludantasthānatvāt, ḍakārayakārayoryathākramaṃ kaṇṭhatālusthāna- tvāt mūrdhadantoṣṭhasthānatvāt| guṇato'pi teṣāṃ nāstyāntaratamyam; gakārādīnāṃ spṛṣṭakaraṇatvāt, yakārādīnāmīṣatspṛṣṭakaraṇatvāt; `īṣatspṛṣṭaṃ karaṇamantaḥsthānam' iti| vacanāt| antasthā yaralavāḥ| sthānamātreṇāntaratamā anunāsikāḥ| tadyathā- jadabānāṃ yam̐lam̐vām̐ḥ sānunāsikāḥ| atra jakārasya yakārastulyasthānaḥ; tayostālusthānatvāt| dakārasya lakāraḥ; tayordantasthānatvāt| bakārasya vakāraḥ; ubhayoroṣṭhasthānatvāt| yadapyantaḥsthasya vakārasya `dantāḥ'- sthānamadhikam, tathāpi yatra tayostulyasthānamoṣṭhaḥ, tatkṛtamāntaratamyamastyeva, ukāraukāravat- ukārasya oṣṭhasthānam, okārasya tu kaṇṭho'pi, `o au kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyau' iti vacanāt; tathāpi yattayostulyaṃ sthānam oṣṭhasta- tkṛtamāntaratamyaṃ bhavatyeva| yathā ca tayorekasya sthānādhikye'pi āntaratamyam, tathā bakāravakārayorapi | guṇamātreṇāntaratamā yathā- jabajānāṃ ṅaṇanāḥ; sarveṣāṃ spṛṣṭatāguṇatvāt| sthānatasteṣāmāntaratamyaṃ nāsti; jabaḍānāṃ yathākramaṃ tālvoṣṭhamūrdhasthānatvāt, ṅaṇanānāntu kaṇṭhamūrdhadantasthānatvāt| `iti' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yata evaṃ sthāna- guṇābhyāṃ ye'ntaratamāsta evānena vihitāḥ, anye tu sarve nivarttitāḥ| tasmāt sthānamātreṇāntaratamo rephasya ṇakāro na bhavati| sthānamātreṇāntaratamatvañcobhayormūrdha- sthānatvāt| guṇatastvāntaratamyaṃ nāsti; spṛṣṭatādiguṇabhedācca| `rephasya yaranta- rbhāve sati' iti| yarkāryaprāpterayaṃ hetuḥ| `yarkāryaṃ prāptam' iti| dvirvacanamityarthaḥ| taddhi yarantarbhāvāt rephasya prāpnoti yathā'nyeṣāṃ yarām| `tat' ityādi| rephasya dvirvacanaṃ prati nimittabhāvaḥ sākṣācchiṣṭaḥ - pratyakṣavihitaḥ, `aco rahābhyām' (8.4.46) iti sākṣādrephaṃ nimittatvanopādāya dvarvacanavidhānāt| yarkāryantu yarantarbhāvādanumitam| `pratyakṣānumitamośca pratyakṣaṃ balīyaḥ' kāta.pa.95) iti sākṣādvihitena nimitta sākṣādrephaṃ nimittatvenopādāya dvirvacana- vidhānāt| yarkāryantu yarantarbhāvādanumitam| `pratyakṣānumitamośca pratyakṣānumitamośca pratyakṣaṃ balīyaḥ' (kāta.pa.95)iti sākṣādvihitena nimittabhāvena rephasya dvirvacanaṃ bādhyate; tadyathā-brāhmaṇā bhojyantām, māṭharakauṇḍinyau pariveviṣṭāmitiatra hi sākṣādvihitena pariveṣaṇaṃ prati sādhanabhāvena māṭarakauṇḍinyayorbrāhmaṇatvādyo'numito bhojanaṃ prati sādhanabhāvaḥ sa bādhyate| yadyevam; dadhyudakādiṣu doṣaḥ| `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityatra hyajantarbhāvādiko yaṇādeśaṃ prati nimittabhāvo'numīyamānaḥ| yaṇādeśastu sākṣācchiṣṭaḥ; `ikaḥ' ita sākṣādikaṃ kāryimamupādāya vidhānāt| tataśca sākṣācchiṣṭena tena nimittabhāva iko bādhyate| tatra vyakteḥ padārthasyāśritatvā- dadoṣaḥ| vyaktau padārthe pratilakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pravarttata ityuktam| bhūdeṣa doṣa iti lakṣamamapyekameva, yaccārkkaḥ markka ityādau caritārtham| ato yadyapi madrahravādau dvirvacanaṃ na vidadhāti, tathāpi na bhavati vaiyarthyaprasaṅga iti| `na dvarucyate rephaḥ' iti|itikaraṇenānantaroktasyārthasya dvirvacanābhāvaṃ prati hetubhāvo dyotpate| `anusvārasya'ityādi| na kevalaṃ `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45)ityetadantaratamaṃ sakṛdeva pravarttamānaṃ vidadhāti, api tu `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4. 58) ityetadapi iti `api' śabdasyārthaḥ| syādetat- yadyapyantaratamaṃ vidadhāti, tathāpi bhavitadavyamevātra repheṇa parasavarṇena| tasyāpyantaratamatvādityata āha- `na ca' ityādi| na ca rephasya savarṇo'stīti sambandhaḥ; kiṃviśiṣṭo nāsti? anusvārāntaratamaḥ| anusvārasya sadṛśatama ityarthaḥ| iti hetorna bhavati kuṇḍaṃ rathenetyatra parasavarṇaḥ| kathaṃ punaranusvārāntaratamaḥ, savarṇo rephasya nāsti? ucyate- rephasya repha eva savarṇaḥ, nānyo varṇaḥ| sa cānusvārasyāntaratamo na bhavati; sthānabhedādguṇabhedācca| rephasya hi mūrdhā sthānam, anusvārasya punaḥ `anusvārayamā nāsikyāḥ' iti iṣyate, nānyeṣām| yadyapivargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā antaḥsthā hakārānusvārau ca yamau ca tṛtīyacaturthau nāsikyāśca saṃvṛtakaṇṭhā nādānupradānā ghoṣavantaśceti bāhyaprayatnākhyena guṇena saṃvatakaṇṭhatvādinā anusvārāntaratamo rephaḥ savarṇaḥ sambhavati, tathāpi na kaguṇamātreṇāntaratamametallakṣaṇam parasavarṇa vidhātumutsahate| yatra sthānato guṇataścāntaratamāstatrānusvārasya parasavarṇāḥ santi; śaṅkitaḥ, kuṇṭhita ityatra caritārthatvāt| atra sthānato'pyanusvārasya nāsikāsthānasya ṅaṇāvantaratamau; tayorapi nāsikāsthānatvāt| `ñamaṅaṇanāḥ svasthānā nāsikāsthā-nāśca' iti vacanāt| guṇato'pi; teṣāṃ pūrvoktairanusvāraguṇairanugatatvāt,`yathā tṛtīyāstathā pañcamāḥ' iti vacanāt| anena hi `vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthāḥ' ityādinā granthena ye'nusvārasādhāraṇā vargatṛtīyānāṃ gakārādīnāṃ guṇā uktāste ṅakārādīnāṃ nirdiśyante| guṇamātreṇāpyantaratamaṃ vidadhyādrepham, yadyasakṛt pravarttate tat| mā bhūt punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttirapārthiketi kṛtvā na cāsakṛt pravarttata ityuktam| `uraḥkeṇa'ityādi| uraḥ kāyati, uraḥ pāti| `kai śabde'(dhā.pā.916), `pā rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1056) ityābhyām `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) `āto lopa iṭi ca'(6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ, subluk, `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66) tasya `kharavasānayorvisarja- nīyaḥ| (8.3.15), `kupvoḥ ka pau ca' (8.3.37) iti yathāyogaṃ visarjanīyāvupadhmānīya- jihvāmūlīyau|| 6.laṇ| ayaṃ ṇakāro dvirbadhyate- pūrvataścaivaṃ parataścaivam| tatreṇgrahaṇeṣvaṇ‌grahaṇeṣu ca sandeho bhavati; kiṃ pūrveṇa syuḥ, pareṇa veti ? atastadapanayanārthamāhe- `iṇgrahaṇāni' ityādi| tatra yathā sarvāṇīṇgrahaṇāni pareṇa ṇakāreṇa gṛhyante tathā `aiuṇ' (mā.sū.1) ityatra pratipāditam| aṇgrahaṇāni tu yāni pareṇāni sambhāvyate, tāni pūrveṇa pratipāditāni| kāni punastāni ? `ṭhḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111) `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) `aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ' (8.4.57), `uraṇa raparaḥ' (1.1.51) ityeteṣu sūtreṣu yānyaṇgrahaṇāni| tatra pūrvasmistāvat sūtre dṛḍhādiṣu `vṛḍha'śabdapāṭho jñāpakaḥ `na pareṇāṇgrahaṇam' iti| yadi hi pareṇa syāt, `vṛḍhaḥ' iti rūpaṃ na syāt| tataśca dṛḍhādiṣu `vṛḍha' pāṭho nopapadyeta| `bṛhū udyame' (dhā.pā.1347)ityasya sūtreṣu niṣṭhāyāṃ ṭhatvaghatva- ṣṭutvaḍhalopeṣu kṛteṣu `vṛḍha' iti rūpaṃ bhavati| kiñca dīrghaśrutyā tatra `acaśca' (1.2.28) iti sannidhāpite satya ca eva dīrghatvena bhavitavyam| tathā ca yadi pareṇa, antaḥpātināmapyacāṃ dīrghatvamabhimataṃ syāt, asandehārthamajghaṇamevakuryāt| atha vā- tadapi na kuryāt; `acaśca' ityasmādeva sarvācāṃ dīrghatvasiddheḥ| tasmādaṇgrahaṇasāmarthyātpūrveṇāṇgrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| `ke'ṇaḥ'(7.4.13) ityanenāpi ke parato halāmaṇāmasambhavādacāmeva hrasvo vidhīyate| tatra yadi sarveṣāmacāṃ hrasvatvamabhīṣṭaṃ syāt| asandehārthama- jgrahaṇameva kuryāt| atha vā- tadapi na kuryāt, hrasvagrahaṇenopasthāpitāt `acaśca' ityasmādevābhilaṣitārthasiddheḥ| tṛtīyenāpi sūtreṇa padāntasyāṇo'nunāsiko vidhīyate, na ca padāntā halo'ṇaḥ santītyacāmevānunāsiko vidheyaḥ; tatra yadi sarveṣāmacāmanunāsi- ko vidhitsitaḥ syāt, asandehārthamacgrahaṇameva kuryāt| atha vā - tadapi na kuryāt; aca eva hi pragṛhyasaṃjñā bhavanti, na halaḥ| tatra ऩñivayuktanyāyena pragṛhya pratiṣedhāt tatsadṛśasyāca eva kāryaṃ vijñāsyate| tasmāt tatrāpyaṇgrahamasāmarthyāt pūrveṇaivāṇgrahaṇaṃ pratīyate| `uraṇa raparaḥ'(1.1.51) ityatrāpi `hotṛpraśāstṛṇām'(6.4.11) iti nirdeśo jñāpayati- `neha pareṇāṇgrahaṇam' iti| pareṇāṇgrahaṇe sati `nāmi' (6.4.3) iti raparo dīrghaḥ syāt' tathā ca praśāstṝṇāmiti nirdeśo na syāt| kiñca- na ca rephādanya ṛkārasya sthāne halo'ṇaḥ kvacicchāstre vidhīyante| tathā hi `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) iti rephaḥ syāt| na ca ṛkārasya sthāne `kartrartham' ityādau rephe rephapare arephapare vā vihite kaścidviśeṣaḥ, kṛte hi rapare tatraikasya rephasya `ro ri'(8.3.14) iti lopena bhavitavyam| tasmādetadapyaṇgrahaṇaṃ pareṇa ṇakāreṇa bhavadajarthamevasyāt| tatra yadi sarveṣāmacāṃ sthāne vidhīyamānānāṃ raparatvamiṣṭaṃ syāt, asandehārthamajgrahaṇaṇeva kuryāt| tadevametadajgrahaṇaṃ pūrveṇaiva ṇakāreṇa bhavatīti niścīyate| ` aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' (1) ityekamanena iti|atra ca `urṛt'(7.4.7) ityatra naiva savarṇānāmṛkāro grāhaka upapadyate,bhāvyamānatvāt, `bhāvyamānenāṇā savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na' (vyā.pa.35) iti pratiṣedhāt, naitadasti; vakṣyati hi tatra- `na cāyaṃ bhāvyamāno'ṇ, kiṃ tarhi ? ādeśāntaranivṛtyarthaṃ svarūpamevābhyanujñāyate'iti| acī- kṛtadityatra`kṛta saṃśabdane' (dhā.pā. 1653)curādiṇic, luṅa, cleḥ `ṇiśri'(3.1.48) ityādinā caṅa| `urṛta' iti ṝkārasya ṛkāraḥ, ṇilopaḥ, `caṅi'(6.1.11) iti dvirvacanam; `urat' (7.4.66) ityattvam halādiḥ śeṣaḥ, `sanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) itīttvam, `dīrgho laghoḥ'(7.4.94) iti dīrghatvam| atha kimarthamajgrahaṇamevaitanna kriyata iti ? yatra kṛte sandeha eva na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam ? naivaṃ śakyamityata āha- `antaḥsthānāmapi hi' ityādi| antaḥsthā dvi prabhedāḥ- rephavarjitāḥ sānunāsikāḥ, niranunāsikāśceti vacanāt| yavalāḥ sānunāsikā- śceti vacanāt| yavalāḥ sānunāsikaniranunāsikabhedena dviprakārāḥ; te pratyāhāre'pi niranunāsikā vā upadiśyeran, sānunāsikā vā ? yadi niranunāsikāḥ ? sayam̐yyantetyādau `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58) ityāntaratamyāt sānunāsikeṣu yakārādiṣu parasavarṇeṣu kṛteṣu teṣāṃ pratyāhāre'nupadeśād yatvaṃ nāstīti `anaci ca' (8.4.47) iti yaro dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ na syāt| aṇgrahaṇe tu satyam savarṇān gṛhṇātītyeteṣāmapi dvirvacanaṃ sidhyati| nanu ca kṛte'pi dvirvacane `halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ' (8.4. 64) ityekasya lopavidhānāt trayāṇāṃ yakārāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ na sambhavatyeva| tatkiṃ dvirvacanārthena prayojanena ? naitadasti; pākṣito hi sa lopaḥ, `jhayo ho'nyatarasyām'(8.4.62) ityanyatarasyāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tatra yasmin pakṣe lopo nāsti, tatra trayāṇāṃ śravaṇaṃ bhavatyeva|atha sānunāsikā upadiśyeran ? pratyāhāre'nusvārasya parasavarṇatvaṃ niranunāsike parato na syāt; yayāṃ madhye teṣāmasanniveśāt| `hakārādiṣu' ityādi| pratijñānunāsikyāḥ pāṇinīyā-| yatrecchanti tatrānunāsikyaṃ pratijānate, nānyatra| lakāre ca tairakārasya tat pratijñāyate, na hakārādiṣu| `(1)itsaṃjñakaḥ' iti| `upadeśe'janunāsika it' (1.3.2) itītsaṃjñā vidhānāt| tena ityādinā anunāsikapratijñāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati| ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñopasaṃkhyānādṛkāro gṛhyamāṇo lṛkāramapi gṛhṇāti, tataḥ `uraṇ raparaḥ' (1.1.51) iti yathā ṛkārasyāṇ śiṣyamāṇo raparo bhavati evaṃ lṛkārasyāpi bhavan laparaśceṣyate| tasmādanunāsikaḥ pratijñāyate| tena `ādirantyena sahetā' (1.1.71) iti `uraṇa raparaḥ' ityatra `ra' iti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ bhavati, rephātprabhṛtyā laṇo'kārāt| tasmiṃśca ṛkārasyāṇ raparaḥ bhavati, lṛkārasya tu lapara iti| tataḥ `tavalkāraḥ' ityādyupapannaṃ bhavati|| 7. ñamaṅaṇanam| `tasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati tribhiḥ' iti| atha `sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti'(6.1.58) ityatrāpyasyākāreṇa grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? `sākṣād‌draṣṭari' (5.2.91) iti nirdeśāt| pratyāhāre hyetasminnakārādyādeśavidhānād draṣṭṛśabdo na sidhyet| iha tarhi `bhrasjo ropaśrayo ramanyatarasyām' (6.4.47) iti repheṇa kasmānna bhavati? atha ramayamupāttaḥ, na tvam- ityeṣa kuto niścayaḥ? tulyā hi saṃhitā tatra bhavitavyaṃ sandehena kimayaṃ ram? āhosvidamiti? vyākhyānānniścaya iti cet? yadi tarhi vyākhyānasya niścayahetutvamabhyupeyate, tata evātra cānyatra ca sarvatraivaṃjātīyake sandehaviṣaye niścayo bhaviṣyatīti kimanyairativistaragranthakāribhirhetubhirupanyastaiḥ prayojanam ! yastu manyate `bhrasjau ropadhayo ram' ityatra vyavasthitavibhāṣayā pratyāhārasya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti, sa idaṃ syādvacanīyaḥ- kimanenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena?ramgrahaṇaṃ vikalpyate- anyatarasyāṃ ram gṛhyata iti ? atha vidhānamanyatarasyāṃ ram vidhīyata iti ? yadi ram‌grahaṇam, tato rephasyaivedaṃ svarūpeṇa makārānubandhavato grahaṇam, napratyāhārasyeti labhyate| etadvayavasthitavibhāṣayā ramāgamastu vikalpena na syāt; anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇavikalpe caritārthatvāt| na hi dvitīyamanyatarasyāṃ grahaṇamasti, yena vidhānaṃ vikalpyeta, itaratra tu pakṣe sidhyati pākṣikaṃ vidhānam; kintu yat tadabhimataṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣayā rephasyaivedaṃ makārānubandhavataḥ svarūpeṇa grahaṇam, na pratyāhārasyeti, tannopapadyate; ekatvādanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya| tasya vidhānavikalpenaivopayuktatvāt| kiñca, kutaścāyamadhyavasāyo vyavasthitavibhāṣeyamiti ? vyākhyānāditi cet; kimidānīṃ pāramparyāśrayaṇena ! vyākhyānādeva naivaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti yatkiñcidetat| ` ñakāreṇāpi pratyāhāragrahaṇamasya dṛśyate' iti| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ tribhiriyuktam ? `ñamantāḍḍaḥ'(da.u.5.7) ityatra pratyāhārasya nāvaśyaṃ grahaṇamiti darśayitum| atra hi ñakāramakārasvarūpopādāne'pi vinā pratyāhāragrahaṇenānyato'pi makārādyantāḍḍapratyayaḥ sidhyatyeva, bahulādhikāravidhānāt| nanvevamapi `caturbhiḥ' ityevaṃ vaktavyam, yamirñamanteṣvityatra ñāreṇāpyasya grahaṇadarśanātka, satyametat;yadi grahaṇamātramabhipretyaitaducyet, na cacedaṃ grahaṇamātramabhisandhāyoktam, kiṃ tarhi? grahaṇaviśeṣam, sautram| na cedaṃ sautraṃ grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? āniṭkārikam| `kecit' ityādi| yānyetānyanantaraṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇānyuktāni tāni `jhabhañ' (ma. sū.8) ityatra yo ñakārastenaiva bhavatvityevaṃ vicintya kecidācāryā makārasya pratyākhyānaṃ kurvanti| tatra tu pratyākhyāne `pumaḥ khayyampare' (8.3.6) ityādiṣu sūtreṣu makārasya sthāne ñakāraḥ karttavya iti teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ| `tathā ca sati' ityādinā makārānubandhapratyākhyāne doṣaṃ darśayati| `ṅaño hrasvādaci ṅañuṇ nityam' (8.3.32) iti hi pāṭhe jhabhorapi pratyāhārahe'ntarbhāvājjhabhāvapyāgaminau syātām- ityetacco- dyamāpatati| tayoḥ jhabhoḥ padāntayorabhāvānna bhaviṣyata iti parihāro vācyaḥ| tasminnukte, `nanu ca labherubjeśca kvipi vihita āgamināvabhau sta eva padāntau' iti punaścodyam| tasmin `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) ti bakārajakārayoḥ kṛtayoḥ kutastāviti punaḥ parihāraḥ! nanu cāgaminojhabhorabhāvādvaṣamyaṃ syāt; tathā hi-ṅaṇanāstraya āgaminaḥ,āgamāstu ṅaṇanajhabhāḥ pañca; tataśca saṃkhyāvaiṣamyānnaiṣām `yathāsaṃkhyam' (1.3.10) iti saṃkhyātānu- deśa syāditi punaścodyam; naiṣa doṣaḥ; sūtre yāvanta āgamāḥ, āgamino'pi tāvanta eva paṭhyante, tatra lakṣyamanapekṣya ṅakārādīnāmeva yathāsaṃkhyamāgamā bhavantīti sūtrārthe vihite uttarakālaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ kāryapratipattirbhaviṣyatīti| yeṣāṃ tāvadāgamānāmāgaminaḥ santi teṣāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhaviṣyati| `jhakārabhakārau tu padānatāvāgaminau na staḥ' iti kṛtvā āgamāvapi na bhaviṣyata iti punaḥ parihāro vācyaḥ| evamanekacodyaparihāreṇāgamino- rjhabhorabhāvāddhetorāgamābhāvapratipattau sādhyāyāṃ mahāpratipattigauravaṃ bhavet| tasmādayuktaṃ makārapratyākhyānamiti bhāvaḥ| 8.jhabhañ| 9.ghañadhaṣ| `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76)itīṭ| `adāgdhām' iti| `daha bhasmīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā. 991)luṅa, tasya cliḥ, `tasthasthamipām' (3.4.101) ityādinā tasastām,cleḥ sic `vadavraja'(7.2.3) iti vṛddhiḥ, prayojanāni paropadeśa evāstu; tenaiva hyetāni sidhyanti, pūrvo- padeśastu na karttavya ityabhiprāyeṇāha- `hayavaradityatra tarhi' ityādi| `aḍgrahaṇeṣu' ityādi| yadi pūrvatra nopadiśyeta,aḍgrahaṇena cāśgrahaṇena cāgrahaṇāt `mahām̐ hi saḥ' ityatra rutvānunāsikatvayatvayalopā na syuḥ| mahacchabdāt suḥ, `ugidacām' (7.1.70) iti numa; `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya ' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| mahān hi iti sthite hakāre paratastasyāḍgrahaṇena grahaṇāt `dīrghādaṭi samānapade' (8.3.9) iti rutvam, `āto'ṭi nityam‌' (8.3.3) iti pūrvasyānunāsikaḥ| aśgrahaṇena grahaṇāt`bho hakāsya haśgrahaṇe-nāgrahaṇāt tasmiṃstvasati parato rorūtvaṃ na syāt| brāhmaṇaśabdāt suḥ, tasya `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66), `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityutvam,`ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `ekasmāt' ityādi| pare grāhyā iti śeṣaḥ| syuriti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| ekasmāditi digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī| ekasmādvarṇāt‌ pare ṅakārādayo grāhyā bhaveyu rityartha| atha vā - ekasmāditi lyablope pañcamī, prāsādāt prekṣate iti (mā.sū.11) `hayavaraṭ' (mā.sū.5) ityatra yena saha ṅakārādīnāṃ grahaṇa muktaṃ sa eva veditavyaḥ| `dvābhyāṃ ṣaḥ' ityatra pare grāhyā iti yadadhyāhṛtaṃ yacca `syuḥ' iti kriyāpadaṃ tadarthādekavacanatayā vipariṇamati| dvābhyāṃ paro dvau vā uccārya ṣakāro grāhyo bhavedityarthaḥ| evamuttaratrāpyartho veditavyaḥ| kau punardvau ? `jhabhañ' (mā.sū.8) `ghaḍhaghaṣ' (mā.sū.9) ityatra yābhyāṃ ṣakārasya grahaṇamuktam, tāveva| `tribhya eva kaṇamāḥ syuḥ' iti| te punastrayaḥ - `ṛlṛk'(mā.sū2) `laṇ'(mā.sū.6) `ñamaṅaṇanam' (mā.sū.7) ityatra yaiḥ kakārādīnāṃ grahaṇamākhyātam‌, ta eva| `jñeyau cayau yai rephasya grahaṇaṃ pratipāditam, ta eva| `śalau ṣaḍbhyaḥ' iti| te punaḥ ṣaṭ- `jabaḍadaś' (mā.sū.10) `hal' (mā.sū.14) ityatra yaiḥ śakāralakārayargrahaṇamuktam, te veditavyā iti|| iti pratyāhāraprakaraṇ| atha prathamādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ 1.vṛddhirādaic|(1.1.1) vṛddhiḥ,āt aic‌- iti kecit tripadamidaṃ sūtraṃ varṇayanti| anye tu, ācca, aicc iti ādaijiti samāhāre dvando'yamiti matvā vṛddhiḥ, ādaic iti dvipadam| itaretarayoge hi bahutvādbahuvacanaṃ syāt| nanu ca samāhāre'pi `dvandvāccudaṣahāntā- ?97t'(5.4.106)iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ syāt; samāsāntavidheranityatvānna bhaviṣyati| anityatvaṃ ṣaṣṭhe jñāpayiṣyate| atha `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? `aya- smayādīni cchandasi' (1.4.20) iti bhasañjñakatvāt| ādiśabdasya prakāravācitvādaiccha- bdo'yamayasmayādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ| nanu tatra cchandasītyucyate, na cedaṃ chandaḥ, tatkuto bhasañjñā ? `chandovat sūtrāṇi bhavanti' ityadoṣaḥ| ihedaṃ sūtramanarthakaṃ vā syādyathākathañcidudāttādivacanavat ? sādhvanuśāsanārthavā, vṛddhiśabdasyādaicāñcānena sādhutvamākhyāyata iti ? prayoganiyamārthaṃ vā, ādaica para eva vṛddhiśabdaḥ prayoktavya iti ? ādeśārthavā, ādaicāṃ vṛddhiśabda ādeśo bhavati te vā tasyeti ? āgamāgamisambandhārthaṃ vā, ādaicāṃ vṛddhiśabda āgamo bhavati, te vā tasyeti ? viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaprasiddhyarthaṃ vā, ādaicāṃ vṛddhiśabdo viśeṣaṇam, te vā, tasyeti ?ekavibhaktikatvaṃ hyatra dṛṣṭam, dṛṣṭaścaikavibhaktikayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, tadyathā nīlamutpalamiti; sañjñāsañjñisambandhārthaṃ vā ? dṛśyate hi so'pyekavibhaktikayoḥ, tadyathā `ayaṃ panasaḥ' iti? tatra tāvadādyaḥ pakṣo nopapadyate| sagaṣigatajñānātiśayo hyācāryaḥ parahitapratipannaḥ samāhitacetāḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ kṛtarakṣāsaṃvidhāno maṅgalapūrvakaṃ mahatā prayatnena sūtrāṇi praṇītavān| tatrāśakyamekena varṇanāpyanarthakena bhavituma, kiṃ punariyatā sūtraprabandhena!nāpi śakyaṃ vṛddhiśabdasyādaicāṃ ca sādhutvamanena vidhīyata iti vijñātum, lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihitatvāt teṣāṃ sādhutvasya| tathā hi vṛddhiśabdo'yama- viśeṣeṇacopadiṣṭaḥ| `vṛdhu vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.759) ityataḥ ktinpratyayaḥ `striyāṃ ktin'(3.3.94) iti, `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ'(8.2.40) iti dhatvam, `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' (8.4. 53)iti dhakārasya dakāraḥ| ādaico'pyakṣarasamāmnāya upadeśāt| aico'kṣarasamāmnāya upadeśaḥ, nākārasyeti cet? avarṇajāterupadeśāt so'pi gṛhyata ityadoṣaḥ| athāpyakāravyakterupadeśaḥ? evamapyadoṣaḥ| `aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ'(1.1.69) ityakāreṇa gṛhyamāṇenākārasyāpi grahaṇāt| prayoganiyamārthamapyetannārhati bhavituma| prayoganiyamārthe hyetasmin‌ `sici vṛddhiḥ' (7.2.1) mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114) ityādāvanādaicparasya vṛddhiśabdasya prayogo nopapadyate| kathaṃ hi nāma svayameva niyamaṃ kṛtvā tamanādaicparaṃ prayuñjīta! anyastu prayoganiyamārthametanna bhavatīti pratipādayitumāha- naha ca prayoganiyamā- rthamārabhyata iti| nanu cāyaṃ prayoganiyamārthamevārabhyate `te prāga dhātoḥ' (1.4.80) iti ? te gatyapasargasañjñakā dhātoḥ prāgeva prayoktavyāḥ iti pareṇa codite parihāramāha- ` pratyākhyāyate sa yogaḥ, na vā, tathāniṣṭadarśanāt' iti| na hi prapacatīti prayoktavye kaścit pacati pra iti prayuṅkate| athāpi na pratyākhyāyeta, evamapi na doṣaḥ, yataḥ sañjñāniyamo'yaṃ na prayoganiyamaḥ, te prādayo dhātoḥ prāk prayujyamānā eva gatyupasa-rgasañjñakā bhavantīti| athāpi prayoganiyamārthaṃ syāt, evamapi na doṣaḥ, laukikānāṃ śabdānāmarthe prayuktānāṃ prayoganiyama ārabhyate, ādaicchabdaśca laukikaḥ, tasya kiṃ prayoganiyamārthena vacaneneti? tatra yaduktaṃ `pratyākhaayāyate sa yogaḥ' iti, tadayuktam| na hi sārthakasya pratyākhyānaṃ yuktam| nirarthakaḥ sa iti cet ? atrāpyanarthakatvāśaṅkāprasaṅgaḥ| yadi hyanarthakānyapi kānicit sūtrāṇi praṇītavān sūtrakāra ityeṣo'- dhyavasāyaḥ syāt| tasmāta tasya prāmāṇyamabhyupagacchatā sarvaṃ tatpraṇītaṃ yena kenacit prakāreṇa sārthakamabhyupeyam| yo'pi sañjñāniyamapakṣamāśritya parihāra uktaḥ, so'pi vṛttyā virudhyate| `te gatyupasargasañjñakā dhātoḥ prāk prayoktavyāḥ' ityanena hi vṛttigranthena prayoganiyama evāśrita iti spaṣṭamevākhyātam| na ca vṛttiṃ vyākhyātumudyatasya tadviruddhaṃ vyākhyānaṃ yujyate kartuma| yadapyuktaṃ `laukikānāṃ śabdānām' ityādi, tadapi na prayoganiyamārthatā- śaṅkāpanodāyālam| tathā hi `vibhāṣā supo bahuc purastātu(5.3.68), `avyayasarva- nāmnāmakac prāk ṭeḥ' (5.3.71), `kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi' (3.1.40) ityalaukikānāmapi bahujādīnaṃ śāstre prayoganiyamo dṛśyate, tatra bhavitavyamevāśaṅkyā, kimetat prayoganiyamārtham, athānyārthamityalamatiprasaṅgena| tasmāt pūrvokta eva parīhāro yuktaḥ| ādeśārthamapyetacchakyate na vijñātum| yadi hyādaicāmanena vṛddhiśabda ādeśo vidhīyeta, ya ete nirdeśāḥ `yāti vāti drāti psāti' (8.4.17) iti, yaśca `rāyo hali'(7.2.85) iti, yaśca `nāvo dvigoḥ' (5.4.99) iti, te nopapadyeran| atha vṛddhiśabda- syādaica ādiśyeran‌, evamapi `id‌vṛddhau'(6.3.28), `vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasya' (6.3.39)ityevamādayo nirdeśā na sambhaveyuḥ| ata evāgamārthamapyetannopapadyate| na hyādaicāṃ vṛddhiśabda āgame vihite tasya vā teṣu pūrvoktā nirdeśā upapadyante| anyastvāha- ādeśavidhāne sthānyādeśasambandhe ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam, āgamavidhānepyavayavāvayavisambandhe, na ceha ṣaṣṭhī vidyate, tasmāt ṣaṣṭhyā abhāvānnedamādeśārtham, nāpyāgamārtham iti| etaccāsamyak| vinā'pi ṣaṣṭhyā `halṅyāgbhyo dīrghāt sutisyapṛktaṃ hal' (6.1.68), `anite'(8.4.19), `antaḥ'(8.4.20), `ubhau sābhyāsasya' (8.4.21) ityāveśavidhānadarśanāt| āgamavidhānasyāpi `na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau tu tābhyāmaic' (7.3.3) iti ṣaṣṭhīmantareṇāpi darśanāt viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaprasiddhyarthamapyetann sambhāvyate| tathā hi sambhavavyabhicāre ca sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavati, nīlotpalavat| na cehādaicāṃ vṛddhiśabde tasya vā teṣu sambhavaḥ| nanu ca yathotpalaśabdaḥsarvatrotpalārthe vartamāno nīlaśabdenārthāntarādvayavacchidyata iti vyavacchidyamāno viśeṣyo bhavati, nīlaśabdastu vyavacchindan viśeṣaṇam, tathānayorapabi yo vayavacchedyaḥ sa viśeṣyo bhavati, yastu vyavacchedakaḥ sa viśeṣaṇamiti? naitadasti| ubhayorhi sārthakatve satyetadupapadyate, nīlotpalaśabdavat| na cādaico'rthavantaḥ| bhavatu nāmānayorviśeṣaṇaviśe- ṣyabhāvaḥ, tathāpi naitatsiddhyarthamidaṃ yuktam; niṣprayojanatvāt, tatpunaḥ prakṛtānupayogitvāt| śabdānuśāsane hi śāstre prakṛte yagnāma śabdasaṃskārānupayogivacanaṃ tatsarvamaprayojanam| śabdasaṃskārānupayogitvaṃ tvetatpratipaditena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvenavṛddhiśabdasyādaicāṃ vā svaraviśeṣasya vā rupaviśeṣasya vā saṃskārasyāsiddheḥ| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva eva teṣāṃ saṃskāra iti cet ? yadyevam, atyalpamidamucyate`vṛddhirādaic' (1.1.1)iti| nīlotpalamityadpi hi vaktavyam, nīlotpalādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaprasiddhaye| na coktam, ato naiṣa saṃskāro'bhimata iti nāsya tādarthyaṃ sambhāvyate| nanu tulyavibhaktikānāṃ tadguṇasamādhyāropo'pi dṛṣṭaḥ, tadyathā `siṃho māṇavakaḥ' iti, tasmāt tadarthametadbhaviṣyatīti yatpakṣāntarameke parikalpayāmbabhūvuḥ, tadarthama- pyetanna bhavati, tadguṇasamādhyāropasya sato'pyatra prakṛtānupayogitvenānarthakatvāt| tasmāt pāriśeṣyāt sañjñāsañjñisambandhārthamevaitadityālocyāha-`vṛddhiśabdaḥ sañjñātvena' ityādi| bhavatu nāma pariśeṣyāttadartham| etat kuto labhyate ? vṛddhi- śabdaḥ sañjñā, ādaicaḥ sañjñinaḥ iti| viparyayaḥ kasmānna bhavati,ādaicaḥ sañjñā, vṛddhiśabdaḥ sañjñī iti? nārhati viparyayo bhavitum| tathā hi, laghvarthatvāt sañjñākaraṇasya, yasminnuccāryamāṇe pradeśeṣu lāghavaṃ bhavati tasya sañjñārthatvena bhāvyam| vṛddhiśabde ca vibhaktike'pyuccāryamāṇe lāghavaṃ bhavati, nādaikṣu; yasmād‌vṛddhiśabda uccāryamāṇe catastro mātrā bhavanti, ādaikṣu tu pañca| na cādaicāṃ pratyekaṃ sañjñābhāvāllāghavaṃ bhavatīti śakyaṃ parikalpayitum, prayojanaviśeṣamantareṇaikasthāne- sañjñāvidhānasya niṣphalatvāt| kiñcāvartibhyaḥ sañjñā bhavanti| vṛddhiśabdaścāvartate, nādaicchabdaḥ tasmānna bhavati viparyayaḥ `vṛddhiśabdaḥ' iti| śabdagrahaṇamarthavyavacche- dārtham| asati hi tasmin śabdādarthāvagaterarthasyaiva sañjñātvaṃ vijñāyeta| yadyapi prāgeva sañjñā vihitā, tathāpi śiṣyapraśiṣyaprabandhādyuparamādvidhīyata itivartamāna prayatven nirdeśaḥ| yatra samudāsya kāryamicchati tatra ubhepadagrahaṇaṃ karoti, yathā `ubhe abhyastam' (6.1.5) iti, anvarthāṃ vā mahatīṃ sañjñām, `halo'ntarāḥ saṃyogaḥ'(1.1.7) iti| tatra hi mahatī sañjñaivamarthā kriyate, samudāyasyaiṣā sañjñāyathā syāditi| etaccottaratra vyaktīkariṣyāmaḥ| iha tu na kiñcittathāvidhaṃ vacanamasti yataḥ samudāyasyai- ṣā sañjñā syāt| tasmādekaikasyaiṣā sañjñeti manasi kṛtvāha `pratyekakam' iti| nanu cehāpi lāghavārthamekākṣarāyāṃ sañjñāyāṃ kartavyāyāṃ vṛddhiriti mahatyāḥ sañjñāyāḥkaraṇaṃ samudāyasya sañjñā yathā syādityevamartham? naitadasti| maṅgalārthatvā- dasyāḥ sañjñāyāḥ| ata evāsyāḥ prāguccāraṇam| anyathā sañjñāyāḥ sataḥ kāryiṇaḥ kāryeṇa bhavitavyamiti, yathā `adeṅguṇaḥ'(1.1.2) ityādau pūrvasañjñīnirdiṣṭa-, tathehāpi nirdiśet| ākārasya guṇāntarayuktayoścaicoḥ pratyāhāre'sanniveśānnāmī varṇā iti kasyacinmandadhiyo bhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākaraṇāyāha-`varṇānām' ityādi| pratyāsattestadbhāvitānāmevaiṣāṃ sañjñā syāditi kasyacidviparyayaḥ syāt, atastamapākartumāha-`sāmānyena' iti| vyāpternyāyādityabhiprāyaḥ| sāmānyenetyasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkartumāha- `tadbhāvitanām' ityādi| te tadbhāvitāḥ ye vṛddhiśabdenotpāditāḥ, tato'nye'tadbhāvitāḥ| āditi taparakaraṇam-`taparastatkālasya'(1.1.70) iti guṇāntarabhinnānāmapi tulyakālānāṃ grahaṇārthaṃ vā syāt, bhinna- kālānāṃ grahaṇanivṛttyarthaṃ vā ? tatr pūrvaḥ pakṣastāvannopapadyate; abhedakatvādihodāttādīnāṃ śāstre guṇānāma| kuta etat ? `luṅalaṅalṛṅakṣvaḍudāttaḥ'(6.4.71) ityudāttagrahaṇāt, anyathā hyudāttaguṇayuktamevāṭamuccārayet| dvitīyo'pi nopapadyate| yadi hyākāraḥ savarṇānāṃ grāhakaḥ syāt, tatastena bhinnakālasyāpyavarṇasya grahaṇe sati tasyāpi sañjñā mā bhūditi bhinnakālānāṃ grahaṇanivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇamupapadyate| na cāsau savarṇānāṃ grāhakaḥ, anaṇtvāt, tasya punarakṣarasamāmnāye'sanniveśāt| tasmādanarthakaṃ taparakaraṇam| tato na kartavyamevetyata āha- `taparakaraṇam' ityādi| ecorarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasay tat tathoktam| nanu ca jātau padārthe plutasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, tatrāpyavarṇajāteḥ samavayāt, tatrāsati taparakaraṇe tasyāpi sañjñā syat, tasmāt tannivṛttaya taparakaraṇaṃ bhavadākārārthamapyupapadyata eva, tatkimucyate `ejartham' iti ? evaṃ manyate- jātipakṣasamāśrayaṇe'pi hi dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyād‌dvimātrā evāvarṇavyaktayaḥ samāśritā iti gamyate, itarathā hi lāghavārtham‌ `ad‌' ityevābhidadhyāt| na ca hrasvanivṛttyarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇamiti śakyate parikalpayitum, dīrghoccāraṇe'pi hrasva- grahaṇaṃ prāpnotyeva, tatrāpyavarṇajāteḥ sambhavāditi| na cāsandehārtham `āt' ityuktam, varṇāntarāsādhāraṇatvāt, asaṃhitayā vā sandehābhāvāditi| nanu ca `taparastatkāla- sya' (1.1.70)ityatra taḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhirāśritaḥ, na cātraic taparaḥ, tatkathaṃ taparakaraṇamaijarthaṃ bhavatītyata āha- `tāvapi parastaparaḥ' iti| na kevalaṃ taḥ paro yasmāt sa tapara iti, api tu tādapi yaḥ paraḥ so'pi tapara iti apiśabdena darśayati. etaduktaṃ bhavati, na kevalaṃ bahuvrīhireva tatrāśrīyate, kiṃ tarhi? pañcamītatpuruṣo'pi| yatā caitadubhayamā- śrīyate tathā tatraivopapādayiṣyāmaḥ| iti karaṇo hetau yata evaṃ tādapi parastaparaḥ, tena taparakaraṇamaijarthamityarthaḥ|`khaṭvaiḍakādiṣu' ityādinā tadevaijarthatvaṃ taparakaraṇasya spaṣṭīkaroti| vṛkṣa elakā `vṛkṣailakā'| akriyamāṇe hyatra taparakaraṇe trimātrikasyākāraikārasamudāya syasthāne vṛddhireci'(6.1.88) iti vṛddhirāntaratamyāt trimātrika evaikāraḥ syātyadi tasyāpi vṛddhisañjñā syāt| khaṭvā odanaṃ khaṭvaudanam, khaṭvā elakā khaṭvailakā ityatrāpi pūrvottarasamudāyayoścaturmātrāyoścaturmātrāvakāraikārau syātām,tanmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti trimātracaturmātrāṇāmaicāṃ vṛddhisañjñānivṛttaye taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate| āśvalāyanaḥ, aitikāyanaḥ' iti| aśvaletikaśabdābhyāṃ `naḍādibhyaḥ phak‌' (4.1.99), `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopaḥ, `kiti ca'(7.2.118) ityādivṛddhiḥ| `aupagavaḥ' iti| upaguśabdāt `prāgdīvyato'ṇ'(4.1.83)| `aupamanyavaḥ' iti| upamanyuśabdāta `anṛṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.104)ityañ, ubhayatrāpi `orguṇaḥ'(6.4.146), avādeśaḥ (6.1.78), ` taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' (7.2.117) iti vṛddhiḥ| etāni catvāryapi tadbhāvito- dāharaṇāni| nanu ye'tra trayaḥ sañjñinasteṣāmādyaistribhirviṣayo darśitaḥ, kimartha- ścaturthopanyāsaḥ? kecidāhuḥ- vaddhinimittabhedāt, ādyayorudāharaṇayoḥ kittaddhito vṛddhernimattam, tṛtīye'pi ṇit, tacurthe'pi ñit iti| etaccāyuktam| tathā hi `iko guṇavṛddhī' (1.1.3) ityatra`akārṣīt' ityudāhṛtya `ahārṣīn' ityudāhṛtam', na ca tatra vṛddhinimittabhedo'sti| tathā `na dhātulopa ārdhadhātuke' (1.1.4) ityatra loluvaḥ ityudāhṛtya `popuvaḥ, marīmṛjaḥ' ityadhikodāharaṇopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ| na ca tatra lopanimittabhedaḥ; pratiṣedhanimittabhedo vā adhikodāharaṇopanyāsasya heturvidyate| prāyeṇā- nyaṣvepi ca sāmānyalakṣaṇeṣu vināpi nimittabhedānādhikodāharaṇopanyāsa upalabhyate| yo'pyāha `opagava ityanenaica aukārasya viṣaye darśite'pi svarabhedādaupamanyava ityetadadhikamudāharaṇamupanyastam' iti, tasyāpi tadayuktam, ata evānantaroktāddhetorveditavyam|. yadi nimittabhedaḥ, svarabhedo vā sarvatrādhikodāharaṇopanyāso veditavyaḥ| `śālīyaḥ, mālīyaḥ' iti| atadbhāvitasyodāharaṇe | atra hi vṛddhisañjñāyāṃ vṛddhiryasyā cāmādistadvṛddham' (1.1.73) iti vṛddhasañjñāphaṃ chapratyayopanyāsastasyā eva phalabhūtāyā abhivyaktyarthaḥ| vṛddhasañjñāyāṃ hi satyāṃ ` vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti jātādāvarthe cho vidhīyate| aikāraukārayostvatadbhāvitayorudāharaṇaṃ nātra darśitam, etadanusarasāra- ṇaiva gamyamānatvāt| ākārasyātadbhāvitasya vṛddhisañjñāyāḥ kārye darśite, tayorapi tadeva kāryamiti tanmukhenaiva gamyata eva| ke punasatyorudāharaṇe? `raimayam, naumayam' iti| ātraikāraukārayorvṛddhisañjñāyāṃ satyāṃ pūrvavad‌vṛddhasañjñā| tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ rāyo vikāraḥ, nāvo vikāra iti `nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ' (4.3.144) iti mayaḍ‌bhavati| 2.adeṅ guṇaḥ| (1.1.2) `taparakaraṇaṃ tviha sarvārtham'iti| sarvasminnarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| tuśabdaḥ pūrvasmādviśeṣaṃ darśayati| tatra hyaijarthameva, iha tu sarvārtham, akārārthameṅarthamapi| asati hi taparakaraṇaṃ adeṅāmaṇatvāt savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ sati bhinnakālānāmapyeṣā sañjñā syāt| tataśca `taritā' ityatrāntaratmayāddīrghasya dīrgha eva guṇasyāt|nanu ca vṛddhisañjñā guṇasañjñāyā bādhikā bhaviṣyati, tat kuto'yaṃ prasaṅgaḥ ? naitadasti| ekasañjñādhikāre hi sañjñayā sañjñāntaraṃ bādhyate, na cātrekasañjñādhi-kāraḥ| syādetat, asatyapyekasañjñādhikāre yathā `jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā'(4.1.163) iti gotrasañjñā yuvasañjñayā bādhyate, yathā ca `liṭ ca' (3.4.115), `liṅāśiṣi'(3.4.116)iti cārdhadhātukasañjñayā sārvadhātukasaṃjñā bādhyate, tathā guṇasaṃjñā vṛddhisañjñayā bādhiṣyate iti? ayuktametata| yuvasañjñāvidhau tugrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ kriyate| tato yuktaṃ yadyuvasañjñayā gotrasañjñā bādhyata iti| ārdhadhātukasañjñā'pi yat sārvadhātukasañjñā bādhyate tadapi yuktameva, `chandasyubhayathā' (3.4.117)ti vacanāt| yadi sārva- dhātukārdhadhātukasañjñayoḥ samāveśaḥ syāt, na bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, tadā `chandasyubhayathā'(3.4.117) iti vacanamapārthakaṃ syāt| iha tu na kiñcit tathāvidhaṃ nibandhanamasti, yato vṛddhisañjñayā guṇasañjñā bādhyate| athāpi kathañcidbādhyeta, evamapi trimātrikasyāpi guṇa- sañjñā syādeva| na hi sā tayā śakyā bādhitum, tasya atadviṣayatvāt| trimātrasyāpi guṇasañjñāyāṃ satyāṃ trimātro'pi guṇaḥ prasajyate| ṛkārasya hi kālato yathaikamatriko'kāro'ntaratamo na sambhavati, tathā trimātro'pi, tat kuta etallabhyate ? hrasvenaivāsya guṇena bhavitavyam na hi trimātreṇākāreṇeti| kiñca, yadi bhinna- kālānāmapi guṇasañjñā syāt, `khaṭvā indraḥ- khaṭvendraḥ khaṭvā urvī khaṭvorvī' ityatra trimātratvāt pūrvottarasamudāyātmanaḥ sthāninaḥ `ād‌guṇaḥ' (6.1.87)iti trimātro guṇaḥ syāt| khaṭvā īṣā- khaṭveṣā, khaṭvā uḍhā-khaṭvoḍhā' ityatra caturmā- mātritvāt caturmātraḥ| tasmāt sarvārthaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ kartavyam| `taritā' ityādi| `tṝ taplavanataraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.969), `ciñ cayane' (dhā.pā.1251), `ṣṭuñ stutau' (dhā.pā.1043), ebhyaḥ `ṇlul‌tṛcau'(3.1.133) iti tṛc| `ārdhadhātukasyeḍ valādeḥ'(7.2.35) itīṭ, `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti guṇaḥ, su, `ṛduśanas‌'(7.1.94) ityādinā anaṅa, `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ| etāni trīṇi yathākramadeṅāṃ tadbhāvitānāmudāharaṇāni| `paṭhanti, paṭhan' ityakārasyātdbhāvitasyodāharaṇe| atrāntyākārasya guṇasañjñāyāṃ `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ bhavati| paṭhanniti śatrantametat| ekāsyātadbhāvitasyakāryodāharaṇam- `ahaṃ pace' ityādi| okārasyātadbhāvitas tanna sambhavatīti na pradarśyate| 3.iko guṇavṛddhī| (1.1.3) `paribhāṣeyam' iti| nādhikāraḥ, asvaritatvāt| nāpi guṇavṛddhayorvidhāyakaṃ lakṣaṇam, lakṣaṇāntareṇa tayorvidhāsyamānatvāt| `sthāniniyamārthā' iti| sthānini niyamaḥ sthāniniyamaḥ, sthānyantaravyavacchedenaikatra pravartanam, so'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| `aniyamaprasaṅge niyamo vidhīyate' iti| yatra sākṣāt sthānī na nirdiṣṭaḥ `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ'(7.3.84), `sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu'(7.2.1) ityādau, tatrāniyame prasakte niyamameṣāṃ karoti-ika eva nānyasyeti. ataḥ sa evasyā viṣayo veditavyaḥ, na tu yatra sākṣāt sthānī nirdiśyate so'pi, yathā- `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) ityādiḥ| tatra hyaniyamasya prāptireva nāsti| liṅgavatī ceyaṃ paribhāṣā, liṅgaṃ cāsyā guṇavṛddhigrahaṇam, tatropatiṣṭhate| tathā ca dve ṣaṣṭhyau prādurbhavataḥ,-`ikaḥ' ityekā ṣaṣṭhī, `miderguṇaḥ'(7.3.82) ityevamādikā dvitīyā| tatra kāmacārādayatheṣṭaṃ sidhyati| tayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ kriyate| `mideḥ' ityatrānta iga na sambhavatīti tsayāṅaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ nopapadyatetasmādatrāṅgenegeva viśiṣyate- mideraṅgasya ya igiti| tena sthānaṣṭhyabhāvādalo'ntyasyānupasthāne sati yatra tatra sthasyeko guṇaḥ siddho bhavati| `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) ityādau tvaṅgasya igantatvaṃ sambhavati| tena cāṅge viśiṣyamāṇe tadantavidhau satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati| tasmādikai-vāṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, `igantasyāṅgasyeti| evaṃcaya satyasyāḥ sthānaṣaṣṭhītvāt `alo|- nttyasya' (1.1.52) ityetadupatiṣṭhachate, tenegantasyaivāṅgasya guṇavṛddhī bhavataḥ, netarasya| `svasañjñayā' iti| atra vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ| `ika eva sthāne' iti| yadartheyaṃ paribhāṣā tasya niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati- `akārṣīt' iti| `ḍukṛñ karaṇa' (dhā.pā. 1472),luṅa, `cleḥ sic' (3.1.44) sici vṛddhiḥ (7.2.1)`astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ| evam `ahārṣīt' iti| atra `hṛñ haraṇe' (dhā.899) ityayaṃ viśeṣaḥ| `ika iti kim' ita| ekadeśadvāreṇa samudāyasya paryanuyogo veditavyaḥ| na hi `guṇavṛddhī' ityetāvatā vineggrahaṇenārthaḥ kaścit saṃgṛhyate| `yānam' iti| yāterlyuṭi guṇe vidhīyamāna āntaratamyādakāraḥ syāt| tataśca dvayorakārayoḥ `ato guṇe' (6.1.97 pararūpatve kṛte `yanam' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| `glāyati' iti| `glai mlai harṣakṣaye' (dhā.pā.903.904), atra sandhyakṣarasya aikārasya ekāro guṇaḥ syāt| tataścāyādeśe kṛte glayati ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| `umbhitā'iti| `ubha umbha pūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1319,1320), tṛc, iṭ| atra vyañjanasya kārasyauṣṭhyasya okāro guṇaḥ syāt| tataścāvādeśe kṛte `ubhavitā' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| atha kathaṃ svasañjñayā śiṣyamāṇāvityeṣa viśeṣo labhyate? na hi sūtre svasañjñāgrahaṇamastītyata āha `punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇam' ityādi| ihapūrvasūtrābhyāṃ guṇavṛddhigrahaṇamanuvartate| katasminnanuvartamāne yat punariha guṇavṛddharigrahaṇaṃ kriyatetasyaitat prayojanam- `yatra svasañjñayā guṇavṛddhī vidhīyete tatrāyaṃ niyamo yathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūt'iti| punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇasāmarthyādanyatarasya guṇavṛddhigrahaṇasya sañjñāpradhānatvaṃ sampādyate| katena svasañjñayā vidhāne niyamo bhavatītyeṣo'- rtho labhyate| anyathā hi yadyevaṃ pūrvo niyamo nātrābhimataḥ syāt, tato niyatasya niya masya prakṛtaguṇavṛddhigrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhatvāt punariha guṇavṛddhigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syādityevamabhiprāyaḥ| `iha mā bhūt' ityādināryaivaṃ prakārasya niyamasya vyavacchedyatvaṃ darśayati- `dyauḥ' iti| `diva aut'(7.1.84) ityaukāraḥ| svarūpeṇa vidhīyamāno'lo'ntyasyaiva bhavati, nekaḥ| `panthāḥ' iti| `pathimadhyṛbhukṣāmāt' (7.1.85) ityākāro'ntyasyaiva bhavati, nekaḥ| `ito'tsarvanāmasthāne'(7.1.86) itīkārasya akāraḥ, `tho'nthaḥ' (7.1.87) iti thakārasya nthādeśaḥ| `iyam' iti| `tyadādīnāmaḥ' (7.2.102) ityatvamantarsayaiva bhavati, nekaḥ| `daśca' (7.2.109) iti dakārasya makāraḥ| sa ityatra tvasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā upasthāne sati tyadādyatvaṃ na syādeva| `tadoḥ saḥ sāvana- ntyayoḥ' (7.2.106) iti satvam, nanu ca `anaśca' (1.2.28) ityayamapi sthāniniyamaḥ svasañjñāvidhāna eveṣyate, tasyāpi ca niyamasya dyaurityādikaṃ vyavacchedyam| tathā hi vṛttikārastatra vakṣyati `svasañjñayā vidhāne niyamaḥ| ajiti vartate| iha mā bhūt, dyauḥ, panthāḥ, saḥ, dyubhyām, dyubhiḥ' (kā 38) iti, tataśca yadanena niyamenaivaṃvidhena karttavyaṃ tattenaiva sidhyati, nārtha evaṃvidhayaniyamarthena punariha guṇavṛddhigrahaṇena? satyametat' kintvevamarthapratipattau ya ete mandadhiyaḥ prāthamakalpikāḥ śrotāraḥ, teṣāṃpratipattigauravaṃ syāt| tasmāt tānanugrahītaṃ vispaṣṭārthamiha sañjñāvidhāne niyamaṃ pratipādayituṃ punarguṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam. tadyevam, yat yena vidhātavyaṃ tadanenaiva vihitamiti tatra sañjñāvidhāne niyamo na karttavyaḥ ? naitadasti; yadi hyasāvitthambhūto niyamo na syāt, tato `dyubhyām dyubhiḥ' ityatra `diva ut'(6.1.131) ityukāraḥ svarūpeṇaiva vidhīyamāno'ca eva sthāne syāt, nālo'ntyasya| na hyanena niyamenācaḥ śakyate vyāvartayitum, tasya guṇavṛddhisañjñakatvāt| 4.na dhātulopa ārdhadhātuke| (1.1.4) uktaparimāṇasya śabdasya dhātusañjñā kṛtā| tasya sarvasya lope kṛte yatra guṇavṛddhī prāpnutastadārdhadhātukena sambhavatyeva, tat kiṃ pratiṣedhena ? tasmāt pratiṣedhavidhānasāmarthyāddhātvekadeśe dhātuśabdo vartata iti matvāha- `dhātvekadeśo dhātuḥ' iti| `dhātulope'iti| yadyayaṃ dhātorlopo dhātulopa iti tatpurūṣaḥ, tata ārdhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ guṇavṛddhiviśeṣaṇaṃ vā syāt- `dhā4tulope satyārdhadhātukanimitte ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaste na bhavataḥ' iti| lopaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā syāt-` ārdhadhātukanimitte dhātulope sati guṇavṛddhī na bhavataḥ' iti? pūrvasmin `knopayati'ityatra pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti| tatra pratividhānaṃ kartavyam| dvitīye tu na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| na hi
