`knopayati' ityatrārdhadhātukanimittalopaḥ, kiṃ tarhi, katavalnimittakaḥ| kintu dvitīye pakṣe preddhamityatra prāpnoti| asti hyatrārdhadhātukanimitto lopaḥ| nanu ceglakṣaṇayorguṇavṛddhayorayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ; na cātreglakṣaṇo guṇaḥ ? naitadasti; atrāpīglakṣaṇa eva guṇo yo hyubhayoḥ sthāne bhavati, labhate so'ntayataravyapadeśam| tathā hi- `mātuḥ, pituḥ' ityatrobhayoḥ sthāne bhavan raparo'ṇ bhavati| tasmāllopaviśeṣaṇapakṣe'pi tatpuruṣe pratividhānaṃ karttavyameva| bahuvrīhau tu na kiñcit pratividheyamiti manyamāno bahuvrīhirayamiti darśayannāha- `tasya' ityādi| etena lopaviśeṣaṇamārdhadhātukamityetaddarśitaṃ bhavati| evaṃ cārdhadhātuke sambhavati yadi tattasya nimittaṃ bhavati, tataśca knopayatītyatrātiprasaṅgo nāvatarati| `tatra' ityādi| nāpi guṇavṛddhyorārdhadhātukaṃ nimittvena viśeṣaṇamityā- khyātam| tataśca preddhamityatrāpyatiprasaṅgo na bhavati, na hyādguṇa ārdhadhātuka- nimittaḥ| `ye te' iti| strīliṅganirdeśaḥ `guṇavṛddhī'ityanena strīliṅgena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| asya tu strīliṅgatā `paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ' (2.4.26) ityatideśāt| arthasya ca so'tideśa iti yattadorapi tatrārthe vartamānayoḥ strīliṅgatā bhavati| nanu ca niyamasya prakṛtatvāt tasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedho yuktaḥ, tat kimityevamāha-`tatra ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaste na bhavataḥ' iti| tayoḥ prādhānyāt| tat punarniyamenopakriyamāṇatvāt, niyamasya tu tādarthyādaprādhānyam| tasmād‌guṇavṛddhayorevāyaṃ pratiṣedho nyāyyaḥ| `loluvaḥ, popuvaḥ' iti| `lūñ chedane' (dhā.pā.1483), `pūñ pavane (dhā.pā.1482)ityetābhyāṃ `dhātorekācaḥ' (3.1.22) ityādinā yaṅ, `sanyaṅo' (6.1.9) iti dvirvacanam, `guṇoyaṅalukoḥ' (7.4.82) ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ, yaṅantāt pacādyaci `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti luki tannimittaguṇapratiṣedhaḥ, tasmin sati `aci śnudhātukabhruvām' (6.4. 77) ityādinovaṅa| `marīmṛjaḥ' iti| `mṛjū śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1066), pūrvavadyaṅa, dvirvacanam, uradattvam, (7.4.66) `halādiḥ śeṣaḥ' (7.4.60) `rīgṛdupadhasya ca' (7.4.90)iti rīgāgamaḥ| lolūyādibhya ityādiśabdena `popūya, marīmṛjya' ityetayorgrahaṇam| `lūñ- lavitā' iti| yāvadeva dhātusañjñā na bhavati tāvadeva `sarvavidhibhyo lopavidhirbalīyāt' (vyā.pa.70) iti ñakārasya lopo bhavati, paścāllū ityetasya dhātusañjñā, tena ñakāralopo dhātulopo na bhavatīti bhavati pratyudāharaṇam| `reḍ ' iti| `riṣa ruṣa hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1232,1230), `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante'(3.2.75) iti vic, ikāracakārau `verapṛktasya'(6.1.67) ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārtho, vakārasya cānenaiva lopaḥ, `pugantalaghūpadhsya ca' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ| `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti ṣakārasya ḍakāraḥ| nanu ca dvayaṅgavikale dve api ete pratyudāharaṇe, tathaiva hyatra dhātulopo na bhavati, evamārdhadhātukanimi-tto'pi na bhavati, naitadasti; sati hi dhātugrahaṇe padadvayasānnidhyādbahuvrīhirlabhyate| tasmiṃśca satyārdhadhātukanimattatvaṃ lopasya| asati hi dhātugrahaṇe `na lopa ārdhadhātuke' ityucyamāne `ārdhadhātukāśraye ye guṇavṛddhī pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| `roravīti' iti| ` ru śabde' (dhā.pā. 1034) ityasmādyaṅa, `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.73) iti yaṅo luk, laṭ,tip, śap| adāditvācchapo luk (2.4.72(,`yaṅo vā'()7.3.94) itīṭ| atra sārvadhātukanimitto guṇo na pratiṣidhyate| nanu ca dvayaṅgavikalamevedam, yathaiva hyārdhadhātukanimitto guṇo na bhavatyevaṃ lopo'pi ? naitadasti; sati hyārdhadhātukagrahaṇe'nyapadārthatve na tasyāśrayaṇāt tannimitto lopo labhyate, tasmiṃśca sati `na dhātulope' itīyatyucyamāne `ye kecana guṇavṛddhī te ca lope sati bhavataḥ' ityeṣa vākyārthaḥ syāt| tataścāviśeṣitatvāllopasya lopamātre pratiṣedho vijñāyate| `abhāji' iti| `bhañjo āmarddane' (dhā.pā. 1453),luṅ, cliḥ, `ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ'(3.1.66) iti ciṇ, `iṇo luk' (6.4.104)iti taśabdasya luk, `bhañjeśca ciṇi' (6.4.33) ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `rāgaḥ' iti| atrāpi `ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' (6.4.27) iti nalopaḥ| `rañja rāge' (dhā.pā.1167), bhāve ghañ| yadyapyatra sravamasti tathāpīka ityatrānuvṛtteriha ceko'sambhavāt ` ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddheḥ prāptāyāḥ pratiṣedho na bhavati| `knopayati' iti| "knūyī śabde" (dhā.pā.485), `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic, `arttihrī' guṇaḥ| `preddham' iti| `ñiindhī dīptau' (dhā.pā.1448), ktaḥ, `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityā-dinānunāsikalopaḥ, `jhaṣastarthorgho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti takārasya dhatvam| `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi'(8.4.53) iti dhātudhakārasya dakāraḥ, pragatamiddhamiti `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| 5. kṅiti ca| (1.1.5) kṅitīti yadīyaṃ parasaptamī syādanantarasyaivekaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, `citaḥ, citavāt' ityādau vyavahitasya `bhinno bhinnavāt' ityādau na syāt, `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe spūrvasya' (1.1.66) ityatra nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantararyārthatvāt| nimittasaptamyāṃ tvasyāṃ sarvatra bhavitavyam, vyavahitayorapi nimittanimittibhāvasadbhāvā- diti manyamāna āha- `nimittasaptamyeṣā' iti| nimittāt saptamī nimittasaptamī| `pañcamī bhayena' (2.1.37) iti `pañcamī' iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ| sā punaḥ saptamī `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' (2.3.37) ityanena veditavyā| kṅito hi nimittabhāvena guṇavṛddhayoḥprāptilakṣaṇo bhāvo lakṣyate| atha nimittasaptamyāmapyasyāṃ kasmādeva vyavahitas pratiṣedho labhyate? tatra tasmin (1.1.66) ityādikāyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anupasthānāt| `kṅiti ca' (1.1.73) ityādarāvapyasyā ik‌paribhāṣāyā upasthānāt `śālīyaḥ, mālīyaḥ' ityatra vṛddharasañjñā na syāta| yatā ceyamik‌paribhāṣā vidhyaṅgaśeṣabhūtatvādvidhāvevopatiṣṭhate, tathāsāvapyānantaryaparibhāṣā| na ceha guṇavṛddhī vidhīyete, kiṃ tarhi ? vihite apyanyatra kṅitītyanena viśiṣyete| tasmānnātra tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā upasthānamityana-ntarasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati| `kṅinnimitte ye guṇavṛddhī' iti| kṅinnimittaṃ yayoste tathokte| te punarye kṅinnimitte sati prāpnutaste vijñeye| etena guṇa- vṛddhīviśeṣaṇaṃ kṅid‌grahaṇamiti darśayati| nanu ca vidhīyamānatayā prādhānyāt pratiṣedha- syaivaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam ? naitadasti; yatra hi guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāraḥ pradhānopakārāya mahate prabhavati, tatra pradhānasyaiva bhūyāṃsamupakāraṃ kartumātmanaḥ saṃskāramanubhūya pradhānena sambandhamanubhavati| yathoktam- `guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāraḥ pratipadyate| pradhānasyopakāre hi tathā bhayasi vartate|| iti| iha tu guṇavṛddhayoḥ kṅiddagrahaṇena viśeṣitayormahāna pradhānasya pratiṣedhasyopakāro bhavati, vyavahitasyāpi tatsiddheḥ| `bhinnaḥ' iti| `bhidir vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā. 1439),ktaḥ, `radābhyāṃ niṣṭhātonaḥ'(8.2.42) iti natvam| `mṛṣṭaḥ' iti| mṛjeḥ `vraśca'(8.2.36) ityādinā jakārasya ṣatvam, `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ'(8.4.41) iti ṣṭutvam| cinuta ityādau tu `sārvadhātukamapit'(1.2.4) iti kṅittvam| `cinvanti'iti| `huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke'(6.4.87) iti yaṇādeśaḥ| atra `citaḥ, citavān, stutaḥ, stutavān, cinataḥ, cinvanti' ityeṣūdāharaṇeṣu yatāyogaṃ sārvadhātukārdhadhātukalakṣaṇasya guṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ, `bhinnaḥ bhinnavān' iti laghūpadhalakṣaṇasya, pariśiṣṭeṣu `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114) iti vṛddheḥ| `glājisthaśca ksnuḥ' iti| ksnupratyayo'yaṃ yadi kit syāt, sthāsnurityatra ghumāsthādisūtreṇa (6.4.66) tiṣṭhaterīttvaṃ syāt| atastatparihārāya ksnorgittvaṃ pratijñāyate| tathā hi tatra vakṣyati-`giccāyaṃ pratyayo na kit| tena stha īkāro na bhavati'(kā.241) iti| gitve ca sati `bhūṣṇuḥ, jiṣṇuḥ' ityatra`kṅitica' (1.1.5) iti pratiṣedha ucyamāno na prāpnoti| ata etaddoṣaparihārāyāha- `gakāro'pyatra' ityādi (kā241)|carttvabhūtaḥ cartvaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ| cartvaṃ tu ` khari ca'(8.4.55) iti. yadi hi ksnorgittvamiṣyate, bhūṣṇurityatra `śrayukaḥ kiti'(7.2.11) iti kiti pratiṣedha ucyamāno na syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tatrāpi carttvabhūto gakāro nirdiśyate| tathā hi -`glājisthaśca ksnuḥ' (3.2.139) ityatra jayādityavṛ- ttau granthaḥ- ``kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) ityatra gakāraścarttvabhūto nirdiśyate, tena guṇo na bhavati| `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) ityatrāpi gakāro nirdiśyate, tena bhuva iḍ na bhavati'(kā. 241) iti| `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) ityatrāpi jayādityavṛttau granthaḥ- `gakāro'pyatra carttvabhūto nirdiśyate bhūṣṇurityatra yathā syāt' iti| vāmanasya tvetat sarvamanabhimatam| tathā hi tasyaiva sūtrasya tadviracitāyāṃ vṛttau granthaḥ- kecidatra dvikakarānirdeśena gakārapraśleṣaṃ varṇayanti bhūṣṇurityevaṃ yathā syāt| sautratvācca nirdeśasya `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) ityatra cartvasyāsiddhatvamanā- śritya rorutvaṃ na kṛtam, visarjanīyaśca kṛtaḥ iti| `glājisthaśca ksnuḥ' (3.2.139) ityatra sthā ā ityakārapraśleṣeṇa sthāsnoḥ siddhatvānna kiñcadetat"(kā 802) iti| sa evaṃ manyate- yadi ksnupratyayayasya kittve sati tiṣṭhaterīttvaṃ prāpnuyāt tathā tatparihārārthaṃ gittvaṃ yujyate pratijñātuma| gittve ca sati jiṣṇuḥ, bhūṣṇuḥ' ityatra yathāyogamiḍ‌guṇayornirāsāya `kṅiti ca'(1.1.5) ityatra `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) ityatra ca gakāraścartvabhūto nirdiśyamānaḥ śobheta| na ca ksnupratyayo git,kiṃ tarhi ? kideva| tatkimiḍ‌guṇpratiṣedhārthena carttvabhūtagakārasya nirdeśena !na ca ksnoḥ kittvesati tiṣṭhaterātvaṃ prāpnoti| tasmāt ` glājisthaśaaca ksnuḥ' (3.2.139) ityākārapraśleṣaḥ kṛtaḥ, ksnupratyayāntasya tiṣṭhaterākāra eva yathā syāt, yadanyat prāpnoti tanmā bhūt ityevamarthaḥ| tataśca tenaiva siddhatvāt sthāsnuśabdasyākiñcitkaramiha gakārapraśleṣavarṇanamiti. `kāmayate' iti| `kamerṇiṅa'(3.1.30)| atra `ata upadhāyāḥ'(7.2.116) iti vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho na bhavati| `laigavāyanaḥ' iti| liguśabdāt `naḍādibhyaḥphak' (4.1.99) iti phaki kṛte `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) iti guṇasya pratiṣedho na bhavati| nanu cokāraigeva, tadayuktamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇam ? naitadasti; atra hi cakāraḥ kriyate `ikaḥ' ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tatra cakāreṇānukarṣaṇasā- marthyādika ityetadarthapadārthatāmutsṛjya svarūpapadārthatāmanubhavati| anyathā hi yadi cakāreṇādhyanukṛṣyamāṇamarthapadārthakameva syāt tadanukarṣaṇārthaṃ cakārakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, arthapadārthasya svaritatvādevānuvṛttisiddheḥ| svarūpapadārthake ca tas‌minniha sanni- hite satyayamartho bhavati, `ikaga ityevaṃ ye guṇavṛddhī vidhīyete, ika itīmaṃ śabdamucārya ye guṇavṛddhī vidhīyete, te kṅinnimitte na bhavataḥ' iti| na ca `laigavāyanaḥ' ityatra ikaḥ' itīmaṃ śabdamucārya guṇo vidhīyate, ikparibhāṣāyāstatrānupasthānāt| anupasthānaṃ tu sākṣādukārasya sthānino nirdeśāt| yatra hi sākṣāt sthānī na nirdiśyate tatrāsāvupatiṣṭhate| nanu yadi svarūpapadārthasyeka ityasyeha sannidhānam, sthānī na nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt, tataśca na jñāyate kasya guṇavṛddhī pratiṣidhyete iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ| sāmarthyādika eva guṇavṛddhayoḥ pratiṣedho'yaṃ gamyate| na hyanyasyeka itīmaṃ śabdumu- ccārya guṇavṛddhī vidhīyete| atha vā " yadyapīkparibhāṣā vidhyaṅgaśeṣabhūtā, tathāpīhāsa- tyapi guṇavṛddhayorvidhāne cakāreṇānukṛśaṣya sannidhāpyate| etadeva hi cakārakaraṇasya prayojanaṃ yadidamikparibhāṣāyāḥ sannidhāpanam| tataśca tasyā upasthāne sati yatrāsau vyāpriyate tatraivāyaṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate| kva cāsau vyāpriyate ? yatra sthānī sākṣānn nirdiśyate. iha tu nirdiśyate sthānī, tasmādikparibhāṣāyā vyāpārābhāvādbhavati pratyudāharaṇ| `mṛjeḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇāpi sā labhyate ? yathā labhyate tathā śrūyatāma| `aco ñṇiti' ś(7.2.115) ityatra `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114) iti vartate, `jarāyā jarasanyatarasyām' (7.2.101) ityato'nyatarasyāṃ grahaṇaṃ ca maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| `acaḥ' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate| mṛjerajādau saṃkrame vibhāṣā vṛddhirbhavati, anyatra na bhavatyeva| `laghūpadhaguṇasyāpyatra pratiṣedhaḥ' iti | etena saṃkramatvaṃ darśayati| anye tu uttarasūtre `kaṇitā śvaḥ' raṇitā śvaḥ' ityanantaramanena granthena bhavitavyam,iha tu durvinyastakākupadajanitabhrāntibhiḥ kulekhakairlikhitamiti varṇayanti| atha vā- nimittasapta- myā evedaṃ phalaṃ darśitamiti mantavyam| `acinavam, asanuvam' ityatra laṅo ṅitvāt tadādeśasyāpi mipo ṅittvam| sthānivadbhāvena mipo ṅittvāt tadādeśasyāpyamo ṅittvaṃ pūrvavat, tataśca tadāśrayo vikaraṇasya guṇapratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti| kasmānna bhavatītyāha- `acinavam' ityādi| ādiśabdena `akaravam' ityādināṃ parigrahaḥ| `lakārasya' iti| lakārādeśo'pi pāramparyeṇa lakārapūrvakatvādupacāreṇa lakāra ityuktaḥ| satyapītya- bhyupagame `halaḥ śnaḥ śānajjhau' (3.2.83) iti śānajādeśasya śitkaraṇālliṅgānnāvaśyamanubandhakāryeṣu sthānivadbhāvo bhavatītyadhyavasito'yamarthaḥ| ato ṅittvavacam' ityādi| yadi ṅiti yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate tallakāre ṅiti syāt, tato liṅa eva ṅittvena cinuyādi- tyādau guṇapratiṣedhasya siddhatvāt `yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣūdātto ṅicca' (3.4.103) iti yat tasya yāsuṭo ṅdvicanaṃ tanna kuryāt, kṛtañca; tato'vasīyate- `ṅiti yat kāryaṃ tallakāre iti na bhavati' iti| 6. dīdhīvevīṭām| (1.1.6) `dīdhīvevyoḥ' iti| dīdhīṅa dīptidevanayoḥ' (dhā.pā. 1076); `vevīṅa vetinā tulye (dhā.pā.1077) ityetayorgrahaṇam| nanu ca `dīṅa kṣaye' (dhā.pā. 1134) `dhīṅa anādare'(dhā.pā.1136), `veñ tantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1006) `vī gatiprajanakāntyasanakhādaneṣu' (dhā.pā.1048) ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? yadyeṣāṃ grahaṇamabhimataṃ syādasandehārthaṃ `vīvedhīdīṭām' ityevaṃ nyāsaṃ kuryāt| anyathā tu kṛtam| tasmāt pūrvoktayoreva dhātvoriha grahaṇam| iṭaśceti- `ārdharadhātukasya' (7.2.35) ityādinā vihitasya| atha `iṭ, kiṭa, kaṭī gatau' (dhā.pā.318,319320) ityasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati, yuktaṃ caitat, dhātusāhacaryāt ? naitadasti; iha`alpāctaram' (2.2.34) ita iṭaḥ pūrvanipāte karttavye tadviparyāsaṃ kurvataitat sūcitam-`anyo'- pyatra kaścidviparyāso vijñeyaḥ' iti| tena dhātusāhacaryāddhātugrahaṇe prāpte tadviparītasyaivāgamasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| `ādīdhyanam' iti| lyuṭ| `ādīdhyakaḥ' iti| ṇvul|`kaṇitā śvaḥ, raṇitā śvaḥ' iti| `aṇa raṇa kaṇa' (dhā.pā.444,445,449) ityādau śabdārthe dhātuvarge kaṇiraṇī paṭhyete , tābhyāṃ luṭi syatāśī lṛluṭoḥ' (3.1.33) iti tāsiḥ, `luṭaḥ prathamasya '(2.4.85) ityādinā tiṣo ḍādeśaḥ, ṭilopaḥ, `ārdhadhātukasya' (7.2.35) ityādineṭ| atheṭo vṛddherudāharaṇaṃ kasmānna pradarśitamityāha- `vṛddhiriṭo na sambhavati' iti| aṅgasya vṛddhirñṇidādau pratyaye vidhīyate iṭ cāyamārdhadhukabhavataḥ| na cārdhadhātukasyāṅasañjñāsti ñṇidādau pratyaye| tasmādiṭo vṛddhirna bhavati| 7. halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ| (1.1.7) antaraṃ chidraṃ vivaraṃ varṇaśūnyaḥ kāla ityarthaḥ| na vidyate'ntaraṃ yaṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| `bhinnajātīyaiḥ' ityādi| bhinnajātīyairiti vacanaṃ bhinnajātīyānāmeva loke vyavadhāyakatvadarśanāt| tathā hi kaścit kenacit kimanantare pare brāhmaṇakule iti pṛṣṭaḥ sannāha- nānantare, vṛṣalakulamanayormadhye prativasīti| `śliṣṭoccāritasya halaḥ sañjñā syādiha nirvāyāy, niryāyāditi `vānyasya saṃyogādeḥ' (6.4.68) ityetvaṃ syāt, iha ca `saṃskaṣīṣṭa' iti `ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ' (7.2.43) itīṭ, iha ca `saṃskriyate' iti `guṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ' (7.4.29) iti guṇaḥ- ityevamādayo'nye'pi bahavo doṣāḥ pratyekaṃ halāṃ sañjñitve bhāṣya udbhāvitāḥ| yadyapi tatraiva te katha- ñcit prayāsena parihṛtāḥ, tathāpi yastu tatparihāreṇa pratipattau sādhyāyāṃ prati- pattigauravadoṣa āpadyate so'parihārya eva| samudāye tu sañjñini doṣāśaṅkā'pi nāsti| tasmāt sa eva sañjñī yukta ityālocyāha- `samudāyaḥ sañjñī' iti| nanu ca yatra sahabhūtānāṃ kāryamicchati tatra yatna ārabhyate, yathā- `ubhe abhyastam' (6.1.5) iti ubhegrahaṇaṃ karoti, na ceha kaścidyatnaḥ kṛtaḥ, tatkathaṃ samudāyasya sañjñā labhyate ? ihāpi kṛta eva yatna ityadoṣaḥ| punarasau ? mahatyāḥ sañjñāyāḥ karaṇam| `laghvarthaṃ hi sañjñākaraṇam' (vyā.pa.135) iti mahatyāḥ sañjñāyāḥ karaṇaṃ prayojanamantareṇa na sambhāvyate| tasmānmahānatra sañjñītyetat sūcayituṃ mahatī sañjñā kṛteti gamyeti| tathā coktam- `iṅgitenonmiṣitemana mahatā vā sūtraprabandhenācāryāṇāmabhiprāyo lakṣyate' iti| evaṃ ca mahān sañjñī bhavati, yadi samudāyaḥ sañjñī bhavati, naikaiko hal| tasmādupa- pannametat samudāyaḥ sañjñīti `halaḥ' iti bahuvacananardeśād‌dvayoḥ sañjñā na siddhyatīti yaścodayet taṃ pratyāha- `jātau ca ' ityādi| caśabdo yasmādarthe| yasmājjātau bahuvacanaṃ tena dvayorbahūnāṃ ca saṃyogasañjñā siddhā bhavati| agnirityādikaṃ rūpodāharaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam `tilānstrāvapati' ityādi| `he mapare vā' (8.3.26) ityato veti varttamāne , `ḍaḥ si dhuṭ' (8.3.29) ityato dhuḍiti ca, `naśca' (8.3.30) iti pakṣe dhuṭ, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti ca takāraḥ| tatra yadā dhuṇ‌nāsti tadā`nasatayāḥ' iti| yadā tvasti tadā `natasatarayāḥ'| `titaucchatram' iti| `tanoterḍauḥ sanvacca(da.u.1.160) iti ḍau- pratyaye ṭilope dvirvacane ca kṛte rūpam| `saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ'syāt iti| yadya- trākārasyokāreṇa sañjñā syādityabhiprāyaḥ| na ca lope satyukāropadeśasya vaiyarthyamāśaṅkanīyam| yatra padasañjñā nāsti titaunītyādau, tatra śrūyamāṇatvāt| `pacati' iti rūpapratyudāharaṇam, `panasam' iti kāryapratyudāharaṇam `skoḥ saṃyogādyoriti lopaḥ syāt' iti| yadi sakāranakārayoḥ sāntarayorapi saṃyogasañjñā syāditi bhāvaḥ| 8.mukhanāsikāvacano'nunāsikaḥ| (1.1.8) `mukhasahitā nāsikā mukhanāsikā' ityanena mukhanāsikāśabdo'yaṃ tatpūruṣaḥ, na dvandva iti darśayati| tat‌puruṣastu mayūravyaṃsakāditvādveditavyaḥ| yadi ca mukhaṃ ca nāsikā ceti dvandva syāt, prāṇitūryādisūtreṇa (2.4.2) ekavadbhāvaḥ syāt| tataśca `sa napuṃsakam' (2.4.17) iti napuṃsakatvaṃ syāt| tasmiṃśca sati `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya'(1.2.47) iti hrasvatvaṃ prasajyeteti bhāvaḥ| nanu cocyate- anayeti karaṇe lyuṭi kṛte, tadantāt `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) ityādinā ṅīpā bhavitavyam, tataśac tadantena bahuvrīhau `mukhanāsikāvacanaḥ' iti nirdeśo nopapadyate ? naitadasti; vacanaśabdo'yaṃ `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti bahulavacanāt karmasādhanaḥ- ucyata iti vacano varṇe vartate, na nāsikāyām| ata evāha- `tayā ya uccāryate' iti|` uccāryate' iti karmaṇi lakāraḥ| evaṃ kṛtvā `mukhanāsikāvacanaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yaṃ veditavyaḥ, na bahuvrīhiḥ| `anusvāsyaiva' iti| anusvāre hyucyamāne nāsikāyāśca vyāpāro na mukhasya ; tena tasyaiva syāt, na tu syāt ñamaṅaṇanānām ; nāpi `abhra ām̐ apaḥ' (ṛ.5.48.1) ityātrārdhacandrākṛtervarṇasya; taduccāraṇe mukhasyāpi vyāpārāt| tataśca `yaro' nunāsike ' (8.4.45) ityetasmin kārye karttavye'nusvārasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na tu ṅakārādīnāmityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca prāsādavāsinyāyena teṣāmapi bhaviṣyati ? yathā `prāsādavāsina ānīyantām' ityukte ye prāsāda eva nivasanti, teṣāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, ye'pi prāsāde bhūmau ca ubhayatra vasanti teṣāmapi| yathā hyabhaya ānīyante, tathehāpi `nāsikāvacanaḥ' ityetāvatyucyamāne nāsikāvacanasyānusvārasya mukhānasikāvacanānāṃ ca ṅakārādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati,tataścānusvārasya hi syādityayuktamuktam. evaṃ tu vaktavyam- anusvārasyāpi hi syāditi ? naitadasti; iha hi trīṇi darśanāni sambhavanti,-` samasta evānunāsiko varṇao nāsikāvacano mukhavacanaśca' ityekaṃ darśanam; ` pūrvabhāgastvasya mukhavacanaḥ' iti tṛtīyam| ubhayorapyanantarayordarśanayornāsikāmukhavacane bhāge tathānurāgaṃ karoti yathā'sāvapi nāsikāvacanabhāga iva lakṣyate| tatra yadetadanantaradarśana- dvayam, tasyānyarat pāṇinerabhimatam| na cāsmin prāsādavāsinyāya ekatrāpyavatarati| yadi hi ṅakārādayo nāsikāyo'pi sākalyenoccāryeran, mukhenāpi; tataḥ prāsādavāsi nyāyena `nāsikāvacanaḥ' ityetāvatyukte teṣāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt| na caivaṃ bhāgasyaiva; teṣāṃ nāsikayā mukhena coccāraṇāt| tadasati mukhagrahaṇe teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt, tadabhāve ca sañjñā na syāditi yuktamuktam- anusvanārasyaiva hi syāt' iti| `kacaṭatapānāṃ mā bhūt' iti| ete hi kakārādayo mukhenaivoccāryante, na nāsikayā; tataścāsati nāsikā- grahaṇe teṣāmeva syāt| evaṃ ca `śaktaḥ', `suptam' ityatra `anudāttopadeśavanati' (6.4.37) ityādinā lopaḥ prasajyeta, `odanapak' ityatra `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) iti dīrghatvam| atha kimarthaṃ mahatī sañjñā kriyate ? anu paścānnāsikā vyāpriyate yasmin, atha vā - anu paścānnāsikāyā vyāpriyate yasmin, yadvā- nāsikāyāḥ paścāt vyāpriyate ? mukhasya tu prakṛtatvāt tadeva gamyate| tatra ye te dve darśane, yayoḥ pāṇineranyataradabhīṣṭam, tayoḥ pūrvasmin nāsikā mukhāt paścāt vyāpriyate, uttaratra mukhaṃ nāsikāyāḥ| anvarthasañjñākaraṇaṃ tu pūrvoktayordarśanayoranyatarābhyupagamasūcanārtham| tadabhyupagamasūcanaṃ tu prāsādavāsinyāyamāśritya mukhagrahaṇaṃ ye pratya- cakṣīran, teṣāṃ nirākaraṇārtham| 9.tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ savarṇam| (1.1.9) tulayā sammitaṃ tulyamiti `nauvayodharma' (4.4.91) ityādinā yatamutpādya tulyaśabdo vyutpādyate| na ca prayatnasya tulayā sammitatvaṃ sambhavati, tataścāsambhavadviśeṣaṇamiti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha- `tulyaśabdaḥ' ityādi| evaṃ manyate- vyutpattyarthaṃ tu kevalaṃ tulopādamate, na tvatra tulārtho vidyate, na vā sammitārthaḥ| sadṛṣaparyāyo hyayaṃ tulyaśabdaḥ| tathā hi- `tulya' ityukte `sadṛśa' iti paryāyo bhavati, na tu tulayā sammita iti| āsyaśabdo'yaṃ ṇyadanto'pyasti| asyate kṣipyate'nnamaneneti `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti karaṇe ṇyat| āsyam- mukham| tatpunaḥ oṣṭhātprabhṛti prāk kākalakāt| kākalakaṃ nāma grīvāyāmunnatapradeśaḥ, loke yaḥ kaṇṭhamaṇiḥ ityucyate| taddhitānto'pyāsyaśabdo'sti- āsye bhavamiti, `śarīrāvayavācca' (4.3.55) iti yati kṛte, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralope `halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ' (8.4.64) iti yalope ca kṛte `āsyam' iti| etacca mukhāntarvarttināṃ tālvādīnāṃ vācakam| tatra yadi pūrvasyāsyaśabdasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt, kacaṭatapānāmapi savarṇasañjñā syāt, ṇyadantasyāsyaśabdasya vācye'rthe teṣāṃ tulyatvāt prayatnaviṣayasya| imamataddhitāntasyāsyaśabdasya grahaṇe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā taddhitāntasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti darśayannāha- `āsye bhavamāsyama' iti| kiṃ punastadityāha- `tālvādisthānama' iti| yasmin varṇā niṣpādyante, tat sthānam| āviśabdena nāsikādīnāṃ grahaṇam| nanu ca nāsikā mukhādvahirvṛttirāsyaṃ na bhavati ? naitadasti; na hi mukhādbahirvarttinī nāsikeyaṃ vivakṣitā, tasyāṃ varṇānāmaniṣpatteḥ| kā tarhi ? antarāsye carma vitatamasti paṇavacarmavat, tatsambaddhā rekhā, yasyāṃ vāyunābhihanyamā-nāyāṃ varṇā niṣpadyante seha nāsikā vivakṣitā| kathaṃ punarvijñāyate taddhitāntasyāsyaśabdasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti ? āsyagrahaṇasārthyāt| yadi hyataddhitāntasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, āsyagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| sarveṣāmeva hi tadvācya evārthe prayatnastulyaḥ|nāstyeva hi saḥ, yasya vyavacchedārthamāsyagrahaṇaṃ syāt| nanu ca visarjanīyasya satya- sati vā savarṇatve prayojanamasti, nāpi doṣaḥ|`spṛṣṭatādiḥ' iti| ādiśabdena īṣatspṛ-ṣṭatādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `varṇaguṇaḥ' iti| akārādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ dharma ityarthaḥ| `tulya āsye prayatno yasya' iti| etena tulyāsyaprayatnaśabdastripado'yaṃ bahuvrīhiriti darśayati| vyādhikaraṇānāmapi gamakatvanādbahuvrīhirbhavatyeva; yathā - `kaṇṭhekālaḥ, urasilomā' iti| atha dvandvagarbhabahuvrīhiḥ kasmānnāśrīyate- āsyaṃ ca prayatnaśca āsyaprayatnau,tau tulyau yasya tat tulyāsyaprayatnamiti ? evaṃ manyate- dvandvagarbhabahuvrīhāvāśrīyamāṇe tālvādinā sthānena prayatno na viśeṣitaḥ syāt| tataśca kakāraṅakārayormithaḥ savarṇasañjñā na syāt, bāhyasya prayatnasya bhinnatvāt| kakārasya vivṛtakaṇṭhatvādirbāhyaḥ prayatnaḥ| ṅakārasya saṃvṛtakaṇṭhatvādiḥ| asatyāṃ ca savarṇasañjñāyāṃ śaṅkitetyatra `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58) iti ṅakāro na syāt| atha satyapi bāhyasya prayatnasya bheda ābhyantaraḥ spṛṣṭatākhyo'nayostulyaḥ prayatnaḥ, taṃ samāśrityasavarṇasañjñā bhaviṣyati ? yadyevam, śakāracakārasayorapi satyapyābhyantarayorvivṛtāspṛṣṭatayoḥ prayatnayorbhede yo'nayorbāhyaḥ prayatnastulyo vivṛtkaṇṭhatvādistadāśrayā savarṇasañjñā syāt| tataśca `aruścyotati' iti vakṣya-māṇaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate|tha tripade tu bahuvrīhau tālvādisthānena prayatno viśiṣyate| tena bāhyaṃ prayatnamutsṛjyābhyantara eva spṛṣṭatādirgṛhyate| sa eva hi tālvādāvāsye sambhavati, netaraḥ| ābhyantarasya prayatnasya grahaṇe sati satyapi bāhya- prayatnabhede bhatatyeva kakāra ṅakārayoḥ savarṇasañjñā; ābhyantaraprayatnasya tulyatvāt, tasyaiva ceha grahaṇāt| na ca cakāraśakārayoḥ satyapi bāhyasya prayatnasya tulyatve savarṇasañjñā prasajati; tasyehāgrahaṇāt, yasya ca grahaṇaṃ tasya cāsamānatvāt| tasyāt tripada eva bahuvrīhirāśrayituṃ yuktaḥ; na dvandvagarbha iti| yadi tarhi tripado bahu- vrīhirāśrīyate, bhinnavibhaktikatvādaprādhānyāccāsyaṃ tulyatvenāviśeṣitaṃ bhavati, tataśca bhinnasthānānāmapi savarṇasañjñā prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ| yadādheyaṃ prati yadadhikaraṇamupadīyate, tadādheyatulyayaiva tat tulyamiti vijñāyate| tathā hi- `devadattayajñadattayostulyaṃ kāṃsyapātryāṃ bhojanam' ityukte kāṃsyapātryapi tayostulyeti gamyate| yaṃ prati yastulyāsyaprayatnaḥ, sa tameva prati savarṇasañjño bhavatītyeṣo'- rtho yato vacanāllabhyata iha tannāsti| tataśca yo yaṃ prati tulyāsyaprayatnaḥ, sa tato'- nyamapi prati savarṇasañjñaḥ syāditi codyamāśaṅkyāha- `samānajātīyaṃ prati' iti| samānajātīyo yaṃ prati yastulyāsyaprayatnaḥ, taṃ prati sa savarṇasañjño bhavati, na tato'nyam| etacca tulyāsyaprayatnaśabdasya savarṇaśabdasya ca sambandhiśabdatvāllabhyate| sambandhiśabdo hyanteraṇāpi śabdāntarasannidhiḥ niyameva sambandhinamupasthāpayati, yathā- `pitari śuśrūṣitavyam' iti| nocyate svasminniti, sambandhāccaitadavagamyate, `yo yasya pitā' iti| tathehāpi| yadyapi yo yasya tulyāsyaprayatnaḥ, sa taṃ prati savarṇasañjño bhavatīti,na cocyate, tathāpi sambandhāt tulyāsyaprayatnaḥ samānajātīyameva prati savarṇasañjño bhavatīti gamyate| atha vā samāno varṇaḥ `savarṇaḥ' ityanvarthasañjñeyam| tenatulyajātīyameva prati savarṇasañjño bhavati| evaṃ hi samāno'sya varṇo bhavati, yadi tameva prati savarṇasañjño bhavati, na vijātīyaṃ prati| `catvāraḥ' ityādi| dvividhāḥ prayatnāḥ, ābhyantarāḥ, bāhyāśca| tatrābhya-ntarāḥ catvāro vṛttarau darśitāḥ| bāhyāstvekādaśaṣa| ke punaste ? `vivāraḥ, saṃvāraḥ,śvāsaḥ, nādaḥ, ghoṣaḥ, aghoṣaḥ, alpaprāṇaḥ, mahāprāṇaḥ, udāttaḥ, anudāttaḥ, svaritaśca' iti| tatra nābhipradeśāt prayatnaprerito vāyuḥ prāṇo nāma ūrdhvamātrāmannuraḥ prabhṛtīnāmanyatamasmin stāne prayatnena vidhāryate, sa vidhāryamāṇaḥ sthānamabhihanti, tataḥ sthānābhighātād dhvanirutpadyate| ākāśe sāvarṇyaśrutiḥ savarṇasyātmalābhaḥ| tatra varṇadhvanāvutpadyamāne yadā sthānamabhihanti, tataḥ sthānābhighātād dhvanirutpadyate| ākāśe sāvarṇyaśrutiḥ savarṇasyātmalābhaḥ| tatra varṇadhvanāvutpadyamāne yadā sthānakaraṇa-prayatnāḥ parasparaṃ spṛśanti, tadā sā `spṛṣṭatā'| īṣadyadā spṛśanti, tadā sā īṣa- spṛṣṭatā; sāmīpyena yadā spṛśanti, sā saṃvṛtatā; dūreṇa yadā spṛśanti, sā vivṛtatā-ete catvāra ābhyantarāḥ prayatnāḥ| ābhyantaratvaṃ punareṣāṃ sthānakaraṇaprayatna- vyāpāreṇotpattikāla eva sambhavāt| tatra spṛṣṭakaraṇāḥ sparśāḥ| kādayo māvasānāḥ sparśāḥ, spaṣṭatā guṇaḥ| karaṇaṃ kṛtiruccāraṇaprakāraḥ| spṛṣṭatānugataṃ karaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te spṛṣṭakaraṇāḥ| evamanyatrāpi veditavyam| īṣatspṛṣṭakaraṇā antaḥ sthāḥ| antaḥ sthā yaralavāḥ| vivṛtaṃ karaṇamūṣmaṇām, svarāṇāṃ ca| svarāḥ sarva evācaḥ| uṣmamāṇaḥ śaṣasahāḥ| atha bāhyāḥ prayatnāḥ kiṃlakṣaṇāḥ ? sa eva prāṇo nāma vāyuparūrdhvamākrāman murdhni pratihato nivṛto yadā koṣṭhamabhihanti tadā koṣṭhe'bhihanyamāne galabilasya saṃvṛtatvāt saṃvāro nāma varṇadharma upajāyate| vivṛtatvād vivāraḥ| saṃvṛte galabile'vyaktaḥ śabdo nādaḥ, vivṛte śvāsaḥ| uparivartinau tau śvāsanādāvanupradānamiti kecidācakṣate| varṇaniṣpatteranu-paścāt pradīyata ityanupradānam| anye tu bruvate `anupradānamanu- svāno ghaṣṭānirhrādavat' yathā- ghaṇṭānirhrādo'nusvanamanubhavati tathā iti| tatra yadā sthānābhighātaje dhnanau nādo'nupradīyate, tadā nādadhvanisaṅgād ghoṣo jāyate, yadā śvāso'nupradīyate, tadā śvāsadhvanisaṅgādaghoṣaḥ, mahita vāyau mahāprāṇaḥ, aspavāyāvalpa- prāṇaḥ| yadā sarvāṅgānusārī prayatnastīvro bhavati tadā gātrasya nigrahaḥ, kaṇṭhavivara- sya ca cāṇutvam, svarasya ca vāyostīvragatitvād raukṣyaṃ bhavati, tamudāttamācakṣate| yadā tu mandaḥ prayatno bhavati, tadā gātrasya sraṃsanam, kaṇṭhabilasya mahattvam, svarasya vāyormandagatitvāt snigdhatā bhavati, tamanudāttamācakṣate| udāttānudāttasvarasannikarṣāt svarita ityevaṃ lakṣaṇā bāhyāḥ prayatnāḥ| bāhyatvaṃ punareṣāṃ varṇaniṣpattikālādūrdhvaṃ, vāyuvaśenotpatteḥ| tatra vargāṇāṃ prathama dvitīyāḥ śaṣaravisarja-nīyajihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyā yamau ca prathamadvitīyau vivṛtakaṇṭhāḥ śvāsānupradānā aghoṣāḥ|vargyayamānāṃ prathame'lpaprāṇāḥ| itare sarve mahāprāṇāḥ| vargāṇāñca tṛtīyacaturthā antaḥsthā hakārānusvārau yamau ca tṛtīyacaturthau saṃvṛtakaṇṭhā nādānupradānā ghoṣavantaḥ| vargyamānāṃ tṛtīyā antaḥsthāśca alpaprāṇāḥ| itare sarve mahāprāṇāḥ| yathā tṛtīyā- stathā pañcamāḥ, ānunāsikyameṣāmadhiko guṇaḥ| ya evaite dviprakārāḥ prayatnā bāhyā ābhyantarāścākhyātāḥ, teṣāmiha savarṇasañjñāyāṃ pūrvoktā ābhyantarāścatvāraḥ spṛṣṭatādaya āśrīyante,na bāhyā vivārādayaḥ, āsyagrahaṇena teṣāṃ vyāvartitatvāt| spṛṣṭatādaya eva hyāsye bhavanti, navivārādayaḥ| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ prayatnagrahaṇam, etāvadastu tulyāsyamiti, āsyagrahaṇenaiva hi spṛṣṭatādayo'pi prayatnāḥ savarṇasañjñāyāṃ nimittabhūtāstālvādisthānavallabhyanta eva, teṣāmapyāsye bhavanāt ? satyametat, tathāpa pratyekaṃ vyāpāra- nirāsārthamubhayorupādānām| itarathā hi yathaiva sthānaṃ tulyaṃ sthānāntaranirapekṣaṃ savarṇa sañjñāyāṃ vyāpriyate, evaṃ prayatno'pi sthānanirapekṣaḥ, sthānaṃ ca prayatnanira- pekṣaṃ vyāpriyeta; tataśca bhinnaprayatnānāmapi tulyasthānānām, bhinnasthānānāmapi tulyaprayatanānāṃ savarṇasañjñā syāt| `a a a' ityādinā yeṣāṃ yāvatāṃ ca yādṛśāṃ ca mitho nityā savarṇasañjñā, tān darśayati| akārāṇāṃ hi sarveṣām `akuhavisarjanīyāḥ kaṇṭhyāḥ' iti tulyaṃ kaṇṭhasthānam| ikārāṇāmapi `icuyaśāstālavyāḥ' iti tālu| ukārā-ṇāmapi `upūpadhmānīyā oṣṭhyāḥ' ityoṣṭhaḥ| ṛkārāṇāmapi `ṛṭuraṣā mūrdhanyāḥ' iti mūrdhā| lṛkārāṇāmapi `lṛtulasā dantyāḥ' ita dantaḥ| ekārāṇāmaikārāṇāṃ ca `eai kaṇṭhyatālavyau' iti kaṇṭhatālu| okārāṇāmaukārāṇāṃ ca `o o kaṇṭhyauṣṭhyau' iti kaṣṭhoṣṭham| prayatnastu sarveṣāmevaiṣāṃ vivṛtaṃ karaṇamūṣmaṇāṃ svarāṇāṃ ceti vivṛtatvam| tasmāt tulyasthānprayatnatvāt svare'kārādayo mithaḥ savarṇasañjñāḥ| evaṃ yāvadaukāraḥ| antaḥsthā dviprabhedāḥ, sānunāsikā niranunāsikāśca rephavarjitāḥ| te'pi samānajātīyānantaḥsthān prati savarṇasañjñā bhavanti| `rephoṣmaṇāṃ savarṇā na santi' iti| te'bhyo'nye'kārādayo varṇā vijātīyā ityeṣo'bhiprāyaḥ| tulyajātīyāstu rephoṣmāṇastulyasthānaprayatnāḥ savarṇāḥ santyeva| tatra rephasya tāvad ṛṭuraṣebhyo yavalebhyaścānye varṇā bhinnasthānatvācca bhinnaprayatnatvācca savarṇā na bhavanti| tathā hi- `akuhavisarjanīyāḥ kaṇṭh‌yāḥ, icuyaśāstālavyāḥ, lṛtulasā dantyāḥ,apūpadhmānīyā oṣṭhyāḥ, eai kaṇṭhyatālavyau, o au kaṇṭhyoṣṭhayau' iti vacanādakārādīnāṃ yathāyogaṃ kaṇṭhādi sthānam| rephasya tvṛṭuraṣā mūrdhanyā iti mūrdhā| prayatno'pyanantaranirdiṣṭeṣvakārādiṣu ye svarāḥ teṣāṃ vivṛtaṃ karaṇamūṣmaṇāṃ svarāṇāṃ ceti vivṛtatvam| ye tu vargāntaḥ pātinaḥ kakārādayaḥ, teṣāṃ spṛṣṭakaraṇāḥ sparśā iti spṛṣṭatā| repha- syeṣatspṛṣṭakaraṇā antaḥsthā itīṣatspṛṣṭatā| śakārasakārāvapi sthānaprayatnabhedād‌ rephasya savarṇau na bhavataḥ| tau hi yathākramaṃ tālavyadantyau| rephastu mūrdhanyaḥ| prayatno 'pi tayorvivṛtatvam| rephasya tu pūrvokta eva| ṛṭuṣāḥ prayatnabhedāccaiva rephasya savarṇā na bhavanti; na tu sthānabhedena; teṣāmapi mūrdhanyatvāt| prayatnabhedastu vidyateṛkāraṣakārayoḥ pūrvavad vivṛtatvam, rephasya tu sa eva pūrvoktaḥ| ṭavargasya spṛṣṭatā| yavalāstu punaḥ sthānabhedādeva savarṇā na bhavanti, na tu prayatnabhedāt; teṣāmapīṣatspṛ- ṣṭaguṇatvāt| sthānabhedastu vidyate, yavalānāṃ yathāyogaṃ tālavyadantyoṣṭhyatvāt| evaṃ visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyānusvārāḥ| kum̐ khum̐ gum̐ ghum̐ ityete ca yamāścātulyasthānaprayatnatvādeva rephasya savarṇā na bhavanti| visarjanīyo hi kaṇṭhyaḥ, jihvāmūlīyo hi jihvyaḥ; upadhmānīya oṣṭhyaḥ, anusvārayamā nāsikyāḥ, rephastu mūrdhanyaḥ| prayatnastu yastasya pūrvoktaḥ, sa visarjanīyādīnāṃ nāstyeva tadevaṃ rephasya rephādanyo nāsti kaścit savarto varṇaḥ| anayā diśoṣmaṇāmapi śakārādīnāṃ sāvarṇyābhāve veditavyaḥ| `vargyaḥ' ityādi| varge bhavo vargyaḥ| `digāditvād yat' (4.3.54), `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityākāralopaḥ| vargyo yo varṇaḥ, so'nyena vargyeṇa svavargāntaḥpātinā tulyāsyaprayatnena saha savarṇo bhavati,yathā-kakāraḥ khakāreṇa| evamanyatrāpi veditavyam| `bhinnasthānānām' ityādi| ete hi kakārādayaḥ sarve spṛ ṣṭaguṇatvāt tulyaprayatnā yathākramaṃ kaṇṭhatālumūrdhadantoṣṭhasthānatvādbhinnasthānāḥ| `tarptā, tarptum' iti| `tṛpa tṛnpha tṛptau' (dhā.pā.1307,1308) ityasya tṛci tumuni ca rūpam| `bhinnaprayatnānām'ityādi| ikārādayohi tālavyatvāt sarve tulya- sthānā vivṛtatvaspṛṣṭatveṣatspṛṣṭatvaprayatnāt yathāyogaṃ bhinnaprayatnāḥ| ikāra- śakārayoryadyapi prayatano'pyabhinnaḥ,tathāpi, tayoḥ pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyatīti na bhavati savarṇa- tvam| `aruścyotati'iti `ścyutir kṣaraṇe' (dhā.pā.41) ityasya laṭi rūpam| tatra paratrāvasthita'rus‌śabdasya sakārasya rutvam| tasya visarjanīyaḥ, tasyāpi `vā śari' (8.3.36) iti sakāraḥ, tasyāpi ścutvaṃ śakāraḥ| `hotṝkāraḥ' iti| kathaṃ punaratra ṛkāra ādeśo bhavati, na hi ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ samudāyasya sthāninaḥ so'ntaratama ityāha- `ubhayoḥ' ityādi| ṛkāro mūrdhanyaḥ, lṛkārastu dantyaḥ| tatra tayoryadyeko mūrdhanyo dantyaśca dīrgho varṇo'ntaratamaḥ sambhavet, tadā so'ntaratama ādeśo bhavet| sa ca na sambhavatītyavayavasya yo'ntaratamaḥ, tena bhāvyam| tatrāpi yadi lṛkāro dīrghaḥ syāt| so'pi paryāyeṇa syāt, sa ca nāsti; tasmāt pāriśeṣyāt samudāyasyaikādeśasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva ṛkāro bhavati| 10.nājjhalau| (1.1.10) `tulyāsyaprayatnāvapi' iti prasaṅge hetumāha, prasaṅgapūrvakatvāt pratiṣedhasya| `daṇḍahasta' ityatrākārahakārayordvayorapi kaṇṭhasthānatvāt tulyasthānatvam, ubhayorvivṛtakaraṇatvāt tulyaprayatnatvam‌; `dadhi śītam' ityatrāpyata eva tulyuprayatnatvam, ubhayostālavyatvāt tulyasthānatvam| `savarṇadīrghatvaṃ na bhavati' iti pratiṣedha- sya phalaṃ darśayati| nanu ca akaḥ savarṇe dīrghavidhau (6.1.101) `aci'; iti vartate, tatrāsatyapi pratiṣedhe dīrghatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati, yathā- kumārī śete ityatra, tadayuktame-vodāharaṇadvayam| syādetat- `aṇudit savarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' (1.1.69) ityakārekā- rābhyāṃ sāvarṇyena grahaṇādactvamasti, tathāpi halṣūpadeśād haltvamapyastīti na tāvaddhakāraśkāravacāveva, api tu halāvapīti, satyametat| ayaṃ punaratra vṛttikārasyābhi prāyaḥ- avaśyaṃ tāvadanyārthaṃ `nājjhalau' (1.1.10) ityetat kartavyam, yasyeti lopā-bhāvārtham| tadanyārthaṃ kṛtametadarthamapi syāt| evaṃ tarhyajanuvṛttidvāreṇa dīrghatvābhāvapratipattau sādhyāyāṃ yat pratipattigauravamāpadyate, tadapāstaṃ bhavatīti| `vaipāśaḥ' iti| vipāśi bhava ityaṇ| `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityatrevarṇa upādīyamānaḥ sāvarṇyena śakāramapyupādatte| evaṃ ca tasya lopaḥ prasajyeta| `ānahuham' iti| anaḍuho vikāra iti `prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ' (4.3.154),tatra `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityatrākāro gṛhyakāro hakāramapi gṛhṇīyāt, tataśca pūrvavat tasya lopaḥ syāt| 11.īdūded‌dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyam| (1.1.11) atredādi yad‌dvivacanam,tat pragṛhyamityevaṃ vā vijñāyate ? īdādyantaṃ yad dvivacanam, tat pragṛhyamiti vā? tatrādye pakṣe `pacete' ityādau pragṛhyasañjñā na prāpnoti, na hyekāramātramatra dvivacanam; api tu āteśabda iti| imamādye pakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha- `īdūdedityevamantam'ityādi| nanvetasminnapi pakṣe agnī ityevamādi na sidhyati, īdādyeva hyatra dvivacanaṃ na tadantam ? `ādyantavadekasmin' (1.1.21) ityanenāntavadbhāvo bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `agnī' iti| ` prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) iti dīrghatvam| atra pragṛhyasañjñāyāṃ satyām `plutapragṛhyā aci' (6.1.125) iti prakṛtibhāvāditiśabde parataḥ `akaḥ savarṇe' dīrghatvaṃ (6.1.101) na bhavati| `vāyu' ityatrāpi `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) iti yaṇādeśaḥ| śeṣeṣvapyudāharaṇeṣvayādeśaḥ| `khaṭve' iti| `auṅa āpaḥ' (7.1.18) iti śībhāvaḥ| ` ād‌guṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `pacete' iti,`yajete' iti| svaritetvādātmanepadam, ātām, ṭerettvam, `āto ṅitaḥ' (7.2.81) itīyādeśaḥ `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yalopaḥ| `vṛkṣāvatra, plakṣāvatra' iti| bhavatyetad dvivacanam; na tvīdūdedantam| tena prakṛtibhāvābhāvādādeśo bhavatyeva| `kumāryatra' iti| `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti ṅīpikṛte `kumārī' ityetadīkārāntam‌, na tu dvivanacāntam; tenāsati prakṛtibhāve bhavatyeva yaṇādeśaḥ| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham ?plutanivṛttyarthamiti cet, na; iṣṭatvāt plutasya| yathā ca taparatve kriyamāṇe'pi plutasya pragṛhyasañjñā sidhyati, tathā bhāṣye `asiddhaḥ plutaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvāt tatkāla eva'(ma.bhā.1.66) ityādinā pratipāditam| guṇāntarabhinnānāṃ tatkālānāṃ grahaṇārthamiti cet,na; `abhedakatvācchāstre guṇānām' (so.pa.80) ityata āha- `taparakaraṇamasandehārtham' iti | asati hi taparakaraṇa īkārasyokārasya ca yaṇādeśaḥ syāt| tataśca sandeha eva syāt‌-kimidaṃ yakāravakāroyargrahaṇam, āhosvidikārokārayoriti `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyātam- vakṣyamāṇaṃ śākalyagrahaṇamihopatiṣṭhate siṃhāvalokitanyāyena , sā ca vyavasthita- vibhāṣā; tena maṇīvādīnāṃ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, maṇīva, dampatīv, rodasīveti| maṇīvetyā- dayaḥ śabdā dvivacanāntāḥ| tatrāsati pragṛhyatve `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' ((6.1.101) ekādeśo bhavatyeva| 12. adaso māt| (1.1.12) `adasaḥ sambandhī yo makāraḥ' iti| avayanavāvayavibhāvalakṣaṇena sambandhena ṣaṣṭhī| `amī atra' iti adas‌śabdāt parasya jasaḥ śī (7.1.17) tyadādyatvam (7.1.102) , ato guṇo' (6.1.97)pararūpatvam, īkāreṇa saha `ād‌guṇaḥ' (6.1.87) `eta īdbahuvacane' (8.2.81) itīttvam, dasya ca matvam, (8.2.80)| ayamadvivacanārtha ārambhaḥ| `amū āsāte' iti| adaso dvivacanamau| tyadādyatvam,`vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhiḥ; `adaso'serdādudo maḥ' (8.2.80) ityaukārasya dīrghasya sthāne tādṛśa evāntaratamyādukaraḥ|atrāpyūkārādikāryamasiddhamiti pūrveṇāprāptiḥ| ataḥ `pūrvātrāsiddham' (8.2.1) ityasya bādhanārthaṃ ārambhaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ `pūrvatrāsiddham'(8.2.1) ityetacchakyaṃ bādhitum, vacanasāmarthyāt? naitadasti; yat siddhe pragṛhyakāryam `aṇo'pragṛhya- syānunāsikaḥ' (8.4.57) iti, tadarthaṃ vacanaṃ syāt, naitadevam; na hyekaṃ prayojanaṃ yogārambhaṃ prayojayati| yadi hyetāvat prayojanaṃ syāt, tatraivedaṃ brūyāt, `aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ, adaso na' iti| `śamytara, dāḍimyatra' iti| `ṣid gaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41)iti ṅīṣ, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ| bhavatyayaṃ makārātpara īkāraḥ, na tvadaḥ sambandhīti| `amuke'tra' iti| `avyayasarvanāmnām'(5.3. 71) ityakac, `jasaḥ śī' (7.1.17), `ād‌guṇaḥ' (6.1.87), pūrvavadutvamatve amuke iti sthite paratra cātraśabde `eṅaḥ padāntādati' (6.1.109) iti pūrvarūpatvam| 13. śe| (1.1.13) `śe' iti| śeśruteraviśiṣṭatvāt kāśe kuśe ityatra yaḥ śeśabdastasyāpi grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, ato viśeṣo vaktavya ityabhiprāyeṇāha- `kimidaṃ śe' iti| `supām'ityādi| yastu kāśakuśaśabdābhyāṃ saptamyekavacane ca kṛte ādguṇe (6.1.87) ca śeśabdaḥ sampadyate, tasyeha grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; lākṣamikatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `yuṣme, asme' iti| ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasya `supāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) ityādinā śeśabdādeśaḥ, `śeṣe lopaḥ'(7.2.90) atha vā- prathamābahuvacanasyaiva śebhāvaḥ, chāndasatvāt `yūyavayau jasi' (7.2.93) ityetanna pravartate| `tve iti, me iti'| saptamyekavacanasya pañcamyekavacanasya ca śebhāvaḥ| `tvamā- vekavacane' (7.2.97) iti yuṣmadasmadostvamāvādeśau| `itarat tu laukikamanukaraṇam' iti| yadā `yuṣme iti' evamādikaṃ tadā laukikamanukaraṇamiti bhāvaḥ| yadā `yuṣme', `asme' ityādadīnāṃ vedavākyasthānāmarthādvayavacchidya svarūpe'vasthānārthaṃ padakārairitikaraṇo'dhyā- hriyate, tadā `yuṣme iti', `asme iti' evamādikamudāharaṇamiti bhavati| itarat tu laukikama nukaraṇamityukte `na yuṣme vājabandhavaḥ' (ṛ.8.69.19), `tve rāyaḥ' (tai.saṃ.1.2.5.2), `me rāyaḥ' (vā.saṃ.4.22) ityeteṣvapi vedavākyeṣu yat `yuṣme' ityādiśeśabdāntaṃ śabdarūpam, tat svarūpeṇa darśayitumāha- `yuṣme iti, asme iti, tve iti, me iti'| yadyevavaṃ kimarthaṃ `na yuṣme vājabandhavaḥ' )ṛ 8.69.19) ityādīnāmupanyāsaḥ ? eṣu vedavākyeṣu ye `yuṣme' ityādayaḥ śabdāḥ, teṣāmetānyanukaraṇanīti pradarśanārthaḥ; anyathā hi jñāyate kasyaitānyatanukaraṇanīti|| 14. nipāta ekājanāṅ| (1.1.14) ekājiti bahuvrīhirvā'yaṃ syāt,karmadhārayo vā ? yadi bahuvrīhiḥ, praśabda- syāpi pragṛhyasañjñā syāt| tataśca `propābhyām' (1.3.42) iti nirdeśo nopapa- dyeta, prāgnaya iti ca pratyudāharaṇam| tasmāt karmadhārayo'yamiti manasi kṛtvāha- `ekaścāsāvacchetyekāc' iti| `a apehi' ityādīni trīṇi cchāndasānyudāharaṇāni; itarat tu laukikam| tatra `ā evaṃ nu manyase' ityatrākāro vākyāparipūraṇārthaḥ| `ā evaṃ kila tat' ityatra tu smaraṇārthaḥ| `cakārātra' iti| karoterliṭ| `parasmaipadānām' (3.4.82) ityādinā tipo ṇal, vṛddhiḥ, raparatvam| `dvarvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti sthānivadbhāvena dvirvacanam| urattvam (7.4.66)| `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam| bhavatyayaṃ ṇalakāra ekāc, na tu nipātaḥ| `prāgnaye' iti| praśabdo bhavati nipātaḥ, na tvekāc| tena `plutapragṛhyā aci' (6.1.125) iti prakṛtibhāvo na bhavati| `akaḥ savarṇe' (6.1.101) iti dīrghatvaṃ tu bhavatyeva| ākāro'tra hi ṅidviśiṣṭa upāttaḥ, tasya na jñāyate- kva ca ṅittvam, kva ca neti| ato ṅittvāṅittvayorviṣayavibhāgapradarśanārthamāha- `īṣadarthe' ityādi| tatreṣadarthe-ā-uṣṇam- oṣṇamiti|īṣaduṣṇamityarthaḥ| kriyāyoge upasargasañjñāyāṃ ṅidviśiṣṭa eva paṭhyate| praparāpasamanvavanirdurvyāṅanyadhayo'pyatisūdabhayaśca| pratinā saha lakṣayitavyāḥ paryupayorapi lakṣaṇamatra|| iti| ā ihi- ehi| ā atti- ātti| maryādābhividhyorapi ṅidviśiṣṭa eva paṭhyate, `āha maryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.113) iti| maryādā- ,sīmā; avadhiḥ| ā udakāntāt- odakāntāt priyaṃ prodhamanuvrajet| abhividhiḥ - abhivyāptiḥ| ā ahicchatrāt, āhicchatraṃ vṛṣṭo devaḥ| ahicchatraṃ gṛhītvā vṛṣṭo deva ityarthaḥ| ṅidviśiṣṭasya `anāṅa' iti pragṛhyasañjñāpratiṣedhāt svarasandhirbhavati| atha `etamātam' ityatraitadaḥ `dvitoyāṭaustvenaḥ' (2.4.35) ityenādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? `anvādeśe' iti tatrānuvarttate| asti cehānvādeśa ityasti prāptiḥ ? yathā na bhavati tathā tatraiva prakaraṇe vṛttikāraḥ svayameva vakṣyatīti(kā.162) punariha nocyate| `ātam' iti| ākāre takāro mukhasukhārthaḥ| ye tu puretamāṅamiti ṅakārasahitamākāraṃ paṭhanti teṣāṃ ṅitaṃ vidyāditi vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; ṅakārasahitasya pāṭhādeva ṅittvavijñānāt| tasmāt takārapara evāyamākāraḥ paṭhitavyaḥ| ` vākyasmaraṇayoḥ' iti| vākyaśabdena vākyārtha uktaḥ; abidheye'bhidhānopacārāt| prakrāntaṃ hi vākyārthaṃ kiñcidapekṣyedaṃ prayujyate- `ā evaṃ nu manyase' iti| evamayaṃ vākyārtho vijñāyata ityrathaḥ| pūrvaprakrāntavākyārthapradarśanaparo'yamākāraḥ prayuktaḥ| atha vā- pūrvaprakrāntavākyārthasyānyathākaraṇamidaṃ prayujyate, `ā evaṃ nu manyase' iti, naivaṃ pūrvamamaṃsthāḥ, samprati tvevaṃ manyasa iti| atha vā- vākyāśabdena vākyamevocyate, vākyāvayavo nirarthaka evākāraḥ prayujyata iti| smaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ, tatra ya ākāro varttate smṛtisūcakaḥ,sa ṅinna bhavati| `ā evaṃ kila tat', evamidaṃ vijñātamityarthaḥ| jñātaṃ smṛtameva| atha vā- smarttavyārthaviṣayaḥ pūrvamākāraḥ prayujyate| `ā' iti smateruttarakālamartha ākhyāyate| `ā' ityetasyaivaṃ kila taditi bhavatyayamartha ityarthaḥ| vākyasmaraṇayorākārasya pragṛhyasañjñāstyeveti `plutapragṛhyā aci' (6.1.125) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| tena `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhirna bhavati| 15. ot| (1.1.15) 16. sambuddhau śākasyetāvanārṣe| (1.1.16) `sambuddhinimittaḥ' iti| sambuddhirnimittaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| etena `sambuddhau' ityasya nimittasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| parasaptamyāṃ tvasyām `he trapo' ityatra na syāt, `svamornapuṃsakāt' (7.1.23) iti sambuddherluptatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `sambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) iti varttamāne `hrasvasya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108) ityanena yo guṇo vidhīyate, sa sambuddhinimittaḥ, tasya sambuddhinimittatvamupādāya vihitatvāt| `gavityayamāha' iti| kenacid gauriti vaktavye śaktivaikalyād `go' ityuktam, tamanyo yadānukaroti, tatraitat pratyudāharaṇam| nanu cānukāryeṇārthenārthavattvāt pratipadikatve sati vibhaktyātra bhavitavyamityata āha- `atra' ityādi| atrānukriyamāṇasyānukaraṇasya yadi bhedo vivakṣyate, tato'rthavattāyāṃ satyāṃ syādvibhaktiḥ, sa tu na vivakṣyata iti kutastasyāḥ prasaṅgaḥ? na hīha śabdaśāstre vastunaḥ sattaiva śab- saṃskārasya pradhānaṃ kāraṇam, kiṃ tarhi, vivakṣā ca| sā ceha nāsti| `śākalyagrahaṇaṃ vibhāṣārtham' iti| etena pūjārthatāśaṅkāṃ nirasyati| yadi hi pūjārthameva tat syāt, vikalpo na bhavediti bhāvaḥ|| 17.uñaḥ| (1.1.17) 18.ūm̐| (1.1.18) `tena trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti' iti śākalyagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ phalaṃ darśayati| yadi hyatra śākalyagrahaṇaṃ nānuvartteta, tadā pūrvasūtreṇa yasmin pakṣa uñaḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñā na vihitā tasminnanenana nityam `ūm̐' ādeśaḥ syāt| tata `u'iti, `ūm̐' iti ca dve rūpe syātām; na vitīti tṛtīyam| śākalyagrahaṇānuvṛttau tu satyāṃ yasmin pakṣe pūrvasūtreṇa pragṛhyasañjñā uño na kṛtā, tasminnena ūm̐ ādeśe vibhāṣā vihite vitīti tṛtīyaṃ rūpaṃ sidhyati| 19. īdūtau ca saptamyrathe| (1.1.18) `adhyasyāṃ māmakī tanū' iti| etad vedavākyaṃ veditavyam| atra `māmakī' `tanū' iti śabdau`sūpāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) iti luptasaptamīkau| tatra yadā arthādvayava- cchidya svarūpe vyavasthāpanāyetiśabdaḥ prayujyate udāharaṇe- `māmakī'iti, `tanū' iti ca| tathā sa`somo gaurī' ityetadapi| māmakyāmityāderupanyāsaḥ saptamyarthapradarśanārthaḥ| `ḍādeśaḥ' iti| supāṃ sulugityādinā (7.1.39)| tatretiśabde parato'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ (6.1.101) bhavatyeva| `dhītī' ityādi| `dhītimatisuṣṭutiśabdebhyaḥ parasya tṛtīyaikavacanas pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam, lug vā| itiśabde parato'ko'trāpi savarṇa-dīrghatvaṃ bhavatyeva| dhītyetyādinā tṛtīyārthavṛttitāṃ darśayati| `vāpyāmaśvaḥ, nadyāmātiḥ' iti `sañjñāyām' (2.1.44) iti saptamīsamāsaḥ| athārthagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe'pi kasmādevātra na bhavati, asti hyatrāpi saptamyarthaḥ ? naitadasti, arthagrahaṇasāma- rthyāt| arthagrahaṇe sati kevalo yo'saṃsṛṣṭaḥ saptamyarthaḥ sa iha gṛhyate| naivaṃvidhe samāse saptamyarthaḥ sambhavati; saṃvibhinnobhayarūpatvād vṛttau varttipadārthānām| eṣo'jahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau parihāra uktaḥ, jahatsvārthāyāṃ tu tasyāṃ vākyāvasthāyāmupasarjanībhūto yo'rthaḥ, taṃ śabdo jahātīti saptamyartho nāstyeva| tenārthagrahaṇe sati samāse pragṛhyasañjñā na bhavati| atha tapakaraṇaṃ kimartham? plutanivṛtyarthamiti cet, na ; asambhavāt| na plute hīkārokārantaṃ satapyamartha rūpaṃ kiñcidasti, yadvayāvṛttaye tapakaraṇaṃ kriyate| guṇāntarabhinnānāṃ tulyakālānāṃ grahaṇārthamiti cet, na; abhedakācchāstre guṇānām ityata āha- `taparakaraṇam' ityādi| taparatve hyasati yaṇādeśaḥ syāt| tataśca kimayaṃ dīrghaḥ, uta hrasva iti sandehaḥ syāt, sa mā bhūditi taparatvaṃ kriyate| `īdūtau saptamī' ityādi| īdūtau saptamītyetāvadeva sūtramastu, kimarthagrahaṇena ? `lupte'rthagrahaṇād bhavet' iha `somo gaurī adhiśritaḥ'(ṛ 9.12.3) iti luptāya- mapi saptamyāṃ pragṛhyasañjñā yathā syādityeva marthagrahaṇam| atra hi saptamyā abhāvāt pragṛhyasañjñā na syāt,arthagrahaṇāt‌ tu bhavati, saptamyarthasya vidyamāna- tvāt| `pūrvasya cetsavarṇo'sau' iti| syādetat‌- naivātra saptamyā luk kriyate,kiṃ tarhi ? `supāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) ityādinā pūrvasavarṇaḥ īkāraḥ| tatrākaḥ savarṇedīrghatve kṛte tasyāntavadbhāve sati saptamīgrahaṇena grahaṇādastyeva saptamī, tato nārtho'rthagrahaṇeneti| etaccāyuktam| evaṃ hi sati āḍāmbhāvaḥ prasajyate| yadyatra pūrvasavarṇaḥ syāt, tadā paratvādaka savarṇadīrghatvaṃ bādhitvā `āṇ nadyāḥ' (7.3.112) ityāṭo bhāva āpapadyate, `ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' (7.3.116) ityāmaśca| bhāvaḥ prādurbhāvaḥ, sattā vā| tasmāt pūrvallugeva kartavyaḥ,tataścāsatyāṃ saptamyāṃ pragṛhya- sañjñā na syāt| tasamādarthagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam ? na karttavyam; yasmāt sarvatraiva saptamyā lukā bhavitavyamiti na kvacit saptamyasti| ucyate cedaṃ vacanam- `tatra vacanasāmarthyālluptāyāmapi tasyāṃ bhaviṣyati' ? naitadasti; yatho vacanād yatra dīrghatvam, tatra bhaviṣyati; yathā- `dṛtiṃ na śuṣkaṃ sarasī śayānam' (ṛ.7.103.2) iti| atra saraḥ śabdāt parasyāḥ saptamyā `iyāḍiyājīkārāṇām' (kā.vā.820) ityasmādupa- saṅkhyānāt `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) ityato vā dīrgha īkāre kṛte saptamī śrayūte; tataścātra vacanasya sāvakāśatvāt `somo gaurī adhiśritaḥ'(ṛ.9.12.3) ityatra na syāt| `tatrāpi sarasī yadi' iti| yadi sarasīśabdo'sti tadātrāpi naivāvakāśaḥ| asti ca sarasīśabdaḥ| tathā hi- gaurādiṣu(4.1.41) `pippalyādayaśca' (ga.sū.47) iti pāṭhāt pippalyādyantaḥpātinaḥ saraḥ śabdādīkāre kṛte sarasīti rūpaṃ sampadyate tathā ca dakṣiṇāpathe mahānti sarāṃsi `sarasya' ityucyante| sarasīśabdasya pragṛhyasañjñāyāṃ prayojanam-tata utpanāyāyaḥ saptamyā luki kṛte itiśabde cādhyāhṛte `sarasī' ityatra svarasandhya- bhāvaḥ| tadevaṃ sarasīśabdo vidyata eveti| `dṛtiṃ na śuṣkaṃ sarasī śayānam' (ṛ.7.103.2) ityatrāpi sarasīśabdo luptasaptamīka eva prayuktaḥ tathā ca tadevāvasthitam| vacanād bhavi- ṣyatīti pratyākhyātamarthagrahaṇam| evaṃ tarhi - jñāpakaṃ syāttadantatve `īdūded‌- dvivacanam' (1.1.11) ityatra catvāraḥ pakṣā āśrīyante| idādayo hi dvivacanena viśiṣyante-īdādiyad dvivacanamiti; īdādibhirvā dvivacanam iti, īdādyantaṃ yad dvivacanamiti; dvivacanaprakṛtirvobhābhyām-dvivacanāntamīdādyantaṃ yac śabdarūpamiti| idādībhirvā dvivacanaṃ viśiṣya paścāt tenedantena dvivacanena prakṛtiḥ, īdādyantaṃ yad dvivacanamaṃ śabdarūpamitīdādyantaṃ dvivacanāntamityarthaḥ| tatra tṛtīye pakṣe doṣa uktaḥ-`kumāryoragāraṃ kumāryagāram, vdavoragāraṃ vadhvagāramam' ityatra pragṛhya- sañjñā prāpnoti; etadīdādyantaṃ dvivacanāntaṃ ca bhavati pratyayalakṣaṇeneti caturthe pakṣe'pi doṣa uktaḥ| aśukle vastre śukle sampadyetāṃ śuklyāstāṃ vastre ityatra prāpnoti| śuklaśabdāc‌cviprat‌yayāntat `napuṃsakācc' (7.1.19) ityauṅaḥ śībhāve kṛte `adhyayādāpsupaḥ' (2.4.82) iti luk| etaddhīdādyantaṃ dvivacananāntaṃ bhavati pratyayalakṣaṇeneti| `tadantatve' iti anena tṛtīyacaturthapakṣāvupalakṣayati| tadantatve tadantapakṣe tṛtīye caturthe ca jñāpakaṃ bhavedetadarthagrahaṇam iti| iha pragṛhyaprakaraṇe pratyayalopalakṣaṇena pragṛhyasañjñā na bhavatīti| yadi hi syādarthagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|etāvad vaktavyam- `īdūtau ca saptamī' iti| saptamyā luki kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena saptamīsahacaritau yāvīdūtau saptamyāṃ parato vā yāvīdūtau tayoḥ pragṛhyasañjñā bhavetye- teti nārtho'rthagrahaṇena| arthagrahaṇādvijñāyate- `pratyayalakṣaṇena pragṛhyasañjñā na bhavati' iti| tena tadantapakṣadvaye yo doṣaḥ uktaḥ sa na bhavati| `mā vā pūrvapadasya bhūt' iti| pūrvapadagrahaṇe samāsa upalakṣyate| yasmāt samāse satyetadbhavati pūrvapadamuttarapadamiti| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati- vāpyaśvo nadyātirityādau samāse pragṛhyasañjñā mā bhūdityevamarthamarthagrahaṇamiti| yathā ca tasmin sati samāse pragṛhyasañjñā bhavati, tathā pūrvameva pratipāditam| 20. dādhā ghvadāp| (1.1.20) `dādhā' iti| dārūpāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ kṛtaikaśeṣāṇāṃ dhārūpayordvayośca kṛtai kaśeṣayordvandvaḥ| nanu ca lakṣaṇa pratatipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam, na tu lākṣaṇikasya' (vyā.pa.3), ityanayā paribhāṣayā `do avakhaṇḍane' (dhā.pā.1148), `deṅa rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.962), `dheṭ pāne' (dhā.pā.902) ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt ? naitadasti; tasyā hi paribhāṣāyāḥ `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) ityapavādo' sti, tena satyapi lākṣaṇikatvedodeṅau tāvad gṛhyete| dheṭo'pi liṅgād grahaṇamanumīyate| tat punarliṅaṃ daipaḥ pakārānubandhaḥ,sa hi `adāp' iti dāppratiṣedhasāmānya- grahaṇārthaḥ kriyate| yadi cāsyāḥ paribhāṣāyā iha vyāpāraḥ syāt, daipaḥ pakārānubandhakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| lākṣaṇikatvādeva hyasya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ pratiṣedhe'sya grahaṇena ? nanu lākṣaṇikamapi dārūpaṃ dhārūpaṃ ca dheṭo nopapadyata eva, sānubandhakasya hyanejantatvādāttvānupapatteḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ yadayam `udīcāṃ māṅo vyatīhāre' (3.4.19) iti meṅa sānubandhakasyāttvabhūtasya nirdeśaṃ karoti , tajjñāpayati- nānubandhakṛta- manejantatvam'(śā.pa.15) iti| nanu ca `māṅa māne' (dhā.pā.1142) ityasyāpyasau nirdeśaḥ syāt, tat kathaṃ jñāpakam ? naitadasti| `meṅa praṇidāne' (dhā.pā. 961) ityayameva vyatīhāre vartate, na `māṅa māne' (dhā.pā.1142) iti| tasmān meṅa evāyaṃ kṛtāttvasya nirdeśo jñāpanārthaḥ| `praṇidadāti' iti| `nergadanadapatapadaghumāsyatihanti' (8.4.17) ityādinā ghusañjñāyāṃ satyāmiha ṇatvaṃ bhavati. `praṇidātā' iti| tṛjantam| `praṇidyati' iti| `otaḥ śyani' (7.3.71) ityokāralopaḥ| aśidviṣaye dārūpo'yaṃ bhavatītyatra ghusañjñā pravarttata eva| `dātaṃ barhiḥ' iti| ghusañjñāyā abhāvāt `do dad‌ghoḥ' (7.4.46) iti dadādeśo na bhavati| `avadātam' iti| atrāpi `niṣṭhā' (3.2.102) iti ktapratyayaḥ|atra `aca upasargāttaḥ' (7.4.47) iti takārādeśo na bhavati| 21. ādyantavadekasmin| (1.1.21) `asahāyasya' ityādinā sūtrārambhasya phalaṃ darśayati| iti karaṇo hetau| yasmādāderantasya yāni kāryāṇyupadiṣṭāni, tānyavidyamānasahāyasya na sidhyanti; tasmādatideśo'yamārabhyate| dvitīyādikaṃ hi sahāyamapekṣyādyantaśabdau pravarttate| tathā hi - lokaḥ sati hi parasmin sahāye pūrvābhāve cādiriti vyapadiśati, sati ca pūrvasminparābhāve cānta iti| atastadubhayamasahāye nāstīti| tatrādyantapratibaddhāni kāryāṇi na syuḥ, yadyayamatideśo ārabhyate| `ekasmin' iti vacanāt `ādyantavata' ityatra saptamīsamarthā- dvatirgamyata ityāha- `saptamyarthe vatiḥ' iti| ādyantayorivādyantavat, `tatra tasyeva' (5.1.116) iti vatiḥ| `aupagavam' ityatrāpyādivyapadiṣṭaṃ kāryamatideśasya phalam| pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ hyāderupadiṣṭam, `ādyudāttaśca' (3.1.3) iti vacanāt| ` ābhyām' iti| atrāntopadiṣṭaṃ dīrghatvaṃ hyantasyopadiṣṭam, `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti vacanāt| idamo bhyām, tyadādyatvam, (7.2.102), `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam, `hali lopaḥ' (7.2.113) itīdrūpasya lopaḥ, `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghaḥ| 22. taraptamapau ghaḥ| (1.1.22) `kumāritarā' iti| `dvivacavibhajyopapade' (5.3.57) ityādinā tarap| `kumāritamā' iti| `atiśāyane' ityādinā tamap| tayorghasañjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `gharūpakalpa' (6.3.43) ityādinā hrasvatvaṃ bhavati| 23. bahugaṇavatuḍati saṃkhyā| (1.1.23) atra bahugaṇaśabdau prātipadike, vatuḍatī pratyayau| `bahukṛtvaḥ' iti- ` sakhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc' (5.4.17)| `bahudhā' iti- `sakhyāyā vidhārthe dhā' (5.3.42) `bahukaḥ' iti- `sakhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' (5.1.22) `tāvatkṛtvaḥ' ityādi- tacchabdāt `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup' (5.2.39) iti vatupi kṛte `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) ityāttve kṛte `tāvat' iti bhavati; kiṃśabdāt kimaḥ saṃkhyāparimāṇe ḍatau kṛte ṭilope ca `kati' iti bhavati; tābhyāṃ pūrvavadeva kṛtvasujādayaḥ| `bahugaṇaśabdayoḥ' ityādi| bahuśabdo'yaṃ saṃkhyāvacano'pyasti, vaipulyavacano' pi; gaṇaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvacano'pyasti, saṅghavacano'pi; tatra yau vaipulysaṅghavacanau,tayoriha grahaṇaṃ nāsti, saṃkhyāvācinoreva tayostveṣā saṅkhyāsaṃjñā vidhīyate,tatkathaṃ saṃkhye- tyanvarthasaṃjñeyam- saṃkhyāyate'nayā saṃkhyā ! na ca yo vaipulye bahuśabdo varttate, yaśca saṅghe gaṇaśabdaḥ, tābhyāṃ saṃkhyāyate| tathā hi- `bahurodanaḥ' ityukte vaipulyaṃ gamyate; tathā `mahān bhikṣaūmāṃ gaṇaḥ' ityukte saṅghaḥ,na tu saṃkhyānam| tasmādanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇād yāvekadvisaṃkhyāvyavacchedena saṃkhyāviśeṣamāhatuḥ, tayoreva grahaṇam| yadyevam,kimarthaṃ tayoriyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate, yāvatā saṃkhyāvācinau tau laukikasaṃkhyāyāmantarbhūtau ? laukikī ca saṃkhyā śāstre gṛhyata eva; anyathā `saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' (5.1.22) ityatra `atiśadantāyāḥ' iti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌, śāstrīyāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyā abhāvādityat āha- `bhūryādīnāṃ nivṛttyartham' iti| bhūri- prabhūtamityevamādayastajjātīyāḥ pracuraviśeṣavācinaḥ santi, teṣāṃ mā bhūdityevamartha bahugaṇaśabdayoḥ saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vidhīyate| tadetena niyamārthametayoḥ saṃjñāvidhānametaditi darśayati| tulyajātīyāpekṣayā hi niyamaḥ| atastulyajātīyānāṃ bhūryādīnāmeva niyamena vyāvṛttiḥ kriyate, nānyeṣām| `ardhapūrvapadaśca' iti| ardhaśabdaḥ pūrvapadaṃ yasya pūraṇapratyayāntas so'rdha- pūrvapadaḥ, sa ca saṃkhyāsaṃjño bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimarthamityāha- `samāsakanvidhyartham' iti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam- `ḍati ca' (1.1.25) ityatra yaścakāraḥ, sa iha svaritatvamāsajya siṃhāvalokitanyāyenopasthāpyate| sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tenārdhapūrvapadaśca pūraṇapratyayāntaḥ saṃkhyāsaṃjño bhavatīti| ardhapañcamaśūrpaḥ' iti| ardhaṃ pañcamaṃ yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| ardhapañcamaiḥ śūrpaiḥ krītamiti `taddhitārthottarapadasamā- hāre ca' (5.1.51) iti samāsaḥ| `saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ' (2.1.52) iti dvigusaṃjñā| ` śūrpādañanyatarasyām' (5.1.26) iti vihitasyāñaṣṭhaño vā `adhyardhapūrvadvigorluga- saṃjñāyām' (5.1.28) iti luk| `ardhapañcakaḥ' iti| `saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan'(5.1.22)|| 24.ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ| (1.1.24) `strīliṅga nirdeśāt' ityādi| ṣṇānteti strīliṅganirdeśaḥ kriyate, na ceha kiñcit strīliṅgaṃ śrūyate, nāpi prakṛtamanyat saṃkhyāyāḥ| tasmāt strīliṅganirdeśāt saṃkhyaiva `ṣṇāntā' ityanena viśeṣaṇena viśiṣyate| `ṣaṭ' iti cānayā saṃjñayā sambadhyate| yadi ṣṇāntetyatra strīliṅganirdeśo na kriyate, sarvaṃ ṣṇāntaṃ śabdarūpaṃ ṣaṭsaṃjñaṃ syāt| tataḥ `pāmānaḥ' vipruṣaḥ' ityādāvapi `ṣa ḍbhyo luk' (7.1.22) iti luk prasajyeta| nanu ca saṃkhyetyanuvarttiṣyate, tat kuto'tiprasaṅgaḥ ? satyametat; saivānuvṛttiḥ strīliṅganirdeśena spaṣṭīkriyate| yadi saṃkhyetyanuvarttate, sāmarthyādeva tadantā vijñāsyate, na hi ṣakāramātraṃ vā nakāramātraṃ vā saṃkhyāsti, tadapārthakamantagrahaṇam, naitadasti; upadeśāvasthāyāṃ yā ṣṇāntā sā ṣaṭ‌saṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthatvādantagrahaṇasya| asati tasmin śatāni sahasrāṇīti numi kṛte ṣaṭsaṃjñā syāt| iha ca aṣṭānām‌ ityaṣṭana ātve kṛte ṣaṭsaṃjñā na syāt| tataśca `ṣaṭ‌caturbhyaśca' (7.1.55) iti nuṇ na bhavati| 25. ḍati ca| (1.1.25) `ḍatyantā yā saṃkhyā sā ṣaṭsaṃjñā bhavati' iti| saṃkhyāgrahaṇenehāpi saṃkhyānuvarttata iti darśayati| kimarthaṃ punaḥ sehānuvarttate ? pāterḍatiḥ pataya ityatra mā bhūt| atha saṃkhyānuvṛttāvapi kasmādevātra na bhavati, yāvatāyamapi saṃkhyāsaṃjña eva, sāmānyena hi pūrvaṃ ḍateḥ saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā ? naitadasti; vatunā sāhacaryāt taddhitasyaiva ḍatestatra grahaṇam, na kṛtaḥ; kṛccāyam| 26.kvaktavatū niṣṭhā| (1.1.26) `bhuktavān' iti| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) ita kutvam| `atvasantas cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| atha kena vihitayoḥ ktaktavatvoreṣā saṃjñā vidhīyate ? anayaiva saṃjñayā| vakṣyati tṛtīye `niṣṭhā' (3.2.102) iti| yadyevam, niṣṭhāsaṃjñayā ktaktavatū bhāvyete, tāvevāśritya niṣṭhāsaṃjñeti; itaretarāśrayo doṣo bhavati, `itaretarāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi śāstre na prakalpyante, (vyā.28) naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhāvinī hi saṃjñā vijñāsyate, yathā- `asya sūtrasya śaṭakaṃ vaya' iti| tau bhūte kāle bhavataḥ, yayorvihita- rniṣṭhetyeṣā saṃjñā bhavatīti| 27. sarvādīni sarvanāmāni| (1.1.27) `sarvaśabda ādiryeṣāṃ tānīmāni sarvādīni' iti| eṣa tad‌guṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ; itarathā hyupalakṣaṇārthatvāt sarvaśabdasya saṃjñā na syāt| na hyupalakṣaṇasyopasarjanī-bhūtasya kāryeṇa sambandho bhavati| tathā hi- `citragurānīyatām' ityukte na gavā- mapyānayanaṃ bhavati. tadguṇasaṃvijñānasya bahuvrīherliṅgam- `adaḥ sarveṣām' (7.3.100) iti nirdeśaḥ| sarvaśabdasya suṭ sarvanāmnaḥ kāryam; anyathā hi tannopapadyate| ` sarvaḥ, sarvau sarve' iti| idamatrodāharaṇaṃ `sarve' iti| atra hi sarvanāmasaṃjñāyām ` jasaḥ śī' (7.1.17) iti śībhāvaḥ kāryaḥ| pūrvayostu tatsāhacaryeṇa `sarve' ityetasya pum̐lliṅgatāṃ śrūyamāṇavibhaktitāṃ ca darśayitumupanyāsaḥ; anyathā `sarve' ityetā- vatyucyamāne strīliṅgasya luptasambṛddherayaṃ prayoga iti| kasyacid bhrāntiḥ syāt| `sarvasmai' iti| `sarvanāmnaḥ smai' (7.1.14)| `sarvasmāt, sarvasmin' iti| `ṅasiṅayoḥ smātsminau' (7.1.14)| `sarvasmāt, sarvasmin' iti| `ṅasiṅayoḥ smātsminau' (7.1.15) iti| `sarvakaḥ' iti- `avyayasarvanāmnāmakac prāk ṭeḥ' (5.3.71) iti| ubhaśabdo'yaṃ dvivacanaṭābviṣaya eva prayujyate-`ubhau ubhe'iti | na ca tat kiñcit sarvanāmakāryaṃ sambhavati; smaiprabhṛtīnāṃ yatāyogamekavacanabahuvacanaviṣayatvāt| akajapi naivaṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñāṃ prayojayati; viśeṣābhāvāt| nahi tasmādakaci, kapratyaye vā vihite rūpabhedo vā bhavati| tat kimarthastasyeha pāṭhaḥ ? ityāha- `ubhaśabdastha' ityādi| `sarva-nāmnastṛtīya ca' (2.3.27) ityanena ubhābhyāṃ hetubhyām, ubhoyarhetvoriti tṛtīyā-ṣaṣṭhyau yathā syātāmityevamarthsatasyeha pāṭha iti darśayati| `ḍataratama' iti| `kiṃyattadornirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac' (5.3.92) `vā bahunāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac' (5.3.93) ityetayoḥ pratyayorgrahaṇam| `vakṣyamāṇena' iti| `prathamacarama' (1.1.33) ityādinā| `katham' ityādi| samaśabdasya sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ' (7.1.52) iti suṭi `sameṣām' iti bhavitavyam, tat kathaṃ sāmānāmiti bhavati ? tataśca saptamyekavacanasya sminbhāve kṛte samasminniti bhavitavyam, tat kathaṃ `same deśe yajet' iti prayoga upapadyate ! ityabhiprāyaḥ| `na sarvatra' iti| na sarvatrārthe varttamāna- syetyarthaḥ| etacca `sarveṣāṃ nāmāni sarvanāmāni' ityanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāllabhyate| sa eva hi samaśabdaḥ sarveṣāṃ nāma bhavati yaḥ sarvaśabdaparyāyaḥ, na cānyoḥ prayogayoḥ samaśabdaḥ sarvaparyāyaḥ| tathā hi `samānām' ityatra samaśabdastulyārthe varttate| `same deśe' ityatrāpyaviṣame- nimnonnatādirahite| ata eva cānvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāt saṃjñopasarjanībhūtānāṃ saṃjñā na bhavati| yathā- sarvo nāma kaścit, tasmai sarvāya dehi| atikrāntaḥ srarvamatisarvaḥ, tasmā atisarvāya dehīti| na hyevaṃprakārāṇi sarveṣāṃ nāmāni; viśiṣṭavsatu viṣayatvāt| `sarvanāmāni' ityatra`pūrvapadāt saṃjñāyām' (8.4.3) itiṇatvaṃ tu na bhavati, ata eva nipātanāt| 28. vibhāṣā diksamāse bahuvrīhau| (1.1.28) `digupadiṣṭe' iti| diśāmupadiṣṭa ukto digupadiṣṭaḥ| sa punaḥ `diṅanāmānyantarāle' (2.2.26) iti yaḥ samāsastasyātra grahaṇam| sa punarlakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā labhyate| pratipadoktasamāsāśrayaṇaṃ tu yā pūrvā dik sottarā'syonmu- gdhasya, `asmai pūrvottarāya dehi' ityatrā mā bhūt| `uttarapūrvasmai' iti| uttarasyāśca pūrvasyāśca diśoryadantarālamiti pūrvoktena sūtreṇa bahuvrīhiḥ, `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ' (jai.pa.vṛ.103) iti pūrvapadasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ, caturthyekavacanam, `sarvanāmnaḥ syāḍ‌ḍhrasvaśca' (7.3.114) iti yāṭ, `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| `samāsagrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| yāvatā na bahuvrīhiḥ samāsatvaṃ vyabhicaratyeva, tato' pārthakaṃ viseṣaṇamityabhiprāyaḥ| `samāsa eva yo bahuvrīhi' iti| yasyātideśena bahuvrīhivadbhāvo na vidhīyate sa veditavyaḥ samāsa eva bahuvrīhiriti| sa punaryaḥ samāsādhikāre vihitaḥ| `bahuvrīhivadbhāvena' iti| yasyātideśikaṃ bahuvrīhitvaṃ sa bahuvrīhivadbhāvena bahuvrīhiḥ| `dakṣiṇadakṣiṇasyai' iti| `ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat' (7.1.9) ityato bahuvrīhivaditi varttamāne `ābādhe ca' (8.1.10) iti dakṣiṇāśabdasya dvirvacanam| bahuvrīhi- vadbhāvācca subluk| ayaṃ bahuvrīhivadbhāvena bahuvrīhiriti vibhāṣā na pravarttate| yo'pi `na bahuvrīhau' (1.1.29) iti vakṣyamāṇaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ so'pīha na bhavati; tatrāpi samāsādhikārāta| `dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām' iti| atra `dvandve ca' (1.1.31) iti nitya eva pratiṣedho bhavati, tena pakṣe suṇna bhavati| yadyevam, `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre' ( jai.pa.vṛ103) iti puṃvadbhāvo'tra na syāt; naitadasti; avayavasyādvandvatvāt| nanu vinā'pi bahuvrīhigrahaṇenātra `dvandve ca'(1.1.31) iti pratiṣedhena bhāvyameva; tadapārthakaṃ bahuvrīhigrahaṇam, naitadasti; yo hi digdvandvo na bhavati sa tasya viṣayaḥ syāt| digdvandve tvasati bahuvrīhigrahaṇe eṣaiva vibhāṣā syāt| tasmādbahuvrī- higrahaṇaṃ karttavyam ? na karttavyam| kasmānna bhavati? `dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām' ityatra pratipadoktasamāsasyeha grahaṇāt| evaṃ tarhyuttarārthaṃ bahuvrīhigrahaṇam| `na vahuvrīhau' (1.1.29) ityatrāsya prayojanaṃ vakṣyati| vṛttikārasya tveṣo'bhiprāyaḥ- `uttarārthamavaśyakarttavyam, taduttarārthaṃ kṛtamihāpi spaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyati' iti| 29. na bahuvrīhau| (1.1.29) `sarvanāmasaṃjñāyām' ityādi| kathaṃ puretadavagatam- abhyupagatastadantavidhiriti? ata eva pratiṣedhāt, anyathā hi niṣphalaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| tadantavidhyabhyupagame hi `paramasarvasmai uttamasarvasmai' ityatrāpi saṃjñā yathā syāt| `iha ca' ityādi| asya `pratiṣedha ārabhyate' ityanena sambandhaḥ| `tvaṃ pitā'sya, ahaṃ pitā'sya' iti vigṛhya bahuvrīhau kṛte'jñātādyarthavivakṣāyām asati pratiṣedhe| `avyayasarvanāmnāmakac prāk ṭeḥ' (5.3.71) ityatrākac prasajyeta| tataśca `tvakatpita-kaḥ, makatpitṛkaḥ' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| tasmādakaj mā bhūditi pratiṣeda ārabhyate| tena `prāgivāt kaḥ' (5.3.70) iti ka eva bhavati| tatra parataḥ `pratyayottarapadayośca' (7.2.98) iti maparyanta-ryoryuṣmadasmadostvamayoḥ kṛtayoḥ `nadyṛtaśca' (5.4.153) iti samāsānte kapi ca `tvatkapitṛkaḥ, matkapitṛkaḥ' iti siddhyati| nanu cānvarthasaṃjñākaraṇādeva saṃjñānirāse kṛte'kaj na bhaviṣyati-na hyatra sarvārthatā sambhavati, viśeṣaviṣayatvāt, naitadasti; samudāyo hi viśeṣe varttate, pūrvapadaṃ tu sarvārthatāyā anapetameva| bhavatvanayoranantarayo-rudāharaṇayoretatsūtraviṣayatā, `priyiśvāya' ityādistu napapadyate; na hi priyaviśvādayaḥ śabdāḥ sarveṣāṃ nāmāni nāpi tadavayavabhūtānāṃ viśvādiśabdānāṃ kiñcit sarvanāmakā- ryamamupapadyate; smaiprabhṛtīnāmaṅgakāryatvāt, viśvādiśabdānāṃ cānaṅgatvāt ? evaṃ manyate- `tvatkapitṛkaḥ, katkapitṛkaḥ' ityatrākaj mā bhūditi, etadarthaṃ tāvadetadāra- bdhavyam, `priyaviśvāya' ityevamādāvapi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| atha `bahuvrīhau' iti varttamāne kimarthaṃ punarbahuvrīhagrahaṇamityāha- `bahuvrīhau' ityādi| `vastrāntaravasanāntarāḥ' iti| vastramantaraṃ yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhi kṛtvā vastrāntarāśca vasanāntarāśceti dvandvaḥ kṛtaṛ| atra varttamā- natvād dvandvasya `dvandve ca' (1.1.61), `vibhāṣā jasi' (1.1.32) iti dvandvā- śrito vibhāṣāpratiṣedhaḥ syāt, na nityo bahuvrīhyāśritaḥ| punarbahuvrīhigrahaṇā-ttu bhūtapūrvasyāpi bahuvrīherāśrayamāt tadāśrayo nityaḥ pratiṣedho bhavati| vasanaśabda- ścātra vasatyasminnityadhikaraṇasādhano gṛhe varttate, na vastre; anyathā vastrāntaravasanāntaraśabdayoḥ paryāyatvād dvandvo na syāt, `tulyārthāñca virupāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ' ityekaśeṣavidhānāt| 30.tṛtīyāsamāse| (1.1.30) nanu ca `vibhāṣā diksamāse' (1.1.28) ityata samāsagrahaṇamanuvarttata eva, tat kimarthaṃ punaḥ samāsagrahaṇamityata āha- `samāsa ityanuvarttamāne' ityādi| astyeva tṛtīyāsamāso mukhyaḥ, yasmin satyaikapadyamaikasvaryamekavibhkatikatvaṃ ca bhavati| asti ca gauṇaḥ, yasmiṃstādarthyādatasminnapi tācchabadyaṃ bhavati| sa punastṛtīyāsamāsārthaṃ vākyam| tatrāsati punaḥ samāsagrahaṇe `gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasaṃpratyayaḥ' (vyā.pa.4) iti mukhya eva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| netaratra| tasmāt tatrāpi pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaḥ samāsagrahaṇam| yadi tarhi tṛtīyāsamāsārthe'pi vākye pratiṣedho bhavati,yāvān kaścit tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ, tadarthe vākye sarvatra pratiṣedhaḥ syāt; tataśca `tvayakā kṛtam, mayakā kṛtam'ityatrākaj na syāt| bhavati hyetat `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (2.1.32) ityanena yaḥ samāsastadarthaṃ vākyam;tatra kapratyaye kṛte `tvatkena kṛtam, matkena kṛtam' iti rūpaṃ syādityata āha- `pūrvasadṛśa' ityādi| etacca lakṣamapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā labhyate| `tvayakā, mayakā' iti| pūrvavat tvamāvādeśau, subantādakac| kvacit tvakayā, makayā iti pāṭhaḥ sa tvayuktaḥ| prātipadikāt tvakajutpattau tvakayā makayeti bhavati, na cātra prātipadikādakajutpattiriṣyate; api tu subantāt| tathā hyakajvidhau vakṣyati-"prātipidakāt" supaḥ' iti ca dvayamapīhānuvarttate| tatrābhidhānato vyavasthā- kvacit prātipadikasya prāk ṭeḥ pratyayo bhavati, kvacit subantasya| `yuṣmakābhiḥ, yuṣmakāsu, asmakāsu, yuvakayoḥ, āvayakayoḥ' ityatra prātipadikasya| tvayakā, mayakā, tvayaki,mayaki' ityatra subantasya" iti| 31. dvandve ca| (1.1.31) 32. vibhāṣā jasi|(1.1.32) `jasaḥ kāryaṃ prati' ityādi| etacc vyavasthitavibhāṣātvādasyā vibhāṣāyā labhyate| atha vā jasīti kāryāpekṣayā ādhārasaptamīyam, na tu sarvādyapekṣayā parasaptamī; tena jasi yat kāryam- jasādhāraṃ yat kāryaṃ jasaḥ śībhāvaḥ tatra vibhāṣā bhavati, nānyatra | kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyata ityata āha-`akaj hi na bhavati' iti hi śabdo hetau|evaṃ vyākhyāyamāne sati `katarakatamakāḥ' ityatrākaj na bhavati; pūrvasūtreṇa saṃjñāpratiṣedhāt anyathā hi yadi jasi parataḥ saṃjñā vikalpyate,tadā pakṣe'kaj bhavedeva| tathā ca tasya tanmadhyapatitvāt tadgrahaṇena grahaṇāt pākṣikaḥ śībhāvaḥ prasajyeta| kapratyaye tu sati tena vyavadhānādevaiṣa doṣo na bhavati| 33.prathamacaramatayālpārdhakatipayanemāśca| (1.1.33) ubhayaśabdasya tayappratyayāntasya' iti| `saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap' (5.2.42) ityubhaśabdādvihitasya tayapo yadyapi`ubhādudātto nityam' (5.2.44) ityayajādeśo vidhīyate, tathāpi sthānivadbhāvāt tadgrahaṇena gṛhyata ityubhayaśabdastayappratyayānto bhavati| `tasya gaṇe pāṭhānnityā sarvanāmasañjñā'iti| na tvanena yogena pareṇāpi pākṣikī| etacca vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāllabhyate| `kākacoryathāyogaṃ vṛttiḥ'iti| tenobhaya- nema-śabdayoḥ sarvāditvānnityamakaco vṛttiḥ, prathamādibhyastu kapratyayasya- ityeṣa yathā- yogārthaḥ|| 34. pūrvaparāvaradakṣiṇottarāparādharāṇi vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām| (1.1.34) `asaṃjñāyām' iti| saṃjñāyāmasatyām pūrvādayaścet saṃjñārūpā na bhavantī- tyarthaḥ| `svābhidheyāpekṣa' ityādi avadhirmaryādā,tasya niyamo'vaśyambhāvaḥ; avadhibhā- vādabhraṃśaḥ|kiṃviśiṣṭo'vadhiniyamaḥ ? svābhidheyāpekṣaḥ hyarthānām- pūrvādiśabdābhidhayānāṃ yat pūrvāditvam, tanniyogataḥ kañcanāvadhimapakṣya sampadyate, na tvavadhinirapekṣam; yathā- pūrvadeśasya yat pūrvatvam,tatparaṃ deśamapekṣya bhavati; parasyāpi yat paratvam, tat pūrvadeśam; tasmāt pūrvādiśabdavācyāpekṣeṇāvaśyaṃ kenacidavadhinā bhāvyam| tatra tasyaivāvadheḥ yaḥ pūrvādiśabdārthāpekṣo'vadhibhāva aikāntikaḥ, sa niyamo vyavasthā, tasyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ pūrvādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ svābhidheya eva varttamānānāmiyaṃ saṃjñā bhavati; na tu vācyāyām| yo hi pūrvādiśabdābhidheyādanyasyārthasyāvadhibhūtasya niyamaḥ, sa kataṃ pūrvādiśabdavācyo bhaviṣyati! `pūrve,parvāḥ' iti| atra parasamādevāvadheriti gamyate| `pare,parāḥ'iti| pūrva- smādevāvaderiti gamyate| `pravīṇāḥ' iti| kuśalā ityarthaḥ| atra prāvīṇyamātreṇa nimittenāvadhinirapekṣa eva dakṣiṇaśabdo varttata iti vyavasthā na gamyate| `satyāmeva' ityādi| jambūdvīpaṃ vāvadhimapekṣya tatrottaraśabdo varttata iti vidyata eva vyavasthā| 35.svamajñātidhanākhyāyām| (1.1.35) `atrāpi nityā sarvanāmasaṃjñā prāptā' iti| gaṇapāṭhāt| evamuttaratrāpi vedatavyam| `na cet' ityādinā jñātidhanākhyāśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| yatra ca śabdāntara- nirapekṣaḥ svaśabdo jñātidhane svarūpeṇācaṣṭe, tatrāsau saṃjñārūpeṇa tayorvarttate| `ātmīyā ityarthaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punarayamarthaḥ, yāvatā `sve puttrāḥ' iti jñātyartho gamyate, `sve gāvaḥ' iti dhanārthaḥ ? naitadasti; puttragośabdasānnidhyādatadubhayaṃ gamyate| svaśabhdenātmīyatvamātraṃ gamyate- `svā jñātayaḥ' iti| prabhūtā svā iti cobhayatra śabdāntaramanapekṣya jñātidhane svarūpeṇaiva svaśabdenābhidhīyete| yadyevam, jñātaya ityanuprayogo nopapadyate; paryāyatvāt, yathā- vṛkṣaśabdaprayoge sati taruśabda- śabdasyānuprayogo virudhyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; paryāyaśabdasya hi yatrānekārtho bhavati sandigdhārtho vā, tatra tadarthasyaiva vyaktīkaraṇārthaḥ paryāyāntarasyānuprayogo na virudhyate; yathā- meghādyanekārthavṛttervarāhakaśabdasya prayoge śūkaraśabdasya prayogaḥ| tathā sandigdhārthasya pikaśabdasya prayoge kokilaśabdasya ! svaśabdaścāyamanekārthaḥ, tatrāsatyanuprayoge kiṃviṣayo'yaṃ prayuktaḥ- iti sandeha syāt| 36. antaraṃ bahiryogopasaṃvyānayoḥ| (1.1.36) `barhiryoge' iti| bahirityanenānāvṛtadeśa ucyate| tena yogo barhiryogaḥ| sa cānāvṛtasya bāhyasya vastuno bhavati| `upasaṃvyāne ca' iti| upasaṃvīyate paridhīyate yat tadupasaṃvyānam- `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti karmaṇai lyuṭ| atha vā, saṃvīyate pidhīyate'neneti saṃvyānam- `karaṇādhikaraṇayośca' (3.3.117) iti lyuṭ| saṃvyānasya samīpamupasaṃkhyānam| abahiryoge sāmarthyāt tadeva veditavyam| `nagarabāhyāḥ' iti| anena bahiryogaṃ darśayati- `paridhānīyamucyate' iti| upasaṃvyānsayedamudāharaṇamupanyastam| vastrāntarāvṛtavastu vastvantareṇāpihitamucyate| aviśeṣābhidhāna'pi yadvastrāntareṇāvṛtam, sāmarthyāt tadevopasaṃvyānamucyate, netarat| `na prāvaraṇīyam' iti| prāvriyate'pidhīyate-neneti prāvaraṇīyam, tannabhidhīyate| tadabhidhāne tasya bahiryogatvāt bahiryoga evedamudāharaṇaṃ syādityābhiprāyaḥ| `antare tāpasaḥ prativasati' iti. atra saṃjñāyā abhāvāt saptamyāḥ sminnādeśo na bhavati| nanu ca jasītyanuvartte, tat kasmāt saptamyantaṃ pratyudāhṛtamityata āha-`guṇasūtrasya ca' ityādi| `apurīti vaktavyam' iti| anantaraṃ `gaṇasūtrasya ca' ityabhidhānād gaṇasūtramevaitad vaktavyamiti gamyate| yadyapi gaṇasūtre'ntaraśabda paṭhyate,tathāpi `pratipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.29) iti prākārādba-hirvarttinī yā pūstasyā api bahiryogo'stīti tatra varttamānasya ṭābantasyāpyantarāśabdasya sarvanāmasaṃjñā prāpnoti, tenāpurīti vaktavyam| tenāntarāyāmityatra syāṇ na bhavati| `vibhāṣāprakaraṇe' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasyeha pratipādanamarthaḥ| asmin vibhāṣāprakaraṇe tīyapratyayāntasya sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāḥ pratipādanaṃ karttavyami- tyarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam `vibhāṣā jasi' (1.1.32) ityatra `vibhāṣā' iti yoga- vibhāgaḥ kriyate, tatra ca `sarvādīni' `dvandve' iti ca nivṛttam, tena tīyasya vibhāṣā sarvanāmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti| na caivaṃ satyatiprasaṅgaḥ; yogavibhāgadiṣṭasiddheḥ nāpi `vibhāṣā dvitīyatṛtīyābhyām' (7.3.115) ityasya vaiyarthyāpattiḥ; prapañcārtatvāt| tataḥ `jasi' dvitīyo yogaḥ| atra vibhāṣāgrahaṇam, sarvādigrahaṇam, dvandva grahaṇaṃ cānuvarttate| 37. svarādinipātamavyayam| (1.1.37) svarādiṣu svastiśabdo'stiśabdaśca paṭhyate| tatra svastiśabdasya kimarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ? yāvatāstiśabdapāṭhādeva tadantavidhinā svastiśabdasyāpi bhaviṣyati| `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena ' (vyā.pa.89) iti tadantavidhi pratiṣedhānna sidhyatītyetat tu nāśaṅkanīyam, `avyayam' iti mahatī saṃjñā kriyate, anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyetaliṅgakārakasaṃkyāviśeṣānupādānna vyeti- vividhatvaṃ na gacchatītyavyayam| tasyāścopasarjanapratiṣedhaḥ, tadantavidhiśca prayojanam| tasmādanvarthasaṃjñakaraṇādeva tadantasyāpi bhaviṣyati, svastiśabdo'pi na vyetyeva, satyametat;evaṃ tvanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇāllabdhastadantavidhirananopada- rśitaḥ| vispaṣṭārthamudāharaṇametat| `tasilādistaddhita edhāc‌paryantaḥ' iti| `pañca- myāstasil' (5.3.7) ityata prabhṛti`edhācca' (5.3.46) ityetatparyantaḥ|`śastasī' iti| `bahvalpārthācchas kārakādanyatarasyām' (5.4.42) `pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ' (5.4.44) `kṛtvasuc' iti| `saṃkhyāyaḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc' (5.4.17)iti| `dvitricaturbhyaḥ suc' (5.4.18) | `āsthālau' iti| `iṇa āsiḥ' (da.u.9.81) ityuṇā- disūtreṇa iṇo dhātorāsipratyayaḥ| `ayāḥ' ityudāharaṇam| `pratnapūrvaviśvemātthāl chandasi' (5.3.111) iti| `cvyarthāśca' iti| abhūtatadbhāve `kṛbhyastiyoge sampadya- karttari cviḥ' (5.4.50) `vibhāṣā sāti kātrsnye' (5.4.52)| `ām' iti| `kime- ttiṅavyayadhādāmvadravyaprakarṣe' (5.4.11)| `nipātā vakṣyante' iti| atha kasmāt te svarādiṣu na paṭhyante ? kaḥ purevaṃ guṇo bhavati ? avayayasaṃjñāyāṃ nipātagrahaṇaṃ tathā hi kriyāyoge dṛśyate-`svaḥ paśyanti, svarārohanti' iti| tatra yadi cādayo nipātāḥ paṭhyeran, teṣāṃ sattve'pi varttamānānāmavyayasaṃjñā prasajyeta| `avyayam' ityanvarthasaṃjñeyam' iti darśayitumāha- `sadṛśam' iti| triṣu liṅgeṣu strīpuṃnapuṃsakeṣu sadṛśaṃ tulyam, liṅgaviśeṣāparigrahālliṅgasāmānyopā- dānācca| `sarvāsu ca vibhaktiṣu' iti| vibhaktinimittatvād vibhaktiḥ| vibhajyate vā prātipadikārtha ābhiriti karmādīni kārakāṇi śaktirūpāṇi vibhaktiśabdenocyante| `vaca- neṣu ca' iti| vacanānyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanāni| ihābhidheye'bhidhānocārād ekādhikā saṃkhyā gṛhyate `yasmānna vyeti liṅgādisaṃkhyāviśeṣānupādānād vividhaṃ nānātvaṃ na gacchati tasmād avyayam' ityanvarthatā pratipāditā bhavati| prayojanaṃ punarupasarjanapra- tiṣedhaḥ, tadantavidhiścetyuktam| tatropasarajanapratiṣedhaḥ- `atyuccaiḥ, atyuccaisau, atyuccaisaḥ'| na hyatra yathopadarśitārthānugamaḥ sambhavati| yatra tu sambhavati, tatra tadantasyāvyayasaṃjñā bhavatyeva; yathā- `paramasvaḥ, uttamasvaḥ' iti| atra hi svar‌ śabda- sya prādhānyālliṅgādiviśesyāsambhavaḥ| pūrvatra tūccaiḥ śabdasya viparyayādvi- paryayaḥ| 38.taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ| (1.1.38) pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya grahaṇaṃ bhavatīta taddhitānta sya saṃjñā vijñāyata ityāha `taddhitāntaḥ śabdaḥ'iti| `yasmānna sarva' ityādi| atrāvayavakātrsnyavṛttiḥ sarvaśabdaḥ| sarvā niravaśeṣā yeṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ vacanānāṃ vibha- ktiriti saṃjñā kṛtā| tāni sarvāṇi yato nopatpadyanta ityarthaḥ. `tataḥ,yataḥ' iti| tad- yacchapabdāt pañcamīsamarthāt `pañcamyāstasil' (5.3.7)iti tasil, `supo dhātuprā tipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti subluk;`prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ' (5.3.1) iti vibhaktitvāt tyadādyatvam; `ato guṇe' (6.1.97), pararūpatvam| `tatra yatra 'iti| `saptamyāstral' (5.3.100 iti tral| `tadā, yadā, sarvadā' iti| `sarvaikānyakiṃyattadaḥ kāle dā' (5.3.15)| sarve ete-tataḥ prabhṛtayaḥ vibhaktyarthapradhānāḥ| sa ca vibhaktayarthaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ sampanna iti prātipadikārthe prathamaiva bhavati| sāpi saṃkhyāviśeṣābhāvānna sarvā| kiṃ tarhi? ekavacanameva; tasyotsargatvāt| tathā coktam- `ekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyate' iti| tasya `avyayādāpsupaḥ' (2.4.82) luk| `ekaḥ' iti| atrāsarvavibhaktikatvamasti; ekatve dvitvāyogāt| ataddhitatvānna bhavati| `aupagavaḥ' iti. atra taddhitāntasya sarvavibhaktiyogānna bhavati|| 39.kṛnmejantaḥ| (1.1.39) `svāduṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte' iti| `svādumi ṇamul' (3.4.26)| `svādumi' ityata eva nirdeśādupapadasya makārāntatvaṃ nipātyate| svādumiti cārthagrahaṇam| tena sampannādāvapyupapade ṇamul bhavati| `vakṣe' iti| `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1063), `bruvo vaciḥ' (2.4.56)iti brūñādeśo vā| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam| `antagrahaṇam' ityādi| `aupadeśikapratipattyartham' iti| nityayoge bahuvrīhivijñānādaupadeśikapratipattiḥ| upadeśe bhavamaupadeśikam|tasya pratipattirjñānam prayojanaṃ yasya tat tathā| evaṃ manyate- vināpyantagrahaṇena `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) iti sāmarthyādvā kṛtastadantavidhau siddhe yadantagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tasyaitat prayojanam niyogato yasyaijantatvamupadeśāvasthāyāmeva bhavati tasyaiva pratītiryathā syāditi| `ādhaye' iti| dadhāterāṅpūrvāt `upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' (3.3.92) iti kiḥ, `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.34) ityākāralopaḥ, caturthyekavacane `gherṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇaḥ| `cikīrṣadaḥ' iti| karoteḥ san, `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ; `sanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ' (3.2.168) ityupratyayaḥ; ato lopaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| `kumbhakārebhyaḥ' iti| `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) `upapadamatiṅa'(2.2.19) iti samāsaḥ; `bahuvacane jhalyet' (7.3.103) ityettvam| nanu ca lakṣamapratipadoktaparibhāṣayaiva vā `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) ityeva vātra saṃjñā na bhaviṣyati- vibhaktipratyayaṃ hyāśritya vidhīyamānatvād guṇādikāryaṃ bahiraṅgam, avyayasaṃjñā tvantaraṅgam, bāhyasya nimittasyānāśrayaṇāt, satyametat; evaṃ tvarthapratipattau pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| atastatparihārārthamantagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam|| 40. ktvātosunkasunaḥ| (1.1.40) `kṛtvā,hṛtvā' iti| `samānukartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle' (3.4.21) iti ktvā| ` udetoḥ' iti| `iṇ gatau' (dhā.1045) `sārvadhātuka' (7.3.84) iti guṇaḥ| `apākarttoḥ' iti| kṛñaḥ| `visṛpaḥ'iti|`gamlṛ' (dhā.942) `sṛplṛ' (dhā.983) itau| `ātṛdaḥ' iti| `tṛdir hiṃsānāradayoḥ' (dhā.1447) 41. avyayībhāvaśca| (1.1.41) `upāgni' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā sāmīpye'vyayībhāvaḥ| `avyayāt' (2.4.82) ita luk| agneḥ samīpe upāgnīti| upāgni mukhaṃ yasyetyavyayī-bhāvagarbho bahuvrīhiḥ|tatra `mukhaṃ svāṅgam' (6.2.167) ityuttarapadāntodāttatve prāpte`nāvyaya' (6.2.168) iti pratiṣiddham| `tasmin pratiṣiddhe pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ' iti| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1) ityādinā tat punarantodāttatvam,upāgniśabdasya samāsasvareṇāntodāttatvāt| `upapayaḥkāraḥ'iti| `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) evam, `upapayaḥ kāmaḥ' ityatrāpi| upapayaḥ kāmo yasyeti bahuvrīhirvāyam| kāmyata iti kāmaḥ, `akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19) iti karmaṇyapi ghañ| `anavyayasya' (vā.939) iti sattve pratiṣiddhe `kupvo ka pau ca'(8.3.37) jihvāmūlīyo bhavati, visarjanīyo vā| atra mukhasvaropacārau nirvartyamānau prayojanam, na tu vidhīyamānau; luk punarvidhīyamānaḥ| nanu cāvayayanibandhanamakajādikāryamastyeva,tat kuto'yaṃ kāryaniyamo labhyata ityāha- `sarvam' ityādi| `idam' iti| `taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38)ityādikam| kiñcit svarūpeṇaiva paṭhyate, kasyacit paryāyāntareṇārthaḥ| sa tvabhidheyadharmeṇopacārā-dityucyate| tatra `kṛmbhakārasandhyarāntaḥ' iti `kṛnmejantaḥ' (1.1.39) ityasyārthaḥpaṭhyate| ktvātosunkasuno'vyayībhāvaśceti svarūpeṇaiva| tasilādistaddhita edhācparya- nta iti yāvat| cvyarthāśceti| asimauṇādikaṃ varjayitvā| taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiri- tyasyārthaḥ| `anityatvajñāpanārtham' iti| prakṛtatvāt `saṃjñāyāḥ' iti labhyate| tenākajādau karttavye saṃjñā na bhavatīti| ajñātādyarthavivakṣāyāmupāgnikamityatrā- kaj na bhavati, ka eva tu bhavati| iha ca upakumbhamātmānaṃ manyata upakumbhammanyaḥ, `ātmamāne khaśca' (3.2.83) ita khaśi kṛte `khityanavyayasya' (6.3.66) ityanuvarttamāne `arurdviṣadajantasya mum' (6.3.67) iti mumaḥ pratiṣedho na bhavati| `iha ca' ityādinā `avyayapratiṣedhe tosunkasunorapratiṣedhaḥ' iti yadvakṣyati tasyātrāvaktavyatāṃ darśayati| sūryasyetyatra `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti ṣaṣṭhī|| 42. śi sarvanāmasthānam| (1.1.42) `kuṇḍāni' ityādi| `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20) iti śiḥ, tasya sarvanāmasthāna tve sati `naṃpusakasya' sthānam' iti| pūrvācāryaireveyaṃ prayojanamantareṇāpi mahatī saṃjñā praṇitā| tasyā iha yat samāśrayaṇam tat tatkṛtasya śabdānuśāsanasya doṣavattvasūcanārtham| tat punaḥ svaśāstrasya punaruktatādoṣaparihārārtham| yadi hi taddoṣavadbhavatyevamasya praṇayanaṃ yujyate, nānyathā| 43. sujanapuṃsakasya| (1.1.43) suḍaiti pratyāhāraragrahaṇam- suśabdādārabhya ā auṭaṣṭakārāt| tatra pañcaiva vacanānayantarbhavantītyāha -`suḍiti pañca vacanāni' ityādi| `napuṃsakādanyatra' ityādi| anenānapuṃsakaśabdasya paryudāsatāṃ darśayati| prasajyapratiṣedhe hi pratiṣedhapradhānamidaṃ vākyaṃ syāt - napuṃsakasya na bhavatīti| tataśca yāvatī kācit suṭaḥ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñā- prāptiḥ, tasyāḥ sarvasyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| evaṃ hi `kuṇḍāni tiṣṭhanti' ityatra pūrveṇāpi saṃjñā na syāt| tasyāstu śasaḥ śirādeśo'vakāśaḥ| yadyapi `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā (vyā.pa.ta19) ityetatsamāśrayeṇa prasajyapratiṣedhe 'pyeṣa doṣa- śakyate parihartum, tathāpi pratipattigauravadoṣaḥ syāt| tathā hi- vidhipratiṣedhayorvirodhādekena vākyena tāvacchakyo na vidhātumiti vākyabhedaḥ karttavyaḥ- `suṭ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjño bhavati| napuṃsakasya ca na bhavati' iti| tataścāsambaddhaṃ pratiṣedhavacana- miti pūrvasyā api prāpterayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ sambhāvyeta| tatastatparihāreṇābhīṣṭārtha pratipattau sādhyāyāṃ niyatabhāvī gauravadoṣaḥ prasajyeta| tasmāt sukhāvabodhārthaṃ - paryudāsa evāśritaḥ| napuṃsake na vidhiḥ' iti| strīpuṃsambandhinaḥ suṭa upādānāt| `na pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| vidhipradhānatvāt prayudāsasya| etena napuṃsake'sya yogasyāvyāpāraṃ darśayati- `tena' ityādi| yata eva nupaṃsake nāsya vidhau pratiṣedhe vā vyāpāraḥ, tena jaso yaḥ śirādeśastasya tena pūrvayogena saṃjñā bhavatyeva; apratiṣiddhatvāt| `rājā' iti| pūrvaddīrghaḥ| halṅyādilopaḥ| `sāmanī,vamanī'iti| `napuṃsakācca' (7.1.19) iti auṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ| tatra saṃjñāyā abhāvāddīrghatvaṃ na bhavati| 44. na veti vibhāṣā| (1.1.44) naveti śabdo'yameko nipāto'pyasti pratiṣedhavācī, yathā-`navā vaktavyaṃ bhuktārthatvāt' ityādau bhāṣyavākye| tasyeha yadi grahaṇaṃ syāt `vibhāṣā diksamāse bahuvrīhau' (1.1.28) ityuktvā `na bahuvrīhau' (1.1.29) ityatra tu punaḥ prati- ṣedhopādānamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmānna nipātasamudāyo'yamiti darśayannāha- `neti pratiṣe- dhaḥ' ityādi| nanu cānyatra saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhaprakriyāyā hi śāstre śabdasyaiva grahaṇaṃ prasiddham, yathā taraptamapau ghaḥ' (1.1.22) `dādhā ghvadāp' (1.1.20) iti, tathehāpi navāśabdayoreva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| tat kathaṃ tadarthayoḥ saṃjñā labhyata ityāha-`itikaraṇaḥ' ityādi| kriyata iti karaṇaḥ, itaścāsau karaṇaścetītikaraṇaḥ, so'rthasya saṃjñino nirdeśo yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| itiśabdo hi viparyāsakṛt| yathā
