gavityarthamāheti gośabdāt parataḥ prayujyamāna itaśabdastamarthapadārthakatvāt pracyāvya śabdapadārthakatve vyavasthāpayati, tathā `navā' śabdābhyāṃ paraḥ iti śabdaḥ prayujyamānaḥ, tau svarūpapadārthaka- tvātpracyāvyārthapadārthakatve vyavasthāpayati| tasmādarthanirdeśārtha evetiśabdaḥ kṛta iti naveti yāvarthau pratīyete pratiṣedhavikalpau, tayoreveyaṃ saṃjñā bhavati; na navāśabda- yoḥ| `tatra pratiṣedhena' ityādinā pratiṣedhavikalpayoḥ pravṛttikramaṃ vyāpārabedaṃ ca darśayati| `samīkṛte' iti| tulyatāmāpādite| `vikalpaḥ pravarttate' iti| pakṣe kāryasampādanāya| nanu ca vāśabda eva vikalpārthatvena loke prasiddhaḥ, pradeśeṣvayamupādīyamāno vikalpena kāryaṃ sampādayiṣayati| tathā hi prāpte vā kārye vikalpaḥ kriyatām ? yadi prāpte? tatra prāptirastyeveti pratiṣedha eva pakṣe karttavyaḥ| athāprāpte ? tatra prāptipūrvakatvāt pratiṣedhasya tāmantareṇa sa na yujyata iti vidhireva pakṣe karttavyaḥ, na pratiṣedhaḥ| etaccobhayaṃ vāśabda eva śaktaḥ prayujyamānaḥ sampādayitum| tat kimarthamiyaṃ saṃjñā kriyata ityāha- `ubhayatra vibhāṣāḥ prayojanti' iti| prakṛtatvāt saṃjñāmiti gamyate| `vibhāṣā śveḥ' (6.1.30) ityatra pratiṣedhamukhena vāśabdasya pravṛttiḥ syāt? vidhimukhena vā ? tatra yadi pratiṣedhamukhena vā na bhavatītyevaṃ pravṛttiḥ ? prāptipūrvakatvāt pratiṣedhasya yatra sa eva tasya viṣaya iti kitsveva vikalpena pratiṣedhāyedaṃ pravarttate| tatra `vacisvapi' (6.1.15) ityādinā śvayateḥ samprasāraṇasya vihitatvāt, na pitsu; tatra tasya na kenacidvihitatvāt. ekatvaccā- sya vākyasya kitsu ca pratiṣedhasampādana eva caritārthatvāt nopapadyate punarvidhimukhena pravṛttiḥ| atha vidhimukhena vā bhavatītyevaṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt ? yatra prāptirnā- sti sa eva vidhiviṣaya iti pitsveva vikalpena vidhyarthaḥ pravarttate;tatra caritārtha- tvāt na kitsu| saṃjñāvidhāne tu na doṣaḥ; tasyāṃ hi satyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ pravartta- māno yo'sau samprasāraṇanimittānimittabhedādviṣaya āsīt taṃ samīkaroti| sarvasyāḥ samprasāraṇanimittatayā tulyatāmāpādayati|tasmin samīkṛte kiti ca piti ca vikalpaḥ prava- rttamāno vidhimukena sarvatra pākṣikaṃ kāryaṃ sampādayati, samprasāraṇaṃ pakṣe bhavatīti| aprāptistu pakṣe sthitaiveti sarvamiṣṭaṃ sidhyati| tasmādubhayatra prāptāvaprā- ptau vibhāṣārthamiyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate| śuśāveti| `ṭuośvigativṛddhyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1010), liṭ‌, ṇal, saṃprasāraṇe kṛte vṛddhyāvādeśau| `śuśuvatuḥ,śiśviyatuḥ' iti| `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinā iyaṅuvaṅau|| 45.igyaṇaḥ samprasāraṇam| (1.1.45) `bhūtaḥ'iti| yatra śāstrāntareṇa vihito bhūtavibhaktyā kāryāntarārthamanūdya-te, yathā- `samprasāraṇasya' (6.1.139) `saprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108)iti, tatra bhūtaḥ| `bhāvī vā' iti| yatra bhāvyamānavibhaktyā vidhānārthaṃ nirdiśyate, yathā `ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam' (6.1.13) `vasoḥ samprasāraṇam' (6.4.131) iti, tatra bhāvī| atra hi ṣyaṅaḥ sthāniko vasusthānikaśceṅaḥ nāsti yasya saṃjñā sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vaya' iti| sa ig yaṇaḥ sthāne bhavati, yasya bhūtasya samprasāraṇamityeṣā saṃjñā bhavatīti| `iṣṭam, uptam' iti| `vacisvapiyajādīnāṃ kiti' (6.1.15) ita samprasāraṇam| `gṛhītam'ityatrāpi `grahijyāvayi'(6.1.16) ityādinā samprasāraṇam| `graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ' (7.2.37) | `kecit' ityādinā ye bhāvinīṃ saṃjñāṃ nāśrayanti tanmataṃ darśayati| kathaṃ punarekasya sūtrasyaitadarthadvayamekena vākyena labhyate? tantreṇa, āvṛttyā vā| nanu ca saṃjñāvidhauśabdasyaiva grahaṇaṃ prasidhdamityuktam, tato yuktaṃ varṇasyaiva saṃjñitvam, arthasyatatu katham ? yathā `naveti vibhāṣā' (1. .44) iti sūtra iti cet? na yuktam; tatretikaraṇa- syārthanirdeśārthasya prayogāt, iha tu sa nāstītyayuktam | ihāpi tantrasyāvṛ- ttervā nyāyasyāśritatvād yuktameva | asya ca sūtrārthadvayasya vibhaktiviśeṣani-rdeśo liṅgam | yadayaṃ `ṣyaḍaḥ samprasāraṇam' (6 1.13) ityādau vidhivākye bhāṣyamānavibhak‌tyā nirdeśaṃ karoti tato jñāyate-`vākyārthaḥ saṃjñī' iti | yataśca `samprasāraṇasya' (6.3.139) ityādau bhūtavibhak‌tyā nirdeśaṃ karoti tato'vasīyate- `varṇa' iti | tasmād yuktaṃ vākyārthasyāpi saṃjñitvam| kirūpo'sau vākyārthaḥ ? ityāha-`sthānyadeśaḥ' ityādi | tatretyādinā anantarayoḥ sūtrārthayorviṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati--vidhau varṇo na sambhavatīti | `ṣyaḍaḥ samprasāraṇam' (6 1.13) ityādau vidhivākye prathamaḥ sūtrārtha upatiṣṭhate | anavāde tu `samprasāraṇasya'(6.3.139) ityādau vihitatvādvidheyasya prathamo'kiñcitkara iti dvitīyaḥ | `aduhitarām' iti | atra yaṇaḥ sthānikatvādikaḥ samprasāraṇasaṃjñayā bhāṣyam | tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghatvaṃ prasajyetīti codyamapākarttumāha-`saṃkhyayātānudeśāt'ityādiiha sthānino yaṇaścatvāraḥ iko'pyādeśāścatvāra eva, tena saṃkhyātānudeśena bhavitavyam `yathāsaṃkhyamanudeśaḥ' (1.3.10) ityādinā | tataśca yakārasya sthāne ya ivarṇastasyaiva samprasāramasaṃjñā bhavati | na ceha yakārasya sthāna ivarṇaḥ | kiṃ tarhi ? lakārasya | tat kutastasyāḥ prasaṅgaḥ ? `druha prapūraṇe' (dhā. pā. 1014), laṅa, `karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' (3.1.87) ityatideśe karmakartayasminepadam, iṭ | `na duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' (3.1.89) iti yaki pratiṣiddhe śap | tasyādāditvālluk | aduhi iti sthite `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) iti tarap | `kimettiṅavyayaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe'(5 4.11) ityām | tarapa ihopanyāso'ṅgasaṃjñārthaḥ | 46. ādyatantau ṭakitau| (1.1.46) `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' (1.1.49) ityasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā ayamapavādaḥ| tena tatsambandhādasyāpi paribhāṣātvaṃ vijñāyate| yadi tarhyādiṣṭid bhavatyantaḥ kidbhavati, tadā `careṣṭaḥ' (3.2.16) `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) ityādayo'pi pratyayā ādyantabhūtāḥ syuoḥ| na ca ṭitaḥ pratyayasyāditve `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṭito vidhīyamāno ṅīb niravakāśa ityāśaṅkanīyam| yatra hi prakṛtereva siddhaṃ ṭittvaṃ na pratyayasya, nadaḍ bhaṣaḍityevamādau, sa tasyāvakāśo bhaviṣyatīti| ṭitaśca pratyayasyā- ditve sati kurucara ityevamādirūpameva sidhyet| kitastvantyatve ādhyoḥ, vidhyori- tyatra `upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' (3.3.92) iti kipratyayasya prakṛtyantaḥ-pātitvāddhātu- grahaṇena grahaṇe sati `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' (6.1.174) ityeṣa svaro na syāt| `noṅa dhātvoḥ' (6.1.175) iti pratiṣedhādityata āha- `ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇasya siṃhāvalokitanyāyenopa-sthānāt| nanvevamapi `gāpoṣṭak' (3.2.8) `vrīhiśālyorḍhak' (5.2.2) ityetāvādya ntau prāpnutaḥ, naiṣa doṣaḥ, `purastādapavādā anantarāt vidhīn bādhante nottarān' (vyā.pa.9) iti sthāneyogatvasyaivāyamapavādo bhaviṣyati, na pratyayaparatvasya| apara āha- ādyantāvayavau, avayavaścāvayavinamantareṇa na sambhavatītyavayavinamākṣipya tau varttete| tataścāvayavāvayavisambandhe yalasyādiranto vāvayavo vidhīyate, so'vayavo ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeṣṭa- vya iti sāmarthyādavayavaṣaṣṭhyā nirdiṣṭasyeti jñāyate| na caivam| `gāpoṣṭak' (3.2.8) `vrīhiśālyorḍhak' (5.2.2) ityetau pratyayāvādyantau prāpnutaḥ, yasmādiha prakṛtayo'vayavaṣaṣṭhyā nirdiṣṭāḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? supāṃ supo bhavantīti pañcamyarthe yā ṣaṣṭhī tayeti| `bhīṣayate' iti| `ñibhī bhaye'(dhā.pā.1084) hetumaṇṇic, `bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk' (7.3.40) `bhīsmyorhetubhaye' (1.3.68) ityātmanepadam| 47. midaco'ntyātparaḥ| (1.1.47) atra yadi `acaḥ' (4.3.31) ityeṣā pañcamī syāt, antyādityanayā pañcamyā samānādhikaraṇatvaṃ syāt| tataḥ `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.52) iti numīhaivā- ntyādacaḥ paraḥ syāt- `kuṇḍāni' iti; asti hyatra napuṃsakasyāntyo'caḥ; payāṃsī- tyatra tu na syāt, `alo'ntyasya ' (1.1.52) iti sakārasyaiva tu sthāne syāt| hyatrājantyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? sakāraḥ| tasmānnirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhīyamiti darśayannāha-`acām'ityādi| jātau bahuvacam| sūtre'pyaca ityekavacanaṃ jātāveva| yadi tarhi nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhīyam, antyasyāviśeṣitatvādaviśeṣeṇa yataḥ kutaścidantyāt paro mit syāt; na hi dvītīyamajgrahaṇamasti, yenāntyo diśeṣyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; samānajātīyasyaiva hi loke nirdhāraṇapratītirbhavati| tathā hi `kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannaśrīratamā' ityukte gaureva pratīyate; nājā, nāpyaśvā| tasasmādihāpyacāṃ madhye'ntyādaco'vadherityantyatvena nirdhāryamāṇaḥ samānajātīyo'jeva| pratīyate| tenāca evāntyāt paro bhaviṣyati| sthāneyogitvapratyayaparatvāpavādārthañcedamārabdham| tatra sthāneyogitvāpavādārtham-`śemucādīnām' (7.1.59) num bhavati, muñcati| `napuṃkas jhalacaḥ' (7..72)payāṃsi| pratyayaparatvāpavādārtham‌- `rudhādibhyaḥ śnam' (3.1.78),ruṇaddhi| nanu ca `purastāda-pavādā anantarān vidhīn bādhante nottarān (vyā.pa.9) iti sthāneyogitvasyaivāpavādo yujyate, na tu pratyayaparatvasya, naitadasti; evaṃ hi śnamo mitkaraṇamanavakāśatvādanarthakaṃ syāt| śravaṇārthatvānnānarthakamiti cet ? naḥ; `tṛṇaha im'(7.3.92) iti nirdeśāt| śravaṇārthe hyetasmin `tṛṇam ha im' iti nirdeśaḥ syāt| tasmāt pratyayaparatva- syāpavādo yuktaḥ| yadyevaṃ `tanmadhyapatitastad‌grahaṇena gṛhyate' (vyā.pa.21) iti prakṛtyantaḥ pātinastad‌grahaṇena grahaṇādaparatvācca śnamaḥ pratyayasaṃjñā na syāt, tathā ca `laśakvataddhite' (1.3.8) iti pratyayādeḥ śakārasya vidhīyamānetsaṃjñā na syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; pratyayādhikāre vidhīyamānatvāt pratyayasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati- satyapyaparatve, satyapi prakṛtyantaḥ pātitve; yathā-bahujakacorantodāttatvam| `bahupaṭavaḥ, uccakaiḥ' ityanayorasati paratve satyaṃ pratyayasaṃjñāyāṃ `citaḥ' (6.1.163) ityantodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva| `masjeḥ' ityādi| nakārasyopadhāyā `anuṣaṅgaḥ' iti pūrvācāryeḥ saṃjñā kṛtā| `ṭumasjo śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1416) ityasya `masjinaśorjhali' (7.1.60)iti numaṃ vakṣyati| sa ca yadyaco'ntyāt paraḥ syāt `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' (8.2.29) iti sakāra- sya `aniditām' (6.4.24) iti nakārasya ca lopo na syāt; yathākramamanāditvādanu- dhatvācca| tasmādantyājjakārāt pūrvo jakārasakārayormadhye num karttavyaḥ| yathā cāntyāt pūrvo labhyate,tathā saptame vakṣyate| `magnaḥ' iti| `oditaśca' (8.2.45)iti niṣṭhānatvam, tasyāsiddhatvat `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvaṃ jakārasya gakāraḥ| `maṅktā' iti atra pūrvavad gakāre kṛte tasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvaṃ kakāraḥ| `naścāpadāntasya jhali' (8.3.24) ityanusvāraḥ| `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58) ṅakāraḥ| pūrvabhaktaścāyaṃ mid veditavyaḥ; anyathā `vahābhre lihaḥ' (3.2.32) iti lihaḥ khaśi kṛte `arurdviṣadajantasya' (6.3.67) iti mumi kṛte vahaṃlih ityatra `mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.23) iti padāntasya vidhīyamāno'nusvāro na syāt, apadāntatvāt| 48.eca igghrasvādeśe| (1.1.48) paribhāṣeyamādeśaniyamārthā `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya'(1.2.47) ityādāvu-patiṣṭhate| ihem eco'vayavasamāhāravarṇāḥ| tatra `e ai' ityetayoḥ pūrvo bhāgo varṇasamā- nākṛtirmātrātmaiva tālavyaḥ| ata eva `e ai kaṇṭhyatālavyau' (ā.śi. 17) iti śikṣākārāḥ paṭhanti; tadavayavoḥ kaṇṭhyatālavyatvāt| `oau' ityetayoḥ pūrvo bhāgastādṛśa eva, yādṛśa ekāraikārayoḥ| uttarastūvarṇasamānākṛtirmātrika oṣṭhyaḥ| ata eva `o au kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyau' (ā.śi|18) iti śikṣākārāḥ paṭhanti; tadavayavoḥ kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyatvāt| tatra samudāyātmanāmecāṃ samudāyāntaratamo hrasvo nāstīti tadavayavasya yo'ntaratamaḥ, tanaiva yuktaṃ bhavitum| sa punarakārā ikāra ukāro vā| tatra ekāraikārayorhrasvo vidhīyamānaḥ kadācidakāraḥ syāt,kadācidikāraḥ| okāraukārayorapi kadācikāraḥ syāt, kadācidukāraḥ| ikārokārāveva yathāyogaṃ yathā syātām, kadācidapyakāro mā bhūdityevamarthamidamārabhyate| atra yadyapyecāmikāṃ sāmyam, tathāpi saṃkhyātānudeśo na bhavati, yasmādannedaṃ vidhāyakam, kiṃ tarhi? niyāmakam| prāptipūrvakaśca niyama iti ye prāptā antaratamā ika eco hrasvāsteṣāmanena niyamaḥ kriyate| na ca prāptāvṛkāralṛkārāviti kuto yathāsaṃkhya- tvam? yadyevam, iṇṇityeva vaktavyam, na tvagiti, satyametat; kintvevamucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt- kiṃ pūrveṇa ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ ? uta pareṇa ? iti; tasmādasandehārthamigityuktam| `atiri, atinu' iti| rāyamatikrāntaṃ, nāvamatikrāntaṃ brāhmaṇakulam `atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā' (vā.91) iti `kugati' (2.2.18) ityā- dinā samāsaḥ, `paravalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ' (2.4.26) iti puṃlliṅge strīliṅge ca prāpte `dviguprāptāpannālaṃpūrvagatisamāseṣu talliṅgameva bhavati| `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvaḥ. ik kaṇṭhatālavyasyaikārasya tālavya ikāro bhavati| kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyasyaukārasyauṣṭhya ukāraḥ| `upagu' iti| goḥ samīpamiti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā sāmīpye'vyayībhāvaḥ| `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvaḥ| kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyokārsayauṣṭhya ukāraḥ| ekārasya tūdāharaṇam- he itīmaṃ śabdamatikrāntaṃ brāhmaṇakulamatihi| `atatikhaṭvaḥ' iti| pūrvavat prādisamāse kṛte `gostrirupasarjanaska' (1.2.48) ityevamādinā hrasvo'kāra eva bhavatyantaratamaḥ| `de3vadatta' iti| atrāmantritsayāderudāttādeśe karttavye `devada3tta' ityatra ca `guroranṛto'ntyasya' (8.2.86) ityādinā plutādeśe karttavya iṅa na bhavati|| 49. ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā|| (1.1.49) `yoganiyamārthā' iti| yoganiyamaḥ sambandhaniyamaḥ, so'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| yadi yoganiyamārthayam- śāstre yā ṣaṣṭhī, sā sthāneyogaiv bhavati, nānyayoge- ti| evaṃ sati `ūdupadhāyā gohaḥ' (6.4.89) ityeṣāpi ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogaiva syāt, nāvayavādayavisambandhayogā| tataśca `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti sthānaṣaṣṭhyā antye'pyupasaṃhārād gohaścāntasya hakārasya ūkāraḥ syāt | `upadhāyāśca' (7.1.101) iti vacanādupadhā-mātrasya cetyata āha-`iha śāstre yā ṣaṣṭhyaniyatayogā' ityādi| aniyamaprasaṅge niyamo'nayā kriyate| kva cāniyamaprasaṅgaḥ ? yatra sandehaḥ; yathā-`asterbhūḥ' (2.4.52)iti| atra hi kimasteḥ sthāne? āhosvidanantare ? iti sandehaḥ, pūrvatra tūpadhāyā avayavalakṣaṇasya sthānino viśiṣṭāvayavino vyavacchinnatvādavayavaṣṭhyeveyamiti niścitam; tato nātrāsyā vyāpāraḥ| `sthāneyogaiva' iti| sthāna iti nimittasaptamī, yogaḥ sambandhaḥ| tenedamuktaṃ bhavati-sthānanimittakasambandhaiveti| etadeva vispaṣṭīkurvannāha-`sthāne yogasya nimitte' ityādi| sthāneyogas nimittabhūte nimittatvaṃ prāpte sati sā veditavyā| bhūtaśabdo hyatra prāptaśabde vartate; yathā- `devabhūtaḥ' ityatra devatvaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ| nimittagrahaṇaṃ kurvan sūtre sthāneyogeti nimittasapta- mīyamiti darśayati| yogaḥ punariha sthānyādeśabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| kuta etat? tasyaiva sthāni- hetutvāt| sthānaśabdobhāvasādhanaḥ, sthitiḥ sthānam| tat punastridhā- `apakarṣaḥ, nivṛttiḥ,prasaṅgaśca' iti| gosthāne'śvo badhyatāmityapakarṣaḥ sthānaśabdasyāstheyaḥ| `śleṣmaṇaḥ sthāne kaṭukamauṣadham' ityatra nivṛttiḥ| `darbhāṇāṃ sthāne śarairāstakarita- vyam' iti prasaṅgaḥ| tatrādyāvarthāviha na sambhavataḥ; nityatvācchabdārthasambandhasya prathamo na sambhavati; sāmānyenāsterupadeśānna dvitīyaḥ| tasmāt tṛtīya evārtha iti matvāha-`stānaśabdaśca' iti| prasaṅgastvarthakriyānimittabhūtasya kālasyāvasaraḥ| ` astesthāne prasaṅge' iti| asteryā kriyā svārthapratipādanalakṣaṇā, tasyā nimittabhūtasya kālasyāvasaraḥ prāpta ityarthaḥ| prasaṅge sambandhasya nimittabhūta ityādinā sūtrārthasyodāharaṇe sambhavaṃ darśayati| `bruvaḥ' iti copalakṣaṇamātram| asteri- tyāderapi hi ṣaṣṭhī prasaṅga eva sambandhasya nimittabhāva utpannā| ke punarbahavaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthāḥ, yataḥ sambandhāntaraviṣayavyavacchedanārthaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā idamucyate? ityāha-`bahavo hi' ityādi| śabde hi samīpānantaravikārāvayavādinimittāḥ sambandhāḥ santi| na tvapatyāpatyavatprabhṛtaya ityato `yāvantaḥ śabde sambhavanti' ityāha| atha sthāneyoga ita kimasamāsaḥ? atha samāsaḥ? yadyasamāsaḥ? tadā yogaśabdasya puṃlliṅgatvāt strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīśabdena ca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti; yogasyāṣaṣṭhītvāt| ataḥ samāsaḥ kiṃ tatpuruṣaḥ ? āhosvid bahuvrīhiḥ ? yadi tatpuruṣaḥ ? tau ca pūrvoktau doṣau syātām, saptamyā lukaprasaṅgaśca| atha bahuvrīhiḥ? evamapi lukprasaṅgo'trānivārya evetyata āha-`ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' ityādi| gatārtham| 50.sthāne'ntaratamaḥ| (1.1.50) paribhāṣeyamādeśaniyamārthā|`sthāne prāpyamāṇānām' iti| etena nedaṃ vidhāyakaṃ vākyam, kiṃ tarhi? lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāptānāmanantaratamānāmitareṣāṃ ca yo'ntaratamaḥ, sa eva bhavatīti niyamārthamiti darśayati| vidhāyakatve hi `dadhi madhu' itādāvapi prasajyate| kiṃ punaratrāniṣṭam ? yāvatāntaratamyād dadhimadhuśabdayostāvevādeśau bhaviṣyataḥ, tayorapyādeśayoranyau dadhimadhuśabdau yāvādeśau syātām, tayorapyanyāvityevamaparisamāptādeśapara- mparāvidhānādanavasthā syāt| tataścārthapratyāyanaṃ prati śabdānāṃ viniyogo na syāt,anvākhyāyakasya śāstrasya pravṛttyanuparamāt| śāstroparatau hyanvākhyātāste prayujyate, nānyathetyaniṣṭam| nanu ca sakṛtpravṛttau lakṣaṇasya caritārtatvāt punaḥ pravṛttirna bhaviṣyati, naitadastica yatra hi prayojanārthā pravṛttistatraitaduktam, iha punarakasmādantaratamo vidhīyata ityanuparataivāsya pravṛttiḥ| niyamākatve'pyasya yadīdaṃ vihitānāṃ niyamaṃ kuryāt ! anarthakameva vacanaṃ syāt| yo hi bhuktavantaṃ bruyāt- `mā bhuṅkṣya' iti,kiṃ tasya tena kṛtaṃ syāt ! tasmāt prāpyamāṇāvasthāyāmeva vākyāntaraḥ saha saṃhatyānana kāryaṃ nirvartyate; tadekadeśabhūtvādasya| `sadṛśatamaḥ' iti| antaratamaśabdasyārtha kathayati| `arthataḥ' ityādi| vataṇḍaśabdāt striyāmapatyārthe `vataṇḍācca' (4.1.108) iti yañ,tasya `luk striyām'(6.4.14) ityakāralopaḥ, vataṇḍī cāsau yuvatiśceti `poṭāyuvati' (2.1.65) ityādinā samāsaḥ| tatrānena `puṃvata karmadhārayaḥ' (6.3.42) ityādinā puṃvadbhāve kartavye sarvaḥ puṃśabdaḥ prasaktaḥ| tatrānena vataṇḍāpatyārtha- sya vataṇḍī śabdasyārthato'ntaratamo vataṇḍāpatyārtha eva vātaṇḍyaśabdo bhavati| `pākaḥ' ityādau bhāve ghañ| `cakārasya' ityādi| `vargāṇāṃ prathamā alpaprāṇāḥ' (āpi.śi. 4.3.) iti cakārakakārāvalpaprāṇau| `vargāṇāṃ prathamadvitīyāḥ śaṣasavisarjanīya- jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyā yamau ca prathamadvitīyau vivṛtakaṇṭhāḥ śvāsānupradānā aghoṣāḥ' (āpi.śi|4.2.) ityaghoṣau| `jakārasya' ityādi| `vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā antaḥsthā hakārānusvārau yamau ca dvitīyacaturthau nāsikyāśca saṃvṛkaṇṭhā nādānupradānā ghoṣavantaḥ'mahāprāṇāḥ' ityalpaprāṇau| `amuṣmai, amūbhyām' iti| adasaścaturthyekavacane bhyāmi ca paratastyadādyatvam,`ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam, `sarvanāmnaḥ smaiḥ' (7.1.4) iti smaibhāvaḥ| bhyāmi `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghaḥ, tato hrasvasya hrasva ukāro bhavati, dīrghasya dīrghaḥ| `sthāne iti varttamāne' iti| prakṛto hi sthānaśabdaḥ prasaṅgavācī| tadanuvṛ- ttau sthāne prāpyamāṇānāmantaratamo bhavati' ityeṣo'rtho labhyate| nanu ca yatrānekamā- ntaryaṃ tatra tālvādisthānata evāntaryasya balīyastvam, tasmāt tad yathā syāditi punastālvādisthānavācinaḥ sthānaśabdasyopādānaṃ kriyate| yadyevam,sthānakṛtamevehāntaryaṃ viśiṣṭamupāttamiti pramāṇādikṛtaṃ parityaktaṃ syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, vākyabhedaṃ hi kṛtvā tatra sambandhaḥ kriyate, sthāne prāpyamāṇānāmantaratama ādeśo bhavati| `sthāne ca bhavati' iti pūrvatra vākye prasaṅgavācī sthāśabdaḥ, uttaratra tālvādisthānavācī| evaṃ vākyabhedena sambandhe sati, pūrvasmin vākye sthānādikṛtānāmāntaryāṇāṃ - parigrahaḥ pratīyate| dvitīye tu teṣāmeva balābalavattvam| `sthāne' iti ca nimittasaptamī| tenedamuktaṃ bhavati- yatrānekamāntaryaṃ tatra sthānena nimittena yo'ntaratamaḥ, sa eva bhavati| vākyabhedasya ca tamabgrahaṇaṃ liṅgam| sādṛśye prakarṣo hi tena pratipādayitumiṣṭaḥ| sa cānekasmin sādṛśye sati sādṛśyāntarāpekṣayā bhavati| ekavākyatāyāṃ ca sthānagrahaṇena sādṛśyāntare niraste kimapekṣayā sādṛśyaprakarṣaḥ syāt ! tasmāt tama- bgrahaṇād vākyabhedo'numīyate, anyathā hi tasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| `cetā' iti| atrekārasya tālavyatvādekārasya kaṣṭhatālavyatvāt sthānata āntaryam; ikārākārayostu pramāṇayorapi mātrikatvāt| `stotā' iti| atrāpyukāra-syauṣṭhyatvādokārasya kaṇṭhyauṣṭhyatvāt sthānata āntaryam| ukārākāyostu pramāṇataḥ pūrvavat| tatrāsati punaḥ sthānagrahaṇe, pramāṇata āntaryāt kadācidakāro guṇaḥ syāt, sthānata āntaryāt kadācidekārau| punaḥ sthānagrahaṇāt tu sthānakṛtasyāntaryasya balīyastvādekāraukārau eva bhavataḥ, na kadācidakāraḥ| `soṣmaṇaḥ, soṣmāṇa iti ' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau; yasmāt soṣmāṇo dvitīyastasmāt soṣmaṇo hakārasya dvitīyāḥ prasaktā ityarthaḥ| evaṃ `nādavato nādavantaḥ' ityādau vākye hetvartho yojyaḥ| `śādaya ūṣmāṇaḥ sasthānena dvitīyā hakāreṇa caturthāḥ' iti śikṣā (ā.śi.1.4. 8.10) | atra `śādaya ūṣmāṇaḥ' vacanena hakārasya soṣmatvaṃ pratipāditam| `sasthānena dvitīyāḥ' ityanena tu vargadvitīyānāṃ khakārādīnām| `hakāreṇa caturthāḥ' ityanenāpi vargacaturthānāṃ dhakārādīnām| samānaṃ sthānaṃ yasya sa sasthānaḥ| `sasthānena' iti| ittha- mbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā| sasthānena dvitīyā ūṣmatayā lakṣyante| etaduktaṃ bhavati- `yathā sasthāna eveṣāmūṣmā, evamete'pi vargāṇāṃ dvitīyā ūṣmāṇaḥ' iti| atha vā - tulyārthayoga eṣā tṛtīyā, tulyaśabdastvadhyāhāryaḥ, tulyatvamūṣmatayā veditavyam| tatra khakārasya sasthāno hakāraḥ, chakārasya śakāraḥ, ṭhakārasya ṣakāraḥ, thakārasya sakāraḥ| phakārasya sasthāna ūṣmā nāsti| tasmāt tasyāpi viśeṣeṇoṣmatvaṃ lakṣyante, tatsadṛśatvāt| tena yathā hakāra ūṣmā evaṃ te'pītyarthaḥ| `nādavataḥ' ityādi| `vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthāḥ' ityādinā pūrvoktena granthena tṛtīyānāṃ hakārasya nādavattvamuktam| ye soṣmāṇo `nādavantaśca' iti| soṣmatvaṃ hakārasya `śādaya ūṣmāṇaḥ' (ā.śi.1.4.8) ityanenākhyātam,caturthānāṃ tu `hakāreṇa caturthāḥ' (ā.śi. 1.4.1) ityanena nādavattvam, ubhayeṣāṃ vargāṇāṃ tṛtīyacaturthā ityādinaiva pūrvoktena| 51. uraṇ raparaḥ| (1.1.51) atra trayaḥ pakṣāḥ sambhavanti- `uḥ sthāne'ṇ raparatvaṃ cānenobhayaṃ vidhīyate' ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ| `lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihitasyāṇa uḥ sthāne paścādanena raparatvamātraṃ kriyate' iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ| `uḥ sthāne lakṣaṇāntareṇa vidhīyamāno'ṇa vidhānakāla eva tena lakṣaṇāntareṇa saha saṃhatya raparatvaviśiṣṭo'nena bhāvyate' iti tṛtīyaḥ| tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate, ṛkārasya sthāna udāttādayo na syuḥ, anena bādhitvāt; `kṛti' ityatra `ñnityādinityam' (6.1.197) ityādyudātto na syāt, `prakṛtam' ityatra pūrvapadsayādyudāttasya `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49)iti prakṛtisvare kṛte `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (6.1.198) ityanudātto na syāt, `udāttānudāttasya svaritaḥ' (8.4.66)iti svaritaśca| yadyacaḥ sthāne udāttādayo vidhīyante, tathāpi teṣāmanyo'javakāśa iti ṛvarṇasthāne pratipadokto'ṇeva raparaḥ syāt| ye cāpyanya ṛvarṇasthāne pratipadamādeśā ucyante, `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) ityevamādibhirlakṣaṇāntaraisteṣu raparatvaṃ na syāt; tataśca `kirati' ityādi na sidhyet| atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate, taratestṛjādau guṇo vidhīyamānaḥ pramāṇata āntaratamyād dīrghasya dīrgha eva syāt, tathā ca `taritā' ityādi na sidhyet| kiṃ ca- ṇvulādau vṛddhau vidhīyamānāmṛkārasya kenacid vṛddhisaṃjñakenāntaratamyaviśeṣo nāstīti sarve vṛddhisaṃjñakāḥ paryāyeṇa prasajyeran| tathā ca pakṣe `nāyakaḥ, stāvakaḥ' ityā- dyapyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| ityevamādyayoḥ pakṣayordoṣavattāṃ dṛṣṭvā, tṛtīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha- `uḥ sthāne'ṇ prasajyamāna eva'ityādi| etena lakṣaṇāntareṇa vidhīyamāna- syāṇo vidhānakāla eva tena saha saṃhatya raparatvaviśiṣṭas vidhāviyaṃ paribhāṣā vyāpriyata iti darśayati| etacca sthānadvayagrahaṇasyātrānuvṛtterlabhyante| pūrvakeṇa hi sthānagraha- ṇenehānuvṛttau `uḥ sthāne' ityatadartharūpaṃ labhyate| dvitīyena tu prasajyamāna ityetat| tathā hi- sthānagrahaṇaṃ saptamyantaṃ prakṛtamanuvarttamāne tatsāmarthyāt prathamāntaṃ sampadyate, sthānaśapabdaścāyaṃ prasaṅgavācī| tataśca yadā sthānenāṇ viśiṣyate-`aṇ sthānam' iti, tadā `aṇ prasajyamāna eva' ityeṣo'rtho jāyate| `prasajyamānaḥ' iti| prasaṅgenābhisambadhyamāna iti yāvat| `eva' iti| avadhāraṇaṃ punaratra vyavaccheda phalatvena sarvavākyānāṃ sāvadhāraṇatvāllabhyate| kathaṃ punaraṇ sthānaṃ bhavati? naiva hi sa sthānaṃ bhavati, tadyogāttu tatra sthānavyapadeśo bhavati, yathā-`yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya' ita yaṣṭiyogāt puruṣāṇāṃ vyapadeśa-| nanu ca `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ' labhyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, svaritatvacihnāddhi yo yatropaṣṭhate, sa tatra sāmarthyāt tatkāryayogyasyai-vārthasyābhidhātā sannupatiṣṭhate| tena yadyapi pūrvasūtre sthānaśabdastavādisthānavacanaḥ, tathāpīhopatiṣṭhamānaḥ prasaṅgavacana evopatiṣṭhate| tedavaṃ yasmānnedaṃ svatantramaṇo raparatvaviśiṣṭasya ca vidhāyakam| tasmādādye pakṣe yo doṣaḥ sa iha na bhavati tataśca lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihitasyāṇaḥ paścādanena raparatvaṃ na vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? prasajyamāna evāṇ lakṣaṇāntareṇa tatsahāyaṃ pratipadya raparo bhāvyate| tena dvitīye pakṣe yo doṣaḥ, so'pyasminna bhavatyeva| prasajyamānasyaiva hi raparatvavidhau yathā ṛvarṇo raśrutimān‌, evamādeśo'pi raśrutimāneva bhavati| tataścāntaratamyādṛkārasya raśrutimatastādṛśa eva raśrutimānedeśo bhavati| anye guṇavṛddhisaṃjñakā vyāvartitā bhavanti| yadi tarhi prasajyamāna eva raparo bhavati, anekaltvāt sarvādeśaḥ prasajyeta, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayaṃ `tarati' iti nirdeśaṃ karoti; tato jñāpyate-sarvādeśo na bhavatīti| `kartā, hartā'iti| `ḍukuñ karaṇe'(dhā.pā.1473) `hṛñ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899) ābhyāṃ `ṇvultṛcau' (3.1.133) iti tṛc, `sārvadhātukārdhakayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti guṇaḥ, `aco rahābhyām' (8.4.46) iti dvitvam| `kirati, girati' iti| `kṛ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1410) `gṛ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1411)- ābhyāṃ laṭ, `śeṣāt kartari parasmaipadam' (1.3.78)iti tip, tudāditvācchaḥ, `ṛta id dhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam| `dvaimāturaḥ, traimāturaḥ' iti| dvayormātrorapatyam, tisṛṇāṃ mātṝṇāmapatyamiti `māturut saṃkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ' (4.1.115) ityaṇ, ukāraścāntādeśaḥ| `taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' (7.2.117) iti vṛddhiḥ| `kheyam' iti| `ī ca khanaḥ' (3.1.111) iti kyap, ikāraścāntādeśaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ'(6.1.87)| `saudhātakiḥ' iti| `sudhāturakaṅa ca' (4.1.97) itīñ| tatsaṃyogenākaṅādeśaḥ kriyamāṇo raparo na bhavati, anaṇtvāt| atha yo'trāṇ, sa raparaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? anādeśtvāt| samudāyo hyatrādeśo na tadavayavaḥ| naiṣa doṣaḥ; yo hi dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭayoḥ sthāne bhavati, labhate so'nyataravyapadeśam, yathā- devadattasya putro devadattāyāḥ putraḥ' iti|| 52.alo'ntyasya| (1.1.52) algrahaṇamantyasya viśeṣaṇam, nādeśasya; anyathā hyalantyasyetyevaṃ brūyāt| ādeśaḥ punaratraikāllabhyate| anyasya `anekālśit sarvasya' (1.1.55) iti sarvādeśatāṃ vakṣyati| `ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasya' iti| sāmānyavacane'pi `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' (1.149) ityadhikārāt sthānaṣaṣṭhyā nirdiṣṭasyeti veditavyam; anyathā ṭitkinmito'pyavayavasambandhaṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭā vidhīyamānā antyasya syuḥ| `id goṇyāḥ' (1.2.50) iti| yeyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī sāntyamalaṃ nīyate- antyasyāla ittvamiti| `pañcagoṇiḥ' iti| pañcabhirgoṇībhiḥ krīta iti `taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti samāsaḥ| `tena krītam' (5.1.37) iti `prāgvahateṣṭhak' (4.4.1) `adhyardhapūrvadvigorlugasaṃjñā-yām' (5.1.28) iti tasya luk| yadyalo'ntyasya ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyādeśo bhavati,` ido'y puṃsi' (7.2.111) ityataḥ `idaḥ' ityanuvṛtteḥ `hali lopaḥ'(7.2.113) vidhīyamāna idrūpasya yo'ntyastasya syāt| tathā ca - ābhyāmiti na sidhyet, naiṣa doṣaḥ; `nānārthake'lo'ntyavidhiranabhyāsavikāreṣu' (vyā.pa.62) iti paribhāṣayā na bhaviṣyati|| 53.ṅicca| (1.1.53) `hotāpotārau' iti| hotṛpotṛśabdayordvandva, ānaṅ, aupratyaye parataḥ `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' (7.3.110) iti guṇaḥ, raparatvaṃ ca| `aptṛntṛc' (6.4.11) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| `mātāpitarau' iti| `pitā mātrā' (1.2.70) iti yasmin pakṣa eka- śeṣo nāsti, tatredamudāharaṇam| yadi ṅidādeśo'nekālapyantyasya bhavati, evaṃ sati tātaṅa- pyantyasya bhavatītyata āha-`tātaṅi' ityādi| tatra guṇapratiṣedhārtham cinutādityādau| atra hi sārvadhātukalakṣaṇasya guṇasya prāptiḥ| vṛddhipratiṣedhārtham- mṛṣṭāditi| atra hi `mṛjervaddhiḥ' (7.2.114) iti vṛddhiprāptiḥ| tadevaṃ guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhe caritārthatvāt tātaṅo ṅitkaraṇasya sāvakāśatve sati tasmina paratvāta `anekālśitsarva- sya' (1.1.55) ityanena tātaṅa sarvādeśo bhavati| ṅiccetyasyāvakāśaḥ- `hotāpotārau' ityādi| anekālityāderavakāśo yona ṅit-`asterbhūḥ' (2.4.52), bhavitetyādi| `jīvatāt' ityādāvubhayaprāptau paratvadanekāltvāt tātaṅa sarvādeśo bhavati, ` jīvatād bhavān' `jīvatāt tvam' iti| jīvatāditi `āśiṣi liṅaloṭau' (3.3.173) iti loṭ, tip, `eruḥ' `tu hyostātaṅ' (7.1.35) ityādinā tātaṅa|| 54. āde parasya| (1.1.54) alo'ntyasyāpavādo'yam| śāstre na kvacit parasyetuccārya kāryaṃ vidhīyate| tataśca nirviṣayametadityabhiprāyeṇāha-`kva ca' ityādi| `yatra pañcamīnirdeśaḥ'iti| `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti vacanād yatra pañcamīnirdeśastatra parasya kāryaṃ śiṣyate| `āsīnaḥ' iti| `āsa upaveśane' (dhā.pā.1021), laṭ, anudāttetvādātmanepadam, śānac, adāditvācchapo luk| `dvīpam, antarīpam' `samīpam' iti| dvirgatā antargatāḥ saṅgatā' āpo'sminniti vigṛhya bahuvrīhiḥ| `ṛkpūḥ' (5.4.74) ityādinā akārapratyayaḥ samāsāntaḥ|| 55. anekālśitsarvasya| (1.1.55) śitaḥ śakārānubandhenānekāltve'pi śiditi pṛthakkaraṇaṃ `nānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam'(vyā.pa.14) iti jñāpanārtham| tasya tu prayojanam-- `diva ut' (6.1.131) ityā-diṣu sarvādeśābhāvaḥ|| 56. sthānivadādeśo'nalvidhau| (1.1.56) sthānaṃ prasaṅgaḥ, sa ca pūrvamuktasvarūpaḥ| atideśo'nekaprakāraḥ- nimittāti- deśaḥ; vyapadeśātideśaḥ, śāstrātideśaḥ, rūpātideśaḥ, kāryātideśaśceti| tatra tāvannimittamaśakyamatideṣṭuma, na hi dhātvādidharmāḥ śabdapravṛttinimittabhūtā dhātvādivyaktyāśritā vastvantaramādeśaṃ prāpayitum, prāpayituṃ pāryante; yathā- brāhmaṇavadasmin kṣatriye varttitavyamiti brāhmaṇaśabdapravṛttinimittaṃ na śakyaṃ kṣatriye prāpayitum, tadvat tasmādaśakyatvāt neha nimittādeśa āśrīyate| nāpi vyapadaśātideśaḥ; saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhādabhinnatvāt| saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhe hi vatkaraṇa- syānarthakyaṃ syāt, vināpi tena tatsiddheḥ| apradhānatvācca nātra vyapadeśātideśo yukta āśrīyatum| ata eva śāstrātideśo'pi| apradhānatvaṃ tu tayorapi kāryaṃ pratyaṅgabhūtatvāt| rūpātideśasyāpyāśrayaṇamayuktam' niṣphalatvāt| yadi hyādeśasya sthāninorūpamatidiśyeta; ādeśasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) ityatra rūpātideśe'pi na bhavatyādeśavaiyarthyam, dvarvacanāduttarakālaṃ śravaṇārthatvāt| tasmādatideśāntarāśrayaṇasyāyuktatvāt kāryātideśa āśrīyate| `sthāninā tulyaṃ vartate' iti| tattulyakāryatvāt, `tena tulyam' (5.1.115)| `sthānyāśrayeṣu' iti| sthānī āśraya eṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| `analāśrayeṣu' iti| ala āśraya eṣāmiti bahuvrīhi kṛtvā na alāśrayāṇi analāśrayāṇīti ऩñsamāsaḥ| anantaroktamevārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkartṛmāha- `sthānyalāśrayāṇi' ityādi| sthānī al āśrayoyeṣāṃ tāni tathoktāni| āśrayagraha-ṇena sūtre yo'lvidhiśabdaḥ, so'lāśrayo vidhiralvidhirityuttarapadalopī samāsa iti darśayati| sa punaḥ samāso mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt samāsaṃ kṛtvā nañsamāsaḥ kṛtaḥ| na alvidhiranalvidhiḥ' iti| punaralāśrayo vidhiḥ ? yo varṇamātrāśritaḥ| yastu samudāyā- śritaḥ so'nalāśrayaḥ| kāryaśabdena kmasādhanena vidhiśabdasyārthamācakṣāṇaḥ `vidhīyate' iti vidhiriti tasya karmasādhatvaṃ darśayati| `kimudāharaṇay'iti praśnaḥ| `dhātvādyādeśāḥ prayojanam' ityuttaram| prayujyate'neneti prayojanam, udāharaṇena ca prayujyata iti| arthāt praśnānurūpaṃ prativacanam| nanu cārdhadhātuke parato bhāvyamādeśābhyām, tatra kimatrādeśenetyata āha- `ārdhadhātuke viṣaye' iti| `prakṛtya' ityādi| `kugati' (2.2.18) ityādinā samāsaḥ, `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap' (7.1.37)| `dadhikam' iti| dadhnā saṃskṛtamiti `dadhnaṣṭhak' (4.2.18)| `adyatanam' iti| `sāyaṃciram' (4.3.23) ityādinā ṭyupratyayaḥ, tuḍāgamaśca, yoranādeśaḥ| `akurutām,akurutam' iti| kṛño laṅ, `tasthasthamipām' (3.4.101) ityādinā tasastām, thasastam, tanāditvāt `tanādikṛñbhya uḥ' (3.1.79), dhātorguṇaḥ| `ata ut sārvadhātuke' (6.4.110)| grāmo vṛ svam, janapado naḥ svam' iti| yuṣmadasmadoḥ ṣaṣṭhī, `bahuvacanasya vasnasau' (8.1.21) iti vasnasādeśau| `vatkaraṇaṃ kim' iti ? vināpi tena tadartho gamyate, yathā `asaṃyogālliṭ kit' (1.2.5) ityādāvityabhiprāyaḥ| `sthāno' ityādi| prāyeṇa hyasmin pāde `vṛddhirādaic' (1.1.1) ityādīni sūtrāṇi saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhārthānyeva dṛṣṭāni| ato'sati vatkaraṇe sthānyādeśasya saṃjñā vidhīyata iti vijñāyate| tadevaṃ mā vijñāyī- tyevamarthaṃ vatkaraṇam| kimarthaṃ punaḥ sthānyādeśasya saṃjñā neṣyata ityāha-- `svāśrayamapi' ityādi| saṃjñā hisaṃjñipratyayanārthā na svataḥ kāryaṃ pratipadyate, api tu tatpratyāyitaḥ saṃjñīti| atra yadi sthānyādeśasya saṃjñā syāt, ādeśasyaiva hi saṃjñinaḥ kāryaṃ syāt,na saṃjñābhūtasya sthāninaḥ| tataśca `āṅo yamahanaḥ' (1.3.28) iti vadherādatmanepadaṃ syāt, na hanteḥ|vatkaraṇe tu satyatideśo'yaṃ bhavati, atideśena cānya- sambandhikāryamanyatra sampādyate;na tu tatra svāśrayaṃ nivarttyate| tathā hi `brāhmaṇavadasmin kṣatriye varttatavyam' ityatideśe tad‌brāhmaṇasambandhikāryaṃ kṣatriye bhāvyate| na tu brāhmaṇasya yat svāśrayamagrabhojanādi tad‌vyāvarttyate| svāśrayamapītyapiśabdādatideśaprāpitamādeśe parāśritamapi| `āhata' iti| hanteraluṅa, `hanaḥ sic' (1.2.14) iti kittvam| `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinā'nunāsikalopaḥ| `hsvādaṅgāt' (8.2.27) iti sico luk| `āvadhiṣṭa' iti | `ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām' (3.1.54) iti vadhādeśaḥ, iṭ, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ṣatvaṣṭutve| `ādeśagrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| sathānīti sambandhiśabdo'yam| tatra yathā `pitṛvat sthūlaḥ' ityukte'ntareṇāpyatra putragrahaṇaṃ sambandhiśabdatvāt putra iti gamyate,tathā sthānivadityukte vināpyādeśagrahaṇena sambandhiśabdatvādādeśa eva sthānivad bhavatīti vijñāyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `ānumānikasya' ityādi| `asterbhūḥ' (2.4.52) ityādau sthānyapi śabdena sākṣāt pratyāyyate, ādeśo'pi| pacatvityatra sthānyapi, ānumānika ādeśo'pi| tathā hi- `eruḥ' (3.4.86) ityatra na vastuta ikāra eva sthānī , api tu tiśabdaḥ| nāpyukāramātra ādeśaḥ, tarhi ? tuśabdaḥ| lāghavārthaṃ tu tadekadeśayo-rikārokārayoruccāraṇam| tenaikadeśadvāreṇa samudāyasya samudāya evādeśo vidhīyate| tatra yathā viṣāṇenaikadeśenopalabdhena viṣāṇī samudāyo'numīyate, tathaikadeśenekāreṇokāreṇa tiśabdastuśabdaśca| atra ca śāstre yasya ca kriyābisambandhaḥ sākṣācchabdādeva pratīyate, yasya ca kutaścidarthaprakaraṇāderanumīyate,tayoḥ pūrvasya prādhānyamitarasya viparyaya iṣyate| tathā hi- `sahayukte'pradhāne' (2.3.19) ityatra vṛttikāraḥ `putreṇa sahāgataḥ' ityādyudāhṛtya vakṣyati- `pituratra kriyādisambandhaḥ śabdenocyate, putrasya tu pratīyamāna iti tasyāprādhānyam' iti| pradhānetarayośca sannidhāne pradhānasyaiva kāryeṇa sampratyayo yuktaḥ| tathā cāha- `pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt siddham' iti| atra hi yadyādeśa ita nocyeta, tato ya ādeśaśabdenopādāya vidhīyamānatvāt prādhānyamanubhavati tasyaiva sthānivadbhāvaḥ syāt, nāpradhānasyānumānikasya| tasmāt tasyāpi sthāni-vadbhāvo yathā syādityevamādeśagrahaṇam| tena pacatvityādāvapi `suptiṅantaṃ padam' (1.414) iti padasaṃjñā siddhā bhavati| kutaḥ punaretavavasīyate ? `eruḥ' (3.4.86) ityanenaikadeśa-dvāreṇa tuḥśabdaḥ samudāyo vidhīyate, na punaryathāśrutamikāramātrasyokāramātrameveti; pacatvityatra padasaṃjñākāryopalabdheḥ, taddhi na vinā padasaṃjñayā, sāpi na vinā tiṅavad bhāvena, so'pi na vinā samudāyodeśeneti| tasmin hi sati sthānivadbhāvena yatna- pratipāditena tiṅabhāvo labhyate; nānyatheti gatametat| athānumānike gṛhīte kathamitarasya grahaṇaṃ labhyate? evaṃ manyate sthānivadityetāvāneko yogaḥ karttavyaḥ, etena yogenādeśaḥ pradhānabhūtaḥ sambandhiśabdatvāllabhyate| tata ādeśa dvitīyo yogaḥ, ānumānikasya sthāni- vadbhāvāya| atra ca sthānivaditi varttate| evamubhayoḥ pratyakṣānumānaśiṣṭyorgrahaṇamupapadyate| `analvidhau' iti| dvayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣabhūtaḥ| `dyupathityadādeśā' ityādi| `diva aut' `pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt' (7.1.85), `tyadādīnāmaḥ' (7.1.102) ityete ` halṅyābbhyaḥ' (6.1.68) sulope karttavye na sthānivadbhavanti; tasya halmātramāśritya pravṛtteralāśrayatvāt|| 57. acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau|| (1.1.57) kimarthamidamucyate ? analvidhau sthānivadbhāvaḥ uktaḥ, alvidhyarthamidam| paṭayatītyādau `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiralāśrayā; akārasyopadhāyā altvāt| tasmāt pūrveṇa na prāpnotītyeke eva paranimittaka eva pūrvavidhāveva karttavye sthānivad bhavatīti niyamārthamityanye| `aca iti sthāninirdeśaḥ' iti| `acaḥ' ityanena sthānaṣaṣṭhyantatāṃ darśayati| `parasminniti saptamīti' iti| na parasaptamī, paraśabdenaiva parasyoktatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| ` pūrvavidhau' iti, `viṣaya' iti| prakṛtatvāt sthānavadbhāvasyeti gamyate, pūrvavidhau viṣaye sthānivadbhavati, nānyasminnityarthaḥ| pūrvasya vidhiḥ pūrvavidhiḥ| vidhi- śabdaścāyaṃ karmasādhanaḥ-- vidhiyata iti vidhiḥ| bhāvasādhano vā-- vidhānaṃ vidhiriti| karma- sādhane hyetasmin pūrvasyeti śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| pūrvasya vyavasthitasya labdhasattāka- sya sambandhini kārye karttavya ityarthaḥ| bhāvasādhane tu `pūrvasya ' iti kṛdyoga- lakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| pūrvasyāpariniṣpannasya vidhāne karttavya ityarthaḥ| pūrvasmin vidhātavya iti yāvat| pūrvatvaṃ punarihādeśāpekṣam, ajapekṣam, nimittāpekṣaṃ vā; eṣāmevādeśā- dīnāmiha sannidhānāt| tatrādeśaḥ svaritatvāt sannihitaḥ, itarayostvatraiva sūtra upādānāt| nanu ca triṣvapyeṣu doṣaḥ, tatkathamādeśādyapekṣayā pūrvatvaṃ śakyamāśrayi- tum, ādeśāpekṣe hi pūrvatva āśrīyamāṇe `paṭayati' ityādau sthānivadbhāvo na sidhyati; lopo hi tatrādeśaḥ, na ca tena pūrvaparatā sambhavati; tasyābhāvarūpatvāt| syādetat- lopasya yaḥ sthānī tadapekṣayā paurvāparyamastītita tad‌dvāreṇāde- śāpekṣayāpyaupacārikaṃ tad bhaviṣyatīti vārtametat; bahukhad‌vakādiṣu mukhye paurvā- parye satyaupacārikakalpanāyā ayuktatvāt| `vyaktiḥ padārthaḥ' ityasya darśanasyāśrayaṇādadoṣaḥ| vyaktau hi padārthe pratilakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pravarttate| tatra yadi paṭayatītyā-diṣvaupacārikatvāt paurvāparyasya sthānivadbhāvo na syāt, yadetadviṣayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ - tasyānavakāśatvād vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ prathamastāvatpakṣo'yuktaḥ| dvitīye tu kāmameṣa doṣo na bhavati| tathā hi - tatra yo'caḥ pūrvastasya vidhau karttavye sthānivadbhavatītyeṣaḥ sūtrārthaḥ, iha ca `na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyāma' (7.3.3) iti vacanāt pragevaijāgamād yaṇādeśena bhavitavyam| tena nāstyaicorajapekṣaṃ pūrvatvamiti na bhavati sthānivadbhāvaḥ, tadabhāvādaicorāyāvāvapi na prāpnutaḥ; kintvatra `acaḥ' ityetadā- deśaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ pratijñātam, na tu pañcamyantam| tadā cācaḥ tadā pañcamya-ntaṃ sampadyate| ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ-- iha `tanvanti' ityupratyayasya yaṇādeśakṛta iṭ prāpnoti, na hyatrācaḥ pūrvasya vyavasthitasya kiñcitkāryaṃ vidhīyate; yato yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvādiḍāgamo na syāt| tṛtīye tu pakṣe yaṇādeśa eva nimittāt pūrvaḥ| tasya vyavasthitasyeṭi vidhātavye sthānivadbhāvo labhyata iti na bhavati tanvantītyatreṭ prasaṅgaḥ; kintvādye pakṣe yo doṣaḥ, sa ihāpi prasajyeta| `vaiyākaraṇaḥ, sauvaśvam' ityatrāpi yvau nimittāt pūrvau bhavata iti| nanu ca nimittāt pūrvasya kārye vidhātavye sthānivadbhāva ucyate, na ceha nimittāt pūrvayorvyoḥ kiñcit kāryaṃ vidhīyate| na hyāyāvādeśau yvoḥ kāryam, kiṃ tarhi ? aicaḥ,naitadasti; aico hi yat kāryaṃ tad yvorapi sambandhi bhavatyeva, tayostadbhaktayostadavayavabhūtatvāt| atrocyate-- ādyantayoḥ pakṣayoryo doṣa uktaḥ, sa tāvanna bhavati; yasmād bahiraṅgāvaicau, taddhitaśrayatvādaṅgāśrayatvācca; antaraṅgāvāyāvau, taddhitanirapekṣatvād varṇāśrayatvācca| `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.42) ityasiddhatvādaicorāyāvau nabha bhaviṣyataḥ| itarasminnapi pakṣe yo doṣa uktaḥ, so'pi na bhavatyeva; tatra karmasādhane sarvamiṣṭaṃ na sidhyatīti bhāvasādhanopyāśrīyate| tena tanvantītyatreṭa evāpariniṣpanna- syācaḥ pūrvasya vidhāne karttavye sthānivadbhāvaḥ siddho bhavati| karmasādhane'pyadoṣaḥ; yaṇādeśa evātrācaḥ pūrvaḥ, tasya vidhāne karttavye eva| na hi yaṇādeśāt pūrvasya vyavasthitasya kasyacidiḍ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? yaṇādeśasyaiva| bhāvasādhane tu tasminna doṣaḥ; yaṇādeśāt pūrvasyāpariniṣpannasyeṭa eva vidhānāt| tasmāt tatrāpi pakṣe bhāvasādhana eva vidhiśabdo'ṅgīkarttavyaḥ| `paṭayati' iti| `tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe' iti ṇic, `ṇāviṣṭhavat prātipadikasya' (vā.813)iti ṭilopaḥ| nanu cātra vyavadhānāt pūrvatvaṃ na sambhavati; naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyavahite'pi hi pūrvaśabdo varttate, yathā-`mathurāyāḥ pūrvaṃ pāṭaliputram' iti| nanu ca dvitīyā samarthāṇṇijutpadyate, tatrāntarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ jaśtve sati paḍayatīti bhavitavyam| ṭilopasya sthānivadbhāvāj‌jaśtvaṃ na bhavatīti cet, na; jaśtvavidhau sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; `tadācaṣṭe' ityatra hi taditi na dvitīyāsamarthāditi, kutastarhi ? karmaṇi iti| kuta etat ? arthanirdeśa- paratvāt| etaduktaṃ bhavati- karmasaṃjñakāt tadācaṣṭa ityasminnarthe ṇij bhavatīti| tasmādasubandhāṇṇijutpatteḥ padasaṃjñāyā abhāvāj‌jaśtvaṃ na pravarttate| `avadhīt' iti| hanterluṅa, `hano vadha luṅi' (2.4.42) iti vadhaśabdo'danta ādeśaḥ, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48), `ārdhadhātukasyeṭ' (7.2.35), `astisico'pṛkta' (7.3.96) itīṭ,`iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| `halantalakṣaṇa' iti| `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādeḥ sūtrāddhalgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ `ato halāderlaghoḥ' (7.2.7) iti vṛddhirhalantalakṣaṇā| `bahukhaṭ‌vakaḥ' iti| nanu ca `svaravidhiṃ prati na sthānivadbhavati' iti pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyati, ataḥ sthānivadbhāvasya prāptireva nāstītyayuktametadudāharaṇam, naitat; viśeṣe hi sa pratiṣedhaḥ--svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśo na sthānivad bhavatīti| na cāyaṃ lopājādeśaḥ svaro na bhavatīti khakārākārasyodāttatvaṃ na bhavati| `kapi pūrvam' (6.2.173) ityuttara- padāntodāttatvameva bhavati| `praśnaḥ' iti| `yajayācayatavitacchapraccha' (3.3.90) ityādinā naṅa| `tuki na sthānivadbhavati' iti| tuki karttavye na sthānivadbhavatītyarthaḥ| yadi hi syāc chakāramātrasya śādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvādvihitasya tukaḥ śravaṇaṃ syādityeke, etaccāyuktam; atra hyantaraṅgatvāt `che ca' (6.1.73) iti tukaiva prāg bhavitavyam|na cātreda- masti `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' (vyā.pari.39) iti, nānāśrayatvāta| yatra hyekaṃ nimittamāśrityayugapad vārṇamāṅgaṃ ca prāpnoti, tatredamupatiṣṭhate, yatā-- `iyāya' iti| atrākāramāśrityābhyāsekārasya `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) iti yaṇ prāpnoti, `abhyāsa- syāsavarṇye' (6.4.78) itīyaṅa ca| tatra `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' (vyā.pari.39) ityasyopasthānādiyaṅeva bhavati| praśna ityatra tu śādeśamanunāsikamāśrayati, tuk punaśchakāram; ato nānāśrayatvānnopatiṣṭhate| tasmāt tukātra bhavitavyameva| avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam; anyathā `cchvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityatra yadvakṣyati vṛttikāraḥ-- `antaraṅgatvāt `che ca' (6.1.73) iti tuki kṛte satukkasyāyamādeśaḥ' iti, tadvirudhyate| anye tu vyācakṣate--`cchavoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) iti sūtre `satukka- sya cchakārasya nirdeśaḥ' ityeva kenacidācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pratipāditāḥ, kenacittu `tugvirahitasya śuddhasya' ityevam, ubhayaṃ caitat pramāṇam| dvaitatve tatrāṅgena vā cchvau viśeṣyete, chakāravakārābhyāṃ vāṅgamiti| tatrādye pakṣe'ṅgasya yaśchastasya śādeśa iti| vākyārthaḥ; satukkasya ca sthānitvenopādānāt| antaraṅge tuki kṛte ?`nānārthake alo'ntyavidhiḥ' (vyā.pa.62) iti tadantavidhyabhāvāt samudāyasyaivādeśo bhavati| yadā śakāravidhau satukkasya cchakārasya nirdeśaḥ, praśna ityetat tadānīmajgrahaṇa- syāpratyudāharaṇameva; tukaḥ punaḥ prasaṅgābhāvāt| yadā tu cchakāravakārābhyāmaṅgaṃ viśeṣyate, tadā chakārāntasyāṅgasya sthānitvam| asmin pakṣe śavidhau śuddha eva chakāra upātto veditavyaḥ| antaraṅgatvāt tu pūrvaṃ tuki kṛte paścādalo'ntyaparibhāṣāyā upasthānāt upasthānāt chakāramātrasya śakāraḥ| tasmin kṛte nimittābhāvāt tuko nivṛttiḥ; yathā-- sthātetyatra ṣatvanivṛttau ṣṭutvasya| atra pakṣe praśna ityetat pratyudāharaṇamajgrahaṇasya| yadyatra sthānivadbhāvaḥ syāt, tukaḥ pratyāvṛttirbhavet; nimittasadbhāvāt, yathā-- `pratyaṣṭhāt' ityatra ṣṭutvasya| `tuki na sthānivadbhavati' ityasyāyamarthaḥ- yo'sau nimittābhāvānnivṛttastugāsīt, tameva paścāt pratyāvarttamānaṃ prati na sthānivadbhavatīti punaḥ pratyāvṛttireva| `pūrvavidhiḥ' iti| nanu ca yadyatra tukaḥ pratyāvṛttiḥ syān naṅo ṅitkaraṇama-rthakaṃ syāt| taddhi pracchaḥ prasāraṇārtha vā viccherguṇapratiṣedhārtha vā kriyate| tatra pracchernaṅi samprasāraṇena na bhavitavyam; `praśne cāsannakāle' (3.2.117) iti nipātanāt| yadi ca sthānivadbhāve sati tukaḥ pratyāvṛttiḥ syātr tato guṇapratiṣedhārtamapi syāt, alaghūpadhatvādeva guṇo na bhaviṣyati, tataścānarthakamevaitat syāt? nānarthakam; `anityamāgamaśāstram' (vyā.pa.99) iti jñāpanārthatvāt| anityatvajñapāne tvāgamaśāsanasya `snakramoranātmanepadanimitte' (7.2.36) ityatra yadvakṣyati-- `kramestu kartaryātmanepadaviṣayādasatyātmanepade kṛti pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti, tanna vaktavyaṃ iti| `uchi uñche' (dhā.pā.215), `vicha gatau' (dhā.pā.1424), `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (3.1.32) ityevamādayo nirdeśāścopannā bhavanti| `ākrāṣṭām' iti| `kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā. 990) āṅpūrvālluṅa; cliḥ, ` spṛśamṛśakṛṣatṛpadṛpāṃ sij vā' (vā.207) ityupasaṃkhyānāt ksasyāpavādaḥ pakṣe sic, tatastām `anudāttasya cadupadhasyānyatarasyām' (6.1.59) ityamāgamaḥ, yaṇādeśaḥ, `vadavrajaḥ' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ| `vaiyāghrapadyaḥ' iti| vyāghrasyaiva pādāvasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ' (5.4.138) ityantalopaḥ| vyāghrapāditi sthite gargāditvād yañ, ` pādaḥ pat' (6.4.130) iti padbhāvaḥ| `ādīdhye' iti| adāditvācchapo luk| athātra ṭerettvāt prāgeva kasmāllopo na bhavati ? syāt, yadi `parasmin' ityucyamāne tu sthānivadbhāvābhāvāt kṛte ṭerettve na prāpnotītyanityo lopaḥ| ṭerettvaṃ tu kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnityam| tasmāt tadeva pūrvaṃ bhavati| `he gauḥ'iti| `goto ṇit' (7.1.90) iti ṇittvāt sarvanāmasthānasya `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) vṛddhiḥ| `sambuddhilope karttavye' iti| `eṅa hrasvāt sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) ityanena| `bābhravyasya' iti| babhvrorapatyamiti `madhubabhvro- rbāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ' (4.1.106) iti yañ, `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) iti vāntādeśaḥ, ādivṛddhiḥ, bābhravya iti sthite `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ| `avādeśo na sthānivadbhavati' iti| nanu cāsatyapi sthānivadbhāve `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya' (vyā.pari.12) iti na bhavitavyamevātra yalopena, tathā hi-- yakārādavavādeśenātmalābhaḥ pratilabdhaḥ iti notsahate sa taṃ bādhitum; naitadasti; saṅghāto hyatra sannipātalakṣaṇaḥ, nāvayavo hal; satyapi vā tasya sannipātalakṣaṇatve na bhavatyeva doṣa-; anityatvāt sannipātalakṣaṇaparibhāṣāyāḥ| anitya- tvaṃ tu `na lopaḥ supsvara' (8.2.2) ityādau sūtre jñāpayiṣyatate| `naidheyaḥ' iti| nipūrvo ḍudhāñ (dhā.pā.1092), `upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' (3.3.92), āto lopaḥ,nidhi iti sthite dvayacaḥ `itaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti ḍhak| nanu pūrvasmād vidhiḥ pūrvavidhiriti pañcamīsamāsasyāpyabhīṣṭatvāt pūrvasmādapi vidhau karttavye sthānivadbhāvena bhāvyam, tathā hi `ṭhasyekaḥ' (7.3.50) ityatra vakṣyati- `mathitaṃ paṇyamasya māthitika ityatra yasyeti lope kṛte `isusuktāntātkaḥ' (7.3.51) iti sthānivadbhāvādikasya kādeśaḥ prāptaḥ; sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasyeti na bhavati,akāralopasya sthāni- vadbhāvatvāt; pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivadbhavati" iti| tadevaṃ yasmāt pūrvasmādapi vidhau sthānivadbhāvo'nena bhavati, tasmāt ` he gauḥ' ityādiṣvapi sthānivadbhāvena bhavitavyamevetyayuktānyetāni pratyudāraṇāni, naiṣa doṣaḥ; ityādiṣvapi sthānivadbhāvena bhavitavyamevetyayuktānyetāni pratyudāharaṇāni, naiṣa doṣaḥ; pūrvasmād vidhau karttavyeyaḥ sthānivadbhāvāḥ,tasyānivatvāt| ata eva cānityatvādapradhānabhūto'sāviti vṛttāvasya sūtrasya pūrvasmāditi na pratipāditastadevā prādhānyasya darśayitum| kutaḥ punastasyānityatvamavasitam? `niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' (6.4.52) ityatra seḍgrahaṇāt |tadevamarthaṃ kriyate- iṭi kṛte ṇilopo yathā syāditi| yadi hyakṛta eva tasmin ṇilopaḥ syāt, kāritamityatreḍāgamo na syāt; `ekāca' iti pratiṣedhāt| tathā ca tatra vakṣyati-- " seḍiti kima? `saṃjñāpitaḥ paśuḥ' `sanīvantardha' (7.2.49) iti jñaperiḍ vikalpyate| `yasya vibhāṣā' (2.7.15) iti niṣṭhāyāmiṭpratiṣedhaḥ| atha punarekāca iti tatrānuvarttate, tatra niṣṭhāyām `atra bhavitavyamiḍāgamena' iti| seḍgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; tat kriyate kālāvadhāraṇārtham| iḍāgame kṛte ṇilopo yathā syāt" iti| akṛte tasmiṃṣṭilope sati kāritamityatra `ekāca upedeśe'nudāttāt' (7.2.10) iti pratiṣedhaḥ iṭaḥ prasajyeta| yadi ca rapūrvasmād vidhau karttavye nityaṃ sthānivadbhāvaḥ syāt, ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāve satyanekācatvādiṭpratiṣedhasya prasaṅga eva nāstīti seḍgrahaṇam na kuryāt, kṛtaṃ ca; tato'vasīyate-- `pūrvasmād vidhānityaḥ sthāni- vadbhāvaḥ' iti| tena gaurityādiṣu pūrvasmād vidhau karttavye sthānivadbhāvo na bhavati| atha vidhigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pūrvasyetyevaṃ siddhama? tathā hi, kāryāpe- kṣayā ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati-pūrvasya vidhau karttavya iti, naitadasti; asati hi vidhigrahaṇe yadi pūrvasyetyucyeta, pūrvasyetyucyeta, pūrvasmād vidhau sthānivadbhāvo na syāt| atha pūrvasmādityucyeta, pūrvasya vidhau na syāt| vidhigrahaṇe sati ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ pañcamīsamāsaśca labhyata iti sarvatra sidhyati| tasmāt samāsadvayārthaṃ vidhigrahaṇaṃ karttavyam|| 58. na padānatadvirvacanareyalopasvarasavarṇānusvāradīrghajaścarvidhiṣu| (1.1.58) atrāpi vidhiśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ karmasādhanaśca| sa ca pratyekamabhisambadhyate| tatra yathāyogaṃ kvacit bhāvasādhana āśrīyate, kvacit karmasādhanaḥ| tatra dvirvacanavidhau bhāvasādhanaḥ, tatra hi tadeva vidhātavyam, na hi tasyāvasthitasya kiñcit kāryam| anyatra tu karmasādhanaḥ| tatra hi vyavasthitasya padāntādeḥ kāryāntaravidhānāt| `kau staḥ, yau staḥ' iti| asterlaṭ, tas, adāditvācchapo luk, pūrvavidhā-vāvādeśe yaṇādeśe ca karttavye sthānivat syāditi| kathaṃ punaḥ sthānivat syāt, yāvatā padasaṃskārāyaiva prayuktatvād vyākaraṇasya ? `staḥ' ityādikaṃ padaṃ padāntaranira- pekṣameva saṃskriyate, anādiṣṭādaco yaḥ pūrvaḥ, tasya vidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvena bhavitavyam| na cāyaṃ prakāraḥ padānataranirapekṣe padasaṃskāre sambhavati; `staḥ' ityādike pade saṃskriyamāṇe kāvityādeḥ padāntararasyāsannidhānāt| kiṃ punaridaṃ rājaśāsanam-- padasaṃskārāyaiva śabdānuśāsanaṃ karttavyamiti ? atha śāstrakārasyaivāyamabhiprāyaḥ ? iti cet, na; śāstrakāreṇa di `yuṣmadyapapade samānādhikaraṇe sthāninyapi madhyamaḥ' (1.4.105)iti yuṣmadādyupapade madhyamādipuruṣavidhānād vākyasaṃskāraprayuktamapi śāstrametaditi sūcitam| atra `kau' ityādikaṃ padaṃ prāgeva vyavasthāpya `staḥ' ityādeḥ padasya saṃskāre kriyamāṇe'nādiṣṭāvacaḥ pūrvaṃ aukārādirbhavatīti sthānivadbhāvaḥ syāt| ataḥ pratiṣedha ucyate| nanu ca `dadhyatra' ityevamādau' pratiṣiddhe'pi sthānivadbhāve bahiraṅgasya yaṇādeśasyāsiddhatvādantaraṅgaṃ dvarvacanaṃ na prāpnoti| tat kimityevamāha-- `asmādvaca- nāt bhavati' iti| na ca śakyaṃ vaktum--" sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhāt `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam'(vyā.pa.42) ityeṣā na pravarttate" iti| yatrobhayamekapadāśrayam-- `paṭvyau paṭvyaḥ śucyau śucyaḥ' ityevamādau,tatra sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhasyārthavattvān‌naiṣa doṣaḥ| dvirvacanameva bahiraṅgam; bahvapekṣatvāt| tathā hyaca uttarasya yora'nacīti ca tritayaṃ tadapekṣate| yaṇādeśastviko'cīti dvayameva| `vare' iti| nanu cātra samāse sati saptamyā lukā bhavitavyam| tat kathaṃ vare iti nirdeśaḥ? ata eva nipātanādalugityadoṣaḥ| anye tvīkārapraśleṣo'treti varṇayanti| evaṃ ca sambandhaṃ kurvanti--`vare yo'jādeśastasya vidhiṃ prati na sthānivat, īvidhiṃ ca prati na sthānavat' iti| tenāmalakyāḥ phalaṃ vikāra iti nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ' (4.3.144) iti mayaṭ, tasya `phale luk' (4.3.163) iti luk, ataḥ `luk taddhitaluki' (1.2.49) gaurādilakṣaṇasya ṅīṣo luki kṛte tasya sthānivadbhāvāt ` yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopaḥ prāpnoti| īkāre parato yo vidhistaṃ prati sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhānna bhavati| nanu cājādeśaḥ paranimittakaḥ lopaḥ pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhavatītyu- cyate, na ca lukā paurvāparyamastītyata eva sthānivadbhāvo na bhaviṣyati? tadaprayojanamīkāra- praśleṣasya| lopenāpi tarhi paurvāparyaṃ nāstīti paṭayatītyādāvapi sthānivadbhāvo na syāt| atha tatra sthānidvārakaṃ paurvāparyaṃ sambhavati, ihāpi tathā syāt| ye tvīkāra-praśleṣaṃ necchanti, ta āyalakyāḥ phalaṃ vikāra āmalakamityetadarthaṃ neti yogavibhāgaṃ kurvanti| `yāyāvaraḥ' iti| atyarthaṃ yātīti `dhātorekācaḥ' (3.1.22) ityādinā yaṅa, dvirvacanam, abhyāsasya hrasvaḥ, `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) iti dīrghaḥ, tato varacca, ato lope kṛte `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yakāralopaḥ| `ato lopaḥ paranimittakaḥ' iti|ārdhadhātuke parato vidhānāt| yadyato lopaḥ paranimittakaḥ, tataḥ `aco yat' (3.1.97) ityatra `aj‌grahaṇaṃ kim, yāvatā halantāṇṇyataṃ vakṣyati' iti codyaṃ samutthāpya ` ajantabhūtapūrvāvapi yathā syāt-- ditsyaṃ dhitsyam' iti yad vakṣyati tad virudhyate; na hi paranimittake'to lope'jantabhūtapūrvād yato vidhiḥ sambhavati, prākkṛdutpa- tterato lopasyābhāvāt, abhāvastu parasya nimittasyābhāvāt? pakṣe bhedādavirodhaḥ| tatra hyārdhadhātuka iti varttate| `ārdhadhātuke' iti viṣayaptamī caiṣā, parasaptamī ceti pakṣa-dvayam; ārdhadhātukasamānyavivakṣāyāṃ sāmānyena paurvāparyaṃ na sambhavatīti viṣayasaptamī bhavati ārdhadhātukavyaktivivakṣāyāṃ tu vyakteḥ paurvāparyaṃ sambhavatīti parasaptamī| yadā tu vyaktidvārakaṃ sāmānyasya paurvāparyaṃ vivakṣyate; tadāpi parasaptamyeva| tatrādye pakṣa ārdhadhātuke viṣayabhūte prāgeva yadutpatterato lopo bhavati, itaratra tu tasminnutpanne| tatra `aco yat' (3.1.97) ityatra yadajgrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ vakṣyati, tat pūrvaṃ pakṣamāśritya| yat punarihāto lopaḥ paranimittaka ityuktam, taditaraṃ pakṣam| tasmād viṣayabhedādavirodhaḥ| parasaptamīpakṣe tu tatrājgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthameva veditavyam| kathaṃ punarjñāyate parasaptamīpakṣo'pi tatrābhimata iti ? `anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' (3.2.149) ityādigrahaṇāt| taddhyevamarthaṃ kriyate-- halantādityevaṃ mā vijñāyīti| evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne jugupsanaḥ, mīmāṃsanaḥ ityatra yuj na syāt; ajanta- tvāt| yadi ca `ārdhadhātuke' iti viṣayasaptamyevaiṣābhimatā syāt, na parasaptamītadā''digrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; ārdhadhātuke viṣaye'kāralope kṛte jugupsatimīmāṃsatyorapi halantatvāt| tasmādādigrahaṇād vijñāyate-- parasaptamīpakṣo'pi tatrābhīṣṭa iti| viṣayasaptamīpakṣe tu tatrādigrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthameva draṣṭavyam| `kaṇḍūtiḥ' iti | `kaṇḍvādibhyo yak' (3.1.27) `striyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) | `cikīrṣakaḥ, jihīrṣakaḥ' iti| cikīrṣajihīrṣaśabdābhyāṃ ṇvul| `śiśeḥ, piṣeśca' iti| `śiṣlu viśeṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1452)`piṣlṛ saṃcūrṇane' (dhā.pā.1453)| hitvadhitva-ṣṭutvajaśtveṣviti| `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti herādeśe kṛte `hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ' (6.4.101) ti dhirādeśaḥ| `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti ṣṭutvam, `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvam| nanu cātra sthānivadbhāvasya prāptireva nāsti; yo hyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhau sthānivadbhavatītyucyate, na cāmānādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvaḥ, tat kiṃ pratiṣedhena ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sthānino nākarasyā'nādiṣṭājapekṣaṃ pūrvatvama- stīti tadādeśo'pyanusvāraḥ sthānivadbhāvādanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrva iti labhyate| `śiṣanti' ityādi| kimarthaṃ punarudāharaṇāntaropanyāsaḥ, yāvatā śiṇḍhītyādya-ntaroktamevedaṃ yuktamudāharaṇ ? evaṃ manyate-- yadi tadevodāhriyate tadā yatra parasavarṇa- statrānusvāreṇa bhavitavyam,tatraiva hi sa vidhīyate; tataśca nāntarīyakatvāt parasavarṇa- vidhau sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhe'nusvāravidhāvapi sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ kṛta eva, tato'- nusvāragrahaṇaṃ pṛthaṅa na karttavyamiti kasyacid bhrāntiḥ syāt| tasmād yatra parasavarṇo na sambhavati, tadevodāharaṇaṃ yuktamiti| `pratidivnā' iti| diveḥ `kaninyuvṛṣi' (da.u.6.51) ityādinā kanin pratyaye rūpam| `hali ca' iti| `upadhāyāñca' (8.2.78) ityetadidānīntanakulekhakaiḥ pramādāllikhitam| tathā hi `upadhāyāñca' (8.2.78)ityatra vakṣyati " pratidīvna ityatra tu `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvam" iti| nanu ca sthānivadbhāve pratiṣiddhe'pi `na bhakurchu-rām' (8.2.79) iti dīrghatvapratiṣedhenātra bhavitavyam, tat kimityevamāha--`asmād vacanād bhavati' iti| na ca sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhasāmarthyādatra pratiṣedho na bhavatīti śakyaṃ parikalpayitum; sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhasya pipaṭhīrityatrārthatvāt| atra hi pipaṭhiṣateḥ kvipi kṛte'to lope rutve ca, rutvaṃ punarasya pūrvatrāsiddhamiti ṣatva- syāsiddhatvāt, yadi sthānivadbhāvo na pratiṣidhyeta, tato'kāralopasya sthānivad- bhāvāt `rvorupadhāyā dīrgha ikaḥ' (8.2.76) ityadhikārād rephavakārāntasya bhasya dīrghatvaṃ pratiṣidhyate| na caitad rephavakārāntaṃ bhasaṃjñakam, api tu nākarāntamiti| `sagdhiḥ' iti| samānā gdhiriti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `samānasya cchandasyamūrdha' (6.3.84) iti sabhāvaḥ| `babdhām' iti| `bhasa bhartsanadīptyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1100), `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) ityabhyāsabhakārasya jaśtvaṃ bakāraḥ| `cakṣatuḥ, jakṣuḥ' iti| `liṭyanyatarasyām' (2.4.40) iti ghaslādeśaḥ, ` kuhośca'(7.4.62) ityabhyāsaghakārasya cutvaṃ jhakāraḥ; tasya pūrvavajjaśtvaṃ jakāraḥ| bahuvacane ghaslādeśa iti| `luṅa sanorghaslu' (2.4.37) ityanena| `bahukhaṭvakaḥ' iti| atra sthānivadbhāvād `hrasvānte'ntyātpūrvam' (6.2.174) iti, khakārasyodāttatvaṃ na bhavati| `kapi pūrvam' (6.2.173) iti ṭvaśabdasyākārāsyaiva bhavati| `kiryoḥ, giryoḥ' iti| `rvorupadhāyā dīrgha ikaḥ' (8.2.76) `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati| etacca vyutpattipakṣamāśrityoktam, `kṛgroricca' iti kirigiriśabdau vyutpādyete| avyutpattipakṣe tvasatyapi sthānivadbhāve dhātutvābhāvānna bhavatyeva dīrghatvam| tathā hyavyutpattipakṣamāśritya `upadhāyāñca' (8.2.78)ityatra vakṣyati--`uṇādaya'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni' (he.pa.103) iti kiryo- giryorityevamādiṣu dīrgho na bhavati' iti| `vāyvoḥ' iti| `lopo vyorvali'(6.1.66) iti yalopo na bhavati| 59.dvarvacane'ci| (1.1.59) pūrvaṃ kāryātideśaḥ kṛtaḥ, idānīṃ tu rūpātideśārthamidamārabhyate| atha vā nimittāt pūrvamityetasmin pakṣe'nantarasūtreṇa dvirvacanavidhiṃ prati pratiṣedhaḥ prāptaḥ ityasyārambho veditavyaḥ| `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti samānādhikaraṇe saptamyau| tatrāj viśeṣyaḥ, dvirvacanaṃ viśeṣaṇam| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya ca prayojanaṃ `dudyūṣati' iti pratyudāharaṇa darśayiṣyate| kathaṃ punaraj dvirvacanaśabdenocyate ? dvarvacananimittatvāt| ata eva vṛttāvāha-- `dvirvacananimitte'ci' iti| bhavati hi tannimittatvāt tācchabdyama, yathā -- `āryurghutam' iti| parasaptamī ceyamapīti `yasminan vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇam' (vyā.pa.127) iti ajādāviti draṣṭavyam| parasminniti ca prakṛtvāt parasminnajādāviti gamyate| atha vā - dvarvacanasya pratyayaviśeṣanimittvād dvirvacanagrahaṇena pratyayaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ, tenājādau pratyaya iti pratīyate| yadi tarhyajādāvajādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavati, `papau' iti na sidhyati, na hyajādāvādeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? acyeva; ihāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvenā-jāditvamastītyadoṣaḥ| iha tarhi na sidhyati-- `cakratuḥ' iti; acyeva tu yaṇādeśo vidhīyate, na tvajādau ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yo hyatrāci yaṇādeśo vidhīyate so'jādāvapi bhavatyeva| yadi dvirvacananimitte'cyajādeśaḥ sthānivadbhavati sarvasyāmavasthāyāṃ dvirvacanāduttarakālamapi syādityata āha--`dvirvacana eva karttavye' iti| evakāreṇa dvirvacana kriyā- kālāt kālāntare sthānivadbhāvasyābhāvaṃ darśayati| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate, yāvataikaṃ dvirvacanagrahaṇam, tena cāj viśeṣitaḥ ? evaṃ manyate-- dvitīyamapi dvirvacanagrahaṇamana- ntarasūtrādihānuvarttate| atha vā- dvirvacanañcetyekaśeṣaṃ kṛtvā `dvirvacane' iti nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| tatraikena dvirvacanagrahaṇena `dvarvacananimitte'ci' ittheṣo'rtho labhyate| dvitīyena tu `dvirvacana eva karttavye' iti| iha dvirvacane karttavye sthānivadbhāvo vidhīyate ita dvirvacanakāryārthaṃ evaiṣa pratīyate| sāckasya dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyamānamanacka- sya na prāpnoti yujyate dvirvacanakāryārthatvamasya| `dvarvacanakāryārthatvamasya| `dvirvacanakāryārthe tvasmin --`cakratuḥ,cakruḥ' ityatrāsyānackasya dvirvacane kṛte satīṣṭamabhyāsarūpaṃ na sidhyati' itivyāmohād yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha-- `rūpātideśaścāyam' iti| `ca' śabdo'vadhāraṇe, rūpātideśa eva, na kāryātideśa ityarthaḥ| kutaḥ punareṣa niścayaḥ-sa `rūpātidheśaścāyam' iti ? ajgrahaṇāt| tasya hyetat prayojanam-- `jeghrīyate dedhmīyate' ityatra mā bhūditi| yadi cāyaṃ dvirvacanakāryātideśaḥ syānna rūpātideśaḥ; ajgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| bhavatvatra sthānivadbhāvaḥ, tathāpi na kaści-dviśeṣaḥ| tathā hi-- yadyapyatra sthānivadbhāvaḥ, evamapi dvirvacanakāryeṇa bhavitavyam; athāpi na sthānivadbhāvaḥ, evamapi bhavitavyam--ubhayatrāpi sāckatvāt, tataśca kathametat pratyudāharaṇam ? tadetadajgrahaṇaṃ kathamarthavad bhavati? yadyeṣa rupādeśaḥ rarūpe'syātidi- śyamāne yadyajgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate tadihāpi rūpātideśe sati dhrā iti, dhmā iti ca dvi-rvacanaṃ syāt, tathā'niṣṭamabhyāsarūpaṃ prasajyeta| tasmādajgrahaṇād rūpātideśo'ya- miti niścīyate| yadyevam, bhedanibandhano vatirnaṃ prāpnoti; sthānyeva hi punarātmīyaṃ rūpaṃ prāpita iti kuto bhedaḥ ? ātideśikānāmatideśikatvena rūpabhedasya vivakṣitatvādadoṣaḥ| `dvirvacana eva karttavye' iti yaduktaṃ tasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkartumāha--`niyatakālaḥ' iti| kṛte dvirvacane ityādinā tadeva niyakālatvaṃ darśayati| `jaghnatuḥ' iti| `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti hakārasya kutvam| `āṭiṭat' iti| aṭaterhetumati ṇic; luṅ, caṅa, `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti `ajāde- rdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti dvirvacanam| `āḍajādīnām'(6.4.72) ityāḍ bhavati| `ninaya' ityādi| `ṇaluttamo vā' (7.1.91) iti yadā ṇittvaṃ nāsti tadā guṇaḥ, yadā ṇitvaṃ tadā vṛddhiḥ| `jagle,magle' iti| `glai harṣakṣaye' (dhā.pā. 904), `mlai gātravināme' (dhā.pā.904) `ādeśa upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityāttvam| bhāve ātmanepadam, `liṭastajhayo-reśirec' (3.4.81)ityeś| `śravaṇamākārasya na bhavati' iti| yadā kālāvadhiparigrahārthaṃ dvirvacanagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadottarakālamapi sthānirūpaṃ prasajyeta, tataścākārasya śravaṇameva syāt| āto lopasya tu goda ityevamādyavakāśaḥ| śrūyamāṇe cākāre pareṇa saha vṛddhiḥ syāt| `dudyuṣati' iti| diveḥ `sanīvantardha' (7.2.49) ityādinā yadā pakṣa iḍāgamo na kriyate tadā `iko jhal' (1.2.9) `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti kittvam, tataḥ `cchvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (3.4.19) ityūṭh| sa ca dvirvacananimittaṃ na bhavati| tatra yadi dvirvacananimittatvena nāj viśeṣyate, ūṭhi parato yo yaṇādeśastasyāpi sthānivadbhāvaḥ syāt| evaṃ cābhyāsarūpamivarṇāntaṃ śrūyeta| dvirvacananimittacparigrahe tu `dyu' ityasya dvirvacanaṃ bhavati| tatra halādiśeṣahrasvatvayordudyūṣatītyabhyāsarūpamukārā- ntaṃ sidhyati|| 60. adarśanaṃ lopaḥ|(1.1.60) `adarśanam' ityādi| nanu cādarśanānupalabdhiśabdāvanupalabdhisāmānyavacanau| aśravaṇānupaccāraṇaśabdautvanupalabdhiviśeṣavacanau| tathā hyaśravaṇādiśabdoccāraṇe śabdasyaivānupalabdhiḥ pratīyate, nānupalabdhimātram, na ca sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdānāmekārthatā, tat kimityevamāha-- `anarthāntaram' iti| evaṃ manyate- sāmānyaśabda api prakaraṇavaśād viśeṣe vartante| iha ca śabdā vyutpādyatvena prakṛtāḥ, tasmād yadyapyadarśanānupalabdhiśabdau sāmānyavacanau, tathāpīha prakaraṇasāmarthyād viśeṣe śabdānupalabdhāveva varttete| iha vṛddhirityādikāḥ saṃjñā śabdānāṃ vihitāḥ| tadvadihāpyadarśanamityasyaiva śabdasya `lopaḥ' ityeṣā saṃjñā syāt| tataśca lopapradeśeṣvadarśanaśabdasyaivopasthānāt sa evādeśaḥ syādityata āha-- `etaiḥ śabdaiḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ puretallabhyate ? evaṃ manyate-- `naveti vibhāṣā' (1.1.44) ityata itikaraṇo'rthanirdaśārtho'nuvarttate| tena hyavadhāraṇaṃ gamyate, yathā-- `kriyā hi dravyaṃ vinayati nādravyam' iti| vināpīkaraṇena śabda-svarūpasya saṃjñā sidhyatyeva, yathā-- `taraptamapau ghaḥ' (1.1.22) ityatra| tasmāditi- karaṇānuvṛttisāmarthyādadarśanamiti yo'rthaḥ pratīyate, tasyaiveṣā saṃjñā, na śabdasya| kiñca `lopaḥ' mahatī saṃjñā kriyate yathānvarthasaṃjñā vijñāyeta| lopanaṃ lopaḥ; anupalabdhiranuccāraṇamityarthaḥ| na cādarśanamityetacchabdarūpamevābhāvātmakam, kiṃ tarhi ? tadarthaḥ| tasmādanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānādarthasyaivaiṣā saṃjñā| yadi tarhyarthasyaivaiṣā saṃjñā, tato'tiprasaṅgaḥ| sarvo hi śabdaḥ svaviṣayādanyatra na dṛśyate| tataśca `trapujatu' ityatra kvipo'darśanasya lopasaṃjñā syāt| evañca sati `pratyayalope pratyaya- lakṣaṇam' (1.1.62) iti hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' (6.1.71) iti tuk prasajyata ityata āha-- `prasaktasya' ityādi| tarhayadarśanamātrasyaiṣā saṃjñā ? na kiṃ tarhi ? śāstrādarthādvā kutaścit prasaktasya yadadarśanaṃ tasyaiva| tadiha na kenacitprakāreṇa kvipprasaṅgo'sti, tatkuto'stiprasaṅgaḥ ? kataṃ pureṣa viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatā nehaprasaktagrahaṇamasti, nāpi tat kṛtam ? evaṃ manyate-- `sthānivat' ityataḥ sthānigrahaṇa-mihāpyanuvartate, sthānī, prasaṅgavan, prasaktaḥ-- iti paryāyā hyete| tenāyamartho labhyate-- prasaktasya yadadarśanaṃ tasyeyaṃ saṃjñeti| `gaudheraḥ' iti| `godhāyā ḍhrak' (4.1.129) eyādeśaḥ, `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.76) iti yakārasya śāstreṇa prasaktasya lopaḥ| `pacerana' ityatrāpi sīyuṭaḥ śāsreṇa| evama- nyatrāpi yathāyogaṃ prasaktatā veditavyā| `jīradānuḥ' `āstremāṇam' iti| pūrvapad vakārasya lopaḥ| `strivu gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā. 1109) yasya `sarvadhātubhyo manin' (5.5.584) iti maninpratyayāntasya dvitīyaikavacana upadhādīrgeṇaitve cakṛte `āsremāṇam' iti| `aparasyānubandhādeḥ' iti| kakārāderanubandhasya| ādiśabdena sīyuṭsakārasya| 61. pratyayasya luk‌ślulupaḥ| (1.1.61) yathā vṛddhiśabdastadbhāvitānamatadbhāvitānāmapi saṃjñā, tathā lugityādikā apyatadbhāvitasyāpi saṃjñāḥ prāpnuvanti, tataśca saṃjñāsaṃkaraḥ syāt| saṃjñāsaṃkare hi sati saṃkīryerannityata āha-- `anekasaṃjñāvidhānācca' ityādi| yadyatadbhāvitasyā- pyetāḥ saṃjñāḥ syuḥ, anekasaṃjñākaraṇamarthakaṃ syāt; ekasyaiva sarvakāryasiddhaḥ| tasmādanekasaṃjñāvidhānād yadadarśanaṃ yayā saṃjñayoccāritayā bhāvitam- niṣpāditaṃ, tasyaiva pratyayādarśanasya sā saṃjñā, nānyasyeti na bhavati saṃkaraḥ| evaṃ tarhītaretarāśrayadoṣaḥ prāpnoti, tathā hi-- saṃjñayā viśiṣṭamadarśanaṃ bhāvyam, sati ca tasmin pratyayā- darśane saṃjñayā bhāvyamityata āha-- `vidhipradeśeṣu ca' ityādi| tadadarśanaṃ vidhīyate yasya vihitasya lugityevamādikāḥ saṃjñā bhavantīti bhāvinyāḥ saṃjñayā vijñānānna bhavatītaretarāśrayadoṣaḥ| `atti' iti| `adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapaḥ' (2.4.72) iti śapo luk| `juhoti' iti| `juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ' (2.4.75)| `varaṇāḥ' iti| varaṇānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāmadūrabhavo grāma iti| `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) tasya `varaṇādibhyaśca' (4.2.82) iti lup| `agastayaḥ, kuṇḍināḥ' iti| yadi pratyayagrahamaṃ na kriyeta, āgastyasyāpa- tyāni bahūni `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaḥ' (4.1.114) iti ṛṣyaṇ| kuṇḍinyā apatyāni bahūni gargāditvād yañ (4.1.165), tayorāgastyakauṇḍinyaśabdayorjasi parato yadā ` āgastyakauṇḍinyayoragastikuṇḍinac' (2.4.70) iti luk kriyate,agastikuṇḍinacau cādeśau; tadā vaiṣamyādekaikasya ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasya sthāninastraya ādesāḥ paryāyeṇa syuḥ| tatra yadā luk kriyate tadā vibhaktimātrasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti| athāpyalo'- ntyasya syāt ?evamapyāgastyaḥ,kauṇ‍ḍinyaḥ iti syāt; agastayaḥ, kuṇḍinā iti ceṣyate| yadāpyāgastyaśabdasya kuṇḍinajādeśaḥ, kauṇḍinyaśabdasya cāgasatyādeśaḥ, tathāpyaniṣṭameva prāpnoti| āgastyaśabdasya hi jasantasya agastayaiti rūpamiṣyate, kauṇḍinyaśabdasya tu kuṇḍinā iti| ata evāgastayaḥ kuṇḍinā ityanayānupūrvyā tayorupanyāsaḥ| athāpyāntaratamyādāgastyaśabdasyāgastiśabda evādeśo bhavati, na kuṇḍinajiti? kauṇḍinyaśabdasyāpi kuṇḍinajādeśo bhavati, nāgastiśabda iti ? evamapi naivāniṣṭāpatte- rmuktiḥ| tathā hi-- evaṃ hyagastayaḥ, kuṇḍinā iti ca sidhyati, tathāpi prāgdīvyatīye-'jādau pratyaye vivakṣite sati `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti cchoḥ na syāt,avṛddha-tvāt| prakṛteḥ| pratyayagrahaṇe tu sati tadadarśanasyaiveyaṃ saṃjñā vihiteti tasyaiva lug bhavati| parijādipratyayavivakṣāyāmapi `go'tre'lugaci' (4.1.89) iti luki pratiṣiddhe vṛddhācchapratyayaśca| agastīnāṃ chātrā āgastīyā iti| kauṇḍinyaśabdāt tu satyapi luki `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) ityaṇeva bhavati-- kauṇḍinyāścātrā iti| tena tatra chapratyayābhāvadoṣo na prasañjanīyaḥ| 62. pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam| (1.1.62) `pratyayalakṣaṇam' iti| pratyayo lakṣaṇaṃ yasyeti kārye'nyapadārthe bahuvrīhiḥ| pratyayanimittamityādinā sūtrārambhasya prayojanamāha| nanu ca sthānivadbhāvanāpyetat sidhyati, naitadasti; alāśrayamapi hi pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ kāryamiṣyate| tathā hyagnicidityatra `hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' (6.1.71) ityalāśrayo'pi tug bhavatyeva| `agnicit' iti| `agnau ceḥ' (3.2.9) iti kvip| adhogiti halṅyādisūtreṇa tilopaḥ; adāditvācchapo luk (2.4.72) `dāderdhātorghaḥ' (8.2.32) iti dhatvam, `ekāco baśo bhaṣ' (8.2.37) ityādinā bhaṣ dhakāraḥ, `jhalāñjaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvam, ghakārasya gakāraḥ,tasya `vāvasāne' (8.4.56) iti cartvaṃ kakāraḥ| `pratyayaḥ' iti| `vartamāne' iti pūrvasūtrāt| `āho yamahanaḥ' (1.3.28)ityā-tmanepadam| `gamahana' (6.4.99) ityādinopadhālopaḥ| `ho hanteḥ' (7.3.54) iti ghaḥṣa| ` saṃgmīya' iti| saṃpūrvād gameḥ `samo gami' (1.3.29) ityādinātmanepadam| `iṭo't' (3.4.146) ityadbhāvaḥ| `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.73) iti śapo luk| pūrvavadupadhālopaḥ| `anunāsikalopo na bhavati' iti| `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinā| `raikulam' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `gohitam' iti| `caturthī' (2.1.36) ityādinā| astyatra ṣaṣṭhīcaturthyekavacanayoḥ pratyayarlopaḥ; kiṃ tvayāvādeśayoraci vidhānāt tadvidhau varṇa āśrayīte, na tu pratyayaḥ| tena varṇanimittakau tau na pratyayanimitta- kāviti na bhavataḥ| nanu ca cātra pratyayasya lopaḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi ? luk, naitadasti; lopaśabdo'pi sāmānyena tadbhāvitasyātadbhāvitasya cā'darśanasya saṃjñā| tasmāllugapi lopo bhavatyeva|| 63. na lumatāṅgasya| (1.1.63) `lumatā' iti| luśaboda yasminnisti sa lumān| kaḥ punarasau ? lugityādisaṃjñāśabdaḥ| karaṇe ceyaṃ tṛtīyā, he tau va, itthambhūtalakṣaṇe vā| lumatā karaṇena lupte pratyaye, tena hetunā vā, tadupalakṣitena vetyarthaḥ| atha pratya ityetat kuto labhyate ? pratyayādarśanasyaiva lugādisaṃjñāvidhānāt| `lumatāśabdena lupte pratyaye yadaṅgam' iti| tat punastameva pratyayaṃ nimittamāśritya yenāṅgasaṃjñā pratilabdhā tad veditavyam|tasya pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavatītyaviśeṣābhidhāne'pi pratyāsatterya evāsau lumatā luptaḥ pratyayo'ṅgasaṃjñāyā nimittaṃ tallakṣaṇamiti gamyate| `gargāḥ' iti. `gargādibhyo yañ' (4.1.105) `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti bahuṣu luk| atra `taddhiteṣvalacāmādeḥ' (7.2.117) iti vṛddhirna bhavati| `mṛṣṭaḥ' iti| mṛjestadas, adāditvācchapo luk, vraścādisūtreṇa ṣatvam, ṣṭutvam, `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114) iti vṛddhirna bhavati| `juhutaḥ' iti| tasi parato juhotyādibhyaḥ ślau kṛte sārvadhātukalakṣaṇo guṇo na bhavati| sarvatra yameva pratyayamāśrityāṅgasaṃjñā jātā sa eva vṛddhyādeḥ kāryasya nimittam| iha ca viśeṣasyānāśraṇānna kevalamaṅgādhikāravihitaṃ kāryaṃ pratiṣidhyate; api tvanaṅgā4dhikāravihitamapi| tena gargāḥ, bidāḥ, uṣṭragrīvā ityatra `ñnityādirnityam' (6.1.197) ityādyudāttatvamanaṅgādhikāravihitamapi na bhavati| iha ca -- atraya iti taddhitasya `kitaḥ' (6.1.165) ityantodāttatvam| gargāḥ, bidā iti yathākramaṃ gargādiyañ| `anṛṣyānnatarye vidadibhyo'ñ' (4.1.104) ityañ| `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti luk| uṣṭragrīvā iti| `ive pratikṛtau(5.3.96) iti vihitasya kano `devapathādibhyaśca' (5.3.100) iti lup| atraya iti atrerapatyārthe `itaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti vihitasya ḍhakaḥ `atribhṛgukutsavasiṣṭha' (2.4.65) ityādinā bahuṣu luk| `pañca, sapta' iti| `ṣaḍ- bhyo luk' (7.1.22) iti jaśśasorluk| `payaḥ sāma'iti| atrāpi `svamornapuṃsakāt' (7.3.23) iti| atra yadyapi lumatā luptaḥ pratyayaḥ, tannimittā cāṅgasaṃjñā, tathāpi pratyayalakṣaṇena `suptiṅgantaṃ padam' (1.4.14) iti padasaṃjñā bhavatyeva; yasmānnāsāva-ṅgasya kāryam, api tu savibhaktikasya samudāyasya pratyayasya hi pūrvabhāgo'ṅgam. na ceha tas lumatā yo luptaḥ pratyamāśrityāhgasaṃjñā bhavati tamevāśritya padasaṃjñā prāpnoti| padasaṃjñāyañceha satyāṃ paya ityatra `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66) iti rutvam| kharavasaniyorvisarjanīyaśca padakāryaṃ bhavati| `pañca, sapta,sāma' iti| atrāpi `nalopaḥ prā- tipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nalopaḥ padasaṃjñākāryam| `kāryate' iti| ṇyantāt karmaṇi lakāraḥ, `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67) atra na lumatā pratyayo luptaḥ kiṃ tarhi ? `ṇeraniṭi'(6.4.51) iti; atra `āto lopaḥ' (6.4.64) ityasmāllopagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tena pratyayalakṣaṇā vṛddhirbhavatyeva|| 64. aco'ntyādi ṭi| (1.1.64) `antyādi'iti bahuvrīhiḥ acāṃ madhye yo'ntyo'c,sa ādiryasya śabdarūpa- sya tat tathoktam| nanu cāntyaśabdo'trācāmityetadapekṣata ityasāmarthyādādiśabdena saha samāso na prāpnoti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; antyaśabdo hi sambandhiśabdaḥ, sambnadhiśabdānāṃ nityasāpekṣatvena gamakatvāt sāpekṣatve'pi samāso bhavati, yathā devadattasya gurukula- miti| `nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī' iti| `yataśca nirdhāraṇam' (2.3.41) ityanena yadi nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhīyam, evaṃ hi sati nirdhāraṇamanekasannipāte bhavatītyaca ityekavacanaṃ na syāt| bahutvadbahuvacanena bhavitavyamityata āha -- `jātāvekavacanam' iti| jāterekatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `acāṃ sanniviṣṭānāṃ yo'ntyoc' iti| kathaṃ punarajityeṣa viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatā neha dvitīyamajgrahaṇam, nāpi prakṛtam ? evaṃ manyate -- samānajātīyasyaiva loke nirdhāraṇaṃ prasiddham| tathā hi, kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannakṣīratameti dvitīyaṃ gośabdamantareṇāpi gaureva pratīyate| tasmādihāpi yadyapi dvitīyamajgrahaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpi samānajātīyo'jeva nirdhāryamāṇo'vasīyata iti| ante bhavo'ntyaḥ, digāditvāt yat| `tadādi' iti| sa ādiryasyeti vigrahaḥ| `icchabdaḥ' ityādini rūpodāharaṇāni| kāryaṃ punaricchabdasya ṭisaṃjñāyāmagnicitamācaṣṭa iti ṇici kṛte `ṇāviṣṭavat prātipadikasya' (vā.813) iti ṭilopa agniṃ cayatīti| `ātām, āthām' iti| anayostu ṭisaṃjñākāryam-- `ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere'(3.4.97) ṭeretvam| `pacete, pacethe' iti kāryodāharaṇe| atha vahimahiṅorikārasya kathaṃ ṭisaṃjñā, yāvatā na so'sti yasya so'ntyaḥ, ajādiriti vyapadiśyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `ādyantavadekasmin' (1.1.21) itivyapadeśidbhāvenādiḥ, antya iti vyapadeśo bhaviṣyati| 65. alo'ntyātpūrva upadhā| (1.1.65) alo'ntyāditisamānādhikaraṇe pañcamyau| `dhātvādau varṇasamudāye'iti| nanu ca neha varṇasamudāya grahaṇamasti, nāpi tat prakṛtam| tat kathameṣo'rtho labhyate ? antyagrahaṇāt, samudāyasyaivāntyo'l bhavati, na kevalaḥ| tasmādantyagrahaṇādeṣo'rtho labhyate| `aleva' iti|evakārakaraṇādevālsamudāyo vyavacchidyate| nanu ca neha dvitīya- malgrahaṇamasti, tadalsumudāyasyāpyeṣā saṃjñā kasamānna bhavati ? lokataśca| loke hyamīṣāṃ bāhmaṇānāmantyāt pūrva ānīyatāmityuktaeka evāntyāt pūrva ānīyate, na samudāyaḥ | evamapyala eva vyavahitasya kasmādeṣā saṃjñā na bhavati ? vyahite'pi pūrvaśabdo varttata eva| ata eva laukikād dṛṣṭāntāt-- loke hyantyāt pūrvamānayetyukte na kaścid vyavahitamānayati, api tvananatarameva| yadi hyala evaiṣā saṃjñā, nālsamudāyasya, `ṛtaśca saṃyogāderguṇaḥ'(7.4.10) ityatra yad vakṣyati-- `saṃyogādiguṇavidhāne saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam' iti, tadvyāhanyate; na hyala evopadhāsaṃjñāyāmanekānantarahalsamudāyātmanaḥ saṃyogasyopadhātvamupapadyate| saṃyogāvayavasyopadhātvādavayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya tathā vyapadeśa ityavirodhaḥ| bhavati hyavayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya tathā vyapadeśaḥ, yathā-- āḍhyamidaṃ nagaramiti | atha vā- saṃyogasyālpūrvatvopalakṣaṇārthaṃ tatropadhāgrahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| akāra ityādīni rūpodāharaṇāni| kāryaṃ tvakārasyopadhāsaṃjñāyāṃ pācakaḥ, pāṭhaka ityatra `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ| ikāralṛkārayostu bhedakaḥ, chedakaḥ, varttakaḥ varddhaka iti| atra `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ| `śiṣṭaḥ' iti| `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075), niṣṭhā, `śāsa idaṅa haloḥ' (6.4.34) iti upadhāyā ittvam| tatra hi `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityādeḥ sutrādupadhāgrahaṇamanuvarttate| `śāsivasi' (8.3.60) ityādinā ṣatvam| `samudāyāt' ityādi| akārasakārasamudāyāt| pūrvasya śakārasyopadhāsaṃjñā mā bhūdityarthaḥ| yadi hi syāt,tasyaivettvaṃ syāt|| 66. tasminnita nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya| (1.1.66) kimarthamidam ? `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityevamādāvacītyevamāderādhārādheyabhāvaḥ pratyāsattinibandhanaḥ, yathā -- gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ prativasatīti| atra gaṅgāyāḥ sā ca pratyāsattiryathā pūrvamapekṣya bhavati, tathā paramapi| tatadaśca dadhyudakādiṣu na jñāyate-- kiṃ pūrvasyekaḥ pratyāsattibhājo yaṇādeśaḥ, uta parasyeti| tatra sandehesati niyamārtheyaṃ paribhāṣā''rabhyate| yadyevaṃ sandehaviṣaya iyamārabhyata iti yatra sandehastatropatiṣṭhate, tataśca dadhyudakamiti siddhaṃ syāt; idaṃ tu na sidhyati-- dadhyatreti| nanu ca vinaiva pari- bhāṣaitat siddham, na hyatra sandeho'sti| idaṃ tarhi na sidhyati-- samidatreti, agnicidatreti| yadi hi yatra sandeho nāsti, tatraiṣā paribhāṣā na syādihānupasthānāt, vyavadhāne'pi yaṇādeśaḥ syādeva| tasmādasandehaviṣaye'pyeṣā paribhāṣā yathā bhavati sa yatnaḥkarttavyaḥ| eṣa kriyate-- iha (tasminniti) `saptamīnirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) tāvat sūtraṃ karttavyam; iyataivābhilaṣitārthasiddheḥ| tatrāpyayamarthaḥ-- svarūpagrahaṇaśaṅkāṃ nirākartumitikaraṇo na karttavyo bhavati| na hi kvacicchāstraṃ saptamīnirdiṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate, yena svarūpagrahaṇamāśaṅkyeta| so'yamalpena sūtreṇa siddhe yanmahat sūtraṃ karoti tanmahāviṣayeyaṃ paribhāṣeti| sūcanārtham| evaṃ ca mahāviṣayeyaṃ bhavati yadi sarvatra-- sandehaviṣaye, anyatra ca pravarttate| syādetat-- "saptamīnirdiṣṭa" ityucyamāne saptamyā yadyapyadhikaraṇaṃ nirdi-śyate, tathāpi tasyādheyapradhānatvāt `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityatrāci yolvyavasthita-stasmin yaṇādeśo vijñāyate, tataścehaiva syāt dadhi bhuṅkta iti, iha tu na syāt-- dadhyatreti; yathānyāse tveṣa doṣo nāsti, tasmāt mahat sūtraṃ praṇītam' iti, naitadasti; yadayaṃ `dādhāghvadāp' (1.2.20) iti nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati-- adhikaraṇa eva yaṇādeśādikāryaṃ bhavati, na tvādheya iti| api ca-yathānyāse'pyadhikaraṇasyādeyapradhānatvādādheya eva yaṇādeśādikāryaṃ tena sarvatraiṣā paribhāṣopatiṣṭhata iti sarvamiṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| iha `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā'(1.1.68) iti svarūpasyaiva grahaṇena bhavitavyam| tataśca yatraiva tasminnityetat padamuccāryate tatraiveyaṃ paribhāṣā syāt `tasminnaṇi ca yaṣmākāsmākau' (4.3.2) iti| asti hyatra tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ paranivṛttiḥ prayojanam-- yauṣmākīṇaṃ yuṣmabhyaṃ dehi, āsmākīnamasmabhyaṃ dehīti| yuṣmabhyaṃ dehi yauṣmākīṇam, asmabhyaṃ dehyāsmākīnamiti| `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityevamādau tveṣā nopatiṣṭhate,ityata āha-- `tasmin' iti| `saptamyarthanirdeśe' iti| evaṃ manyate-- itikaraṇo hyatra kṛtaḥ, sa ca svarūpa- padārthakatvaṃ nirasyārthapadārthakatvaṃ tasminnityasya sampādayati, tenārthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavati| sa tvartho'vaśyaṃ yena kenacicachabdena nirdeṣṭavya iti nānārthakatvāt sāmānyavācinā tasminnityanena padena nirdiṣṭa iti| nanu ca śabdasyārthena paurvāparyaṃ na sambhavatītyarthenāsambhavāt tadvācinā śabdena vijñāsyata ityadoṣaḥ| atredaṃ codyate-- arthasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt svarūpasya ca grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamitikaraṇaḥ kriyate, tacca svarūpagrahaṇam `tasminnaṇi ca yuṣmākāsmākau' (4.3.2) iti sūtreṇa sambhāvyate; yadi ca svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, tatraiva pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kuryāt, na ca kṛtam; tasamādavagamyate-- antareṇāpītikaraṇamarthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, na svarūpasyeti nārthastena ?. stayametat; ye tu mandavuddhya eva pratipattumasamarthāstān prati sukhāvabadhanārthamitikaraṇaḥ ka-taḥ| nirdiṣṭagrahaṇamidarthasya viśeṣaṇam| iha ca śāstre `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityādiṣu vākyeṣu yatra saptamyartho'sti tatrāsau nirdiṣṭa eva sarvatra| tadapārthakaṃ nirdiṣṭagrahaṇaviśeṣaṇaṃ vyabhicārābhāvādityata āha-- `nirdiṣṭagrahaṇam' ityādi| ānantaryamavyavadhānamartho yasya tat tathoktam| kathaṃ punasta-dānantaryārthaṃ bhavati ? tatastatpratīteḥ| tathā hi diśirayamuccāraṇakriyaḥ, niḥśabdo'- pyayamiha nairantaryaṃ dyotayati| tatra nirantaraṃ diṣṭaḥ- nirdiṣṭa iti prādisamāse kṛte sphuṭamenānantaramuccāritamiti pratīyate| kimarthaṃ punarānantaryamāśritamityata āha-- agnicidatretyādi| pūrvaśabdo'-yaṃ vyavahite'pi varttate| tatra yadyānantarya nāśrīyate tato vyavahite'pi syādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca `aci' ityaupaśleṣikamadhikaraṇaṃ vijñāyate, na ca vyavahitamupaśliṣṭaṃ bhavati, tat kimānantaryārthena nirdiṣṭagrahaṇena ? asadetat; asati hi nirdiṣṭ‌grahaṇaaupaśleṣikamadhikaraṇameva na śakyaṃ vijñātum| yasmāt pūrvaśabdo vyavahite'pi varttamānaḥ parasyaiva nivṛttiṃ karoti, na vyavahitapūrvasyāpi| nirdiṣṭagrahaṇe tu sati, saptamyā aupaśleṣikādhikaraṇābhidhāyinyāḥ pratyāsattirupādīyate| sā ca pūrvagrahaṇena na nivarttyate, paranivṛttireva kriyata ityeṣo'rtho labhyate| tena vyavahitasya kāryaṃna bhavati| uttarārthaṃ ca nirdiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ karttavyameva|| 67. tasmādityuttarasasya| (1.1.67) kimarthamidam ? `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti yā'tra sā tu na kārakavibhaktiḥ, kiṃtarhi ? `dikśabdādañcūttarapada' (2.3.29) iti digyogalakṣaṇā| dikśabdastvadhyā- hāryaḥ, tatra kiṃ pūrvaśabdamadhyāhṛtyātiṅaḥ pūrvasya nighātaḥ kriyate ? uta paraśabdama- dhyāhṛtya parasya ? iti sandehe sati paribhāṣeyaṃ niyamāऱtā''rabhyate| `nirdiṣṭagrahaṇamanuvarttate'iti| tena tasyānantaryārthatvādvayavahitasya kāryaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| ihāpītikaraṇo'rthanirdeśārthaḥ kriyate| tena pañcamyarthagrahaṇaṃ bhavati, na tu śabdasvarūpasyetyabhiprāyeṇāha-- `tasmāt' iti| `pañcamyarthanirdeśaḥ' iti| nanu ca pūrvasūtrādevetikaraṇo'nuvartiṣyate, tat kimarthaḥ punarihetikaraṇaḥ ? anena prakāreṇa pūrvasūtrādekadeśo'nuvarttata iti jñāpanārtha-| tenetiśabdavannirdiṣṭa-grahaṇamanuvarttetetyetadākhyātaṃ bhavati| anyastvāha-- "itikaraṇaṃ tvihāvadheravadhimattantratāṃ nivarttayati| tenāvadhere-vottarasya vijñāyate, nāvadhimataḥ| svarūpagrahaṇanirāsārthastvitikaraṇo na bhavati; svarūpā-bhāvāt| yadapi `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (6.1.103) iti, tatrāpi pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt pūrvaḥ śas na sambhavatīti na bhavati sandehaḥ| tasmādavadheravadhimattantratānirāsārtha eveti- śabdaḥ' iti, atrocyate; yadyavadherevottarasya kāryaṃ yathā syādavadhimato mā bhūdityevama-rthaṃ itikaraṇo'vadheravadhimattantratāmapākartuṃ kriyate, nārthastena; lokata eva tatsiddheḥ; loke hi tasmācchātrāduttaro bhojyatāmityukteravadherevottaro bhojyate, nāvadhimataḥ| tadihāpi vināpītikaraṇenāvadherevottarasya kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati; nāvadhimataḥ| yadapyuktam-- "tasamācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (6.1.103) ityatrāpi pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt pūrvaḥ śas na sambhavati" iti, tadapyayuktam;tathā hyaśabdādiśabdācca śasi parataḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghatve pūrvatra ca vṛkṣādiśabde śasante vyavasthāpite gacchata ān vṛkṣānupalabhate gacchato vṛkṣānānupalabhata ityatra pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt pūravaṃ śaś sambhavatyeva| atha yatrobhayanirdeśastatra kasya kāryeṇa bhavitavyam ? tatra yānavakāśā setarasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati, ataḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasya kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati| yathā `āne muk' (7.2.82) ityatra saptamī niravakāsā `ato yeyaḥ' (7.2.80) ityata iti pañcamyāḥ pūrvasūtre sāvakāśāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati| tathā `īdāsaḥ' (7.2.83) iti pañca- myā''na iti pūrvasūtre sāvakāśāyāḥ saptamyāḥ| yatrobhe sāvakāse tatra paratvāt pañcamī saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati| yathā-- `āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ' (7.1.52) iti`ājjaserasuk' (7.1.50) ityatra pañcamī sāvakāśā| `āmi' iti saptamyuttarārthā| tatrāditi pañcamī āmīti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayati, tena sarvanāmna uttarasyāmaḥ suḍ bhavati| iha tu `dīrghāt' (6.1.75) `padāntādvā' (6.1.76) iti, yadyapi `cche ca' (6.1.73) iti saptamī pūrvasūtre sāvakāśā, tathāpi tasyāḥ svarittvāt pūrvayogādanuvṛttāyā niravakāśatvam| ataḥ sā ca saptamī pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati| pañcamī tu paurvaparyaṃ prakalpya sāvakāśā nivarttate| tenāyaṃ sūtrārtho bhavati- dīrghāduttaro yacchaḥ, tasmin parataḥ pūrvasya dīrghasyaiva tug bhavatīti| `sārvadhā- tuke yak' (7.1.67) ityatra niravakāśāpi saptamī dhātoriti pañcamyāḥ sāvakāśāyā api ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ na prakalpayati; anyathā hi dhātorevādeśā yagādayaḥ syuḥ| tataśca `paraśca' (3.1.2) ityasyānuvṛttasya bādhād yagādīnāṃ cānubandhakaraṇasya vayarthyaṃ prasajyeta| na hi dhātvādeśatve sati teṣāṃ paratvamupapadyate tu te dhātoḥ pare bhavanti|| 68. svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā| (1.1.68) `śāstre svameva' ityādi| śāstragrahaṇaṃ loke'rthasyaiva grāhyatvāt| śabdasyeti `kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā' (2.3.71) iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī, śabdaḥ svameva rūpaṃ grāhayati bodhayati, pratyāyayatītyarthaḥ| kaḥ punaḥ śabdasya svarūpasya ca bhedaḥ ? yena śabdasyeta vyatirekanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| paramārthato vastugato nāstyeva bhedaḥ| tathā hi-- svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya svabhāvaḥ| taccet tato'rthāntaraṃ syāc śabdasya vaisvabhāvyameva syāt| asatyapi tu vāstave bhede buddhiviracitaṃ bhedamāśritya ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| buddhirhi svabījaparipākavaśādākāraviśeṣaparigrahavatyupajāyamānā vastuno'satyapi bhede bhedamāpādayati, yathā-- rāhoḥ śiraḥ, svasya svabhāva iti| `na bāhyo'rthaḥ' iti evakāreṇa yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayati|
