atiprasaktasyāpavādamāha--`aśabdasaṃjñā' ityādi| kimarthaṃ punaridamārabhyata ityāha-- `śabdena' ityādi| śabdenoccāritenārthaḥ kāryopayogitayā gamyate, na śabda- svarūpam| tathā hi-- gaurupalabhyatamityukte'rthamevopalabdhumādriyate, na śabdasvarūpam; vyākaraṇe tu pratyayavidhānādikāryamarthasya na sambhavati; tena saha śabdasya paurvāparyābhāvāt| na cārthād vihitena pratyayena kaścit prakṛtopayogaḥ| tena `agnerḍhak' (4.2. 33) ityukte nāyaṃ saṃpratyayo bhavati| agniśabdasya yo'rthaḥ, sa iha kāryī, tasyedaṃ kāryaṃ vidhīyata iti| tataśca tasyārthasya ye vācakāḥ vidheyamiti| yathā --ākṛtivādināṃ gaurduhyatāmiti śabdena jātau coditāyāṃ tatra tatkāryāsambhavāt tadādhārāyāṃ vyaktau saṃbhavāt tatsāhacaryācca tasyāmeva vyaktau saṃpratyayo bhavati, na jātau; tathehāpi tanmā bhūt tadvācināṃ saṃpratyaya ityevamarthamidamārabhyate| tadvācināmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| tadvācino mā vijñāyītyevamarthamidamārabhyata ityarthaḥ| tatra kecidāhuḥ-- svarūpasya paryāyāṇāṃ ca kārye prasakte śrūyamāṇasyaiva tad yathā syāt, paryāyāṇāṃ bhūditi niyamārthā paribhāṣeyamiti| anye tu-- " liṅgavatī paribhāṣā bhavati' , yathā, `iko guṇavṛddhī' (1.1.3) iti guṇavṛddhī liṅgam| vidhyantaraśeṣabhūtā vā; yathā-- `vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam' (kāta.pa.67) iti parasya vidhyantarasya śeṣabhāvamāpadyate| na vāsyā liṅgaṃ vidhyantaraśeṣabhāvo vā vidyata iti saṃjñāsūtramidam" iti pratipannāḥ| yadyapi vṛttau saṃjñāśabdo noccārinaḥ, tathāpi `svameva rūpaṃ śabdasya grāhyam' ityevaṃ bruvatā vṛttikāreṇa saṃjñaivetyākhyātaṃ bhavati| agniśabdādau śabdāntaraiḥ sādhāraṇamapi rūpamasti śabdatvādi, asādhāraṇamapi agniśabdatvādi, tatra sādhāraṇarūpavyudāsenāsādhāraṇasyāgniśabdatvādi- rūpasya parigrahārthaṃ `svam' grahaṇam| taddhi svameva tasya rūm, itarat punaḥ parasyāpi| pratīti pratyanupadeśācchabdasya svarūpamevāsannam, nārthaḥ; viparyayāt, aheyatvā- cca, tannityasambandhitvācca| tathā hyanukaraṇaśabdā hyarthaṃ jahati, na tu svarūpam| asādhāraṇañca rūpam,arthastu sādhāraṇaḥ; śabdāntarairapi pratyāyamānatvāt| tadevamāsannatvānnityasambadhitvādasādhāraṇatvācca rūpameva śabdasya svam, nārthaḥ| tataśca svagrahaṇādeva rūpaparigrahe siddhe vyākaraṇe rūpavadartho'pyaṅgīkriyata iti jñāpanārthaṃ rūpagrahaṇam| tena-- `arthavad‌grahaṇena nānarthakasya' (vyā.pa.1) ityetadupapannaṃ bhavati| śabdānuśāsananaprastāvādeva ca śabdasyeti siddhe śabdagrahaṇam-- yatra śabdaparo nirdeśastatra svarūpaṃ gṛhyate, nārthaparo nirdeśa iti jñāpanārtham| tena ` sve puṣaḥ' (3.4.40) ityatra svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| arthaparatvaṃ tu nirdeśasyāvicchinnapāramparyādācāryopadeśād‌vijñāyate| `āgneyam' iti| agnirdevatā'syetyatrārthe ḍhak| `audaśvitkam' iti| ātrāpyudaśvitā saṃskṛtamityatrārthe ḍhak| `udaśvito- 'nyatarasyām' (4.2.19) ityatra `dadhnaṣṭhak' (4.2.18) ityasyānuvatteḥ, `isusu- ktāntātkaḥ' (7.3.51) iti ṭhakaḥ kādeśaḥ| `ghagrahaṇeṣu' ityādi| yadi ghuprabhṛtirapi saṃjñāśabda svarūpasya grāhakaḥ syāt `upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' (3.2.92) ityatra yadyapi dhātvadhikārastathāpi ghugrahaṇād ghuśabdāt kipratyayaḥ syāt| upasargagrahaṇaṃ tu prādyupalakṣaṇārtha syāt| yathā-- `añ nāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ, nasañcāsthūlāt' (5.4.118) `upasargācca' (5.4.119) ityatra| kumārīgha ityatra ca gha iti saṃjñāśabdena svarūpapratyāyane sati `gharūpakalpa' (6.4.43) ityādina ghaśabde parato hrasvatvaṃ prasajyeta| nanu ca saṃjñāvidhānasāmarthyāt saṃjñāyāḥ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, saṃjñā hi saṃjñinaḥ pratyāyanārthā kriyate; yadi saṃjñāśabdo'pi svarūpaṃ pratyāyayet saṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, naitadasti; saṃjñāvidānasāmarthyāddhi saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayet, paribhāṣāvidhānasāmarthyācca svarūpam| tasmāt pratiṣedhaḥ karttavyaḥ ? na karttavyaḥ, jñāpakāt saṃjñāśabdo rūpasya grāhako na bhaviṣyati| yadayaṃ `ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ' (1.4.24) iti ṣakārāntāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñāṃ vidadhāti,tajjñāpayati- saṃjñāśabdaḥ svarūpasya grāhako na bhavatīti; anyathā hi `ṣaḍbhyo luk' (7.1.22) ityatra ṣaṭśabdena svarūpasya pratyāyitatvāt tato'pi lug bhavatīti ṣakārantāyāyaḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ ṣaḍiti saṃjñā na kuryāt| ṣaṭśabdo hi ṣakārāntā saṃkhyā, nānyā, satyametat; tathāpi yeṣāṃ jñāpakadvāreṇārthapratipattau pratipattigauravaṃ syāt, tān pratitatparihārāyayāśabda- saṃjñeti pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ| śabdagrahaṇam- vyākaraṇe yā saṃjñā tasyā eva pratiṣedho na laukikyā iti pradarśanārtham| `sittdaviśeṣāṇām' ityādi| yatra viśeṣāṇāṃ grahaṇamiṣyate tatra sakāra itsaṃjñakaḥ karttavyaḥ `vṛkṣasya,mṛgas'iti| `tato vaktavayaḥ' ityādi| sinnirdeśaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ prathame'dhyāye'nyatra vā paribhāṣeyaṃ karttavyā-- sittadviśeṣāṇāmityādi| yasya sakāra itsaṃjñakaḥ, sa tadviśeṣāṇāṃ vṛkṣādiviśeṇāṇāṃ khadirādīnāṃ pratipādaka iti vaktavyam| evaṃ `pitparyāyavacanasya ca svādyartham' (kātyā.vā.519) ityādāvapi veditavyam nyāyādapi caitat pratipādyo'rthaḥ sidhyati| yathā sidhyati tathā yathāvasasaṃ purastāt pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ sukhāvabodhanārthaṃ sittadviśeṣāṇāmityādigranthopanyāsaḥ|| 69. aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ| (1.1.69) saṃjñāsūtramidam, na paribhāṣā| sāhi niyamārthā bhavati| na cāṇuditāṃ savarṇānā- manyeṣāṃca grahaṇaṃ prāptam, yena savarṇānāmeva grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti niyamaḥ kriyate- `pareṇa ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇam' iti| tena ṛkārādayo'pi savarṇānāṃ grāhakāḥ sidhyantītyabhiprāyaḥ| pareṇa ca ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇam `a i u ṇ' ityatra pratipāditam| pūrvasūtrāt `svaṃ rūpam' ityetadihānuvarttate| taccārthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatīti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ sampadyate| tena svasyāpi rūpasyāṇ gṛhyasyāṇa udicca grāhako bhavatīti darśayannāha-- `svasya ca rūpasya' iti| `ādguṇaḥ' ityādi| yatheha bhavati devendra iti, tathā khaṭvendra ityatrāpyādguṇo bhavati| `asya cvau' (7.4.32) yathā paṭībhavatītyatre- tvaṃ bhavati tathā mālībhavatītyatrāpi| `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148)| yathā dikṣirityatra lopo bhavati, tathā cauḍirityatrāpi| bāhvāditvāccūḍāśabdadiñ| `svarānunāsikya' ityādi| udāttaḥ sūtre gṛhyamāṇaḥ svarāntarabhinnasyāpi grāhako bhavati| evamanudāttaḥ svaritaśca| tathā sānunāsiko niranunāsikasya, so'pi tasya| `dīrgho na bhavati' iti| yadi `apratyayaḥ' iti pratiṣedho na syāt pratyayo'pi savarṇānāṃ grāhakaḥ syāt| tataśca dīrgho'pi syāt| nanu cātyalpamidamucyate- ` apratyayaḥ' iti, apratyayādeśaṭitkinmita iti vaktavyam| pratyaye pratyudāhṛtam| ādeśe-- `idama iś' (5.3.3), asmāt- itaḥ, `pañcamyāstasil' (5.3.7) iti tasil, asmin - iha, `idamo haḥ' (5.3.11)| atra hi savarṇagrahaṇe sati yadyakṛte tyadādyatva iś‌bhāvastadāntaratamyāt trimātra ikāraḥ prāpnoti, atha kṛte'rddhaca- turthamātraḥ| yadi `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatve'kṛtetadāpi; atha kṛte tato'rddhatṛ-tīyamātraḥ| atha vā- arddhacaturthamātro'rddhatṛkatīyamātraśca nāsti tato dvimātra- strimātraśca syāta| ṭit-- `ārdhadhātukasyeḍ valādeḥ' (7.2.35), lavitā, savarṇagrahaṇe sati dīrgho'pi syāt| kit bhuvo vug luṅaliṭoḥ' (6.4.88) babhūva, atra sānunāsi-ko'pi syāt| santi hi yaṇaḥ sānunāsikā niranunāsikāśca| mit-- `caturanuḍuhorāmudā-ttaḥ', (7.1.98) `am sambuddhau' (7.1.99), anaḍ‌van-- atra dīrgho'pi syāt| tat tarhyevaṃ vaktavyam ? na vaktavyam; cakāro'tra kriyate, so'nuktapratiṣedhasamucca- yārtho bhaviṣyati| tena yeṣāmādeśādīnāṃ grāhakatvaṃ neṣyate te savarṇānāṃ grāhakā na bhaviṣyanti| anye tvāhuḥ- "`apratyaḥ' iti neha saṃjñāgrahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? anvarthagrahaṇam| pratīyate vidhīyate-utpādyata iti pratyayaḥ| tenāpratyaya ityasyāyamartho bhavati--`bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇān na gṛhṇāti (vyā.pa35)iti| haśādayo'pi bhāvyante- utpādyanta iti te'pi pratyayāḥ, tena te savarṇānāṃ grāhakā na bhavanti" iti| caiścakārasya prayojanaṃ vaktavyam| `svaṃ rūpam' ityasyānukarṣaṇaṃ tasya prayojanamiti cet, na; cānukṛṣṭatvāduttaratra tadanuvṛttirna syāt| na caitatprayojanamupapadyate; svaritatvādevānuvṛttisiddheḥ| atha matam-- `prathamāntaṃ svamityetatprakṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ, tasmāccakārare kṛte yatnāt ṣaṣṭhyantatā tasya yathā syādityevamarthaścakāraḥ' iti, etadapi nāsti; arthādeva hi vibhkativipariṇāmasiddheḥ|| 70. taparastatkālasya| (1.1.70) taḥparo yasmāt so'yaṃ tapara iti bahuvrīhiṃ darśayati, tādapi parastapara iti pañca-mītatpuruṣaṃ ca| sa punaḥ pañcamīti yogavibhāgāt samāsa iti veditavyaḥ| kathaṃ punaretat samāsadvayaṃ labhyate, yāvataikasparaśabdaḥ ? ekasyāpyāvṛttyā dvidhā bhedo bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| atra hi bahuvrīherliṅgam--`ato bhisa ais' (7.1.9) iti taparakaraṇam| na hyatra pañcamī tatpuruṣa upapadyate| avarṇo hyatra taparo'bhimataḥ, na bhis| yadi ceha pañcamītatpuruṣaḥ syāt, tarhi bhis taparaḥ syāt; yatastaparo varṇa ihocyate, na cāsau varṇaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tatsamudāyaḥ| pañcamītatpuruṣe tu liṅgam--`vṛddhirādaic' (1.1.1) iti taparakaraṇam| na hyatra bahuvrīhiryujyate| yadi bahuvrīhiḥ syāt tadā''kārasya taparatvaṃ syāt,na cā''kārārthaṃ taparakaraṇam‌, api tvaijartham. etacca tatraiva pratipāditam| savarṇasyeti varttate, varṇasya ca savarṇo na bhavati, nanu varṇasamudāyasya; tasmādaviśeṣābhidhāne'pi varṇa eva taparo vijñāyata ityāha-- `taparo varṇaḥ' iti| tatkālasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ-- sa kālo'syeti| ayukto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ| tathā hi -- tacchabdena taparaḥ parāmṛśyate, taparaśca varṇaḥ| kālastu kriyāviśeṣa iṣyate| tathā hyuktam-- ādityagrahanakṣatraparispandamathāpare| bhinnamāvṛttibhedena kālaṃ kālavido viduḥ|| (vā.pa.3.9.76) iti| tat kuto varṇakriyāviśeṣābhidhāyinostaparakālaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? evaṃ tatkāla iva kālo yasya sa tatkāla iti| asyārthaṃ darśayitumāha-- `ātmanā' ityādi| yadyapi taparakaraṇasannidhānādihātmaśabdasya tatra vṛttiryuktā; tathāpīha sāhacaryāt tatsahacaritāyāmuccāraṇakriyāyāṃ kālākhyāyāṃ sa varttate| kuta etat ? tapareṇa varṇena kriyāyāstulyatvānupapatteḥ| sambhavati sāhacaryāt tācchabdyam| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati- tapara- varṇasahacaritayā kriyayā tulyakālasyeti yādṛśī taparavarṇasyoccāraṇakriyā tādṛguccāraṇa- kriyā yasyeti yāvat| `guṇāntarayuktasya' iti| yana guṇena dharmākhyenodāttādinā viśiṣṭa uccāritastato'nyairudāttādibhirguṇaiḥ sambaddhasyetyarthaḥ| `svasya ca rūpasya' iti| ihāpi tadanuvṛtteḥ| ihedaṃ sūtraṃ niyamārthaṃ vā syāt ? vidhyarthaṃ vā ? yadyaṇityanuvarttate,tataḥ pūrveṇaiva `siddhe satyārambho niyamā- rtho bhavati'-- (kātya.pa.62)taparo'ṇ tatkālasyaiva grāhako bhavati, nānyasyeti| athāṇiti nivṛttam, tato vidhyartham| tatrādye pakṣe `viḍvanoranunāsikasyāt' (6.4.41) ityākāro dīrghastaparo niranunāsikaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ `bhedakā guṇāḥ' ityasmin darśane sānunāsikasya grāhako na syāt; anaṇtvāt| tataśca niranunāsika evādeśaḥ syāt| itaratra tu pakṣe satyapi bhedakatve guṇānāmeṣa doṣo na bhavatīti manyamāno dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-- `vidhyarthamidam' iti| kathaṃ vidhyarthamityāha-- `aṇiti nānuvarttate' iti| `aṇāmanyeṣāṃ ca ' ityādi| yuktaṃ yadanyeṣāmeva taparāṇāṃ grahaṇakaśāstramiti teṣāṃ pūrveṇa grahaṇasyāsiddhatvāt| aṇāṃ tu pūrveṇaiva siddhe grāhakatve kathamamityata āha-- `ato bhisa ais' ityādi| syādetat, ihāpi tat pravṛttamevānavakāśatvādityata āha-- `ata parāḥ' ityādi|`ādguṇaḥ' (1.3.87) ityādāvataparā aṇo'vakāśaḥ|asya tvanaṇastaparā dīrghāḥ| yathā `viḍ- vanoranunāsikasyāt' (1.4.41)iti| ye tvaṇastaparāḥ, teṣūbhayaprāptau paratvādidameva grahaṇakaśāstraṃ pravarttata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `vṛkṣai plakṣaiḥ' iti| tṛtīyābahuvacanaṃ bhis|`ato bisa ais' ((7.1.9) ityaisādeśaḥ; vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhiḥ| `abjāḥ gojāḥ' iti| `janī prādu- rbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149) apsu jāyate, goṣu jāyata iti-- `dajanasanakakhanakramagamo viṭ' (3.2.6)| `khaṭvābhiḥ' iti| kataṃ punaretat pratyudāharaṇam, yāvatā `antādivacca' (6.1.85) ityantādivadbhāve bhavitavyamevātraisbhāvena, taparakaraṇasya tu ytaraikādeśo nāsti tad‌vayavacchedyaṃ bhaviṣyati-- `kīlālapābhiḥ, somapābhiḥ' ityādi ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; antadivacca' (6.1.85) ityatra vakṣyati-- `varṇāśrayavidhāvantādivadbhāvo neṣyate' iti| tathā hi-- khaṭvābhiritadyatrāntavadbhāvābhāvāt `ato bhisa ais' (7.1.9) na bhavatīti| atha vā -- `ataḥ' ityatrākāradvayapraśleṣaḥ kṛtaḥ, śrūyamāṇādato yathā syāt| 71.ādirantyena sahetā| (1.1.71) svarūpavidhiparihārāyārambhaḥ|idamapi saṃjñāsūtram| anādibhūta vastvapekṣya tatpūrvavastuna āditvaṃ na bhavati, antyabhūtaṃ vastvapekṣya tataḥ parasyāntyatvam| na cehādyantayoḥ parasparāpekṣe ādyantatve yujyete| evaṃ hi sati vastvantarasya saṃjñino bhāvādādirantyena sahitaḥ svaryaiva saṃjñā syāt| tataśca `svaṃ rūpam' (1.1.68) ityetasyehānuvṛttaye svaritatvāsaṅgo vṛtā syāt| tasmādādyantaśabdābhyāṃ sāmarthyādādyantavyatirekeṇa tanmadhyapāti vastu saṃjñitvenākṣiptamiti matvāha-- `tanmadhyapatitānām' iti| jātāvidaṃ bahuvacanam; anyathā hyeṅa śabda okārasya saṃjñā na syāt| nanu cādyantaśabdābhyāṃ niyatadeśāvayavāvabhidhīyate, avayavāścāvayavinaḥ samudāya- rūpasya sambandhina iti sambandhiśabdatvādādyantaśabdābhyāṃ tasyaiva saṃjñitvenā- kṣepo yuktaḥ| akata evaṃ vaktavyam-- `tanmadhyapatitānāṃ samudāyasya' iti| evaṃ manyate-- yadayam `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67)ityādau varṇānāṃ samudāye parato yakāraṃ yaṇādeśaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaṃ karoti, tato gamyate-- na varṇasamudāyaḥ saṃjñīti, kiṃ tarhi ? pratyekaṃ varṇā eveti; anyathā varṇasamudāye saṃjñini parato varṇamālāṃ yaṇādeśaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaṃ kuryāditi| asambhavāt sa na kṛta iti cet, na; varṇamālātmana ādeśasya sambhavāt| tarhi samudāye saṃjñini kāryameva na sambhavatīti cet, yadi ca samudāye parataḥ kāryaṃ na sambhavati varṇā eva pratyekaṃ santu saṃjñinaḥ; tatra kāryaṃ sambhavati, kiṃ samudāyena ? `ṭā' ityanena grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi| nanu ca so'pi tāvato'vadheranta eva, na; tāvato'vadheravivakṣitatvāt| ṭakāro hyayam `ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ' (7.1.12) `dvitīyāṭaustvenaḥ' (2.4.34) ityatra tṛtīyaikavacanasya viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, na tu pratyāhārārthaḥ| athādigrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? antyena saha samudāya eva saṃjñā mā bhūditi, naitadasti; `āvṛttidharmāṇo hi saṃjñāśabdā bhavanti'| ādireva pradeśavākyeṣvāvarttate, na samudāyaḥ; tasmādantareṇāpyādigrahaṇaṃ sāmarthyādāderevāntyasahitasya saṃjñātvaṃ vijñāyate, na samudāyasya| evaṃ tarhi sāmarthyalabdhasyaivārthasya vispaṣṭīkaraṇārthamādi- grahaṇam| atha sahagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā tṛtīyayaiva sahārtho gamyate, yathā-- `vṛddho yūnā' (1.2.65) ityatra ? naitadevam; itthambhūtalakṣaṇe'pi tṛtīyā'sti| tasyāṃ ca satyāmādirevāntyenetsaṃjñakenopalakṣitaḥ saṃjñā syāt| tataśca pradeśeṣvaka iti, ika iti, aci iti ca samudāyādvibhaktirna syāt, nirarthakatvenāprātipadiktavāt| `saha' grahaṇāt tu sahabhūtā saṃjñeti samudāyasya saṃjñātvenārthattvāt prātipadikatve sati vibhaktirlabhyate| idgrahaṇaṃ tu `aci' ityatrānitsaṃjñakena `caṭatava' ityanena cakāreṇa saṃjñā mā bhūdityevamartham| antyatvaṃ tasya pūrvavat, na samudāyāpekṣayā| evaṃ tarhi `halantyam' (1.3.3) itītsaṃjñā prāpnoti, tadarthaṃ `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ' (1.3.4) ityatra neti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ| 72. yenavidhistadantasya| (1.1.72) `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyetyasyāyamapavādaḥ'| idamapi saṃjñāsūtram| na tu paribhāṣā| na hyatra niyamarūpatā paribhāṣādharmo vidyate| `yena' iti karamae tṛtīyā| vidhīyate - apūrva eva kriyate iti vidhiḥ karmasādhanaḥ; upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' (3.3.92) iti kipratyayāntaḥ| tadantasya' iti| so'nto'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ| tadityanena sa eva karaṇabhūtaḥ śabdaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| anataśabdo'yamavayavavācī, avayavaśca samudāyasya bhavati| ataśca tasyaiveyaṃ saṃjñā vijñāyata ityāha-- `samudāyasya saṃjñā bhavati' iti| `avaśyalāvyam' iti| `avaśyapāvyam' iti| `lūñ chedane' (dhā.pā.1484), `pūñ pavane' (dhā.pā.1483) vṛddhau kṛtāyām `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityāvādeśaḥ, mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt samāsaḥ; `lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtyeḥ' (kāśikā.6.1.144) iti makāralopaḥ| atheha kasmādejantas saṃjñā na sambhavati, `eco'yavāyāvaḥ' (6.1.78) iti ? kiñcasyāt ? `cayanaṃ cāyako lavanaṃ lāvakaḥ' ityatrānekāltvādayādayaḥ sarvādeśāḥ syuḥ, naiṣa doṣaḥ; `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' (vyā.pa.106) ityeca eva bhaviṣyanti, na sarvasyatadantasya| atha vā-- asya yogasyaivaṃ vidho viṣaya eva na bhavati, tato nāyamiha pravartate| tathā hi yeneti karaṇe tṛtīyetyuktam, na cākartṛkaṃ karaṇamastīti karttāpyāśritaḥ| sa punariha sambandhiśabdatvādantaśabdenāvayavavācinā sannidhāpitaḥ samudāyo vijñāpyate| prakṛtatvāt svarūpaṃ ca kartā ca tribhiḥ prakāraiḥ sannihito bhavati| kvacinnirdeśāt-- `īdūded‌dvicanam' (1.1.11) iti, atra dvivacanaṃ kartṛbhūtaṃ nirdiṣṭam| tathā hīdādibhiḥ karaṇaiḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñāṃ vidadhāti| kvacit prakaraṇāt--yathā `erac' (3.3.56) iti, atra `dhātoḥ' (3.1.91) ityadhikārād‌dhātuḥ prakaraṇāt karttā sannihitaḥ| sa ikāreṇa karaṇenācaṃ vidadhāti| kvacic sāmarthyāt-- yathā `iko jhal' (1.2.9) iti, atra dhātoreva san vidhīyate, nānyasamāditi sāmarthyāddhātuḥ kartā sannihitaḥ; sa ikā karaṇena sanaḥ kittvaṃ vidadhāti| tadevam, `īdūded‌dvivacam' (1.1.11) ityādau kartṛkaraṇayorubhayorapi vidyamānatvāt so'sya sūtrasya viṣaya iti tatra tadantavidhirbhavati| `eco'yavāyāvaḥ' (6.1.78) ityatra tu na kenacit karttā sannihitaḥ prakāreṇa, na cākartṛkaṃ karaṇaṃ sambhavati;tasmāt kartṛkaraṇayorubhayorapyasannihitatvānanāyamasya sūtrasya viṣaya iti na sambhavati tadantavidhiḥ| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyāyam-- `dvitīyā śrita' 2.1.24) ityādau supā śritādayo viśiṣyante,na śritādibhiḥ sup| viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhiḥ, na viśeṣyeṇa| yasmādayeneti karaṇe tṛtīyā, karaṇaṃ ca paratantraṃ parārthaṃ bhavati, na viśeṣyam, tasmādviśiṣṭaiḥ śritādibhistadantavidhirna bhavati| `naḍādibhyaḥ phak' iti| atrāpi prakṛtena prātipadikena naḍādayo viśiṣyante, na naḍādibhiḥ prātipadikam ato'trāpi nāsti tadantavidhiriti| `ugidvarṇagrahaṇavarjam' iti| ugitā varṇena ca prātipadikaṃ viśiṣyate| viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatyeva| `yasmin vidhiḥ' ityādi| tadantavidhau prāpte tadādividhirucyate| yasminni- ti saptamīnirdiṣṭe tadādividhiṃ darśayati| yatrālgrahaṇe saptamīnirdiṣṭe pūrvasya vidhistatra tadādau veditavyaḥ| alādāvityarthaḥ| yadi tarhi tatrāpi tadantividhiḥ syāt, ihaiva syāt-- śriyāviti,iha tu na syāt-- `śriyaḥ' iti ? tadādividhau tu satīhāpi bhavati, svasya ca rūpasyeti śriyāvityatrāpi bhavatyeva| 73.vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad‌vṛddham| (1.1.73) `yasyeti samudāya ucyate' acāṃ madhye yasyādirvṛddhisaṃjñakastasyaiva śabdarūpasya saṃjñā vidhīyate| tacca niyogataḥ samudāyātmakameveti sāmarthyād yasyeti sāmānyapa-denāpi samudāya evābhidhīyate| saṃjñinirdeśārthaṃ yasyeti vacanam| acāṃ madhya ityādinā vṛddhisaṃjñinaḥ samudāyādekadeśasya nirdhāraṇaṃ darśayannacāmityasya nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhītvaṃ darśayati| ādiśabdastvihopakrame varttate, upakramamyate ityupakramaḥ, prathamata uccārita ityarthaḥ| acāmiti bahuvacananirdeśād yas bahūnāmacāṃ madhye vṛddhisaṃjñaka ādibhūtaḥ, tasyaiva vṛddhasaṃjñayā bhavitavyam; na tu yasya dvayormadhye iti codyamapākartumāha-- `acām' ityādi| yadi tarhyacāmiti nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhīyam, evaṃ sati samānajātīyasyaiva nirdhāraṇaṃ bhavatītyacāṃ madhye vṛddhiko'jeva yathā syādityeṣo'rthaḥ syāt| tathā ca satyākāro yasyādistasya saṃjñā na syādāśvalāyana ityādeḥ, na hyākārasya mukhyamactvamasti; akṣvasanniveśāt| upacaritaṃ tu syāt ; `aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' (1.1.69) ityenenānaco'pi sato'ckāryakaraṇāt| na ca mukye sati gauṇasyāśrayaṇaṃ yuktam, gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasaṃpratyayāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyāpternyāyādākārasyāpi gauṇamactvamāśritya bhaviṣyati,anyathā hyaijgrahaṇameva kuryāt, na vṛddhigrahaṇam| `śālīyaḥ, mālīyaḥ, ityādi| atra vṛddhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `vṛddhācchaḥ' ś(4.2.114) iti ccho bhavati| nanu ca śālāmālāśabdayoḥ kāpaṭuśabdasya ca saṃjñayā na bhavitavyam, na hyeṣāṃ vṛddhisaṃjñaka ādiḥ,kiṃ tarhi ? hal,naitadevam; vidyamāno'pi hyatra hal nāpekṣyate,ajapekṣasyāditvasyāśrayaṇāt| etadeva hyajgrahaṇasya prayojanam| kataṃ nāma tadapekṣa- yāditvaṃ vijñāyeteti ? anyathā tatra kartavyameva syāt| ajgrahaṇe kriyamāṇe satyamartho bhavati| acāṃ madhye yasya yo vṛddhisaṃjñako'jevādibhūta iti| anyebhyo'jbhyo yasya vṛddhisaṃjñakaḥ prāguccāryata iti yāvat| tena śālāśabdāderapi saṃjñā sidhyati| `sābhāsannayanaḥ' iti| atra vṛddhisaṃjñābhāvādaṇeva bhavati, na tu cchaḥ| yadi punarā-digrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tato yasyāpyacāṃ madhye vṛddhisaṃjñakaḥ kaścit sabhāsannayanādesta- syāpyeṣā saṃjñā syāt| atra yadyapi vṛddhiśabdaḥ śrūyate, tathāpi talliṅgakapari- bhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate| yasamād yatra niyatasthānike guṇavṛddhī vidhīyate tatra sthāniniyamārthāsā vyāpriyate| etacca prāgevoktam. na ceha guṇavṛddhyorvidhānam, ato nātra vyāpārastasyāḥ| tena yasyāpyaniyatasthāniko vṛddhisaṃjñaka ādibhūtaḥ, tasyāpi saṃjñā siddhā bhavati| `vā nāmadheyasya' ityādi| ye puruṣairvyavahārāya saṃkīrtyamānāḥ śabdā devadatta ityevamādayaḥ, teṣāmeṣā saṃjñā veditavyā| teṣveva nāmadheyaśabdo rūḍhaḥ,na tu ye jātyādinimittakā gavādiśabdā anādivyavahārāntaḥ pātinasteṣu| nanu ca kāśyādipāṭhāt `kāśyādibhyaḥ' (4.2.116) ṭhañ‌ñiṭhābhyāṃ bhavitavyam, tadayuktaṃ devadattīya iti cchapratyayāntasyodāharaṇam, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yo hi devaidatto devadatta iti kriyānimittako devadattaśabdaḥ, tasyaiva tatra pāṭhaḥ,na saṃjñāśabdasya| tena saṃjñābhūtāddevadatta śabdād yadā vṛddhasaṃjñā tadā cho bhavati,anyathā tvaṇ| `gotrāntāt' ityādi| tathā'samastātta kevalād‌gotrapratyayāntād vṛddhācchapratyayo bhavati tathā samastāda-vṛddhādapi| `ghṛtarauḍhiḥ' iti| `samānādhikaraṇādhikāre śākapārthivādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamuttarapada-lopaśca' (vā.83) iti samāsaḥ| evamuttara rūḍhasyāpatyam, pāṇinasyāpatyam-- `ata iñ' (4.1.95) itīñ| bāhvādiṣu `sambhūyo'mbhasaḥ salopaśca' (ga.sū.66) iti paṭhyate| kāśyapaśabdo bidāditvādañantaḥ| `jaihvākātāḥ, hāritakātāḥ' iti| kātyaśabdo gargādiyañantaḥ| jihvācapalaḥ kātyaḥ, jihvākātyaḥ| haritabhakṣaḥ kātyaḥ haritakātyaḥ, tābhyāmautsargika evāṇ, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148)ityakārasya lopaḥ; `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) iti yakārasya|| 74. tyadādīni ca| (1.1.74) `uttarārtham' iti| uttarasūtre'sya prayojanavattvāt yadyanuvarttate,etada-rthamapi kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `iha na sambadhyate' iti| yadīhāpi sambadhyeta tadāyamarthaḥ syāt-- `tyadādīni yasyācāmādibhūtāni tad‌vaddham' iti| tataśca tvatputra ityādāveva syāt, kevālānāṃ ca tyadādīnāṃ na syādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca tvatputro matputra ityādāvupasarjanāni tyadādīni, upasarjanānāṃ ca teṣāṃ tyadāditvaṃ nivartitam, tat kuto'yaṃ prasaṅgaḥ ? yadi yasyācāmāderityetadiha sambadhyate tadā satyupasarjanatve vacanāt tyadādāveva saṃjñā syāt, na kevalānāmiti manyate; kathaṃ punarihānuvartamānaṃ śakyamasambandhum ? svasambnadhānuvṛtteḥ| `vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad‌vṛddham' (1.1.73) iti tyadādīni ca vṛddhisaṃjñakāni bhavanti| `vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad‌vṛddham' iti tad‌vṛddham, `eṅa prācāṃ deśe' (1.1.75) yasyācāmādigrahaṇamanuvarttate| vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam. evaṃ vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam| evaṃ vṛddhiśabdena sambandhamanuvarttamānaṃ na śakyate tyadādibhiḥ sambandhum| `tvādāyaniḥ, mādāyaniḥ' iti| `udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt' (4.1.157) iti phiñ‌, `pratyayottarapadayośca' (7.2.97) iti yuṣmadasmadostvāmādeśau| cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena `vā nāmadheyasya' (vā.15) ityādi vaktavyaṃ na bhavati|| 75. eṅ prācāṃ deśe| (1.1.75) `prācāṃ deśābhidhāne' iti| prācāṃ sambandhī yo deśastadabhidhāna ityarthaḥ| etena prācāmiti deśaviśeṣaṇaṃ na vikalpārthamiti darśayati| prācāṃ matenetyasyāvivakṣitatvādityākhyātaṃ bhavati| `eṇīpacanīyaḥ' ityādi| eṇīpacana ityādibhyacchaḥ| `āhicchatraḥ' iti, `kānyakubjaḥ' iti ahicchatrakānyakubjaśabdābhyāmaṇeva bhavati| `devadattaḥ' iti| vṛddhā-dhikāre vihito `vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca' (4.2.117) iti ṭhañ‌ñiṭhau na bhavataḥ, kāśyapādi- pāṭhādapi tau na bhavataḥ; kriyānimittako hi devadattaśabdastatra paṭhyate saṃjñāśabdasya cedaṃ pratyudāharaṇam| etacca yadā `vā nāmadheyasya' (vā. 15) iti vṛddhasaṃjñā nāsti; tadā veditavyam| `gaumatāḥ'iti| atra sarvamasti na tu deśābhidhānam| tathā hi gomatī nadī pragdeśe, na deśaḥ| na hi nadī deśagrahaṇena gṛhyate;`nadīdeśo'grāmāḥ' (2.4.7) ityatra nadyāḥ pṛthaggrahaṇāt| `eṅ prācāṃ deśe' iti| `udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt' (4.1.157) ityevamādiṣu prāgudañcau śrūyete, tayośca vibhāgo na vijñāyate| atastatparijñānāyāha-- ` prāgudañcau' ityādi| śarāvatī nāma nadī , tasyāḥ pūrveṇa vyavasthito deśaḥ prāgdeśaḥ, uttareṇa udagdeśaḥ| tau śarāvatī vibhajate - vibhāgena vyavasthāpayati tasyāṃ hi maryādāyāṃ satyāṃ tayorvibhāgaḥ parijñāyate| kimarthaṃ vibhajate ? `viduṣāṃ śabdasiddhyartham' iti| paṇ‍ḍitānāṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ śabdavyutpattyartham| kataṃ vibhajate ? `haṃsaḥ kṣīrodakaṃ yathā'| kṣīrodakamiti `jātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) ityekavadbhāvaḥ| kvacit kṣīrodake iti pāṭhaḥ| saḥ `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati' (vyā.pa.91) iti veditavyaḥ| yathā haṃsaḥ kṣīramudakaṃ ca miśrībhāvamupagataṃ pṛthagasaṅkareṇa vyavasthāpayati, tathā śarāvatī prāgudañcau| yat-tadornityābhisambandāt seti vacanādanuktamapi yetyetallabhyate| yā vibhajate sā no'smān pātu rakṣatu| prasiddhastu pāṭho yatra śloke prāgudīcāviti, tatrā'caḥ `uda īt' (6.4.139) iti bhasaṃjñakasyocyamānaḥ kathamīkāraḥ ? kathaṃ ca `ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'dhātoḥ' (7.1.70) iti numa na bhavatīti cintyam| atra varṇayanti-- `acpratyanvavapūrvāt sāmalomnaḥ' (5.4.75) ityatrājitiyogavibhāgenācpratyayaḥ kṛtaḥ, tenātrāci parato bhasaṃjñāmītvaṃ bhavati| num na bhavati; acā sarvanāmasthānasya vyavahitatvāditi| anaye tu prāgudīcamiti samāhāre kurvanti| teṣāṃ `dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt samāhāre' (5.4.106) iti ṭaci samāsānte kṛte pūrvavadīkāro numabhāvaśca bhavati| kvacittu prāgudīca iti pāṭaḥ| tatrāvayavadeśāpekṣayā bahutvavivakṣāyāṃ bahuvacanam| prāgdeśānudagdeśāśca vibhajata ityarthaḥ| śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhapādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ prathamādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ <1.2> atha prathamādhyayasya dvitīya pādaḥ 1.gāṅkuṭādibhyo'ñṇinṅit| (1.2.1) atra pakṣatrayaṃ sambhāvyate-- itsaṃjñako vā ṅakāro'nena bhāvyate, gāṅakuṭādibhyaḥ pare ye'ñṇitaḥ pratyayāste ṅito bhavanti, itsaṃjñako ṅakāra eṣāṃ sambandhī bhavatīti yāvat; evaṃ hi te ṅito bhavanti yadi hi teṣāṃ ṅakāro'nubandho vidhīyate, nānyathā; na hi vinā citragavībhirdevadattaścitragurbhavati| ṅiditīyaṃ vā saṃjñā'nena kriyate, gāṅakuṭādibhyaḥ pare ye'ñṇitaḥ pratyayāste ṅito bhavanti, ṅitsaṃjñakā bhavantīti yāvat| atideśo'yaṃ vā syāt, gāṅakuṭādibhyaḥ pare ye'ñṇitaḥ pratyayāste ṅito bhavanti, ṅidvad‌bhavantītyarthaḥ| tatrādye pakṣe `gāṅakuṭādibhyaḥ' ityanayā pañcamyā'ñṇidityasyāḥ prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parikalpitāyāṃ satyām| `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti vacanādāderalaḥ sthāna ādeśa eva ṅakāraḥ prāpnoti| dvitīye tu pakṣe `aniditāṃ hala upadhāyaḥ kṅiti ' (76.4.24) ityatra saṃjñinaḥ saṃpratyayo na syāt; śabdabhedāt| anyohi ṅicchabdaḥ, anyo hi kṅiśabdaḥ| kiñca, `ṅid‌grahaṇe grahyādau' (6.1.16) sūtra eṣāmeva saṃjñināṃ grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, na yaṅādīnām `kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasaṃpratyayaḥ' (vyā.pa.6) iti vacanāt| athāpi kathañcidete doṣāḥ parihartuṃ śakyeran, ādyayoḥ pakṣayoryastu tatparihāradvāreṇa pravṛttau sādhyāyāṃ pratipattigauravadoṣa āpadyate so'parihārya eva| tṛtīye tu pakṣe na kaścid doṣa iti matvā tamevāśrityāha-- `atideśo'yam'iti| yadyevam, vatinā nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ, anyathā tadartho nāvagamyeta; naitadevam, parapadārtheṣuhi prayujyamānāḥ śabdāvatimantareṇāpi vatyartha gamayanti, yathā-- siṃho māṇavakaḥ,gaurvāhīkaḥ| gāṅitīṅādeśo gṛhyate-- `iṅaśca' (2.4.48), `gāṅa liṭi' (2.4.49), vibhāṣā luṅa lṛṅo' (2.4.50) iti| gāṅādeśo ya iṅaḥ sthāne vakṣyate tasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na `gāṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.950) ityasya| atha `gāṅa gatau' (dhā.pa.950) ityasya dhātorgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha--`ṅakārasya' ityādi|iṅādeśasya yo ṅakārastasyedaṃ prayojanam--iha sūtre tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yathā syānnānyat kiñcidātnepadārtha syāditi cet ? na; ātmanepadasya sthānamivadbhāvenaiva siddhatvāt| tasmādiṅādeśa eva gṛhyate; anyathā ṅakārasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| nanu cobhayorapi sāmānyagrahaṇārtho ṅakāraḥ syāt, tat kuto vaiyarthyam?naitadasta; yadi hi tau samānau syātāṃ tadā sāmānyagrahaṇārthatā tasya, na ca tau samānau; gatyarthasya gāṅo ṅakārasyātmanepadavidhau cirārthatvāt. itarasya tu na kviccaritārthatā| tasmādasamānārthatvādayuktaṃ sāmānyagrahaṇamiti gāṅādeśa gṛhyate| kimarthaṃ punariha uccāryate, na gā ityevocyeta ? caivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi sati niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti `kai gai śabde' (dhā.pā. 916-917) ityasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt| kuṭādayo hi `kuṭa kauṭilye' (dhā.pā.1366) ityata ārabhya `kuṅa śabde' (dhā.pā.1401) iti yāvaditi| tadanantaraṃ vṛtkaraṇāt tato'dhikānāṃ kuṭāditvānupapatteḥ| `adhyagīṣṭa' iti| sico ṅittve ghumāsthāgādi (6.4.66) sūtreṇettvam| atra hi `dīṅo yuḍaci kṅiti' (6.4.65) ityataḥ kṅitītyanuvarttate, `īd yati' (6.4.5) ityata īditi ca| `adhyagīṣata' iti| `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityadādeśaḥ| atha liṭi yo gāṅādeśastasya kasmādudāharaṇaṃ na pradarśitam ? evaṃ manyate-- luṅa evāyam, nāsāviha liḍ‌grahaṇaṃ prayojayati; `aṃsayogālliṭ kit' (1.2.5) iti vakṣyamāṇenaiva siddhatvāt| `utkuṭitā' iti| `kuṭa kauṭilye' (dhā.pā.1366)| `utpuṭitā' iti| `puṭa saṃśleṣaṇe'(dhā.pā.1367)| athehoccukuṭitaṣatīti sano ṅittvādātmanepadaṃ kasmānna bhavati? upadeśādhikārāt| tatra hi `upadeśe'janunāsikaḥ' (1.3.2) ityata upadeśagrahaṇamanuvarttate| na cātraupadeśikaṃ ṅittvam, kiṃ tarhi? ātideśikam| `vyaceḥ' ityādi| `vyaca vyājīkaraṇe'(dhā.pā.1293) iti tudādau kuṭādibhyaḥ prāk paṭhyate| `vicitā' iti| ṅittvādiha grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.6) saṃprāsaraṇam| `uruvyacāḥ' iti| `sarvadhātubhyo'sun' (da.u.9.49) ityasunpratyayaḥ| `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| 2.vija iṭ| (1.2.2) `iḍādipratyayaḥ' iti| iṭa ādiryasya tṛjādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ|athottmapuruṣasyaikavacanasyeṭo grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati, `sārvadhātukamapit' (1.2.4) ityanenaiva tasya kittvasya siddhatvāt ?naitadasti,yatra hi tena na siddhyati tatrottamapuruṣasyaikakavacanasya ṅittvavidhānārthamiḍ‌grahaṇaṃ syāt| kva ca tena na siddhyati ? ārdhudhātuka āśiṣi liṅi-- `udvijiṣīya' ityatra| ato yuktaṃ cottamapuruṣasyaikavacanasya grahaṇam nāgamasya;`arthavad‌grahaṇe nānarthakasya' (vyā.pa.9), `pratyayāpratyayayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.72) iti paribhāṣādvayāt| athāpi kathañcidāgamasyeṭo grahaṇaṃ syāt ? evamapi tanmātrasyaiva ṅittvaṃ labhyate, na tu tadādeḥ pratyayasya, tatkimityāha-- `iḍādipratyayo ṅidbhavati ' iti ? evaṃ manyate-- `vaddhiryasyācāmādiḥ' (1.1.73) ityata ādigrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena ceḍ viśiṣyate| na cottamapuruṣasyaikavacanasyāditvamasti, kiṃ tarhi ? āgamasyaiva; tasmāt sa eva gṛhyate| tasya ca kevalasyādibhūtasya ṅitve prayojanaṃ nāstīti sāmarthyādiḍādeḥ pratyayasya ṅittvaṃ vijñāyata iti| `udvijitā' iti| ṅittvāt `pugantalaghupadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇo na bhavati| 3.vibhāṣorṇoḥ| (1.2.3) `prorṇuvitā' iti| ṅitvād guṇe pratiṣiddhe `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinovaṅādeśaḥ|| 4.sārvadhātukamapit| (1.2.4) `apit' iti| kimayaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ ? uta paryudāsaḥ ? kiñcātra ? pūrvasmin pakṣe loḍuttamapuruṣasyaikavacanasya `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) ityāṭi piti kṛte tudānītyatrāḍ‌vikaraṇākārayoḥ pidapitorekādeśaḥ paraṃ prati `antādivacca' (6.1.85) ityādidbhāvāt pidgrahaṇena gṛhyate iti pittvam , pittve ca satyapiditi ṅittvapratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tataśca dhātorguṇaḥ prasajyeta| itaratra tu pakṣe `cyavante, plavante' ityatra śabantādeśākārayoḥ pidapitorya ekādeśastasya pito'nyatvāt ṅittvamapādyeta, tataśca dhātorguṇo na prāpnoti? pito'nyatvaṃ tvekādeśasya sarvaṃ pratyādivattvāt paragrahaṇena grahaṇāt, ucyate,yathecchasi tathaivāstu, ubhayathāpyadoṣaḥ| pūrvatra tāvadadoṣaḥ; yasmādapitoreva tudānītyatraikādeśaḥ, na pidapitoḥ| tathā hi-- `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) loḍuttamapuruṣasyaiva pittvaṃ vidhīyate, na tvāṭaḥ| itaratrāpyadoṣaḥ, yasmādapidityanena sārvadhātukaṃ viśiṣyate-- pito'nyat sārvadhātukamapiditi| na cāntaśabdākāraḥ sārvadhātukam, kiṃ tarhi ? tadekadeśaḥ| yaccātra sārvadhātukaṃ na ca tena sahaikādeśaḥ, yena sahaikādeśo na ca tatsārvadhātukam;tena yadyapyayamekādeśaḥ pito'nyaḥ; tathāpi sārvadhātukaṃ na bhavatīti tatkuto ṅittvasya prasaṅgaḥ ? atha vā bhavatu ṅittavam, satyapi tasya ṅittve tasmin nāsti guṇābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ ? yasmāt `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' (vyā.pa.39) iti vacanādeśāddhi prāgeva `cyavante, plavante' ityatra guṇena bhavitavyam| `kurutaḥ' iti| tato ṅittve sati vikaraṇasya guṇo na bhavati| karoterasya `ata ut sārvadhātuke' (6.4.130) ityuttvaṃ bhavati| tatra hi `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādisūtrāt kṅitītyanuvartate|| 5.asaṃyogālliṭ kit| (1.2.5) dhātoreva liḍ vidhīyate, nānyasmāditi liṭā sāmarthyāddhātuḥ sannidhāpitaḥ; sa cāsaṃyogagrahaṇena viśiṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha-- `asaṃyogāntāddhātoḥ' iti| yadi tarhyasaṃyogāntāddhātoḥ parasya liṭaḥ kittvaṃ vidhīyate; tadā `vavṛte, vavṛdhe' iti na sidhyati, paratvād guṇena bhavitavyam| kittvasyāvakāśaḥ -- `ījaturījuḥ' iti, guṇasyāvakāśaḥ-- `varttitvā, vardhitvā iti; `vavṛte,vavṛdhe' ityādāvubhayaprāptau paratvād guṇa eva syāt, naitadasti; iṣṭavācitvātparaśabdasya, kittvameveṣṭam, kitvameva param, atastadeva bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| atra ca yadi `asaṃyogāt' iti paryudāsa āśrīyate, tadā saṃyogādanyasmin gṛhyamāṇe nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) sadṛśasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt-- saṃyogasya sadṛśo yo'nyo'sahāyo hal iti halantādeva kittvaṃ bhaviṣyati, nājantāt,tataḥ `cakraścakruḥ' iti na sidhyati| tasmāt prasajyapratiṣedho'yam, na paryudāsaḥ-- na cet saṃyogāt yajādīnāṃ kiti' (6.1.15) iti kiti vidhīyate, na ṅiti| `bibhidatuḥ, bibhiduḥ' iti| kittvāt `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.2.86) iti guṇābhāvaḥ| `sastraṃse, dadhvaṃse' iti| kittvābhāvāt `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityaranunāsikallopo na bhavati| `stransu dhvansu adhaḥ patane' (dhā.pā. 754-755), anudāttetvādātmanepadam, `liṭastajhayoreśirec' (3.4.81) ityeśādeśaḥ| `bibheditha' iti| sip,thal, krādiniyamādiṭ| 6. indhibhavatibhyāṃ ca| (1.2.6) `samīghe' iti| `ñiindhī dīptau', (dhā.pā. 1448) pūrvavadātmanepadam, eśādeśaḥ, kittvāt `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ, dvirvacanam, akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ ca (6.1.101)| atha `ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ' (3.1.36) ityām kasmānna bhavati ? mantraviṣayatvādasya; tatra ca `amantre' ityadhikārāta| evaṃ tarhi mantraśchanda eveti `cchandasyubhayathā' (3.4.117) iti sārvadhātukatvam, tataśca sārvadhākumapit' (1.2.4) iti ṅittvam, ata eva ṅittvādanunāsikalopo bhaviṣyatīti tat kimarthamindheḥparasya liṭaṛ kittvaṃ vidhīyate ? jñāpanārtham| etadanena jñāpyate- anityo'yamāmiti| nitye hyāmi tena vyavadhānādevendheḥ paro liṇna sambhavatīti kittvavidhānaṃ nopapadyate; tasmādanityo'yamāmiti| tena bhāṣāyāmapi `samīdhe' iti prayoga upapanno bhavati| `babhūva, babhūvitha' iti| kittvād yathākramaṃ vṛddhiguṇau na bhavataḥ|`bhuvo vug luṅaliṭoḥ' (6.4.88) iti vuk| `bhavateraḥ' (7.4.73) ityabhyāsasyāttvam| nanu ca kṛtayorapi guṇavṛddhyorvukā bhavitavyam, akṛtayorapīti nityo vuk; kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt, tatra nityatvād vuki kṛte guṇavaddhayoḥ prāptireva nāsti, bhavateralaghūpadhatvāt, anajantatvācceti bhavatigrahaṇamanarthakam ? naitadasti; `śabdāntarasya prāpnuvan vidhiranityo bhavati' (vyā.pa.100) iti vugapyanityaḥ| tataśca paratvāt guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayorvaṅa na syāt| tasmād bhavatigrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| atha kṛtayorapi guṇavṛddhyorekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavatīti nāsti śabdāntaratvam ? evaṃ sati śakyaṃ bhavatigrahaṇamakartum| tat kriyate vispaṣṭārtham| atha `babhūva' ityatra `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.15) iti vṛddheḥ kathaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, yāvateka ityanuvarttate ? kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) ityaneneglakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ pratiṣidhyate, na ceyamiglakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ, nirdiṣṭasthānikatvāt| atra kittvavidhānasāmarthyādaniglakṣa ṇā api vṛddherbhaviṣyati pratiṣedhaḥ; anyathā kittvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāditi cet, na; tasya thalyuttamaṇali ca guṇupratiṣedhārthatvāt| evaṃ tarhi ṅidgrahaṇamapyanuvarttate, tadanuvarttamāne na vidyamānamanyat prayojanam, tenāniglakṣaṇāyā api vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| `indheḥ saṃyogārthaṃ (grahaṇam-- kāśikā) vacanam' iti| tasya saṃyogāntatvāt pūrveṇāsiddheḥ| `bhavateḥ pidartham' iti| nāpidartham; tasyāsaṃyogāntatvādapiditi pūrveṇa siddheḥ| bhavateriha śtipā nirdeśo yaṅalug‌nivṛttyarthaḥ-- yaṅalugantalliṭaḥ kittvaṃ mā bhūditi| `bobhāva' iti| tathā coktam-- śtipā śapānubandhena nirdiṣṭaṃ yad gaṇena ca| yatraikājgrahaṇaṃ kiñcit pañcaitāni na yaṅaluki|| (pu.pa.94) iti| `anthigranthi' ityādi| `śrantha grantha sandarbhe' (dhā.pā.1512,1513), `dambha,dmbhe' (dhā.pā. 1290) `ṣvanja pariṣvaṅge' (dhā.pā.973) eṣāmapi śranthigranthiprabhṛtīnāṃ liṭaḥ kittvaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ kriyate, tena śranthiprabhṛtīnāmapi saṃyogāntānāṃ li ṭaḥ kittvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| `śrethatuḥ' ityādi| kittvāt `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ | `tṝphalabhajatrapaśca' (6.4.122) iti cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādanekahalmadhyasyāpyetvābhyāsalopau| `pariṣasvaje' iti| anudāttettvādātmanepadam| pūrvasya sakārasya `sthādiṣvabhyāsena cābhyāsasya' (8.3.64) iti varttamāne, `upasargāt sunoti' (8.2.65) ityādinā ṣatvam| parasya tu sakārasya `sadisvañjayoḥ parasya liṭi' (8.3.118) iti ṣatvapratiṣedhaḥ| 7.mṛḍamṛdagudhakuṣakliśavadavasaḥ ktvā| la(1.2.7) `muḍa sukhane', (dhā.pā.1516) `mṛda kṣode' (dhā.pā.1515) , `gudha roṣe ' (dhā.pā.1517) , `kuṣa niṣkarṣe' (dhā.pā.1518) `kliśū vibādhane' (dhā.pā.1522), `vada vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā. 1009), `vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1942)| `na ktvā seṭ iti kittvapratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyati' iti| nanvedatadeva niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti-- mṛḍādibhya eva seṭ ktvā kid bhavati, nānyebhya iti, tataśca siddhaṃ devitvā, sevitvetyādi, tat kimarthaṃ `na ktvā seṭ'(1.2.18) iti pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyatira ? vispaṣṭārtham; anyathā hi kecidviparītaniyamaṃ sambhāvayeyuḥ-- mṛḍādibhyaḥ ktvāpratyaya eva kid bhavati, nānya iti| `purastādapakarṣaḥ' ityādi| apakarṣa ityapavāda ityarthaḥ| `kliśitvā' iti| `kliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ' (7.2.50) itīṭ| `uditvā'iti, `uṣitvā' iti| vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) saṃprasāraṇam| vasateḥ `śāsivasidhasīnāñca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam, `vasatikṣudhoḥ' (7.2.52) itīṭ| 8.rudavidamuṣagrahisvapipracchaḥ saṃśca| (1.2.8) `rudir aśruvimocane' (dhā.pā.1067), `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064), `muṣa steye' (dhā.pā.1530), `graha upādāne' (dhā.pā.1533), `ñiṣvap śaye (dhā.pā. 1068) `praccha jñīpsāyām' (dhā.pā.1413)| `grahervidhyarthameva' iti| `na ktvā seṭa' (1.2.18) iti pratiṣiddhasya kittvasya punarvidhiryathā syāt| `svapirvidhyarthameva' ityādi| `sannartham' iti| atha ktvārthaṃ vacanaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `kideva hi ktvā' svapipracchayorhi `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt' (7.2.10) itīṭpratiṣedhāt ktvā seḍ na bhavatītyataḥ `na ktvā seṭ' (1.2.18) iti niṣedho na pravarttate| tena kideva hi ktveti| `ruditvā' iti| `samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle' (3.4.21) iti ktvā| `gṛhītvā' iti| `graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ' (7.2.37) grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) saṃprāsaraṇam| `jighṛkṣati' iti| `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti tatvam, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam; `ekāco baso bhaṣ' (8.2.37) ityādinā gakārasya ghakāraḥ, `sani grahaguhośca' (7.2.12) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `suṣupsati' iti| vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) saṃprasāraṇam| `pipṛcchiṣati' iti| atrāpi grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) saṃprasāraṇam; `che ca' (6.1.73) iti tuk, `stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti ścutvam|| 9.iko jhal| (1.2.9) `ktveti nivṛttam' iti| jhalādeḥ ktvāpratyayasyaupadeśikaṃ kittvamastyeveti tadanuvṛtterapārthakatvāt| san‌grahaṇantu prathamāntamihānuvarttate, tasya jhalityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapannam| ataḥ sāmarthyāt tadādividhirvijñāyata ityata āha-- `jhalādiḥ san kidbhavati' iti| atha tadantavidhiḥ kasmānna bhavati-- jhalantaḥ sanniti ? evaṃ manyate-- vṛddhasaṃjñā (1.1.73) sūtrādihādigrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena jhal viśiṣyate; tasmāt tadādividhireva vijñāyite, na tadantavidhiriti| yadi punastadantavidhiḥ syāt tadā kiṃ syāt ? yatrāto lope kṛte jhalantatvaṃ sanastatraiva syāt-- cikīrṣitetyādau; cikīrṣatītyādau tadu na syāt, adantatvāt| adantatvantu sañśabakārayordvayorekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvāt|4 atheka iti `ik smaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1047) ityasya dhātorgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? jhaliti pratyāhārasyaiva yuktatvāt; kiñca-- gargādiṣu jigīṣuśabdapāṭhācca| dhātugrahaṇe hi sati jayateḥ parasya sanaḥ kittvaṃ na syāt, tathā ca jigīṣuśabdo na siddhyet| kiñca-- dhātugrahaṇe hi satīko dhātoḥ samīpagato hal na sambhavatīti `halantācca' (1.2.10) ityedapyaghaṭamānaṃ syāt| tasmāt pratyāhārasyaiva grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam, na dhātoḥ| `cicīṣati' iti| `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ| `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityādinā pūrvokteneṭpratiṣedhaḥ| uttaratrāpi yatreṭaḥ śravaṇaṃ nāsti, tatrāpyanenaiva pratiṣedho veditavyaḥ| yatra tu viśeṣo'sti, tatrāsau vaktavya eva| `tuṣṭūṣati'iti| `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' (7.4.61) iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ| `śiśayiṣate' iti| `pūrvavat sanaḥ ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam| evamuttaratrāpīcchāsannantādātmanepadamanenaiva boddhavyam| `kimartha punaḥ' ityādi| atra vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ| `guṇo mā bhūt' iti| yadarthamidamucyate tadāha| yenābhiprāyeṇa pṛṣṭavāṃstamāviṣkartumāha-- `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' ityādi| yadi dīrghatve kṛte'pi guṇaḥ syāt tadā dīrghatvasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| tasmānmā bhūtasya vaiyarthyamiti dīrghatvaṃ tad‌guṇasya bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| atra doṣamāpādayitumāha-- `yathaiva tarhi' ityādi| asati kittve'navakāśaṃ dīrghatvaṃ yatā guṇasya bādhakaṃ bhavati, tathā-- `tasmāt' ityādi| yata evamanārabhyamāṇa etasminneṣa doṣo'nuṣajyeta, tasmāddīrghatvasyāvakāśadānāya kittvamidamārabhyate| athārabhyamāṇe'pyetasmin kasmādeṣa doṣo na bhavatītyata āha--`cicīṣati' ityādi| kittve sati tenaiva guṇasya bādhitatvāt| cicīṣati, tuṣṭūṣatītyādiṣu sāvakāśaṃ dīrghatvaṃ bhavati; tena ca paratvāṇṇilopo na bādhyate| na hi kittve sati śakyamevaṃ vaktam-- yathā dīrghatvaṃ guṇaṃ bādhate, tathā ṇilopamapīti; yasmānna guṇo dīrghatvena bādhyate,kiṃ tarhi ? kittvena| atra dīrghatvasyāvakāśo darśitaḥ ṇilopasya tveṣovakāśaḥ- pācayateḥ pāktiḥ, yājayateryāṣṭirityādi; jñīpsatītyatrobhayaprāptau dīrghatvaṃ bādhitvā paratvāt ṇilopa eva bhavati| `jñā avabodhane' (dhā.pā.1507), `māraṇatoṣaṇamaniśāmaneṣu' (dhā.pā.811), `micca' (dhā.pā.1624)iti curādipāṭhāṇṇic| `arttihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk| `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvatvam| anye tu-- `jñapa māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu' (dhā.pā.1624) iti paṭhanti, tato ṇic, tata icchāsan, `sanīvantarddha' (7.2.49) ityādinā pakṣe iḍabhāvaḥ, ka`āpjñapṛdhāmīt' (7.4.55) itītvam, `atra lopo'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityabhyāsalopaḥ| ta`ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopaḥ| `ikaḥ kittvam' ityādi| atha kimarthamika uttarasya sanaḥ kittvaṃ vidhīyate, kimarthamiko jhaliti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, nanvekamevedaṃ sūtraṃ paṭhitavyam, `iko jhal halantācca' iti ? prayojanamāha-- `guṇo mā bhūt' iti| cicīṣatītyādau `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti guṇaḥ prāpnoti, sa mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kittvaṃ vidhīyate| naitadasti prayojanam; yasmāt `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti nāprāpte guṇe dīrghatvamārabhyate, ato dīrghārambhād guṇo na bhaviṣyatīti; anyathā hi dīrghagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| nanu ca cukūṣate ityatra dīrghavacanasya sārthakatvam, atra hi gāṅakuṭādisūtreṇa (1.2.1) ṅittve sati guṇo na pravarttate, naitadasti; na hyekamudāharaṇaṃ prati yogārambhaṃ prayojayati| yadi hyetat prayojanamabhimataṃ syāt, ṇigrahaṇameva kuryāt| samudāyāmātrādapekṣayā vā `purastādapadādāḥ' ityādikā paribhāṣā nāstyeveti| 10. halantācca| (1.2.10) ika ityanuvarttate| atra yadi cāntaśabdo'vayavavācī syādiko halā saha sambandhona syāt, na hīko halavayavaḥ sambhavati| yo hi yenārabhyate, apṛthag‌deśabhūtaḥ sa tasyāvayavo bhavati; yathā-- paṭasya tantava iti| na ca halegārabhyate, tasmānnāyamantaśabdo'vayavavācī; api tu samīpavacano yukta iti matvā''ha-- `samīpavacano''yamantaśabdaḥ' iti| nanu ca dhāturatra sāmarthyādākṣiptaḥ, atsatadapekṣayā halo'vayavatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; evaṃ tarhyantaśabdo'tiricyeta, `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.720 ityanenaiva tadantavidherlabdhatvāt| hal cāsāvantaśceti vigrahaviśeṣeṇa karmadhārayatvaṃ darśayati| kasya punarasāvantaḥ ? prakṛtasyekaḥ| yadyevam, sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavatītikamapekṣamāṇasyāntaśabdasya samāso nopapadyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; antaśabdo hyatra pradhānaḥ| bhavati ca pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsa iti dvitīye'dhyāye jñāpayiṣyati `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge' (2.1.56) ityatra sāmānyāprayogagrahaṇena| `igantāt'iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam| nanu ceka iti pañcamyantaṃ prakṛtam, tat kathaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi pañcamyantaṃ prakṛtam, tathāpīha samīpasamīpisambandhe sati vibhaktivipariṇāmena ṣaṣṭhyantatāmanubhavati-- `ikaḥ samīpagatāt' iti| ikaḥ samīpavartina iti| `bubhutsate' iti| `budha avagamane' (dhā.pā.1172), `ekāco baśo bhaṣ' (8.2.37) ityādinā bhaṣbhāvaḥ| evamuttaratrāpi yatra bhaṣbhāvastatrānenaiva boddhavyaḥ| `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam - dhakārasya takāraḥ| `yiyakṣate' iti| yajervraścādinā (6.1.15) ityādinā saṃprasāraṇaṃ na bhavati| yadi samīpavacano'mantaśabdastadā dambheḥ parasya sanaḥ kittvaṃ na sidhyati| tathā hi-- tasya ya ikaḥ samīpa gato hal na tasmāt paraḥ san, yasmāt paraḥ san nāsāvikaḥ samīpagata ityata āha-- `dambheḥ' ityādi| halityanena haljātirucyate, na tu vyaktiḥ| tena yadā `tā eva vyaktayastyaktabhedā jātiḥ' iti darśanam; tadā tāsāṃ vyaktīnāṃ haltvenāśritānāṃ nāsti vyavadhānam| ato yaiva haljātirikaḥ samīpavartinī tata eva paraḥ sanniti dambhervihitasya sanaḥ kittvaṃ siddhameva| yadāpyarthāntarabhūtā jātirvyaktiṣu pratyekaṃ parisamāptā niravayavaikā, tadāpi nāsti vyavadhānam; yasmādvyaktirvyaktyantarasya vyavadhāyikā bhavati, na tu jāteḥ; tasyā aśarīriṇītvāt| tasmādihāpi darśane yaiva haljātirikaḥ samīpagatā tata eva paraḥ sanniti dambheḥ parasya sanaḥ kittvaṃ bhavati| tasyāstu vyaktivyatiriktāyā jāteryadikamapekṣya samīpavartinītvam, yacca tajjātimapekṣamāṇasya sanaḥ paratvam-- tadubhayaṃ vyaktidvārakaṃ veditavyam| tatra nakāravyaktirikaḥ samīpagateti tadādhārā haljātirapīkaḥ samīpagateti bhakārasya vyakteḥ paraḥ sanniti tadādhārabhūtāyā jāterapi paraḥ san, na tu jātervyaktinirapekṣaṃ samīpavartinītvaṃ sambhavati| nāpi jātyapekṣaṃ sanaḥ paratvam; tadubhayaṃ vyaktidvārakaṃ veditavyam| tatra nakāravyaktirikaḥ samīpagateti tadādhārā haljātipīkaḥ samapīgateti bhakārasya vyakteḥ paraḥ sanniti tadādhārabhūtāyā jāterapi paraḥ sana, na tu jātervyaktinirapekṣaṃ samīpavartinītvaṃ sambhavati nāpi jātyapekṣaṃ sanaḥ paratvam; jāteraśarīriṇītvāt| yadi tarhi vyaktidvārakametadubhayam ? evaṃ tarhi viparyayo'pi vyaktidvārakaḥ syāt| bhakāravyaktirikaḥ samīpagatā na bhavatīti jātirapi na syāt; nakāravyakteḥ paraḥ san na bhavatīti jāterapi na syāt, tataśca halgrahamasya satyapi jātivācakatve dambheḥ parasya sanaḥ kittvaṃ na sidhyatyeva ? naitadasti; yadyapi jātervyaktidvārakamikaḥ samīpavartinītvaṃ tadviparyayaśca, sano'pi yadyapi vyaktidvārakaṃ jātyapekṣaṃ paratvaṃ tadviparyayaśca; tathāpi yadatra haltvasāmānyasyekaḥ samīpagatatvaṃ yadapekṣañca sanaḥ paratvaṃ tadāśrayaṃ kittvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti viparyayastu vidyamāno'pi nāpekṣyata eva, lakṣyānurodhāt| nanu ca haltvaṃ nāma jātirnāsatyeva, tathā hi-- haliti saṃjñāśabdaḥ saṃṅketavaśādeva pravartate ḍitthādiśabdavat| na hi yathā gavādiṣu gotvādikaṃ nāma sāmānyamabhinnamasti, tathā hakārādiṣu varṇeṣu haltvaṃ nāma sāmānyamabhinnamastīti śakyamabhyupagantum; tannabandhanasyābhāvāt| tataścāyuktamuktam-- dambherhalgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvātta siddhamiti, naitadasti; jātipadārthavādināṃ mate ye'pi tāvadekavastvabhidhāyinaḥ saṃjñāśabdā devadattādayastadarthānāmapyavasthābhede parikalpitānānātvena jātirabhyupagamyate, kiṃ punarhalityevamādīnāmanekavarṇaviṣayāṇāṃ saṃjñāśabdānāma !anyathā hyativyāpinī śabdārthasya vyavasthā syāt| idañca tāvadbhavān praṣṭavyaḥ-- gavādiṣu jāterastitvasya kiṃ nibandhanaṃ yenāsau tatrābhyupagamyata iti ? bhinneṣvabhinnābhidhānapratyayāviti cet, etāvitaratrāpi samānau|yathaiva hi gavādiṣu bhinneṣvapi prāk sahketāduttarakālamanuyāyinau tau bhavataḥ, tathā hakārādiṣvapi | prāk saṅketādyathā teṣu tau na bhavatastathā gavādiṣvapi| tasmād yau bhinneṣvabhinnābhidhanāpratyayau jātisadbhāvasampratyayahetubhūtau halṣvapi sta iti tatrāpi haltvaṃ nāma jātirabhyupeyā, na tu gavādiṣveva gotvādikamastītyekānta eva| `dhipsati, dhīpsati' iti| `sanīvantardha' (7.2.49) ityādinā yatra pakṣa iṇ nāsti tatredamudāharaṇam| `dambha icca' (7.4.56) itīttvam, īttvañca, `atra lopo'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityabhyāsalopaḥ| `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartam - bhakārasya pakāraḥ| kittve sati `aniditām' (6.4.24) iti na lopaḥ| dakārasya bhaṣbhāvena dhakāraḥ|| 11. liṅsicāvātmanepadeṣu| (1.2.11) `liṅasicāvātmanepadeṣu parataḥ'iti| kathaṃ punarliṅātmanepadeṣu parato bhavati, yāvatā sica evātmanepadeṣu paratvaṃ sambhavati, na liṅaḥ ? evaṃ manyate-- liṅekadeśe'tra sīyuṭi liṅaśabdo vartate, yathā-- `na dhātulopa ārdhadhātuke' (1.1.4) ityatra dhātvekadeśe dhātuśabdo vartate| tasmāt sīyuṭa evānena prakāreṇa kittvaṃ vidhīyate| atha vā-- yathā halṅyādisūtre (6.1.68) yayoreva dīrghatvaṃ sambhavati tayoreva ṅyāpo dīrghādityetadviśeṣaṇam, tathehāpi yasmādātmanepadaṃ paraṃ sambhavati sicaḥ, tasyaivaitadviśeṣaṇam| ātmanepadagrahaṇaṃ bhavati parasmaipadavyavacchedārtham| `bhistīṣṭa'iti| `āśiṣi liṅaloṭau' (3.3.173) iti liṅ; svaritatvādātmanepadam| evamuttaratrāpi svaritañitaḥ kartrayātmanepadamanenaiva vetitavyam| `suṭa tithoḥ' (3.4.107) iti suṭ| kartari śnam, `liṅa salopo'nantyasya' (7.2.79) iti ca na bhavati, `liṅāśiṣi' (3.4.116) ityārdhadhātukatvāt, tayośca sārvadhātuke vidhānāt| `bhutsīṣṭa' iti| budheḥ `anudāttaṅitaḥ' (1.3.12) ityātmanepadaṃ veditavyam| uttaratrāpyanudāttaṅidbhyaḥ kartaryātmanepadamanenaiva veditavyam| `abhitta' iti| `jhalo jhali' 8.2.26) iti sico lopaḥ| `abuddha' iti| `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti takārasya dhakāraḥ, `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti pūrvadhakārasya dakāraḥ| `yakṣīṣṭa' iti| svaritettvādātmepadam| pūrvavat ṣatvaṃ katvañca| `saṃprasāraṇaṃ hi syāt' iti| vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15)| `adrākṣīt' iti| `asti sico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ, `vadavrajahalantasyācaḥ' (7.2.3) iti vṛddhiḥ| pūrvavat ṣatvakatve|| 12. uśca| (1.2.12) liṅasicāvihānuvartamānau dhātuṃ sannidhāpayataḥ, tata eva tayorvidhānāt| na ca ṛkāreṇa viśiṣyate| `yena vidhistadantasya ' (1.1.72) iti ṛkāreṇa tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha--`ṛkārāntāddhātoḥ' ityādi| atha `ṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098) ityasya dhātorgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? śailīheyamācāryasya yatra yasya dhātorgrahaṇamicchati tatra yasya śtipā nirdeśaḥ karoti, yathā-- `artipipartyośca' (7.4.77) `sartiśāstyartibhyaśca' (3.1.56) iti, na ceha śtipā nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ; tasmādṛvarṇsayaivedaṃ grahaṇam, na dhātoḥ| `akṛta' iti| `hrasvādaṅgāt (8.2.27) iti sico lopaḥ| `variṣīṣṭa' iti| vṛṅo vṛño vaikasya rūpam| `liṅasicorātmanepadeṣu' (7.2.42) itīṭ| 13. vā gamaḥ| (1.2.13) `saṃgasīṣṭa' iti| `samo gamṛcchi' (1.3.29) ityādinātmanepadam| `samagata' iti| hrasvāṅgāt' (8.2.27) iti sico lopaḥ| 14. hanaḥ sic| (1.2.14) `āhata' iti| ` āṅo yamahanaḥ' (1.3.28) ityātmanepadam| pūrvavat sico lopaḥ| `āhasata' iti| `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5 ityadādeśa-| atha sijgrahaṇe prakṛte punaḥ sijgrahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃ kriyata ityāha-- `sijgrahaṇaṃ liṅanivṛtyartham' iti| prakṛtaṃ hi sijgrahaṇaṃ liṅā saha sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau satyāṃ tasyāpyanuvṛttirāśaṅkyeta; tasmāt tannirākartuṃ sijgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| nanu ca hanteliṅi vadhādeśena bhavitavyam; na ca tatra satyapi kittve kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate, tat kasmālliṅanivṛttyarthaṃ sijgrahaṇaṃ kriyata ityata āha-- `uttaratra' ityādi| yadyatra liṅanuvarttate tata uttaratra tasyānuvṛttiḥ syāt, tataścottarasūtreṇa tasyāpi kittvaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| iha tu vṛttāvātmanepadena sij na viśeṣyata ityātmanepadaṃ nivṛttamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākartumāha-- `ātmanepadagrahaṇam' ityādi| ihāpi kasmānna bhavatītyata āha-- `iha tu' ityādi| `luṅi ca' (2.4.43) iti hanteḥ parasmaipadeṣu luṅi vadhādeśaḥ kriyate, sa ca nityaḥ| nityatvantu tasya `ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām' (2.4.44) ityattarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃ grahaṇāt| naca nitye vadhādeśe kittvasya kiñcit prayojanamasti ato nehātmanepadasyānuvṛttirupapadyate| atha kimarthaṃ hanteḥ parasya sicaḥ, kittvaṃ vidhīyate, yāvatā `sārvadhātukamapit' (1.2.4) iti sicaḥ parasya sārvadhātukasya ṅittvamastyeva ? tatra `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ siddhaḥ| sica idittvānna sidhyatīti cet ? na; sica ikārasyoccāraṇārthatvāt| tathā hi `cleḥ sic' (3.1.44) ityatra vakṣyati-- `ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ' iti| evamapi cleriditvāt sico'pi sthānivadbhāvenedittvamato na sidhyatīti cet, na ; clerakārasyoccāraṇārthatvāt. tathā hi `cli luṅi' (3.1.43) ityatra vakṣyati-- `ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ' iti| evaṃ tarhi siddhe ṅittve sati yat punariha hanaḥ sijiti sicaḥ kittvaṃ vidadhāti tajjñāpayati--bāhya sārvadhātukamāśritya sijantasya `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopo na bhavatīti; tenāraṃsta,amaṃsta āyaṃsta pādamiti siddhaṃ bhavati; anyathā hyanunāsikalope kṛta āyatetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| 15.yamo gandhane| (1.2.15) nanu ca `yama uparame' (dhā.pā.984) iti paṭhyate, tat kathamayaṃ gandhane vartate, ityata āha-- `anekārthatvāt' iti| `āṅo yamahanaḥ' (1.3.28) ityatra `akarmakācca' (1.3.26) ityato'karmakagrahaṇamanuvartate| tat kathamiha sakarmakatve satyātmanepadamityata āha-- `sakarmakatve'pi ityādi| sakarmakatvantu padādeḥ kramaṇo'tra vidyamānatvāt| `udāyaṃsta pādam' iti| ākṛṣṭavānityarthaḥ|| 16. vibhāṣopayamane| (1.2.16) `dārakarma' iti| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī| dārakriyetyarthaḥ|| 17| sthāghvoricca| (1.2.17) sicca kidbhavatīti cakāreṇa kittvaṃ samuccīyata iti darśayati| kimarthaṃ punaḥ sicaḥ kittvaṃ vidhīyate; yāvatā guṇapratiṣedhastasya phalam, ikāravidhānasāmarthyādeva guṇo na bhaviṣyati; anyathā hyekārameva vidadhyāt ? naitadasti; lāghavārthaṃ hīkāravidhānaṃ syāt| dīrghoccāraṇāddhrasvoccāraṇaṃ laghu bhavati| `upāsthita' iti| `samapravibhyaḥ sthaḥ' (1.3.22) ityataḥ sthagrahaṇe'nuvartamāne `upānmantrakaraṇe' (1.3.25) ityata upāditi tena `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya' (vyā.pa.12) itīttvaṃ notsahate sicaṃ vihantum, tat kuto lopaḥ ? naitadasti;na hīttvaṃ sicītyucyate, kiṃ tarhi ? ikāraścāntādeśo bhavati sicca kidbhavatīti| athāpi sijnimittakaṃ syāt ? evamapyadoṣaḥ; tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāścānityatvāt| anityatvantu saptame'dhyāye jñāpayiṣyate(kāśikā.7.1.13)| `icca' ityādi| hetuśabdo'trādhyāhāryaḥ| tena `ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge' (2.3.26) iti hetuśabdaprayoge kasyeti ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| takāra it takāret, takāra eva vā id yasya sa takāret, takāreto bhāvastakārettvam| iccetyatra nirdeśe kasya hetorikārasya takārettvaṃ kriyate ? kimarthamikārastaparaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| śeṣalakṣaṇā vā kāryasambandhavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīyam| kasya kāryasya niṣpattyarthamikārastaparaḥ kriyata iti yāvat| `dīrgho mā bhūta' iti, asati hi taparatve'ṇ gṛhyamāṇaḥ savarṇān gṛhṇātītīkāreṇa savarṇānāṃ grahaṇe sati sthānentaratamaparibhāṣayopāsthita, aditetyatra dīrghasthāne dīrgho bhavati, sa mā bhūditi taparatvaṃ kriyate| `ṛte'pabi saḥ' iti| sa ityanena dīrghasya pratyavamarśaḥ| ṛte'pyasmādeva vacanād ghumāsthādisūtreṇa (6.4.66) dīrghaḥ siddhaḥ, tasmād vacanasāmarthyāddīrgho na bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| `bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇān na gṛhṇāti' (vyā.pa.30) ityato dīrgho na bhaviṣyatīti| eṣa tu parihāro noktaḥ, bhāvyamānenāpyaṇā kvacit savarṇānāṃ grahaṇāt| tathā hi-- adasa aupratyaye paratastyadādyatve `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhau kṛtāyām bhavati| `adaso'serdādu do maḥ' (8.2.80) ityukāro vidhīyamānaḥ savarṇānāṃ grahaṇādaukārasya dīrghasya sthāne dīrgha eva bhavati-- amū iti| `anantare pluto mā bhūt' iti| anantarārthe visadṛśārtha ārambhe sati|kuta etat? visadṛśasya ākārasya sthāne kriyamāṇo hrasvo bhavati, na punaḥ plutaḥ| tasmāt plutabādhanārthaṃ taparatvaṃ kartavyam| etadapi nāsti prayojanam| `plutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ' iti| caśabdo hetau| pluto hi dūrāddhūtādiviṣayaviśeṣe (8.2.84) ukta eva| tatra yadyanena pluto vidhīyate tadā sarvatra dūrāddhūtādiviṣaye'nyatra cānena bhavitavyam, tataśca dūrāddhūtādiviṣaye'pi tasmin bhavatyuktānuvādadoṣaḥ syāt; tasya kṛtasya karaṇāt| tasmāt pakṣa uktānuvādadoṣo mā bhūditi hrasva eva bhaviṣyati, na plutaḥ iti pratyākhyātaṃ bhāṣye taparatvam| anye tu varṇayanti-- `plutaśca viṣaye smṛtaḥ' ita nānena taparatvaṃ pratyākhyāyate, kiṃ tarhi? tasya prayojanamākhyāyate| dūrāddhūtādiviṣaye pluta iṣṭo'bhipretaḥ, sa na prāpnoti| sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā( 1.1.50) dīrghasyaiva sthāne dīrgha eva vidhīyate| nanu coktaṃ siddha eva dīrgha iti ? siddhasya punarvacanaṃ plutasya bādhanārthaṃ syāt| iṣyate ca pluto dūrādadhūtādiviṣaye| tasmāt tasya bādhako dīrgho mā bhūditi taparatvaṃ kartavyam| tena vicāryamāṇānāmityāṣṭamiko bhavatyeva pluta iti| 18. na ktvā seṭ| (1.2.18) ktvāpratyayasyaupaveśikaṃ kittvamastyeveti tadiṭaḥ ktvāpratyayena grahaṇāt seṭo'pi prāpnotītyataḥ pratiṣedha'yamārabhyate| `ktvāpratyayaḥ seṭ kinna bhavati' iti| atha kiṃ kakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣedhāt kittvanna bhavati ? kitkāryasya pratiṣedhādvā ? yadi hyatra kakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣedhādakittvaṃ vidhitsitaṃ syāditsaṃjñāprakaraṇe `laśakvaseṭktvātaddhitayoḥ' iti sūtraṃ kuryāt| evaṃ hi dviṣpratiṣedho na karttavyo bhavati| tasmāt kittvapratibaddhaṃ yat kāryaṃ tatpratiṣedhādakittvaṃ seṭaḥ ktvāpratyasyānena kriyate, na tu kakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣedhāt| atha sānubandhakasya grahaṇaṃ kimartham `na tvā' ityevocyeta,evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati? naitadasti; kakārānuccāraṇe hi kaściddveṣyamapi vijānīyāt| seṭaḥ ktvāpratyayasya kakārānubandha eva nāsti, niranubandhakasyoccāraṇāditi| tadevaṃ mā vijñāyīti sānubandhakasyoccāraṇam|kaḥ punaḥ seṭo niranubandhakatve vidhau niranubandhaka uccāryate ? evamapi seṭa eva grahaṇaṃ syāt, nāniṭaḥ;sānubandhakatvāt| `nigṛhītiḥ'iti| `striyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) `titutratatha' (7.2.9) iti `grahādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ (vā.831. ?) iti titutratathetyādineṭpratiṣedho na bhavati|`upasnihitiḥ' iti| `sniha prītau' (dhā.pā.1200),`nikucitiḥ' iti| `kuncu kruncu kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ'(dhā.pa.185,186) eṣu triṣūdāharaṇeṣu yathākramaṃ saṃprasāraṇaguṇapratiṣedhau| `aniditāṃ hala upadhāyāḥ kṅiti' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaśca kittvādbhavati| `na seṭ' ityādi| na seḍityetāvatā yogenākittve sati siddhaṃ devitvetyādi,ktvāgrahaṇaṃ tu kimartham, tena vinā'kittve sati `gudha pariveṣṭane' (dhā.pā.1120) nigudhito nigudhito nigudhitavānityatra niṣṭhāyāṃ prāpnotīti cet ? naitadasti; niṣṭhāyāmavadhāraṇāt| `niṣṭhā śīṅasvidimidi' (1.2.19) ityatrāvadhāraṇānniṣṭhāyāṃ na bhaviṣyati-- śīṅādibhya eva niṣṭhā seṭ kinna bhavati nānyebhyo dhātubhya iti| śīṅādibhyo niṣṭhaiveti viparīta niyamastu nāśaṅkanīyaḥ, na hyaniṣṭārthā śāstre praklṛptiriti na bhaviṣyati| liṭastarhi kittvasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tataśca jagmiva,jagmityetatra `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopo na syādityata āha-- `jñāpakānna parokṣāyām' iti| parokṣe vihitattavālliṭaḥ śrutiḥ parokṣetyucyate, tasyāṃ kittvapratiṣedho na bhaviṣyati| katham ? jñāpakāt | kiṃ tajjñāpakam ? ityāha-- `sani jhalgrahaṇaṃ viduḥ' iti| yadayam `iko jhal' (1.2.9) iti san‌viśeṣaṇaṃ karoti,tato jñāyate-- aupadeśikasya kittvasyana seḍiti pratiṣedho'yam nātideśikasyeti| jhalgrahaṇaṃ hiśiśayiṣata ityatra kittvaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ kriyate| yadi ca na seḍiti pratiṣedhaḥ ātideśikasyāpi kittvasya syāt; jhalgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| astvatra kittvam, tasya na seḍiti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti tasmādaudeśikasya kittvasya pratiṣedho'yaṃ nātideśikasyeti| asyārthasya jñāpakaṃ jhalgrahaṇaṃ syāt, `sthādhvoricca' (1.2.17) ityatra jhalādau sicītvaṃ yathā syāt, ajādau mā bhūditi-- upāsthāyiṣātāmiti| atra hi `syasicsīyuṭtāsiṣu' (6.4.62) ityādinā ciṣvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, ittvañca; tatra paratvācciṇvadbhāvādiṭ| ciṇvadbhāve sati `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk; tatrāsati jhalgrahaṇa iḍādāvapīttvaṃ yakārasthāne prāpnoti, naitadasti; yasmādittvaṃ kitsanniyogena vidhīyate| kittvaṃ hi pradhānabhūtam, ittvamanvācayaśiṣṭam| ataḥ kittvābhāve tadittvaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti| atha `sthādhvoricca' (1.2.17) ityatrāpi kittvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? `na seṭ' ityetāvatā yogena pratiṣiddhatvāt| `reṇa tulyaṃ sudhīvani' iti| repheṇa tulyametadittvam| kva codāharaṇe ? sudhīvanītyatra| śobhanā dhīvāno yasyāṃ sā sudhīvā| `ano bahuvrīheḥ' (4.1.12) iti ṅīpo'tra pratiṣedhe kṛte yathā `vano ra ca' (4.1.7) iti repho ṅīpsanniyogena vidhīyamānastadabhāve na bhavati, tathā kittavasanniyogena vidhāyamānamittvaṃ tadabhāve na bhaviṣyati| kimarthaṃ tarhi ktvāgrahaṇam ? kvasau kittvapratiṣedho mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ ktvāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| kvasau tvaupadeśikaṃ kittvamasti, tasya `na seṭ' ityetāvatā yogena pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| tataśca jagmivān-- ityatropadhālopo na syāt| `vasvarthaṃ kidatīdeśāt' iti| na bhaviṣyatītyadhyāhāryam| astu kvasāvaupadeśikasya kittvasya pratiṣedhaḥ, satyapi tasmin `asaṃyogālliṭ kit' (1.2.5) iti yadātideśikaṃ kittvam, tenopadhālopo bhaviṣyati| jhalgrarahaṇādātideśikasya kittvasya pratiṣedho na bhaviṣyatītyuktaṃ hyetat| tasmādvasvarthaṃ ktvāgrahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti| evaṃ tarhi-- nigṛhītiḥ prayojanam| ktini tu pratiṣedho mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ ktvāgrahaṇamityarthaḥ| jagmivānityatra `vibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām' (7.2.68) iti kvasoriṭ, `ugidacām' (7.1.70) iti num, halaṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau (5.1.68; 8.2.23) `sāntamahataḥ' (6.4.10) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| 19. niṣṭhā śīṅsvidimidikṣvididhṛṣaḥ| (1.2.19) `śīṅa svapne' (dhā.pā.1032) , `ñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1188), `ñimidā snehane' (dhā.pā.1243), `ñikṣvidā snehanamocanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1244), `ñidhṛṣā prāgalbhye' (dhā.pā.1269) | `śayitatavān' iti| `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| `śayitaḥ' iti| `gatyathākarmaka' (3.4.72) ityādinā kartari ktaḥ| `prasveditaḥ' ityādau `ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ kartari ca' (3.4.71) ityanena praśabda ādikarma - prārambhaṃ dyotayati|`pradharṣitaḥ' iti| vaiyātyādanyatredamudāharaṇam| tatra hi `dhṛṣiśasīvaiyātye' (7.2.19) itīṭpratiṣedhena bhavitavyam| prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅaluko grahaṇaṃ smarati| ato yaṅaluko `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ|| 20. mṛṣastitikṣāyām| (1.2.20) titikṣā - kṣamā, kṣāntiriti| yadyevam, kṣāntigrahaṇeva karttavyam,laghu hyevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati ? satyametat; vaicitryārthaṃ tu na kṛtam| `apamṛṣitam' iti| aparāmṛṣṭamityarthaḥ, anekārthatvātaddhātūnām| anekārthatvaṃ tu titikṣāgrahaṇādvijñāyate| asati hi tatra mṛṣastitikṣāyāmeva paṭhyata iti tanna kuryāt, vyavacchedyābhāvāt| 21. udupadhādbhāvadikarmaṇoranyatarasyām| (1.2.21) `ādikarmaṇi vartamānaḥ' iti| ādibhūtakriyākṣaṇa ādikarma, tasmin bhūtatvena vivakṣate yaḥ kto bhavati, sa ādikarmaṇi vartate| `dyotitamanena, dyutitamanena' iti| `dyuta dīptau' (dhā.pā.741) naṃpusake bhāve ktapratyayaḥ| evaṃ `moditamanena, muditamanena' ityatrāpi ; `muda harṣe' (dhā.pā.16) ityasmāt| `pradyutitaḥ' ityādiṣu tu `ādikarmaṇi kta karttari ca' (3.4.71) iti ktaḥ karttaryeva vidhīyate, na karmaṇi; dhātorakarmakatvāt. nāpi bhāve; bhāvodāharaṇādaviśeṣaprasaṅgāt|karttaryavyutpannaḥ kta ādikarmasambandhādādikarmaṇītyucyate|ādikarmasambandhastvarthadvārakaḥ| `rucitam' iti| `ruca dīptau' (dhā.pā. 745) asyākarmakatvāt `gatyarthākarmaka' 3.4.72) ityādinā karttari ktaḥ| dīptimat kārṣāpaṇamityarthaḥ| ādikarmātra na vivakṣitam| `prabhukta odanaḥ' iti| `bhuja pālanābhyavahārayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1454) `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' (3.4.70) iti karmaṇi ktaḥ| tasyādikarmasambandhādādikarmaṇi vṛttiḥ| `gudha pariveṣṭane' (dhā.pā.1120) iti dauvādikaḥ| nigudhitamiti bhāve ktaḥ| yadi vyavasthitavibhāṣayā śabvikaraṇānāmeva bhavati, seḍgrahaṇena kimarthamiha niṣṭhā viśiṣyate ? aśabvikaraṇatvādeva hi prabhukta ityatra na bhavati| na hi bhujiḥ śabvikaraṇaḥ, api tu śnamvikaraṇaḥ, satyametat; uttarārthaṃ seḍgrahaṇamanuvarttanīyam| atastaduttarārthayanuvarttamānamihāpi mandadhiyāṃ sukhapratipattiryathā syādityevamartham| takāro'tra mukhasukhārthaḥ, na dīrghanivṛttyarthaḥ; alaghūpadhatvādeva hi dīrghopadhānāṃ guṇaprasaṅgābhāvāt|| 22. pūṅaḥ ktvā ca|(1.2.22) `na seṭ varttate' ityaktam| `na ktvā seṭ' (1.2.18) ityataḥ| nanu ca pūṅaḥ parayoḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoriṭā na bhavitavyameva; `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) iti pratiṣedhāt| tadapārthikā seḍgrahaṇānuvṛttiriti yaścodayet taṃ pratyāha-- pūṅaśceḍ vihitaḥ' ityādi| ata ktvāpratyayasyodāharaṇaṃ kasmānna pradarśitamityata āha-- `ktvāpratyayasya' ityādi| yadi hyanena yogena ktvāpratyayasya kittvaṃ pratiṣidhyeta, tadā tasyāpyudāharaṇaṃ pradarśyeta, na cānena pratiṣidhyate, kintarhi ? `na kt‌vā seṭ' (1.2.18) ityanenaiva pratiṣiddhatvāt| tasmāta tasyodāharaṇaṃ na pradarśitamitita bhāvaḥ| ktvāpratyayasya `na ktvā seṭ' (1.2.18) ityanena pratiṣedha ityetadeva draḍhayitumāha-- `tathā ca ' ityādi| `pūṅśca' (7.2.51) ityatra sūtre dvayorvibhāṣayormadhye ye vidhayaste nityā bhavantīti manyamānairbhāradvājīyairidamuktam-- `nityamakittvamiḍādyoḥ' iti| tau punariḍādī ktvāniṣṭhāpratyayau| yadi tarhi nityamakittvamiḍādyoḥ; tadā ktvāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| vikalpena hyatrākittavasaddhaye tasya grahaṇamarthavadbhavati, nānyathā| nityatvaṃ kittvapratiṣedhasya `na ktvā seṭ' (1.2.18) ityanenaiva siddhatvāditi codyamāśahkyedamuktam-- `ktvāgrahaṇamuttarārtham' iti| `pūṅaḥ' iti sānubandhakasyoccāraṇaṃ kimartham ? popuvitaḥ, popuvitavān, popuvitveti yaṅalugantāt kittvapratiṣedho mā bhūditi| pūṅanivṛtyarthaṃ sānubandhaksayoccāraṇaṃ nopapadyate; `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) itīṭpratiṣedhāt| pūñaḥ parayoḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ seṭorabhāvāt|| 23. nopadhātthaphāntādvā| (1.2.23) `niṣṭheti nivṛttam' iti| pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt| `grathitvā' iti| kittvapakṣe `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsakilopaḥ| `guphitvā' iti| `gupha gunpha granthe' (dhā.pā.1317,1318) `riphitvā' iti| `ripha katthanayuddhanindāhiṃsādāneṣu' (dhā.pā.1306)| nanu caitadvikpābhāve'pi `ralo vyupadhāt' (1.2.26) ityādinaivātra vikalpena bhavatavyam, na cānayorvikalpayoḥ kaścidviśeṣo'pyasti ? evaṃ tarhi nopadhagrahaṇasāma- rthyādyogāntarakṛto'pabi vikalpo'nena bādhyate| nanu ca ṛkāropadho nopadhagrahaṇasya pratyudāharaṇaviṣayo bhaviṣyati, `ṛpha ṛnpha hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1315,1316), arphitveti, naitadsti; ihāsmābhiranayordhātvo rūpatrayaṃ sādhyam-- arphitvā, ṛmphitvā, ṛphitveti| etat tu satyasati vā nopadhagrahaṇa'nenaiva siddhyatyeva| sati tāvannopadhagrahaṇe, anopadhasya ṛpheḥ `na ktvā seṭ' (1.2.18) iti pratiṣedhe satyarphitveti siddhyati| nopadhasya tu ṛmpherasmin vikalpe sati, ṛmphitvā ṛphitvetīdamaparaṃ rūpadvayaṃ siddhayati| asatyapi nopadhagrahaṇe sarvathāsmin vikalpe satīdaṃ rūpatrayaṃ siddhyatyeva| tasmād yuktamuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ repitveti| `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) iti tadantavidhau siddhe'ntagrahaṇam `iha ktvāpratyakāṇḍe yatnamantareṇa tadantavidharna bhavati' iti jñāpanārtham| tenottarasūtre `ṛta' iti dhātuḥ svarūpeṇa gṛhyate, na tu tadanta iti| 24. vañciluñcyṛtaśca|(1.2.24) `vancu pralambhane' (dhā.pā.1703), `lunca apanayane' (dhā.pā.187), `ṛta' iti sautrau dhātuḥ, yatra `ṛterīyaṅa' (3.1.29) itīyaṅa vihitaḥ| `ṛterīyaṅa' ārdhadhātuke vikalpyate' iti| `ādāya ārdhadhātuke vā' (3.1.31) ityanena| `vacitvā' iti| `aniditām| (6.4.24) iti nalopaḥ| `vaktavā' iti| `udito vā' (7.2.56) itīḍabhāvaḥ pakṣe| cakāro vāgrahaṇasya svaritatvavispaṣṭīkaraṇārthaḥ| tenottarasūtre kāśyapagrahaṇasya pūjārthatā; anyathā hi tasya vikalpārthatā vijñāyeta| tathā ca dvayorvibhāṣayormadhyavarttitvānnityo'yaṃ vidhiḥ syāta| 25. tṛṣimṛṣikṛśeḥ kāśyapasya| (1.2.25) `ñitṛṣā pipāsāyām' (dhā.pā.1228), `mṛṣa titikṣāyām' (dhā.pā.1164), `kṛśa tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1227)| `kāśyapagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham' iti| `kāśyapasyaivaitadviṣayakaṃ jñānaṃ nānyeṣām' ityasādhāraṇajñānodbhāvanameva pūjā| tas tatpūjādvāreṇa śāstrasyāpi mahārthatodbhāvanalakṣaṇā pūjā kṛtā bhavati| evannāma śāstrasya mahārthatvaṃ yena tathāvidhā mumukṣavo'pyādriyanta iti| tena vikalpārthaṃ kāśyapagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyata āha-- vetyeva hi varttate' iti|| 26. ralo vyupadhāddhalādeḥ saṃśca| (1.2.26) ktvāpratyayaśca `na ktvā seṭ' (1.2.18) iti kittve pratiṣiddhe sano'pyakitve svabhāvata eva vyavasthita ubhayatredaṃ vidhimukhenaiva pravarttata itipakṣe kittvaṃ bhavatīti| `{didyutiṣate' -- kāśikā,padamaṃjarī ca} vidadyutiṣate' iti| `dyutisvāpyoḥ saṃprāsaraṇam' (7.4.67) ityabhyāsasya saṃprāsaraṇam| `eṣiṣiṣati' iti| `iṣu icchāyām' (dhā.pā.1351), iḍāgame kṛte `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti dvitīyasyaikāco dvirvanacam| `bubhukṣate' iti. `halantācca' (2.1.10) iti nityaṃ kittvaṃ bhavati| lāghavārtham `iṇupadhāt' iti vācye, iṇgrahaṇāni sarvāṇi parema ṇakāreṇeti jñāpanārthaṃ `vyupadhāt' ityuktam| tena `laṇ' ityatra yaduktam-- `iṇgrahaṇāni sarvāṇi pareṇa ṇakāreṇa' iti tadupapannaṃ bhavati|| 27. ūkālo'jjhrasvadīrghaplutaḥ| (1.2.27) ūḥ kālo yasyācaḥ sa ūkālaḥ| nanu cāyukto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, tathā hi-- ū iti śabdaḥ kālastu kriyā, tat kuto'tra sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmāt `ū' ityetatsahacaritāyāmuccāraṇakriyāyāmiha sāhacaryāt `ū' ityeṣa śabdo varttate, evamapyayuktam; yataḥ `ū' ityetatsahacaritaṃ yaduccāraṇaṃ tadūkārasyaiva, nānyasyācaḥ| tatkathaṃ so'nyasambnadhinyā kriyayā ūkāralaḥ syāt, na hi yajñadattasambandhinībhiścitragavībhirdevadattaścitragurbhavati ? ayamapyadoṣaḥ; vatyarthasyeha gamayantītyuktametat| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- `ū' ityetatsahaciratayoccāraṇakriyayā tulyoccāraṇakriyā kālālakhyā yasyācaḥ sa ūkāla iti| nanu ca ūkāla ityekaḥ saṃjñī, saṃjñāstu tistraḥ, tato vaiṣamyāt saṃkhyātānudeśo na prāpnotīti yo manyeta, taṃ pratyāha-- `ū iti trayāṇām' ityādi| mātrikāṇāṃ trayāṇāmakaḥ savarṇe (6.1.101) dīrghatvamekādeśaṃ kṛtvā `ū' iti nirdeśaḥ kṛta ityarthaḥ| kutaḥ punaretadvijñāyate trayāṇāmekaḥ praśleṣanirdeśa iti ? tisṛṇāṃ saṃjñānāṃ vidhānasāmarthyāt| na hyekasya bhinnaprayojanamantareṇānekasaṃjñāvidhānamarthavadbhavati| na cehaikasyānekasaṃjñākaraṇe bhinnaprayojanamasti| `hrasvadīrghapluta' iti yadyeka evāyaṃ śabdaḥ saṃjñā syāt, lāghavārthatvāt saṃjñākaraṇasya, mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇamayuktaṃ syāt| kiñca-- āvṛttidharmāṇaḥ saṃjñāśabdāḥ pradeśeṣu bhavanti, na cāyaṃ samudāya saṃjñāśabdāḥ pradeśeṣu bhavanti, na cāyaṃ samudāyaḥ pradeśeṣvāvartyate,api tu pratyekaṃ hrasvādiśabdāḥ| tasmāt teṣāṃ dvandvaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśa iti matvāha- `hrasvadīrghaplutaḥ' ityādiḥ| dvandvaikavadbhāvastu `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati' iti vacanāt| nanu ca dvandvaikavadbhāve `sa napuṃsakam' (2.4.17) iti nupaṃsakatvena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ puṃlliṅgena nirdeśaḥ, sautratvānnirdeśasya| chandasi `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti liṅgavyatyaya uktaḥ| `chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā.1.1.1) ityaviruddhāsya puṃlliṅgatā| u ū ū3 ityanayā ānupūrvyaiṣāṃ praśleṣa iti darśayati| kutaḥ punareṣa niścayaḥ-- eṣaivaiṣāmānupūrvīti ? evaṃ manyate-- `vibhāṣā pṛṣṭaprativacane heḥ' (8.2.93) ityekamātrikasya heḥ plutavidhānājjñāyate-- na mātriko'ntya iti| antyatve hi sati tasya plutasaṃjñā syāt| evañca plutavidhānamanarthaṃ syāt| dvimātriko'pyantyo na bhavati; `omabhyādāne' (8.2.87) iti dvimātrikasya plutavidhānāt| tasya cāntyatve hi sati yadi plutasaṃjñā syāt, tadā ca plutasya plutavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasamādante ekamātrikadvimātrikau na bhavataḥ| madhye'pyekamātriko na bhavati, `ato dīrgho yañi' (7.3.101) iti `supi ca' (7.3.102) itica dīrghavidhānasāmarthyāt| yadi madhya ekamātrikaḥ syāt tadā tasya dīrghasaṃjñā syāt,dīrghasya dīrghavacanamakiñcitkaraṃ syāt, tasmādādāvekamātrikatve hi sati pāriśeṣyānmadhye dvimātrikaḥ, ante trimātrika iti| `u ū ū3' iti| atrāpyukārādisahacaritāyāmuccāraṇakriyāyamukārādayo varttante| evaṃ kālo'jiti yakārasya lopaḥ| nanu cokāro'yamaṇ gṛhyamāṇaḥ savarṇān gṛhṇātītyata ukāreṇa dīrghaplutayorgrahaṇe sati tayorapi hrasvasaṃjñā bhavatītyata āha- `kālagrahaṇam' ityādi| kālagrahaṇe hi yeṣāmetāḥsaṃjñā vidhīyate teṣāṃ yathākramamekamātrikatva dvimātrikatvatrimātrikatvāni viśeṣaṇāni labhyante| tathā hi, kālagrahaṇesati pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptau kriyamāṇāyāṃ trayo bahuvrīhayo bhavanti- uḥ kālo yasay sa ukālaḥ, ūḥ kālo yasya sa ūkālaḥ, ū3ḥkālo yasya saḥ ū3 kālaḥ| eṣāṃ yathārmamekamātrikadvimātrikatrimātrikā aco'nyapadārthāḥ| yasmānmātrika evācaḥ `u' ityetatsahacāriṇyā uccāramakriyāyāstulyakālaḥ; evaṃ dvimātrika evāca `ū' ityetatsahacāriṇyā uccāraṇakriyāyāstulyakālaḥ; evaṃ trimātrika evāca `ū3' ityetatsahacāriṇyā uccāraṇakriyāyāstulyakālaḥ| evaṃ ca sati mātrāparimāṇasyāco hrasvasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā satyapyukāreṇa dīrghaplutayorgrahaṇe tayorna bhavati, na hi tau mātrā parimāṇau| tena ālūya, pariṇīyetyatra hrasvāśrayastuṅa na bhavati| `pratyakṣya, prarakṣya' iti| `takṣū tvakṣū tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.655, 656) `rakṣa pālane' (dhā.pā.658) `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāse kṛte `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap' (7.1.37) iti lyap| tatra parato dvayorardhamātaryorhaloḥ saṃyogasaṃjñinorūkāltvamastītyasatyajgrahaṇe hrasvasaṃjñā syāt, tataśca hrasvāśrayastuka prasajyeta| `titaucchatram' iti| atrākārokāracoḥ samudāyasya ūkālatvād dvimātrikatvamastīti dīrghasaṃjñā syāt| tataśca `padāntādvā' (6.1.76) iti vikalpitastuk prasajyeta| ajgrahaṇe tu sati dīrghasaṃjñā na bhavati,acsamudāyasyājgrahaṇenāgrahaṇāt | nanu ca satyāmapi tasyāṃ samudāyāśrayāyāṃ dīrghasaṃjñāyāyamavayavāśrayā hrasvasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| tadāśrayastuṅanitya eva, naitadasti; paratvāddīrghāśrayastugvikalpaḥ prāpnoti| na caivaṃ vidhaviṣaye punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānamasti; yatra pūrvo vidhiḥ pravarttamānaḥ paravidhivijñānaṃ na bādhate tatraitadbhavati-- `punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāt siddham' iti, iha tu nityo vidhiḥ paravidhivikalpavijñānaṃ bādhate; nityavikalpayorvirodhāt| tataśca `sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadbādhitaṃ tadbādhitameva' (vyā.pa.40) iti paribhāṣayaiva vikalpaḥ syāt| tasmādajgrahaṇaṃ 28.acaśca| (1.2.28) paribhāṣeyaṃ liṅgavatī sthāniniyamārthā pradeśeṣu `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) ityevamādiṣūpatiṣṭhate;tadupasthāne ca ṣaṣṭhīdvayaṃ prādurbhavati; viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ prati kāmacārāt| `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) ityatrācā prātipadikaṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ viśiṣyate-- ajantasya prātipadikasyeti, na tu prātipadikenā-jviśiṣyate| yadi hi prātipadikenājviśiṣyeta-- prātipadikasya yo'jiti, tadā madhyasthitasyāpyaco hrasvaḥ syāt| `suvāg brāhmaṇakulam' iti| acā tu prātipadike viśiṣyamāṇe prātipadikasyaivetyeṣā sthānaṣaṣṭhī bhavati, na cāvayavaṣaṣṭhī, tenālo'ntyasyaivāco hrasvo bhavati| `vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta udāttaḥ' (8.2.82) ityatra gṛhyamāṇena ṭiśabdenājviśiṣyate-- ṭeryo'jiti| tena ṭermadhyavartino'pyacaḥ pluto bhavati| yadi tvacā ṭirviśiṣyate-- ajantasya ṭeriti, tadehaiva syāt-- devadattā3 iti; iha tu na syāt-- agniciditi| cakāreṇājityanukṛṣyate, tsaya prayojanamihaiva vakṣyati| atiri- ityādīnyudāharamāni `eca igghrasvādeśe' (1.1.48) ityatra vyutpāditāni| cīyate iti karmaṇi lakāraḥ| `saṃjñāvidhāne niyamaḥ' ityatra yuktimāha-- `ajiti varttate' iti| ajgrahaṇe hyanuvarttamāne hrasvādiśabdā anuvarttamānā aca evopasthānaṃ prati vyāpriyante;tasya svayamevopasthitatvāt| tataśca svarūpamātrapadārthakāḥ santo vidhīyamānasyāco viśeṣaṇatāmupayānti| tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate-- aḥ sthāne'j bhavati `hrasvadīrghaplutaḥ ityevaṃ saṃjñayā vidhīyamāna iti| `dyauḥ, panthāḥ, saḥ' iti| etāni `iko guṇavṛddhī' (1.1.3) ityatra vyutpāditāni| eṣu ca yathāyogaṃ `diva aut' (7.1.84) `pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt' (7.1.85) `tyadādīnāmaḥ' (7.2.102) ityebhiraukārādayaḥ svarūpeṇa vidhīyamānā dīrghādisaṃjñayā na vidhīyanta iti hala eva sthāne te bhavanti, nācaḥ| dyubhyām, dyubhirityatrāpi `diva ut(7.1.131) ityukāro hrasvasaṃjñayā na vidhīyata iti hala eva sthāne bhavati, nācaḥ| nanu ca dyaurityādīni trīṇyudāharaṇāni `iko guṇavṛddhi' (1.1.3) ityanenaiva saṃjñāvidhānaniyamena siddhāni, tatra hi tasyāpyetāni pratyudāharaṇāni prāgupanyastāni, tasmānnārtha etadarthena saṃjñayā vidhīyamānena niyamena ? satyametat; evaṃ manyate-- dyubhyām, dyubhirityevamarthaṃ saṃjñāvidhāne niyamaḥ karttavyaḥ; na hyukārasya guṇasaṃjñāsti, nāpi vṛddhisaṃjñā; yataḥ pūrveṇaiva saṃjñāvidhānaniyamenaitadapi siddhyati| tasmādanyārtho'yaṃ saṃjñāvidhānaniyamaḥ kriyamāṇo ye'pi vismaraṇaśīlāḥ pūrvasya niyamasya prayojanaṃ na smaranti tānanugrahītum-- dyauḥ, panthā-, sa ityevamartho'pi bhavati|| 29. uccairūdāttaḥ| (1.2.29) udāttādayo lokavedayoḥ prasiddhāḥ| tat kiṃ saṃjñākaraṇeneti yaścodayet taṃ pratyāha-- `udāttādiśabdāḥ' ityādi| ādiśabdenānudāttasvaritayoḥ parigrahaḥ| evakāro bhinnakramo varṇadharme ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| lokavedayorudāttādayaḥ śabdā varṇanāṃ yo dharmaḥ - guṇastatraiva prasiddhāḥ, na tu tadvityaci| tasmādiha vyākaraṇa udāttādayo dharmā yasyācastadguṇe'ci saṃjñāpyante - paribhāṣyante; anyathā pradeśeṣūdāttādiśabdaśravaṇādvarṇadharma eva gṛhyeta, na tadvānajityabhiprāyaḥ| uccairiti śrutiprakarṣe'sti-- śrutiprakarṣavatyuccairbhāṣate uccaḥ paṭhatīti| asti ca pramāṇādhikaraṇavācī uccaiḥ sthito devadatta iti, uccairnāma pramāṇam, tasya tadadhikaraṇaṃ tadihoccaiḥ śabdenocyate| tadiha dvitīyasyoccaiḥ śabdasyārtho gṛhyate, netarasyeti darśayitumāha-- `uccaiḥ' iti| uccairbhāṣate ityevamādau tu vākye prayuktasyoccaiḥ śabdasya yo'rthaḥ śrutiprakarṣaḥ sa uccairityatra na gṛhyate| yadi gṛhyeta, upāṃśuprayoga udāttādisaṃjñā na syāt; prakarṣābhāvāt, prakarṣasthitatvādudāttādayo na viśiṣyeran| ya eva hi kañcit pratyuccairbhavati, sa eva hi kañcitpratati nīcairbhavati| evañca sarvamudāttaṃ syāt, anudāttatamo'pi ceṣyata ityabhiprāya| `sthānakṛtam' ityādi| ucyatā nāma pramāṇaviśeṣaḥ, tadadhikaraṇabhūtasthānamuccairbhavati| evañca sarvanamudāttaṃ na syāt| anudāttamuccairucyata ityarthaḥ| `bhāgavatsu' iti| bhāgā avayavā yeṣāṃ tāni bhāgavanti| te bhāgāstālvādiṣu sthāneṣvauttarādharyeṇa vyavasthitāḥ| sthānamuccaiḥ śabdenocyate, tat kutaḥ saṃjñina uccaistvaviśeṣaṇam ? uccaisthānaniṣpannatvāt| tatra samāne sthāna uccairūrdhvabhāge yo niṣpannaḥ sa udāttasaṃjño bhavati| yadi sthāne ya ūrdhvabhāganiṣpanno'c sa udāttasaṃjño bhavatītyetāvaducyate, evañca sa evānavasthitadoṣaḥ| tathā hi- alpaśarīreṣu ya eva tālvādibhāga uccairbhavati, sa eva mahāśarīreṣu tālvādibhāgāpekṣayā nīcairbhavati| ataḥ `samāna' ityetat sthānaviśeṣaṇamuktam| etacc laghvarthatvāt saṃjñākaraṇasyaikākṣarāyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ kartavyāyāmanekākṣarasaṃjñākaraṇāllabhyate| granthādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ bhavatīti| nanu ca granthādhikyādatra kaścidācāryasyādhiko'rtho'bhipreta ityetāvanmātraṃ pratīyate, samānatvamityeṣo'rtha viśeṣaḥ kuto labhyate ? avicchinnādupadeśapāramparyāt| tat punaḥ samānatvaṃ vaktrabhinnatvādveditavyam; na tu tālvādisthānasyābhinnatvāt; anyathā tālavyamevāpekṣyodāttaḥ syāt, na tu kaṇṭhādīn| vakturabhedāt tad‌dvāreṇa bhinnānāmapi tālvādīnāṃ samānatve'pi vijñāyamāna eṣa doṣo na bhavati| kiṃlakṣaṇaḥ punarasāvuccabhāganiṣpanno'jityāha-- `yasmin' ityādi| `āyāmaḥ' ityasya vivaraṇaṃ `nigrahaḥ' iti| nigrahaḥ - stabdhatā| saṃvṛtakaṇṭhatā - kaṇṭhavivarasya saṃvṛtatā| ata eva śanairniṣkrāman vāyurgalāvayavāñśoṣayati| rūkṣatā bhavatyasnigdhatā| `ye te ke' iti| yattatkiṃśabdebhyastyadādyatvam, `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam,`jasaḥ śī' (7.1.17), `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| atra prātipadikasvareṇa prakṛtirūdāttā| `anudāttau suppitau' (3.1.4) iti vibhaktisvaraḥ| ekādeśastu `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.1.5) iti|| 30. nīcairanudāttaḥ| (1.2.30) anvavasarga ityasya vivaraṇaṃ mārdavamiti| śaithilyamityarthaḥ| mṛdutetyasya vivaraṇaṃ snigdhateti| urutetyasyāpi mahatteti| mahattvādeva kaṇṭhavivarasya punaḥ śīghraṃ vāyurniṣkrāman galāvayavānna śoṣayatīti| ataḥ svarasya snigdhatā bhavati| tva-sama-sima-nemetyanuccānīti sarvādiṣveva paṭhyante| anuccāni anuccāni anudāttānītyarthaḥ| `namaste rudra' ityādi| teśabdaḥ `temayāvekavacane' (8.1.22) iti `anudāttaṃ sarvamapādādau' (8.1.18) ityadhikārādanudāttaḥ| rudrādayo'pi `āmantritasya ca' (8.1.19) ityanenāṣṭamikena sarve'nudāttā bhavantīti| 31. samāhāraḥ svaritaḥ|(1.2.31) udāttānudāttaśabdāvajviśeṣayoḥ saṃjñe| saṃjñā hi pradeśeṣūccāritāḥ saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayanti| tābhyāmihānuvṛttābhyāmudāttānudāttayoracorupasthāpitayoḥ pratyayaḥ| tasmāt samāhārātmakasyācaḥ svaritasaṃjñā vidhīyate| samāhāraśabdaścasamāharaṇaṃ samāhāra iti bhāvasādhano'yaṃ loke samudāye rūḍhaḥ| na codāttānudāttātmakaḥ kaścidacsamudāyaḥ sambhavatīti, tataśca saṃjñino'sambhavāt saṃjñāpi na sambhavīti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha-- `sāmarthyācca' ityādi| ucyate cedam-- udāttānudāttasamāhāraḥ svaritasaṃjño bhavatīti, na ca pāribhāṣikodāttānudāttasamāhāratmano'caḥ sambhavo'sti| tatra sāmarthyāllokavedaprasiddhau yau dharmāvudāttānudāttau tāveva gṛhyete; nācau| nanvevamapi sa eva doṣaḥ, loke prasiddhodāttānudāttātmano'ca eṣā saṃjñā vidhīyate, kasya tarhi ? lokavedaprasiddhāvudāttānudāttau samāhriyete yasminnaci tasya| sambhavati caikasminnapyaci tayoḥ samāhāra iti kutaḥ saṃjñino'sambhavaḥ| `samāhriyete yasmin' iti bruvatā'dhikaraṇa sādhano'yaṃ samāhāraśabdo na bhāvasādhana iti darśitam| samāhriyete - saṃhanyete, sahitāvupalabhyete ityarthaḥ| `śikyam' iti| `pūño yaṇṇug hrasvaśca' (da.u.16) iti yaditi varttamāne `śranseḥ śi kuṭ kicca' (da.u.817) iti śraṃsateryatpratyaye śiśabdādeśe kuḍāgame ca kṛte rūpam| tittvāt svaritam| `kanyā' iti| `tilyaśikyamartyakāśmaryadhānyakanyārājanyamanuṣyāṇāmantaḥ' (phi.sū.4.76) ityantaḥ svaritam| `sāmānyaḥ' iti| sāmani sādhuḥ| `tatra sādhuḥ' (4.4.98) iti yatpratyayaḥ| kveti kiṃśabdāt saptamyantāt`kimo't' (5.3.12) ityat‌pratyayaḥ| `kvāti' (7.2.105) iti kvādeśaḥ|| 32. tasyādita udāttardhahrasvam| (1.2.32) ādau - āditaḥ, saptamyrathe tasiḥ| ayameva nirdeśo jñāpakaḥ-- `ādyādibhyastasirbhavati' ityatra| tena tasiprakaraṇe `ādyādibhyaḥ upasaṃkhyānam' (vā.634) ityetanna vkatavyaṃ bhavati| `arddhahrasvam' iti| hrasvasyārddhamityarthaḥ| `ardhaṃ napuṃsakam' (2.2.2) iti samāsaḥ| tataśca `paravalliṅgam' (2.4.26) ityādinā puṃlliṅgena bhavitavyam, hrasvaśabdasya puṃlliṅgatvāt, naitadasti; hrasvaśabdo hi pramāṇaviśeṣaṃ guṇamupādāya pravṛttaḥ, `guṇavanacānāñcāśrayaliṅgavacanāni' iti guṇavacanatvāc śuklaśabda eva hrasvaśabdastriliṅgaḥ| `hrasvaḥ' iti mātrikasya saṃjñā kṛtā, tasyaiva vibhāgaḥ syāt, na tu dīrghaplutayorityāśaṅkyāha-- `arddhahrasvam' ityādi| hrasvasyārddhamarddhamātrā bhavati, ato'rddhamātrā bhavati, ato'rddhahrasvagrahaṇenārddhamātropalakṣyate| tata eva ca tasyetyuktam| trayāṇāṃ hrasvadīrghaplutānāṃ svaritānāṃ nirdeśārtham| yadi cārddhahrasvagrahaṇamarddhamātropalakṣaṇam, atastrayāṇāṃ nirdeśo'rthavān bhavati; nānyathā| `hrasvagrahaṇamatantrama' iti| atantrapradhānam, upalakṣaṇārthatvāt| yathā kākebhyo dadhi rakṣyatāmityatrakākāḥ| tena sarveṣāmeva hrasvādīnāmeṣa svaritavibhāgo bhavati| nanvevamapyāṣṭamikasya svaritasya vibhāgo na sidhyati, tasyāsiddhatvāt, naitadevam; yasmāt paravidhiḥ pūrvavidhāvasiddhaḥ| na cāyaṃ vidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tasya vihitasya vibhāgākhyānārthaḥ| atha vā-- `na mu ne' (8.2.3) ityatra neti yogavibhāgāt siddhaṃ bhavati||.`evaśrirvā' iti| pūrvo bhāgo'yamudāttaḥ paṭutaraḥ| tenoparajyamānastadrūpatāmivāpannaḥ paro bhāgaḥ sphaṭikamaṇirivopadhānenoparaktaḥ śuddhenodāttena bhinnaśrutikatvādanudāttavyapadeśaṃ nārhati| udāttavyapadeśamapi nārhati; uparāgamātratvāt| tasmādekaśrutiriti kecit| anye tvāhuḥ-- pūrveṇa bhāgenānupajātarūpātiśayena noparajyate yadottarabhāgastadā svena rūpeṇa pratibhānādanudātta iti vyapadiśyate| yadā tūpadhānena sphaṭikamaṇiriva pūrveṇa
