bhāgena paṭīyasodāttenābhibhūyānurajyamānastadrūpatāmivopapadyate tadaikaśrutiriti vyapadiśyate| pūrvabhāgaśruterabhinnaikā tulyākārā śrutiryasyeti kṛtvā| na hi tadānīṃ pūrvottarayoḥ svaritaśrutiṃ prati kaścit bhedo'sti; dvayorapyudāttaguṇavattayā pratīyamānatvanāditi| 33. ekaśruti dūrātsambuddhau| (1.2.33) `ekaśruti vākyaṃ bhavati' iti| vākyagrahaṇena padapadaikadeśayornirāsaṃ karoti; tayoḥsambodhanaṃ pratyasāmarthyāt| vākyasya sambuddhau kartavyāyāṃ karaṇabhāvopagamādasti sāmarthyam| tatastasyaikaśrutyaṃ vidhīyate| kutaḥ punastadvākyamityāha-- `dūrāt sambodhayati yena' iti| etena sambuddhiṃ prati vākyasya karaṇabhāvo darśito bhavati| dūrāditi-- `dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca' (2.3.35) iti pañcamī| `sambodhanaṃ sambuddhiḥ' ityādinā sambuddhiritkayanvarthagrahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikaṃ sambuddhigrahaṇamiti darśayati| yadi pāribhāṣikyāḥ sambuddhergrahaṇaṃ syāt tadā `devā {brāhmaṇāḥ iti padaṃjarīpāṭhaḥ} brahmāṇaḥṭa ityatraikaśrutyaṃ na syāt; pāribhāṣikyāḥ sambuddherasattvāt| anvarthagrahaṇe tu bhavati; sambodhanalakṣaṇakriyārūpāyāḥ sambuddherihāpi vidyamānatvāditi bhāvaḥ| kutaḥ punaretadanvarthagrahaṇaṃ vyavasitam ? dūragrahaṇāt| anvarthagrahaṇe dūrādityanena sambuddhirutpadyate| `{paṃktiriyaṃ nāsti-kāśikā} dūrāt sambodhane karttavye' iti| tenārthavadbhavati dūraśabdasyapādānam| pāribhāṣikyāstu grahaṇe tadasambaddhameva syāt| na hyāmantritavibhkaterdūratvamasti| dūratvañca yadyapyanavasthitam, tathāpi yatra prākṛtaprayatnasaṃsthāpitaṃ vacanaṃ na śrūyate, tadiha dūraṃ veditavyam| `svarāṇām' ityādi| `{paṃktiriyaṃ nāsti-kāśikā}ekaśrutisvarūpākhyānamavibhāgaḥ' bhedatirodhānamityanantaraṃ vivaraṇam| udāttādisvaraviśeṣānupalabdhirakārādivarṇamātrāvabodha ekaśrutirityuktaṃ bhavati| `āgaccha bho māṇavaka devadattā3' iti| `dūrāddhūte ca' (8.2.84) ityatraivārthe plutaḥ, sa codāttaḥ; `vākyasya ṭeḥ plutaḥ udāttaḥ' (8.2.82) ityadhikārāt| tasyaikaśrutyodāttasya samāveśa iṣyate, plutanivṛttyartham| yathā cāsau labhyate tathā vakṣyati| pratyudāharaṇe traisvaryameva bhavatīti tatra ākāraḥ `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) `upasargāścābhivarjam' (phi.sū.4.81) ityudāttaḥ| gacchetyasya `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighātaḥ| bho iti `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' ityudāttaḥ| māṇavaka-- devadattaśabdayoḥ `āmantratasya ca' (8.1.19) ita nighātaḥ| 34. yajñakarmaṇyajapanyūṅkhasāmasu| (1.2.34) `agnirmūrdhā divaḥ' ityādi| `agi ragi gatyarthāḥ' (dhā.pā.146,144)| `vījyājvaribhyo niḥ' (da.u.1.18) ita varttamāne `aṅgernirnalopaśca' (da.u.1.20) iti nipratyayaḥ; nalopaśca bhavati| agniśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `murvī bandhane' (dhā.pā.575),`akanin yuvṛṣitakṣirājidhanvidyupratidivaḥ' (da.u.6.51) ityataḥ kaninniti varttamāne `śvannukṣanpūṣan‌plīhankledan‌snehan‌mūrdhanmajjannaryamanviśvapsanparijmanmātariśvanmaghavan' (da.u.6.55) iti mūrdhanśabdaḥ kaninpratyānto nipātita iti nipātanādādyudāttaḥ| vakārasya dhakāro'tra nipātanādeva| `divu krīḍādau' (dhā.pā.1107) ḍivin pratyayaḥ| ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| ḍityabhasyāpyanubandhakaraṇasāmarthyāt `ṭa eḥ' (6.4.143) iti ṭilopaḥ| `div' iti sthite `ūḍidampadādyappumraidyubhyaḥ' (6.1.171) iti vibhakterantodāttvam| kakucchabdaḥ `{phiṣonta udāttaḥ- iti mudritaṃ sūtram}prātipadikamantodāttaṃ bhavati' (phi.sū. 1.1)ityantodāttaḥ| patiśabdaḥ `pāterḍatiḥ' (da.u.1.27) iti ḍatipratyayāntaḥ pratyayasvareṇādyudāttaḥ, tataḥ kakudaḥ patiḥ kakutpatiriti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, sa`samāsasya' (6.1.223) ityantodāttatvam| `pratha prakhyāne' (dhā.pā.1553), `pratheḥ ṣivan saṃprasāraṇañca' (da.u.8.124)| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca'(4.1.41) iti pṛthivaśabdān‌ṅīṣ| pratyayasvareṇa dhātupratyaṅīṣa ādyudāttodāttaḥ| ṣaṣṭhyaikavacanam ṅas| `āṇnadyāḥ'ityanudāttatvam| savarṇadīrghaḥ| `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) iti yaṇādeśaḥ. `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' (6.1.174) iti vibhaktirudāttā| `ayama' iti| `idi paramaiśvarye' (dhā.pā.63) `idito num dhātoḥ' (7.1.58) iti num, `indeḥ kamirnalopaśca' (paṃ.u.596) iti kamipratyayo nalopaśca; idamśabdaḥ kamipratyayenāntodāttaḥ| sau parataḥ `ido'y puṃsi' (7.1.111) itīdama idrūpasyādeśaḥ| `apām' iti| `āplṛvyāptau' (dhā.pā.1260), `āpnoterhrasvaśca' (da.u.1.127) iti kvip, hrasvaśca, ṣaṣṭhībahuvanacam| `ūḍidaṃ pada' (6.1.171) iti vibhakterudāttatvam| tenāpāmityasyāntodāttatvam| `ri gatau' (dhā.pā.1404), `struribhyāṃ tuṭ ca' (da.u.9.62) ityasun pratyayaḥ| tuḍāgamaḥ| `retāṃsi' iti nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `jinvati' iti| `ji jaye' (dhā.pā.561) laṭ,śatrādeśaḥ| `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti vyatyayena śnupratyayaḥ|`huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke' (6.4.87) iti yaṇādeśaḥ| `ugitaśca' (4.2.6) iti ṅīp| `ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ' (7.3.107) iti hrasvaḥ| `eṅa hrasvāt sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sulopaḥ| `ye yajñakarmaṇi' (8.2.88) iti varttamāne `praṇavaṣṭeḥ'(8.2.89) iti praṇavādeśaḥ| sa ca pluta udāttaśca,`vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta udāttaḥ' (8.2.82) ityadhikarāt| praṇava ityokāram, oṅkāraṃ vā''cakṣate| praṇavasyodāttavidhānasāmarthyādasiddhatvācca padāduttarasya `āmantritasya ca' (8.1.19) ityanudāttaṃ na bhavati; śeṣasya tu bhavati| eṣu svareṣu prāpteṣvekaśrutirvidhīyate| `saṃpāṭhe mā bhūt' iti| saṃpāṭha- svādhyāyakālaḥ| `mamāgne' ityādi| `asu kṣapaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209), `yuṣyasimyāṃ madik' (da.u.6.50) iti madik| asmacchabdaḥ pratyayasveraṇāntodāttaḥ| ṣaṣṭhyekavacanasya `yuṣmadasamadbhyāṃ ṅaso'ś' (7.1.27) ityaśādeśa-, `tavamamau ṅasi' (7.2.96) ityasmado mamādeśaḥ| sthā4nivadbhāvādantodāttaḥ| `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam| `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) agniśabdasya `āmantritasya ca' (8.1.19) iti nighātaḥ| `varca dīptau' (dhā.pā.162), `asun' `gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvaratve prāpte, `antaḥ' (6.2.143) ityanuvartamāne `thāthaghañktājavitrakāraṇām' (6.2.144) ityantodāttatvam, saptamībahuvacane `bahuvacane jhalyet'(7.3.103) ityettvam, sthānivadbhāvādekāro'pabyadātta eva| `asa bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065) , loṭ, tip, `eruḥ' (3.4.86) ityutvam, adāditvācchapo luk| `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighātena `astu' śabdo'nudāttaḥ| `japo'nukaraṇamantraḥ' iti| `japa' ityakterarthakathanamanukaraṇamantra iti| anukṛtiḥ - anukaraṇam| sarvatra mantre sphuṭamuccāraṇamityanukaraṇamantraḥ| ata evāha-- `upāṃśuprayogaḥ' iti| yatā jale nimagnasya pāṭhaḥ| kvacidakaraṇamantra iti pāṭhaḥ| tatrāyamarthaḥ-- īṣat karaṇamuccāraṇaṃ yasya so'karaṇamantra iti; naña īṣadarthatvāt| eśabdo nipātaḥ| `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80)| `viśa praveśane' (dhā.pā.1424),`aśūpruṣilaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan' (da.u.125) iti kvapratyayāntatvādviśvaśabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| samañca tat atriṇañceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| samāsāntodāttatvam| `daha bhasmīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.991), loṭ,sip, serhirādeśaḥ,`ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti herluk, `tiṅaṅatiṅa' (8.1.28) iti nighātavidhānāt dahaśabdo'nudāttaḥ| kecid vahā3 iti plutāntaṃ paṭhanti; teṣāṃ sāhasamanicchatāṃ `sarvatra vibhāṣā pluto vaktavyaḥ' (ma.bhā.3.420) ityato vacanāt pluto vaktavyaḥ, sa codāttaḥ| anye tvākārāntaṃ paṭhanti, teṣāṃ chāndasatvādākāraḥ| hrasvo'pi hi varṇo vyatyayena dīrgho bhavati,`puruṣaḥ' `nārakaḥ' iti yathā| `vākyaviśeṣasthā gītayaḥ' iti| yathoktaṃ jaimininā-- `gītiṣu sāmākhyā' iti| gītiḥ - dhvaniviśeṣaḥ| karmagrahaṇaṃ kimartham,yajña ityevocyeta, yajñamantrāṇāṃ yajñakriyārthatvādyajñakarmaṇi bhaviṣyati ? satyametat; vispaṣṭārtha hi karmagrahaṇam| atha vā -- yo'pi na prasiddho yajñaḥ pañcayajanādiḥ, tatrāpi yathā syādityevamartham; anyathā `yajñe' icyucyamāne prasiddho yo yajño'śvamedhādisttatraiva syāt|| 35. uccaistarāṃ vā vaṣaṭkāraḥ| (1.2.35) `vaṣaṭśabdenātra vauṣaṭśabdo lakṣyate'iti| samānārthvādityabhiprāyaḥ| dvāvapi tau devānāṃ dānavacanau| yathā `vaṣaṭ' śabdena devānāṃ dānaṃ dīyate tathā vauṣaṭśabdenāpi| tasmāt samānārthatvāt `vaṣaṭ' śabdo `vauṣaṭ' śabdaṃ lakṣayati| kāraśabdagrahaṇamarthapadārthakatvaṃ vihāya śabdapadārthakatvena dānakriyāyāmupayujyamānasya tasyodāttataratvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| kāragrahaṇe śabdapadārthatayā dṛṣṭā, yathā evakāra iti| anye kāragrahaṇamanyasyāpi yathā syāditi varṇayanti| tena `astu śrauṣaṭ' ityatrāyamudāttataro bhavati| uccaistarāmiti prakarṣapratyayo vauṣaṭ‌śabde `brūhipreṣyaśrauṣaḍāvahānāmādeḥ' (8.2.91) iti yaḥ pluto vihitastadapekṣayā veditavyaḥ; sa hyudāttaḥ, `yājyāntaḥ' (8.2.90) ityanena ya udāttaḥ pluto vihitastadapekṣayā prakarṣasya sattvāt| atha vā-- prakarṣapratyāntaḥ svarūpaśabdāntaramevaitaditi| apare tvāhu-- `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (6.1.158) iti vacanena plutaścodāttaḥ| anyastvanudāttatara iti| 36. vibhāṣā chandasi|(1.2.36) `iṣe tvā' ityādi| `iṣu icchāyām' (dhā.pā.1351), `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip| iḍasyāstīti lugadhikārasya `apratyayaḥ' (vā. 492) ityanenopasaṃkhyānena akārapratyayaḥ, pratyayasvareṇādyudāttaḥ, iṣaśabdāt saptamyekavacanam, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) , `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) | yuṣmacchabdasya dvitīyāntasya `tvāmau dvitīyāyāḥ' (8.1.23) iti tvāmādeśaḥ, sa tvanudāttaḥ; `anudāttaṃ sarvamapādādau' (8.1.18) ityadhikārāt| `agne' iti| `āmantritasya ca' (6.1.198) iti ṣāṣṭhikamādyudāttatvam| āṅapūrvāt `yā prāpaṇe' (dhā.pā.1049) ityasmālloṭa, sip, serhirādeśaḥ, āṅa `upasargāścābhivarjam' (phi.sū.4.81) ityudāttaḥ| `tiṅaṅatiṅa' (8.1.28) iti yāhītyasya nighātaḥ| `vī gatyādiṣu' (dhā.pā.1019) `mantrevṛṣeṣapaca' (3.3.96) ityādinā ktinnudāttaḥ, caturthyekavacane pratyaye `gherṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇaḥ, ayādeśaḥ, dvāvapi sthānivadbhāvenodāttau, śeṣamanudāttam| agniśabdaḥ pūrvavannipratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| dvitīyaikavacane'mi pūrvatvam| `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5)| `īḍa stutau' (dhā.pā.1019)| anudāttettvādātmanepadam| `tiṅaṅatatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) itīḍeśabdasya nighātaḥ| puraḥ pūrvasmin deśa iti vigṛhya `pūrvāparādharāvarāṇāmasi puradhavaścaiṣām' (5.3.39) ityasipratyayaḥ, pūrvaśabdasya purādeśaḥ| puraḥ śabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| dadhāterniṣṭhāyāṃ `dadhāterhiḥ' (7.4.42) iti hirādeśaḥ| `puro'vyayam' (1.4.67) iti gatisaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| samāsasyāntodāttatve prāpte `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇa puraḥ śabdo'ntodāttaḥ| śaṃśabdaścāditvānnipātaḥ| nipātasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| asmacchabdasya ṣaṣṭhī, `bahuvacanasya vasna sau' (8.1.21) iti nasādeśo'nudāttaḥ,anudāttādhikārāt| divaḥ pacādyac|| pacādiṣu devaḍiti paṭhyate| 'ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) ṅīp anudāttaḥ,`yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ| `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) iti ṅībudāttaḥ| dvitīyābahuvacane `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam| `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5)| `ṣṭuñ stutau' (dhā.pā.1043), abhipūrvāt`ṛdorap' (3.3.57) ityap, guṇāvādeśau| varṇavyatyayena vakārasya yakāraḥ| `gatikāraka' (6.2.139) ittyuttarapadaprakṛtisvaratve prāpte `antaḥ' (6.2.143) iti vartamāne `thāthaghañktājavitrakāṇām' (6.2.144) ittyuttarapadāntodāttatvam| saptamyekavacam| `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) tasmāt `abhiṣṭaye' śabdo'ntodāttaḥ|| 37. na subrahmaṇyayāṃ svaritasya tūdāttaḥ| (1.2.37) `subrahmaṇyā nāma nigadaḥ' iti| apādabandhe gadatirvartate| apādabandhaṃ hi gadyamucyate| niśabdaḥ prakarṣe| yaduccairavicchinnamapādabandhaṃ mantravākyaṃ nigada iti tasya vyapadeśaḥ| tasya ca subrahmaṇyopalakṣamatvāt, `subrahmaṇyā' iti strīliṅganirdeśaḥ| `subrahmaṇyom' iti| subrahmaṇi sādhuḥ|`tatra sādhuḥ' (4.4.98) iti yat| `tat svaritam' (6.1.185) iti svaritatvam, `praṇavaṣṭeḥ' (8.2.89) ityoṅkāra ādeśa iti kecit, tadayuktam; `pādasya vārddharcasya vāntyamakṣaramupasaṃhṛtya tadādyakṣaraśeṣasya sthāne trimātramokāramoṅkāraṃ vā vidadhati taṃ praṇavamityācakṣate' iti {kāśikā-8.2.89}vakṣyati| na ca nigade pādavyavasthā, nāpyarddharcavyavasthā| tasmādośabdo'sti nipāto'narthakaḥ| tasya svaritena sahaikādeśaḥ svaritaḥ| `āmantritamādyudāttam' iti| `āmantritasya ca' (6.1.198) ityanena ṣāṣṭhikena| `tsayānenodāttaḥ kriyate' iti| nanu cāsiddho'sau svaritaḥ; vacanāt tasyāsiddhatvaṃ na bhavati| nanu ca vacanasya subrahmaṇyomiti prayojanaṃ vaktuṃ śakyam ? na hi samaste nigade subrahmaṇyāśabdanopalakṣite satīdamekamudāharaṇaṃ yuktam| `akāra udāttaḥ' iti| nipātasvareṇa| `tataḥ paro'nudāttaḥ svaritaḥ' iti| `tiṅaṅatiṅa' (8.1.28) iti nighāte kṛte, `udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' (8.4.66) ityanena| `paścima ekaḥ' iti| chakārākāraḥ| `catvāra udāttāḥ' iti| vakāracchākārābhyāmanye| `dvāvanudāttau' iti| vakāracchakārau| `dvitīyamakṣaram' iti| medhāśabdākāraḥ| `śeṣamanudāttam' iti| medhāśabde yāvacau tābhyāmanyat| `pūrveṇa' iti| medhātithermeṣetyanena| `tathaiva dve ādye akṣare udātte' iti| `yadi gaurāvaskandin' iti samastamāmantritamādyudāttamiti| athāpi gaureti śabdāntaramāmananti, tathāpi tasyāpi praveśe kṛte sakalasyāmantritasyādyudāttatve `udāttādanudāttasya' (8.4.66) ityādinā pūrvoktena vidhinā dve udātte bhavataḥ| `ahalyāyai jāra' iti| ṣaṣṭhyarthe caturthī, `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.3.62) ityatra `ṣaṣṭhyarthe caturthī vakvyā' (vā.142) ityupasaṅkhyānāt; `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti vyatyayena vā| `samastamāmantritamādyudāttam' iti| kauśikaśabdasya parāmantritānupraveśāt| `evaṃ gautamabruvāṇa' iti| etadapi kauśikabrāhmaṇetyanena tulyamityarthaḥ| `dvāvudāttau' iti| anantarayorudāharaṇayoḥ pratyekamādyavityarthaḥ| `śvaḥ śapabda udāttaḥ' iti| prātipadikasvareṇa| `udātta iti vartate' iti. `mantre vṛṣa' (3.3.96) ityādeḥ sūtrāt| `dvāvudāttau' iti| tau punarādī āgacchetyatra darśitau| `padāt paramāmantritaṃ nihanyate' iti| `āmantritasya ca' (8.1.19) ityanena| 38. devabrahmaṇoranudāttaḥ| (1.2.38) `dvayorapi padayorāmantritādyudāttatve kṛte' iti| `vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane bahuvacanam' (8.1.74) iti pūrvasyāvidyāmānatvāt `āmantritasya ca' (8.1.19) iti padāt parasyāpi nighāto na bhavati| tena dvayorapi pṛthageva ṣāṣṭhikamādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `śeṣanighātaḥ' iti| `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (6.1.158) ityanena| 39. svaritātsaṃhitāyāmanudāttānām| (1.2.39) `anudāttānām' iti jātau bahuvacanam| tena dvayorapi bhavati| `imamityantodāttam' iti| idaṃśabdasya kamipratyayāntatvāt pratyayasvareṇāntodātttvam, tasya tyadātyatve `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatve tasyāpyekādeśa (8.2.5) udāttenodāttatvāt| `vidhikala eva' iti| `temayāvekavacanasya' (8.1.22) iti vidhikāla eva nighātavidhānāt| `sarva eta āmantritanighātenānudāttāḥ' iti| yadyapi ``āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat' (8.1.72) iti, tathāpi meśabdāpekṣayā sarveṣāṃ nighātāpatteḥ| `prathamāmantritamādyudāttam' iti| `āmantritasya ca' (6.1.198) iti ṣāṣṭhikena| `tasya dvitīyamakṣaraṃ svaritam' iti| `udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' (8.4.66) iti| `tataḥ pareṣāmanudāttānām' iti| `nāmantrite samānādhikaraṇe sāmānyavacanam' (8.1.73) ityavidyamānatvasya pratiṣedhe sati māṇavakāt parayoḥ `āmantritasya ca' (8.1.19) iti nighātavidhānāt pare'nudāttāḥ| `avagrahe mā bhūta' iti| avagrahaḥ - asaṃhitāpāṭhaḥ| nanu ca svaritāditi pañcamī, tena `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityatra nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantararyārthakatvādavagrahe prāptireva nāsti, yathaiva hi varṇo vyavadhāyakastathā kālo'pi, tat kiṃ saṃhitāgrahaṇam? pañcamīnirdeśakālo na vyavadhāyaka iti jñāpanārtham| tena `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) ityatrāvagrahe'tiṅantāt paraṃ tiṅantaṃ nihanyate|| 40. udāttasvaritaparasya sannataraḥ| (1.2.40) `mātara ityanudāttaḥ' iti| anudāttatvaṃ tu vibhaktisvareṇa| mātara iti mātṛśabdājjas, `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' (7.3.110) iti guṇaḥ| jasaḥ sakārasya rutvam| tasyāpyaśabde śasante parataḥ `ato roraplutādaplute' (6.1.113) ityutvam| `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) `uḍidam' (6.1.171) ityādinā vibhakterantodāttatve kṛte `eṅaḥ padāntādati' (61.109) itiya okāraḥ, so'pi sthānivadbhāvenānudātto bhavati| `tasyodātte parabhūte' iti| vibhaktyakāre| `ikāro'nudāttaḥ' iti| sarasvatītiśabdasambandhī; `āmantritsaya ca' (8 .1.19) iti sarasvatīśabdasya nighātavidhānāt| `tasmānna nihanyate' iti| `anudāttaṃ sarvamapādādau' (8.1.18) ityatrāpādādāviti nighātapratiṣedhāt| `prathamamakṣaram' iti| śakārokāra udāttaḥ, `āmantritasya ca' (6.1.198) iti ṣāṣṭhikena| 41. apṛkta ekālpratyayaḥ| (1.2.41) `ghṛtaspṛk' iti| `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvam - śakārasya khakāraḥ, tasya jaśtvam - khakārasya gakāraḥ| `arddhabhāk' iti| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti jakārasya gakāraḥ| ubhayatra `vā'vasāne' (8.4.56) ita cartvaṃ kakāraḥ| ttarāpṛktasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām ` verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti vakāralopo bhavati| pratyudāharaṇeṣu hi tadabhāvānna bhavati| `darviḥ' iti| `dṛ vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1493) `vṛ dṛbhyāṃ vin' (da.u.1.23) iti vin| `jāgṛviḥ' iti| `jāgṛ nidrākṣaye' (dhā.pā.1072), `jṛśṛstṛjāgṛbhyaḥ kvin' (da.u.1.24) iti kvin| `surāḥ' iti| `ṣūñ abhiṣave' (dhā.pā.1247), surāṃ sunotīti `anyabhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip; surāsut, hrasvasya tuk| `tamācaṣṭe ' (vā. 201) iti ṇic| `ṇāviṣṭavat kāryaṃ prātipadikasya' (vā.813) iti ṭilopaḥ| surāsavateḥ punaḥ kvip, ṇilopaḥ, prathamaikavanacam, halṅyādinā(6.1.68) sulopaḥ; rutvavisarjanīyau| atrāpi ṇilope kṛte'sati pratyayagrahaṇe dhātukārasyāpṛktasaṃjñā syāt| tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ `halṅyābbhyaḥ' (6.1.68) iti dhātusakāralopaṛḥ syāt| nanu cāsatyapi pratyayagrahaṇe `pratyāpratyayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.72) iti saṃjñā vijñāsyate, tat kimarthaṃ pratyayagrahaṇam ? kriyate vispaṣṭārtham| athaikagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? alsamudāyasya mā bhūditi, naitadasti; algrahaṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, anyathā hyalgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt- yadi halsamudāyasyāpi saṃjñā syāt| evaṃ tarhyalgrahaṇenātra jātigrahaṇaṃ bhavatīti jñāpanārthamekagrahaṇamam| tena `halantācca' (1.2.10) ityatra yaduktam--`dambherhalgrahaṇasya jātivācakatvāt siddham' iti tadupapannaṃ bhavati| 42.tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇaḥ karmadhārayaḥ (1.2.42)| `tatpuruṣaḥ' iti samāsaviśeṣasyākhyā| sa ca eka evaśabdaḥ| anekasya ca śabdasya bhinnapravṛttinimittakasyaikasminnarthe vṛttiḥ -sāmānādhikāraṇyam| tataśca yatra bāhyena padena tatpurūṣasya sāmānadhikaraṇyam‌, tatraiveyaṃ saṃjñā syāt--rājapuruṣaḥ śobhana ityādau,asti hyatra tatpuruṣasya kenacit sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti; śobhanaśabdena saha| pācakavṛndāriketyādau tu na syāt, na hyatra tatpuruṣasya kenacit sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti; śabdāntarasya prayogābhāvāditi codyamapākarttumāha- `samānādhikaraṇapadaḥ' iti| samānam - abhinnam, ekamadhikaraṇam - vācyaṃ yeṣāṃ padānāṃ tāni samānādhikaraṇāni padāni, tānyāśrayabhūtāni yasya tatpuruṣasya sa samānādhikaraṇapadastatpuruṣaḥ| etena tatpuruṣārthānāṃ padānāṃ samānādhikaraṇatvādupacāreṇa tatpuruṣo'tra sūtre samānādhikaraṇaśabdenokta iti darśayati| kathaṃ punarbāhyanyapadāpekṣayā tatpuruṣasya mukhye sāmānādhikaraṇye sambhavati satyaupacārikasya grahaṇamupapadyate ? `karmadhārayaḥ' iti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇāt| iha hi lāghavārthatvāt kasaṃjñākaraṇasya, laghīyasyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ karttavyāyāṃ `karmadhārayaḥ' iti mahatīṃ saṃjñāṃ kurvatā-- `anyo'pyatra kaścit viparyayaḥ saṃjñāyāmāśritaḥ' ityeṣo'rthaḥ sūcitaḥ| tena `gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasampratyayaḥ' (vyā.pa.4) iti mukhyasya samānādhikaraṇasya grahaṇaṃ na vijñāyate| `samānābhidheyaḥ' iti. tadarthānāṃ padānāṃ samānābhidheyatvāt tatpuruṣo'pyupacāreṇa samānābhidheya ityuktaḥ| `paramarājyam, uttamarājyam' iti| `sanmahat' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāsaḥ| karmadhāraye sati `akarmadhāraye rājyam' (6.2.130) ityuttarapadādyudāttamatvaṃ na bhavati| `pācakavṛndārikā' iti| vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ' (2.1.62) iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `pācikābhāryaḥ' iti| bahuvrīhirayam| tenātra `na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) iti pratiṣedho bhavatyeva| `brāhmaṇarājyam' iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'yam| tenātra samāsāntodāttameva na bhavati, api tūttarapadādyudāttatvam|| 43. prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam| (1.2.43) `samāse' ityadhikaraṇanirdeśo'yam| kaṣṭaśritādayaḥ samāsāḥ na kiñcit prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ śabdarūpamasti| tathā hi-- samāse kṛte tata eva samāsād vibhaktirutpadyate, na tu tatra sthācchabdāt| na ca vākyakāle samāsārthāt padād yā prathamotpannā tadāśrayaṃ prathamānirdiṣṭatvaṃ samāsāvayavasya kalpayituṃ yuktam, yataḥ `samāse' ityadhikaraṇanirdeśo'yam| tatra samāse kṛte yasmāt prathamotpadyate, tadeva samāse prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ bhavati; na tu yasmāt vākyakāle vibhaktikāle vibhaktirutpadyate| taddhi vākya eva prathamānirdiṣṭam, na tu samāse; prāgeva samāsāt tasya prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt| tataśca samāse kṛte prathamānirdiṣṭasya saṃjñino'sambhavāt saṃjñā na sambhavītyetaccodyamapākartumāha- `prathamayā vibhaktyā yannirdiśyate' iti| samāsārthaṃ yacchāstraṃ tat samāsaśāstraṃ gṛhyate| tatra prathamānirdiṣṭasyeyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate, na tu kaṣṭaśritādau; samāse prathamānirdiṣṭasyāvidyāmānatvāt vidyate ca samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ saṃjñīti kutaḥ saṃjñāyā aprasiddhiḥ ? kathaṃ punaḥ `samāse' ityucyamāne samāsaśāstre yat prathamayā nirdiśyate tasya saṃjñitvaṃ labhyata ityata āha-- `samāse' iti| `samāsaśāstraṃ gṛhyate iti| kathaṃ punaḥ `samāse' ityucyamāne samāsaśāstraṃ grahītuṃ śakyam ? tādarthyāt tatra samāsaśabdasya pravṛtteḥ| bhavati hi tādarthyāt tāvacchabdyam , yathā-- pradīpārthā mallikā `pradīpaḥ' iti, indrārthā sthūṇā `indraḥ' iti| kaṣṭaśritādiṣūpasarjanasaṃjñayāyāḥ kāryam-- `upasarjanaṃ pūrvam' (2.2.30) iti pūrvanipātaḥ| tatredaṃ codyate-- rājñaḥ kumārīṃ paśya rājakumārīṃ paśyetyatra rājan‌śabdaḥ `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) iti samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭaḥ; `dvitīyā śritātītapatita' (2.1.24) iti dvitīyāsamāsaśāstre kumārīśabdaśca| samasāśāstre tatrobhayorapyasyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ pūrvanipātāniyama upasarjanahrasvasvatvañcetyetaddoṣadvayaṃ prāpnotīti| iha ca rājñaḥ kumāryāḥ svaṃ rājakumārīsvamiti dvayorapi ṣaṣṭhyantayoḥ samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭatvādubhayorapyupasarjanasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tadeva doṣadvayaṃ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmādusarjanamiti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇasyaitadeva prayojanam-- anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeteti| apradhanāmupasarjanam, pradhānamanupasarjamiti| apradhānañca pradhānamapekṣate; sambandhiśabdatvāt| tatra samnabdhādetavagantavyaṃ yat prati yadapradhānaṃ tat pratitadupasarjanamiti| śritādīṃścāpekṣya dvitīyāntamupasarjanaṃ bhavati, na tu dvitīyāntamātram| na ceha śritādayaḥ santi| rājñaḥ kumāryāḥ svaṃ rājakumārīsvamityātrāpyeṣa parīhāraḥ| atrāpi kumārīśabdamapekṣya rājanśabdasyāprādhānyam; na tu rājan‌śabdamapekṣya kumārīśabdasya| tasmāt rājan‌śabdasyopasarjanasaṃjñā, na tu kumārīśabdasya| yadi hyanvarthasaṃjñeyam, pācakavṛndārikā, puruṣavyāghraḥ, ardhapippalī, pūrvakāyaḥ-- ityeteṣu pūrvapadārtha eva pradhānamiti pācikādīnāmiha prādhānyam| ato yadyapyete `vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam' (2.1.62), `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge' (2.1.56), `ardhaṃ napuṃsakam' (2.2.2), `pūrvāparādharottaramekadeśikanaikādhikaraṇe' (2.2.1) ityeteṣu samāsaśāstreṣu prathamānirdiṣṭāḥ, tathāpi teṣāmupasarjanasaṃjñā na prāpnoti; kutaḥ ? teṣāṃ prādhānyāt| evaṃ tarhyuttarasūtre'nuktasamuccayārthatvāccakārasya bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| anyastvevaṃ manyate-- `pācakavṛndāriketyevamādiṣu pūrvokteṣu samāseṣvādyau `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam' (2.1.57), `upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ' (2.1.55) ityetābhyāmeva siddhau; śeṣau tu `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) ityanenaiva| tasmāt `vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ' (2.1.62) ityādīnāṃ na tadartha ārambhaḥ; kiṃ tarhi ? upasarjana saṃjñārthaḥ; tenāsatyapi pācikādīnāmapradhānatve teṣāmiyaṃ saṃjñā bhaviṣyati" iti, etaccāsamyak, tathā hi -- `pūjyamānam', `sāmānyāprayoge', `napuṃsakam', `ekādhikaraṇam'-- ityetān viśeṣān vakṣyāmītyetadartha ārambhaḥ syāt| sati caitadartha ārambhe'trāpradhānasyopasarjanasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā pradhānasya na syāt|| 44. ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte| (1.2.44) apradhamānirdiṣṭārtho'yamārambhaḥ| vibhaktiśabdaḥ supāṃ vācakaḥ, vibhāgavacano vā| kārakaśaktirvibhāgaḥ--vibhajyate prātipadikārtho'nayeti kṛtvā| `samāse vidhīyamāne' iti| samāsārthavākyakāle| tadā hi tasya samāsasya vidhīyamānatā bhavati| etena samāsagrahaṇamanuvartamānaṃ samāsārthe vākye varttate, na samāsaśāstra iti darśayati| samāsaśāstre hi sarvameva śabdarūpamekavibhaktikameva bhavatītyekavibhaktigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| sarvameva hi prātipadikaṃ paryāyeṇaikayā vibhaktyā prayujyate| tasmādekavibhaktigrahaṇasāmarthyādavadhāraṇamatra vijñāyata ityata āha-- `yanniyatavibhaktikam' iti| tadeva spaṣṭīkurvannāha-- `dvitīye sambandhiti' ityādi| `pūrvapadenānāvibhaktike'pi' iti| niṣkrāntaśabdaḥ kartṛśaktyupasarjanībhūtaṃ dravyamāha| taccānekasādhanaśaktyupacitamiti kriyāntarasambandhādenekasādhanavibhaktikaṃ bhavati| `uttarapadaṃda tu pañcamyantameva bhavati' iti| niṣakramaṇakriyāpekṣayā''virbhūtāpādānaśaktikatvāt| `niṣkauśāmbiḥ' ityatropasarjanasaṃjñākāryam`gāstriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hasvatvam| atha niso'tra kenopasarjanasaṃjñā vidhīyate, yayo'sya pūrvanipātaḥ ? pūrvasūtreṇeti cet, naitadasti; tenāpradhānasyopasarjanasaṃjñāvidhānāt, nisaścātra prādhānyāt| evaṃ tarhi cakārasyānuktasamuccāyārthatvāt bhaviṣyati| anye tvāhuḥ-- mā bhūnnisa upasarjanasaṃjñā, asatyāmapi tasyāṃ pūrvanipāto bhaviṣyati, `ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte' (1.2.44) iti vacanāditi, etaccāyuktam; pūrvanipāte hi karttavya ekavibhaktikasyopasarjanasaṃjñā nāstyeva| tatra yadi nisa upasarjanasaṃjñā na syāt, tadodaharaṇe dvayorapyasatyāṃ tasyāṃ paryāyeṇāniyaḥ pūrvanipātaḥ prasajyeta| atha kathamardhapippalyādīnāmūpasarjanasaṃjñā na bhavati ? atra ca `vibhāṣā cchandasi' (1.2.36) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ mamḍūkaplutanyāyenānuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenārdha pippalyā ardhapippalītyādau viṣaye pippalyādīnāmekavibhaktiyuktānāmapyusarjanasaṃjñā na bhavati| yadi hi syāt, tadā hrasvatvaṃ syāt|| 45. arthavadagadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipadikam| (1.2.45) `abhidheyavacano'yamarthaśabdaḥ' iti| etena prayojanādivacanādvayavacchinatti| arthaśabdo hi prayojanavacano'pyasti, yathā-- anenārthanāgataḥ, anena prayojaneneti gamyate| nivṛttivacano'pyassi, yathā-- maśakārartho dhūma iti, maśakanivṛttyartha iti gamyate| dhanavacano'pyasti,yathā--arthavān devadatta iti, dhanavāniti gamyate| abhidheyavacano'pyasti, yathā-- asya vacanasyāyamartha iti, idamasyābhidheyamiti gamyate| iha tvabhidheyavacanasyaiva grahaṇam| tat punarabhidheyaṃ jātiguṇakriyādravyabhedena caturvidham|ata eva catuṣṭayī śabdānāṃ pravṛttirbhavati| tatra jātiśabdānāṃ jātirabhidheyā-- gauriti| yadyarthavataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā vidhīyate tadā'bhāvavacanaśaśaviṣāṇādiśabdānāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā nopapadyate, arthābhāvāt, naitadasti; `arthaśabdo'bhidheyavacanaḥ' (kā.1.2.45) ityuktam, abhāvo'pyabhidheyo bhavatyeva| anyathā hyarthābhāvāditīdaṃ vacanamanuccāraṇīyaṃ syāt, anarthakatvāt, na hyanarthakaṃ vacanaṃ prayogarhati| tasmādabāvavacanānāmapi prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavatyeva| `nāntasyādhermā bhūt' iti| nanu cādhāturiti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, tathā hi `vana sambhkatau' (dhā.pā.463), `dhana dhānye' (dhā.pā.1104) ityetayoḥ dharātvorete rūpe, naitadasti; avyutpannāvapi vanadhanaśabdau staḥ, tayorevāyaṃ prayogaḥ| atra yadi nāntasyāvadheḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā syāt tadā subutpattiḥ syāt, tataśca padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ nalopaḥ syāt| nanu ca `adhātuḥ' `apratyayaḥ'-- naitadasti; anarthakasyāpi dhātorvidyamānatvāt yathā-- `iṅa adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1046), `ik smaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1047) iti-- etayoradhipūrvayorevārthavattvam, na kevalayoḥ| yastu gaṇapāṭhe'nayorarthanirdeśaḥ, sa samudāyārthamavayave'dhyāropya kṛta iti veditavyam| adhyāropitārthayorapi tayorgaṇapāṭhasāmarthyāddhātusaṃjñā bhavatyeva| evaṃ pratyayo'pyanarthako'pyasti| yathā-- `yāvādibhyaḥ kan' (5.4.29), yāva eva yāvaka iti| na hyatra pratyayasyānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śakyate'rthavattvaṃ pratyetum| vināpi tena kanpratyayena yāvaśabdādeva tadarthaḥ pratīyayate| tasmādarthavaditi yuktamuktam| `ahan' iti| adāditvācchapo luk, tipo halṅyādinā (6.1.68) lopaḥ, aṭ| sa ca hantigrahaṇena gṛhyata iti kṛte'pi tasmin hantirdātureva| atra vinā dhātugrahaṇena prāgeva pratyayotpatteḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā syāt| nalopastu pratyayotpattau padatve satyuttarakālam| atha vā-- prātipadikasaṃjñā'pi pratyayotpatteruttarakālameva syāt, tasmāddhātugrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| nanu cātra pratyayalakṣaṇena `apratyayaḥ' iti pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam,tat kimadhātugrahaṇena ? naitadasti; prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ nalopaḥ kāryaḥ, nalope ca `na ṅisambuddhayoḥ' (8.2.8) iti pratiṣedho jñāpakaḥ- pratyayalakṣaṇena `apratyayaḥ' iti pratiṣedho na pravartata iti| yadi hyapratyaya iti pratyayalakṣaṇena he rājannityevamādiṣu prātipadikasaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, `na ṅisambuddhayoḥ' (8.2.8) iti pratiṣedho anarthakaḥ syāt; prāptyabhāvāt| atha bhid-chid-lūḥ- pūrityevamādīnāṃ kathaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā, yāvatā kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahatīti dhātava evaita iti, atrādhāturiti pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; mā bhūdanena, kṛdantatvāduttara sūtreṇa bhaviṣyati| na cottarasyāḥ prāpterayaṃ bādhakaḥ; vākyāntarasthatvāt| `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante nottarān' (vyā.pa.10) iti vā| `kāṇḍe, kuḍye' iti| prathamādvivacanānte ete rūpe| `napuṃsakācca' (7.1.19) iti śībhāvaḥ| atra ca `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya' (bhā.pa.sū.7) iti tadantasya pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, na pratyayamātrasya| nanu ca `suptiṅantaṃ padam' (1.4.14) ityatrāntagrahaṇena `anyatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti' iti jñāpitatvāt `apratyayaḥ' iti pratyayāntasya pratiṣedho na labhyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; saṃjñāvidhau sa pratiṣedhaḥ, na cāyaṃ saṃjñāvidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pratiṣedhavidhiḥ| atha kimarthamapratyaya ita pratiṣedha ucyate, yāvatottarasūtre kṛttaddhitagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati-- `kṛttaddhitāntasyaiva prātipadikasaṃjñā, nānyapratyayāntasya-- kāṇḍe,kuḍye ityevamādeḥ'iti ? naitadasti, asatyasmin pratiṣedhe'nyatra`saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti' iti kṛttaddhitayoreva prātipadikasaṃjñā syānna tadantasya; tadantasya caiveṣyate-- bhicchillūḥpūrityevamādīnāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñārtham| satyapratyaya ityetasmin pratiṣedhe prāpte yathā kṛttaddhitāntasya prātipadikasaṃjñā labhyate tathottarasūtre pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ| nanu ca `kāṇḍe' `kuḍye'-- ityetayoḥ pūrvameva prakṛteḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā pravṛttā, vibhaktyā ca sahaikādeśe kṛte'ntādivadbhāvādastyeva prātipadikatvamiti satyapyapratyayagrahaṇe hrasvatvaṃ prāpnotyeva, naitadasti; apratyayagrahaṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati,anyathā hyapratyayagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `adhāturapratyayaḥ' iti dviṣpratiṣedhaḥ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣāśaṅkānirāsārthaḥ `adhātupratyayaḥ' ityucyamāne ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣo'pyāśaṅkyeta-- dhātoryaḥ pratyayasya na bhavatīti|| 46. kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca| (1.2.46) atra `anyatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagraṇe tadantavidhirnāsti' ityatannopatiṣṭhate, yasmādapratyaya iti pratiṣedhe prāpte vacanamidam| `apratyayaḥ' iti pratyayāntasya pratiṣedhaḥ uktaḥ| tena yatra saṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhastatreyamārabhyamāṇā tadantasyaiva bhavatītyetaccetasi kṛtvā''ha-- `apratyaya iti pūrvasūtre paryudāsāt kṛdantasya' ityādi| atha samāsagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā samāsasyārthavattvāt pūrveṇaiva saṃjñā siddhetyata āha-- `arthavatsamudāyānām' ityādi| nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhīyam-- arthavanto ye samudāyāsteṣāṃ madhye samāsasyārthavataḥ samudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā yathā syāditi niyamārthaṃ samāsagrahaṇam| yadyevam, prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyārthavataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā na syāt-- bahupaṭava uccakairiti ? ko'tra doṣaḥ ? `citaḥ' (6.1.163) ityasmin sūtre citaḥ saprakṛterbahujakajarthamiti vacanādetadvayavasthāpyate-- prakṛtimantarbhāvya citsvaro vidhīyata iti| bahupaṭava ityatra bahuci vihite yadi prātipadikasaṃjñā na syāt,tadā prātipadikatvābhāvāt yathā subutpattirna syāt tathotpannāyā api vibhakteḥ `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti lukā na bhavitavyam| tataśca bahupaṭava ityatra jasvibhakterakārasya svaraḥ syāt; ukārasya ceṣyate| prātipadikatve tu sati pūrvotpannāyā vibhakterluki kṛte yā'nyā vibhaktirutpadyate, sā bahujutpatteruttarakālabhāvinītvāt prakṛtau nāntarbhavati| tena tāmutsṛjya pūrvo bhāgaḥ svarabhāga bhavati| ata ukārasya svaraḥ sidhyati| uccakairityatra prātipadiktavābhāvākajvataḥ samudāyādvibhaktirna syāt, tasyāñcāsatyāṃ padatvaṃ na syāt| tataścoccakaiḥ paṭhatīti `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighāto na syāt| tasmāt prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā vaktavyā ? na vaktavyā, yasmāt tulyajātīyānāṃ niyamaḥ, tena tulyajātīyo niyamena vyavacchidyate| tulyajātīyaścaca samāsasubantasamudāyādanyaḥ vākyasamudāya eva, na tu prakṛtipratyayasamudāyaḥ| tenāyaṃ tas niyamena vyavacchedo na kariṣyate, naitadasti; subantāsubantasamudāyo'pi samāso'sti, yathā-- prakarttā, prakāraka iti| atra hi `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ samāsavacanaṃ prāk‌subutpatteḥ' (vyā.,pa.vṛ 138) iti kṛdantenāsubantena gatikārakaṃ subantaṃ samasyate, tena subantāsubantasamudāyo'yaṃ samāsa iti tulyajātīyasyāpi niyame vijñāyamāne bahupaṭavaḥ, uccakairityatra prātipadikasaṃjñā na syāt| evaṃ tarhyācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati-- bhavati prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasya prātipadikasaṃjñeti; yadayamapratyaya iti pratyayāntasya pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti|| 47. hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya| (1.2.47) `napuṃsakaliṅge' iti| nupuṃsakaṃ liṅgaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| sa punarnapuṃsakaliṅgo'rtho dravyabhūto veditavyaḥ; na puṃsakiliṅgasya dravyadharmatvāt| `alo'ntyasya' iti| `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti paribhāṣā| `grāmaṇīḥ' iti| `satsūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip| `agragrāmābhyāṃ ca' (kā.vā.5064) ityupasaṃkhyānāṇṇatvam| kāṇḍe, kuḍye-- ityatrāpi `apratyayaḥ' iti pratiṣedhātprātipadikasaṃjñā nāsti, tena hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati| nanu ca prātipadikāprātipadakayorekādeśo'ntādivadbhāvāt prātipadikagrahaṇena gṛhyate, tataśca kriyamāṇe prātipadikagrahaṇe hrasvatvaṃ prāpnotītyata āha-- `prātipadikagarhaṇasamarthyāt' ityādi| iha yadantavadbhāvaḥ syāt, prātipadikagarhaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt,vyavacchedyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ|| 48. gostriyorupasarjanasya| (1.2.48) `strīti strīpratyayagrahaṇam' iti| atra hetumāha-- `svaritatvāt' iti| strīgrahaṇasyeha svaritatvaṃ kriyata iti svaritenādhikārādavagatirbhavati| tena `striyām' (4.1.3) ityadhikṛtya ye pratyayā vihitāṣṭāvādayasteṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati; na strarthābhidhāyinaḥ śabdamātrasya, nāpi strīśabdasyaiva svarūpasya upasarjanagrahaṇaṃ dvayorviśeṣaṇamityādeḥ spaṣṭīkaraṇayāha-- `gorupasarjanasya, strīpratyayasyopasarjanasya' ityādi| tābhyāṃ prātipadikasyatyāderapi sphuṭīkaraṇāyāha--`upasarjanagośabdāntasya' ityādi| upasarjanagośabdo'nto yasyeti vigrahaḥ| evaṃ gośabdenopasarjanena strīpratyayena ca prātipadikasya tadantavidho sati goḥ kulaṃ gokulam, rājñaḥ kumāryāḥ putro rājakumārīputra ityatra gośabdya kamārīśabdasya ca hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati, anyathā ihāpi syāt| bhavati hyatra gośabdasya rājakumārīśabdasya copasarjanatvamityabhiprāyaḥ| `citraguḥ' iti| `prathamānirdiṣṭam' (1.2.43) ityādinā gośabdasayopasarjanasaṃjñā, niṣkośāmbirityādau tu `ekavibhakti cāpūrva' (1.2.44) ityādinā| `atitantrīḥ' ityādi| `tatri kuṭumbadhāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1678), `idito num' (7.1.58), `avitṛstṛtantrībhyaḥ' (da.u.1.82) itīḥ- tantrīḥ| `lakṣa darśanāṅkanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.ta1538), `lakṣermuṭ ca' (da.u.1.84) iti muṭ īpratyayaśca-- lakṣmīḥ| `śriñ sevāyām' (dhā.pā. 897), `kviba vacipracchi'(vā.288) ityādinā kvip, dīrghaḥ- śrīḥ| `atyādayaḥ krāntyādyarthe dvitīyayā' (vā.91) iti prādisamāsaḥ| yadi strīti stryadhikāravihitāḥ pratyayā gṛhyante tataśca `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya' (bho.sū.7) iti tadantagrahaṇe'tirājakumārīrityatra hrasvatvaṃ na sidhyati; na hi rājakumāraśabdāt `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti ṅīppratyayo vihitaḥ,kiṃ tarhi ? kumāraśabdāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; eṣā paribhāṣā `yasmātpratyayavidhistadādi' (1.4.13) ityatra sūtre pratipāditā| tatra ca `vā''mi (1.4.5) ityataḥ `vā' grahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena vyavasthivibhāṣāvatīyaṃ kvacinnopatiṣṭhata eva| atha vā-- `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' (1.2.46) ityataścakāro'nuvartate,sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenātirājakumārirityatrāpi hrasvatvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `īyaso bahuvrīhau pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| īyasantādyo vihitaḥ strīpratyayaḥ,tadantasya bahuvrīhau pratiṣedha iti| kathaṃ punarasau labhyate ? ` vibhāṣā cchandasi' (1.2.36) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| na caivaṃ satyatiprasaṅgaḥ; vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt| `bahuśreyasī' iti| atiśayena praśasyeti `dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunanau' (5.3.57) itīyasunpratyayaḥ| `praśasyasya' (5.3.60) iti praśasyaśabdasyeyasuni parataḥ śrādeśo bhavati, `prakṛtyaikāc' (6.4.163) iti prakṛtivadbhāvaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp| bahvyaḥśreyasyo yasyeti bahuśreyasīti `nadyutaśca' (5.4.153) iti kap na bhavati; `īyasaśca' (5.4.156) iti kapo niṣedhāt| 49. luktaddhitaluki| (1.2.49) adarśanaṃ (1.1.60) luk, taccābhāvaḥ| abhāve pauvāparyannopapadyate| tasmāllukīti sati saptamīyam, na parasaptamīti matvāha''ha-- `taddhitalukisati' iti| `pañcendraḥ' iti| `taddhitārtha' (2.1.51) ityādinā samāse kṛte `sā'sya devatā' (4.2.24) ityaṇ, tasya `dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) iti luk, `indravaruṇa' (4.1.49) ityādinā vihitasya ṅīṣo'nena luk| tasminnivṛtte sanniyogaśiṣṭānāmekatarāpāya ubhayorapyapāya ityānuko nivṛttiḥ| `pañcaśaṣkuliḥ' iti| `adhyarddhapūrvadvigorlugasaṃjñāyam' (5.1.28) ityārhīyasya ṭhakastena krītārthe vihitasya luk| `āmalakam' iti| āmalakyāḥ phalaṃ vikāra iti `nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ' (4.3.44) ityañ| pūrvavalluk| śaṣkulī, badarī, āmalakī, kuvalī-- gaurādipāṭhadete ṅīṣantāḥ| `gārgīkulam'iti| gārgyaśabdāt `yañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīp; `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ; `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) iti yakārasya ca lopaḥ, gārgyāḥ kulamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, ṣaṣṭhyā luk| gārgīśabdasya samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭatvācchāstrīyamupasarjanatvam, mūlodāharaṇeṣu tvindraṇī prabhṛtīnāṃ laukikamātropasarjanamatvam| ubhayagatiriha śāstre sambhavatīti laukikamapradhānatvamupasarjanatvam| loke hyapradhānamupasarjanamityacyate| `gārgītvam' ityatrāpi gārgīśabdasya laukikamevopasarjanatvam. `avantī, kuntī kurūḥ' iti| avanterapatyaṃ gotraṃ strī, kunterapatyaṃ gotraṃ strī-- `vṛddhetkośalājādāññyaṅa' (4.1.171) | kurorapatyaṃ strī-- `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.172) iti ṇyaḥ| `striyāmavantikuntikurubhyaśca' (4.1.176) iti luk| avantikuntuśabdābhyām, `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) iti ṅīṣ| kuruśabdāt `ūṅutaḥ' (4.1.66) ityūṅa| atra ṅīṣā ūṅā ca taddhitārtho gotrāpatyaṃ strīpradhānamevābhidhīyata ityupasarjanatvaṃ nāsati laukikam| śāstrīyamapi nāsti; aprathamānirdiṣṭāt samāsaśāstra iti|| 50. idgoṇyāḥ| (1.2.50) `pañgoṇiḥ' iti| `taddhitārtha' (2.1.51) iti samāse kṛta ārhīyaṣṭhak| tasya pūrvavalluk| `iditi yogavibhāgaḥ' iti. etasyedgrahaṇameva liṅagam| tathā hi goṇī ityetāvati sūtre hrasvagrahaṇānuvṛttau hrasvatve kṛte pañcagoṇiriti siddhyatyeva;kimidgrahaṇena ? tadetadidgrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ yogavibhāgarthaṃ vijñāyate| nanu cānantarasūtrālluka evānuvṛttiḥ syāt, na hrasvasya, naitadasti; luganuvṛttau hi sūtramidamanarthakaṃ syāt; luko'nantarasūtreṇaiva siddhatvāt| tasmāddhrasvagrahaṇamevānuvarttate, na luggrahaṇam| `pañcasūciḥ' iti| pañcagoṇirityanena tulyam| yadi yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tadātiprasaṅgaḥ syāt| anyeṣāmapi prasajyata ityata āha-- `sa ca' ityādi| yadi sarvatrettvaṃ pūrvayogeṇaiva syāt, tadā `goṇyāḥ' iti vacanamanarthakam| tasmādagoṇīgrahaṇādasyāsarvaviṣayatvam| tena yogavibhāgaḥ sūcīviṣaya eva, nānyaviṣaya iti| taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghānivṛttyartham| dīrghasya dīrghakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| ato vinā taparakaraṇena dīrgho na bhaviṣyīti cet, na; lughrasvabādhanārthatvāddīrghakaraṇasya| bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇān na gṛhṇātīti, tasmādadīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ taparatvaṃ nopapadyata iti cet, na; tasyābhāvyamānatvāt| apūrvasya hi vidhānaṃ bhāvyamānatvam| na cātrāpūrvasya vidhānam| tathā hi-- lugghrasvayoḥ prāptayoḥ punaḥ sa eva īkāraḥ pratiprasūyate| tasmāt taparakaraṇaṃ karttavyam|| 51. lupi yaktavadvayaktivacane| (1.2.51) abhidheyasya liṅgasaṅakhyayoḥ prāptayorayamārambhaḥ| lubiti pratyayasyādarśanam,taccābhāvātmakam| na cābhāve vyaktivacanayoḥ śakyate'tideśaḥ karttum| tasmāllupsaṃjñayā luptasya pratyayasyārtho lupśabdena vivakṣita iti matvā'ha--`lupīti lupsaṃjñayā' ityādi| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate, yāvatā pratyayādarśanasyaiṣā saṃjñā, na tu pratyayārthasya ? sāhacaryāt| sāhacaryyantu yatra lup, tatrāvaśyaṃ pratyayārthasya sadbhāvāt| `yuktavaditi niṣṭhāpratyayena ktavatunā prakṛtyartha ucyate' iti| atra kāraṇamāha-- `sa hi' ityādi| yunakti - abhisambadhnāti, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣaṇasambandhenātmasambandhinaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| tatra `tasya nivāsaḥ' ityādi pratyayārtho viśeṣyaḥ,pañcālādiśabdasyārthaḥ prakṛtyartho viśeṣaṇam| tena hi pūrva vijñātena svāmyantaravyavacchedena pratyayārtho viśiṣyate| `atha vā' ityādi| pūrvaṃ `yujir yoge' (dhā.pā.1444) ityasmāddhāto ktavatupratyaye sati yuktavadityatadrūpaṃ pradarśitam, idānīṃ tasyaiva dhātoḥ ktapratyayādvatipratyaye sati yuktavadityetadrūpaṃ darśayati| yadyapi dviṣṭhatvāt sambandhasya -- yathā pratyayārthena prakṛtyartho yuktaḥ, tathā prakṛtyarthenāpi pratyayārthaḥ; tathāpi pratyayārthasambandhinorvyaktivacanayoḥ pratyayārtha evātideśo'narthaka iti prakṛtyartha evātra yuktaśabdena vivakṣita iti matvā'ha-- `yuktaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ' iti| `saptamyarthe vatiḥ' iti| lupīti saptamīnirdeśāt| vyaktiśabdaḥ prādurbhāvādāvapyarthe varttate, vacanaśabdo hi bhāṣaṇādiṣu, atastatsaṃpratyayo mā bhūdityata āha-- `vyaktivacane' iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ pūrvācāryanirdeśa āśrīyata ityatra āha-- `tadīyam' ityādi| kuta etadityata āha-- `tathā ca' ityādi| na hi svakīyasyaiva pratyākhyānaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ| `pañcālāḥ kṣatriyāḥ' iti| pañ‌cālasyāpatyāni bahūnīti vivakṣāyām `janapadaśabdāt kṣatriyādañ' (4.1.168), tasya `tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām' (2.4.62) iti luk| `teṣāṃ nivāso janapadaḥ' ityasya vakṣyamāṇena `pañcālānām' ityanena sambandhaḥ| `pañcālānāṃ nivāso janapadaḥ' iti| tasya `janapade lup' (4.2.81) iti luk| kuruśabdādapatyārthe `karunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.172) iti ṇyapratyayaḥ| matsyādiśabdebhyo'pyapatyārthe `dvayañmagadha' (4.1.170) ityādināṇ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| `lavaṇaḥ sūpaḥ' iti| lavaṇena saṃsṛṣṭa iti prāgvahatīṣṭhak (4.4.1), tasya `lavaṇālluk' (4.4.24) iti luk| atrābhidheyavalliṅgavacane bhavataḥ| śirīṣāṇāmadūrabhado grāma iti śirīṣāḥ| `adūrabhavaśca' (4.1.70) iti śarīṣaśabdādaṇ, tasya `varaṇādibhyaśca ' (4.2.82) iti lup| ṇatvanna bhavatīti vyaktivacanagrahaṇasya phalam| yadi `vyaktivacane' iti nocyeta, tadā śirīṣeṣu yadvanaspatitvaṃ tasyāpi grāme'tideśaḥ syāt| evañca śirīṣavanamityatra `vibhāṣauṣadhivanaspatibhyaśca' (8.4.6) iti ṇatvaṃ prasajyet| `harītakyaḥ phalāni' iti| harītakīśabdo gaurādiṣu pippalyādidarśanānṅīṣantaḥ| tataḥ phale vikāre `anudāttāderañ' (4.2.44) ityañ; tasya `harītakyādibhyaśca' (4.3.167) iti lup| atra vyaktireva yuktavadbhāvena bhavati, vacanantvabhidheyavaditi| etacca vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| `khalatikaṃ vanāni' iti| `adūrabhavaśca' (4.2.70) ityaṇ, tasya `varaṇādibhyaśca' (4.2.82) iti lup| atra vacanameva yuktavadbhāvena bhavati, vyaktistvabhidheyavadeveti| etadapi pūrvavadeva labhyate|| 52. viśeṣaṇānāṃ cājāteḥ| (1.2.52) pūrvaṃ prakṛtyarthagatayorliṅgasaṃkhyayorlubarthe'tidheśāt tadviśeṣaṇānāmapi ramaṇīyādīnāṃ vyaktivacanātideśaḥ siddha eva| yadyapi bhinnaṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ pravṛttinimittam; tathāpi tena bhinnenāpi tatra pravarttamānānāṃ sa eva lubartho'tidiṣṭavyaktivacanasteṣāmabhidheyaḥ, tasmāt tadgatenaiva liṅgasaṃkhyābhidhāne siddhe jātipratiṣedhārthamidaṃ vacanam| `godauramaṇīyau' iti| godau nāma hradau, tayoradūrabhavo grāma ityarthe'ṇ| `varaṇādibhyaśca' (4.2.82) iti lup tasya| `pañcālāḥ janapadaḥ'| `godau grāmaḥ 'iti| janapadagrāmaśabdau jātivacanau| tābhyāṃ jātinimattābhyāṃ sa eva lubartho jātirūpeṇocyata iti tayorapi vyaktavacane yuktavat syātām| tato `jāteḥ' iti pratiṣedhaḥ| `jātyarthasya' ityādi| jātiśabdasyārtho jātyarthaḥ, tasyāyam `ajāteḥ' iti yuktavadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, na jātiśabdasyaivetyarthaḥ| kimeva sati siddhaṃ bhavatītyata āha- `tena' ityādi| arthasya yuktavadbhāvapratiṣedhe sati yathā jātiśabdasya tatrārthe varttamānasya tadīye liṅgasaṃkhye na bhavataḥ, tathā tadviśeṣaṇānāmapi yuktavadbhāvo na bahvanna ityādau na syāt, ramaṇīyādīnāmajātiśabdatvāt| dvāragrahaṇaṃ lubarthe jātiśabdsya pravṛttatvāt, lubarthe jātiviśeṣaṇānāṃ sākṣādapravṛtteḥ| tāni hi sākṣājjātimeva viśeṣayanti| tasyāṃ tu viśeṣitāyāṃ lubartho'pi viśiṣṭa eva pratīyata iti jātidvāreṇa tasya tāni viśeṣaṇāni bhavanti| `manuṣyalupi' iti| manuṣyalakṣaṇo yo lup tasya viśeṣaṇānāṃ yuktavadbhāvapratiṣedha iti| sa ca vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāllabhyate| `cañcābhirūpaḥ' iti| cañceva manuṣyaścañcā-- `ive pratikṛtau' (5.3.96) iti kan| tasya `lum manuṣye' (5.3.98) iti lup| `abhirūpaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇasyābhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti| ` vardhrikā' iti| pūrvavat kam̐llupau|| 53. tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt| (1.2.53) `tadaśiṣyam' iti pratijñā, `saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt' - iti hetuḥ| yasmāt saṃjñābhūtānāṃ pañcālādiśabdānāṃ pramāṇatvam, tasmāt tadaśiṣyam| pramāṇatvaṃ punaḥ pratyayalakṣaṇam| sarveṣāmeva śabdānāmevaṃ vidhe svaviṣaye pramāṇatvamasti, ucyate cedam, tatra viśeṣo vijñāyate, sa punarabhidheyagataliṅgasaṃkhyānapekṣayā bhinnaliṅgasaṃkhyānāmapi teṣāṃ svārthe pratyāyakatvam| ata evāha-- `saṃjñāśabdā hi nānāliṅgasaṃkhyāḥ' iti| `pramāṇam'iti| pramāṇaṃ pratyāyakā vācakā ityarthaḥ| tatraitat syāt-- saṃjñāśabdā evāmī pañcālādayo na bhavanti, kiṃ tarhi ? yoganimittakā ityata āha-- `pañcālā varaṇāḥ' ityādi| yoganimittakāḥ śabdā yogaśabdāḥ| na hi pañcālādayaḥ śabdāḥ kṣatriyādisambandhena janapadādau varttante; kiṃ tarhi ? saṃjñā etā janapadādīnām| yadi saṃjñāśabdā ete, tataḥ kimiti ? tadaśiṣyamityata āha-- `tatra liṅgaṃ vacanañca' ityādi| kuta etat ? yat saṃjñāśabdānāṃ liṅgaṃ vacanañca tatsvabhāvasiddhamityata āha-- `yathā' ityādi| ekasyāmapi jalakaṇikāyāṃ bahuvacanāntaḥ strīliṅgo'pśabdaḥ prayujyate, ekasyāmapi yoṣiti dāraśabdaḥ puṃlliṅago bahuvacanāntaḥ, gṛhaśabdaścaikasmin veśmani bahuvacanāntaḥ puṃlliṅgaśca, ekasyāmapi vālukāyāṃ bahuvacanāntaḥ sikatāśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ, varṣā ita ekasmin viśiṣṭakāle'pi pravarttamānaḥ strīliṅgo bahuvacanāntaśca varttate| tasmāt yathaiveṣāmapprabhṛtiśabdānāṃ svābhāvikaṃ liṅgaṃ vacanañca tathā pañcālādiśabdānāmapīti nārtho yuktavadbhāvacanena| yadyevam, kasmāt pūrvaṃ taduktam ? pratiṣedhaviṣayopadarśanārtham| na hyanirdiṣṭaviṣayasya pratiṣedhaḥ śakyate karttu jñātuṃ vā|| 54. lubyogāprakhyānāt| (1.2.54) `yogaprakhyānāt' iti|yogo janapadādeḥ kṣatriyādibhiḥ saha sambandhaḥ, tasyāprakhyānādanupalabdherityarthaḥ| ye hi yoganimittikāḥ śabdā yogamabhidhāya tadvati dravye varttante, tebhyo yoga upalabhyate; yathā-- daṇḍiśabdādibhyaḥ| na ca pañcālādibhyo daṇḍyādiśapabdavadyoga upalabhyate, tasmānnaite yogaśabdā ityata āha- `na hi' ityādi| prakhyāyate - kathyate, prakāśyate, buddherviṣaya āpadyata iti yāvat| yata evaṃ pañcālā varaṇā iti sambandho na prakhyayate ata eva naitadupalabhāmahe vṛkṣayogānnagare varaṇā iti, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃjñā etā anapekṣitapravṛttinimittāḥ| yadi saṃjñāśbadā ete, tataḥ kimityāha-- `tasmādatra' ityādi| gatārtham| nanu ca saṃjñā śabdānāmapi vyutpattyartha taddhita utpadyata e, yathā `hastājjātau' (5.2.133) hastī, `kambalācca saṃjñāyām' (5.1.3) kambalyamiti, tatkimucyate-- " tasmādatra `tasya nivāsaḥ' (4.2.69) `adūrabhavaśca' (4.2.70) iti taddhito notpadyate" iti ? satyam, saṃjñāśabdavyutpattyarthaṃ taddhita utpadyate| sa ca kvotpadyate ? yatra śrutikṛto viśeṣo vidyate, na ceha taddhitotpattau lupi sati kaścidviśeṣa iti na taddhitotpattiḥ|| 55. yogapramāṇe ca tadabhāve'darśanaṃ syāt| (1.2.55) `yogapramāṇe' iti| yogasya pramāṇaṃ yogapramāṇam, yena yogaḥ pratyāyyate| tat punariha prakṛtatvāt pañcālādiśabdaḥ| sa hi paramatena pañcālādisambandhaṃ svapravṛttinimittamabhidhāyaiva janapadādau varttate, nānabhidhāya| tena yogasya pramāṇaṃ pratyāyako vācaka ityarthaḥ| `tadabhāve'darśanaṃ syāt' iti| yo hi yoganimittakaḥ sa yogābhāve na prayujyate, daṇaḍyādiśabdavadityabhiprāyaḥ| `yogapramāṇe hi' ityādi| hiśabdaṃ hetvarthaṃ prayuñjānaścaśabdo hetvarthavṛttiḥ sūtre upātta iti darśayati| syādetat, bhavatyeva yogābhāve pañcālādiśabdasyādarśanamityata āha-- `dṛśyate ca' ityādi| gatārtham| 56. pradhānapratyayārthavacanamarthasyānyapramāṇatvāt| (1.2.56) `anyapramāṇatvāt' iti| anyat pramāṇam avagatiheturyasyārthābhidhānalakṣaṇasya tadanyapramāṇam, tasya bhāvo'nyapramāṇatvam| `pradhānaṃ samāse kiñcit padam' iti| yathā rājapuruṣaśabde puruṣa ityetat| `pradhānopasarjane' ityādi| rājapuruṣa ityatra pūrvavadupasarjanam, itarat pradhānam| te ca pradhānārtha saha brūtaḥ| `prakṛtipratyayau' ityādi| aśakyatvaṃ tvanantaprakāratvāt| tathā hi-- citraguriti bahuvrīhau kṛte guṇaguṇibhyāmanyapadārtha ucyate| atra guṇapadaṃ citraśabdo'pradhānam, viśeṣaṇatvāt; guṇipadaṃ gośabdaḥ pradhānam, viśeṣyatvāt| kvacidupasarjanābhyāmanyo'rtho'bhidhīte-- plakṣanyagrādhāviti| tathā hi, na kevalaṃ prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ api tu, kvacit prakṛtyarthamapi, yathā-- svārthikeṣu śuklataram, śuklatamamiti| tathā kecidākhyāteṣu svabhāvāt pradhānamāhuḥ prakṛtyartham-- `kriyāpradhānamākhyātam' iti| anye tu manyante- ākhyāteṣu pradhānabhūtaḥ pratyayārtha eva śaktirūpeṇocyate, yathā vibhaktibhiḥ kvacit pratyaye; na tu śaktimān padārtho dravyabhāvamāpanna ucyate| ataḥ kriyāntareṇa ca sambandhe śaktyantaramāvirbhavati karttāraṃ paśyeti| evamādyanantaprakāramarthābhidhānaśakyaṃ sarvamupadeṣṭum, tasmāllokata evārthāvagatiḥ| kathaṃ punaretadvijñāyata ityata āha-- `yairapi' ityādi| sugamam|| 57. kālopasarjane ca tulyam| (1.2.57) arthasyānyapramāṇatvādityuktam| kathaṃ punaratrāpyayaṃ heturlabhyata iti praśnāvasara ityāha-- `tulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārthaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punastulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārtho bhavati ? manyate-- tulyamiti pratyākhyānakriyāviśeṣaṇametat| anantaroktena pratyākhyānena tulyametat pratyākhyānam| evañc tulyaṃ bhavati yadi yastasya hetuḥ sa evāsyāpi bhavati| tasmāt tulyagrahaṇasāmarthyāt pūrvako hetutrānuvarttate| tena tulyaśabdo hetvanukarṣaṇārtho bhavatīti| `ānyāyyādutthānāt' ityādi| utthānaṃ śayanādrātreḥ paścime yāme nyāyyamuktam| saṃveśanam - śayanam tadapi rajanyāḥ prathame yāme nyāyyam| tadevaṃ sakalo divasaḥ; pūrvasyāśca rātreḥ paścimo yāmaḥ, āgaminyāśca prathamo yāma ityeṣo'dyatanaḥ kāla ityuktaṃ bhavati| `aharubhayato'rddharātram' ityādi| kṛtsno divasa ubhayaścārddharātram| atikrāntāyāśca rātrerāgāminyāśca rātreradyatanaḥ kāla ityapare|| 58.jātyākhyāmekasminbahuvacanamanyatarasyām| (1.2.58) `jātirnāmāyameko'rthaḥ ityādinā sūtrārambhasya prayojanamāha| nanu jāteḥ saṃkhyā na vidyate ? tasyā dravyadharmatvāt| yadyapi vaiśeṣikasiddhāntaprasiddhā guṇapadārthasaṃgṛhītā yā saṃkhyā sā na vidyate; tathāpi `bhedakā guṇāḥ' ityasmaddarśane' bhedamātrā yā saṃkhyā sā vidyata evetyadoṣaḥ| `jāterākhyā' iti| ākhyānamākhyā - pratyāyanam| `ekasminnarthe' iti| jātyākhyo'rtho `jātyartho bahuvadbhavatīti yāvat' iti| etenaitaddarśayati-- na hi jātiviśeṣaṇebhyaḥ sampannādibhyastanna syāt| teṣāmajātiśabdatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| kathaṃ punarjātyarthasya bahuvadbhāvo labhyate ? anvarthagrahaṇāt| bahuvacanamiha na pāribhāṣikaṃ bahuvacanaṃ gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi ? anvartham| uktiḥ - vacanam| bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ bahuvacam. na caikasminnarthe bahūnāṃ vacanaṃ sambhavati, ataḥ sāmarthyādvityartho gamyate-- ekasminnarthe bahuviditi| tadanena prakāreṇa jātyartho bahuvadbhavati| `tena' ityādi| yata e jātyarthasya bahuvadbhāvo vidhīyate, tena jātiviśeṣaṇānāmajātau vartamānānāṃ bahuvacanamupapadyate, jātiśabdavat| `devadattaḥ' iti| devadattaśabdo yadṛcchāśabdaḥ| nānenaikaṃ vastvanekavyaktyanugatamabhidhīyate| anekavyaktyādhārā hi jātiḥ| tato na devadattatvaṃ nāma jātirastīti na bhavatyatra bahuvadbhāvaḥ| nanu cātrāvasthābhedenānekādhāraṃ devadattatvamasti, naitadasti; evaṃ hi jātigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, sarvatra jāteḥ sambhavāt| tasmājjātigrahaṇasāmarthyālloke ye jātiśabdāḥ, pratītāḥ, tadarthā evātra jātiśabdena vivakṣitā iti vijñāyate, na ca devadattaśabdo loke jātiśabdaḥ pratītaḥ| `kāśyapapratikṛtiḥ kāśyapaḥ' iti| kāśyapasyāpatyam `anṛṣyānantarye vidādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.104) ityañ-- kāśyapa iti| tata ivārthe `eve pratikṛtau'(5.3.96) iti kan| `lum manuṣye' (5.3.98)iti lap bhavati| `ayaṃ jātiśabdaḥ' iti| `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha' (4.1.63ma.bhā) iti lakṣaṇāt, tasya ca gotrapratyayāntatvāt| na tvayaṃ jātirūpeṇocyate, kiṃ tarhi ? pratikṛtiriti| evaṃ tarhi jātipratyāyane hi cikīrṣite bahuvadbhāvena bhavitavyam| na ceha jātipratyāyanaṃ cikīrṣitam, kiṃ tarhi ? pratikṛtipratyāyanam|`vrīhiyavau' iti| ekasmiñjātyarthe bahuvadbhāvo'nena vidhīyate| iha tu dvau jātyartho vivakṣitau| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- anyatarasyāmiti vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam| tena saṃkhyāprayoge na bhaviṣyati| atha vā- eko vrīhiḥ sampanna ityatraikaśabdaḥ prayujyamāno jātyarthasyaikatvamudbhāvayati,tacca bahutvena virudhyate| tasmādekatvabahutvayorvirodhādbahuvadbhāvo neha bhaviṣyati|| 59. asmado dvayośca| (1.2.59) atrāpyarthasya bahutvātideśaḥ| `asmado yo'rthaḥ sa bahuvadbhavati' iti| tena tiṅantasyāpi tatra vartamānasya bahuvacanāntatvaṃ bhavati| `vayaṃ brūmaḥ' iti| `ekatve dvitve ca' ityādi| yuktaṃ yadekatve bhavati, dvitve tu katham ? na hi dvitvamasmadarthasya sambhavati; asmacchabdasyātmaviṣayatvāt, ātmanaścaikatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; ātmatvaṃ paratra yadopacaryate `ayaṃ me dvitīya ātmā' iti tadā asmacchabdasya tatrāpi vṛttedvaryarthaviṣayatvaṃ sambhavati| atha vā-- tyadādīnāṃ mitho yadyat paraṃ tacchiṣyata ityasmacchabda eva śiṣyamāṇo yuṣmadarthamapyāheti dvayarthatopapadyata iti yujyate dvayarthatā| atha yadyasmacchabdo bahuvacanāntaḥ prayujyate tadaikārthaviṣayo'yam, na dvayarthaviṣaya iti; atha dvyarthaviṣayo'yaṃ naikārthaviṣaya iti kutasyasyaikārthadvayarthaviṣaye vṛttiravasīyate ? prakaraṇāt| yathā-- ārācchabdasya dūrāntikārthayorvṛttiriti| `aham' iti| `ṅe prathamayoram' (7.1.28) ityambhāvaḥ, `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94) ityahāradeśaḥ| `vayam' iti| jasi `maparyantasya' (7.2.91) `yūyavayau jasi' (7.2.93) ita vayādeśaḥ, `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) `āvām' iti| aupratyaye `yuvāvau dvivacane' (7.2.92) ityāvādeśaḥ| `prathamāyāśca' (7.2.88) ityādinātvam| vaktavya iti vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānāṃ tu-- anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ yadanuvartatate tasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya karttavyam| `yuṣmadi gurāvekeṣām' iti| etadapi cakārasyānukta samuccayārthatvāt sūtreṇaiva saṃgṛhītam|| 60. phalgunīproṣṭhapadānāñca nakṣatre| (1.2.60) `cakāro dvayoranukarṣanārthaḥ' iti| nanu ca phalgunyau nakṣatre dve eva, tathā proṣṭhapade api dve; atrānayorditvādvitva eva bahuvacanaṃ bhaviṣyati, tat kiṃ cakāreṇa dvayorityanukarṣaṇārthena ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati-- nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ jyotiṣa upalakṣaṇārthamiti| tenaitadapi siddhaṃ bhavati-- uditāḥ pūrvāḥ phalguṇyaḥ, udite pūrve phalgunyāviti| yadi nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ jyotiṣa upalakṣaṇārthamiti na jñāpyate, tadiha tu na syāt, yato jyotiṣāmāvasthikī nakṣatratā candramasā yoge sati bhavati, nānyadā; anyadā tu jyotiṣṭvameva| na ca nakṣatrābhidhāyinaḥ `uditāḥ pūrvāḥ phalgunyaḥ' ityatra phalgunīśabdasya prayogaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? jyotirmātrābhidhāyina iti| atra jyotiṣṭvameksayāpyastīti tannivṛtyarthaṃ dvayorityanukarṣaṇārthaṃ cakārakaraṇaṃ yuktam| yadi punarjyotiṣa upalakṣaṇārthaṃ nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ na syāt, tadā kva syāt ? tadehaiva syāt-- adya pūrvāḥ phalgunyaḥ, adya pūrve phalgunyāviti| asti hyatra phalgunyornakṣatratā, candramasā yuktatvāt| tathā ha-- `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityaṇ bhavati| śravaṇaṃ tasya na bhavati; `lubaviśeṣe' (4.2.4) iti luptatvāt| `phalgunyau māṇavike' iti| phalgunyorjāte iti| `phalgunyāṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau' (vā.451) ityupasaṃkhyānāṭṭapratyayaḥ| `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp|| 61. chandasi punarvasvorekavacanam| (1.2.61) 62. viśākhayośca| (1.2.62) 63.tiṣyapunarvavasvornakṣatradvandve bahuvacanasya dvivacanaṃ nityam| (1.2.63) `tiṣyapunarvasavo māṇavakāḥ' iti| tiṣyapunarvasuśabdābhyāṃ `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityaṇ bhavati| tasya `lubaviśeṣe' (4.2.4) iti lup| tatastiṣye jāto māṇavakaḥ punarvasvorjātau māṇavakāviti `sandhivelādi' (4.3.16) ityādinā'ṇ, tasya `śraviṣṭhāphalgunyanurādhā' (4.3.34) ityādinā lup| `paryāyāṇāmapi yathā syāt' iti| nakṣatragrahaṇe satyarthagrahaṇādetadbhavati| śabdagrahaṇe ca `svaṃ rūpam' (1.1.68) ityaṣā paribhāṣā bhavatītyuktametat| tadabhāve paryāyāṇāmapi bhavati| `siddhyapunarvasū' iti| siddhyaśabdastiṣyaparyāyaḥ| `yastiṣyastau punarvasū yeṣām' ityavayavena vigrahaṃ darśayati| samudāyastu samāsārtho veditavyaḥ| atha tiṣyapunarvasava iti ? bahuvrīhiṇā viparyastamatayaḥ puruṣā evaivamucyante | tataśca nakṣatrasamāsa evāyaṃ na bhavati| tat kimetannivṛttyarthena dvandvagrahaṇenetyevaṃ yo deśayet taṃ pratyāha-- `tiṣyādaya eva' ityādi| svadarṇanāparādhādanyathā tiṣyādīn dṛṣṭvā pratipattṛbhista e tiṣyādayo viparyayeṇa dṛśyamānā bahuvrīhiṇaivamucyante, na tu puruṣāḥ| tasmānnakṣatrasamāsa evāyam| `tiṣyapunarvasvidam' iti| kena punaratraikavadbhāvaḥ ? `jātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) iti cet, na; saṃjñāśabadtvāt, devadattādiśabdavat| nāyaṃ jātiśabdaḥ,anekadhārā hi jātirbhavati, na ca tiṣyādistathā| kiñca vakṣyati-- `jātipradhānaparatve ca jātidravyāṇāmayamekavadbhāvaḥ, na niyatadravyavivakṣāyām' iti; niyatadravyavivakṣā cātra, tasmānna `jātiraprāṇinām' ityanenaikavadbhāva upapadyate| na cānyadekavadbhāvalakṣaṇamasti| tatra tiṣyapunarvasvornakṣatre dvandvasamāse bahutvādbahuvacanena bhavitavyam| evañca bahuvacanagrahaṇamanarthakamityata āha-- `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣā' ityādi| yadayamekavacananivṛttyarthaṃ bahuvacanagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tato'vasīyate-- astīyamparibhāṣā `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣaikavadbhavatiṭa (vyā.pa.91) iti| teneha bahuvacanagrahaṇamekavacananivṛttyarthaṃ kṛtimityabhiprāyaḥ| 64. sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa ekavibhaktau| (1.2.64) `sarūpāṇām' iti bahuvrīhau kṛte `jyotirjanapada' (6.3.85) ityādinā samānasyasabhāvaḥ| rūpaśabdo'tra svabhāve varttate| `sarūpāṇāṃ śabdānām' iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| tena svarūpāṇāṃ madhye samānajātīyo yaḥ sarūpaḥ, sa eka eva śiṣyate, na virūpaḥ| samānajātīyasyaiva hi nirdhāraṇaṃ bhavati, na vijātīyasya| atha vā-- samudāyalakṣaṇaiṣā ṣaṣṭhī, sarūpasamudāyāntaḥ pātī ca sarūpa eva bhavati, na virūpaḥ| tena sarūpa eva śiṣyate| `eka vibhaktau' iti| ekaśabdaḥ samānārthaḥ, ekadhanāviti yathā| ekā cāsau vibhaktiśceti `pūrvakālaika' (2.1.49) ityādinā samāsaḥ| ekamekaśeṣa ityatrāpi| atra tvekaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvacanaḥ, śeṣaśabdo'yaṃ nivṛttyā viśiṣṭavasthānamāha, nāvasthānamātram| ata evāha-- `ekaḥ śiṣyate, apare nivarttante' iti| `vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣau' ityādi| avibhaktikānāmayamekaśeṣaḥ; anaimittakatvādvibhakteḥ| na hyayaṃ parāṃ vibhaktimāśritya vidhīyate| ekavibhaktāvitīhasārūpyopalakṣaṇametat, na nimittanirdeśaḥ| ekasyāṃ vibhaktau parato yāni rūpāṇi dṛṣṭāni, teṣāmanutpannāyāmeva vibhaktau prātipadikānāmekaśeṣo bhavati| tataḥ kṛta ekaśeṣe vibhaktirupapadyate| atha vā -- savibhaktikānāmevaikaśeṣaḥ, katham ? vibhaktiśabdena hi kārakamabhidhīyate, vibhajyate prātipadikārtho'nayeti kṛtvā| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- ekasmin samāne'bhinne kārake yāni sarūpāṇi teṣāmevaikakārakāṇāmekaśaṣo bhavatīti| yadyevam, `parataḥ' iti vṛttigrantho nopapadyate, kārakaṃ hyarthasamavāyinī śaktiḥ, na ca tayā śabdānāṃ paurvāparyaṃ sambhavati, kathañca vibhaktiśabdena kārake'bhidhīyamāne savibhaktikānāmekaśeṣo labhyate ? ucyate; vṛttigranthastāvadupapadyate-- paraśabdo hyayamiṣṭavācī, ekavibhaktau parataḥ - ekasyāṃ vibhaktāviṣṭāyāmityarthaḥ| viṣayasaptamī ceyam, sati saptamī vā| ekasmin kārake viṣayabhūta iṣṭe sati saptamī vā| ekasmin kārake viṣayabhūta iṣṭe sati cetyarthaḥ| kiñceṣṭaṃ kārakaṃ bhavati ? yadvivakṣitam| ata e vivakṣitatvāt kārakaṃ svanimittāṃ vibhaktikānāmekaśeṣo labhyate| sahabhāvavivakṣāyāñcāyamekaśeṣo bhavati| yadyekena yugapat sarveṣāmartho'bhidhātumiṣyata evaṃ sati bhavati; nānyathā| nanu ca jātiḥ padārthaḥ, jātiścaikaiva; tatraikatvājjāterbahūnāṃ śabdānāṃ prasaṅga eva nāsti,tatkimekaśeṣārambheṇa ? iti codyāvasare `dravyaṃ padārthaḥ' ityetaddarśanamāśrityāha-- `pratyartham' ityādi| pratyartham - ekaikasminnarthe yasmācchabdānāṃ niveśapravṛttistato'kena śabdenānekārthsayābhidhānam| tatraitaddarśane'keṣāmarthābhidhāne pratyekenaiva kartavye'nekaśabdatvaṃ prasajyata iti yāvantaste'rthāstāvatāṃ śabdānāṃ prayogaḥ prāpnoti, iṣyate caikaśabdatā| tasmādekaśeṣa ārabhyate| `rūpagrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| evaṃ manyate-- rūpagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe padadvayasamanugamyo'rtheḥ pratipattavya iti pratipattigauravaṃ bhavati | samānānāmityucyamāne satyekapadasamanuhamyo'rthaḥ pratīyata iti pratipattilāghavaṃ bhavati; tasmāt samānagrahaṇameva karttavyamiti ? bhinne'pyarthe yathā syāditi rūpagrahaṇam | yadi rūpagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā viśeṣānabhidhānādyatra sarva samānaṃ śabdo'rthaśca tatraiva syād‌vṛkṣā ityādau, akṣā ityādau tu na syāt; arthabhedāt| tathā hyakṣaśabda indriyākhye, śakaṭāṅge, bibhītakādāvarthe ca vartateṣa pādaśabdo'pi kārṣāpaṇa-- ślokapāda-- pāṇipadādāvarthe vartate, māṣaśabdo'pi vrīhyādau| `dvibahvoḥ śeṣe mā bhūt' iti| nanu ca `śeṣa' ityekatvasaṃkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ dvayorbahūnāñca śeṣo na bhaviṣyati,naitadevam; iha vidhīyamānatvāccheṣa eva pradhānam, na ca pradhāne saṃkhyā vivakṣyate| tathā hi-- `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma' (1.4.49) iti karmasaṃjñā; īpsitatamasya prādhānyāt| asatyāṃ saṃkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ dvayorbahūnāñca karmasaṃjñā bhavati| guṇe tu saṃkhyā vivakṣyate, yathā-- `ṅayāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) iti svādayo vidhīyamānatvāt pradhānam; ṅayāpprātipadikamapradhānamiti tatra saṃkhyā vivakṣyate| tenaikaikmādeva svādaya upapadyante| lakṣaṇānurodhādguṇe'pi kvacit saṃkhyā na vivakṣyate, yathā ihaiva-- sarūpāṇāmiti| tena dvayorapi sarūpayorekaḥ śiṣyate| `ādeśo mā bhūt' iti| asati śeṣagrahaṇe sarūpāṇāmiti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyaṃ syāt; tataśacādeśaḥ syāt| evañca `aśūpruṣilaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan' (da.u.8.125) iti kvanpratyayānto'śvaśabdo nitsvarādādyudātta iti dvayoraśvaśabdayorādyudattayoḥ sthāna ādyudāttadvayavānevādeśaḥ syāt; āntaratamyāt| `payaḥ' ityādi| ekaḥ payaḥ śabdaḥ prathamāntaḥ kartṛpadam, dvitīyo dvitīyāntaḥ karmapadam, tato bhinnavibhaktikatvam;naikavibhaktiparatvamityekaśeṣo na bhavati| ` brāhmaṇābhyām' iti| prathamo brāhmaṇaśabdastṛtīyāntaḥ,dvitīyastu caturthyantaḥ| tenātrāpi samānavibhaktikatvaṃ nāsti|| 65. vṛddho yūnā tallakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣaḥ| (1.2.65) vṛddhaśabdo'yamasti laukikaḥ, yaścarame vayasi vartate; asti ca śāstrīyaḥ-- `vṛddhiryasyācāmādestad‌vṛddham' (1.1.73) iti; asti ca pūrvācāryasaṃjñā-- apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamiti| tatra yadi laukiko gṛhyeta ? yuvaśabdasyāpi tatsāhacaryāllaukikasyaiva vayoviśeṣavācino grahaṇaṃ syāt, tataścājaśca varkaraścetyevamādau prasajyeta| vṛddhāvastho hi paśuviśeṣo'ja ityucyate, yuvā tu varkaraḥ| atha śāstrīya upādīyate ? aupagavaścaupagaviścetyādāvapi syādityetadālocyāha-- `vṛddhaśabdaḥ' ityādi| etena pūrvācāryapraṇītāyāḥ saṃjñāyā vṛddhasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti darśayati| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate ? upadeśāt| atha vā evaṃ manyate-- yuvaśabdo yadyapi loke dvitīye vayasi rūḍhaḥ, tathāpi `jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā' (4.1.163) iti paribhāṣābalādapatye yo varttate sa eva gṛhyate| tena tatsāhacaryāt vṛddhaśabdasyāpatyārthavṛttereva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti| gotragrahaṇaṃ tu na kṛtam, vaicitryārtham| `yūnā saha vacane' iti| sahagrahaṇena yūneti sahayoga eṣā tṛtīyeti darśayati| ata e sahayoge tṛtīyāvidhānādavagamyate- sahabhāvavivakṣāyāmekaśeṣo bhavatīti| `samānāyām' ityādinā yatra vṛddhayunimittameva vairūpyaṃ tadviṣayaṃ darśayati| ākṛtiḥ- śabdasya pravṛttinimittam, gārgyātvādi, tasyāṃ samānāyām - abhinnāyāṃ yatra vṛddhayuvapratyayādeva kevalaṃ bhidyete, nānyat prakṛtyādikam, tatra vṛddhayuvapratyayanimittameva vairūpyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `gārgyaśca' ityādi | gargavatsaśabdābhyāṃ gargāditvād yañ, gārgyaḥ, vātsyaḥ, tābhyāṃ yūnyapatye `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak| gārgyaśca gārgyāyaṇaśca gārgyau, vātsyaśca vātsyāyanaśca vātsyau| prakaraṇādinātra yuvārtho gamyate| `gargaśca' iti| gargaśabdo'yaṃ mūlaprakṛtatiḥ; na vṛddhe varttate, nāpi yūni| `gārgyavātsyāyanau' iti| atra na kevalaṃ vṛddhayuvapratyayanimittako viśeṣo'sti, api tu prakṛtinimittako'pi| bhāgavittiśabdo gotrāpatye bhagavittaśabdādiñantaḥ| `bhāgavittikaśca' iti| bhāgavittiśabdādyūnyapatye `gotrastriyāḥ kutsane ṇa ca' (4.1.147) ityataḥ `kutsane' ityanuvṛttau `vṛddhāṭ‌ṭhak sauvīreṣu bahulam' (4.1.148) iti ṭhak|| 66.strī puṃvacca| (1.2.66) stryarthasya vairūpyakāraṇasyādhikyāt pūrveṇa na sidhyatīti vacanam| `puṃvacca' iti vacanādatadeśo'yam| `strī' iti| strīpratyayagrahaṇaṃ vedaṃ syāt ? stryarthavṛttiśabdasya vā grahaṇam ? arthagrahaṇaṃ vā ? yadi strīpratyayasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tato'nena tasyaiva nivṛttiḥ kriyate-- puṃvat strīpratyayo bhavatīti; na tu stryarthasya nivṛttiḥ kriyate; tato gārgyaśca gārgyāyaṇaśceti gargā ityatra `astriyāma' (2.4.62) ityanuvarttamāne `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti luṅana syāt; iha tu gargān paśyatīti `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (6.1.103) iti natvaṃ na syāt| dvitīye tu pakṣe stryarthavṛtteḥ śabdasyānena puṃvadbhāvaḥ kriyate, na tu strītvasya nivṛttiḥ; tathāpi sa eva doṣaḥ syāt| arthagarhaṇe tu na kaściddoṣa ityataḥ stryarthasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti matvā''ha-- `stryarthaḥ puṃvadbhavati' iti| kathaṃ punararthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ labhyate ? ucyate; strīpratyayānāṃ tu tasyābhidheyapātantryāt| arthasyāprādhānyamapāratantrayāt | pradhānaguṇana bhavati; aprādhānyāt| apradhānyaṃ tu tasyābhidheyapāratantryāt| arthasyāprādhānyamapāratantryāt| pradhānaguṇasannipāte tu pradhānasya grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam ataḥ stryarthaṃ eva gṛhyate| `gārgī, vātsī ca' iti| gārgyavātsyaśabdābhyāṃ `yañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīp,pūrvavadakārayakāralopo| `dākṣī' iti| pūrvavanṅīp‌| `dākṣāyaṇaśca' iti| dākṣerapatyamiti `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak|| 67. pumān striyā| (1.2.67) `strīpuṃsalakṣaṇaścedeva viśeṣaḥ' iti| yadyevam, iha na syāt-- gauścāyaṃ gauśceyamityetau gāvau tiṣṭhata iti, na hyatra strīpuṃsakṛtaḥ kaścidviśeṣo'sti ? mā bhūdanena , `sarūpāṇām' (1.2.64) ityādinā bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; yadi hi tena syāt strīśabdasyāpyekaśeṣaḥ prasajyeta| tataśca strīliṅgatāpi syāt liṅgamaśiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvāt| strīliṅgasyaikaśeṣe kṛte puṃsatvaṃ vivakṣitavyamityadoṣaḥ| atha vā, pumāniti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate| tenehāpyasatyapi strīpuṃsakṛte viśeṣe puṃsa evaikaśeṣo bhavati| na caivaṃ satyatiprasaṅago bhavati; yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddheriti| `brāhmaṇī, kukkuṭī, mayūrī' iti| `jāterastrīvaṣayādayopaghāt' (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣ| `kukkuṭamayūryau' iti| atra na kevalaṃ strīpuṃsakṛto viśeṣaḥ,kiṃ tarhi ? ākṛtiśrutikṛto'pi| `indrāṇī' iti| `indravaruṇa' (4.1.49) ityādinā ṅīṣ, ānugāgamaśca| `prāk ca prācī' iti| prāñcīti prapūrvādañcateḥ `ṛtvik' (3.2.59) ityādinā kvin, `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvam| kvinantāt `dikchabdebhyaḥ' (5.3.27) ityādinā'stātipratyayaḥ| tasya `añcerluk' (5.3.3)) iti luk| `prācī' iti| prākchabdāt `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) ityatrāñcateścopasaṃkhyānānṅīp| `prāgityavyayam' iti| `taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38) ityavyayatvam|| 68. bhrātṛputrau svasṛduhitṛbhyām| (1.2.68) 69. napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccānyatarasyām| (1.2.69) `anapuṃsakena' iti| `kima' ityādi| nanu ca vinā napuṃsakenāpi sahavacanena sarūpāṇāmityādinaikaśeṣo bhavatyeva; tat ko'tra viśeṣaḥ, yastenaikaśeṣo vidhīyamānaḥ, anenaiva cetyata āha-- `ekavacceti na bhavati' iti| yadyanenaikaśeṣaḥ syāt, pakṣa ekavadbhāvaḥ syāt| tena tvekaśeṣe sati na bhavati| athāsyeti kimarthamucyate ? yadyasyeti nocyeta, uttaratrāpyekavaccetyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tataścottaratra tu yasyaikaśeṣaḥ kariṣyate, tasyaikavadbhāvaḥ prasajyeta| tasmādasyaiva napuṃsakasyaikavadbhāvo yathā syāt| uttaratra tu yasyaikaśeṣaḥ kariṣyate, tasya mā bhūdityevamarthamasyeti vacanam| asyeti hi vacane sati mā bhūdasya vaiyarthyamityuttaratrāpyekavacceti nānuvartate| nanu cāsvaritatvādeva nānuvartaṣyate| evaṃ tarhi tadevāsvaritatvamanena prakāreṇākhyāyate vispaṣṭārtham| ekāro'trānuvarttate| tena himañca himānī ca himahimānyau, araṇyañcāraṇyānī cāraṇyāraṇyānyāvityatra na bhavati| indravaruṇādisūtreṇa (4.1.49) `himāraṇyayormahatve' (vā. 352) iti vacanāt mahattvamaparo viśeṣaḥ|| 70.pitā mātrā| (1.2.70) `pitarau' iti| `ṛto ṅi' (7.3.110) iti guṇaḥ| `mātāpitarau' iti| `ānaṅṛto dvandve' (6.3.25) ityānaṅa, abhyarhitatvanmātuḥ pūrvanipātaḥ|| 71. śvaśuraḥ śvaśvā| (1.2.71) `śvaśrūśvaśurau' iti| pūrvavatpūrvanipātaḥ|| 72. tyadādīni sarvairnityam| (1.2.72) `sarvagrahaṇaṃ sākalyārtham' iti| vinā tenānapuṃsakenetyasyānuvṛttirāśaṅkyeta, tataśca napuṃsakena saha na syāt| atha vā-- tallakṣamaścedeva viśeṣa ityetadihānuvarttata ityāśaṅkyeta, tataśca yatra tyadādikṛta eva viśeṣastatraiva syāt-- sa ca yaśca yāvityādi, ihi tu na syāt- sa ca devadattaśac tāviti| ataḥ sarvagrahaṇam| `sa ca devadattaśca tau' iti| yadā viśeṣavivakṣā tadaitadudāharaṇam, yadā tu sāmānyavivakṣā , tadā devadatto'pi tacchabdena sambadhyata iti `sarūpāṇām' (1.2.64) ityanenanaiva sidhyati| `yadyatparam' iti| gaṇapāṭhāpekṣaṃ paratvaṃ veditavyam|| 73. grāmyapaśusaṅgheṣvataruṇeṣu strī| (1.2.73) `grāmyāṇām' iti| grāme bhavā grāmyāḥ| `grāmādyakhañau (4.2.94) iti yaḥ| nanu ca saṅghasya tarumatvaṃ na sambhavati, nāpi tadvayavacchedyaṃ taruṇatvam| ataḥ `ataruṇeṣu ' ityayuktaṃ viśeṣaṇamityāha- `ataruṇagrahaṇam' ityādi| ucyate cedaṃ viśeṣaṇam, na ca saṅghasya tatsambhavati, tatra sāmarthyādanyeṣāṃ saṅgho vijñāyate| `gāvaḥ imāḥ' iti| imā ityanuprayogaḥ strītvābhivyaktaye| `etau gāvau' iti| kathaṃ punaridaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, yāvatā dvābhyāmapi saṅgho bhavatyeva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, yasmāt mataṃ syāt saṅghagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, vyavacchedyābhāvāt| `anekaśapheṣu' ityādi| anekāni śaphāni khurā yeṣāṃ teṣvayamekaśeṣo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamihānuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenānekaśapheṣveva bhavati, nānyatreti|| iti śrobodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ prathamādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ <1.3> atha prathamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ 1.bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ| (1.3.1) bhūrādiryeṣāṃ te bhūvādayaḥ| bhūvādayo daśagaṇīparipaṭhitā gṛhyante| `bhavati' ityādi| atra dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `dhātoḥ' (3.1.91) ityanuvarttamāne `varttamāne laṭ' (3.2.123) iti laṭ‌pratyayaḥ| `bhū ityevamādayaḥ śabdā dhātusaṃjñakā bhavanti' ityanena gaṇapāṭhenaiveyaṃ dhātusaṃjñā vidhīyata iti darśayati| tena aṇapayati, kaḍḍpayati ityevamādīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| yadyavam, yā-vā- diva-ityevamādīnāṃ sarvanāma--vikalpa-svargābhidhāyināṃ dhātusamānaśabdānāmakriyāvacanānāmapi dhātusaṃjñā prāpnotīti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākarttumāha-- `dhātuśabdaḥ' ityādi| laghvarthaṃ hi saṃjñākaraṇamicchantyācāryā ityekākṣarāyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ karttavyāyāṃ mahatyāḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñāyā yadāśrayaṇaṃ tasyaitatprayojanam--yathāvidhānāṃ te dhātusaṃjñāṃ kṛtavantaḥ, tathāvidhānamevaiṣā saṃjñā yathā syāditi| te ca kriyāvacanānāmeva dhātusaṃjñāṃ vihitavantaḥ| tadihāpi pūrvācāryasaṃjñāśrayaṇāt kriyāvacanānāmeva dhātusaṃjñā vidhīyate| tena yā-vā-diva ityevamādīnāṃ dhātusamānaśabdānāmakriyāvacanānānna bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca bhūrādiryeṣāmiti bahuvrīhau kṛte, ādiśabde parato yadi saṃhitayā nirdeśaḥ, tadā `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) iti yaṇādeśe kṛte `bhvādayaḥ' iti bhavitavyam, athāsaṃhitayā nirdeśastadā bhū ādaya iti, tatkuto'yaṃ vakāro yasmin sati bhūvādaya iti nirdeśo bhavatītyata āha-- `bhavādīnām' ityādi| bhūvādīnāṃ saṃjñināṃ nirdeśe'yaṃ vakāro maṅgalārthaḥ prayujyate| maṅgalamarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa maṅgalaśabdo dharmaparyāyaḥ, dharmārtha iti yāvat| yathā vede `triyambakaṃ yajāmahe' ityatra yakārasya dṛṣṭaprayojanaṃ nāstrītyadṛṣṭārtho dharmārtha eva pāṭhastasya, tathehāpi vakāsya| atha vā-- apūrvasya vastuno lābho loke maṅgalaṃ sammatam, yathā prātardadhyādīnām; tathehāpi vakārasyāpūrvasyalābho maṅgalaṃ praśastam| praśastārtho maṅgalaśabdaḥ| tathā coktam- `maṅgalādīni maṅgalamadhyāni maṅgalāntāni ca śāstrāṇi prathante vīrapuruṣāṇi bhavantyāyuṣmatpuruṣāṇi ca' (ma.bhā. 1.1.1) iti| iha cādau vṛddhiśabdo maṅgalam, madhye cāyaṃ vakāraḥ, (1.3.) ante ca `svaridatoyam' (8.4.67) ityudayaśabdaḥ| `bhuvo vārtham' ityādi| atha vā-- bhūvādaya ityatra nirdeśe nāyamādiśabdsa prayogaḥ, nāpi maṅgalārthasya vakārasya kiṃ tarhi? vādiśabdasyauṇādikasya| vadantīti vādayaḥ,vācakā ityarthaḥ| vaderthātoḥ `vasivapiyajirājivrajisadihanivāśivādivāribhya iñ' (da.u. 1.53) iti kartarīñ‌pratyayaḥ| yadyapi vādīti sūtraṇyantasyopadānām, tathāpi bahulavacanādaṇyantādapi bhavati|`bhvarthāḥ' iti| teṣāṃ vadīnāmidaṃ viśeṣaṇam,bhavanaṃ bhūḥ, sampadāditvād‌bhāve kvip| bhavaterarthaḥ kriyāsāmānyam| bhūrartho yeṣāṃ te bhvarthāḥ|kasmāt punaste bhvarthāḥ ? `bhuvo vārthaṃ vadanti' iti| itikaraṇo hetau-- yasmādbhṛvo dhātorartha vadantyabhidadhati tasmāt te bhvarthāḥ| evaṃ vidhā vādayo vācakāḥ śabdā bhūvādayo dhātusaṃjñā bhavantītyuktaṃ itīha sūtre saṃjñinaḥ smṛtāḥ -abhimatāḥ, abhipretā ityarthaḥ| tadevaṃ kriyāvacanāḥ śabdā bhūvādayo dhātuṃsajñā bhavantītyuktaṃ bhavati|tena yāva-vā- diva prabhṛtīnāṃ dhātusamānaśabdānāṃ kriyāvacanānāṃ dhātusaṃjñā na bhavati| gaṇapāṭhasāmarthyāt pāṭho'pyaṅgīkriyate| tenāṇapayatītyevamādīnāṃ kriyāvacanānāmapi dhātusaṃjñā na bhavatakītyuktaṃbhavati| asmin vyākhyāne bhūvādaya iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso veditavyaḥ-- bhuvovādayo bhūvādaya iti| atha vā-- ādiśabdasyaivātra `vā gatigandhanayoḥ'(dhā.pā.1050)ityasmāt parasya prayogaḥ| vā ādiḥ yeṣāṃ te vādayaḥ| ādiśabdaḥ prakāravācī, vāprakārā ityarthaḥ| prakārastu sādṛśyam, tatpunaḥ kriyātmakatayā, yadāha-- `bhvarthāḥ' iti| bhvarthatā tu bhuvo'rtha vadatīti hetoḥ| evaṃ vidhā vāprakārakāḥ śabdā iha sūtre saṃjñinaḥ smṛtā|?tadanena prakāreṇa kriyāvacanānāmeva bhūvādīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā bhavatītyuktam| tena dhātusamānaśabdānāṃ yā-vā-diva-prabhutīnāṃ dhātusaṃjñā na bhavati| na hi te kriyāvacanāḥ; niṣpannavastvabhidhāyitvāt| sādhyamānasvarūpā hi kriyā niravayavā kvacit pūrvāparībhūtāvayavā'niṣpannavastusvabhāvā| gaṇapāṭhastu pūrvavadevāṅgīkriyate| tenāṇapayatītyevamādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ dhātusaṃjñā na bhavatīti| asminnapi vyākhyānaṃ `bhūvādayaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam| ṣaṣṭhī ca vācyavācakasamnabdhalakṣaṇā veditavyā|| 2.upadeśe'janunāsika it| (1.3.2) `upadiśyate'nenetyupadeśaḥ' iti| `akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19) iti karaṇe ghañ nanu ca saṃjñāyāmityucyate, na ceyaṃ saṃjñā ? naitadasti; `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti bahulavacanādasaṃjñāyāmapi bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `śāstravakyāni' iti. asyedaṃ vivaraṇam-- `sūtrapāṭhaḥ, khilapāṭhaśca' iti| khilapāṭhaḥ - dhātupāṭhaḥ| cakārāt prātipadikapāṭhaśca| atha ragelageprabhṛtīnāṃ kathamānunāsikyam; na hi teṣāmānunāsikyaṃ gaṇe paṭhyate ? athāparipaṭhitānāmapi bhavati, tadā `bhū' ityevamādīnāṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `pratijñānanāsikyāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ' ityādi| pratijñayā''nunāsikyaṃ yeṣāṃ te pratijñānunāsikyāḥ| yatraivānunāsikyaṃ pāṇinīyāḥ pratijānate, tatraiva tadapaṭhyamānamapi bhavati, nānyatra| etadapi pratijñānaṃ nāniyamena bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? yatraivācāryāḥ smaranti tatraiva tena bhavitavayam, yathā svaritatvamanudāttatvañca smaraṇena vijñāyate, tathā''nunāsikyamapi| yadi tarhyānunāsikyaṃ pratijñāmātrabhāvi tat kimarthaṃ tat kvacit paṭhyate-- `ḍupacam̐ṣ pāke ' (dhā.pā.996) ityādau ? evaṃvidho'rtho'nunāsikaḥ pratijñeya ityarthasya pradarśanārtham| `abhra ām̐ apaḥ' iti| atropapadeśāttūttarakālam `āṅo'nunāsakiśchandasi' (6.1.126) ityanenānunāsiko vihitaḥ, tenetsaṃjñā na bhavati| nanu cānunāsikavidhānasāmarthyādeva na bhaviṣyati, tat kimupadeśagrahaṇena? itsaṃjñāyāṃ hi satyāṃ `tasya lopaḥ' (1.3.9) iti lopaḥ syāt, tataścānunāsikavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, satyametat; evaṃ manyate-- uttarārthamavaśyamupadeśagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| uttarārtha kriyamāṇamihāpi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ vṛttikṛtā darśitā| idantvatra pratyudāharaṇam-- `aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ' (8.4.57), dadhiṃ brāhmaṇakulam| yadyatretsaṃjñā syāt `idito num dhātoḥ' (7.1.58) iti num syāt| nanu ca dhātorityucyamāne dhātornum vidhīyate, nacāyaṃ dhātuḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? prātipadikam,tatkathaṃ num syāt ? naitadasti; `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati' (vyā.pa.132) iti kvibantatvāddhātutvaṃ bhavati| ātmano dadhīcchati `supa ātmanaḥ kyac' (3.1.8) dadhīyati, dadhīyateḥ kvip; dadhiṃ brāhmaṇakulamiti| `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ| `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) ityatrādau lopagrahaṇāt pūrvaṃ yakārasya lopo bhavati| `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti vakārasya| pratyayalopalakṣaṇena `akṛtasārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ| `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvatvam| `aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsikaḥ'(8.4.57) ityanunāsike kṛte `kvabantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati' (vyā.pa.132) iti num syāt| aśmā,bhasmeti `āto manin' (3.2.74) ityatra makārasyetsaṃjñā na bhavati| yadi hi syāt, `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti halantebhyo vidhīyamāno maninnaco'ntyāt paraḥ syāt| `sarvasyāco mā bhūt' iti| daridrāprabhṛtisambandhino'pi|| 3.halantyam| (1.3.3) `ante bhavamantyam' iti| digāditvādyat| antaśabdo'yaṃ samāptau varttate| yathā-- etadantaṃ vanamiti| yena ca samāpyate samudāyaḥ so'ntaḥ| ttarānte - samāptau bhavamantyam| haliti halśabdasyobhayaliṅgatvādantyamiti napuṃsakena nirdeśaḥ| `dhātvādeḥ' ityādi| ādiśabdena sūtraprātipadikapratyayāgamādeśānāṃ grahaṇam| tatra dhātoḥ -- `ḍukṛñ' (dhā.pā.1472) iti ñakāraḥ; sūtrasya-- `aiuṇ' (mā.sū.1) iti ṇakāraḥ; prātipadikasya - `navaṭ' iti ṭakāraḥ; nadaḍiti pacādiṣu paṭhyate| pratyayasya-- `guptijkidbhyaḥ san' (3.1.5) iti nakāraḥ; āgamasya `trapujatunoḥ ṣuk' (4.3.138) iti kakāraḥ; ādeśasya ca -- `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ' (2.4.54) iti ñakāraḥ| `agnicit, somasut' iti| cinoteḥ sunoteścāgniṃ citavān somaṃ sutavāniti kvip, tuk| nanu ca haliti pratyāhārapāṭhe yo'ntyo lakārastasyetsaṃjñā na prāpnoti; itaretarāśrayatvāt| tathā hi-- itsaṃjñāyām `ādirantyena sahetā' (1.1.71) iti haliti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ bhavati| tasmiṃśca tasya lakārasya halantyamitītsaṃjñā| tadidamitaretarāśrayatvaṃ sphuṭatarameva| `itaretarāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi śāstre na prakalpyante' (vyā.pa.28) ityata āha-- `hasya l hal' ityādi| yadekamāvṛttibhedamantareṇāpyanekeṣāmupakāraṃ karoti tat tantram| yathā-- pradīpaḥ suprajvalito bahūnāṃ chātrāṇāmupakāraṃ karoti| iha tu prayatnaviśeṣastantraśabdena vivakṣitaḥ| tena tantreṇa dvitīyamatra halgrahaṇamupāttaṃ parigṛhītaṃ veditavyam| yathā śveto dhāvatītyekena prayatnena dve vākye uccārite bhavataḥ, tathehāpyekenaiva prayatnena dvau halśabdāvuccāritāvityabhiprāyaḥ| hasya l haliti samīpisāmīpyasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| `tena' ityādi| yatastantreṇa nyāyena dvitīyaṃ halgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam, tena pratyāhārapāṭhe halityasya lakārasya hakārasamīpavartinaḥ sākṣādeva saṃjñitvenopāttasyetsaṃjñā kriyate, na tu pratyāhārasamāśrayaṇena| evañca sati `halantyam' (3.3.3) ityatra pratyāhārapāṭhe itaretarāśrayadoṣo na bhavati| 4. na vibhaktau tusmāḥ| (1.3.4) `vṛkṣāt' ityatra takārasyetsaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `titsvasitam' ((6.1.185) iti svaritatvaṃ syāt|`apacatāt, apacatam' iti| pacerlaṅ, `tastathasthamipāṃ tāntantāmaḥ' (3.4.101) iti tāntamādeśau bhavataḥ| `kimo't' (5.3.12) ityatrācchabdasya `prāg diśo vibhaktiḥ' (5.3.1) ityasya makārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārthādukārānubandhādvijñāyate| nityatve hi satyetasmādeva pratiṣedhānmakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyatītyukārānubandhagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| 5. ādirñiṭuḍavaḥ| (1.3.5) atra ṭugrahaṇena `aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' (1.1.69) iti ṭavargasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? ukārsayānunāsikatvāpratijñānāt, `cuṭū' (1.3.7) ityatra ṭugrahaṇācca| yadyatra ṭavargasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tadānenaiva pratyayāderapi siddhatvāt ṭugrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `minnaḥ' iti| `ñītaḥ ktaḥ' (3.2.187) , `āditaśca' (7.2.16) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `vepathuḥ'iti| `ṭvito'thuca'(3.3.89) | `paktrimam' iti| `ḍ‌vitaḥ ktriḥ' (3.3.88)| pākena nivṛttam, `ktrermam nityam' (4.4.20) iti map| `uptrimam' iti| vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprāsāraṇam| `paṭūyati' iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac' (3.1.8), `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ| `kaṇḍūyati' iti| `kaṇ‍ḍvādibhyo yak' (3.1.27)| kathaṃ punaratretsaṃjñāprāptiḥ, yāvatā sūtre ṭuḍuśabdau hrasvāntāvupāttau,dīrghāntāvimau ? netat; yadyapi dīrghatve kṛte dīrghāntāvetau bhavatastathāpyudeśe hrasvāntāveva,`upadeśe' (1.3.2.) iti cehānuvartate| tatra paṭuśabdasya pṛthvādipāṭhāt ṭuśabdasyopadeśe hrasvāntatā siddhā| kaṇḍūśabdasya `kaṇḍavādibhyo yak' (3.1.27) ityatra pāṭhāt ḍuśabdasyāpi| dvividhā hi kaṇḍvādayaḥ-- dhātavaḥ, prātipadikāni ca| tatra dhātuḥ kaṇḍuśabdo hrasvāntaḥ| prātipadikaṃ tu kaṇḍuśabdo dīrghāntaḥ| atha vā-- yadyapyupadeśa iti nānuvartate, tathāpi dīrghatve kṛtepyekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādastyeva prāptiḥ| `ñikārīyati' iti| pūrvavat kyac| ñikāraśabdo na kvacit paṭhyata iti tenātretsaṃjñā na bhavati| yadi syāt, lope kṛte rūpaṃ na siddhyet|| 6. ṣaḥ pratyayasya| (1.3.6) `rajakī' iti| ṣittvāt `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.49) iti ṅīṣ| atha kenātrānunāsakilopaḥ ? `aniditām' (6.4.24) iti cet ? na; tatra kṅitītyucyate,na cātra kṅitpratyayo'sti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; `janījṛṣknasurañjau|ñamantāśca' (ga.sū.dhā.pā.817) itimitsaṃjñākaraṇaṃ rañjerjñāpakam- akṅityapi tasyānunāsikalopo bhavati, anyathā ṇau rañjerakārasyānupadhatvāt `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhyā na bhavitavyamiti mitsaṃjñākaraṇamanarthakaṃ syātadityeke| `ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' (6.4.27) ityatra cakārsayānuktasamuccayārthatvādakṅityapi kkacidrañjeranunāsakilopo bhavatītyapare| `ṣoḍaḥ' iti| ṣaḍ dantā asyeti bahuvrīhiḥ; `vayasi dantasya datṛ' (5.4.141) iti datrādeśaḥ, ṛkāra ugitkāryārthaḥ; `ṣaṣa utvaṃ datṛdaśadhāsūttrapadādeḥ ṣṭutvañca' (vā.765) pṛṣodarādipāṭhāt ṣaṣo'ntyasyotvam, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), uttarapadādiṣṭutavamiti dakārasya ḍakāraḥ| ṣoḍat iti sthite ṣoḍantamācaṣṭa iti `tatkaroti tadādaṣṭe' (vā.200,201) iti ṇic, `ṇāviṣṭhavat kāryam prātipadikasya' (vā.813) itīṣṭhavadbāvāṭṭilopaḥ-- ṣoḍayatīti, tataḥ pacādyac, ṇilopaḥ| `ṣaṇ‍ḍaḥ' iti| `ṣaṇu dāne' (dhā.pā.1464)| `ñamantāḍḍaḥ' (da.u.5.7), `uṇādayo bahulam' (3.3.1)iti bahulavacanāt `dhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ' (6.1.64) iti satvaṃ na bhavati| atha vā-- `ṣaṇḍa' ityetadavyutpanannaṃ prātipadikamiti| `ṣaḍikaḥ' iti| ṣaḍaṅagulidattaśabdāt anukampāyām `bahvaco'manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhajvā' (5.3.78) iti ṭhac| `ṭhājādāpūrdhvaṃ dvitīyādayaḥ' (5.3.83) iti ṅagulidattasya lopaḥ; `ṭhasyekaḥ' (7.3.50) itīkādeśaḥ| ṣaḍaśabdsaya `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ, tasya sthānivadbhāve sati vyavadhānāt ṣaṭśabdasya `yaci bham' (1.4.18) iti bhasaṃjñā na bhavati| antarvartinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padatvāt `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvam - ṣakārasya ḍakāraḥ| yadyeṣāṃ ṣakārasyetsaṃjñā syāt, strīvivakṣāyāṃ `ṣid‌gaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ syāt| ṣaṇḍaśabdo'yaṃ yadyapi balīvarde varttate, tathāpi strīgavīṣpapi ṣaṇḍadharmayogādvṛttirasya sambhavatyeva| yadyapyete ṣoḍādayo lākṣaṇikāḥ, tathāpyudeśagrahaṇena ṣakāro viśiṣyata iti bhavantyetāni pratyayagrahaṇasya pratyadāharaṇāni| bhavati hyatrāpyudeśe ṣakāraḥ|`aviṣaḥ, mahiṣaḥ' iti| `ava rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.600) `maha pūjāyām' (dhā.pā.1867), `avimahyoṣṭiṣac' (da.u.9.3.) nanu ca`uṇādayo bahulam' (3.3.1) iti bahulavacanāt pratyayasaṃjñaivātra na bhavati, satyāmapi tasyāmitsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati,
