bahulavacanāt, tat kasmādādigrahaṇametadanuvarttate ? evaṃ manyate-- uttarārthamavaśyamādigrahaṇamanuvarttamānamihāpi spaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyati| 7. cuṭū| (1.3.7) `kauñjāyanyaḥ' iti| cphañantāt `vrātacphañorastriyām' (5.3.113) iti svārthe ñyaḥ| `chasyeyādeśaṃ vakṣyati' iti| itsaṃjñāpavādam| `śāṇḍikyaḥ' iti| `śaṇḍikādibhyo ñyaḥ' (4.3.92) iti śaṇḍiko'bhijano'syetyarthe ñyaḥ, tatra hi `so'syābhijanaḥ' iti varttate| `mandurajaḥ'iti| `ṅayāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam' (6.3.63) iti mandūrāśabdasya hrasvatvam| `annāṇṇaḥ- ānnaḥ' iti| `annaṃ labdhā' ityrathe ṇaḥ| tatra hi `dhanagaṇaṃ labdhā' (4.4.84) ityato labdhetyanuvarttate| atha kimarthaṃ pṛthagyogaḥ kriyate, `cuṭuṣāḥ pratyayasya' ityeka eva yogaḥ kriyatāmityata āha-- `pṛthagyogakaraṇam' ityādi| `tena vittaḥ' (5.2.26) ityādinā'sya vidheranityatvajñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati|| 8.laśakvataddhite| (1.3.8) `priyaṃvadaḥ' iti| `priyavaśe vadaḥ khac' (3.2.38), `arurdviṣadajantasya' (6.3.67) iti mum| `jiṣṇuḥ'- iti| `glājisthaśca ksnuḥ' (3.2.139) iti| ye tu ksnupratyayaṃ gitamicchanti tanmatenedaṃ gakārasyodāharaṇam| ye tu kitamicchanti tanmatenemapi kakārasyodāharaṇaṃ bhavati| `cūḍāla0ḥ' iti| matvarthe `prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyām' (5.2.96) iti lac pratyayaḥ| nanu ca prayojanābhāvādatretsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati; litpratyayāt pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ prayojanamiti cet, na; citsvarasya hi sarvasya rasyāpavādatvāt pratyayasvareṇahyantodāttatve siddhe citkaraṇasyaitat prayojanam-- citsvara eva yathā syāt, yo'nyaḥ svaraḥ prāpnoti sa mā bhūditi| idaṃ tu pratyudāharaṇam-- lomānyasya santīti `lomādipāmādi' (5.2.100) ityādinā śaḥ, lomaśaḥ ? etadapi nāsti, atrāpi proyajanābhāvādevetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati| idaṃ tarhi pratyudāharam-- `karṇalalāṭāt kanalaṅkāre' (4.3.65) iti bhāvārthe kan; karṇikā, yadyatretsaṃjñā syāt `kiti ca' (7.2.118) ityādivṛddhiḥ stāt, tataśca rūpameva na siddhyeta ? yadyevam ivamevopanyasanīyam, netare ? evaṃ manyate-- etadartham `ataddhite'iti kriyamāṇamihāpi mandadhiyāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ parihartu cūḍālaḥ, lomaśa ityevamarthamapi bhavitumarhatīti|| 9. tasya lopaḥ| (1.3.9) atha kimartham `tasya' ityucyate, yavātetsaṃjñāyāḥ prakṛtatvādyasyetsaṃjñā vihitā sāmarthyāttasyaiva lopo bhaviṣyatīti āha-- `tasyagrahaṇam' ityādi| kaḥ punaritsaṃjñako yo'lontyasya nivṛttyarthaṃ tasyagrahaṇaṃ prayojanatītyāha-- `ādirñiṭuḍavaḥ' iti| asati tasyagrahaṇe, eṣāmapi ñiprabhṛtīnām `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti vacanādantyasya lopaḥ syāt| tasyagrahaṇena tu prakṛta itsaṃjñake sannidhāpite sarvasya lopo bhavati, nāntyasya; anyathā hi tasyagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| yadi tu `nānarthake'lo'ntyavidhiḥ' (vyā.pa.62) ityeṣā paribhāṣā''śrīyate, tadā tasyagrahaṇamakartuṃ śakyate| tat kriyate vispaṣṭārtham| 10. yathāsaṃkhyamanudeśaḥ samānam| (1.3.10) `saṃkhyāśabdenātra kramo lakṣyate' iti| yatrāneke uddeśino'nudeśinaśca, tatrāniyamena sambandhe prāpte niyamārthaṃmidamārabhyate| yatroddeśino'nudeśino'nekasaṃkhyāḥ; tatrāvaśyaṃ saṃkhyābhedena bhavitavyam| yatra ca saṃkhyābhedaḥ, tatra niyatabhāvī kramaḥ ; saṃkhyābhedavatāṃ yugapaduccārayitumaśakyatvāt| ataḥ sāhacaryāt saṃkhyāśabdena kramo lakṣyate| arthadharmatvaṃ tu śabde samāropya saṃkhyāśabdena kramo lakṣyata ityuktam| yathākramagrahaṇaṃ kathaṃ na kṛtam? vaicitryārtham| `yathāsaṃkhyam' iti| `yathā'sādṛśye' (2.1.7) iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| `anudiśyata ityanudeśaḥ' iti| `akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19) iti ghañ| `paścāduccāryate' iti. anuśabdasya paścādarthavṛttitvāddiścoccāraṇakriyatvāt| `samasaṃkhyānam' iti| samasaṃkhyatayā samānatvaṃ darśayati| `{samaṃ paripaṭhitānām'iti mūla (kāśikā) pāṭhaḥ| }samagaṇanaparipaṭhitānāma' iti| tamevārthaṃ śabdāntareṇa vyaktīkaroti| `uddeśināmanudeśināñc' iti| yathākramamityetadapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī| uddeśino yadyapi sūtre na śrūyante, tathāpi sambandhitvāt paścādbhāvasyānudeśagrahaṇāllabhyante| `yathākramam' iti| pūrvavadvīpasāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ, tṛtīyāntañcaitat; tadayamatrārthaḥ- uddeśināmanudeśināñca yo'yaṃ kramastena krameṇānudeśinaḥ sambadhyanta uddeśibhiḥ saheti| yadyapyuddeśināmiti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ prakṛtam, tathāpyarthādvibhaktervipariṇāmo bhaviṣyatīti tṛtīyāntaṃ sampadyate| `prathamāt prathamaḥ' ityādinā yathākramasambandhaṃ darśayati| ādiśabdastṛtīyāt tṛtīyaḥ, caturthāccaturtha ityādiparigrahāya| taudeya ityādau `so'syābhijanaḥ' (4.3.90) ityatrārthe taddhitaḥ| `iha' ityādi| `veśoyaśaāderbhagāt' 94.4.131) iti dve prakṛtī, `yalkhau' iti pratyayāvapi dvāveva; ato yathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| iha kenacinadācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pratigrāhitāḥ-- `veśo yaśa āderbhagādyal kha ca' ityeko yogaḥ| anye tu dvāvetau yogaviti- `veśoyaśa āderbhagāt' ityeko yogaḥ, `yal kha ca' iti dvitīyaḥ| tatra ya eka evāyaṃ yoga ityevaṃ śiṣyā grāhitāstānpratyayaṃ praśnaḥ| vṛttikāreṇāpi tanmatamevāśritya`svaritena' ityādinā parīhāra uktaḥ| ye tu dvāvetau yogāvityevaṃ grāhitāstān pratyeṣa praśno nāsti; yogavibhāgenaiva yathāsaṃkhyasya syāt, yogavibhāgakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ svaritena liṅgena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ labhyate, yāvatā neha svaritagrahaṇamastītyāha-- `svaritenādhikāraḥ' ityādi| `svaritenādhikāraḥ' (1.3.11) iti yogaṃ vibhajya `svaritena' ityeko yogaḥ, `adhikāraḥ' iti dvitīyaḥ| tatra prathamo yogaḥ pūrveṇāpi `yathāsaṃkhyam' ityādinā sambadhyate| apiśabdāt pareṇāpi `adhikāraḥ' ityanena| yadi tarhi svaritena liṅgena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati, evaṃ hi sati sandehaḥ syāt| tathā hi-- yathāsaṃkhyamiti svaritenādhikāro'pi tatra na jñāyate -- kimadhikārārthaḥ svaritānuṣaṅgaḥ ? atha vā yathāsaṃkhyārtha iti ? sandehamātrametat| sarvanasandeheṣvidamucyate-- `bhavati vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattirna hi sandehādalakṣaṇam' (vyā.pa.75) iti|| 11.svaritenādhikāraḥ| (1.3.11) `itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīya' iti| svaritena cihnenādhikārasyopalakṣaṇīyatvāt| yadi pāribhāṣikasyeha svatisya grahaṇaṃ syāt, `raṣābhyāṃ no ṇaḥ samānapade' (8.4.1) ityatra ṇakāraṇṇākārasyādhikārasyādhikāratā na syāt; paribhāṣikasyājdharmatvāt| ṇakārasyānackatvāditi matvā sarveṣāṃ varṇānāmacāṃ halāñca svaritākhyo yo varṇadharmo guṇasyasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayannāha-- `svarito nāma svaradoṣo varṇadharmaḥ' iti| varṇadharmasya tu garhaṇamadhikārāvagamāya| sa iha halyapi svaritāsarañjanādvijñāyate| `adhikāro viniyogaḥ' iti| vyāpārakaraṇam| `adhikṛtatvāduttaratropatiṣṭhate' iti| yathā puruṣo yatrādhikṛto nagarādau tatraivopatiṣṭhate, tathā svaritaguṇayuktaṃ śabdarūpaṃ sūtrakāreṇa niyuktaṃ sūtrakāreṇa tatra tatropatiṣṭhate| `uttaratra' iti vacanamupalakṣaṇārtham| kvacit pūrvatrāpyupatiṣṭhata eva| kva punarasya sadbhāvo bhavati ? kva ca vā na bhavati ? ityāha-- `pratijñāsvaritāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ' iti| pratijñayā svarito yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- yatreva ta ācāryāḥ svaritatvaṃ pratijānate tatraivāsya sadbhāvo bhavati, nānyatreti| tadapi pratijñānaṃ nāniyamena bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? yatrācāryāḥ smaranti tatraiva bhavati| sa cāyaṃ dharmaḥ kalāgadyupama iti veditavyaḥ| kāryārthamupādīyate, kṛtakāryastu nivartate; na tu prayogasamavāyī bhavati| `pratyayaḥ' (3.1.1) ityādinā ye'dhikārāḥ svaritanāvacchidyante teṣāmudāharaṇāni darśayati| atha kimartho'yamadhikāraḥ kriyate ? pratiyogaṃ tas grahaṇaṃ mā kārṣīdityevamarthamiti cet, na; yathā devadattāya gaurdīyatāṃ kambalaścetyukte na ca punarucyate devadattāyeti, atha ca prastutatvāddevadattasya kambalaścetyasya sākāṅkṣatvāt tenaiva sambandho bhavati; tathā ca `sṛ sthire' (3.3.17)`bhāve' (3.3.18) ityevamādīnāmapi vākyānāṃ sākāṅkṣatvādghañādīnāñca prastutatvāt taireva sambandho bhaviṣyati, tatkimadhikareṇa ? satyametat; yatrānya nirdeśo nāsti tatropatiṣṭhate, yatra tvanyanirdeśastatrāsau prakṛtasya nivartaka eva syāt| tathā hi-- gaurdīyatāṃ yajñadattāya kambalo viṣṇumitrāyetyukte'nyanirdeśena prastuto devadatto nivartatte| evañcānyanirdeśenāsya nivartakatve sati `abhividhau bhāva inuṇa' (3.3.44) ityasyenuṇo nirdeśena prastutasya ghaño nivartitatvāt `ākrośe'vanyorgrahaḥ' (3.3.45) ityatrānantareṇenuṇā sambandhaḥ syāt,na punarvyavahitena ghañā,ghañ tviṣyate| nanu ca dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyād ghañevānuvartiṣyate tenaivābhisambandho bhaviṣyati, tathā ca tatra vakṣyati-- `dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyāttatra ghañevānuvarttate, nānantara inuṇ ' iti naitadasti; yadi dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyādaghaña evānuvṛttiḥ syāt, tadā `ṛdorap' (3.3.57) ittatrottareṣvapi yogeṣu ghañevānuvartteta, nāppratyayaḥ| yatpavunarvakṣyati-- `dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyāt' iti, tatra dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyaśabdena svaritatvamevoktam| dṛṣṭamanuvṛttau sāmarthyam-- adhikṛtasya śabdarūpasya yasmāditi bahuvrīhikṛtvā|tasmāt svaritatvādityayamatrārthaḥ| yadyeṣo'rthaḥ sūtrākārābhimataḥ syāt, svaritatvāditi kasmānnoktamiti cet? na;svacchandato hi vacasāṃ pravṛttiḥ, arthastu parīkṣaṇīya ityacodyatametat| tadevaṃ yato'nyanirdaśaḥ prastutasya nivarttako bhavati tasmādadhikāraḥ karttavyaḥ| tasmiṃśca kriyamāṇe tadavagamopāyadarśanāya `svaritenādhikāraḥ' ityetadipa karttavyaḥ|| 12. anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam| (1.3.12) `tatrāyaṃ niyamaḥ kriyate' iti| vidhīyamānatvāt pradhānasya pratyayasya na tu prakṛteriti vijñāyate| ata evāha-- `anudātteto ye dhātavo ṅitaśca tebhyaḥ' iti| yadi punarayaṃ prakṛtiniyamaḥ syāt, tadā kiṃ syāt ? anudāttaṅidbhyaḥ pratyayāntaraṃ na syāt| kāmaṃ vacanasāmarthyāt pratyayāntaramapi bhaviṣyatītyeṣa doṣaḥ śakyate parihartum| yastu vacanasāmarthyadvāreṇābhīṣṭe'rthe pratīyamāne pratipattigauravadoṣaḥ syāt, so'parihārya eva| yadi tarhi pratyayaniyamo'yam, tadā prakṛtīnāmaniyatatvāt tābhyaḥ parasmaipadamapi syāt ? na bhaviṣyati; `śeṣātkarttari parasmaidapadam' (1.3.78) iti dvitīyaniyamavidhānāt śeṣādeva parasmaipadam, nānyasmāditi| `āste' ityādi| `āsa upaveśane' (dhā.pā.1021) `vasa ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1023), `ṣūṅa prāṇigarmavimocane' (dhā.pā.031) , `śīṅa svapane' (dhā.pā.1032), adāditvācchapo luk| `śete' iti| `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ' (7.4.21)|| 13. bhāvakarmaṇoḥ| (1.3.13) bhāva iti dhātvarthaḥ kriyātmaka ucyate, karma tu pāribhāṣikameva| tatredamucyate niyamārthaṃ iti viśeṣaḥ| ayamapi pūrvat pratyayaniyaḥ-- bhāvakarmaṇorevātmanepadaṃ bhavati, nārthaniyamaḥ| arthaniyame sati `ko bhavatā dāyodattaḥ', `ko bhavatā lābho labdhaḥ' iti karmaṇi ghañādirdurlabhaḥ syāt| `supyate' iti| `ñiṣvap śaye' (dhā.pā.1068) vacyādinā (6.1.15) samprāsaraṇ| `kriyate' iti| `riṅa śayagliṅakṣu' (7.4.28) iti riṅādeśaḥ| `lūyate kedāraḥ svayameva' iti| `karmavatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' (3.1.87) ityatra vyapadeśātideśaśāsatrātideśapakṣayoḥ karmakartari parasmaipadena paratvādbhavitavyamiti kasyacid‌bhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākartumāha -- `karmakartari' ityādi| `dvitīyaṃ kartarigrahaṇamupatiṣṭhate' iti| `kartari karmavyatihāre' (1.3.14) ityataḥ| tena karttaiva yaḥ karttā śuddhaḥ kevalaḥ karmavadbhāvarahitaḥ, tatra parasmaipadaṃ bhavati; yatra karmavadbhāvastatrātmanepadaṃ bhavati|kāryātideśapakṣe `kramavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' (3.1.87) ityanenaivātmanapepadaṃ bhavati| 14. karttari karmavyatīhāre| (1.3.14) `karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī' iti| etena laukikamiha karma kriyātmakaṃ gṛhyate, na pāribhāṣikamiti darśayati| kuta etallabhyate ? pratyāsatteḥ| kriyā hi dhātoḥ pratyāsannā, tatra sākṣād‌vṛtteḥ| sākṣād‌vṛttistu dhātuvācyatvāt kriyāyāḥ| pāribhāṣike tu sādhanātmake karmaṇi dhātuḥ sākṣānna varttate;tasyādhātuvācyatvāt| tasmāddhātuṃ pratina tasya pratyāsattiriti na gṛhyate, tena sādhanakarmavyatīhāre na bhavatyātmanepadam-- devadattasya dhānyaṃ vyatilunantīti| lunātirupasaṃgarhārthe lavane varttate| devadattena yaddhānyaṃ saṅagṛhītaṃ purastāllavanenopasaṃgṛhṇantītyarthaḥ| tataścānyasambandhino dhānayasyānyena saṃgrahaṇādbhavati sādhanakarmavyatīhāraḥ| `anyasambandhinīm' iti| anyasya kartturabhīṣṭayā kriyemāṃ kriyāṃ kariṣyāmīti sehānyasambandhinyabhipretā, anyathā yadyanyena niṣpāditā yā kriyā sehānyasambandhinyabhipretā syāt tadā vyatihāro nopapadyeta, na hyanyena niṣpāditāyāḥ punarniṣpādanamupapadyate| `vyatilunate' iti| `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityadādeśaḥ, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ| atha kartṛgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? bhāvakarmanivṛttyarthamiti cet, na; abhīṣṭatvādbhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadam-- vyatibhūyate senayā, vyatigamyante grāmāḥ, vyatihanyante dasyava iti| `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityanenaiva yathā syāt, anena mā bhūdityevamarthamiti cet, na; viśeṣābhāvāt| na hi tenātmanepade satyanena vā kaścidviśeṣo'sti| yadyanena syāt tadā `na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ' (1.3.15) iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tena cātmanepade vidhīyamāne na bhavatyeṣa doṣa iti cet, satyam; eṣo'stu viśeṣaḥ,tathāpi na karttṛgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam; yasmāt `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) ityanantarā yā prāptiḥ sā pratiṣidhyate, na pūrvā| tena bhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadaṃ bhaviṣyati| ata āha--`karttṛgrahaṇamuttarārtham' iti| kaḥ punarasāvuttaro yogo yatrāsya prayojanamityāha-- `śeṣāt' ityādi|| 15. na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ| (1.3.15) `vyatigacchanti'iti| `iṣugamiyamāṃ chaḥ' (7.3.77) iti chatvam, `che ca' (6.1.73) iti tuk| `vyatisarpanti' iti| `gamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.982,983), laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| `vyatihiṃsanti' iti| `tṛhi hisi hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1348,1829)| `vyatighnanti' iti| `hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1012) `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityupadhāpalopaḥ, `ho hanterñṇinneṣu' (7.3.54) iti kutvam| `pratiṣedhe' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdo'trānekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ pratipādane varttate| tacca pratipādanaṃ prakṛtatvāt pratiṣedhasyeti gamyate| tadayamarthaḥ-- pratiṣedhe karttavye hasādīnāmapyātmanepadapratiṣadhasya pratipādanaṃ karttavyamiti| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- neti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena hasādīnāmapi bhaviṣyatīti| tataḥ `gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ, tatra `na' iti varttate|kimarthaṃ punarayam ? pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārtham, tena `na' iti yogavibhāgena hasādīnāmeva pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, nānyeṣyamiti| 16.itaretarānyo'nyopapadācca| (1.3.16) upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam| itaretarānyo'nyaśabdāvupapade yasya sa tathoktaḥ| athopapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, `netaretarānyo'nyābhyām' ityucyatām ? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; evaṃ hyucyamāne pañcamīnirdeśāt `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityuttarasyaiva syāt-- itaretarasya vyatilunantīti, iha tu na syāt-- vyatilunantītaretarasyeti| `parasparopapadācceti vaktavyam' iti| parasparaśabda upapadaṃ yasya tasmāt pratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌- cakāro'tra kriyate| sa cānuktasamaccayārthaḥ| tena parasparopapadādapi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti| 17.nerviśaḥ| (1.3.17) `niviśate' iti| `viśa praveśane' (1424) tudāditvācchaḥ| `nyaviśata' iti| aḍāgamena vyavadhānamityātmanepadena na bhavivyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākarttumāha-- `{yadāgamāstad‌grahaṇena' iti-- kāśikā.padamañjarī ca. aḍāgamaḥ' ityādi| `madhuni viśanti' iti| atra neḥ parasya viśaterātmanepadaṃ prāpnoti, tatkasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `nerupasargasya' ityādi| madhuśabdasya saptameyakavacane `iko'ci vibhaktau' (7.1.73) iti numi madhunīti rūpaṃ bhavati, tasya cāvayavo niśabdo'narthakaḥ|| 18. parivyavebhyaḥ kriyaḥ| (1.3.18) `parikrīṇīte' iti| `ī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itīttvam| `paryādaya upasargā gṛhyante' iti| katham ? kriya iti sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī, na pañcamī-- kriyo ye sambandhinaḥ paryādaya iti| arthadvāraśca teṣāṃ sambandho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| sa copasargaireva paryādibhiḥ sambhavati; nānyairiti sāmarthyādupasargagrahaṇaṃ bhavati| `bahuvi krīṇāti' iti| bahavo vayo yasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| viśabdo'tra pakṣiṇi varttate|| 19. viparābhyāṃ jeḥ| (1.3.19) `sāhacaryāt' iti| upasargagrahaṇae hetuḥ `nerviśaḥ' (1.3.17) ityatra nerupasargasya grahaṇam| anantarasūtre'pi (1.3.18) paryādīnāmupasargāṇāmeva grahaṇam| ataḥ prakaraṇasāhacaryādadviparāśabdāvupasargau gṛhyeteta-- ityeke| apare tu varṇanti-- sāhacarya partyāsattyupalakṣaṇam| yeṣāṃ sāhacaryaṃ teṣāṃ niyogataḥ pratyāsattyā bhavitavyamiti| ataḥ sāhacaryasya pratyāsattyā'vinābhāvitvāt tena pratyāsattirlabhyate| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- pratyāsatterviparāśabdāvupapasargau gṛhyete iti| pratyāsattiśca jayaterviparāśabdābhyāmupasargābhyāmeva, nānupasargābhyām| tathā hi-- tābhyāmeva jayatyartho jayatyartho viśiṣyate,netarabhyāmiti|| 20. āṅo do'nāsyaviharaṇe| (1.3.20) dadāterevāsyaviharaṇe vṛttiḥ sambhavati, nānyeṣāṃ dārūpāṇāṃ dhatūnāmiti| atastatpratiṣedhena tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha-- `āṅapūrvāddāñaḥ' iti| `ādatte' iti| pūrvavadākāralopaḥ, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam| `āsyaviharaṇasamānakriyādapi pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' ityupasaṃkhyānadhyājenāsyaviharaṇaviṣayaṃ darśayati| katham ? viharaṇagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam, iha `āṅo do'nāsye' ityetadvaktavyam, tatrāsye dāño vṛttirna sambhavatīti sāmarthyādāsyasamavāyinyāṃ kriyāyāṃ vṛttirvijñāsyate, tatraiva pratiṣedhaḥ,tat kiṃ viharaṇagrahaṇena ? nanu ca `āṅo do'nāsye' ityetāvatyucyamāne, svaṃ mukhamādatte devadatta ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ, vā hyāsyaviṣayaiva kriyā tasyāṃ varttamāno dadātirāsyavṛttirbhavati, viharaṇamevāsyaviṣayam, grahaṇaṃ tvāsyaviṣayaṃ grahītṛviṣayañca| tadevaṃ viharaṇamanteraṇāpi siddhe yadviharaṇagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tasyaitat prayojanam-- āsyaviharaṇasamānakriyādapi pratiṣedho'yaṃ yathā syādityevamityeke| `itaretarānyo'nyopapadācca' (1.3.16) ityataścakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tenāsyaviharaṇasānakriyādapi pratiṣedho bhavatītyapare| `svāṅgakarmakācca' iti| vaktavyamiti śeṣaḥ| na cātrādravamūrtimallakṣamaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ svāṅgaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi ? svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgamiti| tat karma yasya sa svāṅgakarmakaḥ,tasmāt svāṅgakarmāt pratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ| tena parasambandhinā mukhena yadā sakarmako bhavati tadā bhavatyevātmanepadam-- `vyādadate pipīlikāḥ pataṅgasya mukham' iti| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- karttarīti varttate, āsyamiti ca sambandhiśabdaḥ, tatraivaṃ vijñāyate-- `yasmin karttaryaivātmanepadaṃ bhavati tasya cedāsyam‌' iti| `āṅa' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate-- āgamayasva tāvanmāṇavakam, ānute śṛgālaḥ, āpṛcchate gurūnityevamarthaḥ| tena `āgameḥ kṣamāyām' (vā.35) iti `āṅi nuprasacchayoḥ' (vā.40) iti ca nopasaṃkhyeyaṃ bhavati|| 21. krīḍo'nusaṃparibhyaśca| (1.3.21) `samā sāhacaryāt' iti| yadyapyanvādirupasargatvaṃ vyabhicarati, samśabdastu na vyabhicarati, atastatsāhacaryādanvādirupasarga eva gṛhyate| `māṇavakamanukrīḍati' iti| māṇavakena saha krauḍatītyarthaḥ| `tṛtīyārthe' (1.4.85) ityanuśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā| `āgameḥ' iti| āṅapūrvasya gamerṇyantasya grahaṇam| `kṣamā upekṣā kālaharaṇ' iti| kālapratipādanaṃ pratīkṣaṇamityarthaḥ| `āgamayasva' iti| `janījṛṣvanasurañjau'mantāśca' (ga.sū.dhā.pā. 817) iti mitsaṃjñāyām `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvatvam| loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanam, `thāsaḥ se' (3.4.80) `savābhyāṃ vāmau' (3.4.91) iti vādeśaḥ| `śikṣeḥ' iti| śakiḥ sannanto gṛhyate|`vidyāsu śikṣate' iti| vidyāṃ jijñāsituṃ ghaṭata ityarthaḥ| śakeḥ san, `sani mīmāghurabhalabha' (7.4.54) ityādinesbhāvaḥ| `atra lopo'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityabhyāsasya lopaḥ| `skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca ' (8.2.29) iti sakāralopaḥ, śikṣa iti sthite laṭ| yastu `śikṣa vidyopādāne' (dhā.pā.605) iti paṭhyate, tato'nadāttettvādātmanepadaṃ siddhameva| `āśiṣi nāthaḥ' iti| gatestācchīlyaṃ gatitācchīlyam| tācchīlyam - tatsvabhāvatā| `paitṛkamaśvā anuharante, mātṛkaṃ gāvo'nuharante' iti| pitṛvanmātṛvad‌gamanameṣāṃ svabhāva ityarthaḥ| `māturanuharati, pituranuharati' iti| māturākāraṃ piturākāramanukarotītyarthaḥ| mātṛsadṛśaḥ,pitṛsadṛśaḥ ityarthaḥ| paitṛkamiti piturāgatamiti `ṛtaṣṭhañ' (4.3.78), `isusuktāntāt kaḥ' (7.3.51)| māturanuharatītyatra gatitācchīlyaṃ na vivakṣitam| `kirateḥ' ityādi| `kṛ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā. 1409) asya vikṣepa evārthaḥ| harṣādayastasya viṣayabhūtāḥ| atra harṣo vikṣepasya kāraṇam, jīvikākulāyakaraṇañca tatphalam| eteṣvevārtheṣu kiraterātmanepadaṃ bhavati| `apaskirate' iti| `apāccatuṣpācchakuniṣvālekhane' (6.1.142) suṭ| `ānute' iti| `ṇu stutau' (dhā.pā.1035), adādiḥ| ayañcātrotkaṇṭhāpūrvakaśabdena vartate| `āpṛcchate' iti| `praccha jñīpsāyām' (dhā.pā.1413) taudādikaḥ, grahyādinā (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam| `vācā śarīrasparśanamupalambhanam' iti| śapathaviśeṣaḥ| tathā hi-- devadattasya śarīraṃ spṛśāmīti śapathaṃ kurvāṇo devadattāya śapata iti prayujyate| `ślāghahnuṅasthāśapām'(1.4.34) ityādinā samapradānasaṃjñāyām, devadattāyeti sampradāne caturthī| śapatītyākrośatītyarthaḥ| `samo'kūjane' (vā.34) ityādigranthasya śapa upalambhanaparyantasya yo'rthaḥ sa iha cakāreṇānuktasamuccayārthenopāttaḥ, tasyaivārthasya cakāropāttasya spaṣṭīkaraṇāyāsya granthasyopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ|| 22. samavapravibhyaḥ sthaḥ| (1.3.22) `santiṣṭhate' iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) tiṣṭhādeśaḥ| `astiṃ sakāramātiṣṭhate' iti sakāramātramastiṃ dhātum āpiśalirācāryaḥ pratijānīte| tathā hi -- na tasya pāṇineriva `asa bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065) iti gaṇapāṭhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `sa bhuvi' iti sa paṭhati| `āgamau guṇavṛddhī ātiṣṭhate' iti| sa tvāgamau guṇavṛddhī ātiṣṭhate| evaṃ hi sa pratijanīta ityarthaḥ|| 23. prakāśanastheyākhyayośca| (1.3.23) `tiṣṭhantyasminnati stheyaḥ' iti| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'(3.3.113) ityadhikaraṇe `aco yat' (3.1.97)| `īdyati' (6.4.65) itīttvam| guṇaḥ| `vivāda' iti| sandehaviṣaye| `nirṇetā' iti| niścetā, pramāṇabhūta ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ stheyaśabdāt tasya pratītirbhavati, yāvatā stheyaśabdo bhāvasādhanopyasti gatinivṛttivacana ityāha-- `tasya' ityādi| yasya `stheya' ityākhyā, loke tasya pratītiryathā syādityevamarthamākhyāgrahaṇam| tenākhyāgrahaṇena tasya pratītirbhavatīti darśayitumākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| `tiṣṭhate kanyā chātrebhyaḥ' iti| pūrvavat sampradānasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ chātrebhya iti caturthī| `prakāśayatyātmānamityarthaḥ ' iti| anekārthaddhātūnāṃ tiṣṭhatiratra prakāśane varttate| `saṃśayya' iti| jahātu nainaṃ kathamarthasiddhaḥ saṃśayya kaṇādiṣu tiṣṭhate yaḥ| asādhuyogā hi jayāntarāyāḥ pramāthinīnāṃ vipadāṃ padāni|| (kirā-3.14) ityasya ślokasyāyamekadeśa ihopanyastaḥ| saṃśayyeti vivādapadabhūte vastuni saṃśayitvo bhūtvā karṇādiṣu tiṣṭhata iti| karṇaśakuniprabhṛtiṣu nirṣetṛtvenābhimateṣu tatsu pakṣāntaraṃ parityajya tiṣṭhate; tadupadarśitasyaiva pakṣasyāśrayaṇāt|| 24. udo'nūrdhvakarmaṇi| (1.3.24) anurdhvakarmaṇi varttamānādityukte, yaścodayati-- `nanu ca tiṣṭhaterakarmakakriyāvacanatvānna karmaṇi vṛttirupapadyate| tatkimucyate-- `anūrdhvakarmaṇi varttamānāt' iti, taṃ pratyāha-- `kriyāvācī' iti| yaduktam-- anūrdhvakarmaṇi varttamānāditi, tasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `anūrdhvakarmaviśiṣṭāt kriyāvacanāt' iti| `uda īhāyāmiti vaktavyam'iti| utpūrvāt tiṣṭhaterīhāyāṃ parispandane varttamānādātmepadaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- antareṇāpi karmagrahaṇaṃ kriyāmātravṛttitve tiṣṭhateḥ siddhe yat karmagrahaṇaṃ talloke yā kriyā karmatvena prasiddhā tasyāḥ pratipattayarthaṃ kṛtam, sā tu parispandanātmakaiva parispandanātmikaiva ghaṭanabhramaṇādikā, tathā hi--tāṃ kurvāṇaḥ `sakriyaḥ' ityucyate| sthānāsanādikāṃ tvaparisampandanātmikāṃ kurvāṇo'pi `niṣkriyaḥ' iti| tasmādātmanepadamidaṃ karmagrahaṇādīhāyāmeva varttamānādbhaviṣyati| uda īhāyāmityukte, īhāgrahaṇamanūrdhvakarmaṇo'pavāda iti kasyacid‌bhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākartumāha-- `īhāgrahaṇam' ityādi| viśeṣaṇaṃ vyaktīkaraṇamihābhipretam| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yadidamuktam `uda īhāyāmiti vaktavyam' iti, tatra yadīhāgrahaṇaṃ tadanūrdhvakarmaṇa eva viśeṣaṇaṃ sūtropāttasya vyaktīkaraṇārtham| īhātmakamihānūrdhvakarma vivakṣitamiti pratipādanārthamityarthaḥ|| 25. upānmantrakaraṇe| (1.3.25) `mantrakaraṇe'iti| mantraḥ karaṇaṃ sādhakatamaṃ yasya dhātvarthasya sa tathoktaḥ| `upāt' ityādi| atra vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- uttarasūtre cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena upapūrvāttiṣṭhaterdevapūjādiṣvapyātmanepadaṃ bhavati| `vā lipsāyām' iti| labdhumicchā lipsā| lipsāyāṃ gamyamānāyāmityeṣo'rthoveditavyaḥ,na tu tatra varttamānāt tiṣṭhateriti, na lipsā tiṣṭharerarthaḥ| tathā hi-- `bhikṣuko brāhmaṇakulamupatiṣṭhate'ityatra tiṣṭhatirupasaṃkramaṇe varttate| lipsā tūpasaṃkramaṇasya hetubhūtā gamyate| lipsāyāṃ hetubhūtānāṃ brāhmaṇakulamupasaṃkrāmatītyarthaḥ|| 26. akarmakācca| (1.3.26) `akarmakāt' iti| nāsya karmāstīti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ḍukṛñ karaṇe'(dhā.pā.1472), `anyabhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti manin, dhātorguṇaḥ, `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap| nanu dhātoḥ kriyāvacanādakarmakatvaṃ na sambhavatīti tasmādayuktamakarmakāditi viśeṣaṇam, vyavacchedyābhāvādityata āha-- `akarmakakriyāvacanāt'iti| akarmikā cāsau kriyā cetyakarmakakriyā, tasyā vacano yaḥ, tāṃ vakti so'karmakakriyāvacanaḥ| etenārthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇamidaṃ darśayati-- akarmako yo dhātvarthastasatsāhacaryādabhidheyadharmasyābhidhāna upacārāt dhāturakarmaka iti| arthasya ca yuktametadviśeṣaṇam,tasya sakarmakatvākarmakatvasambhavāt| `yāvadbhuktam' iti| yāvacchabdo nipāto'vyayam, tasya yathārthe vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ, saptamyantañcaitat|ata evāha-- `bhojane bhojane sannidhīyate' iti| `bhāve ktaḥ' iti| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) ityanena|| 27. udvibhyāṃ tapaḥ| (1.3.27) `svāṅgakarmakācceti vaktavyam' iti| svāṅgaṃ karma yasya tasmāt tapaterātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ, tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nuvarttate, tasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt svāṅgakarmakādapi bhaviṣyati| svāṅgañceha na pāribhāṣikam, kiṃ tarhi ? svamaṅgaṃ svāṅgamiti| ātmīyamaṅgamityarthaḥ| `niṣṭapati' iti| `nisastapatāvanāsevane' (8.3.100) iti mūrdhanyaḥ|| 28. āṅo yamahanaḥ| (1.3.28) `āhate' iti| `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ| `āghnate' iti| `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityupadhālopaḥ, `ho hanteḥ' (7.3.54) ityādinā kutvam| `svāṅgakarmakācceti vaktavyam' iti| asya pūrvavadarthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi pūrvavadeva || 29. samo gamyṛcchipracchisvaratyartiśruvidibhyaḥ| (1.3.29) `saṃsvarate' iti| `svṛ śabdopatāpayoḥ' (dhā.tā.932)| `samaranta' iti| artteḥ `sartiśāstyartibhyaśca' (3.1.56) ityatra puṣādisūtrāt parasmaipadagrahaṇānuvṛtterātmanepadeṣvaṅāgeśena na bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākartumāha-- `tatra hi' ityādi| `saṃśṛṇute'iti| `śru śravaṇe' (dhā.pā.942), `śruvaḥ śṛ ca' (3.1.74) iti śnupratyayaḥ, śṛbhāvaśca| `ṛccheranādeśasya grahaṇam' iti| `ṛccha gatīndriyapralayamṛrtibhāveṣu' (dhā.pā.1296) ityasya| `smṛcchiṣyate' iti lṛṭ| syapratyayaḥ| yadyādeśasya grahaṇaṃ syāt tadetanna sidhyet| prādhrādi (7.3.72) sūtreṇārtterṛcchādeśasyacchādaśasya śitītyevaṃ vidhānāt| athārttyādeśyāpi grahaṇaṃ kasmān bhavatītyāha-- `arttyādeśasyatvarttītyevam' ityādi| atha vā-- yadyanādeśasya grahamaṃ syāt, ādeśasyātmanepadaṃ na sidhyatītyata āha-- arttyādeśasya tvartītyevam' ityādi| sthānivadbhāvenetyabhiprāyaḥ| `na lābhārthasya' iti| `vidlṛ lābhe' (dhā.pā.1432) ityasya| atha `na tu sattārthasya, nāpi vicāraṇārthasya' ityevamapi kasmānnoktam ? evaṃ manyate-- nityātmanepaditvādanayorātmanepadārthagrahaṇaṃ nāśaṅkyetaiveti| `dṛśeśceti vaktavyam' iti| `dṛśir prekṣaṇe'(dhā.pā.988) ityasmāt saṃpūrvādātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhānaṃ tu pūrvapadeva| `sampaśyate iti| pādhrādinā(7.3.72) paśyādeśaḥ|| 30. nisamupavibhyo hvaḥ| (1.34.30) `hvaḥ' iti `hveñ sparddhāyāṃ śabdena ca' (dhā.pā.1008) ityasya kṛtāttvasya `āto dhātoḥ' (6.4.140) ityakāralopaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaḥ| `nihvayate' iti| nanu ca kṛtāttvasya nirdeśādatrātmanepadena na bhavitavyam, na hi vikṛtiḥ prakṛtiṃ gṛhṇāti; anyatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; kvacidvikṛtirapi prakṛtiṃ gṛhṇātyeva| kathaṃ jñāyate ? yadayaṃ `na vyo liṭi' (6.1.46) iti kṛtāttvasya vyeño nirdeśonāttvapratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tato jñāyate-- vikṛtirapi prakṛtiṃ gṛhṇātīti; anyathā `vyaḥ' iti nirdeśena vyeño grahaṇābhāvāt kasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt ! `upasargādasyatyūhyorvā vacanam‌' iti| vaktavyamityarthaḥ| `asu kṣepaṇe ' (dhā.pā.1209), `ūha vitarke' (dhā.pā.648) asyatīti śyanā nirdeśāddaivādikasya grahaṇam, na tvādādikasya-- `asa bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065) ityasya|| 31. sparddhāyāmāṅaḥ| (1.3.31) `sparddhāyāṃ viṣaye' iti| spardheha dhātvarthasya viṣayo'bhimataḥ, na dhātoḥ| ata evāha-- `spardhā saṅgharṣaḥ| `parābhibhavecchā' iti| spardhāyāḥ svarūpaṃ darśayitvā dhātvarthasya viṣayaṃ darśayitumāha- `sa viṣayo dhātvarthasya' iti| kaḥ punardhātorartho nāma yasyaivaṃ viṣayaḥ ? ityāha-- `dhātustu śabdakriyaḥ' ityādi| śabdanaṃ śabdaḥ| sā kriyā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| śabdanakriyāvācīti yāvat| yadyapi hvayatiḥ sparddhāyāmapi paṭhyate, tathāpyāṅapūrvastatra na varttate, yathā-- tiṣṭhatirgatinivṛttau paṭhyate, atha ca prapūrvo gatāveva varttate, na gatinivṛttau; tathā hi pratiṣṭhita ityukte gacchatītyarthaḥ| tasmādāṅapūrvasya hvayateḥ sparddhāyāṃ vṛttyabhāvāt sparddhā dhātvarthasya viṣayaḥ| dhātvarthaviṣayatvaṃ tu taddhetubhāvena veditavyam|| 32. gandhanāvakṣepaṇasevanasāhasikyapratiyatnaprakathanopayogeṣu kṛñaḥ| (1.3.32) `apakāraprayuktam' iti| tṛtīyāsamāso'yam| apakāramuddiśya yatpravartate tadapakāraprayuktaṃ veditavyam| `hiṃsātmakam' iti| hinastīti hiṃsaḥ, pacādyac, hiṃsa ātmā yasya tat tathoktam| pīḍākaraṇamityarthaḥ| `sūcanam' iti doṣāviṣkaraṇam| kathametadvijñāyata eṃvidhaṃ sūcanaṃ gandhanamityāha-- `tathā ha' ityādi| `vasta' ityādinanā gandhayatidhāturardayaterarthe varttate iti darśayati| `arda hiṃsāyām' ityādinā ardayaterhisātmakatvam| evañca hiṃsārthenārdayatinā gandhayateḥ samānārthatāṃ darśayatā gandhanaśabdavācyasyārthasya hiṃsātmakatvaṃ darśitaṃ bhavati| bhartsanaṃ tiraskaraṇam| anuvṛttiḥ paracitāvadhāraṇam| `sāhasikyaṃ sāhasaṃ karma' iti| `ojaḥ saho'mbhasā varttate' (4.4.27) iti ṭhak, sāhasikaḥ| tasya karmeti tasmādguṇavacanabrāhmaṇāditvāt (5.1.124) ṣyañ, sāhasikyam| `upayogo dharmādiprayojano viniyogaḥ' iti| dharmādiṣu prayojanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| ādiśabdaḥ kāmāparigrahāya| `edho dakasyopaskurute' iti| `upāt pratiyatnavaikṛtavākyādhyāhāreṣu' (6.1.139) iti suṭ| `kṛñaḥ pratiyatne' (2.3.53) iti ṣaṣṭhī|| 33. adheḥ prahasane| (1.3.33) `tamadhitakre' iti| kṛño liṭ, tasya caiśādeśaḥ| `dvirvacane'ci (1.1.59) iti sthānivadbhāvād‌dvirvacanam, `urata'(7.4.66) ityattvam, raparatvañca, `halādiḥ śeṣaḥ' (7.4.60) `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam|| 34.veḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ| (1.3.34) `kartari karma' (1.3 .14) ityevamādau kvacit karmaśabdasya kriyāvācinā dṛṣṭā| ihāpi tasya kriyāvācitā mā vijñāyītyāha- `karmaśabda iha kārakābhidhāyi'iti| atha kriyābhidhāyī kasmānna bhavati ? vipūrvasya karoteḥ śabdanakriyāyāṃ vṛttyasambhavāt| `śabdakarmaṇaḥ' iti| dhātorarthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ viśeṣaṇam-- śabdaḥ karmāsyeti; śabdakarmā dhātvarthaḥ| tadarthasya śabdakarmatvāttaddvāreṇa dhāturapi śabdakarmeti; anyathā hi kriyāvācitvāddhātoḥ kataṃ śabdaḥ karmāsyeti sambandha upapadyate|| 35. akarmakācca| (1.3.35) `odanasya {pūrṇāḥ' ityeva-- kāśikā, padamañjarī ca|} paripūrṇāḥ' iti| suhitārthayoge ṣaṣṭhī| `pūraṇaguṇasuhitārtha'(2.2.11) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhena jñāpitametat-- suhitārthayoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavatīti| suhitārthāḥ - tṛptyarthāḥ| pūrṇāstṛptā ityarthaḥ|| 36. sammānanotsañjanācāryakaraṇajñānabhṛtivigaṇanavyayeṣu niyaḥ| (1.3.36) `sammānanādiṣu viśeṣaṇeṣu' iti| kiṃsvidatra viśiṣyate nayatyartho'neneti viśeṣaṇam ? kiṃsvinnayatyartha eva viśeṣaṇam ? viśiṣyate vyāvarttyate'rthāntarāditi kṛtvā| tatra sammānanamācāryakaraṇaṃ bhṛtiśceti pūrveṇaivārthenaitāni viśeṣaṇāni, pariśiṣṭāni tu nayatyarthasvabhāvāni dvitīyena viśeṣaṇāni| `nayate cārvī lokāyate' iti| atra nayateḥ prāpaṇamartho viśeṣyaḥ, śiṣyasammānanantu tasya phalabhāvena viśeṣamam| tatsambandhādācāryo'pi cārvītyucyata iti| yathā kuntānna praveśayetyukte kuntaśabdaḥ kuntasambandhāt puruṣeṣvapi varttate, tathehāpi cārvīśabdaścārvīsamnabdhādācārye'pi| `sthirīkṛtya' iti| niśaclīkṛtyetyarthaḥ| niścalatvantu teṣāmananyārthabhāvaḥ| `sthāpyamānāḥ' iti| lokāyate śāstre padārthānāṃ samyagavabodhaḥ| `pūjitā bhavanti' iti| abhilaṣitārthasampādanameva teṣāṃ pūjā| abhilaṣito'rthastu lokāyate śāstre padārthānāṃ samyavabodhaḥ| `utkṣipatītyarthaḥ' iti| etenopatsañjanaṃ nayaterarthaḥ, na tu tasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| evaṃ `niścinotītyarthaḥ' ityādibhirapi jñānādīnāṃ yathāsambhavaṃ nayatyarthatāṃ darśayatīti veditavyam| `īdṛśena' iti| yādṛśaḥ śāstrokto vidhiḥ, tādṛśenetyarthaḥ| atrāpyācāryakaraṇaṃ nayatyarthasya phalabhāvenaiva viśeṣaṇam| `karmakarānupanayate' iti| atra hi bhṛtirhetubhāvena nayatyarthasya samīpakaraṇasya viśeṣaṇam| `ṛṇādeḥ' iti| ādiśabdena karaśulkadaṇḍādīnāṃ grahaṇam| karo nāma rājagrāhyo bhāgaḥ karṣakaiḥ rakṣārthaṃ parikalpitaḥ| `dharmādiṣu' iti| ādiśabdena kāmādiṣvapi|| 37. kartṛsthe cāśarīre karmaṇi| (1.3.37) `nayateḥ karttā' iti| arthadvārakaḥ sambandho veditavyaḥ| `tadekadeśo'pi śarīram' iti| samudāyeṣu hi pravṛttāḥ śabdāḥ kvacidavayaveṣvapi varttanta iti bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punarmukhye sati gauṇasyāpi grahaṇaṃ labhyate ? śarīragrahaṇāt| iha laghutvāt kāyagrahaṇaṃ karttavye yaccharīragrahaṇaṃ karttavye yaccharīragrahaṇaṃ karoti taccharīraikadeśo'pi śarīraśrutyā nāma gṛhyetetyevamartham| `krodhaṃ vinayate' iti| atra nayateryaḥ karttā sa hi buddhīndriyadehasamudāyasvabhāvo devadattādiḥ| tatraiva karma krodho varttata iti karttṛsthaṃ karmāśarīraṃ bhavati| evaṃ gaḍuṃ vinayatītyādau gaḍvādaiḥ śarīraikadeśasya karmaṇaḥ karttṛsthābhāvo veditavyaḥ| atra ca krodhādyapagamaḥ kriyāphalaṃ kartrabhiprāya eveti ` svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye' (1.3.72) ityanenaiva siddhe niyamārthametadvacanaṃ veditavyam-- karttṛsthe karmaṇyaśarīra eva, nānyatreti|| 38. vṛttisargatāyaneṣu kramaḥ| (1.3.38) śeṣalakṣaṇena krameḥ parasmepade prāpta ātmepadaṃ vidhīyate| vṛttyādayo'rthā apratibandhotsāhasphītatāsu prasiddhāḥ|| 39. upaparābhyām| (1.3.39) `saṃkramati' iti| `kramaḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (7.3.76) iti dīrghaḥ| 40. āṅa udgamane| (1.3.40) `ākrāmati māṇavakaḥ kutapam' iti|avaṣṭabhnātītyarthaḥ| `jyotirudgamana iti vaktavyam' iti| jyotiṣāṃ grahanakṣatrādīnāmudgamana evātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `anupasargādvā' (1.3.43) ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvarttate siṃhāvalokitanyāyena, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā; tena jyotirudgaman eva bhaviṣyati, nānyatreti| yadi tarhi `vā' grahaṇamanuvarttate, ubhayorapi yogayoranuvartteta ? maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena nānuvartiṣyata ityadoṣaḥ| 41.veḥ pādaviharaṇe| (1.3.41) `vikrāmatyajinasandhiḥ' iti| dvidhā bhavati| sphuṭatītyarthaḥ|| 42.propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām| (1.3.42) `prakarmate, upakramate' iti| ārabhata ityarthaḥ| 43. anupasargādvā| (1.3.43) `aprāptavibhāṣeyam' iti| vṛtyādīnāṃ nivṛttvāt| 44. apahvave jñaḥ| (1.3.44) `śatamapajānīte' iti| `jñājanorjā' (7.3.79) iti jādeśaḥ śnā, pūrvavat `ī halaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itīttvam|| 45. akarmakācca| (1.3.45) `kathañcāyamakarmakaḥ' iti| evaṃ manyate-- sarpirādi jñeyatvena vivakṣitaṃ karma, atastena karmaṇā sakarmaka evāyamityabhiprāyaḥ| `katham' iti| na kathañcidityarthaḥ| tathā cetyādinā `nātra sarpirādi karmatvena, api tu karaṇatvena vivakṣitam ityatra yuktimāha-- `sarpiṣopāyena' ityādi| yasya sarpiḥṣvabhiṣvaṅago vinā tena bhujikriyāyāmabhilāṣo na bhavati tasya bhojane pravṛttiṃ prati sarpirupāyabhāvaṃ pratipadyata iti tenopāyena sa pravartata iti| `akarmakāditi kim' iti| `nātra sarpirādi jñeyatvena vivakṣitam| kiṃ tarhi? karaṇatvena' iti bruvatā vṛttikṛtā sākṣācchabdopāttena karaṇena sakaraṇādātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| evañca sakaraṇādityevaṃ vācyam, kimakarmakagrahaṇeneti bhāvaḥ| evamucyamāne karaṇayuktāt sakarmakādapi syāditi darśayitumāha-- `svareṇa putraṃ jānāti' iti|| 46. saṃpratibhyāmanādhyāne| (1.3.46) `utkaṇṭhāsmaraṇam' iti| utkaṇṭhāpūrvakasmaraṇamiti| `mātuḥ' iti| `adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi' (2.3.52) iti ṣaṣṭhī|| 47. bhāsanopasaṃbhāṣājñānayatnavimatyupamantrameṣu vadaḥ| (1.3.47) `{bhāsanādiṣu viśeṣaṇeṣu' ityeva-kāśikā, padamañjarī ca|} bhāsanādiṣvartheṣu viśeṣaṇeṣu' iti| atrāpi kiṃsvidviśiṣyate vadatyartho'neneti viśeṣaṇam ? kiṃsvidvadatyartha eva, viśeṣaṇaṃ hyarthāntarādviśiṣyate vyavacchidyata iti kṛtvā ? tatropasambhāṣopalasāntvanamupamantraṇañca dvitīyenārthena vadatyartha eva viśeṣaṇam| pariśiṣṭāni tu bhāsanādīni prathamenārthena viśeṣaṇāni| `bhāsanamāna' ityādinā bhāsanaṃ vadatyarthasya lakṣaṇabhāvena hetubhāvena vā viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| tathā hyatra bhāsamāna iti `lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' (3.2.126) ityanena śānajādeśo vihitaḥ| `jānāti' ityādinā jñānaṃ vadatyarthasya viṣayibhāvena viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| jñānena hyasau vadituṃ jānāti| atra yena jñānena vadanaṃ vadatyarthasya hetubhāvena tatra tenaiva viṣayeṇa paricchedyena viṣayībhavati| `tadviṣayam' ityādinā yatra āviṣkaraṇasya vadatyarthasya hetubhāvena viśeṣaṇamityācaṣṭe| utsāho hyāviṣkriyamāṇa ādiṣkaraṇakriyāyāḥ karmākhyaṃ sādhanaṃ bhavati, sādhanaṃ ca hetuḥ; kārakāṇāṃ kriyānimittatvāt| `vimatipatitāḥ' ityādinā vimatirbhāṣaṇasya vadatyarthasya hetubhāvena viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| satyāṃ vimatau vicitraṃ nānāprakāraṃ bhāṣante| yadi hyabhinnā matiḥ syādabhinnameva bhāṣeran| `upacchandayati' iti| `bhadre bhajasya māmidaṃ te dāsyāmi' ityevamādibhirabhiṣṭe'rthe pravarttayatītyarthaḥ|| 48. vyaktavācāṃ samuccāraṇe| (1.3.48) `prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārtham' iti| yadi tadarthaṃ vyaktavācāmiti nocyeta,`varatanu sampravadanti kukkuḍā {ayi vijahīhi dṛḍhopagūhanaṃ tyaja navasaṅgamabhīru vallabham| aruṇakarodgama eṣa varttate varatanu sampravadanti kukkuṭāḥ|ityevaṃ sayagraḥ ślokaḥ|}| kukkuṭāḥ api vyaktavāca eva| tathā hi -- kukkuṭenāpi lapite viśeṣaparicchedāducyate- kukkuṭā lapantīti| varatanviti tanūśabdasya `ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ' (7.3.107) iti hrasvaḥ| hrasvakavacanasāmarthyāt `hrasvasya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108) iti guṇo na bhavati| nṛṇāmiti na kṛtaṃ vaicitryārtham|| 49. anorakarmakāt| (1.3.49) `anuvadati' iti| anuśabdaḥ punarityasyārthe varttate| punarvadatītyarthaḥ| yajuṣātra karmaṇā sakarmakatvam| 50. vibhāṣā vipralāpe| (1.3.50) `vipralāpātmake' iti| parasparapratibandhena viruddhaḥ pralāpo vipralāpaḥ, sa yasyātmā svabhāvaḥ sa tathoktaḥ| `prāptavibhāṣeyam' iti| `vyaktavācāṃ samuccāraṇe' (1.3.48) ityasyānuvṛtteḥ| 51. avādgraḥ| (1.3.51) `avagirate' iti| `ṛta iddhātoḥ' 97.1.100) itīttvam, raparatvañca| 52. samaḥ pratijñāne| (1.3.52) 53. udaścaraḥ sakarmakāt| (1.3.53) `gehemucvarate' iti| carirgatyarthaḥ| `guruvacanamuccarate' iti| atrotkramaṇātmikāyāṃ gatau varttamānaścaratirguruvacanena karmaṇā sakarmakaḥ| `bāṣpamuccarati' iti| upariṣṭād‌gacchatītyarthaḥ| nātra kiñcitkarma vivakṣitamityakarmakatvam| 54. samastṛtīyāyuktāt| (1.3.54) yadyatra tṛtīyeti gṛhyate, tadehāpi syāt-- ubhau lokau sañcarati imāñcāmutra devaleti| atrāpi tṛtīyārtho gamyata eva| tapasā śrutena vā vidyata evetyetaccetasi kṛtvāha-- `tṛtīyā' iti| ` tṛtīyāvibhaktirgṛhyate' iti| yadyevaṃ tayā saha dhātoḥ sambandho nopapadyate| na hi tṛtīya dhātuvācyetyāha-- `tayā' ityādi| artho dvāraṃ mukhamupāyo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| tṛtīyārthena dhātvarthasya yuktavādaupacāriko dhātostṛtīyīrthena yoga iti darśayati| `yatrapyatra tadarthena yogaḥ sambhavati' iti| vinā karaṇena kriyāniṣpatterabhāvāt, tathāpi na bhavati| `tṛtīya tu' ityādi| tṛtīyāyapuktagrahaṇaṃ hyevamarthaṃ kriyate-- śrūyamāṇatṛtīyayuktādyathā syāditi, anyathā sama ityevaṃ vaktavyaṃ syāt ? anukte'pi siddhvatāt tṛtīyāprayogasya| na hi tena vinā kriyāniṣpattirupapadyate| tasmādyatra tṛtīyā śrūyate tanmūlodāharaṇam, yatra tu na śrūyate tatpratyudāharaṇam|| 55. dāṇaśca sā ceccaturthyarthe| (1.3.55) kathaṃ punastṛtīyā caturthyarthe syāditi ? na kathañcidityarthaḥ| tadvidhāyinaḥ śāstrasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| `vaktavayamevaitat' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- tadeva sampradānaṃ yadā sādhakatamatvena vivakṣyate tadā sādhakatamatvena vivakṣyate tadā caturthye'pi tadā caturthye'pi tṛtīyā bhavati, vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi bhavantīti kṛtvā; na tu svabhāvavataḥ| sā ca vivakṣā laukikī samāśrīte, na tu proyogikīti| loke cāśiṣṭavyavahāre eva sā sambhavati, nānyatra| laukikavivakṣātra samāśrīyata iti asyaivārthasya dyotanāya cecchabdaḥ prayuktaḥ| `dāsyā mālāṃ sampracchate' iti| yo hi dharmaśāstraviruddhāṃ dāsīṃ kāmayituṃ tasyai mālāṃ dadāti tasyāsāvaśiṣṭavyavahāro bhavatītyastyatrāśiṣṭavyavahāraḥ| samprayacchata iti pādhrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) dāṇo yacchādeśaḥ| kathamātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti| na kathañcidityarthaḥ| `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityatra nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāditi| evaṃ manyate-- `sama iti viśeṣaṇe ṣaṣṭhī' ityādi| yadi `samaḥ' iti pañcamī syānna ṣaṣṭhī, tadā praśabdena vyavadhānādātmananepadaṃ na syāt; tasmānneyaṃ pañcamī, kiṃ tarhi ? ṣaṣṭhī-- samo viśeṣaṇasya sambandhī yo viśeṣyo dāṇiti| tataśca vyavahito'pi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavatīti tena vyavadhāne'pi bhavatyātmanepadam|| 56. upādyamaḥ svakaraṇe| (1.3.56) yadi svakaraṇamātra ātmanepadaṃ bhavati śākaṭakādisvīkāre'pi syāditi codyamapākarttumāha-- `pāṇigrahaṇam' ityādi| evaṃ manyate-- pratiniyataviṣayā hi śabdaśaktayo bhavanti, yasmādupapūrvo yamirātmanepadānta evaṃvidha eva svīkāre vartate; na tu sarvasmin| tasmāt pāṇigrahaṇātmakameva svīkaraṇaṃ gṛhyate| upayacchata iti pūrvavadyacchādeśaḥ|| 57. jñāśrusmṛdṛśāṃ sanaḥ| (1.3.57) `tribhiḥ sūtreḥ' iti| `apahnave jñaḥ' (1.3.44) ityādibhiḥ| `dharmaṃ jijñāsate' iti| `jñā avabodhane' (dhā.pā.1507), san, dvirvacanam, abhyāsasya hrasvatvam, `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itīttvam| `śuśrūṣaśate' iti | śru śravaṇe' (dhā.pā.942), `iko jhal' (1.2.9) iti sanaḥ kittam, `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ| `susmūrṣate' iti|`smṛ ādhyāne' (dhā.pā.807) ; pūrvavat kittvāt `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuttvam, raparatvam| `didṛkṣate' iti| `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti kittvam, tataśca vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam|| 58. nānorjñaḥ| (1.3.58) `pūrveṇa' iti| anantarasūtraprāptaṃ yattatpratiṣidhyate-- `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā ' (vyā.pa.19) iti kṛtvā| `tathā ca' ityādi| yasmādanantarasūtreṇaātmanepadaṃ eyatprāpnoti, tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ sampadyate| evaṃsati sakarmakasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ; anantarasūtreṇa sakarmakādātmanepadavidhānāt| akarmakāddhi `akarmakācca' (1.3.45) ityanena prāgevātmanepadaṃ vihitamityanantarātīto yogaḥ sakarmakārtho vijñāyate; yataścaivam, tenākarmakāt `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadaṃ bhavatyeva-- auṣadhasyānujijñāsata iti|| 59. pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ| (1.3.59) `upasargagrahaṇañcedam' iti| kathaṃ śruva iti ? viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| tenāyaṃ sambandho bhavati-- śṛṇoteryau viśeṣaṇabhūtau pratyāṅau tatpūrvāccharuvaḥ sambandhāt sannantādātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| upasargādevārthaṃ dvāreṇa śṛṇoterviśeṣaṇabhūtāviti sāmarthyādupasargayorgrahaṇam| `devadattaṃ prati śuśrūṣate' iti| pratiśabdasya `lakṣaṇe tyambhūtākhyāna' (1.4.90) ityādinā lakṣaṇe karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tena pratinā devadatt eva sambadhyate; na dhātvartha iti|| 60. śadeḥ śitaḥ| (1.3.60) yadi `śadeḥ śitaḥ' iti vyadhikaraṇe ete pañcamyāvityabhyupagamyaivaṃ vyākhyāyate-- śadeḥ paro yaḥ śit tasmādātmepadaṃ bhavatīti, tadā sārvadhātukāśrayatvācchitaḥ prāgeva tadutpatterdhātoḥ śeṣatvādasya lāvasthāyāṃ parasmaipadaṃ syāt, tatastannimittakaḥ vyācikhyāsurāha-- śadiryaḥ śiditi| etena `śadeḥ śitaḥ' iti samānādhikaraṇe ete pañcamyāviti darśayati| kathaṃ punaḥ śadiḥ śidbhavati, yāvatā vikaraṇasya śakāra itsaṃjñaka itsaṃjñāsambandhī, na tu śadeḥ ? ityata āha-- `śadbhāvī' iti| bhāviśabdo'yam `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ'(3.3.3) iti bhaviṣyatkālaviṣayaḥ| śidbhāvīti yataḥ śidbhaviṣyati sa śidbhāvī|etaduktaṃ bhavati-- śinnimittatvādupacāreṇa śadiḥ śidityuktamiti| bhavati hi kāraṇe kāryopacārāt tathā vyapadeśaḥ, yathā-- ऩḍvalodakaṃ pakādaroga iti| śito vā sambandhī' iti| etena `śitaḥ' ityasya ṣaṣṭhyantatāṃ darśayati| kaḥ śadeḥ śitsambnadhī ? yastasya prakṛtiḥ| prāgapi śitaḥ śadestatprakṛtitvamastyeveti śitprakṛteḥ śaderātmanepadaṃ bhavati| `śīyate' iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) śīyādeśaḥ|| 61. mriyaterluṅaliṅośca | (1.3.61) `niyamārthamidaṃ vacanam'iti| mriyaterluṅaliṅoḥ śita eva yathā syāt| yadyevam, ṅid‌grahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā'nyatrātmanepadena na bhavitavyamiti ? ucyate; svarārthamupadiśyate-- mā hi mṛteti luṅi `tāsyanudāttenṅidupadeśālla sārvadhātukasya' (6.1.186) iti anudāttatve kṛte dhātorantodāttatvaṃ bhavati| `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighāto'tra `hi ca' (8.1.34) iti pratiṣidhyate| aḍāgamo'pi `na māṅayoge' (6.4.74) iti| `amṛta' iti| `hrasvādṅāt' (8.2.27) iti sico lopaḥ| `mṛṣīṣṭa' iti| āśiṣi liṅa, tasya `liṅāśiṣi' (3.4.116) ityārddhadhātukatvādvikaraṇābhāvaḥ; `suṭ tithoḥ' (6.4.107) iti suṭ; vali (6.1.66) yalopaḥ| `mriyate'iti| tudāditvācchaḥ; `riṅa śayagliṅakṣu' (7.4.28) iti riṅādeśaḥ, `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādineyaṅa| `mariṣyati'iti| `ṛddhanoḥ sye' (7.2.70) itīṭ|| 62. pūrvavatsanaḥ| (1.3.62) `pūrvavat' iti| `tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ' (5.1.115) iti vatiḥ|. pūrvaśabdaḥ sambandhiśabdatvādavadhimapekṣate| sa cāvadhiḥ śrutatvātsanneva vijñāyata ityāha-- `sanaḥ pūrvo yo dhātuḥ' iti| yadyevam, avadhibhāvopagama eva sangrahaṇasyopayuktatvātta sannantādātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti, na tatraitallabhyate; kutastarhi syāt ? dhātumātrāt, naitadasti; evaṃ hyātmanepadaṃ parasmaipadānukramaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| atha pratyayāntāt syāt ? evamapi sangrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, pūrvavat pratyayāditi vācyaṃ syāt| tasmāt partyāsannaṃ sanaṃ tyaktvā na yuktvā na yuktā'nyanyasyāśrutasya parikalpaneti sanntādeva bhavatīti vijñāyate| `yena' ityādinā vatyarthamācaṣṭe| `tadeva nimittam' iti| anudāttetvaṃ ṅittvañca dhātvantarāvasthāyāmapi sannantādvacanasāmarthyānnimittaṃ bhavati| `asisiṣate' iti| iṭi kṛte `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti siśabdasya dvirvacanam| `nivivikṣate' iti| `viśa praveśane' (dhā.pā.1424), pūrvavat kittvaṣatvakatvāni| `ācikraṃsate' iti| ātmanepadanimittatvāt `snukramoranātmanepadanimitte' (7.2.36) itīṇ na bhavati| `śiśatsati', mumūrṣati'iti| atra sano yaḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ, tasyātmanepadanimittatvamasti; śīyate, mriyata ityātmanapadadarśanāt| tata ātmanepadena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākartumāha-- `iha na bhavati' ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha-- `na hi' ityādi| kiṃ tarhi ? `śidādyapi'iti| śicchabdenātra śidbhāvitvaṃ śitsambandhitvañcoktam| ādiśabdena luṅaliṅorgrahaṇam, tacceha nāstīti na hyatra sanaḥ pūrvabhāgasya śidbhāvitvaṃ śitsambandhitvaṃ vāsti; śitpratyayasyāsmin viṣaye'tyantāsambhavāt, nāpi mriyateḥ parau luṅaliṅau staḥ; tasmānneha śadimriyatyorātmanepadanimittatvamastīti na bhavatyātmanepadam| iha tarhi kasmānna bhavati-- anucikīrṣati, parācikīrṣatīti ? karoterhi gandhanādiṣvartheṣvātmanepadaṃ vihitam, atastdavivakṣāyāṃ sanantādapi tena bhavitavyamityāha-- `yasya ca' ityādi| gandhanādiṣvartheṣu pūrvatrāsanantāvasthāyām `anuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ' (1.3.79) ityanena parasmaipadavidhānāt karoterātmanepadābhāvaḥ kriyate| tasmādābhyāṃ sanantādapyātmanepadanimittābhāvānna bhavati| `atha jugupsate, mīmāṃsata ityatra kathamātmanepadam, yāvatā `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityucyate, na ca gupādiṣu sanaḥ prāgevātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti; ataḥ pūrvavadityatideśābhāvānna bhavitavyamātmanegadenetyata āha-- `iha' ityādi| `jugupsate'iti| `guptijkidbhyaḥ san' (3.1.5) iti san| `mīmāṃsate' iti| `mānabadha' (3.1.6) ityādinā san, abhyāsasya `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itītve dīrghaḥ| kathaṃ punariha `anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam' (1.3.12), yāvatā gupādāvavayave'nudāttetvaṃ liṅgam, na jugupsādau samudāya ityata āha -- `avayave kṛtam' ityādi| yathā goḥ karṇādāvavayave kṛtaṃ liṅagaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, tathā gupādāvavayave kṛtamanudāttettvaṃ samudāyasya jugupsa ityevamāderviśeṣakraṃ bhavati| yadyevam, gopayati, tejayati, saṅketayatītyevamādāvapi prāpnoti, satyam; syādetat-- avayavekṛtaṃ liṅagaṃ tasya samudāyasya gorviśeṣakaṃ bhavati, yaṃ samudāyaṃ so'vayavo na vyabhicarati; sanantaṃ punarna vyabhicarati; ṇijantantu vyabhicaratītyato'trātmanepadena na bhavitavyam; vārttametat, sanantamapi vyabhicaratīti vināpi tena gopayatītyādau sambhavāt| tasmāt samudāyaṃ yaṃ gupādirna vyabhicarati, tasyāsambhavāt sarvasya gupādāvayave kṛtamanudāttettvaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhaviṣyati| tataśca gopayatiprabhṛtibhyo'pyātmanepadaṃ prāpnotītyeva| evaṃ tarhi `nigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca' (1.3.87) ityatra cakāro'nuktasamudhcayārthaḥ kriyate| tena gupādibhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ parasmaipadātmanepadāpavādo bhaviṣyati|| 63. āmpratyayavatkṛño'nuprayogasya| (1.3.63) `āmpratyayavat'iti| `tatra tasyeva' (5.1.116) iti ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādvatiḥ| `kṛño'nuprayogasya' iti samānādhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| `īkṣāñcakre' ityādi| `īkṣa darśane' (dhā.pā.610), `īha ceṣṭāyām' (dhā.pā.632), `ūha vitarke' (dhā.pā.648) liṭ, `ijādeḥ' (3.1.36) ityādi''nām, `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti lerluk; prātipadikatvāt supa prāptaḥ; suḥ, svarāditvādavyayatvāt subluk, `kṛñca' (3.1.40) ityādinā kṛño liṭparasyānuprayogaḥ| `akartrabhiprāyāyartho'yamārambhaḥ' iti bruvatā vidhyarthametadityuktaṃ bhavati| tatrāsminvidhyarthe yo doṣastamudbhāvayitumāha-- `yadi' ityādi| `udubjāñcakāra' iti| `ubja ārjave'(dhā.pā. 1303), utpūrvālliṭ, pūrvavadām| `parasmaipadānām' (3.4.82) ityādinā tipo ṇal| `udumbhāñcakāra' iti| `ubha umbha pūraṇe' (dhā.1319, 1320) `ubhayam' ityādinā parihāraḥ| `katham'iti ? ekena prayatnenāśakyametadubhayaṃ karttumityata āha-- `pūrvavat' ityādi| naivātreko yatnaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? dvau-- `āmpratyayavat' ityeko yatnaḥ,pūrvavadgrahaṇamanuvarttamānaṃ dvitīyaḥ| tatra pūvaṇa yatnena vidhiḥ kriyate, itareṇa niyamaḥ| yadyanuprayogasya kṛña ātmanepadaṃ bhavati, pūrvavadeva; nānyathā| tenodubjāñcakāretyenamādau na bhavati| na hyubjādīnāmātmanepadaṃ sambhavati, parasmaipaditvāt| `īkṣāmāsa' iti| ām, asteranuprayogaḥ| `īkṣāmbabhūva' iti| `bhavetaraḥ' (7.4.73) `kṛñca' (3.1.40) ityatra karotereva grahaṇamityabhiprāyeṇāha-- `kathaṃ punaḥ' ityādi| `kṛñiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam' ityādi| tatra pratyāhare|ḍastibhavatyorapi sannideśaḥ| tastayorapyanuprayogo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| yadyavam, sampado'pyanuprayogaḥ prāpnoti,tasyāpi tatra sanniveśostyeva; `abhividhau sampadā ca' (5.4.53) iti vacanāt| satyapi sanniveśe nāsau pratyāhāragrahaṇana gṛhyata ityadoṣaḥ| yathā tasyāgrahaṇaṃ tatottaratra prastāvāntare pratipadāyiṣyāmaḥ| athāmpratyayavaditi kim ? asati hi tasminnanuprayogamātrasyātmanepadaṃ syāt-- devadattaḥ karotīti ? atrāpi pūrvavadityanuvarttate| tathāpīha syāt-- īhate, karotīti ? `āmpratyayam' ityucyamāne pratyāsatterāma evānuprayogasyeti gamyate, nānuprayogamātre, tenātiprasaṅgo na bhavati|| 64. propābhyāṃ yujerayajñapātreṣu| (1.3.64) `yuja samādhau'(dhā.pā.1177) ityasyānudāttettvāt siddhamātmanepadamityatastasyeha grahaṇamayuktamityabhiprāyeṇāha-- `yujir yoge' iti| `prayuṅkate' iti| rudhāditvāt `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam - jakārasya gakāraḥ, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti carttvam - kakāraḥ, `naśca' (8.3.24) ityādinā'nusvāraḥ, `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58) iti ṅakāraḥ| `svarādyantopasṛṣṭāviti vaktavyam' iti| svaro'j ādiranto vā yasya sa svarādyantaḥ, tadupasṛṣṭāt - tatsambandhādyujerātmanepadaṃ bhavati-- ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam- iha sūtre praśabdo'jantopasargalakṣaṇārthaḥ, upaśabdojādyupalakṣaṇārthaḥ, upaśabdo'jādyupalakṣaṇārthaḥ, tena sarveṇājantenājādinā copasargeṇa cayuktājyujerātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti| svarādyantopasṛṣṭāditi kim ? niryunakti|| 65. samaḥ kṣṇuvaḥ| (1.3.65) `akarmakāditi tatrānuvarttate' iti| sakarmakādapi kṣṇuva ātmanapadamiṣyata iti manyate| ata eva sakarmakasyodāharaṇamupanyastam| `saṃkṣṇute śastram' iti| adāditvācchapo luk| `saṃkṣṇuvāte' iti| `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinovaṅa| `saṃkṣṇuvate' iti| pūrvavadādeśaḥ| 66. bhujo'navane| (1.3.66) `avanapratiṣedhena' ityādi| avanaṃ pālanam| tatpratiṣedhena raudhādikasya bhujergrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate; na taudādikasya-- `{bhujau-- dhātupāṭhaḥ} bhuja kauḍisye' (dhā.pā.1417) ityasya| yathaiva hi savatsā dhenurānīyatāmityukte yasyā hi vatsena saha sambandhaḥ sambhavati saiva godhenurānīyate, na mahiṣyādidhenuḥ; tathehāpyavanapratiṣedhena yasya bhujo'navane vṛttiḥ sambhavati, sa eva raudhādikaḥ pratīyate; tasmāt tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tena nirbhujati, vibhujatīti taudādikasyātmanepadaṃ na bhavati|| 67. ṇeraṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa karttānādhyāne| (1.3.67) `ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ' iti| aṇau karmapradarsanārthametaduktam| idaṃ tvatrodāharaṇam-- `ārohayate hastī svayameva' ita| ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā ityatrāṅapūrvasya tu `ruha bījajanmani prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.859) ityasya dve kriye vācye-- nyagambhavanam, nyagbhāvanañca| tatra nyagbhavanasya hastī karttā, nyagambhāvanasya hastipakā iti| nyagbhavantaṃ hastinaṃ nyagbhāvayantītyarthaḥ| sa yadā tu suśikṣitatvāt suvidheyatvācca nyagbhāvanakriyāyāmatyantamānukūlyaṃ pratipadyate hastī svayameva; tadāsau hastī hastipakān prati prayojanakatvena vivakṣyate, hastipakāstu prayojyatvena| hastī hastipakān prayuṅkte-- māmārohateti, tataśca prayojyaprayojakabhāve vivakṣite hetumaṇṇic| evamuttaratrāpi karmaṇaḥ karttṛtvasya vivakṣitatvāt prayojakabhāvavivakṣāyāṃ ṇijvidheyaḥ| tatastasminnutpanne yadā nirjñātasvarūpatvāccaritārthatvāt prayojyā na vivakṣyante, tadā nivṛttatvāt prayojyaprayojakabhāvasya nyagbhavanamātre ruhirvartate| atredamudāharaṇam-- ārohayate hastī svayameveti| tathā hi yadevāṇyante karmāsīt sa eva ṇyante hastī karttā bhavati| na ca prayojyaprayojakabhāve nivṛtte'pi ṇico nivṛttirbhavatiḥ nivṛttikāraṇābhāvāt| yathaiva hi devadattasya vyāpāre nivṛtte'pi paciḥ pākānna nivarttate-- pacyata odanaḥ svayameveti, tathehāpi nivṛtte prayojyaprayojakavyāpāre ṇico nivṛttirna bhavatīti veditavyam| `siñcanti' ityādi| atrāpi sicyamāno hastī karma yadā suśikṣitatvāt suvidheyatvācca secanakriyāṃ prati prakṛṣṭamānukūlyaṃ bhajate, tadā tasya prayojakatve vivakṣite hastipakānāñca prayojyatve ṇic| tatra kṛte pūrvavat prayojyeṣvavivakṣiteṣu yadevāṇyante karma sa eva ṇyante karttā bhavati| `paśyanti' ityādi| atrāpi dṛśyamānasya rājñaḥ darśanakriyāyāmatiśayenānukūlyabhāvopagamanāt prayojakatve vivakṣite bhṛtyānāñca prayojyatve ṇic| tatra vihite pūrvavat prayojyāvivakṣāyāṃ yadeva dṛśeraṇynate karma rājā, sa eva ṇyante karttā| kriyapi ca sarveṣveteṣūdāharaṇeṣu yaivāṇyantāvasthāyām, saiva ṇyante'pi| satyapi ca ṇici prayojyaprayojakabhāvasya nivarttitattvāt kriyāntarasya cānutpatteḥ| `gaṇayati' ityādi| `gaṇa saṃkhyāne' (dhā.pā.1853) canurādavadantaḥ paṭhyate| tato ṇic , `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityākāralopaḥ| tasya pūrvavidhau karttavye sthānivadbhāvāt `ata upādhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) ti vṛddhirna bhavati| `gaṇayati gogaṇaṃ gopālakaḥ| gaṇayati gaṇaḥ svayameva' iti| atra sa gaṇyamāno yadā gaṇanaṃ pratyānukūlyaṃ bhajamānaḥ prayojakatvena vivakṣyate, gopālakastu prayojyatvena; tadā hetumaṇṇic| tasmin kṛte pūrvavat prayojyāvivakṣāyāṃ yadeva karma sa eva karttā bhavati| tathāpyaṇāviti vacanādātmanepadaṃ na bhavati; na hi gaṇaḥprāgaṇau karmāsīt, kiṃ tarhi ? ṇyanta eva| nanu ca "aṇāvakarmakāccittavatkartṛkāt' (1.3.88) ityatra `aṇau' iti kim ? cetayamānaṃ prayojayati cetayate iti kecit pratyudāharanti" ityuktvā pratyudāharanti" ityuktvā vṛttikāro vakṣyati, tadayuktam, `hetumaṇṇico vidhiḥ| pratiṣedho'pi pratyāsatyā tasyaiva nyāyyaḥ'iti, taccet, satyam, gaṇayati gogaṇaṃ gopālakaḥ, gaṇayati gogaṇaḥ svayamevetyetadapi pratyudahāraṇamayuktameva syāt, naitadasti; bhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt| yadi hi bhedo vivakṣyate, tadā hetumaṇṇico vidhiriti pratiṣedho'pi pratyāsattestasyaiva syāt, na hi viprakṛṣṭasya curādiṇicaḥ|9na ceha bhedo vivakṣitaḥ, `ṇeḥ'iti jātinirdeśāt| tasmāṇṇijmātravidhiḥ, ataḥ pritiṣedho'pi ṇijmātrasyaiva syaditi yuktametat pratyudāharaṇam| `aṇāvakarmakāt' (1.3.88) ityādau sūtre'ṇāviti hetumaṇṇica eva grahaṇam| ata eva hetumaṇṇica eva vidhiriti prāyāsattestasyaiva pratiṣedho yuktaḥ| yathā tatra hetumaṇṇico grahaṇaṃ tathā tatraiva pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ| na cātra tathāvidhaṃ kiñcinnibandhanamasti, yato ṇeriti hetumaṇṇica eva grahaṇamavasīyate; caurādikānāmapyanityaṇyantatvāt, vibhāṣitaṇicāṃ ca keṣāñcidvidyamānatvāt yeṣāmaṇyantānāmeva yat karma, teṣāmeva curādiṇijantānāṃ tasyaiva karttṛtvasambavāt| tasmādiha ṇeriti ṇijmātrasya grahaṇaṃ sūtrakārasyābhimatamiti lakṣyate| atha gaṇayati gogaṇaḥ svayamevetyatra `karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyāḥ'(3.1.87) ityatideśāt kasmādātmanepadaṃ na bhavati ? karttṛsthabhāvakatvāt| atra hi gaṇayatirayaṃ saṃkhyānimitte paricchede jñānaviśeṣe varttate, yasya hi saṃkhyānamityākhyā| sa ca jñāviśeṣaḥ karttari varttate; tatra tasya samavetatvāt, na karmaṇi| tasmāt karttṛsthabhāvakatvādihātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| karmasthakriyāṇāṃ karmasthabhāvakānāñca karmavadbhāvātideśenātmanepadamiṣyate, netareṣām| `lunāti dātreṇa' ityādi| dātrasya tīkṣṇatayā karaṇasyāpi sato viśiṣṭavyāpārabhūtatvāllāvakapuruṣān prati prayojakatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṇic| `ṇau ced‌grahaṇam' ityādi| iha ṇau cediti yat karma sa karttetyetāvatyucyamāne'ṇau yat karma tasya sāmarthyāṇṇāveva karttṛtvaṃ vijñāyata iti kiṃ ṇau cedityanena ? tadaitaṇṇau ced‌grahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ samānakriyārthaṃ vijñāyate-- yadi yaiva karmāvasthāyāṃ kriyā, saiva kartravasthāyāṃ bhavatīti| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yasyaiva dhātvarthasya ytakarma tasyaiva yadi tat karttṛtvena vivakṣyata evamātmanepadaṃ bhavati; nānyatheti| tena `ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, ārohyamāṇo hantī bhītān secayati mūtreṇa' ityatra secayaterātmanepadaṃ na bhavati; bhinnatvāt kriyāyāḥ| tathā hi, nyagbhāvanakriyāyāṃ prāk hsatī karmatvena vivakṣitaḥ, secanakriyāyāṃ tūttarakālaṃ karttṛtvena| `yatsagrahaṇamananyakarmārtham' iti. aṇyante yatkarma ṇyante'pi yadi tadeva karma karttā bhavati na karmāntaram, evamātmanepadaṃ bhavati; nānyathā| nanu vipratiṣiddhametat-- ekasyaivaikadā karmatvaṃ karttṛtvañca ? naitadvipratiṣiddham; eko hi vastudharmaḥ, aparaśca vivakṣādharmaḥ, svātantryavivakṣāyāṃ karttṛtvasya vivakṣādharmatvātta vastudhramatvāccāruhyamāṇatāya karmatvam| `sthalamārohayati manuṣyān' iti| atra karmāntaramapyasti| manuṣyāniti na kevalaṃ hastyeveti na bhavatyātmanepadam| yadyevam, bhītān secayati mūtreṇetyatra karmāntarasadbhāvādātmanepadaṃ na bhaviṣyati; asti hyatrāpi karmāntaram-- bhītāniti; ato na vaktavyam-- samānakriyārthaṃ ṇau cedityetat ? naitadasti, na hi bhītāniti secayateḥ karma kiṃ tarhi ? ārohayateḥ| bhītānārāhayamāṇaḥ san mūtreṇātmānaṃ secayatītyarthaḥ; ayuktametat, evaṃ hyārohyamāṇa ityatrātmanepadaṃ śānacca na syāt, karmāntarasadbhāvāt| naivaṃ tarhi śānajevātra vihitaḥ kiṃ tarhi ? `tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu' (3.2.129) cānaś‌pratyayaḥ| tatra yadi samānakriyārthaṃ ṇau cedgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā yadevārohayateraṇyante karma, sa eva hastī secayaterṇyante karttā bhavatīti tadeva karma, sa eva kartteti syādevātmanepadam| tasmāṇṇau cedgrahaṇaṃ samānakriyārthaṃ karttavyam| `kartteti kimi' iti| karttaryevātmanepadamanena vidhīyate; bhāvakarmaṇoḥ (1.3.13) itmanenaiva siddhatvāt| tasmāt sāmarthyalabdhaḥ karttetyabhiprāyaḥ| karttṛgrahaṇaṃ yevāṇyante karma tasminneva ṇyante karttṛtvena vivakṣite satyevātmanepadaṃ bhatavi, nānyathetyevamartha kriyata iti darśayitumāha-- `ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakāḥ, tānārohayati mahāmātraḥ' iti| atra yadevāṇyante hastī karma na tadeva ṇyante karttṛtvena vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi ? mahāmātraḥ, tenātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| etacca karttṛgrahaṇāllabhyate; tasyānanyārthatvāt| nanu ca yatsagrahaṇamananyakarmārthamityaktam, ihaca karmāntaraṃ hastipakākhyamasta, ato yatsagrahaṇādeva na bhaviṣyati, tat kimetannivṛttyarthena karttṛgrahaṇena ? naitadasti;evaṃ sati hi kartṛgrahaṇe'ṇau yatkarma ṇau cet sa karttā tadeva karma karttā bhavatītyasyārthasyaca pratipādanāya kriyamāṇaṃ yatsagrahaṇamarthavadbhavatīti | asati tu karttṛgrahaṇe tanna karttavyameva syāditi kutaḥ samānakarmatā pratīyate| `smarati vanagulmasya' iti| aṇau karmapradarśanārthametat| karmaviṣayeṇa śeṣatvena viṣayiṇā viṣayaṃ darśayitumuktam| nanvatra na karmāsti; tasya śeṣatvena vivakṣitatvāt| tathā hi `śeṣe' (2.3.50) ittyanuvarttamāne `adhīgartha' (2.3.52) ityādinā karmaṇi śeṣatvena vivakṣite ṣaṣṭhīyaṃ vihitā| tasmādedaṃ darśayitavyam,-- smarati vanagulmamiti| atha vā-- yadyapi taccheṣatvena vivakṣitam, tathāpi smaryamāṇatvāt tasya karmatvaṃ vastuto'styeveti| `smarayati' iti| `smṛ ādhyāne' (dhā.pā.807), vanagulmasya prayojakatve vivakṣite ṇic, ghaṭāditvānmitsaṃjñā, `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvatvam| `enam' iti| `gatibuddhipratyavasānārtha' (1.4.52) ityādinā karmasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām, `dvitīyā ṭaustvenaḥ' (2.4.34) ityenādeśaḥ| nanu ca yatsagrahaṇamananyakarmārtham, iha ca karmānataramasti kokilaḥ, tataśca karmāntarasadbhāvādātmanepadaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti kimetannivṛtyarthenānādhyānagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; ādhyānāmātraṃ vivakṣityedaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupanyastam| enama iti tu vacanaṃ vanagulmaḥ karttā na kokila ityarthopadarśanaparaṃ veditavyam| evaṃ vanagulmaṃ vanagulmo smarayati| ātmānamātmanā smarayatītyarthaḥ| ṇicyutpanne kokilasya prayojyasya vivakṣitatvānnivṛtte prayojyaprayojakabhāve smarayaterṇyantasya prakṛta evārtho bhavati| nanu ca smaraṇaṃ cetanāvatāṃ dharmaḥ, vanagulmaścācetanaḥ, tat kathamasau smaret ? naitadasti; acetaneṣvapi cetanāvaddharmopacāraḥ-- yathā nadīkūlaṃ pipatiṣatīti| `ruhuḥ karttasthakriyaḥ' iti| tadarthasya nyagbhāvanātmano hastipakeṣu samavetatvāt| `dṛśiśca karttasthabhāvakaḥ' iti| tadarthasya darśanasya karttṛṣu bhṛtyeṣu vyavasthitvāt|| 68. bhīsmyorhetubhaye| (1.3.68) `hetubhaye'iti| hetorbhayaṃ hetubhayamiti| `pañcamī bhayena' (2.1.37) iti samāsaḥ| bhītirbhayam - trāsaḥ, aniṣṭāpātāśaṅkā| `tataścadbhayaṃ bhavati' iti| yadi tato hetusaṃjñakāt prayojakādbhayaṃ bhavatyevamātmanepadaṃ bhavati, nānyatheti| yadyevam,smayatyartho na viśeṣitaḥ syāt; yasmādbhayaṃ bibheterevārtho na smarateḥ, tataśca rūpeṇa vismāyayatītyavamādāvapyātmanepadaṃ syāt| muṇḍo vismāpayata ityādau na syādityata āha-- `bhayagrahaṇam' ityādi| bhayagrahaṇaṃ hi dhātvarthopalakṣaṇārtham| dhātvarthaścet prayojakādbhavatītyayamartho vivakṣitaḥ|tena vismayo'pi yadi tata eva hetorbhavati yadyeṣo'rtho labhyata iti smayatyartho'pi viśeṣita eva| vismayaḥ - āścaryam| `muṇḍaḥ' iti| muṇḍaguṇopetatvānmuṇḍaḥ| `bhīṣayate' iti| `ñibhī bhaye' (dhā.pā.1084),`vibhāṣā līyateḥ' (6.1.51) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ `bibheterhetubhaye' (6.1.56) iti pakṣa āttvam| `bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk' (7.3.40) iti ṣuk| `vismāpayate' iti| `{ṣmiṅa'-dhātupāṭhaḥ} smiṅa īṣaddhasane' (dhā.pā.948)| `nityaṃ smayateḥ' (6.1.57) ityāttvam;`artihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk| `kuñcikayainaṃ bhāyayati' iti| karaṇādatra bhayam, na hetoḥ prayojakāt| tenātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| ṣugapyatra na bhavati, sa hīkārāntasyaiveṣyate, `bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk' (7.3.40) ityatra bhī ī-- itīkārapraśleṣanirddeśāt| `rūpeṇa vismāyayati' iti| atra karaṇādeva vismayaḥ;na hetoḥ|| 69. gṛdhivañcyoḥ pralambhane| (1.3.69) 70. liyaḥ sammānanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca| (1.3.70) `viśeṣābhāvāt' iti| kataṃ punarviśeṣabhāvaḥ, yāvatā niranubandhakatvaṃ sānubandhakatvañcānayorviśeṣo'styeva,tataśca `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasyaṭa (vyā.pa.ā53) ityanayā pirabhāṣāya na līṅo grahaṇena bhavitavyam| tadayuktamuktaṃ viśeṣābhāvād‌dvayorapi grahaṇamiti ? naiṣa doṣa-, utsṛṣṭānubandhako hi līha lyanto bhavati| utsṛṣṭe cānubandhe dvayamevābhedakaṃ bhavati-- arthaḥ, śabdāntaratvañca| tatrārthastāvadanayoreka eva, śabdāntaratvamapi nāsti| śabdāntaratvañca prakṛtibedavikaraṇabhedābhyāṃ bhavati| na cānayorṇyantayoḥ prakṛtibhedaḥṣa nāpi vikaraṇabhedo'sti;śabvikaraṇatvāt| yadapi `vibhāṣā līyateḥ' (6.1.51) ityāttvaṃ tadapyubhayorbhavati| tathā ca vakṣyati-- `kimidaṃ līyateriti ? līnātilīyatyorāgantukena yakā nidaśaḥ' iti| `nyagbhāvam' iti| abhibhavanamityarthaḥ| `jaṭābhiḥ' iti| hetau tṛtīyā| jaṭā hi pūjādyadhigamahetubhūtāḥ| tathā hi-- yasya jaṭāḥ santi loke mahānayaṃ tapasvītayupajātasampratyayaiḥ pūjyate|| 71. mithyopapadātkṛño'bhyāse| (1.3.71) `mithyopapadāt' iti| upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam, mithyāśabda upapadaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `padaṃ mithyā kārayate' iti| atrātmanepadānābhyāsasya dyotitatvāt `nityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) isi dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| `sāpacāram' iti| sadoṣam| anena mithyāśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| `svarādiduṣṭam' iti| pūrvasyaivārthaṃ vyaktīkaroti| ādiśabdena rūpasya parigrahaḥ| `asakṛt' iti| abhyāsaśabdārthamudāharaṇena darśayati|| 72. svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale| (1.3.72) `kartrabhiprāye' iti| karttāramabhipraitīti `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1)| yadi sāmānyena yatra kriyāphalaṃ karttāramabhipraiti tatrātmanepadam, tadehāpi syāt-- pacanti pācakāḥ, yajanti yājakā iti| tathā hyatra kriyāphalaṃ dakṣiṇā yājakān karttṛnabhipraiti, bhṛtiśca pācakānityata āha-- `kriyāyāḥ phalam' ityādi| pradhānabhūtaṃ yatphalaṃ kriyāyāstadiha gṛhyate| na ca dakṣiṇādikaṃ kriyāphalaṃ pradhānabhūtam, tato na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ| kiṃ punastatpradhānabhūtamityata āha- `yadayartham' ityādi| etena yaduddiśyāsau yāgādikriyārabhyate, na tu dakṣiṇādyartham| `yadartham' iti| svargādi, na tu dakṣiṇādi| tathā hi svargādyarthaṃ yāgādikriyārabhyate, na tu dakṣiṇādyartham| `yadartham' iti| kriyāviśeṣaṇametat| yacchabdena kriyāyāḥ pradhānabhūtaṃ phalaṃ nirdiśyate| yadarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya kriyārambhasya phalamātrasya grahamabhipretaṃ syāt, tadā phalagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; vyavacchedyābhāvat| nāstyeva hi sa viṣayo yatra kriyāphalaṃ karttāraṃ nābhipraiti; tataśca kartrabhiprāye kriyāyā ityedaṃ bruyāt| evamapyukte ṣaṣṭhyā kriyāyāḥ sambandhini kartrabhiprāye pratyāyite sāmarthyāt phamaleva kriyāyāḥ kartrabhiprāyaṃ gamyate| na hi phalānyat kriyāsambandhi karttāramabhipraiti| tasmāt phalagrahaṇasāmarthyāt pradhānaṃ phalaṃ gṛhyate| atha vā-- pradhānatvādeva pradhānaṃ phalaṃ gṛhyate| tathā coktam-- pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt siddhamiti| asmin vyākhyāne phalagrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham, kartaryātmanepadavidhānāt| pratyāsattaryastasya vācyaḥ karttā yadi tasyaiva tat phalaṃ bhavatīti vijñāyata ityāha-- `tacca' ityādi| gatārtham| `svargādi' iti| ādiśabdenaudanādikamapi gṛhyate| `tathāpi' ityādinā dakṣiṇādeḥ phalasyāpradhānyaṃ darśayati| yadarthaṃ sā kriyārabhyate tatpradhānamihopāttaṃ phalam| svargādyarthaṃ ca yāgādikriyā''rabhyate; na dakṣiṇādyartham| ato'prayojakatvāttadapradhām| tena yadyapi tat karttāramabhipraiti tathāpyātmanepadaṃ na bhavati| athābhipragrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? viprakṛṣṭe'pi phale yathā syāt dvividhaṃ hi kriyāphalam-- āsannam, viprakṛṣṭañca| tatrāsannam-- yasya vyāpārānantarameva niṣpattiḥ| viprakṛṣṭantu-- uparateṣu vyāpāreṣu yannimittāntaramapekṣya kālaviprakarṣakṛtaṃ saṃskāraparipākāccirādbhavati| tatrādyamāsannatvāt dṛṣṭatvādutpattiṃ pratyavyabhicārācca pradhānamam| itarat punarviprakṛṣṭatvādanumeyatvāt sambhavavyabhicārāccotpattiṃ prati vyabhicāraḥ| yadyapi taduddiśya kriyārambhāt tadapi pradhānam, tathāpyaviprakṛṣṭaphalāpekṣayā tasyāprādhānyamastyeva| tatra yadyabhipragrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā lunīta punīta ityādāveva syāt-- yatrāviprakṛṣṭaṃ kriyāphalam| yajate ityādau tu na syāt-- yatra viprakṛṣṭaṃ svargādikaṃ kriyāphalam, pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt| abhigrahaṇe tu na doṣaḥ; yasmādabhirābhimukhye varttate, praśabdasattvārambhe| tena prārambhamātrasyābhimukhye phalaniṣpattau buddhāvāśrīyamāṇāyāṃ sarvatra siddhaṃ bhavati| nanu cāsatyabhipragrahaṇe prakṛtīnāṃ yajiprabhṛtīnāmanubandhaviśeṣāsañjanādeva viprakṛṣṭe'pi phale bhaviṣyatica anyathā hi tasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, na; abhicārādau yatrāviprakṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ dṛṣṭamasti tatra tasya sārthakatvāt| tasmādviprakṛṣṭe'pyapradhāne phale syādityevamarthamipragrahaṇaṃ karttavyameva|| 73. apādvadaḥ| (1.3.73) `nyāyapavādena' ityādinā yenābhiprāyeṇa dhanakāmo nyāyamapavadate taṃ darśayati|| 74. ṇicaśca| (1.3.74) 75. samudāṅ‌bhyo yamo'granthe| (1.3.75) `udyacachati' iti| `cikitsā vaidyaḥ' iti| cikitsāśāstramadhigantumudyamaṃ karotītyarthaḥ|| 76. anupasargājjñaḥ| (1.3.76) nāsyopasargāḥ santīti bahuvrīhiḥ| katasakarmakārtheñcedam| `akarmakācca' (1.3.45) ityevaṃ siddhatvāt|| 77. vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne| (1.3.77) tatra `svaritañitaḥ'(1.3.72) ityādīni pañca sūtrāṇyanuvarttante| `kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale dyogye' iti| kena dyotye ? prakṛtatvādātmanepadeneti vijñeyam| `tadupapadena dyotite na prāpnoti' iti| uktārthānāmaprayogāt| etenāprāptavibhāṣeyamiti darśayati| nanu casvaṃ yajñaṃ yajate ityatra svaśabdasyopapadatvānnopapadyate ? yataḥ `tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham' (3.1.92) iti dvitīyadhātvadhikāre yat saptamīnirdiṣṭaṃ tadupapadasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, na ca svaśabda evaṃvidha ityāha-- `samīpe śrūyamāṇam' ityādi| etenopoccāritaṃ padamupapadamityanvarthasyopapadasya grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati| etacca pāribhāṣikasyāsambhavāllabhyate| `svaṃ yajñam' ityādinā pañcasūtryāṃ yadādyaṃ sūtraṃ tatrodāharati| `svaṃ putram' ityādinā yad‌dvitīyaṃ tatra| `evaṃ pañcasūtryāmudāharāryam' iti| anyatrāpīti seṣaḥ| pañcasūtryantargate sūtre yadudāhṛtaṃ tato'nyatrāpyudāhāryamityarthaḥ | svaṃ kaṭaṃ kārayate, kārayati vā| svaṃ vrīhiṃ saṃyacachate, saṃyacchati vā| svaṃ bhāramudyacchate, udyacchati vā| svaṃ vastramāyacchate, āyacchati vā| svaṃ gāṃ jānīte, jānāti veti| etāni `ṇicaśca' (1.3.74) ityādiṣu sūtreṣu yathāyogamudāharaṇāni|| 78. śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam| (1.3.78) `pūrveṇa' iti| `anudāttahitaḥ' (1.3.12) ityādinā| `sarvatra prāpnoti' iti| aśeṣebhyo'pi| `tadarthamidamucyate' iti| sarvatra parasmaipade prasakte tannivṛttyartham; arthaśabdasya nivṛttivacanatvāt| tathā-maśakārtho dhūma iti| tadenaitat niyamārthamityuktaṃ bhavati| `yebhyo dhātubhyaḥ' ityādinā śeṣatvaṃ darśayati| `yena viśeṣaṇena' iti| anubandhādinā| `yāti, vāti' ityanubandhaśeṣasyodāharaṇam| `āviśati, praviśati' ityupasargaśeṣasyārthaśeṣasyāpi. evaṃ gandhanādibhyo'nyatra karotītyevamādikamudāharaṇaṃ veditavyam| nanu ca śeṣādityanena pañcamyantena dhātusamānādhikaraṇena dhātureva viśiṣyate, nārthaḥ, tataścāśeṣeṣu gandhanādiṣvartheṣu parasmaipadaṃ prāpnoti, naitadasti; gandhanādayo hi prakṛterevārthāḥ, tatrāsau śeṣagrahaṇānnivarttamānastānapi nivarttayati| `pacyate, gamyate' iti| nanu ca yadyatra parasmaipadaṃ syāt, tadā `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) iti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt, anavakāśatvāt, naitadasti; asti hi tasyāvakāśaḥ| kaḥ punarasau ? yo na śeṣaḥ-- āsyate, śayyate, kriyata iti| anudāttetvaṃ ṅittvañcāśeṣaḥ| `śeṣāt kartari' (1.3.78) ityatra karttṛgrahaṇaṃ sāmānyamupāttamiti yo deśayet taṃ pratyāha--`karmakarttari' ityādi| `karttari karmavyatīhāre' (1.3.14) ityādinā pariharati| `karttaiva yaḥ karttā' iti| śuddho yaḥ karttā, karttṛvadbhāvarahito yaḥ karttaityarthaḥ|| 79. anuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ| (1.3.79) 80. abhipratyatibhya kṣipaḥ| (1.3.80) `abhikṣipati' iti| tudāditvācchaḥṣa| 81. prādvahaḥ| (1.3.81) 82. parermṛṣaḥ| (1.3.82) `parimṛṣyati' iti| divāditvācchyan|| 83. vyāṅaparibhyo ramaḥ| (1.3.83) 84. upācca| (1.3.84) `upācca' iti| cakāraḥ pūrvāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ| `uparamati devadattam' iti| nanu copapūrvo ramirakarmaka eva bhavati| tathā hyupapūrvasyāsya vināśo'rtho bhavati; yathā-- uparatāni, naṣṭānīti gamyate| nivṛttirvā bhavati, svādhyāyāduparamate, nivartata iti gamyate| na cāsminnārthe vartamānasya sakarmakatvamupapadyate| tatkataṃ sakarmakasyodāharaṇaṃ yujyata ityāha-- `uparamayatīti yāvat' iti| etena ṇyarthavṛttitāmuparamaterdarśayan sakarmakatāmupapādayatīti| akarmako hi dhāturṇyarthe vartamānaḥ sakarmako bhavati| atha punaraṇyantasya ṇyarthavṛttitopapadyate katham ? sa tathoktaḥ| evaṃvidhasya tasya prayojyena sakarmatvamupapadyata eva| atha kimarthaṃ pṛthagyogaḥ kriyate ? `na vyāṅaparyupebhyo ramaḥ' ityeka eva yogaḥ kriyatāmityāha-- `pṛthagyogakaraṇam' ityādi| gatārtham|| 85. vibhāṣā'karmakāt| (1.3.85) `yāvadbhuktam' iti| `yāvadavadhāraṇe' (2.1.8) ityavyayībhāvaḥ|`bhuktama' iti| `napavaṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) iti ktapratyayaḥ| yāvanti bhojanāni tāvadbhyo nivarttata ityarthaḥ| atha vā-- yāvad‌bhuktamiti yathārthe vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| bhojanādbhojanannivarttata ityarthaḥ|| 86. budhayudhanaśajaneṅprudrumrubhyo ṇeḥ| (1.3.86) `budha avagamane' (dhā.pā.1172), `yudha samprahāre' (dhā.pā.1173), `ṇaśa adarśane' (dhā.pā.1194), `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā. 1149), `iha adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1046), `cyaṅa' (dhā.pā.955) chyuṅ, jyuṅa (dhā.pā.956), jhayuṅa pruṅa (dhā.pā.957) pluṅa (dhā.pā.958) gatau `du dru gatau' (dhā.pā.944, 945), `su sru gatau' (dhā.pā.940)| `janayati' iti| `janījṛṣ' (ga.sū.dhā.pā.817) ityādinā mitsaṃjñā| mitāṃ hrasvatvam| `adhyāpayati' iti| `krīḍajīnāṃ ṇau' (6.1.48) ityāttvam| pūrvavat puk| `etadviṣayāṇyudāharaṇāni' iti| prāptivilayanasyandanaviṣayāṇyetāni prāvayatītyādyudāharaṇāni yathākramamityarthaḥ| syandanaṃ calanamiti loke prasiddham| tato'nyatra syandayatīti boddhayam| prāvayati - prāpayati drāvayati - vilāpayati| srāvayati - syandayatītyarthaḥ| 87.nigaraṇacalanārthebhyaśca| (1.3.87) `nigārayati' iti| `gṛ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410)| `āśayati' iti| `aśa bhojane' (dhā.pā.1523)| `bhojayati' iti| `bhuja pālanābhyavahārayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1046), `calati' iti| `cala kampane' (dhā.pā.832)| ghaṭāditvānmittvam; pūvavad‌dhrasvaḥ| `copayati' iti| `cupa mandāyāṃ gatau' (dhā.pā.403)| `kampayati' iti| `kapi calane' (dhā.pā.375)| ayamapi yogaḥ sakarmakārthaḥ, acitatvatkarttṛkārthaśceti| tadviparītebhyaḥ `aṇāvakarmakāccitavatkarttṛkāt' (1.3.88) ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| tatra yeṣāmudāharaṇānyupanyastāni, teṣu calikampī akarmakau dvau; tayoracitavatkarttṛkārtho'yaṃ yogaḥ| śeṣāṇāntu sakarmakārthaḥ| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `vibhāṣā'karmakāt' (1.3.85) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutyā'nuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenāderanyebhyo nityaṃ parasmaipadam, adestu na bhavatyeva| `ādayate devadattena' iti| atra `gatibuddhi' (1.4.52) ityādinā karmasaṃjñā na bhavati; `ādikhādinīvahīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' (vā.64) iti vacanāt|| 88. aṇāvakarmakāccittavatkarttṛkāt| (1.3.88) `cetayamānam' iti| `citī saṃjñāne' (dhā.pā.39), caurādikaḥ| ayañcākarmakaścittavatkartṛkaśca| `hetumaṇṇico vidhiḥ' iti| budhādeḥ (1.3.86) sūtrādiha ṇijgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sa ca hetumaṇṇijeva; budhādibhyo'nyasya ṇico'sambhavāt| yataśca hetumaṇṇico vidhiḥ, pratyāsattestasyaiva pratiṣedho yuktaḥ| yathābhūta eva vidhibhāk; tathābhūtenaiva pratiṣedhabhājā bhavitavyam; pratyāsatteḥ| tathā hi-- brāh‌maṇāḥ praveśyantāmanyatādhīyānebhya ityukte yatājātīyakānāṃ praveśo vihitastathājātīyakānāmeva pratyāsatteḥ paryudāso vijñāyate| `{ārohyamāṇaḥ'- iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ.} ārohyamāṇam' iti| ṇeraṇāvādi (1.3.67) sūtreṇātmanepadam| yadyapyatra hastipakān prati hastinaḥ prayojakatve vivakṣite ṇijvihitaḥ, tathāpi ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ hastipakāḥ prayojyatvena na vivakṣyante; anyathā hyaṇau yatkarma tadeva ṇau karttā na syāt| tatra prayojyatvāvivakṣāyāmārohya- māṇa ityasya svayamevārohayatītyeṣo'rtho bhavati| tamārohayamāṇaṃ yadānyaḥ prayuṅkte, tadā dvitīyo hetumaṇṇic| tadantāt `ṇicaśca' (1.3.74) ityātmanepadaṃ bhavati| tenārohayata iti yuktameva pratyudāharaṇam|| 89. na pādamyāṅyamāṅyasamaparimuharucinṛtivadavasaḥ| (1.3.89) `pā' iti `lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇāyoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.50) ityanena `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925) ityasyaiva grahaṇam, na `pā rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1056)ityetasya| `damu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1203), `yama uparame' (dhā.pā.984), `yasu prayatne' (dhā.pā.1210), āṅapūrvāvetau| `muha vaicitye' (dhā.pā. 1198), paripūrvaḥ, `ruca dīptau' (745), `nṛtī gātravikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1116), `vada vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.1009) `vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1005), ācchādanārthasya vasergrahaṇaṃ pūrvoktādeva hetorna bhavati| `pūrveṇa yogadvayena' iti| antareṇetyarthaḥ| `nṛtiścalanārtho'pi' iti| apiśabdāccitavatkarttṛkārthaśca| `pāyayate' iti| `śācchāsāhvāvyāvepāṃ yuk' (7.3.37)| pātestvakarmakatvavivakṣāyāṃ parasmaipadaṃ bhavati| `pālayati' iti| `pātelugvaktavyaḥ' (vā.2;7, 3.37) ityupasaṃkhyānāllugāgamaḥ| `damayate' iti| pūrvavat `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92)| `āyāmayate' iti| nanu cātrapimitve sati hrasvena bhavitavyamityata āha-- `yamo'pariveṣaṇe' iti| tatra hi `na kamyamicamām' (ga.sū.dhā.pā.817)ityato netyanuvartate| `āṅa'iti| ṅidviśiṣṭasyākārasyopabadānamupasargapratipattyartham| tenopasargapratirūpako ya ākārastasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| `pādiṣu dheṭa upasaṃkhyānam' iti| pādiṣviti viṣayasaptamī| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| dheṭaḥ pādiviṣayasya parasmaipadapratiṣedhasya pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| yo'yaṃ pādiviṣayaḥ parasmaipadapratiṣedhaḥ,sa dheṭo'pi bhavatītyarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam- neti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena dheṭo'pi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| yadyevam, netyanenaiva siddhatvāt pādīnāṃ grahaṇamanarthakam ? nānarthakam; pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayātvajñāpanārthatvāt| `dhāpayete' iti| `dheṭa pāne' (dhā.pā.902) `ādecaḥ' (6.1.45) ityādināttvam, pūrvavat puk| `śiśum' iti| `gatibuddhi' (1.4.52) ityādinā karmasaṃjñāyāṃ dvitīyā|| 90. vā kyaṣaḥ| (1.3.90) `lohitāyati' iti| alohito lohito bhavatītyatrārthe `lohitādiḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣ' (3.1.13)iti kyaṣ| `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ| `paṭapaṭāyati' iti| paṭacchabdasya ḍāci viṣayabhūte `ḍāci bahulaṃ dve' (vā.888) ityupasaṃkhyānād‌dvirvacanam, `avyaktānukaraṇāt' (5.4.57) ityādinā ḍāc, `nityamāmreḍite ḍāci'(6.1.100) iti paṭaśabdasya yo'ntyastakāraḥ, yaśca tasmātparaḥ pakāraḥ-tayoḥ `katham' iti| na kathañcidityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na labhyata āha-- `yāvatā' ityādi| ātmanepadaṃ hi `anudāttaṅitaḥ' (1.3.12) ityādi niyatam, ato na śakyate kyaṣantādvijñātumiti| `evaṃ tarhi' ityādinā pariharati| `vikalpitam' iti vibhāṣitam, pākṣikamityarthaḥ| nanu cātmanepadaṃ parasmaipadena vyavacchinnam, ato'sannihitvānna śakyate vijñātumityāha-- `tacca'ityādi| kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale vivakṣita ātmanepadaṃ prāpte tadapavādena `amāvakarmakāt' (1.3.88) ityādinā yogadvayena parasmaipadaṃ vihitam| tasyāpavādasyānantarasūtreṇa yaḥ pratiṣedho vihitaḥ, tenāpavādena parasmaipadamapanayatātmanepadaṃ sannidhāpitam| apavāde hyapanīte niyogata evotsargeṇa bhavitavyam| tadevaṃ pratiṣedhena sannidhāpitamihātmanepadaṃ sambadhyate| yadi tarhyanena kartaryātmanepadameva vikalpena vidhīyate, pakṣe parasmaipadaṃ kathaṃ labhyata ityāha-- `tena' ityādi|| 91. dyudbhyo luṅi| (1.3.91) nanu ca dyuterekatvādbahuvacananirdeśo nopapadyata ityāha-- `tatsāhacaryāt' ityādi| yathaikena chattriṇā sāhacaryādanye'pi tatsahacāriṇaśchatriṇa ityucyante-- chatriṇo gacchantīti, tathehāpi dyutinā sāhacaryāt śvitādayo'pi `dyuta' iti vyapadiśyante| kathaṃ punarekasya vyapadeśe satyayamabhipreto'rthaḥ sampadyata ityāha-- `bahuvacananirdeśāt' ityādi| eṃ hi vinā'pyādiśabdena tadartho labhyata ityeṣo'rthaḥ sampadyata iti darśayati| `kṛpūparyantāḥ'iti| anena kṛpeḥ pare ye paṭhyante te dyutādayo na bhavantītyācaṣṭe| etacca tadanantaraṃ vṛtkaraṇādgaṇaparisamāpterliṅgādvijñāyate| `vyadyutat' iti| puṣāditvādaṅa| yadyevam, tata evāṅavidhānāt parasmaipadaṃ tebhyo bhaviṣyati, kimanena yogena ? naitadasti; jñāpakāddhi nityaṃ luṅi parasmaipadaṃ vijñāyate| kiñca luṅo'nyatrātmanepadaṃ na bhavatīti sambhāvyeta| nanu cānudāttetkaraṇasāmarthyādanyatra na bhaviṣyati, naitat; anudāttetkaraṇam `anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' (3.2.149) iti yujarthaṃ syāt| tasmāt karttavyo'yaṃ yogaḥ| aluṭhat| `ruṭha luṭha pratīghāte' (dhā.pā.747, 749)|| 92. vṛdbhyaḥ syasanoḥ| (1.3.92) `syasanoḥ' iti| satī saptamīyam| vartsyatītyādau `se'sici' (7.2.57) ityādeḥ sūtrādasici sa ityanuvarttamāne `gameriṭ parasmaipadeṣu'(7.2.58) ityataḥ parasmaipade ca `na vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ' (7.2.59) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| ātmanepadaṃ tviḍbhavatyeva| `vivṛtsati' iti| `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti kitvād‌guṇābhāvaḥ|| 93. luṭi ca klṛpaḥ| (1.3.93) `cakārastarhi' ityādi| syasanorvṛtāditvādeva siddhe vikalpa ityabhiprāyaḥ| `evaṃ tarhi'ityādinā viśeṣavidhānaṃ sāmānyavidhānasya bādhakaṃ bhavatīti vijñāyate| nanu ca yadīyaṃ prāptiḥ kṛpeḥ prāptiṃ bādhate, dyutādiṣu pāṭhasya tasyānarthakyaṃ prasajyeta ? naitadasti; aṅarthatvāt| nanu ca syasanoriti svaritatvamiṣyate, tena tasya bādhā na bhaviṣyatīti, satyametat; sūtrakārastu cakāraṃ vaicitryārthaṃ cakāra, na svaritatvārtham| `kalptā' iti| pūrvavadadhikāradvayānuvṛttau satyāṃ `tāsi ca klṛpaḥ' (7.2.60) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ' (2.4.85) iti ḍādeśaḥ| `kṛpo ro laḥ' (8.2.18) iti latvam `ciklṛpsati' iti| pūrvavat kitvād‌guṇābhāvaḥ|| iti śrobodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ prathamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ <1.4> atha prathamādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ 1.ā kaḍārādekā saṃjñā| (1.4.1) `yā parā' iti| yatra vipratiṣedhastatra `vipratiṣedhe param' (1.4.2) iti vacanāt parā bhavati| `anavakāśā ca yā' iti| yasyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ kvacidavakāśo nāsti, sā'pyapavādabhūtvāt saṃjñāntaraṃ bādhitvā pravarttate| yadyevam, ata eva saṃjñāsamāveśo na bhaviṣyati, tat kimekasaṃjñādhikāreṇa ? naitadasti, virodhe hi satyapavādabhūtatvaṃ bhavati| vipratiṣedhastu virodha eva, sa ca virodha ekasaṃjñādhikāre sati bhavati, nāsati; tathā hi yatraikasaṃjñādhikāro nāsti, tatra vipratiṣedho nāstyeva, yathā-- pratyayādīnāṃ saṃjñāyām; tasmādasminnadhikāre sati virodho bhavati| tasmiṃśca sati `virodhe param' iti vacanāt parā bhavati, pavādabhūtatvādanavakāśā ca| tasmāt karttavyo'yamadhikāraḥ| yadyevam, aṅasaṃjñāyāṃ bhapadasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo vaktavyaḥ-- bābhravyaḥ, dhānuṣka iti| babhruśabdāt `madhubrabhvrorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ' (4.1.106) iti yañ| tatra bhatvāt `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) aṅgatvādādivṛddhiḥ, tatra `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ; dhanuḥśabdācca dhanuḥ praharaṇamasya `tadasya praharaṇam' (4.4.57) iti ṭhak; `isusuktāntātkaḥ' (7.3.51) iti kādeśaḥ, atra padatvāt `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ' (8.3.39) iti ṣatvam| aṅgatvādādivṛddhirna vaktavyā| `vā kyaṣaḥ' (1.3.90) itato vāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena kvacit saṃjñāsamāveśo bhaviṣyatīti| `anyatra ' iti| loke ca, śāstre ca| loke tāvat-- indraḥ, śukraḥ, purandara iti saṃjñāyāḥ samāveśo dṛṣṭaḥ| śāstre'pi pratyayaḥ,kṛt, kṛtyapratyayaḥ| evamanyatra saṃjñāsamāveśādihāpi syāt, ataevaikā saṃjñā yathā syāditi niyamārthametat| `bhidiśchidiḥ' iti| laghusaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ| prayojanaṃ tu-- `bhettā, chettā' iti| `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ| `śikṣirbhikṣiḥ' iti| gurusaṃjñāyā avakāśaḥ| prayojanaṃ-- `śikṣā, bhikṣā' ita| `gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103) ityakārapratyayaḥ| laghusaṃjñā tvatra prayojanābhāvānna bhavati| ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti-- `atatakṣat, ararakṣat' iti| paratvādgurusaṃjñaiva bhavati| `takṣūtvakṣū tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.655, 656), `rakṣa pālane' (dhā.pā.65ra8), hetumaṇṇic, luṅa, cleścaṅa, ṇilopaḥ, `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti dvarvacanam| yadyatra laghusaṃjñā syāt, `sanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) ityādinā sanvadbhāvāditvaṃ syāt| tadabhāvānna bhavatītyāha-- `sanvallaghuni' ityādi| `eṣa vidhiḥ ' iti| sanvadbhāvavidhiḥ| parasyā idamudāharaṇamuktam| anavakāśāyāstūcyate-- ayante yonirṛtviya iti| ṛtuḥ prāpto'steti `ṛtoraṇ' (5.1.105) `chandasi ghas' (5.1.106) iti ghas; tasyeyādeśe kṛte `siti ca' (1.4.16) iti padasaṃjñā prāpnoti, `yaci bham' (1.4.18) iti bhasaṃjñā ca, anavakāśatvāt padasaṃjñaiva bhavati| yadi bhasaṃjñā
