syāt tadā `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) iti guṇaḥ syāt| bhasaṃjñāyāstvaupagavādiṣvavakāśaḥ| ā kaḍārāditīyato'vadhergrahaṇaṃ vaicitryārtham; anyathā hi `ā dvandvāta ityevaṃ brūyāt| na hi dvandvasaṃśabdānāt pareṇākaḍārādekasaṃjñāvidhānasya prayojanamasti; yata etāvato'vadhergrahaṇamarthavadbhavati|| 2. vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam| (1.4.2) `virodho vipratiṣedhaḥ ' ita| vipratiṣedhaśabdasya loke virodhavācitvena prasiddhatvāt| tathā hi-- viruddhe'bhihite vaktāro vadanti-- `vipratiṣiddhamidamucyate' iti, viruddhamiti gamyate| tasya vipratiṣedhasya viṣayaṃ darśayitumāha-- `yatra' ityādi| prasajyete vidhīyete iti prasaṅgau - vidhī| `anyārthau' iti| anyatra viṣaye'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yayostau tathoktau| anyatra viṣayāntare kṛtārthāvityarthaḥ| `ekasmin' iti| abhinne| yugapat - ekakalām| sa ityasya vipratiṣedha ityane sambandhaḥ| sa vipratiṣedho vipratiṣiddhaḥ, vipratiṣedhasya viṣaya ityarthaḥ| vipratiṣedhaviṣayatvādvipratiṣedaviṣayo hyatra vipratiṣedhaśabdenokto viṣayiṇā viṣayaṃ darśayitum| yasmānna prasaṅgo vipratiṣedha upapadyate, nāpi tadādhāraḥ| `tulyabalavirodhaḥ' iti| tulyabalayorvirodho'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| idaṃ jātipakṣamāśritya vivaraṇaṃ kṛtam| dravyapadārthapakṣe tvayaṃ viśeṣaḥ-- anyaḥ- bhinno'rthaḥ - prayojanaṃ yatostāvanyārthāviti| śeṣaṃ samānam| `vipratiṣedhe' iti ca satī saptamīyam| `utsargāpavāda' ityādi| vipratiṣedho yatrāsti, so'ya yogasyāvakāśaḥ| vipratiṣedhañca tulyabalayoreva bhavatīti nātulyabalayoḥ| etattu `yatra hi prasaṅgāvanyārthau'ityādigranthena tasya viṣayaṃ darśayatā vyākhyātam| na cotsargāpavādādiṣu tulyabalatāstīti, tato nāsāvutsargāpavādādirasya yogasya viṣayaḥ| tena balavāneva tatra bhavati; tatra sāmānyenotsargaḥ pravarttate; yathā--`ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ' (7.2.35) iti, valādisāmānyasyeḍvidhānāt| viśeṣo'pavādaḥ, yathā-- neḍa vaśi kṛti' (7.2.8) itīṭpratiṣedhasya valādiviśeṣe vaśādau kṛti vidhānāt| yasya ca viśeṣe vidhiḥ, sa balavān bhavati; tathā hi-- brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatām, takraṃ kauṇ‍ḍinyāyeti viśeṣavihitaṃ takradānaṃ sāmānyavihitasya dadhidānasyaiva bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati| tasmādvaśādau kṛti pare'pīḍāgamo na bhavati, pratiṣedha eva bhavati-- `stheśabhāsapisakaso varaca' (3.2.175) īśvara iti| nityānityayornityaṃ balavat yathā- `bhisa ais' (7.1.9) ityaitvam| taddhi `bahuvacane jhalyet' (7.3.103) ityettve kṛte prāpnoti| akṛte'pi-- bhūtapūrvagatyāśrayaṇādakārāntādaṅgadbhisa ais vihita iti kṛtvā| yaśca kṛtākṛtapraśaṅgī vidhiḥ sa nitya iti| tathā ca tatra (7.1.9) vakṣyati-- ettvaṃ bhisi paratvāccedata ais kva bhaviṣyati| kṛte'pyettve bhautapūrvyādaistu nityastathā sati|| iti sa nityaḥ| aistve ettvaṃ na prāpnoti; nimittasya jhalādervihitatvāt| vṛkṣeṣvtayādādettvasyāvakāśaḥ, asmiṃśca sati bhūtapūrvagatyāśrayaṇasyāyuktatvāt| tasmāt tadanityam| yaccānityaṃ tat parasya bhāvābhāvamapekṣata iti durbalam| viparyayāt tu nityaṃ balavat| tena vṛkṣairiti paramapyettvaṃ na bhavati| aisbhāva eva tu bhavati| antaraṅgabahiraṅgayorantaraṅgaṃ balavaditi lokata eva dṛṣṭatvāt| loko hi prātarutthāyāntaraṅgāṇi mukhaprakṣālanādīni kāryāṇi karoti, paścadbahiraṅgāṇi rājagṛhagamanādīni kāryāṇi karttumārabhate| śāstre'pyevaṃ veditavyam| divi kāmo'sya dyukāmaḥ, tasyāpatyam `ata iñ' (4.1.95) dyaukāmiḥ. yadyapi dyukāmaśabdādiñ vihitaḥ, tathāpi `akṛtavyūhāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ' (vyā.pa.84) kṛtamapi śāstraṃ nivarttayantīti,pravibhjāyanvākhyāne div kāma iñiti sthite `div ut' (6.1.131) ityuttve kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ prāpnoti, `taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' (7.2.117) iti paratvāt vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti ? antaraṅgatvādyaṇādeśaḥ pūrvo vidhiḥ kriyate, paścād‌vṛddhirukārasya| antaraṅgatvantu yaṇādeśasya varṇāśrayatvāt| vṛddhestu bāhyataddhitāśrayādbahiraṅgatvam| `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' (vyā.pa.39) ityetadiha na pravartate; vyāśrayatvāt| `apravṛttau' ityādi| yadā `ākṛtiḥ padārthaḥ'ityeṣa pakṣa, tadā'nyatra kṛtārthatvācchāstrayorvipratiṣedhe sati parasparapratibandhādapravṛttireva prāpnoti; yathā-- yadiha dvayostulyabalayorekaḥ preṣyo bhavati, tau ca yugapat preṣayataḥ, nānādikṣu tayoḥ kārye bhavataḥ| tato yadyasāvavirodhārthī bhavati tadobhayorapi kārye na pravartate| dravye padārthe tu prativyakti lakṣaṇaṃ pravartta ityakṛtārthatvallakṣaṇayoḥ paryāyeṇa pravṛttiḥ prāpnoti, yathā-- brāhmaṇakṣatriyādīnāmasahabhujāmekasmin bhājane bhujakriyāyāṃ paryāyaḥ syāt| tatra jātau padārthe kṛtārthatvād‌vṛttau prāptayāṃ vidhyarthamidamārabhyate-- vipratiṣedhe sati paraṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti| tatra kṛte yadi pūrvamapi prāpnoti, tadapi bhavatyeva| tatredamucyate-- punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānāt siddhamiti| vyaktau tu padārthe'kṛtārthatvāt śāstrayoḥ paryāyeṇa pravṛttau prāptayāṃ niyamārthamidam-- vipratiṣedhe parameva bhavati na pūrvamiti| tatredamucyate-- `sakṛd‌gatau vipratiṣedhe yadbādhitaṃ tadbādhitameva' (vyā.pa.40) iti| 3. yū stryākhyau nadī| (1.4.3) `ī ca ū ca yū' iti| nanu ca `dīrghājjasi ca' (6.1.105) iti prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghatve pratiṣiddhe yaṇādeśe sati yvāviti bhavitavyam. tatkathaṃ `yū' iti nirdeśa ityata āha-- ` avibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ' iti| `supāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) iti vibhaktirluptatvāt| nāsmādvibhaktirvidyata ityavibhaktikaḥ| `striyamācakṣāte stryākhyau' iti| nanu ca `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) ityaṇi kṛte `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuki ca stryākhyāyāviti bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ stryākhyāviti ? `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) iti kapratyaye kṛta etadrūpamiti cet, na; cakṣiṅo'tra sopasaragtvādityata āha-- `mulavibhujādidarśanāt' iti| mūlavibhujādiṣvapi kapratyaya iṣyate| tathā ca vakṣyati tṛtīye'dhyāye kaprakaraṇe-- `mūlavibhujādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' (vā.232) iti| tena `stryākhyau' iti śabdasya mūlavibhujādiṣu darśanāt kapratyayaḥ| ihedūtoreveyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate ? tadantayorvā ? tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, kṛtstriyāṃ na syāt-- he lakṣmi, he yavāgviti; samudāyau hyatra stryākhyau, na tvīdūtāviti| imamādye pakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha -- `īkārāntamūkārāntam' ityādi| nanu ca `suptiṅantaṃ padam'(1.4.14) ityatrāntagrahaṇādanyatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirna labhyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayam `neyaṅavaṅasthānau' (1.4.4) iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti; tajjñāpayati-- bhavatīha prakaraṇe tadantavidhiriti ; anyathā pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| na hīkārokāramātraṃ stryākhyāmiyaṅasthānamasti,kiṃ tarhi ? tadantam| `kumārī' iti| `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti ṅīṣ| `gaurī' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' ((4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ| `śārṅaravī' iti| `śārṅaravādyaño ṅīn' (4.1.73)| `lakṣmīḥ' iti| `lakṣa darśanāṅkayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1538) `avitṛstṛtantribhya īḥ' (da.u.1.82) ityanuvarttamāne `lakṣermuṭ ca' (da.u.1.84) cakārādīkāraśca| `brahmabandhūḥ' iti| `ūṅutaḥ' (4.1.66) ityūṅapratyayaḥ| ṅakāraḥ `noṅadhātvoḥ' (6.1.175) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| `yavāgūḥ' iti| `yū miśraṇe' (dhā.pa.ā1033) `suyūvacibhyo'nyujāgūjak‌nuc' (da.u.10.4) ityāgūc‌pratyayaḥ| rūpodāharaṇānyetāni|kāryaṃ tu `ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ'(7.3.107) ityevamādi| `mātre, duhitre' ityatra nadīsaṃjñāyā abhāvāt `āṇ nadyāḥ' (7.3.112) ityāṇ na bhavati| `grāmaṇīḥ, khalapūḥ' iti| paṃsyetau varttete| tena natīsaṃjñāyā abhāvāt `ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ' (7.3.107) iti hrasvo na bhavati| grāmaṃ nayatīti `satsūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip| `agragrāmābhyāñca' (kā.vā.5064) iti ṇatvam| khalaṃ punātīti `anyabhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip| `grāmaṇye striyai' iti| `eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya' (6.4.82) iti yaṇaādeśaḥ| `khalapve striyai' | atrāpi oḥ supi' (6.4.83) iti| atra strīśabdena padāntareṇa strītvaṃ dyotyata iti nadīsaṃjñā na bhavati, tenāṇna bhavati| iṣvaśaniprabhṛtīnāṃ tūbhayaliṅgānāṃ śabdārtha eva strītvamiti bhavatyeva nadīsaṃjñā-- iṣvai, aśanyā iti| yadi padāntaradyotye strītve nadīsaṃjñā na bhavati, iha paṭvai striyā iti paṭuśabdasya puruṣe'pi dṛṣṭtvāt padāntaradyotyamatra strītvamiti nadīsaṃjñā na syāt, naitadasti; padāntaraṃ hi davividham- kvacitsāmānyena pravṛttimāśaṅkamānasya śabdasya sāmānyasyābhidheyāntaraṃ vyavacchinatti, yathā-- gośabdasya gavādiṣu gaurvāgiti; kvacit pravṛttimeva karoti , yathā-- vāhīkādau gaurvādīka iti| atra yat sāmānyasya śabdasya paṭvādeḥ padāntarasambandhena viśeṣe'vasthānaṃ tat pade'ntarbhūtamevetyākhyāgrahaṇena nāpanīyate| grāmaṇīśabdasya tu strītvapravṛttiḥ padāntareṇa kriyate,na tu vyavacchidyate| tenāsāvākhyāgrahaṇenāpasāryate| etayostu kriyāśabdatvena rūḍhā puṃsimukhyā vṛtti| paṭuśabdasya pāṭavopādayinaḥ paratra mukhye'pītyasti bhedaḥ| 4.neyaṅusthānāvastrī| (1.4.4) `iyaṅuvaṅasthānau yau yū tau nadīsaṃjñakau na bhavataḥ' iti| yūdvāreṇa yvantasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate, na kevalayoḥ; prāptyabhāvāt. na hi yū kevalāviyaṅustānau stryākhyau vidyete| `hi śrīḥ, he bhrūḥ' iti| atra nadīsaṃjñāyā abhāvāt tannibandhanaḥ `a mbārthanadyorhrasvaḥ' (7.3.107) iti hrasvo na bhavati| `śriñ sevāyām' (dhā.pā.897) `kvibvacipracchiśrisrudruprujvāṃ dīrghau'samprāsāraṇañca'(vā. 288) iti kvipi dīrghatve kṛte śrīriti bhavati| `bhramu anavasthāne' (dhā.pā.1205) ityasmāt `bhramerḍūḥ' (da.u.1.177) iti ḍūpratyaye ṭilope bhruriti bhavati| ubhayoḥ `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādineyaḍuvaṅorvidhānādiyaṅuvaṅasthānau yū bhavataḥ| `he stri' iti| `ṣṭyai styai śabdasaṃdhātayoḥ' (dhā.pā.911,910)| `ādeca upadeśe'śitita (6.1.45) ityāttvam; styāyaterḍraṭa, `ṭeḥ'(6.4.155) iti ṭibhāgalopaḥ; `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti vākarasya lopaḥ, `ṭiṭḍhā' (4.1.15) ityādinā ṅīp| atra nadīsaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhābhāvāt hrasvatvaṃ bhavatyeva| strīśabdasya `striyāḥ' (6.4.79) itīyaṅavidhānādiyaṅasthāna īkāraḥ| atha sthānagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? iyaṅuvaṅasthānayoḥ pratiṣedho yathā syāditi cet ? na; yadyetat prayojanamabhimataṃ syāt `iyaṅuvaṅoḥ' ityevaṃ vācyam| evamapyayamevārthaḥ-- iiyaṅuvaṅoḥ sambandhau yau yū tayornadīsaṃjñā na bhavatīti| kau ca tayoḥ sambandhinau yū ? yau tayoḥ prakṛtibhutāviyaṅuvaṅarasthānāviti, antareṇāpi sthānagrahaṇamiyaṅuvaṅasthānayoḥ pratiṣedho vijñāsyate| idaṃ tarhi sthānagrahaṇasya prayojanam-- yatreyaṅvaṅoḥ sthitirabhinivṛttistatra pratiṣedho yathā syāt| yatra tvapavādena tayorbādhastatra mā bhūditi-- ādhyai, varṣābhvai iti| `dhyai cintāyām' (dhā.pā.908) `anyabhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip; samprasāraṇañca| samprasāraṇantu dṛśigrahaṇāllabhyate| tathā hi tatraiva dṛśigrahaṇaṃ vidhyantaropasaṃgrahārtham| kvaciddīrghaḥ, kvaciddvirvacanamityuktvā `dhyāyateḥ samprasāraṇañca' (vā.292) iti vakṣyati| kṛtasamprasāraṇasyaiva caturthyekavacane `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ| varṣābhūśabdasyāpi `varṣābhvaśca' (6.4.84) iti| 5.vā''mi| (1.4.5) saṃhitāsāmye'pi ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasyāmo grahaṇam, na tu dvitīyaikavacanasya; tatra nadīsaṃjñākāryābhāvāt| nāpi saptamyādeśasyāmo grahaṇam; tasya nadīsaṃjñottarakālaṃ `ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' (7.3.116) ityāmvidhānāt| `śrīṇātra' iti| nadīsaṃjñāpakṣe `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ' (7.1.54) iti nuṭ| iha stryākhyāditi varttate, vibhaktisambandhena ceyaṃ nadīsaṃjñā vidhīyata iti vibhaktisambandhina eva śabdarūpasya stryākhyasya nadīsaṃjñā yuktā, tena yatrāvayavastryākhyaḥ, tatra nadīsaṃjñā na bhavati-- atiśriyāṃ brāhmaṇānām, atibhruvāṃ brāhmaṇānāmiti|| 6. ṅiti hrasvaśca| (1.4.6) yadyatra hrasvaviśeṣaṇārtha `yū' iti nānuvarttate iti nānuvarttate, tadehāpi syāt-- mātre duhitra iti; tasmāt tadihānuvarttate| anuvarttamānamapi yadi prathamāntamanuvartate, tadā prathamāntayorhrasvatvaṃ prati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo nopapadyate| tasmāt tadihārthāt ṣaṣṭhyantamupajāyata ityata āha-- `hrasvaśca yvoḥ sambandhī' iti| kaḥ punastayoḥ sambandhī hrasvaḥ ? yastayorhrasvaḥ savarṇaḥ; tena sāmarthyādikārokārayorgrahaṇam, na hi tābhyāmanyo hrasva īdutoḥ savarṇaḥ sambhavati| `kṛtyai, kṛtaye' iti| yadā nadīsaṃjñā tadā pūrvavadāṭ, anyathā tu `śeṣo dhyasakhi' (1.4.7) iti dhisaṃjñakatvāt `gherṅiti'(7.3.111) guṇaḥ| atrāpi yatra vibhaktisambandhinaḥ śabdarūpasyāvayavaḥ stryākhyastatra pūrvoktayā rītyā nadīsaṃjñā na prāpnoti-- atikṛtaye brāhmaṇāya, atiśriyeti|| 7.śeṣo ghyasakhi| (1.4.7) `sakhyā' iti| ghisaṃjñāyā `āṅo nāstriyām' (7.3.120) iti nābhāvo na bhavati| `sakhye, sakhyuḥ' ityatrāpi `gherṅiti' (7.3.111) na guṇaḥ| `sakhyau' ityatra `acca gheḥ' (7.3.119) ityattvaṃ na bhavati| `idudbhyām' (7.3.117) `aut' (7.3.118) ityauttvaṃ bhavati| sakhyurityatrāpi `khyatyāt parasya' (6.1.112) ityuktam| iha śobhanaḥ sakhā'syeti susakhiriti; susakherāgacchatītyatra tadantavidhinā pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, sa ca `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti' (vyā.pa.89) iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati| iha dvividhā ghisaṃjñā-- avayavāśrayā, samudāyāśrayā ca| tatra yā'vayavāśrayā sā pratiṣidhyate, yā punaḥ samudāyāśrayā sā ca bhavatyeva; tasyā apratiṣedhāt|| 8.patiḥ samasā eva| (1.4.8) `patiśabdasya siddhāyāṃ ghisaṃjñāyām' iti| anantarasūtreṇaiveti śeṣaḥ| `prajāpatinā' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| yadi siddhāyāṃ ghisaṃjñāyāmidamārabhyate tadā `siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ' (du.si.kā.sū.vṛ.59) iti vināpyevakāreṇa labhyata eva niyamaḥ, tat kimarthamevakārakaraṇamityata āha-- `evakārakaraṇam' ityādi| vinā hyevakāreṇa viparītamapyāśaṅkyeta-- patireva samasā iti| tataśca dṛḍhamuṣṭinetyādau na syāt, evakāre tu sati bhavatīti| tathā hyatar samāsaśabdādanantaraṃ prayujyamānaṃ yata evakārakaraṇaṃ tato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti patiśabda eva niyamyate, na samāsaḥ|| 9. ṣaṣṭhīyuktaśchandasi vā| (1.4.9) atra yadi patiśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhīvibhaktyanto ghi jño bhavatītyeṣo'rtho'bhimataḥ syāt, tadā yuktagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; ṣaṣṭhītyavaṃ brūyāt| tasmādyuktagrahaṇe sati ṣaṣṭhyantaśabdāntareṇa yukta ityeṣo'rtho vijñāyata ityata āha-- `ṣaṣṭhyantena' ityādi| yadi punaḥ patiśabdasya ṣaṣṭhyantasya ghisaṃjñā syāt, tadā kiṃ syāt ? pasyurityatraiva syāt, iha tu na syāt-- kruñcānāmapataye nama iti| `mayā patyā' iti| tṛtīyāyukto'tra patiśabdaḥ| asmadaḥ `maparyantasya' (7.2.91) `tvamāvekavacane' (7.2.97) iti mādeśaḥ| `yo'ci' (7.2.89) iti yakāraḥ|| 10. hrasvaṃ laghu| (1.4.10) `bhettā' iti| `pugantalaghūpadhasya ca' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ| `acīkarat' ita| kṛño ṇic, luṅa, aḍāgamaḥ, cleścaṅa, ṇilopaḥ,`ṇau caṅyupadhāyāḥ' (7.4.1) iti hrasvaḥ| `oḥ puyaṇcyapare' (7.4.80) iti vacanaṃ jñāpakam-- ṇau kṛtaṃ sthānivadbhavatīti| `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti kṛśabdo dvirucyate| `urat' (7.4.66) ityattvam, raparatvam, `sanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) iti laghusaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ sanvadbhāvādittvam, `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghatvam|| 11. saṃyoge guru| (1.4.11) `kuṇḍā, huṇ‍ḍā' iti| `kuḍi dāhe' (dhā.pā.270), `huḍi saṅghāte' (dhā.pā.269), numvidhāvupadeśivadvacanādupadeśāvastāyāmeva num| `śikṣā, bhikṣā' iti| `śikṣa vidyopādāne' (3.3.103) ityakārapratyayaḥ, `ajādyataṣṭāpa' (4.1.4)|| 12. dīrghañca| (1.4.12) `īhāñcakre, uhāñcakre' iti| `āmpratyayavat' (1.3.63) ityādau sūtra ete vyatpādite| gurusaṃjñāyāṃ tvatra kāryam- `ijādeśca gurumato'nucchaḥ (3.1.36) ityātmapratyayaḥ|| 13. yasmātpratyayavidhistadādi pratyaye'ṅgam| (1.4.13) `karttā' iti luṭ| `kariṣyati,akariṣyat' iti| luṭlṛṅau| aṅgasaṃjñāyāḥ kāryamatra `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti guṇaḥ, `ṛddhanoḥ sye' (7.2.70) itīḍāgamo yathāyogam| `yasmāditi saṃjñinirdeśārtham' iti| saṃjñino nirdeśaḥ, so'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| nanu ca tadādītyanenātra saṃjñīnirdiṣṭaḥ, tatkathaṃ saṃjñinirdeśārthamiti paryanuyogamāśaṅkya yena hetunā yasmādityasya saṃjñinirdeśārthatvaṃ bhavati,taṃ darśayitumāha-- `tadādisambandhāt' iti| yasmādityetasmin satyanena prakṛtena tadādītyasya sambandho bhavati| yasmāt pratyayo vidhīyate sa ādiryasya tat tadādīti| anucyamāne hyetasmiṃstadityanena sarvanāmnā prakṛtapratyavamarśinā kiṃ sambadhyeteti, asadetat; evaṃ hi sati pratyayādeḥ pratyaye parato'ṅgasaṃjñā syāt, tataśca kariṣyāvaḥ, kariṣyāma ityatra dhātorguṇo na syāt| tasmādviśiṣṭasya saṃjñino nirdeśārtha tasmāditi vaktavyam| anena hi sambandhe sati tadādītyanena yo'tra viśiṣṭaḥ saṃjñī vivakṣitaḥ sa śakyate nirddeṣṭum; nānyathā| `nerviśaḥ' (1.3.17) ityupasargādvidhirastīti niyamasya, na tu pratyayasya; tasya lakṣaṇāntaṇare vihitatvāt| `nerviśaḥ' (1.3.17) ityupalakṣaṇamātram| `parivyavebhyaḥ kriyaḥ' (1.3.18) ityetadapīhopāttaṃ draṣṭavyam| tadāderaṅgasaṃjñā syāt, tataścopasargāt prāgaḍāgamaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| `strī iyatī' iti| idaṃ parimāṇamasyā iti `kimidambhyāṃ vo ghaḥ' (5.240) iti vatup| vasya ca ghatvam, iyādeśaḥ, `idamkimorīśkī' (6.3.90) itīdama īśa, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148)itīkāralopaḥ| `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp- iyatī| strīśabdāt suḥ, tasya halaṅyādinā (6.1.68) lopaḥ, strī iyatī iti sthite yadi vidhigrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadeyacchabde pratyaye parataḥ strīśabdasyāṅgasaṃjñā syāt; tataśca `yasyeti ca' 6.4.148) itīkāralopaḥ prasajyeta| nanu ca`asiddhavadatrābhāt' 6.4.22) ityasiddhatvādīkāralopa evāsiddhaḥ, tat kuto'yaṃ lopaprasaṅgaḥ ? prāgbhādhikārādasiddhatvamityabhiprāyaḥ, naiṣo'styabhiprāyaḥ; vakṣyati hi tatra vṛttikāraḥ-- ra`asiddhavadityadhikāro'yam, yadita ūrdhvamanukrimiṣyāma āadhyāyaparisamāptestadasiddhavadbhavati' iti, tathā hyā bhādityabhividhāvāṅa,tena bhādhikāre'pyasiddhatvaṃ bhavatīti ? evaṃ tarhi vidhigrahaṇenaitajjñāpyate-- bhādhikārīyamasiddhatvamanityatvamiti; tena `vugyuṭāvavaṅyaṇoḥ siddhau vācyau' (vā.776) ityetanna vaktavyaṃ bhavatīti| vuk-- babhūva, yuṭ-- upadidīya iti| nanvevam `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) itīkāralopasya sthānivattvāt strīśabdekāralopāprasaṅga eva, naitadasti; yo hyanādiṣaaṭadacaḥ pūrvastasya pūrvastasyavidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhavatītyādiṣṭadacaḥ pūrvaḥ strīśabdekāraḥ prāk saṃskṛtasya sata iyītaśabdyottarakālaṃ strīśabdena sambadhyate| atha kriyamāṇe'pi vidhigrahaṇe kasmādevāṅgasaṃjñā na bhavati, yāvatā strīśabdādvibhakteḥ pratyayasya vidhirastyeva, pratyayo'pi cāsmāt para iyacchabdo vidyata eva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vidhigrahaṇe sati yasmātpratyayo vidhīyate pratyāsattestasmin parato'ṅgasaṃjñā vidhīyate| iha tu yaḥ strīśabdādvihitaḥ pratyayo nāsau paraḥ, luptatvāt; yaśca para iyacchabdo vihitaḥ, nāsau tato vihitaḥ| atha tadādigrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvātā vinā'pi tena `yasmāt pratyayavidhiḥ pratyaye'ṅgam' ityetāvatyucyamāne yattadornityābhisambandhādyasmātpratyayo vidhīyate tatpratyaye parato'ṅgasaṃjñā bhavatītyeṣo'rtho labhyata ityata āha-- `tadādivanacam' ityādi| asati tadādītyetasmin yasmādeva pratyayo vidhīyate tasyaivāṅgatvaṃ syāt, na tu sarvasya sahasyādeḥ, nāpi sanumkasya samudāyasya; tataḥ pratyayasyādivihitatvat. tadādigrahaṇe sati yasmāt pratyayo vidhīyate sa ādiryasya śabdarūpasya tat tadādīti bahuvrīhirāśrito bhavati, tena sarvasya sahasyādeḥ sanumkasya samudāyasyāṅgasaṃjñā siddhyati-- iti tadādivacanaṃ syādinumartham| ādigrahaṇena prakṛtipratyayasya madhyavartināṃ pratyayāgamānāṃ grahaṇam; numa āgamopalakṣaṇatvāt| `kariṣyāvaḥ' ityatra yasmāt pratyayo vihitastadādeḥ sahasya pratyayasya samudāyasyāṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `ato dīrgho yañi'(7.3.101) iti dīrghatvaṃ bhavati; anyathā kva tarhi syāt ? `vāvāvaḥ, vāvāmaḥ' ityādau| `aya vaya maya paya taya caya ṇaya gatau' (dhā.pā.474-480), yaṅaluk, abhyāsasya `dīrgho'kitaḥ'(7.4.83) iti dīrghatvam; vasmasoḥ `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yalopaḥ-- iha vinā vikaraṇena dhātodīrghatvam; vikaraṇasya śapaḥ `adiprabhṛtibhaayaḥ śapaḥ' (2.4.72) iti luptatvāt| adāditvam `carkarītañca' (dhā.pā.1081) ityādiṣu pāṭhāt| `carkarītam' iti yaṅalukaḥ pūrvācāryasaṃjñā| `kuṇḍāni' iti| jasi `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20) iti śibhāvaḥ| `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) iti num| tadāyaṃ num parādiriti pakṣaḥ, tadā `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghatvaṃ vināpi sanumkasyāṅgasaṃjñayā siddham| yadāpi pūrvāntaḥ, tadāpyaṅgakadeśatvāt `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) ityanuvarttamāne `sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau' (6.4.8) iti dīrghatvaṃ siddham| yadā tvabhaktaḥ, tadāṅsyānekadeśatvānna siddhyati| abhaktaścāyaṃ numiti sūtrakārasya pakṣaḥ| tena numarthamapi tadādivacanaṃ kṛtam| `śrayartham, bhvyartham' iti| śriya idaṃ bhruva idamiti-- `caturthī tadarthārtha' (2.1.36) ityādinā samāsaḥ; astyatra caturthyaikavacanasya vidhiriti| asati hi punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇe śrībhrūśabdayorarthaśabde parato'ṅgasaṃjñā syāt, tataśceyaṅuvaṅau syātām| saptamīnirdiṣṭe tu punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇe śrībhrūśabdayorarthaśabde parato'ṅgasaṃjñā syāt, tataśceyaṅuvaṅau syātāmā| saptamīnirdiṣṭe tu punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇe sati na doṣa iti| tathā hi-- tato vihite pratyaye parata ityevaṃ vijñāyate| yaścāto vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ sa luptaḥ| yadyapi lupte'pi tasmin pratyayalakṣaṇenāṅgasaṃjñā labhyate, kāryaṃ tu na labhyate; `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣamapratiṣedhāt|| 14.suptiṅantaṃ padam| (1.4.14) `sup tiṅiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam' iti| yuktaṃ hi tiṅiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam, anyasya tiṅaśabdasyābhāvāt; kathaṃ subiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam, saptamībahuvacanasya vidyamānatvāt tasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatīti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ` na ṅisambuddhyoḥ' (8.2.8) iti pratiṣedhāt| saptamībahuvacanasya supo grahaṇe ṅisambuddhyoḥ padatvābhāvānnalopasya prāptireva nāstīti pratiṣedho'rthakaḥ syāt| `brāhmaṇāḥ' iti| padatve ca sati `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66), `kharavasānayorvisarjanīyaḥ' (8.3.15)| `paṭhanti' iti| atra padatve sati `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighātaḥ| nanu ca`pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya' (pu pa 24) ityanena `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityanena vā'ntareṇāpyantagrahaṇaṃ tadantasyaiva saṃjñā bhaviṣyati, tatkimarthamantagrahaṇamityata āha-- `padasaṃjñāyām' ityādi| yadīhāntagrahaṇenāpyanyatra saṃjñāvidhau tadantavidhirnāstītyeṣo'rtho na jñāpyate, tadā `taraptamapau ghaḥ' (1.1.22) ityatra tarabantasya ghasaṃjñā syāt, na pratyayamātrasya| tasmādatrāsminnarthe'ntagrahaṇena jñāpyate-- anyatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhiniṣedho yathā syādityevamarthamantagrahaṇam| tena taraptamaporeva ghasaṃjñā bhavati, na tu tadantasya| `gaurībrāhmaṇitarā' iti|atra gaurīśabdasya tarabante brāhmaṇitarāśabde parataḥ `gharūpakalpa' (6.3.43) ityādinā hrasvo na bhavati; tarabantasyāghasaṃjñakatvāt| pratyayamātrasya ghasaṃjñāyāṃ tatra parato brāhmaṇīśabdasya hrasvo bhavatyeva|| 15. naḥ kye| (1.4.15) `rājīyati' iti| ātmano rājānamicchatīti `supa ātmanaḥ kyac' (3.1.8) `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam| `rājāyate' iti| rājevācaratīti `karttṛḥ kyaṅa salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti kyaṅa| `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ| `varmāyate' iti| avarma bhavatīti `lohitādiḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣa' (3.1.13) iti kyaṣpratyayaḥ| `vā kyaṣaḥ' (1.3.90) ityātmanepadam| padasaṃjñāyāmiha nalopaḥ kāryaḥ| nanu caite kyajādayaḥ subantādeva vidhīyante pratyayalakṣaṇena, tataśca `suptiṅantaṃ padam' (1.4.14) ityanenaivātra padasaṃjñā siddhā, tat kimartho'yamārambha ityata āha-- `siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ' iti| siddha iti siddhāvityarthaḥ| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) siddhatvantu prakṛtatvāt padasaṃjñāyā eva vijñāyate| atha vā siddha ityakarmakatvāt kartari ktapratyayaḥ| siddhe niṣpanne padasaṃjñākārya ityarthaḥ| nāntameva iti| niyamasya pratiṣedhāt| viparītaniyame hi sati ṅisambuddhayoḥ padasaṃjñāyā abhāvānnalopo na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ tatpratiṣedhena ? `vācyati' iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac' (3.1.8)| kyaci padatvābhāvāt `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvaṃ na bhavati|| 16. siti ca| (1.4.16) `bhavadīyaḥ' ityādi| `tatra jātaḥ'(4.3.25) ityādau śaiṣike'rthe taddhitaḥ, padatvāt `jhalāñjaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvam| `ūrṇāyuḥ' iti| `ūrṇāyā yus' (5.2.123) iti yusi kṛte padasaṃjñayā bhasaṃjñāyāṃ nirastāyāṃ `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityākāralopo na bhavati| `ṛtviyaḥ' iti| ṛtuḥ prāpto'styeti `ṛtoraṇ' (5.1.148) `chandasi ghas' (5.1.106) ṛtviyaḥ, padatvāt bhatvābhāve tadāśrayaḥ `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) na bhavati| 17.svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāne| (1.4.17) atra yadi saptamībahuvacanādārabhya ā kapaḥ pratyayā gṛhyeran, tadā `asarvanāmasthāne' iti pratiṣedaṃ na kuryāt; prāptyabhāvāt| kṛtaścāsāvato'vasīyate prathamaikavacanādārabhyā kapaḥ pratyayāḥ svādayo gṛhyanta ityata āha-- `svādiṣviti suśabdādekavacanādārabhya' iti| `rājatvam, rājatā' iti| `tasya bhāvastvatalau' (5.1.119)| `rājataraḥ' iti| `dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunau' (5.3.57) iti tarap| `rājatamaḥ' iti| `atiśāyane' (5.3.55) ityādinā tamap| `rājānau,rājānaḥ' iti| atra padasaṃjñāyā abhāvānnalopo na bhavati| yadyevam, rājatyatrāpi na syāt, pratyayalakṣaṇenāsarvanāmasthāna iti padasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt,naiṣa doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati-- bhavati sau parataḥ padasaṃjñeti, yadayam `naṅisambuddhayoḥ' (8.2.8) iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti| atra sambuddhiśabdo'narthakaḥ syāt, padatvābhāvādeva nalopasyāprāpteḥ| atha vā -- `asarvanāmasthāne' iti paryudāso'yam, na prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ,tena sarvanāmasthānādanyatra padasaṃjñā vidhīyate; na tu sarvanāmasthānaṃ pratiṣidhyate| tena tatra pūrvasūtreṇa sau pare padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| atha vā- prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi na doṣaḥ, yasmāt `anantarasya vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā'(vyā.pa.12) ityanantarā yā prāptiḥ sā pratiṣidhyate; na vyavahitā| tena `suptiṅantaṃ padam' (1.4.14) ityakāralopaḥ|| 18. yaci bham| (1.4.18) `yaci' iti varṇagrahaṇaṃ saptamīnirdiṣṭam| ataḥ `yasmin vidhistaddāvalgrahaṇe' (vā.14) iti tadādividhinātra bhavitavyamityata āha-- `yakārādau' ityādi| gārgya ityādau bhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ| `nabho'ṅiromanuṣāṃ vatyupasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam' iti| bhasaṃjñāyāstvatra padasaṃjñābādhaḥ phalam| `nabha iva' iti tulyārthatopadarśanametat; na tu prathamāsamarthādvatiḥ| sa tu nabhasā tulyaṃ varttata iti `tena tulyam' (5.1.115) `āṅgirasvat' iti| pūrveṇa tulyam| `manuṣvata' iti| `janerusiḥ'(da.u.9.37) ityatra bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ `mana jñāne' (dhā.pā.1176) ityetasmādusipratyayaḥ| `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvam| manuṣ iti sthite pūrvavadvatiḥ-- manuṣvaditi| yadyatra padasaṃjñā syāt tadā ṣatvasyāsiddhatvādiha rutvaṃ syāt, tataśca manurvadityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya ceha pratipādanam-- `siti ca' (1.4.16) ityataścakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena nabho'ṅgiromanuṣāṃ vatau bhasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| `vṛṣaṇvasvaśvayoḥ' iti| antarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ bhasaṃjñā vidhīyate,tasyāśca vidhiścakārānuvṛttereva labhyate| vṛṣṇo'śvaḥ, atra bhatve sati yadyapi ṇatvasyāsiddhatvam, tathāpi nalopaḥ padanibandhano na bhavati, `padāntasya' (8.4.37) iti ṇatvapratiṣedhaśca|| 19.tasau matvarthe| (1.4.19) `tasau' iti varṇagrahaṇam| na ca varṇamātrānmatvarthīya sambhati, ataḥ sāmarthyāt tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha-- `takārāntam' ityādi| `matvarthe pratyaye' iti vyadhikaraṇe pade; ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| matorartho matvartha iti, tatra yo varttate pratyayastasminnityarthaḥ| atha vā- samānādhikaraṇe pade, matuśabdena sāhacaryānmatupsahacaritārtha ucyate-- ṇatubartho yasya tasmin, na tu yasminniti matvarthe pratyaya iti| arthagrahaṇaṃ kamatupo'nyatrāpi yathā syāt; itarathā hi matāvityucyamāne matāveva syāt; nānyeṣu| matvarthagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe matupi na syāt; tasyārthaviśeṣaṇatvāt| viśeṣaṇasya ca kāryeṇa sambandhānupapatteḥ| na hi citragurānīyatāmityukte viśeṣaṇabhūtā gāvo'ḍapyānīyante, naiṣa doṣaḥ; viśeṣamapi kvacit kārye viśiṣyate, yathā hi-- devadattaśālāyā brāhmaṇā ānīyantāmityukte devadattaḥ śālāyāṃ viśeṣaṇabhūto yadi brāhmaṇo bhavati tadā so'pyānīyata eva| `udaśvitvāna' iti| bhatvāt padasaṃjñābhāve jaśtvaṃ sidhyati| `jhayaḥ' (8.2.10) iti vatvam, `ugidacām' (7.1.70) iti num, `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| `payasvī, yaśasvī' iti| `asmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121) bhatvādrutvaṃ na bhavati| `indaranpūṣāryamṇāṃ sau' (6.4.12) ityanuvarttamāne `sau ca' (6.4.13) ityanena dīrghaḥ|| 20. ayasmayādīni cchandasi| (1.4.20) yadyatra bhasaṃjñā vidhīyeta tadā padasaṃjñā na syāt, atha yadi padasaṃjñā vidhīyeta tadā'tra bhasaṃjñā na syāt, tadā bhapadasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśo na syāt; ekasaṃjñādhikārāt| sādhutvavidhāne tveṣa doṣo na bhavati, taddhi keṣāñcidbhasaṃjñā vidhīyate padasaṃjñakānām, keṣāñcidubhayasaṃjñākānām; tasmāt sādhutvameva vidhātuṃ yuktamityata āha-- `ayasmayādīni' ityādi| kathaṃ punareṣāṃ sādhutvaṃ vidhīyata ityāha-- `bhapadasaṃjñādhikāre' ityādi| dvāram, mukham, upāya tatra bhāṣāgrahaṇamasti, tathāpyayasmayaśabdasyāsmādeva sādhutvavidhānācchandasyapi mayaḍ bhavatīti bhatvādrutvaṃ na bhavati| `saṛkvatā' iti| ṛco'sya santīti matup| padatvāt `coḥ kuḥ' 8.3.30) iti kutvam| bhatvāt `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvaṃ na bhavati| `ākṛtigaṇo'yam' iti| ādiśabdasya prakāravācitvāt|| 21. bahuṣu bahuvacanam| (1.4.21) `tasyānena bahutvasaṃkhyā vācyatvena vidhīyate' iti| etena vidhyarthatāmasya yogasya darśayati| iha keṣāñcit `svārthadravyaliṅgasaṃkhyākarmādyātmakaḥ pañcakaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ' iti darsanam| keṣāñcit `svārthadravyaliṅgātmakastrikaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ' iti| tatra svārtho viśeṣaṇam; svarūpajātiguṇadravyāṇi| dravyastu viśeṣyam, tatpunarjātiguṇadravyāṇi| tatra yadā śabdasvarūpeṇa viśiṣṭā jātirabhidhīyate-- gauriti, tadā śabdasvarūpaṃ viśeṣaṇatvāt svārtho bhavati; jātistu viśeṣyatvād‌dravyam| yadā tu jātyā viśiṣṭo guṇo'bhidhīte-- paṭasya śuklo guṇa iti, tadā jātirviśeṣaṇatvāt svārtho bhavati; guṇastu viśeṣyatvād‌dravyam| yadā tu guṇairviśiṣṭaṃ paṭādikaṃ dravyamucyate-- śuklaḥ paṭa iti, tadā viśeṣaṇabhūto guṇaḥ svārtho bhavati; viśeṣyabhūtaṃ paṭādikaṃ dravyameva| yadā punardravyamapi dravyāntarasya viśeṣaṇabhūtaṃ bhavati-- yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya, kuntān praveśayetyādau, tadā yaṣṭyādikaṃ dravyaṃ viśeṣaṇabhāvāpannaṃ svārthaḥ; dravyāntaraṃ viśeṣyabhāvāpannaṃ puruṣādikaṃ dravyameva| kvacitsambandho'pi svārtho bhavati-- yatra sambandhanimittakaḥ pratyaya utpadyate, yathā-- daṇḍī, viṣāṇīti| atra daṇḍapuruṣasambandho viśeṣaṇam, daṇḍīti dravyam| kvacit kriyāpi svārtho bhavati, yatra kriyānimittakaḥ pratyayaḥ utpadyate, yathā--pācakaḥ, pāṭhaka iti| kriyākārakasambandho'tra svārtha ityapare| liṅgaṃ strītvādi, saṃkhyaikatvādi, karmādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ kārakaviśeṣāḥ| tatra pūrvoktayordarśanayordvitīyaṃ yaddarśanaṃ tadiha vṛttikāreṇāśritam| dhātostu kriyaiva vācyetyatrācāryāṇāmavivāda eva| tatra prātipadikasya pūrvokte trike'rthe sati dhātośca kriyātmakatve yadīdaṃ sūtraṃ nocyeta, tataḥ `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti' (sī.vṛ.125) iti prātipadikājjasādibahuvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ trika evārthe syāt, na bahutvasaṃkhyāyām| dhātorapi jhiprabhṛti bahuvacanaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ kriyāyāmeva syāt; na tu bahutvasaṃkhyāyām| tasmādanenaiva tasya bahutvasaṃkhyāvācyatvena vidhīyata iti vidhyarthametadbhavati| yathā cānena yogena bahutvasaṃkhyā bahuvacanasya vācyatvena vidhīyate, tathā `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityevamādibhiryogairdvitīyādīnāṃ karmādi ca| `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) ityanenāpi lakārāṇāṃ karmādyeva| tasmādete'pi yogā vidhyarthā eva veditavyāḥ| yeṣāñca pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti matam, teṣāṃ prātipadikasyaiva pañcāpyarthā vācyāḥ| vibhaktayaśca taddayotikā bhavanti| tatra `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti' (sī.vṛ.125) iti vināpi vacanenānena prātipadikādbahuvacanaṃ jasādi bahutve siddhameva| tatra tvaniyamenānyatrāpyekatvādau prāptamanena niyamyata iti niyamārthametadbhavati| kasmāt punarvṛttikāreṇa trikaṃ prātipadikārtha iti darśanamāśritam ? yuktatvāt| tathā hi-- vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyādau na hi vinā vibhaktibhiḥ saṃkhyākarmādayaścārthāḥ pratīyante| yadyapi payaḥ payo jarayatītyādau vināpi vibhaktyā saṃkhyākarmāderarthasya pratītirbhavatīti, tathāpi payasī payāṃsi payasetyevamādau saṃkhyākarmādipratītyarthaṃ niyogato vibhaktirapekṣyata eva| na hi yathā gargā ityatra bahuvacanena yañpratyayamantareṇāpatyārthaḥ pratīyate, tathā gārgya ityatra prakṛtirevāpatyārthamabhidhatta iti śakyate vaktuma| api ca -- payaḥ payo jarayatītyevamādau vibhaktiviśeṣaotpattisāmarthyādeva saṃkhyākarmādyarthsya pratītirbhavati| tathā hi, yataḥ sa vibhaktiviśeṣa utpannastta evāsāvarthaviśeṣaḥ pratīyate, nānyasmāditi trika eva prātipadikārtho yuktaḥ| yadi tarhi bahutvasaṃkhyā bahuvacanasya vācyatvena vidhīyate tadā sūtre bhāvapratyayena bahutvanirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ, anyathā bahutvasaṃkhyā na pratīyeta ? na karttavyaḥ; antareṇāpi bhāvapratyayaṃ bhāvapradhāno nirdeśo bhaviṣyatīti, yathā -- paṭasya śukla iti| nanvevamapi bhādasyaikatvādbahuṣviti bahuvacanaṃ nopapadyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmādbahutavasaṃkhyādhārasya dravyasya yo bhedastaṃ bahutve guṇe'dhyāropya bahuṣviti bahuvacanena nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ , saṃkhyāvācyayaṃ bahuśabdo na vaipulyavācīti jñāpanārthaśca| tena vaipulyaṃ bahuvacanasya vācyaṃ na bhavatīti bahurodanaḥ,bahuḥ sūpa iti vaipulyavācino bahuśabdādekavacanameva bhavati, na bahuvacanam| yadi bahutvasaṃkhyā bahuvacanasya vācyatvena vidhīyate, iha vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyatra bahuvacanaṃ prāpnoti, dve hyatra saṃkhye-- samudāyasaṃkhyā caikatvam, avayavasaṃkhyā ca phalamūlaśākhādyavayavasamavetā bahutvam| asyāpi prātipadikārthenaikārthasamavāyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho'styeva| tathā hi-- yeṣvayavaveṣu samaveta| bahutvasaṃkhyā prātipadikārtho'pi samudāyastatraiva samavetaḥ, tataśca tasmādbahuvacanaṃ prāpnotītyata āha-- `karmādayaḥ' ityādi| karmādayo hyekavibhaktiśabdavācyatvāt pratyāsannā bahutvasaṃkhyāyāḥ; tataḥ pratyāsattestadīya eva bahutve bahuvacanaṃ bhavati| samudāya eva hi vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyatra dṛśikriyayā vyāptamiṣṭatama iti sa eva karmabhāvamāpadyate, nāvayavāḥ, tatkuto bahuvacanasya prasaṅga ? `karmādiṣu' ityādi| karmādayo bahuvacanasya vācyāḥ| tadīyaṃ bahutvaṃ bahuṣveva karmadiṣu sambhavati, ataḥ sāmarthyāt karmādiṣu bahuṣvityeṣo'rthaḥ sampadyate| yadi tarhi vibhaktīnāṃ bahuvacanasya bahutvasaṃkhyā vācyatvena vidhīyate, tadā niḥsaṃkhyebhyo'vyayebhyaḥ svādayo na syuḥ; tataśca padasaṃjñā teṣāṃ na syādityāha-- `yatra ca' ityādi| nanu svādividhānasūtre saṃkhyākarmādayaḥ svādīnāmarthāḥ śāstrāntareṇa vihitāḥ, tena sahāsyaikavākyateti vakṣyati| tatkutaḥ svādīnāṃ sāmānyavihitatvam ? na hi `bahuṣu bahuvacanama' (1.4.21), `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityādinā śāstrāntareṇa svaujasādeḥ sūtrasyaikavākyatāyāṃ svādīnāṃ sāmānyavihitatvamupapadyate| evaṃ tarhi jñāpakena avyayebhyaḥ sāmānyena svādyutpatterjñāpi tatvāt sāmānyavihitā ityuktamityadoṣaḥ; kiṃ punastajjñāpakam ? `avyayādāpsupaḥ' (2.4.82) ityavyayādutpannānāṃ supāṃ lṛgvavacam, na hyanutpannānāṃ lugupapadyate|| 22. dvayekayordvivacanaikavacane| (1.4.22) `dvyekayoḥ' iti| ayamapi bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ; anyathā hi bahutvādbahuvacanaṃ syāt| bhāvapradhāne tu nirdeśe,dvitvamekatvañca dvāvetāvarthāviti yuktaṃ dvivacam| `etadapi' ityādinā'syāpi yogasya vidhyarthatāṃ darśayati| `arthābhidhānam' iti| artho vācyo'bhidhīyate yena tadarthābhidhānam|| 23.kārake| (1.4.23) `kāraka iti viśeṣaṇamapādānādisaṃjñāviṣayam' iti| apādānadayaḥ saṃjñā viṣayo yasya tattathoktam| ādiśabdena sampradānādīnāṃ grahaṇam| atha vakṣyamāṇānāṃ dhruvādīnābhiyaṃ saṃjñā kasmānna bhavati ? evaṃ manyate-- yadīyaṃ saṃjñāśabdā nirdiśyante; ayaṃ tu saptamyā nirdiṣṭaḥ, tasmānneyaṃ dhruvādīnāṃ saṃjñeti| `kārake' iti nirdhāraṇe saptamī, nirdhāraṇaṃ tu bahunāṃ sambhavati, tatkathamekavacanena nirdeśaḥ ? sāmānyapekṣayā tvekavacanam| atha vā-- `chandovat sūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā.1.1.1) tato `vyatayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti bahuvacane prāpta ekavacam kārakeṣu madhye yad dhruvaṃ kārakaṃ tadapādānasaṃjñaṃ bhavati| evamanyatrāpi veditavyamiti| kārakaśabdo'yamastyeva vyutpannaḥ-- ṇvulantaḥ kartṛparyyāya iti, asti ca saṃjñāśabdaḥ-- avyutpanno paryyāya iti| tatreha yadi pūrvoktasya grahaṇaṃ syāta tadāpādānādiṣu kārakaśabdo na varttate, yathā-- kartṛśabdaḥ `ṇvultṛcau' (3.1.133) iti kartari vyutpāditaḥ, tathā kārakaśabdo'pi; karttā ca svatantraḥ, apādānādayaścāsvatantrāḥ, tatkathaṃ teṣu kārakavyapadeśaḥ syāt ? asati hi kārakavyapadeśe kārakasaṃśabdeṣu teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt| atha teṣāmapi kathañcit svatantratābhyupeyeta, evañca tatra kartṛsaṃjñā prasajyeta, tataśca grāmādāgacchati, upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadātītyādau grāmādibhyastṛtīyā prasajyeta, itaretarāśrayaścāpi doṣaḥ syāt| tathā hi-- kartṛsaṃjñottarakālaṃ kārakaśabdasya vyutpattiḥ, tasyāṃ satyāṃ kārakaśabdopakrameṇa karttṛsaṃjñā syāt bahvevaṃ pratividheyaṃ syāt, pratividhāne ca pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| nimittaparyāyasya tu kārakaśabdasya grahaṇe na doṣaḥ syāt, tataḥ sa eva gṛhyata iti matvāha--`kārakaśabdo'yaṃ nimittaparyāyaḥ' iti| `grāmādāgacchati' iti| grāmasya dhrusyāgamanakriyāṃ prati nimittabhāvo'sti| yadīha grāmo'vadhibhāvena nāvatiṣṭhetatata āgamanaṃ na niṣpadyeta,tasmād‌grāmaḥ kārakam| `vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patati' iti| vṛkṣaḥ sambandhitvenātra vivakṣitaḥ na tu nimittatvena| apāyasya kārakagrahaṇānnimittatvenāvivakṣitasyāpādānasaṃjñā na bhavati| naitat kārakagrahaṇasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ yuktam; dhrugrahaṇenaivātrāpādānasaṃjñāyā nivartitatvāāt, dhruvaṃ hi tadyadavadhibhūtamapāye sādhye| tathā hi vṛttikāro vakṣyati-- `apāye sādhye yadavadhibhūtam' (kā.1.4.24) iti| na ceha vṛkṣo'vadhitvena vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? sambandhatvena, naitadasti; vivakṣitāvadhibhāvasyaiva vṛkṣasya sambandhibhāvena vivakṣitvāt| avadhibhūtasya vṛkṣasya sambandhinaḥ parṇa patatītyarthaḥ| na hi sambandhitvena vivakṣā'vadhibhāvavikṣāyā virudhyate| tasmādvivakṣitāvadhibhāvasyaiva vṛkṣsaya sambandhitvamātraṃ vivakṣitam, na tu vidyamānamapyapāyaṃ prati nimittatvamiti kā'trāyuktatā ! `māṇavakasya pitaraṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati'iti| `akathitañca' (1.4.51) ityakathitasya karmasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā `kārake ' (1.4.82) ityetasminnasati māṇavakasyāpi syāt, katham ? akathitaśabdo'yamakīrttita paryāyaḥ| sa ca kasyācidviśeṣasyāprakṛtatvadviśeṣānupādāne sati prayujyamānaḥ sarvatrāviśeṣaeṇākīrttitamātre syāt| tataśca `akathitam' ityucyamāne kārakañcākārakañca sarvamakathitamiti sarvakathitamiti gamyate| yathā pitā'pādānādibhirviśeṣakathābhirna kathitaḥ, tathā māṇavako'pi, atstasyāpi karmasaṃjñā syāt| `kārake' ityasmiṃstu sati praśnakriyānimittasya pitureva bhavati; na tu māṇavakasya| na hyasau praśnakriyāṃ prati nimittabhāvena vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pituḥ sambandhitvena| yadi viśeṣaṇamidaṃ dhruvādīnām; na saṃjñā, tataśca `kārakādattaśrutayorevāśiṣi' (6.2.148) ityevamādiṣu pradeśeṣu yatra kārakaśabdaḥ saṃśabdyate tadā tatrāpādānādīnāṃ kārakagrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na syāt| saṃjñāpakṣe tu na doṣaḥ, saṃjñā hyāvartamānā saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyatītyata āha-- kārakasaṃśabdaneṣu'ityādi| yatra kārakaśabdasya saṃśabdanaṃ tatrāpyanenaiva viśeṣaṇena vivakṣitārthapratyāyanalakṣaṇo vyavahāro'yaṃ vijñāyate; pradeśāntare'pi kārakaśabdasya nimittaparyāyasyaivopādānāt| tacc nimittamapādānanādyeva, na hi tato'nyatkriyānimittaṃ bhavati| tasmāt kārakagrahamenāpādānādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati| anye tvāhuḥ-- sāhacaryāt kārakaviśeṣaṇasahacaritā apādānādayaḥ kārakaśabdenocyanta iti tadgrahaṇenaiva teṣāṃ grahaṇam| kārakagrahamaṃ vā svarayitavyam| tena `svaritenādhikāraḥ' (1.3.11) ityeṣa vidhirbhavati| tasmāt kārakagrahaṇenāpādānādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| 24. dhruvamapāye'pādānam| (1.4.24) apāyaḥ - viśleṣaḥka; vibhāga ityarthaḥ| tasya dviṣṭhatvādyāthā tena vibhāgena yo'paiti so'pāyayuktaḥ, tathā yato'paiti so'pyapāyayuktaḥ; tasmādubhayatra pañcamyā bhavitavyamityata evāha-- `dhruvaṃ yadāpāyamuktam' iti| `apāye sādhye' iti| viṣayasaptamīyam. apāyasya sādhyatvena viṣayabhūta ityarthaḥ| yadyapi dhruvaśabdo loka ekarūpatāmācaṣṭe-- dhruvamasya śīlam, dhruvamasya rūpamiti; tathāpyayāye sādhye'bhihitayā tayā na kaścidarthaḥ sampadyata iti nātra dhruvatā'pāyaṃ pratyupayujyate ? saivopadīyate, sā cāvadhibhāva eva| tasyādapāyasya sannidhau dhruvaśabdaḥ sambandhāt saśleṣalakṣaṇāt pracyavamānasyāvadhibhāvamācaṣṭe, ityata āha-- `avadhibhūtam' iti| ata evāpāye sādhye'vadhibhūtaṃ yattadiha dhruvaśabdenocyate| tena dhāvato'śvāt patita ityevamādāvapyapādānasaṃjñā aśvādeḥ siddhā bhavati| asati hyatrāpi satyapi calatve'śvāderapyapāye'vadhibhāvaḥ| atheha kathamapādānasaṃjñā-- adharyājjugupsate, adharmādviramati, dhaऱmātpramādyatīti, na hyatrāpāyo'sti ? katham ? kāryasamprāptipūrvako hyapāyo bhavati, na ceha kāryasamprāptirastīti āha-- `jugupsā' ityādi| jugupsādyarthānāṃ dhātūnāṃ prayoge'pādānāsaṃjñāyā upasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `apādānam'iti mahatī saṃjñā kriyate, mahāviṣayeyaṃ saṃjñeti sūcanārtham| evañca mahāviṣayā bhavatīyam-- yadi sūtropāttāt saṃjñino'nyo'pyasyā viṣayo bhavati, nānyathā; tena dajugupsādīnāṃ prayoge'satyapāye'pādānasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā-- astyevā'trāpāyaḥ, na hi kāryasamprāptipūrvaka evāpāyo bhavatīti, kiṃ tarhi ? cittasamprāptipūrvako'pi bhavati| iha tāvadadharmājjugupsate, adharmādviramatīti, ya eva manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī bhavati sa evaṃ paśyati-- duḥkha heturayamadharmo nāma, ato nārhatyenaṃ sacetāḥ karttumiti; evaṃ paśyati-- `nāsmāddharmāt kiñcidiṣṭaṃ sampadyate, duḥkhameva kevalaṃ tadārambha nimittakaṃ bhavati' sa evaṃ vicārayaṃstaṃ buddhyā prāpnoti, prāpya ca tato nivarttate| tathā ca dhruvamapāye'pādānamityevaṃ siddham| `pramādyati' iti| `madī herṣe' (dhā.pā.1208), `śamāmaṣṭānāṃ dīrghaḥ śyani' (7.3.74) iti dīrghaḥ| atheha kathamapādānasaṃjñā-- grāmānnāgacchatīti ? kathañca na syāt ? grāmasyāpāyenāyuktatvāt| yasyāṃ satyāmapāyo bhavati, sā pratiṣiddhyate cāpādanasādhanāgamanakriyā, tadasatyāṃ tasyāṃ kuto'pāyaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ atra hyapādānasaṃjñāyāṃ samupajātāyāṃ paścātpratiṣedhena sambandhaḥ kriyate,anyathā hi pratiṣedhasya viṣayo na darśitaḥ syāt| tathā hyapādānasādhanāgamanakriyā pratiṣeddhumiṣṭā|tatra yadi cādāveva niṣedhaḥ syāt, apāyābhāvāt tadasambaddhasya grāmasyāpādānasaṃjñā siddhā na syāt| tataśca yā pratiṣedhyāpādānasādhanāgamanakriyā pratiṣedhasya viṣayabhūtā; sā na śakyate pradarśakayitum; na cātrāpradarśitakaviṣayeta pratiṣedhaḥ śakyate vaktum. tasmāt pūrvamapādānasaṃjñā bhavati, paścātpratiṣedhena yoga ityeṣa kramaḥ| 25.bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ| (1.4.25) bhītirbhīḥ; trāṇaṃ trāḥ; sampadāditvāt‌ kvip| bhīśca trāśca bhītrau| bhītrādarthau yeṣāṃ te bhītrārthāḥ| `bibhetyarthānām' ityādi| bibhetitrāyatiśabdāviha sāhacaryādbibhetitrāyatyarthayorvartete| bibhetirartho yeṣāṃ te bibhetyarthāḥ| trāyatirartho yeṣāṃ te trāyatyarthāḥ| `bibheti' iti| `ñibhī bhaye' (dhā.pā.1084), jauhotyādikaḥ| `udvijate' iti| `ovijī bhayacalanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1460) taudādiko'nudāttet| `trāyate' iti| `traiṅa pālane' (dhā.pā.965) bhauvādikaḥ| `araṇye bibheti' iti| nātrāraṇyādbhayam, kiṃ tarhi ? tatrasthebhyaścaurādibhyaḥ| nanu cātrādhikaraṇasaṃjñā paratvāt bādhikā bhaviṣyati|api ca-- dhruvamityanuvarttate, `dhruvañcāvadhibhūtam' ityuktam| na cāraṇyamavadhibāvena vivakṣitam, tatkimetannivṛttyarthena bhayahetugrahaṇena ? evaṃ tarhi pūrvasyāyaṃ prapañcaḥ| na hi kāyasamprāptipūrvaka evāpāyo bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? buddhisamprāptipūrvako'pi| asti ceha buddhikasaṃprāptipūrvako'pyayāyaḥ, tathā hi -- caurebhyo bibhetītyatra yastāvat puruṣaḥ prekṣāvān bhavati sa evaṃ paśyati-- `yadi māṃ caurāḥ paśyeyurdhruvaṃ me mṛtyuḥ' iti vicārayaṃstān buddhyā prāpnoti, prāpya catato nivartate| tatra dhruvamityādinaiva siddham| tasmāt pūrvasyāyaṃ prapañcaḥ| na ca prapañce gurulāghavaṃ cintyate| evamuttare'pi yogāḥ pūrvasyaiva prapañcā veditavyāḥ; tadudāharaṇānāṃ `adhyayanāt parājayate' ityevamādīnāṃ pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| yathā ca teṣāṃ siddhatvaṃ tathā bhāṣye eva pratipāditam| tasmāt tatrāpi gurulāghavaṃ na cintanīyam|| 26. parājerasoḍhaḥ| (1.4.26) `soḍhuṃ na śakyate' iti| anubhavituṃ na śakyata ityarthaḥ| `adhyayanāt parājayate' ityadhyayanamabhibhavituṃ na śaknoti, na pārayatītyarthaḥ| `viparābhyāṃ jeḥ' (1.3.19) ityātmanepadam| `śatrūn parājayate' iti| abhibhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu ca paratvāt karmasaṃjñayaivātra bādhitatvādapādānasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati, tat kimetannivṛttyarthenāsoḍhagrahaṇena ? satyametat; prapañce gurulāghavaṃ na hi cintyate, prapañcaścāyam| asti hyatrādhyayanād buddhisaṃsarga pūrvako'pāyaḥ| tathā hi-- yaeva puruṣo'laso bhavati, sa evaṃ manyate-- duḥkhāyaivaitadadhyayanamiti, paśyan buddhyā tatprāpnoti, prāpya ca tato nivartate; tasmāt pūrveṇaiva siddham|| 27. vāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ| (1.4.27) vāraṇamartho yeṣāṃ te vāraṇārthāḥ| `yavebhyo gā vārayati' iti| `gāḥ' iti gavāmīpsitatamatvena vivakṣitatvātkarmasaṃjñā, gośabdācchasa, `auto'mśasoḥ' (6.1.93) ityāttvam, rutve kṛte `bhobhagoadhoapūrvasya' (8.3.17) iti yatvam, `hali sarveṣām' (8.3.22) iti yalopaḥ| `vārayati' iti| `vṛñ āvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1813), curādiṇic| `nivartayati' iti| `vṛtu vartane' (dhā.pā. 758), hetumaṇṇic| `yavebhyo gā vārayati kṣetre' iti| atra kṣetrasyānīpsitasya na bhavati saṃjñā; īpsitagrahaṇam| nanu cātra paratvādaradhikaraṇasaṃjñayaiva bādhitatvādapādānasaṃjñāyāḥ, kṣetrasyāpādānasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyatītyato na kartavyamīpsitagrahaṇamiti, etannāśaṅkanīyam; uktottaratvāt|| 28.antarddhau yenādarśanamicchati| (1.4.28) `antarddhau' iti nimittasaptamīyam. `nimittāt karmayoge' (vā.138) iti saptamī, yathā-- carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hantīti| etadeva jñāpakam-- nimittāt karmasaṃyoge'sti saptamīti| asta hyatrādarśanena karmaṇā saṃyogaḥ| `yena' iti| karttari tṛtīyā| nanu ca `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyamiti ? naitadasti; `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' (2.3.66) iti niyamāt karmaṇyeva, na kartari| karma tvatrādarśanasyātmā, tasyāntaraṅtvāt sa eva karma vijñāyate| `tat kārakam' iti| yadyapyatra sūtre tacchabdo nopāttaḥ, tathāpi sa yattadornityābhisambandhāllabhyate| `upādhyāyādantardhatte' ityatropādhyāyena kartā śiṣya ātmanaḥ karmabhūtasyādarśanamicchati| antarddhinimittam| antarddhate iti dadhāterlaṭ,`svaritañitaḥ' (1.3.72) ityātmanepadam, śapaḥ śluḥ, ka`ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam, `śnābhyasatyorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ, abhyāsasya jaśtvam, `dadhastathośca' (8.2.38) iti dakārasya dhakāraḥ, parasya dhakārasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam - takāraḥ| `nilīyate' iti| `līṅa śleṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1139) vaivādikaḥ| `caurānna didṛkṣate' iti| atra yaścaurān na didṛśata iti sa tairātmano'darśanamicchati, na tvantarddhinimittam; kintūpaghātanivṛttyartham| vispaṣṭārthañcāntārddhigrahaṇ| paratvāt karmasaṃjñaiva bādhitatvāccaurāṇāmihāpādānasaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati| prapañcārtho'yaṃ yogaḥ, na ca prapañce gurulāghavaṃ cintyata ityuktam| upādhyāyādantardhate śiṣya iti śiṣyasyāntarddhāturmā bhūt, naitadasti; dhruvamityanuvartate, dhruvañcāvadhibhūtamityuktam; na cāntarddhātāvadhibhūtaḥ| evaṃ tarhyasati yenetyetasmin vacane, satyāmapi dhruvamityasyānuvṛttau sūtrasyāvācakatvaṃ syāt| atastanmābhūditi yenetyuktam|| 29. ākhyātopayoge| (1.4.29) `niyamapūrvakaṃ vidyāgrahaṇam' iti| vidyāgrahaṇārthaṃ śiṣyapravṛttiḥ - niyamaḥ| sa pūrvo yasya tat tathoktam| `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap| `naṭasya gāthāṃ śṛṇoti' iti| sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| niyamapūrvakamiha vidyāgrahaṇaṃ nāsti|| 30. janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ| (1.4.30) janiśabdo'tra sāhacaryājjanyartha vartate| ata evāha-- `janyarthasya' iti| `janmanaḥ' iti| etena janyarthaṃ darśayati| tathā hi-- `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149) iti paṭhyate| prādurbhāvo janma eva| kaḥ punastasya karttetyata āha-- `jāyamānaḥ' iti| `jñājanorjā' (7.3.79) iti jādeśaḥ| atha prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā dhruvamityanuvarttate, dhruvañcāvadhibhutamityuktam| janikarttṛścāvadhiḥ kāraṇameva bhavati; tatrāntareṇāpi prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ prakṛtereva bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; putrāt pramādo jāyata ityādau putrāderapyapādānāsaṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ prakṛtigrahaṇam| dvividhaṃ hi kāraṇam-- upādānakāraṇam, sahakārikāraṇañca| tatra yat kāryeṇābhinnadeśaṃ tadupādānakāraṇam, yathā- ghaṭasya mṛtpiṇḍaḥ| sahakārikāraṇaṃ yat kāryeṇa bhinnadeśam, yathā-- tasyaiva daṇḍacakrādi| tatrāsati prakṛtigrahaṇe pratyāsatterupādānakāraṇasyaiva syāt, netarasya| prakṛtigrahaṇe tu sati sarvasyaiva kāraṇamātrasya bhavati|| 31.bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ| (1.4.31) `bhavanaṃ bhūḥ'iti| sampadāditvāt kvip| prabhavtayasmīdita prabhava ityapādāne `ṛdorap'(3.3.57) ityap| nanu ca `himavato gaṅgā prabhavati' ityetat pūrveṇaiva siddham. tathā hyayamatrārthaḥ-- himavato gaṅgā jāyata iti, tatkimarthamidamārabhyata ityāha-- `prathamata upalabhyate' iti| eṣa cārtho'nekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ veditavyaḥ| janyarthastvatra na sambhavatyeva, na hi himavān gaṅgāyāḥ kāraṇam, sā hyanyebhya eva kāraṇebhya utpannā| himavati tu kevalaṃ prathamata upalabhyata iti|| 32. karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa sampradānam| (1.4.32) `karmaṇā karaṇabhūtena' iti| nanu ca kathaṃ karma karaṇaṃ bhavati ? kriyābhedasambandhāt| tathā hi dadātikriyayā''stumiṣṭatamatvāt tasyāḥ karmatvam, abhiprayāṇakriyāṃ pratitasya sādhakatamatvāt karaṇatvam| `abhipraiti' iti| abhisambadhnātītyarthaḥ| yadi karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa sampradānasaṃjño bhavati, evamajāṃ nayati grāmamityajādibhirnayanakriyākarmabhiḥ sambadhyamānasya grāmasya sampradānasaṃjñā prasajyetetyata āha-- `anyarthasaṃjñāvijñānāt' ityādi| sampradānamiti| tena dadāteḥ karmaṇā yamabhipraiti tat sampradānamiti vijñāyate| nanvevamapi rajakasya vastraṃ dadāti, ghnataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dadātītyatatra prāpnoti, naitadasti; dānaṃ hi nāma pūjānugrahakāmyayā svakīyadravyaparityāgaḥ parasvatvāpattiḥ, tacceha nāsti, ato na bhaviṣyati| karmaṇeti kimartham ? " yamabhipraiti sa sampradānam" ityucyamāne yamabhipraiti tasya karmaṇa eva sampradānasaṃjñatrā syāt. karmasaṃjñāyāstu dadātikarmaṇo'nyatrāvakāśaḥ syāt-- odanaṃ pacatīti| `yaṃ sa' grahaṇaṃ kimartham ? `karmaṇābhipraiti sampradānam' ityucyamāne kayo'bhipraiti tasya sampradānasaṃjñā syāt| tataśca kartuḥ sampradānasaṃjñā syāt, kartasaṃjñāyāstu yatra karmasambandho nāsti, so'vakāśaḥ syāt--āste, śete iti| athābhipragrahaṇa kimartham ? `karmaṇā yameti sa sampradānām' ityucyamāne kālaviśeṣavikṣā syāt, vartamāna eva syāt| tataścopādhyāyasya gāmadāt, upādhyāyāyaṃ gāṃ dāstītyatra na syāt, abhigrahaṇe tu sati bhavati| abhirābhimukhye varttate taccāpyatīte'pyasti| praśabda ādikarmaṇi, prārambhe| sa cāsannihitāyāṃ bhāvinyāmapi kriyāyāṃ sambhavatīti sarvatra saṃjñā siddhā bhavati| naitadabhipragrahasya prayojanamupapadyate| yathaiva karmaṇetyatraikatvasaṃkhyāyā vivakṣā na bhavati; yatā ca `yaṃ' `saḥ' ityatra liṅgasaṃkhyorvivakṣā na bhavati tathā kālasyāpi na bhaviṣyati| kiṃ kāraṇam ? upalakṣaṇārthatvāt| yathā-- `so'rtho yo'nartha bādhate' ityukte yo'pi bādhitavān, yo'pi bādhiṣyate so'pyartha eva| evaṃ tarhi granthādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ yathā syādityavamarthamabhipragrahaṇam| etena kriyayāpi yamabhipraiti tasyāpi sampradānasaṃjñā siddhā bhavati; anyathā hi yadyapi kriyā prārthanādhyavasānābhyāṃ vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt karma, tathāpi dadātikarmasambandhābhāvānna siddhyet| kathaṃ punaretadavasitam-- kriyayā yamabhipraitisa sampradāvamityayamartho'tra pratipādayitumiṣṭatam iti ? abhipragrahaṇāt| asti hyatrācāryasya kaścidartho'dhiko'bhimataḥ, yasyāvabhāsanāyādhikaṃ śabdāntaraṃ prayuktamiti gamyate, na tvarthaviśeṣaḥ| na hi tat tasya vācakam| yadyapyavācakaṃ syāt, tathāpi lakṣyadarśanavaśādavicchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśācca viśeṣāvagatirbhaviṣyatītyadveṣyametat| `kriyāgrahaṇamapi karttavyam' iti| kriyayā grahaṇaṃ kriyāgrahaṇam| yena kriyā gṛhyate, tadvayākhyānaṃ karttavyam| kiṃ punastadvyākhyānam ? taccāsmābhirabhigrahaṇsaya prayojanaṃ varṇayadbhiḥ kṛtameva| kā punariha kriyā, yayābhipreyamāṇasya sampradānasaṃjñeṣyate ? sā vivakṣitā| ata āha-- `kriyayāpi yamabhipraiti' ityādi| `nigalhate' iti| `garha galha kutsāyām' (dhā.pā.636,637) anudāttet| `yuddhāya sannahyate' iti| `naha bandhane' (dhā.pā.1166) divādau svaritet| sa ceha niścaye varttate, yuddhe niścayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| `patye śete' iti| śīṅatropasarpaṇapūrvake śayana varttate| patimupasṛtya śete ityarthaḥ| `karmaṇaḥ karaṇasaṃjñā' ityādi| etat `paśunā rudraṃ yajate' ityetadviṣayameva veditavyam| yajiḥ svaritet| etacca `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti suvyatyayena siddhameveti na vaktavyam|| 33. rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ| (1.4.33) `rucinā samānārthā rucyarthāḥ' iti| rucyarthānāmityasmādeva nipātanāta-- mayūravyaṃsakāditvānmadhyamapadalopo samāsaḥ| `samānārthāḥ' iti| ekārthā ityarthaḥ| yadyapi `ricirdīptau' (dhā.pā.745) paṭhyate, tathāpīhābhilāṣe varttate, anekārthatvāddhātūnām; tatraiva prīyamāṇārthasya sambhavāt| yasya hyabhilāṣaḥ sa prīyamāṇaḥ. yastvabhilaṣati sa prīṇāti| `prīyamāṇaḥ' iti| tṛpyamāṇa ityarthaḥ| `prīñ tarpaṇe' (dhā.pā. 1474) ityetasmāt karmaṇi vihitasya lasya śānac| `anyakarttṛkaḥ' ityādinā tamabhilāṣaviśeṣaṃ darśayan ruciśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| prīyamāṇāpekṣayā'nyortho veditavyaḥ| prīyamāṇādanyaḥ karttā yasya so'nyakarttukaḥ| `rocate svadate' iti| `ruca dīptau'(dhā.pā.745) `svada āsvādane' (dhā.pā.18) anudāttettau| `devadattasthasya' ityādinā'nyakarttṛkatāmabhilāṣasya darśayati| `devadattāya rocate modakaḥ pathi' iti| prīyamāṇagrahādihādhikaraṇasya pathaḥ sampradānasaṃjñā na bhavati| atha devadatto modakamabhilaṣatītyatra devadattasya sampradānasaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati ? rucyarthābhāvāt `anyakarttṛko hyabhilāṣo ruciḥ, (kā. 1.4.33) ityuktam. na cehānyakarttṛko'bhilāṣaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? prīyamāṇo devadatto yastatrastho'bhilāṣastatkarttṛkaḥ|| 34. ślīghah‌nuṅsthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamānaḥ| (1.4.34) `jñīpsyamānaḥ' iti. `māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā' (dhā.pā.811) iti ghaṭādiṣu paṭhyate| tasmāt niśāmane jñāne varttamānāt hetumaṇṇic| atha vā `jñapa micca' (dhā.pā.1624) iti curādau paṭhyate| tasmāccurādiṇic, mittvāt hrasvatvam, san, dvirvacanam, `āpjñapyṛdhāmīt' (7.4.55) itītvam, `atra lopa'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityabhyāsalopaḥ, karmaṇi lakāraḥ, śānac yak, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48)| `ślāghate' iti| `ślāghu katthane' (dhā.pā.115) anudāttet| `{hnute- kāśikā, `nihnute-padamañjarī.} apahnate' iti| `hnuṅa apanayane' (dhā.pā.1082), ādādikaḥ| `tiṣṭhate' iti| `prakāśanastheyākhyayośca' (1.3.23) iti taṅa| `śapate' iti| `{śapa ākrośe- dhā.pā.} śapa upalambhane' (dhā.pā.1000) ityanenopalasaṃkhyānana taṅa|| 35. dhareruttamarṇaḥ| (1.4.35) `uttamarṇaḥ' iti| ṛṇe uttam uttamarṇaḥ| ata eva nipātanāt samāsaḥ, saptamīsamāse ṛṇasya pūrvanipātāt| nanu cottamarṇe ṛṇaśabdena na bhavitavyam| `ṛṇamādhamarṇye ' (8.2.60) ityādhamarṇye tasya nipātanāt, naitadasti; kālāntare deyaniyamopalakṣaṇārthaṃ hi tatrādhamarṇyagrahaṇam| ata uttamarṇo'pi bhavatyeva| `śataṃ dhārayati' iti| `dhṛṅa avasthāne' (dhā.pā.1412), śataṃ dhriyate svarūpeṇāvatiṣṭhate, svabhāvānna pracyavate| tadanyaḥ prayuṅkta iti `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic| `grāme' iti grāmasyādhikaraṇasyānuttamarṇasya na bhavati|| 36. spṛherīpsitaḥ| (1.4.36) `spṛhayati' iti| ato lopasya (6.4.48) `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāvādguṇo na bhavati| yadā tu puṣpādīnāmīpsitatamatvaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā paratvāt karmasaṃjñaiva bhavati-- puṣpāṇi spṛhyatīti|| 37.krudhadruherṣyāsūyārthānāṃ yaṃ prati kopaḥ| (1.4.37) krudhadruhāvakarmakau, tatra ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāmayamārambhaḥ, itarau sakarmakau| tatra dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyām| kathaṃ punareṣāṃ bhinnārthatve sati `yaṃ prati kopaḥ' iti sāmānyena tadviśeṣaṇamupapadyata ityāha-- `krodhastāvat' ityādi| sugamam| `kruddhyati, druhyati' iti| `krudha kope'(dhā.pā.1189), `druha jighāṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1197) daivādakau| `īrṣyati' iti| `{īkṣyaṃ, sūkṣyaṃ-dhā.pā.}īrkṣa, sūrkṣa, īrṣya īrṣyārthāḥ' (dhā.pā.510,509,511)| `asūyati' iti| asūyaśabdaḥ kaṇ‍ḍavādiyagantaḥ| `bhāryāmīrṣyati'iti| asti bhāryāyāmīrṣyā, na tu tāṃ prati kopaḥ| kevalaṃ parairdṛśyamānāṃ tāṃ na kṣamate| athāsmin dveṣṭītyatra kathaṃ na bhavati sampradānasaṃjñā ? dviṣerakrodhādyayarthatvāt| aprītau hyenaṃ smaranti; tathā cācetaneṣvapi prayujyate-- auṣadaṃ d‌veṣṭīti| nābhinandatīti gamyate|| 38. krudhadruhorupasṛṣṭayoḥ karma| (1.4.38) 39. rādhīkṣyoryasya vipraśnaḥ| (1.4.39) `rādhyati' iti| `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau' (dhā.pā.1262,1263),daivādikaḥ| `daivam' iti śubhāśubhaṃ karma| yasyeti grahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| tathā hi-- `yaṃ prati' ityanuvarttate, tatra yaṃ vipraśna ityevamabhisambandhe kriyamāṇe yasyetyasyārtho'prayujyamānasyāpi gamyata eva| 40. pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya karttā| (1.4.40) `pareṇa' ityādi| anyena kenacididaṃ me kriyatāmiti prayukto vyāpāritaḥ san pratijānīte| ataḥ pratijñāturanyena prayuktsayābhyupagamo bhavati| prayokteti vyāpārayitā| sūtre pūrvasyetyarthāpekṣayā puṃlliṅgena nirdeśaḥ|sa tvartho vicāryamāṇaḥ kriyaiva bhavati| yasmāt kartteti kriyāyā eva bhavati nānyasyārthasyetyāha-- `pūrvasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ' iti| yaścāsau pūrvasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ karttā bhavati, sa pratijñātuḥ prayojako bhavatīti hetusaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāmidaṃ vanacam| `devadattāya gāṃ pratiśṛṇoti' iti| atra pūrvasyā yānacakriyāyā devadattaḥ karttā| devadattena hi mahyaṃ gāṃ dehīti yācita sa yadā dadāmīti pratijānīte, tadaivaṃ prayujyate-- devadattāya gāṃ pratiśṛṇotīti | pūrvasya kartteti kim ? vinā tena gavāderabhyupayemānasya karmaṇa eva syāt| nanu ca paratvāt karmasaṃjñā tasya bādhikā bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; nāprāpte hi saṃjñāntara idamārabhyata iti| ihāpi ca devadattāya gāmāśṛṇotīti devadattasya hetusaṃjñā prāpnoti| tatra pūrvasya karttetyasminnasati yathā devadattasya hetusaṃjñāṃ bādhate, tadā karmasaṃjñāmapi bādheta| atha vā-- `purastādapavādā anantarān vidhīn bādhante nottarān' (vyā.pa.9) iti karmasaṃjñāmeva bādheta| pūrvasya karttetyasmiṃstu sati hetusaṃjñāmeva bādhate, na karmasaṃjñām|| 41.anupratigṛṇaśca| (1.4.41) `anupratigṛṇaḥ' iti śnāpratyayena nirdeśāt kryādipaṭhitasya `gṝ śabde' (dhā.pā.1498) ityasya, na `gṝ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410) ityasya taudādikasya| `hotā prathamaṃ śaṃsati'iti| etena stutikriyāyāḥ pūrvasyā hotā kartteti darśayati| protsāhayatītyanenāgṛṇātipratigṛṇātiśabdayorarthamācaṣṭe| kathaṃ punarjñāyate-- anupūrvaḥ pratipūrvaśca śaṃsiturgṛṇātiḥ protsāhane varttata ityāha-- `anugaraḥ pratigaraḥ' iti| anugīryate - hotā prathamaṃ praśasyate yena śabdena so'yamanugaraḥ| evaṃ pratigīryate yena sa pratigaraḥ| pūrvasay karttetyeva, hotre'nugṛṇātika sadasītyadhikaraṇasya mā bhūt|| 42. sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam| (1.4.42) nanu ca sāmagryadhīnā hi kriyāsiddharekasyāpyabhāvena na bhavati| tat kasyātra prakarṣo yatparigrahāya sādhakatamaśabdasya grahamamita yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha-- `kriyāsiddhau' ityādi| prakṛṣṭam - atyantamupakārakam| atha vā -- prakarṣaḥ prakṛṣṭam `nupaṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114)| prakṛṣṭena prakarṣeṇopakārakaṃ prakṛṣṭopakārakaṃ yat kriyāyasiddhiviṣaye prakarṣeṇopakārakaṃ vivakṣitaṃ tat sādhakatamam| vivakṣitagrahaṇaṃ yadā prakṛṣṭopakārakatvena vivakṣyate, tadā sādhakatamavyavahāro vijñāyate, nānyedita jñāpanārtham| tathāhi-- vivakṣāvaśād yadeva kadācit karaṇambhavati-- dhanuṣā vidhyatīti, tadeva kadācit svātantryavivakṣāyāṃ karttṛtvamanubhavati-- ṭadhanurvidhyatīti| `lunāti' iti| `pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ' (7.3.80)| `tamabgrahaṇaṃ kim ? gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' iti| yadi tamabgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tato'trādhikaraṇasaṃjñā na syāt| iha hi dvivadha ādhāraḥ- gauṇaḥ,mukhyaśca| tatra mukhyo ya ādheyena vyāpyate, yathā-- tileṣu tailamasti;atra tailenādheyenādhārabhūtāstilā vyāptāḥ| avyāpto gauṇo yathā-- gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti| atra hi sāmīpyād gaṅgāyāṃ ādhāratvamupacaritam, na mukhyam; vyāptyabhāvāt| tatrāsati tamabgrahaṇe `gauṇamukhyayormukhye kāryasaṃmpratyayaḥ' (vyā.pa.4) iti mukhyasyaivādhikaraṇasaṃjñā syāt, netarasya; tamabgrahaṇāt tasyāpi bhavati; tathapīha tamabgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam,katham ? vināpi tena prakarṣāvagateḥ| yathaiva hyanabhirūpāya kanyādānasya pravṛttirnāstītyabhirūpāya kanyā deyetyukte vināpi prakarṣapratyayenābhirūpatamāyeti gamyate; tathehāpi kārakādhikārādasādhake saṃjñāyāḥ pravṛttirnastīti `sādhakaṃ karaṇam' ityukte'ntareṇāpi tamabgrahaṇaṃ sādhakatamamiti gamyate, tatkiṃ tamabgrahaṇena ? tadetat tamabgrahaṇaṃ jñāpanārthaṃ kṛtam| etadanena jñāpyate-- `iha kārakādhikāre itaḥ sūtrādanyatra vinā tamabgrahaṇena prakarṣo nāśrīyate' iti| tena `ādhāro'dhikaraṇam' (1.4.45) ityanena `gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādāvamukhyasyāpi gaṅgāderādhārasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā siddhā bhavati|| 43. diva karma ca| (1.4.43) `dīvyati' iti| `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ|| 44. parikrayaṇe kasaṃpradānamanyatarasyām| (1.4.44) parikrītiḥ - parikrayaṇam| `niyatakālam' iti| nātyantikam| `vetanādinā' iti| ādiśabdena bandhakādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `nātyantikaḥ kraya eva' iti niyatakālatvaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| pariśabdo'tra pratyāsatiṃ dyotayati| krayo hi nāmātyantikaḥ| vetanādinā kevalaṃ yattu niyatakālaṃ tadātyantikasya krayasya samīpamiti pariśabdenākhyāyate|| 45. ādhāro'dhikaraṇam| (1.4.45) `ādhriyante kriyāguṇā asminnityādhāraḥ' iti| `adhyāyanyāyodyāvaṭa (3.3.122) ityādinā''dhāraśabdo'dhikaraṇe ghañanto vyatpādita-| kriyāpekṣatvat kārakasyeti kriyāgrahaṇam| yadyādhriyanti kriyā yasmin sa ādhāraḥ iti, evaṃ hi sati kartṛkarmaṇorevādhikaraṇasaṃjñā prasajyeta, tayoreva hi kriyā ādhriyante| tathā hi- karttasthā va ā kriyā bhavati, karmasthā vā, anavakāśatvāt karttṛkarmaṇoḥ saṃjñā na bhaviṣyatyeṣa doṣa prasaṅag iti, etaccānuttaram; satyapi hyanavakāśatve tayoḥ paryāyaḥ syāt| ekadādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhavitavyaṃ taṃ darśayati| pratirābhimukhye| `kriyāṃ prati ya ādhāraḥ' iti|| kriyāyā abhimukho ya ādhāra ityarthaḥ| yaśca kriyāṃ dhārayati sa kriyāyā abhimukho bhavati| kriyāyāstu dhāraṇaṃ sākṣāt, vyavadhānena vā; karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kriyāśrayayordhāraṇāt| atra pūrvasya vyavacchedārthaṃ `karttṛrmaṇoḥ' ityuktam| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kriyādhārabhūtayordhāraṇāt kriyāyā abhimukho ya ādhārastasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhavatīti| tadevaṃ kriyādhārabhūtakarttṛkarmadhāraṇadvāreṇa kriyāyā abhimukho ya ādhārastasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā; yato'nena vidhīyate tato na bhavati pūrvasya doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| na hi karttṛkarmaṇoranena prakāreṇa kriyāṃ pratyādhāratvam; api tu sākṣādeva kriyādhāraṇāt| nanvevamapi karttṛkarmaṇormukhyaṃ kriyādhāratvam, sākṣādeva kriyādhāraṇāt, karttṛkarmādhārasya tu kaṭādergauṇatvaṃ kriyāśrayabhūtakarttṛkarmadhāraṇadvāreṇa kriyādhāraṇāt| tatra mukhya ādhāre sati gauṇasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā na prāpnotīti sa doṣasatdavastha eva? naitadasti; tamabgrahaṇena jñāpitametat-- gauṇasyāpyādhārasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā bhavatīti| bhavatu gauṇasyādhikaraṇasaṃjñā, mukhyasyāpi karttṛ karmaṇaśca kasmānna bhavatīti cet, na; paratvādanavakāśatvācca karttṛkarmasaṃjñābhyāṃ bādhyamānatvāt| adhikaraṇasaṃjñā hi pūrvo gauṇa ādhāre sāvakāśā, tadviparīte tu karttṛkarmasaṃjñe iti tābhyāṃ bādhyamānā notsahate tayorviṣayamavagāhitum| `kaṭe āste' iti| karttṛsthā kriyā yatra pūrveṇa prakāreṇādhriyate tasyodāharaṇam;; vikledanakriyāyāḥ karmasthatvāt| `sthālyāṃ pacati' iti| karmasthā kriyā yatrādhriyate tasyodāharaṇam; vikledanakriyāyā karmasthatvāt| tatpunaradhikaraṇaṃ triprakāram-- aupaśleṣikam,vaiṣayikam, abhivyāpakañca| tatrādye -- kaṭe āste,sthālyāṃ pacatīti kaṭāderpayādhārasya hyādheyena sahopaśleṣaḥ saṃyogalakṣaṇo'stītyaupaśleṣikaṃ tadbhavati| vaiṣayikam-- gurau vasati, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti| prativasatīti viṣayo hyananyatrabhāvaḥ, yathā-- cakṣuṣvaprabhṛtīnāṃ rūpādibhyo'nanyatrabhāvāccakṣurādīnāṃ rūpādayo viṣayā ityucyante, evaṃ śiṣyādīnāṃ gurvādibhyo'nanyatrabhāvādeṣāṃ te viṣayā iti| nanu ca `ādhāro'dhikaraṇam' (1.4.45) ityuktam, ādhāraśca ko bhavati ? ya āśrayaḥ; saṃyogataḥ samavāyo vā bhavati, na ca śiṣyādīnāṃ guruprabhṛtibhiḥ saha saṃyogaḥ samavāyo vā'sti, tadayuktaṃ teṣāmadhikaraṇatvam ? naitadasti; yadāyattā hi yasya sthitiḥ sa vināpi saṃyogasamavāyābhyāṃ tasyāśrayo bhavati, yathā-- rājāyattasthititvāt puruṣasya rājeti; na ca rājñā saha puruṣasya saṃyogasamavāyau sta-| tathā hi-- tadadhīnasthititvāt rājāśrayaḥ puruṣa iti loke vyapadiśyate, tathā śiṣyādīnāṃ gurvādyāyattā sthitiriti yuktastān prati guruprabhṛtīnāmāśrayabhāvaḥ| abhivyāpakaṃ yathā-- tileṣu tailam, daghni sarpiriti| tilādikaṃ tailadikamādheyaṃ vyāpyāvatiṣṭhata iti tilādikamabhivyāpakamadhikaraṇam| yadyapyatra tilādīnāṃ tailādibhiḥ saha saṃyogo'sti, tathāpi deśavibhāgābhāvādatra saṃśleṣavyavahāro nāstītyaupaśleṣikāt tatpṛthagevopasthāpyate|| 46.adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma| (1.4.46) `adhyāste' iti| `āsa upaveśane' (dhā.pā.1021) adādiḥ anudāttet|| 47. abhinivaśaśca|(1.4.47) 48. upānvadhyāṅvasaḥ|(1.1.48) lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.50) `vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1005) ityasya bhauvādikasya grahaṇam, na `vasa ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1023) ityasyādādikasya| `vaseraśyarthasya' ityādi| `upoṣya rajanīmekām' iti, trirātramupavasatītyatra ca `kālādhvanoḥ' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā| atha vā `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ' (vā; ma.bhā.1.336) iti karmatve| atrārthaśabdo nivṛttivacana iti bhojananivṛttivācina ityartha-| `vaktavyam' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ihāpyanyatarasyāgrahaṇanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate; tena vaseraśyarthasya pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati|| 49. kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma| (1.4.49) `karttuḥ kriyayā' iti| etena kartturiti nepsitatamāpekṣayā `ktasya ca vartamāne' (2.3.67) ityaneneyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī, api tu kriyāpekṣayā śeṣalakṣaṇaiveti darśayati| nanu ca neha kriyopāttā, tatkathaṃ tadapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī prayujyate ? yadyapi nopāttā, tathāpi karttuḥ kriyāpekṣatvāt karttṛśabdo'yaṃ sambandhiśabda iti karttṛsambandhinīṃ kriyāmupasthāpayatītyadoṣaḥ| īpsitaśabdo hyasti rūḍhiśabdaḥ-- īpsito'bhipreta iti, asti ca kriyāśabdaḥ-āptamiṣṭa īpsita iti ; tatraha kriyāśabdo gṛhyate, netaraḥ; na hi rūḍhiśabdasya kriyayā karttṛsādhyayā sambandha upapadyate| `īpsita' iti| `āplṛ vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1260) san, dvirvanacam, `āpjñapyṛdhāmīt' (7.4.55) itīttvam| `atra lopo'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityabhyāsalopaḥ| īpsa iti sthite, ktapratyaye kṛte, iṭi ca `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralope cepsitaśabdaḥ sampadyate| tenārthadvayamihopāttam-- prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthaśca| tatrāptumityanena prakṛtyarthaṃ darśayati,iṣṭatamamityanena pratyayārtham| `karmaṇaḥ' ita| aśvasya| atra bandhakriyayā āptamiṣṭatamatvāt karmatvam| sa hi bhakṣaṇakriyayā māṣānāptumicchati| `payasaudanaṃ bhaṅkte' iti| asati hi tamabgrahaṇe payaso'pi syāt| tadapi karttṛrbhujikriyayā vyāptumiṣṭaṃ bhavati| tamabgrahaṇe tu sati na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ; prādhānyādaudanasyaivepsitatamatvāt| prādhānyaṃ tvodanasya saṃskāryatvāt, payasastvaprādhānyaṃ saṃskārakatvāt| `karmetyanuvarttamāne' iti| `adhiśīṅasthāsāṃ karma' (1.4.46) ityataḥ| `punaḥ'ityādi| pūrva karmagrahaṇamādhāreṇa sambaddham; atastadanuvṛttau tasyānuvṛttiḥ syādata ādhāranivṛttyarthaṃ punaḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| yadi punarādhāro'nuvarttate, tataḥ kiṃ syādityatrāha-- `ādhārasyaiva hi syāt' iti| `hi' śabdo yasmādarthe| yasmāsyādityāha-- `geham' ityādi| ādhārānuvṛttau tu yatra na bhavati taddarśanayitumāha-- `odanaṃ pacati' ityādi| ādiśabdenaudanaṃ bhaṅktaṃ ityevamādergrahaṇam| atha nadī kūlaṃ karṣatītyādau kathaṃ karmasaṃjñā ? kathañca na syāt ? nadyāderacetanatvāt, acetanānāmīpsāyā asambhavāt, naitadasti; atra nadīti padāntarasambandādīpsāyā abhāvo'cetanasyāpi bhāvaḥ pratīyate| na ca padasaṃskāre padānatarasambandhagamyo'rtha upayujyate, tena kūlaṃ karṣatītyādāvicchāmātramāśritā vyāptiḥ, karma ca saṃskriyate| yadyapi paścānnadyā saha sambandhādacetanatvamicchāyā abhāvaśca pratīyate, tathāpi ca tadbahiraṅgatvādantaraṅgasaṃjñākārya na śaknoti nivartayitum| anenaiva nyāyena yatra vyāptirnāsti,icchāmātraṃ ca kevalam, tatrāpi karmasaṃjñā bhavati, yathā- grāmaṃ ganatumicchāmi na ca me gamanaśaktirastīti| tacca karma trividham-- nirvartyam, vikāryam, prāpyañca| tatra nirvarttyaṃ yadasakadevotpādyate, yasya janma kriyate, tannirvarttyam , yathā-- kaṭaṃ karoti, kaṭo hyasanneva kriyate| vikāryaṃ yallabdhasattākamavasthāntaramāpādyate kevalaṃ bhasmākhyāmavasthāmāpādyante| prāpyaṃ yatra vyāptivyitarekeṇa kriyākṛtā viśeṣā na vibhāvyante, yathā-- ādityaṃ paśyatīti| na hi dṛśikriyayā vyāpyamānasya savituḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣa upalabhyata iti prāpyametat karma|| 50.tathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam|(1.4.50) cakāro'vadhāraṇe| ata eva vṛttāvāha-- `tenaiva' iti| `anīpsitam' iti| yadyapyayaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tadā grāmaṃ gacchan vṛkṣamūlānyupasarpatītyādau vṛkṣamūlādīnāṃ karmasaṃjñā na syāt| tathā hi-- prasajyapratiṣedhe satyanena yogenānīpsitasyaiva karmasaṃjñā vidhīyate; vṛkṣamūlāni ca na tāvadīptitāni, pūrvamanabhisandhāya pravṛtteḥ; nāpyanīpsitāni, apratikūlatvāt; tataścānīpsitasya karmasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā teṣamīpsitādanyatvenānīpsitānna syāt| paryudāse tu satyanena yonenepsitādanyasya karmasaṃjñā vidhīyate| bhavanti ca yathoktaprakaraṇāni vṛkṣamūlānīpsitādanyāni; atasteṣāmapi karmasaṃjñā sidhyatītyetadālocya paryudāso'yamiti darśayitumāha-- `īpsitādanyat' ityādi| kiṃ punastadityāha-- `dveṣyam' ityādi| dveṣyam - pratikūlam, yathā-- viṣacaurādi| itaradapratikūlam, yathā -- uktaprakārāṇi vṛkṣamūlāni| `bhakṣayati' iti| `bhakṣa adane' (dhā.pā. 1557) caurādikaḥ|| 51.akathitañca| (1.4.51) `{mudrita `kāśikāvṛttau' tu `apādānādiviśeṣakathābhiḥ' ityevāsti|}apādānādhibhirviśeṣakathābhiḥ' iti| kārakasāmānyakathāyā vyavacchedārtametat| yadi hi kenāpyakathitasya karmasaṃjñā syāt, tadā māṇavakasya pitaraṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchatītyatrākārakasyāpi māṇavakasya karmasaṃjñā syāt| `parigaṇanam' iti| anayadhātuvyavacchedārthametat| tena `duha prapūharaṇe' (dhā.pā.1014) ityevamādīnāmeva dhātūnāṃ prayoge'kathitasya karmasaṃjñā vidhīyate, nānyeṣām| `upayujyata ityupayogaḥ' iti| karmasādhano ghañantaḥ| `upayajyate' iti| iṣṭārthasiddhau vyāpāryata ityartha-| `payaḥprabhṛti' iti| prabhṛtiśabdana bhikṣādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `tasya nimittaṃ gavādi' iti. ātrāpyādiśabdena pauravādergrahaṇam| `tasyoparyujyamānapayaḥ prabhṛtanimittasya' iti| upayujyamānañca tat payaḥ prabhṛti ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaṃ kṛtvanā upayujyamānapayaḥ prabhṛternimittamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `gavādeḥ' iti| ādiśabdena pauravādergrahaṇam| nanu ca pāṇyādikamapyupayoganimittamiti, tena vinopayogasya payaso'sambhavāt| ādiśabdena kāṃsyapātrādergrahaṇam| `vihitā hi tatra karaṇādi saṃjñā' iti| ādiśabdenādhikaraṇasaṃjñāyā grahaṇam| `tadartham' iti| karaṇādeḥ karmasaṃjñānivṛttyarthamityarthaḥ| arthaśabdasya nivṛttivacantavāt. `apūrvavidhau' iti| pūrvagrahaṇamatrānyavidherupalakṣaṇārtham| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yasyānyo vidhirnoktasya karmasaṃjñeti| tena yatrāpi vakṣyamāṇe hetukarttṛsaṃjñe iti tatrāpyeṣā saṃjñā na bhavatīti dogdhāpyupayogasya nimittaṃ tasya karmasaṃjñā na bhavati| sūtre'pi `akathitam' iti kathamanivṛttaparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ bhūtakālo na vivakṣyate; upalakṣaṇatvāt| tena yo'pi kathayiṣyamāṇo hetukarttṛsaṃjñābhyām, tasyāpi karmasaṃjñā na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| bruviśāsiguṇena' iti| kaḥ punarguṇa ityāha-- `sādhanam' iti| sādhanaṃ hi kriyayā upakārakam | yaccopakārakaṃ tadupakāryam pradhānamapekṣya guṇo bhavati| katarat punaḥ sādhanamityāha-- `pradhānaṃ karma' iti| kiṃ punastadityāha-- `dharmādikam' iti| ādiśabdena pattyādergrahaṇam| pradhānatvantu dharmādestadarthatvācchiṣyādipravṛtteḥ| `sambadhyate' iti sacata ityasyārthakathanam| tathā hi-- `ṣaca samavāye' (dhā.pā.997) iti paṭhyate, samavāyaśca sambandha eva| sacate - tena guṇena sambandhamupaiti| yacca tena sambandhamuṣaiti tattena sambadhyate| `uktam' iti ācaritamityasya vivaraṇam| sūtrākāreṇetyetadapi `kavinā' ityasya| `gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ' iti| `duha prapūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1014) ādādikaḥ| `dāderdhātorghaḥ' (8.2.32), `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40), `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvam| nanu cātra vihitā'pādāna saṃjñā, asti hyatrāpāyaḥ-- goḥ duheḥ kṣaraṇārthatvāt, kṣarati gauoḥ kṣīram, tad‌gordogdhā kṣārayati, evañca tat kṣāryamāṇaṃ tato'pakrāmatīti spaṣṭa evāpāyaḥ, tato nedamudāharaṇamupapadyate ? naitadevam; satyapi hyapāye nātra goravadhitvaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi ? kṣīraṃ prati nimittabhāvamātram| yadyevam, goḥ kārakatvaṃ na syāt, yathā -- vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatītyatra vṛkṣasya na; kṣaraṇakriyāṃ prati nimittabhāvenāvivakṣitatvāt, naitat; avadhitvaṃ hyatra gorna vivakṣitam| kṣaraṇaṃ prati nimittabhāvastu vivakṣita eva. vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patatītyatra tu patanaṃ prati vṛkṣasya nimittabhāvamātramapi na vivakṣitam, na kevalamavadhibhāva ityasamānam| `pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate' iti| nanu cātra kathitāpādānādisaṃjñā , asti hyasau| pauravādgāmādatta iti astyevavāpāyaḥ ? naitadasti; na hi yācanādevāpāyo bhavati , kiṃ tarhi ? avarodhanakriyāṃ prati nimittabāvamātram| asyāñcāvasthāyāṃ vā vivakṣyate; na caitadiha vivakṣitam, hetunā gāmavasthāpayatītyayamatrārtho veditavyaḥ, na tu kvāvasthāpayatītyetadiha cintyata eva| `māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati' iti| `praccha jñīpsāyām' (dhā.pā. 1413), tudādiḥ, grahijyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam| nanu ca kathitātrāpādānasaṃjñā, asti hyatrāpāyaḥ-- sahi tasmādupadeśamāditsate, naitadasti; na hi praśnamātreṇāpāyo bhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? pṛṣṭaḥ san yadyasāvācaṣṭe tadāpāyena yujyate| satyapyapāye nātra māṇavako'vadhibhāvena vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? praśnakriyāṃ prati nimittabhāvamātreṇa| `pauravaṃ gāṃ bhikṣate' iti| `bhikṣa yācñāyām' (dhā.pā.606) anudāttet| ata kimartha yācibhikṣyordvayorupādānam, yāvatā'nayorarthabhedo nāsti ? na ceyaṃ saṃjñā śbadāśrayā, kiṃ tarhi ? athaśriyā| tathā hi- yācinā samānārthasyānyasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati-- devadattaṃ śataṃ prārthayate, devadattaṃ śataṃ mṛgayata iti| tasmāt satyapi śabdebhede na yuktaṃ tayoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇam| evaṃ tarhi yāciratrānunaye varttate-- tana kruddhaṃ yācate, avinītaṃ yācata iti, tadarthaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ syāt| `vṛkṣamavacinoti phalāni' iti| nanu cātra vihitā'pādānasaṃjñā tathā hi-- vṛkṣāt phalānyādata ityapāyo'trārthaḥ,naitadasti; na hyatra vṛkṣo'vadhitvana vivakṣitaḥ| kintarhi ? phalāvacayanasya hetubhāvamātreṇa| vṛkṣeṇa hetunā phalāvacayanaṃ karotyarthaḥ| tasya vṛkṣasya hetubhāvaḥ kimavadhibhūtasya ? adhikaraṇabhūtasya vā ? ityevamādikā cintā na kṛtā| evaṃ `māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ brūte, māṇavakaṃ dharmamanuśāsti' iti| `brūñ vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.1044), `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075) adādī| nanu ca kathitātra sampradānasaṃjñā, asti hyatra sampradānatvam, sampradeyena dharmeṇābhipreyamāṇatvāt, naitadasti; dadātikarmaṇābhipreyamāṇasya sampradānasaṃjñā vihitā, na cātra dharmo dadātikarma; bruviśāsyoradānārthatvāt| athāpi dānārthatā syāt ? evamapi māṇavekana nimittena dharmaṃ dadātītyayamarthaḥ syāt| māṇavakasya sampradānatvanāvivakṣitatvāt; dharmadānanimittatvena vivakṣitatvāt| bruviśāsiguṇena ceti cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena nayatiprabhṛtīnāṃ prayoge'pyakathitasya karmasaṃjñeṣyate|tathā coktam-- nīvahyoharateścaiva gatyarthānāṃ tathaiva ca| dvikarmakeṣu grahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti niścayaḥ|| iti| atrāpi śloke cakāro jayatiprabhṛtīnāṃ prayoge'kathitasya samuccayārthaḥ| kimudāharaṇam ? ajāṃ nayati grāmaṃ devadattaḥ| ajāṃ vahati grāmaṃ devadattaḥ| ajāṃ harati grāmaṃ devadattaḥ| śataṃ jayati devadattaṃ yajñadattaḥ| śataṃ gargān daṇ‍ḍayatīti| nanu cobhayeṣāmapi `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma' (1.4.49) ityanenaiva karmasaṃjñā siddhā| yadi tarhyajādīnāmīpsitatamatvaṃ vivakṣyate, na grāmādīnām, tadā kathaṃ karmasaṃjñā ? tathāpi `tathāyuktam' (1.4.50) ityanena siddhā| yadā tarhi grāmādīnāmīpsitatvaṃ prakarṣarahitaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā na siddhyati| akarmakāṇāñca dhātūnāṃ kālabhāvādhnagantavyadeśānāṃ karmasaṃjñeṣyate| tathā coktam-- kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām| daśāścākarmakāṇāñca karmasaṃjñā bhavanti ca|| iti vaktavyam (ma.bhā.1.336) iti| tasmāt tadartho'nuktasamuccayārthaścakāraḥ kṛtaḥ kālaḥ -- māsamāste māsaṃ svapitīti| bhāvaḥ-- godohamāste, godohaṃ kasvapitīti| adhvā gantavyaḥ-- krośamāste, krośaṃ svapitīti| adhvā cāsau gantavyaśceti viśeṣamasamāsaḥ| `kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraya' (2.2.38) iti viśeṣyasya pūrvanipātaḥ| deśaḥ kurūnāste, kurūn svapitīti| sarvaṃ ete kālādayo'kathitāḥ; pūrvavidheḥ kasyacid‌pravṛttatvāt|| 52.gatibuddhikapratyavasānāthaśabdakarmākarmakāṇāmaṇi karttā sa ṇau|(1.4.52) `yāpayati' iti| `artihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- uttarasūtre (1.4.53) anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣabhūto vijñāyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā; tena nīvahyorna bhaviṣyati| `vaheḥ' ityādi| niyacchati - viśiṣṭe viṣaye'vasthāpayatīti niyantā sārathiḥ, avidyamāno niyantā karttā yasya sa tathoktaḥ, tasya| `nīvahyoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' (vā.62) iti yo'nantaroktaḥ sa vaheraniyantṛkarttṛkasya bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- tasyaivānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣā tvānniyantṛkarttṛkasya vaheḥ karmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti| `ādikhādyoḥ' ityādi| atrāpi vaktavyaśabdasya pūrvavadevārthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi pūrvavadeva karttavyam| `bhakṣyati piṇḍī devadattaḥ' iti| curādiṇic| `bhakṣayati' piṇḍīṃ devadattena' iti| hetumaṇṇic| `bhakṣayati balīvarddān śasyam' iti| bhakṣiratra hiṃsārthaḥ| `sarve sacetanā bhāvāḥ' ityasmin darśe hiṃsitaṃ śasyamiti śasyasya bhakṣaṇena devadatto hiṃsito bhavati| yasya hi tacchasyaṃ tasya hiṃsā gamyate| `śabdakarmaṇām' iti| śabdagrahaṇeneha pāribhāṣikaṃ karma gṛhya.te, na tu kriyā| kriyā grahaṇe hi karma grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| kārakādhikārādeva kārakasya kriyāpekṣatvācchabdātmikāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ varttamānā dhātavo grahīṣyanta iti, tat kiṃ karmagrahaṇena ? yadi tarhi pāribhāṣikaṃ karma gṛhyate, jalpati devadatto jalpayati devadattam, vilapati devadattaṃ kārṣāpaṇamityatra na prāpnoti, śabdādanyasya pāribhāṣikasya karmaṇo vivakṣitatvāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; buddhyarthatvāt bhaviṣyati| atra hi jalpatiprabhṛtayastāvacchabdasādhane bodhane varttante| jalpati devadatta iti| vacanena bodhayatītyarthaḥ| evamanyatrāpi| paśyati kārṣāpaṇamityatra dṛśiścakṣuḥ sādhane jñāne varttate| cakṣuṣā jānīta ityarthaḥ| tasmādbuddharthatvāt siddham| `adhyāpayati' iti| `krīṅajīnāṃ ṇau' (6.1..48) ityāttvam| `artihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk| kimarthaṃ punaridaṃ sūtram, yāvatā ṇyante dhātau prayojanakavyāpāreṇa preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇākhyena vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt prayojyasya `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma' (1.4.49) ityanenaiva karmasaṃjñā siddhā ? satyam, niyamārthaṃ vacanam-- prayojakavyāpāreṇa vyāpyamānasya yadā karmasaṃjñā tadā gatyarthādīnāmeva,nānyeṣāmiti|| 53. hṛkrorantayatarasyām|(1.4.53) gatyarthādayo nivṛttāḥ| tenobhayatra vibhāṣeyam| yadā haratirgatau varttate, abhyavahāre vā, karotiścākarmaṇo bhavati tadā prāpte| yadā tu haratiḥ steyādau varttate, karotiśca sakarmako bhavati tavā'prāpte| `upasaṃkhyānam' iti| pratipādanamityarthaḥ| etacca prakṛtatvāt tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `akathitañca' (1.4.51) ityataścakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tenābhivādidṛśorapyātmanepade karmasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti| `abhivādayate' iti. `ṇitaśca'(1.3.ka74) ityātmanepadam| `darśayate' iti| atrāpi `ṇeraṇau' (1.3.67) ityādinā| 54.svatantraḥ kartā| (1.4.54) astyayaṃ svatantaraśabdo bahuvrīhiḥ| svaṃ tantraṃ yasya sa svatantraḥ| asti ca samāsapratirūpako rūḍhiśabdaḥ, pradhānārthavṛttiḥ, yathā-- svatantro'yamiha devadatta iti, pradhānabhūta iti gamyate| tatra yadi pūrvo gṛhyeta tadā tantuvāyasyaiva syāt; vistṛtā hi tantavastantram, tacca tantuvāyasyaivāsti| devadattaḥ pacatītyādau na syāt| itarasya tu grahaṇe sarvatra bhavati| tasmāt vyāpternyāyāt sa eva gṛhyata iti matvāha-- `svatantra iti pradhānabhūtaḥ' iti| yadyevamapradhānamapekṣya pradhānamucyata iti yatrādhikaraṇādīnyaparāṇyapradhānāni kārakāṇi santi, devadattaḥ kāṣṭhairagninodanaṃ sthālyāṃ pacatītyādau tatraiva syāt| yatra tu teṣāmavivakṣā-- āste devadattaḥ, śete devadatta ityādau, tatra na syāditi yo deśayet taṃ pratyāha-- `aguṇabhūtaḥ' iti| evaṃ manyate-- pradhānenāguṇabhāva upalakṣyate| guṇabhāvo yatra nāsti sa kartteti| kārakāntarāvivakṣāyāmapyaguṇabhāvo'styeveti sarvatra bhavati| nanu ca sāmagryadhīnā hi kriyāsiddhiḥ, ekasyāpyabhāve na sidhyati, tat kasyātra prādhānyaṃ yatparigrahāya svatantragrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? ityāha -- `yaḥ kriyāsiddhau' ityādi| yadyapi kriyāsiddhau sarveṣāṃ vyāpāraḥ, tathāpi svātantryaṃ yasya vivakṣyate sa eva svatantra ityutyate, nānya iti| devadattaḥ pacatītyatra devadattaḥ karttṛsaṃjñakatvāt karttṛpratyayenocyate lakāreṇa|| 55. tatprayojako hetuśca|((1.4.55) `tasya prayojakastatprayojakaḥ' iti. nanu ca `karttari ca' (2.2.16) ityanena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhe nātra bhavitavyamityāha-- `nipātanātsamāsaḥ' iti| `prayojakaḥ' iti prerakaḥ - upadeśakaḥ, vyāpāraka ityarthaḥ| na cānyena prayujyamānasya svavyāpāre svātantrayaṃ hīyate; anyathā hyakurvatyapi kārayīti syāt| prayojakatvaṃ dvividham-- mukhyam, itaracva| devadattaḥ kaṭaṃ kārayītyatra devadattasya mukhyam| bhikṣā vāsayatītyatra bhikṣāṇāṃ vāsahetutvāt prayojanatvamupacaritam, na mukhyam. na hi bhikṣā yūyaṃ vasathetyevaṃ prayuñjate| iha ca kārakādhikāre tamabgrahaṇavyatirekeṇātiśayo na vivakṣita iti `sādhakatamaṃ karaṇa m' (1.4.42) ityatra tamabgrahaṇena jñāpitametat| tena yasyāpi prayojagatvamupacaritam, na mukhyam, tasyāpi hetusaṃjñā bhavatyeva| `saṃjñāsamāveśārthaścakāraḥ' iti| asati tasminnekasaṃjñādhikārādatra kartṛsaṃjñā na syāt| ataḥ saṃjñāsamāveśārthaścakāraḥ kriyate| `hetutvāt' ityādinā saṃjñādvayasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| prayojakavyāpāre hi `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic vidhīyate| tasya hetutvaṃ prayojakasya hetutve satyupapadyate| hetutvātprayojako ṇico nimittaṃ bhavati| kartṛpratyena na lakāreṇābhidhānaṃ karttṛsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ bhavatīti karttṛtvat karttṛpratyayena lakāreṇocyata iti|| 56. prāgrīśvarānnipātāḥ| (1.4.56) ca,vā,ha, aha ityatra nipātasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `svarādinipātamavyayam' (1.1.37) ityavyayasaṃjñā bhavati| `nipātā ādyudāttā bhavanti' (phi.sū.4.80) ityādyudāttatvañca| atha kimarthaṃ prāggrahaṇam ? yāvatā pañcamyuccāraṇasāmarthyādeva prāgityasya dikchabdasyādhyāhāro bhaviṣyati| na ca `parām' ityayamapi dikchabdo'sti| ato nādhyāhāra āśaṅkanīyaḥ| tadadhyāhāre hi `cādayo'sattve' (1.4.57) ityevamādayo yogā nipātasaṃjñāsambandhābhāvādasambaddhāḥ syuḥ| tasmāt prāgityetadevādhyāhariṣyate| tat kiṃ prāgavacanena ? ityāha-- `prāgvacanam' ityādi| ekā saṃjñetyanuvarttate| nipātasaṃjñā cādiṣu prādiṣu vā kriyāyoge caritārthā| tatrāsati prāgvacane nipātasaṃjñāyā upasargādisaṃjñābhiranavakāśābhirbādhyamānatvāt tābhi) saha tasyāḥ samāveśo na syāt| iṣyate cātra, tadarthaṃ prāgvacanam, tasmin satyevaṃ sambandhaḥ kriyate-- rīśvarāta yāvantaḥ prāgvyavasthitāste sarve nipātasaṃjñakā bhavanti, nipātāśca santa upasargādisaṃjñakā iti| tena nimittameva nipātasaṃjñopasargasaṃjñānāṃ bhavati| na ca nimittinā nimittaṃ vyāhanyate, anyathā hi tasya nimitatvameva na syāt| adhyāhṛte tu prākśabde rīśvarādye prāgvyavasthitāste sarve nipātasaṃjñakā bhavantītyeṣo'rtho'bhimataḥ syāt, na tu nipātāḥ santa upasargādisaṃjñakā ityeṣo'pyartho labhyate| sūtropātto tu prāk‌śabda eṣo'rtho labhyata eva; anyathā tasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| atha kimarthaṃ rephādika īśvaraśabdo gṛhyate-- prāgrīśvarāditi, na ca prāgrīśvarādityevocyeta, pratyāsatteranantara eva hīśvaraśabdo grahīṣyata ityata āha-- `rīśvarādvīśvarātmā bhūta' iti| rephasahita īśvaro rīśvaraḥ| śākapārthivāditvānmayūravyaṃsakāditvādvā samāsaḥ| rīśvarādityucyamāne vīśvarānmā bhūt, `adhirīśvare' (1.4.97) ityasyaiveśvaraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| `īśvare totunkasunau' (3.4.13) ityatra yo vīśvaraśabdastasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūt| yasya grahaṇe bahūnāṃ saṃjñā bhavatyato vyāpternyāyādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāta| nanu ca vakārastatra nāstyeva, tat kimucyate vīśvarānmā bhūditi ? evaṃ manyate-- yadā sūtrāṇi saṃhitayā paṭhyante-- `śaki ṇamulkamulāvīśvaretosunkasunau' (3.4.12,13) iti tadā lauśabdasya grahaṇe na prayojakam| yadyapi parasyeśvaraśabdasya grahaṇe tannibandhanā vyāptirasti, tathāpyanantarasyaiveśvaraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, na parasya; katham ? jñāpakāt; yadayaṃ `kanmejantaḥ' (1.1.39) iti kṛto māntasyaijantasyāvyayasaṃjñā śāsti tajjñāpayati-- anantarasyeśvaraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ netarasyeti; anyathā hi
