ṇamulādīnāṃ nipātatvādevāvyavyasaṃjñā siddheti `kṛnmejantaḥ' (1.1.39) iti vacanamarthakaṃ syāt, naitadasti jñāpakam; yasmāt `īśvare tosunkasunau' (3.4.13) ityasmāt paro'pi kṛdejanto māntaścāsti| `kṛtyārthe tavaikenkenyatvanaḥ' (3.4.14) `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamula ca' (3.4.22) ityevamādiḥ| tatkathaṃ `kṛnmejantaḥ' (1.1.39) ityeta jñāpakaṃ syāt ? evaṃ tarhi yadayamavyayībhāvasya `avyayībhāvaśca' (1.1.41) ityavyayasaṃjñāṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-- anantaro ya īśvaraśabdastasya grahaṇamiti| anyathā hi `avyayībhāvaśca' (1.1.41) ityedapārthakaṃ syāt; nipātatvādevāvyayībhāvasyāvyayasaṃjñāyāḥ siddhatvāt| asyāpi jñāpakatāmapākarttumahā-- `samāseṣvavyayībhāvaḥ' iti| sarveṣāṃ samāsānāṃ nipātatvādavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ `avyayībhāvaśca' (1.1.39) ityetadvacanaṃ niyamārthaṃ syāt-- samāseṣu tatpuruṣādiṣu madhye'vyayībhāva evāvyayasaṃjño bhavati, nānya iti| evaṃ tarhi laukikanyāyādanantarasyaiveśvaraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| loke hi `odakāntaṃ priyaṃ prothamanuvrajet' iti ya evānantara udakāntastameva gatvā tata eva bāndhavā nivarttante, na vyavahitāt| tasmādihāpyanenaiva nyāyenānantarādevaśvaraśabdānnipātasaṃjñā nivartiṣyata ityata āha-- `laukikaṃ cātivarttatate' iti| laukikamapi nyāyaṃ loko'tikramya varttate, yasmāt dvitīyamapyadakāntaṃ snehāt kathāprasaṅgadvā gatvā nivarttante bāndhavāḥ| tadevaṃ rephādhika īśvaraśabda uccāryate| tena vīśvarānmā bhūditi sthitametat|| 57. cādayo'sattve|(1.4.57) `asattve' iti| paryudāso'yaṃ vā syāt, prasajyapratiṣedho vā ? tatra yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ syāt, tadā sattvādanyatra varttamānāścādayo nipātasaṃjñakā bhavantīteyaṣaḥ sūtrārthaḥ syāt| tataśca paśuśabdasya cādiparipaṭhitasya jātivyavacchinne dravye varttamānasya nipātasaṃjñā syāt| yo hi jātiviśiṣṭe dravye varttate, sa jātidravyasamudāyātmakamarthamāha| yaścaivaṃvidho'rthaḥ sa dravyāt kevalādanyo bhavati| nipātasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ paśuriti savibhaktikasya śravaṇaṃ na syāt| prasajyapratiṣedhe tveṣa doṣo na bhavati| tatra hi yatra dravyagandho'pyasti tatra sarvatra pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam| asti ceha dravyagandhaḥ| paśutvajātyāśritasya dravyasyāpi paśuśabdenābhidhānāt| tasmāt prasajyapratiṣedha evāyaṃ yukta ityālocyāha-- `prasajyapratiṣedho'yam' iti| kva tarhi varttamānaḥ paśuśabdo'sattvavacano bhavati ? yatra vṛttau nipātasaṃjñāṃ labhate dṛśyarthe-- yathā, lodhaṃ nayanti paśu manyamānā iti| atra dṛśyarthena paśuśabdena mananaṃ viviṣyate| darśanametanmananam, samyagjñānamityarthaḥ| sattvaśabdo'yamiha sattāyāṃ varttata iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākarttumāha-- `sattvamiti ca dravyamucyate' iti| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe| dravyameva na sattetyarthaḥ| yadi hyatra sattavaśabdena sattocyate, pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt ? na hi cādiṣu madhye śabdaḥ sattāvācī kaścidasti| tasmādadravyamevocyate| idaṃ tarhi sarvanāmapratyavamarśayogyo yo'rthastad‌dravyamiti| tathā coktam-- vastūpalakṣamaṃ yatra sarvanāma prayujyate| dravyamityacyate so'rtho bhedyatvena vivakṣitaḥ|| iti| bhedyatvena viśeṣyatvenetyarthaḥ| ata evāvasīdati yatra guṇo viśeṣaṇabhāveneti satttvaṃ tad‌dravyamucyate| `caṇ' iti paṭhyate| tasya ṇakāro viśeṣārthaḥ `nipātairyadyadihantakuvinnekacceṇkaccidyatrayuktam' (8.1.30) iti, sa tu cecchabdasyārthe varttate| yatra' iti paṭhyate| tasya `taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38) ityavyayasaṃjñā siddhaiva| `nipātairyadyadihantaḥ' (8.1.30) iti viśeṇaṇārtha nipāta saṃbodhyate| asati nipātatve `traiṅa pālane' (dhā.pā.965) yaṃ trāyata iti yatra ityasya `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) iti kapratyayasya grahaṇaṃ syāt| `nañ‍' iti paṭhyate; naño ñakāraḥ `nalopoḥ nañaḥ' (6.3.73) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| `nalopo nañ' ityucyamāne pāmanaputra ityatrāpi syāt, yadi tatra `aluguttarapade' (6.3.1) ityuttarapadagrahaṇa pūrpapadaṃ naśabdena viśeṣyate-- nāntasya pūrvapadasyeti| atha tu pūrvapadena viśeṣyate-- (see in other text)page no.206) uttarasaṃjñīttarasūtre kṛtā saṃjñopasargasaṃjñā| tasyā viśeṣaṇaṃ vyavacchedaḥ prādibhyo'nyasmādvayāvartanamuttarasaṃjñā mā bhūt' iti| ekayoge hi sati yathā prādīnāmupasargasaṃjñā bhavati tathā cādīnāmapi syāt| ataḥ prādīnāmevopasargasaṃjñā yathā syāccādīnāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pṛthagyogaḥ kriyate| `parāḥ senāḥ' iti| senāyāḥ dravyatvāt tatra varttamānasya parāśabdasyeha grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| parā utkṛṣṭāḥ paradeśasthitā vā| yatra tvekavacanaṃ paṭhyate-- parā seneti, tatra rūpodāharaṇaṃ veditavyam| dvivacanabahuvacanayostu nipātatvādavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ vibhakterluksyāt|| 59.upasargāḥ kriyāyoge| (1.4.59) `praṇayati' iti| praśabdasyopasargatvāt `upasargādasamāse'pi ṇopadeśasya' (8.4.14) iti ṇatvam| `pranāyako deśaḥ' iti| atranayanakriyayā praśabdasya yogo nāstītyupasargasaṃjñā na bhavati. nanu cātrāpi gamikriyayā yogo'styeveti syādeva tasyopasargasaṃjñā, netadasti; kriyāyogagrahaṇaṃ hyevamanarthakaṃ syāt| katham ? prādīnāṃ kriyāyogāvyabhicārāt; tasmāt kriyāyogagrahaṇasāmarthyādyaṃ prati kriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatuyapasargasaṃjñakā bhavanti, nānyaṃ prati| na ceha nayanakriyayā yuktaḥ praśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? gamikriyayeti nayatiṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñako na bhavati| `marucchabdasyopasaṃkhyānam' iti| tatvavidhāviti| śeṣaḥ; anyathā hi `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) `upasargāścābhivarjam' (phi.sū.4.81) ityādyudāttatvamapi syāt| antodāttaśceṣyate marucchabdaḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ; marucchabdasyopasargasaṃjñāyāḥ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `upasargāḥ' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate| atra ca `prādayaḥ' iti nābhisambadhyate| tena marucchabdasya tatvavidhāvupasargasaṃjñā bhavatīti| ata eva yogavibhāgāt śracchabdasyāṅavidhāvantaḥ śabdasyāṅgividhiṇatveṣūpasargasaṃjñā bhavatīti veditavyam| yogavibhāgasyedaṃ liṅgam `prajñāśraddhārcāvṛttibhyo ṇaḥ' (5.2.101), `tiro'ntardhau' (1.4.71) iti ca nirdeśaḥ| tataḥ `kriyāyoge' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ| atra ca `prādayaḥ' iti sambadhyate| kimarthamidam ? pūrveṇaiva siddhamiti pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvājñāpanārtham, tena nātiprasaṅagaḥ| prādīnāmakriyāyoga upasargasaṃjñā mā bhūdityevamarthañca| `maruttaḥ' iti| `aca upasargāttaḥ' (7.4.47) iti ktapratyaye kṛte dvitakāranirdeśāddavāteḥ sarvādeśaḥ| nanu casatyāmupasargasaṃjñayāṃ karucchabdasyānajantatvāt tatvena na bhavitavyamityata āha-- `saṃjñāvidhāna sāmarthyāt' ityādi| yathā hyupasaraja ityatra ḍitkaraṇasāmarthyādabhasyāpi ṭilopo bhavati, tathehāpyanajantādapi tatvaṃ bhaviṣyati; anyathā hīdaṃ vacanamapārthakaṃ syāt| marucchabdasyopasargasaṃjñāyā anyakāryābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| `śracchabdasyopasaṃkhyānam' iti| atrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya sa evārthaḥ| pratipādanamapi tadeva| nanu ca bhidādipāṭhādeva hi śraddheti siddham;tatkathaṃ tatsiddhaye śracchabdasyopasargasaṃjñā kriyate ? evaṃ manyate- anārṣastatra pāṭha iti|| 60. gatiśca| (1.4.60) `prakṛtya' iti| gatisaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap' (7.1.37) iti lyap| `prakṛtam' iti| `kte ca' (6.2.45) ityanuvartamāne `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti prakṛtisvareṇādyadāttaḥ praśabdaḥ| `yatprakaroti' iti| praśabdādanantarasya `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighāte prāpte `nipātairyadyadi' (8.1.30) ityādinā pratiṣedhe tipaḥ pittvādanuvadāttatvam| `satiśiṣṭasvarasya balīyastvamanyatra vikaraṇasvarebhyaḥ' (vā; 9;6.1.158) iti vikaraṇasvarasya pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati| karotereva tu bhavati-- `dhātoḥ' (6.1.162) iti| śeṣamanudāttaṃ bhavati| praśabdasya `upasargāścābhivarjam' (phi.sū.4.81) ityādyudāttatve prāpte `gatirgatau' (8.1.70) iti nighāte'nuvartamāne `tiṅi codāttavati' (8.1.71) iti karotiśabde tiṅanta udāttavati parato'nudāttatvaṃ bhavati| tatra hi `pūjanāt pūjitamanudāttaṃ kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ' (8.1.67) ityato'nudāttamiti vartate| etacca prayojanatrayamuttaratra gatisaṃjñāyā veditavyam| atha kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ, na gatigrahaṇaṃ pūrvayogaga eva kriyate ? ityata āha- `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| `uttaratra ' ityādinā yogavibhāgasyottarārthatāṃ darśayati| yadyuttaratrāpyupasargasaṃjñā syāt, tadā kiṃ syādityata āha-- `ūrīsyādityatra ' ityādi| `cakāraḥ saṃjñāsamāveśārthaḥ' iti| asati cakāra ekasaṃjñādhikārādekatra saṃjñādvayasya vidhānāt paryāyaḥ syāt, na samāveśaḥ| `praṇītam' ityādinā saṃjñāsamāveśasya phalaṃ darśayati| `gatiranantara iti svaraḥ' iti| udāharaṇadvaye'pi `upasargāditi ṇatvaṣatve bhavataḥ' iti| `praṇītam' iti| `upasargādasamāse'pi ṇopadeśasya' (8.4.44) iti ṇatvam| `abhiṣiktam' iti| `upasargātsunoti' (8.3.65) ityādinā ṣatvam| `kārikā' ityādi| dhātvarthanirdeśa etadupasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam| yo'nyaḥ karttari kārikāśabdo ṇvulantaḥ, tasya kārikāṃ kṛtvetyevaṃ bhavati| `upākhyāna' śabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ. tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- uttarasūtre cakārsayānuktasamuccayārthatvāt kārikāśabdasya gatisaṃjñā bhavatīti| `punaścanasau' ityādi| punaścanaḥ śabdau chandasi viṣaye gatisaṃjñakau ca bhavata ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tūttarasūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatāmāśritya karttavyam| `punarustyūtam' iti| `ṣivu tantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1108), niṣṭhā, uditvāt `idito vā' (7.2.56) iti vibhāṣeṭtvāt `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ; `cchavoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) iti vakārasyoṭh, yaṇādeśaḥ| `canohitam' iti| `dadhāterhiḥ' (7.4.42) iti nahirādeśaḥ, `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti prakṛtisvare ṇādyudāttatvam| canaḥ śabdo hi `nipātā ādyudāttā bhavanti' (phi.sū.4.80) ityādyudāttaḥ|| 61.ūryādicviḍācaśca| (1.4.61) `cvyantā ḍājantāśca' iti| nanu ca padasaṃjñāyāmantagrahaṇena jñāpitam--`anyatra saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti' (pu.pa.vṛ.81) iti; ataścviḍācoreva gatisaṃjñayā bhavitavyam, tat kimucyate-- cvyantā ḍājantāśceti ? evaṃ manyate-- `kriyāyoge' (1.4.59) iti varttate, na ca pratyayamātrasya kriyāyogaḥ sambhavati| tasmāt kriyāyogānuvṛttisamārthyāt tadantasyaiva saṃjñā vijñāyata iti bhavatyeva tadantasya saṃjñā| sā tu viśeṣānupādānāddhātumātreṇa yoge prāpnotītyata āha-- `cviḍācoḥ' ityādi| abhūtatadbhāve kṛbhvastiyoge (5.4.50) cvirvihitaḥ| `avyaktānukaraṇāt' (5.4.57) ityādāvapi sūtre kṛbhvastiyogasyānuvṛtterḍājipi tatraiva vihitaḥ| tena cviḍācostāvaddhātvantareṇa yogāsambhavāt kṛbhvastiyoge gatisaṃjñāvidhānam| atastatsāhacaryādūryādīnāmapi taireva yoge vidhīyate| ūryādibhyaścvyarthasyāpratīterna pratipādayitumāha-- `urī, urarī' ityādi| śrauṣañaḍādīnāṃ svadhāparyantānāṃ cādiṣu pāṭhādakriyāyoge'pi nipātasaṃjñā bhavati| āvis‌śabdaḥ sākṣātprabhṛtiṣu paṭhyate| tena tasya `vibhāṣā kṛñi' (1.4.72) iti karotiyoge vibhāṣā gatisaṃjñā| `śuklīkṛtya' iti| `asya cvau' (7.4.32) itīttvam| `paṭapaṭākṛtya' iti| `vā kyaṣaḥ' (1.3.90) ityatra paṭapaṭāśabdo vyutpāditaḥ|| 62. anukaraṇaṃ cānitiparam‌| (1.4.62) `anitiparam' iti| atretiparaśabda ite para iti pañcamīti yogavibhāgāt tatpuruṣo vā syāt ? itiḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhirvā ? tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadetikhāṭ‌kṛtyetyatra pratiṣedhaḥ syāt; iha tu na syāt-- khaḍiti kṛtvā āgata ita, aniṣṭañcaitat; dvitīye tu pakṣa eṣa doṣo na bhavati, atastamevāśrityāha-- `itiḥ paro yasmāt' iti| `niraṣṭhīvat' iti| `ṣṭhivu nirasane' (dhā.pā.560) `subdhātuṣṭhivuṣvaṣkatīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' (vā.671) iti pratiṣedhāt `dhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ' (6.1.64) iti satvaṃ na bhavati| `ṣṭhivuklamucamāṃ śiti' (7.3.75) iti dīrghatvam|| 63. ādarānādarayoḥ sadasatī| (1.4.63) `{prītyatiśayaḥ - ādaraḥ-- kāśikā}prītisambhrama ādaraḥ' iti| prītyā sambhramaḥ prītisambhramaḥ, prītipūrvikā pratyutthānāsanādidānakriyetyarthaḥ| `paribhavaudāsīnyam' iti| paribhavaḥ - avajñā| tiraskāraḥ - audāsīnyam| karttavyam - pratyutthānāsanādidānaṃ pratyupekṣā| paribhaveṇaudāsīnyaṃ paribhavaudāsīnyamiti, `tṛtīyā' iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ| atha vā-- paribhavaścaudāsīnyañca paribhavaudāsīnyam| atha kimarthamanādaragrahaṇamasadgrahaṇañca kriyate ? nādare sadityevocyate ? atha kathamidānīmanāde'sacchabdasyāvyayasaṃjñā syāt ? kathañca samāsādi kāryam ? tadantavidhināsacchabdasyāpi nipātasaṃjñāyāṃ gatisaṃjñāyāñca satyāṃ sacchabdasya nipātasyāvyayasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā'vyayasaṃjñāyāṃ tadantavidherupasaṃkhyānādasacchabdasyāpyavyayasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) ityatra ca subantasya prakṛtatvādgatyantasya subantasya samāso vidhīyamāno'sacchabdasyāpi bhaviṣyati| `gatirantaraḥ' (6.2.49) ityatrāpi pūrvapadamityanuvarttate| `gatirgatau' (8.1.70) ityatrāpi padasyeti| tena gatyantasya pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvaro vidhīyamānastatā yathoktaṃ kāryam, anādarāvagatistu kathaṃ syāt ? asatyanādaragrahaṇe na sadasaditi nañā''daraptiṣedhāt| ādaraścet pratiṣiddhaḥ kimanyadanādarāt syāt ? naitadyuktamucyate; nañsamāso hi tatpuruṣaḥ sadṛśameva kāryaṃ pratipādayati, yathā-- abrāhmaṇamānayeti| tatreha yadyanādaragrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā satsadṛśaṃ yat tadasad yatrādaraprasaṅgastatraiva syāt-- gurumasatkṛtya gataḥ| yatra tvaprasakta evādarastatra na syāt-- bhṛtyamasatkṛtya gataḥ| anādaragrahaṇe tu sati bahuvrīhirvijñāyate-- avidyamāna ādaro yasminnityanādara ito| bahuvrīhiścātyantābhāve prasaktyabāve ca bhavatīti sarvatra saṃjñā sidhyati| tasmādanādaragrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| tasmiṃśca kriyamāṇe satyasadṛgrahaṇamapi karttavyameva| anyathā hi kimanādaragrahaṇena viśiṣyeta-- ysayānādare varttamānasya gatisaṃjñā vidhīyate ! na hi sacchabdasyānādare vṛttiḥ sambhavati| yadyapi tasya na sambhavati tadantasyāsacchabdasya sambhavatīti cet, satyam; sambhavati, na tu tasya gatisaṃjñā labhyate, tadantavidherabhāvāt| prakṛte na hi tadantavidhirbhavati, na ceha kiñcit prakṛtamasti ; tasmādasacchabdārthamanādaragrahaṇam| yadi tu yathā `goṣpadaṃ sevitāsevitapramāṇeṣu' ityatrāsevite goṣpadaśabdo na sambhavatītyagoṣpadaśabdārthamasevitagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, tathehāpi sacchabdo'nādare na sambhavatītyaschabdārthamanādaragrahaṇaṃ vijñāyeta; tadā śakyamasacchabdasya grahaṇamakarttum| asadgrahaṇantu kriyate tadā vispaṣṭārtham| satkṛtvā'satkṛtyeti| śobhanāśobhanārthāviha sadasacchabdau| vidyamānāvidyamānārthau vā|| 64.bhūṣaṇe'lam|(1.4.64) `alaṃ kṛtvā' iti| paryāptāvihālaṃśabdo varttate| 65.antaraparigrahe|(1.4.65) antaḥśabdo'yaṃ madhye'dhikaraṇabhūte vartate; parigrahe ca| tatra parigrahapratiṣedhādiratra saṃjñā vidhīyate|yastvasya svarādiṣu pāṭhaḥ, sa parigrahe'pyavyayasaṃjñārthaḥ| `antarhasya' iti| madhye hatvetyarthaḥ| `vā lyapi' (6.4.38), ityanunāsikalopaḥ| vaktavya iti vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvameva kṛtam| `antardhā' iti| ātaścopasarga' (3.3.106) ityaṅa| `antarddhiḥ' iti| `upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' (3.3.92) iti kipratyayaḥ| `antarṇayati' iti| `upasargādasamāse'pi' (8.4.14) iti ṇatvam|| 66. kaṇemanasī śraddhāpratīghāte|(1.4.66) kaṇeśabdaḥ saptamyantapratirūpako nipātaḥ| na cehābhilāṣātiśaye varttamāno gṛhyate| tasya hi śraddhāpratīghāta ityupādhiḥ sambhavati| manaḥśabdo'pi tatsāhacaryādabhilāṣavṛttireva vijñāyate| `kaṇe' hatvā, mano hatvā' iti| atra kaṇeśabdaḥ sūkṣme taṇ‍ḍulāvayave varttate'dhikaraṇabhūte, manaśśabdaścetasi|| 67. puro'vyayam|(1.4.67) `puraskṛtya' iti| pūrvasmāddeśāgata ityasminnarthe `pūrvādharāvarāṇāmasi puradhavaścaiṣām' (5.3.39) ityasipratyayaḥ pūrvaśabdasya ca purādeśaḥ| `taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38) ityavyayasaṃjñā visarjanīyasthānikasya sakārasyopacāra ityeṣā saṃjñā pūrvācāryapraṇītā| `namaspurasorgatyoḥ' (8.3.40) iti sakāraḥ| `pūḥ purau, puraḥ kṛtvā gataḥ' iti| puraḥ kṛtvetīdaṃ pratyudāharaṇ| pūḥ parāvityetayostūpanyasastatsāhacaryeṇa puraḥśabdasyānavyayatvapradarśanārthaḥ| `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1489), `bhrājabhrāsa' (3.2.177) ityādinā| kvip| `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuktam, raparatvañca| gatisaṃjñāyā abhāvādiha samāsādi kāryaṃ na bhavati| `namaspurasorgatyoḥ' (8.3.40) iti visarjanīyasya sakāro'pi na bhavati| nanu ca yadyatra gatisaṃjñā syāt gatisamāse kṛte supo nivṛttyā bhavitavyam, tadā pura iti rūpaṃ na syāt; asati tasmin saṃjñā'pi nivarttate, naitadasti; yadyapi vibhaktau nivṛttāyāṃ pura iti rūpaṃ na syāt, naivaṃ saṃjñā nivarttate; ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt (vyā.pa.16)|| 68. astaṃ ca|(1.4.68) `astaṃśabdo makārānto'vyayam' iti| avyayamityata eva viśeṣaṇopādānasasāmarthyādadavyayatvaṃ vijñeyam| cādeśakṛtigaṇatvādvā| `astaṃ kṛtvā kāṇḍaṃ gataḥ' iti| `asu kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209), niṣṭhā, pūrvavadiṭpratiṣedhaḥ| cakāraḥ `avyayam' (1.4.ka67) ityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| yadyevam,cānukṛṣṭatvāduttaratra tasyānuvṛttirna syāt ? uttaratrāpi cakārastadanukarṣaṇārtho'nuvartiṣyata ityadoṣaḥ|| 69. accha gatyarthavadeṣu|(1.4.69) `acchaśabdo'vyayamabhiśabdasyārthe'iti| abhirābhimukhye| `acchodya' iti| yajāditvādvacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam| acchamityakaluṣamityarthaḥ|| 70. ado'nupadeśe|(1.4.70) upadeśaḥ - parasyārthakathanam| tacca parasya pratyāyanārtha bhavatītyāha-- `upadeśaḥ parārthaḥ' iti| `adaḥ kṛtvā' iti| etatkṛtvetyarthaḥ|| 71. tiro'ntarddhau|(1.4.71) `tiro bhūtvā sthitaḥ' iti| anṛjurbhūtvā, pārśvato bhūtvetyarthaḥ|| 72. vibhāṣā kṛñi|(1.4.72) `tiraskṛtya'iti| `tariso'nayatarasyām' (8.3.42) iti visarjanīyasya sattvam| 73. upāje'nvāje| (1.4.72) 74.sākṣātprabhṛtīni ca|(1.4.74) `sākṣātprabhṛtiṣu cvyarthavacanam' iti| cvyartha ucyate kathyate yena tacvyarthavacam - cvyarthavyākhyānam| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati-- sākṣātprabhṛtīnāṃ cvyartho yena pratipādyate asmin saṃjñāvidhau tacvyarthavacanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| kimartham ? asākṣādbhūtaṃ yadā sākṣāt kriyate tadā gatisaṃjñā yathā syāt| yadā tvasākṣādbhāvo na kriyate, kintu sākṣādbhūtsaya pratyakṣabhāvamupagatasyaiva sato yo'nyo viśeṣaḥ kaścit kriyate, tadā mā bhūditi| evaṃ mithyāprabhṛtīnām| amithyābhūtānāṃ mithyābhūtānāṃ yadā kriyate, tadā yathā syāt; anyathā mā bhūt| tadevaṃ vyākhyānam-- `ūryādicviḍācaśca' (1.4.61) ityatra cvigrahaṇam `accha gatyarthavadeṣu' (1.4.69) ityataścārthagrahaṇamiha maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttate| tena cvyarthe varttamānānāṃ sākṣātprabhṛtīnāṃ gatisaṃjñā vidhīyata iti| vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādvā cvyartha eva varttamānānāṃ teṣāṃ saṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti| cvyarthatā cobhayathā sambhavati-- cvyantānām, acvyantānāñca| tatra yadā cvyantatā bhavati tadā `ūryādicviḍācaśca' (1.4.61) iti nityaṃ saṃjñā bhavati, anyathā tvanena gatisaṃjñā vibhāṣā bhavati; vyavasthitavibhāṣayā cāsya sūtrasya cvyarthaṣveva pravṛtteḥ| makārāntatvanipātanam| agnau, vaśeprabhṛtayo vibhaktipratirūpakanipātā draṣṭavyaḥ| prādurāviḥ śabdāvūryādiṣu urasimanasiśabdau vibhaktipratirūpakau nipātau| `urasikṛtya'iti| abhyupagamyetyarthaḥ| `manasikṛtya' iti| niścityetyarthaḥ|| 76. madhye pade nivacane ca|(1.4.76) `madhye pade' iti| saptamyantapratirūpakau| `nivacane' iti| arthābhāve'vyayībhāvaḥ; nitṝṇaṃ nivusamiti yathā| `nivacanekṛtya' iti| uccāraṇasāmarthyāt saptamyāḥ samāse'pyalug bhavati| evamuttaratra|| 77.nityaṃ haste pāṇāvupayamane| (1.4.77) `hastekṛtya, pāṇaukṛtya' iti| saptamyāḥ pūrvavadaluk| `dārakarma' iti| bhāryākaraṇam|| 78. prādhvaṃ bandhane|(1.4.78) `bandhane' iti nimittasaptamīyam| prādhvaṃśabdasyānukūlyavṛttitvāt `bandhane' ityasya viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyata iti sāmarthyāt tadarthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha-- `tadānukūlyam' ityādi| bandhanaṃ heturyasya tattathoktam| `prādhvaṃkṛtya' iti| bandhanena nimittenānukūlyaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| `prādhvaṃ kṛtvā' iti| samarthamadhvagamane śakaṭam, adhvābhimukhaṃ kṛtveti gamyate| `upasargādadhvanaḥ' (5.4.85) ityac samāsāntaḥ| `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭulopaḥ| pragatamadhvānamiti prādisamāsaḥ| lakṣamapratipadoktaparibhāṣayaivātra (vyā.pā.3) prāptau siddhāyāṃ lākṣaṇiko'pi prādhvaṃśabdo yatra bandhanenābhisambadhyate, tatrāpi gatisaṃjñā bhavatīti jñāpanārthaṃ bandhanagrahaṇam| tena yadā bandhanenaiva śakaṭasyādhvani sāmarthyādadhvābhimukhatā vivakṣyate, tadā prādhvaṃkṛtya śakaṭaṃ gatamityetadapi siddhaṃ bhavati|| 79. jīvikopaniṣadāvaupamye|(1.4.79) `{aupamye viṣaye'-- kāśikā.} aupamyaviṣaye' iti| upamīyate'nayetyupamā| `ātaścopasarge' (3.3.106) ityaṅa| tasyā bhāva aupamyam; dhyañ| tatpunaḥ kriyākārakasambandhaḥ| `samāsakṛttaddhiteṣu sambandhābhidhānamanyatra rūḍhyabhinnarūpāvyabhicaritasambandhebhyaḥ'iti vacanāt| viṣayagrahaṇenaupamye iti saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| sambhavati ca jīvikopaniṣadāvupamābhūte pratyaupamyaviṣayabhāvaḥ, tena vinopamāyā abhāvāt| `jīvikākṛtya' ityādi|jīvikāmiva kṛtvā| upaniṣadamiva kṛtvetyarthaḥ| jīvikā - jīvanopāyaḥ| upaniṣat - rahasyaṃ hetuśca| yattatsadṛśaṃ tajjīvikena jīvikā| upaniṣadhivopaniṣaditi jīvikopaniṣadbhyāmupamīyate|| 80. te prāgdhātoḥ|(1.4.80) niyamārthametat| niyamaḥ punaḥ saṃjñānaniyamo vā syāt-- te prādayo yadā dhātoḥ prāka prayujyate tadaiva gatyupasargasaṃjñakāḥ bhavantīti ? prayoganiyamo vā-- te prādayo gatyupasargasaṃjñakāḥ santo dhātoḥ prāk prajñoktavyā iti ? yatra yadi pūrvo niyama āśrīyeta tadā saṃjñāvākyānāmayamekadeśo vijñāyeta-- te prādayo dhātoḥ prāk prayujyamānā gatyupasargasaṃjñakā bhavantīti| tathā ca gatyupasargasaṃjñayoranabhinirvṛttatvāt te gatyupasargasaṃjñā iti pratyavamarśo na yujyate| nipātasaṃjñāyāścābhinirvṛttatvāt ta ityanena nipātā eva pratyavamṛśyeran; tataśca nipātasaṃjñāyā niyamaḥ syāt| itaratra tu niyamenāyaṃ yogo gatyupasargasaṃjñāvākyānāmekadeśabhūto bhavatīti na bhavatyeva doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| saṃjñāniyamasya cāprākprayujyamānānāṃ saṃjñānivṛttiḥ phalaṃ syāt, taccāyuktam; na hyaprākprayujyamānānāṃ satyāmapi saṃjñāyāṃ kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| itarasya tu niyamasyāprākprayogābhāvaḥ phalam, tacca yuktam; na hi gatyupasargasaṃjñakānāmaprākprayoga iṣyate| tasmāt prayoganiyama eva nyāyya iti tamāśrityāha-- `te gatyupasargasaṃjñakāḥ' iti| `tathā ca' ityādi| yādṛśo niyamaḥ kṛtastadanurūpaṃ tatsadṛśamevetyarthaḥ| nanu ca naiva kaścit prapaṭhatīti prayoktavye `paṭhati pra' iti prayuṅakte, tato'niṣṭādarśanādapārthakametat, naitadasti; yadyapi bhāṣāyāṃ dhātoḥ pareṇa prayujyamānāste gatyupasargasaṃjñakā na dṛśyante, chandasi tu dṛśyante| tatra ya eva mandabuddhiḥ pratipattā teṣāṃ chandasi dhātoḥ pare prayogaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathaiva te chandasi viṣaye dhātoḥ pareṇa prayujyante, tathā bhāṣāyamapi prayoktavyā iti manyate, taṃ prati vyutpādanārthatvānnāsti vaiyarthyaprasaṅgaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ tegrahaṇam ? yāvatā prakṛtatvādeva gatyupasargasaṃjñakānāṃ prākprayogeṇa sambandho vijñasyata ityāha-- `tegrahaṇam' ityādi| asati tegrahaṇe gatisaṃjñakānāmanantaratvāt ta eva prākprayogeṇa sambadhyeran| tegrahaṇe tūpasargasaṃjñā api nirdiśyanta iti taṣāmapi sambandha upapadyate| tasmādupasargāṇāmapi prākprayoganiyamo yathā syādityevamartha tegrahaṇam| nanu cayaṃ prati kriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñakā bhavantītyantareṇāpi dhātugrahaṇaṃ dhātoreva prāk prayogo vijñāsyate, na hi dhātoranyatra kriyā'sti, tatkathaṃ dhātorityucyate ? naitadasti ; prakarttṛmicchati pracikīrṣatītyatrāpi dhātośca prāk prayogo yathā syāt| atra sanaḥ sambandhinyaṣaṇakriyayā yuktaḥ praśabda iti sanaṃ gatyupasargasaṃjñā yathā syāt| tataścāsati dhātugrahaṇe tata eva prāk prayujyeta |dhātugrahaṇe tu cikīrṣaterdhātoḥ prākprayujyate, na sanaḥ|| 81. chandasi pare'pi|(1.4.81) 82.vyavahitāśca| (1.4.82) chandasi vyavahitānāṃ prayogavacanāt bhāṣayāṃ vyavahitānāṃ prayogo na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| yadyevam, gativyavadhāne'pi prākprayogo na prāpnoti-- samāharatītyādau naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hi tulyajātīyako vyavadhāyako bhavati| gatyupasargajāterāśrayaṇānnāsti vyavadhānam| `ā mandraiḥ' ityādi| atrāṅo mandrairityādibhiḥ padairvyadhāne'pi yāterdhātoḥ prākprayogaḥ| `āyāhi' iti| etenāṅo yāhītyanena sambandhaṃ darśayati|| 83. karmapravacanīyāḥ| (1.4.83) `karmapravacīyāḥ' iti vakṣyamāṇānāṃ saṃjñināṃ bahutvādbahuvacanena nirdeśaḥ| mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇasyaitatprayojanamanvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta-- karma proktavantaḥ karmapravacīyā iti| bhūte `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti karttaryanīyar| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvacanaḥ| ke ca karma proktavantaḥ ? ye samprati kriyāṃ na tvāhuḥ| tadevamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇadvāreṇa ye kriyāṃ dyotitavantaḥ, na tu proktavantaḥ ? yeta samprati kriyāṃ na tvāhuḥ| tadevamanvarthasaṃjñākaraṇadvāreṇa ye kriyāṃ dyotitavantaḥ, na tu samprati dyotayanti, te karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā bhavantītyuktaṃ bhavati| yadi sampratati na kriyāṃ dyotayanti, kintarhi ? sambandhaviśeṣam| yathā śākalyasya saṃhitāmanuprāvarṣakhadityatra hi niśamanakriyayā saṃhitāpravarṣaṇayoryaḥ sambandha upajanito hetuhetumadbhāvalakṣaṇaḥ, tamanuśabdo dyotayati| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā' (2.3.8) iti dvitīyā bhavati|| 84. anurlakṣaṇe| (1.4.84) `lakṣaṇāśabdo'tra cihne vartate' iti matvā kaściccodayati-- `kimartham' ityādi| itarastu `lakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyānabhāgavīpsāsu' (1.4.90) ityādau sūtre| tatra cihne jñāpake varttamānasya lakṣaṇaśabdasya grahaṇam, iha tu kārake hetau, atastena na sidhyatītyenābhiprāyeṇa taṃ pratyāha-- `hetvarthantu vacanam' ityādi| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe-- hetvamarthameveti| hetuśabdo'tar kārakahetuvacanaḥ, na jñāpakahetuvacanaḥ; anyathā hyaparihāra evāyaṃ syāt| heturartho yasya tattathoktam| hetau varttamānasyānoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthamidaṃ vacanamityarthaḥ| kimarthaṃ punahatau varttamānasya tasyeyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyata ityāha-- `hetau tṛtīyāyām' ityādi| saṃhitā hi varṣaṇasya hetuḥ, anuhud‌dyajñaḥ sekasya, tathā hi-- saṃhitāmanuniśamya śrutvā prāvarṣat| avuḍudyajñañcānuniśamyāsiñcat| tatra yadi hetāvanoreṣā saṃjñā nocyeta śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu raprāvarraṣadityādau `hetau' (2.3.23) iti tṛtīyā syāt| tasmāttāṃ bādhitvā dvitīyaiva yathā syādityevamartha hetāviyaṃ saṃjñā'norvidhīyate|| 85. tṛtīyārthe|(1.4.85) `nadīmanvavasitā' iti| sahārtho'tra tṛtīyārthaḥ| `sahayukte'pradhāne' (2.3.19) iti sahārthayoge tṛtīyāvidhānāt| `anvavasitā' iti| `ṣiñ bandhane' (dhā.pā.1477) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ rūpam|| 86. hīne|(1.4.86) `anuśākaṭāyanaṃ vaiyākaraṇāḥ' iti| śākaṭāyanamapekṣyānye vaiyākaraṇā hīnā iti| apekṣayātra janito yaḥ sambandhastena vyatiricyate śākaṭāyana iti| tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ tadapavādena dvitīyā vidhīyate| ekayaiva vibhaktyobhayastho'pi sambandho dyotita iti| tena sambandhyantaravācino vaiyākaraṇaśabdādaparaḥ sambandhivibhaktirna bhavati|| 87. upo'dhike ca| (1.4.87) adhikadhyārūḍhamucyate| na cānadhikena vinādhikaṃ sambhavati| tenādhike sambandhe'dhyārūḍhakriyājanite saṃjñeyaṃ vijñāyate| cakāraddhīne ca| `upakhāryāṃ droṇaḥ' iti| khāryā droṇo'dhika ityarthaḥ| `yasmādadhikam' (2.3.9) ityādinā saptamī| tayaiva sambandhasyābhihitatvāt droṇaśabdāt `karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā' (2.3.8) iti dvitīyā na bhavati|| 88. apaparī varjane|(1.4.88) `prakṛtena sambandhinā' iti| varṣādinā| `kasyacit' iti| trigarttādeḥ| `apa trigartebhyaḥ' iti| `pañcamyapāṅaparibhiḥ' (2.3.10) iti pañcamī| `pari pari trigartebhyaḥ' iti| `parervarjane' (8.1.5) iti dvirvacanam| `odanaṃ pariṣiñciti' iti| sarvataḥ siñcatītyarthaḥ| `śe mucādīnām' (7.1.59) iti num| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyā abhāvādupasargasaṃjñaiva bhavati| tena `upasargātsunoti' (8.3.65) ityādinā ṣatvaṃ bhavati|| 89. āṅ maryādāvacane|(1.4.89) yatrāṅo maryādāyāmabhividhau ca kāryamicchati tatrobhayorapi grahaṇaṃ karoti, yathā-- `āṅa maryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.1.13) ityādi| iha tu maryādāgrahameva kṛtam, nābhividhigrahaṇam, ato'bhividhāvanayā saṃjñayā na bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha-- `vacanagrahaṇāt' ityādi| vacanagrahaṇe hi sati bahuvrīhirlabhyate| `maryādā' ityetadvacanaṃ yatra sūtre tanmaryādāvacanam| tatrāyamartho bhavati-- yatra maryādāgrahaṇamasta sūtre, tatra ya āṅa sa karmapravacanīyasaṃjño bhavati| tatpunaḥ sūtram-- `āha maryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.1.13) ityetat-- tatra cāṅa maryādābhividhyorvarttamāna upātta ityubhayatrāpi bhavati| kaḥ punarvarjanasya maryādāśca viśeṣaḥ, yena pūrvasūtre varjanamabhidhāyeha maryādāgrahaṇaṃ karoti ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ-- varjane hi tatparityāgenānyatra sāmānyena varṣaṇādinā sambandho gamyate, yathā-- ā trigarttebhyo vṛṣṭo deva iti, atra hi yasyāṃ diśi vyavasthito vaktedaṃ vākyaṃ prayuṅkte tasyāṃ diśi yo deśo yastathānyāsu dikṣu tatra sarvatraiva trigartān‌ varjayitvā vṛṣṭa iti gamyate| maryādāyāṃ tvidaṃ vākyaṃ prayuṅakte-- ā pāṭaliputrād‌vṛṣṭo deva iti, tatsambandhinyāmeva diśi yo vyavasthito deśastasya deśasya varṣaṇena sambandharaḥ pratīyata ityeṣa viśeṣaḥ| `īṣadarthe kriyāyoge mā bhūt' iti| īṣadartha ākaḍāra iti| kriyāyoge samāharatīti| pūrvatra saṃjñāyā abhāvātpañcamī na bhavati| itaratra `gatirgatau' (8.1.70) iti nighāto bhavati| yastu vākyasmaraṇayorākāro varttate, tasyāṅittvādiha ṅakāroccāraṇādeva saṃjñāyā aprasaktiḥ|| 90. lakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyānabhāgavīpsāsu pratiparyanavaḥ|(1.4.90) lakṣaṇaṃ jñāpako hetuścihnamihābhipretam| lakṣyate cihnyate yena tallakṣaṇam| kañcitprakāramāpannamitthambhūtam, tasyākhyānamitthambhūtākhyānam| `bhī prāptau' (dhā.pā.1844) ātmanepadī| tasmāt `ā dhṛṣādvā' (dhā.pā.1805 taḥ paścāt) iti vibhāṣitaṇico yadā curādiṇij nāsti, tadā ktāntasya bhūta iti rūpaṃ bhavati| svīkriyamāṇoṃ'śo bhāgaḥ| yastvasvīkriyamāṇe'śe bhāgaśabdaḥ prayujyate-- priyaṅgorbhāgo nagarasya bhāga iti, sa svīkriyamāṇāṃśasādṛśyāt| padārthān vyāptumicchā vīpsā| ete ca lakṣaṇādayaḥ pratyādīnāṃ na dyotyāḥ| kiṃ tarhi ? viṣayabhūtāḥ, ata evāha-- `viṣayabhūtāyam' iti| etacca `abhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti' (vyā.pa.73) iti liṅgavipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇādibhiḥ sambadhyate| etacca `abhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti' (vyā.pa.73) iti liṅgavipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇādibhiḥ sambadhyate| yadi lakṣamādayaḥ pratyādīnāṃ na dyotyāḥ, tarhi kiṃ te dyotayanti ? sambandhaviśeṣam| `vṛkṣaṃ prati vidyotate vidyut' iti| atra vṛkṣo lakṣaṇam, vidyotamānā vidyullakṣyā; sā hi vṛkṣaṃ prāpya vidyotata iti tayoḥ prāptikriyājanito'tra lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ pratiśabdena dyotyate| `sādhurdevadatto mātaraṃ prati' iti| pratinā devadattasya mātṛviṣayā sādhubhāvāpattirākhyāyate| atrāpi mātaraṃ prāpya sādhubhāvāpattiriti prāptikriyājanita eva mātuḥ sādhubhāvāpatteśca viṣayaviṣayibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ pratinā''khyāyate| `yadatra mām'ityādi| yo bhāgo māmabhibhajate sa dīyatāmityarthaḥ| atrāpi vibhajanakriyājanitaḥ svīkārakriyājanito vā svasvāmibhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ| `mām' iti| asmacchabdasya `tvamāvekavacane' (7.2.97) iti mādeśaḥ| `dvitīyāyāñca' (7.2.87) ittyāttvam| `vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ prati siñcati' iti| atra vīpsā dvirvacanenaiva dyotyate| pratiśabdasya tu sekakriyājanito vṛkṣāyāṃ yaḥ sambandhaḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sa eva dyotyaḥ| vṛkṣādinimittaṃ sādhanam, sekaḥ sādhyaḥ| dvitīyā ceha sakarmakatvāt siceḥ sekena vyāptumiṣṭatamānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ karmatve sati `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityanenaiva siddhā| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayopasarjanasaṃjñayā nivarttitattvāt `upasargāt sunoti' (8.3.65) ityādinā dhatvaṃ na bhavati| `pariṣiñcati' iti| sarvataḥ siñcatītyarthaḥ| athetyādi codyam| varjanetyādi parīhāraḥ| apaśabdasāhacaryādityatartraivopapattiḥ| tatra hi karmapravacanīyādhikārādvarjanārthasyāpaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ varjana eva| tasya `apaparī varjane' (1.4.88) iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā| tasmāttena sāhacaryādvarjanārthasya parorgrahaṇam| atastenāpi yoge varjana eva viṣaya iyaṃ pañcamī vidhīyate, na lakṣaṇādiṣu|| 91. abhirabhāge|(1.4.91) `yadatra māmābhiṣyāt' iti| `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyā abhāvadupasargatvamastyeva| tena `upasargaprādurbhyāmastiryacparaḥ' (8.3.87) iti ṣatvam| `mām' iti| yadyapyastirakarmakastathāpyakarmakā api dhātavaḥ sopasargāḥ sakarmakā bhavantīti karmaṇi dvitīyā (2.3.2) nanu cābhiśabdo bhāgasambandhasya dyotaka iti tenāsteḥ sambandho nāsti; tatkathaṃ sakarmakatā ? naitadasti; asti sambandhadvāreṇa hyabhiśabdo bhāgasambandhaṃ dyotayati, anyathā hi yadi tasyāstinā yogo na syāt tadopasargasaṃjñāpi na syāt| tataścopasargasaṃjñānibandhanamabhiṣyāditi ṣatvamapi na syāt|| 92. pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ|(1.4.92) `abhimanyurarjunataḥ prati' iti| arjano mukhyaḥ| tatsadṛśo'bhimanyuḥ| so'rjumanukarotītyatrānukaraṇakriyājanitaḥ sambandhaviśeṣo'nukāryānukaraṇabhāvaḥ pratinā dyotyate| `pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt' (2.3.11) iti pañcamī| `pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ' (5.4.44)| `māṣānasmai tilebhyaḥ' iti| tilānāṃ pūrvadattānāṃ māṇāṇāṃ pratidānamiha niryātanam| tilān gṛhītvā māṣān dadātītyarthaḥ| dānagrahaṇakriyājanito'tra sambandha uttamarṇādhamarṇabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ|| 93. adhiparī anarthakau|(1.4.93) `anarthāntaravācinau' iti| etenānarthāntaravācitvādanarthakādavityuktam, na tvarthābhāvāditi darśayati| yadi hyavidyamānārthatvādanarthakau syātām, nirarthakamidaṃ sūtraṃ syāt| tathā hi-- karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā gatyupasargasaṃjñābādhanārthā'nena vidhīyate| na cānarthakayoradhiparyorgatyupasargasaṃjñāprāptirasti| yaṃ prati kriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñā vidhānāt| anarthakayośca kriyāyogāsambhavāt| `kuto'dhyāgasacchati' ityādi| kuta ityāpādāne pañcamī| karmapravacīyeti (2.3.8) dvitīyā na bhavati; `upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī'(cāṃ.pa.69) iti vacanāt| sūtrārambhasya tu prayojanamākhyātameva| kuta iti, kiṃśabdāt `pañcamyāstasil' (5.3.7) iti tasil, `ku tihoḥ' (7.2.104) iti kubhāvaḥ| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayā gatyupasargasaṃjñorvādhitatvāt `gatirgatau' (8.1.70) iti nighāto na bhavati| nanu cāgacchatītyukta āgamanaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ pratīyate, adhyāgacchati, paryāgacchatīti-- adhipariyoge tvāgamanasyoparibhāvaḥ sarvatobhāvaścāvagamyata ityaparo viśeṣaḥ, tatkathamanarthāntaravācitvamanayoḥ ? naitadasti; yadā tayorapyarthayoḥ prakaraṇādeḥ kutaścidavagatayoradhiparī prayujyete tadā tayoranarthāntaravācitvaṃ veditavyam| kathaṃ punaravagatārthayoḥ ? naitadasti; yadā tayorapyarthayoḥ prayogaḥ, `uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ' (vyā.pa.60) iti vacanāt ? satyam, avagatārthasyāpi prayogo dṛśyate, yathā-- `brāhmaṇau dvau' iti| lokasya prayoge gurulāghavaṃ pratyanādarāt|| 94.suḥ pujāyām|(1.4.94) `susiktaṃ bhavatā' iti| bhavacchabdāt karttari tṛtīyā| dvitīyā tu pūrvavadeva na bhavati| `dhātvarthaḥ stūyate' iti| śobhanodbhāvanaṃ stutiḥ, saiva tasya pujā| `upasargāśrayaṃ ṣatvaṃ na bhavati' iti| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayopasargasaṃjñāyā bādhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `suṣiktaṃ kiṃ tavātra' iti| kṣepo'yam,na pūjā|| 95. atiratirakramaṇe ca|(1.4.95) `atistutameva bhavatā' iti| niṣpanne'pi phale stutiḥ pravṛtterthaḥ| `śobhanaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ' iti| pūjāmāviṣkaroti|| 96. apiḥ padārthasambhāvanānvavasargagarhāsamuccayeṣu|(1.4.96) `padārthe' iti| anyasya padasyārtho lakṣyate| na svārthaḥ, nāpi svasambandhinaḥ; padasyārthaḥ padārthaḥ. svapadārthagrahaṇaṃ, svasambandhipadārthagrahaṇaṃ vā padārthagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| apiśabdasya hi yo'rthaḥ yaścāpiśabdasambandhinaḥ syādityādeḥ padasya , sa padārtha eveti kiṃ padārthagrahaṇena ? tasmāt padārthagrahaṇasāmarthyādviśiṣṭapadasyārtho vijñāyata ityāha-- `padāntarasya' ityādi| `sarpiṣo'pi syāt' iti| karmapravacanīyasaṃjñayopasargasaṃjñāyā nivartitatvāt `upasargaprādurbhyāmastiryacparaḥ' (8.3.ka87) iti ṣatvaṃ na bhavati| atha sarpiḥśabdād‌dvitīyā kathaṃ na bhavati ? apiśabdena tasya yogāsambhavāt| sarpiṣo hi yā mātrā sā'piśabdena yuktā, na sarpiḥ| mātrāśabdāt tarhi kasmānna bhavati ? tasya prayogābhāvāt| yadā tu prayujyate, tadā karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaiva nāsti; aprayujyamānasya padāntarasyārthe tadvidhānāt| `adhikārthavacanena' iti| adhikartho mūlakasahasrasekādiḥ, tasya vacanena sekādāvarthe kriyāyāṃ yacchakterapratighātasyāviṣkaraṇam - prakāśanaṃ tatsambhāvanam| `api siñcenmūlakasahasram| api stuyādrājānam' iti| tasya seke stutau ca sāmarthyaṃ na vihanyata ityarthaḥ| `sambhāvane'lamiti cet siddhāpyoge' (3.3.154) iti liṅa| `kāmacārābhyanujñānam' iti| kamacāraḥ - icchayā pravṛttiḥ, tasyābhaayanujñānaṃ kāmacārābhyanujñānam| `api siñca, api stuhi' iti| siñca vā stuhi vā yatheṣṭamabhyanujñāto'sītyarthaḥ| `dhigjālmaṃ devadattam' iti| ubhayasarvatasoḥ kāryā dhiguparyādiṣu triṣu| dvitīyāmreḍitānteṣu tato'nyatrāpi dṛśyate||(vā.118) ityupasaṃkhyānād‌dvitīyā| `api siñcetpalāṇḍum' iti| `arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' (3.3.69) iti liṅa| palāṇ‍ḍumiti karmaṇi dvitīyā (2.3.2)| `api siñca, api stuhi ' iti| ekasmin karttari stutisekakriyayoścanīyamānatā| atra samuccayaḥ| siñca ca stuhi ceti prasiddhasamuccayārthasya caśabdasya prayogeṇa tameva samuccayamudāharaṇe vyaktīkaroti|| 97.adhirīśvare|(1.4.97) `tadayaṃ svasvāmisambandhe' iti| parilapālanādikriyājanito'tra sambandhaḥ| `tatra' ityādi| sarvatra hi sambandhe kiñcidanūdyate, kiñcidākhyāyate| yatprasiddhaṃ tadanūdyate, yadaprasiddhaṃ tadākhyāyate - vidhīyate; jñāpyate; yathā-- yaḥ kuṇ‍ḍalī sa devadatta iti| kuṇḍalitvānuvādena devadattanuvādena devadattatvaṃ vidhīyate| yacca vidhīyate tatpradhānam, itaradapradhānaṃ viśeṣamam| tatra yadā svamaprasiddhatvādvidhīyate tadā svāmī pradhānatvādvayatirekamāpadyata iti tata iva karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyuktatvādvyatirekanibandhanavibhakto ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ tadapavādaḥ `yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī' (2.3.9) iti saptamī bhavati| tayaiva sambandhasya dyotitatvāt svāt prathamaiva bhavati, na saptamī| yadā tu svāmyaprasiddhatvāt vidhīyate, tadā viparyayo veditavyaḥ|| 98. vibhāṣā kṛñi| (1.4.98) adhirīśvara iti varttate| tena prāpte vibhāṣeyam| adhipūrvaḥ karotirviniyoge vartate| viniyuktasyaivaśvaryaṃ sampadyate| `yadatra māmadhikariṣyati' iti| māmiti karmaṇi dvitīyā| adhikariṣyatīti; atra `nipātairyadyadi' (8.1.30) ityādinā nighāte pratiṣiddhe'sya prakṛtisvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 99. laḥ parasmaipadam| (1.4.99) la iti prathamā vā syāt ? ṣaṣṭhī vā ? tatra yadi prathamā syāllakārasyaiva parasmaipadasaṃjñā syāt, na tadādeśānāṃ tibādīnām| kāmam, teṣamamapi sthānivadbhāvena syāt| `taṅānāvātmanepadam' (1.4.100)ityatra tu `laḥ' ityanena taṅānayoḥ sambandho nopapadyeta, na hi taṅānau lau bhavataḥ| atra taṅānabhāvo lakāra eva taṅānāvityevamabhihitaḥ| sāhacaryādvā lādeśau taṅānāvava `la' ityuktāviti vyākhyeyam| tathā ca vyākhyānadvāreṇeṣṭārthapratipttau sādhyāyāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe tveṣa doṣo nāsti, atastamāśrityāha-- `laḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhī' ityādi| nanvayamapi pakṣo doṣavāneva, lādeśasya hi parasmaipadasaṃjñā vidhīyamānā tiṅāṃ na syāt, teṣāṃ paratvāt `tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi' (1.4.101) ityādinā prathamapuruṣādisaṃjñayā bhavitavyam| parasmaipadasaṃjñāyāstu śatṛkvasvoścāvakāsaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayaṃ `sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (7.2.1.) ityāha tajjñāpayati-- bhavati ca tiṅāṃ parasmepadasaṃjñeti| sa hi parasmaipade pare sici vidhīyate, na hi sijviṣaye śatṛkvasū sambhavataḥ| `tiptasjhi' ityādi rūpodāharaṇamātram|| 100. taṅānāvatmanepadam| `katīha nighnānāḥ' iti| nipūrvoddhanteḥ `tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś' (3.2.129) iti cānaśpratyayaḥ| `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ| `hohanterñṇinneṣu' (7.3.54) iti kutvam| yadyanādeśo'pi cānaśātmanapadasaṃjñakaḥ syāt parasmaipadino hantarna syāt|| 101. tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi prathamamadhyamottamāḥ| tiṅa iti prathamābahuvacanam| tiṅaḥ saṃjñinaḥ kiṃbhutāḥ ? trīṇi trīṇityevambhūtā ityarthaḥ| vacanāpekṣayā napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśaḥ| vīpsāyāñcaitad‌dvirjanam| yadi tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi vacanāni prathamamadhyamottamapuruṣasaṃjñakāni bhavanti, evaṃ sati ṣaṭ‌trikāḥ saṃjñinaḥ saṃjñāstitra iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti; vaiṣamyāt| tatra yadyekasyānekasaṃjñāvidhānavaiyarthyādekā saṃjñā bhavet, na tvekaikasya tisraḥ, tathāpi saivaikaikā bhavantītyavyavasthā vā syāt; naiṣa doṣaḥ;iha hi parasmaipadagrahaṇamātmanepadagarhaṇañcānuvartate| tadanuvṛttau ca dvau rāśī bhavataḥ- navānāṃ tiṅāṃ parasmaipadasaṃjñakānāmeko rāśiḥ, tathā nāvānāmātmanepadasaṃjñakānāṃ dvitīyaḥ| tatra prathame rāśau ye trayastrikāḥ, ye ca dvitīye rāśau trayastrikāstairidaṃ sūtraṃ pratyekamabhisambadhyate-- parasmaipadeṣu tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi pthamamadhyamottamāḥ, tathātmanepadeṣu tiṅastrīṇi trīṇi prathamamadhyamottamā iti| evaṃ hi sati na bhavati saṃkhyātānudeśābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| tamevārthaṃ darśayitumāha-- `tiṅo'ṣṭādaśa pratyayāḥ' iti| `nava' ityādinā rāśidvayaṃ darśayati| `tatra' ityādinā prathame rāśau ye trayastrikāstairasya sūtrasya sambandhaṃ karoti| `ātmanepadeṣu' ityādināpi dvitīye rāśau ye trayastrikāstaiśca|| 102. tānyekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanānyekaśaḥ| `tāni' iti bahuvacanaṃ saṃjñāsamāveśārtham; anyathā hyekasaṃjñādhikāre sati vacanparāmāṇyāt puruṣavacanasaṃjñāḥ paryāyeṇa pravarteran| evañca tatra `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) ityādinā vidhīyamānamāḍādikāryaṃ pākṣikaṃ syāt| asmiṃstu sati bhavati saṃjñāsamāveśaḥ| tacchabdena hi trīṇi trīṇi labdhapuruṣasaṃjñakāni tānyekavacanādisaṃjñakāni bhavantīti pratyavamṛśyante, tena yāni labdhaprathamapuruṣādisaṃjñakāni tānyevaikavacanādisaṃjñakāni bhavanti| nanu ca trikāṇāṃ prathamādisaṃjñaikaikasya caikavacanādisaṃjñā, tatra viṣayabedādekasaṃjñādhikāre'pi virodho nāstyeveti; naiṣa doṣaḥ; tadasti puruṣādisaṃjñāpi hi pratyekameva, na hi samudāyo nāmānyastrikebhyo'sti; tasmāt tibādayastrakā eva saṃjñinaḥ| trigrahaṇantu maryādārtham| tratvasaṃkhyāparicchinnāstiṅaḥ pratyekaṃ puruṣasaṃjñāḥ pratipādyante| tasmāt prathamādisaṃjñānāmekavacanādisaṃjñānāñcaikaviṣayataiveti saṃjñāsamāveśārthaṃ tānītyuktam|| 103. supaḥ| (1.4.103) suviti pratyāhāragrahaṇam| prathamaikavacanāt suśabdādārabhya saptamībahucanasya supaḥ pakāreṇa| atha kapaḥ pakāreṇāyaṃ pratyāhāra kasmānna vijñāyate ? saptamībahuvacanasya pakārasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| sa hyanudāttārthaḥ syāt ? pratyāhārārtho vā ? tatrānudāttārtho na bhavati; anudāttasya supatvādeva siddhatvāt| tatra yadi pratyāhārārtho'pi na syāt tadāsyāpārthakatvameva syāt| tasmāt tenaivāyaṃ pratyāhāro vijñāyate, na tu kapaḥ pakāreṇa; svaravidhau tasya caritārthatvāt|| 104.vibhaktiśca| (1.4.104) cakāraḥ puruṣādisaṃjñāsamāveśārthaḥ| vinā tenaikasaṃjñādhikāre vacanaprāmāṇyāt paryāyaḥ syāt| tiṅo vibhaktatve prayojanam `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ' (ra1.3.4) itītsaṃjñāpratiṣedhaḥ| supastvecca, anyacca tyadādyatvādi|| 105.yuṣmadyupapade samānādhikaraṇe sthāninyapi madhyamaḥ| (1.4.105) niyatārthametaditi darśayitumāha-- `lasyetyadhikṛtya' ityādi| etacca niyamārthatve kāraṇam| satyārambho niyamārtho bhavati, nāsiddhe| sa punarayaṃ niyama upapadārthaniyamo vā syāt-- tiṅo yuṣmadyupapade madhyama eva ? puruṣaniyamo vā syāt-- yuṣmadyevopapade madhyam iti vā ? tatra yadi prathamo niyama āśrīyate, tvayā kurvatā tvayā kurvāṇeneti yuṣmadyupade lasya śatṛśānajādeśau na bhavataḥ| tasmāt tadarthaṃ yatnāntaramāstheyam| itaratra tu na kiñcidyatnasādhyam, ato dvitīyapakṣamāśrityāha-- `teṣāmayam' ityādi| vyavahite ca, avyavahite ceti| nanu ca parasparaṃ sannikṛṣṭaṃ yatpadaṃ tadupapadamucyate-- upoccāritaṃ padamiti kṛtvā;yacca vyavahitaṃ tadavyavahitāpekṣayā viprakṛṣṭam, ato vyavahitena bhavitavyam, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmāt sannikṛṣṭaṃ viprakṛṣṭamityavyavasthitametadubhayagrahaṇam; sāpekṣatvāt parāparavat| tatra yadyavyavahitamapekṣya vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ bhavati, tathāpyanyadviprakṛṣṭataramapekṣya sannikṛṣṭaṃ bhavatītītaratra vyavahitenāpi bhavitavyam| yadyevam, upapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? pūrvabhūte'pi yathā syādityevamartha kṛtam| anyathā `yuṣmadi' ityetāvatyucyamāne' tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66)iti parabhūta eva yuṣmadi pūrvasya madhyamaḥ syāt, na tu pūrvabhūte parasya| upapadagrahaṇādatrāpi bhavati| pūrveṇa pareṇāpi prayujyamānamupapadaṃ bhavatyeva| `samānādhikaraṇe' ityanena samānābhidheya iti vyācakṣāṇo'yamadhikaraṇaśabdo'bhidheyavacanaḥ sūtra upātta iti darśayati| tatpunarabhidheyaṃ yatra lakāra utpadyate kartari karmaṇi vā kārake pratyāsattestadeva vijñāyate ityāha-- `tulyakārake' ityādi| tulyaṃ kārakaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| tulyaśabdena samānaśabdasyārtho darśitaḥ| `prayujyamāne'prayujyamāne'pi' iti| anena sthāninyapītyasyārthamācaṣṭe| sthānaśabdaḥ prasaṅgavācī-- sthānamasyāstīti sthānī| kasya ca sthānam ? tasyaiva sthānamasti yasyārtho gamyate, śabdo na prayujyate| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- aprayujyamāne'pi yuṣmadi, apiśabdāt prayujyamāne'pi| samānādhikaraṇagrahaṇaṃ kim ? `tvayā pacyate' ityatra mā bhūt, bhinnaṃ hyadhikaraṇam| tathā hi-- `tvayā' ityetat karttṛvāci; karttari tṛtīyāvidhānāt| `pacyate' iti karmavāci; karmaṇi lakāravidhānāt|| 106. prahāse ca manyopapade manyateruttama ekavacca|(1.4.106) `prahāse gamyamāne' iti| yatra bhūtārthābhāvādvañcanaiva kevalaṃ tatra vakturabhiprayāviṣkaraṇena prahāso gamyate| `manyopapade' iti|manyatirupapadamupoccāritaṃ padaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| madhyamasya dhātorvidhānāt dhāturanyapādratho vijñāyata ityāha-- `dhātoḥṭa iti| `sa caikavat' iti| yatra dvau mantārau bahavo vā tatrāyamekavadbhāvo vidhīyate| anyatra tu manturekatvādevaikavacanaṃ siddham| `madhyamottamayoḥ' iti| yathākramaṃ yuṣmadasmadorupapadayoḥ samānādhikaraṇayoraprayujyamānayorapyarthasya vidyamānatvāt| yathā pratyudāharaṇe pūrvakamupapadagrahaṇaṃ yuṣmacchabdenābhisambaddhamihānuvartteteti tanmanyatinā'śakyamabhisambandhṛmiti punarupapadagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| manyateriti śyanā nirdeśaḥ, ityasya tānādikasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdatyevamarthaḥ| tenenaha na bhavati-- ehi manuṣe rathena yāsyāmi na hi yāsyasi yātastena te piteti| evaṃ hi manoterbhavati|| 107. asmadyuttamaḥ| (1.4.107) yadā yuṣdasmadī dve apyete upapade staḥ, tadā kathaṃ bhavitavyam ? yadi karttṛśaktī ādhārapratiniyate apekṣyete, tadā''khyātamapi pṛthageva prayujyate-- pacasi pacāmi ceti| athāvirodhācchaktidvaye'pi lakāra utpadyate, tadā vipratiṣedhāduttama eva bhavati-- tvañcāhañca pacāva iti| yadyapi `tyadādīnāṃ yadyatparaṃ tacchiṣyate' bhavati| āvāṃ pacāva ityatra hyasmacchabdasya yuṣmadartho'pi vācyaḥ, anyathā hi dvivacanaṃ na syāt| na hyasmacchabdasyaiva dvitvamupapadyate|| 108. śeṣe prathamaḥ| (1.4.108) 109. paraḥ sannikarṣaḥ saṃhitā| (1.4.109) `paraśabdo'tiśaye varttate' iti| yathā paraṃ duḥkhamiti| etana paraśabdola digādiṣvapyartheṣu varttate, tathāpīhātiśaye varttamānasya tasya grahaṇamita darśayati| sannikarṣaḥ - pratyāsattiḥ, saṃśleṣaśca| tatreha pratyāsattirgṛhyata iti darśayannāha-- `sannikarṣaḥ pratyāsattiḥ' iti| saṃśleṣastu na gṛhyate, tasya varṇeṣvasambhavāt| saṃśleṣo hyekakālānāṃ bhavati, na ca varṇāmāmekakālatāpattiḥ; krameṇoccāritvāduccaritapradhvaṃsitatvāt| saṃśleṣo hyekakālānāṃ bhavati, na ca varṇānāmekakālatāpattiḥ; krameṇoccāritvāduccaritapradhvaṃsatatvāt| satyāmapi caikakālatāyāṃ na sambhavatyeva varṇānāṃ saśleṣaḥ| tathā hi-- saṃśleṣaḥ saṃyogato vā syāt, samavāyato vā; tatra pūrvako dravyasyaiva syāt, na tu śabdasya-- nirguṇā guṇā iti kṛtvā| itaro'pi naiva śabdasya sambhavati, na hi varṇo varṇe samavaiti; śabdasyākāśasamavāyitvāt| na ca saṃyogasamavāyayoratiśayaḥ sambhavati; sarvatraikarupakatvāt| tathā ca `paraḥ' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate| pratyāsattistvapekṣākṛtabhedāt prakarṣāprakarṣābhyāṃ prayujyamānāparagrahaṇena viśiṣyata iti yuktaṃ tasya viśeṣaṇatvam | kaḥ punarasau paraḥ sannikṛṣṭān varṇānuccārayati vaktari pūrvasya varṇasya ye niṣpādakāstālvādayasteṣāṃ vyāpāroparatau varṇāntarasya ca ye niṣpādakāstālvādayasteṣāṃ vyāpāropadeśanamarddhamātrākālamāhuḥ| sa varṇānāṃ vyavadhānaḥ - vyavadhāyako yasmin so'rddhamātrākālavyavadhānaḥ sannikarṣaḥ| yadi varṇānāmarddhamātrākālavyavadhānaḥ sannikarṣaḥ,kathaṃ tarhi dadhyatretyādau vayavadhāyakakālo nopalakṣyate,varṇāḥ saṃśliṣṭā evopalabhyante ? naitat; kimarthaṃ punaretadārabhyate, yāvatā parameva sannikarṣaṃ saṃhiteti vadantyācāryāḥ, tathā hi saṃhitāmadhīṣvetyukte paraṃ sannikarṣamevādhīte śiṣyaḥ ? naitadevam; padasya padāntareṇa yadānantaryaṃ sā saṃhiteti loke'bhidhīyate | tathā ca vaktāro vadanti-- saṃhitāmadhīte na padāni, padānyadhīte na saṃhitāmiti| tathā caikapade hi saṃhitākāryaṃ na syāt, `iko yaṇaci'(6.1.77) iti-- kumāryau, kurmārya iti| sati hyasmin varṇānāṃ sannikarṣaviśeṣasyānena saṃhitāsaṃjñā vidhīyata ita sarvatraiva bhavati||| 110. virāmo'vasānam| (1.4.110) `viratirvirāmaḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ| virāmo vaṇoccāraṇābhāvo'vasānasaṃjño bhavati| `viramyate'neneti virāmaḥ' iti virāmaśabdasya dvitīyamarthaṃ darśayati| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.13) iti bahulavacanādasaṃjñāyāmapi `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti ghañ| atra pakṣe yenāntyena varṇena viramyate so'vasānasaṃjño bhavati| tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe'bhāve paurvāparyābhāvāt `kharavasānayoḥ' (8.3.15) ityatrāvasānāpekṣayā viṣayasaptamīyaṃ vijñāyate; na parasamaptamī| kharapekṣayā tu saptamīyam| anye tu-- yadyabhāve paurvāparyaṃ na sambhavatītyavasanāpekṣayā `kharavasānayoḥ' (8.3.15) iti parasaptamī nopapadyate, tadā `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityādāvapi parasaptamī nopapadyate| katham ? varṇānāṃ kramabhāvitvāt, uccaritapradhvaṃsitatvācca| yadegasti tadāñ nāsti, yadā tvajasti tadeg nāsti| athātra buddhiprakalpitaṃ paurvāparyamāśritya parasaptamīṣyate, tadā `kharavasānayoḥ' (8.3.15) ityatrāpitathaivaiṣṭavyeti manyamānā avasānāpekṣayāpi parasaptamīmicchanti| apare tu--antyasya tu varṇasyāvasānasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `kharavasānayoḥ' (8.3.15) iti ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate| atrāvasānāpakṣayā sthānaṣaṣṭhī| rephasyāvasānasya visarjanīya iti kharapekṣayā tavānantaryalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhīti vadanti| tanmate sthānaṣaṣṭhyāṃ hi `ro ri' (8.3.14) ityato rephasyānuvṛttasya yat sthānitvaṃ tadavirudhyate tadevamekāpi vibhaktiryathāyogaṃ vibhajyate| nanu cābhāvapakṣe'pi pūrvasminnapi bhāge'nuccāramamasti, tatrāpi visarjanīyaḥ prāpnoti-- ratha iti, asti hyatrāpi rephāt prāguccāraṇam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ tatra hi prakṛtaṃ padagrahaṇaṃ repheṇa viśiṣyate-- rephāntasya padasyeti| na ca pūrveṇa repheṇa padaṃ bhavati| nanvevapyarthasyaiṣā saṃjñā syāditi `kharavasanāyoḥ' (8.3.15) ityatra `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate| śabde hi saptamīnirdiṣṭe satīyamupatiṣṭhate, nārthe| tadanupasthāne ca pareṇa repheṇa rephāntasya ratha ityetasya padasya pūrvo yo rephastasya vyavahitasyāpi visarjanīyaḥ syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; jñāpakānna bhaviṣyati, yadayaṃ `uraṇ raparaḥ' (1.1.51) iti vyavahitasya rephasya visarjanīyamakṛtvā nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati- vyavahitasya rephasya visarjanīyo na bhavatīti| `nanvatra loke prasiddherevāyantye varṇe'vasānaśabdasya sampratyayo bhaviṣyati| prasiddho hi loke--antye varṇe'vasyateḥ prayogaḥ| tathā hi kenāvasyatītyukte vaktāro vadanti-- ikāreṇokāreṇa veti| ikārādivarṇenāvasānaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| tataḥ pradeśa evāvasānagrahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti nārthaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñipraṇanena, naitadasti; apūrvo hi syatiḥ parisamāptāvapi varttate-- avasito vāda iti, avagame'pi varttate-- avasito'rtha iti, parābhave'pi varttate--dvayorvivāde'vasito davadatta iti| tatra yadīyaṃ nārabhyate, tadāvasānagraṇe sandehaḥ syāt-- kimabhidhānāvasānaśabdasya grahaṇamiti ? `virāmo'vasānam' (1.4.110) iti tu hyantagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam-- kharantyayoriti ? etadapi nāsti; evaṃ hi sandehaḥ syāt-- kimantyasya varṇasya ? uta padasya? āhosvadvākyasyeti ? tatrāntyasya viśeṣaṇārthaṃ varṇagrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ syāt| tasmāt saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhaḥ karttavyaḥ| `vṛkṣaḥ, plakṣaḥ' iti| `kharavasanāyorvisarjanīyaḥ' (8.3.15)| `dadhim̐ madhum̐' iti| `aṇo'pragṛhyasyānunāsika' (8.4.57) iti| atra hi `vā'vasāne'(8.4.56) ityato'vasānagrahaṇamanuvartate|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ prathamādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ samāptaścāyaṃ prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|| <2> <2.1> śrībodhisattvadaśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitā nyāsāparaparyāyā kāśikāvyākhyā dvitīyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ 1.samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ| (2.1.1) `paribhāṣeyam' iti| parito vyāpṛtā bhāṣā - paribhāṣā| tathā coktam-- `paribhāṣā punarekasthā sarva śāstramabhijvalayati, yathā-- vaśmapradīpaḥ'| kutaḥ punaretadvijñāyate-- paribhāṣeyam, nādhikāra iti ? padavidhigraṇālliṅgāt | uttaratra hi sarvaḥ parāṅgavadbhāvādiranukarasyamānaḥ padavidhireva| tatra yadyamadhikāraḥ syāt, padavidhigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; vayāvartyābhāvāt| paribhāṣāyāṃ tvasyām, paribhāṣā hyekadeśasyāpi sarvatra śāstre vyāpriyata ityasati padavidhigrahaṇe varṇavidhāyavapyupatiṣṭheta| tato varṇavidhinirāsārtha kriyamāṇaṃ padavidhigrahaṇamarthavadbhavati| tasmāt padividhagrahaṇālliṅgāt paribhāṣeyaṃ nādhikāra ityavasīyate| yadyavam, `isusoḥ sāmarthye' (8.3.44) , `na cavāhāhaivayukte' (8.1.24) ityevamādiṣu yogeṣu sāmarthyagrahaṇaṃ yuktagrahaṇañca kimarthaṃ kriyate, yāvatā `padasya' iti tatrānuvarttate, tatra padavidhitvādevāsāmarthye na bhaviṣyati ? satyametat; yadarthaṃ tu kriyate tat tatraiva pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ| vidhiśabdo'yamastyeva bhāvasādhanaḥ-- vidhānaṃ vidhiriti| asti ca karmasādhanaḥ-- vidhīyata iti vidhiḥ| tatra bhāvasādhane vidhiśabda āśrīyamāṇe padānāmapariniṣpannānāṃ pariniṣpādanaṃ padavidhiriti padeṣu karmaṇi kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī; teṣāṃ vidhinā sambandhāt| karmasādhane tu pariniṣpannānāṃ vyavasthitānāmeva padānāṃ yatsamāsādi kāryaṃ vidhīyate sa padividhiḥ| tatra padeṣu ca śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati; vidhīyamānasya kāryasya padasambandhitvenopādānāt| tatra yadīha bhāvasādhano vidhiśabda āśrīyeta tadā vibhaktividhānameva saṅgṛhītaṃ syāt,samāsa-- parāṅgavadbhāva--taddhitavṛttyādikaṃ na saṅgṛhyetaca na hi tatra padānāmasatāṃ vidhānam; kiṃ tarhi ? vyavasthitānāmeva padānāṃ samāsādi kāryaṃ vidhīyate| itaratra tu vidhiśabda āśrīyamāṇe te'pi saṅgṛhītā bhavantīti manyamānaḥ karmasādhanaṃ vidhiśabdamāśrityāha-- `vidhīyata iti vidhiḥ' iti| nanu cātrāpi pakṣe vibhaktividhānaṃ na saṅgṛhyeta, na hi `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityevamādiśāstreṇa vyavasthitānāṃ padānāṃ kiñcit kāryaṃ vidhīyate, api tu padānyeva vidhīyante ? yadi na saṅgṛhītaṃ syānna nāma| na ca tadasaṅgrahe kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata ityuttaratra pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ| `samāsādiḥ' iti| ādiśabdena taddhitavṛtyādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `samarthaḥ śaktaḥ' iti| svakāryanirvartanakṣama ityarthaḥ| sa hi loke samartha ityucyate| svārthapratipādanameva śabdānāṃ svakāryam| ye ceha laukikā vaidikāśca śabdā adhikṛtāste sarve eva svakāryapratipādanaṃ prati samarthāḥ| tasmāt `samarthaḥ' ita viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādviśeṣaḥ kaścidāśrīyate| sa ca viśeṣaḥ-- vṛttyarthaṃ yadvākyamupādīyate, pratyāsattestadarthapratipādane yā śaktatā tallakṣamo vijñāyata ityāha-- `vigrahavākyarthābhidhāne' ityādi| viśeṣeṇa gṛhyate vijñāyate'neneti vigrahaḥ, vigrahaśca tadvākyam| atha vā-- viśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ vigrahaḥ, vigrahārthaṃ yadvākyaṃ tadvigrahavākyam| śākapārthivāditvānmadhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ| vigrahavākyasyārtho vigrahavākyārthaḥ, tadabhidhāne tatpratyāyane yaḥ śaktaḥ sa samartho veditavyaḥ, yathā-- rājapuruṣa ityayaṃ samasāḥ, etadarthaṃ yadvākyaṃ rājñaḥ puruṣa iti tasya yo'rthastadabhidhāne rājapuruṣa ityayaṃ śabdaṃ śaktaḥ; tato'pi tadarthasya pratīteḥ| sa punararthaḥ-- saṃsargaḥ, bhedaśca;bhedasaṃsargau vā|tatra svaviśeṣasya svāmiviśesya svāmiviśeṣeṇa yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa `saṃsargaḥ' ākhyāyate| svāntarasya svāmyantarebhyaḥ, svāmyatarasya svātantarebhyaśca vyāvṛttiḥ `bhedaḥ' ākhyāyate| tatra saṃsargavādino mate saṃsarga eva śabdārthaḥ, vyāvṛttistvarthasaṃgṛhītā| na hyavyāvarttyasaṃgṛhītā| na hyavyāvarttyamānayoḥ svasvāminoḥ sambandhyantarebhyaḥ saṃsarga upapadyate| bhedavādinastu vyāvṛttirava śabdārthaḥ, saṃsargo'rthasaṅgṛhītaḥ; na hi vyāvarttyamānasya sambandhyantareṇāsambaddhasya svāmyāderavasthānamasti| ubhayavādinastu ubhaya eva śabdārthaḥ| yadi vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne yaḥ śaktaḥ sa samartho vijñāyeta, evaṃ sati samāsataddhitaviṣayameva sāmarthyāmiti parāṅgavadbhāvavibhaktividhānayoriyaṃ paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭheta; na hi tatra vigrahavākyārthābhidhānamasti ? yadi nopatiṣṭheta, na nāma; na ca tadanupasthāne kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyeta| tathā hi-- parāṅgavadbhāve tāvannimittagrahaṇaṃ deśayiṣyati bhāṣyakāraḥ| tatra ca nimittasya nimittinā sāmarthyamastyeva-- madrāṇāṃ rājan, paraśunā vṛścanniti| vibhaktividhāne'pi yāstāvat kārakavibhaktayastā yeṣveva kārakeṣu karmādiṣu vidhīyante teṣāṃ kriyayā sambandho'styeva| upapadavibhaktiṣvapi `sahayukte'pradhāne' (2.3.19) ityevamādiṣu yuktagrahaṇādīni santi, tatrāpi sāmarthyamastyeva| tatraivaṃ sambandhe sati vibhaktaya iṣyante, na tu vigrahavākyārthābhidhānalakṣaṇasāmarthye| evaṃ tāvanmukhyārthavṛttiḥ samarthaśabdo darśitaḥ| idānīmupacaritavṛttiṃ darśayitumāha-- `atha vā' ityādi| samarthāni padānyāśrayo yasya sa samarthapadāśrāyaḥ; tadbhāvaḥ samarthapadāśrayatvam| tato hetoḥ samāsādiḥ samartha ucyate| āśrayasya samarthatvādupacāreṇāśrito'pi tatheti vyapadiśyate; kāraṇadharmasya kārya upacārāt, yathā-- ऩḍ‌valodakaṃ pādarogaḥ| `samarthānām' ityanena vākye vyapadeśalakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyamāha| tathā hi `rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityatra vākye rājā puruṣamapekṣate -- mamāyamiti, puruṣo'pi rājānamapekṣate-- ahamasyeti| `saṃsṛṣṭārthānām' ityanena samāse padānāmekārthībhāvanalakṣamaṃ sāmarthyaṃ darśayati| ekārthībhāvaśca pṛthagavasthitānāṃ bhinnārthānāṃ padānāṃ samāse sādhāraṇārthatā nāmāvasthāviśeṣaḥ| vākye hi sādhāraṇārthatā nāsti; bhinnārthatvāt| ata eva tatra bhedanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhyupajāyate-- rājñaḥ puruṣa iti| vṛttau tūbhayapadavyavacchinārthābhidhānat sādhāraṇārthatā bhavati| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati-- samāse hi viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyamanupraviśatyekārthī bhavati viśeṣyeṇa saraha, vākye hi viśeṣamaṃ viśeṣyāt pṛthagavatiṣṭhata iti| yasminnasati, vākye rājño gauścāśvaśca puruṣaśceti bhedanibandhanasamuccayapratipādanāya caśapabda prayujyate| samāse tu yasmin sati sa nivarttate rājño gavāśvapuruṣā ityayamekārthībhāvo veditavyaḥ| `paśya devadatta kaṣṭam, śrito viṣṇumitro gurukulam' iti| atra kaṣṭaśabdasya paśyetyanena sambandhaḥ; na tu śritaśabdana; tena sāmarthyābhāvātsamāso na bhavati| nanu ca śritādīnāṃ śrutatvāttaireva dvitīyāṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ-- śritādīnāṃ sambandhinī yā dvitīyeti śakyate vyapadeṣṭam asati tu tasmin, dvitīyāmātraṃ śritādibhiḥ samasyata iti vijñāyate| evaṃ sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ syādeva-- mahat kaṣṭaṃ śrita iti, bhavati hyatra śritādinimittā dvitīyā| tasmāt samarthagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| `kiṃ tvaṃ kariṣyasi saṅkulayā, khaṇḍo devadatta upalena' iti| atropalena tṛtīyāntena kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanam| atastatkṛtatvamastīti prāpnoti samāsaḥ; samarthagrahamānna bhavati| samarthagrahaṇe tu satyayamartho bhavati-- yasyaiva tṛtīyāntasya samāsastenaiva yadi kṛtaṃ khaṇḍanamiti| na ceha tatkṛtaṃ khaṇḍanamato na bhavati samāsaḥ| evamanyatrāpyasāmarthyādasamāso veditavyaḥ| 2.subāmantrite parāṅgavatsvare| (2.1.2) `parasyāṅgavat' iti| atrāṅgavaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| parsayāṅgavat paraikadeśavadbhavati| tad‌grahaṇena gṛhyata ityarthaḥ| evaṃ tādātmyātideśo'yaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `tādātmyātideśo'yam' iti| tādātmyam - tatsabhāvatvam| `subantam' ityādinā tameva tādātmyātideśaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| `subantamāmantritamanupraviśati' iti| tatrāntarbhavatītyarthaḥ| `kuṇḍenāṭan' iti| atra kuṇḍaśabdokāra āmantritasvaraḥ| evamanyatrāpi sasupkasyāmantritasya svaro veditavyaḥ| `pīḍye pīḍyamāna' iti| he pīḍyamāna tvadīyayā pīḍayā'haṃ pīḍye, bādhye'hamityarthaḥ| `pīḍa avagāhane' (dhā.pā.1544), curādiṇic, ubhayatra karmaṇyātmanepadam, ekatrottamapuruṣaikavacanamiṭ, anyatra śānac, sārvadhātuke yak, ṇilopaḥ, `tāsyanudāttenṅidadupadeśāllasārvadhātumanudāttamahanviṅoḥ' (6.1.186) itīṭo'nudāttatvam, yakaḥ pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvam, yakaḥ pratyayasarveṇādyudāttatvam, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (ra8.2.5) ityekāra udāttaḥ| pīḍyamānetyasya tu `pīḍya' ityasyāt padāduttarasya `āmantritasya ca' (8.1.19) iti nighātaḥ| `gehe gārgyaḥ' iti| gehaśabda uñchādipāṭhādantodāttaḥ, saptamyekādeśaḥ pūrvavadudāttaḥ, gārgya iti ñtsareṇādyudāttaḥ| pṛthaksvara evātra bhavati| `devadatta kuṇḍenāṭan' iti| yadi paragrahaṇaṃ na kriyate tadā devadattaśabdaṃ pūrvamapyāmantritaṃ prati subantasyānupraveśaḥ syāt, tataśca devadattaśabdāt padātparasyāṭannityetasya `āmantritasya ca'(8.1.19) iti nighātaḥ syāt| nanu ca paragrahaṇe kriyamāṇe kuṇḍaśabdasya parāṅgavadbhāve satyādyudāttatve ṣāṣṭhike kṛte devadattaśabdāt padātparasyāṭannityetasya nighātena bhavitavyameva ? naitadasti; apādādau hi sa nighātaḥ, pādāditvañceha vivakṣitam; tatra ca devadattetyāmantritasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| evaṃ kuṇeḍanāṭannityapi| āmantritanighāto'tra na bhavati; pādāditvāt| `yathā mṛtpiṇḍībhūtaḥ svaraṃ labheta' iti| kathaṃ nāma subantasamudāyo mṛtpiṇḍa ivaikībhūta ekarūpatāmivāpannaḥ svaraṃ labhetatetyavamarthamaṅgagrahaṇam| kimarthaṃ punarekībhūtasya svaraprāptaye yatnaḥ kriyata ityata āha-- `ubhayoḥ' ityādi| yadyaṅgagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tataśca kāryātideśa- śāstarātideśa-vyapadeśātideśānāmanyatamaḥ syāt| tathā ca sati yathā parasya kāryamādyudāttatvamāmantritavyadeśa ādyudāttaśāstraṃ ca; tathā subantasya pūrvasyāpi syāditi,tataścobhayorapyādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| aṅgagrahaṇe tu sati tādātmyātideśo'yaṃ bhavati| tena mṛtpiṇḍībhūtaḥ subantasamudāya āmantritādyudāttarūpaṃ svaraṃ labhata iti na bhavatyubhayorādyudāttatvaprasaṅgaḥ| `svāśrayamapi kāryaṃ yathā syāt' (iti)| `āma kuṇḍenāṭan' ityatra aṭannityetasya padātparasya `āmantritasya' (8..19) iti nighāte prāpte `na luṭ' (8.1.29) ityato netyanuvarttamāne `āma ekāntaratāyā abhāvāt| parameva hi syāt subantamasativatkaraṇe, na ca tathābhūtenaikāntaratā yuktā| vatkaraṇe tu sati, bhavati kadācit svāśrayamapyanaṅgatvamityupapadyata ekāntaratā, tena nighātapratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati| tatrāyaṃ svaravibhāgaḥ-- āmityasya nipātasvareṇādyudāttatvam| kuṇḍaśabdasyāpi parāṅgavadbhāve satyāmantritasvareṇādyudāttatvam| tathā nighātapratiṣedhe satyaṭannityetasyāpi ṣāṣṭhikenādyudāttena bhavitavyam| `kūpe siñcan' iti| atra parāṅgavadbhāvo nāstīti padāditvaṃ sakārasya bhavati| tena `sātpadādyoḥ' (8.3.109) iti ṣatvapratiṣedhaḥ syāt| `carma naman' iti| atrāpi parāṅgavadbhāvābhāvāt samānapadasthau nimittanimittinau na bhavata iti samānapadāśrayaṃ ṇatvaṃ na bhavati| `subantasya parāṅgavadbhāve samānādhikaraṇasya' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ samānādhikaraṇasya na prāpnoti, yata idamupasaṃkhyānaṃ kriyata ityāha-- `anantaratvāt' iti| `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) ityatra nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāt vyavahite na prāpnotittayupasaṃkhyāyate| `tīkṣṇayā sūcyā sīvyan' ityatra sīvyannityetasmin paratastīkṣṇayetyasya vyavahitasyāpi parāṅgavādādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `uccairadhīyāna' iti| uccaiḥ śabdasya parāṅgavadbhāvābhāvādāmantritanibandhanamādyudāttatvaṃ na bhavati| tasminnasati tatrāntodāttatvameva bhavati; svarādiṣvanantodāttasya pāṭhāt| tathā hi tatraiva sannatara-- uccais- nīcairityevamādīni pṛthakparyantānyupadiśya `ete sannataraprabhṛtayo'ntodāttāḥ paṭhyante' (1.1.37) ityuktam| adhīyānetyasya yadā pādāditvaṃ vivakṣyatetadā''dyudāttatvam, anyatra `āmantritasya ca' (8.1.19) iti nighātaḥ|| 3. prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ| (2.1.3) `yathāvṛddham' iti| atra samāsasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca ' (1.2.46) ityevamādi kāryaṃ bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ prāgvacanam ? yāvatā pañcamīnirdeṃśādeva prāgityasyādhyāhāro bhaviṣyati; na ca parāgityayamapi dikchabdo'sti, atastasyāpyadhyāhāraḥ syādityaśaṅkanīyam, tadadhyāhāre kaḍārasaṃśabdanāt pare ye'nukraṃsyante teṣāṃ samāsasaṃjñā syāt; tathā ca kaḍārasaṃśabdanādanantarameva samāsādhikāraṃ kuryāt, iha tu kṛtaḥ, tasmādiha karaṇasāmarthyāt samāsādhikārasya prāgityasyādhyāhāro bhaviṣyati, tato nārthaḥ prāgvacanenetyāha-- ` prāgvacanam' ityādi| uttaratrāvyayībhāvādisaṃjñābhiḥ saha samāsasaṃjñāyāḥ samāveśo yathā syādityevamartha prāgvacamanam| asati tu tasmin, tābhiranavakāśābhiriyaṃ saṃjñāla bādhyeta| asyāstu samāsasaṃjñāyāḥ `saha supā' (2.1.4) ityatra saheti yogavibhāgena yaḥ samāsaḥ krite so'vakāśaḥ syāt-- anuprāvarṣat, anuvyacaladiti, tiṅantenātra samāsaḥ; asatyapi sāvakāśatva ekasaṃjñādhikāre vacanapramāṇyāt paryāyeṇa vṛttiḥ syāt, na tu samāveśaḥ| sākṣāt sūtreṇopātte tu prāgvacane sati bhavati samāveśaḥ, katham? evaṃ hi sambandhaḥ kriyate-- kaḍārāt prāgyāvanto vyavasthitaḥ sarve te samāsasaṃjñakā bhavanti, samāsasaṃjñakāḥ santo'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñāṃ labhanta ita| tena nimittameva samāsasaṃjñā'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñānām| naca nimittinā nimittaṃ vihanyate; anyathā tasya nimittatvameva na syāditi yuktaḥ sūtropāttena prāgvacanena samāveśaḥ| adhyāhṛte tu tasmin `kaḍārasaṃśabdanātprāgyāvanto vyavasthitāḥ sarve te samāsasaṃjñakā bhavanti' ityeṣo'rtho labhyate, na tu `samāsasaṃjñakāḥ santo'vyayībhāvādisaṃjñakāḥ' ityeṣo'pi| sākṣāt sūtropātte tu tasminneṣo'pi labhyate; anyathā tasya sūtre sākṣādupādānamanarthakaṃ syāt|| 4. saha supā| (2.1.4) `sahagrahaṇaṃ yogavibhāgārtham' iti; nanu cāsati tasminnekaikasya saṃjñā syāt, tataśca ṛkpāda ityatra `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ pathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityatrākāraḥ samāsāntaḥ syāt; iha ca `rājāśvaḥ' ityatra `samāsasya' (6.1.223) iti dvau svarau syātām, sahabhūtayoreva samāsasaṃjñā yathā syādekaikasya mā bhūdityevamartha sahagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? evaṃ manyate-- supeti tṛtīyaiva sahārtha gamayati, yathā `vṛddho yūnā' (1.2.65) iti| samāsaṭa iti ca mahatī saṃjñā kriyate-- anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeteti| kathaṃ nāmānvarthasaṃjñā kriyate ? samasanam - samāsaḥ, saṃkṣepa ityarthaḥ| saṃkṣepaścānekavastuviṣayaḥ| tenāsatyapi sahetasmin sahabhūtayoreva samāsasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati| `na pratyekam' iti| `anuvyacalat' iti| tiṅantenātra samāsaḥ| atra `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighāte kṛte samāsasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tannibandhanamantodāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 5. avyayībhāvaḥ| (2.1.5) `yathāvṛddham' ityatrāvyayībhāvatve sati `avyayībhāvaśca' (2.4.18) iti napuṃsakatve `nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ' (2.4.83) ityeṣa vidhirbhavati| `anvarthasaṃjñā ceyam' iti| anavyayamavyayaṃ bhavatītyavyayībhāvaḥ| `pūrvapadārthaprādhānyam' ityādinā anvarthasaṃjñāyāḥ phalamāha| prāyeṇa hyavyayībhāve pūrvapadamavyayam, parapadamanyavyayam; samudāyo nāvyayam‌| sa yadi pūrvapadavaśena tasya pūrvapadasya yo dharmo'vyayatvaṃ tatpratipadyate tato|ñanavyayasvabhāvaḥ sannavyayasvabhāvo bhavati| evañca pūrvapadavaśena taddharmaṃ pratipadyate yadi pūrvapadaṃ pradhānaṃ bhavati, nānyathā| pradhānavaśena hi vastunaḥ svadharmaparityāgena dharmāntarāpattiryuktā| tadevamanvarthasaṃjñeyaṃ bhavantī pūrvapadārthaprādhānyamavyayībhāvasya darśayati| tena yadā pūrvapadārthasya prādhānyaṃ bhavati tadāvyayībhāvo bhavati, nānyathetyuktaṃ bhavati|| 6.avyayaṃ vibhaktisamīpasamṛddhivyṛddhyarthābhāvātyayāsampratiśabdaprādurbhāvapaścādyathānupūrvyayaugapadyasādṛśyasampattisākalyāntavacaneṣu| (2.1.4) `strīṣvadhikṛtya kathā pravarttate'dhistri' iti| `anabhihite' (2.3.1) iti sūtre `tiṅakṛttaddhitasamāsaiḥ parisaṃkhyānam' (ma.bhā.1.441) iti parigaṇanaṃ kṛtam, tenādhiśabdena dyotite saptamyarthe strīśabdāt saptamī bhavati| tena tadanta eva samasyate| adhiśabdastu prathamāntaḥ| `avyayībhāvaśca' (2.4.18) iti napuṃsakatvam| `hrasvo napuṃsake' (1.2.47) iti hrasvaḥ| vibhaktiśabdeneha kārakamucyate-- vibhajyate prātipadikārtho'nayeti kṛtvā| taccehādhikaraṇaṃ vivakṣitamityāha-- `saptamyarthe yadavyayam' iti| `upakumbham' iti| samīpārthenopaśabdenopajanite vyatireke kumbhaśabdāt ṣaṣṭhī bhavatīti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ eva samasyate| `samudram' iti| yadā madrairviśiṣyamāṇatvāt samṛddheḥ prādhānyaṃ bhavati tadāyaṃ samāsaḥ| madrāṇāmādhikyena ṛddhirvarttata ityarthaḥ| yadā tu madrāḥ samṛddhyā viśiṣyamāṇāḥ pradhānabhāvamanubhavanti tadā `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) ita tatpuruṣo bhavati-- sumadarā iti| samṛddhimanto madrā ityarthaḥ| `durgavadikam' iti| gavādikānāmṛddhivigamo varttata ityarthaḥ| nanu cārthābhāva ityanenaiva tatsiddham, tathā hyarthābhāvo vastvabhāvo bhavatyeva, tatko'tra viśeṣo yenārthābhāvāt ṛddhivigamasya pṛthagabhidhānaṃ kriyate ? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ; uttarapadārthābhāvo hi dravyābhāvaḥ, yathā-- nirmakṣikamiti, makṣikāṇāmabhāva ucyate; na tu durgavadikamityatra gavādikānāmabhāvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tadīyāyā ṛddhervigamaḥ| `arthābhāvaḥ' iti| arthārthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? dharmābhāve prasajyapratiṣedho mā bhūt, yathā-- na bhavati brāhmaṇo'brāhmaṇa iti| brāhmaṇatvaṃ dharmo'tra pratiṣidhyate, na tu vastvabhāvaḥ| kiñca-- itaretarābhāveca mā bhūt, gauraśvo na bhavatīti| atrāpyarthāntaratvaṃ pratidhyate, na tu vastvabhāvaḥ| `atyayo'bhūtatvam iti| asyaiva prayāyo'tikramaḥ| atikramaḥ ityutpattyabhāvaḥ, pradhvaṃsābhāva ityarthaḥ| arthābhāvastu kvaciddeśe sarvadaiva vastuno'bhāvaḥ, na tūtpannasya paścādabhāva ityatyayo'rthābhāvādbhidyate| `upabhogasya' ityādinā'rthābhāvādbhedaṃ darśayati| arthābhāvo hi kvaciddeśe kālatrayepyabhāvaḥ, asamprati punarupabhogasya yo varttamānaḥ kālastasyaiva pratiṣedha iti bhidyate; asampratyarthābhāvāt| `atitaisṛkam' iti| tisṛkā nāma grāmaḥ `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) `tata āgataḥ' (4.3.74) iti vā'ṇ, taisṛkam, na taisṛkasya varttamānaḥ kāla upabhogasyetyarthe'titaisṛkamiti bhavati| `anurūpam' ityatra yogyatāyāmanuśabdaḥ| yogyaṃ rūpaṃ vahatītyarthaḥ| `pratyartham' iti| pratiśabdo'vyayamatra vīpsāyām, arthamartha prati pratyartham| nanu cātra nityasamāsatvāt vākyena na bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; pratiśabdasya vīpsāyāmarthe karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā, tadyoge dvitīyā yathā syādityevartham| tasyāśca vākya eva prayogo nānyatreti tena satyapi nityasamāsatve vākyamapi bhavati| `yathāśakti' iti| padārthānativṛttau yathāśabdaḥ| padamatra śaktaśabdastasyārthaḥ śaktareva; tasyā anativṛttiranatikramaḥ| yathāśakti karotīti śakyanatikrameṇa karotītyarthaḥ| `jyeṣṭhānupūrvyeṇa' iti| jeyaṣṭhānukrameṇetyarthaḥ| `sacakram' iti| `avyayībhāve cākāle' (6.3.81) iti sahaśabdasya sabhāvaḥ| evaṃ `sakikhi' ityādāvapi sabhāvo vaditavyaḥ| `guṇabhūte'pi' ityādi| yadi sādṛśya iti nocyeta tadā pūrvapadārthapradhāno'vyayībhāva iti yadā sādṛśyaṃ viśeṣyatvāt pradhānaṃ bhavati tadaiva syāt, sādṛśyaṃ kikhyāḥ sakikhīti guṇabhūte tu na syāt, asmādvacanādbhavati| `sadṛśaḥ kikhyā' iti| sādṛśyavataḥ prādhānyapradarśanena sādṛśyasya guṇabhāvaṃ pradarśayituṃ sadṛśaḥ kikhyā ityuktam‌| sādṛśyaprādhānye vivakṣite hi sādṛśyamiti bhāvapratyayena yukto nirdeśaḥ syāt| `sakikhi' iti| pūrvavad hrasvaḥ| nanu ca sampattiḥ samṛddhireva, tatkathaṃ pṛthagucyata ityata āha-- `sampattiranurūpam' ityādi| `sabrahmavābhravāṇām' iti| teṣāmanurūpa ātmabhāva ityarthaḥ| `adhikārthavacanena ' iti| tṛṇānāmabhyavahāro'dhikāryastadvacanena| na kiñcidityādinā vākyenādhikārthatāṃ darśayati| yo hi tṛṇānyabhyavaharati sa kathamanyadabhyavahāryya parityajyati ! nanu cāntaśabdaḥ parisamāptau varttate, tatra ca sākalyamastyeva tatkathamantavacanaṃ sākalyātpṛthagucyata ityata āha-- `{antaḥ-- kāśikā} antaśabdaḥ'ityādi| yāvato'dhyayanasya parigrahaḥ-- etāvanmayā'dhyetavyamiti-- tadapekṣayā yā samāptiḥ so'ntaḥ, sa cāsākalye'pyadhyayanasya bhavatīti sākalyāt pṛthagucyate| `sāgnyadhīte' iti| agniparyantamadhīta ityarthaḥ| agnartho granthastādarthyādagniśabdenocyate| yāvato'dhyayanasya parigrahastasyāgnirantaḥ; na tu tataḥ pareṇādhyayanameva nāstīti| tattu nādhīyata ityasākalyamatretyāha-- `iyam' ityādi| subodham|| 7. yathā'sādṛśye| (2.1.7) `ye ya vṛddhāḥ' ityanena `yathāvṛddham' ityatra yathāśabdo vīpsāyāṃ varttata ityācaṣṭe| `yathā devadattastathā yajñadattaḥ' iti| devadattasadṛśo yajñadatta ityarthaḥ| nanu ca yathāśabdo'yamupamānaṃ `yajñadatta' ityupameyamapekṣate| tatra `sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavati' ityasāmarthyādeva samāso na bhaviṣyati, tatkimarthamasādṛśya iti pratiṣedhena ? naitadasti; na hyatra yathāśabda upamānam, kiṃ tarhi ? `yathā devadattaḥ' ityeṣa samudāyaḥ| tasmāt tasyaivopameyāpekṣayā'sāmarthyam, na tu yathāśabdasya|| 8. yāvadavadhāraṇe| (2.1.8) `iyattāparicchedaḥ'iti| iyato bhāva iyattā - parimāṇam, tasyāḥ paricchedo niścayaḥ| `yāvanti pātrāṇi' ityādinā tameveyattāparicchedaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| `nāvadhārayāmi' ityādinā iyattāparicchedābhāvaṃ darśayati|| 9. suppratinā mātrārthe| (2.1.9) `vṛkṣaṃ prati' ityatra lakṣaṇe pratiśabdo varttate, na mātrārthe| nanu paraṃ subgrahaṇaṃ kamarthaṃm ? yāvatā `subāmantrite' (2.1.2) ityataḥ subgrahaṇamatuvartiṣyata ityata āha-- `subgrahaṇam' ityādi| subgrahaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ hyavyayena sambaddham; atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmādavyayanivṛttyarthamidamanyata subgrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 10. akṣaśalākāsaṃkhyāḥ pariṇā| (2.1.10) `kitavyavahāre' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ kitavavyavahāra iṣyamāṇe'pi tatra labhyate ? svabhāvata eva; samāsasya tatra vṛtteḥ|na hyarthā atidiśyante, laukikatvāt teṣām| `tasya' ityādi| tasya pātayitustasya ca vipāta ityanena sambandhaḥ| vipātaḥ - parājayaḥ| `etasya' iti| akṣādereva pratyavamarśaḥ| abhedavivakṣāyāmekavacanam| etasyānayathā pāta ityanena sambandhaḥ| `anyathā' iti| jaye ya uktaḥ pātaprakārastadapekṣayā'nyathātvaṃ vivakṣitam| `pañcasu tvekarūpāsu jaya eva bhavati' iti| pañcaparīti samaso na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| jaye hi yadakṣādīnāṃ vṛttaṃ tadapekṣayānyapātatve sati samāsena bhavitavyam| na ca pañcasvekarūpāsvanyathātvaṃ sambhavati| ata eva jayastadā bhavati yadā pañcāpyekarūpā bhavanti-- uttānā avāñco vā| etena prakāreṇa `pareṇa catuṣpari' ityatropapattirdarśitā| `pareṇa' iti| atiśayenetyarthaḥ| `akṣādayastṛtīyāntāḥ' ityādi| anyathā vṛttāvayaṃ samāsa iṣyate| tatra cākṣādināmanyathāvṛttau karttṛtvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ vā bhavati, atastṛtīyayā bhavitavyamiti tadantā eva samasyante | `pūrvoktasya' iti| akṣāderityarthaḥ| kuta etat ? akṣādayastṛtīyāntā iti pūrvamakṣāderevoktatvāt| abhedavivakṣāyāmekavacanam| ṣaṣṭhī ceyaṃ śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ vṛttaśabdāpekṣayā sambandhalakṣaṇā, vṛttaśabdastvadhyāhartavyaḥ| `yathā na tat' iti| akṣādeḥ pūrvoktasya yathā vṛttamabhūt pūrvaṃ jaye tathā vṛttaṃ yadi samprati na bhavatyevaṃ samāso bhavati , nānyathā| pūrvavṛttasyānyathātvadyotane samāso'yam, taccaikenāpi kriyate, tato dvivacanādyapekṣayā niṣprayojanamityāha-- `ekatve'kṣaśalākayoḥ' iti| akṣaśalākayorekavacanāntayorityarthaḥ| tato'yaṃ nyāyasiddha evārthaḥ ślokena saṃgṛhītaḥ| atha vā-- uttaraṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇamihāpi siṃhāvalokitanyāyena sambadhyate| sā ca vyavasthivibhāṣā| tena vacanasiddha evāyamartho veditavyaḥ| akṣādaya iti kim ? pāśakenedaṃ na tathāvṛttaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ jaye| pariṇeti kim‌ ? subantamātreṇa saha samāso mā bhūt| kitavavyavahāra iti kim ? akṣābhyāmakṣairvā na tathā vṛttaṃ yatā pūrvaṃ jaye|| 11.vibhāṣā| (2.1.11) 12. apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā| (2.1.12) `nanu bahiḥ śabdayoge na kenacitpañcamī vidhīyate, tatkathaṃ tadantena samāsa ityāha-- `bahiḥ śabdayoge' ityādi| yadetat pañcamyantena saha bahiḥ śabdasya samāsavidhānam, tajjñāpayati- bhavati hi bahiḥ śabdayoge pañcamīti| athopādānasāmarthyāt bahiḥ śabdayoge pañcamī na sambhavatītyapañcamyantenaiva subantamātreṇa samāsa ityevaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? aśakyametadvijñātum; pañcamīgrahaṇasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| tathā hi `apapari varjane' (1.4.88) ityevamapaparyoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tābhyāṃ yoge `pañcamyapāṅaparibhiḥ' (2.310) iti pañcamyaiva bhavitavyam; nānyathā vibhaktyā| `añcuśabdenāpi yoge' `anyārāt' (2.3.29) ityādinā pañcamyaiva bhavitavyamityapārthakaṃ pañcamīgrahaṇaṃ syāt. nanu cākarmapravacanīyau yāvaparī tayorapañcamyantena samāso mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pañcamīgrahaṇaṃ syāt-- parigataḥ, apagata iti ? naitadasti; paratvāddhi tayoḥ `kugatiprādayaḥ' (ra2.2.18) ititatpuruṣeṣa bhavitavyam| nanu ca nāprāpte hyetasminnayamārabhyamāṇo bādhako bhavati ? naitadasti; karmapravacanīyo yāvapaparī tatrāvakāśaḥ syāt| tatra hi karmapravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyatati| tasmādbahiḥ śabdasya pañcamyantenaiva samasāvidhānam, nānyena; anyathā pañcamīgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmātsādhūktam-- `bahiḥśabdayoge pañcamībhāvasyaitadeva jñāpakam' iti|| 13. āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ| (2.1.13) atha maryādābhividhigrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā pañcamītyanuvarttate, āṅā ca karmapravacanīyenaiva yoge pañcamī vidhīyate-- etayorevārthayoḥ `āṅa maryādāvacane' (1.4.89) ityāṅaḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā4, nānyatra; tatrāntareṇāpi maryādāvidhigrahaṇaṃ tayorevārthayo samāso bhaviṣyati, nānyatreti ? satyametat; tathāpi mandadhiyāṃ sukhāvabodhanārthaṃ maryādābhividhigrahaṇam|| 14. lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye| (2.1.14) `abhyagni, pratyagni' iti| `agnimabhi, agniṃ prati' iti vigrahaḥ| `karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā' (2.3.8) karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tvekasya `abhirabhāge' (1.4.91) ityanena| aparasya `lakṣaṇetyambhūtākhyāna' (1.4.90) ityādinā| atra cāgnirlakṣa ṇam, tena śalabhapāto lakṣyate| atrābhimukhye cābhipratī varttete; tathā hyagnyabhimukhameva śalabhāḥ patanti, nāpi pārśvataḥ, nāpi pṛṣṭhata ityartho'vagamyate| `srughnaṃ pratigataḥ' iti| srughnānmathurāṃ prasthito diṅamohāt srughnameva pratinivṛtta iti nātra srughno lakṣaṇam| yaduddiśya hi gacchati tallakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| yadā tu diṅamohādyata eva prasthitastameva pratigacchatitadā tadapratītaṃ kathaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati-- `srughnamiti ! `tathāyuktañcānīpsitam' (1.4.50) iti karmasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ karmaṇi dvitīyā| `yenāgnistena gataḥ' iti| bhavatyatrāgnirlakṣaṇamābhimukhaayamapyasti, abhipratī tu na sta iti tena yenatenaśabhdābhyāṃ saha samāso na bhavati| `abhyaṅkā gāvaḥ, pratyaṅkā gāvaḥ' iti| abhinavaḥ pratinavo'ṅka āsāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| abhiśabdo'trābhinavārthe varttate, pratiśabdaśca pratinavārthe| aṅko'tra bhavati gavāṃ lakṣaṇam, ābhimukhyantu nāsti| nanu cātra paratvādbahuvrīhiṇā bhavitavyam, ataḥ sa bādhako bhaviṣyati, kimābhimukhyagrahaṇena ? naivam; asatyābhimukhyagrahaṇe'śeṣatvāt kuto bahuvrīhirbhavati ! atha vaitajrajñāpayati-- bahuvrīhiravyayībhāvena bādhyata iti| tena dvau munī vyākaraṇamisi siddhaṃ bhavati; anyathā hi svapadārthe caritārtho'vyayībhāvo dvimuni vyākaraṇamityatrānyapadārthe paratvādbahuvrīhiṇā bādhyeta|| 15. anuryatsamayā| (1.4.15) yasya samayā yatsamayeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam| nanu ca samayāśabdayoge `abhitaḥ paritaḥ samayānikaṣā' (vā. 119) ityādagyupasaṃkhyānāddvitīyayā bhavitavyam, ataḥ ṣaṣṭhyeva tāvanna na sambhavati, kutaḥ punastasyāḥ samāsaḥ ? athāpi kathañcit ṣaṣṭhī syāt, tathāpi samayāśabdasyāvyayatvat `pūraṇaguṇa' (2.2.11) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yogagrahaṇādiha samayāśabdārthena yoge dvitīyā vijñāyate| sa cārtho mukhya eva gṛhyate, na gauṇaḥ| sa punarmukhyo'rthaḥ samīpam| na ceha samayāśabdasya mukhyo'rtho'sti, kiṃ tarhi ? gauṇo'rthaḥ| anureva samayāśabdenocyate, tasmāccheṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhyeva nyāyyā| ata eva dravyavācitvādavyayasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt `pūraṇaguṇa' (2.2.11) iti pratiṣedho nopapadyate| `anuryatsamayā' iti| etenānuśabdārthe samayāśabdo varttata iti darśayati| nanu ca samayāśabdasya samīpamarthaḥ, tatkathamanuśabdaḥ samayāśabdenocyeta ityāha-- `yasya samīpavācī'iti| etena samayāśabdārthābhidhāyitvādanuśabdaḥ samayāśabdenopacārādvyapadiṣṭa ityācaṣṭe| bhavatyupacāreṇa hi tadarthābhidhāyini tadvyapadeśaḥ, yathā-- sītāharaṇaṃ kāvyamiti| tenetyanena yasyānuśabdaḥ samayavācī sa parāmṛśyate| nanu ca so'rthaḥ, tatkutastena samāsaḥ ? arthe kāryāsambhavāt tadvācini śabde kāryaṃ vijñāyate, tathā ca tenetyasya tadvācinā śabdenetyayamartho'tra gamyate| `anuvanam' iti| tenetyanena yat ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ tena vanaśabdena samāsaḥ| vanasyānviti samīpasamīpisambandhe ṣaṣṭhyeva yuktā| `vanaṃ samayā' iti; pūrvoktenopasaṃkhyānena vanaśabdāddvitīyā| `vṛkṣamanu vidyotate vidyut' iti| atra karpravacanīyalakṣaṇā dvitīyā| anuśabdo'tra lakṣaṇe varttate, na sāmīpye|| 16. yasya cāyāmaḥ| (2.1.16) atrāpyupacāreṇāyāmavācitvādanurevāyāmaśabdanoktaḥ| `anugaṅgaṃ vārāṇasī' iti. yadyapi gaṅgāvārāṇasyāvubhe apyāyamavatyau, tathāpyāyāmavattayā gaṅgāyāḥ prasiddhatvād‌ gaṅgaivātra lakṣaṇam, na vārāṇasī| prasiddhaṃ hi lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati, nāprasiddham| tasmādgṅgayaivātra samāso bhavati, na vārāṇasyā| `yamunāyāmena gathurāyāmaḥ lakṣyate' iti| yamunayā tadvatyā lakṣaṇabhūtayeti veditavyam| yasmādyasyāyāmavācyanuśabdastena lakṣaṇabhūtena subantena samasyate| yumanāyāścāyāmavācyanuśabdaḥ, na yamunāyāmasya| na hyāyāmasyāpara āyāmo'sti, tasmādyamunāyāmeti hetāviyaṃ tṛtīyā| yamunāyāmena hetunā tadvatyā yamunayā lakṣaṇayabhūtayā karaṇabhāvamāpannayā vā mathurāyāmo lakṣyata ityayamartho veditavyaḥ|| 17. tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīni ca|(2.1.17) tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīnāṃ gaṇapāṭhādeva kṛtasādhutvānāmiha prakaraṇe saṅkīrtanamavyayībhāvasaṃjñārtham; na tu subantena samāsārtham| ata evāha-- `samudāyā eva nipātyante' iti| tathābhūtānāṃ pāṭha evaiṣāṃ nipātanam| `avyayībhāvasaṃjñakāni bhavanti' iti| anena saṃjñāmātarṃ vidhīyate, na tveṣāṃ subantena samāsa iti darśayati| `tiṣṭhadgu, bahadgu'iti| pūrvapadasya śatrādeśo nipātyate| `gostariyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvaḥ| tiṣṭhanti gāvo yasminna kāle sa tiṣṭhadgu kālaḥ| vahanti gāvo yasmin kāle sa bahadgu kālaḥ| `cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ' asati tasmin paramatiṣṭhadgviti `sanmahat' (2.1.61) ityādinā paramaśabdena samāsaḥ syāt| avadhāraṇārthe tu tasmin tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtīnītyevambhūtānyevāvatiṣṭhate| `āyatīgavam' iti| puṃvadbhāvābhāvaḥ samāsāntaśca bhavati| āyatyo gavo yasmin kāle sa āyatīgavam| `khaleyavam; khalebusam' iti| saptamyā alag nipātyate| `lūyamānayavam' iti| śānaj nipātyate| tathā `pūyamānayavam' ityatrāpi| `ete kālaśabdāḥ' iti| tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtayaḥ saṃskriyamāṇabusaparyantāḥ| `samabhūmi, samapadāti' iti| samatvaṃ bhūmeḥ, samatvaṃ padāteriti pūrvapadārthaprādhānye'vyayībhāvaḥ| uttarapadārthaprādhānyavivakṣāyāntu samapadātiḥ samabhūmiriti viśeṣaṇasamāsastatpuruṣo bhavati| anye makārāntaṃ samaśabdaṃ paṭhanti-- samambhūmi, samampadāti' iti| ` suṣamam, viṣamam, duḥṣamam,aparasamam' iti| samaśabdeneti| suṣamādayaścaite| suṣamādayaścaite pūrvapadārthaprādhānye samāsāḥ| atra śobhanatvaṃ samasyetyevamādi vākyaṃ draṣṭavyam| uttarapadārthaprādhānye tu prādisamāso viśeṣaṇasamāsaśca yathathāyogaṃ karttavyaḥ| `āyatīsamam' iti| samāśabdaḥ saṃvatsaravācī, tena samāsaḥ- āyatī samaṃ āyatīsamam| evaṃ pāpā samā pāpasamam| puṇyā samā puṣyasamam| anye tu tṛtīyāsamāsaṃ varṇayanti-- āyatyā samaṃ āyatīsamamiti; evamanyatrāpi| pragatatvamahnaḥ prāhṇam| ayamapi pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ| uttarapadārthaprādhānye tu tatpuruṣa eva bhavati-- prāhṇe kalyāṇanāmānāvetau tiṣyapunarvasū iti| evaṃ `praratham' `pradakṣiṇam' `pramṛgam' , `aparadakṣiṇam' , `samprati', `asamprati'| `ic karmavyatīhāre' (5.4.127) itīco'vyayībhāvatve prayojanamavyayasaṃjñā, napuṃsakatvañca| daṇḍaiśca daṇḍaiśca prahṛtyedaṃ yuddhaṃ vṛttimiti| `tatra tenedamiti sarūpe'(2.2.ka27) iti samāsaḥ, `ic karmavyatīhāre' (5.4.127) itīc samāsāntaḥ-- `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti dīrghaḥ, `daṇḍādaṇḍi' iti|| 18. pāre madhye ṣaṣṭhyā vā| (2.1.18) nanu ca prakṛtaiva mahāvibhāṣā tayaiva vikalpo bhaviṣyati, tatkiṃ vāgrahaṇenetyāha-- `vāvacanāt' ityādi| gatārtham| yadi tarhi vāvacanāt pakṣe ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhavati, māhavibhāṣayā kiṃ kriyata ityāha-- `mahāvibhāṣayā' ityādi|| 19. saṃkhyā vaṃśyena| (2.1.19) `ekalakṣaṇa' iti| ekasvabhāvaḥ| santānaḥ - prabandhaḥ| santānināmekalakṣaṇatvāt, santāno'pyekalakṣamo bhavati| tatar vidyayaikalakṣaṇaḥ-- vaiyākaraṇavaṃśaḥ, upādhyāyavaṃśa iti| janmanā-- brāhmaṇavaṃśaḥ, kṣatriyavaṃśa iti| `tatra bhavo vaṃśyaḥ' iti| digāditvādyat| `dvau munī' iti| pāṇinikātyāyanau| `vyākaraṇasya' iti| sambandhalakṣamā ṣaṣṭhī| `trimunivyākaraṇasya' iti| pūrvau dvau, bhāṣyakārastṛtīyaḥ| `vidyayā' iti| vyākaraṇākhyayā| `tadvatām' iti| pāṇiniprabhṛtanīnām| `abhedavivakṣā' iti| yau tau dvau munī tāveva vyākaraṇamityatiśayena vidyayā yogaṃ tayorākhyātumabhedavivakṣā yadā kriyate tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati-- dvimuni vyākaraṇamiti|| 20. nadībhiśca| (2.1.20) cakāreṇa `saṃkhyā' ityanukṛṣyate| bahuvacananirdeśenārthasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na svarūpasya, nāpi saṃjñāyāḥ, tena sarvairnadīvācibhiḥ samāso vijñāyata ityāha-- `nadīvacanaiḥ' ityādi| `samāhāre
