cāyamiṣyate' iti| cakāro'vadhāraṇe -- samāhāra eva nānyatreti| yadyevam, samāhāragrahaṇamaṃ karttavyam ? na karttavyam, yata eva hetorakṣādīnāṃ pariṇā saha kitavavyavahāra eva samāso bhavati, tataeva hetorayamapi samāhāra eva bhaviṣyati- sapta gaṅgāḥ samāhṛtāḥ saptagagṅamiti| pūrvavad hrasvaḥ| anyapadārthe tu na bhavati-- dvīrāvatīko deśa iti| `pañcanavam, saptagodāvaram'iti| kṛṣṇodakapāṇ‍ḍupūrvāyā bhūmeracpratyayaḥ smṛtaḥ| godāvaryāśca nadyāśca saṃkhyāyā uttare yadi|| iti vacanādac samāsāntaḥ|| 21. anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām| (2.1.21) `kṛṣṇaveṇṇā' iti| kṛṣṇā cāsau veṇṇā ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `śīghragaṅgaḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| 22. tatpuruṣaḥ| (2.1.22) `kaṣṭaśritaḥ' iti| tatpuruṣasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha'(6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam| atha kimarthamiyaṃ mahatī saṃjñā vidhīyata ityāha-- `pūrvācāryasaṃjñā ceyam' iti| tadaṅgīkaraṇaṃ kimarthamityāha-- `tadaṅgīkaraṇam' ityādi| upādhiḥ - viśeṣaṇam| kaḥ punarasau tadīya upādhirityāha-- uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ' iti|| 23. dviguśca| (2.1.23) `samāsāntāḥ prayojanam' iti| `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ' (5.4.86) ityatastatpuruṣa ityanuvarttamāne `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91) `gorataddhitaluki' (5.4.92) iti ca dvigorapi yathā syāt| `pañcarājī' iti| pañcānāṃ rājñāṃ samāhāra iti `taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti samāsaḥ| `saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ' (2.1.52) iti dvigusaṃjñā, ṭac, `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ `akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' (vā.156) iti strīliṅgatā, `dvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīp| `dvahyahaḥ, tryahaḥ' iti| `ahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.145) iti ṭilopa), `rātrahnāhāḥ puṃsi'(2.4.29) iti puṃstvam| `pañcagavam' iti| `sa napuṃsakam' (2.4.17) iti napuṃsakatvam| satyapyakārāntatve strītvaṃ na bhavati; `pātrādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' (vā.1.5.9) iti vacanāt|| 24. dvitīyā śritātītapatitagatyāstaprāptāpannaiḥ| (2.1.24) `śritādiṣu' ityādi| śritādiṣu samāsakāraṇatvenopātteṣu satsu gamigāmyādīnāṃ samāsasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| etairapi samāsaḥ pratipādayitavyaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-`dvitīyā' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena gamigāmiprabhṛtibhirapi samāso bhavati| na caivaṃ śritādigrahaṇanarthakam; pūrvaviṣayasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārthatvāt| ādiśabdaḥ prakāravācī| gamigāmiśabdayorekataropādānenaiva siddhe dvayorupādānamuṇādīnāmanyeṣāñca yathā syāt; anyathā yadi gamigrahaṇameva kriyeta tadā''diśabdasya prakāravācitvāt gamiprakārāṇāmuṇādīnāmeva grahaṇaṃ syāt| atha gāmigrahaṇameva kriyeta, tadā gāmiprakārāṇāmuṇādīnāṃ syāt| tasmāddvayorapi grahaṇaṃ karttavyam| `grāmaṃ gamī'iti| `gamerini' (da.u.6.57) itīnipratyayaḥ| sa ca bhaviṣyatkāle; `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' (3.3.3) iti vacanāt| `grāmaṃ gamī' iti| `āvaśyakādhamarṇyayoḥ' (3.3.170) ityāvaśyame ṇiniḥ| `akenorbhaviṣaayadādharmarṇyayoḥ' (2.3.70) iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ| `odanaṃ bubhukṣuḥ' iti| bhujeḥ sannantāt `sanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ' (3.2.168) ityupratyayaḥ| ka`na loka ' (2.3.69)ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ| kaṣṭaṃ śrita ityādāvapyanenaiva ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ| 25. svayaṃ ktena| (2.1.25) `tasya dvitīyayā saha sambandho nopapadyate' iti| dvitīyārthāsambhavāt| itiśabdo hetau| yatastasya dvitīyayā saha sambandho'nupapannastasmāddvitīyāgrahaṇamuttarārthamanuvarttate, na tvetadartham| `svayaṃdhautau pādau' iti| `dhāvu gatiśuddhayoḥ' (dhā.pā.601), asyodittvādvibhāṣiteṭ| `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `cchavoḥ śūḍanunāsike caṭa (6.4.19) ityūṭh| `etyedhatyūṭhasu' (6.1.89) iti vṛddhiḥ| `svayaṃvilīnamākhyam' iti| `līṅa śleṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1139), `svādaya oditaḥ' (kā.8.2.45) ityodittvāt `oditaśca' (8.2.45) iti natvam| `kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.126) iti gatipūrvasyāpi samāso bhavati| kaḥ punaratra samāse sati viśeṣaḥ yāvatā vināpi tenaitadrūpaṃ sidhyatītyāha-- `aikapadyam' ityādi|| 26. khaṭvā kṣepe| (2.1.26) `sa ca' ityādi| evakāreṇa vākyārthatāṃ kṣepasya nirasyati| syādetat-- vākyārtho'pi kṣepaḥ; tena vākyamapi bhaviṣyatītyāha-- `na hi' ityādi| vākyena hi kriyākārakasambandhamātraṃ gamyate, na tu kṣepaḥ| `khaṭvārohaṇañca' ityādi| viruddho mārgaḥ - vimārgaḥ,tena prasthānam - gamanam| adhītya snātvā guruṇābhyanujñātena khaṭvā'roḍhavyā| yattvanyathā khaṭvārohaṇaṃ tadvimārgaprasthanam| na tu khaṭvārohaṇameva| iha ca `khaṭvārūḍhaḥ' ityādau khaṭvārohaṇaṃ vimārgaprasthānasyopalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇameva vijñāyata ityāha-- `sarva eva' ityādi| ārūḍha ityāṅapūrvasya ruheḥ ktapratyaye ḍhatvadhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopadīrgheṣu kṛteṣu rūpam| jālma ityayuktakārītyarthaḥ| 27. sāmi| (2.1.27) `asattvavācitvāt' iti| dravyādhārā hi karmaśaktiḥ| ato dravyavācina eva dvitīyayā sambandho bhavati, nāsattvavācinaḥ|| 28. kālāḥ| (2.1.28) `carācarāḥ' iti| anatyantasaṃyogapratipādanārtham| caranti bhramantīti carācarāḥ, anavasthitā ityarthaḥ| `caricalipativadīnamacyākcābhyāsasya' (vā.658) iti careḥ pacādyaci dvirvacanamabhyāsasyākcāgamaśca| `kadācidahargacchanti' ityuttarāyaṇe| `kadācidrātrim' iti dakṣiṇāyane| etena tadevānavasthitatvaṃ vyaktīkurvannahno rātreśca tairmuhūrtairanatyantasaṃyogamācaṣṭe| `aharatisṛtāḥ' iti| `ro'supi' (8.2.69) ityahno nakārasya rephaḥ| `ahaḥ saṃkrāntāḥ' iti| `kramu pādavikṣepe' (dhā.pā.473),pūrvapadiṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ' (6.4.15) iti dīrghaḥ| `māsapramitaḥ' iti| `māṅa māne' (dhā.1088), `ādikarmaṇi karttari ca' (3.4.71) iti karttari niṣṭhā| `dyatisyati' (7.4.40) ityādinettvam| `māsaṃ pramātumārabdhaḥ' iti. māsasyaikadeśasya pratipadaścandramasā yogaṃ darśayan māsasya tenātyantasaṃyogamācaṣṭe| kālasya hi kṛtsnasya svena sambandhinā vyāptiḥ - atyantasaṃyogaḥ| na ca pratipaccandramā māsasyeha vyāptiḥ - saṃyogo'stīti nehātyantasaṃyogaḥ| 29. atyantasaṃyoge ca| (2.1.29) `kṛtsnasaṃyogaḥ' iti| kṛtsnasya saṃyogaḥ kṛtsnasaṃyogaḥ, kṛtsnasya kālasya muhūrttādeḥ svena sambandhinā - sukhādinā saṃyoga - sambandho'tyantasaṃyogaḥ| etadeva spaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `kālasya' ityādi| `muhūrta sukham' iti| `kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā| atra muhūrtas kālasya svena sambandhinā sukhena vyāptiḥ| 30. tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena guṇavacanena| (2.1.30) `tatkṛta' iti| etadarthaśabdenāsamastameva, avibhaktiñca| tṛtīyāvibhakteḥ `supāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) iti luptatvāt| etacca guṇavacanenetyasya samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam| ata eva kīdṛśeneti pṛṣṭaḥ sannāha-- `tatkṛtena' iti| taditi sarvanāmnā prakṛtasya tṛtīyāntasya pratyavamarśa iti tṛtīyāntakṛteneti darśayati| tṛtīyāntena guṇavacanasya karaṇatvaṃ na sambhavatītyataḥ sāmarthyāt tadarthakṛteneti vijñāyata ityata āha-- `tṛtīyāntārthakṛteneti yāvat' iti| arthadvāreṇa cedaṃ guṇavacanasya viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam- tṛtīyāntārthakṛto guṇavacanārtha iti| so'pi tathocyate| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- tṛtīyāntārthakṛtena guṇavacanārtheneti| artha eva hi tṛtīyāntārthena kriyate, na ca guṇavacanaśabdaḥ| guṇamuktavān - guṇavacanaḥ| ` kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.13) iti karttari lyuṭ| atha vā-- karaṇe, guṇa ukto'neneti guṇavacanaḥ| yaśca pūrva guṇe vartitvā paścāt tadvati dravye varttate sa guṇavacanaḥ| guṇenetyucyamāne ghṛtena pāṭavamityādau prasaṅgaḥ, atastannivṛttyarthaṃ vacanagrahaṇam| tasmiṃśca sati guṇe vartitvā tadvati dravye yo varttate tenaiva samāso bhavati, na tu guṇa eva yo varttate tena saha| na ca pāṭavādayaḥ śabdāḥ pūrvaṃ guṇe vartitvā paścāt tadvati dravye varttante, api tu guṇa eva| vacanagrahaṇāt taiḥ saha samāso na bhavati| `śaṅkulākhaṇḍaḥ, girikāṇaḥ' iti| khaṇḍakāṇaśabdāvatra khaṇḍanena nimīlane ca kriyārūpāpanne guṇe vartitvā paścānmatublopādabhedopacārādvā tadvati dravye vartate iti guṇavacanau bhavataḥ| `dhānyārthaḥ' iti| bhavutyayamarthaśabdastatkṛtaḥ, tathā hi sa gobhirvapāvān kṛtaḥ| na tu vapāvānityayaṃ śabdo guṇamuktavāmiti na guṇavacanaḥ, tatastena saha samāso na bhavati|| 31. pūrvasadṛśasamonārthakalahanipuṇamiśraślakṣṇaiḥ| (2.1.31) yuktaḥ samasadṛśaśabdābhyāṃ samāsaḥ, yāvātā tābhyāṃ yoge `tulyārtheratulopamābhyām' (2.3.72) iti tṛtīyāvidhānam, itaraistu pūrvādibhiḥ kathaṃ tṛtīyāsamāsa upapadyate ? na hi tadyoge kenacittṛtīyā vihitā ityāha `asmādeva' ityādi| subodham| `pūrvādiṣvavarasyopasaṃkhyānam' iti| pūrvādiṣu samāsakāraṇatvenopātteṣu satsvavaraśabdasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| avaraśabdenāpi tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ pratipadyata ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- uttarasūtre bahulagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tenāvaraśabdenāpi samāso bhavati|| 32. karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam| (2.1.32) `bhikṣābhiruṣitaḥṭa iti| hetau (2.3.23) tṛtīyā vihitā| vaservacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam, `śāsivasighasīnāñca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam, `vasatikṣudhoḥ' (7.2.ka52) itīṭ| `dātreṇa dhānyaṃ lūnavān' iti| `lvādibhyaśca' (8.2.44) iti niṣṭhānatavam| `pādahārakaḥ' iti| pādābhyāṃ hriyata iti pādāhārakaḥ| pādābhyāmiti pañcamī caturthī vā| hāraka iti `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti karmaṇi ṇvul| `galecopakaḥ' iti| gale cupyata iti| `cupa mandāyāṃ gatau' (dhā.pā. 403) ityasmāt pūrvavadeva ṇvul| `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' (6.3.14) ityulak|| 33. kṛtyairadhikārthavacane| (2.1.33) `stutinindāprayuktam' iti| stutyā nindayā vā yat prayuktaṃ pravarttitaṃ tat stutinindāprayuktam| tadarthamuccāritamityarthaḥ| `adhyāropitārthavacanam' iti| adhyāropito'rtho'sanneva buddhyā samāropitastasya vacanamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `kṛrttṛkaraṇayoḥṭa iti| arthe kāryāsambhavāt tadabhidhāyini subante kāryaṃ vijñāyate| `kākapeyā' iti| `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925) iti `aco yat' (3.1.97) `īdyati' (6.4.65) īttvam| atra sampūrṇatoyatvodbhāvanaṃ nadyāḥ stutiḥ, adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthaḥ kākapeyatvam-- evaṃ nāma sampūrṇatoyā nadī yattaṭasthairapi kākaiḥ śakyā pātum| `śvalehyaḥ kūpaḥ' iti| `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) atrāpyāsannodakatvodbhāvanaṃ kūpasya stutiḥ| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthaḥ śvalehyatvam-- evaṃ nāmāsannodakaḥ kūpo yataḥ śnabhirapi lihyate| `bāṣpacchedyāni tṛṇāni' iti| atra māradvātiśayodbhāvanaṃ tṛṇānāṃ stutiḥ| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārtho bāṣpacchedyatā-- evaṃ nāma mṛdūni tṛṇāni yadbāṣpeṇāpi śakyāni chettum| `kaṇṭakasañceya odanaḥ' iti| atrāpi vaiṣadyātiśayodbhāvanaṃ viklinnatodbhāvaऩñcaudanasya stutiḥ| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthaḥ kaṇṭakasañceyatvam-- evaṃ nāmaudanasya viśadatātiśayo vikledaśca yatkaṇṭakenāpi śakyaḥ sañcetum| evaṃ tāvat stutiprayukte'dhikāryavacana udāharaṇāni| nindāprayukte'dhikārthavacana etāvantyeva draṣṭavyāni| tathā hi-- kākeyā nadītyatrālpatoyatvodbhāvanaṃ nadyā nindā| adhyāropitaḥ punaratrārthastadeva pūrvoktaṃ kākapeyatvam, evaṃ śvalehyādāvapi pūrvokta evādhyāropito'rtho draṣṭavyaḥ-- evaṃ nāmālpatoyā nadī yatkākairapi śakyaṃ pātumiti| śvalehyaḥ kūpa ityatrāpyaśuddhatoyatvodbhāvanaṃ nindā- evaṃ nāmālpa odano yatkaṇṭakairapi cīyata iti| nanu ca bahulavacanādadhikārtho'pi pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ samāsaḥ, tatkimarthamidamityāha-- `pūrvasya' ityādi| te vai vidhayaḥ susaṃgṛhītā yeṣāṃ prapañcaśceti| susaṃgṛhītaṃ yathā syāditi pūrvasyāyaṃ prapañca kriyate|| 34. annena vyañcanam| `dadhyodanaḥ' iti| nanu ca kriyākṛtaḥ kārakāṇāṃ sambandha-, na tu svataḥ| na ca vṛttāviha kācana kriyā śrūyata iti sāmarthyābhāvaḥ| asati ca sāmarthye samāsābhāvaḥ| athāsatyapi sāmarthye vacanasāmarthyāt samāso bhavatīti cedāsyatāṃ dadhnā, odano bhujyatāṃ devadattenetyatrāpi syādityata āha-- `vṛttau' ityādi| na hyasatyāmupasecanakriyāyāṃ saṃskāryaṃ saṃskārakaṃ sambhavati| asti ceha tadubhayamityatastadbhāvādeva samāsāntarbhūtā kriyā gamyate| taddvārakaścānnavyañjanayoḥ sambandha iti vidyata eva sāmarthyam|| 35. bhakṣyeṇa miśrīkaraṇam| (2.1.35) `miśrīkaraṇam' iti| amiśraṃ miśraṃ kriyate'neneti miśrīkaraṇam| `kharaviśadamabhyavahārya bhakṣyam' iti| tatraiva bhakṣyaśabdasya rūḍhatvāt|| 36. caturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharakṣitaiḥ| (2.1.36) `tadarthena' ityādi| yadi tādarthyamātre samāsaḥ syāt, balirakṣitagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tathā hi-- kuberabaliḥ,gorakṣitamityatrāpi tādarthyaṃ gamyatata eva| tasamādbalirakṣitagrahaṇālliṅgāt `tādarthye prakṛtivikārabhāve samāso bhavati' iti vijñāyate| nanu ca sampradāne caturthyarthaṃ balirakṣitagrahaṇaṃ syāt, naitadasti; dadātikarmaṇā hi abhipreyamāṇasya kriyayā vā sampradānasaṃjñeṣyate, na ceha dadātikarmaṇā kriyayā vā'bhipreyamāṇatā'sti, tatkutaḥ sampradāne caturthī ? kena punastādarthye caturthī bhavatītyāha-- `asmādeva' ityādi| yadi tādarthye caturthī na syāt, tadā tadarthagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmādyadetat, tadarthena caturthyantasya samāsavidhānaṃ tadeva jñāpakam-- tādarthye caturthī bhavatīti| `arthena' ityādi| karttavyamiti śeṣaḥ| nityasamāsa ucyate - kathyate, yena tannityasamāsavacanaṃ vyākhyātavyam| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yenārthaśabdena nityasamāsaḥ pratyāyyate tadvayākhyānaṃ karttavyamiti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenārthaśabdena nityasamāso bhaviṣyati, sarvaliṅgatā ceti| `paravallaliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ' (2.4.26) iti paravalliṅgatāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ sarvaliṅgatā vidhīyate| eṣā tu lokāśrayatvālliṅgasyeti siddhā| atha vā -- bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ sarvametat siddham| gohitam, gosukhamiti `caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣya' (2.3.73) ityādinā caturthī| hitayoge tvanāśiṣyapi caturthī bhavati| tathā hi vakṣyati-- `hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā' (vā. 123) iti| 37. pañcamī bhayena| (2.1.37) `bhayabhītabhītibhībhiriti vaktavyam' iti| evaṃ hi tribhirapi bhītādibhiḥ samāso bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| svayameva vyākhyātumāha-- `pūrvasya' ityādi| yathaiva hi `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (2.1.32) iti tṛtīyāntasya samāso vidhīyamāno bahulagrahaṇasya sarvopādhivyabhicārārthatvādanyavibhaktyantasyāpi samāso bhavati-- pādahārakaḥ, galecopaka iti, tathā vṛkabhīta ityādāvapi samāso bhaviṣyati| tasmāt pūrvakasya bahulagrahaṇassayaivodāharaṇapradarśanārtho'yaṃ yogaḥ prapañcārtho veditavyaḥ| `tathā ca' ityādi| yasmāt pūrvakeṇaiva bahulagrahaṇena siddhaṃ tasyaivāyamprapañcaḥ; tasmāttata eva bahulagrahaṇāt `grāmanirgataḥ' ityādyapi siddhaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdena vṛkabhītādergrahaṇam|| 38.apetāpoḍhamuktapatitāpatrastairalpaśaḥ| (2.1.38) `alpaśaḥ' iti| `bahvalpārthācchas kārakādanyatarasyām' (5.4.42) iti śas| `alpā pañcamī samasyate' iti|| alpebhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ utpannā yā pañcamī sā samasyate, na tu sarvebhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ ityarthaḥ|| 39. stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchrāṇi ktena| (2.1.39) `stokānmuktaḥ; kṛcchrānmuktaḥ' iti| `karaṇe stokālpakṛcchra' (2.3.33) ityādinā pañcamī| `antikādāgataḥ, dūrādāgataḥ' iti| dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca' (2.3.35) ityanena|| 40. saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ| (2.1.40) śauṇḍairiti bahuvacananirdeśādādyartho gamyata ityāha-- `śauṇḍādibhiḥ' ita| kena punarvihitāyāṃ saptamyāṃ tadantasya śauṇḍādibhiḥ samāso vidhīyate ? `saptamyadhikaraṇe ca' (2.3.36) ityaneneti cet, vārttametat| tathā hyadhikaraṇaṃ kārakam, tacca kriyāpekṣam| na cākṣaśauṇḍa ityādau vṛttau kācana kriyā śrūyate| tatkuto'dhikaraṇasyeha sambhavaḥ ? na ca śakyate vaktum‌-- asmādeva vacanācchauṇḍādibhiryoge saptamī bhaviṣyatīti, devadattaḥ śauṇḍa ityatrāpi prasaṅghaḥ syādityata āha-- `vṛttau' ityādi. astyevātra prasaktikriyā| sā tu samāsārtha evāntarbhūtetigamyamānatvāddvṛtau kriyāpadaṃ na prayujyate| tasyā yatsādhanamadhikaraṇaṃ tatra saptamītyadoṣaḥ| antaḥ śabdastvatrādhikaraṇapradhāna eva paṭhyate| tasya prayoge tatsāmānādhikaraṇyameva saptamyāḥ kāraṇam| vane'ntarvanāntarvasatīti pūrvapadārthapradhānye tu `vibhaktyarthe yadavyayam' (2.1.6) ityavyayībhāva eva bhavatiḥ- antarvaṇamiti| adhiśabdo'tra paṭhyate-- tasyādhikaraṇaprādhānye satyavyayībhāvaḥ- adhistri| ādheyaprādhānye tu tatpuruṣaḥ-- brāhmaṇeṣvapi brāhmaṇādhīna iti| brāhmaṇādhiśabdaḥ kevalo na prayujyate| `aṣaḍakṣāśita' (5.4.7) ityādinā'dhyuttarapadāt svārthikasya nityasya khasya vidhānāt|| 41. siddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiśca| (2.1.41) 42. dhvāṅkṣeṇa kṣepe| (2.1.42) `dhvāṅakṣeṇetyarthagrahaṇam' iti| arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| yatra hi śabdapradhāno nirdeśastatra svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavati, anyatra tvarthagrahaṇameveti pratipāditametat prāk| arthapradhānatvantu nirdeśasyāvicchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśādvijñāyate| bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterarthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vā| api ca `kṣepe' ityucyate, kṣepaścārthakārita evetyarthagrahaṇameva yuktam| arthagrahaṇe ca sati dhvāṅakṣaparyāyairapi samāso bhavati, ata āha-- `dhvāṅakṣavācinā' ityādi| `tīrthe dhvāṅakṣa iva' iti| upamānabhāve sati dhvāṅakṣasya kṣepo gamyate,nānyatheti darśayitumivaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ| samāse tu samāsa evopamānārthasyāntarbhūtatvādivaśabdo gatārtho na prayujyate| yathaiva hi tīrtha dhvāṅakṣaściraṃ sthātāro na bhavanti, tadvadanyo'pi yaḥ kāryaṃ pratyanavasthitaḥ sa `tīrthadhvāṅakṣaḥ' ityucyate, yadāha-- `anavasthita ityarthaḥ' iti| kāryaṃ pratyanavasthitatvameva kṣepaḥ|| 43. kṛtyairṛṇe| (2.1.43) `yapratyayāntenaiva samāsa iṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punaryatpratyayenaiva labhyate ? alpaśa ityanuvṛtteḥ, `māsadeyam' iti| pūrvavadyat, īttvañca| saptamī hyatraupaśleṣike'dhikaraṇe veditavyā| māse hyatīte yo'ntaro divasaḥ sa māsaṃ pratyupaśliṣṭo bhavati, `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣamam' (2.3.37) ityanena vā| māsātikramaṇabhāvena hi ṛṇadānabhāvo lakṣyate| atha ṛṇa ityucyate, tatredaṃ na sidhyati-- pūrvohṇegeyaṃ sāma, prātaradhyeyo'nuvākaḥ, ityata āha-- `ṛṇam' ityādi| ṛṇaṃ hi niyogato niryātayitavyamiti niyogasahacaritam| ataḥ sāhacaryāt tena niyogo'vaśyambhāva upalakṣyate| etacca `kṛtyaiḥ' iti bahuvacananiradeśālliṅgādgamyate| katham ? `kṛtyaiḥ' iti bahuvacanamatra vivakṣitam, tacca ṛṇagrahaṇasya niyogopalakṣaṇārthatve prakṛtibhedena| bhidyamāne kṛtye sati prasajyate, na tvanyathā| yatpratyayasyaikatvāt tenaiva samāsasyeṣṭatvāt|| 44. saṃjñāyām| (2.1.44) `samudāyopādhiḥ' iti| `saṃjñāyām' iti nedaṃ pūrvapadasyottarapadasya vā viśeṣaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? samudāyasya-- samudāyena cetsaṃjñā gamyata iti| kimevaṃ sati sidhyatītyata āha-- `tena' ityādi| atraivopapattimāha-- `na hi' ityādi|| 45. ktenāhorātrāvayavāḥ| (2.1.45) `etattu te divāvṛttaṃ rātrau vṛttañca drakṣyasi' ityādi. nātrāharavayavāḥ rātryavayavāśca santi, kiṃ tarhi ? kṛtsnamevāhaḥ, kṛtsnā ca rātririti, teneha samāso na bhavati || 46. tatra| (2.1.46) `tatretyetat saptamyantam' iti| saptamīsādharmyāt| tral‌pratyaya evātra saptamīśabdenoktaḥ| bhavati hi tāddharmyāt tācchabdyam| yathā-- gaurvāhīka iti| saptamīsādharmyaṃ punastralo'dhikaraṇārthatvāt. yathaiva hyadhikaraṇapratyāyanāya saptamī prayujyate,tathā tralapi| atha mukhyaiva saptamīvibhaktiḥ kasmānna vijñāyate ? tasyāstatraśabde'sambhavāt| asambhavastu tralaiva tadarthasya dyotittavāt| anyastvāha-- yadā vibhaktyādaśāstralādayastadā sthānivadbhāvenaivaitat saptamyantaṃ bhavati| ādeśapakṣasatu tatra vṛttikṛtā nāśrita ityasamyagetat| antaśabdaścātrāvayavavacanaḥ| saptamītralpratyayo'nto'vayavo yasya tattathoktam|| 47. kṣepe| (2.1.47) `avataptenakulasthitam' iti| `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' (6.3.14) iti saptamyā aluk| kaḥ punaratra kṣepaḥ ? kāryeṣvanavasthitatā| yadāha-- `etaccāpalam' ityādi| yathā avatapte deśe nakulā na ciraṃ sthātāro bhavanti, tadvadanyo'pi yo'rthānārabhya na ciraṃ teṣvavatiṣṭhate taṃ pratīdamucyate-- avataptenakulasthitamiti| `udakaṃ viśīrṇam' ityādāvapyārambhasya niṣphalatā kṣepaḥ| ata evāha-- `niṣphalaṃ yatkriyate tadevamucyate' iti| `pravāhe mūtritam' iti| `mūtra prasravaṇe' (dhā.pā.1909) curādiḥ|| 48. pātresamitādayaśca| (2.1.48) `yuktārohyāviparigrahārthaḥ' iti| yuktārohyādiṣu yuktārohyādibhirvā parigarho'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya pāṭhasya sa tathokkataḥ| kimarthaṃ punaryuktārohyādiṣu parigrahasteṣāmiṣyata ityāha-- `pūrvapadādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt' iti yuktārohyādīnāṃ hi `yuktārohyādayaśca' (6.2.81) ityanena pūravapadādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| tatra yadi ye ktāntāste na paṭhyeran, tadā teṣāmādyudāttatvaṃ na syāt| kathaṃ punaḥ pātresamitādayo yuktārohyādigrahaṇena gṛhyante; yatasteṣāṃ vidhīyamānamādyudāttatvaṃ pātresamitādīnamapi bhavatītyāha-- `yuktārohyādiṣu hi' ityādi| `udumbaramaśakādiṣūpamayā kṣepaḥ' iti| yastatraivāvaruddho na kvacid‌gacchati tamava viśiṣṭacaṃ manyate-- nāsmātparamastīti, so'dṛṣṭavistāra ucyata udumbaramaśaka iti| evamanyatrāpyapamānāt kṣepaḥ| `pratiṣiddhasevanena' iti| yaḥ kaścit pratiṣiddhamācarati sa `mātaripuruṣaḥ' ityucyate| `nirīhatayā' iti| yo na kiñcit kartuṃ samarthaḥ sa `piṇḍīśūraḥ' ityevamādibhiḥ padairabhidhīyate| `cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ' iti| pātresamitādaya eva yatā syuḥ, yadanyat samāsāntaraṃ teṣāṃ prāpnoti tanmā bhūditi| tena paramapātresamitā iti `sanmahat' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāsāntaraṃ na bhavati|| 49. pūrvakālaikasarvajaratpurāṇanavakevalāḥ samānādhikaraṇena| (2.1.49) `bhinnapravṛttinimittaprayuktasya' ityādi| bhinnapravṛttinimittagrahaṇaṃ paryāyanivṛttyartham| ekagrahaṇaṃ gauraśva ityādinivṛttyartham| `pūrvakāla ityarthanirdeśaḥ' iti| arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| tena svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `pariśiṣṭānāṃ svarūpagrahaṇam' iti| śabdapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| `pūrvakālo'parakālena' iti| kutaḥ punaranukto'pyeṣo'rthaviśeṣo labhyate; sambandhiśabdatvāt pūrvakālasya ? na hyanapekṣyāparakālaṃ pūrvakālaṃ sambhavati; ataḥ pūrvakālaparigrahe kṛte satyaparakālasyāpi parigrahaḥ kṛta eva| `snānānuliptaḥ' iti. pūrvaṃ snātaḥ paścādanulipta ityatra snātaśabdaḥ snānena nimittena prayuktaḥ, anuliptaśabdo'nulepanena; tayoścaikatrārthe vṛttirityasti sāmānādhikaraṇyam| `ekaśāṭī' iti| ekā cāsau śāṭī ceti `puṃtkarmadhāraya' (6.3.42) ityādinā puṃvadbhāvaḥ|| 50. diksaṃkhyaṃ saṃjñāyām| (2.1.50) `pūrveṣukāmaśamītyādiḥ' grāmāṇāṃ saṃjñā| pūrvā cāsāviṣukāmaśamī ceti pūrveṣukāmaśamī| mandaśriyāṃ pūrvottarapadavibhāgamātrapradarśanārthaṃ vākyaṃ kṛtam| na hyatra vākyena bhavitavyam| na hi vākyena saṃjñā gamyate|| 51.taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca| (2.1.51) ekasyā api saptamyā viṣayabhedena bhedaṃ darśayitumāha-- `taddhitārthe viṣaye' ityādi| yadi taddhitārthe'bhidheya ityevaṃ vijñāyeta, tadā pāñcanāpitirityādau taddhito durlabhaḥ syāt| tadarthasya samāsenaivoktatvādityetanmanasi kṛtvā taddhitārthāpekṣayā viṣayasaptamīyamiti darśayituṃ `taddhitārthe viṣaye' ityuktam| taddhitāḥ - aṇādayaḥ, teṣāmartho'patyādiḥ, tasmin viṣaye| ananyatrabhāvo viṣayaśabdasyārthaḥ, yathā-- matsyānāṃ jalaṃ viṣaḥ iti| `paurvaśālaḥ' iti| pūrvasyāṃ śalāyāṃ bhava iti taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte prāk samāsaḥ| tataḥ subluk| tatastaddhitaḥ| `pūrvaśālāpriyaḥ' iti| pūrvā śālā priyā'syeti pūrvaṃ padānāṃ trayāṇāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| paścāt priyaśabde uttarapade parataḥ parvayoḥ padayostatpuruṣaḥ| tasmin sati samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati śāletyatra| `samāhāre {dikśabdaḥ iti mūlapāṭhaḥ, padamañjarī ca| } diṅa na sambhavati' iti| samāhāro hi samūhaḥ| sa ca bhinnārthānāmevaikakālānāṃ bhavati. buddhyā yugapadārthānāṃ parigrahādekakālatvam, na tvabhinnavastunaḥ| saṃkhaayaiva ca bhedamācaṣṭe; tasyā bhinnārthābhidhāyitvāt, na tu dikśabdaḥ; tasya pratiniyataviṣayatvāt| tasmāt samāhāre dikśabdona sambhavatīti sa na tatra samasyate| `pañcānāpitiḥ' iti| pañcānāṃ nāpitānāmapatyamiti taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte prāk samāsaḥ| paścāt `ata iñ' (4.1. 95)| `pañcakapālaḥ' iti| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛta iti taddhitārthe viṣayabhūte pūrvaṃ samāsaḥ; paścādaṇ| tasya `dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) iti luk| `{pañcagavadhanam iti mudrita pāṭhaḥ}pañcagavadhanaḥ' iti| pañca gāvo dhanamasyeti prāk trayāṇāṃ padānāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| uttarakālaṃ dhanaśabda uttarapade parataḥ pūrvayoḥ padayostatpuruṣaḥ| tasmin sati `gorataddhitaluki' (5.4.92) iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ| tatra hi `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ' (5.4.86) ityatastatpuruṣagrahaṇamanuvarttate| `pañcapūlī'iti| pañcānāṃ pūlānāṃ samahāra iti vigrahaḥ| `dvigurekavacanam' (2.4.1.) ityekavadbhāvaḥ| `akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' (vā.156) iti strīliṅgatā; `dvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīp| nanu samāhāraḥ - samūhaḥ, samūhaśca taddhitakārtho bhavatītyapārthakaṃ samāhāragrahaṇam; taddhitārtha ityeva siddhatvāt ? naitadasti; pañcakumārītyatra hi samūhapratyayasya `dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.21) iti luki kṛte `luk taddhitaluki' (1.2.49) iti strīpratyayasyāpi luk syāt| samāhāre tu pṛthaggṛhīte taddhitānutpattirevātra viṣaye samākhyāyate| tato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| pañcānāṃ kumārīṇāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcamakumāri| `ekavibhakticāpūrvanipāte' (1.2.44) ityupasarjanasaṃjñāyām `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvatvam| kathaṃ punaratraikavibhaktatvam ? ṣaṣṭhyaivaikayā yogāt| tathā hi samāhāraḥ samūhaḥ, tena ca tatsambandhe ṣaṣṭhyaiva bhavitavyam| ataḥ samāhāraḥ kumā4rīṇām, samāhāraṃ kumārīṇāṃ paśya, samāhāreṇa kumārīṇāmityevamādibhiranekābhirvibhaktibhiryujyamāne'pi samāhāraśabde kumārīśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhyaivaikayā yujyata ityekavibhaktikatvam||va 52. sakhyāpūrvo dviguḥ| (2.1.52) `samāsānto bhavati' iti| ṭac| `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91) ityuvṛtteḥ|| 53. kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ| (2.1.53) kutsitaśabdo'yamiha rūḍhimācaṣṭe| tathā ca niṣṭhā bhūtakālaṃ nopādatte| kutsanaśabdena ca kutsāhaturdharmo gṛhyate-- kutsyate garhyate'neneti kṛtvā| bahuvacananirdeśastu svarūpavidhernirāsārthaḥ| tena kutsitavādinā kutsanavacanaiḥ saha samāso vijñāyate, na tu kutsitaśabdasya kutsanaśabdena| ata āha-- `kutsitavācīni' ityādi| śabdapravṛttinimittakutsāyāmayaṃ samāso veditavyaḥ| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate ? pratyāsatteḥ| śabdasya hi pravṛttinimittaṃ pratyāsannam, atastat kutsāyāmeva samāsena bhavituṃ yuktam| `vaiyākaraṇakhasūciḥ' iti| vaiyākaraṇaścāsau khasūciśceti vigrahaḥ| yaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ san vyākaraṇe khamākāśaṃ sūcayatīti nirīkṣate niṣpratibho bhavati sa evamucyate| atra hi vaiyākaraṇatvaṃ vaiyākaraṇaśabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ tat kutsyate; tatpunaḥ vyākaraṇādhyetṛsambandhaḥ, vyākaraṇaveditṛsambandho vā.tena hi nimittena vaiyākaraṇaśabdo puruṣe varttate| evamanyatrāpi śabdapravṛttinimittakutsāyāṃ samāso veditavyaḥ| `yājñikakitavaḥ' iti. kitava iva kitavaḥ| yathā hi kitavaḥ kiṃ tavāstīti dhanavattāmātramapekṣamāṇo dyūte pravarttate, na tu tasya jātyādikamapekṣate; tathā yājñiko'pi yājane pravarttamāno yastṛṣṇayā'yājyasya dhanavatāmātramapekṣate, na tu tasya yāgārhatāṃ sa yājñikakitava ityucyate| ata āha- `ayājyayājanatṛṣṇāpara ucyate' iti| `mīmāṃsakadurdurūḍhaḥ' iti. mīmāṃsako mīmāṃsādhyayanaphalamanavāpya nāstiko jāta iti pratīyate| `vaiyākaraṇaścauraḥ' iti| nanu cauratvena garhyamāṇo vaiyākaraṇaḥ kutsito bhavatyeva| tadabhiṣāyī ca vaiyākaraṇaśabdaḥ | tatkathamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupapadyata ityāha-- `na hyatra ' ityādi| pratyāsatterhi śabdapravṛttinimittasya kutsāyāṃ sasāsena bhavitavyam| na ceha vaiyākaraṇaśabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ kutsyate; yasmāccauro'pi samyak vyākaraṇaṃ vettyadhīte vā| tasmānnātra śabdapravṛttinimittaṃ kutsyate, kiṃ tarhi ? yatra tadvaiyākaraṇatvaṃ varttate sa kutsyate, vaiyākaraṇatvantu tasyopalakṣaṇameva kevalam, yo'sau vaiyākaraṇaḥ sa cauraḥ, yathā-- yaḥ kampate so'śvattha iti| atra kampanamaśvatthasyopalakṣaṇam| `kutsito bāhmaṇaḥ' iti| bhavatyatra kutsitaśabdaḥ kutsitābhidhāyī| na tu brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ kutsanavacanaḥ|| 54. pāpāṇake kutsitaiḥ| `pāpāṇakaśabdau kutsanābhidhāyinau' ityuktam| yadyevamatra pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ samāsaḥ, kimarthamidanucyata ityāśaṅ‌kyāha-- `tayoḥ' ityādi| yadi pūrveṇa syāt samāsaḥ, tataḥ kutsitaśabdasya prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt pūrvenipātaḥ syāt, pāpāpaṇakaśabdayostu paranipātaḥ| tasmāt pūrvanipātārthamidamārabhyate| kutsitagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| anyathā pūrvayogādeva kutsita ityanuvartiṣyata iti tanna karttavyameva syāt|| 55. upāmānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ| (2.1.55) `upamīyate'nenetyupamānam' iti| sādṛśyena yena paricchidyate tadupamānamityarthaḥ| yathā gauriva gavaya ityatra gaurupamānam,tena hi sādṛśyena gavayaḥ paricchidyate| `yādṛśo gaustādṛśo gavayaḥ' ityarthaḥ pratīyate| sāmānyamanekasādhāraṇaṃ bhavati; iha copamānasya śrutatvāt tasya copameyāpekṣatvādupamānopameyoreva sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ sāmānyaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`upamānopameyayoḥ' ityādi| `tadviśiṣṭopameyavacanairayaṃ samāsaḥ' iti| tena sāmānyena dharmeṇa viśaṣṭaṃ yadupameyaṃ tadvacanairayaṃ samāso bhavati| kṛtaḥ punaḥ sāmānyavacanairityukte satyeṣa viśeṣo labhyate ? nyāyāt| tathā hi-- sāmānyamuktavantaḥ sāmānyavacanāḥ, yathā- guṇamuktavanto guṇavacanā iti| kadā ca te sāmānyavacanā bhavanti ? yadā sāmānyamabhidhāya sāmānyaviśiṣṭe tadvati dravye varttante| tacca sāmānyavadupamānasya sambandhiśabdatvādupameyameva vijñāyata iti nyāyaprāpta evārtho vṛttikṛtā darśitaḥ| `śastrīśyāmā devadattā' iti| atropamānaṃ śastrī, upameyā devadattā| prasiddhaṃ hyupamānaṃ bhavati, nāprasiddham. śastryeva śyāmaguṇatvena prasiddhā, na devadattā| tayoḥ sāmānyaṃ sādhāraṇo dhaऱmaḥ śyāmatvam| tat śyāmatvamuktvā śyāmaśabdo devadattayāmabhedopacārānmatublodvā varttata iti sāmānyavacano bhavati| nanu ca samānādhikaraṇenetyanuvarttate, iha ca śastrīśabdasya śastryāṃ vṛttiḥ, śyāmāśabdasya devadattāyām, ato vaiyadhikaraṇyāt samāsena na bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; sarvatra hyupamānopameyayorbhedāt tadvācinorvaiyadhikaraṇyameva, ucyate cedaṃ vacam, ato vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi vacanasāmarthyāt samāso bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- śastrīśabdo'pyatra devadattāyāṃ varttate| tena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ evāyaṃ samāsaḥ-- śastrau cāsau śyāmā ceti śastrīśyāmā| nanu ca śastrīśabdo'yaṃ jātivacanaḥ śastrītvaṃ pravṛttinimittamupādāya tadvati varttate, na ca tat śastrītvaṃ devadattāyāmasti, tat kathaṃ tatra varttate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `sarva evāmī śabdā guṇamupādāya tadvati dravye varttante' ityapi darśanamasti| tatra śyāmatvaṃ guṇamupādāya śastrīśabdo devadattāyāṃ vartiṣyate| tāddharmyādvā devadattā śastrīśabdenābhidhāsyate| bhavati hi tāddharmyāt tācchabdyamityuktaṃ prāk| tāddharmyaṃ punaḥ śyāmaguṇatvam| `phālā iva taṇḍulāḥ' iti| bhavanti hi phālā upamānam| tathāhi tairdīrghatvādinā sādṛśyena taṇḍulā upamīyante| taṇḍulaśabdastu sāmānyavacano na bhavati| nanu ca taṇḍulaśabdo'pi taṇḍulatvaṃ sāmānyamupādāya tadvati dravye varttata iti bhavatyeva sāmānyavacanaḥ, tadayuktamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇam ? naitadasti; tathā hyupamānopameyayoḥ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ sāmānyamityuktam| na ca taṇḍulatvaṃ phālānāmasti, kiṃ tarhi ? taṇḍulānāmeva|| 56. upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge| (2.1.56) `sāmarthyādupamānavacanaiḥ' iti| yadyapi `upamānavacanaiḥ' iti sūtre nopāttaṃ, tathāpyupameyamānāpekṣamityupamitaśabdaḥ sambandhiśabdatvādupamānatvaṃ vyāghradīnāṃ gamayati| tena viśeṣānabhidhāne'pi sāmarthyādupamānavacanaistaiḥ samāso vijñāyate| `na cetsāmānyavācī śabdaḥ prayujyate' iti| upamānopameyayoḥ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ, śauryādi, sāmānyamṣa yadi tadvācī śabdo na prayujyate, evaṃ sati samāso bhavati; nānyathā| nanu ca sāmānyasya samāse'ntarbhūttavāt tdavācināṃ śabdānāṃ prayogo nāsti, tatkiṃ pratiṣedhena ? naitadasti; sādhāraṇadharmaḥ sāmānyaṃ hi samāse'ntarbhūtam, na tu tadviśeṣaḥ| tatrāsati pratiṣedhe viśiṣṭasādhāraṇadharmavācinaḥ prayogaḥ syādeveti karttavyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ? na karttavyaḥ,katham? sāmānyaśabdaprayoge hi sati tadapekṣatvena sāpekṣamasamartha bhavatītyasāmarthyādeva samāso na bhaviṣyati| eṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati-- `bhavati hi pradhānasya sāpekṣyasyāpi samāsaḥ' iti| puruṣāścātropameyatvāt pradhānaḥ, upamānantu vyāghrādi tadarthatvādapradhānam| kimetena jñāpakena prayojanam ? `rājapuruṣaḥ śobhanaḥ' ityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati| `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti prāpte' iti| nanu ca viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyeṇa samānādhikaraṇena samāsaṃ vakṣyati, upamānopameyayośca bhedādvaiyadhikaraṇyam, tatkuto viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti prāptiḥ ? evaṃ manyate-- puruṣādāvupameye vartmānairvyāghrādibhirupamānaśabdairayaṃ samāso bhavati. yathā copamānaśabdānāmupameyavṛttitve sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tathā pūrvasūtra eva vyākhyātam|| 57. viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam| (2.1.57) `bhedakaṃ viśeṣaṇam' iti| `{śiṣlṛ viśaraṇe iti mudrita); śiṣlṛ śeṣaṇe, vipūrvaḥ-- padamaṃjarī} śiṣlṛ viśeṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1451) ityasmāddhātorvipūrvāt karaṇe lyuṭ| viśiṣyate'neneti viśeṣaṇam| tasyedaṃ lakṣaṇam-- bhademiti| yat sāmānyākāreṇa pravṛttamanekaprakāravadvastu prakārāntarebhyo vyavacchidyaikatra prakāre vyavasthāpayati, tad bhedakaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti| `bhedyaṃ viśeṣaṇam' iti| viśeṣaṇīyaṃ viśeṣyam| vipūrvāt tasmāddhātoḥ `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) iti karmaṇi ṇyat| tasyedaṃ lakṣaṇam, bhedyamiti| yadanekaprakāravadvastu prakārāntarebhyo vyavacchidyaikatra prakāre vyavasthāpyate tadbhedyaṃ viśeṣyamiti| atha kimarthaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorubhayorupādānaṃ kriyate ? na; anyatarasyaiva kriyeta, sambandhiśabdatvāddhi tayoranyataropādānenaivetarasyāpyavagatirbhavatyeva ? satyametat; yatra pūrvottarapade pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhūte bhavatastraiva samāso bhavatīti jñāpānārthamubhayorupādānam, yathā-- nīlotpalamiti. atra nīlārtho bhramarādibhyo vyāvartyotpalārthenotpale vyavasthāpyate| utpalārtho'pi raktotpalādibhyo vyāvartya nīlārthena nīle vyavasthāpyata ityasti pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ| sa yatra nāsati tatra tu na samāsaḥ yathā-- vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapeti| vṛkṣo hi śiṃśapātvaṃ vyabhicarati, śiṃśapā tu na vṛkṣatvam| atastatprakārāntarebhyaḥ palāśādibhyastaṃ vyavacchinattīti śiṃśapā tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, na tu viśeṣyam| vṛkṣastu viśeṣyaḥ śiṃśapārthastu vṛkṣatvaṃ na vyabhicaratīti na tasyāsau viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| atha kiṃ na bhavitavyameva śiṃśapāvṛkṣaḥ, āmravṛkṣa iti ? viśeṣaṇasamāsena bhavitavyam, yadā śiṃśapādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣe vṛttirnāvadhāryate| tathā hi-- śiṃśapādiśabdāḥ phalasya vṛkṣasya mūlasya ca vācakāḥ sāmānyaśabda iti tadarthānāṃ vṛkṣatvavyabhicārādadviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, vṛkṣaśca viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| yadā tu kutaścit prakaraṇādarthādvā vṛkṣādyarthā evāvasitavṛttayo bhavanti tadā na bhavitavyam| nanu ca vṛkṣārthāvasitavṛttitvād‌vṛkṣaśabdasya tadā prayoga eva nopapadyate, uktārthatvāt, `uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ' (vyā.pa.60) iti vacanāt| tataśca samāsasyāprasaṅga eva| tatkiṃ tannivṛttyarthenobhayagrahaṇena? naitadevam; kvaciduktārthānāmapi loke prayogo dṛśyate, yathā-- apūpau dvāvānayeti| yadi tarhi yatrobhayoḥ pratyekaṃ viśeṣamaviśeṣyabhāvastatra samāsena bhavitavyam, evaṃ sati pratyekamupasarjanatvaṃ syāt, ubhayorapi viśeṣaṇatvāt, viśeṣaṇasyeha sūtre prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt, tataścotpalanīlaramityapi syāt, nīlotpalamiti tu sarvadaiveṣyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmādekataraṃ pradhānam, itaradapradhānam| dvayoḥ prādhānye parasparānupakāritvādasambandhayorekatra prayogo na syāt| aprādhānye'pi dvayoḥ pradhānāpekṣāvatornāsti parasparopakāritvamiti na syādevaikatra prayogaḥ| tasmādekatra pradhānam, aparaṃ tvapradhānam| yaccāpradhānaṃ tedavopasarjanasaṃjñāṃ bhavati, netarat; anvarthatvādupasarjanasaṃjñāyāḥ-- upa - samīpe viśeṣye svārtha sṛjati - kṣipatīti| nīlaśabdaścāpradhānam, tadarthasya guṇasyāprādhānyāt; utpalaśabdastu pradhānam, tadarthasya dravyasya prādhānyāt| tasmānnīlaśabda evopasarjanam, notpalaśabda iti na bhavati pūrvoktadoṣāvasaraprasaṅgaḥ| yatrobhāvapi tatra paryāyeṇopasarjanabhāvaḥ, yathā-- kubjakhañja, khañjakubja iti| atha kuto'tra dravyasya prādhānyamavasitam ? ucyate;yathā-- śvetaṃ chāgamālabhetetyasyāṃ deśanāyāṃ deśanāyāṃ śvetaguṇasyābhāve'nyavarṇasyāpi cchāgasyālambhanācchāgābāve śvetaguṇasyānyadravyasyānālambhanācca| na hi cchāgābhāve piṣṭakapiṇḍīlamālabhya yājñikaḥ kṛtī bhavati| yadi ca pradhānaṃ guṇaḥ syāttadā yathā chāgābhāve piṣṭakapiṇḍī nālabhyate, tathā śvetaguṇābhāve'nyaguṇo'pi cchāgo nālabhyate| na ca sa nālabhyate, tasmāt dravyameva pradhānam, na guṇa iti| nanu cotpalaśabdo'pi naiva dravyaśabdo'yamiti vyavasthāpyate| evaṃ nīlaśabde'pyatiprasaṅgaḥ, prabhṛtyā vināśāt svādhāraṃ dravyaṃ naiva jahāti| ato dravyātmabhūtatvājjātestannimittakaḥ śabdo dravyasyotpatte| guṇāḥ punarapāyino'napāyino vā satyetasmin dravye varttante nivarttante ca| tasmānnaite dravyātmabhūtā iti na tannimittaśabdo dravyaśabdo vyavasthāpyata ityalamatiprasaṅgena| `takṣakaḥ sarpaḥ' iti| nanu ca takṣakaḥ sarpasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva, tathā hi-- sarpa tyukte sarpasāmānyaṃ pratīyate, na sarpaviśeṣaḥ| takṣaka- sarpa ityukte sarpaviśeṣo'takṣakādvyāvṛtto'vasīyate, tadayuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇametat; naitadasti;uktaṃ hyetat- yatraikaisyobhayatra bhāvastatra samāsa iti| na tu kadācit sarpārthasya takṣako viśeṣyo bhavati| kathaṃ na bhavati ? takṣakasya sarpatvāvyabhicārāt| nanu ca takṣakaśabdasyānekaprakāratvena prakārāntaranivṛttaye yujyata eva sarpasya takṣako'pi viśeṣyaḥ ? naitadasti; na nāmadheyasya kriyāśabdena tulyamarthābhidhānasāmarthyam| avayavārthānusāreṇa hi kriyāśabdo'rthaṃ bodhayati, samudāyarūpeṇa tu nāmadheyam| `avayavaprasiddheḥ samudāyaprasiddhirbalīyasī' (vyā.pa.108) iti tasyāṃ satyāṃ kriyāśabdārthaviṣayāpekṣā nopajāyata eva| `lohitastakṣakaḥ' iti| bhavati lohito viśeṣaṇam, na tu takṣako viśeṣyam| tasya lohitatvāvyabhicārāt| yadi tarhi takṣako na viśeṣyaḥ, lohito'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ na syāt; viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyāpekṣatvāt| na ca śakyaṃ takṣakādyarthāntaraṃ paṭādikaṃ viśeṣyaṃ tadapekṣayā lohitasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ parikalpayitum| evaṃ hi lohitādyadarthāntaraṃ tīvraviṣādikaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ tadapekṣaṃ takṣakasyāpi viśeṣyatvaṃ prasajyeta| tasmādvispaṣṭārthamubhayorgrahaṇamityapare|| 58. pūrvāparaprathamacaramajaghanyasamānamadhyamadhyamavīrāśca| (2.1.58) `pūrvasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ' iti| tenaiva siddhatvāt| asti hyatrāpi pratyekaṃ pūrvottarapadayarviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyabhāvaḥ|| 59. śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ| (2.1.59) `śreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavacanam' iti| abhūtatadbhāve varttamānānāṃ samāso yathā syāt| yadā hi śreṇyādiśabdānāmarthā apariniṣpannā eva niṣpādyante tadā samāsa iṣte| yadā tu niṣpannā eva te rūpāntareṇa kriyate tadā śreṇayaḥ kṛtā daṇḍitāḥ satkṛtā vetyevamādyarthavivakṣāyāṃ neṣyate| kṛtaśabdasya daṇḍitādiśabdānāmartheṣu vṛttirna sambhavatītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam| karoteḥ kriyāsāmānyavācitvāt| anekārthatvādvā dhātūnām| śreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavacanamityasyāyamarthaḥ-- cvyartha ucyate - pratyāyyate yena taccvyarthavacanam| `karttavyam' iti| yena śreṇyādiṣu samāsakarāṇatvenopātteṣu cvyarthatā pratipadyate tadvayākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- bahulagrahaṇamihānuvarttate, tena cvyarthānāmeva samāso bhavatīti nācvyarthānām| `cvyantānām' ityādi| cvervikalpena vidhānāddvividhāścvyarthāḥ-- cvyantāḥ, acvyantāśca| tatra ye śreṇyādayo'cvyantāsteṣāmanena samāsaḥ| cvyantānāntu `ūryyādicviḍācaśca' (1.4.61) iti gatisaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ paratvāt `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāso bhaviṣyatīti|| 60. ktena nañviśiṣṭenānañ| (2.1.60) ayaṃ viśiṣṭaśabdo'styeva sāvadhāraṇa ādhikye varttamānaḥ| yathā-- devadattayajñadattāvāḍhyāvabhirūpau prekṣāvantau| devadattastu yajñadattāt svādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ; svādhyāyenaivādhika iti gamyate| anye tu guṇāḥ samānā eva bhavanti| asti ca niravadhāraṇa ādhikye varttamānaḥ, yathā-- devadattayajñadattāvāḍhyāvibhirūpau prekṣāvantau| devadattastu yajñadattāt svādhyāyena viśiṣṭaḥ, svādhyāyenādhika iti gamyate| anye tu guṇāḥ samānā bhūyāṃso vā, te na vivakṣitā bhavanti| yadyapi cābhinnarūpameva vākyadvayametat, tathāpi prakaraṇādeḥ kutaścidarthabhedo gamyate, yathā-- ārācchabde dūrāntikārthabhedaḥ| tatra yadi niravadhāraṇa ādhikye varttamāno viśiṣṭaśabdo gṛhyeta, tadā siddhaṃ ca tadabhuktañcetyatrāpi syāt, astyatra nañādhikaṃ ktāntam| tasmāt sāvadhāraṇa ādhikye vartamānaṃ viśiṣṭaśabdaṃ parigṛhyāha-- `nañaiva viśeṣo yasya' ityādi| `prakṛtyādikam' iti| ādiśabdena pratyayopasargayoḥ parigrahaḥ| `anañ' iti| avidyāmāno nañ yasmin ktānte tadanañ| `kṛtañca tadakṛtañca' iti| kathaṃ punarekameva vastu kṛtaṃ syādakṛtañca ? avayavadharmeṇa samudāyasya tathā vyapadeśādadoṣaḥ| kṛtabhāgasambandhāt kṛtam, akṛtabhāgasambandhāt tadevākṛtamityucyate| atha vā- yadarthaṃ kṛtaṃ tatrāsāmarthyādakṛtam, yathā-- putrakāryāsāmarthyāt putro'pyaputra iti| yadi nañeva viśeṣo yasya sarvamanyat prakṛtyādikaṃ tulyaṃ tena samāsaḥ, evaṃ sati yasya nuḍapyadhika iḍāgamo vā, tena saha samāso na bhavatītyāha-- `nuḍiṭau' ityādi| yattu nañviśiṣṭaṃ ktāntaṃ tadbhaktau nuḍiṭau, atastadgrahaṇena gṛhyete, ato nāsya bhedakau tau| abhedakāvityarthaḥ| tena tadadhikamapi nañviśiṣṭameva bhavatīti tena samāso bhavatyeva| `aśitānaśitena' iti| `tasmānnuḍaci' (6.3.74) iti nuṭ| `kliṣṭākliśitena' ti| `kliśaḥ ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ' (7.2.50) iti pakṣe iṭ| anañici śakyamakartum| yadi sa nañ samasyeta tadā nañviśiṣṭatā nopapadyate; dvoyarapi nañsambandhāt| tasmānnañviśiṣṭagrahaṇādevānañ samasyata ityeṣo'rtho labhyata ityanañgrahamamanarthakam| tat kriyate vispaṣṭārtham| `kṛtāpakṛtādīnām' ityādi| kṛtāpakṛtaprabhṛtīnāmupasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- bahulagrahaṇamihānuvarttate, tena kṛtāpakṛtādīnāmapi samāsī bhavatīti| `kṛtāpakṛtam' iti| tadekadeśasyeṣṭasya karaṇāt kṛtam| apakṛtañca tadekadaśasyānabhimatasya karaṇāt| `bhuktavibhuktam' iti| bhuktaṃ tvabhyavahṛtatvāt, vibhuktañcāśobhanatvāt| viśabdo'trāśobhavatvaṃ pratipādayati virūpavat| atha vā- bhuktañca tatpratyāgatañceti `gatapratyāgatam'| yātañca tatpūrvamanuyātañca paścāt `yātānuyātam'| `krayākrayikā' iti| mahān krayaḥ krayaśabdonocyate, alpastu krayikāśabdena| krayāvayavasambandhāt krayaḥ, krayikāvayavasambandhāt krayitā, krayaścāsau krayikā ceti krayākrayikā| `anyemāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti dīrghaḥ| evaṃ puṭaścāsau puṭikā ceti `puṭāpuṭikā'| phalañca tat phalikā ceti `phalaphalikā'| mānañca tadunmānikā ceti `mānonmānikā'| `samānādhikaraṇādhikāre' ityādi| atrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanantu pūrvavadeva|| 61. sanmahatparamottamotkṛṣṭāḥ pūjyamānaiḥ| `pūjyacamānavacanairiti vacanāt' ityādi| pūjyamanatvaṃ hyavamuttarapadasya bhavati yadi pūjāvacanā bhavanti, nānyathā; tasmāt pūjyamānagrahaṇāt sadādayaḥ pūjāvacanā vijñāyante| ata eva sacchabdena śatṛśānacorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, na hi tau pūjāmāhatuḥ| `utkṛṣṭā gauḥ karddamāt' iti| uddhṛtetyarthaḥ| atha kathaṃ mahādrumaḥ, mahodadhiriti samāsaḥ, na hyatra pūjā gamyate, kiṃ tarhi ? pramāṇātireka uttarapadārthasya ? yadyapyevam, tathāpi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterbhaviṣyati|| 62. vandārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam| (2.1.62) vandārakādayo jātiśabdāḥ| te copamānatve sati pūjāvacanā bhavanti| tatra vyāghrāderākṛtigaṇatvāt `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ' (2.1.56) ityevaṃ siddhe samānyaprayogage'pi yathā syādityevamartho'yamārambhaḥ| "`pūjyamānam' iti vacanādvṛndārakādayaḥ pūjāvanacanā gṛhyante" iti| na hyanyathā pūjyamānatvamupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ| `suṣīmo nāgaḥ' iti| nanu ca viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti varttate| na ca nāgādanyaḥ suṣīmo'sti, saṃjñā hyeṣā nāgasyaiva ? evaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ vṛttikṛtā darśitā|idantvatra pratyudāharaṇam--devadatto nāgo yasmānmūrkha iti|| 63. kataratamau jātiparipraśne| (2.1.63) `jātiparipraśna eva vyutpādyete'iti| `kiṃyattadaurnirdhāraṇe'(5.3.92) ityanuvarttamāne `vā bahūnām' (5.3.93) ityādinā| syādetat-- kataraśabdaviśeṣaṇārtha jātiparipraśnagrahaṇamityāha-- `kataraśabdo'pi' ityādi| `tadeva jñāpayati' iti| yadi tarhi katamaśabdo jātiparipraśna eva varttamāno gṛhyate, jātiparipraśnagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāta, vinā'pi tena yathoktayā nītyā kataratamaśabdau jātiparipraśna eva varttamāno grahīṣyete| `tathā ca' ityādi| yata eva takamaśabdasya jātiparipraśnādanyatrāpi vṛttiḥ, evañca kṛtvā bhavatāṃ devadattaḥ katama iti pratyudāharaṇamupapadyate| anyathā tannopapadyet; tasya jātiparipraśnādanyatrāpravṛtteḥ|| 64. kiṃ kṣepe| (2.1.64) `kiṃsakhā' iti| `anaṅa sau' (7.1.93) ityanaṅādeśaḥ| atha kiṃrājetyādau `rājāhaḥ sakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91) `gorataddhitaluki' (5.4.92) iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `kimaḥ kṣepe' ityādi| atra `na pūjanāt' (5.4.69) ityataḥ `na' ityanuvarttate|| 65. poṭāyuvatistokakatipayagṛṣṭidhenuvaśāvehadbaṣkayaṇīpravaktṛśrotriyādhyāpakadhūrtairjātiḥ| (2.1.65) viśeṣaṇamityādinā samāse prāpte vacanamidaṃ paranipātārtham| guṇaśabdā hyete| tatra yadi tena samāsaḥ syāta tadaiṣāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ prasajyeta| atha dhūrttagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā kutsanaśabdo'yam, `kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ' (2.1.53) ityevaṃ samāsaḥ siddha ? ityāha-- `dhūrttagrahaṇamakutsārtham' iti| śabdapravṛttinimittakutsāyāṃ samāso vijñāyate, na kutsāyām|| 66. praśaṃsāvacanaiśca| (2.1.66) `rūḍhiśabdāḥ praśaṃsāvacanā gṛhyante' iti| triprakārā hi praśaṃsāśabdāḥ- keijjātiśabdāḥ parārthe prayujyamānāḥ praśaṃsāmācakṣate yathā-- siṃho devadatta iti| kecidguṇaśabdā guṇaguṇisambandhena praśaṃsāvacanā bhavanti, yathā-- ramaṇīyo grāmaḥ, śobhanaḥ pācaka iti| kecidrūḍhiśabdā matallikādayaḥ; teṣāṃ praśaṃsaiva śabdārthaḥ| tadiha vacanagrahaṇāt praśaṃsāyāmeva ye varttante te gṛhyante rūḍhiśabdāḥ| `goprakāṇḍam' iti| śobhanaḥ praśasto gaurityarthaḥ| yogavibhāgo'sandehārthaḥ| yadi pūrvayoga eva praśaṃsāvacanā gṛhyeran, tadā sandehaḥ syāt-- kiṃ poṭādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ vacanamabhisambadhyate ? atha praśaṃsayeti ? poṭādibhiḥ sambandhe tatparyāyairapi samāsaḥ syāt|| 67. yuvā khalatipalitavalinajaratībhiḥ| (2.1.67) `khalatyādibhiḥ samānādhikaraṇaiḥ' ityādi| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ jaratībhiriti strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ, jaradbhirityevaṃ nāma nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ syāt, na hi jaratīśabdena strīliṅgena yuvaśabdasya puṃliṅgasya sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyata ityāha-- `jaratībhiriti strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ punaranena nirdeśenaiṣā paribhāṣā śakyate jñāpayitum ? yadyeṣā na syāt tadā jaratībhirityevaṃ nirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt. tathā ca samānādhikaraṇādhikārāt samānādhikaraṇena jaratīśabdenāyaṃ samāso vijñāyate| na ca tena strīliṅgena puṃsi varttamānasya yuvaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati, tadeṣa nirdeśaḥ kathamarthavān bhavati ? yadyeṣā paribhāṣā'vatiṣṭhate ! tasyāṃ hi satyāṃ yuvaśabdasya grahaṇe yuvatiśabdasya grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyupapadyate| yuvatijaratīśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tasmiṃśca sati tayoḥ samāsaḥ| tedavaṃ jaratībhiriti nirdeśo jñāpayati-- eṣā paribhāṣā'stīti| nanvevamapi jaratyā samāsa ucyamāne jaratā na prāpnoti-- yuvajaranniti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vṛttyantare hi jaradbhiriti paṭhyate| ubhayathā'pyācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pratipāditā ityubhayaṃ sidhyati|| 68. kṛtyatulyākhyā ajātyā| (2.1.68) `tulyaparyāyāśca' iti| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? evaṃ manyate--kṛtya ityarthagrahaṇam| atastatsāhacaryāt tulya ityarthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, tatrārthe kāryāsambhavāt tadvācināṃ samāso vijñāyata ityākhyāgrahaṇaṃ tulyanāmadheyaparigrahārtham| anyathā gaurvāhīka ityatrāpi syāt ; gośabdasyeha sādṛśyārthatvāt| sarva eva hi śabdāḥ parapadārthe prayujyamānāḥ sādṛśyaṃ gamayanti| ākhyāgrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe gośabdo'tra tulyanāmadheyaṃ na bhavatīti samāsābhāvaḥ| bhojyoṣṇamityādāvuṣṇādayaḥ śabdā guṇavacanāḥ| tatrāsatyasmin yoge viśeṣaṇasamāse sati teṣāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| ataḥ paranipātārtha ārambhaḥ| `tulyamahān' iti| yadyapyatra `sanmahat' (2.1.561) ityādinā samāsaḥ prāpnoti, tathāpi paratvādanenaiva bhavati| tulyākhyāyāmasyāvakāśaḥ-- tulyaśveta iti| tasya cātulyākhyāyāmavakāśaḥ-- mahāpuruṣa iti| `bhojya odanaḥ' iti| odana śabdo'tra jātivacanaḥ|| 69. varṇo varṇena | (2.1.69) `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' (2.1.57) iti varttate| tatra yadi dvayorapi varṇaśabdayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇamiha syāt, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo nopapadyeta; abhinnārthatvāt| na hi tadeva devadattasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃ viśeṣyatvaṃ copapadyate| athāpyekasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, aparasyārthagrahaṇam ? evapyekaḥ sāmānyavācī syādvarṇaśabdaḥ, dvitīyastu viśeṣavācī kṛṣṇādiśabdaḥ| tataśca pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ viśeṣyatvaṃ ca na syāt| yatra ca tadubhayamasti tatra samāsa iti prāgubhayagrahaṇasya prayojanamuktam| tasmādubhayatrāpyarthagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `varṇaviśeṣavāci' ityādi| `kṛṣṇasāraṅgaḥ, lohitasāraṅgaḥ' iti| nanu ca kṛṣṇaśabdo lohitaśabdaścāvayave varttate sāraṅgaśabdastu samudāye; yathā-- śabalaśabdaḥ, tatkathamavayavavṛtteḥ kṛṣṇādiśabdasya samudāyavṛttinā sāraṅgādiśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyamityāha-- `avayavadvāreṇa' ityādi| kṛṣṇa ityucyate, lohitāvayavasambandhāllohita iti| ata eva gauṇatvādatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasya `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' (2.1.57) ityādinā samāso na prāpnotītīdamārabhyate mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇamanvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeteti| tenāpradhānamupasarjanamiti| na cātra samudāyo'pradhānam, kiṃ tarhi ? pradhānameva| avayavānāntu tadarthatvādaprādhānyam| ato'vayavavacanasyaiva kṛṣṇaśabdāderupasarjanatvam| na samudāyavacanasya sāraṅgādiśabdasya|| 70. kumāraḥ śramaṇādibhiḥ| (2.1.70) `taiḥ saha strīliṅga eva kumārīśabdaḥ samasyate' iti| na tu puṃlliṅga ityavadhāraṇena darśayati| na hi puṃlliṅgasya strīliṅgena sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ| `tairupabhayathā' iti| strīliṅgaḥ, puṃlliṅaśca| kathaṃ punaḥ puṃlliṅgaiḥ samāsa ucyamānaḥ strīliṅgaiḥ syādityata āha-- `prātipadikagrahaṇe' iti| gatārtham|| 71. catuṣpādo garbhiṇyā| (2.1.71) `catuṣpādaḥ' iti| catvāraḥ pādā yāsāṃ tāścatuṣpādaḥ| `pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ' (5.4.138) ityantasya lopaḥ| `catuṣpājjātiriti vaktavyam' iti| catuṣpādo jātivacanā eva garbhiṇyā samasyanta ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- poṭādi(2.1.65) sūtrādiha jātigrahaṇamanurttate| tena catuṣpajjātivācyeva garbhiṇyā samasyate, nānyaditi|| 72. mayūravyaṃsakādayaśca| (2.1.72) `mayūravyaṃsakaḥ' iti| mayūraścāsau vyaṃsakaśceti mayūravyaṃsakaḥ| vyaṃsakaśabdasya pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipātārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| evaṃ cātra mayūravyaṃsakādīnāṃ yavanamuṇḍaparyantānām| `chandasi hstegṛhya' ityādi| samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap' (7.1.37)| bhāṣāyāntu -- hastegṛhītvā, punardattvetyevaṃ bhavati| `ehīḍādayo'nyapadārthe' iti| ehi īḍa yatra karmaṇi varttate taducyate-- `ehīḍam' iti| evam-- `ehiyavam' iti| ehivāṇijeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā `ehivāṇijā'| evam-- `apehivāṇijā, prehivāṇijā'| ehi savāgatamiti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā `ehisvāgatā'| evam-- `apehisvāgatā'| prauha kaṭamiti yasyāṃ sā `prohakaṭā'| eṃ prohakardamādaya āharavasanāntāḥ| kṛndhi vicakṣaṇeti yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā `kṛndhivicakṣaṇā' | `uddharotsṛja' iti| tiṅantayoḥ samāsaḥ| `ākhyātamākhyātena kriyāsātye' (ga.sū.20) ityevaṃ siddhe'sātatyārthaṃ vacanam| uddharotsṛjati yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sā uddharotsṛjā| kriyāpradhānaścāyaṃ samāsaḥ| `utpatanipatā'| `uttamavidhamā'| evamuddharotsṛjetyādikamasātatyaviṣayameva| `uccāvacanam' iti nipātyate| udak cāvāk citi vigṛhya| uccaiśca nīcaiśceti vigṛhyoccanīcamiti nipātyate| ācitañcopacitañceti vigṛhya `ācopacam'| ācitañca parācitañceti `ācaparācam'| niścitañca pracitañceti `niścapracam'| na kiñcana `akiñcanam'| `snatvākālakaḥ'| `pītvāsthirakaḥ'| `bhuktvāsuhitaḥ' ityeṣāmantodāttārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| lyabbhāvaśca nipātyate| `proṣyapāpīyān' iti| aikapadyamaikasvaryañca samāsādbhavati| evam-- utpatyapākalādīnām| `nityarohiṇī| niṣaṇṇaśyāmā| apehiprasavā| ihapañcamī| ihadvitīyā' iti| aikapadyamaikasvaryañca samāse bhavati| `jahi karmaṇā bahulamābhīkṣṇye karttārañcādhidadhāti' iti| jahīti loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanam| tadantaṃ karmaṇā ca bahulaṃ samasyata ābhīkṣṇye gamyamāne samāsena cetkarttā cābhidhīyate| jahijoḍamityābhīkṣṇyaṃ ya āha sa ucyate `jahijoḍaḥ' iti| jahistamba iti, loṭ; sip, `hanterjaḥ' (6.4.36) iti jādeśaḥ| joḍāderatra karmabhāvaḥ| `ākhyātam' ityādi| tiṅantaṃ tiṅantena saha samasyate kriyāsātatye gamyamāne| aśnīta pibatetyasakṛdyatrocyate tatra `aśnītapibata' iti prayujyate| kriyāpradhānaścāyaṃ samāsaḥ| evaṃ pacatabhṛjjatetyevamādayo veditavyāḥ| bhindhi lavaṇamiti yatrībhidhīyate sā `bhindhilakṣaṇā'| evaṃ `pacalavaṇā' iti|| iti śrībodhasattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ dvitīyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ <2.2> atha dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. pūrvāparādharottaramekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe| (2.2.1) `sāmarthyādekadeśavacanāḥ' iti| yadi hi pūrvādayaḥ śabdā ekadeśavacanā na syusatadottarapadasyaikadeśitvaṃ na gamyeta;ekadeśina ekadeśāpekṣatvāt| tasmāt sāmānyoktā api pūrvādayaḥ śabdā sāmarthyādekadeśavacanāḥ samasyanta iti vijñāyate| ekādhikaraṇagrahaṇamekadeśino viśeṣaṇamityasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkartumāha-- `ekaṃ ca' ityādi| ekamityekasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamityarthaḥ| `ekadravyam' ityanenādhikaramaśabdo'tra dravye varttamāna upātta ti darśayati| nanu `ekadeśinā' iti tṛtīyāntametat, `ekādhikaraṇe ityetat saptamyantam, tat kathaṃ tayorbhinnavibhaktikayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva upapadyate, kathañca na syāt; bhinnārthatvāt ? naitadasti; `chandovat sūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā.1.1.1) ityato `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti bahulavacanāt| `ekādhikaraṇe' ityatra tṛtīyārtha evaiṣā saptamī| na `saptamyadhikaraṇe ca' (2.3.36) ityanena| ato nāsti bhinnārthatvamityadoṣaḥ| `ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ' iti| `ekadeśinā' iti vacanāt pūrvādayaḥ śabdā ekadeśavacanā āśrīyante| sambandhiśabdā hi niyatameva pratiyoginamupasthāpayanti| tatrāvayavāvayavisambandhe steyakadeśinaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāmupajanitāyāṃ `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) iti samāsaḥ prāpnoti, atastadapavādo'yaṃ yoga iti| `pūrvakāyaḥ' ityatra kāya ekadeśī, ekadravyañca; ekasaṃkhyāyuktatvāt| `pūrvaṃ nābheḥ kāyasya' iti| nābheriti digyogalakṣaṇā pañcamī| nābherupariṣṭāt yat pūrvaṃ tat kāyasyetyeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ| tenātra nābhirekadeśinī na bhavati| kiṃ tarhi ? avadhibhūtā, tadvācī nābhiśabdaḥ pañcamyanto na samasyante| yastvekadeśī kāyastadvācinaḥ kāyaśabdasya bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| satyapi pūrvaśabdasya sāpekṣatve kāyasya prādhānyāt pradhānasyaca sāpekṣasyāpi samāso bhavatīti jñāpitametat `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge' (2.1.56) ityatra| `pūrvaṃ {chātrāṇāmāmantraya ita mūlapāṭhaḥ, padamañjarīsammataśca|} chātrāṇāmāmantrayasva'iti| atra bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaikadeśinaśchātrā iti na bhavati samāsaḥ| nanu cātra paratvāt `na nirddhāraṇe' (2.2.10) iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedho bhaviṣyati| tat {kimevādhikaraṇe- iti mudrita pāṭhaḥ|} kimekādhikaraṇagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; yadi tarhyāmantrayasvetyetannāpekṣyate tadā pūrvaṃ chātrāṇāmityetāvadvākyaṃ parisamāpyate,tadā nirddhāraṇābhāvānnāyaṃ tasya pratiṣedhasya viṣaya ityasatyekādhikaraṇe'nekasaṃkhyenāpyekadeśinā samāsaḥ syāt| atha sarvaṃ hi vākyaṃ kriyayā parisamāpyata iti pūrvaṃ chātrāṇāmityatra yāṃ kāñcit kriyāmadhyāhṛtya nirddhāraṇaṃ parikalpyeta, evaṃ `pūrvaṃ kāyasya' ityatrāpi nirddhāraṇaṃ syāt| asti hyatrāpyakarṣaṇakriyā nirddhāraṇahetuḥ| tathā ca tasyaiva yogasya viṣaye kilārabhyamāṇo'yaṃ yogastadapavādaḥ syāt. na cotsargāpavādayorvipratiṣedha upapadyate, tatkathaṃ paratvāt `na nirddhāraṇe' (2.2.10) iti pratiṣedhaḥ pravarttate-- saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyetyādi ? yadayaṃ `saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyāhnasya' (6.3.110) ityāha, tato jñāpakādavasīyate-- sarveṇaikadeśinā'hnaḥ samāso bhavatīti| anyathā hi sāyapūrvatvamahnaśabdasya nopapadyata ityayuktametadvacanaṃ syāt|| 2.arddhaṃ nupaṃsakam| (2.2.2) `samapravibhāge tvarddhaśabdo napuṃsakamāviṣṭaliṅgastasyedaṃ grahaṇam' iti| yadyevam, samagrahaṇameva karttavyam ? naivaṃ śakyam, anekārthatvāt samaśabdasya| tathā hi--sa nimnonnatādirahite'pi deśe varttate-- yathā--same yajeteti, nimnonnatādirahite deśe yajetetyarthaḥ| athāpi samapravibhāga icyucyate, evamapi gurutvaṃ syāt, tasmānnapuṃsakagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam? na karttavyam; arddhamiti napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśādeva hi napuṃsakasya grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, naitadasti; asati hi napuṃsakagrahaṇaṃ śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakanirdeśa iti vijñāyeta, yathā-- `svamajñātidhanākhyāyām' (1.1.35), `banthuni bahuvrīhau' (6.1.14) iti ca; tataścārddhaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvatā'nāśritā syāt| evamanupaṃsakaliṅgo'pi samasyeta| tasmādarddhaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvamāśrayituṃ napuṃsakamiti vaktavyam| `arddhapiptalī' iti| `paravaliṅgam' (2.4.26) iti strīliṅgatā| athātra `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? anupasarjanatvāt| upasarjanatvaṃ tu `ekavibhakti ca' (1.2.44) iti| atra `vibhāṣā chandasi' (1.2.36) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate| sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā pratipāditā| `grāmārddhaḥ' iti| grāmasyaikadeśa ityarthaḥ| `arddha paśordaivadattasya' iti| devadattaśabdena saha samāso na bhavati| anekadeśitvāddevadattasya| na hyasāvekadeśaḥ, kintarhi ? svāmī| yastvekadeśī paśuśabdaḥ, tena saha bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| satyapi paśuśabdasya sāpekṣatve paśoḥ prādhānyāt samāso bhavatyeva-- arddhapaśurdevadattasyeti|| 3. dvitīyatṛtīyacaturthaturyāṇyantarasyām| (2.2.3) `anyatarasyāṃ grahaṇāt so'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhavati' iti| nanu ca pūraṇapratyayāntā ete dvitīyādayaḥ śabdāḥ| tatra pūraṇetyādinā samāsaniṣedhena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ so'pi bhavatītyāha-- `pūraṇa' ityādi| yadyatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt tadā'nyatarasyāṃ grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| vākyasya tu mahāvibhāṣayaiva siddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `dvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyāḥ' iti| bhikṣāyā dvitīyo bhāga ityarthaḥ| `dvitīyaṃ bhikṣāyā bhikṣakasya' iti| bhikṣukeṇa sahātra samāso na bhavati| na hyasāvekadeśī, kiṃ tarhi ? svāmī| turyaśabdaḥ `caturaśchayatāvādyakṣaralopaśca' (vā.571) iti yatpratyayāntaḥ pūraṇārthasya pratipādakaḥ|| 4. prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā| (2.2.4) `dvitiyāsamāse prāpte' iti| `dvitīyā śrita' (2.1.24) ityādinā| `samāsavidhānātso'pi bhavati' iti| apiśabdādayamapi bhavati| `prāptajīvikaḥ'iti| `ekavibhakti ca' (1.2.44) ityādinopasarjanatvam| hrasvatvaṃ tu `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti| atra ca `paravalliṅgam' (2.4.26) ityādinā jīvikāyā yalliṅagaṃ tat samudāyasya kasmānna bhavati ? `dviguprāptāpannalaṃpūravagatisamāseṣu pratiṣedo vaktavyaḥ'(vā.163) iti vacanāt| tena prāptāpanyoryalliṅgaṃ tat samudāyasya bhavati| atha yadā prāptājīvikāmiti vigṛhya samāsaḥ kriyate tadā kimudāharaṇam ? prāptajīvika iti| ṭāpaḥ śravaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? `striyāḥ puṃvat' (6.3.34) iti yogavibhāgāt puṃvadbhāvena ṭāpo nivartitatvāt|| 5. kālāḥ parimaṇinā| (2.2.5) `sāmarthyāt parimāṇavacanāḥ' ita| evaṃ hyuttarapadasya parimaṇivācitvaṃ gamyate yadi kālaśabdāḥ parimāṇavacanā bhavanti, nānyathā| tasmāt kālā ityeviśeṣābhidhāne'pi sāmarthyāt `parimāṇavacanaḥ kālaśabdāḥ samasyante' iti vijñāyate| nanu cakālaḥ parimāṇeva bhavati; anavadhitvāt, tat kathaṃ tadabhidhāyinaḥ śabdāḥ parimāṇavacanā bhavanti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi mukhyasya parimāṇasya vācakā na bhavanti, gauṇasya tu bhavatyeva| iha hi mukhyaṃ parimāṇatvaṃ kālasya māsaderna bhavatīti sāmarthyāt paricchedahetumātraparimāṇasādharmyamupādāyopacāreṇa kālāḥ parimāṇtavenābhimatāḥ| māsādayo'pi hi jātādeḥ sambandhinīrādityagatīrgamayanti, ato bhavanti paricchedahetavaḥ| `ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaviṣaye yogārambhaḥ' iti| parimāṇaparimāṇisambandhe hi parimāṇavācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam| yatra ca ṣaṣṭhī bhavati sa ṣaṣṭīsamāsasya viṣayaḥ,tenāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya viṣayo yoga ārabhyate| `māsajātaḥ' ityatra jātaḥ parimāṇī| tasya parimām̐ māsaḥ| `dvayahajātaḥ' iti| dvayorahnoḥ samāhāra iti dvyahaḥ| `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91)| `ahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.145) iti ṭilopaḥ| `na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre' (5.4.89) ityahnādeśapratiṣedhaḥ| dvyaho jātasya dvyahajātaḥ| atha `kālāḥ' iti bahuvacananirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ ? svarūpavidhinirāsārtha iti cet; naitadasti; na hi svarūpagrahaṇe satyuttarapadasya parimāṇivācitvaṃ gamyate, kālaśabdasyāparimāṇavācitvāt| tasmāt parimāṇigrahaṇādeva kālaviśeṣavācināṃ māsādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tarhi bahuvacananirdeśo'yaṃ mātrādhikyena sūtraprabandhasyārthādhikyasūcanārthaḥ| tathā coktam-- `iṅgitenonmiṣitena mahatā sūtraprabandhenācāryāṇāmabiprāyā lakṣyante' iti| tena saṃkhyāpūrvapadastripado'pyayaṃ parimāṇinā tatpuruṣasamāso bhavatītyeṣo'rtho labhyate| tena dvyahnajāta ityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati| dve ahanī jātamasyeti vigṛhya tripade tatpuruṣe kṛte jātaśabda uttarapade pūrvayoḥ padayoḥ `taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti dvyavayavastatpuruṣo bhavati, pūrvaṣaṭṭac, `ahnohna etebhyaḥ' (5.4.88) ityahnādeśaḥ|| 6. nañ| (2.2.6) naño ñakāraḥ `nalopo nañaḥ' (6.3.73) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, pāmanaputrādiṣu mā bhūt| `lomādipāmādipicchādibhyaḥ śanelacaḥ' (5.2.100)| athābrāhmaṇa iti kiṃpradhāno'yaṃ samāsaḥ ? uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ, yathā-- rājapuruṣa iti| pūrvapadārthapradhāno'vyayībhāvaḥ, yathā-- amakṣikamiti| anyapadārthapradhāno bahuvrīhiḥ, yathā--abrāhmaṇako deśa iti| yadyevam, abrāhmaṇamānayetyukte brāhmaṇamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti ? atha nivṛttipadārthako'yaṃ brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ, sā ca nivṛttiḥ svābhāvikī nañā dyotyata iti matam, evaṃ ca satyabhāva evāsyārtha ityabrāhmaṇamānayetyukte na kasyacidānayanaṃ prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;sarvaṃ hi padaṃ svārthe prayujyamānaṃ prayogapratijñānamapekṣate| tathā coktam-- "ātmā buddhyā sametyārthān mano yuṅkte vivakṣayā" iti| tacca dvividhaṃ jñānam-- samyak, mithyā ceti| ubhayamapyetat brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ pravarttayati| yatra samyagjñānapūrvake brāhmaṇaśabdaprayoge nāsti naño vyāpāraḥ, na hi tatra nañā kiñcita kriyate| mikhyājñānapūrvake tu vidyata eva tasya vyāpāraḥ| tatra hi tena mithyājñānaprabhāvatā parasyākhyāyate| mithyājñānaṃ ca duṣṭendriyahetukam| taccasādṛśyādṛte na sambhavatīti pratiṣedhe satyattarapadārthasadṛśaḥ samāsārtho jāyate| tathā coktam-- `nañiva yuktamanyasadṛśādhikaraṇe tathā hyarthagatiḥ' (vyā.pa.65) iti| tasmādabrāhmaṇamānayetyukte brāhmaṇasadṛśe kṣatriyādau pratītirbhavatīti na bhavati pūrvokatdoṣāvasaraprasaṅgaḥ|| 7. īṣadakṛtā| (2.2.7) `īṣadguṇavacanenati vaktavyam' iti| īṣadityetadavyayaṃ samasyate, na sarveṇākṛdanetanetyetadrūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| ttaredaṃ vyākhyānam-- vibhāṣetyanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena guṇavacanenaiva samāso bhaviṣyati, nānyena| `īṣadgārgyaḥ' iti| gārgyaśabda'yaṃ jātivacanaḥ, na guṇavacanaḥ| nanvakṛtetyucyate, ttara īṣatpītaḥ, īṣadunna ta ityādi na sidhyati; pītādiśabdasya kṛdantatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avyutpannā hyete pītādiśabdā veditavyāḥ; na tu kṛdantāḥ|| 8. ṣaṣṭhī| (2.2.8) `kṛdyogā ca' ityādi| `kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī samasyate' iti vyākhyeyam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- yadayaṃ `ktena ca pūjāyām' (2.2.12) `adhikaraṇavācinā ca' (2.2.13) `karmaṇi ca' (2.2.14) `tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari ca {ca nāsati sūtre}' iti niṣedhamārabhate, tajjñāpayati -- `kṛdyogā yā ṣaṣṭhī sā samasyate' iti ; anyathā pratiṣedhārambho'narthakaḥ syāt; prāptyabhāvāt| `idhmapravraścaḥ' iti| karaṇa lyuṭ| `kṛtyulyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti karttari vāta| `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| palāśaśātanaḥ' iti| śaderṇyantasya `śaderagatau taḥ' (7.3.42) iti dakārasya takāraḥ| pūrvavallyuṭ, ṣaṣṭhī ca| kimarthamityucyate, yāvatā ṣaṣṭhītyanenaiva kṛdyogalakṣaṇāyā api ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ siddhaḥ evetyata āha- `pratipadavidhānā ca' ityādi| subodham| 9.yājakādibhiśca| (2.2.9) cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena `tatsthaiśca guṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭī samasyata iti vaktavyam' (iti) iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati;anenaiva siddhatvāt| tasmin sthitāḥ - tatsthāḥ| prakṛtasyānyasyābhāvāt tadityanena guṇā eva pratyavamṛśyante| tena guṇātmanyeva ye guṇā varttante , na kadāciddravyātmani, taiḥ ṣaṣṭhī samasyate| yadyapi nāstyeva hi sa guṇo yo dravye na varttate, sarvanasya guṇasya dravyāśritatvāt; tathāpi guṇaśapabdāstu kecit matublopādabedopacārādvā tadvati dravye varttamānā guṇamādhārānugataṃ gamayanti, yathā-- śuklaḥ paṭaḥ, lohitaḥ kambala iti| apare tvāśrayādvibhaktaṃ dravyaṃ pratyanupasarjanībhūtaṃ guṇamāhuḥ, yathā-- candranasya gandhaḥ, kapisthasya rasa iti| tasmādabhidhānaśaktavyāpārāpekṣayā tatsthairiti viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam. tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- ye guṇāḥ svaśabdairdravyaṃ pratyanupasarjanabhāvāpannā eva pratyāyyante, taiḥ saha ṣaṣṭhī samasyata iti candanasya gandhaśabdanagandhaḥ, kapitthasya rasaḥ kapittharasaḥ| gandhādayo hi svaśabdairādhāravibhaktā eva pratyāyyante, na tu kadācidāśrayānugatā dravyaṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtāḥ|| 10. na nirddhāraṇe| (2.2.10) `manuṣyāṇāṃ kṣatriyaḥ śūratamaḥ' iti. `yataśca nirddharāṇam' (2.3.41) iti ṣaṣṭhī| `pratipadavidhānā ca' ityādi| `ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe' (2.3.50) iti sāmānyalakṣaṇavihitāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ tyaktvā yā'nyā viśeṣalakṣaṇāvihitā ṣaṣṭhī sā pratipadavidhānā,ka sā ca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyata ityetadrūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- neti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena pratipadavidānā ṣaṣṭhī na samasyata iti|yadyevam, kathaṃ gṛhasvāmī, vidyādāyādaḥ, pṛthvīśvara iti, pratipadavidhānā hyeṣā ṣaṣṭhī bādhiṣyata iti cakāreṇa punaḥ ṣaṣṭhīpratiprasavaḥ kriyate| na hyevaṃvidā ṣaṣṭhī pratipadavidhānā bhavati| ata va `na nirddhāraṇe' iti niṣedho vidhīyate| `yataśca nirddhāraṇam' (2.3.41) ityatrāpi cakāreṇa saiva śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī pratiprasūyate, anyathā hīyamapi pratipadavidhānaiva ṣaṣṭhīti samāso na syāt| tataśca `na nirddhāraṇe'iti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt|`sarpiṣo jñānam' iti. `jño'vidarthasya' (2.3.51) iti karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī|| 11. pūraṇaguṇasuhitārthasadavyayatavyasamānādhikaraṇena| (2.2.11) `chātrāṇāṃ pañcamaḥ' iti| `tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ' (5.3.48) `nāntādasaṃkhyādermaṭ' (5.3.49) samudāyasamudāyisambandhe śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| evaṃ `valākāyāḥ śauklyam', `kākasya kārṣṇyam' ityatra guṇaguṇisambandhe śeṣalakṣaṇaiva ṣaṣṭhī veditavyā| brāhmaṇasya karttavyamityatra `kṛtyānāṃ karttari vā'(2.3.71) iti ṣaṣṭhī| atha kathaṃ gorviśatiriti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, yāvatā saṃkhyāyā guṇatvāt pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayaṃ ` śatasahastarāntācca niṣkāt' (5.2.119) ityāha, tajjñāpayati-- saṃkhyāyāḥ samāso bhavatīti| na hi tenā vinā śatasahasrāntatā niṣkasya prātipadikasya sambhavati| `tavyatā sānubandhakena samāso bhavatyeva' iti| niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā tasyāgrahaṇāt| `brāhmaṇakarttavyam' iti| `gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) iti prakṛtisvareṇāntasvaritamuttarapadaṃ bhavati. yadi tarhi niranubandhakenāpi samāsaḥ syāt prakṛtisvare kṛte pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ syāt, sa cāniṣṭaḥ; ato niranubandhakena samāsaḥ pratiṣidhyate, na tu sānubandhakena| kiñca syāditi ? evaṃ manyate-- kriyamāṇe'pyetasmin pratiṣedhe viśeṣaṇasamāsenātra bhavitavyameva| tadavasyambhāvini samāse yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syāt tadā ko doṣaḥ syāt, yatparihṛtaye'yaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti ? -- `{pūrvanipātasyāniyamaḥ--kāśikā}pūrvanipātāniyaḥ' ityādinā doṣamāha| yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syāt tadā dvayorapi padayoḥ prathamānirdiṣṭatvādupasarjane sati pakṣe viśeṣaṇasyāpi pūrvanipātaḥ syāt, sa ca neṣyate| viśeṣaṇasamāse sati viśeṣaṇasyaiva samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt pūrvanipāto bhavatīti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅga|| 12. ktena ca pūjāyām| (2.2.12) ``matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' iti vakṣyati'iti| ktamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ| `tasyedaṃ grahaṇam' iti| `matibuddhi' (3.2.188) ityādinā sūtreṇa yo vihitaḥ ktaḥ, tasya pūjāyāmanyatra ca sarvasya vihitasyedaṃ grahaṇam| na kevalaṃ pūjāyāṃ yo vihitastsayaiveṣyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| ata evāha-- `pūjāgrahaṇamupalakṣaṇārtham' iti| kasyopalakṣaṇārtham ? `matibuddhi' (3.2.188) ityādau sūtre nirdiṣṭārthasya yaḥ kto vidhīyate tasya matyādeḥ| tena na kevalaṃ pūjāyāṃ yaḥ kto vihitastena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedho bhavati, api tu matibuddhayorapi yo vihitastenāpi| `rājñāṃ mataḥ' iti| `ktasya ca varttamāne' (2.3.67) iti ṣaṣṭhī| pūjāyāṃ kim ? chātrasya hasitaṃ chātrahasitam| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) śeṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī|| 13.adhikaraṇavācinā ca| (2.2.13) `idameṣāmāsim' iti| asyate'sminnityadhikaraṇe ktaḥ| `adhikaraṇavācaniśca' (2.3.68) ṣaṣṭhī| evaṃ pītamityādāvapi| adhikaraṇavācineti kim ? chātras‌ya hasitaṃ chātrahasitamiti|| 14. karmaṇi ca| (2.2.14) ``ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' (2.3.66) ityasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyā idaṃ grahaṇam' iti| etacc punaḥ `karttari caṭa (2.2.16) iti pratiṣedhādvijñāyate| yadi hi karmaṇi yā kācit ṣaṣṭhī tasyāḥ sarvasyā idaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt tadā `karttari ca' (2.2.16) iti punaḥ pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryāt; anenaiva siddhatvāt| yatra hi karttari tṛjakau vihitau tatra niyogataḥ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam. tasmāt `karttari ca' (2.2.16) iti punaḥ pratiṣedhavacanādubhayaprāptau karmaṇi yā ṣaṣṭhī vihitā tasyā atra grahaṇamavasīyate| `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' (2.3.66) iti ṣaṣṭhyā iha grahaṇādidhmavraśacnaḥ; palāśaśātanaḥ, ikṣubhakṣikāṃ me dhārayasīti samāsaniṣedho na bhavati|| 15. tṛjakābhyāṃ karttari| (2.2.15) bhavataḥ śāyiketyādau bhāve `paryāyārhaṇotpattiṣu ṇvuc'(3.3.111) bhavatīti ` kartṛkarmaṇo kṛti' (2.3.65) iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī| tṛcā yoge karttari ṣaṣṭhī nāsti, tenaiva karttṛrabhihitatvāt| tarhi kimarthaṃ tṛco grahaṇamityāha-- `tasmat' ityādi| `ikṣubhakṣikāṃ me dhārayati' iti| pūrvavaṇṇyuc| atrekṣuśabdāt kṛdyoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| `me'iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī kṛdyogaiva| `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' (2.3.66) ityatra na pravartate; `akākārayoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' (vā.143) iti vacanāt|| 16. karttari ca| (2.2.16) `itaratra vyabhicārābhāvāt' iti | tṛci| sāmarthyādakasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇam| kart‌tṛgrahaṇamityatra hetuḥ| sambhavavyabhicāre hi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavati. na hi tṛc karttāraṃ vyabhicarati; tasya karttaryaiva vidhānāt| akastu vyabhicarati; tasya bhāve'pi vidhānāta| ataḥ sāmarthyādakasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ karttṛgrahaṇam; na tṛcaḥ| `apāṃ sraṣṭā' iti| apāmaiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| `apāṃ sraṣṭā' iti tṛc; vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam| `sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti' (6.1.58) ityamāgamaḥ| `nanu ca' ityādi| yājakādipāṭhādbhavitavyamevātra samāsanenetyabhiprāyaḥ|`sambandhiśabdasya' ityādinā parīhāraḥ| hotṛśabdena sambandhiśabdena sambandhiśabdena sāhacaryādbhavartṛśabdo'pi sambandhiśabdastatra gṛhyate; ayantu kriyāśabdaḥ-- bibharttīti bharttā| `saktūnāṃ pāyakaḥ' iti| `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk| atha kimarthaṃ tṛcaḥ sānubandhakasyoccāramam ? tṛno nivṛttyarthamiti cet, naitadasti; tadyoge `na lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' (2.3.69) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhāt| evaṃ tarhyetadeva jñāpakam--tṛnyoge'pi kvacit bhavatīti| tena `bhīṣmaḥ kuruṇāṃ bhaśokaharttā' ityādi siddhaṃ bhavati|| 17. nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ| (2.2.17) `uddālakapuṣpabhañjikā' iti| `rogākhyāyāṃ ṇvul bahulam' (3.3.108) ityanuvarttamāne `saṃjñāyām' (3.3.109) iti ṇvul| uddālakapuṣpādiṣu karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| `dantalekhakaḥ, nakhalekhakaḥ' iti| `ṇlultṛcau'(3.1.133) iti ṇvul| krīḍāyāṃ viṣaye `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) iti sūtreṇa mahāvibhāṣayā vikalpena samāse prāpte jīvikāyāñca `karttari ca' (2.2.16) iti niṣedhe prāpte'yamārambhaḥ| tatra nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? jīvikārtham| itaratra tvārambhasāmarthyānnityo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati| jīvikāyāṃ tvasati nityagrahaṇe mahāvibhāṣādhikārādvikalpena samāsaḥ syāditi tadarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam, uttarārthañca|| 18. kugatiprādayaḥ| (2.2.18) `kuśabdo'vyayaṃ parigṛhyate' iti| aliṅgasaṃkhyatvādavyayatvam, na tu nipāteṣu pāṭhāt| na hyayaṃ tatra paṭhyate| `na dravyavacanaḥ' iti| pṛthivyādau yo dravye varttate tasyātra grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| kuta etadityāha-- `gatyādibhiḥ sāhacaryāt' iti| gatārtham| `koṣṇam' iti| `īṣadarthe ca' (6.3.105) iti koḥ kādeśaḥ| `kavoṣṇam' iti| `kavacoṣṇe' (6.3.107) iti kavādeśaḥ| `kaduṣṇam' iti. `koḥ kattatpuruṣe'ci' (6.3.101) iti kat| `kupuruṣaḥ' iti pāpārthe| `duṣkṛtam' iti| `dus' kṛcchrārthe varttate| `idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya' (8.3.41) iti ṣatvam| `{nāsti kāśikāyām; padamañjaryāṃ dṛśyate-- suṣṭutam iti|}sustutam' iti| suśabdo'tiśaye varttate| `atistutam' iti| atirakramaṇe| `{ābaddham- kāśikā}āviddham' iti| āṅa kriyāyoge, maryādāyāṃ vā| `paryāyadayo glānādyarthe' iti. paryādirākṛtigaṇaḥ| `paryadhyayanaḥ' iti| pariglāno'dhyayanāyetyarthaḥ| `vāpasī iva' ityādi| `sarvadhātubhyo'sun' (da.u.9.49) ityanuvarttamāne `vaserṇicca' (da.u.9.77) ityasunpratyayānto vāsaḥśabdo vyutpāditaḥ, vastraśabdo'pyaugaṇādikaṣṭranpratyayāntaḥ, tena dvāvapyetau `ñnatyādirnityam' (6.1.197) ityādyudāttau| `prādiprasaṅge' ityādi. prādigrahaṇe yaḥ prasaṅgaḥ samāsaśāstrasya tatra karmapravacanīyānāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- lakṣaṇādiṣvartheṣu karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā bhavati| na ca te'rthāḥ samāsena gamyanta ityanabhidhānāt karmapravacanīyānāṃ samāso na bhavati| yatra te'rthā gamyante tatra bhavatyeva samāsaḥ -- atistutamiti|| 19. upapadamatiṅ| (2.2.19) `edhānāhārako vrajati' iti| `tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' (3.3.10) iti ṇvul| `etayoryogayoḥ supsupeti `{na sambadhyate iti mūlapāṭhaḥ} nābhisambadhyate' iti| nanu cāsminnava yoge tadanabhisambando yukto yatrātiṅagrahaṇamasti, na tu pūrvasūtreṇa, na hi tatrātiṅityetadasti ? evaṃ manyate-- `atiṅa' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, sa ca pūrvasūtrasyāpi śeṣabhūto vijñāyate| nanvevamapyatiṅiti prathamāntena nirdeśāt prathamāntasyaiva subityasya nivṛttiryuktā, na tṛtīyāntasya supetyasya ? naitadasti; samānyena subadhikāranivṛttyupalakṣaṇārthatvādyuktā dvayorapi nivṛttiḥ| `tena' ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| pūrvayoge'pyatiṅagrahaṇāt `gatyupasargasaṃjñakānāṃkṛdbhiḥ saha prāk subutpateḥ samāso bhaviṣyati' (vyā.pa.138) ityetadupapannaṃ bhavati| tathā hi tatra gatayaḥ kṛdbhiḥ saha samasyante, asmistu yoge'tiṅagrahaṇāt kārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ samāsaḥ subutpatteḥ prāgupapanno bhavati| tathā hyatra kārakaṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samasyate prāk subutpatteḥ| samāse sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarsayannāha-- `aśvakrītī' iti| atrāśvaḥ karaṇaṃ kārakam, tadvācino'śvaśabdasya `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ| subutpattyāṃ stāyaṃ yadi sa samāsaḥ syāt tadā prāgantaraṅgatvāṭṭāpa syāt, tataḥ sup, paścāt samāsaḥ, tataśca `krītāt karaṇapūrvāt' (4.1.50) iti ṅīṣ na syāt ; ata ityadhikārāt| ṅīṣastvavakāśaḥ--dhanena krītaṃ krayaṇaṃ yasyāḥ| prāksubutpatteḥ samāse sati ṭāpna kriyate, prathamataḥ samāsa eva bhavati, tenādantatvānṅīṣ siddho bavati| kathaṃ punaraśvaderupapadatvam| yāvatā dvitīyadhātvadhikāre saptamyā nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hi dvitīyadhātvadhikāre yat saptamyā nirdiṣṭaṃ tadevopapadasaṃjñaṃ bhavati| api tu yadapyupoccāritaṃ padaṃ tadapyupapadaṃ bhavatyeva, tadapi śāstre `itaretarānyonyopapadācca' (1.3.16) ityādau sūtre kvacidākṣīyata eva. tasmādaśvādikamapyuccāritapadatvādupapamiha vivakṣitam| padvaṃ punastasya padyate gamyate'nenārtha ita kṛtvā; na tu subantatvāt; iha supo'sambhavāt| subanutpatteḥ prāk samāsāt| yadi tarhi yadupoccā4ritaṃ padaṃ tadapīhopapadaṃ gṛhyate, tadātiprasaṅgaḥ syāt; rājaśritamityatrāpi prāk subutpatteḥ samāsaprasaṅgāt, tadataśca padatvābhāvānnalopo na bhavati ? asarvaviṣayatvādasya jñāpakasyetyadoṣaḥ| na hyanena sarvatra `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ prāk subutpatteḥ samāso bhavatiṭa iita jñāpyate, kiṃ tarhi ? kvacideveṣṭaviṣaye | kathametajjñāyate ? `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' (6.3.14) iti kṛdanta uttarapade saptamyā alugvidhānāt| yadi tarhi sarvatraiva gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ syāt tadā saptamyāḥ kṛdanta uttarapade'lugvidhānaṃ nopapadyate-- bileśaya ityādau, saptamyā asambhavāt| tasmāt kvacideva prāk subutpatteḥ samāsaḥ, na sarvatreti|evañca kṛtvā `sā hi tasya dhanakrītā prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī' ityādau ṭābantena samāsa upapanno bhavati|| 20.amaivāvyayena| (2.2.20) `svāduṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte' iti| `svādubhi' (3.4.26) iti ṇamul| svādumītyatasmādeva māntanirdeśādupapadasya makārāntatvaṃ nipātyate| yadi pūrveṇaiva samāse siddhe niyamārtham vacanam; evañca sati saddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo'nteraṇāpyevakārakaraṇaṃ niyamārtho bhaviṣyati, tatkimarthamevakārakaraṇamityāha-- `evakārakakaraṇam' ityādi kimarthaṃ punastadupapadaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ kriyata ityata āha-- `amaiva tulyavidhānam' ityādi| yena vākyenāyameva pratyayo vidhīyate na tu pratyayāntaram; tena yadupapadaṃ nirdiśyate tadamaiva tulyavidhānam, tasyaiva samāso yathā syādityevamarthamevakārakaraṇamupapadaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ kriyate| sa ca samāsaḥ pratyāsatteramaiva bhavati, na pratyayāntareṇeti vijñāyate| `agre bhuktvā, agre bhojam' iti| atrāgreśabda upapadam `vibhāṣāgreprathamapūrveṣu' (2.4.24) ityamā ktvāpratyayena ca tulyavidhānamiti na samasyate| avyayagrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| na hyanavyavamamantamasti yannivṛttyarthamavyayagrahaṇamarthavadbhavati|| 21. tṛtīyarāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām| (2.2.21) `paryāpto bhoktum' iti| `paryāptavacanaṣvalamartheṣu' (3.4.66) ityatra `śakadhṛṣajñāglāghaṭarabha' (3.4.65) ityādeḥ sūtrāt tumungrahaṇānuvṛttestumunpratyayaḥ|| 22. ktvā ca| (2.2.22) `alaṃ kṛtvā, khalu kṛtvā ' iti| `alaṃkhalyoḥ pratiṣedhayoḥ prācāṃ ktvā' (3.4.18) sa ca tṛtīyaprabhṛtibhyaḥ pūrvaḥ|| 23. śeṣo bahuvrīhiḥ| (2.2.23) `upayuktādyo'nyaḥ' iti| abhihitādanya ityarthaḥ| `yadyānyaḥ samāso noktaḥ' iti| yatrānyā samāsasaṃjñā na vihitetyarthaḥ| `citraguḥ' iti| atra bahuvrīhitve sati `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam' (6.2.1) ityeṣa vidhirbhavati| `unmattagaṅgam' iti| `anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām' (2.1.21) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| asati hi śeṣagrahaṇa ihāpi bahuvrīhiḥ syāt| nanu ca bahuvrīhau prāpte'vyayībhāvastvārabhyamāṇastasyaiva bādhako bhaviṣyati, tatkuto bahuvrīhiprasaṅgaḥ ? `prākkaḍārāt paraṃ kāryam' ityasmin pakṣa idaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupanyastam| tatra hi pakṣe kayadi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tataḥ anyapadārtheca saṃjñāyām' (2.1.21) iti vacanaprāmāṇyadavyayībhāvaḥ syāt| paratvādbahuvrīhirityeke| ayantu pakṣo vṛttikāreṇa nāśrita ityayuktametat| tasmāt `ākaḍārādekā saṃjñā' (1.4.1) ityasmin pakṣe `vyaktiḥ padārthaḥ' ityeddarśamāśrityedaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupanyastam| vyaktau hi padārthe pratilakṣye lakṣaṇaṃ pravarttate| atrāsati śeṣagrahaṇe yadesadviṣayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tadakṛtārthamityavaśyaṃ tena pravarttitavyam| ekasaṃjñādhikārācca yogapadyaṃ na sambhavatīti vacanaprāmāṇyādubhayaprasaṅgaḥ, ubhe api paryāyeṇa syātāmityapare|| 24. anekamanyapadārthe| (2.2.243) anekagrahaṇaṃ subityanena sambadhyate, prathamāntatvāt; na supeti tṛtīyāntena| `prāptodako grāmaḥ' ityādīni dvitīyādivibhktyartheṣu yathākramaṃ bahuvrīherudāharaṇāni| `prathamārthe tu na bhavati' iti| anabhidhānāt| na hi vṛṣṭe deve gata iti vākyādyo'rthaḥ pratīyate, sa vṛṣṭadevaśabdāt pratīyate| `anekagrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| evaṃ manyate-- anekagrahaṇamityekasya mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ syāt, etaccāyuktam; yathaiva hi `supsupā' (2.1.4) ityadhikārāt samarthaparibhāṣopasthānācca tatpuruṣa ekasya na sambhavati, tathā bahuvrīhirapi na bhaviṣyatīti kimarthamanekagrahaṇamityāha-- `bahūnāmapi yathā syāt' iti| `supsupā'(2.1.4) ityadhikārāt samarthaparibhāṣopasthānāccānekasyaiva samāse labdhe satyanekagrahaṇaṃ pracuratārthaṃ vijñāyate, tena bahūnāmapi bhavati| citragvādeḥ sakāśāt susūkṣmajaṭakeśādiṣu pracurāṇi padāni bhavanti| athānyapadārthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorviṣayavibhāgārtham| aviśeṣaṇa tatpuruṣa ucyamāṇo'nanyapadārthe kṛtāvakāśo'nyapadārthe paratvātadbahuvrīhiṇā yathā bādhyeta-- vīrapuruṣako grāmaḥ, citragurdevadatta iti| `bahuvrīhiḥ samānādhikaraṇānām' ityādi| samānādhikaraṇānāṃ padānāṃ bahuvrīhirbhavatītyetartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimarthamidamityāha-- `vyadhikaraṇānāṃ mā bhūt' iti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- abhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛtaddhitasamāsā bhavanti, na ca vyadhikaraṇānāṃ bahuvrīhau kṛte vivakṣitārthābhidhānamasti| na hi pañcābhirbhuktamasyeti vākyādyo'rthaḥ pratīyate sa pañcabhuktaśabdāt| tasmādanabhidhānādvayadhikaraṇānāṃ bahuvrīhirna bhaviṣyati| yatra tvabhidhānamasti tatra vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi bhavatyeva samāsaḥ- kaṇṭhekāla iti| `avyayānāñca' iti| bahuvrīhirbhavatīti sambandhanīyam| cakārādanavyayānāñca kvacit| asamānādhikaramārthamidam| `uccairmukham' iti| uccaiḥ śabdasyāvyayasyāsasattakatvavācitvāt sattvavācinā mukhaśabdena nāsti sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tathā'pi gamakatvāt samāso bhavatyeva| anavyayānāmudāharaṇam- kaṇṭhe sthitaḥ kālo yasyeti sa kaṇṭhekāla ityevamādi| kathaṃ punastulye'pi vaiyadhikaraṇye padānāṃ kvacidbahuvrīhergamakatvaṃ bhavati ? kvacinna bhavatīti ? śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt| śabdaśaktayaśca pratiniyatāśrayāḥ kvacideva pravarttante; na sarvatra| `saptamyupamānapūrvapadasyottarapadalopaśca' iti| saptamyantaṃ pūrvapadaṃ yasyottarapadasya tat saptamīpūrvapadam| tasya pareṇa padāntareṇa samāso bhavati| tasya ca saptamyantapūrvapadasyottarapadalopo bhavati| kaṇṭhe sthita iti vigṛhya `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ| `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' (6.3.14) ityaluk| `kaṇṭhe sthitaḥ kālo'syeti kaṇṭhekālaḥ' iti| atra saptamyantapūrvapadasya samānādhikaraṇatvāt siddha eva bahuvrīhiḥ| uttarapadalopastu vidhīyate. evamanyatrāpi veditavyam| upamānaṃ pūrvapadaṃ yasyottrapadasya tat padāntareṇa samasyate| tasyopamānapūrvapadasyottarapadalopa vidhīyate| uṣṭramukhamiva mukhamasyoṣṭramukhaḥ, kharamukhaḥ| atroṣṭra upamānaṃ pūrvapadaṃ mukhasya| nanu coṣṭramukamupamānaṃ devadattamukhasya, na tūṣṭraḥ ? upamanāvayavatvāduṣṭro'pyupamānamucyata ityadoṣaḥ| `samudāyavikāraṣaṣṭhyāśca' iti|uttarapadalopaścetyanuvarttate| samudāyaṣaṣṭhyāntādvikāraṣaṣṭhyantācca pūrvapadāt paraṃ yaduttarapadaṃ tat padāntareṇa samasyate| tasya ca samudāyavikāraṣaṣṭhyantapūrvapadasyottarapadasya lopo bhavati| keśānāṃ saṅghātaḥ keśasaṅghātaḥ, sa cūḍāsyeti keśacūḍa ityatra samudāyasamudāyitasambandheṃ ṣaṣṭhī| `suvarṇasya vikāro'laṅkāro'sya' ityatra vikāravikārisambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| `prādibhyaḥ'ityādi| uttarapadalopaścetyanurttate| dhātorjātaṃ niṣpannaṃ dhātujam| prādibhyaḥ pūrvapadebhyaḥ paraṃ yaddhātujamuttarapadaṃ patitaśabdādi tadantasya bahuvrīhirbhavati| tasya cottarapadasya vā lopaḥ| `ऩño'styarthānām'ityādi| naña uttareṣāṃ vidyamānādīnāmityarthaḥ| iha subiti varttate; astiśabdaścāyaṃ tiṅantaḥ ṭhaastikṣīretyevamādi na sidhyatīti yo manyeta taṃ pratyāha-- `subadhikāre' iti| astikṣīrādeḥ samāsa ucyate - pratipādyate yena tadastikṣīrādervacanam| vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam- `upasargavibhaktasvarapratirūpakāśca nipātā bhavanti' iti vibhaktipratirūpako'yamastiśabdo nipātaḥ, na tiṅantaḥ| tenāstikṣīrā brāhmaṇītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati| 25. saṃkhyayā'vyayāsannādūrādhikasaṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye| (2.2.25) `upadaśāḥ' iti| `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt' (5.4.73) iti ḍac samāsāntaḥ, ṭilopaśca| daśānāṃ samīpe ye varttante te tathocyante, te punarnavaikādaśa vā| pūrvapadārthapradhāno'yaṃ samāsaḥ| yadyevam, kastarhyavyayībhāvasyāsya ca viṣayavibhāgaḥ; so'vyayībhāvo'vavyayasya samīpe varttamānasya `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā pūrvapadārthapradāna eva vidhīyate ? ucyate-- yadā samīpinaḥ prādhānyaṃ tadā bahuvrīhiḥ,yadā tu samīpasya prādhānyaṃ tadāvyayībhāvaḥ- ityeṣa viṣayavibhāgaḥ| `upaviṃśāḥ' iti| pūrvavaḍḍac| `tirviśaterḍiti' (6.4.142) iti ṭilopaḥ| `āsannadaśāḥ' iti| daśānāmāsannā āsannadaśāḥ| te ca pūrvavannavaikādaśa vā| `adūradaśāḥ' iti| daśānāmadūrā ye, te punaḥ pūrvoktā eva| `adhikadaśāḥ' iti| daśānāmadhikāḥ , te punarekādaśādayaḥ| `dvitrāḥ' iti| dvau vā trayo vati vigrahaḥ| vārthecāyaṃ samāsaḥ| vārthaścāyaṃ saṃśayaḥ, na vikalpaḥ| yadi vārtha iha vikalpa āśrīyate tato yadā dvau bhavataḥ, tadā bahuvacanaṃ na syāt| tasmāt saṃśayo'tra vārthaḥ| saṃśayite cārthe bahuvacanaṃ bhavati, yathā-- kita bhavataḥ putrāḥ| uktañca bhāṣye-- `avijñāte'rthe bahuvacanaṃ prayoktavyam' iti| tatkatham? saṃśayajñānasyobhayapakṣarāmarśitvena bahvarthaviṣayatvāt| ubhayapakṣāparāmarśitve saṃśaya eva na syāt| atha vā-- pañcaivātra sadā bhavanti, na kadāciddvau trayo veti| tathā ca `dvitrā' ityukte pañcaiveti gamyate| saiṣā pañcādhiṣṭhānāvāgiti tato yuktaṃ bahuvacanam| yadi tarhi vārthe'yaṃ samāsaḥ, tasyārthasyānyapadārthatvāt pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ samāsaḥ ? na siddhyati, matvarthe hi pūrvayogaḥ; amatvartho'yaṃ yogaḥ| atha vā-- prathamārthe varjayitvā'nyatra vibhaktyarthe pūrveṇa samāsaḥ| prathamārthamidaṃ vacanam| `tricaturāḥ' iti| `caturo'cprakaraṇe caturastryupābhyāmupasaṃkhyānam' (vā.639) ityac samāsāntaḥ| `dvidaśāḥ' iti| dvirdaśeti vigrahaḥ| sujarthe'yaṃ samāsaḥ| daśasambandhinī yā''vṛttirdaśaśabdena lakṣyamāṇā sā dviśabdenākhyāyate| sujarthaśca pratyayārtho nānyapadārtha iti pūrveṇa na siddhyati| atha vā-- prathamārthe'picāyam, amatvarthe'pi; ataḥ pūrveṇa na sidhyati| samāsa eva sujarthaṃ gamayituṃ samartha iti vṛttau suj na prayujyate| `adhikā viṃśatirgavām' iti|
