viṃśatiśabdo'tra saṃkhyāna eva varttate; na tu saṃkhyeye dravye|| 26. diṅnāmānyantarāle| (2.2.26) `dakṣiṇapūrvā' iti| prathamārthe'pyayaṃ samāsa iṣyate, amatvarthe'pi tatpūrveṇa na sidhyatītyamamatvarthaṃ ārambhaḥ pratipadavidhānārthaśca| `vibhāṣā diksamāse' (1.1.28) ityatra diśāṃ yaḥ samāsaḥ pratipadavihitastasya grahaṇamiṣyate| pratipadavihitaśca samāso diśāmeva bhavati yadyayaṃ yoga ārabhyate, nānyathā| `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ' iti| sa punaḥ `striyāṃ puṃvat' (6.3.34) iti yogavibhāgena sidhyatīti veditavyam| `nāmagrahaṇaṃ rūḍhyartham' iti| loke ye rūḍhañā dikśabdāstatparihārthamityarthaḥ| `aindryāśca kauberyāśca' iti. nemau rūḍhiśabdau, kiṃ tarhi ? yogikau-- indrasyeyamaindrī, kuberasyeyaṃ kauberī| `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇ|| 27. tatra tenedamiti sarūpe|(2.2.27) `itikaraṇaḥ' ityādi| samāsādabhimate'rthe itikaraṇo yamarthaṃ pratipādayati taṃ darśayitumāha-- `laukikamarthamanusārayati' iti| anugamayati prabodhayatīti yāvat| sa punarlaukiko'rtho grahaṇādiriti darśayannāha `tataḥ' ityādi| yasmāditikaraṇo laukikamarthamanusārayati tato hetorgarhaṇādiriti sarvaṃ labhyate| `yattatretyādinā' karmavyatīhāra iti parasparagrahaṇam, parasparagrahaṇañcetikaraṇādeva labhyata iti veditavyam| svarūpavidhiratretikaraṇādeva na bhavatīti veditavyam| daṇḍaiśceti karaṇe tṛtīyā| `sa cāvyayam' iti| tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣu pāṭhādavyayībhāvaḥ; `avyayībhāvaśca' (1.1.41) ityavyayasaṃjñāvidhānāt| `sarūpam' iti| samānasya `jyotiravacanasya' (6.3.85) ityādinā sabhāvaḥ|| 28.tena saheti tulyayoge| (2.2.28) `tulyayoge varttamānam' ityādi| tulyogaḥ - samānasambandhaḥ| taṃ yadā sahaśabdodyotayati tadāsau tatra varttate| `saputraḥ' iti| saha putreṇeti vigrahaḥ karttavyaḥ| `sahayukte'pradhāne' (2.3.19) iti tṛtīyā| `vopasarjanasya' (6.3.82) iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| atra saputra āgato devadatta iti devadattasya putrasya cāgamanena tulyasamban‌dhaḥ sahaśabdena dyotyate| atha kathaṃ punaḥ sakarmaka ityādau syāt ? kathañca na syādityāha-- `na hyatra' ityādi| `prāyikam' iti|asarvaviṣayamityarthaḥ| kutaḥ punaḥ prayikatvamasya labhyate ? itikaraṇāt| nanu cānyaditikaraṇasya prayojanamasti, kiṃ tat ? sahaśabdaḥ svarūpapadārthako yathā gamyeta; anyathā hyarthanirdeśo'yaṃ vijñāyeta| tataśca sākaṃ sārddhamityādayo'pi samasyeran ? naivaṃ brūmaḥ; -- iha sūtre ya itikaraṇastato labhyata iti, kiṃ tarhi ? pūrvasūtrādyo'nuvarttate tata iti|| 29. cārthe dvandvaḥ| (2.2.29) kaḥ punarayaṃ cārtho nāmetyāha-- `samuccayā'nvācaya' ityādi| samuccitiḥ - samuccayaḥ| sādhanamekaṃ kriyāṃ vā prati kriyāsādhanānāmātmarūpabhedanena cīyamānatā'nekatvamiti yāvat| sa punastulyabalānāmaniyatakramayogapadyānāmeva bhavati, yathā-- gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśuñcāharaharnayamāno vaivasvatastṛptiṃ nopayātīti| anvācayo'pi yatraikasya prādhānyam, itaradapradhānam, tadanurodhenānvācīyamānatā, yathā-- bho vaṭo bhikṣāmaṭa gāñcānayeti| itaretarayogaḥ samāhāraśca samuccayasyaiva prabhedaḥ| sa eva hi parasparāpekṣāṇāmavayavabhedānugata itaretarayogaḥ, yathā-- devadattayajñadattābhyāmidaṃ kāryaṃ karttavyam| ubhāvapi tatkāryaṃ prati parasparāpekṣau| tathā hi tadekasyāpyabhāve na kriyate| avayavapradhānaścāyamiti dvitvāddvicavacanaṃ bhavati| parasparāpekṣāṇāmeva tirohitāvayavabhedaḥ saṃhatipradhānaḥ samāhāraḥ; yathā-- chatropānahamatiti| atrāpi kasyāñcit kriyāyāṃ chattrādeḥ parasparāpekṣatvam| saṃhatipradhānatvāccaikavacanam| yadi tarhi samuccayānvācayāvapi cārthau tadā tayorapi samāsaḥ prāpnotīttayata āha-- `tatra' ityādi| samuccaye tāvat parasparānabhisambandhā eva gavādayo nayanādibhiḥ sambadhyamānāḥ samucīyanta ityāsāmarthyāt satyapi cārthe tasmin na bhavati samāsaḥ| anvācaye'pyekaṃ sāpekṣaṃ netarat, yathā-- pūrvokta udāharaṇe| ttara hi gavānayanaṃ bhikṣāṭanamapekṣate, na tu bhikṣāṭanaṃ gavānayanam,; vināpi tena tadanuṣṭhānāt| sa yadi gāṃ paśyati tadā tāmapyānayati, na cet bhikṣāmevāṭatītyanyatarāpekṣārahite cārthe na bhavati samāsaḥ| `itaretarayoge samāhāre ca vidhīyate' iti| tatra sarveṣāṃ sāmarthyasya vidyāmānatvāt| `vāktvacam, vāgdṛṣadam' iti. `dvand‌vāccudaṣahāntāt samāhāre' (5.4.106) iti ṭac| samāsāntaḥ| `jātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) ityekavadbhāvaḥ|| 30. upasarjanaṃ pūrvam| (2.2.30) `pūrvavacanaṃ paraprayoganivṛttyartham' iti| nanu ca paraprayogaviparyayo loke na dṛṣṭa eva; tatkathaṃ paraprayoganivṛttyarthena pūrvagrahaṇenetyata āha-- `aniyamo hi syāt' iti| sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅa| evaṃ manyate-- yadyapi paraprayogaviparyayo na dṛṣṭaḥ, tathāpyasati niyāmake vākye puruṣāparādhādviparītaprayogo'pi sambhāvyeta| yeṣāñca vākyameva samāsībhavatīti darśanam, teṣāṃ vākyasyānitayatakramatvāt tadvikāro'pi samāso'niyatakramaḥ sāditi sūtrārambhaḥ|| 31. rājadantādiṣu param| (2.2.31)ṭa `pūrvasya paranipāta' iti| liptavāsitādyuptagāḍhaparyanteṣu| udūkhalamasalādayo ye dvandvāḥ, tatra kvacidalpāctaratvāt pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti, kvacid dhyantatvāt pūrvanipātaḥ, kvacidajādyantatvāt; kvacitulyādaniyamaḥ| `dṛṣdupalam' iti pramādāccāyaṃ pāṭho lakṣyate| alpāctaratvādaddṛṣacchabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ siddhaḥ| `akṣibhruvam, dāragavam' iti| acaturādisūtreṇāc (5.4.79) samāsāntaḥ| `sthūlapūlāsam' iti| pramadapāṭho'yaṃ lakṣyate;pūrvoktādeva kāraṇāt|| 32. dvandve ghi| (2.2.32) `upasarjanam' ityanvarthasaṃjñāvidhānādapradhānasyopasarjanasaṃjñā vihitā| dvandve ca sarveṣāṃ padānāṃ prādhānyam| na kasyacidaprādhānyamityupasarjanasaṃjñāyā abhāvādaniyame prāpte vacanamidam| atra yatra bahūnāṃ pūrvanipātaprasaṅgastatra kimekasyāniyamo bhaviṣyati, uta sarveṣāmityāha-- `anekaprāptāvekasya' ityādi| eva cārtho jātipadārthasyāśrayaṇāllabhyate vyaktau tu padārthe prativyakti śāstrapravṛtyā bhavitavyam, tataḥ sarveṣāṃ niyamaḥ syāt| ākṛtau tu padārthe lakṣya ekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sakṛdeva pravarttate| tena caikasya pūrvanipāte jātiḥ kṛtārtheti śeṣāṇāmaniyamo bhavati| evamuttaratrāpyekasya niyamaḥ, śeṣāṇāntvaniyama iti veditavyam| `vispaṣṭapaṭuḥ' iti| vispaṣṭaḥ paṭuḥ, mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ|| 33. ajādyadantam| (2.2.33) `dvandve ghyantādajādyadantaṃ vipratiṣedhena' iti| `dvandve ghi' (2.2.32) iti tasmādajādyadantamityetatadbhavati vipratiṣedhena| `dvandve ghi'ityasyāvakāśaḥ-- paṭuśuklau,paṭuguptau| `ajādyadantam' ityasyāvakāśaḥ-- uṣṭraśaśau, uṣṭrakharau| indrāgnī ityatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti, ajādyadantaṃ bhavati vipratiṣedhena|| 34. alpāctaram| (2.2.34) `ṛtunakṣatrāṇām' ityādi| ṛtūnāmānupūrvya prādurbhāvakṛtam, nakṣatrāṇāmudayakṛtam| ṛtunakṣatrāṇāmityatraiva varṇagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kṛtamiti paryanuyogadoṣamāśaṅkyāha-- `samānākṣarāṇām' ityādi| asamānākṣarāṇāmapi varṇānāmānupūrvyeṇa pūrvanipāta iṣyata iti pṛthagvacanam. ānupūrvyañca varṇānāṃ janmakṛtamiti lokavyavahāre prasiddham| prasiddhiśca śrutikṛtā| śrutau hi paṭhyate `mukhate brāhmaṇamasṛjat, bāhubhyāṃ rājanayam, ūrubhyāṃ vaiśyam, padbhyāṃ śūdram' iti| `saṃkhyāyā alpīyasyāḥ' iti dvandve ceti vaktavyam| `dvitrāḥ,tricaturāḥ' iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `navatiśatam' iti dvandvaḥ|| 35. saptamīviśeṣaṇe bahuvrīhau| (2.2.35) `sarvanāmasaṃkhyayoḥ' iti| yatra guṇavacanena saha samāsaḥ so'sya viṣayaḥ| yatra tu dravyavācinā tatra sarvanāmaṃkhyayorviśeṣaṇatvādeva pūrvanipātaḥ siddhaḥ| `saptamyāḥ pūrvanipāte' ityādi| saptamyantasya pūrvanipāte prāpte gaḍvādibhyaḥ paravacanaṃ karttavyamiti| saptamynataṃ paramucyate - kathyate yena vyākhyānena tat paravacanam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- āhitāderākṛtigaṇatvād gaḍukakaṇṭhaprabhṛtayastatraiva draṣṭavyāḥ,tena gaḍvādibhyaḥ paraṃ saptamyantaṃ bhaviṣyati| `kathaṃ vahegaḍuḥ' iti| yadi gaḍvādibhyaḥ saptamyāḥ paravacanamiti bhāvaḥ| `prāptasya ca bādhā vyākhyeyā' iti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `vāhitāgnyādiṣu' (2.2.37) ityato vāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena prāptasya paranipātasya bādhanaṃ bhaviṣyati|| 36. niṣṭhā| (2.2.36) `nanu viśeṣaṇamevātra niṣṭhā' iti| kṛtaśabdaḥ kriyāśabdaḥ| kaṭaśabdo dravyavacanaḥ| tatra yathā guṇo dravyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ tathā kriyā'pi| tathā sati niṣṭhāntasya viśeṣaṇatvāt pūrveṇaiva pūrvanipātaḥ siddhaḥ| kaṭekṛtamanenetyādinā vigrahabhedena niṣṭhāyā viśeṣaṇatvābhāvaṃ darśayati| atra vigrahe saptamyantameva viśeṣaṇam, niṣṭhāntaṃ viśeṣyam, sāmānādhikaraṇye hi kriyāguṇau viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvau niyamenānubhavataḥ, na hi vaiyadhikaraṇye| tathā hi-- paṭasya śuklaḥ, kākasya gatirityatra guṇāderviśiṣyetvam, vyavacchedyatvāt; dravyasya tu viśeṣaṇatvam, vyavacchedakatvāt| `niṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvanipāte' ityādi| jātyādibhyo niṣṭhāntaṃ paramucyate, tena tadvyākhyānaṃ karttavyam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- sāraṅgajagdhī-māsajātā-sukhajātādayaḥ śabdāḥ āhitāderākṛtigaṇatvāt tadantaḥpātinaḥ, tena jātikālasukhādibhyo niṣṭhāntaṃ paraṃ bhavatīti| `sāraṅgajagdhī' iti| sāraṅgaśabdo jātivacanaḥ| tataḥ `ktādalpākhyāyām' (4.1.51) ityanuvarttamāne `asvāṅgapūrvapadādvā' (4.1.53) iti ṅīṣ| `kathaṃ kṛtakaṭaḥ' iti| kaṭaśabdasya jātivācitvāditi praśnaḥ| `prāptasya cābādhā vyākhyeyā' iti| tena kṛtakaṭa ityatrāpi bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ| sā punaraprāptasya cābādhā pūrvavadeva vyākhyeyā| evamuttaratrāpi vyākhyeyā| `praharaṇārthebhyaḥ' ityādi| praharaṇamartho yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| tebhya pare niṣṭhāsaptamyau bhavata ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- asyudyataḥ, daṇḍapāṇirityevamādināṃ śabdānāmāhitāgnyādiṣu pāṭhāt pare niṣṭhāsaptamyau bhavata iti|| 37. vā''hitāgnyādiṣu|(2.2.37) 38. kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraye| (2.2.38) kaḍārādayo ye guṇaśabdāsteṣāṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ bhavatītyāha-- `guṇaśabdānām' ityādi| gatārtham|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ <2.3> atha dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. anabhihite| (2.3.1) dadhāterhinotervā'nabhihita ityasya rūpam; samānatvāt, anekārthatvācca dhātūnām| na jñāyate kimarthasyānabhihitaśabdasya grahaṇamiti sandehaḥ syāt, atastaṃ nirākarttumāha-- `anabhihite'nukte' ityādi| yadyanabhihite karmādau dvitīyādayo vibhaktayo bhavantīti sāmānyenocyeta; tato yathā `kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ' ityatra ktapratyayena karmaṇo'bhihitatvāt kaṭaśabdād‌dvitīyā na bhavati, tathā `kaṭaṃ karoti', `bhīṣmamūdāraṃ śobhanaṃ darśanīyam' ityatra kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānayā dvitīyayā bhīṣmādigatasya karmaṇo'bhihitatvādbhīṣmādibhyo dvitīyā na prāpnoti| tasmāt kaścidviśeṣo'trābhimata iti matvā taṃ viśeṣaṃ pṛcchati-- `kenānabhihitate'? iti| itaro viditābhiprāya āha-- `tiṅakṛttaddhitasamāsaiḥ' ityādi| kriyata iti karmaṇi lakāraḥ| `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67)| `riṅa śayagliṅaśu' (7.4.28) iti riṅādeśaḥ| `śatyaḥ, śatikaḥ' iti| `śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate' (5.1.21) iti ṭhanyatau bhavataḥ| `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityevamādi| tatredamuktam- karmādayo'vyapare vibhaktīnāṃ vācyāḥ, ata stadīye bahutve bahuvacanaṃ bhavatīti| evañca bruvatā vṛttikṛtā karmādyāśritāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ dvitīyādayo vibhaktayo bhavantītyetaduktaṃ bhavati| na ca tatra kaścidviśeṣa upāttaḥ| santi ca karmādayo'bhihitāḥ, anabhihitāśca| tatra viśeṣānupādānta, yathā anabhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣvekatvādiṣu dvitīyādayo vibhaktayo bhavanti, tathā'bhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣvapi syuḥ| ato'nabhihitā ye karmādayastadāśrayeṣvekatvādiṣu yathā vibhaktayaḥ syuranyatra mā bhūvannityanabhihita ityetadviśeṣaṇamārabhyate| `anabhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣu' iti| anabhihitāḥ karmādaya āśrayā yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| etena `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ityādeḥ śāstrasya, anabhihita ityetasya ca `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityevanamādibhiḥ sahaikavākyatāṃ darśayati-- anabhihite karmaṇi dvitīyā bahuṣu bahuvacanamiti| evamanyatrāpyekavākyatā veditavyā| ekavākyatā ca guṇapradhānabhāvamantareṇa na sambhavatītyekasya guṇabhāvena bhavitavyam, aparasya pradhānabhāvena| tatra viśeṣaṇatvādanabhihita ityasya karmādyepekṣayā guṇabāvaḥ, karmādīnāṃ tu viśeṣyatvāt prādhānyam, ekatvādyapekṣayā karmādīnāntu viśeṣaṇatvādaprādhānyam| ekatvādīnāṃ viśeṣyatvāt pradhānabhāvaḥ| atha kathaṃ kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānā dvitīyā mīṣmādipadānugataṃ karmābhidadhāti, yathā-- niṣṭheti cet ? syādadat-- `yathā kaṭaḥ kṛto bhīṣma udāraḥ śobhano darśanīya ityatra karoteḥ karmaṇyutpadyamānā niṣṭhā sarva bhīṣmādikamapi karmābhidadhāti,tathā kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānā dvitīyā' iti, vārttametat; kṛta iti kriyākārakasambandhanimittakabhidhānam| kriyā cotpadyamānā sāmarthyāt sarvāṇi kārakadravyāṇyākṣipati| tataḥ kṛña utpadyamānaḥ ktaḥ sādhāraṇatayā yāvat karoteruyāti karmatāṃ tāvat sarvamevābhidadhātīti yuktam| bhīṣmādigatāyā api karmatāyāḥ ktapratyayenābhidhānam| kaṭastu viśiṣṭadravyavacanaḥ, tata utpadyamānā dvitīyā tadgatameva karma śaknotyabhidhātum, nānyagataṃ kiñcit, tatkathaṃ tayā bhīṣmādigatamapi karmābhidhīyate ? tathā ca nirarthakaṃ parigaṇanam| tasmāt tiṅakṛttaddhitasamāsairevābhidhānaṃ sambhavatīti sambhavadudāharaṇapradarśanamaparametat parisaṃkhyānaṃ veditavyam, na parigaṇanam|| 2. karmaṇi dvitīyā| (2.3.2) dvitīyā tiṅavibhaktirapyastīti tasyā apyatra grahaṇamiti kasyacidāṅkā syāt, atastannirākartumāha-- `dvitīyādayaḥ śabdāḥ' ityādi| karmaśabdeneha sādhanaṃ karma gṛhyate, na tu kriyākarma| tathā hi - ye vibhaktyarthā ekatvādayasteṣāṃ viśeṣaṇatvenaiva karmādayo'nukraṃsyante| na ca kriyākarmaṇi dvitvabahutve staḥ; sādhanakarmaṇi tu vidyete, tasmāt tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, netarasya| `ubhasarvatasoḥ'ityādi| ubhasarvaśabdayostasipratyayāntayoḥ prayoge dvitīyāvibhaktiḥ kāryāḥ| śeṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāmayamārambhaḥ| ubhasarvatasorityatra yadyupyabhaśabdaḥ paṭhitastathāpi sāmarthyādubhayaśabdo gṛhyate; sādharmyāt| na hyubhaśabdastasipratyayānto'sti; tasya nitydavivacanaṭābviṣayatvāt| tathā coktam-- `anyabhāvo nietyadvivucanaṭābviṣayatvādubhayo'nyatra' (1.1.27-vā.8,9) iti| `ubhayataḥ, sarvataḥ' iti| `pañcamyāstasil' (5.3.7)| dhikśabdayoge'pi dvitīyā kāryā| tathoparyādiṣu triṣu yoge dvitīyā kāryā| `āmreḍitānteṣu'iti| kṛtadvirvacaneṣvityarthaḥ| `uparyuyari grāmam' ityādau `uparyadhyadhasaḥ sāmīpye' (8.1.7) iti dvirvacanam| `tato'nyatrāpi dṛśyate' iti| yathoktādanyatrāpi dṛśyate dvitīyeti sambandhaḥ| kva cānyatra dṛśyata ityata āha-- `abhitaḥ' ityādi| `prayabhibhyāñca' (5.3.9) iti tasiḥ| apiśabdo vikalpārthaḥ| api dṛśyate'pi na dṛśyateca| tena hā tāta hā mātarityādi sidhyati|| 3. tṛtīyā ca hośchandasi| (2.3.3) `yavāgvā'gnahotraṃ juhoti' iti| yadyapyatra `supāṃ supo bhavanti' (vā.818) iti dvitīyāsthāne tṛtīyādeśavidhāne'pyetat sidhyati; tathāpi payasā juhoti, ājyena juhotītyevamādi na sidhyati| tathā hi-- sthānivadbhāvāt `svamornapuṃsakāt' (7.1.23) ityekasya luk prāpnoti| aparasya `ato'm' (7.1.24) ityambhāvaḥ|| 4.antarāntareṇa yukte| (2.3.4) `antarāntareṇaśabdau nipātau sāhacaryādgṛhyete' iti| ayamantarāśabdo yadyapi strīpratyayānto'sti, tathā'strīpratyayānto'pi;antareṇaśabdastvastrīpratyayānto gṛhyate| yaścāstrīpratyayānto'ntarāśabdaḥ sa nipāta evetyantarāśabdasya tāvannipātasya grahaṇam| atastena nipātena sāhacaryādantareṇaśabdasyāpi tasyaiva grahaṇam| tenānipāto yastṛtīyānto'ntareṇaśabdaḥ, yaśca ṭābanto'ntarāśabdastābhyāṃ yoge dvitīyā na bhavati| kiṃ te bābhrāvāṇāṃ śālaṅkāyamānāñcāntareṇa gatena ? grāmayorantarāyāṃ puri vasatītyantaraśabdo'tra viśeṣavacanaḥ| gamirapi jñānavacanaḥ| kiṃ te viśeṣaṇa jñānenetyarthaḥ| `ṣaṣṭhyapavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ' iti|ra śeṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ ṣaṣaṭhyāṃ prāptāyāmasyārambhāt| ṣaṣṭhyāpavādatvamasya yogasyāntarāntareṇaśabdārthapradarśanadvāreṇa vispaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `tatra' ityādi| madhyaṃ hi sambandhiśabdatvādamadhyabhūtaṃ dvitīyaṃ sambandhinamapekṣya bhavati| tatra yadapekṣaṃ madhyatvaṃ tato madhyena vyatireke samupajanite ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti| vinārtho'pi śeṣa eva| atrāpi ṣaṣṭhyeva prāpnoti| `antarā tvāñca māñca kamaṇḍaluḥ' iti| tava mama madhye kamaṇḍalurityarthaḥ| atha kamaṇḍaluśabdāddvitītā kasmānna bhavati ? satyapyantarāntareṇayoge tasya prādhānyāt| tathā hi-- kamaṇḍaloḥ svārthā pravṛttiḥ , yuṣmadasmadostu parārthā; kamaṇḍaluviśeṣaṇatvena tayoḥ pravṛttatvāt| tatra kamaṇḍaloḥ svārthe varttamānāt prādhānyenāvasthitvāt prātipadikārthādapracyutatvāt paratvāt prathamaiva bhavati| dvitīyāyāstvapradhāne yuṣmadasmacchabde'vakāśa iti tābhyāṃ teneva prathamāntena kamaṇḍalunopajanite vyatireke ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ dvitīyā vidhīyate| `antareṇa puruṣakāram' iti| vinā puruṣakāreṇetyarthaḥ| `antarā takṣaśilāṃ pāṭaliputrañca srugh‌nasya prākāraḥ' iti| atra srughnaḥ prākāraviśeṣaṇatvenopakṣīṇasāmarthya iti na bhavati tsayāntarāśabdena yogaḥ|| 5. kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge| (2.3.5) kālādhvanorityarthagrahaṇam| ata āha-- `kālaśabdebhyo'dhvaśabdebhyaśca' ityādi| `māsasya dviradhīte| krośasyaikadeśe parvataḥ| yojanasyaikadeśe parvataḥ' iti| nātra `kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' iti dvitīyā bhavati|| 6. apavarge tṛtīyā| (2.3.6) `apavargaḥ'iti| atyantasaṃyogasya phalarūpametadviśeṣaṇamupāttam| tacca kriyātyantasaṃyogasyaiva sambhavati, nānyasyati sāmarthyādatra kriyātyantasaṃyoga eva gṛhyate| sarvasyāśca kriyāyāḥ parisamāptirasti; tasmādviśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāt phalaprāptau satyāṃ kriyāyāḥ parisamāptirihāpavargo vijñāyata ityata āha-- `phalaprāptau' ityādi| `karttṛvyāvṛtau' iti| na hi māsamadhīto'nuvāko na cānena gṛhīta ityukte'pavargo gamyate, kiṃ tarhi ? kartturaśaktimātram| na ca tatrāpavargavyapadeśaḥ|| 7. saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye| (2.3.7) `adya bhuktvā devadatto dvyahe bhoktā, dvyahādbhoktā' iti| nanu cātra eka eva karttā, kārakabhede sati tannibandhano madhyavyayapadeśo bhavati, tat kathamasati kārakabhede kārakayormadhye kālo bhavatītyata āha-- `karttṛśaktyoḥ'ityādi| na hi dravyaṃ kārakam, kiṃ tarhi ? śaktiḥ, sā ceha bhidyate| tathā hi-- devadatte dve śaktī vyavasthite; ekādya bhujeḥ sādhanam, aparā dvyahe'tīti iti karttṛśaktibhede sati yukto madhyavyapadeśaḥ| `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ' ityādi| iṣvāsaḥ karttā, lakṣyaṃ karma| `karmāpādānayoḥ' iti. karma tadeva| apādānaṃ yataḥ paro niryāti| `karmādhikaraṇayorvā' iti| ihetyanena yannirdiśyatetadadhikaram| karma ca tadeva| `tayormadhye krośaḥ' iti| krośasyehāpādānādhikaramatvābhāvāt saptamīpañcamyau na bhavatiḥ| na hi krośāccharo'paiti, kiṃ tarhi ? tadekadeśāt| nāpi krośe vyavasthitaṃ lakṣyam, kiṃ tarhi ? tadekadeśa eva| tasmāt krośasya śeṣatvāt ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ saptamīpañcamyau vidhīyete| athātra saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? yāvatā kālādhvanau hi dvau, saptamīpañcamyāvapi dva, ata eva sāmāt saṃkhyātanudeśena bhavitavyam- kālāt saptamī, adhvanaḥ pañcamītyata āha-- `saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ' ityādi| `svaritenādhikāraḥ' (1.3.11) ityatra svariteneti yogavibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ, tata pūrveṇāpi sambadhyate. yatra svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate tatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ yathā syāt| iha tu svaritatvaṃ nāsti, ato na bhavati saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ|| 8. karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā| (2.3.8) `śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣat' iti| `anurlakṣaṇe' (1.4.84) iti karmapravacanayīsaṃjñā| 9. yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī| (2.3.9) `upakhāryāṃ droṇaḥ' iti| khāryā adhiko droṇa ityarthaḥ| `upo'dhike ca' (1.4.87) ityupaśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā| `yasya ceśvaravacanam' iti| yasya ceśvaravyapadeśa ityarthaḥ| īśvaravyadeśastu svāmina eva sambhavati| tatraiva saptamyā bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrānti syāt, atastānnirākarttumāha-- `yasya ceśvaravacanam' ityādi| yasya ceśvaravacanamityanena dvayorapi - svasvāminoḥ paryāyeṇa saptamī bhavatīti| katham, yāvatā `adhirīśvare' (1.4.97) ityanenādhikaśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā, īśvarastu svamī, sa ca svamapekṣya bhavati ? svasvāmisambandhe'dhiśabdaḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjño bhavati| tatra kadācit svāmī karmapravacanīyavibhaktayā yujyate, kadācit svamityetat pratipāditaṃ prāgeva| kathaṃ punaryasya ceśvaravacanamityucyamāne svamapi karmapravacanīyavibhaktyā yujyate, na hi tasyeśvaravyapadeśo'sti ? evaṃ tarhi anuktasamuccayārthaścakāraḥ kriyate, tena yasyeśvaravyapadeśo nāsti tatrāpi saptamī vijñāyata ityadoṣaḥ|| 10. pañcamyāpāṅapirabhiḥ| (2.3.10) apapariśabdayoḥ `apaparī varjane' (1.4.88) ityanena karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā, āṅaśca `āṅamaryādāvacane' (1.4.89) ityanena| `vṛkṣaṃ pari vidyotate' iti| pariḥ `lakṣaṇetyambhūtakhyāna'(1.4.90) ityādinā|| 11. pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt| (2.3.11) `mukhyasadṛśaḥ pratinidhiḥ' iti| mukhyo yaḥ kaścit kārye rūḍhaḥ - samarthaḥ, prasiddhaḥ - pradhānabhūtastena sadṛśo yastadabhāve tasya kāryasya siddhyarthamupādīyate sa pratinidhiḥ| `abhimanyurarjunataḥ prati' iti| mukhyādarjunādabhimanyuḥ pratinidhistataḥ pañcamīvibhaktirbhavati| pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ| `māṣānasmai tilebhyaḥ pratiyacchati' iti| ye tilāḥ pūrvaṃ dattāstebhyo māṣāṇāṃ pratidānam| tilebhya iti pañcamī bhavati| tilān gṛhītvā māṣān dadātītyarthaḥ| nanu ca `pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ' (1.4.92) iti prateḥ pratinidhipratidānarorevārthayoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tayoreva pratinā yoga upapadyate, na tu yataste tasyeti manyamāna āha-- `nanu ca' ityādi| `sambandhasambandhāt' iti| sambadhyata iti sambandhaḥ-pratinidhiḥ, pratidānañca, tadubhayamayi karmapravacanīyena pratinā yujyate| tena sambandhena yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa sambandhasambandhaḥ| kasyapunastena sambandhaḥ ? yataḥ pratinidhiḥ pratipādanañca tasya| sambandhiśabdau hi pratinidhipratidānaśabdau| tau ca nāsati pūrvavijñāte mukhye pūrvadatte ca bhavati iti pratinidhipratidānābhyāṃ yasya sambandhastasya tābhyāṃ sambandho'stīti te api karmapravacanīyairyukte bhavata iti| kvacit `sambandhisambandhāt' iti pāṭhaḥ| tatrāpi pratinidhiḥ hūtidānañca sambandhiśabdenocyate; tadubhayasyāpi karmapravacanīyena sambandhāt| tena sambandhinā yaḥ sambandhaḥ sa sambandhisambandha iti sa evārthaḥ|| 12. gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani| (2.3.12) yadi kriyāmātramiha ceṣṭāśabdenocyate tadā ceṣṭāgrahaṇamapārthakam| sarvo hi dhātuḥ kriyāvacanaḥ| tasmādviśeṣaṇaṃ pādānasāmarthyāt parispandavacano'yaṃ ceṣṭāśabdo vijñāyate, ityāha-- `parispandakriyāṇām' iti| parispandaḥ - śarīravyāpāraḥ, sā kriyā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| `adhvanītyarthagrahaṇam' iti| arthapradhānatvannirdeśasya, saptamīnirdeśācca| yadīha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt `anadhvanaḥ' iti kuryāt| `āsthitapratiṣedhaścāyaṃ {vijñeyaḥ- kāśikā|} vijñāyate iti| yena deśaviśeṣeṇa prāpyaṃ grāmādikaṃ prāpyate sa deśaviśeṣo loke'dhveti rūḍhaḥ| kena ca prāpyaṃ prāpyate ? yaḥ panthā ākrāntastena| tasmāt tasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| yadā tu sa evotpathena prāpyate tadā tasya patho'dhvavyapadeśo na bhavatīti bhavatyeva tatra caturthī| `dvitīyāgrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| karmaṇi kārake caturthyāṃ vikalpitāyāṃ pakṣe nyāyaprāptaiva dvitīyeti bhāvaḥ| tat kriyate bādhakabādhanārtham| `apavādaviṣaye'pi yathā syāt' iti| athārthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na gatikarmaṇītyevocyeta, yāvatā gatirartha eva ? naitadasti; yā gatirgaminaiva śabdāntarasannidhānādyanapekṣatayocyate tatra yathā syāt| pādaviharaṇātmikā ca yā gatiḥ pradhānabhūtā tasyā evagrahaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| teneha na bhavati-- striyaṃ gacchati, ajāṃ grāmaṃ nayati| atra hi gamemam̐thunamathaḥ strīśabdasannidhānādgamyate, na tu gameḥ kevalāt| nayateśca prāpaṇamevārthaḥ pradānabhūtaḥ, tadviśeṣaṇantu prādavihaṇamapradhānam| yadyevam,grāmaṃ gamayati grāmāya gamayatīti ṇante guṇabhūtatvādgamarna sidhyati, gameratra preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādiko hyarthaḥ prādhānyamanugacchati, naiṣa doṣaḥ ; na hyatra grāmo ṇyantasya karma, kiṃ tarhi ? gamereva|| 13. caturthī sampradāne| (2.3.13) `devadattāya rocate' iti| `rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ' (1.4.33) iti saṃpradānasaṃjñā| `puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhyati' iti| atra `spṛherīpsitaḥ' (1.4.36) ityanena| `tādarthye upasaṃkhyānam' iti| tacchabdena caturthyantasyārtho nirdiśyate| tasmā idaṃ tadartham, tasya bhāvastādarthyam| tatra caturthyā upasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `caturthī' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena tādarthye caturthī bhavatīti| athavā `caturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharakṣitaiḥ'(2.1.36) iti tādarthye caturthyāḥ samāsavacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ bhavati-- tādarthye'pi caturthīti| `klṛpi sampadyamāne' ityādi| klṛptyarthānāṃ dhānūnāṃ prayoge sampadyamāne karttari saṃpādanakriyāviśiṣṭe caturthī vaktavyā, vyākhyeyetyarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tameva yogavibhāgamāśritya| tathā `utpātena jñāpyamāne' ityādāvapi| `mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūḥ' iti| yavāgūrmūtravikārarūpeṇa bhavatītyarthaḥ| vikārarūpāpattau caturtī vijñeyā| teneha na bhavati-- devadattasya śālayaḥ saṃpadyanta iti| yadā cābhedavivakṣā tadā paratvāt prathamaiva bhavati, na caturthī-- mūtramidaṃ saṃpadyate yavāgūriti, uccāro'yaṃ sampadyate yavaudana iti| yadā tu `janikarttṛḥ prakṛtiḥ' (1.4.30) iti prakṛterapādānātvaṃ vivakṣyate tadā yavāgvā iti pañcamyeva syāt-- mūtraṃ sampadyate yavāgvā iti| `vātāya kapilā vidyut' iti| atra kapilāvidyudutpāto vātasya lakṣaṇam| tena jñāpyamāne vāte caturthī bhavati| `arocakine' iti| `ata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) itīniḥ|| 14. kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ| (2.3.14) `kriyārthā kriyopapadaṃ yasya' ityādi| kathaṃ punarayamartho labhyate, yāvatā neha sūtre dvitīyaṃ kriyāgrahaṇamupāttamastītyāha-- `tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' (3.3.10) ityasmin viṣaye kriyārthopapadaṃ sambhavatīti yadatra kriyārthopapadaṃ tat kriyaiveti gamyate| `sthāninaḥ'iti| śabdāstiṣṭhantyasminniti sthānam| tadasyāstīti sthāni| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yasyārthaḥ pratīyate, na tu prayogo'sti, sa sthānītyucyata iti| `edhebhyo vrajati'iti| āṅapūrvo haratiratra sthānī, tatkarma tvedhāḥ| edhānāharttu vrajatītyarthaḥ| nanu cātra tādarthyamasti, atastādarthyaṃ ityevaṃ siddhā caturthī, tatkimarthaṃmidaṃ vananam ? niyamārtham- sthānino'prayujyamānasyaiva karmaṇi yathā syāt, prayujyamānas mā bhūt| `bhakṣiratra sthānī' iti| praviśa gṛhaṃ piṇḍīṃ bhakṣayeti gamyamānatvāt| praviśa tarpaṇamityatrāpi pibatiḥ sthānī| `na tu kriyārthopapadaḥ' iti| tumunnādiviśiṣṭapratyayānto hi kriyārthopapado bhavati| ayantu loḍantaḥ| na ca loṭ kriyārthopapade vidhīyata iti na bhavati bhakṣiratra kriyārthopapadaḥ|| 15. tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt| (2.3.15) `tumunā samānārthaḥ' iti| vṛttau gamyamānatvāt samānaśabdo na prayuktaḥ| `tumarthabhāvavacanapratyayāntāt' iti| tumartho bhāvavacanapratyayo'nto yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `bhāvavacanāśceti vakṣyati, tasyedaṃ grahaṇam' iti| sa eva hi tumartho bhāvavacanaḥ sambhavati, nānyaḥ| `pākāya vrajati' iti| yadyapyatra tādarthyaṃ gamyate tathāpi caturthī na bhavati; tasminneva tādarthyaṃ vihitena bhāvapratyayena tasyoktatvāt,yathā-- pācako vrajatītyatra na bhavati| tena caturthīvidhānārthamidamārabdham| atha vā-- bhāvavacanādeva yathā syāt, iha mā bhūt-- pācako vrajatīti niyamārthaṃmetat| `pākaḥ, tyāgaḥ, rāgaḥ' iti bhāve ghañ| nanu ca kriyārthopapadagrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate, tadarthādvibhaktervipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvaivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate-- kriyārthopapadādbhāvavacanāditi| yastu kriyārthopapado bhāvavacanaḥ sa tumartha eveti kiṃ tumarthagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; na hi kriyārthopapadagrahaṇaṃ bhāvavacanasya viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhavati| kiṃ tarhi ? dhātoreva| tasmāt tumarthagrahaṇaṃ karttavyameva| `kārako vrajati'iti-- `tumunṇvulau' (3.3.10) iti ṇvul| bhavatyayaṃ tumartho na tu bhāvavacanaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? karttṛvacanaḥ, tena tadantānna bhavati|| 16. namaḥsvastisvāhāsvadhālaṃvaṣaḍyāgācca| (2.3.16) `alamiti paryāptyarthasya grahaṇam' iti. `tasmai prabhavati santāpādibhyaḥ' (5.1.101) ityalaṃśabdasamānārthena prabhavatiśabdena yoge caturthīnirdeśālliṅgāt| nanu cāsmālliṅgādarthasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na tu śabdasyetyeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyate; na tu paryāptyarthasyetyeṣo'rthaḥ| tathā ca bhūṣaṇapratiṣedayorapi grahaṇaṃ syāt| evañca kanyāmalaṃkurute, alaṃ bāle rodanenetyādāvapi caturthī syāt; naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāmarthyāt paryāptyarthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, katham ? kanyāmalaṅakurute ityatra `upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' (cāṃ.pa.69) iti `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) iti dvitīyayaiva bhavitavyam| `alaṃ bāle rodanena' ityatrāpyata eva hetoḥ karaṇe tṛtīyayaiva| atra hi rodanaṃ karaṇabhāvamāpannameva pratiṣedhena sambadhyata iti sāmarthyāt paryāptyarthasya grahaṇaṃ sampadyate| `cakāraḥ punarasyaiva samuccayārthaḥ' iti| yadetannamaḥprabhṛtiyoge caturthīvidhānaṃ tatsamuccayārthaścakāraḥ| tena punarvidhnāt `caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣya' (2.3.73) ityādināśīrvivakṣāyāṃ pakṣe yā ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate tāmapi bādhitvā caturthyeva bhavati| yadyavam, kārakavibhaktimapi bādhitvā `kanyāmalaṅkurute' ityādau caturthyeva syāt, tataśca yaduktam- sāmarthyāt paryāptyarthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti, tannopapadyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; kārakavibhakterbalīyastvāt, punarvidhānasya cānyatra caritārthatvāt| atha vā-- vakṣyamāṇā vibhāṣā siṃhāvalokitanyāyenehāpyupatiṣṭhate| tena `kanyāmalaṅkurute ityādau caturtī na bhavati|| 17.manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'prāṇiṣu| (2.3.17) `anādarastiraskāraḥ' iti| atraivānādaraśabdasya rūḍhatvāt| tiraskāraḥ - paribhavaḥ, avajñānamityarthaḥ| ` na tvā tṛṇāya manye' iti| tṛṇādapi nikṛṣṭataraṃ tvāmahaṃ ityarthaḥ| ` vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ' iti| `manikarmaṇi' iti kasmānnoktam ? eva hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavatīti ? `mana jñāne' (dhā.pā.1176) ityasya daivādikasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt, `manu bodhane' (dhā.pā.1471) ityasya tānādikasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartho vikaraṇanirdeśa iti darśayitumāha- `na tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manve' iti| `aśmānaṃ dṛṣadaṃ manye' ityādau yathāvyavasthitasya vastunaḥ svarūpamāviṣkriyata ityatrānādaro na gamyate| `yedatadaprāṇiṣviti tadanāvādiṣviti vaktavyam' iti| aprāṇigrahaṇapanīyanāvādigrahaṇaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| yathānyāse hi na tvā nāvaṃ manya ityatra caturthī syāt| na tvā śune manya ityatra caturthī na syādityabhiprāyaḥ|| 18. karttṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā| (2.3.18) `tṛtīyāvidhāne {prakṛtayādīnām'itivṛttau pāṭhaḥ} prakṛtyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam ? na siddhyati, karttṛkaraṇayorabhāvāt| tayostvabhāvaḥ prakṛtyā'bhirūpa ityādau kriyāyā avidyamānatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| prātipadikenātra sambandamātraṃ pratīyate, na tu kācana kriyā| na ca tayā vinā karttṛkaraṇe sambhavataḥ; tayoḥ kriyāpekṣatvāt| tataśca sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt-- prakṛterabhirūpaḥ, prāyasya yājñikaḥ, gotrasya gārgya iti| `samena dhāvati, viṣameṇa dhāvati' iti| yadyapyatra kriyā'pyasti, tathā'pi nātra samaviṣamaśabdau karaṇatvena vivakṣitau, kiṃ tarhi ? karmatvena, tataśca dvitīyā syāt| `dvidroṇena dhānyaṃ krīṇāti' ityādāvapi dvidroṇātyeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ| `pañcakena paśūn krīṇāti' iti| pañca parimāṇamasya paśusaṃghasya pañcakaḥ saṅghaḥ| pañcakaṃ saṅghaṃ kṛtvā paśūn krīṇātītyarthaḥ| evaṃ `sāhasreṇāśvān krīṇāti'iti sāhasraṃ saṅghaṃ kṛtvā| sahasraṃ sahasraṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanārthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- pratīyamānā'pi kriyā kārakāṇāṃ nimittaṃ bhavatyeva| iha ca prakṛtyā'bhirūpa ityatrāpi karotyartho bhavatyartho vā gamyate| gārgyo'smi gotreṇetyatrāpi jñāne bhavane vā gamyamāne gotrasya karaṇatvaṃ pratīyate| samena dhāvatītyadau samena viṣameṇa vā pathā karaṇeneti gamyate| dvidroṇenetyatrāpi tṛtīyā na karmatvaṃ bodhayati| kiṃ tarhi ? karaṇatvam| atra hi dvidroṇādyarthaṃ hiraṇyādikaṃ mūlyabhūtaṃ tādarthyāddvidroṇādiśabdenoktam| tasyāpi karaṇatvamastyeveti karaṇa ityevaṃ sarvatra tṛtīyā siddhyati|| 19. sahayukte'pradhāne| (2.3.19) kriyāguṇadravyasambandhe hi sati sahayogo bhavati| ataḥ `putreṇa sahāgataḥ' ityādīni kriyādisambandhe yathākramudāharaṇāni vṛttikṛtopanyastāni| sarvatra ca putrasyātrāpradhānyamiti tatastṛtīyā bhavati| nanu cobhayorapi pitāputrayoḥ kriyādisambandhaḥ pratīyate, tatkutaḥ putrasyāprādhānyamitarasya pradhānabhāva ityāha-- `pituratra' ityādi| `yadypyubhayagataḥ kriyādisambandhaḥ pratīyate, tathā'pyupāttaśabdavyāpārāpakṣayā pradhānāpradhānavyavasthāḥ-- śabdena yasya kriyādisambandhaḥ pratyāyyate tat pradhānamitaradapradhānamiti| iha tu piturava kriyādisaṃbandhaḥ pratyāyyate śabdena, na tu putrasya | kuta etat ? śabdaśaktasvābhāvyāt| tathāvidhā hi śabdaśaktiryataḥ piturevātra kriyādisambandhaṃ śnoti pratipādayitum, na putrasyeti; evañcāgata ityādavekavacanamupapadyate; anyathā hi dvitvāddvivacanaṃ syāt, yathā-- pitatāputrāvāgatāviti| `putrasya tu pratīyamānatvādaprādhānyam' iti| arthātsa punararthaḥ sahārthayogaḥ| sa ca bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt putrasya kriyādisambandhamantareṇa na sambhavatīti sambandhasya nāntarīyakatvāt putrasyāpi kriyādisambandhaṃ pratyāyayati| `sahārthena yoge tṛtīyāvidhānāt' iti| kutaḥ punaretadavagataṃ sahārthena yoge tṛtīyāvidhānamiti ? yuktagrahaṇāt| tasya caitadeva prayojanam-- sahārthena yoge tṛtīyā yathā syāt, nānyat| `śiṣyeṇa sahopādhyāyasya gauḥ' iti| atra dravyasambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyaivopādhyāyasyocyata ityasya prādhānyāt| tatrāsatyapradhānagrahaṇe pradhāne'pyupādhyāye syāt| nanu ca paratvāt ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati? na bhaviṣyati; aśeṣatvāt| sati tvapradhānagrahaṇe śeṣo'yaṃ sampadyata iti ṣaṣṭhī|| 20. yenāṅgavikāraḥ| (2.3.20) ayamaṅgaśabdo'vayave prasiddhaḥ| sa yadi tatraiva varttamāna iha gṛhyate tadā'traiva syāt-- akṣi kāṇamasyeti; atra hyakṣṇaḥ śarīrāvayavasya vikāraḥ kāṇena guṇena dyotyata iti| iha tu na syāt-- akṣṇā kāṇa iti| na hyatrāvayavasyākṣṇo vikāro lakṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ? aṅganaḥ samudāyasyetyata āha-- `aṅgaśabdo'tra'ityādi| aṅgamasyāstītyaṅgaḥ, arśa āditvādacpratyayānto'ṅgaśabda upātta iti darśayati; aṅgino'ṅgāpekṣatvāt| yadapekṣayā'ṅgino'ṅgitvaṃ tadeva yenetyanena nirdiśyata iti darśayitumāha-- `yena' ityādi| vikṛteneti sāmarthyāllabdhamarthaṃ darśayati| na hyavikṛtenāṅganino'ṅgena vikāro lakṣyate| `lakṣyate' iti| dyotyata ityarthaḥ| `akṣṇā kāṇaḥ' iti| atrākṣṇā'vayavena vikṛtenāṅgino devadattasya vikāro lakṣyata iti tatsatṛtīyā| vibhaktirbhavati| kathaṃ punaravayavena vikṛtena samudāyastathā vyapadiśyata ityāha-- `avayavadharmeṇa' ityādi| yāthā'ḍhyamidaṃ nagaramityavayavadharmeṇāḍhyatvenātra samudāyo vyapadiśyate, tathehāpyavayavena vikṛtana samudāyo vyapadiśyata iti| kathaṃ punaratrākṣiśabdasya prayogaḥ kriyate, yāvatā vinā'pi tena kāṇatvaṃ guṇaḥ samudāyasya pratīyata eva ? satyametat; laukike śabdaprayoge gurulāghanaṃ pratyanādarāt| yastu tadādriyate so'kṣiśabdaṃ na prayuṅkta eva| `akṣi kāṇamasya' iti| atrāsatyaṅgagrahaṇe kāṇaśabdāt tṛtīyā syāt| lakṣyate hi kāṇatvena guṇenākṣṇo vikāraḥ samudāyasyāvayavasya|| 21. itthambhūtalakṣaṇe| (2.3.21) kañcit prakāramityanena ityamityasyārthamācaṣṭe| tathā hi prakāravacane `idamasthamuḥ' (5.3.24) iti thamupratyaye vihite itthamityedrūpaṃ bhavati| sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ prakāra ucyate| āpanna ityanena bhūtaśabdsayārthamācaṣṭe| tathā hi-- `bhū prāptāvātmanepadī' (dhā.pā.1844) ityasya caurādikasya `ā dhṛṣādvā' (dhā.pā.805) ityasyānantaram) iti yadā ṇij nāsti tadā ktapratyaye `bhūta' iti rūpaṃ bhavati| tasyetītvambhūtasya | `lakṣaṇam' iti| lakṣyate cihnyate'neneti lakṣaṇam - cihnam| `api bhavān kamaṇḍalunā chātramādrākṣīt' iti| atra manuṣyatvaṃ sāmānyam, tasya cchātratvaṃ prakāraḥca; taṃ prāptasya cchātrasya kamaṇḍalurlakṣaṇam| `chātreṇopādhyāyam' iti| manuṣyatvaṃ sāmānyam, tasyopādhyāyatvaṃ prakāraḥ; taṃ prāptasyopādhyāyasya lakṣaṇaṃ chātraḥ| `śikhayā parivrājakam' iti| manuṣyatvaṃ sāmānyam, parivrājakatvaṃ prakāraḥ| taṃ prāptasya parivrājakasya lakṣaṇaṃ śikhā| `lakṣaṇasya samāse'ntarbhūtatvāt' iti| ekārthībhāvad bahuvrīhyarthena lakṣaṇārthasyāpṛthagbhāvādityarthaḥ| bahuvrīhāveva vācyatvenāntarbhāvo lakṣaṇasyeti gatārthatvāt tṛtīyā na bhavati| itthambhūtalakṣaṇa iti kim ? vṛkṣaṃ pari vidyotate vidyut| nātra vidyotanatvaprāptasya kasyacidvṛkṣeṇa lakṣaṇam| kiṃ tarhi ? vidyotanasyaiva|| 22. saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi| (2.3.22) `mātrā sañjānīte' iti| `jñānanorjā' (7.3.79) iti jādeśaḥka, `ī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itītvam, `saṃpratibhyāmanādhyāne' (1.3.46) ityātmanepadam| ādhyāne tu `adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi' (2.3.52) iti paratvāt ṣaṣṭhī bhavati-- mātuḥ sañjānātīti| kṛtprayoge cānādhyāne'pi `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti paratvāt ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavati-- saṃjñāteti|| 23. hetau| (2.3.23) heturdvividhaḥ-- śāstrīyaḥ,laukikaśca| tatra śāstrīyaḥ ` tatprayojako hetuśca' (1.4.55)| laukikaḥ phalasādhanayogyaḥ padārthaḥ| tatra śāstrīye hetau `karttṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā' (2.3.18) ityevaṃ siddhā tṛtīyā| tasmāllaukikasya hetoridaṃ grahaṇamityata āha-- `phalasādhanayogyaḥ' ityādi| aniṣpādayannapi phalaṃ tāsāśanayogyaḥ padārtho loke heturityucyata iti yogyagrahaṇam| `dhanena kulam' ityādau kulādīnyakurvantyapi dhanādīni tatkaraṇayogyatayā loke hetuvaypabadeśamāsādayantīti tebhyastṛtīyā| iha yūpāya dārviti sadapi dāruṇo hetutvaṃ na vivakṣitam| kiṃ tarhi ? kāraṇasyānyathātvam| tena tādarthye caturthī bhavati|| 24. akarttaryṛṇe pañcamī| (2.3.24) `śatena bandhitaḥ'iti| bandherṇyantasya niṣṭhāyāmetadrūpam| `śatamṛṇañca bhavati'iti| uttamarṇāya deyatvāt| prayojakatvāt karttṛsaṃjñeti, `tatprayojako hetuśca' (1.4.55) iti cakārāt karttṛsaṃjñāvidhānāt| nanu laukiko hetuḥ pūrvasūtre gṛhītaḥ, sa cehānuvarttata iti tata eva pañcamī vidhīyate, na cātra laukiko hetuḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pāribhāṣika iti prāptyabhāvādakarttarīti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ ? naitadasti;tatra hi śāstrīye hetau tṛtīyā siddheveti laukikasya hetaurgrahaṇam, iha tu pañcamī vidhīyate| na cātarāsau śāstrīye hetau kenacit sidhyati| dvāvapīha hetū gṛhyete| atha vā śāstrīyasyāpi hetorlaukikaṃ hetutvamaviruddhameva| yo hi bandhane prayuṅkte sa tatsādhanayogyo bhavatyeva|| 25. vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām| (2.3.25) `dhanena kulam' iti| dhanaṃ dravyam, na guṇaḥ| dravyāśrito hi guṇo bhavati, na dravyameva ! guṇaśabdena cātra sambandhimātraṃ parārtharūpāpannamucyate, tenāgniratra dhūmādityādyapi siddhaṃ bhavati| nanu cāstriyāmityucyate, tena nāstīha ghaṭo'nupalabdherityādi na sidhyati ? naitadasti;`vibhāṣā guṇe' iti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ|tena yatreṣyate tatraya yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddhiriti striyāmapi bhavatyeva|| 26. ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge| (2.3.26) prayogasya śabdadharmatvāt heturityanena hetuśabda eva vijñāyata ityata āha--`{hetuśabdasya prayoge--kāśikā} hetuśabdaprayoge' iti| evañca hetuśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇe sati tatparyāṇāṃ nimittakāraṇādīnāṃ prayoge ṣaṣṭhī na bhavatīti kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā śeṣavivakṣayaivātrādhyayanādibhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati, tatsamānādhikaraṇyācca hetuśabdādapi ? evaṃ tarhi saiva śeṣavivakṣā'smin viṣaye vacanenākhyāyate mandadhiyāmanugrahāya|| 27. sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca| (2.3.27) `nimit‌takāraṇahetuṣu sarvāsāṃ vibhaktīnāṃ prāyadarśanam' iti| etaccakārasyānukkatasamuccayārthatvallabhyata iti veditavyam| yadarthagrahaṇametata kasmāt paryāyopādānaṃ kṛtamitmāha-- `paryāyopādānam' ityādi| asati paryāyagrahaṇa etat svarūpagrahaṇamiti kasyacidbhrānti syāt| atastannirākarttu paryāyagrahaṇam|| 28. apādāne pañcamī| (2.3.28) `vṛkebhyo bibheti' iti| `bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ' (1.4.25) ityapādānatvam| adhyayanāt parājayata ityatra `parājerasoḍhaḥ' (1.4.26) ityapādānatvam| `viparābhyāñjeḥ' (1.3.19) ityātmanepadam| `pañcamīvidhāne ityādi| yadetat pañcamīvidhānamatra lyablope pañcamo syādityupasaṃkhyānam - vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- iha pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nuvarttate| sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena lyablope karmaṇi pañcamī bhaviṣyati| `adhikaraṇe copasaṃkhyānam' ityādi| atrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu pūrvavaccakārānuktasamuccayārthatvamāśritya karttavyam| `praśnākhyānayośca' ityādi| vaktavyeti vyākhyātavyetyarthaḥ| vyākhyānantu tāmeva cakārānuvṛttimāśritya karttavyam| atha vā-- atrāpādāna ityevaṃ siddhā pañcamī| tathā hi kuto bhavānitytarāgacchatīti pratīyate, pāṭaliputrādityatrāpyagacchāmīti; ataḥ sphuṭamevāpādānatvam| `yataścāṣvakāla' ityādi| yataḥ prabhṛtyadhvanaḥ kālasay nirmāṇamiyattāparicchedastatra pañcamī vaktavyā| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- adhvani kāle ca nirmīyamāṇe yadavaśribhūtatvena vivakṣyate tatra pañcamī vaktavyā - vyākhyeyā| vyākhyānantu pūrvavaccākārānuvṛttimāśritya karttavyam| atha vā- adhvani nirmīyamāṇe apādāna ityevaṃ siddhā pañcamī| tathā hi-- gavīdhumataḥ sāṅkāśyaṃ catvāri yojanānītyatra niḥsṛtyeti kriyā gamyate| ato yuktamevāpādānatvam| kārttikyā āgrahāyaṇī māsa ityatrāpi pareṇeti śabdo gamyate| tatrottarasūtreṇa digyolakṣaṇā pañcamī bhaviṣyati| `tadyuktātkāle' ityādau tadityanena pañcamī sambadhyate| pañcamīyuktāt paro yaḥ kālastatra saptamī vaktavyā - vyākhyeyā| vyākhyānaṃ tu kārttikyā āgrahāyaṇī māsa ityatra `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam'(2.3.37) ityanena saptamī siddhā| kārttikyāḥ paro yo māsastatsattayā''grahāyaṇyā bhāvo lakṣyate| `adhvanaḥ prathamā' ityādi| tadyuktāditi varttate| tatra yadā sāṅkāśyasya yojanādabhedo vivakṣyate tadā prathamā| `gavīṣumataḥ sāṅkāśyaṃ catvāri yojanāni' iti. bhedavivakṣāyāntu `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' (2.3.37) iti saptamī| tathā hi gavīdhumataḥ sāṃkāśyaṃ caturṣu yojaneṣu gateṣu satsu bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyate| tatra yojanasya sambandhi sambandhi gamanaṃ sāṅkāśyabhāvasya lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati|| 29. anyārādittararttedikśabdāñcūttarapadājāhiyukte| (2.3.29) `anya ityarthagrahaṇam' iti| arthadvāraka eva hi śabdasya śabdāntaraṇe yogo bhavati| tasmādarthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tenetyādinā'rthagrahaṇasya phalaṃ darśayati| athānyo devadattādyajñadatta iti yajñadattaśabdādapi pañcamī kasmānna bhavati ? devadattādutpannayā pañcamyobhayagatasyāpyanyatvasya pratipāditvāt tadviśiṣṭamanyatvamekata evotpādyamānayā pañcamyā śakyaṃ pratipādayitumiti dvitīyasambandhinaḥ pañcamī na bhavati| `itara iti nirdiśyamānasya pratiyogī padārtha ucyate' iti|yathā kvacitprakaraṇe dvau prakṛtau -- devadattaḥ, anyaśca kaścit| tatraikastāvannirdiśyate-- devadattaḥ śūra iti| tasya nirdiśyamānasya yo'sau dvitīyaḥ sambandhī pratiyogī sa itaraśabdenocyate, yathā--itaraḥ kātara iti| `śabdagrahaṇam'ityādi| śabdagrahaṇe sati diśi dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo dikśabda iteṣo'rtho labhyate | tena yo'pi samprati dikśabdo deśe kāle ca varttate, so'pi diśi duṣṭa iti tadyoge pañcamī bhavati| tatra deśavṛttinā pañcamī-- pūrvo grāmāt parvata iti | kālavṛttinā'pi-- pūrvo grīṣmādvasanta iti| `itarathā hi digvṛttinaiva yoge syāt' iti| tatraiva dikśabdasya mukhyatvāt| `prāggrāmāt' iti| prapūrvādañcaterṛtvigādisūtreṇa (3.2.59) kvinpratyayaḥ| tadantādyadādiśabdebhyaḥ `saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyo digdeśakāla' (5.3.27) ityādinā vihitasya stāteḥ `añcerluk' (5.3.30) iti luk; luki kṛte tadedamudāharaṇam| `dakṣiṇā grāmāduttarā grāmāt| `dakṣiṇāhi grāmāduttarāhi grāmāt' iti| `dakṣiṇādāca' `āhi ca dūre' (5.3.37) `uttarācca' (5.3.38) ityājāhī pratyayau|| 30. ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena| (2.3.30) atasarthāḥ pratyayā dikśabdebhyaḥ svārtha eva bhavantīti tadantasya dikśabdatvāt pūrveṇa pañcamyāṃ vacanamidam. `puro grāmasya' iti| `pūrvādharāvaṇāmasipuradhavaścaiṣām' (5.3.39) ityādinā'sipratyayaḥ, pūrśabdasya purādeśaśca| purastādityatrāpi `dikśabdebhyaḥ saptamī' (5.3.27) ityādinā'stātipratyayaḥ|`astāti ca' (5.3.40) iti purādeśaḥ| `upari grāmasya, upariṣṭādgrāmasya' iti| `uparyupariṣṭāt' (5.3.31) ityūrdhvaśabdasyopi ityādeśo rilariṣṭātilau ca pratyayau bhavataḥ|. 31. enapā dvitīyā| (2.3.31) `pūrveṇa ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanamidam'iti| enapo'tasarthatvāt| `tadartho yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ' iti. enapeti pṛthayogaḥ karttavyaḥ,enapā ṣaṣṭhī yathā syāt| anyathā hi dvitayīyāsau bādhyeta| tato dvitīyeti dvitīyo yogaḥ, atra cainapeti varttate|| 32. pṛthagvinānānābhistṛtīyā'nyatarasyām| (2.3.31) `pañcamīgrahaṇamanuvarttate' iti| svaritatvāt| ime sarve pṛthagādayo'sahāye'rthe varttante| bhedenopādānantu paryāyāntaranivṛttyartham| iha tṛtīyāpañcamyau mā bhūtām-- hirug devadattasya| viṣvag devadattasyeti| tatrāsatyāṃ pañcamīgrahaṇānuvṛttau yathā hirugityādinā paryāyāntareṇa yoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, tathā pṛthagādibhiryoge pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī syāt, na pañcamī| tasmāt pañcamīgrahaṇamanuvarttanīyam, anuvṛttereva pakṣe bhaviṣyati, tat kimarthamanyatarasyāṃ grahaṇam ? satyam; tat kṛtañca tasyā evānuvṛtteḥ sūcanārthamuttarārthañca|| 33.karaṇe ca stokālpakṛchrakatipayasyāsattvavacanasya| (2.3.333) `yadā tu dharmamātram' ityādi| yadyogāddravyaṃ stokādivyapadeśamāsādayati te guṇā dharmaśabdenocyante| tanmātraṃ stotādibhiḥ śabdairabhidhīyamānaṃ karaṇatvena yadā vivakṣyate na tu dravyam, tadā stokādiśabdānāmasattvavacanatā| yadā tu so'yamityabhedāt tadvati dravye varttante, tadā teṣāṃ sattvavanatā bhavati| `kriyāviśeṣaṇe mā bhūt' iti| kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvāt karmatvam| tadviśeṣaṇamapi karma bhavati, taccāsattvaṃ bhavati| kriyaiva hi tāvaddravyaṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ pustadviśeṣaṇaṃ dravyaṃ bhaviṣyati ? ekārthatve'pi stokādīnāṃ bhedenopādānāṃ paryāyāntaranivṛttyartham| iha mā bhūt-- mātrayā mukta iti|| 34. dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭhyantarasyām| (2.3.34) vikalpena pañcamyāṃ vihitāyāṃ pakṣe śeṣatvādeva yadyapi sidhyati, tathā'pi tadiha ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat `caturthī cāśiṣya' (2.3.73) ityādinā''śiṣi yā caturthī vidhīyate tāmapi bādhitvā ṣaṣṭhyeva yathā syādityevamartham-- dūraṃ hitaṃ grāmasya, antikaṃ hitaṃ grāmasyeti| nanu cānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ prakṛte punaranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamityāha-- `anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam' ityādi| yadīhānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā pakṣe tṛtīyā syāt; tasyā evānantarasūtre śrutatvāt| punaranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ pañcamīvidhānārthaṃ vijñāyate; prayojanāntarābhāvāt| tathā hi-- tṛtīyāvikalpārthaṃ tāvadetanna bhavati| tṛtīyāvikalpo hi pūrvakeṇānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena sidhyati| na cānyā kācidvabhaktiḥ prakṛtā, kiṃ tarhi ? pañcamī| tasmāt pañcamīvikalpārthametadvijñāyate|| 35. dūradāntikārthabhyo dvitīyā ca| (2.3.35) `{evamprakārakaṃ vākyaṃ vṛttau nāsti}pañcamī ca' iti| tadanuvṛttisāmarthyāt| `tṛtīyā'pi samuccīyate' iti| cakāreṇa| `yathāyatham' iti| yathāsvaṃ yo yasyātmīyo viṣayastatrāsau bhavati, na vibhaktyantaramityarthaḥ|| 36. saptamyadhikaraṇe ca| (2.3.36) `dūrāntikārthebhyaścatasro vibhaktayo bhavanti' iti| pūrvasūtreṇa dvitīyādayastisraḥ, anena saptamī| `saptamīvidhāne ktasyenviṣayasya' ityādi| inviṣayo yaḥ ktastadīye karmaṇi saptamī| vidheyā| kaścenviṣaḥ ktaḥ ? yastadantastenaiva saha prayujyata ityarthaḥ| ananyatrabhāvārthatvādatra viṣayaśabdasya| `adhītī vyākaraṇe' iti| adhītaṃ vyākaraṇamaneneti| `śrāddhamanena bhuktam' (5.2.85) ityato'nenetyanuvarttamāne `pūrvādīniḥ' (5.2.86) ityata inirityanuvarttamāne ca `iṣṭādibhyaśca' (5.2.88) itīnipratyayaḥ| atra yadyapi karmaṇyeva kto vihitastathāpi taddhita utpanne'dhītavyākaraṇorabhisambandho nivarttate| asti ca dhātvarthasya vyākaraṇena sambandha iti karmaiva vyākaraṇaṃ bhavatītyato dvitīyā syāt, yathā-- kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti| tasmāt saptamyā upasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌-- yo'sāvadhītī karttā tasya vyākaraṇaṃ viṣamatvena vivakṣyate| tasmādadhikaraṇa ityevaṃ siddhā saptamī|| `sādhvasādhuprayoge' ityādi| anarcārthamiha sādhuśabdasya grahaṇam| arcāyāṃ hi `sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyām' (2.3.43) ityanenaiva siddhā saptamī| `sādhurdevadatto mātari' ityādi| atrāpyadhikaraṇa eva saptamī| tathā hyatra mātṛsthāsu kriyāsu mātṛśabdo vartate, pitṛsthāsu kriyāsu pitṛśabdaḥ; tāsāñca kriyāṇāṃ sādhvasādhutāṃ prati viṣayabhāvo'stīti vaiṣayikādhikaraṇa eva saptamī| vaktavyaśabdastu vyākhyeya ityarthe varttate| evamuttaratrāpi| `kārakārhāṇāñca' ityādi| bhāvapradhāno'tra kārakaśabdaḥ| kriyāṃ prati yeṣāṃ kārakatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ nyāyyaṃ te kārakārhāḥ, teṣāṃ kārakārhatve saptamī vaktavyā| `ṛddheṣu' ityādi| ṛddhā hi bhujikriyāṃ prati sādhanabhāvamarhinti| teṣāmeva ceha kārakatvaṃ vivakṣitam| etadanusāreṇa kārakārhāṇāñcākārakatva ityevamāderartho veditavyaḥ| atrāpi sarvatra `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' (2.3.37) ityenaiva siddhā saptamī| tathā hi-- ṛddhādisambandhinā bhujikriyādilakṣaṇenātra bhāvena daridrādisambandhyāsanādibhāvo lakṣyate| `carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti' ityatra dvīpinanasya nimittaṃ carma, tasya dvīpinā karmaṇā saha saṃyogaḥ| atrāpi cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt siddhā saptamī| nanu ca dūrāntikārthānukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥca nārthastadanukarṣaṇārthena cakāreṇa, saptamīti yogavibhagādeva dūrāntikārthebhyaḥ saptamamī bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- uttarasūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt saptamī veditavyā|| 37. yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam| (2.3.37) kīdṛśī punaḥ kriyā kriyāntaraṃ lakṣayatītya ta āha-- `prasiddhā ca' ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ, prasiddhaivetyarthaḥ| na hi svayamaprasiddhaṃ parasya lakṣaṇamupapadyate| atha kathaṃ phalāyāmāneṣvāmreṣu gataḥ, paktevaṣvāgata ityatra saptamī, na hīha bhāvaḥ śrūyate ? yadyapi na śrūyate ? tathā'pi gamyate| phalāyamāneṣu jāteṣvityarthaḥ|| 38. ṣaṣṭhī cānādare| (2.3.38) anādaraḥ tiraskāraḥ, paribhava ityarthaḥ| `rudataḥ' iti| `rudir aśruvimocane' (dhā.pā.1067) śatṛpratyayaḥ|| 39. svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca| (2.3.39) svāmīśvarādhipatīnāmekārthatve'pi bhedenopādānaṃ paryāyāntaranivṛtyartham| iha mā bhūt-- grāmasya rājeti| `ṣaṣṭhyāmeva prāptāyām' iti| śeṣalakṣaṇāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyām|| 40. āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cāsevāyām| (2.3.40) āyuktatā nipuṇatā ca kaṭādikaraṇaviṣayaiveti saptamyāmeva prāptāyāṃ pakṣe ṣaṣṭhīvidhānārthaṃ vacanam| `āsevāyāmiti kim ? āyukto gauḥ śakaṭe' (iti)| īṣadyukta ityarthaḥ|| 41. yataśca nirdhāraṇam| (2.3.41) kimarthaṃ punaridam ? yāvatā nirdhāryamāṇo'vayavaḥ samudāyāntarbhūtaḥ; tatra yadā samudāyāsyādhikaraṇatvaṃ vivakṣyate tadā saptamī siddhaiveti, yathā-- vṛkṣe śākheti; yadā tvavayavāvayavisambandhastadā ṣaṣṭhī, yathā-- vṛkṣasya śākheti ? satyametat; prapañcārtha vacanam|| 42. pañcamī vibhakte| (2.3.42) `vibhāgo vibhaktam' iti| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114)| ` yasminnirdhāraṇāśraye' iti| yato nirdhārayate sa iha nirdhāraṇāśraya iti sarvasminneva nirdhāraṇāśraye vibhāgostīti viśeṣaṇopādānasārthyādvibhāga eva yatra sa nirdhāraṇāśrayo vijñāyate; tena kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannakṣīratametyatra na bhavati| tathā hi-- goṣu nirdhāryamāṇa ekadeśo yasmāt gotvenāntarbhūtaḥ pratīyate tasmānnāsti vibhāga iti| yadā tu kṛṣṇena guṇena pathagbhūtaḥ pratīyate tadāsti vibhāga iti| nātra nirdhāraṇāśrayo vibhāga eva| iha punarmāthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhyatarā iti māthuratvena nāpyāḍhyataratvena māthurāṇāmantarbhāvaḥ| tas ādatra vibhāga evetyayamasya yogasya viṣayaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ-- yatra rāśīkṛtya pṛthakkaraṇaṃ sa pūrvasya yogasya viṣayaḥ; yatra tu pṛthagbhūtasyaiva guṇāntarāviṣkaraṇaṃ so'sya; tatra dvayorapyavasthayorvibhāga eveti kṛtvā ayamapi yogaḥ prapañcārtha eva| vibhāgo hi samnabdhātpracyutiḥ| pāṭaliputrakāśca sambandhāt pracyavamānānāṃ māthurāṇāṃ sambandhe pracyuteravadhibhāvamupavāntītyapādāna ityevaṃ pañcamī siddhā|| 43. sādhunipuṇābhyamarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ| (2.3.43) `{apratyādibhirahita vaktavyam' iti vṛttau pāṭhaḥ|} apratyāderiti vaktavyam' iti| ke punaḥ pratyādayaḥ ? yeṣāṃ `lakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyāna' (1.4.90) ityādinā karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vihitā te pratiparyanavaḥ ityādayaḥ|| 44. prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca| prasitaśabdo'yaṃ guṇavacano'pyasti-- prakṛṣṭaḥ sitaḥ prasitaḥ, kriyāśabdo'pyasti-- `ṣiñ bandhane' (dhā.pā.1477) ityasya prapūrvasay niṣṭhāyāṃ vyutpādyate, tatrehotsukaśabdena kriyāśabdena sāhacaryāt kriyāśabdo vijñāyata ityata āha-- `prasitaḥ prasaktaḥ' iti| `yastatra nityamevābaddhaḥ sa prasitaśabdenocyate' iti| ābaddha ivābaddhaḥ, yo hi yatra prasaktaḥ sa tatrābaddha iva bhavati| `keśaiḥ prasitaḥ, keśeṣu prasitaḥ' ityādi| prasitatvamutsukatvañca keśaviṣayamiti `saptamyadhikaraṇe' (2.3.36) ityeva siddhā saptamī pakṣe tṛtīyāvidhānārtha vacanam|| 45.nakṣatre ca lupi| (2.3.45) nakṣatre ca lupīti subvyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamīvidhānam| ata evāha-- `labantānnakṣatraśabdāt' ityādi. `puṣyeṇa' ityādi| `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) iti vihitasyāṇaḥ `lubaviśeṣe' (4.2.4) iti lup| pañcāleṣu vasatītyatrāpi `tasya nivāsaḥ' (2.3.36) iti vihitasyāṇaḥ `janapade lup' (4.2.81) iti lup‌| `maghāsu grahaḥ' iti| sāmīpye'dhikaraṇa eva saptamī| atra `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityasyārthasyāvivakṣitatvādaṇ na bhavati| `adya puṣyaḥ' iti| pūrvavadaṇ, lup| `adhikaraṇe' (2.3.36) ityanuvarttate| na cehādhikaraṇatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ|| 46. prātipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā| (2.3.46) `prātipadikārthaḥ sattā'iti| yadi jātistadā devadattādau na syāt| atha sato bhāvaḥ sattā, tadākāśakusumādau na syādityāha-- prādipadikārthaḥ satteti| yatrārthāntaranirapekṣā śabdasya pravṛttiḥ sa sarvaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ| sattāgrahaṇantūpalakṣaṇārtham| uccairnīcaiḥ' iti| atroccaiḥ śabdasya svārthe jātyādyarthāntanirapekṣaḥ vṛttiḥ| atra ca prathamāyāḥ prayojanam-- `sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā vibhāṣā' (8.1.26) iti vikalpena temayādividhiryathā syāt-- grāma uccaiste svam, grāma uccaistava svamiti| padasaṃjñā tu ṣaṣṭhyā'pi syādeva| `kumārī, vṛkṣaḥ, kuṇḍam' iti| nanu cātrāpi prātipadikārtha ityevaṃsiddhā prathamā; liṅgamapi prātipadikārtha eva bhavati| tathā ca vakṣyata `striyām' (4.1.3) ityatra `siddhāstu striyāḥ prātipadikaviśeṣaṇatvāt svārthe ṭābādayaḥ' (vā.4.13) iti ? naitadasti; idamapi hi tatra vakṣyati-- `atha vā punaridamastu| striyāmabhidheyāyām' (ma.bhā.4.1.3) iti| kiñca-- strītavaṃ pratyeṣā gatiḥ syāt, puṃnapuṃsake tu niyogato vibhaktivācye eva| tathā hi-- vinā vibhaktyā taṭaśabdāḥ pratyujyamānaḥ kiṃ puṃstvamācaṣṭe ? uta napuṃsakatvam ? iti sandehaḥ syāt| tatra yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ityatra prātipadikārthenānupātte svasvāmikasambandhe tasya cābhidhāne vibhaktyapakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, tathā puṃnapuṃsakayorapi ṣaṣṭhī syāt| tasmālliṅgagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| `droṇaḥ, khārī, āḍhakam' iti| nanu cātrāpi prātipadikārthatvādeva sidhyati prathamā, tathā hi -- droṇādayaḥ śabdāḥ parimāṇe lauhe dārumaye vā arthāntaranipekṣā eva varttante ? satyam; sidhyati tadā yadā parimāṇa eva varttante, yadā tu punaḥ parimeye vartante tadā na sidhyati| tathā hi-- droṇādayaḥ śabdā droṇādikaṃ parimāṇamarthāntaraṃ pravṛttinimittamupādāya vrīhyādau parimeyaṃ varttante| kathaṃ punaste tatra varttante ? so'yamityabedasambandhāt- droṇaparimito vrīhirdroṇa iti | yadyevam, nimittarūpeṇa nimittano'bhidhānādavyatirikta eva prātipadikārtha iti prātipadikārtha ityeva siddhā prathamā ? na sidhyati, na hi mukhye sati gauṇasyāśrayaṇaṃ yuktam| nanvevamapi liṅgagrahaṇādevātra prathamā bhaviṣyati, tatkiṃ parimāṇagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; tasya hi yatra parimāṇaṃ nāsti so'vakāśa iti| atra parimāṇādhikye ṣaṣṭhyeva syāt| tasmāt parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| parimāṇagrahaṇañca yatra nimittādarthāntare so'yamityabhedasambandhācchabdaḥ pravarttate, tadupalakṣaṇārtha veditavyam| tena parimāṇavadarthāntarabhūteṣvapyunmānādiṣu prathamā bhavati| ghṛtam, palam, dīrgha kāṣṭham, śuklaḥ paṭaḥ, hasto muṣṭirvitastirityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati| kuta etat ? mātraśabdāt| sa hyatra vyāptivacano gṛhyate, yathā-- kanyāmātraṃ varayati, brāhmaṇamātraṃ bhojayatīti| tena parimāṇagrahaṇasyaivopalakṣaṇārthatā vijñāyate yadi tu yathā `payomātraṃ bhuṅkte' ityatra mātraśabdo niyamārthaḥ, tathehāpi niyamārtha eva syāt; tataśconmānādiṣu prathamā na syāt; tasya parimāṇādanyatvāt-- ukteṣvapyekatvādiṣu prathamā yathā syāditi| vacanagrahaṇe tvasatyukteṣvekatvādiṣu prathamā na syāt| `anabhihite' (2.3.1) ityadhikārāt| nanu ca parigaṇanaṃ tatra kṛtam, tat kuto'yaṃ prasaṅgaḥ ? naitadasti; pratyākhyātaṃ hi tatra parigaṇanam| tathā hi--rūḍhaḥ karma, bhīṣmādayo'pi karmaṇi, tatra karmāṇi, tatra karmaṇītyeva dvitīyā siddhā| kaṭaśabdādutpadyamānā dvitīyayā sāmānyakarmoktam, na viśeṣakarma| tatrāvaśyaṃ viśeṣo vaktavya iti bhīṣmādibhyo'pi viśeṣābhidhānārtha dvitīyā bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- kaṭa eva karma, tatsāmānādhakaraṇyāt bhīṣmādibhyo'pi dvitīyā bhaviṣyati; nārthaḥ parigaṇanena| yatpunaridaṃ `tiṅakṛttaddhitasamāsaiḥ parisaṃkhyānam' (2.3.1) iti vṛttāvupanyasatm, tadebhirevābhidhānaṃ sambhavatīti sambhavapradarśanārthaparaṃ veditavyam| yadyapyekādibhirapi saṃkhyāśabdairektavādīnāmabhidhānaṃ sambhavati, tathā'pyabhihite'pi tairetkatvādāvarthe vacanagrahaṇāt yatnāt vibhaktyeti| tairapyabhidhānasya sambhavapradarśanārtha yatnaḥ kṛtaḥ| `nipātarasyānarthakasya' ityādi| athārthaviśeṣaṇārtha prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? asati hi tasmin na jñāyate-- kasyārtha iti, tathā cārthamātre prathamā syāt ? naitadasti;prātipadikāddhi prathamā vidhīyate| tatrāsati prātipadikagrahaṇe prātipadikārtha eva bhavatīti vijñāyate| tasyādvṛttikāroktameva prātipadikagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ nyāyyam|| 47. sambodhane ca| (2.3.47) sambodhanam - abhimukhīkaraṇam, "tadadhike prātipadikrathā" iti| abhimukhīkaraṇasya kriyāparatvāt prātipadikārthe tasyāntarbhāvo nāsti, tsayātadātmakatvāt, tasmāta tenādhikaḥ prātipadikārtho bhavati| atha kathamiha prathamā-he-pacanam, he pacamāneti ? kathañca na syāt ? śatṛśānajbhyāmuktatvāt sambodhanasya| etāvapi `sambodhane ca' iti sambodhana eva vakṣyate| mā bhūdanena, pūrvasūtreṇa bhaviṣyati ? sambodhanārthasyeha `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' (1.2.46) ityanena prātipadikārthatvāt| yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ|| 48. sā''mantritam| (2.3.48) `tadantaṃ śabdarūpam' iti| nanu ca `saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti' (pu.pa.vṛ.81) iti jñāpitametat `suptiṅantaṃ padam' (1.4.14) ityatrāntagrahaṇena| iha ca saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇam, tat kathaṃ tadantasya saṃjñā vidhīyate ? naitadasti; yadyapi saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇamiha, tathā'pi tadantasyaiveyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate| yadīha pratyayamātrasya saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ syāt tadā pradeśeṣu tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, tathā ca saṃjñākaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| pradeśeṣu sambodhana ityevaṃ brūyāt| evamapi pratyayamātrasya grahaṇaṃ labhyata eva| tasyaiva sambodhane vihitatvāt| tasmāt saṃjñākaraṇādeva tadantasya saṃjñā labhyate| seti vacanaṃ pūrvasūtreṇāpi sambodhane yā vihitā tasyā apīyaṃ saṃjñā yathā syāt-- he pacan, he pacamānetyatra| asati tvasmin `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti pūrvasūtreṇaiva yā vihitā tasyā eva syāt; setyetaducyamānaṃ sarvanāmapadaṃ sāmānyena pravarttata iti kṛtvā| ataḥ sambodhanamātre yā prathamā tāṃ pratipādayati, tena sarvatra saṃjñā siddhā bhavati| āmantritasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ he devadatta ityādau `āmantritasya' (6.1.198) ityādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `āmantritam' iti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇaṃ vaicitryārtham|| 49. ekavacanaṃ sambuddhiḥ| (2.3.49) `he paṭo, he devadatta' iti| atra sambuddhisaṃjñāyāṃ satyām, `sambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) ityadhikṛtya `hrasvasya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108) iti guṇe `eṅa hrasvāt sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sorlopo yathāyogaṃ bhavati| atha sugrahaṇameva kasmānna kṛtam, na ca saptamībahuvacanasya prasaṅgaḥ, sambodhanaprathamādhikārāt ? satyam; kintu naitadasti; pratyayamātrasya saṃjñāvidhānārthamekavacanagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam-- he pacanam, hepacamāneti; anyathā hi pūrveṇa yathā tadantasya saṃjñā vihitā tathehāpi syāt| na cehāsaṃjñinaḥ kaścidviśeṣo'ṅgīkriyata iti suśabdena tadantameva lakṣyate, tataśca tadantakasyaiva saṃjñā syāt| tathā `eṅa hrasvāt sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sorlopo vidhīyamānaḥ `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityādereva syāt; pratyayamātrasya na syāt| tasmāt pratyayamātrasya saṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthamekavacanagrahaṇam|| 50. śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī| (2.3.50) karmādīnāṃ prakṛtatvāt tadapekṣayā śeṣatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `karmādibhyo yo'nyaḥ' iti| karmādayaḥ kārakaviśeṣāstasya sambandhasya hetubhūtāḥ, sa tu phalabhūtaḥ| hetuphalayośca prasiddhamanyatvamiti tebhyo'nyo bhavati| prātipadikārtha{vyatiriktaḥ-kāśikā.padamañjarī ca} vyatirekaḥ| vyatirekaḥ - ādhikyam| atha vā-- yena prātipadikārtho vyatiricyate - vyatirekīkriyate sa vyatirekaḥ| prātipadikārthasya vyatirekaḥ - prātipadikārthavyatirekaḥ| sa śeṣaḥ| kaḥ punarasavityāha-- `svasvāmikasambandhādiḥ' iti| ādiśabdenovayavāvayaviprabhṛteḥ sambandhasya grahaṇam| sambandhaśca yadyapi dviṣṭhastathāpi tasyaikatvādekata eva sambandhina utpadyamānayā ṣaṣṭhyā vibhaktyā'bhihitatvāt dvitīyāsambandhinaḥṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| ekasmādutpadyamānā'pi ṣaṣṭhī viśeṣaṇādeva bhavati ; na viśeṣyāt| viśeṣyāttu prathamaiva bhavati; yasmāccheṣaśabdo'yaṃyathā prakṛtādanyaviśeṣaṇamācaṣṭe tathā parārthamapi| evaṃ hyabhiyuktāḥ puruṣā upadiśanti-- śeṣaḥ parārtha iti| rājñā puruṣa iti svasvāmikasambandasyodāharaṇam | atra puruṣasya prādānyam, viśeṣyatvāt| rājño'prādhānyam, viśeṣaṇatvāt| viśeṣaṇasya parārthatvāt śeṣabhāva iti tataḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| yadā tu dvāvapi viśeṣaṇabhūtau tṛtīye sambandhinyapekṣitau bhavataḥ, tadā dvābhyāmapi ṣaṣṭhī bhavati `rājñaḥ puruṣasya gṛham' iti| `paśoḥ pādaḥ' iti| atrāvayavāvayisambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| `pituḥ putraḥ' ityatra janyajanakasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| atha śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityevamādau pratyaniyamo'rthaniyamaśceti dvāvapi pakṣau| tatra pratyayaniyamapakṣe yadi śeṣagrahamaṃ na kriyeta tadā karmaṇyeva dvitīyeti karmāniyatam, dvitīyā tu niyatā; atastatrāpi ṣaṣṭhī syāditi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| śeṣa eva yathā syādanyatra mābhūditi arthaniyamapakṣe tu śeṣagrahamaṃ śakyamakarttum| yāvatā karmaṇi dvitīyaivaiti karma niyatam, dvitīyā tvaniyatā; tasyāmanyatrāpi prāptāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhītyucyamānaṃ sūtramidaṃ niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati-- yatra ṣaṣṭhī cānyā ca prāpnoti tatra ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavati| evamanyatrāpi veditavyam|| 51. jño'vidarthasya karaṇe| (2.3.51) yadyapi bahavo vidayaḥ santi, tathāpi yasyārthe jānātarvṛttiḥ sambhavati tasyaiva videḥ pratiṣedhakaraṇaṃ yuktam, `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064) ityasyaivārthe jānātervṛttiḥ sambhavati, tasmādavidarthasyetyanena jñānārthasyaiva pratiṣedho vijñāyata ityāha-- `ajñānārthasya' ityādi| `sarpiṣo jānīte, madhuno jānīte' iti| `apahnave jñaḥ' (1.3.44) ityanuvarttamāne, `akarmakācca' (1.3.45) ityātmanepadam| dhuna iti-- ` iko'ci vibhaktau' (ra7.1.73) iti num| sarpiṣā karaṇabhūte pravarttata ityarthaḥ| yasya priyatamaṃ sarpistasya pravṛtiṃ prati sarpiṣaḥ karaṇabhūtatvāt| dhātūnāmanekārthatvājjānātiriha pravṛttyarthaḥ| `sarpiṣiraktaḥ pratihato vā' iti| sarpiṣi raktatvaṃ pratihatatvaṃ ca cittabhrānteḥ kāraṇamāha| yadi sarvameva grāhyaṃ tadātmanā sarpiḥsvabhāvatayā pratipadyate| evaṃ satyavidarthatā nopapadyate, jñānārthatvādityata āha-- `mithyājñānamajñānameva' iti| jñānakāryākaraṇāditi bhāvaḥ| aviparītaviṣayaparicchedo hi jñānakāryam, katacca mithyājñānena na kriyata iti mithyājñānamajñānamucyate, yathā-- putrakāryākaraṇāt putro'putra iti|| 52. adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi| (2.3.52) `adhīka' iti| `ik smaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1047) ityasyādhipūrvasya grahaṇam| adhīgityanena samānārthā adhīgarthāḥ| kakārānubandhakaraṇamasya dhātoratraiva sūtre viśeṣaṇārtham| adhyayanārthānāmityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt-- ko'yaṃ dhāturiti| adhipūrvasyoccāraṇenādhipūrvasyaivāsya prayoga iti darśayati| `karmaṇi kārake' ityādi| yadā tadeva karma śeṣakāryatvāccheṣatvena vivakṣyate na karmatvena, tadā tatra ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| `adhyeti' iti| adāditvācchapo luk| evam `īṣṭe' iti| vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam| `māturguṇaiḥ smarati' iti| atra karmagrahaṇādguṇānāṃ karaṇabhūtānāṃ śeṣavivakṣāyāmapi ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati|| 53. kṛñaḥ pratiyatne| (2.3.53) `etho dakasyopaskurute' iti| gandhanādi (1.3.32) sūtreṇātmanepadam, `upātpratiyatna' (6.1.139) ityādinā suṭ|| 54. rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvareḥ| (2.3.54) rujeti kecidbhidādiṣu paṭhanti| ye na paṭhanti te'pi `cintipūjikathikumbacarccaśca' (3.3.105) iti cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādasmādeva nipātanādvā rujāśabdasya sādhutvaṃ varṇayanti| rujā artho yeṣāṃ te rujārthāḥ| `bhāvavacanānām' iti| yadi bhāvārthābhidhāyināṃ rujārthānāmityeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ syāt, tadā'narthakamidaṃ vacanaṃ syāt| sarva eva hi rujārthā bhāvavacanāḥ| tasmānnātar dhātuvācyo bhāvo vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pratayayavācyaḥ, yatra `bhāve' (3.3.18) iti dhañ vidhīyate| vacanaśabdo'yaṃ karttṛsādhanaḥ, vaktīti vacanaḥ, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti karttari lyuṭ| na ca rujārthānāṃ yo bhāvastasya vacanakriyāṃ prati karttṛtvaṃ sambhavatīti sāmarthyādavacanaśabdena prakṛtyarthaṃ parityajya pratyayārtho vivakṣita iti pratīyate| sa punaḥ karttṛśaktiḥ| bhāvavacanānāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ-- bhāvo vacanaḥ karttā yeṣāṃ te bhāvavacanāḥ| bhāvakarttṛkā ityarthaḥ| etatsarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvā''ha-- `bhāvakarttṛkāṇām' iti| bhāvakarttṛkāṇāmityevaṃ noktaṃ vaicitryārtham| `caurasya rujati' iti| `rujo bhaṅge' (dhā.pā.1416), taudīdikaḥ| atra rogo bhāvaḥ karttā| `caurasyāmayati' ityatrāpyāmayaḥ| `ama roge' (dhā.pā.1720), caurādikaḥ| `eti jīvantamanando naraṃ varṣaśatādapi' iti| astyatrānando bhāvaḥ karttā| na tvetirdhātū rujārthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? gatyarthaḥ| `nadī kūlāni rujati' iti| rujiratra dravyakarttṛkaḥ, na bhāvakarttṛkaḥ, nadyā dravyatvāt| naitadyuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇam, rujāśabdo hi ruḍhiśabdatvāt vyādhimevācaṣṭe; na cātra vyādhivacanaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? bhaṅgavacano rujiḥ| evaṃ tarhi pratyudāharaṇadigiyaṃ darśitā vṛttikṛtā| idantvatra pratyudāharaṇam-- śleṣmā puruṣaṃ rujatīti| vyādhinā grāhayatītyarthaḥ| jvarayatīti| `jvara yoge' (dhā.pā.776), hetumaṇṇic| ghaṭāditvānmittvam| `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvaḥ| `santāpayati' iti| `tapa santāpe' (dhā.pā.985), hetumaṇṇic| santāpo'tra bhāvaḥ karttā|| 55. āśiṣi nāthaḥ| `sarpiṣo nāthate' iti| sarpiryasya nāstyato'rthitvādāśāste saḥ-- sarpirme bhūyāditi| `āśiṣi nāthaḥ' ityupasaṃkhyānādātmanepadam| `māṇavakamupanāthati' iti| yācata ityarthaḥ|| 56. jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām| (2.3.56) `na daivādikasya' iti| hiṃsāyāmiti vacanāt| asya ca tatrāpravṛtteḥ| ata eva hi ṇyantasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, tatkimartho ṇyantasya nirdeśa iti ? kaḥ punarāha cyantasya nirdeśa iti ? atra hīkāro'yaṃ dhātunirdeśārthaḥ kṛtaḥ, `ikśtipau dhātunirdeśe' (vā.319) iti| yadyevam, jāsītyākāraḥ kathaṃ śrūyate? ucyate-- ākāramuccārya vikṛtanirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, vikṛtanirdeśastū yatrāsyaitadrūpaṃ bhavati tatraiva yathā syādiha mā bhūt,-- dasyumajījasaditi| luṅa, `ṇiśri'(3.1.48) ityādinā cleścaṅa, `ṇau caṅayupadhāyā hrasvaḥ' (7.4.1), `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti dvirvacanam, `sanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) ityādinā sanvadbhāvaḥ, `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itītvam, `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.93) iti dīrghaḥ| nāṭakrāthayorapi vakṛtānirdeśasyaitadeva prayojanam| iha mā bhūta-- dasyumanīnaṭaditi, dasyumacikrathaditi| krathervṛddhiśca prayojanam, etacca `nipātanādvṛddhiḥ' iti bruvatā vṛttikāreṇa darśitam| `{niprahanti'iti vṛttau pāṭhaḥ} niprahan' iti| dhātūpasargānirdeśamātramiha tantram| na tūpasargasayoḥ saṃghātaḥ, nāṣyānupūrvī; tayoravivakṣitatvāt| tena nipraśabdayorvyastasamastayorviparītānupūrvīkayośca grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `saṃghātavigṛhītaviparyastasya grahaṇam' iti. `caurasya praṇihanti' iti| nergadanada' (8.4.17) ityādinā ṇatvam. `caurasyonnāṭayati' iti| `naṭa avaspandane' (dhā.pā.(7.2.116) iti vṛddhi siddhā; tatkimarthamucyate-- nipātanādvṛddhiriti ? ata āha-- `ayaṃ hi' ityādi| `hrasvasya syāt' iti| `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) ityanena| `caurasya pinaṣṭi' iti| ` piṣlṛ sañcūrṇane' (dhā.pā.1452) rudhāditvāt śnam| `dhānāḥ pinaṣṭi' iti| atra hiṃsā nāsti; tasyā prāṇidharmatvāt| idañcābhāvakarttṛkāṇāmapi yathā syādityevamarthamārabdham caurasyojāsayati devadattaḥ|| 57. vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ| (2.3.57) `śatasya vyavaharati' iti| śataṃ krayavikrayeṇa viniyuṅkte, dīvyatīti vetyarthaḥ| `śatasya paṇate' ityatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| anudāttetvādātmanepadam,| `āyapratyayaḥ kasmānna bhavati' iti| `gakapūdhūpa'(3.1.28) ityādinā prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ| `stutyarthasya' ityādi| yadyapi `paṇa vyavahāre stutau ca'(dhā.pā.439) iti stutivyavahārayoḥ paṇiḥ paṭhyate; tathāpi stutyarthasyaiva paṇaterāyapratyaya iṣyate, na vyavahārārthasya| tatra vṛttikāraḥ svayameva yuktiṃ vakṣyati| stutyarthyena paṇinā sāhacaryāt tadartha eva paṇirāyamutpādayati,na vyavahārārtha iti| `śalākāṃ vyavaharati' iti| parigaṇayatītyarthaḥ| atra vyavahārārthe varttata ityasamānārthatvam| `brāhmaṇān paṇayati' iti| stautītyarthaḥ| paṇayītyasyārthe vyavaharatervṛttirnāstītyasamānārthatā|o| 58. divastadarthasya| (2.3.58) `brāhmaṇān dīvyati' iti| stautītyarthaḥ| `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ| yadi tadarthasyaiva bhaviṣyati, pūrvayoga eva divo grahaṇaṃ karttuṃ yuktaṃ syāt| tatkimartho yogavibhāga ityata āṅa-- `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti|| 59. vibhāṣopasarge| (2.3.59) `śalākāṃ prati dīvyati' iti| arthāntare krīḍādau dīvyatirvarttate|| 60. dvitīyā brāhmaṇe| (2.3.60) `brāhmaṇe; iti| brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ śathapathasyākhyā| `grāmasya' iti| śeṣaṣaṣṭhī| sabhāyāmityetadapekṣayā| `tadahaḥ' iti| etaduhāraṇam| `svamornapuṃsakāt' (7.1.23) ityamo luk| `ahan' (8.2.68) ityanuvarttamāne `ro'supi' (8.2.69) iti nakārasya rephaḥ, visarjanīyaḥ| `dīvyeyuḥ' iti| liṅa, jherjus, `ato yeyaḥ' (7.2.80) itīyādeśaḥ, `liṅa salopo'nanttayasya' (7.2.79) iti salopaḥ| sopasargasya vibhāṣayā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prāptāyāṃ nityaṃ dvitīyāvidhānārthaṃ vacanaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `sopasargasya' iti| `vibhāṣopasarge' (2.3.59) ityanena vyavasthitavibhāṣayāpi cchandasi nityaṃ dvitīyā bhaviṣyatīti tadarthakamidaṃ vacanaṃ nopapadyate|| 61. preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsampradāne| (2.3.61) `iṣyaterdaivādikasya' iti| `iṣa gatau' (dhā.pā. 1127) ityasya śyanā nirdeśa iṣyantarāṇāṃ nivṛttyarthaḥ| loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanena nirdeśastu lakārāntarasya puruṣāntarasya vacanāntarasya ca nivṛttyarthaḥ| `tadviṣaya eva' iti| loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanaviṣaya eva| `agnaye chāgasya' ityādi| chāgasya vikāraścachāgaḥ| tatrāgnirdevatā sampradānam| kachāgavikāro vapādi sampradeyaṃ haviḥ karma| `{nāsti-kāśikā, padamañjarī ca} nanu preṣya' iti| `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti harluk| ` anubrūhi' iti| `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti hirādeśaḥ| adāditvācchapo luk| bhāṣāviṣaye'pyayaṃ yogaḥ; uttarasūtre chandograhaṇāt| `juhudhi' iti| `hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ' (6.4.101) iti dhibhāvaḥ| `agnaye gomayāni preṣya' iti| nanu ca gomayāni harvīṣi bhavantyeva, tatkathaṃ pratyudāharaṇam ? naivam; devatāsampradānagrahaṇādeva sambandhiśabdātvāddhavirgrahaṇe siddhe punarhavirgrahaṇādabhyavahāryasya haviṣo grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| na ca gomayānyabhyavahāryāṇi bhavantīti yuktaṃ pratyudāharaṇam| `haviṣaḥ prasthitasya' ityādi| prasthitaśabdena yadviśiṣyate havistat prasthitam| tasya ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam --`vibhāṣopasarge' (2.3.59) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena haviṣaḥ prasthitasya na bhavati|| 62. caturthyarthe bahulaṃ chandasi| (2.3.62) `bahulagrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttereva sidhyatīti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| `kṛṣṇo rātryai, himavato hastī' iti| atra bahulagrahaṇāt saptamyarthe'pi caturthī bhavati| `vaktavyā' iti| vyākhyātavyetyarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- bahulagrahaṇamiha kriyate| tena kvacit ṣaṣṭhyarthe'pi caturthī bhavati| kvacidanyadevetyeṣo'pi bahulagarhaṇasyārtho'bhimata eva|| 63. yajeśca karaṇe| (2.3.63) `dhṛtasya yajate' iti| yajiratra devapūjāyāṃ varttate, tatra ca ghṛtasya karaṇabhāvaḥ|| 64. kṛtvo'rthaprayoge kāle'dhikaraṇe| (2.3.64) `pañcakṛtvaḥ' iti| `saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc' (5.4.17) ` dvirahnaḥ' iti| `dvtricaturthyaḥ suc' (5.4.18)| `gamyate hi dvistriścaturvā' iti| prakaraṇāderiti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca bahiraṅgaḥ prakaraṇādyartha iti pañcakṛtva ityamatra ca vacanasya caritārthatvādiha na bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati-- prakaraṇādyartho'pi vibhaktīnāṃ nimittamiti| tena `vṛddho yūnā' (1.2.65) iti ` sahayukte'pradhāne' (2.3.19) iti sahārthe gamyamāne tṛtīyā bhavatīti|| 65. karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti| (2.3.65) `āsikā' iti| bhāve `paryāyārhaṇotpattiṣu ṇvuc' (3.3.111)| `sraṣṭā' iti| sṛjestṛc'| `sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti' (6.1.58) ityam, `vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam| `taddhitaprayoge mā bhūt' iti| atha tiṅaprayoge mā bhūdityevamarthamapi kṛdgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? tatra `na lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' (2.3.69) ityanena ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhāt| ` kṛtapūrvī kaṭam' iti| `pūrvādiniḥ' (5.2.86) ityatra inirityanuvarttamāne `sapūrvācca' (5.2.87) itīnipratyayaḥ| atra karttā taddhitenaivokta ityatra vākyamevaitannopaprasaṅgo nāsti, karma tu tenānabhihitamityasati kṛdgrahaṇe kaṭādeḥ karmaṇaḥ ṣaṣṭhī syāt| nanu cātra vākyamevaitannopapadyate, tathā hi-- karmaṇo niṣṭhayā'bhihitatvāt dvitīyayā'tra na bhavitavyam, nāpi taddhitena, asamārthyāt| tatpunarasāmarthya sāpekṣatvāt| tathā hi-- kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ pūrvamaneneti kṛtaśabdaḥ kaṭamapekṣate, naivam; dhātorutpadyamānā niṣṭhā kathaṃ kaṭaśabdasya karmatāmabhidadhyāt| tasyā hi karmasāmānyamevābhidhātuṃ sāmarthyam, na karmaviśeṣam| vākye tarhi kathaṃ tayā kaṭaśabdasya karmatvamabhidhīyate ? tatra yuktamabhidhānam; kṛta ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| taddhite tūtpanna ekārthībhāvātsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nivṛttamiti kena kaṭādeḥ karmabhāvo'bhidhīyate ? kriyā tu prakṛtyarthatvādyathā vākye guṇībhūtā sādhanasambandhamanubhavati, tathā vṛttāvapīti karotyarthāpekṣaṃ kaṭaśabdasya karmatvamupapadyate| tasmāddhavitavyameva dvitīyayā| kiñca vṛttisamānārthena vākyana bhavitavyam| na ca vṛttau bāhyaṃ kaṭādikaṃ karma gamyate yena pratyaya utpādayiṣyate| vākye kaṭādikarmāpekṣā niṣprayojaneti gamyate| tasmādevaṃ vigrahaḥ karttavyaḥ-- kṛtaṃ pūrvamaneneti| tataśca nāsti sāpekṣatvamiti bhavatyeva taddhitaḥ| `itarathā hi' iti| yadi śeṣagarhaṇamanuvarttata ityarthaḥ| `karttari ca kṛtītyevaṃ brūyāt' iti| evamapi hyucyamāne śeṣa ityanuvṛttau cakārakaraṇāt karmaṇītyetallabhyata eva, kiṃ karmagrahaṇena ? tasmāt punaḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ śeṣādhikarānivṛttyartham| punaḥ karmagrahaṇena hi pūrvasya karmagrahaṇasya nivṛttirākhyāyate| tannivṛttau tatsambaddhamanuvṛttamapi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ nivarttate|| 66.ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi| (2.3.66) `ubhayaprāptāviti bahuvrīhiḥ' iti| tena tatpuruṣaśaṅkāṃ nirasyati| bahuvrīherāśrayaṇasya prayojanaṃ vakṣyati| ubhayagrahaṇamena prakṛtatvāt karttṛkarmaṇī sambadhyete| `ubhayoḥ prāptiryasmin kṛti'ityanenaikasminnevetyabhiprāyaḥ| `karmaṇyeva' iti niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati| ubhayaprāptāveva karmaṇītyeṣa tu viparītaniyamo na bhavati| mā bhūt pūrvasūtreṇa karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīvidhānasya vaiyarthyamiti| `āścaryo gavāṃ doho'gopālakena' iti| duherbhāve ghañ| tatrobhayoprāptau karmaṇyeva goṣu ṣaṣṭhī bhavati; nā'gopālake karttari| atra ca `kṛtvo'rthaprayoge' (2.3.64) ityataḥ prayogagrahaṇaṃ nānuvarttate| tena gamyamāne'pi karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, yathā-- `antardhau yenādarśanamicchati' (1.4.28) ityatra hyaprayujyamānasyātmanaḥ karmatvaṃ gamyate| `pānam' iti| `lyuṭ ca' (3.3.115) iti bhāve lyuṭ| iha tu na bhavati-- āścaryamidamodanasya ca pāko brāhmaṇānāñca pādurbhāva iti| na hyatraikasmin kṛtyubhayoḥ prāptiḥ| tathā hyodanasya pāka ityatra karmaṇyevaudane prāptiḥ, na tu brāhmaṇeṣu karttuṣu| na hi pākasya karttṛtvena vivakṣitā brāhmaṇāḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? prādurbhāvasya karttṛtvena | brāhmaṇānāṃ naca prādurbhāva ityatrāpi prādurbhāva ityetasmin kṛti karttṛṣveva brāhmaṇeṣu prāptiḥ, na karmaṇyodane| na hi prādurbhāvasyodanaḥ karma; bhavaterakarmakatvāt| pākasyaiva tvodanaḥ karmatvena vivakṣitaḥ| `akākārayoḥ'ityādi| niyamasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| akākārayoḥ prayoge niyamo na bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `caturthyarthe bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.3.62) ityato bahulagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tenākākārayoḥ prayoge niyamo na bhaviṣyatīti| `śeṣe vibhāṣā' iti| asyāpyartho bahulagrahaṇasamāśrayaṇena vyākhyātavyaḥ| `bhedikā' iti| pūrvavadbhāve ṇvuc| `cikīrṣā' iti| `a pratyayāt' (3.3.102) ityakārapratyayaḥ|| 67. ktasya ca varttamāne| (2.3.67) `rājñāṃ mataḥ' iti| `matibuddhi' (3.2.188) ityādinā ktaḥ| rājñāmiti karttari ṣaṣṭhī| karma tu niṣṭhayābhihitam| atheha kasmānna bhavati-- śīlito devadattena, rakṣito devadattenetyādi, śīlitādiṣvapi `matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' (3.2.188) iti cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvanādvartamāna eva kto vidhīyate ? yadyapyevam, tathāpi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtteriha na bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| atha vā-- prakaraṇādevātra varttamānakālatā gamyate| padārthastu bhūtatvameva pratipādayati, na varttamānatām| yasya tu padārtho varttamānastatprayoge bhavatyeva ṣaṣṭhī, yathā-- `kānto hariścandra iva prajānām' iti| `śeṣavijñānāt siddham' iti| upasaṃkhyānaṃ ptyācaṣṭe-- `tathā ca' ityādinā| yastūpasaṃkhyānamārabhate, tasya karttṛtvāvivakṣāyāmapi ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavati, na tṛtīyeti darśayati|| 68. adhikaraṇavācinaśca| (2.3.68) `tasya prayoge ṣaṣṭhī vibhaktirbhavati' iti| yathāsambhavaṃ yatra karttaiva saṃbhavati tatra kartari bhavati; yathā-- idameṣāmāsitamiti| atrāserakarmakatvāt kartaiva sambhavati, na karma| yatra tu karma karttāpi sambhavati tatrobhayatrāpi, yathā-- idameṣāṃ bhuktamodanasyeti| bhujeḥ sakarmakatvāt karmāpyastyevaudanaḥ| `ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi' (2.3.66) iti niyamaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? `karttṛkarmaṇo kṛtiḥ' (2.3.65) ityasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prāptereva niyamo vijñāyate| `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti, `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante nottarān' (vyā.pa.10) iti vā| adhikaraṇe ceti vaktavye vācigrahaṇamidhakaraṇaktopalakṣaṇaṃ mā vijñāyītyevamartham| upalakṣaṇārthatve hi tasyārthāntaravṛtterapi dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhya utpannasya ktasya prayoge ṣaṣṭhī syāt| vācigrahaṇe tu yadā bhāve ktapratyayo bhavati tadā ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| tadā karttari tṛtīyaiva bhavati -- hahānenāsitamiti| na hyatrādhikaraṇavācī ktaḥ; `{kto'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthe'bhyaḥ' iti sūtram|} kto'dhikaraṇe dhrauvyagatipratyavasānāthabhyaśca' (3.4.76) iti cakārāt yathāprāptañceti bhāve karttari ca vidhānāt| yadā tu karttari kto bhavati tadā tenaivābhihatatvāt tatra ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| ihema āsitā iti cakāraḥ pūrvāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ|| 69. na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām| (2.3.69) `kikinau ca gṛhyete' iti| yadyapi kikinoralādeśatvāt sthānivadbhāvena lagrahaṇena tayorgrahaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpi `liṭ ca' (3.2.171) ityatideśena bhavitavyam| viśeṣātideśe hi nāntarīyakaḥ sāmānyātideśa iti; viśeṣasya sāmānyenāvinābhāvāditi| tena sāmānyanibandhanaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kikinorapi sidhyatīti yuktaṃ tayorapi grahaṇam| `pacamānaḥ' iti śānac| svaritettvādātmanepadam| `pecānaḥ' iti| `liṭaḥ kānajvā' (3.2.106) iti vacanāt, kānac| dvirvacanam| `ata eka' (6.4.120) ityādinaitvābhyāsalopau| `pecivān' iti| `kvuśca' (3.2.107) iti kvasuḥ| etvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayoḥ `vasvekājāddhasām' (7.2.67) itīṭ| `ugidacām' (7.1.70)iti num| `sāntamahasaḥ' (6.4.10) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| `dadiḥ| papiḥ' iti| `ādṛgamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ ca' (3.2.171) iti kikinoranyataraḥ| liṭ cetyatideśāddvivanam| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.3.64) ityākāralopaḥ| `cikīrṣuḥ' iti| `sanāsaṃsabhikṣa uḥ' (3.2.168)| `alaṅkariṣṇuḥ'iti| `alaṃkṛñ' (3.2.136) ityādineṣṇuc| `{āgāmukam- kāśikā, padamañjarī ca|} āgāmukaḥ' iti| `laṣapatapada'(3.2.154) ityādinokañ| `ukapratiṣedhe' ityādi| pratipādyata iti śeṣaḥ| pratipādanantu bahulagrahaṇānuvṛttimāśritya karttavyam| `kṛtvā' iti| `samānakarttṛkayoḥ' (3.4.21) iti ktvā| `avyayapratiṣedhe' ityādi| atrāpi pūrvavadvākyaśeṣo veditavyaḥ| pratipādanañca pūrvavadeva| atha vā -- `avyayībhāvaśca' (1.1.41) ityatra `sarvamidaṃ kāṇḍaṃ svarādiṣu paṭhyate' (1.1.41 kāśikā) ityādinā vṛttikāreṇa pratipādanaṃ kṛtam| `saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' (vyā.pa.64) iti vā| `udetoḥ' iti| utpūrvādiṇo `bhāvalakṣaṇe stheṇkṛñvadicari' (3.4.16) ityādinā tosun| `visṛpaḥ' iti| `sṛpitṛdoḥ kasun' (3.4.17) | ` īṣatkaraḥ' iti| `īṣad' (3.3.126) ityādinā khal| `īṣatpānaḥ' iti| `āto yuc' (3.3.128)| `ātṛno nakārāt' iti| tācchīlikasya tṛnaḥ sambandhino nakārādityarthaḥ| ` pavamānaḥ' iti| `pūṅa pavane' (dhā.pā.966), `pūṅayajoḥ śānan' (3.2.128)| `naḍamaghnānaḥ' iti| `tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś (3.2.129)| `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ| `ho hanteḥ'(7.3.54) ityādinā kutvam| `adhīyan' iti| `iṅa dhāryoḥ śatrakṛcchriṇi' (3.2.130) iti śatrādeśaḥ| iyaṅādeśaḥ| upasargeṇa saha dīrghaḥ| `karttā' iti| `ā kvestacchīla' (3.2.134) ityādinā tṛn| `dviṣaḥ śaturvāvacanam' iti| dviṣaḥ paro yaḥ śatṛpratyayasya prayoge vāvacanaṃ karttavyam; abhidhānābhidheyayorabhedopacārāt| vetyanena vārtha uktaḥ| vārtho'pi vikalpaḥ| vikalpa ucyate - pratyāyyate yena tadvāvacanam| tasya vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānaṃ -- bahulagrahaṇamihānuvarttate, tena dviṣaḥ śaturvikalpena pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| `dviṣan' iti| `dviṣo'mitre' (3.2.131) iti śatṛpratyayaḥ|| 70. akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ| (2.3.70) `akasya bhaviṣyati kāle' iti| nādhamarṇye, tasya tatrāsambhavāt| `inastu bhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' iti| tasyobhayorapi sambhavāt| nanu ca sāmyādiha saṃkhyātānudeśena bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; svaritena hi saṃkhyātānudeśo bhavati, na ceha tadarthaṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate| `kaṭaṃ kārako vrajati' iti| `tumunṇvulau' (3.3.10) ityādinā ṇvul| `grāmaṃ gamī' iti| gameriniḥ| sa ca `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' (3.3.3) iti vacanādbhaviṣyatkālaviṣayaḥ| `śataṃ dāyī' iti| `āvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ' (3.3.170)| `yavānāṃ lāvakaḥ' iti| `ṇvulatṛcau' (3.1.133) iti ṇvul| `avaśyaṃ kārī' iti| āvaśyake ṇiniḥ| `varṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ' iti| `pūrī āpyāyane' (dhā.pā.1151) caurādikaḥ| tasmāt `ṇvultṛcajau' (3.1.133) iti bhaviṣyatkāle ṇvul| sa hi triṣu kāleṣu bhavati| `bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyākasyedaṃ grahaṇam' iti| iha hi bhaviṣyaditi svaryate| svaritenādhikārāvagatirbhavati| tena bhaviṣyadadhikāravihitasyedamakasya grahaṇam, na sarvasya|| 71. kṛtyānāṃ karttari vā| (2.3.71) `geyo māṇavakaḥ sāmnām'iti| `bhavyageya' (3.4.68) ityādinā karttari geyaśabdo vyutpāditaḥ| gāyatīti geyaḥ sāmnāmiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī nityameva bhavati| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `na lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' (2.3.69) ityatra neti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, tenobhayaprāptau kṛtye ṣaṣṭhyāpratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| tena kraṣṭavyā śākhā grāmaṃ devadatteneti| kṛṣeḥ `anudāttasya cardupadhasyāntarasyām' (6.1.59) ityamāgamo bhavati| devadatte karttari ṣaṣṭhī mā bhūditi| evamubhayaprāptau kṛtye ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pratiṣedho vaktavya ityuktam| karmaṇi tu śākhāyāṃ kṛtyenābhihitvādeva ṣaṣṭhī na bhaviṣyati| grāmyasyāpradhānatvādeva yathaiva hi kṛtyāḥ pradhāne karmaṇi bhavanti nāpradhāne tathā ṣaṣṭhyapi| na ceha grāmaḥ pradhānaṃ karma, kiṃ tarhi ? śākheti|| 72.tulyārthairatulopamābhmāṃ tṛtīyā'nyatarasyām| (2.3.72) tulyārthaiḥ sadṛśārthairityarthaḥ| arthagrahaṇaṃ padāntaranirapekṣayā ye tulyārthatāmāhustatparigrahārtham| tena padāntarasānnidhyena dyotakā ivādayo nivartitā bhavanti-- gauriva gavaya iti, yathā gaustathā gavaya iti| svarūpanivṛttyarthatvarthagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; bahuvacananirdeśādeva svarūpavidhernirastatvāt| ihāpi pitustulyaḥ prajñayeti prajñāśabdāt ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati hetutvana karaṇatvena vā prajñāyā vivakṣitatvāt `itarathā hi tṛkatīyānukṛṣyeta' iti| tasyā anantarasūtre śrutatvāt| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya tvetadeva prayojanamiti| tadeva cakāreṇānukṛṣyata iti|| 73. caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ| `tṛtīyānirdeśādevārthagrahaṇe siddhe'rthagrahaṇādarthaśabdaḥ pṛthageva nimittaṃ vijñāyate| kathaṃ punastṛtīyāgrahaṇādarthagrahaṇaṃ sidhyati ? aparisamāptatvādasya yoga ityadhyāhriyate| sa cārthaireva sambhavati, na śabdairiti sāmarthyādarthagrahaṇaṃ sidhyati|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinedandrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ <2.4> atha dvitīyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ 1. dvigurekavacanam| (2.4.1) atra yadi pāribhāṣikamekavacanaṃ gṛhyeta tadānuprayoga ekavacanaṃ na syāt-- pañcapūlīyaṃ śobhaneti, anuprayogasyādvigutvāt| yadi pāribhāṣikamekavacanamihābhipretaṃ syāt tadā dvigorekavacanamityevaṃ brūyāt, tasmādanvarthasyaikavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ na pāribhāṣikasyeti manasi kṛtvāha-- `ekasya vacanamekavacanam' iti| etenaikavacanaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsatāṃ darśayannanvarthatāṃ darśayati| ekasya vacanaṃ vācakamekavacanamiti| vaktīti vacanam, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'
