(3.3.113) iti karttari lyuṭ| ekavacanasyaivārthaṃ paryāyāntareṇa spaṣṭīkartumāha-- `ekārthasya' ityādi| nanu caikavacanamiti puṃlliṅgena bhavitavyam; katham ? dvigoḥ puṃlliṅgatvāt; na; liṅgasāmānyasya vivakṣitatvānnapuṃsakaliṅgenaiva sāmānyena nirdeśaḥ kṛta ityadoṣaḥ| `tadanena prakāreṇa' iti| anvarthasyaikavacanaśabdagrahaṇātmakenetyarthaḥ| nacānekārthābhidhāyinaḥ śabdasya vacanaśatairapyekārmathābhidhāyitvaṃ śakyate karttum; śabdānāmarthābhidhāyitvasya svābhāvikatvāt; ucyate cedaṃ vacanam, tataḥ sāmarthyādatideśo'yaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha-- `dvigvarthasyaikavadbhāvo vidhīyate' iti| asyaivārthaṃ spaṣṭīkarttamāha-- `dvigvartha ekavadbhavati' iti| yadyevam, taddhitārtho yo dvigustasyāpyakavadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti-- pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtau saṃskṛtā vā pañcakapālau pañcakapālā vetyata āha-- `samāhāradvigośca' ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇe| samāhāradvigoreveti yāvat| kathaṃ punaḥ samāhāradvigoreva grahaṇaṃ labhyate ? evaṃ manyate-- `dvandvaśca' (2.4.2) ityatra cakāreṇa dviguranukṛṣyate| yasminnarthe dvandva ekārthībhavati tasminnevārthe dvigorapyekavadbhāvo yathā syāditi| dvandvaśca samāhāra evaikārthībhavati, nānyatra| tasmāt dvigorapyekavadbhāvastatraiva bhavati; ataḥ samāhāradvigorevedaṃ grahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ bhavati| yadi tarhi samāhāradvigorevedaṃ grahaṇaṃ tadā niṣprayojano'tideśaḥ, tathā hi-- samāhāro dvigorarthaḥ, samāhāraśca bhāvasādhanaḥ, samāharaṇaṃ samāhāraḥ - samudāyaḥ, sa caika eva| tatra nyāyaprāptamevaikavacanamiti niṣphalaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ ? naitadasti; yataḥ `samudāyibhyo'nanyaḥ samudāyaḥ' ityasmin darśane'nekadravyātmakatvāt samudāyasyaikavacanaṃ na siddhyatītīdamārabdham| tathā coktaṃ bhāṣye-- `pratyadhikaraṇaṃ vacanotpatteḥ saṃkhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyācca dvigorekavacane vidhānam' iti| pratyadhikaraṇam - pratidravyam| vacanasyotpattau pratyabhidheyadravyasamavāyinī saṃkhyāvibhaktiḥ prayojikotpadyate| dvigośca yo'rthaḥ so'nekadravyātmakaḥ| tathā hi-- pañca samāhṛtāḥ| samāhriyamāṇānāṃ pūlānāṃ pañcasaṃkhyāvacchinnatvāt saṃkhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyācca pañcaitāni dravyāṇīti kṛtvā samudāyasyaikavacanaṃ na siddhyati| tatrāsatyasmin vacane bahutvāt bahuvacanaṃ syāt| ata evadbhāvo vidhīyata iti vākyārthaḥ| `samudāyibhyo'nyaḥ samudāyaḥ' ityasmin darśane sūtramidaṃ pratyākhyātavyameva| tathā coktaṃ bhāṣye-- `na vā samāhāraikatvāt' iti| na vā yogārambheṇaivārthaḥ| yasmādeko'yamarthaḥ samāhāro nāma| tatraikatvādekavacanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti vākyārthaḥ| `pañcapūlī' iti| `akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' (vā.156) iti strītve sati dvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīp| `arthasyaikatvāt' ityādinā'rthātideśasya phalaṃ darśayati|| 2. dvandvaśca prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām| (2.4.2) atrāṅgaśabdaḥ samudāye parisamāpyate ? pratyekaṃ parisamāpyate vā ? tatra yadi samudāye parisamāpyeta tadaikamevedaṃ vākyaṃ syāt, tathā ca vyatikaraḥ prasajyeta| prāṇitūryasenāṅgānāṃ parasparasahitānāṃ yo dvandvo vyatikīrṇāvayavastasyaikavadbhāvaḥ syāt| pratyekaṃ parisamāptau tveṣa doṣo na bhavati| tatra hi prāṇyaṅgānāṃ dvandva ekavadbhavatītyevamādīni trīṇi vākyāni sampadyante| svaviṣaye yatra bahuvacanāntaṃ vākyaṃ kriyate tatra prathamena vākyena prāṇyaṅgānāṃ prāṇyaṅgaireva yaḥ samāsastasyaikavadbhāvo vidhīyate| dvitīyena vākyena tūryāṅgānāṃ tūryāṅgaiḥ| tṛtīyena senāṅgānāṃ senāṅgairiti na bhavati saṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ| na hi caturtha vākyamasti yena vyatikīrṇāvayavasya dvandvasyaikārthatā syāditi manyamānaḥ pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptipakṣamāśrityāha-- `aṅgaśabdasya' ityādi| tathā tūryāṅgānāmiti dvandva ekavadbhavatītyepekṣate| evaṃ senāṅāganāñcetyatrāpi| `pāṇipādam' iti| atra yadi prāṇyaṅgamapi prāṇigrahaṇena gṛhyate tadā `jātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) ityevaṃ siddham| yathā-- paṇavamṛdaṅgamiti| `rathikāśvāroham' iti| rathikāścāśvārohāśceti vṛttipadārthasya bahutvaṃ darśayitavyam| yasmādbahutvameva senāṅgatve kāraṇam| bahutvābhāve senāṅgatvannāstīti rathikāśvārohāviti bhavitavyam| `hastyaśvādiṣu paratvāt paśudvandvavibhāṣayaiva bhavitavyam' iti| `vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛga' (2.4.12) ityādinā| `itaretarayoge' ityādinā dvandvaprakaraṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eva' ityādinā viṣayavibhāṣāgārthatāṃ spaṣṭīkaroti|| 3. anuvāde caraṇānām| (2.4.3) `caraṇaśabda' ityādinā sūtrasya viṣayaṃ darśayati| tathā hi-- yo hi kaṭhādiproktādhyayanaviśeṣaḥ śākhā, tatra yadā caraṇaśabdo varttate tadā `jātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) ityeva siddham| yadā tu śākhānimittakaḥ' iti| śākhā nimittamsayeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `pramāṇāntarāvagatasya' iti| śabdāt pramāṇādyadanyat pramāṇaṃ tat pramāṇāntaram, tatpunaḥpratyakṣādi| tenāvagatasya paricchinnasya śabdena rasaṅkīrtanamātramiti mātraśabdo'rthāvagativyudāsārthaḥ| `udagāt,pratyaṣṭhāt' iti| utpūrvādiṇaḥ pratipūrvāttiṣṭhaterluṅa, `iṣo gā luṅi' (2.4 .45) iti gādeśaḥ, `gātisthā' (2.4.77) iti sico luk| `kaṭhakālāpam' iti| kaṭhena proktamadhīyata iti kaṭhāḥ| kaṭhaśabdāt proktārthe `kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaśca' (4.3.104) iti ṇiniḥ, tasya `kaṭhacarakālluk' (4.3.107) , tataḥ ` tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya `proktālluk' (4.2.64) , `chandobrāhmaṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi' (4.2.66) iti tadviṣayatā| kalāpinā proktamadhīyata iti kalāpāḥ| proktārthe kalāpino'ṇ, `inaṇyanapatye' (6.4.164) iti prakṛtibhāve prāpte `sabrahmacāripīṭhasarpikalāpikuthumitairatilijājalilāṅgaliśilāliśikhaṣṭiśūkarasadmasuparvaṇāmupasaṃkhyānam' (vā. 798) iti ṭilopaḥ| tataḥ `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ| tasya `proktālluk' (4.2.64) iti luk| pūrvavat tadviṣatā ca| kaṭhāśca kālāpāśca kaṭhakālāpam| ` yadā tu prathamata evopadeśaḥ' iti| anavagatasyaiva prāk pramāṇāntareṇa śabdenādyaṃ pratyāyanamarthasya praśne prativacane vopadeśaḥ, sa yadā bhavati tadātra pratyudāharaṇam| ` udaguḥ' iti| `ātaḥ' (3.4.110) iti jharjus| `usyapadāntāt' (6.1.96) iti pararūpatvam| `stheṇoradyatanyāñceti vaktavyam' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `tulyārthairatulopamābhyām' (2.3.72) ityataḥ sūtrādanyatarasyāmityanuvarttate| sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena stheṇoradyatanyāmanuvāde caraṇānāmekavadbhāvo bhaviṣyati, nānyatreti| `adyatanī' iti luṅaḥ pūrvācāryapraṇītaiṣā saṃjñā| `anandiṣuḥ' iti| `ṭunadi samṛddhau' (dhā.pā.67), `sijabyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjus| `udyanti' iti| `iko yaṇ' (6.4.81) iti yaṇādeśaḥ|| 4. adhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam| (2.4.4) `adhvaryuvede' iti| aitenādhvaryuśabdanātra yajurvedo lakṣyata iti darśayati| athāṣvaryorṛtvigviśeṣasya yaḥ kraturiti kratuviśeṣaṇamevādhvaryugrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? asambhavāt; ko hi tasya kraturbhavati ! api tu ghanavyayaśīlasya| yadyapi tasya kratau karttṛtvamasti tadapi ṛtvigantareṇa sādhāraṇamityadhvaryuṇaikena tasya viśeṣaṇamayuktam| nanu cātharvavedavihito yaḥ kratustannivṛttyarthamadhvaryuṇaikena kathaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ na syāt; na hi ttarādhvaryavaḥ santi ? naitadasti; yadi hyetāvat prayojanamabhihitaṃ syāt tadā'natharvaṇa iti pratiṣedhameva kuryāt| laghīyasī hi sākṣāt pratiṣedhe pratītirbhavati| trayīgrahaṇaṃ vā kuryāt| yadi cādhvaryuṇā kraturviśeṣyeta tadeṣuvajrāvityatrāpi syāt ? iṣuvajrāvapi hyadhvaryoḥ kratū bhavataḥ; tayorapi tatkartṛkatvāt| tasmādadhvaryūṇāṃ yajurvedavidāṃ yo vedaḥ so'dhvaryuśabdenopalakṣyate| sa punaryajurvedaḥ| tatrādhvaryuvede yasya kratorvidhānaṃ so'dhvaryukraturiti| itikarttavyatopadeśaḥ prayogaścānuṣṭhānātmako vidhānaśabdenoktaḥ| yadi tarhyadhvaryukratuvācināmanapuṃsakaliṅgānāṃ dvandva ekavadbhavatīti sūtrārthastadā sūtre'dhvaryukratuśabdasyānapuṃsakamityasya ca dvandva itayanena prakṛtena sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeśo nopapadyate| ato'dhvaryukratuvācināmanapuṃsakaliṅgānāmiti vaktavyaṃ syādityata āha-- `adhvaryukraturanapuṃsakam' iti| `gauṇo'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ' iti| gauṇa ityamukhya aupacārika ityarthaḥ| adhvaryukratvavayavo dvandva upacāreṇādhvaryukraturityuktaḥ| sa evānapuṃsakaliṅgāvayavo'napuṃlakamiti| gauṇanirdeśastu lāghavārtho veditavyaḥ| yadi punaranapuṃsakamityanena mukhyayā vṛttyā dvandva evocyeta tadā `sa napusaṃkam' (2.4.17) ityasyāpavādo'yaṃ vijñāyeta| `arkāśvamedham' ityādi| arkaścāśvamedhaścetyarkāśvamedham| sāyāhnaścātirātraśceti `sāyāhnātirātram'| `iṣuvajrau' ityādi| iṣuvajraprabhṛtayo'dhvaryukratavo na sambhavati, na hi teṣāmadhvaryuvede vidhānam| kiṃ tarhi ? sāmavede| `rājasūyavājapeye' iti. etau rājasūyavājapeyaśabdau puṃlliṅgāvapi staḥ| tatra yadā napuṃsakaliṅgau prayujyete tatredaṃ pratyudāharaṇam| `somayāgeṣu' iti| yatra yatra somapānaṃ vihitaṃ te somayāgāḥ| teṣveva kratuśabdo rūḍhaḥ| na ca darśapaurṇamāsau somayāgau| `anapuṃsakam' (2.4.4) ityupādānāt svarūpagrahaṇamiha na bhavati| na hi kratusāmānyo napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati|| 5. adhyayanato'viprakṛṣṭākhyānām| (2.4.5) adhītiradhyayanamiti bhāvasādhano'dhyayanaśabdaḥ, karmasādhano vā -- adhīyata ityadhyayanamiti| `adhyayanataḥ' iti| `ādyādibhyastasyupasaṃkhyānam' (vā. 634) iti hetutṛtīyāntāt tasiḥ| ata āha-- `adhyayanena nimittena' iti| `aviprakṛṣṭā' iti| aviprakṛṣṭā''khyā yeṣāṃ te'viprakṛṣṭākhyāḥ| nimittasya sādhāraṇatvādiviprakṛṣṭatā| tatpunarnimittaṃ sūtropāttamevādhyayanamākhyānāmadheyam| `padakakramakam' iti| padamadhīte, kramamadhīte iti `kramādibhyo vun' (4.2.61)| `kramakavārtikam' iti. vṛttimadhīta iti vārtikaḥ| kratūkthādisūtrāntāṭṭhak (4.2.60)| kathaṃ punaḥ padasyādhyetuḥ kramasya cādhyayanena nimittenāviprakṛṣṭatā bhavatītyāha-- `sampāṭhaḥ' ityādi| yasmāt padānāṃ kramasya ca yaḥ pāṭhaḥ sa nātibhinnaḥ| grantho'pi tādṛśa eva, ataḥ pratyāsannaḥ| yataśca padānyadhītya kramo'dhyetavyaḥ, tato'pi sampāṭhastayo| pratyāsannaḥ, tataśca tena sampāṭhenādhyayanena nimittena padaka iti kramaka iti ca yā'dhyeturākhyā sā'pi pratyāsannā bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| `pitāputrau' iti| `ānaṅa ṛto dvandve' (6.3.25) ityānaṅādeśaḥ| tatra hi `putre'nyatarasyām' (6.3.22) ityataḥ putra ityanuvarttate| atrāpi piteti putra iti cākhye pratyāsanne sādhāraṇatvānnimittasya| tathā hi-- janyajanakabhāvo dvayorapi tayornimittam| `yājñikavaiyākaraṇam' iti| yajñamadhīte yājñikaḥ| kratūkthādinā (4.2.60) ik| vyākaramamadhīte vaiyākaraṇaḥ| `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ| astyatrādhyayananimittatvamanayorākhyayoḥ, na tu pratyāsatiḥ| na hi yajñādhyayanena vyākaraṇādhyayanena vā tayoḥ kriyāpratyāsattirnāpi granthapratyāsattiḥ|| 6. jātiraprāṇinām| (2.4.6) ayamapi gauṇyā vṛttyā jātirdvandva iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| jātivācyavayavo dvandvo jātirityuktaḥ| jāteśca svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, aprāṇināmiti pratiṣedhāt| `ārāśastri' iti| `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvaḥ| `nandakapāñcajanyau' iti| saṃjñāśabdayoreva dvandvo'yam, na jātiśabdayoḥ| anenāprāṇināmityasya paryudāsatāṃ darśayati| tenāyamartho bhavatītyāha-- `nañivayukta' ityādi| `rūparasagandhasparśāḥ' ityādi guṇajātiḥ| `gamanākuñcanaprasāraṇāni' iti kriyājātiḥ| `jātiparatve ca' iti| yadā jāteḥ prādhānyena vivakṣā tadā jāteḥparatve pradhānatve sati jātiśabdānāmamekavadbhāvo bhavati| `na niyatadravyavivakṣāyām' iti| yadā kvaciddeśādau niyatānāṃ dravyaviśeṣāṇāṃ vivakṣā bhavati tadā jātiśabdasya prayoge'pyekavadbhāvo na bhavati| kuta etat ? jātirityabhidhānānmukhyā jātirāśrīyate; na gauṇī| etacca pradhāne kāryasampratyayāllabhyate| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yadā jātireva vyaktiviśeṣamāśritya prayujyate tadā naikavadbhāvaḥ| yadā tu vyaktiviśeṣamanāśritya prayujyate tadaivaikavadbhāva iti| `badarāmalakāni' iti| atra badarāmalakānāñca vyaktiprayuktānāṃ pratītiḥ; na jātiśabdānām| ata eva vyaktyāśrayaṃ bahuvacanam; anyathā jāterdvitvāddavivacanameva syāt, na bahuvacanam| aprāṇināmiti paryudāso'yam| tenāyamartho labhyate-- nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) rūparasasparśādīnānnaikavadbhāva iti| aprāṇināmiti pratiṣedhe bahutvaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ vidhāvapi bahutvaṃ gamayati| tena bahuprakṛtereva dvandva ekadavadbhavati, na dviprakṛteḥ-- ārāśastryāviti|| 7. viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadīdeśo'grāmāḥ| (2.4.7) viśiṣṭaśabdo'yaṃ bhedavacanaḥ| yoña'pi `ktena nañviśiṣṭenānañ' (2.1.ka60) ityatra sāvadhāraṇādhikye viśiṣṭaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ; so'pi bheddavāreṇaiva pratipattayaḥ| teneha vṛttikāro'pi `bhinnaliṅgānā{api nāsti--kāśikā}mapi' ityāha| `agrāmāḥ' iti| pratiṣedhādanayoḥ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatītyāha-- `nadīvācinām' ityādi| yadi nadīvācināṃ dvandvo deśavācināñcaikavadbhavatītyayamatra sūtrārtho'bhimataḥ, tatkathaṃ nadīdeśa ityayaṃ dvandva ityanena prakṛtena sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeśa ityāha-- `nadyavayavo dvandvonadītyucyate' ityādi| etena gauṇaḥ sūtre nirdeśa iti darśayati| nadīdeśa ityayaṃ yadi dvandvasamāsastadā vyatikīrṇāvayavo dvandvo yasya kaścidavayavo nadī kaściddeśastasyaikavadbhāvaḥ syāt| kiñca, dvandvo bhavanneṣa samāhāre vā syāt ? itareratarayoge vā ? ttra pūrvasmin pakṣe `sa napuṃsakam' (2.4.17) iti napuṃsakatvaṃ syāt, itaratra tu dvivacanamitīmaṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā''ha-- `nadīdeśa' iti| `asamāsa evāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ' iti| `madrakekayāḥ' iti| madrāśca kekayāśca madrakekayāḥ| atha nadīgrahaṇaṃ kasmāt kriyate ? na deśagrahaṇādeva nadīgrahaṇaṃ siddhamityata āha-- `nadīgrahaṇamadeśatvāt' iti| kasmāt pūnarnadī deśo na bhavatītyāha-- `janapado hi deśaḥ' iti| tatraiva deśaśabdasya rūḍhatvāt| yat punarnadī deśa ityucyate tat tātsthyāt| bhavati hi tātsthyāt tācchabdyam, yathā- mañcāḥ krośantīti| `tathā ca' ityādi| tasmājjanapada eva deśo nānyaḥ parvatādiḥ| evañca kṛtvā deśagrahaṇena parvatādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| `agrāmā ityatra ' ityādi| loke hi grāmagrahaṇena nagaragrahaṇaṃ bhavati, tathā hyabhakṣyo grāmyaśūkara ityukte nāgaro'pi na bhakṣyate| tataścehāgrāmā iti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyamāṇo nagarāṇāmapi prāpnoti, tasmādagrāmā iti pratiṣedhe nagarapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, agrāmā ityanena nagarāṇāṃ yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti tasya pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tena nagarāṇāṃ vidhireva bhavati| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- yadayam `prācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām' (7.3.14) ityatra grāmanagarayorbhedenopadānaṃ karoti kajjñāpayati-- iha śastre grāmagrahaṇena nagarāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti| tenāgrāmā iti pratiṣedho nagarāṇāṃ na bhavati| `ubhayatacca' ityādi| ubhayasminnityarthaḥ ubhayataḥ| yatra kaścidavayavo grāmaḥ kaścinnagaraṃ tatra grāmāṇāṃ yaḥ pratiṣedha ucyate sa eva vaktavyaḥ, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- agrāmā iti prasajya pratiṣedho'yaṃ vijñeyaḥ, nacet dvandve grāmā vidyanta iti| tena yatra grāmagandho'pyasti tatrāpyekavadbhāvo na bhavatīti|| 8. kṣudrajantavaḥ| (2.4.8) kṣudraśabdo'yamastyeva yaḥ kārpaṇyavati puruṣe varttate; yathā-- kṣudro devadatta iti, kṛpaṇa iti gamyate| asti ca śīlahīne'ṅgahīne ca, yathā --kṣudrābhyo veti| atra hyaniyatapuṃskā vikalāṅgāśca striyaḥ kṣudrāgrahaṇena gṛhyante| asti ca parimāṇāpacaye, yathā-- kṣudrāstaṇḍulā iti| iha tu jantuśabdasannidhānāt prāṇiśarīrasyālpatāmācaṣṭe| tena parimāṇāpacaye varttamānasya kṣudraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `apacitaparimāṇaḥ kṣudraḥ' iti| alpaśarīra ityarthaḥ| apacitaparimāṇatā cāpekṣābhedādanavasthiteti| asthiretyarthaḥ| kṣudrajantuśabdasyābhidheyaṃ prati sma-tīrupanyasyati-- `kṣudrajanturanasthiḥ syāt' iti| `kṣudir sampevaṇe' (dhā.pā.1443) kṣudyata iti kṣudraḥ| auṇādikaḥ `sphāyītañci' (da.u.8.31) ityādinā rak| kṣudraścāsau jantuśceti kṣudrajantuḥ| `anasthiḥ' iti| yasyāsthīni na vidyante| kavalaṃ yasya carmaśoṇitamāṃsamasti sa kṣudraścāsau jantuśceti kṣudrajantuḥ| `atha vā kṣudra eva yaḥ' iti smṛtyantaramāha| kṣodayituṃ yaḥ śakyate sa kṣudrajantuḥ| śabdārthavaśāt prasiddha eva loke kṣudrajanturgrāhyaḥ| sa punarmaśakādiraṅge yasyātmīyaṃ śoṇitaṃ nāsti| yeṣāṃ vā gocarmamātraṃ rāśihatvāpi naraḥ patito na bhavati te prasiddhāḥ kṣudrajantava ucyante| `śataṃ vā prasṛtau yeṣām' aparā smṛtiḥ| psṛtau añjalau baddhaṃ yeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ śataṃ prasṛtirbhavati śatena vā prasṛtiḥ pūryate te kṣudrajantavaḥ| `kecidānakulādapi' iti. kakecidvarṇayanti-- nakulaparyantāḥ kṣudrajantava iti| `iyameva smṛtiḥ pramāṇam' iti| asyāḥ sarvasmṛtyanugrāhiṇītvāt| tathā hyetadupalakṣiteṣu kṣudrajantuṣu smṛtyantaradarśitā api kṣudrajantavo'ntarbhavati| itarā api smṛtayaḥ pramāṇaṃ kasmānna bhavantītyāha-- `itarāsām' ityādi| anasthyādīnāṃ smṛtīnāmā nakulādapīti smṛtyā virodhaḥ| tasmānnaitāḥ prāmāṇyenābhyupagamyante, tena sarvatredaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| `kṣudrajantavaḥ' iti bahuvacananirdeśāt bahuvacananirdeśāt bahuprakṛterevaikavadbhāvo yathā syāt| taneha na bhavati-- yūkālikṣe, daṃśamaśakāviti| ayañca prāṇijātyartha ārambhaḥ| `kṣudrajantava iti kim' iti ? nanu ca sūtrāsyābhāve kiṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ syāt ? evaṃ manyate-- anyathā hi jantava iti sūtraṃ karttavyam, tataścātiprasaṅga syāditi|| 9. yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ| (2.4.9) pratipakṣabhāvamātraṃ loke virodhaśabdenocyate| tasyeha grahaṇe sati chāyātapau, agnijale ityatrāpi syāditi matvā vairamiha virodho'bhimata iti darśayitumāha-- `virodho vairam' iti| evaṃ manyate-- `kṣudrajantavaḥ' (2.4.8) ityato jantugrahaṇamanuvarttate| tena jantūnāṃ yo virodhastasyeha grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| sa ca vairasvabhāva eveti| `śāśvatiko nityaḥ' iti| śasvaditi traikalyamucyate| tatra bhavaḥ śāśvatikaḥ| `kālāṭaṭhañ'(4.3.11)| asmādeva nipātanāt tāntādapi ko na bhavati| yaśca traikalye bhavati sa nityaḥ| `gopāliśālaṅkāyanāḥ' iti| gopālayaśca śālaṅkāyanāśca gopāliśālaṅkāyanāḥ| nātra śāśvatiko virodha ityekavadbhāvo na bhavati| `cakāraḥ punarasyaiva samuccayārthaḥ' iti| prakṛtasyānyasya samuccetavyasyābhāvādasyaikavadbhāvasya samuccayārthaścakāro vijñāyate| tena kiṃ bhavatītyāha-- `tena paśuśakuni' ityādi| paśuśakunivibhāṣāyā avakāśaḥ--mahājorabhram, mahājorabhrāḥ, haṃsacakravākam, haṃsacakravākā iti| nityavirodhināmekavadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ-- brāhmaṇanāstikamiti, śvaśṛgālam, aśvamahiṣam| kākolūkamityatrobhayaprāptau paratvāt paśuśakunivibhāṣā syāt| cakārasya punarasyaiva samuccayārthatvādanena nityamekavadbhavati|| 10.śūdrāṇāmaniravasitānām| (2.4.10) yadyapi `ṣiñ bandhane' (dhā.pā. 1248) iti sinotirbandhane varttate; tathāpi niravapūrvo bahiṣkaraṇe varttata ityāha-- `niravasānaṃ bahiṣkaraṇam'| yairbhukte pātraṃ saṃskāreṇāpi na śuddhyati tasmāt te tato bahiṣkṛtāḥ - pṛthakkṛtāḥ| na labhante tatra bhoktumityarthaḥ|| 11. gavāśvaprabhṛtīni ca| (2.4.11) gavāścādīni kṛtaikavadbhāvāni gaṇe paṭhyante| teṣāmamanena sādhutvamātraṃ vidhīyate| na tvekavadbhāva iti darśayannāha-- `gavāśvādīni' iti| gvāśvamityevamādīnāmajaiḍakaparyantānāṃ paśudvandvavikalpe vacanamidam| kubjavāmanaprabhṛtīnāṃ trayāṇāmaprāpte| śvacāṇḍālasyāvirodhaḥ ? yadā virodhaṃ dvandvo nācaṣṭe kevalañcārthamātre varttate tadā śvacāṇḍālamihāstīti| `strīkumāraṃ dāsīmāṇavakam' ityaprāpte vacanam| `śāṭīpicchakam' iti `jātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) iti siddhe, abahuprakṛtyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| `uṣṭrakharamuṣṭraśaśam' iti| paśudvandvavibhāṣāprāptau nityārtham| mūtraśakṛdādīnāṃ māṃsaśoṇitaparyantānāmaprāṇijātīnāmabahuprakṛtyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| darbhaśaraprabhṛtīnāṃ tṛṇavibhāṣāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| dāsīdāsādīnāṃ trayāṇāmaprāpte| `pumān striyā' (1.2.67) ityekaśeṣo na bhavatyasmādeva nipātanāt| `gavāśvaprabhṛtiṣu yathoccāritaṃ dvandvavṛttam' iti| katham ? tathā rūpsayāśrayaṇāt| gaṇapāṭhe hi yadeṣāṃ śabdānāṃ rūpaṃ tadāśritam| yena yathoccāritānāmekavadbhāvalakṣaṇaṃ dvandvavṛtaṃ bhavati| `rūpāntare tu nāyaṃ vidhiḥ' iti| yadā `avaṅa sphoṭāyanasya ' (6.1.123) ityavaṅa nāsti tadā rūpāntare jāte'nena sūtreṇa yo vidhiḥ kriyate sa na bhavati| paśudvandvavibhāṣaiva pravarttate|| 12. vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharottarāṇām| (2.4.12) vṛkṣādigrahayaṇeneha vakṣādiviśeṣavācināṃ grahaṇam| katham ? yasmādatra hi vṛkṣādibhirdvandvaḥ pratyekaṃ viśiṣyate, tenaiṣā vibhāṣā tulyajātīyeṣvevāvatiṣṭhate| virūpeṣu tulyajātīyeṣvapi, na svarūpeṣu| teṣāṃ dvandvo nāsti; ekaśeṣavidhānāt| virūpeṣvapi na paryāyeṣu| teṣāṃ dvandvābhāvāt| dvandvābhāvaśca yugapatprayogābhāvāt, yuktārthābhāvācca| cārthābhāvastvarthabhedābhāvāt| bhinnādhiṣṭhānā hi cārthatā| na ca paryāyāṇāṃ bhinnārthatā sambhavati; tasmādvarūpeṣveva vṛkṣādiviśeṣavāciṣvasyā vibhāṣāyā upasthānam| tena viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ vṛkṣādiṣu vijñāyate, na svarūpagrahaṇam, nāpi paryāyagrahaṇam| atha sāmānyaviśeṣavācināṃ grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate, sambhavati hi sāmānyaviśeṣavācināṃ dvandvaḥ, yathā-- govalīvardamiti ? na; anabhidhānāt| na hi vṛkṣadhavamityevaṃ loke'bhidhānamasti; dhavaśabdādeva tadarthābhidhāyino vṛkṣaśabdasyārthasyāvagatvāt, dhavādiśabdaprayoge vṛkṣādiśabdasya prayogānarhatvāt| govalīvardamityatra tu balīvardasannidhāne gośabdasya strīgavīṣveva vṛtterdvāvapi viśeṣavācināviti yukto dvandvaḥ| ye'trāprāṇivācinasteṣāṃ `jātiraprāṇinām' (2.4.6) ityekavadbhāve nitye prāpte vacanamidaṃ vibhāṣārtham| pariśiṣṭānāmaprāpte| paśugrahaṇenaiva mṛgādigrahaṇe satyapi paśvantareṇeṣāṃ kimartham ? tulyajātīyānāṃ dvandvo'yamekavadbhavatītyuktam, atra paśugrahaṇenaiva siddhe mṛgādigrahaṇe satyapi paśvantareṇeṣāṃ paraspareṇa vā dvandvo mā bhūdityevamartham| `paśudvandva' ityevaṃ siddhe'śvavaḍavagrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham| yo'nya etayoḥ paryāyastatra mā bhūt-- hayavaḍave iti| `bahuprakṛtiḥ' iti| bahvarthā bahuvacanāntā vā prakṛtiryasya sa bahuprakṛtiḥ| bahvarthānāṃ phalādīnāmeṣāṃ bahuvacanāntānāṃ vā dvandva ekavadbhavatītyarthaḥ|| 13. vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci| (2.4.13) `adravyavācinām' iti| etenādhikaraṇaśabdo'tra dravye varttate nādhāra iti darśayati| na hi vipratiṣiddhavācināṃ śabdānāmādhāre vṛttirastiḥ; vibhaktyarthatvādādhāraśakteḥ| `śītoṣṇe' iti| śītoṣṇayoḥ sahānavasthānalakṣaṇenaiva virodhena viruddhatvādvipratiṣiddhavācitvam| tathā sukhaduḥkhayorapi|| `kāmakrodhau' iti| kruddho'pi kāmamācaratīti nānayorvipratiṣiddhatvam|| 14. na dadhipayaādīni| (2.4.14) `yathāyatham' iti| yathāsvaṃ yasya yadātmīyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tenetyarthaḥ| tatra dadhipayasī ityādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ vyañjanavācitvādvibhāṣaikavadbhāvaprāptiḥ| nanu ca sarpirmadhunī, madhusarpiṣī iti rājadantādiṣvanayornipātanādevaikavadbhāvo na bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; pākṣiko hi vyañjanaikavadbhāvaḥ| tatra yasmin pakṣe sa nāsti tasminnipātanaṃ pūrvanipātvyabhicārārthaṃ syāt| itarasminnapi pakṣa ekavadbhāvaniṣedhārtho'tra pāṭhaḥ| yadyevam, anenaiva siddhatvādrājadantādiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt ? nānarthakaḥ; bahuvacanārthatvāt| `sarpirmadhunī, madhusarpiṣī' iti| nanu tatrāpi dvavacanāntāveva paṭhyete ? yadyapyevam, tathāpi śabdāśrayatvāt paranipātasyārthadharmatvāddvitvaṃ nāpekṣyate| arthāśrayastvekavadbhāva iti tatpraṣedhe yujyate saṃkhyāṃ vivakṣitum| `brahmaprajāpatī' ityādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ samāhāraikatvāt prāptiḥ| `śuklakṛṣṇau' iti| `vipratiṣiddham' (2.3.13) ityādinā| `idhmābārhiṣī' ityādīnāṃ samāhāraikatvāt prāptiḥ|| 15.adhikaraṇaitāvattve ca| (2.4.15) adhikaraṇaṃ varttipadārthaḥ' iti| varttana varttaḥ - samāsaḥ| bhāve ghañ| varto'syāstīti varti - samāsāvayavabhutama| varttiśca tat padañceti varttipadaṃ tasya padasyārtho'dhikaraṇamityucyate| kathaṃ punastasyādhikaraṇatvāmityata āha-- `sa hi' ityādi| ādhāro hyadhikaraṇam| varttipadārthaśca samāsārthasyādhāro bhavati; tatra tasya samavāyāt| varttipadārthairhyavayavairavayavī samāsārtha ārabhyate, avayavī cāvayaveṣu kasamavaiti| `tasya ' iti| varttipadārthasya| `daśa {ime nāsti--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca} ime dantauṣṭhāḥ}' iti| `dvandvaśca' (2.4.2) ityādinā prāptiḥ|| 16. vibhāṣā samīpe| (2.4.16) adhikaraṇaitāvattvasya prakṛtatvāt tadapekṣayaiva samīpatvaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha-- `adhikaraṇaitāvattvasya samīpe' iti| `upadaśaṃ dantauṣṭham'iti| atrādhikaraṇaitāvattvaṃ daśasaṃkhyā, tatsamīpaṃ navaikādaśa vā| tatra daśaśabda etāvattvamācaṣṭe| upaśabdaḥ sāmīpyam| kathaṃ punardvandvaikavadbhāvo vikalpyamāno'nuprayogasya labhyata ityata āha-- `avyayasya' ityādi| yadyapyarthātideśādanuprayogasyāpi vikalpo labhyate, tathāpi parīhārāntaramapyastīti darśanārthamasyopanyāsaḥ| tatrāvyayasya saṃkhyāyā avyayībhāvo vihitaḥ--`avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā| bahuvrīhirapi vihitaḥ-- `saṃkhyāyāvyayāsanna' (2.2.25) ityādinā| atraikavadbhāvapakṣa ekārthasya dvandvasyaikārtha evāvyayībhāvo'nuprayujyate| ekārthatvaṃ punastasya sāmīpyapradhānasatvāt| yadyapyavyayībhāvo'vyayam, tathāpyabhedaikatvaṃ bhedābhāvalakṣaṇaṃ tasyāstyeva sāmānādhikaraṇyam| itaratra tu bahvarthasya dvandvasya bahvartha eva bahuvrīhiranuprayujyate| bahvarthaṃ punarbahuvrīheḥ samīpinaḥ prādhānyāt| bahuvrīhirhi samīpī pradhānatvādbhedasaṃkhyāmupādata iti bahvartho bhavati| `upadaśam' iti| `avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ' (5.4.7) ityanuvarttamāne `anaśca' (5.4.108) iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ| `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopoḥ| `upadaśāḥ' iti| bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt' (5.4.73) iti ḍac|| 17. sa napuṃsakam| (2.4.17) `pañcagavam' iti| `gorataddhitaluki' (5.4.92) iti ṭac| sagrahaṇaṃ dvigorapi yathā syādityevamartham. itarathā hi `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedo vā' (vyā.pa.19) ityanantarasyaiva dvandvasya syānna vyavahitasya dvigoḥ, naitadasti; ekavacanamityanuvarttate, tasya `napuṃsakam' ityanena sambandhe sati kuto vyavadhānam ! na hyatraikaravacanena viśeṣo dvandvo'nenāpekṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ? ekavacanamātram| prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārthaṃ tarhi sagrahaṇam| sa ityetadanuvādo bhaviṣyati, anuvādaśca prasiddhasyaiva bhavati| tathā ca yathādarśanamiyaṃ liṅgavyavasthā''khyāyata iti| tena dvandvaikavadbhāve nityaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ vijñāyate| dvigoścāniyatā| tena `akārāntottrapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' (vā.156) ityetadupapannaṃ bhavati| `pañcapūlī' iti| `dvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīp| etadeva dvigoḥ strīprakaraṇe ṅībvidhānaṃ jñāpakam-- `kvacit striyāṃ dvigurbhāṣyate' iti| `pañcakhaṭvam, pañcakhaṭvī' iti| upasarjanahrasvatve kṛte pakṣe ṅīp| `pañcatakṣam, pañcatakṣī' iti| nalope kṛte pakṣe ṅīp|| 18. avyayībhāvaśca| (2.4.18) `adhistri' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā'vyayībhāvaḥ| `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvatvam| `unmattagaṅgam, lohitagaṅgam' iti| `anyapadārthe ca sañjñāyām' (2.1.21) iti samāsaḥ| pūrvavaddhrasvatvam| `pūrvapadārthapradhānasyāliṅgataiva prāptā' iti. adhistrītyādau pūrvapadasyāliṅgatvāt| `anyapadārthapradhānasyābhidheyaliṅtā' iti| unmattagaṅmityādau deśo'bhidheyaḥ, sa ca puṃlliṅga iti puṃlliṅgatvaṃ prāptam| `puṇyāham' iti| karmadhārayaḥ| `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91) iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ| `rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi' (2.4.29) iti pulliṅgatāyāṃ vacanam| `vipatham' iti| `pathaḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ' (vā. 161) iti paravalliṅgatāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanam| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) itaki samāsaḥ| `catuṣpatham' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| samāhāradvigau tu pūrveṇaiva siddham| `ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ|| 19. tatpuruṣo|ñanañkarmadhārayaḥ| nañmātrasya tatpuruṣasyābhāvannañātra nañsamāso lakṣyata ityāha-- `nañsamāsam' iti| `vakṣyati-vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyā' iti| anantarayogeyvasyādhikārasya prayojanaṃ nāstītyastānullaṅghya vyavahitasya `vibhāṣā senāsurā' (2.4.25) ityādiyogasyopanyāsaḥ| ita uttareṣvanantareṣu yogeṣvasya prayojananābhāvaḥ `na hi saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu tatpuruṣa nañsamāsaḥ, karmadhārayo vā'sti' ityādinā bhāṣye pratipāditaḥ| `dṛḍhasenaḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| athānañkarmadhāraya iti ko'yannirdeśaḥ ? yadi hyatra nañkarmadhārayayorvadandvaḥ, tadā samāhāre vā syāditaretarayoge vā ? tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe napuṃsakatvaṃ prasajyeta; itaratra tu dvivacanam| nirdeśasya sautratvādubhayathāpyadoṣaḥ| tathā hi-- cchandovat sūtrāṇi bhavantīti| chandasi ca liṅgavacanavyatyayaṃ tṛtīye'dhyāye vakṣyati || 20. saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu| (2.4.20) prakṛte na tadantavidhiriti prakṛtasya tatpuruṣasya kanyayā tadantavidhirvajñāyata ityāha-- `kanthāntastatpuruṣaḥ' iti| `sauśamikantham' iti| sauśamīnāṃ kanthā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `dākṣikanthā' iti| astīyaṃ grāmasya saṃjñā; na tūśīnareṣu kiṃ tarhi ? tato'nyatreti|| 21. upajñopakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām| (2.4.21) `upajñāyata ityupajñā' iti| `ātaścapasarge' (3.3.106) iti karmaṇyaṅa| `upakramyata ityupakramaḥ'| atra `akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19) iti karmaṇi ghañ| `nodāttopadeśasya' (7.3.34) ityādinā vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ| `yadyapyupajñeyasyopakramyasya ca' ityādi| upajñeyaḥ - parijñeyaḥ| upakramaḥ - upakramitavyaḥ| ādiḥ - prāthamyam| `pāṇinyupajñam' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tena tatprathamataḥ praṇītam| `akālam' iti| sa svasmin vyākaraṇe kālādhikāraṃ na kṛtavān| `vyāḍyupajñaṃ daśahuṣkaraṇam' iti| vyaḍirapyatra yugapatkālabhāvināṃ vidhīnāṃ madhye daśa huṣkaraṇāni kṛtvā paribhāṣitavān pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ kālamiti| vālmīkeḥ ślokā vālmīkiślokā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|| 22. chāyā bāhulye| (2.4.22) `pūrvapadārthadharmo bāhulyam' iti| atra hetumāha-- `śalabhādīnām'ityādi| śalabhādīnāṃ bahutvaṃ śalabhacchāyamityādau hi gamyate, na hi tena vinā chāyā sambhavati| ataḥ pūrvapadārthasya śalabhāderbāhulyaṃ dharmaḥ|| 23. sabhā rājā'manuṣyapūrvā| (2.4.23) `iha kasmānna bhavati-- rājasabhā' iti| `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā' (1.1.68) iti vacanadihaiva yuktaṃ bhavitumityabhiprāyaḥ| `tadayuktam' ityādi| etena `paryāyavacanasyaiveṣyate' (kā.vṛ.2.4.23) ityetadāptavacanena draḍhayati| yataḥ paryāyavacanasyaiveṣyate tasmādeva hetoridamuktam| `{jitparyāyavacanasyaiva-kāśikā| jaditparyāyavanasyaiva' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ paryāyavacanasyaiva bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ, yāvatā neha sūtre tathāvidhaṃ vacanamasti ? evaṃ manyate-- nanu ca pūrvagrahaṇamasti, ataḥ pūrvagrahaṇādeṣo'rtho labhyate, katham ? yadi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt `rājā'manuṣyāt' ityevaṃ brūyāt, pañcamyeva hi dikśabdamadhyāharayiṣyati, na ca sabhāntasya tatpuruṣasya pūrvaśabdādanyo dikśabdo'dhyāharttuṃ śakyata iti kiṃ pūrvagrahaṇena ? tat kriyate'rthagrahaṇaṃ yathā syāt| arthagrahaṇe ca satyarājā'manuṣyapūrvā iti dviṣpratiṣedho varṇyate-- arājapūrvā, amanuṣyapūrveti| tadanena nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) tatsadṛśā rājaparyāyā gṛhyante, na tu tadviśeṣāścandraguptādayaḥ, na hi te rājārthasya vācakā iti| atha vā-- arthagrahaṇe'smin `vibhāṣā samīpe' (2.4.16) ityato vibhāṣāgarhaṇamanuvarttate maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| teneha prayāyavacanasyaiveśvarādergrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, nānyasya| `amanuṣyaśabdo {hi-- vṛttau nāsti} hi rūḍhirūpeṇa rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣu varttate' iti| yadyevam, `anuṣyakarttṛke ca' (3.2.53) ityatra yadudāhariṣyati-- jāyāghnastilakālakaḥ, patighnī pāṇirekhā, śleṣmadhnaṃ madhu, pittaghnaṃ ghṛtamiti,tadvyāhanyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atra hi cakāra kriyate, tasyaiva vidheḥ samuccayārthaḥ| tena punarvidhānāt, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.ka113) iti vacanādvā rakṣaḥ piśācādibhyo'nyatrāpi bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- amanuṣyaśabdo'yaṃ dvividhaḥ-- astyevāyamavyutpanno yo rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣu varttate, asti ca vyutpanno nañsamāsaḥ; tatrehāvyutpannasya rūḍhiśabdasya grahaṇam| `amanuṣyakarttṛke ca'(3.2.53) ityatra vyutpannasyārūḍhiśabdasya grahaṇamityavirodhaḥ| `devadattasabhā' iti| devadattaśabdo na rājaparyāyaḥ; nāpyamanuṣyavacanaḥ|| 24. aśālā ca| (2.4.24) sabhāśabdo'yamastyeva kuṭīvacanaḥ-- kadīrghā sabhā,hrasvā sabheti| asti ca saṅaghātavacanaḥ, yathā-- brāhmaṇānāṃ sabhā, strīṇāṃ sabheti; iha cāśāleti kuṭīvacanapratiṣedhāditaro gṛhyata ityata āha-- `saṅghātavacanaḥ' ityādi|| 25. vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām| (2.4.25) `śvaniśam' iti| yasyāṃ niśāyāṃ śvāno mattā viharanti sā śvaniśam; śvaniśeti cocyata iti|| 26. kaparavalliṅgaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ| (2.4.26) kimarthamidam ? ihāyaṃ dvandvaḥ sravapadārthapradhānaḥ, sa yadā bhinnaliṅgavayavo bhavati tadā pūrvottarayoḥ padayorbhinnaliṅgayoranugrāhakamekaṃ liṅgaṃ nāsti yena samudāyo vyapadiśyate| ubhābhyāñca yugapadasambhavādaśakyo vyapadeśaḥ kartṛm| ataḥ paryāyaḥ syāditi dvandve niyamārthaṃ vacanam| tatpuruṣo'pi dvividhaḥ-- pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ, uttarapadārthapradhānaśceti| tato ya uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣastasya pradhānatvādeva parasya yalliṅagaṃ tatsamudāyasya bhaviṣyatīti taṃ pratyanarthakaṃ vacanam| yastu pūrvapadārthapradhānastasya pūrvapadasya yalliṅgaṃ tasmin prasakta uttarapadasya yalliṅgaṃ tadvidhīyata iti tatra vidhyarthametadbhavati| `dvandvasya tatpuruṣasya ca' iti| dvandvatatpuruṣayoriti ṣaṣṭhīyaparaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvāt| tathā ca mayūrīkukkuṭāvityatra pūrvapadasya strīpratyayo nivartteta, tatpuruṣe'pyarthapippalītyatra pūrvapadasyāpi strīpratyayaḥ syāt; tasmāta ṣaṣṭhīyam| tathā ca sati samāsārthasyāyamatideśo vijñāyate| pūrvapadsaya na pratiṣidhyate; nāpi vidhīyata iti na bhavati pūrvoktadoṣāvasaraprasaṅgaḥ| samāsārthasya liṅgātideśādanuprayogo'pi samāsārthasyaiva viśeṣaṇamiti talliṅgameva bhavati| ka`kukkuṭamayūryāvime' iti| upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ na bhavati, upasarjanasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt| uktaṃ hyetat prāk-- `upasarjanamiti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ prayojanamanvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta-- apradhānamupasarjanam' iti| dvandvaśca sarvapadārthapradhāna iti nāstyupasarjanasaṃjñā| ardhapippalītyādāvapi satyekavibhaktiyoge yathā pippalyāderupasarjanasaṃjñā na bhavati, tathopasarjanasaṃjñāvidhāveva tatpratipāditam| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `tatpuruṣaḥ' (2.4.19) ityanuvartamāne punastatpuruṣagrahaṇasyaitat prayojanam-- tatpuruṣaviśeṣasya paravalliṅgatā yathā syāditi. tena dviguprāptāpannalampūrvagatisamāseṣu paravalliṅgatā na bhavati; anyathā yadi sarvastheyaṃ tatpuruṣasya paravalliṅgatā syāt tadā `parakavalliṅgaṃ dvandvasya ca' ityevaṃ brūyāt| cakārāddhi prakṛtasya tatpuruṣasyeti vijñāsyata eveti| `pañcakapālaḥ' iti| taddhitārthe dviguḥ| saṃskṛtārtha utpannasyāṇaḥ `dvigorluganapatye'(4.1.88) iti luk| `prāptajīvikaḥ' iti| prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā' (2.2.4) iti samāsaḥ| `alañjīvikaḥ' iti| `paryādayo glānādyarthe caturthyā' (vā. 93) iti samāsaḥ| niṣkauśāmbiḥ' iti| `nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā' (vā.94) iti|| 27. pūrvavadaśvavaḍavau| (2.4.27) `aśvavaḍavayorvibhāṣaikavadbhāvo vihitaḥ'iti| `vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛga' (2.4.12) ityādinā| `arthātideśaścāyam, na nipātanam' iti| nipātane hi pūrvavaditi vacanamarthakaṃ syāt, aśvavaḍavāvityevaṃ brūyāt| tena `dvivacanamatantram' ityādinā'rthātideśasya phalaṃ darśayati| nipātane hi vacanāntare pūrvavalliṅgatā na syāt|| 28. hemantaśiśirāvahorātre ca cchandasi| (2.4.28) paravalliṅgatāpavādo'yaṃ yoga iti hemantaśiśirāvityatra napuṃsakatvāpavādaḥ, parasya śiśiraśabdasya napuṃsakatvāt| `ahorātre' iti| puṃlliṅgatvāpavādo'yam| `rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi' (2.4.29) iti puṃlliṅgatve prāpte chandasi liṅgavyatyaya ukta iti-- `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) ityanena|| 29. rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi| (2.4.29) `paravalliṅgatayā strīnapuṃsakayoḥ prāptayoḥ' iti| rātriśabdasya strīliṅgatvādahaḥ śabdasya ca napuṃsakatvāt| `dvirātraḥ' iti| dvayo rātryoḥ samāhāraḥ| `taddhitārtha' (2.1.51) ityādinā samāhāre dviguḥ| `ahaḥ sarvaikadeśasaṃkhyātapuṇyācca rātreḥ' (5.4.87) ityac samāsāntaḥ| atra hi `ac pratyanvavapūrvāt sāmalomnaḥ' (5.4.75) ityato'jityanuvarttate| `pūrvāhṇaḥ' iti|ra ahnaḥ pūrvamiti vigṛhya `pūrvāpara' (2.2.1) ityādinā samāsaḥ, `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91) iti ṭac, `ahno'hna etebhyaḥ' (5.4.88) ityahnādeśaḥ; `ahno'dantāt' (8.4.7) iti ṇatvam| `dvayahaḥ' iti| pūrvavat samāhāre dviguḥ| pūrvavat ṭac| `na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre' (5.4.89) iti pratiṣedhāvahnadeśo na bhavati| `ahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.145) iti ṭilopaḥ| `anuvākādayaḥ' iti| kecidāhaḥ-- bahuvrīhirayam, anukrānto vāko'nayānena vā'nuvākaḥ| strīliṅge napuṃsakaliṅge ca prāpte vacanam| anye ca manyante-- yo'yaṃ ghañ sa sāmarthyāt puṃlliṅgaḥ| tasya hi napuṃsake bhāve kto'pavādaḥ, striyāñca ktin| tenāsau sāmarthyāt puṃsyavāvatiṣṭhate| yastvakarttari kārake vidhīyate sa puṃsi napuṃsake ca varttate; bādhakābhāvāt| striyāntu na bhavati; yataḥ `striyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) ityakarttari ca kārake vidīyate, sa viśeṣavihito ghañaṃ bādhate| iha ca vaceḥ `akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19) iti ghañ vihitaḥ| anūcyate yat padaṃ tadanuvākaḥ| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| asmin pakṣe napuṃsake prāpte vacanam|| 30. apathaṃ napuṃsakam| (2.4.30) `apadham' iti| `patho vibhāṣā' (5.4.72) iti yadā samāsāntapratiṣedho nāsti tadā `ṛkpūrabdhūpathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| samāsāntanirdaśādyadā samāsānto nāsti tadā puṃlliṅgataiva bhavati-- apanthā iti|| 31. arddharcāḥ puṃsi ca| (2.4.31) arddharcā iti bahuvacananirdeśādādyartho gamyata ityāha-- `arddharcādayaḥ' ityādi| `śabdarūpāśrayā ceyam' iti| śabdarūpamāśrayo yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| śabdarūpamāśrityārthamanapekṣyadviliṅgateyaṃ vidhīyata ityarthaḥ| kriyāśabdasyābhidheyavalliṅgamiti bhūtaṃ kuṇḍam, bhūtā śāṭī, bhūto ghaṭa iti| yaugikasyābhidheyavalliṅgamiti lavaṇaṃ śākam, lavaṇā yavagūḥ, lavaṇaḥ sūpaḥ iti| lavaṇena saṃsṛṣṭamiti `saṃsṛṣṭe' (4.4.ka22) iti ṭhak| tasya `lavaṇālluk' (4.4.24) iti luk| ata eva taddhitārthayoge bhūtatvāt apūrvaśabdo'yaṃ dharmādharmayorvarttate| `tatsādhane' iti| adṛṣṭopārjanaṃ prati yasyāṅgabhāvaḥ sa tatsādhanamityarthaḥ, sa punaryāgādiḥ| karmaśabdo nakārānta evobhayaliṅga iti krama karmā ceti|| 32. idamo'nvādeśe'śanudāttastṛtīyādau| (2.4.32) `ādeśaḥ kathanam' iti| prathamataḥ pratipādanam, śabdena| `anavādeśo'nukatham' iti| paścātpratipādanam| tacca yādṛśamihābhipretaṃ tādṛśaṃ paścādvakṣyati| `ābhyāṃ chātrābhyām' ityādi| ādeśa eṣaḥ| `atho ābhyām' ityādyanvādeśaḥ eṣaḥ| athośabdenātrānvādeśa ucyate| nanu ca tyādādyatve kṛte hali lope (7.2.113) cātho ābhyāmityādirūpaṃ sidhyatyeva, tasmādanudāttameva kevalaṃ vidheyam, ādeśavacanaṃ tvanarthakamityata āha-- `ādeśavacanam' ityādi| `avyayasarvanāmnāmakac prāk ṭeḥ' (5.3.71) ityakaracpratyaye kṛte satyapi `anāpyakaḥ' (7.2.112) ityadhikārādidrūpasya lopo nāstītyastayādeśavacane rūpaṃ na sidhyati| nanu ca `hali lopaḥ' (7.2.113) ityanena halādāvidrūpasya lope'nenājādau yathā syādityavevamarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? naitadasti; sāmarthyāddhi halādāveva bhavitavyam, tatra smaibhāvādiṣu kṛteṣu| tasmāt sākackārthamādeśavacanam| sākackārthe cāsminnārabdhe śitkaraṇaṃ sarvādaśārtham; anyathā hyalo'ntsya syāt| prayojanābhāvānna bhaviṣyatīti cet, na; akārasya tvakāravacanaṃ dīrghādeśanivṛttyrathaṃ vijñāyate| athānudāttavacanaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `ūḍidampadādyappumraidyubhyaḥ' (6.1.171) iti vibhakterudāttatve kṛte `ānudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (6.1.158) iti prakṛteranudāttatvaṃ bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; savibhaktyarthamanudāttavacanam, savibhaktikasyānudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| tena sarvānudāttamevābhyāmiti padamanvādeśe bhavati| yadi paścāduccāraṇamātramanvādeśastadeha kasmānna bhavati-- devadattaṃ bhojaya, imañca yajñadattamiti ? asti hyatrāpyanvādeśaḥ, tataśca `dvitīyāṭaussvenaḥ' (2.4.34) ityenādeśaḥ prāpnotītyata āha-- `neha paścāduccāraṇamātram' ityādi| `teneha na bhavati' iti| na hyatraikasyābhidheyasya pūrvaṃ śabdena pratipāditasya dvitīyaṃ pratipādanam, kiṃ tarhi ? abhidheyāntarasya| tathāhi pūrvaṃ devadattasya pratipādanam, uttarakālaṃ yajñadattasya| kathaṃ punarayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatāpaścāduccāraṇamātre'nvādeśaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ, na ca sāmānyaśabdaḥ śabdāntasannidhānādikaramanteraṇa viśeṣe'vatiṣṭhate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmāt `vibhāṣā senā' (2.4.25) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenaivaṃvidhaviṣaya evānvādeśo'tra grahītavyaḥ, nānvādeśamātram| tasamādviśiṣṭasyānvādeśasya grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ| yadapi ca vakṣyati tatra-- `yatra kiñcidvidhāya' ityādi, tadapīmameva nyāyaṃ hṛdi kṛtveti boddhavyam|| 33. etadastratasostratasau cānudāttau| (2.4.33) `atho atra' iti| `saptamyāstral' (5.3.10)| `atho ataḥ' iti| `pañcamyāstasil' (5.3.7)| `punarvacanamanudāttārtham' iti| `etado'ś' (5.3.5) iti yaḥ pāñcamiko'śādeśaḥ sa udāttaḥ syāt| anudāttataśceṣyata ityanudāttārtha vacanam| atha tratasoriti kimartham, yāvatā `tratasau cānudāttau' iti vacanāt tayoreva nimittabhāvo vijñāsyate ? naitadasti; anvācayo'pi vijñāyeta, yathā-- `karttuḥ kyaṅa salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti| atrāviśeṣeṇa kyaṅa bhavati| tathā'trāviśeṣeṇa tāvadaśādeśo bhavati| yatra tu tratasau dṛśyete tatra tāvanudāttau bhavataḥ, tasmāt tāvannimitabhāvārthaṃ tratasoritivaktavyam| atha tratasoranudāttatvaṃ kimartham, yāvatā litsvara eva tayoranudāttatvaṃ kariṣyati ? naitadasti; na hyatra litsvaro'sti, anudāttasyādeśasya vidhānāt| nanu ca litasvare kṛta ādeśasvaraḥ kriyate; yadyevam, litsvarāpavāda ādeśasvaro vijñāyeta, na cāpavādaviṣayamanutsargo'bhiniviśate ? tasmādyathā goṣpadapramityatra liti pūrvamanudāttabhāvo nāstīti prattayayasvara eva bhavati; tathehāpi syāditi tratasoranudāttārtha vacanam| tataścaitadapi sarvamanudāttaṃ padaṃ bhavati| tāviti vaktavye tratasoriti vacanaṃ spaṣṭārtham| goṣapadapramiti| `yāvati vindarajīvoḥ' (3.4.30)| `carmodayoḥ pūreḥ' (3.4.31)| `varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścādanyatarasyām' (3.4.32) iti ṇamul, ūlopaśca|| 34. dvidīyāṭaussvena| (2.4.34) `idametadoḥ' ityādi| nanu cānantaratvādetada evātrānuvṛttiḥ prāpnoti, nedamaḥ; vyavahitatvādityata āha-- `maṇ‍ḍūkaplutinyāyena' ityādi| `ekamevedaṃ vidhānam' iti| ayaṃ daṇḍa ityanena daṇḍasya sattopalakṣaṇamātraṃ kṛtvā `harānena' ityanenaiva haraṇakriyāṃ prati daṇḍasya karaṇabhāvo nirdiśyata ityekaṃ vidhānam| `etamātaṃ ṅitaṃ vidyāt' ityatrāpi `īṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādābhividhau ca yaḥ' (ma.bhā.1.71) itīṣadādyarthasyākārasya nirdeśāmātraṃ kṛtvā `etamātaṃ ṅitaṃ vidyāt' ityanena vedanakriyāṃ pratyākāramātrasya karmabhāva eva vidhīyata ityekameva vidhānam|| 35. ārdhadhātuke| (2.4.35) `dadhyāt' iti| āśiṣi liṅa| `liṅāśiṣi' (3.4.116) ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñā| `hanyāt' iti| `vidhinimantraṇa' (3.3.161) ityādinā liṅa| `viṣayasaptamī ceyam' iti| yadi parasaptamī syāt tadā bhavyamityādi na siddhyati| tathā hi-- halantatvādastyādīnām `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) iti ṇyati kṛte tasmin parataḥ `asterbhūḥ' (2.4.52), `ajervyaghañapoḥ' (2.4.56) `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ' (2.4.54) ityete ādeśāḥ syutaḥ| tatra dvayorvṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ tṛtīyasya yuki kṛte bhāvyaṃ pravaiyamākhyāyyamityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| viṣayasaptamyāṃ tvasyāmārddhadhātukatve vivakṣite prāgeva pratyayotpatterādeśāḥ syuḥ| tato'jantatvāt `aco yat' (3.1.97) iti yati `īdyati' (6.4.65) itītve kṛte sarveṣāṃ guṇe'styādeśasya `dhātostannimittasyaiva' (6.1.80) ityavādeśe ca bhavyaṃ praveyamākhyeyamiti siddhyati| tasmādviṣayasaptamīyam, na parasaptamī| kathaṃ punarviṣayasaptamīyaṃ labhyate, yāvatā `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti paribhāṣopasthānāt parasaptamyeva nyāyyā, na viṣayasaptamī ? naitadasti; `ārdhadhātuke' (2.4.35) iti sāmānyanirdeśāt, na ca sāmānye paurvāparyamasti| buddhyā paurvāparyamastīti cet ? naivam; evaṃ hi gauravaṃ syāt| atha vā-- `aco yat' (3.1.97) ityajgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-- viṣayasaptamīyamiti| `paścādyathāprāptam' ityādi| ādeśeṣu kṛteṣūttarakālaṃ yo yataḥ prāpnoti sa tato bhavatītyarthaḥ|| 36. ado jagdhirlyapti kiti| (2.4.36)| `prajagghya' iti| `samānakarttṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle' (3.4.21) iti ktvā| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap' (7.1.37)| `jagdhaḥ' iti| `jhaṣastathorddho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti takārasya dhakāraḥ| `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvam-- dhakārasya dakāraḥ| `jharo jhari savarṇe' (8.4.65) iti lopaḥ| atheha `idito num dhātoḥ' (7.1.58) iti num kasmānna bhavatītyata āha-- `ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ' iti| yathā-- `ada bhakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1011) ityatrākāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, tathehāpīkāro veditavyaḥ| atha lḍagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, ti kitītyevaṃ siddham ? na sidhyati; yasmāt ktvāpratyayasya paratvāllyavādeśaḥ prāpnoti, naitadasti; antaraṅgatvājjagdhyādeśena bhavitavyam| antaraṅgatvantu tasyaikapadāśrayatvāt| lyabādeśasya tu bahiraṅgatvam; samāsāśrayatvāt; samāsasya cānekapadāśrayatvāt| evaṃ tarhi-- jagdhau siddhe'ntaraṅgatvāt ti kiti yallyabujyate| (taj) jñāpayatyantaraṅgāṇāṃ lyapā bhavati bādhanam||iti| tena dadhāteḥ, jahāteśca saṃpūrvādvipūrvācca ktvāpratyaye kṛte `dyatisyatimāsthāmiti kiti' (7.4.40) ityatasti kitītyanuvarttamāne `dadhāterhiḥ' (7.4.42) `jahāteśca ktvi' (7.4.43) iti hirādeśo lyabādeśaṃ bādhitvaṃ prāptaḥ| asmādeva jñāpakāllyapā bādhitatvānna bhavati-- saṃdhāya, vihāyeti| evaṃ nirdāya durdāyeti `do dad ghoḥ' (7.4.46) iti dadādeśo na bhavati| prasthāyetyatra `dyatisyātimāsthāmitita kiti' (7.4.40) itītvaṃ na bhavati| prakhanya prakhāyeti `janasanakhanāṃ sañjaloḥ' (6.4.42) iti nityamāttvaṃ na bhavati, `ye vibhāṣā' (6.4.43) iti vibhāṣaiva bhavati| tatra hi `vihvanoranunāsikasyāt' (6.4.41) ityata ādgrahaṇanuvarttate| `prakramya' iti `kramaśca ktvi' (6.4.18) iti dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati| tatra hi `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111) ityato dīrghagrahaṇam, `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) ityato jhalgrahaṇaṃ kṅiti cānuvarttate| āpṛcchyeti `cchvoḥ śūjanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) iti śakāro na bhavati| pradīvyetyatrānenaiva sūtreṇoṭh na bhavati| `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvam| prapaṭhyetyatra `ārddhadhātukasya' (7.2.35) itīḍ na bhavati|| 37. luṅasanorghaslṛ| (2.4.37) `aghasat' iti| lṛdittvāt puṣādisūtreṇa (3.1.55) cleraṅgādeśaḥ| `jighatsati' iti| `saḥ syārddhadhātuke' (7.4.49) iti sakārasya takāraḥ| `ghaslṛbhāve'cyupasaṃkhyānam' iti| ghaslṛbhāve karttavye'ci tasyopasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena ghaslṛbhāve'cyapi bhavati| `praghasaḥ' iti| pacādyac|| 38. ghañapośca| (2.4.38) `ghāsaḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ| `praghasaḥ' iti| `upasarge'daḥ' (3.3.59) ityap| `luṅasanghañpsu ghaslṛ' ityekayoge karttavye yogavibhāgo vaicitryārthaḥ|| 39. bahulaṃ chandasi| (2.4.39) `ghastām' iti| laṅa, tasastām, ādādikatvācchapo luk| `bahulaṃ chandasyāmāṅyoge'pi' (6.4.75) ityahāgamābhāvaḥ| atha vā luṅyudāharaṇametat| `mantre ghasahvara' (2.4.80) ityādinā clerluk| `sagdhiḥ' iti| striyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94)| `ghasibhasorhali ca' (6.4.100) ityupadhalopaḥ| `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sakāralopaḥ| atha tu sico'nena lopo vidhīyate tadā cchāndasī varṇalopo draṣṭavyaḥ-- yathā iṣkarttāramadhvara iti| pūrvavat takārasya dhakāraḥ| ghakārasya jaśtvam‌| samānā gdhiriti `pūrvāparaprathama' (2.1.58) ityādinā samāsaḥ, `samānasya cchandasyamūrddhaprabhṛkatyudarkeṣu' (6.3.84) iti sabhāvaḥ| `attām' iti| `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sico lopaḥ| tasastām| `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti dakārasya takāraḥ| atha vā laṅyudāharaṇametat| atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇameva kasmānna kriyate ityucyate kaḥ punarevaṃ sati guṇe bhavatīti paryanuyogamāśaṅkyāha-- `tadevottarārthamapi bhaviṣyati' iti| etenehānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe satyuttarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavatītīmaṃ guṇaṃ darśayati| tarhīhaivānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamuttarasūtre'nuvartiṣyate| yadi punaruttarasūtre bahulagrahaṇamanuvartteta tadā kiṃ syāt ? anyadapi kiñcita kāryaṃ bhavatītyāśaṅkyeta| kvacidanyadevetyeṣo'pyartho hi bahulagrahaṇasyābhīṣṭa eva| `ghastāmityatropadhālopo na bhavati' iti| `ghasibhasorhali ca' (6.4.100) iti prāptaḥ| sa bahulagrahaṇānna bhavati|| 40. liṭyanyatarasyām| (2.4.40) `liṭi parataḥ' iti| nanu ca `ārdhadhātuke' (2.4.35) iti varttate, `ārdhadhātuke' iti ca viṣayasaptamīyamityuktam, tadayuktaṃ liṭi parata iti vacanam ? nedamayuktam; ārdhadhātukaśabdasyārdhadhātukatvamanekapratyayasādhāraṇaṃ sāmānyamarthaḥ, tena ca paurvāparyaṃ na sambhavati| taddhi deśato vā bhavati kālato vā, sāmānyasya cādeśatvāt kālatvānnityatvācca tena saha deśakṛtaṃ kālakṛtañca paurvāparyaṃ nopapadyate, ato yuktā `ārdhadhātuke' iti viṣayasaptamī| iha tu `liṭi' ityārdhadhātuka upāttaḥ, sambhavati cānena paurvāparyam| kiñca-- liṭi rabhūte ghaslṛ- ādeśe vidhīyamāne na kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| tasmāt parasaptamyevaiṣā yuktā| `jakṣatuḥ' iti| `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ, `śāsivasighasīnāñca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam| `āda, ādatuḥ, `āduḥ' iti| `ata ādeḥ' (7.4.70) ityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ| nanu ca `ghaslṛ adane' (dhā.pā.715) ityetasya jāghāsa, jakṣatuḥ, jakṣuriti bhaviṣyati; `ada bhakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.ta1011) ityasya āda, ādatuḥ, āduriti; asti ghasiḥ prakṛtyantaram, `sṛghasyadaḥ kmarac' (3.2.160) iti kmarajvidhānāt, tat kathamiha liṭi vikalpavidhānam ? ghaseḥ prakṛtyantarasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārtham| tena tasya sārvadhātuka ārdhadhātuke ca yatra liṅgaṃ nāsti vacanañca, tatra prayogo na bhavati|| 41. veño vayiḥ| (2.4.41) `ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ' iti| nānubandhaḥ| tena num na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `uvāya' iti| `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām' (6.1.17) iti samprasāraṇam| `ūyatuḥ, ūyuḥka' ityatrāpi grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam| atha yakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `liṭi vayo yaḥ' ityādi| `veña iti samprasāraṇaṃ na bhavati' iti| vacyādisūtreṇa prāptam `veñaḥ' (6.1.40) iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati| tatra hi `na samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam' (6.1.37) ityato neti varttate| uvāya ityādi rūpaṃ vayerātmanepaditvānna siddhyatīti sūtrārambhaḥ|| 42. hano vadha liṅi| (2.4.42) `akārāntaścāyamādeśaḥ' iti| kuta etat ? śailīyamācāryasya yatreha prakaraṇe vyañjanānta ādeśaḥ, tatroccāraṇārthamikāraṃ karoti, yathā--jagdhirityādau| tasmādikārāntākaraṇādakārānto'yamādeśa iti vijñāyate| `halantalakṣaṇā' iti| `vadavrajahalantasyācaḥ' (7.2.3) ityanena yā vṛddhirvidhīyate sā halantalakṣaṇā| 43. luṅi ca| (2.4.43) `ātmanepadeṣu luṅi vikalpo yathā syālluṅi mā bhūt' iti| anena yogavibhāgasyottarārthatāṃ darśayati| ekayoge hi sati liṅo'pyuttaratrānuvṛttestatrāpyātmanepadeṣu vikalpaḥ syāt|| 44. ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām| (2.4.44) `āvadhiṣṭa' iti| `āṅo yamahanaḥ' (1.3.28) ityātmanepadam| `āphadhiṣata' iti| `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityavādeśaḥ| `āhata' iti| `hanaḥ sic' (1.2.14) iti kittvam, `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinā'nunāsikalopaḥ, `hrasvādaṅgāt' (8.2.27) iti sico lopaḥ|| 45. iṇo gā luṅi| (2.4.45) `agāt' iti| `gatisthā' (2.4.77) ityādinā sico luk| `aguḥ' iti| `ātaḥ' (3.4.110) iti jherjusa, `usyapadāntāt' (6.1.96) iti pararūpatvam| `luṅīti varttamāne' ityādi| `luṅi ca' (2.4.43) ityota luṅagarhaṇe'nuvarttamāne yatpunaḥ luṅagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tasyaitataprayojanam-- parasmaipadeṣvapi yathā syāt| nityañcātmanepadeṣu| etenaitaddarśayati-- pūrvakaṃ hi luṅagrahaṇamātmanepadagrahaṇenānyatarasyāgrahaṇena ca sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tayorapyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tathā cātmanepadaṣveva vikalpenādeśaḥ syāt| tasmādaviśeṣeṇa, nityañca yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punarluṅagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| `agāyi' iti| `ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (3.1.66) iti ciṇ| `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk| `ciṇo luk'(6.4.104) iti takārasya luk| `iṇvadika iti vaktavyam' iti| yatheṇo gādeśo luṅi bhavati, tathā `ik smaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1047) ityasyāpi bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.39) ityato bahulagrahaṇamanuvarttate maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena| teneko'pi luṅi gādeśo bhaviṣyatīti|| 46. ṇau gamirabodhane| (2.4.46) `gamayati' iti. `janījṝṣknasurañjo'mantāśca' (dhā.pā.ga.sū.817) iti mittvāt hrasvatvam|| 47. sani ca| (2.4.47) `jigamiṣati' iti| `gameriṭ parasmaipadeṣu' (7.2.58) itīṭ| `pratīṣiṣati' iti| `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti `sanyaṅoḥ' (6.1.9) ityanena sa ityasya dvarvacanam| `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itīttvam| upasargekārasya dhātorikāreṇa saha `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101)| `iṅaśca' (2.4.48) ityādinā yogavibhāgasyottarārthatāṃ darśayati| ekayoge hi ṇerapyuttaratrānuvṛttiḥ syāt, tataśca tatrāpyayamādeśaḥ prasajyeta|| 48. iṅaśca| (2.4.48) `adhijigāṃsate' iti| `pūrvavat sanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam| `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ|| 49. gāṅ liṭi| (2.4.49) `adhijage' iti| `liṭastajhayoreśirec' (3.4.81) ityeś| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| gā ityetasya dvirvacanam| nanu liṭi parabhūte taśabdasya paratvāt pragevaiśādeśena bhavitavyam; paścāt gāṅādeśena, tataśca dvirvacane nimitte'cyayaṃ gāṅādeśa iti `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti sthānivadbhāvādivarṇasya dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, tatkathaṃ gā ityetasya dvarvacanam ? naitadasti; yasmāt liṇmātrāpekṣatvāt gāṅādeśo'ntaraṅgaḥ, liḍādeśaviśeṣāśrayatvādeśādeśo bahiraṅagaḥ, tasmādantaraṅgatvādeśādeśāt prāgeva gāṅgādeśena bhavitavyam, tataśca dvirvacananimittenāyamacyajādeśa iti sthānivadbhāvo na bhavati, tatkuta ivarṇasya dvirvacanaprasaṅgaḥ| `gāṅo'nubandhakaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇārtham' iti| gāṅakuṭādisūtre (1.2.1) `gāṅakuṭādibhyaḥ' ityucyamāne `kai gai śabde' (dhā.pā.916,917) ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt, tataścāgāsīnnaṭa ityatra grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? yena hetunā na bhavati sa heturgāṅkuṭādisūtre eva darśitaḥ| nanu ceṅo ṅitastatra sthānivadbhāvenaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, tatkiṃ ṅakāreṇetyata āha-- `na hi' ityādi| tatra hi gāṅityetasya svarūpasya grahaṇam| na ca tat sthānivadbhāvena labhyate| kiṃ tarhi ? kāryam| yasmāt `sthānivadādeśaḥ' (1.1.56) iti kāryātideśo'yam, na rūpātideśaḥ|| 50. vibhāṣā luṅlṛṅoḥ| (2.4.50) `adhyaiṣṭa' iti| `āḍajādīnām' (6.4.72) ityāṭ| `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhi | 51. ṇau ca saṃścaṅoḥ| (2.4.51) `ṇāvitīṅapekṣayā' ityādi| ṇāvitīyaṃ yā parasaptamīṅapekṣayā sā| `saṃścaṅoḥ' itīyaṃ yā parasaptamī sā ṇyapekṣayetyarthaḥ| `adhijigāpayiṣati' iti| ṇic| `artihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk, san, iṭ, guṇāyādeśau| adhyāpipayiṣati' iti| `krīṅajīnāṃ ṇau' (6.1.48) ityāttvam, puk, `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti `pā' ityasya dvirvacanam| `adhyajīgapat' iti| `ṇiśri' (3.1.48) ityādinā caṅa| `ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ' (7.4.1)| `sanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) iti sanvadbhāvāt `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itīttvam| `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) itī dīrghaḥ|| 52. asterbhūḥ| (2.4.52) `īhāmāsa' iti| īhateḥ `ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ' (3.1.36) ityām| `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti lerluk; `kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi' (3.1.40) ityasterliṭparasyānuprayogaḥ| `pratyāharagrahaṇenāstergrahaṇasāmarthyāt' iti| `kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi' (3.1.40) ityatra kṛñiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam, `abhūtatadbhāve kṛbhvastiyoge sampadyakartari' (5.4.50) iti kṛśabdādārabhya `kṛño dvitīyatṛtīyaśambabījāt' (5.4.58) ityākṛño ñakārāt| tena ca pratyāhāragrahaṇenāsterapi grahaṇam; tasyaitadeva prayojanam-- āseteyatadanuprayoge rūpaṃ yathā syāditi| yadi cāsteranuprayoge'pi bhūbhāvaḥ syāt, tadāsetyetadanuprayoge rūpaṃ na syāditi pratyāhāragrahaṇamanarthakam| tataśca`kṛbhvanuprayujyate liṭi' ityevaṃ brūyāt| tatrāpyayamarthaḥ-- kimidaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇamuta karoterityeva sandehaḥ parihṛto bhavati, kṛtañca pratyāhāragrahaṇam, tasmāt pratyāhāragrahaṇasāmarthyādanuprayoge'pi bhūbhāvo'sterna bhavati| `tathā cocyate' ityādinā'nantaroktamevārthamāptavacanena draḍhayati| bhūriti dīrghoccāraṇaṃ niṣṭhāyāṃ hrasvaśravaṇaṃ mā bhūt-- bhūto bhūtavāniti, asteriti śtipā nirdeśo'syatermā bhūt; naitadasti, niranubandhaka(vyā.pa.53) pirabhāṣayaivāsyaterna bhaviṣyati| tasya hyukāro'nubandhaḥ `idito vā' (7.2.56) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ kṛtaḥ| astestvakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, nānubandhaḥ| evaṃ tarhi śtipā nirdeśo vaicitryārtha ityeke| niranubandhakaparibhāṣāyāḥ pratyayavidhiviṣayatvādityapare|| 53. bruvo vaciḥ| (2.4.53) `vaktā' iti| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam| `ūce' iti| vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprāsāraṇam|| 54. cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ| (2.4.54) `nityamātmanepadaṃ na bhavati' iti| yadi hi syāt, akārānubandhakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmāt kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale vivakṣita ātmanepadaṃ syānnānyatra| `kśādirapi' iti| kakāraśakārayorakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| k‌ś khyāñityevaṃrūpa ādeśo vaktavyaḥ| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pyevaṃvidha ādeśo labhyate ? pūrvoktasya bahulagrahaṇasyānuvṛtteḥ| ata e bahulagrahaṇasyānuvṛttervarjane'sanayoścādeśapratiṣedho bhavatīti vyākhyānaṃ karttavyam| `saṃcakṣyā' iti| `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124)| `nṛcakṣā' iti| `sarvadhātubhyo'sun' (da.u.9.49), `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| `vicakṣaṇaḥ' iti| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti karttari lyuṭ| `bahulam' ityādi| saṃjñāyāṃ chandasi ca jagdhyādeśādikāryaṃ bahulaṃ na bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimartham ? annādyartham| annādayaḥ śabdā sādhavo yathā syuḥ| vyākhyānantu tadeva bahulagrahaṇamāśritya karttavyam| `annam' iti| ado jagdhirādeśo na bhavati; bahulagrahaṇasya siṃhāvalokitanyāyenānuvṛtteḥ| `vadhaka' iti| `hano vadha' (2.4.42) ityādinā vadhādeśo liṅyuṭacyamāno hanterṇvulpratyaye kṛte'pi bhavati| `gātram' iti| auṇādikaḥ ṣṭran| `iṇo gā luṅi' (2.4.45) iti luṅyucyamāno gādeśo'trāpi bhavati. ` vicakṣaṇaḥ' iti| cakṣiṅa khyāñādeśo na bhavati lyuṭi| ajiraśabdastu `ajiraśiśiraśithira' (da.u.8.27) iti kiracpratyayānta auṇādiko nipātitaḥ| tasyāta eva nipātanāt `ajeghañapoḥ' (2.4.56) iti vidhīyamāno vībhāvo na bhavati| ādiśabdena `praghasa' ityādergrahaṇam|| 55. vā liṭi| (2.4.55) 56. ajervyaghañapoḥ| (2.4.56) `pravāyakaḥ' iti| ṇval| `pravayaṇīyam' iti| anīyar| `kṛtyacaḥ' (8.4.29) iti ṇatvam| `ghañapoḥ pratiṣedhe kyapa upasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam' iti| ghañapoḥ karttavye kyapaḥ pratiṣedhasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| kyapaḥ pratiṣedhanimittatvena pratiṣedhaṃ prati sambandhitvena vivakṣitatvāt kyapa iti ṣaṣṭhī| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `saṃjñāyāṃ samajanipatamanavida' (3.3.99) ityādinā saṃjñāyāṃ gamyamānāyāmajeḥ kyap vidhāsyate| niyatavarṇānupūrvīkā ca saṃjñā bhavati, na cādeśe kṛte saṃjñā gamyate, tasmāt saṃjñāyāṃ vidhānāt kyapi vībhāvo na bhavati| `valādāvarddhadhātuke vikalpa iṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate ? ajerudāttatvāt, sa hīḍartho dhātuṣūdāttaḥ paṭhyate| yadi cāsya nityaṃ vībhāvaḥ syāt, tadā tasyodāttapāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| na hi vībhāve vihita iṭ prāpnoti;tasyānudāttatvāt| 57. vā yau| (2.4.57) `yu' iti lyuṭo grahaṇam' iti| anyasyāsambhavāt| `pravayaṇo daṇḍaḥ' iti| prājyate'neneti karaṇe lyuṭ| pūrvavaṇṇatvam|| 58. ṇyakṣattriyārṣañito yūni lugaṇiñoḥ| (2.4.58) `ṇyādayo gotrapratyayāḥ' iti| `gotrādyūnyastriyām' (4.1.94) iti gotrapratyayāntādeva yuvapratyayavidhānāt| `tasmādyūnīñ' iti| `ata iñ' (4.1.95) ityanena| `kauravyaśabdastikādiṣu paṭhyate' iti| aurasaśabdādanantaram| `kṣatriyagotrasya tatra grahaṇam' iti| aurasaśabdena kṣatriyagotrapratyayāntena sāhacaryāt| aurasaśabdo hi janapadaśabdāt kṣattriyādañ (4.1.168) iti kṣattriyagotrapratyayāntaḥ|| `ṛṣyaṇ' iti| `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca' (4.1.114) ityanena| `kurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ' iti| vamarathyaśabdaṃ vyutpādayati| tasmāt `kaṇvādibhyogotre iti śaiṣiko'ṇ' iti| nanu ca vāmarathyaśabdaḥ kurvādiṣu paṭhyate, na kaṇvādiṣu, tatkathamevamuktam ? yadyapi na paṭhyate, tathāpi vāmarathyasya kaṇvādivat svaravarjamiti pāṭhāt kaṇvādivadbhāvo'sti, ata evamuktamityadoṣaḥ| `dākṣāyaṇaḥ' iti| `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak| `abrāhmaṇagotramātrāt' iti| iha kaiściduktam-- `aṇiñorluki kṣatriyagotramātrādyuvapratyayasyopasaṃkhyānam' iti| teṣāṃ vaiśyagotrānna prāpnoti; tasmādvaiśyagotrādapi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ mātragrahaṇam| brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ hi gotrāṇi sambhavanti, tatra brāhmaṇagotraṃ varjayitvā'nyataḥ sarvasmādbhavati| pūrvake tu vākye'tadrājādapi kṣatriyagotrādyathā syādityevamarthaṃ mātragrahaṇam| tathā hi `aṇiñorluki tadrājādyupratyayasyopasaṃkhyān' darśayati| `bhāṇḍījaṅghiḥ' ityevamādinā vaiśyagotrodāharaṇam| brāhmaṇagotrapratiṣedhādiha na bhavati--dākṣāyaṇa iti| `śālvāvayavalakṣaṇaḥ' iti| kṣatriyagotarmadhikṛtyedamuktam| bhāṇḍījaṅghirityatra vaiśyagotre `ata iñ' (4.1.95) ityaneneñeva bhavatīti veditavyam| `pailādidarśanāt siddham' iti| pailāderākṛtigaṇatvāt tatrete draṣṭavyā iti darśayati|| 59. pailādibhyaśca| (2.4.59) `pīlāyā vetyaṇ' iti| tatra hi `śivādibhyo'ṇ' (4.1.112) ityato'ṇgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `anye pailādayaḥ iñantāḥ' iti| atraudañciśabdo bāhvāditvādiñantaḥ| bāhvādiṣu hyudañcuśabdaḥ paṭhyate| ukāroccāraṇamatantram| dhātupradarśanārthatvāt| udañcatīti `ṛtvik' (3.2.59) ityādinā sūtreṇa kvin| udaco'patyamaudañciḥ| nipātanāt `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityādinā nalopo na bhavati, `acaḥ' (6.4.138) ityakāralopaśca| bhauliṅgiśabdaḥ śālvāvayava iñantaḥ| śeṣāstu `ata iñ' (4.1.95) itīñantā veditavyāḥ| śālaṅkiriti paṭhyate, sa katham, yāvatā naḍādiṣu `śalaṅku śalaṅkañca' (ga.sū.67) iti pāṭhāt śālaṅkāyana ita bhavitavyam ? prakṛtyantaraṃ śalaṅkuśabdo'sti, tato'yamiñ vihita ityeke| asmādeva nipātanācchalaṅkuśabdādiñiti vijñāyate, tatsanniyoge ca śalaṅkādeśa ityapare| `tadrājāccāṇaḥ' iti| tadrājasaṃjñakāccāṇa uttarasya yuvapratyayasya lug bhavati| aṅgasyāpatyamiti `dvayañmagadha' (4.1.170) iti phiñ, tasyānena luk|| 60. iñaḥ prācām| (2.4.60) anyatra prāggrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthaṃ dṛṣṭam, ata ihāpi vikalpo mā vijñāyītyāha-- `gotraviśeṣaṇam' ityādi|| 61. na taulvalibhyaḥ| (2.4.61) taulvalyādiṣvāntarahātiśabdaḥ pauṣkarasādiśabdaśca bāhvādī iñantau| bāhvādiṣu hyantarahacchabdaḥ puṣkarasacchabdasya paṭhyete; atrobhayapadavṛddhikaścānuraśatikāditvāt| śeṣāstu `ata iñ' (4.1.95) iti iñantāḥ|| 62. tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām| (2.4.62) `bahuṣu varttamānasya' iti| bahuṣvartheṣu varttamānasyetyarthaḥra| atha `bahuvacane parataḥ' ityevaṃ kasmānna vyākhyāyate ? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; yataḥ saṃkhyāvācī bahuśabdo na bahuvacanavācī| yadi tu `bahuvacane parataḥ' ityayamartho'trābhimataḥ syāt, astriyāmiti pratiṣedhe na kuryāt; prāptyabhāvāt| na hi tadrājāntadutpannena strīpratyayena vyavahite bahuvacane parato lukaḥ prāptirasti| kiñca, attraya ityatra bahucane parato luki vidhīyamāne udāttanivṛttisvaraḥ prasajyeta| katham ? attrerapatyāni bahūnīti `itaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti ḍhaki tasya `taddhitasya', `kitaḥ' (6.1.164,165) ityantodāttattatve kṛte bahuvacane jasi parataḥ `attribhṛgukutsavasiṣṭha' (2.4.65) ityādinā luki kṛte `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) iti vibhakterudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti| tasmāt bahuṣu vartmānasyetyayamevārthaḥ| bahuṣviti ca tadrājāntasya viśeṣaṇam, na tadrājasya; anyathā hi dvandve doṣaḥ prasajyeta-- āṅgaśca vāṅgaśca sauhmaścā'ṅgavāṅgasuhmā ityatra huṅ na syāt; na hyatra tadrājo bahuṣu varttate| tadantastu varttate, yugapadadhikaraṇavacano hi dvandva iti kṛtvā| tasmāt tadrājāntasyaivedaṃ viśeṣaṇam, na tadrājasya| `tadrājasaṃjñakasya pratyayasya bahuṣu varttamānasyāstrīliṅgasya lugbhavati' ityayaṃ tu vṛttigrantha evamunneyaḥ-- bahuṣu varttamānasyāstrīliṅgasya tadrājāntasya yaḥ sambandhī tadrājasaṃjñakaḥ pratyayastasya tadrājasaṃjñakasya pratyayasya lugbhavati| katham ? tadrājāntasyaivaitat sāmarthyaṃ labdham| na hyatadrājāntasya tadrājasaṃjñakaḥ pratyayaḥ sambandhī bhavati| sūtre'pyantagrahaṇaṃ na kṛtam; pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayaiva tadanta sya labdhatvāt| tathāpi pratyayāntasya lugucyamānaḥ pratyayamātrasyaiva vijñāyate; `pratyayasya lukślulupaḥ' (1.1.61) iti pratyayādaśanasyaiva luksaṃjñāvidhānāt| `tenaiva cet' iti| tadrājapratyayāntenaivetyarthaḥ| `aṅgāḥ, vaṅgāḥ, suhmāḥ' iti| aṅgasyāpatyāni bahuni| `dvayañmagadha' (4.1.170) ityādinā'ṇ, tasya luk| `lohadhvajāḥ, vrīhimantaḥ' iti| `pūgāñ‍ñyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt' (5.3.112) iti ñyapratyayaḥ, tasya luk| `aupagavāḥ' iti| `prāgdīvyato'ṇa' (4.1.83) `priyavāṅgāḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| nātra tadrājapratyayena bahutvaṃ kiṃ tarhi ? samāsena| na cāsau tadrājapratyayāntaḥca tatastadrājasyāvihitatvāt| tadyevam, dvandvo'pi, tadrājapratyayānto na bhavatīti tatrāpi luṅa na syāt ? naitat ; yadi dvandvo'pi tadrājapratyayānto na bhavati, tathāpi pratyekaṃ dvandvāvayavāstadrājapratyayāntā gahvarthāśceti tatra bhavatyeva luka| na ca bahuṣvityarthagrahaṇam, yaśca bahvarthastatrāvaśyameva tatkṛtena bahutvena bhavitavyam, tatkiṃ tenaivetyanena ? evaṃ manyate-- antaraṅgatvāt tadrājapratyayotpattivelāyāṃ yadbahutvamupajāyate tadeva yadi gṛhyate, na tu tatpadāntarāpekṣam, tataśca dvandveṣu lug na syāt| tenaivagrahaṇaṃ tu dvitīyo'yaṃ yatna iti-- yaḥ pratyayāntasya bahutvaṃ tenaiva kriyate, yacca padāntarāpekṣeṇāpi tatra sarvatra bhavatīti| yadyevam, ihāpi prāpnoti-- priyavāṅgā iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; evakāro hyatra kriyate| sa tulyajātīyāpekṣayaiva niyamaṃ karoti, lopibireva yat kṛtaṃ bahutvamiti| na ca priyavāṅgā ityatra lopibhireva kṛtaṃ bahutvam, yasmādatra kiñcillopi padaṃ kiñcidalopi, evañca niyame sati dvandve sati dvandve'pi yatra lopyalopināṃ tatrāpi na bhavati-- `gārgyakāśyapagālavānām' (8.4.67) iti, atra gārgyakāśyapayoḥ `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti lopaḥ prāpnoti| gālavasya tu ṛṣyaṇantatvānnāsti lukaḥ prāptiḥ| `āṅgyaḥ' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp|| 63. yaskādibhyo gotre| (2.4.63) `apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram' (4.1.162) iti pāribhāṣikamevedaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate, na laukikamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt| atastāṃ nirākarttumāha-- `pratyayavidheyaścānyatra ' ityādi| etaccobhayagatiriha śāstre saṃbhavatīti labhyate| laukike gotre gṛhyamāṇe śāstrīyamapi tatrāntarbhavati; pratyayavidhau tu laukikagotrasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti jñāpakāt| yadayam-- `gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhrarājarājanyarājaputravatsamanuṣyājādavuña' (4.2.39) ityatra gautragrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā rājanyagrahamaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati-- pratyayavidhau laukikagotragrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti| `yāskāśchātrāḥ' iti| `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇ| puṣkaracchabdo'pyatra paṭhyate, sa kimarthaḥ; yāvatā `bahvaca iñ prācyabharateṣu' (2.4.66) ityevaṃ sidhyati ? na sidhyati; `na gopavanādibhyaḥ' (2.4.67) iti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti| gopavanādiṣu hi kaiścit taulvalyādayaśceti paṭhyate, taulvalyādiṣu puṣkarasacchabdaḥ paṭhyate, taulvalyādīnāñca gopavanādiṣu pāṭho'stītyayameva yaskādiṣu puṣkarasacchabdapāṭho jñāpayati|| 64. yañañośca| (2.4.64) `gārgyaḥ' iti| `yañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīp| `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ, `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.50) iti yakārasya ca| tatra hi `sūryatiṣyāgastyamatsyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ' (6.4.149) ityataḥ `ya' ityanuvarttate, `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityato lopa iti ca| `vaidyaḥ' iti| `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn' (4.1.73)| `dvaipyāḥ, autsāḥ' iti| jātādau śaiṣike'rthe yañaño| `yañādīnām' ityādi| yañādīnāṃ bahuṣu lugucyamāna ekatve dvitve ca prāpnotīti vacanam| ekadvayoriti ca saṃkhyāpradhāno'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, yathā-- `dvayekakayordvicavanaikavacane' (1.4.22) iti, ekatvadvitvayoriti yāvat; upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| karttavyamityadhyāhāryam| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `vā yau' (2.4.57) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vāgrahaṇamanuvartate| cakāro vātrānuktasamuccayārthaḥ kriyate| tena yañādīnāmekadvayorvā tatpuruṣe ṣaṣṭhyā lugbhavatīti| yadi vetyanuvarttate tadā bahuṣvapi vikalpaḥ syāt| vyavasthivibhāṣāvijñānānna bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `āṅgakulam' iti| atrāṅgaśabdāt tadrājasaṃjñako'ṇ, sa ca yañādirna bhavati tasyeha prakaraṇe yañādibhyaḥ prāṅnirdeśāt| `upagārgyam' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādināvyayībhāvaḥ| `paramagārgyaḥ' iti| `sanmahat' (2.1.61) ityādinā prathamāntayostatpuruṣaḥ|| 65. attribhṛgukutsavasiṣṭhagotamāṅgirobhyaśca| (2.4.65) `{ātreyyaḥ-- iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ'āttreyaḥ' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti| ṅīp|| 66. bahvaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu| (2.4.66) `bharatāḥ' iti| yeṣāṃ bharata ādyaḥ saṃjñākārī te bharatāḥ| `pannāgārāḥ' ityādiṣūhāharaṇeṣu `ata iñ' (4.1.95), tasya luk| `bālākayaḥ' iti| bāhvāditvādiñ| `hāstidāsayaḥ' iti| `ata iñ' (4.1.95)| `ārjunāyanaḥ' iti| `yañiyośca' (4.1.101) iti phak|| 67. na gopavanādibhyaḥ| (2.4.67) vidādyantargaṇo'yamiti lukprāptiṃ darśayati| `śaigravāḥ' iti| `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) | nanu cānye'pi haritādayo'tra paṭhyante, tatkimityavadhāryata etāvanta ityata āha-- `pariśiṣṭānām' ityādi| `pramādapāṭhaḥ' iti| anārṣaḥ pāṭhaḥ ityarthaḥ| yadi teṣāṃ pramādapāṭhaḥ, evaṃ tarhyavidāditvādañapyebhyo na prāpnotītyata āha-- `te hi' ityādi| te hi caturthe'dhyāye bidādiṣu gopavanādibhyaḥ parve paṭhyanta iti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| yastviha gopavanādibhyo'ṣṭabhyaḥ para eṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ, sa pramādapāṭha ityucyate|| 68. tikakitavādibhyo dvandve| (2.4.68) kimarthaṃ punastikakitavābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ gaṇa upalakṣyate, naikenaivopalakṣyeta ? naitat; kāryiṇā hi gaṇa upalakṣaṇayituṃ yuktaḥ, dvandvaścātra kāryī, tenaivopalakṣayituṃ yuktaḥ|| 69. upakādibhyo'nyatarasyāmadvandve| (2.4.68) yadi dvandve ca bhavatyadvandvagrahaṇaṃ tarhi kimarthamityāha-- `advandvagrahaṇam' ityādi| dvandvagrahaṇe nātra dvandvādhikāraḥ sambadhyate-- dvandve dvandvādhikāra iti, tasya nañā sambandhe ca dvandvādhikāranivṛttiḥ pratīyate| tha viṣayopagrahaṇārthamadvandvagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate-- advandve'dvandvaviṣaya iti ? yadyayamartho'bhīṣṭaḥ syādadvagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt; vināpi tenārthasya pratīteḥ| katham ? tikakitavādayo'pīha trayaḥ paṭhyante-- upakalamakāḥ, bhraṣṭakakapiṣṭalāḥ, kṛṣṇājinakṛṣṇasundarā iti, teṣāñcādvandva eva grahaṇaṃ prayojayati na dvandvaḥ; pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāditi| teṣāṃ tāvarnniyamenādvandvārthaṃ grahaṇam, tatsāhacaryāditareṣāmapyadvandvārthaṃ grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti niṣphalamevādvandvagrahaṇaṃ syāt| tasmād dvandvādhikāranivṛttyarthametadyuktamiti| `teṣāṃ pūrveṇa nityameva lugbhavati' iti| anyathā hi tikakitavādiṣu teṣāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| `advandve tvanena vikalpaḥ' iti| prakṛtatvālluko vijñeyaḥ| tatropakalamaśabdābhyāṃ naḍādiphagvidhānāt tasya lugvikalpaḥ, tataḥ parebhyaḥ prāk kapiṣṭhalaśabdāt iñaḥ| kapiṣṭhalamayūrakarṇa-- ityetebhyaḥ śivādibhyo'ṇaḥ| khārījaṅghādibhyaḥ prāk kaṭheraṇiśabdādata iñaḥ| kaṭheraṇiśabdādautsargikasyāṇaḥ| kuṣītakādibhyaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaparyantebhyo'ta iñaḥ| anulomaśabdāt bāhvādīñaḥ| bāhvādiṣu hi lomaśabdaḥ paṭhyate, sa ca tadantavidhiṃ prayojayati| anugatāni lomānyasyetyanulomā, tasyāpatyānulomayaḥ, anulomāna iti| śeṣāṇāmata iñaḥ|| 70. āgastyagauṇḍinyayoragastiguṇḍinac| (2.4.70) yadyapi pratyayāntāt ṣaṣṭhyuccāritā, tathāpi pratyayasyaiva lugvijñāyate, na tadantasya; yasmāt pratyayādarśanasya lugityeṣā saṃjñā vihitā, na tadantasyetyālocyāha-- `āgastyakauṇḍinyayorgotrapratyayayoḥ' iti| vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| āgastyakauṇḍinyayoryāvavayavau gotrapratyayau tayorityarthaḥ| tāveva pratyayau svarūpeṇa darśayannāha-- `aṇo yañaśca' iti| yaño yadyapi luk siddhastathāpi punarvidhīyate kuṇḍinajādeśena tasya bādhā mā vijñāyīti| `madhyodātto hi kuṇḍinīśabdaḥ' iti| kuṇḍamasyāstīti `ata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) itīnipratyaye kṛte pratyayasvareṇa| `tadādeśo'pi tathā syāt' iti| sthānivadbhāvena madhyodāttaḥ syāt| citkaraṇānmadhyodāttatvaṃ na bavati| kimarthaṃ punaḥ pratyayāntarayorevāyamādeśo na kriyata ityāha-- `tayoḥ' ityādi. yadi pratyayāntayorevāyamādeśaḥ syāta `gotre'lugaci' (4.1.89) iti pratiṣadho na syāt. yasmālluko'sau pratiṣedho nādeśasyeti syādevātrādeśaḥ, tataścāvṛddhādaṇeva syāt; evaṃ cāgastā ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| yadyapi vṛddhsayādeśaḥ syānivadbhāvād vṛddhagrahaṇena gṛhyate tathāpyagastīyā iti syāt, āgastīyā iti na sidhyati| na ca sthānivadbhāvo labhyate; vṛddhasaṃjñāyā alvidhitvāt| iha pratyayasya tu luki pariśiṣṭasyādeśe vihite `gotre'lugaci' (4.1.89) iti luki ca pratiṣiddhe `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) siddho bhavati| `tatra viśeṣo nāsti' iti| satyāmapi vṛddhasaṃjñāyāṃ `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) iti cchāpavadenāṇaiva bhavitavyamiti nāsti kauṇḍinye viśeṣaḥ|| 71. supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ| (2.4.71) `dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' iti| yadīyaṃ saptamī syāt tadā'yamartho vijñāyeta-- dhātau ca prātipadike ca yā sannikṛṣṭā vibhkatistasyā lugbhavatīti| sannikṛṣṭatvañcopaśleṣamantareṇa na sambhavatītīhāpi syāt-- vṛkṣaḥ plakṣa iti, asti hyatrāpi prādipadikena vibhakterupaśleṣaḥ| tasmāt ṣaṣṭhīyaṃ yukteti matvāha-- `supo vibhakterdhātusaṃjñāyāḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ punavibhakterdhātusaṃjñā prātipadikasaṃjñā ca bhavatītyata āha-- `tadantargatā' ityādi| nanvemapi dhātuprātipadikayorevakadeśībhūtā vibhaktayaḥ syuḥ, na dhātusaṃjñakāḥ, nāpi prātipadikasaṃjñakāḥ ? samudāyeṣu hi pravṛttāḥ śabdā avayevaṣvapi varttanta ityadoṣaḥ| `putrīyatī' iti| ātmanaḥ putramicchatīti `supa ātmanaḥ kyac' (3.1.8) `kyaci ca' (7.4.36) itīttvam, `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (3.1.32) iti dhātusaṃjñā, sā ca subantāt kyajvihita iti sasupkasyaiva bhavatīti tenātra vibhaktirdhātvantargatā bhavati| `kaṣṭaśritaḥ' iti| kaṣṭaṃ śrita iti `dvitīyā śrita' (2.1.24) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' (1.2.46) iti prātipadikasaṃjñā, sāpi subantānāṃ samāso bhavatīti sasupkasyaiva bhavati| tenātrāpi vibhaktiḥ prātipadikāntargatā bhavati| vṛkṣaḥ, plakṣa ityatrāpyapratyaya iti prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedhāt savibhaktikasya prātipadikasaṃjñā nāstīti nāsti vibhakteḥ prātipadikāntarbhāvaḥ|| 72. adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapaḥ| (2.4.72) 73. bahulaṃ chandasi| (2.4.73) `trādhvam' iti| `traiṅa pālanai' (dhā.pā.965) bhauvādikaḥ, loṭa, dhmamādeśaḥ, ṭerettvam, `savābhyāvāmau' (3.4.91) ityamādeśaḥ|| 74. yaṅo'ci ca| (2.4.74) `aci pratyaye parataḥ' iti| pratyayagrahaṇamacīti na pratyāhāragrahaṇamiti pradarśanārtham| yadi hi pratyāhāragrahaṇabhimataṃ syāt tadā'ṇīti ṇakāreṇaiva kuryāt| na hi yaṅantādaṇo'nye'caḥ pare sambhavantītyabhiprāyaḥ| idamevājgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam-- sarve dhātavaḥ pacādyantaḥpātina iti| `loluvaḥ'iti| `dhātorekāco halādeḥ kriyāsamabhihāre' (3.1.22) iti yaṅ, dvarvacanaṃ `sanyaṅoḥ' (6.1.9) ityanena, `guṇo yaṅalukoḥ' (7.4.82) iti guṇaḥ| lolū ya iti sthite pacādyac, yaṅo luk, `na dhātulopa' (1.1.4) ityādinā guṇapratiṣedhaḥ| `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinovaṅa| `sanīsraṃsaḥ| danīdhvaṃsaḥ' iti| `sransu dhvansu avasraṃsane' (dhā.pā.754,755), pūrvavadyaṅdikāryam| ` na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratiṣedhāt pratyayalakṣaṇena `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityādinā'nunāsikalopo na bhavati| `nīgvañcu' (7.4.84) ityādinā'bhyāsasya nīgāgamaḥ| `lālapīti|vāvadīti' iti| lapervadeśca `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ| `yaṅo vā' (7.3.94) itīṭ|| 75. juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ| (2.4.75) `śabanuvarttate, na yaṅa' iti| śaba eva svaritatvapratijñānāt| `juhoti' iti| `ślau' (6.1.10) dvirvacanam| bibharti' iti| `uratṭa (7.4.66) ityattvam| `raparatvam| `bhṛñāmit' (7.4.76) itīttvam| `nenekti' iti| `ṇijir śaucapoṣayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1093) , `nijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ' (7.4.75), `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvarvacanam|| 76. bahulaṃ chandasi| (2.4.76) `dāti, dhāti' iti| dadātidadhātyoḥ pūrvasūtreṇa ślau prāpte bahulaṃ pratiṣidhyate| śapo luk| `vivaṣṭi' iti| `vaśa kāntau' (dhā.pā.1080), adāditvācchapo luki prāpte śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvarvacanam, `bhṛñāmit' (7.4.76) ityanuvarttamāne `bahulaṃ chandasi' (7.4.78) itīttvam, vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam| `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti ṣṭutvam| `vibhakti' iti| `bhaja sevāyām' (dhā.pā.998) bhauvādikaḥ,śapaḥ śluḥ, pūrvavadittvam, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.3)) iti kutvam| `vivakti' iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ| sa ca `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1063) ityetasyādādikasya veditavyaḥ|| 77. gatisthāghupābhūbhyaḥ sicaḥ parasmaipadeṣu|( 2.4.77) `agāt' iti| `imo gā luṅi' (2.4.45) iti gādeśa-| `apāt' iti| `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925)| `abhūt' iti| `bhū suvostiṅi' (7.4.88) iti guṇapratiṣedhaḥ|| `gāporgrahaṇe iṇpivatyorgrahaṇam' iti| iṇādeśasya grahaṇaṃ tāvadgātītyata eva śtipā nirdeśādvijñāyate| śtipā hi vikaraṇaśūnya evamartho nirdeśaḥ kriyate--lugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yathā syāditi; anyathā hi yadi gāyatergrahaṇamiṣṭaṃ syāt tadā gā ityevaṃ brūyāt| evaṃ tarhi `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) ityubhayorapi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, kiṃ śtipā nirdeśena ? tasmādayameva śtipā nirdeśo jñāpayati-- imādeśsayaivedaṃ grahaṇam, na gāyateriti| pāgrahaṇe pibatereva garhaṇamityetadapi `lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.50) ityanayā paribhāṣayā vijñāyate| `aghāsīt' iti| `kai gai śabde' (dhā.pā.916,917) `yamaramanamātāṃ sak ca' (7.2.73) iti sagāgamaḥ| sic, iṭ ca| `astisico'pṛkte (7.3.96) itīṭ| `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| `apāsīt' iti| `pā rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā. 1056) pūrvavat sagādikāryam| `āgāsātām' iti| karmaṇyātmanepadam| ātām| kimarthaṃ punaḥ sico lugucyate, na lerityevocyeta ? atrāpyayamarthaḥ sampādyate, uttarasūtre ligrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati ? naitadasti; iha lerhi luki vijñāyamāne mā hi gātāmiti `ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām' (6.1.187) ityādiḥ svaro na siddhyet,sa punarudāttaḥ| agurityatrāpi `ātaḥ' (3.4.110) iti `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjusbhāvo na siddhyati| tasmāt sica eva lug vaktavyaḥ|| 78. vibhāṣā ghrādheṭ‌śācchāsaḥ| (2.4.78) `ghrā gandhopādāne' (dhā.pā.926), `dheṭ pāne' (dhā.pā.902), `śo tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1145), `cho chedane' (dhā.pā.1146), `ṣo'ntakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1147)| `dheṭaḥ pūrveṇa nitye prāpte' iti| ghusaṃjñakatvāt| alukpakṣe pūrvavat sagādikāryam| dheṭaḥ sānubandhakasya nirdeśo dhāñparīhārārthaḥ| yadi kṛtāttvo nirdiśyeta tadā dhāño'pi grahaṇaṃ syāt| `adhrāsātām' iti| karmaṇyātmanepadam|| 79. tanādibhyastathāsoḥ| (2.4.79) `atata' iti| `svaritañitaḥ' (1.3.72) ityātmanepadam| `anudāttopadeśa' ((6.4.37) ityādinā'nunāsikalopaḥ| `ataniṣṭa yayam' iti| madhyamapuruṣabahuvacanāntametat|| 80. mantre ghasahvaraṇaśavṛdahād‌vṛc‌kṛgamijanibhyo leḥ| (2.4.80) sica ityanuvarttamāne punarligrahaṇaṃ `ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām' (6.1.187) ityādeḥsickāryasya nivṛttyartham, uttarārthañca| `akṣan' iti| `ada bhakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1011) luṅa, `luṅasanordhaslṛ' (2.4.37) iti ghaslādeśaḥ| tataḥ `cli luṅi' (3.1.43) iita cliḥ, tasyānena luk, jherantādeśaḥ, `itaśca' (3.4.100) ikatīkāralopaḥ, `saṃyogāntasya' (8.2.23) iti takāralopaḥ, `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ, `śāsivasighalasīnāñca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam, `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvam, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam| hvaretyāgantukenākāreṇa nirdeśaḥ| `mā hvaḥ' iti| luṅa, tiṅaguṇaraparatvāni, halṅyādilopaḥ, (6.1.68), `na māṅayoge' (6.4.74) ityaḍāgamābhāvaḥ| `prāṇaḍ' iti| `ṇaśa adarśane' (dhā.pā.1194), pūrvavalluṅādikāryam, vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam, `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jastvam-- ṣakārasya ḍakāraḥ, tasya `vāvasāne' (8.4.56) iti cartvaṃ ṭakāraḥ,`upasargādasamāse'pi' (8.4.14) iti ṇatvam| kvacit `prāṇag' iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) ityataḥ kurityanuvarttamāne `naśervā' (8.2.63) iti kutvam| `āvaḥ' iti| vṛñastip, guṇo raparatvam, halṅyādinā (6.1.68) sipo lopaḥ| `dhak' iti| `daha bhasmīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.911), sip,halṅyādinā (6.1.68) sipo lopaḥ| `dāderdhātorghaḥ' (8.2.32) iti hasya ghaḥ| `ekāco baśo bhaṣ' (8.2.37) ityādinā dakārasya dhakāraḥ, dhakārasya jaśtvam-- gakāraḥ, tasya cartvam-- kakāraḥ, āḍāgamasya `bahulaṃ chandasyāmāṅyoge'pi' (6.4.75) iti niṣedhaḥ| `āprāt' iti| `prā pūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1061) ityasmāt tip| `parāvarka' iti| vṛjestip, laghūpadhaguṇaḥ,halṅyādinā (6.1.68) lopaḥ| `rātsasya' (8.2.24) iti niyamāt saṃyogāntalopābhāvaḥ| jakārasya pūrvavat kutvaṃ gakāraḥ, tasya cartvaṃ kakāraḥ| `akran' iti| kṛño jherantādeśaḥ, saṃyogāntalopaḥ| `ajñata' iti| janerjhasya `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityadādeśaḥ, pūrvavadupadhālopaḥ, `stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) itiścutvam| kvacit `ajñan' iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra jhiḥ, tataḥ parasmaipadaṃ vadheyam| `brāhmaṇe prayogo'yam' iti| yo'yamanantaraṃ mantre janeruktaḥ sa brāhmaṇo mantravyākhyānagranthaḥ| mantre janerluk ca dṛśyata iti tadviṣayamudāharaṇaṃ nopanyastam| yadi tarhyamantre lugbhavati mantragrahaṇaṃ kimarthamityāha-- `mantragrahaṇam' ityādi|| 81. āmaḥ| (2.4.81) `īhāñcakre' iti| `īha ceṣṭāyām' (dhā.pā.632), liṭ, `ijādeśca' (3.1.36) ityādinā''m| tasya kṛtve makārāntasya kṛdantatvāt prātipadikasaṃjñā, suḥ, āmaḥ svarādipāṭhādavyayatvam, `avyayādāpsupaḥ' (2.4.82) iti sulopaḥ, `kṛñca' (3.1.40) ityādinā liṭparasya kṛño'nuprayogaḥ, `āmpratyayavat'(1.3.63) ityādinā''tmanepadam, tata eśādeśaḥ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam| āmo makārasyānusvāraḥ, `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58)| atheha kasmānna bhavati-- jagāma, śaśāmeti ? arthavadāmo grahaṇāt, asya cānarthakatvāt| pratyayastu `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti' (pu.pa.pā.90) ityarthavān| iha tarhi kasmānna bhavatyam roga iti-- āmeti ? `lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.3), asya tu lākṣaṇikatvāt|| 82. avyayādupsupaḥ| (2.4.82) `tatra śālāyām' iti| tacchabdāt saptamyāstral| tasya `prāgdiśo vibhakti' (5.3.1) iti| vibhaktisaṃjñā, tyadādyatvam,ṭāp, `tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' (6.3.35) iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38) iti tralo'vyayatvam, tatautpannasya ṭāpo luk| kena punaravyayāṭṭābutpadyate ? `ajādyataṣṭāp' (4.1.4) iti cet, naca striyāṃ ṭāpo vidhānāt, avyayasya cāliṅgatvāt| tasmādavyayāṭṭāpaḥ sambhava eva nāstītyavyayādapārthakaṃ ṭāpo lugvacanam ? nāpārthakam; `striyām' (4.1.3) guṇipradhānanirdeśaḥ-- strītvavati padārthe ṭābādaya iti| strītvavati ca tasyāṃ śālāyamityetasmin padārthe tatretyetadavyayaṃ varttate| yadyapi vākyārtho'tra strītvam; tathāpi vākyārthatayaiva tasay strīpratyayo dyotyate, sati ca strīpratyaye padārtha eva strītvaṃ bhavati, tataṣṭāpo lugvaktavyaḥ| `kṛtvā, hṛtvā' iti| `ktvātosunkasunaḥ' (1.1.40) iti ktvāpratyayasyāvyayatvam, tata utpannasya supo luk| kena puravyayāt subutpattiḥ ? svādi (4.1.2) sūtreṇeti cet, na; tatra `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) itayādinā śāstrāntareṇaikavākyatāyāṃ svādīnāṃ niyatvāt, avyayānāñcāsaṃkhyatvāt| syādetat-- yatra saṃkhyāsti tatra `bahuṣu vahuvacanam‌' (1.4.21) ityevamādinā svādiniyaḥ kṛtaḥ, avyayebhyastu niḥsaṃkhyebhyaḥ samānyavihitāḥ svādayo vidyanta eveti ?vārttametat; svādisūtreṇa (4.1.2) hi `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ityādinā śāstrāntareṇaikavākyatāyāṃ svādīnāṃ vidhānāt| tathā hi-- tatrokkataṃ saṃkhyākarmādayaśca svādīnāmarthāḥ śāstrāntareṇa vihitāḥ, tena sahāsyaikavākyateti| ekavākyatāyāñca kutaḥ svādīnāṃ sāmānyena vidhānām| na hyaparaṃ lakṣaṇamasti yena svādayaḥ sāmānyena vihitāḥ| evaṃ tarhyetadevāvyayādutpannasya supo lugvacanaṃ jñāpakam-- bhavantyavayayāt svādaya iti| na hyanutpannasya lugupapadyate| etadeva jñāpakaṃ hṛdi kṛtvoktam-- `avyayebhyastu niḥsaṃkhyebhyaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ svādayo vidyanta eva' iti|| 83. nāvyayībhāvadato'matvapañcamyāḥ| (2.4.83) `etasmin pratiṣiddhe pañcamyāḥ śravaṇameva bhavati' iti| katham ? iha dvoyararthayorvidhānāt, vidhāyake ca vākye dve eva| tatra `nāvyayībāvādataḥ' ityetat pratiṣedhasya vidhāyakamekaṃ vākyam| `am tvapañcamyāḥ' ityetadamo vidhāyakaṃ dvitīyaṃ vākyam, tatra cāta ityetadapekṣate| ata eva vṛttau vākyadvayamupanyastam-- `adantādavayayībhāvaduttarasya supo na lugbhavati' ityekaṃ vākyam, `amādeśastu tasya bhavatyapañcamyāḥ' iti dvitīyam| tatrāpañcamyā ityanena `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti pañcamyā amādeśa eva pratiṣidhyate, na tvaluk pūrvavākyena vihitaḥ| ata evāluki sati pañ‍camyāḥ śravaṇameva bavati| ekavākyatāyāṃ hi satyāṃ kāryadvayasyaikayā pāṭhapravṛtyā vidhīyamānatvāt kāryadvayasyāpañcamyā iti pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| pañcamīṃ varjayitvaitat kāryadvayaṃ veditavyam| vākyabhede tvapañcamamyā ityetat pratyāsannamamādeśamapekṣate, na tu vākyāntaravihitamalukam| tenāpañcamyā ityanena sambadhyamānaḥ sāmānyena vidhīyamānaḥ sannaluk pañcamīmapyavagāhate; tasmāt pañcamyāḥ śravaṇameva yuktam| tuśabdenāpyayamartho labhyate| nanu ca kriyāyāḥ kārakāṇi bhavanti, pūrvapadārthapradhānaścāvyayībhāva uktaḥ,pūrvapadārthasya cāsattvabhūtatvāt kriyāmantareṇa sambandhābhāvādapādānādibhāvo nāsti, tat kuto'vyayībhāvāt pañcamyādayo vibhaktayo bhaveyuḥ ?naitadasti; pūrvapadārthaprādhānye'pi guṇabhūtottarapadārthapekṣaḥ kriyāyoga upapadyate, yathā-- pañcapūlīmānayeti| tatra bhāvaprādhānye'pi guṇabhūta dravyāpekṣaḥ kriyāsambandhaḥ|| 84. tṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulam| (2.4.84) `sumadram' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā samṛddhāvavyayībhāvaḥ| ` unmattagaṅgam' iti| `anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām' (2.1.21) ityanena| `ekaviṃśatibhāradvājam' iti| `saṃkhyā vaṃśyena' (2.1.19) iti|| 85. luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ| (2.4.85) parasmaipadasyātmanepadasya ca yathākramaṃ ḍārauras-- ityeta ādeśā bhavanti' iti| yadeyavam, parasmaipadeṣu tip tas jhītyetat pratyekaṃ prathamapuruṣasaṃjñā, ātmanepadeṣvapi ta ātāṃ jha iti; tatra sthāninaḥ ṣaṭ, traya ādeśā iti vaiṣamyāt saṃkhyāyānudeśābhāvādekaikasya paryāyeṇa sarva ādeśāḥ syuḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ānantaryato hi vyayasthā bhaviṣyati|
