parasmaipadam, śap‌pratyayaśca, aṭā saha savarṇadīrghatvam| tipa ikāralopo'tra na bhavati; tadvidhau `vaito'nyatra' (3.4.96) ityato vetyanuvṛtteḥ| `cyāvayāti' iti| `cyaṅa {na sto dhātupāṭhe} chyuṅa jyuṅa {na sto dhātupāṭhe} jhayuṅa pruṅa pluṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.955,956,957,958)| hetumaṇṇic| sipaḥ pitkaraṇaṃ bobhūyiṣātāmityatrodāttanivṛttisvareṇodāttatve prāpte'nudāttārtham| yaṅantāt bobhūyaśabdālleṭa ātmanepadam, ta, ṭeretvam‌| `eta ai' (3.4.93) `leṭo'ḍāṭau' (3.4.94) ityāṭ `tasyānudāttenṅidadupadeśāllasārvadhātukamanudāttamahanviṅoḥ' (6.1.186) iti sārvadhātukasyānudāttatvaṃ pitkaraṇasāmarthyādantaraṅgo'pi sipsvaraṃ pratīkṣate| tena kṛte tasmin sipa iḍāgamaḥ| sa cāgamānudāttatvenānudāttaḥ| `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) iti yaṅo'kārasyodāttasya lopaḥ| udāttatvaṃ tu tasya dhātusvareṇa ca| `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) ityudāttatve prāpte pitkaraṇādanudāttatvamiṭo bhavati|| 35. kāspratyayādāmamantre liṭi| (3.1.35) pratyayagrahaṇeneha sannādīnāṃ pratyāyānāṃ grahaṇam| `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt' (pu.pa.vṛ.44) iti paribhāṣayā `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) iti vā tadantavidhirvijñāyate|dhātvadhikārācca pratyayagrahaṇeneha dhātavo viśiṣyanta ityāha-- `pratyayāntebhyo dhātubhyaḥ' iti| āmpratyayo bhavatīti halantapakṣamāśrityoktam| adantapakṣe tvāmaḥ pratyayo bhavatītyevaṃ vaktavyam, tacca noktam; vakṣyamāṇādāmo'mittvamadantatvādityata evāvagamyamānatvāt| `amantre' iti viṣayasaptamīyam, na parasaptamī, tena mantrapratiṣedhāt bhāṣāyāṃ brāhmaṇe ca viṣaye'yaṃ vidhirvijñāyate| brāhmaṇo nāma mantrāṇāmeva vyākhyānagranthaḥ| na ca nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) brāhmaṇa eva bhavitavyam, na bhāṣāyām ? naitat; yadi bhāṣāyāmapi na syāt brāhmaṇa ityevaṃ brūyāt| `kāsāñcakre' iti| `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti lerluk| liṭaḥ kṛttavāllupte tasmin `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' (1.2.46) iti pratyayalakṣaṇena prātipadikasaṃjñā, suḥ, svarādipāṭhāt ` taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38) ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādvā'vyayasaṃjñāyāṃ sorluk| atha `halṅyābbhyaḥ' (6.1.68) ityanenātra sorlopo bhaviṣyati, kimatrāvyayasaṃjñayā| `lolūyāñcakre' iti| lolūyaśabdādyaṅantādām| `nonāva' iti| `ṇu stutau' (dhā.pā.1035), `ṇo naḥ' (6.1.65) iti natvam, yaṅa, nonūyata iti sthite `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti yaṅo luk, liṭ, tip, `parasmaipadānām' (3.4.82) iti ṇal, vṛddhiḥ| atra pratyayalakṣaṇena pratyayāntādām syāt, amantra iti vacanānna bhavati| `kāsyanekācaḥ' ityādi| pratyayagrahaṇamapanīyānekājgrahaṇaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| kimarthamityāha-- `culumpādyartham' iti| yathānyāsaṃ hi ka ityasmāt prajāpativācino viṣṇuvācino'śabdādācārakvipi tadantādapyām prasajyeta, cakāsṛprabhṛtibhyo'pratyayāntebhyaśca na syāt, tasmādidaṃ nyāsāntaraṃ draṣṭavyam| anye tu pratyayagrahaṇasyānekājupalakṣaṇānna karttavyametaditi manyante, etaccāyuktam; na hi pratyayagrahaṇamanekājupalakṣaṇārthamupapadyate, ekācāmapi pratyayānāṃ dhātūnāṃ vidyamānatvāt| yathā tvetannyāsāntaraṃ pratyākhyeyaṃ bhavet tathottaratra darśayiṣyāmaḥ| `cakāsāñcakāra, daridrāñcakāra' iti| `cakāsṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.1074), `daridrā durgatau' (dhā.pā.1073)| `culumpāñcakāra' iti| culumpaterdhātuṣvaparipaṭhitasyāpi kāsyanekājgrahaṇaṃ culumpādyarthamiti kātyāyanavacanaprāmāṇyāt dhātutvaṃ veditavyam| athāmo makārasya `halantyam' (1.3.3) itītsaṃjñā kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `āmo'mittavam' ityādi| makāra idyasya so'yamit, na midamit, tasya bhāvo'mittvam| kathamamittavamityāha-- `adantatvāt' ityādi| makārāntatve hi sati makārsayetsaṃjñā syāt| na cāsya makārāntatvam, kiṃ tarhi ? adantatvam| tenākāra eva `upadeśe'janunāsika it' ((1.3.2ḥ itītsaṃjñāmanubhavan makārasyetsaṃjñāṃ pratibadhnāti| yathā cāme'mittavamadantatvādaguṇatvaṃ videstathā| guṇābhāvo'pi hi vidervidāñcakāretyatrākārāntatvādāveva bhavati. athākārāntatve satyato lope (6.4.48) tasyāḥ `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāvādikāra upadhā na bhavati, tena laghūpapadhaguṇo na bhavati| adantatvaṃ tu videḥ `uṣavidajāgṛbhyo'nyatarasyām' (3.1.38) ityanenāmpratyayasanniyogenākārāntatvanipātanāt| abhyupetyāmo makārāntatvamamittvaṃ pratipādayitumāha-- `āścakāsorvidhānācca' iti| āmo'mittvamiti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ,`dayāyāsaśca'( 3.1.37) ityāsa āmo vidhānāt| kāsyanekājgrahaṇaṃ culumpādyarthamityupasaṃkhyānāccakāseḥ| ādigrahaṇena hi cakāserapi grahaṇam| makārasyetsaṃjñaiyatat prayojanam-- aco'ntyāt paro yathā syāditi| yadi cāmo'mittvaṃ syāt tadā''ścakāsorāmo vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| na hi tayoraco'ntyāt pa āśi bhavatyabhavati vā kaścidviśeṣaḥ| ubhayathā hi `akaḥ savarṇe' (6.1.101) iti dīrghatve tadeva rūpaṃ syāt, tadetadāścakāsorāmo vidhānaṃ kathamarthavadbhavati ? yadyamittavamāmo bhavati nānyathā| na hyanyat kiñcitprayojanamastīti prayojanābhāvāditsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati| āścakāsorvidhānasamārthyāt savarṇadīrghatvamiha na bhaviṣyati| `midaco'ntyāt paraḥ' (1.1.47) iti paribhāṣā vā nopasthāsya ityetacca nāśaṅkanīyaṃ lakṣyavirodhamanicchatā| evaṃ hyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| na cāniṣṭārthā śāstre praklṛptiryuktā| yadi tarhyamo'dantatvamevaṃ satyāmamantra iti nirdeśo nopapadyate, savarṇadīrghatve `āmāmantre' iti bhavitavyamityāha-- `pararūpaṃ katantavat' iti| yathā` sarvatra lohitādikatantebhyaḥ' (4.1.18) ityatra pararūpaṃ tathehāpīti na bhavati nirdeśānupapattiḥ|| 36. ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ| (3.1.36) `{yajādeḥ iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ|} ijādeḥ' iti| ādiryasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ic' iti pratyāhāragrahaṇam| gururasyāstīti gurumān| `ṛcchativarjitaḥ' ṛcchinā tyaktaḥ| tadrūparahita ityarthaḥ| `īhācañkre' iti| `īha ceṣṭāyām' (dhā.pā.632) `ūhāñcakre' iti| `ūha vitarke' (dhā.pā.648)| `tatakṣa, rarakṣa' iti| `takṣū tvakṣū tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.655, 656), `rakṣa pālane' (dhā.pā.658)| `iyaja; uvapa' iti| yajivapyoruttame ṇali `ṇaluttamo vā' (7.1.91) iti ṇittvābhāvapakṣe vṛddhyabhāvādgurumattābhāvaḥ| kecit iyeṣa, uvoṣeti pratyudāharanti| `{iṣa dhā.pā.} iṣu icchāyām' (dhā.pā.1351) `uṣa dāhe' (dhā.pā.696), ṇali laghūpadhaguṇaḥṣa dvirvacanam, `abhyāsasyāsavarṇe' (6.4.78) itīyaṅuvaṅau| nanu ca guṇe kṛta etāvapi gurumanto bhavata iti bhavitavyamevāmātra ? na bhavitavyam; `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya' (vyā.pa.12) iti liṭsannipāto gurumattāyā hetuḥ| gurumattā ca `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti liṭameva vihanti| atha vā-- gurumata iti nityayoge matup, tena nityaṃ yasya gurumā yogastato bhavitavyam, na ceṣeruṣeśca nityaṃ guruṇā saha yogaḥ| yadyevam, `uchī vivāse' (dhā.pā.216) -- ucchāñcakāretyatra tuki kṛte na prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṛcchipratiṣedho hi jñāpayati-- āgamanimittā gurumattā yasya tato'pi bhavatīti| `ānarccha' iti| `ṛccha gatīndriyapralayamūrtibhāveṣu' (dhā.pā.1296), `che ca' (6.1.73) iti tuk, `ṛcchatyṝtām' (7.4.11) itiguṇaḥ, dvirvacanam, halādiśeṣaḥ, `ata ādeḥ' (7.4.70) iti dīrghaḥ, `tasmānnuḍ dvihalaḥ' (7.4.71) iti nuṭ| nanu ca `ṛcchatyṝtām'(7.4.11) iti ṛcchateranantare liṭi guṇavacanaṃ jñāpakam-- ṛccherām na bhavati| sati hi tasminnāgamanimittā gurumattā yasya tato'pi bhavatītyetajjñāpitaṃ na syāt| tasmādanṛccha iti pratiṣedhaḥ karttavyaḥ| `ūrṇoteḥ' ityādi| ijāditvādgurumattvācca prāpnotyām| tasmāt pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu-- vakṣyamāṇasyānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya siṃhāvalokitanyāyenānuvarttitasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvavijñānāt karttavyam| `prorṇunāva' iti| `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti `nu'ityasya dvirvacanam| rephastu na dvirucyate; `na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' (6.1.3) iti pratiṣedhāt| `atha vā' ityādi| `ṇu stutau' (dhā.pā.1-35)| `tena tulyaṃ varttate' iti nupavat, tasya bhāvo nuvadbhāva iti. nautinā tulyaṃ varttata ityarthaḥ| kiṃ punastasya prayojanam, yenāsau tathā vācyaḥ ? ityāha-- `yaṅaprasiddhiḥ prayojanam' iti| nuvadbhāve sati yathā nauteḥ `dhātorekācaḥ' (3.1.22) itiyaṅa bhavati nonūyata iti, evamūrṇoterapi- prorṇonūyata iti| `āmaśca pratiṣedhārtham' iti nuvadbhāvo vācya ityapekṣate| tasmin sati yathā nauteranijāditvādgumattābhāvāccām na bhavati, tathorṇoterapi-- prorṇunāveti| `ekācaśceḍupagrahāt' iti| `nuvadbhāvo vācyaḥ' iti sambadhyate| karmaṇi `lyablope' (vā.127) iti pañcamī, yathā-- prāsādāt prekṣate, āsanāt prekṣata iti| iḍupagraha iti iṭpratiṣedhaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityanuvarttamāne `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) iti ya iḍupaghaḥ kriyate taduddiśya prayojanamūrṇoternuvadbhāvo vācya iti| tena yathā nauteḥ `śrayukaḥ kiti' itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ-nutaḥ, nutavāniti, tathorṇoterapi-- prorṇutaḥ, prorṇutavāniti| atha vā-- iḍupagrahāditi hetāviyaṃ pañcamī, yathā-- `tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt' (1.2.53) iti| ekāco yata iḍupagraho vidhīyate tasmāt prayojanāddhetorūrṇoternuvadbhāvo vācya ityarthaḥ| atha `ijādeśca' iti kimarthaścakāraḥ ? anuktasamuccayārthaḥ , tena `kāsyanekācaḥ' (vā. 205) iti vaktavyaṃ na bhavati| yathānyāse'pi cakāreṇa cakāsāñcakāretyādeḥ siddhatvāt| nanu ca yadīdaṃ nocyeta, tadā pratyayānto'pi yo dhāturekāc tato'pi prasajyet ? yadi neṣyate, tadā vakṣyamāṇamantayatarasyāṃgarhaṇamanuvartyaṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamaṅgīkarttavyam|| 37. dayāyāsaśca| (3.1.37) `palāyāñcakre' iti| parāpūrvasyāyateḥ `upasargāsyāyatau' (8.2.19) iti latvam| 38. uṣavidajāgṛbhyo'nyatarasyām| (3.1.38) uṣajāgṛbhyāṃ sāharyādviderapi parasmaipadino jñānārthasya grahaṇam, na tu sattāvicāraṇārthaṃ yorātmanepadinoḥ, nāpi lābhārthasyobhayapadinaḥ; jāgarttinā''dādikena vā sāhacaryādviderādādikasyaiva grahaṇamityāha-- `vida jñāne' iti| vivedetyatrādantatvābhāvādguṇo bhavatyeva| āmsanniyogena videradantatvaṃ vijñāyate, tena tatraiva guṇābhāvo nānyatreti| ata āha-- `videradantatvapratijñānādāmi guṇo na bhavati' iti|| 39. bhīhrībhṛhuvāṃ śluvacca| (3.1.39) `bhīhrībhṛhuvām' iti| pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī| supāṃ supo bhavantīti| `śluvat' iti| ślaviva śluvat| `tatra tasyeva' (5.1.116) iti saptamīsamarthādvatiḥ| kāryātideśaścāyam| ata evāha-- `śluvaccāsmin kāryaṃ bhavati' iti| `dvitvamittvañca' iti| `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam, `bhṛñāmit' (7.4.76) itīttvam| asati hyatideśe liḍāśrayaṃ dvirvacanamāmā vyavadhāne na syāt| ittvamapi naiva syāt, tadvidhau hi `ṇajāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau' (7.4.75) ityataḥ ślāvityanuvarttate| tasmāt tasyobhayasya siddhaye `śluvacca' ityatideśaḥ|| 40. kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi| (3.1.40) `anuprayujyate' iti| anupraśabdau pratyekaṃ prathamānte pade| `yujyate' ityātmamanepade prathamapuruṣaikavacanāntaṃ padam| `āmpratyayasya' iti| ām pratyayo yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ| paścādityanenānuśabdasyārthamācakṣāṇaḥ prāk prayogaṃ nirākaroti| sāvadhāraṇaphalatvācca sarvavākyānāmāmpratyayasyaiva paścāt kṛñ prayujyate-- ityavadhāraṇamihāśritam, tena vyavadhāne prayogo nirākṛto bhavati| na hi vyavadhāne kṛñanuprayujyamāna āmpratyayasyaivānuprayukto bhavati, api tu śabdāntarasyāpi|`liṭi parataḥ' ityanena pratyayāntare pare prayogābhāvamāha| nanu ca `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti liṭo lukā bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ liṭi parataḥ kṛña nuprayujyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hyayamatrārthaḥ-- lakṣaṇāntareṇa yo vihito liṭparaḥ kṛñanuprayujyata iti yāvat| nanu ca kṛñityucyate, pācayāmbabhūva pācayāmāseti bhavaterasteścānuprayogo na sidhyatītyāha-- `kṛñiti pratyāhāreṇa' ityādi|`abhūtatadbhāve kṛbhvastiyoge' (5.4.40) itītaṃ kṛśabdaṃ gṛhītvā `kṛño dvitīyatṛtīyaśambabījāt kṛṣau' (5.4.58) iti ñakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇametat| tena pratyāhāragrahaṇena kṛbhvastayastrayo gṛhyante| tatra ca trayāṇāmapyantarbhāvādityadoṣaḥ| evamapyasteranuprayogo na sidhyati, yasmāt `asterbhūḥ' (2.4.52) iti bhūbhāvena bhavitavyamityāha-- `tatsāmarthyāt' iti| pratyāheraṇa kṛbhvastīnāṃ grahaṇasāmarthyādasterbhūbhāvo na bhavati| teṣāṃ pratyāhāragarhaṇasyaitat prayojanam-- asteranuprayogo yathā syāt| yadyasteranuprayogasya bhūbhāvaḥ syāt niṣphalaṃ pratyāhāragrarahaṇaṃ syāt, `kṛbhvanuprayujyate liṭi' ityevaṃ brūyāt| tatrāpyayamarthaḥ-- kimidaṃ karotergrahaṇam ? uta pratyāhārasya ? iti sandehaḥ parihṛto bhavati| yadi tarhi kṛñiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam, evaṃ sati `abhividhau sampadā ca' (5.4.53) iti sampadānuprayogaḥ prāpnoti; tasya pratyāhāre'ntarbhūtatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (3.1.32) ityato dhātugrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena ca kṛñ viśiṣyate--kṛñ yo dhāturiti, na ca sampadetyaṃ dhātuḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ, tasmānnānuprayujyate| `pācayāmbabhūva' iti| pacerṇyantādām| `ayāmantālvāyyetnviṣṇuṣu' (6.4.55) iti ṇerayādeśaḥ| `bhavateraḥ' (7.4.73) ityabhyāsasyāttvam| `bhuvo vug luṅaliṭoḥ' (6.4.88) iti vugāgamaḥ| kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā'mantamidam, anabhivyaktakriyāpadārtham| ato hi kriyākālamātrasyābhivyaktirbhavati, na sādhanapuruṣasaṃkhyānam| na hi vinā tiṅantapadena tāsāmabhivyaktirbhavati| tasmādaparisamāptyarthatvādevāmantasyānuprayogo bhaviṣyati ? kṛbhvastīnāmanuprayogo yathā syāt, `{pacādīnāṃ mā bhūt| pacādīnāmiti cenna'} iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} pacādīnāṃ mā bhūditi cet, na; pacādīnāṃ viśeṣavācitvādanuprayogasyānupapatteḥ| viśeṣavācī hyanuprayujyamānaḥ sāmānyavācino hyāmantasyānuprayujyate ? viśeṣavācino vā ? tatra na tāvat sāmānyavācina āmantasya viśeṣavācyanuprayogamarhati, tasyāsambhavāt| kṛbhvastayo hi sāmānyavācinaḥ, na ca tebhyaḥ kenacidām vihitaḥ| viśeṣavācino'pyāmantasya viśeṣavācī samānārtho'nuprayujyeta ? bhinnārtho vā ? tatra samānārthastāvannānuprayujyate; uktārthatvāt| tasmiṃścānuprayoktumiṣṭa āmantasya sakalakriyākālādyarthābhivyaktirbhavati| sāmarthyāt sa evānuprayoktavyo yatra sarvābhavyaktirbhavati| tatra kriyāmantena samānārthena pūrveṇa ! bhinnārtho'pi nānuprayogamarhati; tadarthānabhivyakteḥ| anuprayogo hyāmantasyārthasyābhivyaktaye kriyate, na cātyantabhinnārthenāmantavācyasyārthasya sambandhinaḥ sādhanādayaḥ śakyante'bhivyaṅaktum| sāmānyavācinā tu śakyante'bhivyaṅaktum| viśeṣasannidhau hi sāmānyaśabdasya viśeṣe'vasthānādāmantasya sannidhau sāmānyaśabdāḥ kṛbhvastayo'nuprayujyamānāstadvācya evārthaviśeṣe varttante, tasmādeṣāmeva kṛbhvastīnāmanuprayogo bhaviṣyatīti nārabdhavyamidam ? naitadasti; yathaiva hi kṛbhvastayaḥ kriyāsāmānyavacanāḥ, evaṃ vidyatirapīti tasyāpyanuprayogaḥ syāt| tasmāt tannivṛttyarthamidamārabdham| vyavahitaprayoganivṛttyarthañca, pācayāṃ devadattaścakāreti mā bhūt| vyavahitaprayogānivṛttistvavadhāraṇaviśeṣāllabhyate| avadhāraṇaṃ tu sarvavākyānāṃ vyavacchedaphalatvāt sāvadhāraṇaphalatvāccakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādvā labhyate| viparyayanivṛttyarthaścārabdhavyaḥ, viparyayanivṛttistvanoḥ paścādarthatvāllabhyate|| 41. vidāṅkurvantvityanyatarasyām| (3.1.41) `viderloṭyāmpratyayaḥ' iti| viderliṭyām vihito loṭi na prāpnotītyato'pi nipātyate| amamāśritya laghūpadhaguṇaḥ prāpnotīti tadabhāvaśca| `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti lerlugvidhīyamāno loṭo na sidhyatītyato loṭo luk| liṭparasya kṛño'nuprayoga ukto loṭparasya na prāpnoti, so'pi nipātyata iti sarvatra sambandhanīyam| `kurvantu' iti| bahuvacanam, jherantādeśaḥ, `eruḥ' (3.4.86), vikaraṇamaśritya dhātorguṇaḥ, ` ata ut sārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityuttvam, vikaraṇasya yaṇādeśaḥ| `itikaraṇaḥ' ityādi| loḍvacanānāmupalakṣaṇārthatve satītikaraṇasya yadiṣṭaṃ taddarśayitumāha-- `na kevalam' ityādi| `kurutām' iti| `tasthas' (3.4.101) ityādinā tasastām| `kuru' iti. `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti hiḥ, `utaśca pratyayāt' (6.4.106) ityādinā herluk| `kurutam' iti| tasastam|| 42.abhyutsādayāṃprajanayāṃcikayāṃramayāmakaḥ pāvayāṃkriyādvidāmakranniti cchandasi| (3.1.42) `abhyutsādayām' iti| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāse kṛta ekamevedaṃ prathamāntam| evaṃ `prajanayām' ityetadapi| śeṣāṇyapyāmantāni prathamāntānyeva| `akaḥ' iti| karoterluṅa| prathamapuruṣaikavacanāntam| `akrana' iti| prathamapuruṣabahuvacanāntam| `sadijaniramīṇām' iti| `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu' (dhā.pā.1427), `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1449), `ramu krīḍāyām' (dhā.pā.853)| `ṇyantānām'iti| hetumaṇṇijantānām| `pacateḥ' iti| liṭi vihitatvālliṅi na prāpnoti, tato nipātyate| `asya' iti| punāteḥ pavatervā ṇyantasya| `lṛṅyām nipātyate' iti| pūrvavanna prāpnotīti kṛtvā| `viderapi guṇābhāvaśca' iti| `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86)iti guṇaḥ prāpnoti, atsatadabhāvo nipātyate| `abhyutsādayām' iti| pūrvavaṇṇerayādeśaḥ| luṅo luk| `akaḥ' iti| karoterluṅa, aḍāgamaḥ, tip, cliḥ, tasya `mantre ghasahvara' (2.4.80) iti luk, guṇaḥ, raparatvam, `halṅyābbhyaḥ' (6.1.68) iti tilopaḥ, rephasya visarjanīyaḥ| `abhyudasīṣadat' iti| `ṇiśri' (3.1.48) ityādinā caṅa, `ṇau caṅyupadhāyāḥ' (7.4.1) iti hrasvaḥ, `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti dvirvacanam, halādiśeṣaḥ, `sanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) iti sanvadbhāve satīttvam, `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghaḥ| eṣā prakriyā yathāyogamuttaratrāpi veditavyā| `prajanāyām' iti| `janījṝṣ‌knasurañjo'mantāśca' (dhā.pā.817) iti mittvāt hrasvatvam| `cikayām' iti| kakāro'pyatra nipātyate| guṇāyādeśau| `acaiṣīt' iti| `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ, sici vṛddhiḥ| `ramayām' iti| `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92)| `pāvayām' iti| `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti liṅo luk| `kriyāt' iti| kṛña āśiṣi liṅa, tip, `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ, yāsuṭ, `riṅa śayagliṅakṣu' (7.4.28) iti riṅādeśaḥ; `sko saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti salopaḥ| `pāvyāt' iti| pūrvavalliṅa, `liṅāśiṣi' (3.4.116) ityārdhadhātukatvācchapo'bhāvaḥ, `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopaḥ| `vidām' iti| viderluṅa, ām, guṇābhāvaḥ, luṅo luk| `akran' iti| kṛño luṅa, cliḥ, jherantādeśaḥ, `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ, saṃyogāntalopaḥ, cleḥ `mantre ghasahvara' (2.4.80) iti luk, aṭa, yaṇādeśaḥ| `avediṣuḥ' iti| sica iṭ, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjus| ` itikaraṇaḥ prayogadarśanārthaḥ' iti| anye'pyevaṃjātīyāśchandasi veditavyā ityarthaḥ|| 43. cli luṅi|| (3.1.43) `ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ' iti| uccāraṇamevāsyārtho nānyat kiñcit prayojanamityarthaḥ| etenetsaṃjñākāryaṃ na bhavatīti darśayati| `cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| `citaḥ' (6.1.163) ityantodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| atha `mantre ghasahvaraṇaśavavṛdahād‌vṛckṛgamijanibhyo leḥ' (2.4.80) ityekāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ, cakārastadavighātārthaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate ? evaṃ manyate-- mantreghasādibhyo naivābhyo lirasti yasya sāmānyagrahaṇārtho'yamikāraḥ syāt, tasmiṃścāsati sāmānyagrahaṇārthe tadavighātārthatāpi cakārasya nopapadyate| `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) ityatra tarhīkāracakārau kasmānna sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārthau bhavataḥ, tatra hi mantreghasādi (2.4.80) sūtrāllerityanuvarttate, tatrekāracakārayorabhāve `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na liṅaliṭoḥ ? naitadasti; atra mā bhūlligrahaṇānuvṛttiḥ,aviśeṣeṇāpi pratyayamātrasya lug bhavaṣyati; naivaṃ sati kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| na hi so'sti pratyayo yasya luki sati kiñcidaniṣṭaṃ bhavet| satyāmapi ligrahaṇānuvṛttau na doṣaḥ, anekasmin grāhye sati sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ bhavati, na cāmaḥ parasyānekaṃ grāhyamasti| na hi kvacidāmaḥ paro liṭonyaḥ prayogo'sti, tasmādanyābhāvālliṭa eva grahaṇam| tatra nārthaḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārthenekāreṇa,nāpi tadavighātārthena cakāreṇa| nanu ca pāvayāṅkriyādityatrānyo'pi lirasti ? naitadasti; nipātanādeva tatsiddham|taccāvaśyaṃ nipātanamāśrayitavyam; anyathā kriyamāṇe'pīkāre tadavighātāraethe ca cakāre abyutsādayāmiti na siddhyet| tasmāt pūrvoktameva prayojanaṃ nyāyyam| yathottarārthaścakārastathottaratra pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ clipratyayamāsajya tasya sijādaya ādiśyante, na sicamevotsargaṃ vidhāya tasya ksādaya ādeśā vidhīyeranniti ?naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi `śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ' (3.1.45) ityatra clerabhāvādaniḍgrahaṇaṃ dhātorviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyeta- dhātoraniṭa iti| tathā ca guherna siddhyeta-- aghukṣaditi|tasya hi ūdittvāt svaratyādinā (7.2.44) vikalpeḍvidhānānnāstyaniṭtvam| clau satyaniḍgrahaṇena sa eva viśiṣyate-- cleraniṭa iti| guheśca parasya clervibhāṣiteṭtvāt yadeṇ nāsti tadā cleraniṭtvāt ksaḥ siddho bhavati|| 44. cleḥ sic| (3.1.44) `ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ' iti| etenehoccāraṇādanyaprayojanaṃ nāstīti darśayannitsaṃjñāyāṃ abhāvamāha| nanu cāsatīkāre'nubandhe `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanenāmaṃstetyatrānunāsikalopaḥ prāpnoti, tatastatpratiṣedhārtho'yamitsaṃjñakaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? evaṃ manyate-- asatyapīkāre'nubandhenaiva sijantasyānunāsikalopena bhavitavyam; `hana sic' (1.2.14) iti kitkaraṇājjñāpakāt| tathā hi hanteḥ kitkaraṇasyaitat prayojanam-- āhatetyatrānunāsikalopo yathā syāt| yadi sijantasyānunāsikalopaḥ syāt hante sicaḥ kitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| antodāttārthaḥ| nanu ca sico'nackatvāccakārasya svarārthatā nopapadyate ? iṭi kṛte sācko bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| nanvevamapi luṅyatrāḍāgamasyodāttatve satiśiṣṭasvareṇādyudāttatvena bhavitavyam, kimarthaścakāraḥ ? yatra tarhi `na māṅayoge' (6.4.74) ityaḍāgamaḥ pratiṣidhyate tatra cakārasya svarārthatā bhaviṣyati| nanu tatrāpi `tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighātena bhavitavyam ? tarhi yatra `hi ca' (8.1.34) iti nighātaḥ pratiṣidhyate-- mā hi lāvīdityādau , tatra svarārtho bhaviṣyati| nanu ca clestatra sthānivadbhāvādeva citsaro bhaviṣyatītikimādeśe cakāro'nubadhyate ? ityāha-- `āgamānudāttatvaṃ hi' ityādi| yāsuṭa udāttavacanenāgamānudāttatvaṃ jñāpayiṣyate| tacca nāprāpte svarāntare vidhīyate| tathā hi-- ye prakṛtibhaktā āgamā aḍānukaprabhṛtatayasteṣāṃ prakṛtisvaraḥ prāpnoti, ye ca pratyayabhaktā iḍādayasteṣāṃ pratyayasvaraḥ; tasmādagamānudāttatvaṃ sarvasya svarāntarasya bādhakam| tataścaiva tadyathā pratyayasvaraṃ bādhate tathā citsvaramapi sthānivadbhāvakṛtaṃ bādheta| tasmādādeśe'pi cakāro'nubadhyate| hi-śabdoyasmādarthe,itiśabdastasmādarthe| yasmādevaṃ citasvaramapi bādheta tasmāt sthāninyādeśe'pi dviścakāro'nubadhyate. nanu ca mā hi lāvītyādāvāgamānudāttatvaṃ yadi syāt cleścitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, prayojanābhāvāt; tasmāt cleścitkaraṇasāmarthyādāgamānudāttatvena citsvaro na bādhiṣyate-- ityapārthakaṃ sicaścitkaraṇam ? nāpārthakam; pakṣe sārthakatvāt. katham ? iha hi yathā vyaktipadārthapakṣamāśritya `sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ' (1.2.64) ityetatsūtramārabdham, tathā vyaktipadamārthakṣāśrayatpadviścakāro'nubadhyate| vyaktau hi padārthe yathā citsvaralakṣamaṃ pratilakṣyaṃ pravarttate tathāgānudāttatvajñāpakamapi yāsuṭa udāttavacanam| tataśca mā hi lāvīdityatrāgamānudāttatvaṃ tena jñāpitameva| tathā ca-- yatheha citsvaro bhavati tathāgamānudāttatvenāpi bhavitavyam; anyathā hyetadviṣayasya jñāpakasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| na ca dvayorapyanudāttayoryaugapadyaṃ sambhavatīti paryāyaḥ syāt| tatra pakṣe sthāninaścakārasya pakṣāntara āgamānudāttatvena bādhyeta| dviranubadhyamāne tu cakāre yadyapi pakṣe'nudātto'bhinirvarttate, tathāpyabhinirvṛtte tasmin dviścakārā4nubandhakaraṇasāmarthyāt punaścitsvaro'bhinirvarttate, ato na doṣaḥ| `spṛśamṛśa' ityādi| spṛśimṛśikṛṣibhyaḥ `śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ' (3.1.45) iti kse prāpte, tṛpidṛpibhyāṃ puṣāditvādaṅi prāpte sijvā vaktavyaḥ - vyākhyeyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ksavidhau `vidāṃkurvantvityanyatasyām' (3.1.41) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate, puṣādisūtre'pi `ātmanepadeṣu' (3.1.54) ityataḥ| sā ca vyavasthita vibhāṣitobhayata eva vijñāyate| tena spṛśimṛśikṛṣibhyo vikalpena kso bhaviṣyati, anyebhyastu nityam| tṛpidṛpibhyāmanyatarasyāmaṅ ca bhaviṣyati, anyebhyastu puṣādibhyo nityameva| tena yasmin pakṣe ksāṅorabhāvastasmin pakṣe sāmānyavihitaḥ sijeva bhavati| `aspṛkṣat' iti| `spṛśa saṃsparśe' (dhā.pā.1422), ksaḥ, vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam, `ādeśapratyayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvam| `asprākṣīt' iti| `anudāttasya cardupadhasyānyatarasyām' (6.1.59) ityamāgamaḥ; `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, ṛkārasya yaṇādeśaḥ| `aspākṣīt' iti| sic| yadā'māgamo nāsti tadā ṛkārasyaiva vṛddhiḥ|evaṃ `mṛśa āmarśane' (dhā.pā.1425), `kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā.1286) ityetayorapi rūpadvayaṃ, veditavyam| `atu pat' iti| `tṛpa prīṇane' (dhā.pā.1195)| `atrāpsīt, atāpsīt' iti| pūrvavat| evaṃ `dupa harṣaṇamocanayoḥṭa (dhā.pā.1196) ityasyāpi rūpatrayaṃ veditavyam|| 45. śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ| (3.1.45) `aghukṣat' iti| `duha prapūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1014), `dāderdhātorghaḥ' (8.2.32), `ekāco baśo bhaṣ' (8.2.37) ityanena dakārasya bhaṣbhāvena dhakāraḥ, dhakārasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam-- kakāraḥ| `alikṣat' iti| `liha āsvādane' (dhā.pā.1016), `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam, pūrvavat ṣatvakatve| `adhākṣīt' iti|` daha bhasmīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.991), pūrvavat ḍhatvakatvaṣatvabhaṣbhāvacartvāni| `akoṣīt' iti| `kuṣa niṣkarṣe' (dhā.pā. 1518) laghūpadhaguṇaḥ|| 46. śliṣa āliṅgane| (3.1.46) `atra' iti| āliṅgane| `niyamārthametat' iti| pūrveṇa siddhe satyārambhāt| `aślikṣat' iti| pūrvavat katvam| `samāśliṣajjatu kāṣṭham' iti| puṣāditvādaṅ| pratyāsattiratra nairantaryalakṣaṇā śliṣerarthaḥ, na tvāliṅganam| yadyayaṃ puṣādau paṭhyate, kathamidaṃ niyamārtham; siddhe satyārambho niyamāya bhavati, na ca pūrveṇa ksaḥ siddhaḥ, aṅā vādhitatvāt ? manyate-- `śliṣaḥ' iti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ| kimartham ? aṅabādhanārtham-- ksa eva bhavati, nāṅ| tataḥ| `āliṅgane' iti kimartham ? niyamārtham-- āliṅgana eva kso bhavati, anyatrāṅeveti| yadyevam, `śliṣaḥ' ityevaṃ yogavibhāgo yathāṅaṃ bādhate tathā `ciṇbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (3.1.66) iti ciṇamapi bādheta-- upāśleṣi kanyā devadatteneti ? naitadasti; `purastādapa vādā anantarān vidīn bādhante nottarān (vyā.pa.9) ityayamaṅaṃ bādhate, na ciṇam| atha vā-- `ciṇbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (3.1.66) ityatra `ciṇ te padaḥ' (3.1.60) ityataściṇityanuvartamāne punaściṇ‌grahāhaṇasyaitatprayojanam-- ciṇeva yathā syāt, yadanyat prāpnoti tanmā bhūditi| atha `śriṣu śliṣu pruṣu pluṣu dāhe' (dhā.pā.701,704) ityetasya śliṣo grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? āliṅgane tasya vṛttyasambhavāt, `aniṭaḥ' (3.1.45) ityadhikārācca, asya seṭtvāt|| 47. na dṛśaḥ| (3.1.47) `adarśat' iti| aṅ| `ṛdaśo'ṅi guṇaḥ' (7.4.16) iti guṇaḥ| adrākṣīt' iti| `sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti' (6.1.58) ityamāgamaḥ| `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, pūrvavat ṣatvakatve|| 48. ṇiśridrusrubhyaḥ karttari caṅ| (3.1.48) `cakāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ' iti| `caṅi' (6.1.11) ityatrāṅītyacyamāne `asyativaktikhyātibhyo'ṅ (3.1.52) ityanenāpi vihite'ṅi dvirvacanaṃ syāt| `acīkarat, ajīharat' iti| `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti dvirvacanaṃ kṛhṛśabdayoḥ urattvam, `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam-- kakārasya cakāraḥ, hakārasyāpi jhakāraḥ, `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) iti jhakārasya jakāraḥ| śeṣamabhyudasīṣadadityanusāreṇa veditavyam| `aśiśriyat' ityādi| `śriñ sevāyām' (dhā.pā.897), `du dru gatau' (dhā.pā.944, 945), `sru gatau' (940), `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinā yathāyogamiyaṅuvaṅau| `akārayiṣatām' iti| karmaṇi dvivacanam, ātām, iḍguṇāyādeśaṣatvāni| `kamerupasaṃkhyānam' iti| nanu `kamerṇiṅ' (3.1.30) iti ṇiṅi kṛte ṇyantatvādeva kameścaṅ, siddhaḥ, tat kathamupasaṃkhyāyata ityāha-- `āyādayaḥ' ityādi| `acakamata'iti| anudāttettvādātmanepadam, pūrvavadabhyāsasya kutvam| `ṇiṅbhāvapakṣe sanvadbhāvaḥ' iti| na tvaṇiṅpakṣe iti darśayati; yasmāt `sanvallaghuni caṅ pare' (7.4.93) ityasya caṅ paro yasmāṇṇeḥ sa caṅparo tasmin parato yadaṅgaṃ tasyābhyayāsasya sanvat kāryaṃ bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ, na cāyamartho ṇiṅabhāvapakṣe sambhavati|| 49. vibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ| `adadhat' iti| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| pūrvavadabhyāsasya jaśtvaṃ dakāraḥ| `adhāsīt' iti| luṅ, sic, `yamaramanamātāṃ sak caṭa (7.2.73) itīṭ, prakṛteśca sagāgamaḥ, `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ, `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| `aśiśviyat' iti| pūrvavadiyaṅ| `aṅapyatra vikalpyate' iti| `jṝstambhu' (3.1.58) ityādisūtreṇa| `aśvat' iti| `śvayateraḥ' (7.4.18) ityatvam, `ato guṇe' (6.1.97), pararūpatvam| `aśvayīt' iti| hyantakṣaṇāśvasa' (7.2.5) ityādinā vṛddhipratiṣedhe kṛte guṇe'yādeśaḥ| `adhiṣātām' iti| karmaṇi dvivacanam, ātām, `sthāghvoricca' (1.2.17) iti kittvamittvañca| 50. gupeśchandasi| (3.1.50) `yatrāyapratyayo nāsti tatrāyaṃ vidhiḥ' iti| anāyapratyayāntakasyopādānāt| āyapratyayāntasya dhātvantaratvāt| `ajhūgupatam' iti| `gupū rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.395), luṅ, dvirvacanam,thas, `tasthastha' (3.4.101) ityādinā tam `dujādīnāṃ dīrgho'bhyāsasya' (6.1.7) iti dīrghaḥ| `agauptam' iti| `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sico lopaḥ,tasyāsiddhatvāt `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ| `agopiṣṭam' iti| ūdittvāt `svarati' (7.2.44) ityādinā pakṣe iṭ, `neṭi' (7.2.4) iti vṛddhau pratiṣiddhāyāṃ laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| `agopāyiṣṭam' iti| āyapratyayāntāt sic, iṭ, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48)|`rūpatrayam' iti| pāścātyam|| 51. nonayatidhvanayatyelayatyardayatibhyaḥ| (3.1.51) `ebhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ' iti| ūnayatyelayatibhyāṃ curādiṇyantābhyam| `pūrveṇa' iti| `śriṇi' (3.12.48) ityādinā| `aunayīt' iti| tip, sic, `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ, tasyāsiddhatvādvṛddhau prāptāyāṃ `hmyantalakṣaṇa' (7.2.5) iti pratiṣedhaḥ, guṇāyādeśau, `āḍajādīnām' (6.4.72) ityāṭ, `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| `auninat' iti| `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti dvirvacanam| ṇilopaḥ| `dhvanayīt' iti| dhvanayīdityatadeva nipātanādadantatvam, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48), tasya sthānivadbhāvāt `ata upādhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhirna bhavati| `bahulaṃ chandatyamāṅyoge'pi' (6.4.75) ityaḍniṣedhaḥ| `adidhvanat' iti| sanvadbhāvādittvam| `aililat' iti| `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti liśabdasya dvirvacanam, pūrvavadāṭ| `ārdidat' iti| ihāpi dvitīyasyaikāco dvarvacanaṃ pūrvavat| rephastu na dvirucyate; ` na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' (6.1.3) iti pratiṣedhāt| āṭ, vṛddhiḥ|| 52. asyativaktikhyātibhya'ṅ| (3.1.52) `brūñādeśo vā' iti| brūvo vaciḥ' (2.4.53) iti| `cakṣiṅādeśo vā' iti| ` cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ' (2.4.54) iti| `paryāsthata' iti| `upasargādasyatyūhyorvacanam' (vā.49) ityupasaṃkhyānātmanepadam| `asyatesthuk' (7.1.17)| `avocat' iti| `vaca um' (7.4.20) `ākhyat' iti| pūrvavadākāralopaḥ|| 53. lipisicihvaśca| (3.1.53) `ahvat' iti| pūrvavadākāralopaḥ| atha kimartho yogavibhāgaḥ, na `asyativaktikhyātilipisicihvaśca' ityeka eva yogaḥ kiyatāmityāha-- `pṛthak' ityādi| uttarasūtre lipiprabhṛtibhya evātmanepadeṣvaṅvikalpo yathā syādityevamartho yogavibhāgaḥ| eka yoge hyasyatyādīnāmapyuttaratrānuvṛttiḥ syāt tathā ca tebhyo'pi vikalpenāṅ prasajyeta|| 54. ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām| (3.1.54) `svaritañicaḥ' ityātmanepadam iti. lipisicyoḥ svaritettvāt, hvayatestu ñittvāt| `alipta, asikta' iti| `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sico lopaḥ, tasyā (8.2.26) siddhatvāllaghūpadhaguṇaḥ prāptaḥ, sa `liṅsicāvātmanepadeṣu' (1.2.11) iti kittvānna bhavati, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam|| 55. puṣādidyutādy‌lṛditaḥ parasmaipadeṣu| (3.1.55) lṛkāra idyeṣāṃ te lṛditaḥ| puṣādirastyeva bhāvādyantargaṇaḥ-- puṣa puṣṭau' (dhā.pā.700) śriṣu śliṣu pruṣu pluṣu dāhe' (dhā.pā.701-704) ityevamādiḥ, asti ca divādyantargaṇaḥ--`puṣa puṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1182), `śuṣa śoṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1183) ityevamādiḥ, asti ca kryādyantargaṇaḥ-- puṣa puṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1529), `muṣa steye' (dhā.pā.1530) ityevamādiḥ, tadiha kasya grahaṇamityāha-- `puṣādirdivādyantargaṇaḥ' ityādi. yadi bhvādyantargaṇo gṛhyate, puṣādyanantaraṃ dyutādīnāṃ pāṭhāt pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt; puṣādigrahaṇenaiva gṛhītatvāt, tasmāt sa tāvanna gṛhyate| kryādyantargaṇo'pi naiva gṛhyate, tatra hi catvāra eva paṭhyante dhātavaḥ-- pūrvoktau dvau `khaca bhūtaprādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1531), `graha upādāne' (dhā.pā.1533) ityetau, yadi caite jighṛkṣitāḥ syarlṛdita yaevaitān kuryāt, evaṃ puṣādigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati| tasmāt pāriśeṣyād divādyantargaṇānāṃ puṣādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| atha puṣādaya lṛditaḥ kasmānna kṛtāḥ ? na; na hi te lṛditaḥ śakyante karttum| lṛditve hi teṣāṃ udita āditaśca paṭha yante teṣām `udito vā' (7.2.56) `āditaśca' (7.2.16) ityetayoḥ kāryayorabhāvaḥ syāt| atha dyutādayaḥ kasmāt lṛdito na kṛtāḥ ? yata eva hetoḥ puṣādaya lṛdito na kṛtāstata eva dyutādayaśca| teṣvapi hi kecidudita āditaśca paṭhyante| tatra puṣādaya ādivādi parisamāpteḥ| yattu `ṣṇiha prītau' (dhā.pā.1200) ityanantaraṃ vṛditi vṛtkaraṇaṃ tad ravādīnāṃ parisamāptyartham, na puṣādīnāmityācāryāṇāṃ smṛtiḥ| dyutādayastu `kṛpū sāmarthye' (dhā.pā.762) ityevaṃparyantāḥ, tadanantaraṃ vṛt; `ghaṭa ceṣṭāyām' (dhā.pā.763) iti vṛtkaraṇāt| `adyutat' iti| `dyudbhyo luṅi' (1.3.91) iti pakṣe parasmaipadam| `aśvatat' iti| śvitā varṇe' (dhā.pā..742)| `agamat, aśakat' iti| `gamlṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.982), `śaklṛ śaktau' (dhā.pā.1261)| `vyadyotiṣṭa' iti| anudāttettvādātmanepadam| `aloṭiṣṭa' iti| `ruṭa luṭ pratīghāte' (dhā.pā.747,748)|| 56. sarttiśāstyattibhyaśca| (3.1.56) `asarat' iti| `ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ' (7.4.16)| `aśiṣat' iti| `śāsa idaṅ‌haloḥ' (6.4.34) itīttvam, `śāsivasi' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam| `ārat' iti| pūrvavad guṇaḥ, ajāditvādāṭ, savarṇadīrghaḥ| `pṛthaka' ityādi| yadi `puṣādidyutād‌lṛditsarttiśāstyasartibhyaśca' ityekayoga eva kriyeta; sarttiprabhṛtibhya parasmaipada eva syāt, nātmanepade| tasmādebhya evātmanepade'pi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ pṛthagyogakaraṇam| `samaranta' iti| sampūrvādartteḥ `samo gami' (1.3.29) ityādinātmanepadam| `bahulaṃ chandasyamāṅayoge'pi' (6.4.75) ityaḍāgamābhāvaḥ; chāndasatvādayasya prayogasya| nanu ca yadyātmanepadeṣvaṅa bhavatyeva, tat kiṃ parasmaipadeṣvityanukarṣaṇārthena cakāreṇetyāha-- `tacca' ityādi| taditi parasmaipadeṣvityetadapekṣate| `uttaratropayogaṃ yāsyati' iti| na tvihaivopayogaṃ yāti; anyathā pṛthagyogakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|| 57. irito vā| (3.1.57) iśca raśca irau, itau yasya ta irit| tatrekārasya `urajeṣe'janunāsika it' (1.3.2) itītsaṃjñā, rephasya `halantyam' (1.3.3) iti|atha vā irit yasyaiva samudāyasya tatyetsaṃjñā, na pratyekamavayavasya ? irityayaṃ samudāya itsaṃjñako yasya sa irit| samudāyasyetsaṃjñā'smādeva vacanādveditavyā| na hyanyena kenacit tasyetsaṃjñā vihitā| `abhaitsīt' iti| `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ| `aruddha, abhitta' iti| svaritettvādātmanepadam,pūrvavat sico lopaḥ|| 58. jṛstambhumrucumlucugrucuglucugluḍhañcuśvibhyaśca| (3.1.58) stambheruditkaraṇam `udito vā' (7.2.56) iti viśeṣaṇārtham. `astabhat' iti| `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `aśvat' ityādi| rūpatrayaṃ `vibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ' (3.1.49) ityatra vyutpāditam| `glucugluñsvoranyataropādāne rūpatrayaṃ sidhyati' iti| kathaṃ kṛtvā ? yadi tāvat glucirupādīyeta tasyāṅi sici cāglucat, aglocīdityetadrūpadvayaṃ sidhyati; gluñcestu sici tṛtīyamagluñcīditi| atha gluñcirupādīyeta, tasyāṅi sici cāglucat, agluñcīditi rūpadvayaṃ sidhyati| glucestu sici tṛtīyamaglocīditi| yadyevam, kimarthamubhayorupādānam, rūpatrayaṃ hi sādhyam, taccānyataropādāne'pi sidhyatyevetyata āha-- `arthabhedāt' ityādi| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| bhinno hyanayorarthaḥ| tatrānyatarasyopādāne ya eva nopādīyeta tatraivārthe'glucaditi na sidhyet| tasmādbhinnārthatvādadvyorupādānam| `kecit' ityādi| anekārthatvāddhātūnāmabhinnārthatā na viruddhyate| tasmādubhayorupādānagluñcaditi siddhya iti|| 59. kṛmṛdṛruhibhyaśchandasi| (3.1.59) `ḍukṛñ karaṇe' (dhā.pā.1472), `mṛṅa prāṇatyāge' (dhā.pā.1403), `dṛ vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1493), `huha {bījajanmaṇi prādurbhāve ca dhā.pā.} janmani' (dhā.pā.859)| tatrādyānāṃ trayāṇāṃ sici prāpte, ruheśca `śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ' (3.1.45) iti kse prāpte| `akarat' iti| pūrvavad‌guṇaḥ| `amarat' iti| vyatyayena parasmaipadam| bhāṣāyāṃ tu akārṣīt, amṛta, adārīt, arukṣaditi bhavati|| 60. ciṇ te padaḥ| (3.1.60) `sāmarthyāt' ityādi| taśabdo| ñayamastyevātmanepadaikavacam, asti ca parasmaipadamadhyamapuruṣabahuvacanaṃ yasyasya sthāne vidhīyate; tatrāsya dhātorātmanepaditvāt parasmaipadabahuvacanaṃ na sambhavati, ataḥ pāriśeṣyāvātmanepadaikavacanasya grahaṇam| iyameva ca pāriśeṣyasiddhiḥ sāmarthyam| `udapādi' iti| `ciṇo luk' (6.4.104) iti taśabdasya luk| `udapatsātām' iti| ātām, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti carttvam| `udapatsata' iti| jhe `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityadādeśaḥ| iha veti nivṛttam| uttaratrānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇāt|| 61. dīpajanabudhapūritāyipyāyibhyo'nyatarasyām| (3.1.61) `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149), `budha avagamane' (dhā.pā.1172) iti| etena `jana janane' (dhā.pā.1105), `{ budhir bodhane dhā.pā.875 bhvādigataḥ (858) divādigataśca (1172) `budha avabodhane' ityeva paṭhyate| `adugdha' iti| `śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ' (3.1.45) iti ksaḥ, tasya `ksasyāci' (7.3.72) ityataḥ `ksasya' ityanuvarttamāne `lugvā duhadiha' (7.3.73) iti luk| `dāderdhātorghaḥ' (8.2.32) pūrvavajjaśtvam| `adohi' iti| śuddhe karmaṇi taśabdaḥ, tenātra nityaṃ ciṇ bhavati|| 64. na rudhaḥ| (3.1.64) karmavadityatideśe prāptasya ciṇo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `aruddha' iti| `jhalo jhali' (8.2.2) iti sico lopaḥ; tasyāsiddhatvāllaghūpadhaguṇaḥ prāptaḥ `liṅasicāvātmanepadeṣu' (1.2.11) iti kittvānna bhavati| pūrvavad‌dhatvajaśtve|| 65. tapo'nutāpe ca| (3.1.65) `tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva' (3.1.88) ityatideśāt `ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (3.1.66) iti prāptasya ciṇo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `atapta tapastāpasaḥ' iti| upavāsādilakṣaṇaṃ tapastāpasaṃ tapati duḥkhayatītyarthaḥ| tapaso'tra karttṛtvam, tāpasasya tu karmatvam| yadā tu sa tāpastvagasthībhūtaḥ svargāya tapastapyate, tadāyaṃ prayogaḥ- atapta tapastāpasa iti| idānāṃ tapasaḥ karmatvaṃ tāpasasya karttṛtvam| tapaḥśabdaśceha jñānaviśeṣe svargādyavāptihetau varttate| tapirapyarjane| arjitavān jñānaviśeṣaṃ tāpasa ityarthaḥ| `anvavātapta pāpena karmaṇā' iti| yat pūrvaṃ pāpakarma kṛtaṃ tena paścāt tapto'bhyāhata ityarthaḥ| karmaṇyatra lakāraḥ|| 66. ciṇ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ| (3.1.66) `bhāvakarmaṇorarthayoḥ' iti| taśabdasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇam| `bhāvakarmaṇoryastaśabdaḥ' iti| atha ciṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā `ciṇ te padaḥ' (3.1.60) ityataściṇgrahaṇamanuvarttata eva ? syādetat-- `dīpajana' (3.1.61) ityanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena `na rudhaḥ' (3.1.64) iti niṣedhena ca sambaddhaṃ tat, ato yadi tadanuvartteta tatsambaddhamevānuvartteteti, etacca nāsti; anayatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya pūrvayoreva yogayornivartitatvāt, prāptipūrvakatvācca niṣedhasya| yadi bhāvakarmaṇościṇaḥ prāptiḥ syāt, tadā tatpratiṣedhārthaṃ netyasyānuvṛttiḥ syāt| na ca tayostasya kenacit prāptiḥ; ciṇvidhau sarvatra karttarityanuvṛtteḥ| tadapārthakaṃ punaściṇgrahaṇamityāha-- `ciṇgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham' iti| asati ciṇgrahaṇe mandadhiyaḥ pratipattigauravaṃ syāt, atastamanugrahītuṃ nyāyaprāptasyaivārthasya spaṣṭīkaraṇāya punaściṇgrahaṇam|| 67. sārvadhātuke yak| (3.1.67) bhāvakarmaṇorityanuvarttate,tacceha sārvadhātukasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayannāha-- `bhāvakarmavācini' ityādi| bhāvakarmaṇorarthayorvarttate yat sārvadhātukaṃ tadbhāvakarmavāci| tācchīlya āvaśnake ṇiniḥ| athaivaṃ kasmānna bhavati-- bhāvakarmaṇorabhidheyayoḥ sārvadhātuke parato yagbhavatīti ? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; sārvadhātukavācyatvena bhāvakarmaṇoḥ śāstre pratijñānāt| kuta etaditi cet ? `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) iti vacanāt| nanu cākāri kaṭo bhavatā, aśāyi bhavatā, abibharbhavānityādau sārvadhātukābhāve'pi karmādīnāṃ pratīyamānatvāt sārvadhātukārthatā nopapadyate; na hi yo yadabhāve pratīyate sa tasyārtho yujyate, anvayavyatirekasamadhigamyatvādarthasya ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hyayaṃ niyamaḥ-- anvayavyatirekasamadhigamyatvādarthavattayā| bhavitavyamiti, kiṃ tarhi ? pratijñā| prāpitā ca sā bhavati yathā kvibādīnām| asti ca sārvadhātukasyeti yatkiñcidetat| `śayyate' iti|`ayaṅayi kṅiti' (7.4.22) ityayaṅādeśaḥ| `yayagvidhāne' ityādi| nanu ca karmavadityatideśādeva yagbhaviṣyatīti kimupasaṃkhyānenetyata āha-- `vipratiṣedhāddhi' ityādi| `karttari śap' (3.1.68) ityasyāvakāśaḥ-- śuddhaḥ karttā bhavatīti; `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67) ityasyāvakāśaḥ- śuddhaṃ karma, pacyata odana iti| pacyata odanaḥ svayamevetyatra karmavadbhāvādyak‌ prāpnoti, vatkaraṇāt svāśrayakamapi yathā syāditi karttṛtvasya sambhavācchabapi, tatra paratvācchabeva syāt| śaśāstraṃ yakśāstrāt paraṃ bhavati, tasmāt karmakarttari yaka upasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| pratipādanaṃ tvidam -- jñāpakāt karmakarttaryapi yagbhaviṣyatīti| kiṃ tajjñāpakam ? `na duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau' (3.1.89) iti pratiṣedhaḥ| yadi hi karmakarttari yagna syāt pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| vipratiṣedhāddhi śapo balīyastvaṃ śāstrātideśatvamabhyapetyoktam, na tvasau śāstrātideśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? kāryātideśaḥ| kāryātideśasūtrameva svatantraṃ yagādeḥ kāryasya vidhāyakam, tacca param; ato vipratiṣedhādyaka eva balīyastvam|| 68. karttari śap| (3.1.68) ` pakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| `anudāttau suppitau' (3.1.4) ityanudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| `śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ' iti| `tiṅaśitsārvadhātukam' (3.4.113) iti sārvadhātukatvaṃ yathā syāt| śyanprabhṛtīnāmapi śakārasyaitat prayojanaṃ veditavyam|| 69. divādabhyaḥ śyan| (3.1.69) `śapo'pavādaḥ' iti| tatprāptāvevāsyārambhāt| `nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| `ñnityādirnityam' (6.1.197) iti padasyādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| `dīvyati' iti| `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ|| 70. vā bhrāśabhlāśabhramutrasitruṭiṣaḥ| (3.1.70) `sanoti, kṣaṇoti' iti| `ṣaṇu dāne (dhā.pā.1464), kṣaṇu hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1465)| `niyamārtham' iti|etadeva tanādikāryaṃ yathā syādityeṣa niyamo yathā syāt| anyat tanādikāryaṃ tadabhāvam| asati hi niyamārthe yathānyebhyastanādibhyo vibhāṣā sicastathāsorlug bhavati-- atata, atathāḥ, ataniṣṭa, ataniṣṭhāḥ, tathā karoterapi syāt| asmiṃstu sati na bhavati, tadabhāve ca `hrasvādaṅgāt' (8.2.27) ityāṣṭamika eva lopo bhavati-- akṛta, akṛthāḥ| nanu satyapi tasmiṃstanādikārye naiva kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate, alukpakṣe'pi `hrasvāt' (8.2.27) iti lopapravṛtteḥ ? naitat; nāprāpte sico lope lugārabhyamāṇastasya bādhakaḥ syāt| `pūrvatrāsiddham' (8.2.1) ityāsiddhatvādayuktā lopabādhetyetanāśaṅkanīyam; yasmādvakṣyatyetat‌-- `nāstyapavādeṣvasiddhatvam, apavādavacanaprāmāṇyāt' iti| yadi tarhi karoteranyat tanādikāryaṃ neṣyate, kasmāt tarhi bhvādāveva paṭhitaḥ ? kaḥ punarevaṃ lāghavakṛto viśeṣaḥ| bhvādāvapi pāṭhe niyogato'sya vikaraṇavidhau grahaṇaṃ karttavyamityadeśyametat|| 80. dhinvikṛṇvyora ca| (3.1.80) bhvāditvācchapi prāpte vacanam| `akārādeśo bhavati' iti| alo'ntyasya (1.1.52) paribhāṣayā| `dhinoti' iti| `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48)| atha laghūpadhaguṇo'tra kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `allopasya' ityādi| `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) ityallopasya sthānivadbhāvanādanupadhatvādikārasya guṇo na bhavati| lāghavārathaṃ `dhivikṛvyoḥ' iti vaktavye numanuṣaktayorgrahaṇaṃ kṛtamupadeśāvasthāyāmeva numbhavatīti jñāpanārtham| tena numvidhāvupadeśivadvacanamiṣṭasvarasiddhyarthamiti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati|| 81. kryādibhyaḥ śnā| (3.1.81) 82. stambhustumbhuskambhuskumbhuskuñbhyaḥ śnuśca| (3.1.82) cakāraḥ śnānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `stabhnāti' iti| ādau `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ| śnuśnābhyāṃ saha nirdeśāt tadviṣayataivaiṣāṃ dhātūnāmiti kasyacidbhrānti syāt| atastannirākarttumāha-- `udittvapratipādanāt' ityādi| eṣāṃ hyukāra itsaṃjñakaḥ pratijñāyate, tasya ktvāpratyaya iḍ‌vikalpaḥ phalam| yadi ta etadvikaraṇaviṣayāḥ syuḥ, uditkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmāduditkaraṇapratijñānāt sarvārthatvameṣāmavasīyate| arthaśabdo'yaṃ viṣayavācī| sarvaviṣayatvamityarthaḥ|| 83. halaḥ śnaḥ śānajjhau| (3.1. 83) `puṣāṇa, muṣāṇa' iti| vidhyādau loṭ, `serhyapicca' (3.4.87), kryāditvāc śnā, tasyānena śānac| cakāro'ntodāttārthaḥ| `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti herluk| `krīṇīhi' iti| `ī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itīttvam| nanu ca śnāpratyayasya prakṛtatvāt sa eveha sthānitvena vijñāsyate, tat kimarthaḥ `śnaḥ' iti nirdeśa ityāha-- `śna iti sthāninirdeśaḥ' ityādi| śānacśabdo'yamādeśa ityeṣa saṃpratyayo yathā sthādityevamarthaḥ śna iti nirdeśaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasati tasminneva saṃpratyayo na syādityata āha-- `pratyayāntaraṃ hi' ityādi| sarve dhātavo'nyagaṇapaṭhitā api viṣayo yasya tattathoktam|`śnaḥ' ityasmin hyasati sthānirdeśe śnāpratyayasyānuvṛttirna jñāyet| tataśca sarvebhyo dhātubhyo halantebhyaḥ śānajapavādaḥ pratyayo bhavati tasya ca śānajādeśaḥ, tadā miderguṇo mā bhūt; itarathā hyayaṃ guṇaḥ pratiṣedhaviṣaya ārabhyamāṇo yatheha bhavati-- medhyatīti, tathehāpi syāt-- midāna iti| punaḥ śitkaraṇe tu `sārvadhātukamapit' (1.2.4) iti ṅittvamapi punaḥ pravarttate| tena mideḥ prataṣedhaviṣaye'pi guṇa ārabhyamāṇa iha na bhavati|| 84. chandasi śāyajapi| (3.1.84) `atrāpi cit-- śit‌karaṇayoḥ pūrvoktameva prayojanam| `{nāsti kāśikāyām|} gṛhāṇ' iti| `grahaṇa upādāne' (dhā.pā.1533) loṭ, sip; hiḥ, tataḥ śnā,tasya śānac, herluk (6.4.105), grahyādīnā (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam| `gṛbhāya' iti, kvacit pāṭhaḥ| tatra `hṛgrahorbhaśchandasi' (vā. 8.2.32) iti bhatvam| `badhāna'iti| `bandha bandhane' (dhā.pā.1508) `aniditām' (6.4.24) iti nalopaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|| 85. vyatyayo bahulam| (3.1.85) `yathāyathama' iti. yo yasyātmīyo viṣayaḥ - yathāyatham| yasmin yasmin viṣaya ityarthaḥ| kiṃ punarayaṃ vyatyayo nāmetyāha-- `vyatigamanaṃ vyatyayaḥ' iti| tameva vyatyayaṃ spaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `{vyatihāraḥ-kāśikā} vyatikaraḥ' ityādi| `kvacit' ityādinā vyatyasya prakārāntaraṃ darśayati| `bhedati' iti| śnamo viṣaye śapo vidhānam| `marati' tyatrāpi śaviṣaye śap, parasmaipadañca vyatyayenaiva| `mriyate' iti| pūrvavadriṅa, tasyeyaṅa| `neṣatu' iti| nayaterloṭ, tip, `eruḥ' (3.4.86) sip, tasmāt paraḥ śap, dhātorguṇaḥ, sipaḥ ṣatvam| trivikaraṇatāyāstūdāharaṇam-- `{taruṣema vṛtram‌' -- kāśikā} taruṣema dṛṣadam' iti| taraterāśiṣi liṅ, mas, `nityaṃ ṅit, (3.4.99) itivasmasoḥ salopaḥ, yāsuṭ, `chandasyubhayathā' (3.4.117) iti sārvadhātukatvālliṅa upratyayaḥ, tasmāt paraḥ sip, tasmādapi paro'ṅa, dhātorguṇaḥ, sipaḥ ṣatvam, `ato yeyaḥ' (7.2.80)itīyādeśaḥ| aṅā saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), `liṅaḥ salopo'nantasya' (6.1.79) iti salopaḥ| `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yalopaḥ| atha `vyatyayaḥ' ityetāvat kataṃ noktam,kiṃ bahulagrahaṇena, pūrvasūtrāddhyapiśabdasyānuvṛttau satyāṃ chandasi vyatyayo bhavati, apiśabdādyathāprāptañceti, evamabhisambandhe kriyamāṇe'ntareṇāpi bahulagrahaṇaṃ sarvamiṣṭaṃ sidhyayatyevetyata āha-- ` bahulagrahaṇam' ityādi| sarvasya prakṛtasyāprakṛtasya vidhervyabhicāro vyatyayalakṣaṇo yathā syādityevamartha bahulam, itarathā hyasati bahulagrahaṇe prakṛtānāmeva syādīnāṃ śānac‌paryantānāṃ syāt, nānyeṣāṃ śnamprabhṛtīnām, iṣyate ca teṣāmapi| sa bahulagrahaṇa eva sati labhyate| etamevārthaṃ darśayitumāha-- `suptiṅupagraha' ityādi| tatar supāṃ vyatyayaḥ-- dhuri dakṣiṇāyāmiti prāpte saptamyā viṣaye ṣaṣṭhī| tiṅām-- ye yūpāya takṣati| takṣantīti prāpte| lādeśavyaṅgyakriyāviśeṣo mukhya upagrahaḥ| iha tu tadvyaktinimittatvāt parasmaipadātmanedayorupagrahaśabdo varttate| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- ātmanepadaparasamaipadayorvyatyaya iti| sa brahmacāriṇamicchate, pratītamanyadagniṃ yudhyati| icchati, badhyata iti prāpte| liṅgasya-- madhostṛptā ivāsata iti| madhuna iti prāpte| narasya - prathamapuruṣādeḥ-- atopacārairdaśabhirviyūyāya iti| viyūyāditi prathamapuruṣaviṣaye madhyamapuruṣaḥ, `yu miśraṇe' (dhā.pā. 1033), vipūrvādāśiṣi liṅa, sip, yāsuṭ, `akṛtsārva dhātukayoḥ' (7.4.24) iti dīrghaḥ, `skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti salopaḥ| kālasya-- so'gnīnādhāsyamānena| luṭo viṣaye luṭ; kālaśabdo'tra kālaviṣayatvālluḍādipratyayeṣu varttate| na hi mukhyakālasya vyatyayaḥ śakyate karttum| halām-- śuphitaṃ mukhabījam| śubhitamiti prāpte| `śubha śumbha śobhārthe' (dhā.pā.1321,1322) niṣṭhā, iṭ, bhakārasay phakāraḥ| acām-- upagāyantu māṃ patnayo garbhiṇayaḥ| patnyo garbhiṇya iti prāpte| īkārasya ikāraḥ| svarāṇām-- `anto'vatyā' (6.1.220) ityantodāttatvaṃ yatheha bhavati-- aśvavatīṃ somavatīṃ prajāvatīṃ sūryavatīṃ dṛṣadamita, tathehāpi syāt-- aśvavatī somavatī prajāvatī| vyatyaye tu satyaśvaśabdasya prakṛtisvara eva bhavati| kaḥ punaḥ prakṛtisvaraḥ ? ādyudāttatvam| tathā hi ṅīpo'nudāttatvaṃ pittvāt| matupo'pyata eva| `{aśūpruṣipluṣilaṭikaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan' iti da.u.sūtram} aśūpruṣilaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan' (da.u.8.125) iti kvanpratyayāntatvāt nitsvareṇādyudātto'śvaśabdaḥ| karttṛgarhaṇaṃ kārakopalakṣaṇārtham| kārakāṇāṃ vyatyaya ityarthaḥ| āsādayadbhirubhayorvedāḥ| āsādayadbhya iti prāpte sampradānasya karaṇatvam| `yaṅa' iti pratyāhāragrahaṇārtham-- `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67) iti yaka ārabhya `liṅyāśiṣyaṅa' (3.1.86) ityato ṅakāreṇa| yagādīnāṃ pratyayānāmaṅaparyantānāṃ vyatyaya ityarthaḥ| muṇḍā śuṣmasya bhedatīti| śnami prāpte śap| eṣāṃ śapprabhṛtīnāṃ vyatyayamicchati śāstrakṛt-- pāṇiniḥ| `so'pi ca sidhyati bāhulakena' apiśabdāt syādivyatyayaḥ| bāhulasya bhāvo bāhulakam, dvandvamanojñāditvādvuñ (5.1.133)| caśabdo hetau| yasmādevaṃ prakṛtānāmaprakṛtānāñtaca bāhulakena vyatyayaḥ sidhyati tasmādbahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti|| 86. liṅyāśiṣyaṅ| (3.1.86) `śapo'pavādaḥ' iti| nanu cāśiṣi yo liṅa vihitastasya `liṅāśiṣi' (3.4.116) ityārthadhātukasaṃjñā, sārvadhātuke ca śab‌vihitaḥ, tatkathaṃ śapo'pavāda ityāha-- `chandasyubhayathā' ityādi| sthādibhya evātra dṛśyate,nānyebhya ityabhiprāyeṇāha-- `sthāgāgami' ityādi. `upastheyam' iti|upapūrvāttiṣṭhaterāśiṣi liṅa, mip, tasya `tasthas' (3.4.101) ityādinā'mādeśaḥ, yāsuṭ, ubhayasaṃjñātvena sārvadhātukatvāt `liṅa salopo'nantyasya' (7.2.79) iti salopaḥ| kvacit `upastheṣam' iti pāṭhaḥ| tatrārddhadhātukatvāt salopābhāvaḥ, vali yalopaḥ| `upageyam' iti| `gai śabde' (dhā.pā.917) `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityāttvam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| `gamema' iti| gameḥ parasya liṅo mas, `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' (3.4.99) iti salopaḥ| yāsuḍādi sarva pūrvavat| `voceyam' iti| `vaca bhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1842)| sip, tasyām, aṅa, aṅi parataḥ `vaca um' (7.4.20), `yā' ityasya iy, ubhayatra `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `videyam' iti| `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064)| `śakeyam' iti| `śaklṛ śaktau' (dhā.pā.1261)| `āruheyam' iti| `ruha {bījajanmaṇi prādurbhāve-- dhā.pā.} janmani (dha.pā.859) iyādeśādi sarva pūrvavat| `dṛśeragvaktavyaḥ' iti| aṅi hi sati `ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ' (7.4.16) iti guṇaḥ syāt| tathā ca dṛśeyamiti na sidhyet| aki tu sati kittvādguṇābhāvo bhavati| tasmādagvaktavyaḥ - vyākhyeyaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu bahulagrahaṇānuvṛttervaktavyam|| 87. karmatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ| (3.1.87) `karmavat' iti| `tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ' (5.1.115) iti; na tu `tatra tasyeva' (5.1.116) iti; tulyakriya iti prathamānirdeśāt| anyathā tulyakriye, tulyakriyasyati saptamyā ṣaṣṭhyā vā nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| tulyākriyā'syeti tulyakriyaḥ| kena tulyakriyaḥ ? karmaṇā| sāpekṣatve'pi gamakatvāt samāsaḥ| tulyaśabdo'yaṃ sadṛśavacanaḥ| na ca sādhanasya karmaṇaḥ kriyayā sādṛśyamupapadyate; atyantabhedāt| tathā hi-- karma dravyaṃ pariniṣpannam| tdaviparītasvabhāvā kriyā| tasmāt karmaṇeti karmaśabdo'yaṃ gauṇastātsthyādupacāreṇa karmasthāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ varttate, yathā-- mañcāḥ krośantīti, atra mañcaśabdaḥ puruṣeṣu| upacārastu karmasthabāvakānāṃ karmasthakriyāñca karmavadbhāvo yathā syāt, kartṛsthabhāvakānāṃ kartṛsthakriyāṇāṃ ca mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| etatsarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvāha-- `karmaṇi kriyā karma' iti| etena karmaśabdo'yaṃ karsthakriyāvācītyācaṣṭe| karmasthakriyāvācini ca karmaśabde yaḥ sūtrārthaḥ sampadyate taṃ darśayitumāha-- `karmasthayā' ityādi| evaṃ sthite sūtrārthe tulyaśabdo'yaṃ sādhāraṇavacana iti manyamāno yo deśayet-- `yadi karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ sādhāraṇakriyaḥ karttā karmavadbhavati tadā pacatyodanaṃ devadatta ityatrāpi syāt; yasmādihāpi yāsau pradhānakriyā tāmuddiśya sarvāṇi kārakadravyāṇi pravarttante, tayākarmasthayā pravarttante, tayākarmasthayā sādhāraṇakriyaḥ karttā bhavati, yathaiva hyasāvanyeṣāṃ kārakāṇāṃ sambandhinī tathā kartturapi' iti, taṃ pratyāha-- `yasmin karmaṇi' ityādi| tadvadyathāśabdau sādṛśyārthau prayuñjānaḥ `sadṛśavacano'yaṃ tulyaśabda-,na sādhāraṇavacanaḥ' ityācaṣṭe| yasmin karmaṇi karttṛbhūte'pi kartravasthāṃ pratapanne'pi tādṛśī kriyā lakṣyate yādṛśī karmāvasthāyāṃ sa kartā karmavadbhavati| sādṛśyañca kañcidbhedādhiṣṭānamityasādhāraṇa evādhiśrayaṇādilakṣaṇaḥ karttṛvyāpāro gṛhyate, na tu sādhāraṇo vikledādilakṣaṇaḥ| sa cāsādhāraṇaḥ pacacyodanaṃ devadatta ityatra kārakāntaravyāpāravisadṛśo devadattasya kartturvyāpāra iti na bhavati karmavadbhāvaḥ| atha vā-- karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ karttā karmavadbhavatītyukte sadṛśavacanastulyaśabda iti manyamāno yo deśayet-- `yadyevam, bhidyamānaḥ kusūlaḥ pātrāṇi bhinattītyatrāpi prāpnoti, tathā hi yādṛśī pātreṣvavayavavibhāgātmikā kriyā tādṛśyeva kusūle karttari lakṣyate' ityasmin pūrvapakṣa idamāha-- `yasmin karmaṇi' ityādi| sa ityanena yasminnityanena yo'rtho nirdiṣṭaḥ sa eva pratyavamṛśyate| etenaikadravyādhārayaiva karmasthayākriyayā tulyakriyaḥ karttā karmavadbhavatīti darśayan pūrvapakṣaṃ pratikṣipati| evacca pratyāsatternyāyāllabhyate| ekadravyasamavāyino hi kriyā pratyāsannā, dravyāntarasamavetā tu viprakṛṣṭā| nanu ca śaktiḥ kārakamiti darśanam, na ca karmaśaktiḥ kadāpi karttṛbhāvamāpadyate, tadayuktamuktam-- yasmin karmaṇi karttṛbhūte'pīti ? śaktiśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣāyāṃ śaktyādhāraṃ dravyamevaitaduktamityadoṣaḥ| idaṃ tarhyayuktamuktam-- `tadvat kriyā lakṣyate yathā karmaṇi' iti| yasmādya eva karmāvasthāyāṃ vyāpāraḥ sa eva kartravasthāyāmapīti sādṛśyaṃ nopapadyate, tasya bhedādhiṣṭhāne sati sattvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avasthābhedena kriyābedādyadyapyavasthāvad‌dravyamabhinnam, tathāpyavasthābhedo'sti-- anyaiva hi kartravasthā,anyā ca karmāvasthā| avasthābhedena kriyābheda iti tadadhiṣṭhānaṃ sādṛśyaṃ bhavati| ihātideśo nimitta-- vyapadeśa--śāstra-- kāryabhedādanekavidhaḥ| tatreha nimittātideśo na bhavati, na hi karmaṇo yannimittaṃ kartturopsitatamatvaṃ tat karttaryatideṣṭuṃ śakyate; vastvantaradharmāṇāṃ vastvantareṇa viruddhadharmiṇā sambandhābhāvāt| vyapadeśātideśastu saṃjñāpakṣānna bhidyate| saṃjñāpakṣe tu vakṣyamāṇo doṣaḥ, vatigrahaṇañcānarthakaṃ syāt| śāstrātideśapakṣe tu śāstramatidiśyate, tasminnatidiṣṭe taireva śāstrairyagādayaḥ prāpyante; tataśca yadyayaṃ śāstrātideśaḥ syāt karmakartari paratvācchabādayo bādhakāḥ syuḥ, tatra pratividheyaṃ syāt| kāryātideśe tvanenaiva yagādayo vidhīyante| tena yena kartrāśrayāḥ karmakarttari śabādayaḥ prāpnuvanti te paratvādyagādibhirbādhyanta iti na kiñcitpratividhātavyam| pradhānaṃ tu kāryātideśaḥ; tadarthatvanādatideśaśāstrāṇām| ataḥ kāryātideśatāmasya darśayannāha-- `karmāśrayāṇi' ityādi| nanu ca `tulyakriyaḥ' iti prathamānirdeśāt tadantasya karturatideśo vijñāyate, na ca sūtre karttṛgrahaṇamasti| yadyapi ca prakṛtaṃ tadapi saptamyantam, prathamānirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ tatkathaṃ prathamāntakarttṛgrahaṇamantareṇa śakyate'tideśaḥ karttumityāha-- `karttari' ityādi| kiṃ punarasyātideśasya prayojanamityāha-- `yagātmanepada' ityādi| `bhidyate' iti yaka udāharaṇam| `abheri' iti ciṇaḥ| `kāriṣyate' iti ciṣvadbhāvasya| karmaṇi hi `syasicsīyuṭ' (6.4.62) ityādinā ciṇvadbhāvo vihitaḥ| ātmanepadasya tu sarvāṇyevaitānyadāharaṇāni| `svāśrayamapi' ityādi| yadvināpyatideśo na bhavati tat svāśrayam, tadyathā syādityevamarthaṃ vatkaraṇam| asati hi tasmin saṃjñāsūtramidaṃ syāt, tataśca karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ karttā karmasaṃjñakaḥ syāt| evañca sati sakarmakatvāt `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) iti bhāve lakāro na syāt| vatkaraṇe tu satyatideśo bhavati| tena cāprāptameva karttuḥ karma kāryaṃ bhavati, na svāśrayaṃ karttṛtvam| akarmakasvabhāvatvamapanīyate, tatra tasyā vyāpārāt| etenākarmakāṇāṃ bhāve laḥ siddho bhavati-- bhidyate kusūneti| atha bhidyate kusūlaḥ svayamevetyatra kusūlaśabdāddvitīyā kasmānna bhavati, etadapi karma kāryaṃ bhavatyata āha-- `liṅyāśiṣyaṅiti' ityādi| dvau lakārau yasmin sa dvilakāro nirdeśaḥ| yadi dvilakārako nirdeśastadā kimityāha-- `tatra' ityādi| kāryaṃ pratītyadhyāhāryam| dvilakāranirdeśe sati `liṅyāśiṣyaṅa' (3.1.86) ityato lānuvṛttelantisyaiva kāryaṃ prati karttā karmavadbhavati, na tu prātipadikasya| itikaraṇo hetau| yata evaṃ tasmāt kusūlāddvitīyā na bhavati| `karaṇādhikaraṇābhyām' iti| karmaṇetyasatyasmin karaṇādhikaraṇasthayāpi kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ karttā karmavat syāt, asmiṃstu sati na bhavati| `sādhvasiśchinatti' iti| kaṇasya karttṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ karaṇasthayāpi kriyayā chedyadravyāntaḥpraveśalakṣaṇayā tulyakriyo'trāsiḥ karttā| `sādhu sthālī pacati' iti| atrādhikaraṇasya karttṛtvavivakṣāyāmadhikaraṇasthayā kriyayā sambhavati dhāraṇātmikayā tulyakriyaḥ karttā| atheha kasmānna bhavati-- pacatyodanaṃ devadattaḥ, rādhyatyodanaḥ svayameveti; bhavati hyatrāpi karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ karttā, tathā hi yādṛśyodene karmabhūte kriyā vikledanalakṣaṇā lakṣyate tādṛśyeva karttṛbhūte'pi, pacatirādhyatyorekārthatvādityāha-- `dhātvadhikārāt' ityādi| samānaśabdo'yamekaparyāyaḥ, yathā-- devadattayajñadattayoḥ samānā māteti| ekā māteti gamyate| `dhātorekācaḥ' (3.1.22) ityato dhātugrahaṇamanuvarttate| karmādiśabdāśca sambandhiśabdāḥ,ye ca sambandhiśabdāste prakṛtyaiva niyatarūpaṃ sambandhinamupasthāpayanti| tathā hi-- mātari bhaktyā pravartitavyāmityukte'ntareṇāpi svasyāmiti vacanaṃ svasyāṃ mātarīti gamyate| tena yaṃ dhātumapekṣya tasya karmaṇaḥ karttṛtvaṃ tameva dhātuṃ sannidhāpayati, nānyam| tataśca dhātugrahaṇe'nuvarttamāne satyayamartho labhyate| yasmin dhātau karmaṇopasthāpite yat karama tasminneva dhātau sa yadi karttā bhavatyevaṃ satyayamatideśaḥ, nānyathā| tena pacatyodanaṃ devadattaḥ,rādhyatyodanaḥ svayamevetyatra na bhavati, bhinnayordhātvorodanasya karmakarttṛtvāsambhavāt| atha vā-- dhātoriti yeyamekā saṃkhyā sā vivakṣitā, tenaikasminneva dhātau karmavadbhāvo bhavati| `karmasthabhāvakānām' ityādinā nyāyaprāptamevārthaṃ darśayati|tathā hi-- karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyasya karttuḥ karmavadbhāvo bhavati| na ca karttṛsthabhāvakānāṃ karttṛsthakriyāṇāṃ karttā tathāvidho'sti| yadyapi kriyāpyupādīyate, `lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' (3.2.126) ityatra ca bhāvo'pi parigṛhyate; tathāpīha dvayorupādānasāmarthyādarthabhedo draṣṭavyaḥ| sā parispandanasādhanasādhyā kriyā kriyāśabdenocyate, aparispandanasādhyā tu bhāvaśabdena| yeṣāṃ karmasthobhāvaḥ karmasthā ca kriyā; yeṣāṃ karttṛstho bhāvaḥ karttasthā ca kriyā, teṣāmudāharaṇaṃ darśayitumāha-- `karmasthaḥ pacaterbhāvaḥ' iti| pacyate ghaṭaḥ svayamevetyatra yadā taddeśasthaghaṭakarmakapāko niṣpadyate tadā'parispandanasādhanasādhyasvabhāvaḥ pākaḥ karttastho bhavati, yadā tu deśāntaraṃ gacchataḥ pākadravyasya pākābhinirvṛttirbhavati tadā karmasthaiva paceḥ kriyā, yathā -- pacyata odana ityatrodāharaṇe| `karmasthā ṭaca bhideḥ kriyā' iti| bhidyate kusūlaḥ-- svayameveti| avayavavibhāgalakṣaṇā hi bhideḥ kriyā,sā ca daśāntaraprāptau satyāṃ bhavatīti bhidyate parispandaḥ,tena karmasthā kriyā bhavati| `māsāsibhāvaḥ karttasthaḥ' iti| āserdhātorbhāva asibhāvaḥ| āsanaṃ hi bhāvaḥ; tasyāḥ parispandanasādhanasādhyatvāt| tathā hi-- vyāpāroparatāvāsta iti prayujyate| māsasahacarita āsibhāvaḥ| śākapārthivāditvāt samāsaḥ-- māsāsibhāvaḥ| kadā sa māsasahacarita āsibhāvo bhavati ? yadā māsamāsta iti prayujyate| māsamiti karmaṇi dvitīyā| karmasaṃjñā tu `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ kramasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām' (vā.1.4.51) iti vacanāt| māsāsibhāvaḥ karttastho bhavati, āsitari samavāyāt| tenāsyate māsaḥ svayameveti na bhavati| `karttṛsthā ca gameḥ kriyā' iti| gamanaṃ pāda viharaṇātmakam| tacca parispandanasā nasādhyatvācca kriyā, sā ca gantari devadattādau samavetā, na karmaṇi grāmādau| tena karmasthakriyābhāvādgamyate grāmaḥ svayameveti na bhavati|| 88. tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva| (3.1.88) `tapaḥ karmakasyaiva' iti| evakāro vispaṣṭārthaḥ; vyavacchedaphalatvāt, sarvavākyānāmityevaṃ tadarthasya labdhatvāt| yadi hyatapaḥkarmakasyāpi syāt, tapaḥkarmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `nānyakarmakasya' ityavadhāraṇena yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayati| `kriyābhedāt' iti| kriyāvisadṛśatvādityarthaḥ| pūrvaṃ hi kriyāsādṛśye karmavadbhāvo vihita iti vaisadṛśyena prāpnoti, ato vidhyarthametat| ata eva karmasthayā kriyayā tulyatvaṃ na sambhavatīti `karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' (3.1.87) ityetannānuvarttate| `upavāsādīni' ityādinā tameva kriyābhedaṃ darśayati| upavāsādiśabdena tapaḥ śabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| `duḥkhayantītyarthaḥ' ityanena tāpasasya karmāvasthāyāṃ taperduḥkhanamartha iti darśayati| `svargāya tapastapyate' iti| tapaḥśabdo'tra jñānaviṣeya svargādyavāptihetau varttate| `arjayītyarthaḥ'ityanena tāpasasya kartravasthāyāṃ tapirarjane varttata iti darśayati| nivarttayatītyartha iti, na duḥkhayatīti; tapaso'cetanatvādduḥkhāsambhavāt|| `uttapati suvarṇam' ityādau suvarṇakarmakatvāt tapeḥ karmavadbhāvo na bhavati|| 89. na duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau| (3.1.89) `karmakarttari yakciṇānupadiṣṭau na bhavataḥ' iti| karmakarttarīti viśeṣaṇam| `karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' (3.1.87) iti prāptayoryakciṇorayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, na tu ciṇvadbhāvakarmaṇoḥ| `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67) iti ca| śuddhe karmaṇi yau prāptau tayorapīti darśanārtham| etacca `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti paribhāṣayā labhyate| `dugdhe' iti| yaki pratiṣiddhe śap, tasyādāditvālluk| pūrvavad ghatvaghatvajaśtvāni| `adugdha' iti| luṅa| ciṇi pratiṣiddhe ksaḥ, tasya `lugvā' (7.3.73) ityādinā luk| `prasnute' iti| `{ṣṇu prasravaṇe' dhā.pā.} snu prasravaṇe' (dhā.pā.1038), pūrvavacchapo luk| `prāsnoṣṭa' iti| luṅa| `namate' iti| `ṇama prahvatve śabde' (dhā.pā.981)| antarbhāvitaṇyartho'tra namiḥ karmaṇi varttata iti veditavyam| evaṃ hi karmasthakriyo bhavati; anyathā karttṛsthakriyatvāt prāptirnāstyeveti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| antarbhāvitavyarthastu karmasthakriyo bhavati-- namati daṇḍaṃ devadattaḥ| `namate daṇḍaḥ svayameva' iti| yathā ṇyantāvasthāyām| `yakciṇoḥ pratiṣedhe' ityādi| yakciṇoḥ pratiṣedhe karttavye śranthyādīnāmapi tasya pratiṣedhasyopasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu neti yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddhyarthāt karttavyam| ṇīti hetumaṇṇica itarasya ca ṇergrahaṇam| hetumaṇṇic| `kārayati' kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ| kārayate kaṭaḥ syavameva' iti| yaki pratiṣiddhe śap| `acīkarata kaṭaḥ svayamevaṭa iti| ciṇi pratiṣiddhe `ṇiśri' (3.1.48) ityādinā caṅa,ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ' (7.4.1) iti hrasvaḥ| `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam| itaro ṇiḥ-- `pucchabhāṇḍa cīvarāṇṇiṅa' (3.1.20)| `utpucchayate gāṃ gopaḥ| utpucchayate gauḥ svayameva' (iti)| yaki pratiṣiddhe śap| evamuttaratrāpi veditavyam| `udapupucchata gauḥ svayameva' iti| ciṇi pratiṣiddhe pūrvavaccaṅa| evamuttaratrāpi veditavyam| `śrantha grantha sandarbhe' (dhā.pā.1512,1513)| curādau granthiśranthī paṭhyete (dhā.pā.1837,1838)| `ā dhṛṣādvā' (dhā.pā.1805 anantaram) iti vibhāṣāṇicau| tayoryadā ṇij nāsti tadodāharaṇe; anyathā ṇītyevaṃ siddhiḥ| granthi granthaṃ devadattaḥ| granthate granthaḥ svayameva| agranthiṣṭa granthaḥ svayameva| śranthati mekhalāṃ devadattaḥ| śranthate mekhalā svayameva| `śrantha grantha sandarbhe' (dhā.pā.1512,1513) itikryādāvapi paṭhyete, tayorapyayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ-- śrathnīte mekhalāṃ devadattaḥ, śranthīte mekhalā svayameva| `ī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itīttvam| aśranthiṣṭa mekhalā svayameva| grathnīte granthaṃ devadattaḥ| granthīte granthaḥ svayameva| agranthiṣṭa granthaḥ svayameva| brūte kathāṃ devadattaḥ| brūte kathā svayameva| pūrvavacchapo luk| avocata kathāṃ devadattaḥ| avocata kathā svayameva| `bruvo vaciḥ' (2.4.53) iti vacirādeśaḥ, `asyativaktikhyātibhyoṣa'ṅa' (3.1.52) ityaṅādeśaḥ; `vaca um' (7.4.20)| antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvāt karmasthakriyātvaṃ veditavyam| `ātmanepadākarmakāṇām' iti| ātmanepadavidhāvakarmakā ye dhātavo gṛhyante ta ātmanepadākarmakāḥ| `vikurvate saindhavāḥ svayameva' iti| `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityadādeśaḥ| `vyakṛṣata saindhavāḥ svayameva' ityatrāpi kṛño vipūrvāt `akarmakācca' (1.3.35) ityātmanepadavidhānādātmanepadākarmakatvam| atrāpi valgane varttamānaḥ karotirantarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ karmasthakiyo bhavati|| 90. kṛṣirajoḥ prācāṃ śyanparasmaipadaṃ ca| (3.1.90)ṭa rañjeḥ kṛtānunāsikalopanirdeśo lāghavārthaḥ| `yagātmanepadayorapavādau' iti| śyan yako'pavādaḥ; parasmaipadaṃ tvātmanepadasya| `rajyati' iti| `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `prācāṃ grahaṇaṃ vikalpārtham' iti| etena pūjārthatāmapanayati| pūjārthe tasmin vikalpo na labhyeta| `kuṣyate' ityādinā vikalpārthe prāggrahaṇe yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati| `syādiviṣaye ca' ityādi| ādiśabdena tāsiprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| `cukuṣe, rarañje' iti| liṭ, ātmanepadam, tapratyayaḥ, tasyaiśādeśaḥ| `koṣiṣīṣṭa' iti| āśiṣi liṅa, sīyuṭ, `suṭ tithoḥ' (3.4.107) iti suṭ, laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, ṣatvam, ṣṭutvañca| `raṅakṣīṣṭa' iti| `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.3.30) iti kutvam-- gakāraḥ| `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam--kakāraḥ| `akoṣi, arañji' iti| luṅa,ciṇ|| 91. dhātoḥ| (3.1.91) `yaṅavidhau dhātorityadhikārāt' iti| `dhātorekācaḥ' (3.1.22) iti yaṅavidhau yat dhātugrahaṇaṃ tasyehādhikārādityarthaḥ| iyañca dhātugrahaṇasyānarthakatve yuktiḥ| `kṛdupapadasaṃjñārthaṃ tu' iti| ānarthakyamapākaroti| nanu ca pūrveṇāpi dhātugrahaṇena kṛdupapadasaṃjñe sidhyata syātām, iha kariṣyatīti syapratyayasya `kṛdatiṅa' (3.1.93) iti kṛtsaṃjñā syāt| tataśca `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' (1.2.46) iti prātipadikasaṃjñā prasajyeta, tasyāñca satyāṃ subutpattiḥ| `cli luṅi' (3.1.43) ityatra ca `tatropapadam' (3.1.92) iti luṅo'pyapapadasaṃjñā syāt, tataśca luṅyupapade clirityayamarthaśca sambhāvyeta| tasamādiha dhātvadhikāre kṛdupapadasaṃjñe yathā syātāṃ pūrvatra mā bhūtāmiti pūnardhātugrahaṇam| athādhikāreṇaite saṃjñe vidhāsyete pratyayasaṃjñāvat, tena pūrvatra na bhaviṣyatīti cet ? na hi; siṃhāvalokitanyāyopyasti| adhikāreṇa vidhāne pūrvatrāpi sambhāvyeyātām| tatra vyākhyānaṃ karttavyaṃ bhavet| vyākhyānācca laghu dhātugrahaṇaṃ bhavati| avaśyañcānyārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ karttavyam, tadanyārtha kriyamāṇaṃ kṛdupapadasaṃjñāvidhāvapi vispaṣṭārthaṃ bhaviṣyati| tāmeva cānyārthatāṃ darśayitumāha-- `ārdhadhātukasaṃjñārtham' ityādi| caśabdādvā'sarūpavidhānārthañcetyayamatrārtho veditavyaḥ| `vā'sarūpo'striyām' (3.1.94) ityasmin dhātvadhikāre'sarūpo'pavādo bādhako yathā syāt, pūrvatra mā bhūt| tena ksādibhiḥ sicaḥ samāveśo na bhavati| nanu ca pūrveṇāpi dhātugrahaṇenārdhadhātukasaṃjñā setsyati, kiṃ dvitīyadhātugrahaṇena ? ityata āha-- `dhātorityevam' ityādi| dhātorityevaṃ dhātuśabdamuccārya vihitasyārdhadhātukasaṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punardhātukṛgrahaṇamityarthaḥ| kimarthaṃ punardhātorityevaṃ vihitasyārdhadhātukasaṃjñocyate ? ityāha-- `iha mā bhūt' itati|asati dvitīye dhātugrahaṇe lūbhyām, lūbhirityatrārdhadhātukasaṃjñā syāt. bhavati hyatra dhātoḥ paraḥ pratyayaḥ-- `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati' (vyā.pa.132) iti kṛtvā| ārdhadhātukatve satyārdhadhātukalakṣaṇa iṭ prasajyeta| dvitīyaṃ tu dhātugrahaṇaṃ kriyamāmaṃ sāmarthyādchabandapadātmakaṃ bhavati| tenāyamartho labhyate-- dhātorityevaṃ dhātusaṃśabdanena yo vihitaḥ sa ardhadhātukasaṃjño bhavatīti| tena lūbhyāmityādāvārdhadhātukatvaṃ na bhavati| na hīha dhātorityevaṃ pratyayo vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? prātipadikādityevam|| 92. tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham| (3.1.ka92) `saptamyā nirdiṣṭam' ityanena saptamīsthamityasyārthamācaṣṭe| śabdasya hīyaṃ saṃjñā vidhīyate, sa ca kaḥ saptamīstho bhavati ? yasyāḥ saptamyā nirdeśaḥ| `kumbhakāraḥ' iti| upapadasaṃjñāyāṃ `upapadamatiṅa' (2.2.19) iti samāsaḥ, `gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) ityattarapadasya prakṛtisvaratvaṃ bhavati| `sthagrahaṇam' ityādi| nirdiśyate'neneti nirdeśaḥ| saptamī nirdeśo yasya sa saptamīnirdeśaḥ| tatpratipattyarthaṃ sthagrahaṇam| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- sūtre yat saptamyā nirdiṣṭaṃ tasya saṃjñitvena pratipattiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ sthagrahaṇam| yadi punaḥ sthagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tataḥ kiṃ syādityata āha-- `itarathā hi' ityādi| itarathā hyakriyamāṇe sthagrahaṇe `saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnāsti' (pu.pa.vṛ.81) itisaiva saptamyupapadasaṃjñāṃ pratipadyeta| na cāsataḥ saṃjñinaḥ saṃjñā yukteti yatra śrūyate saptamī-- stamberama ityādau tatraiva syāt| syādetat-- naitat pratyayagrahaṇam,kiṃ tarhi ? saptamīśabdasya svarūpasya grahaṇamityāha-- `yatra' ityādi| gatārtham| `sthagrahaṇāttu' ityādi| sthagrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe granthādhikyāt sūtre yasya saptamyā nirdeśastat saṃjñitvena nirdiśyate, tenu sarvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati; yeṣāmiyaṃ saṃjñeṣyate teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva sūtre saptamīnirdeśāt| tathā hi-- `stambakarṇayoḥ' (3.2.13) ityatra stambakarṇaśabdau sūtre saptamyā nirdiṣṭau| `saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ' (3.2.97) ityatrāpyupasarādayaḥ| `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) ityatrāpi karmābhidhāyinaḥ kumbhaprabhṛtayaḥ| nanu ca lāghavārthaṃ saṃjñākaraṇam, tatkimarthaṃ gurvī saṃjñā kriyate ? ityāha-- `gurusaṃjñākaraṇam' ityādi| upaśabdaḥ sāmīpye| upoccāritaṃ padamupapadamityanyarthasaṃjñāvijñāne sati samarthaparibhāṣāvyāpāro yathā syādityevamarthaṃ gurusaṃjñākaraṇam| samarthaparibhāṣopasthāne sati yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate taddarśayitumāha-- `paśya kumbham' ityādi. anvarthasaṃjñāyāṃ hi satyāmupapadāśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ padavidhirbhavati| yatra ca padagandho'pyasti tatra samarthaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate| tena paśya kumbhaṃ karoti kaṭamityatra `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) na bhavati| na hīha kumbhasya karotinā sāmarthyam, kiṃ tarhi ? paśyetyanena| padaśabdo'pyatrānvartha eva, na pāribhāṣikaḥ| tathā hi subantasya padasaṃjñā ṭacopapadasaṃjñāvidhanakāle subantatayāsti; yasmādupapadasaṃjñāyāṃ vihitāyāmupapadāśraye'pi pratyaya upapadasamāso'pi `gatirakārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ samāsavacanaṃ prāk‌subutpatteḥ' (vyā.pa.vṛ.138) iti subutpattyā bhavitavyaḥ| tasmādanvartho'yaṃ padaśabdaḥ-- padyate gamyate'rtho yena tat padamiti| `tatra' grahaṇaṃ saptamīsthasya pratyotpattiṃ prati nimittabhāve satyupapadasaṃjñā yathā syādityevamartham| asati hi tatra grahaṇe karmaṇyupapade'nupapade'pi pratyayaḥ syāt| yastu karmaṇīti saptamyā nirdeśaḥ, sa yadā saptamyantaḥ sambhavati, tadā tasyopapadasaṃjñārthaḥ syāt; na tu tasmin satyeva pratyayena bhavitavyamityeṣo'rtho labhyate| tasmāt yathoktaprayojanārthaṃ tatragrahaṇam| nanu cānantarasya dhātvadikārasya nirdeśārthaṃ tatragrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati, tatraitasmin dhātvadhikāre'nantara upapadasaṃjñā yathā syāditi ? naitadasti; adhikārādapyetat siddham| upapadasaṃjñādhikariṣyate, tena vakṣyamāṇeṣu saṃjñiṣu saṃjñā bhaviṣyatīti nārtha etadarthena tatragrahaṇena| `tatraitasmin' ityādistu vṛttigrantha evamunnīyate-- etasmin dhātvadhikāre yatsaptamyā nirdiṣṭaṃ tadupapadasaṃjñaṃ bhavati| tatra ca nimitte pratyaya ityeṣo'rthaḥ sopaskāratvād‌vṛttigranthasya labhyate|| 93. kṛdatiṅ| (3.1.93) `karttavyam' iti| kṛtsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' (1.2.46) iti prātipadikasaṃjñā| `cīyāt' iti| āśiṣi liṅa,`liṅāśiṣi' (3.4.116) ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñā| atiṅiti yadi nocyeta, tiṅo'pi kṛtsaṃjñā syāt; tataśca `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghatvaṃ na bhavet| atiṅiti tu satyakṛdyakāratvādbhavati|| 94. vā'sarūpo'striyām| (3.1.94) apavādaviṣayamutsargo nābiniviśata ityeṣa utsargadharmaḥ, kṛtāñca keṣāñcidutsargāṇāmapavādaviṣaye pravṛttiriṣyate, sā ca vacanamantareṇa na siddhyatīti tadarthamidam| nanu cārabhyamāṇe'pyetasmin naivāyamarthaḥ sampadyate, tathā hi-- asyotsargeṇa vā sambandhaḥ syāt, apavādena vā, ubhābhyāṃ vā ? tatra yadi pūrvakalpa āśrīyeta tadā vāśabdena vikalpārthenopasthāpitayorbhāvābhāvayorasyāyamarthaḥ syāt-- utsargo'sarūpo'striyāṃ pakṣe bhavatīti, pakṣe na bhavatīti| tathā cāpavādasya svasmin viṣaye nityāprāptiḥ syāt| na hyanenāpavādasya kiñcitkṛtam; tena sahāsyāsambandhāt| na ca bādhake'pavāde'vikalpāṃ pravṛttimanubhavati sati tatrotsargaḥ pravartitumutsahata iti svaviṣaya eva vikalpaḥ pravarteta| atha dvitīyaḥ, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt-- asarūpo'pavādo'striyāṃ vikalpena bhavatīti| evamapi naivotsargasyāpavādaviṣaye pravṛttirlabhyate| utsargo'pavādo'striyāṃ vikalpena bhavatīti| evamapi naivotsargasyāpavādaviṣaye pravṛttirlabhyate| utsargo'pavādaviṣayaṃ parihati, tadāpavādasya bādhakatvāt| tacca bādhakatvamasminnapi pakṣe tadavasthameva, na hyanena tadapanītam, kiṃ tarhi ? svasmin viṣaye tasya bhāvābhāvau pratipāditau-- pakṣe bhavati,pakṣe na bhavati| na cānyadvacanamasti; yato'pavādaviṣayamutsargo'vyāste| apavādasyābhāvapakṣe prāpakavacanamantareṇāpi utsargo bhaviṣyati| pratibandhābhāvāditi cet ? satyametat kāryabādhāyām; śāstrabādhāyāntu yat kāryasya vidhāyakaṃ tadapavādena bādhyamānaṃ tadviṣaparīhāreṇaiva pravarteta, tasmin pravṛtte paścāpadavāde vikalpena pravṛttimanubavtayapi tadviṣaya utsargapravṛttirna sambhavati, sāmānyaśāstrsayātadviṣayatvāt| astu kāryavadhāpakṣa iti cet? na; ayuktatvāt| na hyabādhite vidhāyake śāstre tatkāryabādhā yujyate| nidānocchedena hi nidānina ucchedaḥ śakyate karttum, nānyathā| na hi pradīpe'nucchinne tatprabhocchidyate| tasmādapavādaḥ śāstrameva bādhate,tasmiśca bādhite satyapavādābhāvapakṣe'pi naivotsargasyāpavādaviṣaye pravṛttiḥ syāt. atha tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt-- utsargo'sarūpo'striyāṃ vā bhavati, apavādo'pīti| evamapi tayoḥ svasmin viṣaye vikalpena pravṛttiḥ syāt, na tūtsargasyāpavādaviṣaye; pūrvoktādeva hetoḥ| tasmāt kriyamāṇe'pyetasmin naivābhimato'rthaḥ sampadyata iti deśayet, taṃ pratyāha-- `asarūpo'pavādapratyayo vā bādhako bhavati' iti| etenāpavādasyānena sambandhaḥ, na tu bhāvābhāvau vikalpyete, kiṃ tarhi ? pakṣe bādhakatvamiti darśayati| evañca yasmin pakṣe'pavādo bādhako na bhavati, tasmin viṣaye pratibandhābhāvādutsargaḥ pravarttata iti sidhyati samāveśaḥ| `stryadhikāravihitaṃ pratyayaṃ varjatvā' iti.kathaṃ punaḥ `astriyām' iti vacanādeṣo'rtho labhyate ? evaṃ manyate-- `strīgrahaṇamiha svaryate, svaritena cādhikārāvagatirbhavati; tena strayadhikāravihitamāśritya yāvutsargāpavādau vihitau tadvi,ye pratiṣedho vijñāyate' iti| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate-- striyāmabhidheyāyāmasarūpo'pavādo bādhako vā na bhavatīti ? evamaśakyaṃ vijñātum; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne lavyā lavitavyeti yadviṣaye tavyo na syāt| evaṃ tarhi kasmānna vijñāyate-- stirayāmityevaṃ strīśabdasaṃśabdanena yaḥ pratyayo vihitaḥ sa iha strīśabdenoktaḥ, tatra striyāmityevaṃ vihite'sarūpo'pavādo bādhako vā na bhavatīti ? evamaśakśaṃ vijñātum; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne vyāvakrośī, vyāvakruṣṭiriti ṇaco viṣaye ktinaḥ pravṛttirna syāt,; yasmāt `karmavyatīhāre ṇac striyām' (3.3.43) iti ṇajvihitaḥ, striyāṃ ktinnapi; tasmāt pūrvokta evārthaḥ| yadyevam, `ktalyuṭtumunkhalartheṣu' (pu.pa.vṛ.76) iti paribhāṣā na prāpnotica teṣāmastryadhikāravihitatvāt ? `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114), `lyuṭ ca' (3.3.115)-- hasitam, hasanam, tayorviṣaye `bhāve' (3.3.18) iti ghañapi prāpnoti | `samānakarttṛkeṣu tumun' (3.3.158) -- icchati bhoktum,tasya viṣaye `icchārtheṣu liṅaloṭau' (3.3.157)api prāpnutaḥ ? `āto yuc' (3.3.128) --īṣatpānam, tasya viṣaye `īṣav‌duḥsuṣu kṛcchrākṛcchrārtheṣu khal' (3.3.126) iti khalapi prāpnoti ? vāvacanasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvānna bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `ṇvultṛcāvityutsargā' iti| sāmānyavihitatvāt| `igupadhāpīkiraḥ kaḥ ityapavādaḥ' iti| viśeṣavihitvāt| `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) ityutsargaḥ, `ātaścopasarge' (3.1.136) iti kapratyayo'pavādaḥ| nanu cānubandhakṛtenāsārūpyeṇa so'pyasarūpa ityāha-- `nānubandhakṛtam' ityādi| atra `dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā' (3.1.139) iti vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam| yadi hyanubandhakṛtamasārūpyaṃ syādvibhāṣāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt. anubandhakṛtādasārūpyādeva hi `śyā''dvyadha' (3.1.141) ityādisūtreṇa pakṣe ṇo bhaviṣyati|| 95. kṛtyāḥ prāṅ ṇvulaḥ| (3.1.95) `kṛtyāḥ' iti bahuvacanena nirdeśo bahutvāt saṃjñinām| atha vā-- anuktakṛtpratyayasaṃgrahārthaṃ bahuvacanam| tena `kelimara upasaṃkhyānam' (vā.121) ityetat karttavyaṃ na bhavati| `ṇvultṛcāviti vakṣyati' iti| atha rogākhyāyāṃ ṇvul bahulam' (3.3.108) ityasya ṇvulo'vadhitvaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? jñāpakāt| yadayam `arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' (3.3.169) iti kṛtyagrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā tṛjgrahaṇaṃ karoti, tato jñāyate-- nāsyāvadhitvamiti; anyathā tṛco'pi kṛtyatvādbhadenopādānamanarthakaṃ syāt| yadyevam; prāgvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt, ata eva jñāpakāt tṛca iyaṃ saṃjñā na bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; asati hyetasmin, jñāpakāt tṛca eva na syāt| ṇvulastu syādeva| syādetat-- yogāpekṣaṃ jñāpakam, etasmin yoge kṛtyasaṃjñā bhavati-- eṣo'rthastṛjgrahaṇena jñāpyate, tena ṇvulo'pi na bhaviṣyatīti ? evamanyeṣāmajādīnāṃ syāt, pratipattigauravañca syāt, yogāpekṣasya jñāpakasya durvijñānatvāt|| 96. tavyattavyānīyaraḥ| (3.1.96) `takārarephau svarārthau' iti| takāraḥ `titsvaritam' (6.1.185) iti svaritārthaḥ| rephaḥ `upottamaṃ riti' (6.1.217) itimadhyodāttārthaḥ| `vasestavyat karttari ṇicca' iti|`vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1005) ityasmāt karttari tavyapratyayo bhavati, sa ca ṇidbhavatīti| na caitadvaktavyam; `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti siddhatvāt| vasatīti vāstavyaḥ| ṇittvāddvṛddhiḥ| `kelimara upasaṃkhyānama'iti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasay pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu prāgeva kṛtam| punarapi kriyate-- `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) itibahulavacanāt kelimarpratyayo'pi kṛtyo bhaviṣyati| kakāraḥ kitkāryārthaḥ, rephaḥ svarārthaḥ| svayameva pacyante `pacelimā māṣāḥ'| śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādata e bahuvacanācca karmakarttaryeva bhavati nānyatra|| 97. ato yat| (3.1.97) `takāraḥ `yato'nāvaḥ' iti {svarārthaḥ-- kāśikā} viśeṣaṇārthaḥ' iti| ādyudāttārthaḥ| `geyam' iti| `kai gai śabde' (dhā.pā.916,917), `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityāttvam, `īdyati' (6.4.65) itīttvam, guṇaḥ| `yāvatā' ityādi| iha dvividhā dhātavaḥ-- halantā ajantāśca; tatra `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) iti ṇyataṃ halantādicchati|ataḥ pariśeṣyādevājgrahaṇamantareṇāpyajantādeva yad‌bhaviṣyatītyato'jgrahaṇamapārthakamityabhiprāyaḥ| `ajantabhūtapūrvāt' iti| ajantaścāsau bhūtapūrvaśceti karmadhārayaḥ| yaḥ prāgajanta āsīt saṃprati tu halantaḥ, tato'pi yathā syādityevamarthamajgrahaṇam| `ditsyam'| `dhitsyam' | dāño dhāñaśca san, dvirvacanam| `sani mīmā' (7.4.54) itīs| `atra lopo'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityabhyāsalopaḥ| `saḥ syārdhadhātuke' (7.4.49) iti tattvam| anutpanna evārdhadhātuke viṣayabhāvena vivakṣite `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ| asyāmavasthāyāmasatyajgarhaṇe na syāt; anajantatvāt| tasmiṃstu sati bhūtapūrvamajantatvamāśritya bhavati| pākṣikañcaitat prayojanaṃ veditavyam| kva tasminpakṣe ? yadārdhadhātuke viṣayabhāvana vivakṣite `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) vidhīyate| yadā''rdhadhātukaḥ, tadā nedaṃ prayojanam| vispaṣṭārthaṃ tvajgrahaṇaṃ veditavyam| `takiśasi' ityādi| `taka { sahane iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} hasane(dhā.pā.117), `śasu hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.727), `cate cade yācane' (dhā.pā.865,866) , `yatī prayatne' (dhā.pā.30), `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149)--eṣāṃ yatpratyayasyopasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| pratipādanaṃ tu bahulagrahaṇamāśritya karttavyam| `hano vā vadha ca' iti| hanterdhātoryatpratyayo bhavati, ṇyato'pavādaḥ| vāvacanāt papakṣe ṇyadbhavatyeva| yatpratyayastu tata eva bahulavacanāllabhyate| yadā yadbhavati tadā hanterbadhādeśaḥ| so'pi `hano vadha liṅi' (2.4.42) ityatra `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.39) ityato bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhyate| ghātya iti| `hanastaḥ' (7.3.32) iti tatvam, `ho hanteḥ' (7.3.54) iti kutvam|| 98.poradupadhāt| (3.1.98) `prākyam| vākyam' iti| `cajoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutvam| `kopyam| gopyam' iti. `kupa krodhe' (dhā.pā.1233), `gupa {gopane ityeva-dhā.pā.} gopanakutsanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.970), `gupa vyākulīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1234)| āpyamiti| `āplṛ vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1260)|| 99. śakisahośca| (3.1.99) 100. gadamadacarayamaścānupasarge| (3.1.100) `anupasarge' iti| sujvyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamī| ata evāha-- `anupasargebhyaḥ' iti| avidyamānopalasargebhya ityarthaḥ| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate-- upasargādanyo'nupasarga iti ? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne kevalebhyo na syāt| nañivayukta (hai.pa.94) nyāyenopasargasadṛśasya subantasya grahaṇe sati `vadaḥ supi kyap ca' (3.1.106) ityatra punaḥ subgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, asyaivānupasargasya tatrānuvṛtteḥ| tasmāt pūrvokta evārtho yuktaḥ| `niyamārtham' iti| anupasargādeva yathā syāt, sopasargānamā bhūditi| `careḥ' ityādi| sopasargārthamidam- carerdhātorāṅi copapade yadbhavatīti, agurāvabhidheye| sa tu jñāpakādeva sidhyatīti nopasaṃkhyeyaḥ, yadayam `āścaryamanitye' (6.1.147) `sammānanotsañjanācāryakaraṇa' (1.3.36) ityādi karoti, tato jñāyate-- carerāṅi cāgurau yadbhavatīti| `ācāryo deśaḥ' iti gantavya ityarthaḥ| guruḥ- upanetā|| 101. avadyapaṇyavaryā garhyapaṇitavyānirodheṣu| (3.1.101) `avadyam' iti| vadernañyupapade `vadaḥ supi kyap ca' (3.1.106) iti yatkyapoḥ prāptayoryadeva nipātyate| `anudyam' iti| yajāditvāt saṃprāsaraṇam, `nalopo nañaḥ' (6.3.73), `tasmānnuḍaci' (6.3.74) iti nuṭ| `paṇyam' iti| paṇervyavahārārthasya ṇyati prāpte yannipātyate| `pāṇyam' iti| stotavyamityarthaḥ| `varyā' iti| vṛṅo ṇyati prāpte yannipātyate| striyāmityanena sūtre liṅganirdeśasya tantratāṃ darśayati| `apratibandhaḥ' iti| anenānirodhaśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| apratibandhaḥ prasarābhighāta ityarthaḥ| `vṛtyā' iti| nirodhanīyā| prasaravighāto'syāḥ karttavya ityarthaḥ| etacca vṛñaḥ `etistṛśāsu' (3.1.109) iti kyapi kṛte `hrasvasya piti kṛti' (6.1.71) iti tuki ca rūpam| `vāryā ṛtvijaḥ' iti| vṛṅa etadrūpam| ṛtvijo hi dhanena saṃvibhaktavyā ityastyanirodhaḥ| strīliṅgatā tu nāstīti ṇyadeva bhavati| nanu `etistuśāsvṛ' (3.1.109) iti kyapā bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; vṛño hi tatra grahaṇam, vṛṅaścātrodāharaṇam|| 102. vahyaṃ karaṇam| (3.1.102) 103. aryaḥ svāmivaiśyayoḥ| (3.1.103) `vaktavyam' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- tantreṇeha dvāvaryaśabdāvuccāritau,tatraika ādyudāttaḥ,aparo'ntodāttaḥ| ya ādyudāttaḥ sa vaiśye nipātyate, itarastu svāminīti|| 104. upasaryā kālyā prajane| (3.1.104) `prāptakālā kālyā' iti| `tadasya prāptasya' (5.1.104) ityanuvarttamāne `kālādyat' (5.1.107) iti yat| prajananam - prajanaḥ, bhāve ghañ, `janivadhyośca' (7.3.35) iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| `upasāryā' iti| upasaṃkramaṇītyetyarthaḥ| 105.ajaṃrya saṅgatam| (3.1.105) `jīryateḥ' iti. `jṝṣ jhṝṣ vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1130, 1131)| `saṅgamana' iti| saṅgamanam - saṅgatiḥ| `lyuṭ ca' (3.3.115) iti lyuṭ| etena saṅtamityatra `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) iti darśayati| `karttari yatpratyayo nipātyate'iti| tṛjādīnāmapavādaḥ| `ajaritā' iti| tṛc|| 106. vadaḥ supi kyap ca| (3.1.106) `anupasarga iti varttate' iti| nanu ca `satsūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādau sūtre vakṣyati-- etadupasargagrahaṇaṃ jñāpanārtham, anyatra subgrahaṇa upasargagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti; evañca tata eva jñāpakādupasarge na bhaviṣyatīti kimihānupasargagrahaṇānuvṛttyā ? vispaṣṭārthamityeke| tatra vājñāpanārthamupasargagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam; iha vānupasargamanuvartyamiti vikalpadarśanārthamityapare| `brahmodyam' iti| brahmaṇo vadanamityarthaḥ| bhāve kyap, pūrvavat saṃprasāraṇam, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), upapadasamāsaḥ|| 107. bhuvo bhāve| (3.1.107) `yat tu nānuvarttate' iti| pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt| `brahmabhūyaṃ gataḥ' iti| brahmatvaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ| nanu ca `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' (3.4.70) iti bhāvakarmaṇoḥ kṛtvā vidhīyante, anupasarga iti cānuvarttate, anupasargaśca bhavatirakarmaka itisāmarthyādbhāva eva bhaviṣyati, na karmaṇi, kiṃ bhāvagrahaṇena ? ityāha-- `bhāvagrahaṇena ? itayāha-- `bhāvagrahaṇamuttarārtham' iti| etena `hanasta ca' (3.1.108) ityatropayogamāha-- tatra bhāva eva yathā syāt| `bhavyam' iti| aco yat' (3.1.97), dhātorguṇaḥ, `dhātostannimittasyaiva' (6.1.80) ityavādeśaḥ|| 108. hanasta ca| (3.1.108) `brahmahatyā' iti| brahmaṇo hananamityarthaḥ| `dhātaḥ' iti| pūrvavat tatvakatve| kimarthaṃ punarghañ pratyudāhriyate, na ṇyadityāha-- `ṇyattu' ityādi| tatraiva yuktimāha-- `anabhidhānāt' iti|abidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā bhavanti, na ca hantervihitena ṇyatā bhāvaḥ śakyate'bhidhātum| tathā hi dhātya ityukte karmaiva pratīyate, na bhāvaḥ|| 109. etistuśāsvṛdṛjuṣaḥ kyap| (3.1.109) `śiṣyaḥ' iti| `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075),` śāsa idaṅahaloḥ' (6.4.34) itīttvam, `śāsivasi'(8.3.60) iti ṣatvam| `ādṛtyaḥ' iti| `dṛṅa ādare' (dhā.pā.1141), āṅapūrvaḥ| `juṣyaḥ' iti| `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1288)| atha kimarthaṃ kyabgrahaṇam, yāvatā `vadaḥ supi kyap ca' (3.1.106) ityataḥ kyabgrahamanuvarttata evetyata
