āha-- `kyabiti varttamāne' ityādi| `bādhakabādhanārtham' iti| etadvispaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `orāvaśyake' iti| stugrahaṇasyāvakāśo yatrāvaśyakaṃ na vivakṣyate-- stutya iti, ` orāvaśyake' (3.1.125) ityasyāvakāśo'nyo dhātuḥ-- avaśyalāvyamiti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti-- avaśyastutya iti, paratvādbādhako ṇyat syāt| punaḥ kyabgrahaṇāt tamapi bādhitvā kyabbhavati| `vṛgrahaṇena vṛño grahaṇamiṣyate, na vṛṅaḥ' iti| tatkatham ? `kṛṣirajoḥ' (3.1.90) ityādeḥ sūtrādiha parasmaipadagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena vṛśabdo viśiṣyate-- parasamaipadaṃsya yo vṛśabda iti| kaśca parasmaipadasya vṛśabdaḥ ? yasya parasmaipadaṃ prati nimittbhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ| vṛña evobhayapadinaḥ sa dṛṣṭaḥ, na vṛṅaḥ; tasya nityātmanepaditvāt| tena vṛña eva grahaṇaṃ bhavati, na vṛṅaḥ| `śaṃsiduhi' ityādi| ebhyaḥ śaṃsiprabhṛtibhyo vā kyabbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tadeva bahulagrahaṇamāśritya karttavyam| `śasyam' iti| `śansu stutau' (dhā.pā.728), `aniditām' (6.4.24) iti nalopaḥ| `guhyama' iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.896)| `aḥṅapūrvādañjeḥ' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tacca pūrvavat| `añjū vyaktibhramaṇakāntigatiṣu' (dhā.pā.1458)| pūrvavannalopaḥ| iyaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ saṃjñā| `kathamupeyam' iti| iṇa etadrūpamiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| `īṅa etadrūpam' iti. `īṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.1143) ityasya `aco yat' (3.1.97) iti yati satyetadrūpam, na tviṇaḥ| tasya hi kyapi satyupetyamiti bhavitavyam|| 110. ṛdupadhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ| (3.1.110) `klṛpicṛtau varjayitvā' iti| `kṛpū sāmarthye' (dhā.pā.762), `cṛtī {hiṃsāśranthanayoḥ' dhā.pā.} hiṃsāgranthanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1324) ityetau tyaktvā| kṛperlatvasyāsiddhatvādṛdupadhatvam| `kalpyam' iti| latvasyāmiddhtavādṛkārasyaivākāro guṇaḥ| `ṇyadeva bhavati-- kīrttyam' iti| ārdhadhātukavivakṣāyāṃ curādiṇicaḥ `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilope kṛ-te halantatopajāyata iti kṛtvā `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) iti ṇyadeva bhavati| `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ| nanu ca `aco yat' (3.1.97) ityatrājgrahaṇasya prayojanamuktam-- ajantabhūtapūrvādapi yathā syāt, ditsyam, dhitsyamiti;evañcehāpi ṇici yataiva bhavitavyam ? evaṃ tarhyanityaṇyantāścurādaya ityaṇyantādevātra ṇyadbhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvavat| pāṇibhyāṃ sraṣṭavyā `pāṇisargyā rajjuḥ' | `upapadamatiṅṭa (2.2.19) iti samāsaḥ| `samavapūrvācca' iti| sṛjerṇyadbhavatīti sambadhyate| cakāraḥ samuccaye|na kevalaṃ pāṇāvupapade ṇyadvaktavyaḥ; api tu samavapūrvācca|| 111. ī ca khanaḥ| (3.1.111) `kheyam' iti| `khanu avadāraṇe' (dhā.pā.878), nakārasya īkāraḥ, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| atha kimarthaṃ dīrgha ādiśyate, yāvatā hrasve'pi kṛte ādguṇena bhavitavyam| na ca hrasvasyādguṇe kṛte kaścidviśeṣaḥ ? syādetat-- ekādeśastu tugvidhāvasiddho vaktavyaḥ, tatra yadi hrasva ādiśyate tadā hrasvsayādguṇe kṛte tugvidhāvasiddhatvād hrasvāśrayastuk syāt; dīrghādeśe tu na bhavati, ato dīrghādeśo vaktavya iti ? etacca nāsti; yasmāt padāntapadādyoyaṃ evādeśaḥ sa tugvidhāvasiddho vaktavyaḥ, na sarvatretyāha-- `dīrghanirdeśaḥ| kimarthaṃ punardvitīya savarṇadīrghatvena (6.1.101) dvyorivarṇayoḥ praśleṣo yathā syādityevamartho dīrghanirdeśaḥ| kimarthaṃ punirdvitīya ivarṇaḥ, yāvataikenaiva kheyamiti rūpaṃ sidhyatītyata āha--` tatra ' ityādi| dvayorikārayoḥ praśleṣanirdeśaḥ| tatra yo dvitīya ivarṇaḥ saḥ `ye ca' (6.4.109) ityāttvabādhā yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| `ye vibhāṣā' (6.4.43) ityasyāvakāśaḥ-- khāyate, khanyate, isi, asyādeśasyāvakāśo yasmin pakṣa āttvaṃ nāsti; āttavapakṣe tūbhayaṃ prāpnoti| ubhayaprāptāvasatīkāre partavādantaraṅgatvāccāttvaṃ syāt, asmiṃśca satyāttvaṃ bādhitvekāra eva bhavati| antaraṅgatvaṃ punarāttvasya yakārasāmānyamāśritya vidhānāt| ittvasya bahiraṅgatvam; kyabviśeṣamāśritya vidhānāt|| 112. bhṛño'saṃjñāyām| (3.1.112) `bhartavyā ityarthaḥ' iti| etena kriyāśabdatvaṃ bhṛtyaśabdasya darśayan saṃjñāśabdatvamapākaroti| `saṃpūrvādvibhāṣā' iti| asaṃjñāyāmevāyaṃ kyopa nityaṃ prasaktasya kyapo nityaṃ prasaktasya vikalpaḥ| etadvakṣyamāṇasya vibhāṣāgrahaṇasyobhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣabhūtatvādavyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| `saṃjñāyāṃ puṃsi' ityādi| asaṃjñāyāmityasya pratiṣedhasyeti śeṣaḥ| etena puṃsi pratiṣedhasya caritārthatāmāha-- yata evaṃ puṃsi caritārthaḥ pratiṣedhastato na te bhāryā prasidhyati| bhāryāśabdastava sūtrakārasya mate na prasidhyatītyarthaḥ| puṃsi pratiṣedhe hi caritārthe striyāṃ kyapā bhavitavyam| nanu cāsaṃjñāyāmityucyate, saṃjñāśabdaśca bhāryāśabdaḥ, tathā hi abibhratyapi devadatte tasya patnī bhāryetyucyate, tatkutaḥ kyapprasaṅgaḥ ? na brūmaḥ-- anena sūtreṇa kyapā bhavitavyamiti kiṃ tarhi ? `saṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣada' (3.3.99) ityanena, tatra uttaramāha-- `striyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'sti' iti| bhāvādhikāraśabdenātra bhāvasyābhidheyabhāvopagamalakṣaṇo vyāpāro vivakṣitaḥ, na tu śāstrīyo'dhikāraḥ| striyām - strīprakaraṇe, `saṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣada' (3.3.99) ityādinā kyapi vidhīyamāne bhāvasyādhikāraḥ, śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt| tatra kyab‌vidhīyamāno bhāva eva bhavati, na karmaṇi| `tena bhāryā sidhyati' iti| karmaṇītyabhiprāyaḥ| yasmāt striyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'sti| bhāva eva vācyatvena vyāpriyate, na karma,tena karmaṇi bhāryāśabdaḥ prasidhyati| striyāṃ bhāvādhikāre hi bhāva eva kyapā bhavitavyam| karmaṇi tu ṇyataiva|| 113. mṛjervibhāṣā| (3.1.113) ṛdupadhatvāt prāptavibhāṣeyam| `ṛdudhāccāklṛpicṛteḥ' (3.1.110) iti kyapo vidhānāt| `parimārgyaḥ' iti| pūrvavat kutvam, `gṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114)|| 114. rājasūyasūryamṛṣodyarucyakupyakṛṣṭapacyāvyathyāḥ| (3.1.114) `rājñā sotavyaḥ' iti| vākyaviśeṣeṇa rājani tṛtīyānta upapade karmaṇi nipātanamiti darśayati| `rājā veha sūyate' ityanenāpi rājani prathamānta upapade'dhikaraṇe nipātanamiti| `ṣuñ abhiṣave' (dhā.pā.1247) ityasmāt kyap| tatra cāsya tugabhāvo dīrghatvañca nipātyate| `sūsartibhyām' iti| `ṣū praraṇe' (dhā.pā.1408), `sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.935)- ābhyāṃ yathākramaṃ `aco yat' (3.1.97) iti yati prāpte `ṛhalorṇyate' (3.1.124) iti ca kyab nipātyate| `suvati' iti| karmaṇi| kārye lokān' prerayatīti| tasmin hyudite lokasya kriyāpravṛttiḥ| `pakṣe yati prāpte' iti| `vadaḥ supi kyap ca' (3.1.106) ityanena| mṛṣāvavanam - mṛṣodyam| kyap, samprasāraṇam; `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), upapadasamāsaḥ| `rocate'sau'iti| karttṛpratyayāntenārthamupadarśayan karttari nipātanaṃ darśayati| tṛjādau prāpte kyab nipātyate| `gupeḥ' iti| `gupa gopane' (dhā.pā.970), `gupū rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.395) ityasya vā| `avyayaḥ' iti| `vyaṇa {bhayasaṃcalanayo dhā.pā.} bhayacalanayoḥ' dhā.pā.764)--asmāt karttari tṛjapavādaḥ kyab nipātyate|| 115. bhidyoddhyau nade| (3.1.115) `ujjheśca' iti| `ujjha utsarge' (dhā.pā.1304)| `karttari kyab nipātyate' iti| tṛjāderapavādaḥ|| 116. puṣyasiddhyau nakṣatre| (3.1.116) `puṣeḥ siddheśca' iti| `puṣa puṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1182) `{ṣidhu dhā.pā.}sidhu saṃrāddhau (dhā.pā.1192)| `adhikaraṇe kyab nipātyate' iti| lyuṭo'pavādaḥ| 117. vipūyavinīyajityā muñjakakalkahaliṣu| (3.1.117) `vipūrvāt pavateḥ' iti| `paṅa pavane' (dhā.pā.966)| `nayateśca' iti| vipūrvādityapekṣate| `yati prāpte' iti| trayāṇāmapyajantatvāt| vipūyate vipūyaḥ| vinīyate - siddhatvaṃ prāpyate vinīyaḥ| tailena ghṛtena vā triphalādidravyasamavetena sādhyaḥ kaścidauṣadhaviśeṣaḥ kalka ityucyate| jetavyo `jityaḥ' | bṛhaddhalam - haliḥ|| 118. pratyapibhyāṃ graheśchandasi| (3.1.118) `pratigṛhyam' iti| `grahijyā' (6.1.16) ityādinā saṃprasāraṇam| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ|| 119. padāsvairibāhyāpakṣyeṣu ca| (3.1.119) `asvairī' iti.`īra {gatau kampane ca -- dhā.pā.}(dhā.pā.1018)| svena svayamīrituṃ gantūṃ śīlamasyeti tācchīliko ṇiniḥ| nipātanād‌vṛddhiḥ svarī - svatantraḥ| asvairī ucyate| `bāhyāyām' iti| bahirbhūtāyāmityarthaḥ| `bahiṣaṣṭilopaśca' (vā.378) ityupasaṃkhyānādyañ, tatra ca ṭilopaḥ| `pakṣye cārthe' iti| pakṣyaśabdo vargamācaṣṭe| pakṣe bhavaḥ pakṣya iti| digāditvādyat| pragṛhyata iti pragṛhyaṃ padam| asananikarṣo'tra gṛhṇāterarthaḥ| svarā hi tatra na sannikṛṣyante sannidhīyanta ityasannikarṣaḥ| avagṛhyata ityavagṛhyam| `yasyāvagrahaḥ kriyate' iti| tatra samudāyapade'vayavapadāni vividhānyavagṛhya vicchidyākhyāyante| tenāvayavānāmavagṛhyatvādavagṛhyamityucyate| `gṛhyakāḥ' iti| `anukampāyām' (5.3.76) iti kan| `gṛhītakāḥ' iti| saṃyatāḥ paratantrīkṛtā iti yāvat| `anyatra' iti| puṃsi napuṃsake ca| `vāsudevagṛhyāḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|| 120. vibhāṣā kṛvṛṣoḥ| (3.1.120) `vṛṣeśca' iti| vṛṣu {pluṣu dāhe-dhātu pāṭhaḥ-703} pluṣu mṛṣu mecane' (dhā.pā.706,707)|| 121. yugyaṃ ca pattre| (3.1.121) `patantyaneneti pattram' iti| `dāmnīśasa' (3.2.182) ityādinā ṣṭran| ` yugyam' iti| `yujir yoge' (dhā.pā.1444)| yojanīrye -- yujyate vāhanena {gamanamiti iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} gavādikamiti yugyam|| 122. amāvasyadantarasyām| (3.1.122) `amāvasyat' iti| ṇyatpratyayāntametannipātanam, na kyappratyayāntamiti jñāpanārthaṃ takārānubandhoccāraṇam; anyathā kyapaḥ prakṛtatvāt kyappratyayāntametaditi sambhāvyeta| sa cāpi titpratyayo ṇyadihābhipretaḥ, na yat; anyathā hi nipātanamarthakaṃ syāt| yatprakaraṇe `amāvaseranyatarasyām' ityeva brūyāt| doṣavattvācca yatpratyayāntanipātasya| doṣastūttaratrāviṣkariṣyate| yaśca yatpratyayāntanipātane doṣaḥ sa kyabante'pi samprasāraṇābhāvaśca nipātayitavyatāmāpadyeta; tasmāṇṇyatpratyayāntametannipātanamiti matvāha-- `kāle'dhikaraṇe ṇyatpratyayo bhavati' iti | ekadeśavikṛtatvādinā ṇyatpratyayāntanipātanasya guṇaṃ darśayati| vṛddhyabhāvo hi ṇyati nipātito'māvasyāśabda eva| amāvasyāśabdo nātropatiṣṭhate vṛddhyabhāvapakṣe| tataśca `ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati' (vyā.pa.16) ityamāvasyāśabde gṛhyamāṇe'māvāsyāśabdasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati| tena `pūravāhṇāparāhṇārdrāmūlapradoṣāvaskārād‌vun' (4.3.28) ityanuvarttamāne `amāvāsyāyā vā' (4.3.30) ityamāvāsyāśabde vunnaṇau vidhāyamānāvamāvasyāśabdasyāpi sidhyata ḥ| `amāvaseḥ' ityādi| ekasyā api prakṛtervṛddhibhāktvāvṛddhibhāktvadharmabhedena bhedasya vivakṣitatvāddvivacane nirdeśaḥ| ahamityātmānaṃ vyapadeśayannapare'nyathā kurvantīti sūcayati| `ṇyatoḥ' iti| ṇyatpratyayāntayorityarthaḥ| `nipātayāmyavṛddhitām' iti| anyatarasyāmiti śeṣaḥ| tena kiṃ sidhyītyāha-- `tathaikavṛttitā tayoḥ' iti| prasiddhyatīti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| kvacit `tathaikavṛttitām'iti pāṭhaḥ| tatra nipātayāmīti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| nipātayāmītyasya ca sādhayāmītyeṣo'rthaḥ| `tayoḥ' iti| amāvāsyā'māvasyayoḥ pratyavamarśaḥ| vṛttiḥ punarvunnaṇoḥ pratyayayorutpattiḥ| ekā tulyā yayorvṛttistāvekavṛttī,tadbhāva ekavṛttitā| sā ṇyatpratyayamutpādya tatra vṛddhyabhāvanipātanena sidhyatīti;ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt| `svaraśca me prasidhyati' iti| `tit svaritam' (6.1.185) iti| antasvaritatvaceṣṭam| `sidhyati' iti| ye tvamāpūrvasya vaseryataṃ nipātayanti, anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇācca pakṣe ṇyatamicchanti,teṣāṃ yadyapyamāvasyeti rūpaṃ sidhyati tathāpi yatpratyayapakṣe svaro na sidhyati; `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) iti svaritatvāpavāda ādyudāttatvaṃ vasyāśabdasya prāpnoti| amāśabdenāpi samāse kṛte `gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) itikṛdantasyottarapadasya prakṛtisvare kṛte vasyāśabda evādyudāttaḥ syāt| antasvaritasceṣyate| ekavṛttitāpi pūrvoktā na sidhyati;śabdāntaratvāt| eko hi yatpratyayāntaḥ aparaśca ṇyatpratyayānta iti ṇyati vṛddhyabhāvo nipātyate|| 123. chandasi niṣṭarkyadevahūyapraṇīyonnīyocchiṣyamaryastaryādhvaryakhanyakhānyadevayajyāpṛcchyapratiṣīvyabrahmavādyabhāvyastāvyopacāyyapṛḍāni| (3.1.123) `kyapi prāpte' iti| ṛdupadhatvāt| `ādyantaviparyayaḥ' iti kakārasyāderantatvaṃ nipātyate| takārasyāntasyāditvam| `hvayateḥ' ityādi| yadā `hveñ sparddhāyām' (dhā.pā.1008) ityasmāt kyap tadā yajāditvāt (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam, `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghaḥ| yadā tu `{hu dānādanayoḥ' dhā.pā.}hu dāne' (dhā.pā.1083) ityasamāt, tadā tugabhāvo nipātyate dīrghatvaṃ ca| devā hūyante'sminniti devahūvaḥ| `{ucchiṣyam iti kāśikā} acchivyaḥ' iti| `śiṣlṛ {viśeṣaṇe-dhā.pā.} viśaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1451)| `śaścho'ṭi' (8.4.63) iti chakāraḥ, `stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti ścutvam| ` ābhyāṃ yatpratyayaḥ' iti| ṛkārāntatvāṇṇyati prāpte| `striyāmava nipātanam'iti| anyathā staryeti strīliṅganirdeśo'pārthakaḥ syāt| `āpṛcchyaḥ' iti| grahyādinā (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam| `pratiṣīvyaḥ' iti| `hali ca' (8.2.77) ita dīrghaḥ' `vaderṇyat' iti| `vadaḥ supi kyap ca' (3.1.106) iti kyapi yati ca prāpte| `bhāvyaḥ, stāvyaḥ' iti| bhavateḥ stauteśca yadapavādo ṇyat| `niṣṭarkye' ityādi| sukhopagrahaṇārthau saṅagrahaślokau| `vyatyayam' iti| ādyantaviparyayamityarthaḥ| `ṇyadekasmāta' iti| karmaṇi lyablopa eṣā pañcamī| ekaṃ niṣṭarkyaśabdamuddiśya ṇyadbhavati| ekaṃ śabdaṃ sādhayituṃ ṇyadbhavatīti yāvat| `caturbhyaḥ kyap' iti| tādarthya eṣā caturthī| ye devahūyādayo'nantarāścatvārastadartha tatsiddhyartha kyab bhavatīti| `cataturbhyaśca yato vidhiḥ' iti| eṣāpi tādarthyaṃ eva caturthī| tadanantarā ye catvāro maryādayaḥ khānyaparyantāstadartham - tatsiddhyarthaṃ yato vidhirbhavati| `ṇaydekasmāt' iti| eṣāmapi lyablope karmaṇi pañcamī| khānyamekaṃ śabdamuddiśya ṇyadbhavati| khānyaśabdaṃ sādhayitumityarthaḥ| `yaśabdaśca' iti| ekasmādityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| devayajyāśabdamuddiśya yaśabdo bhavati| `dvau kyapau' iti| āpṛcchyapratīṣīvyaśabdayoḥ siddhye dvau kyapau bhavataḥ| `ṇyadvidhiścutaḥ' iti| caturo vārān ṇyadbhavatītyarthaḥ| sa punaḥ pariśiṣṭeṣu brahmavādyādiṣu| atha vā-- `ṇyadekasmāt' ityekasmāddhātorityarthaḥ| `caturbhyaḥ kyap' iti| caturbhyo dhātubhyaḥ kyab bhavatīti| nanu ca nayatirekaeva dhātuḥ, tatkathaṃ caturbhyo dhātubhya ityucyate ? upasargabhedādekasyāpi bhedo vivakṣita ityadoṣaḥ| `caturbhyaśca yato vidhiḥ' iti| tadanantarebhyaścaturbhyo dhātubhyo yato vidhirityarthaḥ| `ṇyadekasmāt' iti. khana ekasmāddhātorṇyadvidhiḥ| `yaśabdaśca' iti| devayajyāśabda ekasmāddhātoryaśabdo bhavati| `dvau kyapau' iti| āpṛcchyapratiṣīvyaśabdayoḥ siddhya āpracchiptiṣivaśabdābhyāṃ dvau kyapau bhavataḥ|| 124. ṛhalorṇyat| (3.1.124) `pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī' iti| `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) ityanena| kasyāḥ punaḥ pañcamyā arthe ṣaṣṭhī ? digyogalakṣaṇāyāḥ| pratyayavidhau hi `paraśca' (3.1.2) iti sambandhāt pañcamyā bhāvyam|| 125. orāvaśyake| (3.1.125) `avaśyambhāva āvaśyakam' iti| manojñāditvād‌vuñ| etadeva jñāpakam-- avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopo bhavatīti| atra dvayaṃ sambhāvyate-- upapadatvam, āvaśyaka upapada iti; upādhikatvañca, āvaśyake dyotya iti| tatra yadyevaṃ jñāpyate-- āvaśyakaupapada iti, tadopapadarahitādāvaśyake dyotye na syāt‌| `lāvyaṃ pāvyam' iti| āvaśyake dyotya ityevaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `āvaśyake dyotye' iti| etacca pratyāsatyā labhyate| upādhirhi pratyayāntadyotyatvādantaraṅgaḥ, upapadena ca sambandho bahiraṅgaḥ, tadarthasya padāntaravācyatvāt| `svarasamāsānupapattiḥ' iti| upapade hyāvaśyake vijñāyamāne `upapadamatiṅa' (2.2.19) iti samāso bhavati| tasmiṃśca sati `gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) ityupapadāśraya uttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvam, na titsvaro bhavati| dyotyapakṣe tu samāso na syāt; lakṣaṇābhāvāt| athāpi kathañcidupapadasamāsādanyaḥ samāsaḥ syāt ? evamapyupapadasamāsāśrayaḥ svaro na syāt; tataśca titsvaro na labhyet, samāsāntodāttatvaṃ hi syāt| `avaśyalāvyam' iti| `lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye' iti malopaḥ| `mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt' ityādi| mayūravyaṃsakāderākṛtigaṇatvādavaśyalāvyaprabhṛtalāvyaprabhṛtayastatra draṣṭavyā iti darśayati| svaraḥ kathamityāha-- `uttarapadaprakṛtisvaratve ca' ityādi. tatrāyaṃ yatnaḥ-- `gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) ityatra `ṣaṭ ca kāṇḍādīni' (6.2.135) ityataścakāro'nuvarttiṣyate, sa cānṛktasamuccayārthaḥ| tenāvaśyalāvyamityādāvapi prakṛtisvaro bhavatīti|| 126. āsuyuvapirapilapitrapicamaśca| (3.1.126) `yato'pavādaḥ' iti| `ṣṛñ abhiṣave' (dhā.pā.1247), `yu miśraṇe' (dhā.pā.1033) anayo rajantvāt| `ḍuvapa bījatantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1003), `rapa lapa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.401,402), `trapūṣ lajjāyām' (dhā.pā.374), `camu adane' (dhā.pā.469)--eṣāmadupadhatvanāt pavargāntatvāt| `dābhyam' iti| dabhirdhātuṣvapaṭhita eva prakṛtyantaramasti culumpavat|| 127. ānāyyo'nitye| (3.1.127) `ṇyannipātyate' iti| yati prāpte| yadyanitye nipātyate ghaṭādiṣvapyatiprasaṅgaḥ, teṣāmanityatvādityāha-- `rūḍhaḥ' ityādi| satyapi pravṛttinimittatve rūḍhyā niyataviṣayatvāc‌śabdā viśiṣṭa evārthe varttante, nāviśiṣṭe, mayūrādiśabdavat| na hi mahyāṃ rautīti sarvo mayūra ityucyate, nāpi gacchatīti sarvo gaurityucyate, kiṃ tarhi ? viśiṣṭa eva prāṇī| tasmādrūḍhiśabdāddakṣiṇāgnāveva varttate, na ghaṭādiṣu| `nityamajāgaraṇāt' iti| satatamajvalanādityarthaḥ| jvalanameva hi tas jāgaraṇam| dakṣiṇāgnāvapi viśiṣṭa evāvatiṣṭhate na sarvatreti darśayitumāha-- `yaśca' ityādi| kiṃ punastasya yonivakalpo'sti, yenaivaṃ viśiṣyate ? ityāha-- `tasya hi' ityādi| yoniḥ - kāraṇamityarthaḥ| `vaiśvakṛlāt' ityādinā yonivikalpaṃ darśayati| `ānāyyo'nitya iti cet' iti| ghaṭādiṣvapi prāpnotīti śeṣaḥ| `dakṣiṇāgnau kṛtaṃ bhavet' iti| `ānāyyaḥ' ityetasminnipātanaṃ dakṣiṇāgnāveva viśiṣṭe kṛtaṃ bhavet, nānyatra| liṅa sambhāvanāyām| etat sambhāvyate, nānyathetyarthaḥ| `ekayonau ca taṃ vidyāt' iti| tamānāyyaśabdamāhavanīyena ya ekayonirdakṣiṇāgnistatra vidyājānīyādityarthaḥ| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe-- ekayonāveva| `āneyo hyanyathā bhavet' iti| ghaṭādāvanitye dakṣiṇāgnau cāhavanīyena bhinnayonau `aco yat' (3.1.97) iti yati kṛta āneya ityevaṃ bhavati||| 128. praṇāyyo'sammatau| (3.1.128) avidyamānā sammatirityanena vākyaviśeṣeṇa bahuvrīhiṃ darśayaṃstatpuruṣāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti-- `sammatiḥ sammatatā' iti| sammata iti pūjita ityucyate| sammatasya bhāvaḥ sammatatā| etena sammatiśabdeneha pūjitābhidheyateti darśayati| `yadyevam' ityādi| avidyamānapūje caurādau praṇāyyaśabdasyāntevāsini prayogo nopapadyate| na hi pūjā'ntevāsini na vidyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `brahma prabrūyāt' iti brahamaśabdenātra veda ucyate| `sammatirabhiloṣo'pyucyate' iti| na kevalaṃ pūjetyapiśabdena darśayati| `tadabhāvena' iti| abhilāṣābhāvena| `niṣkāmatayā' iti| bhāvabhogābhilāṣarahitatayetyarthaḥ|| 129. pāyyasānnāyyanikāyyadhāyyā mānahavirnivāsasāmidenīṣu| (3.1.129) `pāyya' iti|` āto yuk' (7.3.33) `havirviśeṣeṣvatiṣṭhate' iti| yatraivāyaṃ rūḍhastatraivāvatiṣṭhate| na havirmātre| `dhāyyā' iti | pūrvavat yuk| `ṛgviśeṣasya vācakaḥ' iti| sarvā ṛco na sāmidhenīśabdenocyate, kiṃ tarhi ? samidādhānamantraḥ| tathā hi samidādhānamantre sāmidhenīśabdo vyutpādyate| sāmidhenyapi na sarvā ṛgabhidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? kācideveti darśayannāha-- `tatra' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyena nipātanāṃ kriyamāṇaṃ viśeṣaviṣayaṃ labhata ityāha-- `rūḍhiśabdo hyamam ' iti|dhāyyāśabdo rūḍhiśabda ṛgviśeṣasya vācakaḥ | saivānenocyate, nānyā| kathaṃ punarjñāyate rūḍhiśabdo'yamityata āha-- `tathā ca' ityādi| yadi rūḍhiśabdo'yaṃ na syāt sāmidhenyāṃ nipātitatvād dhāyyāḥ śaṃsatityatra ṛgviśeṣe na dṛśyeta, dṛśyate cāsau| tasamādrūḍhiśabdo'yamityavasīyate| yadi tarhyasāmidhenyāmapi dṛśyate, sāmidhenīgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt ? nānarthakam; rūḍhiviśeṣopalakṣaṇārthatvāt||| 130. kratau kuṇḍapāyyasañcāyyau| (3.1.130) `pibateḥ' iti| `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925)| `adhikarame yatpratyayaḥ' iti| lyuṭi prāpte| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ ṇyataṃ tyaktvā yatpratyayāntaḥ kuṇḍapāyyaśabdo nipātyate ? ata āha-- `yato'nāva iti svaraḥ' iti| yatpratyayāntatve hyuttarapadādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| ṇyatpratyayāntatve'ntasvaritatvaṃ syāt| `kuṇḍapānam' iti| kratoranyatra lyuḍeva bhavati|| 131. agnau paricāyyopacāyyasamūhyāḥ| (3.1.131) `saṃpūrvādvaheḥ' ityādi| halantatvāṇṇyat siddha eva; tasmiṃstu sati samprasāraṇaṃ na prāpnoti; akittvāt| ṇyataḥ kṛte'pi samprasāraṇe `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghatvaṃ na prāpnoti; yasamādaṅgāvayavāddhala uttaraṃ yat samprasāraṇaṃ tadantasyāṅgasya dīrgatvaṃ vidhīyate; na cāyamevamprakāro'sti,ata ubhayaṃ nipātyate| na sampūrvādūheḥ sāmānyavihitena ṇyataiva sidhyati| agnāveva vaheḥ sampūrvāṇṇyadyathā syāt, iha mā bhūt-- saṃvoḍhavyo brāhmaṇa iti|| 132. cityāgnicitye ca| (3.1.132) `tenāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati' iti| yatpratyayāntanipātane hi pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ padasya bhavati| ṇyati tu sati titsvaritatvaṃ bhavati| tasmāt prakṛtaṃ tyaktvā yapratyayo nipātyata iti bhāvaḥ|| 133. ṇvul‌tṛcau| (3.1.133) `cakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ' ityādi| tṛjtṛnoḥ sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ yathā syāditi| asati tu tasmin `niranubandhakaraṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti tṛno grahaṇaṃ na syāt| athāntodāttārthaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? tasya pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhatvāt|| 134. nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ| (3.1.134) `pratyāsattyā pacinaivādiśabdasya sambandho mā vijñāyītyata āha-- `pratyekam' ityādi| `nandivāśi' ityādi| `ṭunadi samamṛddhau' (dhā.pā.67), `vāśṛ śabde' (dhā.pā.1163), `madī harṣe' (dhā.pā.1208), `duṣa vaikṛtye' (dhā.pā.1185), `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau' (dhā.pā.1262,1263), `śubha śumbha śobhāyām' (dhā.pā.1321,1322), `ruca dīptau' (dhā.pā.745)-- ebhyo dhātubhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ lyurbhavati| nandayatīti| nandanamityevamādyudāharaṇam| `dūṣaṇam' iti| `doṣo ṇau' (6.4.90) ityūttvam| aṇyantānāṃ tveṣāmasaṃjñāyāṃ saṃjñāyāṃ ca tṛjādaya eva bhavanti| grahyādīnāṃ nandyādīnāñca gaṇe pāṭhasyedameva prayojanam-- saṃjñāviśiṣṭaviṣaye teṣāṃ sādhutvaṃ yathā syāt| anyathā hi prakṛtīreva gaṇe paṭhitveha cādiśabdena tā upalakṣya pratyayaṃ vidadhyāt| `sahitapi' ityādi| `ṣaha marṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1809), `tapa santāpe' (dhā.pā.985), `damu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1203) - ebhyaḥ saṃjñāyāmaṇyantebhyo lyuḥ| `jalpanaḥ' ityādi| `japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.397,398), `ramu krīḍāyām' (dhā.pā.853), `dṛpa {harṣamohanayoḥ-dhā.pā.} harṣaṇamocanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1196), `kadi kradi āhvāne rodane ca' (dhā.pā.70,71), `kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā.990) hṛṣu aloke' (dhā.pā.709),`arda hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1828), janamardayatīti janārdanaḥ, karmaṇyaṇi prāpte lyuḥ| `yu {miśraṇe'miśraṇe ca-dhā.pā.} miśraṇe' (dhā.pā. 1033), `ṣūda kṣaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1717), madhuṃ sūdayatīti madhusūdanaḥ| atrāpi karmaṇyaṇi prāpte lyuḥ| `ñibhī bhaye' (dhā.pā. 1084)| vipūrvāt `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic; `bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk' (7.3.40)|`lavaṇaḥ' iti| `lūñ chedane' (dhā.pā.1483)| `nipātanāṇṇatvam' iti| kṛtaṇatvasya gaṇe pāṭho nipātanam| `ṇaśa adarśane' (dhā.pā.1194) vipūrvaḥ, `damu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1203)- dvāvapyetau hetumaṇṇijantau| vittaṃ vināśayatīti vittavināśanaḥ| kulaṃ damayatīti kuladamanaḥ| `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ'(6.4.92) iti hrasvaḥ, karmaṇyaṇi prāpte lyuḥ| `graha' ityādi| `graha upādāne' (dhā.pā.1533), `ṣaha marṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1809) utpūrvaḥ| `tasu {upakṣaye--dhā.pā.}kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1212), `dasu ca' (dhā.pā.1213),dasivat pūrvaḥ| `bhasa bhartsanadīptyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1100) utpūrvaḥ| `ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau' (dhā.pā.928), `āto yuk'(7.3.33)| sthāyī| `matri {guptaparibhāṣaṇe' dhā.pā.} guptabhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1679), curādiṇijantaḥ| `mṛda kṣode' (dhā.pā.1515) saṃpūrvaḥ| saṃmṛd‌nātīti saṃpūrvādeva yathā syāt| `rakṣaśruvasavapaśāṃ nau' iti| `rakṣa pālane' (dhā.pā.658), `śru śravaṇe' (dhā.pā.942), `ḍuvapa bījatantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1003), `śo tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1145)-- eṣāṃ niśabda upapade ṇiniḥ| `niśāyī' iti| pūrvavadyuk| `yāci' ityādi| `ṭuyācṛ yācñāyām' (dhā.pā.863), `hṛñ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899) , vyāṅpūrvaḥ, punaḥ sa eva saṃpūrvaḥ, `vaja vraja gatau' (dhā.pā.252,253), vada vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.1009), `vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1005) --eṣāṃ pratiṣiddhānāṃ ṇinirbhavati| `pratiṣiddhānām' iti| `pratiṣiddhārthānāmityrathaḥ| pratiṣiddhārthatāṃca nañpūrvāṇāmeva bhavatīti nañpūrvebhyo ṇinirvijñāyate| kathaṃ punaḥ pratiṣiddhānāṃ prayogaḥ ? upacārasattayāmapratiṣedhādadoṣaḥ| na hi mukhyaiva padārthānāṃ sattā; kintūpacaritā'pi yathoktamarthadvāreṇa padārthānāmanyā sattaupacārikīti| tatra mukhyā yā sattā tasyā eva pratiṣedhaḥ, na tu buddhisthāyā aupacārikyā iti tannibandhanaprayogo na virudhyate| `acām' ityādi| ajantānāṃ dhātūnāmacittakarttṛkāṇāṃ pratiṣiddhānāṃ ṇinirbhavati| avidyamānaṃ cittamasyeti acittaḥ sa karttā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| arthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ viśeṣaṇam| arthasya hyacittakarttṛkatvāt tadabhidhāyino dhātava upacāreṇa tathocyante| `viśayī viṣayī deśe' iti| viśayayiviṣayiśabdau deśe'bhidheye ṇinipratyayāntau sādhū bhavataḥ| `śīṅa svapne'((dhā.pā.1032), `ṣiñ bandhane' (dhā.pā.1477)--etayorvipūrvayorṇiniḥ| vṛddhyabhāvaśca nipātanāt| abhibhāvī bhūte' iti| abhibhāviśabdo bhūtakāle ṇinipratyayāntaḥ sādhurbhavati| bhavaterabhipūrvāt ṇiniḥ| abhibhūtavānityabhibhāvī| `aparādhī, uparodhī' iti| `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau' (dhā.pā.1262,1263), `rudhir āvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1438)- ābhyāmapopapūrvabhyāṃ ṇiniḥ| `paribhāvī, paribhavī' iti| bhavateḥ paripūrvasya| pakṣe vṛddhayabhāvaḥ| `paca' ityādi| `ḍupacaṣ pāke' (dhā.pā.996), `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1842), `ḍuvapabījatantusantāne {chedane'pi--dhā.pā.}'(dhā.pā.1003), `vada vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.1009), `cala kampane'(dhā.pā.832), `śala gatau' (dhā.pā.843), `patlu gatau' (dhā.pā.845)| `nadaṭ' iti| `{ṇada' -dhā.pā.}nada avakte śabde' (dhā.pā.54)| ṭakārānubandho ṅībarthaḥ| `{bhaṣaṭ-kāśikā} bhasaṭ' iti| `{bhaṣa bhartsane'} bhasa bhartsanadīptyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1100) ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ| `gṛ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410), `miṣa sparddhāyām' (dhā.pā.1352), `kupa krodhe'(dhā.pā.1233), `miha secane' (dhā.pā.992), `tṝ plavanataraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.969), `cura steye' (dhā.pā.1534), `gāhū viloḍane' (dhā.pā.649), `jṝṣ jhṝṣ vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1130,1131), `mṛṅa prāṇatyāge' (dhā.pā.1403), `kṣamūṣ sahane' (dhā.pā.442), `tuda vyathane' (dhā.pā.1281), `mṛd kṣode' (dhā.pā.1515), `divu krīḍādau' (dhāpā.1107), `nṛtī gātravikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1116), `vraṇa gātracūrṇane' (dhā.pā.1937) curādiḥ; `dṛśir prekṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.988)| `ḍubhṛñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1087)- asmājjāraśabda upapade'c| jāraṃ bibhartīti `jārabharaḥ'| paceḥ śunyupapade karmaṇyaṇapadādo'c-- śvānaṃ pacatīti `śvapacaḥ'| `ākṛtigaṇaḥ' iti| pacādisambandhina ādiśabdasya prakārārthatvāt| ākṛtigaṇatve cāsya cakradharādayaḥ siddhā bhavanti|| 135. igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ| (3.1.135) `vikṣipaḥ' iti| kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `jñaḥ' iti| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| `priyaḥ' iti| `prīñ tarpaṇe' (dhā.pā.1836), iyaṅa| `kiraḥ' iti| `kṝ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1409), `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam, raparatvam| atha kathaṃ devādayaḥ sidhyanti, yāvatā divādīnāmigupadhatvāt ke kṛte divaḥ, siva ityevamādinā rūpeṇa bhavitavyam‌ ? ata āha-- `devaseva' ityādi| ādiśabdaḥ prakāre|| 136. ātaścopasarge| (3.1.136) `ṇapratyayasyāpavādaḥ' iti| `śyādvyadha' (3.1.141) ityādinā prāptasya| `suglaḥ' iti| `glai mlai harṣakṣaye' (dhā.pā.903,904)|| 137. pāghrādhmādheṭdṛśaḥ śaḥ| (3.1.137) `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925), `ghrā gandhopādāne' (dhā.pā.926), `ṣmā śabdāgnisaṃyogayoḥ' (dhā.pā.927) `dhṭ pāne' (dhā.pā.902)- eṣāmākārāntalakṣaṇe ke ṇe ca prāpte śo vidhīyate| yadyupasarga ityanuvarttate tadā ke; atha nivṛttam-- ke prāpta ityanupasargebhyo ṇe| dṛśestvigupadhalakṣaṇe ke| `utpiba' ityādiṣu pratyayasya śittvāt sārvadhātukasaṃjñāyāṃ `karttari śap' (3.1.68)| prāghrādinā (7.3.78) yathāyogaṃ pibādayaḥ| `saṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| prakṛtatvācśapratyayasya| tasya pratiṣedhasya `vyāghrādibhiḥ' (2.1.56) iti vacanaṃ liṅgam|| 138. anupasargāllimpavindadhāripārivedyudejicetisātisāhibhyaśca| (3.1.138) `anupasargāt' iti| subvyatyayena bahuvacanasya sthāna ekavacanam| `limpaḥ,vindaḥ' ityādi| `lipa upadāhe' (dhā.pā.1433), `vidlṛ lābhe' (dhā.pā.1432)| sanumkayorgrahaṇamupadeśāvasthāyāmeva `num' bhavatīti {cetanākhyāna dhā.pā.padamaṃjarī } vedanākhyānanivāseṣu' (dhā.pā.1708), curādiṇyantaḥ| atha vā-- jñānādyarthānāṃ bidādīnāmanyatamo hetumaṇṇyantaḥ| `ejṛ kampane' (dhā.pā.234), hetumaṇṇijantaḥ| `citī saṃjñāne' (dhā.pā.39) curādiṇyansaḥ| `ṣaha marṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1809) hetumaṇṇyantaḥ, curādiṇyanto vā | `limpaḥ, vindaḥ' iti| `tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ' (3.1.77), `śe mucādīnām' (7.1.59) iti num| `pralipaḥ, {nāsti-kāśikā}pravidaḥ' iti| igupadhalakṣamaḥ ka eva| `nau limpeḥ'ityādi| niśabda upapade limperdhātoḥ śapratyayo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvatrasthasya cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt karttavyam| `gavādiṣu' ityādi| gavādiṣūpapadeṣu saṃjñāyāṃ viṣaye śo bhavati| karmaṇyaṇo'pavādaḥṛ| sa ca cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāllabhyate|| 139. dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā| (3.1.139) `ṇasyāpavādaḥ' iti| `śyādvyadha' (3.1.141) ityādinā prāptasya| kasya tvapavādo na bhavati; anupasargādityanuvṛtteḥ| `dadaḥ,dadhaḥ' iti| śe kṛte śap| tasya juhotyāditvāt śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ| `dāyaḥ' iti| `āto yuk' (7.3.33)| `pradaḥ' iti| `ātaścopasarge' (3.1.136) iti kaḥ| nanu ca `dada dāne' (dhā.pā.17), `dadha dhāraṇe' (dhā.pā.8)- ityetābhyamaci kṛte dado dadha iti, dā dhā--ityetābhyāmapi ṇe kṛte dāyo dhāya iti bhaviṣyati, tatkimityanena sūtreṇa ? naitadasti; aci hi sati `ackāvaśaktau'(6.2.157) ityantodāttatvaṃ syāt| śe tu nañsvara eva bhavati-- adadaḥ, adadha iti|| 140. jvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ| (3.1.140) `jvaliti' iti| jval iti - ādi yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhi| vibhaktestvaśravaṇam, `supāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) iti luptatvāt| `kasantebhyaḥ' iti| kaso'ntā iti tatpuruṣaḥ, antaśabda samīpavācī| atha vā -- kaso'nta eṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| antaśabdaḥ samīpavācī, maryādāvācī vā| `jvala dīptau' (dhā.pā.804,831) iti dviṣpaṭhyate-- ghaṭādiṣu , parastācca| `tebhyaḥ' iti| tatrāsatyasmin viśeṣaṇe sandehaḥ syātkebhyo jvalādibhya iti ? atastannirāsārthaṃ jvalādayo viśiṣyante-- kasantā ye jvalādaya iti| na ghaṭādyantargaṇaḥ paryudasto bhavati| kaseḥ paratvādye paṭhyante tannivṛttyarthaṃ kasagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, kasamadhītya vṛditi pāṭhāt| nanu ca ghaṭādiṣu jvalādīnāṃ pāṭho mitsaṃjñārthaḥ, tatra vināpi kasantagrahaṇaṃ kasantā eva grahīṣyante,tadanarthakamidaṃ viśeṣaṇam ? naitadasti; asati hi tasmin pūrveṣāṃ jvalādīnāmubhayārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ syāt-- mittvārthaḥ pratyayārthaśca| itareṣāṃ tu pratyayārtha eva| tasmāt kasagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| `aco'pavādaḥ' iti| jvalādīnāṃ pacājyantaḥ pātitvāt| `tanoterṇasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam' iti| ṇe vidhātavye tanoterapi ṇasya pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| pratipādanaṃ tūttaratra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt karttavyam|| 141. śyā''dvayadhāsrūsaṃsravatīṇavasāvahṛlihaśliṣaśvasaśca| (3.1.141) `śyeṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.963)| ādityākārāntānāṃ dādhāprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| `vyadha tāḍane' (dhā.pā.1181), `sru gatau' (dhā.pā.940) āṅpūrvaḥ, punaḥ sa eva saṃpūrvaḥ| `iṇ gatau' (dhā.pā.1045) atipūrvaḥ,`ṣo'ntakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1147) avapūrvaḥ| `hṛñ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899) avapūrvaḥ| `liha āsvādane' (dhā.pā.1016), `śliṣa āliṅgane' (dhā.pā.1186), `śvasa prāṇane' (dhā.pā.1069)| atra ye sopasargāḥ paṭhitāstebhyaḥ sopasargebhya eva bhavati; śeṣebhyastu sopasargebhyaḥ, anupasargebhyaśca| `anupasargāditi nivṛttam' iti| punaruttaratrānupasargagrahaṇāt| `bibhāṣeti ca' iti| nivṛttamiti sambadhyate| vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ hyanupasargeṇa sambaddham| atastannivṛttau tasyāpi nivṛttirbhavati| `bādhakabādhanārtham' iti| `ātaścopasarge' (3.1.136) iti viśeṣavihitatvāt kaḥ sāmānyavihitasya ṇasya bādhakaḥ, tastadbādhanārtham| avaśyaterapyupādānasyaitat prayojanaṃ veditavyam| atha vā-- upasarganiyamārmatha tasya grahaṇam, avapūrvādeva yathā syāt| `avaśyāyaḥ' iti| `āto yuk' (7.3.33)|| 142. dunyoranupasarge| (3.1.142) `dunyoḥ' iti subbyatyayena pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī| `anupasarge' ityapi pañcamyarthe saptamī| ata evāha-- `dunoternayateścānupasargāt' iti| `dāvaḥ' iti| `ṭu du upatāpe' (dhā.pā.1256)| `nāyaḥ' iti| `ṇīñ prāpaṇe' (dhā.pā.901)| `pradavaḥ, praṇayaḥ'iti| pacādyac, `upasargādasamāse'pi' (8.4.14) iti ṇatvam|| 143. vibhāṣā grahaḥ| (3.1.143) `vyavasthitavibhāṣā ceyam' iti| etat `jalacare' ityādinā spaṣṭīkaroti| `bhavateśceti vaktavyam' iti| bhavateśca vibhāṣā ṇo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| vyākhyānaṃ tu vibhāṣeti yogavibhāgāt karttavyam|| 144. gehe kaḥ| (3.1.144) `gehe karttari' iti| etena `gehe' iti pratyayārthasya kartturupādhirayam, na tūpapadamiti darśayati| etaccāśvapatyādau gṛhapatiśabdapāṭhādvijñāyate| `tātsthyāddārāśca' iti| gehamiti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| etena gauṇe'pi gehe pratyayo bhavatītyācaṣṭe| etacca tantreṇa gehaśabdasya dvitīyasyoccāraṇāllabhyate| `gṛham'iti| grahyādinā (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam|| 145. śilpini ṣvun| (3.1.145) `śilpini karttari' iti| pūrvavadupādhitvaṃ darśayannupapadatvamapākaroti| etacca rajakasya vastraṃ dadātīti bhāṣyakāraprayogāllabhyate| `nṛtikhanirañjibhyaḥ parigaṇanam' iti| etacca vibhāṣetyanuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣātvāllabhyate| `rañjeranunāsikalopaśca' iti| eṣo'pi tata eva bhāṣyakāraprayogāllabhyate| kiñca `janījṝṣ‌knasurañjo'mantāśca' (dhā.pā.819 taḥ paścāt) iti yad rañjermittvaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-- akṅityapi rañjeranunāsikalopo bhavatīti| mittvasya hyetadeva prayojanam- `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvatvaṃ yathā syāt, na cāsatyasminnanusākilope vṛddhirasti| na cāsatyāṃ vṛddhau hrasvabhāvinyupadhā bhavati| tena ṇau rañjeryathānunāsikalopo bhavati, tathā ṣvuni ca| parigaṇanāt hvātā, hvāyaka ityatra na bhavati| ṣvuno nitkaraṇamādyudāttārtham, ṣakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ|| 146. gasthakan| (3.1.146) `gaḥ' iti| `āto dhātoḥ' (6.4.140) ityākāralopaṃ kṛtvā `gai śabde' (dhā.pā.917) ityasyāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ| ata evāha-- `gāyateḥ'iti| nanu ca `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaṇaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) iti `gāṅ gatau' (dhā.pā.950) ityāsyapi grahaṇena bhavitavyam ? naitat; yasmād gāthaka iti thakanpratyayāntena gāyatyarthaviśeṣa eva śilpini karttṛtvaṃ vijñāyate; na tu gāṅarthaviṣaye| thakano nakāra ādyudāttārthaḥ|| 147. ṇyuṭ ca| (3.1.147) `gāyanaḥ' iti| `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk| `gāyanī'| ṭittvānṅīp| `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttaratra cakāreṇa ṇyuṭa evānuvṛttiryathā syāt, thakano mā bhūditi| `go ṇyuṭ‌thakanau' ityekayoge thakannapyanukṛṣyeta|| 148. haśac vrīhikālayoḥ| (3.1.148) `jahāteḥ' iti| ohāk tyāge' (dhā.pā.1090)| `jihāteśca' iti| `ohāṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.1089)| asyātra grahaṇamiṣyate| tayoḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārtha eva kakāro jahāternirdiśyate| asati hi tasmin yadīdamekānubandhagrahaṇam‌, tadupādāne dvayanubandhakasya jihāterna syāt| atha dvayanubandhakasya jahāterna syāt| kakāre tu sati dvayorapi sānubandhakatvāt sāmānyena grahaṇamupapadyate| `vrīhau kāle ca karttari' iti| etena vrīhikālayoḥ pratyārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ darśayati| upapadatvaṃ tu nirasyati| etacca `dāmahāyanāntācca' (4.1.27) iti nirdeśādvijñāyate| `hāyanāḥ' iti| `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk| `jahatyudakamiti kṛtvā' iti| vrīhiṣu hāyanaśabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ darśayati| `jihīte bhāvān' iti| `jihīte bhāvān' iti| etenāpi saṃvatsare|| 149. prusṛlvaḥ samabhihāre vun| (3.1.149) `prasṛlvaḥ' iti samabhihāraṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaḥ| numāgamastu satyapi napuṃsakatve na kṛtaḥ, anityatvādāgamaśāsanasya| `samabhihāre vun' iti| anyatra samabhihāraśabdasya paunaḥ punyādikamartha iti, ihāpi sa evārtha iti kasyacit bhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākarttumāha-- `samabhihāragrahaṇena' ityādi| lakṣyate pradarśyata ityarthaḥ| etaccānekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ labhyate| śilpinītyanuvṛtterityapare| śilpī - sādhukārī| `sādhukāriṇi vunvidhānam' sādhukāritvopalakṣaṇasya phalaṃ darśayati| `sakṛdapi' ityādi| anantarasyaiva spaṣṭīkaraṇam|| 150. āśiṣi ca| (3.1.150) `āśiṣi gamyamānāyām' iti| na vācyāyām| `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) iti karttureva pratyayāntavācyatvāt| `dhātumātrāt' iti| dhātusāmānyavivakṣitatvāt, prusṛlvāñca nivartitatvāt| anyasya ceha dhātuviśeṣasyānāśrayaṇāt| dhātumātrāśrayo bhavati, na tu kutaścideva viśeṣāt| `jīvatāt, nandatāt' iti| āśiṣi loṭ‌prayogeṇa jīvakanandayostatsamānārthatāṃ darśayati| kā punariyamāśīrnāmetyāha-- `āśīḥ prārthanāviśeṣaḥ' iti| aprāptasyābhīṣṭasya vastunaḥ prārthanā - āśīḥ| `sā ceha kriyāviṣayā'iti| kriyā viṣayo'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| eṣa cārtho dhātugrahaṇāt, dhātośca kriyāvācitvādvijñāyate| `amuṣyāḥ kriyāyāḥ' iti| jīvanakriyāyā nandanakriyāyāśca karttā bhavedityevamāśāsyate-- jīvanaṃ nandanañca te bhūyāditi|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ <3.2> atha tṛtīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. karmaṇyaṇ| (3.2.1) `karyaṇi' iti nedaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam; `aśabdasaṃjñā' (1.1.68) iti pratiṣedhāt| yadi ca karmapradeśeṣu svarūpameva gṛhyate,tadā saṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt; nāpi kriyāgrahaṇam, tasya hi grahaṇe `kartrabhiprāye' (1.3.72) iti nirdeśo nopapadyate, kriyākarmaṇo hi grahaṇe kriyāvācyupapade pratyayena bhavitavyam, na ceha kriyāvācyupapadamasti tasmāt `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma' (1.4.49) iti karma gṛhyate| tasya prabhedaṃ darśayitumāha-- `trividham' ityādi| tatra nirvarttyaṃ yadasadevotpadyate, tathā--kumbhaṃ karoti,nagaraṃ karotīti| kumbhādikaṃ hyavidyamānamevotpadyata iti nirvarttyaṃ karma| vikāryam-- yasya sata eva kaścidadvikāro vidhīyate, tadyathā-- kāṇḍaṃ lunāti, nagaraṃ lunātīti| sata eva kāṇḍāderlavanena vikāro vidhīyata iti vikāryaṃ karma| prāpyam-- nāsata evotpādanaṃ kriyate, nāpi sata eva vikārādhānam, kevalaṃ kriyāsambandhamātraṃ pratīyate, tadyathā-- vedamadhīte, carccāṃ parayatīti| atrahyavyayanādinā vedādeḥ sambandhamātraṃ pratīyate, na tvasata evotpādanam| nāpi sata evānyathālakṣaṇo vikāra iti prāpyametat karma| `sarvatra' ityādi| traprakāre viśeṣānupādānāt| `karmaṇyupapade' iti nābhidāne kuto mā bhūt ? `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) ityasya bādhā iti| `śīlikāmi' ityādi| `{śīla upadhāraṇe iti dhā.pā. curādau paṭhyate; `śīla samādhau' iti ca dhā.pā.bhvādau paṭhyate} śīla samādhau' (dhā.pā.1878) curādirṇyantaḥ| `kamu kāntau' (dhā.pā.443) kamirṇiṅantaḥ| `bhakṣa adane' (dhā.pā.1557), curādirṇyantaḥ| `cara gatyarthaḥ' (dhā.pā.559) āṅpūrvaḥ| ikāro'sya dhātunirdeśārthaḥ| ebhyo'ṇi prāpte ṇo vaktavyaḥ - vyākhyeyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `jvalitikasantebhyo ṇaḥ' (3.1.140) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena ṇo'nuvarttate, `vibhāṣā grahaḥ' (3.1.143) ityataśca vibhāṣāgrahaṇam, dvāvapīha karmaṇyupapade ṇāṇau vidhīyate| atra vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācchīlītyādibhyo ṇa eva bhaviṣyatīti, pariśiṣṭebhyastvaṇeveti| etayostu striyāṃ viśeṣaḥ - aṇi hi ṅib bhavati, ṇe tu ṭāp| ṇakāraḥ `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) vṛddhyarthaḥ| `pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvañca' iti|`gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛt' (6.2.139) ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvaratve prāpte pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvañca vaktavyam - vyākhyeyam| tatredaṃ vyākhyāna m-- `{tatpuruṣe tulyādau' mu.pāṭhaḥ} tulyārtha' (6.2.2) sūtre `tatpuruṣe'iti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ tena māṃsaśīlādibhyaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvañca bhaviṣyatīti| māṃsaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ-- `vṛtṛvadihanikami{kaṣiyumucibhyaḥ da.u.} kaṣibhyaḥ saḥ' (da.u.9.21) ityanuvarttamāne `manerdīrghaśca' (da.u.9.23) iti sapratyayāntatvātpratyayasvareṇa| kalyāṇaśabdo madhyodāttaḥ-`laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' (phiṭ. 2.42) ityanena| asyāyamarthaḥ-- ante laghau paratau dvayoścāntayorlaghvoḥ parato bahvacśabdasya yo guruḥ sa udātto bhavati| `bahvaṣ' iti bahvajityarthaḥ| nanu ca śīlyādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ghañaṃ kṛtvā tadantena bahuvrīhau kṛte sidhyatveva māṃsaśīlādi, tatkiṃ ṇavidhānena ? naitadasti; bahuvrīhau sati bahubhakṣā ityatra `vahornañcaduttarapadabhūmni' (6.2.175) ityuttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ syāt| avaśyañcāṇbādhanārtho ṇo vaktavyaḥ, anyathā hi yadā `māṃsaṃ kāmayate' itīdaṃ vākyaṃ bhavati tadā'ṇapi syāt| `īkṣikṣamibhyāśca'iti| `īkṣa darśane' (dhā.pā.610), `{kṣamū-dhā.pā.}kṣamu sahane' (dhā.pā.1206)- ābhyāṃ ṇo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvavadeva karttavyam|| 2. hvāvāmaśca| (3.2.2) `hveñ sparddhāyām'| `veñ tantusantāne' iti| atha `vā gatigandhanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1050) ityasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? akarmakatvāt| karmaṇi cehānuvarttate| `māṅa māne' iti| ṅakārānubandhavato mā ityasyopalakṣaṇārthametat| `meṅa praṇidāne' (dhā.pā.961) ityasyāpi grahaṇamiṣyate; `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) iti vacanāt| nanu yadi gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣastadā `mīñ hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1476), `ḍumiñ prakṣepaṇe'(dhā.pā.1250) iti tayorapyejviṣaya āttve kṛte metyetadrūpaṃ sampadyate ? bhavatyevābhyāmaṇeveti pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasya| `svargahvāyaḥ' iti| `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk|| 3. āto'nupasarge kaḥ| (3.2.3) `anupasarge' iti| vyatyayena pañcamīprasaṅge'pi saptamī| dhātuviśeṣaṇañcaitat| ata evāha-- `ākārāntebhyo'nupasargebhyaḥ'iti ca| `godaḥ' iti| pūrvavaladākāralopaḥ| `pārṣṇim' iti| `traiṅa pālane' (dhā.pā.965)|| 4. supi sthaḥ| (3.2.4) supīti grahaṇāt karmaṇīti na sambadhyate, tiṣṭhaterakarmakatvācca| `samasthaḥ' ityādau saptamyanta upapade `atra' ityādi| supītyeko yogaḥ, tatra cāta ityanuvarttate| `supītyādinā' asya yogasyārthamācaṣṭe| `tataḥ stha ita' iti| dvitīyo yoga iti| `sthaśca supi' iti vivaraṇam| `kim'ityādi| pūrveṇa siddhamiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| `bhāve'pi yathā syāt' iti| ārambhasāmarthyāt karttari tāvanna bhaviṣyati| na cārthāntaraṃ nirddiśyate, tatra `anirddiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti' (pu.pa.pā.90) iti bhāva eva syāt| sa eva hi dhātūnāṃ svārthaḥ| `{ākhūtthaḥ-kāśikā} ākhūttham' iti| `udaḥ sthāstambhoḥ pūrvasya' (8.4.61) iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ|| 5. tundaśokayoḥ parimṛjāpanudoḥ| (3.2.5) `parimṛjāpanudoḥ' iti| subvyatyena pañcamyarthe ṣaṣṭhī| `mṛjū śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1066) pūripūrvaḥ| `nuda preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1426) apapūrvaḥ| `ālasya' ityādi| pratyayārthopādhirayam| alasa evālasyam| cāturvarṇyāditvāt svārthe ṣyañ| āharatītyāharaṇaḥ| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti karttari lyuṭ| sukhasyāharaṇaḥ sukhāharaṇaḥ| ālasyakarttari sukhasyāharaṇe'nena ko bhavati, nānyatretyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- atrāpi pūrvavadvavibhāṣāgarhaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenālasyasukhāharaṇayoreva karttoḥ ko bhavati, nānyatreti| `tundaparimārja evānyaḥ' iti| anālasye tvaṇ bhavati| `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114)| `śokāpanodaḥ' iti| yaḥ pratipakṣopadeśena śokaṃ kevalamapanudati, na tu sukhamutpādayati| atrāṇeva tu bhavati| `kaprakaraṇe' ityādi| mūlavibhujādibyastadarthe caturthī| ādiśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ| mūlavibhujādyartha mūlavibhujādayaḥ sādhavo yathā syurityevamartha kapratyayasyopādānaṃ pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `hvāvāmaśca' (3.2.2) ityataḥ `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) ityatra cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena mūlavibhujādibhyaḥ kapratyayo bhaviṣyatīti| mūlaṃ vibhujati| `{bhujo-dhā.pā.} bhuja kauṭilye' (dhā.pā.1417)| nakhāni muñcantīti nakhamucāni| `muclṛ mokṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1430)| ` kākagṛhāstilāḥ' iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.896)| kākebhyo gūhitavyāḥ|tavyadādyapavādaḥ| karmaṇi kaḥ| `kau modate kumudam' iti| tṛjādyapavādaḥ|| 6. pre dājñaḥ| (3.2.6) `sopasargārthaṃ ārambhaḥ' iti| anupasargāt `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) ityevaṃ siddhatvāt| `dadāteḥ' iti| dārūpāṇāṃ dhātūnāmupalakṣaṇametat| anyeṣāmapi dārūpāṇāṃ grahaṇamiṣyame; `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) iti vacanāt| `preṇopasṛṣṭāt' iti| preṇopasargeṇa sambaddhādityarthaḥ| sūtre `pre' iti subvyatyayena tṛtīyārthe saptamī veditavyā| `pathiprajñaḥ' iti| panthānaṃ prajānātītyarthaḥ|| 7. sami khyaḥ| (3.2.7) `gāṃ sañcaṣṭe' iti| vākyaviśeṣeṇa `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ' (2.4.54) iti khyāñādeśasya grahaṇam, na `khyā prakathane' (dhā.pā.1060) ityetasyeti darśayati| etacca saṃpūrvasya khyāteḥ prayogāsambhavāllabhyate|| 8. gāpoṣṭak| (3.2.8) `lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayorlukvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.50) iti `pā' iti pānārthasya grahaṇamam, rakṣaṇārthasya na| yadyapi `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) ucyate, tathāpi pibatinā sāhacaryāt `gā' ityasyālugvikaraṇasya grahaṇam, na gatyarthasyetyāha--`gāyateḥ, pibateśca' iti| ṭakaḥ kitkaraṇamāto lopārtham| ṭitkaraṇaṃ ṅībartham; na tu `ādyantau ṭakitau' (1.1.46) ityevamartham| kuta etat ? ādyantayoravayavatvāt| na ca pratyayo'vayavo yujyate, `paraśca' (3.1.2) iti vacanāt| nanu ca gāporiti ṣaṣṭhī ṭako'vayavatvañca bodhayiṣyate ? naitadasti; pañcamyarthe tveṣā ṣaṣṭhī, karttṛviśeṣaṇārthā vā-- gāpoḥ karttarīti| yuktañcaitat, evaṃ hi pratyayaparatvaṃ bādhitaṃ na bhavati| kiñcāditve hi ṭakaḥ kitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| pibaterūpapadāntasya nivṛttyarthamāha-- `surāśīdhvoḥ' ityādi| tatra pibateriha grahaṇam, na pāterityetat prāgeva vyavasthāpitam| iha `vibhāṣā' (3.1.143) ityanuvarttate, sā tu vyavasthitavibhāṣā; tena surāśīdhvorupapadayorbhaviṣyati, nānyatra| `kṣīrapā' iti| strīliṅgodāharaṇaṃ striyāṃ viśeṣa iti pradarśanārtham| `bahulam' ityādi| pibateśchandasi bahulaṃ ṭagbhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu -- tasyaiva vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya karttavyam| tasya tu phalaṃ surāpeti pakṣe kapratyayo bhavati|| 9. harateranudyamane'c| (3.2.9) `udyamanamutkṣepaṇam' iti| adhaḥ sthitasya vsatuna ūrdhvaṃ nayanamityarthaḥ| `aṃśaharaḥ' iti| aṃśaṃ svīkarotītyarthaḥ, na tūtkṣepayati| `acprakaraṇe' ityādi| `prātipadikagrahaṇe {liṅgiviśiṣṭasya' iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ|} liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.29) iti ghaṭagrahaṇenaiva ghaṭīgrahaṇe siddhe ghaṭīgrahaṇamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham| tasya tu prayojanam -- `dityadityādityapattyuttarapadāṇṇyaḥ'(4.1.85) ityatra vakṣyate| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena śaktyādiṣūpapadeṣu graherajbhaviṣyati| `sūtre ca' ityādi| dhārerartho dhāryyarthaḥ| tatra vartamānād‌graheḥ sūtre copapade'ca upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| pratipādanaṃ tāvattadeva| `sūtragrāha evānyaḥ' iti| yaḥ sūtraṃ kevalamupādatte na dhārayati, tatrāṇeva bhavati|| 10. vayasi ca| (3.2.10) `utadyamanārtho'yamārambhaḥ' iti| anudyamane pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| `asthiharaḥ'iti| asthyutkṣepaṇasamarthe vayasi varttata ityarthaḥ|| 11. āṅi tācchīlye| (3.2.11) anudyamanamiti nivṛttam| tenāviśeṣāllabhyate-- udyamane cāyaṃ vidhiriti| nanu cānudyamane pūrveṇaiva siddham, paratvāddhi tṛn prāpnoti, vāsarūpavidhānādajapi bhavati ? naitadasti; vakṣyati hyetat-- tācchīlikeṣu vāsarūpeṇa tṛjādayo na bhavantīti| `tācchīlyaṃ tatsvabhāvatā' iti| tat punarmānaso dharmaḥ| phalanirapekṣayā pravṛttiranumīyate| `puṣpāharaḥ'ityādinā tācchīlyamudāharati|| 12.arhaḥ| (3.2.12) `{strīliṅge iti mūlapāṭhaḥ} striyāṃ viśeṣaḥ' iti| aṇi hi sati ṅībbhavati, aci tu sati ṭāp|| 13. stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ| (3.2.13) `japeḥ śabdakarmakatvāt' iti gāyatrīṃ japati;anuvākaṃ japatītyatra śabdakarmakasyaiva prayogadarśanāt| `karmaṃ na sambhavati' iti| karṇasyāśabdātmakatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|itikaraṇo hetau| yata eva karṇaśabdaḥ karma na sambhavati tena supītyetadiha sambadhyate,na karmaṇīti| `hastisūcakayoḥ' ityādi| hastisūcakagrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasyaiva kartturviśeṣaṇam| `stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ' iti yo'yamajvidhiḥ sa hastisūcakayoḥ kartrorbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu-- tasyaiva vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya karttavyam| `stamberamaḥ karṇejapaḥ' iti| `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' (6.3.14) iti saptamyā aluk| `sūcakaḥ'iti| piśunaka ityarthaḥ|| 14. śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām| (3.2.14) `dhātumātrāt' iti| dhātumātragrahaṇenāpavādaviṣaye'pi vidhānaṃ darśayati| evaṃ hi dhātumātrādbhavati, yadyapyapavādaṃ bādhitvā tadviṣaye'pi bhavati| eṣa cārtho dhātugrahaṇāllabhyate| `śami saṃjñāyām' ityādinā dhātugrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayanam, dhātupratipāditamarthaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti-- `śami saṃjñāyām' iti| sūtropalakṣaṇametat| `śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām' ityasmin sūtra ityarthaḥ| `hetvādiṣu' iti| ādiśabdena tācchīlyānulomyayorgrahamam| śamyupapade karoteḥ saṃjñāyāṃ hetvādiṣu vivakṣiteṣu `kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu' (3.2.20) iti ṭaḥ prāpnoti, atastadvādhanārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇam| śami dhātoritysayāvakāśaḥ karoteranyo dhātuḥ śamyupapadaḥ sambhavati-- śaṃvada iti, `kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomye' (3.2.20) ityasyāvakāśaḥ karotiḥ śabdāntaropapadaḥ-- śrāddhaṃ karotīti śrāddhakara iti; karoteḥ śamyupapade saṃjñāyāyamubhayameva prāpnoti--śaṅkarā nāma śakuniketi| sā hi tacchīlā, tatsaṃjñā ca, tatra paratvāṭṭaḥ prāpnoti, punardhātugrahaṇāddhātu mātrādvidhīyamānaṃ ṭaṃ bādhitvā'jeva bhavati|| 15. adhikaraṇe śeteḥ| (3.2.15) `supīti sambadhyate' iti|śeterakarmakatvāt| adhikaraṇasya cākarmakatve sambhavati supītīha sambadhyate, na karmaṇīti| `pārśvādiṣūpasaṃkhyānam' iti| ārambho'yamanadhikaraṇārthaḥ| pārśvābhyāmiti tṛtīyāntamupapadaṃ darśayati| uraḥśaḥ, pṛṣṭhaśaya ityatrāpi tṛtīyāntamevopapadaṃ veditavyam| `digdhasahaśayaḥ' iti| digdhena saha śeta iti `tṛtīyā' (2.1.30) iti yogavibhāgena samāsaḥ| digdhasya sahena prāk pratyayotpatteḥ paścādupapadasamāsaḥ| `girau' ityādi| girāvupapade śeteśchandasi viṣaye ḍo bhavati| `giriśaḥ'iti| ḍittvāṭṭilopaḥ| etat sarvaṃ `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti bahulavacanāt siddham|| 16. careṣṭaḥ| (3.2.16) `pratyayāntarakaraṇaṃ ṅībartham' iti| ṭittvānṅībbhavati|| 17. bhikṣāsenādāyeṣu ca| (3.2.17) `anadhikaraṇārtha ārambhaḥ' iti| adhikaraṇe pūrveṇaiva siddham| bhikṣāñcaratīti `bhikṣācaraḥ' senāñcaratīti `senācaraḥ'| `ādāya' iti lyabantametat| ādāya caratīti `ādāyacaraḥ' atrādātavyakarmaṇo'vivakṣitattvāt pūrvākālamātre vivakṣite pratyayaḥ| ādānaṃ kṛtvā caratīti yāvat| tena sāpekṣatvādasāmarthye sati pratyayo na sidhyatītyetadacodyam| athāpi karmāpekṣate ? evamapi na doṣaḥ; vacanasāmarthyādasāmarthye'pi pratyayo bhavati|| 18. puro'grato'greṣu sartteḥ| (3.2.18) puraḥśabdaḥ `pūrvādharāvarāṇāmasi puradhavaścaiṣām' (5.3.39) ityasipratyayānto vyutpāditaḥ| agrataḥśabdo'pi `tasiprakaraṇa ādyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' (vā.634) iti tasipratyayāntaḥ| `agre' iti| agraśabdasyaikārāntatvaṃ nipātyate--agresara ityetadrūpaṃ yathā syāt| nanu ca saptamyā alukāpyetat sidhyati ? satyam; yadā sidhyati tadā saptamyanta upapade pratyayaḥ| yadāgraḥ saratīti, agreṇa vā saratītyasaptamyantastadā na sidhyati; tadarthamekārāntatvaṃ nipātyate|| 19. pūrve karttari| (3.2.19) `pūrvaśabde karttṛvācinyupapade pratyayaḥ' iti| etena karttarītyanenopapadaṃ viśiṣyate, na karttā| pratyayārtho nirdiśyata iti darśayati; tasya `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) ityanenaiva nirdeśāt| ayuktatvādiha nirdeśasyetyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca pūrvaḥ saratītyatrāsāmarthyamasti, tathā hi-- pūrvaśabdo'yaṃ vyavasthāvacanaḥ, avayavavācī vā| tatra pūrvasmin kalpe'vadhirapekṣaṇīya-- asmādayaṃ pūrva iti| itarasmiṃstvavayavī padārthaḥ, yathā -- pūrva kāyasyeti, ubhayorapi sāpekṣitatvāt, asāmarthye sati pratyayānutpattiḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pūrvaśabdaḥ sambandhiśabdaḥ| sāpekṣe'pi vṛttirnanu bhavatyeva, yathā-- devadattasya gurukulamiti|| 20. kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu| (3.2.20) hetvādaya ete, nopapadāni| yadi hyupapadāni syuḥ, `śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām' (3.2.14) ityatra dhātugrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| taddhi kṛño hetvādiṣu ṭapratiṣedhārthaṃ kṛtam| yadyeṣāmupapadatvaṃ syāṭṭapratyayasya prāptireva nāstīti dhātugrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|ato naivāmupapadatvam, nāpi pratyayārthatvam; `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) iti karttuḥ pratyayārthatvāt| na ca tairbādhā yuktā, virodhābhāvāt| tasmāt pratyayārthaviśeṣamatvameṣāṃ yuktam| tatra karttari pratyayo bhavati yasminnabhidhīyamāne tadviśeṣo hetvādayo gamyante| ata evāha-- `hetau tācchīlye ānulomye ca gamyamāne' iti| `heturaikāntikaṃ kāraṇam' iti| etena laukikahetorgrahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati| pāribhāṣiko hetuḥ svatantrasya karttuḥ prayojakaḥ, yadi tasyeha grahaṇaṃ syāta kṛña iti nopapadyate; na hyaṇyantāt prayojakakarttari prayojaka itpadyate, api tu ṇyantādantarbhāvitaṇyarthāt pratyaya utpadyata iti cet ? naitadasti; ṭapratyayāntaṇṇyarthasyāpratīteḥ| nanu ca laukikasya hetorgrahaṇe sati nimittatayā karttā viśiṣyate, taccāyuktam; na hi kartturanimitvamasti yadviśeṣaṇena vyāvarttyeta ? naiṣa doṣaḥ siddhe kartturhi nimittatve punarhetuśabda upādīyamāna aikāntikatvaṃ bodhayatīti--yaḥ karttā yasyāḥ aikāntiko heturiti| ata evoktam-- `heturaikāntikaṃ kāraṇam' iti| ānulomyam - anukūlayāmītyārādhyacittānupravarttanam| `yaśaskarī'iti| `ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa' (8.3.46) ityādinā visarjanīyasya satvam|| 21. divāvibhāniśāprabābhāskarāntānantādibahunāndīkiṃkṛlipilibibalibhaktikarttṛcitrakṣetrasaṃkhyājaṅghābāhvaharyattaddhanuraruṣṣu| (3.2.21) `yathāyogam' iti| divāśabdasya supīti sambandhaḥ, tasyādhikaraṇasya pradhānatvāt karmatvānupapatteḥ| śeṣāṇāṃ tu sattvapradhānatvāt karotisambandhe karma copapadyata iti karmaṇītyanena sambandhaḥ| `ahetvādyartha ārambhaḥ' iti| hetvādiṣu pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| `bhāskaraḥ' iti. kathaṃ punaratra sakāraḥ, yāvatā sakārasya rutvavisarjanīyayoḥ `kupvo ka pau ca' (8.3.37) iti visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyayoranyatareṇa bhavitavyamityāha-- `sakārasya nipātanāt' ityādi| bhāskarānteti yatsakārasyoccāraṇaṃ tadeva nipātanam| `bahukaraḥ' iti| bahuśabdo vaipulyavācī| `ahaskaraḥ' iti| ahannityasya `ro'supi' (8.2.69) iti nakārasya rephaḥ, tasya visarjanīyaḥ| tasya `ataḥ kṛkami' (8.3.46) ityādinā satvam| `dhanuṣkaraḥ, aruṣkaraḥ' iti| `isusoḥ sāmarthye' (8.3.44), `nityaṃ samāse'nuttarapadasthasya' (8.3.45) iti ṣatvam| athānantagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, antagrahaṇādevānantaśabde'pi tadantavidhinā bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti; sarvasminnupapadavidhau na hi tadantavidhiriṣyate| tathā hi `{ vārtikakāraḥ} padakāraḥ paṭhati-- `upapadavidhau bhayāḍhyādigrahaṇaṃ tadantavidhiṃ prayojayati' (1.1.72 vā.9) iti| evaṃ tarhi nānatakaro'nantakara ityantaśabdenāpi nañsamāso bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śaṅkyam;svare doṣaḥ syāt| sati śiṣṭe hi `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā prakṛtisvare hi nañsvaraḥ prasajyeta| tathā cānantakaraśabda ādyudāttaḥ, `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) iti naña udāttatvāt;iṣyate ca `{ gatikārakakopapadāt kṛt iti sūtram} gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛt' (6.2.139) ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāntodāttatvam| tasmādanantagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| `kiṃyattadbahuṣvajvidhānam' ityādi| kimityādiṣūpapadeṣvajvidhānaṃ karttavyam, tatkathamiha ṭo'pyanuvarttate ? māṇḍūkalputinyāyenājapi, vibhāṣāgrahaṇamapi| tadvayavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt kiṃyattadbahuṣu kṛño'jeva bhavati, śeṣeṣu divādiṣu ṭa eva| ahetvādyarthatvāccārambhasya yadā hetvādayo viśeṣā na vivakṣyantetadā kiṃyattadbahuṣu kṛño'jvidhānam, teṣu vivakṣiteṣu pūrvasūtreṇa ṭa eva bhavati| tathāyaṃ prayoga upapanno bhavati-- jātiriyaṃ kiṃkarīti| kiṃkaraṇaśīlā kiṃkarī, na kiñcidapi karoti| niṣprayojananeti yāvat|| 22. karmaṇi bhṛtau| (3.2.22) `karmaṇīti svarūpagrahaṇam' iti| kuta etat ? karmagrahaṇasamārthyāt| yadi pāribhāṣikasya karmaṇo grahaṇamiha syāt karmagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; karmādhikārāt| karoteśca sakarmaṃkatvāt tenaiva sambaddho bhaviṣyati| tathā ca prāguktam-- karmaṇi supīti dvayamapyanuvarttate, tatra sakarmakeṣu karmaṇītyetadupatiṣṭhate, anyatra supīti| tasmāt svarūpagrahaṇamevaitat| `karmanirdeśaḥ'iti| karma vyāpāraḥ, tasya nirdeśaḥ - mūlyam|| 23. na śabdaślokakalahagāthāvairacāṭusūtramantrapadeṣu| (3.2.23) `hetvādiṣu ṭaḥ prāptaḥ' iti| `kṛño hetu' (3.2.20) ityādinā|| 24. stambaśakṛtorin| (3.2.24) `vrīhivatsayoriti vaktavyam' iti| karttṛviśeṣamaṃ vrīhivatsagrahaṇam| anena sūtreṇa ya in vidhīyate sa vrīhivatsayoḥ kartrorbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ihāpi vibhāṣetyanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena vrīhivatsayoḥ kartroreva bhaviṣyati, nānyatra| nityatvāduttarapadādādyudāttatvam|| 25. haraterdṛtināthayoḥ paśau| (3.2.25) `paśau karttari' iti| etena paśugrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasya kartturviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| pratyayārthatvaṃ tu `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) iti vacanāt| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam-- pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇameveti, na punarbādhakameveti ? taducyate-- dhātoḥ pratyayasya vidhānāt tadarthasya yena sambandhastatra vācye pratyayena bhavitavyam| dhātvarthaḥ - kriyā tasyāśca sādhanena sambandhaḥ, na vastusvarūpeṇa| sādhanañca śaktiḥ, na vastusvarūpam| paśuśabdena vastusvarūpeṇa svārthamācaṣṭe| na śaktisvarūpeṇeti| tenāśaktisvarūpe pratyāyyamānaḥ paśurnārhati pratyayārtho bhavitum| so'pratyayārthaḥ sannaśaktitvāt kathamimaṃ pratyayārtha bādheta| tasmāt pratyayārthaḥ, tena karttari viśiṣyata iti yuktamuktam-- paśau karttarīti| eṣa nyāyo'nyatrāpi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇe draṣṭavyaḥ|| 26. phalegrahirātmambhariśca| (3.2.26) 27. chandasi vanasanarakṣimathām| (3.2.27) `brahmavaniṃ tvā kṣatravanim'iti| brahma vanati, kṣatraṃ vanatītyarthavivakṣāyāminpratyayaḥ| tadantāddvitīyā, tasyāḥ `supāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) iti luk| yuṣmacchabdāddvitīyādibhakteḥ `tvāmau dvitīyāyāḥ' (8.1.23) iti tvādeśaḥ| `gosanim' iti| gāṃ sanatītyartha inpratyayaḥ| tadantādami pare pūrvarūpatvam| panthānaṃ rakṣata iti `pathirakṣī'| dvivacanametat| pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam| `havirmathīnām' iti| havirmathantīti vigṛhya pratyayaḥ| tadantāt ṣaṣṭhyā bahuvacanam|| 28. ejeḥ khaś| (3.2.28) ṇyantāt' iti| etena prakṛtyantarasyāyamejerikā nirdeśa ityāśaṅkāṃ nirasyati| kutaḥ punarṇyantamavasitam ? khaśaḥ śitkaraṇāt| prakṛtyantarasya grahaṇe śitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| taddhi sārvadhātuke sati tadāśrayasya śapo vidhiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate| na caijeḥ prakṛtyantarasya satyasati vā śapi kaścidviśeṣo'sti, ṇyagrahaṇe tu sati śitkaraṇamarthavadbhavati| asati tasmin ṇilopaḥ syāt, tasmiṃstu sati sārvadhātunibandhane śapi ṇilopo na bhavati| ārdhadhātukatvaṃ ṇilopa ityeke, etaccāyuktam; uttarārthaṃ hi śitkaraṇaṃ syāt| asati hi tasminnuttarasūtre dheṭa āttvaṃ syāt, dhmaśca dhamādeśo na syāt| tathā ca stanandhayaḥ, nāsikandhama iti na sidhyet| tasmādvyākhyānādeva ṇyantatvamavaseyam| `khakāro'yaṃ mumarthaḥ'iti| `khityanavyayasya' (6.3.66) ityadhikṛtya `arurdviṣadajantasya' (6.3.67) iti mumāgamo yathā syāt| `śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ' iti| `tiṅaśit sārvadhātukam' (3.4.113) iti sārvadhātukasaṃjñā yathā syāt| `aṅgamejayaḥ' iti| śap, guṇāyādeśau| `khaśprakaraṇe' ityādi| vātādiṣūpapadeṣu `aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.230), `dheṭ pāne' (dhā.pā.902), `tuda vyathane' (dhā.pā.1281),`ohāk tyāge' (dhā.pā.1090)--ityebhyo dhātubhyaḥ khaśprakaraṇa upasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam -- `nāḍīmuṣṭyośca' (3.2.20) ityatra cakāraḥ, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena vātādiṣūpapadeṣvajādibhyo dhātubhyaḥ khaś bhaviṣyati| `śunindhayaḥ' iti| `khityanavyayasya' (6.3.66) iti hrasvatvam| `śarddhañjahāḥ' iti| juhotyādibhyaḥ śapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau'(6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam, `śnābyasatyorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ|| 29. nāsikāstanayordhmādheṭoḥ| (3.2.29) `stane dheṭaḥ' ityādinā yathāyogamupapadasambandhaṃ darśayannudāharaṇāni darśayati| `nāsikandhamaḥ' iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) dhamādeśaḥ| `taccaitat' ityādi| yathāsaṃkhyābhāve hetumāha| stanaśabdo hi nāsikāpekṣayalpāctaraḥ, tasya pūrvanipāte karttavye yo'yamapūrvanipātaḥ kṛtaḥ salakṣamavyabhicāraṃ sūcayati| yatheha pūrvanipātaśāstraṃ vyabhicarati, svaviṣaye na pravartate, tathā yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīti| ato'smāllakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnādyathāsaṃkhyābhāvo labhyate|| 30. nāḍīmuṣṭyośca| (3.2.30) `atrāpi'ityādinā nāḍīmuṣṭiśabdo hi dhyantaḥ tasya hi `dvandve ghi' (2.2.32) iti pūrvanipāte prāpte yo'yamapūrvanipātaḥ kṛtaḥ sa pūrvanipātalakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnam, ata ihāpi saṃkhyātānudeśo na bhavitītyapi sūcayati| atha pratyekamupapadābhyāṃ dhātoḥ pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ| sa codāharaṇenaiva vṛttāvabhivyaktaḥ| `anuktasamuccayārthaścakāraḥ' iti| tena ghaṭīkhārīvātaśabdeṣvapyupapadeṣu dhmādheṭoḥ khaś bhavati| yadyevam, vaiṣamyādeva saṃkhyātānudeśo na bhaviṣyatīti nirarthakastadabhāvārtho ghyantasyāpūrvanipātaḥ ? ucyate-- vākye bhedena dve hyatra, ekena vākyena nāḍīmuṣṭī-- ityetayordhmādheṭoḥ khaś bhavatīti| ataḥ `nāḍīmuṣṭyoḥ' ityekaṃ vākyam, cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt ghaṭīkhārīvātaśabdeṣvapyupapadeṣu dhmādheṭoḥ khaś bhavatīti dvitīyam| tatra pūrvasmin vākye samānatvamastīti syādeva saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ|| 31. udi kūle rujivahoḥ|(3.2.31) `udi' iti| saptamīyam- udi sati| tatrotkūlaśabdayorviṣayavyavasthā draṣṭavyā| `te prāgdhātoḥ' (1.4.80) iti vacanāddhātoranantaramutśabdaḥ, tasmāt pūrvaḥ kūlaśabda iti| atha vā-- `{ uditi-- mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} udīti parasaptamī-- udi parataḥ kūlaśabdasyopapadatva iti| athocchabdasyāpyupapadasaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati, pratyekaṃ saptamyuccāraṇāt ? eṣā hyācāryasya śailī yatra pratyekamupapadatvamasti tatra samudāyāt saptamīmuccārayati, yathā-- `nāḍīmuṣṭyoḥ (3.2.30) iti| iha tu viparyayaḥ kṛta iti na bhavatyupapadatvam| api ca rujivahoḥ sakarmakatvāt karmaṇītīhopatiṣṭhate| na cocchabdasay karmatvaṃ sambhavati asattvavācitvāt| kutastasyopapadatvam| `kūlamudrujaḥ' iti| tudāditvācchaḥ' `kūlamudvahaḥ' iti| śap|| 32. vahābhre lihaḥ| (3.2.32) `vahaṃlihaḥ' iti| `liha āsvādane' (dhā.pā.1016) adāditvācchapo luk, `sārvadhātukamapit' (1.2.4) iti ṅitvādguṇābhāvaḥ|| 33. parimāṇe pacaḥ| (3.2.33) `prasthampacā,droṇampacā' iti| prasthadroṇaparimite vrīhyādau prasthadroṇaśabdāvupacāreṇa varttete; na prasthādāveva parimāṇaviśeṣe kāṣṭhādimaye| kledavācī hyatra paciḥ| na ca mukhyasya prasthādervikledaḥ sambhavati, ato na tasya sambandha upapadyate| svarūpagrahaṇamapyata eva na bhavati; na hi svarūpapradhānena parimāṇena vikledavacanasya paceḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati| yadyapi hi prasthādiśabdaḥ parimeye varttate, tathāpi parimāṇavyapadeśo na tasya virudhyate, prathamaṃ parimāṇavṛttitvāt|| 34. mitanakhe ca| (3.2.34) `aparimāṇārtha ārambhaḥ' iti| parimāṇe pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| mitanakhaśabdayoraparimāṇavacanatvāt| sarvadaiva hi mitaśabdaḥ parimeyadravyavacanaḥ , nakhaśabdo hi prāṇyaṅgavacanaḥ|| 35. vidhvarūṣostudaḥ| (3.2.35) `aruntudaḥ' iti| aruśśabdasya `arurdviṣadajantasya' (6.3.67) ityukārāt paro mumāgamaḥ, saṃyogāntalopaḥ (8.2.23), `mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.23), `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ'(8.4.58) itiparasavarṇaḥ|| 36. asūryalalāṭayordṛśitapoḥ| (3.2.36) `asūryampaśyāḥ' iti| prāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) paśyādeśaḥ| `dṛśinā nañaḥ sambandhāt' iti| asāmarthya hetuḥ| atra hi darśanaṃ pratiṣidhyate,na tu sūrya eva| tasmād‌dṛśinaiva nañaḥ sambandhaḥ, na sūryeṇetyasāmarthyam| `sūryaṃ na paśyanti' iti dṛśinā nañaḥ sambandhaṃ darśayati| yadā sūryaḥ pratiṣadhyate tadā na bhavitavyameva pratyayena, anabhidhānāt| samāsaścāyamasāmarthye'pi bhavati, gamakatvāt| asmādeva vacanādvā| nanu ca yathā rājadārāḥ sūryaṃ na paśyantīti tathānyadapi parapuruṣādikam, tatrāyuktaṃ sūryeṇaikena viśeṣaṇenetyata āha-- `guptiparañcaitat' iti| yatetadasūryampaśyā rājadārā iti vacanametad‌guptipradhānam; guptipratipādanāya prayuktatvāt| `evaṃ nāma' ityādinā guptiparatvamasya darśayati|| 37. ugrampaśyerammadapāṇindhamāśca| (3.2.37) `ugrampaśya' iti| `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) iti prāpte dṛśeḥ khaś nipātyate| pūrvavat paśyādeśaḥ| `irammadaḥ'iti| `irayā mādyati'iti| `madī harṣe' (dhā.pā.1208)| tṛjādiṣu prāpteṣu khaś nipātyate| tatra divāditvācchyani prāpte tadabhāvo nipātyate| `pāṇindhamāḥ' iti| adhikaraṇe lyuṭi prāpte khaś nipātyate| pūrvavaddhamādeśaḥ| 38. priyavaśe vadaḥ khac| (3.2.38) `cakāraḥ `khacihrasvaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ'iti| `khe hrasvaḥ' ityucyamāne khaśyapi syāt| nanu caikānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasyeti (vyā.pa.52) na bhaviṣyati ? evaṃ tarhi paribhāṣāśrayaṇāccakārakaraṇameva laghviti ca manyate| nanu ca priyaṃvado vaśaṃvada iti khaśyapi siddhyati, kimarthaṃ pratyayāntarakaraṇamityāha-- `pratyayāntarakaraṇamuttarārtham'iti| `dviṣatparayostāpeḥ' (3.2.39) ityatra khaci hrasvastāperyathā syāt| ṇilopaścetyādyarthaṃ pratyayāntaraṃ kriyate| athottaratraiva khac kasmānna kriyate ? atrāpi khajbhavatīti vijñānārtham| tena gamerapi supyupapade khac siddho bhavati| yadi `khac‌prakaraṇe gameḥ supyapasaṃkhyānam' (vā.247), tatropasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanārthaṃ pratyayāntaraṃ kriyate| pratipādanantvidameva veditavyam| `vihāyaso viha ca' iti| gamervihāyaḥśabda upapade khacpratyayaḥ, tatsanniyogena vihāyaḥśabdasya vihādeśaḥ| `khacca ḍidvā vaktavyaḥ' iti| ḍittvāṭṭilopaḥ syāt, `vihāyaso viha ca' (vā.248) ityato'sya bhedena pāṭhāt| ḍittvasyānityatvajñāpānārtham; anyathā vihaṅgama iti na sidhyet| `ḍe ca' ityādi| ḍapratyaye ca gamervihāyaso vihādeśaḥ| `vihagaḥ' iti| na punaratra ḍapratyayaḥ ? asmādeva vacanādbhavati| atha vā vakṣyatyuttarataḥ `ḍaprakaraṇe'nyeṣvapi dṛśyate' (vā.256) iti|| 39.dviṣatparayostāpe| (3.2.39) `dvayorapi grahaṇam' iti| ṇyantāvasthāyāṃ viśeṣābhāvāt| `dvitakārako nirdeśaḥ'iti| `dviṣatparayoḥ'iti nirdeśe dvau takārau,tatraiko dviṣacchabdasyāvayavaḥ, tena dviṣacchabdo viśiṣyate-- dviṣacchabda upapade takārānta iti| `tena striyāṃ na bhavati' iti| strīpratyayāntastakārānto na bhavati| asati tu dvitīye takāre `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.29) iti strayiyāmapi syāt| `{dviṣatīkāśikā} dviṣatī' iti| `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp| ugittvantu dviṣacchabdasya `dviṣo'mitre' (3.2.131) iti śatrantatvāt|| 40. vāci yamo vrate| (3.2.40) `śāstritaḥ' iti| śāstre kṛta iti vigṛhya śāstraśabdāt pratipadikāddhātvarthe ṇic, tadantāt kte vihate śāstrita iti| śāstravihita ityarthaḥ| atha vā śāstriṇa itaḥ śāstritaḥ, śāstravida itaḥ - jātaḥ, pravṛttaḥ| atha vā-- śāstraśabdastārakādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ| śāstramasya sañjātamiti śāstritaḥ| `vācaṃyamaḥ' iti| vācaṃ yacchatīti vigṛhya khaci `vācaṃyamapurandarau ca' (6.3.69) iti pūrvapadasya mumabhāvo nipātyate| nanu ca pratyayo'pi tenaiva nipātanena bhaviṣyati, tatkimanena ? naitadasti; yacchatīti pacādyaci vihite tataśca `vāco yamaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāse kṛte vācaṃyama iti sidhyati| sampadyata eva, tatra tu nipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt| evañca sati nityamupapadasamāso na syāt| ataḥ khacpratyayo vidheyaḥ, nipātanamapi karttavyam|| 41. pūḥsarvayordārisahoḥ| (3.2.41) `dāri' iti| `dṝ vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1493) ityasya ṇicā nirdeśaḥ| `purandaraḥ' iti| pūrvapade mumbhāvo nipātyate| `bhage ca dāreriti vaktavyam' iti| bhage copapade dāreḥ khajbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--`ugrampaśyerammadapāṇindhamāśca' (3.2.37) ityataścakāro'nuvarttate, na cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena bhage copapade dāreḥ khajbhavatīti|| 42. sarvakūlābhrakarīṣeṣu kaṣaḥ| (3.2.42) `sarvaṅkaṣaḥ' iti| `kaṣa khaṣa śiṣa jaṣa jaṣa {śaka iti mu.pāṭhaḥ} śaṣa vaṣa maṣa ruṣa riṣa hiṃsārthāḥ' (dhā.pā.685-694)|| 43. megharttibhayeṣu kṛñaḥ| (3.2.43) `upapadavidhau' ityādi| nanu cābhayaśabdo nañsamāse sidhyatyeva ? naivaṃ śakyam, satiśiṣṭatvāddhi `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarādyudāttatvaṃ syāt, `{gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' iti sūtram} gatikārakopapadānām' (6.2.139) ityādināntodāttatvaṃ ceṣyate| tasmāt karttavyam| apavādatvāt khajayamaṇaṃ bādhate, hetvādivivakṣāyāñca paratvāṭṭapratyayamapi|| 44. kṣemapriyamadre'ṇ ca| (3.2.44) atha `kṣemapriyamadre vā' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam ? kimaṇgrahaṇena ? khaci vikalpyate, `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) ityanenaivāṇ bhaviṣyītyata āha-- `veti vaktavye' ityādi| `kṣemapriyamadre vā' ityucyamāne pakṣe vāgrahaṇādyathāprāptamapīṣyate| tato hetvādiṣu vivakṣiteṣu `kṛño hetutācchīlya' (3.2.20) ityādinā ṭaḥ syāt; atastadvādhanārtham| tena hetvādivivakṣāyāṃ ṭapratyayaṃ bādhitvā'ṇ bhavati|| 45. āśite bhuvaḥ karaṇabhāvayoḥ | (3.2.45) atra supītyupatiṣṭhate, na karmaṇīti; bhavaterakarmakatvāt| `āśitaśabde subante' ityādi| atha viparyayaḥ kasmānna vati, karaṇabhāvayorupapadayorāśite pratyayārtha iti ? asambhavāt| āśita ityaśnāteḥ karttocyate, tasya bhavatinā sambandho nopapadyate| na hi yo'śnāteḥ karttā sa bhavateḥ pratyayārtho bhavatumutsahate| tasmādāśitaśabdasyopapadatvam, itarayostu pratyayārthatvam| evañca ghañlyuṭorapavādo bhavati| vā'sarūpavidhinā lyuḍapi bhavatyeva-- āśitabhavana odana iti| ghañastu svarūpatvādbādhakha eva||| 46. saṃjñāyāṃ bhṛtṛvṛdhārisahitapidamaḥ| (3.2.46) `saṃjñāvaśāt' iti| saṃjñāśabdā hi dvividhā bhavanti-- kecidavayavārthānugatāḥ,yathā-- saptavarṇa iti; kecittu viparītāḥ, yathā tailapāyiketi| tadiha yatrāvayavārthānugamo'sti viśvambharaḥ, śatruntapa ityādiṣu , tatra karmaṇīti sambadhyate-- viśvaṃ bibharttīti viśvambharaḥ| yatra tvavayavārthānugamo nāsti, yathā-- rathantaraṃ sāmeti, tatra vyatpattyarthaṃ supīti sambadhyate-- rathena taratīti, rathe taratīti vā| `patiṃvarā' iti| `vṛñ varaṇe' (dhā.pā.1254), `vṛṅa sambhaktrau'(dhā.pā.1509)| patiṃ vṛṇīte, patiṃ vṛṇuta iti vigrahaḥ| śatruṃ jayatīti `śatruñjayaḥ'| `dhāri' iti| dhṛño ṇyantasya grahaṇam| yugaṃ dhārayatīti `yugandharaḥ'| pūrvapadadhrasvatvam| śatruṃ sahata iti `śatruṃsahaḥ'| śatruṃ tapatīti `śatruṃtapaḥ'| ariṃ dāmyatīti `arindamaḥ' | yadyapi damirakarmakaḥ, tathāpyantarbhāvitaṇyarthatvāt sakarmako bhaviṣyati| ariṃ damayatītyarthaḥ|| 47. gamaśca| (3.2.47) `yasya sautaṅgamiḥ putraḥ' iti| putrasya sautaṅgamitvavyapadeśena pituḥ sutaṅgamasaṃjñānumīyata iti darśayati| satyāṃ hi pituḥ sutaṅgamasaṃjñāyāṃ tatputrasya sautaṅgamiśabdenābhidhānaṃ bhavati, nāsatyām| atha yogavibhāgaḥ kimarthaḥ, pūrvasūtra eva gamergrahaṇaṃ kriyātamityāha-- `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| gamerevottaratrānuvṛttiryathā syāt, bhṛñādīnāṃ mā bhūt| ekayoge hi te'pyanuvartteran|| 48. antātyantādhvadūrapārasarvānanteṣu ḍaḥ| (3.2.48) `ḍakāraṣṭilopārthaḥ'iti| ḍiti `ṭeḥ' (6.4.155) iti ṭilopo yathā syāt| kathaṃ punaḥ satyapi ḍakāre ṭilopo labhyate, yāvatā bhasaṃjñakasya hi ṭilopa ucyate, na ceha bhasaṃjñā'stītyāha-- `ḍityabhasyāpi' ityādi| yadi satyapi ḍiti ṭilopo mā bhūt, tadā tasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu caśravaṇārtha bhaviṣyati, tatkuto vaiyarthyaṃ syāt ? evaṃ manyate-- `prāvṛṭ‌śaratkāladivāñje' (6.3.15) iti kṛtaṭilopasya janerḍapratyayāntasyāyaṃ nirdeśaṃ karoti, tato'vasīyate ḍakārasyāśravaṇārthateti| `sarvatra' ityādi. upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `gamaśca' (3.2.47) ityataścakāro'nuvarttate| tasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt sarvatretyādānupapade ḍo bhaviṣyatīti| sarvatraśabdaścātra supītyanena sambadhyate, na tu karmaṇītyanena; tasyādhikaraṇaśaktipradhānatvāt karmatvānupapatteḥ| pannaśabdaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt karmaṇītyanena sambadhyate| pratipāditaṃ hi `karaṇe ca stokālpa' (2.3.33) ityādisūtre kriyāviśeṣaṇasya karmatvam| `uraso lopaśca' iti| `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti sakārasya| `suduroradhikaraṇa' iti| lyuḍapavādo ḍo vidhīyate| vā'sarūpavidhinā so'pi bhavati-- sugamanam, durgamanamiti| adhikaraṇa iti kim ? karmaṇi mā bhūt| `īṣad‌duḥsuṣu' (3.3.126) ityādinā khaleva bhavati-- sugamaḥ, durgama iti| `niro deśe' iti| nir‌śabda upapade gamerḍo bhavati deśe'dhikaraṇe| nirgamyate'smin deśe nirgo deśaḥ| deśādanyatra lyuḍeva-- nirgamanamiti|| 49. āśiṣi hanaḥ| (3.2.49) `āśiṣi' iti| pratyayārthametat| tasmin karttari pratyayo bhavati yasmin vidhīyamāna āśīrgamyate| `timiṃ vadhyāt' iti| āśīrliṅa| prayogavato vākyasyopanyāsastu samānārthatvāt timihaśabdasya prakhyānārthaḥ| `dārāvāhana' ityādi| ṭakārādeśa evopasaṃkhyāyate| aṇpratyayastu `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) ityanenaiva siddhaḥ| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityantasya bhaviṣyatīti ? naca ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasyālontyaviṣayo bhavanti| na ceha hanteḥ ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pañcamyā| nanvarthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati-- hana ityasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhī sampadyate ? evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthamantagrahaṇam| `dārvāhanti' iti|dāruśabdo'tra dvitīyāntaḥ| `svamornpuṃsakāt' (7.1.23) iti luptatvānna dvitīyā śrūyate| `cārau vā' iti|atrā'pyādeśo vikalpena vidhīyate| aṇ tu `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1) iti nityameva siddhaḥ| `cārvāghāṭaḥ'iti| `ho hanterñṇinneṣu' (7.5.54) iti kutvam| `hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ'(7.3.32) iti tatvam| `karmaṇi sami ci' ityetadvākyaṃ karmaṇyupapada ityasyaiva viśeṣaṇam|| 50. ape kleśatamasoḥ| (3.2.50) `udi kūle rujivahoḥ' (3.2.31) ityatrocchabdasyopapadatve yo nyāya uktaḥ sa ihāpyapaśabdasya veditavyaḥ| `anīśīrartha ārambhaḥ'iti| āśiṣi pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt|| 51.kumāraśīrṣayorṇiniḥ| (3.2.51) `kumāraghātī' iti| pūrvavat tatvakutve| `nipātanācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ' iti| kumāraśīrṣayorityata eva nipātanācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvo bhavati, na punaḥ `śīrṣaśchandasi'(6.1.60) ityanena| tatra hi śīrṣanniti śiraḥśabdasamānārthaṃ śabdāntaraṃ nipātyate,anyathā śīrṣaghātīti cchandasyeva syāt,na bhāṣāyām| `kumāraśīrṣayoḥ' iti ca nirdeśo nopapadyate, sa hi nakārāntaḥ; akārāntena cāyaṃ nirdeśo bhavati, na nakārānteneti| ṇinerdvitīya ikāro nakārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārthaḥ, ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ|| 52. lakṣaṇe jāyāpatyoṣṭak| (3.2.52) lakṣyate cihnyate'neneti lakṣaṇam| tadasyāstīti tasmin lakṣaṇavati| etena matvarthīyākārapratyayānto lakṣaṇaśabdaḥ sūtra upātta iti darśayati, sa ca karttuḥ pratyayasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayannāha-- `lakṣamavati karttari' iti| atha lakṣaṇaśabdasyopapadatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? kecidāhuḥ- `hanteḥ sakarmakatvāt karmaṇītīhopatiṣṭhate;tatra yadīha lakṣaṇasyopapadatvaṃ syāt, tat karmaṇā viśiṣyeta| na ca lakṣaṇaṃ hanteḥ karmopapadyate, sa hi hiṃsāyāṃ varttate, hiṃsā ca prāṇiviṣayā| jāyāpatyoḥ prāṇidharmatvāt karmatvamupapadyate'iti, etaccānupapannam ; matvarthīyākārapratyayāntasya lakṣaṇaśabdasya prāṇinyapi vṛtteḥ| vyākhyānādeva lakṣaṇasyānupapadatvaṃ vijñāyate| anabhidhānādvā| jāyāpatyoḥ kartrorabhidhānaṃ dṛṣṭam| `jāyāghnaḥ'iti| kittvāt `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ, pūrvavat kutvam| `patighnī'iti| ṭittvānṅīp|| 53. amanuṣyakarttṛke ca| (3.2.53) `amanuṣyakarttṛke' iti| amanuṣyaḥ karttā yasya sa tathoktaḥ etacca dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇam, dhātvartho hanterityata āha-- `{ evaṃprakārā paṃktirmūlapāṭhe nāsti} amanuṣyakarttṛke dhātvarthe' ityādi| athāmanuṣyakarttṛkagrahaṇamupapadaviśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? karmaṇītyanuvarttate, karmaṇaścāmanuṣyakartrā saha sambandhānupapatteḥ| sādhanasya hi kriyāyāḥ sambandhaḥ, na kārakāntareṇa| pratyayārthasya karttṛridaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? tasyāmanuṣyakarttṛkatvābhāvāt| na hi karttuḥ karttā sambhavati, api tu kriyāyāḥ| nanu ca karttṛgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam, vināpi hi tenāmanuṣyakarttari pratyayo labhyata eva ? naivaṃ śakyam; karttṛgrahaṇamantareṇāmanuṣyagrahaṇaṃ kevalamupādīyamānamupapadaviśeṣaṇamapi vijñāyate| tasmāt karttṛgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| tasmin satyamanuṣyakarttṛgrahaṇaṃ tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ na sambhavatītyato dhātvartha eva tena viśeṣayituṃ yuktaḥ| `iha kasmānna bhavati' iti| hastikarttṛkatvādamanuṣyakarttṛko dhātvarthaḥ| etasmādbhavativyameva ṭakpratyayeneti manyate|| 54. śaktau hastikapāṭayoḥ|(3.2.54) `śaktau gamyamānāyām' iti| anenopapadatvaṃ śakternirākaroti| `hastikapāṭayoḥ karmaṇīrupapadayoḥ'ityanenāpi hastikapāṭayoḥ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate-- śaktāvupapade hastikapāṭayoḥ kartroriti ? ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi vijñāyamāne hastikapāṭayormanuṣyakarttṛke dhātvarthe hantirvarttate| tathā ca pūrveṇaiva siddhe'syārambhavaiyarthyaṃ syāt| upapadatve tu tayoḥ śaktau gamyamānāyāṃ manuṣye karttari vijñāyata iti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| `viśeṣa hastinaṃ hanti'iti| viṣeṇetyaśaktikatvaṃ darśayati| yo hi svayaṃ hantuṃ na samarthaḥ sa viṣādinopāyāntareṇa hanti|| 55. pāṇighatāḍaghau śilpini| (3.2.55) `pāṇighatāḍaghau' iti| ṭapratyayo ghatvaṃ ṭilopaśca nipātyate|| 56. āḍhyasubhagasthūlapalitanagnāndhiprayeṣu cvyartheṣvacvau kṛñaḥ karaṇe khyun| (3.2.56) `accau'iti| bahuvrīhiḥ-- na vidyate cviryasmistatrāccau| tatpuruṣo vā -- cveranyo'cviḥ| acvyanta ityarthaḥ| acvādityāḍhyādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam| ekavacanaṃ tu pratyekaṃ tairabhisambadhyate| `āḍhyādiṣu' ityādinā karttṛviṣaṣaṇatvamāḍhyādīnapākaroti| `karaṇe kārake'ityanenāpi karaṇasyopapadatvaṃ nirasyati| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate-- karaṇa upapade āḍhyādiṣu karttṛṣviti ? tatra kecidāhuḥ-- āḍhyādayo'tra śabdapradhānāḥ, na ca tathābhūtānāṃ karttṛtvamupapadyate| śabdapradhānatvaṃ punasteṣāṃ cvyanteṣvacvāviti pratiṣedhādvijñāyate| śabda eva hi cvyanto bhavati, nārthaḥ| cvyantatā śabdasyaiva vidyate, nārthasya| tatra yadyete'rthapradhānāḥ syuḥ; cvyartheṣviti viśeṣaṇamanupapannaṃ syāt, acvāviti ca pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| paryudāso'pyanarthakaḥ syāt ; na; tsayāpyāḍhya ityevaṃśabdaḥ sukhati, subhagaśabdaḥ sukhayītyādiprayogeṣu karttatvadarśanāt| vyākhyānādevārthaniścayo'dveṣyaḥ| karaṇasya pratyayārthatvena nirdeśāt `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) iti na vyāpriyate| nanu ca neme cvyarthāḥ, te niyogata eva cvyantāḥ, iha tvacvyantā āḍhyādayo na sambhavantyeva, tatkiṃ paryudasyanta ityāha-- `cvervikalpena vidhānāt' ityādi| vikalpena vidhānaṃ tu `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' (4.1.82) ityato vāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `āḍhyaṃ tailena kurvanti' ityādi| na hyasau prāganāḍhyastailenāḍhyaḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi ? āḍhyastailenābhyajyate| anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ karotiratrābhyañjane varttate| tenābhūtaprādurbhāve nāstīti bhavati pratyudāharaṇam| atha vā-- bhavatu nāmābhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ, tathāpi yuktamevedaṃ pratyudāharaṇamiti darśayitumāha-- `prakṛteravivakṣāyām' ityādi| na hyabhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ ityevaṃ sarvo'bhūtaprādurbhāvaścvyartho bhavati, kintu viśiṣṭa eva; yasmāt tatra prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ darśayiṣyate| prakṛtiḥ kāryasya pūrvāvasthā| tena yatrāśritaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvārambhaśca kāryasay bhāvyamānatayā vivakṣyate tatra sa abhūtaprādurbhāvaḥ, sa eva cvyarthaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yadā kāryasya pūrvāvasthā vivakṣyate tadā cvyartho bhavati, nābhūtaprādurbhāvavivakṣāyāmiti| iha tu pūrvāvasthāmaparāmṛśyānāśritapūrvārambhe kārye'bhūtatadbhāvamātraṃ vivakṣitam| tena satyapyabhūtatadbhāve cvyartho na bhavati| ato bhavatyetat pratyudāharaṇam-- `āḍhyīkurvanti' iti| `abhūtatadbhāve kṛbhvasthiyoge' (5.4.50) ityādinā cviḥ, `asya cvau'(7.4.32) itīttvam| `lyuṭā bhavitavyam' iti| `karaṇādhikaraṇayośca' (3.3.117) ityanena lyuḍ‌vidhānāt| yadi lyuṭā bhavitavyaṃ tataḥ kimityāha-- `na ca' ityādi| ubhayatrāpi tadeva rūpam, sa eva svaraḥ| rūpaṃ tāvadabhinnam, ubhayatrāpi samāsasya nityārthatvāt; tathā hi khyunyupapadasamāsena bhavitavyam, lyuṭyapi gatisamāsena ? `anavyayasya' (6.3.66) iti ca pratiṣedhānmumā ni bhavitavyamiti rūpabhedo nāsti| svaro'pi na bhavati bhedakaḥ; khyuni sati yatraiva nitsvaro bhaviṣyati, lyuṭyapi litsvarastatraiva| `pratiṣedhasāmarthyāt' iti| āḍhyīkaraṇamityasya rūpasya nirāsāya `acvau' (3.2.56) iti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| evaṃ tasya nirāsaḥ kṛto bhavati yadi khyunā mukte lyuḍapi bhavati, anyathā hi syādeva| tadeva rūpamiti pratiṣedhaḥ syāditi vaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ| `arthataḥ' iti| na śabdataḥ| arthastu pratiṣedhasāmarthyameva| `uttarārthaśca' iti| uttarasūtrasyopayogaṃ darśayati| tatra khiṣṇuckhukañbhyāṃ mukte tṛjādibhirbhavitavyamityasti viśeṣaḥ|khyunaḥ khakāro mumarthaḥ, nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ|| 57. karttari bhuvaḥ khiṣṇuckhukañau| (3.2.57) `karttari kārake' iti| karttṛgrahaṇaṃ karaṇanivṛttyartham| nanu cāsvasitatvādevānuvṛttirna syāt ? satyametat; dveṣyamapi kaścidavijānīyāt-- yathaivāḍhyādayo'nuvarttante tathā tatsambandhakaraṇamapīti| uttarārthañca karttṛgrahaṇam| `udāttatvāt' ityādi| udāttāditaro'nudāttaḥ, tena bhavatervihitasyārddhadhātukasya `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt' (7.2.10) itīṭ‌pratiṣedho na bhavati| balādilakṣaṇeṭā (7.2.35) bhavitavyam, tataśca tenaivekārāditvaṃ siddham,tato na karttavyaṃ khiṣṇuca ikārāditvamiti bhāvaḥ| ikārāditvakaraṇasya prayojanamāha-- `nañastu' ityādi| yadi| khiṣṇu ca ikārāditvaṃ na kriyate tato yadyapīṭi kṛte satīkāraditvaṃ tasya bhavati, tathāpi tasya lākṣaṇikatvāt `kṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśca' (6.2.60) ityatreṣṇujgrahaṇena na grahaṇaṃ syāt| tataścānāḍhyambhaviṣṇuriti naña uttarasyottarapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ na syāt,iṣyate ca| ato naña uttarasyottarapadāntodāttatvaṃm, tenekārāditvamiṣṇucaḥ kriyate| nanu ca satyapīkārāditve alaṃkṛñādisūtre (3.2.136) vihitasyaiveṣṇuco grahaṇena bhavitavyam‌, netarasya , tasyaikānubandhakatvāt, asya dvayanubandhakatvāt ? ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyādasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| khakāro mumarthaḥ; cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ, ñakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ|| 58. spṛśo'nudake kvin| (3.2.58) `supi sthaḥ' (3.2.4) ityatroktam-- `karmaṇi' `supi'iti dvayamanuvarttate, tatra sakarmakeṣu karmaṇītyupatiṣṭhate, anyatra supīti| spṛśirayaṃ sakarmakaḥ, ataḥ spṛśerdhātoranudake subanta upapada ityukte pūrvāparavyāhati manyamāna āha-- `nanu ca' ityādi|`naiṣaḥ' ityādinā parihāraḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ karttṛgrahaṇe karttuśca pracayārthe vijñāyamāne subanta upapade pratyayo labhyata ityāha-- `subantamātre' ityādi| subantamātra upapade satyekaḥ pracayārthaḥ karttā karmaṇyupapade sati bhavati, aparaḥ karaṇādāvupapade; tatra bhede sati tatsambandhabhedena bhidyamānasya karttuḥ pracayo labhyate| `ghṛtaspṛk' iti| `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' ityādi| `kvipratyayasya kuḥ' ityucyamāne kvipo'pi grahaṇaṃ syāt,ato nakāro'nubadhyate| prakṛterādyudāttārtho nakāro na bhavita; spṛśerekāctvāt,tatsvareṇaiva siddhatvāt| kakāro guṇapratiṣedhārthaḥ, vakāraḥ `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ|| 59. ṛtvigdadhṛksragdiguṣṇigañcuyujikruñcāṃ ca| (3.2.59) `ṛtau yajati' iti| vasantādika ṛtau yajati, yasmin ṛturdevatā sa yāga ṛtustaṃ yajatīti| `ṛtuprayukto vā yajati' iti| yasmin yāga ṛtuḥ prayojakastamṛtuprayukto yajatīti| asmin pakṣe prayuktamātrasya lopo nipātyate| `ṛtvik'iti| yajāditvāt (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam| `yathākathañcidanugantavyā' iti| yena kenacit prakāreṇa vyutpādayitavyam, na tvavayavārthastantramiti darśayati| `antodāttatvaṃ nipātyate' iti| niyatasvarabādhanārtham| `dadhṛk' iti| abhyāsasya `urat' (7.4.66) ityattvam, halādiḥśeṣaḥ, (7.4.60) jaśtvam| `ṣatvañca nipātyate' iti| `sātpadādyoḥ' (8.3.109) iti pratiṣedhānna prāpnotīti kṛtvā| `ṣṇiha prītau' (dhā.pā.1200), utsnihyatītyuṣṇik| `nipātanaiḥ' saha nirdeśāt' ityādinā nipātanaiḥ sahaiṣāṃ yo nirdeśaḥ sa eṣāmapi kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| tenaiṣu kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati| idaṃ tvalākṣaṇikam-- yaḥ sakarmakasyāpi subantamātra upapade bhavati| `prāṅa' iti| `ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'dhātoḥ' (7.1.70) iti num, halṅyādi (6.1.68) saṃyogādi (8.2.23) lopau,nakārasya pūrvavat kutvam| `kevalāt' iti| satyapi karmaṇi supītyadhikāre nirupapadādeva bhavati; nipātanaiḥ saheti nirdeśāt| kvinvidhānasāmarthyādvā| upapade hi sadādisūtreṇa (3.2.61) kvipā bhavitavyam| `sopapadāt' ityādi| na ca sopapadādyujeḥ kvipi kvinā vā viśeṣo'sti; `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvasya siddhatvāt| anupapadatve `yujerasamāse' (7.1.71) iti numi kṛte nakārasya kutvārthaṃ kvino vidhānaṃ sārthakaṃ bhavati|| 60. tyadādiṣu dṛśo'nālocane kañca| (3.2.60) anālocanamiha cakṣurjñānamātramabhipretam| yadi tatra dṛśirna varttata evaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyathā| `tyādṛk, tyādṛśaḥ' iti| `dṛkdṛśavatuṣu' (6.3.89) ityanuvarttamāne `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) ityātvam| `kaño ñakāraḥ `ṭiḍḍhāmaña' iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ iti| yadi kaño ñakāro na karttavyasatdodāttārtho nakāraḥ karttavyaḥ| evañca kañkannityevaṃ (4.1.15) karttavyam| tataścaivamucyamāne `yāvādibhyaḥ kan' (5.4.29) yādiketyatrāpi ṅīp prasajyate, atastadviśeṣaṇārtho ñakāraḥ karttavyaḥ iti| nanu ca dṛśerdarśanakriyatvāt tādṛk tādṛśa ityādiṣu darśanakriyā'styeva, tathā hyeṣāṃ vyutpattau taṃ paśyatyevaṃprakāraṃ vākyamupadiśyācāryāḥ pratyayaṃ kurvanti| vākyasamānārthā vṛttirbhavati, sā ca darśanakriyā jñānārthikā| tatkathamatra dṛśiranālocane varttata ityāha-- tādṛgādayo hi rūḍhiśabdaprakārāḥ'ityādi| rūḍhiśabdeṣu nāvayavārthena bhavitavyam,kiṃ tarhi ? samudāyārthena| ata evātrāvayavārtho nopadīyate| vyutpattyarthastu vidyamāno'pyavayavārtha nopādatte, yathā-- vyājighratīti vyāghra ityādau| tasmādiha yadyapi vyutpattyarthaṃ vākyasya darśanakriyopādīyate, tathāpyasau vṛttau nāstyeva| tathā hi-- tādṛk tādṛśa ityādibhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ sadṛśavastuviṣaye pratyaya upajāyate, na tu darśanakriyāviṣaya iti yuktaiva dṛśeranālocane vṛttiḥ| `samānānyayośceti vaktavyam' iti| samānānyayośca śabdayorupapadayordṛśeḥ kvinkañau pratyayau bhavava ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- pūravasūtrādiha
