cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuvatasamuccayārthaḥ| tena samānānyayorupapadayordṛśeḥ pratyayau bhaviṣyataḥ| `sadṛśaḥ' iti| `samānasya' (6.3.84) ityanuvarttamāne ` dṛgdṛśavatuṣu' (6.3.89) iti sabhāvaḥ|| 61. satsūdviṣadruhaduhayujavidabhidacchidajinīrājāmupasarge'pi kvip| (3.2.61) `karmagrahaṇaṃ tu `spṛśo'nudake kvin' ityataḥ prabhṛti na vyāpratiyate' iti| nanu sakarmakā api dhātavaḥ santi, tatkathaṃ na vyāpriyata iti ? evaṃ manyate-- spṛśo'nudake kvin' (3.2.58) ityādiṣu yat `karttari' (3.2.57) ityanuvarttate tat karttṛpracayārthaṃ vijñāyate, tena supīti vyāpriyate, na karmaṇīti| evaṃ hi karttṛpracayo labhyate, nānyathā| atha upasargagrahaṇaṃ kimarthama ? yāvatopasargāḥ subantā eva, tatra subgrahaṇenaivopasargagrahaṇaṃ siddhamityāha-- `upasargagrahamaṃ jñāpanārtham'iti| `anyatra subgrahaṇa upasargagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati' iti| kvānyatra subragrahaṇa upasargagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatītyāha-- `vadaḥ supi kyap ca' iti| nanu ca `vadaḥ supi kyap ca' (3.1.106) ityatra `gadamadacarayamaścānupasarge' (3.1.100) ityato'nupasargagrahaṇamanuvarttate| evañcopasargagrahaṇaṃ nānuvarttayitavyamiti vā jñāpanārthamupasargagrahaṇam| vikalpapradarśanārthaṃ karttavyamityanye| `apūre tvāhuḥ-- jñāpakaprayojanadigiyamiti vṛttikāro darśayati| idaṃ tu spaṣṭaṃ jñāpakasya prayojanam-- `spṛśo'nudake kvin' (3.2.58) ityatra `supi' (3.2.4) ityadhikārādasati jñāpaka upasargagrahaṇe subante'pyupasarge syāt-- upaspṛśati, saṃspṛśatīti; asmāt jñāpakānna bhavati| `sāhacaryāt'ityādi| yadi `sū'ityayaṃ dhāturādādikatvaṃ vyabhicarati `dviṣa aprītau'(dhā.pā.1013) ityeṣa tu na vyabhicarati, ato'nena sāhacaryāt `sū' ityādādikasya `ṣūṅa prāṇigarbhavimocane' (dhā.pā.3031) ityasya grahaṇam, na `ṣū preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1408) ityasya taudādikasya | nanu ca sadinā taudādikasāhacaryādasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati ? naitadasti; yathaiva hi `sū' ityeṣa taudādikatavaṃ vyabhicarati,tathā sadirapi, tasya bhvādiṣu pāṭhāt, tatkathaṃ tena sāhacaryāt taudādikasyeha grahaṇaṃ syāt| `na subateḥ' iti| anādādikasūrūpasya dhātorupalakṣamametat| `{ṣūṅ-dhā.pā.}ṣañ prāṇiprasave' (dhā.pā.1132) ityetasyāpi daivādikasya grahamaṃ na yuktam ; nyāyasya ca tulyatvāt| `dvayorapi grahaṇam' iti| viśeṣānupādānāt| `na lābhārthasya' iti| `vid‌lṛ lābhe' (dhā.pā.1432) ityetasya| `akārasya vivakṣitatvāt' iti| iha lābhārthasyānupādāne hetuḥ `vidaḥ' iti sūtre' kārāntoccāraṇaṃ vivakṣitamiti,tena viderakārāntasya gaṇe pāṭhāt sa eva gṛhyate, na lṛkārāntaḥ| `śṛciṣat' iti| `{ṣad‌lṛ-dhā.pā.} sad‌lṛ viśaraṇārthaḥ (dhā.pā.854)| `mitradhruk'iti| `druha jighāṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1197) `vā druhamuha' (8.2.33) iti kakāraḥ, `ekāco baśo bhaṣ' (8.2.37) ityādinā bhaṣbhāvaḥ| `godhuk' iti| ` duha prapūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1014) `dāderdhātorghaḥ'(8.2.32) iti ghatvam| `aśvayuk' iti| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvaṃ gakāraḥ, tasya pūrvavat kakāraḥ| `śatrujit' iti| `hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' (6.1.71)| `kathamatra ṇatvam' iti| `pūrvapadāt saṃjñāyāmagaḥ' (8.4.3) iti saṃjñāyāṃ vidhīyamānena ṇatvenāsaṃjñāyāmiha na bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `samrāṭaḥ'iti| `rājṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.822), `vraścabhrasja' (8.2.36) iti cartvaṃ ṭakāraḥ, `mo rājisamaḥ kvau' (8.3.25) iti makāraḥ| kvipaḥ kakāro guṇavṛddhiniṣedhārthaḥ| pakārastugarthaḥ| `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti vakāralopaḥ| ikāraḥ `verapṛktasya' iti sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ|| 62. bhajo ṇviḥ| (3.2.62) `ardhabhāk' iti| `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti vakāralopaḥ| pratyayalopalakṣaṇena `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam| ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ| ikāraḥ `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ|| 63. chandasi sahaḥ| (3.2.63) `jalāṣāṭ' iti| `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam, tasya jaśtvam-- ḍakāraḥ,tasya `vā'vasāne' (8.4.56) iti ṭakāraḥ|| 64. vahaśca| (3.2.64) `pṛṣṭhavāṭ' iti| pūrvavad‌vṛddhiḥ, ḍhatvajaśtvacartvāni| yogavibhāgaṃ uttarārthaḥ-- uttaratra bahenuvṛttiryathā syāt, sahermā bhūt| ekayoge hi sati dvayorapyanuvṛttiḥ syāt|| 65. kavyaparīṣaparīṣyeṣu ñyuṭ| (3.2.65) pūrveṇa cvau prāpte ñyṛḍvidhīyate| ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ, ñakāraḥ svarārtho vṛddhyarthaśca| yumātraṃ pratyayaḥ, tasya `yuvoranākau'(7.1.1) ityanādeśaḥ|| 66.havye'nantaḥpādam| (3.2.66) `anantaḥpādam' iti| antaḥ śabdo madhyaśabdena samānārthaḥ| antaḥpādamiti pādasya madhya ityartha-| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ-- na antaḥpādamanantaḥpādamiti| etacca vaheḥ prakṛtatvāt tasyaiva viśeṣamaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha-- `anantaḥpādañcedvahirvarttate'iti| chandasītyanuvṛtteḥ pādaśabda ṛkpādaṃ bodhayati| ṛkpādamadhye vahirna varttata ityarthaḥ| pratyudāharaṇe pādamadhye vahirvarttata iti tena `vahaśca' (3.2.64) iti ṇvireva bhavati|| 67. janasanakhanakramagamo viṭ| (3.2.67) `dvayorapi grahaṇam' iti| viśeṣānupādānāt| `tathā' ityādi| yathānantarayordhātvorubhayorgrahaṇamiti, tathānayorapi sambhavaktārthayorityarthaḥ| `ṭakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇavighātārthaḥ'iti| asati ṭakāre `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) ityatraikānubandhaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.52) asyaivaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt, na vijādīnām| ṭakāre tvasyāpi dvayanubandhakatvāt sarveṣāṃ grahaṇamupapadyate| `viśeṣaṇārthaśca' iti| `viḍ‌vanoranunāsikasyāt' (6.4.41) ityatra viśeṣaṇārthaṣṭakāraḥ, `vivanoḥ' ityucyamāne hi kvibādīnāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt, tathā cākarodityevamādau lopaḥ syāt| `abjāḥ' iti| apsu jāyata iti abjāḥ| evaṃ `gojāḥ'| gāṃ sanotīti `goṣāḥ'| `sanoteranaḥ' (8.3.106) iti ṣatvam| naraṃ sanotīti `nṛṣāḥ'| vilaṃ khanatīti `vilakhāḥ'| dadhi krāmatīti `dadhikrāḥ' | agre gacchatīti `agregāḥ'| `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' (6.3.14) iti saptamyā aluk| sarvatra `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti lopaḥ, `viḍ‌vanoḥ' (6.4.41) ityāttvam|| 68. ado'nanne| (3.2.68) 69. kravye ca| (34.2.69) `pūrveṇaiva siddhe' iti| kravyaśabdasyānarthakatvāt| `kathaṃ tarhi kravyādaḥ' iti| yadi vacanaṃ vā'sarūpavidhibādhanārthamiti bhāvaḥ| `kṛtvikṛta' ityādinā kṛttavikṛttaśabda upapade'trāṇ, na tu kravyaśabda iti darśayati| yadi tarhi kṛttavikṛttaśabda upapade'ṇ, kathaṃ kravyādaśabdaḥ sidhyati; kṛttavikṛttāda iti bhavitavyamityāha-- `tasya ca' ityādi| nanu ca kṛttavikṛttaśabde upapade'ṇi kṛte tatra copapadasya kravyabhāva iti rūpaṃ bhavati, kravyaśabda upapade'ṇi kṛte tadeva, kvātra viśeṣaḥ; yataḥ kravyaśabda upapade|ñaṇ pratiṣidhyate ? ityata āha-- `kṛttavikṛtta' ityādi| etenārthabhedaṃ darśayati-- yo hi kṛttavikṛttaśabdena pakvamāṃsabhakṣaḥ sa eva kravyāda ucyate,yastvapakvamāṃsabhakṣaḥ sa kravyāducyate|| 70. duhaḥ kabghaśca| (3.2.70) `kāmadudhā' | `gharmadughā'| kāmaṃ dogdhīti kāmadughā| garmaṃ dogdhīti gharmadudhā|| 71. mantre śvetavakthaśaspuroḍāśo ṇvin| (3.2.71) `etebhyaḥ' iti| śvetava ityevamādibhyaḥ prakṛtyupapadasamudāyebhyaḥ| `dhātupapadasamudāyā nipātyante' iti| śvetavā ityevādayaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ dhātūpapadasamudāyā nipātyante, na punaḥ pṛthagevopapadāni dhātavaśca nirdiśyante ? ityāha-- `alākṣaṇikakāryasiddhyartham' iti| śvetavā ityevamādiṣu `avayāḥ śvetavāḥ puroḍāśca' iti rutvaṃ nipātyate| `ukthaśāḥ'iti| `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66) itirutvamastyeva| `śaṃsateḥ'iti| `{śaṃsu-dhā.pā.} śansa stutau' (dhā.pā.728) ityasya| ṇvinau nitkaraṇamādyudāttārtham| ṇitkaraṇaṃ vṛddhyartham| ikāraḥ `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| `śvetavāhādīnām‌' ityādi| yadi tarhīdamucyate, nārthaḥ `avayāḥ śvetavāḥ puroḍāśca'ityanena vacanena, rutvārthena tasya dīrghatvātta ? nanu ca `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ'(6.4.14) iti dīrghatvaṃ siddhameva ? yatra tarhi tena na sidhyati tadarthaṃ yathā syāt| kva punastena na sidhyati ? sambuddhau | yadi tarhi taducyate tadā ḍas na vaktavyaḥ,tenaiva nipātanena śvetavahādīnāmasantatā nipātayiṣyate ? naitadasti; sambuddhau dīrghatvaṃ na syādityuktam| athāsantatā nipātayiṣyata iti vaktavyam, tathā ca sati śvetavobhyāmityatrotvaṃ syāt| tasmāt ḍas vaktavyaḥ, nipātanamapi karttavyam|| 72. ave yajaḥ| (3.2.72) `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ'iti| uttarasūtre yajarevānuvṛttiryathā syāt|| 73. vijupe chandasi| (3.2.73) `upayaḍ‌bhīḥ'iti| `vraścādinā' (8.2.36) ṣatvam, pūrvavajjaśtvam-- ḍakāraḥ| `ubhayaṭ‌tvam' iti| tvapratyaye parataḥ `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvaṃ ṭakāraḥ| nanu ca `mantre' (3.2.71) ityanuvarttiṣyate, mantraśca cchanda eva, tat kimarthaṃ chandasigrahaṇaṃ kriyata ityāha-- `chandograhaṇaṃ brāhmaṇārtham' iti| asati cchandograhaṇe mantragrahaṇānuvṛtterapi brāhmaṇe na syāt, na hi mantragrahaṇena brāhmaṇaṃ gṛhyate;tasya granthāntaratvāt| mantravyākhyāne granthaviśeṣe brāhmaṇaśabdo varttate, na tu mantre ; tasamād‌brāhmaṇe'pi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ chandasītyuktam| `vicaścitkaraṇam' ityādi| asati citkaraṇa eṣa ekānubandhaḥ syāt| tataśca `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) ityatraikānubandhakaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.52) asyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na kvibādīnām| citkaraṇe tu satyekānubandho na kaścidastīti sarve gṛhyante|| 74. āto maninkvanibbanipaśca| (3.2.74) manino nakāra ādyudāttārthaḥ| kvanibvanipoḥ pakārānudāttārthau, ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| kvanipaḥ pakāraḥ pitkāryārthaḥ, cakāro vico'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ| śobhanaṃ dadātīti `sudāmā'| `sarvanāmasthāne ca'(6.4.8) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| aśva iva tiṣṭhatītyaśvatthāmā| pṛṣodarāditvāt sakārasya takāraḥ| śobhanaṃ dadhātīti `sudhīvā'| śobhanaṃ pibatīti `supīvā'| dhumādinettvam (6.4.66)| bhūri dadātīti `bhūridāvā' | ghṛtaṃ pibatīti `ghṛtapāvā'| kīlālaṃ pibatīti `kīlālapāḥ'|| 75. anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante| (3.2.75) `suśarmā' iti| `śṝ hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1488) śobhanaṃ śṛṇātīti vigrahaḥ| `prātaritvā' iti| iṇaḥ prātaḥ śabda upapade kvanip, `hrasvasya piti kṛti' (6.1.71) iti tuk| `vijāvā' iti| `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149), vijāyata iti vanip, `viḍ‌voranunāsikasya' (6.4.41) ityāttvam| `agregāvā' iti| `gmlṛ sṛplṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.982,983) pūrvavadāttvam| `reḍasi' iti| `riṣa hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.694), pūrvavajjaśtvaṃ ḍakāraḥ| `dṛśigrahaṇaṃ prayogānusaraṇārtham' iti|tena prayoge gamyamāne yatra dṛśyante maninnādayastatraivaite sādhavaḥ, ato nāpūrvatamaḥ kriyate| etena `te na sarvato vidheyāḥ' ityuktaṃ bhavati| yadyanyebhyo'pi dṛśyante, pūrvasūtramanarthakam, maninnādayaḥ sarvadhātubhyo dṛśyanta ityevaṃ vācyam ? naitadasti; ākārāntebhyo dhātubhyo niyogataste bhavanti, anākārāntebhyaḥ kvacideya| api tu pūrvayogaśchan‌dasi, vayaṃ tu bhāṣāyāmapi|| 76. kvip ca| (3.2.76) `nirupapadetrabhyaśca' iti| etadapiśabdasya sarvopādhivyabhicārārthasyānuvṛtterlabhyate| `ukhāsrat| prarṇadhvat' iti| `sransu dhvansu avasransane' (dhā.pā754,755) , `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ| `vasusransudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ' (8.2.72) iti datvam, `vā'ḍavasāne' (8.4.56) iti cartvam| `vāhābhraṭ' iti| `bhranśu adhaḥ patane' (dhā.pā.1225), vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam, pūrvavajjaśtvam, cartvam, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.37) iti dīrghaḥ|| 77. sthaḥ ka ca| (3.2.77) `bādhakabādhanārtham' ityādi| kakviporbādhako'c, tasyāpi bādhanārtham| acastu bādhakatvaṃ `śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām' (3.2.14) ityatra dhātugrahaṇam| taddhi yato'pavādo vihitastato'pi śamyupapade saṃjñāyāmajeva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kṛtam| evañca `sthaḥ ka ca' ityetadyadi nocyeta, tato yathā kṛño hetvādiṣu ṭapratiṣedhārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ tathā tiṣṭhaterapi kakviporbādhanārthaṃ vijñāyate| tathā ca sati śamyupapade saṃjñāyāṃ tiṣṭhaterajeva syāt, na kakvipau| asmiṃstu yoge satyacaṃ bādhitvobhāveva bhavataḥ| `śaṃsthaḥ' iti| ` āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ|| 78. supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye| (3.2.78) `brāhmaṇānāmantrayitā' iti| `matri guptabhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1679), `idito num dhātoḥ' (7.1.58) iti num, curādiṇic, tataḥ `tṛn' (3.2.135) iti tācchīlikastṛn| `supi' ityādi| nanu ca `supi' (3.2.4) ityanuvarttamāne punaḥ subgrahaṇamanarthakam ?nānarthakam; pūrvakaṃ hi subgrahaṇamupasargeṇa sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| ata upasarganivṛttyarthaṃ punaḥ subgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| `utpratibhyām' ityādi| subgrahaṇasya copasarganivṛttyarthtavādupasarge na prāpnotīti vacanam| utpratibhyāṃ paro ya āṅa,tasminnupapade sartterdhātorupasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) ityato'trāpiśabdaḥ sarvopādhivyabhicārārtho'nuvarttate, tena `udāsāriṇyaḥ'ityatropasarge ṇinirbhavati| `sādhukāriṇi ca'iti| atācchīlyārtha ārambhaḥ| cakāreṇopasaṃkhyānamityanukṛṣyate, tasya pratipādanamevārthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu-- pūrvavadapiśabdaṃ sarvopādhivyabhicārārthamāśritya karttavyam| atha vā-- yadayam `tacchīlataddharmatsādhukāriṣu' (3.2.134) iti tacchīletyabhidhāya tatsādhukārigrahaṇaṃ karorati,tajjñāpayati--sādhukāriṇyatācchīlye'pi ṇinirbhavatīti| `brahmaṇi vadaḥ' iti| ayamapyatācchīlyārtha ārambhaḥ, jātyartho vā| tācchīlye'jātau pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt vā'sarūpanivṛttyartho na hi bhavati| brahmāṇaṃ vadita `brahmavādī'iti| ṇinerṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ| dvitīya ikāro nakārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārthaḥ|| 79. karttaryupamāne| (3.2.79) dhātoḥ karttari pratyayavidhānāt tasyaivopapadakarttopamānaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `upapadakarttā'ityādi| upapadavācyaḥ kartrā - upapadakarttā, śākapārthivāditvanmadhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ| `uṣṭrakrośī' iti| `kruśa āhvāne rodane ca'ca(dhā.pā.856)| `dhvāṅakṣarāvī' iti|`ru śabde' (dhā.pā.1034)| atācchīlyārtha ārambhajātyartho veti; tācchīlye'jātau ca pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| `bhakṣayati' iti| `bhakṣa adane' (dhā.pā.1557) caurādikaḥ|| 80. vrate| (3.2.80) `samudāyopādhiścāyam' iti| pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇe hi tasmin vrata eva karttari pratyayaḥ prasajyeta,na tadvati devadatte| `dhātūpapada' ityādinā samudāyopādhitvaṃ vratasya darśayati| `kāmacāraprāptau niyamaḥ'iti| kāmacāraḥ - icchāpravṛttiḥ, tatprāptau satyāṃ niyamaḥ| aniyamatvādyatheṣṭaṃ sāmānyena śayane bhojane ca pravṛttau prāptāyāmayamarthāntarādvayāvarttyaviśeṣe sthaṇḍilādau na prāpnoti, tasmādvayavasthāpyate| niyamaścātra dvividhaḥ sambhavati-- sthaṇḍile śeta evāśrāddhaṃ bhuṅaktaṃ evetyeyaṃrūpo vā syāt, sthaṇḍila eva śete'śrāddhameva bhuṅkte ityevaṃrūpo vā,tatra pūrvake niyame yadaiva sthaṇḍile na śete'śrāddhañca na bhuṅkte tadaiva vratalopaḥ prāpnoti| tasmād dvitīyo niyamo yukta iti manyamāna āha-- `sati śayane'ityādi|| 81. bahulamābhīkṣṇye| (3.2.81) `ābhīkṣṇyaṃ paunaḥpunyam' iti| punaḥ punarbhāvaḥ paunaḥpunyamiti, avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ| `tātparyamāsevaiva' iti| tadevābhīkṣṇyam| paryāyāntarābhyāṃ spaṣṭīkaroti-- `{tācchīlyādanyat--kāśikā, padamaṃjarī ca|} tācchīlyādanyaḥ' iti| etena `supyajātau' (3.2.78) ityādinā''bhīkṣṇye na sidhyatītyasāmarthyamudbhāvayannasya yogasya phalaṃ darśayati-- `kaṣāyapāyiṇaḥ'iti| yatra deśe kaṣāyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ pibatāmārogyaṃ bhavati, ataste kaṣāyaṃ pibantīti, na tu tācchīlyāt| `kṣīrapāyiṇaḥ'iti| te'pi tathoktādeva kāraṇāt pānāntarābhāvādvā tācchīlyābhāve'pyagatyā kṣīraṃ pibanti| `sauvīrapāyiṇaḥ' iti| atrāpyetadevānantaroktaṃ punaḥ punaḥ sauvīrapānasya kāraṇam| sarvatra `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk| `prātipadikāntanum' (8.4.11) ityādinā ṇatvam. `kulmāṣakhādaḥ' iti| `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1)|| 82. manaḥ| (3.2.82) `manyatergrahaṇam' iti| `mana jñāne' (dhā.pā.1176) ityetasya daivādikasya| `na manuteḥ' iti| `manu avabodhane' (dhā.pā.1471) ityetasya tānādikasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| nana u ca yadeva manyaterṇinipratyaye kṛte darśanīyamānīti rūpaṃ bhavati, tadeva manuterapi,tat ko'tra viśeṣo yato manyatergrahaṇamiṣyate,na manuterityata āha-- `uttarasūtre hi' ityādi| yadyapīha viśeṣo nāsti, uttarasūtre tu vikaraṇakṛto viśeṣo'sti, tatra hi manyateḥ khaśi kṛte divāditvācchyan bhavati, manutestu tanāditvādupratyayaḥ|| 83. ātmamāne khaśca| (3.2.83) `ātmamāne' iti| mananam - mānaḥ, bhāve ghañ| ātmano mānaḥ ātmamānaḥ| `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti ṣaṣṭhī, `kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate'(vā. 83) iti samāsaḥ| atha karttari ṣaṣṭhī kasmānna bhavati ? ātmagrahaṇasāmarthyāt| na hyātmano'nyasya padārthasya matiḥ sambhavati, tasyā ātmaguṇatvāt| athātmaśabdo'yaṃ na sukhādiguṇamācaṣṭe, ki tarhi ? parābhāvam| paro yo na bhavati sa ātmeti, tathāpyātmagrahaṇamanarthakam| evaṃ hi manturyā matiryā matisttatra varttamānādityeṣo'rthaḥ syāt, sa cāyuktaḥ,ka sarvā hi matiḥ paramapi manyamānasya mantureva bhavati, tasmāt karmaṇyeva ṣaṣṭhī| `yadā pratyayārthaḥ karttā' ityādi| kathaṃ punareṣa evārthaḥ, karma karttā ca yujyate ? śaktibhedāt, yathā-- pīyamānaṃ madhu madayatīti| khaśaḥ khakāraḥ `arurdviṣadajantasya' (6.3.67) iti mumarthaḥ| śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ|| 84. bhūte| (3.2.84) bhūtaśabdo'yamatikrāntavacanaḥ, asti ca svarūpavacanaḥ, tatra na jñāyate-- kasmin bhūte pratyaya iti ? atastatpajñānāyāha-- `dhātvadhikārācca'ityādi| caśabdo hetau| yasmād dhātoriti varttate tasmāddhātvarthabhūta iti vijñāyate| nanu ca dhātvadhikārāddhātoreva bhūta ityetadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam ? na; asambhavāt| dhātorhyasminnabhidheye guṇībhūtasya bhūta ityetadviśeṣaṇamanupapannam| atastatrāsambhavāt tadarthasyaiva tadviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate|| 85. karaṇe yajaḥ| (3.2.85) `ṇiniranuvarttate, na khaś'iti| ṇinereva svaritatvāt| kva punaryāgaḥ karaṇamityāha-- `agniṣṭomaḥ phalabhāvanāyām' ityādi| phalaṃ svargaḥ?, tasya yā bhāvanotpādanā - yajamānasambandhī vyāpāraḥ, tatrāgniṣṭomayāgaḥ karaṇaṃ bhavati| nanu cāgniṣṭomavyatirekeṇa yajamānasay vyāpāro bhāvanākhyo nāstyeva, yatra yāgaḥ karaṇamiṣyate, tathāhyagniṣṭomākhyenaiva hyasau yāgena svargākhyaṃ phalamutpādayati ? naitadevam; viśeṣavyāpāre hi sāmānyavyāpāro'sti, vikṣeṣasya sāmānyavyabhicārāt| sāmānyavyāpāra eva hyādau phalārthino buddhau sanniviśate| tathā hi-- pratipattā phalaṃ samīhamānaḥ svayameva phalakāmaḥ san `svargo manasi karttavyaḥ'iti sāmānyavyāpāraṃ buddhāvāropayati, tataḥ ` agniṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta'iti śāstrasyāgniṣṭomena karaṇena svarga bhāvayeditīmamartha pratipādya, svargabhāvanāṃ prati karaṇatvenāgniṣṭomamāśrayati| tasmāt sāmānyavyāpāre svargasyotpādo viśeṣavyāpāro'gniṣṭomākhyo yāgaḥ svargābhāvanāyāṃ karaṇaṃ bhavati| nanu cānuṣṭhīyamānaḥ karmatvamanubhavati, tathāpi tasya śaktibhedāt karaṇatvaṃ na virudhyate, yathā -- `nipīyamānena madhunā mattaḥ' ityatra karmabhāvamanubhavato'pi madhunaḥ karaṇabhāvo bhavati| tadevamagniṣṭomayājītyasyāyamarthaḥ-- agniṣṭomena karaṇena svarga bhāvitavāniti| svargaśabdastu vṛttādantarhitatvānna prayujyate|| 86. karmaṇi hanaḥ| (3.2.86) `pitṛvyaghātī' iti| `hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ' (7.3.32) iti tatvam| `ho hanterñṇinneṣu' (7.3.54) iti ghatvam, `sau ca' (6.4.13) iti dīrghatvam| `kutsitagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam'iti pratyayarthasya viśeṣaṇam| gṛhyate'neneti grahaṇam| tat punarvyākhyānam| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yena kutsitaḥ karttā pratyayārtho gṛhyate tadvyākhyānaṃ karttavyamiti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- vakṣyamāṇabahulagrahaṇamapakṛṣyeha sambandhaḥ kriyate, tena pitṛvyavadhādikāṃ pratiṣiddhāṃ kriyāṃ kurvāṇo yaḥ karttā kutsyate, tatrava, nānyatra|| 87. brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvip| (3.2.87) `brahmahaḥ'iti| pūrvavaddīrghatvam| `sarvadhātubhyaḥ kvibvihita eva' iti| `kvip ca' (3.2.76) ityanena| `caturvidhaścātra niyamaḥ' iti| dhātuniyaḥ, upapadaniyamaḥ, pratyayaniyamaḥ, kālaniyamaḥ| cakāro'vadhāraṇe -- caturvidha eva| `brahmādiṣveva hanternānyasminnupapade'iti dhātuniyamaṃ darśayati| ata eva yataevakārakaraṇaṃ tato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti| upapadebhyaḥ para evakāraḥ prayujyamāno hantiṃ niyamayati| prāyikaścāyaṃ niyamaḥ, kvacidanyasminnupapade dṛśyate-- madhuhetu| prāyikatvañca tasya vakṣyamāṇabahulagrahaṇasya purastādapakarṣāllabhyate| `brahmādiṣu hantereva nānyasmāt' iti upapadaniyamaḥ| atra hi hanteḥ ekāraḥ śrūyamāṇa upapadaṃ niyamayati-- brahmādiṣu hanterbhūte kvibeva| `nānyaḥ pratyayaḥ' iti kālaniyamaḥ| brahmādyupapade hanteḥ kvipi vihite bhūtakālasya niyamitatvāt| yadi brahmādiṣu kvibeva nānyaḥ pratyayaḥ iti, tadā niṣṭhāpi na prāpnoti-- brahmāṇaṃ hatavāniti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante, nottarān'(vyā.pa.10) ityaṇādaya eva bādhyante, na niṣṭhā| evamapīha vṛtrasyāhanturiti tṛj na prāpnoti ? prāyikatvānniyamasya na doṣaḥ| `tathā bhūtakāla eva nānyasmin' iti pratyayaniyamaḥ, bhūtakāle pratyayo niyamyata iti kṛtvā| kathaṃ punarekadā catvāro niyamā labhyanta ityāha-- `tadetat'ityādi| `bahulaṃ chandasi' (3.2.88) iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ bahulagrahaṇaṃ purastādapakṛvyānena yogena sambadhyate-- brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvib‌bahulamiti, tenāyaṃ caturvidho niyamo labhyate|| 88. bahulaṃ chandasi| (3.2.88) 89. sukarmapāpamantrapuṇyeṣu kṛñaḥ| (3.2.89) `suśabdaṃ varjayitvā'iti| tasyāsattvavacanāt karmatvānupapatteḥ| `svādiṣu karmasu' iti| bāhulyamāśrityoktam, yathā-- `brāhmaṇagrāmaḥ, bhaṭṭagrāmaḥ' iti| kuta etat ? suśabdaṃ varjayitvetyanantarāṇāmevābhidhānāt| `trividhaścātra niyamaḥ' iti| etadapi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhyate| `kālopapadapratyaya{niyamaḥ-kāśikā}viṣayaḥ' iti| kālopapadapratyayā viṣayā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa punaḥ kālaniyamaḥ, upapadaniyamaḥ, pratyayaniyamaśceti| tatra kālaniyamaḥ--svādiṣu kṛño bhūta eva kvibeva bavati, nānyaḥ pratyaya iti; na bhavati-- karma kṛtavān karmakāra iti| upapadaniyamaḥ--svādiṣu kṛña eva, nānyasmāddhātoriti; na hi bhavati kvip-- mantramadhītavāniti, aṇeva bhavati mantrādhyāya iti| pratyayaniyamaḥ-- svādiṣu kṛño bhūta eva kvip, na varttamāne, bhaviṣyati vā, tena mantraṃ karoti, mantraṃ kariṣyatīti vetyarthavivakṣāyāṃ mantrakṛditi na bhavati| `śāstrakṛt' iti| `kvip ca' (3.2.76) iti kvip|| 90. some suñaḥ| (3.2.90) `dhātukālopapadapratyaya viṣayaḥ'iti| pūrvavadbahuvrīhiḥ| kālādiniyamo'nyapadārthaḥ| tatra kālaniyamaḥ-- some sunoteḥ kvibeva bhūte, nānyaḥ pratyayaḥ; na hi-- somaṃ sutavān somasāva iti| dhātuniyamaḥ--soma eva sunoteḥ kvip, nānyasminnupapada iti;iha na bhavati--surāṃ sutavān surāsuditi| upapaniyamaḥ--some sunotereva, nānyasmāddhātoritita;iha na bhavati kvip-- somaṃ krītavāniti , somakrāya ityaṇeva tu bhavati| pratyayaniyamaḥ-- some sunoterbhūta eva kvip, nānyatreti;tena somaṃ sunoti, soṣyati vetyarthavivakṣāyāṃ somasuditi na bhavati|| 91. agnau ceḥ| (3.2.91) `atrāpi pūrvavat'ityādi| tatra kālaniyamaḥ-- agnau cinoterbhūte kvibava, nānya iti; tenāgniṃ citavānityarthavivakṣāyāmagnicāya iti na bhavati| dhātuniyamaḥ-- agnāveva cinoternānyasminnupapada iti; teneṣṭakāciditati na bhavati| upapadaniyamaḥ-- agnau cinotereva nānyasmāddhātoriti; tenāgnikṛditi na bhavati| pratyayaniyamaḥ-- agnau cinoterbhūta eva kvip, nānyasmin kāle; tena varttamānabhaviṣyatoragniciditi na bhavati|| 92. karmaṇyagnyākhyāyām| (3.2.92) `karmaṇi hanaḥ' (3.2.86) ityata upapadaviśeṣame karmagrahaṇe'nuvarttamāne yat punariha karmagrahaṇaṃ tasya pratyayārthatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `karmaṇyeva kārake' iti| `dhātūpapada' ityādinā samudāyopādhitkmetadagnyākhyāgrahaṇasya darśayati| `ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ rūḍhisampratyayārtham' ityādi| agniśabdo'yamagnisāmānyavācī, atrāsatyākhyāgrahaṇe viśeṣo na vijñāyate-- kasyeha grahaṇamiti, rūḍhisampratyayārthamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tadarthamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kriyata ityāha-- `agnyartho hi' ityādi| agnyartho ya iṣṭakānāṃ racanāviśeṣaḥ sa śyenacidityucyate, tatraivāyaṃ pratyaya iṣyate| sa kathaṃ tatraiva labhyate ? yasya grahaṇaṃ kriyate, tasmiṃśca sati prasiddho gṛhyamāṇo'gnyartho ya iṣṭakānāṃ racanāviśeṣaḥ sa eva pratyayārtho vācyatayā vijñāyate, nānyaḥ|| 94. karmaṇīnirvikriyaḥ| (3.2.93) `karmaṇīti varttamāne' ityādi| `karmaṇihanaḥ' (3.2.86) ityataḥ| `punaḥ karmagrahaṇam' ityādi| yat karma kriyāsambandhamanubhavat karttuḥ kutsāmāvahati,tat kutsānimittaṃ karma yathā syādityevamartham| karmagrahaṇe'nuvarttamāne punaḥ karmagrahaṇamanantarasūtre yat karmapratyayārthatve'niṣṭaṃ karmagrahaṇaṃ tannivṛttyartham| karmagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? tasya svaritatvādevānuvṛtteḥ| `somavikrayī' iti| somavikrayaṇaṃ śāstre pratiṣidhyata iti somākhyaṃ karma vikrayaṇakriyayā sambadhyamānaṃ vikretuḥ kutsāmāvahati| `dhānyavikrāyaḥ' iti| `karmaṇyaṇ' (3.2.1)|| 94. dṛśeḥ kvanip| (3.2.94) `pratyayāntaranivṛtyartham' iti| pratyayāntaramaṇādi, tasya nivṛttyartham| nivṛtte satyapi pratyayaḥ pratyayāntaratve bhavatyeva-- paralokaṃ dṛṣṭavāniti| atra ca kāraṇaṃ `brahmabhrūṇa' (3.2.87) sūtra eva uktam|| 95. rājani yudhikṛñaḥ| (3.2.95) nanu ca yudhirayamakarmakaḥ, tatkathaṃ tasya karmaṇītyupapadyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha--`antarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ' ityādi| antarbhāvitaḥ - tanupraveśito ṇyartho yasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| rājā yudhyate, taṃ prayuṅkte puruṣo yoddhuṃ veti| tatrāsau puruṣasya vyāpāraḥ preṣaṇādiko'rtho ṇyartho yadā buddhyā yudhyaterantarbhāvyate, tadāsau prayojyakarmaṇā sakarmako bhavati| `yodhitavān' iti| ṇyantasya prayogaḥ| `niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' (6.4.52) iti ṇilopaḥ|| 95. sahe ca| (3.2.95) `asattvavācitvānnopapadaṃ karmaṇā viśeṣyate'iti| tadarthasya karmatvānupapatteḥ|| 97. saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ| (3.2.97) saptamīti pratyayagrahaṇam|tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha-- `saptamyanta upapade' iti| svarūpagrahaṇamata eva na bhavati| `upasarajaḥ' iti| ḍitkaraṇasāmarthyādabhasaṃjñakasyāpi ṭilopaḥ| `mandurajaḥ' iti| `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam' (6.3.63) iti hrasvaḥ|| 98. pañcamyāmajātau| (3.2.98) `buddhijaḥ' iti| `janikṛrttuḥ prakṛtiḥ' (1.4.30) iti buddherapādānatvādapādāne pañcamī|, tadasyopapadatvam| buddhyādiśabdā jātiśabdā na bhavanti; buddhyādīnāmātmaguṇatvāt|| 99. upasarge ca saṃjñāyām| (3.2.99) `samudāyopādhiḥ'iti| dhātūpasargapratyayasamudāyena yadi saṃjñā gamyata ievaṃ pratyayārtho bhavati, nānyatheti darśayati-- `{prajāḥ- kāśikā} prajāḥ' iti| prāṇisamudāyasyaiṣā saṃjñeti| yadyasya sūtrasya prajetyetadevodāharaṇam, tadā `pre janaḥ saṃjñāyām'iti vaktavye prajeti sidhyatyeva, kimupasargagrahaṇena ? upasargagrahaṇamuttarārtham; `anau karmaṇi'(3.2.100) ityupasarge yathā syāt, karmapravacīye mā bhūt| athānantyasya prayogaviṣayasyānyasminnupapade kadācit pratyayo dṛśyate yadi, tadaitadarthamapi|| 100. anau karmaṇi| (3.2.100) `anupūrvājjaneḥ' ityādi| athānuśabdasyopapadatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? yato na bhavati sa hetuḥ `udi kūlerujivahoḥ' (3.2.31) ityatra vyākhyāta iti punarnākhyāyate| `pumamujaḥ' iti| lupte'pi supi pratyayalakṣaṇena padatvam, tena saṃyogāntalopo (8.2.23) bhavati|| 101. anyeṣvapi dṛśyate| (3.2.101) `apiśabdaḥ' ityādi| sarva upādhaya upapadādayaḥ, teṣāṃ vyabhicāro yathā syādityevamartho'piśabdaḥ| `dhātvantarādapi'iti| `khanu avadāraṇe'(dhā.pā.878) ityetasmāt| `kārakāntare'pi' iti| kartturanyasmin kārake karmaṇi|| 102. niṣṭhā| (3.2.102) `kṛtam' iti| atra kittvād guṇābhāvaḥ| `kṛtavān' iti| `ugidacām' (7.1.70) iti num| `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādi (6.1.68) saṃyogāntalopau (8.2.23)| `niṣṭhāyām' ityādi| niṣṭhāsaṃjñake pratyaye vidhātavye'prasiddhaniṣpattikasya niṣṭhāsaṃjñakasya pratyayasya niṣṭheti cāsyāḥ saṃjñāyā aprasiddhiḥ, kutaḥ ? itaretarāśrayatvāt| kathamitaretarāśrayatvamityāha-- `saṃjñāyām' ityādi| niṣṭhetyevaṃ saṃjñāmuccārya ktaktavatvoriha bhūte vidhānam, vidyamānayośca tayoḥ saṃjñayā bhavitavyamitītaretarāśrayatvam, `itaretarāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi śāstre na prakalpyante'(vyā.pa.28)| yadito ktaktavatū svarūpeṇa vijñātau bhavata evañca `ktaktavatū niṣṭhā' (1.1.26) ityanyasya saṃjñā vidhātuṃ śakyate,nānyathā| ataḥ saṃjñāyā aprasiddhiḥ, tasyāścāprasiddhau tayoraprasiddhiḥ| `bhāvinī' iti| bhaviṣyantītyarthaḥ| yathā-- asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayeti| bhāvinīśabdo'yam `gameriniḥ'(da.u.6.57) `āṅi ṇit' (da.u.6.58) `bhuvaśca' (da.u.6.59) itīnipratyayānto vyatpāditaḥ| sa ca `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' (3.3.3) iti bhaviṣyatkāle vihitaḥ| tena bhāvinītyasya bhaviṣyantītyevārtho labhyate| `sāmarthyāt' ityādi| sa bhūte bhavati yasyotpannasya niṣṭhetyeṣā saṃjñā bhavati| na cānyasyotpannasya niṣṭhetyeṣā saṃjñā bhavati| api tu ktaktavatvoreveti sāmarthyam| `ādikarmaṇi' ityādi| karmaśabdo'tra kriyāvācī| ādibhūte kriyārambhādibhūte prathame kriyālakṣaṇa ityarthaḥ| yāvatkriyālakṣaṇaiḥ sakalaḥ kaṭaḥ parisamāptimupaiti kriyālakṣaṇānāṃ tāvatāmapavarge bhūtakālo bhavati| ādye kriyālakṣaṇe samudāyasyāpariniṣpannatvāt varttamānakāla eveti| tatra varttamāne niṣṭhā na prāpnoti, ato vaktavyo vyākhyeyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- yadayaṃ `udupadhādbhāvādikarmaṇoranyatarasyām' (1.2.21) ityādikarmaṇi karmaṇi niṣṭhā vikalpayati| yadvā-- `ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ karttari ca' (3.4.71) ityādi, tajjñāpayati-- ādikarmaṇi niṣṭhā bhavatīti| `prakṛtaḥ kaṭam' iti| praśabdo'trādikarma dyotayati| ya evārthaḥ prakaroti kaṭaṃ devadatta iti, sa evārthaḥ prakṛtaḥ kaṭaṃ devadatta iti|| 103. suyajorṅvanip| (3.2.103 `sutvā' iti| `hrasvasya piti kṛti' (6.1.71) iti tuk, `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) ityādinā dīrghaḥ, `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nakāralopaḥ|| 104. jīryateratṛn| (3.2.104) `jaran' iti| atṛno nittvādādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `ugidacām' (7.1.70) iti num|| 105. chandasi liṭ| (3.2.105) `dadarśa' iti| darśarliṭa, ṇal, dvirvacanam‌, `urat' (7.4.66) ityattm, raparatvam, halādiśeṣaḥ (7.4.60), laghūpadhaguṇaḥ (7.3.86)| `ātatāna' iti| `tanu vistāre' (dhā.pā.1463) āṅapūrvaḥ, `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ| `dhātusambandhe sa vidhiḥ' iti| `dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ' (3.4.1) ityato dhātusambandhagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `ayaṃ tvaviśeṣaṇeṇa' iti| bhūtamātre| liṭa ikāraṭakārāvuttarasūtre viśeṣaṇārthau| `laḥ kānajvā' ityucyamāne lakārāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt| ṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ|| 106. liṭaḥ kānajvā| (3.2.106) kānacaścikaraṇamantodāttārtham| kitkaraṇaṃ kitkāryārtham| tatpunaḥ `bandha bandhane' (dhā.pā.1508) ityevamādayaḥ saṃyogāntāḥ prayojanti,nānye| asaṃyāgāntebhyaḥ `asaṃyogālliṭ kit' (1.2.5) iti siddhaḥ, saṃyogāntā api kittvaṃ bhāṣāyāṃ prayojayanti, na chandasi| tatrāha-- `chandasyubhayathā' (3.4.117) iti liṭaḥ sārvadhātukatvāt `sārvadhātukamapit' (1.2.4) iti ṅittvamastyeva| na kittve ṅittve vā cchandasi kaścidviśeṣo'sti| bhāṣāyāṃ tu yadyasaṃyogāntebhyaḥ kittvaṃ na syādyo'yaṃ `ṛcchatyṛtām'(7.4.11) iti guṇaḥ pratiṣedhaviṣaya ārabhyate sa yatheha na bhavati-- nipaparatuḥ, nipaparuriti;tathehāpi syāt-- nipapurāṇa iti; kittve ca sati na bhavati| bhāṣāyāṃ tu kittvamarthavadbhavati| `pṛ pālana pūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1086), nipūrvāt kānac| dvirvacanāt paratvāt `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuttvam, raparatvañceti| `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti sthānivadbhāvāt pṛśabdo dvirucyate| urattvaraparatvahalādiśeṣāḥ, aṭ‌kupvādinā (8.4.2) ṇatvam| bhāṣāyāṃ kānajbhavītyasmādeva jñāpakādavasīyate| `cikyānaḥṭa iti| abhyāsāduttarasya cinoteścakārasya `vibhāṣā ceḥ' (7.3.58) iti kutvam, `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ| `suṣuvāṇaḥ' iti| `{sunoteriti-iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ|} sunoteriti; `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinovaṅādeśaḥ, `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvam| `vibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati' iti| yadyapi liḍiti prathamāntaṃ prakṛtaṃ tathāpyarthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati| ādeśambandhāduttarasya liṭaḥ ṣaṣṭhyantatā bhaviṣyati|tasmādantareṇāpi liḍ‌grahaṇaṃ prakṛtvālliṭa eva kānajādeśo bhaviṣyatīti liḍ‌grahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `yo'pi' ityādi| yo'pi `parokṣe liṭ‌' (3.2.115) ityanenaliḍ‌vihitastasyāpi liḍ‌grahaṇe sati kānajādeśo bhavati| asati tu tasmin `anantarasya vidhirvā pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) ityasyaiva syāt, na parokṣe liṭaḥ| athāsati liḍ‌grahaṇe pratyayāntaraṃ kānac kasmānna vijñāyate ? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum, pratyayāntare hi `na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām' (2.3.69) iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedho na syāt| tataścāgniṃ cikyāna ityatrāgniśabdāt ṣaṣṭhī syāt||| 107. kvasuśca| (3.2.107) kvasorugitkaraṇaṃ numartham| kitkaraṇaṃ kānaca iva draṣṭavyam| asati hi tasmin `ṛcchatyṛnām'(7.4.11) iti yatheha guṇo na bhavati-- teratuḥ, teruriti; tathehāpi tatīrvāniti| `tṛ plavanataraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.969), `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.10) itīttvam, `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ, dviravacanamabhyāsakāryam| `jakṣivān' iti| `liṭyanyatarasyām' (2.4.40) ityaderghaslādeśaḥ| `vasvekājāddhasām' (7.2.67) itīṭ, `ghasibhasorhali ca' (6.4.100) ityupadhālopaḥ, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti ghakārasya kakāraḥ, `śāsivasighasīnāñca'(8.3.60) iti ṣatvam, `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) ityabhyāsasya cutvam--jhakāraḥ, `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) iti jhakārasya jakāraḥ| `papivān' iti| `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925)| pūrvavadiṭ| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityakāralopaḥ| `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttarasūtre kvasorevānuvṛttiryathā syāt, kānaco mā bhūt|| 108. bhāṣāyāṃ sadavaśruvaḥ| (3.2.108) nanu ceha prakaraṇe bhūtasāmānye liḍ vihitaḥ, tenāsau bhāṣāyāṃ nāstyeva, tadasatastasya kathaṃ ktasurādeśaḥ śakyate vijñātumityāha-- `ādeśavidhānādeva' ityādi| yadetadbhāṣāyāṃ liṭaḥ kvasorādeśavidhānamata eva vijñānād bhūtasāmānye bhāṣāyāṃ liḍitvanumīyate; anyathā hyādeśavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| na hyavidyamānasya sthānina ādeśa upapadyate| yadi tarhyādeśavidhānālliḍ‌ bhāṣāyāmanumīyate, tataśca sadādibhyo bhāṣāyāṃ nityaṃ liṭ prāpnoti, tasya `vibhāṣā kvasuḥ' iti pakṣe tiṅaḥ śravaṇaṃ prasajyeta, luṅādeśaśca svaviṣaye pākṣiko na syāt, nityatvālliṭaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;ādeśena hi liṅgena liḍanumīyate, tena yadādeśo nāsti tadā tadanumānamapi nāstyeva| tadasattve liṭaḥ kuta ādeśā yeṣāṃ śravaṇaṃ prasajyeta ! yatra pakṣe liṭ nāsti tatra svaviṣaye luṅādayo bhavantaḥ kena nivāryante ! `upasedivān' iti| `ṣad‌lṛ viśaraṇe' (dhā.pā.854)| `ata ekahalmadhye' (6.4.120) ityādinaitvābhyāsalopau, `vasvekājāddhasām' (7.2.67) itīṭ, num, `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādi (6.1.68) saṃyogāntalopau (8.2.23)| `upāsadat' iti| vāgrahaṇādyasmin pakṣe liḍ nāsti tasmin pakṣe bhūtasāmānye luṅ, tip, `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ, puṣādinā (3.1.55) cleraṅ| `upāsīdat' iti| `anadyatane laṅ' (3.2.111), prāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) sīdādeśaḥ| `upasasāda' iti| `parokṣe liṭ' (3.2.115), tip, ṇal, `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ| `anūviṣān' iti| `vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1005), liṭaḥ kvasūrdvirvacanam, vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam| `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām' (6.1.17) ityabhyāsasya samprasāraṇam, `śāsivasighasīnāñca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam, `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101) anuśabdena saha punardīrghaḥ| `anvavātsīt'iti| luṅ, `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ, `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `saḥ syārddhadhātuke' (7.4.49) iti tatvam, `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ| `anvavasat' iti| laṅ| `anūvāsa' iti| liṭa, pūrvavat samprasāraṇādikāryam| `upaśuśruvān' iti| `śru śravaṇe' (dhā.pā.942), liṭaḥ kvasuḥ, dvirvacanam| `upāśrauṣīt' iti| luṅ `sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (7.2.1) iti vṛddhiḥ, pūrvavadiṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ, `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ, upasargeṇa `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101)| `upāśṛṇot' iti| laṅ, `śruvaḥ śṛ ca' (3.1.74) iti śnupratyayaḥ, śṛbhāvaśca, `sārvadhātukārthadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti guṇaḥ| `upaśuśrāva' iti| liṭ, tip, ṇal, `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddhiḥ, āvādeśaḥ| ihānena sūtreṇa yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate tadbhūtasāmānye| `{iyaṃ paṃktirmudrite nāsti} luṅ' (3.2.110) ityanena luṅ| `anadyatane luṅ' (3.2.111) ityanena laṅ, `parokṣe liṭ' (3.2.115) ityanena liṭ, bhūtānadyatanaparokṣe parau ca laṅiliṭau bhavataḥ| viśeṣavihitatvācca laṅaliṭorasya sadādikāryasya bādhakau prāpnutaḥ| tasya kāryasya bhūtasāmānyamavakāśaḥ; laṅaliṭoḥ sadādibhyo'nyebhyo dhātubhyaḥ, sadādibhyo bhūtaviśeṣe bhūtānadyatanaparokṣe; bhūtānadyatane cobhayaprāptau yathoktakāraṇadvayāt laṅaliṭau syātām| na caitat sūtravihitaṃ kāryamapīti yaścodayet, taṃ pratyāha-- `luṅalaṅaviṣaye'pi' ityādi| liḍ‌grahaṇasya vāgrahaṇasya cāsya sūtrasya purastāt `anadyatane laṅa' (3.2.111) , `parokṣe liṭ' (3.2.115) ityatra cānuvṛttiḥ kriyate| tatra cānuvṛttisāmarthyāt laṅyapyetat bhavati| atraivaṃ sambandhaḥ karttavyaḥ-- anadyatane laṅa bhavati, sadādibhyo vā liṭ, liṭaśca kvasurādeśo nityamiti| parokṣe liḍ‌ bhavati, sadādibhyo vā, liṭaḥ kvasuriṣyate, sūtrāntaravihitaścāyam|| 109. upeyivānanāśvānanūcānaśca| (3.2.109) `upapūrvādiṇaḥ kvasuḥ' iti| liḍādeśa iti veditavyaḥ| `abhyāsadīrghatvam' iti| `dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti' (7.4.69) ityanena| `tatsāmarthyāt' ityādi| dīrghatvavidhānasāmarthyādakaḥ savarṇe dīrghtavamekādeśaḥ pratiṣidhyate, pravṛttivighāto'sya kriyata ityarthaḥ| yadi hyekādeśaḥ syāt, dīrghatvabhidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt; ekādeśenaiva dīrghatvasiddheḥ| nanu cābhyāsadīrghasyeyatuḥ, iyurityayamavakāśaḥ syāt-- yatra dhāturūpasya `iṇo yaṇ' (6.4.81) iti yaṇādeśaḥ kriyate ? naiṣo'syāvakāśaḥ, atra hi `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāvena bhavitavyam| katham ? savarṇadīrghatve hi pūrvāparavidhitavāt pūrvavidhiriti śakyate vyapadeṣṭum| yo hyubhayasthānī niṣpadyate labhate'sāvanyataravyapadeśam| na cātra `na padānta' (1.1.58) ityādisūtreṇa dīrghavidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedho'sti; yasmāt `svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśau na sthānivadeva' (kāśikā.1.1.58) ityādisūtreṇa dīrghavidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedho'sti; yasmāt `svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśau na sthānivadeva' (kāśikā.1.1.58) iti sthānivadbhāvādakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvenātra bhavitavyam| tadetadabhyāsadīrghatvamanavakāśatvāt savarṇadīrghatvaṃ bādhata iti sthitametat-- sāmarthyādekādeśaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti| `tatra' ityādi| ekādeśapratibandhake hi satyanekāctvaṃ bhavati, tena `vasvekājād‌ghasām' (7.2.67) ityaneneḍāgamo na prāpnotīti sa nipātyate| `dhāturūpakasya yaṇādeśaḥ' iti| `iṇo yaṇ' (6.4.81) ityanena, tardīdaṃ nipātanameva| satyajādāvapi parato vasoḥ samprāsaraṇamiti| samprasāraṇe kṛte satīṭ prāpnoti sa `vasvekājādghasām' (7.2.67) iti pratiṣiddhaḥ, sa evānena nipātanana pratiprasūyate| pratiṣiddhaḥ sa punaḥ pravarttate, na tvapūrva vidhīyate| `tenājādau na bhavati' iti| apipūrvasya hi vidhānena viśeṣānupādānādajādāvapi prasaṅgaḥ syāt; na tu lakṣaṇapratiṣedhasyeṭaḥ prasave; tasya valāditvāt| `upeyuṣā' iti| samprasāraṇe kṛte dhātoryaṇādeśaḥ, `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvam| `na cātropasargastantram' iti| upasrgo'tra na pradhānamityarthaḥ| tantratvaṃ tasya `bahulaṃ chandasi' (3.2.88) ityato bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhyate| `upāgāt' iti| luṅa, `iṇo gā luṅi' (2.4.45) iti gādeśaḥ| `gātisthā'( 2.4.77) ityādinā sico luk| `upait' iti| laṅa, tip, adāditvācchapo luk, `āḍajādīnām' (6.4.72) ityāṭ, `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| `upeyāya'iti| liṭ, tip, ṇal, `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddhiḥ, āyādeśaḥ, sthānivadbhāvādadvirvacanamikārasyeti; `abhyāsasyāsavarṇe'(6.4.78) itīyaṅa, ikāreṇa saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `anāśvān' iti| `aśa bhojane' (dhā.pā.1523) liṭ, kvasuḥ, dvirvacanam, `aśa'ityasya `ata ādeḥ' (7.4.70) ityabhyāsasya dīrghatvam, iḍabhāvaśca,`vasvekājāddhasām' (7.2.67) ityanena prāptasyeṭo'bhāvo nipātyate| na āśvān anāśvān-- nañsamāsaḥ, `nalopo nañaḥ' (6.3.73) iti nalopaḥ;`tasmānnuḍaci' (6.3.74) iti nuḍāgamaḥ| `nāśīt' iti| luṅa, `cleḥ sic' (3.1.44), `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ, pūrvavadāṭ, vṛddhiḥ, nañā saha savarṇadīrghatvam| `nāśnāt' iti| laṅ, kryāditvāt śnā, āḍāgamaḥ| `nāśa' iti| liṭ, tip,ṇal, dvirvacanam, pūrvavadabhyāsadīrghatvam, dhātunā nañā sahākaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvam| `vaceḥ'ityādi| `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1063)-- ityasmāt `bruvo vaciḥ'(2.4.53) iti vacyādeśādvā vaceranupūrvāt, kānac karttaryātmanepadasaṃjñako na prāpnoti;parasmaipaditvāt, itarasmāt karttrabhiprāyaphalasya vivakṣitatvāt, ataḥ sa nipātyate| vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) dhātoḥ samprasāraṇam, `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām' (6.1.17) ityabhyāsasya paścādanuśabdena sahākaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvam| `anvavocat' (6.1.87)| `anvabravīt' iti| bruvo laṅa,śapo luk, `bruva īṭ' (7.3.93)| `anūvāca' iti| liṭ, ṇal, `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ, pūrvavadabhyāsasya samprāsaramekādeśaḥ|| 110. luṅ| (3.2.110) ṅakāraḥ `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' (3.4.99) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| ukāraḥ `luṅalaṅalṛṅakṣvaḍudāttaḥ'(6.4.71) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| bhūtasāmānye cāyaṃ luṅa veditavyaḥ; bhūtaviśeṣaṇe'nadyatanyāṃ laṅaliṭorvidhānāt| `akārṣīt' iti| `sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (7.2.1) iti vṛddhiḥ; pūrvavadīṭ| `vasateḥ' ityādi| `vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1005) ityasmādanadyatane laṅi prāpte luṅa vaktavyaḥ| divasaḥ sakalo'tikrāntāyā rātreścaturtho yāma āgāminyāśca prathamo yāmaḥ-- ityeṣo'nadyatanaḥ kālaḥ| tatra rātriviśeṣe'tikrāntāyā rātreścaturthe yāme pratyutthitaḥ kva bhavānuṣitaḥ ? iti kenacit pṛṣṭaḥ kaścit, sa tasmin rātraviśeṣe divā vā prativacanaṃ prayacchan luṅaṃ prayuṅkte-- `ahamatrāvātsam' iti| sa ca na prāpnoti; yasmādasau tato rātriśeṣāt pūrvabhāgaṃ praharatrayalakṣamadhiśayitaḥ, so'syānadyatanakālaḥ, tataścānadyatane laṅa syāt; tasamālluṅ vaktavyaḥ - vyākhyeyaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi bahulagrahaṇamāśritya karttavyam| `jāgaraṇasantatau' iti| yadyasau rātriśeṣaṃ sakalaṃ santatyā'vicchedena jāgaritavānevaṃ luṅ bhavati| muhūrttamapi yadyasmin rātriviśeṣe śayitavāṃstato laṅeva-- āhamatrāvasamiti| `avātsam' iti| luṅ, mip, `tasthastha' (3.4.101) ityādināmbhāvaḥ, `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ; `saḥ syārdhadhātuke'(7.4.49) iti sakārasya tatvam|| 111. anadyatane laṅ| (3.2.111) `anadyatane' iti| yadyayaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ syāt tadā paryudāso vā syāt, prasajyapratiṣedho vā| tadā pūrvasmin pakṣe'dyatanādyo'nyastasmin bhavitavyam| evañca `adya hyo vābhukṣmihi' ityatrāpyadyatanavyāmiśre prāpnoti| asti hyadyatanānadyatanasamudāyo'nadyatanādanyaḥ, itarastvadyatane na bhavatītyeṣo'rtho jāyate, tataśca bhūtasāmānye syāt| anadyatana iti adyatanabhūtaviśeṣe pratiṣedhaḥ,na bhūtasāmānye| na hi bhūtasāmānyaṃ bhūtaviśeṣaḥ, tasmāt tatpuruṣapakṣo doṣavāniti matvā''ha-- `anadyatana iti bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ' iti| avidyamāno'dyatano yasminniti so'nadyatanabhūtadhātvarthaḥ, atra varttamānāllaṅa bhavati, na tvadyatanānadyatanasamudāye, tatrādyatanaikadeśasya sadbhāvāt| bhūtasāmānye'pi na bhavatyeva, vidyate hi sāmānye viśeṣaḥ; tasyāntarbhūtaviśeṣatvāt| yatrādyatanagandho'pyasti tatra laṅā na bhavitavyamityeṣo'rtho buhavrīhau sati labhyate| yadi tarhi bahuvrīhirayam, evaṃ satyadyatane'pi prāpnoti, na hyadyatane dvitīyo'dyatano'sti ? naitadevam; adyatanasāmānye muhūrttāderadyatanaviśeṣasya vidyamānatvāt| tasmādadyatano'vidyamānādyatana iti na śakyate vaktum| `adya hyo vā bhukṣmahi' iti| luṅ, `bhujo'navane' (1.3.66) ityātmanepadam, mahiṅ, `liṅasicorātmanepadeṣu'(7.2.42) iti sicaḥ kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam-- jakārasya gakāraḥ, tasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti carttvaṃ kakāraḥ,pūrvavat ṣatvam| `parokṣe ca' ityādi| parokṣaśabdo rūḍhiśabda indriyātikrānte'rthe varttate| parokṣe lokavijñāte - lokaprasiddhe prayokturdarśanaviṣaye laṅantasya yaḥ prayoktā tasya darśanaviṣaye laṅ vaktavyaḥ - vyākhyeyaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu-- tasyaiva bahulagrahaṇamāśritya karttavyam| nanu ca vipratiṣiddhamidamucyate-- parokṣe'rthe darśanaviṣaya iita,parokṣo hyartho'tīndriya ucyate, indriyaviṣayabhāvāpannastu darśanaviṣayaḥ, tato yadi parokṣaḥ, kathaṃ darśanaviṣayaḥ| yadi darśanaviṣayaḥ kathaṃ parokṣaḥ ? naitadasti; śakyadarśanaviṣaya ityuktam,ananubhūtatvāt parokṣa ityavirodhaḥ| aruṇat'iti| `rudhir āvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1438), rudhāditvāt śnam, tip, halṅyādinā (6.1.68) tilopaḥ| sāketāvarodhastadānīntanaprayokturdarśanaviṣayatvāt lokaprasiddhaśca,kāryavyāsaṅgadananubhūtatvāt parokṣaśca| parokṣa iti kim ? udagādādityaḥ | `gātisthā' (2.4.77) ityādinā sico luk| pūrvavadādeśādi kāryam| lokavijñāta iti kim ? cakāra kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ| prayokturdarśanaviṣaya iti kim ? jaghāna kaṃsaṃ kila vāsudevaḥ| hanteḥ parokṣe liṭ; dvirvacanam, `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti kutvam-- hakārasya ghakāraḥ| kaṃsavadhaścikārālavṛttatvādidānīntanaprayokturdarśanaviṣayo na bhavati| yastu kaṃsavadhena tulyakālaḥ prayoktā sa laṅameva prayuktavān--ahan kaṃsaṃ vāsudeva iti| mūlodāharaṇe'pi prayoktā sāketāvarodhatulyakālo veditavyaḥ| tasyaiva hyasau darśanaviṣayaḥ,nānyasya|| 112. abhijñāvacane lṛṭ| (3.2.112) `vatsyāmaḥ' iti| lṛṭ, mas, `syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ' (3.1.33) iti sya, pūrvavat sakārasya tatvam, `ato dīrgho yañi' (7.3.101) iti dīrghaḥ| `vacanagrahaṇam' ityādi| asati hi vacanagrahaṇe'bhijñāśabda evopapade syāt| tasmiṃstu yāvanto'bhijñāvacanāsteṣu sarveṣu bhavati|| 113. na yadi| (3.2.113) `yadi' iti| satī saptamīyam| abhijñāvacanañcānuvarttate| tena yatra yacchabdo'sti tatra niyogato'bhijñāvacanaṃ tatsahitaṃ na bhavatītyāha-- `yacchabdasahite'ityādi| `avasāma' iti| vaserlaṅ, `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ'(3.4.99) iti salopaḥ, pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| `vāsamātram'ityādinā uttarasūtrasya nāyaṃ viṣaya iti darśayati| yadi hi tatrāparaṃ lakṣaṇamapekṣyate tadottarasūtre pākṣiko vidhiḥ syāt, sa neṣyate, tasmānnāpekṣate|| 114. vibhāṣā sākāṅkṣe| (3.2.114) `ubhayatravibhāṣeyam' iti| prāpte cāprāpte ca| asati hi yacchabde ` abhijñāvacane luṭ' (3.2.112) iti prāpte, sati yacchabde `na yadi' (3.2.113) iti pratiṣedhādaprāpte| ākāṅkṣaṇam - ākāṅkṣā,ākāṅkṣayā saha varttate sākāṅkṣaḥ| ākāṅkṣā ca sambandhajñānamucyate, taccetanāvato dharmaḥ, tasmāt sākāṅkṣa iti prayokturviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `sākāṅkṣaścet prayoktā'iti| asyaivārtha spaṣṭīkarttumāha--`sākāṅkṣaśceta prayoktā' iti| asyaivārtha spaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `lakṣyalakṣaṇayoḥ' ityādi| tatra yadi hyetadapekṣyata etaduktaṃ bhavati-- lakṣyalakṣaṇayoryaḥ sambandhastadviṣayajñānaṃ yadi prayokturupapannaṃ bhavati| yadi prayoktā lakṣyalakṣaṇayoḥ sambandhamapekṣata iti yāvat| `bhokṣyāmahe' iti| bhujaḥ pūrvavadātmanepadam, syapratyayaśca, ṭeretvam, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam-- jakārasya gakāraḥ, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam-- kakāraḥ, sakārasya ṣatvam| kiṃ punarlakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇañca, yayoḥ sambandhe prayokturākāṅkṣetyāha-- `vāso lakṣaṇam'iti| parijñātatvāllakṣaṇam, tena hi jano lakṣyate| `bhojanaṃ tu lakṣyam' iti| aparijñātatvāt; na tu lakṣaṇam| parijñātaṃ lakṣaṇamiti bhavati, yathā-- agnerdhuma iti|| 115. parokṣe liṭ| (3.2.115) `nanu ca' ityādi| dhātvartho hi pūrvāparībhūtāvayavā sādhyamānā kriyā| yacca sādhyamānaṃ tadasat| taccāsadindriyāṇāmaviṣayaḥ, teṣāṃ sadviṣayatvāt| yaccendriyāṇāmaviṣayaḥ tat parokṣamiti sa eva hi dhātvarthaḥ parokṣaḥ, tataḥ parokṣagrahaṇamanarthakam, vyavacchedyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| `satyametat' iti| yadanantaramuktam| yadi satyametat tadā kasya vyavacchedārthaṃ parokṣagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityāha-- `asti tu' ityādi| yatra sādhyāni pratyakṣāṇi tatrāniṣpanne kriyātmani dhātvarthe pratyakṣābhimāno lokasya bhavati| nanu ca sāvadhānānyapi naiva pratyakṣāṇi;śaktisvabhāvatvāt, śakteśca kāryānumeyatvāt, na hyaśaktau kāryaṃ karotīti kāryakaraṇe śaktiranumīyate; tat kimucyate sādhanāni pratyakṣāṇi ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;`dravyāśritā hi śaktayaḥ'iti dravyasya pratyakṣtavādāśrayadhamamāśriteṣu śaktyātmakeṣūpacāryāṇyetānyapi pratyakṣāṇītyucyante| atha vā-- tadapi sādhanāśrayaṃ dravyaśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt sādhanaśabdenocyate; tadanena parokṣagrahaṇena pratyakṣābhimāno'sti, sa eva parokṣa icyucyate-- tadāha-- `sa yatra nāsta' iti| ātmaviṣaya uttamasya ca dhātvarthasya parokṣatvaṃ nopapadyate; tatsādhanānāṃ pratyakṣatvāt| tatra lokasya pratyakṣatvāt, tataścottamena sidhyatīti codyamāśaṅkyāha-- `uttamaviṣaye' ityādi| ātmasādhyā hi kriyā, yatra cittavikṣepānnopapadyate, tadāsau parokṣā bhavati, tenottamaviṣaye'pi parokṣabhāvaḥ| tadbhavatyeva| `vilalāpa' iti| lapervipūrvasyottame ṇali rūpam| `atyantāpahnave' iti| pratyakṣametat| apahnavaḥ - apalāpaḥ| sa kcidatyanto bhavati yaḥ sarvāpahnavaḥ, kvacidanatyanto ya ekadeśāpahnavaḥ| tatra yo'tyantaḥ sa sarvāpahnavaḥ, tatra liḍ‌vaktavya, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi bahulagrahaṇamāśrit karttavyam| kaścit kenacit pṛṣṭaḥ-- `kaliṅgeṣu prasthito'si'ityādi| sa evamāha-- `nāhaṃ kaliṅgān jagām' iti| atra kevalaṃ na kaliṅgaviṣayasyāpahnavo'pi tu gamanasyāpīti vidyate'tyantāpahnavaḥ| yastu sthānamātrasyāpahnavo na gamanasyāpi , tadānatyantāpahnave laṅeva bhavati-- na hi kaliṅgeṣu pratyatiṣṭha iti| tathā kaścit kenacit pṛṣṭaḥ dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviśya tvayedaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtamiti| sa evamāha-- `nāhaṃ dakṣiṇāpathaṃ praviveśa' iti| atrāpi vidyate'tyantāpahnavaḥ| tathā hi-- na kevalaṃ dakṣiṇāpathapiṣayaṃ kāryaṃ pratiṣidhyate, api tu praveśamapi|| 116. haśaśvatorlaṅa ca| (3.2.116) 117. praśne cāsannakāle| (3.2.117) `praṣṭavyaḥ praśnaḥ' ityanena praśnaśabdaṃ karmasādhanaṃ darśayati| karaṇasādhane hi pṛcchyate'neneti śabdaḥ praśnaśabdenocyate| tathā ca sati tasyoccaryamāṇatvādātmalābhasya sarvadaivāsannakāla ityāsannakālagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| bhāvasādhane'pyarthāntaravācibhyo dhātubhyo na syāt| `agacchat'iti| `gamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.982, 983), `iṣugamiyāṃ chaḥ' (7.3.77) iti chatvam| `iyāja' iti| `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām'(6.1.17) iti samprasāraṇam| `jaghāna' iti| kaṃsavadho'tra pṛcchamānaḥ| sa cedānīntanaprayokturapekṣayā viprakṛṣṭakālaḥ| pañcavarṣābhyantaramāsannakāla iti naiyāyikā varṇayanti| pañcavarṣātītastu viprakṛṣṭa iti bhavati| kaṃsavadho'tra viprakṛṣṭakālaḥ|| 118. laṭ sme| (3.2.118) `naḍena sma purādhīyate' iti| iṅo'dhipūrvāllaṭ, `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityātmanepadam, ṭeretvam, `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67), `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ| upasargeṇa sahākaḥ savarṇe (6.1.101) dīrghatvam| atha vā-- karttaryātmanepadam, adāditvācchabdo luk, `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityadādeśaḥ, dhātoriyaṅa yathāyogaṃ pūrvavat|| 119. aparokṣe ca| (3.2.119) `bravīti' iti| `bruva īṭ' (7.3.93) | `kathayati' iti| `katha vākyaprabandhe' (dhā.pā.1851), curādāvadantaḥ, tasmāṇṇic, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) , `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāvāt `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhirna bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ punaridamārabdham ? pūrveṇa parokṣe vidhānādaparokṣe na prāpnoti, atastatrāpi yathā syādityevamartham| nanu ca pūrvayoge parokṣagrahaṇaṃ nivartiṣyate, tasmin nivṛtte pūrveṇaiva parokṣe cāparokṣe ca bhaviṣyati ? satyametat; codyamapi kaścidvijānīyādyadi parokṣagrahaṇaṃ nivṛttaṃ tatsambaddhamanadyatanagrahaṇamapi nivṛttamiti, tadanyathā mā vijñāyīti pūrvasūtre parokṣagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tasmiṃścānuvarttamāne karttavyametat, anyathā hyaparokṣe na syāt|| 120. nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane| (3.2.120) `pṛṣṭaprativacane' iti| praśnaḥ - pṛṣṭam, bhāve niṣṭhā| pṛṣṭapūrvakaprativacanaṃ pṛṣṭaprativacanam, śākapārthivāditvanmadhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ| `anadyatane parokṣa iti nivṛttam' iti| asvaritatvāt| `akārṣīḥ kaṭaṃ devadatta' ityeṣa praśnaḥ| `nanu karomi bhoḥ'ityetat praśnapūrvakaṃ prativacanam| `avocastatra kiñciddevadatta'ityeṣa praśnaḥ| `nanu karomi bhoḥ'ityetat praśnapūrvakaṃ prativacanam| `nanvakārṣīt' iti| praśnapūrvakaṃ prativacanaṃ na bhavatīti luṅeva bhavati| nanu ca prativacanaṃ sarvaṃ praśnapūrvakamevu, tadanarthakaṃ pṛṣṭagrahaṇam, vyavacchedyābhāvāt ? naitadiṣṭam ;prativacanaśabdo'yamastyeva pṛṣṭānvākhyāne-- yaḥ praśnamantareṇa na bhavati; astyavyayībhāve-- vacanaṃ vacanaṃ prativacanam, yathārthe `avyayam' (2.1.6) iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ;asti samādhivacanaḥ-- pratipūrvasya vaceḥ samādhāviti darśanāt, tathā hi vaktāro vadanti-- yadananābhihitaṃ tanmayā prayuktamiti, pariṣkṛtamityarthaḥ; tadevamanekārthe prativacanaśabda-, yadi pṛṣṭagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate sarveṣvartheṣu syāt| asmiṃstu kriyamāṇe praśnapūrvo yaḥ prativacanaśabdaḥ, sa eva gṛhyate, nānya iti na bhavtayānarthakyam|| 121. nanvorvibhāṣā| 3.2.121) `nākarṣam'iti| pūrvavadambhāvaḥ|| 122. puri luṅ cāsme| (3.2.122) `purāśabde' iti| etena purāśabda ihopapadatvenopātto na puriti darśayati| yadyetadeva, asyākārāntatvāt purīti saptamyanto nirdeśo nopapadyate ? `āto dhātoḥ' (6.4.140) iti yogavibhāgādākāralopādadoṣaḥ| atha `pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ'(dhā.pā.1086) ityetasmādbhrājādisūtreṇa (3.2.177) kvipi vihitaḥ `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuttve raparatve ca kṛte yaḥ pūḥśabda sampadyate tasyehāpyupapadatvenopādānamiti kasmānna vijñāyate ? tasyānadyatanavṛttyasambhavāt| purāśabdastu tatraiva varttata iti tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| `luṅa ca' iti cakāreṇa laḍanukṛṣyata iti darśayati| `yathāviṣayam' iti| `yathā'sādṛśye' (2.1.7) iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| `anye'pi'iti| laṅādayaḥ| `vasanti' iti| laṭ| `avātsuḥ' iti| luṅa, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjusādeśaḥ, `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, pūrvavat sakārasya tatvam| `avasan' iti| laṅa| `ūṣuḥ' iti| liṭ, `parasmaipadānām' (3.4.82) ityādinā jherjus, dvirvacanam, vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam, `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām' (6.1.17) ityabhyāsasya ca; `śāsivasighasīnāñca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam|| 123. varttamāne laṭ| (3.2.123) `prārabdho'parisamāptaśca' iti| prārabdho yaḥ sādhayituṃ prastutaḥ, na ca samāptimupagataḥ sa varttamāna ityucyate| varttamānagrahaṇaṃ dhātvadhikārāt tadarthasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `varttamāne' ityādi| na hyadhātvarthe dhātorvṛttiḥ sambhavati| laṭaṣṭakāraḥ `ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere' (3.4.79) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| akāraḥ `vido laṭo vā ' (3.4.83) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ; ikāre hyaccārite liḍādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt|| 124. laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāvaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe| (3.2.124) śatṛśānacoḥ śakārau sārvadhātukārthau| ṛkāra ugitkāryārthaḥ| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇa iti paryudāso'yam| prathamāśabdo'yaṃ vibhaktiviśeṣe soraujasparynate śāstre rūḍhaḥ| prathamāyā anyā dvitīyādikā vibhaktiḥ - aprathamā| samānaśabdo'yaṃ sādhāraṇavacanaḥ, yathā-- devadattayajñadattau samānadhanāvita| adhikaraṇaśabdo'yamabhidheyavacanaḥ samānañca tadadhikaraṇañceti karmadhārayaḥ| aprathamayā samānādhikaraṇam - aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇam| `tṛtīyā' (2.1.30) itiyogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ| tataḥ `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' (2.3.37) iti saptamī| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇabhāvena śatṛśānacorbhāvo lakṣyate| aprathameti paryudāsavṛttyā dvitīyādervibhaktergrahaṇam, tena pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantavidhirbhaviṣyatītyāha-- `aprathamāntena cet' ityādi| `tasya' iti| laṭaḥ| sāmānādhikaraṇyam' iti| samānābhidheyamiti| yadi dvitīyāntena śabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam - samānābhidheyatvaṃ sambhavatyevaṃ śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ, nānyatheti vākyārthaḥ| evaṃ vivṛmvatā'prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe'tra paryudāsa āśritaḥ, na prasajyapratiṣedha iti darśyate, anyathā hi yadi prasajyapratiṣedha āśritaḥ syāt prathamāntena ceta sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na bhavatītyevaṃ brūyāt| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadi prasajyapratiṣedha āśritaḥ ? aprathāsamānādhikaraṇa uttarapade śatṛśānacau na syātām-- bhajyata iti bhaktiḥ, kurvan bhaktirasya kurvadbhaktiḥ, kurvāṇo bhaktirasya kurvāṇabhaktiḥ| ye ca prathamāsamānādhikaraṇavṛttayastaddhitāsteṣu na syātām-- `praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap'(5.3.66) kurvadrūpam, kurvāṇarūpamiti; `īṣadasamāptau kalpaśabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ' (5.3.67) kurvatkalpaḥ| nanu paryudāse'pi bhavatyeva doṣaḥ, na hyatrāprathamāntena kvacit prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe'pi bhavata iti| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu pratiṣedhaṃ vidhāya pratiṣiddhasya ca purvidhānamayuktam| `pacantaṃ devadattaṃ paśya' iti| dvitīyāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ darśayati| `pacatā' iti| tṛtīyāntena| vibhaktervipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā devadatteneti sambandhāt| nanu ca laḍādeśasyātrāprathamāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyam, na laṭaḥ; tasya prayogābhāvāt| ādeśadharmasya sthāninyupacārāt laṭo'pyupacāritaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ|atha laḍgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'nantarasūtrāllaḍityanuvarttata eva ? syādetat; prathamāntañcaitat| ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśena cehārthaḥ, tasmāt ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśārtha punarlaḍ‌grahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti, etaccāyuktam,prathamāntasyāpi laḍ‌grahamasyārthadvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyatīti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vijñāsyata ityata āha-- `laḍiti varttamāne' ityādi| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe punarlaḍ‌grahaṇam| tena kvacit prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe bhavataḥ-- kurvan brāhmaṇaḥ| `san brāhmaṇaḥ' iti| `asa bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065), adāditvācchapo luk| `śnasoralopaḥ' (6.4.111), ityakāralopaḥ| `vidyamānaḥ' ityādau sarvatra brāhmaṇa ityapekṣate| `vida sattāyām' (dhā.pā.1171), divādirātmanepadī, śyan| `juhvat' (7.1.78) iti| `hu {dānādanayoḥ (ādāne ityeke prīṇane'pi iti bhāṣyam) -dhā.pā.} dāne'(dhā.pā.1083), `huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke' (6.4.87) iti yaṇādeśaḥ, `nābhyastācchatuḥ (7.1.78) iti numāgamābhāvaḥ| `adhīyānaḥ'iti| `iṅa adhyayane' (dhā.pā.11046), adhipūrvaḥ| pūrvavat `aciśnu'(6.4.77) ityādinā iyaṅa| `māṅyākrośe' iti| māṅyupapada ākrośe gamyamāne laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau bhavataḥ| `mā pacan, mā pacamānaḥ' iti| nanu cātraiva māṅi luṅā bhavitavyam, etasmādevādhikavidhānāt ? punarlaḍ‌grahaṇādākrośe na bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `māṅi luṅa' (3.3.175) ityasya yatrākrośe nāsti so'vakāśaḥ| `kecidvibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttayanti' iti| san brāhmaṇo'sti brāhmaṇa ityādau vikalpena śatṛśānacau yathā syātāmityevamartham| keciditi vacanāt kecinnānuvarttayantītyuktaṃ bhavati| teṣāmayamabhiprāyaḥ-- yadi prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe nityaṃ tau bhavatastadā'prathamāsamānādhikaṇagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, `śatṛśānacau'ityevaṃ brūyāt| tatrāpyayamarthaḥ-- sāmānyena prathamāsānādhikaraṇe'nyatra śatṛśānacorvidhānāt punargrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati| tasmādaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇagrahaṇasāmarthyādaprathamāsamānadhikaraṇa eva nityau tau bhavataḥ, prathamāsamānādikaraṇeṣvanyatheti| yadi tarhi vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttayanti, yathā san brāhmaṇaḥ, asti brāhmaṇaḥ, vidyamāno brāhmaṇaḥ,vidyate brāhmaṇa ityādau vikalpena bhavataḥ; tathā kurvadbhaktiḥ kurvāṇabhaktirityevamādāvapi syātāmityata āha--`sā ca' ityādi| `tatra' iti| vyavasthitavibhāṣayāṃ satyām| `yathādarśanam' iti| yathā lakṣyasya darśanaṃ tadanurūpāḥ prayogā unneyāḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- lakṣyadarśanavat syāt| kvacinnityaṃ tau śatṛśānacau veditavyau, kvacit pākṣikau,kvacidavidyamānāviti| tatra kurvadbhaktiḥ, kurvāṇabhaktiḥ, kurvattaraḥ, kurvattama ityādau nityam ; san brāhmaṇaḥ , asti brāhmaṇa ityādau pākṣikau; taraptamavādipratyaye pare tāvavidyamānāveva| `pacatitarāma' iti| pacatiśabdāt `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) iti tarap, `kimet'(5.4.11) ityādināmi kṛte na bhavataḥ|| 125. sambodhane ca| (3.2.125) `pऱthamāsamānādhikaraṇārtha ārambhaḥ' iti| avadhāraṇamiha draṣṭavyam| pūrvayogo hyaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇārthaḥ, kvacit prathamāsamānādhikaraṇārthaśca; ayaṃ tu prathamāsamānādhikaraṇārthaṃ eva| yadi tarhi pūrvasūtraṃ prathamāsamānādhikaraṇārthamapi, tarhyeṣaṃsati tau yathā anyatra prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe'pi bhavatastathā sambodhane'pi bhaviṣyata ityapārthakam ? nāpārthakam; tasyaiva prapañcārthatvāt| `he pacan' iti| `na ṅisambuddhyoḥ' (8.2.8) iti nalopapratiṣedhānnalopābhāvaḥ| `he pacamāna' iti| `eṅa hrasvāt sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sulopaḥ|| 126. lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ| (3.2.126) `dhātvartha viśeṣaṇañcaitat' iti| dhātvadhikārāt| athopapade kasmānna bhavataḥ ? kriyāyā iti vacanāt| yadyupapade syātāṃ tadā kriyāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| upapadaṃ hi dhātorbhavati, sa ca kriyāvacana ityentareṇāpi kriyāgrahaṇaṃ lakṣamahetū kriyāviṣayau vijñāsyete| tat kriyāgrahaṇena dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatve hi tayoḥ kvaciddhātvartho dravyasya heturbhavati, lakṣaṇaṃ vā ; kvacidguṇasya , kvacitkriyāyāḥ| ato dravyādinivṛttyarthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ yuktam; ataḥ `kriyāyāḥ' iti vacanam| `kriyāviṣayau' iti| kriyāyā ityetadvivaraṇam| kriyā viṣayo yathostau tathoktau| etena `kriyāyāḥ' iti yeyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī sā subvyatyayena saptamyāḥ sthāne vihiteti sūcayati| `śayānā bhuñjate' iti| śīṅo'pavāditvācchapo luk, `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.4.21) iti guṇaḥ| atra śayanaṃ lakṣaṇam, bhujikriyā viṣayaḥ|tena hi bhujikriyā lakṣyate tatra śīṅa varttate| `tiṣṭhanto'nuśāsati' iti| tiṣṭhateḥ pāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) tiṣṭhādeśaḥ| atrāvasthānaṃ lakṣaṇam, tenānuśāsanakriyā lakṣyate| `arjayan vasati' atrādhyayanam| `pacati, paṭhati' iti| nātra kriyāyā lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvo vivakṣitaḥ| `yaḥ kampateso'śvatthaḥ'iti| atra hi kampanaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti tenāśvattho lakṣyate, na tu kriyāviṣayam, kiṃ tarhi ? dravyaviṣayam; aśvatthasya dravyaviṣayatvāt| `yadutplavate tallaghu' iti| atrotplavanenalaghusaṃjñako guṇo lakṣyata iti gu viṣayaṃ tat, na tu kriyāviṣayam| varṣatīti dhāvati, hantīti palāyata ityatra yadyapi varṣaṇahananābhyāṃ dhāvanapalāyanakriye lakṣyete, tathāpi śatṛśānacau na bhavataḥ; `nanvorvibhāṣā'(3.2.121) ityato vyavasthitavibhāṣetyanuvarttate; itikaraṇena hetubhāvasya dyotitatvāt| pūrvanipātalakṣamavyabhicāraliṅgam' iti| `dvandve ghi' (2.2.32) ityanena dhyantasya yaḥ pūrvanipātaḥ kriyate tasya vyabhicāraḥ| svaviṣaye satyapi tasya kvacidabhāvaḥ| tasya vyabhicārasya liṅgamayaṃ nirdeśaḥ|yadi hyabhicārī dhyantasya nipātaḥ syāt, `hetulakṣaṇayoḥ'iti nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| vyabhicāre tu sati dhūmāgnī ityevamādaya upapannā bhavanti|| 127. tau sat| nanu ca prakṛtatvādeva śatṛśānacoriyaṃ saṃjñā syāt, tatkiṃ taugrahaṇamityāha-- `taugrahaṇam' ityādi| upādhinā viśeṣamenāsaṃsargārthaṃ taugrahaṇamityarthaḥ| upādhistu varttamānakālaḥ, tatra śatṛśānacorvihitvāt| upādhyasaṃgarhārthe taugrahaṇe sati kiṃ bhavatītyāha-- `śatṛśānajmātrasya' ityādi| mātragrahaṇamupādhisaṃgrahavyavacchedārtham| asati hi taugrahaṇe yādṛśau prakṛtau tādṛśayorava saṃjñā syāt| kīdṛśau ca tau ? varttamānakalāvihitau| tataśca lṛḍādeśayorbhaviṣyatkālavihitayoḥ saditi saṃjñā na syāt| nanu ca `luṭaḥ sadvā' (3.3.14) iti sacchabdena tau vidhīyete, tato vacanasāmarthyāt tu bhaviṣyataḥ ? na brūmaḥ-- vidhānaṃ tayorna sidhyatīti, kiṃ tarhi ? vihitayoruttarakālasaṃjñā na sidhyati| tataśca brāhmaṇasya kariṣyan, brāhmaṇasya kariṣyamāṇa ityatra `pūraṇaguṇa' (2.2.11) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedho na syāt| sad‌grahaṇaṃ tu sacchabdenaiva varttamānaśatṛśānajante ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhārthaṃ syāt| taugrahaṇe śatṛśānacorviśeṣaṇamanapekṣya rūpamātre saṃjñā''khyāyata iti varttamānakāle vidhānāsaṃsaktayorapi saṃjñā sidhyatīti|| 128. pūṅyajoḥ śānan| (3.2.128) varttamānavihitāḥ śatṛśānacprabhṛtayaḥ| ete lādeśā vā syuḥ ? pratyayā vā ? tatra yadi iha laṭa ityanuvarttate tadā lādeśāḥ, atha nānuvarttate tataḥ pratyayāḥ| tasyādeśāḥ kriyeraṃstadā `nanvorvibhāṣā'(3.2.121) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttayitavyaṃ jāyeta; anyathā pavate devadattaḥ, yajate devadatta iti tiṅaśravaṇaṃ kuryāt| pratyayalakṣaṇe tu vāsarūpavidhinā yadā laḍ bhavati tadā pratyayaśravaṇaṃ tiṅaśravaṇamupapadyate| kiñca, ādeśapakṣe `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) iti bhāvakarmaṇorapi śānannādayaḥ syuḥ, karttaryeva ceṣyante| pratyayapakṣe tu `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) iti karttaryeva bhavanti, na bhāvakarmaṇoḥ, iha katīha maṇḍayamāna ittyuttarasūtre cānaśi kṛte `tāsyanudāttenṅidadupadeśāllasārvadhātukamanudāttamahnviṅoḥ' (6.1.186) itinighātaḥ syāt, pratyayapakṣe tu na bhavati; alasārvadhātukatvāt| cānaśaḥ `laḥ parasmaipadam' (1.4.99) `taṅānāvātmanepadam' (1.4.100) ityātmanepadasaṃjñā prasajyeta, tataścātmanepadibhya eva syāt-- katīha nighnānā iti| pratyayapakṣe tvalādeśānna bhavatyātmanepadasaṃjñāprasaṅgaḥ| tadevamādeśapakṣe bahavo doṣāḥ pratividheyāḥ, pratatividhāne'pi teṣāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ bhavatīti matvā pratyayapakṣamāśrityāha-- `śānanpratyayo bhavati' iti| śakāraḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaḥ| `pavamānaḥ' iti| `pūṅa pavane' (dhā.pā.966), śap, `āne muk' (7.2.82)| `yadi' ityādi| `na lokāvyaya'(2.3.69) ityādau tṛnniti tṛna eva pratyayasya nirdeśa iti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| `tṛnniti pratyāhāranirdeśāt' iti| `somaṃ pavamānaḥ, naḍamāghnānaḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedha ityanena sambandhanīyam| yadi tṛnniti pratyayagrahaṇaṃ syāt tadā śānanprabhṛtīnāṃ pratyayārthe sati `somaṃ pavamānaḥ' ityādau ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedho na syāt| na ca tṛnniti pratyayasya grahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? pratyāhārasya| tatra caśānannādayo'ntarbhūtā iti bhavatyeva ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ| `dviṣaḥ śaturvā vacanam' iti| `dviṣo'mitre' (3.2.131) ityanena yaḥ {śatā'iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} śatṛ vidhīyate tasya pratyāhāre'sminnantarbhāvāt tadyoge ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ syāt, tataścaurasya dviṣanniti pakṣe na syāt| tasmāt `dviṣa aprītau' (dhā.pā.1013) ityasya śatrantasya prayoge dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vā ṣaṣṭhī vaktavyā|| 129. tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś| (3.2.129) `maṇḍyamānāḥ' iti| `maḍi bhūṣāyām' (dhā.pā.321), iditt‌vānnum| hetumaṇṇic| `bhūṣayamāṇāḥ' iti| `bhūṣa alaṅkāre' (dhā.pā.682), curādiṇic| `kavacaṃ paryasyamānāḥ'iti| divāditvācchyan| tadeva vayo gamyate tatra sthitāḥ kavacaṃ paryasyante| kavacam - sannāham| `śikhaṇḍaṃ vahamānāḥ'iti| atrāpi tathāvidhaṃ vayo gamyate yatra varttamānāḥ śikhaṇḍaṃ vahanti| śikhaṇṇṭaḥ - cūḍā| vacanagrahaṇaṃ vaicitryārtham, vināpi hi tena vayasi gamyamāne pratyayo labhyata eva, yathā ca `vayasi ca' (3.2.10) ityatra | `nighnānāḥ' iti| hananaśaktiriti gamyate|| 130. iṅdhāryoḥ śatrakṛcchriṇi| (3.2.130) `akṛcchriṇi karttari'iti| etenākṛcchriṇīti pratyayārthasya kartturetadviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| `akṛcchraḥ sukhasādhyo yasya dhātvarthaḥ so'kṛcchrī' iti| `ata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) itīniḥ| `adhīyan' iti| pūrvavadiyaṅa| `dhārayan' iti| `dhṛṅa avasthāne' (dhā.pā.1412) curādiṇic|| 131. dviṣo'mitre| (3.2.131) `amitraḥ śatruḥ' iti| śatrādevāmitraśabdasya rūḍhatvāt| `dveṣṭi' iti| adāditvācchapo luk|| 132. suño yajñasaṃyoge| (3.2.132) `yajñasaṃyogaḥ' iti| karmasādhanaḥ saṃyogaśabdaḥ| ata eva vṛttāvāha-- `yajñasaṃyukte'bhiṣave' iti| saṃyuktaḥ - sambaddhaḥ, yajñena saṃyukto yajñasaṃyuktaḥ| kadā cābhiṣavo yajñasaṃyukto bhavati ? yadā yajñāṅgaṃ bhavati| `sunvantaḥ' ityādi| `svādibhyaḥ śnuḥ' (3.1.73) | `sarve yajamānāḥ' iti| sunvanta ityanena yajamānāḥ sattriṇo yajñasya ye svāminaste'bhidhīyante, na tu yājñikā iti darśayati| kathaṃ punareṣo'rtho labhyate, yāvatā yathābhiṣavasya yajamānāḥ, karttārastathā yājakā apītyāha-- `saṃyogagrahaṇam' ityādi| iha `suñoyajñe' ityetadveditavyam, evamapi hyucyamāne yajñasaṃyuktatābhiṣavasya labhyata eva; yajñaviṣayaścaiṣa sunotyartho bhavatītyarthasya pratipatteḥ, tasmāt saṃyogagrahaṇamiti na karttavyametat ? kriyate pradhānakarttṛpratipattyartham| yāgasya ye karttāro bhūtvā phalaṃ prāpnuvantaḥ sunvantaste pradhānakarttāraḥ, te punaryajamānāḥ,na yājakāḥ|| 133. arhaḥ praśaṃsāyām| (3.2.133) 134. ā kvestacchīlataddhartatsādhukāriṣu| (3.2.134) `tacchīlādiṣu karttuṣu' iti| anena tacchīlādīnāṃ pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇatāṃ darśayati|`abhividhau cāyamāṅa' iti| abhividhiḥ - abhivyāpti-| atrāṅa na maryādāyām, tena vakṣyamāṇasya kvipo'pyayamarthanirdeśa iti| so'pi tacchīlīdiṣveva bhavati| `tat'ityādi| `dhātoḥ' (3.1.91) iti varttate,na ca dhātoḥ śīlādiviśeṣaṇamupapadyate, tasmāt tasya yo'rthaḥ sa śīlādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ viśeṣaṇabhāvena tacchīlādiśabdena nirdiśyate| sa dhātvarthaḥ śīlaṃ yasya sa tacchīlaḥ| sa eva dharmo yasya sa taddharmā| sādhu karotīti sādhukārī, tasya dhātvarthasya sādhukārīti yāvat| `svabhāvataḥ' iti| bhavatyasmāt phalanirapekṣā vṛttiriti bhāvaḥ| svabhāvaścaitaniko dharmaḥ, sa punaḥ śīlameva|`phalanirapekṣaḥ' iti| phalākāṅkṣārahitaḥ| `tatra'iti| dhātvarthe| `tadācāraḥ'iti| tacchīlāt tadācārasyānyathātvaṃ darśayati| `yo dhātvarthaṃ sādhu karoti' iti| atrāpi vinā śīleneti sambadhyate| `sādhu'iti| praśastamityarthaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇatvānnapuṃsakatvam|| 135. tṛn| (3.2.135) `muṇḍayitāraḥ' iti| muṇḍāṃ kurvantīti `muṇḍamiśra' (3.1.21) ityādinā ṇic, iṣṭhavadbhāvena ṭilopaḥ| `{muṇḍayitāraḥ śrāviṣṭhāyanā bhavanti badhūmūḍhām'--kāśikā|} vadhūmūḍhāṃ śrāviṣṭhāyanā muṇḍayanti' iti| eteṣāṃ kuladharmaḥ| `āhvarakāḥ śrāddhe siddhe'nnamapaharanti' iti| eteṣāmācāraḥ| yaḥ kaṭaṃ sādhu karotīti sa karttā kaṭamiti| kheṭaṃ yo līlayā gacchati sa sādhu gacchati| `tṛnvidhau' ityādi| atācchīlyārtha ārambhaḥ| asmiṃstṛnvidhāvanupasargasya dhātostṛn vaktavya ṛtvikṣvabhidheyeṣu| `hotā' iti| `hu {dānādanayoḥ| ādāne ityeke|prīṇane'pi iti bhāṣyam-- dhā.pā.} dāne' (dhā.pā.1083)| `potā' iti| `pūṅa pavane' (dhā.pā.966)| `udgātā' iti| `kai gai śabde' (dhā.pā.916,917)|`svare vikṣeṣaḥ' iti. tṛci sati `gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) iti prakṛtisvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati, tṛni tu sati `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) ityanuvarttamāne' `tādau ca niti kṛtyatau' (6.2.49) iti pūrvavadasya prakṛtisvaraḥ prasajyeta| `nayateḥ ṣuk ca' iti| kṛte guṇe ṣugāgamo veditavyaḥ; anyathā hyalaghūpadhatvād‌guṇo na syāt| guṇo'pi vā vaktavyaḥ| atra ṛtvigiti varttate| ayamapyatācchīlyārtha ārambhaḥ| `tviṣeḥṭa ityādi| `tviṣa dīptau' (dhā.pā.1001) ityasmāddevatāyāmabhidheyāṃ tṛn vaktavyaḥ, akāraścopadhāyā ādeśo bhavati| `aniṭ‌tvaṃ ca'iti| etasya sarvaśeṣatve cāsya potetyatrāniṭ‌tvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| `kṣadeḥ'ityādi| `kṣada'iti sautro dhātuḥ| `gudhṛvīpacivayiyamisadi kṣadibhyastraḥ'(paṃ.u.4.166) ityādyuṇādisūtrapāṭhāt| uṇādiṣu nipātitatvāt hotrādaya iti siddham| tatra hi `naptṛneṣṭṛtvaṣṭṛkṣatṛpotṛhotṛbhrātṛjāmātṛpitṛduhitṛ' (da.u.2.3.) ityete nipātitāḥ|| 136. alaṃkṛñnirākṛñprajanotpacotpatonmadarucyapatrapavṛtuvṛdhusahacara iṣṇuc| (3.2.136) alampūrvaḥ karotiḥ, punaḥ sa eva nirāṅapūrvaḥ, `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149) prapūrvaḥ;`{paci dhā.pā.} paca vyaktīkaraṇa' (dhā.pā.174);`pada gatau' (dhā.pā.1898), patimanye paṭhanti;`śala hula patlṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.843,844,845)| `{madī harṣaglepanayoḥ'-dhā.pā.)madī tṛptisādhane' (dhā.pā.815)-- ete padādaya utpūrvāḥ| `ruca {dīptavabhiprītau ca' -dhā.pā.} dīptau' (dhā.pā.745); `trapūṣ lajjāyām' (dhā.pā.374) apapūrvaḥ, `vṛtu varttane' (dhā.pā.758), `vṛdhu vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.759), `ṣaha marṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1809), `cara gatyarthaḥ' (dhā.pā.559)-- ebhya iṣṇuj bhavati, {tṛṇo'pavādaḥ iti, mu.pāṭhaḥ} tṛno'pavādaḥ| yadā tvalampūrvaḥ karotirmaṇḍane varttate, tadā `krudhamaṇḍārthebhyaśca' (3.2.151) iti yuc prāpnoti;pūrvavipratiṣedhaśca vaktavyaḥ; anyathā maṇḍanādanyatra sāvakāśamiṣṇucaṃ paratvādbādhate| ye'tra sopasargāḥ paṭhyante, tebhya etadupasargapūrvebhya eva bhavati, anyebhyastvaniyamena|| 137. ṇeśchandasi| (3.2.137) `dhārayiṣṇavaḥ, pārayiṣṇavaḥ'iti| `dhṛṅa avasthāne' (dhā.pā.1412), `pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ (dhā.pā.1086); hetumaṇṇic, `ayāmanta'(6.4.55) ityādināyādeśaḥ|| 138. bhuvaśca| (3.2.138) `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttarasūtre bhavatarevānuvarttanaṃ yathā syāt; anyathā yadi `ṇibhūbhyāñca' ityeko yogaḥ kriyate tadā ṇigrahaṇamapyanukṛṣyeta| `bhājiṣṇunā' ityāda| laukikaprayogaḥ| tasyopanyāso bhāṣāyāmapi `bhrājṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.181) ityetasmādiṣṇucpradarśanārthaḥ|| 139. glājisthaśca ksnuḥ| (3.2.139) atha sthāsnurityatra `ghumāsthāgāpā' (6.4.66) ityādisūtreṇa kasmādītvaṃ bhavatītyāha-- `piccāyam' ityādi| īttvaṃ kṅiti| tatra `dīṅo yuḍaci kṅiti' (6.4.63) ityanuvṛtteḥ| na cāyaṃ kit, na cāyaṃ ṅit; kiṃ tarhi ? git| gakārasya tvaśravaṇam,cartvabhūtasya nirdeśāt| yadi tarhi gidayam, jiṣṇurityatra guṇaḥ prāpnoti, yasmāt `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti kṅiti pratyaye guṇaḥ pratiṣidhyate, na gitītyata āha-- `kṅiti ca' ityādi. na hi `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) ityatra kakāraṅakārāveva nirdiśyete, kiṃ tarhi ? gakāro'pi kṛtacartvaḥ,tena gityapi guṇo na bhavati| bhūṣṇurityatra tarhi śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) iṭ‌pratiṣedha udyamāno giti na syādityata āha-- `śrayukaḥ' kiti ityādinā gakāraścartvabhūto nirdiśyate' iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `tena' iti| gakārasya cartavabhūtasya nirdeśeneti| `kasnorgitvāt'ityādi| gakāra itsaṃjñako yasya sa git, tadbhāvo gittvam| tasmāt gittvānna syāsnurityatrekāraḥ| tiṣṭhaterīkāro na bhavati| kasmāt punargittavādīkāro na bhavatītyāha-- `kaṅitoritvaśāsanāt' ityādi| kakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| yasmāt kṅitītvamucyate, ayaṃ tu git, tasmāt kṅiti vidhīyamānamītvaṃ gitvādiha na prāpnoti| yadyevam, jiṣṇurityatra guṇaḥ prāpnotītyata āha-- `guṇābhāvaḥ'ityādi| triṣu kakāragakāraṅakāreṣvitsaṃjñakeṣu yo guṇapratiṣedhaḥ sa smarttavya- - jñātavyaḥ| `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) ityatra gakāraścartvabhūto nirdiṣṭaḥ| yadi tarhi gidayam, `bhūṣṇurityatra `śrayukaḥ kiti'(7.2.11) ityīṭ‌pratiṣedho na syādityata āha-- `śrayuko'niṭ‌catvamiṭpratiṣedho bhavatīti veditavyam| yadi gakāraścartvabhūtaḥ `śrayuka kiti' (7.2.11) itīṭpratiṣedho na syādityata āha-- `śayuko'niṭ‌tvam' ityādi. gakāro'pi tataścartvabhūto nirdiśyate| tana kakāragakārayordvayorapītsaṃjñakayoḥ śrayuko'niṭ‌tvamiṭpratiṣedho bhavatīti veditavyam| yadigakāraścarttvabhūtaḥ `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) ityatra nirdiśyate,` haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityutvaṃ prāpnoti, tasyāsiddhatvāt ? sautratvānnirdeśaśyāsaṃhitayā pāṭhānna bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| vāmanasya tvetat sarvamanabhimatam| yathā nābhimataṃ tathā `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) ityatra pratipāditam| `daṃśeḥ'ityādi. upasaṃkhyānaśabdaḥ pratipādane varttate| `danśa daṃśane' (dhā.pā.898) ityetasmādapi ksnupratyayasyopasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nurttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena daṃśerapi bhaviṣyatīti| `daṃkṣṇavaḥ' iti| vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam| `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopo na bhavati, ksnorgitvāt| ye tu kitvamicchanti, tairiha nakāralopapratiṣedhaḥ `nāñceḥ pūjāyām' (6.4.30) ityatra neti yogavibhāgena karttavyaḥ| yatnāntaraṃ vā tairāstheyam-- nakārasyānusvāraḥ, tasya parasavarṇaḥ|| 140. trasigṛdhidhaṣikṣipeḥ knuḥ| (3.2.140) `trasa {dhāraṇe-- dhā.pā.} udvege' (dhā.pā.1741), `gṛdhu abhikāṃkṣāyām' (dhā.pā.1246) , `ñighṛṣā pragalbhye' (dhā.pā.1269), `kṣipa preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1285)| `trasnuḥ' iti| `neḍ‌vaśikṛti'(7.2.8) itīṭ‌ pratiṣedhathaḥ| `gṛghnuḥ 'iti| `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti guṇābhāvaḥ|| 141.śamityaṣṭābhyo ghinuṇ| (3.2.141) `śamu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1201), `tamu kāṅkṣāyām'(dhā.pā.1202), `damu {upaśame-dhā.pā.} uparame' (dhā.pā.1203), `śramu tapasi khede ca' (dhā.pā.1204), `bhramu anavasthāne' (dhā.pā.1205), `kṣamu sahane' (dhā.pā.1206), `klamu glānau' (dhā.pā.1207), `madī harṣe'(dhā.pā.1208)| `uttaratra kutvārthaḥ' iti| samparkītyādau `cajoḥ ku ghiṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti yathā syāt| `ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ' iti| anubandhatvamasya nirasyati| anubandhatve sati śaminau śamina iti `ugidacām' (7.1.70) iti num prasajyeta| iha śaminitarām, śaminitamāmiti `nadyāḥ śeṣasyānyatarasyām' (6.3.44) iti varttamāne `ugitaśca' (6.3.45) ityanyatarasyāṃ hrasvatvaṃ syāt, anyathā hyasyānubandhakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmaduccāraṇārtha evokāro bhavati| hrasvatvañca `gharūpakalpacelaḍ‌bruvagotramatahateṣu' (6.3.43) ityanena nityaṃ bhavati| `śamī' iti| `ata upadhāyā-' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhirna bhavati, `nodāttopadeśa' (7.3.34) ityādinā pratiṣiddhatvāt| `sau ca' (6.4.13) iti dīrghaḥ| `asitā'iti| `asu kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209) tṛni bhavati|| 142. sampṛcānurudhāṅyamāṅyasaparisṛsaṃsṛjaparidevisaṃjvaraparikṣipapariraṭaparivadaparidahaparimuhaduṣadviṣadruhaduhayujākrīḍavivicatyajarajabhajāticarāpacarāmuṣābhyāhanaśca| (3.2.142) `pṛcī samparke' (dhā.pā.1462) sampūrvaḥ| `rudhir āvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1438) anupūrvaḥ;`yama uparame' (dhā.pā.984), `yasu prayatne' (dhā.pā.1210) āṅapūrvaḥ,`sṛja visarge' (dhā.pā.1178), `jvara roge' (dhā.pā.776) sampūrvaḥ;`kṣipa preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1285), `raṭa paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.297), `vada vaktāvyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.1009), `daha bhasmīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.991), `muha vaicittye' (dhā.pā.1198) paripūrvaḥ, `duṣa vaikṛtye' (dhā.pā.1185), `dviṣa aprītau' (dhā.pā.1013), `druha jīghāṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1197),`duha prapūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1014), `krīḍṛ vihāre' (dhā.pā.350) āṅapūrvaḥ, `vijir pṛthagbhāve' (dhā.pā.1094) vipūrvaḥ, `tyaja {hānau ityeva-dhā.pā} vayohānau' (dhā.pā.986), `rañja rāge' (dhā.pā.999), `bhaja sevāyām' (dhā.pā.998), `cara gatyartha' (dhā.pā.559) atipūrvaḥ, sa evānupūrvaḥ, `muṣa steye' (dhā.pā.1530) āṅapūrvaḥ, `hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1012) abhyāṅapūrvaḥ| śaऱeṣā vṛttāveva nirdiṣṭāḥ| `na tvadādiḥ'iti| `gṛhyate'iti sambadhyate| ādādikaḥ kasmānna gṛhyata ityāha-- ādādikastu lugvikaraṇaḥ, tasmāt sa na gṛhyate| `paridevirbhvādiḥ' iti| `gṛhyate' iti sambandhaḥ| atha paridiveḥ krīḍādyarthasya ṇyantasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? aṇyantairitaraiḥ sāhacaryāt| `sāmānyena gṛhyate' iti| viśeṣābhāvāt| `dvayorapi grahaṇam' iti| tata eva hetoḥ| `nipātanādanunāsikalopaḥ' iti| `tyajaraja'iti sūtre niranunāsikasyoccāraṇameva nipātanam| `samparkī' iti| laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| `āyāmī' iti| `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ| `parisārī' iti| atrāpi `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddhiḥ| `abhyāghātī' iti| pūrvavad‌ghatvatatve|| 143. vau kaṣalasakatthasrambhaḥ| (3.2.143) 144. ape ca laṣaḥ| (3.2.144) 145. pre lapasṛdrumathavadavasaḥ| (3.2.145) `pralāpī, prasārī' iti| `lapa vyaktāyāṃ vāci'(dhā.pā.402), `sṛ gatau' (935)| `pradrāvī, pramāthī'iti| `du dru gatau' (dhā.pā.944 945), `{mathe viloḍane-dhā.pā.} madha viloḍane' (dhā.pā.848)| `nācchādanārthasya' iti| na `vasa ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1023)ityetasya|| 146. nindahiṃsakliśakhādavināśaparikṣipapariraṭaparivādivyābhāṣāsūyo vuñ| (3.2.146) `ṇidi kutsāyām' (dhā.pā.66), `arda hisi hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1828, 1829), `khādṛ bhakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.49), `ṇaśa adarśane' (dhā.pā.1194) vipūrvaḥ, hetumaṇṇyantaḥ| `kṣipiḥ'pūrvokta eva, evaṃ raṭirvadiḥ paripūrvo hetumaṇṇyantaḥ, `bhāva vyaktāyāṃ vāci (dhā.pā.612) vyāṅapūrvaḥ| `asūya' iti kaṇḍavādiyagantasya grahaṇam| atra kliśerupatāpārthasya bhāṣateśca `anudātteśca halādeḥ' (3.2.149) iti yuci prāpte vuñcidhānam| śeṣebhyastu tṛni| nanu `paraśca' (3.1.2) iti digyogalakṣaṇayā pañcamyā bhavitavyam, yathā vṛttau -- nindādibhyo dhātubhyaḥ' iti, tatkathaṃ sūtre prathametyata āha-- `pañcamyarthe prathamā' iti| `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) itisubvyatyayeneti bhāvaḥ| samāhāradvandvācca prathamaikavacanam, puṃlliṅgaṃ tu vyatyayena| `asūyakaḥ'iti| `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ nindādibhyo dhātubhyo vuñ vidhīyate, yāvatā vā'sarūpavidhinaiva nindakādayaḥ,siddhāḥ, tadeva hi rūpam, sa eva svaraḥ, ihaivaikatra svaraviśeṣo'sti-- asūyaka iti, atra vuñi sati ñitvādāderudāttatvaṃ bhavati, ṇvuli tu sati litpratyayāt pūrvasya syāt, tasmādasūyaterevaikasmād‌vuñ, vidhātavyaḥ, netarebhyo nindādibhya ityata āha-- `ṇnulaiva siddhe'ityādi| yadi tacchīlādiṣu vā'sarūpavidhinā tṛjādayo'pi syuḥ nindādibhyo vuñ na vidadhyāt, vihitaścāsau, ata eva vuñvidhānaṃ jñāpayati-- tacchīlādiṣu vā'sarūpavidhirnāstīti| tenālaṅkārakaḥ, nirākarttetyādīnāṃ tacchīlādiṣu sādhutvaṃ na bhavati|| 147. devikruśoścopasarge| (3.2.247) `ādevakaḥ' iti| diveḥ krīḍādyarthād ṇyantād‌vuñ|`ākrośakaḥ' iti| `kruśa {āhvāne rodane ca- dhā.pā.} āhvāne' (dhā.pā.856)| `kroṣṭā' iti| vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam|| 148. calanaśabdārthādakarmakādyuc| (3.2.148) calanaṃ deśāntaraprāptihetuḥ kriyāviśeṣaḥ| śabdaḥ śrotraviṣo'rthaḥ| `calanaḥ, copanaḥ' iti| `cala kampane' (dhā.pā.832),`cupa mandāyāṃ gatau' (dhā.pā.403)| `śabdanaḥ' iti. `śabda {upasargādāviṣkāre bhāṣaṇe ca'-- dhā.pā.}śabdane upasargā viṣkāre ' (dhā.pā.1714) iti caurādikaḥ| atha vā-- `pratipadikāddhātvarthe bahulam' (ga.sū.1860 curādiḥ- 1915) ityādinā ṇic, `śabdavairakalaha' (3.1.17) ityādinā ṇijantādyuc| `ravaṇaḥ'iti| `ru śabde' (dhā.pā.1034)|| 149. anudātteśca halādeḥ| (3.2.149) `edhitā'iti| `edha vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.2)| `jugupsanaḥ,mīmāṃsanaḥ' iti `guptijkidbhyaḥ san'(3.1.5) `mānbadha' (3.1.6) ityādinā sani dīrghe ca kṛte bhavataḥ| atra tadantau samudāyāvanudāttetau avayave kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣakaṃ bhavatīti| tathā ca yadyādigrahaṇaṃ na kriyate tadā tābhyāṃ na syāt; yasmādasatyādigrahaṇe halā tu tadantavidhirvijñāyate-- anudātteto halantāditi| na ca jugupsamīmāṃsaśabdau halantau, kiṃ tarhi ? ajantau| ādigrahaṇe satyahalantebhyo'pi bhavatītyādigrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| tacca tadā karttavyaṃ yadāto lopa ārdhadhātuke parato bhavatītyayaṃ pakṣaḥ, na tu yadārdhadhātuke viṣayabhūta ityeṣa pakṣaḥ| tadā hyārdhadhātukavivakṣāyāṃ vijñāyamāne halantagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; vyāvartyābhāvāt| tasmād hlgrahaṇasāmarthyādāderviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyata ityādigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyameva| atrādigrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthameva vyākhyeyam| `vasitā' iti| `vasa ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1023)|| 150. jucaṅkramyadandramyasṛgṛdhijvalaśucalaṣapatapadaḥ| (3.2.150) `javanaḥ'iti| `ju' sautrau dhātuḥ; gatau varttata ityeke| viśeṣahetau vega ityapare| `caṃkramaṇaḥ, dandramaṇaḥ'iti| `kramu pādavikṣepe' (dhā.pā.473)| `drama hamma gatau' (dhā.pā.466, 467), `nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau' (3.1.23) iti yaṅ, dvirvacanam, `nugato'nunāsikāntasya' (7.4.85) iti nuk, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ, `yasya halaḥ' (6.4.49) iti yakāralopaḥ| `jvalanaḥ, śocanaḥ' iti| `jvala hvala sañcalane'(dhā.pā.804,805), `śuca śoke' (dhā.pā.183)| nanu cātra jucaṃkramyadaṃdramyaprabhṛtayaścalanārthāḥ,padistvanudātteta, halādiśca; tasmādetebhyo yathāyogaṃ pūrvayogābhyāṃ yuc, siddhaḥ, tataḥ kimarthamiha grahaṇamityāha-- `calanārthānām' ityādi| asati teṣāṃ grahama iha caṃkramaṇo grāmasyetyevamādau na syāt;grāmādeḥ karmaṇo vivakṣitatvāt| tasmāt sakarmakebhyo yathā syādityevamarthameṣāṃ grahaṇam| `jñāpakārtham' ityādinā matāntaraṃ darśayati| `alaṃkṛñastṛnna bhavati' iti| anenāpi jñāpakasya prayojanam| alaṃkartteti sādhurna bhavatītyadhyāhāryam| kathaṃ punaḥ padigrahaṇaṃ jñāpakamityāha-- `tathā hi' ityādi| viśeṣavihitenokañā bādhā mā bhūt, samāveśa eva yathā syādityevamarthamiha padigrahaṇaṃ kriyate| yadi tācchīlike vā'sarūpavidhiḥ syāt tato'sarūpatvadevokañā samāveśaḥ syāditi paderyujvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmājjñāpanārthamevaitadviśeṣavihitatvam; `anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' (3.2.149) iti sāmānyalakṣaṇena vihitatvāt| yadi tarhi vā'sarūpavidherabhāvo jñāpyate, ganteti ca `anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' (3.2.149) iti yujna sidhyati, `vau kaṣa'( 3.2.143) ityādinā dhinuṇo vidhānādityata āha-- `prayikañca ' ityādi| prāyikatvañcottarasūtre pratipādayiṣyate|| 151. krudhamaṇḍārthebhyaśca| (3.2.151) `tṛn' (3.2.135) iti tṛni prāpte yujvidhīyate| ihottare'pi pratyayo yatra viśeṣo na vivakṣyate, tatra tṛna evāpavādo veditavyaḥ| `roṣaṇaḥ'iti| `ruṣa roṣe' (dhā.pā.1670)|| 152. na yaḥ| (3.2.152) `pūrveṇa' iti| `anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' (3.2.149) ityādinā siddhatvāt| atha `aya vaya raya ṇaya gatau'(dhā.pā.474,475,482,480) ityasmāddhātoryuco vidhānārthañcaitatkasmānna vijñāyate ? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum;yasmānnayateḥ `anudāttetaśca' (3.2.149) ityādinaiva siddhatvāt| tasmāt pratiṣedhārthamidam| `knayitā, kṣmāyitā' iti| `knūyī śabda {undane ca-dhā.pā.} unde ca' (dhā.pā.485), `kṣmāyī vidhūnane' (dhā.pā.486)|| 153. sūdadīpadīkṣaśca| (3.2.153) `ṣūda kṣaraṇe' (dhā.pā.25), `dīpau dīptau' (dhā.pā.1150), `dīkṣa {mauṇḍyejyopanayananiyamavratādeśeṣu-dhā.pā} mauṇḍye' (dhā.pā.609)| `nanu ca' ityādi deśyam| `vā'sarūpeṇa' ityādi parihāraḥ| syādetat--vā'sarūpavidhirnāstīti jñāpitametat| tato nāsti yucprāptirityata āha-- `tācchīlika'ityādi| prāyikasya cāyameva liṅgam| yadi hi sarvatra vā'sarūpavidherabhāvaḥ syāt, tato viśeṣavihitenaiva pratyayena bādhitatvādeva yujna bhaviṣyīti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| `tathā ca' ityādinā tācchīlikapratyayena samāveśaṃ darśayan prāyikatvameva jñāpakasya draḍhayati| `kamrā'iti| `namikampi' (3.2.167) ityādinā rapratyayaḥ| `kamanā' iti| anudāttetaśca halādeḥ'(3.2.149) iti yucpratyayaḥ| `kamprā'iti| `kapi calane'(dhā.pā.275)| `sūdeḥ' ityādi codyam| `anityam' ityādi parihāraḥ| `yogavibhāgādavijñāyate' iti| anityatve sādhanaṃ `nayasūdadīpadīkṣa' ityekayoge karttavye yadyogavibhāgaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati-- pūrvasmāt pratiṣedhādasya kaścidviśeṣo'stīti| sa puvanarviśeṣo'nityatvameva| yadyapi dīpadīkṣatimyāmapi yuc prāpnoti, anabhidhānna bhavati|| 154. laṣapatapadasthābhūvṛṣahanakamagamaśṛbhya ukañ| (3.2.154) `{upasthāyukāḥ-kāśikā} upasthāyukaḥ' iti| `āto yuk' (7.3.33) ityādinā yuk| `{pravarṣukāḥ-kāśikā} pravarṣukaḥ'iti| `vṛṣu mṛṣu secane'(dhā.pā.706,707) iti. `kāmukāḥ'iti| `kamu kāntau'(dhā.pā.443)| `nodāttopadeśa'(7.3.34) ityādinā vṛddhipratiṣedhe prāpte'nācamerityatra `camikamivamīnāmiti vaktavyam' (vā.844) iti vṛddhireva bhavati| `{kiṃśārukaṃ-kāśikā} śārukaḥ'iti| `śṛ hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1488)| apapūrvāllaṣeḥ `apeai ca laṣaḥ'(3.2.144) iti dhinuṇ bhavati| uktaṃ hi prāk-- tācchīlikeṣu `glājisthaśca ksanuḥ' (3.2.139) iti vacanasāmarthyāt| gameśchandasi `ādṛgama'(3.2.171) ityādinā kikināvapi bhavataḥ|
