bhāṣāyāmapi;`bhāṣāyāṃ dhāñkṛñsṛjanigaminamibhyaḥ (vā.284) ityupasaṃkhyānāt| kameḥ `namikampi' (3.2.167) ityādinā rapratyayaḥ|| 155. jalpabhikṣakuṭṭaluṇ‍ṭavṛṅaḥ ṣākan| (3.2.155) `japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.397,398), `bhikṣa `yācñāyām' (dhā.pā.606) `kuṭṭa {chedanebhartsanayoḥ-dhā.pā.} cchedane' (dhā.pā.1558), `luṇṭa steye'(dhā.pā.1563)-- caudādikāvetau| `vṛṅa sambhavatau' (dhā.pā.1509)| jalperakarmakatvavivakṣayā `calanaśabdārthādakarmakādyuc' (3.2.148) iti yuci prāpte| bhikṣerapi `anudāttetaśca halādeḥ'(3.2.149) iti yucyeva| kuṭṭiluṇṭibhyāṃ `ṇeśchandasi'(3.2.137) itīṣṇuci| vṛṅo'pi `ādṛgamahana' (3.2.171) ityādinā kikinoḥ prāptayostadapavādaḥ ṣākan vidhīyate| `varākī'iti| ṣitvānṅīṣ|| 156. prajoriniḥ| (3.2.156) `jucaṃkramya' (3.2.150) ityādinā yuci prāpta inirvidhīyate| ikāro nakārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārthaḥ|| 157. jidṛkṣiśrīṇvamāvyathābhyamaparibhūprasūbhyaśca| (3.2.157) `ji jaye' (dhā.pā.561), `dṛṅa ādare' (dhā.pā.1411), `śriñ sevāyām'(dhā.pā.897) vipūrvaḥ, `iṇ gatau' (dhā.pā.1045), `ṭuvama udgiraṇe' (dhā.pā.849), `vyatha {bhayasañcalanayoḥ-dhā.pā.} bhayacalanayoḥra' (dhā.pā.764) nañpūrvaḥ, `ama roge'(dhā.pā.1720) abhipūrvaḥ| `ṣū preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1408) prapūrva ityasya grahaṇam, na `ṣūṅa prāṇigarbhavimocane'(dhā.pā.1031) `ṣūoṅa prāṇiprasave'(dhā.pā.1132) ityetayoḥ| niranubandhakaparibhāṣayeti (vyā.pa.53) bhāvaḥ| iṇjibhyāmityatra `iṇnaśjisarttibhyaḥ kvarap'(3.2.163) iti vacanāt kparap bhavati|| 158. spṛhigṛhipatidayinidrātandrāśraddhābhya āluc| (3.2.158) `curādāvadantāḥ paṭhyante' iti| tenāto lope kṛte `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau'(1.1.57) sthānivadbhāvādvṛddhiguṇau na bhavata ityābhiprāyaḥ| etebhyaśchandasi pūrvavadiṣṇuci prāpte drāterdadhāteśca kikinoḥ prāptayorālujvidhīyate| `spṛhayāluḥ'iti| `ayāmanta' (6.4.55) ityādinā ayādeśaḥ| `āluci' ityādi| śīṅa gṛhyate| yena tacchīṅagrahaṇaṃ tat punarvyākhyānamityetaduktaṃ bhavati| tadvyākhyānaṃ karttavyaṃ yenāluci vidhātavye śīṅo'pi grahaṇaṃ bhavati| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena śīṅapi prakṛtitvena guhyata iti|| 159. dādheṭsiśadasado ruḥ| (3.2.159) `ḍudāñ dāne' (dhā.pā.1091), `do avakhaṇḍane'(dhā.pā.1148), `deṅa rakṣaṇe'(dhā.pā.962)--trayāṇāmiha grahaṇam; `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) iti vacanāt| `dheṭ pāne'(dhā.pā.902), ṣiñ bandhane' (dhā.pā.1477), `śadlṛ śātane' (dhā.pā.1428), `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu' (dhā.pā.1427)| atha `dhārurvatso mātaram' iti kathamatra dvitīyā, yāvatā `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyamityata āha-- `na lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' iti| uko ya ukārastena sahākaḥ savarṇadīrghatvena praśliṣṭaḥ, tena tadantavidhau vijñāyamāne ukārāntasya pratyayasya prayoge ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati, tena dvitīyaiva bhavatīti na ṣaṣṭhī| nanviha tarhi-- kaṭaṃ cikīrṣuriti pratiṣedho na syāt, upratyaysayānukārāntatvāt| ghinuṇapi bavati| chandasyukārāntatvāt `ādṛgamahana' (3.2.171) ityādinā kikināvapi bhavataḥ|| 160. sṛghasyadaḥ kmarac| 3.2.160) 161. bhañjabhāsamido ghurac| (3.2.161) `{bhañja āmardane'(dhā.pā.1453), `bhāsṛ dīptau'(dhā.pā.624), `ñimidā {snehane-dhā .pā.} snehanamocanayoḥ'(dhā.pā.1243)| `bhaṅaguram'iti| `cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutvam| `karmakarttari pratyayaḥ' iti| bhajyate svayamevetyarthaḥ| kutaḥ punaḥ karmakarttari pratyo labhyata ityata āha--`svabhāvāt' iti| prakṛtyaiva pratyayaḥ karmakarttarimabhidhatte, na karttṛmātram| ataḥ karmakarttaryeva|| 162. vidibhidicchideḥ kurac| (3.2.162) `jñānārthasya vidergrahaṇam' iti| `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064) ityetasya| `na lābhārthasya' iti| `vidlṛ lābhe' (dhā.pā.1432) ityetasya | ajñānārthasya viderupalakṣaṇametat, tena sattāvicāraṇārthau yau vidī tayorapi grahaṇaṃ na bhavatyeva| kvacittvanayorādiśabdenopasaṃgrahāya lābhārthasyeti pāṭhaḥ| kasmāt punarjñānārthasya grahaṇamityāha-- `svabhāvāt' iti| viderutpannena pratyayena svabhāva eva jñānakriyāyā yaḥ karttā sa eva pratīyate, nānyaḥ| tasmājjñānārthasya grahaṇam, nānyasya| `karmakarttari pratyayaḥ'iti| svayameva cchidyata ityarthe| tatra svabhāvāditi pūrvokta eva hetuḥ|| 163. iṇnaśjisarttibhya kvarap| (3.2.163) `itvaraḥ' iti| `hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' (6.1.71)| `itvarī' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) ityādinā ṅīp|| 164. gatvaraśca| (3.2.164) 165. jāgarūkaḥ| (3.2.165) `jāgarūkaḥ' iti| `jāgṛ nidrākṣaye' (dhā.pā.1072)| vā'sarūpavidhinā tṛnnapi-- jāgariteti bhavati|| 166. yajajapadaśāṃ yaṅaḥ| (3.2.166) daṃśeryadi `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityādinā'nunāsikalopo lupte'pi yaṅi pratyayalakṣaṇena sidhyati, tathāpi lāghavārthaṃ kṛtānunāsikalopo draṣṭavyo nirdiṣṭaḥ| `yāyajūkaḥ' iti| yajeryaṅa, `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) iti dīrghaḥ, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ| `jañjapūkaḥ, dandaśūkaḥ' iti| `lupasada' (3.1.24) ityādinā yaṅa, `japajabha'(7.4.86) ityādinā'bhyāsasya nuk|| 167. namikampismyasakamahiṃsadīpo raḥ| (3.2.167) ṇama prahvatve śabde' (dhā.pā.981), `kapi calane' (dhā.pā.375), `ṣmiṅa īṣaddhasane' (dhā.pā.948), `kamu kāntau' (dhā.pā.443), `{tṛha-dhā.pā} tṛhi hisi hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1455,1456), `dīpī dīptau' (dhā.pā.1150)| kapeścalanārthatvāt kamidīpibhyañcānudā4ttettvādyuci prāpte ro vidhīyate| `kriyāsātatyam' iti| kriyamāṇānāmavicchedena pravṛttiḥ - kriyāsātatyam| tatra svabhāva eva pratyayānto varttate|| 168. sanāśaṃsabhikṣa uḥ| (3.2.168) `sanpratyayo gṛhyate' iti| `guptijkidbhyaḥ' (3.1.5) ityādinā yo vihitaḥ| `na sanirdhātuḥ'iti| `ṣaṇu dāne' (dhā.pā.1464) ` vana ṣaṇa sambhaktau' (dhā.pā.463,464) iti na gṛhyate| etacca gargādiṣu jigīṣuśabdapāṭhādvijñāyate, sa hi pratyayagrahaṇe copapadyate, na tu dhātugrahaṇe| `āṅa śāsi icchāyām'ityādi| etadapyāṅā saha nirdeśādvijñāyate| icchārtho hyāṅasahitaḥ paṭhyate, na stutyarthaḥ| `āśaṃsu, bhikṣuḥ' iti| atra `anudātteśca halādeḥ' (3.2.149) iti yuci prāpta upratyayasya vidhānam|| 169. vinduricchuḥ| (3.2.169) `videḥ' iti| `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064)| itareṣāṃ tvanabhidhānānnipātanasāmarthyādvā grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| `iṣeḥ' iti| `{iṣa-dhā.pā.} iṣu icchāyām' (dhā.pā.1351) ityetasya | `iṣa gatau' (dhā.pā.1127) ityādīnāṃ tviṣīṇāṃ pūrvavad‌grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| `icchuḥ' iti| chakārādeśo nipātyate| `che ca' (6.1.73) iti tuk, `stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti ścutvam|| 170. kyācchandasi| (3.2.170) `mitrayuḥ' iti| mitramicchatīti `supa ātmanaḥ kyac'(3.1.8) iti kyac| `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti, `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvañca, etadubhayamapi `na cchandasyaputrasya' (7.4.35) iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati| `saṃsvedayuḥ'iti| lohitāditvāt (3.1.13) kyaṣ| `sumnayuḥ' iti| `devasumnayoḥ' (7.4.38) iti pratiṣedhaḥ| sumna ivācaratīti `karttuḥ kyaṅa salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti kyaṅa|| 171. ādṛgamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ ca| (3.2.171) parapadārtheṣu prayujyamānāḥ śabdā vatimantareṇāpi vatyarthaṃ gamayanti, yathā-- gaurvāhīkaḥ, siṃho māṇavaka iti| gaurvāhīka ityukte go śabdo'rthāntare prayukto vināpi vatinā gaurivāyamiti tulyaśabdarūpe vāhīke pratīyate| iha liḍiti svārthādanyatra kikinoḥ prayuktaḥ| tasmādasatyapi vatinā yoge'tideśo gamyata ityāha-- `liḍ‌vacca tau bhavataḥ'iti| liṭā tulyau - tulyadharmāṇau bhavata ityarthaḥ| dvirvacanādikaṃ yalliṭaḥ kāryaṃ tat kikinorbhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kāryātideśo'yam, na śāstrātideśaḥ; kāryātideśāpekṣayā śāstrātideśasyāprādhānyāt| aprādhānyaṃ tu śāstrātideśasya kāryatvāt| yadi tarhi kāryātideśo'yam `laḥ parasmaipadam' (1.4.99) iti parasmaipadasaṃjñā'pi kikinoḥ prāpnoti, tataścātmanepadibhyastau na syātām ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; lādeśasya hi parasmaipadasaṃjñā, na lakārasya| `la' iti hyādeśāpekṣayā tatra ṣaṣṭhī, lādeśaḥ parasmaipadasaṃjñako bhavatīti yāvat| na ca kikinau lādeśau,tatkutaḥ parasmaipadasaṃjñāyāḥ prasaṅgaḥ| tibādayastarhi kasmānna bhavanti ? tayorvidhānasāmarthyāt | yadi tarhi tibādayaḥ syuḥ, kikinorvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt-- liṭameva vidadhyāditi, na ca tibādibhistacchīlādayo vidhīyante ? anabhidhānānna bhaviṣyanti| kvasukānacau kasmānna bhavataḥ, na ca tayorbhāva ānarthakyaṃ kikinorupapadyate; `liṭaḥ kānajvā' (3.2.106) `kvasuśca' (3.2.107) iti vikalpena kvasukānacorvidhānāt ? anabhidhānādeva tāvapi na bhaviṣyataḥ; na hi tābhyāṃ tacchīlādayo vidhīyante;ata evānabhidhānāt| `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) itibhāvakarmaṇorapi kikinau na bhavataḥ| yathaiva hi `bhañjabhāsamido ghurac' (3.2.161) iti bhañjerutpannena ca ghuracā svabhāvāt karmakarttaivābhidhīyate na karttṛmātram, tathā kikinbhyāmapi dhātorutpannābhyāṃ svabhāvādeva karttaivābhidhīyate, na bhāvakarmaṇī| `āditi dakāro mukhasukhārthaḥ'iti| taparatvanirāsārthametat| ata evāha-- ` na tvayaṃ taparaḥ' iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ taparo neṣyata ityāha-- `mā bhūt' ityādi| `taparastatkālasya' (1.1.70) iti tādapi para iti pañcamīsamāso'pyāśritaḥ| `vṛddhirādaic' (1.1.1) ityatra trimātracaturmātrayoraicāṃ vṛddhisaṃjñā mā bhūdityevamartham| tataśca yadyevaṃ taparaḥ syāt tadā ṛkāre'pi tapara eva syāt, tataśca ṛkāreṇa tatkālānāṃ mātrikāṇāmetad‌grahaṇaṃ syāt, na punardīrghāṇām| tatra ko doṣaḥ ? dadhiścakrirityevamādāveva syātām; taturiḥ, jagurirityevamādau ca na syātām| tasmāt mā bhūdityeva doṣa iti taparatvamatra neṣyate| `papiḥ somam' iti| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ, dvirvacanam, abhyāsasya hrasvaḥ| `na lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' (2.3.69) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ kāryaṃ iti somaśabdāt karmaṇi dvitīyaikavacanaṃ bhavati| `dadiḥ' iti| `ḍudāñ dāne' (dhā.pā.1091)| `tatuḥ' iti| `bahulaṃ chandasi'(7.1.103) ityuktam, raparatvañca| `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti sthānivadbhāvāt tṛśabdo dvirucyate| (dhā.pā.7.4.66) ityattvam,raparatvam, halādiśeṣaḥ (7.4.60)| `jaguriḥ' iti| `gṛ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410) `janmiḥ, jaghniḥ' iti| `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ| janernakārasya `sto ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti ścutvaṃ ñakāraḥ| `atha' ityādi codyam| `ṛcchatyṛtām' ityādinā parīhāraḥ| `utsargaśchandasi' ityādi| sāmānyena vidhānam - utsargaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- prakṛtiviśeṣamanupādāya dhātumātrāt kikinorutpādau draṣṭavyāviti| dhātumātrādvidhātavyāviti yāvat| kuto hetorityāha-- `sadādibhyo'pi darśanāt' iti| sadādibhyo'pi sūtrānupāttebhyaḥ kikinau yasmādutsargaḥ karttavyaḥ| `sediḥ,nemiḥ'iti| pūrvadettvābhyāsalopau| `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu' (dhā.pā.854), `ṇama prahvatve śabde' (dhā.pā.981), `ata ekahalmadhye'nādeśāderliṭi'(6.4.120) ityettvābhyāsalopau| `dadhiḥ, cakriḥ' iti| ghāñaḥ pūrvavadākāralopaḥ| `cakriḥ, sasriḥ' iti| karoteḥ sartteśca yaṇādeśaḥ| `jajñiḥ' iti| janeḥ pūrvaccutvopadhālopau| `nemiḥ'iti| pūrvavadattvābhyāsalopau| `sahivahi' ityādi| bhāṣāyāmapi varttate| `sāsahiḥ' ityādi| sahādibhyo yaṅa, dvirvacanam, pūrvavadakārayalopau|| 172. svapitṛṣornajiṅ| (3.2.172) `svapnaka, tṛṣṇak' iti| `ñiṣvapa śaye' (dhā.pā.1068), `ñitṛṣā pipāsāyām' (dhā.pā.1228), `coḥ kuḥ'(8.2.30) iti kutvam-- gakāraḥ| tasya `vā'vasāne' (8.4.58) iti cartvam-- kakāraḥ| najiṅo ṅakārastṛṣeśca guṇapratiṣedhārthaḥ, ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ|| 173. śṛvandyorāruḥ|(3.2.173) śṛṇoteḥ `laṣapata' (3.2.154) ityādinokañapi bhavati| vandateḥ `anudāttetaśca' (3.2.149) ityādinā yuci prāpte vacanamidam|| 174. bhiyaḥ kruklukanau| (3.2.174) `krukannapi vaktavyam' iti| krukannityaparaḥ pratyayo vācyaḥ, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `ādṛgamahana' (3.2.171) ityādeḥ sūtrāccakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena krukannapi bhaviṣyatīti|| 175. stheśabhāsapikasakaso varac| (3.2.175) `sthāvaraḥ'iti| `ekāca'(7.2.10) ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ|`īśvaraḥ' ityādāvapi `neḍ‌ vaśi kṛti' (7.2.8) iti| tiṣṭhateḥ pūrvasūtravihitau ksnūkañāvapi vacanādbhavataḥ| īśabhāsoḥ pūrvavadyuci prāpta idaṃ vacanam| 176. yaśca yaṅaḥ| (3.2.176) `yāyāvaraḥ' iti| pūrvavadakārayalopau|| 177. bhrājabhāsadhurvidyutojipṝjugrāvastuvaḥ kvip| (3.2.177) `{bhrājṛ- dhā.pā} bhrāja dīptau' (dhā.pā.181), `bhāsṛ dīptau' (624), `urvī turvī thurvī dhurvī hiṃsārthāḥ'(dhā.pā.569,570,571,573), `dyuta dīptau' (dhā.pā.741), `urja balaprāṇanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1549), `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1086), `ju'iti sautro dhātuḥ, `ṣṭuñ stutau' (dhā.pā.1043) grāvapūrvaḥ| `vibhrāṭ' iti| vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam| pūrvavajjaśtvaṃ cartvañca| `dhūḥ' iti| `rāllopaḥ' (6.4.21) iti vakāralopaḥ, `rvorupadhāyā dīrgha ikaḥ' (8.2.76) iti dīrghaḥ| `pūḥ'iti| `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuttvam, raparatvañca, pūrvavaddīrghatvam| `javaterdīrghaśca' iti| katham ? kecidāhuḥ-- sūtre `jū' iti dīrghaḥ paṭhitavya iti| apare tvāhuḥ- uttarasūtre dṛśyata ityubhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣaḥ, tacca vidhyantaropasaṃgrahārtham, atojavaterdīrgho vidhīyata iti| grāvāṇaṃ stautīti grāvastut|`hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' (6.1.71)| `kimarthamidam' ityādi dyodyam| `tācchīlikairbādhyate' iti parīhāraḥ| syādetat-- vā'sarūpavidhinā kvacidapi bhaviṣyatītyāha-- `vā'sarūpavidhiśca' iti| etattu `nindahiṃsa' (3.2.146) ityādau sūtra uktam| nanu ca `sūdadīpadīkṣaśca' (3.2.153) iti sūtre prāyikatvaṃ jñāpakasya pratipāditam, vā'sarūpavidhiścātra nāstītyāha-- `tasyaiva' iti| `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.75), `kvip ca' (3.2.76) ityādinā bhavati|| 178. anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate| (3.2.178) nanu cānyabhyo'pītyetāvataiva siddham, tatkimarthaṃ dṛśigrahaṇamityādi ? kvacidityādinā yeṣāmupasaṃgrahārthaṃ dṛśigrahaṇaṃ tāni vidhyantarāṇi darśayati| yasmāt vidhyantarāṇāmupasaṃgrahārthaṃ dṛśigrahaṇam,evañca kṛtvā vṛttikāraḥ `kvibvacipṛcchi'(vā.288) ityādikaṃ vākyaṃ paṭhati| dṛśigrahaṇopāttāni tānyeva vidhyantarāṇi darśayitumityabhiprāya-| kathaṃ punardṛśigrahaṇena vidhyantaropasaṃgrahaḥ ? dṛśigrahaṇe hi sati `yathā dṛśyante kvibantā dhātavastathaiva te'nugantavyāḥ' ityeṣo'rtho labhyate| tasmiṃścārthe labhyamāne dvirvacanādividhayaḥ saṃgṛhītā bhavanti| evaṃ hite yathā dṛśyante tathānugatā bhavanti| yadi yathāyogaṃ dvirvacanādayo vidhīyante, tadā kvibanteṣu kvaciddvirvacanaṃ dṛśyate, kvacidapi saṃprasāraṇamiti yuktamuktam-- `dṛśigrahaṇaṃ vidhyantaropasaṃgrahārtham' iti| `vāk' iti| vacervacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) prāptasya samprasāraṇasyābhāvaḥ kriyate| `śabdaprāṭ' iti| pṛccherapi grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇasya| vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam, pūrvavajjaśtvaṃ cartvañca| āyataṃ stautīti `āyatastūḥ' | `ṣṭuñ stutau' (dhā.pā.1043)| kaṭaṃ pravata iti `kaṭaprūḥ'| `pruṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.957)| `śrīḥ' iti| `śriñ sevāyām' (dhā.pā.897)| `didyut' iti| `jagat' iti| `gamaḥ kvau'(6.4.40) ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `dadṛt' iti| `urat'(7.4.66) ityattvam, raparatvam, halādiśeṣaḥ (7.4.60)|`dhīḥ'iti| `dhyai cintāyām' (dhā.pā.908) `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghaḥ|| 179. bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ| 3.2.179) `dhanikādhamarṇayoḥ' ityādi| dhaniko yasmai ṛṇaṃ dhāryate| adhamarṇo yo dhārayati| tadantare madhye yastiṣṭhatyātmapakṣapatitaḥ sampratyayahetuḥ sapratibhūśabdenocyate, na sarvaḥ| tena grāmayorantare yastiṣṭhati tatra pratyayo na vati| etacca śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāllabhyate, `dṛśyate' (3.2.178) ityasyānuvarttervā| asya hyanuvṛttau pratibhūriti saṃjñeyam, tat kimantaragrahaṇena, saṃjñāyāmityeva vaktavyam ? naitadasti; dravyatāvighātā hi saṃjñāśabdā bhavanti, na caivaṃ pratibhūśabdaḥ| tathāpi satyapi devadatte kadācidasau na pravarttata eva|| 180.viprasaṃbhyo ḍ‌vasaṃjñāyām| (3.2.180) `vibhuḥ' iti| pūrveṇa kvibeva bhavati| `mitadravādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' iti| āviśeṣeṇa-- saṃjñāyām, asaṃjñāyāñca| `mitadravādibhyaḥ'iti tādarthye caturthī| mitadravādayo ḍupratyayāntāḥ sādhavo yathā syurityevamarthaḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tacva pratipādanaṃ prakṛtatvāḍ‌ḍuśabdasya | tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) ityato'pi śabdo'trānuvarttate, tena mitadravādibyo ḍupratyayo dhātvantarādapi bhavati, padāntare ceti|| 181.dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran| (3.2.181) `dhayateḥ' iti| `dheṭ pāne' (dhā.pā.902)| `dadhāteḥ' iti| `ḍudhāñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1092)| `karmaṇi kārake' iti| etena karmaṇaḥ pratyayārthatāṃ darśayannupapadatvamapākaroti| yadi hi karmaṇa upapadatvaṃ syāt `karmaṇyaṇ'(3.2.1) ityasminneva prakaraṇe vidadhyāt| evaṃ hi dviḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati| nanu ca yadyapi dviḥ karmagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati| nanu ca yadyapi dviḥ karmaghaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, tadāpyuttarasūtreṇa ṣṭrangrahamaṃ karttavyaṃ jāyate ? jāyatāṃ nāma, laghīyo hi karmagrahaṇāt ṣṭrangrahaṇam| nanviha varttamāna ityanuvṛttervarttamānapratyayo bhavati, tatra tu kriyamāṇe naitallabhyate ? naitadasti;ihāpi kriyamāṇe naiva varttamāne pratyayo bhavati| na hi dhātrītyukte kāpyaviśeṣā pratīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? kriyākārakasambandhamātraviśiṣṭā strī pratīyate-- āmalakī ca dadhati tāṃ bhaiṣajyārthamiti kṛtvā| tasmāt `karmaṇi' iti pratyayārthaṃ eva, nopapadam|| 182. dāmnīśasayuyujastutudasisicamihapatadaśanahaḥ karaṇe| (3.2.182) `dāp lavane ' iti| yathā `dādhā ghvadāp'(1.1.20) iti sūtre `daip śodhane' (dhāpā.924) ityasyāpi grahaṇam| tarhīhāpi kasmānna bhavati ? anabhidhānāt| prakṛtyaiva hi dātramiti ṣṭranpratyayāntena lavanasya karaṇamucyate, na śodhanasya| `karaṇe kārake' iti| etena karaṇapratyayārthatāṃ darśayannupapadatvaṃ nirākaroti| yadyupapadatvamasyasyāt tadājādiṣu daṃṣṭrāśabdasya pāṭho nopapadyate| `yoktram' iti| `coḥ kuḥ'(8.2.30) iti kutvam| `meḍhram' iti| `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam, `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti ghatvam, `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti ṣṭutvam, `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13) `daṃṣṭrā'iti| ajāditvāṭṭāp| `daṃśeḥ'ityādi| nanu ca yathā `tyajaraja' (3.2.142) iti rañjeranunāsikanirdeśe dhinuṇpratyaye rāgītyanunāsikalopo bhavati, tathā daṃśeḥ ṣṭranpratyaye na lopo bhaviṣyati,tatkathamasya jñāpakatopapadyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyayaṃ nirdeśo daṃśeḥ ṣṭranpratyaye'nunāsikalopārthaḥ syāt, tadā daṃṣṭrāśabdasyājādipāṭho virudhyate| tasmājjñāpakārthatvam| `naddhrī'iti| `naho dhaḥ'(8.2.34) iti dhatvam, `jhaṣastathordho|dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti takārasya dhatvam, dhakārasya `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvam, `ṣid‌gaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ| ye'tra seṭo dhātavaḥ śasprabhṛtayasteṣāṃ hi `titutratatha' (7.2.9) ityādineṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ|| 183. halasūkarayoḥ puvaḥ| (3.2.183) `taccet karaṇaṃ halaśūkarayoravayavo bhavati' iti| etena halaśūkarayorityeṣā'vayavaṣaṣṭhī, natvabhidheyasaptamīti darśayati| `{mukhamucyate-- kāśikā, padamañjarī ca} mukhamevocyate' iti| nānyaḥ karṇādyavayavaḥ| etaccābhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyāt|| 184. arttilūdhūsūkhanasahacara itraḥ| (3.2.184) `dhū vidhūnane' (dhā.pā.1398), `ṣū preraṇe' (1408) ityanayorgrahaṇam| `dhūñ kampane' (dhā.pā.1487) ` {ṣūṅa-dhā.pā.} ṣūñ prāṇigarbhavimocane' (dhā.pā.1031) `ṣūṅa prāṇiprasave' (dhā.pā.1132) ityeteṣāṃ `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti paribhāṣayā grahaṇaṃ na bhavati|| 185. puvaḥ saṃjñāyām| (3.2.185) `barhiṣpavitram' iti| pavateḥ, punātervā| anena pavitraṃ barhiṣā kṛtam| barhiṣpavitram - kuśavikāraḥ| pradeśinyā aṅgulerveṣṭanamucyate| 186. karttari carṣidevatayoḥ| (3.2.186) 187. ñītaḥ ktaḥ| (3.2.187) `minna' iti| `āditaśca' (7.2.16) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `radābhyām' (8.2.42) iti natvam| evaṃ `kṣviṇṇaḥ' ityātrāpi| `aṭkupvāṅa'(8.4.2) ityādinā ṇatvam| `dhṛṣṭaḥ' iti| `dhupiśasī vaiyātye' (7.2.19) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti ṣṭutvam|| 188. matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca| (3.2.188) `mataḥ' iti| `mana jñāne' (dhā.pā.1176)| iṭpratiṣedhaḥ `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityādinā, `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ| `iṣṭaḥ' iti| `{iṣa--dhā.pā.} iṣu icchāyām'(dhā.pā.1351)| `udito vā' (7.2.56) iti vibhāṣitatvānniṣṭhāyāṃ `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `buddhaḥ' iti| `budha avagamane' (dhā.pā.858)| pūrvavaddhatvam, takārasya jaśtvam,dhakārasya dakāraḥ| `pūjitaḥ, arcitaḥ' iti| `{bhvādau nopalabhyate;curāditvenaiva prasiddhaḥ|} pūja pūjāyām' (dhā.pā.1642);`arca pūjāyām' (dhā.pā.204) bhvādī| etau cāradī ca, tatra yadā curādibhyāṃ pratyayastadā `niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' (6.4.52) iti ṇilopaḥ| `śīlitaḥ' ityādau `śīla samādhau'(dhā.pā.658) `kṣamuṣ sahane' (dhā.pā.442),`kruśa {āhvāne rodane ca- dhā.pā}āhvāne' (dhā.pā.856), `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ (dhā.pā.1288),` ruṣa roṣe' (dhā.pā.1670), `hṛñ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899), `hṛṣa tuṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1229), `hṛṣu alīke' (dhā.pā.709),`tuṣa {prītau-dhā.pā.} tuṣṭau (dhā.pā.1184), `kamu kāntau' (dhā.pā.443), `yama uparame' (dhā.pā.984), `kaṣa hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.685), `mṛṅa prāṇatyāge' (dhā.pā.1403)-- ityeteṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ yathākrameṇaitāni rūpāṇi| tatrādyau seṭau| yaścātra kaścidudidūdicca, tasya niṣṭhāyāṃ `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ| yastvīdit tasyāpi `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām' (7.2.14) itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ| hṛṣereva `hṛṣerlomasu' (7.2.29) ityādinā `ruṣyamatvarasaṃghuṣāsvanām' (7.2.28) iti vibhāṣiteṭ| `{nāsti-kāśikā} kāntaḥ, kṣāntaḥ' iti| `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) iti dīrghaḥ| `ākruṣṭaḥ' iti| vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam| `saṃyataḥ' iti| pūrvavadanunāsikalopaḥ| `amṛtaḥ' iti| gatyarthādīnāṃ karttari ktaḥ| `pūrvavat' (iti)| yathā śīlādiṣu varttamāne niṣṭhā tathā'mṛtaśabdasyāpītyarthaḥ| `suptaḥ'iti| svapeḥ samprasāraṇam| `śayitaḥ' iti| `niṣṭhā śīṅa' (1.2.19) ityādinā kittvapratiṣedhād‌guṇaḥ| `āśitaḥ' iti| `aśa bhojane' (dhā.pā.1523) āṅapūrvaḥ, `lipa upadehe' (dhā.pā.1433), `tṛpa prīṇane' (dhā.pā.1195)| atra aśiśīṅau seṭau; śeṣāstvaniṭaḥ| `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ| yadyapi śīlādayo varttamānakāle vyutpādyante, tathāpi śīlito devadattena, rakṣito devadattena ākruṣṭo devadattenetyatra `ktasya ca varttamāne' (2.3.67) iti ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati| yathā na bhavati tathā tatraiva pratipāditam|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhapādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ| <3.3> atha tṛtīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ 1.uṇādayo bahulam| (3.3.1) `varttamāna ityeva' iti| `varttamāna laṭ' (3.2.123) ityato varttamānagrahaṇamanuvarttata iti darśayati| `saṃjñāyām' iti| varttata iti `puvaḥ saṃjñāyām' (3.2.185) ityataḥ| bāhulakam' ityādi| `lā ādāne' (dhā.pā.1058), bahunarthāllāghīti bahulam| `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) bahavaḥ punararthāḥ kvacitpravṛttyādayaḥ| tathā coktam-- kvacitpravṛttiḥ kvacidapravṛttiḥ kvacidvibhāṣā kvacidanyadeva| vidhervidhānaṃ bahudhā samīkṣya caturvidhaṃ bāhulakaṃ vadanti|| iti| bahulasya bhāvo bāhulakam| `dvandvamanojñādibhyaśca' (5.1.133) iti manojñāditvādvṛñ| bahvarthādānaṃ bahulaśabdas pravṛttinimittamiti tatraivāyaṃ bhāvapratyayaḥ| tad‌bāhulakaṃ prakṛtestanudṛṣṭeruktam| pratyayamanādiṃ kṛtvā yaḥ pūrvamupādīyate śabdaḥ sā prakṛtirityucyate| pratyayāt pūrvaṃ kriyata iti prakṛtiḥ| prakarṣeṇa niyamena pratyayaḥ kriyate tasyā iti vā prakṛtiḥ| `prakṛteḥ'iti| jātau ṣaṣṭhyekavacanam| `tanudṛṣṭeḥ' iti| karmaṇi lyablope pañcamī| tanudṛṣṭiṃ vīkṣya bāhulakamuktamiti| `vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām' (2.3.25) ityanena tviha pañcamī na bhavati; astriyāmiti pratiṣedhāt| atha vā `vibhāṣā guṇe' iti yogavibhāgādiha pañcamī veditavyā| tanuśabdaḥ śarīravacano'pyasti, guṇavacano'pi ; iti tu guṇavacanaḥ, prakṛteralpatvaṃ nāma yoguṇastasya vācakaḥ| darśanaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ - upalabdhiḥ, tanorguṇasya dṛṣṭistanudṛṣṭiḥ| tato guṇo nityaṃ guṇinamapekṣata iti gamakatvāt tanuśabdasya prakṛtimapekṣamāṇasyāpi dṛṣṭiśabdena samāso bhavati| ayaṃ tvarthaḥ-- prakṛterguṇasya, tayordarśanāditi| atha vā tanurdṛṣṭiryasyāḥ prakṛteḥ sā tanudṛṣṭiḥ| atra pakṣe yadyapi tanuguṇo dṛṣṭerviśeṣaṇam, tathāpyasau dṛṣṭeḥ prakṛterapi viśeṣaṇatvena pratīyata eva| prakṛtestanutvādeva hi tad‌dṛṣṭitanutvaṃ bhavati| uṇādiṣu pañcapādyāṃ svalpāḥ prakṛtayo dṛśyante, tato'nyābhyo'pi ca prakṛtibhyaḥ pratyayā dṛśyante, tasmādbahulagrahaṇādbhavanti| yathā hi `hṛṣerulac' (paṃ.u.1.98) iti `hṛṣu alīke' (dhā.pā.709) ityasmādulajuktaḥ, tathā `śaki śaṅkāyām' (dhā.pā.86) ityato'pi bhavati-- śaṅkuleti| kiñca, prāyasamuccayanādapi teṣāṃ taduktamiti sambandhaḥ| taditi bāhulakaṃ parāmṛśyate| teṣāmuṇādīnāṃ prāyeṇa bāhulyena samuccayanaṃ grahaṇaṃ vidhānaṃ nā prāyasamuccayanam| `tṛtīyā' (2.1.30) iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ| apiśabdaḥ samuccayate| na kevalaṃ prakṛtestanudṛṣṭestad‌bāhulakamuktam, api tu prāyasamuccayanādapi teṣāmetaduktaṃ bhavati| na kevalaṃ prakṛtastanvyaḥ paṭhitāḥ, api tu pratyayā api prāyeṇasamuccitāḥ, na sarve, tadarthaṃ bāhulakamiti| bāhulakādvayavahitā api te cet pratyayā unnīya vidhīyante| tathā hi `artteḥ kyurucca'(paṃ.u.5.17) ityartidhātuḥ paṭhitaḥ,phiḍaphiḍḍau tu pratyayau na vihitau tathāpi ṝphiḍaṛphiḍḍaśabdayordarśanāt tāvapi ca vidhīyete| `kāryasaśeṣavadheśca taduktam' iti| caśabdaḥ samuccaye| pūrvoktakāraṇadvayādetasmāt tadbāhulakamuktam| vidhānaṃ vidhiḥ - kāraṇam, saha śeṣeṇa varttate yo vidhiḥ sa saśeṣaḥ, saśeṣaścāsau vidhiśca saśeṣavidhiḥra, kāryānāṃ saśeṣidhiḥ kāryasaśeṣavidhiḥ| katasmācca bāhulakamuktam| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- prakṛteḥ pratyayāśritāni kāryāṇi na niḥśeṣāṇi pañcapādyāṃ darśitāni, iṣyante cādarśitānyapi tāni| atastatsiddhyarthaṃ tad‌bāhulakamuktam| tena ṝphiḍa, ṛphiḍ‌ḍa-- ityatra guṇapratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati| evamādi tāvat pratyayāśritaṃ kāryaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| `ṣaṇu dāne' (dhā.pā.1464), `ñamantāḍḍaḥ' (paṃ.u.1.113) iti ṣaṇḍaḥ| atra `dhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ' (6.1.64) iti satvaṃ na bhavati| satyapi vā satve punaḥ ṣatvameva kriyata ityevamādi prakṛtyāśritamapi kāryaṃ bāhulakādbhavati| `naigamarūḍhañibhavaṃ hi susādhu' iti| nigamaḥ - chandaḥ, tatra bhavā naigamāḥ, ṛgayanādipāṭhādaṇ| nigamasya veme naigamāḥ| rūḍhiḥ - prasiddhiḥ; bhavantīti bhavāḥ, rūḍhau bavāḥ| `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ| lokaprasiddhā ityarthaḥ| naigamāśca rūḍhibhavāśca naigamarūḍhibhavam| `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣaikavadbhavati' (vyā.pa.91) ityekavadbhāvaḥ, `sa napuṃsakam' (2.4.17) iti napuṃsakaliṅgatā| hiśabdo yasmadārthe| yasmādetadeva bāhulakamanekārthasya sādhakam, tasmānnaigamaṃ rūḍhibhavaṃ suṣṭhu sādhu bhavati; vyākaraṇe bahulagrahaṇena saṃskṛtatvāt| anyathā'saṃskṛsatvād‌gāvyādiśabdānāmiva tasyāsādhutvaṃ syāt| anyairapi pramāṇapuruṣairnaigamarūḍhibhavānāṃ vyutpādyatvamabhyupetamiti darśayitumāha-- `nāma ca dhātujam' ityādi| `nirukte' iti| nirukte śāstre| `nāma' iti| prātipadikam| tasya hīyamanyācāryasaṃjñā| dhātorjātatvāddhātujam| dhātugrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam, pratyayāgamādayo'pi gṛhyante| niruktakāraḥ svaśāstre nirukte prātipadikaṃ dhātujamāha; dhātupratyayakādivibhāgena vyutpāditatvāt| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe, bhinnakramaśca| dhātujamevetyevaṃ draṣṭavyam| śakaṭasya putraḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ so'pi nāma dhātujamevāha| tadevaṃ niruktakāraśākaṭāyanadarśanena trayī śabdānāṃ pravṛttiḥ-- jātiśabdāḥ, guṇaśabdāḥ, kriyāśabdā iti;na santi yadṛcchāśabdā iti| atha vā-- jātiguṇaśabdānāmapi kriyāśabdatvameva; dhātujatvāt| tataścaikaiva śabdānāṃ pravṛttiḥ-- kriyā śabdā iti| atha yadi prakṛtiviśeṣaṃ pratyayaviśeṣañcopādāyana vyutpāditaṃ śabdarūpam, tasya kathaṃ dhātujatvaṃ veditavyam, na hi prakṛtipratyayānavadhāraṇe dhātujatvaṃ śakyaṃ niścetumityata āha-- `yanna' ityādi| arthaśabdaḥ prayojanavācī, paramarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya prakṛtyādeḥ sa padārthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ padamarthaḥ prakṛtyāderbhavati ? taduddiśya tadupādānāt| padaṃ hi vyutpādayiṣyāmītyevamarthaṃ prakṛtyāderupādānām| kasmāt ? prakṛtipratyayaśca padārthaḥ, tasya viśeṣaḥ padārthaviśeṣaḥ| samutthānaṃ samutthaḥ - prādurbhāvaḥ;`supi sthaḥ' (3.2.4) ityatra yogavibhāgena bhāva eva kapratyayaḥ| padārthaviśeṣāt samutthaḥ prādurbhāvo yasya tat `padārthaviśeṣasamuttham'| yadevaṃvidhaṃ na bhavati śabdarūpaṃ pratyataḥ prakṛtitataśca tadūhyam| dhātujatvenāpi taduktaṃ bhavati-- yasya pratipadoktā prakṛtipratyayaviśeṣānāsāditātmā nirvṛttistasya prakṛtiviśeṣāt pratyayaviśeṣācca dhātujatvaṃ niścetavyamiti| nanu ca tathāvidhasya prakṛtipratyayaviśeṣasyāparijñānādevāśakyaṃ dhātujatvaṃ niścetumiti matvā pareṇa coditam, tatkathaṃ pratyayataḥ prakṛteśca tadūhyamityuktaṃ yujyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;evaṃ hi bruvatā'nena prakṛtipratyayāvevaṃ tāvaddhyūhitavyau,tatastābhyāṃ tacchabdarūpamityetadapyarthāduktaṃ bhavati| na hyanavadhāritābhyāṃ prakṛtipratyayābhyāṃ śakyaṃ dhātujatvaṃ kasyacinniścetumiti kimatrāyuktam ? yatra prasiddhapratyayāvayavena śabdāntareṇa kasyācidbhāgasya sārūpyādhigamo'sti tatra pratyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā pariśiṣṭo bhāgaḥ prakṛtitvenotprekṣitavyaḥ| yathā-- `uṣikuṣigarttibhyasthan' (paṃ.u.2.4) iti thanpratyayāntamoṣṭhādikaṃ prasiddhapratyayāvayavam| tena ca ḍitthavitthaśabdayoḥ kiñcit sārūpyamasti,tataiṣāmiva hi teṣāṃ thaśabdo'vayavo viśiṣṭadeśavarttī vidyate| tatra thanpratyānte śabdarūpe yo dṛṣṭasthaśabdaḥ pratyayasaṃjñakastatsādṛśyāt ḍitthaḍavitthaśabdasthaṃ thaśabdaṃ pratyayamavadhārya tataḥ pariśiṣṭastayorbhāgo ḍiḍḍaviditi ca dhātutvenohyaḥ| tataścaivaṃ sūtraṃ karttavyam-- ḍīṅasthaṇ ḍiḍḍavicceti| `ḍīṅa vihāsā gatau' (dhā.pā.1135) ityasmāt thanpratyayaḥ, ḍīṅaśca ḍiḍḍavidityetāvādeśau bhavataḥ| yatra tu śabdarūpe nirjñātadhātvavayavena śabdāntareṇa kiñcidbhāgagataṃ sārūpyamasti, tatra prakṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā pariśiṣṭo bhāgaḥ pratyayatvenohitavyaḥ, yathā-- ṛtamiti dṛṣṭaṃ śabdarūpa prasiddhaprakṛtyavayavam, tena ṛphiḍaśabdasya ṛphiḍḍaśabdasya ca kiñcidabhāgagataṃ sārūpyamasti, ubhayeṣāṃ teṣāmukārāditvāt| tatra niṣṭhāpratyayānta ṛtaśabde ya ṛkārāvayavo dhātusaṃjñakastatsādṛśyādṛphiḍaṛphiḍḍaśabdasthañca ṛvarṇaṃ dhātumavadhārya tataḥ pariśiṣṭastayorbhāgaḥ phiḍa iti phiḍḍa iti ca pratyayatvenohyaḥ| tataścaivaṃ sūtraṃ karttavyam-- `artteḥ phiḍaphiḍḍau' iti, `ṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098) ityasmāt phiḍaphiḍḍau pratyayau bhavataḥ| ṛphiḍaḥ, ṛphiḍḍaḥ| guṇaḥ pūrvoktāt kāraṇānna bhavati| atha vā-- kitāvevaitau pratyayau vidhātavyau| evaṃ prakṛtipratyayādūhitvā tasya śabdarūpasya dhātujatvamūhitavyam| yat prakṛtipratyayaviśeṣāvayavānugataṃ na taddhātujatvaṃ vyabhicarati, yathā-- karttavyaṃ karaṇīyamityevamādayaḥ śabdāḥ| `ūhyam' iti| anujñāvyam| na yatra kvacidūhaḥ karttavyaḥ,api tu viśiṣṭa eva viṣaya iti darśayannāha-- `saṃjñāsu' ityādi| ya ete nirūḍhāḥ sādhutveva śabdarūpāsteṣveva saṃjñāta) sūhaḥ karttavyo, nānyatra| `dhāturūpāṇi'iti| kalpayitavyānīti śeṣaḥ| `pratyayāśca tataḥ pare' iti| kalpayitavyā ti śeṣaḥ| `kāryāt' guṇābhāvadikāt| `vidyāt'jānīyāt| `anubandhaṃ' kakārādikam| etadanantaroktaṃ `śāstramuṇādiṣu'| śāstropanibandhanatvācchāstraviṣayatvādvā śāstramityuktam| yadi tarhyatra sūtre `saṃjñāyām' (3.2.185) ityanuvarttate `varttamāne'(3.2.123) iti ca, bahulagrahaṇaṃ ca kriyate, tat kimarthamuṇādiṣu `varttamāne pṛṣadvṛhajjagacchatṛvacca' (da.u.6.5) iti varttamānagrahaṇam ? `dhṛṣerdhiṣa ca saṃjñāyām'(da.u.5.27) iti saṃjñāgrahaṇam, `bahulamanyatrāpi' (da.u.5.23) iti bahulagrahaṇañca kriyate ? `bhūte'pi dṛśante' (3.3.2) iti vacanādbhūte'pi pṛṣadādayo bhavantītyāśaṅkānivṛttyartham| varttamānagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtāyā eva saṃjñāyā anuvṛtterdṛḍhīkaraṇārtham| punaḥ saṃjñākaraṇaṃ bahulavacanādasaṃjñāyāmapi bhavantītyāśaṅkānivṛttyarthaṃ vā| asyaiva bahulasya smaraṇārthaṃ punarbahulagrahaṇam| evaṃ hi vismaraṇaśīlānāmanugrahaḥ kṛto bhavati|| 2.bhūte'pi dṛśyante| (3.3.2) `pūrvatra varttamānāt'iti| atha pūrvatra varttamānagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna nivarttitam, yuktaṃ hi tat tatra nivarttiyitum, tathā hi-- tasmiṃstatra nivṛtte satīdaṃ na karttavyam ? naitadasti;avaśyamaitat karttavyam,yasmāt kecidbhūta eveṣyante| yadica pūrvatra varttamānagrahaṇānuvṛttirna syāt,bhaviṣyatyapyuṇādayo na syuḥ| `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' (3.3.3) ityekaṃ tu niyamārthaṃ vijñāyeta-- bhaviṣyatyeva gamyādayaiti| tasmāt pūrvatrānuvarttayitavyaṃ varttamānagrahaṇam| `vartma' iti| `āto manim'(3.2.74) ityanuvarttamāne `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti maninpratyayaḥ|`neḍ vaśi kṛti' (7.2.8) itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ| `bhasma' iti| `bhasa bhartsanadīptyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1100)| `dṛśigrahaṇam' ityādi| viśiṣṭaprayogamanusṛtya yatra śiṣṭāḥ prayujyate tatra bhūte pratyayaḥ karttavyaḥ,na tu sarvatreti dṛśigrahaṇenāyamarthaḥ pratipādita iti darśayati|| 3.bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ| (3.3.3) `pratyayasyaiva' ityādi| idaṃ hi bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ sādhavo bhavanti,yadi pratyayasyaiva bhaviṣyatkālatā vidhīyate, atha tu pratyayasyānyakālatā syānna te bhaviṣyati sādhavaḥ syuḥ|tasmāt pratyayasyaivānena prakāreṇa bhaviṣyatkālatā vidhīyate| `grāmaṃ gamī' iti| `gameriniḥ' (da.u.6.57) itīnipratyayaḥ,`sau'(6.4.13) iti dīrghaḥ| `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' (2.3.70) iti ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ grāmaśabdāt `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.32)| `āgāmī' iti| `gameriniḥ'(da.u.6.57) iti varttamāne `āṅi ṇit' (da.u.6.58)itīniḥ; ṇittvādupadhāvṛddhiḥ| `prasthāyī'ityādi| `ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau' (dhā.pā.928) `budha bodhane' (dhā.pā.1172), `yuja samādhau' (dhā.pā.1177) `yā prāpaṇe' (dhā.pā.1949) --ebyaḥ `supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye'(3.2.78) iti ṇiniḥ|yātitiṣṭhatyoḥ `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk| yujaḥ `cajoḥ kughiṇ‌ṇyatoḥ'(76.3.52) iti kutvam| `bhāvī' iti| `āṅi ṇit' (paṃ.u.4.7) iti varttamāne `bhuvaśca' (paṃ.u.4.8) itīniḥ, ṇittvādvṛddhiḥ| `anadyatana upasaṃkhyānam' iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na sidhyati ? bhaviṣyatīti lṛṭāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate, tena ca lṛṭa eva viṣaye bhaviṣyatsāmānye syāt, na bhaviṣyadanadyatane,tato luṭo na viṣayaḥ, lṛṭā bādhitatvāt| tasmādanadyatana upasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya ceha pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- bahulagrahaṇamihānuvarttate,tenānadyatane'pi bhaviṣyatīti| ete ca gamyādayo luṅlṛṭorubhayorapi bādhakāḥ, apabādatvāt|apavādatvaṃ tu yenanāprāptinyāyena (vyā.pa.49) nanu ca vāsarūpavidhinā luṅlṛṭāvapi prāpnutaḥ, tadvidhau `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' ityanuvṛtteḥ ? satyam; asyāmapyanuvṛttau pakṣe eveti cet ? naitadasti;evaṃ hyanuvṛttirapārthikā syāt|| 4. yāvatpurinipātayorlaṭ| (3.3.4) `yāvadbhūṅkte' iti| `bhujo'navane' (1.3.66) ityatmanepadam| `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) tyakāralopaḥ| `yāvaddāsyati tāvadbhokṣyate' iti| yatparimāṇamsaya, tat parimāṇamasyeti `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup' (5.2.39) `dṛgdṛśavatuṣu' (6.3.89) ityanuvarttamāne `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) ityāttvam| `purā vrajiṣyati'iti| `pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1489)| `bhrājabhāsa' (3.2.177) ityādinā kvip, `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuttvam, karaṇe tṛtīyaikavacanam| nanu cāvyutpannāveva yāvatpurāśabdau nipātau, to ca vyutpāditau, to ca vyutpāditau, tatra lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayaiva (vyā.pa.3) tayornipātayorgrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, tatkimarthaṃ nipātagrahaṇam ? mandabuddhīnāṃ pratipattigauravaparihārthamityeke| asyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārthamityapare| anityatvajñāpanasya tu prayojanamuttaratra vakṣyate|| 5. vibhāṣā kadākahyoḥ| (3.3.5) `kadā bhoktā' iti| luṭ| nanu ca bhaviṣyatītyanuvṛtterlṛṭa eva viṣaye bhavitavyam, na luṭaḥ| tato lṛḍeva pakṣe yukta udāhartum, tatkathaṃ luḍapyudāhṛtaḥ ? evaṃ manyate-- `anadyatane luṭ' (3.3.15) ityatra `vibhāṣā kadākarhyoḥ' ityasyānuvṛtterlṛṭo viṣaye vibhāṣā luṭā bhavitavyamiti| `karhi bhokṣyate' iti| lṛṭ| nanu ca karhiśabdaḥ `anadyatane rhilanyatarasyām'(5.3.21) ityanadyatane vyutpāditaḥ, tadasau yatra prayujyate tatarānadyatana iva kālaḥ sambhavati, tatkuto lṛṭaḥ prāptiḥ, `anadyatane luṭ'(3.3.15) iti luṭaiva pakṣe bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; yasmādbhokṣyata ityetat padaṃ bhaviṣyatkāla eva varttate| anadyatanakālāvagatistu karhiśabdasannidhāne sati vākyādbhavati| na ca vākyagamye'rthe lṛḍbhavati| tathā hi padamiha saṃskriyate, na ca padasaṃskāre vākyagamyo'rtha upayujyate| tasmādbhaviṣyatsāmānye vivakṣite lṛḍbhavati, bhaviṣyati viśeṣe'pyanadyatane vivakṣite luḍiti|| 6. kiṃvṛtte lipsāyāma| (3.3.6) `kimo vṛttam' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥkimo vṛttamityāha-- `vṛttagrahaṇena ' ityādi| tadityanena kiṃśabdaḥ sambadhyate-- kimetacchabdarūpaṃ vibhaktyantaṃ vṛttagrahaṇena pratīyāt| ḍataraḍatamau ca `kiṃyattadaurnirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac'(5.3.92)|`vā bahūnāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac' (5.3.93) ityetau pratyayau kiṃśabdasambandhināveva vṛttagrahaṇena pratīyāt| ptyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā ceha ḍataraḍatamāntaṃ pratīyādityeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ| `parisaṃkhyānam ' iti| niyama ityarthaḥ| tena kiṃtarām, kiṃgauḥ, kiṃpuruṣaḥ-- ityavamādiṣu padeṣu na bhavati; teṣāṃ kiṃvṛttatvasya parigaṇanena nirastatvāt| `bhojayanti' iti| hetumaṇṇayantāllaṭ| `bhojayitāraḥ' iti| `luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ' (2.4.85) iti jhe rasādeśaḥ, `ri ca' (7.4.51) iti sakāralopaḥ| `labdhukāmaḥ pṛcchati' iti| udāharaṇeṣu lipsāyā gamyamānatvāt|| 7. lipsyamānasiddhau ca| (3.3.7) lipsāyāmeva satyāṃ sambhavati, nāsatyām| ato yatra lipsyamānasiddhirgamyate tatrāvaśyaṃ lipsayā bhavitavyam, tathā ca pūrveṇaiva siddham, tatkimartho'yamārambha ityata āha-- `akiṃvṛttārtho'yamārambhaḥ'iti| yadyevam, pūrvasūtra eva kiṃvṛttagrahaṇamakṛtvā pratyayo videyaḥ, evaṃ hīdaṃ nārabdhavyaṃ bhavati ? naitadasti; eṃ hi yathā lipsyamānasiddhau gamyamānāyāṃ kiṃdṛttaṃ cākiṃvṛttaṃ ca bhavati tathā yatrāpi lipsyamānasiddhirahitaṃ lipsyamānaṃ gamyaṃ tatrāpi syāt| kiṃvṛtta eva tat tatreṣyate, tasmāt pūrvayoge kiṃvṛttagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| tasmiṃśca satīdamapyakiṃvṛttārothamārabdhavyam| `dātāraṃ protsāhayati' iti| bhaktadānaviṣaye'sya protsāhaṃ janayatītyarthaḥ|| 8. loḍarthalakṣaṇe ca| (3.3.8) `praiṣādi'iti ādiśabdena vidhinimantraṇāmantraṇādhīṣṭādayo gamyante| `āgacchati' iti| `iṣugamiyamāṃ chaḥ' (7.3.77) iti cchatvam| `adhyayanapraiṣasya'iti| adhyayanaviṣayaḥ praiṣo'dhyayanapraiṣaḥ, śākapārthivāditvāduttarapadalopī samāsaḥ| `atha tvaṃ chando'dhīṣva ' iti| atra `praiṣātisargaprāptakāleṣu kṛtyāśca' (3.3.163) iti loṭ| sa ca praiṣo'dhyayanaviṣayaḥ| tasyopādhyāyagamanaṃ hyapekṣyādhyayane praiṣatetyasyopādhyāyāgamanasyapraiṣaṃ prati nimittabhāvaḥ|| 9. liṅ cordhvamauhūrtike| (3.3.9) `nipātanāt samāsaḥ' ityādi| ūrdhvamauhūrtikaśabdasyoccāraṇeva nipātanam| ūrdhvaṃ muhūrttāditi vigṛhyāsmādeva nipātanāt samāsaḥ| tataḥ `bahvaco'ntodāttāt' (4.3.67) iti ṭhañ, tata uttadarapadavṛddhiḥ, sā hyata eva nipātanāt| bhaviṣyataḥ prakṛtatvāt tasyaivordhvamauhūrttikagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `bhaviṣyataścaitat' ityādi| ūrdhvamauhūrttikaśabdaścāyaṃ varttamānasya pratyāsanne vartate| ūrdhvamauhūrttike varttamānasamīpa ityarthaḥ| `āgacchet' iti| yāsuṭ, `ato yeyaḥ' (7.2.80) itīyādeśaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)`lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yakārasya lopaḥ,salopo'nantyasya' (7.2.79) iti sakārasya|| 10. tumun‌ṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām| (3.3.10) `bhikṣiṣya ityasya jaṭāḥ' iti| lṛṭ, anudāttettvādātmanepadam,uttamapuruṣaikavacanam, iṭ, ṭerettvam, `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam| atrāsti bhikṣikriyārthamupapadaṃ jaṭāśabdaḥ, na tu jaṭāśabdaḥ kriyāvacanaḥ; jaṭānāṃ dravyatvāt| `dhāvataste patiṣyati daṇḍaḥ'iti| `dhāv gatiśuddhayoḥ'(dhā.pā.601), laṭ, tasya śatrādeśaḥ, ṣaṣṭhyekavacanam| atha vā `sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.935)ityasya prāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) dhāvādeśaḥ| astyatra dhāvatikriyopapadam, na tu kriyārthaḥ| arthaśabdo hyayaṃ prayojanavacanaḥ, yacca yaduddiśya pravarttate tattasya prayojanaṃ bhavati, na cāsau daṇḍapatanamuddiśya dhāvati, kiṃ tarhi ? kāryāntarārtham| `atha' ityādi codyam| `sāmānyena vihita eva'iti| bhaviṣyatyanyatra ca kāle kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade'nyatra cāviśeṣeṇa vidhānāt| `lṛṭā' ityādi parihāraḥ| `lṛṭa śeṣe ca' (3.3.13) iti lṛṭaṃ vakṣyati, tena viśeṣavihitena lṛṭā bādhyate, tanmā bhūtattasya bādheti punariha vidhīyate| atha tumun kriyārthopapadena bādhyata ityetat ksamānnoktam ? bhinnārthatvāt| na hi bhinnārthayorbādhyabādhakabhāvo bhavati, bhinnārtho ca ṇvultumunau| tathā hi-- karttari ṇvul, tumun punarbhāve| kathaṃ jñāyate ? `tumarthe sesen' (3.4.9) ityatra tumarthagrahaṇāt| yadi tumun `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) ityato vacanāt karttari syāt,tataḥ sesenprabhṛtayo'pi tatraiva bhaviṣyantīti tumarthagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, kṛtavāṃśca, tatastumarthagrahaṇādavasīyate-- tumun karttari na bhavati| na cānyārtho nirddiśyate, tatra `anirddiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti' (pu.pa.90) iti bhāva eva tumun bhavatīti vijñāyate| yaduktam-- lṛṭā kriyārthopapadena bādhyata iti,tadvighaṭayitumāha-- `vāsarūpavidhinā'ityādi| `evaṃ tarhi' ityādi| etena jñāpakārthatāṃ ṇvulvidhānasyācaṣṭe| yadi hi kriyāyāmupapade kriyārthāyāṃ vāsarūpeṇa tṛjādayaḥ syurṇvulapi tṛjarthābhidhāyitvādvāsarūpavidhinā bhaviṣyantīti punariha tanna vidadhyāt, vihitavāṃśca;tatastena ṇvulvidhānenāsmin viṣaye vāsarūpeṇa tṛjādayo na bhavantītyeṣo'rtho vijñāpyate| `tena' ityādinā jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `karttā' iti| tṛc| `vikṣipaḥ' iti| `igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ'(3.1.135)| tumuno nakāra ādyudāttārthaḥ, ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| ṇvulo lakāro liti pratyayāt pūrvasyodāttārthaḥ, ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ|| 11. bhāvavacanāśca| (3.3.11) `bhāvavacanāḥ' iti| bruvantīti vacanāḥ, bahulacanāt karttari lyuṭ| bhāvasya vacanā bhāvavacanāḥ| bhāvavacanatvaṃ punasteṣāṃ bhāvādhikāre vidhānāditi darśayitumāha--`bhāve iti prakṛtya'ityādi| prakṛtya adhikṛtyetyarthaḥ| `ghañādayaḥ'iti| ādiśabdenājabādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `kimartham' ityādi codyam| `kriyārthopapade vihitena' ityādi parihāraḥ| syādetat-- vāsarūpavidhinā te bhaviṣyanti| ata āha-- `vāsarūpavidhiśca nāstītyuktam' iti| etacca pūrvasūtra uktam| `atha ' ityādi| bhāva ityetāvadvaktavyam; evaṃ hyucyamāne satīdameva ghañādīnāṃ vidhāyakaṃ syāt,tataśca te dhātumātrādaviśedhema prasajyeran; viśedhānupādānāt| vacanagrahaṇādayamartho labhyate-- bhāve ye vihitāḥ pratyayāste tathā bhavanti yathā bhāvasya vācakā bhavantīti| yathā ca te bhāvasya vācakā bhavanti tathā praśnapūrvakaṃ darśayitumāha--`kathañca' ityādinā| `nāmasāmañjasyena' iti| na vyatirekeṇa,nāniyamenetyarthaḥ| tatra kecidāhuḥ- vacanagrahaṇādyaireva vidhivākyairbhāva eṣāṃ vidhānaṃ taireva kriyāyāmupapade kriyārthāyāṃ bhavanti, evañcate vācakā bhavanti, nānyatheti| anye tvāhuḥ-- etadeva sūtraṃ vidhāyakam; vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyāt| anenāpi tathaiṣāṃ vidhānaṃ bhavati yathā svairvidhivākyaiḥ| yadi bhāve hi tadvidhiḥ, nānyasminnapi viṣaye bhaviṣyati| tat tasmāt punarvidhīyata iti|| 12. aṇ karmaṇi ca| (3.3.12) `karmaṇyaṇ' ityādi| `tumunṇvulau' (3.3.10) ityādisūtre jñāpitametat-- vāsarūpavidhiriha nāstīti| tena yadyapi viśeṣaṇeṇāṇ vihitaḥ, tathāpi vāsarūpavidherabhāvāt kriyārthopapada na ṇvulā bādhitaḥ,tasmāt punarvidhīyate| `sopa'pavādatvāṇṇavulaṃ bādhate' iti| nāprāpte ṇvulītarasyārabdhatvāt, viśeṣavihitatvācca| `kādīn' iti| bādhata iti sambandhaḥ| ādiśabdena ṭagādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `tenāpavādaviṣaye'pi bhavati' iti| apavādāḥ sāmānyavihitasyāṇaḥ kādayaḥ, tadviṣaye'pi bhavati| `aṇ karmaṇi ca' (3.2.12) ityasyā'nākārāntakriyopapado'vakāśa-- kāṇṭalāvo vrajatīti, `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) ityasyākārāntaḥ kriyopapado'vakāśaḥ --goda iti; iha hyubhayaṃ prāpnoti-- godāyo vrajatīti, paratvādaṇ bhavati| tathā `gapoṣṭak'(3.2.8) ityasyāvakāśaḥ--surāpaḥ,śīdhupaḥ,aṇaḥ sa eva;ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--surāpāyo vrajati, śīdhupāyo vrajatīti|| 13. lṛṭ śeṣe ca| (3.3.13) `cakārāt' ityādi| etena kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmityasyānukarṣaṇārthaścakāra iti darśayati| `kariṣyāmi' iti| `ṛddhanoḥ sye' (7.2.70) itīṭ|| 14. lṛṭaḥ sadvā| (3.3.14) `satsaṃjñau' iti| `tau sat' (3.2.127) itisaṃjñāvihitatvācchatṛśānacau satsaṃjñakau| kathaṃ punarlṛṭaḥ śatṛśānacau bhavata ityāha-- `aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe' ityādi| prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe vikalpena yathā laṭaḥ śatṛśānacau,tathā lṛṭo'pi vyavasthitavibhāṣayā satsaṃjñakau bhavataḥ| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇādiṣu nityaṃ bhavataḥ-- kariṣyantaṃ paśya, kariṣyamāṇaṃ paśya, he kariṣyan, he kariṣyamāṇa, arjayiṣyan vasati, kariṣyadbhaktiḥ, kariṣyamāṇabhaktiḥ, kariṣyadrūpaḥ,kariṣyamāṇarūpa ityaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe| prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe tu vikalpaḥ-- kariṣyati devadattaḥ kariṣyan devadattaḥ; kariṣyate devadattaḥ, kariṣyamāṇo devadatta iti| lṛḍiti varttamāne punarlṛḍ‌grahaṇaṃ sthāninirdeśārtham; itarathā hi pratyayāntaratvaṃ satsaṃjñakayorvijñāyeta| lṛṇmātrasya yathā syādityevamarthaṃ vā| tena yo'nadyatane lṛṭ tasyāpi bhavataḥ-- śvo'gnīnādhāsyamāneneti| `abhijñāvacane lṛṭ' (3.2.112) ityasya na bhavataḥ; bhaviṣyatītyadhikārāt, asya ca bhaviṣyatkālavihitatvāt| anadyatane punarlṛḍuttarasūtre'nadyatana itiyogavibhāgādbhavatīti veditavyam| lṛṭaṣṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ, ṛkāraḥ `syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ' (3.1.33) ityatra viśeṣārthaḥ|| 15. anadyatane luṭ| (3.3.15) `anadyatana iti bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ' iti| adya bhāvo nāsyāsminnityanadyatanaḥ| `tena' ityādinā bahuvrīhisamāsāśrayaṇasya phalaṃ darśayati| etacca `anadyatane laṅ'(3.2.111) ityatra vyākhyātaprāyamiti tata evādavagantavyam| `adya śvo vā gamiṣyati' iti| adya śvaśca gamiṣyatītyarthaḥ| `paridevane' ityādi| bhaviṣyadanadyatane luḍukto bhaviṣyatsāmānye na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca, etadarthamidamucyate| paridevanam - anuśocanam| `śvastanī' iti. luṭa iyamanyācāryasaṃjñā| `vaktavyā' iti| vyākhyeyā| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `lṛṭ śeṣe ca' (3.3.13) ityataścakāro'nuvanarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tataḥ paridevane śvastanī bhaviṣyatyarthe bhaviṣyatīti| anyastvayaṃ nu kadā gantetyādāvanadyatana eva kāle luḍiti darśayannāha-- padamanvākhyāne vyākaraṇe ca, tacca padaṃ gantetyādikamanadyatana eva varttate| tasya yadā'nadyatane bhaviṣyatsāmānye vā vṛttiḥ sārthāt prakaraṇādvā bhavatīti vākyārmatho'vatiṣṭhate| na ca vākyārthaḥ padasaṃskārasya nimittam, kiṃ tarhi ? padārthaḥ| tasmādanadyatane luḍityeṣa siddhamiti| anena tu nyāyena paridevane śvastanītyādi samyagetat| luṭo'pi ṭakāraṣṭeretvārthaḥ; ukāraḥ `luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ' (2.4.85) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ|| 16. padarujaviśaspṛśo ghañ| (3.3.16) paderṇvṛltṛcorapavādo ghañ vidhīyate, rujiviśibhyāmigupadhalakṣaṇasya kasya, spṛśeśca pacādyacaḥ| `pādaḥ' iti| `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ| yadyevam, padamiti na siddhyati ? na tu khalu na siddhyati, `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam (6.1.158)iti nipātanāt| `spṛśa upatāpe iti vaktavyam'iti| upatāpaḥ - rogaḥ, tatra spṛśerghañbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `lṛṭaḥ sadvā' (3.3.14) ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena spṛśerupāta eva karttari bhavati, nānyatreti| `svare viśeṣaḥ' iti| aci hi satyantodāttatvaṃ bhavati, ghañi tu padasyādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| ghaño ñakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ, ādyudāttārthaśca| ghakāraḥ `cajoḥ kughiṇṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutvārthaḥ|| 17. sṛ sthire| (3.3.17) `sartterdhātoḥ' iti| `sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.935) ityasmāddhātoḥ| `sthire karttari' iti| etena sthiragrahaṇaṃ pratyayārthasya kartturviśeṣaṇaṃ na tūpapadamiti darśayati|`ghañpratyayo bhavati' iti| tṛjādyapavādaḥ| kaḥ punarayaṃ sthiro nāmetyāha-- `sthira iti kālāntarasthāyī' ityādi| tatraivopapattimāha-- `sa ciram' ityādi| sartterdhātorgatirarthaḥ| sa ca kālāntarasthāyina eva karttuḥ sambhavati, nātmalābhasamanantaranāśinaḥ| tasmāt kālāntarasthāyyeva gaterdhātvarthasya karttā yujyata ityeveha sthiraśabdenocyate| yadi kālāntarasthāyina eva gatiḥ sambhavati sthiragrahaṇamanarthakam, na hyasthiraḥ sarttyarthas karttopapadyate ? nānarthakam; prakarṣeṇa yaḥ sarati tatra karttari pratyayo yathā syādityevamarthatvāt| ata eva sa ciraṃ tiṣṭhan kālāntaraṃ saratīti vṛttau ciragrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| `candasāraḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `vyādhimatsyabaleṣviti vaktavyam' iti| asthirārtho'yamārambhaḥ| eṣu vyādhyādiṣu triṣvipi ghañ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi cakārānuvṛttimāśritya karttavyam| `atīsāraḥ' iti| `upasargasya ghañyamanuṣye bahulam' (6.3.122) iti dīrghatvam|| 18. bhāve| (3.3.18) `rāgaḥ' iti| `rañjeśca' (6.4.26) `ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' (6.4.27)ityanunāsikalopaḥ| nanu ca `bhāve' iti bhavatināyaṃ ghañantena nirdeśaḥ kriyata iti bhavativiṣaya eva pratyayārthanirddeśaḥ kṛto bhavati, tataśca bhavateryo bhāvastasminneva vācye pratyayaḥ syāt, sa ca bhavaterevotpadyamānena pratyayena śakyo'bhidhātum, atastata eva pratyayena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ pākastyāgo rāga iti pacyādibhyo bhavati ? ata āha-- `kriyāsāmānyavācī' ityādi| kriyāsāmānyaṃ hi sarva dhātvarthānugataṃ bhavaterarthaḥ| tena kriyāsāmānyavācinā'rthanirdeśaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ sarvadhātuviṣayaḥ kṛto bhavati, ataḥ pacyādibhyo'pi pratyayo bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu dhātvarthaḥ pūrvāparībhūto'pariniṣpannaḥ, tato yadi tatra vācye pratyayo bhavati tasyāsattvabhūtatvālliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ pratyayārthasya sambandho na siddhyati, tata āha-- `dhātvarthaśca' ityādi| evakāraḥ pratyayavyavacchedārthaḥ| dhātunaivocyate dhātvarthaḥ, na tu pratyayena| kathaṃ tarhi ghañādayo vidhīyanta ityata āha-- `yastasya' ityādi| tasya dhātvarthasya siddhatā niṣpanntā nāma yo dharmastatra ghañādayaḥ pratyayā vidhīyante, tato yuktaḥ pratyayārthasya liṅgasaṃkhyāyogaḥ| tasya yo dharmastasya sattvabhūtatvādityarthaḥ| bhāva iti-- ihi puṃlliṅgenāyaṃ nirddeśa ekavacanenana ca| tena puṃlliṅga eva bāve ekavacana eva pratyayāḥ syuḥ| na liṅgāntarayukte nāpi vacanāntare| evañca sati `striyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) ityatra `bhāve' `striyām'iti caitayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyate, vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ hi syāt| tataḥ striyāṃ bhāve ktinpratyayo na syāt, arthāntara eva karmādau syāt| bhāve ca puṃlliṅge pākau pākā ityatraikavacanaṃ syāt| yathājātīyakaṃ hyarthamupādātuṃ samartho bhāvaśabdastathājātīyake'rthe pratyayena yuktaṃ bhavituṃ nānyatretyata āha-- `puṃlliṅgamekavacanaṃ cātra na tantram' iti| sarvaliṅgasaṃkhyāsambandhayogyaṃ pratātipadikārthasāmānyanimittaṃ pratyayanimittatvenopādīyate, tadeva pradhānam, na liṅgaṃ nāpi vacanam| tatra prātipadikārthasāmānyaṃ vinā liṅgavacanābhyāṃ na śakyaṃ nirddeṣṭumiti nāntarīyakatvāt tayorupādānam| pratīte tu tasmin prātipadikārthasāmānyacaritārthatvālliṅgavacane liṅgāntare ca pratyayā bhavantyeva| `paktiḥ' iti| bhāve `striyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) | `pakvam' iti| `nupaṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114)| `pacanam' iti| `lyuṭ ca' (3.3.115) iti lyuṭ| atrāpi yadi bhāve pulliṅgastantraṃ syāt, tato bhāvanapuṃsakaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattervaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ syāt, tataśca bhāve napuṃsake lyuṇna syāt, arthāntara eva tu syāt| bhāve ca puṃlliṅge pacanamityasya tulyatvāccodyaparihārasyopanyāsaḥ, anyathā hyanyadeva bhāvagrahaṇamadhikṛtya lyuṭo vidhānādadamihānupanyasanīyameva syāt| `pākau' ityādikaṃ vacanāntare bhāvapratyayasyodāharaṇam|| 19. akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām| (3.3.19) `prāsaḥ'iti| `asu kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209), `prasevaḥ' iti| `ṣivṛ tantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1108), ubhayatrāpyatra karmaṇi ghañ| `āhāraḥ' iti| `hṛñ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899)| `madhurāhāraḥ' iti| karmadhārayaḥ, ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo vā| `meṣaḥ' iti| `miṣa sparddhāyām' (dhā.pā.1352), pacādyac| `karttavyaḥ' iti| karmaṇi tavyaḥ| `cakāraḥ saṃjñāvyabhicārārthaḥ' iti| cakāro'yaṃ bhinnakramaḥ saṃjñāyāmityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, tadanena cārtha dyotyate| `saṃjñāyāñca'iti cārthaṃ dyotayannasau saṃjñāvyabhicārāya bhavati, tenāsaṃjñāyāmapi ca bhavati yadyevam, saṃjñāgrahaṇamakṛtvā sāmānyenaiva pratyayo vidheyaḥ; tatrāpyayamarthaḥ-- saṃjñāvyabhicārārthaścakāro na karttavyo bhavati ? satyametat ; tathāpi bāhulyena saṃjñāyāṃ bhavati; asaṃjñāyāṃ tu kvacidevetyamumarthaṃ sūcayituṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| dīyata iti `dāyaḥ' karmaṇi ghañ, pūrvavad yuk| `lābhaḥ' iti karmaṇyeva ghañ| `kārakagrahaṇam' ityādi| paryudāse hi `akarttari' ityukte kārakagrahaṇamanteraṇāpi nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) kartturanyatra tādṛśe kāraka eva karmādau pratītirbhavati, yathā-- abrāhmaṇa iti brāhmaṇasadṛśe kṣatriyādau| tasmāt paryudāse vināpi kārakagrahaṇena kārakaeva pratyayo labhyataita kārakagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam| prasajyapratiṣedhe tu karttavyam, tatra hi kriyāpratiṣedhamātraṃ pratīyate, na sadṛśaṃ vastvantaram| tatra yadi `akarttari saṃjñāyām' ityetāvaducyeta, karttari na bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyeta| evañca vidhāyakasya vākyāntarasyābhāvāt karmādiṣu pratyayo na syāt| kva tarhi syāt ? `anirddiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti (puṃ.pa.90) iti svārthe| nanu ca vihitaḥ svārthe pūrveṇeva ? naitadasti;`dhātvarthasya hi siddhatā nāma yo dharmastatra ghañādayo vidhīyante' ityuktam| tasmāt prasajyapratiṣedhe kārakagrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? ityata āha-- paryudāse kārakagrahaṇamantareṇāpi sidhyati, sa evāśrayiṣyate, tatkimarthamaṃ kārakagrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? ityata āha-- `tatkriyate' ityādi| yadi tarhi paryudāsa evaiṣa nañsamāsaḥ syāt, kārakagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, vināpi hi tena kāraka eva pratyayo labhyate; prasajyapratiṣedhe tu sati kārakagrahaṇamarthavadbhavati, na hi tatra vināpi tena kārake pratyayo labhyate| ivañcānantarameva pratipādanam| tasmāt kārakagrahaṇena prasajyapratiṣedhe'pi samāso'stīti jñāpyate| tena `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityatra prasajyapratiṣedhe samāso labhyate, tataśca yaduktam--`anaimittikamāttvaṃ śiti pratiṣedhaḥ' iti, tadupapannaṃ bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra prasajyapratiṣedha āśrīyate ? prāgeva pratyayotpatteranimittaka āttve kṛte suglaḥ sumla iti `ātaścopasarge' (3.1.136) iti ko yathā syāt| paryudāse tu tatrāśrīyamāṇe śito'nyatra tṛjādau pratyaye parabhūta āttvena bhavitavyam, tataśca glāyatiprabhṛtibhya ākārāntalakṣamaḥ pratyayo na syāt| nanu cācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati-- bhavantyejantebhya ākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyaya iti, yadayaṃ kabādhanārthaṃ `hvāvāmaśca' (3.2.2) ityaṇaṃ śāsti, tasmādaśitīti paryudāse'pyāśrīyamāṇe jñāpakādejantasyākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ pratyayaḥ sidhyatyeva ? naitadasti; karmopapadaviṣayamevaitajjñāpakaṃ vijñāyate| tasmādaśitītyatra prasajyapratiṣedha evāśrayituṃ yuktaḥ| tasya cāstitvamiha kārakagrahaṇena jñāpyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ prasajyapratiṣedho na sidhyati, yatastadastitvajñāpanaṃ pratipannaṃ kriyate ? asāmarthyaṃ kāraṇam; sāmarthye hi sati samāsena bhavitavyam,na ca tat prasajyapratiṣedhe| tathā hi tatar nañ kriyayā sambaddhaḥ, nottarapadena|| 20. parimāṇākhyāyāṃ sarvebhyaḥ| (3.3.20) `ekastaṇḍulaniścāyaḥ'iti| `grahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' (3.3.58) ityapi prāpte dhañ| `dvau śūrpaniṣpāvau' iti| atrāpi `ṛdorap' (3.3.57) ityapi prāpte| `idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya' (8.3.41) iti visarjanīyas ṣatvam| `dvau kārau'iti| `kṛ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1409)| nanu ca dvau śūrpaniṣpāvāvityatra `nirabhyoḥ pūlvoḥ' (3.3.28) ityanena ghañ siddhaḥ, tatkimarthamidamihoktam ? evaṃ manyate -- anyārte sarvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe parimāṇākhyāyāṃ vā'nyatraiva siddham, niṣpūrvādapi hyappratyayo yuktaḥ, `nirabhyoḥ pūlvoḥ' (3.3.28) ityasya tu yatra parimāṇākhyā na gamyate so'vakāśa iti| kaḥ punastena vānena vā ghañi sati viśeṣaḥ ? ko nyāyo vākhyayate ? na kaścit| nanu ca dhātoriti sāmānyamadhikṛtam, na dhātuviśeṣa iti| antareṇāpi sarvagrahaṇaṃ dhātumātrāddhañ bhaviṣyati tatkimarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇamityāha-- `sarvagrahaṇam' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasati sarvagrahaṇe'po bādhā na sidhyatītyāha-- `purastāt' ityādi| `purastādapavādā anantarān vidhīn bādhante nottarān' (vyā.pa.9) iti| sati sarvagrahaṇe ghañamanantaramacameva bādheta, nāpam| sarvagrahaṇe tu satyapamapi bādhate| tasmādapo'pi bādhā yathā syāditi sarvagrahaṇam| na ca parimāṇaśabdo'yaṃ prasthādiṣu rūḍho na saṃkhyāyām, tatkathaṃ parimāṇākhyāyaṃ pratyayo vidhāyamāna ekastaṇḍulaniścāya ityādau gamyamānāyāṃ bhavatītyata āha-- `ākhyāgrahaṇam' ityādi| ākhyāgrahaṇamiha rūḍhernirāsastyāgo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kṛtam| tena rūḍhau tyaktāyāṃ saṃkhyāpi gṛhyate| ākhyāgrahaṇasāmarthyāddhi parimāṇam, ato yuktaṃ tasyāpi grahaṇam| yadi sarvagrahaṇāt paramapyayaṃ ghañ bādhate, sthīpratyayānapi bādhetetyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| ata evāha--`strīpratyayāstu na bādhyante' iti| kṛtaḥ punarayamartho labhyate ? `sarvebhyaḥ'iti pañcamyantena nirddaśāt| pañcamyantanirddeśe hi sarvaśabdo dhātusamānādhikaraṇo vijñāyate| tena prakṛtyāśrayasyāpavādasya sarvagrahaṇādbādhā bhavati, nārthāśrayasya| yadi tvarthāśrayo'pyapavādo bādhitumiṣṭaḥ syāt, tadā sarvasminniti sarvaśabdaṃ saptamyantamuccārayet| `ekā tilocchritiḥ'iti| śriña utpūrvāt `striyāṃ ktin‌' (3.3.94), `stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti cutvam, `śaścho'ṭi' (8.4.63) iti cchatvam| `dārajārau' ityādi| dārajāraśabdau nipātyete| kimatra nipātyate ? `dṛ vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1493) `jṛṣ vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1130) ābhyāṃ hetumaṇṇyantābhyāṃ karttari tṛjādiṣu ghañi ṇiluk| nanu ca `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilope hi sati `janījṛṣknasurañjo'mantāśca' (dhā.pā.817) iti mitsaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ṇilope kṛte'pi pratyayalakṣaṇena jīryatermitāṃ hrasvatvaṃ prasajyate| astu tarhi mitāṃ hrasvatvam, punarghañāśrayā vṛddhirbhaviṣyatīti cet ? ayuktametat; na hi ghañāśrayā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāve sati ṇicā vyavahitatvāt| luki tu sati tasyāparanimittatvādasati sthānivadbhāve ghañamāśritya vṛddhirbhavati| na ca pratyayalakṣaṇena hrasvatvaṃ prasajyate; `na lumatāṅgasyaṭa (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt| tasmāllugvaktavyaḥ|| 21. iṅaśca| (3.3.21) `aco'pavādaḥ' iti| `erac' (3.3.56) iti prāptosyottarasyāpīvarṇāntādghañ vidhīyamāno'ca evāpavādo veditavyaḥ| `adhyāyaḥ' iti| karmaṇi ghañ| `tadantācca vā ṅīṣ' iti| yo'yamapādāne ghañ tadantānṅīṣ pratipādyaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `voto guṇavacanāt' (4.1.44) ityatra veti yogavibhāghaḥ karttavyaḥ, tenāpādāne striyāmiṅo yo ghañ vihitastadantānṅīṣ bhaviṣyatīti| yadā ca puṃyogo na vivakṣyate tadā ṅīṣ pratipādyaḥ| yadā tūpādhyāyasya strīti puṃyogo vivakṣyate tadā `puṃyogādākhyāyām' (4.1.48) ityeva ṅīṣ siddhaḥ| upetyādhīyate'syā upādhyāyī| `śṛ vāyuvarṇanivṛteṣu' iti| `śṛ hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1488) - asmādvāyvādiṣu vācyeṣu ghañ pratipādyaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu tameva cakāramanuktasamuccayārtham, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti bahulagrahaṇaṃ vā''śritya karttavyam| nivṛttam - nivāraṇam| śītādiduḥkhopaśamaheturnivāraṇamucyate| `akṛtanīśāraḥ' iti| akṛtaśītanivāraṇa ityarthaḥ| pūrvavadupasargasya dīrghatvam|| 22. upasarge ruvaḥ| (3.3.22) `apo'pavādaḥ' iti| `ṛdorap' (3.3.57) iti prāptasya| uttarasūtreṇāpyuvarṇāntāddhañ vidhīyamāno'pa evāpavādo veditavyaḥ|| 23.sami yudruduvaḥ| (3.3.23) 24. śriṇībhuvo'nupasarge| (3.3.24) `anupasargebhyaḥ'iti| avidyamāna upasarga eṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ `anupasargebhyaḥ' iti pañcamyantena vivaraṇaṃ kurvan sūtre'nupasarga iti subvyatyayena eṣā saptamīti darśayati| `kathaṃ prabhāvo rājñaḥ' iti| anupasargavacanādiha praśabda upasarga upapade na bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `{kathaṃ ca--kāśikā} kathaṃ nayo rājñaḥ' iti| anupasargādghañātra bhavitavyamiti manyate|| 25. vau kṣuśruvaḥ| (3.3.25) `vikṣāvaḥ'iti| `ṭukṣu śabde' (dhā.pā.1036)|| 26. avodorniyaḥ| (3.3.26) `unnāyaḥ' iti| `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) iti vā'nunāsikaḥ| `kathamunnayaḥ padārthānām' iti| ucchabdopapadatvāddhañātra bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ|| 27. pre drustumruvaḥ.(3.3.27) 28. nirabhyoḥ pūlvoḥ| (3.3.28) `sāmānyena grahaṇam' iti| viśeṣānupādānāt | `yathāsaṃkhyamupasargasambandhaḥ' iti| nisopasargeṇa puvaḥ sambandhaḥ, abhinā lūñaḥ| nanu ca pūñ‌pūṅlūñastrayo dhātavaḥ, upasargau dvau, ato vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyena na bhavitavyam ? pūrūpamutsṛṣṭānubandhasāmānyamekameva, tato nāsti vaiṣamyamityadoṣaḥ|| 29. unnyorgraḥ| (3.3.29) `ṝdorap'(3.3.57) itiprāptasyāyamapavādaḥ| uttaratrāpi ṝkārāntāddhañ vidhīyamāno'pa evāpavādo veditavyaḥ| `dvayorapi grahaṇam' iti| viśeṣānupādānāt|| 30. kṛ dhānye| (3.3.30) dhānyamiha prakṛtyartho vā syāt ? pratyayārtho vā syāt ? prakṛtyarthastāvannopapadyate;dhānyasya dravyatvāt dhātośca kriyāvācitvāt| pratyayārthastūpapadyate dhānyam;kintu pratyayenābihitatvādutkāro dhānyasyeti dhānyaśabdasya prayogo na prāpnoti| athāpi prayogaḥ syāt ? evamapi pratyayarthe'ntarbhūtatvāt ṣaṣṭhī nopapadyate-- utkāro dhānyasyeti| sāmānādhikaraṇyameva pratyayāntena syāt, evaṃ hi pratyayartho bhavati yadi pratyayāntena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati, yathā-- dṛtihariḥ paśuriti| tasmānnedaṃ pratyayārthaḥ,nāpi prakṛtyarthaḥ, api tu prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇamiti hiṃsārthasya' iti| `kṛ hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1496) ityasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha-- `anabhidhānāt' iti| śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādutkāraśabdābhyāṃ dhānyaviṣayo vikṣepa evābhidhīyate, na hiṃsā| yasya cārthaḥ pratyayāntenābhidhīyate tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam, netarasya| `utkāro dhānyasya' iti| vikṣepo dānyasyetyarthaḥ|| 31. yajñe sami stuvaḥ| (3.3.31) `sametya stuvanti yasmin deśe' ityādinā saṃstāvaśabdasyādhikaraṇasādhanatvaṃ darśayati|| 32. pre stro'yajñe| (3.3.32) `barhiṣprastaraḥ'iti| `idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya' (8.3.41 ) visarjanīyasya ṣatvam|| 33. prathane vāvaśabde| (3.3.33) `tṛṇavistaraḥ' iti| tṛṇācchādanamityarthaḥ|| 34. chandonāmni ca| (3.3.34) chandaḥśabdo'yamastyeva mantrabrāhmaṇe, astyanyadakṣarāṇāmittāviśiṣṭavṛtte yasya gāyatryādayo viśeṣāḥ| tadiha katarastadartho gṛhyate ? ityāha-- `vṛttam' ityādi| atraivopapattimāha-- `nāmagrahaṇāt' iti| yadyatra mantrabrāhmaṇamiṣṭaṃ syānnāmagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt, chandasītyeva brūyāt| evamapi hyucyamāne mantrabrāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ labhyata eva, yathā-- `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.39) ityādau vākye| tasmannāmagrahaṇāv‌vṛttamiha cchando gṛhyate| `viṣṭārapaṅktiḥ' iti| `chandonāmni ca' (8.3.94) iti ṣatvam| viṣṭāraśabda evātra ghañantaśchandonāmeti kasyacid‌bhrāntiḥ syāt, tannirākaraṇāyāha-- `viṣṭārapaṅktiśabdo'tra' ityādi| tatra - viṣṭārapaṅktiśabde | `avayavatvena varttate'iti| ghañantaṃ śabdarūpamiti sambandhanīyama| yadi ghañantaṃ śabdarūpaṃ na cchandonāma, kintu viṣṭārapaṅktiśabdaḥ, tatra ghañantarūpamavayatvena varttate, evaṃ tarhi `chandotatkathamunnīyate ? asya hi chandonāmni gamyamāna ityeṣo'rthaḥ,pratyayāntaṃ chandonāma bhavatīti yāvat| evañcārtha evaṃ sati nopapadyata ityāha-- `chandonāmnītyadhikaṇasaptamyeṣā'iti| etena cchandonāmni pratyayāntasyādhikaraṇabhūte pratyayayo bhavatītyayamatrārtho veditavyaḥ,na cchandonāmni gamyamāna ityeṣa iti darśayati|| 35. udi grahaḥ| (3.3.35) `apo'pavādaḥ' iti| `grahavṛdṛniścigamaśca' (3.3.58) iti prāptasya| `{chandasi vipūrvādapīṣyatesrugudyamananipātanayoḥ'ityeva vārttikapāṭho mudrito dṛśyate|} chandasi tu'ityādi| yajñapātraviśeṣo yenāhutirdīyate tatsrugucyate, tasyodyamanam - ūrdhvalanayanam, nipātanam - dhastānnayanam,etayorarthayorgraheśchandasi viṣaye ghañiṣyate| sa ca `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'(3.3.113) iti labhyata iti veditavyam| `nigrābham' iti| hṛgrahorbhaśchandasyupasaṃkhyānāddhakārasya bhakāraḥ|| 36. sami muṣṭau| (3.3.36) graheḥ kriyāvācitvāt muṣṭeścākriyātmakatvāt tatra graherna sambhavati, tasmānmuṣṭigrahe yo'rthastasya viṣayo vijñāyata ityāha-- muṣṭiviṣayaścedvātvartho bhavati' iti| astyevāyaṃ muṣṭiśabdaḥ parimāṇe--śākasya muṣṭiriti, astyaṅgulīnāṃ racanāviśeṣe, yathā-- hanti muṣṭineti,tatar yadīha parimāṇavṛttergrahaṇaṃ syādasya sūtrasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, `parimāṇākhyāyāṃ sarvebhyaḥ' (3.3.20) ityeva siddhatvāt| tasmādaṅgulīnāṃ racanāviśeṣavṛttergrahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `muṣṭiraṅgulisanniveśaḥ' iti|sanniveśaḥ - racanāviśeṣaḥ| `aho mallasya saṃgrahaḥ'iti| muṣṭerdārḍhyamityarthaḥ| ata evāha-- `dṛḍhamuṣṭitā''khyāyate' iti| 37. parinyornīṇordyūtābhreṣayoḥ| (3.3.37) `padārthānām' ityādi| padārśabdo vastuvācī| kutsitaścāraḥ - apacāraḥ|yatāprāptasyākaraṇamityarthaḥ| yathāprāptasyākaraṇamasādhvetaditiloke kutsyate, tasmādanyaḥ śāntaścāro'napacāraḥ| etamevārthaṃ paryāyāntareṇa vyaktīkarttumāha-- `yathāprāptasya karaṇam' iti| yadyat prāptimiti `yathā'sādṛśye'(2.1.7) itivīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| karaṇam - sampādanam| etuduktaṃ bhavati-- yukterāgamāllokaprasiddhervā yaḥ padārthānāṃ prāpnoti tasya sampādanamabhreṣa iti|`{ bhreṣṛ gatau-dhā.pā.} bhreṣa calane' (dhā.pā.884) bhreṣaṇam - bhreṣaḥ, svarūpāt taccalanam| abhreṣo bhreṣasvarūpādacalanam| evaṃ hi padārthāḥ svarūpādacalitā bhavanti yadi prāptaṃ nātivarttante| `parimāyena' iti| `upasargādasamāse'pi ṇopadeśasya' (8.4.14) iti ṇatvam| `hanti' iti bādhate| `samantānnayanena' iti| pariṇāyenetyasyedamarthakathanam|| 38. parāvanupātyaya iṇaḥ| (3.3.38) `anatipātaḥ' iti| anitakrama ityarthaḥ| `atipāta ityarthaḥ' iti| atikrama ityarthaḥ|| 39. vyupayoḥ śeteḥ paryāye| (3.3.39) paryāyo'nupātyaya eva,tatrānupātyayagrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhe paryāyagrahaṇaṃ bādhakabādhanārtham| abhividhivivakṣāyāṃ parimāṇamapi bādhitvā ghañeva yathā syāt| evañcārthe śabdādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ bhavatīti labhyate, na tu paryāyaśabdo'syārthasya vācakaḥ|| 40. hastādāne cerasteye| (3.3.40) `hastādānagrahaṇena' ityādi| hastenopāyāntaranirapekṣeṇopādānam - pratyāsattiḥ, tataeva vastuno bhavati, tasmāddhastādānagrahaṇena grāhyasya vastunaḥ pratyāsannatopalakṣyate; hastādānaśabdābhidheyasyārthasya pratyāsatteḥ sāhacaryāt| `vṛkṣaśikhare' ityādi| vṛkṣaśikharagrahaṇenādeyasyāpratyāsannatvaṃ sūcayati|| 41. nivāsacitiśarīropasamādhāneṣavādeśca kaḥ| (3.3.41) `rāśīkaraṇam' iti| prakīrṇasyaikatrakaraṇamityarthaḥ| `cikhallinikāyaḥ' iti| cikhallirjanapadaḥ, tasya nikāyaḥ - nivāsaḥ| athādigrahaṇaṃ kim ? arthasya mā bhūt| yadyevam, `caḥ kaḥ' iti vaktavyam ? evaṃ tarhi yadā yaṅlugantādutpadyate tadā `{antyābhāve antyasadeśasya' śāka.pa.}antyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' (śāka.pa.56) iti dvitīyasya cakārasya mā bhūdityavamarthamādigrahaṇam|| 42. saṅghe cānauttarādharye| (3.3.42) `ekadharmaniveśena' iti| ekadharmānugamanenetyarthaḥ|| 43. karamavyatihāre ṇac striyām| (3.3.43) `dātoḥ'(3.1.91) ityadhikārāddhātuvācyaṃ yatkarma tadava gṛhyate,na sādhanakarma| na hi dhātostatra vṛttirastīti matvā''ha-- karmaṃ kriyā'iti| `cakāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ' iti| antodattārthaścakāraḥ kasmānna bhavati ? nārhatyantodāttārtho bhavitum; ṇajantādaño vidhānāt| satiśiṣṭasvareṇādyudāttena bhavitavyam,tatra kuto'ntodāttasya sambhavaḥ| tasmādviśeṣaṇārtha eva cakāraḥ| `striyām' ityucyamāne `prajñāśraddhārcābhyo ṇaḥ'(5.2.101) iti prājñetyatrāpi syāt| `vyāvakrośī' ityādi| `kruśa { āhvāne rodane ca--dha.pā.}, `likha akṣaravinyāse' (dhā.pā.1365),`hase hasane' (dhā.pā.721)--ebhyo ṇac, `ṇacaḥ striyām'(5.4.14) iti svārte'ñ, `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp, `na karmavyatihāre' (7.3.6) ityaijāgamapratiṣedhaḥ| ādivṛddhireva bhavati| `vyatipākaḥ' iti| tatra puṃlliṅgatvādbhāvasya ghañ bhavati| atha `striyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) ityasminneva prakaraṇe ṇac kasmānnoktaḥ, kaḥ punarevaṃ sati guṇo bhavati, dviḥ striyāṃgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavita ? asti guṇaḥ,vāsarūpavidhistu na syāt ; astriyāmiti pratiṣedhāt | tataśca ktino ṇacāsamāveśābhāvādvyāvakruṣṭiriti na sidhyet| iha tu kriyamāṇe ṇac sidhyati; yasmāt `vā'sarūpo'striyām' (3.1.94) ityatra strīgrahaṇasya ca svaritatvāt stryadhikarāravihitapratyayaviṣaya eva `astriyāma' (3.1.94) iti pratiṣedho vijñāyate,na strīpratyayamātraviṣaye| tasmādyathānyasameva nyāyyam| `vyāvacorī, vyāvacarcī' iti| `cura steye' (dhā.pā.1534), `carca adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1712)-- ābhyāṃ curādiṇijantābhyām `ṇyāsaśrantho yuc' (3.3.107) iti yuc prāpnoti, sa ca viśeṣavihitatvāt paravācca bādhakaḥ, tathāpi tadviṣaye tu ṇajeveṣyate| `vyatīkṣā,vyatīhā' iti| `īkṣa darśane' (dhā.pā.610), `īha ceṣṭāyām' (dhā.pā.632) -- ābhyāṃ `gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103) ityakāraeva pratyayo bhavati| na ṇac śakyaḥ karttum;yasmāt kvacidbādhakaviṣaye sa iṣyate, na sarvatra| bādhakatvaṃ tvakārapratyayasya pūravavadveditavyam| `vyātyukṣī'iti| `ukṣa secane' (dhā.pā.657)| atra bādhakasyāpyakārasya viṣaye ṇajeva bhavati| `tadetadvaicitryaṃ kathaṃ labhyate' iti| na kathañcit| tallābhahetorabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'(3.3.113) ityanena| ato hetorvecitryametallabhyata iti darśayati|| 44. abhividhau bhāva inuṇ|(3.3.44) `sāṃkūṭinam' iti| `kūṭa {paritāpe (paridāhe ityanye)-dhā.pā.} (dhā.pā.1890), `aṇinuṇaḥ' (5.4.15) itīnumantāt svārthiko'ṇ| `inaṇyanapatye' (6.4.164) iti prakṛtibhāvāt `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopo na bhavati| `saṃrāvaḥ' iti| `upasarge ruvaḥ (3.3.22) iti ghañ| `saṃdrāvaḥ' iti| atrāpi `sami yudruduvaḥ' (3.3.23) iti| nanu ca bhāva iti varttata eva, tatkimarthaṃ punastad‌grahamityāha-- `bhāve' iti| `varttamāne' ityādi| bhāvagrahaṇamihātiricyate, taditaricyamānaṃ vāsarūpanirāsārthaṃ vijñāyate| tena ktena sahenuṇaḥ samāveśo na bhavati| nanu ca kāraka ityapi varttate, tatastannivṛttyarthaṃ bhāvagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? evaṃ manyate-- bhāve kāraka iti dvaye prakṛte'pi prayogadarśanavaśādvayavasthā bhavati, yathā ṇacaḥ| sa hi dvathe'pi prakṛte lakṣyadarśanānurodhāt punargrahamantareṇāpi yathā bhāva eva vijñāyate, na karāke, tathātrenuṇapi bhāva eva vijñāsyate| tasmādvāsarūpavidhinirāsārthameva punarbhāvagrahaṇaṃ yuktamiti| yadyevam, tarhi, yathā ghañenuṇaḥ samāveśo na bhavati tathā lyuṭāpi na syādityata āha-- `lyuṭā tu' ityādi| gatārtham| inuṇo ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ| ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ|| 45. ākrośe'vanyorgrahaḥ| (3.3.45) ` grahavṛdṛ' (3.3.58) ityādinā prāpte vacanam| `dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmrthyāt' iti| prayogopasthānena ghaño'nuvṛttisāmarthya dṛṣṭam, inuṇastu kalpayitavyam| dṛṣṭasāmarthyayośca sannidhau dṛṣṭasāmarthyadagrahaṇaṃ nyāyyam| ato ghañevānuvarttata ityeke| evaṃ tu `grahavṛdṛ' (3.3.58) ityādāvapi sūtre ghañevānuvarttate, nāp| tasmādanyathā vyākhyāyate-- dṛṣṭamanuvṛttisāmarthyamadhikṛtasya yatra tad‌dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyam, tatra punaḥ svaritatvam| tato hi śāstre'dhikṛtasya śabdasyānuvṛttau sāmarthye dṛśyate| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- ghaña eva svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate, nenuṇaḥ| tasmāt svaritatvādghañevānuvarttate, nenuṇiti|| 46. pre lipsāyām| (3.3.46) 47. parau yajñe| (3.3.47) 48. nau vṛ dhānye| (3.3.48) `apo'pavādaḥ'iti| `grahavṛdṛ' (3.3.58) ityādinā prāptasya | `nīvārā nāma vrīhayo bhavanti' iti| etena yadyapi dhānyaśabdena sāmānyavācināyaṃ vyutpādyate, tathāpi pratyayāntaṃ śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāddhānyaviśeṣa e varttata iti darśayati| `upasargasyaghañi' (6.3.122) iti dīrghatvam| `nivarā' iti| nivriyata iti nivarā| svabhāvenābantamapi striyāṃ varttate| evañca yad ghañabanto ghājantaśceti liṅgādhikāre'bantasya puṃlliṅgatāpratipādanaṃ tat prāyikaṃ veditavyam|| 49. udi śrayatiyautipūdruvaḥ| (3.3.49) `ajaporapavādaḥ' iti| śrayaterivarṇāntatvādaco'pavādaḥ, yautiprabhṛtīnāṃ tūvarṇāntatvādapaḥ| `kathaṃ patanāntāḥ samucchrayā iti' iti| ucchabdopapadatvāddhañātra bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `vakṣyamāṇam' ityādi parihāraḥ| yadi tarhi vibhāṣāgrahaṇamiha sambadhyate, yautiprabhṛtīnāmapi vikalpena pratyayaḥ prasajyate ? vyavasthitavibhāṣayā na prasajyata ityadoṣaḥ|| 50. vibhāṣā''ṅi rupluvoḥ| (3.3.50) rauteḥ `upasarge ruvaḥ' (3.3.22) iti nityaṃ ghañi prāpte plavaterapyuvarṇāntatvādapi sūtrārambhaḥ|| 51. ave graho varṣapratibandhe| (3.3.51) `grahavṛdṛ' (3.3.58) ityādināpi prāpte tadapavādaḥ, pakṣe ghañabhidhīyate| `kutaścinnimittāt' iti| sattvakarmāparādhādhikārāt|| 52. pre vaṇijām| (3.3.52) `vaṇiksambandhana ca' ityādi| tulāsūtraṃ hi prāyeṇa vaṇijāsambaddham - sahacaram, tataḥ sāhacaryādvaṇiksambandhena tadupalakṣyate| nātra vaṇijāṃ prādhānyām| tasmāt tadeva tulādisūtraṃ tadanyaśabdasyābhidheyam|| 53. raśmau ca| (3.3.53) `rathādiyuktānām' ityādi| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate,yāvatā raśmiśabdaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ, yathaivāsāvaśvādisaṃyamanārthāyāṃ rajjvāṃ varttate tathā candrārkādisambandhiṣvapi raśmiṣu ? evaṃ manyate- yathā `nau vṛ dhānye' (3.3.48) iti dhānyaśabdasyāpi dhānyaviśeṣa eva gṛhyate, pratyayāntena śabdaśaktisvabhāvyāddhānyaviśeṣasya vābhidhānāt; tathā yadyapi raśmiśabdaḥ sāmānyavācī, tathāpi pratyayāntaḥ svabhāvādrajjuviśeṣa eva varttate| tasmāt yuktaṃ grahaṇamiti|| 54. vṛṇoterācchādane| (3.3.54) `vṛṇoteḥ'iti| śnuvikaraṇena nirdeśo vṛṅo nivṛttyarthaḥ| atrāpi sāmānyavācitve prāgvadācchādanaśabdādanyatra| pakṣe `grahavṛdṛ' (3.3.58) ityādinābbhavati|| 55. parau bhuvo'vajñāne| (3.3.55) 56. erac| (3.3.56) `cakāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ' iti| vināpi tena thāthādisūtre (6.2.144) apratyayādityapratyayasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt| `ajvidhau' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'(3.3.113) ityetadāśritya karttavyam| anyastu `pañcamī bhayena' (2.1.37) `varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyāntarasyām' (3.4.32) iti nipātanādbhayādīnāṃ siddhimicchati, na cāsau yuktā; kimidaṃ bhayavarṣaśabdayornapuṃsakaliṅgayoruccāraṇam ? it puṃlliṅgayoḥ ? iti sandehāt| `vaktayau'iti| vyākhyeyāvityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tadeva bahulagrahaṇamāśritya karttavyam| `javaḥ, savaḥ' iti| `ju' (3.2.150) ityesmāt sautrāddhātoḥ, `ṣuñ abhiṣave' (dhā.pā.1247) ityesmāccottarasūtreṇāpi prāpte'jbhavati| svare viśeṣaḥ-- api hi stāmādyudāttaṃ padaṃ syāt, ajante satyantodāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 57. ṛdorap| (3.3.57) `pitkaraṇaṃ svarārtham' iti| `anudāttau suppitau' (3.1.4) ityanudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| `ṛdorap' ityatra ṛkārastaparaḥ syāt| evaṃ sati tādapi parastaparaḥ ityukāro'pi tasya paraḥ syāt| tataśca `taparastatkālasya' (1.1.70) iti paribhāṣopasthānādihaiva syāt-- yavaḥ,stava iti; lavaḥ,pava ityatra tu na syāt| dakāre tu `aṇ savarṇān gṛhṇāti-- `bhuvaḥ gṛhṇāti' (vyā.pā.66 ?) iti dīrghādapi bhavati| tasmādukāro'yaṃ savarṇaṃ gṛhṇāti| atra ca liṅgam-- `bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ' (1.4.31) iti nirdeśaḥ|tapare tu bhavaterap na syāt, tataśca `prabhavaḥ'iti nirdeśo nopapadyate| tasya tu dakārasya mukhasukhārthatvādanyat prayojanaṃ na sambhavatītyetatsarvamālocyāha-- `dakāro mukhasukhārthaḥ' iti|| 58. grahavṛdṛniścigamaśca| (3.3.58) `vṛ' iti vṛṅvṛñoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam| `dṛ'iti| `dṛṅa ādare' (dhā.pā.1411)| `niścinotestavaco'pavādaḥ' iti| `erac' (3.3.56) iti prāptasya| atha niścigrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā nāsmādacyapi vā vihite kaścidviśeṣo'sti, tadeva hi rūpamubhayatrāpi samāpadyata ityāha-- `niścigrahaṇaṃ svarārtham' iti| anudāttārthamityarthaḥ| nanu ca `hastādāne cerasteye' (3.3.40) iti cinīterghañ vidhīyamāno na syāt, niṣpūrvādapi prāpnoti, atastadbādhanārthamapi niścigrahaṇaṃ yuktam ? naitadasti; niṣpūrvādapi hi cinoteścaiṣa ghañ pūrvavipratiṣedheneṣyate| nanu ca svarārthamapi niścigrahaṇaṃ nopapadyataeva, tathāpi `gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvare prāpte` antaḥ'(6.2.143) , `thāthaghañktājabitrakāṇām' (6.2.144) ityantodāttatvenaiva bhāvyate| tathā cāpi pratyaye'pi satyanudāttatvenaiva bhavitavyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;niścigrahaṇasāmarthyāta thāthādisvarastasmin viṣaye na bhavati| tasminnasatyuttarapade prakṛtibhāvenāvasthite'po'nudāttatvāddhātoścāntodāttatvānniścaya iti padaṃ kṛtsvareṇa madhyodāttṃ bhavati, aci satyantodāttaṃ syāt| `vaśiraṇyoḥ' ityādi| `vaśa kāntau' (dhā.pā.1080), `raṇa' (dhā.pā.445) iti śabdārthaḥ, aṇaraṇetyādayaḥ śabdārthāḥ (dhā.pā.444-453) dhātavaḥ| tayorvaśiraṇyorapa upasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ kartavyam| tatredaṃ pratipādanam -- cakāro'trānuktasamuccayārthaḥ kriyate, tena vaśiraṇyorapyabbhaviṣyati| `ghañarthe ka' ityādi| ghañartho bhāvaḥ karttṛvarjitañca karākam, tatra kapratyayasya vidhānaṃ karttavyaṃ sthādyartham| etattu `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'(3.3.113) ityeva siddham| `pā' iti lugvikaraṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.50) pānārthasya grahaṇam, na rakṣaṇārthasya| `prasthaḥ' iti| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| `praśnaḥ' iti| `ṣṇā śauce' (dhā.pā.1052)| `āvidhaḥ' iti| `vyadha tāḍane' (dhā.pā.1181)| `grahijyā' (6.1.16) iityādisūtreṇa samprasāraṇam| `vighnaḥ'iti| `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ, `ho hanteḥ'(7.3.54) ityādinā kutvam| `āyudham' iti| `yudha samprahāre' (dhā.pā.1173)|| 59. upasarge'daḥ| (3.3.59) `aderdhātorappratyayo bhavati' iti| ghañapavādaḥ| ita uttaratrāpi halantādab‌vidhīyamāno ghaño'pavādo veditavyaḥ| `vighasaḥ, praghasaḥ' iti| `ghañapośca' (2.4.38) iti ghaslādeśaḥ| atha kimarthamaderabvidhīyate, na ghaseḥ prakṛtyantarādeva vidhīyate,kaḥ punarevaṃ sati guṇo bhavati ? aderapi ghaslubhāvo na karttavyo bhavati ? satyametat; tathāpyuttarārthamadervihitam-- `nau ṇa ca' (3.3.60) ityaderyathā syāt, ghasermā bhūditi|| 60. nau ṇa ca| (3.3.60) 61.vyadhajaporanupasarge| (3.3.61) 62.svanahasorvā| (3.3.62) 63. yamaḥ samupaniviṣu ca| (3.3.63) 64. nau gadanadapaṭhasvanaḥ| (3.3.64) 65. kvaṇo vīṇāyāñca| (3.3.65) `sopasargārthaṃ vīṇāyā grahaṇam' iti| yadi vīṇāviṣaye'pyanusargādeva syāt, vīṇāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| anupasargāt sāmānyena vidhānādvīṇāyāmapi pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ|| 66. nityaṃ paṇaḥ parimāṇe| (3.3.66) `parimitaḥ'iti| parimito mitaḥ paricchinnaḥ| dvayostrayāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ vā mūlakādidravyāṇāṃ yo muṣṭiḥ - parimāṇaviśeṣo badhyate saṃvyavahārārthaḥ sa `mūlakapaṇaḥ' ityādinā śabdenābhidhīyate|| 67. mado'nupasarge| (3.3.67) `vidyāmadaḥ'iti| vidyayā madaḥ| `karttukaraṇe' (2.1.32) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `unmādaḥ' iti| atrāpi `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti `vyadhajaporanupasarge' (3.3.61) ityatraiva madigrahaṇe karttavye `mado'nupasarge' iti sūtrapraṇayanamasya vidheranityatvājñāpanārtham, tena māda iti siddhaṃ bhavati|| 68. pramadasaṃmadau harṣe| (3.3.68) nanu ca `madaḥ' (3.3.67) ityanuvarttate, tatra prasaṃbhyāmiti vaktavyam, evamapyabhīṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva,tatkiṃ nipātyate ? ityata āha-- `prasaṃbhyām' ityādi| rūḍhiśabdeneha pramadasaṃmadābhyāmanyasyāśrutatvādanayośca rūḍhiśabdatvādetādeva vivakṣitatāviti gamyate| avadhāraṇañceha draṣṭavyam, sāvaradhāraṇatvāt sarvavākyānām| tena rūḍhyarthaṃ nipātanam| pramadasammadaśabdārthamevaiṣo'rthaḥ sampadyate| anena sūtreṇa `pramadasammadau' ityanayoreva rūḍhiśabdyorvyutpattiryathā syānna śabdāntarāṇāmityavamarthaṃ nipātanamiti yāvat| yadi hi madigrahaṇamanuvarttya prasaṃbhyāmityetāvaducyeta, tarhi yadāpi prasaṃbhyāṃ samastābhyāmuttaro madirbhaviṣyati tadāpi pratyayaḥ syāt| tathā yadā prasamāvanyasmādupasargāt parau bhavataḥ prasaṃbhyañca paro madirbhavati tadāpi syāt| tataśca prasammadaḥ, abhiprasammadaḥ, pranisammadaḥ-- ityevamādyarūḍhiśabdārthamapi sūtraṃ syāt, na pramadasammadārthameva| nipātane tu sati niyamo vijñāyate-- pratyekamevetau;na samastau, nāpyanyopasargasahitāviti| tena rūḍhyarthaṃ sūtraṃ sampadyate|| 69. samudorajaḥ paśuṣa| (3.3.69) 70. akṣeṣu glahaḥ| (3.3.70) `graherap siddha eva' iti| `grahavṛdṛ' (3.3.58) ityādinā| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ nipātanamityāha-- `latvārtham' ityādi|| 71. prajane sartteḥ| (3.3.71) 72. hvaḥ samprasāraṇañca nyabhyupaviṣu| (3.3.72) `nihavaḥ'iti| `hveñ {spardhāyāṃ śabde ca--dhā.pā} sparddhāyām' (dhā.pā.1008)| samprasāraṇe kṛte guṇāvādeśau| juhotereva niprabhṛtyupasargapūrvasya `nihavaḥ'ityādike rūpacatuṣṭaye siddhe sati hvayaserniprabhṛtipūrvasya ghañ‌nivṛttyarthamevaitadvavacanam|| 73. āṅi yuddhe| (3.3.73) `āhvāyaḥ'iti| `āto yuk ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk|| 74. nipānamāhāvaḥ| (3.3.74) nipibanti tasminniti nipānamityadhikaraṇe (3.3.117) lyuṭ| kasmādāhāvaśabda udakādhāre varttata ityāha-- `tatra hi' ityādi| etenāhāvaśabdasyodakādhāre pravṛttanimittaṃ darśayati|| 75. bhāve'nupasargasya| (3.3.75) `bhāvagrahaṇam' ityādi| nanu ca yathā `karmavyatihāre ṇac striyām' (3.3.43) ityatra dvaye prakṛte ca lakṣyadarśanavaśādbhāva eva pratyayo vijñāsyate, tathehāpi, tatkiṃ bhāvagrahaṇena `akarttari ca kārake' (3.3.19) ityetannirāsārthena ? satyametat; lakṣyadarśanasāmarthyādeva prāpta eva evārtho bhāvagrahaṇenākhyāyate mandabuddhīnāmanugrahāya| atha yathā `abhividhau bhāva inuṇ' (3.3.44) ityatra `bhāve' iti varttamāne punarbhāvagarhaṇaṃ vāsarūpanirāsārthaṃ vijñāyate, tathehāpi kasmānna vijñāyate ? lakṣyadarśanavaśāt| dṛśyate hi ktādayaḥ-- hūtam, hvānam, hūtiriti| ghañādau vāsarūpeṇa bhāvaḥ|| 76. hanaśca vadhaḥ| (3.3.76) `sa cāntodāttaḥ' iti| sūtre vadhaśabdasyāntodāttasyoccāraṇāt| `tatra 'ityādinā'ntodātte vadhādeśe yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati| api kṛte `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralope ca `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ'(6.1.161) ityapa udāttatvaṃ bhavati| `dhātaḥ' iti| karmādau kārake ghañ,`hanasto'ṭiṇṇaloḥ' (7.3.32) iti tatvam; `ho hanteḥ' (7.3.54) ityādinā kutvam| `cakāro bhinnakramatvāt' ityādi| cakāro nādeśena sambadhyata iti sambandhaḥ|kasmānna sambadhyate ? bhinnakramatvāt| yadi `hano vadhaśca' ityeṣa cakārasya kramaḥ; ādeśānantaramanuccāraṇāt|tasmāt bhinnakramatvāt kramabhedānnādeśena sambadhyate|api tu prakṛtena pratyayena| evañca prakṛtena sambandhaṃ darśayitumāha-- `ap ca' ityādi| ap pratyayo bhavati, cakārāvṛtteryaḥ prāpnoti sa ca | tena ghañapi bhavati|| 77. mūrttau ghanaḥ| (3.3.77) `abhravanaḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhāsamāso'yam| abhrasya kāṭhinyamityarthaḥ| yadi mūrttāvabhidheyāyāṃ ghanaśabdo vyutpādyate-- ghanaṃ dadhīti, mūrtimato daghno nābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti, kathaṃ hi nāma mūrttau vyutpāditastato'nyatra varttatate ? ityata āha-- `dharmaśabdena dharmī bhaṇyate' iti| matubālopādabhedopacāraḥ, yathā-- śuklaḥ paṭaḥ| śuklaśabdena śuklaguṇaḥ paṭa iti bhāvaḥ|| 78. antarghano deśe| (3.3.78) `antarghanaḥ'iti| antarhaṇyante prāṇino'tretyadhikaraṇe'p| `tavapi grāhyameva' iti| ubhayathā cācārye śiṣyāṇāṃ pratipāditvāt|| 79. agāraikadeśe praghaṇaḥ praghāṇaśca| (3.3.79) 80. udghano'tyādhānam| (3.3.80) `atyādhānam' iti| atiśabda uparibhāve varttate| ādadhātiḥ sthāpane| ya upari nidhīyate sthāpyate tasmin saḥ, tadasyādhānam| adhikaraṇe lyuṭ| `udghanaḥ' iti| uddhanyate'sminnityadhikaraṇe'p|| 81. apaghano'ṅgam| (3.3.81) `apaghanaḥ'iti| apahanyate'neneti karaṇe'p|| 82. karaṇe'yovidruṣu| (3.3.82) 83. stambe ka ca| (3.3.83) `tatra ca' iti| anantarokte'pi| `ghanādeśaḥ'iti| `mūrttau ghanaḥ' (3.3.77) ityataḥ `ghanaḥ' ityatasyānuvṛtteḥ| `stambaghnaḥ'iti| pūrvavat kutvopadhālopau|| 84. parau ghaḥ| (3.3.84) `valighaḥ' iti| `pareśca ghāṅkayoḥ'(8.2.22) iti vibhāṣā latvam|| 85. upaghna āśraye| (3.3.85) `āśrayaśabdaḥ' ityādi| āśrayaṇamāśrayaḥ - sevā| sā ca yatra pratyāsattistatra bhavatītyāśrayaḥ pratyāsattisahacaraḥ|tasmādāśrayaśabdaḥ sāmīpyaṃ pratyāsattimupalakṣayati; tadarthasya pratyāsattisāhacaryāt| `parvatopaghnaḥ' iti| parvatasamīpabhūto'rtha ucyate|| 86. saṅghodvaghau gaṇapraśaṃsayoḥ| (3.3.86) `saṅghod‌ghau' iti| saṃhananaṃ saṅghaḥ| utkaṭaṃ hanyate jñāyata iti udghaḥ| karmaṇyap| kathaṃ punarhantirjñāne varttate ? gatyarthatvāt| sarveṣāṃ gatyarthānāṃ dhātūnāṃ jñānārthatvāt|| 87. nigho nimitam| (3.3.87) samantānmitamiti na?nimitaśabdaḥ| sarvata ārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca tulyamityarthaḥ| ekamevārthaṃ prasiddhatareṇa darśayitumāha-- `samārohapariṇāhau yasya tat tathoktam| ārohaḥ - ucchrāyaḥ| pariṇāhaḥ - vistāraḥ| `nighā vṛkṣāḥ'iti| niviśeṣamaṃ hanyante jñāyanta iti nighāḥ| karmaṇyapi samantāt tulyā ityarthaḥ| evaṃ te nirviśeṣaṃ jñāyante yadi samantādārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca tulyā bhavanti|| 88. ḍ‌vitaḥ ktriḥ| (3.3.88) `uptrimam' iti| `vacisvapi' (6.1.15) ityādinā samprasāraṇam| ktreḥ kakāro guṇapratiṣedhārthaḥ|| 89. ṭ‌vito'thuc| (3.3.89) `vepathuḥ' iti| vepanam - vepathuḥ| svabhāvata evaitadubhayaṃ bhāve bhavatīti ghaño'pavādo vijñāyate| ghañ tu vāsarūpavidhināpi na bhavati; anabhidhānāt| athucaścakāraḥ|athucaścakāraḥ svarāthaḥ|| 90. yajayācayatavicchapraccharakṣo naṅ| (3.3.90) `yaja devapūjādau' (dhā.pā.1002), `ṭuyāc yācñāyām' (dhā.pā.863), `{yatī prayatne-dhā.pā} yata prayatne'(dhā.pā.30), `viccha gatau' (dhā.pā.1423), `praccha jñīpsāyām' (dhā.pā.1413), `rakṣa {pālane-- dhā.pā.}rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.658)--atra svābhāvikatvādyāceranyeṣāṃ naṅpratyayāntānāṃ puṃsi vṛttiriti tebhyo naṅ na ghañapavādo bhavati| yathādarśanañca vāsarūpavidhanā ghañapi bhavati- yāga iti| yācestu naṅantasaya svabhāvāt striyāṃ vṛttiriti tato naṅ `gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103) iti prāptasyākārapratyayasyāpavādaḥ| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti vacanādvāsarūpavidhirna bhavati| `ṅakāro guṇapratiṣedhaḥ' iti| viccherlaghūpadhaguṇo mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| nanu cāntaraṅgatvāt `che ca' (6.1.73) iti tukaiva vicchestāvadbhavitavyam, tatrālaghūpadhatvādeva guṇo na bhaviṣyati, tatkiṃ tatpratiṣedhārtho ṅakāraḥ karttavyaḥ| `anityamāgamaśāsanam'(vyā.pa.99) ityasya caideva naṅo ṅikaraṇaṃ jñāpakam| yadā tarhyanityatvāt, tuṅ‌na, tadā `cchvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) iti satukkasya cchakārasya śādeśo vidhīyamānaḥ kevalasya na prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasmāt `cchvoḥ'iti
