dvicchakāro nirdeśaḥ| tatraikaḥ satukkaḥ, dvitīyaḥ kevala eva, tena kevalasyāpi śādeśo bhaviṣyati| yadi tu dvicchakāro nirdeśaḥ `cchvoḥ' iti dvivacanaṃ na prāpnoti,bahutvāt sthāninām ? sautratvanānnirdeśasya bahuvacanasya vyatyayena dvivacanaṃ bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| avaśyaṃ dvicchakāro nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ; anyathā `rāllopaḥ' (6.4.21) ityatra kevalasya lopo na syāt, kevalasya cchakārasyāprakṛtvāt| vacanaṃ tu vakāralopārthameva syāt| `yajñaḥ, yācñā' iti| `stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti ścutvena nakārasya ñakāraḥ| `yatnaḥ' iti| `neḍ vaśi kṛti' (7.2.8) itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ| `viśnaḥ, praśnaḥ' iti| `cchvoḥ'(6.4.19) ityādinā cchakārasya śakārādeśaḥ| `rakṣṇaḥ'iti| `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti nakārasya ṇakāraḥ| atha praccheḥ grahijyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇaṃ `praśnaḥ' ityatra kasmānna bhavatītyata āha-- `praccheḥ' ityādi| kiṃ jñāpakamityāha-- `praśne ca' ityādi|| 91.svapo nan| (3.3.91) 92. upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ| (3.3.92) `kipratyayo bhavati' iti| ghaño'pavādaḥ| `kitkaraṇe lopārtham' iti| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopo yathā syāditi|| 93. karmaṇyadhikaraṇe ca| (3.3.93) karmādhikaraṇayoḥ saptamyā bhedena nirdeśānnobhayorupapadatvam, nāpi pratyayārthatvam, tasmāt kiñcit tatropapadam, kiñcitpratyayārthaḥ| karma upapadam, adhikaraṇaṃ pratyayārthaḥ| eṣa tu vibhāgo vyākhyānāslakṣyadarśanācca vijñāta ityāha--`karmaṇyupapade ityādi| athādhikaraṇagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `akarttari ca kārake' (3.3.19) ityasyānuvṛtterevādhikaraṇe pratyayo labhyate ? ityāha-- `adhikaraṇagrahaṇam' ityādi| asati hyadhikaraṇagrahaṇera'rthāntare'pi bhāve karaṇādau kārake prakṛtapratyayaḥ syāt, tasmāt tannivṛttyarthamadhikaraṇagrahaṇam|| 94. striyāṃ ktin| (3.3.94) `bhāvādau' iti| ādiśabdenākarttuḥ kārakasyopādānam| `ghañajapāmapavādaḥ' iti| ya ikārāntāstebhyo'co'pavādaḥ, ya ṛkārāntā uvarṇāntāśca, tebhyo'paḥ, śeṣebhyo ghañaḥ| vaktavya iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) ityetadāśritya karttavyam| `āptiḥ' ityādi| `āplṛ vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1260), `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau' (dhā.pā.1262), `dīpī dīptau' (dhā.pā.1150), `sransu dhvansu avasraṃsane' (dhā.pā. 754,755) `ḍulabhaṣ prāptau' (dhā.pā.975)| labheti ṣittvāt `ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅa' (3.3.104) ityaṅi prāpte śeṣebhyastu gurutvāt `gurośca halaḥ'(3.3.103) ityakāre ktina vidhīyate| `iṣṭiḥ' iti| vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam|`kīrṇiḥ,gīrṇiḥ, śīrṇiḥ' iti| `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam, raṣādisūtreṇa (8.4.1) ṇatvam| yathā `radābhyām' (8.2.42) ityādinā kīrṇa iti niṣṭāyāstakārasya natvaṃ bhavati, tathehāpi ktinaḥ| yathā `lvādibhyaḥ'(8.2.44) iti lūna ityatra niṣṭhātakārasya natvaṃ tathā `lūniḥ, yūniḥ'ityātrāpi ktinaḥ|| 95. sthāgāpāpacī bhāve| (3.3.95) `aṅo'pavādasya bādhakaḥ' iti| sthādibhyaḥ `ātaścopasarge'(3.3.106) iti prāptasyāṅo'pavādasya bādhaka ityarthaḥ| `paktiḥ' iti| `ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅa' (3.3.104) ityasya | `prasthitiḥ' iti| `dyatisyati' (7.4.40) ityādinettvam| `saṅgītiḥ'iti| dhumāsyādi (6.4.66) sūtreṇettvam| atra ca `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) iti `gai śabde'(dhā.pā.917) `gāṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.950) iti dvayorapi grahaṇam| `pā'iti| pūrvavat pānārthasya grahaṇam, na rakṣaṇārthasya | `bhāvagrahaṇam' ityādi| arthāntaram - karttṛvarjitaṃ karākam, tannivṛtyarthaṃ bhāvagrahaṇam| `katham' ityādi| yadyaṅo'pavādasyāpavādo'yaṃ ktinpratyayastat kathaṃ `avasthā saṃsthā' iti sidhyati ? na kathañcidityabhiprāyaḥ| `vyavasthāyām' ityādi| yadidaṃ vyavasthāśabdasyāṅantasya sūtra uccāraṇametadeva jñāpakam, ataḥ ktinātyantabādhā na bhavatīti, tenāvasthetyādyapi sidhyati| `atyantāya' iti| caturbhyantapratirūpako nipāto'yam yathā- cirāyeti|| 96. mantre vṛṣeṣapacamanavidabhūvīrā udāttaḥ| (3.3.96) `vṛṣu mṛṣu secane' (dhā.pā.706,707), `{iṣa--dhā.pā.} iṣu icchāyām'} (dhā.pā.1351), `ḍupacaṣ pāke' (dhā.pā.996), `mana jñāne' (dhā.pā.1176), `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064),`bhū sattāyām' (dhā.pā.1), `vī gativyāptiprajanādiṣu' (dhā.pā.1048), `rā {dāne -dhā.pā.} ādāne' (dhā.pā.1057)| `prakṛtipratyayoḥ' iti| prakṛtisāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ dvivacanam, anyathā hi bahutvāt prakṛtīnāṃ bahuvacanaṃ syāt| `vibhaktivipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ' iti| vṛṣādibhyo yā prathamā tasyā arthāt pañcamīpariṇāmaḥ| tena prakṛtipratyayoḥ sambandhaḥ; anyathā sambandhānupapatteḥ| `matiḥ' iti| `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinā'nunāsikalopaḥ| `sarvatra' ityādi| mantre ca, amantre ca -- sarvatra vṛṣādibhyaḥ kinvihitaḥ| pacerapi sthāgādi (3.3.95) sūtreṇa| yadyevam kimarthamidamityāha-- `udāttārtham' iti| `iṣestu' ityādi| iṣericcheti nipātanaṃ vakṣyati; tasmāt ktinvidhīyate, anyathā nipātanenaivāsya syāt| vṛṣādibhyaḥ ktinpratyaya eva vidhātavyaḥ| udāttavacanamuttarārtham| `vrajayajorbhāve kyap' (3.3.98) iti kyabudātto yathā syāt|| 97. ūtiyūtijūtisātihetikīrttayaśca| (3.3.97) `svarārthaṃ vacanam' iti| na tu pratyayārtham| `striyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) ityeva siddhatvāt| nāpyūḍartham; `jvaratvara' (6.4.20) ityādinaiva siddhatvāt| `yauteḥ'iti| `yu {miśraṇe'miśraṇe ca-dhā.pā} miśraṇe (dhā.pā.1033) ityasya| `javateśca' iti| `ju' ityasya sautrasya (3.2.150) dhātoḥ| `dīrghatvañca' iti| cakārādudāttatvañca| ktin sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva siddhaḥ| `lyateḥ' iti| `ṣo'ntakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1147) ityasya | `ittvābhāvo'pi nipātyate' iti| `dyatisyati' (7.4.40) ityādinettvaṃ prāpnoti, tatastasyābhāvo nipātyate| `sanotervā' iti| `ṣaṇu dāne' (dhā.pā.1464) ityasya| `janasanakhanām' (6.4.42) ityāttve kṛte sātiriti sidhyatīti śeṣa-| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ nipātanamityāha-- `svarāऱthama' ityādi| asati hi nipātane sātiśśabda ādyudāttaḥ syāt| antodātto yathā syādityevamartha nipātanam| `hanterhitanotervā' iti| hetiriti yadā hanteḥ, tadā hakārasyaittvaṃ nipātyate, anunāsikalopastu `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinaiva siddhaḥ| yadā tu `hi {gatau buddhau ca-dhā.pā} (dhā.pā.157) itsya, tadā guṇo nipātyate| `kīrttiḥ'iti| `kṛtaṃ saṃśabdane' (dhā.pā.1653) ityasmāccurādiṇijantāt `ṇyāsaśrantho yuc' (3.3.107) iti yuci prāpte ktinnipātyate| `upadhāyāśca' (7.1.101) itīttvam bhavati, `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvam|| 98. vrajayajorbhāve kyap| (3.3.98) `ijyā' iti| vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam| yadyudāttaṃ vidhīyate pitkaraṇaṃ kimarthamityāha-- `pitkaraṇamuttaratra' ityādi|| 99. saṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣadanipatamanavidaṣuñśīṅbhṛñiṇaḥ| (3.3.99) `bhāva iti na svaryate' ityādi| sthāgādisūtre (3.3.95) yadbhāvagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tasyaiva svaritatvaṃ na kriyate| `bhāve' (3.3.18) `akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19) ityeṣa evādhikāraḥ| `samajyā' iti| `ajervyaghañapoḥ'(2.4.56) iti vībhāvo na bhavati; saṃjñāyāmiti vacanāt| na hi vībhāve kṛte saṃjñā gamyate, niyatavarṇānupūrvīkā hi saṃjñā bhavati| `nipatyā' iti| nipatanti tasyāmiti| `ṣad‌lṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu' (dhā.pā.854)| niṣīdantī tasyāmiti| `nipatyā' iti| nipatanti tasyāmiti| `matyā' iti| manyante tayeti matyā| pūrvavadanunāsikalopaḥ, hrasvasya tuk| vidanti tayā vidyā| sunvanti tasyāṃ sutyā| śerate tasyāṃ śayyā| `ayaṅa yi kṅiti'(7.4.22) ityayaṅādeśaḥ| bharaṇaṃ bhṛtyā| eti tayetyā - ayanamiti| `bhṛño'saṃjñāyām' (3.1.112) ityatra-- `saṃjñāyāṃ puṃsi dṛṣṭatvānna te bhāryā prasidhyati|" striyāṃ bhāvādhikaro'sti tena bhāryā prasidhyati|| ityuktam, iha `bhāva iti na svaryate' (kā.3.3.98) ityabhihitam, ataḥ pūrvottataravacanaṃ vyāhatamiti manyamāna āha-- `katham' ityādi| yadīha `bhāve' (3.3.18) iti na svaryate tatkathaṃ `striyāṃ bhāvādhikāro'sti' ityuktam, na hi `bhāve' ityasvaryamāṇe bhāvādhikārasyehāstitvamupapadyate ? `bhāvādhikāro bhāvyavyāpāraḥ'ityādi parihāraḥ| bhāvādhikāraśabdena tatra vyāpāro vācyatvena vivakṣitaḥ| sa punarbhṛtyāśabdābhidheyabhāvopagamanalakṣamaḥ| ata evaitaduktaṃ bhavati-- `saṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣada' ityādinā vyutpāditasya bhṛtyāśabdasya bhāva evābhidheyamupayāti, na tu karttṛvarjitaṃ kārakam| tena karmaṇi kārake bhāryeti sidhyīti| na tu śāstrīyo'dhikāro'yaṃ svaritatvāsaṅgāt priyogamupatiṣṭhate, sa tatra bhāvaśabdena vivakṣito mā bhūt| samajanti tasyāṃ samajyā, niṣīdanti tasyāṃ niṣadyā, vidantyanayā vidyetyevamādīnāṃ kārake karaṇādike karaṇādasādhutvamiti na| kathaṃ punaḥ `bhāve'karttari ca kārake' (3.3.18,19) sarvasminnanuvarttamāne kvacidbhāvaḥ kyabantasyābhidheyabhāvamupayāti ? kvacidakarttṛkārakamevetyeṣa niyamo labhyate ? saṃjñāvaśāt| yatrotpadyamānena pratyayena saṃjñā gamyate tatra bhāva evābhidheyatvaṃ pratipadyate, itaradudāste| yatra tvakarttari kārake pratyayenotpannena saṃjñā gamyate tatra tadabhidheyatāmupayāti, bhāvastvaudāsīnyamavalambate| `akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām'(3.3.19) iti saṃjñāgrahaṇe'nuvarttamāne punaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ bhāvārtham, pūrvakaṃ hi saṃjñāgrahaṇamakarttṛkārakeṇa sambaddhamiti| tataḥ karttṛvarjita eva kārake saṃjñāyāṃ syāt, na bhāve| tasmādbhāve'pi saṃjñāyāmeva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇam| atha kathaṃ bhṛtiḥ, matiḥ, āsutiriti ? nipātanāt| kiṃ punarnipātanam ? `karmaṇi bhṛtau' (3.2.22), `matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca' (3.2.188) `rajaḥkṛṣyāsutipariṣado valac' (5.2.112) iti|| 100. kṛñaḥ śa ca| (3.3.100) `yogavibhāgo'tra karttavyaḥ' iti| kṛñaḥ kyabiti bhavati, tataḥ śaśca, yathāprāptañceti, tena trīṇi rūpāṇi sidhyanti| tatra `kṛñaḥ'iti yogena kṛtyetyetadrūpaṃ sidhyati, `śa ca' ityanena kriyā kṛtiriti cetyetadrūpadvayaṃ kriyata iti| yadā bhāve śabdastadā `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67), `riṅ śayagliṅakṣu' (7.4.24) iti riṅādeśaḥ| yadā tvakarttari kārake tadā yagabhāvāccha eva pratyaye parato dhātoriṅādeśe kṛte `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinā tasyeyaṅ| śakāraḥ sārvadhātukārthaḥ|| 101. icchā| (3.3.101) iṣarbhāve śapratyayo bhavati; abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyāt, na kārake| `yagabhāvaśca' iti| `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67) iti yak syāt, atastadabhāvo nipātyate| `icchā' iti| `iṣugami' (7.3.77) ityādinā chatvam| `paricaryā' ityādi| `cara gatyarthaḥ' (dhā.pā.559), `sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.965), `mṛga anveṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1900) curādāvadantaḥ, `aṭa paṭa gatau' (dhā.pā.295,296)--ebhyo bhāve śaḥ, pūrvavadyak, sartterguṇaḥ| mṛgayaterakāralopābhāvaḥ, `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopaḥ| `aṭāṭyā' iti| aṭaterdvivacanāttvañcābhyāsasya| `jāgartterakāro vā' iti| yadā śastadā `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67), `jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu' (7.3.85) iti guṇaḥ| `jāgarā' iti yadā tvakāraḥ|| 102. a pratyayāt| (3.3.102) `dhātoḥ' (3.1.91) ityadhikārāt pratyayagrahaṇaṃ dhātorviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `pratyayāntebhyo dhātubhyaḥ' iti| `cikīrṣā' iti| cikīrṣaśabdāt sannantādaprtyayaḥ| `putrīyā' iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac' (3.1.8), `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam| `putrakāmyā' iti| `kāmyacca' (3.1.9) iti kāmyac| `lolūyā' iti| `dhātorekāco halādeḥ'(3.1.22) iti yaṅa|| 103. gurośca halaḥ| (3.3.103) `dhātoḥ (3.1.91) ityadhikārādgurugrahaṇaṃ halgrahaṇaṃ ca tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `gurumān halanto yo dhātuḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ punargurorityucyamāne gurumān dhāturlabhyate ? sāmarthyāt| na hi halantasya dhātoḥ kasyacidgurusaṃjñā vihitā, ucyate cedaṃ guroriti, tatra sāmarthyādgurumān dhāturgurusaṃjñākenābhedopacāraṃ kṛtvā guruśabdenokta iti gamyate| iṣyate hyabhedopacārādvināpi matupā tadvatorabhidhām-- yathā-- śuklaḥ paṭa iti| atha rudhādibhya eva yathā syāt, kuḍiprabhṛtībhyo mā bhūdityevamartho viparyayaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate `gurvanto yo dhāturhalvān' iti ? jñāpakāt, yadayaṃ `gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani' (2.3.12) ityapratyayāntasya ceṣṭāśabdasya `śaki śaṅgāyām' (dhā.pā.86) iti ca śaṅkāśabdasya nirdeśaṃ karoti, tato jñāyate-- nātra viparyaya iti| viparyaye hi na hi ceṣṭeti gurvantaḥ, nāpi śaṅketi| `kuṇḍā' ityādi| `kuḍi dāhe' (dhā.pā.270), `huḍi saṅghāte' (dhā.pā.269), `īha ceṣṭāyām' (dhā.pā.632) `ūha vitarke' (dhā.pā.648)-- ityeṣāṃ rūpāṇi|| 104. ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ| (3.3.104) `gaṇaparipaṭhiteṣu'ityādi| bhidādayo'ṅantā eva gaṇe paṭhyante, tebhyoyadi punarihāṅa vihitaḥ prātipadikebhyo vihitaḥ syāt, taccāyukteṃ syāt, dhātvadhikārāt,tasmāte teṣu yāḥ prakṛtayo'vayavabhūtāstā niṣkṛṣya pṛthakkṛtvā `ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅ' iti bhidādigrahaṇena nirdiśyante| tāḥ punaḥ `bhidir vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1439), `chidir dvaidhīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1440), `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064), `kṣipa preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1285), `guhū saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.896), `ḍudhāñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1092), `{midṛ medhāhiṃsanayoḥ'-dhā.pā.}{medṛ saṅgame ca.dhā.pā.} medhṛ hiṃsāsaṃkleśanayoḥ'(dhā.pā.868,869), `ṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098), `hṛñ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899) `hukṛñ karaṇe' (dhā.pā.1472), `kṣi kṣaye'(dhā.pā.236), athavā `kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1407), `tṛ plavanataraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.969), `ghṛñ dhāraṇe' (900), `likha akṣaravinyāse' (dhā.pā.1365), `cuda {sañcodane-dhā.pā.}samucchraye(dhā.pā.1592), `pīḍa avagāhane' (dhā.pā.1544), `ḍuvapa {bījatantusantāne, chedane'piṛdhā.pā.} bījatantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1003), `vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1942), `{mṛjū-dhā.pā.}mṛjūṣ śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1066),`krapa {kṛpāyāṃ gatau ca-dhā.pā.} (dhā.pā.771) ityete veditavyāḥ| yadi tarhi prakṛtayo nirdiśyante bhidādīnāṃ gaṇe pāṭho'narthakaḥ ? atha pāṭhaḥ kriyate pratyayavidhānamanarthakam ? gaṇe pāṭhastāvannānarthakaḥ; prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārthatvāt| prasiddhyusaṃgrahastu yatra bhidādayaḥ samudāyāḥ prasiddhāstatraivaiṣāṃ sādhutvaṃ yathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| tena yaduktaṃ bhāṣye `bhidā vidāraṇe' (ga.sū.29) ityevamādi, tadupapannaṃ bhavati| na ca pratyayavidhānamanarthakam; asandehārthatvāt| asati hi tasmin sandehaḥ syāta--kimeṣu `igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' (3.1.135) ityevamādinā lakṣaṇāntareṇa kaprabhṛtādayaḥ pratyayā vihitāḥ ? utāṅpratyaya eva ? iti| tatar pūrvasmin pakṣe strītvavivakṣāyāṃ ktin prasajyate, kasmāt ? asandehārthatvāt| ataḥ pratyayavidhānaṃ nānarthakam| `ārā' iti. `ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ' (7.4.16)| `guhā giryyoṣadhyoḥ'iti| guhāśabdo giryyoṣadhyoreva sādhurbhavati, nānyatra| giriśabdaścātra `samudāyeṣu hi vṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi varttante' (vyā.pā.sū.85) ityekadeśe varttate| guheti gireḥ kaścidevaikadeśa ucyate| guhā nāmauṣadhiḥ| anyatra guheḥ ktin bhavati-- gūḍhiriti| `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31), `jhatastathorgho'ghaḥ' (8.2.40), `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13), `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111)| `hārā, kārā, dhārā'iti| guṇe kṛte dīrghatvaṃ nipātyate| `lekhā, rekhā' iti| likherguṇo nipātyate| pakṣe lakārasay rephaścādeśaḥ| `cūḍā' iti| codayaterḍatvādeśo nipātyate, upadhāyā dīrghaśca| `ārā śastr‌yām'iti| ārāśabdaḥ śastryāṃ sādhurbhavati, atrāpi guṇe kṛte dīrghatvaṃ nipātyate| `ārttiranyā' iti| artterāṅapūrvasya ktin| `upasargādṛti dhātau' (6.1.91) ityekādeśaḥ, raparatvam| `dhārā prapāte' iti| yatra prapātanaṃ tatra dhāreti, yathā-- jaladhārā, kṣīradhāreti|| 105. cintipūjikathikumbacarcaśca| (3.3.105) `curādiḥ'iti| etat `citi smṛtyām' (dhā.pā.1535) ityādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| `yuci prāpte' iti| `ṇyāsasaśrantho yuc' (3.3.107) ityanena| yastu bhvādau kumbiḥ paṭhyate tato `gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103) ityakāreṇa bhavitavyam| na ca kumberakāre'ṅi vā sati kaścidviśeṣo'stīti nāsāviha grahaṇaṃ prayojayati|| 106. ātaścopasarge| (3.3.106) `śradantaroḥ'ityādi| upasarge ivopasargavat| yādṛśyupasarge vṛttiḥ pratyayotpattilakṣaṇā, tādṛśyeva tayorapi bhavati| tena yathā pradhā, upadhetyupasarge bhavati, tathā śradantarorapi śraddhā, antardheti| na ceyaṃ vṛttirupasaṃkhyānasādhyā; yataḥ śraddhāśabdastārakādiṣu ca pāṭhāt sādhutvamanubhavati| antardhāśabdo'pi jñāpakāt, yadayaṃ `antardhauyenādarśanamicchati' (1.4.28) ityantardhiśabdasya kipratyayāntasya nirdeśaṃ karoti, tatato jñāyate-- bhavatyantaḥśabda upasargakāryasya nimittamiti; anyathā hi tasminnupapade `upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' (3.3.92) iti kipratyayo na syāt, tataśca `antardhau' iti nirdeśo nopapadyate|| 107. ṇyāsaśrantho yuc| (3.3.107) `akārasyāpavādaḥ' iti| `a pratyayāt' (3.3.102), `gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103) iti dvābhyāṃ yathāyogaṃ prāptasya| `kathamāsyā' iti| na kathañcit| aḥ syādāseḥ, anena sūtreṇa yujvā bhaviṣyati, nānya iti bhāvaḥ| `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) ityādi parihāraḥ| nanu ca vāsarūpavidhinā ṇyatpratyayaḥ syāt, sa ca vāsarūpavidhiḥ striyāṃ na bhavati, `astriyām' (3.1.94) iti pratiṣedhāt, tat kimucyate-- `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) iti ṇyadbhaviṣya(tī)ti ? ityata āha-- `vāsarūpa' ityādi| edha cārthastatraiva pratipāditaḥ| `upasaṃkhyānam' iti| pratipādanamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- vakṣyamāṇaṃ bahulagrahaṇamubhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣaḥ, tena ghaṭṭiprabhṛtibhyo bhaviṣyīti| `vaktavyaḥ'iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tadeva bahulagrahaṇamāśritya karttavyam| `anveṣaṇā' iti| `iṣa gatau' (dhā.pā.1127), `iṣa ābhīkṣṇye' ( ? ) iti vā|| 108. rogākhyāyāṃ ṇvulbahulam| (3.3.108) `ktinnādīnāmapavādaḥ' iti| ādiśabdenāṅādīnām|`ākhyāgrahaṇam' ityādi| yadi pratyayāntaṃ rogasya nāma bhavatyevaṃ pratyayo bhavati| nānyathetyasyāsya saṃvādnāyākhyāgrahaṇam| te padāntaravācye roge na bhavati-- bubhukṣā bhasmakeneti| `bahulagrahaṇam' ityādi| rogākhyāyā rogākhyāyā anyatrāpi ṇvulo vidhānaṃ vyabhicāraḥ; tadarthaṃ bahulagrahaṇam| tena dhātvarthanirdeśe'pi siddho bhavati| aparo'rthaḥ rogākhyāyā viṣayāṇṇvulo vidheryo'nyatrāpyasya lakṣaṇasya viṣaye vṛttirvyabhicāraḥ saḥ, tadarthaṃ bahulagrahaṇam| tena `ikśtipau dhātunirdaśe'(vā.319) ityevamādi sarvaṃ saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavati| `pracchardikā' iti| `charda vamane'(dhā.1589) curādiḥ| `pravāhikā'iti| `vaha prāpaṇe'(dhā.pā.1004)| `pracarcikā' iti| `carca adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1712) curādiḥ| atra vaheḥ ktini prāpte ṇvul,itarayostu yuci| `śiro'stiḥ' iti| `arda hiṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1828), `arda {gatau yācane ca' -dhā.pā.} gatau' (dhā.pā.55) iti vā| `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam| śirasā saha ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, `sasajuṣo ruḥ'(8.2.66), `ato roraplutādaplute' (6.1.113) ityuttvam, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), `eṅaḥ padāntādati' (6.1.109) ityete vidhayaḥ karttavyāḥ| `ikśtipau'iti| kakāraḥ kitkāryārthaḥ, tena pacatiriti sārvadhātukanibandhanaḥ śabbhavati| nanu ca karttṛvācini sārvadhātuke śabvidhīyate; na cātra karttā pratyayārthaḥ;tatkutaḥ śapaḥ sambhavaḥ ? sārvadhātukasaṃjñārthaśitkaraṇasāmārthyādakarttṛvācinyapi sārvadhātuke śabbhaviṣyati;anyathā hi śitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| yadyevam, yagapi syāt ? anabhidhānānna bhaviṣyati| `varṇātkāraḥ' iti| varṇādityucyate, tatraivakāra iti na sidhyati ? bahulagrahaṇasannidhau vacanāt kvacidavarṇādapi bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| atha vā karaṇaṃ kāraḥ, evasya kāraiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam| `matvarthācchaḥ' iti| atrākāralopaśca vaktavyaḥ| abhasaṃjñatvaddhi na prāpnoti| bahulagrahaṇādvākāralopo bhaviṣyati| `iṇajādibhyaḥ' (iti)| `ik kṛṣyādibhyaḥ' iti| adhātunirdeśārthametat| ājyādayaḥ śabdāḥ saṃjñāśabdā draṣṭavyāḥ|| 109. saṃjñāyām| (3.3.109) `uddālakapuṣpabhañjikā' iti| `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ' (2.2.17) iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṣaṣṭhī punaratra `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti kṛdyogalakṣaṇā|| 110. vibhāṣākhyānaparipraśnayoriñ ca| (3.3.110) iha sūtre pūrvamākhyānasya nirdeśaḥ, paścāt paripraśnasya; vṛttau tu `paripraśne cākhyāne ca gamyamāne'iti pūrva paripraśnasoyapanyāsaḥ,paścādākhyānasya; tatra yaścodayet--kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vṛttau viparyayaḥ kṛtaḥ ? iti, taṃ pratyāha-- `pūrvaṃ paripraśnaḥ'ityādi| paripraśnapūrvakaṃ vyākhyānaṃ bhavati, ato vṛttau pūrvaṃ paripraśnasya tadudāharaṇasya copanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ, paścādākhyānasya| kramavyatikrame prayojanābhāvādityābhiprāyaḥ| sūtre tarhi kasmāt pūrvaṃ paripraśno na nirdiṣṭaḥ, paścādākhyānamityāha-- `sūtre' ityādi| `alpāctaram' (2.2.34) iti sūtreṇa dvandve padānāṃ kramasya niyatvādalpāctarasyākhyānaśabdasya sūtre pūrvanipātaḥ kṛta iti darśayati| `kāṃ kārim'iti| iñ| `kāṃ kārikām' iti| ṇvul | `kāṃ kriyām' iti| `kṛñaḥ śa ca' (3.3.100) iti śaḥ| `kāṃ kṛtyām' iti| tatra cakārāt kyap| `kāṃ kṛtim' iti| yogavibhagāt ktin kṛtaḥ| `kāṃ gaṇim' iti| iñ| `gaṇa saṃkhyāne' (dhā.pā.1853) curādāvadantaḥ paṭhyate| `kāṃ gaṇikām' iti| ṇvul| `gaṇanām'iti| yuc| evam--`kāṃ pācim' ityādi| `kāṃ pācimakārṣīḥ', `kāṃ pācikām' , `kāṃ pacām'| `kāṃ yājim' , `kāṃ yājikām' ityādi, kāmiṣṭim| `kāṃ pāṭhim' , `kāṃ pāṭhikām' `kāṃ paṭhitim' iti|| 111. paryāyārhaṇotpattiṣu ṇvuc| (3.3.111) `ktinnādīnāmapavādaḥ'iti| ādiśabdenākārādīnām| `agragāmikā' iti| agrasya gāmikā| kṛdyogalakṣaṇāyāḥ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaḥ| `svarārtham' iti| antodāttatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| ṇvuli hi sati pratyayāt pūrvamudāttaḥ syāt|| 112. ākrośe nañyaniḥ| (3.3.112) 113. kṛtyulyuṭo bahulam| (3.3.113) `yatra vihitāstato'nyatrāpi bhavanti' iti| yadyevam‌, `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' (3.4.70) ityevamāderarthanirdeśasyānarthakatvaṃ jāyate ? naitadasti; yogato hi kṛtyādayo bhāvādiṣvartheṣviṣyante, kārakāntare tvalpaḥ| sā ca tathā teṣāṃ vṛttiranarthanirdeśe sati sidhyatīti kutastasyānarthakyam ! `snānīyam' iti| karaṇe kṛtyaḥ| `dānīyaḥ'iti| dīyate tasmai iti sampradāne| `apasecanam' iti| apasicyate taditi karmaṇi lyuṭ| `avasrāvaṇam' iti| `avasrāvyate taditi `sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.935) ityasmāṇṇyantāt karmaṇi lyuṭ| bhujyataiti `bhojanāḥ'| ācchādyanta iti `ācchādanāni' | karmaṇyeva lyuṭ| rājño bhojanā rājña ācchādanānīti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `praskandanam, prapatanam'iti| praskandati, prapatatyasmādityapādāne lyuṭ| atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā sūtrārambhasāmarthyādeva kṛtyulyuṭo yatra vihitā stato'nyatrāpi prāyeṇa bhavantītyeṣo'rtho vijñāyata evetyata āha-- `bahulagrahaṇāt' ityādi| etenānye'pi kṛto yatra vihitāstato'nyatrāpyabhidheya iṣyante, tacca bahulagrahaṇāt sidhyati| ato bahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti sūcayati| `pādahārakaḥ'iti| karttari ṇvul vihito bahulagrahaṇādiha karmaṇi bhavati|| 114. napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ| (3.3.114) `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ ' (3.4.70) iti bhāve ktaḥ siddhaḥ| napuṃsake bhāve'pi kto'yaṃ viśeṣavihitena lyuṭā bādhyata iti yogarambhaḥ|| 115. lyuṭ ca| (3.3.115) `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ'iti| uttaratra lyuṭa evānuvṛttiryathā syāt, ktasya mā bhūt|| 116. karmaṇi cayena saṃsparśātkarttuḥ śarīrasukham| (3.3.116) `nityasamāsārthaṃ vacanam' iti| nityaḥ samāso'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat tathoktam| kathaṃ punaretadvacanaṃ nityasamāsārthaṃ bhavatītyāha-- `upapadasamāso hi nityasamāsaḥ' iti| anena hi sūtreṇa karmaṇyupapade pratyayo vidhīyata iti, `upapadamatiṅ'(2.2.19) ityupapadasamāso bhaviṣyati, sa ca nityaḥ;tadvidhau `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ'(2.2.17) ityato nityagarhaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `payaḥ pānaṃ sukham' iti| kathaṃ punaretadasyodāharaṇaṃ bhavati ? yāvatā nātra saṃsparśāt sukhamutpadyate, kiṃ tarhi ? abhyavahārāt;naiṣa doṣaḥ;sarve hi te'bhyavahārādayo na vinā sparśena na bhavatīti nāntarīyakatvāt sparśo nāpekṣyate| `tūlikāyā utthānaṃ sukham' iti| `udaḥ sthāstambhoḥ pūrvasya'(8.4.61) iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ| astīha karttuḥ śarīrasukham, na tu karmaṇā saṃspṛśyamānasya, kiṃ tarhi ? apādānena tūlikākhyena| `agnikuṇḍasyopāsanam' iti| `āsa upadeśane' (dhā.pā.1021) upapūrvaḥ| atrāsparśāt sukhaṃ bhavati; agnikuṇḍenopāsyamānenopaspṛśyamānasyaiva tadutpatteḥ| `guroḥ snāpanam' iti| `ṣṇā śauce' (dhā.pā.1053), hetumaṇmic| `arttihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk| nanu cātrāpi guruḥ sukhasya karttā bhavatītyastīha karttuḥ sukham| tatkathamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha--`snāpayaterna guruḥ' iti| anenataddarśayati-- nātra sukhāpekṣaṃ karttṛtvaṃ vivakṣitam, kiṃ tarhi ? kriyāpekṣam| na cātra snāpanakriyāyā guruḥ karttā, kiṃ tarhi ? śiṣyaḥ, tasya ca guruḥ karmaiva bhavati| karmasaṃjñā punarguroḥ `gatibuddhi' (1.4.52) ityādisūtreṇa; tasyākarmake snātāvaṇynate karttatvāt| `pariṣvañjanam' iti| `ṣvanja pariṣvaṅge' (dhā.pā.976), `upasargāt sunoti' (8.3.65) ityādinā mūrdhanyaḥ| `mānasī prītiḥ'iti| tena putrapariṣvañjanajanmanaḥ prītiviśeṣasya śarīrasukhatvaṃ darśayati| `mardanam' iti| `mṛda kṣode' (dhā.pā.1515)| `sarvatrāsamāsaḥ pratyudāhriyate'iti| na tu lyuḍabhāvaḥ| lyuṭaḥ pūrvasūtreṇa sarvatra bhāvāt|| 117. karaṇadhikaraṇayośca| (3.3.117) `karaṇe'dhikaraṇe ca kārake' ityanena karaṇādhikaraṇayoḥ pratyayārthatvaṃ darśayati| atropapade karaṇādhikaraṇe kasmānna bhavataḥ ? `karaṇādhikaraṇayoḥ'ityata eva nirdeśāt| karaṇādhikaraṇaśabdau hi lyuḍantau karaṇādhikaraṇasādhanau ca| tatra dadyupapadatvametayoḥ syādeṣa nirdeśo nopapadyate| yadyevam, sati nirdeśe pratyayavidhānaṃ ca , sati ca tasmin nirdeśa itītaretarāśrayatvaṃ prasajyeta ? na; nityatvācchabdānām| na hyapūrvaṃ kiñcidutpadyate; śabdānāṃ nityatvāt| sattāmeva tu teṣāmanvākhyānaṃ kriyate iti itaretarāśrayatāyāḥ prasaṅgaḥ| `idhmapravraścanaḥ' iti| `ovraścūchedane' (dhā.pā.1292), idhmānāṃ pravraścana iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `palāśaśātanaḥ' iti| `śadlṛ śātane' (dhā.pā.1428), `hetumaṇṇic, `śaderagatau taḥ' (7.3.42) iti tatvam| `godohanī' iti| `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp|| 118. puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa| (3.3.118) `samudāyeṇa cet' ityādi| prakṛtipratyayasamudāyena yadi saṃjñā gamyata evaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyathā| `akārtsnyārtham' iti| akārtsnyam - asākalyam, prayojanamartho yasya tat tathoktam| etenākṛtsnaviṣayatāṃ pratyayasya darśayati| `dantacchadaḥ' iti| `chada apavāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1935), curādiṇic| `chāderghe'dvayupasargasya' (6.4.96) iti hrasvaḥ, pūrvavat samāsaḥ| `prasādhanam'iti| `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau' (dhā.pā.1262), 1263), asmāddhetumaṇṇyantāt pūrvasūtreṇa karaṇe lyuṭ, `kugatiprādayaḥ (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ|| 119. gocarasañcaravahavrajavyajāpaṇanigamāśca| (3.3.119) `pūrvasminnevārthe' iti| karaṇe'dhikaraṇe ca| nanu pūrvasūtreṇaiva gocarādiṣu ghaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkimityayaṃ yoga ārabhyate ? ityāha-- `halaśca' ityādi| nanu ca pratyayagrahaṇaṃ tatrānuvartiṣyate, tena gocarādiṣu ghañ bhaviṣyati ? pratipattigauravaṃ tu syāta; prāyagrahaṇānuvṛtterajñāpakatvāt|| 120. ave tṝstrorghañ| (3.3.120) `stṛṇāteḥ'iti| `stṛñ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1484) ityasmāt| `prāyānuvṛtteḥ' ityādi| prāyaśabdasyānuvṛttau satyāmeva upapade tṛstrorghañpratyayo bhavati saṃjñāyāṃ prāyeṇopadhibhūtāyāmityeṣo'rtho labhyate| `na saṃjñāyām'iti| asyopādheḥ prāyikatvāt kvacidasaṃjñāyāmapi bhavati|| 121. halaśca| (3.3.121) `veṣṭaḥ' iti| `veṣṭa veṣṭane' (dhā.pā.255)| `mārgo'pāmārgaḥ' iti| `{mṛjū-dhā.pā.} (dhā.pā.1066)| `cajoḥ (7.3.52) ityādinā kutvam, mṛjervṛddhiḥ, (7.2.114) `upasargasya ghañi' (6.3.122) iti dīrghaḥ|| 122. adhyāyanyāyodyāvasaṃhārādhārāvāyāśca| (3.3.122) `ahalantārtha ārambhaḥ'iti| halantebhyaḥ pūrvasūtreṇaiva siddhatvāt|| 123. udaṅko'nudake| (3.3.123) `nanu ca' ityādi codyam| `udakapratiṣedhārthaṃ vacanam'iti parihāraḥ| yadyetannārabhyeta tadodake'pi pūrveṇa syādityarthaḥ| `tailodaṅkaḥ'iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṣaṣṭhī punaḥ karmaṇi kṛdyogalakṣaṇā| `udakoñcanaḥ' iti| karame lyuṭ| `ghaḥ kasmāt' ityādi| evaṃ manyate-- `puṃsi saṃjñāyām' (3.3.118) ityādinā ghe prāpte ghañ vihitaḥ, tataśca tena mukte viṣaye ghanaiva yuktaṃ bhavitumiti| `viśeṣābhāvāt' iti| na hyatrāñcaterghañi ghe vā sati viśeṣo'sti| tatra yadyudake'pi ghaḥ syādanukapratiṣedhenārtho na syādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca ghe sati pratyayasvareṇāntodātta udaṅkaśabdo bhavati, ghañaḍhi sati ñitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ syāt, tat kimucyate viśeṣābhāvādityata āha-- `ghañyapi' ityādi| `thāthādisvareṇa' iti| thāthaghañktājabitrakāṇām' (6.2.144) ityetadvihitena|| 124. jālamānāyaḥ| (3.3.124) 125. khano gha ca| (3.3.125) `ḍo vaktavyaḥ'ityādi| sarvatra vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeya ityeṣo'rthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam- cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena ḍādayo'pi pratyayā bhaviṣyantīti| nanu ca ghañanukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ ? naitadasti; svaritatvādeva hi ghañapatiṣṭhate| atha kimarthaṃ khanerghaḥ pratyayo vidhīyate, yāvatā kutvārthaṃ tasya vidhānam, na ca khaneḥ kaścidavayavaḥ kutvabhāgasti ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavatīti| tena khalaḥ,bhagam, padamityevamādayaḥ siddhā bhavanti|| 126. īṣad‌duḥsuṣu kṛcchrārtheṣu khal| (3.3.126) `taditarayoḥ'iti| suśabdeṣacchabdayoḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyoktenāpi viśeṣo labhyate ? ityāha-- sambhavāt'iti| yatra yasya sambhavastatra tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| kṛcchrameva duḥśabdasyārthe varttate, nākṛcchram| itarayostvarthe'kṛcchrameva varttaite na kṛcchram| tasmāt kṛcchraṃ dura eva viśeṣaṇam, akṛcchra tvitarayoreva| `īṣātkaraḥ kaṭo bhavatā' iti| akṛcchreṇāyatnena kriyate bhavatā kaṭa ityarthaḥ| `īṣatkāryaḥ'iti| `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) iti ṇyat| īṣacchabdo'tra manāgityasyārthe varttateta| `lakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| liti pratyayāt pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| nanu ca hrasvādikaṃ khitkāryaṃ `khityanavyayasya' (6.3.66) ityevamādiśāstreṇānavyayasya vidhīyate; īṣadādayaścāvyayasaṃsajñāḥ; tatkimarthaṃ khalaḥ, khitkaraṇamityāha-- `khitkaraṇamuttaratra mumartham' iti|uttaratrānavyaye'pyupapade khal vidhāsyate, tatra `arūrdviṣadajantasya mum' (6.3.67) iti mum yathā syādityevamarthaṃ khitkaraṇam|| 127. karttṛkarmaṇośca bhūkṛñoḥ| (3.3.127) karttṛkarmaṇorupapadatvaṃ bhavati, na tu pratyayārtham| yadi ca tayoḥ pratyayārthatvaṃ syādīṣadādiṣvevopapadeṣu pratyayaḥ syāt, tataśca khitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; anavyayasya khitkāryavidhānāt| īṣādādīnāñcāvyayatvāt; tasmādato'pi khitkaraṇam| upapade karttṛkarmaṇī, na tu pratyayārthāvetāvityavasīyate| atra ca karttṛkarmaṇī īṣadādayaśca na pratyekaṃ pratyayasya nimittam, kiṃ tarhi ? tatsamudāyaḥ| cakāreṇa hyatar sanniyogaḥ kriyate, tena karttṛkarmaṇorīṣadādīnāñca yugapadupapadatvaṃ bhavati; nānyathā| yadyevam, kathaṃ dvayorupapadayoryugapat samāsaḥ ? kaḥ punarāha-- yugapat samāsa iti ? pūrvaṃ hi parasyopapadasya samāsaṃ kṛtvā paścāt pūrvasya samāso bhavati| kiṃ punaratra paramupapadam ? karttṛkarmaṇī| kuta etat ? khitkaraṇasāmarthyāt| khitkaraṇaṃ hi mumartham, mumāgamaścānavyayasya vidhīyate| tatreṣadādīnāṃ dhātoścānantarye khitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `īṣadāḍhyambhavaṃ bhavatā' iti| akṛcchramāḍhyena bhayate bhavatetyarthaḥ| `īṣadāḍhyaṅkaro devadatto bhavatā' iti| akṛcchramāḍhyaḥ kriyate devadatto bhavatetyarthaḥ| `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ'ityādi| cvyartho'bhūtatadbhāvaḥ| tadarthayoḥ karttṛkarmaṇorupapadayoḥ khala bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- prāyagrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttate, tena yadā karttṛkarmaṇī cvyarthe bhavatastadaiva pratyayo bhavati, nānyadeti| `svāḍhyena bhūyate' iti| atra cvyarthasyāvivakṣitatvāt pratyayo na bhavati|| 128. āto yuc| (3.3.128) 129. chandasi gatyarthebhyaḥ| (3.3.129) `sūpasadanam' iti| `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu' (dhā.pā.854), upapūrvaḥ|| 130. anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate| (3.3.130) `sudohanam' iti| `duha prapūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1014)| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- apiśabdo'tra kriyate, sa ca sarvavyabhicārārthaḥ, tena `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075), `yudha samprahāre' (dhā.pā.1173), `dṛśir prekṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.988), `ñidhṛṣā prāgalbhye' (dhā.pā.1269), `mṛṣa titikṣāyām' (dhā.pā.1164)-- ityetebhyo'pi bhāṣāyāṃ yujbhavatīti| kathaṃ punaretadavasitam-- `sarvavyabhicārārtho'piśabda iti ? sūtrārambhāt| yadi hi gatyarthavyabhicāra evātrābhisaṃhitaḥ syāt, sūtramidaṃ nārabheta| pūrvasūtra eva ca gatyarthagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt|| 131. varttamānasāmīpye varttamānavadvā| (3.3.131) yadi samīpasya bhāvo'bhidhīyeta taddhi syāt, evaṃ sati varttamānasya sāmīpyena ca samāso na syāt; sambandhābhāvāt| na hi sāmīpyasya varttamānena sambandhaḥ, api tu tatsamīpena; tasya tadguṇatvāt| tasmāt svārtha evāyamiha bhaviṣyatīti matvāha''ha-- samīpameva sāmīpyam' iti| kimarthaṃ punaḥ svārthikaṃ ṣyañaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate, na varttamānasamīpa evocyeta yato lāghavaṃ bhavati ? ityata āha-- `ṣyañaḥ svārthikatvaṃ jñāpyate' iti|svārthe ṣyañapi syādaneneti| svārthe ṣyañ bhavatītyamumarthaṃ jñāpayituṃ svārthikaḥ ṣyañ kṛta iti| `cāturvarṇyādisiddhyartham' iti| anenāpi jñāpanasya prayojanamucyate| ādiśabdena cāturāśramyādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `ayamāgacchāmi' iti| ayamāgamamityasyārtha etadvarttate| `āgamam' iti| luṅa, uttamaikavacanam, `tasthasthamipām' (3.4.101) ityādinā mipo'mbhāvaḥ, puṣādisūtreṇa (3.1.55) cleraṅa| `eṣa gacchāmi' iti| eṣa gamiṣyāmītyasyārtha idaṃ varttate| `gameriṭ parasmaipadeṣu' (7.2.58) itīṭ| `gantāsmi'iti| luṭ, tāsiḥ, mip| atha vatkaraṇaṃ kimartham, yatvatā `varttamānasāmīpye varttamāne' ityucyamāne varttamānakālavihitāḥ pratyayā varttamānasāmīpye bhavantītyeṣo'rtho labhyata evatyata āha-- `vatkaraṇam' ityādi| asati vatkaraṇe varttamānakālena rūpamātrameṣāṃ pratyayānāmupalakṣyate, na tu prakṛtyādaya upādīyeran, tataśca dhātumātrāt syuḥ| vatkaraṇe tu sati sarvasādṛśyaṃ gamyate; tatraiva vatervidhānāt, tena saṅkaro na bhavati| tamevana saṅkarābhāvaṃ darśayitumāha-- `yena 'ityādi| evaṃ hi sarvasādṛśyaṃ bhavati yadi yena viśeṣaṇena varttamāne vihitāstenaiva varttamānasāmīpye bhavanti, nānyathā| `prakṛtyopapadopādhinā' iti| ādiśbdenopādherabidheyasya ca grahaṇam| `pavamānaḥ, yajamānaḥ'iti| `pūṅyajoḥ śānan' (3.2.128) vihitaḥ,sa varttamānasāmīpye'pi tābhyāmeva bhavati, na dhātvantarāt| `alaṅgariṣṇuḥ' iti| tācchīlyādiviśiṣṭe karttaryalampūrvāt kṛña iṣṇudvihitaḥ, varttamānasāmīpye'pi tatpūrvādeva bhavati| tasminneva cārthe `parudagacchat' ityatra viprakarṣavivakṣāyāṃ laṅeva bhavati| `varṣeṇa gamiṣyati' iti| atrāpi lṛḍeva bhavati| `yo manyate' ityādināpi pratipattṛviśeṣaṃ prati sūtraṃ pratyācaṣṭe| `kālāntaragatistu' ityādi| kālāntaraṃ varttamānasamīpo bhūto bhaviṣyaṃśca kālaḥ, tasya yā gatiḥ - pratītiḥ| āgacchāmītyasya padasya varttamānakālaviśeṣe'pyayaṃ gacchāmītyato vākyāt kadā devadatta gamiṣyasītyedvākyasamanantaraṃ prayujyamānādbhavati| vākyagamyo'pi kālo yadi padasaṃskāravelāyāmupayujyate yujyeta sūtrārambhaḥ, na cāsau tatropayujyate; yasmācchāstreṇa padasya saṃskāraḥ kriyate, na vākyasya| pade saṃskriyamāṇe tadgamya eva kāla upayujyate, tena vākyagamya ityabhiprāyaḥ| itikaraṇaḥ prakṛtapratyavamarśaka iti| evaṃ yo manyate - avagacchati taṃ pratīdaṃ nārabdhavyameva| yadarthamārabhyate teṣāṃ pratyayānāṃ `varttamāne laṭ' (3.2.123) ityādinaiva śāstreṇāsiddhatvāt| prakaraṇagrahaṇena kevalamidaṃ sūtraṃ nārabdhavyam, api tu `aśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca' (3.3.132) ityevamādīnyapi nārabdhavyanīti darśayati| `tādṛśam'ityādi| evañca yastu tādṛśaḥ pratipattā na bhavati mandabuddhistaṃ pratyārabdhavyamevetyuktaṃ bhavati| na hyasāvevaṃ nyāyena pratipattuṃ samarthaḥ| `tathā ca' ityādi| yasmāt tatraivaṃ vākyagamyaḥ kālaḥ padasaṃskāravelāyāṃ nopayujyate, evañca sati śvaḥ kariṣyatītyemādyupapadyate| tatrāpi hi kariṣyatītyetat padaṃ bhaviṣyatyeva kāle varttata iti `lṛṭ śeṣe ca' (3.3.13) ityeva lṛṭ siddhaḥ| bhaviṣyadanadyatanastu kālo'yam| yadyuttarakālaḥ pratīyate tathāpyasau vākyārtha iti padasaṃskāre nāśrīyate| yadi tu vākyagamyo'pi kālaḥ padasaṃskāre samāśrīyeta, tadā tu kariṣyatītyevamādi nopapadyeta-- bhaviṣyadanadyatane luṭaiva bhavitavyamiti kṛtvā|| 132. āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca| (3.3.132) `āgamat' iti| luṅa| āgata iti niṣṭhā| `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ| `adhīmahe' iti| iṅo luṭ, mahiṅ, adāditvācchapo (2.4.72) luk| `adhyagīṣmahi' iti| luṅa, `vibhāṣā luṅalṛṅoḥ' (2.4.50) itīṅo gāṅādeśaḥ, gāṅakuṭādinā (1.2.1) sico ṅittvāt `ghumāsthā' (6.4.66) ityādinettvam| bhūtavaccetyādideśe laṅaliṭāvapi prāpnutaḥ, tau kasmānna bhavata ityāha-- `sāmānyātideśe' ityādi| bhatasāmānyātideśo'yam, bhūtaviśeṣapratyayau ca laṅaliṭau| sāmānyātideśe viśeṣasyānatideśaḥ, tena tāviha na bhavataḥ|| 133. kṣipravacane lṛṭ| (3.3.133) `bhūtavaccetyacasyāyamapavādaḥ'iti| na prāpte bhūtavaccetyasminnasyārambhāt| atha vacanagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? yāvatā kṣipre lṛḍityenenaiva sarvaṃ siddhamityata āha-- `vacanagrahaṇaṃ paryāyārtham'iti| asati hi vacanagrahaṇe kṣipraśabda evopapade lṛṭ syāt, tasmiṃstu sati yāvantaḥ kṣipravacanāsteṣu sarveṣu bhavati| atha lṛḍgrahaṇaṃkimartham, na kṣipravacana ityevocyeta, bhūtavaccetyasyātideśasya bhaviṣyatkālaviṣayatvāt tasmin pratiṣidodhe `laṭ śeṣe ca'(3.3.13) ityenenaiva siddhaḥ? ityāha--`neti vaktavye'ityādi| neti vaktavye yallṛḍ‌grahaṇaṃ kriyate tasyaitat prayojanam-- luṭo'pi viṣaye bhaviṣyadanadyatane kāle `lṛḍ‌ yathā syāt, anyathā, hi lṛḍapavādo luḍeva syāt|| 134. āśaṃsāvacane liṅ| (3.3.134) `āśaṃse yukto'dhīyīya' iti|iṅaḥ liṅaḥ sīyuṭa, uttamapuruṣaikavacanam, iṭ, `iṭo't'(3.4.106) ityadbhāvaḥ `sārvadhātukamapit'(1.2.4) iti ṅittvādguṇābhāvaḥ, `liṅa salopo'nantasya'(7.2.79) iti sakāralopaḥ, dhātoriyaṅ, upasargeṇa saha `akaḥ sarvaṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101)| `āśaṃse kṣipramadhīyīya'iti | atra yadyapi kṣipravacanamupapadamāśaṃsāvacanamapi, tathāpi paratvālliṅeva bhavati, na lṛṭa| tasya tu yatrāśaṃsāvacanamupapadaṃ nāsti so'vakāśaḥ-- `kṣipramadhyeṣāmahe'iti|| 135.nānadyatanavatkriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ| (3.3.135) `kālānāṃ sāmīpyam'ityenana kālasambdhi sāmīpyamihāśrīyata iti darśayati| kutaḥ punaḥ sāmānyoktena kālasambandhina eva sāmīpyasya grahaṇaṃ labhyate ? varttamānasāmīpya ityata ārabhya prāyikatvādasya prakaraṇasya| etadapi kutaḥ ? varttamānādiśabdānāṃ kālaśabdatvāt| api ca laṅaluṭoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, tau ca kālavihitau| ato yatra hi tau, tatra tatsambandhenaiva kālasāmīpyamihāśrīyata iti vijñāyate| tatpunaḥ kīdṛśamityāha-- `tulyajātīyena'ityādi| tulyajātīyagrahaṇaṃ bhinnajātīyanivṛttyartham| kālamātreṇa vyavadhānena gṛhyamāṇe yeyaṃ paurṇamāsyatikrāntā tasyāmupādhyāyo'gnīnādhitetyevamādāvudāharaṇe sāmīpyaṃ na syāt; amāvāsyayā anyābhiśca tithibhyarvyavadhānāt| tasmāt samānajātīyenāvyavadhānamaśrīyate| `adāt' iti| `gātisthā'(2.4.77) ityādinā sico luk| `adhyāpipat' iti| `hetumati ca'(3.1.26) iti ṇic| `krīṅajīnāṃ ṇau' (6.1.48) ityāttvam, `arttihrī'(7.3.36) ityādinā puk, luṅa, cleḥ `ṇi śrī'(3.1.48) ityādinā caṅa, `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti pītyetasya dvirvacanam, `āḍajādīnām' (6.4.72) ityāṭ, `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ, ṇico lopaḥ| `yeyaṃ paurṇamāsyatikrāntā' iti| paurṇamāsyantareṇāvyavahitā yā paurṇamāsī, tāmadhikṛtyedamāha| sā hi yadyapyamāvāsyayā anyābhiśca tithibhirvyavahitā, tathāpi tulyajātīyena paurṇamāsyākhyena kālenāvyavahitatvāt sāmīpyaṃ nātivarttate| `agnīnādhita' iti| dadhāterāṅapūrvasya `sthāghvoricca'(1.2.17)itīttvam, sicaśca kitvam, `hrasvādaṅgāt' (8.2.27) iti sico lopaḥ| `adita'iti| dadāte rūpam| pūrvavat| `yakṣyate'iti|yajerlalṛṭ‌, syaḥ, tasmin parastathā ṣaṣve kṛte `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si'(8.2.41) iti katvam| `ādhita' ityādau sarvatra `svaritañitaḥ'(1.3.72) ityādinā''tmanepadam| kimarthaṃ pratiṣedhadvyamucyate, `nādyatanavat kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ'ityevocyeta ? kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayorhyadyatanapratyayau luṅalṛṭāviṣyete, nānadyatanapratyayau laṅalṛṭau| tau ca laṅaluṭāvevamucyamāne sidhyata evetyata āha-- `dvau pratiṣedhau' ityādi| evaṃ manyate-- yadi `nādyanavat kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ'ityevocyeta tadaitadevaṃ sūtraṃ vidhāyakaṃ syāt, tataśca saṅkaraḥ prasajyeta-- luṅo'pi viṣaye lṛṭ, lṛṭaśca viṣaye luṅa| na hyatrāyaṃ viśeṣa upādīyate| bhūte luṅa bhaviṣyati lṛḍiti pratiṣedhaviṣaya ucyamāne nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, tato nānena kiñcidvidhīyate, kevalamanadyatanapratyayānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, teṣu pratiṣiddheṣu svaireva vākyairvidhāyakairluṅādaya utsargāḥ sve svekāle'pavādavinirmukte bhavanti| ato yathāprāptābhyanujñāpanāya pratiṣedhadvayamucyate|| 136. bhaviṣyati maryādāvacane'varasmin| (3.3.136) `maryādāvacane sati' iti| vacanagrahaṇamabhividhāvapi yathā syāt| maryādāviśeṣa evābhividhiśca| saiva maryādā yadā kāryeṇābhisambaddhyate tadā'bhividhirityucyate, yadā tu na sambaddhyate tadā maryādeti| tatreha vacanagrahaṇādviśeṣo nāśrīyate, tena maryādāyā uktimātre bhavati| vināpi vacanagrahaṇenābhividhau pratiṣedho na bhavet; yasmādyatrābhividhau kāryamicchati tatrābhividhigrahaṇaṃ vā karoti, yathā-- `āṅ maryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.1.13) itii; vacanagrahaṇaṃ vā, yathā-- `āṅ maryādāvacane' (1.4.89) iti| tadabhividhāvapi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ vacanagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| `avarasmin' iti| arvāgityarthaḥ| `gantavyaḥ'iti| bhaviṣyatkātāmadhvano darśayati| `tasya yadavaram' iti| anenādhvano vibhāgaṃ `dviḥ' iti| etenāpi kriyāpratibandhābhāvam| `bhokṣyamahe' iti| `bhujo'navane' (1.3.66) ityātmanepadam, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti gakāraḥ, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti gakārasya kakāraḥ| `adhyaimahi' iti| mahiṅa, `āḍajādīnām' (6.4.72) ityāṭ, `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ, upasargasya (6.1.77) yaṇādeśaḥ| `apibāma' iti| pāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) pibādeśaḥ, `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' (3.4.99) iti sakāralopaḥ| `bhoktāsmahe' iti| luṭ| `tatraca viśeṣaṃ vakṣyati' iti| anahorātrāṇāmityanena (3.3.137)|| 137. kālavibhāge cānahorātrāṇām| (3.3.137) `kālamaryādāvibhāge sati' iti maryādāvibhāgaśabdayoḥ sayāhāre dvandvaḥ| tena kālaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `teṣāñca' iti| taisteṣāñceti yuktaṃ yat teṣāṃ vibhāge pratiṣedho bhavati; tatsambandhitvādvibhāgasya| yadā tairanyasya vibhāgastadā na yuktam, na hi tadā tatsambandhī vibhāgaḥ| kiṃ tarhi ? vibhajyamānasambandhī| tathāpyahorātrakṛtatvādvibhāgasya sambandhitvamastyeva; nimittasya naimittikasambandhādityadoṣaḥ| yadi vacanamahorātrapratiṣedhārtham, evaṃ ca sāmarthyāt kālavibhāgasyaiva pratiṣedho vijñāsyate, na deśavibhāgasya, na hi deśavibhāgasyāhaurātraiḥ saha sambandhostītyata āha-- `yogāvibhāga uttarārthaḥ'iti| uttarasūtre kālavibhāga eva yathā syādityevamartham, deśavibhāge mā bhūditi| `abhuñjmahi' iti| `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ| `trividhimudāharaṇam' iti| tatra prathame śabdāntaravācyasya kālasyāhorātrairvibhāgaḥ, dvitīye'horātravācyasya śabdāntaravācyayena kālena vibhāgaḥ, tṛtīye'horātravācyasya kālasyorātravācyena kālena| `sarvathā' iti| sarveṇa prakāreṇa| yadyahorātrairanyasya vibhāgo'thadhāpyanyena teṣāṃ yadyahorātraireva teṣāmevamapi pratiṣedha iti sarvathāśabdasyārthaḥ| `ahorātrasaṃsparśaḥ' iti| ahotrāṇāṃ vibhāgena sambandha - ahorātrasaṃsparśa iti| 138. parasminvibhāṣā| (138) `sarvatrānadyatanavatpratyayā udāharttavyāḥ' iti| bhūtānadyatane-- tatra yuktā adhyaimahi, tatrodanamabhuñjmahīti sarvatra luṅadāharttavyaḥ| bhaviṣyadanadyatane tu-tatra yuktā adhyetāsmahe, tatraudanaṃ bhoktāsmaha iti sarvatra luḍudāharttavyaḥ|| 139. liṅanimitte lṛṅ kriyātipattau| (3.3.139) `ityevamādikam' iti| ādiśabdena `kathami liṅa ca' (3.3.143) ityevamādayo gṛhyante| `kutaścidvaigūṇyāt' iti| vidhurapratyayopanipātāt, kāraṇāntaravaikalyādvā| `āyāsyat' iti| `syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ' (3.1.33) iti syapratyayaḥ| `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ| `āhvāsyat' iti| `hveñ {spardhāyāṃ śabde ca--dhā.pā.} spardhāyām' (dhā.pā.1008)| `{vāstīdamudāharaṇaṃ kāśikāyām} paryāsiṣyata' iti| `āsa upaveśane' (dhā.pā.1021), anudāttet| {tatra hetubhūtam-- kāśikā} taddhetubhūtam' iti| śakaṭaparyābhavanasya hetubhūtam| etena liṅanimittaṃ hetuhetumadbhāvaṃ darśayati| `liṅgiliṅgebudhvā' iti| asakṛt prāk kamalakāhvāne sati śakaṭasyāparyābhavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvino'pi kamalahvānasya śakaṭasyāparyāyabhavanasya hetubhūtatvaṃ hetubhūtatvaṃ liṅgena budhvā| liṅgaṃ punaḥ kamalakāhvānasāmānyaṃ dharmam| `tadatiparttiṃ ca' iti| kamalakāhvānasya śakaṭaparyābhavanasya cātipattim| tatra kamalakāhvānasya cātipattiṃ kamalakasya deśāntaragamanādinā liṅgenāvagamyate, śakaṭaparyābhavanasyātipattimatra śakaṭasya gurubhārāropaṇādinā| `ito vākyāt' iti| yadi kamalakamāhvāsyadityādevarvākyāt| atha kimarthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇam, na tvetadvaktavyam-- liṅ‌nimitte lṛṅatipattāviti, dhātvadhikārādvināpi kriyāgrahaṇena dhātvarthasyātipattāviti viśeṣo'rtho labhyate, tato'narthakaṃ kriyāgrahaṇamiti manyate;naitat; liṅanimitta iti śrūyate, prakṛtasya sambandhāccharuktasya sambandho balavāniti liṅanimittasyaivātipattirvijñāyate| tataśca `utāpyoḥ samarthayoḥ' (3.3.152) iti sāmarthyātipattāvutāpyoścātipattau liṅa prasajyeta| tasmāt kriyāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam|| 140. bhūte ca | (3.3.140) `utāpyarityārabhya'ityādi| `utāpyoḥ samarthayayoḥ' (3.3.152) ityetatprabhṛtiṣu liṅ‌nimitteṣu hyetallṛṅavidhānam| kuta etadityāha-- `prāk' ityādi| yasmāt prāk `votāpyoḥ' (3.3.141) iti vakṣyate, tataśca pāriśeṣyād‌bhūte liṅo vidhānaṃ `votāpyoḥ' (3.3.141) ityādiṣvevāvatiṣṭhate| `na tu bhuktavān' ityādi| kriyātiparttiṃ darśayati|| 141. votāpyoḥ| (3.3.141) `vā ā utāpyoḥ' iti| etenāṅa praśleṣaṃ darśayati| yadyoṅo'tra praśleṣaḥṣa votāpyoriti na prāpnoti, paratvādguṇe kṛte pūrveṇa saha vṛddhyā bhavitavyam ? sautratvānnirdeśasyetyadoṣaḥ| nipātanatvāt pūrveṇa sahaikādeśaṃ kṛtvā pareṇa sahādguṇaḥ (6.1.87) kariṣyate| nanu cāṅo yoge `pañcamyāpāṅparibhiḥ' (2.3.10) iti pañcamyā na ca padādāṅo yoge pañcamī bhavati; aprātipadikatvāt| `maryādāyām' ityādi| yadyabhividhau syāt `utāpyoḥ samarthayoḥ' (3.3.152) iti liṅ vikalpena prasajyeta, nityañceṣyate| tasmānmaryādāyāmayamāṅ, nābhividhau| `yathāprāptañca' iti| liṅādiḥ; vāgrahaṇāt|| 142. garhāyāṃ liḍapijātvoḥ| (3.3.142) `kālasāmānye na prāpnoti' iti| etena bhaviṣyatītyādeḥ kālaviśeṣavācito'nuvṛttiṃ sūcayannayaṃ kālasāmānye vidhiriti darśayati-- `kālaviśeṣavihitān' iti| bhūte kālaviśeṣe laṅaliṭau vihitau, bhaviṣyati luṅalṛṭau ca| tān sarvān kālasāmānye vidhīyamāno laṭ paratvādbādhate| `yājayati' iti| yajerhetumaṇṇyantāllaṭ| `liṅnimittābhāvāt' iti| hetuhetumadāderilaṅ‌nimittabhāvādiha yadyapi kriyātipattirvivakṣyate, tathāpi lṛṅa na bhavati|| 143. vibhāṣā kathami liṅ ca| (3.3.143) `vibhāṣāgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yasmin kāle lṛṅādayo vihitāsteṣāṃ bādhanaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇam| yadyevam, anarthakaścakāraḥ, vibhāṣāgrahaṇādeva hi laṭo'pyabādhitvāt sidhyatyeva ? satyaṃ sidhyati varttamāne, kālāntare tu na sidhyati| na hi tatra kathamityupapade laṭaḥ prāptiriti tat kathaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇena sidhyati ! tasmāllaḍarthaścakāraḥ karttavyaḥ|`yājayet' iti| liṅa| `yājayiṣyati' iti| lṛṭ| `ayīyajat' iti| luṅa, cleścaṅa, ṇau caṅi hrasvaḥ, ṇilopaḥ, `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti dvirvacanam, `sanyataḥ'(7.4.79) itīttvam| `ayājayat' iti| yājayāñcakāra' iti| liṭ| `kāspratyayāt' (3.1.35) ityām, `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti lerluk, tasyāvyayatvāt subaluk, `kṛñca' (3.1.40) ityādinā liṭa āmparasya kṛño'nuprayogaḥṣa ṇal, dvirvacanam, abhyāsakāryam, `ayāmanta' (6.4.55) ityādināyādeśaḥ| atra liṅ‌nimittamastīti kathamityetat garhā ca ? tadetadgarhāyāṃ liṅo vidhānādbhūtavivakṣāyāṃ kriyātipattau lṛṅiti bhūte ceti varttamāne `votāpyoḥ' (3.3.141) iti vacanādbhaviṣyadvivakṣāyāṃ sarvatra nityanaiva lṛṅā bhavitavyamiti; bhavitavyamiti; bhaviṣyatīti varttamāne `liṅ‌nimitte lṛṅ kriyātipattau (3.3.139) iti vacanāt|| 144. kiṃvṛtte liṅalṛṭau| (3.3.144) `kiṃvṛtte' iti| vṛttagrahaṇena tadvibhaktyantaṃ pratīyatate| `ḍataratamau ca' iti kiṃvṛtte ca lṛḍityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, prakṛto hi liṅ, tataścakāreṇa tasyaiva samucyayo vijñāsyate, kiṃ liṅ‌grahaṇenetyāha-- `liṅgrahaṇam' ityādi| asati hi liṅ‌grahaṇe yathā prakṛtvāccakāreṇa liṅa samuccīyate, tathā laḍapi samuccīyeta, so'pi hi prakṛta eva| tasmāllaṭo nivṛttyarthaṃ liṅagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam|| 145. anavaklṛptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛtte'pi| (3.3.145) atra dvāvarthau, pratyayāvapi dvāveva, tataśca yathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamiti kasyacid‌bhrāntiḥ syāt, atastannirākarttumāha-- `bahvacaḥ'ityādi| amarṣaśabdo hyanavaklaptiśabdāpekṣayālpāctaraḥ, tatra `alpāctaram' (2.2.34) iti tasya pūrvanipāte karttavye yo'yamiha vahvaco'navuklṛptiśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ kṛtaḥ sa lakṣaṇavyabhicārārthatāṃ darśayati| yatheha pūrvanipātalakṣaṇaṃ vyabhicārāt svaviṣaye na pravarttate, tathā yathāsaṃkhyalakṣamamapīti, tena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| apigrahaṇaṃ kiṃvṛtte'pi yathā syāt,anyathā hyakiṃvṛttagrahaṇe kiṃvṛtte na syāt| yadi yathā `upakādibhyo'nyatarasyām' (2.4.69) ityatrādvandvagrahaṇaṃ dvandvādhikāranivṛttyartham, tathehāpyakiṃvṛttagrahaṇaṃ kiṃvṛttādhikāranivṛttyarthaṃ syāt, tasminnivṛtte kiṃvṛtte'kiṃvṛtte pratyayadvayaṃ bhaviṣyatīti vyākhyāyate, tadā śakyate'pigrahaṇamakartum| tarhi tat kriyate vispaṣṭārtham|| 146. kiṃkilāstyartheṣu lṛṭ| (3.3.146) `kiṃkilaśabdaḥ samudāyaiti| etena kiṃkilaśabdayoḥ pratyekamṛpapadatvaṃ nirasyati, kasmāt punastayośca pratyekamupapadatvaṃ na bhavati ? kevalasya kiṃśabdasyānavaklaptyamarṣayorvṛtyasambhavāt, samudāyasya ca sambhavāt| `liṅgo'pavādaḥ' iti| pūrveṇa prāptasya| `liṅanimittamiha nāsti' iti| lṛṭa eva vidhānāt||| 147. jātuyadorliṅ| (3.3.147) `lṛṭo'pavādaḥ' iti| anavaklṛptyādisūtreṇa (3.3.145) prāptasya| `yadāyadyorupasaṃkhyānam' iti| liṅeva yathā syāt, lṛṅa mā bhūt| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanārthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam--anavaklaptyādi (3.3.145) sūtrādihāpiśabda'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena yadāyadyorapi bhaviṣyati|| 148. yaccayatrayo| (3.3.148) `lṛṭo'pavādaḥ' iti| anavaklṛptyādisūtreṇa (3.3.145) prāptasya| atha pūrvasūtra eva yaccayatrayorgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kṛtam, kiṃ yogavibhāgena ? ityata āha-- `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttaratra yaccayatrayorevānuvṛttiryathā syāt, jātuyadormā bhūt| `yathāsaṃkhyamiha neṣyate' iti| pūrvoktādeva lakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnāt| sa ca bahvacaḥ pūrvanipātaḥ sarvatraiva cātra prakaraṇe lakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnam, na tu tatraiva sūtre| atha vā-- yathāsaṃkhyārthasya svaritatvasyābhāvādiha na bhavati yathāsaṃkhyam| uktaṃ hi prāk-- `svaritena cihnena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati' iti|| 149. garhāyāṃ ca| (3.3.149) 150. citrīkaraṇe ca| (3.3.150) 151. śeṣe lṛḍyadau| (3.3.151) `yaccayatrābhyām' ityādinā yaccayatrāpekṣaṃ śeṣaṃ darśayati| citrīkaraṇāpekṣayā śeṣo na śakyate vijñātum; citrīkaraṇasyeha svaryamāṇatvāt| `ārokṣyati' iti| `ruha bījajanmani prādurbhāve ca' (dhā.pā.859)| `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31), `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41)| `āścarya yadi bhuṃjīta' iti| anavaklṛpreratrāścarya gamyate| tatrāścaryanimitte lṛṭi pratiṣiddhe `jātuyadorliṅavidhāne yadāyadyorūpasaṃkhyānam' (vā.331) ityanavaklṛptau liṅa|| 152. utāpyoḥ samarthayorliṅ| (3.3.152) `samarthayoḥ' iti| dhātunā sāmarthyamiha nāśrīyate| tayorupapadatvenaiva tasya labdhatvāt| tasmāt parasparasāmarthya samarthaśābdādiha gṛhyate| tadapi vyapekṣālakṣaṇamekārthībhāvalakṣaṇamubhayamutāpyorna sambhavati; paryāyeṇa tayorupapadatvāt, tasmāt samānārthalakṣaṇamiha sāmarthya samarthaśabdena pratipādyata ityata āha-- `samānārthatvamanayoḥ'iti| `kuryāt' eiti| upratyaye kṛte guṇo raparatvañca, `ata ut sārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityuttvam, `ye ca' (6.4.109) ityukāralopaḥ|| 153. kāmapravedane'kacciti| (3.3.153) `kāmo me bhuñjīta bhavān' iti| svābhiprāyaṃ parasyānenāviṣkāroti|| 154. sambhāvane'lamiti cetsiddhāprayoge| (3.3.154) `yogyatādhyavasānam' iti| yogyatā - sāmarthyam, tasyādhyavasānam| sā yenādhyavasīyate niścīyate tadyogyatādhyavasānam - jñānam, sambhāvanamucyate| tamevārthaṃ paryāyāntareṇa vispaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `śaktiśraddhānam' iti| śaktiḥ - sāmarthyam, sā śraddhīyate yena jñānena tacchaktiśraddhānam| `tat' iti| sambhāvanam'| `paryāptyā' iti| sāmarthyena|etena paryāptāviha varttamāno'laṃśabdo gṛhyate, na tu bhūṣaṇādāviti darśayati| `paryāptam' iti| śaktam, svakāryanirvarttanakṣamamityarthaḥ| svakāryaṃ punastasya viparītaviṣayaparicchedaḥ| `avitatham' iti| vidyamānaviṣayatvāt| etena paryāptyarthaṃ evāsya svīkṛtiḥ| evaṃ hi tadviparītaviṣayaṃ bhavati yadi vidyamānaviṣayatvādavitathaṃ bhavati, nānyathā | `alamaḥra'iti| alaṃśabdasya | kuta etat ? itikaraṇenārthapadārthakatvāt pracyāvya śabdapadārthakatayā'laṃśabdasya vyavasthāpanāt| alamarthaḥ sambhāvanasya viśeṣamaṃ nopapadyate, tataśca yaduktam-- `tadidānīmalamathana viśeṣyate' iti tadvighaṭate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ'; āvṛttiralaṃśabdasya kariṣyate, tatraikasya sūtropāttasyārthapadārthakatā bhaviṣyati, āvṛttasyetikaraṇenābhisambandhādarthapadārthatāyāḥ pracyutasya śabdapadārthakatā cātra gamyate| `cārthaḥ' iti| arthāt, prakaraṇādvā| `{na cāsau prayujyate-kāśikā} na tu prayujyate' iti|avagatārthatvāt| `{ tadīdṛśasaṃbhāvanopādhike'rthe -- kāśikā} kriyāsambhāvanopādhike' iti| kriyāsambhāvanamupādhiviśeṣaṇaṃ yasyār3tasya sa tathoktaḥ| `api parvataṃ śirasā bhindyāt' iti| pūrvavat `śnasorallopaḥ'(6.4.111)| atra yat parvatabhedanaviṣayaṃ sāmarthyaṃ puṃsaḥ sambhāvyate tat tasya vidya evetyavitathatvāt paryāptaṃ sambhāvanam| `prāyeṇa sa gamiṣyati' iti| astyatra sambhāvanaṃ prāyaśabdāt pratīyamānam, alamarthastu nāsti; tena bhaviṣyatkālavivakṣāyāṃ lṛḍeva bhavati na liṅa|| 155. vibhāṣā dhātau sambhāvanavacane'yadi| (3.3.155) `{bhaviṣyati ca kāle-- kāśikā'} bhaviṣyati kāle' iti| iṣyata ityapekṣate| kathaṃ punarvibhāṣā bhaviṣyatkālaśca labhyate, yāvatā neha sūtre vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ vināpi bhaviṣyatkālo'sti ? ata āha-- yasmādvibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate' iti| tena vibhāṣā liṅapratyayo labhyate| yat `utāpyoḥ' (3.3.152) ityādeḥ sūtrālliṅiti varttamāne punarliṅagrahaṇaṃ kriyate'tobhaviṣyatkālo labhyate| punarliṅagrahaṇasyaitat prayojanam-- kālaviśeṣe bhaviṣyati yathā syāditi| tena hantīti palāyata ityevamādau varttamānavivakṣāyāṃ laḍeva bhavati| atra hananaṃ hetuḥ, palāyanaṃ hetumat| `palāyate' iti| `upasargasyāyatau' (8.2.19) iti latvam|| 157. icchārtheṣu liṅaloṭau| (3.3.157) `bhuṅktām' iti| ṭeretve kṛta ām| `kāmapravedana iti vaktavyam' iti| kāmasyecchāyāḥ pravedane - prakāśane imau liṅaloṭau bhavata ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `kāmapravedane'kacciti' (3.3.153) ityataḥ kāmapravedanagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena kāmaprevadana eva bhavataḥ| atra liṅ‌grahaṇaṃ kimartham, na `icchārtheṣu loṭ ca' ityevocyata, cakāreṇa samuccīyamāno'pi prakṛto liṅa bhaviṣyati ?naitadasti; vibhāṣayā hi bhaviṣyatkāla ityuktam,tato yadyasāvanuvarttate vikalpaḥ syāt| tadbādhanārthameva punarliṅagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 158. samānakarttṛkeṣu tamun| (3.3.158) pūrveṇa liṅloṭoḥ prāptayostumun vidhīyate| `tumunaprakṛtyapekṣameva'iti| yasmād dhātostumun , ataḥ pratyāsattestadapekṣameva samānakarttṛkatvaṃ jñāyate-- tumunprakṛteryaḥ karttā sa cedicchārthānāmapi bhavatīti| `icchati bhoktum' iti| yo'treṣeḥ karttā sa eva bhujerapītyastīha samānakarttṛkeṣu liṅaloṭau ca paratvāt prāpnutastau mā bhūtamityevamartham, {arthaḥ-mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ,} ṇvul mā bhūdityeva {arthaśca-mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} ca| `devadattaṃ bhuñjānamicchati' iti| atra bhūjerdevadattaḥ karttā, icchatestato'nya iti nāsti samānakarttṛkatvam, tena varttamānavivakṣāyāṃ laḍeva bhavati| `anabhidhānāt' iti| na hyatra tumunotpadyamānena vivakṣato'rthaḥ śakyate'bhidhātumiti| abidhānalakṣaṇāśca kṛttaddhitasamāsāḥ| atha vā-- `anabhidhānāt' iti| icchan karttumityabhidhānasyābhāvādityarthaḥ| lokaprasiddhānāṃ hi śāstre'nvākhyānaṃ kriyate, na tvicchan karttumityādayo lokaprasiddhāḥ|| 159. liṅ ca| (3.3.159) `bhuñjīyādhīya' iti| `iṭo't' (3.4.106)| kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā vāsarūpavidhinaivātra liṅ bhaviṣyati ? naitadasti;liṅaloṭorapavādatvād bādhakayoḥ prāptayostadvabādhanārthastumun, vidhīyate| tena bādhitatvādyathā loḍ na bhavati, tathā liṅgapi na syāt| tasamālliṅavidhānārthamidamucyate| `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttarasūtre liṅa evānuvṛttiryathā syāt, tumuno mā bhūt|| 160. icchārthebhyo vibhāṣā varttamāne| (3.3.161) `preraṇam' iti| niyogaḥ' `nimantraṇaṃ niyogakaraṇam' iti| asatyāmapīcchāyāmakaraṇe satyadharmotpatterniyamenāvaśyambhāvena yat karaṇaṃ tannimantraṇam| `kāmacārakaraṇam'iti| kāmacāra- - icchāpracāraḥ| tena yatkaraṇaṃ tadāmantraṇam| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yadicchayaivakaraṇaṃnānicchayā akaraṇe'pi doṣābhāvāt,tadāmantramaṇam‌| ihāyaṃ vidhyādirarthaḥ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā syāt ? pratyayārtho vā ? pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā ? tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta tadā yatra prakṛtireva vidhyādīnarthānācaṣṭe tatra na sidhyet-- vidadhyānnimantrayetāmantrayetādhīcchediti, na hyatra prakṛtyarthādanye viśeṣaṇabhūtā vidhyādayaḥ santītyeṣa doṣaḥ pratividheyaḥ syāt| pratividhīyamāne'pi tasmin pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| atha dvitīyaḥ ? bhāvakarmakarttṛpratyayārthānāṃ vidhyādayo vācakāḥ syurityevamanayordoṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā tṛtīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-- `vidhyādayaśca' ityādi| pratyayārthāsta eva bhāvakarmakarttāraḥ| teṣu `laḥ karmaṇi ca' (3.4.69) ityādinā pratyayasya vidhānāt teṣāmayaṃ vidhyādirartho viśeṣaṇamiti matvā''ha-- `vidhyādiviśiṣṭeṣu' ityādi| etenādiśabdena nimantraṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam| dvitīyena bhāvakarmaṇoḥ| `āsīt' iti| adāditvācchapo (2.4.72) luk| `adhyāpayet' iti| pūrvavadāttvapukau|| 162. loṭ ca| (3.3.162) yadi vidhyādiṣveva loḍbhavatyevaṃ yogavibhāgaḥ kimarthaṃ kriyate ? ityāha-- `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttarasūtre loṭa evānuvṛttiryathā syāt, liṅo mā bhūditi| `karotu' iti| `eruḥ' (3.4.86) ityuktam| `adhyayai' iti| `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) ityāṭ, ṭeretve kṛte `eta ai' (3.4.93), `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ, prakṛterguṇāyādeśau|| 163.praiṣātisargaprāptakāleṣu kṛtyāśca| (3.3.163) `kāryaḥ' iti| `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124) iti ṇyat| `kṛtyaḥ' iti| `vibhāṣā kṛvṛṣoḥ' (3.1.120) iti kyap| `kimarthamidam' ityādi dveṣyam| `viśeṣavihita' ityādi parīhāraḥ| kṛtyā hi sāmānyena vihitāḥ| loṭ tu praiṣādinārthaviśeṣeṇa| atastena viśeṣavihitena kṛtyāḥ praiṣādiviṣaye bādhyeranniti punarvidhīyate| `vāsarūpa'ityādīnā parīhāraṃ vighaṭayati| `evaṃ tarhi' ityādinā preṣādiṣu kṛtyavidhānasya jñāpakatvaṃ darśayati| nanu cā'sati prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati, iha cāsti prayojanam, kiṃ tat ? praiṣādi yena niyamena kṛtyā bhavanti, nānyatreti ? naitat; aniṣṭatvāt| anyatrāpi hi kṛtyā dṛśyante-- tṛṇena śoṣyam, budhena bodhyamiti| tacca niyame sati na sidhyet, na hyatra praiṣādayo gamyante| tasmānneha niyamo'bhīṣṭaḥ, na cānirdiṣṭārthā praklṛptiḥ śāstre yuktā (bho.pa.sū.107)| tato yuktaṃ jñāpakameva;kṛtyavidhānasyāvaśyambhāvāt| avaśyaṃgrahaṇena na kvacidapi bhavatīti darśayati| etacca stradhikārāt pareṇāpi vāsarūpavidhiḥ kvacit svaritatvapratijñānāllabhyate| tena kālādiṣūpapadeṣu vāsarūpavidhinā lyuḍapi bhavati-- kālo bhojanasyeti| yadi tu sarvathā vāsarūpavidhirna syāt tadā `kālasamayavelāsu tumun'(3.3.167) iti tumunneva nityaṃ syāt| `kecidāhuḥra'iti vacanādapare tvetayorviśeṣaṃ necchantītyuktaṃ bhavati|| 164. liṅ cordhvamauhūrtike| (3.3.164) `yathāprāptañca' iti| loṭ, kṛtyāśca|| 165. sme loṭ| (3.3.165) `liṅakṛtyānāmapavādaḥ'iti| anantara sūtra vihitānām|| 166. adhīṣṭe ca| (3.3.166) `liṅoṣa'pavādaḥ'iti| vidhyādisūtreṇa prāptasya| `adhyāpaya'iti| serhirādeśaḥ (3.4.87), tasya `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti luk| `juhudhi'iti| `hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ' (6.4.101) iti dhirādeśaḥ|| 167. kālasamayavelāsu tumun| (3.3.167) `praiṣādigrahaṇamiha sambadhyate' iti|na cediha praiṣādayo gamyante, tena tatra na bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| kālo bhojanasyetyukte tasyād bhaṅktāṃ bhavāniti praiṣo gamyate| tataśca praiṣādigrahaṇe'nuvarttamāne'pīha prāpnotītyabhiprāyeṇāha--`iha kasmānna bhavati' ityādi| syādet-- praiṣādi kṛtyavidhānājjñāpakāt stryadhikārāt pareṇāpi vāsarūpavidhirnāstīti, kiṃ tarhi ? anityaḥ|tataḥ kvacidbhavati| etacca `evaṃ tarhetañjñāpayati' (3.3.163 kā.vṛ) ityādinā prāgevābhihitam|| 168. liṅ yadi| (3.3.168) ` tumuno'pavādaḥ'iti| pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasya|| 169. arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca| (3.3.169) `voḍhavyaḥ'iti| `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31), `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40), `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ'8(8.4.41), `ḍho dhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13) , `sahivahorodavarṇasya' (6.3.112) ityete vidhayaḥ karttavyāḥ| `atha'ityādi dveṣyam| `yo'yam' ityādi parīhāraḥ| vāsarūpavidhiḥ strdhikārāt pareṇa nāvaśyambhavatītyuktameva|| 170. āvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ| (3.3.170) `āvaśyakam'iti| manojñāditvād‌vuñ| `upādhirayam'iti| pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ| `nopapapadam' iti| upapadatve tu kārī, hārīti rūpaṃ nasyādityabhiprāyaḥ|`orāvaśyake'(3.2.125) ityatra pratipāditamevāvaśyamupādhiḥ, nopapadamiti;tadihāpi tadvadevopādhikatvamāvaśyakasya vaditavyam| tena saha nirddeśādādhamarṇyamapyupādhireva, nopapadamiti| yadyāvaśyakamapādhirnopapadam, `upapadamatiṅ'(2.2.19) iti samāso na syāt, na cānyallakṣaṇamasti yeneha samāsaḥ syāditi yo manyet, taṃ pratyāha-- `mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt samāsaḥ' iti `sahasraṃ dāyī'iti|`akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' (2.3.70) iti ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ dvitīyaiva bhavati|| 171. kṛtyāśca| (3.3.171) `kimartham'ityādi codyam| `viśeṣavihitena'iti parīhāraḥ|`karttari'ityādinā parīhāravighaṭanañca| `kecit'ityādinā parakīyamatena parohārasamarthanam| `bhavyageyam'iti| `samudāyeṣu hi vṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi varttante' (śā.pa.85) iti bhavyageyādayaḥ śabdā avayavabhūteṣu kṛtyeṣviha varttante| `karttṛvācinaḥ'iti| bhavyageyādisūtreṇaiṣāṃ pakṣe karttari nipātanāt| yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ|| 172. śaki liṅ ca| (3.3.172) `prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇañcaitat' | pūrveṇābhiprāyeṇopapadanirāsārthamidamucyate| `jīvyāt'iti|`skoḥ'(8.2.29) iti salopaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ liṅagrahaṇam, `loṭ ca'(3.3.162) ityeva siddham, cakāreṇa hyanukṛṣyamāṇo liṅapi bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam; yathaiva hi cakāreṇa liṅanukṛyate tathā kṛtyā apyanukṛṣyeran| nanu nivartiṣyante kṛtyāḥ, teṣu nivṛtteṣu liṅa evānukarṣaṇārthaścakāro bhaviṣyati ? satyametat; evaṃ yadi teṣāṃ nivṛttirvijñāsyate liṅo'pi nivṛttiḥ syāt| vyākhyānādanuvartiṣyata iti cedevamapi pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| tasmāt pratipattigauravaparīhārārthaṃ yathānyāsameva nyāyyam| atra vidhyādisūtre (3.3.161) evāśīrgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kṛtam, evaṃ hi liṅaloṭorgrahaṇaṃ na kṛtaṃ bhavati ? nai śakyam; vidhyādisūtre pāṭhe sati `sme loṭ' (3.3.165) ityevamādibhiḥ paratvādbādhā syāt| ihatu kriyamāṇe paratvādeṣa yogasteṣāṃ bādhako bhaviṣyatīti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅga| avaśyañcottarārthamāśīrgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam-- `kticktau ca saṃjñāyām' (3.3.174) ityāśiṣi yathā syātām| || 174. kticktau ca saṃjñāyām| (3.3.174) `samudāyena'iti| prakṛtipratyayasamudāyena| etena samudāyopādhitāṃ saṃjñāyā darśayati| `tantiḥ'iti| `tanu vistāre'(dhā.pā.1463), atra `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti'(6.4.15) iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti, `anudāttopadeśa'(6.4.37) ityādinānusikalopaśca; tadubhayaṃ `na ktici dīrghaśca' (6.4.39) iti niṣidhyate| `sātiḥ'iti| `ṣaṇu dāne'(dhā.pā.1464), `janasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ'(6.4.42) ityāttvam| `devadattaḥ'iti| ḍudāño niṣṭhāyām `do dad ghoḥ'(7.4.46) iti dadādeśaḥ, `khari ca'(8.4.55) iti cartvam|| 175. māṅi luṅ| (3.3.175) `mā karṣit' iti| `na māṅyoge' (6.4.74) ityaḍāgamābhāvaḥ|| 176. smottare laṅ ca| (3.3.176) smaśabda uttaramadhikaṃ yasya māṅaḥ sa tathoktaḥ|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ <3.4> atha tṛtīyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ 1. dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ| (3.4.1) `dhātvarthe dhātuśabdaḥ' iti| abhidheye'bhidhānopacāraṃ kṛtvā dhātvartho'tra dhātuśabdena nirddiṣṭa iti darśayati| bhvādiṣvevāyaṃ dhātuśabdo varttate, svārthe guṇībhūtasya dhātuśabdasya śabdāntareṇa sambandho na syāt; tasmāddhātvartha evāyaṃ dhātuśabdo varttate, na bhvādiṣu| tataśca dhātusambandha ityasya dhātvarthasambandha ityeṣo'rtho vijñāyata ityāha-- `dhātvarthānāṃ sambandho dhātusambandhaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punaḥ sambandha ityāha-- `viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ' iti| `ayathākāloktā api' ityādi| yo yasyātmīyaḥ kālo yathākālam| `yathā'sādṛśye'(2.1.7) iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ, yathākāle uktā yathākāloktāḥ, `saptamī'(2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ,na yathākāloktāḥ - ayathākāloktāḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- svaiḥ svairvidhāyakairvākyairyatra yasmin yasmin kāle ye ye vihitāstato'nyatrakāle'pi prayuktāḥ pratyayāḥ sādhavo bhavantīti| `agniṣṭomayājī' ityādīnyudāharaṇāni darśayati| sarvatra tiṅantadācyo'rtho viśeṣyaḥ, subantavācyastu viśeṣaṇam| `agniṣṭomayājīti bhūtakālaḥ' iti| bhūtaḥ kālo'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ| bhūtakālatvaṃtu bhūtādhikāre `karaṇe yajaḥ'(3.2.85) iti ṇinervidhānāt| `janiteti bhaviṣyatkālaḥ' iti| bhaviṣyan kālo'syeti bahuvrīhireva| bhaviṣyatkālatvaṃ tu bhaviṣyadanadyatane lṛṭo vidhānāt| `tatra'iti| nirdhāraṇe saptamī| tayorbhūtakālabhaviṣyatkālayormadhye yo bhūtakālaḥ sa bhaviṣyatkālena sambadhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati| agniṣṭomayājīti bhūtakālo janiteti bhaviṣyatkālenāpi sambadhyamāno bhaviṣyatkāla eva sampadyate| dvitīye'pyudāharaṇe `kṛtaḥ' iti bhūtakālaḥ; bhūte niṣṭhāvidhānāt| `bhavitā' iti bhaviṣyatkālaḥ pūrvavadeva| tatra bhūtakāla itareṇāpi sambadhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati| tṛtīye'pi `bhāvī'iti bhaviṣyatkālaḥ; `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ'(3.3.3) iti vacanāt| `āsīt' iti bhūtakālaḥ; bhūtānadyatane laṅo vidhānāt| tatra bhaviṣyatkālo bhūtakālenāpi sambadhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati| ihāgniṣṭomayājyasya putro janiteti bhūtakālo bhaviṣyatkālenāpi sambadhyamāno bhaviṣyatkālaḥ sampadyate| tathā hyayamatrārthaḥ pratīyate-- so'syaputro janitā yo'gniṣṭomena yaṣṭeti| na ca bhaviṣyatkālo bhūtakālenābhisambadhyamāno bhūtakālatāṃ pratipadyate, na hyatrāyamarthaḥ pratīyate-- so'sya putro jāto yo'gniṣṭomeneṣṭavāniti| itarayorapyudāharaṇayorviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyakālatāmāpadyate, yatastatrāyamartho'vagamyate-- sa śvo bhavitā kaṭo yaḥ kariṣyate, tat kṛtyamāsīd yadabhūtamiti| tadetatkathaṃ bhavati ? viparyayaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- `viśeṣaṇam'ityādi| viśeṣaṇaṃ hi parārthatvād‌guṇo'pradhānamityarthaḥ| tena ca pradhānakālasya viśeṣyasyopakāraḥ karttavyaḥ| na ca tat pradhānamaparityajya svakālaṃ pradhānakālamapratipadyamānaṃ pradhānopakārakriyāṃ karttuṃ samartha bhavatīti pradhānasya yaḥ kālastamurudhyate| viśeṣyaṃ tūpakāryatvātpradhānam|na ca pradhānasya guṇakālāpattiryuktā, anyathā yadiguṇakālaṃ pradhānakālaḥ pratipadyeta tadā tasya pradhānatvaṃ hīyeta| tena na bhavati viparyayaḥ| atha pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pratyaya ityanuvarttata ityata āha-- `pratyayādhikāre'ityādi| pūrvakaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaṃ dhātusambaddham, atastadihāśrīyamāṇaṃ dhātvadhikāravihitānāṃ pratyayānāṃ sādhutve sampadyate| atra punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇe pratyayamātraṃ gṛhyate, tadarthaṃ punaḥ pratyayagrahaṇam| `kālabhede' iti| kālaviśeṣe,asmātkālādanyasmin kāla ityarthaḥ| `gomānāsīt'iti | gomāniti varttamānakālaḥ, `tadasya'(5.2.94) ityādinā varttamānakālamastītyupādāya matupo vidhānāt| sa bhūtabhaviṣyatkālābhyāṃ sambadhyamānaḥ sādhurbhavati|| 2. kriyāsamabhihāre loṭ loṭo hisvau vā ca tadhvamoḥ| (3.4.2) `prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṃ caitat'iti| etenopapapadatvaṃ nirasyati| upapadatve hi kevalāddhātorna syādityādityabhiprāyaḥ| atra tiṅādeśau vā hisvau syātām, loḍādeśau veti dvau pakṣau| nanu ca prathamapakṣāśaṅkāyāḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti; loṭa iti vacanāt,tat kathamasāvāśaṅikataḥ ? loṭsthānikatvādādeśo'pi loḍ‌vyapadeśamāsādayīti yuktamāśaṅkitum| tatra hi yadi pūrvakaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tadā `bhuṅkṣva bhuṅkṣvetyevāhaṃ bhuñjai'iti `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) iti, pittvānṅittvaṃ nāsti, tataśca `śnaṣorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityākāralopo na syāt| ubhāvapi ca parasmaipadānāmātmanepadānāmaniyamena syātām;niyamahetorabhāvāt| sāmānyena tiṅāṃ sthāne vidhīyamānayoḥ kṛta etallabhyate ! yataḥ parasmaipadānāṃ hyādeśena bhavivyam, itareṣāṃ svādeśeneti| tasmādduṣṭo'yaṃ pakṣa iti matvā dvitīyapakṣamāśrityāha-- `tasya ca loṭaḥ' ityādi| yasmin pakṣe doṣaḥ prasajati taṃ pratividhāsyati| `tadhvaṃbhāvinastu vā bhavataḥ' iti| loṭa ityapekṣyate| taśca dhvañca tadhvamau, tau bhāvinau yasya loṭaḥ sa taṣvambhāvī| etena tādaśārtho loḍeva sthānī; tādarthyāt, sūtre taśabdena vyapadiṣṭo dhvamādeśārthaśca dhvaṃśabdeneti darśayati| atha tadhvamāvevasthāninau kasmānna vijñāyete ? aśakyaṃ hi tau sthānitvena vijñātum| tayorapi sthānitve'loḍādeśayorapi hisvau syātām| atha tadhvamau viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ-- loṭo yau tadhvamāviti, tato'yamadoṣa iti cet; evamapi pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| tadhvambhāvinau loṭa eva sthānitvaṃ yuktam, na tadhvamoḥ| yaditarhi loṭo hisvāvādeśau, na tadādeśānāṃ tiṅāmeva, evañca `laḥ parasmaipadam' (1.4.99) iti tayoḥ parasmaipadasaṃjñā syāt, tataśca `śeṣātkarttari parasmaipadam'(1.3.78) ityubhāvapi parasmaipadibhya eva syātām; tiṅakṣvasanniveśācca tadantasya tiṅantatā na syāt, tataśca `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighāto na syādityata āha-- `yogavibhāgaśca' ityādi| `loḍityeva' iti| etena dvitīye yoge loḍityasyānuvṛttiṃ darśayati| `loḍdharmāṇau'ityādi| loṭa iva dharmastiṅatvāditvāryayostau loḍ‌dharmāṇau| nanu ca loḍādeśānāṃ tiṅatvādi dharmaḥ, na loṭaḥ ? ādeśadvāreṇa sthānino'pi loṭastiṅatvādidharmo bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| kathaṃ punaryogavibhāge sati loḍ‌dharmāṇau tau bhavataḥ ? yogavibhāge sati dvitīye yoge loṭaśabdo yo'nuvarttate tenārthādvibhaktervipariṇāmo bhavatīti ṣaṣṭhyantatāmāpannena hisvau viśeṣyete-- loṭo yau hisvāviti| tataśca loḍādeśayoḥ sipthāsoḥ sthāne yau hisvau `serhyapicca' (3.2.87) ityādinā śāstreṇa vidhāsyete, tāveva yathāsvamupāttaviśeṣāviha loṭaḥ sthāne vidhīyete, nāpūrvāviti| tena loḍ‌dharmāṇau tau ityeṣo'rtho labhyata eva| `tena'ityādi| ata eva- yathoktena prakāreṇa, loḍ‌dharmāṇau hisvau loṭaḥ sthāne bhavataḥ| tena parasmaipadatvanamātmanepadatvañca bhedena viṣayavibhāgena vyavatiṣṭhate| tatra hiśabde parasmaipadatvaṃ vyatiṣṭhate; loṭ‌sambandhino heḥ parasmaipadasaṃjñakatvāt| svaśabde cātmanepadatvaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate;svaśabdasya loṭ‌sambandhina ātmanepadasaṃjñakatvāt| `tiṅatvañca dvayorapi bhavati' iti| loṭ‌sambandhinostayordvayorapi tiṅantatvāt| nanu ca sipthāsorloḍādeśayostau sambandhinau, tadādeśatvāt, na loṭaḥ, tatkathaṃ loṭsambandhitvena vyadiśyete ? ādeśadvāreṇa loṭ‌sambandhitvaṃ tayorapyastītyadoṣaḥ| yadi tarhi loḍdharmāṇau bhavataḥ, evamekavacanasaṃjñā syāt, madhyamapuruṣasaṃjñā ca, tayorapi loḍ‌dharmatvāt, tataśca vacanāntarabhāvinaḥ puruṣāntarabhāvinaśca loṭo na syātām ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;yadi hyekavacanamadhyamapuruṣasaṃjñe api syātāṃ vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt, vināpyanena vacanena madhyamapuruṣaikavacanayorhisvayoḥ siddhatvāt| `lunīhi lunīhi'iti| `kriyāsamabhihāre dvau bhavataḥ' (vā.886) iti dvirvacanam|`ī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itīttvam| `lunanti'iti| `śnābhyastayorātaḥ'(6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ| `atha vā' ityādinā `vā ca tadhvamoḥ' iti vāgrahamasya phalaṃ darśayati| `alāvīt' iti| `sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu'(7.2.1) iti vṛddhi, `ārdhadhātukasyeḍ‌valādeḥ' (7.2.35) itīṭ,`astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ, `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| `alāviṣṭām' iti| `tasthastha' (3.4.101) ityādinā tasastām| `alāviṣuḥ' iti| sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjusādeśaḥ| `evaṃ madhyamottatayo{api nāsti-kāśikā,padamañjarī ca}rapyudāhāryam' iti| lunīhi lunīhītyeva tvamalāvīryuvāmalāviṣṭaṃ yūyamalāviṣṭa| atha vā-- lunīta lunītetyeva yūyamalāviṣṭa| lunīhi nīhītyevāhamalāviṣam, āvāmalāviṣvi, vayamalāviṣma| `evaṃ madhyamottamayo{api nāsti-kāśikā}rapyudāhāryam' iti| lunīhi lunīhītyevaṃ tvaṃ laviṣyasi, yuvāṃ laviṣyathaḥ, yūyaṃ lavipyatha| atha vā-- lunīta lunītetyeva yūyaṃ laviṣyatha| lunīhi lunīhītyevāhaṃ laviṣyāmi, āvāṃ laviṣyāvaḥ, vayaṃ laviṣyāmaḥ| `adhīyāt' iti| iyaṅa| `adhīyate' iti| `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityadādeśaḥ| `evaṃ {sarveṣu lakāreṣūdāhāryam-kāśikā, padamañjarī ca}sarvalakāreṣūdāhāryam' iti| laṅa-lunīhi lunīhītyevāyamalunāt, imāvalunītām, ime'lunan| lunīhi lunīhītyeva tvamalunaḥ, yuvāmalunītam‌, yūyamalunīta| atha vā-- lulīta lunītetyeva yūyamalunīta| lunīhi lanīhītyevāhamalunām, āvāmalunīva, vamamalunīma| adhīṣvādhīṣvetyevāyamadhyaita, imāvadhyaiyātām,ime'dhyaiyata| adhīṣvādhīṣvesatyeva tvamadhyaithāḥ, yuvāmadhyaiyāthām, yūyamadhyaidhvam| atha vā-- adhīdhvamadhīdhvamityeva yūyamadhyaidhvam| adhīṣvādhīṣvatyavāhamadhyaiṣi, āvāmadhyaivahi, vayamadhyaimahi| anyeṣu lakāreṣvatigranthavistarabhayānnodāhriyate|anayā diśā svayamevābhyupagamyodāhāryam| atha lunīhi lunohīti kathamatra dvirvacanam, yāvatā dhātunaiva kriyāsamabhihāro'vagamitaḥ; tadviśiṣṭakriyāvacanāddhātorloḍvidhānāt ? atha vā-- avagamite sati tasmin dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti cedevaṃ yaṅantasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ syāt ? ityata āha-- `kriyāsamabhihārābhivyaktau' ityādi| yadyapi kriyāsamabhihāraviśiṣṭakriyābhidhāyino dhātorloḍ bhavati, tathāpi yā tasya kriyāsamabhihārabhivyaktiḥ sā dhātunā na kriyate, kiṃ tarhi ? loḍaiva| sa catāṃ karttuṃ dvirvacanasahita eva samartho bhavati, na kevalaḥ; tatra tasyāvidhānāt| sa hi loṭa `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) iti karmādiṣu vidhīyate, na kriyāsamabhihāre| tasmāt tadabhivyaktau karttavyāyāṃ loṭ svayamasamartha iti dvirvacanamapekṣate, tena tadantasya dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kena punarvidhīyamānaṃ dvirvacanamapekṣata ityāha-- `kriyāsamabhihāre' ityādi| `yaṅapratyayaḥ punaḥ' ityādi| yaṅapratyayo hi kriyāsamabhihāra eva vidhīyate| tenāsau tatra vidhīyamānastadabhivyaktau svayameva samartha iti nāpekṣate dvirvacanam| tena tadantasya dvirvacanaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|| 3.samuccaye'nyatarasyām| (3.4.3) `anekakriyādhyāhāraḥ' iti| anekāsāṃ kriyāṇāṃ cīyamānatetyarthaḥ| etena samabhihārāt samuccayasya bhedaṃ darśayati| samabhihāro'pi paunaḥpunyam, bhṛśārtho vā, sa caikasyā eva kriyāyāḥ sambhavaḥ| samuccayaḥ punaranekāsāṃ kriyāṇām| `bhāṣṭramaṭa'iti| `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti luk| atra sādhanabhedādbhedamupāgatānāmanakāsāmaṭanakriyāṇāṃ samuccayaḥ| `atha vā' ityādi| prathamenātha vetigrahaṇena `vā ca tadhvamoḥ' (3.4.2) iti vāgrahaṇapratipāditaṃ vikalpaṃ darśayati, dvitīyenānyatarasyāṃ (3.4.3) grahaṇapratipāditam|| 4. yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ pūrvasmin| (3.4.4) `pūrvasmina loḍ‌vidhāne' ityādervākyasya yasmāddhātorityādinārthaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| `dhātusambandhe' ityādi| dhātusambandha (3.4.1) ityanuvṛtterdhātusambandha eva loḍ‌vidhānam, ato'nu prayogaḥ siddhaḥ eva, na hi tena vinā dhātusambandho bhavati; tasya dviṣṭhatvāt| yadyevam, kimarthamidaṃ vacanam ? ityāha-- `yathāvidhyarthaṃ tu' iti| atha vyavahitaprayogasya vā pūrvasya prayogasya vā nivṛttyarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati, yathā-- `kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi' (3.1.40) iti ? na; tayorapīṣṭatvāt| iṣyate hi vyavahitaprogaḥ- lunīhi lunīhītyavāyaṃ devadatto lunāti| pūrvaprayogo'pīṣyate-- lunāti devadatto lunīhi lunīhīti| tasmādyathā vidhyarthamevedaṃ yuktam| nanu ca`samuccaye sāmānyavacanasya' (3.4.5) iti dhātvantarasya samānārthasya prayogābhyanujñānāt kriyāsamabhihāre yathāvidhyanuprayogo bhaviṣyatīti, tatkimanena vacanena ? naitadasti, samuccaya eva hi niyamaḥ syāt, kriyāsamabhihāre tu yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ syāt, dhātvantarasya ca samānārthasya| tasmādārabdhavyamidam|| 5. samuccaye sāmānyavacanasya| (3.4.5) `sarvaviśeṣānuprayogānivṛttyartham' iti| yadīdaṃ nārabhyate tadā yāvadbhyo dhātubhyo loḍvihitastāvatāmevānuprayogaḥ prasajyeta; tatastannivṛtyarthametat| nanu cāntareṇāpīdaṃ vacanaṃ lāghavāt sāmānyavacanasyaivānuprayogo bhaviṣyati| sarvaviśeṣānuprayoge hyodanaṃ bhuṅkṣva saktūn piba dhānāḥ khāda ityevāyaṃ bhuṅkte pibati khādatīti sarveṣu tadā taruśabdasyaiva prayogaḥ syāt, vanaspatiśabdaprabhṛtayastūcchidyeran, na caivam, tasmānnāsti laukikaśabdaprayoge gurulāghavaṃ pratyādaraḥ| nanu ca bhrāṣṭramaṭetyādāvudāharaṇe kārakasyaiva samuccayo bhrāṣṭrādeḥ, na kriyāyāḥ, tasyā ekatvāt; anekādhāratvañca sāmānyam, ekatve kriyāyāstanna sambhavati, tatkathaṃ sāmānyavacanasyānuprayoga upapadyate ? ityāha-- `bhrāṣṭamaṭa'ityādi| gatārtham|| 6. chandasi luṅlaṅaliṭaḥ| (3.4.6) `yathāyatham' iti| yathāsvam| yo yasyātmīyo viṣayaḥ sa tatretyarthaḥ| `akarat' iti|`kṛmṛdṛruhibhyaśchandasi'(3.1.59) iti cleraṅa, `ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ' (7.4.16)| `akaram' iti| mipo'm| `avṛṇīta' iti| vṛño laṅ, kryāditvāt śnā, pūrvavadītvam| `mamāra' iti| liṭ, `mriyaterluṅaliṅośca' (1.3.61) iti niyamāt parasmaipadam, ṇal, vṛddhiḥ, raparatvam, `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti sthānanivadbhāvāt mṛ ityetad‌dvirucyate, `urat' (7.4.66) ityatvam, raparatvam, halādiśeṣaḥ|| 7. liṅarthe leṭ| (3.4.7) `neṣat' | `takṣiṣat' iti| nayatestakṣate śca leṭ, tip, `itaśca lopaḥ parasma aipadeṣu' )3.4.97) itīkāralopaḥ, `sib bahulaṃ leṭi'(3.1.34) iti sip, `leṭo'ḍāṭau' (3.4.94) ityāṭ| takṣiṣadityatra `ārdhadhātukasya' (7.2.35) ityādineṭ| joṣiṣadityādīnyudāharaṇāni `sib bahulaṃ leṭi'( 3.1.34) ityatra vyutpāditāni|| 8.upasaṃvādaśaṅkayośca| (3.4.8) `upasaṃvādaḥ paribhāṣaṇam; karttavye paṇabandhaḥ' iti| upasaṃvādaśabdasyemau paryāyau| `yadi me bhavān' ityādinosavādasya svarūpaṃ darśayati| kāraṇata ityādināpyāśaṅkāyāḥ| `anusaraṇam' iti| anugamanam, anumānamityarthaḥ| `tarka utprekṣā' iti| āśaṅkāyā imau pryāyau| `ahameva' ityādi| devaiḥ paśupatiruktastripuraṃ jahīti, tenoktam-- `ahameva paśūnāmīśai' iti. brahmahatyābhāgaṃ gṛhāṇetyukte āditya idamuktavān `madagrā eva vo grahā gṛhyāntai| maddevatānyeva vaḥ pātrāṇyucyāntai| `īśai'iti-- `īśa aiśvarye' (dhā.pā.1020), uttamapuruṣaikavacanam, iṭ, ṭeretvam, `eta ai' (3.4.93)| `gṛhyāntai' iti--graha upādāne' (dhā.pā.1533), `jho'ntaḥ' (7.1.3), karmaṇi `sārvadhātuke yak' (3.1.67), grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat sādhanam| `ucyāntai' iti-- `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1063), vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| `patāma' iti-- `patlṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.845), mas, `leṭo'ḍāṭau' (3.4.94) ityāṭ| `jihmācaraṇena' ityādinā pūrvoktamāśaṅkālakṣaṇamudāharaṇe darśayati| `liṅartha evāyam' iti| hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ| katham ? upasaṃvāde tāvat-- yadi me bhavānidaṃ kuryādahamapi ta idaṃ dāsyāmītyevaṃvidhaṃ paribhāṣaṇalakṣaṇam| tatra ca karaṇaṃ hetuḥ, dānaṃ hetumaditi yukta upasaṃvādo liṅarthaḥ| āśaṅkāpi kāraṇataḥ kāryānusaraṇam| tatrāpi kāraṇaṃ hetuḥ, kāryānusaraṇaṃ hetumadityāśaṅkāpi liṅartha eva| yadyevamma, pūrveṇaiva siddham, tatkimarthamidamucyate ? ityāha-- `nityārtha vacanam' iti| syādetat pūrveṇaiva nityaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha-- `pūrvasūtre' ityādi|| 9. tumarthe sesenaseasenkasekasenadhyaiadhyaikadyaikadhyainśadhyaiśadyaintavaitavaṅtavenaḥ| (3.4.9) `kathaṃ jñāyate' iti| `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) iti vacanāt karttaiva tumartho yukta iti manyate| `vacanasāmarthyāt' ityādi| yadi karttaiva tumarthaḥ syāt tumarthavacanamarthakaṃ syāt, kṛttvādeva hi sayādayaḥ karttari bhaviṣyanti| tasmāt tumarthagrahaṇālliṅgāt karttari tumunna bhavati| `apakṛṣyate' | apanīyate| karttari na bhavatīti yāvat| syādetat, karmādirasyārtho bhaviṣyatītyāha-- `na ca' ityādi| `anyasmin' iti| karmādau| yathā tarhi karmādāvanirdeśānna bhavati tathā bhāve'pi na syāt| bhāve'pi naiva tumunnirdiśyata ityāha-- `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ' ityādi| arthāntarasya nirdeśādyā prakṛtiḥ pratyayānāṃ nimittatvenopādīyate tadarthasya pratyāsattestatraivāninirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti, sa punariha svārtho bhāvaḥ| kuta etat ? dhātvadhikārāt, dhātośca bhāvavacanatvāt| yadyevam, bhāvagrahaṇameva kuryāt, laghutvāt ? naivaṃ śakyam; bhāvagrahaṇe sati `karttari kṛt' (3.4.67) iti vacanāttumun karttaryeva syāt| tumarthagrahaṇe hi tumuno'pi hi bhāva evārtha ityetadjñāpitaṃ bhavatīti na kaściddoṣa iti| `vakṣe' iti| `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1063), sepratyayaḥ, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam| `eṣe' iti| iṇaḥ senpratyayaḥ| `jīvase' iti| `jīva prāṇadhāraṇe' (dhā.pā.562)| pratyayadvayasyāpyetadevodāharaṇam, svarastu bhidyate| `preṣe' iti| iṇaḥ prapūrvāt kse, `ād‌guṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `śriyase' iti| `śriñ sevāyām' (dhā.pā.897), asmāt ksena, iyaṅ| `upācaradhyai' iti| `cara gatyarthaḥ' (dhā.pā.559), upāṅapūrvaḥ| pratyayadvayasyāpīduhāraṇam, svarabhedāttu bhedaḥ| `āhuvadhyai' iti| `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925), śadhyai, prāghrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) pibādeśaḥ| `mādayadhyai' iti| `madī {harṣaglepanayoḥ-dhā.pā.} harṣe' (dhā.pā.815), hetumaṇṇic, śadhyain, guṇāyādeśau| `pātavai' iti| pibatestavai| `sūtave' iti| `ṣūṅa prāṇigarbhavimoce' (dhā.pā.1031), taveṅa, ṅitvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `gantave' ityādīnyudāharaṇāni gamikarotiharatīnāṃ yathākrameṇa|| 10.prayai rohiṣyai avyathiṣyai| (3.4.10) `prayai' iti| `ato lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ|| 11. dṛśe vikhye ca| (3.4.11) `dṛśe' iti| dṛśeḥ kepratyayaḥ| `vikhye' iti| vipūrvāccakṣiṅa khyātervā kepratyayo nipātyate|| 12. śaki ṇamulkamulau| (3.4.12) `vibhājamam' iti| vipūrvādbhajerṇamul| `apalupam' iti| `luplṛ cchedane' (dhā.pā.1431), kamul|| 13. īśvare tosunkasunau| (3.4.13) abhicaritoḥ' iti| caraterabhipūrvāt tosunpratyayaḥ| `vilikhaḥ, vitṛdaḥ' iti| likhateḥ, `{u tṛdir' dhā.pā.}tṛdir hiṃsādānayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1446) ityetasmācca kasun|| 14. kṛtyārthe tavaikenkenyatvanaḥ| (3.4.14) `kṛtyānāmartho bhāvakarmaṇī' iti| `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' (3.4.70) itibhāvakarmaṇoḥ kṛtyānāṃ vidhānāt| `antetavai' iti| anupūrvādiṇastavai| `paridhātavai' iti| paripūrvāddadhāteḥ| `paristaritavai' iti| paripūrvādeva `stṛñ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1252) ityasmāt| `avagāhe' iti| `gāhu viloḍane' (dhā.pā.649) akpūrvaḥ| `didṛkṣeṇyaḥ' iti| `dṛśaḥ san, dvirvacanam, urattvam, raparatvam, `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itīttvam, `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti guṇābhāvaḥ, vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam,`ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam, didṛkṣa iti sthite kenyapratyayaḥ, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48)| `śuśrūṣeṇyaḥ' iti| śṛṇoteḥ san, `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ, dvirvacanamabhyāsakāryam, śuśrūṣa iti sthite kenyapratyayaḥ| `karttvam' iti| karotestvam| `sayādisūtre'pi tavai vihitaḥ' iti| sayādīnāṃ sūtraṃ sayādisūtram, yena sayādayo vihitāstatatrāpi tavaipratyayo vihitaḥ| `tasya tumarthāt' ityādi| yadi tu tasya tumartha eva bhāve vidhiḥ syāt tasyānarthakyaṃ syāt; anenaiva siddhatvāt| tasmādyadyapi tatra tumartha ityucyate, tathāpi tato'nyatra karmakārake kartrādau tavaipratyayavidhānaṃ veditavyam|| 15. avacakṣe ca| (3.4.15) `eśpratyayo nipātyate' iti| śitkaraṇaṃ sārvadhātukasaṃjñārtham| tenārdhadhātuke vidhīyamānaḥ sārvadhātuke `cakṣiṅa khyāñ' (2.4.54) iti khyāñādeśo na bhavati|| 16. bhāvalakṣaṇe stheṇkṛñvadicarihutamijanibhyastosun| (3.4.16) `āsaṃsthātoḥ' ityādi| āsaṃsthātoḥ śabdena samāptirucyate, vedyāṃ sadanaṃ lakṣyate| `purā sūryasyodetorādheyaḥ' iti| atrāpyādhānakriyā sūryasyodayena| `purā vatsānām' tyādau vatsānāmapākaraṇenāsanam| `purā pravaditoḥ' ityādau pravadanena havanam| `purā pracaritoḥ' ityādau pracaraṇena havanameva| uttarayorudāharaṇayorāhavanenāsambhavanam|| 17. sṛpitṛdoḥ kasun| (3.4.17) 18. alaṃkhalvoḥ pratiṣedhayoḥ prācāṃ ktvā| (3.4.18) `pratiṣedhavācinoḥ' iti| pratiṣedhayorityasyedaṃ vivaraṇam|etena pratiṣedhavācitvādalaṃkhaluśabdau sūtre pratiṣedhaśabdenoktāviti darśayati| bhavati hi tadvācitvāttācchabdyam; yathā-- `kṣudrajantavaḥ' (2.4.8) iti, tatra kṣudrajantuvācitvādyūkālikṣādayaḥ śabdāḥ kṣudrajantuśabdenoktāḥ| `alaṅkāraḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ| bhūṣaṇavacano'trālaṃśabdaḥ| `alaṃ vāle rodanena' iti| bhāve lyuṭ| `vāsarūpavidhiriti cet' iti| vināpi prāggrahaṇena vikalpo labhyata eva| yasmādasarūpo'pavādo bādhako bhavatītyevaṃ cenmanyase,evaṃ tarhi prāggrahaṇam, pūrvaṃ stryadhikārāt| pareṇa vāsarūpavidhirnāstīti cetasi kṛtvā vikalpārthaṃ prāggrahaṇamuktam|| 19. udīcāṃ māṅo vyatīhāre| (3.4.19) `apamitya' iti| `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityātvam, `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ, `samāse'ऩñpūrve ktvo lyap' (7.1.37) iti lyap, `mayateridanyatarasyām' (6.4.70) itīttvam, `hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' (6.1.71)| nanu ca `samānakarttṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle' (3.4.21) ityanenaivātra ktvāpratyayo bhavati, asti hyatrāpi samānakarttṛkatvam| tathā hi-- ya evāpamayateḥ karttā sa eva yācateḥ,tatkimarthaṃ vidhīyate ? ityāha-- `apūrvakālatvāt' ityādi| pūrvaṃ hyasau yācate paścādapamayata iti nāsti pūrvakālatvam, tasmādaprāpta eva ktvā vidhīyate| vidhīyatānnamāma; ayantu doṣaḥ-- yadaivāsmādvacanānmayateḥ ktvā bhavati, tadaiva samānakarttṛkayorityasmādvacanādyācaterapi syāt ? naiṣa doṣa-; yasmāt `samānakarttṛkayoḥ' (3.4.21) ityatra `udīcām' (3.4.19) iti varttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā,tena yadā mayateḥ ktvā bhavati tadā yācateḥ ktavā na bhaviṣyati| `udīcāṃgrahaṇāt' ityādi| udīcāṃgrahaṇamiha vikalpārtham| tena yathāprāptamapi pakṣe bhavati| yācateḥ ktvā| mayaterlaḍādiḥ| māṅiti `māṅa māne' (dhā.pā.1142) ityasyāyaṃ nirdeśa iti kasyacidāśaṅkā syāt,atastāṃ nirākarttumāha-- `meṅa kṛtāttvasyāyaṃ nirdaśaḥ' iti| kutaḥ punaretadavagatam ? vyatīhāragrahaṇāt| meṅeva vyatīhāre varttate, na māṅa, tasmānmeṅa evāyaṃ nirdeśa iti vijñāyate| kimarthaṃ punarevaṃ nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ,kṛte yatra sati sandehaḥ syāt, na meṅa ityevāsandigdhaḥ karttavya syādityata āha-- `jñāpanārthaḥ'iti| meṅa ityevaṃ nirdeśe karttavye
