yaḥ sānubandhakasya kṛtāttvasya nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ sa jñāpanārthaḥ| tenaitajjñāpayate-- `nānubandhakṛtamanejantatvam' iti| `tena' ityādinā jñāpanaprayojanaṃ darśayati| yadyamartho na jñāpyeta tato halantatvād daipa ejantatvaṃ na syāt| tatra ko doṣaḥ ? dābgrahaṇena daibgrahaṇaṃ na syāt; bhinnerūpatvāt| tataśca `dādhā ghvadāp' (1.1.20) ityatra daipaḥ pratiṣedho na syāt| asmiṃstvarthe jñāpite sati bhavati|| 20. parāvarayoge ca| (3.4.20) ihemau parāvaraśabdau sambandhiśabdau| pūrvañcāpekṣya paro bhavati, parañcāpekṣ.yāvaraḥ,sambandhiśabdāśca niyatameva pratiyoginamupasthāpayanti, tasmāt sūtre yadyapi viśiṣṭaprayogo na mirdiśyate, tathāpi pūrvaparayoreva parāvarābhyāṃ yogo gamyata ityāha-- `pareṇa pūrvasya' ityādi| `paranadīyogena parvato viśiṣyate' iti| tathā hyaprāpya nadīṃ parvata ityukte parayā nadyā parvatasya yo yogastadviśiṣṭaḥ parvataḥ pratīyate| `avaraparvatayogena nadī viśiṣyate' ivi| yasmādatikramya parvataṃ nadītyukte'vareṇa parvatena nadyā ca yo yogastadviśiṣṭa nadī vijñāyate|| 21. samānakarttṛkayoḥ pūrvakāleḥ| (3.4.21) dhātvadhikārāddhātvarthasyaiva samānakarttṛkatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `samānaḥ karttā yayordhātvarthayoḥṭa ityādi| nirdhāraṇe ceyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī| samānaśabdaścāyamekavācī| nanu śakti kārakam, anyā ca pūrvakālakriyāyāḥ, tatkutaḥ samānakarttṛkatvaṃ vijñāyate ? ityāha-- `śaktiśaktimatoḥ' ityādi| śaktiḥ śaktimām̐śca śaktiśaktimantau| yaśca śaktyādhāro yā ca śaktistayoriha bhedo na vivakṣitaḥ| tena śaktyādhāra eka eva devadattaḥ karttā, sa cobhayorapi kriyayoreka eveti yuktaṃ samānakarttṛkatvam| `pītvā' iti| pūrvavadītvam | iha `samānakarttṛkayoḥ' iti dvirvacanena nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ tena dve eva kriye pratyupasthāsyete, na bahvyaḥ, tataśca dvayoreva kriyayoḥ pratyupasthāpitayoḥ syāt, na bahvīṣu ? ityāha-- `dvivacanam' ityādi| kriyāpradhānatvādasya nirdeśasya| nātra dvivacanaṃ pradhānam; nāntarīyakatvāt| tena dvivacanena nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| avaśyaṃ yena kenacidvacanena nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ, tasmādatantratvād‌dvivacanasya, bahvīṣvapi kriyāsu bhavatyeva| `bhuktavati brāhmaṇe vrajati' siti| atra bhujikriyāyā brāhmaṇaḥ karttā, vrajatikriyāyāstu devadatta iti samānakarttṛkatvābhāvaḥ| `vrajati jalpati ca' iti| yaugapadyādiha kriyāyāḥ pūrvakālatā nāsti| `vyādāya' iti| dadātervyāṅapūrvasya rūpam| `sammīlya' iti| `mīla smīla kṣmīla nimeṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.517,519,520) ityasya sampūrvasya hetumaṇṇyantasya| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na sidhyītyāha-- `apūrvakālatvāt'upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- pūrvayogāccakāyo'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena mukhaṃ vyādāya svapitītyādau pūrvakālatvābhāve'pi bhaviṣyatīti|| 22. abhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca| (3.4.22) `dvirvacanasahitau' ityādi| ābhīkṣṇyaṃ hi dyotayituṃ dvirvacanasahitayoreva ktvāṇamuloḥ sāmarthyam, na kevalayoḥ; śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt| tasmāddvirvacanaṃ vidheyamiti bhāvaḥ| kena punaratra dvirvacanamityāha-- `ābhīkṣṇye' ityādi| `pāyampāyam' iti| `āto yuk' (7.3.33)|| 23. na yadyanākāṅkṣe| (3.4.23) `anākāṅkṣe' iti| na vidyata ākāṅkṣā - apekṣā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `ktvā tu pūrvasūtravihito'pi' iti| apiśabdādanantaravihito'pi yuktaṃ yadanantarasūtravihitaḥ pratiṣidhyate-- `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.99) iti kṛtvā| pūrvasūtreṇa vihitasya tu kathaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ? prakaraṇāpekṣayā pratiṣedhavidhānāt| pūrvakālaprakaraṇe yat prāpnoti tanna bhavatītyevamayaṃ pūrvakālaprakaraṇāpekṣayā pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| tasmādyuktaḥ pūrvasūtravihitasyāpi pratiṣedhaḥ|| 24. vibhāṣāgreprathamapūrveṣu| (3.4.24) `ābhīkṣaṇye' iti nānuvarttate' iti| `aprāptavibhāṣeyam' ityatreyaṃ yuktiḥ| nanu ca pratāptavibhāṣeyaṃ yuktā,ṇamulyaprāpte ktvāpratyaye `samānakarttṛkayoḥ' (3.4.21) ityādinā prāpte satyārambhāt ? naitadasti; anantarasūtravihitau hi ktvāṇmulāvityadhikṛtyāprāptavibhāṣeyamityucyate| yastu `samānakarttṛkayoḥ' (3.4.21) ityādinā kevalaḥ ktvā vihitastaṃ prati vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyameva; vāsarūpavidhinā tatpratipāditasyārthasya siddhatvāt| `nanu ca' ityādinā'nantaroktavibhāṣāgrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ vighaṭayati | `ktvāṇamulī yatra' ityādi| vāsarūpavidhinaiva pakṣe laḍādiṣu| siddheṣu yat tadarthaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate tena yatra ktvāṇamulau yugapadvidhīyete tatra vāsarūpavidhirnāstītyeṣo'rtho jñāpyate| kimetasya prayojanaṃ jñāpanasya ? ityāha-- `tena' ityādi| `upapadasamāsaḥ' ityādi| `amaivāvyayena' (2.2.20) ityupapadasamāsaḥ prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `uktam' ityādi| `amaiva yat tulyavidhānamupapadaṃ tat samasyate' (kā.va.2.2.20) ityuktaṃ prāk| agne bhṛtīnyupapadānyamā cānyena ktvāpratyayena tulyavidhānam, ato na samasyante|| 25. karmaṇyākrośe kṛñaḥ khamuñ| (3.4.25) `caurāṅkāram' iti| `arurdviṣadajantasya mum' (6.3.67) iti mum| `caurakaraṇam' ityādi| karotiratroccāraṇakriyaḥ| `cauro'si'ityākrośavākye cauraśabdasya yat karaṇamuccāraṇaṃ tadākrośasyaiva sampādanārtham| na hi tenavinā''krośaḥ śakyate pratipādayitum| `na tvasau cauraḥ kriyate' iti| aśakyatvāt| na ca `cauro'sīti śatakṛtvo'pi bruvatā puruṣasya śakyate cauratvamutpādayitum|| 26. svādumi ṇamul| (3.4.26) `svādumītyarthagrahaṇam‌' iti| nanu ca `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā' (1.1.68) iti vacanāt svarūpasyaiva grahaṇena bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; śabdānuśāsanaprastāvādeva hi śabdasyeti siddhe śabdagrahaṇaṃ yatra śabdaparo nirdeśastatra svaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhyate nārthaparanirdeśa iti jñāpanārthaṃ kṛtam, iha cārthaparo nirdeśaḥ| tasmādarthagrahaṇameva yuktam| arthaparatvaṃ tu nirdeśasyāvicchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśādvijñāyate| arthagrahaṇe ca sati tatparyāyeṣvapi pratyayo labhyata ityāha-- `svādvartheṣu' ityādi| atha `svādumi' iti kimarthaṃ makārāntatvaṃ nipātyate, māntasyopapadasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syāditi cet ? na; yadyetatproyajanam, na nipātayitavyam, anantarasūtre khamuñaḥ prakṛtatvāt sa eva vidhāsyate| asmiṃśca vihite mumaiva māntatvamupapadasya bhaviṣyatītyetaccodyamāpākarttumāha--`svādumi'ityādi| etenaitaddarśayati--yadyapi khamuñi sati sidhyati makārāntatvam, īkārapratiṣedhastu na sidhyati, tataśca svaduśabdādupapadāt `voto guṇavacanāt' (4.1.44) iti ṅīṣ prasajyet, tathā cāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| mākārāntatvanipātane hi nimittasya vihitatvānṅīṣprasaṅgo nāsti| tasmādyo'pi khamuñaṃ vidadhāti tenāpyavaśyamīkārapratiṣedhārthaṃ makārāntaṃ nipātayitavyamiti| yadyapi parasyābhimatam-- `khamuñi vihite mumaiva makārāntatvaṃ bhaviṣyati' iti, tadapi na sarvatreti sūcayitumāha-- `cvyantasya' ityādi| anenaitaddarśayati-- yadi makārāntatvaṃ na nipātyeta, tadā satyapi khamuñi makārāntatvaṃ cvyantasyopapadasya na syāt; tasyāvyayatvāt| mum‌vidhau ca `khityanavyayasya' (6.3.66) ityadhikārāt| tasmādyo'pi khamuñaṃ vidadhāti tenāpi makārāntatvanipātanaṃ karttavyam| evaṃ hi makārāntatvanipātanameva kriyatām, pratyayastu prakṛtaḥ khamuñeva vidhātavyaḥ ? aśakyaḥ khamuñ vidhātum; khamuñpratyaye hi makārāntatvanipātanamavyayārthaṃ vijñāyate,tataśca `cvau ca' (6.3.64) iti dīrghatvaṃ syādeva| ṇamuli sati sarvavidhayapavādastu vijñāyeta, tena dīrghatvamapi na bhavati| avaśyañcottarārthaṃ ṇamul vidheyaḥ, na ca tasminnuttaratra vidhīyamāne lāghavaṃ bhavati, nāpīha gauravam| kva punarartha ete pratyā bhavantītyāha-- `tumarothādhikārācca' ityādi|| `ete' iti| ye tumarthadhikāre vihitāḥ| `yadyevam' iti| yadi tumarthe bhavantītyarthaḥ| `bhujipratyayena' ityādi| yadyapi ṇamulā'nabhihitaḥ karttā, tathāpi bhujipratyayena laṭābhihita iti na bhavitavyaṃ tṛtīyayā| nanu ca śaktilakṣaṇaḥ karttā, anyā ca svādukaraṇaviṣayā śaktiḥ, anyā ca bhujikriyāviṣayā, tatra laṭābhihitāyāmapi bhujikriyāviṣāyāyāṃ śaktāvitarasyāḥ śakteḥ karttṛsaṃjñāyā anabhidhānāt {prāpnotītyeva-mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} prāpnotyeva tṛtīyetyāha-- `na cāsmin' ityādi| atra hi samānakarttṛkaprakaraṇe śaktamataḥ śaktīnāñca bhedo na vivakṣyate| tena śaktimān devadattaḥ karttā| sa caika evābhihitaśceti kutastatīyāprasaṅgaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ bhedenopādānaṃ na vivakṣitam ? ityāha-- `samānakarttṛkatve hi' ityādi| abhyupagamyāpi bhedavivakṣām, parihārāntaramāha-- `pradhānaśaktyabhidhāne' ityādi| kiṃ kṛtaḥ punaratra karttṛśaktyoḥ pradhānaguṇabhāvaḥ ? kriyākṛtaḥ; svāduṅkāraṃ hi guṇabhūtam, bhujikriyārthatvāt| bhujikriyā tu pradhānam; tenopakāryatvāt| kriyāyāśca guṇapradānabhāvāt tadviṣayayorapi karttṛśaktyoḥ pradhānaguṇabhāvo bhavati| tatra pradhānaśaktāvabhihitāyāmapradānaśaktirabhihitatvāt prakāśate - pratibhāsate; pradhānānuyāyitvād‌guṇānām| tena tṛtīyā na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|| 27. anyathaivaṃkathamitthaṃsu siddhāprayogaścet| (3.4.27) `siddhāprayogaḥ' iti| siddho'prayogo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `nirarthakatvāt' ityādi| abhidheyābhāvāt prayojanābhāvādvā nirarthakatvam| `evameva' iti| nirarthakatvamevetyarthaḥ| `anyathā bhuṅkte' ityādinā tadevānarthakatvaṃ cetasi kṛtvā siddhāprayogatāṃ darśayati| anyathā bhuṅkte iti yāvānevārthaḥ karotāvaprayujyamāne gamyate tāvānevārthaḥ karotāvaprayujyamāne gamyate tāvānevārtho'nyathākāraṃ bhuṅkta iti karotau prayujyamāne'pi| tasmādanarthakaḥ karotiḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ prayujyamāna evānarthako bhavati ? anyathādayaete prakāravacanāḥ, te yadānuprayogadhātorarthas prakāramācakṣate tadā kṛñapi tairviśeṣyamāṇastadīyaprakāramācaṣṭe, gacānyata evāvagata ityanarthako bhavati| yadyevam, avagatārthatvāt tasya prayogo na prāpnoti ? naivam; avagatārthamapi prayogo dṛśyate-- apūpau dvāvānaya, pacāmyahamiti| `anyathā kṛtvā śiro bhuṅkte' ityatrānyathāśabdena padāntarasya śirasaḥ prakāramākhyāyate| sa vinā karotinā nāvagamyate| yadi hi karotirna prayujyeta, bhujikriyāgata eva prakāro'nyathālakṣaṇaḥ pratīyateta, na śirogataḥ| śirasastu bhujyamānataivāvagamyeta| tasmānnātra karotiḥ śiddhāprayogaḥ|| 28. yathātathayorasūyāprativacane| (3.4.28) `asūyāprativacane' iti| asūyāprabhavaṃ prativacanamasūyāprativacanam| `yadyasūyan' ityādi| asūyanniti śatrantametat| kaṇḍvādiyagantaḥ| asya prativaktītyanena sambandhaḥ| prativakti - pratibhaṇati, prativacanaṃ vadātītyarthaḥ| `pṛcchati' iti| saptamyantametat| pṛcchati sati yadyasūyan - asūyāṃ kurvan prativakti tadā tatra pṛcchati yat prativacanaṃ tadasūyāprativacanam| `yathākāram' ityādi| kathaṃ bhavān bhokṣyate ityevaṃ vacanaṃ pṛcchati satyasūyāprativacanam| `yathākāram' ityādi| kathaṃ bhavān bhokṣyate ityevaṃ vacanaṃ pṛcchati satyasūyāprativacanametat| `yathā kṛtvā'haṃ bhokṣye tathā drakṣyasi' iti. naitadasūyāprativacanam| kiṃ tarhi ? tadvyākhyānam|| 29. karmaṇi dṛśividoḥ sākalye| (3.4.29) `karmaṇyupapade sākalyaviśiṣṭe' iti| etena sākalyagrahaṇaṃ karmaviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| `{yaṃ yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jānāti-- kāśikā'} yaṃ yaṃ jānāti labhate vicārayati vā' iti| etena jñānalābhavicāraṇārthānāṃ vidīnāṃ grahaṇamiti darśayati| kutaḥ punaḥ sattārthasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati ? tasyākarmakatvāt, karmaṇīti copādānāt|| 30. yāvati vindajīvoḥ| (3.4.30) `vindateḥ' iti| `vidlṛ lābhe' (dhā.pā.1432) ityasya|| 31. carmodarayoḥ pūreḥ| (3.4.31) `pūrayateḥ' iti| etena nirdeśe ṇyantasyedaṃ grahaṇamityācaṣṭe| iha karmaṇīti varttate| na cāṇyantasya pūreḥ karma sambhavati; akarmakā hi dhātavo ṇyantāḥ sakarmakā bhavanti| tasmāṇṇyantasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate|| 32. varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām| (3.4.32) `samudāyena' iti| prakṛtipratyayopapadasamudāyena| etena varṣapramāṇasya samudāyopādhitvaṃ darśayati| `asyagrahaṇaṃ kimartham' iti| prakṛtatvāt pūrayateḥ, asyeti vacanamantareṇāpi tasyaiva lopo vijñāsyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `upapadasya mā bhūt' iti| yadyasyeti nocyeta tato yathā varṣapramāṇaṃ samudāyopādhirvijñāyate, ūlopo'pi tathā samudāyopādhirvijñāyeta| pkṛtipratyayopapadasya samudāyasya ya ūkārāntasya lopo bhavatīti, tataścopapadasyāpi syāt| tasmāt mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti `asya' ityucyate|| 33. cele knopeḥ| (3.4.33) `ṇyantāt' iti| sapukkasyāyāṃ nirdeśaḥ| puk ca `arttihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā ṇāveva parato bhavatīti| tasmādata eva nirdeśāṇṇyantatā'vagamyate| `celārtheṣu'iti| celamardho yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| etena `cela' ityasyārthagrahaṇatāṃ darśayati| arthagrahaṇe ca yā yuktiḥ sā `svādumi ṇamul' (3.4.26) ityatroktā, saivehārthagrahaṇe draṣṭavyā| `celaknopam' iti| vali yalopaḥ, `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ, ṇilopaḥ|| 34. nimūlasamūlayoḥ kaṣaḥ| (3.4.34) `kaṣaḥ' iti| `kaṣa śiṣa' (dhā.pā.685,687) iti hiṃsārthadhātuvarge paṭhyate|| 35. śuṣkacūrṣarūkṣeṣu pidhaḥ| (3.4.35) `piṣaḥ' iti| `piṣlṛ sañcūrṇane' (dhā.pā.1452)|| 36. samūlākṛtajīveṣu hankṛñgrahaḥ| (3.4.36) `samūlaghātam' iti| `ho hanterñṇinneṣu' (7.3.54) iti kṛtvam, `hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ' (7.3.32) iti tatvam|| 37. karaṇe hanaḥ| (3.4.37) `ahiṃsārtho'yamārambhaḥṭa iti| hiṃsāyām `hiṃsārthānām' (3.4.48) iti vakṣyamāṇena siddhatvā| `nityasamāsārthaḥ' iti| hiṃsārthasyāpīti śeṣaḥ| `upapadamatiṅ' (2.2.19) iti nityasamāso yathā syādityevamartho'yamārambhaḥ| tena tu pratyaye sati `tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām' (2.2.21) iti vikalpena syāt| `yathāvidhyanuprayogārthaśca' iti| `kaṣādiṣu yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ' (3.4.46) iti| yasmāddhātorṇamul vihitastasyaivānuprayogo yathā syāt, tena tu pratyaye dhātvantarsayānuprayogaḥ syāt| nanu ca yatā hantihiṃsārtho bhavati tadā paratvāt tenaiva bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ nityasamāsārtho yathāvidhyanuprayogārthaśca hiṃsārthasya hanterayamārambho yujyate ? ityata āha-- `pūrvavipratiṣedhena' ityādi|| 38. snehane pipaḥ| (3.4.38) `snehanavācini' ityanena `snehane' ityasyārthamācaṣṭe|| 39. haste varttigrahoḥ| (3.4.39) `varttirṇyantaḥ' iti| nirdeśādeva varterṇyantatvaṃ pratīyate|| 40. sve pupaḥ| (3.4.40) `svapoṣam' iti| ātmavācinī svaśabda upapade pratyayaḥ| `gopoṣam' iti| ātmīyavācini| `dhanapoṣam' iti dhanavācini| `pitṛpoṣam' iti jñātavācini|| 41.adhikaraṇe bandhaḥ| (3.4.41) 42. saṃjñāyām| (3.4.42) 43.kartrorjīvapuruṣayornaśivahoḥ| (3.4.43) `naṣṭaḥ' iti| naśervraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam, `masjinaśorjhali' (7.1.60) ityāgamasya numaḥ `aniditām'(6.4.24) ityādinā lopaḥ| `puruṣeṇoḍhaḥ' iti| vahervacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam, `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti parapūrvatvam, `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31), `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40), `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41), `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13), `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111) iti dīrghaḥ|| 44. ūrdhve śuṣipūroḥ| (3.4.44) `ūrdhvaṃ pūryate' iti| ūrdhvaṃ pūrito bhavatītyarthaḥ| anudāttettvādātmanepadam, divāditvacchyan|| 45. upamāne karmaṇi ca| 93.4.45) `ghṛtanidhāyam' iti| pūrvavad yuk|| 46. kaṣādiṣu yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ| (3.4.46) 47.upadaṃstṛtīyāyām| (3.4.47) iha `mūlakenopadaṃśaṃ bhuṅkte' ityādau karaṇe tṛtīyā, tadantaṃ mūlakādyupapadam| tacca karaṇamudaṃśervā syāt, bhujervā ? tatropadaṃśestāvannopapadyate; anyasmin {hyupadiśyamāne-mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} hyupadaṃśyamāne'nyat karaṇaṃ bhavati, iha ca tadeva mūlakādyupadaśyate, nāparaṃ kiñcit| bhujiṃ tu pratyupapadyata eva karaṇabhāvaḥ, kintūpapadasaṃjñā na syāt, tadabhāvadupapadasamāsaśca; yasmādupapadamiti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇaṃ samarthaparibhāṣāyā vyāpārtham, teneha tasyāmupasthitāyāṃ yameva prati yasya sāmarthya tameva prati tasyopapadasaṃjñāyā bhavitavyam| bhujiṃ tu prati tasyopapadasaṃjñayā bhavitavyam| bhujiṃ tu prati mūlakādeḥ sāmarthyam, nopadaṃśi pratīti codyamāśaṅkyāha-- `mūlakādi copadaṃśe' ityādi| yadyapi bhujiṃ prati mūlakādeḥ karaṇabhāvaḥ tathāpyupadaṃśinā saha sāmarthyamupapadyata eva; yatastasya karma| na ca bhujinā saraha sambandhe satyupadaṃśinā saha sambandho nivarttate; virodhābhāvāt| tasmādupapadyata evopapadatvam, tasmiṃśca satyupapadasamāsaḥ| `kriyābhede sati'iti| kriyābhedagrahaṇena ktvāpratyayaviṣayamupalakṣayati| yatra kriyāṇāṃ paurvāparyaṃ samānakarttṛkatvañca sa ktvāpratyayasya viṣayaḥ| etaccobhayaṃ kriyābhede sati bhavatīti ktvāpratyayasya viṣaya upalakṣyate| `mūlakenopadaśya bhuṅkte' iti| `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ|| 48. hiṃsārthāñca samānasakarmakāṇām| (3.4.48) dhātusambandhādhikārādanuprayogeṇa bhavitavyam, dviṣṭhatvāt| tatra pratyāsatteranuprayogadhātvapekṣayaiva samānakarmatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `anuprayogadhātunā' ityādi| `kālayati' iti| `{vela kālopadeśe (kāla iti pṛthagdhāturityeke)-dhā.pā. kala kṣepe-dhā.pā.} kāla vikṣepe (dhā.pā.1880)| `dantatāḍam' iti| `taḍa āghāte' (dhā.pā.1579), curādireva| `daṇḍenāhatya' ityādi| atra hanteścauraḥ karma , anuprayogadhātośca gauriti samānakarmakatvābhāvaḥ| tena ktvāpratyaya eva bhavati| `āhatya' iti| `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinā'nunāsikalopaḥ, `hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' (6.1.71)|| 49. saptamyāṃ copapījarudhakarṣaḥ| (3.4.49) `upaśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate' iti| rudhikaṣibhyāmupapūrvābhyāmeva yathā syāt| `pārśvopapīḍam' iti| `pīḍa avagāhane' (dhā.pā.1544), curādiḥ| `karṣateḥ' ityādi| `kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā.990, 1286) bhvādau tutādau ca paṭhyate, tatreha bhauvādikasya grahaṇam, na taudādikasya; śapā nirdeśāt| śapā nirdeśastasya kṛtaguṇasyoccāraṇāllabhyate|| 50. samāsattau| (3.4.50) `yuddhasaṃrabhāt' iti| saṃrambhaḥ - manaḥ saṃkṣobhapūrvako vākkāyavikāraviśeṣaḥ,yuddhāya saṃrambho yuddhasaṃrambhaḥ, tasmādatyantaṃ sannikṛṣyante, ptatyāsīdantīti yāvat|| 51. pramāṇe ca| (3.4.51) `pramāṇamāyāmaḥ' iti| `āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ syāt' iti vacanāt| dairghyamiti prasiddhatarārthena śabdāntareṇa pramāṇaśabdasyaivārthaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| `dvyaṅgulotkarṣam' iti| dvyoraṅgulyoḥ samāhāro dvyaṅgulam, `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ' (5.4.86) ityādinā'c| tena dvyaṅgulena khaṇḍikāyā derghyaṃ paricchidyate|| 52. apādāne parīpsāyām| (3.4.52) `śayyotthāyam'iti| `udaḥ sthāstambhoḥ pūrvasya ' (8.4.61) iti pūrvasavar ṇaḥ, `āto yuk' (7.3.33) evam' ityādinā parīpsāṃ darśayati| `randhrāpakarṣam' iti| evaṃ nāma tvarate yat pātramapi nāpekṣate, stanarandhrādevāpakṛṣya mukhena payaḥ pibatītyarthaḥ| `bhrāṣṭrāpakarṣam' iti| evaṃ nāma tvarate yadbhājanamapi dīyamānaṃ nāpekṣate, bhrāṣṭrādevāpakṛṣya hastena bhakṣayati|| 53. dvitīyāyāśca| (3.4.53) 54. svāṅe'dhruve| (3.4.54) svāṅgalakṣaṇamadravādi caturthe vakṣyati| `akṣinikāṇam' iti| `kaṇa nimīlane' (dhā.pā.1715), curādirnipūrvaḥ| `yasminnaṅgecchinne prāṇī na mriyate taddhratam' iti| pāṇipādādikam| adhruvatvaṃ punastasya jīvatyapi prāṇini kadācidabhāvāt| yasmistvaṅge cchinne prāṇī mriyate tad‌dhruvam, śiraḥprabhṛti| dhruvatvaṃ punastasya sadā prāṇini sanniveśāt|| 55. parikliśyamāne ca| (3.4.55) `parikleśaḥ sarvato vibādhanam' iti| sarvataḥśabdena pariśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| vibādhanaśabdenāpi kliśerdhātoḥ|| 56. viśipatipadiskandāṃ vyāpyamānāsevyamānayoḥ| (3.4.56) `viśyādibhiḥ kriyādibhiḥ' iti| ādiśabdena patyāditrayāṇāṃ grahaṇam| `anavayavena' iti| sākalyena| `padārthānām' iti| gehādīnām|`tātparyam' iti| kriyāṇāṃ paunaḥpunyamābhīkṣṇyamityarthaḥ| `dravye vyāptiḥ' ityādinā vyāpyamānāsevyamānayorviṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati| yadi vyāpyamāna āsevyamāne cārthe pratyayo bhavati, evañca sati tayorarthayornityatā vīpsā ca vidyata iti `nityavīpsayoḥ'(8.1.4) iti dvivacanena bhavitavyam, tat kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- `samānena'ityādi| yadyapi samāsastayorarthayorna vidhīyate, purastādeva pratipāditam| `tathā ca vakṣyati'iti|bhāṣyakāraḥ| `supsu vīpsā 'iti vacanāt `vyāptamānatāyāṃ dravyavacanasya dvirvacanaṃ bhavati'ityuktaṃ bhavati| `tiṅkṣu nityatā'iti vacanāt `āsedhyamānatāyāṃ kriyāvacanasya dvirvacanaṃ bhavati' ityuktaṃ bhavati| `gehaṃgeham'iti| dravyamavacanasya dvirvacamanam| `gehamanupraveśamanupraveśam'iti| kriyāvacanasya|`nanu ca'ityādi deśyaṃ `ktvānivṛttyartham'ityādinā paramatamāśaṅkya nirākaroti| syādetat, `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca' (3.4.22) ityanena ktvāṇamulau dvāvapi vihitau, tatra yadi viśyādibhyaḥ punarāsevāyāṃ ṇamul vidhīyeta tadā ktvāpratyayo'pi syāt| atastannivṛttyarthaṃ punarṇamulucyata iti ? etacca nāsti; iṣṭatvāt| iṣyate hyāsevāyāṃ viśiprabhṛtibhyaḥ ktvā-- gehamanupraviśyānupraviśyāsta iti| tasmādayuktaṃ tannivṛttyarthaṃ punarṇamulgrahaṇam| `dvitīyāntopapadārtham' ityādi| yadi ktvānivṛttyarthaṃ na prayujyate tadā dvitīyāntasyopapadasaṃjñārthaṃ punarvacanam| anena `dvitīyāyāñca' (3.4.53) ityadhikārāddvitīyānta upapade pratyayavidhānam| ato dvitīyāntasyopapadasaṃjñā labhyate| kimarthaṃ punardvitīyāntasyopapadatvamiṣyate ? ityāha-- `upapadasamāsaḥ' ityādi| pakṣagrahaṇaṃ `tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām' (2.2.21) iti vikalpena samāsavidhānāt| syādetat--tenāpi ṇamulvidhāna upapadasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatītyata āha--`tena hi'ityādi| na hi tenopapadasambandhe ṇamul vidhīyate; saptamīsthasya kasyacicchabdasyābhāvāt| tasmāt tena ṇamulvidhāne satyupapadatvābhāva eva syāt|| 57. asyatitṛṣoḥ kriyāntare kāleṣu| (3.4.57) `asyatitṛṣoḥ'iti| `asu kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209), ñitṛṣā pipāsāyām' (dhā.pā.1228)| `kriyāmantarayati' ityādi| antaraṃ karotīti `tatkaroti'(vā.200) ityādinā ṇic| `kriyāmantarayati kriyāntaraḥ' (iti) karmaṇyaṇ, ṇilopaḥ|antaraśabdaścāyamiha vyavadhāne varttata iti darśayannāha--`kriyāvyavadhāyakaḥ'iti| `pāyayati'iti| `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925), ṇic| `śācchā'(7.3.37) ityādinā yuk| `atyasanena tarṣaṇena ca gavāṃ pānakriyā vyavadhīyate' iti| yaccāyaṃ pānaṃ yacca dvyahe'tīte pānaṃ bhavitā tanmadhyavartitvādtayasananatarṣaṇayoḥ| `adya pāyayitvā' ityādinā dvyahātyāsaṃ gāḥ pāyayatītyasyārthamācaṣṭe| etadanusāreṇānyasyāpyartho gamyata itina vyākhyātaḥ| `dvyahamupodhya'iti| `vasa nivāse'(dhā.pā.1942), vacyādinā (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam, ktvo lyabādeśaḥ `śāsivasighasīnāñca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam| atropavasane bhujikriyāvyavadhāyake vasirvarttate| atra `asyatitṛṣoḥ'iti yadi nocyeta tadehāpi syāt| `na gatirvyavadhīyate' iti| yathā malodāharaṇe'tyasanena tarṣaṇena ca madhyavarttinā pānakriyā vyavadhīyate, na tatheha gatiḥ| tatra cāhañchabdātṛ `kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā| sakalasyāhna iṣvatyasanena vyāptatvādiṣuśabdāt karmaṇyeva| `yojanamatyasya gāḥ pāyayati' iti| atrādhvavācyupapadam| kvacit srudhnādau pāyayitvā yojanamatikramya pāyayatītyarthaḥ| `adhvakarmakam‌', `na kālakarmakam'iti dvāvapi bahuvrīhī|| 58. nāmnyādiśigrahoḥ| (3.4.58) `ādiśeḥ' iti| `diśa atisarjane' (dhā.pā.1283)), āṅpūrvaḥ|| 59. avyaye'yathābhipretākhyāne kṛñaḥ ktvāṇamulau| (3.4.59) `ayathābhipretākhyāne' iti| yadyadabhipretamiṣṭaṃ yathābhipretam, `yathā'sādṛśye'(2.1.7) iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvasamāsaḥ, na yathābhipretamayathābhipretam| apriyamityarthaḥ| `ācakṣe'iti| āṅapūrvāccakṣiṅo laṭ; `thāsaḥ se'(3.4.80), `skoḥ saṃyogādyoranteca'(8.2.29) iti kakāralopaḥ, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam,`iṇkoḥṭa (8.1.57) iti ṣatvam| `uktam' iti| kvoktam ? `upadaṃśastṛtīyāyām' (3.4.47) ityatra| upapadasamāsārthaṃ vacanamiti ca| `ktvā ca' (2.2.22) ityanenopapadasamāsaḥ pakṣe yathā syāt| kasmāt punaranena yaḥ ktvā vihitastena samāso bhavati ? yastu `samānakarttṛkayoḥ' (3.4.21) ityādinā vihitastena na bhavati ? ityāha-- `tathā hi' ityādi| `ktvā ca'(2.2.22) ityatra `tṛtīyāprabhṛtīni' (2.2.21) ityanuvarttate| tasmādanena yaḥ ktvā vihitastenaiva pakṣe samāso bhavati, na tu tena, tṛtīyāprabhṛtiṣūpapadeṣu ktvā vidhīyate| atha ṇamulgrahaṇaṃ kimartham; yāvatā ṇamulanuvarttata eva,tataḥ ktavā ceti vaktavyam ? ityāha-- `ṇamuladhikāre' ityādi| tulyakakṣatvaṃ tadvat tulyabalatvam| `tena' ityādi| jñāpakasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| yadi `ktvā ca' ityucyeta| cakāreṇa yatnādanukṛṣṭo ṇamuluttaratra nānuvartteta; yatnābhāvāt| yathā tena ktvāpratyayasyānvācīyamānatā vijñāyeta tataścottaratra tasyāpradhānyādanuvṛttirna syāt| punarṇamulgrahaṇe sati sahanirdeśāt ktvāṇamulorguṇapradhānabhāvo na bhavatīti dvayorapyanuvṛttirbhavati|| 60. tiryacyapavarge| (3.4.60) `tiryakkṛtvā' iti| tiro'ñcatīti ṛtvigādinā (3.2.59) kvin| `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti cakārasya jakāre kṛte `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ'(8.2.62) iti kutvam--gakāraḥ, tasyāpi cartvam-- kakāraḥ, `tirasastiryalope' (6.3.94) iti tiryādeśaḥ| `tiryakkṛtvā `{kāṣṭhaṃ iti mūlapāṭhaḥ} kāṇḍaṃ gataḥ'iti| anṛjṛ kṛtvā| pārśvataḥ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| atha `tiryaci' ko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, yāvatā bhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `acaḥ' (6.4.38) ityakāralope kṛte tiraścīti bhavitavyamityata āha-- `tiryaci' ityādi| sarvatra hyanukaraṇabhūtaśabdaḥ śabdasvarūpasyaivānukaraṇam| etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ-- kvaciccabdapadārthasyānukaraṇam, kvacidarthasyeti| tatrānukaraṇamityetāvapi vaktavye śabdarūpagrahaṇaṃ śabdarūpamātrasyārtharahitasyaitadanukaraṇamiti jñāpanārtham| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- śabdapadārthako yastiryakchabdastasyedamanukaraṇam, na tu sa eva| tena śabdāntaratvādakāralopo na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| nanvevamapi `prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati'(vyā.pa.113) iti bhavitavyamevātra prakṛtikāryeṇākāralopena ? ityata āha-- `na ca' ityādi| atraivopapattimāha--`anukriyamāṇarūpavināśaprasaṅgāt' iti| yadyatra prakṛtikāryaṃ syāt tato yādṛśamanukaraṇaṃ tiryagiti śabdarūpaṃ tasya vināśo'nupalabdhiḥ syāt| yādṛśamanukarttumiṣṭamakṛtākāralopaṃ tādṛśaṃ na pratīyetetyarthaḥ| yataevaṃ prakṛtivadanukaraṇabhāve satyeṣa doṣa āpatati, tatoneha prakṛtivadanukaraṇena bhavitavyam| `prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.113) ityasya tu yatrārthapadārthasyānukaraṇaṃ so'vakāśo veditavyaḥ| kva ca yathā prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatītyāha-- `etado'ś' ityādi| etado'dasa ityubhayamapyetacchabdarūpapadārthakasyānukaraṇam| yadi ca śabdapadārthakasya yadanukaraṇaṃ tasyāpi prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt, tadā tyadādyatvādike prakṛtikārye kṛte-- etasya, amuṣyeti rūpaṃ syāt| tasyādyatheha prakṛtibhāvo na bhavati,tathātiryacītyatrāpi|| 61.svāṅge taspratyaye kṛbhvoḥ| (3.4.61) `yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati, yāvatā dve prakṛtī, pratyayāvapi dvāvevetyasti yathāsaṃkhyaprāptinimittam ? `kṛbhvoḥ' iti nirdeśāllakṣamavyabhicāracihnāt| iha pratyaye vidhīyamāne `paraśca' (3.1.2) iti sambandhāddigyogalakṣaṇayā pañcamyā bhavitavyam, tatar kṛbhūbhyāmiti pañcamīnirdeśe karttavye yo'yaṃ `kṛbhvoḥ' iti nirdeśāllakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnāt| iha pratyaye vidhīyamāne `paraśca' (3.1.2) iti sambandhāddigyogalakṣaṇayā pañcamyā bhavitavyam, tatra kṛbhūbhyāmiti pañcamīnirdeśe karttavye yo'yaṃ `kṛbhvoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ sa lakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnam, tena yathāsakhyābhāva iti veditavyam| `mukhataḥ' iti| `apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' (5.4.45) iti tasiḥ| `mukhīkṛtya' iti| atra mukhaśabdaścvyantaḥ| `abhūtatadbhāve' (5.4.50) ityādinā cviḥ, `asya cvau' (7.4.32) itīttvam| `mukhe tasyati' iti| `tasu upakṣaye', (dhā.pā.1212) `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip, halhyādinā (6.1.68) sulopaḥ, rutvavisarjanīyau| dhāturatra tas‌śabdaḥ, na tu pratyayaḥ| tena tadanta ḍapadeśe ktvāṇamulau na bhavataḥ, `samānakarttṛkayoḥ' (3.4.21) iti ktvaiva bhavati|| 62. nādhārthapratyaye cvyarthe| (3.4.62) `nārtho dhārthaśca' iti| nāpratyayasahacarito'rtho nā ityucyate, dhāpratyayasahacaritaśca dhā iti| nā'rtho yasya pratyayasya sa nārthaḥ dhā'rtho yasya pratyayasya sa dhārtha iti| `dvidhākṛtya' iti| `saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā' (5.3.42)| `dvaidhaṃ kṛtvā' iti| `dvitryosca dhamuñ' (5.3.45) iti dhamuñ| `dvedhākṛtya' iti| `edhācca' (5.3.46) ityedhāc| `hiruk kṛtvā, pṛthak kṛtvā' iti| asati pratyayagrahaṇe hirukpṛthakśabdayorasahārthatvāt nārthatvanamastīti tayorapyupapadayoḥ ktvāṇamulau syātām| pūrvasūtrādeva pratyayagrahaṇānuvṛttyā siddhe punariha pratyayagrahaṇaṃ sukhapratipattyartham| pūrvakaṃ hi pratyayagrahaṇaṃ samāsaikadeśatvādyatnānuvṛttaṃ syāt| `nānā kṛtvā kāṣṭhāni gataḥ' iti| cvyartho'tra nāsti; prakṛtyanyāvasthāyā avivakṣitatvāt| `dhārthamarthagrahaṇam' iti| dhāpratyayo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat tathoktaḥ| dhārthā hi pratyayā bahavaḥ,tatrasatyarthagrahaṇe dhāpratyayasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, nānyeṣāṃ tadarthānām| athagrahaṇe tu sati teṣāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati| atha nārthamapyarthagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- `nā punareka eva' iti| arthagrahaṇaṃ hi tatra kriyate yatra bahavo grāhyāḥ sambhavanti, nāpratyayastveka eva,tasya cārthagrahaṇamantareṇa sidhyatīti na tadarthamarthagrahaṇam| nanu ca ghamuñādīnāmapi sthānivadbhāvādeva dhāgrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, atodhārthamapyarthagrahaṇamayuktam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; aghādeśo'pi dhārthapratyayo'sti, `ghamuñantāt svārthe ḍadarśanam' (vyā.pa.610) iti vacanāt| tasmāddhārthamarthagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ-- nārthamapyarthagrahaṇaṃ karttavyameva| tathā hi-- dvau nāpratyayau; eko niranubandhakaḥ, dvitīyaḥ sānubandhakaḥ| tatrāsatyarthagrahaṇe `niranubandhagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti nāpratyayasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na sānubandhakasya nāñaḥ| arthagrahaṇe tu sati tasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati|| 63. tūṣṇīmi bhuvaḥ| (3.4.63) nanu ca `svāṅge taspratyaye kṛbhvoḥ' (3.4.61) ityato bhūgrahaṇamanuvarttata eva, tat kimarthaṃ bhuva itīhocyate ? ityāha-- `bhūgrahaṇam' ityādi| pūrva hi bhūgrahaṇaṃ kṛñā sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt; atastannivṛtyarthaṃ punariha bhūgrahaṇam|| 64. anvacyānulomye| (3.4.64) `anvaci' iti nirdeśastiryacītyanena vyākhyātaḥ| `anvagbhūya'iti| pūrvavat kvini kṛte tadantasya jaśtve kṛte ca rūpam| `anvagbhūtvāṭa iti| anucaro bhūtvā tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ|| 65. śakadhṛṣajñāglāghaṭarabhalabhakramasahārhāstyartheṣu tumun| (3.4.65) nanu ca `tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' (3.3.10) ityevaṃ śakādiṣūpapadeṣu tumun siddhaḥ, tat kimartho'yamārambha ityāha-- `akriyārtho'yamārambhaḥ' iti| akriyārtheṣvapi śakādiṣu tumun yathā syādityevamartho'yamārambhaḥ| na hi śaknoti bhoktumityādau kriyārthopapadaṃ gamyate| kiṃ tarhi ? arthāntaram, anyadeva| iha tāvat-- `śaknoti bhoktum, utsahate bhoktum, jānāti bhoktum' iti prāvīṇyaṃ gamyate| `glāyati bhoktum' iti tadaśaktatā gamyate, `ghaṭayati bhoktum, arhati bhoktum' iti tadyogyatāmātram| `ārabhate bhoktum, prakramate bhoktum' iti bhujerevādyāvasthānakriyāntaram| `labhate bhoktum' iti pratyākhyānam| `asti bhoktum' ityādau sambhavamātram|| 66. paryāptivacaneṣvalamartheṣu| (3.4.66) `paryāptiranyūnatā' iti| paripūrṇatetyarthaḥ| `alamarthaviśiṣṭeṣu' iti| yadyapi bhūṣaṇādayo'lamarthāḥ, tathāpi paryāptivacane sāmarthyemeva sambhavatīti tadeva gṛhyate| prayogadarśanārthabodhena vyākhyānato vā| tenālamarthaviśiṣṭeṣvityayamartho bhavati| yadyevam, sāmarthyeṣvityevaṃ kasmānnaktam ? naivaṃ śakyam ; evaṃ hyucyamāne sāmarthyena bhuṅkte, balena bhuṅkta ityādāvapi syāt| yathānyāse tu na doṣaḥ; na hyatra paryāptirdṛśyate| kiṃ tarhi ? saukaryam| sukarametadityarthaḥ| yathāvidhyasya sambhavamātraṃ vivakṣitam, sambhavatyevaṃvidhasya karaṇamityarthaḥ|| 67. karttari kṛt| (3.4.67) kimarthamidam ? karttari tṛjādayo yathā syuḥ| kva tarhi syuḥ ? anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe (pu.pa.pā.90)| nanu ca svārthe yatra pratyayamicchati tatra bhāvagrahaṇaṃ karoti, yathā-- ghañādividhau bhāva iti, na caite ghañādayaḥ svārthe bhavanti, kiṃ tarhi? tasya dharme siddhatākhye; tathā lakārādividhau `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ'(3.4.69) ityatra sūtre lakārā api naiva svārthe vidhīyante, kiṃ tarhi ? tasya dharme sādhyatākhye ? yadyapi ghañādīnāṃ lakārāṇāñca bhāve vidhānam, tathāpi śabdaśaktistvābhāvyādeṣa viṣayavibhāgo labhyate| ghañādīnāṃ hi dhātvarthasya siddhatāmevābhidhātuṃ sāmarthyam, lakārāṇāṃ sādhyatāmeva| tadevaṃ yadanirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti, tasmāt tṛjādayo'pi tatraiva bhaveyuḥ, ataḥ karttaryeva te yathā syurityevamarthamidamārabhyate| atra ca dvedham-- kṛdutpattivākyānāmayaṃ śeṣo vā syāt-- ṇvultṛcau karttari, nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ karttarīti ? arthādeśo vā ? nirapekṣaiḥ svaiḥ svairvidhāyakaivarvākyairvihitānāṃ kṛtāṃ paścādanenārtha ādiśyeta-- ye na lakṣaṇāntaraiḥ kṛto vihitāste karttari vācye bhavantīti| tatra yadi dvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta tato yathā tṛjādīnāmanenartha ākhyāyate, tathā khyunnādīnāmapi; viśeṣānupādānāt, tataste'pi karttari syuḥ| sveṣu vidhivākyeṣu karaṇādīnāmupādānāt kaṇādiṣvapi| yadyapyekasya pratyayasya karttari karaṇe ca yagupad‌vṛttirna sambhavati, tathāpi vacanasāmarthyāt paryāyeṇa karttari karaṇe ca syuriti| tasmādduṣṭo'yaṃ pakṣa iti prathamaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-- `kṛdutpattivākyānām' ityādi| anena teṣāmasya caikavākyatāmāha| yadyevam, khyunnādivākyeṣvapyanenopasthātavyam-- teṣāmapyayaṃ śeṣa iti kṛtvā, tataścāsminnapi pakṣe dvitīye pakṣe bhāvī doṣaḥ syāt? ityata āha-- `tatra yeṣu' ityādi| tatraiva heutamāha-- `arthākāṅkṣatvāt' iti| śeṣo hi teṣāṃ bhavati yānyaparisamāptatvādarthamākāṅkṣanti, nānyeṣām| ato yeṣu vākyeṣvartho nādiśyate teṣāmeva sākāṅkṣatvāt śeṣo'yaṃ yuktaḥ| tṛjādīnāmeva vidhāyakāni vākyānyarthānādaśādarthākāṅkṣāṇi| tathā hi-- `ṇvultṛcau bhavataḥ' ityukte'rthaviśeṣākāṅkṣā bhavati-- kvemau bhavata iti| tasmāt teṣāmevāyaṃ śeṣa iti teṣvevopatiṣṭhate| `na khyunnādivākyeṣu' iti| `upatiṣṭhate' iti| prakṛtenaiva sambandhaḥ| `sākṣāt' ityādi| anupasthāne kāraṇam| khyunnādivākyānyarthākāṅkṣāṇi na bhavanti, teṣu karaṇādīnāmarthānāṃ sākṣānnirdeśāt| tasyānna teṣāmayaṃ śeṣa iti na teṣūpatiṣṭhate,ato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ|| 68. bhavyageyapravacīyopasthānīyajanyāplāvyāpātyā vā| (3.4.68) bhavyādiṣu geyapravacanīyopasthānīyāḥ sakarmakāḥ| tena teṣāṃ karmaṇi prāpte karttari ca nipātanam| śeṣāṇāmakarmakāṇāṃ bhāve karttari ca| `bhavyaḥ' iti| `aco yat' (3.1.97), guṇaḥ, `dhātostannimittasyaiva' (6.1.80) ityavādeśaḥ| `geyaḥ' iti| `īdyati' (6.4.65) itīttvam,guṇaḥ| `sāmnām' iti| karmaṇi kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| `upasthānīyaḥ' iti| anīyar| `janyaḥ'iti| `aco yat' (3.1.97) ityatra `takiśasiyaticatijanīnāmupasaṃkhyānam' (vā.213) iti yat| `āplāvyaḥ' iti| plavateḥ `orāvaśyake' (3.1.125) ṇyat,vṛddhiḥ, pūrvavadāvādeśaḥ| `āpātyaḥ' iti| `ṛhalorṇyat' (3.1.124)|| 69. laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ| (3.4.69) pūrvasūtreṇa kṛtsaṃjñakatvāllakāraḥ karttaryeva prāpnoti na bhāvakarmaṇoḥ, atastayorapi yathā syādityevamarthamidamārabdham| `la ityutsṛṣṭānubandhakam ityādi| laḍādīnāṃ daśānāṃ lakārānāṃ viśeṣakarānanubandhānutsṛjya `laḥ' iti sāmānyaṃ gṛhyate| `prathamābahuvacanāntañcaitat' iti| pañcamīṣaṣṭhekavacanāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| pañcamyāṃ hyasyāṃ lakārāt paro yastasyaivārtho nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt, tataśca karttaryeva lakāraḥ syāt, ṣaṣṭhyāmevāsyāmanantaryalakṣaṇā vijñāyeta| tathā ca lakārasya yo'nantarastasyaivārthanirdeśaḥ syāt, tataśca sa eva doṣo yaḥ pañcamyām| atrāpyādeśāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate ?evamapi lakārādeśānāmanenāmartho nirdiśyata ityayameva viṣayārtho na nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt| nanu ca lakārasya prayoga eva nāsti, tatkathaṃ tasyaiva karmādayo'rthāḥ ? sāmarthyāt tadādeśānāmete'rthā vijñāsyanta ityadoṣaḥ| `sakarmakebhyo bhāve na bhavanti' iti| akarmakebhya iti vacanāt; anyathā hi tadanarthakaṃ syāt|| 70.tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ| (3.4.70) `tayoreva bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti| etena `tayoḥ' ityanena `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' ityasya pratyavamarśa iti darśayati| nanu cānantarasūtre dve vākye-- `laḥ karmaṇi bhavanti karttari ca' ityekaṃ vākyam, `bhāve cākarmakebhyo'pi bhavanti karttari ca' iti dvitīyam, tatrānantaravākyaśrutayoḥ karttṛbhāvayoreva tayorityanena pratyavamarśo yuktaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ| yadayamuttarasūtre `karttari ca' (3.4.71) iti karoti,tato'vasīyate-- bhāvakarmaṇoreva pratyavamarśa iti yadi bhāvakartroreva pratyavamarśaḥ syāt, karttṛgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; karttaryanenaiva siddhatvāt| evaṃ hi tatra vaktuṃ yuktaṃ syāt-- karmaṇi ceti, karmaṇi kenacidaprāptaḥ syāt| yadā punariha bhāvakarmaṇoḥ pratyavamarśastadā yuktaṃ karttarigrahaṇam, karttaryaprāpte yathā syāt| yathāprāptaṃ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ| tasmādbhāvakarmaṇoreva pratyavamarśo yuktaḥ| `evakāraḥ' ityādinā evakārasya vyavacchedyaṃ apakarṣaṇārthaḥ - nivṛttyarthaḥ| `śayitam' iti| `niṣṭhā śīṅa' (1.2.19) ityādinā kittvapraratiṣedhādguṇaḥ| `īṣatkaraḥ,sukaraḥ' iti| `īṣaduḥsuṣu' (3.3.126) ityādinā khal| `īṣadāḍhyaṃbhavam' iti| atrāpi `karttṛkarmaṇośca bhūkṛñoḥ (3.3.127)|| 71. ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ karttari ca| (3.4.71) `ādikarmaṇi' iti| ādiścāsau karma ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `kriyākṣaṇaḥ' iti| etena karmaśabdokriyāṃ karmācaṣṭe, na sādhanaṃ karmeti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam-- `kriyāṃ karmācaṣṭa iti ? ādiśabdena viśeṣaṇāt| bahunāṃ kriyākṣaṇanāmādimadhyāntabhāve satyanādibhūtakriyākṣamavyavacchedādādibhūto yaḥ kriyākṣaṇastadādikarmeti yuktaṃ pratipādayitum| ādigrahaṇena sādhanaṃ karma tvekamevetyādiśabdena viśeṣayituṃ na śakyate; āderanādibhūtatvāpekṣatvādādiśabdasya tatrāpravṛttiḥ, vyavacchedyābhāvāt| ādikarmaṇi ca `bhūte' (3.2.84) ityanuvarttamāne `niṣṭhā' (3.2.102) ityanenaiva vihita iti darśayatinnāha--`tasmin' ityādi| ādyo yaḥ kriyākṣaṇaḥ sa pariniṣpannatvād‌bhūto bhavatīti yuktā tasya bhūtatvena vivakṣitatā| `prakṛtaḥ kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ' iti| karttari ktaḥ| tenaiva karttā'bhihita iti devadattaśabdāt tṛtīyā na bhavati| karmaṇastvanabhihitatvāt kaṭaśabdāddvitīyā bhavatyeva| `prakṛtaḥ kaṭo devadattena' iti| atra karmaṇi ktaḥ| tenaiva karṇaṇo'bhihitatvāddvitīyā na bhavati| karttaranabhihitatvāddevadattaśabdāt tṛtīyā bhavatyeva| `prakṛtaṃ devadattena' iti| bhāve ktapratyayaḥ| sarvatra praśabda ādikarma dyotayati| nanu cādibhūtakriyākṣamakāle kaṭo'nabhinirvṛtta eva bhavati, kaṭakāraṇabhūtā eva pīraṇādayastadānīṃ santi, na ca tadavasthaḥ kaṭaḥ tadavasthaḥ kaṭaḥ, tatkathaṃ prakṛtaḥ kaṭa iti bhūtakālena prakṛtaśabdena kaṭasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam ? ādyena kriyākṣaṇena yo vīraṇādīnāṃ viśeṣa āhitastatra tādarthyāt kaṭaśabdo varttate, sa ca bhūta evetyadoṣaḥ|| 72. gatyarthākarmakaśliṣaśīṅsthāsavasajanaruhajīryatibhyaśca| (3.4.72) `upasthitaḥ' iti| `dyatisyatimāsthāmiti kiti' (7.4.40) ittītvam| `anūṣitaḥ' iti| vacyādinā (6.1.15 samprasāraṇam, `vasatikṣughoḥ' (7.2.52) itīṭ, `śāsivasighasīnāñca' (8.23.60) iti ṣatvam| `anujātaḥ' iti| `janasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ' (6.4.42) ityāttvam| `ārūḍhaḥ' iti| `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31), `jhaṣastathorddho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvam, `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41), ` ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13), `ḍhralope pūrvasya' (6.3.111) iti dīrghaḥ| `anujīrṇaḥ' iti| `jṛ vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1494), `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam, `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvam, `radābhyām' (8.2.42)ityādinā natvañca| nanu ca śliṣādīnāmakarmakatvādeva sidhyatīti tatkimarthameṣāṃ grahaṇamityāha-- `śliṣādayaḥ' ityādi| `tadartham' iti| sakarmakārthamityarthaḥ|| 73. dāśagoghnau sampradāne| (3.4.73) `goghnaḥ' iti| sa eva hanteḥ pacādyac| sampradāne'c nipātyate, upadhālopaśca| atha vā-- ṭak‌pratyayo nipātyate, upadhālopaśca `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinaiva siddhaḥ, `ho hanteḥ' (7.3.54) ityādinā kutvam| yadi sampradāne `goghnaḥ' iti nipātyate, tataścāṇḍālāderapi tenābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti; yasmāt tasmai api ye hyāgatāya dātuṃ ghnanti te'pi sukṛta ityata āha-- `nipātanasāmarthyāt' ityādi| yathaiva hyatra nipātanasāmarthyāt kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ labhyate tathā'rthaviśeṣo'pi| tasmādyadyapi `goghnaḥ' ityaviśeṣeṇa nipātyate, tathāpi viśiṣṭasyaiva| tena ṛtvigāderabhidhānam, nānyasya cāṇḍālādeḥ| yadā tarhi dātuṃ hanyate tadā tasya goghna ityabhidhāṃ na prāpnotītyata āha-- `asatyapi' ityādi| yathā hyapacannapi yogyatayā pācaka ityucyate, tathā'satyapi gohanane goghna iti|| 74. bhīmādayo'pādāne| (3.4.74) `{uṇādipratyayāntā ete-- kāśikā'} ūṇādipratyayā ete'| iti| uṇādayaḥ pratyayā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| ke punasta uṇādayaḥ pratyayāḥ ? ityata āha-- `śyādhūsūbhyo mak' ityādi| ādiśabdena maṅkvannādīnāṃ grahaṇam| yadi tarhyuṇādipratyayā ete, evaṃ satyuṇādipratyayānāṃ rūḍhiśabdāt kriyākārakasambandhābhāvādapādāne vṛttirna sambhavatyeva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; rūḍhiśabdeṣvapi keṣāñcit kriyākārakasambandho'styeva, yathā-- tailapāyikādiṣu| ato'deśyametat| `tābhyām' ityādi| nanu cāsatyasmin sūtre tābhyāmityeṣa nirdeśo nopapadyate; apādānasyāprakṛtatvāt, tatkutaḥ paryudāsasya prasaṅgaḥ ? naiṣa doṣa-; arthakatvametat| asmin hyasati tatraivaṃ sūtraṃ karttavyam-- tato'pādānāccānyatroṇādaya iti| tathā ca yadīdaṃ nocyeta,tadā syādeva paryudāsaḥ|| 75. tābhyāmanyatroṇādayaḥ| (3.4.75) atha kimarthaṃ tābhyāmityanena sampradānāpādānapratyavamarśaḥ kriyate, etāvadeva vaktavyam-- avyatroṇādaya iti, prakṛtatvādeva hi tayostābhyāmanyatroṇādayo vijñāsyante ? ata āha-- `sampradānapratyavamarśārtham' ityādi| `anyathā hi' ityādi| yadi `tābhyām' ityanena tayoḥ pratyavamarśo na kriyate ityarthaḥ| `anantaratvāt' ityādi| `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti nyāyādapādānasyaiva paryudāsaḥ syāt, yadi tābhyāmiti nirdeśo na kriyeta| `kṛṣiḥ' iti| `ik kṛṣyādibhyaḥ' (vā.324) itīk| `tantuḥ' iti| `sitanigamimasisacyāvidhāñkruśibhyastun' (da.u.1.122) iti tun| `carma' iti | manin|| 76. kto'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhyaḥ| (3.4.76) nanu ca neyaṃ loke prasiddhiḥ -- dhrauvyārthā akarmakāḥ, pratyavasānārthā abyavahārthā iti, tatkathamayamartho labhyate ? ityata āha-- `svanikāyaprasiddhiḥ' iti| svanikāyaḥ - vaiyākaraṇasaṅghaḥ, tatreyaṃ prasiddhiḥ| `karttṛbhāvādhikaraṇeṣu' iti| bhāvakarmaṇoḥ `tayoreva' (3.4.70) ityādinā| `idameṣām' iti| `adhikaraṇavācinām' (2.3.68) iti ṣaṣṭhī| `katham' ityādi| `bhuktā brāhmaṇāḥ, pītā gāvaḥ' iti| karttari niṣṭhā, anyathā'nabhihitatvāt kartturbrāhmaṇaśabdādgośabdacca karttari tṛtīyā syāt| na pratyavasānārthebhyaḥ kenacit karttari kto vihitaḥ, tatkathametau sūtrādanantaramidaṃ kasmānna paṭhyate, ekaḥ evaṃ sati guṇo bhavati, dviḥ ktagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati| tadevaṃ vaktavyam --ādirmaṇi ktaḥ karttari ca, tataḥ śliṣaśīṅasthāsavajanaruhajīryatibhyaśca, tato'dhikaraṇe ca dhrauvyagatipratyavasānārthebhya iti, evañca dviḥ ktagrahaṇaṃ gatyarthākarmakagrahaṇañca na karttavyaṃ bhavati ? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; evaṃ hyucyamāne yathā dhrauvyārthebhyaḥ karttari kto bhavati, tathā pratyavasānārthebhyo'pi syāt, sa ca neṣyate| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu|| 77. lasya| `akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ' iti| etenānubandhaśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| anubandhe hyasminnakārānubandhaviśiṣṭayoreva laṅalaṭorgrahaṇaṃ syāt, nānyeṣāṃ liḍādīnām| `arthaviśeṣe'iti| karttṛkarmādau' | `kālaviśeṣe' iti| varttamānādau| `akṣarasamāmnāyavat' iti| yathā'kṣarasamāmnāye pratyāhāre'kārādayo varṇā ānupūrvyā kathyante, tadvadityarthaḥ| `atha lakāramātrasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati' iti| viśeṣānupādānāmiti bhāvaḥ| `cūḍālaḥ' iti| `prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyām' (5.2.96) iti lac| `dhātvadhikāraḥ' iti| `dhātoḥ' (3.1.91) iti pañcamyantamanuvarttate, tena ca lakāro viśiṣyate-- dhātorvihitas lasyeti| `laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ' (3.4.69) ityādau prakāraṇe ye'rthāḥ karttṛkarmabhāvā nirdiṣṭāsta ihānuvarttante, taiśca lakāro viśiṣyate-- kartrādiṣu vihitasya lasyeti| tena visiṣṭasyaiva lakārasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati, na sarvasyeti bhāvaḥ|| 78.tiptasjhisipthasthamibvasmastātāṃjhathāsāthāṃdhvamiḍvahimahiṅ| (3.4.78) `pakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| `anudāttau suptitau' (3.1.4) ityanudātto yathā syāt| `iṭaṣṭakāraḥ' ityādi| nanu cāsatyapyetasmin viśeṣaṇārthe naivaṃ kiñcidaniṣṭaṃ prāpnoti, `iṭo't' (3.4.106) ityatra sūtre liṅādeśasyeṭo'dvidhānāt, tato'nyasya liṅgādeśasyekārasyāsambhavāt| tivādyavayavo'stīti cet ? na; tasyālādeśatvāt| tibādayo hi samudāyā lādeśāḥ, na ca tadavayavā ikārādayaḥ| arthavadgrahaṇe (vyā.pa.1) paribhāṣayārthavadikārasya grahaṇe sati kṛtastabādyavayavasya prasaṅgaḥ ! na hi te'rthavantaḥ; tibādīnāmeva samudāyānāmarthavatvāt| tasmānna karttavya eva ṭakāraḥ ? satyaṃ na karttavyaṃ, ya evaṃ pratipattuṃ samarthastaṃ prati; yastvasamarthastaṃ prati karttavya eva| atha `ādyantau ṭakitau' (1.1.46) iti viśiṣṭadeśa āgamabhūtasyāsya vidhānaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṣṭakāraḥ kasmānna vijñāyate ? ityāha-- `tibādibhiḥ' ityādi| tulyatvam - sadṛśatvam, tatupanarekayoganirdiṣṭatvena| tasmin sati lasya (3.4.77) ityanayā ṣaṣṭhyā sarveṣaṃ tibādīnāṃ sambandho bhavati| dvitīye tviṭa eva| tatra yasminpakṣa āśrīyamāṇe sarveṣāmanugraho bhavati sa evāśrayituṃ yukta iti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyamaṅgīkarttavyā| iṭo'pyādeśatvaṃ tena bhavatīti na bhavati deśavanidhyarthaṣṭakāraḥ| atha vā-- tibādibhirekayoganirdiṣṭatvena yat tibādibhistulyatvaṃ tat sāhacaryopalakṣamam| tibādibhistulyatvāt tatsāhacaryādityarthaḥ| sāhacaryeṇa sandigdhārthaniścayo bhavati, yathā-- savatsā dhenuriti| tathehāpi sandeho jāyate-- kimayamādeśaḥ ? utāgamaḥ ? iti, tathāpi tibādibhirasandigdhādeśabhāvaiḥ sāhacaryādādeśo'yamiti niścīyate| tena deśavidhyarthatā ṭakārasya na bhavati| yadyevam, `phalipāṭinamimanijanāṃ guk paṭinākidhataśca' (da.u.1.103) ityatrāpi paṭyādibhirādeśaistulyatvādgugāgamo'pyādeśaḥ syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `saṃjñāyām' (3.2.185) iti tatrānuvarttate,na cādeśena saṃjñā gamyate, kintvāgamena| tasmādguka āgamatvaṃ veditavyam| tatraikāpi ṣaṣṭhī yadā'deśana sambadhyate tadā sthānaṣaṣṭhī bhavati, yadā tvāgamena tadāvayavaṣaṣṭhī| `mahiṅo ṅakāraḥ' ityādi| atha ṅitvārtho ṅakāraḥ kasmānna bhavati ? tasya `sārvadhātukamapit' (1.2.4) ityanenaiva siddhatvāt|| 7ra9. ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere| (3.4.79) `iha kasmānna bhavati' ityādi| śānajapi ṭito lakārasya sambandhyātmanepadasaṃjñakaśca, tasmāt tasyāpi ṭeretvena bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| `prakṛtaiḥ' ityādi| prakṛtānāṃ tibādīnāṃ madhye `yānyātmanepadāni'-- ityevamihātmanepadāni viśiṣyante, tena na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| na hi śānac tibādiṣu sanniviṣṭaḥ| lāghavārthaṃ `ṭitastaṅām' iti vācye `ātmanepadānām' iti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham| nanu ca `taṅām' ityucyamāne tasastakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ syāt ? arthavad‌grahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.1) na bhaviṣyati| yastarhi thasya sthāna ādiśyate tena syāt ? na; tibādiṣu sanniviṣṭā ye teṣāṃ tiṅāṃ grahaṇaṃ vijñāsyate| pratyāsattervā ātmapadīyena taśabdena pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ vijñāsyate| vyāptestvanāśrayaḥ; lakṣyasthityanurodhāt|| 80. thāsaḥ se| (3.4.80) `peciṣe' iti|liṭ, `ata ekahalmadhve'nādeśāderliṭi' (6.4.120) ityetvābhyāsapopau| `paktāse' iti| luṭ, tāsiḥ, `tāsastyorlopaḥ' (7.4.50) iti sakāralopaḥ| `pakṣyase' iti| lṛṭ, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam-- kakāraḥ| atha thakāramātrasyaiva sakārādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati--thaḥ sa iti, thakārasya sakāre kṛte parasya bhāgasya ṭeretve satyabhīṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva ? naitacchakyamca evaṃ hyārthāśabdasya yasthakārastasyāpi syāt| dhātvadhikārāddhātoryo vihita iti viśeṣaṇānna bhavatīti cet ? na; asambhavāt| na hi tathāvidhastakāro dhātorvihitaḥ sambhavati | atha dhātoranantarasyaiti viśiṣyeta ? evamapyanāditva eva parasya syāt, netarebhyo vikaraṇebhyaḥ; vyavadhānāditi yathānyāsamevāstu| ṭerettvenaiva siddha ekārāntatve yadekārāntatvāmādeśasya kriyate, tat `tiṅāmādeśānāṃ ṭeretvaṃ na bhavati' iti jñāpanārtham| tena ḍāraurasprabhṛtiṣu ṭeretvaṃ na bhavatīti-- paktā, paktārau, paktāra iti|| 81.liṭastajhayoreśirec| (3.4.81) `śakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ' iti| asati tasmin dhātvadhikārāt `tasmādityuttarasya ' (1.1.67) ityādeḥ parasya takārasya prasajyeta| śakāre tu sati `anekālśit sarvasya' (1.1.55) iti vacanāt sarvasya bhavati| atha `śe' iti kasmānnoktam ? naivaṃ śakyam; `śe' iti hi pragṛhyasaṃjñā syāt| iha ca vyatipapa iti pibādeśaḥ syāt| eśi tu sati na bhavati, vakṣyati hyetat-- `varṇe yat syāt tacca vidyāt tadādau' iti|| 82. parasmaipadānāṃ ṇalatususthalathusaṇalvamāḥ| (3.4.82) `papaktha' iti| `upadeśe'tvataḥ' (7.2.62) itīḍabhāvaḥ| `pecitha' iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, tatra hi `ṛto bhāradvājasya' (7.2.63) iti niyamādiṭ| `thali ca seṭi' (6.4.121) ityevatvābhyāsalopau| `peca' iti| `dhātoḥ' (3.1.91) ityadhikārāt `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) , `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti thakārasyākārādeśaḥ| dvayorākārayoḥ `ato guṇe ' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam| atha vā-- āntaratamyādbahvarthasyākārasya bahvartha eva sthānī yukta iti samudāyasyaiva bhavati| `peciva, pecima' iti| krādiniyamādiṭ|| 83. vido laṭo vā| (3.4.83) `vida jñāne' iti| etena jñānārthasya vidergrahaṇam, nānyeṣāmiti| evaṃ manyate-- vida iti pañcamī, tena `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityanantarāṇāṃ tibādīnāmādeśena bhavitavyam| na cānyasmādvideḥ parasmaipadānyanantarāṇi sambhavati; vikaraṇairvyavadhānāt| vicārasattārthayoścātmanepaditvāt parasmaipadānupapattiḥ| tasmāt jñānārthasyaiva grahaṇamiti|| 84. bruvaḥ pañcānāmādita āhau bruvaḥ| (3.4.84) `pañcaiva' ityādi| nanu ca neha dvitīyaṃ pañcagrahaṇaṃ, nāpyadigrahaṇamādeśaviśeṣamam, tatra pañcānāmādyānāṃ sthāne sarvaireva ṇalādibhiḥ paryāyeṇa bhavitavyam, tat kathaṃ pañcaiva ṇalādaya ādeśā bhavantītyeṣo'rtho labhyate ? ityata āha-- `sthānisambandhāt ' ityādi| iha hi sthāninaḥ pañcaivā'dyā nirdiṣṭāḥ, teṣāñca `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ' (1.1.50) iti paribhāṣayā pañcirevādyaiḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati, netaraiśca| tathā hi-- pañcānāmevādyānāmāntaratamyamasti, tulyārthatvāt| nānyeṣām, viparyayāt| tasmāt sthānisambandhādādeśeṣvapi pañcatvamāditvañca vijñāyata iti yuktam-- pañcaiva ṇalādaya ādeśā bhavantīti| `āttha' iti| `āhasthaḥ' (8.2.35) iti hakārasya thakāraḥ, tasya `khari ca' (8.3.55) iti cartvam-- takāraḥ| `bravīti' iti| `bruva īṭ' (7.3.93)| `pareṣām' iti| thādīnām| atha `bruvaḥ' iti kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā bruva iti yadetat pañcamyantaṃ tadevārthadvibhaktervipariṇāmo bhaviṣyīti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vijñāsyata ityāha-- `bruvaḥ' iti punarvacanam' ityādi| asati hi śrate sambandhini vibhaktivipariṇāmo yuktaḥ| iha parasmaipadānāmiti prakṛtā eva tibādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhyantāḥ sambandhina iti na yukto vibhaktivipariṇāmaḥ| `bruvaḥ' itiyadi punarnocyeta tato yathā ṇalādayaḥ parasmaipadānāṃ bhavanti, evamāhaudeśo'pi syāt| tasmāt taṃ prati bruvaḥ sthānitvaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ `bruvaḥ' iti punarucyate| `parasmaipadānāmeva hi syāt' iti| yadi `buvaḥ' iti punarnocyeteti śeṣaḥ| ayañca `bruvaḥ' iti pūnarvacanasya hetuḥ| hiśabdo yasmādarthe| yasmādasati punavarvacane parasmaipadānāmevāhādeśaḥ syāt, tasmāt `bruvaḥ' iti punarvacanaṃ karttavyam|| 85. loṭo laṅvat| (3.4.85) `tāmādayaḥ' iti| yeṣāṃ `tasthastha' (3.4.101) ityādinā vidhānanam| `salopaśca' iti| yasya nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' ( 3.4.99) iti vidhānam| `aḍāṭau ityādi| `luṅlaṅlṛṅakṣu' (6.4.71)ityādināṭ, `āḍajādīnām' (6.4.72) ityāṭ laṅaḥ kārya vidhāsyate| `laṅa śākaṭāyanasyaiva' (3.4.111) iti jherjusādeśaśca| na ceha kaścidviśeṣa upādīyate, tataśca yasmādatideśāt tāmādikāryaṃ bhavati tathā `āḍajādīnām'(6.4.72) laṅakāryeṇāpi bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| `itaśca' (3.4.100) iti lopaḥ, mipo'mbhāvaśca| deśyametat| tayoḥ `eruḥ' (3.4.86) ityuttvasya `merniḥ' (3.4.899) iti nirādeśasya cāpavādasya vidhāsyamānatvāt| `sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā' iti| tena tāmādirevādeśo bhavati, na tvaḍādiriti manyate|| 86. eruḥ| (3.4.86) `hinyoḥ' ityādi| hiśca niśca hinī, tayorutvapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, anyathā hi lunīhi pacānīti na sidhyet| `na voccāraṇasāmarthyāt' iti| yadi hīkāre kṛte satyukāreṇa bhavitavyaṃ tadokāramevoccārayet| ayaṃ hi ladhīyān śabdavyutpattāvupāyaḥ| na cekāroccāraṇe sūtrasya lāghavaṃ bhavati, tadukāra evoccarayitavye yadikāroccāraṇaṃ karoti, tasyaitat prayojanam-- utvaṃ mā bhūditi|| 87. serhyapicca| (3.4.87) `lunīhi' iti| pittve pratiṣiddhe `sārvadhātukamapit' (1.2.4) iti ṅittvam, tatastannibandhanaṃ `ī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itītvaṃ bhavati| `rāghnuhi' iti| `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau' (dhā.pā.1262), 1263) svāditvāt śnuḥ| atrāpi pūrvavanṅitvane sati guṇo na bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ guru sūtraṃ kriyate, na `se rhi ṅicca' ityevocyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; ṅittvasya vidhāne sthānivadbhāvātam pittvaṃ syādeva| tataśca ṅittvānṅitkāryaṃ guṇaniṣedhādikaṃ syāt, pittvāccānudāttatvam| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu|| 88. vā cchandasi| (3.4.88) `apittvaṃ vikalpyate'( iti)| `lādeśaḥ' iti| tasyānantaratvāt| ādeśastu tena vyavahitatvādanantaro na bhavati vikalpyate| `yuyodhi' iti| `yu{miśraṇe'miśraṇe ca' dhā.pā} miśraṇe' (dhā.pā.1033), `bahulaṃ chandasi' 2.4.76) iti śapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.ta10) iti dvirvacanam| atrāpi pittvena ṅittvaṃ nāsti, tena guṇo na bhavati| `aṅitaśca' (6.4.103) iti ghibhāvaḥ| `prīṇīhi' iti| `prīñ {tarpaṇe kāntau ca' -dhā.pā.}(dhā.pā.1474) kryāditvāt śnā| atrāpyapittve sati pūrvavadītvam|| 89. merniḥ| (3.4.89) `utthalopayorapavādaḥ' iti| yathākramaṃ `eruḥ' (3.4.86), `loṭo laṅavat' (3.4.85) ityatideśena prāptayoḥ| ikāralopasya ca laṅi `itaśca' (3.4.100) iti vidhānādatideśena tasya prāptiḥ| `pacāni' ityatra `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) ityāṭ|| 90. āmetaḥ| (3.4.90) atraikāreṇa loḍviśiṣyate, loṭā vaikāra iti dvau pakṣau| tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta tadaikāsya viśaeṣaṇatvādviśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyekārāntasya loṭa ām vidhīyamāno'nekāltvāt sarvādeśaḥ syādityeṣa doṣaḥ pratividheyaḥ| dvitīye tu pakṣa ekāra eva viśeṣyatvāt pradhānam| na ca pradhāne tadantavidhirityekārasyaiva bhaviṣyīti na kiñcit pratividheyam| tena dvitīyapakṣamāśrityāha-- `loṭ‌sambandhina ekārasya' ityādi| `pacatām' iti| ṭeretve kṛta ām| iha pacāvedam, yajāvedamiti yadyapyantādivadbhāvādguṇo loḍ‌grahaṇena gṛhyate, tathāpi bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) ityantaraṅga āmādeśe karttavye bahiraṅgasyādguṇasyāsiddhatvādāmādeśo na bhavati| bahiraṅgatvaṃ tu guṇasya dvipadāśrayatvāt| āmastvantaraṅgatvamekapadāśrayatvāt|| 91. savābhyāṃ vāmau| (3.4.91) `pacasva' iti| `thāsaḥ se' (3.4.80) iti kṛte vakāraḥ| `pacadhvama' iti| ṭeretve kṛte'mādeśaḥ|| 92. āḍuttamasya picca| (3.4.92) `sa cottamapuruṣaḥ pidbhavatiṭa' iti| athāṭa eva pittvaṃ kasmānna kriyate ? nirarthakatvāt| pittvaṃ hyanudātārthaṃ vā syāt, guṇavṛddhyarthaṃ vā; tatrāṭo'nudāttatvamāgamatvādeva siddham, guṇavṛddhyostu naivāsau nimittam; apratyayatvāt| tasmādāṭaṃ prati pittvamanarthakamityuttamasyaiva vidhīyate| `karavāṇi' iti| pittvāduttamasya ṅitvaṃ nāsti, tena guṇo bhavati| `karavai' iti| `eta ai' (3.4.93), `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ|| 93. eta ai| (3.4.93) `āmo'pavādaḥ' iti| `āmetaḥ' (3.4.90) iti prāptasya| `pacāvedaṃ yajāvedam' iti| `loṭo laṅ‌vat' (3.4.85)iti salope sati `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ|| 94. leṭo'ḍāṭau| (3.4.94) `paryāyeṇa' iti| atha yugapadeva kasmānna bhavataḥ ? evaṃ manyate-- ṭitāvetau vidhīyete, ṭittvañcādividhānārthaṃm| na ca yugapad‌dvayorāditvaṃ bhavati, ekenaivādideśasyāvaṣṭabdhatvānna yuktaṃ yaugapadyamiti| `joṣiṣat' ityādīvyudāharaṇāni `sibbahulaṃ leṭi' (3.1.34) ityatra vyutpāditāni| atrāpi vyutpādyante| `joṣiṣat' iti-- `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1288), sipa ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, anenāṭ, `itaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (3.4.97) itīkāralopaḥ `ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ' (7.2.35) itīṭ, laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' 8.3.59) iti ṣatvam| `tāriṣat' iti-- `tṛ plavanataraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.969), `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti vyatyayena dhātvakārasya dīrghaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| `mandivat' iti--`madi stutimodamadasvapnakāntigatiṣu' (dhā.pā.13) idito num' (7.1.58)| `padāti' iti| `pada gatau' (dhā.pā.1169) divādāvanudāttet , vyatyayena parasmaipadam; śappratyayaśca, aṭā sahākaḥ savarṇe (6.1.101) dīrghatvam, tip| ikāralopo'tra na bhavati; tadvidhau `vaito'nyatra' (3.4.96) ityato vāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `cyāvayati' iti| `cyuṅ jyuṅa pruṅa pluṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.955--958), hetumaṇṇic|| 95. āta ai| (3.4.95) `mantrayaite' iti| `matri {guptaparibhāṣaṇe-dhā.pā.} (dhā.pā.1679), curādiṇic, śap,{guṇāyādeśaḥ' iti mu.pāṭhaḥ|} guṇāyādeśau| `āṭaḥ kasmānna bhavati' iti| padāti vidyudityādau| `vidhānasāmarthyāt' iti| yadyāṭa aitvaṃ syāt aiḍāgamameva vidadhyāt, evaṃ prakriyālāghavaṃ bhavatīti manyate|| 96. vaito'nyatra| (3.4.96) `śāsai' iti| uttamapuruṣaikavacanamiṭ, ṭeretvam| `īśai' ityādīni udāharaṇāni `upasaṃvādāśaṅkayoḥ' (3.4.8) ityatra vyutpāditāni| `dadhasa' iti| `ḍudhāñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1092), `thāsaḥ se' (3.4.80), śapaḥ ślu), `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam, aṭ, `ghorlopo leṭi vā' (7.3.70) ityakāralopaḥ|| 97. itaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu| (3.4.97) `parasmaipadagrahaṇam' ityādi| nanu ca ṭeretvamiḍādiṣu bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati, tat kiṃ parasmaipadagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; ṭeretvasyāvakāśa anyeṣu lakārādiṣu, ito lopasya ca parasmaipadeṣu; ubhayaprasaṅge paratvādito lopaḥ syāt|| 98. sa uttamasya| (3.4.98) `karavāva' iti| `leṭo'ḍāṭau' (3.4.94) ityāṭ| `uttamagrahaṇam' ityādi| yadi tarhi puruṣāntare mā bhūdityevamarthamuttamagrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? na ; vasmasgrahaṇameva karttavyam, atrāpyayamarthaḥ-- sakāragrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ na bhavati, alo'ntyaparibhāṣayaiva sakālopo bhavati ? aśakyaṃ vasmasgrahaṇaṃ karttum; tasmin sati yadā vyatyanena puruṣāntarasya sthāne tau bhavatastadāpi lopaḥ syāt, yadā cottamapuruṣasya sthāne thas kriyate tadā lopo na syāt| uttamagrahaṇe satyeva doṣo na bhavati sthānivadbhāvena madhyamottamasaṃjñayorbhavantyorekasaṃjñādhikārādasati samāveśa uttamasaṃjñayā madhyamasaṃjñāyā nivṛttiḥ| sakāragrahaṇañca yadi na kriyeta, tadottamasya vyatyayena vacanāntareṣu kṛteṣu varṇāntarasyāpi lopaḥ syāt| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu|| 99. nityaṃ ṅitaḥ| (3.4.99) `apacāvāpacāma' iti| laṅa, `ato dīrgho yañi' (7.3.101) iti dīrghaḥ|| 100. itaśca| ( 3.4.100) `apacāt' iti| laṅa| `apākṣīt' iti| luṅa `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ|| 101. tasthasthamipāṃ tāntantāmaḥ| (3.4.101) `apāktām' iti| pūrvavad‌vṛddhiḥ, `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sico lopaḥ|| 102. liṅa sīyuṭ| (3.4.102) `pacet' ityādau `vidhinimantraṇa' (3.3.161) ityādinā liṅa, `liṅa salopo'nantasya' (7.2.79) iti sakāralopaḥ, śapā saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) vali lopaḥ| `pakṣīṣṭa' ityādau āśiṣi liṅa, cakārasya `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam, `iṇkoḥ' (8.3.57) iti ṣatvam|| 103. yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣūdātto ṅicca| (3.4.103) `parasmaipadaviṣayasya' iti| etena `parasmaipadeṣu' ityasyāḥ saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati, na parasaptamītvam| parasaptamītvaṃ tu na sambhavati; liṅaḥ parasmaipadānāmasambhavāt| `āgamānudāttatve prāpte' iti| kutaḥ punarāgamānudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti niścitam ? ata eva yāsuṭa udāttavacanāt| yadi hyāgamā anudāttā na syustadodāttavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; pratyayabhaktatvenaiva yāsuṭaḥ pratyayasvareṇaivādyudāttasya siddhatvāt| nanu yāni pidvacanāni tadarthamudāttavacanaṃ syāt, teṣāṃ hyanudāttatvāt tadbhakto yāsuḍanudātta eva syāt, yadyudātta iti nocyeta ? naitadasti;yadyetat pyojanamabhimataṃ syāt, apidityevaṃ brūyāt| tadaitadudāttavacanamāgamānudāttasya jñāpakameva| `tatra ṅitkāryāṇāmasambhavāt' iti| na sarveṣāmityabhiprāyaḥ| kuta etat ? yāvatā `uṣyāt' ityatra grahijyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) yatsamprasāraṇaṃ tat yāsuṭyayi ṅiti sambhavati| ṅinmātnibandhanaṃ hi samprasāraṇam; viśeṣānupādānāt| tatra yadi yāsuṭo ṅittvaṃ vidhīyeta tadā graheḥ samprasāraṇasyaivekasyānugrahaḥ syāt| liṅastu ṅitve vidhāne sarvasya ṅitkāryasya guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhādevānugraho bhavatīti liṅa eva ṅittvaṃ vidhīyate| `ṅitkāryāṇām' iti| ṅiti kāryāṇāmityarthaḥ| `kuryāt' iti| vikaraṇāśrayo dhātorguṇaḥ, `ata ut sārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityutvam, `ye ca' (6.4.109) ityukāralopaḥ| `kuryuḥ' iti| `usyapadāntāt' (6.1.96) iti pararūpatvam| `acinavam' iti| mipo'm| atra ṅittvābhāvādguṇaḥ| etacca jñāpakasya prayojanam|| 104. kidāśiṣi | (3.4.104) `pratyayasyaivedaṃ kittvam' iti| yadyevam, āśiṣi liṅ vihitastasya yāsuṭ kidbhavatītyetadvirudhyate ? nāsti virodhaḥ; yāsuḍ‌vacanaṃ liṅa evopalakṣaṇam| tena liṅavayavadvāreṇa liṅa eva kittvamanena vidhīyate; yāsuḍavayavatvālliṅaḥ| `nāgamasya' iti| `nāgamasya' iti| atrāpi nāgamātrasyetyeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ| `prayojanābhāvāt' iti| na sarvasya kittvaprayojanasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| kutaḥ ? vācyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) yadvacisvapyoḥ samprasāraṇaṃ tasya yāsuṭyapi kiti sambhavāt| kinmātre hi samprasāraṇamucyate, viśeṣāparigrahāt| yadi guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhastulya eveti kastarhi ṅitvāt kittvasya viśeṣo yena tasmin prāpte kittavaṃ vidhīyeta ? ityāha-- `samprasāraṇam' ityādi| ṅitve vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) kiti didhīyamānaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ na syāt. `jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu' (7.3.85) iti vidhīyamāno guṇaḥ| `iṣyāt' iti| `skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti sakāralopaḥ| `vacyāt' iti| kitvābhāvādvaceḥ samprasāraṇaṃ na bhavati| `jāgṛyāt' iti| pūrvasūtreṇa ṅitvam, tena guṇo na bhavati| ubhayatrādādikatvācchapo luk|| 105. jhasya ran| (3.4.105) `kṛṣīran' iti| āśiṣi liṅ|| 106. iṭo't| (3.4.106) `kṛṣīya' iti| āśiṣi liṅ| `naivāyamādeśāvayavaḥ' iti| akāramātrasyādeśatvāt| yadyevama, akāro'yamādeśo vidhīyata iti `aṇuditsavarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' (1.1.69) iti savarṇānāṃ grāhakaḥ syāt ? `bhāvyamāno'ṇ savarṇān na gṛhṇāti' (vyā.pa.35) iti na bhaviṣyati| satyapi vā savarṇagrahaṇe mātrikasyāntaratamyānmātrika eva bhaviṣyati| atha lāviṣīṣṭetyatrāgamasyeṭaḥ kasmādakāro na bhavatītyāha-- `āgamasyeṭo grahaṇaṃ na bhavati' iti| atra kāraṇamāha-- `arthavad‌grahaṇe na' ityādi| nanu cāgamānāmapyarthavattvamastyeva, tathā hi-- yāsuṭ‌sahitenaiva liṅo|ñartho'vibhidhīyate, na kevalena ? naitadevam; anyeṣu lakāreṣu vināpi tenārthavattā dṛṣṭā, āgamānāṃ tu na kvacit| tena te'rthavanto na bhavantīti|| 107. suṭ tithoḥ| (3.4.107) atha takārathakārābyāṃ liṅa viśiṣyate-- takārathakāyoryo liṅa sthānīti ? tena vā tau liṅasambandhinostakārathakārayoriti ? tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadā viśeṣyatvālliṅaḥ prādhānyam| tataśca pradhāne kāryasampratyayālliṅa eva suḍāgamaḥ syāt| evañca paratvādviśeṣavihitvācca suṭā sīyaḍ bādhyeta| tasmādduṣṭo'yaṃ pakṣa iti dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha-- `liṅsambandhinoḥ' iti| yaduktam-- takārathakārayoḥ suḍāgamo bhavatīti, tasyārtha spaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `takārathakārāvāgaminau' iti| viśeṣyatvena prādhānyāditi bhāvaḥ| yaduktañca-- liṅasambandhinoriti, tasyārtha spaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `liṅ tadviśeṣaṇam' iti| `sīyuṭastu liṅevāgamī' iti| takārathakārāvevakāreṇa vyavacchidyete| `tena' ityādi| yata evaṃ takārathakārāvāgaminau suṭaḥ, sīyuṭastu liṅeva, tena bhinnadeśatvāt suṭā sīyuḍ na bādhyate| na ca bhinnadeśayorbādhyabādhakabhāvo yuktaḥ; virodhābhāvāt| `kṛṣīṣṭa, kṛṣīṣṭhāḥ' iti| tathāsorekavacanayo rūpe| `kṛṣīyāstām, kṛṣīyāsthām' iti| ātāmāthāmoḥ | sarvatrāśiṣi liṅa, `uśca' (1.2.32) iti kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ|| 108. jherjus| (3.4.108) `paceyuḥ' iti| `ato yeyaḥ' (7.2.80) itīyādeśaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) , pararūpatvam|| 109. sijabhyastavidibhyaśca| (3.4.109) `vetteśca' iti nirdeśena lugvikaraṇasyaiveha grahaṇamiti darśayati| tasyaiva hi jhiranantaraḥ sambhavati,nānyeṣāṃ vidīnām| vikaraṇairvyavadhānāt| sattāvicāraṇārthayorātmanepaditvāt jherasambhava eva, tasmāllugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam| `abhyastavidigrahaṇamasijartham' iti| yadyabhyastavidigrahaṇamasijartham, evaṃ sati laḍādisambandhino'pi jheḥ prāpnotītyata āha-- `ṅita iti cānuvarttate' iti| tena ṅillakārasambandhina eva jherjus bhaviṣyati, nānyeṣāmityabhiprāya-| `abibhayuḥ, ajihrayuḥ' iti| `ñi bhībhaye' (dhā.pā.1084), `hrī lajjāyām' (dhā.pā.1085), `juji ca' (7.3.83) iti guṇaḥ, juhotyādibhyaḥ śapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam| `ajāgaruḥ' iti| adāditvācchapo luk; jāgarteḥ `jakṣityādaya ṣaṭ' (6.1.6) ityabhyastasaṃjñā|| 110. ātaḥ| (3.4.110) sicaḥ parasyākārāntāduttarasya jheriti bruvatā dvābhyamapyanantarasay jherityuktaṃ bhavati| ubhābhyāñcānantaryaṃ na sambhavati, ātaḥ sicā vyavadhānāditi manyamānaḥ pṛcchati-- `katham' ityādi| `sico luki' iti| `gātisthā' (2.4.77) ityādinā yadā sico luk kriyate tadā pratyayalakṣaṇena sico'nantaraḥ sambhavati| `śrutyā cākārāntāt' iti| tadanantaraśrūyamāṇatvāt| śrutyeti śrotrendriyasādhyopalabdhyetyarthaḥ| tadevaṃ dvābhyāmapyānantaryasyāśrayaṇāt sāmarthyādātaḥ sijlugantād jherjus bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| na hi śrūyamāṇe sici dvābhyāmānantaryaṃ sambhavati| `takāro mukhasukhārthaḥ' iti| vyāvarttyābhāvāt| na hi hrasvāt plutādvā varṇāt paraḥ sic sambhavati| `pūrveṇaiva siddhe' iti| lupte'pi sici pratyayalakṣaṇena jheḥ sijanantaratvādabhūvinniti niyamasya vyāvartyaṃ darśayati| `bhuvo vug luṅaliṭoḥ' (6.4.88) iti vuk| nanu ca naiveha pūrvasūtreṇa prāpnoti, na hīha sijapekṣayānantaryaṃ jhervidyate, tat kiṃ pratiṣidhyata ityāha-- `pratyayalakṣaṇena' ityādi| lupte hi pratyayalakṣaṇenānantaryamasti, ataḥ pūrveṇa prāpnoti| jus niyamena pratiṣidhyate| yadi tarhi niyamārthamidam, `akārṣuḥ' ityatrāpi na syāt, na hyatrātaḥ sijlugantātparo jhirbhavatīti ? ityata āha--`tulyajātīya' ityādi| ātaḥ sijlugantānniyamārthamayaṃ jus vidhīyate| sa ca niyamastulyajātīyāpekṣaḥ, tena samānajātīyameva vyavacchinatti| kaśca samānajātīyaḥ ? anyaḥ {sijalugantaḥ iti mu.pāṭhaḥ|} sijlugantaḥ| na cākārṣurityatra jheḥ pūrvaḥ sijlugantaḥ iti nāyaṃ niyamasya viṣayaḥ, tena bhavatyeva jus|| 111. laṅaḥ śākaṭāyanasyaiva| (3.4.111) `ayuḥ, avuḥ' iti| pūrvavacchapo luk, pūrvavacca pararūpatvam| `laṅeva' ityādi| yatsambandhino jherjusbhāvo vidheyaḥ| tiṅatvamadhikṛtyemuktam| kutaḥ etat ? laṅaliṅorapyākārāntādanantarayoḥ sambhavāt| tatsambandhinostu `jherjus' (3.4.108) ityevamādinaiva śāstreṇa jusbhāvo vihita iti na tāvadadhikṛtyedamucyate| evakārastu lṛṅavyavacchedārthaḥ, syapratyayena jhervyavadhānāt| sa cātideśadvāreṇa yasya laṅavadbhāvo na bhavati sa veditavyaḥ| yasya hyatideśadvāreṇa laṅavadbhāvo vihitaḥ sa upacāreṇa laṅityucyate| paramārthatastu loḍevāsau, na laṅeva| `laṅavadbhāvena yaḥ' iti| laṅiti sambadhyate|laṅā tulyaṃ mā bhūditi mukhyasyaiva laṅo grahaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ laṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| kena punarlaṅavadbhāvo bhavatītyāha-- `loṭo laṅvat' iti. anena hi sūtreṇa (3.4.85) loṭo laṅvat kāryaṣvatidiṣṭeṣu laṅkāryayogāt tasya laṅvadbhāvo bhavati| tena laṅasadṛśabhūta upacāreṇa laṅiti vyapadiśyate| atrāyamarthaḥ--yadi mukhyasya laṅaḥ parigrahārthaṃ laṅgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tataḥ `loṭo laṅvat' (3.4.85) ityatideśādyathā tāmādikāryaṃ loṭo bhavati, tathedamapi syāt| ato'sya doṣasya nivṛtyarthaṃ laṅagrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti mā bhūnnāmāyaṃ jus; loṭo laṅagrahaṇādyatnāt|| yastu `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) ityanena vidhīyate sa vibhyatu, jāgratu, vidantvityādau kasmānna bhavati, na hi kiñcit tatra yatnāntaramasti ? ityāha-- `sijabhyasta' ityādi| kathaṃ punarvinā yatnena pūrvako jus loṭo na bhavatītyāha-- `jusbhāvamātraṃ hi' ityādi| na hyayameva jus mukhyena laṅā viśiṣyate,kiṃ tarhi ? jusbhāvamātram| yo'smin prakaraṇe jus vihitaḥ sa mukhyasyaiva laṅo bhavati, netarasyeti| tena pūrvako'pi jus na bhavati| `ekakāra uttarārthaḥ' iti| atha tadarthaṃ evakāraḥ kasmān bhavati ? vidhyarthatvāt tasya | na hi vidhyarthavākya evakārasyārthavatvamupapadyate| sa hi niyamārtheṣūpayujyate, na hi vidhyartheṣu| na cedaṃ niyamārtham; siddhe hi vidhirārabhyamāṇo niyamārtho bhavati (kā.du.pa.59), na ca siddhe'yamārabhyate| tasmāduttarārthaṃ evakāraḥ| nanu śākaṭāyanasyaiva matena yathā syādanyeṣāṃ mate mā bhūdityevamarthamihaivakāraḥ syāt ? na; tena vinā'pyasya niyamasya siddhatvāt| yadyanyeṣāṃ mate na syāt, śākaṭāyanagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt|| 112. dviṣaśca| (3.4.112) `adviṣu' iti. adāditvācchapo luk|| 113. tiṅśitsārvadhātukam| (3.4.113) `bhavati, nayati' iti| tiṅaḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñāyāṃ tannibandhanaḥ karttari śap, tasyāpi śitaḥ sārvadhātukatvāt `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' 7.3.84) iti guṇaḥ| `roditi' iti| pūrvavacchapo lopaḥ, `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) itīṭ| `pavamānaḥ, yajamānaḥ' iti| `pūṅyajoḥ śānan' (3.2.128) ,tasya sārvadhātukatvāt śap, tasyāpi sārvadhātukatvāddhātorguṇaḥ|| 114. ārdhadhātukaṃ śeṣa-| (3.4.114) `lavitā' iti| tṛc, `ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ' (7.2.35) itīṭ| `vṛkṣatvam' iti| `tasya bhāvastvatalau' (5.1.119)| `lūbhyām' iti| lunāteḥ kvibantādbhyām| `jugupsate' iti| gupādisūtreṇa (3.1.5) san| tvalādīnāmārdhadhātukatvābhāvādiḍabhāvaḥ| yaktaṃ `vṛkṣatvam' pratyudāharaṇam, tvapratyayasya dhātoravidhānāt, `lūbhyām' ityādyayuktam, `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati' (vyā.pa.132) iti nyāyāt, myāmpratyayo dhātoreva vihitaḥ, sanpratyayo'pi dhātoḥ, gupāderdhātutvāt ? naitadasti;asyaiva hi doṣasya parīhārāya dhātuśabdena yo vihita ityuktam| tasya cāyamarthaḥ-- dhātorityevaṃ yo vihitaḥ,dhātuśabdamuccārya yo vihita iti yāvat| yasya vidhāyakalakṣaṇe dhātugrahaṇamasti,na caivaṃ bhmāṃsanau vihitau; tdavidhau dhātvadhikārasya dhātugrahaṇasya cāsambhavāt| kathaṃ punardhātusaṃśabdanena yo vihita ityeṣo'rtho labhyate, yāvatā dhātorityekameva dhātugrahaṇamanuvarttate, taccādhātupratyayanivṛttau caritārthatvānnāparaṃ kiñcidviśiṣṭamabhidhātumutsahate ? evaṃ manyate-- yaṅavidhānasūtrāt (3.1.22) `śamidhāto saṃjñāyām' (3.2.14) ityato vā dvitīyadātugrahaṇamanuvarttate, tatraikena dhātunā adhātupratyayo nivartatate, apareṇa dhātupratyayo viśiṣyate-- dhātorityevaṃ yo vihita iti| śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kim ? tiṅaśitormā bhūt, anyathā hyekasaṃjñādhikārābhāvāt pratyayādisaṃjñānāmiva samāveśaḥ syāt|| 115. liṭ ca| (3.4.115) `śekitha' iti| ārdhadhātukatvālliṭaḥ `ṛto bhāradvājasya' (7.2.63) itīṭ| tatra ṛta eva bhāradvājasya nānyeṣāṃ dhātūnāmityeṣo'rtho'bhimataḥ| `thali ca seṭi' (6.4.121) ityetvābhyāsalopau| `jagle, mamle' iti| ārdhadhātukatvāt `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| `nanu ca ' ityādinā yaduktaṃ `sārvadhātukasaṃjñāyā apavādaḥ' (kā.3.4.115) iti tadvighaṭayati| ekasaṃjñādhikārādanyatra samāveśo bhavati, yathā-- tyayādisaṃjñānām| na cātraikasaṃjñādhikāro'sti,tadayuktamasyāḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñāyā apavādatvamityabhiprāyaḥ|`satyametat'ityādinā apavādatvameva samarthayate|| 116.liṅāśiṣi| (3.4.116) `{laviṣīṣṭhā' iti mu.pāṭhaḥ} laviṣīṣṭa' iti| thās , `suṭ tithoḥ' (3.4.107) iti suṭ, ṣaṣvam, ṣṭatvañca|| 117.chandasyubhayathā| (3.4.117) `{astaye iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} svastaye' iti| `asa bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065), striyāṃ ktin| sārvadhātukatvādasterbhūbhāvo na bhavati| `viśṛṇvire' iti| atra liṭaḥ sārvadhātukatvāt `śruvaḥ śṛ ca' (3.1.74) iti śnupratyayaḥ, śṛbhāvaśca| `sunvire' iti| `svādibhyaḥ śnuḥ' (3.1.73)| `upastheyāma'iti| tiṣṭhaterliṅa,yāsuṭ,mas, `eterliṅi' (7.4.24)ityetvam| nanu `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) ityanenaiva siddhaṃ sarvamevedam, kimartho'yamārambha ityāha-- `vyatyayo bahulamityasyaiva' iti| gatārtham|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ tṛtīyasyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ| samāptaśca tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| <4> <4.1> atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ 1. ṅyāpprātipadikāt| (4.1.1) `adhikāro'yam' iti| svaritenāsañjitatvāt| `ā pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ' iti| anenādhikārasyāvadhiṃ darśayati| tataḥ paraṃ nāyamanuvarttate; asvaritatvāt| `svādiṣu kapparyanteṣu' iti| adhikārasya viṣamācaṣṭe| `ṅī iti ṅīpṅīṣṅīnāṃ sāmānyena grahaṇam' ityādi| `ṅī' iti viśeṣakarānanubandhānutsṛjya yat sāmānyaṃ ṅīmātraṃ tadiha gṛhyate| `ṭābḍāpcāpāmāp' iti| sāmānyena grahaṇamiti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| nanu ca ṅyādīnāṃ bahutvādbahuvacanena bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ `ṅyāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) ityekavacanena nirdeśa ityāha --`teṣām' ityādi| samāhāradvandeneha ṅyādīnāmayaṃ nirdeśaḥ kṛta ityarthaḥ| itaretarayoge hi dvandve syādbahuvacanam| na cāyamitaretarayoge dvandvaḥ,kiṃ tarhi ? samāhāre| tasya caikārthatvādekavacanameva yuktam| `samāhāranirdeśaḥ' iti vacanamitaretarayoganivṛttyartham,sāmāsantaranivṛttyarthañca, anyathā hi ṅyāpoḥ prāptipadikaṃ ṅyāpprātipadikamityapi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa āśaṅkyeta| tato ṅyantamābantañca samāsaprātipadikaṃ yat tataḥ syād rājakumāryādibhyaḥ na tu kevalebhyaḥ kumāryādibhyaḥ| ṅyāpostu vidhānenaiva prātipadikaṃ prakṛtiḥ syāt| tasmāt samāhāra dvandvenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ | tatra tu trayaṃ prakṛtitvenādhikriyate, tena sarvato bhavati| atha kathaṃ punaratra vigrahaḥ ? kecidāhuḥ-- `ṅīśca āpca prātipadikañceti| nanu ca `apratyayaḥ' (1.2.45) iti prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedhād ṅīśceti vibhaktyutpattirna syāt ? ucyate; nāyaṃ pratyayaḥ, api tu pratyayānukaraṇamidam| evamapi `prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.113) iti syādeva pratiṣedhaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥca anukaraṇaṃ dvaidham-- arthasya, śabdamātrasya ceti| jñāpitamācāryeṇaitad dvedhā nirdeśāt -- `parivyavebhyaḥ kriyaḥ' (1.3.18) , `viparābhyāṃ jeḥ' (1.3.19) itīyaṅādeśasya karaṇākaraṇābhyām| ato'tra śabdamātramanukṛtam, na tvarthasahitam| tenātra `apratyayaḥ' (1.2.45) iti nāstyeva pratiṣedhaḥ| prakṛtivadatideśastvarthavatyanukaraṇe| nanu cevamapi halṅyādilopena (6.1.68) bhāvyam ? ucyate; ṅyantāt sulopaḥ, na ṅīmātrāt| vyapadeśivadbhāvāt syāditi cet ? na; `vyapadeśavadbhāvo'prātipadikena' (śāka.pa.65) ityucyate, prātipadikañcadam| tasmāt `ṅīśca' iti| atha pratyayavidhiviṣayaiṣā paribhāṣā pūrvādiniḥ' (5.2.86) `sapūrvācca' (5.2.87) ityatra jñāpitatvāt ? na cāyaṃ pratyayavidhiḥ, kastarhi ? lopavidhiriti, ataḥ paribhāṣā na pravarttata ityastyeva vyapadeśivadbhāva iti tataḥ pravarttate lopaśāstram| ataḥ sulopena bhavitavyam-- ṅī ceti| sāmānyena paribhāṣāpravṛttimāśritya ṅīśceti vigrahaḥ| anyastvāha-- `prayogasya eva kumārī, gaurītyādiṣu ya īkāraḥ so'trānukṛta eva luptavibhaktikaḥ,tena ṅī ityeva bhavati| yadyevam, kuto ṅakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārtha āsajyate ? nanu cānukriyamāṇenārthenārthavattvāt punarapi vibhaktyutpattiḥ prāpnoti, tataśca ṅīśceti bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; prākkālabhāvinī yā vibhaktistāṃ pratyayalakṣaṇenāśrityāpratyaya (1.2.45) iti pratiṣedhāt| athāpi syāt-- `na ṅisambuddhyoḥ' (8.2.8) iti jñāpakāt pratyayalakṣaṇenāpratyaya (1.2.45) iti prātipadikasaṃjñā na pratiṣidhyate' iti| asadetat; nalopavidhiviṣayamevaitajjñāpakam| ato'tra nāstyeva pratyayalakṣaṇena prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedha iti sthitametat| nanu ca pratyayatve sati `paraśca' (3.1.2) iti vacanāt pare bhavantaḥ svādayaḥ pūrvāṃ prakṛtimākṣipya bhavanti, na hyanyathā paratvamupapadyate, tasya paratvasya pūrvāpekṣatvāt, na ca ṅyādibhyo'nyā prakṛtirupapadyate| tatra ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇamantareṇāpi pāriśeṣyādiyameva prakṛtirlabhyate tathā hi, prakṛtyantaraṃ dhāturiti-- tiṅantañca, vākyañca| pratyayā api svādayaḥ, ṭābādayaḥ aṇādayaśca| tatra dhātostāvat svādibhirna bhavitavyam, te hyekatvādiṣvartheṣu vidhīyamānāstadvantaṃ śabdamākṣipanti| na ca dhāturekatvādimān| athāpyaviśeṣaṇotpadyante, utpannānāṃ tu niyamaḥ kriyate ? tathāpi na aiva teṣāṃ dhātorutpattiryuktā; sāmānyavihitānāṃ svādīnāṃ viśeṣavihitaistavyadādibhirbādhitatvāt| ṭābādayastarhi dhātorbhaveyuriti cet ? syādetat| asati ṅyāpprātipadikagrahaṇe'kārāntebhyo dhātubhyo jugupsādibhyaḥ `ataḥ' (4.1.4) iti ṭāp syāt, apidbhyo vañcuprabhṛtibhyaḥ `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp syāt, nakārāntebhyo manprabhṛtibhyaḥ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5) iti ṅīppratyayaḥ iti ? etacca nāsti ; yataḥ striyāṃ ṭābādayo vidhīyante, kriyāvacanaśca dhātuḥ| kriyāyāścāsattvabhūtatvālliṅgena yogo nāsti; tasya dravyadharmatvāt| etena tiṅantādvākyācca ṭābādīnāmutpattiḥ pratikṣiptā; tayorapi kriyāpradhānatvāt| aṇādīnāmapi naiva dhātorutpattirupapadyate| te hyapatyādinārthena sambandhe sati vidhīyante| dhātuvācyasyārthasyāsattvabhūtatvādyathā strītvena yogo na sambhavati, tathāpyapatyādinā hyarthena| etena tiṅantādvākyāccāṇādīnāmutpattirnirastā; tadarthasyāpi kriyāpradhānasyāpatyādinā sambandhābhāvāt| devadattasya pacati yastasyāpattyamiti satyapi sambandhe `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) iti jñāpakānna bhavati| ye'patyādinārthena sambandhe taddhitā vidhīyante te'nantaroktayā nītyā mā bhūn, ye tu svārthe vidhīyante tairyuktameva bhavitumiti cet ? vārttametat; yathaiva hi svādīnāṃ sāmānyavihitānāṃ viśeṣavihitaistavyadādibhirbādhitatvāt tadutpattirnopapadyate tathā svārthikānāmapi sāmānyavihitānāṃ svārthikaistumunnādibhirviśeṣavihitairbādhitatvānnopapadyata eva| tiṅantāt tarhi ke syuriti cet ? jñāpakānna bhaviṣyanti| yadayaṃ kvacit taddhitavidhau tiṅgarhaṇaṃ karoti-- `atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau' (5.3.55) `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) iti, kvacit taddhitavidhau tiṅgrahaṇaṃ karoti-- `atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau' (5.3.55) `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) iti, tajjñāpayati-- tiṅantāt taddhitā na bhavantīti| vākyāt tarhi bhaveyariti cet ? anabhidhānānna bhaviṣyanti| na hi `devadattasyāśvakaḥ' ityukte vākyārthagatā ajñātādayo'rthāḥ kapratyayena dyotyante, kiṃ tarhi ? aśvaśabdagatā eva| svādibhirapi naiva tiṅantādbhavitavyam, teṣāṃ hyekatvādayo'rthāḥ,te ca tiṅabhirevoktāḥ| na coktarthānāṃ prayoge yuktaḥ; `uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ' (vyā.pa.60) iti vacanā| nanu coktārthānāmapi prayogo dṛśyate, yathā-- eko dvau bahava iti cet ? yukto'tra prayogaḥ vacanagrahaṇāt| `prātipadika' ityādau hi sūtre vacanagrahaṇasyaitat teṣāṃ bhavati; tatrāsyāḥ paribhāṣāyā upasthānāt| tena liṅgaviśiṣṭānāmapi sarvādīnāṃ sarvanāmakāryamupapadyate| yadyevam, imameva nyāyamāśritya śakyaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇamakarttum ? naitadasti; na hi prātipadikasaṃjñā liṅgaviśiṣṭasyārthavataḥ śabdarūpasya bhavitumarhati; `aprtayaya' (1.2.45) iti pratiṣedhāt| na ca prātipadikasaṃjñāvidhau sarve'rthavantaḥ saṃjñinaḥ svarūpeṇa śakyā darśayitum; teṣāmānantyāt| yadyevam, `ṇāviṣṭhavat prātipadikasya' (vā.813) ityatrāpi tarhīyaṃ paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate; svarūpāgrahaṇāt, tataśca liṅgaviśiṣṭeṣvaṣṭhavadbhāvo na syāt| tatra ko doṣaḥ ? kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārīyatītyatra ṭilopo na syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bahulamiṣṭhavadbhāva iṣyate, tathā ca curādau paṭhyate `prātipadikād dhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca' (curā.ga.sū.186) iti| tasmādbahulavacanālliṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpīṣṭhavadbhāvo bhaviṣyati| `kiñca' ityādanā prayojanāntaraṃ samuccinoti| taditi ṅyāpoḥ pratyavarśaḥ| ṅyantādābantācca taddhitavidhānaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ ca ṅyābgrahaṇam| `kālitarā' iti| kālaśabdājjanapadādisūtreṇa (4.1.42) ṅīp, tadantāt `dvivacanavibhajyopapade' (5.3.57) ityādinā tarap, `gharūpakalpa' (6.3.43) ityādinā hrasvaḥ| `hariṇitarā' iti| haritaśabdāt `varṇādanudāttāt topadhāto naḥ' (4.1.39) iti ṅīp, takārasya nakāraḥ, `aṭkupvāṅ' (8.4.2) ityasati ṅyābgrahaṇe paratvādātiśayikaḥ syāt| asmiṃstu sati ṅyāpostaddhitavidhāne prakṛtitvenāśrayaṇāt pūrvaṃ ṅyābbhyāṃ bhavitavyamiti tadantāt taddhitavidhiḥ sidhyati| nanu cāntaraṅgaḥ strīpratyayaḥ, bahiraṅgāstaditāḥ, tathā hi-- `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' (4.1.82) ityadhikārādvibhaktyantāte utpadyante, vibhaktayaśca karmādyapekṣāḥ, karmādayaśca bāhyakriyānimittatvādbahiraṅgāḥ tataśca nimittasya bahiraṅgatvāt taddhitā api bahiraṅgāśrayā eva bhavanti; liṅgasya tu sambandhyantarānapekṣatvādantaraṅgatvañca, atastannimittā api ṭābādayo'ntaraṅgā bhavanti, tataścāntaraṅgatvādeva ṭābādibhistāvadbhavitavyam, paścāt tadantāt taddhitairityapārthakaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇam ? naitadasti; tadantāt taddhitavimadhānārthaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇamityatra hi vākye taddhitagrahaṇena svārthikā ye taddhitāsta eva vivakṣitāḥ| imamevārthaṃ sūcayituṃ kālitarā, hariṇitareti strīpratyayāntāt svārthika eva tarappratyaya udāhṛtaḥ| svārthikeṣu ca `samarthānām' (4.1.82) ityetannānuvarttate| tathā hi kṣyati vṛttikāraḥ-- `svārthikapratyayāvadhiścāyamadhikāraḥ `prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ' (5.3.1) iti yāvat| svārthikeṣu hyasyopayogo nāsti' iti| evañca sati vibhaktyutpattimanapekṣya prātipadikādeva svārthikairbhavitavyamiti kutasteṣāṃ bahiraṅgatvam ! nanvevamapi kālitaretyādyanudāharaṇam; tarappratyayasya bahiraṅgatvāt| sa hi yadyapi vibhaktyutpattiṃ nāpekṣate, pratiyoginaṃ tu bāhyārthamapekṣata eva, strīpratyayasya tu na kaścit pratiyogyapekṣeti tasyāntaraṅgatvam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; udāharaṇadigiyaṃ vṛttikāreṇa darśitā | etāni tvatrodāharaṇāni darśayitavyāni-- enikā, śyenikā, rohiṇiketi| atra hi yadi pūrvaṃ taddhitaḥ syāt tadetaśyatarohitaśabdebhyo'jñātādyarthavivakṣāyāṃ kapratyaye `varṇādanudāttāt topadhāt to naḥ' (4.1.39) ityanena ṅībnakārau na syātām| yadi tarhi ṅyābantāt taddhitavidhānārthaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇam, samāsāntā api tadantādeva syuḥ, tataśca bahavo gomanto'syāṃ nagaryāmiti syāt, bahuvrīhau kṛte `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp, tataśca `nadyṛtaśca' (5.4.153) iti kapi bahugomatīketi rūpaṃ syāt, bahugomatketi ceṣyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hi samāsāntāḥ samāsādutpadyante| kiṃ tarhi ? akṛta eva samāse tadarthāduttarapadāt| tathā hi `na kapi' (7.4.14) ityatra vakṣyati vṛttikāraḥ-- `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) ityayamapi hrasvaḥ kapi na bhavati, samāsārthe hyuttarapade kapi kṛte paścāt samāsena bhavitavyamiti strīpratyayāntaṃ samāsaprātipadikaṃ na bhavati' iti| na ca bahavo gomanto'syāṃ nagaryāmityatra vākye samāsārthamuttarapadaṃ striyāṃ varttata iti prākkapaiva bhavitavyam, paścāt samāsena, tataḥ strīpratyayena pratyayānupūrvyā bahugomatketi siddhaṃ bhavati| yida tarhyakṛta eva samāse tadarthāduttarapadāt samāsāntā bhavanti, tadā `nañastatpuruṣāt' (5.4.71) ityatra `nañaḍhaḥ pare vakṣyamāṇā ya ṛgādayastadantāt tatpuruṣāt samāsāntā na bhavanti' ityeṣa vṛttigrantho virudhyate, tebyastatpuruṣasamāsārthebhyaḥ samāsāntā na bhavantīti vaktavyaṃ syāt ? nañaḥ prakṛtatvāt sa eva vijñāyate | `tatpuruṣāt' (5.4.71) ityatrāpi tatpuruṣaśabdastādarthyāt tatpuruṣārtha uttarapade varttate| tatra punaḥ ṛgādeḥ śrutatvādṛgādireva vijñāyate, tadantāt tatpuruṣāditi ca vyadhikaraṇe pañcamyau| tato'yamarthaḥ nañaḥ pare ya ṛgādayaste samīpabhūtā yasya nañastasmāt paraṃ yattatpuruṣārthamṛgādipadaṃ tataḥ samāsānto na bhavatīti| atha vā-- avayavavacano'ntaśabdaḥ, samānādhikaraṇa eva pañcamyau; tādarthyāt| ṛgādyantaṃ tatpuruṣārthaṃ yudattarapadaṃ tadeva| tadantāt tatpuruṣārthādityuktam| tataścāyamarthaḥ nañaḥ pare ya ṛgādayastadantāt tatpuruṣārthāduttarapadāt samāsāntā na bhavantīti| tat punastadantatatpuruṣārtham| uttarapadaṃ sāmarthyādṛgādyeva vijñāyate| `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt' (5.4.73) ityatra tarhi yo'yaṃ vṛttigranthaḥ-- `saṃkhyeye yo'yaṃ bahuvrīhirvarttate tasmādabahugaṇāntāḍḍacpratyayo bhavati' iti, tasya virodhaḥ ? nāsti virodhaḥ; atra hi bahuvrīhyarthamuttarapadameva tādarthyādbahuvrīhirityuktaṃ bhavati| tadayamarthaḥ-- saṃkhyeye yadbahuvrīhyarthamuttarapadaṃ varttate tasmāḍḍcpratyayo bhavatīti| anayā diśā'pyanya evañjātīyā virodhāḥ pariharttavyāḥ| tadevaṃ sthitamevaitat-- tadantāt taddhitavidhānārthaṃ hyābgrahaṇamiti, vipratiṣedhāt taddhitavidhānārthaṃ ṅyābgrahaṇamiti, vipratiṣedhāt taddhitavalīyastvamiti| yadyevam, `yunastiḥ' (4.1.77) `ūṅutaḥ' (4.1.66) ityetayorapi tyūṅorgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate, tadantāt taddhitotpattiryathā syāt-- yuvatitarā, brahmabandhūtareti ? `nadyāḥ śeṣasyānyatarasyām' (6.3.44) ityūṅo vikalpena hrasvatvaṃ na karttavyam; hyābgrahaṇasyopalakṣaṇārthatvāt| `striyām' (4.1.3) iti prakṛtya yeṣāṃ vidhānaṃ tadupalakṣaṇārthamiha ṅyābgrahamam| atastyūṅorapi grahaṇamiha kṛtameva veditavyam| ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ yadyupalakṣaṇārthama, anyatarasyaiva grahaṇaṃ karttavyam, ekenāpi hi strīpratyayā upalakṣyanta eva ? satyametat ; vaicitryārthaṃ tu dvayorgrahaṇam | `yāvādibhyaḥ kan' (5.4.29), `lohitānmaṇau' (5.4.30), `varṇe cānitye' (5.4.31) ityanena tu vikalpena svārthikena strīpratyayasya bādhanamiṣyate| tatra yadā bādhā tadā lohitaśabdāt kani ṭāpi kṛte cetve lohitiketi bhavitavyam; yadā tu na bādhā tadā ` varṇādanudāttāttopadhāt to naḥ' (4.1.39) iti ṅībnakārayoḥ kani ca `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvatve kṛte lohiniketi bhavitavyam| tasmādvaktavyamevaitat-- lohitālliṅgabādhanaṃ veti|| 2. svaujasamauṭchaṣṭābhyāṃbhisṅebhyāmbhyasṅasibhyāmbyasṅasomṅyossup| (4.1.2) `ukārādavo'nubandhāḥ' ityādi| tatra prathamaikavacanasyokāra uccāraṇārthāḥ| `anahasau' (7.1.93) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate ? vyāvartyābhāvāt| jaso jakāro'sandigdhoccāraṇārthaḥ, asati hi tasminnaukārasyāvādeśe kṛte sandehaḥ syāt-- kīdṛśasya pratyayasyoccāraṇamiti, tatra vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamāpadyate| atha `jasaḥ śī' (7.1.17) ityatra viśeṣaṇārthaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate ? `asaḥ śī' (ityucyamāne'pyatiprasaṅgābhāvāt| `auṭaṣṭakāraḥ suḍiti pratyāhāragrahaṇārthaḥ' iti| vṛttau tveṣa grantho nāsti; bhavitavyaṃ tvanena| lekhakapramādadoṣādidānīmantarhitaḥ| śasaḥ śakāra auṭaṣṭakārasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvenāsandigdhoccāraṇārthaḥ| śakāraḥ sandehanirāsārthaḥ, itarathā hyauḍasityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt-- kiṃ ṭakārasyedamuccāraṇam, uta ḍakārasyeti ?tatra ḍakāroccāraṇāṭṭilopaḥ syāt| nanu ca satyapi śakāre bhavitavyameva sandehena-- kimidaṃ kṛtacartvasya ḍakārasyoccaraṇam ?ṭakārasya veti ? naitadasti; yadi hi ḍakārasya syāt, śakāroccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| atha `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (6.1.103) iti tatra viśeṣaṇārthaḥ `ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ' (7.1.12)
