ityatra | `supāṃ suluk' (7.1.39) ityādau supāṃ suluk pūrvasavarṇa ā āt śe ityākārapraśleṣaḥ, tatrāsati ṭakāre tasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt| `saṃkhyākarmādayaśca' ityādi| saṃkhyā svādīnāmarthe vihitā `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ityādinā śāstrāntareṇa| karmādayaśca `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityevamādinā| `tena sahāsyaikavākyatā' iti| karmaṇi bahutve bahuvacanaṃ śas| karmaṇi dvitvaikatvayodvivacane auḍamau| evamanyatrāpyekavākyatā veditavyā| yadi tarhi tena sahāsyaikavākyatā , tadā yuktaṃ `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ityatra -- `yatra ca saṃkhyā sambhavati tatrāyamupadeśaḥ, avyayebhyastu niḥsaṃkhyebhyaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ svādayo vidyanta eva' iti, tadvirudhyate, ekavākyatāyāṃ hi viśiṣṭa evārthe karmādisambandhinyekatvādau svādīnāṃ vidhānāt sāmānyavihitatvaṃ nopapadyate| yadapīdaṃ tatroktam- `ṅyāpprātipadikāt svādayo lasya tibādaya iti bahuvacanaṃ vihitaṃ tasyānena bahutvasaṃkhyāvācyatvena vidhīyate' iti, tadapi virudhyata eva; na hyekavākyatāyāṃ vihitasya bahuvacanasya paścādbahutvasaṃkhyāya vācyatvena vidhānaṃ yuktam| tena śāstrānteṇānena ca saṃhatya bahutvasaṃkhyāyāmeva bahuvacanavidhānāt pūrvakastāvannāsti virodhaḥ| ekavākyatāyāmapi hi yathā svādīnāṃ sāmānyena vidhānamupapadyate tathā `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ittraiva pratipāditam| yo'pi dvitīyo virodha udbhāvitaḥ so'pi na bhavatyeva; hyāpprātipadikāt svādayo lasya tibādaya iti bahuvacanaṃ vihitamiti `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ityanena saihakavākyatāmāpannenetyayaṃ tatrābhiprāyo veditavyaḥ| tasyānena sūtreṇa bahutvasaṃkhyā vācyatvena vidhīyata ityatrāpi svādisūtreṇa (4.1.2) `lasya' (3.4.77) ityādinā ca śāstreṇa sahaikavākyatāṃ pratipannenetyeṣo'bhiprāyo draṣṭavyaḥ| evañca saṃhatyaiva bahuvacanaṃ vihitam| saṃhatyaiva ca tasya bahutavasaṃkhyā vācyatvena vidhīyata iti kuto virodhaḥ; nanu ca `bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ityekamidaṃ śāstram, tasya di svādisūtreṇai (4.1.2)kavākyatā, tato `lasya' (3.4.77) ityādinā śāstrāntareṇa sā nopapadyate ? atha tenaikavākyatā, svādisūtreṇa (4.1.2) sā nopapadyate ? naiva doṣaḥ; dve hyete vacane tantroccārite, tatraikasya svādisūtreṇaikavākyatā, aparasya `lasya' (1.4.21) ityādinā śāstrāntareṇa| atha vā-- anyathā virodhābhāvaḥ pratipādyate| iha hi svādayo'nena sūtreṇa `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) ityevamādikaṃ śāstramanapekṣya vā vidhīyeran ? tadvāpekṣya tena sahaikavākyatāmāpanne te ? iti dvau pakṣau| tatrādye pakṣe'viśeṣeṇaiva svādayo vidhīyanta iti, tathā vihitānāṃ tu teṣāṃ niyamaḥ kriyate-- yatra saṃkhyā sambhavati tatrāsau bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ityādinā śāstrāntareṇa karmādisambandhyekatvādisaṃkhyāvācyatvena vidhīyate, yāni tu niḥsakhyānyavyayāni tebyaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ svādaya santītyeva| dvitīye tu pakṣe viśiṣṭa evārthe karmādisambandhini bahutvādau svādayo vidhīyante| tatra `bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (1.4.21) ityādyaḥ pakṣa āśritaḥ, iha tu dvitīya iti nāsti virodhaḥ; pakṣāntaramāśritya tathā'bhidhānāt| atha dvitīye pakṣe kathamavyayebhyaḥ subutpattiḥ, na hyekavākyatāyāṃ saṃkyākarmādyartharahitebhyaḥ svādyutpattirupapadyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; jñāpakādbhaviṣyati| yadayaṃ `avyayādāpsupaḥ' (2.4.82) ityavyayādutpannasya supo lukaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-- bhavatyavyayādvibhaktyutpattiriti| `kumārī' iti| `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti ṅīp| `gaurī' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ| `śārṅgaravī' iti `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn' (4.1.73)| `khaṭvā' iti| `ajādyataṣṭāp' (4.1.4) iti ṭāp| `bahūrājā' iti| `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' (4.1.13) iti ḍāp| `kārīvagandhyāḥ' iti| karīṣasya gandha iva gandho yasyeti| `gandhasyedutpūtisusurabhibhyaḥ' (5.4.135) , `upamānācca' (5.4.137) itīttvam| karīṣagandherapatyamiti `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ,`taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' (7.2.117) ityādi vṛddhiḥ,`aṇiñoranārṣayorgurupottamayoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādinā ṣyaṅādeśaḥ, `yaṅaścāp' (4.1.74) iti cāp|| 3. striyām| (4.1.3) `ṅyāporanenaiva vidhānāt' iti| etena `striyām' ityadhikṛtya pratyayavidhau hyābantāyāḥ prakṛterabhāvamāha| eṣa ca `prātipadikamātramatra prakaraṇe sambadhyate' ityatra hetuḥ| yadi hi ṅyābantā prakṛtiriha prakaraṇe sambhavet tato ṅyāpāvapi sambadhyeyātānām, sā ṅyābrūpā na sambhavati, ato na tāviha sambadhyete| iha ca strītvaṃ pratyācāryāṇāṃ darśanabhedaḥ, kvacicca darśane doṣo dṛśyate| tatra keṣāñciddarśanam-- `stanakaśavatī strī syāllomaśaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ| ubhayorantaraṃ yacca tadabhāve napusaṃkam|| iti| `stanakeśavatī' iti, bhūmnyatiśāyane vā matup| `lomaśaḥ' ityatrāpi lomādipāmādisūtreṇa (5.2.100) śapratyayaḥ| `ubhayorantaram' iti, ubhayoḥ strīpuṃsayoḥ sadṛśamityarthaḥ| tatpunaḥ sādṛśyaṃ liṅgavatvena| evaṃ tarhi tadubhayaṃ samuditaṃ yatra tannapuṃsakaṃ prāpnoti| bhavati hi samudāyarūpaṃ samudāyirūpeṇa liṅigatvena sadṛśamityata āha-- `tadabhāve' iti| etadubhayaṃ yatra nāsti tat `napuṃsakam' iti| tena na sambhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| yadi tadabhāve napuṃsakamityetaducyate, tato'vyayānāṃ tiṅantānāñcaiva napuṃsakatvaṃ syāt| tathāpyubhayorantaraṃ yadityetāvaducyate, evamapi kukkuṭamayūryau ityevamādīnāṃ liṅgasamudāyamatāṃ samudāyānāṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ prasajyeta| tasmādubhayorantaraṃ yat tadabhāva iti ca dvayamapyuktam| tadevaṃ yanna strī na pumān liṅgavacca vastu tannapuṃsakamityucyate, tato'vyayānāṃ tiṅantānācañca napuṃsakatvaṃ na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| atra darśane bhrṛkuṃse ca ṭāp prasajyate, tasay hi stanakeśasambandha upalabhyate| bhrṛkuṃsaḥ strīveśadhārī nartakaḥ, puruṣa ucyate| khaṭvādīnāñca stanakeśābhāvāt strītvaṃ na syāt, vṛkṣādīnāñca lomaśatvābhāvāt kuṃstvābhāvaḥ prāpnoti, kharakuṭyādīnāñca lomaśatvāt puṃstvam, tataśca kharakuṭīḥ paśyeti `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (6.1.103) iti natvamāpadyeta| anyeṣāṃ tu darśanam-- saṃstyānam, prasavaḥ, sthitiśceti| saṃstyānam-- apacayasvabhāvaṃ strītvam, tadyatrāsti so'rthaḥ strī| prasavaḥ - upacayātmakaḥ puṃstvam, tadyatrāsti sa pumān| upacayāpacayarahitā yā'vasthā tadātmikā sthitirnapuṃsakatvam, tadyatrāsti tannapuṃsakamiti| atrāpi darśane saṃstyānādestrayasya sarvatra bhāvādekaikaṃ vastu strī, pumān, napuṃsakañca prasajyeta| saṃstyānavivakṣyāyāmeva strītvaṃ bhavati, prasavavivakṣāyāmeva puṃstvam, sthitivivakṣāyāmeva napuṃsakatvam, ato'yamadoṣa iti cet ? ayuktametat; tathā hi-- upacīyate kumārītyapi kumārī strī bhavati, na pumān| apacīyate vṛkṣa iti saṃstyānavivakṣāyāmapi vṛkṣaḥ pumāneva bhavati, na strī| upacīyate kuṇḍamapacīyate vetyupacayāpacayayoranyataravivakṣāyāmapi kuṇḍaṃ napuṃsakameva bhavati, na pumān nāpi strī| tadevamācāryāṇāṃ strītvaṃ prati darśanabhedāddoṣadarśanācca pṛcchati-- `striyāmityucyate,keyaṃ strī' ityādi| vṛttikārastu viditābhiprāyo darśanāntaramāśrityāha-- `sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ' ityādi| sāmānyāni viśeṣāśceti| tathā sāmānyāni ca tāni tulyajātīpadārthasādhāraṇatvādviśeṣāśca parasparato vijātīyebhyaśca viśiṣyante - vyāvartyanta iti sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ| `strītvādayo gotvādaya iva' iti| yathaiva hi gotvādayaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣā bhinneṣva pi svāśrayeṣvabhinnākārabuddhyabhidhānahetavastathā strītvādayo'pi| yathaiva hi gotvādayastulyajātīyeṣu sarveṣu varttante, vijātīyebhyastu vyāvarttante, tathā strītvādayo'pi| tasmāt tadvadeva te'pi sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ| nanu ca sāmānyaviśeṣaṇāṃ sarvavyaktyanugatatvādasminnapi darśane sa eva sarvatra sarvaliṅgatāprasaṅgaḥ, tatkimiti darśanāntaramutsṛjyedaṃ darśanamāśritamityāha--`bahuhaprakārā vyaktayaḥ'iti| vyajanta ābhiriti vyaktavyaḥ-- sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmāśrayāḥ| bahuprakārā vyaktayo yeṣāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāṃ te tathoktāḥ| anenaitat sūcayati-- vicitratvāt sāmānyaviśeṣāśrayāṇāṃ vyañjakānāṃ kaścideva sāmānyaviśeṣaḥ kenacidevāśrayeṇa vyajyate, na sarvaḥ sarveṇa| pratiniyataviṣayatvāt padārthaśaktīnām| tatra yenārthena strītvameva vyajyate na puṃstvaṃ nāpi napuṃsakatvam, sā stryeva bhavati, na pumān, nāpi napuṃsakam, yena puṃstvameva vyajyate sa pumāneva, yena napuṃsakatvaṃ tannapuṃsakameva| yastu dvayostrayāṇāṃ vā vyañjakaḥ sa dviliṅgastriliṅgo veṣyate-- ardharcaḥ, ardharcam; padmaḥ, padmam; taṭaḥ, kaṭī,taṭamiti| tena nāsmin darśane pūrvadoṣāvasaraḥ| yastarhi sāmānyaviśeṣasyāśrayo vyañjako na bhavati sa kathaṃ tadyogāt strī bhavati ? pumān napuṃsakañceti ?ata āha--kvacit' ityādi| āśātmākāśādiṣu hi sāmānyaviśeṣāḥ strītvādayaḥ kvacidupadeśamātravyaṅgyā eva, na tvāśrayavyaṅgyāḥ, tadāśrayāṇāmatīndriyatvāt| tatra yasminnupadeśena strītvaṃ vyajyate sā strī bhavati, yathā -- iyamāśeti| yatra puṃstvaṃ sa pumān, yathā--ayamātmeti| yatra napuṃsakatvaṃ tannapuṃsakameva, yathā-- idamākāśamiti| kathaṃ strītvādayaḥ kvacidupadeśamātravyaṅgyā bhavantītyāha-- `yathā' ityādi| brāhmaṇatvakṣatriyatvādīnāṃ hi tathāvidha āśrayo nāsti yastānyabhivyañjayet; sāmānyaviśeṣāśrayāṇāmāśātmākāśādīnamatīndriyatvāt| tadāśrayaṇāmanyatra sādṛśyādupadeśamātrādeva tu brāhmaṇatvādīnāmabhivyaktirbhavati| yathā ca teṣāṃ tathā ca kvacit strītvādīnām| kiṃ punaridaṃ strītvam ? pratyayārthaḥ ? uta prātipadikaviśeṣaṇam ? ityāha-- `strītvañca' ityādi| yadā strīśabdo vinā'pi bhāvapratyayena strītve varttate tadā striyāmabhidheyāyāṃ ṭābādayo bhavantīti strītvaṃ pratyayārtho bhavati| yathaiva hi gośabdo jātipadārthapakṣe bhāvapratyayarahito'pi gotve varttate tathā strīśabdo'pi strītve| yadā tu strītvaṃ viśeṣaṇamupādāya tadvati dravye strīśabdo'pi varttate tadāyaṃ pakṣo'pi bhavati-- striyāṃ yat prātipadikaṃ varttate tasmāṭṭābādaya iti strītvaṃ prakṛterviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati| `ubhayathā'pi yujyate' iti| kathaṃ punarubhayathā yujyate, yāvatā strītvasya pratyayārthatve strītvaṃ pradhānamāpadyata iti tatra vyatirekalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī prāpnoti, yathā--strītvaṃ devadattāyā iti, tataśca kumārī devadatteti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt ? dvivacane bahuvacane ca kumāryau kumārya iti na syātām, ekatvāt strītvasya ? anekaśca pratyayo nopapadyate gārgāyaṇī, kārīṣagandhyā,kālitareti;ekatvāt strītvasya, tasya ca prathamotpannenaiva ṣphaṣyaṅādinābhihitatvāt ? strīti ca īkāro na prāpnoti saṃstyāne `{strī ityeva mudritadaśapādyuṇādisūtrapāṭhe dṛṣyate} styāyaterḍraṭ' (paṃ.u.4.165) iti ḍraṭpratyayāntenābhidhīyate, yato vyatirekalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt| kasmāt na hi sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmāśrayādbhedaḥ strīpratyayāntenābhidhīyate, yato vyatirekalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt| kasmāt punarnābhidhīyate ? śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt| dvivacanabahuvacane api copapadyate; yasmāt sāmānyaviśeṣāṇāmekatve'punarnābhidhīyate ? śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt| dvivacanabahuvacane api copapadyete; yasmāt sāmānyaviśeṣaṇāmekatve'pyāśrayasaṃkhyāstadvācina upādadate, śabdaśaktisvābhāvyādeva| tenāśrayasyānekatvāt dvivacanabahuvacane bhaviṣyataḥ| gārgyāyaṇītyevamādau dvābhyāmeva strīpratyayābhyāṃ strītvaṃ vyajyate| naikena ṣyaṅādinetyaneko'pi pratyayo yukta eva| atha vā-- gārgyāyaṇītyatra `prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ' 4.1.17) iti vihitasya ṣphasya ṣitkaraṇasāmarthyāt ṅīṣ pratyayo bhaviṣyati| `kārīṣagandhyā' iti| ṣyaṅantāt `yaṅaścāp' (4.1.74) iti vacanasamārthyādaccābbhaviṣyati| `kālitarā' iti| jānapadādi (4.1.42) sūtravihitena ṅīṣā strītvamaprakarṣaviśiṣṭamuktam, na tu prakarṣaviśiṣṭam, atastasyānabhihitatvāt taravantāt ṭābbhaviṣyati| strīti `striyām'(4.1.3) iti nirdeśālliṅgāṭṭitkaraṇasāmarthyādvā ṅībbhaviṣyati| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe tu prātipadikena strītvaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamevocyate, ṭābādayastu dyotakā iti| tatra vyatirekābhāvāt ṣaṣṭhyā aprasaṅgādeva dvivacanabahuvacane api| anekatvāddravyasya yukte'neko'pi pratyayo yukta eva| yathaiva hi prātipadikenokte'pi strītve khaṭvetyādau ṭābādayo bhavanti, tathā gārgyāyaṇītyādāvaneke'pi ṣphādayo bhavanti| anenaiva strītvasya dyotitatvāditi yuktamuktam-- `ubhayathāpi yujyate' iti|| 4. ajādyataṣṭāp| (4.1.4) `ajādyatadantācca'iti| akārāntādityarthaḥ| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? acchabdāntāc śaraddaradityevamāderiti ? liṅgāt| kiṃ liṅgam ? `tadādyācikhyāsāyām' (2.4.21) `yakapūrvāyāḥ' (7.3.46) ityevamādinirdeśāt| svarūpagrahaṇe hi te nopapadyeran| `pakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ' iti| `ṅyāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) ityatrāsati hi pakāre'sya grahaṇaṃ na syāt| `ṭakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārthaḥ' (iti)| asati hi ṭakāre `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvaynubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.52) itiṭāpakasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na ḍāpcāpoḥ; dvayanubandhakatvāt| `śubhaṃyāḥ kīlālapāḥ' iti| `anyebhyotha'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) itivic| kiṃ punaḥ syāt, yadyatrāpi ṭāpsyāt ? ityāha-- `halṅyābhyaḥ' ityādi| `jātilakṣaṇe' iti| `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt' (4.1.63) iti| `puṃyogalakṣaṇe' iti| `puṃyogādākhyāyām' (4.1.48) iti| `puṣpaphalottarapadalakṣaṇe' iti| `pākakarṇaparṇapuṣpaphalamūlavālottarapadācca' (4.1.64) iti| `vayolakṣaṇe' iti| `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti| `ṭillakṣaṇe' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.42) iti| `śūdrā cāmahatvapūrvā' ityādi| nanu ca `āmanmahataḥ' (6.3.46) ityādināttvenātra bhavitavyam, ata evaṃ vaktavyam-- amahāpūrveti ? naitadasti; arthapradhānasya hi tadāttvamucyate, śabdapradhānaścāyam| mahacchabdaḥ pūrvo yasyāḥ sā mahatpūrveti| `mahatpūrvasya pratiṣedhaḥ' iti|ahamatpūrvetyasyārthamācaṣṭe| atrāpi jātiriti sambadhyate, jātivacanasya pratiṣedho yathā syāt| iha mā bhūt-- mahatī śūdrā mahāśūdreti| at hyuttarapadaṃ śūdraśabdo jātau varttate, na samudāyo mahatīśūdrārūpaḥ| kathaṃ punarjātirityucyamāne mahtpūrvasya prāptiḥ,yataḥ pratiṣedha ucyata ityāha-- `mahāśūdraśabdo hyābhīrajātivacanaḥ' iti| mahāśūdraśabdala eva hi samudāyo jātau varttate| ata eva mahāśūdrīti `jāterastrī' (4.1.63) ityādinā ṅībbhavati| nanvevamapi nāstyeva ṭāpaḥ prāptiḥ,śūdraśabdāddhi pratyaya utpadyamānaḥ kathaṃ mahāśūdrāt prāpnotītyata āha--`tatra tadantavidhirna' ityādi| `kathaṃ tadantavidhiḥ' iti| na kathañcit| grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhāditi (vyā.pa.89) manyate| `atidhīvarī ' iti| `atipīvarī' iti| dadhāteḥ pibateśca `āto maninvavaniṣvanipaśca' (3.2.74) iti kvanip, ītvaṃ ghumāsthādisūtreṇa (6.4.66)| dhīvānamatikrāntā, pīvānamatikrānteti `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| atra tadantavidhau jñāpite sati `vanorac' (4.1.7) iti ṅībrau na bhavataḥ| yadi punastadantavidhirna jñāpyeta tadā `vanaḥ' iti pratyayagrahaṇametat, tataśca pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya ca grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (pu.pa.vṛ.44) iti vacanādihaiva syātām-- `dhīvarī, pīvarīti; atidhīvarī, atipīvarītyatra tu na syātām| `atibhavatī'| atimahatī' iti| bhavatuśabdaḥ kevala ugit sarvādiṣu paṭhyate, mahaditi gaurādau, tatrāsatyasmiñjñāpake kevalābhyāmeva bhavanmahacchabdābhyāmugidgaurādilakṣaṇau ṅībṅīṣau syātām| atibhavatī, atimahatītyatra tu na syātām, jñāpake tu sati bhavataḥ| yadyevam, pañcānāmajānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcājīti dvigorapi tadantavidhinā ṭāp prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ajādibhiḥ striyāmiti viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ,`ajādyataḥ' (4.1.4) iti hi ṣaṣṭhī,tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ karttavyaḥ-- ajādīnāṃ yā strī, ajādiśabdānāṃ vācye'rthe yat strītvaṃ samavāyasambandhena varttamānam, tatra ṭābiti| na ca pañcājītyatrājāśabdasyārthe vācye strītvaṃ samavetam, kiṃ tarhi ? samāhāre vācye| `pūrvāpahāṇā| aparāpahāṇā| ṭit' iti| lyuḍantatvāt|kaka `prākpuṣpā' iti| prāñcantīti prāñci, `ṛtvigdadhṛk (3.2.59) ityādinā kvin| prāñci puṣpāni yasyāḥ sā prākpuṣpā|| 5. ṛnnebhyo ṅīp| (4.1.5) `ṅakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ' iti| asati hi tasmin `ṅyāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) ityatra ṅīti ṅīgṅīṣoreva grahaṇaṃ syāt| na ṅīpaḥ|| 6.ugitaśca| (4.1.6) `yathākathañcit' iti| yena kenacit prakāreṇa| yadi varṇa ugit sambhavati, yadi pratyayaḥ, athāpi prātipadikam, sarvarthā yatraiṣāmanyatamaḥ sambhavati tat `ugicchabdarupam‌' iti| anenogicchabdarūpasya viśeṣaṇaṃ na prātipadikasyeti darśayati| yadi prātipadikasyaiva viśeṣamaṃ syādihaiva syāt-- bhavatī, mahatīti; arvatītyatra tu na syāt, `arvaṇastrasāvanañaḥ' (6.4.127) iti nakārasya trādeśaḥ kṛta iti varṇa eva takāra ugit, na prātipadikam; gomatītyatra ca na syāt, atrāpi hi matuppratyaya evogit, na prātipadikam; tasmādugicchabdasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktamityabhiprāyaḥ| taccogicchabdarūpaṃ prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇam, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha-- `tadantāt' ityādi| yadi tarhyugicchabdarūpāntāt prātipadikānṅībbhavatyevaṃ sati bhavatīti na sidhyati, na hyatrogicchabdarūpāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ bhavati, bhavacchabdāntādugitaḥ prātipadikādanyasya tadantasyābhāvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyapadeśivadbhāvāt tadantādbhaviṣyati| nanu ca `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' (śāka.pa.65) iti vyapadeśidbhāvena nātra bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; na hyugiditi prātipadikagrahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? prātipadikāprātipadikagrahaṇam; varṇapratyayorapyugitorgrahaṇāt| `pacantī, yajantī' iti| śatrantānṅīp| `dhātorugitaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| pratipādyata iti śeṣaḥ| `añcateścopasaṃkhyānam' iti| añcaterṅīppratyayasya pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredamubhayatra pratipādanam -- `pādo'nyatarasyām' (4.1.8) iti sūtre `anyatarasyām' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate, sa ca `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) `vano ra ca' (4.1.7) `pādo'nyatarasyām' (4.1.8) ityeṣāṃ trayāṇāmapi yogānāṃ śeṣaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca sā| tena prātipadikādugitacchabdarūpāntāddhātūgiccabdāntādañcatereva nityaṃ ṅībbhavati, tato'nyebhyastu na bhavatyeveti| anye tvanyathā pratipādanaṃ kurvanti-- ukhāsrat, parṇadhvaditi| kriyākārakasambandhamātraṃ vivakṣitam, na strītvamiti ṅībna bhavati| strīśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāttu strītvapratītirāpadyate| na ca `strīyām' (4.1.3) ityatra strīsāmānādhikaraṇyapakṣaḥ sthitaḥ| prācītyādiṣu tu strītvaṃ vivakṣitam, teneha bhavatīkāra iti| `ukhāsrat, parṇadhvat' iti| ukhena sraṃsate, parṇāni dhvaṃsata iti `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti kvip, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.137) ityukhasya dīrghatvam| prācīti prapūrvādañcateḥ kvin, `acaḥ' (6.4.138) ityakāralopa), `cau' (6.3.138) ityupasargasya dīrghatvam|| 7. vano ra ca| (4.1.7) `vanaḥ' iti kvanibvanipoḥ pratyayorgrahaṇam| atha `bana ṣaṇa sambhavaktau' (dhā.pā.463,464) `vanu yācane' (dhā.pā.1470) ityābhyāṃ `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti vici kṛte yadrūpaṃ vanniti niṣpadyate tatkasmānna gṛhyate yadi tābhyāṃ vij dṛśyeta sa tu na dṛśyate; anabhidhānāt| `śarvarī' iti| `śṝ haṃsāyām' (dhā.pā.1488), `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti vanip,guṇaḥ raparatvam| `paralokadṛśvarī' iti| dṛśastenaiva sūtreṇa (3.2.75) kvanip| `vanona haśaḥ' iti| kvaciditi śeṣaḥ| haśaḥ paro yo vanip haśantāddhātorvihitastadantāt prātipadikāt kvacinṅībrephaścāntādeśo na bhavati| `sahayudhvā' iti| `yudha samprahāre' (dhā.pā.1173), `dṛśeḥ kvanip' (3.2.94), `rājani yudhikṛñaḥ' (3.2.95), `sahe ca' (3.2.96) iti kvanip, `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7), `sarvanāmasthāne' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ, `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7)| kvacittu pratiṣedho na bhavatyeva-- śarvarīti, atar rephāddhaśaḥ paro vanip; avāvarīti, atrāpi haśantāddhātorvanibvihitaḥ, tathāpi pratiṣedho na bhavati| `oṇṛ apanayane' (dhā.pā.454), `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti vanip, `viḍ‌vanoranunāsikasyāt' (6.4.41) ityāttvam, avādeśaḥ| na ca vano na haśa ityeva {vaktavyaṃ karttavyam' iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ| } vaktavyam; yasmāt `pādo'nyatarasyām' (4.1.8) ityantarasyāṃgrahaṇamasyāpi yogasya śeṣaḥ| sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena yatra ṅībrephau neṣyete tatra na bhaviṣyataḥ|| 8.pādo'nyatarasyām| (4.1.8) `pāda iti kṛtasamāsāntaḥ pādaśabdo nirdiśyate' iti| atha `pada gatau' (dhā.pā.1169) ityasmāṇṇyantāt `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvipi kṛte yat pāditi rūpaṃ niṣpadyate rūpaṃ niṣpadyate tasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? vijñāyate yadi pādayateḥ kvib dṛśyet, sa tu na dṛśyate; anabhidhānāt| `dvipāt, dvipadī' iti| dvau pādādasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `pādasya lopaḥ' (5.4.138) ityanuvarttamāne `saṃkhyāsupūrvasya' (5.4.140) ityakāralopaḥ, `pādaḥ pat' (6.4.130) iti padbhāvaḥ|| 9. ṭābṛci| (4.1.9) `ṛcītyabhidheyanirdeśaḥ' iti| viṣayanirdeśāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| yadi hi viṣayanirdeśaḥ syāt, tata ṛci viṣaya ṛggranthe yaḥ pācchabdastadantāt prātipadikāṭṭābbhaviṣyatītyeṣo'rthaḥ syāt, tathā ca ṛgveda eva syāt, nānyatra| abhidheyanirdeśe tu sarvatra bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|| 10. na ṣaṭsvasrādibhyaḥ| (4.1.10) yo yataḥ prāpnoti sa sarvaḥ pratiṣidhyate' iti| ṅīpo'nantaratvāt tasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedha ityāśaṅkāyā nirāsārthamidamuktam| nanu cātra `ṭābṛci' (4.1.9) iti ṭābevānantaraḥ, tat kuto ṅīpo|nantaratvam ? asvaritatvāt| asya ṭāpo ṅīpa evānantaryaṃ yuktam| nanu ca ṣaṭsaṃjñāḥ saṃkhyāśabdāḥ, saṃkhyāśca bhedamātraṃ dravyasya pratyayāyanti, na strītvam, yā tu tasya strītvapratītiḥ sā śabdāntareṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyādbhavati, na ca strīsamānādhikaraṇapakṣaḥ `striyām' (4.1.3) iti sūtre sthitaḥ, tathā ca tebhyaḥ strīpratyayasya prāptireva nāstītyapārthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ? naitadasti; saṃkhyā hi guṇaḥ, `saṃkhyā parimāṇāni pṛthaktvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgau' iti vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ (1.1.6) guṇasūtre pāṭhāt| guṇavacanānāṃ cāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti, yathā--śuklā śāṭī, śuklaḥ kambalaḥ, śuklaṃ vastram; śuklaḥ śuklau śuklāḥ iti| tathā sati pratiṣedhe yathā śuklādiśabdebhyaḥ strīpratyayo bhavati tathā ṣaṭ‌saṃjñakebhyo'pīti syāt, yathā-- pañca brāhmaṇya iti| `ṣaḍbhyo luk' (7.1.22) iti jaso luk| `svasā' iti| `anaṅa sau' (7.1.93) pūrvavat `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) iti dīrghaḥ| tisṛcatasṛśabdāvapi svasrādiṣu paṭhyete, tayoḥ kimarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ ? yāvatā vibhaktau parataḥ `tricaturoḥ striyāṃ tisṛcatasṛ' (7.2.99) iti tisṛcatasṛbhyāṃ bhavitavyam, tatra yadi tāvṛkārāntalakṣamaṃ ṅīpaṃ prati nimittabhāvaṃ pratipadyeyātāṃ vibhakterānantaryaṃ tābhyāṃ vihanyeta, etacca `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya' (vyā.pa.12) ityuktam| tasmāt sannipātalakṣaṇaparibhāṣayaiva ṅībna bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ pratiṣedhena ? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati-- anityaiṣā paribhāṣeti| tena yā, seti siddhaṃ bhavati| atrāpi hi vibhaktau tyadādyatvamityakāraṣṭāpo nimittaṃ na syāt, ṭāpi hi sati vibhakterānantaryaṃ vihanyate| paribhāṣāyastvanityatvenaiva ṭābbhavati| `ṣaṭsaṃjñānām' ityādi| pañca brāhmaṇya ityādau `avantarasya vidhirbhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti ṅīpo'nantarasya pratiṣedhe kṛte `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nakāre lupte satyākārāntatāyāmupajātāyāṃ ṭābutpattiḥ kasmānna syāt ?syādeva, nimittasya savidhānāt| nalopasyāsiddhatvānna syāditi cet ? naitadasti; `nalopaḥ supsvarasaṃjñātugvidhiṣu kṛti' (8.2.2) iti parigaṇiteṣveva vidhiṣu nalopasyāsiddhatvamucyate| na ca ṭābvidhistatra parigaṇyate, tat kutastatra nalopasyāsiddhatvam ? ṭābvidhirapi tatra parigaṇyata eveti darśayannāha-- `pratyāhārāt' ityādi| cābiti cāpsambandhinaṃ pakāramupalakṣayati | tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- subiti| tatra na saptamībahuvacanasambandhinā supaḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāro gṛhyate,kiṃ tarhi ? `yaṅaścāp' (4.1.74) iti cāpsambandhinā| tasmāṭṭāpo vidhirapi subvidhireva; ṭāpo'pi pratyāhārāntarbhāvāt| tataśca ṭābvidhāvapi nalopasyāsiddhatvena bhavitavyamiti siddhaṃ sarvamiṣṭam| sidhyatyeva| `doṣastvittvave' iti| bahūni carmāṇyasyāṃ nagaryāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap, ṭāp, nalopaḥ| atredānīṃ `pratyayasthātkāt' (7.3.44) ityanenettvamiṣyate bahucarmiketi yathā syāt, tacca na prāpnoti, na hyatra kāt pūrvo'kāraḥ; siddhatvārthaṃ sarvavibhaktyantaḥ samāsa āśritaḥ| supo vidhiḥ subvidhiḥ, supivā vidhiḥ subvidhiriti| yadi ca ṭābapi sup syāt, tatastratrāpi paratrāvasthita ittvamucyata iti tadapi subvidhiḥ syāt-- supi vidhiriti kṛtvā| tatastasminnapi karttvye nalopasyāsiddhatvaṃ syāt, tavayuktaścāpā pratyāhāraḥ| `tasmānnobhau' iti| yasmādevaṃ cāpā saha pratyāhāre doṣastamādubhāvapi ṭābṅīpau na bhavata iti pratiṣiddhau| kathamiha hi striyāmityartho'pekṣate ? asminnarthe yaduktaṃ bhavatīti stryarthe cobhau ṅīpṭāpāvuktāvityubhāvapi bhavataḥ|| 11. manaḥ| (4.1.11) `vāmā,pāmā' iti| dadāteḥ pibateśca `āto maninkvanibvanipaśca' (3.2.74) iti manin, pūrvavat `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) dīrghaḥ| atha samīmā, sīmānau, sīmānaḥ; atimahimā, atimahimānau, atimahimāna ityatra kataṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, yāvatā mana ityarthavato mana etad‌grahaṇam| na ca yathā dāmā pāmetyatar manaḥ pratyayārthenārthavatvaṃ tathā sīmetyevamāda na kenacidarthenārthavattvam, tathā hi sīmāśabdastāvadavyutpannaṃ prātipadikam, tasyaiva cārthavattvam, na tadavayavabhūtasya manaḥ; atimahimetyatrāpi naiva mano'rthavattvam, tathā hi-- `mahato bhāvaḥ' ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ `pṛthvādibhya imanic' (5.1.122) iti mahchabdādimanijvihitaḥ, tatra cemanica evārthavattvam, na tadekadeśasya mana ityata āha-- `aninasmangrahaṇāni' ityādi| etadvākyaṃ paṭhatā vākyakāreṇa an, in,as, man-- ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇe'rthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣā (vyā.pa.1) na vyāpriyate| tenaiṣāmanarthakānāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati, ebhiścānarthakaiḥ sārthakaiśca tadantavidirbhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati, tataśca sīmā'timahimetyādāvapi pratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati|| 12. ano bahuvrīhiḥ| (4.1.12) `anupadhālopo bahuvrīhirihodāharaṇam' iti| kathaṃ punaretatlabhyate, yāvatā nātra viśeṣa upāta ityāha-- `upadhālopino hi' ityādi| yasmāt `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' (4.1.28) ityupadhālopino vikalpaṃ vakṣyati, tasmāt pāriśeṣyādanupadhālopo bahuvrīhirasyāvakāśa iti| tasya codāharaṇam-- `suparvā' ityādi| śobhanamasyāḥ parvaṃ śobhanaṃ carmāsyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| ayañca `na saṃyogādvamantāt' (6.4.1237) ityallopo na bhavati| `atirājī' iti| `atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā' (vā.91) iti `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti tatpuruṣo'yam|| 13. ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām| (4.1.13) ihānyatarasyāṃgrahamasya ḍāpaḥ mukte pakṣe pratiṣedho'pi yathā syādityetadvā prayojanaṃ syāt ? ḍāppratiṣedhābhyāṃ mukte pakṣe ṅībapi yathā syādityetadvā ? tatrādyaṃ tāvadayuktam;ḍābapi hyucyate, pratiṣedho'pi, tāvubhāvapi vacanasāmarthyādbhaviṣyataḥ| dvitīyamapyayuktam| anyatarasyāṃgrahamena hyanupadhālopino vā bahuvrīheḥ pakṣe ṅībvidhīyate ? upadhālopino vā ? tatra prathamastāvat pakṣo nopapadyate, yadi hyatrānupadhālopinaḥpakṣe ṅībvidhīyeta pratiṣedhavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; dvitīyo'pi nopapadyate, `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' (4.1.28) iti pratipadaṃ vikalpena ṅīpo vidhāsyamānatvāt| na ca tadanyatarasyāṃgrahamaṃ na kariṣyāma itīhānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ karttuṃ yuktam; taddhyavaśyameva karttavyam, upadhālopino hi ṅīpā mukte ḍāppratiṣedhau yathā syātām-- bahurājñyau, bahurājānau, bahurāje iti| itarathā hi ḍāppratiṣedhau suparvādiṣvanupadhālopiṣu sāvakāśau paratvānṅīpā bādhyeyātām| tasmādvakṣyamāṇamapyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ karttavyameveti tatsarvaṃ manasi kṛtvā''ha-- `anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kimartham' iti| nirarthakamiti bhāvaḥ| `bahuvrīhau'ityādi| `vano ra ca' (4.1.7) ityanena yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate tasyāpi bahuvrīhau vikalpo yathā syādityevamanarthakamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam| yadyatprāptaṃ tattadvikalpena pratyupasthāpayitavyam| ṅībrephāvaprāptau, `ano bahuvrīheḥ' (4.1.12) iti pratiṣedhāt| tasmāt tadvidhānārthamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| kathamanyatarasyāmiti ? yogavibhāgo'tra kriyate, tatra bahuvrīhigrahaṇamanuvarttate, `vano ra ca' (4.1.7) ityetacca maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena| tena vannantādbahuvrīheranyatarasyāṃ ṅībrephaścāntādeśo labhyata iti bahupīvā, bahudhīvā, bahupīvarī, bahudhīvarītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati| anye tvāhuḥ-- ubhābhyāṃgrahamasahitādanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇādvannantādbahuvrīherṅībrephau labhyete| `ubhābhyām' (4.1.13) itineyaṃ pañcamī, kaṃ tarhi ? tṛtīyā, vannante bahuvrīhau strītvamubhābhyāṃ ṅībrephābhyāṃ karaṇābhyāṃ prayoktrā pratyāyayitavyamiti| nanu ca mannantāt prātipadikādannantācca bahuvrīherḍābubhābhyāmityadubhābhyāṃgrahaṇasya prayojanam ? evaṃ manyate-- svaritatvādeva `ubhābhyāma' (4.1.13) iti vacanamantareṇāpyubhābhyāmeva pratyayo labhyata eveti|| 14. anupasarjanāt| (4.1.14) ihānupasarjanāditi vidhirvānenottaratra kriyate-- upasarjanādanyasmādanupasarjanānṅībādayo bhavantīti ? pratiṣedho vā-- upasarjanānna bhavatīti ? tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta `kukkuṭīpādaḥ' iti na sidhyet; pūrvapadasyopasarjanatvāt| upasarjanatvaṃ tvasya `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) iti samāsaśāstre prathamānirdeśāt| kukkuṭītyetadapi na sidhyet; pradhānaṃ hyanupasarjanam, na cātra jātiḥ pradhānam, apradhānāpekṣayā hi pradhānaṃ bhavati, na cātra kiñcidapradhānamasti yadapekṣayā jāteḥ prādhānyaṃ syāt| tasmādvidhipakṣo'yaṃ duṣṭa iti matvā pratiṣedhapakṣamāśrityāha -- `uttarasūtreṣūpasarjanapratiṣedhaṃ karoti' iti| `kurucarī' iti| kuruṣu caratīti `careṣṭaḥ' (3.2.16) iti ṭaḥ| `upapadamatiṅa' (2.2.19) iti tatpuruṣasamāsa ityasyottarapadapradhānatvādaprathamānirdiṣṭatvācca samāsaśāstre caraśabda ihopasarjanaṃ na bhavatīti| `bahukurucarā' iti| bahavaḥ kurucarā asyāmiti| asyānyapadārthapradhānatvāt prathamānirdiṣṭatvācca śāstre samāsapadānāmatrāvayava upasarjanam| `{jāteḥ iti ṅīṣ--kāśikā'} jāterṅīṣ' iti| `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt' (4.1.63) ityanena| `bahukukkuṭā' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| atrāpi pūrvavajjātiśabda upasarjanam| nanu ca bahukurucaretyatra samudāyaḥ striyāṃ varttate, nāvayavaḥ na ca samudāyaṣṭit, kiṃ tarhi ? avayavaḥ tatra ṭita ucyamāna īkāraḥ kena punaḥ samudāyādaṭitaḥ syāt ? bahukukkuṭetyatrāpi samudāyaḥ striyāṃ varttate, nāvayavaḥ| na ca samudāyo jātivacanaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ; avayavaḥ| tatra jātivācina ucyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ kenājātivācinaḥ samudāyāt syāt, yatpratiṣedhārthamidamucyata iti manyamāna āha-- `katham' ityādi| `tadantavidhinā' iti| parihāraḥ| tatraitat syāt-- `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate' (vyā.pa.89) iti, ata āha-- `jñāpitañca' ityādi| `śūdrā cāmahatpūrvā jātiḥ' ga.sū.40.4.1.4) ityatra mahatpūrvetyanenāsmin prakaraṇe tadantavidhiriti jñāpitametat| `tathā ca' iti| evaṃ satītyarthaḥ yasmāt pūrvaṃ tadantavidhiriha prakaraṇe'stīti jñāpitametat; anena ca sūtreṇopasarjanena tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate, nānupasarjanena, evañca sati pradhānena tadantavidhirbhavatyeva| tena kumbhakārī, nagarakārīti siddhaṃ bhavati| tatra hi kāraśabdo'ṇantaḥ pradhānam| tadantāt samāsāt `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) itīkāraḥ syādeva| nanu cāṇityatrāṇiti kṛd‌grahamam, tataśca `kṛd‌grahame gatikārakapūrvapadasyāpi grahaṇam' (vyā.pa.126) ityanayā paribhāṣayaiva kumbhakāraśabdāt kārāntādīkāraḥ sidhyati, tato nedaṃ tadantavidhijñāpanasya prayojanamityata āha-- `na ca' ityādi| kathaṃ na ? ityāha-- `taddhito'pyaṇasti' iti| tasyāpyatra grahaṇam, anyathā hyaupagavīti na sidhyet| tasmānnedaṃ kṛdgrahaṇam, kiṃ tarhi ? kṛdakṛdgrahaṇam| tatra yadi tadantavidhirna jñāpyate, tadāṇiti pratyayagrahaṇam, `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt sa vihitastadādestadantasya ca grahamaṃ bhavati' (pu.pa.vṛ.44) itīhaiva syāt-- aupagavīti, iha tu na syāt-- kumbhakārīti, atra hi dhātoraṇ vihitaḥ, tadantaśca striyāṃ na varttate; tāvanmātrasya kāraśabdasya prayogābhāvāt| yā vā strīyāṃ varttate sopapadam, na tasmāt pratyayo vihitaḥ| tadantavidhau tu jñāpite kāraśabdāntādapīkāraḥ sidhyati|| 15. ṭiḍraḍhāṇañdvayasajdaghnañmātractayapṭhakṭhañkañakvarapkhyunām| (4.1.15) `sarvatra' iti| strīprakaraṇe| nanu ca `patyurno yajñasaṃyoge' (4.1.33) `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) ityādau nānuvarttate, tasyāta ityasyāsambhavādviśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyata ityāha-- `tat sati' ityādi| yatra sambhavati tatra viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, yatra tu na sambhavati tatrottarārthamevānuvarttate| iha kasmānna bhavati-- `pacamānā' iti| sthānivadbhāvena śānacaṣṭittvamasti, atastadantādapi ṅīpā bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| `dvayanubandhakatvāllaṭaḥ' iti| tena `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.52) ityetayā paribhāṣayā laṭo'tra grahaṇaṃ nāstīti darśayati, tasya hyakāro dvitīyo'nubandho'sti| `lyuḍādiṣu katham' iti| īkāro bhavatīti śeṣaḥ| ādiśabdena `gāpoṣṭak' (3.2.8) ityevamādayo gṛhyante| lyuḍādīnāmapi dvyanubandhakatvāṭṭidgrahaṇena bhavitavyam, atastadantebhyo ṅībna syāt, tataścaka karaṇī, sāmagītyādi na sidhyet| `ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāt' iti| yadi teṣāmapi ṭid‌grahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na syāṭṭitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt; prayojanāntarāsambhavāt| tasmāt satyapi dvyanubandhakatve ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāllyuḍādayo gṛhyanta ityadoṣaḥ| laṭo'pi tarhi ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva grahaṇena bhavitavyamityata āha--`itaratra' iti| laṭi hi ṭitkaramasya `ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere' (3.4.79) iti ṭeretvaṃ phalam| ato yadyapi grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi naiva ṭitkaraṇasya vaiyarthyaṃ prasajyeta| tasmāt ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyāllyuḍādayo gṛhyanta ityadoṣaḥ| laṭo'pi tarhi ṭitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva grahanena bhavitavyamityata āha--`itaratra' iti| laṭi hi ṭitkaraṇasya `ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere' (3.4.79) iti ṭeretvaṃ phalam| ato yadyapi tasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi naiva ṭitkaraṇasya vaiyarthyaṃ prasajyeta| tasmāt ṭitkaraṇasya caritārthatvādayuktaṃ tasyedaṃ grahaṇam| `paṭhitā vidyā' iti| atrāpi kathamiti sambadhyate| iḍāgamasya hi pratyayabhaktatvāt pratyayasya ṭittvamasti, tatasca ṅīpā bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ paṭhitetyetadrūpaṃ bhavatīti ?`āgamaṭittvamanimittam' iti| prakṛtatvāt ṅīpa iti vijñāyate| kathaṃ jñāyate'yamanimittamityāha--`ṭyuṭyulau' ityādi| tuḍ vetyāgamaṭittvenaiva siddhe ṅīpi `sāyaṃciraṃ prāhṇa' (4.3.23) ityādisūtre `ṭyuṭyulau' iti punaḥ pratyayoṣṭatkaraṇaṃ jñāpakam-- āgamaṭittvamanimittvaṃ ṅīpa iti| `soparṇeyī,vainateyī' iti| suparṇīśabdājjātilakṣamaṅīṣantādvinatāśabdācca ṭābantāt `strībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) iti ḍhak| āyamannādi (7.1.2) sūtreṇaiyādeśaḥ| nanu ca `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti ḍhako grahaṇena na bhavitavyamityata āha-- `niranubandhako ḍhaśabdaḥ' ityādi| nanu cāyaṃ niranubandhako'sti `śilāyāḥ ḍhaḥ' (5.3.102) iti ? naitadasti; svabhāvata eva hyayaṃ napusaṃke varttate| ayaṃ tarhyasti svābhāvyāt-- `{sabhāyā ḍhaśchandasi iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} sabhāyā yaḥ' (4.4.105) `ḍhaśchandasi' (4.4.106) iti ? ayamapi naiva striyāṃ varttate, chandasi sabheyīśabdasya prayogādarśanāt| tasmānnaranubandhako ḍhaśabda striyāṃ nāstīti neha niranubandhakaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate; anyathā hi ḍhagrahamamanarthakaṃ syāt| `ṇe'pi' iti| aṇi yat kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ taṇṇe'pi kvaciditi kvacinna bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| kva punarṇe'pyaṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti ? tācchīlike | tathā hi `kārmastācchīlye' (6.4.172) ityatra jñāpitametat- ṇe'pyaṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti, katham ? kārmaśabdo hi tācchīlye ṭilopārthaṃ nipātyate| yadi na ṇe'pyaṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ na syāt nipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt| karmaśabdāt karma śīlamasyeti `chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ' (4.4.62) iti ṇe kṛte `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) ityevaṃ ṭilopasya siddhatvāt| `an' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāvānna sidhyatīti cet ? naitadasti; aṇi hi prakṛtibhāva ucyate, tatra `inaṇyanapatye' (6.4.64) ityato'ṇītyanuvarttate| tadevaṃ `tācchīlike ṇe'pyaṇi kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati' ityasyārthasya jñāpitatvāt tatraivāṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati, nānyatra| ` caurī, tāpasī' iti| curā śīlamasyāstapaḥ śīlamasyā iti `chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ' (4.4.62) ṇe'pyaṇkṛtaṃ bhavatīti ṅīp| `dāṇḍā mauṣṭā' iti| daṇḍaḥ praharaṇasyām, muṣṭiḥ praharaṇasyāṃ krīḍāyāmiti `tadasyāṃ praharaṇam' (4.2.57) iti krīḍāyāṃ ṇaḥ| athāṇityakārādārabhya laṇo ṇakārāt pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? ṭibādīnāṃ punargrahaṇāt| pratyāhāragrahaṇe hi teṣāṃ grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, aṇantādeva siddhatvāt| `autsī, audapānī' iti| utsasyodapānasyeyamiti `utsādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.86) ityañ| atha `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn' (4.1.73) ityatra punarañgrahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃ kriyate, .yāvatānenaiva siddham, tadeva hi rūpaṃ sa eva hi svaraḥ, tathā hi-- ṅīni sati `ñnityādirnityam' (6.1.197) ityādyudāttaṃ bhavati,autsītyatrāpyutsaśabdādañantānñitsvareṇādyudāttānṅīpi kṛte tadevādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati ? ityāha-- `śārṅgarvādyañaḥ' ityādi| bidasyāpatyaṃ gotraṃ strīti `anṛṣyānantaryye bidādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.104) ityañi kṛte tasya `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha' (kā.vṛ.4.1.63) iti jātitvāt `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt' (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣ prāpnoti| tadbādhānārthaṃ punaḥ `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn' (4.1.73) ityatrāño grahamaṃ kriyate| yadyevam, ihāñgrahamaṃ na karttavyam, tenaivotsītyāderapi siddhatvāt ? naitadasti; jātigrahaṇaṃ tatra `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) ityato'nuvarttate `puṃyogādākhyāyām' (4.1.48) ityādināñ baidaḥ, tasya bhāryā baidīti, tasya puṃyoga ṅīṣeveṣyate, tasmāt tatra jātigrahaṇamanuvarttanīyam| tasmiṃścānuvarttamāna autsītyatrotsasyeyamityarthavivakṣāyāmañi kṛte'jātitvādīkārastatra na prāpnoti,tasmādihāpyañgrahaṇaṃ karttavyameva| dvayasajādīnāmanubandhoccāraṇaṃ pratyayaparigrahārtham| prātipadikānyapi dvyasajādīni santi, tatrāsatyanubandhoccāraṇe teṣāmapi grahaṇaṃ vijñāyeta| tayaśabdo'pi `aya vaya taya {ṇaya-dhā.pā.} naya gatau' (dhā.pā.474,485,479,480) iti tayo dhātorajantaṃ prātipadikaṃ sambhavati, atastannivṛttyrathaṃ pakāroccāraṇam| `ūrudvayasī' ityādi| ūrupramāṇamasyāḥ, jānupramāṇasyā iti `pramāṇe dvayasajdaghnañmātracaḥ' (5.2.37) iti dvayasajādayaḥ pratyayāḥ| `pañcatayī' iti|pañcāvayavā asyā iti `saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap' (5.2.42)| `ākṣikī, śālākikī' iti| akṣairdīvyati śalākābhirdīvyatīti `tena dīvyatikhanati' (4.4.2) ityādinā ṭhak, ṭhasyekādeśaḥ| `lāvaṇikī' iti| lavaṇaṃ paṇyamasyā iti `lavaṇāṭṭhañ' (4.4.52)| atha kimarthaṃ ṭhakṭhañaurbhedenopādānām ? na viśeṣakarānubandhānutsṛjya `ṭha'iti sāmānyenaiva grahaṇaṃ kriyetetyata āha-- `bhedena' ityādi| `ṭha' iti sāmānyena grahaṇe sati ṭhanādīnāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt, atastannivṛttyai bhedena grahaṇam| ādiśabdo ñiṭhādīnāṃ parigrahāya, tena daṇḍo'syāstīti `ata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) iti ṭhani kṛte daṇḍikīti na bhavati, kāśiṣu bhaveti `kāśyādibhyaṣṭhāññiṭhau' (4.2.116) iti ñiṭhe pratyaye kṛte kāśikīti na bhavati| kañonubandhagrahaṇaṃ `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) ityevādīnāṃ nivṛttyartham| `yādṛśī, tādṛśī' iti| `tyadādiṣu dṛśeranālocane kañca' (3.2.60) iti kañ, `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) iti yattadorāttvam| kvarapo'nubandhoccāraṇaṃ `stheśabhāsa' (3.2.175) ityādinā vihitasya varaco nivṛtyartham| yadyevam, eka evānubandha uccāraṇīyaḥ, ekenāpi varaco nivṛttiḥ sidhyatyeva ? satyametat, tathāpi mandabuddhīnāṃ sukhapratipattaye'nubandhadvayoccāraṇam| `itvarī, naśvarī'iti| `iṇnaśjasarttibhya- kvarap' (3.2.163) hrasvasya tuk| khyuno'nubandhoccāraṇaṃ lāghavārtham; anayathā hi ṣaṣṭhībahuvacane kṛte nuṭi nāmi dīrghatve ca guruccāraṇaṃ syāt| `āḍhyaṅkaraṇī' iti| anāḍhya āḍhyaḥ kriyate'nayeti `āḍhyasubhaga' (3.2.56) ityādinā khyun, `arurdviṣadajantadasya mum' (6.3.67)| nañsnañīkak' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamucyārthaḥ, tena nañādibhyo'pi bhaviṣyatīti| `straiṇī,pausnī' iti| striyā iyam, puṃsa iyamiti `strīpuṃsābhyāṃ naṅasnañau bhavanāt' (4.1.87) iti nañsañau| `śāktīkī, yāṣṭīkī' iti| śaktiḥ praharaṇamasyākṣitam| taruṇī surā,talunī sureti-- atra surādau viṣaye taruṇatalunaśabdābhyāṃ ṅībveditavyaḥ, na hi surādīnāṃ vayo'sti,tasya prāṇidharmatvāt| abhinatvamātraṃ surādīnāṃ taruṇatalunaśabdābhyāṃ gamyate| yadā tu vayo vivakṣyate tadā gaurādipāṭhānṅīṣā bhavitavyam| tatra svare viśeṣaḥ-- taruṇatalunaśabdau hi `{kṝvṛdāribhya unan' (da.u.5.52) `tro raśca lo vā' (da.u.5.56) ityunanapratyayāntau vyutpāditau,ato nitsvareṇādyudāttau| tatra ṅīpi satyādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati; ṅīṣi tu sati pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvam|| 16. yañaśca| (4.1.16) `gārgī| vātsī' iti| gargavatsaśabdābhyāṃ striyāmapatye `gargādibhyo yañ' (4.1.105) iti yañ, ṅīp, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakārasya lopaḥ, `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) iti yakārasya ca| `apatyagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam' iti| apatyaṃ gṛhyate yena tadapatyagrahamam| vyākhyānametaduktaṃ bhavati-- tathā vyākhyānaṃ karttavyaṃ yathā yaño viśeṣaṇamapatyaṃ gṛhyet| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- uttarasūtre vikalpārthaṃ prācāmiti vacanamanenāpi yogena sambadhyate,vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca sā vijñāyate, tenāpatye'rthe yo yañ vihitastadantānnityaṃ bhavati, yastu dvīpaśabdājjātādāvarthe vihitadantānna bhavatīti| atha yogavibhāgaḥ kimarthaḥ ? na pūrvasūtra eva añgrahaṇaṃ kriyetetyata āha-- `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttarasūtre yañantādeva ṣpho yathā syāt, ṭidādibhyo mābhūditi|| 17. prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ| (4.1.17) `ṣakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ' iti| `ṣid‌gaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīpyathā syāt| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi ṣakāre naiva ṅīṣā bhavitavyam, ṣphapratyayenaiva strītvasyābhivyaktatvādityata' āha-- `pratyayadvayena' ityādi| na hi kevalaḥ ṣphaḥ strītvamabhivyaṅktuṃ samartha iti ṅīṣamapekṣate| tena sahitābhyāmeva tābhyāṃ strītvaṃ vyajyata iti ṅīṣā bhavitavyam| `taddhitagrahaṇam' ityādi| `kṛttaddhitasamāsaśca' (1.2.46) iti prātipadikasaṃjñā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇam| prātipadikasaṃjñā tu ṅīṣ yathā syādityevamartham| nanu ca vināpi tayā ṣitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva ṅīṣ bhaviṣyati, anyathā hi ṣitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syat, prayojanantarābhāvāt; na ca `trapūṣ lajjāyām' (dhā.pā.374) ityato'pi dhātoḥ syādityatiprasaṅga āśaṅkanīyaḥ, dhātoḥ ṣitkaraṇasya `ṣidbhidādibhyo'ṅa' (3.3.104) ityaṅavidhau caritārthatvāt, ata iti cādhikārāt ? satyametat, pratipattigauravaṃ tu syāt| tasmāt sukhapratipattaye taddhitagrahamam| `sarvatragrahaṇam' ityādi| uttarasūtre sarvatragrahaṇamanarthakam| taddhi sarveṣāmacāryāṇāṃ matena yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate, etaccāprayojanam, asvaritatvadeva hi prāggrahaṇasya sarveṣāṃ matena bhavitavyam| tasmāduttarasūtre sarvatragrahaṇamanarthakam, atastadihāpakṛṣyate| kimarthamityāha-- `bādhakabādhanārtham' iti| `āvaṭyāccāpaṃ vakṣyati' ityādanā bādhakabādhanārthamityasyaivārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti|avaṭyāccāpo'vakāśaḥ-- udīcāṃ matena āvaṭyeti, ghavaṭaśabdād gargādiñantāccāp, `prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ' (4.1.17) ityasyāvakāśaḥ-- gārgyāyaṇīti; āvaṭyāt prācānubhayaprasaṅge paratvāccāp syāt. sarvatragrahaṇāt ṣpha eva bhaviṣyati-- āvaṭyāyanīti|| 18. sarvatra lohitādikatantebhyaḥ| (4.1.18) `svatantram' iti| yo hyanyasyāvayavabhūto na bhavati kevalaḥ kataśabdastat svatantraṃ prātipadikam| yastu kurukataśabdasyāvayavaḥ kataśabdastasya svāntantryaṃ nāsti; samudāyapratibaddhatvāt| kaḥ punarasau kataśabdaḥ svatantraṃ prātipadikamityata āha-- `kapiśabdāt' ityādi| `lauhityāyanī' | śāṃsityāyanī' iti| lohitaśaṃsitaśabdābhyāṃ gargāditvādyañ| `vābhravyāyaṇī' iti| atrāpi babhruśabdāt `madhubabhruvorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ' (4.1.106) iti yañ `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146), `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) iti vāntādeśaḥ, yañantebhyaḥ ṣphaḥ| `kaṇvāttu'ityādi| kaṇvaśabdāt pūrvaḥ śakalaśabda iṣyate, kataśabdāttūttaraḥ| kimevaṃ sati bhavatītyāha-- `pūrvottaro'ityādi| evaṃ sati pūrvottaro gaṇau tadantādī bhavataḥ| tacchabdena śakalaśabdaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| śakalaśabdo'nta ādiśca yathākramaṃ yayoḥ pūrvottarayorgaṇayostau tadantādī pūrvottaragaṇau| lohitādiḥ śakalaśabdānto bhavati pūrvo yathaḥ| uttara gaṇaḥ kaṇvādiḥ śakalaśabdādirbhavati| kiṃ punaḥ pūrvottarayorgaṇayostadantāditve prayojanamityāha--`ṣphāṇau tatra prayojanam' iti| pūrvasya gaṇasyaśakalāntatve ṣphaḥ prayojanam| uttarasya śakalāditve'ṇ prayojanam| `prātipadikeṣvanyathā pāṭhaḥ'iti| kapikata, kurukata, anaḍuh, kaṇva, śakala -- ityanayā'nupūrvyā prātipadikeṣu pāṭhaḥ| `sa evaṃ vyavasthāpayitavyaḥ' iti| kaṇvāttu śakalaḥ pūrvaḥ'ityādinā yā''nuparvī darśitā tayā vyavasthāpayitavyaḥ| ata etaduktaṃ bhavati-- kurukata, anaḍuh-- ityetāvanyasmin sthāne paṭhitavyau, śakalaśabdastu katakaṇvaśabdayormadhye paṭhitavyaḥ| `manyate' iti ślovārttikāraḥ| kathaṃ punarevaṃ pāṭhe sati śakalaśabdāt ṣphāṇau sidhyata āha-- `katantebhyaḥ' ityādi| katasyāntaḥ katanta iti tatpuruṣaḥ `katantebhyaḥ'iti nipātanātpararūpatvam| kataśabdo'nte yeṣāṃ lohitādīnāṃ te katantā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| katantaśca śakalaśabdaḥ, katantāśca lohitādaya iti katantaśca katantāśceti sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ| `tathā' ityādinā yathā katantebhya ityatra bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayorekaśeṣaḥ, tathā kaṇvādibhya ityatrāpīti darśayati| kaṇvasyādiḥ kaṇvādiḥ śakalaśabdaḥ kaṇvaśabdaḥ ādiryeṣāṃ gokakṣādīnāṃ te kaṇvādayaḥ, kaṇvādiśca kaṇvādayaśca kaṇvādayaḥ, pūrvavadekaśeṣaḥ| `tatpuruṣavṛttyāsaṃgṛhītaḥ'iti| `katantebhyaḥ' ityatra `kaṇvādibyaḥ' (4.2.111) ityatra tatpuruṣavṛttyā tatpuruṣasamāsena| `madhyāpīta' iti| katakaṇvaśabdayorgaṇayorvā| `pratyayadvayam' iti| ṣphapratyayam, aṇpratyayañca| `pratipadyate' iti| prāpnoti| tatpuruṣavṛttyāhi tasya saṃgrahe satyasya sūtrasyāyamartho jāyate-- katantācchakalaśabdāt tathā yañantāt katantebhyaśca lohitādibhyo yañantebhyaḥ striyāṃ ṣphapratyayo bhavatīti| tena ṣphapratyayaṃ pratipadyate śakalaśabdaḥ| `śākalyāyanī' iti| `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) ityatrāpi tatpuruṣavṛttyā śakalaśabdasya saṃgrahe satyayamartho bhavati| kaṇvādeḥ śakalaśabdāntādgotrapratyayāntāt kaṇvādibhyo gokakṣāntebhyo gotrapratyayāntebhyaḥ śaiṣikeṣvartheṣvaṇpratyayo bhavatīti| tenāṇpratyayamapi śakalaśabdaḥ pratipadyate-- śākalyasyeme chātrāḥ śākalā iti|| 19. kauravyamāṇḍūkābhyāñca| (4.1.19) `kathaṃ kauravī'iti| kauravyaśabdādevātra hībvihita iti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| kuruśabdādevātrāṇantānṅībvihita iti darśayannāha--`tasyedam' ityādi| `kauravyamāṇḍūkayoḥ' ityādi| kauravyamāṇḍūkayoranena sūtreṇa yatkāryaṃ vidhīyate tasyāsurerapyupasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| āsurerapi ṣphaḥ pratipādayitavya iti yāvat| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- cakāro'tra kriyate,sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ tenāsuriśabdādapi ṣpho bhaviṣyatīti| `āsurāyaṇī'iti| asurasyāpatyamiti `ata iñ' (4.1.95) , tadantāt ṣphaḥ| `iñaścetyaṇi prāpte' iti| tatra `prasthottarapadapaladyādikopadādaṇ' (4.2.110) neti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, tenāsuriśabdādapi pratiṣiddhe `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti cha eva bhaviṣyati-- āsuriṇā prokta āsurīyaḥ kalpa iti|| 20. vayasi prathame| (4.1.20) `yauvanādiḥ' iti| ādiśabdo vṛddhatvādyupasaṃgrahārthaṃ iti| `śrutyā varttate' iti| yat prātipadikaṃ śravaṇamātreṇaiva prakaraṇādyanapekṣaṃ prathamaṃ vayaḥ pratyāyayati tadatra śrutyā varttate| `kumārī' iti| nanu ca nāyaṃ kumārīśabdaḥ prathame vayasi varttate, kva tarhi ? puṃyogābhāve, tathā hi vṛddhāyāmapi hi prayujyate-- vṛddhā kumārīti ? naitadasti;kumārīśabdo hi prathama eva vayasi rūḍhaḥ| yastu vṛddhāyāmapi tasya prayogastatra kumārīsādharmyāt, na tu puṃyogābhāvāt| bhavati hi tāddharmyāt tācchabdyam, yathā --ṛ- gaurvāhīka iti| `vayasyacarame' iti| acarame - anantye ṅībbhavatītyetadartharūpamasya sūtrasya vyākhyānamityarthaḥ| tetredaṃ vyākhyānam-- prathamavayograhaṇamihācaramasya vayasa upalakṣaṇam, tenānyatrāpyacarame vayasi ṅībbhavatīti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ prathama eva vayasi gṛhyamāṇe na sidhyati, yenaivaṃ sūtrārtho vyākhyeyaḥ ? ityāha-- `dvitīyavayovacanāvetau' ityādi| iha keciccatvāri vayāṃsīcchanti --kaumāra yauvana madhyatva vṛddhatvāni| tathā cāhuḥ-- `prathame vayasi nādhītaṃ dvitīye nārjitaṃ dhanam| tṛtīye na tapastaptaṃ caturthaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati|| iti| anye trīṇīcchanti--kaumārayauvanasthāvirāṇi| tathā cāhuḥ-- pitā rakṣatikaumāre bharttā rakṣati yauvane, putrastu sthāvire bhāve na strī svātantryamarhati||iti| kecidbālyamadhyatvavṛddhatvānīti trīṇīcchanti|tathā cāhuḥ-- āṣoḍaśādbhavedbālo yāvat kṣīrānnavarttakaḥ| madhyamaḥ saptatiryāvat parato vṛddha ucyate|| iti| eteṣu sarveṣu yauvanaṃ dvitīyaṃ vayo bhavati| nanu prathamavayovacanau tu vadhūṭīciraṇṭīśabdāvityato na prāpnoti, tasmādacaramasya vayasa ihopalakṣaṇaṃ prathamaṃ vaya iti vyākhyeyamiti kecit| yastu manyate `kecittu dve eva vayasī icchantīti, yāvatyo buddhimatyo'vasthāstāḥ sarvā rāśīkṛtya prathamaṃ vayo vyavasthāpyate, yāstvapacayavatyo'vasthāstāḥ sarvā rāśīkṛtya dvitīyaṃ vayaḥ| tathā coktam-- `varddhate yāvadannena tāvadvardhitavyaṃ paścadapāyena yokṣyate'iti,etadeva darśanamāśrityaitat sūtraṃ praṇītam| iti| tena vadhūṭī, ciraṇṭītyatrāpi ṅībbhavatīti tena dvitīyavayovacanāvetau| prāptayauvanā stryabhidhīyata ityasya granthasyāvirodhāya yatitavyam| na hyasmindarśane yauvanaṃ dvitīye vayasyantarbhavati;yauvanāvasthā vṛddhimatītvāt| atha kathamuttānaśayālohitapādiketi, yāvatā bālyamatra gamyate, bālaiva hyuttānaśayā lohitapādikā bhavati, tasmādbhavitavyameva ṅīpetyata āha-- `naitā vayaḥ śrutayaḥ' iti| naite vayovacanāḥ śabdā ityarthaḥ| iha tāvaduttānaśayeti prātipadikaśravaṇamātreṇa kriyākārakasambandhamātraṃ pratīyate-- uttānā śeta ityuttānaśayā| `harateranudyamane'c' (3.2.9) ityato'jgrahaṇe'nuvarttamāne `adhikaraṇe śeteḥ' (3.2.15) ityatrottānādiṣu karttuṣvityupasaṃkhyānādac,`striyāḥ puṃvat'(6.3.34) iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| sarvaivottānā śete, ucyate cedamuttānaśayeti;tatra niyamo gamyate| anyathā śāyitumasāmarthyāduttānaiva yā sete sottānaśayeti gamyeti| avagate'pyasminniyame sandeha eva-- kimasau bālā ? vṛddhā vā ? iti| vṛddhā'pi hi kadācidanyathā śayitumaśaktā syāt, uttānaiva ca śete| tasmādyadottānaiva śeta iti niyamapratītirbhavati, vṛddhatvābhāvaśca kutaścitaprakaraṇāderavasito bhavati, tadā bālyaṃ gamyate| `lohitapādikā'iti| atrāpi lohitau pādāvasyā ityanyapadārthamātraṃ tāvat tacchabdāt pratīyate| yadā tu prakaraṇādinā svabhāvata evāsyā raktau pādau nālaktakarasādineti pratītirbhavati tadā bāleti gamyate| itiśabdaḥ prakārārthaḥ| evamprakārā naitā vayaḥ śrutaya ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ bālā, vatseti ? ajāditvāṭṭābbhaviṣyati| nanu vacanasāmarthyādanena ṅībapi prāpnoti ? naitadasti;tasyānyatra kumārī, kiśorītyādau caritārthatvāt|| 21. dvigoḥ| (4.1.21) `pañcapūlī' iti| pañcānāṃ pūlānāṃ samāhāra iti| `taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti samāhāradviguḥ| `akārāntodattarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' (vā. 156) iti strīliṅgatā| `triphalā' iti| trayāṇāṃ phalānāṃ samāhāra iti| pūrvavad dviguḥ|| 22. aparimāṇavistācitakambalyebhyo na taddhitaluki| (4.1.22) `taddhitaluki sati'iti| etena `taddhitaluki' ityeṣā viṣayasaptamīti darśayati| parasaptamītyeṣānopapadyate;luko'bhāvarūpatvāt, abhāve ca paurvāparyābhāvāt| `sarvato mānaṃ parimāṇam' iti| pariśabdaḥ sarvato bhāve| sarvata ārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca mīyate - paricchadyate yena tatparimāṇam- prasthādiḥ| `pañcāśvā' iti| taddhitārthe dviguḥ, `tena krītam' (5.1.37) ityārhīyaṣṭhak, `adhyarthapūrvāddvigorluk'(5.1.28) | `kālaḥ saṃkhyā ca na parimāṇam' iti| na hi tābhyāmārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca mīyate| jñāpakācca na tayoḥ parimāṇatvamavasīyate| yadayaṃ `parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' (7.3.17) iti siddhāyāmuttarapadavṛddhau `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca'(7.3.15) iti saṃkhyāsaṃvatsaragrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--kālaḥ saṃkhyā ca na parimāṇaṃ bhavatīti| vistādi ca parimāṇaviśeṣa eva grahītavyaḥ| ato vṛttigranthaḥ-- parimāṇārthaṃ grahaṇamiti | kāṇḍasya vā parimāṇatve tūttarasūtreṇa niyamārthatā na virudhyate| yadyevaṃ `kālāḥ parimāṇinā' (2.2.5) ityatra sāmarthyāt parimāṇavacanāḥ kālaśabdāḥ samasyanta iti yaduktaṃ tadvirudhyate ? nāsti virodhaḥ; upacāreṇa tathānyatra parimāṇivācinā subantenābhidhānāt| iha hi mukhyaṃ kālasya parimāṇatve niṣidhyate| tatra hyaupacārikaṃ kālasya parimāṇatvamāśritya parimāṇavacanāḥ kālaśabdā ityuktam-- kālāḥ parimāṇaneti bruvatā| parimāṇavacanatvaṃ kālaśabdānāmupayuktaṃ bhavati,na hi tena vinā parimāṇāpekṣayottarapadasya parimāṇivyapadeśa upapadyate| na ca kālasya mukhyaṃ parimāṇatvamasti| ataḥ sāmarthyādaupacārikaṃ parimāṇatvamāśritamiti gamyate| upacārasya hetuḥ paricchedasya hetutvamātram, parimāṇasya sādharmyam| kālo hi māsādirjātādisamabandhinīmādityagatiṃ gamayatīti bhavati paricchedasya hetuḥ| ataḥ parimāṇasādharmyādupapadyate, tatra ca parimāṇopacāraḥ| `dvivarṣā, trivirṣā' iti| dve varṣe bhūteti `samadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhāvī' (5.1.80) ityanena vihitasya ṭhakaḥ `varṣālluk' (5.1.88)iti luk pākṣikaḥ| cittavattve tu pratyayārthasya vivakṣite `cittavati nityam' (5.1.89) iti nityameva luk| dve varṣe pramāṇamasyā iti `pramāṇe lo dvigornityam' (vā.558,559) iti nityameva luk| `dviśatā, triśatā' iti| dvābhyāṃ śatābhyāṃ krīteti `paṇapādamāṣasaśatādyat' 5.1.34) iti yati prāpte `śāṇādvā' (5.1.35) ityatropasaṃkhyānam-- `śatācceti vaktavyam'(vā. 510) iti| tena śatasaśabdāt pakṣe `saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' (5.1.22) iti kan,tasya pūrvavalluk| `dvivistā'iti| dvau bistau pacati| `sambhavatyavaharati pacati' (5.1.52) ityanenārhīyaṣṭhak, tasya pūrvavalluk| dvāvācitau pacati `dvyācitā'| `āḍhakācitapātrātsakho'nyatarasyām' (5.1.53) iti varttamāne `dvigoḥ ṣṭhaṃśca' (5.1.54) iti ṣṭhan, tasya pūrvalluk| dvābhyāṃ kambalyābhyāṃ krītā `dvikambalyā'| `tena krītam' (5.1.37) iti ṭhak,tadvadeva| luk| `dvyāḍhakī' iti| dvāvāḍhakau pacati| `āḍhakācitapātrātkho'nyatarasyām' (5.1.53) iti varttamāne `dvigoḥ ṣṭhaṃśca' (5.1.54) itipakṣe ṣṭhan, tasyā luk| `pañcāśvī' iti| pūrvavat samāhāre dviguḥ| ihemau dvaupratiṣedhāvucyete, tatraikaḥ śakyamakarttum| katham ? evaṃ sūtranyāsaḥ kariṣyate-- parimāṇāntātaddhitalukīti| pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthametat-- parimāṇāntādeva taddhitaluki ṅībbhavati, nānyasmāt| tena dvyāḍhakītyādāveva bhavati, na pañcāśvetyādau;tato vistācitakambalyebhyo na taddhitalukītyanuvarttate,bistādibhyaḥ parimāṇebhyo'pi taddhitaluki ṅībna bhavatīti ? naivaṃ śakyam; viparīto'pi niyamaḥ sambhāvyeta--parimāṇāntāt taddhitalukyevana bhavati, nānyatreti| tataśca dvayoḥ kuḍavayoḥ samāhāro dvikuḍavīttra na syāt| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu|| 23. kāṇḍāntātkṣetre| (4.1.23) `niyamārtham' iti| kṣetra eva yathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā sāmarthyādeva tadantavidhirlabhyata eva, yathā-- pūrvasmin sūtre, na hi kevalasya kāṇḍaśabdasya kenaciddvigusaṃjñā vihitā ? satyametat, kintvasatyagrahaṇe kāṇaḍameva kṣetreṇa viśiṣyeta-- kāṇḍaśabda eva kevalo yaḥ kṣetre varttate iti, tataśceha pratiṣedhaḥ syāt-- dvābhyāṃ kāṇḍasaṃjñakābhyāṃ kṣetrābhyāṃ krītā dvikāṇḍī vaḍaveti| iha tu na syāt-- dve kāṇḍe pramāṇamasyāḥ kṣetrabhakteḥ dvikāṇḍā kṣetra bhaktiriti| antasūtre tu sati kāṇḍaśabdasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kṣetraṃ na bhavati; tasya dvigo guṇabhūtatvāt| 24. puruṣātpramāṇe'nyatarasyām| (4.1.24) `pramaṇe yaḥ puruṣaśabdo varttate'iti| jātivacano'pi puruṣaśabdaḥ, yadā pramāṇaśabdenābhisambadhyate tadā puruṣagate pramāṇe varttate| bhavati padāntarasambandhena śabdasyārthāntare vṛttiḥ, yathā-- siṃho māṇavaka iti| siṃhaśabdo jātivacano'pi māṇavakasānnidhyācchauryalakṣaṇaṃ guṇamācaṣṭe| `dvipuruṣī' iti| `pramāṇe dvayasac'(5.2.37) iti vihitasya dvayasacaḥ `pramāṇe lo dvigornityam'(vā. 558,559) iti luk| `aparimāṇāntatvāt pratiṣedha prāpte'iti| `aparimāṇavista' (4.1.22) ityādinā| `dvābhyāṃ puruṣābhyāṃ krītā dvipuruṣā' iti| pūrvavadārhīyasya ṭhako luk| `taddhitaluki' ityeva| `pañcapuruṣī' iti| pramāṇārthavṛttānāmeva samāhārānnāsti dvyaṅgavikalatā|| 25. bahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ| (4.1.25) `ūdhaso'naṅiti samāsānte kṛte' iti| akṛta eva samāse bahuvrīhyarthaṃ uttarapade pūrvaṃ samāsāntena bhavitavyamiti prāk tataḥ samāsānta eva bhavati, tato bahuvrīhiḥ tataḥ strīpratyayaḥ-- ityevaivānupūrvī|`ano bahuvrīheḥ' ityādi| itiśabda ādyarthe| `ano bahuvrīheḥ' (4.1.12) ityādinā śāstrāntareṇetyarthaḥ| tatra `ano bahuvrīheḥ' ityanena sūtreṇa pratiṣedhe prāpte `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' (4.1.13) ityanena ḍāp| `kuṇḍoghnī' iti| kuṇḍamivodho'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ,`allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopaḥ| `prāptodhāḥ' iti| `prāptāpanne ca dvitīyayā' (2.2.4) iti tatpuruṣaḥ, `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| `ana upadhālopinaḥ'ityādi| `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' (4.1.28) ityetenāpi vidhīyamānasya ṅīpo'yaṃ ṅībbādhaka iṣyate| kathaṃ punarihocyamānastasya bādhako bhavati ? uttarasūtrānuvṛtteḥ| asatyānuttaratrānuvṛttau `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante' (vyā.pa.10) ityevamayaṃ ṅībḍāppratiṣedhāveva bādhate, nopadhālopino ṅīṣam| tataśacopadhālopinaḥ paratvāt sa eva pakṣe bhavet| tasmāt `ana upadhālopinaḥ' (4.1.28) ityatrāsyānuvṛttiḥ karttavyāḥ| tenopadhālopino'pyūdhasantānṅīṣeva bhavati| `samāsāntaśca striyāmeva' iti| samāsāntavidheranityatvāt| anityatvaṃ tu punarūdhaḥśabdena sakārāntenāsamāsāntena viśeṣaṇādvijñāyate| yadi hi nityaḥ syāt `bahuvrīherūghnaḥ' iti nirdeśaḥ syāt|| 26.saṃkhyāvyayāderṅīp| (4.1.26) `dvyūghnī'ityādi| dve ūdhasī asyāḥ| trīṇyūdhāṃsyasyāḥ|abigatamūdho'syāḥ|nirgatamūdho'syā iti vigrahaḥ| `ādigrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| evaṃ manyate-- saṃkhyāvyayābhyāmityeva vaktavyam, `bahuvrīherūdhasaḥ' (4.1.25) iti hi varttate,, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate-- saṃkhyāvyayābhyāmuttaro ya ūdhaḥśabdastadantābahuvrīherṅībbhavatīti, tathā ca niṣpalamādigrahaṇam, vināpi tena siddhatvāditi| `dvividhoghnī' ityādi| yadyādigrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā `saṃkhyāvyayābhyām' iti pañcamīnirdeśāt saṃkhyāyā anantaro ya ūdhaḥśabdastadantādeva syāt| yatra tu vyavadhānaṃ tatra tu na syāt, ādigrahaṇāttu tatrāpi bhavati| dvividhamūdho yasyā iti vigrahaḥ| atrādigrahaṇe sati vidhaśabdena vyavadhāne'pi bhavati|| 27.dāmahāyanāntācca| (4.1.27) `ūdhasaḥ' iti nivṛttam,prakṛtyantaropādānāt| `saṃkhyāgrahaṇanuvarttate, nāvyayagrahaṇam' iti| saṃkhyāgrahaṇasyaiva svaritatvāt| `ḍāppratiṣedhavikalpeṣu prāpteṣu' iti| `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' (4.1.13) ityādinā ḍāpi prāpte `ano bahuvrīheḥ' (4.1.12) iti pratiṣedha `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyāmṭa (4.1.28) iti vikalpe ca| dve dāmanī asyā iti `dvidāmnī'| `dvau hāyanāvasyā iti `dvihāyanī'| `hāyano vayasi smṛtaḥ' iti| prakṛtiriti śeṣaḥ| kasya prakṛtiḥ ? ṅīpaḥ prakṛtatvāt tasyaiva| bahuvrīhyadhikārādatra hāyamānto bahuvrīhiriti gamyate| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- hāyamānto bahuvrīhirvayasi gamyamāne ṅīpaḥ prakṛtirācāryaiḥ smṛta iti| tena yadi vayo gamyate tato ṅībbhavati, nānyathā| etaccottarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasyobhayoryogayoḥ śeṣabhūtatvādvyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| atha tricaturbhyāṃ hāyanasyāpyupasaṃkhyānādyathā hi trihāyanī caturhāyaṇītyatra ṇatvaṃ bhavati; tathā trihāyanā śālā, caturhāyanā śāletyatrāpi kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha -- `ṇatvamapi' ityādi| tadapi hi ṇatvamaupasaṃkhyānikamācāryairvayasyeva smaryate| na ca śālāyā vayaḥ sambhavati, tasya prāṇidharmatvāditi neha ṇatvaṃ pravartate| antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| bahuvrīhyadhikārādeva hi sāmarthyāt tadantavidhirlabhyate; na hi kevalayordāmahāyanaśabdayorbahuvrīhisaṃjñā kenacidvihitā|| 28.ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām| (4.1.28) `upadhālopī'iti| upadhālopo yasya ṅīpi parataḥ sambhavati sa upadhālopī| `nanu' ityādi| `ano bahuvrīheḥ' (4.1.12) iti pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, `ḍābubhābhyāmamanyatarasyām' (4.1.13) iti ḍāp, anayatarasyāṃgrahaṇācca pakṣe ṅīp| yadi tarhi `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' ityanena ṅībapi vidhīyate, tadā dāmā pāmetyatrāpi syāt ? anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvānna bhaviṣyati| `anupadhālopinaḥ' ityādi| yadīdaṃ nocyeta, anupadhālopino'pi ṅīp syāt| tasmādupadhālopina eva ṅībyathā syāt, anupadhalopino mā bhūdityevamarthamidamucyate | `bahurājā' iti| ṅīppratiṣedhaḥ| `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti nopadhāyā dīrghaḥ| `bahurājñī' iti| ṅīp, `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134)| `bahurāje' iti| ḍāp, `auṅa āpaḥ' (7.1.18) iti śībhāvaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.97)| dvivacananirdeśo ḍāpo'bhivyaktaye| ekavacane hi ḍāppratiṣedhayorna kaścidviśeṣaḥ; ubhayatrāpi tulyarūpatvāt| kvacit `bahurājāḥ' iti bahuvacanena nirdeśaḥ, tasyāpi tedava prayojanam| `bahumatsyā' iti| `sūryātiṣyāgastyamastyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ' (6.4.149) iti lopavidhānādupadhālopītyeṣa bahuvrīhiḥ| `suparvā' iti| ayamupadhālopī na bhavati| `na saṃyogādvamantāt' (6.4.137) ityupadhālopapratiṣedhāt|| 29. nityaṃ saṃjñāchandasoḥ| (4.1.29) nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham| pūrvaṇaiva hi vikalpena ṅīp siddhaḥ, tadārambhasāmarthyādeva ṅībnityaṃ bhaviṣyati, anyathā hīdaṃ vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt|| 30. kevalamāmākabhāgadheyapāpāparasamānāryakṛtasumaṅgalabheṣajācca| (4.1.30) atha māmakagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā'smadaḥ `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇi kṛte `tavakamamakāvekavacane' (4.3.3) itimamakādeśena māmaka iti bhavati, tataśca `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) ityeva ṅīpsiddheḥ ? satyametat; niyamārthaṃ tu māmakaśabdasya grahaṇam; saṃjñācchandasoryathā syāt, anyatra mā bhūditi|| 31. rātreścājasau| (4.1.31) `ajasau' iti | viṣayasaptamīyam, na parasaptamī, kutaḥ ? strīpratyayasyāntaraṅgatvājjasaḥ paratvāvirodhādviṣayasaptamītve na doṣa ityāha-- `jasviṣayatvāt' ityādi| `ajasādiṣviti vaktavyam'iti|jāsādiviṣayādanyatra rātriśabdānṅībbhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- iha lāghavārthaṃ `ajasi' iti vaktavye'jasāvityuktam, mātrādhikyādarthādhikyasūcanārtham, tenājasādiṣu ṅībbhavatīti| ādiśabdenāmādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `katham' ityādi| `rātryaḥ' iti| rātriśabdasya jasantasya prayogaḥ| evaṃ hi `dīrghājjasi ca' (6.1.105) iti savarṇadīrghatve pratiṣiddhe yaṇādeśa upapadyate, nānyathā| yadi tu rātriśabdasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ syāt, tataḥ `jasi ca'(7.3.109) iti guṇe kṛte'yādeśe ca rātraya iti rūpaṃ syāt| īkārāntaśca rātriśabdo na sambhavati;ajasāviti ṅīppratiṣedhāt| tataśca rātrya iti prayogo nopapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `ṅīṣayam'ityādi| nanuca rātriśabdo bahvādiṣu paṭhyate, tatkathaṃ bahvādilakṣaṇastato ṅīṣbhaviṣyati ? ityata āha--`tatra hi' ityādi| `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ'iti| kṛta ikāraḥ kṛdikāraḥ,tadantānṅīṣ bhavati|`vṛdṛbhyāṃ vin' (da.u. 1.23) varvī, darvī| yastu ktinsambandhī tadantānna bhavati-- `striyāṃ ktin' (3.3.94) kṛtiḥ, hṛtiḥ| `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke' iti| eka ācāryā sarvato'ktinnarthāt kṛdikārādakṛdikārācca ṅīṣ bhavatītyāhuḥ, rājiḥ rājī| rājiśabdo'vyayutpattipakṣe kṛtikārānto na bhavati| aktinnarthāditi, na vidyate ktinnartho yasya so'ktinnarthaḥ, tasmāt sarvato ṅīṣ bhavati| yastu ktinnarthastadantānna bhavati-- kṛtiḥ hṛtiḥ| `ākrośe ऩñyaniḥ' (3.3.112) -- akaraṇiḥ, aharaṇiḥ| rātriśabdaścāyaṃ vyutpattipakṣe kṛdikārānto bhavati, `rā ādāne' (dhā.pā.1057), `rāśadibhyāṃ trip' (da.u.1.36) rātriḥ, tasmāt pakṣe ṅīṣ rātrī| avyutpattapakṣe tu kṛdikārānto na bhavati, tataḥ `sarvato'ktinnarthāt' (ga.sū.51) iti ṅīṣ|| 32. antarvatpativatornuk| (4.1.32) `sa tu nakārāntatvādeva siddhaḥ' iti| `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp' 4.1.5) ityanena| `nipātanasāmarthyāt' ityādi| yathaiva hi nipātanasāmarthyādanyat kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati, tathārthaviśeṣe'pi vṛttiḥ| kasminpunararthaviśeṣe vṛttirbhavati ? ityata āha-- `antarvatpativat' ityādi| yathākramamantarvadityasya garbhasaṃyoge vṛttiḥ, patipadityasya bhartṛsaṃyoge| garbheṇa saṃyogo garbhasaṃyogaḥ, sa kasyā bhavati ? yasyāḥ kukṣau garbho vyajyate| bhartrā saṃyogo bhartusaṃyogaḥ, sa ca kasyā bhavati ? yasyāḥ patirjīvati| bharttā ceha yo'gnisākṣipūrvakeṇa pāṇigrahaṇanena sambandhī sa evābhimataḥ, natu yaḥ pṛthivīsvāmī| `{rāśatibhyāṃ da.u.} iha tu na bhavati iti-- antarasyāṃ śālāyāṃ vidyate' (iti) śālāyāṃ kukṣigatena garbheṇa sambandhābhāvāt| `patimatī' iti| parirasyā astīti matup, `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp| atra patiśabda īśvare svamini varttate| tena saṃyoge ca na pativaditi nipātyate| yena tu saṃyogo nipātyate sa cākhyāta eva| `matubnipātyate' iti| antaḥśabdasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvāt prathamāsamarthatā nāsti| prathamāsamarthāccāstisamānādhikaraṇena matubvidhīyate, na cāstināntaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tasmānmatubna prāpnotīti nipātyate| `vatvaṃ na siddham' iti| `mādupadhāyāśca' (8.2.9) ityādinaivākāropadhatvāt| `nipātyate' iti| kenacidaprāptatvāt| ` matupsiddhaḥ'iti| patirasyāstīti prathamāsamarthasya patiśabdasyāstinā sāmānādhikaraṇyāt| `garbhiṇī' ityanena garbhasaṃyogaṃ darśayati| `jīvapatiḥ'ityanenāpi bhartṛsaṃyogam| `antarvatpativatoḥ'ityādi| antarvatpativadityetayoḥ śabdayornipātanānmatubavatve bhavataḥ, yathākramaṃ garbhiṇyāṃ jīvapatyāṃ ca striyāmabhidheyāyām| garbho'syā astīti garbhiṇī| jīvatīti jīvaḥ, pacādyac; jīvaḥ gatiryasyāḥ sā jīvapatiḥ|nanu ca `patiḥ samāsa eva' (1.4.8) iti ghisaṃjñoya'yaṃ patiśabdaḥ,tatra `acca gheḥ' (7.3.119) ityātvautvayoḥ kṛtayoḥ jīvapatāviti bhavitavyam, tadayukto jīvapatyāmiti nirdeśaḥ ? naitadasti; `śeṣo ghyasakhi'(1.4.7) iti, siddhāyāmeva ghisaṃjñāyāṃ `patiḥ samāsa eva' (1.4.8) ityanena śeṣasyaiva patiśabdasya ghisaṃjñā niyamārthaṃ vidhīyate, na cāyaṃ śeṣaḥ; `ṅiti hrasvaśca' (1.4.6) iti nadīsaṃjñāsambhavāt| nadīsaṃjñāyāṃ ca satyāṃ `idudbhyām' (7.3.117) iti `ṅerām nadyāmnībhyaḥ' (7.3.116) ityām, yaṇādeśe jīvapatyāmiti bhavati| `vā cchandasi nugvidhiḥ' | chandasi vikalpe tu nugvidhirbhavati| sa ca vakṣyamāṇasya vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya siṃhāvalokitanyāyenānuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| nukpakṣe `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5) iti ṅīp| `antarvatnī' iti| anukpakṣe `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp--antarvatīti bhavati|| 33. patyurno yajñasaṃyoge| (4.1.33) `yajñasaṃyoge' iti| yajñasambandhe| kasya punaryajñena saṃyogaḥ ? patiśabdavācyārthasya| atha patiśabdasyaiva kasmānna bhavati ? asambhavāt| tayorhi vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ syāt, na kevalaḥ patiśabdo yajñasya vācakaḥ| kathaṃ punaryajñena saṃyoga ityāha-- `tatsādhanatvāt' iti| tasya yajñasya sādhanaṃ tatsādhanam, tadbhāvo yajñasādhanatvam| tasmādyajñena saṃyogo bhavati| yajamānasya yā bhāryā tasyā yāgaṃ prati sādhanabhāvo'stīti; vinā tayā tadaniṣpatteḥ| na hi bhāryāvirahitastrairṇikaḥ kevalo yajñe'dhikriyate| tasmāt sa tayā karaṇabhūtayā yajñaṃ niṣpādayatītyasti tasyā yajñena saha kriyākārakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ| `tatphalagrahītṛtvādvā' iti| yajñasaṃyoge dvitīyo hetuḥ| anena tu svasvāmibhāvalakṣamaḥ sambandhaḥ pratipādyate| yajñasya yatpradhānaṃ phalaṃ svargākhyaṃ tadyajamānasya patnī parigṛhṇāti| ato yadyapi yajñaṃ prati tasyāḥ sādhanatvaṃ na vivakṣyate, tathāpi tatphalasya grahaṇāt, yathā yajamānasya yajñena hasa svasvāmibhāvasambandhaḥ, tathā tatpatnyā api| atha phalagrahītṛtvāditi kathamatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ ? kathañca na syāt ? `karttari ca' (2.2.16) iti tṛcā saha ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhāt ? naivāyaṃ tṛjantena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? dvitīyeti yogavibhāgāt tṛnnantena dvitīyāsamāsaḥ| atha vā-- yājakādiṣu grahītṛśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena ṣaṣṭhīsamāso bhaviṣyati| athāpi tatra na paṭhyate ? evamapi `yājakādibhiśca' (2.2.9) iti cakārasyānuktasamucayārthatvādbhaviṣyati| `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5) iti grahītṛśabdādiha ṅīp na bhavati, strītvasyāvivakṣitatvāt| kvacit `phalagṛhṇītatvāt' iti pāṭhaḥ|tatra phalagṛhītaśabdayorbahuvrīhiḥ| phalaśabdasya jātivācitvānniṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvanipāte prāpte `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanam' (vā.116) iti gṛhītaśabdasya paranipātaḥ| `katham' ityādi| eṃ manyate-- `śūdrasyaiva tāvadyajñe'nadhikṛtvādyajñena saṃyogo nāsti, kiṃ punastadbhāryāyāḥ ? ataḥ `vṛṣalasya patnī' ityeṣa prayogo nopapadyate' iti| `upamānādbhaviṣyati' iti| patnīvaddhi patnī| yathaiva hi yajamānasya patnyagnisākṣipūrvakeṇa tatpatyuḥ sambandhinī tatkāryeṣu cādhikṛtā tathā vṛṣalasya bhāryā'pi| tasmāt patnīsamādharmyāt sā'pi patnītyucyate|| 34. vibhāṣā sapūrvasya| (4.1.34) `patiśabdāntasya'ityādi| etena patiśabdasya grahaṇam, sapūrvagrahaṇam, anupasarjanagrahaṇañca -- trayamapyetat prātipadikasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| sahaśabdo'yamastyeva tulyayoge-- saśiṣyo gururāgata iti, guroḥ śiṣyasya cāgamanena tulyayogaḥ pratīyate; asti ca sattāvacanaḥ, yathā-- sahaiva daśabhiḥ putrairbhāraṃ vahati gardabhī' iti, vidyamanairevetyarthaḥ| tadiha sattāvacano gṛhyate, sapūrvasya vidyamānapūrvasyetvarthaḥ| yadi hi tulyayoge varttamāno gṛhyate, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt--sahapūrveṇa patiśabdāntasya nakāro bhavatīti| tataśca patiśabdāt pūrvasyāpi vṛddhādiśabdasya nakāraḥ syāt| evaṃ hi tulyayogo bhavati yadi nakāra ubhayorapi bhavati| pūrvaśabdo'yamastyeva vyavasthāśabdaḥ, yathā--pūrvaṃ mathurāyāḥ pāṭaliputramiti; astyavayavavacanaḥ, yathā-- pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti| tadihāvayavavacano gṛhyate| saha vidyamānaḥ pūrvo'vayavo yasya tat sapūrvamityucyate| yadi vyavasthāśabdo gṛhyeta, tatrāyamarthaḥ syāt-- vidyamānaḥ pūrvo yasmāt tasya patiśabdāntasya nakāro bhavatīti| tatasca dṛḍhapatnītyatra na syāt, na hi patiśabdāntādihakaścit pūrvo'stīti| atha patiśabdasyaiva sapūrvatvamanupasarjanatvañca viśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? aśakyatvāt| sa hyavayavavacanaṃ vā pūrvaśabdaṃ gṛhītvā viśiṣyeta, vyavasthāśabdaṃ vā| tatra pūrvastāvadayuktaḥ kalpaḥ avyabhicārāt, asambhavācca| katham ? yadi pakāraṃ pūrvamabhipretya vidyamānaḥ pūrvo'vayavo yasyeti viśiṣyeta, tato'vyabhicārādayuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam| na hi pakāreṇa yasya pūrvatvaṃ tatpatiśabdo vyabhicarati| atha śabdāntaram ? tadasambhavādayuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam| na hi śabdāntaraṃ patiśabdasyāvayava upapadyate| vyavasthāśabdapakṣe tu vidyamānaḥ pūrvo yasmāt taditi viśiṣyate| yujyate ca viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ| kintu vākye'pi nakāraḥ prāpnoti-- grāmasya patiriyaṃ brāhmaṇīti; asti hyatra patiśabdāt pūrvo grāmaśabda-| anupasarjanagrahaṇenāpi patiśabde viśiṣyamāne bahuvrīhau vikalpo na prāpnoti-- dṛḍhaḥ patirasyā dṛḍhapatiḥ, dṛḍhapatnīti| na hyatrānupasarjanaṃ patiśabdaḥ, sarvopasarjanatvād‌bahuvrīheriti bahuvrīhyavayavānāmapyupasarjanatvāt| tasmāt prātipadikasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| `patiriyaṃ brāhmaṇī grāmasya' iti| nanu ca vyapadeśivadbhāvādidamapi sapūrvamiti śakyate vyapadeṣṭum| na ca `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'pratipadikena' (śāk.pa.65) iti vyapadeśivadbhāvābhāvaḥ; prātipadikatvāt| yadyevam, patiśabdāntatāpi nāstīti, ato dvyaṅgavikalatā ? naitadasti; sapūrvagrahaṇe hi kriyamāṇe patiśabdāntasyetyeṣo'rtho labhyate| akriyamāṇe tu tasmin śabdasyaiva śuddhasya nakāro vijñāyate|| 35. nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu| (4.1.35) `sapatnyādiṣu' iti| ke punaḥ saptnatyādayaḥ ? ye paṭhyante| teṣu prātipadikeṣu yeṣāṃ samānādīni pūrvapadāni te sapatnyādayaḥ| kuta etat ? samānādīnāṃ gaṇe pāṭhāt, sapatnyādīnāṃ cāpāṭhāt| lāghavārthaṃ samānārthaṃ samānādiṣviti pravaktavye kṛte nakāradeśasya sapratyayasya ca sapatnyādiṣviti samudāyasyoccāraṇam-- niyogata eva samudāya īkāranta eva yathā syādityevamartham| tena sapatnī bhāryā yasya sa sapatnībhārya iti `striyāṃ puṃvat' (6.3.34) iti puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati| `sapatnyādiṣu nityam' ityādi| samānādiṣu pūrveṣvayavayaveṣu satsu nityaṃ patiśabdasya nakārādeśo bhayatītyarthaḥ| yadi pūrveṇa vikalpe prāpta idaṃ vacanam, evaṃ hi nityagrāhaṇayanarthakam, ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi nityaṃ vidhirbhaviṣyatītyata āha-- `nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham' iti| `dāsācchandasi' iti| dāsaśabdāt paro yaḥ patiśabdastadantasya prātipadikasya cachandasi viṣaye nityaṃ nakārādeśo bhavati| dāsaḥ patiryasyāḥ sā dāsapatnī| bhāṣāyāṃ tu pūr‌veṇa vikalpaḥ-- dāsapatiḥ, dāsapatnīti|| 36. pūtakratorai ca| (4.1.36) `aikāraścāntādeśo bhavati' iti| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam-- ādejño'yamiti, na punaḥ pratyayaḥ ? uttarasūtre'pyādeśatvāt| uttarasūtre hyayamevaikāro'nuvarttate, tatra cāsyādeśatvam| ata ihāpyādeśatvamavasīyate| uttarasūtre kuto'syādeśatvaṃ niścitamiti cet ? udāttavacanāt| yadi hi pratyayaḥ, tasyādyudāttatvādudāttavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; pratyayasvareṇaivodāttatvasya siddhatvāt| `traya ete yogāḥ' iti| ayaṃ caikaḥ, vakṣyamāṇau cānantarau-- dvau-- ete trayo yogāḥ puṃyogaprakaṇe `puṃyogādākhyāyām' (4.1.48) ityevamādau draṣṭavyāḥ; tasminneṣāṃ svaritatvenānuvṛtteḥ| pūtaḥ kraturyena pukaṣeṇa sa pūtakratuḥ, tasya strī pūtakratāyī|| 37. vṛṣākapyagnikusitakusīdānāmudāttaḥ| (4.1.37) `vṛṣākapiśabdo madhyodāttaḥ' iti| `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' (phiṭ.2.42) iti vanacāt| asyāyamarthaḥ-- laghāvante parato dvayośca laghvoḥ parato bahvacśabdasya yo guruḥ sa udātto bhavatīti| `bahvaṣ' iti bahvajityarthaḥ| pāṇineryaścakāreṇa pratyāhāraḥ so'nyeṣāmācāryāṇāṃ matena ṣakāreṇa| vṛṣākapiśabde kapiśabdasambandhinorlaghvoḥ parataḥ pūrva ākāro gurutara udātto bhavati, śeṣamanudāttam| tatra yadyudāttagrahaṇaṃ na kriyetānudāttasya sthāne ya ādeśaḥ sthānivadbhāvena so'nudātta eva syāt| tasmādvṛṣākapi śabda udāttatvaṃ prayojayati| `agnyādiṣu punarantodātteṣu' iti| `phiṣaḥ' (phi.sū.1.1) ityādināgnyādīnāmantodāttatvam| ādiśabdena kusitakusīdayorgrahaṇam| `phiṣ' iti prātipadikasyaiva punaranyācāryākṛtā saṃjñā|| 38. manorau vā| (4.1.38) `vāgrahaṇena dvāvapi vikalpyete' iti| pratyekaṃ vāgrahaṇenābhisambandhāt| yadā caikāraukārau na bhavatastadā ṅībapi na bhavati ; tasya sanniyogaśiṣṭatvāt| `manuśabda ādyudāttaḥ' iti| etenodāttagrahaṇamanuvarttayitavyam; anyathā śeṣasyānudāttatve sthānivadbhāvenādeśasyāpyanudāttatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| `mana jñāne' (dhā.pā.1176) `{bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanimamasjbhya uḥ-- da.u.}bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritanidhanimimasjbhya uḥ' (da.u.1.92) ityanuvarttāne `dhānye nit' (da.u.1.94) iti ca `śṛsvṛsnihitrapyasivasihaniklidibandhimānibhyaśca' (da.u.1.95) ityupratyayaḥ, nitvāt `ñnityādirnityam' (6.1.197) ityādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati manuśabdasya|| 39. varṇādanudāttāttopadhātto naḥ| (4.1.39) `varṇānāṃ taṇitanitāntānām' (phi.sū.2.23) ityasyāyamarthaḥ-- varṇavācināṃ taśabdāntānāṃ ṇakārāntānāṃ tiśabdāntānāṃ niśabdāntānāṃ cādirudātto bhavatīti, ādigrahaṇamudāttagrahaṇaṃ ca prakṛtaṃ tatrānuvarttate| `prakṛtā' iti| prakarṣeṇa kṛteti, `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.12) iti samāsaḥ| praśabdo'yaṃ nipātaḥ, `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) `upasargāścābhivarjam' (phi.sū.4.81) ityudāttaḥ| samāse'pi kṛte `gitaranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudātta eva bhavatīti| seṣamanudāttam| `ghṛtāditvādantodāttaḥ' iti| `ghṛtādīnāñca' (phi. sū.1.21.) ityantodāttatvavidhānāt| etacca phiṭsūtre paṭhyate| `śiti' iti `varṇānām' (phi.sū.2.33) ityādinā śitiśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `piśaṅgāt' ityādi| piśaṅgaśabdaḥ `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādinā madhyodāttaḥ, tataḥ `anyato ṅīṣ' (41.36) ityataścakāro'nuktasamuccayārtho'nuvarttate| tena piśaṅgādapi ṅībbhavatīti| `vaktavyam' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `manorau vā' (4.1.39) ityato vetyanuvartate,sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenāsitapalitaśabdābhyāṃ ṅīṣna bhaviṣyatyeveti| `varṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānām' (phi.sū.2.33) iyādyudāttau asitapalitaśabdau| `tayośchandasi' ityādi| asitapalitaśabdayostakārasya knameka ācāryā icchanti| sa tu `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) ityeva siddhaḥ| `bhāṣāyāmapīṣyate' iti| etena pratyācaṣṭe| `asiknikānām' iti| ajñātārthe `prāgivātkaḥ' (5.3.70) itikaḥ, `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ|| 40. anyato ṅīṣ| (4.1.40) `sāraṅgī, kalmāṣī' iti| `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādinā madhyodāttau sāraṅgakalmāvaśabdau| `śavalī' iti| `śapa akrośe' (dhā.pā.1000), `kalastṛpaśca' (da.u.8.107) iti `śapervaśca' (da.u.8.108) iti kalapratyayaḥ, pakārasya bakāraḥ, pratyāyādyudāttatvena madhyodāttaḥ śabalaśabdaḥ| `khaṭvā' iti| `khaṭa kāṅkṣāyām (dhā.pā.309), `aśūpruṣilaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhyaḥ kvan' (da.u.8.125) iti kvan, nitsarveraṇādyudāttaḥ khaṭvāśabdāḥ| `kṛṣṇā' iti| `kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā.990) `{iṇsiñdīṅuṣyavibhyo nak--da.u.) iṇsiñjidīṅuṣyavibhyo nak', `kṛṣervarṇe' (da.u.5.35.37) iti nak, pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ kṛṣṇaśabdaḥ| `kapilā' iti| `kamu kāntau' (dhā.pā.443) `salikalyanimahibhaḍibhaṇḍiśaṇḍipiṇḍituṇḍikukibhūbhya ilac' (paṃ.u.155), `kameḥ paśca' (paṃ.u.1.56) iti makārasya pakāraḥ, citsvareṇāṇāntodāttaḥ kapilāśabdaḥ|| 41. ṣid‌gaurādibhyaśca| (4.1.41) `ṣidbhyaḥ prātipadikebhyaḥ' iti| ṣakāra idyeṣāṃ tāni| kathaṃ punaḥ prātipadikāni ṣinti bhavanti, yāvatā dhvunādeḥ pratyayasya ṣakāra itsaṃjñakaḥ,na tu teṣām ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avayavagataṃ hi ṣittvaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, yathā-- akṣigataṃ kāṇatvaṃ puruṣasya --kāṇaḥ puruṣa iti| yadyevam, dhātugatamapi ṣittvaṃ samudāyasya viśeṣaṇaṃ prāpnoti, `trapūṣ lajjāyām' (dhā.pā.347), aṅa, apatrapeti ? naitadasti; yo hyanubandho'vayave niṣprayojanaḥ sa samudāyārtho vijñāyate| dhātostu vidyata eva ṣitkaraṇasya nānyat prayojanamasti, ataḥ samudayārthameva tadvijñāyate| `rajakī' iti| atra `rañjeśca' (6.4.26) ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādanunāsikalopaḥ| gaurādiṣu gauraśabdasya satyapi varṇavācitve prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttatvāt pūrveṇa prāpnotītīha pāṭhaḥ| matsyādīnāṃ yakāropadhānām `ayopadhāt' (4.1.63) iti jātilakṣaṇasya ṅīṣaḥ pratiṣedhe prāpte| śṛṅgaśabdasya prāk śvañśabdāt puṭādīnāñcānandavarjjitānāṃ strīviṣayatvāt śṛṅgaśabdasya prāpte puṭādīnāṃ cāstrīviṣayā (4.1.63)diti pratiṣedhe prāpte| ānandaśabdasyājātivācitvānṅīṣyaprāpte| śvaṃstakṣannityetayoḥ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5) itiṅīpi prāpte| anuḍuhyanaḍvāhītyanayoranakārāntatvānṅīpyaprāpte| ikārāntayoḥ sapratyayorgaṇe pāṭhaḥ puṃvadbhāvaprati,edhārthaḥ-- anaḍuhībhāryaḥ, anaḍvāhībhārya iti| etadeva vacanaṃ jñāpakam-- anaḍuhaḥ striyāṃ vikalpenāmbhavatīti| tena yaduktam-- `anaḍuhaḥ {striyāṃ veti -- vā.pāṭha.} striyāñceti vaktavyam' (vā.829) iti, tanna vaktavyamiti bhavati| `{eṣaṇaḥ kā.vṛ.}eṣaṇaṃ karaṇe' iti| eṣaṇaśabdaḥ karaṇe kārake ṅīṣamutpādayatīti| iṣyate'nayetyeṣaṇī| karaṇa iti kim ? iṣyate'syāmityadhikaraṇe ṅīpi| medha ityasyājātitvānṅīṣyaprāpte| gautamasya śārṅragaravāditvānṅīni prāpte| pakṣe ca vacanātso'pi bhavatyeva| āyasthūṇādīnāmālipiśabdaparyantānāṃ `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' (4.1.78) iti ṣyaṅi prāpte| āyasthūṇaśabdaḥ śivādyaṇantaḥ| `{bhauri,bhauliki-gaṇapāṭhaḥ} bhaurikyādayaḥ `ata iñ' (4.1.95) itīñantāḥ| āpicchikasya ṅīṣi prāpte| āpicchikānāṃ rājānaḥ, teṣāmapatyaṃ strī| `janapadaśabdāt kṣatriyādañ' (4.1.168) ityañ, tasya `ataśca' (4.1.177) iti luki kṛte?pratyayalakṣaṇena ṅīpprāpnoti| āraṭādīnāṃ prāk śātanaśabdāt strīviṣayatvānṅīṣyaprāpte| śātanādīnāṃ lyuḍantatvānṅīpi prāpte| adhikaraṇānṅīpi| agre hāyanamasya ityāgrahāyaṇī| svārthiko'ṇ, ṇatvaṃ nipātanāt| aṇantatvānṅīpi prāpte| īkārāntasya pāṭhaḥ puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhārthaḥ-- āgrahāyaṇībhārya iti| pratyavarohaṇasevanayorlyuḍantayoṣṭitvānṅīpi| kecittu puṃdbhāvapratiṣedhārthaṃ pratyavarohiṇīti paṭhanti--pratyavarohiṇībhārya iti| `sumaṅgalātsaṃjñāyām' (iti) | `nityaṃ saṃjñācchandasoḥ' (4.1.29) iti varttamāne `kevalamāmaka' (4.1.30) ityādinā ṅīpi prāpte| pakṣe vacanāt so'pi bhavati| saṃjñāyāmiti kim ? sumaṅgalā| sundarādīnāṃ prāk taruṇaśabdāt strīviṣayatvāt ṅīṣyaprāpte| taruṇatalunaśabdayorvayolakṣaṇe ṅīpi prāpte| `nañsnañīkaktaruṇatalunānāmupasaṃkhyānam' (vā.338) ityatra tu vayograhaṇam| bṛhanmahacchabdayorugitvānṅīpi prāpte| `rohiṇī nakṣaṇe' iti| nakṣatra iti kimartham ? rohitā| `revatī nakṣatre' iti kim ? yeṣāṃ revataśabdo'trākārānta iti darśanaṃ teṣāṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ ṭāp-- revateti| yeṣāṃ tvidaṃ vacanam-- rāvidyate'syā iti reśabdānmatup, nipātanādvatvamiti, teṣāṃ pratyudāharaṇam `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp-- revatīti| svare viśeṣaḥ| vikalādīnāṃ ṭāpi prāpte| kaṭaśabdācchoṇyabhidhāne ṅīṣ| kaṭī śroṇirityarthaḥ| śroṇiriti kim ? kaṭā| `pippalyādayaśca' iti| etāvadgaṇe paṭhyate| tāṃstu pippasyādīn darśayituṃ pippalī harītakītyādikaṃ vṛttikāvacanam| `pṛthivī' iti| īkārāntanipātanaṃ puṃvadbhāvanivṛttyartham-- pṛthivībhārya iti| kroṣṭuśabdasya `striyāṃ ca' (7.1.96) ititṛjvadbhāvaḥ| `mātari ṣicca' iti| `pitṛṣyamātulamātāmahapitāmahāḥ' (4.2.36) ityatra pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ pitari vācye ḍāmahajnipātayiṣyate| mātari ḍāmahajeva| tasyāpi ṣittvam| `daṃṣṭrā' iti| `{danśa dhā.pā.} daṃśa daśane' (dhā.pā.989), `dāmnīśas' (3.2.182) ityādināṣṭran| ṣillakṣaṇasyānityatvān ṅīṣaṣṭābbhavati|| 42.jānapadakuṇḍagoṇasthalabhājanāgakālanīlakuśakāmukakabarādvṛttyamatrāvapanākṛtrimāśrāṇāsthaulyavarṇānācchādanā'yovikāramaithunecchākeśaveśeṣu| (4.1.42) varttate yayā sā vṛttiriti jīvanopāyo vṛttiśabdenehocyate| janapade bhāvā vṛttirjānapadī| `utsādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.86) ityañ| `janāpadyanyā' iti|`ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅībeva bhavati| `svare viśeṣaḥ' iti| ṅīṣi sati pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati| ṅīpi tu satyādyudāttatvam; jānapadasya ñitsvareṇādyudāttatvāt| `amatram' iti| bhājanam - pātram| `kuṇḍā'nyā' iti| kriyāśabdo'yamityāhuḥ|`kuḍi dāhe' (dhā.pā.270), `gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103) ityakāratapratyayaḥ,`ajādyataṣṭāp' (4.1.4) | yastu dravyavacanaḥ kuṇḍaśabdaḥ sa nityaṃ nupaṃsaka eva varttata iti pratyudāharttuṃ na yukta iti| `āvapanam' iti| bhājanaviśeṣa ucyate, yatra dhānyādi prakṣipya nīyate| `goṇā'nyā' iti| sā punaryasyā idaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ nāma| `akṛtrimā' iti| puruṣavyāpāradibhirna nirvṛttetyarthaḥ| `sthalā'nyā' iti| yā pauruṣeyī| `bhājī' iti| `bhaja viśrāṇane' (dhā.pā.1733) curādiṇic| `ṇyāsaśrantho yuc' (3.3.107) iti yuc prāpnoti| asmādeva nipātanādaṅ, aṅantānṅīṣ| `śrāṇā' iti| `śrā pāke' (dhā.pā.810) ityasmāt ktaḥ| `{saṃyogāderāto dhātoryaṇvataḥ'iti sūtram'}saṃyogāderdhātoryaṇvataḥ' (8.2.43) itinatvam, `aṭkupvāṅanumvyavāye'pi' (8.4.2) iti ṇatvam| `nāgaśabdaḥ' ityādi| nāgaśabdo dvividhaḥ-- jātivacanaḥ, guṇavacanaśca| tatar sthaulyagrahaṇādiha na jātivacano ṅīṣamutpādayati, na hi jātivacanasya sthaulyamabhidheyaṃ sambhavati; nāpi guṇāntaravacanaḥ; na hi guṇāntaraśabdānnāgavacanānṅīṣantādguṇāntaraṃ pratīyate, api tu sthaulyameva| tasmādyadā'sau sthaulyaṃ guṇamabhidhāya dravye varttate tadā ṅīṣamutpādayati, nānyathā| `anyatra' ityādi| sthaulyādagyatra guṇa eva dairdhyādau varttamāno nāgaśabdo yadā dravyaṃ viśināṣṭi tadā ṭāpamutpādayati| `jātivacanāttu' ityādi| hastitvādijātivacanāt `jātarestrīviṣayāt' (4.1.63) ityādinā ṅīṣbhavati| `varṇaścet' iti| dravye varttamāno yadi varṇastasya prayṛttinimittaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| `kālā'nyā' iti| yasyā yādṛṭacchikasaṃjñā| `nīlā'nyā' iti| ācchādanaṃ śāṭikādi| anācchādane, na sarvatra| kiṃ tarhi ? `nīlādauṣadadhau prāṇini ca' iti| śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt,tatraiva nīlaśabdasya vṛtteḥ| atha vā `manorau vā' (4.1.38) ityato vāgrahaṇamihānuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā , tenānayorevārthayostato bhaviṣyati, nānyatreti| `saṃjñāyāmeva' iti| anācchādana evāyaṃ vikalpaḥ| eṣo'pi tata eva vāgrahānuvṛtterlabhyate| `ayovikāraḥ' iti| viśiṣṭa eva `phālaḥ' iti yasya nāmadheyam| `kuśā'nyā' iti| tadākṛtireva kāṣṭhādimayī| `kāmukā'nyā' iti| sā punaryasyā maithunādanyadvastu kāmayituṃ śīlam| `maithunecchavatī bhaṇyate' iti| matvarthīyākārāntasya maithunecchāśabdasyopādānāt| `keśaveśaḥ'iti| etadākhye viśiṣṭa eva| `kavarā'nyā' iti| varṇo'syā' astīti matup, tasyā lopādabhedopacārādvā dravye yo varttate sa veditavyaḥ|| 43. śoṇātprācām| (4.1.43) śoṇaśabdo'yaṃ varṇavacanaḥ| `varṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānām' (phi.sū.2.33) itivacanādādyudāttaḥ| tatra `anyato ṅīṣ' (4.1.40) iti siddhe vacanaṃ niyamārtham-- pracāmeda yathā syāt, anyeṣāṃ mā bhūditi|| 44. voto guṇavacanāt| (4.1.44) `guṇamuktavān guṇavacanaḥ' iti| bhūte kāle lyuṭo vidhānāt| sa punaryaḥ prāg guṇamabhidhāya paścānmatublopādabhedopacārādvā tadvaddravyamabhidhatte sa veditavyaḥ| `paṭvī, mṛdvī' iti| atra paṭutvaṃ mṛdutvañca yatākramaṃ guṇamabhidhāya paṭumṛduśabdau tadvati dravye varttete iti guṇavacanau bhavataḥ| `śuciḥ' iti| śuciśabdaḥ śucitve guṇe varttitvā dravye varttata iti guṇavacanaḥ, na tūkārāntaḥ| `ākhuḥ' iti| jātivacano'yam, na gaṇavacanaḥ| `guṇavacanānṅībādyudāttārtham' iti| guṇavacanānṅībvidheyaḥ, na ṅīṣ| svare viśeṣaḥ| kimartham ? ādyudāttārtham | antodātteṣu `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' (6.1.174) ityudāttatvamīkārasya vidhīyata iti nāsti viśeṣo ṅībṅīṣoḥ| ādyudātteṣu tu ṅībanudātta evāvatiṣṭhate, tasmāt tadarthaṃ ṅībvidheyaḥ| nanu ca ṅīṣ prakṛtaḥ, tat kathaṃ ṅīp śakyate vidhātum ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṅībeva hyatra maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttate, na ṅīṣ; asvaritatvāt| `vasvī' iti| `vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1942) `bhṛmṛśītṛcaritsaritani{dhani-nāsti-da.u.} dhanimimasjibhya uḥ' (da.u.1.92) iti varttamāne `dhānye nit' (da.u.1.94) iti ca śṛsvṛsnihitrapyasivasihaniklidivandhimanibhyaśca' (da.u.1.95) ityupratyayaḥ, nicca, nittvādādyadāttatvaṃ bhavati| guṇavacanaścāyaṃ vasuśabdaḥ, vasutve guṇe varttitvā tadvati dravye varttata iti kṛtvā| paṭuśabdo'pyādyudāttatvānṅīpaṃ projayati| `aṭa paṭa gatau' (dhā.pā.296,297), hetumaṇṇic, `phalipāṭinamimanijanāṃ guk paṭinākidhataśca' (da.u.1.103) ityupratyayaḥ, pāṭeśca paṭirādeśaḥ, `dhānye nit' (da.u.1.94) ityanuvṛtternatvādādyudāttatvam| mṛduśabdaśca pratyayasvareṇāntodātta iti, tatra ṅīpo ṅīṣo vā viśeṣo nāsti| `mrada mardane' (dhā.pā.767), `kurbhraśca' (da.u.1.107) ityataḥ kurityanuvarttamāne `prathimradibhrasjāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ ca' (da.u.1.113) iti kupratyayaḥ, samprasāraṇaṃ ca bhavati| `kharusaṃyogopadhapratiṣedhaḥ' iti| kharuśabdāt saṃyogopadhāśca pratiṣedhaḥ| sa tu vetyasya vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādeva labhyata iti vaktavyamiti| `utaḥ' iti taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛttyartham, tena paṭurityatra na bhavati| paṭumicchatīti `supaḥ ātmanaḥ kyac' (3.1.8),
