`akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ| paṭū ya iti sthite kvip, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ, `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yakārasya lopaḥ| iha `utaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇopādanādeva śāstrīyaguṇasyāparigrahaḥ siddhaḥ ma hyedeṅgāṃ madhye kaścidukārānto'sti| loke tu kvacidupasarjanaṃ guṇa ityabhidhīyate, yathā-- guṇabhūtā vayamiti, apradhānabhūtā iti gamyate| yasya guṇasya hi bhāvāt tadvati dravyaśabde niveśastadabhidhāne tvatalāvityatra viśeṣaṇamātraṃ guṇaśabdenocyate, tathā hi, jātāvapi bhāvapratyayo bhavati-- iha tu yādṛśo guṇa iṣyate tādṛśaṃ paribhāṣitumāha-- `sattve nivaśate'paiti' ityādi| vyavacchedaphalakatvāt sarvavākyānāṃ sattava evetyavadhāraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| sattvam - dravyam, tatraiva niviśate, tadevāśrayatītyarthaḥ| apaiti - tataḥ sattvādapagacchathi, yathā-- āmraphale śyāmatā pūrvamupaiti, raktatāyāmupajātāyāṃ tato'paiti| `pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate' (iti)| pṛthak - nānā jātayo yeṣāṃ te pṛthagjātayaḥ, atasteṣu pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate| na hi gotvamaśvādiṣu vyaktiṣu dṛśyate| govyate| govyaktau dṛṣṭaḥ śaṅ‌khādāvapi śuklādirguṇau dṛśyate| etena sarveṇa jātirguṇo na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| na hi jātirdravyamevāśrayati| yathā hi sattā dravyaguṇakarmasu triṣvapi varttate, dravyatvaṃ dravya eva, karmatvaṃ karmaṇyeva, guṇatvaṃ guṇa eva, nāpi dravyavartinī jātiḥ sattvādapaiti; janmanaḥ prabhṛtyā vināśāttasyādhāradravyāparityāgāt na jātiḥ pathagjātiṣu dṛśyate| na hi gotvamaśvādivyaktiṣu dṛśyate, nāpyaśvatvaṃ gavādiṣviti nāsti jāterguṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ| karmaṇastu syāt; tadapi hi sattva eva nivaśite yadā sakriyaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati, apaiti ca tato yadā tu niṣkriyaṃ bhavati| `pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate' iti| ghaṭapaṭādiṣu dṛśyate| ataḥ raktatā guṇaḥ, sa hyagnisanniyogena niṣpādyate| `akriyājaśca' iti| kriyā - vyāpāraḥ, tato jātaḥ kriyājaḥ, na kriyājo'kriyājaḥ - nityaḥ, yathā-- ākāśādiṣu mahattvādirguṇaḥ| tadevaṃ guṇasyotpādyatvānutpādyatvaprakāradvayadarśanena karmaṇo guṇatvanivṛttiḥ kṛtā bhavati| taddhyutpādyameva, nānutpādyam| evamapi dravyasya guṇatvaṃ prāpnoti,tasyāpi hyete dharmā vidyante|tathā hi-- tadapi yadi dravya evārambhake'vayavabhūte niviśate, apaiti ca tataḥ, yathā-- śarīramavayavīti| taddhi hastapādādiṣvavayaveṣu samavaiti; tadvināśe ca vināśāt tato'paiti| pṛthagjātiṣu dṛśyate, hastyādiṣu dṛśyate| dravyasyāpi pūrvoktaṃ prakāradvayamastyeva| avayavidravyasyotpādyatvādākāśādestadvadanutpādyatvāt ? ityata āha-- `so'sattvaprakṛtirguṇaḥ'iti| prakṛtiḥ - svabhāvaḥ| sattvaṃ dravyaṃ prakṛtiryasya sa sattvaprakṛtiḥ, na sattvaprakṛtirasattvaprakṛtiḥ| yathoktairdharmairyukto yo dravyasvabhāvo na bhavati sa guṇaḥ| dravyam - dravyasvabhāvam, ato guṇo na bhavati|| 45. bahvādibhyaśca| (4.1.45) bahvādiṣu `śaktiḥ śastre' iti paṭhyate, tasyāyamarthaḥ-- śastre'bhidheye śaktiśabdādvā ṅīṣ bhavati-- śaktiḥ, śaktī| śastra iti kim ? śaktiḥ,sāmarthyam| anye tu śaktiśastrī iti śabdadvayaṃ paṭhanti-- śaktiḥ,śaktī, śastriḥ, śastrī| `itaḥ prāṇyaṅgāt' iti| ikārāntāt prāṇyaṅgavācino vā ṅīṣ bhavati-- dhamaniḥ, dhamanī| ita iti kim ? samarthā grīvā| prāṇyahgāditi kim ? śreṇiḥ| `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' (iti)| `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke' (iti)| asyārthaḥ `rātreścājasau' (4.1.31) ityatraiva vyākhyātaḥ| yadi sarvato'ktinnarthāt ṅīṣ bhavati, śakaṭyādīnāṃ gaṇekimarthaṃ ikārāntānāṃ pāṭhaḥ ? tasyaiva prapañcārthaḥ| paddhatiśbadsayāktinnarthāditi pratiṣedhe prāpte pāṭhaḥ| pādasya hatiḥ paddhatiḥ, `himakāṣihatiṣu ca' (6.3.54) iti padbhāvaḥ| `candrabhāgānnadyām' iti| candrabhāgaśabdānnadyāmabhidheyāyāṃ vā ṅīṣ bhavati-- candrabhāgī nadī| nadyāmiti kim ? candrabhāgā nāma devatā| `ahan' iti| ayaṃ śabdaḥ kevalaḥ striyāṃ na varttate| tasmāt samāse tadanta udāhāryaḥ| dīrghāṇyahāni yasyāṃ śaradi sā dīrghāhno| ṅīppratiṣedhāvapyasmādbhavataḥ| `anoḥ bahuvrīheḥ' (4.1.12) `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām' (4.1.13) ityapi ḍābbhavati; `ana upadhālopino'nyatarasyām' (4.1.28) iti vā ṅīp ca| tena dhāturūpyaṃ bhavati| yadi bahuśabdo guṇavacanaḥ,tatkimarthamasyeha grahaṇam,yāvatā purveṇaiva siddho ṅīṣ ? ityata āha-- `tasya' ityādi|| 46. nityaṃ chandasi| (4.1.46) atha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pūrveṇaiva siddhe vikalpe satyārambhasāmarthyādeva nityaṃ bhaviṣyati ? ityata āha-- `nityagrahaṇamuttarārtham' iti|| 47. bhuvaśca| (4.1.47) `prabhvī' ityādi| `bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ' (3.2.179) ityataḥ `bhuvaḥ' ityanuvarttamāne `vipraṃśabhyo ḍvasaṃjñāyām' (3.2.180) itipratyayaḥ, tadantānṅīṣ| `svayambhūḥ' iti| bhavateḥ kvibantasya rūpam| nanu ca `bhuvaḥ' iti bhūśabdāddīrghādiyaṃ pañcamī, , tataśca dīrghādeva pratyayena bhavitavyam, na hrasvādityata āha-- `hrasvādeveyaṃ pañcamī ' iti| tarhi `bhuvaḥ'iti nirdeśo nopapadyate, `gherṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇe kṛte `bhoḥ' iti nirdeśena bhavitavyam ? ityata āha-- `sautro nirdeśaḥ'iti| chandasi varṇavyatyaya uktaḥ| tena tasya guṇe'kṛta uvaṅādeśaḥ kṛta iti darśayati|| 48. puṃyogādākhyām| (4.1.48) `puṃyogāt' iti| `vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām' (2.3.25) iti hetau pañcamī| yogaḥ - sambandhaḥ| `ākhyāyām' iti| pañcamyartha eṣā `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti saptamī| ākhyāyate'nayā prātipadikakārtha iti śrutyā''khyā| `puṃsa ākhyāyām' iti| puṃso vācakabhūtamityarthaḥ| taddhi puṃyogāddhetoḥ samprati striyāṃ varttate; na puṃsi| atīta e kāle puṃso vācakamāsīt, ato bhūtagrahaṇam| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yat prātipadikaṃ prāk puṃso vācakamabhūt, paścāttu paṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ varttate tasmān ṅīṣbhavatīti| kathaṃ punaryoge guṇabhāvamāpannasya puṃsa ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yujyate, striyāmityanuvṛtteḥ striyā eva ? naitadasti; yo hi puṃyogāt striyāṃ varttate so'vaśyaṃ striyamacaṣṭa iti viseṣaṇamidamadanarthamakameva syāt| puṃyogasya tarhīdaṃ viśeṣaṇam ? na; asambhavāt| na sambhavatyeva hi tat prātipadikaṃ yat puṃyogāddhetoḥ pūrvaṃ striyāṃ varttate, puṃyogasya cākhyābhūtaṃ bhavati| gaṇakādayo hi ye śabdāḥ puṃyogāt striyāṃ varttante te sarve eva vācakāḥ prāgabhūvan, na puṃyogasya| ye tu puṃyogādayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃyogasya vācakāḥ, te puṃyogāt striyāṃ na varttanta eva| na ceha kaścit tathāvidho'nya prakṛtaḥ, nāpi śrūyate, yasyākhyāgrahaṇena sambandhaḥ syāt| tasmādguṇabhūtasyāpi puṃsa evānena sambandho vijñāyate| `gaṇakī' ityādi| gaṇayatīti gaṇaka,ṇvul| pratiṣṭhita iti praṣṭhaḥ, `ātascopasarge' (6.1.136) iti kaḥ| `praṣṭho'gragāmini' (8.3.92) iti nipātanānmūrdhanyaḥ| sarva ete puṃso vācakāḥ| puṃyogāttu yadottarakālaṃ striyāṃ varttante tadaitebhyo ṅīṣ| `puṃsi śabdapravṛttinimitasya sambhavāt' iti| gaṇanādikriyāsvabhāvaṃ yadgaṇakādiśabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ tasya puṃsi sambhavaḥ, na striyām, nāpi napaṃsake| tasmāt puṃsi śabde ete| puṃso vācakā ete śabdā ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi striyāṃ varttante ? ityāha-- `tadyogāt' ityādi| tadyogaḥ - tasyāyamiti sambandhaḥ, svasvāmibhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| tasmādete puṃśabdā api svabhāvataḥ striyāṃ varttante| yathaiva tadyogāt striyāṃ snānodvarttanapariṣekādīn labhate tathā tācchabdyamapi| `devadattā' iti| atra devadattaśabdasaṃjñakena puruṣeṇa yogāddevadattaśabdaḥ striyāṃ na varttate| kiṃ tarhi ? svata eva, tasyā hīyaṃ saṃjñā kṛtā| `parisṛṣṭā, prajātā' iti| prasūtetyarthaḥ| nirluṭhitagarbheti yāvat| parisṛṣṭaprajātaśabdau striyāṃ varttamāno prasavanimittamupādāya pravarttete| parisargaḥ, prajanaḥ, prasava ityekārthā ete śabdāḥ| tasya ca prasavasya puṃyogo nimittam, tena vinā tadabhāvāt| tasmāt puṃyogāddhetoḥ striyāṃ varttata iti| varttata iti| na tu puṃśabdākhya iti īkāro na bhavatīti| `ete śabdāḥ' iti| bahuvacanaṃ ye'nye'pyevaṃjātīyāḥ śabdāstānapekṣya veditavyam; anyathā hi parisṛṣṭaprajātaśabdayordvitvadetau śabdāviti vaktavyaṃ syāt| `gopālikādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti| siddhye iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| gopālikādīnāṃ śabdānāṃ siddhaye ṅībpratiṣedhaḥ| sa tu `voto guṇavacanāta' (4.1.44) ityato vetyanuvṛttestasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya pratipādyaḥ| `sūryāddevatāyāṃ cāvvaktavyaḥ'iti| nanu ca ṅīṣa eva pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, ṅīṣi pratiṣiddhe ṭābbhaviṣyati, ṭāpi ca sūryeti sidhyatyeva ? naitadevam; yadyapi hi rūpaṃ siddhyati, svaratu na sidhyati, yasmāt sūryaśabdo'yamādyudāttaḥ| tathā hi `rājasūyasūryaḥ' (3.1.114) ityatra kyabanto nipātitaḥ, tataḥ kyapaḥ pittvādanudāttatvam| dhātostu suvateḥ sarttervā dhātusvareṇāntodāttatvam| tatra ṭāpi satyanudāttatvaṃ syāt, tu satyantodāttatā bhavati| pitkaraṇaṃ tu `ṅyāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇārtham| `sūrī'iti| sūryasya strī mānuṣī sūrī, ṅīṣeva bhavati, `sūryatiṣyāgastyamastyānām' (6.4.149) iti yalopaḥ|| 49. indravaruṇabhavaśarvarudramṛḍahimāraṇyayavayanamātulācāryāṇāmānuk| (4.1.49) `yeṣām' iti| indrāṇīnām| `anyeṣāṃ tu' iti| himādīnām| atha kimarthamānuk kriyate, anugeva nocyeta, tena savarṇadīrghatvena sidhyati ? na sidhyati; `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) iti pararūpatvaṃ hi prāpnoti| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, pararūpe hi nugeva vaktavyaḥ syāt| evaṃ tarhyakāroccāraṇasamarthyādbhaviṣyati| lvarasandhireva na bhavatītyevamapi vijñāyate| tasmānmaivaṃ vijñāyītyānugeva vaktavyaḥ| atha vā-- indramācaṣṭa iti `tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe' (vā.200,201) iti ṇici `ṇāviṣṭavat prātipadikasya' (vā.813) iti ṭilopaḥ, indrayateḥ kvip, ṇilopaḥ, indraḥ strīndrāṇītyatra dīrghaghasyākārasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthamānuko vidhānam| ānuki hi sati dīrgho na śrūyeta| nanu ca naivātra ṅīṣā bhavitavyam, ata ityadhikārāt ? dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyādbhaviṣyati| `himāraṇyayormahattve' iti| mahattvena yuktā himādayaḥ strīliṅgenābhisambadhynate yadā, tadā strītvavivakṣāyāmanayoḥ pratyayāgamayorvidhānamityetadanenākhyāyate, na tu strīpratyayasyāyamapavāda ucyate| strītva eva hi pratyayo bhavati| `yathāddoṣe'iti| yavāddoṣe gamyamāne striyāṃ ṅīṣ bhavati-- duṣṭo yavo yavānī| `yavanāllipyām' iti| `yavanānāṃ lipiḥ' iti| `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityapprasaṅge ṅīṣ vidhīyate, sa tu tadarthasya ṅīṣaiva dyotitatvānna bhavati| `ācāryadaṇatvañca' iti| nedamapūrvaṃ vaktavyam, kṣubhnādiṣvasya pāṭhāt| `svārtha evāyaṃ vidhiḥ' iti| evakāreṇa puṃyogo vyavacchidyate| yadi hi puṃyoge vidhirayaṃ syāt śūdrā'pi kṣatriyasya bhāryā kṣatriyāṇīti syāt| tasmāt svārthe evāyaṃ vidhiḥ-- kṣatriyaiva kṣatriyāṇīti| `puṃyoge tu ṅīṣaiva bhavitavyam' iti| pūrvasūtreṇa| `licca'iti| kasya tallitvam ? ānukaḥ| tathā hi-- mudgalānīśabdas dvitīya udātta āmyāye paṭhyate| ṅīṣastu litve tṛtīya udāttaḥ syāt|| 50. krītātkaraṇapūrvāt| (4.1.50) karaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ yasminnityādinā karaṇapūrvagrahaṇaṃ krītagrahaṇañca ubhayamapyetatprātipadikasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| pūrvaśabdo'yamavayavavacanaḥ| karaṇamavayavo yasminnityarthaḥ| atha krītaśabdasyaiva karaṇapūrvagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? aśakyatvāt | krītaśabdo hyavayavavācinaṃ vā pūrvaśabdaṃ gṛhītvā viśeṣyeta-- karaṇaṃ pūrvasminniti ? vyavasthāśabdaṃ vā-- karaṇaṃ pūrvamasmāditi ? tatra prathamaḥ pakṣo na sambhavati; na hyatra krītaśabdasya karaṇavāciśabdāntaramavayava upapadyate, dvitīyastu sambhavati, kintu vākye'pi syāt-- aśvena krīteti, asti hyatra krītaśabdāt karaṇaṃ pūrvam| prātipadike tu viśeṣyamāṇe na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| na hyaśvena krītetyetat karaṇāvayavaṃ krītaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikam| kiṃ tarhi ? vākyam| tasmāt prakṛtaṃ prātipadikaṃ sāmānyamevāvayavavācinā pūrvaśabdena viśeṣyate| krītaśabdenāpi tadeva karaṇapūrvaṃ prātipadikam| tena tasmin viśeṣyamāṇe sāmarthyāt tadantavidhiḥ prasajyetetyāha-- `krītaśabdāt prātipadikāt' iti| `vastrakrītī, vasanakrītī' iti| atra `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāksubutpatteḥ' (vyā.pa.vṛ.138) iti vastravasanayoḥ karaṇayoḥ krītaśabdena `karttakaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (2.1.32) iti prāgeva subutpatteḥ samāsaḥ| `sukrītā, duṣkrītā' iti| gatyupapadatvāt prāgeva subutpatteḥ `kugatiprādayaḥra' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| duṣkrītetyatra `idudupadhasya cāpratyaya' (8.3.41) iti ṣatvam| `ṭābantena samāsaḥ' iti| subantayoreveti veditavyam| ṭāpi vihite kṛdantatāyā vihitatvāt| atra kiṃ ṭāp kriyatām ? uta vibhaktiriti ? antaraṅgatvāṭṭāp| paścādbahiraṅgā vibhaktiriti vibhaktyantayoḥ samāsaḥ| antaraṅgatvaṃ bahiraṅgatvaṃ tu ṭābvibhaktyoḥ `ṅyāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) ityatra pratipāditam| kṛte tarhi ṭāpi ṅīṣ kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `ata iti ca' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ ṭābantena samāsaḥ sidhyati, yāvatā `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ' (vyā.pa.vṛ.138) iti prāgeva kṛdantatāyāṃ samāsena bhavitavyamityata āha-- `gatikārakopapadānām' ityādi. kathaṃ punarbahulaṃ taducyate ? ityāha-- `karttṛkaraṇe' ityādi| `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (2.1.32) ityanena hi gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ samāso vidhīyate| sa ca bahulagrahaṇāt kvacit kṛdantāvasthāyāṃ prāgeva subutpatteḥ, kvacidanyathā| tena `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk subutpatteḥ (vyā.pa.vṛ.138) iti bahulaṃ tadācāryairucyate| tataśca ṭābantenāpi kvacitsamāso labhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ|| 51. ktādalpākhyāyām| (4.1.51) `abhraviliptī' iti| `lipa upadehe' (dhā.pā.1433), asmāt ktaḥ| alpairabhrairviliptetyasyāmarthavivakṣāyāṃ pūrvavatprāksubutpatteḥ samāsaḥ| alpaśabdastu gatārthatvānna prayujyate| `candanānuliptā' iti| bahucandanānuliptetyarthaḥ|| 52. bahuvrīheścāntodāttāt| (4.1.52) `śaṅkhabhinnī' iti| `radābhyām' (8.2.42) iti natvam| niṣṭhāntasya `niṣṭhā' (2.2.36) iti pūrvanipāte prāpte `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ paravacanam' (vā.116) iti sa na bhavati| śaṅkhādiśabdā hi jātivacanāḥ| ata eva hi `jātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanāt kto'kṛtamitapratipannāḥ' (6.2.170) ityantodāttatvaṃ bhavati| `galakotkṛtī' iti| `kṛtī chedane' (dhā.pā.1435) ityasmāt ktaḥ| `keśalūnī' iti| keśān lunātīti| `lvādibhyaḥ' (8.2.44) iti natvaṃ codayati| `pādapatitā' iti| `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' (2.1.32) iti tatpuruṣasamāse'ntodāttatvam| `antodāttājjātapratiṣedhaḥ' iti| antodāttādbahuvrīherṅīṣo vidhāne jātaśabdāntāt pratiṣedhaḥ, sa cāntagrahaṇādeva labhyata iti na vaktavyam| ihāntagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyameva, vinā'pi tena yathā `varṇaādanudāttāt' (4.1.39) ityatrānudāttāntāditi vijñāyate, tathehāpyantodāttantāditi vijñāsyate ? tadevamarthaṃ kriyate-- antodātta eva yo nityaṃ bahuvrīhistato yathā syāt, vikalpena yo'ntodāttastato mā bhūditi| iha ca dantājātā, stanajātetyatra `vā jāte' (6.2.171) iti vikalpenāntottatvam, ato'yaṃ vidhirna bhaviṣyati| atha vā-- uttarasūtre vāgrahaṇamubhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣaḥ, vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca, tena jātaśabdāntānna bhaviṣyati| asmiṃstu vyākhyāne'ntagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthameveti veditavyam| `pāṇigṛhītyādīnāmarthaviśeṣe'iti| `siddhaye' iti śeṣaḥ| pāṇigṛhītītyādīnāṃ siddhyarthaṃ viśeṣa eva ṅībbhavati, na sarvatra| etadapi vyavasthitavibhāṣayā labhyate| viśeṣastu pāṇigrahaṇasya veditavyaḥ| āgnisākṣipūrvakaṃ bhāryārthaṃ yasyā pāṇigrahaṇaṃ kriyate sā pāṇigṛhītīti bhavati| `yathākathañcit' iti| yathoktāt prakārādanyena kenāpi prakāreṇetyarthaḥ| `abahunañ' ityādi| bahvādipūrvānṅīṣ na bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tasyaiva vāgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvamāśritya karttavyam| `jātikālasukhādi' ityādi| `bahukṛte' ityatra `bahornañvaduttarapadabhūmni' (6.2.175) ityantodāttatvam| `akṛtā, sakṛtā' ityatra `nañsubhyām' (6.2.1732) iti| `māsajātaḥ' ityādiṣu `jātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanāt ktaḥ' (6.2.170) iti|| 53. asvāṅgapūrvapadādvā| (4.1.53) `asvāṅgapūrvapadāt' iti| na svāṅgam - asvāṅgam, tat pūrvapadaṃ yasya bahuvrīheḥ sa tathokta-| `sāraṅgajagdhī' iti| `ada bhakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1011), `ado jagdhiḥ' (2.4.36) ityādinā jagdhyādeśaḥ, `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti takārasya ghatvam, `jharo jhari' (8.4.65) iti ghalopaḥ| `palāṇḍabhakṣitī' iti| `bhakṣa adane' (dhā.pā.1557), curādiṇic| `surāpīti' iti| ghumāsthādi (6.4.66) sūtreṇetvam| sarvatra `jātikālasukhādibhyaḥ' (6.2.170) ityādinottarapadāntodāttatvam| `vastracchannā, vasanacchannā' iti| `chada apavāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1833) ityasya curādiṇyantasya ktapratyaye `vā vāntaśāntapūrṇa'(7.2.27) ityādinā cchannaśabdo nipātitaḥ| `anācchādanāt' (6.2.170) ityuttarapadāntodāttatvapratiṣedhe `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam' (6.2.1) iti prakṛtisvare kṛte `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (6.1.158) iti śeṣasyānudāttatvādihāntodāttatvaṃ nāsti| pūrvapade evātrādyudātte--ekaṃ nitsvareṇa, aparaṃ litsvareṇa| `thasa ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1023), ṣṭranpratyayaḥ--vastram| dhātorvasanam--lyuṭ| `bahulam' ityādinā saṃjñāyāṃ chandasi bahulaṃ ṅīṣbhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatra vāgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvādeva bahulaṃ saṃjñācchandasorbhaviṣyati| nanva sūtreṇaivānenāvasya bahuvrīhitvādbhaviṣyati ṅīṣ, kimarthaṃ tarhīdam ? ityāha-- `pravṛddhā ca'ityādi| vigrahaviśeṣeṇa tatpuruṣaṃ darśayati| 54. svāṅgāccopasarjanādasaṃyogopadhāt| (4.1.54) `candramukhī' iti| candra iva mukhamasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| atra ca `prathamānirdiṣṭam' (1.2.43) ityādinā mukhaśabdasyopasarjanasaṃjñā| `atikeśī' iti| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| `eka vibhakti ca' (1.2.44) iti keśabdasyopasarjanatvam| `aṅga' iti| aṅgādibhya upasarjanebhyo ṅīṣ bhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimartham ? saṃyogopadhatvānṅīṣ na prāpnoti, tadarthametadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| tadidaṃ vyākhyānam-- uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāṅgādibhyaḥ saṃyogopadhebhyo ṅībbhavatīti| `adravam' iti| mukhanāsikābhyāṃ yo'bhiniṣkrāmati vāyuḥ sa prāṇaḥ, prāṇo'syāstīti, prāṇī, tatra yattiṣṭhati tatprāṇistham; mukhādi svāṅgamucyate| yadyevam, kapho'pi svāṅgaṃ syāt, tataśca bahukaphetyatra ṅīṣ prasajyeta ? ityata āha-- `adravam' iti| viśeṣaṇopādānānna bhavatyayaṃ prasaṅgaḥ, kaphasya dravātmakatvāt| evamapi jñānaṃ svāṅgaṃ bhavet, prāṇisthatvādadravatvācca, tataśca bahujñānetyatrāpi ṅīṣ syāt ? ityata āha-- `mūrtimat' iti| asarvagatāni yāni dravyāṇi teṣāṃ parimāṇaṃ hrasvādimadyat tanmūrttiḥ, sā yasyāsti tanmūrtimat| na ca tad‌jñāne'stīti;nirguṇatvāt| guṇānāṃ ca jñānasyātmaguṇatvānnāsya svāṅgatvaprasaṅgaḥ| yeṣāmapi kāṭhinyādisparśaviśeṣo mūrttiḥ, tanmatenāpi naiva jñāṃ mūrtimadbhavati, na hi jñānasya sparśo'sti| evamapi śophasya śvayathusaṃjñakasya svāṅgatvaṃ prāpnotyeva; yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatvāt| tataśca bahuśophetyatra ṅīṣ prasajyetetyata āha-- `avikārajam' iti| vikāraḥ - dhātuvaiṣamyam, bhūtaprakṣoma ityarthaḥ, tato jātaṃ vikārajam| na vikārajam - avikārajam| tadevaṃ viśeṣamopādānasāmarthyāt| śophasyāpi svāṅgatvaṃ na prāpnoti| yadi prāṇisthaṃ svāṅgaṃ bhavati, evaṃ tarhi rathyādipatitānāṃ keśānāṃ svāṅgatvaṃ na syāt, tataśca dīrghakeśī rathyeti na sidhyatītyata āha-- `atatstham' ityādi| tasmin prāṇini tiṣṭhatīti tatstham, na tatstham atatstham - aṇistham| evamapi keśādi svāṅgaṃ bhavati yadi tatprāṇini pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati| pratimāvayavānāṃ tarhi mukhādīnāṃ svāṅgatā na syāt, aprāṇisthatvāt, tataśca dīrghamukhī pratimeti ṅīṣ na syāt? ityata āha-- `tasya cettatathā' iti| tasya prāṇinastat svāṅgaṃ yathā yutaṃ yena prakāreṇa saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa sambaddhaṃ tathā tena prakāreṇāprāṇino'pi yadi sambaddhaṃ bhavatyevamapi tasya svāṅgatvaṃ bhavati| atha vā-- tasya cedaṃ prāṇinastat svāṅgaṃ tathā yadi yutaṃ sambhavati yathā prāṇinaḥ, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavati| anyeṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ- `tena cetattathā yutam' iti| tena prāṇinā yena prakāreṇa saṃsthānaviśeṣādinā sambaddhaṃ tathā yadyaprāṇināpi sambaddhaṃ bhavati, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavati| atha vā--tenāprāṇinā tanmukhādi yadi tathā yutam - sambaddhaṃ bhavati yathā prāṇinā, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavati| atha vā tena cenmuravādīnāṃ svāṅgena tadaprāṇisthaṃ dravyaṃ tathā yadi yutaṃ bhavati yathā prāṇidravyam, evamapi svāṅgaṃ bhavatīti| sarvathāyayamarthaḥ-- yādṛśaṃ prāṇino mukhādi svāṅgaṃ tādṛśameva yadyaprāṇino'pi bhavati svāṅgamevameva bhavatīti|| 55. nāsikodarauṣṭhajaṅghādantakarṇaśṛṅgācca| (4.1.55) `bahvajlakṣaṇe' ityādi| nāsikodarayoḥ| `na kroḍādibahvacaḥ' (4.1.56) iti bahvajlakṣaṇe pratiṣedhe prāpte vacanam| śeṣāṇām `asaṃyogopadhāt' (4.1.54) iti saṃyogopalakṣaṇe| `sahanañvidyamānapūrvalakṣaṇanastu pratiṣedho bhavatyeva' iti| nāsikodarayostāvadayaṃ yogaḥ `purastādapavādā anantarān vidhīn bādhante, nottarān' (vyā.pa.9) ityanantarameva bahvajlakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ bādhate, na sahādilakṣaṇam| oṣṭhādiṣvapi `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante' (vyā.pa.10) iti pūrvameva saṃyogopadhalakṣaṇam, tenāsau bhavatyevama-- sahanāsikā, anāsikā, vidyamānanāsiketi| `bimboṣṭhī' iti| bimbamivoṣṭhau yasyāḥ sā bimboṣṭhī-- `otvaṣṭhayoḥ samāse vā pararūpaṃ vaktavyam' (vā.687) ityaupasaṃkhyānikaṃ pararūpatvam| ye tu bimbauṣṭītyaukāraṃ paṭhanti te `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhiṃ kurvanti| `pucchācceti vaktavyam' iti| pucchāntācca prātipadikānṅīṣ bhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| kimartham ? saṃyogopadhādapi pucchāntādyathā syāt| vyākhyānaṃ tu cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvamāśritya karttavyam| `kalyāṇapucchī' iti| kalyāṇaṃ pucchamasyāḥ| `kabara' ityādi| kabarādibhyo yaḥ pucchaśabdastadantānṅīṣ bhavatīti| eṣo'pi tata eva cakārādvāgrahaṇasya vā vyavasthitavibhāṣātvallabhyate| kabaraṃ pucche yasyāḥ sā kabarapucchī| evaṃ `maṇipucchī, viṣapucchī, śarapucchī' iti| `saptamīviśeṣaṇe bahuvrīhau' (2.2.35) iti pucchasya pūrvanipāto na bhavati; `saptamyāḥ pūrvanipāte gaḍvādibhyaḥ paravacanam' (vā. 115) iti vacanāt| `upamānāt pakṣāt pucchācca' iti| nityamiti sambadhyate| etadapi pūrvoktāt kāraṇadvayāllabhyate| `pucchācceti vaktavyam' (vā.364) ityanenaiva siddhe punariha pucchagrahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham,nityārthaṃ vā| ulūkasyeva pucchaṃ yasyāḥ sā `ulūkapucchī' || 56. na kroḍādibahvacaḥ| (4.1.56) `kalyāṇakrīḍā' iti| kroḍāśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ| `kroḍāghāṭājihvāśirodharāsaṅgakulāspṛhāmāyā' iti liṅgakārikāyāṃ pāṭhāt| kalyāṇī kroḍā'syā iti vigrahaḥ| `striyāḥ puṃvat' (6.3.34) iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| uttarapadasya `gostriyoḥ' (1.2.48) ityādinā hrasvaḥ| tataḥ `svāṅgāccopasarjanāt' (4.1.54) ityādinā prāptasya ṅīpo'nena pratiṣedhaḥ tataṣṭāp| `mahālalāṭā'iti| `āmanmahat' (6.346) ityādinātvam|| 57. sahanañvidyamānapūrvācca| (4.1.57) `sakeśā' iti| saha keśairvartata iti| `tena saheti tulyoge' (2.2.28) iti samāsaḥ| `vopasarjanasya' (6.3.82) iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| `akeśā'iti| avidyamānāḥ keśā asyeti, `naño'styarthānāṃ bahuvrīhiruttarapadalopaśca' (vā.102) iti vidyamānaśabdalopaḥ| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kim, sahanañvidyamānādityevocyeta, etayā hi pañcamyā svāṅge viśeṣyamāṇe sahādipūrvatā labhyata eva ? naitadevam; pañcamī hi paratvena svāṅgaṃ viśeṣayet-- sahādibhyaḥ paraṃ yat svāṅgamiti| tataśca sahādibhyaḥ pareṇa svāṅgenānyasyāpi kalyāṇaṃ vidyamānamukhamasyā iti vigrahaḥ| atha vā-- vidyamānaṃ mukhaṃ yasya sa vidyamānamukhaḥ, kalyāṇo vidyamānamukho yasyā iti vigrahaḥ| pūrvagrahaṇe sati pūrvaśabdasyāvayavavācitvāt sahādipūrvatvena prātipadikaṃ viśeṣyata iti sahādyavayavaṃ yat svāṅgāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ tasmāditi vijñāyamāne nātra pratiṣedho bhavati, na hyetat sahādyavayavameva| kiṃ tarhi ? kalyāṇaśabdāvayavamiti na bhavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ|| 58. nakhamukhātsaṃjñāyām| (4.1.58) `sūrpaṇakhā' iti| `pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ' (8.4.3) iti ṇatvam| atha kathaṃ śūrpanakhī rākṣasīti ? asaṃjñātvāt| saṃjñāyāmityucyate, na ceyaṃ saṃjñā| tathā hi-- `pūrvapadāt' (8.4.3) ityādinā ṇatvaṃ na bhavati| yaugikastveṣa tasyā vyapadeśaḥ; śūrpākāranakhayogāt-- śūrpamiva nakho yasyāḥ śūrpanakhīti|| 59. dīrghajihvī ca cchandasi| (4.1.59) atha kimarthamīkārāntanipātanaṃ kriyate, na `dīrghajihvā cchandasi' ityevocyeta, evamucyamāne pratiṣedha prakaraṇāt pratiṣedho vijñāyeteti cet ? na; saṃyogopadhatvena prāptyabhāvāt, prāptipūrvakatvācca pratiṣedhānām| tasmāt sāmarthyādvidhireva vijñāsyata ityāha-- `nipātanaṃ nityārtham' iti| kalpitatvāt prakṛtasya ṅīṣa ihāpi vikalpita evāsau vijñāyeta, nipātanāt nityo bhavati|| 60. dikpūrvapadānṅīp| (4.1.60) `vidhipratiṣedha' ityādi| vidhiviṣayaḥ-- svāṅgamupasarjanasaṃyogopadhatvam, nāsikādi ca prātipadikam| pratiṣedhaviṣayaḥ- saṃyogopadhañca prātipadikam, `na kroḍādibahvacaḥ' (4.1.56) `sahanañvidyamānapūrvācca' (4.1.57) iti| etenaitat sūcayati-- `svāṅgāccopasrjanāsaṃyogopadhāt' (4.1.54) ityādi vidhiśāstramihānuvarttate, `na kroḍādibahvacaḥ' (4.1.56) ityādi pratiṣedhaśāstram, tena yatra viṣaye ṅīṣ vihitastatraiva ṅībvidheyaḥ| yatra tu viṣaye ṅīṣ pratiṣiddhastatra ṅībapi pratiṣidhyata iti| `yatra ṅīṣ vihitaḥ' ityādinā vidhi viṣayāpekṣayāḥ phalaṃ darśayati| kaḥ punarṅīpo vā viśeṣaḥ, yāvatobhayatra tadeva rūpam ? ityāha-- `svare viśeṣaḥ' iti| ṅīpo hi pittvādanudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti, ṅīṣastu pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvam| `prāṅamukhī' iti| ṛtvigādi (3.2.59) sūtreṇāñcateḥ kvin, `aniditām' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ, `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp--prācī| prācyāṃ diśi mukhamiti `dikśabdebhyaḥ saptamīpañcamī' (5.3.27) ityādināstātiḥ, `añcerluk' (5.3.30) iti tasya luk, `luk taddhitaluki' (1.2.49) iti strīpratyayasyāpi luk, `taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38) ityavyayatvam, `avyayādāpsupaḥ' (2.4.82) iti supo luk-- prāg mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā prāṅamukhī, `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) iti ṅakāraḥ| `prāṅ‌mukhā' iti| ṭāp| nanu ca ṅīpā mukte `svāṅgāccopasarjanāt' (4.1.54) iti ṅīṣā bhavitavyam ? naitadasti; ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--yatrotsargāpavādayorvibhāṣā tatrāpavādena mukta utsargo na pravarttata iti, yadayaṃ `pīlāyā vā' (4.1.118) iti vāgrahaṇaṃ karoti| yadyatrāṇā vikalpitena mukte `strībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) (iti) ḍhakāreṇa bhavitavyaṃ kiṃ vāgrahaṇena ? tasmādasmādvāgrahaṇādidaṃ jñāpyate-- yatrotsargo'pi vibhāṣā tatrāpavādena mukta utsargo na pravartata iti| kathaṃ punarutsargo vibhāṣā ? mahāvibhāṣayā| `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityaṇutsargaḥ, `strībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) iti ḍhagapavādaḥ; tena mukte yadyapi syādaṇ, kiṃ vāgrahaṇena ? netyevaṃ brūyāt, tatrautsargikāṇo nivṛttyartham| `iha na bhavati' ityādinā pratiṣedhāpekṣāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati| `prākkroḍā, prāgjaghanā' iti| atra hi `na kroḍādibahvacaḥ' (4.1.56) ityasyāpyanuvṛtterṅīṣ na bhavati| `prāggulphā' iti| atrāpyasaṃyogopadhā (4.1.63), `vahaśca' (3.2.64) iti ṇviḥ, ṇveḥ sarvāpahārī lopaḥ, pratyayalakṣaṇena `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ, ṅīṣ, `vāha ūṭh' (6.4.132) iti saṃprāsaraṇasaṃjñako vakārasyoṭh bhavati; `vasoḥ samprasāraṇam' (6.4.131) ityataḥ samprasāraṇānuvṛtteḥ| ṭhakāraḥ `etyedhatyūṭhasu' (6.1.89) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti pararūpatvam, `etyedhatyūṭhsu' (6.1.89) iti pūrvapadākāreṇa saihakādeśo vṛddhiḥ|| 62. sakhyaśiśvīti bhāṣāyām| (4.1.62) `sakhī' iti| sakhiśabdānṅīp| nāsyāḥ śiśurastīti vākyaśeṣeṇa bahuvrīhiṃ darśayannaśiśuśabdo yo bahuvrīhistasyāśiśvīti nipātyate| na tu tatpuruṣo yastasyeti darśayati| tatpuruṣe hi na śiśuraśiśurityevaṃ bhavati| `sakhā' iti| `anaṅ sau' (7.1.93) ityanaṅādeśaḥ, `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ| `sakhyaśiśubhyām' ityevaṃ vaktavye yannipātanaṃ kriyate, tasyaitat prayojanam-- tulyaśruteḥ śabdāntarasyāpi yathā syāt, saha khena yā varttate sā sakhīti|| 63. jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt| (4.1.63) jāseḥ prātipadikāditi sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatterjātivāci yat prātipadikaṃ tadihābhidhāne'bhidheyopacāraṃ kṛtvā jātiśabdenoktam, ata eva vṛttāvāha-- `jātivāci yat prātipadikam' iti| `astrīviṣayāt' iti| ananyatrābhāve'pi viṣayaśabdo varttate, ata eva vṛttāvāha-- `na cet striyāmeva niyatam' iti| na striyāmeva yasya bhāvaḥ, kintu striyāṃ cānyatra ca tadastrīviṣayam| jātirityucyate, keyaṃ jātirnāmeti praśnasyottaramāha--`ākṛtigrahaṇā' ityādi| ākriyate vyajyate'nayetyākṛtiḥ - saṃsthānamucyate| tathā hi-- durākṛtiḥ duḥsaṃsthānamucyate, svākṛtiśca susaṃsthānam| gṛhyate'nenetita grahaṇam, karaṇe lyuṭ| ākṛtirgrahaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā''kṛtikagrahaṇā, saṃsthānavyaṅgyeti yāvat| nanu cākṛtiśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyād‌grahaṇaśabdasya striyāṃ vṛttiriti `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīpā bhavitavyam, tadantena samāse kṛte `nadyṛtaśca' (5.4.153) iti kap, tataścākṛtigrahaṇīketi prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; grahaṇaśabdo hi pūrva karaṇasāmānye vyutpāditaḥ, paścādviśeṣeṇābhisambadhyate| tatra padāntarasannidhāne yastasya liṅgaviśeṣasambandhaḥ, sa ca bahiraṅga iti sāmānyaliṅgenaivāntaraṅgeṇa vākyaṃ kṛtvā samāsaḥ kriyate, yathā-- `mukhanāsikāvacano'nunāsikaḥ' (1.1.8) ityatra| tadanena lakṣaṇena sāmānyarūpā gotvādilakṣaṇā jātirityuktaṃ bhavati| gotvādayo hi viṣāṇādimatsaṃsthānavyaṅgyatvādākṛtigrahaṇāḥ| etena lakṣaṇena brāhṇatvādayo jātiviśeṣā na saṃgṛhītāḥ| na hi te saṃsthānavyaṅgyāḥ; tadāśrayasya saṃsthānasyābhinnatvāt| yādṛśaṃ hi saṃsthānaṃ brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyādeḥ saṃsthānamapi tādṛśamevetyato dvitīyaṃ lakṣaṇamāha-- `liṅgānāñca' ityādi| yāpi sarvāṇi liṅgāni na bhajati sāpyasaṃsthānavyaṅgyāpi jātiḥ, yathā-- brāhmaṇatvādiḥ| sā hi strīliṅgaṃ puṃliṅgaṃ ca bhajati-- brāhmaṇaeḥ, brāhmaṇīti, na tu napuṃsakaliṅgamityasarvaliṅgabhāgbhavati| brāhmaṇatvādiṣvapyudeśābhivyaṅgyatā'śrayaṇīyā, anyathā devadattaḥ, devadatteti liṅgadvayaṃ bhajati, atrāpi jātitvaṃ syāt. na cāyaṃ jātiśabda iṣyate, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃjñāśabdaḥ| vidhyarthañcedam | ataḥ sarvaliṅgabhājo'pi pūrveṇa lakṣaṇena jātitvamasti, yathā--taṭaḥ,taṭī, taṭamiti| sarvaliṅgaṃ bhajata iti sarvaliṅgabhāk, karmaṇyupapade `bhajo ṇviḥ'(3.2.62) iti ṇviḥ| nanu ca liṅgāpekṣayā sarvaśabda upapade bhajo ṇvipratyayo na prāpnoti, upapadāśrayatvā, upapadasamāsaśca asamarthatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathaiva hi devadattasya gurukulamityatrāsāmarthye'pi samāso bhavati, gamakatvāt; tathaivamubhayamapi bhaviṣyatīti| sā ca jātiḥ-- `sakṛdākhyātanirgrāhyā' iti| sakṛt - ekavāram, ākhyātā - upadiṣṭā, nirgrāhyā - niścayena grāhyā| etena jātidharmānekatvanityatvapratyekaparisamāptitvalakṣaṇān darśayati| sakṛdevāraṃ yasmāt kṛṣṇe dhavale vā gopiṇḍa ākhyātā tadvilakṣaṇe'pi gopiṇḍe nirgrāhyā, tasmādeva nityā pratyekaṃ parisamāptā ca| yadi hyekā na syāt, sakṛdākhyātā gauriti piṇḍāntare na gṛhyeta| yadi ca nityā na bhavet, piṇḍavināśe tasyā api vināśāt piṇḍāntareṇa na gṛhyeta| yadi ca pratyekaṃ sarvātmanā parisamāptā na syāt, tasminnapi tāvat piṇḍe sarvātmanā na gṛhyeta yatrākhyātā, kiṃ punaḥ piṇḍāntare ! aṃśena hi parisamāptau satyāmaṃśa eva parigṛhyate, na jātiḥ| najātyaṃśo jātirbhavati, anekatvaprasaṅgāt| tṛtīyaṃ jātilakṣamamāha-- `gotrañca' ityādi| `apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram' (4.1.162) iti gotraṃ pāribhāṣikam| iha tu laukikamapi gotramapatyamātraṃ gṛhyate| caraṇamadhyayanabhedenānekadhā| gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha jātirbhavati| gotraṃ nāḍāyanādi| yadyapi nāḍāyanatādi sāmānyaṃ gotravadeva kalpyate, tathāpi tat saṃsthānavyaṅgyaṃ na bhavati| sarvaliṅgabhāvaktvācca-- nāḍāyanaḥ pumān, nāḍāyanī strī, nāḍāyanaṃ napuṃsakamiti| ato gotrasya jātitvapratipādanasiddhaye gotrañcetyuktam| caraṇaśabdastvadhyayanakriyāsambandhena pravṛttatvāt| kriyāśabda eva jātiśabda ityatastadarthasya jātitvaptipādanāya caraṇaiḥ sahetyuktam| `kukkuṭī, śūkarī mayūrī' iti| ākṛtigrahaṇāyā jāterudāharaṇam| `brāhmaṇī, vṛṣalī' iti| asarvaliṅgabhājaḥ| `nāḍāyanī, cārāyaṇī' iti| gotralakṣaṇāyāḥ| naḍacaraśabdayoḥ `naḍādibhyaḥ phak' (4.1.99) iti phagapatye'rthe| `kaṭhī, bahvṛcī' iti| caraṇalakṣaṇayāḥ| `muṇḍā'iti| muṇḍaguṇayogāt| muṇḍo bhavatyeṣa ityastrīviṣayaḥ-- muṇḍo devadatta iti; puruṣe'pi muṇḍaśabdasya vṛtteḥ| na tu jātiśabdaḥ,kiṃ tarhi ? guṇaśabdaḥ|`makṣikā' iti| sarvadā striyāmeva niyatvāt strīviṣayo makṣikāśabdaḥ| `kṣattriyā' iti| gotramiha jātiḥ| `kṣattrāddhaḥ' (4.1.138) iti gotrāpatye ghavidhānādasravaliṅgabhāktvācca jātittvam| `kṣattriyaḥ' iti ca puṃsyapi vṛtterastrīviṣayaḥ kṣattriyaśabdaḥ| yopadhastu-- `yopadhapratiṣedhe hayagavayamukatsyamanuṣyāṇāmapratiṣedhaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punareṣa labhyate ? uttarasūtre cakāsyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt| tena hi hayagavayādibhyo ṅīṣvidhānādayaṃ pratiṣedho na pravarttate| `matsī' iti| `sūryatiṣyāgastyamatsyānām' (6.4.149) ita yalopaḥ| `manuṣī' iti| `manorjātāvañyatau ṣuk ca' (4.1.161) iti yatpratyayaḥ, ṣugāgamaśca| jātitvaṃ ca puraneṣāṃ hayagavayādīnāmākṛtigrahaṇādveditavyam|| 64. pākakarṇaparṇapuṣpaphalamūlabālottarapadācca| (4.1.64) `odanapākī' iti| odanasya pāka iti ṣaṣṭīsamāsaḥ| vyutpattimātrārthaṃ tvasau kriyate, na tvavayavārtho vidyate| samudāya eva hyayaṃ kasyāñcijjātau varttate| evaṃ `śahkukarṇī' ityadiṣvapi veditavyam|| 65. ito manuṣyajāteḥ| (4.1.65) `avantī, kuntī' iti| avantikuntiśabdābhyāmapatye'rthe `vṛddhetkośalājādāññyaṅ' (4.1.171) `striyāmavantikuntukurubhyaśca' (4.1.176) iti tasya luk, tato ṅīṣ| `dākṣī,plākṣī'iti| `ata iñ' (4.1.95) | sarvatra gotraṃ hi jātiḥ| `viṭ, darat' iti| viśo'patye'rthe `janapadaśabdātkṣattriyādañ' (4.1.168)| darado dvayañmagadhādisūtreṇāṇ (4.1.170), `ataśca' (4.1.177) iti tayoḥ striyāṃ luk| ihāpi gotraṃ jātiḥ| `tittiriḥ' iti| atrākṛtigrahaṇā jātiḥ| `udameyī' iti| `ata iñ'(4.1.95) gotramiha jātiḥ| `iña upasaṃkhyānam' iti| iñantānṅīṣa upasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| kimartam ? ajātyartham| ajātivācino'pīñantādyathā syāt| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- `itaḥ' iti yogavibhāgo'tra kriyate, teneñantādajātivācino'pi bhaviṣyatīti| tataḥ `manuṣyajāteḥ' ityayaṃ dvitīyo yogaḥ pūrvayogasyānityatvajñāpanārthaḥ|tena muṣyajātau nityam, anyatra tu yathādarśanam| kvacideva na sarvatra| `sautaṅgamī' ityādyudāharaṇam| syādetat-`ata iñ' (4.1.95) iti gotrāpatya evātreñ vihitaḥ, gotrañca jātireva, tat kimucyate--iña upasaṃkhyānamajātyarthamiti ? ata āha-- `sutahgamādibhyaḥ' ityādi| sutaṅgamena nirvṛtā nagarīti `vuñchaṇ' (4.2.80) ityādinā sutaṅgamāditvādiñ| `itaḥ' ita tapakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛttyartham| tena avantīśabdādayaṃ na bhavati| avantimicchati, `supa ātmanaḥ kyac' (3.1.8), `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ, avantī ya ita sthite kvip, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ| pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇādapṛktalopāt prāk `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yalopaḥ, paścāt `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti vakārasya| tataḥ avantī iti sthite yadi taparakaraṇaṃ na kriyeta, tato'smādapi syāta, tataḥ `halṅyābbhyaḥ' (6.1.68) iti sulopaḥ prasajyeta,tato'vantīriti na sidhyet|| 66. ūṅutaḥ| (4.1.66) `kurūḥ' iti| kurorapatyaṃ strī-- kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.172), `striyāmavanti' (4.1.176) ityādinā tasya luk| gotramiha jātiḥ| `brahmabandhūḥ' iti| brahma bandharasyāḥ, vīro bandhurasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| brahmabandhūvīrabandhūśabdau kasyāñcideva jātau varttete| jātitvaṃ punarasarvaliṅgabhāktvāt| tau hi strīliṅgapuṃlliṅgādeva, na napuṃsakaliṅgau| `utaḥ' iti taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham| na tu dīrghanivṛttyratham; ūkārāntas manuṣyajātivācino'bhāvāt| `ṅakāraḥ'ityādi| ūṅo yadi ṅakāro na kriyeta tadā `noṅdhātvoḥ' (6.1.175) ityasminnapi na karttavyaḥ syāt ; ṅākārānubandhavato'nyas kasyacidūkārasyābhāvāt| tataśca `nodhātvoḥ' ityucyamāne yavāgvā, yavāgvai ityatrāpi `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt' (6.1.174) iti tṛtīyādivibhakterudāttatvasya prāptasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt| nanu cārthavata ūkārasya grahaṇāt `arthavad‌grahaṇe nānarthakasya' (vyā.pa.1) ityanarthakasya na bhaviṣyati, yavāgūśabdo hi `sṛyuvacibhyo'nyujāgūjaknucaḥ' (da.u.10.4) ityāgūcpratyayānto vyutpāditaḥ, tatrāgūcchabda eva pratyayārthenārthavān, ūkārastvanarthaka eva ? naitadasti; yasmānna varṇagrahaṇeṣviyaṃ paribhāṣā vyavasthitā, varṇagrahaṇañcedam, ato nopatiṣṭhate| athopatiṣṭheta ? evamapi `kṛṣicamitanidhanisarjikharjibhya ūḥ' (da.u.1.164) ityūpratyayasya grahaṇaṃ syāt| tataśca kharjvā, kharjve-- ityatra pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyeta| tasmādviśeṣaṇārtho ṅakāraḥ karttavyaḥ| atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, nanu uṅevocyeta, `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101) iti dīrghatvena hi dīrdhasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati ? ityata āha-- `dīrghoccāraṇam' ityādi| yadi dīrgho noccāryeta tadā `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti paratvāt pakṣe kap syāt, atastadbādhanārthaṃ dīrgoccāraṇam| kathaṃ punardīghoccāraṇena kapo nivṛttiḥ ? brahmā bandhūrasyeti samāsādanantaramūṅ kriyatām ?uta kabiti ? tatra paratvāt kap syāt; dīrghoccāraṇenokārapraśleṣāt| punarvidhānaṃ tulyakālaprāptikaṃ svārthikatayā samānajātīyaṃ kabvidhimeva nivartayati, na svādividhim| svādayastūṅantādbhavantyeva; tyūṅorapi grahaṇāt; jñāpakādvā, `śvaśuraḥ śvaśravā' (1.2.71) itinirdeśāt| tena brahmabandhūriti nityamūkārānta eva bhavati, na tu kadācit kabantaḥ| `adhvaryuḥ' iti| adhvaramicchatīti kyac, `kyācchandasi' (3.2.170) ityupratyayaḥ, `kabyaghvarapṛtanasyarci lopaḥ' (7.4.39) ityakāralopaḥ| `aprāṇijāteśca' ityādi| aprāṇijātivācinaśca prātipadikādūṅ pratyayo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `paṅgośca' (4.1.68) ityatra cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāpraṇijāteśca rajjvādivarjitādbhaviṣyati| `alābūḥ, karkandhūḥ' iti| kaḥ punarasyoṅi satyasati vā viśeṣaḥ, yāvatobhayatra tadeva rūpaṃ sa va svaraḥ; tathā hi-- alābūśabda uṇādiṣūkārapratyayānta eva vyutpādyate, `kṛṣicamitanidhanisarjikharjibhya ūḥ' (da.u.1.164) `{iti varttamāne ṇit iti ca (da.u.1.168) nañi lambernalopaśca' (da.u.1.170) itinañpūrvāt `labi avasraṃsane ityasmādūpratyayaḥ' iti pāṭhena bhavitavyam| iti `varttamāne ṇit' iti ca `nañi lambernalopaśca' (da.u.1.170) iti nañpūrvāt `labi avasraṃsane' (dhā.pā.379) ityasmādūpratyayayaḥ, `idito num' (7.1.58) ityanena kṛtanumāgarūpasya nakāras nalopaśca vihitaḥ; karkandhūśabdo'pi `nṛtiśṛdhyoḥ kūḥ' (da.u.1.174) iti varttamāne `andūdṛnbhūjambūkaphelūkarkandhūdidhiṣūḥ' (da.u.1.176) ityūkārānta eva vyutpāditaḥ, tatkimarthamūṅ vidhīyate ? alābvā, alābvai-- ityatra `noṅadhātvoḥ' (6.1.175) iti vibhaktyādyudāttatvapratiṣedho yathā syāt| asati hi tasmin yathā khalapvau, khalapvaḥ- ityatra sa na bhavati tathehāpi na syāt|| 67. bāhvantātsaṃjñāyām| (4.1.67) 68. paṅgośca| (4.1.68) `śvaśurasyokārākārayorlopaśca' iti| ayaṃ tu `śvaśuraḥ śvaśravā' (1.2.71) iti nipātanādeva siddha iti na vaktavyaḥ|| 69.ūrūttarapadādaupamye| (4.1.69) `vṛttoruḥ' iti| vṛttau {parimaṇḍalā ūrū iti mudritaḥ pāṭha|} parimaṇḍalābūrū yasyāḥ sā vṛttoruḥ| lāghavārthamūrvantāditi vaktavya ūrūttarapadādityuktam-- yatra kevala ūrubda uttarapadaṃ tatra yathā syādityevamartham; anyathā hi yadyarvantādityucyeta,tadā svāmina ūrū svāmyūrū, hastina iva svamyūrū yasyāḥ sā hastisvamyūrurityatrāpi syāt, bhavati hyetadūrvantaṃ prātipadikam| uttarapadagrahaṇe tu na doṣaḥ, na hyetadūrūttarapadaṃ prātipadikam, kiṃ tarhi ? svāmyūrūttarapadam|| 70. saṃhitaśaphalakṣaṇavāmādeśca| (4.1.70) `saṃhitorūḥ' iti| saṃhitaśabdaḥ saṃśliṣṭavacanaḥ, saṃśliṣṭorurityarthaḥ| `sahitasahābhyāñceti vaktavyam' iti| sahita, saha -- ityetābhyāṃ paro ya uruśabdastadantācca prātipadikādūṅ bhavītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ghakāro'tra kriyate, sa cāyuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena sahitasahābhyāmapi bhaviṣyati| sūtra ādigrahaṇamūrūttarapadamityasyānuvṛtterliṅgam| anyathā saṃhitādiprātipadikebhya eva pratyayo bhavatītyeṣo'rtho vijñāyeta| satyāṃ hi svaritatvādevānuvṛttāvebhyo yatparamūrūttarapadaṃ satyapyasmin madhyapade tatraiva pratyayaḥ prasajyate;saṃhitasvāmyūruśabdāt, na saṃhitoruśabdāt| guṇabhāvādūruśabdasya na syādeveha viśeṣaṇam|| 71. kadrukamaṇḍalvośchandasi| (4.1.71) kadruśabdo varṇaviśeṣavacanaḥ, tataḥ `voto guṇavacanāt' (4.1.44) iti ṅīṣaḥ prāptasya `kharusaṃyogopadhayoḥ' (vā.349) iti pratiṣedhe kṛte prātipadikenānabhidhāne prāpte vacanam| kamaṇḍaluśabdasyāpyaprāṇivācitvāt `aprāṇijāteścārajjvādīnām' (vā.369) ityūṅa prāpte chandasi niyamārtham| atha vā-- ayaṃ rajjvādi,tataḥ pratiṣedhe sati prāptyarthaṃ vacanam|| 72. saṃjñāyām| (4.1.72) 73. śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn| (4.1.73) `baidī, aurvī' iti| bidaurvaśabdābhyāṃ `anṛṣyānantarye' (4.1.104) ityādinā'ñ, tadantād‌gotratvājjātitve jātilakṣaṇe ṅīṣi prāpte ṅīn vidhīyate| svare viśeṣaḥ| `aṇantā ete' iti| gotamaśabdādapatye'rthe `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇi' (4.1.114) ityādinā'ṇ, śeṣebhyastu tasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) iti| gautamaśabdādgaurādipāṭhāt ṅīṣapi bhavati| `ḍhagantā ete' iti| śubhrāditvāt| `kāmaṇḍaleyaḥ'iti| `ḍhe lopo'kadrvā' (6.4.147) ityukāralopaḥ| eṣāṃ `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīpi prāpte vacanam| `vātsyāyana' iti| vatsaśabdādgargādiyañantāt `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak| `mauñjāyana' iti| muñjaśabdāt `naḍādibhyaḥ phak' (4.1.99) iti phak| `jātiḥ' iti| gotralakṣaṇā| laukikamapi hi tatra gotraṃ gṛhyate| yuvāpi ca loke gotramucyate, tathā hi vaktāro vadanti-- gārgyāyaṇo gotreṇeti| `ḍhagantāḥ' iti| kekasaśabdasya śubhrāditvāt aḍhagantāññyaṅantādapi tāviti| kapiśiviśabdābhyāmapatye'rthe `vṛddhetkośalājādāññyaṅa' (4.1.171) iti ñyaṅ| `yaṅaścāp' (4.1.74) iti cāpi prāpte vacanam| `ehi, paryehi' iti| `īha ceṣṭāyām' (dhā.pā.632) ityasmādāṅapūrvāt paryādyāṅpūrvācca `{in ityevoṇādisūtram-- vṛttau tu sarvadhātubhyaḥ inpratyayo bhavati iti dṛśyate-da.u.} sarvadhātubhyaḥ' (da.u.1.46) itīnpratyayaḥ| bahvādiṣu `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' (ga.sū.50) iti pāṭhānṅīṣi prāpte vacanam| `yañantaḥ' iti| gargāditvāt| `yañaśca' (4.1.16), `prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ' (4.1.17) iti ṅīpi ṣphe ca prāpte vacanam| `{udapānaḥ iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} audapānaḥ'iti| udapānādāgata iti `śuṇḍikādibhyo'ṇ' (4.3.76) ityaṇ| utsādiṣvayaṃ paṭhyata iti tatrāñi kṛte nāsti viśeṣaḥ-- ṅīpo vā ṅīno vā, ubhayatrāpi hi `ñnityādirnityam' (6.1.197) ityādyudāttena bhavitavyamityetanmanasi kṛtvā''ha-- `śuṇḍikādyaṇantaḥ prayojayati' iti| `jātiḥ' iti| arālacaṇḍālayorasarvaliṅgatvāditi jātitvam| vataṇḍasya gaurādilakṣaṇe ṅīṣi prāpte vacanam| pratyayalakṣaṇena `yañaśca' (4.1.16), `prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ' (4.1.17) iti ṅīṣphayorbādhanam| vataṇḍasyāpatyaṃ strī `vataṇḍācca' (4.1.108) iti yañ, tasya `luk striyām' (4.1.109) iti luk| `bhogavadgaurimatoḥ saṃjñāyām' iti| saṃjñāyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ bhogavadgaurimacchabdābhyāṃ ṅīn bhavati| matvantatvāt `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīpi prāpte vacanam| nanu ca bogaśabdo ghañantaḥ, gauriśbadaḥ `ata iñ' (4.1.95) itīñantaḥ, tena dvāvapyetau ñitsvareṇādyudāttau| tābhyāṃ matup, pittvādanudāttaḥ| tathā ca bhogavadgaurimadbhyāṃ ṅīpi ṅīni vā vihite na kaścidviśeṣaḥ, tatkimarthaṃ tābhyāṃ ṅin vidhīyate ? ityata āha-- `ghādiṣu nityaṃ hrasvārtham' iti| `gharūpakalpa' (6.3.43) ityādiṣu nityaṃ hrasvo yathā syāditi tābhyāṃ ṅīno vidhānam-- bhogavatitarā, gaurimatitareti| yadi punarugillakṣaṇo ṅīpkriyeta,tataḥ `nadyāḥ śeṣasyāntayatarasyām' (6.3.44) ityanuvarttamāne `ugitaśca' (6.3.45) iti vikalpena hrasvatvaṃ syāt| athānenāpi ṅīni sati kasmādeva `ugitaśca' (6.3.45) ityanyarasyāṃ hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati, yāvatā bhogavadgaurimadbhyāmugidbhyāmevāyaṃ tsayā vikalpena hrasvatvaṃ bhavatīti | na cānena sūtreṇa yā vihitā sā nadyugitsaṃśabdanena vihitā bhavati; ugittvānāśrayaṇāt| saṃjñāyāmiti kim ? bhogavatī, gaurimatīti| `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp| atra ca ghādiṣu vikalpanaiva hrasvo bhavati-- bhogavatitarā , bhogavatītarā, gaurimatitarā, gaurīmatītareti| `nṛnarayorvaddhiśca' iti| nṛśabdasya `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5) iti ṅīpi prāpte vacanam| naraśabdasya `ajādyataḥ' (4.1.4) iti ṭāpi prāpte jātitvānṅīṣi vā| jātitvaṃ tvākṛtigrahaṇāt| vṛddhiśca tayorbhavati, sā ca nṛśabdasyālo'ntyaparibhāṣayā (1.1.52) ṛkārasyasthāne bhavati| naraśabdasya `yasyeti' (6.4.148) lope kṛte satyakārasya| nanu ca `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' (vyā.pa.63) iti rephasyaiva bhavitavyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vṛddheryā'ntaramā prakṛtistatra ṣaṣṭhī, yatra ṣaṣṭhī tatrādeśa ityakāraḥ sthānī jñāyate| putraśabdamatra kecit paṭhanti, na sa kevalaḥ stiyāṃ varttata ityayaṃ samāsanto gṛhyate| samāsānte ca varttamāno duhitṛśabdena samānārtho bhavan strīliṅgo bhavati-- pradyotaputtrī, śailaputtrīti| `yathoyogam' iti| yathāsambhavam|| 74. yaṅaścāp| (4.1.74) pakāro'tra `ṅyāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ,cakārastadavighātārthaḥ, evamubhayoranyatra caritārthayoḥ `anudāttau suppitau' (3.1.4) ityetadbādhitvā paratvāt `citaḥ' (6.1.163) ityantodāttatvaṃ cāpo bhavati| `ñyaṅaḥ ṣyaṅaśca sāmānyagrahaṇametat' iti| viśeṣakarānubandhānutsṛjya yatsāmānyaṃ yaṅamātraṃ tasyedaṃ grahaṇam| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ yujyate; yāvatā ñyaṅa eva tatra grahaṇaṃ yuktam, tathā hi-- so'patye vidhīyamānaḥ strītvaṃ vaktumasamartha iti strīpratyayamapekṣate, na tu ṣyaṅa, tasya striyāmeva vidhānāt ? naitadasti; yadi hi sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ na syāt ṣyaṅo ṅitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasya hyatra sūtre sāmānyagrahaṇeva prayojanam, nānyata kiñcit| tasmāt ṅitkaraṇasāmarthyāt ṣyaṅo'pi grahaṇaṃ bhavati| `āmbaṣṭhyā' ityādi| āmbaṣṭhasauvīrakosalaśabdebhyo'patye'rthe `vṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ' (4.1.171) iti ñyaṅ, tadantāccāp| `kārīṣagandhyā' iti| etat svādisūtre (4.1.2) vyutpāditam| `vārāhyā' iti| varāhaśabdāt `ata iñ' (4.1.95) | `bālākyā' iti| balākāśabdādbāhvādilakṣama iñ| ubhayatra `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādinā ṣyaṅādeśaḥ, tadantāccāp| `śārkarākṣyā' ityādi| śarkarākṣapūtimāṣagorakṣaśabdebhyo gargādiyañantebhyaścāp|| 75. āvaṭyācca| (4.1.75) `ṅīpi prāpte' iti| `yañaśca' (4.1.16) ityanena|| 76. taddhitāḥ| (4.1.76) `yuvatiḥ' iti| taddhitasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `kṛttaddhita' (1.2.46) ityādinā prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavati| atha `taddhitāḥ' iti na sambhavati bahuvacananirdeśaḥ, yathaiva hi `pratyayaḥ' (3.1.1) ityekavacananirdeśe'pi vakṣyamāṇānāṃ bahūnāmapi sannādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ sā saṃjñā bhaviṣyati, tathā'trāpyekavacanenaiva nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ ? ityata āha-- `bahuvacanam' ityādi| ekavacana eva karttavye yadbahuvacanaṃ kriyate tasyaitatprayojanam--anuktā ye taddhitā lakṣaṇavākyairanabhihitāsteṣāmapi parigraho yathā syāt| tataḥ `pṛthivyā ñāñau' (vā.376) ityādi na karttavyaṃ bhavati| bahuvacananenaivānuktataddhitaparigrahārthena teṣāṃ siddhatve mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇa etat prayojanam, anvarthasaṃjñā yathā vijñāyeta-- tebhyo hitāstaddhitāḥ| tadityanena laukikā vaidikāśca śabdāḥ pratyavamṛśyante; teṣāṃ vyutpādyatvena prakṛtatvāt tena tatraiva bhavantyaṇādayo yatra ca bhavantasteṣāmupakāriṇo bhavanti, nānyatreti| tenābhidhānalakṣaṇatvaṃ taddhitānāmupapannaṃ bhavati| atha taddhitādhikāraḥ strīpratyayānāmādita eva kasmānna kriyate ? kimeva sati bhavati ? taddhitānāmupapannaṃ taddhitānantatvāt prātipadikamiti `ṅyāpprātipadikāt' (4.1.1) ityatra ṅyābgrahamaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, `prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ' (4.1.17) ityatra ca taddhitagrahaṇam, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) itīkāragrahaṇañca;taddhita ityevaṃ siddhatvāt ? aśakyamevaṃ karttum; evaṃ hi kriyamāṇe tatra ṅyābgrahaṇasya yat pūrvaṃ prayojanamuktaṃ tanna syāt; ṅībṅīṣṅīnāñca ṅakārasyetsaṃjñā `ataddhite' (1.3.8) iti pratiṣedhāt| iha ca paṭvīti `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) iti guṇaḥ syāt| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu|| 77. yūnastiḥ| (4.1.77) `ṅīpo'pavādaḥ' iti| nakārāntatvāt `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5) iti prāptasya | athedantāt `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) iti ṅīṣ kasmānna bhavati ? amanuṣyajātitvāt| na hi yuvatiśabdo manuṣyajātivacanaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? vayovacanaḥ| tathā hi yauvanāvasthāyāmeva sa varttate, na bālyavṛddhatvāvasthāyām| na caivaṃvidhā jātiśabdāḥ,te hi sarvāvasthāsu vyuktiṣu jātinibandhanā varttante, gośabdādivat|| 78. aṇiñoranārṣayorgurūpottamayoḥ ṣyaṅ gotre| (4.1.78) iha `aṇiñoḥ' iti pratyayamātraṃ vā gṛhyate ? tadanto vā samudāyaḥ ? tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, `gurūpottamayoḥ' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyeta| na hyaṇiñorgurūpottamatvaṃ sambhavati, kasya tarhi ? tadantasya samudāyasya| tasmāddvitīyaḥ pakṣa āśrayituṃ yukta iti matvā''ha-- `gotre yāvaṇiñau vihitāvanārṣau tadantayoḥ prātipadikayoḥ' iti| yadi tarhi samudāyasyāṇantasyeñantasya cedaṃ grahaṇam, `anārṣayoḥ' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ na prakalpyeta; samudāyasya ṛṣādeva vidhānāt| aṇiñostu prakalpyata etadviśeṣaṇam; tayorṛṣādanyatar ca vidhānāt| `gotre' ityapi viśeṣaṇamaṇiñoreva yuktam, na samudāyasya; tathā hi `apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gautram' (4.1.162) iti paribhāṣikaṃ gotramiha gṛhyate,tatra cāṇiñāveva vihitau, na samudāyaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; samudāyasyaite viśeṣaṇe na sambhavata iti sāmarthyādekadeśayoraṇiñorvijñāyete| ata eva vṛttāvāha-- `gotre yāvaṇiñau vihitāvanārṣau' iti| ihāyaṃ ṣyaṅādeśo vā syāt ? pratyayo vā ? nanu ca ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśādādeśenaivānena bhavitavyamiti asandigdhametat, tadayuktā dvitīyapakṣāśaṅkā ? naitadasti; pratyayavidhāvapi ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśo dṛśyate, yathā-- `gāpoṣṭhak' (3.2.8) `vrīhiśālyorḍhak' (5.2.2) iti,tasmāt pratyayapakṣaśaṅkāpi yuktaiva| tatra yadi pratyayaḥ syāt, audamedheya iti na sidhyet| udameghasyāpatyaṃ strī-- `ata iñ' (4.1.95), tadantādanena ṣyaṅ, ikārasva yasyeti (6.4.148) lopa), `yaṅścāp' (4.1.74), audamedhyā, tasyā apatyamiti `strībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) , eyādeśaḥ| tasmin `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) iti yalopa iṣyate, sa na prāpnoti; anāpatyayakāratvāt| nanu ca `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) iti cet ? na; ītītyatrānuvarttate| ādeśapakṣe tvaṇiñorapatyatvāt tadādeśasyāpi ṣyaṅaḥ sthānivadbhāvenāpatyatvamiti sidhyati yalopaḥ| tasmādādeśapakṣa eva sādhurityabhiprāyeṇāha--`ṣyaṅādeśo bhavati' iti| nanu cādeśapakṣe'pyauḍulomyeti na sidhyati, lomaśabdo bāhvādiṣu paṭhyate| tas kevalasyāpatyena saṃyogo nāstīti tadantaḥ samudāyo gṛhyate, tata uḍulomno'patyaṃ strī--bāhvāditvādiñi kṛte tasya ca ṣyaṅādeśaḥ| tatra `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopa iṣyate, sa ca na prāpnoti;`ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168) iti prakṛtibhāvāt| pratyayapakṣe tviño vyavahitatvāt ṣyaṅaḥ prakṛtibhāvo nāstīti bhayati ṭilopaḥ| nana `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lope kṛte nāsti vyavadhānam| `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti lopasya (6.4.148) iti lope kṛte nāsti vyavadhānam| `acaḥ parasmin pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti lopasya sthānivadbhāvādastyeva| ādeśapakṣe'pyadoṣaḥ; ānupūrvyā siddhatvāt| na hyatrākṛte lope gurupottamatvaṃ sambhavati| tatra prāgeva ṣyaṅa iñi tasyaiva ṭilopaḥ, tato gurupottamatā| tataḥ ṣyaṅityānupūrvyā siddhatvam| ayaṃ tarhyādeśapakṣa doṣaḥ-- anekāltvāt sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti, `ṅicca' (1.1.53) ityantasya prāpnotīti cet ? naitadasti; apavādapratiṣedhāddhi sarvādeśaḥ prāpnotīti| `ṅicca' (1.1.53) ityantādeśaḥ kriyatām, āhosvidanekāltvāt sarvādeśaḥ, tatra paratvāt sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti, yathā-- `tuhyostātaṅṅāśiṣyanyatarasyām' (7.1.35) ? ityata āha-- `nirdiśyamānasya' ityādi| yathā pācchabdasya padityayamādeśo vijñāyate na pācchabdāntasya samudāyasya, tathā'yamapi nirdiśyamānayoraṇiñoreva vijñāyate| tat kva tarhi sarvādeśena bhavitavyam ? yatra samudāyāt ṣaṣṭhyuccāritā, yathā--tuhyoriti| `ṅakāraḥ sāmānyagrahaṇārthaḥ' iti| asati hi tatra `yaṅaścāp' (4.1.74) ityatra `vṛddhetkosalājādāññyaṅ' (4.1.171) ityasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na ṣyaṅaḥ| `ṣakārastadavighātārthaḥ' iti| tatra hyasatyekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvayanubandhakasya (vyā.pa.52) tyasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt, na ñyaṅaḥ| uttamaśabdo'yamastyeva vyutpannaṃ tamabantaṃ prātipadikam, astyavyutpannam| tatra yadi vyutpannasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ syādvārāhyeti na sidhyet; yasmādvyutapttimānuttamaśabdaścatuṣprabhṛtiṣvavatiṣṭhate| yathā hyucchabdādudgatābhidhāyinastamappratyayo'tiśāyane vidhīyate| anudgatañcāpekṣyodgato bhavati| triṣu ca dvāvudgatau,eko'nudgataḥ,na ca dvayorayaṃ codgata ityayamanayoratiśayenodgata ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ tamabutpadyate; tarapā viśeṣavihitena bādhitatvāt| caturṣu tu traya udgatāḥ, eko'nudgataḥ, tatar trīnudgatānapekṣyāyañcodgataḥ| ayaṃ caiṣāmatiśayenodgata ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ tamabutpadyate, tasmāccaturṣveva prāpnoti; tatra cottamaśabdasya svarūpasiddheḥ, tataśca vārāhyeti na sidhyet| na hyatra catvāraḥ santītyetadālocyāvyutpanno'yamihottamaśabdo gṛhyata iti darśayannanāha-- `uttamaśabdaḥ svabhāvāt' ityādi| adhyutpanna eva hyuttamaśabdaḥ svabhāvāt triprabhṛtīnāmantyamāha, na vyutpannaḥ| sa hi catuṣprabhṛtīnāmantyamāha, tasmāt `uttamaśabdaḥ svabhāvāt' ityādinā granthenāvyutpannasyottamaśabdasyeha grahaṇamiti darśitaṃ bhavati| tadevamavyutpannasya grahaṇe vārāhītyetadapi siddhaṃ bhavati| `ṭiḍ‌ḍhāṇañiti ṅībeva bhavati' iti| pramādapāṭho'yam| yathaiva hi baidīti jātitvādañantāt `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn' (4.1.73) iti ṅīn bhavati, tathehāpi ṅīnaiva bhavitavyam| jātitvaṃ tu gotratvāt| tasmāt `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn iti ṅīneva bhavati' ityayamevātra pāṭho draṣṭavyaḥ| `vāsiṣṭhī, vaiśvāmitrī' iti| `ṛṣyandha' (4.1.114) ityādini'ṇ| `aupagavī, kāpaṭavī' iti| upagukapaṭuśabdābhyāmautsargiko'ṇ, `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146)| `āhicchatrī| vaiśvāmitrī' iti| `tatra jātaḥ' (4.3.25) ityaṇ|| 79. gotrāvayavāt| (4.1.79) gotrañca tadavayavañceti gotrāvayavaḥ| iha tvabhidhāne'bhidheyopacāraṃ kṛtvā tadabhidhāyiprātipadikaṃ gotrāvayava śabdenoktam| nanu caivaṃ vigrahe viśeṣaṇatvādavayavaśabdasya nīlotpala iva nīlaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| rājadantāderākṛtigaṇatvādviśeṣaṇasya paranipāto bhaviṣyati| gotraṃ punariha laukikaṃ gṛhyate, na pāribhāṣikam| loke ca pradhānabhūta ādipuruṣaḥ svaprabhavasyāpatyasantānasya saṃjñākārī gotramucyate| tathā hi bharato nāma kaścidādyaḥ pradhānaḥ puruṣo'bhūt, tena sarva eva tatpūrvakāḥ puttrapauttrādayo bharatā iti vyapadiśyante| avayavaśabdo'yamastyevaikadeśe, tatsambandhādavayavīti samudāya ucyate| asti ca pṛthagbhāve--avayutiḥ - avayavaḥ, pṛthagbhūta ityarthaḥ| yadyapi yautirmiśraṇe paṭhyate, tathāpyanekārthatvāddhādūnāmavapūrvaḥ pṛtaghbhāvamācaṣṭe| astyapradhāne, yathā-- kulāvayavo'yam, saṅghāvayavo'yamiti| kulasay saṅghasya cāpradhānabhūto'yamiti gamyate| tatra yadeyakadeśavācī gṛhyate tadupādānamanarthakaṃ syāt, gotrādityeva vaktavyam| gotrādavayavo'pi hi gotraṃ bhavati, yathā-- kṣīrāvayavaḥ kṣīramiti| athāpi pṛthagbhāve gotrādanyatra varttamāno gṛhyate, evamapi puṇikādibhyo vihitayoraṇiño vihitau; aniṣṭañcaitat; tasyaikadeśavācini pṛthagbhāvavācini vākyaśabde doṣa ityatrāpradhānavācyeva gṛhyate| `gotrāvayavāḥ' iti| puṇikādiśrutīnāmetadviśeṣaṇam| apradhānagotrābhidhāyinya ityarthaḥ| `gotrabhamatāḥ' iti| gotramityevamabhimatā gotrābhivāyinya ityevaṃ loke prasiddhāḥ| na punargotrādhyāye paṭhitā ityarthaḥ| ata eva tāsāmapradhānyam; gotrādhyāye'paṭhitatvāt| `kulākhyāḥ' iti| kulam - gotram, ākhyāyata ābhirityākhyāḥ, gotreṇetyevamādi| `tataḥ' iti| yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭābhyaḥ puṇikādiśrutibhyaḥ| yadi tarhi tato gotravihitayoraṇiñoḥ ṣyaṅ bhavatyevaṃ satyapārthako'yaṃ yogaḥ, pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt ? ityata āha-- `agurupottamartha ārambhaḥ'iti| `pauṇikyā' ityādi| puṇikabhuṇikamukharaśabdebhyaḥ `ata iñ' (4.1.95) itīñantasya ṣyaṅaścāp|| 80. kroḍyādibhyaśca| (4.1.80) `kraujītyevamādibhyaśca striyāṃ ṣyaṅpratyayo bhavati' iti| nanu cāceśapakṣaḥ pūrvamāśritaḥ, tat kimarthamiha pratyayapakṣa āśrīyate ? tadāśrayaṇe'pyatra doṣo nāstīti pradarśanārthaḥ| `agurūpottamārtha ārambhaḥ' ityādi| ye'trāntā iñantāśca paṭhyante tān tyayamagurūpottamārtha ārambhaḥ| ye tvanye, tān pratyayamaṇiñarthaḥ| tatrādyāḥ krauḍyādayaḥ prāk caupayataśabdādiñantāḥ|caupayataprabhṛtayastvaṇantāḥ prāk saudhātakiśabdāt| saudhātakiśabdastu `sudhātorakaṅ ca' (4.1.97) itīñantaḥ| `sūta yuvatyām' iti| sūtaśabdādyuvatyāṃ prāptayauvanāyāṃ ṣyaṅ bhavati-- sūtyā, anyatra ṭābeva--sūtā| `bhoja kṣattriye' iti| bhojaśabdāt kṣattriyajātau vācyāyāṃ ṣyaṅa bhavati| jātilakṣaṇasya ṅīṣo'pavādaḥ--bhojyā, anyatra ṭābeva bhavati-- bhojā| tata- pare prāggaukakṣyaśabdādiñantāḥ| sa punargargādiyañantaḥ|| 81. daivayajñiśaucivṛkṣisātyamugrikāṇṭheviddhibhyo'nyatarasyām| (4.1.81) `gotre pūrveṇa nityaḥ' ityādi| yadā pautraprabhṛtāvapatya iñ vidhīyate tadā pūrveṇa `aṇiñoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādinā nitye prāpte vikalpyate| yadā tvanantarāpatye tadā'prāpta eva pakṣe vidhīyate|| 82. samarthānāṃ prathamādvā| (4.1.82) `svārthikapratyayavadhiścāyamadhikāraḥ'iti| svārthe prakṛtyarthe bhavāḥ svārthikāḥ , adhyātmāditvāṭ(vā.456) ṭhañ| svārthikāḥ pratyayā avadhirmaryādā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `prāgdiśo vibhaktiriti yāvat' iti| anena yataḥ pareṇa svārthikāḥ pratyayā avadhibhūtāḥ pravarttante tatsūtraṃ darśayan `prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ' (5.3.1) ityetatsūtrāt prāgayamadhikāra icyācaṣṭe| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ svārthikeṣvayamapyadhikāro na pravarttate ? ityāha-- `svārthikeṣu' ityādi| `samarthānām' iti| sambaddhārthānamāmityeṣo'rthaḥ| sambaddhārthatā ca dviṣṭhatvāt pratiyogini sati bhavati, svārthikānāñ‍ca prakṛtyarthādarthāntaraṃ na sambhavati yatpratyayāyanāya śabdāntaraṃ prayujyeta,yadapekṣayā ca samarthatā syāt| tasmāt samarthatāvā abhāvāt svārthikeṣu samarthānāmityetat tāvannopayujyate| ata eva pratiyogino'bhāvāt prathamādityetadapi nopayujyata eva| yadi hi pratiyogiśabdāntaraṃ syāt, tata āśaṅkā syāt-- kiṃ prathamāt pratyayaḥ ? uta dvitīyāditi ? tataśca tannivṛttaye prathamāditi vacanamanuvarttamānamarthavat syāt| asati tu dviītīye pratiyogini tadanuvṛttirnopayujyate| `vikalpo'pi tatrānavasthitaḥ'iti| aniyata ityarthaḥ| yataḥ kecit svārthikā nityameva bhavanti| tathā ca `aṣaḍakṣāśitaṅgvalaṃkarmālam' (5.4.7) ityādau sūtre bhāṣyakāraḥ parigaṇanaṃ kariṣyati-- `ke punarnityāḥ pratyayāḥ ? tamabādayaḥ prāk kāt, ñyādayaḥ prāgvunaḥ, āmādayaḥ prāṅamayaṭaḥ, bṛhatyā jātyantāt samāsāntāśca' iti| tatra `atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau' (5.3.55) iti tamapprabhṛtayo ye pratyayāḥ `prāgivāt kaḥ' (5.3.70) ityetasmāt prāk te nityāḥ| tathā `pūgāññyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt' (5.2.112) ityato ñyapratyayāt prabhṛti `pādaśatasya saṃkhyādervīpsāyāṃ vunma lopaśca' (5.4.1) ityato vunaḥ prāgye te nityāḥ| tathā `kimettiṅavyayaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe' (5.4.11) ityata āmprabhṛti prāk tatprakṛtavacane mayaṭo ye pratyayāste nityāḥ| tathā `bṛhatyā ācchādane' (5.4.6) iti yo vihitaḥ kapratyayaḥ`jātyantācchobandhuni' (5.4.9) iti ca yaścapratyayo ye samāsāntā ḍajādayaste sarve nityāḥ| tasmādvikalpaḥ svārthikeṣvanavasthitaḥ| tataśca vāgrahaṇamapi tatrānavasthitameva kvacidanuvarttate, kvacinnetyuktaṃ bhavati| iha prathamāditi viśeṣaṇaṃ prayogavākyasya ? lakṣamavākyasya vā ? yadi prathamaḥ ,tato laukike vākye padānāṃ prayoge niyamo nāstīti; pātramāhara, āhara pātramiti prayogāt| tataśca yadāpatyamupagoriti prayujyate tadāpatyaśabdāt prathamāsāmarthyāt pratyayaḥ syāt| nanu ca tasyetanena sūtropāttenānukaraṇapadena ṣaṣṭhyantena prathamenālaukikavākyasamavāyi paścānnirdiṣṭamapi padamanukṛtam, tat prathamatvāt prathamavyapadeśamāsādayati| tena yadāpyapatyamupagoriti laukikaṃ vākyaṃ prayujyate, tadopaguśabdādeva yathoktenaiva prakāreṇa labdhaprathamavyapadeśāt pratyayo bhaviṣyati; nāpatyaśabdāt| tadādye'pi pakṣe samāśrīyamāṇe na doṣa iti cet ? vārttametat; na hi mukhye prathame sambhavapisati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam| ataḥ satyapyupaguśabdasya gauṇena prathamatve mukhyāt prathamādapatyaśabdādeva pratyayaḥ syāt, nopaguśabdāt| pratipattigauravañca| dvitīye tu pakṣa eva doṣo nāvatarati; lakṣamavākyeṣu padānāṃ prayogasya niyatvāt| atastamāśrityāha-- `lakṣaṇavākyāni' ityādi| samarthānāṃ madhye prathamaḥ pratyayaprakṛtitvena nirdhārita iti, yathā-- kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannakṣīratameti, gavāṃ madhye kṛṣṇā gauḥ sampannakṣīratamātvena| yadi tarhi samarthānāṃ prathamāt pratyayo bhavati, evaṃ sati `tasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityatra tasyetyetatsarvanāma| sāmānyavāci prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭamiti sāmānyavācina eva pratyayaḥ syāt, na viśeṣavācinaḥ; prātipadikādupagvityādeḥ, na hi tallakṣamavākye prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭam ? ityata āha--`tasya' ityādi| `viśeṣalakṣaṇārtham' iti| viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthamityarthaḥ| yadi hi tasyetyedviśeṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ na syāt tadā samarthatā tasya na syāt| na hi tasyetyetat prakaraṇādyanapekṣaṃ viśeṣeṣvatiṣṭhachate| na ca viśeṣeṣvanavasthitenānenāpatyasya kaścidupakāraḥ kṛto bhavati; sambandhisāmānyasya sambandhiśabdatvāt, apatyaśabdenaiva gamitatvāt| tataścopākārabhāvāt samarthatā na syāt| ucyatecedam-- tasyeti| tasmāt sāmarthyādviśeṣopalakṣaṇārthatvaṃ tasyetyasya| tena ye viśeṣā upalakṣitāḥ - pratipaditānte sambandhyantaravyavacchedena viśiṣṭaṃ sambandhinaṃ pratipādayanta upakāriṇo bhavantītyupapadyate taiḥ saha sāmarthyam| tasmāt tasyetat sāmānyaṃ viśeṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ draṣṭavyam| tena tasya yat prāthamyaṃ tadviśeṣāṇāmupaguśabdādīnāṃ vijñāyate| tataśca tata eva pratyayo bhavati, na ca sāmānyavācinaḥ| `kambala upagorapatyaṃ devadattasya' iti| atropaguśabdaḥ kambalena saha sambaddhaḥ, nāpatyena| apatyaśabdasyāpi devadattaśabdena, nopaguśabdena| tasmādapatyaśabdena, sahopaguśabdasya sambandho nāstīti na tataḥ pratyayo bhavati| `vākyamapi hi yathā syāt' iti| asati hi vāgrahaṇe vākyenāpatyasyābhidhāne prāptetasminnarthe vidhīyamānaḥ pratyayastannivarttayet | nanu ca samāne'rthe śāstrānvito'śāstrānvitasya nivarttako bhavati, yathā-- `gamerḍoḥ' (da.u.2.11) ityanena śāstrānvito gośabdo'śāstrānvitasya gāvīśabdas samānārthasyaiva, na tu bhinnārthasya ḍitthādeḥ| na ca vṛttivākyayoḥ samāno'rthaḥ, vṛttau hyekārthībhāvaḥ sāmarthyam, vākye tu vyapekṣā ? naitadevam; satyapi hyetasminnarthabhede pradhānārtho na bhidyate, tathā hi-- upagorapatyamānayetyukte ya evārtho'patyātyavatsambandhaviśiṣṭaḥ sa ānīyate| aupagavamānayetyukte sa eva| pradhānāpekṣayaiva ca samānārthaḥ śāstranvito'śāstrānvitaṃ nivarttayati, anyathā hi gośabdo'pi gāvīśabdaṃ na nivarttayet| asti hi tayorapyarthabhedaḥ, tathā hi-- gośabdo gotvamācaṣṭe, gāvīśabdastu tathā, aśāstriyatvañca| tasmādasati vāgrahaṇe yathā gośabdaḥ satyapyapradhānārthabhede pradhānārthasya samānarthādgāvīśabdaṃ nivarttayati, tathā taddhito'pi śāstrānvito'śāstranvitaṃ vākyaṃ nivarttayet| tasmādvākyamapi yathā syāditi vāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| `yadyevam' ityādi| yadi vāgrahaṇena taddhitasya bhāvābhāvau kurvatā vākyasya bhāvaḥ kriyate, evaṃ sati yadā vākyaṃ nāsti tadā taddhitenaiva bhavitavyam| samāsavṛttirupagvapatyamityeṣaḥ taddhitavṛttyā bādhyeta| `naiṣa doṣaḥ' ityādi| gatārtham|| 83. prāgdīvyato'ṇ| (4.1.83) `prāgdīvyat' ityayukto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ , yāvatā `dīvyati' (4.4.2) iti vakṣyati, na tu dīvyaditi, tatra dīvyatīśabdasyāvadhitvenopādāne dīvyateriti nirdeśena bhavitavyam ? ityata āha-- `tadekadeśaḥ'ityādi| samastasya dīvyatiśabdasyāvadhitvenopādānāe sati na yujyetāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ, na tu samastasyopādānam, api tu tadekadeśasya dīpavyacchabdasyetyadoṣaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ dīvyadgrahaṇaṃ prāggrahaṇañcata, naṇityevādhikāraḥ kriyatām ? naivaṃ śakyam;evaṃ hi kriyamāṇe `strībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) ityevamādinā'dhikārāntareṇa vicchinanasyāṇaḥ `tena raktaṃ rāgāt' (4.2.1) ityevamādiṣu punargrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ jāyeta| avadhinādhikāraparimāṇa ākhyāte tadavadhikeṣvartheṣu sarveṣvayamabhyanujñāyata itipunaraṇgrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ na bhavati| tasmādadhikāraparimāṇajñāpanārthaṃ dīvyadgrahaṇaṃ tāvatkarttavyam| prāggrahaṇamapi karttavyameva tasyaivāvadhitvadyotanārtham| asati hi tasmin `dīvyato'ṇ' ityucyamāne prakṛtiraṇo dīvyacchabdo vijñāyeta| `triṣvapi darśaneṣu' ityādi| kathaṃ punariyamapavādaviṣayaparihāreṇāṇaḥ pravṛttirlabhyate, yāvatādhikāre tasmin sati pratiyogamupasthānādapavādaviṣaye'pyaṇ prāpnoti-- `ata iñ aṇ ca' iti, anyathā hi tasya tatropādānamanarthakaṃ syāt ? paribhāṣāpakṣe'pi prāgdīvyato'rtheṣvaṇityaviśeṣeṇa paribhāṣite sāmānyena paribhāṣā pravarttamānā kenāpavādaviṣayaṃ pariharet ? vidhāvapi prāgdīvyato yāḥ prakṛtayastāḥ sarvā ihaikadhyamupanīyāṇ vidhīyamānaḥ sarvataḥ pravartteta, anyathā sarvato vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt ? evaṃ manyate-- jñāpakādapavādaviṣaye na bhaviṣyatīti, yadayaṃ kvacidvāgrahaṇamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇañca karoti-- `pīlāyā vā' (4.1.118), `udaśvito'nyatarasyām (4.2.19) iti,tajjñāpayati-- nāpavādaviṣaye'ṇ bhavatīti| vidhau tu bhūyān parīhāraḥ| na hi prāgdīvyato yāḥ prakṛtayastābhyo'ṇ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? prāgdīvyato ye'rthāsteṣu| tatra samānārthe prakṛtiviśeṣādutpādyamāna iñaṇaṃ bādhiṣyata iti| atha kimarthamiyānavadhirupādīyate, na prāk ṭhaka ityevocyeta, `prāgvahateṣṭhak' (4.4.1) ityetasmāṭṭhakaḥ prāgityarthaḥ ? naivaṃ śakyam; `dadhnaṣṭhak' (4.2.18) ityevamādirapi ṭhagavadhitvena vijñāyate| `prāk kaṃsīyāt' ityevaṃ tarhi vaktavyam-- `kaṃsīyaparaśabdayoryañañau luk ca' (4.3.168) iti,tatra yaḥ kaṃsīyaśabdastataḥ prāgityarthaḥ ? evamapyaśakyaṃ vaktum; `dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) ityetayāpi kaṃsīyādutpadyeta, tataśca dvayoḥ kaṃsīyayorvikāro dvikaṃsa ityatra luṅna syāt| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu|| 84.aśvapatyādibhyaśca| (4.1.84) 85. dityadityādityapatyuttarapadāṇṇyaḥ| (4.1.85) `pattyuttarapadācca' iti| etenottarapadaśabdaḥ patiśabdenaiva sambadhyate, nānyairdityādibhiriti darśayati| etacca pratyāsattervyākhyānādvā labhyate| `yamācceti vaktavyam' ita| yamaśabdācca ṇyapratyayo bhavītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam| tatreyaṃ vyākhyā-- iha lāghavārthaṃ patyantāditi vaktavye patyuttarapadādita vacanamadhikavidhānārtham | granthādhikyādarthāviṣayaṃ bhavatīti| tena yamaśabdādapi ṇyo bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā-- pūrvasatrāccakāro'nuvarttate,tasmādanuktasamuccatayārthatvādbhaviṣyatīti| `vāṅamatipitṛmatām' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu tadeva granthādhikyādarthādhikyamāśritya cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthasyānuvṛttervā karttavyam| yāmyamityādiṣu yathāyogaṃ prāgdīvyatīyepatyādāvarthe ṇyapratyayaḥ| `pṛthivyā ñāñau' iti| ete ñādayaḥ-- `taddhitāḥ' (4.1.76) iti bahuvacanenānuktataddhitaparigrahārthena siddhyantīti na vaktavyāḥ| tatra pṛthivīśabdādyadā ñastadā ṭāp-- pārthivā, yadā tvañ tadā `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp--pārthivī| `bahiṣaṣṭilopaśca' ityādi| nanu ca `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ sāyaṃprātikādyarthaḥ' (vā.802) ityenaiva ṭilopasiddhiḥ, tatkimarthaṃ punarucyate ? ityata āha-- `ṭilopapavacanam' ityādi| `ārātīyaḥ' iti| anityatvājñāpanasya prayojanam| ārādbhavatīti `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114)| `sthāmno'kāraḥ'(iti)| sthāmanśabdasya kevalasyāpatyārthe prayogo nāstīti tadantasyākārapratyayo vijñeyaḥ| aśvasyeva sthāmāsyetyaśvatvāmā, pṛṣodāditvāt sakārasya takāraḥ| aśvatthāmno'patyamaśvatthāmaḥ, `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ| `lomno'patye' iti| lomaśabdo bāhvādiṣu paṭhyate, tasya kevalasyāpatyena sambandho nāstīti tadantavidirvijñāyate| atrāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ bahuṣviñi prāpte tadapavāda evākāro vidhīyete| uḍulomno'patyāni bahūnyuḍulomāḥ| `sarvatra' iti| apatye ca anyatra ca|atha vā-- prāgdīvyatīye cānyatra cārthe'jādipratyayaprasaṅgaṃ iti| ajādeḥ pratyayasya prasaṅgaḥ - prāptiḥ| tatra gośabdāt sarvatra yad bhavati| yadyevam, `ugavādibhyo yat' (5.1.2) ityatra gograhaṇaṃ kimartham ? asyaiva prapañcārtham| `gavyam' iti| gorapatyam, gavā caratīti vā| aṇaṣṭhako vā'jāderyatrārthe prasaṅgastatra yadbhavati, nānyatra| `gorūpyam, gomayam' iti| `hetumanu,yebhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ' (4.3.81), `mayaṭ ca' (4.3.82)| `ṇyādayaḥ' ityādi| lakṣamaśabdo nimittavacanaḥ,cihnavacano vā| arthaviśeṣo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya so'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇo'ṇapavādaḥ| tasmāt pūrvavipratiṣedhena ṇyādayo bhavanti| na cedaṃ vaktavyam; paraśabdasyeṣṭavācitvāt tenaiva siddhatvāt| ādiśabdena `utsādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.86) ityevamādayaḥ pratyayā gṛhyante| tatra ṇyasyāvakāśaḥ bhavati-- daityaḥ, vānaspatyamiti| ṇyaścāyaṃ sarveṣvapatyādiṣvartheṣu vidhīyata iti sāmānyapratyayo bhavatīti, ato nārthaviśeṣalakṣaṇaḥ| arthaviśeṣalakṣamasyāṇapavādasyāvakāśaḥ-- dulerapatyamiti `itaścāniñaḥṭa (4.1.122) iti ḍhak-- dauleyaḥ, ḍhagayamapatya evārthaveśeṣe vidhīyata ityarthaviśeṣalakṣaṇo bhavati| ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti-- diterapatyaṃ daityaḥ, vanaspatīnāṃ samūho vānaspatyamiti vā, ṇyapratyayo bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena| arthaviśeṣalakṣaṇāditi kim ? yo'ṇapavādo'rthasāmānyenārthaviśeṣe vihitaḥ sa paratvāṇṇyādīn bādhitvā bhavatyeva| uṣṭrapatirnāma pattram| tasyoṣṭrapateridamiti tasyedaṃ vivakṣāyām `pattrādhvaryupariṣadaśca' (4.3.133) ityañ-- auṣṭrapatyam, tasyedaṃlakṣaṇo hyayamañaṇo'pavādaḥ, na yo'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇastasya| arthaviśeṣā hyapatyādayo'rthāḥ| tasyedamarthastu sāmānyam, nārthaviśeṣaḥ| `kathaṃ vaiteyaḥ'iti| yadi ṇyādayo'rthaviśeṣalakṣaṇādaṇapavādāt pūrvavipratiṣedhana bhavanti, daiteya iti na sidhyati| atrāpi hi ṇyapratyayenaiva bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `ditiśabdāt' ityādi| ditiśabdo'yaṃ `do avakhaṇḍane' (dhā.pā.1148) ityasmāt `kticktau' (3.3.174) iti ktic, `dyatisyati' (7.4.40) ityādinettvamityevaṃ yadā vyutpādyate tadā `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' (ga.sū.50) iti ṅīṣ| athāvyutpannaṃ prātipadikaṃ tadā `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke' (ga.sū.51) iti| nanu `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.29) iti ditiśabdo gṛhyamāṇo ditīśabdamapi grāhayati, tataśca yathā ditiśabdāṇṇyapratyayaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena bhavati, tathā ditīśabdādapi tena bhavitavyamityata āha--`liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā'nityā' iti| anityatvaṃ punarasyāḥ `acprakaraṇe śaktilāṅgalāṃkuśayaṣṭitomaraghaṭaghaṭīdhanuḥṣu graherupapasaṃkhyānam' (vā.235) iti ghaṭaśabdoccoraṇādveditavyam|| 86. utsādibhyo'ñ| (4.1.86) `tadapavādānāñca' iti| iñādīnām| `vaṣkayā'se' iti gaṇe paṭhyate| tasyāyamarthaḥ- vaṣkayaśabdādañ bhavati, ase asamāse ityarthaḥ| pūrvācāryaiḥ samāsasya `sa' ityeṣā saṃjñā kṛtā| vaṣkayasyāpatyaṃ vāṣkayaḥ| asa iti kim ? `gauvaṣkayiḥ'| `ata iñ' (4.1.95) itīñeva bhavati| `udasthānāddeśe' iti| udasthānaśabdāddeśe vācye'ñ bhavati| udasthāne bhavo deśa audasthānaḥ| deśa iti kim ? udasthāno nāma kaścitpuruṣaḥ, tasyāpatyamaudasthāniḥ| `pṛṣadaṃśe' iti| pṛṣacchabdādaṃśe'bhidheya'ñ bhavati| pṛṣadoṃ'śaḥ pārṣadaḥ| aṃśa iti kim ? pārṣado'nyaḥ| aṇeva bhavati| kuruśabdo'tra paṭhyate, tasyāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ kaurava iti na sidhyati,yasmāt `kurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.151) `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.172) itica ṇyapratyayaḥ prāpnoti| añpratyayo hi sāmānyavihitaḥ, ṇyapratyayastu viśeṣavihitaḥ| sāmānyavihitaśca viśeṣavihitena bādhyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ayaṃ yogastayoryogayoranuvartiṣyate; tatrāpyapatye'rthe kuruśabdo'navakāśa ityañapi tato bhaviṣyati| apatyārthasya `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ vā kaurava iti bhaviṣyati| `grīṣmādacchandasīti vaktavyam' (iti)| grīṣmaśabdādacchandasyabhideye'ñ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimarthamityāha-- `iha mā bhūt' ityādi| chandasi triṣṭuvādau vācye sandhivelādisūtreṇa (4.3.16) ṛtvaṇeva yathā syāt, añmā bhūdityevamartham| tena graiṣmī triṣṭuvityañ na bhavati| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- veti varttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena grīṣmaśabdācchandasi vācye'ñ na bhavatīti| `vṛttaṃ gṛhyate' iti| yasya triṣṭujjagatītyādayo viśeṣāstadiha vṛttam; ataśchando gṛhyate, na vedaḥ|| 87. strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt| (4.1.87) `atra tāvat strīśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇam, na ṭābādistrīpratyayantasya śabdasya| tato hi `strībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) iti ḍhakaṃ vakṣati, tatsāhacaryāt puṃśabdo'pi taddharmaiva vijñāyate| tasyāpi svarūpagrahaṇeva| `pausnam' iti| `saṃyogānatasya lopaḥ' (8.2.23) iti lopaḥ| yadi prāgbhavanasaṃśabdanāt strīpuṃsābhyāṃ ऩñsanañau bhavataḥ, vatyarthe'pi tau syātām, tataśca strīvat, puṃvaditi na sidhyedityāha- `striyāḥ puṃvat' ityādi| yadayam `striyāṃ puṃvat' (6.3.34) iti nirdeśaṃ karoti tato jñāyate-- vatyarthe nañsnañau na bhavataḥ| nanu caitasmānnirdeśāt snañpratyayo vatyarthe na bhavatīti śakyaṃ vijñātum, na tu nañpratyayo na bhavatīti, tataśca strīvaditi na sidhyati ? ityata āha-- `yogāpekṣañca' ityādi| `puṃvat' iti nirdeśādayaṃ yogo vatyarthe na pravarttate-- ityavamarthamidaṃ yogāpekṣaṃ jñāpakam, na tu snañpratyayāpekṣam| tena strīvadityetadapi sidhyati|| 88. dvigorluganapatye| (4.1.88) `prāgdīvyataḥ' iti| tasya svaritatvāt| `na bhavanāt'iti| viparyayāt| dvigoriti pañcamī ceyaṃ syāt ? ṣaṣṭhī vā ? tatra yadi pañcamī, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt-- dvigoḥ parasyānapratyapratyayasya prāgdīyavyatīyasya lugbhavatīti| tataśca yathā dvigusaṃjñānimittasya lugbhavati-- pañcakapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ puroḍāśaḥ pañcakapāla iti, tathā yo dviragornimittaṃ na bhavati tasyāpi syāt-- pañcakapālasya puroḍāśasyedaṃ khaṇḍam| `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇ-- pāñcakapālamiti| tamimaṃ pañcamīpakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā, ṣaṣṭīpakṣamāśrityāha-- dvigoriti ṣaṣṭhī' iti| `dvigoryaḥ sambandhī' iti| yasya taddhitasyārthe `taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti samāhāradvigurvidhīyate sa dvigoḥ sambandhīti; arthadvāreṇa tadarthasya dvigusambandhitvāt| so'pi taddvāreṇa dvigusambandhī| `nimittatvena'iti| anena nimittanaimittikabhāvena yaḥ sambandho tasya lugbhavati, na tu paurvāparyabhāvena yastasyeti darśayati| etacca nimittanaimittikabhāvasyāntaraṅgatvāllabhyate| sa hi dvigorādyastaddhitena sambandhaḥ; tasmāt sa gṛhyate| paurvāparyabhāvastūttarakālamapi bhavatīti bahiraṅgo bhavati, ato na tasya grahaṇam| `pañcakapālaḥ' iti| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛta iti `taddhitārtha' (2.1.51) iti samāsaḥ, `saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ' (2.1.52) iti dvigusaṃjñā, `saṃskṛtam' (4.4.3) ityaṇ, tasya luk| `dvivedaḥ'iti| dvau vedāvadhīta iti pūrvavatsamāsaḥ, `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.1.59) ityaṇ| `dvaidevavattiḥ' iti| dvayordevadattayorapatyamiti `ata iñ' (4.1.95)| `pañcakapālasyedamiti pāñcakapālam' iti| atra saṃskṛtārthe yaḥ prathamaḥ pratyaya utpannaḥ sa eva dvigornimittam, na tu ya uttarakālaṃ tasyedamityarthavivakṣāyām| na hi tasyārthe viṣayabhūte dvigurvihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? saṃskṛtārthe yo vihitastasya| tenādvigunimittatvāt `tasyedam' (4.3.1120) iti yo vihitastasyeha lugna bhavati| `atha vā' ityādi| pūrvaṃ hi dvigoryastaddhito nimittaṃ tasya lugvihitaḥ, idānīṃ dvigoreva vidhīyata ityasti viśeṣaḥ| kathaṃ punardvigoreva lugbhavati ? ityata āha-- `dvigoriti sthānaṣaṣṭhī' iti| `nanu ca' ityādinānantarokaktavyākhyānaṃ vighaṭayati| `pratyayasya lukślulupaḥ' (1.1.61) itilugādikāḥ pratyayādarśanasyaitāḥ saṃjñā vihitāḥ, tato lugucyamāno'nena na śakto dvigoreva lukaṃ vidhātumityābhiprāyaḥ| `satyametat' iti| yadanantaramuktam| yadyevam, kathaṃ luksaṃjñāyā dvigorluglabhyate ? ityata āha-- `upācāreṇa tu' ityādi| atathābhūte vastuni yo'dhyāropitatathābhāvo jñānaviśeṣaḥ sa upacāraḥ| lakṣyate'nayeti lakṣaṇā, sāpunarihopacāra eva `etena hyadvigurūpastaddhito dvigurūpatayā lakṣyate| yathā mañcāḥ krośantītyatrāmañcarūpā api puruṣā mañcarūpatayā lakṣyante, tathehāpyadvigurūpastaddhito dvigurūpatayā| upacārasya tu nibandhanaṃ dvigunimittabhūtatvam, yadāha-- ` dvigunimittabhūtaḥ pratyaya eva dviguḥ' iti| bhavati hi kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ, yathā-- āyurghṛtamiti| `dvigunimittako'pi tarhi' ityādi| dvigurnimittaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| yo dharma upacārasya nibandhanaṃ sa iha guṇaśabdena vivakṣitaḥ| guṇanimittā kalpanā - guṇanimittakalpanā, sā punarupacārātmikaiva veditavyā| yadyupacāreṇa dvigornimittaṃ pratyayo'pi dvigurucyate, dviguryasya nimittaṃ so'pi gauṇyā kalpanayā kasmāddviguriti nocyate ? kārye'pi hi kāraṇaśabda upacārāt prayujyamāno vidyata eva, yathā-- purātanaṃ sarvamidaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ karma bhujyata iti| `pāñcakapālam' iti| pañcakapālasya puroḍāśasyedaṃ khaṇḍamityaṇ, sa ca dvigorutpannatvāddvigunimittaka ityabhiprāyaḥ| na tasya dvigutvaṃ nimittamiti niṣpannatvāddvagostaddhitasyotpadyamānasya na dvigutvaṃ nimittaṃ, kiṃ tarhi ? prātipadikam| tathā hi-- nāsau dvigurityevaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi ? prātipadikādityevam| tasmāt sannihitā'pi dvigutā na pratyayasya nimittamiti, na ca pratyayo dvigurityupacāreṇa vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyata iti| `itarastu' iti| taddhitapratyayaḥ, yas mūlodāharaṇe lugdarśitaḥ| `dvigutvasyaiva nimittam' iti| evakāreṇa prātipadikasya vyavacchedaḥ kriyate-- dvigutvasyaiva nimittam, na tu prātipadikatvasya; yatastadarthe dvigusamāso vidhīyate,na tu prātipadikatvamityasti viśeṣaḥ| tataśca dvigoryo nimittaṃ tatraiva dvigutvavyapadeśa upācārādbhavati| na tu niṣpannāddvigorya utpadyate tatrāpi| `yadyevam'ityādi| yadi dvigoryo nimittaṃ taddhitaḥ so'tra nimittatvādupācāreṇa dvigurucyate tasya lopo bhathavi| evaṃ satīha kathaṃ lopaḥ-- pañcakapālyāṃ saṃskṛtaḥ pañcakapāla iti ? atra hi pañcānāṃ kapālānāṃ samāhāra iti samāhāre dvigau niṣpanne tatastūttarakālaṃ taddhito vidhīyamāno na dvigornimittaṃ bhavati| `naivātra' ityādi parihāraḥ| kasmānnotpadyata ityāha-- `traiśabdyaṃ hi' ityādi| traya eva śabdāḥ - traiśabdyam| cāturvarṇyāditvāt svārthe ṣyañ| ihāsmābhistraiśabdyaṃ sādhyam| pañcakapālīśabdastaddhitotpattimantareṇāpi siddhatīti na tasmāt taddhita utpadyate| `pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ' ityādinā traiśabdyaṃ darśayati| `dvayoḥ śabdayoḥ' ityādi| yaśca samāhāre pañcakapālīśabdaḥ, yaśca taddhitārthaviṣaye samāse pañcakapālaśabdastau dvāvapi samānārthau,tayorekena pūrveṇa vigraha eveti tasmānna taddhitotpattirvijñeyā| `aparasmādutpattiḥ' iti| pañcakapālaśabdāt| avyavikanyāyena| yathā'vermāṃsamāvikamityaviśabdena vigrahaḥ,aviśabdastu pratyayamutpādayati tadvadihāpi| `atheha kasmānna bhavati' ityādi| rūpyamayaṭāvapi hi dvigornimittabhūtau, atastayorapi lukā bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `vetyanuvarttate' iti `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā'(4.1.82) ityataḥ| nanvevamapi sarvatra vikalpena luk prāpnotītyata āha-- `sā ca' ityādi| ca śabdo hetau| yasmāt sā vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate, tena pañcakapāla ityādau nityaṃ lugbhavati| pañcagargarūpyamityādau na bhavatyeva|| 89. gotre'lugaci| (4.1.89) `aci' iti| yadyeṣā parasaptamī syācchavidhāvitaretarāśrayatā prasajyeta| katham ? gargasyāpatyāni bahuni `gargādibhyo yañ' (4.1.105), tasya yadi luk syāccho na syāt| lupte'pi tasmin `pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam' (1.1.62) iti cet ? `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalopapratiṣedhād‌vṛddhyabhāvena vṛddhasaṃjñā na syāt, tataśca vṛddhalakṣaṇaccho na syāt| tasmād‌vṛddhatvaṃ prātipadikasya vāñchato'luk pūrva syāt| sa cāluka che parato yadi bhavati tataścālugvinimittaśchaḥ, tannimittaścālugitivyaktamitaretarāśrayatvam| tadimaṃ parasaptamyāṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣayasaptamīyamiti darśayannāha--`ajādau prāgdīvyatīye viṣayabhūte' iti| viṣayabhūte - anutpanna eva buddhistha ityarthaḥ| `gārgīyāḥ' iti| gargasyāpatyāni bahūni| gargāditvādyañ (4.1.105) | tasya gargāṇāñchātrā ityarthavivakṣāyāmajādāvanutpanne buddhyabhimukhīkṛte viṣayabhūte `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) itiyo luk prāpnoti tasyānena pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, tataścādivṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ tannibandhanāyāṃ ca vṛddhasaṃjñāyām `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.1.114) iti cchaḥ, īyādeśaḥ, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ, `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) ita yakārasya| `vāstīyāḥ' iti| pūrveṇa tulyam| `ātreyīyāḥ' iti| attrerapatyāni bahūni| `itaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti ḍhak, tasya `attribhṛgukutsa' (2.4.65) ityādinā luki prāpte'trīṇāṃ chātrā iti cche viṣayabhūte tasya pratiṣedhaḥ| `khārapāyaṇīyāḥ' iti| kharapasyāpatyāni bahūni| `naḍādibhyaḥ phak' (4.1.99), `yaskādibhyo gotre' (2.4.63)iti tasya prāptasya lukaḥ kharapāṇāṃ chātrā iti cche viṣayabhūte pratiṣedhaḥ| `kaubalam, vādaram' iti| kubalīvadarīśabdau gaurādiṅīṣantau pratyayasvareṇāntodāttau, tayoḥ śeṣamanudāttam| tena kubalyā vikāraḥ phalam, vadaryā vikāraḥ phalamityarthavivakṣāyām| `anudāttāderañ' (4.2.44) tasya `phale luk' (4.3.163) iti tayorlug yaḥ prāpnoti tasya kubalasyedaṃ vadarasyedamityarthavivakṣāyāmajādau che viṣayabhūte pratiṣedho na bhavati; gotragrahaṇāt| gotre yaḥ pratyayo vācakatvena varttate tasya lukaḥ pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam| na cāyamañ gotre vācakatvena varttate, api tu vikāre, tena tasya lugbhavatyeva| tasmin sati `luktaddhitaluki' (1.2.49) iti strīpratyayasyāpi luk| añi lupte vṛddhyabhāvād‌vṛddhatvaṃ nāstītyaṇeva bhavati, na tu cchaḥ| `gargarūpyam, gargamayam' iti| pūrvavadrūpamayaṭau| yadyatrāluk syādgārgyarūpyaṃ gārgyamayamiti syāt| `gārgīyam' iti| `tasmai hitam' (5.1.5) iti `prākkrītācchaḥ' (5.1.1) iti cchaḥ, sa ca prāgdīvyatīyo na bhavati; dīvyataḥ pareṇa vidhānāt| `gotrasya' iti| gotrapratyayasya | `bahuṣu lopinaḥ' iti| bahuṣvartheṣūtpannasya yasya lopo vidhīyate sa bahuṣu lopī| `bahuvacanāntasya pravṛttau' iti| pravṛttiḥ - arthāntarasaṃkrāntiḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- bahuvacanāntasyārthāntarasaṃkrāntāviti| sā cārthāntarasaṃkrāntāviti| sā cārthāntarasaṃkrāntistadantādyadā yūni pratyaya utpadyate tadā bhavatīti veditavyam; tadā gotrāntasya yūni pravṛtteḥ| `dvayekayoḥ' iti| yadā gotrapratyayāntādekasminnarthe yūni dvayorvā yūnoḥ utpadyate tadā'rthāntarasaṃkrāntau satyāmalugbhavati| bidasyāpatyānibahuni| `anuṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ña' (4.1.104) ityañ, sa ca `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti bahuṣu lugvidhānādbahuṣu lopī bhavati, tadantādyuvavivakṣāyāmekasmin yūni dvayorvā `ata iñ' (4.195), tasya ṇyakṣattriyādisūtreṇa (2.458) luki kṛte gotrapratyayāntasya tasyārthāntarasaṃkrāntau satyāṃ gotrapratyayasyāña ihāpi bahuṣūtpannasya lagna bhavati| kathaṃ punarna bhavati, yāvatā'luko viṣayābhāvāt prāgdīvyatīyo'jātiriñ pratyaya upanītaḥ ? pratyayalakṣaṇam' (vyā.pa.96) iti ca paribhāṣā| yathā gave hitaṃ gohitamiti caturthīsamāse subluki kṛte pratyayalakṣaṇena caturthīvibhaktimāśritya gośabdasya `eco'yavāyāvaḥ' ityavādeśo na bhavati; varṇāśrayatvāt| varṇāśrayatvaṃ tu tasyāci vidhānāt| yathā ca `varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇamṭa (vyā.pa.96) iti paribhāṣā, tathā baidaḥ, baidau-- ityatrāpyalukā varṇāśrayatayā na bhavitavyam ? naitadasti, na hyalugatra varṇāśrayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? taddhitāśrayaḥ| acītyetat tviha sūtre viśeṣaṇatvenoktam| ata eva vṛttāvuktam-- ajādau prāgdīvyatīye pratyaya iti| tasmāt tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā ihovasthāne'sati `gotre'lugaci' iti bhavatīti, anenaivātrāluk siddhaḥ| sa ca bahuṣu yuvasu mā bhūditi dvayekayorevetyupasaṃkhyānam| tatra bidā ityeva bhavati| `ekavacanadvivacanāntasya' ityādi| ekavacanāntatasya gotrapratyayasya dvivacanāntasya ca bahuṣvartheṣu yuvasaṃjñakeṣu pravṛttau saṃkrāntau satyāṃ lugvaktavyaḥ| tatra baidasyetyekavacanāntaṃ gotram, baidayoriti dvivacanāntam‌| atra ca pūrvavadañ, tayoryuvāpatyabahutvavivakṣāyām `ata iñ' (4.1.95) | tasya ṇyakṣattriyādisūtreṇa (2.4.58) luki kṛte'ño'pi gotrapratyayasya lugiṣyate| sa ca na prāpnoti, tasmādupasaṃkhyāyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na prāpnoti ? ityāha-- `na hyatra' ityādi| `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti anena hi bahuṣūtpannorlugvidhīyate, na cāñ huhaṣūtpanna,kiṃ tarhi ? ekasmin dvayośca, tasmānna prāpnotīti| tadevaṃ sarvathā bahuṣu bidā ityevaṃ bhavitavyamiti sthitam|| 90. yūni luk| (4.1.90) `yūni' iti| `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe saptamī| ata eva vṛttāvāha--`yuvapratyayasya' iti| ajādau pratyaye vivakṣite buddhisya ityādinā'cīti viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| yadyeṣāṃ parasaptamī syāt, yatrāpi cchapratyayo neṣyate tatrāpi syāt| yuvapratyayāntasya buddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| `phāṇṭāhṛtarūpyam, phāṇṭāhṛtamayam' iti| yadyatra luk syāt, phāṇṭāhṛtarūpyaṃ phāṇṭāhṛtamayamiti na syāt| `bhāgavittikīyam' iti| prākkrītīyacchaḥ (5.1.1) pūvavat|| 91. phakphiñoranyatarasyām| (4.1.91) `gārgīyāḥ, vātsīyāḥ' iti| pūrvapadakārayakāralopaḥ| `vā' (4.1.82) iti varttamāne'nyatarasyāṃ grahaṇaṃ `pūrvasūtre nityo vidhiḥ' iti jñāpanārtham|| 92. tasyāpatyam| (4.1.92) `pūrvairuttaraiśca pratyayairabhisaṃbadhyate' iti| tatra pūrvaistāvadaṇādibhiḥ sambadhyate; asaṃyuktavidhānāt| asya yadi pūrvairabhisambandho na bhavet `tasyāpatyamata iñ' ityekayogameva kuryāt| yatastu `ata iñ' (4.1.95) ityanena `tasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityetadasaṃyuktaṃ karoti, tato'saṃyuktavidhānātpūrvārthametadvijñāyata ityevaṃ tāvatpūrvairabhisambadhyate| uttarairapyabhisambadhyate; teṣvasya svaritatvāt| `tasya' iti| puṃlliṅgena nirdeśaḥ kriyate, ekavacanena ca| tena puṃlliṅgādevotpattiḥ syāt, ekavacanāntācca| strīliṅgānnapuṃsakācca na syāt-- devadattāyā apatyam, kulasyāpatyamevamādau na syāt| dvivacanabahuvacanāntācca-- dvayormātrorapatyam, tisṛṇāṃ mātṛṇāmapatyevamādau na syāt| atha napuṃsakaliṅgenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ ? strīliṅgāt puṃlliṅgācca na syāt| apatyamityekavacane'tra nirdeśaḥ kriyate, tenaikasminnevāpatye syāt, na dvayornāpi bahuṣu-- upagorapatye aupagavau; upagorapatyānyaupagavā iti| etasmin pūrvapakṣa idamāha-- `prakṛtyartaviśiṣṭaḥ' ityādi| `gṛhyate' iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| prakṛtyartha upagavādiśabdānāmarthaḥ,tena viśiṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭhyartho'patyāpatyavatsambandhaḥ| nanu ca tasyātra tacchabdasya sāmānyavācino grahaṇam, tasya kṛta upagavādirarthaviśeṣaḥ, yena ṣaṣṭhyartho viśiṣyate ? tasyetyasya viśeṣopalakṣaṇatvādadoṣāḥ| viśeṣopalakṣaṇatvaṃ cāsya prāgeva pratipāditam| tasmādviśeṣa evopagvādiḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ| `apatyamātrañca' iti | mātraśabdo'dhikasya liṅgādervyavacchedāya| `liṅgavacanādikam' iti| ādiśabdena kālasya
