grahaṇam| varttamānena hi kālenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate| yathoktam-- `yatrāpi sākṣādanyakriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate tatrāpyastirbhavantīparaḥ prathamapuruṣo'prayujyamāno'pyastīti gamyate' iti| tatra varttamānakālavivakṣāyāṃ kālāntare na syāt| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ liṅgavacanādi na vivakṣyate ? tasyāpradhānyāt| avaśyaṃ hi yena kenacilliṅgādinā nirdeśaḥ karttavya iti, nāntarīyakatvāt| tasyehopādānam, yathā-- dhānyārthinaḥ palālāderapradhānasyāpi| `tasyedam' ityādi| `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityetatsūtramapatyārthe'pi varttate| yo hyupagorapatyamupagorasāvayamiti śakyate vyapadeṣṭum| tasyedamityasya viśeṣā hyete-- apatyam, samūhaḥ, nivāsaḥ, vikāra iti| tataśca `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityanenaivāpatyārthe'pyaṇ siddhaḥ, tat kimarthaṃ tasyāpatyamityetat sūtraṃ kṛtam ? `bādhanārtham kṛtaṃ bhavet' iti| `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityanena vidhīyamānasyāṇo yo bādhakaḥ `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti cchaḥ prāpnoti, tadbādhanārthamidaṃ kṛtam| etatsūtravihitenāṇā chapratyayasya bādhanaṃ yathā syāt| kathaṃ punaraśaiṣikaḥ śaiṣikaṃ bādhate ? apatyādibhyaścaturarthīparyantebhyo'nyoṣaḍarthaḥ śaiṣikāṇāṃ viṣayaḥ| ayaṃ cāpatyācchaviṣaye nāstyeva| tadasannayaṃ kathaṃ chapratyayaṃ bādhiṣyata ityata āha-- `utsargaḥ śeṣa evāsau' iti| asatyasmin yoga ityabhiprāyaḥ| asāvityanena prakṛtatvāt tasyāpatyamityeṣo'rthaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| utsarga utpannenāpyaṇā sa evārtha utsargasāhacaryāducyate| utsargasāhacaryantu tasya tatrotsargasyāṇādervidhānāt| ihāpi kriyamāṇe `tasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityetasmin yoge `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityetasminnanupraveśādyathānyastadviśeṣaḥ śeṣo bhavati tathā'patyārtho'pi| asti tasyāpyupayuktāpekṣamanyatvam, `caturarthīparyanteṣvanantarbhāvāt| tataśca śeṣatvādapatyārthe cchapratyayaḥ prāpnoti| asmiṃstu yoge `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityatra śeṣe nānupraviśati; upayuktatvāt| tataścāśeṣatvādapatye chapratyayasya chapratyayasya prāptirnāstyeva| saivāprāptirbādhanaśabdenoktā| atha bādhanārthasyāsya kiṃ prayojanamityāha-- `vṛddhānyasya prayojanam' iti| vṛddhāni prātipadikānyasya yogasya prayojanam| bhānorapatyaṃ bhānavaḥ, śyāmagorapatyaṃ śyāmagava ityatrāṇ siddho bhavati| asati tvasmin yoke'patyārthaḥ pūrvoktarītyā śeṣaḥ syāt| tataśca tatra vṛddhebhyacaḥ `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) prasajyeta|| 93. eko gotre| (4.1.93) `kṛtrimākṛtrimayoḥ kṛtrime kāryasaṃpratyayaḥ'(vyā.pa.6) iti paribhāṣikasyaiva gotrasya grahaṇam| apatyādhikāre gotragrahaṇācca| apatyamātraṃ hi laukikaṃ gotram, tasya yadīha grahaṇamabhimataṃ syādeka ityevaṃ brūyāt, laukikasya gotrāpatyādhikārādeva labdhatvāt| tasmādgotragrahaṇācca pāribhāṣikasya grahaṇamatyāha--`apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram' iti| `bhedena' ityādi| bhedena - vibhāgena, apatyamapatyaṃ prati - pratyayatyam| yāvantyapatyāni sambhavanti tebhyo'pi sarvebhyaḥ pratyayānāmutpatteḥ prasaṅge prāptau satyāmityarthaḥ| sarveṣāmapatyena yogena gargagārgigārgyagārgyāyaṇānāmanyatamasya yadapatyaṃ tatsarveṣāmapatyaṃ bhavatīti paramaprakṛteranantaragotramuvalakṣaṇāḥ pratyayāḥ prāpnuvanti| gargasya yadapatyaṃ tatsarveṣāṃ gārgigārgyagārgyāyaṇānāmapi sambandhi bhavati| tathā hyatra yadyapi gargasyāpatyamiti gargaśabdena vigrahaḥ kriyate, tathāpi nāyaṃniyamo labhyate-- gargaśabdādevotpattiriti, api tu kāmacāraḥ| tataśca yadā gargaśabdādutpattirbhavati tadā gargāditvādyañ (4.1.105) , yadā gārgiśabdāt tadā `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak, yadāpi gārgyaśabdāt tadāpi sa eva phak, yadā gārgyāyamaśabdāt tadā `ata iñ' (4.1.95) | evaṃ pratyapatyaṃ vibhāgena pratyayānāmutpattau prasaktāyāmanena niyamaḥ kriyate-- `eka eva pratyayo bhavati' iti| etena pratyayaniyama iti darśayati| pratyayaniyamastvekastvekaśabdasya pratyayaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāllabhyate| ekaśabdaścāsminniyame saṃkhyāvacano veditavyaḥ yathā--ekaḥ,dvau, bahava iti| evakāreṇa dvayādivyavacchedaḥ kriyate-- eka eva pratyayo bhavati,na dvau, nāpi bahava iti| sa caikaḥ pratyayo bhavannekagrahaṇāt paramaprakṛtereva bhavatīti sāmarthyāduktaṃ bhavatīti| yadi hi gārgiśabdādutpadyet, dvau syātām-- iñphakau, naikaḥ ? atha gārgyaśabdādevamapi dvāveva-- yañphakau ? atha gārgyāyaṇaśabdāt, trayaḥ syuḥ-- yañphagiñaḥ| tasmānmūlaprakṛterevotpattāvekaḥ pratyayaḥ sidhyatītyekagrahaṇaṃ kurvatā sāmarthyānmūlaprakṛtereva gotrapratyayasyotpattiruktā bhavati| nanu cotpādayitaivāpatyena sambadhyate, evaṃ hi loke dṛśyate-- pitāmahasyotsaṅge dārakamāsīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaścit pṛcchati-- kasyāyamiti ? sa āha-- devadattasyeti, tenotpādayitāraṃ vyapadiśati, nātmānam ? tataḥ sarveṣāmapatyena yogābhāvāt pratyapatyaṃ bhedena pratyayotpattiprasaṅgo nāstyeveti nivarttyābhāvādidaṃ niyamārthaṃ nārabdhamityata āha-- `sarve'patyena yujyante' iti| atraivopapattimāha-- `apatanādapatyam' iti| yannimittaṃ hi yasay pāpeṣvapatanaṃ tadapatanāt tasyāpatyaṃ bhavati| tasmādyo vyavahitena janitaḥ so'pi paramaprakṛtivācyasyārthasyāpatyaṃ bhavati,tasyāpi yenāpatanāt| paramaprakṛtigrahaṇañcopalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam| itaraprakṛtivācyasyāpi hyarthasyāvyavahitajanito'patyaṃ bhavatyeva| yatpunaruktam-- kasyāyamityukte utpādayitāraṃ vyapadiśati, nātmānamiti, na tenotpādayiturevāpatyena yogaḥ, śakyate pratipādayitum| yasmānna tatra yasya tenāpatanaṃ sa jijñāsitaḥ syāt, kiṃ tarhi ? ya utpādayitāraṃ vyapadiśati nātmānam| yadi yasya tu tenāpatanaṃ sa jijñāsitaḥ syāt, tadā''tmānamapi vyapadiśedeva| yadi ca sarve'patyena na yujyeran, `apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram' (4.1.162) iti yo'yamapatyapautraprabhṛtiśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena nirdeśaḥ, sa nopapadyate; yadapekṣayā pautrādivyapadeśamāsādayanti pumāṃsastaṃ prati teṣāmanapatyatvāt| tasmādato'pi nirdeśāt-- sarve'patyena yujyanta iti vijñāyate| `tatputtro'pi gārgyaḥ' iti| apiśabdāt tatpautrādirapi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatputtro'pi gārgya ityāha-- `sarvasmin' ityādi| yadapi gārgyāyaṇa ityatraikena vyavahitena janitaṃ gotrāpatyaṃ yasmāt tatrāpi gargaśabdādyañeva bhavati, tasmāt tatputtro'pi gārgyo bhavati| gargaśabdādityanena paramaprakṛterbhavatīti darśayati| etaccaikagrahaṇāllabhyata ityuktam| `atha vā' ityādinā prakṛtiniyamaṃ darśayati prakṛtiniyamastvekaśabdasya prakṛtisāmānādhikaraṇyāllabhyate| ekaśabdo'tra prāthamyaniyame varttata iti veditavyam, yathā-- vargāṇāṃ prathamadvitīyāḥ saṃvṛtakaṇṭhāḥ śvāsānupradānā aghoṣā eke'lpaprāṇā itare sarve mahāprāṇā iti| atra hi prathame'lpaprāṇā iti gamyate| ekaśabdasyedaṃ vivaraṇam-- `prathamā prakṛtiḥ' iti| kā ca prathamā ? yā paramaprakṛtirapratyayāntā `garga naḍa' ityevamādikā| `prakṛtirniyamyate' iti| prathamaiva prakṛtiḥ pratyayamutpādayati, nāprathamā-- gārgigārgyagārgyāyaṇaprabhṛtiśabdāḥ pratyayāntāḥ| gargasyāpatyaṃ gārgyaḥ, tatputtro'pi gārgyaḥ| naḍasyāpatyaṃ nāḍāyanaḥ, tatputtro'pi nāḍāyanaḥ| sarvatra vyavahitajanite'pi gotrāpatye prathamā prakṛtiḥ pratyayamutpādayati|| 94. gotrādyūnyastriyām| (4.1.94) `ayamapi niyamaḥ' iti| na kevalaṃ pūrvaḥ-- ityapiśabdena darśayati| sarveṣāṃ hyapatyena yoge paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvabhyo'pi yuvāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ pratyayaḥ prāpnoti, atastannivṛttyarthaṃ niyamaḥ kriyate| `gotrādeva'iti| gotrapatyayāntādevetyarthaḥ| anena niyamasvarūpaṃ darśayati| `na parama' ityādinā niyamasya vyavacchedyam| `gārgyāyaṇaḥ, dākṣāyaṇaḥ' iti| gotre yau yañiñau vihitau tadantāt `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak| `aupagaviḥ' nāḍāyaniḥ' iti| gotre yāvaṇphakau vihitau tadantāt `ata iñ' (4.1.95)| `dākṣī' iti| vakṣasyāpatyaṃ caturtha strī| `ata iñ' (4.1.95), `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) iti ṅīṣ| `kiṃ punaratra pratiṣidhyate' iti| sarvasmin pratiṣidhyamāne doṣaṃ manyate| tameva doṣamāviṣkartumāha-- `yadi' ityādi| `striyāmaniyamaḥ prāpnoti' iti| paramaprakṛtyanantarayuvabhyo'pi striyāṃ yuvapratyayaḥ prāpnotītyarthaḥ| `gotrasaṃjñāyā yuvasaṃjñayā bādhitatvāt' iti| `jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā' ityatra tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ kṛtaḥ| tena abhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti| `tasmāt' ityādi| yata eva ca niyamayuvapratyayayorubhayorapi pratiṣedhe doṣaḥ, tasmāt tannirāsāya yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ| tatra ` gotrādyūni' ityeko yogaḥ, anena ca niyamaḥ kriyate, yadāha-- `gotrād yūni pratyayo bhavati' iti. tataḥ `astri yām' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ| tena ca yūnītyatra yaduktaṃ kāryaṃ tasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, yadāha-- `yūni yaduktaṃ striyāṃ tanna bhavati' iti| `yuvasaṃjñaiva pratiṣidhyate' iti| katham ? `astriyām' ityatra hi yoge yūnītyetadanuvarttate, tenaivaṃ vijñāyate-- yūni yaduktaṃ kāryaṃ striyāṃ tanna bhavatīti| yuvasaṃjñā ca yūnyeva kāryayuktetyataḥ saiva pratiṣidhyate| `yuvasaṃjñaiva' iti| evakāreṇa niyamayuvapratyayorvyavacchedaḥ kriyate| `tena strī gotrapatyayenābhidhāsyate' iti| tasyāṃ yuvasaṃjñāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ gotrasaṃjñāyā avicalatvāt|| 25. ata iñ| (4.1.95) `ataḥ'ityanena prakṛtaṃ prātipadikaṃ viśiṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyata āha-- `akārāntāt prātipadikāt' iti| athāta iti `ata sātatyagamane' (dhā.pā.34) ityasya kvibantasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate ? `śivādibhyo'ṇ' (4.1.112) iti vacanāt| taddhīño bādhanārthaṃ kriyate| yadi ceha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, śivādibhyaḥ prasaṅga eva nāstīti tebhyastadbādhanārthamaṇvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, krauḍyādīnāñceñantānāṃ pāṭhāt| tasmādakārāntasyaivedaṃ grahaṇam| yadyevam, asyāpatyamirityatra na prāpnoti, anakārāntatvāt ? etadapi vyapadeśivadbhāvenākārāntaṃ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `śubhaṃyāḥ, kīlālapāḥ' iti| yāteḥ, pibateśca `āto maninkvanibvanipaśca' (3.2.74) ityatra hi `vijupeśchandasi' (3.2.73) ityataścakāreṇa vijapyanukṛṣyate| `katham' ityādi| daśarathaśabdādapyakārāntadiñā bhavitavyam| tataḥ `dāśarathāya' ityaṇantasya prayogo nopapadyata iti bhāvaḥ| `śeṣavivakṣāyām' ityādi| etena daśarathasyāyamityarthavivakṣāyāmatrāṇa vihitaḥ, na tu `tasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityarthavivakṣāyāmiti darśayati| yadā tu daśarathasyāpatyamiti vivakṣyate, tadeñbhavatyeva-- dāśarathiriti|| 96. bāhvādibhyaśca| (4.1.96) `bāhaviḥ' iti| `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146)| `kvacit' iti| ajīgarttāviṣkārānteṣu| bāhuprabhṛtīnāṃ vaṭākuparyantānāmanakārāntatvāt prāptyarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| cūḍāśabdasya ca `dvaya caḥ' (4.1.121) iti ḍhaki prāpte| vṛkalādīnāṃ prāk puṣkarasacchabdāt `avṛddhābhyo nadīmānuṣībhyaḥ' (4.1.113) ityaṇi prāpte| puṣkarasadityevamādīnāṃ lomaśabdaparyantānāṃ prāptyarthaḥ, anakārāntatvāt| `amitaujasaḥ salopaśca' iti| amitaujasśabdādiñ bhavati, salopaśca| āmitaujiḥ| udañcviti paṭhyate, tatrāñcaterdhātoścakāro veditavyaḥ| nāyaṃ punarakārāntaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? kvinnantaḥ, pratyayavelāyāṃ nipātanādanunāsakilopo na bhavati| udīco'patyamaudañciḥ| śiraḥ śabdastadantavidhiṃ prayojayati, kevalasya napuṃsakasyāpatyena sambandhābhāvāt| hastiśiraso'patyaṃ hāstiśīrṣiḥ, `ye ca taddhite' (6.1.61) ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccalomno'patyam-- aurdhvalomiḥ| ajīgarttādīnāṃ prāgudaṅkaśabdāt `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇi' (4.1.114) ityādināṇibādhake prāpte| `udaṅkaḥ saṃjñāyām' iti| udaṅko nāma kaścit, tasyāpatyamaudaṅkiḥ| `sambhūyo'mbhasoḥ salopaśca' (iti)| sambhūyas, ambhasityetayoriñ bhavati, sakāralopaśca-- sāmbhūyiḥ,āmbhiḥ| `bāhvādiprabhṛtiṣu' iti| prabhṛtiśabdeneta ūrdhvaṃ ye vakṣyante te parigṛhyante| `yeṣāṃ darśanaṃ gotrabhāve laukike' iti| darśanaṃ - prasiddhiḥ| laukike gotre bhāvaḥ - saṃjñākāritvam| yeṣāṃ laukikagotrabhāve prasiddhisteṣāṃ bāhvādiṣu parigraho draṣṭavyaḥ | `tato'nyatra teṣāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| yeṣāṃ laukike gotrabhāve na darśanamapi tu tato'nyatra darśanam, teṣāṃ pratiṣedho veditavyaḥ| tena bāhurnāma kaścidādipuruṣo yaḥ saṃjñākāritvena prasiddho yadapatyasantānāntaḥ pātinaḥ pumāṃso bāhuvyapadeśamāsādayanti, tata eveñ bhavati| yastvidālīntano bāhurnāma kaścit tato'ṇeva bhavati-- bāhava iti| etacca vetyanuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāccalabhyate| sambandhiśabdānāñca śvaśurādīnāñca yatkāryamucyate tasya tatsādṛśyāt pratiṣedho bhavati| atrāpi pūrvokta eva heturveditavyaḥ| rājaśvaśurādyat' (4.1.137) iti śvaśuraśabdādyatpratyayaḥ sambandhiśabdādeva bhavati, na saṃjñāśabdāt| tena śvaśuro nāma kaścit, tasyāpatyaṃ śvāśuritīñeva bhavati| `saṃjñāśvaśurasya' iti| saṃjñayā yaḥ śvaśuraḥ, na sambandhena sa saṃjñāśvaśuraḥ|| 97. sudhāturakaṅ ca| (4.1.97) `vyāsavaruḍa' ityādi| vyāsādīnāmiñ, tatsanniyogena cākaṅādeśo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- pūrvasūtrāmiha cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ,tena vyāsādīnāmapi bhaviṣyati| `vaiyāsakiḥ' iti| `na yvābhyām' (7.3.3) ityādinaijvṛddhipratiṣedhau| atha bāhvādiṣveva sudhātṛśabdamadhītya tatra cākaṅādeśaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ, yathā-- amitaujasaḥ salopaśceti gaṇe paṭhyate ? sūtre vā, na tatra kaścillāghavābhāvādviśeṣo labhyata iti yatkiñcidetat|| 98. gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ| (4.1.98) `iño'pavādaḥ' iti| akārāntatvāt kuñjādīnām| `cakāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ'iti| yadyatra cakāro na kriyeta tataḥ `vrātacphañorastriyām' (5.3.113) ityatrāpi naiva kriyate, cphañpratyasyābhāvāt| tataśca `vātaphañorastriyām' ityucyamāne `aśvādibhyaḥ phañ' (4.1.110) ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt| `kauñjāyanyaḥ, kauñjāyanyau' iti| `pūgāññyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt' (5.3.112) ityataḥ `ñyaḥ' ityanuvarttamāne `vrātacphañorastriyām' (5.3.113) iti svārtha ñyaḥ| `kauñ‍jāyanāḥ' iti| `ñyādayastadrājā-' (5.3.119) iti tadrājasaṃjñakatvāt `tadrājasya bahuṣu' (2.4.62) ityādinā luk| kiṃ punaratra ñitvasvareṇa bhavitavyam ? uta citsvareṇa ? ityata āha-- `ekavacanadvivacanayoḥ' ityādi| ekavacanadvivacanayostāvat sati tasmin citsvare paścād ñye vihite samupajāyamāno ñitsvaraḥ satiśiṣṭo bhavatīti tenaiva bhavitavyam| bahuvacane tu ñye nivṛtte prāpte taṃ tyaktvā citsvara eveṣyate| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi sa labhyate, citkaraṇasāmarthyāditi cet na; ñitkaraṇasāmarthyād ñitsvaro'pi labhyate| evaṃ tarhi svaravidhau yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate,idamasti-- `citaḥṭa (6.1.163) iti; tataḥ `taddhitasya' (6.1.164) iti, tatra `citaḥ' ityevānuvarttate| kimarthamidam ? paratvāt `ñnityādirnityam' (6.1.197) ityādyudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti, tadbādhanārtham| tataḥ `kitaḥ' (6.1.165) iti, kitaśca taddhitasyānta udātto bhavati|| 99.naḍādibhyaḥ phak| (4.1.99) naḍādiṣu `śalaṅku śalaṅkañca' iti paṭhyate| tasyāyamarthaḥ- śalaṅkuśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati śalaṅkabhāvaṃ cāpadyate, tena śālaṅkāyana iti bhavati| `pailādiṣu 'iti| pailādiṣu śālaṅkiśabda iñantaḥ paṭhyate, tata utpannasya yuvapratyayasya lugyathā syāt-- `śālaṅki pitā, śālaṅkiḥ putraḥ' iti| tatra hi `ṇyakṣattriyārṣañitaḥ' (2.4.58) ityādeḥ sūtrāt `yūni luk' iti cānuvarttate, tasya śālaṅgiśabdasya tatra pāṭho na yujyate-- naḍādiṣu pāṭhāt phakā bhavitavyamiti kṛtvā, tat kathamiñantastatra paṭhyata iti codyam| tasya parihāramāha-- `gotraviśeṣe' ityādi| kauśikaṃ yadgotraṃ tatraiva śalaṅkuśabdādācāryaḥ phakaṃ smaranti, tato'nyatra tviñeva bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| sa tviñ bāhvāderākṛtigaṇatvāllabhyate| abhyupetyāpi gotramātre phako vidhānam| parihārāntaramāha-- `atha vā' ityādi| iño bhāva upalakṣaṇam| śalaṅkabhāvasyāpi hi pailādipāṭha eva jñāpakam| pūrvatrāpi parihāre tasya eva jñāpakaṃ veditavyam| `agniśarman vṛṣagaṇe' iti| agniśarmañśabdādvṛṣagaṇe gotre phagbhavati-- āgniśarmāyaṇaḥ| anyatrāṇeva-- āgniśarmaḥ| `amuṣya' iti paṭhyate| tatar nipātanādvibhakteraluk-- āmuṣyāyaṇa iti| `kṛṣṇaraṇau brāhmaṇavāśiṣṭhayoḥ' iti| kṛṣṇaraṇaśabdau yathākramaṃ brāhmaṇe vāśiṣṭhe cābhidheye phakamutpādayataḥ| kārṣṇāyano brāhmaṇaḥ| rāṇāyaṇo vaśiṣṭhaḥ| vaśiṣṭhagotra ityarthaḥ| anyatreñeva bhavati-- kārṣṇiḥ, rāṇiriti| `kroṣṭu kroṣṭañca' iti paṭhyate| kroṣṭuśabdaḥ phakamutpādayati, kroṣṭañcāpadyate -- krauṣṭāyanaḥ|| 100. haritādibhyo'ñaḥ| (4.1.100) `na ca' ityādi codyam| `satyametat' ityādi parihāra ucyate| gotre yo'ñ vihitastadantebhyo haritādibhyaḥ phak| na ca gotrapratyayādaparo gotrapratyayayaḥ sambhavati| tatra sāmarthyādagotrādhikāre'pi yūni pratyayo vijñāyate| yadyevam, gotrādhikāraḥ kimarthaḥ ? ityāha-- `gotrādhikāra uttarārthaḥ' iti|| 101. yañiñośca| (4.1.101) atha `dvīpādanusamudraṃ yañ' (4.3.10) iti yo yañ vihitaḥ, yaśca `vṛñchaṇ' (4.2.80)ityādinā sūtreṇa sutaṅgamādibhya iñiti tadantāt kasmānna bhavati, na hyatra kaścidviśeṣa upāttaḥ ?ityata āhaḥ-- `dvīpādanusamudraṃ yañ' ityādi| gotragrahaṇena hyatra yañiñau viśeṣyete-- gotre yau yañiñāviti| na ca `dvīpāt' (4.3.10) ityādinā gotre yañ vihitaḥ,kiṃ tarhi ? jātādāvarthaviśeṣe| nāpi sutaṅgamādibhyo gotre iñ vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tadasminnastīti deśe' (4.2.67,70) ityevamādiṣu caturṣvartheṣu, tena tadantānna bhavati| yadi tarhi gotragrahaṇeneha yañiñau viśeṣyete, na pratyayārthaḥ, evaṃ sati kvāyaṃ pratyayo bhavatīti na vijñāyata ityata āha--`tadantāt' ityādi| kasmāt tadityāha-- `gotrādyūnīti vacanāt' iti|| 102. śaradvacchunakadarbhād‌bhṛguvatsāgrāyaṇeṣu| (4.1.102) `gotra ityetat' iti| yadi tarhi gotra iti varttate, bhuguvatsābhyāṃ mūlaprakṛtibhyāṃ pratyayārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate, gotrapratyayābhyāmeva hi tābhyāṃ gotrāpatyaṃ pratyayārthaḥ śakyo viśeṣayitum,ata eva yuktaṃ syādvaktum-- bhārgavavātsyāyanāgrāyaṇeṣviti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;gotrādhikārasāmarthyāddhi gotrāpatya eva varttamānāviha gṛhyete, kārye kāraṇopacāraṃ kṛtvā| tāmeva gotrāpatye tayorvṛttiṃ darśayituṃ vṛttāvityuktam-- `śāradvatāyano bhavati bhārgavaścet, śaunakāyano bhavati vātsyaścet' iti|| 103. droṇaparvatajīvantādanyatarasyām| (4.1.103) `katham' ityādi| yadi gotrāpatye droṇādibhyaḥ phagbhavati, tatkathaṃ drauṇāyanaḥ, droṇataḥ pratītyevamādiṣu prayogeṣvanantaro'śvatthāmā ityucyate ? `naivātra' iti| nātredānīntano droṇastadanantarāpatye phakā droṇāyana iti, kiṃ tarhi ? `anādiḥ'iti| śrutisambhavadarśanārthamidamuktam| yena hetunāśvatthāmā drauṇāyana ityucyate tamidānīntanetyādinā darśayati| `idānīntanāttu'ityādi| anādidroṇavyavacchedaparametadveditavyam| na hi tāvadbhāratadroṇa idānīntano bhavati; cirātītatvāt| cirātīto'pyartho buddhau paribhāvyamāno varttamānatāṃ pratipadyate, yathā-- adya kaṃso hanyatām| idānīntanād droṇādapyaśvatthāmni droṇāyana ityevaṃ gotrapratyayena yadabhidhānaṃ tadadhyāropeṇa bhavati| avidyamānasyaiva tatrāsañjanamadhyāropaḥ| kasyādhyāropaḥ ? gotrasya | `śrutisāmānyāt' iti| adhyārope hetuḥ| anāderdroṇasyāśvatthānamnaḥ pituśca droṇa iti samānā śrutiḥ| ataḥ śrutisāmānyādanādidroṇāpatyasya yo dharmo gotratvaṃ tadbhāvaṃ bhāratadroṇāpatye'śvatthāmnyapi śrutisāmanyāccalitabuddhayaḥ pratipattāra adhyāropayanti| tenādhyāropeṇa droṇāyana iti tatrābhidhāṃ pravarttate|| 104. anṛṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ| (4.1.104) `ye punaratrānṛṣiśabdāḥ' ityādi| nanu ca sūtre ānantaryaśabdo bhāvapratyayānta upāttaḥ,tatraivaṃ vivaritavyam-- ye punaratrānṛṣiśabdāḥ puttrādayastebhyo'patyānantarya eva bhavati ? naitadasti; na hyayaṃ bhāve ṣyañ vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? svārtha eva, cāturvarṇyavat; anyathāpatyasya dharma ānantarye pratyayaḥ dharma ānantarye pratyayaḥ syāt, nāpatye, tatreṣyate ca| kathaṃ punargotrādhikāre satyanuṣibhyo'nantarāpatya eva pratyayo labhyate ? atra gotragrahaṇaṃ nivarttate| ṛṣiśabdebhyo'nantarāpatya eva svadityata āha-- `anṛṣyānantarya ityasyāyam' ityādi| `yadyayamarthaḥ' ityādi| asmin hyarthe satyanṛṣyānantarya ityetadviṣyartha bhavati; anṛṣeranantarāpatye pratyayavidhānāt| tataśca ṛṣyapatya ānantaryepratiṣedho na kṛtaḥ syādityāha-- `ṛṣiśabdo'traṛṣijātāvṛṣitve varttate| `apatyeṣu nairantaryam' iti| `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| paścādṛṣerapatyanairantaryamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tadāyamartho bhavati-- ṛṣitvasyāpatyeṣu nairantaryaviṣaye'ñaḥ pratiṣedho na kṛtaḥ syāt| atha vā-- ṛṣayaśca te'patyāni ca ṛṣyapatyāni, teṣāṃ nairantaryaṃ tadviṣaye pratiṣedho'ñaḥ pratyayasya na kṛtaṛ syādityarthaḥ| tatar ko doṣaḥ ? ityāha-- `tatredam' ityādi| sapta kāśyapā ṛṣayo'patyāpatyavatsambandhena parasapraṃ sambaddhāḥ, yeṣāṃ mittrahūrnāma kāśyapaḥ saptamaḥ, teṣāmuṣitvasyāpatyeṣu nairantaryam| tatra ṛṣyapatyānāṃ vā nairantarye viṣaye'ñaḥ pratiṣedha iṣyate,kāśyapānāmityetadrūpaṃ yathā syāt| añi sati tasya bahuṣu lopābhāvāt kāśyapānāmiti prāpnoti| sa ca pratiṣaedho'sminnarthe sati na prāpnoti, tataśca kāśyapānāmiti na sidhyati| tasmāt `anṛṣyānantarye' ityasya ṛṣyapatyanairantaryeṇa na bhavatītyeṣo'rtho vijñāyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `anantarāpatyarūpeṇaiva' iti| na cātra gotrāpatyaṃ vivakṣitam| kiṃ tarhi ? kiṃ tarhi ? anantarāpatyam| ato'nantarāpatyarūpeṇaiva ṛṣyaṇā ṛṣyandhakādiṣu (4.1.114) vihitena kāśyapānāmityabhidhānaṃ bhaviṣyati| etadeva draḍhayitumāha-- `avaśyañca' ityādi| ṛṣyapatyaṃ nairantaryaṃ viṣayo yasya pratiṣedhasya sa tathoktaḥ| ṛṣitvasyāpatyeṣu ṛṣyapatyānāṃ vā yannairarantarya tadviṣaye pratiṣedhe vijñāyamāna ityarthaḥ| `kauśiko viśvāmitra iti duṣyati' iti| kiṃ kāraṇam ? viśvāmitrastapastepe-- nānṛṣiḥ syāmiti, tatrabhavānṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ,sa punastapakṣepe --nānṛṣeḥ puttraḥ syāmiti, tatrabhavān gādhirapi ṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ; sa punastapastepe-- nānṛṣeḥ pautraḥ syāmiti; tatrabhavān kuśiko'pi ṛṣiḥ sampannaḥ| tadetadbhavati-- ṛṣitvasyāpatyeṣu nairantaryam,ṛṣyapatyānāṃ vānantaryam| tataśca ṛṣyapatyanairantarye na bhavatītyevaṃ vijñāyamāne kauśiko viśvāmitra iti na sidhyati| `parastrī paraśuñca' iti|parastrīśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati pareśubhāvañcāpadyate| parastriyā apatyaṃ pāraśavaḥ|| 105. gargādibhyo yañ| (4.1.105) `kathaṃ mānavī prajā'iti| gargādiṣu pāṭhādyañā bhavitavyam, tataśca mānavīti na sidhyatīti| lohitādilakṣaṇe hi yañantāttu ṣphe vihite mānavyāyanīti bhavitavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| gotramityucyate, gotre hi yañ pratyaya ucyate, nāpatyasāmānye| tena tatrautsargiko'ṇ mānavīti bhaviṣyati| `katham' ityādi| yadi gotramityucyate, tato yathā gargaśabdādanantarāpatye yañ na bhavati, tathā ca jamadagniparāśaraśabdābhyāmapi na bhavitavyam, tatkathamanantaro rāmo jāmadagnyaḥ, vyāsaḥ pārāśarya ityatra yañ bhavati ? `gotrarūpādhyāropeṇa bhaviṣyati' iti| yadānantarāpatyayorapi gotrarūpayo rāmavyāsayorvivakṣitatvādgotrarūpādhyāropaḥ kriyate, tadā yañ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| asato na yuktā vivakṣetyetacca na sambhāvanīyam; dṛśyate hyasato'pi vivakṣā, yathā-- vindhyo varddhitakaḥ, samudraḥ kuṇḍiketi| yadā tarhyanantarāpatyavivakṣā bhavati, tadā kena bhavitavyamityāha-- `antarāpatyavivakṣāyāṃ tu' ityādi| `vājā'se'iti| vājaśabdo yañamutpādayati| ase, asamāsa ityarthaḥ| vājyaḥ asamāsa iti kim ? sauvājiḥ|| 106. madhubabhvrorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ| (4.1.106) yadi tarhi babhruśabdasya gargādipāṭhādeva siddhe kauśike niyamārthamiha grahaṇam, evaṃ sati nārtho gargādiṣu pāṭhena, kauśike vidhyarthameva grahaṇamastu, nāsya ? ityata āha-- `gargādiṣu pāṭho'pi' ityādi| gargādiṣu pāṭho'pi karttavyaḥ| `sarvatra lohitara' (4.1.18) ityādināntargaṇakārya ṣpho yathā syāt| atha gaṇa e kauśikagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kṛtam, kaḥ punarevaṃ sati guṇo bhavati, sutre punarbabhrugrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati ? satyametat; `apāṇinīyatvāt' gaṇasya| naivaṃ cākaraṇe pāṇinirupālambhamarhati| gaṇakāreṇāpi hi kiṃ na kṛtam ? vaicitryārtham| vicitrā hi gaṇasya kṛtirgaṇakāreṇa|| 107. kapibodhādāṅgirase| (4.1.107) `kāpeyaḥ'iti| `itaścāmiñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti ḍhañak| yadi kapiśabdo gargādiṣu paṭhyate, niyamārthaṃ tviha tasya grahaṇam, evaṃ satyāṅgirase vidhyarthamevāsya grahaṇamevāstu,nārtho gargādiṣu pāṭhena ? ityata āha-- `lohitādikāryārthaśca' ityādi|| 108. vataṇḍācca| (4.1.108) kimarthamidam ? anarthakamidamityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha-- `yāvatā' ityādi| `śivādiṣvapi' ityādinā prayojanaṃ darśayati| yadīdaṃ nocyeta, tato gargādipāṭhādāṅgirase yathā yañ bhavati, tathā śivādiṣu pāṭhādaṇapi syāt| tasmādāṅgirase yañā śivādyaṇo bādhanaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punarvacanam| atha gargādipāṭhādeva siddhe, āṅgirase niyamārthametaditi kasmānnoktam ? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum; prayojanābhāve hi niyamārthaṃ bhavati| iha cāsti prayojanam, tacca darśitameva|| 109. luk striyām| (4.1.109) `vātaṇḍyāyanī' iti| lohitādilakṣaṇaḥ ṣphaḥ|| 110. aśvādibhyaḥ phañ| (4.1.110) `ye tvatra' ityādi| `eko gotre' (4.1.93) iti vacanādgotrapratyayāntādaparo gotrapratyayo nopapadyate| tatra sāmarthyādagotrādhikāre'pi ye gotrapratyayāntāḥ paṭhyante tebhyaḥ `gotrādyūnyastriyām' (4.1.94) iti yūni pratyayo vijñāyate| `śapa ātreye' iti| śapaśabdāt phañāttreyaścedbhavati śāpāyana āttreyaḥ, anyatra śāpiḥ| vailyaśabdo gotrapratyayāntaḥ, tasmādyūni bhavati | vilirnāma rājarṣiḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ gotram, `vṛddhetkosalājādāñ ñyaṅ' (4.1.171), vailyaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ vailyāyano yuvā| ānaḍuhyaśabdo'pi gotrapratyayānto gargādiṣu, yañantatvāt; tasmādapi yūnyeva phañ-- ānaḍuhyāyano yuvā| striyāṃ ḍhageva bhavati-- jātāyā apatyaṃ jāteyaḥ| `āttreya bhāradvāje'iti| āttreyaśabdāt phañ bhāradvājaścedapatyārtho bhavati-- āttreyāyaṇo bhāradvājaḥ, anyatra āttreyiḥ| `bhāradvāja āttreye' iti| bhāradvājaśabdāt phañ āttreye'patyaviśeṣe-- bhāradvājāyana āttreyaḥ, anyatra -- ṛṣyaṇ|| 111. bhargāttraigartte| (4.1.111) 112. śivādibhyo'ṇ| (4.1.112) `yathāyatham' iti| yathāsvam| yasya ya iñādirātmīyapratyayastadapadādo'ṇ vidhīyate| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na `śivādibhyaḥ' ityevocyeta ? `śivādibhyaḥ' etāvatyucyamāne yathāvihitamiñādireva pratyayo mā bhūt, aṇeva yathā syādityevamarthamiti cet; naitadasti; yathāvihitamiñādīn pratyayān pratyetadvacanamanarthakam; vināpyanena tatsiddheḥ| tasmādantareṇāpyaṇgrahaṇamaṇeva bhaviṣyati| nanu cāsatyaṇgrahaṇe phañaḥ prakṛtatvāt tasyaiva vidhirvijñāyate ? naitadasti; yadi hi śivādibhyaḥ phañ vidhātumiṣṭaḥ syāt, tato'śvādiṣveva teṣāṃ pāṭhaṃ kuryāt| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam-- ayamuṣṭiṣeṇaśabdaḥ śivādiṣu paṭhyate, tasya `senāntalakṣaṇakāribhyaśca' (4.1.152) iti ṇyapratyayaḥ prāpnoti| tatrāsatyaṇgrahaṇe punarvidhānamidaṃ tadbādhane kṛtārthamiti tato yathāvihitamiñeva syāt, nāṇ; tato'ṇeva yathā syādityaṇgrahaṇam| `udīcāmiñaṃ bādhitum' iti| `udīcām' (4.1.153) ityaneneñ prāpnoti, tatastaṃ bādhituṃ takṣanśabdo'tar paṭhyate| tathā tarhi takṣanśabdasyātra pāṭhādudīcāmiñ bādhyate, tathā `senāntalakṣaṇakāribhyaśca' (4.1.152) iti yo ṇyastasyāpi bādhā prāpnoti| tataśca `tākṣaṇyaḥ' iti na sidhyati ? ityāha-- `ṇyapratyayasya tu bādho neṣyate' (iti)| kathamaniṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati ? supiṣṭaśabdādibhiḥ sāhacaryāt| iha yastakṣañśabdaḥ supiṣṭamayūrakharadūratakṣannityevaṃ supiṣṭādibhiḥ saha paṭhyate, yathā teṣāñceñapavādārtho'tra pāṭhaḥ, taiḥ sāhacaryādasyāpīñapavādārtha eva pāṭho vijñāsyate| tatra śivādīnāṃ prāg bhūriśabdādiñapavādārthaṃ vacanam| bhūri, sandhi, muni-- ityeteṣāṃ `itaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti ḍhaki prāpte| kuṭhāra, anabhimlāna-- ityetayoḥ kakutstha-- ityemādīnāṃ prāg jaratkāruśabdādiño bādhanārtham| jaratkāruprabhṛtīnāṃ prāk supiṣṭaśabdāt `strībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) iti ḍhaki prāpte| supiṣṭādīnāṃ prāk takṣañśabdādiñaḥ| takṣannityasya kārilakṣaṇodīcāmiñaḥ| ṛṣṭiṣeṇasya senāntalakṣamasya ṇyasya ca bādhanārtham| gaṅgādipāṭ‌śabdayoryasminnaprāpta iha pāṭhaḥ sa vṛttikāreṇaiva vyākhyātaḥ| yaskādibhyaḥ prāg bhūmiśabdādiñi prāpte| bhūmiśabdasya `itaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti ḍhaki| ilāśabdasyāpi `{dvyacaḥ iti sūtram} dvyacaśca' (4.1.121) iti ḍhaki| emeva sapatnīśabdasyāpi `strībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) iti ḍhakyeva| `dvyaco nadyāḥ' iti| nadīvācakā ye dvyacastebhyo'ṇ bhavati, sandhyā-- sāndhyam, kulyā-- kaulyam| nanu cātra tannāmiko'ṇastyeva ? satyamasti; sa tu `dvyacaḥ' (4.1.121) iti ḍhakā bādhyate| tasmāt tadbādhanārthaṃ vacanam| `triveṇī trivaṇañca' iti| triveṇīśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati, trivaṇañcāpadyate| triveṇyā apatyaṃ traivaṇaḥ|| 113. avṛddhābhyo nadīmānuṣībhyastannāmikābhyaḥ| (4.1.113) śāstrāntare paribhāṣitamapi vṛddhamasti-- apatyamantarhitaṃ vṛddhamiti; iha śāstre'pi paribhāṣitaṃ vṛddhamasti `vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad‌vṛddham' (1.1.73) iti, ato vṛddhapratiṣedhe kasyacit sandehaḥ syāt-- kasya vṛddhasyāyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃsvit yadiha paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ? uta yacchāstrāntareṇa paribhāṣitaṃ tasyeti ? atastannirāsāya `vṛddhiryasya' 91.1.73) ityādineha śāstre yat paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam-- iha vṛddhaṃ yat paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam-- iha vṛddhaṃ yat paribhāṣitaṃ tasyāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti ? nadīmānuṣīnāmadheyasya gotrapratyayāntasyāsambhavāt| nadīgrahaṇe tviha laukikyeva nadī gṛhyate, na tu pāribhāṣikī| kuta etat ? laukikārthavṛttinā mānuṣīśabdena sāhacaryāt| atha svarūpagrahaṇameva nadīmānuṣīśabdayoḥ kasmānna bhavati ? vṛddhapratiṣedhāt| svarūpagrahaṇe hi vṛddhapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt; prasaṅgābhāvāt| bahuvacananirdeśācca na svarūpagrahaṇam| svarūpagrahaṇe hī nadīmānuṣīśabdayordvitvād‌dvicanenaiva nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| `avṛddhābhyiti śabdadharmaḥ syāt| yadi tarhyarthadharmo'yam, kathaṃ nadīmānuṣībhya ityanena prakṛtayo nirdiśyante, arthadharma eva hyevaṃ nirdiṣṭo bhavati, na prakṛtayaḥ? ityata āha-- `tena' ityādi| tenārthabhedopacārāt| nadīmānuṣyabhidhāyinyaḥ prakṛtayo nirdiśyante| `pratyayaprakṛtiḥ' iti| pratyayasya prakṛtiriti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `ḍhako'pavādaḥ' iti| avṛddhādīnāṃ nadīnāṃ manuṣīṇāṃ nāmadheyānāṃ strīpratyayāntatvāt| `vaitastaḥ, nārmadaḥ' iti| vitastānarmadāśabdābhyāmaṇ| `śaikṣitaḥ' iti| śikṣitāśabdāt| `sauparṇeyaḥ, vainateyaḥ' iti| suparṇāvinatāśabdau pakṣiṇīnāmadheye, na nadīmānuṣyau| `śaubhaneya-' iti| śobhanāśabdo varttate nadīmānuṣyarthaḥ, na tu saṃjñātvena, kiṃ tarhi ? viśeṣaṇatvena|| 114. ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca| (4.1.114) `iño'pavādaḥ' iti| nanu cānakārāntebhyo'tstryādibhyo ye ḍhagādayaḥ prāpnuvanti tadapavāda eva yukta ityata āha-- `attryādibhyastu' ityādi| ekenādiśabdena ṛṣayo jātasenādayo'ndhakādiṣu ca varttamānā ugrasenādayaḥ, parigṛhyante, dvitīyena ṇyādayaḥ pratyayāḥ| tatra ṛṣyaṇo'vakāśaḥ-- vāsiṣṭhaḥ, `itaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti ḍhako'vakāśaḥ--dauleyaḥ;attriśabdādubhayaprāptau paratvād ḍhagbhavati-- āttreyaḥ| ṛṣyaṇo'vakāśaḥ sa eva, senāntalakṣamasya ṇyasyāvakāśaḥ-- kāriṣeṇyaḥ, hāriṣeṇyaḥ;jātaseno nāma ṛṣiḥ, tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati-- jātasenyaḥ| andhakāṇo'vakāśaḥ--vāsudevaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva; śūraseno viṣvakseno nāma vṛṣṇiḥ, tasmādubhyaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati-- śaurasenyaḥ , vaiṣvaksenyaḥ| kurvaṇo'vakāśaḥ--nākulaḥ,ṇyasya sa eva; ugraseno nāmāndhakaḥ,tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati-- augrasenyaḥ| vṛṣṇyaṇo'vakāśaḥ-- vāsudevaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva; śūraseno viṣvakseno nāma vṛṣṇiḥ, tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati-- śaurasenyaḥ, vaiṣvaksenyaḥ| kurvaṇo'vakāśaḥ--nākulaḥ, ṇyasya sa eva; bhīmaseno nāma kuruḥ, tasmādubhayaprāptau paratvāṇṇyo bhavati-- bhaimasenyaḥ| `kathaṃ punaḥ' ityādi codyam| `kecidāhuḥ' ityādi codyaparihāraḥ| `kākatālīyam' iti| abuddhipūrvakamityarthaḥ| `saṅkalitāḥ' iti| samuccitāḥ| `nityā eva' iti| andhakādīnāṃ vaṃśānāmanāditvāt|| 115. māturutsaṃkhyāsambhadrūparvāyāḥ| (4.1.115) `dvaimāturaḥ'iti| prāk taddhitārthe viṣaye dvikuḥ, paścāt taddhitaḥ| `sāmmāturaḥ' iti| pūrvaṃ prādisamāsaḥ, paścāt taddhitaḥ|`bhādramāturaḥ' iti| pūrvaṃ viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ; tatastaddhitaḥ| atha pratyayārtha vacanaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- `pratyayaḥ punaḥ' ityādi| utsargalakṣaṇenaiva `tasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityanena| nanu ca saṃkhyādipūrvatvaṃ mātṛśabdasya viśeṣaṇam, tatra mātṛśabdāpekṣayā nirdeśaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ puṃlliṅga eva dṛśyate, tatkathaṃ `saṃkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ' iti strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ ? ityata āha-- `strīliṅganirdeśo'rthāpekṣaḥ' iti| mātuḥ śabdasya yo'rthastadapekṣo'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, sa cārthaḥ strīliṅgaḥ| tena strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| `tena' ityādinārthāpekṣasya phalaṃ darśayati| arthāpekṣe hi strīliṅganirdeśe strīliṅgo yasyārtho mātṛśabdasya , tasyaiva grahaṇena bhavitavyam, tena dhānayamāturgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati| na hi tasya strīliṅgo'rthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? puṃlliṅgaḥ| dhānyaṃ mimīte yo bhṛtakaḥ sa dhānyamātetyucyate| `saumātraḥ' iti| prāk prādisamāsaḥ| tata autsargiko'ṇ|| 116. kanyāyāḥ kanīna ca| (4.1.116) 117. vikarṇaśuṅgacchagalādvatsabharadvājāttriṣu| (4.1.117) atra vatsabharadvājāstriśabdā vātsyabhāradvājāttreyeṣu gotraviśeṣeṣu labdhavṛttaya upāttā iti| ata evāha-- `vaikarṇo bhavati vātsyaśceta, śauṅgo bhavati bāradvājaścet, cāgalo bhavatyāttreyaścet' iti| sā punasteṣāṃ gotrāpatye vṛttiḥ kārye kāraṇīpacārādveditavyā| `dvayamapi caitat pramāṇam' iti| kathaṃ punaḥ parasparaviruddhamapi pramāṇaṃ bhavati ? ityāśaṅkyāha-- `ubhayathā hyetat sūtramācāryeṇa praṇītam, tasmāt ko virodhaḥ|| 118. pīlāyā vā| (4.1.118) 119. ḍhakca maṇḍūkāt| (4.1.119) 120. strībhyo ḍhak| (4.1.120) `iha strīgrahaṇena ṭābādistrīpratyayāntāḥ śabdāḥ gṛhyante' iti| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? bahuvacananirdeśāt| svarūpagrahaṇe hi tasyaikatvādekavacanenaiva nirdeśaṃ kuryāt| stryarthamātrasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? vimātṛśabdasya stryarthasya śubhrādiṣu pāṭhāt| yadyatra stryarthamātrasya strīśabdasya grahaṇaṃ syāt, tasya śubhrādiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt, anenaiva ḍhakaḥ siddhatvāt| `aiḍaviḍaḥ dāradaḥ' iti| iḍaviḍo'patyaṃ varado'patyamityaṇeva bhavati| ḍhagiti varttamāne ḍhakaḥ punargrahaṇaṃ nityārtham| `vaḍavāyā vṛṣa vācye' iti| yastasyā garbhe bījaṃ prakṣipati sa vṛṣo vāḍaveya ityucyate| `aṇkruñcākokilāt smṛtaḥ' iti| vṛṣa iti nāpekṣyate| apatye vidhirevāyam| ḍhako'pavādaḥ|| 121. dvyacaḥ| (4.1.121) `tannāmikāṇo'pavādaḥ'iti| ye dvyacaḥ strīpratyayāntā nadīmānuṣīnāmadheyabhūtāstebhyo viśeṣavihitatvāt tannāmikāṇ bhavati| tatastadbādhanārthaṃ ḍhagvidhīyate|| 122. itaścāniñaḥ| (4.1.122) 123. śubhrādibhyaśca| (4.1.123) `yathāyogam' ityādi| ye tāvadakārāntāstebhya iño'pavādaḥ| śalākā, kurekā,ambikā, aśokā, khaṭvā, piṅgalā, khaṇḍonmattā-- ityetempastannāmikāṇaḥ| vidhavāśabdāt kṣudrālakṣaṇasya ḍhrakaḥ| kiṃkasā, rohiṇī, ajavasti, śakandhi, kṛkalāsa, sudatta, paridhi-- etebhyaścatuṣpāllakṣaṇasya ḍhañaḥ| godhāśabdād godhāyā ḍhrakaḥ, vacanasāmarthyāt so'pi bhavatyeva| śeṣebhya autsargiko'ṇa ityeṣa yathāyogārthaḥ| `lakṣaṇaśyāmayorvāsiṣṭhe' iti| lakṣaṇa, śyāma-- ityetayorvāsiṣṭhe'patyaviśeṣe ḍhagbhavati| lākṣaṇeyo vāsiṣṭhaḥ, lākṣaṇiranyaḥ| śyāmeyo vāsiṣṭhaḥ, śyāmāyano'nyaḥ| aśvāditvāt phañ|| 124.vikarṇakuṣītakātkāśyape| (4.1.124) 125. bhruvo vukca| (4.1.125) 126. kalyāṇyādīnāminaṅ| (4.1.126) 127.kulaṭāyā vā| (4.1.127) kulanyaṭatīti kulaṭā| nanvakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatve kṛte kulāṭeti bhavitavyamityata āha-- `pararūpam' ityādi| `pūrveṇaiva' iti|`strībhyo ḍhak' (4.1.120) ityananaiva| vyavahite'pi pūrvavyapadeśaḥ pravarttate, yathā-- mathurāyāḥ pāṭaliputraṃ pūrvamiti| `kaulaṭeraḥ' iti| eyādeśe kṛte vali yalopaḥ|| 128.caṭakāyā airak| (4.1.128) `caṭakāyā apatyaṃ strī caṭakā' iti| `luk taddhitaluki' (1.2.49) iti luki kṛte punaṣṭāp karttavyaḥ| puṃlliṅgādapi striyāmiṣyata eva luk| evam `caṭakādairak' ityetat sūtramāsīt, idānīṃ pramādācca `caṭakāyāḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ|| 129. godhāyā ḍhraka| (4.1.129) `godheraḥ' iti| pūrvavadyalopaḥ|| 130. āragudīcām| (4.1.130) `ācāryagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham' iti| nanu cāsatyācāryagrahaṇe nitya evāyaṃ vidhiḥ syāt, tathā cārakaḥ pūrveṇa ḍhrakā samāveśo na syāt| tadvikalpārthamevācāryagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha-- `vacanasāmarthyāt' iti| ḍhragapi hyucyate, āragapi, tatra vacanasāmarthyāt samāveśo bhaviṣyati| tasmāt pūjārthamevācāryagrahaṇam| `jñāpakaṃ tu' ityādi| rakā siddhe yadāragvacanaṃ sañjñāpanārtham| tenaivaṃ jñāyate-- anyebhyo'pyayaṃ bhavati;anyathā hyāragvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt raki siddheḥ| tena jaḍasyāpatyaṃ jāḍāraḥ, pāṇḍāra iti siddhaṃ bhavati, na hyetadrakā sidhyati|| 131. kṣudrābhyo vā| (4.1.131) `arthadharmeṇa' iti| arthasya kṣudratvāttadabhidhāyinyo'pi prakṛtaya upacāreṇa kṣudrā iti nirdiśyante|| 132. pitṛṣvasuśchaṇ| (4.1.132) 133. ḍhaki lopaḥ| (4.1.133) `kathaṃ punaḥ' ityādi| ḍhagvidhau ṭābādistrīpratyayāntagrahaṇāt pitṛṣvasṛśabdasya cāstrīpratyayāntatvāt| tato ḍhako bhāvamasambhāvayataḥ praśnaḥ| `etadeva' ityādi| yadetat pitṛṣvasṛśabdaṃ prati ḍhako nimittatvenāśrayaṇam, etadeva pitṛṣvasṛśabdat tasya bhāvaṃ jñapāyati| na hyasato nimittabhāva upapadyate|| 134. mātṛṣvasuśca| (4.1.134) `pitṛṣvasurityetadapekṣate'iti| ihāpi `anantarasya pitṛṣvasurvidhirvā bhavatipratiṣedho vā' iti lopa evānantaraḥ prāpnoti, na chaṇ; vyavahitatvāt| ubhayamapi caitadiṣyate, tatra yato hetoretaddvayamapi labhyate tamanena darśayati-- `pitṛṣvasuḥ' iti| etadihāpekṣyamāṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ jñāyate yathā lopavidhau `pitṛṣvasuḥ' (4.1.132) iti ca ṣaṣṭhī, tenāyamarthaḥ sampadyate-- pitṛṣvasuryaduktaṃ tanmātṛṣvasurapi tena chaṇ ḍhaki lopaśca labhyate| ubhayamapi hyetat pitṛṣvasuruktam|| 135. catuṣpādbhayo ḍhañ| (4.1.135) `catuṣpādbhyaḥ' iti| catvāraḥ pāda āsāmiti tāstathoktāḥ| `pādasya lopa'hastyādibhyaḥ' (5.4.138) iti lopaḥ| ihāpyarthadharmeṇa tadabhidhāyinyaḥ prakṛtayo nirdiśyante| ata evāha-- `catuṣpādabhidhāyinībhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ' iti| bahuvacananirdeśaḥ svarūpavidhinirāsāya| `aṇādīnām' iti| ādiśabdena ḍhagādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `kāmaṇḍaleyaḥ' ityādi| kamaṇḍalūśuntibāhujambuśabdāścatuṣpājjātivācinaḥ,teṣāṃ `ḍhe lopo'kadravāḥ' (6.4.147) ityuvarṇalopaḥ|| 136. gṛṣṭayādibhyaśca| 4.1.136) aṇādīnāmapavādaḥ| ādiśabdena ḍhakaḥ| bahuvacananirdeśastu prakṛtibhedena tayorbhedasya vivakṣitatvāt| tatrājavastimitrayuśabdayoraṇo'pavādaḥ, śeṣāṇāṃ `itaścāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) iti ḍhakaḥ|| 137. rājaśvaśurādyat| (4.1.137) `kṣatriyajātiścet' iti| pratyayāntena yadi kṣatriyajātirgamyate evaṃ yad bhavati| yo hyapatyameva rājño na kṣattriyajātistatrāṇevautsargiko bhavati| etacca `vā (4.1.131) ityasyehānuvṛttasya vyavasthivibhāṣātvavijñānāllabhyate| `rājanyaḥ' iti| `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `rājanaḥ' iti| atrāpi `an' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ|| 138.kṣattrādghaḥ| (4.1.138) `ghapratyayo bhavati' iti| ghaśabda eva, na tu taraptamapāviti veditavyam| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate,yāvatā `ghaḥ' iti taraptamaporiyaṃ saṃjñā, coccaritā saṃjñinaṃ sampratyayāyatīti tayoreva grahaṇaṃ yuktam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pratyayavidhau yatra `ghaḥ' iti śrūyate,tatra svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati; jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ pratyayāderghakārasyeyādeśaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati-- yatra pratyayavidhau ghaḥ śrūyate svarūpameva gṛhyata iti| na hi saṃjñinorgrahaṇena pratyayāderghaḥ sambhavati|| 139. kulātkhaḥ| (4.1.139) `uttarasūtre' ityādi| uttarasūtre hi pūrvapadapratiṣedhādyasyāṃ paribhāṣāyāṃ prātipadikaśrutirasti, sā'tra nopatiṣṭhata ityeṣo'rtho jñāyate| yadi hyupatiṣṭheta, tadā grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhādeva (vyā.pa.89) sa pūrvapadānna bhaviṣyatītyapūrvapadāditi pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt| sāmānyāpekṣañca jñāpakam; tena `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' (śāka.pa.65), `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirneṣyate' (vyā.pa.89) ityetayorapīha paribhāṣayorupasthānaṃ na bhavati| tataśca kulaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ kulaśabdo gṛhyate|| 140. apūrvapadādanyatarasyāṃ yaḍḍhakañau| (4.1.140) nanu pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ; na ca kulaśabdasya padāntaramavayava upapadyate; pṛthagbhūttavāt, anārambhakatvācca, tato vyapacchedyābhāvādapūrvapadādityuktametatkulaśabdasya viśeṣaṇam ? ityāha-- `samāsasambandhi' ityādi| samāse satyetadbhavati-- pūrvapadam, uttarapadamiti| tasmāt samāsasambandhinaḥ pūrvapadsayābhāvena kulaśabdo viśeṣyate-- avidyamānaṃ samāsasambandhi pūrvapadaṃ yasyeti| kasya cāvidyamānam ? yaḥ samāsasyāntabhūto na bhavati kevalaḥ kulaśabdaḥ,tena kevalāt kulaśabdādayaṃ vidhirityuktaṃ bhavati| atha vyavasthāvācyeva pūrvaśabdaḥ kasmānnāśrīyate ? aśakyatvāt| tatra hyāśrīyamāṇe'vidyamānaṃ pūrvapadaṃ yasmāt kulaśabdāt so'pūrvapadaśabdenocyate| tataśca devadattaḥ kulyo devadattaḥ kauleyaka iti vākye yaḍḍhakañau na syātām; devadattasyeha pūrvapadasya vidyamānatvāt| `padagrahaṇaṃ kim' iti| apūrvādityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, evamapi hīṣṭaṃ sidhyati, laghu ca sūtraṃ bhavatīti manyate| `bahucpūrvapadādapi yathā syāt' iti| `apūrvāt' ityucyamāne bahuc pūrvaṃ yatpratātipadikaṃ bahujasya pūrvaṃ iti tataḥ pratyayo na syāt| padagrahaṇe tu sati tato'pi bhavati; tasyāpūrvapadatvāt| `bahukulyaḥ' iti| īṣadasamāptaṃ kulamiti `vibhāṣā supo bahuc purastāttu' (5.3.68) iti bahuc| bahukulasyāpatyaṃ bahukulyaḥ|| 141. mahākulādañkhañau| (4.1.141) 142.duṣkulāḍḍhak| (4.1.142) 143. svasuśchaḥ| (4.1.143) 144. bhrātṛrvyacca| (4.1.144) `takāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| `tistvaritam' (6.1.185) iti svaritatvaṃ yathā syāt| 145. vyansapatne| (4.1.145) nanu `nityaṃ sapatnyādiṣu' (4.1.35) iti sapatnīśabda eva strīliṅgo vyutpāditaḥ, tatkathaṃ sapatna iti prayogaḥ puṃliṅgasya yujyata ityāha-- `sapatnaśabdaḥ śattruparyāyaḥ' ityādi| `ivārthe' iti| ivārthaḥ - sādṛśyam| yathaiva hi sapatnī duḥkhahetuḥ, tathā śattrurapīti| yaḥ sapatnīva sapatnaḥ sa ucyate|| 146. revatyādibhyaṣṭak| (4.1.146) `yathāyogam' ityādi| tatrādyānāṃ caturṇāṃ strīpratyayāntatvād ḍhako'pavādaḥ; vṛkañcin-- ityasyāṇaḥ, śeṣāṇāmakarāntatvādiñaḥ|| 147. gotrastriyāḥ kutsane ṇa ca| (4.1.147) `apatyaṃ prautraprabhṛti gotraṃ gṛhyate' iti| na laukikamapatyamātram, tad‌grahaṇe hi gotragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| apatyādhikārādeva tad‌grahaṇasya labdhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `piturasaṃvijñāne' iti| aprasiddhau| tasya piturasaṃvijñānapradarśanārthaṃ mātrā yo vyapadeśo'sti tena kutsā syāt| `gārgo jālmo gārgikaḥ' iti| gargaśabdādgotre gargādiyañantāt `yañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīpi `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) itilope sati yakārasya gārgī iti sthite ṇaṭhakau| `glaucukāyanaḥ' ityādi| glucakasyāpatyaṃ gotraṃ strī `prācāmavṛddhāt' phin bahulam' (4.1.160) iti phin,tataḥ `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) iti ṅīṣ,tato ṇaṭhakau| `kārikeyaḥ'iti| kārakaśabdāṇṇvulantāṭṭāp|kārikāśabdo'yaṃ gotre na varttate,tato ḍhageva bhavati| `aupagaviḥ'iti| upagorapatyaṃ gotraṃ pumān,aṇ, tadantādiñeva bhavati| atra kenacit pratiṣiddhācaraṇādinā kutsā veditavyā|`gārgeyo māṇavakaḥ' iti| atra pitari vijñāte mātuḥ parijñānārthaṃ tanmatrā vyapadeśaḥ kriyata iti nāsti kutsā, tena ḍhagena bhavati|| 148.vṛddhāṭṭhaksauvīreṣu bahulam| (4.1.148) `sauvīreṣviti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam' iti| sauvīreṣu yad‌vṛddhaṃ sauvīragotrābhidhāyi yad‌vṛddhamityarthaḥ| `bhāgavitteḥṭa ityādi| bhagavittasyāpatyaṃ gotram| `ata iña' (4.1.95) , tadantāt ṭhak-- `bhāgavittikaḥ' | `bhāgavittāyanaḥ' iti| `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak| tṛṇādibindorapatyamautsargiko'ṇ tārṇabindavaḥ, tataṣṭhak-- `tārṇabindavikaḥ'| pūrvasūtre ṭhak cānukṛṣṭa itīha nānuvarttata iti punaṣṭhaggrahaṇaṃ ṇsaya nivṛttyartham| vāpūrvakaṃ hi ṭhaggrahaṇaṃ ṇapratyayena sambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| `bhāgapūrvapado vṛttiḥ' ityādi| yebhyo'nena sūtreṇa ṭhagiṣyate, ta etena ślokena parigaṇyante| `bhāga' ityetat pūrvapadaṃ yasya vṛttiśabdasya sa tathoktaḥ| ayaṃ tāvadeko bhāgavittiḥ, dvitīyastārṇabindavaḥ, tṛtīyastvākaśāpeyaḥ-- ya ete trayaḥ śabdāḥ ,gotre ṭhagbahulaṃ tata iti| sauvīragotravacanāntāt prātipadikādbahulaṃ yaṣṭhagucyate sa tatastebhya eva bhāgavittiprabhṛtibhyastribhyo bhavati, nānyebhya ityarthaḥ| atha vṛddhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā pūrvasūtrādgotragrahaṇamanuvarttate, sauvīragrahaṇenaiva viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ; yaccasauvīragotre varttate prātipadikaṃ bhāgavittyādikaṃ tadvṛddhameva, tato nivṛttyabhāvādapārthakaṃ vṛddhagrahaṇam ? ityāha -- `vṛddhagrahaṇam' ityādi| taddhi gotragrahaṇaṃ striyā viśeṣaṇam, atastasminnanuvarttamāne viśeṣyāyāḥ striyā anuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmāt tannidṛttyarthaṃ vṛddhagrahaṇam| gotragrahaṇamevānuvartiṣyate; tasyaiva svaritatvāt, na strīti-- etadvyākhyeyaṃ bhavati| vyākhyānācca laghu vṛddhagrahaṇameva| `aupagaviḥ' iti| aṇantādiñ| nanu ca parigaṇanaṃ kṛtam,tatkathamaupagavaśabdāt ṭhakprasaṅgaḥ ? sauvīragrahaṇe sati tatparigaṇanam| tathā hi-- bhāgavittiprabhṛtayaḥ sauvīragotrābhidhāyina eva parigaṇitāḥ| tatrāsati sauvīragrahaṇe aupagavaśabdādapi prasajyate-- `bhāgavittāyanaḥ' iti| pūrvavat phak| atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham,na, vāgrahaṇameva kriyeta,tenāpi hi bhāgavittiko bhāghavittikāyana ityādi sidhyatyeva ? ityata āha-- `bahulagrahaṇam' ityādi| vāgrahaṇādvikalpamātraṃ labhyate, na tūpādhivaicitryam| bahulagrahaṇe tu tadapi| tasmādupādhīnāṃ viśeṣamānāṃ vaicitryam - nānāprakāratā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ bahulagrahaṇam| tadevopādhivaicitryaṃ darśayitumāha-- `gotrastriyā ityārabhya' ityādi| sukhāvabodham|| 149.pheśca ca| (4.1.149) `yamundaśca'ityādi| yebhyo'nena sūtreṇa chaṭhakāviṣyete, teṣāmanena ślokena parigaṇanaṃ kriyate, tattu bahulagrahaṇānuvṛttereva labhyata ityevaṃ tadveditavyam| yamundamuddiśya vṛttikāreṇaivodāharaṇaṃ darśitam| itarayostu darśayāmaḥ-- suyāmno'patyaṃ, phiñ-- sauyāmāyaniḥ,tasyāpatyaṃ sauyāmāyanikaḥ| vṛṣasyāpatyaṃ,phiñ, tasya vārdhyāyaṇiḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ vārṣyāyaṇīyaḥ,vārṣyāyaṇikaḥ| ete yamundādayaḥ śabdāḥ phiñaḥ smṛtāḥ - phiñantā vijñātāḥ| `gotrastriyāḥ kutsane ṇa ca' (4.1.147) ityādayaścatvāro yogāḥ| tatrādyaḥ kutsana eva, antyaḥ sauvīreṣveva| madhyamau tu dvau sauvīreṣu kutsāyāñca śabdavitsmaret jānīyāt|| 150. phāṇṭāhṛtimimatābhyāṃ maphiñau| (4.1.150) `ālpāctarasya' ityādi| mimataśabdo'yamalpāctaraḥ, tasya `alpāctaram' (2.2.34) iti pūrvanipāte prāpte yaḥ paranipātaḥ sa lakṣamavyabhicāracihnaṃ sūcayati| yathedaṃ pūrvanipātalakṣaṇaṃ vyabhicarati - svaviṣaye na pravarttate, tathā yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| ata evaikaikasmāt pratyayadvayaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati|| 151.kurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ| (4.1.151) `kauravyaḥ' iti| `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.156), `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādaśaḥ| `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' ityādi| kimarthaṃ punaḥ kuruśabdādaparo'pi ṇyapratyayo bhaviṣyati, yāvatānenaiva siddham, tadeva hi rūpam, sa evaca svaraḥ ? ityata āha-- `sa tu kṣattriyāt' iti| anenārthabhedaṃ darśayati| sa hi `janapadaśabdāt kṣattriyādaña' (4.1.168)ityadhikārāt kṣattriyādbhavati, ayaṃ tu tato'nyataḥ| tataścaikaḥ kṣattriyāpatyo bhavati, aparastvakṣattriyāpatya iti spaṣṭa evārthabhedaḥ| rūpaviśeṣo'pi bahuṣu vidyata iti darśayannāha-- `tadrājasaṃjñakaḥ' ityādi| tasya hi tadrājasaṃjñakatvāt `tadrājasya bahuṣu' (2.4.62) ityādinā bahuṣu lukā bhavitavyam -- kurava iti| ayaṃ tu śrūyata eva kauravyā iti| rathakāraśabdo'tar paṭhyate, tatra rathakāraśabdaścāstyeva jātivacanaḥ, asti ca kārivacanaḥ, tadiha tayoḥ kataraḥ paṭhyate ? ityāha-- `rathakāraśabdo'tra paṭhyate' ityādi| atha kārivacano'pi kasmānna paṭhyate ? ityāha-- `kāriṇastu' ityādi| yo hi vacano rathakāraśabdaḥ, tata uttarasūtreṇaiva ṇyaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkitra tasya pāṭhena ! `puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati' iti| `bhasyā'ḍha taddhite' (vā.731) iti yaḥ puṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, sa keśinī śabdasya na bhavati| yadi syāt, `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilope kṛte `kaiśyaḥ' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt| kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- `strīpratyayasya nirdeśasāmarthyāt' iti|yadi hi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt, strīpratyayenāsya nirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt, puṃlliṅgamevainaṃ paṭhet| puṃlliṅgasyāpi pāṭhe liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā keśinīśabdādapi pratyayaḥ sidhyati| nanu ca puṃlliṅganivṛttyarthaḥ strīpratyayāntasya pāṭhaḥ syāt ? naitadasti; abhidhānādeva hi puṃlliṅgānna bhaviṣyati| `tasya kaṇvādivat'iti| apatyādhikāre'yamatideśo bhavan kaṇvādibhirapatyapratyayāntairvijñāyate| kaṇvādayaśca gargādyantaḥ pātinaḥ, tena yañantānāṃ kaṇvādīnāṃ yatkāryaṃ tadvāmarathyasya svaravarjaṃ bhavatītyayaṃ bhavati| `lugādikam' iti| ādiśabdena ṅībādikaṃ gṛhyate| kaṇvādīnamapatyapratyayasya `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti bahuṣu lugbhavati| striyāṃ `yañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīp| `prācāṃ ṣpha taddhite' (4.1.17) itiṣpha pratyayaḥ striyāmeva| `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak| śaiṣikeṣvartheṣu `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) ityaṇ `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityarthavivakṣāyām| `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañyañiñām' (4.3.127) ityaṇ| etāni kāryāṇi yathā kaṇvādīnāṃ bhavanti tatā vāmarathyasyāpi| eṣāṃ `vāmarathā' ityādīni yathākramamudāharaṇāni| `nātideśikamādyudāttattvam' iti| yathā kaṇvādīnāṃ yañantānāṃ ñitsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ, na tathā vāmarathyasya, kiṃ tarhi ? pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvameva bhavati| `samrājaḥ kṣattriye' iti| samrājaḥ kṣattriye ṇyo bhavati, samrājo'patyaṃ sāmrājyaḥ| anyatrāṇeva-- sāmrājaḥ|| 152. senāntalakṣamakāribhyaśca| (4.1.152) atra grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhi (vyā.pa.89) pratiṣedhāllakṣaṇaśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇam| ata evāha-- `lakṣaṇaśabdāt' iti| kārītyarthagrahaṇam| tatrārthe kāryasyābhāvāt tadvācinaḥ pratyayo vijñāyata ityāha-- `kārivacanebhyaśca' iti|yathā lakṣaṇaśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tathā kāriśabdasya kasmānna bhavati ? śivādiṣu takṣanniti pāṭhāt| asya hi kārilakṣaṇamiñaṃ bādhituṃ tatra pāṭhaḥ| yadi ca kāriśabdasyeha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt, takṣanśabdādibhyaḥ prāpterasambhavādutsargeṇaivāṇā bhavitavyamiti tasya śivādiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| arthagrahaṇe tvanena prāptasyeño bādhanārthastatra pāṭho yujyate|| 153. udīcāmiñ| (4.1.153) `vacanasāmarthyāt' ityādi| ṇyo'pyucyate, iñapi, vacanasāmarthyādevāntareṇācāryagrahaṇaṃ tayoḥ samāveśe siddhe tadācāryagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tadvaicitryārtham| ācāryagrahaṇasyātiricyamānatvādayamartho labhyate, granthādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ bhavatīti kṛtvā| nanu ca pūjārthamācāryagrahaṇaṃ syāt ? naitadasti; evaṃ hi prācāmapi grahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ syāt| te'pi hi senāntalakṣaṇakāribhya iñaṃ smaranti| `takṣanśabdaḥ' ityādinā vaicitryaṃ darśayati| `tākṣṇaḥ' iti| śivādyaṇi kṛte `ṣapūrvahandhṛtarājñāmaṇi' (6.4.135) ityallopaḥ| `tākṣaṇyaḥ' iti| `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ|| 154. tikādibhyaḥ phiñ| (4.1.154) `kauravyaśabdaḥ paṭhyate' ityādi| kauravyaśabdo'yamastyeva kṣattriyagotravacano yaḥ `kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.172) iti ṇyapratyayāntaḥ; tayoriha pūrvo gṛhyate| kuta etat ? aurasaśabdena sāhacaryāt| aurasaśabdo'yaṃ `janapadaśabdāt kṣattriyādañ' (4.1.168) ityañpratyayāntaḥ, tenāsau kṣattriyavacanaḥ, tatsāhacaryāccakauravyaśabdo yaḥ kṣattriyapratyayāntatvāt kṣattriyavacanaḥ sa eva gṛhyate| `yastu' ityādi| yastu `kurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.15)| iti ṇyapratyayānto brāhmaṇādigotravacanaḥ, tasmāt `ata iñ' (4.1.95) idīñaiva bhavitavyam, tatraitat syāt ? svamanīṣikeyaṃ bhavata ityāha-- `tathā ca' ityādi| yata evaṃ brāhmaṇādigotravacanādiñaiva bhavitavyam| tathā hi ṇyakṣattriyādi (2.4.58) sūtre pūrverapi vṛttikāraiḥ-- kauravyaḥ pitā, kauravyaḥ putra ityudāhṛtam| yadi cātaḥ phiñ syāt tadudāharaṇaṃ na yujyeta|na hi ṇyapratyayāntādvihitasya phiño yūni lugucyate, api tvaṇiñoḥ|| 155.kauśalyakārmāryābhyāñca| (4.1.155) `paramaprakṛterevāyaṃ pratyaya iṣyate' iti| kośalaśabdāt, karmāraśabdācca| evakāḥ `vṛddhetkośalājādāññyaṅ' (4.1.171) iti ñyaṅanto yaḥ kauśalyaśabdaḥ, yaśca `senāntalakṣaṇakāribhyaśca' (4.1.152) iti kārilakṣaṇaṇyapratyayāntaḥ karmāryaśabdaḥ tayorvyavacchedāya| yadi mūlaprakṛtereveṣyate, kathamidaṃ vikṛtaṃ prakṛtirūpaṃ śrayūte ? ityāha-- `pratyayasanniyogena' ityādi| na ceyaṃ svamanīṣikā, api tvācāryaṇāmeva bhāṣyakāraprabhṛtiīnāmidaṃ matamiti darśayannāha-- `tathā ca' ityādi| kaḥ punaḥ paramaprakṛteḥ pratyayāntādvatpattau viśeṣaḥ ? paramaprakṛterutpattāvapatyamātre pratyayo labhyate, pratyayāntāt tūtpattau `gotrādyūni' (4.1.94) iti vacanāt `yūnyapatye' ityeva viśeṣaḥ| `yuḍ vādiṣṭasya' iti| ādiṣṭagrahaṇamāyannādeśae kṛte yathā syādityevamartham; anyathā hyanāditvādāyannādeśo na syāt| `dāgavyāvaniḥ' iti| `orguṇeḥ' (6.4.146) kṛte `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ|| 156. aṇo dvyacaḥ| 94.1.156) `kārtrāyaṇiḥ' iti| kartturapatyamityaṇ-- kārtraḥ, tataḥ phiñ| ` dākṣāyaṇaḥ' iti| dākṣiśabdādiñantādyūni pañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak| pratipādanādi sugamam|| 157.udīcāṃ vṛddhādagotrāt| (4.1.157) `vṛddhāt' iti| ihaiva yatpāribhāṣikaṃ vṛddhaṃ tad‌gṛhyate, na śāstrāntaraprasiddham, agotrāditi pratiṣedhāt| `kāriśabdāt' ityādi| kārilakṣaṇasyeño'vakāśaḥ-- tāntuvāyiriti, phiño'vakāśaḥ--āmraguptāyaniriti; ihobhaṃ prāpnoti-- nāpitāyaniriti, paratvāt phiñeva bhavati|| 158. vākinādīnāṃ kukca| (4.1.158) `yadiha vṛddhamagotram' iti| vākinaśabdādikākaparyantam| `iñādyapavādo yogaḥ' iti| ādiśabdenāṇo grahaṇam| tatra carmivarmaśabdayoraṇo'pavādaḥ śeṣāṇāmiñaḥ| `camivarmiṇornalopaśca' iti| carmin, varmin-- ityetayoḥ kukphiñau bhavataḥ, nalopaśceti| kuki kṛte prātipadikasyānakārāntatvānnalopo'tra na prāpnotīti vidhīyate-- cārmikāyaṇiḥ,vārmikāyaṇiḥ|| 159. putrāntādanyatarasyām| (4.1.159) `tena' ityādi| vacanāt pūrvasūtreṇaivodīcāṃ matena yaḥ pakṣe phiñ vihitastasminnanenānyatarasyāṃ kugāgamo'pi vidhīyate|tena trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti|| 160.prācāmavṛddhātphinbahulam| (4.1.160) `vikalpārthaḥ' iti| vikalpaprayojanāya| `ekenaiva sidhyati' iti| vikalpārthatvāditi|prakṛtatvādvikalpa iti gamyate| atra ca kimarthaṃ sarveṣāṃ grahaṇamityadhyāhāryam| tatretyādyuttaram| yaccodīcāṃgrahaṇaṃ yacca prācāṃgrahaṇam, tadubhayaṃ pūjārtham| `bahulagrahaṇaṃ vaicitryārtham' (iti)| pāriśeṣyādanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthamityuktaṃ bhavati| `kvacit' ityādinā bahulagrahaṇasya vaicitryārthatāṃ darśayati|| 161. manorjātāvañyatau ṣuk ca| (4.1.161) `tathā ca' ityādi | yasmādapatyārtho'tra nāsti, evañca kṛtvā mānuṣā iti bahuṣu lugna bhavati| apatyārthe tu sati `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti bahuṣu luk prasajyeta| `apatye kutsite' ityādi| mūrdhanyopasaṃkhyānaparo'yaṃ ślokaḥ| aṇpratyayo'patyavivakṣāyām `tasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityenaiva sidhyati| nanu ca mūrdhanyo'pi ca bahulagrahaṇānuvṛttyā sidhyatyeva ? evaṃ tarhi bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhya evārthaḥ ślokena kathyate| sa cāpi mūrdhanyo viśiṣṭa eva viṣaye mūḍhādāvapatye bhavati, na sarvatra| anadhītavedatvadajño mūḍhaḥ| mūḍhatvādeva pratiṣiddhācaraṇādvā kutsito yaḥ sa brāhmaṇajātīyo māṇava ucyate|| 162. apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram| (4.1.162) prabhṛtiśabda ādiśabdasyārthe| pautraḥ prabhṛtiryasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| yadi pautraprabhṛti yadapatyaṃ tad‌gotrasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, gargasyāpi gotrasaṃjñā prāpnoti, so'pi kañcit prati pautro bhavatyeva| satyāñca gotrasaṃjñāyāṃ gotraśabdādanantarāpatye pratyayo na prāpnotīti codyamāśaṅkyāha-- `sambandhiśabdatvāt' ityādi| gotrasaṃjñā hyapatyas potraprabhṛtervidhīyate| te ca yascāpatyamiti sambandhiśabdo'sau niyogato'patyavantamapekṣata| tena tasya yadapatyaṃ tadapekṣayā gotrasaṃjñā vidhīyate| na ca yasya gargaḥ potrastasyāsau gargo'ptayamiti śakyate vyapadeṣṭum ; apatyatvasya tatrāpratibhāsanāt| apratibhāsanaṃ pustastasya dvato'vivakṣitatvāt| yadapi hi tatrāpatyatvaṃ tadapyavivakṣitasvarūpeṇa nākhyātam, tato'patyasya potraprabhṛtervidhīyate| ataḥ svarūpeṇa pratibhāsamāno na bhavati gargasya gotrasaṃjñāyāḥ prasaṅgaḥ|`gargasya pautraprabhṛti' iti| gargasambandhi pautrādyapatyaṃ gārgya iti gotrasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ' (4.1.98) ityato gotra ityanuvarttamāne `gargādibhyo yañ' (4.1.105) itigotre'patye yañ bhavati| `apatyamiti vyapadeśo'yam' iti| saṃjñina iti śeṣaḥ| taccottarasūtra ityabhiprāyaḥ| iha tu pautrasyāpatyatvāvyabhicārāt tadapatyameva pratyayāntaiḥ vijñāyata iti nārthaḥ saṃjñivyapedaśārthenāpatyagrahaṇena| uttarasūtre tu pautraprabhṛtyetat ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vipariṇamya pautraprabhṛteḥ sambandhino'patyasya yuvasaṃjñeṣyate, sā cāpatyagrahaṇamantareṇa na labhyate| anyadapi hyapatyāt pautraprabhṛteḥ sambandhyasti, tatra na jñāyate-- kasyeyaṃ saṃjñeti ? atastatra saṃjñino vyapadeśāya yuktamapatyagrahaṇamityeke| iha tu saṃjñivyapedaśārthaṃ yuktamapatyagrahaṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ| asati hyapatyagrahaṇe sambnadhiśabdatvādapatyaśabdasyetyādi yaduktaṃ codyanirāsāya tadaghaṭamānaṃ syāt| tataśca gargasyāpi gotrasaṃjñā syādeva| tasmādihāpi saṃjñivyapeśāyāpatyagrahaṇaṃ karttavyameva, apatyarūpeṇa pratibhāsamānasya saṃjñā yathā syāt| `anyasya mā bhūt' iti| nanu ca tasmādeva tatprakṛtamapatyagrahaṇaṃ tadeva saṃjñivyadeśāya bhaviṣyati, tat kimapareṇāpatyagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; taddhi pratyayārthatayā pkṛtaṃ kathaṃ saṃjñino vyapadeśāya syāt; syādetat yadyapi tatpratyayārthe kṛtaṃ tathāpi tasyehānuvṛttas tatprayojanaṃ nāstītyataḥ saṃjñivyapadeśāya vijñāsyata iti ?etacca nāsti; uttarārthaṃ hyadhikārāṇāmanuvṛttirdṛśyate,vyākhyāऩñcaivaṃ karttavyaṃ syāt, vyākhyānācca vacanameva laghutaramityapatyagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| `kauñji-, gārgiḥra' iti| anantarasya gotrasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt `gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ' (4.1.98), `gargādibhyo yañ' (4.1.105) iti yaśca gotre vidhīyamāno na sa bhavati|| 163. jīvati tu vaṃśye yuvā| (4.1.163) `abhijanaprabandhaḥ' iti| abhajanāḥ - pitāmahādayaḥ, prabandhaḥ - santānaḥ, tatra bhavo vaṃśya iti digāditvādyat| `pautraprabhṛtyapatyam' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `pautraprabhṛtīti ca' ityādi| yadi pautraprabhṛtītyetat sāmānādhikaraṇyenāpatyaṃ viśeṣayet pautraprabhṛti yadapatyamiti tadārabhya yuvasaṃjñā syāt, taccāniṣṭam| tasmānnaitat sāmānādhikaraṇyenāpatyasya viśeṣaṇam kiṃ tarhi ? arthādvibhavanaktavipariṇāme kṛte ṣaṣṭhyantatāmāpannaṃ vaiyadhikaraṇyena pautraprabhṛryadapatyamiti, tathā sati yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate taddarśayitumāha-- `tena' ityādi| yata evaṃ vibhaktivipariṇāme kṛte pautraprabhṛtītyanena ṣaṣṭhyantenāpatyaṃ viśeṣyate tena caturthādārabhya yuvasaṃjñā vidhīyate, tasya ca vibhaktapariṇāmasyāpatyaṃ hetuḥ| apatyaśabdo hi sambandhiśabdatvanāddhetvādyapekṣate,tatra ṣaṣṭhyā heturbhavati| sannihitatvācca| pautraprabhṛti tasyetyetadevāpekṣate, tatastatraiva ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayati|yadi tarhyapatyagrahamasāmarthyāt pautraprabhṛteḥ ṣaṣṭhīvipariṇāmo bhavati, pūrvasūtre'pi kasmānna bhavati ? tatra prathamāyā anavakāśatvāt| pūrvasūtre hyakṛtārthā prathamā, tato na śakyate tasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ vipariṇamayitum| iha tu kṛtārthā śakyate ṣaṣṭhībhāvena vipariṇamayitum| `gārgyāyaṇaḥ' iti| iha yuvasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `gotrādyūnyastriyām' (4.1.94) iti gotrapratyayāntādyūni pratyayo bhavati| `tu śabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ' iti| kaḥ punaḥ saṃjñāsamāveśe doṣaḥ kathyate ? śālaṅkerapatyaṃ yuvā `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak, pailasyāpatyaṃ yuvā `aṇo dvyacaḥ'(4.1.156) ita phiñ,tayoḥ `pailādibhyaśca' (1.4.59) iti lugucyate-- śālaṅkiryuvā, pailo yuveti| yadi ca gotrayuvasaṃjñayoḥ samāveśaḥ syāt tadā śālaṅkeryūnaśchātrā ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ prāgdīvyatīye'jādau pratyaye viṣayabhūte gotrādayaḥ `gotre'lugaci' (4.1.89) ityaluk syāt| tatastasmādyūno gotrasaṃjñā mā bhūdityavadhāraṇārthastuśabdaḥ kriyate|| 164. bhrātari ca jyāyasi| (4.1.164) bhrātṛśabdas sambandhiśabdatvādyadapekṣaṃ bhrātṛtvaṃ meva bhrātaraṃ saṃjñitvenopakṣipati| jyāyāniti praśasyatarovṛddhataraścābhidhīyate| tasya ca jyāyastvaṃ guṇairvayasā vā| yuvānaṃ pratiyoginamapekṣya bhavatīti sa eva jyāyasītyanena pratiyogī pratyupasthāpyate| tena bhrātureva kanīyasaḥ saṃjñā vijñāsyata iti matvāha-- `kanīyān bhrātaḥ yavasaṃjño bhavati' iti| `pūrvajāḥ' ityādinā avaṃśyārthatāmārambhasya samarthayate| `akāraṇatvāt' ityanenāpi bhrāturavaṃśyatvam| yo hi sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa vā kāraṇaṃ sa vaṃśyaḥ, na ca bhrātā kāraṇam, tasmādasau vaṃśyo na bhavatīti|| gārgye jīvati bhrātari jīvatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ vātsye jīvati vātsyāyano'sya kanīyān bhrātā, dākṣau jīvati dākṣāyaṇo'sya kanīyān bhrātā veditavyaḥ|| 165. vānyasmin sapiṇḍe sthaviratare jīvati| (4.1.165) `saptamapuruṣāvadhayaḥ' iti| saptamaḥ puruṣo'vadhiryeṣāṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ te tathoktāḥ samānapiṇḍāḥ,nipātanāt sabhāvaḥ, `samānasya' (6.3.84) iti yogavibhāgādvā| tasya ca yogavibhāgasyaitalliṅgam, tena sapiṇḍāḥ śāstreṣvā saptamātpuruṣāt| pareṇa ye te sapiṇḍā nocyante| `yeṣām' ityatyādhikāra iti pareṇa sambandhaḥ| `ubhayatra' iti| janmani maraṇe ca| `ityevamādikāyām' iti| ādiśabdena nivṛttyādikāḥ kriyāśca gṛhyante| tathā coktam-- ubhayatra daśāhāni kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyate| dānaṃ pratigraho yajñaḥ svādhyāyaśca nivarttate|| iti|| `jīvati' iti| saptamyekavacanametat| prathamāyāśca sthāne subvyatyayena saptamī vihitā, ata evāha-- `jīvadeva' iti| `tarabnirdeśaḥ' ityādi| asati hi tarabnirdeśe sthaviraśabdādvayaḥprakarṣamātraṃ gamyate, tarapā tu sthānaprakarṣo'pi gamyate| tasmādubhayorutkarṣārthastarabnirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| `pitṛvye pitāmahe bhrātari ca' iti | dvāvapyetau sthānata utkṛṣṭau| sthānaśabdena ceha sambandhaviśeṣa ucyate; anekārthatvāddhātūnām| `gārgya eva bhavati' iti| na gārgyāyaṇaḥ|yuvasaṃjñāyāmasatyāṃ yuvapratyayasya phako'nutpatteḥ | `mṛte' iti| sthaviratare sapiṇḍe| `mṛto vā' iti| pautraprabhṛtirapyatra mṛto'rthaḥ|| 166. vṛddhasya ca pūjāyām| (4.1.166) `apatyamantarhitam' ityādinā śāstrāntareṇa paribhāṣitaṃ yad‌vṛddhaṃ tatparigṛhyate, na tu yadiha śāstre paribhāṣitaṃ taditi darśayati| kutaḥ punaretadavagatam-- śāstrāntaraparibhāṣitamiha vṛddhatvaṃ gṛhyata iti ? apatyādhikārāt| śabdātmakasya vṛddhasyāpattvāsambhavādvijñāyate| `pūjāyāṃ gamyamānāyām' iti| kā punariha pūjā vivakṣitā ? yuvatvameva| taddhi loke sarvaprāṇināmabhimatam| nanu ca neha yuvaśabdo vayaḥ padārthaka evāyaṃ yuvaśabdo gotre vartiṣyate| `saṃjñāsāmarthyāt' ityādinā saṃjñāpraṇayanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| gotrapratyayenābhihitamapi gotram| saṃjñāsāmarthyāt punaryuvapratyayo vidhīyate gārgyāyaṇa iti| atha kimarthaṃ vṛddhasyeti ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeśaḥ kriyate, na vṛddhamiti prathamāntaṃ nirdiśyate,evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati ? ityāha-- `vṛddhasya' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādvicitrā sūtrasya kṛtiḥ; tasmād‌vṛddhasyeti ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeśaḥ| evaṃ hi sūtre kṛte vaicitryaṃ sambhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ|`tatra bhavān gārgyāyaṇaḥ' iti| tatrabhavacchabdasya pūjāvacanasya prayogeṇa pūjāṃ gamayatīti|| 167. yūnaśca kutsāyām| (4.1.167) nanu ca yuvasaṃjñā pūrvamevābhinirvṛttā,yadāha-- `yūnaśca' iti|na hyasatyāṃ tasyāmayaṃ nirdeśa upapadyate, tadabhinirvṛttāyāstasyāḥ punarvikalpena vidhānamanupapannamityata āha-- `nivṛttipradhāno vikalpaḥ' iti| nāyaṃ vidhipradhāno vikalpaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? pratiṣedhapratipādanapara ityarthaḥ| siddhāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ gotrasaṃjñā vaktavyāḥ; anyathā yūno gotrapratyayenābhidhānaṃ na syāt ? ityata āha-- `yuvasaṃjñāyām' ityādi| gotrasaṃjñāyā yuvasaṃjñā pratipakṣaḥ pratyanīkaḥ| sā cennivṛttā gotrasaṃjñaiva pravarttate; pratipakṣābhāvāt, ato na vaktabgeti bhāvaḥ| `gārgyo jālmaḥ'iti| jālmaśabdas kutsāvacanas prayogeṇa kutsāṃ gamayati| kutsā punariha yūno vṛddhatayābhidhānasyaivānabhimatatvāt| ata evākutsite yuveti vākyārthaṃ padamanvākhyāyate| sā ca kutsā yā'nyā vā tato veti viśeṣo nāśrīyate, yathā-- kadannādiviṣaye devadattādīnām|| 168. janapadaśabdātkṣattriyādañ| (4.1.168) janapadavṛttiśabdaḥ pañcālādirjanapada ityuktaḥ,kṣatriyavṛttiḥ kṣatriya ityabhidhāne'bhidheyopacārāt, sāhacaryādvā| nanu pañcālādayaḥ śabdāḥ, te `tasya nivāsaḥ' (4.2.69) iti taddhite kṛte tasya `janapade lup' (4.2.81) iti lupi ca janapade varttante, tat kathamavarakālayā janapadaśabdatayā nityāḥ kṣatriyaśabdā viśeṣyante ? kathaṃ punaḥ kṣattriyasambandhādete janapade varttanta ityetadabhidhātumarhati vidvān| sūtrakāreṇa hi `tadaśi,yaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvālluvyogāprakhyānāt' (1.2.53,54) itiyuktavadbhāvaṃ lupañca pratyādiśatā janapade kṣattriyeṣviva svata eva pañcālādiśabdasya vṛttiruktā| yathā śabdā nityāstathā pañcālādirapi janapada iti kuto janapadavacanānatāyā avarakālatā !`pāñcālaḥ' ityādi| pañcālādayaḥ śabdā deśe santaḥ kṣattriyavācino'pi bhavanti svabhāvata eva, tebhyo'patyārthe'ñ| `aikṣvākaḥ' iti| ikṣvākuśabdasya `dāṇḍināyanahastināyana' (6.4.174) ityādau sūtre ukāralopo nipātitaḥ| `drauhyavaḥ' iti| drahyuśabdaḥ kṣattriyavacana eva, na janapadaśabdaḥ, tenāṇeva bhavati| `pāñcālirvaidehiḥ' iti| iha pañcālavidehaśabdau bhavato janapadaśabdau, na tu kṣattriyavacanau| api tu brāhmaṇavacano, teneñeva bhavati| `kṣattriyasamānaśabdāt' ityādi| kṣattriyavacana eva śabda upacāreṇa kṣattriya ityuktaḥ janapadaśabdo janapada iti| kṣattriyeṇa samānaḥ śabdo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| tasmāt kṣattriyasamānaśabdādasyeti ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādrājanyabhidheye'patyavat pratyayotpattiriti vaktavyam| `avṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt' (4.2.125) (iti) prāptasya vuño'pavādaḥ| yathā pañcālasyāpatyamityatra bhavati pāñcālaḥ, tathā pañcālānāṃ rājā pāñcāla ityatrāpi bhavati|`māgadhaḥ' iti| magadhaśabdādapatye `dvyañmagadha' (4.1.170) ityādināṇ bhavati, tathā tas yarājetyatrāpi|| 169. sālveyagāndhāribhyāñca| (4.1.169) 170. dvyañgamadhakaliṅgasūramasādaṇ| (4.1.170) 171. vṛddhetkośalājādāññyaṅ| (4.1.171) vṛddhagrahaṇeneha `vṛddhiryasyācāmādistaddvṛddham' (1.1.73) iti gṛhyate, tasyaiva hi janapadaśabdatā kṣattriyavācitvaṃ ca sambhavati, na śāstrāntaraparibhāṣitasya| `āmbaṣṭhyaḥ sauvīryaḥ' iti| āmbaṣṭhasauvīraśabdābhyāṃ ñyaṅa| `āvantyaḥ, kauntyaḥ' iti| avantikuntiśabdābhyāṃ ñyaṅa| `kaumāraḥ' ityatrāñ bhavati| `ḍyaṇ vaktavyaḥ' iti| kṣattriyañyaṅo'pavāda iti, ḍakāraṣṭilopārtha iti| sa ca `vānyasmin sapiṇḍe'(4.1.165) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vetyanuvṛtterlabhyate| tathaivamatiprasaṅgo bhavati ? vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt sa na bhaviṣyati| `anyasmāt pāṇḍavaḥ' iti| yaḥ pāṇḍuśabdaḥ kṣattriye varttate,tasmādautsargike'ṇi kṛte pāṇḍava iti bhavati|| 172. kurunādibhyo ṇyaḥ| (4.1.172) añaṇorapavādaḥ| kuruśabdasyatu dvyajlakṣaṇasyāṇaḥ| kuruśabdāt `kurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.151) iti pūrvamapatye uktaḥ| tasya yo janapadaśabda kṣattriyo na bhavati so'vakāśaḥ, yastu janapadaśabdaḥ kṣattriyastasmāt paratvādañi tadapavādo dvyajlakṣaṇo'ṇ syāt| atastaṃ bādhituṃ punarṇyo vidhīyate|| 173. sālvāvayavapratyagrathakalakūṭāśmakādiñ| (4.1.173) `ajapīṣyate' iti| tannāmikālakṣaṇaḥ| kuto vijñāyate ? sālva iti nipātanāt| tadavayavā janapadānāṃ vācakāḥ kṣattriyāṇāṃ samānā bhavanti| ataste'pyaupacārikaṃ sālvāpadeśamāsādayanti|| 174. te tadrājāḥ| (4.1.174) `gotrayuvasaṃjñākāṇḍena vyavahitatvāt' iti|gotrayuvasaṃjñāprakaraṇaṃ hi yadantarā vyavadhāyaṃ kṛtaṃ tasyaitadeva prayojanam| tena ye vyavahitāḥ pūrve'ṇādayasteṣāṃ `te tadrājāḥ' ityatra sarvanāmnā pratyavamarśo mā bhūditi| `tathā caivodāhṛtam' (iti)| `tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām' (2.4.62) ityatra kāryāśrayamudāhṛtam| iha tu prakaraṇe rūpāśrayam|| 175. kambojālluk| (4.1.175) `colaḥ,śakaḥ' iti| dvyañmagadha (4.1.170) lakṣaṇasyāṇo luk| kerala ityañaḥ|| 176. striyāmavantikuntikurubhyaśca| (4.1.176) `avantī| kuntī' iti| taddhitaluki kṛte `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) iti ṅīṣ ?| `kurūḥ' iti| `ūṅ' (4.1.66) ityūṅ|| 177. ataśca| (4.1.177) `takāro vispaṣṭārthaḥ' iti| takāre hyasati `asya' iti nirdeśena bhavitavyam, tataśca samānatvānnirdeśasya sandehaḥ syāt-- kimayavamavarṇasya nirdeśaḥ ? āhostavit idamaḥ ? iti| takāre tu satyeṣa doṣo na bhavati; taparasya vaṇaṣveva prasiddhatvāt| dīrghanivṛttyarthastu takāro na bhavati, dīrghasyāsambhavāt| `sūrasenī| madrī' iti| sūrasenāśabdādyo'ñ, mdaraśabdādyo dvyajlakṣaṇo'ṇ -- tayorluki kṛte `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt' (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣ| `darat' iti| daracchabdād dvyañmagadhalakṣaṇasyāṇo (4.1.170) luk| yadi `ataḥ' iti varṇasyedaṃ grahaṇam, evaṃsati varṇagrahamaṃ tadantavidhiṃ prayojayatītīhāpi prāpnoti-- āmbaṣaṣṭhyā, sauvīryā iti ? ata āha-- `avantyādibhya luk' ityādi| yadyatra tadantavidhiḥ syādavantyādibhyo lugvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt; anenaiva siddhatvāt| tadantavidhāvasatyakāragrahaṇamātreṇa na sidhyatītyavantyādibhyo lugvacanamanarthavadbhavati|| 178. na prācyabhargādiyaudheyādibhyaḥ| (4.1.178) `pāñcālī, vaidehī'iti| `janapadaśabdāt' (4.1.168) ityādināñ| `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn' (4.1.73)| `āṅagī| māgadhī' iti| `dvyañmagadha' (4.1.170) ityādināṇ| `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt' (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣ| bhargaśālvaśabdābhyāṃ dvyañmagadhalakṣaṇo'ṇ (4.1.170)| śeṣebhyastvañ| `bhārgī' ityādau pūrvavat ṅīṣ| `yaudheyī, śaukreyī, śaubhreyī' iti| yaudheya śaukreya śaubhreyaśabdebhyaḥ svārthe `parśvādiyaudheyādibhyo'ṇañau' (5.3.117) ityaṇ| bhārgītyādau pūrvavanṅīṣ| `kasya punaḥ' ityādi|yenābhiprāyeṇa pṛṣṭavān taṃ `katham' ityādinā āviṣkaroti| `parśvādi' ityādi| parśūḥ - kṣattriyaḥ, janapadena samānaśabdaḥ, tasyāpatyaṃ strītvaviśiṣṭam| `dvyañmagadha' (4.1.170) ityādināṇ, tasya `ataśca' 4.1.77) iti luk| parśvādiyaudheyādibhyo'ṇañau' (5.3.117) ityanenāpi yaḥ svārthiko'ṇ, tasyāpi luk| evaṃ `rakṣāḥ' iti| asūraśabdājjanapadaśabdādityādināñ, tadantāt pūrvavat svārthiko'ṇ toyarluk| `tathā ca' ityādinā jñāpakameva bhāṣyakārayatena draḍhayati|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ caturthādhyāye prathamaḥ pādaḥ| <4.2> atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ dvitīyo pādaḥ| 1. tena raktaṃ rāgāt| (4.2.1) rañjirayamastyevānurāge -- deve raktaḥ, striyāṃ rakta iti; asti ca varṇaviśeṣe -- rakto gauriti, lohita ityarthaḥ; asti śuklasya varṇāntarāpādane --raktaḥ paṭa iti, śuklamapanīya raktādikaṃ varṇāntaramāpādita ityarthaḥ| iha tṛtīye'rthe varttamāno gṛhyate, yadāha-- `śuklasya' ityādi| rāgaśabdo'yamastyeva bhāvasādhanaḥ, asti ca karaṇasādhanaḥ; tatreha dvitīyo gṛhyate, yadāha-- `rajyate'neneti rāgaḥ' iti| rāgagrahaṇena cārthasya grahaṇam, na svarūpasya| tena rāgaviśeṣavācinaḥ prātipadikāt pratyayo vijñāyate, na tu rāgaśabdādevetyata āha-- `rāgaviśeṣavācinaḥ prātipadikāt' iti| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? arthaparatvānnirdeśasya| yatra śabdaparo nirdeśastatra svarūpaṃ gṛhyate,na yatrārthaparo nirdeśa iti prāk pratipāditameva| arthaparatvañca nirdeśasyāvicchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśādgamyate| yadi tarhi śuklasya varṇāntarāpādanamityabhiprāyeṇāha-- `katham' iti| `upamānāt' ityādi parihāraḥ| yathā `gaurvāhīkaḥ' ityupamānād‌gośabdo'rthāntare vāhīke varttate,tathehāpi kāṣāyādiśabdo gardabhakarṇādāviti bhāvaḥ|| 2. lākṣārocanāśakalakardamāṭṭhak| (4.2.2) `śakalakardamābhyāmaṇapīṣyate' iti| sa ca `vānyasmin sapiṇḍe' (4.1.165) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vāgrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhyate| na caivaṃ satyatiprasaṅgo bhavati; vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt|| 3. nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ| (4.2.3) iha kālaṃ kriyātmānaṃ kecidicchinti, apare dravyātmānamākāśādikalpam| darśanadvayamapi caitadihāśrayitumayuktam| pūrvasmin darśane samāśrīyamāṇe sūryādidravayāntarsayāyāṃ vā kriyāyā nakṣatreṇa yogaḥ syāt ? ātmasthāyā vā ? pūrvasyāstāvanna sambhavati, arthāntarāsamavāyāt| anyathā hyākāśādayo'pi kriyāvantaḥ syu| na hyarthāntarasamavāyinyā api kriyāyā dravyāntareṇa yogaḥ syāt| ātmasthāyāstu kriyāyā vidyate nakṣatreṇa yogaḥ, kintu yuktagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate; vyavacchedyābhāvāt| na hi puṣyādisthāyāḥ kālasya puṣyādibhiḥ kadācidyogo yujyate yadvyavacchedārthaṃ yuktagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| evaṃ tāvat `kriyā kālaḥ' ityetaddarsanamatrāśrayitumayuktam| dvitīyamapyayuktameva; yasmāt kālaviśeṣāvadhāraṇaheturiha yogo'bhipretaḥ| tathā hi kālaviśeṣāvadhāraṇārthameva pauṣītyādiloke prayujyate| sa caivaṃvidho yogastayoreva bhavatīti yayoḥ sannikarṣaviprakarṣe staḥ, yathā-- puṣyacandramasoḥ| tayorhi kadācit sannikarṣo bhavati, tadācidviprakarṣaḥ| na ca nakṣatrakālayoḥ kadācit sannikarṣaviprakarṣaiḥ staḥ,tayornityatvādityetaccetasi kṛtvāha-- `kathaṃ punaḥ' ityādi| na kathañcidityabhiprāyaḥ| nakṣatranikaṭavartini candramasi varttamānaḥ sūtre nakṣatraśabda upātta ityetat sūcayannāha-- `puṣyādisamīpasthe' ityādi| yataiva hi sāmīpyāt `gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' iti gaṅgāsamīpasthe deśe gaṅgāśabdo varttate, tathehāpi puṣyadayo nakṣatraviśeṣavācinaḥ śabdāḥ puṣyādisamīpasthe candramasi varttante| tena tatraiva varttamānāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti| tena pukhyādisamīpasthacandramasā kālasya viśeṣāvadhāraṇaheturyoga upapadyate| tadavasthasya candramasaḥ kādācitkatvāt| puṣyasamīpasthena candramasā yukta ityarthaḥ; tadavasthe candramasi puṣyaśabdasya vṛtteḥ| `pauṣī' iti| `sūryatiṣyāgastyamastyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ (6.4.149) ityatra `{tiṣyapuṣyayornakṣatrāṇi yalopaḥ' iti mu.pāṭha|} tiṣyapuṣyayornakṣatrāṇi' (vā.808) iti vacanādyalopaḥ|| 4. lubaviśeṣe| (4.2.4) yadyaviśeṣe lugbhavati, ihāpi prāpnoti-- pauṣī rātriḥ,pauṣamahariti, atrāpyaviśeṣī gamyata eva| tathā hi-- pauṣīrātrirityukte, adya śvo veti viśeṣo na gamyata ityata āha-- `na cet nakṣatrayuktasya' ityādi| evaṃ manyate-- `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityanuvarttate, tena tadviśeṣa eva na bhavatīti| `rātryādiviśeṣaḥ' iti|ādiśabdenāha, muhūrttaḥ, lavaḥ-- ityete viśeṣā gṛhyante| `yāvān' ityādi| anantaroktamevārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| kiyāṃśca kālo nakṣatreṇa yujyate ? ahorātraḥ| tadevaṃ yāvān kālo nakṣatreṇa yuktastasyāviśeṣe na gamyate, api tu tadekadeśasya rātreḥ, ahno veti nāyaṃ lupo viṣayaḥ| yadyevam, pratyayasyāpi kathamekadeśo viṣayaḥ ?samudāyadvāreṇa tadantaḥpātino gṛhyante| ekadeśānāmapi yogāt pūrveṇa pratyayotpattiḥ siddhā bavati| punarihāvayavasyaikadeśo lupo viṣaya iti| iha tarhi prāpnoti-- pauṣo'horātra iti, at yāvān kālo nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ, tasyāviśeṣo gamyate, tathā hyahorātra ityukte na jñāyate-- kimatītaḥ, athānāgataḥ,atha varttamāna iti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; aviśeṣa iti prasajyapratiṣedho'yam| tena nakṣatrayuktasya kālasya yatra viśeṣo rātryādistatra na lugbhavatīti jñāyate, na tu yatrāviśeṣastatra tu lubbhavatīti|| 5. saṃjñāyāṃ śravaṇāśvatthābhyām| (4.2.5) `lupi yuktavadbhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati' iti| yadi syāt, śravaṇaśabdasya puṃlliṅgatā syāt| `nipātanāt' ityādinā parihāraḥ| gatārthaḥ|| 6. dvandvācchaḥ| (4.2.6) nakṣatragrahaṇaṃ yatprakṛtaṃ tadihārthāt ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vipariṇamyate|tena nakṣatrāṇāṃ yo dvandvastasmāt pratyayo vijñāyata ityāha-- `nakṣatradvandvāt' iti| `viśeṣe cāviśeṣe ca' iti| aviśeṣagrahaṇasya nivṛttatvāt| `adya rādhānurādhīyam' iti| nanu cāviśeṣe lupā bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ pratyayasya śravaṇamityāha-- `lupaṃ paratvādbādhate' iti|| 7. dṛṣṭaṃ sāma| (4.27) 8. kalerḍhak| (4.2.8) `tīyāt' iti| dvestīyaḥ' (5.2.54) iti tīyaḥ| `treḥ samprasāraṇañca' (5.2.55) iti tīyaṃ vakṣyati, tadantāt svārtha īkagvaktavyaḥ| `na vidyāyāḥ'iti| vidyāyā abhidhāne tīyādīkagna bhavati| `gotrādahkavat' iti| yathā tasyāṅka ityatrārthe vivanakṣite gotrāt pratyayo bhavati, `tena dṛṣṭaṃ sāma' (4.2.7) ityatrārthe vivakṣite tathaiveṣyate| `aupavena dṛṣṭaṃ sāma' iti| aupagavaśabdaḥ `tasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) itigotrapratyayāntaḥ| `gotracaraṇād‌vuñ bhavati' iti| yathaupagavasyāyamaṅka aupagavaka ityaupagavaśabdād‌gotrapratyayāntādaṅke vuñbhavati, tathā `tena dṛṣṭaṃ sāma' ityatrāpi| nanu ca `gotracaraṇād‌vuñ' (4.3.126) ityatra nāṅkārtha upāttaḥ, tatkathamanenāhkavadityucyamāne vuñ bavati ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tatrāṅkavadityanena vihitasyedamartho vivakṣyate| `tena gotrapratyayāntādyathā `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityatrārthe pratyaya iṣyate, tathā tena dṛṣṭaṃ sāma' itatyatrāpītyarthaḥ| `dṛṣṭe sāmani' iti saṅgrahaḥ|gatārthaḥ|| 9. vāmadevāḍḍyaḍḍyau| (4.2.9) `{udāharaṇadvayaṃ mūle nāsti, evameva vāmadevy iti dṛśyate|} vāmadevyam, vāgamadevyam' iti| ekastitsvareṇāntasvaritaḥ, dvitīyaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `ṅitkaraṇaṃ kimartham‌' iti| `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityevaṃ lopasya siddhatvāḍ‌ḍitkaraṇasyānarthakyaṃ manyate-- ḍyaḍḍyāvityādi| na vāmadevyamavāmadevyamiti--atra `naño guṇapratiṣedhe sampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ' (6.2.155) ityato naña ityanuvarttamāne `yayatoścātadarthe' (6.2.156) ityuttarapadasyāntodāttatve vidhīyamāne'nayorgrahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartha ḍitkaraṇam| asati ca tatrānayorgrahaṇe naña eva svaro bhavati, sa punarudāttaḥ| `nipātā ādyudāttā bhavanti' (phiṭ.sū.4.80) iti vacanāt| atha kriyamāṇe ḍitkaraṇe kasmādanayorgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati ? ityāhṛ-- `niranubandhagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti paribhāṣayā ḍyaḍyaḍyayorapi nivṛttiḥ kriyate| yad‌grahaṇe'pi `ekānubandhakaraṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.52) iti paribhāṣayā yataḥ| anayośca paribhāṣayorastitva etadeva ḍitkaraṇaṃ liṅgam| saṅgrahaśloke `atadarthe' ityanena `yayatoścātadarthe' (6.2.156) ityetat sūtraṃ labhyate| etasmin sūtre ityarthaḥ| `nañsvare'iti| naño yaḥ svaraḥ nañsvaraḥ| śeṣo gatārthaḥ|| 10. parivṛto rathaḥ| (4.2.10) `cārmaṇaḥ'iti| `an' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāve ṭilopo na bhavati| `na saṃyogā4dvamantāt' (6.4.137) ityallopo na bhavati| atheha kasmānna bhavati-- chāttraiḥ parivṛto ratha iti ? atrāha-- `samantādveṣṭitaḥ' ityādi| vṛṇotirayaṃ veṣṭane varttate, tasya pariṇā sarvato bhāvo dyotyate| tasmādyaḥ sarvato veṣṭyate tatraiva tyayena bhavitavyam, na tu chāttraiḥ rathaḥ sarvato veṣṭitaḥ, tato na tatra pratyayasya prasaṅgaḥ| yastu chāttraiḥ parivṛto ratha iti prayogaḥ,saparivṛtasyādhyāropeṇaupacārikaḥ|naca mukhye sati parivṛtatve gauṇasyādhyāropitasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam|| 11.pāṇḍukambalādiniḥ| (4.2.11) `pāṇḍukambalī' iti| `sau ca' (6.4.13) iti dīrghaḥ| `matvarthīyenaiva siddhe' iti| yaddhi yena samntādveṣṭitaṃ tat tasyāsti| tasmāt `ata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) iti mtavarthīyeneninā siddhe yattadvacanaṃ tadaṇo nivṛttyartham| yadi labhyeta, tannārabhyeta| yadi hyetadvacanaṃ na syāt, tadā `parivṛto rathaḥ'(4.2.10) ityaṇprasajyet, tataśca pāṇḍukambala iti syāt, pāṇḍukambalīti ceṣyate| tasmādaṇninṛttyarthamucyate|| 12. dvaipavaiyāghrādañ| (4.2.12) `dvīpivyāghrayorvikāra' ityādi| dvīpino vikāraścarma, vyāghrasya vikāraścarma-- ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ `prāṇirajatādvibhyo'ñ' (4.3.154) ityañpratyayāntatvāt dvaipavaiyāghraśabdayoḥ, tābhyāmiha dvīpivyāghravikāratvāccarmaṇi abhidhīyete| carmaṇaiva dvīpivyāghravikāreṇa rathasya parivṛtatvaṃ sambhavati, na vikāramātreṇeti carmaṇī iha dvaipavaiyāghraśabdābhyāṃ vivakṣite iti gamyate|| 13. kaumārāpūrvavacane| (4.2.13) `apūrvavacane'iti| apūrvasya vacana iti, apūrvābhidhāna ityarthaḥ| kasyāpūrvavacanamityāha--`pāṇigrahaṇasya' ityādi| etacca sāmānyoktāvapi nipātanasāmarthyāllabhyate| yathaiva hi nipātanasāmarthyādanyadapi kiñcidalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ labhyate,tathedamapi| `ubhayataḥ striyām' ityādi| yadi kaumāra iti pumānabhidhīyate, evamapyasyāpūrvatvaṃ yadā striyā eva viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, na puṃsaḥ evamatannipātyate nānyathetyarthaḥ| `apūrvapatim' iti| nāsyāḥ pūrvaḥ patiriti bahuvrīhiḥ| patyā saha yasyāḥ pāṇigrahaṇaṃ nivṛttaṃ sā'pūrvapatiḥ| tāṃ patirupapannaḥ prāptavānityarthaḥ| `apūrvapatiḥ' iti| ayamapi bahuvrīhiḥ| `kaumārāpūrvavacane' ityādi| kaumāra ityetannipātyate, apūrvavacane| kiṃ punariha nipātyata ityāha-- `kumāryā aṇvidhīyate' iti| kumārīśabdādaṇ nipātyata ityarthaḥ| kadetyāha-- `apūrvatvaṃ yadā tasyāḥ' iti| iha hi nipātanena pumānabhidhīyate, strī vā,tatra dvayorapi pakṣayorapūrvatvam| yadā tasyāḥ striyā viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, na puṃsaḥ, tadetannipātanam, nānyathetyarthaḥ| `kumāryā bhavatīti vā' iti| anena yogaḥ pratyākhyāyate| yo hi kumārīṃ prāptavānasau tatra bhavati| tatasca `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) iti śaiṣike bhavārthe'ṇantaṃ kaumāraśabdaṃ vyutpadyeta,tataḥ puṃyagolakṣaṇe ṅīṣi sati hi kumārītyetat siddham| svarakṛto viśeṣo nāstyeva| tathā hi aṇantānṅīṣyapi kṛte `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lope ca `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) ityudāttena ṅīpā bhavitavyam| ṅīṣ pratyayasvareṇādyudātta eva| nanu caivaṃ sati kaumārasya yā'nyāpi strīkaumāravyapadeśasya kāraṇaṃ sāpi kaumārīti prasajyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pratyāsatterhi yā tas pratyāsannā saiva tasya kaumārīti bhaviṣyati| kā punastasya pratyāsannā ? yā kaumāre vyapadeśasya hetuḥ| yasyāmasau bhavan kaumāra ityucyate saiva, nānyā| yadyapi vyāsādayo'pi kumāryā bhavanti tathāpi teṣvaṇ, na bhaviṣyati; anabhidhānāt| etaccāvaśyamanabhidhānamāśrayaṇīyamiti; itarathā hi kriyamāṇe'pi nipātane `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityanenāṇ syādeva|| 14. tatroddhṛtamamatrebhyaḥ| (4.2.14) 15. sthaṇḍilācchayitari vrate| (4.2.15) `samudāyena ca' ityādinā prakṛtipratyayopādhitvaṃ vratasya darśayati| `śāstritaḥ' śabdaḥ `vāci yamo vrate' (3.2.40) ityatra vyutpāditaḥ|| 16. saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ| (4.2.16) `saṃskṛtam' iti| atra sāmānyaśabdatvāt saṃskṛtaśabdasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvam| ekavacanatvañca | `bhakṣāḥ' iti| viśe śabdatvādbhakṣaśabdasya puṃlliṅgatvam| bahuvacanatvañca| bhakṣaśabdo'yaṃ ghañanta upāttaḥ| sa ca kharaviśavābhyavahārya eva rūḍha ityāha-- `kharaviśada' ityādi| subodham|| 17. śūlokhādyat| (4.2.18) 18. dadhnaṣṭak| (4.2.18) ṭhakaṃ vakṣyati-- `saṃskṛtam' (4.4.3) ityanena| `tenaiva siddham' iti|yad dadhni saṃskṛtaṃ tad dadhnā hi saṃskṛtaṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| `iha radadhyadhikaraṇamādhārabhūtam' iti| yathā śūle saṃskriyamāṇasya māṃsasya śūlam| na hi śūlena māṃsasya kaścit saṃskāra kriyate, api tu lavaṇādinā| ādhārabhāvamātraṃ tu māṃsasya śūlaṃ pratipadyate| yadi tarhi dadhi kevalamādhārabhūtam, kena tatra tarhi saṃskāraḥ kriyate ityāha-- `dravyāntareṇa' ityādi| 19.udaśvito'nyatarasyām| (4.2.19) `{odasvityam iti mu.pāṭhaḥ} audaśvitkam' iti| `isusuktāntāt kaḥ' (7.3.51)|| 20. kṣīrādaḍḍhañ| (4.2.20) `kṣaireyī' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp|| 21. sāsminpaurṇamāsīti saṃjñāyām| (4.2.21) `tataścedvivakṣā bhavati' iti| tata iti pratyayānto nirdiśyate| etaduktaṃ bhavati-- yadi pratyayāntālloke'sya vivakṣā bhavatyevaṃ pratyayo bhavati; nānyathetyarthaḥ| `pratyayāntena ca' ityādinā saṃjñāyāḥ samudāyopādhitvaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| `eṣā saṃjñā' iti| yā pratyayāntena gamyate| `pauṣī' iti| `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityaṇ, tadantānṅīp| `iha na bhavati' iti| saṃjñāyā anavagamyamānatvāt| na hi daśarātrasya pratyayāntāḥ saṃjñā, nāpi bhṛtakamāsasya| kiṃ tat tulyaṃ phalamityāha-- `prayogānusaraṇam' iti| prayogānusaraṇaṃ prayogopalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| saṃjñāgrahaṇe hyetat kriyate-- prayogamupalakṣya yatra prayogo dṛśyate māsārdhamāsasaṃvatsareṣu tatra pratyaya utpādayituvyaḥ, na tu bhṛtakamāsādau| iti karaṇenāpyetadeva kriyate| tathā hi-- pratyayāntādyadi lokasyārthavivakṣā bhavati, evaṃ hi pratyaya utpādayitavyaḥ, nānyatheti| evamarthamitikaraṇa upādīyate, tataśca lokavivakṣā māsārdhamāsasaṃvatsaraviṣayā bhavati, evaṃ hi na bhṛtakamāsādiviṣayā| tasmāt proyagānusaraṇam, ubhayorapi phalaṃ tulyameva| `saṃjñā' ityādi| nanu ca yathā saṃjñāśabdaḥ prayogānusaraṇaphalatayā loke prasiddhaḥ, tathetikaraṇo'pi, tatkimarthamiha tasya tena tulyatvameva jñāyate ? ityāha-- `na hyayam' ityādi| tathā hi-- loke'yaṃ saṃjñāśabdaḥ prayogānusaraṇaphalatvena yathā prasiddhaḥ, na tathetikaraṇaḥ| tasmādasya tena tulyatā jñāpiteti bhāvaḥ| `saṃjñārthatveṭa ityādinā jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| saṃjñayā tulyo'rtho yasya sa saṃjñārthaḥ| samāsena gamyamānatvāt tulyaśabdo na prayujyate, yathā `rucyarthānām' (1.4.33) ityatra rucinā samānaśabda iti bhāvaḥ| saṃjñārthasya bhāvaḥ - saṃjñārthatvam| arthaśabdaścāyaṃ prayojanavacanaḥ| `tadupapannaṃ bhavati' iti| yata eva saṃjñāśabdenetikaraṇasya tulyārthatā jñāpitā tena yatra yatra prayogānusāraṇārthaṃ itikaraṇaḥ, tatastataśca vivakṣā bhavatītyucyate-- tadupapannaṃ bhavatīti; itakaraṇasya saṃjñāprayojanatvāt| `pūrṇamāsādaṇ' iti| pūrṇo māso yasyaṃ tithāviti tatrārthe bahuvrīhiḥ| asmādeva nipatānādaṇ| pūrṇamāsasyeyaṃ `paurṇamāsī'| `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇ| tithiviśeṣasyeyaṃ saṃjñā| vyatpattistu yathākathañcit karttavyāḥ|| 22. āgrahāyaṇyaśvatthāṭṭhak| (4.2.22) 23. vibhāṣā phālgunīśravaṇākārtikīcaitrībhyaḥ| (4.2.23) 24. sāsya devatā| (4.2.24) `tasminnabhidheye' iti| yāgasampradānabhūtadevatāsvāminīke puroḍāśādau| eṣa cābhidheyaviśeṣaḥ| sāmānyoktāvapītītyasyehānuvṛtterlabhyate| `ādiyatyam, bārhaspatyam' iti| `dityadityādityapatyuttarapadāt' (4.1.85) ityādinā ṇyaḥ| yāgasya devatehābhipretā| aindro mantra iti ca prayoge kasyacit puroḍāśādikasya deyasyābhāvādindrasya sampradānatvaṃ nāsti| ato nāsau devadeti pratyayenātra na bhavitavyamiti manyate| `maṃntrastutyam' iti| yathā devatā pūjārhā tathā mantrastutyamapi vastu, tato devatāsādharmyāt tadi devatetyupacaranti vidvāṃsaḥ| indraśca mantrastutyo bhavati, tasmādasampradānabhūtamapi taṃ devatetyucaparanti| daivatopacāraṃ tatra kurvantītyarthaḥ| nanvemapi naivātra pratyayena bhavitavyam; mukhye sati gauṇasyāśrayaṇasyāyuktatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;yathaiva hi kaścidenakenaiva yatnena śveto dhāvatīti tantreṇa vākyadvayamuccārayati, tathehāpyācāryeṇa dve vākye tantreṇoccārite| tatraikaṃ mukhyārtham; aparaṃ gauṇārthaṃ bhaviṣyati| `katham' ityādi| agnerhi na mukhyaṃ devatātvam, nāpi gauṇam| tatra mukhyaṃ tāvannāsti;deyābhāvenāsampradānabhūtatvāt| gauṇamapi nāsti; mantraśabdābhāvena mantrastulyatathānupāttatvāt| tasmādatra pratyayena na bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `upamānādbhaviṣyati' iti| devatāsvāminīka evātra pratyaya upapadyate| yastvarthāntare
