pratyayāntaprayogaḥ sa āgneya ivāgneya ityupamānādbhaviṣyati, yathā-- kāṣāyau gargabhasya karṇāviti| nanu ca sāsmin paurṇamāsīti seti prakṛtameva| tatkimarthaṃ punariha samarthavibhaktirnirdeśyata ityata āhu-- `seti prakṛte' ityādi| yadidaṃ seti prakṛtaṃ tatsaṃjñāsambaddhamiti, tadanuvṛttau saṃjñāgrahaṇasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmāt tannivṛttyarthaṃ punariha samarthavibhaktinirdiśyata iti|| 25. kasyet| (4.2.25) takāro mukhasukhārthaḥ, na dīrghanivṛttyarthaḥ| bhāvyamānemāṇā savarṇānāmagrahaṇāt| satyapi savarṇagrahaṇa āntaratamyād hrasvasya hrasva eva bhaviṣyati na dīrghaḥ| ` prajāpatervācakaḥ' iti| anenāsarvanāmatvamasya darśayati| ikārasya `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopo na bhavati, vidhānasāmarthyāt| `kāyam' iti| vṛddhyāyādeśau|| 26. śukrādghan| (4.2.26) 27. aponaptrapānnaptṛbhyāṃ ghaḥ| (4.2.27) aponapāt, apānnapāditi yadyete devatānāmadheyetat kathametadvilakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtirūpaṃ sūtre śrūyate ? ityāha--`tayostu pratyayasanniyogena' ityādi|| 28. cha ca| (4.2.28) atha kimarthaṃ yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, na `aponaptṛ-- apānnaptṛbhyāṃ ghacchau' ityekayoga eva kriyate ? ityāha-- `yogavibhāgaḥ' ityādi| ekayoge hi dve prakṛtī, pratyayāvapi dvāveva, samasaṃkhyatvāt saṃkhyātānudeśaḥ syāt, atastannivṛttaye yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate| `cha prakaraṇe' ityādi| paiṅgākṣīputrādibhyaśchaprakaraṇe chasyopasaṃkhyānam - pratipādanaṃ karttavyam| tatredaṃ pratipādanam-- cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ , tena paiṅgākṣīputrādibhyaścho bhavatīti|| 29. mahendrādghāṇau ca| (4.2.29) atha `mahendrādaṇ ca' ityeva kasmānnoktam ? cakārādghacchau bhaviṣyataḥ, evamucyamāne dveṣyamapi vijñāyate--anantaraṃ cha eva cakāreṇātra kṛṣyata iti| tasmāt tathā mā vijñāyīti ghagrahaṇam|| 30. somāṭṭyaṇ| (4.2.30) `saumī' iti| `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) iti yalopaḥ|| 31. vāyvṛtupitruṣaso yat| (4.2.31) `vāyavyam| ṛtavyam' iti| `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146),`vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ| `pitryam' iti| `rīṅṛtaḥ' (7.4.27) iti rīṅ, yasyeti (6.4.49) lopaḥ|| 32.dyāvāpṛthivīśunāsīramarutvadagnīṣomavāstoṣpatigṛhamedhāccha ca| (4.2.32) `aṇo ṇyasya cāpavādaḥ' iti| vāstoṣpatiśabdāt `dityadityādibhya' (4.1.85) ityādinā prāptasya ṇysyāpavādaḥ| śeṣebhyastvautsargikasyāṇaḥ| vāstunaḥ patirvāstoṣpattiḥ| vāstuśabdasya napuṃsakasya puṃlliṅgatā, ṣaṣṭhyarthe'luk ca nipātanāt| `ṣaṣṭhyāḥ patiputrapṛṣṭha' (8.3.53) ityādinā ṣatvam| `dyāvāpṛthivyau' iti| `divo dyāvā' (6.3.29) iti dyāvādeśaḥ| `śunāsīrīyam' iti| `devatādvandve ca' (6.3.26) ityānaṅ| `agnīṣomīyam' iti| `īdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ' (6.3.27) itīttvam; `agneḥ stutstomasomāḥ' (8.3.82) iti ṣatvam|| 33. agnerḍhak| (4.2.33) 34. kālebhyo bhavavat| (4.2.34) bahuvacanagrahaṇena svarūpagrahaṇe niraste, kālaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ pratyayo vijñāyata ityāha-- `kālaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ' ityādi| `vatkaraṇam' ityādi| sarvasya sādṛśyasya parigraho yathā syādityevamartha vatkaraṇam| `kālebhyo bhavaḥ' ityucyamāne yadi tāvat kālagrahaṇaṃ bhavapratyayaiḥ sambadhyate ? bhave'rthe kālebhyo vidhāsyante ye pratyayāste `sāsya devatā' (4.2.24) ityetasminnarthe bhavanti, tadā ca devatāprakṛtiraviśeṣitā syāt| evañca devatāmātravācinaḥ prātipadikādaviśeṣeṇa pratyayāḥ prasajyeran| atha devatāprakṛtibhiḥ kālagrahaṇaṃ sambadhyate ? bhave ye vidhāsyante te pratyayāḥ kālebhyo devatābhyaḥ prasajyeran| athāpyubhayeṣāṃ sannidhānādviśeṣyabhedena vākyabhedācca pratyayaiḥ prakṛtibhiśca sambadhyate-- kālebhyo bhave'rthe vidhāsyante ye pratyayāste kālebhyo devatābhyo bhavantīti ? evamapi yaḥ kaścit kālaprakṛtiḥ pratyayo yataḥ kutaścit kālāddevatāyāḥ syāt, ṛtubhyo'ṇ muhūrtādibhyo'pi syāt| vatau tu sati tasya sādṛśyavidhānāt sarvasādṛśyaparigraho bhavati| tena yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo yena viśeṣaṇena ye pratyayā bhavārthe vidhāsyante, ihāpi tābhya e prakṛtibhyastenaiva viśeṣaṇena ta eva pratyayā bhavantīti na bavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| `{vāsantam--kāśikā} vāsantaḥ'iti| `sandhivelādi'(4.3.16) sūtreṇāṇ| `{prāvṛṣeṇyam--kāśikā} prāvṛṣeṇyaḥ' iti| `prāvṛṣa eṇyaḥ' (4.3.17)|| 35. mahārājaproṣṭhapadāṭhṭhañ| (4.2.35) 36. pitṛvyamātumātāmahapitāmahāḥ| (4.2.36) `pitāmahī,mātāmahī' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ|| 37. tasya samūhaḥ| (4.2.37) `kākam, śaukam, bākam' iti| kākaśukabakaśabdā ādyudāttāḥ|`prāṇināṃ kupūrvāṇām' (phi.sū.2.30) ityanena| asyāyamarthaḥ-- prāṇiviśeṣavācināṃ śabdānāṃ ādibhūtāḥ kavargāt teṣāmudātto bhavatīti|| 38. bhikṣādibhyo'ṇ| (4.2.38) athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na bhikṣādibhyo yathāvihitamevocyeta ? ityata āha-- `aṇgrahaṇam' ityādi| bhikṣāśabdo'yam `gurośca halaḥ'(3.3.103) ityakārapratyayāntatvādantodāttaḥ| tatra `anudāttoderañ' (4.2.44) ityañ aṇo bādhakaḥ prāpnoti, tasya bādhakasya bādhanārthamaṇgrahaṇam| nanu ca yadyatrāṇ syāt punarvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt ? naitadasti; paratvādacittalakṣaṇaṣṭhak prāpnoti, atastadbādhanarthaṃ punarvacanaṃ syāt| añpratyayastu syādeva, aṇgrahaṇāt punaraṇeveti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| `gārbhiṇam' iti| garbhiṇīnāṃ samūho `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite' (vā.731)| `siddhatvāt pratyayavidhau' (4.2.38) puṃvadbhāvena strīpratyayanivṛttiḥ, tato'ṇ, tasmin `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ prāptaḥ, `inaṇyanapatye' (6.4.164) iti prakṛtibhāvānna bhavati| `tasyagrahaṇa' iti| yuvatiśabdasya yadi puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati, tadā tasya pratyayāntatvāt `anudāttādeḥ' (4.2.44) ityañi prāpte tadbādhanārthamihāṇgrahamamarthavadbhavati| yadi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt tadā tadanarthakaṃ syāt| tathā hi --`siddhaśca' pratyayavidhau' (vā. 4.2.38) iti vacanādanutpanna eva taddhite buddhisthe puṃvadbhāvena bhavitavyam| yuva śabdasya `kanin yṛvṛṣitakṣirājidhanvidyupratidivaḥ' (da.u.6.51) iti kaninpratyayāntasya nitsvareṇādyudāttatvam| tatra yadi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syādutsargalakṣaṇevāṇ siddha itīha grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmānnā bhūdassayānarthakyamiti tasyagrahaṇasāmarthyādeva puṃvadbhāvo na bhavati, tena yauvatamiti siddhaṃ bhavati|| 39. gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhrarājarājanyarājaputravatsamanuṣyājād‌vuñ| (4.2.39) `apatyādhikārādanyatra laukikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate' iti| yadyevam, gotragrahaṇenaitasya siddhatvādrājanyamanuṣyayorupādānamanarthakam ? naitadasti; na hi tau gotrapratyayāntau, jāteḥ pratyayārthatvāt| yadyevam, lopasya prāptireva nāsti, tatra yaduktam-- `prakṛtyāke rājanyamanuṣyayuvānaḥ' (vā.814) iti yalopo na bhavatīti, tadanarthakaṃ syāt ? etat punarekīyamatamāśrityoktam| kecidācāryā rājanyamanuṣyayorapatyapratyayāntatvamicchanti, atastanmatamāśrityaiduktamityadoṣaḥ, tanmatena tarhi rājanyamanuṣyayorgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt ? jñāpanārthatvāt| tenaitadjñāpyate-- rājanyamanuṣyayoryakārasay kiñcidapatyāśritaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavatīti| kiṃ punastat ? āpatyavyapadeśam| tena rājanyakam, `mānuṣyakamiti -- atrāpi `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) iti yalopo na bhavatīti| tathā sūtropātta eva rājanyamanuṣyayoḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ `prakṛtyāke rājanyamanuṣyayuvānaḥ' (vā.814) ityanenākhyāyata iti veditavyam| `vṛddhācceti vaktavyam' iti| vṛddhaśbadād‌vuñ bhavatītyedarthamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- iha punaruttarasūtrāccakāro'nuvarttate siṃhāvalokitanyāyena, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena vṛddhaśabdād‌vuñ bhavatīti| yogaścāyaṃ yathāyogamaṇañorapavādaḥ|| 40. kedārādyañca| (4.2.40) `gaṇikāyāśca yañvaktavyaḥ' (iti)| vaktavyo vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ihāpyuttarasūtrāccakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena gaṇikāśabdādapi yañ bhavatīti, vuñ na bhavatīti, anabhidhānāt|| 41. uñ kavacinaśca| (4.2.41) kavaciñśabdo matvarthīyenipratyayāntaḥ,pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| tasmādanudāttādi (4.2.44) lakṣaṇe'ñi prāpte vacanam|| 42. brāhmaṇamāṇavavāḍavādyan| (4.2.42) `pṛṣṭādupasaṃkhyānam' iti| pṛṣṭhaśabdādyanpratyayasyopasaṃkhyānam - vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena pṛṣṭhaśabdādapi bhaviṣyatīti| `ahīnaḥ' iti| `ahnaṣṭakhoreva'(6.4.145) ṭilopaḥ| `āhnaḥ' iti| `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopaḥ| nanu cācittalakṣaṇena ṭhakā bhavitavyam, tatkathamāhna iti bhavati ? ityāha-- `khaṇḍikādiṣu ' ityādi| `ṇasvaktavyaḥ' iti| sakāraḥ `siti ca' (1.4.16) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| tena pārśvamityatra bhatvābhāvāt `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) na bhavati|| 43. grāmajanabandhusahāyebhyastal| (4.2.43) grāmaśabdādacittalakṣaṇe ṭhaki prāpte| janaśabdo ñitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ; ghañantatvāt| tathā bandhuśabdo'pi nitsvareṇādyudātta eva| tathā hi sa `dhānye nit' (da.u.1.94)iti varttamāne `{śṝsvṛsnihitrapyasi--da.u.} śṝsvasnihitapyasivasihaniklidibandhimanibhyaśca' (da.u.1.95) ityanena vyutpādita upratyayāntaḥ| ādyudāttatvādaṇi prāpte| sahāyaśabdo'pi `laghāvante bahvaṣo guruḥ' (phi.sū.2.42) iti madhyodāttaḥ| tatra anudāttāderañi prāpte talo vidhānam| `gajācceti vaktavyam' iti| gajaśabdāt tal bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ ceha cakārasyānuvṛttimāśritya karttavyam|| 44. anudāttāderañ| (4.2.44) `kāpotam, māyūram' iti| kapotamayūraśabdau `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' (phi.sū.2.42) iti madhyodāttau' | `taittaram' iti| tittiriśabdaḥ kit' (da.u.1.48) iti kitpratyayāntaḥ| tarateḥ {sanvalluk iti. prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ} sanvattuk cābhyāsasyeti pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| nanu ca sanvadbhāvādādyudāttaḥ prāpnoti ? `uṇādayo bahulam' (3.3.1) iti bahulavacanāt svare sanvadbhāvo na bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ|| 45. khaṇḍikādibhyaśca| 94.2.45) `ādyudāttārthamacittārthañca vacanam' iti| asatyetasminnādyudāttebhyo'ṇ syāt, acitebyo'cittalakṣaṇaṣṭhak prasajyeta| `kṣudrakāścamālavāśceti kṣattariyadvandvaḥ' iti|kṣudrakasyāpatyāni bahūni `janapadaśabdāt kṣattriyādañ' (4.1.168), mālavasyāpatyāni bahūni| `vṛddhetkośalājādāññyaṅ' (4.1.171) | tayoḥ `tadrājasya' (2.4.62) iti bahuṣu luk, paścāddvandvaḥ| `tataḥ pūrveṇāñi siddhe' iti| samāsāntodāttatve kṛte dvandvasamāsasyānudāttāditvāt| vacanaṃ gotravuño bādhanārtham| `gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhra' (4.2.39) ityādinā gotralakṣaṇo vuñ‌prāpnoti, tadbādhanārthaṃ kṣudrakalṛmālavakasyeha gaṇe pāṭhaḥ| `nanu ca' ityādi| paratvādevāñ vuñaṃ bādhiṣyata ityato nārtho vuño bādhanārthenānena vacaneneti bhāvaḥ| etacca gotratvamabhyupetyoktam| idānīṃ gotratvameva na bhavatīti darśayitumāha-- `na ca' ityādi| gotrasamuccayo'yam| na ca gotrasamudāyo gotragrahaṇena gṛhyate, yathā janapadasamudāyo na janapadagrahaṇena| tathā ca kāśayaśca kośalāśca kāśikośalāḥ, teṣu bhavāḥ kāśikośalīyāḥ| janapadatvābhāvāt `{janapadavadhyośca--mu.pāṭhaḥ} janapadatadavadhyośca' (4.2.124) iti vuñ na bhavati, `vṛddhāśchaḥ' (4.2.114) eva tu bhavati| syādetat-- yadyapi gotrasamudāyo gotraṃ na bhavati, tadavayustu bhavati, kṣudrakamālavakaśabdo'vayavo gotram, atastadantavidhinā tadantād‌gotrasamudaḥyādapi vuñ prāpnoti ? ata āha -- `na ca' ityādi| na hi sarvastadantavidhirbhavatīti| tathā hi-- `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityatroktam--`samāsapratyayavidhau pratiṣedhaḥ', `ugidvarṇagrahaṇavarjam' (vā.12,13) iti| pratyayavidhiścāyam| yeṣu tatra ca tadantavidhiriṣyate te tatraiva `bhayādyādigrahaṇam' (vā.303) ityādinā parigaṇitāḥ, na cāsya tatra parigaṇanam| tato nāsti tadantavidhiḥ| `evaṃ tarhi' ityādi| yadayaṃ kṣudramālavakagrahaṇaṃ karoti vuñbādhanarthām, tajjñāpayati-- vuñi pūrvavipratiṣedho bhavati, na paravipratiṣedhaḥ| `sāmūhikeṣu ca tadantavidhirasti' iti| kimetasya jñāpane prayojanamityāha-- `aupagavakam, kāpaṭavakam' iti| etad vuñpūrvavipratiṣedhajñāpanasya projanam| asati hyetasmiñjñāpane parivipratiṣedhena `anudāttāderañ' (4.2.44) ityañ syāt| vuñastu yatrādyudāttatvaṃ so'vakāśaḥ -- glaucukāyanakamiti| glucukāyanaśabdo hi `prācāmavṛddhāt phin bahulam' (4.1.160) iti phinpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ|| `vānahastikam,gothenukam' iti| tadantavidhijñāpanasya prayojanam| asatyetasmiñjñāpane `acittahastidhenoṣṭhak' (4.2.47) iti dhenuhastiśabdābhyāṃ vidhīyamānaṣṭhak na tadantāt syāt| `{kṣudrakamālavāt-- kāśikā, padamañjarī ca|} kṣudrakamālavakāt' iti| gaṇe `kṣudrakamālavāt senāsaṃjñāyām' (ga.sū.82) iti paṭhyate, tatra yadyayameko yogaḥ syāt, ekena yatnena ca jñāpanaṃ niyamaśca na labhyate| tasmādatra yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ| tatra kṣudrakamālavādityeko yogaḥ, senāsaṃjñāyāmiti dvitīyaḥ| tatra pūrvo yogo jñāpanārthaḥ, uttaro niyamārthaḥ| `punarasyaiva' iti| kṣudrakamālavādityasyaiva yogasya | `kṣaudrakamālavī' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp| `kṣaudrakamālavakamanyat' iti| tadantavidhinātra vuñ bhavati| `añsiddheḥ' ityādi| kṣudrakamālaśabdāt `anudāttāderañ' (4.2.44) ityañ siddhaḥ| tatko'rthaḥ kiṃ prayojanaṃ tasya gaṇapāṭhena ?na kiñcidityarthaḥ| syādetat--yo gotralakṣaṇo vuñ syādetastadbādhanārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ ? ityāha-- `gotrād‌vuñ vidhīyate' (iti)| na ca kṣudrakamālavaśabdo gotram, tatkutastato vuñprāptiḥ ? `tadantāt' ityādi| yadyapi kṣudrakamālavaśabdo gotrasamudāyo gotraṃ na bhavati, tadavayavastu bhavati, tena tadantavidhinā prāpnotyeva| `na ca sarvataḥ' iti| na ca tadantavidhiḥ sarvatraiva bhavati| parigaṇiteṣveva kāryeṣu tadantavidhiriṣyate, na cedaṃ tatra parigaṇyate, tatkutastadantavidhinā vuñprāptiḥ| `jñāpakaṃ syāt' ityādi| idaṃ hi kṣudrakamālavagrahaṇaṃ jñāpanārthaṃ bhavet| etajjñāpayati-- sāmūhikeṣu tadantavidhirastīti| evaṃ kṛtvā'ṣaḍapiśalervidhirupapanno bhavati| vidhīyate'neneti vidhiḥ, sa punaḥ `dhenoranañaḥ' (vā.423) iti, etaddhi tatsūtram| asyāyamarthaḥ-- dhenuśabdaḥ samūhe'rthe ṭhakamutpādayati, na ceddhenuśabdo naña uttaro bhavatīti| nañpūrvapado na bhavatīti yāvat| yadi tatra sāmūhikeṣu tadantavidhirna syāt `anañaḥ' iti vacanaṃ nopapapadyate| asati tadantavidhau dhenuśabdāducyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ, kaḥ prasaṅgo yadadhenuśabdāt syāt ! tadetadanañiti vacanaṃ paramarthavadbhavati yadi sāmūhikeṣu tadantavidhirbhavati, nānyathā| prayojanāntaramāha--`senāyām' ityādi| senāsaṃjñāyāmeva kṣudrakamālaśabdādañ bhavatītyeṣa niyamo yatā syādityevamarthastasya gaṇe pāṭha ityarthaḥ| `yathā' ityādi| ceti samuccaye| pūrvavipratiṣedhena vuñā'ño bādhanaṃ yathā syādityevamartho gaṇe pāṭhaḥ| `{khaṇḍikā--kāśikā} khaṇḍika' iti| khaṇḍikaśabdo matvarthīyaṭhanpratyayānto nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `vala { saṃvaraṇe sañcalane ca' -- dhā.pā.} saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.491) ityasmāt `uṇādayo bahulam' (3.3.1) ityavanpratyaye ḍalayorekatvasmaraṇāllakārasya ḍakārādeśe ṭāpi vaḍaveti bhavati| bhikṣukaśabdo'pi kutsārthavivakṣāyāṃ kannantatvāt pūrvapadādyudāttaḥ| śukolūkayorapi `prāṇinā kupūrvāṇām' (phi.sū.1.30) iti kupūrvādirudātta eva| śvañśabdaḥ `kanin yuvṛṣi' (da.u.6.51) ityataḥ kaningrahaṇe'nuvarttamāne `śvannukṣanpūṣanplīhankledantasnehanmūrdhanmajjannaryamanviśvapsanparijmanmātariśvanmaghavan' (da.u.6.55) iti kaninpratyayānto nipātitaḥ,tenasāvapi pūrvavadādyudāttaḥ| yugavaratrāśabdayoracitārthaḥ| saṃhatavigṛhītārthaṃ yugavaratrāgrahaṇaṃ varṇayanta-- yaugam, vāratram, yogavaratramiti|| 46. caraṇebhyo dharmavat| (4.2.46) `gotarcaraṇād‌vuñityārabhya' iti| nanu ca tatra dharmagrahamaṃ nāsti, tatkathaṃ dharmavadityatideśaḥ prayujyate ? ityāha-- `tatredam' ityādi| idameva dharmavaditi vacanaṃ liṅgabhūtaṃ gamayati-- `caraṇāddharmāmnāyayoḥ' (vā.476) ityetadvacanaṃ śeṣabhūtamiti| na hi tena vinā'deśa upapadyate| `vatiḥ sādṛśyārthaḥ' iti| asati hi vatau yadi caraṇagrahaṇaṃ dharmapratyayairabhisambadhyate-- caraṇebhyo dharme'bhyo ye pratyayā abhidhāsyante te bhavanti `tasya samūha-' (4.2.37) ityetasminnartha iti, samūhaprakṛtirna viśeṣitā syāt| evañceha prakṛtimātrāddharmapratyayāḥ prasajyeran| atha prakṛtiḥ sambadhyate-- dharme ye vidhāsyante pratyayāste bhavanti| `caraṇebhyaḥ samūhaḥ' ityetasminnarthe, evamapi dharmapratyayāna viśeṣitāḥ syuḥ| tataścācaraṇebhyo'pi ye dharme vidhāsyante pratyayāste'pīha caraṇebhya āpadyeran| athāpyubhayasannidhānādubhayaṃ viśeṣyate, tena vākyabhedaṃ kṛtvā pratyayaiḥ prakṛtibhiḥ sambadhyate-- caraṇebhyo dharme'tha ye pratyayā vidhāsyante te samūhe bhavanti caraṇebhya iti ? evamapi kaścit caraṇaprakṛtikaḥ pratyayo yataḥ kutaściccaraṇāt samūhe syāt| `kaupiñjalahāstipadādaṇ' (4.3.132) chandogādibhyo'pi syāt| vatau tu tasya sādṛśye vidhānāt sarvasādṛśyaparigraho bhavati| tena yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaścaraṇaviśeṣaṇena ye pratyayāḥ vihitāḥ , ihāpi tābhyaḥ prakṛtistenaiva viśeṣaṇena ta eva pratyayā bhavantīti na kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| tasmāt sarvasādṛśyaparigrahārthaṃ vatkaraṇaṃ karttavyam| ` kāṭhakam, kālāpakam' iti| `gotracaraṇād‌vuñ' (4.3.126) | `chāndogyam, aukthikyam' iti| `chandogokthikayājñikabahvṛcanaṭāññyaḥ' (4.3.129) iti ñyaḥ| `ātharvaṇam' iti| `kaupiñjalahāstipadādaṇ' (4.3.132),`ātharvaṇikasyekalopaśca' (4.3.133) ityaṇ, ikalopaśca| ete pratyayā yathā caraṇebhyo dharme bhavanti, tathā samūhe'pi|| 47. acittahastidhenoṣṭhak| (4.2.47) `acita' iti| arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasyārthasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na svarūpasya, tenācittavācibhyaṣṭhagvijñāyata ityāha-- `acittavācibhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ' iti| hastidhenuśabdayośca śabdapradhānatvānnirdeśasya svarūpagrahaṇam| ata eva `hastidhenuśabdābhyām' iti| `{dhenoranaña iti vaktavyam-- iti vārtikapāṭhaḥ|} adhenoriti vaktavyam' iti| dhenuśabdādanañpūrvāṭṭhag bhavatītyedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- vakṣyamāṇamihānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣo vijñāyate, vyavasthivibhāṣā ca|tena dhenuśabdādanañpūrvādeva bhavatīti, na ऩñpūrvāditi| `ādhenavam' iti| `utsādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.86) | nanu ca dhenuśabdastatra paṭhyate, tatkathamadhenuśabdādbhavatīti ?tatrāpi tadantavidheḥ sambhavāt| tat kathaṃ vijñāyate ? vaṣkayāsa iti vaṣkayaśabdasya samāse pratiṣedhāt| vaṣkayaśabdāddhi pratyayavidhānam, govaṣkayaśabdānna prāpnoti,kiṃ samāsapratiṣedhena ? itaḥ pratiṣedhādvijñāyate-- asti tatra tadantavidhiriti|| 48. keśāśvābhyāṃ yañchāvanyatarasyām| (4.2.48) keśaśabdādacittalakṣame ṭhaki prāpte vacanamidam| aśvaśabdādapyaṇi sūtramidamārabhyate| anyatarasyāṃgrahamāṭ‌ṭhagaṇāvapi bhavataḥ|| 49. pāśādibhyo yaḥ| (4.2.49) acittalakṣaṇake kaṭhi prāpte vacanamidam|| 50. khalagorathāt| (4.2.50) gośabdādaṇi prāpte, khalarathābyāmacittalakṣaṇe ṭhakīdaṃ vacanam| atra pāśādiṣveva khalādīnāṃ pāṭhaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ ? ityāha-- `pāśādiṣvapāṭha uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttarasūtra initrakaṭyacaḥ khalādibhya eva yathā syuḥ, pāśādibhyo mā bhūditi|| 51. initraṭyacaśca| (4.2.51) `khalādibhya inirvaktavyaḥ' iti| vaktavyo vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena khalādibhya inipratyayo bhaviṣyati| ādiśabdaścāyaṃ prakāre, khalaprakāra ityarthaḥ| kiṃ punaste khalaprakārāḥ ? yebya inirdṛśyate| yadi tarhi khalādibhya inirbhavati, vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti ? vākyabhedādadoḥ| ekaṃ vākyaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati, iha dve vākye iti| initrakaṭyacaḥ khalagorathebhyo bhavantītyekaṃ vākyam; cakāraścānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, taḥ khalādibhya inirbhavatīti dvitīyam| dvitīye tu vākye khalaśabdasya tatra prakāropalakṣaṇatvaṃ veditavyam, na tu prakṛtitvam|| 52. viṣayo deśe| (4.2.52) `yo'sau viṣayo deśaścet sa bhavati' iti| nanu ca yo viṣayaḥ sa deśa eva bhavati, kiṃ tadviśeṣaṇena deśe grahaṇena ? ityāha-- `viṣayaśabdo'yam' ityādi| `atyantaśīlite' iti| atyantābhyasta ityarthaḥ| 53. rājanyādibhyo vuñ| (4.2.53) `ākṛtigaṇaścāyam' iti| aparisamāptatāṃ rājanyāderdarśayati|ādiśabdaścāyaṃ prakārārthaḥ|| 54. bhaurikyādyaiṣukāryādibhyo vighalbhaktalau| (4.2.54) 55. so'syādiriticchandasaḥ pragātheṣu| (4.2.55) `chandasaḥ' iti| na svarūpagrahaṇam, nāpi mantrabrāhmaṇayoḥ | kasya tarhi ? akṣarāṇāmiyattāvacanaśchandaśabdo'sti, yasya jagatyādayo viśeṣāḥ, tasyedaṃ grahaṇam| tasyaiva hi pragātha ityādau sambandhaḥ, netarasya| tena paṅktyādibhyaḥ pratyayo bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| `{pragathanena--kāśikā} pragranthena' iti| uccāraṇaviśeṣaṇena pragranthāt prakarṣādgāyanarthādveti| etena yannimittakaḥ pragāthaśabdastāṃ kriyāṃ darśayati| pragāthaśabdo'yaṃ yadā `akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19) iti karmaṇi ghañanto vyutpādyate-- pragravayate'sau pragātha iti, pṛṣodarādipāṭhādgranthe rephānunāsikayorlopaśca , tadā pragranthanakriyānimittako bhavati| yadā tu `kai gai śabde' (dhā.pā.916,917) ityasmāt `uṇādayo bahulam' (3.3.1) iti pragāthasthanpratyayānto vyutpādyate, tadā gāyanakriyānimitto bhavati| `nupaṃsake' ityādi| napuṃsakaliṅge svārtha eva cchandasaḥ pratyayasyopasaṃkhyānam| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- iti karaṇo vivakṣārthaḥ| tena yatra pratyayāntācchiṣṭānāṃ vivakṣā bhavati tatra pratyayena bhavitavyam| napuṃsakaliṅge svārthe'pi ca sā bhavati, atastatrāpi pratyayo bhavati| avaśyaṃ caitadeva vijñeyam| yo hi manyate-- `sarvātiprasaṅganivṛttiritikaraṇena kriyate' iti, tasyāsāvanarthaka eva syāt; sarvātiprasaṅgānānupādhibhirnirastatvāt|| 56. saṅgrāme prayojanayoddhṛbhyaḥ| (4.2.56) atra `saṃgrāme' iti pratyayārtha iti, saptamyantatvāt| `prayojanayoddhṛbhyaḥ' iti pañcamyantatvāt prakṛtinirdeśaḥ, tataśca `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' (4.1.82) ityetadvirudhyate; prathamasya pratyayārthatvena dvitīyasya prakṛtitvenopādīyamānatvādityasya codyasya nirāsāyāha-- `so'syeti samarthavibhaktiḥ pratyayārthaścānuvarttate' iti| etenaitaddarśayati-- `prayojanayoddhṛbhyaḥ' ityetadevamarthaṃ yasmāt pūrvasūtrādeva sa iti prathamaṃ tadihānuvarttate, tadvaśeṣaṇaṃ tu prayojanayoddhṛbhya iti| pratyayātho'pyasyeti pūrvasūtrādanuvarttate, tadviśeṣaṇaṃ saṃgrāmaḥ, tatro nāsti virodhaḥ; pūrvasūtre yat prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ tata eva pratyayavidhānāditi|| 57. tadasyāṃ praharaṇamiti krīḍāyāṃ ṇaḥ| (4.2.57) 58. ghañaḥ sāsyāṃ kriyeti ñaḥ| (4.2.58) `kriyeti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam' iti| yatra tadghañantaṃ kriyāvāci cedbhavatīti| tena bhāve yo ghañ tadantāt pratyayo bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| nanu ca bhāve yo ghañ tenaiva tadantaṃ kriyāvāci ? yasmāddhātvarthasya siddhatā nāma yo dharmastatra ghañādibhirbhavitavyamityuktaṃ prāk, dharmadharmiṇorbhedasyāvivitatvāt kriyādharmo'pi kriyāśabdanokta ityadoṣaḥ| `itikaraṇo vivakṣārthaḥ'iti| nanu ca parvasūtrādevetikaraṇo'nuvaritiṣyate,tatkiṃ punariha tasyopādānam ? itikaraṇasyeha prakaraṇe'nadhikāratāṃ darśayituṃ punarupādānam| tena `taddhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityatrāsyetikaraṇasyānanuvṛttau vivakṣāniyamābhāvādadhyetṛveditṛmātre pratyayaḥ siddho bhavatītyeke| vaicitryārthamitikaraṇopādānamityapare| `śyainampātā' iti| `śala hula patlṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.843, 844,845) bhāve ghañ, śyenasya pāta iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ñe vihite `śyenatilasya pāte ñe' (6.3.71) ita mum| `prākāraḥ' iti| karoteḥ prapūrvāt `akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' (3.3.19) iti karmaṇi ghañ| `upasargasya ghañyamanuṣye bahulam' (6.3.122) iti praśabdasya dīrghaḥ| bhavatīdaṃ ghañantam; na tu kriyāvāci; prākāras dravyatvāt| `atha'ityādi codyam| `krīḍāyāmityanena tatsambaddham' ityādi parihāraḥ| syādetat,anuvarttatāṃ krīḍā, tasyāñcedaṃ pratyavidhānamiṣyata ityata āha-- `sāmānyena ca' ityādi|| 59. tadadhīte tadveda| (4.2.59) `vaiyākaraṇaḥ' iti| `nana yvābhyām' (7.3.3) ityādinā vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ,aijāgamaśca| `dvistaddagrahaṇam' ityādi| yadi `tadadhīte veda' ityevocyeta pratyayārthadvasya dvitīyāsamarthe samuccayo vijñāyate, tataśca yastvadhīte vetti ca tatraiva syāt; yastvadhīte kevalaṃ na vetti, vetti vā kevalaṃ nādhīte tatra na syāt| dvistad‌grahaṇe tu vākyabhedādadhīyāne viduṣi ca pratyekaṃ pratyayaḥ sidhyati| tadarthaṃ dvistad‌grahaṇam| naitad‌dvistad‌grahaṇasya prayojanam, yathaiva hi `te na dīvyati khanati jayati jitam' (4.4.2) ityatra sakṛt samarthavibhaktyupādāne'pi pratyayārthacatuṣṭayena tṛtīyāsamarthena samuccayo na vijñāyate,tathehāpi na vijñāsyate| tena yathā dīvyatiprabhṛtiṣu pratyayo bhavati, tathehāpi pratyekamadhīyāne viduṣi ca bhaviṣyatīti ? na brūmaḥ-- ihaiva dvistad‌grahaṇamadhīyānaviduṣoḥ pṛthagvidhānārthamiti| `kutastarhi ? `kratūkthādisūtrāntāṭṭhak' (4.2.60), `vasantādibhyaṣṭhak' (4.2.63) ityatra ca| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra na syāt ? kratuśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyaḥ,vasantādayo'pyṛtuvacanāḥ, teṣāmadhyayanaṃ nopapadyate| tatsahacarite granthe syāt, sa ca tatra goṇa iti na gṛhyate| mukhya evārthe vedane sambhavatīti tebhyo viduṣyeṇa pratyayaḥ syāt, nādhyetari| punardvistadgrahaṇādgauṇasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti pratyekamadhyetṛviduṣoratra ṭhakpratyayo bhavati|| 60. kratūkthādisūtrāntāṭṭhak| 94.2.60) kratuśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyaḥ, tasyādhyanavedane dve na sambhavata iti sāhacaryāt tadartho grantho gṛhyate, na tu kratunāmā kraturastīti tadviśeṣā ye'gniṣṭomādayastadratho grantho gṛhyate, tatra cāha-- `kratuviśeṣavācibhyaḥ' iti| agniṣṭomamadhīta ityagniṣṭomena sahacaritaṃ tadarthagranthamadhīta ityarthaḥ| `sūtrāntādakalpāderiṣyate' iti| kimiṣyata eva ? tato na tat śasyate, labhyate ca | kutaḥ ? vetyanuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt| `kiṃ tarhi ? sāmalakṣaṇa aukthikye varttamāne' iti| ukthasaṃjñakānāṃ sāmnalakṣaṇaṃ vyākhyāgrantha aukthikyaḥ, `{chandogaukthikya' itimu.pāṭhaḥ |} chandogaukthikaya' (4.3.129) ityādinā ñyaḥ| tatraukthikye sāmalakṣaṇegranthe varttamāna ukthaśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati| kuta etat ? gauṇena saha kratuśabdena nirdeśāt| aukthikye ukthaśabdasya vṛttistādarthyādbhavati| bhavati ca tādarthyāt tācchabdyam, yathā-- pradīpārthā mallikā pradīpa iti| aukthikyaṃ yo'dhīte kathaṃ tatra bhavitavyam ? ityata āṅa-- `aukthikyaśabdācca' iti| tatraiva kāraṇamāha-- `anabhidhānāt' iti| `vidyālakṣaṇakalpasūtrāntāt' (ga.sū.84), ityasyātiprasaktasyāpavādamāha-- `vidyā ca'ityādi| vidyāśabdo'naṅgakṣatradharmasaṃsargatripūrva eva pratyayamutpādayati, nāṅgādipūrva ityarthaḥ| `traividyaḥ' iti| tryavayavā vidyā, śākapārthivāditvāduttarapadalopī samāsaḥ| trividyāmadhīte traividyaḥ| yāvakrītamākhyānadhīte `yāvakrītikaḥ'| priyaṅgumadhīte `praiyaṅgavikaḥ'| vāsavadattāmākhyayikāmadhīte `vāsavadattikaḥ'| sumanottarāmadhīte `saumanottarikaḥ| `sarvasāderdvigośca laḥ' iti| sarvādeḥ sāderdvigorutpannasya ṭhako lopo bhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu ca `dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) ityevaṃ siddhaḥ ? satyametat; iha tu kaiścit `vidyālakṣaṇakalpasūtrāntāt' (ga.sū.84) ityādinā pratipadaṃ pratyayo vidhīyate| tad dveṣyamapi jāyeta| pratipadavidhānānna luk, tato lugvacanam| `anusūrlakṣyalakṣaṇe ca' iti| anusūśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati| lakṣyalakṣaṇe ca śabdarūpe pratyayamutpādayataḥ| `ānusukaḥ' iti| `isusuktāntāt kaḥ' (7.3.51) iti kaḥ, `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ| `ikana bahulaṃ padottarapadāt' iti| padaśabda uttarapadaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `śataṣaṣṭeḥ ṣikan pathaḥ'iti| śataṣaṣṭiśabdābhyāmuttarasmāt pathaḥ ṣikan pratyayo bhavati| ṣakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ, nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| etatsarvamukthādiṣu pāṭhādeva siddham| yadapīha kiñcinna paṭhyate, tadapi ca bahulagrahaṇena saṃgṛhītam| ukthādiṣvapi ṣikan bahulaṃ padottarapadācceti paṭhyate|| 61. kramādibhyo vun| (4.2.61) 62. anugrāhmaṇādiniḥ| (4.2.62) `brāhmaṇasadṛso'yaṃ grantho'nubrāhmaṇam' iti| yathārtha'vyayībhāvaṃ darśayati| nanu yo'nubrāhmaṇamadhīte tasyānubrāhmaṇamastīti tatra matvarthīyenaiveninā siddham, tat kimarthamidam ? aṇbādhanārtham| yadīdaṃ nocyeta `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ prasajyeta|| 63. vasantādibhyaṣṭak| (4.2.63) `{vasantasahacarito'yaṃ grnatho vasantaḥ-kāśikā} vasantasahacarito grantho vasantaḥ'iti| yo vasante paṭhyate, niyogena yatra ca vasanto varṇyate sa vasanta sahacarito bhavati| `varṣāśaradam' iti| varṣāśca śaracca varṣāśaradam| `dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt samāhāre' (5.4.106) iti ṭac| samāsāntena nirdeśaḥ|| 64. proktālluk| (4.2.64) yukto nirdeśo yadi proktanāmā grantho vyākaraṇādirbhavati, na cāsāvasti; anyārthena tataḥ paraḥ sambhavatītyetaṃ doṣamākarttumāha-- `proktasahacaritaḥ' ityādi| sāhacaryāt so'yamityabhedopacāreṇa proktārthe yo vahitaḥ pratyayaḥ sa proktaśabdenokta iti darśayati| `pāṇinīyaḥ' iti| `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) tadantāt `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ| tasya luk `pāṇinīyaḥ'| āpiśalinā proktamityaṇ, tasya luk-- `āpiśalaḥ' | kaḥ punaratra viśeṣo'rtho luki sati, yāvatā tadeva rūpam ? ityāha-- `striyām' ityādi| asati luki `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp syāt, so'ṇaḥ svareṇāntodāttaḥ| luki hi sati ṭābbhavati, svareṇa tu madhyodāttaḥ| āpiśaliśabdālluki sati svare nāsti viśeṣaḥ| satyapi hi lukyantodāttatvena bhavitavyam| striyāntu pūrvokto viśeṣo varttate-- na hi luki sati ṅībbhavati; satyapyaṇi tatraiva `anupasarjanāt' (4.1.14) ityadhikārāt pratiṣedhāt, proktārthavihitasya cāṇa ihopasarjanatvāt|| 65. sūtrācca kopadhāt| (4.2.65) kopadhāditi vacanāt svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatītyataḥ sūtravācino grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha-- `sūtravācinaḥ pratipādikāt' iti| `aṣṭakam' iti| aṣṭāvadhyāyāḥ parimāṇamasya| `tadasya parimāṇam' (5.1.57) ityanuvarttamāne `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' (5.1.58) iti ca `sakhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan' (5.1.22) iti kan| `saṃkhyāprakṛteriti vaktavyam' iti| saṃkhyā pkṛtiryasya pratyayasya sa saṃkhyāprakṛtiḥ| tadantāt kopadhādutpannasya lubbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vaktavyam, vyākhyemityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- veti varttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena saṃkhyāprakṛtereva bhaviṣyati, nānyasmāditi| `{cātuṣṭayaḥ-- kāśikā, catuṣṭayaḥ-padamañjarī|}cātuṣṭayam' iti| catvāro'vayavā asyeti `saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap' (5.2.42), `hrasvāt tādau taddhite' (8.3.99) iti mūrdhanyaḥ, ṣatvaṃ bhavati| etat saṃkhyāprakṛtipratyayāntam, na tu kopadham, kiṃ tarhi ? yopadham|| 66. chandobrāhmaṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi| (4.2.66) `proktagrahaṇamanuvarttate' iti| taccehārthāt prathamāntaṃ vijñāyate chandobrāhmaṇānītyasya samānādhikaraṇārtham, ata āha-- chandāṃsi brāhmaṇāni ca proktapratyayāntānīti bhavanti' (iti)| svarūpagrahaṇamiha na bhavati| tathā hi -- proktagrahaṇamihānuvarttate, na ca cchandobrāhmaṇaśabdau proktapratyayāntau| tasmācchandobrāhmaṇavācino ye śabdāḥ proktapratyayāntāste gṛhyante| kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate ? iha proktapratyayāntasya bahuprakāratā labhyate| tathā hi kvacit tadantasya svātantryamupalabhyate, yatā-- pāṇininā proktaṃ pāṇinīyaṃ śāstram| proktārtha eva vṛttiḥ svātantryam| pāṇinīya śabdasya cātra proktārtha eva vṛttiḥ| kvacidupādhyantayogaḥ, yathā-- pāṇinīyaṃ mahat bhavatsu vihitamiti| kvacidvākyam-- pāṇinīyamadhīta iti| kvacid‌vṛttiḥ| pāṇinīya iti| tadiha chandobrāhmaṇānāmadhyetṛveditṛviṣayā vṛttiryathā syāt| prakārāntaraṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamidamucyate| `adhyetṛveditṛ' iti| adhyetṛveditṛpratyayo viṣayeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| `{ananyabhāvo--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca} anyatrabhāvo viṣayārthaḥ' iti| yathā matsyānāṃ jalaṃ viṣaya ityatrānanyatrabhāve viṣayaśabdo varttate, tathehāpi| etena yadyapi grāmasamudāyādiṣvartheṣu viṣayaśabdasya vṛttiḥ, tathāpīhānanyatrabhāve varttamānaḥ saṃgṛhyata iti darśayati| `tena'ityādinā ananyatrabhāvavṛttiśabdasya phalaṃ darśayati| evaṃ hyatranyatrābhāvo bhavati yadi svātantryādi na bhavati| upādhyantarayogo mahattvādinā viśeṣeṇa sambaddhaḥ kaṭha iti| `kaṭhena proktam' iti| `kalāpiśvaiśabhyāyanāntavāsibhyaśca' (4.3.104) iti ṇiniḥ, tasya `kaṭhacarakālluk' (4.3.107), tataḥ kaṭhena proktamadhīte tadvedeti (4.2.59) punaraṇ, tasyāpi `proktālluk' (4.2.64) iti luk| `maudāḥ, paippalādāḥ' iti| `kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaśca' (4.3.104) iti ṇiniḥ-modena proktamiti, `kalāpino'ṇ' (4.3.108) ityaṇ, tadantāt `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya `proktālluk' (4.2.64) iti luk| `ācārbhinaḥ' iti| ṛcābhena proktamiti `kalāpivaiśamyāyanāntevāsibhyaśca' (4.3.104) iti ṇiniḥ, tadantāt `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ| `vājasaneyinaḥ' iti| vājasaneyena proktamiti| `śaunakādibhyaśchandasi' (4.3.106) iti ṇiniḥ, tadantāt `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya luk| `tāṇḍinaḥ' iti| tāṇḍyaśabdād‌gargādi (4.1.105) yañantāt proktārthe `purāṇaprokteṣu brāhmaṇakalpeṣu' (4.3.105) iti ṇiniḥ, `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) itiyalopaḥ| tataḥ `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya luk| `bhāllavinaḥ' iti| bhāllaviśabdādiḍhantāt proktārthe pūrvavaṇṇiniḥ,tadantāt tadveda (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya luk| śāṭyāyaninaḥ' iti| śāṭyaśabdād‌gargādi (4.1.105) yañantāt `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak,tataḥ proktārthe pūrvavaṇṇiniḥ, tadantāt `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya luk| `aitareyiṇaḥ' iti|aitareyaśabdāclubhrādiḍhagantāt (4.1.123) pūrvavaṇṇiniḥ, tataḥ `tadadhīte' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasyu luk| `brāhmaṇaviśeṣapratipattyartham' iti| brāhmaṇaviśeṣaḥ purāṇaproktatvam| tasya pratītiḥ - pratipattiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ brāhmaṇagrahaṇam| `yājñavalkyāni' iti| yājñavalkyaśabdādgargādi (4.1.105) yañantāt proktārthe `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) ityaṇ| `saulabhani' iti sulabhena proktānīti| pūrvavat `kalāpino'ṇ' (4.3.108) ityaṇ| atra svātantryaṃ bhavati| na hīha purāṇaproktatvamasti; idānīntena proktatvāt| `kāśyapinaṛḥ, kauśikinaḥ'iti| kaśyapena proktaḥ kalpaḥ, kauśikena prokkata iti| ` kāśyapakauśikābhyāmṛṣibhyāṃ ṇiniḥ' (4.3.103), tadantāt `tadadhīte' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya luk| `pāraśariṇaḥ, śailālinaḥ' iti| pārāśaryeṇa proktaṃ sūtram, śilālinā proktaṃ sūtram-- `pāraśaryaśilālibhyāṃ bhikṣunaṭasūtrayoḥ' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya luk| `karmandinaḥ, kṛśāśvinaḥ' iti| karmandena proktaṃ sūtram, kṛśāśvena proktaṃ sūtramiti `karmandakṛśāśvādiniḥ' (4.3.111) tadantāt `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya luk| `paiṅgī kalpaḥ'iti| piṅgena proktaḥ kalpaḥ-- `purāṇaprokta' (4.3.105) ityādinā ṇiniḥ| tatra svātantryameva bhavati, na ca tadviṣayatā|| 67. tadasminnastīti deśe tannāmni| (4.3.67) `pratyayāntanāmā' iti| yadi tarhi tannāmni deśe pratyayaḥ, itikaraṇo'narthakaḥ, tannāmagrahaṇādevātiprasaṅganivṛttiḥ ? naitadasti; dvividhaṃ hi nāma-- saṅketitam, anuvṛttañca| saṅketitaṃ yadadyāpi vyavahārapadavīṃ nānupatati, tatrānuvṛttaṃ yannāma tatrāyaṃ yogaḥ| anuvṛttañca vyāvahārikam, tatpratipattyarthamitikaraṇaḥ kriyate, grāmādiviśeṣaparigrahārthaśca| yadyevam, itikaraṇa eva kriyatām, kiṃ tannāmnītyanena ? etadapi na karttavyam; nāmadheyatā virodhino'pi balīyaso'pi pratyayān bādhitvam| katham ? nāprāpte matupyayaṃ yoga ārabhyamāṇe matupamavādatvādbādhate| tadapavādaistviniṭhanādibhiḥ saha sampradhāraṇāyāmapavādavipratiṣedhādiniṭhanādaya eva syuḥ| nāmagrahaṇe tu sati balīyobhirapi sampradhāraṇāyāḥ sampratyayo bhavati-- yo nāmadheyatāṃ gamayati sa cāturthika eveti| ataḥ sa eva bhavati|| 68. tena nirvṛtattam| (4.2.68) `caturṣvapi' iti| anantarātīte'smin vakṣyamāṇayośca yogayoḥ| `karttari ca'iti| lakṣyānurodhena kvaciddhetau kvacit karttari ca-- sahasreṇeti hetau,kuśāmbeneti karttari| yadā hetau tadā vṛtterakarmakatvānnirvṛtta iti karttari niṣṭhā, yadā karttari tadā'ntarbhāvitavyamarthatvātā karmaṇi| akarmakā apyantarbhāvitaṇyarthāḥ sakarmakā bhavanti|| 69. tasya nivāsaḥ| (4.2.69) 70. adūrabhavaśca| (4.2.70) 71.orañ| (4.2.71) `yathāyatham' iti| yathāsvam| tatra prathame prathamāsamarthavibhaktiyuktāt| dvitīye tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktiyuktāt| tṛtīyacaturthayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamarthavibhaktiyuktāt| `nadyāstu paratvānmatubeva bhavati' iti| nadyāṃ matup' (4.2.85) ityanena|| 72. matośca bahvajaṅgāt| (4.2.72) `mālavatam' iti| yadi bahvajiti, na bhavatyeva doṣaḥ|| 73. bahvacaḥ kūpeṣu| (4.2.73) 74.udak ca vipāśaḥ| (4.2.74) 75. saṅkalādibhyaśca| (4.2.75) 76. strīṣu sauvīrasālvaprākṣu| (4.2.76) 77. suvāstvādibhyo'ṇ| (4.2.77) `uvarmāntalakṣaṇasya' ityādi| ya uvarṇāntāstebhyaḥ `orañ' (4.2.71) iti prāptasyāño'pavādaḥ| śeṣebhyaśca `bahvacaḥ kūpeṣu' (4.2.73) ityādinā prāptasya kūpalakṣaṇsya| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, subāstvādibhyo yatāvihitamevocyeta| punarvacanaṃ yo vihito na ca prāpnoti tadartaṃ vijñāyate| aṇeva ca vihito na prāpnoti; apavādena bādhitvā |atha sa bhaviṣyītyata āha-- `aṇgrahaṇam' ityādi| asati hyaṇgrahaṇe `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān vidhīn bādhante nottarān' (vyā.pa.10) iti nadīmatupā saha samprasāraṇāyāṃ paratvānnadīpamatup syāt| aṇo grahaṇādaṇeva bhavati| tasmānmatupo bādhanārthaṇgrahaṇam|| 78. roṇī| (4.2.78) `ko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ'iti| kutsito'yaṃ nirdeśa ityarthaḥ| kutsitaṃ tu lakṣaṇātikrāntatvāt| tadeva lakṣaṇātikrāntatvaṃ darśayitumāha `yāvatā'ityādi| sarvāvasthā ca kevalasya tadantasya ca pratipattiḥ prakṛtatvena yathā syādityevamarthamucyate| yadi `roṇyāḥ' ityādinirdeśaḥ kriyeta tadā `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirna' (vyā.pa.89) iti kevalādeva syāta, na tadantāt| roṇīti śāstrānapekṣeṇa nirdeśena śāstranirapekṣatvamihocyate, tadasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anapekṣaṇādiha tadantāpi pratyayaḥ siddho bhavati. nanu ca grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate, na cedaṃ prātipadikam; strīpratyayāntatvāt| atha matam-- `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.29) iti prātipadikasya tadantavidheḥ pratiṣidhyamānaḥ strīpratyayāntasyāpi pratiṣidhyata iti,etacca yatra hi prātipadikasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ tadviṣayā paribhāṣeti prāg jñāpitametat ? evaṃ tarhi tasya jñāpanasya prāyikatvaṃ darśayati| tena kvacidasvarūpagrahaṇe'pyeṣā paribhāṣā pravarttate| tena kumārīmācaṣṭe kumārayatītyatra `jātiṣṭhavat prātipadikasya' (vā.813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvaḥ siddho bhavati|| 79. kopadhācca| (4.2.79) 80. vuñchaṇkaṭhajilaseniraḍhañṇyayaphakphiñiññyakakṭhako'rīhaṇakṛśāśvarśyakumudakāśatṛṇaprekṣāśmasakhisaṅkāśabalapakṣakarṇasutaṅgamapragadinvarāhakumudādibhyaḥ| (4.2.80) `autsirgiko'pi tatreṣyate' iti| yadyevam, tasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnotītyata āha-- `tasya ca' ityādi| `tathā coktam' ityādi| tadeva draḍhayati-- autsargika ityeva| śirīṣāṇāmadūrabhavo śirīṣāḥ, tasya vanaṃ śirīṣavanamiti bhāṣyakāravacanāllabhyate| viśeṣavihitānāṃhi lupā na bhavitavyam| ata autsargikasya lubbhavatīti vijñāyate|| 81. janapade lup| (4.2.81) 82. varaṇādibhyaśca| (4.2.82) 83. śarkarāyā vā| (4.2.83) `pāṭhasāmarthyāt'ityādi| yadi nityo lup syāt, gaṇayorasya pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| tasmāt pāṭhasamārthyādeva pakṣe śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyata āha| `evaṃ tarhi' ityādinā vāghaṇasya jñāpakaṃ darśayati| `śarkarā' iti| autsargikasya lup| `śārkaram' iti| tsyaiva pakṣe śravaṇam| `śarkarakam' iti| kumudāditvāṭṭhac| `śārkarakam' iti| varāhāditvāt kak| śārkarikam, śarkarīyam' iti| uttarasūtreṇa ṭhakchau|| 84. ṭhakchau ca| (4.2.84) 85. nadyāṃ matup| (4.2.85) `udumbarāvatī'iti| `matau bahvajo'najirādīnām' (6.3.119) iti dīrghaḥ|| 86. madhvādibhyaśca| (4.2.86) 87. kumudanaḍavetasebhyo ḍmatup| (4.2.87) kumudaśabdāṭṭhacṭhakoḥ prāptayoḥ| naḍaśabdādapi `ऩḍaśādāḍḍavalac' (4.2.88) iti `naḍādīnāṃ kukca' 4.2.91) iti| asmiṃśca vidhau prāpte vetasaśabdādapi matub vidhīyate| `mahiṣācca' ityādi| `mahiṣaśabdānmatub vidhīyate' ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamaccayārthaḥ| tena mahiṣaśabdādapi bhaviṣyatīti|| 88. naḍaśādāḍḍvalac| (4.2.88) 89. śikhāyā valac| (4.2.89) 90. utkarādibhyaśchaḥ| (4.2.90) 91. naḍādīnāṃ kuk ca| (4.2.91) `kruñcāyā hrasvatvañca' iti| kruñcāśabdasya kugbhavati hrasvatvañca-- `krauñcakīyam' iti| `tikṣannalopaśca' iti| takṣannityasya kugāgamo bhavati, nalopaśca-- `takṣakīyam' iti| 92. śeṣe| (4.2.92) `upayuktādanyaḥ śeṣaḥ' ityetadgrahaṇakavākyam| tadeva `apatyādibhyaḥ'ityādinā vivṛṇoti|apatyādayo hi cāturarthyaparyantāḥ pratyayavidhau viniyuktāḥ, tasmāt tebhyo yo'nyo jātādirarthaḥ,sa śeṣaḥ| nanu ca nivṛttā apatyādayaḥ, tebhyaścāntareṣu jātādiṣi yeṣu ghādayastato'patyādiṣu naiva te prāpnuvantīti tatkiṃ tannivṛttyarthena śeṣādhikāreṇa ? itya āha-- `tasyedam' ityādi| jātādiṣvartheṣu tasyedamityeṣo'rthaḥ paṭhyate| taccāpatyādīnāṃ sāmānyam| sāmānye ca vidhīyamānastadviśeṣe'pi vidhīyate| tadupalakṣaṇatvāt sāmānyasya| atastasyedaṃ viśeṣatvājjātādyantaḥpātiṣvapatyādiṣu ghādayaḥ prāpnuvanti| tasmāt teṣu mā bhūvanniti śeṣādhikāraḥ kriyate| `kiñca' ityādinā prayojanāntaraṃ darśayati| asati hi śeṣādhikāre ghādīnāṃ prathamārthenaiva sambandhamanubhavatāṃ tatraiva kṛtārthatā vijñāyeta| tatra dvitīyādiṣvartheṣu prāgdīvyatīyā evāṇādayaḥ syuḥ, na tu ghādayaḥ| śeṣaśabdastūpayuktādanyatayā jātādīnarthānekīkṛtya śaknotyabhidhātum-- `sarvatra ghādayaḥ sidhyantīti| ataḥ sākalyārthaṃ vā śeṣavacanam| `lakṣamaṃ cādhikāraśca, iti| iha lakṣaṇasya vidhāyakatvāllakṣyate'neneti lakṣaṇamiti kṛtvā; uttaratrādhikāraḥ svaritatvāt| tatra yadā'sya lakṣaṇam,cākṣuṣādayaḥ sidhyanti| yadā svadhikāratā, tadā sarveṣu jātādiṣvartheṣu ghādayo bhavanti| yadi tarhi śeṣa itilakṣaṇamapīdamanenaiva yathā grahaṇādiṣvartheṣu pratyayo bhavati, tathā jātādiṣvapi bhaviṣyatīti jātādyanukramaṇamanarthakam ? na; apavādavidhānārthatvāt| yāni tvanapavādārthāni jātanivṛttalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ--ityevamādīni tāni śeṣagrahaṇasyaiva prapañco veditavyaḥ|| 93. rāṣṭrāvārapārādghakhau| (4.2.93) rāṣṭraśabdāt `vṛddhācchaḥ'(4.2.114) iti cche prāpte|avārapāraśabdādaṇi ghakhau vidhīyete| avārasya pāramavārapāramiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| rājadantādiṣu darśanāt pārāvāramityapi pakṣe bhavati| vigṛhītādviparītācca labhyate| vaktavyamevaitat| atha vā-- ekaśeṣo vijñāsyate, tatraikaḥ samudāyārethaḥ, aparo'vayavārtho bhaviṣyati| viparītasyāpi `ekārthānāṃ virūpāṇām' (1.2.64.vā.23) ityekaśeṣo na virudhyate, thā-- vakradaṇḍaśca kuṭiladaṇḍaśca kuṭiladaṇḍāviti, yathā ca yaṅlukāviti | nanu ca tasyaivaṃ prakṛtayo bhavanti, pañca rāṣṭrādiśabdāḥ,pratyayau tu dvau-- iti vaiṣamyāt saṃkhyātānudeśo na sidhyati ? naiṣa doṣaḥ;nirdeśāpekṣaṃ hi yathāsaṃkhyatvam| nirdeśaśca dvayoreva tadapekṣayā prakṛte yathāsaṃkhyatvam| evaṃ pañcādyabheda upajāyate, na sa yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bādhate| yathā vuñādīnāñca gaṇāpekṣayā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pravṛtte tu yathāsaṃkhyena pratyayotpattivelāyāṃ gaṇeṣu yadyapi prātipadikarūpāṇyasamasaṃkhyāni bhavanti, tathātrāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na hīyate| kutaḥ punaravagatam-- ekaśeṣo'yamiti ? vyākhyānāt| `prakṛtiviśeṣopādānamātreṇa' iti| mātraśabdo jātādyarthavibhaktinirdeśasya ca vyavacchedāya|| 94. grāmādyakhañau| (4.2.94) vṛddhalakṣaṇe che prāpte vacanam|| 95. kattryādibhyo ḍhakañ| (4.2.95) kattryādiṣu yad‌vṛddhaṃ paṭhyate tataśche prāpte śeṣebhyastvaṇīti yogo'yamārabhyate| kattriśabdaśca tatpuruṣaḥ-- kutsitāstrayaḥ, `koḥ kat' (6.3.101) itiyogavibhāgāt kadbhāvaḥ| ata eva nipātanādbahuvrīhirvā-- kutsitāstrayo yasyāḥ kattriḥ| `kuḍyāyā yalopaśca' iti| kuḍajñāśabdāḍ ḍhañ bhavati yalopaśca --kauḍeyakaḥ| ye tu `kulyāyā yalopaśca' iti paṭhanti teṣāṃ kauleyakaḥ|| 96. kulakukṣigrīvābhyaḥ śvāsyalaṅkāreṣu| (4.2.96) `aṇo'pavādo yogaḥ|| 97.nadyādibhyo ḍhak| (4.2.97) yānyatrāvṛddhāni tebhyo'ṇi prāpteṣa vṛddhebhyastu vārāṇasītyevamādibhyaśche prāpte'pavādaḥ| keṣāñcit `ropadhetoḥ prācāma'(4.2.123) iti vuñi prāpte ḍhagārabhyate| `paureyam' iti | puri bhavam| vane bhavaṃ `vāneyam' | `gaireyam' iti| girau bhavam| `tadubhayamapi darsanaṃ pramāṇabhūtam iti| ubhayathā'pyācāryeṇa śiṣyāṇāṃ pratipāditvāt| gaṇe nadītyetat svarūpeṇa grahaṇam, na saṃjñāgrahaṇārtham| saṃjñāgrahaṇe hi mahyadīnāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt| 98. dakṣiṇāpaścātpurasastyak| (4.2.98) paścātpurasoravyayatvāt sāhacaryāddakṣiṇāśabdo'pi `dakṣiṇādāc' (5.3.36) ityajantamadhyayameva gṛhyate| evaṃ ca `avyayāttyap' (4.2.104) ityatra parigaṇanāt tyapaḥ prāptirnāstītyaṇo'pavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ|| 99.kāpiśyāḥ ṣphak| (4.2.99) vṛddhā (4.2.114)diti che prāpte kāpiśīśabdāt ṣphagvidhīyate| `bāhlo' ityādi| bāhlītyādibhyaḥ ṣphagbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- uttarasūtrādiha cakāraḥ siṃhāvalokitanyāyenānuvarttate, tasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt bāhlyādibhyo'pi ṣphagbhavatīti|| 100. raṅkoramanuṣye ca| (4.2.100) `ordeśe ṭhañ' (4.2.119) iti ṭhañi `janapadatadavadhyośca' (4.2.124) iti janapadalakṣaṇe vuñi `kopadhādaṇ' (4.2.132) ityaṇi prāpte vacanam| `{kacchādipāṭhādamanuṣye'ṇāpi--kāśikā,padamañjarī ca|} kacchādipāṭhādaṇipa siddhaḥ' iti| `kacchādibhyaśca' (4.2.133) ityatra `kopadhādaṇ' (4.2.132) ityaṇ grahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `nañivayuktanyāyena'iti| nañyukte cevayukte ca tatsadṛśasampratyayo bhavati| iha ca manuṣyaśabdo nañyuktaḥ, tasmānneha manuṣyanneha manuṣyapratiṣedhyaḥ kriyate| api ca manuṣyasadṛśe prāṇinyeva pravṛttiḥ, tena manuṣyasadṛśe prāṇini ṣphagaṇau bhavataḥ| aprāṇini tu kacchādipāṭhādaṇeva bhavati, na ṣpak-- `rāṅkavaḥ kambalaḥ'iti| `viśeṣa vihitena' ityādi| yadīhāpyaṇna kriyeta,tadā`{kacchādibhyaśca ityeva sūtram|} kacchādibhyo'ṇ' (4.2.133) ityaṇo rāṅkavaḥ kambala ityatra sāvakāśatvāt prāṇini viśeṣavihitena ṣphakā tasya bādhanaṃ syāt| tasmādeṣa doṣo mā bhūdityaṇapi kriyate|| 101. dyuprāgapāgudakpratīco yat| (4.2.101) aṇi prāpte yad vidhīyate| prāgityādayaḥ śabdā añcateḥ `ṛtvik'(3.2.59) ityādinā kvini kṛte satyātmānaṃ labhante| te ca dvividhāḥ-- avyayasaṃjñakā,anavyayasaṃjñakāśca| yadā tvastātipratyayāntā bhavanti tadā `taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38) ityavyayasaṃjñāvidhānādavyayasaṃjñakāḥ,anyadā tvanavyayasaṃjñakāḥ| teṣāmiha viśeṣasyānupādānādubhayeṣāmapi grahaṇam| `prācyam, `{avācyam--itikāśikāpāṭhaḥ,padamañjarīpāṭhaśca| }apācyam' iti| `acaḥ' (6.4.138) ityakāralopaḥ, `cau' (6.3.138) iti dīrghaḥ| `udīcyam' iti|`uda īt' (6.4.139) itīkāraḥ| `prāktanam' iti| prākśabdāt `dikśabdebhyaḥ saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyo dik' (5.3.27) ityādinā'stātiḥ, tasya `añcerluk' (5.3.30) iti luk, tato'nena yati prāpte `sāyañciram' (4.3.23) ityādinā ṭyuṭyulau bhavataḥ| yatastu -- yaśca kālavācī so'vakāśaḥ|| 102. kanthāyāṣṭhak| (4.2.102) aṇapavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ|| 103. varṇau vuk| (4.2.103) `varṇuḥ' iti| nado'bhidhīyate| srotasi ca kanthā na sambhavīti sāmīpikamadhikaraṇaṃ vijñāyate, ata āha-- `tatsamīpo deśo varṇuḥ' iti| varṇuśabdāt `adūrabhavaśca' (4.2.70) ityatrārthe `suvāstvādibhyo'ṇ' (4.2.77) ityaṇ, tasya `janapade lup' (4.2.81) iti lupi kṛte varṇuriti bhavati| nanu ca pratipadavidhānāt pratyayasya lubna bhavati ? naivam; suvāstvādipāṭho hi janapadādānyasmin pratyayārthe kṛtārthaḥ--`vārṇavo grāmo nagaramiti, na tu janapade| tatra tu paratvāllopena bhavitavyam| `taddhiṣayārtha'iti| viṣayagrahaṇena varṇāditi saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| sa varṇudeśo viṣayo yasya tadviṣayārthaḥ| sā punaḥ kanthaiva|| 104.avyayāttyap| (4.2.104) `ameha' ityādi| parigaṇanam| etaccottarasūtrasthasyānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasyabhoryogayoḥ vijñāyate vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyate| amāśabdaḥ samīvācī, svarādipāṭhādavyayatvam| ihetyādīnāṃ `taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ'(1.1.38) iti| amā bhavo'mātyaḥ| `aupariṣṭaḥ' iti| upariṣṭādbhavatītyaṇi kṛte `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopo vaktavyaḥ' (vā.842) iti ṭilopaḥ|parato bhavaḥ `pārastaḥ'| parataḥ śabdaḥ `vibhāṣā parāvarābhyām' (5.3.29) ityasujantaḥ| `ārātīyaḥ' iti| atra ṭilopo na bhavati; `bahiṣaṣṭilopaśca' (vā.378) ityatrānityatvasya jñāpitatvāt| `tyabnerdhruve' iti| niśabdādhruve vācye tyabbhavati| niyate sarvakāle bhavo nityaḥ| `niso gate' iti| niḥśabdādgate vācye tyabbhavati| `niṣṭyaḥ' iti| `hrasvāttādau taddhite' (8.3.99) iti mūrdhanyaḥ| evamādaviṣṭya ityatrāpi bhavati|| 105. aiṣamohyaḥśvaso'ntarasyām| (4.2.105) aiṣamaḥprabhṛ-tīni kālavācīni prātipadikānyavyayāni| `sāyañciram' (4.3.23) ityādinā paratvāṭṭyuṭyuloḥ prāptayoridaṃ vacanam| `śovastikam' iti| `dvārādīnāñca' (7.3.4) ityaijāgamaḥ|| 106.tīrarūpyottarapadādaññau| (4.2.106) atha tīrarūpyottarādityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavatīti ? ata āha-- `tīrarūpyāntāt' ityādi| yadīha tīrarūpyāntādityujyeta, bahucpūrvādapi syāt-- bahutīre jāta iti, bhavati hyetat tīrāntam| uttarapadagrahaṇe hyeṣo'tiprasaṅgo na bhavati, na hyetat, tīrottarapadam, yasmāt samāse satyetadbhavati| pūrvapadamuttarapadamiti nyāyena nāyaṃ samāsaḥ|| 107. dikpūrvapadādasaṃjñāyāṃ ñaḥ| (4.2.107) `paurvaśālaḥ'iti| pūrvasyāṃ śālāyāṃ bhavaḥ paurvaśālaḥ| `taddhitārthaḥ' (2.1.51) ityādinā taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tataḥ pratyayaḥ| atha padagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? `na dikpūrvāt' ityevocyeta ? ityata āha-- `padagrahaṇam' ityādi| asati hi padagrahaṇa svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt| tathā ca diggajaḥ, dignāgaḥ, digdāhaḥ-- ityevamādiḥ prakṛtirvijñāyate| padagrahaṇe tu sati digviśeṣo gṛhyate,katham ? padagrahaṇasāmarthyādvyādhikaraṇe bahuvrīhirvijñāyate-- diśaḥ pūrvapadaṃ yasya | diśa iti ca vācakāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate| teneha tadabhidhāyī pūrvādidikśabdo gṛhyate| 108. madrebhyo'ñ| (4.2.108) `paurvamadraḥ' iti| pūrvavat taddhitārthe (2.1.51) samāsaḥ, tato'ṇi prāpte,`avṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt' (4.2.125) itica vṛñi, `madravṛjyoḥ kan' (4.2.131) iti kanyañ vidhīyate|| 109. udīcyagrāmācca bahvaco'ntodāttau| (4.2.109) `śaivapuram, māhānagaram' iti| śivapuramahānagaraśabdau samāsasvareṇāntodāttau| `māthuram' iti| mathurāśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| madhyadeśagrāmastu, tenāṇeva bhavati| `dhvājam' iti| dhvajīśabdaḥ pippalyāditvānṅīṣantaḥ|gaurādiṣu hi ppilyādayaḥ paṭhyante,tenāsau pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| udīcyagrāmasya bahvajanto bhavati| `dhānaśabda udāttaḥ' iti| `gatikārakopapadāt' (6.2.139) iti dhānaśabdasya lyuḍantasya prakṛtibhāvāt|| 110. prasthottarapadaladyādikopadhādaṇ| (4.2.110) `udīcyagrāmalakṣaṇasyāño'pavādaḥ' iti| prasthottarapadādīnāmudīcyagrānatvāt| `mādrīprasthaḥ, māhakīprasthaḥ' iti| atra prakṛtiḥ samāsasvareṇāntodāttā| athottarapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na prasthāntādityevocyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; tadihāpi prasajyeta--uttamakarṇīprasthaḥ| tatrāpyuttarapadagrahaṇānna bhavati| na hyatra prasthaśabda uttarapadam, kiṃ tarhi ? karṇīprasthaśabdaḥ| `tataṣṭhaññiṭhayorapavādaḥ'iti `vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca' (4.2.117) iti prāptayoḥ| atha vāhīkaśabdaḥ kimartamiha paṭhyate, yāvatā kopadhatvādevāṇ siddhaḥ ? atrāha-- `vāhīkaśabdaḥ' ityādi| yadi vāhīkaśabda iha na paṭhyate, paratvāt `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti cchaḥ syāt| kopadhasya tu nilīka ityatrāvṛddhamavakāśaḥ| tasmātparamapi cchaṃ bādhitvā'ṇ yathā syāditi kopadho'pi vāhīkaśabdaḥ paṭhyate| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na yāvatā yathāvihitamevocyeta ?na; punarvidhānādaṇeva bhavatīti vijñāyate| apavādasya vidhāne punarvidhānamanarthakamityāha--`ajagrahamam' ityādi| yadatra vṛddhaṃ vāhīkagrāmaḥ,tasmāt `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityato'ṇi prāpte ` vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) prāpnoti, tasmin `vāhīkagrahāmebhyaśca' (4.2.117) iti ṭhaññiṭhau, tau paratvāt bādhitvā yadyatrāṇgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā punarvidhānāccha eva syāt| aṇgrahaṇādeva bhavati-- goṣṭhyāṃ bhavaṃ `gauṣaṭhyam' iti| tasmāt bādhakamapi bādhitvā'ṇeva yathā syādityevamarthamaṇgrahaṇam| kopadhagrahaṇamihājanapadārtham| janapadatadavadhi'(4.2.124) `kopadhādaṇ' (4.2.132) ityanena siddhaḥ| yakṛllomaśabdaḥ paladyādiṣu paṭhyate, tasya nalopa nipātyate,anyathā `an' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāve sati yakṛllomni bhavaḥ yākṛlloma iti na sidhyet|| 111. kaṇvādibhyo gotre| (4.2.111) `gotragrahaṇamiha na pratyayārtham' iti| śeṣādhikārāt| yadi hi pratyayārthaḥ syāt, śeṣādhikāro vācyeta| `{na ca--kāśikā padamañjarī ca} na prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam'(iti)| asambhavāt| na hi kaṇvādīnāṃ paramaprakṛtirūpāṇāmeva gotrārthatvaṃ sambhavati| tarhi gotragrahaṇaṃ sambadhyetetyevamarthaṃ pṛcchati| `evam' ityādinā pratyayavidhiviśeṣaṇaṃ gotragrahaṇamiti darśayitvā tena gotrapratyayāntebhyaḥ kaṇvādibhyo'ṇ bhavatīti darśayati| `chasyāpavādaḥ' iti| gotrapratyayāntānāṃ kaṇvādīnāṃ vṛddhatvāt| `kāṇvāḥ, gaukakṣāḥ'iti| kaṇvagokakṣaśabdābhyāṃ gotrāpatye gargādi (4.1.105) itvādyañ, tadantādaṇ, `āpatyasya' (6.4.151) ityādinā yalopaḥ| `kāṇvaḥ' iti| `sāsya devatā' (4.2.24) ityaṇ|| 112. iñaśca| (4.2.112) dākṣyādibhyaḥ `ata iñ' (4.1.95) itīñantebhyo'ṇ| `sautaṅgamīyam' iti. sutaṅgamena nirvṛttamiti `vuñchaṇ' (4.2.80) ityādinā sutaṅgamaśabdāccāturarthika iñ|| 113.na dvyacaḥ prācyabharateṣu| (4.2.113) `paiṅgīyāḥ, prauṣṭhīyāḥ'iti| prācyagotrodāharaṇam| `kāśīyāḥ,pāśīyāḥ'iti| bharatagotrodāharaṇam| `katham' ityādi codyam| `naitadasti' iti parihāraḥ| ubhayañcaitat,tadudāharaṇam| ubhayañcaitadanugatārtham| nanu ca bharatāḥ prācyā eva,tataḥ prācyagrahaṇenaiva teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, tatkimarthaṃ teṣāṃsvaśabdenopādānam ? ityata āha-- `jñāpakādanyatra' ityādi| kvānyatra ? `bahvaca iñaḥ prācyabharateṣu' (2.4.66) ityatra|| 114. vṛddhācchaḥ| (4.2.114) `avyayatīra'ityādi| tatrāvyayavidhiṃ bādhate-- ārādbhava ārātīyaḥ| tīrottara eva vidhiḥ,taṃ ca vāyasatīre bhavo vāyasatīrīyaḥ| rūpottarapadāttu chaṃ bādhitvā `dhanyayopadhād‌vuñ' (4.2.121) iti yopadhalakṣaṇo vuñ bhavati-- maṇirūpye bhavo māṇirūpyaka iti| udīcyagrāmavidiṃ bādhate-- vāḍavākṣe bhavo vāḍavākṣīyaḥ, sāḍalapure bhavaḥ sāḍalapurīyaḥ| kopadhalakṣamam--audake bhava audakīyaḥ, caulluke bhavaḥ caullukīyaḥ| teṣāṃ tu vidhīnāmavṛddho'vakāśaḥ|| 115. bhavataṣṭhakchasau| (4.2.115) `sakāraḥ padasaṃjñārthaḥ' iti| `siti ca' (1.4.16) iti padasaṃjñā yathā syāt| tasyāñca satyāṃ bhavadīyamatityatra `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvaṃ bhavati| `bhāvatkaḥ' iti| `iśusuktāntāt kaḥ'(7.3.51)| `avṛddhāttu bhavataḥ' iti| śatrantāditi|| 116.kāśyādibhyaṣṭhaññiṭhau| (4.2.16) kāśicediśabdābhyāṃ janapadalakṣaṇe (4.2.124) vuñi prāpte sājāteḥ `iñaśca' (4.2.112) ityaṇi, saṃvāhādibhyo vṛddhacche (4.2.114) , hastikarṣūśabdāt `ordeśe ṭhañ' (4.2.119) iti ṭhañi, pariśiṣṭebhyaḥ `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityaṇīdamārabhyate| kathaṃ punarñakāra eva viparyastadeśe'nubandhe kriyamāṇe viśeṣa ityata āha-- `strīpratyaye viśeṣaḥ' iti| ante hi ñakāre'nubandhe sati `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ'(4.1.15) itiṅībbhavati| ādau hi sati ṭābeva bhavati| `vṛddhādityanuvarttate' iti| yadyevam, atra ye vṛddhāḥ paṭhyante tebhyaḥ ptyaye na prāpnoti ? ityāha-- `yetvavṛddhāḥ'ityādi| yadi tarhyavṛddhebhyo'pi vacanaprāmāṇyātpratyayo bhavati, vṛddhādityasyānuvṛttirapārthiketyata āha-- `devadattaśabdaḥ' ityādi| devadattaśabdasya prāgdeśa eva hi varttamāne'sya vṛddhasaṃjñā, na vāhīkagrāme| tatra yadi vṛddhāditi nānuvarttate, vāhīkagrāmavācino'pi tataṣṭhaññiṭhau syātām| tasmāt tannivṛttyarthaṃ vṛddhādhikāro'rthavān bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `katham' ityādinā vṛddhasaṃjñāyāṃ devadattīyā iti bhāṣyakārasyopanyāse tadudāharaṇaṃ vighaṭayya `tatraivaṃ varṇayanti' ityādinā samarthayate| `āpadādipūrvapadātkālāt' iti| āpacchabda ādiryeṣāṃ tānyāpadādīni| tāni pūrarvapadaṃ yasya tadāpadādipūrvapadam| tataḥ kālāṭṭhaññiṭhau bhavataḥ|ādiśabdenordhvādayaḥ śabdā gṛhyante|| 117. vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca| (4.2.117) 118. vibhāṣośīnareṣu| (4.2.118) 119.aurdeśe ṭhañ| (4.2.119) `naiṣādakarṣukaḥ| śāvarajambukaḥ' iti| niṣādakarṣūvarajambūśabdābhyāṃ ṭhañ, `isusuktāntāt kaḥ' (7.3.51), `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ| nanu ca ṭhañ prakṛta eva, sa evehānukṛṣyate, tatkiṃ ṭhañgrahaṇena ? ityata āha-- `ṭhaññiṭhayoḥ' iti| yathaiva hi ṭhañ prakṛtaḥ, evaṃ ñiṭho'pi| tatra dvayorapi prakaraṇe ṭhañ cānuvartiṣyate, netara ityetanna labhyate| tasmāt ñiṭhasya nivṛttaye punaṣṭhañgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| nanu cāsvaritatvādeva ñiṭho nānuvartiṣyate ? satyametat; tadevāsvaritatvaṃ jñāpayituṃ ñiṭhasya ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| taccāsvaritatvamākhyāyate mandabuddhīnāmanugrahāya|| 120. vṛddhātprācām| (4.2.120) `āḍhakajambukaḥ' iti| pūrvavat kādeśo hrasvatvañca|| 121. ghanvayopadhād‌vuñ| (4.2.121) dhanvano'rthasya grahaṇam, na svarūpasya; vṛddhādhikārāt| na hi dhanvaśabdo vṛddhaḥ| pāredhanvani jātaḥ pāredhanvakaḥ, `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ| airāvate jāta airāvatatakaḥ|| 122. prasthapuravahāntācca| (4.2.122) `vṛddhādityeva' iti| yadi tarhi vṛddhādityanuvarttate vṛddhādhikārādeva svarūpagrahaṇābhāvāt kathaṃ tadantavidhirbhavati, nahi prasthādeḥ kevalasya vṛddhatvaṃ sambhavati, kiṃ tarhi ? tadantasya, tatkimantagrahaṇena ? maivam; satyapi vṛddhādhikāre yathā dhanveti vṛddhagrahaṇaṃ hi deśasya viśeṣaṇaṃ tathehāpi syāt, tannivṛttyarthamantagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam|| 123. ropadhetoḥ prācām| (4.2.123) `īkārāntācca' iti|kataṃ punarjñāyate--dīrghasyedaṃ grahaṇam, na hrasvasyeti ? sāmarthyāt | prāggrahaṇaṃ hi deśasya viśeṣaṇam| vṛddhāditi varttate, na ca vṛddhamikārāntaṃ prāgdeśavācyasti, tasmāddīrghasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti vijñāyate| ekacakrāśabdasya tu `eṅ prācām' (1.1.75) iti vṛddhasaṃjñā| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham, neha kiñcittasya vyāvarttyamastītyata āha-- `taparakaraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamṭa (iti)| asati hi tasmin ropadha iti sthite guṇe kṛte vibhaktau ca ropadhayoriti nirdeśaḥ syāt| tatraiva sandehaḥ syāt--kiṃ ropadhasyedaṃ grahaṇam ? uta ropadhasyekārāntasyeti ? taparakaraṇe tu sati sandeho na bhavati| īropadhāditi noktam, vaicitryārtham|| 124. janapadatadavadhyośca| (4.2.124) `tadavadherapi' ityādi| `janapadatadavadhyośca' ityatra tacchabdena sannihitatvājjanapada evaparāmṛśyate| na cāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṣaṣṭīsamāse hyajanapado'pi yo'vadhistato'pi vuñ prasajyeta| cha eva tasyeṣyate-- mauñjī nāma vāhīkānāmavadhirgrāmaḥ, tatra bhavo mauñjīya iti| tasmāt samānādhikaraṇa evāyaṃ samāsaḥ-- saeva janapado'vadhirmaryādā tadavadhiriti| tena janapadāvadhireva eva gṛhyante, na grāmaḥ| `kimarthaṃ tarhi tadavadhigrahaṇam' iti| yadi tadavadhirapi janapada eva gṛhyate,nirarthakaṃ tarhi tasya grahaṇam, `janapadācca' ityetāvadeva vaktavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| `bādhakabādhanārtham' iti| garttottarapadādvakṣyamāṇaścha eva paratvādviśeṣavihitatvācca bādhakaḥ, tasya bādhanārthaṃ tadavadhigrahaṇam|tenahi trigartteṣu bhavastraigarttaka ityatrottarasūtreṇa gartattottarapadācchaṃ bādhitvā vuñeva bhavati|| 125. avṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt| (4.2.125) `aṇchayorapavādaḥ' iti| avṛddhādaṇo'pavādaḥ, vṛddhācchasya| atha viṣayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, vināpi tena viśeṣo labhyata eva| katham ? iha janapadatadavadhiśabdābhyāṃ samānādhikaraṇatvādvahuvacanaśabdo na pāribhāṣiko vijñāyate,kiṃ tarhi ? anvarthaḥ-- bahūnāmarthānāṃ vacano yo janapadastadavadhiśceti| yaśca bahūnāmarthānāṃ vacanaḥ so'rthān bahūn brūvan sāmarthyādeva bahuvacanaviṣayo bhavati ? ityāha-- `viṣayagrahaṇam' ityādi| ananyatrabhāvaḥ kathaṃ nāma labhyata ityevamarthaṃ viṣayagrahaṇam| ananyatrabhāvaḥ kimarthamiṣyata ityāha-- janapadaikadeśaḥ kriyate| varttanī ca varttanī ca varttanī ca varttanyaḥ,tadbahūnāṃ vācako bhavati| tataśca yadi viṣayaghaṇaṃ na kriyate tato varttanīṣu bhava iti vuñ syāt| viṣayagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati, ananyatrabhāvo viṣayaḥ| tenaivaṃ vijñāyate-- bahuvacanaṃ na yo vyabhacarati| yaścaikaśeṣaḥ sa bahūvacanaṃ vyabhicarati, tasyahi vivakṣābhāve bahutvāt| dvayorapi ca kadācid‌vṛtteḥ| `apigrahaṇam' iti| apigrahaṇaṃ hi vṛddhādapi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate| vṛddhātpūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ, tat kimapigrahaṇena ? `takrakauṇḍinyāyena' iti| yathā `brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatā takraṃ kauṇ‍ḍinyāya' iti sāmānyena vṛttasya dadhidānasya viśeṣe varttamānena takradānena bādhā kriyate, tathehāpi bahuvacanaviṣaye ca sāmānyena pravṛttasya pūrvayogasya bahuvacanaviṣaye varttamānenānena yogena bādhā vijñāyate| tasmād‌vṛddhādapi yathā syādityapi śabdena samuccīyate|| 126. kacchāgnivaktragarttottarapadāt| (4.2.126) kacchaśabdārthamuttarapadagrahaṇāt, sa hi kevalo'pi deśa varttate| itareṣāṃ tu kevalānaṃ deśe vṛttyasambhavāt sāmarthyādeva tadantavidhirlabhyata itītarān pratyuttarapadagrahaṇamanarthakam| `kacchāgnivaktragarttāntāt' iti noktam, bahucpūrvānmā bhūt| yadā hi kacchadeśena deśāntarantarasya guṇasāmye satīṣadasamāptaḥ kacchadeśa iti kacchaśabdādbahuc kriyate tadā bahukacchaśabdo deśavacana iti| antagrahaṇe tu sati tato'pi pratyayaḥ syāt, uttarapadagrahaṇānna bhavati| `dārukacchaḥ'iti| kacchaśabdasyottarapadasya vṛddhasyodāharaṇam| `paippalīkacchakaḥ' ityavṛddhasyodāharaṇam, evamanyādyuttarapadānāmapi| ekavṛddhasyodāharaṇam| aparaṃ vṛddhasya veditavyam|| 127. dhūmādibhyaśca| (4.2.127) `aṇāderapavādaḥ'iti| ādiśabdena kacchādīnāṃ grahaṇam| tatra deśavacanā avṛddhā yedhūmādayastebhyo'ṇo'pavādaḥ| ye tu vṛddhāstebhyaśchas| ya udīcyagrāmāstebhyo'ṇaḥ| ye bāhīkagrāmāstebhyaṣṭhaññiṭhayoḥ| `tasya yopadhatvādeva vuñi siddhe' iti| `dhanvayopadhād‌vuñ' (4.2.121) ityanena| `janapadalakṣaṇe vuñi siddhe' iti| `avṛddhādapi' (4.2.125) ityādinā| `kūlāt sauvīreṣu' iti| kulaśabdād‌vṛñ bhavati sauvīreṣu| kaulako bhavati sauvīraśceta, kaulo'nyat|| 128. nagarātkutsanaprāvīṇyayoḥ| (4.2.128) `nāgarā brāhmaṇāḥ' iti| aṇ| nanu ca `nagara,māhiṣmatī' (4.2.95) iti nagaraśabdaḥ kattryādiṣu paṭhyate, tato ḍhakañā bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ nāgarā iti pratyudāhriyata ityāha-- `kattryādiṣu' iti| dvividho nagaraśabdaḥ-- jātivacanaḥ, saṃjñāvacanaśca| tayoḥ kattryādiṣu māhiṣmatīśabdena sāhacaryāt saṃjñāśabdaḥ paṭhyate| tatra jātiśabdānnāgarā iti pratyudāhṛtam| saṃjñāśabde tu nāgareyaka iti pratyudāharttavyam|| 129. araṇyānmanuṣye| (4.2.129) `aupasaṃkhyānikasya ṇasyāpavādaḥ' iti| `araṇyāṇyaḥ' (vā.437) ityupasaṃkhyānātprāptasya | `pathyadhyāyanyāya' ityādi| eṣu pathyādiṣu vuñbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `dhūmādibhyaśca' (4.2.127) ityataścakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ,tena pathyādiṣu vuñbhavati| `vāgomayeṣu' iti| gomayeṣu vācyeṣu vā vuñbhavatīti| sa tu tasyaiva cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthasyānuvṛttervakṣyamāṇasya vibhāṣāgrahaṇasyobhayoḥ śeṣabhūtatvāllabhyate| yadi tarhi vakṣyamāṇaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣabhūtaṃ pathyādiṣvapi vikalpena vidhiḥ syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyavasthitavibhāṣā hi sā, tena gomayādvikalpena vidhirbhavati, pathyādiṣu nityamiti|| 130. vibhāṣā kuruyugandhārābhyām| (4.2.130) `saiṣā yugantharārthā vibhāṣā' iti|na kuruśabdārthā| tatra kacchādipāṭhādvināpi vibhāṣāgrahaṇenāṇā bhavitavyam | nanu yugandharaśabdādapyaṇi `avṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt' (4.2.125) iti nityaeva vuñi prāpte vacananityārthaṃ bhaviṣyati, nitye hi vuñi punarārambho'narthaka- syāt, tasmādyugandharārthā'pi vibhāṣā na prasajyeta ? naitat punarārambho viparyayeṇāpi śakyate samarthayitum| janapadalakṣaṇo (4.2.124) yo vuñ sa vibhāṣā,ayaṃ tu nitya iti|asmāttu yugandharārthaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| manuṣyatatsthayostu kuruśabdānnitya eva vuḍhbhavati, kacchādiṣu pāṭhasāmarthyāt| anyathānayaiva vibhāṣayā vuñaṇoḥ siddhatvāt kaccādipāṭho'rthakaḥ syāt; anavakāśatvāt|| 131. madravṛjyoḥ kan| (4.2.131) `janapadavuño'pavādaḥ'iti| `avṛddhādapi' (4.2.125) ityādiprāptasya| madravṛjyoḥ kanniti ñyantasya paranipātaḥ `dvandve ghi' (2.2.32) ityasya vidheranityatvajñāpanārtham| tena dhūmāgnī ityevamādi siddhaṃ bhavati|| 132.kopadhādaṇ| (4.2.132) `janapadavuño'pavādaḥ' iti| pūrvatpraptasya| kiṃ punardeśādanyatra varttamāno neṣyate, yo deśe varttate ? ityāha-- `anyatretyādi pūrveṇa' iti|`prasthottarapadāt' (4.2.110) iti sūtreṇa| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na kopadhādyathāvihitamevocyeta, yathāvihitamucyamāne'ṇapavādo vuñ syāditi cet ? na; vuñvidhāne hi vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt,tena vinā vuñaḥ siddhatvāt| tasmādvacanasāmarthyādvihito'ṇeva prāpnoti| anyena bādhitvā ata evāṇ ataevāṇ bhaviṣyatīti| sa hi `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) iti vihito bādhitaśca vuñaivetyata āha-- `aṇgrahaṇam' ityādi| `ikṣvākuṣu jātaḥ'iti| ikṣvākuśabdādordeśe ṭhañ (4.2.119) prāptaḥ, tasmin janapadavuñā bādhite yadīhājgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate tadā punarvacanād‌vuñeva bhavati, aṇgrahaṇādaṇeva bhavati| `aikṣvākaḥ' iti| `dāṇḍināyanahāstināyana' (6.4.174) ityādāvikṣvākuśabdasyokārasya lopo nipātitaḥ|| 133.kacchādibhyaśca| (4.2.133) `vuñāderapavādaḥ' iti| ādiśabdena ṭhañaḥ| tatra ye janapadabahuvacanaviṣayāstebhyo vuñaḥ prāptasyāpavādaḥ| sindhuvarṇuśabdābhyāmordeśe ṭhañaḥ (4.2.119)| `kacchaśabdo na bahuvacanaviṣayaḥ' iti| tena `avṛddhādapi' (4.2.125) ityādinā bādhakasya vuño'prāptāveva sāmānyenāṇsiddha eveti darśayati| yadyevam, kimarthaṃ tasya pāṭhaḥ ? ityāha-- `tasya' ityādi| uttarasūtreṇa vuñ manuṣyatastthayoryathā syādityavamarthaḥ kacchasyeha pāṭhaḥ, na tvanarthakaḥ| `kopadhādevāṇ siddhaḥ'iti| pūrvasūtreṇeti| `ihagrahaṇamuttarārtham' iti| uttarasūtra vuñ yathā syāt|| 134. manuṣyatatsthayorvuñ| (4.2.134) 135. apadātau sālvāt| (4.2.135) `sālvaḥ' iti| kacchādipāṭhādaṇ|| 136. goyavāgvośca| (4.2.126) 137. garttotatrapadācchaḥ| (4.2.137) avṛddhārtha vacanam| vṛddhāttu `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) ityanenaiva siddhamiti| sati tu vṛddhāvapi paratvādanenaiva bhavitavyam| `ano'pavādaḥ' iti| nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt| `vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇañca' ityādi| yad‌garttottarapadaṃ vāhīkavāci tato vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇau ṭhaññiṭhau bādhittavāt paratvāccha eva bhavati, tasya garttottarapadamavakāśa iti| athottarapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na garttāntādityevocyeta ? ityāha-- `uttarapadagrahaṇam' ityādi| yadi garttāntādityucyeta tadā bahugartta ityetasmādapi bahucpūrvāt syāt, bhavati hyetad‌garttāntam| uttarapadagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati, na hyetad‌garttottarapadam| samāse hi satyetadbhavati-- pūrvapadamuttarapadamiti|| 138. gahādibhyaśca| 94.2.138) `aṇāderapavādaḥ' iti| ādiśabdena vuñaḥ| tatra kāmaprasthaśabdāt `prasthapuravahāntācca' (4.2.122) iti prāptasya vṛño'pavādaḥ, śeṣebhyastvautsargikasyāṇaḥ| `sambhavāpekṣaṃ viśeṣaṇam'iti| sambhavamapekṣata iti sambavāpekṣam| yeṣāṃ deśe cādeśe ca vṛttiḥ sambhavati gahādīnāṃ teṣāmevedaṃ viśeṣamamiti| etadubhayamapi viśeṣaṇamevārthāryaiḥ smaryate| `pṛthivīmadhyasya' ityādinā tadviśeṣaṃ darśayati| `caraṇasambandhena' ityādi| caraṇenārthena sambandhaścaraṇasambandhaḥ; tena karaṇena vāṇ bhavati| kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? nivāsalakṣamaḥ| nivāso lakṣaṇaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| kathaṃ nivāsalaśraṇaḥ ? yaḥ pṛthivīmadhye nivāsabhūte varttamānāt madhyaśabdādbhavati, sa hi nivāsena lakṣyate| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--pṛthivīmadhyanivāso'sya caraṇasyeti| yadāyamartho vijñāyate tadāṇbhavati, nānyatreti| tena yadā pṛthivīmadhyād‌gataṃ caraṇamiti caraṇamiti vivakṣyate tadā ccha eva bhavati--madhyamīya iti| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyoktāveva viśeṣo labhyata iti ? sāmānyabhidhāne'pi viśeṣopasthānadarśanāt| ghṛtakṣaraṇavacca sa hyaviśeṣeṇopadiṣṭo ghṛtādiṣvevāvatiṣṭhate| tasmāt sāmānyoktāvapi pṛthivīmadhya eva varttamāne madhyaśabdo madhyamabhāvamāpadyate| caraṇe ca pratyayārthe nivāsalakṣaṇa evāṇ bhavati,na hi sarveṣu jātādiṣvartheṣu| `mukhapārśvatasorlopaḥ' iti| mukhapārśvaśabdayostasastayoḥ pratyayasanniyogena lopo bhavati| sa ca alo'ntyasya (1.1.52) iti vacanādantyasya | lopavacanaṃ `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' (vā.842) ityasyānityatvajñāpanārtham, tenārātīya ityatra na bhavati| `mukhatīyam, pārśvatīyam' (iti)| `apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' (5.4.45) iti mukhapārśvaśabdābhyāṃ tasiḥ| `ādyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' (vā.634) ityaupasaṃkhyānike sakārasya lope kṛte'kārasyāpi `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopaḥ| `devasya ceti vaktavyam' iti| devaśabdasya kugbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- `{janapapadayoḥ kukka iti saṃ. pariṣatkāśikāpāṭhaḥ'}kugjanasya parasya' (vā.ga.sū.101) ityatra cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena devadaśabdādapi bhaviṣyati|| 139. prācāṃ kaṭādeḥ| (4.2.139) 140. rājñaḥ ka ca| (4.2.140) 141. vṛddhādakekāntakhopadhāt| (4.2.141) `kopadhalakṣaṇasya ca' ityādi| akekāntāt `kopadhādaṇ' (4.2.132) ityaṇi prāpte'ṇo'pavādaḥ| kopadhādapi vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇasya ṭhaño ñiṭhasya ca| `ropadhetoḥ prācām' iti| `akekāntagrahaṇe kopadhagrahaṇam' iti| iha sūtre'kekāntagrahaṇamapanīya kopadhagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| kopadhādityevaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ|| 142. kanthāpaladanagaragrāmahvadottarapadāt| (4.2.142) `vāhīkagrāmalakṣaṇasya' iti| ṭhaññiṭhayośca| antagrahaṇenaiva siddha sattyuttarapadagrahaṇaṃ vaicitryārtham|| 143. parvatācca| (4.2.143) 144. vibhāṣā'manuṣye| (4.2.144) `pārvatīyāni phalāni' iti| nanu cāmanuṣyaśabdo rakṣaḥpiśācādiṣveva rūḍhaḥ tathā hi `sabhā, rājā'manuṣyapūrvā' (2.4.23) ityatra `iha kasmān bhavati--kāṣṭhasabheti, tatredamuktam--`amanuṣyaśabdo rūḍhirūpeṇa rakṣaḥ piśācādiṣveva varttate' iti, tatkathaṃ `amanuṣye' ityucyamāne phalādiṣvabhidheyeṣu bhavati ?naiṣa dvoṣaḥ;dvau hyamanuṣyaśabdau -- rūḍhaḥ, vyutpannaśca| tatra `sabhā rājā'manuṣyapūrvā' (2.4.23) ityatra rūḍhiśabdasya grahaṇam, iha tvitarasya manuṣyādanya varttamānasya|| 145. kṛkaṇaparṇādbhāradvāje| (4.2.145) `bhāradvājaśabdo'pi deśavacana eva,na gotraśabdaḥ'iti| deśa eva bhāradvāje kṛkaṇaparṇaśabdavṛtteḥ sambhavāt|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ caturthādhyāye dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ| <4.3> atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ| tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ| 1.yuṣmadasmadoranyatarasyāṃ khañca| (4.3.1) `tatra vaṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati' iti| dve hi prakṛtī, pratyayāśca traya iti vaiṣamyam| nanu ca khañchāvevānena vidhīyete, aṇpratyayastvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena yathāprāptasyābhyanujñāne kṛte śāstrādeva bhavati, tatkṛto vaiṣamyam ? cho'pi tarhi tenaivānena vidhīyate, tasyāpi hi cakāro'bhyanujñāpaka eva| so'pi svaśāstrādeva `vṛddhācchaḥṭa (4.2.114) ityetasmādbhavatīti ? evamapi vaiṣamyam| sarvathā nāsti yathāsaṃkhyaprasaṅga|| 2. tasminnaṇi ca yuṣmākāsmākau| (4.3.2) `tasminniti sākṣadvihitaḥ khañ nirdiśyate' iti| tasminnityukte prāgeva tatraiva pratītyutpatteḥ| tatra punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sākṣādvihitvam,ānantaryācca khañaḥ, tasyaiva yuktaḥ| nanu ca pūrvasūtre khañceti cakāreṇa ccho'nukṛṣyate,vācakadeśaśca vācya iti khañaścha evānantaro bhavati| syādanantaro yadi cakārastasya vācakaḥ syāt, na cāsau tasya vācakaḥ | sa hi samīpavartinaḥ padārthāntarasya sahāyatāmātramācaṣṭe| khañaḥ sahāyatāmākhyāya nivṛtte cakāre sā sahāyatā prakaraṇācchenaiva vijñāyate| tasmāccakāraśchasya vācako na bhavatīti nāsau tādṛśaḥ| tatkṛtayostasyānantarya `nimittayoḥ' ityādi| dve hi nimitte-- khañaṇau, nimittanāvapi dvāvevādeśau, tataḥ samānatvadyathāsaṃkhyenātra bhavitavyamiti manyamānas praśnaḥ| `yogavibhāgaḥ ityādi' parihāraḥ| `yuṣmadīyaḥ, asmadīyaḥ' iti| yadi `tasminnaṇi ca' iti nocyeta to yathā pūrvasūtravihitayoḥ khañaṇorimāvādeśau bhavatastathā cche'pi syātām| tasmiṃstu sati na bhavataḥ|| 3.tavakamamakāvekavacane| (4.3.3) pūrveṇa yuṣmākāsmākayoḥ prāptayoḥ `pratyayottarapadayośca' (7.2.98) iti tvamayorekavacanetavakamamakāvādeśau vidhīyete| `ekavacanaparayoḥ' iti| ekavacanaṃ paraṃ yābhyāṃ te tathokte| `nimittayostu' ityādi| yathā pūrva eva sūtre yogavibhāgānnimittayorādeśau prati yathāsaṃkhyatvaṃ na bhavati, tathehāpi na bhaviṣyati| tasya ca yathāsaṃkhyābhāvasya pūrvasūtra eva yogavibhāgo hetuḥ| tena hi pūrvatra nimitte nivṛtte yathāsaṃkhye kṛte tasmādihāpyanuvarttate| te nivṛtte yathāsaṃkhye evānuvarttete; ajahaddharmatvādadhikārāṇām| tasmādihāpi pūrvakayogavibhāgādyavāsaṃkhyabhāvaḥ| iha sarvavidhibhyo lugvidhirvalavānityekavacanasya luki kṛte yuṣmadasmadorekavacanaparatā na sambhavatīti pratyayalopalakṣaṇena samarthayitavyā| tadapi pratyayalopalakṣamaṃ pratiṣedhalakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣedhayitumāha-- `nanu ca' ityādi| `vacanāt' ityādi parihāraḥ| yadi hi pratyayalopalakṣaṇaṃ na syādidaṃ vacanamapārthakaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca yasyaivaka vacanaparatā sambhavati tasya viśeṣaṇārthamekavacanaṃ syāt, kasyaikavacanaparatā sambhavati ? nimittasya khañādeḥ| nimitte tvekavacanaparatvena viśeṣyamāṇe satīhaiva syātām-- yauṣmākaḥ putraḥ, āsmākaḥ putraḥ; atra hyekavacanaparatvam, taddhi tasyopapadyate; iha ca na syātām-- tāvakāḥ putrāḥ, māmakāḥ putrā iti| na hyatra nimittasyaikavacanaparatā sambhavatīti ? naitadasti; yuṣmadasmadī pūrvasūtre viśeṣe abhūtām| tathā hi-- khañyaṇi ca parato yuṣmadasmadoriti khañaṇparatā tayoḥ, ata eva yuṣmadasmadī viśeṣyete| tadihāpi tathābhūte evānuvarttete; ajahaddharmatvādadhikārāṇāmiti tayorevaikavacanaparatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| atha vā tavakamamakayorvidheyatvena prādhānyāt tayorevaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| tayoreva tadviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavat sthānidvārakameva bhavati| yadi sthāninorekavacanaparatā, evamādeśau sthānivattvādekavacanaparau bhavataḥ| tadanenāpi prakāreṇa yuṣmadasmadorekavacanaviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam| na tu kathañcinnimittasya khañādeḥ| `atha vā' ityādi| purvaṃ pāribhāṣikamekavacanamāśritya vyākhyātam, idānīṃ tvartamāśritya vyācaṣṭe-- eko'rtha ucyate yena tadekavacanam| atra tu vyākhyāne `ekavacane' iti nedaṃ saptamyekavacanam| kiṃ tarhi ? prathamādvivacanāntam|| 4. ardhādyat | (4.3.4) 5. parāvarādhamottaramapūrvācca| (4.3.5) `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti' (vyā.pa.89) ititadantavidhipratiṣedhāt pūrveṇāprāptāvayamārambhaḥ| tatrādhamottamaśabdau nindāpraśaṃsāvacanau, tatpūrvādaṇi prāpte satyamārambhaḥ| parāvaraśabdau yāvadikchabdau tatpūrvādapyaṇyeva| yau tu dikchabdau tatpūrvāduttarasūtreṇa ṭhañi yati ca| kathaṃ punaḥ `parāvarādhamottamebhyaḥ' ityucyamāne parāvarādipūrvatā śakyā vijñātum ? ityāha-- `ardhāditi varttate' ityādi| iha hi pūrvasūtrādardhādityanuvarttate| tatra parāvarādhamottamebhyaḥ paro yo'rdhaśabdaḥ-- ityevaṃ viśeṣamāṇe'rddhaśabdasāmarthyādeva tasya parāvarādipūrvatā vijñāsyate, tatkiṃ pūrvagrahaṇena ? `tatra' iti| parāvarayoradikśabdayoḥ| `pareṇa' iti| uttarasūtreṇa ṭhañyatau syātāmiti| yadi pūrvagrahaṇaṃ na kriyetetyabhiprāyaḥ| `asmāt' ityādi| parāvarādipūrvādeva yathā syādityetadeva hi pūrvagrahaṇasya prayojanam| tena hi pūrvaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati, na paramityeṣo'rthaḥ sūcyate| tasmāt dikśabdapakṣe'pi parāvarapūrvādyadeva bhavati|| 6. dikpūrvapadāṭṭhañca| (4.3.6) `paurvārddhikam' iti| pūrvasminnarthe jātaḥ| ` taddhitārtha' (2.1.51) ityādinā samāsaḥ,tatastaddhitaḥ| atha padagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, dikpūrvādityevocyeta ? ityāha-- `padagrahaṇam' ityādi| asati hi padagrahaṇe svarūpavidhiḥ syāt, tataśca digarddhe jāta ityatraiva syāt| padagrahaṇe tu sati yannāma kiñcid‌diksambandhiḥ pūrvapadaṃ tasya grahaṇamupapannaṃ bhavati|| 7.grāmajanapadaikadeśādañṭhañau| (4.3.7) `yato'pavādau' iti| pūrveṇa prāptasya| `paurvārdhāḥ' iti|pūrvavatsamāsaḥ| nanvatra pūrvasminnarddhe grāmasyeti grāmamapekṣamāṇasyārdhaśabdasyāsāmarthyāt samāso nopapadyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pradhānamātrārddhaṃ bhavati| pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ-- ityetat `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyaprayoge' (2.1.56) ityatra jñāpitam|| 8. madhyānmaḥ| (4.3.8) madhyaśabdo yo gahādiṣu pṛthivīmadhyavacanaḥ `madhyamadhyamañcāṇ caraṇe' (ga.sū,.99) iti paṭhyate, tatastu tata eva vidhirbhavati| yastvanyastasyeha grahaṇaṃ veditavyam|| 9. a sāmpratike| (4.3.9) nyāyyaṃ yuktamityādibhiḥ paryāyaiḥ sāmpratikaśabdārthamācaṣṭe--`{sāmpratikam--nyāyyam, yuktam, ucitam, samamucyate--kāśikā,padamañjarī ca} sāmpratikaṃ nyāyyamucyate' (iti)| tathā hi prayogo dṛśyate na bāhyaṃ prāptamityevaṃ varttitavyamasāmpratamiti| atra nyāyyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ pratīyate| sāmpratameva sāmpratikam| vinayāderākṛtigaṇatvāt `vinayādibhyaśca' (5.4.34) iti ṭhak|| 10. dvīpādanusamudraṃ yañ| (4.3.10) `anusamudram' iti| samudraṃ samayā'nusamudram| `anuryatsamayā' (2.1.15) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| `aṇo manuṣyavuñaścāpavādaḥ' iti| `kacchādibhyaśca' (4.2.133) iti prāptasyāṇaḥ| `manuṣyatatsthayorvuñ' (4.2.134) iti prāptasya vuñaḥ|| 11. kālāṭṭhañ| (4.3.11) `kālaviśeṣavācinaḥ' iti| anena kālādityarthagrahaṇam, na svarūpasyeti| yadi hi svarūpagarhaṇaṃ syāt, sandhivelādi (4.3.16) sūtreṇāṇo vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt; `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| iha tvarthagrahaṇe ṭhañbādhanārthatvāt tasyānarthakyaṃ bhavati| tasmādarthagrahaṇametat| iha kecicchabdā mukhyayā vṛttyā kāle varttante-- māso'rdhamāsa iti,kecidgauṇyā vṛttyā-- kadambapuṣpasāhacaryāt kālaḥ kadambapuṣpaḥ,vrīhipalālena sāhacaryāt kālo vrīhipalāla iti; teṣāmihobhayeṣāmapi grahaṇam| ata evāha-- `yathā kathañcit' iti. yena kenacitprakāreṇetyarthaḥ| `guṇavṛttyā'pi' iti| anena yathākathañcidityasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| aupacārikī, vṛttiḥ, apradhānabhūtā vṛttirityarthaḥ| apiśabdānmukhyāyapi vṛttyā| nanu ca mukhye sati gauṇasya grahaṇamayuktam, gauṇamukhyayormukhye, kāryasampratyayāt (vyā.pa.4) ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati-- gauṇasyāpi kālasya grahaṇamiti, yadayaṃ sandhivelādisūtre (4.3.16) prakṛtena kālagrahaṇena nakṣatrāṇi viśinaṣṭi| na hi mukhyārthaḥ kālo nakṣatrāṇāṃ viśeṣaṇamupapadyate| teṣu mukhyasya kālatvasyāsambhavāt|| 12. śrāddhe śaradaḥ| (4.3.12) `ṛtvaṇo'pavādaḥ'iti| sandhivelādisūtreṇa (4.3.16) prāptasya| `{śrāddha iti na karma gṛhyate' ityeva mūlapāṭho dṛśyate|`śrāddha iti karma gṛhyate-- padamañjarī|} śrāddhaṃ iti na karma gṛhyate' iti| kriyāviśeṣaḥ kaścit śāstroktena vidhinā sādhyaḥ śrāddhagrahaṇena gṛhyate, na tu śraddhāvān puruṣaḥ| kuta etat ? tasya pratyayenānābhidhānāt| śāradikaśabdena hyabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyāt karmaṇa evābhidhānam, na puruṣasya|| 13. vibhāṣā rogātapayoḥ| (4.3.13) 14. niśāpradoṣābhyāñca| (4.3.14) 15. śvasastuṭ ca| (4.3.15) tasya {tasya ceti iti mūlapāṭhaḥ;padamañjarīśca|} veti| ṭhañaḥ| kuta etat ? tasya vidhīyamānatayā prādhānyāt, pradhāne ca kāryasampratyayāt| sa ca tuḍāgama ikādeśe kṛte bhavatīti veditavyam| nanu sanniyogaśiṣṭatvāt tuṭastenaiva tāvadbhavitavyam, paścādaṅgasaṃjñāyāmabhinirvṛttāyāmikādeśena ? naitadasti; upedaśāvasthāyāmeva hīkādeśe kṛte na bhavitavyam, jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ `vuñchaṇkaṭhac' (4.2.80) iti pratyayasvarārthamanubandhaṃ cakāraṃ karoti| pratyayasaṃjñāyāḥ sanniyogāddhi pratyayasvare kṛte paścādikādeśa iti siddhamantodāttatvam, kiñcitkaraṇena ? tasmāccitkaraṇādvijñāyate-- sanniyogaśiṣṭebhyo'pi pūrvamikādeśo bhavati| tena ṭhaggrahaṇānyaṅgasaṃjñābhūtānīkameva bodhayantīti tuḍapi tasyaiva bhaviṣyatīti vijñāyate| `etābhyām' ityādi| śvaḥśabdo'yamavyayaṃ kālavācī| tena yadā ṭhañtyapau na bhavataḥ,tadā `sāyañciram'(4.3.23) ityādinā ṭyuṭyulau api bhavataḥ|| 16.sandhivelādyṛtunakṣatrebhyo'ṇ| (4.3.16) `ṭhaño'pavāda-ṭa iti| `kālāṭṭhañ' (4.3.11) iti prāptasya| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yathāvihitamevocyeta,tenaivamucyamāne na prāpnotītyāśaṅkanīyam, yadi ṭhañ syāt punarvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt, tasmādvacanaprāmāṇyādyo vihito na sa prāpnoti, ṭhañpratyayena bādhitatvāt sa eva bhaviṣyati, sa vācya ? ityata āha-- `aṇgrahaṇam' ityādi| sandhivelādiṣu paurṇamāsīśabdo vṛddhaḥ paṭhyate| svātiriti nakṣatraśabdo vṛddho'sti| tatra yadyaṇgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tābhyāṃ paratvāṭṭhañā che bādhite punarvacanāccha eva syāt| tasmāt tanapi bādhitvā vṛddhādaṇeva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaraṇgrahaṇam| `taiṣam, pauṣam' iti| tiṣyapuṣpaśabdābhyāṃ `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityaṇ, tasyāṇo `lubaviśeṣe' (4.2.4) iti lup, tato'nenāṇ, tiṣyapuṣyayornakṣatrāṇi' (vā.808) iti yalopaḥ| `saṃvatsarātphalaparvaṇoḥ'iti| saṃvatsaraśabdādaṇbhavati phale parvaṇi cābhidheye| sāṃvatsaraṃ phalam, sāvaṃtsaraṃ parva vā| sāṃvatsarikamanyat|| 17. prāvṛṣa eṇyaḥ| (4.3.17) atha kimarthaṃ pratyaye mūrdhanyaḥ paṭhyate, na `raṣābhyām' (8.4.1) ityenaiva ṇatvaṃ bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam, iha hi na syāt-- prāvṛṣeṇiti padāntatvāt|| 18. varṣābhyaṣṭhak| (4.3.18) atha kimarthaṃ ṭhagvidhānam,kālāṭ (4.3.11) ṭhañaiva siddhatvāt,ubhayatrāpi tadeva rūpamiti ? naivam; ṭhaki sati pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ syāt, ṭhañi tu sati `ñnityādirnityam' (6.1.197) ityādyudāttatvam|| 19.chandasi chañ| (4.3.19) 20.vasantācca| (4.3.20) 21. hemantācca| (4.3.21) `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| `sarvatrāṇ ca tarlopaśca' (4.3.22) iti vakṣyati, sa hemantaśabdasyaiva yathā syāt, vasantasya mā bhūt| yadi `hemantavasanatābhyām' ityekayogaḥ kriyeta, tato vasantasyāpi syāt; tasya hyuttaratrānuvṛtteḥ|| 22. sarvatrāṇ ca talopaśca| (4.3.22) chandasi pūrveṇa ṭhañi prāpte bhāṣāyāmapi ṛtvaṇi caitaducyate| `sarvatragrahaṇam' ityādini sarvatragrahaṇasya prayojanamācaṣṭe| `chandasi bhāṣāyāñca' ityādinā chando'dhikāranivṛtteḥ phalaṃ darśayati| `nanu ca' ityādi| asvaritvādeva cchandasīti nānuvartiṣyate, tato nārthaśchanado'dhikāranivṛttyarthena sarvatragrahaṇenetyabhiprāyaḥ| `saiva' ityādinā yāsāvasvaritatvādananuvṛttiḥ saiva sarvatretyanena śabdenākhyāyate| kimarthamityāha-- `prayatnādikyena' ityādi| pratyatnādhikyametadeva śabdenākhyātam| tena hetunā pūrvasūtre'pi sarvatraśabdasya sambandho yathā syādityevamarthaḥ śabdenākhyāyate| kasmāt punaḥ pūrvasūtre'pi sarvatragrahaṇasya sambandha iṣyate ? ityāha-- `haimantikamiti hi' ityādi| hiśabdo hetau| ācāryā hi haimantikamiti bhāṣāyāṃ ṭhañaṃ smasanti| sa caivaṃ bhāṣāyāmapi siddhyati, yadi pūrvasūtre'pi sarvatra grahaṇasya sambandho bhavati| tatra hi sati pūrvasūtrasyāyamartho bhavati-- hemantācca sarvatra cchandasi bhāṣāyāmapi ṭhañ bhavatīti| `kaḥ punaranayoraṇo viśeṣaḥ'iti| na kaściditi bhāvaḥ| `ṛtvaṇi hi' ityādinā viśeṣaṃ darśayati| `haimantī' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp| `tadevam' ityādi| yata eva pūrvasūtreṇa ṭhañ bhavatyanenāṇ talopasahitaḥ,tena trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti|| 23.sāyañciramprāhṇeprage'vyayebhyaṣṭyuṭyulau tuṭ ca| (4.3.23) `kālāṭṭhañ' (4.3.11) iti ṭhañi prāpte sāyamādibhyaḥ ṭyuṭyulau vidhīyete, tayośca tuḍāgamaḥ| ṭhañapavādatvācc ṭyuṭyuloḥ| ṭhañaiva cchasya bādhitvādetābhyāṃ punaśchasya sampradhāraṇaiva nāsti| tena vṛddhādapi ṭyuṭyulāveva bhavataḥ-- prāktanamiti| `tayośca' ityādi| yadyanādiṣṭayostuṭ syāt tadā yurūpau pratyayau na bhavata ityanādeśo na syāt| tasmādādiṣṭayostayoḥ kṛtādeśayostuḍāgamaḥ| etacca `ghakālataneṣu kāla nāmnaḥ' (6.3.17) iti nirdeśāllabhyate. na hyanādiṣṭayostuḍ‌vidhānena tanaśabda upapadyate| atha pratyayoṣṭitkaraṇaṃ kimartham, na tuṭa eva ṭittvena pratyayorapi ṭittvaṃ vijñāsyata iti, yatastad‌grahaṇena grahaṇādāgamānām ? naitadasti; yuktaṃ yat pratyayadharmā āgame bhavanti tasya pratyayabhaktatvāt, natvāgayadharmā pratyaye| tasmāṭṭitkāryārthaṃ pratyayorapi ṭittvamāsajyate| `syaterantakarmaṇaḥ' iti| `ṣo'ntakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1147) ityasya | `prāhṇe prage ityekārāntam' iti| nipātyata iti sambandhaḥ| nanu ca `ghakālataneṣu kālanāmnaḥ' (6.3.17) iti saptamyā alukaiva siddham, tadapārthakaṃ nipātanam ? yatra tarhi saptamyartho nāsti tadarthaṃ nipānam -- grāhṇaḥ soḍho'sya prāhṇetanaḥ, pragaḥ soḍho'sya pragetana iti| atra hi `tadasya soḍham' (4.3.52) iti prathamāsamarthātpratyayavidhānātsaptamyartho nāsti| tadabhāvatsaptamyapi nāstyeva| `ciraparutparāribhyastno vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu `taddhitāḥ' (4.1.76) ityatraiva kṛtam| evamuttaratrāpi veditavyam| ciraśabdasya sūtre copādānāṭṭyulāvapi bhavataḥ| `pragasya cchandasi galopaśca' iti|vaktavya iti sambandhaḥ| vaktavyaśabdasya sa evārthaḥ| vyākhyānāt tvihāpi `pratnapūrvaviśvemāt thāl cchandasi' (5.3.111) itinipātanamāśritya karttavyam| `antācceti vaktavyam' (iti)| antaśabdāḍ‍ḍimajbhavatītyetadartarūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu kṛtameva| ḍimaco ḍitkaraṇaṃ paścādityasya ṭilopārtham| nanu ca `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopo vaktavyaḥ' (vā.842) ityanenaiva siddham ? na sidhyati; anityatvāt tasya| yathā ārātīya ityatra na bhavati, tathehāpi na bhavatīti kasyacid‌bhrānati syāt, atastannirāsārthaṃ ḍitkaraṇam|| 24. vibhāṣā pūrvāhṇāparāhṇābhyām| (4.3.24) `{pūrvāhṇetanam--kāśikā} pūrvāhṇetanaḥ' iti| ahnaḥ pūrvo bhāga iti pūrvādisūtreṇai (2.2.1) kadeśisamāsaḥ| `rājahaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' (5.4.91) iti ṭac samāsāntaḥ, `ahno'hna etebhyaḥ' (5.4.88) ityahnādeśaḥ,`ahno'dantāt' (8.4.7) iti ṇatvam| yadā'patyamyantāt pratyayastadā pūrvāhṇatana iti bhavitavyamiti; saptamyabhāvāt| saptamyabhāvastu prathamāsamarthāt taddhitotpatteḥ|| 25.tatra jātaḥ| (4.3.25) `aṇādayo ghādayaśca' iti| ekenādiśabdenāṇādīnāmihotsargāṇāṃ grahaṇam, dvitīyena ghādīnāṃ śeṣādhikāravihitānām| sraughnaḥ,māthuraḥ' iti| `prāgdīdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) | `autsaḥ, audapānaḥ' iti| `utsādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.86)| `rāṣṭriyaḥ,avārapārīṇaḥ' iti| `rāṣṭrāvārapārādghakhau' (4.2.93)| `śākalikaḥ, mālavikaḥ' iti| `vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca' (4.2.117) iti ṭhaññiṭhau| `kāttreyakaḥ, aumbheyakaḥ' iti| `kattryādibhyo ḍhakañ' (4.2.95)|| 26. prāvṛṣaṣṭhap| (4.3.26) `eṇyasyāpavādaḥ' iti| `prāvṛṣa eṇyaḥ' (4.3.17) iti prāptasya|| 27. saṃjñāyāṃ śarado vuñ| (4.3.27) `samudāyena cetsaṃjñā gamyate' iti| anena samudāyopādhitvaṃ saṃjñāyā darśayati|prakṛtipratyayasamudāyena cetsaṃjñā gamyate ityarthaḥ| yadyevam, śāradakā darbhā itidarbhaśabdasya prayogo na prāpnoti, pratyayāntenābhihitatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathaiva hi śāradakaśabdo darbhaviśeṣasya nāmadheyaṃ tathā mudgaviśeṣasyāpi| tatrāsati darbhaśabdaprayoge'nekārthasādhāraṇatvāt kasya nāmadheyamiti sandehaḥ syāt-- ko'rthaḥ śāradakaśabde vivakṣita iti|
