tasmādasandehārtho darbhaśabdo upādīyate| `saṃjñādhikāram' ityādi| `kecit' iti vacanāt kecinnānṛvarttayantītyuktaṃ bhavati|| 28. pūrvāhṇaparāhṇārdrāmūlapradoṣāvaskarād‌vun| `pūrvāhṇakaḥ,aparāhṇakaḥ' iti| pūrvavadekadeśisamāsādikaṃ kāryaṃ vidheyam-- `vibhāṣā pūrvāhṇāparāhṇābhyām' (4.3.24) iti, tatra ṭyuṭyul‌vidhiśca| `ārdrakaḥ, mūlakaḥ' iti| `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityāgatasyārthaḥ `lubaviśeṣe' (4.2.4) iti lup tato vun| `niśāpradoṣābhyām'iti| ṭhañvidheḥ| `ṭhañādaya eva ' ādiśabdena ṭyuṭyulādayo gṛhyante|| 29. pathaḥ pantha ca| (4.3.29) 30. amāvāsyāyā vā| 94.3.30) `ekadeśāvikṛtasya' ityādi| `amāvasyadanyatarasyām' (3.1.122) ityatra ṇyatyavṛddhireva nipātyate| avṛddhistu vṛddherekādeśabhūtatayā vikāro bhavatītyekadeśavivṛtamamāvasyāśabdasyopapadyate| ye tu sandhivelādiṣu hrasvopadhamadhīyate, teṣāṃ vṛddhyupadhasya grahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti, na hi vikṛtiḥ prakṛtiṃ gṛhṇāti| tasmāddīrgha eva pāṭho yuktaḥ||| 31. a ca| (4.3.31) atha yoga vibhāgaḥ kimarthaḥ,na `amāvāsyā a ca vā' ityevocyeta, cakāro vuno'nukarṣārtho bhaviṣyati, vāvacanañcobhayorvikalpārtham, tena tābhyāṃ mukkate'ṇapi bhaviṣyati ? astyetat; kintvekayoge sati `sindhvapakarābhyāṃ kan' (4.3.32) iti kanneva vikalpena kasyacid‌bhrāntiḥ syāt; atastannivṛttyarthaṃ yogavibhāge hi sati vyavadhānatayā vikalpasya kan nityo vijñāyate|| 32. sindhvapakarābhyāṃ kan| (4.3.32) `apakaraśabdādautsargike'ṇi' iti| prāpte vidhānamiti sambandhaḥ|| 33. aṇañau ca|(4.3.33) yathāsaṃkhyārtho yogavibhāgaḥ| yadi `sindhvapakarābhyāñca kannaṇañaḥ' ityekayogaḥ kriyeta,tato vaiṣamyādekaikasyāḥ prakṛteḥ pratyayāstrayaḥ syuḥ|| 34. śraviṣṭhāphalgunyanurādāsvātitiṣyapunarvasuhastaviśākhāṣāḍhābahulālluk| (4.3.34) nakṣatrāṇaḥ śravaṇe prāpte lugucyate| nanu ca `nakṣatrebhyo bahulam' (4.3.37) ityanenaiva lugbhaviṣyati ? satyametat; tasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ| uttarāvapi yogau prapañcau tasyaiva veditavyau|śraviṣṭhādayaścaite ` nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityanenānagatasyāṇaḥ `lubaviśeṣe' (4.2.4) iti kṛte lubantā veditavyāḥ|` strīpratyayasyāpi' `luk taddhitaluki' (1.2.49) iti lugbhavati' iti| ye strīpratyayāntāsteṣāmupasaṃkhyānamiti pratipādanamityrathaḥ| taccopariṣṭāt kariṣyate| citrāyāṣṭāpo luki kṛte punaṣṭāp kriyate| `gaurāditvānṅīṣ' iti| revatīrohiṇītyatra| `phalgunyaṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau vaktavyau' iti| striyāmityapekṣyate| tayostu vidhānasāmarthyānna lugbhavatiṣa| ṭasya ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ, ano nakāra ādyudāttārthaḥ| vaktavyaśabdo vyākhyeye varttate| vyākhyānaṃ tu kṛtameva ca| `śraviṣṭhāṣāḍhābhyāṃ chaṇapi vaktavyaḥ' iti| atra striyāmiti nopapadyate| ṇakāro vṛddhyarthaḥ| vaktavyaśabdasya sa evārthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi kariṣyate ca| kṛtameva|| 35. sthānāntagośālakharaśālācca| (4.3.35) gośālakharaśālayorhrasvāntayoḥ pāṭhānnapuṃsakayorgrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| napuṃsakaliṅgatā tu `vibhāṣā senāsurā' (2.4.25) ityādinā| yadyapi napuṃsakayorgrahaṇam, tathāpi pratipadikagragaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati iti strīliṅgābhyāmapi lugbhavatyeva| udāharaṇe'pyautsargisyāṇau luk|| 36. vatsaśālābhijidaśvayuktśatabhiṣajo vā| (4.3.36) vatsaśālaśabdo napuṃsakaliṅgo gṛhyate| kuta etas?vyaptervyāyāta;napuṃsakaliṅgasya hi grahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā strīliṅgādapi lugna sidhyati; na tu strīliṅgasya grahaṇe napuṃsakāt| `bahulagrahaṇasyāyaṃ prapañcaḥ' iti| vatsaśālaśabdo yadyapi nakṣatravacano na bhavati, tathāpi bahulavacanāt tato'pi lugbhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ|| 37. nakṣatrebhyo bahulam| (4.3.37) `rohiṇaḥ'ityādau nakṣatrāṇaḥ pakṣe luk| `mṛgaśirāḥ'iti| `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ|`mārgaśīrṣaḥ'iti| `ye ca taddhite' (6.1.61) ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ| atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? napūrvasūtrādeva vāgrahaṇamanuvartiṣyate ? idaṃ prayojanam-- na kvacidanyadeva yathā syāt, tena phalgunyaṣāḍhābhyāṃ ṭānau siddhau bhavataḥ| śraviṣṭhāṣāḍhābhyāñchaṇapīti|| 38. kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ| (4.3.38) `nanu ca' ityādi| janmavadvastu jātaśabdasyārthaḥ, kṛtasyāpi janmāstyeva, tasmādyadyatra kṛtaṃ jātamapi tattatra bhavati| `yacca krītam' ityādi| prāptaṃ labdhamucyate| krītaṃ prāptamapapi tadbhavatyeva, tasmāt krītaṃ labdhamapi bhavati| `śabdasyārthasyābhinnatvāt' iti|svajanmanyanubhūtakarttṛbhāvo jātaśabdasyārthaḥ| jātaśabdasyaiva viśeṣopalakṣitaparavyāpāro svajanmaniṣpattau kṛtaśabdasyārthaḥ| prāptisāmānyaṃ labdhaśabdasyārthaḥ| prāptiviśeṣo yasya mūlahetukā prāptiḥ| sa krītaśabdasyārthaḥ| na ca sāmānyaviśeṣayorekārthatā yuktā| mā bhūtparyāyaprasaṅga iti bhidyate śabdārthaḥ| `vastumātreṇa' iti| krītalabdhayoryadādhārabhūtaṃ vsatumātraṃ tasyābhinnarūpatvātkrītaṃ labdhaṃ bhavati| mātragrahaṇaṃ śabdārthavyavacchedārtham| ata evāha-- `śabdārthastu bhidyata eva' (iti)| na hi yena rūpeṇa krītaśabdena tatpratyāyyate tenaiva labdhaśabdena| evaṃ jātakṛtaśabdayorvastutvenābhinnatvam| śabdārthadvāreṇa tu bhinnārthatvameva| anyenaiva hi rūpeṇa jātaśabdena tadvastu pratyāyyate, anyena kṛtaśabdena|| 39. prāyabhavaḥ| (4.3.39) `prāyabhavagrahaṇamanarthakam' iti| vaicitryādanyasyārthasyābhāvādanarthamityucyate| vaicitryeṇa tu sārthakameva| kasmāt punararthakamiti ? `tatra bhavena kṛtārthatvāt' iti| yat `prāyabhavaḥ'ityasya sādhyam, tasya `tatra bhavaḥ'(4.3.53) ityanenaiva sādhitatvāditibhāvaḥ| yo hi rājye prāyeṇa bhavati tatrāsau bhavatyeva| tataśca tatra bhave tasyāntarbhāvāt `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityanenaiva kṛtaṃ sampādanamriti kiṃ prāyabhavagrahaṇena ? `anityabhavaḥ' ityādinā parasyottaramāśaṅkate|syādetat-- anityabhavaḥ prāyabhavo nityabhavastatra bhava iti, tasmāt tatra bhavena prāyabhavsayāsaṃgrahānna sidhyati ? ityāśaṅkyāha-- `muktasaṃśayena tulyam' iti| muktastyaktaḥ saṃśayo yena tat muktasaṃśayam| nyāyyastatra bhavo'yamiti yo niścitastena tulyaṃ bhavati| tathā hi-- sraghne bhavo devadattaḥ sraughna ityucyate, na cāsau srughne sadā bhavati, avaśyaṃ hi kadācidudagdesādīnapakrāmati, atha ca tatrabhavapratyayo bhavati| yadi ca nityabhavastatra bhavaḥ ? jihvāmūle bhavo varṇaḥ jihvāmūlīya ityatra `tatra bhavaḥra' (4.3.53) ityadhikāre jihvāmūlāṅguleśchaḥ' (4.3.ka62) iti ccho na syāt, na hi varṇo nityaṃ jihvāmūle bhavati| tasmāt prāyabhava kakakakakakakakakasya tatrabhavāntarbhavāt tato na ṇyatiricyata itnarthakaṃ prayabhavagrahaṇam|| 40. upajānūpakarṇopanīveṣṭhak| (4.3.40) jānunaḥ samīpam, karṇasya samīpam, nāvyāḥ samīpamiti-- `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā'vyayībāvaḥ| `{aupajānukaḥ-- kāśikā'} upajānukaḥ' iti| `isusuktantāt kaḥ' (7.3.51)|| 41. sambhūte| (4.3.41) `avaklṛptiḥ'ityādi| avaklṛpti - sambhāvanā| pramāṇānatirekaḥ - ādhārapramāṇādādheyapramāṇasyānatiriktatā, yasyāṃ satyāṃ sravamādheyamādhāramanupraviśati| `srudhne sambhavati' (iti)| yastu srudhne sambhāvyate, srughnapramāṇānnātiricyate, tadanupravaśāt sa senādiko'rtha evamucyate|| 42. kośāḍḍhañ| (4.3.42) `kauśeyaṃ vastram' iti| nanu ca vasraṃ kauśeyaṃ na sambhavati, kintu kṛmiḥ, tataśca kṛmāveva syāt, na vastre; api ca viśeṣānabhidhānāt khaḍgasambandhino'pi kośāt pratyayaḥ prasajyetetyāha-- `rūḍhireṣā' ityādi| rūḍhiśabdo hi yathākathañcidutpādyate, na tatrāvaśyamavayavārtho'pekṣyaḥ, kvacidavayavārthāsambhavāt| tathā hi tailaṃ pibatītyevaṃ tailapāyikāśabdo vyutpādyate, na tatrāvaśyamavayavārtho'pekṣyaḥ, kvacivayavārthāsambhavāt| tathā hi tailaṃ pibatītyevaṃ tailapāyikāśabdo vyutpādyate, sa ca tailapānakriyārahita eva kvacit prāṇiviśeṣe varttate| sasmādyadyapi na kṛmau| atha khaṅgakośādutpattau ko doṣaḥ, yena tataḥ pratyayo neṣyate ? khaṅgasyābidhānaṃ prāpnoti| sa hi tatra sambhavatīti cet ? itarasmādapi tarhi kośāt pratyayotpattau ca kṛmerabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti, sa hi tatra sambhavati| atha tatrāpi rūḍhivaśādvastrasyābhidhānam, na kṛmeḥ| itarasmādapi tarhi kośādutpattau vasrasyābhidhānaṃ na khaṅgasya ? evaṃ manayate-- yadyapi sambhūtādhikāre kośāḍḍhañ vidhīyate, tathāpi kauśeyaśabdānna sambhavo'rtha pratīyate, api tu vikāro'rthaḥ; rūḍhivaśāt| kauśeyaṃ vasramitikośavikāro vasramityarthaḥ| tathā ca vārttikakāreṇoktam-- `vikāre kośāḍḍhañ, `{sambhūtārthānupapattiḥ--vā.pāṭhaḥ'} sambhūtārthānupapatteḥ' (vā. 1,2(4.3.42) iti| vikārasca kauśeyaśabdāt kṛmikośasya pratīyate, na khaṅgakośasya ; rūḍhivaśāt| tasmādyasya vikāraḥ pratīyate tadabhidhāyina eva kośaśabdādyukkataḥ pratyayaḥ netarasmāt|| 43. kālātsādhupuṣpyatpacyamāneṣu| (4.3.43) kālāditi svaryate, prakṛtīruttarā viśeṣayitum| na ca svarūpagrahaṇe satyuttarāḥ prakṛtayaḥ śakyā viśeṣayitum; svarūpasyādhāraṇatvāt| tasmādarthagrahaṇamevaitat| tenakālaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ pratyayo vijñāyata ityāha-- `kālaviśeṣavācibyaḥ' ityādi| `haimanaḥ' iti| `sarvatrāṇ ca talopaśca' (4.3.22)| `śaiśiraḥ' ityādau sandhivelādisūtreṇa (4.3.16) ṛtvaṇ|| 44. upte ca| (4.3.44) `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttaratra vuñ upta eva yathā syāt; sādhvādiṣu mā bhūt|| 45. āśvayujyā vuñ| (4.3.45) `ṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| `kālāṭaṭhñ' (4.3.11) prāptasya| nanu ca kālāṭṭhañ vihitaḥ| na cāśvayujīśabdaḥ kālavācī, tataḥ kutaṣṭhañ ? ityāśaṅkya kālavācitvamāśvayujīśabdasya pratipādayitumāha-- `aśvinībhyāṃ yuktā' ityādi|| 46. grīṣmavasantādanyatarasyām| (4.3.46) 47. deyamṛme| (4.3.47) 48. kalāpyaśvatthayavabusād‌vun| (4.3.48) kathaṃ punaḥ kalāpādayaḥ śabdāḥ kāle varttante, yāvatā mayūrādiṣu teṣāṃ vṛttiḥ prasiddhetyata āha-- `kālāpyādayaḥ śabdāḥ' ityādi| evameva viṣayaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti-- `yasminkāle' ityādi| aśvatthaśabdo'tra vṛkṣaviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ| tena sarva eva kālaḥ sambadhyata iti tad‌dvāreṇa kālaviśeṣo na saṃjñāyate| tasmādaśvatthaphalasahacāriṇi kāle'śvatthaśabdo varttata iti darśayitumāha-- `yasmānnaśvatthāḥ phalanti' ityādi| aśvatthaśabdo yadyapi vṛkṣe varttate, tathāpi phale varttate eva|| 49. grīṣmāvarasād‌vuñ| (4.3.49) `aṇṭhañorapavādaḥ' iti| grīṣmaśabdādṛtvaṇorapavādaḥ| anarasamāśabdāt kālāṭṭhañaḥ| avarā cāsau samā cetyavarasamā|| 50. saṃvatsarāgrahāyaṇībhyāṃ ṭhañca| (4.3.50) kālāṭṭhañi prāpte vacanam| tena ṭhañ na vaktavya iti| vuñi vikalpite vināpi ṭhañgrahaṇena pakṣe yathāprāptaṃ ṭhañeva bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| `ṭhañgrahaṇam' ityādi| tatra yadyatra ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta `sandhivelā' (4.3.16) ityādiṣu `saṃvatsarātphalaparvaṇoḥ' (ga.sū.104) iti pāṭhāt sandhivelādyaṇaṣṭhañapavādatvādaṇatvena kāle vivakṣite vuñā mukte'ṇeva syāt| ṭhañgrahaṇādaṇamapi bādhitvā ṭhañeva bhavati|| 51. vyāharati mṛgaḥ| (4.3.51) `naiśikaḥ,naiśaḥ| prādoṣikaḥ, prādoṣaḥ' iti| niśāpradoṣābhyāṃ (4.3.14)ṭhañ| tena mukte pakṣa ṛtvaṇeva bhavati|| 52. tadasya soḍham| (4.3.52) kālāditi varttate, na ca kālo jīyate, tasmānnisāsahacaritamihādhyayanaṃ gauṇyā vṛttyā niśetyevamādibhirabhidhīyata iti vijñāyate| ata evāha-- `niśāsahacaritamadhyayanaṃ niśā' iti|| 53. tatra bhavaḥ| (4.3.53) 54. digādibhyo yat| (4.3.54) `aṇaśchasya cāpavādaḥra' iti| yaddigādiṣu vṛddhaṃ vāpyādi tataśchasyāpavādaḥ, śeṣebhyastvaṇaḥ prāgdīvyatīyasya| atha mukhajaghanayośca kimarthaḥ pāṭho digādiṣu , yāvatā śarīrāvayavāt tābhyāmuttarasūtreṇaiva (4.3.55) bhaviṣyati ? ityāha-- `mukhajaghanayoḥ' iti| senāvayavavācinau hi yau mukhajaghanaśabdau tau śarīravayavavācinau na bhavataḥ| pāṇipādādyavayavasvabhāvaṃ hi śarīram, na caivamātmikā senā; kiṃ tarhi ? rathādisamudāyātmikā| `udakātsaṃjñāyām' iti| udakaśabdāt saṃjñāyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ yadbhavati-- udakyā strī, rajasvalocyate| na cātra prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārtho vā vidyate| sā ca tayoravidyamānatā saṃjñāgrahaṇena vijñāyate| saṃjñāyāmanyatra-- audako matsya iti, atrāṇeva bhavati|| 55. śarīrāvayavācca| (4.3.55) `aṇo'pavādaḥ' iti| nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt| yastu pādādivṛddhastataḥ paratvādyat chaṃ bādhate|| 56. dṛtikukṣikalaśivastyastyaherḍhañ| (4.3.56) dṛtikukṣibhyāṃ śarīrāvayatvādyati prāpte;kukṣiśabdo dhūmādaṣvapi paṭhyate, tasmāt `dhūmādibhyaśca' (4.2.127) iti vuñi prāpte; śeṣebhyastvaṇi ḍhañi vidhīyate| astiśabdastiṅanto mā vijñāyītyata āha-- `astiśabdaḥ' ityādi| `vibhaktisvarapratirūpakāśceti nipātā bhavanti' iti nipātasaṃjñakaṃ tiṅantasadṛśaṃ prātipadikametat, na tiṅantaḥ| etacca tiṅantena samānārtham, yathā-- astikṣīrā brāhmaṇīti| bhinnārthaśca yathā dhane varttate, yathā-- astimāniti| dhanavāniti gamyate | tadiha viśeṣasyānabhidhānādubhayasyāpi grahaṇam|| 57. grīvābhyo'ṇ‌ ca| (4.3.57) bahuvacananirdeśādbahuvacanāntāt pratyayena bhavitavyam, anyathā hyekavacenaiva nirdeśaṃ kuryāditi kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastāṃ nirākartumāha-- `grīvāśabdaḥra' ityādi| arthaviśeṣādbahuvacananirdeśaḥ kutaḥ, na tu bahuvacanāntādeva yathā syāditi darśayati|| 58. gambhīrāññyaḥ| (4.3.58) `bahirdeva' ityādi| bahurdevapañcajanebhyaśca ñyo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- cakāro'tra varttate, tena bahirādibhyo'pi ñyo bhaviṣyatīti|| 59. avyayībhāvācca| (4.3.59) `kiṃ tarhi' ityādi| kathaṃ punaravyayībhāvāditi sāmānyenocyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ parimukhādereva ? ityata āha-- `parimukhādīnāñca' ityādi| caśabdo hetau| na hyantat kāryamasti parimukhādigaṇapāṭhasya| tatra yadyapyetadapi na syāt, vidhyarthameva tasya syāt, tasmāt parimukhādereva bhavati, na sarvasmādavyayībhāvāt| yadyevam, parimukhāderityevaṃ vaktavyamityāha-- `teṣām' ityādi| yadi hi parimukhāderityucyate, tato'satyavyayībhāvagrahaṇe tatpuruṣebhyo'pi parimukhādibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ syāt, tasmiṃstu sati na bhavati-- parigataṃ mukhaṃ parimukhamiti prādisamāsaḥ, tatra bhavaḥ parimukhaḥ; aṇeva bhavati| api cottarārdhamavyayībhāvagrahaṇamavaśyameva karttavyam-- `antaḥpūrvapadāṭṭhañ' (4.3.60) | `grāmātparyanupūrvāt' (4.3.61) ityavyayībhāvādyathā syāt| `pārihanavyam' iti| `orguṇaḥra' (6.4.146), `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ| `aupakūlam' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā'vyayībhāvaḥ| eṣa ca parimukhādiṣu na paṭhyata ityaṇeva bhavati| atra piramukhamiti kathamavyayībhāvaḥ ? yāvatā apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā (2.1.12) samasyante, pañcamī ca pariṇā karmapravacanīyena yoge bhavati, karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tu `apaparī vardane' (1.4.88) ityanena, na ca parimukhe varjanaṃ gamyate, kiṃ tarhi ? sarvatobhāvaḥ ? evaṃ tarhi `avyayam' (2.1.6) iti yogavibhāgavyayībhāvo bhaviṣyati| anye tu ye'tra parihanuprabhṛtayo'vyayībhāvāḥ, te `apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā' (2.1.12) ityanenaiva bhavanti| atra yeṣvapi varjanaṃ na gamyate, tatasteṣvayi `avyayam' (2.1.6) iti yogavibhāgenaiva| ye tūpasīrādaya upapūrvāḥ, te sāmīpye `avyayam' (2.1.6) ityādinā| `anugaṅgam' iti| `yasya cāyāmaḥ' (2.1.16) ityavyayabhāvaḥ| anye tu ye'nusīrādayo'nupūrvāste paścādarthe'vyayamityādinā|| 60. antaḥ pūrvapadāṭṭhañ| (4.3.60) `antaḥśabdo vibhaktyarthe samasyate' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā| vibhaktyarthastvadhikaraṇam, antaḥśabdasyādhikaraṇapradhānatvāt| samānaśabdāṭṭhañvaktavyaḥ' iti | vaktavyaśabdo vyākhyeye| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- ihāntaḥpūrvādityevaṃ siddhe yadadhikaṃ padagrahaṇaṃ tadadhikamiha kāryaṃ bhavatītyevamarthaṃ kriyate, tena samānaśabdādapi iñ bhavatīti| etena śabdāntarādeva| adhyātmādibhya ūrdhvandamādūrdhvadehāllokottarapadācca ṭhañ bhavatīti veditavyam| `ādhyātmikam' iti| `ādhyātmikam' iti| ātmanyadhi adhyātmam, vibhaktyirthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| `anuśatikādīnāñca' (7.3.20) ityubhayapadavṛddhiḥ| `adhyātmādirākṛtigaṇaścāyam' iti| yadyevam, `samānaśabdāṭṭhañ vaktavyaḥ' (vā.454) ityadyanarthakam, adhyātmādibhyaścetyanenaiva siddhatvāt ? nānarthak; asyaiva prapañcārthatvāt| adhyātmādireva tat prapañcyate| nanu cākārānta ūrdhvaśabdaḥ, tat kuta iha makārāntatvamāyātamitāha-- `ūrdhvaśabdena' ityādi| `aihalaukikaḥ, pāralaukikaḥ' iti| pūrvavadubhayapadavṛddhiḥ| `mukhatīyam, pārśvatīyam' iti| `apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' (5.4.45) iti tasiḥ| `ādyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam' (vā.634) ityaupasaṃkhyāniko vā| `avyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ' (vā.842) ityanena ṭilopaḥ| `maṇnīyau ca pratyayau vaktavyau' iti| madhyaśabdādityapekṣate| `madhyo madhyaṃ dinaṇ cāsmāt' iti| madhyaśabdo madhyambhāvamāpadyate, dinaṇ cāsmāt pratyayo bhavati| `sthāmnaḥ' iti| sthāmaśabdāntāt prātipadikāt| aśvasyeva sthāma balamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, pṛṣodaraditvāt sakārasya takāraḥ| aśvatthāmni bhava ityaṇ, tasya luk| `ājināntācca' iti| lugiti sambadhyate| `vṛkājinaḥ' iti| aṇo luk| `samānasya' iti| ānantaryalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| samānaśabdādanantaraṣṭhañiṣyata ityarthaḥ| `samānasya' iti| ānantaryalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| samānaśabdādanantaraṣṭhañiṣyata ityarthaḥ| `adhyātmādiṣu' iti| vaiṣayike'dhikaraṇe saptamī| adhyātmādiviṣaye ṭhañiṣyata ityarthaḥ| `kugjanasya parasya ca' iti| cakārādīyaśca pratyayaḥ| `ūrdhvandamācca dehācca' iti| ūrdhvaśabdāt parasmāt damaśabdādūrdhvaśabdāddeśaśabdācca ṭhagiṣyata ityarthaḥ| `īyaḥ kāryo'tha madhyasya' iti| athaśabdaḥ samuccaye| madhyaśabdasyānantara īyaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ| `maṇmīyau pratyayau tathā' iti| madhyaśabdādityapekṣyate| maṇmīyau madhyaśabdasyāntarau karttavyau| `ajināttathā' iti| ajināntāt lugvaktavya ityarthaḥ|| 61. grāmātparyanupūrvāt| (4.3.61) `pārigrāmikam' iti| `{grāmaśabdāntādavyayībhāvāt pari--kāśikā|}' grāmāt pari' iti| `aparaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā' (2.1.12) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| `ānugrāmikam'iti| atrāpi `anuryatsamayā' (2.1.15)|| 62. jihvāmūlāṅguleśchaṭhaḥ| (4.3.62) `yato'pavādaḥ' iti|` śarīravayavācca' (4.3.55) iti prāptasya|| 63. vargāntācca| (4.3.63) 64. aśabde yatkhāvanyatarasyām| (4.3.64) `che prāpte' iti| pūrvasūtreṇa|| 65. karṇalalāṭātkanalaṅkāre| (4.3.65) karṇikāśabdaścābharaṇaviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ| rūḍhiśabdeṣu ca nāvaśyamapi karṇasambandhena bhavitavyam|| 66. tasya vyākhyāna iti ca vyākhyātavyanāmnaḥ| (4.3.66) `{ tasya vyākhyāne- iti sūtrabhāgaḥ}tasya vyākhyānam' iti| vyākhyāyate'neneti vyākhyānam, karaṇe lyuṭ| cakārāt `tatra bhave ca' iti| nanu ca vyākhyānaṃ pratyayārthaḥ, tasya samīpe cakāraḥ śrūyata iti pratyayārthamātrasyaiva samānajātīyasya tenānukarṣaṇaṃ nyāyyam, na tu samarthavibhakterapi; samānajātīyasya tu cakāraḥ samuccayaṃ karoti, yathā-- `kedārādyañca' (4.2.40) iti; pratyayasamīpavarttinā cakāreṇa pratyaya eva samuccīyate, yathā-- `ṭhañ kavacinaśca' (4.2.41) pādānāt pūrvasyāḥ samarthavibhakternivṛttau satyāṃ bhavārthe'pi ṣaṣṭīsāmarthyādeva pratyayo yuktaḥ-- tadayuktamuktam; tatra bhave ceti, tasya bhave ceti vaktuṃ yuktam ? ityata āṅa-- `vākyārthasamīpe' ityādi| ihetirakaraṇena tasya vyākhyāna ityeṣo'rthaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| na tu vyākhyānapratyayārthaḥ| tasmāditikaraṇāntataramuccāritaścakārastatpratyayavamṛṣṭasya vākyārthasyaiva samīpe śrūyamāṇastulyajātayīmeva vākyārthaṃ samuccinoti| tena bhavārthe saptamīsāmarthyādeva eva kṛtaḥ; anyathā hi `tasya vyākhyāne ca' ityevaṃ brūyāt| kaḥ punarasau vākyārtha ityāha-- `tatra bhave' iti| `na tu pāṭalīputraśabdo vyākhyātavyanāma' iti| nanu ca pāṭaliputraḥ kośalayā vyākhyāyate, niyataṃ tena vyākhyātavyena bhavitavyam, anyathā tasya vyākhyānī sukośalā na syāt| tasya vyākhyānasya pāṭaliputraśabdo vyākhyātavyanāma bhavatīti bhāvaḥ ? naitadasti; yadīha vyākhyātavyamabhipretam, na tasyaitannāma bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kiñceha vyākhyātavyamabhipretam ? yadvyākhyātavyatayā loke prasiddhataram| kuta etat ? vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇāt| iha hi vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇaṃ vyākhyātavyārthaṃ tu na karttavyameva;vināpi hi tena vyākhyāvyanāmna eva pratyayasiddheḥ| tathā hi `tasya ' iti tasya pratiyogivyākhyānamupāttam| tacca vyākhyātavyasyaiva sambhavati, nānyasya| tasmādyadyattasay vyākhyātavyaṃ sāmarthyāttadeva tasyetyanena ṣaṣṭhyantenopādīyata iti vijñāyate| tataścāntareṇāpi vyākhyāvyanāmagrahaṇaṃ vyākhyātavyanāmābhidhāyina eva pratyayo bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇena ? tat kriyate vyākhyatavyatayā loke yaḥ prasiddhastadabhidhāyina eva pratyayo yathā syādityevamartham| vyākaraṇādayo granthaviśeṣā loke prasiddhāḥ, na te pāṭaliputrādayaḥ| evamapi nāmagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam, vyākhyatavyagrahaṇasāmarthyādeva hi vyākhyātavyatayā prasiddhatarebhyaḥ pratyayo labhyata eva ? naitadasti;vyākhyāne hi pratyayārthe vyākhyānādeva vyākhyātavyavācinaḥ pratyaye siddhe punarvyākhyātavyagrahaṇasāmarthyāda vyākhyātavyatayā ye prasiddhāstebyaḥ pratyayo labhyate, na tu tatra bhave; tatra sāmarthyābhāvāt| bhave'pi cārthe tatra vyākhyātayā prasiddhatarāḥ, tadabhidhāyibhya eva pratyaya iṣyata iti; na tu yataḥ kutaścit| tasmādbhavādhikāre rūḍhyupasaṃgrahārthaṃ nāmagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| atha kimarthaṃ bhavavyākhyānayoryugapadadhikāraḥ kriyate ? ityāha-- `bhavavyākhyānayoḥ' ityādi| ṭhañādīnapavādānatrābhidhāsyāmītyevamartho yugapadanayoradhikāraḥ| nanu kimucyate-- apavādavidhānārthaṃ iti; prakṛtānāmaṇādīnāṃ pratyayānāmarthanirdeśo yathā syāt ? ityata āha-- `kṛtanirdaśau hi tau' iti| kṛtanirdeśau hi tāvarthau| ekaḥ `tatra bhavaḥ' iti, aparaḥ `tasyedam' iti| tasyedaṃviśeṣatvādvyākhyānasya|| 67. bahvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañ| (4.3.67) `ṣātvaṇatvikam' iti| `nātānatikam' iti| ubhayatra dvandvātpratyayaḥ| `samāsasvareṇāntodāttāḥ prakṛtayaḥ'iti| `samāsasya' (6.1.223) ityanena bahuvacananirdeśaścaivaṃjātīyāparaprakṛtyapekṣayā| dvyacaṣṭhakaṃ vakṣyati-- `dvyajṛdbrāhmaṇa' (4.3.72) ityādinā| `saupam' iti| `taiṅam' iti| suptiṅśabdau prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttau| `gatisvareṇādyudāttaḥ'iti| `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) ityanena| antagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham; sarvodāttasya prātipadikasyāsambhavāt| sāmarthyādeva tadantavidhirbhaviṣyatīti, yathā-- `varṇādanudāttāttopadhāt to naḥ' (4.1.39) iti| api codātta iti varṇagrahaṇaṃ sarva tadantavidhiṃ prayojayatīti yukta eva tadantavidhiḥ|| 68. kratuyajñebhyaśca| (4.3.68) `anantodāttārtha ārambhaḥ' iti| yadyevam, rājasūyikam, vājapeyikamityetadevopadāharaṇadvayaṃ yuktam| rājasūyavājapeyaśabdayoḥ kṛdantottarapadayoḥ prakṛtisvareṇa madhyodāttatvāduttarapadaṃ cādyudāttamatra| ekaṃ vyābantatvāt kṛtsvareṇa, aparaṃ `yato'nācaḥ' (6.1.213) iti| samāse ca kṛte `gatirakārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) iti prakṛtibhāvenādyudāttamevanāvatiṣṭhate; `{āgniṣṭomikaḥ, nāvayajñikaḥ--kāśikā} āgniṣṭomikaṃ nāvayajñikam' iti| etadudādaharaṇadvayamayuktam, agniṣṭomanavayajñaśabdābhyāṃ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttābhyāmanenāprāpteḥ ? na hi pūrveṇānena vā ṭhañi viśeṣaḥ| kratusāhacaryādatrodāhṛtam| śabdaḥ sāhacaryādvarttata iti vijñāyate|| 39. adhyāyeṣvevarṣeḥ| (4.3.69) 70. pauroḍāśapuroḍāśāt ṣṭhan| (4.3.70) puroḍāśasyedamityantodāttaḥ| tasmādbahvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañi (4.3.67) prāpte| puroḍāśastu `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' (phi.sū.2.42) iti madhyādāttaḥ| asmādaṇi prāpte ṣṭhan vidhīyate| vakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ, nakāra ādyudāttārthaḥ| teṣāṃ saṃskāro mantraḥ pauroḍāśa iti| `puroḍāśasahacaritaḥra' iti| sāmarthyāt sāhacaryādvā puroḍāśā yena mantraṇa saṃskriyante puroḍāśaśabdo varttate, na puroḍāśeṣu| kṛta etat ? vyākhyātavyanāmagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| na hi puroḍāśā vyākhyātavyatayā prasiddhatarāḥ|| 71. chandaso yadaṇau| (4.3.71) 72. dvyajṛd‌brāhmaṇarkprathamādhvarapuraścaraṇanāmākhyātāṭṭhak| (4.3.72) `aṇorapavādaḥ' iti| ādiśabdena ṭhañaḥ| tatra ya ṛkārāntā udgātṛprabhṛtayo bahvaco'ntodāttastebhyaṣṭhaño'pavādaḥ| brāhmaṇaprathamādhvarebhyo'pi ṭhaña eva| te'pi barvacaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttāḥ| nāmākhyātaśabdādapi samastāt tasyaiva| so'pi bahvac, samāsasvareṇāntodāttaśca| pariśiṣṭebhyo'ṇaḥ| `pāṃśukam, pāñcahotṛkam' iti| `isusuktāntāt kaḥ' (7.3.51) | pañcahotṛcaturhotṛśabdāvigante `dvigau' (6.2.29) itipūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyudāttau| pūrvapadaṃ hi `nraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ' (phi.sū.2.28) ityudāttam| puraścaraṇaśabdolyuḍantaḥ kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa (6.2.139) madhyodāttaḥ| ākhyātaśabdaḥ `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) ityādyudāttaḥ| `saṅgātaviguhītārtham' iti| taccaikaśeṣasamāsāśrayaṇāllabhyata iti veditavyam|| 73. aṇṛgayanādibhyaḥ| (4.3.73) `ṭhañorapavādaḥra' iti| ādiśabdena ṭhakaśchasya ca| tatra ye bahvaco'ntodāttastebhyaṣṭhañaḥ| vidyānyāyaśikṣāśabdebhyo dvyajlakṣamasya ṭhakaḥ| vyākaraṇaśabdād‌vṛddhācchasya| aṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? na ṛyayanādibhyo tā vihitamevocyeta, na caivaṃ satyapavādāḥ ṣṭhanādayaḥ syuriti sambhāvyate; apavādavidhānasya hi vaiyarthyaṃ syāt| tasmādvacanaprāmāṇyadyo vihito na ca prāpnotyanyena bādhitatvāt sa eva bhaviṣyati, sa cāṇeva ? ityata āha-- `aṇgrahaṇam' ityādi| tatra yadyaṇgrahaṇaṃ na kriyet, tadā yadatra vṛddhamantodāttaṃ ṭhañā bādhite purvacanāccha eva bhaviṣyati| tasmācchasya bādhakasay bādhanārthamaṇgrahaṇam| tena vāstuvidya iti siddhaṃ bhavati| vāstuvidyāśabdo vṛddhaḥ,samāsasveramaāntodāttaśca| `ṛgayana' ityādi| ṛgayanamiti| ṛgayanaśabdo bhāvasādhana ṛcāmayanam,yadyapi bhāve lyuṭ, tathāpyabhadopacārāt tadvati granthe vyākhyātavye varttate, sa ca `ano bhāvakarmavacanaḥ' (6.2.150) ityantodāttaḥ| yaistu karaṇe lyuṭaṃ kṛtvāṛgayanaśabdo vyutpādyate, teṣāṃ sa kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇa madhyodātto na gaṇe pāṭhaṃ prayojayati tataḥ `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityeva siddhaḥ| padavyākhyānaśabdaḥ `manktinvyākyānaśayanāsanasthānayājakādikrītāḥ' (6.2.151) ityantodāttaḥ| `{nāsti-- kāśikāyāṃ padamañjaryāṃ ca|} māna' iti| manordhātoryadā ghañ tadā `thāthaṣañktājavitrakāṇām' (6.2.144) ityantodāttaḥ| atha mināterlyuṭ,tadā `ano bhāvakarmavacane' (6.2.150) ityantodāttaḥ| `chandobhāvaḥ' iti| `gatikārakopapadāt' kṛt' (6.2.139) iti kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| bhāṣāśabda `gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103)ityakārapratyayānto vyutpāditaḥ| `chandoviciti' iti| `manktin' (6.2.151) ityādināntodāttaḥ| punaruktaśabdaḥ `thāthaghanktā javitrakāṇām' (6.2.144) ityantodāttaḥ| `{ nāsti--kāśikāyām' } niruktaḥ' `saṃjñāyāmanācitādīnām' (6.2.146) ityantodāttaḥ, vyākaraṇaśabdo lyuḍanto madhyodāttaḥ| nigamaśabdaḥ `gocarasañcara' (3.3.119) ityādisūtre ghapratyayānto nipātitaḥ pratyasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| vāstuvidyāśabdo'ṅgavidyā {kṣattravidyā--kāśikā padamañjarī ca|} kṣattriyavidyetyete ca samāsasvareṇāntodāttāḥ| utpāt, `{utpāda --kāśikā' } udapāda--ityetau thāthādi (6.2.144) sūtreṇāntodāttau| saṃvatsara iti| `aśeḥ sara' (da.u.8.50) ityanuvṛttau `vaseḥ saṃpūrvāccit' (da.u.8.51,52) ityevaṃ vyutpādatitvāt saṃvatsaraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| mṛhyaterdhātoḥ ktaḥ, kte ūrāgamaḥ, tena `muhūrta' ityantodāttaḥ| `nimitta' śabdo'pi prātipadikasvareṇa| `upaniṣat' iti| upanipūrvāt sadeḥ kvip| kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ|| 74. tata āgataḥ| (4.3.74) atha `srughnādagacchan vṛkṣamūlādāgataḥ' iti. atra vṛkṣamūlaśabdāt pratyayaḥ kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- `mukhyam' ityādi| mukhyaṃ pradhānaṃ vivakṣitam, tadiha parigṛhyate; na tu nāntarīyakapradhānam, na hi mukhye satītarasyāpradhānasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam; mukye kāryasampratyayāt|| 75. ṭhagāyasthānebhyaḥ| (4.3.75) 76. śuṇḍikādibhyo'ṇ| (4.3.76) `āyasthānaṭhako'pavādaḥ' iti| bāhulyādevamuktam; yasmāt kṛkaṇaśabdo'tra paṭhyate| tatra hi `kṛkaṇaparṇādbhāradvāje' (4.2.145) iti prāptasya cchasyāpavādaḥ| tīrthaśabdaśceha dhūmādiṣu paṭhyate, tataḥ `dhūmādibhyaśca' (4.2.127) iti prāptasya vuño'pavādaḥ| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na śuṇḍikādibhyo yathāvihitamevocyeta, na caivaṃ paṭhyamāne'pavāda eva syādityāśaṅkanīyam; apavādavidhāne hi vacanavaiyarthyaṃ syāt, tasmādantareṇāpyaṇgrahaṇamaṇeva bhaviṣyati ? ityata āha-- `aṇgrahaṇam' ityādi| `udapāna' śabdo'tra paṭhyata āyasthānavacanam, utsādiṣvasau paṭhyate; tatrāsatyagrahaṇa āyasthānaṭhakaṃ bādhitvā `utsādibhyo'ñ' (4.1.86) ityañeva syāt| tasmāt tasya bādhakasya bādhanārthamaṇgrahaṇam| tenodapāna ityatrāṇsiddho bhavati|| 77. vidyāyonasambandhebhyo vuñ| (4.3.77) 78. ṛtaṣṭhañ| (4.3.78) `taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham' iti| atha dīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati ? asambhavāt| na hi vidyāyonisambandhiṣu kiñcidṛkārāntaṃ prātipadikamasti yannivṛttyarthastakāraḥ syāt|| 79. pituryacca| (4.3.79) `pitryam' iti| `rīṅa ṛtaḥ' (7.4.27) ita rīṅa, yasyati (6.4.148) lopaḥ|| 80. gotrādaṅkavat| (4.3.80) yadi gotrādaṅkavatpratyayavidhirbhavatītyucyate'ṇa evātideśaḥ prāpnoti, na vuñaḥ| yasmādaṇvidhāvevāṅgagrahaṇamasti| `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇa' (4.3.127) ityādau sūtreṇa vuñvidhau `gotracaraṇād‌vuñ' (4.3.126) ityatra ? ityāha-- `aṅkagrahaṇen' ityādi| yathā kākebhyo dadhi rakṣyatāmityatra kākagrahaṇamupadhātasāmānyasyopalakṣaṇam, evamihāpyaṅkagrahaṇaṃ `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityasya| tenāyaṃ sūtrārtho bhavati-- yathā `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityatra pratyayo bhavati, tathā `tata āgataḥ' (4.3.74)ityatrāpi| tena vuño'pyatideśa upapadyate| nanvevamapyaṇo'tideśo na prāpnoti, na hi tadvidhau gotragrahaṇamasti ? pūrvasūtrād‌gotragrahaṇamanuvarttata ityadoṣaḥ| `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇa' (4.3.127) eityādinā yena sūtreṇāṇ vihitastaddarśayati|| 81. hetumanuṣyebhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ| (4.3.81) `samādagatam' iti| samāddhetorāgatamasyārthaḥ| kena punariha pañcamī ? asamādeva jñāpakāt| yadayaṃ pañcamyantāt pratyayamāha tato jñāyate-- hetau pañcamī bhavati|| 82. mayaṭ ca| (4.3.82) `yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyānirāsārthaḥ' iti| nanu cānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇenautsargike'bhyanujñāyamāne vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyasya prāptereva nāsti ? satyametat; yastu rūpyamayaṭorapūrvatvādvidhīyamānapekṣayā yathāsaṃkhyatvaṃ manyeta,taṃ prati yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate|| 83. prabhavati| (4.3.83) `{prathamataḥ--kāśikā'} prathama upalabhyata ityarthaḥ' iti| prathama ityanena praśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| `upalabhyate' ityanenāpi bhavateḥ| anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ bhavatirihopalabdhau bhavatirihopalabdhau varttate| `himavataḥ prabhavati' iti| `bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ' (1.4.31) iti himavato'pādānasaṃjñā|| 84. vidūrāññyaḥ| (4.3.84) `tatra tu saṃskriyate' iti| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| saṃskriyate eva ca tatra vidūre nagare, na tataḥ prabhavati| `vālavāyo vidūrañca' iti| vālavāyaśabda eva pratyayamutpādayati, na vidūraśabdaḥ| prabhavatiśabdasya prathamata upalabhyata ityarthaḥ| prabhavati ca vālavāye parvate| tasmādyataḥ prabhavati tadvācī vālavāyaśabdaḥ prakṛtitvenākṣipyate| yathā viśravaṇaravaṇā ityādeśāveva śivādiṣu paṭhyete| apatyādhikārāttu yena tayorapatyāpatyavatsasambandhaḥ sa eva prakṛtitvenākṣipyate viśravasśabdaḥ| viśravaso'patyaṃ vaiśravaṇaḥ, rāvaṇaḥ| atha vā prakṛtyantarameva vidūraśabdo vālavāye varttate| vidūrāt bhavati vālavāyāt parvatāt prabhavatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ sthite yo brūyāt-- naiva tatra vālavāye prasiddho vidūraśabda iti,taṃ pratyāha-- `jitvarīvadūpācaret' iti| yathā vaṇija eva vāsāṇasī nagarīṃ `jitvarī' ityuccārayanti maṅgalārtham, na lokāḥ, evaṃ vaiyākaraṇā eva vālavāyaṃ vidūramityuccārayanti| niyatadeśapuruṣaviṣayā api rūḍhayo bhavantītyetajjitvarīvadityanena kathayati|| 85. tadgacchati pathadūtayoḥ| (4.3.85) patho niṣkriyatvādgameḥ karttatvaṃ nopapadyata ityāha-- `tatstheṣu' ityādi| puruṣavṛttirgamanaṃ pathyupacaryata iti darśayati| `atha vā' ityādi| prāptāvatra gamirvarttate | asti ca pratyakṣagamyaiva srughnādīnāṃ patho'syaivānantaryalakṣaṇā prāptiḥ|| 86. abhiniṣkramati dvāram| (4.3.86) kathaṃ punaḥ karaṇatvena prasiddhaṃ dvāraṃ svātantreṇaiva vivakṣyate ?ityāha-- `yathā' ityādi| yathā cchedanakriyāyāmasiḥ karaṇatvena prasiddhau'pi svātantryeṇa vivakṣyate|nanu cetanāvato'bhiniṣkramaṇaṃ bhavati, cetanāvatā prayuktasya vā-- devadatto'bhiniṣkrāmatīti, na ca dvāraṃ cetanāvatā prayuktam, tasmānnopapadyate tasyābhiniṣkramaṇam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; acetaneṣvapyabhiniṣkrāmatīti vyavahāro dṛśyate, tadyathā anena guhāmukhena vāyurabhiniṣkrāmatīti| niṣkrīyatvāt tarhi nopapadyate ? tatstheṣu niṣkrāmatsu dvāramabhiniṣkramatītyupacaryata ityadoṣaḥ|| 87. adhikṛtya kṛte granthe| (4.3.87) nanu `kṛte' iti karmaṇi niṣṭhā, tataśca tayā'bhihitatvāt karmaṇo dvitīyā na prāpnoti ? ityāha-- `adhikṛtyetyetapekṣayā dvitīyā' iti| lyabantena yā kriyā'bhidhīyate tadapekṣayā dvitīyā, na ca tasyā yatkarma tatkenacidabhihitam| niṣṭhayā hi granthātmakameva karmābhihitam, na tu lyabantakriyāyā yatkarma subhadrādikaṃ tadapi| girimittramadhikṛtya kṛto `gairimittraḥ'| yayātimadhikṛtya `yāyātaḥ' | `lup' ityādi| ākhyāyikāyai iti tādarthye caturthī| ākhyāyikārthamākhyāyikāmabhidhātuṃ pratyayasya lugbhavatītyarthaḥ|| 88. śiśukrandayamasabhadvandvendrajananādibhyaśchaḥ| (4.3.88) `yamasabham' iti| `sabhārājā' (2.4.23) ityādinā nupaṃsakaliṅgatā| yadīndrajananādāveva śiśukrandādayo draṣṭavyāḥ,tatkimarthaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam ? ityata āha-- `prapañcārtham' ityādi| `evañca sati' ityādi| caśabdo hetau| yasmādindrajananāderākṛtigaṇasya tadantarbhūtānāmeva śiśukrandādīnāṃ prapañcārthaṃ grahaṇam; tasmādevamartha'smin sthite devāsurādīnāṃ pratiṣedho na vaktavyaḥ, prāptyabhāvāt| yebhya eva cchapratyayo'yaṃ dṛśyate, ta evendrajananādayaḥ, na ca devāsurādibhyo dṛśyate|| 89. so'sye nivāsaḥ| (4.3.89) 90. abhijanaśca| (4.3.90) `tatsambandhāddeśo'pyabhijana ucyate' iti| yathā yaṣṭīḥ pravedaśayeti yaṣṭisambandhādyaṣṭiśabdaḥ puruṣe varttate, tathā'bhijanaśabdo deśe varttate| kaḥ punarasau yo'bhijanasambandhādabhijana ucyate ? ityata āha-- `yasmin' ityādi| `iha deśavācinaḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ punarmukhye'bhijane gauṇāt pratyayo bhavati ? ityāha-- `nivāsapratyāsatteḥ' iti| nivāso (4.3.89)'nukṛṣyate tenābhijano viśeṣyate nivāso yo'bhijana iti| tasmāddeśavācina eva pratyayo bhavati, na bandhubhyaḥ ; teṣāmanivasatvāt| nivāsābhijanayoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ ? nāstyeva kaścidviśeṣaḥ, abhijanasya nivāsabhūtatvāditi manyate| `yatra' ityādi| viśeṣaṃ darśayati| `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttareṣu yogeṣvabhijanapratyayā yathā syuḥ, nivāse mā bhūvanniti|| 91. āyudhajīvibhyaśchaḥ parvate| (4.3.91) `āyudhajīvibhyaḥ' iti| tādabhya caturthīti pañcamīṃ nirākaroti| yadi hyeṣāṃ pañcamī syāt, āyudhajīvibhya eva parvate'bhidheye cho bhavatītyeṣa sūtrārthaḥ syāt, na ceṣyate; tasmāt evaiṣā caturthī, na pañcamīti| `sāṅkāśyakāḥ' iti| `dhanvayopadhād‌vañ' (4.2.121)|| 92. śaṇḍikādibhyo ñyaḥ| (4.3.92) `aṇāderapavādaḥ' iti| ādiśabdena chādeḥ| atra ye śaṇḍikādīn parvātanācakṣate teṣāṃ matena pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasya chasyāpavādaḥ| ye tu janapadaśabdāḥ, teṣāṃ `avṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt' (4.2.125) iti prāptasya vuñaḥ| śaṇḍikaśabdāt `kopadhādaṇ' (4.2.132) iti prāptasyāṇaḥ|| 93. sindhutakṣasilādibhyo'ṇañau| (4.3.93) `prabhṛtayaḥ' iti| prabhṛtiśabdena madhu, vasanta, kamboja, sālva,kaśmīra-- ityete gṛhyante| {gandhāra iti mu.pāṭhaḥ gandhāri iti prācīnamudrita pāṭhaḥ|}kiṣkindhā, `{nāsti gaṇa pāṭhe}sāradi, `{urasa kāśikā}uras, darat-- ityeteṣām `avṛddhādapi' (4.2.125) ityādinā vuñi prāpte vacanam| takṣaśilādiṣvapi kaumedura, kāṇ‍ḍavāraṇa, grāmaṇī-- ityeteṣāṃ `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti che prāpte| śeṣāṇāṃ `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityaṇi|| 94. tūdīśalāturavarmatīkūcavārāḍḍhakchaṇḍhañyakaḥ| (4.3.94) 95. bhaktiḥ| (4.3.95) `bhajyate sevyata iti bhaktiḥ' iti| `bhaja sevāyām' (dhā.pā.998) ityetasmāt karmasādhanaḥ ktin|| 96. acittādadeśakālāṭṭhak| (4.3.96) nanu ca deśakālayoracittayoḥ pratiṣedhānnañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) prakṛticetanaiva vijñāsyate, tatkimacittagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; vinā hi tenādeśakālāditi na jñāyate-- kimayaṃ prakṛtinirdeśaḥ, uta deśakālayoḥ pratiṣedha iti ? tatrāniṣṭamapi vijñāyate-- adeśaśabdāt , kālaśabdācceti| acittagrahaṇe tu sati tenātiprasaṅge satyadeśakālāditi pratiṣedho vijñāyate| asmādeva ca pratiṣedhādacittāditi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati| svarūpagrahaṇe hi deśakālābhyāṃ prasaṅgo pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryāt|| 97. mahārājaṭṭhañ| (4.3.97) nanu ca pūrvasūtrādeva ṭhaganuvartiṣyate, tenāpi hi mahāṃrājika iti sidhyatyeva, tatkathaṃ ṭhañ pratyayāntaraṃ kriyate ? ityāha-- `pratyayayāntarakaraṇam' ityādi| ñitsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi pratyayāntarakaraṇam| ṭhaki hi sati taddhitasya `kitaḥ' (6.1.165) ityantodāttatvaṃ syāt|| 98. vāsudevārjunābhyāṃ vun| (4.3.98) vāsudevaśabdād‌vṛddhācchasyāpavādaḥ| arjunaśabdādautsargikasyāṇaḥ| nanu cārjunaśabda kṣattriyākhyaḥ,tasmāduttarasūtreṇa prāptasya vuño'pavādo yuktaḥ ? evaṃ manyate-- bahulagrahaṇaṃ tatra kriyate, tenārjunaśabdād‌nuñpratyayasya prāptireva nāsti, tasmādasmādaṇeva syāt, atastadapavādo nyāyyaḥ| `nanu ca' ityādi codyam| syādetat-- vuñvunorviśeṣo'sti, ato vāsudevaśabdād‌vun vidhīyate ? ityāha-- `na cātra' ityādi| vāsudevaśabdasya ca vuñi vuni vā sati nāsti kaścidviśeṣa iti | tathā hyubhayatra tadevarūpam, sa eva svaraḥ| yo'pi vuñi sati puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ `vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre' (6.3.39) iti,sa vunyapi labhyata eva `na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) iti| `saṃjñeṣaḥ' ityādinā, yaduktam-- `nanu ca vāsudevaśabdād‌gotrakṣatriyākhyebhyaḥ' (4.3.99) iti vuñastyeva' iti, tannirākaroti| gotrakṣattriyākhyebhyo vuñ vidhīyate| na ca vāsudevaśabdo gotrākhyaṃ prātipadikam, nāpi kṣattriyākhyam, tatkuto ityanena `alpāctaram' (2.2.34) ityanena vārjuśabdasya pūrvanipātamakurvataitadvijñāpitam--abhyarhitaṃ pūrvaṃ nipatati| tena mātāpitarau, śraddhamedhe, dīkṣātapasī-- ityatra śāstrādevābhyārhitasya pūrvanipātaḥ siddho bhavati| abhyarhitatvaṃ tu vāsudevaśabdasya devatāviśeṣatvāt|| 99. gotrakṣattriyākhyebhyo bahulaṃ vuñ| (4.3.99) `glaucukāyanakaḥ| mlaucukāyanakaḥ' iti| glucukamlucukaśabdābhyāṃ `prācāvṛddhāt phin' (4.1.160)tadantād‌vuñ| ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? na gotrakṣattriyebhya ityevocyeta ? ityata āha-- `ākhyāgrahaṇam' ityādi| yadyākhyāgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tato ye'pi yathākathañcit kṣattriye vartante tebhyo'pi syāt, neṣyate; tasmāt prasiddhakṣattriyapiragrahārthamākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tenaha na bhavati-- vidvān kṣattriyo bhaktirasyeti| na vidvacchabdaḥ kṣattriyaśabda iti prasiddhaḥ| kṣattriyaśabdasya tu sāmānādhikaraṇyāt kṣattriye vṛttirgamyate| `pāṇinīyaḥ' iti| pāṇino'patyamityaṇ; `gāthividatha' (6.4.165) ityādinā prakṛtibhāvaḥ, pāṇino bhaktirasyeti `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) `pāṇinīyaḥ'| pauravo bhaktirasyeti `pauravīyaḥ' || 100. janapadināṃ janaṣadavatsarvaṃ janapadena samānaśabdānāṃ bahuvacane| (4.3.100) `{nāsti--kāśikā}ekaśabdāḥ' iti| etena samānaśabdo'yamekavācīti darśayati| `pratyayaḥ prakṛtiśca' iti| sarvaśabdena yo'rtha upāttastamācaṣṭe| `tadvat aṅgā kṣattriyā bhaktirasya' iti| aṅgādibhyaḥ kṣattriyebhyo bahuṣvapatyeṣu `dvyañmagadha' (4.1.170) ityādinā vihitasyāṇaḥ `tadrājasya' (2.4.62) ityādinā luk kriyate| bahuvacane'ṅgadayo janapadino janapadena samānaśabdā bhavanti| atra janapadavṛttibhyo'ṅgādibhyo yathā `so'sya bhaktiḥ' (4.3.95) ityetasmin viṣaye `janapadatadavadhyośca' (4.2.124) iti vuñ bhavati, tathā janapadavṛttibhyo'pi --`pañcālā brāhmaṇāḥ'iti| yadā pañcālanivāsiṣu sāhacaryāt pañcālādiśabdo varttate, tadā bhavanti brāhmaṇā janapadena bahuvacane samānaśabdāḥ, na tu te janapadinaḥ| tenātideśābhāvādaṇeva bhavati-- `pāñcālaḥ'| `sarvagrahaṇam' ityādi| yadi sarvagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā pratyayasya vidhīyamānatayā prādhānyāt pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt tasyaivātideśaḥ syāt, na prakṛteḥ| tasmādyathā prakṛterapyatideśo bhavati tadarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| `sa ca' ityādi| sa ca prakṛtyatideśaḥ sarvagarhaṇaṃ dvyekayoreva prayojayati, na bahuṣu| janapadaśabdo nātra vṛddhaḥ, tasmādavṛddho janapadaśabdo dṛśyate| bahuvacane tu `tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām' (2.4.62) iti luki kṛte vināpyatideśenāvṛddhaḥ, ata eva bhavatīti tatra prakṛtyatideśo'narthakaḥ| tato netadarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| `vṛddhinimitteṣu' ityādi| vṛddhinimitteṣu vuñādiṣvādiṣṭāyāmavṛddhāyāṃ prakṛtau punarvṛddhibhāvāt| `prakṛtinirhrāsekṛte' iti sarvagrahaṇātprakṛtyadeśena nirhāsaḥ| nirhrāso'lpatayā'pakṣaya ityarthaḥ| `mādraḥ' iti| etāñca prakṛtimapekṣya madra ityeṣā prakṛtiralpā bhavati| `vārjyaḥra' ityetāñca vṛjiriti| nanu vateḥ sarvasādṛśasyārthatvanādvatinirdeśenaiva prakṛteratideśo bhaviṣyatīti, tatkiṃ sarvagrahaṇena ? naitadasti; yataiva tatra sarvasādṛśyārthe vatau na pratyārtho devatārthe'tidiśyate, tathehāpi janapadarūpaṃ janapadini nātidiśyate| kasmāt punastatra pratyayārtho nātidiśyate ? vatinā tayorbhedasya pratipāditatvāt| vatirhi sādṛśye ridhīyate, sādṛsyaṃ ca bhedāśrayam; yadi bhavārthasyāpi devatārthatayā vipariṇāmaḥ syāt, tadā vatireva na syāt| tasmādanyasya kāryasya sādṛsyaṃ vatirācaṣṭe, pratyayārthayostu bhedam, ihāpi ca janapadajanapadinorbhedamācaṣṭa iti| asati sarvagrahaṇe janapadarūpaṃ janapadarūpaṃ janapadini na labhyate| tasmāt sarvagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| `bahulagrahaṇam' ityādi| samānaśabdatāyā viṣayapradarśanaṃ lakṣaṇam| tadarthaṃ bahuvacanagrahaṇam| `anyathā hi' ityādi| bahuvacanagrahaṇaṃ na kriyetetyarthaḥ| `tatraiva' iti| bahuvacane| bahuvacana eva tadrājapratyayasya luki kṛte samānaśabdatā bhavati, yataśca tatraivātideśaḥ syāt| `ekavacanadvivacanayorna syāt' iti| tatra samānaśabdatayā abhāvāt| `bahuvacane tu' itādi| bahuvacanagrahaṇe tu sati bahuvacane ye janapadena samānaśabdāsteṣāṃ yatra vā tatra vātideśe vijñāyamāne dvyekayorapyasau siddho bhavati|| 101. tena proktam| (4.3.101) `prakarṣeṇoktam' iti| prakarṣaḥ - atiśayaḥ,tena vyākhyātaṃ tadadhyāpitaṃ vā `proktam' ityucyate| `na tu kṛtam' iti| na tu kṛtamutpāditaṃ proṣatamityucyate| kasmādityāha-- `kṛte granthe' (4.3.116) iti gatārthatvāt| kathaṃ māthurītyaṇ, yāvatā vṛdhācchenaiva bhavitavyam ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `kalāpino'ṇ' (4.3.108) ityatrāṇgrahaṇasyānyebhyo bhavatītyetat prayojanaṃ vakṣyati, tena māthuraśabdādapyaṇbhavati| `pāṇinīyam' iti| pāṇiśabdāt `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti cchaḥ| `āpiśalam,kālakṛtsnam' iti| āpiśalikāśakṛtsniśabdābhyāṃ `iñaśca' (4.2.112) ityaṇ|| 102. tittirivaratantukhaṇḍikokhācchaṇaḥ| (4.3.102) `taittirīyāḥ' iti| chaṇpratyayaḥ, tebhyaḥ `tadadhīte' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya `proktālluk' (4.2.64) iti luk| `chandobrāhmaṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi' (4.2.66 iti tadviṣayatā| `chandasi' ityādi| kathaṃ punaścachandasi labhyate ? na hi cchandograhaṇamastītyāha-- `śaunakādibhyaḥ' ityādi|| 103. kāśyapakauśikābhyāmṛṣibhyāṃ ṇiniḥ| (4.3.103) `ṇakāra uttaratra vṛddhyarthaḥ' iti| uttareṣu yogeṣu vṛddhiryathā syāt| iha hi ṇakārasya prayojanaṃ nāsti, tasya hi vṛddhireva prayojanam| kāśyapakauśikaśabdau vṛddhimantau| `tasyāpi ca' ityādi| nanu ca cchandobrāhmaṇādīnāṃ tadviṣayatā yuktā, tatkathaṃ kalpasyāpi sā bhavati ? ityāha-- `śaunakādibhyaḥ' ityādi| syādetat-- yadyapīdaṃ na siddhyatyeva| na hi śaunakādibhyaśchandasi' (4.3.106) ityatrānuvarttate, tathāpi chandobrāhmaṇādīnāṃ tadviṣayatocyamānā kalpasya na sidhyatyeva| nahi śaunakādisūtrā (4.3.106) nuvṛttau satyāmasya yogasay kalpaśchandobhāvaṃ brāhmaṇabhāvamāpadyata ityāha-- `chando'dhikāravihitānañca' ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇā'pi chando'dhikāravihitānāṃ svaryate| tena `śaunakādibhyaśchandasi' (4.3.106) itīdamprakṛtayo vihitāḥ proktapratyayāḥ, teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva kalpādāvapi tadviṣayatā bhavati| atha guṇakalpanayā kalpādīnāmapi chandastvaṃ vivakṣyate| nanuca `chandobrāhmaṇāni ca' (4.2.66) ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt tenaiva prāgeva kalpādestadviṣayatā pratipāditā, tatkimarthaṃ punaranena prakāreṇa pratipādyate| tatra vā kalpādestadviṣayatāpratipādanārthaścakāraḥ karttavyaḥ, ayaṃ vā prakāra āśrayitavya iti vikalpapradarśanārtham| `idānīntanena' ityādi| idānīntano yaḥ kāśyapaḥ sa kāśyapagotraprabhavatvāt kāśyapa ityucyate, tathedānīntano yaḥ kauśikaḥ sa kauśikagotraprabhavatvāt kauśika ityucyate; tatra yadi ṛṣigrahaṇaṃ ṛṣiśabdādeva, tathā hi pravarādhyāye ye paṭhyante ta ṛṣaya iti, imāvapi tatra paṭhyete eva ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādayamṛṣiśabdaḥ kriyāśabdo vijñāyate-- ṛṣirdarśanāditi| tena yāvananyapuruṣasādhāraṇenaupadeśikena darśanena tadvnatau kāśyapakauśikaśabdau tata idaṃ pratyayavidhānam; na cedānīntanau kāśyapakauśikaśabdāvevaṃvidhau, tābhyāṃ cha eva bhavati|| 104.kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaśca| (4.3.104) abhidhāne'bhiyopacārāt kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsyabhidhāyinaḥ śabdā iha kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsiśabdena nirdiṣṭāḥ| ata evāha-- `kalāpyantevāsinām' iti| nanu ca ye vyavahitāḥ śiṣyaśiṣyāḥ, te kalāpivaiśampāyanāntevāsina eva bhavanti, tadayuktamuktam-- kalāpyantevāsinaścatvāraḥ,vaiśampāyanāntevāsino nava ? ityāha-- `pratyakṣakāriṇaḥra' ityādi| karotiratrādhyayane varttate| yaiḥ sākṣādadhītaṃ te pratyakṣakāriṇaḥ| ihāntevāsino gṛhyante caitāvanta eveti| kimatrāyuktam ? kuta iha sākṣātkāriṇo gṛhyante, na hi vyavahitā ityatra hetuṃ pṛcchati| `kalāpikhāṇḍāyanagrahaṇāt' iti| hetunirdeśaḥ| `{tathā hi--kāśikā}tathā ca' ityādi| asyaiva vivaraṇam| vaiśampāyanasay kalāpyantevāsī, tasya ye'ntevāsinaste vaiśampāyanāntevāsino bhavantyeva| yadi tatra ye vyavahitāste'pyantevāsino gṛhyeran kalāpigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, `vaiśampāyanāntevāsibhyaḥ' ityevaṃ brūyāt| tathā vaiśampāyanāntevāsī khāṇḍāyanaḥ;tatra yadi vyavahitā apigṛhyeran, tato vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvādanenaiva sūtreṇa siddhe śaunakādiṣu khāṇḍāyanaśabdasya pāṭho niṣphala eva syāt| tasmādihāpi kalāpigrahaṇaṃ śaunakādiṣu khāṇḍāyanaśabdasya pāṭha etadubhayamapi sākṣātkārigrahaṇasya liṅgaṃ jñāpakam| `hāridraviṇaḥ' ityādi| haridruprabhṛtibhyaḥ proktārthe ṇiniḥ,tadantāt `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya `proktālluk' `ulapena caturthena' iti| sahārthe tṛtīyā| `kālāpakam' iti| kalāpina idaṃ kālāpakam, `gotracaraṇād vuñ' (4.3.126)| nanu ca `dharmāmnāyayorvuñ' (vā.476), na ceme śivyā dharmāmnāyāḥ,tatkathaṃ vuñ ? evaṃ tarhyupamānādbhaviṣyatīti| kālāpakamiva dharmavacchiṣyā ucyante| yathā dharmaḥ kalāpisambandhī, tathā śiṣyā ityucyata upamānārthaḥ| `ālambirnāma prācāṃ deśaḥ, tatrotpannaḥ `carakaḥ'| evaṃ `palaṅgakamalāvubhau' | prācāmevatrayaḥ| ete prācyāḥ vaiśampāyanaśiṣyāḥ `ṛcābhāruṇitāṇḍyāśca madhyamīyāstrayo'pera' carakāḥ| madhyadeśe bhavā madhyamīyāḥ| gahādiṣu `madhyamadhyamañcāṇ caraṇe' (ga.sū.99) iti paṭhyate. tasyāyamarthaḥ-- madhyaśabdo madhyamabhāvamāpadyate, chapratyayaśca tato bhavati, caraṇe tu pratyayārthe'ṇ ca bhavatīti| tatra yadā ṛcābhādīnāṃ caraṇatvaṃ na vivakṣyate,tadā che kṛte madhyamīyā iti bhavati| caraṇavivakṣāyāṃ tvaṇi kṛte mādhyamā iti bhavati| udakṣu bhavā udīcyāḥ, `dyuprāgapāg' (4.2.101) ityādinā yat| udīcyeṣu madhye śyāmāyaniścarakaḥ|kaṭhakalāpināvapyudīcyeṣu carakau, aparasyāpyuktam-- `kalāpino'ṇ' (4.3.108) iti| nanu ca vaiśampāyanāntevāsināṃ kaṭhenaiva caraka ityeṣākhyā, tatkathaṃ caraka ityucyata ? ityāha-- `caraka iti vaiśampāyanasya' ityādi| yadyapi teṣāṃ caraka ityākhyānaṃ na bhavati, tadgurostu vaiśampāyanasya bhavati, tatsambandhena tacchiṣyā api tathocyante|| 105. purāṇaprokteṣu brāhmaṇakalpeṣu| (4.3.105) `bhāllavinaḥ'iti| bhāllavaḥ, śāṭyāyanaḥ,aitareya-- ityetebhyaḥ proktārthe ṇiniḥ| tadantāt `tadadhīte' (4.2.59) ityutpannasya `poktālluk' (4.2.64) `chandobrāhamaṇāni' (4.2.66) ityādinā tadviṣayatā| `paiṅgī' iti| `āruṇaparājī' iti| piṅgāruṇaparājaśabdābhyāṃ ṇiniḥ| `yājñavalkāni' iti| `āśmarathaḥ' iti| yājñavalkyaśvaravyaśabdābhyāṃ gargādiyañantābhyāṃ `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.59) ityutpannasya, `āpatyasya' (6.4.151) ityādinā yalopaḥ| nanu yājñavalkādīnyapi purāṇaproktānyeva brāhmaṇāni, brāhmaṇāntaraiḥ purāṇaproktestulyatvāt ? ityāha-- `yājñavalkya' ityādi| ākhyāneṣu hyeṣā vārttā -- yājñavalkyādayo'parakālāḥ pravaktāro'nyebhyaḥ pravaktṛbhyaḥ| tathā ca vastutvamanapekṣya vyavaharati sūtrakāra ityadoṣaḥ| `tadviṣayatā kasmānna bhavati' (iti)| `chandobrāhmaṇāni' (4.2.66) ityādineti bhāvaḥ| `pratipadam' ityādi| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) hi pratipadaṃ viśeṣaṇam| brāhmaṇamuccārya brāhmaṇeṣu yaḥ pratyayo vihitastasya tadviṣayatā vidhīyate| tasmāt tadviṣayatāsya na bhavati| kalpeṣu tarhi kasmānna bhavati; yathā-- kāśyapena proktaṃ kalpamadhīyate kāśyapina ityatra ? `na cāyam' ityādi| chando'dhikāre ye yogastadvihitasya pratyayasya tadviṣayatā bhavati, na cāyaṃ yogaśchando'dhikāramanuvarttate;tenaitadvihitasya pratyayasyādhyetṛveditṛviṣayatā kalpeṣu na bhavati-- paiṅgī kalpaḥ, āruṇaparājī kalda iti| purāṇa iti ko'yaṃ śabdaḥ, yāvatā `sāṃyaciram' (4.3.23) ityādinā ṭyuṭyuloḥ sanniyogena tuṭi kṛte purātanamiti bhavitavyam ? ityata āha-- `purāṇa iti nipātanāt tuḍabhāvaḥ (iti)| yadyevam, na bhavati purātanam ? ityāha-- `{na vā kāśikā}na ca' ityādi. nanu `bādhakānyapi nipātanāni' (vī.pa.vṛ.109) ityato bhavitavyameva vācakeneti ? avācakānyapi (nī.pa.vṛ.110)| abādhakānyapi bhavanti, etacca `śaderagatau taḥ' (7.3.42) ityatra pratipāditam|| 106. śaunakādibhyaśchandasi| (4.3.106) `chāṇorapavādaḥ' iti| ye vṛddhāstebhyaśchasyāpavādaḥ, śeṣebhyastvaṇaḥ| `śaunakinaḥ| vājasaneyinaḥ' iti| śaunakena proktaṃ vājasaneyena proktamiti ṇiniḥ| tadantāt (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya `proktālluk' (4.2.64), pūrvavat tadviṣayatā| `kevalāddhi' ityādi| tat saṃhatārthamityatrāyaṃ hetuḥ| yasmāt kevalāt kaṭhāllakaṃ vakṣyati, tasmāt kaṭhaśāṭha iti yadatra paṭhyate tatsaṃhatārtham|| 107. kaṭhacarakālluk| (4.3.107) `kaṭhāḥ, carakāḥ' iti| proktapratyayasya luki kṛte yo hyadhyetaryaṇ bhavati tasyāpi proktālluk (4.2.64)| pūrvavat tadviṣayatā|| 108. kalāpino'ṇ| (4.3.108) `kālāpāḥ'iti| pūrvavat proktapratyayāntādadhyetaryutpannasyāṇo luk, tadviṣayatā ca| `atha' ityādi| nanu cāsatyaṇgrahaṇe yathā prāpte vidhīyamāne ṇinerevāpavādaḥ syāt ? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| tasmādyo vihito na ca prāpnotyanena kabādhitatvāt sa eva bhaviṣyati, sa cāṇeva| `evamādi' iti| ādiśabdena maudāḥ,paippalādāḥ, śākalāḥ, jājalāḥ-- ityeteṣāṃ grahaṇam| asata, tvacgrahaṇe sarvameva na sidhyet; `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti chenāṇa autsargikasya bādhitatvāt|| 109.chagalino ḍhinuk| (4.3.109) `chāgaleyinaḥ' iti| ihāpi pūrvavadevādhyetaryutpannasyāṇo luk ca tadviṣayatā | evamuttarayoryogayorveditavyaḥ|| 110. pārāśaryaśilālibhyāṃ bhikṣunaṭasūtrayoḥ| (4.3.110) `yathāsaṃkhyam' ityādi| pārāśaryādbhikṣusūtre pratyayaḥ śilālino naṭasūtre| `tadviṣayatā cātreṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇāpi sā labhyate ? ityāha-- `tadartham' ityādi| nanu cānuvarttamānacchandohaṇenaiva tadviṣayatā prāpnoti ? na; bhikṣuvanaṭasūtirayoracchandasatvādityāha-- `guṇakalpanayā ca' ityādi| chandasastūpacāranimittaṃ yo dharmaḥ sa iha guṇo'bhipretaḥ, taddhetukā kalpanā| yathā chando yadarthamadhīyate tathā sūtramapi taddhetuṃ sampādayati| bhikṣunaṭayorityevamādikayā guṇakalpanayā bhikṣunaṭasūtrayośchandastvamaupacārikam| `pārāśariṇaḥ' iti| pārāśaryaśabido gargādiṣu vañantaḥ, `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) iti yalopaḥ| `śailālinaḥ' iti| `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ| `pārāśaram' iti| `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) ityaṇ| `śailālam' iti| autsargiko'ṇ, `nāntasya ṭilope sabahrahmacāripīṭha' (vā.798) ityādinā ṭilopaḥ|| 111. karmandakṛśāśvādiniḥ| (4.3.111) 112. tenaikadik| (4.3.112) `tena'iti| `tulyārthairatulopamābhyām' (2.3.72) iti tṛtīyā| `saudāmanī' iti| `an' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāvāṭṭilopādyabhāvaḥ| nanu ca teneti prakṛtameva,tatkimarthaṃ punariha tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktirupādīyate ? ityāha-- `teneti prakṛte' ityādi| pūrvatra hi teneti chando'dhikārasambaddham, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt| tasmācchando'dhikāranivṛttayepunariha tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktirupādīyate| kimarthaḥ punaśchando'dhikāraḥ pūrvatra kriyate ? ityāha-- `pūrvatra' ityādi| pūrveṣu yogeṣu cchando'dhikārāt tadviṣayatā sādhyate| tasmāt tatra cchando'dhikāraḥ karttavyaḥ| tasmiṃstu kriyamāṇe tannivṛttyarthaṃ iha ca yatna āstheyaḥ chandasyeva pratyayaḥ syāt|| 113. tasiśca| (4.3.113) 114. uraso yacca| (4.3.114) 115. upajñāte| (4.3.115) `akālakam' iti| kālaparibhāṣārahitamityarthaḥ|| 116. kṛte granthe| (4.3.116) kaḥ punaḥ kṛtopajñayorviśeṣaḥ, yenopajñāyata iti prakṛte sati kṛtagrahaṇaṃ kriyate ? ityāh-- `utpāditam' ityādi|| 117. saṃjñāyām| (4.3.117) 118. kulālādibhyo vuñ| (4.3.118) 119. kṣudrābhramaravaṭarapādapādañ| (4.3.119) `svare viśeṣaḥ' iti| aṇi hi pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ syāt| añi tu sati ñitsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 120. tasyedam| (4.3.120) `tasya' iti| puṃlliṅgenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ, puṃsyeva syāt, na dvivacanabahuvacanāntāt; pratyakṣavācinaśca syāt; nāpi viśeṣavācinaḥ; tacchabdasya parokṣavastumātravācitvāt| pratyayārtho'pīdamityekavacanena napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdiṣṭa ityekasminnarthe syāt-- napuṃsaka eva,nānyatra; parokṣe na syāt; idamaḥ pratyakṣavācitvāt ? ityetat‌ sarvamāśaṅkyāha--`prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ' ityādi| prakṛtau ṣaṣṭhyarthamātraṃ vivakṣitam| pratyayārthe'pi ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhimātram, yena vinā ṣaṣṭhyartho na sampadyate| `yadaparam' ityādinā mātraśabdena yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayati| ādiśabdena sāmānyabhidhāyitvaṃ gṛhyate| asya tu sarvatra vivakṣākāraṇam `tasyāpatyam' (4.1.92) ityatraivaktam| atheha kasmānna bhavati-- devadattasyānantaram, devadattasya samīpatyādi ? `anantarādiṣu' ityādi| `anabhidhānāt' iti| pratyayāntenānantarādīnāmapratyāyanamit‌yarthaḥ| `saṃvahestuḥ'iti| vahestrantādityarthaḥ| `sāṃvāhitram' iti| sampūrvādvahesturiṭ ca, yaṇādeśaḥ| `siddha evātrāṇ' iti| `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityanena| yadyevaṃ kimarthamupasaṃkhyānam ? ityāha-- `iḍartham' ityādi| upasaṃkhyāne hyasatīḍāgamo na syāt, `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt' (7.2.10) itīṭpratiṣedhāt| `agnīghaḥ' ityādi| agnīgha ityetasmāccharaṇe gṛhe vācye raṇ vaktavyaḥ, bhasaṃjñā ca vaktavyā, bhasaṃjñāyāñca satyāṃ padasaṃjñābhāvājjaśatvaṃ na bhavati| `samidhām' ityādi| ādhīyante yena mantraviśeṣeṇa samidhastasmin sanidhāmādhānaviśeṣe samicchabdāt vaṇyaṇ pratyayo vaktavyaḥ - vyākhyeyaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu --`havirnivāsasāmidhenīṣu' (3.1.129) ityetannirdeśamāśritya vaktavyam| `sāmidhenī' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ, `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) iti yalopaḥ|| 121. rathādyat| (4.3.121) `nānyatra' iti| sannāhādau|| 122. pattrapūrvādañ| (4.3.122) 123. pattrādhvaryupariṣadaśca| (4.3.123) `patrādvāhye' (vā.474) ityavadhāraṇamatra draṣṭavyam-- pattrādvāhya eveti| anyatra kasmānna bhavata ? anabhidhānāt| atha kimarthaṃ na pūrveṇa sahaikayoga eva kriyate-- `pattrapūrvapatrādhvaryupariṣado'ñ' iti ? naivaṃ śakyam; evaṃ hi pūrvapattrapūrvāt prātipadikādanyato'pi prasajyeta| yogavibhāge pūrvasmin yoge rathādityanuvṛtte ratha eva pattrapūrvagrahaṇena viśeṣyata iti na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ| ekayoge tu rathādyanuvṛttau satyāṃ yathā pattrapūrvatayā ratho viśeṣyate, tathā pattrādibhirapi ratha eva niśeṣyate ityaniṣṭaṃ syāt| tasmādyogavibhāga eva nyāyyaḥ|| 124. halasīrāṭṭhak| (4.3.124) 125. dvandvād‌vun vairamaithunikayoḥ| (4.3.125) `bābhraṇyaśālaṅkāyanikā' iti| vunnantaḥ svabhāvādeva striyāṃ varttata iti ṭāp , `pratyayasthāt' (7.3.44) ityādinettvam|| 126. gotracaraṇād‌vuñ| (4.3.126) vuni prakṛte vuñvidhānaṃ vṛddhyartham| taccāvṛddhā eva gotracaraṇaśabdāḥ prayojayanti, na vṛddhāḥ| teṣu hi vuñi vuni vā sati na kaścidviśeṣaḥ| `glaucukāyanakaḥ' iti| `prācāmavṛddhāt phin bahulam' (4.1.160) iti phin, tadantād‌vuñ| `caraṇāt' ityādi| caraṇāddharmāmnāyayoreveṣyate, nānyatra; anabhidhānāditi|| 127. saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇeṣvañyañiñāmaṇ| (4.3.127) tena vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| asati tu ghoṣagrahaṇe, añādayastrayaḥ saṅghādayo'pi tatra iti samānādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ syāt ? ghoṣe ca pratyayo na syāt| `baidaḥ' iti| `anṛṣa' (4.1.104) ityādināñ; tadantādaṇ| aṅkalakṣamayoḥ ko viśeṣa iti? nāstyeva kaścidviśeṣaḥ| paryāyatvādaṅkalakṣamayoriti manyate| `lakṣaṇam' ityādinā viśeṣaṃ darśayati| lakṣaṇaṃ cihnaṃ lakṣyasyaiva svam, nānyasya; yathā vidyā bidānām| bidānāmeva hi lakṣaṇānāṃ sambandhinām nānyasya kasyacit| aṅkastu gavādistho na gavādīnāṃ sambhavati| kiṃ tarhi ? tato'nyeṣām, gavādisvāminām| atha kimarthaṃ gitkaraṇaṃ pratyayasya, yāvatāñantādyañantāḥ prakṛtayo vṛddhā eva ? ata āha-- `ṇitkaraṇam' ityādi| baidī vidyetyatra ṅīb yathā syāt| iha ca baidīvidya ityatra `vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre' (6.3.39) iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho yathā syāt| evamarthaṃ ṇitkaraṇam,na vṛddhyartham|| 128. śākalādvā| (4.3.128) `vuño'pavādaḥ' iti| caraṇalakṣamasya śākalaśabdasya caraṇalakṣaṇatvāt| `śākalāḥ' iti| śākalyaśabdādgargādiyañantāt `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) iti proktārthe' ṇ| `āpatyasya ca taddhitenāti' (6.4.151) iti yalopaḥ| śākala iti sthite `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.59) ityaṇ, tasya proktālluk (4.2.64)--śākalāḥ, teṣāṃ saṅghaḥ śākalaḥ, śākalaka iti vā|| 129. chandogaukthikayājñikabah‌vṛcanaṭāññyaḥ| (4.3.129) `vuñaṇorapavādaḥ' iti| chandogādibhyaścaraṇalaṇasya vuño'pavādaḥ| naṭādautsargikasyāṇaḥ|| 130. na daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu| (4.3.130) `daṇḍapradhānā māṇavā daṇḍamāṇavāḥ' iti| madyamapadalopisamāsaṃ darśayati| sa punarmayūkhyaṃsakāditvādvetivyaḥ| mayūravyaṃsakāderākṛtigaṇatvāt| `vuñpratyayo na bhavati' iti| etena vuño'yaṃ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| kathaṃ punarjñāyate vuño'yaṃ pratiṣedha ? ityāha-- `gotragrahaṇam' ityādi| iha hi gotragrahaṇamanuvarttate `gotracaraṇād‌vuñ' (4.3.126) ityataḥ, tenāyamartho bhavati-- `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityetasminnarthe yaḥ pratyayo gotrāt prāpnoti sa daṇḍamāṇavāntevāsiṣu na bhavatīti, gotre vuñeva prāpnotīti, atastasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedho vidhīyate| gaukakṣyaśabdādgargādiyañantāt `kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) ityaṇ, pūrvavadyalopaḥ| `dākṣāḥ' iti| dākṣiplākṣimāhakibyaḥ `iñaśca' (4.2.112) ityaṇ || 131. raivatikādibhyaśchaḥ| (4.3.131) `pūrveṇa' iti| `gotracaraṇād‌vuñ' (4.3.126) ityanena| `raivatikīyam' iti| revatyā apatyamiti raivatikaḥ, tataśchaḥ| `svāpiśīyam' iti| svāpiśiśabdādiñantācchaḥ| atha cchagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, nānantarasūtrādvipratiṣedho'nuvartiṣyate, tatra revatikādibhyo vuñi pratiṣiddhe vṛddhatvādeṣāṃ cha eva bhaviṣyati ? bhavet siddhaṃ yatra cchasyāpavādo nāsti-- raivatikīya iti, ye tvatreñantāḥ paṭhyante--svāpiśi, audamedhi, aucadavāpi-- ityevādayaḥ tebhyaḥ yāvatā gahādirasau, gahāditvāccha eva bhaviṣyati ? na sidhyati; gahādipāṭhasyānyastaddhitārtho'vakāśaḥ, idamarthe tu paratvād‌vuñeva syāt| tasmādidamarthe tu syāditi yuktastasyeha pāṭhaḥ|| 132. kaupiñjalahāstipadādaṇ| (4.3.132) `gotrādhikārāt' iti| `gobravuño'pavādaḥ' ityatrāyaṃ hetuḥ| atra hi gotragrahaṇe'dhikriyamāṇe kaupiñjalahāstipadaśabdābhyāṃ gotravācakābhyāmaṇ vidhīyate, sa ca nāprāpte gotravuñīti, tena tasyaivāpadavādo vijñāyate| `kaupiñjalaḥ' iti| kupiñjalasyāpatyamityetasmādeva nipātanādaṇ, tadantāt kaupiñjalasyedamiti punaraṇ| `hāstipadaḥ' iti| hastina iva pādāvasyeti hastipādasyāpatyamityasmādeva nipātanādaṇ, pādasya padbhāvaḥ, hāstipadasyedamiti punaranenāṇ| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na yathāvihitamevocyeta ? nanu caivamucyamāne `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) syāt ? naitadasti; yadyetābhyāṃ cho'bhīṣṭaḥ syāt, raivatikādiṣvetau paṭhyeyātām| raivatikādibhyastu pṛthagupādānādvijñāyate--naitābhyāṃ cho bhavatīti| vuñ tarhi syāt ? naitadasti; ārambho hyevamanarthakaḥ syāt, gotrādityevaṃ vuñaḥ siddhatvāt| nānarthakaḥ, yatrāsau pratiṣidhyate tatrārambhasya sārthakatvāt| kva cāsau pratiṣidhyate ? `na daṇḍamāṇavāntavevāsiṣu' (4.3.130) tasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| ṇitkaraṇaṃ kaupiñjalī kriyeti ṅīṣyathā syāt| iha ca kaupiñjalī kriyā'sya kaupiñjalīkriya iti `vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre' (6.3.39) iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho yathā syāt|| 133. ātharvaṇikasyekalopaśca| (4.3.133) `caraṇavuño'pavādaḥ' iti| ātharvaṇikasya caraṇavācitvāt| `ātharvaṇaḥ' iti| atharvaṇā proktamityaṇ `an' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| ātharvaṇa iti sthite'vyetari `tadadhīte tadveda' (4.2.54) ityanuvarttamāne `vasantādibhyaṣṭhak' (4.2.63) ātharvaṇikaḥ| ata eva nipātanāt `poktālluk' (4.2.64) iti lugna bhavati| `caraṇāddharmāmnāyayoḥ' (vā.476) iti pūrvoktamiṣṭaṃ smārayati|| 134. tasya vikāraḥ| (4.3.134) `prakṛteravasthāntaram' iti| prakṛteḥ kāraṇasyāvasthāntaram - anayathātvam| `aprāṇī' iti| prāṇinaḥ `prāṇirajatādibhyaḥ' (4.3.154) añaṃ vakṣyati| `ādyudāttam' iti| `anudāttādeśca' (4.3.140) ityañaṃ vakṣyati| `avṛddham' iti| vṛddhānmayaṭaṃ vakṣyati--`nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ' (4.3.144) iti, yasya ca nānyat pratipadaṃ vidhānamiti-- gopayasoryat' (4.3.160) ityevamādi| nanu ca `an' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāvena bhavitavyam, tatkathamāśma iti bhavati ? ityāha-- `aśmano vikāra iti ṭilopaḥ' iti| ṭilopārthamaśvamano vikāra ityetadupasaṃkhyānaṃ kṛtam| `nitsarevādyudāttā ete' iti| aśmādayaḥ śabdāḥ| tatrāśmabhasmaśabdau maninpratyayāntatvānnatsvareṇādyudāttau| mṛttikāśabdo'pi tikanpratyayāntatvāt -- `mṛdastikan' (5.4.39) iti| atha tasyeti vacanaṃ kimartham, yāvatā tasyagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtameva ? ityāha-- `{tasyaprakaraṇam-- prācīna mudrita vā} tasya prakaraṇam' ityādi| taddhi prakṛtaṃ tasyeti vacanaṃ śaiṣikairghādibhiḥ {sambaddha--mu.pāṭhaḥ} sambaddham| atastadanuvṛttau te'pyanuvartteran| asmiṃstu tasyagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe pūrvakaṃ tasyeti vacanaṃ nivarttate| tasmāt prakṛte'pi tasyeti vacane śaiṣika nivṛttyarthaṃ punastasyetyucyata iti| nanu ca pradhānaṃ ghādayaḥ, vidhīyamānatvāt; tasyeti tu vacanapradhānam, tadarthatvāt; tatrāyuktā guṇe nivarttamāne pradhānasya nivṛttiḥ prasajyeta, yathaiva hi prakṛtaṃ tasyeti vacanaṃ ghādibhiḥ sambaddhaṃ tathā aṇādibhirapi ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, ubhayeṣāṃ hi nivṛttī niṣpalaḥ sūtrasyārambhaḥ syāt| vidheyasya kasyacidabhāvāt, tasmānna bhavatyubhayeṣāṃ nivṛttiḥ| nanu cārambhasāmarthyādubhayeṣāmanyatameṣāṃ nivṛttirityetāvadvijñāyate| tatkiṃ ghādayo nivarttante ? utāṇādayaḥ ? sandeha eva| sandehamātrametat, sarvasandeheṣvidamupatiṣṭhate-- `vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattirna hi sandehādalakṣaṇam' (vyā.pa.75) iti| ghādayo nivarttanta ityevaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ, svaritatvādaṇādīnāmanuvṛttirbhaviṣyati| nanu cāsvaritvāddhādīnāmanuvṛttiḥ, saiva tu tasyeti vacanenākhyāyate śaiṣikanivṛttyartham| `vikārāvayavayoḥ' ityādinā viśeṣaṃ darśayati| kena punavikārāvayavayorghādayaḥ prāpnuvanti ? `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityanenaca tasyedaṃviśeṣatvāt tayoḥ| `hālaḥ,sairaḥ' iti| yadi śaiṣikā anuvartteraṃstato halasīraśabdābhyāṃ `halasīrāṭṭhak' (4.3.124) iti ṭhak syāt| tannivṛttau tvaṇeva bhavati|| 135. avayave ca prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyaḥ| (4.3.135) `maurvaṃ kāṇḍam' iti| mūrvāśabdādavayave pratyayaḥ| `maurva bhasma' iti| vikāre| `ita uttaram' ityādinā vakṣyamāṇānāṃ pratyayānāṃ viṣayavibhāgaṃ darśayati| `katham' iti| kena prakāreṇāyaṃ vibhāgo labhyate| pratyakṣamarthaṃ pṛcchati-- `dvayamapi'ityādi| yato hetoreṣa viṣayavibhāgo labhyate taddarśayati| tatar phalapākāntā oṣadhaḥ,puṣpavantaḥ phalavantaśca vṛkṣāḥ, tadviśeṣā vanaspatayaḥ phalavanta eva| tatra vanaspatigrahaṇena vṛkṣaviśeṣāstato'nyena gṛhyante| vṛkṣagrahaṇe tu vanaspaterapi grahaṇaṃ vijñeyam| `vikārāvayavayoḥ' ityādi| yugapadadhikāre hyaṇādīn vakṣyāmītyevamartho yugapadadhikāraḥ| aṇādīnāmarthanirdeśārtho'pi kasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- `kṛtanirdeśo hi tau' iti| kṛtanirdeśo hi tāvarthau `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityanenaiva;tasyedaṃ viśeṣatvāt tayoḥ|| 136. bilvādibhyo'ṇ| (4.3.136) `añmayaṭorapavādaḥ' iti| yadatrānudāttādi tasmāt `anudāttādeśca' (4.3.140) iti prāptasyāño'pavādaḥ| yad‌vṛddhaṃ tataḥ `nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ' (4.3.144) iti mayaṭaḥ| tatra bilvaśabdasya prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttatve prāpte `bilvatiṣyayorvāntasvaritatvam' (phi.sū.1.23) iti svaritatvaṃ bhavati, udātto vā| `vrīhimudga' śabdau ghṛtāditvādantodāttau| `masūragodhūma' śabdau `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' (phi.sū.2.42) iti madhyodāttau| evaṃ `gavedhukā' śabdo'pi| iṣeḥ ksuḥ, `ikṣuḥ' | pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `veṇuḥ' śabdo'pi `vibhāṣā veṇvindhānayoḥ' (6.1.215) itipakṣe'ntodātta eva| `karpāsīpāṭalī' śabdau `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt' (4.9.63) iti ṅīṣantau| ṅīṣpratyayāntatvānṅīṣptyayasvareṇāntodāttau| `karkandhū' śabdaḥ `andūdṛgbhūjambūkaphelūkarkandhūdidhiṣūḥ' (da.u.1.176) iti nipātanānmadhyodāttaḥ| `kuṭīra' śabdaḥ `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādinā madhyodāttaḥ| sarva ete `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (6.1.158) ityanudāttādayaḥ| tenāñbādhanārthaṃ grahaṇamiti| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na bilvādibhyo yathāvihitamevocyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; pāṭalīśabdo hyatra vṛddhaḥ paṭhyate, tasmādaño bādhake mayaṭi prāpte punarvacanādañeva syāt| aṇgrahaṇāt tvaṇeva bhavati| tasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 137. kopadhācca| 94.3.137) `yathāyogam' iti| prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyo vikārāvayavayoḥ, anyebhyastu vikāramātra ityeṣo yatāyogārthaḥ| `año'pavādaḥ' iti| `oऱñ' (4.3.139), `anudāttādeḥ' (4.3.140) ityetābhyāṃ prāptasya| `tittiḍīkamāṇḍūka dardurūkamadhūka'śabdāḥ `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādinā madhyodāttāḥ,tenānudāttādayo bhavanti|| 138. trapujatunoḥ ṣuk| (4.3.138) `oraño'pavādaḥ' iti| anudāttatvāt| `aprāṇyādi' iti| ādiśabdenauṣadhitvamavṛkṣatvaṃ ca gṛhyate|| 139. orañ| (4.3.139) `anudāttāderanyadihodāharaṇam' iti| anudāttāderuttarasūtreṇaiva siddhatvāt| `daivadāravam, bhādradāravam' iti| devadārubhadradāruśabdau `pītadravarthānām' (phi.sū.2.37) ityādyudāttau| tasyāyamarthaḥ--pītadruḥ artho yeṣāṃ te pītadravarthāḥ, teṣāṃ pītadravarthavacanānāmādirudāyo bhavati|| 140. anudāttādeśca| 94.3.140) `dādhittham' ityādi| dadhni tiṣṭhatīti, kapau tiṣṭhatīti --supi sthaḥ' (3.2.4) iti kaḥ,`ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvāt sakārasya takāraḥ,upapadasamāsaḥ, samāsasvareṇāntodāttau| tena dadhitthakapitthaśabdāvanudāttādī bhavataḥ|| 141. palāśādibhyo vā| (4.3.141) `ubhayatravibhāṣeyam' iti| prāpte cāprāpte ca| tāmevobhayatravibhāṣāṃ spaṣṭīkarttumāha-- `palāśakhadira' ityādi| palāśaśabdo dhṛtāditvādantodāttaḥ,khadiraśabdo'pi titsvareṇa| `iṣimadimudikhidicchidibhidimandicanditisimihimuhimucirucirudhibandhiśuṣibhyaḥ kirac' (da.u.8.26) ityanuvarttamāne `ajiraśiśiraśithilasthirasphirasthavirakhadirāḥra' (da.u.8.27) iti kiracpratyayānto nipātitaḥ| śiṃśapāśabdaḥ `pāntānāṃ gurvādīnām' (phiṭ.3.55) iti madhyodāttaḥ| tasyāyamarthaḥ-- pāśabdāntānāṃ gurvādīnāṃ dvitīyamudāttaṃ bhavatīti| athakha `dvitīyaṃ prāgīṣāt' (phi.sū.3.50) ityatrānuvarttate, `spadi kiñciccalane' (dhā.pā.14) asmāt `anudāttādeśca halādeḥ' (3.2.149) iti yuc-- spandanaḥ, citsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `kṛśṛgṛṭipaṭi{śauṭibhyaḥ--da.u.}śaṭibhya īran' (da.u.8.72) karīra śabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `kṝśṛgṛkaṭipaṭi{śauṭibhyaḥ da.u.}śaṭibhya īran' (da.u.8.72) karīra śabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `kṛhṛbhyāmīṣan' (da.u.9.9), `śṛpṛbhyāṃ {kit --da.u.}kicca' (da.u.9.10) iti śirīṣaśabdo'pi nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| vikaṅgatapūlāsayavāsāśca `grāmādīnāṃ ca' (phi.sū. 2.38) ityādyudāttāḥ|| 142. śamyāṣṭlañ| (4.3.142) `año'pavādaḥ' iti| śamīśabdasay gaurāditvānṅīṣantasya pratyayasvareṇāntodāttasyānudāttāditvāt| ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ|| 143. mayaḍ‌vaitayorbhāṣāyāmabhakṣyācchādanayoḥ| (4.3.143) `etayoḥ' iti| `kimanena'ityādi codyam| `ye viśeṣapratyayāḥ' ityādi parihāraḥ| ādiśabdena `uṣṭrād‌vuñ' (4.3.157) ityevamādayo gṛhyante| yadi hyetayoriti nocyeta, tato ya iti uttare viśeṣāḥ pratyayāḥ añādayaḥ taiḥ saha samprasāraṇāyāṃ paratvāt ta eva syuḥ| `etayoḥ' ityucyamāne tu viśeṣapratyayeṣvapi pakṣe bhavanti, tena kapotamayamityādi siddhaṃ bhavati| atha kriyamāṇe `etayoḥ'ityetasmin, kathamavādaviṣaye mayaḍ‌ bhavati ? etayorityasya dvitīyavidhānārthatvānmayaṭpratyayo vikārāvayavayorbhavati| ekam-- vidhānametayoriti, mayaḍ‌bhavatīti-- dvitīyam| tatra yadyetadadvitīyaṃ vidhānaṃ tadā prāpaṇārtham| tena yatrāpi viśeṣapratyayairbādhito vijñāyate| tasmādvāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam|| 144. nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhyaḥ| (4.3.14) prāgdīvyatīyāṇo hyapavādo mayaḍārabhyate, aṇaṃ tu kopadhalakṣaṇam, añamuvarṇāntalakṣaṇamanudāttādilakṣaṇaṃ ca paratvādbādhate| `ārambhasāmarthyādeva nityaṃ bhaviṣyati' iti| yadi hyanityaḥ syāt, asya sūtrasyārambho'narthakaḥ syāt; pākṣikasya mayaṭaḥ pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt| `tadanena kriyate' iti| yat tadekeṣāmācāryāṇāmiṣṭam| tadanena nityagrahaṇena saphalaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate ? tadyathā dvāraṃ dvāramiti śabdādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ bhavatīti nityagrahaṇenāyamarthaḥ sūcyate| yadyevam, nityagrahaṇādeva mṛcchaśabdasyāpi nityo'yaṃ mayaṭ siddhaḥ, tadapārthako'sya śarādiṣu pāṭhaḥ ? nānarthakaḥ; nityagrahaṇasyaivodāharaṇapradarśanārthatvāt|| 145. gośca purīṣe| (4.3.145) `gavyam' iti| goridamityarthavivakṣāyāṃ `sarvatra gorajādiprasaṅge yat' (vā.383) iti yat, `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ| `purīṣaṃ na vikāro nāpyavayavaḥ'iti| prakṛtatvādgoriti gamyate| tatar vikārastāvanna bhavati ; prakṛteravasthāntaraṃ purīṣam; {godharmānanvayādodanavastūpakāsya --prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ} godharmānanvayāt| vastūpakārasya samudāyasyaikadeśo hyārambhako'vayavo bhavati, yathā--hastādi śarīrasya; na caivaṃ goḥ purīṣam| kva tarhīdaṃ vidhānamityāha--`tasyedaṃ viṣaye' iti| gavā bhāvitatvāt purī sya, tat tasyāḥ kāryamiti tasyedanartho bhavati| tasmāt tatraivedaṃ mayaṭo vidhānam| vikārāvayavayostarhi kena bhavitavyam ? ityāha-- `vikārāvayavostu' ityādi|| 146. piṣṭācca| (4.3.146) `aṇo'pavādaḥ' iti| piṣṭaśabdo'yaṃ `niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt' (6.1.205) ityādyudāttaḥ, tena tasmādautsargikaḥ prāpnoti, tatastasyāyamapavādaḥ|| 147. saṃjñāyāṃ kan| (4.3.147) `mayaṭo'pavādaḥraṭa iti| pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasya| nanu ca saṃjñāyāṃ kanaṃ vakṣyatyeva, tadapārthakaṃ tadvidhānam ? naitadasti; sa hyalpādiṣvartheṣu, ayaṃ tu vikāre| tadidaṃ sārthakam; arthabhedāt|| 148. vrīheḥ puroḍāśe| (4.3.148) 149. asaṃjñāyāṃ tilayavābhyām| (4.3.149) `tilayavaśabdāvādyudāttau' iti| tasmādaṇprāpnoti, atastasyāyamapavādaḥ| ādyudāttatvaṃ tu tayoḥ `tṛṇadhānyānāṃ {garmut-- da.u. gro muṭ ca' paṃ.u.}dvyaṣām' (phiṭ.2.27) ityanenaiva bhavitavyam| asyāyamarthaḥ-- tṛṇadhānyānāṃ dvyacāmādirudātto bhavatīti| `yāvakaḥra' iti| vikāre'ṇ| tadantāttu `yāvādibhyaḥ kan' (5.4.29) iti kan|| 150. dvyacaśchandasi| (4.3.150) 151. notvadvardhrabilvāt| (4.3.151) `mauñjam' iti| muñjāśabdasya pūrvapadādyudāttatvena tasmādautsargika evāṇ| `gārmutm' iti| `mugrorutiḥṭa (paṃ.u.1.96), `{garmut-- da.u. gro muṭ ca' (paṃ.u.} gormuṭ ca' (paṃ.u.1.97) iti pratyayasvareṇa garmucchabdo'ntodāttaḥ| tasmāt `anudāttādeśca' (4.3.140) ityañ| `brārdhrī'iti | `vṛdhivapabhyāṃ ran' (da.u.8.45) brardhraśabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ, tasmāt `prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83), `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp| `bailvam' iti| `bilvādibhyoṣa'ṇ' (4.3.136)| atha matuṣā nirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ ? na nodvardhrabilvādityevocyetetyata āha-- `matubnirdeśaḥ'iti|`notvadvardhrabilvāt' (4.3.151) ityucyamāna uditi varṇagrahaṇaṃ syāt| atra varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidhiṃ prayojayatīti tasmāttanniṣedhāya matubnirdeśaḥ| kaḥ punastadantavidhau sati doṣaḥ syādityata āha-- `ihai va' ityādi| evakāreṇa muñjādibhyo na syāditi darśayati| `vaiṣṇavī' iti| bilvāditvādaṇ|| 152. tālādibhyo'ṇ| (4.3.152) `mayaḍādīnāmapavādaḥ' iti| ādiśabdenāñaḥ|prakṛtibhedāt tayorbahutvasya vivakṣitvād dvayorapi bahuvacanam| tatra tālaśyāmākaśabdābhyāṃ vṛddhalakṣaṇasay mayaṭo'pavādaḥ| barhiṇo vikāro'vayavo veti `prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ' (4.3.154) ityanena bārhiṇaśabdo'pi vikārāvayavapratyāntaḥ, tena tasmādañ `ñitaśca tatpratyayāt' (4.3.155) iti prāptasyāño'pavādaḥ| śeṣebhyastvindrāliśādibhyo'nudāttādilakṣaṇasyāñaḥ| liśidṛśibhyāmindra upapade `kaprakaraṇe mūlavibhujādibya upasaṃkhyānam' (vā.232) iti kapratyayaḥ| `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti dīrghatvam| `gatikārakopapadāt kṛt' (6.2.139) iti kṛtsvareṇāntodāttau `indrāliśendrādṛśa' śabdo| `indrā ghu' śabdaḥ samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `capa sāntvane' (dhā.pā.399) `pacādyac' capaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| pīyūkṣāśabdaḥ `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādinā madhyādāttaḥ| yadyapyasya ṭāpi kṛte `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) nāsti, prāktu ṭāpo vidyata eva, tasyāmevāvasthāyāṃ madhyodāttatvaṃ bhavati| `tālāddhanuṣi' iti paṭhyate| tālaśabdādaṇ pratyayo bhavati dhanuṣyabhidheya iti| tālaṃ dhanuḥ, tālamayamanyat| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, na yathāvihitamevocyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; bārhiśabdād‌vṛdiddhilakṣaṇo mayaṭ `ñitaśca tatpratyayāt' (4.3.155) ityaṇā bādhitaḥ| tatrārambhasāmarthyādanmayaḍeva syāt| `śyāmāka'-śabdaḥ `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādinā madhyodāttaḥ| tasmāt `anudāttāderañ' (4.2.44)| paratvād‌vṛddhalakṣaṇena mayaṭā bādhita itipunarārambhasāmarthyādañeva syāt| aṇgrahamādaṇeva bhavati|| 153. jātarūpebhyaḥ parimāṇe| (4.3.153) `bahuvacananirdeśāt' ityādi| yadi svarūpagrahaṇamabhīṣṭaṃ syāt tasyaikatvādekavacanenaiva nirdeśaṃ kuryāditi bhāvaḥ| `mayaḍādīnām' iti| ādi śabdonāño grahaṇam| bahuvacanaṃ tu pūrvavat| tatra ye vṛddhā hāṭakajātarūpaprabhṛtayaḥ, tebhyo mayaṭo'pavādaḥ| ye tu tapanīyaprabhṛtayo'nudāttādayastebhyo'ñaḥ| `tāpanīyam' iti| tapanīyaśabdaḥ `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādinā madhyodāttaḥ|| 154. prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ| (4.3.154) `aṇādīnāmapavādaḥ' iti| ādiśabdena mayaṭ parigṛhyate| bahuvacanaṃ tu pūrvavat| tatra ye prāṇiśabdā ādyudāttāstebhyo'ṇapavāda iti| ye tu vṛddhāstebhyo mayaṭ parigṛhyate| rajatādiṣvapi yadādyudāttaṃ tasmādaṇo'pavādaḥ| yatpunaranuvāttādi tasmānmayaṭaḥ| tato hi `anudāttādeśca' (4.3.144) ityanenaivāñi siddhe punarvacanamañeva yathā syāt, `mayaḍvaitayoḥ' (4.3.143) ityādinā mayaḍ mā bhūdityevamartham| tatra `rajataṃ' ghṛtādipāṭhādantodāttam| `sīsa, loha' iti| `nabviṣayasyānisantasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttam| asyāyamarthaḥ-- napuṃsakaviṣayasya śabdasyānisantasyādirudātto bhavatīti| nabiti napuṃsakasya saṃjñā| antyāt pūrvamityanuvarttamāne `śiśṛmānodumbarabalīvardoṣṭrārapurūravasāṃ ca' (phi.sū.3.64) ityudumbare'ntyāt pūrvamakṣaramudāttam| nīladārurohitabibhītaka-- ityeteṣāṃ `laghāvante' (phi.sū.242) ityādinā madhyādāttatvam| pītadāruśabdamapi kecit paṭhanti| sa `nabviṣayasyānisantasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttaḥ| `taraterḍriḥ' (paṃ.u.5.66) iti ḍripratyayāntatvāt triśabdasya pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvam| trayaḥ kaṇṭakā asyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam' (6.2.1) iti trikaṇṭakaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `{kaṇvaṃ prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ} kaṇṭaṃ karotīti karmaṇyaṇ| `{kaṇvakāra prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ} kaṇṭakāraśabdaḥ kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ|| 155. ñitaśca tatpratyayāt| (4.3.155) `mayaṭo'pavādaḥ' iti| vṛddhalakṣamasya sarvasya ñitpratyayāntasya vṛddhatvāt|`ete pratyayā gṛhyante' iti| nanu caikānubandhaparibhāṣayā ṣṭlaño grahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `ñitaśca' iti hi cakārastatsamuccayārthaḥ| tena tasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| oraño (4.3.139) grahaṇena `anudāttadeśca' (4.3.140) `palāśādibhyo vā' (4.3.141) ityetatsūtragrahaṇaṃ veditavyam; abhinnatvāt| ya evaṃ `orañ' (4.3.139) ityanenāñvihitaḥ sa evāsmin sūtradvaye'nuvarttate| `daivadāravasya vikāro'vayavo vā' ityādinā yathāyogameṣāṃ pratyayānāmudāharaṇādīni darśayati| `kāṃsyam pāraśavam' iti| kaṃsāya hitamiti `prāk krītāccha-' (5.1.1) kaṃsīyaḥ| paraśave hitamityugavāditvā (5.1.2) dyat| paraśavyasya vikāro'vayavo veti `kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoryañañau luk ca' (4.3.168) iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ yañañau bhavataḥ, chayatośca luk-- kāṃsyam, pāraśavaḥ; tayorvikāro'vayavo vetyenenāñ| `bailvamayam' iti| bilvaśabdo `bilvādibyo'm' (4.3.136) ityaṇantaḥ| tato vṛddhalakṣame mayaḍeva bhavati| `vaidamayam' iti| `anṛṣa' (4.1.104) ityādināñ-- vaidaḥ| bhavatyayamañpratyayo ñit, na tu vikārāvayavalakṣamaḥ,tena mayaḍeva bhavati|| 156. krītatparimāṇāt| (4.3.156) `aṇādīnāmapavādaḥ' iti| ādiśabdenāñādīnāṃ grahaṇam| `saṃkhyāpi parimāṇagrahaṇena gṛhyate' iti| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate, yāvatā parimāṇaśabdaḥ prasthādiṣu rūḍhaḥ, na saṃkhyāyām ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathaiva hi prasthādiparicchedahetustathā saṃkhyāpi| ata upamānāt saṃkhyāyāmapi parimāṇaśabdo vartiṣyate parimāṇamiva parimāṇamiti| nanvevaṃ mukhye sati gauṇagrahaṇamayuktam ? ayamatra doṣaḥ -- iha hi tantreṇa dvau parimāṇaśabdāvuccāritau, tatra dvitīyaṃ padamudāttam, tena saṃkhyāpi gṛhyate| `naiṣkikam' iti| prāgvateṣṭhañ' (5.1.18)| `śatyaḥ, śatikaḥ' iti| `śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate' (5.1.21)| `sahasram' iti| `śatamānaviṃśatikasahasravatanādaṇ' (5.1.27)| `adhyardhapūrva' (5.1.28) ityādinā sādṛśaṣyārthe vatau sati yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate taddarśayati| ādiśabdena prakṛtyādiparigrahaḥ| `dvisahasram' iti| dvayoḥ sahasrayorvikāra iti taddhitārthe dviguḥ| `prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadāt tadantavidhiraluki' (5.1.20 vā.) iti tadantavidhirabhyanujñānādyathā krītārthe `śatamānaviṃśatisahasravasanāt' (5.1.29) iti pakṣe lugbhavati, tatehāpi| `dvisāhasram' iti| `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarapūrvasya' (7.3.15) ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| `daviniṣkaḥ' iti| yathā krītārthe niṣkaśabdāt prāgvateṣṭhañ (5.1.18) bhavati tasya `dvitripūrvānniṣkāt' (5.1.30) iti pakṣe luk, tathehāpi| `dvinaiṣkikam' iti| `parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñānnāṇayoḥ' (7.3.17) ityuttarapadavṛddhirbhavati|| 157. uṣṭrād‌vuñ| (4.3.157) 158. umorṇayorvā| (4.3.158) umāśabdastṛṇadhānyamityāha (phi.sū.2.27) nādyudāttaḥ, ūrṇāśabdo'pi prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tābhyāṃ yathāsaṃkhyamaṇañoḥ prāptayorvibhāṣā vuñārabhyate|| 159. eṇyā ḍhañ| (4.3.159) `puṃsastvañeda bhavati' iti| yadiha puṃso ḍhañ syāt puṃlliṅgenaiva nirdeśaṃ kuryāditi| puṃlliṅga na hi nirdeśe prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyeṇīśabdādapi pratyayo labhyata eva| tasmāt strīliṅganirdeśādeva puṃso'ñ bhavati, na ḍhañ|| 160. gopayasoryat| (4.3.160) `mayaḍviṣaye tu vidhīyate' iti| ajādiprasaṅga iti vacanāt| mayaṭo'najāditvāt tadviṣaye na prāpnotītyatastatra gośabdādvidhīyate| payaḥśabdastu pibaterityasunpratyayānto nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ, tasmāt prāgdīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityaṇ prāpnoti| atastadapavādo'yaṃ yadvidhīyate|| 161.drośca| (4.3.161) 162. māne vayaḥ| (4.3.162) 163. kale luk| (4.3.164) `tadviṣaye' iti| vikārāvayavaviṣaye| `āmalakam' iti| `nityaṃ vṛddhaśarādibhya-' (4.3.144) iti mayaṭ, tasya luk| strīpratyayasya luk pūrvavat| nanu ca phalaṃ vṛkṣasya na vikāraḥ nāpyavayavaḥ| vikāro dvedhā bhavati-- yo vā prakṛtaṃ nigṛhṇāti--khadiraṃ bhasmeti; yo vā prakṛtivyapadeśaṃ karoti-- khādiro yūpa iti| na ca phalaṃ vṛkṣamapagṛhṇāti, nāpi phalena yuktasya vyapadeśāntaraṃ janayati, atha ca tasya dikārastathā phalamapi| syādetat| pallavitāvasthāṃ vṛkṣasyāpagṛhṇan pallava upajāyate, ato yuktā tasya tadvikārāvayavateti; phalamapi tasya phalitāvasthāṃ vṛkṣasyāpagṛhṇan phalamupajāyate, tasyāpi yukta eva tadvikārabhāvaḥ| yadapyuktam-- nāvayavo'nārambhakatvāditi, tadapyayuktam; phalaṃ hyupajāyamānaṃ śākhyādyavayavasahāyamanyameva viśiṣṭaṃ vṛkṣāvayavamārabhate| tadyathā pallavo viśiṣṭaṃ samudāyāntaramārabhamāṇo'vayavo bhavati tathā phalamapīti veditavyam|| 164. plakṣādibhyo'ṇ| (4.3.164) `año'pavādaḥ' iti| tatrekṣukarkandhūśabdābhyāmuvarṇāntalakṣamasyāño'pavādaḥ, śeṣebhyastvanudāttādilakṣaṇasya| sarve hi te'ntodāttatvādanudāttāyaḥ| tatra plakṣanyagrodhāśvatthaśabdāḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttāḥ| iṅguvībṛhatīśabdau tu gaurādiṅīṣantatvāt pratyayasvareṇāntodāttau| `vidhānasāmarthyāt' ityādi| yadyaṇo luk syādvacanamarthakaṃ syāt| na hyaṇo vāño vā luki kṛte kaścidviśeṣo'sti| `naiyagrodham' iti| `nyagrodhasya ca kevalasya' (7.3.5) ityaivāgamaḥ|| 165. jambvā vā| (4.3.165) `añastu bhavatyeva' iti| tasya luki sati vidhānamanarthakaṃ bhavati; aśrūyamāṇatvāt| `jambūni' iti| luki kṛte'bhidheyaliṅgaṃ napuṃsakaṃ bhavati| `hrasvo nupaṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti, `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' (7.120),num, `nopadhāyāḥ'(6.4.7) iti dīrghaḥ|| 166. lup ca| (4.3.166) kaḥ punarlupi sati viśeṣo yato luki prakṛte sa vidhīyate ? ityāha-- `yuktavadbhāvo viśeṣaḥ' iti| lupi sati yuktavadbhāvo bhavati `lupi yuktavadv‌yaktivacane' (1.2.51) iti, lupi satyeva viśeṣa iti| `jambūḥ phalam' iti| atra yuktavadbhāvena prakṛtigatameva liṅgaṃ bhavati, tena napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ na pravarttate| `lupprakaraṇe' ityādi| phalapākena śuṣyantīti phalapākaśuṣaḥ| `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.3130) iti kvip| `vrīhayaḥ, mudgāḥ' iti| bilvādibhyo'ṇo (4.3.136) lup| `yavāḥ, māṣāḥ'iti| ata autsargikasyāṇaḥ| ete `tṛṇadhānyānām' (phi.sū.2.27) ityādinādyudāttāḥ| `puṣpamūleṣu bahulam' iti| puṣpamūleṣu cābhidheyeṣu bahulaṃ lubbhavati| mallikā,vanamallikā, jātiḥ, vidārī, aṃśumatī, bṛhatī--atrānudāttādilakṣaṇasyāño lup| mallikānavamallikāśabdau `laghāvante dvayośca bahvaṣo guruḥ' (phi.sū.2.42) iti madhyodāttau| jātiśabdaśca `kvicktau ca saṃjñāyām' (3.3.174) iti kticpratyayāntatvādantodāttaḥ| badarībṛhatīśabdāvapi gaurādiṅīṣantatvādantodāttāveva| aṃśumatīśabdaḥ `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅībantaḥ| aṃśuśabdasya prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttatvānmadhyodāttaḥ| `pāṭalāni' iti| bilvāditvādaṇ| `śālvāni mūlāni' iti| śālvānītyanudāttādilakṣamo'ḍha| śālvaśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| śālva iti -śāka iti yasya prasiddhiḥ| `kvacidanyadapi' iti| lupo'nyatrāpi kvacit kāryaṃ bhavati| tatpurlukluporabhāvaśca| `kadambakam' ityādāvanudāttalakṣaṇasyāño luk| kadambādayaḥ śabdā `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādinā madhyodāttāḥ| `balvāni' iti| atrobhayābhāvaḥ| `bilvādibhyo'ṇ' (4.3.136) | etattu sarva harītakyādipāṭhādeva siddhamiti nāpūrva vaktavyam| yato harītakyādiṣu `yeṣāñca phalapāka nimittaḥ śoṣaḥ; puṣpamūleṣu bahulam' (4.3.167) iti paṭhyante|| 167. harītakyādibhyaśca| (4.3.167) harītakyādiṣu kaṇṭakārikā,gargārikā, śephālikā-- ityete `saṃjñāyāṃ kan' (5.3.75) iti kannantatvānnitsvareṇādyudāttāḥ| tenaiva tebhya autsargikasyāṇo lup| śeṣebhyastvanudāttādilakṣaṇasyāñaḥ, sarve te'ntodāttatvādanudāttādayaḥ| tatra kālā, drākṣā, dhrākṣā-- ityetebhyaḥ prāgye paṭhyante te ṅīṣantatvādantodāttāḥ tatra śvetapākī, arjunapākī-- ityetau `pākakarṇaparṇa' (4.1.64) ityādinā ṅīṣantau| śeṣebhyastu gaurāditvāt `gaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41)| kālādrākṣādhrākṣāśabdebhyaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttebhyaṣṭāp, savarṇadīrghatvam, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) ityudāttatvam| ataḥ kālādayo'pyantodāttāḥ|| 168. kaṃsīyaparaśavyayoryañañau lukca| (4.3.168) `kaṃsīyaḥ'iti| uṇādau kaṃsaśabdaḥ sapratyayānto vyutpāditaḥ| paśuśabdo'pi `pṛthivivyā {dhṛṣihṛṣabhyaḥ--da.u.} dhṛṣibhyaḥ kuḥraka' (da.u.1.108) ityanuvarttamāne `āṅparayoḥ khaniśṛbhyāṃ {ḍicca--da.u., ticca iti prā.mu.nyāsapāṭhaḥ} ṇicca' (da.u.1.118) iti kupratyayāntaḥ| tadanayorapi dhātupratyayayorlukkasmānna bhavati ? ityāha-- `prātipadikādhikārāt' ityādi| prātipadikāditi varttate, tena prātipadikebhyo yo vihitastasya lugbhavati| ne cemau prātipadikādvihitau, kiṃ tarhi ? dhātoḥ, ato'nayorlugna pravarttate| `anudāttatvādeva' iti| paraśavyaśabdo hi `titsvaritam' (6.1.185) ityantasvaritaḥ| `tenānudāttādiḥ' iti| `ītīti tatra varttate' iti| `yasyate ca' (6.4.148) ityataḥ|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ caturthādhyāye tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ <4.4> atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ caturthaḥ pādaḥ 1. prāgvahateṣṭhak| (4.4.1) atha prāggrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? arthaviśeṣe pratyayāntareṇāpavādena nivartitasya ṭhaka uttarasmin granthāntare punarupasthānaṃ yathā syādityavemartham| tadyathā-- `saṃskṛtam' (4.4.3) ityetasminnarthaviśeṣe `kulatthakopadhāt' (4.4.4) ityaṇā nivarttitasyottaratrārthāntare `tarati' (4.4.5) ityetasminnarthe punarupasthānaṃ yathā syāditi| `ṭhakprakaraṇe' ityādi| taditi karmābhidhāyibhya āhetyetasminnarthe māśabdādibhyaṣṭhaka upasaṃkhyānan| `vākyādetat pratyayavidhānam' iti| sa eva hi vākyārtha iti nāvamṛṣṭaḥ karmabāvamupagataḥ| tadāheti nirdiśyate--tadabhidāyina eva vākyāt pratyaya iti| padasamudāyo hi vākyamiti| `mā' ityetasya ca `śabda' ityetasya ca padasya yaḥ padasya yaḥ samudāyastadvākyam| evamanyatrāpi veditavyam| kathaṃ punaḥ prātipadikādhikāre vākyātpratyayavidhiḥ ? ityata āha-- `prabhūtādibhyaḥ' iti| punarvacanāt| yadi hyanenāpi prātipadikādeva pratyayavidhiḥ syādevaṃ sati `{āheti prabhūtādibhyaḥ--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ} āhau prabhūtādibhyaḥ' (vā.483) iti punarupasaṃkhyānamanarthakaṃ syāt; anenaiva siddhatvāt| prabhūtādayo'pi hi māśabdādayo bhaviṣyanti, te ca karmābhidhāyina eva pratyayamutpādayanti; kriyāviśeṣaṇābhidhāyitvāt| kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ hi karmatvaṃ `tatpratyanupūrvamīpalomakūlam' (4.4.28) ityatra pratipādayiṣyate-- pratyayārtho'pyaheti| sa eva tasmādāheti prabhūtādibhya itipunarvacanādvākyādeva pratyavidhānaṃ vijñāyate| `kriyāviseṣaṇāt' iti| prabhūtādiśabdaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇābhidhāyitvādabhidhāne'bhidheyopacāraṃ kṛtvā kriyāviśeṣamaśabdenoktaḥ|| 2. tena dīvyati khanati jayati jitam| (4.4.2) `tena' iti pratyekamabhisambadhyate| `sarvatra karaṇe tṛtīyā' iti| dīvyatītyādau karttari lakāra iti tenaiva kartturabhihitatvāt karttari tṛtīyā nopapadyate| tasmāt karaṇa eva tṛtīyā| atha hetau tṛtīyā kasmānna
