bhavati ? anabhidhānāt| jitamityatra karmaṇi niṣṭhāvidhānādyadyapi karttaryapi tṛtīyā sambhavati, tathāpi dīvyatītyādibhiḥ sāhacaryāt karaṇa eva tṛtīyā vijñāyate| devadattena jitamityatra karttari tṛtīyā; tena vākyameva bhavati; na pratyayaḥ| iha sūtre dīvyatītyādinaikavacanāntenaikasaṃkhyasya pratyayārthasya varttamānena ca kālena nirdeśaḥ| tataścaikasminneva pratyayārthe pratyaya syāt, na dvibahvoḥ| tathā varttamāna eva kāle, na bhūtabhaviṣyatoriti yaścodayet, taṃ ityāha-- `pratyayārthe saṃkhyākālayoravivakṣā' iti| avivakṣātu tayornāntarīyakatvāt| avaśyaṃ hi yayā kayācit saṃkhyayā yena kenacit kālena nirdeśaḥ karttavya iti| na tau pradhānam, na ca tayorvivakṣeti| yadi tarhi saṃkhyākālayoravivakṣeti sādhanasyāpyavivakṣā prāpnoti, ekaprakaraṇatvāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yasya hi vivakṣāmantarema dvitīyasya padasyoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ bhavati tanniyogato vivakṣitavyam| dīvyatītyādiṣvanvarthamātre vivakṣyamāṇe dvitīyasya padasyoccāraṇamanarthakamāpadyeteti na yuktā sādhanasyāpyavivakṣā| iha dīvyatītyevamādau `kriyāpradhānamākhyātam' iti kriyaiva padena prādhānyenākhyāyate, karttā tu guṇībhūtaḥ, taddhitastu--ākṣika iti prādhānyena karttāramevātra vakti, kriyā tu guṇabhāvena, etaccāyuktam; ākhyāteṣūtpannaiḥ pratyayairyathā'sau tiṅantenābhidhīyate, tathaiva pratyayāntenāpi yukto'bhidhātumiti yaścodayet, ityāha-- `kriyāpradhānatve'pi ca' ityādi| abhidhānasvabhāvaścāyam, yena kriyāprādhānyasyāpyanuvidhīyamānastaddhitaḥ karttupradhāno bhavati| tasmāt karttṛtvabhāvo'trāpekṣitavyaḥ| na hi svabhāvo'pi na hi svābhāvo'pi paryanuyogamarhati|| 3. saṃskṛtam| (4.4.3) yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ-- `kulatthakopadhādaṇ' (4.4.4) ityayamapavādaḥ saṃskṛta eva yathā syāt, `dīvyati' ityādau mā bhūdityevamartho yogavibhāgaḥ|| 4. kulatthakopadhādaṇ| (4.4.4) 5. tarati| (4.4.5) 6. gopucchāṭṭhañ| (4.4.6) `svare viśeṣaḥ'iti| ṭhaki hi sati taddhitasya `kitaḥra' (6.1.165) ityantodāttatvaṃ syāt| ṭhañi sati ñitsareṇādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 7. naudvyacaṣṭhan| (4.4.7) iha prakaraṇe keṣucit saṃhitikaḥ ṣakāro dṛṣṭaḥ, keṣucitpratyayasyaivānubandhaḥ;tadiha ṭhagadhikāre na jñāyate-- kaḥ sāṃhitikaḥ ? kaḥ pratyayānubandhaḥ ? iti| ato'sandehārthaṃ parigaṇanaṃ kṛtam| tacca `ākarṣātparpādibhyaḥ' ityādinā ślokena karoti| `ākarṣāt ṣṭhal' (4.4.31), `pargādibhyaṣṭhan' (4.4.10), `bhastrādibhyaṣṭhan' (4.4.16), `kasusīdadaśaikadaśāt ṣṭhanṣṭhacau' (4.4.31), `āvasathāt ṣṭhal' (4.4.74), `kiśarādibhyaḥ ṣṭhan' (4.4.53) iti vitaḥ ṣaḍete| nanu ca `anyato ṅīṣ' (4.1.40) ityādayo'nyebhyo'pi vitaḥ santyeva| tatkimucyate ṣaḍete ? ityata āha-- `ṭhagadhikāre' ityādi| ṭhakaḥ prakṛtatvāt tadadhikāre ye ṣitaḥ ta eva parigṛhyanta iti darśayati| nanvevamapi sati sapta bhavanti, kusādādi (4.4.31) sūtre ṣitpratyayadvayavidhānāt ? ityatrāha-- `vidhivākyāpekṣaṃ tu ṣaṭtvam' iti| ṣitaḥ pratyayānāṃ saptatvāt| etenaiva yogāḥ ṣitaḥ prayuktāḥ| ṣitpratyayārthāḥ ṣaḍete yogā ityarthaḥ|| 8.carati| (4.4.8) 9. ākarṣāt ṣṭhal| (4.4.9) `lakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| liti pratyayāt pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| `ṣakāro ṅīṣarthaḥ' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ yathā syāt| `ākarṣikī' iti| `svarṇaparīkṣārtho nikaṣopala ucyate' iti| ākṛṣyate svarṇamiti kṛtvā| 10. parpādibhyaḥ ṣṭan| (4.4.10) parpādiṣu `pādaḥ pacca' iti paṭhyate, tasyāyayamarthaḥ-- pādaśabdāt ṣṭhan pratyayo bhavati tatsannayogena capadityayamādeśaḥ padikaḥ, padikī| yadyevaṃ `padyatyatadarthe' (6.3.53) iti `padbhāva ike caratāvupasaṃkhyānam' (vā.740) itikasmādupasaṃkhyāyate ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `pādaḥ pat' (6.4.130) ityasyāpaurāṇikatvāt|| 11. śvagaṇāṭaṭhñca| (4.4.11) `ṣvāgaṇikaḥ'iti| śunāṃ gaṇaḥ śvagaṇaḥ| nanu ca śvañśabdo dvārādiṣu paṭhyata iti `dvārādīnāñca' (7.3.4) iti vṛddhipratiṣedhenaivāgamena bhavitavyam, tatra tadādividheriṣṭatvāt, tatkathaṃ śvāgaṇika iti bhavati ? ityāha-- `śvāderiñiṭa ityādi| dvārādikārye ca pratiṣiddhe satyādivṛddhireva bhavati|| 12. vetanādibhyo jīvati| (4.4.12) 13. vasnakrayavikrayāṭaṭhan| (4.4.13) `krayavikrayagrahaṇaṃ saṅghātavigṛhītārtham' iti| iha tantreṇa krayavikrayaśabdāvuccāritau;tatraikasya saṅghātārthaṃ grahaṇam, aparasya tu vigṛhītārthaṃ veditavyam|| 14. āyudhāccha ca| 94.4.14) 15. haratyutsaṅgādibhyaḥ| (4.4.15) 16. bhastrādibhyaḥ ṣṭhan| (4.4.16) bhastrādiṣu `śīrṣebhāra' iti paṭhyate| tatrāsmādeva nipātanācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ, `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ, `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam' (6.3.14) iti pakṣe saptamyā aluk|| 17. vibhāṣā vivadhavīvadhāt| (4.4.17) `paryāhāre' iti| paritaḥ sa hriyata iti paryāhāraḥ, maṇḍalādikamucyate|| 18. aṇ kuṭilikāyāḥ| (4.4.18) 19. nirvṛtte'kṣadyūtādibhyaḥ| (4.4.19) 20. trermamnityam| (4.4.20) `ḍivataḥ ktrirityayaṃ triśabdo gṛhyate' iti| saṃkhyāśabdaḥ kasmānna gṛhyate ? nabhidhānāt | na hi trirityucyate vivakṣitārthasya pratītirbhavati| `uptrimam' iti| `vacisvapiyajādīnāṃ kiti' (6.1.15) iti samprasāraṇam| `nityagrahaṇaṃ svātantryanivṛttyartham' iti| kevalasya tripratyayāntasya mappratyayarahitasya prayogaḥ svātantryam, tannivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇam| svātantranivṛttyarthe nityagrahaṇe sati yo'rthaḥ sampadyate taṃ `{tryantaḥ--mu.pāṭhaḥ} tryantam' ityādinā darśayati| `viṣayāntare' ityādinā yadevakārasya vyavacchedyaṃ tadācaṣṭe| mappratyayaviṣayārthādanyaviṣaye yatra pratyayo na bhavati tadvi yāntaram| nityagrahaṇaṃ tannivṛttiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ veditavyam|. 21.apamityayācitābhyāṃ kakkanau| (4.4.21) `apamitya' iti| `udīcāṃ māṅo vyatīhāre' (3.4.19) iti ktvā, tasya lyabādeśe kṛte,apamityeti bhavati| tasya ca `ktvāsosunkasunaḥ' (1.1.40) ityavyayasaṃjñā| tena tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktyādhikāre'pyavibhaktikādevāsmāt pratyayavidhiḥ|| 22. saṃsṛṣṭe| 4.4.22) nanu ca `saṃskṛtam' (4.4.3) ityeva saṃsṛṣṭe pratyayayo bhaviṣyati, yat punaryena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ tattena saṃskṛtaṃ bhavati ? naitat; sato hyutkarṣādhānaṃ saṃskāraḥ,ekabhāvaḥ saṃsargaḥ| na ca tatrotkarṣeṇa bhavitavyam, svaśucidravyasaṃsarge svaprakarṣa eva bhavati, notkarṣaḥ| saṃsargamātre pratyaya iṣyate; tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭa iti vaktavyameva; etadeva kriyatām; kiṃ `saṃskṛtam' (4.4.3) ityanena ? asatyapi saṃsarge yatra saṃskṛtamasti tatrāpi pratyaya iṣyate-- vaidyikaḥ, na vidyayā saṃsarga upapadyate; saṃsargo dravyayoreva bhavati, yathā--daṇḍapuruṣayoḥ| mūrtimatastaddharmatvāt, rana tu vidyā mūrttimatī| kulatthakoladhādaṇo (4.4.4) vidhānārthaṃ saṃskṛtagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam| na hi saṃsṛṣṭamātre pratyaya iṣyate; kintu tatkṛtaguṇādhāne|| 23. cūrṇādiniḥ| (4.4.23) nanu ca cūrṇena ye saṃsṛṣṭāsteṣāṃ cūrṇamasti, tatra matvarthīyenaiveninā siddhamiti tadapārthakamidam ? naitat ; astivivakṣāyāṃ matvarthīyena siddhaṃ syāt, saṃsṛṣṭavivakṣāyāṃ punarna sidhyati, ta hi ṭhak syāt| ṭhako bādhanārthatve kuto'syānarthakyam|| 24. lavaṇālluk| (4.4.24) `dravyavācī' ityādi| lavaṇaśabdo'yamastyeva guṇavacano yo rasaviśeṣe varttate, rasasya guṇatvāt| asti dravyavacanaḥ, yathā--pañca lavaṇānīti| tatra yo guṇavacanaḥ sa lukaṃ na prayojanayati| guṇairhi yadyapi dravyaṃ na saṃsṛjyate, tathāpi guṇaśabdāḥ `so'yam' ityabhedena sambandhāddravye varttante, yathā-- śuklaḥ paṭaḥ, {kṣāram--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ} kṣauram, amlaṃ dadhīti; tathā lavaṇaśabdo'pi vartiṣyate, tataḥ kiṃ lukā ? avaśyaṃ tadevaṃ vijñāyam, anyathā hi madhurādibhyo'pi lugvaktavyaḥ syāt| dravyaśabdāstvanyatra so'yamityabhedasamarthanānna varttante| tasmāddravyavācī lavaṇaśabdo lukaṃ prayojayati|| 25.mudgādaṇ| (4.4.25) 26. vyañjanairupasikte| (4.4.26) `vyañjanaiḥra' iti| bahuvacananirdeśaḥ svarūpavidhinirāsārthaḥ| tenetyadhikārādeva tṛtīyāyāṃ samarthavibhaktau varttamānāyāṃ tṛtīyānuvādaḥ sukhapratipattaye| `saṃsṛṣṭe' (4.4.22) iti varttamāna upasiktasyaitat prayojanam-- odanādau yathā syāt| iha mā bhūt-- sūpena saṃsṛṣṭā sthālīti| udakenodasikta odana iti| udakaṃ vyañjanaṃ na bhavati; vyañjanaśabdasya sūpādāveva rūḍhatvāt| nanu yadvyañjanairupasiktaṃ tattaiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ bhavati; tatra saṃskṛtameva siddham ? na sidhyati; sato hyutkarṣāvānaṃ saṃskāraḥ, na cāsau sarvatropasiktaḥ sambhavati| tathā hi-- vyapagate svādurasai pratibhāvāpannairupasikteṣvodanādiṣvapakarṣa eva bhavati, notkarṣaḥ| upasiktamātre'pi ceṣyate| tasmāt prāk tasya pṛthagārambhaḥ|| 27. ojaḥ sahombhasā vartate| (4.4.27) `varttate' iti| ceṣṭata ityarthaḥ| `tatprakriyāviśeṣaṇam' ityādi| anena hi vṛttyarthasya karttavyatāmācaṣṭa| varttata iti varttamānaṃ karotyarthaḥ| sa hi vṛttyarthaḥ karttavyatayā sambadhyamānaḥ karma sampadyate| tatsāmānādikaraṇyācca tadviśeṣaṇamapi karttavyatayā yujyate| tadapi karma ca prasaktam| kriyāviśeṣaṇasyaivākarmake'pi dhātau karmatvamākhyātam| tadityanena dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāmapi dvitīyāntā iha prakṛtayo nirdiṣṭā vispaṣṭārtham; anyathā pratyayavidhau pañcamī nyāyyeti tadantā eva nirdiśyeran|| 28. tatpratyanupūrvamīpalomakūlam| (4.4.28) `prātīpikaḥ' iti| pratigatā āpo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| evañca `dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt' (6.3.97) itīttvam| aparatra tu `ūdanordeśe' (6.3.98) iti deśādanyatrottvameva, tataṣṭhak| `{prātilomikaḥ, ānalomikaḥ--kāśikā,padamañjarī ca|} prātilomikam, ānulomikam' iti| pratigatāni lomānyasya , anugatāni lomānyasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ac pratyanu' (5.4.75) ityādinā'c samāsāntaḥ|| 29. parimukhañca| (4.4.29) `pañcamyayāṅparibhiḥ' (2.3.10) iti pañcamī| `apaparibahirarañcavaḥ pañcamyā' (2.1.12) ityavyayībhāvasamāsaḥ, tataṣṭhak| svābhimukhaṃ varjayitvā yaḥ sevako varttate sa pārimukhikaḥ| sarvatobhāve vā pariḥ, tasya `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti prādisamāsaḥ| yato yataḥ svāmino mukhaṃ varttate tatastato yaḥ sevako varttate sa pārimukhikaḥ|| 30. pyacchati garhyam| (4.4.30) `dviguṇam' iti| tādarthyāt tācchabdyaṃ darśayati| ādviguṇārthe vastuni dviguṇaśabdaṃ varttayitvā tatra pratyayaṃ kurvataḥ ko'bhiprāyaḥ ? evaṃ manyate-- dvaiguṇika iti uttamarṇa ucyate, na cāsau dviguṇaṃ prayacchati, kiṃ tarhi ? skandayitvā dviguṇaṃ gṛhṇāti; anyathā hi viparyaye sati prasasyameva syāt, na tu garhyam| yadaikasminnarthe tādarthyād‌dviguṇaśabdo varttate tadaikameva dviguṇārthaṃ prayacchato dviguṇameva bhavatīti garhyamiti| garhā punariha pratiṣiddhasya śāstreṇa dīyamānasya pratyavāyahetutvādvetitavyā| `prakṛtyantaram' ityāpinopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe'| tatrāpi tādarthyādvṛddhyarthaṃ yaddīyate tad‌vṛdhudhiśabdenocyate| nanu ca tatpratyākhyāne vṛddhiśabdāt pratyaye sati vārdhika ityapi syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avyavikanyāyena hi vṛddhiśabdena vākyameva bhavati| vṛdhuṣiśabdena vākyaṃ vṛttiśca|| 31. kusīdadaśaikādaśāt ṣṭhanṣṭhacau| (4.4.31) tatrāpi kusīdārthe vastuni daśaikādaśārtheṣu ca daśasu daśaikādaśaśabdaṃ varttayitvā tataḥ pratyayaḥ| sarvataḥ pūrvavadabhiprāyo veditavyaḥ| daśa caikādaśa ceti samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ| nanu ca bhinnaviṣayayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyate ? daśaikādaśaśabhdo'pyekādaśārtheṣu daśasvevopacarādvarttata ityadoṣaḥ| yo daśa prayacchatyekādaśa eva syuriti sa daśaikādaśa ityucyate| daśaikādaśāditi nirdeśādakārāntatvaṃ nipātyate; kimartham ? vākye'pyakārāntatvaśravaṇārtha daśaikādaśān prayacchatīti|| 32. uñchati| (4.4.32) `uñchati' iti| uddhunotītyarthaḥ|| 33. rakṣati| (4.4.33) 34. śabdadarduraṃ karoti| (4.4.34) tadityanenaiva dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ śabdadarduramiti dvitīyānirdeśo laukikavākyapradarśanārthaḥ| śabdadarduraṃ karotītyedvyāvahārikaṃ vākyam| asya pratigraho yatra loke vyavahārastatra pratyayo bhavati nānyatretyartha sūcayate, tena śabdaṃ karoti ravara ityatra na bhavati| loke sa śābdika ityucyate yaḥ śabdaṃ vetti; vaiyākaraṇa eva śabdaṃ vetti, tena tatraiva pratyayo bhavati, na khare| ca asau vaiyākaraṇaḥ pratyayaprakṛtyādinā sarvaṃ śabdaṃ jānāti|| 35. pakṣimatsyamṛgānhanti| (4.4.35) `svarūpasya paryāyāṇāñca tadviśeṣaṇānāñca grahamiṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi paryāyādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ labhyate ? arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśe svarūpasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati, nārthapradhāna iti pratipāditametat prāk| yadi tarhi paryāyāṇāmapi grahaṇam, ajihmān hantyanimiṣān hantītyatrāpi prāpnoti ? naiṣa doṣaḥ iha dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ punarditīyāsamarthavibhaktinirdeśo laukikavākyapradarśanārthaḥ| asay parigrahaḥ-- yatra laukikavākyavyavahārastatra pratyayo bhavati nānyatretyasyārthasya sūcanārtham, tenājihmān hantītyādau pratyayo na bhavati| ajihmān hantyanimiṣān hantītyasyārthasya vivakṣāyāmājihmikaḥ, ānimiṣika iti loke na vyavahāro'sti| tatra pakṣiṣu `pākṣikaḥra' itaci svarūpasyodāharaṇam| `śākunikaḥ' iti paryāyasya| `māyūrikaḥ, taittirikaḥ' iti| viśeṣasya| matsyeṣu `mātsyikaḥra' iti svarūpasya | `mainikaḥra' iti paryāyasya | `śāpharikaḥra, śākulikaḥ'iti viśeṣasya| mṛgeṣu `mārgikaḥ' iti svarūpasya| `hāriṇikaḥra' iti paryāyasya| `saukarikaḥ, sāraṅgikaḥ' iti viśeṣasya|| 36. paripanthañca tiṣṭhati| (4.4.36) yathā parimukhañceti parimukhaśabdasyāvyayībhāvatvaṃ tatpuruṣatvañca, tathehāpi paripanthaśabdasya taddvayaṃ veditavyam| `taditi dvitīyāsamarthāt' iti| nanu ca tiṣṭhatirayamakarmakaḥ tatkathaṃ dvitīyayā saha sambandhaḥ ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; akarmaṇāmapi hi {kālabhāvādhvanāṃ mudritapāṭhaḥ} kālabhāvādhnaḥ karmasaṃjñāṃ pratipadyante| tathā coktam-- `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām' (vā.1.3.51) iti| `pāripanthikaścauraḥ' ityavyayībhāvaḥ| cauro yaḥ panthānaṃ varṇayitvā tiṣṭhati sa pāripanthikaśabdenocyate| tatpuruṣapakṣe tu yaścauraḥ patho vyāpya tiṣṭhati sa paripanthika ucyate| `cakāraḥ' ityādi| tiṣṭhati cetyatra pratyayārthasamanantarameva cakāro draṣṭavyaḥ, tena samānajātīyasyaiva pratyayārthasya samuccayaṃ karoti| atha prakṛtereva samuccayaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate ? karmatvānupapatteḥ | tatra hi dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiranuvarttate, tiṣṭhateścākarmakatvāt prakṛtāyā matsyādeḥ pkṛteḥ karmabhāvo nopapadyate| kālabhāvādhvanāmeva hyakarmakāṇāṃ karmasaṃjñeṣyate, na matsyādīnām| laukikavākyapradarśanārthaṃ tadetad‌dvitīyoccāraṇaṃ karotītyāha-- `{paripathaśabdaparyāyaḥ--kāśikā}paripathaparyāyaḥ' iti| kimetasya jñāpane prayojanamityāha-- `sa viṣayāntare' ityādi| asati hyasmin jñāpane ṭhakpratyayasanniyogena prakṛtirnirdiśyamānā pratyayābhāvena prasajyate| jñāpane tu sati yatrāpi pratyayo na bhavati tatrāpi prayoga upapadyate|| 37. māthottarapadapadavyanupadaṃ dhāvati| (4.4.37) daṇḍabhāvo mātho daṇḍamāthaḥ - ṛjuḥ panthā ucyate, taṃ dhāvati `dāṇḍamāthikaḥ'| śulkasya māthaḥ śulkamāthaḥ, `śaulkamathikaḥ'| padasya paścādanupadam, paścādarthe'vyībhāvaḥ, anupadaṃ dhāvati-- `ānupadikaḥ' | pratyāsatyā dhāvatītyarthaḥ| dvitīyāyāṃ samarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ punardvitīyānirdeśaḥ `iṣṭād‌dvitīyāntādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt' ityevamartham| tena yaḥ `anuryatsamayā' (2.1.15) `yasya cāyāmaḥ' (2.1.16) `kugatipradāyaḥ' (2.2.18) ityādibhiryogairanuśabdasya samāsaḥ, tato na bhavati|| 38. ākrandāṭaṭhñca| (4.4.38) `ārttāyanam' iti. paritrāṇārthamīyate gamyata ityayanam, ārttānāmayanamārttāyanam| śaraṇamityarthaḥ|| 39. padottarapadaṃ gṛhṇāti| (4.4.39) padagrahaṇena svarūpameva gṛhyate, na suptiṅantaṃ padam| ata evāha-- `padaśabda uttarapadaṃ yasya' iti| etacca dvitīyāyāṃ laukikaravākyapradarśanārthatvād‌dvitīyānirdeśāllabhyate| padottarapadaṃ gṛhṇātītyetallaukikaṃ vākyam| asya pradarśanenaitat sūcitam-- laukikasya hi padasya grahaṇam, na pāribhāṣikasyeti| atha padāntādityeva kasmānnoktam ? ityāha-- `padāntāditi noktam' ityādi| gatārtham| padamevottarapadaṃ yasya tasmādyathā syāt| iha tu ślokapādapadaṃ gṛhṇātīti bhavatīti kecit|| 40. pratikaṇṭhārthalalāmañca| (4.4.40) kaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ prati pratikaṇṭham, yathārthe'vyayībhāvaḥ, ābhimukhye vā ` lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye' (2.1.14) iti| kaṇṭhasyābhimukhya iti| kaṇṭhasyābhimukhyaṃ pratikaṇṭham, prātikaṇṭhikaḥ sa ucyate sarva kaṇṭhaṃ yo gṛhṇāti, yo vā kaṇṭhamābhimukhyena gṛhṇāti| dvitīyāsamarthaprakaraṇe punardvitīyānta prakṛtinirdeśa iṣṭādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| tena pratigataḥ kaṇṭhamiti `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti tatpuruṣo yaḥ pratikaṇṭhaśabdastato na bhavati|| 41. dharmañcarati| (4.4.41) `caratirāsevāyām' iti| āsevā - paunaḥpunyam| `adharmācca vaktavyam' iti| adharmaśabdāccaratītyetasminnarthe ṭhagbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam-- pūrvasūtrādiha cakāra'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārtho veditavyaḥ, tenādharmādapi bhaviṣyati|| 42. pratipathameti ṭham̐śca| (4.4.42) `pratipadhikam' iti| pūrvavadvīpsāyām, ābhimukhye vā'vyayībhāvaḥ| panthānaṃ panthānaṃ prati pratipatham| ābhimukhye-- patha ābhimukhyaṃ pratipatham| yaḥ sarvān patha eti, ābhimukhyena vā panthānameti sa prātipadika iti cābhidhīyate|| 43. samavāyān samavaiti| (4.4.43) `samavāyaḥ samūha ucyate, na samprasāraṇā' iti| kuta etat ? tatra samavaitītyasya pratyayārthasyāyogāt| āgatya tadekadeśībhavatīti samavaitiśabdasyārthaḥ| sampradhāraṇā cāmūrtiḥ, caitasiko dharmaḥ, na ca tadekadeśībhavituṃ śakyate| tasmāt samūha eva samavāyaśabdasyārthaḥ, naitītyasyārthaḥ| etīti varttamāne samavaitīti vacanamarthaviśeṣapratipattyartham| etīti prāptimātraṃ kurvannucyate| samavaitītyāgatya tadekadeśībhavatīti|| 44. pariṣado ṇyaḥ| (4.4.44) 45. senāyā vā| (4.4.45) 46. saṃjñāyāṃ lalāṭakakkuṭyau paśyati| (4.4.46) `abhidheyaniyamārthaḥ' iti| abhidheye sevakaviśeṣe ca pratyayāntasya niyamaḥ| tatraiva vṛttiryathā syādityevamartham| `na tu rūḍhyartham' iti| lālāṭikakaukkuṭikaśabdayo rūḍhyāmekatvāt| `tadanena' ityādi| yata eva sarvāvayavebyo lalāṭaṃ dūre dṛśyate, tasmādanena lalāṭadarśanena sevakasya svāminaṃ pratyanupaśleṣo labhyate| na tvatra lalāṭārtho darśanaṃ cāsti| yādṛśaścānupaśleṣo vivakṣitaḥ, taṃ `kāryeṣvanupasthāyitvam' ityanena darśayati| `kukkuṭīśabdenāpi' ityādi| kakkuṭyā hyalpadeśaviṣayaḥ pāto bhavati| tadanena kukkuṭīpātadeśasyālpatā lakṣyate| na tvatra kukkuṭyartho deśaśca vidyate|| 47. tasya dharmyam| (4.4.47) 48. aṇ mahiṣyādibhyaḥ| (4.4.48) 49. ṛto'ñ| (4.4.49) 50. avakrayaḥ| (4.4.50) 51. tadasya paṇyam| (4.4.51) apūpāḥ paṇyamasyetyāpūpikaḥ| atha yathā vākye paṇyaśabdo yujyate tathā vṛttāvapi kasmānna yujyate ? ityāha-- `paṇyam' iti| `viśeṣaṇam' ityādi| atha ya evamavekṣyamāṇaḥ paṇyārthaṃ vṛttāvantarbhāvayati tena gatārthatvāt paṇyaśabdo na prayujyate|| 52. lavaṇāṭhṭhañ| (4.4.52) 53. kiśarādibhyaḥ ṣṭhan| (4.4.53) 54. śalāluno'nyatarasyām| (4.4.54) `śalālukaḥ'iti| `isusuktāntāt kaḥ' (7.3.51)|| 55.śilpam| (4.4.55) `śilpaṃ kauśalam' iti| kriyābhyāsapūrvako jñānaviśeṣaḥ| `mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śilpamasya' iti| mṛdaṅgo vādyate yena śilpena tanmṛdaṅgavādanam| nanu ca mṛdaṅgavādanaṃ śilpaṃ yasyeti vigṛhya pratyaya utpadyamāno mṛdaṅgavādanaśabdādeva prāpnoti, na tu mṛdaṅgaśabdāt, tato mārdaṅgavādanika iti bhavitavyam, tatkathaṃ mārdaṅgika iti bhavati ? ityāha-- `mṛdaṅgavādanam' ityādi| mṛdaṅgaśabda eva pratyayamutpadayati, sa tu mṛdaṅgavādane varttamānaḥ, na mṛdaṅge| atraśabdaśaktisvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ| na cāyaṃ niyamaḥ-- yena vigrahaḥ kriyate, tata eva pratyayena bhavitavyamiti| yathā hyaveridaṃ māṃsamāvikam, māṃsamityaviśabdena vigrahaḥ kriyate'vikaśabdādeva pratyayo bhavati, tathehāpi mṛdaṅgavādanaśabdena vigrahaḥ kriyate, pratyayastu mṛdaṅśabdādbhavati| tena tatra gatārthatvācchilpaśabdo na prayujyata ityabhiprāyaḥ|| 56. maḍḍukajharjharādaṇanyatarasyām| (4.4.56) 57. praharaṇam| (4.4.57) `dhānuṣkaḥ' iti| kādeśaḥ `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ' (8.3.39) iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam|| 58. paraśvadhāṭṭhañ ca| (4.4.58) 59. śaktiyaṣṭyorīkak| (4.4.59) atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham, ikageva nocyeta, ikakyapi savarṇadīrghatve kṛte śāktīko yāṣṭīka iti sidhyatyeva ? na sidhyati; ikārasya `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopena bhavitavyam| tatkutaḥ savarṇadīrghatvam ? ikāroccāraṇasāmarthyādeva lopo na bhaviṣyati| nanu cāvagrahanivṛttirikārasya prayojanaṃ syāt ? naitat; yadi hyetat prayojanaṃ syāt sūtrārambho'narthakhaḥ syāt; ṭhakāpyanavagrahasya siddhatvāt ? nānarthakaḥ ; vākyanivṛttyarthatvāt| evamapi pratyayagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt, ṭhakpratyayo hi prakṛtaḥ , tatraitāvadena vaktavyam-- śakkatiyaṣṭyoriti| evaṃ punarvidhānāṃ vākyanivṛttyarthaṃ bhaviṣyati, kimīkagvidhānena ? tasmādikaggrahaṇasāmarthyāllopo na bhaviṣyati| evamapi ṭhakaiva `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopābhāvenānavagrahe siddhe hīkaggrahaṇamadhikavidhānārthaṃ pratīyate| tena `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopo na bhavati| yathā tasmādakaḥ savarṇe (6.1.101) dīrgho'pi na syāditi vigṛhītameva śrūyeta| tasmādīkagvaktavyaḥ|| 60. astināstidiṣṭaṃ matiḥ| (4.4.60) `kiṃ tarhi paraloko'stīti {yasya matiḥ--kāśikā} matiryasya' iti| kathaṃ punarasati viśeṣopādāna etallabhyate ? ityāha-- `tadetat' ityādi| abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyāllabhyate| nanu cāstīti tiṅantam, nāstīti vākyam| ata etābhyāṃ na prāpnoti pratyayaḥ, prātipadikādhikārāt (4.1.1.) ? ityata āha-- `astināstiśabdau' ityādi| abhyupagamyāpi tiṅantatvaṃ vākyatvañca parihārāntaramāha-- `vacanādākhyātādvākyācca pratyayaḥ' iti|| 61. śīlam| (4.4.61) `apūpabhakṣaṇaṃ śīlamasya' iti| śīlaviṣayatvādupācārāt tathā vyapadeśaḥ| bhakṣaṇakriyā tadviṣayañca śīlaṃ taddhitavṛttāvantarbhavati| tena tatra pratīyamānatvādbhakṣaṇaśīlaśabdau na prayujyete iti bhāvaḥ|| 62. chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ| (4.4.62) chattraśīlatvaṃ śiṣyasya pratipādayitumāha-- `chādanādapavāraṇācchattram' ityādi| apavāriṇādityanena cchādanādityasyārthaṃ vyaktīkaroti| ācchādayati hi yat tacchatramityucyate , tena śiṣyo'pi gurukāryatatparo gururyāni cchidrāṇi gopayati teṣāmāvaraṇāya pravṛttastatra yuktaḥ sacchatrasahacaritāṃ kriyāmācaram̐śchattraśīlo bhavati| `sthāśabdo'tra paṭhyate, sa copasargapūrvo gṛhyate' iti| tataśca tasya `ātaścopasarge' (3.3.106) ityaṅpratyayamutpādyāpyutpāditatvāt| kevalasya tu pāṭhaḥ sarvopasargasaṃgrahārthaḥ| `curā' iti, paṭhyate, tatra nipātanādakārapratyayo guṇābhāvaśca|| 63. karmādhyayane vṛttam| (4.4.63) kriyayā yadvyāpyamānamīpsitatamamanīpsitatamaṃ vā tat karma| iha tvanīpsitatamaṃ gamyate| ata evāha-- `yasyādhyayanaprayuktasya' ityādi| na hi kasyacidadhyayane yuktasya parīkṣākāle paṭhataḥ skhalitapāṭharūpamīpsitaṃ bhavati| adhyayanaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ, karmasādhano vā| adhītam, adhīyate, vā'dhyayanam| vṛttaṃ - bhūtam,utpannamityarthaḥ| `ekamanyat'ityādi| samyak pāṭhāpekṣayānyo'rtho veditavyaḥ| `dvaiyanyikaḥ; traiyanyikaḥ' iti| `na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyām' (7.3.3) ityaijāgamaḥ| `adhyayane karma vṛttamityetat sarvaṃ taddhitavṛttāvantarbhavati' iti| tena tatrādhyayanavṛttaśabdo'vagatārthatvānna prayujyata iti bhāvaḥ|| 64. bahvacpūrvapadāṭṭhac| (4.4.64) `dvādaśānyikaḥ' iti| dvādaśaśabdo bahvacpūrvapadam| dvau ca daśa ceti dvandvaḥ| `dvyaṣṭanaḥ saṃkhyāyāmabahuvrīhyaśītyoḥ' (6.3.47) ityāttvam, tato dvādaśānyānīti vigṛhya `taddhitārthe' 92.1.51) iti samāsaḥ| nanu caikādeśe kṛte pūrvottarapadābhāvāt bahvacpūrvapadaṃ na bhavati, na cāntādivadbhāvo'sti -- `ubhayata āśraye nāntādivat' (vyā.pa.51) naiṣa doṣaḥ; `nendrasya parasya' (7.3.22) iti jñāpakādeśādeśāt pūrvaṃ pratyayaḥ| `tatrodaśānyikaḥ' iti| trayaśca daśa ceti dvandvaḥ, `trestrayaḥ' (6.3.48) iti traya ādeśaḥ| anyaśabdo'tra samyak pāṭhāpekṣayāpapāṭhe varttata ityata āha-- `caturdaśāpapāṭhāḥra' ityādi| kathaṃ punarjñāyate'pāṭhe'nyaśabdo varttate ? ityāha-- `udātte' ityādi| udātte karttavye'nudāttakaraṇamapapāṭhaḥ| tatra ya udātte karttavye'nudāttaṃ karoti sa yasmādanyaṃ karoṣītyucyate tato jñāyate'nyaśabdo'papāṭhe varttata iti|| 65.hitaṃ bhakṣāḥ| (4.4.65) nanu hitaśabdayoge caturthyā bhavitavyam, `hitayoge caturthī bhavati' (vā. 123) ityupasaṃkhyānāt, `tasmaihitam' (5.1.5) iti nirdeśāt ? `sāmarthyādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati' iti| sāmarthya punastadevopasaṃkhyānam| liṅgañca--hitārthā kriyā taddhitavṛttāntarbhavati, tena na prayujyata iti|| 66. tadasmai dīyate niyuktam| (4.4.66) nanu ca `tadasay paṇyam' (4.4.51) ityatastaditi prathamā samarthavibhaktiranuvartiṣyate, tadapārthakaṃ punaḥ prathamāsamarthavibhaktyupādānām; `asmai' iti pratyayārthopyapārthaka eva| tathā hi `asya' (4.4.51) ityanuvarttate, tatra `dīyatau' iti ityabhisambandhātttu sam‌paradānatvena bhavitavyam| tataśca śeṣasambandhe nivṛtte caturthyamatra vipariṇamyate, tasmāt `dīyate niyuktam' ityetāvadeva vaktavyam ? atrocyate-- samarthavibhaktyupādānaṃ tāvat pūrvasūtre samarthavibhaktiviśeṣaḥ pratyayanutpādayatītyasay sūcanārtham. teneha na bhavati-- duḥkhamasyādhyane vṛttam, ajayo'syādhyayane vṛtta iti| apapāṭha eva hi vṛtte pratyaya iṣyate| dīyamāne na sarvasmāt caturthī-- areḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dadātīti| sa ca ṣaṣṭhyā eva viṣayo'rthaḥ| ṣaṣṭhyarthaṃ eva pratyayo vijñāyate, caturthyantādyathā syāt| evaṃ `asmai' iti pratyayārtho nirdiśyate|| 67. śrāṇāmāṃsaudanāṭ‌ṭiṭhan| (4.4.67) `atha ṭhañeva kasmānnoktaḥ' iti| eva hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| syādetat-- ṭhañṭiṭhanorviśeṣo'sti, ataṣṭinnukto na ṭhañ ? ityata āha-- `na hyatra' ityādi| dvyorapyanayorvṛddhatvānnāsti viśeṣaḥ| yo'pi `vṛddhinimittasya' (6.3.39) ityādinā ṭhañi puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, tasay `na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) iti ṭiṭhnnapyabhāvānnātra ṭhañṭiṭhanoḥ kaścidviśeṣo'sti| `māṃsaudana' ityādinā viśeṣaṃ darśayati| `kecit' iti vacanādvigṛhītagrahaṇaṃ kecinnecchanatītyetaduktaṃ bhavati| tanmate ṭhañeva vaktavyaḥ| ṭiṭhatvacanaṃ vaicitryārtha veditavyam|| 68. bhaktādaṇanyatarasyām| (4.4.68) 69. tatra niyuktaḥ| (4.4.69) atha `niyuktaḥ' (4.4.66) iti varttamāne punarniyuktagrahaṇaṃ kasmāt kriyate ? arthabhedāt| na tasya hyakavyabhicāralakṣaṇo nityabhāvo'rthaḥ| asya tu tato'nya evārtho yadāha-- `niyuto'dhikṛtaḥ' ityādi|| 70. agārāntāṭhṭhan| (4.4.70) 71. adhyāyinyadeśakālāt| (4.4.71) adhyetuṃ śīlamasyetyadhyāyī, tācchīliko ṇiniḥ| `adhyayanasya yau deśakālau śāstreṇa pratiṣiddhau tāvadeśakālaśabdenocyete' iti| apratiṣiddhābhyāṃ deśakālaśabdābhyāmanyatvāt paryudāsavṛttyā'bhakṣyāsparśanīyavadadhyayanasyeti| ata āha-- tasyādhyāyinā pratyayārthena sannidhāpitatvāt| na hi vinādhyayanenādhyāyyupapadyate|| 72. kaṭhināntaprastārasaṃsthāneṣu vyavaharati| (4.4.72) alpāctarasya prastāraśabdasya ca pūrvanipātamakurvannetat sūcayati-- anyadapi kāryaṃ lakṣaṇaprāptaṃ na bhavati| tena kaṭhināntaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti kaṭhinaśabdāntaṃ prātipadikaṃ gṛhyate| `{haratirayam-- prā.mu. pāṭhaḥ} vyavaharatirayamasti paṇinā samānārthaḥ-- yasya `vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ' (2.3.57) ityatra grahaṇam, asti vivāde-- vyavahāre parihṛtamiti, asti ca vikṣepe śalākāṃ vyavaharatīti, asti ca laukike kriyātatve-- laukiko vyavahāra iti| iha tu kriyātattve varttamānasya grahaṇamityetaddarśayitumāha--`vyavahāraḥ kriyātattvam' iti| kriyāyā aviparītasvabhāvatvādi kriyātattvam| `yathā' ityādi| laukiko vyavahāra ityatra yathā vyavahāraḥ kriyātattve varttate, tathehāpi darśayati| kriyātattve varttamānasya grahaṇam| `tatra' (4.4.69) itisaptamyadhikāre saptamīnirdeśāt prasiddhyupasaṃgrahaṇaṃ labhyate| `vāṃśakaṭhinikaśchakracaraḥra' iti| yaścakracaraḥ sannanuṣṭheyāṃ kriyāṃ śāstroktamavigītā vaṃśakaṭhine'nutiṣṭhati sa evamucyate|| 73. nikaṭe vasati| (4.4.73) nikaṭe samīpa ityarthaḥ| yatra śāstrato nikaṭavāsastatrāyāyaṃ vidhiḥ| etacca saptamyāṃ samarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ punaḥ saptamīnirdeśāt prasiddhyupasaṃgrahaṇena labhyate| sa hyevamarthaḥ kṛtaḥ-- iṣṭe saptamyante yathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| sa punaḥ śāstrato nikaṭavāsa āraṇyakasya bhikṣoriti darśayati-- `āraṇyakena bhikṣuṇā' ityādi|| 74. āvasthāt ṣṭhal| (4.4.74) 75. prāgghitādyat| (4.4.75) 76. tadvahita rathayugaprāsaṅgam| (4.4.76) taditi dvitīyāmarthavibhaktau labdhāyāṃ rathādīnāṃ dvitīyānirdeśa iṣṭādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| tenehava bhavati-- gauryugya iti; iha na bhavati-- yugaṃ vahati rājā kaliṃ dvāparaṃ veti| tathā prāsajyata iti prāsaṅgaḥ, yat kāṣṭhaṃ vahanakāle vatsānāṃ kaṇṭhaāsajyate tatprāsaṅgaḥ, taṃ vahati prāsaṅgyaḥ| iha na bhavati-- prasaṅgādāgataṃ prāsaṅgam| `yugyañca pattre' (3.1.121) iti nipātanādyugyaśabde siddhe yugagrahaṇaṃ svarārtham| na yugyamayugyamityatra naño guṇapratiṣedhe `sampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ' (6.2.155) ityato naña ityanuvarttamāne `yayatoścātadarthe' (6.2.156) iti naña uttarasyāntodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| tena na hyekasvaro labhyate| tasya kyabantatvāt|| 77. dhuro yaḍḍhakau| (4.4.77) atha `dhuro ṭhak ca' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam, cakāraḥ samuccayārthaḥ, yathābhihite pratyaye vijñāyamāne yadeva bhaviṣyati ? naitadevam; yo hi dhuraṃ vahati dhuso'sau voḍhā bhavati|tasya yathāvihite pratyaye vijñāyamāne `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇapi syāt| yad‌garhaṇāt tasyedaṃvivakṣāyāmapi yadeva bhavati|| 78.khaḥ sarvadhurāt| (4.4.78) `sarvadhuram' iti| sarvā cāsau dhūśceti `pūrvakālaika' (2.1.49) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' (5.4.74) ityādinā samāsāntaḥ| `strīliṅge nyāyye' iti| tatpuruṣasyottarapadārthapradhānatvāt `paravalihghaṃ dvandvatatpuruṣayoḥ' (2.4.26) iti dhūḥśabdasya yalliṅgaṃ tadeva nyāyyamiti| tatra `sarvadhurāyāḥ' iti sūtre karttavye yataḥ sarvadhurāditi napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśaḥ sa śabdarūpāpekṣaḥ, arthāpekṣe hi nirdeśe paravalliṅgatā bhavati| ayantu śabdarūpāpekṣaḥ,śabdarūpañca napuṃsakamiti napuṃsakenaiva nirdeśo yuktaḥ| arthavivakṣāyāṃ tu strīliṅgameva bhavati-- sarvadhurāṃ vahatīti|| 79.ekadhurālluk ca| (4.4.79) `ekadhurāt' ityayamapi śabdarūpāpekṣayā nirdeśaḥ| arthāpekṣayā hi paravalliṅgatā bhavati| atrāpi pūrvavat samāsasamāsāntau veditavyau| vacanasāmarthyātpakṣe lugvidhīyate| yadi hi nityo luk syāt, khasya vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt, yata eva hi lukaṃ vidadhyāt|nanu caikadhuraśabdāt kenacidvihito na syāt, tasya kathaṃ luk śakyate vijñātum ? lugvacanādeva yato'pi vidhiranugamyata ityadoṣaḥ|| 80. śakaṭādaṇ| (4.4.80) rathaśakaṭahalasīrebhyaḥ pratyayavidhānamanarthakam, `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityanenaiva siddhatvāt| śabdabhedādvidhānamiti cedanyo hi śabdo rathaṃ vahatīti, anyo hi rathasya voḍheti| tadā'rthāśrayatvāt pratyayavidhānasyārthasāmānyāt siddham| na hi kaścidravyamityukte rathasyāyamityevāvaiti, vahatyarthaḥ pratīyate| tasmāt syādeva rathādyat|| 81. halasīrāṭṭhak| (4.4.81) śakaṭādaṇevotsargaḥ karttavyaḥ| evañca vākyaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ; yatā-- rathasya voñā rathya iti| na tat vidhīyate; tatra pratyayavidhāne `dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) ityanena luk prāpnoti| anena punarna prāpnoti, kasmāt ? `prāgādīvyato'ṇ' (4.1.83) ityadhikārāt| nanu ca kriyāmāṇe'pīha dvigoraṇ pratyayo na prāpnoti, `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti' (vyā.pa.89) iti ? na; etadeva hi `śakaṭādaṇ' (4.4.80) ityavamādikaṃ jñāpakaṃ bhavati tadantavidheriti| tena dvaihalikaḥ, dvaiśakaṭaḥ , dvaisīrika ityevamādikaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati|| 82. saṃjñāyāṃ janyāḥ| (4.4.82) astyatra yarbha iti `{in ityeva sūtram-- da.u.} in sarvadhātubhyaḥ' (da.u.1.46) janayatīti vā| `atra kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' (ga.sū.50) `sarvato'ktinnarthāt' (ga.sū.51) iti ṅīp-- janī, tāṃ vahanti janyāḥ - jāmāturvayasyāḥ| vivāhamānitābhidhīyate| kecittu karttari jāyate'syāṃ garbha iti `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti lyuṭi jananaśabdācca ṅīpi nakārākārayorlopena sādhayanti| nanu ca janīśabdādeva yadvidheyaḥ ? sarvakālārthaṃ nipātanamityeke|| 83. vidhyatyadhanuṣā| (4.4.83) `padyāḥ' iti| `padyatyatadarthe' (6.3.53) itipādaśabdasya padbhāvaḥ| `ūravyāḥ' iti| `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ| `nanu ca' ityādi| dhanuratra prakṛtyarthaḥ, pratyayārthena vāhyaṃ karaṇamapekṣyate, tena sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavatītyasāmarthyam ? nanu caṭa vyadhanamevātra sāpekṣam, kriyayā karaṇaṃ sambadhyata iti kṛtvā, tacca vyadhanaṃ kriyāpradhānatvādākhyātasya pradhānaṃ bavati, pradhānas sāpekṣasya bhavatyeva vṛttiḥ, yathā-- rājupuraṣo'yamabhirūpa iti ? naitadasti; yadyapi kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, tathāpīha pratyayārthaṃ eva pradhānam| pratyayārthasya sādhanaṃ vyaddhā| tathā ca prāguktam--`kriyāpradhānatve'pi cākhyātasya taddhiteḥ svabhāvāt sādhanapradhānaḥ' iti| atha kriyādvāreṇa vyaddhurapi karaṇaṃ pratyapekṣā bhavatīti kalpyate, tathā ca sati prakṛtyarthasyāpi kriyādvāreṇaiva karaṇaṃ pratyapekṣā bhavatīti kena vāryate ! na hi pādau vidhyati dhanuṣeti karaṇavivakṣāyāṃ vyadhanamātrasya pādau karma dhanuṣkaraṇaviśiṣṭasya| tasmādvyadhanasyāpi kriyākaraṇe pratyapekṣetyasāmrathyātpratyayo na bhaviṣyati| `anabhidhānācca' iti| atraivocapapattyanataram| kathaṃ punarupapattyantaramityāha-- `na hi' ityādi| dhanuṣā padya ityukte dhanuṣa padyaṃ pratyupalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ sambhāvyate, yathā--śikhayā parivrājakamadrākṣīdittra śikhayā parivrājakaṃ prati| dhanuṣā saha dṛṣṭaḥ padya ityeṣo'pyarthaścāśaṅkyate| na tu pādau vidhyati dhanuṣetyayamartho vivakṣitaḥ pratīyate| `evaṃ tarhi ' ityādinā kriyāviśeṣaṇaparo dhanuṣeti nirdeśaḥ; na dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvapratiṣedhaḥ| pratiṣedhe pradhānamiti darśayati--`tena' ityādinā| kriyata eva dhanuṣaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, tena kriyā viśeṣyate| tena cauraṃ vidhyatītyādau na bhaviṣyati| sambhāvyate hi caurādivyadhanakriyayā dhanuṣaḥ karaṇatvam|| 84. dhanagaṇaṃ labdhā| (4.4.84) kathaṃ punaratra dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiḥ, yāvatā `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam ? ityāha-- `labdheti tṛnnantam' ityādi| tṛnnantasya hi prayoge `na lokāvyayaniṣṣākhalarthatṛnām' (2.3.69) iti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhena dvitīyā bhavati|| 85. annāṇṇaḥ| (4.4.85) 86. vaśa gataḥ| (4.4.86) vaśaḥ - kāmaḥ, icchā| vaserdhātorata eva nipātanādapratyayaḥ| dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau prakṛtāyāṃ vaśamiti dvitīyānirdeśa iṣṭe viṣaye dvitīyāntādyathā syāt, aniṣṭānmā bhūt| tenehaiva bhavati-- vaśaṃ gataḥ, icchāprāptaḥ, vidheya ityatraiva bhavati|| 87. padamasmin dṛśyam| (4.4.87) karmaṇaḥ kṛtaivābhihitatvād‌dvitīyā na sambhavati| na ca dvitīyāprathamābhyāmanyatra vibhaktau padamiti rūpamupapadyate| tasmāt prathamāntamevaitaditi niścityāha-- `nirdeśādeva' ityādi|| 88. mūlamasyāvarhi| (4.4.88) āvarhaṇamāvarhaḥ, utpādanamityarthaḥ| vṛherāṅapūrvādbhāve ghañ, āvarho'syāstītyāvarhīti| dvitīyāvibhaktiriha nāsti| na ca prathamādvitīyābhyāmanyasyāṃ vibhaktau mūlamityetadrūpamupapadyate| tasmāt prathamāntamevaitat| nirdeśādeva prathamā samarthavibhaktirupapadyate iti matvāha-- `mūlaśabdāt prathamāsamarthāt' iti|| 89. saṃjñāyāṃ dhenuṣyā| (4.4.89) `yaśca pratyayaḥ' iti| kimarthaṃ punaryapratyayo nipātyate ? ityāha-- `antodātto hyayamapīṣyate' iti| yati sati titsvareṇāntasvaritatvāt| antodāttaśceṣyate| tasmādyapratyaya eva nyāyyaḥ| na kevalaṃ saṃjñāviṣaya eveṣyate; api tvantodātto'pītyeṣo'piśabdasyārthaḥ|| 90.gṛhapitanā saṃyukte ñyaḥ| (4.4.90) `saṃyukte' iti| sambaddha ityarthaḥ| `anyasyāpi' ityādi| yathaiva hi gṛhapatiryajanamāno gārhapatye kāryaṃ karoti, tathā dakṣiṇāgnāvāhavanīye ca| tasmādanyasyāpi dakṣiṇādergṛhapatinā saṃyogo'sti| yadyevam, atiprasaṅgo'nyatra prāpnoti ? ityāha-- `tatr saṃjñādhikārāt' ityādi| abhidheyaniyamārthaṃ saṃjñāgrahaṇamanuvartate, teneha na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ|| 91. nauvayodharmaviṣamūlamūlasītātulābhyastāryatulyaprāpyavaddhyānāmyasamasamitasammiteṣu| (4.4.91) kathaṃ punarihāpi samarthavibhaktirlabhyate ? yāvatā nehopāttā, nāpyanuvarttata ityāha--`pratyayārthadvāreṇa' ityādi| dvāram - upāyaḥ, kārakamityarthaḥ| iha tāryādayaḥ pratyayārthāḥ| tatsambandhe karttari karaṇe hetau tulyārthayoge ca yathāsambhavaṃ tṛtīyaiva bhavati| tataḥ samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| `nāvyam' iti| `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ| atra nāvastaraṇakriyāyāṃ karttṛtvaṃ karaṇatvañca vivakṣāvaśādbhavatīti karaṇe karttari vā tṛtīyā | evamanyatrāpi yathāyogaṃ veditavyam| `dharmeṇa prāpyaṃ dharmyam' iti| tatpunardharmasya phalaṃ svargādyucyate| `nanu ca' ityādi| nanu ca dharmeṇa yatprāpyaṃ taddharmādanapetaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `vidhyaḥ' iti| viṣeṇa vadhamarhatītyarthaḥ| vadhyaśabdasya `daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ' (5.1.66) ityarhārthe vyutpāditatvāt| `ānāmyamabhibhavanīyam' iti| anekārthatvāddhātūnāmatra namirabhibhave varttate| `paṭādīnāmutpattikāraṇaṃ mūlam' iti| dattena hiraṇyena paṭādīnāmutpattirbhavati| `tena' iti| mūlena| `tat' iti| mūlyam' | `śeṣīkriyate' iti| anenābhibhūyata ityasyārthamācaṣṭe| śeṣīkriyate - guṇabhāvamāpādyate, apradhānīkriyata ityarthaḥ| apradhānīkaraṇeva abhibhavaḥ| kathaṃ punastena taccheṣīkriyate ? ityāha-- `mūlyaṃ hi' ityādi| hiśabdo hetau| mūlyamiha karttṛ, mūlaṃ karma| tatpraṇayena hiraṇyena paṭādayo vikrīyante| tatra yanmūlātiriktaṃ hiraṇyaṃ lābhaḥ, tanmūlyaṃ guṇo bhāvaḥ| saha tena varttata iti saguṇaḥ| guṇaḥ punariha tadeva mūlyaṃ veditavyam| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati-- yasmānmūlyabhāgenaiva bhāgabhūtena sabhāgaṃ mūlaṃ karoti na nyūnaṃ tanmūlyamabhidhīyata iti| mūlye sati tat tatra dviguṇaṃ karotītyucyate| kā punariyaṃ yuktaḥ, yadi nāma saguṇaṃ mūlaṃ karotītyucyate tat kathaṃ mūlyamabhibhūyate ? yateyaṃ yuktistadākhyāyate-- iha hi śāstre yatsiddhamupakāri tadaṅgamapradhānam, yaccopakārasādhyamanupakārakaṃ tadaṅgi pradhānamityeṣā vyavasthā| tathā coktam-- śāste dvyameveha syādaṅgamatha vā bhavedaṅgi tatra| upakāri siddamaṅgaṃ sādhyānupakārakamaṅgīti|| iti|| evañca mūlyena mūlaṃ saguṇaṃ kriyāmāṇamupakāryatvāt pradhānaṃ sampadyate, mūlyaṃ tvanupakāryatvādapradhānaṃ sampadyate| tanmūlena mūlyamabhibhūyate, tadapekṣayā tasyāḥ pradhānabhāvāpatteḥ| `tulayā sammitaṃ tulyam' iti| atra tulyārthayoge tṛtīyā| yadyapi tulyārthayoge ṣaṣṭhyapi vidhīyate,tathāpi nauprabhṛtibhyastṛtīyāsamarthebhyaḥ pratyayavidhānāt tulāśabdādapi tṛtīyāsamarthādeva pratyayo vijñāyate| `yathā' ityādinā tulayā sādṛśyaṃ darśayati| nanu ca `tulyāsyaprayatnam' (1.1.9) iti nipātanādeva tulyaśabdasya sādhutvaṃ bhaviṣyati, sa ca sadṛśa eva loke prasiddha iti nārthastulāśabdāt sammite pratyayavidhānena ? svarārthaṃ tu pratyayavidhānāt| `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) ityādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt| na hi nipātane satyādyudāttatvaṃ tulyaśabdasya śakyate vijñātum|| 92. dharmapathyarthanyāyādanapete| (4.4.91) `nirdeśādeva pañcamī samarthavibhaktiḥ' iti| yadyevam, `dhuro yaḍḍhakau' (4.4.77) ityevamādāvapi nirdeśādeva samarthavibhaktirvijñeyā ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tatra hi dvitīyā samarthavibhaktiḥ| evaṃ jñānaṃ syāt-- dvitīyānuvṛttirapārthikā syāt| iha tu na kācidvibhaktiranuvarttate, pañcamī ca sūtre śrūyate| tasmāt saiva samarthavibhaktiranukalpayituṃ yuktā|| (4.4.92) 93. chandaso nirmite| (4.4.93) pratyayārthasāmarthyalabhyā' iti| `nirmite' iti pratyayārthaḥ| tatra cchandasaḥ karaṇatvamiti sāmarthyāt tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| chandaḥśabdo'yaṃ vede triṣṭuvādau, icchāyāśca varttate; iha tvicchāyāṃ varttamāno gṛhyate, ata evāha-- `icchāyā kṛtaḥ' iti| icchāvṛttistu saṃjñāgrahaṇasyābhidheyaniyamārthasyānuvṛtterlabhyate|| 94. uraso'ṇ ca| (4.4.94) `saṃjñādhikārādabhidheyaniyamaḥ' iti| tenorasā nirmitaṃ sukhamityādau na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|| 95. hṛdayasya priyaḥ| (4.4.95) `hṛdyaḥ' iti| `hṛdayasya hṛllekha' (6.3.50) ityādinā hṛdbhāvaḥ|| 96. bandhane carṣau| (4.4.96) ṛṣiśabdo'yamastyeva guṇavati puruṣaviśeṣe, asti ca vede;iha saṃjñādhikārādeva na manuṣyagrahaṇamiti darśayati-- `ṛṣirvedo gṛhyate (iti)|| 97. matajanahalāt karaṇajalpakarṣeṣu| (4.4.97) `{pratyayārthasāmarthyāllabdhā--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ|} pratyayārthasāmarthyālabhyā' iti. karaṇādayaḥ pratyayārthāḥ| tatra karaṇādayaḥ śabdā bhāve karaṇe ca vyutpādyanta iti sāmarthyādevopalabhyamānā ṣaṣṭhīvibhaktirvijñāyate| yadyapi karṣaśabdaḥ parimāṇavacano'pyasti, tathāpi karaṇādīnāṃ sāhacaryāt kriyāśabda eva gṛhyate| karaṇaśabdo bhāvasādhanaḥ| yadā tu karaṇasādhanaḥ, tadā kriyate'neneti karaṇam, `rathasītāhalebhyo yadvidhau' (vā.473) iti tadantavidhiratreṣyate| tasyodāharaṇam--`dvihalyaḥ' iti darśayati| `bhāvasādhanañca' iti| atrāpi pūrvavadvibhāgo veditavyaḥ|| 98. tatra sādhuḥ| (4.4.98) `sāmanyaḥ' iti| `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| sādhuriha nipuṇaḥ, yogya iti bhāvaḥ|| 99. pratijanādibhyaḥ khañ| (4.4.99) janaṃ janaṃ prati pratijanam, `yathārthe'vyayam' (2.1.6) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| `parasyakulam, amuṣyakulam' iti| nipātanādaluk| `ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe' (6.3.21) iti vā yadā parakulatvenākruśyate| `yatra' ityādi| `pratijana' , `sarvajana' ityevamādiṣu keṣuciddhitārtha eva pratiyate, na tu pravīṇo yogyaśabdasyārthaḥ| tena tatra vacanasāmarthyāt pare'pi prākkrītīyāḥ pratyayā bādhyante| anyathā hi vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt|| 100. bhaktāṇṇa| (4.4.100) 101. pariṣado ṇyaḥ| (4.4.101) 102.kathādibhyaṣṭhak| (4.4.102) 103. guḍādibhyaṣṭhañ| (4.4.103) 104. pathyatithivasatisvapaterḍhañ| (4.4.104) 105. sabhāyā yaḥ| (4.4.105) `svare viśeṣaḥ' iti| yati sati `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) ityādyudāttaṃ syāt, ye tu sati pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaṃ syāt|| 106. ḍhaśchandasi| (4.4.106) 107. samānatīrthe vāsī| (4.4.107) vasatīti vāsī| nipātanādeva ṇiniḥ, grahādilakṣaṇo vā| atha vā-- vasanaṃ vāsaḥ, so'syāstīti vāsī, matvarthīya iti| atha `tatra' (4.4.98) iti varttamāne punaḥ `samānatīrtheṭa iti saptamyupādānaṃ kimartham ? prakṛtitveneṣṭhāt saptamyantādyathā syāt; aniṣṭānmā bhūt| etena guruvacano yastīrthaśabdastadantāt saptamīsamarthāt pratyayo bhavati, na tu yaḥ prayogādivacanastadantāt| amumevārthaṃ cetasi kṛtvā''ha-- `tīrthaśabdena gururucyate' iti|| 108. samānodare śayita o codāttaḥ| (4.4.108) `okāraścodāttaḥ' iti| yataḥ svare prāpta okārasyodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| `śayitaḥ sthita ityarthaḥ'(iti)| anekārthatvāt tasya sthitāvapi vṛtteḥ; tathā hi --jalāśaya iti| samānodaryaḥ' iti| samānañca tadudarañceti samānādhikaraṇasamāsaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ pratyayaḥ|| 109. sodarādyaḥ| (4.4.109) ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt sodarśaśabdādapi pūrveṇa yatyeva prāpte yo vidhīyate| `vibhāṣodare' (6.3.88) iti viṣayasaptamīti matvā''ha-- `yakārādau pratyaye' ityādi| `o codātta iti nānuvarttate' iti| pratyaya vidhānasāmarthyādya udāttaḥ|| 110. bhave chandasi| (4.4.110) `aṇādīnāṃ ghādīnāñcāpavādaḥ' iti| `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) iti prāptānām| yadyevam, yatā bādhitatvācchandasi teṣāmabhāvaḥ syāt, tataśca muñjāvatyaṃ mauñjāvataṃ vetyevamādi na sidhyati ? ityāha-- `sati darśane' ityādi| kathaṃ punarevaṃ labhyate ? ityāha--`sarvavidhīnām' ityādi| sarvavidhivyabhicārastu `bahulaṃ chandasi' (3.2.88) iti bahulagrahaṇāllabhyate| muñjāvān nāma parvataḥ, tatra bhavo'sau mauñjāvataḥ|| 111. pāthonadībhyāṃ ḍyaṇ| (4.4.111) 112. veśantahimavadbhyāmaṇ| (4.4.112) 113. srotaso vibhāṣā hyaḍḍyau| (4.4.113) ḍyaḍyaḍyayoḥ svare viśeṣaḥ| ḍyati hi sati `tit svaritam' (6.1.185) ityantasvaritaḥ syāt, ḍye tu pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 114. sagarbhasayūthasanutādyan| (4.4.114) samāno garbhaḥ, samāno yūtha iti karmadhārayaḥ| `ṇu stutau' (dhā.pā.1035) , bhāvektaḥ, samānaṃ nutamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| samānañca tannutañceti karmadhārayo vā| `svare viśeṣaḥ' iti| yati sati `svaritam' (6.1.185) ityantasvaritatvaṃ syāt, yanisati nitsvareṇādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| `sarvatra samānasya cchandasi' iti| `samānasya cchandasyamūrdhaprabhṛtyudarkeṣu' (6.3.84) ityasyopalakṣaṇapara ekadeśa upāttaḥ|| 115. tugrāddhan| (4.4.115) 116. agrādyat| (4.4.116) `sāmānyena yadvihitaḥ' iti| `bhave cchandasi' (4.4.110) ityanena| atha yad‌grahaṇaṃ kimartham, na yathāvihitamevocyeta ? naivaṃ śakyam; `agraścāḍḍimac' (vā. 448) ityevāmagraśabdāḍ‌ḍimajapyuktaḥ, tatra yathā vihite pratyaya ucyamāne ḍimacapi syāt| tasmādyad‌grahaṇaṃ karttavyam|| 117. ghacchau ca| (4.4.117) `svare viśeṣaḥ' iti| ghe vihite'ntodāttatvaṃ syāt, ghani tu satyādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 118. samudrābhrādghaḥ| (4.4.118) nanu ca `ajādyantam' (2.2.33) `alpāctaram' (2.2.34) ityabhraśabdasya pūrvanipātena bhavitavyam, tatkathamapūrvanipātaḥ ? ityāha-- `amraśabdasya' ityādi|| 119. barhiṣi dattam| (4.4.119) 120. dūtasya bhāgakarmaṇī| (4.4.120) bhāve `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇi prāpte `guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ' (5.1.124) iti ṣyañi yato vidhām| yeṣāṃ `sakhyuryaḥ' (5.1.126) ityatra `dūtavaṇigbhyāñca' (vā.540) ityupasaṃkhyāyate, teṣāṃ karmaṇi ye prāpte|| 121. rakṣoyātūnāṃ hananī| (4.4.121) `nirdeśādeva samarthavibhaktiḥ' (iti)| sā punaḥ ṣaṣṭhī `karttukarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti karmaṇi draṣṭavyā| yogyatāmātre vivakṣite hanyate'nayeti hananī, karaṇe lyuṭ, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp| nanu ca rakṣīyātuśabdayordvitvād‌dvivacanena bhavitavyam, tatkathamidamuktam ? vacanasāmarthyāt sambhāvanameva stutiriti darśayitumāha--`bahuvacanam' ityādi| yogaścāyaṃ `tasyedam' (4.3.120) ityaṇi prāpte veditavyaḥ|| 122. revatījagatīhaviṣyābhyaḥ praśasye| (4.4.122) `ṣaṣṭhīsamamarthebhyaḥ' iti| sāmarthyāddhi ṣaṣṭhayeva samarthavibhaktirvijñāyate| yathā hi-- `{śaṃsa--prā.mu.pāṭha}śaṃsu stutau' (dhā.yā.728) ityato'smādeva nipātanādbhāve kyappratyayaḥ; `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' (3.3.113) iti bahulavacanāt| tatrāvaśyaṃ kṛdyogalakṣaṇayā ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam| ayamapi yogaḥ pūrvavadaṇi prāpte veditavyaḥ|| 123. asurasya svam| (4.4.123) `ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāt' iti| `asurasya' iti nirdeśādeva ṣaṣṭhī samarthavibhaktarlabhyate| `svam' iti| ātmīyamityarthaḥ| `aṇo'pavādaḥ' iti| `tasyedam' (4.3.120) iti prāptasya|| 124. māyāyāmaṇ| (4.4.124) māyāyāṃ neti vaktavye'ṇgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham|| 125. tadvānāsāmupadhāno mantra itīṣṭakāsu luk ca matoḥ| (4.4.125) sa vivakṣito'vayavo'sminniti tadvān| kaḥ punarasau ? samudāyaḥ| ata evāha-- `tadvānityavayavena samudāyo nirdiśyate' iti| etenaikadeśādidaṃ pratyayavidhānamityuktaṃ bhavati. ` varcaḥśabdo'smin mantre'sti' ityādinā tatsamudāyaṃ pradarśayati| `cayanavacanaḥ' iti| cinotereva karaṇe lup| `tejasyā'iti| tejaḥśabdo'sya mantsyāstīti tejasvānupadhānamantraḥ| śeṣaṃ vigrahavākyādi pūrvavat| mantrādeva, samudāyānmā bhat| yadyapi samudāyaḥ prātipadikamaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi vacanasāmarthyāpi syāt| kiṃ tarhi vacanānna labhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `itikaraṇo niyamārthaḥ' iti| asatīhetikaraṇe mantre bahūnāṃ sambhave sarveṇa padena tadvān mantro gṛhyate| asmiṃstu sati tena niyamārthena yenaiva padena tadvatā mantreṇeṣṭakopalakṣyate,tenaiva sarvo mantro gṛhyata ityetadupapannaṃ bhavati| atha matubgrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā matubantādayaṃ vidhīyate, tatra pratyayasya lug vijñāyamāno vidhānasāmarthyācca matupa eva bhaviṣyatītyapārthakaṃ matubgrahaṇaṃ ? naivam; uttaratra `aśvimānaṇ' (4.4.126) ityatar hyupavānamātrāvayave dvau matvarthīyau-- inimatupau, tatrāsati matubgrahaṇe luk syāt; asmin sati matupa eva bhavati|| 126. aśvimānaṇ| (4.4.126) `āśvinīḥ' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp|| 127. vayasyāsu mūrdhno matup| (4.4.127) `mūrdhanvatīḥ' iti | `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp| vayasyāstā mūrdhanvatyaśceti vayasvāmanupadhāno mantraḥ, tāsāmiti vayasyāḥ| mūrdhanvānupadhāno mantraḥ, tāsāmiti mūrdhandatyaḥ| `yatri' ityādi| na hyevaṃvidho yāsāmupadhāno mantrastato vayasyātviti vacanāt| atra mūrdhaśabda evāsti, na vayaḥ śabdaḥ, tato na bhavati--mūrdhanvatya iti| `vaktavye' iti| tadvānityadhikārānmatubantānmardhaśabdātpratyayena bhavitavyam| ataḥ `mūrdhanvataḥra' iti yuktaṃ vaktum, tanmatupo bhāvinaṃ lukaṃ cetasi kṛtvā| evaṃlaghu sūtraṃ bhavati|| 128. matvarthe māsatanvoḥ| (4.4.128) matvarthe māsatanvoriti pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam| matvarthagrahaṇādeva prathamā samarthavibhaktirastyupādhikā labhyate ? ityāha-- `prathamasamarthādastyupādhikāt' iti| `{anantarārtheva vā-- kāśikā} anantarārthe ca' iti| na kevalaṃ matvartha eva tyayo vaktavyaḥ| `nanu ca tapa) prabhṛtīnāṃ pratyayārthamāsādivacanānāmabhidheyaliṅgavacanāni bhavantīti puṃlliṅgatā prāpvoti, tasyāñca satyāṃ `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrgheṇa bhavitavyam; tatkathaṃ tapaśca sahaśca nabhaśceti prayogaḥ ? ityata āha--`napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ chāndasatvāt' iti| ayaṃ hi cchāndasaḥ prayogaḥ| tatreti puṃlliṅge'bhidheye napuṃsakaliṅgamupapadyate| `vyatyayo bahulam' (3.1.85) iti liṅgavyatyayasya cchandasi vidhānāt| iḍasminmāse'stīti `iṣaḥ' | ūrghasmin māse'stīti `ūrjaḥra'| śugasmin māse'stīti `śūciḥ' śug vāsmin māse'stīti `śukraḥ'| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam| arthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham, yāvatā `matau chaḥ sūktasāmnoḥ' (52.59) ityatra yathā `matau' ityucyamāno matvarthe pratyaya ucyate, tathehāpi labhyate, tasmāt `matau' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam ? satyametat; vispaṣṭārthamarthagrahaṇam || 129. madhorña ca| (4.4.129) 130. ojaso'hani yatkhau| (4.4.130) asantatvāt `asmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121) iti vinipratyaye prāpte matupo'pavādaiḥ saha samāveśāt matupi yatkhau vidhīyete| atha yad‌grahaṇaṃ kimartham, nanu `ojaso'hani kha ca' ityevocyeta, cakāreṇa yathāvihite pratyaye vijñāyamāne yaditi ca bhaviṣyati ? naivaṃ śakyam; cakāreṇa hi sandehaḥ syāt-- kimanenānantarasūtravihito ño'nukṛṣyate ? atha prakṛto yaditi ? tasmādasandehārthaṃ yadgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam|| 131. veśoyaśāderbhagādyal| (4.4.131) litkaraṇaṃ svarārtham|| 132. kha ca| (4.4.132) `yogavibhāgaḥ' ityādi| yadi pūrvasūtra eva khagrahaṇaṃ kriyate; dve prakṛtī pratyayāvapi dvāveveti sāmarthyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ prasajyeta| tasmāt tannirāsārtho yogavibhāgaḥ|nanu `yathāsaṃkhyamanudeśaḥ samānām' (1.3.10) ityatra iha kasmānna bhavati--`veśoyaśañāderbhagādyal kha ca' iti darśayitavā svaritena liṅgena yathāsaṃkhyamityuktam ? tadekayogatāmabhyupetya| bhavatu nāmaikayogaḥ, tathāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavatīti darśanārtham, tata kuto yathāsaṃkhya nirāsārtho yogavibhāga ? ata āha-- `uttarārthaśca' iti|| 133. pūrvaiḥ kṛtaminayau ca| (4.4.133) `pūrvaḥ kṛta minayau ca' iti| kha eva yathā syāt, yanmā bhūt| `pūrvairiti bahuvacanāntena ' ityādi| `pathibhiḥ pūrvaiḥra' ityevamādibhirvedavākyaiḥ pūrvapuruṣakṛtatvenayadā praśaṃsāṃ pratipādayituṃ niṣṭhā sādhveva śakyate vijñātum, tadā pūrvapuruṣābhidhāyinaḥ pūrvaśabdāt pratyaya upapadyate| tasmāt pūrvairiti bahuvacanāntena pūrvapuruṣā abhidhīyante| chandasāmarthaparatvād‌bahuvacanasya|tena pūrvapuruṣāṇāṃ panthā āsthitaḥ sampadyata iti darśayitumāha--`tatkṛtāḥ panthānaḥra' iti|| 134. 135. 136. matau ca| (4.4.136) śabde kāryāsambhavāt matup‌śabdena matvartho lakṣyata ityāha--`matvarthe' ityādi| matvarthe ca pra prathamāsamarthādastyupādhikāt pratyayo vijñāyata ityāha-- `sahasramasya vidyate' iti|| 137. somamarhati yaḥ| (4.4.137) `tadarhati' (5.1.63) ityarhārthe ṭhaki prāpte yo vidhīyate| `svare viśeṣaḥ' iti| yatyādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| yapratyaye tu satyantodāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 138. maye ca| (4.4.138) `{nāstīyaṃ paṃktiḥ-- kāśikā, padamañjarī ca}rūpyamayaṭo'pavādo yogaḥ' iti| `maya iti mayaḍartho lakṣyate' iti| śabde kāryāsambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| `tatra yathāyogaṃ samarthavibhaktiḥra' iti| tatrāgatārtha pañcamī, vikārāvayavayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī| prakṛtavacane prathameti yathāyogārthaḥ|| 139. madhoḥ| (4.4.139) mayaḍartha āgate prakṛtavacane yathāyogaṃ rūpyamayaṭoḥ prāptayoryadvidhīyate| tatra mayaṭo hi `dvyacaśchandasi' (4.3.150) iti prāptasya `notvadvardhavilvāt' (4.3.151) iti pratiṣedha ucyate|| <5> <5.1> śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryajinendrabuddhipādaviracitā nyāsāparaparyāyā kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikākhyā kāśikāvyākhyā - dvitīyo bhāgaḥ pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ pādaḥ 1. prāk‌ krītācchaḥ| (5.1.1) [`avyayam‌'--iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ (caukhā)-1967) vidhiḥ, adhikāraḥ, paribhāṣā veti trayamatra sambhāvyate| yathā caitat‌ tritayamapi nirdoṣam‌, tathā `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' (4.1.83) ityatra darśatam‌| yadyevam‌, kāśikākāreṇa kasmānna sūcitam‌? ekadeśānusmaraṇena sarvasya sūcitatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| atha prāgiti ko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, yāvatā prapūrvasyāñcateḥ kvini nalopādike vihite `ugidacām‌ (7.1.70) ti numi, saṃyogāntalope ca, `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti nakārasya ṅakāre prāṅiti bhavitavyam‌? athedṛśī vyutpattirāśrīyeta, yāvatā `añcateścopasaṃkhyānam‌ (vā.336) iti kṛte ṅīpi prācyāṃ diśi vasatīti `dikśabdebhyaḥ saptamī' (5.3.27) ityādinā astātiḥ, tasya `añcerluk‌' (5.3.30) iti luk‌, `luktaddhitaluki' (1.2.49) iti ṅīpo'pi `tasilādistaddhita edhācparyantaḥ' ityavyayatve `avyayāt‌' (2.4.82) iti sorluki `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt‌ sarvanāmasthānābhāve numo'pyabhāvaḥ, tataḥ kutve sati prāgiti sampadyate? yastu manyate--"ādye'pi pakṣe kriyāviśeṣaṇatvānnapuṃsakatvam‌, kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ yathā napuṃsakatvam‌, karmabhāvaśca; tathā `karaṇe ca stokālpakṛtchra' (2.3.33) ityatra pratipāditam‌, tatra karmaṇi dvitīyāyāḥ `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) iti luki kṛte pūrvavannumabhāvaḥ" iti, tanmate dvitīyaikavacanāntaṃ padaṃ sañjāyate| tadevamitarasmin‌ pakṣe `ṣaṣṭhyatasarthapratyayena' (2.3.30) iti ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam‌, tatkathaṃ `krātāt‌' iti pañcamīnirdeśaḥ? nai tadasti; yāvatā `anyārāditararttedikśabdaḥ' (2.3.29) ityatredamuktam‌dikśabdatvādeva siddhe'ñcūttarapadagrahaṇaṃ `ṣaṣṭhyatasartha' ityanena prāptāṃ ṣaṣṭhīmapi bādhitvā pañcamyeva yathā syāditi kutaḥ ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgaḥ| ato vyavasthitamidam‌--prak‌ krītāditi| atha prāgvacanaṃ kim‌, na `krītācchaḥ' ityevocyeta? naitadasti; evaṃ hyu cyamāne krītaśabda eva prakṛtitvena jñāyeta, tataśca krītaśabdādeva pratyayaḥ syāt‌| tasmāt krītādityavadhidyotanārthaṃ prāgiti vaktavyam‌| tarhyayamarthaḥ `prāgghitāt‌' (4.4.75) ityataḥ prakṛtena prāggrahaṇena hi sambadhyate| evaṃ tatraitat‌ syāt‌--taddhi `bhave cchandasi' (4.4.110) iti, tena cchando'dhikārasaya nivṛtteḥ| tarhi hi `prāgdīvyataḥ' (4.1.83) ityataḥ prakṛtatvāt‌ tenāpi ca vahaterityevamādikaṃ sambadhyeta, yathā--`strīpuṃsābhyāṃ nañsnañau bhavanāt‌' (4.1.87) iti? naitadasti; evaṃ hi `somāṭṭyaṇ‌' (4.2.30) ityādau yatra pañcamī śrūyate tatra sarvatra prāgvacanena sambandhe na jñāyate--ko vidhiḥ, kā ca prakṛtiriti syāt‌| yeṣāmavadhitvamiṣyate, teṣāmeva prākśabdamadhītavāniti| iha tu prakṛtena prāgvacanena sambadhyate| tananu ca viparyayaḥ kasamānna bhavati--bhavanāditi prakṛtiḥ strīpuṃsābhyāmityavadhinirdeśa iti? naitadasti; avaderakatvādekavacanena nirdeso nyāyyaḥ prakṛtinirdeśe tu dve eva prakṛtī parasparāpekṣe iti dvivacanamupapadyate| nanu ca viśadamidamuditamapyarthajñānam‌| svarita liṅgādadhikārāṇāmāsaṅga ityetadbhavatā vismṛtam‌, tadevam‌ `somāṭṭyaṇ‌' (4.2.30) ityādau kaḥ prāgvacanasambandhaprasaṅga iti nārthaḥ prāggrahaṇena? satyametat‌; kintu svaritatvāsvaritatvakhyāpanaparamparayā mandadhiyo mohamāsādayantīti tatpratipattyarthaṃ prāggrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| `avatsīyaḥ' iti| vikalpanāt‌ trayamatra sambhavati--anutpanne pratyaye nañāsya sambandha iti, utpanne vā saṃsargaḥ, utpattikāla eveti| tatrādye pakṣe vatsadanyasmai hitamitauṣṭābhidhānaṃ na prāpnoti| na cāpi caturthī; hitārthasya pratiṣidhyamānatvat‌| tṛtīye tu pakṣe yatā doṣo na bhavati tathā pratividhīyate| tatra vatsahitaśabdayoḥ padāntaranirapekṣayoḥ kriyāpadena bhavatinānugammānatvāt‌, na ca brāhmasambandho'ntaraṅgasambandhaṃ nivarttayituṃ śaknoti| ata eva na devadattāya gāṃ dadātīti sampradāne caturthī bhavati; karmaṇābhiprāpterantaraṅgatvāditi| tathānena ca krameṇa yatrāpi prāptirna vidyate, kevalaṃ tvicchāmātrameva, atrāpi karmasaṃjñā pravartate, tadyathā-grāmaṃ gantumicchāmi na kaścit‌ sahāyo'stīti| yadapyucyate-asāmarthyāttaddhitena na bhavitavyamiti, tadetadapyasāram‌; yadayam‌, `naño guṇapratiṣedhe sampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ' (6.2.155) iti tadantānyuttarapadāni naño guṇapratiṣedhe varttamānāni parāṇyantodāttāni bhavantīti taddhitagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| atha kimarthamiyānavadhirupādīyate, na hi tatra tāvadasya vyāpāro'sti; pratyayāntarairbādhitatvāt‌| laghutvāt‌ `prākṭhañaśchaḥ' iti vaktavyam‌? ityata āha-`artho'vadhitvena' ityādi| kaḥ punararthamavadhitvenāṅgīkurvato guṇa iti cet‌? ayamabhiprāyaḥ-`prākṭhañaśchaḥ' ityucyamāne prāk‌ ṭhaño yāḥ prakṛtayastābhyaścho bhavatītyarthaḥ syāt‌| tataścādhikārasya pratiyogopasthānādapavādaviṣaye chapratyayaḥ prasajyeta| arthe tvavadhitvenopādīyamāne prāk‌ krītādye'rthāsteṣu ccho bhavatītyayamarthaḥ sampadyate, tato'tiprasaṅgo na bhavati| tena samāne'rthe prakṛtiviśeṣādutpadyamāno'pavādaśchaṃ bādhate| nanu ca `prāk‌ ṭhañaḥ' ityucyamāne'pavādaviṣaye'pi ccho na bhaviṣyatyeva; jñāpakāt‌, yadayaṃ `vibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ' (5.1.4) iti vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ śāsti; itarathā hyadhikārāccho'pi labhdha eveti vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌? satyametat‌; kintu jñāpakadvāreṇārthapratipattau satyāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ sukhapratipattyarthamartho'vadhitvenoktaḥ| anye punarāhuḥ--gṛhīta iti `āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacya' (3.3.132) ityanena bhaviṣyati niṣṭhāpratyaya iti| tenāyamarthaḥ sampadyate-vatsīyādirūpasiddhyarthamarthamavadhiṃ grahīṣyāmīti| ataḥ śālāturīyeṇa `prāk‌ ṭhañaśchaḥ' iti noktam‌; anyathā hi pratyayāvadhitve pratipadoktā antaraṅgā ityupāttābhyaḥ prakṛtibhya eva pratyayaḥ syādityāśaṃkyeta| anye punaranyathā varṇayanti-`parikhayā ḍhañ‌' (5.1.17) ityatra `chayatoḥ pūrṇo'vadhiḥ' ityabhidhāsyati; tataśca tena krītamiti vakṣyatītyucyate, tataścedaṃ viruddhamityāha-`artho'vadhitvena' ityādi| gatārtham‌| naiyāyika ityāha-"kvacidatho'vadhitvena gṛhyate, yatā-`ārhāt‌' (5.1.19) `bhavanāt‌' (4.1.87)| iti, kvacit‌ pratyayaḥ prāgvahateḥ--`ā ca tvāt‌' (5.1.120) iti, kvacit‌ prakṛtiḥ--`ākaḍārāt‌' (1.4.1) `prākkaḍārāt‌' (2.1.3) iti, kvacidekadeśaḥ--`prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' (4.1.83) iti, kvacinniravadhiḥ pratyayaḥ--`ṅyāpprātipadikāt‌' (4.1.1) iti; tenāyamātmano vaicitryamācāryo darśayatītyavasīyate" iti| atha krītaśabdādeva pūrveṇa cchapratyayo bhavatītyevaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate, yathā-`vibhāṣā supo bahuc‌ purastāttu' (5.3.68) iti? anabhidhānāt‌| na hi krītaśabdāt‌ purastādutpadyamānena pratyayena kasyacidarthasyābhidhānamasti| na cāpi `tena krītam‌' (5.1.37) iti nirdeśa upapadyate| tatraivamapi prāk‌ krītaśabdādeva pratyayo bhavatītyeva kasmānna vikalpyate? anabhidhānādeva| na hi tata utpannena pratyayena vivakṣito'rtho'vagamyate| arthāntaraṃ bhavādikam‌, tatra ca vṛddhalakṣaṇaścha eva siddha ityanarthakamidaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ prāguditameva prayojanaṃ nyāyyam‌|| 2. ugavādibhyo yat‌| (5.1.2) ugiti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ vā syāt? uvarṇagrahaṇaṃ vā? tatrādye pakṣe'yaṃ vākyārtho jāyate-ugantebhyaḥ prātipadikebhyo'vādibhyo'vakārādibhyo'vasuprabhṛtibhya iti| vakārādīn‌ varjayitvetyarthaḥ| nanu caivaṃ sati pañcamyā nirdeśaḥ syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) iti lukā nirdaṣṭatvāt‌| evaṃ tarhi prātipadikeṣu gavādipāṭhasāmarthyāt‌ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; anyathā hi gavādīnāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt‌| etat‌ sarvaṃ manasi kṛtvā''ha-`uvarṇāntāt‌' iti| sarvatragrahaṇe tadantavidherabhyupagamādityabhiprāyaḥ| `śaṅkavyam‌' iti| `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ| `sanaṅaguḥ' ityādi| carmavikāralakṣaṇasyāño'va kāśāḥ--vārdhram‌, vāratram‌, uvarṇāntalakṣaṇasya yato'vakāśaḥ--śaṅkavyam‌ picavyamiti; sanaṅagurnāma carmavikāraḥ, tatrobhayaprāptau paratvāt‌ `carmaṇo'ñ‌' (5.1.15) ityañ‌ prāpnoti `tathā' ityādi| `annavikārebhyaśca' iti| apūpādilakṣaṇāsya pkṣīkasya yato'vakāśaḥ--apūpyāstaṇḍulāḥ, apūpīyā iti, uvarṇāntalakṣaṇasya sa eva; carurnāma havirviśeṣaḥ; saktuścānnavikāraḥ, tata ubhayaprasaṅge paratvāt‌ `vibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ' (5.1.4) iti havirlakṣaṇo'nnavikāralakṣaṇaśca vidhiḥ prāpnoti| tadevaṃ sanaṅguśabdādañ‌ prāptaḥ, carusaktuśabdābhyāṃ vikalpena yat‌, nityaśceṣyate, tadarthaṃ pūrvavipratiṣedho bhāṣitavya iti| `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146), `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.4.79) ityavādeśaḥ| `sanaṅgavyam‌' ityādi| etacceṣṭavācitvāt‌ paraśabdasya labhyata ityavagantavyam‌| `gavādiṣu nābi nabhañceti paṭhyate' iti| atra kasyacidiyamāśaṅkā syāt‌--bhasaṃjñāpratiṣedo vidhiyata ti, tataśca yasyeti lopena bhavitavyamityata āha--`nābhiśabdo yatpratyayam‌' iti| śarīrāvayavo yo nābhiśabdastatra kathaṃ bhavitavyamityāha--`yastu' ityādi| tataḥ śarīrāvayavādyati kṛte paratvāt‌ `nābhyaṃ tailam‌' iti| nanu ca śarīrāvayavalakṣaṇe yati sati nabhabhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavatītiyāha-`gavādiṣu yatā' ityādi| sa hi gavādiyatā saha vihitaḥ| tena `sanniyogaśiṣṭānāmanyatarābāva ubhayorapyabhāvaḥ' (vya.pa.48) iti nabhabhāvo na bhavati| `śunaḥ' ityādi| śvannityetasya samprasāraṇe kṛte'nnantatā'stīti `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopena bhāvyameveti| evaṃ tarhi samprasāraṇasāmarthyānna bhavati? naitadasti; `yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ sa vidhirbādhyate, yastu vidernimittameva nāsau bādhyate' (vyā.pā.56) iti tadavastho doṣaḥ| dīrghavidhānasāmarthyāditi cet‌? evamapi pakṣe syāt‌| evaṃ tarhyanyathā vyākhyāyate| iha cakāradvayaṃ paṭhyate--samprasāraṇañja, vā dīrghatvañceti| dvitīyaścakārī bhinnakramaḥ samprasāraṇasamīpe draṣṭavyaḥ| sa ca samucyārtho'nyasya samuccetavyasyābhāvāt‌ tadeva samuccinoti| tatra samprasāraṇamekena kriyate dvitīyena tadrūpasyaivāvasthitiriti| `tatsanniyogena' ityādi| tadityanena dīrghatvaṃ pratyavamṛśyate| tena dīrghatvena yata evāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati; anyathā `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) ityādyudāttatvaṃ syāt‌| `ūdhaso'naṅ‌ ca' iti| ūdhaḥśabdasyānaṅādeśo bhavati, cakārādyacya| `ūdhanyaḥ'| pūrvavat‌ prakṛtibhāvaḥ|| 3. kambalācca saṃjñāyām‌| (5.1.3) nanu `aparimāṇavistācitakambalyebhyaḥ' (4.1.22) iti nipātanādeva kambalya iti sidhyati kambalyaṃ hi pariṃmāṇaviśeṣaḥ, itarathā hi kambalyaśabdasya tatra grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, parimāṇaviśeṣasya kambalyaśabdo nāmadeyam‌; ayamapi pratyayaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ vidhīyamānastatraiva bhavati, nānyatra; nahyatra kambalyaśabdaḥ saṃjñā, tasmānnārtho'nena? naitadasti; nipātanena hi kambalyaśabdaḥ parimāṇe sādhurityetāvat‌ pratīyate, na tu yadanto'yamiti| tataścāntasvaritatvaṃ na syāt| tasmāt‌ svaritatvaparijñānārthamidaṃ karttavyam‌| anantaraśrutasya yato'nukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ| nanu svaritatvādeva yadbhaviṣyati? cho'pi tarhi syāt‌| nanu ca cchasya sannidhāne prakṛtimātrāccha ukta iti niyamārthamidaṃ syāt‌, taccāniṣṭam‌, yat‌ punarniyataviṣaya iti tatsambandhe vidhyarthatā, vidhiniyamayośca vidhereva jyāyān‌? naitadasti; chasyāpi sambandhe vidhyarthatā sambhavati| kathaṃ saṃjñāyāmityucyate, saṃjñā cānupāttāvayavārthāpi bhati, tatrānavayavārthānāmaprākkrītīyatvāddhitādyarthābhāve chapratyayārthametat‌ syāt‌, tasmāccakaro yatpratayayānukarṣaṇārthaḥ karttavyaḥ? na kartavyaḥ; iṣṭato'pyadhikārāṇāṃ pravṛttinivṛttī bhavata iti yata evānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati, na tu cchasya| evaṃ tarhi cakāra ugavādibhya ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| kimarthamidam‌? sanaṅgvādibhyaḥ paratvādañādayaḥ prāpnuvanti tadbādhanārthamiti| atha gavādiṣveva `kambalācca saṃjñāyām‌' iti kasmānna paṭhati? tatra pāṭhe na kaścidgurulāghavakṛto viśeṣa iti yatkiñcidetaditi|| 4. vibhāṣā havirapūpādibhyaḥ| (5.1.4) haviḥśabdo gavādiṣu paṭhyate, tena tasmānnityaṃ yatā bhavitavyam‌| atra haviṃrviśeṣāṇāṃ grahaṇam‌, nasvarūpasyeti; ugavādisūtre svarūpaparibhāṣāyā upasthānāt‌| na hi tatra sopatiṣṭhamānā kenacinniṃvāryate, tena svarūpasyaiva grahaṇam‌| tatra svarūpagrahaṇe satīha svarūpaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate; anyathā hi yadyatrāpi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tataḥ svatantra ekasmāt‌ śabdāt‌ nityaśca yato vidhiḥ syādanityaścetyubhayamekatra nopapadyata iti na bhavati viparyayaḥ| atha vā-haviḥśabdasyehi pṛthagupādānādarthapradhānatvamavasīyate, anyathā hyapūpādiṣveva paṭhediti| `annavikārebhyaśca' iti| annavikāraḥ-annaprakārāḥ, te ca pratayayamutpādayanti vibhāṣā-udanyāḥ, udanīyā iti| yadyevam‌, apūpādīnāṃ kiṇvaparyantānāmatra vikāratvādeva siddhatvāt‌ pāṭho'narthako jāyate? yadā tarhi kenacidākārasādṛśyenāpūpādayo'rthāntare upacaryante, tadarthameṣāṃ pāṭhaḥ| kiṃñcānnavikāragrahaṇenāpūpādiṣu pratyamicchata ihāpi syāt‌--yavāpūpāḥ, vrīhitaṇḍulā iti| pratipadapāṭhe tu grahaṇavattvāt‌ tadandavidhiḥ paryudasto bhavati| nanu ca 'asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' (5.1.20) ityasamāsagrahaṇādbhavitavyamevātra tadantavidhinā, etenāsamāsagrahaṇena pūrvatra tadantavidhirastītyeṣo'rthaḥ pratipādyate? satyametat‌; apūpādiṣu pratipadapāṭhasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati|| 5. tasyai hitam‌| (5.1.5) etadeva jñāpakam‌-hitayoge caturthyastīti| tena yaduktam‌-`hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā' (vā. 123) ityetadupapananaṃ bhavati|| 6. śarīrāvayavādyat‌| (5.1.6) śīryata iti śarīram‌, tena ghaṭāderapi grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyata āha--`śarīraṃ prāṇikāyaḥ' iti| etena rūḍhiriyamiti darśayati| gavādāveti śarīrāvayavavācinaḥ| tatra tu yāḥ prakṛtayastābhyo'nenāpi pūrveṇāpi vā yati viśe ṣo nāstyeva| yatra viśeṣaḥ--`nābhi nabhañca' (ga.sū.106) iti, sa viśeṣastatraiva veditavya eva|| 7. khalayavamāṣatilavṛṣabrahmaṇaśca| (5.1.7) khalādīnāṃ vṛṣaparyantānāṃ `yasyeti' (6.4.148) lopaḥ| `brahmaṇyam‌' iti| `na saṃyogādvamantāt‌' (6.4.137) iti pratiṣedhāt‌ `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopo na bhavati| `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopo'pi na bhavita; `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168) iti prakṛtibhāvāt‌| vṛṣaśabdo'yamatrākārānto gṛhyate, na tu brāhmaṇaśabdo'kārānta iti| nanu cāśaṅkā vṛṣaśabde yuktā-nalope sati kimayamakārāntaḥ? āhosvinnakārāntaḥ? iti, brahmanśabdācca yato nivṛttiprasaṅgād‌ brahmañśabdādapi yacaca pratyayo nivarttata iti bhāvaḥ| ata evāha--`chapratyayo'pi' ityādi| yatpratyayāpekṣayāpirayam‌--na kevalaṃ yatpratyayo na bhavati, api tu cchapratyayo'pīti| brāhmaṇaśabdācchapratyayābhāvo yojyaḥ| nanu cābhyāmihānupādanād‌ yatpratyayo na bhavati, `tasmai hitam‌' (5.1.5) iti cchapratyayastu kasmānna bhavati? ityāha-`anabhidhānāt‌' iti| na hīha vṛṣīyam‌, brāhmaṇīyamityukte vivakṣito'rthaḥ pratīyate; yato'rthapratipādanaṃ prati niyatā eva śabdaśaktayo bhavantīti kvacit‌ pratyayāntenārthasyābhidhānam‌ṣa kvacidvākyeneti| ato vākyamevāvatiṣṭhate-`vṛṣṇe hitam‌, brāhmaṇebhyo hitam‌' iti| vākyasamadhigamyasyārthasya taddhitenānabhidhānāditadi yāvat‌|| 8. ajāvibhyāṃ thyan‌| (5.1.8) ajaśabdo'yamiha puṃlliṅga upāttaḥ; aviśabdasya dhyantaśabdasyāpūrvanipātāt‌| ābantasya grahaṇe hyadiśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ syāt| adantasya grahaṇe `dvandve dhi' (2.2.32) ityetasya bādhitatvāt‌ `ajādyadantam‌' (2.2.33) ityajabdasya pūrvanipāto yujyate| tasmāt‌ puṃlliṅgasya grahaṇam‌| tathā va `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.29) iti strīliṅgādapi pratyayo bhavatyeva-ajābhyo hitamajathyam‌| `tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' (6.3.35) iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| parisaṃkhyāyante hi tatra tasilādayaḥ, teṣāñca madhye parisaṃkhyātau --grahaṇe śabdāntaratavādikarāntāt puṃlliṅgānna syāt‌|| 9. ātmanviśvajanabogottarapadāt‌ khaḥ| (5.1.9) ayātmannityatra nalopaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ, yāvatā dvandvenāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate, tatra `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nalopaḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha-`ātman‌' ityādi| ātmannityeva bhavatyeṣā prākṛtiriti jñāpanārthaṃ nalopo na kṛtaḥ| kaḥ punarevaṃ sati viśeṣaḥ? ityāha-`tena' ityādi| gatārtham‌| yadyevam‌, viśvajanaśabdena hyuttarapadasya sambandhaḥ prāpnoti? evaṃ manyate-ātmanniti nalopābāvena pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptervyabhicārasya darśitatvāt‌ tataḥ pratyāsaterbhogaśabdenaiva sambadhyate, na tu viśvajanaśabdeneti nāsati doṣaḥ| `karmadhārayādeveṣyate' iti| vāryapāramparyopadeśāt‌| vibhāvāgrahaṇānuvṛttervyavasthitavibāṣāvijñānādvedaṃ veditavyam‌| viśvasya jano viśvajanaḥ, viśvo jano'syeti viśvajana iti samāsena bhavitavyam‌| yathā kho na bhavati tathā ccho'pi na bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha-`bahuvrīhistu' ityādi| `upasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌-iha hi bhogasamāsāditi vāktavye uttarapadagrahaṇamadhikavidhānārtham‌| na caivaṃ sati bahupūrvādīṣadasamāptau bhogo bahubhoga ityasmāt‌ khaḥ syādityāśaṅkanīyam‌; bahucpracpratyayasya samāsābāvāt‌| tato'tri chenaiva bhavitavyam‌--bahubhogīya iti| tena pañcajanādapi bhaviṣyati| saṃjñāśabdaścāyam‌; `diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām‌' (2.1.50) iti samāsaḥ| tathā sarvajanādapi veditavyaḥ| `tatpuruṣādeva' iti| viśeṣānabhidhāne'pi mahājanāditi nirdeśādeva samānādhikaraṇādeva bhogaśabdo'yaṃ bhāvasādhanaḥ--bhuktirbhoga iti, karmasādhano vā--bhujyata iti bhoga iti| ayamavyutpannaḥ śarīravācīsa, tasyeha grahaṇamityāha--`bhogaśabdaḥ' ityādi| bhogaśabdaḥ śarīrameva pratipādayatītyarthaḥ| yatra varttamāno'yaṃ sākṣāt‌ sambandhamāha, tatraiva khapratyayamāsādayati| varttate ca kriyāyāṃ dravye ca| tathā hi--yadyapi bhujikriyayā dravyeṇa ca sambandho'sti, tathāpi śarīreṇa mukhyaḥ sambandha iti tato bhavati pratyayaḥ| yathā rājācāryābhyāṃ vākyameva bhavati, tathehāpi bhavitarvyāmiti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`ācāryādaṇatvam‌' iti| kṣubhnādipāṭhāt‌| `kevalābhyāṃ vākyameva bhavati' iti| chapratyayo na bhavati, anarbhidhānādeva|| 10. sarvapuruṣābhyāṃ ṇaḍhañañau| (5.1.10) `sarvāṇṇasya vāvacanam‌' iti| abhidhāne'bhidheyopacārādveti vikalpmāha| ihāpi vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttereva veditavyam‌| na ca sarvapuruṣābhyāṃ vikalpa āśaṅkā; vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt‌| 'puruṣādvadha' iti| tatra vadhe--`tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇo'pavādaḥ, vikāre--`prāṇirajatādibyo'ñ‌' (4.3.154) ityañaḥ, samūhe'pi--`tasya samūhaḥ' (4.2.37) ityaṇaḥ| `tena kṛte granthe' [`kṛte granthe' ityeva pāṇinīyaṃ sūtram‌] (4.3.116) ityaṇa eva|| 11. māṇavacarakābhyāṃ khañ‌| (5.1.11) ubhayasmin‌ ñitkaraṇaṃ svarārtham‌| carake vṛddhyarthaṃ ca| māṇave tu `vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre' (6.3.39) iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhārtham‌| māṇavīnā bāryāṃ yasya sa māṇavīnābhārya iti|| 12. tadarthaṃ vikṛteḥ prakṛtau| (5.1.12) tasmai idaṃ tadartham‌, `caturthī tadartha' (2.1.36) ityādinā samāsaḥ| etadeva vacanaṃ jñāpakam‌--arthottarapade samāse samudāyārthasya liṅgaṃ bhavati, na ca paravalliṅgatetiṃ| etena yaduktaṃ--`arthena nityasamāsaḥ sarvaliṅgatā ca vaktavyā' (vā.78) iti sā siddhā bhavati| `prakṛtirupādānakāraṇam‌' iti| samānajātīyamabhinnasantānavṛtti kāraṇamupādanakāraṇamityucyate| upādīyata ityupādānam‌, bahulavacanāt‌ karmaṇi lyuṭ‌, tasya kāraṇamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `tasyaiva va' ityādi| tasyaivopādānakāraṇasyottarabhāvyasthāviśeṣo vikṛtiḥ| `vikṛtivācinaḥ' ityādi| nanu ca `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' (4.1.82) iti vacanāttadarthamiti prathamaṃ nirdiṣṭatvāt‌ prakṛteśca tadarthatvāt‌ tadvācina eva pratyayaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; prathamasya cāprathamasya ca kāryaprāptau prathamādeva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ prathamagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ kṛtam‌| iha tu prathamāt‌ prāptireva nāsti| `prakṛtau' iti| saptamyā prakṛteḥ pratyayārthatvena sampāditatvāt‌| `vikṛteḥ' iti| pañcamyā vikṛteḥ prakṛtitvena tasmānnāyamasya viṣaya iti vikṛtivācina eva pratyayo bhavati| `vikṛtyarthāyām‌' iti| anena tadarthamityatra subvyatyayena saptamyāḥ sthāne prathamā, liṅgavyatyayena ca strīliṅgasya sthāne napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ kṛtamiti darśayati| nanu ca chandasi vyatyaya uktaḥ, nedaṃ chandaḥ, tatkuto vyatyayaḥ? `chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā.1.1.1) ityadoṣaḥ| `tadarthagrahaṇena' ityādi| iha prakṛtyantaranivṛttiḥ--yavānāṃ dhānāḥ, dhānānāṃ saktava iti| kvacidvikārasya prakṛtisambandhaḥ--dhānānāṃ yavāḥ, saktūnāṃ dhānā iti| kvacit‌ prakṛterananyārthatā, yathā--kāṣṭhānāmaṅgārāḥ| prakṛterananyārthatākhyānārthena yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate, taddarśayati--`pratyayārthasya ca' ityādi| iha vikṛtyarthāyāṃ prakṛtau pratyaya ucyate| tasya tasmāt‌ tādarthye caturthyeva śakyate pratibodhayitum‌| ataḥ pratyayārthasya tadarthatvena sāmarthyāccaturthī samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| `kecittu' ityādi| teṣāṃ vacanalabhyaivu caturthī samarthavibhaktiḥ| `tadartham‌' iti| kimiti ṣaṣṭhī pratyudāhriyate? ṣaṣṭhyati tādarthyaṃ brūte, yathā--guroridaṃ gurvarthamiti| tathā sati ṣaṣṭhyapi samarthavibhaktirbhavati| aṅgārāṇāṃ kāṣṭhānīti pratyudāharaṇaṃ tu prakṛtyantaranivṛttyā, tayā yavādeḥ samarthyete| aṅgārebhyaḥ kāṣṭhāni, prākārebhya iṣṭakā iti| idamasati tadarthagrahaṇe na jñāyate kimarthaṃ vivakṣitamiti| tasmādananyārthatā prakṛtervivakṣiteti| etat‌ prayojanaṃ pratipādayituṃ tadarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca prakṛtyantaranivṛtyā prakṛtireva sambadhyamānā vyatiricyata iti yavādereva vyatirekavibhaktirbhavati| ye tu caturthīṃmanuvarttayanti, teṣāṃ tadarathagrahaṇaṃ catarthīviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate--tādarthye caturthīti| tatra mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūriti pratyudāharaṇam‌| teṣāṃ caturthyanuvṛttirapārthikā; tadarthagrahaṇenaiva gatārthatvāt‌| tathā ca yā tādarthyasamānārthā ṣaṣṭhī sā cāsatyāṃ viśeṣyate| `yā kācit‌' itaci| na tūpādānakāraṇabhūtāpītyarthaḥ| syādetat‌--kūpaḥ prakṛtirudakasya na bhavatyeva; tatastannivṛttyarthaṃ vikṛtigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamityata āha--`bhavati ca' ityādi| caśabdovadhāraṇe| nanu cānyebhya eva svakāraṇebhya udakamutpādyate, tatkathaṃ kūpastasya prakṛtiḥ? ityāha--`tatrotpādanāt‌' iti| yathaiva hi prayājādīnāṃ dharmāṇāmutpattyādhārabhūtau darśapaurṇamāsau prakṛtau bhavataḥ, evamudakasyotpattyādhārabhūtatvāt‌ kūpaḥ prakṛtirbhavati| yadyevam‌, udakamapi tasya vikṛtiḥ? ityāha--`nanu' ityādi| atraivopapattimāha--`atyantabhedāt‌' iti| vikāro hi prakṛteruttaramavasthāntaramiti tato nātyantabhinno bhavati, yathā--kāṣṭhānāmaṅgārāḥ| te hi pārthivenābhinnasantānavarttitvena kāṣṭhebhyo nātyantaṃ bhidyante| udakaṃ tu bhinnasvabhāvatvādbhinnasantānavarttitvācca kūpādatyantaṃ bhinnam‌| ato na tasyottaramavastāntaramiti na bhavati vikṛtiḥ| `na tu kośī tasya prakṛtiḥ' iti| atatkāraṇatvāt‌, anutpattyādhārabhūtatvācca| nanu ca prakṛtirvikṛtiriti sambandhiśabdāvetau| sambandhiśabdaśca niyata eva pratiyogini pratītimupajanayati, yathā hi--`mātarivarttitavyam‌' ityukte na cocyate `svasyāṃ mātari' iti, yā yasyā mātā tasyāmiti pratīyate| evaṃ sati kūpalakṣaṇāyāṃ prakṛtau vikṛtyarthāyāṃ pratyayārthatvena vivakṣitāyāmasatyapi vikṛtagrahaṇe tasyaiva kūpasya yā yā vikṛtistata eva pratyayo vijñāyate| tathā ca vikāravācino'siśabdāt‌ pratyaye vidhitsite yasyāsau prakṛtistasyāmeva tadarthāyāṃ prakṛtāvasatyapi prakṛtigrahaṇe pratyayo vijñāyate| tasmādanyataropādāne'pi sarvamiṣṭaṃ sampadyate| na kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata ityāha--`tadarthaṃ dvayorapi' ityādi| anenaivaṃ manyate--syādetadeva yadāsau prakṛtivikṛtiśabdau niyogataḥ sambandhiśabdau, na cemau niyogataḥ sambandhiśabdau| tathā hiṃ, vipūrvastāvadayaṃ karotiṃrastyevāpakāre--devadatto'sthityai vikarotīti; asti ceṣṭānānātve--vikurvate cchātrā iti; astyanaucitye--vikṛtireṣā strīṇāṃ yat‌ svātantryamiti| asti kārye--tantunāṃ paṭo vikāra iti| tatā prapūrvo'pyayamasti kāraṇe--tantavaḥ prakṛtiḥ paṭasyeti; astiṃ caudāsīnye--sattvānāṃ prakṛtiriti| tānyucyante yānyanārambhakāṇi; asti doṣāpagame--prakṛtisto'yamiti| asti svabhve-prakṛtyā'bhirūpa iti; asti dharmāṇāmutpattyādhāre, yathā-darśapaurṇamāsau dharmāṇāṃ prakṛtistho'yamiti| asati svabhāve-prakṛtyā'bhirūpa iti; asti dharmāṇāmutpattyādhāre, yathā-darśapaurṇamāsau dharmāṇāṃ prakṛtiriti| tadevamarthabahutvādanayoḥ sarmbāndhatvamanaikāntikamiti, ato'nyataragrahaṇe na sidhyati| na cānyatareṇa śakyate vaktuṃ vivakṣitaḥ prakṛtivikārabhāvaḥ| ayamupādānakāraṇasya taduttarāvasthābhūtasya ca yo vikāraḥ sa iha veditavyaḥ| yadi tu vipūrvaḥ karotiranekārthaḥ, `tasya vikāraḥ' (4.3.134) ityatrāpi sandehāpagamāya tarhi prayatitavyam‌? satyametat‌; śailīyamācāryasya yasya kvacidabhidhānamāśrayati, kvacannyāyam‌, kvacidvacanamiti tat‌ sarvamucyate| tena sarvaṃ pratyāyyate|| 13. chadirupadhibalerḍhañ‌| (5.1.13) yadā chadiścarmavikāro vivakṣyate tadāpi ḍhañeveṣyate--chādiṣeyaṃ carmeti| nanu ca paratvāt‌ `carmaṇo'ñ‌' (5.1.15) ityañ‌ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `carmaṇo'ñ‌' ityatra chadiṣo ḍhañanuvarttiṣyate| yathā chadiḥśabdādvaliśabdāccaturthīsamarthāt‌ prakṛtivikārabhāve pratyaya upajāyate, tathopadhiṃśabdādapi bhavativyamityāśaṅkyāha--`upadhiśabdāt‌' ityādi| atra yuktimāha--`upadhīyate' ityādi| tena `karmaṇyupasarge ghoḥ kiḥ' iti darśayati| tena ca dravyasyānāsāditottarāvasthasyābhidhānam‌| yadyupadhiṃśabdādvikṛtivācinaḥ syāt‌, evamarthāntare syāt‌| na cāsau prakṛtiviśeṣe bhavati| na tūpadhiśabdādvācyasya pratyāntarasya prakṛtivikārabhāvo'sti, abedāt‌| tathā hi--yadeva rathāṅgamupadhiśabdenocyate tadevānāsāditottarāvasthamaupadheyaśabdenāpi| syādetat‌--yadā bhāvasādhana upadhiṃśabda upadhānamupadhiriti tadā nāsti bhedaḥ, kriyābhidhānāt‌; yadāpyupadhiśabdena kriyādravyasya vikāra ucyate tadaupadheyaśabdena ca tatprakṛti dravyam‌, ataḥ prakṛtiviśeṣe parapratyayau bhaviṣyatīti? etaccāyuktam‌; na hi kriyādravyasya vikāro yujyate; atyantabhedāt‌| tasmāt‌ sthārthaṃ evopadhiṃśabdāt‌ pratyayo vijñāyate|| 14. ṛṣabhopānahorñyaḥ| (5.1.14) `carmaṇyapi' ityādi| ñyasyāvakagāśaḥ--aupānahyo muñjaḥ, año'vakāśaḥ--vārdhram‌, vāratram‌; carmaṇi prakṛtitvena vivakṣite satyubhayaprāptau pūrvavipratiṣedhena ñya eva bhavati--aupānahyaṃ carmeti|| 15. carmaṇo'ñ‌| (5.1.15) `carmaṇaḥ' iti pañcamī vā syāt‌? ṣaṣṭhī vā? yadi pañcamī, carmaṇa eva pratyayo bhavet‌, na carmavikāravācibhyaḥ| etacca kuto labhyate? anabhidhānāt‌| tathā hi prakṛtiviśeṣa eva pratyaya iṣyate| na ca carmaśabdādutpanne pratyaye vivakṣitārthasyābhidhānamasti| tasmānneyaṃ pañcamī, api tu ṣaṣṭhī|| 16. tadasya tadasmin‌ syāditi| (5.1.16) dvitīyāśaṅkāmapaninīṣurāha--`tat‌' ityādi| asterakarmakatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| avayavārthapūrvatvādavayavyarthasyetyāha--`asya' ityādi| karotīti karaṇaḥ| karttari bahulavacanāllayuṭ‌| itiścāsau karaṇaśceti karmadhārayaḥ| `sambhāvane'lamiti cetsiddhāprayoge' (3.3.154)| nanu ca prākārīyā iṣṭakāḥ, prāsādīyaṃ dārviti ca pūrveṇaiva siddham‌, tathā hi--yāsāmiṣṭakānāṃ yasya ca dāruṇo bahutvena prākāraḥ prāsādaśca sambhāvyate, tāsāmiṣṭakānāṃ tasya ca dāruṇo yathāsaṃkhyena prākāraprāsādau vikārau bhavataḥ, tādarthyācceṣṭakānāṃ dārūṇāñcāstīvetyata āha--`prakṛtivikāra' ityādi| gatārtham‌| `dvistadgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| ityeṣa nyāyo'nena pradarśyate| `tadasyāstyasminniti matup‌' (5.2.94) ityādau naikaḥ pratyayārthaḥ| tatra tatsamudāyena samarthavibhakteḥ sambandho vijñāyate| tataśca yatra dvābhyāṃ pratyayārthābhyāṃ samarthavibhakteḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati--śākhāvān‌ vṛkṣa ityādau, tatraiva tat‌ syāt‌| yatra tvanyatareṇaiva sambandhaḥ--gomān devadattaḥ, vṛkṣavān‌ parvata ityādau, tatra na syāt‌| asmiṃstu nyāye pradarśiśate sarvatra bhavati|| 17. parikhāyā ḍhañ‌| (5.1.17) parikhāśabdena cātra kheyamucyate|| 18. prāgvateṣṭhañ‌| (5.1.18) prāgvacanaṃ `śīrṣacchedādyacca' (5.1.65), `daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ' (5.1.66) ityevamādinādhikāravatā ṭhañi viccinne `pārāyaṇaturāyaṇacāndrāyaṇaṃ varttayati' (5.1.72) ityevamādāvarthanirdeśe ṭhañeva yathā syādityevamartham‌|| 19. ārhādagopucchasaṃkhyāparimāṇāṭhṭhak‌| (5.1.19) `tadarhati' (5.1.63) ityeko vidhiḥ, `tadarham‌' (5.1.117) iti dvitīyaḥ, tat‌ kasyehāvadhitvenopādānam‌? ityāha--`tadarhati' ityādi| itarasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? evaṃ manyate yadi tasya grahaṇabhipretaṃ syāt‌ 'prāgvateḥ' (5.1.18) ityanenaiva sambandhaṃ kuryāt‌, na `ārhāt‌' ityanena| nanu ca vatyarthe'pi naitadasti; yadyapi vatyarthe'pi ṭhagadhikriyate, tathāpi tatra tena na bhavitavyam‌; pratipadavihitena vatinā bādhitatvāt‌, anabhidhānādvā| tasmādarhatiśabdaikadeśasyaivārhaśabdasyāvadhitvaṃ nyāyyam‌| `gopucchādīn‌ varjayitvā' iti| kathaṃ punaretajjñāyate--agopucchāditi pratiṣedho'yamiti? anyasyārthasyehāsambhavāt‌| nanu cāyamarthaḥ syāt‌--agopucchaśabdāt‌ saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇācceti? aśakyo'yamarthaṃ iha sambhāvayitum‌| yadi hyayamarthaḥ syāt‌, niṣkādibhyaḥ parimāṇādeva siddhatvāt‌ punarvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| nanu ca niyamārthaṃ punarvacanaṃ syāt‌--asamāsa eva yathā syāditi? naitadasti; na hi vidhau sati niyamārthatā yuktā| niyame hi satyavaktavyasya tyāgācchabdabādhanam‌| kiñca, siddhañca punarvacanamupādīyata iti, uktānuvāde doṣaśca| vidhau tu na śabdabādhanam‌, nānuvādoṣa itadi| vidhiniyamasambhavavicāre vidhinaiva yuktaṃ bhavitum‌| tasmādanyasyehārthasyāsambhavāt‌ `agopucchāt‌' iti pratiṣado'yamiti vijñāyate| jñāpakātprakṛtaratara na vivakṣyate, yadayam‌ `lokasarvalokāṭṭhañ‌' (5.1.44) iti ṭhako nivṛttyarthaṃ ṭhañaṃ karoti| `abhividhāvayamākāraḥ' iti| maryādāyāṃ hi varttamānasyākārasyātra grahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, prāggrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhatvāt| abhividhivṛtterākārasya grahaṇe sata yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate, taddarśayitumāha--`arhatyarthe'pi ṭhagbhavati' iti| `bhedagaṇanaṃ saṃkhyā' ti| bhidyanta iti bhedāḥ, bhinnāḥ padārthāḥ, te gaṇyante saṃkhyāyante paricchidyante yena tadbhedagaṇanam‌, ekatvādi| saṃkhyābhede hi sati padārthanusaṅkalpanamekatvādibhiḥ kriyate| ekatvasaṃkhyā'pi bahuṣu sanniveśiteṣu bhedamekamasahāyamāha| `gurutvamānamunmānam‌' iti| suvarṇādervastuno gurutvamutkṣipyate, yena tadunmānaṃ tulādi| `āyāmamānaṃ pramāṇam‌' iti| tiryagabhimukhasya vastuno yenāyāmaparicchedaḥ kriyate tat‌ pramāṇam‌, vitastyādi| `ārohaparaṇāhamānaṃ parimāṇam‌' iti| ārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca mīyate vrīhyādyartho yena tatparimāṇam‌| ārohaḥ ucchrāyaḥ, pariṇāhaḥ vistāraḥ| saṃkhyāparimāṇayorbhede pṛṣṭe yadunmānādīnāṃ viśeṣapradarśanaṃ tatprasaṅgena tadviṣayasyājñānasyāpanayanārtham‌| saṃgraheṇa kilaśabda evamādimatamācāryāṇāmityarthaṃ sūcayati| `sarvataḥ' iti| ārohataḥ pariṇāhataścetyarthaḥ| `saṃkhyā bāhyā tu sarvataḥ' iti| unmānāt‌ parimāṇāt‌ pramāṇācca saṃkhyā bāhyā; tatrānantarbhāvāt‌|| 20. asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ| (5.1.20) 'ṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| yena nāprāptityāyena (vyā.pa.49)| niṣkādibhyo droṇaparyantebhyaḥ parimāṇaśabdatvāt‌ ṣaṣṭhiśabdasya saṃkhyāśabdatvāṭṭhaki paryudaste ṭhañeva prāpnoti, atastasyaivāyamapavādaḥ| `tedantāpratiṣedhasya' iti tadantavidherapratiṣedhasyetyarthaḥ| yadi tarhi tadantāt‌ pratyayo vijñāyate, evaṃ tarhi `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' (śā.pa.65) iti kevalebhya- pratyayo nopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; asamāsagarahaṇena hi grahaṇavatparibhāṣāyā (vyā.pa.89) nivṛttirākhyātā, nivṛttāyāñca `ye navidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) iti tadantādbhavati| tatra ca `svasya ca rūpasya' (kāśikā.1.1.72) iti prakṛtatvāt‌ kevalādapi bhavati| yattu manyate-`apūrvopādānasāmarthyāt‌ kevalāditi lāghavārthaṃ kevalānāṃ pāṭhaḥ syāt‌' iti, yatkiñcadetat‌| `ita uttarañca' ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi tadantavidhirlabhyate, yāvatā `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirna' (vyā.pa.89) iti pratiṣidhyate? asyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvāt‌| anityatvaṃ tu tasyā gargādiṣu `vājāse' iti samāse pratyayapratiṣedhādgamyate| nityatve hi vājaśabdādutpadyamānasya pratyayasya samāse prāptireva nāstīti pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt‌| `dviśūrpam‌' iti| dvābhyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ krītamiti taddhitārthe dviguṃ kṛtvā| na tāvadeṣā lugantā prakṛtiriti saṃkhyāpūrvapadādapi `śūrpādañanyatarasyām‌' (5.1.26) ityañeva kriyate, tasya `avyarddhapūrvadvigorlugasaṃjñāyām‌' (5.1.28) iti luk‌| `dviśaurpikam‌' iti| `parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' (7.3.17) ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| yaduktam‌--`saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantavidhiritīṣyate' iti, yaccoktam‌--`lugantāyāstu prakṛterneṣyate' iti, tadubhayamāptāgamena sthirīkarttumāha--`tathā coktam‌' ityādi|| 21. śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate| `kano'pavādaḥ' iti| uttarasūtreṇa prāptasya| `śatikam‌' iti| `tadasya parimāṇam‌' (5.1.57) iti varttamāne `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' (5.1.58) iti saṅghe pratyayārthe vivikṣita uttarasūtreṇa kanneva bhavati| `pratyayārtho'tra saṅghaḥ' iti| śatamadhyāyānāṃ parimāṇaṃ yasya nidānakhyagranthasya, sa ceha pratyayārthaḥ| sa ca śatasaṃkhyāvyavacchinnāvyāyasamudāyātmaka iti saṅgha eva paratyayārto bhavati| `śatameva vastutaḥ' iti| avyāyaśatasyānanyārthatvāt tatasca prakṛtyarthāt‌ na bhidyate| tadeva hyadhyāyānāṃ śataṃ prakṛtyābhidhīyate, pratyayāntenāpi tadeveti neha prakṛtyarthāt‌ pratyayārthabhedaḥ| tadetena yatra cāvyatiriktaḥ prakṛtyārthāt‌ pratyayārthastatra pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| na ca vyatirikta ityetadākhyātam‌| nanu ca `saṅghe cānauttarādharye' (3.3.42), `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu' (5.1.58) ityatra ca prāṇisamūhe saṅghaśabdo gṛhyate, tatara kathaṃ granthaviṣayo gṛhyate/ upacāreṇetyadoṣaḥ| yadi vā saṃkhyāsūtre saṃjñāśabdasāhacaryādviśiṣṭaḥ saṅgho gṛhyate| `saṅghe cānauttarādharye' ityatrāpi `chandonāmni ca' (3.3.34) ityato nāmagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ prāṇisaṅgho gṛhyate| iha tu yatvābhāvād‌ ganthasyāpi grahaṇamityaviśeṣaḥ| `iha tu' ityādi| nanu ca śate'bhidheye pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌, iha ca śatadyaṃ śāṭakaśatam‌, śatikaṃ śāṭakaśatamityukte śataṃ pratīyata eva,
