tatkimiti pratiṣedho na bhavati? ityāha--`vākyena' ityādi| śatyaśatikaśabdau hi sāyānyaśabdau, sāmānyaśabdāśca na prakaraṇādikamantareṇa viśeṣe varttante| tena yāvacchāṭakaśatimityetatpadāntaraṃ na prayujyate, tāvat‌ pratyayārthasya śatatvaṃ nāvasīyate| tasmāt‌ padāntarasannidhau gamyamānatvāt‌ padāntarārtho bhavati, na pratyāyārthaḥ| `na śrutyā' iti| gamyata iti sambandhaḥ| yatra pratyayāntena padāntaranirapekṣeṇa pratyayārthasya śatatā''khyāyate, tatra śrutyā pratyayāntaśravaṇamātreṇaiva gamyate, yathā--pratyudāharaṇe śataṃ parimāṇamasya śatakamityukte gamyata evaitat‌--pratyayārtho'pi śatameveti| iha tu vākyācchatatvaṃ pratīyate| na ca padasaṃskārakāle vākyārthastayāṅgabhāvo'sti| tadā tasyopasarjanatvāt‌ prakṛtyarthādatirikte pratyayārthe pratiṣedho bhavati, na tu vyatiriktavākyagamya iti| tadāptavacanena draḍhayitumāha--`tathā coktam‌' ityādi| śatapratiṣedhe karttavye prakṛtyarthādanyasya pratyayārthasya śatatve'pratiṣedha ityetaduktaṃ bhavati| tatrānyat‌ prakṛtyarthaḥ śatam‌, anyat‌ pratyayārthaḥ śatam‌| tatra vidhireva bhavati; na pratiṣedha iti| kena panaḥ samāse prāpnoti, yatastatpratiṣedārtho'samāsānukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ kriyate? ityāha--`prāgvateḥ' ityādi|| 22. saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan‌| (5.1.22) `pañcakaḥ paṭaḥ' iti| laukikyāḥ saṃkhyāyā udāharaṇam‌| `bahukaḥ' ityādi| paribhāṣitāyāḥ| `catvāriṃśatkaḥ' iti| `isusuktāntāt‌ kaḥ' (7.3.51)| `arthavartāstaśabdasya grahaṇāt‌' iti| arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.1.)| `ḍateḥ paryudāso na bhavati' iti| śabdāpekṣayā'vayavaṣaṣṭhīti| pratyayasya ya ekadeśastiśabdastasya paryudāso na bhavati, na hyayamarthavān‌| `katikaḥ' iti| kiṃ parimāṇameṣāmiti `kimaḥ saṃkhyāparimāṇe ḍati ca' (5.2.41) iti ḍatiḥ, `ṭeḥ' (6.4.143) iti ṭilopaḥ| katibhiḥ krītamiti vigṛhya kan‌| yadyarthavatastiśabdasya grahaṇam, navateryastiśabdastasyāpi paryudāso na prāpnoti; navatiśabda eva hi samudāyaḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣeṇārthavān‌, na tadekadeśastiśabdaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; navatiśabde yo navaśabdaḥ so'nekārthaḥ| tathā ca saṃkhyāviśeṣāvagatamato navaśabdāt‌ paro yastiśabdastata eta vijñāyate; tadbhāve bhāvāt‌| aśītiśabdasya tarhi tiśabdasya paryudāso na prāpnoti, nāsāvarthavān‌? nāpi tataḥ pūrvo yo'śīśabdastasya kaścidartho'sti, samudāya eva tu saṃkyāviśeṣeṇārthavān? naitadasti; yadyapyaśī-itiśabdasya na kaścanārthaḥ prakāśate, tathāpi pratijñāyate| aśītiśabdo hyevaṃ vyutpādyate--aṣṭānāṃ daśānāmaśībhāvaḥ, tiśabdaśca pratyayaḥ| ya evāṣṭānāṃ daśānāmārthaḥ so'śīśabdasya, yastu saṃkhaghyāviśeṣaḥ so'yaṃ tiśabdasyaiveti, tatastasya nānarthakyam‌| evamapi viśateḥ pratiṣedho na sidhyati? sa hyevaṃ vyutpādyate--dvayordaśatorvinbhāvaḥ, śatiṃśca pratyaḥ| tatra śatipratyayāt‌ pūrvasya bhāgasya dvayordaśatoryo'rthaḥ sa eva pratijñāyate śatipratyasya, saṃkhāyaviśeṣaḥ, tiśabdasya na kaścit‌| iṣṭameva tat‌| saṃgrāhitaḥ kan‌ viṃśateḥ--`tadviṃśatikam‌' iti| atha `atiśadantāyāḥ' ityatrāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, atiśacchabdasya na prāgvatīyatvāt‌ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayaiva (pu.pa.la.vṛ.44) tadantavidhirbhaviṣyati/ evadeva tarhi prayojanam‌--anayacā paribhāṣayā tadantavidhirmā bhūditi| kiñca syāt‌? ihaikasaptatyā krīta iti pratiṣedho na syāt‌; ekasaptadaśatastipratyayasyāvidhānāt‌| antagrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe sati samudāyasyānte tiśabdaḥ śruyata ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati|| 23. vatoriḍ‌ vā| (5.1.23) `vatvantasya saṃkhyātvāt‌' iti| bahugaṇasūtreṇa (1.1.23) saṃkhyāsaṃjñāviṃdhānat‌| `tasya' ityādi| kathaṃ punastasyānenāgamaḥ śakyo vijñātum‌, yāvatā neha kangrahaṇam‌? yadapi prakṛtaṃ tadapi prathamānirdiṣṭam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, `vatoḥ' iti pañcamī `kan‌' iti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalpayiṣyati `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti| `tāvatkaḥ' iti| tatparimāṇamasyeti `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup‌' (5.2.39), `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) ityātvam‌|| 24. viṃśatitriṃśadrabhyāṃ ḍvunasaṃjñāyām‌| (5.1.24) `viṃśakaḥ' iti| `ti viṃśaterḍiti' (6.4.142) iti tiśabdasya lopaḥ, ato guṇe (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| yasyeti (6.4.148) lopo na bhavati; `asidhdavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) iti lopasyāsiddhtvāt‌| nanvihāntarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñā, tatkathaṃ pararūpatvam‌? evaṃ tarhyasiddhatvasyānityatvād‌ yasyeti lopo bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `kathaṃ punaratra kan‌' iti| triṃśatka ityadhikṛtya praśnaḥ viṃśatika ityatrārthavatastiśabdasya grahaṇāt‌ paryudāso na pravarttata iti tamadhikṛtyāsya praśnasyopanyāso nopapadyate| `yogavabhāgaḥ kariṣyate'iti| triṃśadarthamityabhiprāyaḥ|| 25. kaṃsāṭ‌ṭiṭhan‌| (5.1.25) `ṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| na ṭhakaḥ, kaṃsaśabdasya parimāṇavācitvāt‌|| 26. śūrpādañanyatarasyām‌| (5.1.26) `ṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| na ṭhakaḥ, śūrpaśabdasya parimāṇavācitvāt‌|| 27. śatamānaviṃśatikasahasravasanādaṇ‌| (5.1.27) `ṭhakṭhañorapavādaḥ' [`ṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| śatamānaṃ parimāṇam‌, sahasraṃ saṃkhyā, tenaitābhāṃ ṭhagna prāpnotīti ṭhaño'pavādaḥ| viṃsatyā krītaṃ `viṃśātikam‌' iti| tacca paramāṇamapi sambhavati| tatra parimāṇāṭṭhaño'pavādaḥ, aparimāṇaṭṭhakaḥ, vasanaśabdāṭṭhagapavādaḥ|| 28. adhyardhapūrvadvigorlugasaṃjñāyām‌| (5.1.28) `adhyaradhakasam‌' iti| adhyardhena kaṃsena krītamiti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| `prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvadapānāṃ tadantavidhiraluki' (ma.bhā. 2.346) iti `kaṃsāṭ‌ṭiṭhan‌ (5.1.25) iti ṭiṭhan‌, tasya luk‌| `dvikaṃsam‌' iti| `adhyardhaśūrpam‌' iti| śūrpādañanyatarasyām‌' (5.1.26) ityañ‌; ṭhañanyatarasyām‌, tasya luk‌| yadyatira dvigoḥ parasyārhīyasya lugvidhīyate, viśeṣānupādanāt‌ taddhitalugantādapi dvigoḥ parasya prāpnoti--dvābyāṃ śūrpābhyāṃ krītaḥ paṭo dviśūrpaḥ paṭaḥ, dviśūrpeṇa paṭena krītamiti dviśaurpikamiti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyamāṇaṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ pūrveṇāpi sambadhyate| vyavasthitavibhāṣā sā| tena taddhitalugantād‌dvigoḥ parasya na bhaviṣyati--dviśaurpikamiti| prāgvatīye ṭhañi kṛte `parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' (7.3.17) ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| `pāñcalohitikam‌, pāñcakalāpikam' iti| kasyācit‌ parimāṇaviśeṣasya nāmadheye ete| pañca lohinyaḥ parimāṇamasyeti, pañca kapālāḥ parimāṇamasyeti vigṛhya taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, `tadasya parimām‌' (5.1.57) iti ṭhañ‌, `bhasyā'ḍhe taddhite' (vā.731) iti puṃvadbāvāllohinīśabdasyekāranakāranivṛttiḥ| `adhyardhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyaiva' iti| abhidhāne'bhidheyopacāraṃ kṛtvā, `adhyardhaśabdaḥ saṃkhyaiva' ityuktam‌| yathaiva hyekādikā laukikasaṃkhyā, evamadhyardhaṃśabdo'pi| `sa kimarthaṃ bhedanopādīyate' [`saḥ' nāsti--kāsikā] iti| saṃkhyāyā iti śeṣaḥ. iha hi dvagoradhyardhapūrvasya bhedenopādanādadhyardhapūrvasya bhedena saṃkhyāyā upādānaṃ bhavatīti| atastasyādhyardhaśabdasya bhedenopādānasya prayojanaṃ darśayituṃ pṛcchati| `jñāpakārtham‌' ityādinā prayojanamācaṣṭe| kiṃ punarasya saṃkhyākāryaṃ na bhavatītyāha--`saṃkhyāyāḥ' ityādi|| 29. vibhāṣā kārṣāpaṇasahasrābhyām‌| (5.1.29) `adhyardhasahasram‌' iti| `śatamānaviṃśatika' (5.1.27) ityādinā vihitasyāṇo luk‌| `adhyardhasāhasram‌' iti| `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' (7.3.15) ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| `suvarṇaśatmānayorupasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--`vistācca' (5.1.31) ityataḥ siṃhāvalokitanyāyena cakāro'tropatiṣṭhate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena suvarṇaśatamānayorapi viṣyati| `adhyardhasuvarṇam‌' iti| ṭhaño luk‌, `adyardhaśatamānam‌' iti| `śatamāna' (5.1.27) ityādi-vihitasyāṇaḥ| `adhyardhaśatamānam‌' iti| `parimāṇāntasya' (7.3.17) ityādinottarapadavṛddhiḥ| nanu ca suvarṇamunmānam‌, na parimāṇam‌, tatkutastasya buddhiḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; uttarapadavṛddhau hayunmānamapi parimāṇamiti gṛhyate| kaguto jñāyate? `asaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' (7.3.17) iti śāṇaśabdasya pratiṣedhāt‌| yadi tarhi tatronmānaṃ na gṛhyeta, tadā śāṇasyonmānārthasya prāptireva nāstīti pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryāt‌| adhyardhapūrvadvigubhyāṃ kārṣāpaṇasahasrayoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ kasmān bhavati? lakṣaṇavyabhicāreṇa tadabhāvasya sūcitatvāt‌| iha tāvat‌ `adhyardhapūrvadvigoḥ' (5.1.28) iti nirdeśe'lpāctaratvād‌ dhyantatvācca dviguśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti, `kārṣāpaṇasahasrābhyām‌' ityatrālpāctaratvāt‌ sahasraśabdasya? tāvetau nirdeśau lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ bodhayantau yatāsaṃkhyaparibhāṣāyā apyabhāvaṃ bodhayata iti na bhavati yathāsaṃkhyaparibhāṣā|| 30. dvitripūrvānniṣkāt‌| (5.1.30) adhyardhapūrvagrahaṇamasvaritatvānnopatiṣṭhate| `dviniṣkam‌' iti| dvābhyāṃ niṣkābhyāṃ krītamiti asamāne ṭhako vidhānādatra ṭhañ‌, tasya luk‌| `dvinaiṣkikam‌' iti| `parimāṇāntasya' (7.3.17) ityādinottarapadavṛddhiḥ| `bahupūrvācca' iti| bahupūrvad‌dvigorniṣkaśabdāntādārhīyasya pratyayasya vibhāṣā lugbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`dvitribhyāṃ niṣkāt‌' ityeva siddhe pūrvagrahaṇamadhikaṃ kurvatai tat‌ sūcitam‌--`anyadapyadhikaṃ kiñcidasti' iti| tena bahupūrvādapi bhavati|| 31. vistācca| (5.1.31) `dvitripūrvāditi cakāreṇānukṛṣyate' iti| nanu ca svaritatvādeva dvitrigrahaṇamanuvarttiṣyate, svaritatve satyadhikāraparimāṇaṃ na jñāyata iti cet‌? vārttametat‌| vyākhyānato'dikāraparamāṇaṃ vijñāsyate? evaṃ tarhi svaritatvādeva dvitripūrvagrahaṇasyānuvṛttau siddhāyāṃ yattadanukarṣaṇārthaṃ cakaramadhikaṃ karoti, tenaitat‌ sūcayati--anyadapyatra kiñcidadhikaṃ bhavatīti| tena bahupūrvādapi vibhāṣā luk‌ siddho bhavati| `bahibistam‌' iti| `dvibistam‌' iti dvau visto parimāṇamasyeti ṭhañ‌, tasya luk‌| `dvibaistikam‌' iti| uttarapadavṛddhiḥ|| 32. viṃśatikātkhaḥ| (5.1.32) `dvitripūrvagrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam‌; pūrvatra cānukṛṣṭatvāt‌, asvaritatvādvā| śatamānādisūtreṇa (5.1.27) aṇi prāpte tasya luki kho vidhīyate| `vidhānasāmarthyādasya lugna bhavati' iti| yadi luk‌ syāt‌, khavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| na hyaṇaḥ khasya ca luki sati kaścidviseṣo'sti|| 33. khāryā īkan| (5.1.33) khārīśabdasya parimāṇavācitvāṭṭhañi prāpte tasyekan‌ vidhīyate| `kevalāyāśceti vaktavyam‌' iti| kevalo yo'samastaḥ khārīśabdastataścekan‌ bhavatītye tadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--ikanniti vaktavye yadikanomātrādhikasya vidhānaṃ tadanyadapyatra kiñcadbhavatīti sūcayati, tena kevalādapi khārīśabdādīkan‌ bhavatīti| kathaṃ punarikani rūpaṃ sidhyati? savarṇadīrghatvena| nanu ca yasyeti lopaḥ (6.4.148) prāpnoti? naitadasti; yadi hi yasyeti lopaḥ syāt‌, ṭanameva brūyāt‌| `kākiṃṇyāścopasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tu tasyaivādhikasūcanārthasyekano vidhānamāśritya karttavyam‌| `kevalāyāścetyupasaṃkyānam‌' [`kevalāyāśca' ityeva-kāśikā] iti| upasaṃkhayanaśabdasya pratapādanamarthaḥ| pūrvavat‌ prakṛtena sambandhaḥ|| 34. paṇapādamāṣaśatādyat‌| (5.1.34) paṇapādamāṣebhyaḥ `asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' (5.1.20) iti asamāse ṭhako vidhānāṭṭhañi prāpte tasya luki śataśabdādapyasamāse `śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate' (5.1.21) iti ṭhanyatorvidhānāt‌ samāse saṃkhyālakṣaṇe kani yad‌ vidhīyate| `dvipādyam‌' ityādi| nanu padbhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati `padyatyatadarthe' (6.3.53) iti? satyam‌; `pādasya padājyāti' (6.3.52) ityatra prāṇyaṅgasyaiva padbhāvavidhānāt‌| kṛta etat‌? `ājyāti' ityādinā gativacanena sambandhastasyaivopapadyate; na parimāṇaśabdasya| sa eva prāṇyaṅgavācyuttarasūtre'pyanuvartiṣyata iti tasyaiva padbhāva iṣyate| syādetat‌--ayamapīha pādaśabdaḥ prāṇyaṅgavācī, ato bhavitavyameveha padbhāvena? ityata āha--`padbhāvo na bhavati' iti| `padyatyatadarthe' (6.3.53) iti padbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, sa na bhavati| kiṃ kāraṇamityāha--`prāṇyaṅgasya' ityādi| `pādasya padājyātigopahateṣu' (6.3.52) ityatra prāṇyaṅgasya pādasya grahaṇam‌| `idaṃ tu parimāṇagrahaṇam‌' [`parimāṇam‌-kāśikā] iti| paṇādibhiḥ parimāṇaiḥ sāhacaryāt‌ parimāṇaṃ pādo gṛhyate, na prāṇyaṅgamiti padbhāvasyāprasaṅgaḥ|| 35. śāṇādvā| (5.1.33) `ṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| na ṭhakaḥ; śāṇasya parimāṇatvāt| `śatācceti vaktavyam‌' iti| śatāccādhyarthapūrvād‌dvigośca yatpratyayo bhavatotyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyakhyānam‌--pūrvasūtrādiha śataśabdo'nuvarttate, tena tadantādapi yadbhavatīti| yadyevam‌, pūrvasūtre tasya pāṭho'narthaka iti, ihaiva śataśāṇābyāñceti vaktavyam‌? naivaṃ śakyam‌; evaṃ hyucyamāne `dvitripūrvādaṇca' (5.1.36) ityanenāpi śatāt‌ prasajyeta| pūrvasūtre tu pāṭhasāmarthyādaṇvidhau nānuvarttate| śataśabdaḥ svaritatvāccehānuvarttamāno vā yatamutpādayati|| 36. dvitripūrvādaṇca| (5.1.36) `tena trairūpyaṃ sampadyate' iti| ekaṃ rūpaṃ sūtranirdiṣṭe'ṇi, dvitīyaṃ cakārasamuccite yati, tṛtīyaṃ vāśabdaprāpitasya ṭhaño lukadi| `dviśāṇam‌' iti| ṭhaño luk‌|| 37. tena krītam‌| (5.1.37) `sāptatikam‌, āśītikam‌' iti| `prāgvateṣṭhañ‌' (5.1.18) `naiṣkikam‌'; pāṇikam‌' iti| `asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' (5.1.20) iti ṭhak‌| `śatyam‌, śatikam‌' ita| `asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' (5.1.20) iti ṭhak‌| `śatyam‌, śatikam‌' iti| `śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate' (5.1.21) iti| `dvikam‌, trikam‌' iti| `saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan‌' (5.1.22)| sāmānyārthābhidhāne teneti tṛtīyopādanādiha kasmānna bhavati--devadattena krītam, pāṇinā kritam‌? ityata āha--`tena' ityādi| karaṇe tṛtīyā| parimūlyāt‌ tataḥ pratyayena bhavitavyam‌| `anyatra' iti| anyatara mūlyāt‌ karaṇe tṛtīyā bhavati| `anabhidhānāt‌' iti| na hi yā karttari tṛtīyā yāpyamūlyāt‌ karaṇe tṛtīyotpadyate, tadantādutpannaḥ pratyāyo vivakṣitaṃ vastu pratipādayitumalaṃ sambhavati| tathā ha--daivadattikaṃ pāṇikamiti cokte, devadattena kartrā krītam‌ pāṇinā karaṇena krītamityeṣo'rtho nāvasīyate| devadatteneti karttari tṛtīyā, pāṇineti karaṇe| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--pragatyāsannavinimayadravyasambandhānabhidhānāditi| `anabhidhānādeva' iti| na hi prāsthikamityukte, prasthābhyāṃ krītaṃ praśthairvā krītamityeṣo'vagamyate| tatra punarabhidhāne ko hetuḥ? śabdaśaktirīdṛśī, kimatrānyena hetunā! api ca prasthādayaḥ śabdā arthatastu parimāṇānāmarthānāṃ vācakā iti teṣāmabhidheyasya pracaye pravṛttisambhave ko hetuḥ? nanvevaṃ vākye'pi pracayo nopapadyeta? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vākye hi pracayasya vācikā vibhaktirastīti pracayābhidhānaṃ na virudhyate| vṛttau tu na kaścit‌ pracayamācaṣṭa iti nāsau vṛttiviṣaye yujyate| yadi tarhi dvivacanabahuvacanāntāt‌ pratyayena na bhavitavyam‌, evaṃ sati dvābhyāṃ krītaṃ dvikam‌, tribhiḥ krītaṃ trikamityevamādi na sidhyatītyata āha--`yatra tu' ityādi| anabhidhānaṃ dvivacanāntāt‌ pratyayānutpatterhetuḥ| taccābhidhānaṃ kva na bhavati? yatra prakṛtyarthasya saṃkhyābhedāvagamo nāstīti; pramāṇābhāvāt‌| iha tu pramāṇamastyeva kiñcit‌| dvyādaya eva śabdāḥ prakṛtitvenopāttāḥ| te hi svapravṛttinimittabhūtayaiva saṃkhyayā'vacchinnaṃ vastu pratipādayanti| ataḥ svārthasya saṃkhyāviseṣāvagame pramāṇam‌| tenātrānabhidhānādityeṣa hetunastiti bhavati pratyayaḥ| `tathā' ityādi| yathā trikamityādau prakṛtyarthasaṃkhyānabhāvopagame pramāṇasambhavādbahuvacanāntādapi pratyayo bhavati, tathā maud‌gikamityādāvapi mudgādiśabdaprakṛtiratra svārthasya saṃkhyāvagame pramāṇamityetaddarśayitumāha--`na hyekena' ityādi| mudgādinaikaya vyaktyā krayo na bhavatīti vināpi vibhaktyā mudgādiśabdānuvṛttau bahutvaṃ gamyate| tatra pramāṇaṃ bhavati| ekagrahaṇa trayānupayoginordvayorapyupalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam‌|| 38. tasya nimittaṃ saṃyogotpātau| (5.1.38) `mahābhūtānām‌' [mahābhūtapariṇāmaḥ-utpāttaḥ--kāśikā] iti| pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānām‌| `sāhasram‌' iti| śatamānādisūtreṇa (5.1.27) aṇ‌|| 39. godvyaco'saṃkhyāparimāṇāśvāderyat‌| (5.1.39) `ṭhañādīnāmapavādaḥ' iti| adiśabdena ṭhagādīnāṃ grahaṇ‌| nanu ca saṃkhyāparimāṇayoḥ paryudāsāt‌ kanaṣṭhako'pavāda iti vaktuṃ śakyate, tatkasmāṭṭhañādīnāmityucyate? ṭhañādīnāmityayamatadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhirdraṣṭavyaḥ| anayaivāpekṣayoktam‌--aśvasya nimittamāśvikamiti| ṭhak‌, pratyudāhṛtaḥ| sarvapratyayasambhavaḥ, tadbādhanārthamidamuktam‌| `pañcakam, aṣṭakam‌' iti| saṃkhyālakṣaṇaḥ kan‌ (5.1.22)| `prāsthikaḥ' iti| prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ‌, (5.1.18)|| 40. putrāccha ca| (5.1.48) 41. sarvabhūmipṛthivībhyāmaṇañau| (5.1.41) 42. tasyeśvaraḥ| (5.1.42) `tasya nimittam‌' (5.1.38) ityatastasyagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tatkimarthaṃ punastasyanirdeśaḥ? ityāha--ṣaṣṭhīprakaraṇe punaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamarthavibhaktinirdeśaḥ' ityādi| `pratyayārthasya' iti| nimittasya| `anyathā' iti| yadi ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ pratyayārthai nivṛttyartho na kriyate, tato yathā saṃyoga utpātaśca pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇam‌, tatheśvaro'pi tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ sambhāvyeta| tathā ceśvaraviśiṣṭe nimitta eva pratyayaḥ syāt‌|| 43. tatra viditi iti ca| (5.1.43) īśvarānukarvaṇārthaścakāraḥ| itikaraṇo vivakṣārthaḥ|| 44. lokasarvalokāṭṭhañ‌| (5.1.44) sarvatra ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ ṭhako nivṛttyartham‌, anyathā hi prakṛtimātranirdeśe kriyamāṇe `ārhāt' (5.1.19) iti ṭhakprasajyeta|| 45. tasya vāpaḥ| (5.1.45) `apyate'smin‌ vāpaḥ' iti| adhikaraṇasādhanaḥ `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti ghañ‌|| 46. pātrāt‌ ṣṭhan‌| (5.1.46) `pātraśabdaḥ parimāṇavācī' iti| `ṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| atreyaṃ yuktiḥ--yadi hyaparimāṇavācī syāt‌ tadārhīyasya ṭhako'pavādaḥ, na ṭhañaḥ| `pātrikī' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ‌|| 47. tadasminvṛddhyāyalābhaśulkopadā dīyate| (5.1.47) nanu ca vṛddhyādīnāṃ bahutvākhyānenaiva bahuvacanaṃ tena bhavitavyamitita kathaṃ dīyata ityekavacanāntena tasya nirdeśaḥ? ityāha--`dīyata ityekavacanam‌' ityādi| yadi samuditairvṛddhyādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ kriyate tarhi syādbahuvacanam‌| na ca taiḥ samuditaiḥsa kriyate, kiṃ tarhi? pratyekam‌, ata ekavacanameva| vṛddhiśabda iha laukiko dhanaviśeṣavācī gṛhyate, na ca saṃjñāpadam‌, āyādibhirdhanaviśeṣavācibhiḥ saha nirdeśāt‌| ata evāha--`tatra' ityādi| uttamarṇasya yaddhanaṃ tasmādatiriktamadhikaṃ dhanamadhamarṇena yaddātavyaṃ tad‌vṛddhiḥ| `grāmādiṣu' iti| ādiśabdena kṣetrādi| `paṭādīnām‌' ityādi| paṭādīnāṃ vyavahriyamāṇānāmupādānaṃ sūtrādi| tasya yanmūlyaṃ tasmādatiriktaṃ dravyaṃ paṭādivikrayeṇa yallabhyate sa lābha-| `rakṣānirveśaḥ' iti| vaṇijāṃ rakṣākārī rājño bhāgo rakṣānirveśa ityucyate| nanu cāsāvapayāyaḥ, tadapārthakaṃ śulkasya pṛthagupādānam‌? naitadasti; pañcāsmin‌ grāma āya ityāyaṃ prati grāmasyādhikaraṇabhāvaḥ; utpadyamānasyāyasyādheyabāvāt‌| śulke tu na sambhavati| pañcāsmin‌ śate śulkā iti śataṃ na śulkasyādhikaraṇam‌, kiṃ tarhi? iyatāparicchedaḥ śatena śulkasya kriyate| tasmādasya bhinnatvāt‌ śulkaḥ pṛthaguktaḥ| `siddhaṃ tu' ityādi| vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi bhavantīti sampradānākhye cādhikaraṇatvena vivakṣetyāha--`samam‌' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 48. pūraṇārddhāṭṭhan‌| (5.1.48) `pūraṇavācinaḥ' iti| pūryate yenārthena sa pūraṇaḥ, tadvācinaḥ prātipadikāt‌| etena `pūraṇa' ityarthasya grahaṇam‌, na pratyayasyeti darśayati| kathañca pratyayasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌? yadi pūraṇagrahaṇaṃ svaryeta| tasmin‌ hi svaryamāṇe `tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ‌' (5.2.48) ityadhikṛtya ye pratyayā vihitāste gṛhyeran‌| kiñca syāt‌? `pūraṇādbhāge tīyādan‌' (5.3.48) ityannantāṭṭhan‌ na syāt‌; apūraṇapratyayāntatvāt‌| tasyāgrahaṇe tu sati svārthikaḥ syādan‌| tasminnapyutpanne pūraṇa evārthe tadantamapi vartata iti tato'pi ṭhan‌ siddho bhavati| `ṭhakṭhanorapavādaḥ' iti| pūraṇādārhīyasya ṭhako'pavādaḥ. ardhādapi `arddhācceti vaktavyam‌' (vā.502) ityaupasaṃkhyānikasya ṭiṭhanaḥ| ṭhaki ṭiṭhani ca sati ṅīp‌ syāt‌; ṭhani tu ṭābbhavati| `dvitīyikaḥ' iti| dvayoḥ pūraṇa iti `dvestīyaḥ' (5.2.54) iti toyapratyayaḥ| `tṛtīyikaḥ' iti| `treḥ samprasāraṇañca' (5.2.55)| `pañcamikaḥ, sarptāmakaḥ' iti| `tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ‌' (5.2.48) iti ḍaṭpratyayaḥ, tasya `nāntādasaṃkhayādermaṭ‌' (5.2.49) iti maḍāgamaḥ|| 49. bhāgādyacca| (5.1.49) `ṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| na ṭhakaḥ; bhāgaśabdasya parimāṇatvāt‌| nanu cāṅgamātravacano'pi bhāgaśabdo'sti? satyamasti; na tu tasyeha grahaṇam‌| tasya hi grahaṇe vṛddhyādibhiḥ sambando nopapadyate| parimāṇavacanastu prasiddho rūpakāṃśe varttata iti vṛddhyādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ upapadyate|| 50. taddharapi vahatyāvahati bhārādvaṃśādibhyaḥ| (5.1.50) `prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam‌' ityādi| prakṛteḥ prātipadikasya| `bhārādvaṃśādibhya ityarthaḥ' iti| atrārthe vaṃśādaya eva śuddhāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti| nanu ca vaṃśādayaḥ śabdāḥ, bhāra ityapi śabda eva; na ca śabda śabdāntarasya samānādhikaraṇaṃ viseṣaṇamupapadyate, tatkathaṃ bhārabhūtebhyo vaṃśādibhya ityeṣo'rtho bhavati? ityāha--`bhāraśabdo'rthadvāreṇa' ityādi| vaṃśādīnāṃmarthasya bhāraśabdasyārtho mukhyaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌, arthadvāreṇa tu vaṃśādīnāṃ bhāraśapabdasya copacaritam| arthadharmeṇa śabdo'pi tathā vyapadiśyata ityarthaḥ|| 51. vasnadravyābhyāṃ ṭhankanau| (5.1.51) pūrveṇa ṭhaki prāpte tadapavādau ṭhankanau vidhīyate|| 52. sambhavatyavaharati pacati| (5.1.52) `pramāṇānatirekaḥ' iti| pramāṇādanādhikyamityarthaḥ| `nanu ca' ityādi| tathā hi--sakthālīprasthaṃ pacati; tatrāvaśyaṃ prasthasya sambhavena bhavitavyam‌; na hyanyathā śakyate paktumityabhiprāyaḥ| `nāstyatra niyogaḥ' iti| vyabhicāramāha--`prasthaṃ pacati brāhmaṇī' iti| atra hi pāka eva gamyate, na sambhavaḥ|| 53. āḍhakācitapātrāt‌ kho'nyatarasyām‌| `ṭhaño'pavādaḥ' iti| āñakādīnāṃ parimāṇakatvāt‌ pūrvema prāptasya|| 54. dvigoṣṣṭham̐śca| (5.1.54) pūrveṇa ṭhankhayoḥ prāptayostataśca lukīdamucyate| `vidhānasāmarthyādanayorlugna bhavati' iti| yadi hyatrāpi luk‌ syāt‌, vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `ṭhañastu pakṣe'nujñātasya' iti| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena| `dvyāḍhakī' iti| ṭhaño lukpakṣe `dvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīp‌| `dvyācitā' iti| `aparimāṇa' (4.1.22) ityādinā ṅīppratiṣedhe ṭāp‌|| 55. kulijāllukkhau ca| (5.1.55) `cātūrūpyam‌' iti| ekaṃ khe rūpam‌, ṣṭhani dvitoyam‌, luko'pi vikalpitatvāṭṭhaño'luki tṛtīyam‌, luki caturtham‌| nanu ca kulijaśabdasaya parimāṇavācitvāt‌ `parimāṇāntasya' (7.3.17) ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āāha--`parimāṇāntasya' iti| `parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇakulijāt‌' ityevaitat‌ sūtraṃ pratyetavyamiti darśayati|| 56. so'syāṃśavasnabhṛtayaḥ| (5.1.56) `vasnadravyābhyām‌' (5.1.51) ityatrāpi vasnaśabdena mūlyamucyate|| 57. tadasya parimāṇam‌| (5.1.57) `prāsthiko rāśiḥ' ityādau sarvatra ṭhañ‌| `dviṣāṣṭikaḥ' ityādi| `saṃkhyāyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' (7.3.15) ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| `punarvidhānasāmarthyāt‌' ityādinā punarvidhānaphalaṃ darśayati| `dviṣāṣṭikaḥ' ityādau dviḥ pratyavidhānam‌, tatra pūrvasūtrāt‌ samarthavibhakteḥ pratyāyārthasayānuvṛtteḥ prathamaṃ pratyayo vidhīyate, tasya `adhyardhapūrva' (5.1.28) sūtreṇa lugbhavati| nanviha ca yaḥ sūtre samarthavibhakteḥ pratyayārthasya copādanāt‌ punarvidhīyate tasyāpi punarvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌|| 58. saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsahghasūtrādhyayaneṣu| (5.1.58) `parimāṇopādhikāt‌' iti| parimāṇamupādhirviśeṣaṇaṃ na sambhavati, na hi śabdaḥ parimāṇaṃ śabdasya sambhavatīti? tadarthasya viseṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyata ityadoṣaḥ| nanu cārthasyāpi na sambhavati, saṃkhyā hi naiva parimāṇam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nātra rūḍhaḥ parimāṇaśabdo gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi? kriyāśabdaḥ--parimāyate yena tat‌ parimāṇamiti| saṃkhyāyāpi ca parimīyata iti sāpi parimāṇam‌| nanvevamapi viśeṣaṇamanarthakam; na hyaparicchedikā saṃkhyāsti, sañcakṣāṇā hi saṃkhyocyate? satadyam‌; paricchedikaiva saṃkhyā, sā tu svasyābhideyaṃ paricchinattīti ṣaṣṭhyarthamavaśyaṃ na paricchinatti| pañcāsya saṅghasya putrā iti nātra sahghasyeyattā pratīyate| iha tu pañcasaṃkhyā parimāṇamasya saṅghasyeti bhavatīyattāpratītiḥ saṅghasya| tasmādupapannaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌| `tatra' ityādi| pañcaśabdo'yaṃ saṃkhyeya eva varttate, na kadācidapi saṃkhyānamātre| tataśca ya eva saṃkhyeyāḥ pañcatvasaṃkhyayāvacchinnāḥ pañcaśabdenocyante, pratyayāntenāpi ta eva na hi teṣāṃ bhinnānāmatra saṃkhyeyāntaraṃ parimāṇaṃ pratyayavākyaṃ sambhavapati| tasmāt‌ saṃjñāyāṃ svārthaṃ eva pratyayo vācyaḥ| tathā cāha vārttikakāraḥ--`saṃjñāyāṃ svārthe utpadyate' iti| `pañcako'dhītaḥ' iti pāṭhāpekṣayā puṃlliṅgaḥ| `adhītiradhyayanam‌' iti| anena bhāvasādhanamadhyayanaśabdaṃ darśayati| yadyadhīyata ityadhyayanaṃ karmasādhano'dyayanaśabdaḥ syāt‌, sūtragrahaṇaṃ pṛthagvaktavyaṃ na syāt‌; adhyayanagrahaṇenaiva siddhatvāt‌, sūtramapyadhīyata eva| `pañcāvṛttyaḥ' iti pāṭhe punaḥ kriyātmikāḥ pañca vārā ityādinā paryāyāntareṇa pañcāvṛttya ityasyaivārthaṃ vyaktīkaroti| `stome ḍavidhiḥ' iti| atrāpi cchandasīti sambadhyate| mantrasamudāyaḥ stomaḥ| `ekaviṃśaḥ' iti| `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ ca, `ti viṃśaterḍiti (6.4.142) iti tiśabdalopaḥ| `śanśatoḥ' ityādi| śannityevamantācchandasi ḍinirvaktavyaḥ|| 59. paṃktiviṃśatitriṃśaccatvāriṃśatpañcāśatṣaṣṭisaptatyaśītinavatiśatam‌| (5.1.59) `apadatvaṃ ca' iti| padanibandhanasya jaśatvādeḥ kāryasya pratiṣedhārthamihaite viṃśatyādayaḥ parimāṇe nipātyante| `tadasya parimāṇam‌' (5.1.57) ityadhikāre nipātanāt‌| evañca gavāṃ viṃśatiriti ṣaṣṭhī vyatirekanibandhanā na prāpnoti| viṃśatiśabdena hi tānyeva godravyāṇi gṛhyante, na tadadhikaṃ kiñcidarthāntaram‌| bahuvacanaṃ prasajati teṣāṃ bahutvāditi yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`viṃśatyādayaḥ' ityādi| yathākathañcitprakāreṇa| vināpyavayavārtheneti yāvat‌| rūpamātraṃ pradhānam‌, nāvayavārthaḥ| yastveṣāmarthaḥ sa lokata eva vyavatiṣṭhata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `nātrābhiniveṣṭavyam‌' iti| saṃkhyāparimāṇopādhikaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ| `parimāṇamātraṃ pratyayāḥ' iti nāyamatrābhiniveśaḥ karttavya ityarthaḥ| anabhiniveśasya kāraṇamāha--`tathā hi' ityādi| syādetat‌--`atrāpyavayavārtho'sti' ityata āha--`na ca' ityādi| brāhmāṇānāṃ paṃktirityukte saṃkhyāparimāṇopādhikaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ, parimāṇo vā kaśṭacit‌; pratyayārtho hi na gamyate, kiṃ tarhi? sanniveśaviśeṣaḥ saṃsthānātmako guṇa eva pratīyate| tathā hi--tasya sanniveśaviśeṣasyānavagame tāvatsyeva brāhmaṇeṣu paṃktiriti na prayujyate| tadevaṃ guṇaśabdatvādviṃśatyādīnāṃ gavāṃ viṃśatiriti sidhyati ṣaṣṭhī; viṃśatiśabdasya saṃkhyānavṛttitvāt‌| yadi tarhi guṇaśabdā ete, viṃśatigavi iti dravyaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti? guṇinyatra vṛttiḥ, guṇamātre na tato'yamadoṣa iti| vaktavyaḥ sa hetuḥ yata eteṣā kvacidguṇamātre vṛttirbhavati, kvacidguṇini| bahuvacanaprasaṅgācca guṇini vṛttirityetadeva duḥstham‌; bahutvādguṇinām‌| iha ca viṃśatiḥ kuṇḍānīti napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ prāpnoti, viṃśatirbrāhmaṇā iti puṃlliṅgam‌, guṇavacanānāṃ hi śabdānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti, yathā--śuklaḥ kambalaḥ, śuklaṃ vastram‌, śuklā śāṭīti| yadāsau dravyamāśritya bhavati guṇaḥ, tasya liṅgavacanaṃ yat‌ tadguṇavacanasyāpi bhavati, yathā--guṇaśabdatve'pyeṣāmāśrīyamāṇe na bhavatyeva doṣaprasaṅgānmuktiḥ? ityata āha--`yā caiṣām‌' ittayādi| na kevalamarthābhidānaṃ svābhāvikam‌, kintvetadapītyapiśabdena darśayati| yatra dravyeṇa guṇinaiṣāmabhidheyo guṇo viśeṣyate, tatra svabhāvādeva guṇamātre vṛttiḥ| yatra tveta upasarjanībhūtasvārthāstena svārthena dravyaṃ viśeṣayanti tatraiṣāṃ svabhāvata eva guṇini vṛttiḥ| `svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānaṃ ca' iti| guṇinyaṇi varttamānānāṃ yayorliṅgasaṃkhyayoryadanuvidhānamanuvarttamānametadapi sarvaṃ svābhāvikam‌| anyeṣāmapi, guṇaśabdānāmapi kvacit‌ svabhāvata eva guṇini vṛttirbhavati, tadyathā-śuklaḥ paṭa ityatra śuklaśabdasya| kvacidguṇamātre, yathā--asyaiva śuklo guṇaḥ paṭasyetyatra| anyeṣāmapi keṣāñcit‌ śabdānāṃ svābhāvikaṃ svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānaṃ dṛśyata eva, tadyathā--vedāḥ pramāṇam‌, śrutayaḥ pramāṇamiti| tasmāt‌ svābhāvikatvādguṇamātre guṇini ca vṛtteḥ svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānasya ca na bhavati yathaktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ| yadā hi svabhāvata iti saṃkhyānamātre guṇe guṇamātre vṛttiḥ tadā vyatirekanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| yadā tu guṇini, tadā tayorapi ca dravyaśabdatvākat‌ sāmānādhikaraṇyamapi bhavati| dravye'pi varttamānānāṃ svābhāvikaṃ svaliṅgasaṃkhyānuvidhānam‌| atha sahasrādayo'pi kasmānna vyutpādyante? ityāha--`sahasrādayo'pi' ityādi| evañjātīyakā evamprakārā viṃśatyādibhiḥ sadṛśā ityarthaḥ| teṣāmapi guṇavattvāt‌ tadvadeva viṃśātyādivadeva draṣṭavyāḥ| viṃśātyādaya iva te'pi prakṛtyādivibhāgena vyutpādyanta ityarthaḥ| yadyevam‌, kimarthaṃ viṃśatyādaya eva sūtre upāttāḥ? ityāhṛṛ`udāharaṇamātram‌' ityādi| udāharaṇamātraṃ viṃśatyādigrahaṇam‌, anye'pyevañjātīyāḥ sahasrādayastathaiva vyutpādyāḥ|| 60. pañcad‌daśatau varge vā| (5.1.60) nanu ca `saṅgha' ityanuvarttiṣyate, kiṃ vargagrahaṇena? naitadasti; saṅghaśabdo hi prāṇisamudāye rūḍhaḥ| vargaśabdastu samūhamātre iti vargagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 61. saptano'ñ‌ chandasi| (5.1.61) saṃkhyālakṣaṇe kani prāpte saptañśabdācchandasyañvidhānam‌|| 62. triṃśaccatvāriṃśatorbrāhmaṇe saṃjñāyāṃ ḍaṇ‌| (5.1.62) triṃśacchabdāt‌ `viṃśatitriṃśadbhyām‌' (5.1.24) iti yogavibāgena kani prāpte catvāriṃśacchabdādapi `prāgvateṣṭhañ‌' (5.1.18) iti ṭhañi prāpte'yamārabhyate| `abhidheye saptamyeṣā' ityādi| viṣayasaptamyāmasyāṃ brāhmaṇaviṣayaścet‌ prayogo bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ syāt‌, tathā cānyatra pratyayāntasya prayogo na syāt‌, tasmānna viṣayasaptamyeṣā| etacca saṃjñāgrahaṇādeva vijñāyate| na hi brāhmaṇagrahaṇāt‌ triṃśaccatvāriṃśatau ḍaṇṇantau kasyacit‌ padārthasya saṃjñinau staḥ, brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vidyate|| 63. tadarhati| (5.1.63) `śvaitacchatrikaḥ, vāstrayugmikaḥ' ityādiṣu ṭhak‌| `ārhāt‌ (5.1.19) ityabhividhau cāyamākāra iti|| 64. chedādibhyo nityam‌| (5.1.64) `nityagrahaṇam‌' iti| atha vibhāṣāyā nivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇena kasmānna vijñayate? aśakyaṃ tannivṛttyarthaṃ vijñātum‌| vināpi nityagrahaṇena mahāvibhāṣānivṛttiḥ śakyate vijñātum‌| tathā hi--chedādibhyaḥ pūrveṇaiva ṭhaki siddhe punarvacanādeva nityavidhirbhaviṣyati, kiṃ nityagrahaṇena? tato nityagrahaṇamahanyahanyarhatvāt‌ `tadarhati' (5.1.63) ityasyārthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tathā ca jātamārambhasya prayojanamiti vākyaṃ na nivartate| `virāgo viraṅgañca' iti| virāgaśabdaṣṭhakamutpādayati viraṅgādeśaṃ cāpadyate| nityaṃ virāgamarhati vairaṅgikaḥ| pratyayasanniyogena cāyasādeśa iti pratyayābhāvādvākye na bhavati|| 65. śīrṣacchedādyacca| (5.1.65) pratyayasanniyogena śīrṣabhāvaḥ, tena vākye pratyayābhāvānna bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|| 66. daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ| (5.1.66) daṇḍaśabdo'yamasti kriyāvacanaḥ--dḍanaṃ daṇḍa iti, asti dravyavacanaḥ; viśeṣābhāvāddvayorapi grahaṇam‌|| 67. chandasi ca| (5.1.67) yadanuvarttate, nānantaro yaḥ; yata eva svaritatvāt‌|| 68. pātrādgham̐śca| (5.1.68) `ṭhakṭhañorapavādaḥ' iti| nanu ca pātraṃ bhājanam‌, na parimāṇam‌, atastadvācinaṣṭhak‌ prāpnoti, tasyaivāpavādo yuktaḥ, tatkimucyate ṭhakṭhañorapavādaḥ? ityāha--`pātraṃ parimāṇamapyasti' iti| na kevalaṃ bhājanamityapiśabdena darśayati| tatra yadā parimāṇe pātraśabdo varttate, tadā ṭhaño'pavādaḥ; yadā bhājane, tadā ṭhakaḥ| pātraṃ sthālyādi| ko'rthaḥ? caṇḍālādirbāhyaśca pātraṃ parimāṇamarhati| yena bhukte punarna saṃskāreṇa bhājanaṃ śudhyati sa pātriyaḥ, pātrya iti cocyate|| 69. kaḍṅgaradakṣiṇāccha ca| (5.1.69) `cakārādyacca' iti| athānantarasya yataḥ samuccayaḥ kasmānna bhavati? evaṃ manyate--svaratatvaṃ pratijñātamiti| anantarācca svarita āsannataraḥ| sa ca pratiyogamupatiṣṭhamāno vākyaśeṣa eva bhavati| tasmādyata eva samuccayo yukta iti| yo gaurnirguṇatvāt‌ khalakaṇādyanarhaḥ sa kaḍaṅgaryaḥ kaḍaṅgarīya iti cocyate| māṣādīnāṃ khaleṣvavaskaranālakāṣṭhamatidurjaraṃ busādyapi kaḍaṅgaramucyate| athātra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ kasmānna bhavati, asti hi tasya prāptiḥ, prakṛtipratyayānāṃ sāmyāta; tathā hi--dve prakṛtau, dvau pratyayau? ityata āha--`alpāctarasya' ityādi| dakṣiṇaśabdasyālpāctarasya pūrvanipāte prāpte yo'yamiha paranipātaḥ sa lakṣaṇānapekṣatāṃ nirdeśasya darśayan‌ lakṣaṇavyabhicārasyacihnaṃ bhavati| atastena cihnena yathā-saṃkhyābhāvaṃ sūcayati sūtrakāraḥ| tena na bhavati yathāsaṃkhyam‌|| 70. sthālībilāt‌| (5.1.70) `chayatāvanuvartete' iti| nanu cānukṛṣṭamuttaratra nānuvarttata iti cānukṛṣṭasya yataḥ punariha cakāreṇānu-vṛttirnopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; anityā hyeṣā paribhāṣā| kathaṃ jñāyate? `ekājuttarapade ṇaḥ' (8.4.12) ityatra ṇe prakṛte punarṇagrahaṇāt‌| taddhi `vā bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' (8.4.10) ityanuvarttamānasya vikalpasya nivṛttyarthaṃ kriyate| yadi ceyaṃ nityā syātad‌, pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvādeva hi tasyānuvṛttirna bhavati| atha vā--cakāropyatrānu-varttate yato'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tena pūrvatra cānukṛṣṭasyāpi tasya punariha cakāreṇānukṛṣyamāṇasyānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati| `sthālībilakaḍaṅgaradakṣiṇāccha ca' ityekayoge karttavye yadidaṃ yogavibhāgakaraṇaṃ tatsthālībilādviśeṣe varttamānāt‌ pratyayo yathā syādityevamartham‌| tena sthālomukha eva varttamānaḥ sthālīvilaśabdaḥ pratyayamutpādayati| na tu sthālīsambandhini cchidramātre varttamānaḥ|| 71. yajñartvigbhyāṃ ghakhañau| (5.1.71) 72. pārāyaṇaturāyaṇacāndrāyaṇaṃ vartayati| dvitīyāprakaraṇe punardvitoyoccāraṇamiṣṭaviṣaye dvitīyāntādyathā syādityevamartham‌| tena yadyapi pārāyaṇaṃ guruṇā śiṣyeṇa ca gamyate tathāpi śiṣya eva pratyayo bhavati, na gurau| tathā turāyaṇo yāgo yadyapi yajamānena yājakaiśca varttyate tathāpi yajamāna eva pratyayo bhavati, na yājake|| 73. saṃśayamāpannaḥ| (5.1.73) atrāpi dvitīyāprakaraṇe punardvitīyoccāraṇamiṣṭaviṣaye dvitīyāntādyathā syādityevamartham‌| tena yadyapi dve api kartṛkarmaṇī saṃśayamāpanne, tathāpi yadviṣayaḥ saṃśaya utpadyate tatraiva karmaṇi sthāṇvādau pratyayo bhavati, na tu saṃśayasya karttari puruṣe; anabhidhānāt‌|| 74. yojanaṃ gacchati| (5.1.74) `krośaśatayojanaśatayorupasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tathā tato'bhigamana-marhatīti cetyādāvapi vākye| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--iha dvitīyādhikāre punaradvitīyoccāraṇamadhikaṃ tu kurvataitat‌ sūcitam‌--anyadapyatra kiñcidadhikaṃ bhavati| tena sarvametadgaditaṃ kāryamupapannaṃ bhavati|| 75. pathaḥ ṣkan‌| (5.1.75) 76. pantho ṇa nityam‌| (5.1.76) `nityagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| atha vākyanivṛttyarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? panthaśabdasya vākyāsamavāyitvāt‌| sa hi pratyayasanniyogena vidhīyate, na vākyena samavaiti| nanu ca pathinśabdena vākyaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌? naitadasti; yadi tadevamarthaṃ syāt‌ pūrvasūtra eva kṛtaṃ syāt‌--yatra pathinśabdaḥ śruyate| iha tu karaṇe pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate|| 77. uttarapathenāhṛtañca| (5.1.77) `cakāraḥ pratyayārtha' iti| pratyayārthasamīpe śrūyamāṇatvāt‌| gacchatītyatra pūrvaṃ dvitīyāntāt‌ pratyaya utpannaḥ| tadihāpi tata eva pratyayena bhavitavyamiti bhrāntiḥ syāt‌| atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`atrāpi' ityādi| cakāro hyarthāt‌ paraḥ śrūyamāṇo'trārthamātrasyaiva gacchatotyasyānukarṣakaḥ pratīyate, na tu vibhakterapi; sambandhābhāvāt‌| tasmāt‌ sa ihānuvṛttaḥ sannihitayā samarthavibhaktyā sambadhyamānastṛtīyāsamarthādeva pratyayamutpādayatīti bhāvaḥ| `vārijaṅgala' ityādi| vāryādayaḥ pūrvapadaṃ yasya tat‌ tathoktam‌| etayorevārthayorupasaṃkyānam‌| `madhukamaricayoḥ' ityādi| madhukamaricayorabhidheyayoḥ sthalāt‌ paro yaḥ pathinśabdaḥ, tadantādāhṛte vaktavyaḥ|| 78. kālāt‌| (5.1.78) kālāditi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati, kutaḥ? pṛthagasya yogasyārambhāt‌| kālaśabdasyāpi yadi svarūpagrahaṇama bhīṣṭaṃ syādimaṃ pṛthagyogamakṛtvottarasūtre kālaśabdādeva tṛtīyāmuccārayet‌--kālena nirvṛttamiti| evaṃ hi nirdeśādeva tṛtīyāsamarthāt‌ pratyayo vijñāyate| uttarasūtre ca kālaśabdaḥ svaritatvādanuvarttiṣyata iti siddhamiṣṭam‌| ato na karttavya evāyaṃ pṛthagyogaḥ| sa eva kriyate'rthagrahaṇaṃ taditi darśayitum‌|| 79. tena nirvṛttam‌| (5.1.79) `āhnikaḥ' [āhnikam‌-kāśikā] iti| `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopaḥ| ṭilopastu `ahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.145) iti niyamādiha na bhavati|| 80. tamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhāvī| (5.1.80) `kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā| `tamadhīṣṭaḥ' ityādau karmaṇi dvitīyā nopapadyate; adhyeṣyamāṇādi hi puruṣādikarmānayāniṣṭayābhihitam‌, na cānyā kriyā'sti yasyāṃ māsādi karma syāt‌| `nanu ca' ityādinā, yaduktam‌--`kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) dvitīyeti tadvighaṭayati| tena kathaṃ māso vyāpyata iti? na kathañcit‌| vighaṭata ityarthaḥ| yaddhi muhūrttaṃ kriyate, tena muhūrttena māsaikadeśo vyāpyate, na tu sakalo māsaḥ| `kriyārthe' iti| adhyayanādikriyārthe| tadarthaṃ hi te kriyete| `phalabhūtayā kriyayā' iti| adhyayanādikayā| `tābyāmeva vyāpta ityucyate' iti| tadanyavyāpārasya tatropacārāt‌| yathā `caureṇa grāmo dagdhaḥ' ityukte na caureṇa grāmo dahyate, api tu tadāhṛtenāgninā| upacāreṇa tu tathā vyapadeśaḥ|| 81. māsādvayasaki yatkhañau| (5.1.81) `sāmarthyādbhūt‌ evātrābhisambadhyate' iti| vayasi bhūtārthasyaiva sambhavāditi bhāvaḥ| bhāvyartho'pi tatra sambhavatīti cintyametat‌| atha tu neṣyate, punarabhidhānaṃ śaraṇamāśrayitavyam‌| khaño ñitkaraṇaṃ svarārtham‌, vṛddhyarthañca| nanu ca vṛddha eva māsaśabdaḥ? satyaṃ vṛddho'yam‌, tathāpi vṛddhasyāpi vṛddhireṣitavyā| māsīnābhārya iti `vṛddhinimitasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre' (6.3.39) iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedo yathā syāt‌|| 82. dvigoryap‌| (5.1.82) `prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantagrahaṇamaluki' iti (kāśikā. 5.1.20) tadantaviderabhyanujñānād‌dvigorapi --| yayaḥ pitkaraṇananudāttārtham‌| anyathā māsaśabdāntāt‌ pratyaye vihite siti śiṣṭatvāt‌ `igantakāla' (6.2.29) iti dvigāveveti svarabādhanāt‌ pratyayasvaraḥ syāt‌, -- syāt‌| pratyaye'nudāttārthe piti `iganta' (6.2.29) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ siddho bhavati|| 83. ṣaṇmāsāṇṇyacca| (5.1.83) ṣaṇmāsaśabdo dviguḥ| tasmāt‌ pūrveṇa yapi prāpte vacanam‌| `sa cakāreṇa samuccetavyaḥ' iti| yadyevam‌, kathamanantaro yabbhavati? ityāha--`svaritatvāccānuvarttiṣyate' iti| tenānuvṛttisāmarthyādanantaro yabbhavatīti manyate|| 84. avayasi ṭham̐śca| (5.1.84) 85. samāyāḥ khaḥ| (5.1.85) 86. dvigorvā| (5.1.86) `pūrveṇa' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ samāśabdādvidhīyamānaḥ pratyayastadantād‌dvigoḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`prāgvateḥ' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 87. rātryahassaṃvatsarācca| (5.1.87) `dvyahīnaḥ' iti| `ahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.145) iti ṭilopaḥ| vibhāṣānuvarttate, tena vyavasthitavibhāṣātvānna ṭajbhaviṣyati| `dvaiyahnikaḥ, traiyahnikaḥ' iti| `na yvābhyām‌' (7.3.3) ityādinaijāgamaḥ, vṛddhipratiṣedhaśca|| 88. varṣālluk‌ ca| (5.1.88) `bhāvini tu traivarṣikaḥ' iti| tatra hi `abhaviṣyati' (7.3.16) iti vacanāt‌| ihādivṛddhireva bhavati|| 89. cittavati nityam‌| (5.1.89) yadi cittavati pratyayārthe nityaṃ lugbhavati, `varṣasyābhaviṣyati' (7.3.16) ityatra yadvakṣyati--`dve varṣe adhīṣṭo bhṛto vā karma kariṣyatoti dvivārṣiko manuṣyaḥ' ita, tadvirudhyate; na hi nitye lukyadhīṣṭabhṛtayorutpannasya pratyayasya cittavatyabhidheya evaṃ rūpamupapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhūta evāsyotpannasya pratyayasya cittavati nityaṃ lugiṣyate, na sarvatra| kuta etat‌? nityagrahaṇāt‌| iha nityagrahaṇamanarthakameva| ārambhasāmarthyādeva nityo lugbhaviṣyatīti kiṃ niyamagrahaṇena? tat‌ kriyate viśiṣṭe'rthe nityo lugyathā syādityevamartham‌| sa punarviśiṣṭo bhūta eva|| 90. ṣaṣṭikāḥ ṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyante| (5.1.90) `bahuvacavāntasya nirdeśādbahuvacana eva ṣaṣṭikaśabdasya sādhutvam‌, nānyatra' iti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`bahuvacanamatantram‌' iti| apradhānamityacarthaḥ| apradhānatvaṃ tu tasya nāntarīyakatvāt‌| avaśyaṃ hi yena kenacidvacanena nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ| yadyevam‌, ekavacanena nirdeśaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ, evaṃ hi laghurbhavati? satyam‌; vaicitryārthaṃ bahuvacanena kṛtaḥ| yadi `ṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyante' ityasminnayaṃ etannipātanaṃ, mudgādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ, te'pi hi ṣaṣṭirātreṇapacyante? ityata āha--`saṃjñaiṣā' ityātadi| dhānyaviśeṣa eva hiṃ ṣaṣṭikaśabdaḥ saṃjñātvena rūḍhaḥ| tenābhidhānāmmudgādiṣvatiprasaṅgo na bhavati|| 91. vatsarāntācchaścandasi| (5.1.91) 92. saṃparipūrvātkha ca| (5.1.92) 93. tena parijayyalabhyakāryyasukaram‌| (5.1.93) `parijayyaḥ' iti| pariḥ sarvatobhāve| śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ| sarvataḥ śakyo jetuṃ `parijayyaḥ' `labhyaḥ' iti, `kāryyaḥ' iti| atrāpi śakyārtha eva kṛtyau| māsena śakyo labyo māsikaḥ paṭaḥ| māsena śakyaṃ kartu sukaraṃ vā māsikaṃ cāndrāyaṇam‌| `tena nirvṛttam‌' (5.1.79) `tamadhīṣṭaḥ' (5.1.80) iti vibhaktitadvaye prakṛte punasteneti tṛtīyopādanāṃ dvitīyānivṛttyartham|| 94. tadasya brahmacaryam‌| (5.1.94) `dvābhyāmapi sambadhyate' iti| samarthavibhaktyā, pratyayārthena ca| kathaṃ sambadhyate? ityāha--`kālasya' ityādi| iha hi dvitīyā'tyantasaṃyoge|sā hiyaḥ kālasya vyāpakastamapekṣate, nāntarayakatvāt‌| na hi tena vinā'tyantasaṃyoga upapadyate| brahmacaryaṃ ca `kālasya vyāpakam‌' iti| `vyāpakam‌' iti| vyāpakamapekṣamāṇāyāṃ vibhaktau brahmacaryasambandho bhavati| kathaṃ pratyayārthena sambadhyate? ityata āha--`pratyayārthasya ca svam‌' iti| pratyayārthaḥ pratiyogi vasaktu svamapekṣate|prakṛtatvācca brahmacaryasyaiva pratiyogitvaṃ vijñāyate, taddhi tasya svaṃ bhavati| ataḥ pratiyogyapekṣāyāṃ pratyayārthasyāpi brahmacaryeṇa sambandho bhavati| `pūrvatra' ityādinā pūrvottarayorvṛttyorviśeṣaṃ darśayati| kiṃ punaratra pramāṇamityāha--`dvayamapi' ityādi| kathaṃ punarddhayamapi pramāṇamityāha--`ubhayathā' ityādi| ubhayasminnapi hyatrārthe sūtrametadācāryeṇa praṇītam‌| dvayamapi pramāṇam‌| `mahānāmnyādibhya' iti| brahmacaryaṃ evārtha idamupasaṃkhyānām‌| `taccarati' ityādi| taditi dvitīyāsamarthebhyo mahānāmnyādibhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ `carati' ityetasminnarthe idaṃ ṭhaña upasaṃkhyānam‌| `tatsahacaritaṃ vrataṃ tacchabdenocyate' iti| bhavati hi sāhacaryāt‌ tācchabdyam‌, yathā--yaṣṭīḥ praveśayeti| atha ṛca evocyanta ityevaṃ kasmānna vijñāyete? caraṇārthasyāyogāt‌| brahmacarya hi caryate| `caturmāsāṇṇyo yajñe' ityādi| catumasiśabdāt‌ tatreti saptamīsamarthādbhava ityetasminnarthe yajñe viṣaye ṇyo vaktavyaḥ| `saṃjñāyāmaṇvaktavyaḥ' iti| caturmāsādbhava ityetadapekṣate| idañca yajñādanyatropasaṃkhyānam| nanu ca `tatra bhavaḥ (4.3.53) ityanenāṇaabhavatyeva, kimarthamupasaṃkhyāyate? satyamasti; tasya tu dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) iti lukprapnoti| ato lugbādhanārthaṃ tasyopasaṃkhyānam‌|| 95. tasya ca dakṣiṇā yajñākhyebhyaḥ| (5.1.95) athākhyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌? na yajñebya ityucyeta? ityata āha--`ākhyāgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yajñānamadheyamātrādakālavācino'pi pratyayo yathā syādityevamarthamākyāgrahaṇamiti| `itarathā hi' ityādi| yadyākhyāgrahaṇaṃ na kriyotetyarthaḥ| nanu caikāhadvādaśāhādayo naiva kālaśabdāḥ, tatkutasteṣāmevātragrahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ? athākālavācināmapyeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ sambhavati? evaṃ satyagniṣṭomādīnāmapi bhaviṣyatītyapārthakamākhyāgrahaṇam‌? ityata āha--`prāgvateḥ' ityādi| yadyapyete kālaśabdā na bhavanti, tathāpi prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantavidhirabhyanujñātaḥ| tena satyapi kālādhikāre'pyasti teṣu grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ| tathā ca tatra vacanasya caritārthatvādagniṣṭomādibhyo na syāt‌, tebhyo'pi yathā syādityākhyāgrahaṇam‌| nanu caivamapi sūtramanarthakam‌, yā hyagniṣṭomasya dakṣiṇā sāpyagniṣṭome bhavati| tatra `bahvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañ‌' (4.3.67) `kratuyajñebhyaśca' (4.3.68) ityeva ṭhañ‌ siddhaḥ| idamapi sūtraṃ ṭhañarthamevārabhyate? satyametat‌, kintu bhāvarthe `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) iti vivakṣite tadā paratvādaṇādayaḥ syuriti yuktaṃ vidhānam‌| api ca yajñākhyebhyastena ṭhañiṣyate| grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhyabhāvāt‌ saṃkhyāpūrvapadebhyaṣṭhañ‌ na labhyeta--dvayorvājapeyayorbhavā dakṣiṇā dvaivājapeyikīti| anena ca vidhānena `prāgvateḥ saṃkhyāpūrvapadānāṃ tadantagrahaṇamaluki' (kāśikā. 5.1.20) iti ṭhañ‌ siddho bhavati| athāpi kathañcit‌ tadantavidhirbhavārthe labhyate, tathāpi `dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) iti lukprasajyeta| tasmādyuktaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ| 96. tatra ca dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavat‌| (5.1.96) `yathā māse bhavaṃ māsikam‌' ityādi| `kālāṭṭhañ‌' (4.3.11) iti| `prāvṛṣeṇyam‌' iti| `prāvṛṣa eṇyaḥ' (4.3.17)| `vāsantaṃ śāradam‌' iti| sandhivelādisūtre (4.3.16) ṇāṇ‌| `haimanam‌' iti| `hemantācca' (4.3.21) iti, `sarvatrāṇca talopaśca' (4.3.22) iti| vatiḥ sādṛśyārthaḥ| `kālebhyo bhavavat‌' (4.2.34) ityatraitadvyākhyātam‌| tata evānugantavyam‌| cakāraḥ kālādityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ, tena cānukṛṣṭatvāduttaratra nānuvarttate, ata āha--`kālādhikārasya pūrṇo'vadhiḥ' ityādi| nanu ca yanmāse dīyate kāryaṃ ca tanmāse bhavati; māsādhāratvāt‌ tatsattāyāḥ| ataḥ `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityanenāṇaiva siddhamiti kimatideśena? evaṃ tena satyapi bhavatyarthe kāryadīyamānayoḥ kāryatāṃ dīyamānatāñca kālāntāt‌ taiḥ pratyayairapi khyāyayitumatideśaḥ| kiñcānena ca tatra bhavānāmapi na | tena sati tasmin‌ tadantavidheriṣṭatvād‌dvayormāsayordīyate kāryaṃ vā--dvaimāsikamiti| athāpi kathañcidbhavārthe'pi tadantavidhirgṛhyate, evamapi `dvigoḥ' (4.1.88) iti luk‌ syāt‌| nanu cātrāpi vidhāne satyatideśādeva luk‌ prāpnoti? vacanasāmarthyān‌ pratyayamātrasyātideśo vijñāsyate, na sarvakāryāṇāmityadoṣaḥ|| 97. vyuṣṭādibhyo'ṇ‌| (5.1.97) vyuṣṭaśabdo'yaṃ kālaśabdaḥ| tatsāhacaryānnityaśabdo'pi kālaśabda eva gṛhyate| nākāśādivacanaḥ| tena tatra saptamyapavādaḥ `kāladhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā bhavati| tena saptamyadhikāre'pi nityaśabdād‌dvitīyāsamarthādeva pratyayaḥ| nityaṃ dīyate `naityam‌'| sarvakāle dīyate ityarthaḥ| `aṇprakaraṇe' ityādi| padetat‌ kātyāyanenoktam‌ `aṇprakaraṇe agnipadādibhya upasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.532) ityetanna vaktavyam‌| kathaṃ tarhyaṇ‌ syāt‌? vyuṣṭādiṣvevāgnipadādayaḥ paṭhitavyā| athāṇgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā bhavavat‌' (5.1.96) ityetadihānuvarttate, tenaivātrāṇapi bhaviṣyati? naivaṃ śakyam‌; evaṃ hi sati vyuṣṭanityaśabdābhyāṃ `kālāṭṭhañ‌' (4.3.11) iti ṭhañ‌ syāt‌; naiṣa doṣaḥ; tatra punarārambhasāmarthyādyaṣṭhañā bādhitaḥ sa eva bhaviṣyati| kaḥ punarasau? aṇeva| evamapi tīrthaśabdāt‌ dvyajṛdbrāhmaṇādi(4.3.72)sūtreṇa ṭhagvihita iti tataṣṭhageva syāt‌| ye cātra praveśanādayo'ntodāttāḥ; tebhyaṣṭhañ‌ syāt‌ `brahvaco'ntodāttāṭṭhañ‌(4.3.97)iti; tebhyo bhavārthe ṭhaño vihitatvāt‌| tasmādaṇgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 98. tena yathākathācahastābhyāṃ ṇayatau| (5.1.98) `yathāsaṃkhyaṃ neṣyate' iti| alpāctarasya hastaśabdasya paranipāto lakṣaṇavyabhicārasya vacanahetuḥ| `tṛtīyārthamātrañcātra sambhavati' iti| tṛtīyārthasya gamyamānatvāt‌| tathā hi--yathākathāca dattamityukte, anādareṇa dattamiti gamyate| `na tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktiḥ' iti| yathākathācaśabdasaya vākyatvāt‌| pratyastu vacanasāmarthyādvākyādapi bhavatyeva|| 99. sampādini| (5.1.99) `guṇotkarṣaḥ sampattiḥ' iti| sampādinītyatra prakṛtibhāgasyārthamācaṣṭe| pūrvāvasthāyā guṇātireko guṇotkarṣaḥ| `āvaśyake ṇiniḥ' iti| avaśyaṃ sampadyata iti `āvaśyakādhamarṇayorṇiniḥ' (3.3.170)| `viśeṣataśobhate' iti| śobhanākhyasya guṇasya pūrvāvasthāyā utkarṣādatiricyamānatvāt‌|| 100. karmaveṣādyat‌| (5.1.100) `karṇyam‌' iti| `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ|| 101. tasmai prabhavati santāpādibhyaḥ| (5.1.101) `saktumāṃsaudanādvigṛhītādapi' iti| apiśabdāt‌, saṅghātādapi| sāktumāṃsaudanikaḥ| sāktukaḥ| māṃsikaḥ| audanikaḥ|| 102. yogādyacca| (5.1.102) 103. karmaṇa ukañ‌| (5.1.103) 104. samayastadasya prāptam‌| (5.1.104) atha kimarthaṃ taditi samarthavibhaktirnirdiśyate; yāvatā samaya iti nirdeśādeva sā dṛśyate? ityatrāha--`samarthavibhaktinirdeśa uttarārthaḥ' iti| `ṛtoraṇ‌' (5.1.105) inyevamādau prathamāsamarthādyathā syāditi uttarārthañca kriyamāṇo'trāpi vispaṣṭārtho bhaviṣyatītyatraiva kṛtaḥ; nottaratra|| 105. ṛtoraṇ‌| (5.1.105) vasanto'sya puṣpaderṛtuḥ prāptaḥ, sa tasya janakatvāt‌ prayojako bhavatīti `prayojanam‌' (5.1.109) iti ṭhañi prāpte satyayamārabhyate|| 106. chandasi ghas‌| (5.1.106) ghasaḥ sakāraḥ `siti ca' (1.4.16) iti padasaṃjñārthaḥ| tena padatvena bhatve niraste `ṛtviya' iti| atra `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) iti guṇo na bhavati|| 107. kālādyat‌| (5.1.107) 108. prakṛṣṭe ṭhañ‌| (5.1.108) `prakṛṣṭam‌' iti| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114)| kālasya dīrghatvamiha prakṛṣṭaśabdenocyate| atha ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā prakṛta eva ṭhañ‌, tatra prakṛṣṭamityetāvadeva vaktavyam‌? ityāha--`ṭhañgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌' iti| asati hi ṭhañgrahaṇe yato'nantaratvāt‌ sa eva vidhīyata iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt| tasmānmandabuddhi pravaktāraṃ prati vispaṣṭārthaṃ grahaṇam‌|| 109. prayojanam‌| (5.1.109) prayojayatīti prayojanam‌| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam‌' (3.3.113) iti karttari lyuṭ‌|| 110. viśākhāṣāḍhādaṇmanthadaṇḍayoḥ| (5.1.110) ṭhañapavādo yogaḥ| mantho'vakṣāro viloḍanadaṇḍo vā|| 111. anupravacanādibhyaścaḥ| (5.1.111) `viśipūrī' ityādi| `viśa praveśane' (dhā.pā.1824), `pūrī āpyāyane' (dhā.pā.1803), `patlṛ gatau' (dā.pā. 845) `ruha bījajanmani' (dhā.pā. 859)--etāḥ prakṛtayo yasyānasya `yuvoranākau' (7.1.1) iti yusthāne vihitasyānaḥ, tasmādvidyamānapūrvapadāccha upasaṃkhyeyaḥ| kevalasyānasya sapūrvapadatvaṃ na sambhavatīti tasya śabdasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate| gṛhapraveśanaṃ prayojanaṃ yasya tatra gṛhapraveśanaśabdo viśiprakṛtyanantaḥ, gṛhaśabdena ca sapūrvapadaḥ| yadi tarhi viśyādiprakṛtyanantācchaśabdāccha upasaṃkhyāyate, anupravacanādiṣu saṃveśanārohaṇādīnāṃ pāṭho'narthakaḥ; tasyaiva prapañcārthatvāt‌|| 112. samāpanātsapūrvapadāt‌| (5.1.112) atha padagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, sapūrvādityevocyeta? ityata āha--`padagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| asati hi padagrahaṇe, īṣadasamāptaṃ samāpanaṃ bahusamāpanaṃ tat‌ prayojanamasyeti tatrāpi prāpnoti; bhavati hyayaṃ samāpanaśabdaḥ sapūrvaḥ| padagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati; bahucapratyayasyāpadatvāt‌|| 113. aikāgārikaṭ‌ caure| (5.1.113) `caure niyamārtham‌' iti| prakṛtatvācca ṭhaña eva| evaṃ bruvatā ṭhañāntametannipātyata ityuktaṃ bhavati| nanu ca ṭakārānubandha evamarthamāsaṅgyate, ṅīvyatā syāditi, sa cātra ṭhañantatvādeva siddhaḥ, tat‌ kimarthaṃ ṭakāraḥ? ityata āha--`ṭakāraḥ' ityādi| asati hiṭakāre, yathā ṅībbhavati tathā ñitsvaro'pi--ādyudāttatvaṃ syāt| `kāryāvadhāraṇārthaṣṭakāraḥ' kriyate, tena ṅībeva bhavati, na ñitsvaraḥ| `apara ikaṭpratyayaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca nipātayanti' iti| teṣāṃ ṅībartha eva ṭakāraḥ| ekaśbado'sahāyarthaḥ, sa cāsahāyavācī draṣṭavyaḥ| asahayagrahaṇaṃ caurasya svārthe, na tūpalakṣaṇaṃ prayojanam‌|| 114. ākālikaḍadyentavacane| (5.1.114) ādiḥ-janma, antaḥ-vināśaḥ, tayorvacanamādyantavacanam‌| tasmin‌ satyetannipātanam‌| `samānakālāvādyantāvasya' iti| nanu cotpadanavināśayorayaugapadyāt‌ samanakālatvaṃ na sambhavati, na hyanena janmanāśayorekakālatā pratipadyate, kiṃ tarhi? vidyudāderanavasthāyitvapradarśanaparatvādasyetyata āha--`utpādānantaraṃ vināśinītyarthaḥ' iti| `ākālāṭṭhaṃśca' iti| yadā ṭhan‌ tadā--ākālikā| yadā ṭhañ‌ tadā--ākālikī| ākālaśabdaścāyaṃ `āṅ‌ maryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.1.13) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| ā kālādākālam‌--`kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti, tatpuruṣo vā--āvṛttaḥ kāla ākāla iti|| 115. tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ| (5.1.115) `tulyam‌' iti| karmapadametat‌, kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt‌| pratipāditaṃ hi prāk‌ kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ karmatvam‌ `stokāntikadūrarthākṛcchrāṇi ktena' (2.1.39) iti sūtre| `brāhmaṇena tulyaṃ varttate brāhmaṇavat‌' iti| kā punaratra kriyā? brāhmaṇena tulyaṃ varttate kṣatriyādigatā adhyayanādikā| nanu ca tasyā brāhmaṇaniṣṭhayā'dhyayanādikriyayaiva tulyatā| na ca tāṃ brāhmaṇaśabda āha| kiṃ tarhi? jātiṃ dravyaṃ vā| na ca tābhyāṃ kriyayā tulyatvam‌; svabhāvabhedāt‌| yatra hi kiñcit sāmānyam‌, kaścidviśeṣaḥ, sa viṣayastulyatāyāḥ iha tvatyantabheda eva? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi brāhmaṇādiśabdaiḥ kriyā nocyate, tathāpyabhidheyasambandhena pratīyate, yathā--`guḍaḥ' ityukte guḍenānabhidhīyamānā api mādhuryādayaḥ| tatra brāhmaṇādiśabdena yo'rtha ucyate tena tulyatvaṃ kriyāyā na sambhavati| ucyate cedaṃ vacanasāmarthyāt‌| yāsāvabhidheyana brāhmaṇena kriyā gamyate tayā tulapyātā vijñāsyate| nanu ca tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktivācyayā kriyayaiva pratyayārthakriyāyāstulyatā, tasyāśca ghañanto'vakāśaḥ--tailapākena tulyo ghṛtapāka ityādi? naiṣo'styavakāśaḥ; ghātvartho hi kriyā, sā ca pūrvāparībhūtā| atha vā--asattvabhūtā| na ca tasyāṃ ghañādayo bhavanti, kva tarhi? tasyaiva dhātvarthasya dharme siddhatāyāmeva| ghātvarthasyāpi ghañādisthāyā bhidyate| tatkathaṃ ghañādīnāmarthaḥ kriyeti śakyate vaktum‌? na ca tayā ghañādivācyasiddhatayā dravyagatāyāstulyatā| na hi dravyabhūtenāsattvabhūtasya vastutulyatopapadyata ityato nāsti vacanasyāvakāśaḥ| yadi tarhi kriyā ghañādibhirnābhidhīyate--kartuṃ gamanam‌, bhoktuṃ pākaḥ, karakasya vrajatīti `tumuṇṇavulau kriyāyaṃ kriyārthāyām‌' (3.3.10) iti tumuṇṇvulau na prāpnutaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadatra prakṛtirūpaṃ tasya kriyaivārtha iti tadāśrayau tumuṇṇvulau bhaviṣyata ityalamatiprasaṅgena|| 116. tatra tasyaiva| (5.1.116) atha kiyarthamivetyucyate, na vatyarthe sādṛśye bhaviṣyati? bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; na hi tulyagrahaṇaṃ śakyamihānuvarttayitum‌| taddhi kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt‌ karma, tatra yadīha tasyānuvṛttiḥ syāt‌ tathābhūtasyaiva syāt‌| tataśca karmaṇyeva tulye pratyayaḥ syāt, tathā ca--mathurāyāmiva mathurāvat‌ sludhne prāsāda ityādi na sidhyet‌| tasmādiveti vaktavyam‌| akriyārthaścāyamārambhaḥ|| 117. tadarham‌| (5.1.117) arahatītyarthaḥ| kriyāgrahaṇamihānuvarttate, tato'syāmevarhaṇakriyāyāṃ kartṛbhūtāyāṃ pratyayo vidhīyata iti| yatrāsau pratyayārthatvena vivakṣyate, tatra vākyameva bhavati--brāhmaṇamarhatīti|| 118. upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe| (5.1.118) upasargāḥ prādayaḥ, te caivamātmakāḥ| yatra kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prayujyate, tatra kriyāyā viśeṣakā bhavanti--āgacchati, pragacchatīti| yatra na prayujyate, tatra samādhanakriyāvācakāḥ--saṅkaṭaḥ, utkaṭa iti| kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prādīnāṃ vatyantānāṃ prayoge na prayujyate| tena sādhano dhātvartheḥ svārthaḥ| tena sādhane dhātvarthe varttamānādupasargāt‌ pratyayo vijñāyati ityāha--`samādhane dhātvarthe' iti| yadi hyevamātmakā upasargāḥ, dhātvarthagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌? satyametat‌; tat‌ kriyate vispaṣṭārtham‌| `udvataḥ, nivataḥ' iti| ucchabdāt‌ niśbadāt samādhane dhātvarthe vatiḥ| nanu ca vateravyayasaṃjñakatvādvibhakterluk‌ prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati? avyayasaṃjñāyā anityatvāt‌| anityatvaṃ tu tasyāḥ `satyametat‌; tat‌ kriyate vispaṣṭārtham‌| `udvataḥ, nivataḥ' iti| ucchabdāt‌ niśabdāt‌ samādhane dhātvarthe vatiḥ| nanu ca vateravayayasaṃjñakatavādvibhakterluk‌ prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati? avyayasaṃjñāyā anityatvāt‌| anityatvaṃ tu tasyāḥ `sarvamidaṃ kāṇḍaṃ svarādāvapiṃ paṭhyate' ityādinā'vyayasaṃjñāprakaraṇa eva pratipāditam|| 119. tasya bhāvastvatalau| (5.1.119) bhavateranekārthatvādbhavāśabdo'yamabhiprāyādiṣvanekeṣu varttate| tatra na jñāyate-ko'trārto bhāvaśabdena vivakṣitaḥ? ityatastatparijñānārthamāha--`bhavato'smāt‌' iti| yasmādgotrāderviśeṣaṇatvādviśeṣye gavādau gaurityevamādikaḥ śabdo bhavati, gotvākāravatī ca buddhistena yo'rtho gavādeḥ śabdasya pravṛttanimittaṃ sa bhāvaśabdenocyate| tathā coktam‌--`yasya gaṇasya bhāvāddravye śabdaniveśastadabhidhāne tvatalau' iti| guṇa iti viśeṣaṇamihocyate, dravyaṃ viśeṣyam‌| yasya viśeṣaṇasya bhāvādvidyamānatvādviśeṣye śabdasya niveśaḥ pravṛttirbhavati, tadabhidhāne tvatalādayaḥ pratyāyaḥ bhavanti| tat‌ panaḥ śabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittamanekaprakāram‌; jātiśabdānāṃ jātiḥ--aśvatvamiti, guṇaśabdānāṃ guṇaḥ--śuklatvamiti, kriyāśabdānāṃ kriyā-pācakatvamiti| kecittu kriyākārakasambandhaṃ kriyāśabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittamicchanti| yadṛcchāśabdānāṃ saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhitvamiti saṃkṣepeṇaitaduktam‌| vistareṇa tu bhāṣyādāvuktamiti tata evānugantavyam‌| atha nānātvamityādau kathaṃ pratyayo bhavati? kathaṅkāraṃ na bhavitavyam‌? ṣaṣṭhīsamarthāt pratyayavidhānāt‌, nānetyevamādīnāñcāvyayānāṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthenāyogāt‌, ayogāstu teṣāmasattvavācitvāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sasattvabhūto'pyarthaḥ śabdāntareṇa pratyavamṛṣṭaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarethena prayujyate--nānetyasya bhāva iti| tañca pratyavamṛṣṭārthaṃ vṛttireva gamayatīti nānupapannā ṣaṣṭīsamarthatā|| 120. ā ca tvāt‌| (5.1.120) `prathimā' iti| `turiṣṭemeyassu' (6.4.154) iti, `ṭeḥ' (6.4.155) iti ṭilopaḥ| `ra ṛtohalāderlaghoḥ' (6.4.161) iti ṛkārasya rephaḥ, `sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ| `pārthavam‌' iti| `igantācca laghupūrvāt‌' (5.1.131) ityaṇ‌| `apavādaiḥ' ityādi| imanicprabhṛtīnapavādastvitalorvakṣyati, taiḥ saha tayoḥ samāveśaḥ| ekaviṣayatā yathā syādityevamarthamidam‌| nanu ca svaritatvādanuvarttamānāvanuvṛttisāmarthyādevāpavādaviṣaye'pi bhaviṣyataḥ? naitadasti; asti hyanuvṛtteḥ prayojanam‌, kiṃm‌? `guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ca' (5.1.124) iti karmaṇyapi yathā syātām‌; itarathā hi bhāve vidhīyamānau karmaṇi na syātām‌| `karmaṇi ca' ityādi| nanu cānuvṛttisāmarthyādeva karmaṇyapi bhaviṣyataḥ? naitadasti; asti hyanyadanuvṛtteḥ prayojanam‌, kim‌? apavādaviṣaye'pi yathā syātām‌| tasmiṃsatvasati na syātām‌, asmiṃstu satyetadubhayamapi labhyate| `cakāraḥ' ityādi| yadi cakāro na kriyeta tato'traiva prakaraṇe ye'pavādāstaireva samāveśaḥ syāt‌, na nañsnañbhyām‌; tayoranyatara vihitatvāt‌| cakāre tvapavādasamuccayārthe sati sarvāpavādaviṣaye tvatalau labhyete| tena strīpuṃsābhyāmapi siddhau bhavataḥ| yadyevam‌, anyeṣvartheṣu sāvakāśau nañsnañau bhāve na sidhyataḥ, tvallabhyāṃ bādhyamānatvāt‌? naiṣaḥ doṣaḥ; `bhavanāt‌' ityavadhyupādānasāmarthyādbhāve'pi bhaviṣyataḥ; itarathā hi bhāvameva vidhitvenopādadīta|| 121. na nañpūrvāttatpuruṣādacaturasaṅgatalavaṇavaṭabudhakatarasalasebhyaḥ| (5.1.121) adhikāro'yam‌| tenottareṣāṃ bhāvapratyayānāṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate; na tvataloriti matvā''-`ita uttare ye bhāvapratyayāḥ' ityādi| na tu `pṛthvādibhya imanijvā' (5.1.122) ityevamādiṃbhiryogaiḥ parigaṇitābhya eva prakṛtibhyaḥ pratyayo vidhīyate| na ca tatra kācit‌ prakṛtirnañpūrvā gṛhyate, na ca tadantavidhirasti; grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt‌| tasmāt tatra nañpūrvāt‌ prāptirnāstīti nāstyasyopayogaḥ? satyam‌; yatra tvantagrahaṇ‌--`patyantapurohitādibhyo yak‌' (5.1.128) ityevamādiṣu yogeṣvasti, yatra ca svarūpagrahaṇaṃ nāsti `yopadhādgurūpottamādvuñ‌' (5.1.132) ityevamādiṣu, tatra nañpūrvādapi prāptirastīti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| `apatitvam‌' iti| nañsamāse kṛta uttarakālaṃ patyantādabhāvavivakṣāyāṃ `patyanta' (5.1.128) ityādinā yagna bhavati| `apaṭutvam‌' iti| `iganta' (5.1.131) ityaṇ‌ na bhavati| `aramaṇīyatvam‌' iti| `yopadāt‌' (5.1.132) ityādinā vuñ‌ na bhavati| nāsya paṭavaḥ santītyapaṭuriti bahuvrīhirayam‌, tenāsmādigantalakṣaṇo'ṇ‌ bhavati--`āpaṭavam' iti| `ācaturyam‌' iti| brāhmaṇāditvāt‌ ṣyañ‌| nanu ca nañsamāsā brāhmaṇādiṣu na ṣaṭhyante, tatkutastena ṣyañ‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ā kṛtigaṇo hi brāhmaṇādiriṣyate| acaturādipratiṣedha evākṛtigrahaṇasya jñāpakam|| 122. pṛthvādibhya imanijvā| (5.1.122) pṛthvādiṣu ya igantā laghupūrvāḥ pṛthumṛduprabhṛtayaḥ, teṣāmaṇi prāpte; ye guṇaśabdāḥ khaṇḍa caṇḍa--ityevamādayaḥ, teṣāṃ ṣyañi; ye vayovacanāḥ--bāla vatsa--ityevamādayaḥ, teṣāṃ `prāṇabhṛjjāti' (5.1.129) ityādināñi sarveṣāmapavāda imanijvidhīyate| `vāvacanam‌' ityādi| ādiśabdenaṣyañādīnāmupasaṃgrahaḥ| vākyārthaṃ tu vāvacanaṃ na bhavati; mahāvibhāṣayaiva vākyasya siddhatvāt|| 123. varṇadṛḍhādibhyaḥ ṣyañca| (5.1.123) bahuvacanaṃ prateyakamabhisambadhyate--varṇebhyo dṛḍhādibhyaśceti; tena bahuvacananirdeśādvarṇaśabdena varṇavācināṃ grahaṇamiti vijñāyate, na svarūpagrahaṇe tu varṇaśabdamapi dṛḍhādiṣu evādhīyīta| varṇaśabdaśca guṇaviśeṣasya vācakaḥ; na brāhmaṇādīnām‌| kutaḥ? dṛḍhādibhirguṇavacanaiḥ sāhacaryāt‌| ata evāha-dṛḍhādibhiḥ sāhacaryādrūpaviśeṣā eva śuklādayaḥ pratyayamutpādayanti, na tu svarūpaśabdāḥ, nāpi tatparyāyāḥ| katham‌? dṛḍhādayo hi guṇā upasarjanaṃ dravye varttante| tatsāhacaryādvarṇaśabdā api tatsadṛsā eva gṛhyante| na varṇaśbadasya tatparyāyāṇāṃ vā tādṛśī vṛttirasti; guṇamātravacanatvāt‌| varṇadṛḍhādīnāṃ guṇavacanatvādeva siddhe punarvacanamimanijartham‌| yadyevam, ṣyañgrahaṇanarthakam‌, imanijeva vidheyaḥ, sa ca vibhāṣayaiva prakṛtaḥ? taducyate; avasyaṃ ṣyañgrahaṇamuttarārtha karttavyam| tatra vā kriyata iha veti nāsti viśeṣaḥ| `śuklimā' iti| pūrvavaṭṭilopaḥ| `draḍhimā' iti| pūrvadṛkārasya rabhāvaḥ| `aucito, yathākāmī' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ‌| `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) iti yalopaḥ| `veyatilābhamatimanaḥśāradānām‌' iti paṭhyate| tasyāyamarthaḥ--viśabdāduttareṣāṃ yātādīnāṃ pratyayābhavantīti| viyātatvam, viyātatā, viyātimā, vaiyātyam‌| vilābhatā, vilābhatvam‌, vailābhyam‌, vilābhimā| vimatitvam‌, vimatitā, vaimatyam, vimatimā, `igantāt‌' (5.1.131) ityaṇ‌, vaimatam‌| vimanasatvam‌, vimanastā, vimanimā, vaimanasyām‌| viśāradatvam‌, viśāradatā, vaiśāradyam‌, viśāradimā| `samo matimanasoḥ' iti| sama uttarayormatimanasoḥ pratyayo bhavati| saṃmatitā, saṃmatitvam‌, saṃmatimā, sāṃmatyam‌| saṃmanastvam‌| saṃmanastā, saṃmanimā, sāṃmanasyam‌|| 124. guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ca| (5.1.124) `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) iti śaiṣikeṣu prāpteṣu karmaṇi ṣyañvidhānam‌, cakāradbhāve ca| `karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvacanaḥ' ita| sādhanakarmavacanaśaṅkāmapākaroti| ye hi jaḍādiśabdāḥ guṇaśabdāḥ, gumavacanāḥ, brāhmaṇādayaśca teṣāṃ sādhanakarmaṇā sambando na sambhavati; kriyāvācakatvābhāvāt‌| tasmāt‌ kriyāśabda eva karmaśabdaḥ| `brāhmaṇādirākṛtigaṇaḥ' iti| avṛtkṛtatvāt‌| `ādiśabdaḥ prakāre' [`prakāravacanaḥ'--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| evaṃ prakārebhyaḥ ṣyañ‌ bhavatītyevamarthamādiśabdaḥ prakaravacanatvaṃ bodhayati| yadyevam‌, guṇavacanagrahaṇaṃ prātipadikeṣu ca brāhmaṇādīnāmanukramaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌? nānarthakam‌; prapañcārtha hi tat‌ svārthe vidhānārthañca| tatra brāhmaṇaśabdāt‌ `prāṇabhṛjjāti' (5.1.129) iti jātivacanatvādañi prāpte tadbādhanārthaṃ ṣyañvidhīyate| māṇavavāḍavābhyāṃ gotralakṣaṇe vuñi| `arhato num‌ ca' iti| asya numarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ--arhantyam‌| coradhūrttābhyāṃ manojñāditvād‌vuñi prāpte| ārādhaya, virādhaya, aparādhaya--ityetebhyo'patyavivakṣāyāṃ `janapadaśabdāt‌ kṣatriyādañ‌' (4.1.168), tasya `kambojālluk‌' (4.1.175) iti luk‌| tato gotravuñi prāpte pāṭhaḥ| ekabhavādīnāmanyabhāvaparyantānāṃ svārthe vidhānārtham| akṣetrajñaśabdasya ` nañpūrvāt‌' (5.1.121) iti pratiṣedhe prāpte| prāgbāliśaśabdāt‌ kuśalādīnāṃ yudāditvādaṇi prāpte| bāliśaśabdo vayovacanaḥ, tasmādvayolakṣaṇe'ñi prāpte| anīśvaraśabdasya `na nañpūrvāt‌' (5.1.121) iti pratiṣedhe prāpte| `alasa' iti bahuvrīhiḥ ṣyañamutpādayati, tatpuruṣāttu, `na nañpūrvāt‌' (5.1.121) iti pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌; tasya prapañcārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| rājan‌śabdasya purohitaditvādyaki prāpte| `saṃvādin‌' `saṃveśin‌', `bahubhāṣin‌, `śīrṣadhātin‌', `sayastha', `paramastha', `duṣpuruṣa'--ityevamādīnāṃ nañpūrvārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| `gaṇapati', `adhipati'--ityetayoḥ patyantalakṣaṇe yaki prāpte| `gaḍula', `dāyāda', `viśasti'--ityeteṣāṃ tvatalornivṛttyarthaḥ| śeṣāṇāṃ prapañcārthaḥ| guṇavacanā eke rāśiḥ, brāhmaṇādayo dvitīyaḥ, tābhyāṃ bhāve karmaṇi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti, tat‌ kasmānna bhavati? brahmaṇādiśabdasyālpāctarasya paranipātāt‌| sa hi lakṣaṇe nirapekṣatāṃ nirdeśasya jñāpayan‌ yathāsaṃkyalakṣaṇānapekṣatāmapi bodhayati, tena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati|| 125. stenādyannalopaśca| (5.1.125) 126. sakhyuryaḥ| (5.1.126) `dūtavaṇigbhyāñca' ityādi| dūtavaṇigbhyāṃ yo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌-pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ--`dūtavaṇigbhyāñca' ityādi| dūtavaṇigbhyāmapi bhavati|| 127. kapijñātyorḍhak‌| (5.1.127) kapiśabdāt‌ `igantācca laghupūrvāt‌' (5.1.131) ityaṇi prāpta idaṃ vidhīyate| `yathāsaṃkhyam‌' ityādi| tatra `guṇavacanabrahmaṇādibhyaḥ' (5.1.124) ityatra yatāsaṃkhyābhāvaḥ pratipāditaḥ| ihāpi pratipādyate| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--atra cakāro'nuvarttate, sa caikasyāḥ prakṛterbhāve karmaṇi ca ḍhagviṃdhiṃ samuccinoti| tena yathāṃsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati; anyathā hi samucyayo nopapadyate| asvaritatvādvā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhaviṣyati, pratipāditaṃ hi pūrvam‌--`svaritatvena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati' iti| na ceha yathāsaṃkhyārthaṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate|| 128. patyantapuruhitādibhyo yak‌| (5.1.128) patyantāt‌ pūrvavadaṇi prāpte, purohitādiṣu rājaśabdarādbrāhmaṇādipāṭhāt‌ ṣyañi, śeṣebyastvataloryagvidhīyate| `rājāse' iti| rājaśabdādase-asamāse yagbhavati--rājyamiti| samāse tu brāhmaṇāditvāt‌ ṣyañeva bhavati--ādhirājyamiti| nanu ca kevalo rājaśabdo brāhmaṇādiṣu paṭhyate, tetkathamadhirājaśabdāt‌? tadantavidhinā; etadeva jñāpakamasa iti vacane--astauhi prakaraṇe rājaśabdena tadantavidhiriti| iha patyantapurohitādī iti dvau rāśī, arthāvapi bhāvakarmaṇī dvāveveti sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti; tadasvaritatvāt‌ pūrvavanna bhavati|| 129. prāṇabhṛjjātivayovacaṭanodragātrādibhyo'ñ‌| (5.1.129) prāṇabṛtaḥ prāṇina ucyante, teṣāṃ jātiḥ prāṇabhṛjjātirityarthaḥ| tadvācino yatāsambhavaṃ tvatalādiṣvañvidhīyate| prāṇabhṛdgrahaṇāt‌ tṛṇādiśabdebhyo na bhavati-tṛṇatvam, tuṇateti| jātigrahaṇāddevadattādiśabdebhyo na bhavati--devadattatvam‌, devadattatā| yadigantaṃ laghupūrvaṃ ca tasmāt‌ paratvādaṇbhavati| `taittiram‌' iti| vayovacanādapi yathāyogaṃ tvatalādiṣveva prāpteṣvañvidhānam‌| vacanagrahaṇaṃ svarūpavidhinirāsārtham‌; anyathā vayaḥśabdādeva syāt‌| tatrodgātrādiṣu `udgāt‌, unnatṛ, adhvayuityeteṣāmṛtvigvacanāt‌ `hotrābhyaśchaḥ' (5.1.135) iti cche prāpte satyañarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| suṣṭhu, duṣṭhu, vadhū--ityeteṣāṃ laghupūrvalakṣaṇe'pi prāpte| `subhagamantre' iti| subhagaśabdo mantraviṣaye'ñamutpādayati--mahate saubhāgāya| `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' (pu.pa.vṛ. 56) iti| `hṛdbhagasindhvanta' (7.3.19) ityuttarapadavṛddhirna bhavati| mantra iti kim‌? saubhāgyam‌, brāhmaṇāditvāt‌| śeṣaṇāmiha pāṭhastvataloḥ prāptayoḥ|| 130. hāyanāntayuvādibhyo'ṇ‌| (5.1.130) hāyanāntāt‌ tvataloḥ prāptayoraṇvidhānam‌| nanu ca `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityanena hāyanāntādaṇa siddhaḥ? na sidhyati; paratvāt‌ tvatalbhyāṃ bādhyate--āṣāḍhahāyaṇasya bhāvaḥ karma vā āṣāḍhahāyaṇa iti `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) prasajyeta| tasmādyuktaṃ hāyanāntādaṇvidhānam‌| `yauvanam‌' iti| `an‌' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| yuvādiṣu yuvaśabdasya vayolakṣaṇaṃ badhitvā manojñāditvād‌vuñi prāpte pāṭhaḥ| sthaviraśabdasya vayolakṣaṇe'ñi hotṛśabdasyāpyudgātrāditvādañeva| `puruṣāse' iti| puruṣaśabdādasamāse'ṇ‌| bhavati--pauruṣam‌| asa iti kim‌? rājapuruṣatvam‌| asya `prāṇabhṛjjāti' (5.1.129) ityaprāpte pāṭhaḥ| kamaṇaaḍaluśabdasyegantatvādevāṇi siddhe tvatalorbādhanārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| `hṛdayāse' iti| hṛdayaśabdādasamāse'ṇ‌ bhavati| hārddam‌, `hṛdayasya hṛllekhayadaṇlāseṣu' (6.3.50) iti hṛdbhāvaḥ| asa iti kim‌? hṛdayaśabdādasamāse'ṇ‌ bhavati| hārddam‌,`hṛdayasya hṛllekhayadaṇlāseṣu' (6.3.50) iti hṛdbhāvaḥ| asa iti kim‌? paramahṛdayatvam‌| kuśalādīnāṃ kṣetrajñaparyantānāṃ brāhmaṇāditvāt‌ ṣyañi prāpte pāṭhaḥ, śeṣāṇāṃ tu tvataloḥ| nanu ca grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidherabhāvāt‌ samāsādaṇprāptireva nāsti, tadaparthakaḥ `puruṣāse', `hṛdayāse' iti ca pratiṣedhaḥ? nāpārthakaḥ, eṣā hi viṣayasaptamī--samāse cikīrṣite viṣayabhūta eva puruṣaśabdahṛdayaśabdāviti| yadi pratiṣedho nocyeta, tato nañsamāsasya bhāvapratyayasya cāṇo yugapatprasaṅge paratvādaṇeva syāt‌| pratiṣedhāttu samāsa eva tāvadbhavati| tato yasya bhāvapratyayasya nimittamasti sa utpadyate| kaścāsau? tvatalau--apuruṣatvam‌, apuruṣatā; ahṛdayatvam‌, ahṛdayatā| iha hāyanānta ekaraśiḥ, yuvādirdvitīyaḥ; arthāvapi dvāveva--bhāvakarmaṇī, tena sāmarthyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti; tadalpāctarasya yuvādiśabdasya paranipātalakṣavyabhicāracihnānna bhavati| asvaritatvādvā|| 131. igantācca laghupūrvāt‌| (5.1.131) `igantāt‌' iti| ik‌ anto yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| prātipadikamanyapadārthaḥ| `laghupūrvagrahaṇe' ityādi| athegeva kasmānna viśeṣyate? tasya bahuvrīhyarthe guṇabhūtatvādviseṣaṇena sambandhasya karttumaśakyatvāt| pūrvaśabdo'yaṃ vyavasthāśabdatvādaparamapekṣate| iha cāparasyānirdiṣṭatvānna jñāyate--kuto laghuḥ pūrvaḥ? tatparijñānāya pṛcchati--`kutaḥ punarasau laghuḥ pūrvaḥ' iti| pratyāsattinyāyamāśrityāha--`sannidhānāt‌' ityādi| sannidhānaṃ tviha sūtre ikaḥ; śrutatvāt‌| `tena' iti| antabhūtena laghupūrveṇekāntagrahaṇamitiricyata iti; niṣphalatvāt‌| yato hi `laghupūrvāt‌' ityukte ca prātipadikasya tadantavidho sati sāmarthyādeva tasyāntatvaṃ labhyata ityapārthakamantagrahaṇamasmin‌ vyākhyāne| pūrvake tu vidhāne, antagrahaṇe'sati `laghupūrvegvataḥ' ityeva vidhinirdeśo vijñāyate, tataścānantasyāpīko vidhitvaṃ syāt‌| tadā laśunalakuṭaprabhṛtibhyo'pi pratyayaprasaṅga ityevamarthamantagrahaṇam‌| `kathaṃ kāvyam‌' iti| anyathā bhavitavyam‌; kaviśabdasya laghupūrvogantatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|| 132. yopadhāṭgurūpottamād‌vuñ‌| (5.1.132) tvatalādiṣu prāpteṣu vuñvidhīyate| uttamaśabdo'yamihāvyutpannaṃ prātipadikaṃ gṛhyate; tatsvabhāvāt‌ triprabhṛtīnāmantyamāheti matvā''ha--`triprabhṛtīnāmantyam‌' ityādi| tamapratyayāntasya tu grahaṇe sati `aṇioranārṣayoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādau sutāre yo doṣa uktaḥ, sa ihāpi tadanusāreṇa veditavyaḥ| uttamasya samīpamupottamam‌, `avyayaṃ vibhaktisamīpa' (2.1.6) ityavyayībhāvaḥ|| 133. dvandvamanojñādibhyaśca| (5.1.133) dvandvāt‌ tvatalādiṣu prāpteṣu vuñvidhīyate| manojñādiṣu yo guṇavacanastasmāt‌ ṣyañi, cauradhūrttaśabdābhyāmapi brāhmaṇāditvāt‌ ṣyañyeva; yuvaśabdādyavāditvādaṇi, śeṣebhyastvataloḥ| `amuṣyaputraḥ' iti| nipātanādvibhakteraluk‌| iha dvandvamanojñādī dvau rāśī, pratyayārthāvapi bhāvakarmaṇī dvāveva--iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prpnoti, tatpūrvavadasvaritatvānna bhavati| atha vā--cakāro'tra samuccayārthaḥ kriyate| tasya cānyatsamuccetavyaṃ nāstīti vuñvidhimeva pratyekaṃ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ samuccinoti| tenaikasmādrāśerbhāve karmaṇi ca vuñ‌ bhavati, na tu yathāsaṃkhyam‌; anyathā hi samuccayo nopapadyate|| 134. gotracaraṇācchalāghātyākāratadaveteṣu| (5.1.134) apatyanimittā samākhyā gotrakhyā, sā ca pravarādhyāye paṭhyate| yā ca vedādhyayanaprayuktān‌ puruṣānācaṣṭe sā caraṇaśabdasyākhyā| `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha' (ma.bhā., 2.225) iti pāribhāṣikaṃ gotracaraṇayorjātitvamiti `prāṇabhṛjjāti' (5.1.129) ityādinā'ñi prāpte vuño vidhānam‌| iha gotracaraṇavācinī dve prātipadike, arthāvapi dvāveva--tatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti, tat‌ pūrvapadasvaritatvānna bhavati| ata evāha--`pratyekaṃ bhāvakarmaṇorarthayoḥ' iti| `ślāghādiṣu viṣayabhūteṣu' iti| tathā hi na bhāvaḥ ślāghādīnāmanyatamo'pi bhavitumarhati| śabdapravṛttinimittaṃ bhāvaḥ| na ca gotracaraṇaśabdānāṃ ślāghādayaḥ pravṛttinimittaṃ bhavati| karmāpi naiva ślāghādisvabhāvaṃ bhavati| na hi gotracaraṇānāṃ ślāghādayaḥ karmatayā rūḍhāḥ, yathā--agnestāpādayaḥ; kriyārūpatvātteṣām‌| sādhyatayā bhāvakarmaṇoḥ pratyayārthatayā viṣayabhūteṣu vuñ‌ bhavati| `tadavetastatprāptaḥ' iti| iṇo'tra gatyarthatvāt‌| `tajjñāto vā' iti| avapūrvasyeṇo jñāne'pi vṛttisambhavāt‌| tacchabdena ceha gotracaraṇayoḥ sambandhinī bhāvakarmaṇaī pratinirdiśyete| `gārgikayā' iti| `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) iti yalopaḥ|| 135. hotrābhyāśchaḥ| (5.1.135) tvataloḥ prāptayoścho vidhīyate|| 136. brahmaṇastvaḥ| (5.1.136) `neti vaktaye' iti| chapratyaye'pyapavāde pratiṣiddhe tvapratyayaḥ| `tasya bhāvastvatarlau (5.1.119) ityeva sidhyati| tasmānnetyeva vaktavye yadetadvacanaṃ tattvena talo bādhanaṃ yathā syādityevamartham| yadi netyucyate; tadā cche pratiṣiddhe yathā tvo bhavati tathā talapi syāt‌| tvavacane tu talo bādhā siddhā bhavati|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ pañcamādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ|| <5.2> atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. dhānyanāṃ bhavane kṣetre khañ‌| (5.2.1) `bhavanti jāyante'sminniti bhavanam‌' iti| adhikaraṇe lyuṭ‌| jāyanta utpadyanta ityarthaḥ| etenotpattivacano bhavatiratra gṛhyate, na sattāvacanaḥ tasya hi grahaṇe satyanyatra cotpannānāṃ yatra sthāpanaṃ paścādyatra sthāpyante tatrāpi prasajyeta| yadi taddhyutpattivacano bhavatirgṛhyate, kṣetragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tatra mudgānāṃ bhavanaṃ kusūla ityatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate| na cotpattivacanasya bhavatergrahaṇe sati kusūle prasaṅgaḥ, na hyasau mudgādīnāmutpatteradhikaraṇam‌, kiṃ tarhi? sattāyāḥ; naitadasti; sati hi kṣetragrahaṇe bhavatiratrotpattivacano bhavati| katham? kṣetraśabdo hyayaṃdhānyānāmutpattyādhāramācaṣṭe| tena tasya grahame sati sattāṃ prati na bhūmiḥ kṣetravyapadeśamāsādayatīti yuktaṃ tadutpattau bhavatirvarttata iti| kṣetragrahaṇe tvasati, bhavatiḥ sattāvacano'pi gṛhyate| tathā kusūle'pi prasajyeta| api ca--bhavanaśabdo rūḍhyā gṛhavacano'payasti, so'pi kṣetraśabdena nivartyata iti| atha kathaṃ ṣaṣaṭhī samarthavibhaktirupādīyate, yāvatā `tasya bhāvastvatalau' (5.1.119) ityataḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamarthavibhaktiranuvarttata iti tataiva siddham‌| evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--pūrve pratyayā nāvaśyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamarthādbhavantīti| tena `hotrābhyāśchaḥ' (5.1.135) iti| hotrāyāḥ prathamāsamarthayāḥ svārthe cchaḥ siddho bhavati--hotraiva hotrīyamiti| evañca caturvarṇādibhyaḥ prathamāsamarthebhyaḥ svārtheṣyañ‌ siddho bhavati|| 2. vrīhiśālyorḍhak‌| (5.2.2) 3. yavayavakaṣaṣṭikādyat‌| (5.2.3) 4. vibhāṣā tilamāṣomābhaṅgāṇubhyaḥ| (5.2.4) `khañi prāpte vacanam‌, pakṣe so'pi bhavati' iti| yuktaṃ yat‌ pakṣe tilamāṣāṇubhyaḥ khañ‌ bhavatīti; teṣāṃ dhānyatvāt‌| umābhaṅgayostvadhānyatvāt‌ khañ‌ pākṣiko na yuktaḥ| yadeva hi `tilāśca me yavāśca me' ityādiṣu vedavākyeṣu paṭhyate tadeva dhānyam‌| yāvādaya evu mantre paṭhyante, nomābhaṅge| yadi tayorapi dhānyatvaṃ syāt‌ te api paṭhyayātām‌, tato'vagamyate na tayordānyatvām, evañca na khañastābhyāṃ prāptirasti, yataḥ so'pi pakṣe syādityevāha--`umābhaṅgayoḥ' ityādi| śaṇasaptadaśamudgāni dhānyānīti smṛtiḥ| tatra śaṇādiṣu madhya umābhaṅge api dhānyatvena saṃkhyāyete iti tayordhānyatvamāśritameva| yastu punarvede tayorapāṭhaḥ; sa vaidikakarmaṇyanupayogāt‌| ato na tatrāpāṭhādadhānyatvamityabhiprāyaḥ|| 5. sarvacarmaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ khakhañau| (5.2.5) iha kṛtaḥ pratyayārthaḥ| tatra carmaṇaḥ karaṇatvaṃ syāt‌, kartṛtvaṃ vā| tatra yadi karaṇatvaṃ tadā niyataṃ karaṇalakṣaṇayā tṛtīyayā bhavitavyam‌| atha karttṛtvameva `na loka' (2.3.69) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ karttṛlakṣaṇā tṛtīyaiva| tasmāt‌ pratyayārthasāmarthyālabhyā tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktiriti matvā''ha--`tṛtīyāsamarthāt‌' iti| sa ca sarvacarmaṇa iti nirdeśaḥ sarvaśabdasya carmaśabdena samāsaṃ kṛtvā kṛtaḥ| tataḥ `carmaṇaivāsya sambandho na hayanyatā samāsa upapadyate' iti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha--`sarvaśabdaścātra' ityādi| yadyevam‌, asāmarthyāt‌ samāso na prāpnoti? ityata āha--`tatrāyam‌' ityādi| asmādeva nipātanādityabhiprāyaḥ| atha carmaṇaivabhisambandhaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? ityāha--`sarvaścarmaṇā kṛtaḥ' iti| atra hi vākyārthe taddhitavṛttiriṣyati| tathā hyayameva vākyārthastaddhitānugataḥ pratīyate| asmiṃścārthe vākyārtha evaṃ taddhitavṛttirlabhyate, yadi sarvaśabdaḥ kṛtena sambadhyate na carmaṇā| yadi sarvaśabdaścarmaṇā sambadhyate, sarvacarmaṇā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso vā syāt‌, karmadhārayo vā; tatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāse taddhitāntāt‌ sarvasambandhinā carmaṇā kṛta ityeṣo'rthaḥ pratīyate| karmadhāraye tu sarvacarmaṇā kṛta ityeṣo'rthaḥ| na cāyaṃ dviṣprakāro yastaddhitāntādavasīyate, api tu sarvacarmaṇā kṛta ityayameva| tasmādaśakyaḥ sarvaśabdasya carmaṇā sambandho vijñātumiti kṛtenaiva sambandho yuktaḥ|| 6. yathāmukhasammukhasya darśanaḥ khaḥ| (5.2.6) `dṛśyate'sminniti darśanaḥ' iti| adhikaraṇe lyuṭ‌| `yathāmukham‌' iti| `yathā'sādṛśye' (2.1.7) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| mukhasya sadṛśaṃ yathāmukham‌| kiṃ punastat‌? ādarśāśrayaṃ pratibimbam‌| nanu ca `asādṛśye' iti pratiṣedhānnātra samāsena bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`nipātanāt‌' ityādi| samāsaścāyaṃ pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ| pūrvapadaṃ cāsattvavacanamiti prathamāsamarthādeva pratyaya upapadyate| atha vā--`nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ' (2.4.83) iti jñāpakādavyayībhāvād‌dvitīyādayo bhavantītyato dvitīyāsāmarthyāt‌ pratya upapadyate| `yathāmukhaṃ yatāmukhīnaḥ' iti| mukhasadṛsya darśanaḥ' iti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| yatrā''darśādau sarva mukhaṃ dṛśyate sa evamucyate|| 7. tatsarvādeḥ pathyaṅgakarmapattrapātraṃ vyāpnoti| (5.2.7) atha sūtra dvitīyāntaprakṛtyuccāraṇaṃ kimartham‌? taditi dvitīyāsāmarthyāt‌ pratyayo yathā syāt‌| atha vā--pathyaṅgakarmapattrapātramiti naiveyaṃ dvitīyā, na hi vyāpnotikriyayā pathyādayaḥ sambadhyante, kiṃ tarhi? sarvādi| tasmāt‌ tasyaiva karmatvam‌, na pathyādīnāṃ tadavayavānām‌| tat‌ kutaḥ? na sā dvitīyā, subvyatyayena pañcamyāḥ sthāne prathamā tveṣā| tasmāt‌ samāhāradvandvasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvāt‌ `ato'm‌' (2.4.83) ityabhbhāvaḥ kṛtaḥ| `pariśiṣṭam‌' iti| `sarvādeḥ pathyaṅgakarmapattrapātram‌' ityetacca| sarvādeḥ prātipadikasya pathyādayaścādau na bhavanti| tataḥ sāmarthyāt‌ tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha--`pathyaṅgakarmapattrapātrāntāt‌' iti| `sarvapathīnaḥ' iti| sarvaścāsau panthāśceti `pūrvakāla' (2.1.49) ityādinā samāsaḥ, `ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityakāraḥ samāsāntastadataḥ| nanu ca samāsānte kṛte pathyantameva na bhavati? yadatra pathyantaṃ tadāśrayo vidharirbhavatītyadoṣaḥ| nanu ca vyavadhānānna prāpnoti? antagrahaṇāt‌ samāsāntāḥ samāsagrahaṇena gṛhyanta iti nāsti vyavadhānam‌|| 8. āprapadaṃ prapnoti| (5.2.8) `tayoravyayībhāvaḥ' iti| `āṅmaryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.1.13) ityanana| `śarīreṇāsambaddhasyāpi paṭasya pramāṇamākhyātam‌' iti| prāptiyogyatāmupādāya hi yogyo'sāvāprapadāccharīraṃ prāptum‌| atha vyāptiprāptyoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ, yena vyāpnotīti kṛte prāpnotītyuktam‌? sambandhamātraṃ prāptiḥ, sambandha eva sākalyena vyāptirityeva viśeṣaḥ|| 9. anupadasarvānnāyānayaṃ baddhābhakṣayatineyeṣu| (5.2.9) `anurāyāme' ittayādi| yadāyāme tadā `yasya cāyāmaḥ' (2.1.16) iti samāsa-| yadā sādṛśye tadā `yatārte yadavyayam‌' tena `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā | yatā padamāyataṃ tathā ca `baddhopānadanupadīnā'| sādṛśye yathānupadaṃ tatā baddhā'nupadīnā| `padapramāṇetyarthaḥ' iti| yadāpyanu sādṛśye, tadāpyayamartha veditavyaḥ, tulyapramāṇatayaiva sādṛśyam‌| `ayaḥ pradakṣiṇam‌' iti| ayanamayaḥ, gamanamityarthaḥ| pradakṣiṇaṃ gamanamaya ityucyeta| `anayaḥ prasavyam‌' iti| ayaviparītaṃ prasavyamanaya ityucyate| evamavayavārthaṃ darśayitvā samudāyārthaṃ darśayitumāha--`pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāminām‌' ityādi| bahuvacanamayānayanimittapradarśanārtham‌| yadi śārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ prasavyaṃ ca gacchantyevamayānayau bhaktaḥ, nānyathā| tatrātmoyāḥ śārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ gacchanti, parakīyāḥ prasavyam‌| teṣāmevaṅgāmināṃ yānisthānāni teṣāṃ yasmin‌ pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanātmake gativiśeṣe sati parairvipakṣabhūtaiḥ śārairasamāveśaḥ-anadhyāsanamanākramaṇaṃ so'yānaya ityucyate; na tu pradakṣiṇaprasavyagamanamātre sa evāyam‌| evaṃrūpo'yānayo yadā samahāyaiḥ śārauḥ padānyadhiṣṭhīyante tadā veditavyaḥ| sasahāyānāmeva hi śārāṇāṃ padāni parairna śakyante'dhyāsitum| asahāyānāṃ tu śakyata eva| `phalakaśirasi sthitaḥ' iti| yatra phalake'ṅka'kṣairdīvyanti tasya śirobhūtaṃ yatra sthānaṃ kiṃtavānāṃ prasiddhaṃ tatra sthitaḥ śāraḥ `ayānayīnaḥ' ityucyate; tatraivāyānayīnaśabdasya rūḍhatvāt‌| apare tu, neyo netavyaḥ, na notastataḥ| tatra `śirasi sthitaḥ' ityarthānupapatteḥ `phalakaśirasi sthāpyate' ityartha iti granthena bhavitavyamityāhuḥ| nīto vā neyaḥ; tadupalakṣaṇatvāt‌| bhāvinyāvasthayoktaḥ| ayānayasambandhitve'pi sarveṣāṃ viśeṣyādeva pratyayotpattiruktaiva| satyapi dvitīyādhikāre punardvitīyoccāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭād‌ddhitīyāntādyathā syādityevamartham‌| tena viśiṣṭārthaneyavacanādayānayaśabdād‌ddhitīyāntātad‌ pratyayo bhavati, na neyavacanamātrāt‌| sa eva viśiṣṭo yo nayaḥ pradakṣiṇaprasavyagāmītyādinā granthena darśitaḥ| athāyānya iti ko'yaṃ śabdaḥ, yadi hyayaṃ samāhāre dvandvaḥ, tasya napuṃsakatvādayānayamiti bhavitavyam‌? athetaretarayoge, dvyarthatvādayānayāviti bhavitavyam‌? nāyaṃ dvandvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt‌ tatpuruṣaḥ--ayasahito'nayo'yānaya iti| atha baddhābhakṣayatineyeṣviti kathaṃ tiṅantasya dvandvaḥ? kaḥ punarāhāyaṃ dvandva iti? yadi na dvandvaḥ, kathaṃ neyeṣviti bahuvacanam‌? sautratvānnirdeśasya| subvyatyayena vā cchandasyekavacanasya sthāne bahuvacanamupapannam‌| nanu cchandasi subvyatyaya uktaḥ, nedaṃ chandaḥ? `chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā. 1-1-1) ityadoṣaḥ| atha vā; dvandva evāyam‌, na tu tiṅantasya| na hi bhakṣayatiśabdo'yaṃ tiṅantaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? tiṅantapratirūpako nipātastiṅantena samānārthaḥ, yathā--astikṣīrā brāhmaṇītyatrāstiśabdaḥ|| 10. parovaraparamparaputrapautramanubhavati| (5.2.10) kathaṃ punarapratyayasanniyogena nipātanasya vinā pratyayena darśanamupapadyate? ityāha--`tacchabdāntarameva draṣṭavyam‌' iti|| 11. avārapārātyantānukāmaṃ gāmī| (5.2.11) `gāmī' iti| `āvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ' (3.3.170) ityāvaśyakārthe ṇiniḥ| bhaviṣyati cāyaṃ kāle gāmiśabdo varttate, yadāha--`gamiṣyatīti gāmī'| sā ca bhaviṣyati vṛttiḥ `bhaviṣyati gamyādayaḥ' (3.3.3) iti vacanāllabhyate; ityāha--`bhaviṣyati' ityādi| `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoriti ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhaḥ' iti| tena dvitīyāsamarthatopapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| kṛdyogā hi ṣaṣṭhī dvitīyāyā apavādaḥ, tena ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhe hi sati dvitīyayaiva bhavitavyam‌| `avārapāram‌' iti| avārasya pāramiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam‌| vā ca ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pūrvanipāto vaktavyaḥ| tena pakṣe pārāvāramityapi bhavati| `vigṛhītādapi' iti| [`bhavati'-mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] `viparītācca' iti| kathaṃ punaradhikārādeva dvitīyāsamarthavibhaktau labdhāyāmihādhikaṃ dvitīyopādānaṃ kṛtam‌? etena tadadhikasya vidhirbhavatīti sūcitam‌| tena vigṛhītādviparītācca pratyaya upapadyate| `atyantam‌' iti| antasyābhāvo'tyayo veti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā'vyayībhāvaḥ| atha vā--antamatikrāntamiti `kugati' (2.2.18) ityādinā tatparuṣaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇañcaitat‌| `bhṛśaṃ gantetyarthaḥ' iti| bhṛśārthatvena loke'tyantaśabdasya prasiddhatvāt‌| `anukāmam‌' iti| kāmasadṛśamanukāmam‌| kāmanurūpamityarthaḥ| yathārthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| idamapi kriyāviśeṣaṇameva|| 12. samāṃsamāṃ vijāyate| (5.2.12) `samāṃ samāsa' iti| `nityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) iti vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam‌| ata āha--`samāṃsamāmiti vīpsā' iti| `subantasamudāyaḥ prakṛtiḥ' iti| prātipadikādhikāre vacanasāmarthyāt‌| `garbhaṃ dhārayatītyarthaḥ' iti| anekārthatvāddhātūnām‌| `pūrvapade supo'lugvaktavyaḥ' iti| taddhita utpanne `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca'(1.2.46) iti prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti subluk‌ prāpnoti, tasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| `garbhavimocane'pi vijanirvarttata ityāhuḥ' iti| tadevaṃ manyate--yadā garbhadhāraṇe varttate tadatyantasaṃyoge dvikatīyaivātra, na saptamī| garbhavimocane vijanāvupapadyate saptamī| `yalopamātram‌' iti| na hi garbhavimocanena sakalā samā vyāpyata iti mātraśabdena sarvasyā vibhakterlopo na bhavatīti darśayati| `pariśiṣṭasya' iti| āmśabdasya| `anutpattau' iti| taddhitasya| `uttarapadasya ca' iti| cakārāt‌ pūrvapadasya lopo vaktavya iti yakārasya pratyayasanniyogena vidhīyamāno lopastadabhāve na prāpnotīti pakṣa upasaṃkhyāyate|| 13. adyaśvīnāvaṣṭabdhe| (5.2.13) `avaṣṭabdhe vijana āsanne prasave' iti| atra pūrvayoḥ padayoruttarābhyāṃ yathākramamarthākhyānam‌|| 14. āgavīnaḥ| (5.2.14) 15. anugvalaṅgāmī| (5.2.15) 16. adhvano yatkhau| (5.2.16) 17. abhyayitrāccha ca| (5.2.17) `abhyamitrāt‌' iti| amitrasyābhimukhamabhyamitram‌| `lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye' (2.1.14) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇañcaitat‌| tena dvitīyaiva samarthavibhaktarbhavati|| 18. goṣṭhātkhañ‌ bhūtapūrve| (5.2.18) `bhūtapūrvaṃ caraṭ‌' (5.3.53) iti prāpte khañ‌ vidhīyate| `gāvastiṣṭhantyasminniti goṣṭham‌' iti| `supisthaḥ' (3.2.4) iti kaḥ, `ambāmbagobhūmi' (8.3.97) ityādinā mūrdhanyaḥ| `bhūtapūrve' iti| pūrvaṃ bhūta iti bhūtapūrvaḥ| `supsupā' (2.1.4) iti samāsaḥ| `bhūtapūrvagrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva viśeṣaṇam‌' iti| arthadvārakaṃ veditavyam‌, yathā--`dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samāna' (3.1.7) ityādisūtre karmatvam‌, samānakarttṛkatvañca|| 19. aśvsyaikāhagamaḥ| (5.2.19) `ekāhena gamyata iti ekāhagamaḥ' iti| `akarttari ca' (3.3.19) ityādinā ghañ‌, nipātanānna vṛddhiḥ| `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ| `āśvīnāni śataṃ patitvā' iti| ekāhena yāni gamyante yojanāni teṣāṃ śataṃ gatvetyarthaḥ| śataṃ saṃkhyeye varttamānaṃ svasaṃkhyopādāna eva svabhāvādvarttate| tenāśvīnāni śatamityāśvīnaśabdena bahvarthapravṛttisāmānādikaraṇye'pye'pyekavacanāntameva prayujyate|| 20. śālīnakaupīne adhṛṣṭākāryayoḥ| (5.2.20) `yathākathañcit‌' iti| yena kenacit‌ prakāreṇa| nāvayavārthe pratyabhiniveśaḥ karttavya iti darśayati--`uttarapadalośca' iti| uttarapadaṃ praveśanaśabdo'vataraṇaśabdaśca, tasya lopaḥ| `śālīno jaḍaḥ' iti| sa hi jāḍyāt‌ prativacanamapi dātuṃ śakto'pyāryairādriyamāṇo na śaknoti tatra
