sthātum‌--janatā paśyatīti, ataḥ śālāpraveśanamarhati| śālāśabdo'yamihi kuṭīravacanaḥ| `kaupīnaṃ pāpam‌' iti| taddhi loke nindyatvādakāryyatvāccākāryyam‌, talloke kūpe'vataraṇaṃ praveśanamarhatītyucyate| tatsāmarthyāccharīrāvayavaḥ kaścitkaupīnaśabdenocyate| yadapi tasya śarīrāvayavasyācchādanārthaṃ vāsaḥ, tadapi tatsambandhāt‌ pravrajitādīnāṃ kaupīnamityucyate|| 21. vrātena jīvati| (5.2.21) `nānājātīyāḥ' iti| anekajātīyāḥ| `aniyatavṛttayaḥ' iti| aniyatakriyāḥ| `teṣāṃ karma vrātam‌' iti| vrātasāhacaryāt‌ tadapi vrātamityucyate| atha vā--vrātānāmidamityarthavivakṣāyāṃ che prāpte, asmādeva nipātanādaṇ‌ bhavati| tatpunaḥ karma bhāravahanādi| `tatra neṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi na bhavati prakṛtāyāṃ mahāvibhāṣāyāṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt‌|| 22. sāptapadīnaṃ sakhyam‌| (5.2.22) `sāptapadīnamiti nipātyate' iti| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate? pratyayaḥ pratyayārthaśca prakṛtaḥ| khañpratyayārthaścāvāptiḥ| saptabhiḥ padairavāpyata iti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| tataḥ saptapadaśabdātkhañ‌| `katham‌' ityādi| sakhyubhaviḥ karma vā sakhyām‌| tatra yadi sāptapadīnamiti nipatyate, sakhiśabdena sāmānādikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti, na hi sakhyameva sakhā bhavatīti praṣṭurabhiprāyaḥ| `guṇapradhānaḥ' ityādi| guṇo bhāvaḥ karma vā pradhānaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa yadā ca guṇamātre mukhyayā vṛttyā varttate tadā guṇapradhāno veditavyaḥ| `tadā sakhyaśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati' iti| dvayorapyekārthavṛttitvāt‌| `yadā tu' ityādi| lakṣaṇā upacāraḥ| dharmadharmiṇorabhenopacāreṇa gauṇyā vṛttyā taddhiti saṃkhyāvati puruṣe varttate tadānenaiva samānādhikaraṇo bhavati| yathā yadā śuklaśabdo guṇamātre varttate tadā dravyaśabdena samānādhikaraṇo na bhavati--paṭasya śukla iti, yadā tvasau tvamityabhisambandhāt‌ paṭe varttate tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati--śuklaḥ pada iti; tathehāpi veditavyam‌|| 23. haiyaṅgavīnaṃ saṃjñāyām‌| (5.2.23) `hyogodohasya hiyaṅgvādeśaḥ' iti| hyogodohasya hiyaṅgaśabda ādeśa ityarthaḥ| hyau godohanaṃ hyogodohaḥ, `supsupā' (2.1.4) iti samāsaḥ| `vikāre khañpratyayaḥ' iti| `tasya vikāraḥ' (4.3.134) iti prāptasayāṇo'pavāda iti|| 24. tasya pākamūle pīlvādikarṇādibhyaḥ kuṇabjāhacau| (5.2.24) aṇo'pavādau| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇi prāpte kuṇabadayo vidhīyante| jakārasya prayojanābhāvāt‌ `dhuṭū' (1.3.7) itītsaṃjñā na bhavati|| 25. pakṣāttiḥ| (5.2.25) `ekayoganirdiṣṭānām‌' iti| svaritatvenādiśabdānāmanuvṛttirbhavati| svaritatvapratijñāpratibaddhatvāt‌| ekayoganirdiṣṭānāmapi yatra pratijñāyate svaritatvaṃ tatraiva bhavati, nānyatra| tenaikayoganirdiṣṭanāmapyekadeśasyānuvṛttirupapadyate|| 26. tena vittaścuñcupcaṇapau| (5.2.26) `vidyācuñcuḥ, vidyācaṇaḥ' iti| atha `cuṭū' (1.3.7) iti cakārasyetsaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati? ukto'sya hetustatraiva--pṛthagyogakaraṇamasya vidheranityatvajñāpanārthamiti|| 27. vinañbhyāṃ nānāñau nasaha| (5.2.27) `svārthe nānāñau pratyayau bhavataḥ' iti| `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti' (sī.pa. 125) iti kṛtvā| ñakārastvādyudāttārthaḥ|| 28. veḥ śālacchaṅkaṭcau| (5.2.28) `sasādhanakriyāvacanāt‌' ityādi| uktametat‌--upasargā hyevamātmakā bhavanti yatra kaścit‌ kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prayujyate tatra kriyāviśeṣaṇamāhuḥ| yatra na prayujyate tatra sasādhanakriyāmiti| iha na kaścit‌ kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prayujyate, tasmāt sasādhanakriyāvācina upasargāt‌ pratyayo bhavati| sa ca bhavan‌ `anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavanti' (sī.pa. 125) ityanirdiṣṭārthatvāt‌ svārthe bhavati| `vigate śṛṅge' iti| etena vigamanakriyāyāṃ śṛṅgasādhanāyāṃ viśabdo varttata iti darśayati| yadi sasādhanāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ pratyayaḥ, viśālo gaurviśaṅkaṭo gauriti na sidhyati, na hi gauriha vigamanasya sādhanam‌, kiṃ tarhi? śṛṅge? ityata āha--`tadyogāt‌' ityādi| yathā sāsnādyavayavayogādavayavadharmeṇa gauḥ sāsnetyucyate, tathā viśālaviśaṅkaṭaśṛṅgayogādgaustathetyucyate| `paramārthatastu' ityādi| samudāyo vyutpatyarthaḥ| ato'tra na kevalaṃ sasādhanakriyā nāsti, api ca sādhanamipi nāsti| tasmādguṇaśapabdā viśālādayaḥ paramārthato loke prasiddhāḥ yathā--śuklādayaḥ śabdāḥ| tena nātra viśālīdiṣu prakṛtipratyayārthayorabhiniveśaḥ karttavyaḥ| tadevaṃ paramārthato'narthakāḥ| veḥ śālacchaṅkaṭacāvapyanarthakāveva vidhīyate ityuktaṃ bhavati| `ete' iti| vyutpādayiṣyamāṇān‌ saṅkaṭādīn‌ buddhau kṛtvā bahuvacanaṃ kṛtam‌, te'pi hi guṇaśabdā eva|| 29. saṃprodaśca kaṭac‌| (5.2.29) sasādhanakriyāvacanādupasargāt svārthe pratyaya iti sarvaṃ pūrvavadeva veditavyam| `alābūtilomā' ityādi| alābūprabhṛtibhyo rajasyabhidheye kaṭacpratyayasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam‌| vikārapratyayānāmapavādaḥ; alābūprabhṛtīnāṃ yadrajastasya tadvikāratvāt‌| `goṣṭhādayaḥ' ityādi| ādiśabdaḥ prakāre| paśunāmāni gośabdādīni, tebhyaḥ sthānādiṣvabhidheyeṣu goṣṭhajādayaḥ pratyayā vaktavyāḥ| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ sthānādiṣu goṣṭhajādayo vidhīyante| nanu `taddhitāḥ' (4.1.76) iti bahuvacanenaiva saṃgṛhītaṃ saṅghāte kaṭajityādi sarvam‌? satyam‌; anantaroktasyaiva vākyasya prapañco'yam‌| `avikaṭam‌' iti| atra `tasya samūhaḥ' (4.2.37) iti sāmūhike pratyayo kaṭaṭ‌| `avipaṭam‌' iti| prakīrṇānāmavīnāṃ vistāra ucyate| dvāvuṣṭau `uṣṭragoyugam‌'| ṣaṅ hastino `hastiṣaṅgavam‌' iṅgudasya sneha `iṅgudatailam‌'| tilasya `rasāstilatailam‌'| `bhavane kṣetre' ityādi| ikṣūṇāṃ bhavanaṃ kṣetra `mikṣuśākaṭam‌' | `ikṣuśākinam‌'| mūlasya bhavanaṃ kṣetraṃ `mūlaśākaṭam‌'| mūlaśākinam‌|| 30. avātkuṭāracca| (5.2.30) 31. nate nāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ ṭīṭañnāṭajbhraṭacaḥ| (5.2.31) `namanaṃ natam‌' iti| bhāve niṣṭhāṃ darśayati| `nāsikāyāḥ sambandhinī' iti| anenāpi nāsikāyā ityapi sambandhalakṣamā ṣaṣṭī| yadi nāsikāyāḥ sambandhini nate vācya ete pratyayāḥ, kathaṃ tadetena nāsikā puruṣaścābhidhīyate? ityāha--`tadyogāt‌' iti|| 32. nerbiḍajbirīsacau| (5.2.32) `kathaṃ nibiḍāḥ' iti| tadyogo'tra nāsti| atastadyogābhāvāt‌ tathābhidhānaṃ nopapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `upamānādbhaviṣyati' iti| niviḍatayā nāsikayā tulyāḥ keśā vastrāṇi ca nibiḍatayā| tenopamānāt‌ tadubhayaṃ nibiḍaśabdavācyaṃ bhaviṣyati|| 33. upādhibhyā tyakannāsannārūḍhayoḥ| (5.2.33) `saṃjñādhikārācca' iti| `nate nāsikāyāḥ' (5.2.31) ityādisūtrāt‌ saṃjñādhikārānuvṛtteḥ| `niyataviṣayam‌' iti| parvataviṣayamevāsannārūḍhaṃ gṛhyate| tena vṛkṣasyāsannam‌, plakṣasyārūḍhamityatara na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| athopatyakā, adhityaketyatra `pratyayasthāt‌ kāt‌ pūrvasya' (7.3.44) ityanenettvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`pratyayasthāt‌ kāt‌' iti| yadyatrettvaṃ syāt‌ saṃjñārūpaṃ na sidhyet‌; nopatyikādhityiketyevaṃrūpā saṃjñā| tasmāt‌ saṃjñādhikārādittvaṃ na bhavati|| 35. karmaṇi ghaṭo'ṭhac‌| (5.2.35) `karmaṇi' ityanena karmaṇīti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ darśayiti| atha pāribāṣikasya karmaṇo grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? asambhavāt‌| asambhavastu ghaṭaterakarmakatvāt‌| `aṭhacpratyaye'kāroccāraṇaṃ ṭhasyekādeśanivṛttyartham‌|| 36. tadasya sañjātaṃ tārakādibhya itac‌| (5.2.36) tārakādiṣu `bubhukṣāpipāsā' śabdau paṭhyete, tayoḥ kimarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ, yāvatā sannantābhyāṃ niṣṭhāyāmiṭi ca kṛte bubhukṣitaḥ, pipāsito devadatta iti bhavati? satyam‌; bhūte vidhānādvarttamāne na sidhyati| anena tu varttamāne'pi sidhyati| tasmādyuktastayoḥ pāṭhaḥ| `garbhādaprāṇini' iti| garbhaśabdādaprāṇinyabhidheya itacpratyayo bhavati| garbhitāḥ śālayaḥ| aprāṇinīti kim‌? garbhaḥ sañjāto'syā garbhiṇī gauḥ|| 37. pramāṇe dvayasajdadhnañmātracaḥ| (5.2.37) pramāṇaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvātpratyayārtho vijñāyate| `prathamaśca dvitīyaśca' ityādi| dvayasajdadhnacau ūrdhvamāna iṣyete| upari nikṣipya yatra mīyate, na tiryyak‌ samantato vā, tadūrdhvamānam‌| `aviśeṣeṇa' iti| pramāṇe parimāṇa unmāne vā'viśeṣeṇa sarvatra mātrajbhavatīti| `prasthamātramityapi bhavati' iti| apiśabdādvitastimātramityapi bhavatīti| `pramāṇe loḥ' iti| lukaścāyaṃ pūrvācāryavihitā saṃjñā| ayaṃ mātraca utpannasya lugucyate; na dvayasajdadhnayoḥ| tayorūrdhvamāne vidhānāt‌| asminnartha utpattirapi nāsti| `dvigornityam‌' iti| dvigorapramāṇatvāt‌| satyapi ca pramāṇāntatve tadantaviderabhāvāt‌| pūrveṇa prāpta eva lugucyate| `nityagrahaṇaṃ kim‌' iti| na hi vikalpaḥ prakṛto yannivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| na ca pūrvasya vidhervikalpena pravṛttiṃ jñāpayitumiha nityagrahaṇaṃ kartuṃ yuktam‌| na hyasau vibāṣayeṣyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `saṃśaye', ityādinā nityagrahaṇasya prayojanamāha| śravaṇaṃ prādaḥ, `kṛtvalyuṭo bahulam‌' (3.3.113) iti bhāve ghañ‌' śrāvo'syāstīti śrāvī, sa punarvakṣyamāṇo mātracpratyayaḥ pramāṇasambandhenocyate| `stome ḍaṭ‌' ityādi| pañcadaśāhāni parimāṇamasya yajñasya `pañcadaśaḥ'| `pañcadaśī' iti| ṭittvānṅīp‌| `śanśatorḍiniḥ' iti| stome cānyatrāviśeṣeṇāyaṃ vidhiḥ| `viṃ śinaḥ' iti| ḍiniḥ, `ti viṃśaterḍiti' (6.4.142) iti tilopaḥ, yasyeti lopaśca| `śamamātraṃ diṣṭimātramiti| pramāṇasyodāharaṇadvayam‌| `prasthāmātram‌, kuḍavamātramiti' parimāṇasya| pañcamātram‌, daśamātramiti saṃkhyāyāḥ| yatraitanna nirṇīyate śamaṃ syādvā na veti tatra śamamātramiti prayucyate| evamanyatrāpi yathāyogaṃ veditavyam‌|| 38. puruṣahastibhyāmaṇ‌ ca| (5.2.38) `hāstinam‌' iti| `hanaṇyanapatye' (6.4.164) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `dvipuruṣī iti| `puruṣāt‌ pramāṇe'nyatarasayām‌' (4.1.24) iti ṅīp‌| `dvihastino iti| atra ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' (4.1.5) iti ṅīp‌|| 39. yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup‌| (5.2.39) `yāvān‌' iti| `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) ityakāraḥ| ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌, `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| pramāṇaparimāṇaśabdau paryāyāviti matyamāno paścodayet‌--atra kasmāt‌ parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, yāvatā pramāṇagrahaṇamanuvarttata eveti? taṃ pratyāha--`pramāṇe iti varttamāne' ityādi| sa punaranayoḥ pramāṇaparimāṇayorbhedaḥ `parimāṇaṃ tu sarvataḥ, āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ syāt‌' iti prāgeva vyākhyātaḥ| `ḍāvatāvarthavaiśeṣyāt‌' iti| `ḍāvatau' iti pūrvācāryasaṃjñāpratipāditāpekṣo'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, te hi yattadetebyo ḍāvatumeva pratyayaṃ kṛtavantaḥ| viśiṣyata iti viśeṣaḥ, viśeṣasya bhāvo vaiśeṣyam‌| arthasya vaiśeṣyamarthasya viśiṣṭatvamityarthaḥ| pramāṇaśapabdasyānyo'rthaḥ, parimāṇaśabdasya cānyo'rtha iti bhinnārthatvamanayoḥ; tasmādarthavaiśeṣyāḍḍāvatau vidhātavye parimāṇaśabdasya nirdeśaḥ pṛthagucyate| ucyata iti kriyata ityarthaḥ| kimarthaḥ pṛthignirdeśaḥ kriyate? ityāha-`mātrādyapratighātāya' iti| pṛthignirdeśenārthabede siddhe sati mātrajādīnāṃ bādhā mā būdityevamarthaḥ pṛthagnirdeśaḥ kriyata ityāha| athaikatve tu prakṛtisāmānye mātrajādayo vidhīyamānā utsargā bhavanti, prakṛtiviśeṣāt‌ tu vatub‌ vidhīyamāno'pavādau bhavati, `apavādenotsargo bādhyate' iti yattadetebhyo mātra jādayo na syuḥ, tataśca tatpramāṇamasya tanmātramityādi na sidhyet‌, arthabhedyutsargāpavādabhāvo nāstīti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| kiñca--`bhāvaḥ siddhaśca ḍāvatoḥ' iti| `ḍāvatoḥ' iti pañcamī| arthabhede sati vatuppratyayāntānmātrajādīnāmutpattiśca siddhā bhavati| parimāṇe vatub‌ bhavati--yat‌ parimāṇamasya yāvāniti| tadantāt‌ parimāṇe mātrajādayo bhavanti--yāvat‌ parimāṇamasya yāvanmātram‌| athaikatve tu `uktārthānāmaprayogaḥ' (vyā.pa.60) ti matupā'bihitatvādasyārthasya tadantānmātrajādayo na syu-| `tvāvataḥ, māvataḥ' iti| maparyantayoryuṣmadasmadoḥ `pratyayottarapadayośca' (7.2.98) iti tvāmādeśau pūrvavadāttvam‌|| 40. kimidambhyāṃ vo ghaḥ| (5.2.40) `kiyān‌| iyān‌' iti| `idaṃkimorīśkī' (6.3.90) iti kimaḥ kī| `idama īś‌' iti| `yasyeti' (6.4.148) lopaḥ| kena punaḥ kimidambhyāṃ vihitasya vatupo vakārasya ghatvaṃ vidhīyate? ityāha--`atha vā' ityādi| `yogavibāgena vā' iti| `kimidambhyām‌' ityetāvatā yogena vatupaṃ vidhāya tataḥ `vo ghaḥ' ityanena vatupo vakārasya ghatvaṃ vidhīyate| atha vagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti vakārasyaiva gho vidhīyate, nanu cānekāltvāt‌ sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, akāro hyatroccāraṇārtho varṇamātrameva, na tvādeśaḥ| kutaḥ punaretadvijñeyam‌? vyākhyānāt‌| tarhi vakāra evaṃ laghīyāniti yuktaṃ tasya sthānitvenopādanam‌| vakāre tvasthāninyupāttai yadyapi samudāyādeśaḥ, tathāpi na doṣaḥ; dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpaṃ bhaviṣyati|| 41. kimaḥ saṃkhyāparimāṇe ḍati ca| (5.2.41) `saṃkhyāyāḥ parimāṇam‌' iti| kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| parimitiḥ parimāṇam‌| saṃkhyāpariccheda ityarthaḥ| pariccheda ti bhāve ghañ‌| `saṃkhyāparicchede varttamānāt‌' iti| paricchedopādhikāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ varttamānādityeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ| yathā hyayamevārtho'sya vacanasyottaratra tathā vyaktīkariṣyate| tasya vakārasya ghatvamiti; `vo ghaḥ' ityanuvṛtteḥ| `pṛcchyamānatvāt‌' iti| yadā saṃkhyāyāḥ paricchede kiṃśabdo varttate| kadā ca varttate? yadā saṃkhyā paripṛcchyamānā bhavati| na hyaparipṛcchyamānāyāḥ pariccheda upapadyate| yadā ca paripṛṭacchyamānā bhavati, tadā ca kiṃśabdaḥ paricchedaviśiṣṭāyāṃ varttata iti pṛcchyamānatvāt‌ `paricchedopādikāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ varttamānāt‌ kimaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti vijñāyate| pariccheda upādhiviśeṣaṇabhūto yasyāḥ sā paricchedopādhikā| paricachedaviśeṣaṇeti yāvat‌| tadanena saṃkyāparicchede varttamānāt‌ kima ityasya yo'rtho'bhimataḥ sa vyaktīkṛtaḥ| `kati' iti| jasaḥ `ṣaḍbhyo luk‌' (7.1.22) iti luk‌| `atha vā' ityādi| atra ca vyākhyāne `saṃkhyāparimāṇe' iti karmadhārayaḥ, nipātanādupasarjanasyāyaṃ paranipātaḥ| parimāṇaśabdaśca parimīyate'neneti karaṇasādhanaḥ| `evamātmikaiva' iti| asyārthaṃ paricchedasvabhāvetyanena vispaṣṭīkaroti| paricchidyate'neneti paricchedaḥ, sa svabhāvo yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| `yatra' ityādinā yadarthaṃ parimāṇagrahaṇena saṃkhyā viśeṣyate taddarśayati| syādetat‌--nāstyeva sa viśeṣo yatra saṃkhyāyāḥ paricchedasvabhāvo nāsti, tadapārthakaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti? ata āha--`kṣepe hi' ityādi| `keyameṣāṃ saṃkhyā daśānām‌' iti| nātra saṃkhyā paricchedakatvena vivakṣitā| na hyatra paricchedo'sti; kṣepaparatvādvākyasya| kiṃśabdo'tra kṣepe varttate, na praśne|| 42. saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap‌| (5.2.42) `catuṣṭayī' iti| caturo rephasya `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.3.34) iti saḥ; tasyāpi `hrasvāttādau taddhite' (8.3.99) iti mūrdhanyaḥ, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) ityādinā ṅīp‌|| 43. dvitribhyāṃ tayasyāyajvā| (5.2.43) tayapratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā prakṛta evāsāvanuvarttiṣyate? ityāha--`tayagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yadi tayabgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā tayapratyayādanya evāyamayac‌ pratyayo vijñāyeta, na tayabādeśaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadi pratyayāntaraṃ syāt‌? tayaṣkāryyamayaco na syāt‌| kiṃ tat‌? `prathamacaram‌' (1.1.32) ityādinā jasi vibhāṣā sarvanāmasaṃjñā--dvaye, dvayāḥ; `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅop‌--dvayo| nanu ca pūrvasūtreṇaiva vihitasya tasya iha cādeśārthānuvṛttirvijñāyate| prayojanāntarābhāvāt‌, `dvitribhyām‌' iti| pañcamīnirdeśaḥ `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ sampādayiṣyate, atonenāntareṇāpi tayabgrahaṇaṃ tayapsthānitvaṃ labhyata eva? naitadasti; yadyanuvṛtatistayapo'nyāryā na syāt‌, tato'nuvṛttisamarthyāt‌ tayapaḥ sthānitvaṃ vijñāyeta| tasya tvanuvṛttiruttarārthipi bhavati| `ubhādudātto nityam‌' (5.2.44) ityava yogavibāgena tayabvidhātavyaḥ| na cānuvarttamānaḥ śakyate vidhātum‌| ata uttarārthāyāmanuvṛttau satyāṃ tayapsthānitvamayuktamiti tayabgrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 44. ubhādudātto nityam‌| (5.2.44) `vacanasāmarthyāt‌' ityādi| yadyantodāttaḥ syādudāttavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| ayaci ca kṛte citsvareṇaiva `satiśiṣṭasvaro balīyān‌' (vā. 6.1.158) ityantodāttatvasya siddhatvāt| ādyudāttatvaṃ hyanyathā na sidhyatīti tadrathaṃ kriyasāṇamarthabadvacanaṃ bhavatīti| `yadi laukiko saṃkhyā' iti| dvitrādivat‌| pūrveṇa yogena tayayo vidhānam‌, tasyāpareṇa yogena nityamayajādeśo vidhīyate| `ubhaye dedamanuṣyāḥ' iti| ubhāvavayavau yeṣāmityubhaye| kathaṃ bahutve devamanuṣyāṇāṃ dvāvavayavau bhavataḥ? yadyapyatra bahutvamasti, dvitvamapi tu prātipadikayorastyeva; atra hi dvau rāśī samudāyasyāvayavau--eko devanāṃ rāśiḥ, aparo manuṣyāṇāmityadoṣaḥ|| 45. tadasminnadhikamiti daśāntāḍḍaḥ| (5.2.45) `pratyayārthena ca' ityādi| yathājātīyaḥ pratyayārthastathājātīya eva yadi prakṛtyartho vati evaṃ pratyaya ityate, nānyathā| pratyayārthena prakṛtyarthasya tulyajātīyatvaṃ darśayitumudāharaṇamupanyasyati--`ekādaśa kārṣāpaṇāḥ' iti| prakṛtyartho'pyekādaśa kārṣāpaṇā eveti prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayārthena samānajātīyaḥ| `iha tu na' ityādi| atra hi kārṣāpaṇaśataṃ pratyayārthaḥ| prakṛtyarthastvekādaśa māṣāḥ| te ca kārṣāpaṇebhyo vijātīyā iti na bhavati pratyayaḥ| `śatasahasrayoścaiveṣyate' iti| yat‌ `tadasmin‌' tasmiṃśca śate sahasre vā pratyaya iṣyate; nānyatara triṃśatyādau| kathaṃ punaranupāttameva sūtre labhyate? ityāha--`iti karaṇo vivakṣārthaḥ' ityādi| `katham‌' ityādi| yadi śate sahasre vādhikini pratyayena bhavitavyam‌, iha pratyayo na prāpnoti--ekādaśaṃ śatasahasramiti| atra hi śatasahasraṃ saṃkhyāntarañcādhikam‌, na śataṃ nāpi sahasramityabhiprāyaḥ| `śatānām‌' ityādi| anena śatasahasrasya saṃkhyāntaraṃ nirasyāti| yadā śataśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhyantaḥ sahasraśabdena samasyate tadā śatānāṃ sahasraṃ śatasahasraśabdenocyate| yadā tu sahasraśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhyantaśabdena samasyate, tadā sahasrāṇaāṃ śataṃ śatasahasraśabdenocyate| nanu ca sahasraśabdasya paṣṭhyantasya samāse sahasraśatamiti bhavitavyam‌? rājadantādiṣu darśanāt‌ tasya paranipāto bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `tatra śatasahasrayorityeva siddham‌' iti| śatasahasravācyasyārthasya śatasahasrayorevāntarbhāvāt‌| `adhike' ityādi| loke pratyayārthena samānajātāvadhike śatasahasrayoreva pratyayākhyaṃ kāryamiṣṭam‌| yadā tvasamānajātyadhikaṃ bhavati, na ca śataṃ sahasraṃ vā pratyayārthena vivakṣitam‌, tadā neṣyate| athaikādaśaṃ śatasahasramityatra kasyādhikye sati ḍaḥ karttavyaḥ? ityāha--`yasya' ityādi| saṃkhyā saṃkhyānam‌, gaṇanamityarthaḥ| yasya saṃkhyā, tasyādhikye ḍaḥ karttavyaḥ| kasya ca saṃkhyā bhavati? adhikatvaṃ saṃkhyāyate yasya| yadā śatāni saṃkyāyate tadā--śatānāṃ sahasramiti śatasahasram‌, tadā śatādhikye ḍaḥ karttavyaḥ| ekādaśādhikānsmin‌ sahasra ekādaśaṃ śatasahasramiti| yadā tu sahasrāṇi saṃkhyāyate--sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ sahasraśatmiti, tadā sahasrādhikye ḍaḥ karttavyaḥ| ekādaśasahasrāṇyadhikānyasminnekādaśaṃ śatasahasramiti| atha kimarthaṃ taditi prathamāsamarthavibhaktirupādīyate? yāvatā `tadasya sañjātam‌' (5.2.36) ityanuvarttata eva, tatra pratyayārtha evāsminniti nirdeṣṭavyaḥ? naivaṃ śakyam‌; tadanuvṛttau hi tatsambandhasyāsyeti pratyārthasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ prasajyeta| na ca ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyarthayorvirodhaḥ; tato'sminniti nirdeśāt‌ pūrvaḥ pratyayārtho na nivarttate, tasyāṃ tvanuvṛttau ṣaṣṭhyarthe'pi pratyayaḥ syāt‌| tasmādasyeti nivṛttyarthaṃ punastaditi prathamāsamarthavibhaktirupādīyate| yadyevam‌, asyeti pratyayārthasya nivṛttatvāt‌ `saṃkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne mayaṭ‌' (5.2.47) ityatra ṣaṣṭhyarthe pratyayo na prāpnoti| iha nivṛttasyāpi maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvṛttirbhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| anye tu jñāpakaṃ tadityasya varṇayanti| taditi prakṛte yat‌ tadityāha, tajjñāpayati--`tadasya sañjātam‌' (5.2.36) ityādau sūtre yannirdiṣṭaṃ tadihānuvarttamānamapyaṅgabhāvaṃ na yātīti ṣaṣṭhyarthe pratyayo na bhavati|| 46. śadantarviśateśca| (5.2.46) nanu ca `paṅ‌kti' (5.1.59) ityādau sūtre triṃśadādayaḥ śabdāḥ śatpratyayāntāḥ, tataśca pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayaiva tadantāt‌ pratyayo labhyate, tat‌ kimantagrahaṇena? ityāha--`śad‌grahaṇe'ntagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yadyantagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā yasmāt‌ sa vihitastadādereva syān‌; nādhikāt‌| ato'dhikādapi yathā syādityevamarthamantagrahaṇam‌| yadi tarhi yasmāt‌ pratyayo vihitastadāderadhikārthamantagrahaṇaṃ kevalānna prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena kevalādapi bhaviṣyati| `saṃkhyāgrahaṇañca karttavyam‌' iti| saṃkhyā gṛhyate yena tat‌ saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| kiṃ punaḥ karttavyam‌? vyākhyānam‌| tatraivaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap‌' (5.2.42) ityataḥ saṃkhyāyā ityanuvarttate, tena saṃkhyādhikādeva bhaviṣyati, nānyādhikāt‌| `viṃśateśca' ityādi| viṃśatiśabdācca tadantācca prātipadikāṅḍapratyayo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatraidaṃ vyākhyānam‌--viṃśatiśabdāttāvat‌ sākṣāt‌ sūtropāttāta pratyayo bhavati, tadantādapi; cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāditi| `saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ ca' ityādau pūrva evārthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi pūrvakameva|| 47. saṃkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne mayaṭ‌| (5.2.47) `guṇo yena nimīyate' iti| parivarttyate, vikrīyata ityarthaḥ| `so'pi' ityādi| na hi tasya bhāgatvamantareṇa nimeyasya guṇa ityeva nirdiṣṭasya bhāgatvamadhyavasātuṃ śakyam‌| yadā hi mūlasya bhāgatvaṃ nāsti, bhāgavyapadeśo na pravarttata eva| tena yadyapi nimānasya bhāgatā noktā, tathāpi sāmarthyāt‌ sā pratīyate| `yavānāṃ dvau bhāgau nimānamasya' iti| nanu cobhayatrāpi parivarttanam‌, tathāpi mūlya eva nimānaśabdo rūḍha iti yanmūlyatvena vivakṣitaṃ tadeva nimānaṃ bhavati, netarat‌| `yavānām‌' iti| bhāgāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī| yadyevam‌, parāpekṣa uvaścicchabde taddhitasya vṛttirvirudhyate| nanūdaśvidbhāge pratyayaḥ, nodaśviti, tatkathaṃ dvimayamudaśviditi pratyayāntasyodaśvicchabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyam‌? ityata āha--`bhāge'pi tu' ityādi| atra punarabhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ| yathaivāṇādayo'patyāpatyavatsambandhe'pi vidhīyamānā abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyāt‌ prādhānyena sambandhinamācakṣate--aupagavo dākṣiriti, tathāyamapi bhāge vidhīmāno bhāgavantamudaśvidādikamācaṣṭe| `guṇasyeti caikatvaṃ vivakṣitam‌' iti| guṇasyeti yaikasaṃkhyā sā vivakṣitā| nanu ca `taddhitāḥ (4.1.76) iti nirdeśe'pi bahuvacanamapramāṇam‌, tasyāvivakṣitatvāt‌' ityuktam‌, tatkathamihaikatvavivakṣā yujyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha hi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaṃ kṛtvā guṇanimāna eva karttavyam‌, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati| so'yamevaṃ vaktavye sati yadguṇasyetyekavacanamuccārayati, tenaitat‌ sūcayati--vivakṣitamatraikatvamiti tenetyādinaikatvavivakṣāyāḥ phalaṃ darśayati| ekatvavivakṣāyāṃ hyetat‌ prayojanam‌--ekasya guṇasya nimāne varttamānādyathā syāt‌| `dvau bhāgau yavānāṃ traya udaśvitaḥ' iti| atra trayāṇāṃ bhāgānāṃ nimāne dviśabdo varttata iti na bhavati pratyayaḥ| nanu ca satyāmapyekatvavivakṣāyāṃ naivānna pratyayena bhavitavyam‌, yataḥ `bhūyasaśca vācikāyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ pratyaya iṣyate' iti vacanam‌| na hyatra dviśabdo bhūyaso vācakaḥ? evaṃ tarhi yavānāṃ yau dvau bhāgau, tāviha nimeyatvena vivakṣyete| ye traya udaśvito bhāgāste nimānatvena| tatra yadyekatvavivakṣā na syāt‌ tadā triṣūdaśvidguṇeṣu varttamānāt‌ pratyayaḥ syāt‌| bhūyasaścetyapi pratyayārthāt‌ prakṛtyarthasya bhūyaso vācikāyāḥ pratyaya iṣyate, nānyataḥ| `iha na bhavati' iti| anabhiṣānāt‌| `tadasminnadhikam‌' (5.2.45) ityādeḥ sūtrāditikaraṇānuvṛttervā| yadi bhūyaso vācikāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā iṣyate yavānāṃ dvau bhāgau nimānamasyetyatra na prāpnoti? ityata āha--`bhūyasa iti ca' ityādi| evamapi hi prāpnoti--dvau yavānāmaṣyarddha udaśvita iti, asti hyatra pratyarthāt‌ prakṛtyarthasyādhikyam‌? ityata āha--`guṇaśabdaḥ' ityādi| guṇaśabdo hyayaṃ bhāgavacano'pi samatāmapi tasya bhāgasya brūte, na cāṣyarddhaśapabdena samabhāga ucyate| `nimeye cāpi dṛśyate' iti| kena punarvihito dṛśyate? anenaiva| katham‌? dve atra vākye; tatraikasmin‌ vākye nimānaśabdaḥ karaṇasādhanaḥ--nimīyate'neneti nimānam‌; dvitīye tu karmasādhano nimīyata iti nimānam‌; `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam‌' (3.3.113) iti karmaṇi lyuṭ‌| yadā karaṇasādhanastadā guṇasyeti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭī, yadā tu karmasādhanastadā karttari| guṇo hi nimānakriyākaraṇamiti karttṛtvena vivakṣyate| bhavati hi karaṇasya karttṛtvena vivakṣā, yathā--sādhyasiśchinattīti| tatraikena vākyena nimāne parttamānāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā nimeye'bhidheye pratyayo vidhīyate| apareṇa nimeye varttamānāyā nimāne'bhidheye'pi pratyayo'bhidhīyate| vākyabhedasya ca saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ nibandhanam‌--`saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap‌' (5.2.42) ityataḥ| evañca saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvarttate| idamiha dvitīyam‌| tatra yadyatraikaṃ vākyaṃ syād‌dvitīyaṃ saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, sautrānumitābhyāṃ tu dve vākye kriyamāṇe tadarthavadbhavati| tasmāddve atra vākye| `dvau vrīhiyavau' ityādi| atra nodaśvidbhāgasya dvau vrīhiyavau nimānatvena vivakṣitau, kiṃ tarhi? udaśvitaḥ| evaṃ `dvauguṇau' ityādi| atra prathamāsamartho guṇasya nimānena varttate| na hi kṣīrasya bhāgadvayena tailasya bhāgo nimīyate| mayaṭaṣṭitkaraṇaṃ ṅībartham‌--dvau guḍasyaiko drākṣāyā dvimayī drākṣeti|| 48. tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ‌| (5.2.48) iha dve saṃkhyāgrahaṇe anuvarttate, tatra caikena `saṃkhyāvācinaḥ prātipadikāt‌' iti bruvatā prakṛtirviśeṣitā| dvitīyena tu pratyayārtha viśeṣayitumāha--`yena' ityādi| saṃkhyānaśabdaṃ samuccārayan‌ saṃkhnāvacanaḥ saṃkhyānaśabdena pratyayārtho viśeṣyate iti darśayati| dvividho hi saṃkhyāśabadaḥ--saṃkhyānavacanaḥ, saṃkhyeyavacanaśca| tatra yadi saṃkhyeyavacanena pratyayārtho viśeṣyate, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt‌--saṃkhyeyaṃ muṣṭyādikaṃ yena pūryate dravyāntareṇātiriktaṃ kriyate sa ca pūraṇa iti, tataśca pañcānāṃ muṣṭikāṇāṃ ghaṭa ityatrāpi syāt‌| tasmātsaṃkhyāvacanenaiva pratyayārtho viśeṣayittuṃ yuktaḥ| `sampadyate' iti| pūryyata ityasyārthamācaṣṭe| etenaitaddarśayati--saṃkhyāvacanena pratyayārtho viśeṣyate| na muṣṭikāṇāmiva dravyāṇāṃ dravyāntareṇātiriktakaraṇaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ pūraṇam‌, kiṃ tarhi? sampattireveti| `iha na bhavati' ityādi| na hi ghaṭa upajāte pañcatvasaṃkhyā muṣṭikāṇā sampadayate| kiṃ tarhi? tatra pañcasaṃkhyakānāmeva dravyāntareṇātiriktatā|| 49. nāntādasaṃkhyādermaṭ‌| (5.2.49) `ḍaṭo maḍāgamo bhavati' iti| atha pratyaya eva nāntāt‌ maṭ‌ kasmānna bhavati? narhati pratyayo bhavitum‌| pratyaye hi tasmin‌ sati ḍaṭo'nuvṛttirapārthikā syāt‌, sa hi pūrvameva vihitaḥ, na ca vihitasyānuvṛttirvidhānārthopapadyata iti| āgamārthe ca sā vijñāyate| nanu ca pañcama ityādau na kaścidviśeṣaḥ--maṭa āgamatve, pratyayatve vā; tadeva hi rūpam‌, sa eva hi svaraḥ, kiñcānuvṛttena, maṭa eva pratyayatvamastu? satyam‌, iha nāsti viśeṣaḥ; viṃśatitama ityādau tu vidyate| tathā hi `viśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām‌' (5.2.56) iti maṭpratyayaḥ syāt‌| [`mayaṭ‌' mudritapāṭhaḥ] viṃśatitamaprabhṛtayaḥ śabdāḥ pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttāḥ syuḥ| ḍaṭi tu pratyaye sati tasyādyudāttatve kṛte tataścāgamānudāttatve cāntodāttā bhavanti| tasmādutarārthe'nuvarttamānasyehāpi ḍaṭa eva pratyayatvaṃ vijñāyate| kathaṃ punarḍaṭo maḍāgamaḥ śakyo vidhātum‌, yāvatā prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ prakṛtaṃ ḍaḍgrahaṇam‌, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ? ityādi--`nāntāt‌' ityādi| yadyapi prathamāntaṃ ḍaḍgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtam‌, tathāpi ḍaṭa āgamasambandhena `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti nāntādityeṣā pañcamī ḍaḍiti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ prakalapayatatyadoṣaḥ| `pañcamaḥ' iti| ṭilopo'tra na bhavati; maṭi kṛte satyabhasaṃjñakatvāt‌| nanu ca paratvāṭṭilopenaiva tāvadbhavitavyam‌? naitadasti; antaraṅgo hyāgamaḥ, sa hi pratyayasanniyogenocyate| ṭilopastūtpanne pratyaye bhasaṃjñāyā satyāṃ prakṛtipratyayāvāśritya bhavatīti bahiraṅgo bhavati| `ekādaśānāṃ pūraṇā ekādaśaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punarasmātprāptiḥ, yāvatā saṃkhyāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, saṃkhyāsam‌dāyo'pi hi saṃkhyāgrahaṇena gṛhyate--saṃkhyāyate'nayeti kṛtavā| avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam‌; anyathā'daśatayā na syāt‌|| 50. thaṭ ca cchandasi| (5.2.50) 51. ṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk‌| (5.2.51) `tadiha saptamyā' ityādi| pūraṇādhikāre hyayaṃ vidhīyamāno ḍaṭsanniyogana vidhīyate| tatra yadyapi saptamau nāsti, tathāpi ḍaṭi parato vijñāyate| tenārthādvibhaktivapariṇāmo bhavatīti ḍaḍiti yadvatteta tadiha saptamyā vipariṇamyate| `katipayaśabdo na saṃkhyā' iti| laukikatvābhāvāt‌ saṃkhyā na bhavati; loke'sya saṃkhyātvenāprasiddhatvāt| śāstrīyo'pi na bhavati; śāstre saṃkhyāsaṃjñā'vidhānāt‌| yadi na saṃkhyā, kaṃthamasya ḍaṭ‌, yatra paratasthugvidhīyate? ityāha--`tasya' ityādi| yadetaḍḍaṭi parataḥ katipayaśabdasya thugvidhānaṃ tata eva jñāpakāḍḍaṭ‌pratyayo'sya bhavatītyavasīyate| `ṣaṣṭhaḥ' iti| ṣṭtvam‌| ṭilopo'tra na bhavati| thugvidhānasāmarthyāt‌| āgamasya pūrvāntakaraṇaṃ bhasaṃjñārtham‌| yadi parādiḥ kriyate tato bhasaṃjñā na syāt‌, tathā cāsatyām‌, `svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāne' (1.4.17) iti padasaṃjñā syāt‌| tataśca ṣaṣṭha ityatra jaśtvaṃ prasajyeta| `caturthaḥ' iti| atra rephasya `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.3.34) iti satvam‌| pūrvānte tu saṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ na bhavati|| 52. bahupūgagaṇasaṅkhasaya tithuk‌| (5.2.52) `pūgasaṅghayorasaṃkhyātvāt‌' iti| atra kathaṃ pratyaya iti, pūgasaṅghaśabdau hi na laukikī saṃkhyā, nāpi śāstrīyā, tatkathaṃ tābhyāṃ ḍaṭpratyayaḥ, yatra paratastayostithugvidhīyate, ḍaṭi ca vidhānam‌? athātrottaramāha--`idameva' ityādi| yadetaḍḍaṭi paratastayostithuko vidhānametadeva jñāpayati--bhavati tābhyāṃ ḍaṭpratyaya iti| na hyasatastithugāgamaṃ prati nimittabhāva upapadyate|| 53. vatorathuk‌| (5.2.53) `yāvatithaḥ' iti| `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup‌' (5.2.39), `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91)|| 54. dvestīyaḥ| (5.2.54) `dviśabdāt‌ tīyapratyayo bhavati' iti| atha dviśabdāduttarasya ḍaṭastīyādeśaḥ kasmādeva na bhavati? jñāpakatvāt‌| yadayam‌ `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) iti ṭāpā nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--nāyamādeśa iti| yadyevamanenaiva siddhatvāt‌ pratyayavidhānamanarthakam‌? na; svarārthatvāt‌| nipātanāddhi prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ syāt‌| tīyapratyaye tu pratyayasvareṇa madhyodātto bhavati| kiñca, yadi pratyayo na vidhīyate `bādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti' (nī.pa.bṛ. 109) iti ḍaḍapi syāt‌| yadi punarayaṃ ḍaḍādeśaḥ syāt‌, tarhi kiṃ syāt‌? ḍaṭsvareṇa tīyaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ syāt‌, striyāṃ ca ṭittvānḍīp‌, tataśca dvitīyeti nirdeśo nopapadyate|| 55. treḥ samprasāraṇañca| (5.2.55) `aṇa iti tatra varttate' iti| `ḍhūlope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111) ityataḥ| nanu ca pareṇa ṇakāreṇāṇgrahaṇa ṛkāro'pyaṇ‌ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`pūrveṇa ca' ityādi| atra `trestu ca' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam‌? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum‌, evaṃ hyucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt‌ - kimayamādeśaḥ, utta pratyaya? iti|| 56. viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām‌| (5.2.56) `viṃśatyādibhyaḥ parasya' ityādi| nanu ca tīyapratyayena ḍaḍ‌ vyavahitaḥ, tatkathaṃ tamaḍāgamaḥ śakyo vijñātum‌? ata āha--`pūraṇādhikārāt‌' iti| pūraṇārthe yo vihitasatasya viṃśatyādibhyaḥ parasya tamaṅ‌vidhīyate, sa nānyo ḍaṭaḥ sambhavatīti ḍaḍeva vijñāyate| `viṃśātyādayo laukikāḥ saṃkhyāśabdā guhyante' iti| vyāpternyāyāt‌| te punarviśatyekaviṃśatiprabhṛtayaḥ saṃgṛhītā bhavanti| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadi paḍktyādisūtre (5.1.59) teṣāmasanniviṣṭatvāt‌| 57. nityaṃ śatādimāsārdhamāsasaṃvatsarācca| (5.2.57) `śatādigraṇam‌' ityādi| saṃkhyādibhyaḥ śatādibhyo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ śatādigrahaṇam‌| atha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā''rambhasāmarthyādeva nityo vidhirbhaviṣyati? bhavecchatādibhya ārambhasāmarthyādityevam‌| māsādibhyastvanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇātuvṛttervibhāṣā syāt‌| nanu cāsvaritatvādeva nivarttiṣyate'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam‌? vispaṣṭārtha tarhi nityagrahaṇam‌|| 58. ṣaṣṭyādeścāsaṃkhyādeḥ| (5.2.58) prākśatāt‌ ṣaṣṭyādāyo vijñeyāḥ| śatādīnāṃ svaśabdena tamaṭo vidhānāt‌|| 59. matau chaḥ sūktasāmnoḥ| (5.2.59) `matau' iti matvartha ucyate; sāhacaryāt‌| `matvarthena' ityādi| samarthavibhaktiḥ prathamā, prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam‌--astitvam‌, pratyayārthaḥ--asyāsminniti ca, sarvametanmatvarthagrahaṇena `ākṣipyate' iti| sannidhāpyate, upasthāpyata ityarthaḥ| yuktaṃ yanmatubgrahaṇe pratyayārtha ākṣipyate; tasya tadviṣayatvāt‌| samarthavibhaktyādi kathamākṣipyate? arthasāhacaryāt‌|| atha vā pradhānānuvṛttitvāddguṇānām‌, prādhānyena pratyayārtha upasthāpite pratyayasāmarthyāt‌ tadapi guṇabhūtamupasthāpyata eva| ihāsyavāmādiśabdo'nekapadāntatvādvākyam‌| vākyasya cārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti prātipadikasaṃjñā nāsti, atastebhyo na prāpnoti; aprātipadikatvāditi yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha-`anukaraṇaśabdāśca' ityādi| anukaraṇagrahaṇena ca vākyatvamasyavāmaprabhṛtīnāṃ nirasyati| na hyanukaraṇaśabdānāmavayavabhūtāni padāni santi, tatkutasteṣāṃ vākyatvam‌? yataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñā na syāt‌| `svarūpamātrapradhānāḥ' ityanenārthavattvaṃ teṣāṃ darśayati| anarthakatve hyarthavataḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāvidhānāt‌ prātipadikatvaṃ na syāt‌| tathā ca sa eva pratyayābhāvaḥ prasajyeta| mātraśabdo'rthāntaravyavacchedāya| svarūpamātraṃ pradhānamabhidheyaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| caśabdo yasmādarthe| yasmādanukaraṇaśabdāḥ svarūpamātrapradhānāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti, tenānekadādapi pratyayākhyaṃ kāryaṃ siddham‌; tasya prātipadikatvāt‌| aprātipadakatvañca vākyatvādanarthakatvādvā bhavet‌| na cāsyavāmaprabhṛtīnāṃ vākyatvam‌; anukaraṇaśabdatvāt‌| nāpyanarthakatvam‌; svarūpamātreṇārthavattvāt| yadi hyasyavāmetyādāvanukaraṇaśabdenānekāni padānyasyāvayavabhūtāni santi tatkathaṃ tenānekapadādapi siddhamityuktam‌? paraprasiddhyā padasya| asyavāmādayo'pyevam‌| eṣāmanekāvayavāḥ prasiddhāḥ; tasmāt‌ tatprasiddhyaivamuktam‌; na tu vidyamānānekapadatvāt‌| atha kathamanukaraṇaśabdāḥ svarūpamātrapradānā bhavanti, yāvatānukāryameva teṣāmabhidheyam‌, atastadeva pradhānasvarūpam‌? naitadasti; iha hi prathamāsamarthādastinā samānādhikaraṇāt‌ pratyayo vidhīyate| anukaraṇaśabdāścānukriyamāṇenārthenārthavanto'pi pratyavamṛṣṭā itikaraṇena śabdaśabdena vā prathamāsamarthāstisamānādhikaraṇā bhavanti| arthe hi guṇībhūtānāṃ prathamāsamarthatvamastyupādhikatvañca nopapadyate| tathā hyasyavāmo'sminnastītyukte'nukaraṇapratyāyitasyānukāryasyaiva śattdasya prathamāsamarthatvamastyupādhikatvañca gamyate, na tvanukaraṇaśabdasya| tasmāditikaraṇena śabdaśabdena vā'vaśyambhāvo pratyavamarśaḥ| asyavāma ityasminnastyavāmaśabdo vāsminnastīti bhedānukriyamāṇapadārthatā nivarttate, svarūpapadārthataivānujāyate| nanvevaṃ sati matvartho nopapadyate, anukāryā hyāmnāyaśabdāḥ sūktasāmnoḥ santi, na tu tadanukaraṇaśabdā laukikādayaḥ? naiṣa deṣaḥ; vākya svātantryahetoritikaraṇādeḥ sannidhau tena pratyavamṛśyamānā anukaraṇaśabdāḥ svarūpeṇārthavanto bhavanti, vṛttau tvanukāryeṇaiva; tatra svātantryahetoritikaraṇāderabhāvāt‌| vṛttāveva sūktasāmanī samatvarthavattayā vaktumiṣṭe, na vākya iti kimatra nopapadyate! asyavāmaśabdo'sminnastyasyavāmīyam‌| kayāṣubhāśabdo'sminnasti `kayāṣubhīyam‌'| yogaścāyaṃ matvarthīyānāmapavādaḥ|| 60. adhyāyānuvākayorluk‌| (5.2.60) anantarasūtre sūktasāmnoreva cchasya vihitatvāt‌ prakaraṇāntare ca kvacidadhyāyānuvākayośchasyāvidhānāt‌ pṛcchati--`kena punaḥ' ityādi| na hyasatastasya lugupapadyate, āha evāyaṃ lukam‌| ata etadeva lugvacanaṃ jñāpayati--adhyāyānuvākayośchasya vidhānamastīti| `vikalpena ca' ityādi| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe, vikalpenaivetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarvikalpena labhyate? `viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām‌' (5.2.56) ityanyarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| yadyevam‌, pūrvatrāpi vikalpena vidhiḥ prāpnoti? bhaṇḍkaplutinyāyenānuvṛttirbhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ|| 61. vimuktādibhyo'ṇ‌| (5.2.61) pūrveṇa cche tasya ca pakṣe luki prāpte vimuktādibhyo'ṇvidhīyate|| 62. goṣadādibhyo vun‌| (5.2.62) `adhyāyānuvākayorluk‌' (5.2.60) iti cchasya ca luki prāpte goṣadādibhyo vunārabhyate|| 63. tatra kuśalaḥ pathaḥ| (5.2.63) `kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ' (4.3.38) ityaṇi prāpte vun‌ vidhīyate|| 64. ākarṣādibhyaḥ kan‌| (5.2.64) ākarṣādiṣu yad‌vṛddhaṃ tataśche prāpte śeṣebhyastvaṇi kanvidhīyate| pratyayāntarakaraṇam‌--yadatrokārāntaṃ tasyātra guṇo mā bhūt‌, yaccekārāntaṃ tasya `yasyeti' (6.4.148) lopo mā bhūdityevamartham‌| vuni tu sati tadubhayaṃ prasajyeta| tata punarihāśiṣṭaṃ prasajyeta| tasya punarvani kani vā sati na kaścidviśeṣa iti na tatpratyayāntaraṃ prayojayati|| 65. dhanahiraṇyātkāme| (5.2.65) `dhane kāmaḥ' iti| dhanaviṣaya icchetyarthaḥ|| 66. svāṅgebhyaḥ prasite| (5.2.66) `prasite' iti| yadyapi sinotirayaṃ `ṣiñ‌ bandhane' (dhā. pā. 1477) iti bandhane paṭhyate, tathāpyanekārthatvādihāsaktau varttate| `keśeṣu prasitaḥ' iti| `prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca' (2.3.44) iti saptamī| āsaktiśca kriyāviṣayo dharma iti keśādisthānabalā kriyā keśādiśabdenocyate| ata evāha--`keśādiracanāyāṃ prasakta evamucyate' iti| `bahuvacanaṃ svāṅgasamudāyādapi yathā syāt‌' iti| asati hi tasmin‌, yathā janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena na gṛhyate, tathā svāṅgasamudāyo'pi svāṅgrahaṇena neti svāṅgasamudāyānna syāt‌, tasmiṃstu sati bhavati; anyathā tasya prayojanābhāvāt‌| svarūpavidhinirāsastasya prayojanamiti cet‌? na; `adravam‌' (kāśikā 4.1.54) ityādinā svāṅgasya paribhāṣitatvena svarūpavidherasambhavāt‌|| 67. udarāṭṭhagādyūne| (5.2.67) pūrveṇa kani prāpte ṭhagvidhīyate| `ādyūno'vijigīṣuḥ' iti| `vivo'vijigīṣāyām‌' (8.2.49) ityavijigīṣāyāmeva vivo niṣṭhātakārasya natvavidhānāt‌| `udarakaḥ' pūrveṇa kanena bhavati|| 68. sasyena parijātaḥ| (5.2.68) `sasyena iti sahayogalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā, itthambhūtalakṣaṇe vā| `sasyaśabdo'yaṃ guṇavācī' iti| sasyaśabdo hyayaṃ dhānyavacano'pyasti, yathā--śāliḥ sasyam‌, yavāḥ sasyamiti; tasya grahaṇaṃ mā vijñāyītyevamarthamidamuktam‌--`idamabhidhānam‌' iti| sasyaka ityetat‌ kanpratyāntam‌|| 69. aśaṃ hārī| (5.2.69) `karmaṇi dvitīyaiva bhavati' iti| karmaṇi dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ kṛdyogalakṣaṇā tadapavādā ṣaṣṭhyārabhyate| tasyāścāvaśyake ṇinipratyaye `akenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayoḥ' (2.3.70) iti pratiṣedhaḥ| tena nirapavādād‌dvitīyaiva bhavati|| 70. tantrādacirāpahṛte| (5.2.70) `acirāpahṛtam‌' iti| aciraśabdo'lpakālavacanaḥ, tasyāpahṛtaśabdenāpahṛto gataḥ kālo'syeti `kālāḥ parimāṇinā' (2.2.5) iti samāsaḥ| `pañcamīsamarthāt‌' iti| nirdeśādeva| na hīha kācit‌ prakṛtā vibhaktiranuvarttate, pañcamīnirdeśaśca śruyate, tasmānnirdeśādeva pañcamīsamarthāt‌ pratyayo vijñāyate| sā punaḥ pañcamyapaharaterapāyavacanatvāt‌ tadyogena tantramapādānameva bhavatītyapādānalakṣaṇā veditavyā|| 71. brāhmaṇakoṣṇike saṃjñāyām‌| (5.2.71) kimarthaṃ punarivam‌, yāvatā saṃjñāyāṃ vyutpādyate, saṃjñāyāmeva tu brāhmaṇakoṣṇike? na; viṣayāntare'pi| tameva viṣayaṃ darśayitumāha--`yatra' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 72. śītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi| (5.2.72) `kriyāviśeṣaṇāt‌' iti| kriyāviśeṣaṇasya hi karmatvaṃ pratipāditam‌| `kāriṇi' iti| tācchīlye ṇiniḥ| tasya ca prayoge ṣaṣṭhī pratiṣiddhā, tasmāt‌ karmaṇi dvitīyayaiva bhavitavyam‌| kriyāviśeṣaṇācchītādiśabdād‌dvitīyāsamarthātpratyayo vijñāyate| tena neha śotoṣṇaśabdo sparśaviṣaye varttamānau pratyayamutpādayataḥ| kva tarhi? māndye, śaighrye ca; yasmādāvaśyake ṇiniḥ| na sa padārtho'sti yaḥ śītoṣṇasparśau niyogataḥ karoti| tuṣārātapāvapi hi nāvaśyaṃ kurutaḥ; pratibandhasambhavāt‌| karttṛśaktistu padārthānāṃ niyateti sā śaktiḥ karttṛtve kaścinniyogato mandaṃ karoti, kaścit‌ śīghramiti yujyata evāvaśyakatvam‌|| 73. adhikam‌| (5.2.73) `adhyārūḍhaśabdasyottarapadalopaḥ' iti| uttarapadamārūḍhaśabdastasya lopo nipātyate| kathaṃ punaradhiko droṇaḥ khāryāmityasya prathamāntasya droṇaśabdasya prayogaḥ, adhikā khārī droṇeneti tṛtīyāntasya ca? ityata āha--`karttari karmaṇi ca' ityādi| `gatyarthakarmakaśliṣa' (3.4.72) ityādinā sūtreṇa ruheḥ karttari karmaṇi ca kto vihitaḥ, tena karttari karttari karmaṇi cādhyarūḍhaśabdo varttate, tataśca tasyārthe vyutpādyamāno'dhikaśabdo'pi tatparyāyo bhavaṃstayorevārthayorbhavati| tatra yadā karttari varttate tadā droṇaśabdāt‌ prathamā bhavati, na tṛtīyā| yadā karmaṇi varttate tadā kartturanabhihitatvādadhikaśabdena droṇaśabdāt‌ tṛtīyā bhavati| karmaṇastvabhihitatvāt‌ khārīśabdāt‌ prathamaiva bhavati, na dvitīyā| `adhikā khārī droṇena' iti| nanu cādhiko droṇaḥ khāryāmasyāmityatra karmaṇo'nabhihitatvāt‌ khārīśabdād‌dvitīyā prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayam‌ `yasmādadhikam‌ (2.3.9) `tadasminnadhikam‌' (5.2.45) iti ca nirdeśaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati--adhikaśabdena yoge pañcamīsaptamyāveva vibhaktī bhavata iti|| 74. anukābhikābhīkaḥ kamitā| (5.2.74) `anukaḥ' iti| anuśabdāt‌ kan‌| `abhiko'bhīkaḥ' iti| atrāpyabhiśabdāt‌|| 75. pārśvenānvicchati| (5.2.75) nirdeśādeva tṛtīyāsamarthavibhaktirlabhyata ityāha--`pārśvaśabdāt‌ tṛtīyāsamarthāt‌' iti|| 76. ayaḥśūladaṇḍājinābhyāṃ ṭhakṭhañau| (5.2.76) `ayaḥśūladaṇḍājinābhyām‌' iti| tṛtīyāntanirdeśādevārthāt‌ tṛtīyā samarthavibhaktilaṃbhyata ityāha--`tṛtīyāsamarthātabhyām‌ iti|| 77. tāvatithaṃ grahaṇamiti lugvā| (5.2.77) pūraṇapratayayāntānāṃ sāmānyanirdeśo'yam‌| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśe svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavatītyuktam‌| kathaṃ pratyayaḥ svārthe bhavatīti? anirdiṣṭārthāḥ pratyayāḥ svārthe bhavantīti (pu. pa. pā. 90) kṛtvā| `dvikaṃ, trikam‌' iti| tīyasya luk‌| `catuṣkam‌' iti| pūraṇapratyayasya ḍaṭaḥ sathukaśca luk‌, catūrephasya `visarjanīyasya saḥ (8.3.34), tasya `idupadhasya cāpratyayasya' (8.3.41), iti ṣatvam‌| `tāvatithena' ityādi| pūraṇapratyāntāt‌ prātipadikāt‌ tṛtīyāsamarthādgṛhṇātītyetasminnarthe kanpratyayo bhavatīti vaktavyam‌| pūraṇapratyayasya ca nityaṃ luk‌| `ṣaṭkaḥ' iti| ṣakārasya jaśtavaṃ ḍakāraḥ, tasyāpi cartva ṭakāraḥ| atra ca ḍaṭaḥ sathuko luk‌| `pañcakaḥ' iti| atrāpi ḍaṭaḥ| atheha kasmānna bhavatīti--dvitīyena hastena daṇḍaṃ gṛhṇāti? ityāha--`itikaraṇo vivakṣārthaḥ' ityādi| suboṣam‌|| 78. sa eṣāṃ grāmaṇīḥ| (5.2.78) 79. śṛṅkhalamasya bandhanaṃ karabhe| (5.2.79) nanu ca na śṛṅkhalamātreṇa karabho badhyate, kiṃ tarhi? rajjavādikena ca, tatkathaṃ śṛṅkhalaṃ bandhanamucyate? ityāha--`yadyapi' ityādi| yadyapi tatra rajjvādikamapyaparamasti, tathāpi śṛṅkhalamasya tantrīkaraṇaṃ prati sādhanaṃ bhavatyeva, na hi tena tadbhavati| tataḥ śṛṅkhalaṃ bandhanamucyate| rajjvādikamapi yadi bandhanaṃ bhavati, bhavatu! na hyatrāvadhāryate--śṛṅkhalameveti|| 80. utka unmangaḥ| (5.2.80) `sasādhanakriyāvacanāt‌' iti| sādhanam‌-manaḥ; kriyā-gamanam‌; saha tena gamanakriyā| tadvacanāt‌ sasādhane gamane varttamānādityarthaḥ| `tadvati' iti| tacchabdena kriyā pratyavamṛśyate| sasādhanakriyāvatītyarthaḥ| `utsukaḥ' iti| utkaṣṭita ityarthaḥ|| 81. kālaprayojanādroge| (5.2.81) `arthalabhyā' ityādi| artho'dhikaraṇādiḥ| tenātra saptamīprabhṛtiranuktāpi samarthavibhaktirlabhyate| `prayojanaṃ kāraṇaśabdenovyate kālagrahaṇaṃ pṛthaṅna kartavyam‌, kālo'pi rogasya kāraṇaṃ bhavati? naitadasti; na hyavaśyaṃ kālo rogasya kāraṇaṃ bhavati| tatra yadā hyasau rogasya kāraṇaṃ na bhavati, tathāpi tato yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kālagrahaṇam‌| `dvitoye'hni bhavo dvitīyakaḥ' iti| tatra kāraṇāntarādvātādeḥ kutaścidbhavato jvarasya kālaḥ kevalamadhikaraṇabhāvena vivakṣitaḥ, na tu hetubhāvena| kathaṃ punaḥ kālādanyataḥ pratyayo dvitīyādibhyaḥ śabdebhyo bhavati, na hyete kālaśabdāḥ prasiddhāḥ, sāmānyaśabdā hyete, śabdāntarasannidhānāt‌ tu kāle vṛttireṣāṃ gamyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vākye hyeṣāṃ śabdāntarasannidhau kali vṛttiḥ, vṛttigataśca prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyayānāṃ viśeṣaṇam‌; sannihitatvāt‌| na vākyagataḥ; viprakarṣāt‌| `viṣapuṣpairjanitaḥ' iti| tṛtīyā| `uṣṇaṃ kāryamasya' iti| atra kāryakāraṇasambandho vivakṣitaḥ| sa cedaṃśabdādevotpannayā ṣaṣṭyābhihita ityuṣṇaśabdāt‌ prathamaiva bhavati| iha kālaprayojanaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ pratyayo'bhihitaḥ, na kālaprayojanaśabdābhyām‌; kālaviśeṣavācibhyo bhavan‌ kriyāyāḥ kartari jvare prayojanaviśeṣavācibhyaḥ prayojanamiti; kāryakāraṇavivakṣāyāñca kāryasambandhini| na cāyaṃ prakāraniyamaḥ sūtre uktaḥ, tatkathaṃ labhyate? ityata āha--`uttarasūtrādiha saṃjñāgrahaṇamapakṛṣyate' iti| tena tasmin‌ satyayamartho bhavati--pratyayāntaścet‌ saṃjñā bhavati, tasmiṃścārthe sati pratyayāntaṃ yadi saṃjñā bhavatyevaṃ pratya utpadyate, nānyatheti| saṃjñāgrahaṇasannidhānādiha sarvaprakāro'yaṃ niyamo labhyate| na hi vinā tena prakārema pratyayāntaṃ saṃjñā bhavati| nanu cottarasūtre saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva śeṣabhūtam‌, tatkathaṃ tato'pakraṣṭa śakyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ubhayorapi yogayostaccheṣabhūtam‌| katham‌? yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate-- `tadasminnannaṃ prāye' tataḥ `saṃjñāyām‌' iti; tena saṃjñāgrahaṇamubhayeṣāṃ śeṣo vijñāsyate|| 82. tadasminnannaṃ prāye saṃjñāyām‌| (5.2.82) `annaṃ cetprāyaviṣayam' iti| prāyo viṣayo yasya tattathoktam| viṣayagrahaṇe `prāye' iti saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayi| `pratyayo bhavati' iti| anyathā guḍāpūpāḥ prāyeṇānnamiti vavakṣāyāḥ kārakāṇi bhavantītiprāyasya viṣayabhūtasya karaṇatvena vivakṣitatvāt tṛtīyā| `guḍāpūpikā' iti `pratyayasthāt kāt pūrvasyātaḥ' (7.3.44) itīttvam| `vaṭakebhya inirvaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam--iha saṃjñāgrahaṇasya pratyayāntopādhikatvādyatra pratyayāntaṃ saṃjñā bhavati tatra pratyayena bhavitavyam| na ca vaṭakaśabdaḥ kanpratyayāntaḥ kasyacit saṃjñā, tena tataḥ kan na bhaviṃṣyati tarsmiścāsati matvarthīya inirbhaviṣyatīti| `vaṭakino' iti| `ṛmnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5)|| 83. kulmāṣādañ| (5.2.83) saṃjñāgrahaṇena pūrveṇa kanaḥ prāptāvasatyāṃ vākyenābhidhāne prāpte matvarthīye matubādāvidamucyate| `vkaulmāṇī' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp|| 84. śrotriyam̐śchando'dhīte| (5.2.84) `nakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| nanu ca nakāra id yasya tarsminniti parataḥ svara ucyate, na ca samudāyānubandhe nakāre nitparatvamasti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na evet nit, tatpuruṣo'yam| tena nakāra itsaṃjñe parataḥ pūrvasya svaro bhaviṣyati| kiṃ punaratra nipātyate? ityāha--`chando'dhīte' iti| asya vākyasyārthe śrotriṃyanniti nipātyate| `chandaso vā' ityādi| pūrvatra vākyārthe padamavidyamānaprakṛtipratyayavibhāgaṃ nipātitam; idānīṃ tu prakṛtipratyayau nipātyete tadavīta ityasminnarthe| atra yadyapi nidita bahuvrīhiḥ, tathāpi svaraḥ sidhyatyeva; ghanpratyayasya nitaḥ parasya vidyamānatvāt| `katham‌' ityādi| yadi cchabdaḥśabdasya śrotraśabda ādeśo ghaṃśca pratyayaḥ `tadadhīte' ityasminnarthe nipātyate, nipātanena bādhitatvādatrārthe cchāndasa iti na siṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ|| 85. śrāddhamanena bhuktaminiṭhanau| (5.2.85) `śrāddhaśabda' ityādi| śāstroktena vidhinā niṣpādyasya kasyaciveva kriyāviśeṣasya śrāddhaśabdaḥ saṃjñā| karmaśabdo'yaṃ kriyāvācī| śraddhā yatra karmaṣyasti tacchrāddham‌, `prajñāśraddhārcāvṛttibhyo ṇaḥ' (5.2.101) iti ṇapratyayaḥ| `tatsādhane' ityādi| bhūktatvaṃ karmaṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ na sambhavatīti tatsādhane bhavatādau varttitvā śrāddhaṃ pratayayamutyādayatīti vijñāyate| tatsādhāne tu tasya vṛttiḥ, tādarthyāt‌; yathā--pradīpārthāyāṃ mallikāyāṃ pradīyapaśabdasya| `samānakālagrahaṇam‌' iti| samānaḥ kālo gṛhyate yena tatsamānakālagrahaṇam‌| vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| kimartham‌? ityāha--`adya bhukte' ityādi| yasminnahani śrāddhamanena bhuktaṃ tasminneva śrāddhika iti syāt‌ṣa adya bhakte śvo mā bhūdityevamartham‌| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--ihāpi vetyanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena yasminnevāhani śrāddhaṃ bhuktaṃ tasminneveṣyate; nānyatreti|| 86. pūrvādiniḥ| (5.2.86) `pūrva gataṃ pītaṃ bhūktam‌' iti| pūrvaśabdo'tra kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt‌ karma bhavatīti dvitīyāsamarthāt‌ pratyayo vijñāyate| `pūrvo' iti| `sau ca' (6.4.13) iti dīrghaḥ|| 87. sapūrvācca| (5.2.87) sahaśabdo vidyamānavacanaḥ| ata evāha--`vidyamānaṃ pūrvam‌' iti| `vopasarjanasya' (6.3.72) iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| `kṛtapūrvo kaṭamiti' nanu ca niṣṭhyā karmaṇo'bhihitatvād‌dvitīyā'tara na prāpanoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; neyaṃ karmaṇi niṣṭhā, kiṃ tarhi? bhāve| yadāpi karmaṇi tadāpi na doṣaḥ; niṣṭhayā hi sāmānyaṃ karmābhihitam‌, na viśeṣakarma| tasmādviśeṣakarmaṇo'nabhihitatvād‌dvitīyā bhaviṣyati| nanu ca pūrvaṃ kṛtamityanekapadāvayavatvācca vākyamidam‌| vākyasya cārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti prātipadikasaṃjñā nāsti| tatkathamataḥ pratyayaḥ? ityāha--`supsupā' ityādi| `yogadvayena ca' ityādi| yadi `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' (śāka. pa. 65) ityeṣā paribhāṣā na syāt‌ tadā `sapūrvātpūrvādiniḥ' ityekayogaṃ kuryāt‌ kiṃ yogavibhāgena! ekayoge hi sati kevalādapi vyapadeśivadbhāvena pratyayo bhaviṣyati| tadevamekayogena siddhe yat‌ `pūrvādiniḥ' (5.2.86) iti pṛthagyogaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--astīyaṃ paribhāṣā `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātipadikena' (śāka. pa. 65) iti| yadi vā `grahaṇavatā' (vyā. pa. 89) ityādikā paribhāṣā na syāt‌ `sapūrvācca' itīmaṃ yogaṃ na kuryāt‌| `pūrvādiniḥ' (5.2.86) ityanenaiva hi kṛtapūrvītyādāvapi bhaviṣyati tadantavidhinā| tadeyaṃ pūrvayogeṇaiva pūrvaśabdādapi siddhe pratyaye yat‌ `sapūrvācca' itīmaṃ yogaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati--astīyaṃ paribhāṣā `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirna bhavati' (vyā. pa. 89) iti|| 88. iṣṭādibhyaśca| (5.2.88) `iṣṭo yajñe' iti| kathaṃ punaratra sapatamī; yāvatā yajñasya karmatāyāṃ dvitīyayā bhavitavyam‌? ityāha--`ktasyenviṣayasya' ityādi| 89. chandasi paripanthiparipariṇau paryavasthātari| (5.2.89) kiṃ punaratrevaṃ nipātyate? paryavasthātṛśabdaṃ vyavasthāpya tadavayavasyāvasthātṛśabdasya pamtha ādeśa ekatra kriyate, aparatra tasyaiva pariśabdaḥ, paścādinipratyayaḥ|| 90. anupadyenveṣṭā| (5.2.90) `anupadī' iti| paścāt‌ padasyānupadam‌, paścādarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| tasmādinipratyayo nipātyate|| 91. sākṣāddraṣṭari saṃjñāyām‌| (5.2.91) `saṃjñāgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| viśiṣṭa evābhidhadheye pratyayāntasya vṛttirabhidheyaniyamaḥ' (vā. 802) iti ṭilopaḥ| `saṃjñagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| asati hi saṃjñāgrahaṇe yathograhaṇe yathopadraṣṭā sākṣiśabdenocyate, tathā dātā grahītā cocyeyātām‌, etāvapi hi draṣṭārau bhavata eva| saṃjñāgrahaṇādupadraṣṭaivocyate| dātṛgrahītṛbhyāṃ yo'nyo draṣṭā samīpe sa upadraṣṭā| nanu ca `svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣi' (2.3.39) iti nipātanādeva sākṣiśabdaḥ sādhurbhāviṣyati, abhidheyaniyamo'pi laukikatvādasya padasya lokokta eva vijñāsyate, tadapārthakamidam‌? naitadasti; na hi tasmin‌ nipātane sākṣiśabdasya nakārāntatā śakyate vyavasātum, pramāṇābhāvāt‌| loke na svābhidheye pratīyamāne pratipattigauravaṃ syāt| tasmānnakārāntatāpratipattigauravaparihārārthaṃ cedamucyate|| 92. kṣetriyac‌ parakṣetre cikitsyaḥ| (5.2.92) cikitsya iti śakyārthe kṛtyaḥ| `vākyārthe' ityādi| `parakṣetre cikitsyaḥ' ityasya vākyasyārthe kṣetriya ityetat‌ padavacanamavidyamānaprakṛtipratyayavibhāgaṃ nipātyate| cakāro'ntodāttārthaḥ| `parakṣetrādvā' ityādi| vāśabdaḥ prakārāntaraṃ dyotayati| atha vā--parakṣetraśabdāt‌ tatreti saptamīsamarthāt‌ cikisya ityatrārthe pratyayo nipātyate, paraśabdasya ca lopaḥ| `parakṣetraṃ janmāntaraśarīram‌' iti| ihatyāccharīrādanyatvādasādhya ityanena paraśabdasyārthaṃ darśayati| sasyārthaṃ hi yat‌ kṣetraṃ saṃskṛtaṃ tadanutpādyatvāt‌ tṛṇānāṃ parakṣetraṃ bhavati| `sarvaṃ caitat‌ pramāṇam‌' iti| sarvasyācāryeṇa pratipāditatvatāt‌|| 93. indriyamindraliṅgamindradṛṣṭamindrasṛṣṭamindrajuṣṭamindradattamiti vā| (5.2.93) `rūḍhireṣā' ityanenanāvayavārthaṃ tyājayati| kathaṃ punarjāyate rūḍhireṣā? ityāha--`tathā ca' ityādi| yadyeṣā rūḍhirna syāt‌, vyutpatteraniyamo na syāt‌; arūḍhiśabdeṣu niyatatvādeva tadarthasya| rūḍhiśabde tvasmin‌ yujyate vyutpatteraniyamaḥ| rūḍhiśabdānāṃ hi yathākathañcidvyutpattiḥ kriyate parikalpitenāvayavārthena| kathaṃ punarātmā cakṣurādinā karaṇena śakyo'numātum‌? ityāha--`nākarttṛkam‌' ityādi| anenāvinābhāvaṃ darśayati| itikaraṇao hetau| yasmāt‌ karaṇādīnāṃ pravṛttirnivṛttirvā kartradhīnā, tasmādyatra tāni tatrāvaśyaṃ kartrā bhavitavyam‌| cakṣurādinā karaṇenāvinā bhāvenāliṅgenātmā'numīyate| kathaṃ punastadātmanā sevitam‌? ityāha--`taddvāreṇa' ityādi| dvārema hi viṣayeṣvātmano jñānamutpadyate| tasmādviṣayān‌ jñātumātmā cakṣurādīnadriyaṃ sevate| `yathāyatham‌ iti| yathāsvam‌| yo yasyendriyasya viṣayastat‌ tasmai dattam‌| `itikaraṇaḥ prakārārthaḥ' iti| evaṃ prakārāntareṇāpi vyutpattiḥ kart‌tavyetyetaditikaraṇaḥ prakārarthaṃ dyotayati ata evāha--`sat sambhave' ityādi| indreṇa viṣayā nīyante sambadhyanta itīndriyamityevamādikā sati sambhave tathā vyutpattiḥ karttavyā| `vāśabdaḥ' ityādi| asati hi vāśabde `indraliṅgam' ityevamādīnāṃ vikalpaprakārāṇā pāratantryaṃ vijñāyeta| parasparāpekṣāyā samuccitāyā eva vyutpatteḥ kāraṇamiti| vāśabdastavindraliṅgamitīndradṛṣṭamiti cetyevaṃ sambadhyamānasteṣāṃ svātantryaṃ darśayati| tenaikaikaḥ prakāraḥ prakārāntaranirapekṣo vyutpattādaṅgabhāvamupayāti|| 94. tadasyāstyasminniti matup‌| (5.2.94) `pratyayārtho' iti| nanu ca yad‌ yasya bhavati tata tasminnasti, yadyasminnasti tat‌ tasya bhavati, yathā--vṛkṣe śākhā, vṛkṣasya śākheti; tatrānyataranirdeśenaiva siddham‌, tatkimarthaṃ dvau nirdiśyete? naitadasti; na hi ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyarthayoravaśyambhāvo samāveśaḥ, tathā hi gāvo gaṅgāyāṃ bhavanti, na ca te tasyāḥ; tathā deśāntaragato'pi putro devadattasya ca bhavati, na cāsau tatra| tasmādubhāvapi nirdeṣṭavyau| `astīti prakṛtiviśeṣaṇam‌' iti| nanu ca sambhave vyabhicāre ca viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo bhavati nīlotpalavat‌, na cāstitvasya vyabhicāro'sti, yathoktam‌--`na sattāṃ padār‌tho vyabhicarati' iti| tasyā vyavacchedyābhāvādapārthakamidaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌? naitadasti; viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādeva viśiṣṭaiva sattā viśeṣaṇatvenopāttā, na sattāmātramiti pratīyate| sā punarviśiṣṭasattā sappratisattaiva| asti ca tasyā vyabhicāra iti prasajyata eva viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ sampratisattā viśeṣaṇatvenopāttā? tasyāmeva pratyayo yathā syāt‌ bhūtabhaviṣyatsattāyāṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌| tena gāvo'syāsan‌, gāvo'sya bhavitāra ityatar na bhavati| nanu ca gomānāsīta, gomān‌ bhaviteti bhūtabhaviṣyatsattāyāṃ matupaṃ vidhāya kathaṃ prayujyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, dhātusambandhe'yathākāloktānāmapi pratyayānāṃ sādhutvavidhānādevaṃ prayujyace; na bhūtabhaviṣyatsattāyāṃ pratyayavidhānāt‌| `astyarthopādhikaṃ cedbhavatītyarthaḥ' iti| vartmānasattāviśiṣṭaṃ yadi tatra bhavatītyarthaḥ| `gomān‌' iti| `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌| halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrdhaḥ| `vṛkṣa vān‌' iti `mādupadhāyāśca' (8.2.9) ityādinā vatvam‌| `viṣayaniyamaḥ' iti| viṣaye pratyayasya bhāvo viṣayaniyamaḥ| sa punarviśiṣṭaviṣayo bhūmādiriti darśayannāha--`bhūmanindā' ityādi| bahorbhāvo bhūmā| `pṛthvādibhya imanic‌' (5.1.222) itīmanic‌| `bahorlopo bhū ca vahoḥ' (6.4.158) iti bhūbhāvaḥ, ikāralopaśca| gāvo bahavo'sya santīti gomān‌| ekasya dvayorvā vidyamānatve'pi gomāniti na vyapadiśyate| nindāyāṃ-kakudāvarttīti| niṣphalatvānninditaḥ| praśaṃsāyām‌--praśastaṃ rūpaṃ yasyāsti rahūpavānityucyate| nityayoge-kṣīrameṣāmastīti kṣīriṇo vṛkṣāḥ| nityaḥ kṣīrasambandho yeṣāṃ ta ucyante| `atiśāyane udariṇī kanyā' iti| yasyā atiśayenodaramasti saivamucyate| `saṃsarge daṇḍī' iti| daṇḍasaṃsarga ucyate| teneha gṛhasthite vidyamāne'pi daṇḍe daṇḍīti nābhidhīyate|| 95. rasādibhyaśca| (5.2.95) `anyanivṛttyartham‌' iti| anyasyeniprabhṛtermatvarthīyasya nivṛttirarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tattathoktam‌| `katham‌' ityādi| rasādibhyaḥ punarvacanamanyanivṛttyartham‌| tato rūpiṇī kanyetyādi na sidhyatīti bhāvaṛḥ| `prāyikam‌' ityādi| anyanivṛtterbāhulyenārthaḥ--so'syāstīti prāyikameva yuktaṃ bhavatīti| bāhulyenāsyānyanivṛttitvena rūpaṇītyādau kvacidanyo'pi bhavatīti kathaṃ punarasya prāyikatvaṃ labhyate? ityāha--`itikaraṇaḥ' ityādi| itikaraṇaśceha vivakṣārtho'nuvartte| tena yatadra tu matubantādeva lokasya vivakṣā bhavati, tatra tenānyanivṛttiḥ kriyate; na sarvatra| `atha vā' ityādi| parihārāntaram‌| ādiśabdena cakṣurādīndriyaparigrahaḥ| guṇāditi gaṇe paṭhyate| ca guṇagrahaṇaṃ sarveṣāmeva rasādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam‌| tena ye rasanādīndriyagrāhyāḥ| `teṣāmevāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ' iti| guṇavacanāntebhyo rasanādīndriyagrāhyebhyo'nyanivṛttiranena kriyate, nānyebhya-| syādetat--rūpiṇītyādāvapīndriyagrahyā ye guṇāstebhyo matvarthīya utpannaḥ? ityāha--`rūpiṇo, rūpikaḥ` ityādi| rūpiṇī, rūpika ityatra śobhāguṇo gamyate, na cakṣurgrāhyeṇa rūpeṇa| `rasiko naṭaḥ' ityatrāpi bhāvaguṇo gamyate, na tu rasanendriyagrāhyeṇa guṇena| bhāvāḥ śṛṅgāravīrabībhatsādayo racanādharmāḥ| `ekācaḥ' iti| ekākṣarāditi| eko'j‌ yasya tasmānmatubeva bhavatīti--dhīmān‌, svavāniti|| 96. prāṇisthādato lajanyatarasyām‌| (5.2.96) `kaṇikālaḥ' iti| kaṇikādiśabdo'yaṃ prāṇyaṅgasya vācakaḥ, nālaṅkāraviśeṣasya| prāṇyaṅgādeva hīṣyate, ata āha--`prāṇyaṅgāditi vaktavyam‌' iti| prāṇyaṅgatvādevākārāntallajbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--itikaraṇo vivakṣārtho'nuvarttate| tena prāṇyaṅgadeva bhaviṣyatīti, nānyasmāt‌| anabhidhānādvā'prāṇyaṅgānna bhaviṣyatīti| nanu caikāco lacaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvaṃ siddham‌, tatkimarthaṃ cakāraḥ? ityāha--`pratyayasvareṇaiva' ityādi| cūḍālaśabdāt‌ prathamaikavacanāntāt‌ parato'siśabde vyavasthite tasya `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighātaḥ, soḥ `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66) iti rutvam‌, `ato roraplutādaplute' (6.1.113) ityutvam‌,`ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), tasya ca `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) ityudāttatvam‌, `eṅaḥ padāntādati' (6.1.109) iti pararūpamekādeśaḥ| asati tu vakāre `svarito vānudātte'padādau' (8.2.6) iti svaritaḥ syāt‌| atastadbādhanārtha cakāraḥ kriyate|| 97. sidhmādibhyaśca| (5.2.97) yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena lajvikalpeta, tena pakṣe yathāprāptameva syādityakārāntāt‌ sidhmāderiniṭhanau syātām‌| ata imaṃ doṣaṃ parihartumāha--`anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena' ityādi| anekārthatvānnipātānāmanyatarasyāmiha samuccate varttate| tathā ca vārtikakāreṇoktam‌--`anyatarasyāmiti samuccayaḥ' iti| matubiha svaritatvāt‌ sannihita iti sa eva samuccīyate, na tu yathāprāptaṃ pratyayāntaramityeke| anye tvāhuḥ--`anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthameva| na ceniṭhanāvubhau kriyete; tayormahāvibhāṣayaiva siddhatvāt‌| tarhi pratyayāntaraṃ pakṣe vidhīyate? tadapi na; yathāprāptamāpādayittuṃ sannihitapratyāsatteḥ matubeva| tadevamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇe sati matubeva vikalpyata ityabhiprāyeṇānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena samuccīyata ityuktam‌' iti| `na tu pratyayo vikalpyate' iti| nanu ca laco bhāvābhāvau kriyete ityarthaḥ| `tasmāt‌' ityādi| yata evamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena matup‌ samuccīyate, na tu pratyayo vikalpyate, tasmādye'trākārāntāḥ paṭhyante tebhya iniṭhanau na bhavataḥ| `pārṣṇiśramanyordīrghaśca' iti| pārṣṇi, dhamani iti śabdābhyāṃ lajbhavati, tayośca dīrghaḥ--pārṣṇīlaḥ, dhamanīlaḥ| `vātadantabalalalāṭānāmūṅ ca' iti| vātādīnāṃ, tasya ca laca ūṅagagamaḥ| vātūlaḥ| dantūlaḥ| balūlaḥ| lalāṭūlaḥ| `jaṭāghaṭākalāḥ kṣepe' gamyamāne| jaṭālaḥ, ghaṭālaḥ, kalālaḥ| kṣepa iti kim‌? jaṭāvān‌| `kṣudrajantūpatāpācca' iti| kṣudrajantūpatāpācca' iti| kṣudrajantuḥ-nakulādiḥ| upatāpaḥ-rogaḥ|| 98. vatsāṃsābhyāṃ kāmabale| `kāmavati balavati cārthe' iti| matvantayornirdeśena kāmabaśabdāvarśaādyakārāntāvupāttāviti darśayati| nanu ca vatsāṃsaśabdau naiva kāmabalayorvartete, kiṃ tarhi? vayoviśeṣe prāṇyaṅgaviśeṣe ca, tatkathaṃ tābhyāṃ kāmavān‌ balavāṃścocyate? ityāha--`vṛttiviṣaye' ityādi| kathametajjñāyate? ityāha--`na hyatra' ityādi| vatsaśabdasya vākye yo vayoviśeṣalakṣaṇo'rthaḥ prasiddhaḥ, aṃsaśabdasya ca yaḥ prāṇyaṅgalakṣaṇaviṣayaḥ sa yasmādatra vṛttau na vidyate na jñāyata ityarthaḥ| atha vā--na vidyata iti nāstītyarthaḥ| anena vākye yau tayorathā prasiddhau vayaḥprāṇyaṅgaviśeṣātmakau, tayorvṛttāvabhāvo darśitaḥ| idānīṃ yau tayorabhimatāvartho tayorbhāvaṃ darśayitumāha--`vatsalaḥ' ityādi| `snehavān‌' iti| kāmavānityarthaḥ| tadevaṃ yasmādvatsāṃsaśabdayorvākye vayaḥprāṇyaṅgalakṣaṇo'rtho na vidyate, tataścavatsalāṃsalaśabdābhyāṃ yathoktaḥ snehavān‌ balavāṃścocyate, tato jñāyate--vatsāṃsaśabdau vṛttiviṣaye kāmabalayorvarttamānau tadvati pratyayamutpādayata iti| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ sarvatra cātra prakaraṇe matupsamuccayārthe varttate| tato matupā bhavitavyamiti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha--`na cāyam‌' ityādi| anenaiva ca hetunā vākyamapi na bhavatīti veditavyam‌| vkāye hi naivāyamarthaḥ sambhavati 99. phenādilacca| (5.2.99) 100. lomādipāmādipicchādibhyaḥ śanelacaḥ| (5.2.100) pāmādiṣu `aṅgāt‌' iti paṭhyate, tatra kalyāṇagrahaṇamaṅgaviśeṣaṇam‌| kalyāṇāni śobhanānyaṅgānyasyāḥ santītyaṅganā| kalyāma iti kim‌? aṅgavatī| `śīkīpalālīdadravāṃ hrasvatvañca' iti| śākyādīnāñca pratyayo bhavati hrasvatvañca--śākinaḥ, palālinaḥ dadruṇaḥ| mahacchākaṃ śākī, mahāpalālaṃ palālauti kecit‌| nānājātīyānāṃ śākānāṃ samāhāraḥ śākī, palālānāṃ samāhāraḥ palālīti| `viṣvak‌' ityādi| viṣvakśabdānna pratyayo bhavati, uttarapadalopaśca| sa cākṛtasandheḥ akṛtayaṇādeśasya| viṣvañcatīti viṣuśabda upapade'ñcate; `ṛtvik‌' (3.2.59) ityādinā kvin‌, anunāsikalopaḥ, tato viṣu-ac‌ iti sthite viṣvañco yasya san‌tīti na pratyayaḥ, akṛtayaṇādeśasyottarapadalopaḥ--viṣuṇa iti bhavati| viṣuṇaśabdo'yaṃ nipātyate| nānārthe varttate| `lakṣmyā acca' iti| lakṣmāśabdānnapratyo bhavati, akāraścāntādeśaḥ lakṣmīrasyāstīti lakṣmaṇaḥ| `jaṭā ghaṭa' ityādi| jaṭādibhyaḥ kṣepe gamyamāna ilacpratyayaḥ| jaṭilaḥ, ghaṭilaḥ, kalilaḥ| kṣepa iti kim‌? jaṭāvān‌, ghaṭāvān‌, kalāvān‌|| 101. prajñāśraddhārcāvṛttibhyo ṇaḥ| (5.2.101) prajñāśabdānmatupi picchādipāṭhādilaci ca prāpte, itarebhyastu matupi ṇo vidhīyate|| 102. tapaḥ sahasrābhyāṃ vinīnī| (5.2.102) atra sūtre dve prakṛtī upātte, pratyayārthāvapi dvāveva prakṛtāvanuvarttete| tathā ca `vatsāṃsābhyāṃ kāmabale' (5.2.98) `sikatāśarkarābyāñca' (5.2.104) ityevamādiṣvapi keṣucidyogeṣu yathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamiti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha--`pratyayārthayostu' iti| kasmāt‌ punariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati? `vatsāṃsābhyāṃ kāmabale' (5.2.98) ityatrāṃśaśabdasya paranipātāllakṣamavyabhicāracihrāt‌| aṃsaśabdasya hi `ajādyadantam‌' (2.2.33) iti pūrvanipāte balaśabdasyāpi `ladhvakṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ nipatati' (vā. 108) ityasmin‌ prāpte yo'yaṃ paranipātaḥ sa lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ darśayanniha matupprakāraṇe yathāsaṃkhyaṃ lakṣaṇasya vyabhicārayati| tena pratyayarthayoḥ sarvatra matupprakaraṇe yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| prakaraṇa ityetat‌ kutaḥ? prakaraṇāpekṣatvāllakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnasya| etadapi kutaḥ? vyākhyānāt‌| dvayorlakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnayorupādānādvā yogāpekṣatāyāṃ tvanyatarasyaivopādānaṃ kuryāt‌| `asantatvāt‌' iti| tapaḥśabdādasantatvāt‌ `asmāyāmeṣāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121) ityevamādinā vinipratyaye siddhe sahasraśabdāccākārāntatvāt `akata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) itīnipratyaye siddhe, punarivaṃ vidhānaṃ vakṣyamāṇenāṇā bādhā mā bhūdityevamartham‌| `sahasrāttu' ityādi| `ata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) iti ṭhannapi prāpnoti, so'pi bādhyate| etana sahasraśabdāt‌ ṭhano bādhānamiti punarvacanamiti darśayati|| 103. aṇ‌ ca| (5.2.103) `aṇprakaraṇe' ityādi jyotsnādirākṛtigaṇaḥ| yebhyo matubarthe'ṇ‌ dṛśyate te jyotsnādayo draṣṭavyāḥ| upasaṃkhyānaśabdaścāyaṃ pratipādane varttate| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena jyotsnādibyo'pi bhaviṣyatīti| `kauṇḍalaḥ' iti| kuṇḍale yorhati sa evamucyate| anyastu kuṇḍalītyeva bhavati|| 104. sikatāśarahkarābhyāñca| (5.2.104) `ādeśa ihodāharaṇam‌' iti| deśa uttarasūtreṇa lubilacorvidhāsyamānatvāt‌|| 105. deśe lubilacau ca| (5.2.105) 106. danta unnata urac‌| (5.2.106) akārāntatvādiniṭhanoḥ prāptayoḥ `tundādiṣu' (5.2.117) `svāṅgāt‌' iti pāṭhādilaci dantaśabdādurajvidhīyate|| 107. ūṣasuṣimuṣkamadho raḥ| (5.2.107) yathāsambhavaṃ matupīniṭhanośca prāptayorūṣādibhyo ro vidhīyate| `madhuraḥ' iti| madhuśabdo'tra rasaviśeṣe varttate| `raprakaraṇe' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdaḥ pratipādane varttate| tatredaṃ pratipādanam--`deśe lubilacau ca' (5.2.105) ityataścakāro'tra varttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena mukhaprabhṛtibhyo'pi ro bhavati| `nagapāṇḍupāṃśu' [`nagapāṃśupāṇḍubhyaḥ kāśikā] ityādi| nagapāṃśuprabhṛtibhyaśca ro bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tāmeva cakārasyānuvṛttimāśritya karttavyam‌|| 108. dyudrubhyāṃ maḥ| (5.2.108) dyauśca druśca dyudrū, tābhyāṃ matupi prāpte mo vidhīyate| dhaurasyāstīti dyumaḥ, `diva ut‌' (6.1.131) ityuttvam‌| kecit‌--`dyuśabda prakṛtyantaramahno nāmadheyam‌, tata idaṃ pratyayavidhānam‌' ityāhuḥ| `rūḍhiṣu matup‌ punarna vikalpyate' iti| rūḍhiśabdārthasya matupā'nabhidhānāt‌|| 109. keśādvo'nyatarasyām‌| (5.2.109) iniṭhanoḥ prāptayormatupi cedamārabhyate| nanu ca prakṛtamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamastyeva, tatkimarthaṃ punarivaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`nanu ca prakṛtam‌' ityādi| `vaprakaraṇe' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| keśaśabdādyathā vapratyayaḥ, evamanyebhyo'pi tathā vapratyayo dṛśyate, tasmādvaktavyaṃ vyākhyeyam‌| tathā vyākhyānaṃ karttavyaṃ yathāsāvanyebhyo bhavatītyarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--ihāpi sa eva cakāro'nuktasamuccayārtho'nuvarttate, tenānyebhyo'pi bhavatītyarthaḥ| 110. gāṇḍyajagātsaṃjñāyām‌| (5.2.110) `hrasvādapi bhavati' iti| kathaṃ punardīrghasya grahaṇe hrasvādapi bhavatīti? `tatra tulyā hi' hatyādi| yādṛśī dīrghasyeha saṃhitā hrasvagrahaṇe'pi tādṛśyeva dṛśyate| tasmāt‌ hrasvasyāpi grahaṇamiha na virudhyata iti bhāvaḥ| tatra caitat‌ syāt‌--yadyapi tulyā saṃhitā, tathāpi kṛtayaṇādeśo'yameka eva śabdaḥ, tasya svarūpa ityanyatarasya parigrahaṇena bhavitavyam‌| tatra yadi dīrghatya grahaṇaṃ hrasvānna prāpnoti, atha hrasvasya grahaṇaṃ dīrghanna prāpnotītyata āha--`ubhayathā' iti| ubhayaprakāraṃ hyācāryeṇa praṇītaṃ sūtram‌| tasmādubhayorapi grahaṇamityadoṣaḥ| atha saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ kim‌, yāvatetikaraṇasya cānuvṛtterasaṃjñāyāṃ na bhaviṣyati, yathā dyudrabhyāṃ mapratyayaḥ? evaṃ tarhi tasyaivetikaraṇasya prapañcaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇamiti draṣṭavyam‌|| 111. kāṇḍāṇḍādīrannīracau| (5.2.111) iniṭhanorapavādo'yam‌|| 112. rajaḥ kṛṣyāsutipariṣado valac‌| (5.2.112) rajaḥśabdāt‌ `asmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121) iti vinau prāpte, itarebhyastu matupi valajvidhīyate| `valacprakaraṇe' ityādi| vapratyayasya vyākhyānenedamapi vyākhyātaprāyam‌| atra `vale' (6.3.118) iti dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? `vanagiryoḥ saṃjñāyām‌' (6.3.117) ityataḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ|| 113. dantaśikhātsaṃjñāyām‌| (5.2.113) dantaśabdādiniṭhanoḥ prāptayorvalajvidhīyate| śikhāśabdādinipratyayo vakṣyate `vrīhyādibhyaśca' (5.2.116) ityatra `śikhādibhya inirvācyaḥ' (ma. bhā. 2.398) iti| adeśārthaṃ śikhāgrahaṇam‌, śikhāvalā sthūṇetyatra yathā syāt‌| deśe tu `śikhāyā valac‌' (4.2.89) ityanenaiva cāturarthika eva siddhaḥ| yadyevam‌, idameva vaktavyam‌, kiṃ tena? naitadasti; tadapi hi vaktavyameva--nirvṛttādiṣvartheṣu yathā syāt‌| atrāpi saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ tasyai vārthasyānuvādārtham‌| itikaraṇānuvṛrttyavābhidheyaniyamasiddheḥ|| 114. jyotsnātamisrāśṛṅgiṇorjasvinnūrjasvalagominmalinamalīmasāḥ| (5.2.114) `strītvamatantram‌' iti| apradhānam‌, avivakṣitatvāt‌ strīliṅganirdeśastu vaicitryārthaḥ|| 115. ata iniṭhanau| (5.2.115) ata ityakārastaparo gṛhyate| ata evāha--`akārāntāt‌' ityādi| athācchabdasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate--acchabdāt‌ prātipadikāditi? adityayuktaṃ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavitum‌; svarūpagrahaṇe hi rasādibhyo matupo vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| sa hīniṭhanorbādhanārthaṃ vidhīyate| na ceha svarūpagrahaṇe tebhyastau pratyayau prāpnuta iti kiṃ tadvidhānārthena matupo vidhānena! `taparakaraṇaṃ kim‌? śraddhāvān‌' (iti)| nanu ca vrīhyādiṣu mālādaya ākārāntāḥ paṭhyante, te ca niyamārthā bhaviṣyanti--etebya evākārāntebhya iti? naitadasti; tulyajātīyasyaivaṃ niyamaḥ syāt‌, ḍāpcābantābhyāṃ syātāmevetīniṭhanau| tasmādakārastaparaḥ karttavyaḥ| `kāryī, iti| kṛta iniḥ| `taṇḍulikaḥ' iti| jāteriniṭhanau|| 116. vrīhyādibhyaśca| (5.2.116) `śikhādibhyaḥ' ityādi| ubhayatrādiśabdaḥ prakāre| śiṣṭaprayoge yebhya inireva dṛśyate, te śikhādayo draṣṭavyāḥ, te hi tebhyaṣṭhanaṃ vihitavantaḥ| eṣa tu viṣayavibhāga itikaraṇānuvṛttereva gṛhyate| `vācya' iti| asya tu vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| `yavakhadādiṣu' iti viṣayasaptamī| `evaṃ tarhi' ityādi| tundādiṣu vrīhiśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇe satīha tasya grahaṇamanarthakaṃ jñāyata iti sāmardhyāt‌ tatra vrīhigrahaṇenārthagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| arthagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayitumāha--`śālayo'sya santi śālikaḥ' ityādi| `śīrṣānnañaḥ' iti| naña uttaralasya śīrṣannityetasya pratyayo bhavati| nipātanācchirasaḥ śīrṣabhāvaḥ--aśīrṣī, aśīrṣikaḥ| anye tu śīrṣanniti śabdāntaraṃ paṭhanti| tasya tu pāṭho bhāṣāyāmapi yathā syādityevamarthaḥ| anyathā `śīrṣaṃśchandasi' (6.1.60) iti vidhānāt‌ bhāṣāyām‌ aśīrṣikaḥ, aśīrṣavāniti na syāt‌|| 117. tundādibhya ilacca| (5.2.117) yathāsambhavaṃ matubādiṣu prāpteṣvidamārabhyate| `cakārādiniṭhanau matupca' iti| etena pratyayacatuṣṭayaṃ tundādibhyastviniṭhanāvapi| `svāṅgādvivṛddhau' iti| svāṅgadvivṛddhau varttamānāt‌ pratyayo bhavati| vṛddhau mahāntau karṇāvasya staḥ--karṇilaḥ, karṇikaḥ, karṇī, karṇavān‌|| 118. ekagopūrvāṭṭhañ‌ nityam‌| (5.2.118) matubādiṣu prāpteṣu ṭhañvidhīyate| sa ca samānādhikaraṇatatpuruṣādekapūrvādbhavati, na tu sarvata ekapūrvāt‌| etaccetikaraṇātuvṛtterlabhyate| ekañca tacchataṃ caikaśatam‌, tadasyāstīti aikaśatikaḥ| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe--ekaśatavān‌| `katham‌' ityādi| yadi `ataḥ' (5.2.115) ityetadanuvarttate, gośakaṭīśabdānna sidhyati, tasyānakārāntatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `tato bhaviṣyati' iti| tadantādbhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| eṣo'rthaḥ--ekagopūrvādadantāt‌| prātipadikāṭṭhañ‌ vidhīyata iti sāmarthyāllabhyate| atha vā--tato hetorbhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `avaśyaṃ ca' ityādiḥ asatyāṃ hyata ityanuvṛttau dvandvopatāpagarhyādiṣu (5.2.128; 5.2.115) yogeṣu citrakalalāṭikādiśabdebhyo'pi pratyayaḥ syāt‌| `nityagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| asati hi nityagarahaṇe'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ matupsamuccayārthaṃ sarvatrānuvarttata iti matubati syāt‌| tasmādabādhanārthaṃ nityagrahaṇam‌| `kathamekadravyavattvāt‌' iti| yadi nityagrahaṇaṃ matubbādhanārtham‌, evam‌, na hyeka dravyavattvādityatraikapūrvāddravyaśabdānmatup‌ sidhyatīti manyate| `ekena' ityādi| ekaśabdasya dravyavattvādityanena `supsupā' (2.1.4) iti samāsaṃ kṛtvā sādhutvamasya pratipādanīyamityarthaḥ|| 119. śatasahasrāntācca niṣkāt‌| (5.2.119) 120. rūpādāhatapraśaṃsayoryap‌| (5.2.121) `tadāhatamucyate' iti| āhatam‌-āhananam‌, tāḍanamityarthaḥ| ato niṣpannaṃ puruṣādirūpam‌, tadapi kāryai kāraṇopacārādāhatamityucyate| `yapprakāraṇe' iti| yapprakaraṇe'nyebhyo'pi dṛśyata iti vaktavyamiti| anenāsya tu tulyatvāt‌ tadvadeva vyākhyānaṃ karttavyam‌| cakārastviha `śatasahasrāntācca niṣkāt‌' (5.2.119) ityato'nuvarttate|| 121. asmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ| (5.2.121) `yaśasvī'| `tapasvī'| `payasvī'| `tasau matvarthe' (1.4.19) iti bhatvam‌, ato bhatvājjaśatvaṃ na bhavati| jaśtvena sakārasya dakāraḥ prāpnoti, sa na bhavati|| 122. bahulaṃ chandasi| (5.2.122) `dvayobhayahṛdayāni' ityādi| avadhāraṇamiha draṣṭavyam‌| dvayādīnyeva dīrghatvaṃ prayojayanti, netarāṇi; svata eva dīrghatvāt‌| `tadetatsarvaṃ bahulagrahaṇena sampadyate' iti| vaktavyaśapabdastu vyākhyāne varttate ityabhiprāyaḥ|| 123. ūrṇāyā yusa| (5.2.123) `ūrṇāyuḥ' iti| padatvena bhasaṃjñābhāvādyasyeti lopo na bhavati|| 124. vāco gminiḥ| (5.2.124) atha minireva kasmānnocyate? jaśtve kṛte vāggmīti sidhyati; nanu ca `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) ityanunāsikaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vyavasthitavibhāṣāṃ vijñāsyate| evaṃ tarhi gakāramadhikaṃ kurvannetat‌ sūcavati--gminirayamiti| yaḥ samyagbahu bhāvate tatrāpi vakṣyamāṇāvālajāṭacau bādhitvā gminireva bhavati| evaṃ hyaṣikaṃ bhavati yadyapavādaviṣaye'pi kvacidbhavati, nānyā| evañcā lajāṭacau kutsitaṃ yo bahu bhāvate tatraiva pāriśeṣyādbhavata iti veditavyam‌|| 125. ālajāṭacau bahubhāṣiṇi| (5.2.125) `kutsite' iti| vaktavyaśabdastu vyākhyāne varttata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `vaktavyam‌' iti| kutsitaṃ yo bahubhāṣate tatrālajāṭacau bhavata ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ pūrvasūtra eva kṛtam‌|| 126. svāminnaiśvarye| (5.2.126) `ekācaḥ' iti rasādiṣu (5.2.95) pāṭhānmatupi prāpta idamārabhyate| `aiśvaryavācinaḥ iti| dhanavacano'yaṃ svaśabda aiśvaryavācī| tathā ca-dhanayogādaiśvaryaṃ taducyate| `svavān‌' iti| ātmādāvarthāntare svaśabdo varttate|| 127. arśaādibhyo'c‌| (5.2.127) yathāsambhavaṃ matubādiṣvajvidhīyate| `ākṛtigaṇaścāyam‌' iti| avṛtkṛtatvāt‌| ādiśabdaścāyaṃ prakāre| `svāṅgāddhīnāt‌' iti| hīnasvāṅgavṛtteḥ prātipadikādajbhavati--khañjaḥ pādo'stīti śuklam‌| nanu ca śuklaśabdo guṇavacanaḥ, tatrābhedopacāreṇāpyetat‌ sidhyati? evaṃ tarhi dravyavṛtterapi varṇavācinaḥ prātipadikādyathā syādityevamarthaṃ varṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌| śuklaguṇayuktāḥ prāsādāḥ śuklāḥ, te'smin‌ santi śuklaṃ nagaram‌| pratyayasvareṇaivāntodāttatve siddhe cakāro'rśo'syāstīti `svarito vānudātte'padādau' (8.2.6) iti svaritabādhanārthaḥ|| 128. dvandvopatāpagarhyātprāṇisthādiniḥ| (5.2.128) `tadviṣayebyaḥ' iti| tacchabdenopatāpagarhāveva parāmṛśyete| te upatāpagarhe viṣayo yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| prāṇisthavācināṃ sarveṣāmeva dvandvādīnāmivaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌| `prāṇyaṅgānneṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi na bhavati? cakārānuvṛtteḥ| `siddhe pratyaye' iti| `ata iniṭhanau' (5.2.115) ityanenaiva| `ṭhanādibādhanārtham‌' iti| inireva yatā syāt‌, ṭhanādirmā bhūdityevamarthaṃ punarvacanam‌| ādiśabdena matub‌ gṛhyate| ita uttare yogā niyamārthā veditavyāḥ|| 129. vātātisārābhyāṃ kuk‌ ca| (5.2.129) `vātātisārābhyām‌' iti| yadyapi pañcamī, tathāpyarthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavati| āgamasambandhe ṣaṣṭhībhāvena vipariṇamyate| ata evāha--`tasyanniyogena ca tayoḥ kugāgamaḥ' iti| atha pratyayasyaivāgamaḥ kasmānna bhavati? kugāgamavatā pratyayenārthaṃsyānabhidhānāt‌| svarūpaṃ na sidhyatīti ca| `piśācācceti vaktavyam‌' iti| piśācaśabdādinipratyayo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`bahulaṃ chandasi' (5.2.122) ityato bahulagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena piśācaśabdādapi bhaviṣyati|| 130. vayasi pūraṇāt‌| (5.2.130) `vayasi dyotye' iti| kathaṃ punarvayo dyotyate, yadi pañcamādayaḥ śabdāḥ kāle varttamānāḥ pratyayamutpādayanti| ata eva teṣāṃ kāle vṛttiṃ darśayitumāha--`pañcamo māso'syāsti' iti| `siddhe sati' ityādi| pūraṇapratyayānāmakārantatvādiniḥ siddha eva, tasmin‌ siddhe punarivaṃ vacanaṃ niyamārthaṃ jñāyata iti| `inireva bhavati' iti| niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati|| 131. sukhādibhyaśca| (5.2.131) `inipratyayo niyamyate' iti| pūrvavanniyamo veditavyaḥ| `tadiha' ityādi| yato vrīhyadiṣu mālāśabdaḥ paṭhyate, tasmādyadiha kṣepe mālāśabdasya punarvacanaṃ tanmatupo bādhanārtham‌, na tu ṭhanaḥ| sukhādibhya iti nocyata iti; anenaiva nivarttitatvāt‌| mālāśabdo hi śikhādiṣu, tatrāntarbhāvinaḥ kṣepādanyatrenirbhavatyeva| śikhāditvānmatup‌ ca; matupastasyānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena samuccitatvāt‌--mālī, mālāvāniti|| 132. dharmaśīlavarṇāntācca| (5.2.132) 133. hastājjātau| (5.2.133) hastena hastamātraṃ pratīyate, na ta jātiḥ| puruṣaśabdaprayogāt‌ puruṣajātirgamyate|| 134. varṇādrabrahmacāriṇi| (5.2.134) `samudāyena cedbrahmacārī bhaṣyate' iti| etena samudāyopādhitvaṃ brahmacāriṇo darśayati| vidyāgrahaṇārtha yadopanīyate tataḥ sevitavyo yo niyamaviśeṣastadbrahmā, taccarati brahmacārī, āvaśyake ṇiniḥ| tatra niyamaviśeṣacaraṇe brāhmaṇādīnāmeva trayāṇāṃ varṇānāmadhikāraḥ, na śūdrasyetyāha--`brahmacārīti traivarṇiko'bhipretaḥ' iti| triṣu varṇeṣu bhavaḥ, tatrāntarbhūtatvāt‌ traivaṇikaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sa evābhipreta ityāha--`sa hi' ityādi|| 135. puṣkarādibhyo deśe| (5.2.135) iha kasmānna bhavati--puṣkarāṇi padmānyasmin‌ deśe santīti? itikaraṇānuvṛtteḥ| `arthāccāsannihite' iti| asannihitagrahaṇe tasya cāstitvena virodhaḥ| yadi hyasannihito'rthaḥ, na nāma vidyate; yadi vidyate, kathamasannihitaḥ? tasmādviśeṣaṇopādānādastotyetadviśeṣaṇamutsṛjyāsannidhānopādhikādarthāt‌ pratyayo vidhīyate| abhidhānaśaktisvābhāvyācca| `arthī' iti| abhilāṣavānevocyate| na sarvo'sannihito'rthaḥ pratyayāntena tadvimarśādasannihitavān‌, ataḥ pratyayo vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ, kathaṃ punaranucyamāno labhyate? `bahulaṃ chandasi' (5.2.122) ityato bahulagrahaṇena yathā `aṣṭrāmekhalādvayobhayarajāhṛdayādīnāṃ dīrghaśca' (bā. 586) ityevamādikaṃ kāryaṃ sampādyate, tathedamapi| `tadantācca' ityādi| asannihitamityanuvarttate, asannihitopādhikādarthādinipratyayo bhavatītyetadarthaṃrūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu kṛtaprāyam‌| 136. balapādibhyo matubanyatarasyām‌| (5.2.136) `yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena pratyayo vikalpyate--balādibhyo matubvikalpo bhavatīti, tato matupā mukte yathāprāptaminiṭhanāvapi syātām‌, inireva ceṣyate, sa kathaminireva labhyate, yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇeneniḥ samuccīyate, na matubiti vikalpena? ityevaṃ cetasi kṛtvāha--`anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena' ityādi| nanu yadīniṭanau dvāvapi syātām‌, sūtrārambho'narthakaḥ syāt‌, vinā'pyanena pratyayasya siddhatvāt‌, tasmānmatupo'pi vikalpasyānena doṣaḥ? naitadasta; ārambhasāmarthyādiniṭhanoranyataro bhavatītyeṣo'rtho labhyate, na tvinireva| tasmādinisamuccayārthamevānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 137. saṃjñāyāṃ manmābhyām‌| (5.2.137) `prathiminī, dāminī' iti| prathimin‌, dāmin‌--ityetābhyāminiḥ, `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ, `ṛnnebhyo ḍīp‌' (4.1.5) iti ṅīp‌| atrāpi saṃjñāgrahaṇamitikaraṇasyaiva prapañcaḥ|| 138. kaṃśaṃbhyāṃ babhayustitutayasaḥ| (5.2.138) `udakasukhayorvācako' iti| yathāsaṃkhyaṃ kamityudayakasya vācakaḥ, śamiti sukhasya| `śaṃyuḥ' iti| `mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.33), tasya `vā padāntasya' (8.4.59) iti parasavarṇaḥ, masyānunāsiko yakāraḥ| tenānusvāraparasavarṇau siddhau bhavataḥ' iti| tayoḥ padādhikāre vidhānāt‌| yadi punaḥ padasaṃjñā na syāt‌, tatastasyāmasatyāṃ padanibandhanayoranusvāraparasavarṇayorabhāvāt‌--kamyuḥ, śamyurityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ sampadyate|| 139. tundibalivaṭerbhaḥ| (5.2.139) tundiśabdāt‌ tundādiṣu `svāṅgādvivṛddhau' (5.2.117) iti pāṭhādilacīniṭhanormatupi prāpte, baleḥ pāmādipāṭhānne matupi, vaṭermatupyeva bo vidhīyate|| 140. ahaṃśubhamoryus‌| (5.2.140) `ahamiti śabdāntaram‌' iti| asmadaḥ `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94) iti, tyadādyatve ca kṛte yacchabdarūpaṃ sampadyate, tasmādanya evāhamavyutpannaḥ śabdaḥ, na tu tadityevaṃ śabdānyatvaṃ darśayitvā'rthāntaraṃ darśayitumāha--`ahaṅkāre varttate' iti| `ahaṃyuḥ, śubhaṃyuḥ' iti| pūrvavadanusvāraparasavarṇau|| iti śrībodhisattvadeśīyācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ pañcamādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ <5.3> atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ| (5.3.1) `vibhaktisaṃjñāste vedivyāḥ' iti| vibhaktirityeṣa śabdaḥ saṃjñā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| nanu ca vibhaktiśabdaḥ suptiṅāṃ saṃjñā, saṃjñā ca pradeśavākyeṣūccāritā saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayatīti suptiṅāṃ vibhaktisaṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| yathā vṛddhiśabdaḥ svābhidheye laukike'rthe guṇībhūto'pyādaic‌ prati saṃjñātvamanubhavati, tathā vibhaktiśabdo'pi tasilādīn‌ prati saṃjñātvena veditavyaḥ| atha tatraiva kasmānnocyate--`supo vibhaktiśca prāgdiśaśca' iti, evaṃ sati punarvibhaktigrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ na bhavati? naivaṃ śakyam‌; evaṃ hi nyāse sati `kuta ārabya prāgdiśīyāḥ? iti na jñāyate| kiñca `digādibhyo yat‌' (4.3.54), `tenaikadik‌' (4.3.112) iti cānekaṃ śāstre diggrahaṇamityavadhirapi sandihyeta| `kiṃsarvanāmabahubhyaḥ' (5.3.2) ityevamādeśca kārahyasyāvadhidarśanārthaṃ punariha `prāgdiśaḥ' iti vācyameva syāt‌| tasmādyathānyāsameva sādha| `tataḥ, yataḥ' iti| `aṣṭana ā vibhaktau' (7.2.84) ityanuvarttamāne `tyadādīnāmaḥ' (7.2.102) ityatvam‌, `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ' (1.3.4) iti sakārasyetsaṃjñāpratiṣeṣaḥ, `taddhita ścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' (1.1.38) ityavyayatvādvibhakterluk‌| `kutaḥ' iti| `ki tihoḥ' (7.2.104) iti kimaḥ kubhāvaḥ| `tyadādividhayaḥ' iti| tyadādayo'tra dibhaktinibandhanāḥ| `tataḥ' iti| tyadādividheratvasyodāharaṇam‌| `iha iti| idamo vibhaktisvarasya| idamaḥ saptamyantāt‌ `idamo haḥ' (5.3.11) iti hapratyayaḥ, `idama iś‌' (5.3.3) itīśādeśaḥ| `ūḍidampadādyappumraidyubhyaḥ' (6.1.171) iti idamaḥ parasyodātatvaṃ vibhaktitve sati siddhaṃ bhavati| atra tu pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhamādyudāttatvam‌| tasmāccodāharaṇadigiyaṃ pradarśita| idaṃ tvatrodāhāraṇaṃ yuktam‌--`itaḥ' iti| ivamastasil‌, pūrvavadiś‌| atacra hyasati vibhaktitve liti pratyayāt‌ pūrvapadādyudāttatvaṃ [`pūrvamādyudāttatvaṃ'-mudritapāṭhaḥ (vārāṇasī-1967)] syāt‌| tasmistu `ūḍidam‌' (6.1.171) ityādinedamaḥ parasya tasa ādyudāttatvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| nanu ca satyapi vibhaktitve paratvāllitsvareṇa bhavitavyam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `liti' (6.1.193) ityatra hi `ūjidam‌' (6.1.171) ityādikaṃ sūtramanuvarttiṣyate litsvarabādhanārtham‌| nanvevamapi naiva vibhakterudāttatvaṃ sidhyati? tatra hi `sāvekācastṛtīyādivibhaktiḥ' (6.1.168) ityatastṛtīyādigrahaṇamanuvarttate, na ca tasilādayastṛtīyādigarahaṇena gṛhyante| tṛtīyaikavacanamāranya ā pañcamādhyāyaparisamāpteryāvān‌ pratyayo vibhaktisaṃjñaḥ sarvo'sau tṛtīyādiḥ| `ataḥ param‌' ityādi| sāmarthyaṃ hi nāma sambandhārthatā; sā ca pratiyoginamapekṣata eva yana sahaikārthībhāvo bhavati tasmin‌ pratiyogini sati, nānyathā| prāthamyamapi pratiyogyapekṣameva| dvitīyaṃ hi pratiyoginamapebhya prathamamityucyate| ita uttaraṃ pratyayāḥ prakṛtyartha eva bhavantīti, na tadviṣau dvitīyasya pratiyoginaḥ sambhavaḥ; tadabhāvāt‌ sāmarthyaprāthamyayorapi nāstyeva sambhavaḥ; tayoḥ pratiyogyapekṣatvāt‌| yataścaitadevam‌, tataḥ `sāmarthyādhikāraḥ prathamagrahaṇañca nopayujyate' iti dvayamapi nivṛttm‌| yadyevam‌; vāvacanasyāpi nivṛttiḥ prāpnoti, ekayoganirdiṣṭatvāt‌? ityāha--`vāvacanaṃ tu varttata eva' iti| tasya svaritatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `tena vikalpena' ityādi| tenottarasūtre vāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ phalaṃ darśayati|| 2. kiṃsarvanāmabahubhyo'dvyādibhyaḥ| (5.3.2) `kutra' iti| `saptamyāstral‌' (5.3.10), pūrvavat‌ kubhāvaḥ| `prakṛtiparisaṃkhyānam‌' iti| prakṛtiparigaṇanam‌| `vaiyākaraṇapāśaḥ' iti| `yāpye pāśap‌' (5.3.47)| ayaṃ cāvadheḥ paro vya ityanyābhyo'pi prakṛtibhyo bhavati| `sarvanāmatvādeva siddhe' iti| sarvanāmatvaṃ kimaḥ sarvādiṣu pāṭhāt‌| `kimo grahaṇam‌' ityādi| kiṃśabdo'yaṃ dvyādiṣu paṭhyata iti tasya `dvyādibhyaḥ' iti paryudāsaḥ kriyate| tasmāt‌ sarvanāmno'pi svaśabdenopādānam‌| yadyevaṃ dviśabdāt‌ pūrvaṃ kiṃśabdaḥ paṭhitavyaḥ, evaṃ hi tasya pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ na karttavyameva bhavati? satyametat‌; na sūtrakārasyeha gaṇapāṭha iti nāsāvupālambhamarhati| api ca tyadādīnāṃ yadyatparaṃ tattacchiṣyata iti kimaḥ sarvaireva tyadādibhiḥ saha vivakṣāyāṃ śeya iṣyate--`tvañca kaśca' kau, bhavāṃśca kaśca kau; sa caivaṃ pāṭhe na sidhyatīti yathānyāsamevāstu| `bahugrahaṇe saṃkhyāgrahaṇam‌' iti| kathamiha sarvanāmasaṃjñayā sarvādayaḥ saṃjñino nirdiśyante? tasmāt‌ taiḥ saha nideśādbahuśabdasyāpi bahugaṇādi (1.1.23) sūtreṇa yasya saṃkhyāsaṃjñā vihitā tasyaiva saṃjñitā tasyaiva saṃjñino grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| `bahoḥ sūpāt‌' iti| atra vaipulyavācī bahuśabdaḥ|| 3. idama iś‌| (5.3.3) `śakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ' iti| asakati hi tasmin‌ `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) syāt‌| tataścedrūpasya hali lope (7.2.113) kṛte, `ādguṇe' (6.1.87) caitaḥ, ehetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| nanu cedamastyadādyatve (7.2.102) kṛte'to guṇe (6.1.97) pararūpatve cedrūpalope cāntyasyāpyādeśa itaḥ, iheti sidhyatyeva? sidhyedyadi prāk‌ tyadādyatvaṃ labhyeta; na tu tallabhyam‌, itvameva hi tāvadantaraṅgaṃ syāt‌| itvaṃ hi tasilādipratyayaṃmātramapekṣata ityantaraṅgam‌, tyādyatvamaṅgasaṃjñāṃ parasya pratyayasya vibhkitatvaṃ cāpekṣata iti bahiraṅgam‌, tasmācchākaraḥ karttavyaḥ|| 4. etetau rathoḥ| (5.3.4) `rathoḥ' iti varṇayorivaṃ grahaṇam‌| tatra `yasmin‌ vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vā. 14) iti rephādau thakārādau ca kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityādi--`rephādau' ityādi| rephasyākāra uccāraṇārtha iti kathaṃ jñāyate? idamaḥ parasya prāgdiśīyasyākāravato rephasyābhāvāt‌|| 5. etado'ś‌| (5.3.5) `śakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ' iti| nanu cāntyasya sa bhavan‌ yadi tāvadakṛte tyadādyatve bhavati tato dakārasya bhavannanarthakaḥ prasajyeta, tyadādyatvenāpi hi tasyākāro labhyata eva; atha tyadādyatve kṛte'kārasya sthāne bhavannanarthaka eva prasajyate na hyakārasyākāravacane prayojanamasti, kṛtavāṃśca; tatra vacanādasatyapi śakāre sarvādeśo bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; asti hyakārasyākāravacane prayojanam‌| kim‌? ataḥ, atretyatra yo'nyaḥ prāpnoti sa mā bhṛditi| kaḥ punarasau? liti pratyayāt‌ pūrvasyodāttaḥ| tasmācchakāraḥ karttavyaḥ| `thamuḥ [thamupratyayaḥ punaretada upasaṃkhyeyaḥ--kāśikā] punarupasaṃkhyeyaḥ' iti| tasyāvidyamānatvat‌| upasaṃkhyeya iti pratipādya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--eta eva thakārādāvādeśavacanaṃ jñāpayati--bhavatyetadasthamuriti| kuto nu khalvetat‌? jñāpakāt‌| thamu bhaiviṣyati, na punarthaṃ evāsau `prakāravacane thāl‌' (5.3.23) ityaviśeṣavihitasthakārādistasminnevādeśaḥ syāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; idamasthakārādiviśeṣa iṣyate| `etadaḥ' ityattrāpi hyedama ityanuvarttate, tacca nādeśavidhānārtham‌; ādeśasya pūrvameva vihitatvāt‌|
