tasmāt‌ pratyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tata etena thakārādi viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ--idama ityevaṃ yo vihita idaṃśabdenaiva yo vihitasthakārādiriti, thamureva caivaṃ vihitaḥ, na thāliti yuktamuktamādeśavacanaṃ jñāpayati--bhavatyevaitadasthamuriti|| 6. sarvasya so'nyatarasyāṃ di| (5.3.6) `dīti' dakārādiyaṃ saptamī| tatra dakāramātrasya prāgdiśīyasyābhāvāt‌ `yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vā. 14) ityato dakārādau vidhirjñāyata ityāha--`prāgdiśīye dakārādau' ityādi| `sarvadā brāhmāṇī' iti| `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3), tataṣṭāp‌|| 7. pañcamyāstasil‌| (5.3.7) `tasila pratyayo bhavati' iti| ādeśā evāmī tasilādayaḥ pañcamyādīnāṃ sthāne kasmātra kriyante, evaṃ hi vibhaktitasaṃjñā na karttavyā bhavati? aśakyā eta ādeśāḥ kartum‌; ādeśatve hyeṣāmavyāyāt‌ tyapi (4.2.104)--tatastyaḥ, yatastya ityatra `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti luk‌| labhante hi sthānivadbhāvena subādeśāḥ subāśrayaṃ kāryam‌| tata iti, `anudāttau suppitau' (3.1.4) ityanudāttaḥ| kuta iti, `dheṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇaḥ| etarhīti, `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghaḥ| tatreti, `bahuvacanejhalyet‌ (7.3.103) ityetvam‌| kutreti, `acca gheḥ' (7.3.119) ityauttvam‌| tataḥ, tatreti, `ṅasiṅyoḥ smātsminau' (7.1.15) iti smātsminau| tasmānnādeśā amī kriyante| yadyevam‌, `tasu upakṣaye' (dhā. pā. 1212) ityasmāt‌ tasyannityatra dhāturūpasya pañcamyāḥ parasya `taseśca' (5.3.8) iti tasilādeśaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; svārthikavijñānānna bhaviṣyati| svārthikā hyete tasilādayaḥ, tanmadhye tasilādeśo vidhīyamānastathā vijñāyate yathā svārthe kriyāmāṇaḥ, svārthikatvaṃ nātikrāmati| `apādāne cāhīyarūhoḥ' (5.4.45) ityanena vihitastasya svārthikasya sāthāne bhavaṃstasilapi svārthika eva bhavati| dhātustu prātipadikādarthāntare varttata iti tadādeśo bhavaṃstasil‌ svārthiko na bhavati|| 8. taseśca| (5.3.8) `kuta āgata' iti| `apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' (5.4.45) iti paratvāt‌ tasau kṛte tasyānena tasil‌| nanu ca kṛte'pi tasili tadeva rūpam‌, tatkimarthamādiśyate? ityāha--`tasestasilvavacanam‌' ityādi|| 9. paryabhibhyāñca| (5.3.9) `sarvobhayārte varttamānābhyāmiṣyate' iti| teneha na bhavati--pariṣiñciti, abhiyātīti| atra cānabhidānaṃ hetuḥ.ya ata vā--`sarvasya' (5.3.6) ityādeḥ sūtrādanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena sarvobhayārthaṃ eva varttamānābhyāṃ bhavati, nānyatra|| 10. saptamyāstral‌| (5.3.10) 11. idamo haḥ| (5.3.11) 12. kimo't‌| (5.3.12) `kva' iti| `kvāti' (7.2.105) iti kimaḥ kvādeśaḥ `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ (1.3.4) iti pratiṣedhasya `ivamasthamuḥ' (5.3.24)) ityukāreṇānityatvasya jñapitatvāditsaṃjñā takārasya| dānīmastu pratiṣedhānnāstītsaṃjñā; prayojanābhāvācca|| 13. vā ha ca cchandasi| (5.3.13) 14. itarābhyo'pi dṛśyante| (5.3.14) `pañcamīsaptamyapekṣamitaratvam‌' iti| tadanantaramitaraśabdasya jñātatvāt‌| atha dṛśigrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `itarābhyo'pi' ityetāvataiva siddham‌? ityāha--`dṛśigrahaṇam‌' ityādi| prāyiko vidhiryatā syādityevamarthaṃ vṛśigrahaṇam‌| tasmistu sati śiṣṭaprayoge'nugamyamāne yatra dṛśyate tatra bhavati, nānyatretyeṣo'rtho labhyate| tena prāyikatvaṃ vidheḥ sidhyati| `tena' ityādi| dṛśigrahaṇe tu sati yatretarābhyaḥ śiṣṭaprayogo dṛśyate tābhya eva tasilādibhirbhavitavyam‌| bhavadādiyoga evetarābhyo dṛśyante, tenetaratraiva tadvidhānam‌| yadi hyanyebhyo'pi tasilādayo bhavanti, pūrvaṃ pañcamīsaptamībhyāṃ vidhānamanarthakam‌? naitadasti; niyogato hi tābhyāmiṣyate, itarābhyo bhavadādiyoge| etacca pūrvasmin‌ vidhāvasmiśca satyubhayaṃ labhyata iti kuta ānarthakyam‌!|| 15. sarvaikānyakiṃyattadaḥ kāle dā| (5.3.15) `saptamyā ityanuvarttate' iti| tasyāḥ svaritatvāt‌| `na tvitarābhyaḥ' iti| tadvipharyayāt‌| `tralāderapavādaḥ' iti| yatāsambhavam‌| tatra kiṃśabdāt‌ `kimo't‌' (5.3.12) iti prāptasyātpratyayasyāpavādaḥ| keṣāñcinmatena taralo'pi| tacchabdādapi `tayodardāhilau ca cchandasi' (5.3.20) iti| śeṣebhyastu tralaḥ| `kadā' iti| kimaḥ kādeśaḥ|| 16. idamo hil‌| (5.3.16) `hasyāpavādaḥ' iti| `idamo haḥ' (5.3.11) iti prāptasya| `lakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| `liti'(6.1.193) pratyayāt‌ pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| nanu ca yathā ita ityatra--`ūḍidam‌' (6.1.171) ityādinā vibhaktisvaro bhavati, tathehāpi tenaiva bhavitavyam‌? naitadasti; tathā hi yuktamita ityatra yadvibhaktisvaro bhavatīti; tasilo littvasya paritaḥ, abhita ityatara caritārthatvāt‌, asya tu hilo litkaraṇamakṛtārtham‌| tadyadi vibhaktisvarema bādhyeta tasyānarthakyaṃ syāt‌| tasmāllitsvara eva bhavati|| 17. adhunā| (5.3.17) 18. dānīñca| (5.3.18) dānīñceti yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ--`tado dā ca' (5.3.19) ityatra dānīmeva yathā syāt‌, pūrvasūtravihitaḥ pratyayo mā bhūditi|| 19. tado dā ca| (5.3.19) `anarthakam‌' iti| vaicitryārtham‌| anyasyābhāvādanarthakaṃ vaicitryeṇa sārthakameva| `vihitatvāt‌' iti| `sarvaikānya' (5.3.15) ityādinā|| 20. tayordārhilau ca cchandasi| (5.3.20) `idā'| `idama iś‌' (5.3.3)| tathā varṇavyatyayena dakārasya dhakāraḥ| `idānīṃ, tadānīṃ iti| dānīmpratyayasyodāharaṇam‌|| 21. anadyatane rhilanyatarasyām‌| (5.3.21) tasilādiṣu prāpteṣu hilpratyayo vidhīyate| `kahi' iti| `kimaḥ kaḥ' (7.2.103)| `kadā, yadā, tadā' iti| `sarvaikānyakiyattadaḥ kāle dā' (5.3.15)|| 22. sadyaḥ parutparāryaiṣamaḥ paredyavyadya pūrvedyuranyedyuranyataredyuritaredyaraparedyuradharedyurubhayedyurutteradyuḥ| (5.3.22) `samāne'hani sadyaḥ' iti| nimittanimittinoḥ samāne sādhāraṇe'hani nipātanametat‌| tadyathā--sadyaḥ prāṇaharaṇaṃ marmaṇi tāḍanamiti | yasminnevāhani marmaṇi tāḍanaṃ tasminnevāhani prāṇaraṇamityarthaḥ| `udārī ca' iti| ucca āriśceti udārī| `parasmādedyavi' iti| paraśabdādedyavipratyayo bhavatyahanyabhidheye|| 23. prakāravacane thāl‌| (5.3.23) `sāmānyasya [`sāyāsya viśeṣo bhedakaḥ-prakāraḥ'-kāśikā] 24. idamasthamuḥ| (5.3.24) 25. kimaśca| (5.3.25) `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| `thā hetau ca' (5.3.26) iti vakṣyati, sa kima eva yathā syāt‌, idamo mā bhūditi|| 26. thā hetau ca cchandasi| (5.3.26) 27. dikśabdebhyaḥsaptamīpañcamīprathamābhyo digdeśakāleṣvastātiḥ| (5.3.27) `digdeśakāleṣu varttamānebhyaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punarthe diśāṃ śabdāste deśe kāle varttante? svabhāvāt‌| yathaiva hi te diśa svabāvādeva varttante, na hetvantarāt‌,; tathā deśakālayorapi| yadyavam‌, triṣu varttamānāḥ kathaṃ diśā vyapadiśyante--dikśabdebhya iti? kathaṃ tarhi vyapadeṣṭavyam‌, digdeśakālaśabdebhya iti? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vyapadeśasyaitat‌ phalam‌--aindryāṃ diśi nivasatītyatra mā bhūditi| etaccānyatamenāpi labhyata ityanenaiva vyāpadeśo yuktaḥ, yena vyapadeśālladhu sūtraṃ bhavati| diśā ca vyapadeśe laghu bhavati, dikśabdasyālpāctaratvāditi diśāṃ tena vyapadeśaḥ| evamapi dikśabdasya diśi vṛtteḥ viśeṣaṇamayuktam‌, avasyaṃ hi dikśabdo diśi varttate, tatraivaṃ karttavyam‌--deśakālayoriti? naitadasti; evaṃ hyu cyamāne satyupalakṣaṇameva hi dikśabdaḥ syāt‌, pratyastu deśakālavṛttibhya eva syāt‌, na digvṛttibhyaḥ| diggrahaṇe tu tebhyo'pi bhavati| iha tisro vibhaktayaḥ, trayaścārthā digādayaḥ, tatra sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyam‌--iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāmapākartumāha--`yathāsaṃkhyamatra neṣyate' iti| tatkathamihekavacananirdeśe karttavye bahuvacananirdeśaḥ? pratyekaṃ digādivṛtterbahulavibhaktyantāt‌ pratyayaḥ karttavya iti sūcanārthaḥ| evañcāyaṃ bahulavibhaktyantāt‌ pratyayaḥ kṛto bhavati, yadi digvṛtterapi saptamīpañcamīprathamāntādeva bhavati--deśavṛtterapi, kālavṛtterapi| atha vā-`thā hetau ca' (5.3.26) ityataścakāro'nuvarttate, sa ca śrutimeva samuccinoti| tena digādivṛtteḥ pratyekaṃ saptamīpañcamīprathamāntāt‌ pratyayo bhavati, na yatāsaṃkhyam‌! yathāsaṃkhyaṃ hi samuccayo virudhyateta| atha vā--`svaritatve sati yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati' ityuktam‌, na ceha yathāsaṃkhyārthaṃ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyeta, tena yathāsaṃkyaṃ na bhaviṣyati| `purastāvadhastāt‌' iti| pūrvādharaśabdābhyāmastātiḥ| `astāti ca' (5.3.40) iti vakṣyamāṇena yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pur‌, adha--ityetau pūrvādharaśabdayorādeśau| `aindryāṃ diśi vasati' iti| aindrīśabdaḥ sāmānyenendrasambandhivastumātramācaṣṭe, dikśabdasannidhau tu diśi varttate, tena dikśabda iti loke na prasiddha itadi na bhavatyataḥ pratyayaḥ| `pūrvaṃ grāmaṃ gataḥ' iti| pūrvaśabdo'tra grāmasya deśātmakatvāddeśe varttate, na tvatra saptamyādivibhaktyantaḥ, kiṃ tu dvitīyānta| `pūrvasmin‌ gurau vasati' iti pūrvaśabdo'tra digādyupalakṣite gurau varttate, na digādiṣu|| 28. dakṣiṇottarābhyāmatasuc‌| (5.3.28) `akāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ' iti| yadyatrākāro na kriyate, tadā `ṣaṣṭhī tasarthapratyayena' (2.3.30) iti sūtraṃ karttavyam‌, evañca sati tasilo'pi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| tataśca tato hetunetyatrāpi tṛtīyāṃ bādhitvā ṣaṣṭhī syāt‌| tasmādakāro viśeṣaṇārthaḥ karttavyaḥ| atha yadā dakṣiṇottaraśabdau diśi varttete, tadā ṭāpśravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartho'kāraḥ kasmānna bhavati? `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ' (vā. 104) iti puṃvadvacanenaiva ṭāpo nivarttitatvāt‌| nanu cāsatyakāre pratyayasvarema siddhatvāccakāro'pi naiva karttavyaḥ, tatra, `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe tu na dvyanubandhakasya' (vyā. pa. 52) iti tasilo grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati? evamapi `pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ' (5.4.44), `tenaikadik‌'(4.3.112), `tasiśca' (4.3.113) ityanyataragrahaṇaṃ syāt‌| tasmādviśeṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ karttavyaḥ|| 29. vibhāṣā parāvarābhyām‌| (5.3.29) 30. añcerluk‌| (5.3.30) dikśabdādityadhikārātkevalasya cāñcateradikśabdatvāt‌ `añceḥ' ityañcūttarapadasya nirdeśo'yaṃ vijñāyate, ata evāha--`añcatyantebhyaḥ' iti| `dikśabdebyaḥ' iti| `prāgvasati' iti| prapūrvādañcateḥ `ṛtvik‌' (3.2.59) ityādinā sūtreṇa kvin‌, `añcateścopasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā. 336) iti ṅīp‌, `acaḥ' (6.4.138) ityallopaḥ, `cau' (6.3.138) iti dīrghaḥ--prācī iti sthite, astātiḥ, tasya luk‌, kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvam‌| `pratyak‌' iti| pratīcīśabdāt‌ pratyayaḥ, sa tu pūrvavadupapādyaḥ|| 31. uparyupariṣṭāt‌| (5.3.31) `ril‌riṣṭātilau ca pratyayau nipātyete' iti astāterapavādau|| 32. paścāt‌| (5.3.32) `ātiśca pratyayaḥ' iti| ayamapyastāterapavādaḥ| `dakṣiṇapaścāduttarapaścāt‌' iti| dakṣiṇāparasyāṃ diśi vasatīti dakṣiṇapaścāt‌ evamuttarapaścāt‌| `ardhottarapadasya ca' iti aparasyeti sambadhyate| `vināpi pūrvapadena paścabhāvo vaktavyaḥ' iti| aparasyārddhottarapadasyeti prakṛtena sambandhanīyam‌| atra sarvatra vaktavyaśabdo vyākhyāne darttate| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--uttarasatrāt‌ siṃhāvalokitena cakāro'trāvatiṣṭhate, sa cānuktasamuccāyārthaḥ| tena dikpūrvapadasyāparaśabdasya paścabhāva ityevamādikaṃ kāryaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati|| 33. paśca paścā ca cchandasi| (5.3.33) 34. uttarādharadakṣiṇādātiḥ| (5.3.34) uttaradakṣiṇābhyāṃ `dakṣiṇottarābhyāmatasuc‌' (5.3.28) `enabanyatarasyāmadūre'pañcamyāḥ' (5.3.35), `dakṣiṇādāc‌' (5.3.36), `āhi ca dūre' (5.3.37), `uttarācca' (5.3.38) ityebhiryogairatasujādiṣu prāpteṣvadharādapyastātāvātirvidhīyate, tasyāstātirbādhyata eva| atasujādayastu vacanātpakṣe bhavantyeva| atra ca yadyapyuttarādīnāṃ saptamyādīnāṃ ca vibhaktīnāṃ digādīnāṃ copādhīnāṃ tritvam‌, tathāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| kutaḥ? tadarthasya svaritatvasyāpratijñānāt‌| ladhvakṣarasyādharaśabdasyāpūrvanipātāllakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnādvā'sya lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ darśayan‌ yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamiha nāpekṣyata iti sūcayati| tena vibhaktibhistāvadyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| upādhibhistu dakṣiṇaśabdasya kāle vṛttyasambhavācca|| 35. enabanyatarasyāmadūre'pañcamyāḥ| (5.3.35) `adūre cedavadhimānavadherbhavati' iti| kathaṃ punarevaṃ viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatā sūtre'vadhiśabdo na śrūyate, nāpyavadhimān‌? dikaśabdānāmavadhyapekṣā pravṛttirbhavati| avadhimānaṣyavadhimapekṣya bhavatīti sāmarthyādanuktī'pyeṣa viśeṣo labhyata iti| `adhastādvasati' iti| `astāti ca' (5.3.40) iti vakṣyamāṇenāstātau parato'dharaśabdasyādeśaḥ| `prāgaseḥ' iti| `asi puradhavaścaiṣām‌' (5.3.39) iti vakṣyamāṇaḥ| keciddikśabdamātrāt‌ pratyayaṃ manyanta iti teṣāṃ matena pūrveṇa vasatītyādyapi bhavati| yadi dikśabdamātrāt‌ pratyo bhavatītyañcātyantādapi syāt‌? bhavatu, `añcerluk‌' (5.3.30) iti lumbhaviṣyati? naitadasti; `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān‌ vidhīn‌ bādhante' (vyā. pa. 10) ityastāterevātrānena luk‌, nānyasya| evaṃ tarhyanyatarasyāmiti vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam‌| tenāñcatyantānna bhaviṣyati| pakāraḥ `enapā dvitīyā' (2.3.31) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ, svarārthaśca|| 36. dakṣiṇādāc‌| (5.3.36) `cakāro viśeṣaṇaārahthaḥ' iti| asati hi tasmin‌ paścāśabda ākārānto nipātita iti tenāpi yoge pañcamī syāt‌| svarārthastu cakāro nopapadyate; pratyayasvareṇaiva siddhatvāt‌|| 37. āhi ca dūre| (5.3.37) 38. uttarācca| (5.3.38) `ājāhī pratyayau bhaktaḥ' iti| nanu cānantaryādāhireva prāpnoti? nana; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa hi vyavahitamapyācaṃ samuccinoti| tenā''japi bhaviṣyatīti|| 39. pūrvādharāvarāṇāmasi puradhavaścaiṣām‌| (5.3.39) pūrvādastātau prāptestātāvavārādapi vibhāṣātasucīdamārabhyate| atha `eṣām‌' iti kimarthamidamucyate, yāvatā yeyaṃ pūrvādiṣu ṣaṣṭhī saiva pratyayaṃ vidhāya sthāne ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate, sambandhabhedācca ṣaṣṭhyarthabhedaḥ? satyametat‌; tathāpi sukhapratipattyarthameṣāmityuktam‌|| 40. astāti ca| (5.3.40) nanu cāsinā badhitatvāt‌ pūrvādibhyo'stātinā na bhavitavyam‌? ityāha--`idameva' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 41. vibhāṣā'varasya| (5.3.41) 42. saṃkhyāyā vidhārthe dhā| (5.3.42) `prakāravacane ca jātīyar‌' (5.3.69) iti, tasyāyamapavādaḥ| `vidhā-prakāraḥ' ityaktaḥ `prakāravacane thāl‌' (5.3.23) ityatra, sa ca dravyaguṇaviśeṣo'pyasti; tatra yadi so'pi gṛhyeta dravyaguṇayorliṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yīgādvā ptyayāntamaliṅgamasaṃkhyaṃ ca na syāt‌| evañca tasyāvyayatvaṃ na syāt‌, tacceṣṭam‌; tathā hi--dhāpratyayo'vyayeṣu paṭhyate--tasilādistaddhita edhācparyanta iti| kriyāviṣaye tu tasmin‌ gṛhyamāṇe na doṣaḥ; kriyāyāḥ sarvadā liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmayogādityetat‌ cetasi kṛtvā''ha--`sa ca' ityādi| kriyādhātuvācyo vikledanādirarthaḥ, sa ca viṣayo'sya sa tathoktaḥ. kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyoktau viśeṣasya grahaṇaṃ labhyate? arthagrahaṇasya hyetadeva prayojanam‌--prakāraviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syāditi, anyathā hi `vidhāyām‌' ityevaṃ hi brūyāt‌| yadi tarhi prakāraḥ kriyāviṣayo gṛhyate, navadhā dravyam‌ nadadhā guṇa ityatra na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ? atrāpi kriyā'vyāharttatavyā| navadhā dravyam‌, navadhā guṇa upapādya vigṛhyate ceti|| 43. adhikaraṇavicāle ca| (5.3.43) 44. ekāddho dhyamuñanyatarasyām‌| (5.3.44) `aikadhyaṃ kuru' iti| adhikaraṇavicāla udāharaṇam‌| aikadhyaṃ bhuṅkte' iti| vidhārthe| atra dhāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, na ca tatra vidhyarthā vṛttiyuktā; pūrvameva vihitatvāt‌| tasmādanuvṛttisāmarthyāt‌ sthānitvaṃ dhāpratyayasya vijñāyata it‌yāha--`prakaraṇādeva labdhe' iti| dhāpratyayasya sthānitva iti śeṣaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasati dhāgrahaṇe vidhārthe vihitasya na bhavati? ityāha--`anantarasyaiva hi' ityādi| asati hi punardhāgrahaṇe `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā. pa. 19) ityadhikaraṇavicālārthe yo vihitastasyaiva syāt‌, na tu vidhārthe yo vihitastasya| punardhāgrahaṇe tu sati dhāmātrasyādeśaḥ siddho bhavati|| 45. dvitryośca dhamuñ| (5.3.45) `matidvaidhāni' iti| nanu ca svārthikāḥ prakṛtidharahmānanuvarttanta iti liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāmatra na bhavitavyam‌? naiva doṣaḥ; ativarttante hi kadācit‌ svārthikāḥ prakṛtidharmān‌ yathā--catvāra eva varṇāścāturvarṇyamiti|| 46. edhācca| (5.3.46) 47. yāpye pāśap‌| (5.3.47) yāpyaśabdo'yaṃ gamayitavye varttate--grāmāntarāt‌ yāpya iti; astyaśakyapratīkāre--yāpyo roga iti, asti kutsite--yāpyo'yamiti, kutsita iti gamyate| pāśappratyayāntāt‌ kutsita eva pratīyata iti tadabhidhāyina eva yāpyaśabdasyevaṃ grahaṇaṃ yuktatam‌| ata evāha--`yāpyaḥ kutsita ityucyate' iti yāpyante-apanīyante tasmādguṇā iti yāpyaḥ, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam‌' (3.3.113) ityapādāne kṛtyaḥ| `tatra kasmānna bhavati' iti| yadyapyasau vyākaraṇe pravīṇaḥ tathāpi duḥśīlatvādbhavitavyameva tatretyabhiprāyaḥ| `yasya' ityādi| guṇo viśeṣaṇam‌ dravyaṃ viśeṣyam‌, tatra dravye yadyapi bahavo guṇāḥ santi, tathāpi yasya guṇasya bhāve dravye śabdo niviśate varttate pratyāsattestasyaiva kutsāyāṃ śabdena bhavitavyam‌; na tu vaiyākaraṇasya duḥśīlatvaṃ pravṛttinimittam‌| kiṃ tarhi? vyākaraṇasya parijñānam‌, adhyayanaṃ vā| na ceha duḥśīlatvena bhavitavyaṃ pratyayena|| 48. pūraṇādbhāge tīyādan‌| (5.3.48) `pūraṇapratyayo yastīyaḥ' iti| `tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ‌' (5.2.48) iti pūraṇādhikāre vihitatvāt‌, pūraṇābhidheyatvādvā| upacārema pratyo'pi tīyaḥ pūraṇa ityucye| `bhāge' iti| aṃśa ityarthaḥ| kimarthaṃ punaridam‌, yāvatā kṛte'pyani rūpaṃ tadeva? ityāha--`svarārthaṃ vacanam‌'iti| vibhāge nitsvareṇādyudāttaṃ yathā syāt‌| `pūraṇagrahaṇamuttarārtham‌' iti| uttaratra pūraṇapratyayāntātpratyayo yathā syāt‌| tasya ca vyavacchedāya kriyamāṇaṃ pūraṇamihāpyarthavat‌ syāt‌, sa ca nāstīti nehārthatā tasyopapadyate| nanu ca `mukhapārśvataserīyaḥ', (vā. 460) `pārśvatīyaḥ' ityapūraṇo'pi so'sti? ityata āha--`mukhatīyādiranarthakaḥ' iti| arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa. 1) arthavāniha tīyo gṛhyate, na ca mukhatīyādiranarthavān‌| ataḥ satyapi pūraṇagrahaṇe tasya grahaṇaṃna bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ|| 49. prāgekādaśabhyo'cchandasi| (5.3.49) 50. ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamābhyāṃ ña ca| (5.3.50) yathāsaṃkhye hi ṣaṣṭhādanyathā prāptaṃ cetyan‌| na ca pūrveṇaiva siddha iti ṣaṣṭhagrahamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmādubhayābhyāmubhayaṃ bhavati|| 51. mānapaśvaṅgayoḥ kanlukau ca| (5.3.51) cakārādyathāprāptaṃ ceti|| 52. ekādākiniccāsahāye| (5.3.52) `ākinicaḥ kano vā lugvijñāyate' iti| pratyāsatteḥ| na tu prakāraṇāntaravihitasya; viprakarṣāt‌| `sa ca' ityādi yadi nityaḥ syāt‌ tadvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmādvidhānasāmarthyāt‌ pakṣe bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasahāyagrahaṇaṃ saṃkhyāśabdanirāsārthaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`tadupādāne hi' ityādi| asatyasahāyagrahaṇe saṃkhyāvācino'pyekaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| tasmistu sati dvibahnorna syāt‌| na hi dvayorbahuṣu vā caikatvasaṃkhyā vidyate| asahāyatā tu śatasyāpi bhavati; tulyajātīyānyasyābhāvāt‌--śatamasahāyamiti| tenā sahāyārthasya grahaṇe dvibahvorapi pratyayaḥ sidhyati| atha kasmādākinijvadhīyate, na akanijityevocyeta, atrāpi savarṇadīrghatveneṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva? na sidhyati; `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌, yasyeti (6.4.148) lopaśca prāpnoti| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; asti hyakāroccāraṇasya prayojanam‌| kim‌? bhasaṃjñāyāmanyaḥ padasaṃjñānibandhano'vagraho mā bhūditi| tasmādākinijeva viṣeyaḥ|| 53. bhūtapūrve caraṭ‌| (5.3.53) kimarthaṃ punaretau samānārtho śabdāvupadiśyete, nānyatara evopadiśyeta? naivaṃ śakyam‌; iha hyatikrāntakālaviśiṣṭe'rthe varttamānāt‌ pratyagrahamiṣyate, sa cātikrāntaḥ kālo'nyataroktau naiva gṛhyate| tathā hi--bhūtaśabdo varttamāne'pyarthe varttate, yathā--bhūtavāniti, pūrvaśabdastu digdeśayorapi| tasmādanyataroktāvatikrāntakālo na pratīyate| ata evā''ha--`bhūtapūrvaśabdo'tikrāntakālavacanaḥ' iti| atha cakārasya `cuṭ‌' (1.3.7) itītsaṃjñā kasmānna bhavati? anityatvāttasya vidheḥ| anityatvaṃ tu tatraiva pratipāditam|| 54. ṣaṣṭhyā rūpya ca| (5.3.54) iha ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ yattdviśeṣaṇaṃ parārthatvādapradhānam‌, itarat‌ punastenaivopakriyamāṇatvādviśeṣyaṃ pradhānam‌| pradhānena ca kāryasampratyaya itadi yatā ṣaṣṭhyantāt‌ pratyavidhāne sampratati ṣaṣṭhyantapratiyogini pradhāne pratyayo vijñāyato, ma prakṛtyarthe; tathā bhūtapūrvagrahaṇaṃ tasyaiva jñāyate, na prakṛtyarthasyetyetadālocyā''ha--`ṣaṣṭhyantāt‌' ityādi| pratyayārthastu ṣaṣṭhyantasya yaḥ pratiyogī sa veditavyaḥ|| 55. atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau| (5.3.55) `atiśāyanam‌' iti| lyuṭ‌| yadyapi śetiḥ kevalaḥ svapne varttate, tathāpyatipūrahvasya prakarṣe vṛttiḥ, ata evā''ha--`prakarṣaḥ' iti| nanu cātiśayanamiti bhavitavyam‌? ityāha--`nipātanāddīrghatvam‌' iti| nipātanaṃ tvatiśāyanaśabdasya katham‌? sādhutvaṃ vijñāyate ityevamartham‌| `prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ caitat' iti| pratyayāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ svāthikānāṃ dyotyaṃ bhavatīti na vācyam‌; tasya prakṛtivācyatvākat‌| `paṭiṣṭhaḥ, laghiṣṭhaḥ' iti| `turiṣṭhemeyassu' (6.4.154) iti ṭilopaḥ| `gariṣṭhaḥ' iti| `priyasthirasphirorubahulaguru' (6.4.157) ityādinā guruśabdasya garādeśaḥ| `prakarṣapratyayāntādapareṇa pratyayena na bhavitavyam‌, ekenaiva pratyayasya dyotitatvāt‌' iti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha--`yadā ca' iti| yatra prathame prakarṣe ātiśāyaniko vihitaḥ'; tatra tenaiva dyotitatvād‌dvitīyo mā bhūta prakarṣapratyayaḥ| prakarṣāntaratve ātiśāyanapratyayāntādyuktamevāpareṇātiśāyikena pratyayena bhavitum‌, tadadyotitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| iṣṭhani parataḥ `praśasyasya śraḥ' (5.3.60), pūrveṇa saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| iṣṭhanpratyāntāt‌ tamapprakarṣapratyayaḥ| atra pratiyogyapekṣo yaḥ prakarṣaḥ pūrvasmāt‌ prakarṣāt‌ sa prakarṣa iṣṭhanpratyayena dyotitaḥ| nanu ca nāsyātiśāyikasya vidhāyakaṃ vākyamasti, yena tasmin‌ vihite tadantādaparaḥ prakarṣa ātiśāyāniko vidhīyeta, idameva hyekaṃ vākyam‌, tatrānenaiva vidhīyamāne prakarṣapratyayo tadantāyāḥ prakṛterasambhava ityayukta ātiśāyikādaparasyātiśāyikasya bhāvaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha vidhīyamānapratatyayabhedāddve ete vākye, tatraikeneṣṭhan‌ vidhīyate, apareṇa tu tadantāt‌ tamap‌|| 56. tiṅśca| (5.3.56) `pacatitamām‌' iti| `kimettiṅavyayaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe' (5.4.11) ityām‌| `guṇavacane' ityādi| iṣṭhano'nudāharaṇe hetuḥ| `ajādī guṇavacanādeva' (5.3.58) iti niyama iti, tata eva tena bhavitavyam‌| na ca tiṅnto guṇavacanaḥ, ato nāsāvudāhriyate|| 57. dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunau| (5.3.57) `dvayorarthayorvacanaṃ dvivacanam‌' iti| etenānvarthasya dvivacanasya grahaṇam‌, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati yadi hi pāribhāṣikaṃ dvivacanaṃ, gṛhyeta, `asmākaṃ ca devadattasya devadatto'bhirūpataraḥ ityatra pratyayo na syāt‌; pāribhāṣikatasya dvivacanasyābhāvāt‌| anvarthasya tu grahaṇe sati bhavati dvyarthatopapadasya| tathā hi--asmākamityanenaiko'rtha ucyate, ekasminnevārthe `asmado dvayośca' (1.2.59) iti bahuvacanasya vidhīnāt‌| devadattasyetyanenāpi dvitīyo'rtha ucyata iti bhavatyeva tadanvarthadvivacanamupapadam‌| tadevamanvarthasya grahaṇe sarvatra sidhyatīti tasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti manyate| `vibhaktavyaḥ' iti| pṛthak‌ karttavya ityarthaḥ| yaḥ punaratiśayyamānastasyopapadatvam‌, nātiśayituḥ; tataḥ pratyavidhānāt‌| nanu ca `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124) iti ṇyati kṛte vibhāgya iti bhavitavyam‌, kathaṃ vibhajya iti nirdeśa upapadyate? ityāha--`nipātanādyadbhavati' iti| iha dve upapade, evaṃ prakṛtī ca pratyayāvapi dvāveva, tataśca yathāsaṃkhyena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhāntiḥ syāt‌, atastannirāsārthamāha--`yathāsaṃkhyām‌'cāracihnāt‌| sa hi lakṣaṇāntaranirapekṣatāṃ darśayan‌ yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīha nāpekṣeteti sūcayati| `paṭīyān‌ iti| pūrvavaṭṭilopaḥ, `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| (6.1.68; 8.2.23)| `māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhyatarāḥ' iti `pañcamī vibhakte' (2.3.42) ityanena pañcamī| pāṭaliṃputrakebhya ityedatra vibhajyopapadam‌, pāṭaliputrakā hi māthurebhyo vibhajyante-pṛthak‌ kriyante| nanū caitadapi `dvivacanopapade' ityeva siddham‌, asti hyatra dvivacanamupapadam‌, tathā hi--māthurāṇāmeko rāśiḥ, aparaḥ pāṭaliputrakāṇām‌, tau ca dvivacanenocyete, tasmādvibhajyagrahaṇamanarthakam‌? naitadasti; yadyapyatra rāśyapekṣā dvyarthatā'sti, tathāpi nāsau śabdenopādīyate| kiṃ tarhi? avayavabhedaḥ| ata eva māthurāḥ pāṭaliputrakebhya iti bahuvacanam‌| iha rāśyapekṣāpi dvyarthatā nāstīti--sāṅkāśyakebhyaḥ pāṭaliputrakebhyaśca māthurāḥ sukumāratarā iti| tasmādvibhajyagrahaṇamapi karttavyam‌|| 58. ajādī guṇavacanādeva| (5.3.58) `pācakataraḥ' iti| kartṛśaktimato dravyasyābhidhānāddravyavacano'yaṃ pācakaśabdaḥ| athaivakāraḥ kimarthaḥ, yāvatā siddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo vināpi tena niyamārtho bhavati?ityāha-`evakāraḥ' ityādi| asati hyevakāre viparītamavaṣāraṇaṃ vijñāyate--ajādī eva guṇavacanāditi, tataśca yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti prakṛtiniyamaḥ syāt‌| evaṃ ca guṇavacanasyājādyoniyatatvāt‌ tatastarabādirnaṃ syāt‌| evakāre tu prakṛtyanantaramuccāryamāṇe sati pratyayārthaniyamo'yaṃ bhavati na prakṛtiniyama iti paṭutaraḥ, paṭutama iti siddhaṃ bhavati| etayorapi siddhyarthaṃ `guṇavacanādiṣṭhannīyasunau' iti sūtraṃ na kṛtam‌| tadā vidhyarthatvādetau taraptamaporapavādatvādbādhakāviti tayorabhāve paṭutaraḥ, paṭutama iti na sidhyet‌|| 59. tucchandasi| (5.3.59) `karipṭhaḥ' iti| karttṛśabdāt‌ tṛnnantādiṣṭhan‌, `turiṣṭhemeyassu' (6.4.154) iti tṛśabdalopaḥ| `dohīyasī' iti| dogdhrīśabdāt‌ tṛnnantādīyasun‌, tṛśabdasya lope kṛte nimittābhāvādghatvādinivarttate, `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp‌|| 60. praśasyasya śraḥ| (5.3.60) nanu cājīdī iti prathamāntam‌, tatkathamajādyoḥ parata ādeśo labhyate? ityāha--`ajādī' itaci| `tadviṣayaḥ' iti| sa praśasyaśabdo viṣayo yasya sa tadviṣayaḥ| `ajādī guṇavacanādeva' (5.3.58) itatyanena yo niyamaḥ sa tadviṣaye na pravarttata iti darśayati| `evamuttareṣvapi' iti| `vṛddhasya ca' (5.3.62) ityevamādiṣu| ayamanayoḥ ayamanayoḥ śreyāniti dvivacanopapada īyasun‌ ayamasmāt‌ śreyāniti vibhajyopapade| pūrvatra nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī (2.3.41), uttaratra `pañcamī vibhakte' (2.3.42) iti pañcamī|| 61. jya ca| (5.3.61) yogavibhāgo yathāsaṃkhyanivṛttyarthaḥ, uttarārthaśca| uttaratra vṛddhaśabdasya jyādeśa eva yathā syāt‌, śrādeśo mā bhūviti|| 62. vṛddhasya ca| (5.3.62) `vṛddhaśabdasya' iti| `vṛddha' ityetasya śabdasyetyarthaḥ| etena `vṛddhasya' iti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ darśayati| nanu ca vṛddhaśabdaśca saṃjñā kṛtā--`vṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddham‌' (1.1.73) iti, atastatpratyāyitasyaiva saṃjñino grahaṇaṃ na svarūpasya, `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā' (1.1.68) iti vacanāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ, `praśasyasya' ityetadihānuvarttate, tena vṛddhaśabdo viśeṣyate--praśasyasya vṛddhasyeti| svarūpagrahaṇe vayo'dhike ca śabdārthe praśasyatā yujyate, na pāribhāṣikagrahaṇe| atha vā--sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā (1.1.50) jyaśabdasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva sthāno vijñāyate, antaratamaśca tasya vṛddhaśabda eva, tena tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌| `tayośca' ityādi| yathā `praśasyasya śraḥ' (5.3.60) ityatra niyamābhāvenājādyoḥ pratyayayoḥ sattvaṃ jñāpitam‌, tathehāpi jñāpyate| niyamābhāvastvajādyoḥ parataḥ pūrvavadādeśaviṣānādeva veditavyaḥ|| 63. antikabāḍhayornedasādhau| (5.3.63) `nimittyoḥ' ityādi| nimittau pratyayau, tayoḥ parata ādeśavidhānāt‌| kasmāt‌ punariṣyamāṇo na bhavati? alpācyatasya paranipātāt‌| sa hi lakṣaṇāntarānapekṣatāmācaṣṭe| tena yathāsaṃkhyalakṣaṇamapīha nāpekṣyate| yadyevam‌, sthānyādeśayorapi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti? mā bhūdyathāsaṃkhyam‌, āntaratamyādvyavasthā bhaviṣyati| nanu ca vyavasthākāri cellakṣaṇāntaraṃ nāpekṣyate, sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣāpi (1.1.50) na prāpnoti? naitadasti; nirveśānyathātvaṃ hi nirdeśakṛtā vyāvasthā nāstītyetadeva bodhayati, yā tvarthakṛtā vyavasthā tāṃ na nivarttayati| api cādeśapratipattaye `ṣaṣṭhī sthāne yogā' (1.1.49) ityeṣā paribhāṣā niyogato'pekṣaṇauyā| taccheṣabhūtā `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ (1.1.50) iti paribhāṣā kathaṃ śakyā nāpekṣitum‌|| 64. yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām‌| (5.3.64) atrāpi nimittayoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ neṣyate, tasya hyabhāvaḥ `ajādyadantam‌' (2.2.33) ityalpaśabdāsya pūrvanipāte paranipātāllakṣaṇānapekṣāccihnillabhyate, yuveti svarūpagarahaṇamiṣyate, na jīvattvaṃ vaṃśasya| kasmāt‌? ihāpi `praśasyasya' (5.3.60) ityetadanuvarttate, tena yuvaśabdo viśeṣayitavyaḥ--praśasyasya yūna iti| svarūpagrahaṇe sarvalokābhimatayauvanākhyavayaḥsambandhe śabdārthe praśaṃsopapadyate, na pāribhāṣikagrahaṇe| atha vā--sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā (1.1.50) kannityādeśasya yo'ntaratamaḥ sa eva sthāniti vijñāyate, antaratamaśca yuvaśabda eva| tasmāt svarūpasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌| `anyatarasyāṃ' grahaṇamihālpaśabda eva prayojayati, na yuvaśabdaḥ, tasya vināpi tena vikalpaḥ siddha eva; `sthūlaṭūrayuvahrasvakṣiprakṣudrāṇāṃ yaṇādiparaṃ pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ' (6.4.156) iti vacanāt‌| na hi nitya ādeśe yaṇādeḥ parasya lopaḥ sambhavati, nāpi pūrvabhāgo guṇabhāk‌| `yaviṣṭhaḥ, yavīyān‌' iti| sthūladūrādisūtreṇa (6.4.156) yaṇādeḥ paraṃ lupyate, pūrvasya ca guṇo bhavati|| 65. vinmatorluk‌| (5.3.65) matupā sāhacaryāt‌ matvarthīya eva vinipratyayo gṛhyate--`tapaḥ sahasrābhyāṃ vinīnī' (5.2.102), `asmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121) iti; ābhyāṃ caitadeva lugvacanamajādyobhaviṃ jñāpayati| `sragviṇau'| iti| asmāyādisūtrema (5.2.121) viniḥ| `srajiṣṭhaḥ' iti| `prakṛtyaikāc‌' (6.4.163) iti prakṛtibhāvāṭṭilopābhāvaḥ|| 66. praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap‌| (5.3.66) `svārthikāśca' ityādi| prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇaṃ prasaṃsādi, tasya dyotakāḥ svārthikā bhavanti, na tvathantirasya vācakāḥ| yadi praśaṃsāyāṃ varttmānādrūpabvidhīyate, nindāyāṃ varttamānānna prāpnoti-vṛṣaṣalarūpo'yam‌, caurarūpo'yamiti| vṛṣalādayo hi śabdāḥ sadā nindāvacanāḥ; na kadācitpraśaṃsāyāṃ varttante, yathā kākādayaḥ śabdāḥ? ityata āha--`prakṛtyarthasya' ityādi| prakṛtyarthasya vaiśiṣṭyaṃ paripūrṇatvam‌, tasmin‌ sati praśaṃsā bhavati| evañca yadā vṛṣalādiśabdānāmapi padārthasya paripūrṇatā bhavati, tadā te praśaṃsāyāṃ varttante iti tebhyo'pi pratyayo bhavati| palāṇḍubhakṣaṇena surāpāṇena ca prakṛtyarthasya paripūrṇatā bhavati, tadā te praśaṃsāyāṃ varttante iti tebhyo'pi pratyayo bhavati| palāṇḍubhakṣaṇena surāpāṇena ca prakṛtyarthasya paripūrraṇatāṃ darśayati| vṛṣalaśabdasya hi śūdro vācyaḥ| sa yadā palāṇḍvādikamapi sādhujanagahitamabhyavaharati tadā pa rapūrṇatvaṃ tasya śūdratvam‌| śūdraḥ-sarvāśī, sarvavikrayīti| cauraśabdārthasyāpi suguptavastvapahāreṇa paripūrṇatā bhavati| nanu ca `svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvarttante' (vyā.pa.74) iti prakṛtyarthasya ye liṅgavacane te svārthikapratyayāntasyāpi bhavata iti bhāvaḥ| tataśca pacatorūpam‌, pacantirūpamityatra dvivacanabahavacanābhyāṃ bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`kriyāpradhānam‌' ityādi| ākhyātasya yadyapi kriyā sādhanañcobhayaṃ vācyam‌, tathāpi tasya kriyaiva pradhānamarthaḥ| yaśca pradhānaṃ prakṛtyarthastasyaiva liṅgavacanaṃ svārthikairanuvarttayituṃ yuktam‌| kriyāpradhānamekaiva ca kriyā| tena rūpappratyayāntādākhyātād‌dvivacanabahavacane na bhavataḥ| napuṃsakaliṅgamapi tarhi na syāt‌, kriyāyā aliṅgatvāt‌? ityata āha--`napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ tu' ityādi| tatraiva hetumāha--`lokāśrayatvālliṅgasya' iti| yadi tarhi hyokā kriyā, pacataḥ, pacantīti dvivacanabahuvacane na sidhyataḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyapi hyekā kriyā, sādhanaṃ hyanekam‌, atastadāśraye dvivacanabahuvacane bhaviṣyataḥ| rūpappratyayāntāt‌ tarhi syātām‌? tiṅntenoktatvānna bhaviṣyataḥ| ekavacanaṃ tu bhaviṣyati; tasyautsargirakatvāt‌, `ekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyate' iti vacanāt‌|| 67. īṣadasamāptau kalpabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ| (5.3.67) 68. vibhāṣā supo bahuc‌ purastāttu| (5.3.68) vibhāṣāgrahaṇeneha bahuc‌ sambadhyate, na purastādityetat; tena bahucaḥ pūrvatvaṃ na viklpyata iti nityameva tadbhavati, ata evāha--`sa tu purastādeva' iti| evakārema tuśabdasyāvadhāraṇārthatāṃ darśayati| yadi punastuśabdo' vadhāraṇārtho na kriyate, tato na jñāyate--kiṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇena bahuc‌ sambadhyate, atha purastāditayetaditi! tu śabdena tvavadhāraṇārthena purastāditatyetasmin‌ niyamite pāriśeṣyādvibhāṣāvacane bahujevābhisambadhyata iti vijñāyate| `citkaraṇamantodāttārtham‌' iti| kasya punarantodāttatvaṃ citkarādbhavati? saprakṛteḥ samudāyasya;`citaḥ saprakṛterba hvakajartham‌' (vā.6.1.163) iti vacanāt‌| yadyevam‌, paṭava iti subantādutpattau jasa udāttatvaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bahucyutpanne sati `arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipadikam‌ (1.2.45) iti prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyām‌, `supo dhātuprātipādikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti subluk‌ tāvat‌ kriyate, tasmin‌ kṛte paścādudāttatvaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ paṭuśabde ya ukārastasya bhavati| yastu punaḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ subluki ca kṛte anyo jas‌ utpadyate, tasyodāttatvaṃ nāśahkanīyam‌, na hyasau prakṛtyekadeśaḥ| nanu cārthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti bahucpūrvasya prātipadikasaṃjñayā na bhavitav‌yam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tulyajātīyasya niyamaḥ| kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ? yathājātīyakānāṃ samāsaḥ| kathañjātīyakānāṃ samāsaḥ? bhadasaṃsargavatām‌| bhedasaṃsargau ca pṛthagarthānāmeva bhavataḥ| dyotakānāñca pṛthagarthavattā na sambhavati| atha kasmāt‌ subluk‌ tāvat‌ kriyate, paścādantodāttatvam‌, yāvatā paratvādantodāttatve nai va pūrvaṃ yuktaṃ bhavitum‌? naitadasti; nityo hi luk‌, kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt‌| sa hi kṛte'pyantodāttatve prāpnoti, akṛte'pi; antodāttatvaṃ tvanyasya luki kṛte prāpnoti| anyasyākṛte śabdāntarasya prāpnuvan‌ vidhiranityo bhavati, tasmāllugeva tāvat‌ kriyate| `bahuguḍā drākṣā' iti| kathaṃ punaratreṣadasamāptiḥ, yāvatā guḍaśabdena guḍajātirucyate, tadādhāro vā dravyam‌| tatra jātistāvadekā, niravayavā ceti sarvasminnāśraye samāptā, dravyamapi yat‌ tayā sambaddhaṃ tat‌ sarvataḥ pūrṇatvāt‌ samāptameva| tasmādīṣadasamāptirayuktamiha viśeṇam‌, asambhavāt‌? sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca bahuguḍā drākṣeti drākṣāśabdena na prāpneti, tasyārthāntaratvāt‌? strīliṅgamapi `svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvarttante' (vyā. pa. 74) iti nopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha śabdāduccāritāddvayaṃ pratīyate--śabdo'rthaḥ, jātirdravyañca; abhidheyasambandhenāśabdārthabhūtā api guṇāḥ, yatraitadubhayamasti tatra samāptiḥ| yatra tvanyatarannāsti tatreha guḍaśabdo guḍajātihīne mādhuryādiguṇahīne vā dravye varttate ityupapadyata īṣadasamāntiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamapyupadyata eva| katham‌? yadā tāvajjātihīne kenacit‌ sādharmyeṇa drākṣādiśabdābhidheye varttitvā guḍaśabdaḥ pratyayamutpadayata, tadā drākṣāśabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati; ubhayorekārthavṛttitvāt‌| yadā tu guṇahīne guḍajītīya eva, tadāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyam‌, gaurvāhīka iti yathā, tathā bhaviṣyati guṇahīno'pi guḍaśabdaḥ| guḍo bahuguḍaśabdenottyate, tena ca tulyā drākṣeti sā'pi bahuguḍaśabdenābhidāyiṣyate| strīliṅgamapi copapadyate; tasya lokāśrayatvāt‌| api ca `svārthikāḥ prakṛteliṃṅgavacanānyanuvarttante (vyā. pa. 74) iti prāyikametata| tena kadācidativarttatante'pi, yathā kuṭīraḥ, śamīra iti| `kuṭīśamīśuṇḍābhyo raḥ' (5.3.88) iti svārthikaśca| `vibhāṣāvacanāt‌' ityādinā vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya prayojanamācaṣṭe| asati hi vibhāṣāgrahaṇe tiḍanteṣu kṛtāvakāśāḥ kalpabādayo bahucā subantādviśeṣavihitena bādhyeran‌ tasmistu satadi pakṣe te'pi bhavanti| nanu ca bhinnadeśena bahucā nāsti teṣāṃ virodhaḥ, tatkuto bādhā? asatyāṃ vā bādhāyāṃ kṛte'pi bahuci tairbhavitavyameva, paradaśasyānavaṣṭabdhatvāt‌? naitadasti; na hyavaśyaṃ deśakṛta eva sāmānyaviśeṣayorvirodho bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? arthakṛto'pi| bahucaśca kalpabādibhiḥ samānortha iti bahucā dyotitatvāt‌ tasyārthasya kalpabādayo na bhavaviṣyanti| na hi dyotite punardyotanamasti, yathābhihite nābhidhātavyam‌| atha subgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā prātipadikagrahaṇamanuvarttate, na ca prātipadikāt‌ subantādvā bahuca utpattau kaścidviśeṣo'sti? ata āha--`subgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| asati hi subgrahaṇe `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) iti prakṛtatvāt‌ tato hi pratyayaḥ syāt‌| atastannivṛttyarthaṃ subagrahaṇam‌|| 69. prakāravacane jātīyar‌| (5.3.69) `tasya vacane' iti| uktau, dyotana ityarthaḥ| `prakāravati cāyam‌' ityādinā thāljātīyarorviṣayabhedaṃ darśayati| viṣayabhede sati viśeṣavihitenāpi tālā jātīyaro bādhanaṃ na bhavati| thālpratyāntāt‌ jātīyar‌ siddho bhavati--kathañjātīya iti|| 70. prāgivātkaḥ| (5.3.70) tiṅantādayaṃ pratyayo neṣyate| `akajiṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punaretayorbhāvābhāvau labhyete? ityāha--`tiṅaścetyanuvṛttam‌' ityādi| uttaratraivetyavadhāraṇena tvihānuvṛttamapi kapratyayena sambandhanīyamiti darśayati| tacca pūrvasūtrādvacanagrahaṇe'pyanuvarttamāne yata utpadyamānena pratyayenājñātāderarthasya vacanaṃ bhavati, tatraiva tena bhavitavyam‌| na ca tiṅntādutpadyamānenāpi kapratyayena so'rthaḥ śakyate dyotayituṃ, akacā tu śakyate| tasmāt‌ `tiṅśca' (5.3.56) ityetadanuvṛttamuttarasūtreṇākacā sambandhanīyam‌, neha kapratyayena| prāggrahaṇamapidyotanārtham‌, ivagrahaṇamavadhyartham‌; anyathādhikāraparimāṇaṃ na jñāyate|| 71. avyayasarvanāmnāmakacprāk‌ ṭeḥ| (5.3.71) `kasyāpavādaḥ' iti| nanu ca bhinnadeśatvāt‌ kākacorvirodho nāsti, na cāsati virodhe bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ, tataḥ kathaṃ kasyāpavādaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; naivāvaśyaṃ deśakṛta eva virodho bhavati, api tvarthakṛto'pītyuktam‌--`akac‌pratyayena samānorthaḥ' iti| akacā dyotitatavāt‌ tasyārthasya kapratyayo na bhaviṣyati| yadyatra prātipadikādityanuvṛtteḥ prātipadikasya prāk‌ ṭerakajvidhīyate, tvayakā mayaketyādi na sidhyati? atha supa iti prāk‌ ṭervidhīyeta, evamapi yuṣmakābhiriti na siṣyati? ityata āha--`prātipadikātsupaḥ' iti| `dvayamapi' ityādi| nanu ca dvayānuvṛttāvapi kvacit‌ subantasyaiva prākṭerbhavati, kvacit‌ prātipadikasya--ityeṣā vyavasthā na labhyate? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| vacanagrahaṇaṃ vyavasthārthamihānuvarttate| tena yatra prātipadikasya prākṭerutpadyamānenārthadyotanaṃ śakyate kartum‌, tatra prātipadikasya prāk‌ ṭerbhavati; yatra subantādutpannenārthadyotanaṃ śakyaṃ sampādayituṃ, tatra subantasyaiva| akacaścitkaraṇamantodāttārtham‌| taddhi saprakṛteḥ samudāyasya| tathā ca vakṣyati--`citaḥ saprakṛterbahvakajartham‌' (vā. 6.1.163)| `tūṣṇīmaḥ kāmpratyayo vaktavyaḥ' iti| yathāsambhavaṃ kutsādiṣvartheṣu| cakāro deśavidhyarthaḥ| `śīle ko malopaśca' iti| śīlamiti na svabhāva evocyate, kiṃ tarhi? niyamo'pi| tathā hi--śīlavān‌ bhikṣurityabhidhīyate, yaḥ samyaṅniyamamanupālayatīti| tena yo'pi niyamaparatayā vācaṃ niyamayati so'pi tūṣṇīka ucyate|| 72. kasya ca daḥ| (5.3.72) `akacsanniyogena' ityādi| kathaṃ punarakacsanniyogenetyeṣa viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatā na sūtre taduktam‌? ityāha--`cakāraḥ' ityādi| cakārasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--akacsanniyogena kakārasya dakāro yathā syāditi bhāvaḥ|| 73. ajñāte| (5.3.73) `ajñātaviśeṣo'jñātaḥ' iti| yadi yasyātyantamajñānaṃ so'jñātaḥ syāt‌, evaṃ sati sarvathā vastuvijñānā bhāve prakṛtireva na syāt‌, na hi sarvathā'vijñāto'rthaḥ prayogamarhati; tasmāt‌ svena rūpeṇa jñātasya yasya dharmāntaratvamajñātaṃ sa ihājñāto'bhimata iti jñāyate--avijñātaviśeṣo'jñāta iti| asyaivārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha--`svena' ityādi| svarūpamaśvatvādi, viśeṣarūpaṃ svasvāmisambandhādi|| 74. kutsite| (5.3.74) 75. saṃjñāyāṃ kan‌| (5.3.75) 76. anukampāyām‌| (5.3.76) `kāruṇṇena' ityādi| abhyupapattiranugraha eva| `svapitaki, śvasitaki' iti| `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) iṭ‌, adāditvācchapo luk‌|| 77. nītau ca tadyuktāt‌| (5.3.77) `sāmadānādirūpāyo nītiḥ' iti| ādiśabdena bhedadaṇḍayorgrahaṇam‌; tautvanukampāyāṃ na sambhavata iti sāmadānādirekaiva nītirguhyate, `ehaki' iti| iṇa āṅapūrvālloṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanasya `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti hirādeśaḥ| nanu pūrveṇaivātrāpi pratyayaḥ siddhaḥ, atrāpayanukampā gamyata eva, tata kimartham‌ ityāha--`pūrveṇaiva' ityādi| pratyāsanno'nukampāsambandho yasyānukampayamānasya sa tathoktaḥ| pratyāsannatvaṃ tu sambandhasaryānukampyānaṃprati; tadāśrayatvādanukampāyāṃ vidhīyamānaḥ pratyāsatteryasyānukampayā pratyāsannaḥ sambandhastataḥ eva yukto vidhātumiti pūrvemānukampyamānādeva pratyo vihitaḥ, na tu vyavahitāt‌ punarghānādeḥ| ataḥ samprati tato'pi yathā syādityevamarthamidam‌| `vyavahitāt‌' iti| viprakṛṣṭādityarthaḥ| viprṛṣṭatvamatadāśrayatvādanukampāyāḥ| na hi tasyāṃ dhānādirāśrayaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? anukampyamāno devadattādiḥ|| 78. bahvaco manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhajvā| (5.3.78) `devikaḥ' iti| `yajñikaḥ' iti| `ṭhājāvūrdhvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ' (5.3.83) iti dattaśabdasya lope kṛte `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ| pratyudāharaṇe sarvatra ka eva veditavyaḥ| `madrabāhukaḥ' iti| madrau bāhū yasya sa madrabāhuḥ| nedaṃ manuṣyanāma, kiṃ tarhi? viśeṣaṇam‌| manuṣyagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌? devahastako hastītyatra mā bhūt‌| nāma grahaṇaṃ kimartham‌? mṛgakaḥ, matsyaka ityatra mā bhūt‌|| 79. ghanilacau ca| (5.3.79) `deviyaḥ' iti| ghan‌ pūrvavallopaḥ| `devilaḥ' iti ilac‌| `devikaḥ' iti| ṭhan‌| `devadattakaḥ' iti kaḥ|| 80. prācāmupāderaḍajvucau ca| (5.3.80) upaḍa ityādau upendradattaśabdātpratyayaḥ| vikalpārthaṃ prāggrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`vetyeva hi' ityādi| atra he vetyanuvarttate, tasmāttenaiva vikalpasya sampāditatvāt‌ tadarthagrahaṇaṃ nopapadyate|| 81. jātināmnaḥ kan‌| (5.3.81) `nāmagrahaṇam‌' iti| asati hi nāmagrahaṇe jātisvarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌| ataḥ svarūpagravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ jātigrahaṇam‌|| 82. ajināntasyottarapadalopaśca| (5.3.82) `vyāghrājino nāma kaścit‌' iti| vyāghrasyājinam‌, vyāghrājinamivājinaṃ yasyeti vyāghrājinaḥ| `saptamyupamānapūrvasya bahuvrīhiruttarapadalopaśca' (vā. 99) iti bahuvrīhāvuttarapadalope kṛte vyāghrājina ityeṣa śabdaḥ sampadyate| athājinalopaścetyevaṃ kasmānnoktam‌, kimuttarapadagrahaṇena? naivaṃ śakyam‌; vyāghramahājinau nāmakaścit‌, so'nukampitaḥ--vmāghraka ityatrājinaśabdasya lopa ucyamāne mahacchabdasya nivṛttirna syāt‌| uttarapadasyatu lope vidhīyamāne bhavati| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu| mahadajinaṃ mahājinam‌, vyāghrasya mahājinamiva mahājinamasyeti pūrvavaduttarapadalopī bahuvrīhiḥ, tataḥ kan‌|| 83. ṭhājādāvūrdhvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ| (5.3.83) `asmin‌ prakaraṇe' ityādi| anenāsmin‌ prakaraṇe yau vihitau ṭhājādī tatra lopī bhavati, yau tu prakaraṇāntare tatra na bhavatīti darśayati| etaccaitatprakaraṇa vihitayoṣṭhājādyorihānuvutterlabhyate| athordhvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `dvitīyādacaḥ' iti pañcamī, tasmādantareṇāpyūrṣvagrahaṇam‌, `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityūrdhvaṃ yacchabdarūpaṃ tasyaiva lopo bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`urdhvaṃgrahaṇam‌' it‌yādi| asatyūrdhvaṃgrahaṇe `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti dvitīyādaco yaḥ parastasyāderlopaḥ syāt‌, tasmistadu sati sarve nivarttate| ataḥ sarvasya lopo yathā syādityevamarthamūrdhvaṃgrahaṇam‌| atha ṭhagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā ṭhasyekādeśe kṛte'jādāvityeva siddham‌? ityata āha--`ṭhagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| uko dvitīyatve satyakṛta evekādeśe ṭhāvasthāyāmeva dvitīyādūrdhvasya lope kṛte `isusuktāntāt‌ kaḥ' (7.3.51) iti kavidhiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ ṭhagrahaṇam‌| tatraitat‌ syāt‌ codyam‌--ikādeśe kṛte'jādilakṣate ca dvitīyādūrdhvasya lope sthānivadbhāvāṭṭhagrahaṇena grahaṇāt kādeśo bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`ajādilakṣaṇe hi' ityādi| ihādeśavidhau tatra ṭhagrahaṇaṃ varṇagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, saṅghātagrahaṇaṃ vā; tatra varṇagrahaṇe'lvidhitvāt‌ sthānivadbhāvo nopapadyate| sahghātagrahaṇe yadyapyupapadyate, tathāpi `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya' (vyā.pa.12) ityajāditvasannipātakṛtamukaḥ ṭhapratyayenānantaryyamiti tadajāditvavighātaṃ na kuryāt‌| tataśca yathā--mathitaṃ paṇyamasya māthitika ityatra yasyeti (6.4.148) lope satyapi takāreṇa ṭhasyānantaryye kādeśo na bhavati, tatā vāyudatto vāyuka iti na syāt‌| tasmāduko dvitīyatve kavidhānārthaṃ ṭhagrahaṇam‌| `uvarṇāllaḥ' iti| tasya ca lopa ityarthaḥ| sa cādereva bhavati, na sarvasya| athavā--la ityādeśaevāyaṃ sarve lasya vidhīyate| ca cānekāltvātsarvasyaiva bhavati| `dvitīyādacaḥ' iti| dvitīyalope karttavye sandhyakṣarasya dvitīyatvaṃ bhavati yadā, tadādeḥ śabdarūpasya lopo bhavatīti vaktavyam‌| sandhyakṣarādūrdhvasya lopo'pi prāpte sandhyakṣarasyaikākṣarapūrvapadānāmityādi dvitīyādaca ūrṣvasya lopaḥ uktaḥ, tadapavādaḥ| `ekākṣara' iti| akṣaraśabdaścāyamacyapi varttate| ekākṣaramekāca pūrvaṃpadaṃ yeṣāṃ te, teṣāmuttarapadalopo vaktavyaḥ| `vāgāśīḥ' iti| vācyāśīrasyeti kṛtvā vaiyadhikaraṇye bahuvrīhiḥ| anukampito bāgāśīriti vigṛhyaṭhaci kṛte dvitīyādaca ūrdhvasya lopaḥ syāt‌| tasmin‌ sati vāc‌-ā-ika iti sthite yasyeti (6.4.148) lope kṛte `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūravavighau' (1.1.54) iti sthānivadbhāvātpadasaṃjñā na syāt‌| tasmāt‌ tasyāntarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñā, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌--vāgika iti syāt‌| āśīḥśabdasya tasya paralope kṛte tasyānajādeśātvāt‌ sthānivadbhāvo nāstīti bhasaṃjñā bhavatyeva, tatastayā padasaṃjñāyā niṣidvāyāṃ padanibandhanakutvādi na bhavatīti vācika iti sidhyati| `katham‌' ityādi| yadyekākṣarapūrvapadānāmuttarapadasya lopa ucyate, ṣaḍika iti na sidhyati| atrāpyuttaralope kṛte bhasaṃjñāyānupajātāyāṃ padasaṃjñāyāṃ bādhitāyām‌ `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti ṣaṣaḥ ṣakārasya jaśtve kṛte ṣaḍika iti na sidhyati|| 84. śevalasupariviśālavaruṇāryamādīnāṃ tṛtīyāt‌| (5.3.84) `sa cākṛtasandhīnām‌' iti| yadyasvarasandhau lopo bhavatyevaṃ sidhyati, nānyathā| tasmādakṛtasvarasandhīnāmeva śevalādīnāṃ lopo bhavatīti vaktavyam‌|| 85. alpe| (5.3.85) 86. hvaṃsve| (5.3.86) `dīrghapratiyogī hrasvaḥ' iti| sa punaryamapekṣya dīrgho bhavati sa veditavyaḥ| nanu ca dīrghatvāpacaye sati hrasvo bhavati; yatra dīrghatvāpacayastatrālpatāstīti pūrveṇaiva siddham‌? na sidhyati; na hyayaṃ niyogaḥ--yatra dīrghasyāpacayastatrālpatvena bhavitavyamiti, tathā hi--satyapyapacaye mahattvaguṇayuktaṃ yadvastu tadamahadeva bhavati, na cālpam‌|| 87. saṃjñāyāṃ kan‌| (5.3.87) 88. kuṭīśamīśuṇaaḍābhyo raḥ| (5.3.88) `kuṭīraḥ| śamīraḥ' iti| svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanṛvarttate iti prakṛtigatenaiva strīliṅgena bhavitavyam‌, na pulliṅgena? ityata āha--`svārthikatve'pi' ityādi|| 89. kutvā ḍupac‌| (5.3.89) 90. kāsūgoṇībhyāṃ ṣṭarac‌| (5.3.90) 91. vatsokṣāśvarṣabhebhyaśca tanutve| (5.3.91) yadi tanutve vatsādiśabdebhyaḥ pratyayo vidhīyate, ye śarīre kṛśā vatsādayastatrāpyaviśeṣeṇa pratyayaḥ prasajyeta, viśeṣānupādānāt‌? ityata āha--`yasya guṇasya' ityādi| guṇo viśeṣaṇam‌, viśeṣyaṃ dravyam‌| vatsādiśabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ vayoviśeṣādi| yasmin‌ sati vatsādayaḥ śabdā dravye viśeṣye niviśante-pravarttate, tasyaiva vatsādiśabdasya pravṛttinimittsya tanutve pratyo bhavati, na tanutvamātre; tat‌ punaḥ pratyāsatteḥ| vatsādibhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ pratyaye vidhīyamāne anyat‌ pravṛttinimittaṃ na pratyāsannama, tatastasyaiva tanutve yuktaṃ pratyayena bhavitavyam‌| `tasya tanutvaṃ dvitīyavayasaḥ prāptiḥ' iti| tṛtīyavayaḥprāptikāle dvitīyasya vayasaḥ| ukṣaśabdasya pravṛttinimittasya niścitaṃ tanutvamavaśiṣyate| `tasya tanutvamanyapitṛkatā' iti| gardabhapitṛktetyarthaḥ| tarhi gardabhādaśvāyāmutpanno'śvatara ityucyete| `tasya tanutvaṃ bhārodvaharne mandaśaktitā' iti| bhārodvahanaṃ prati yaḥsamartho na syāt‌ sa ṛṣabhatara ityucyate| yadā tu tasya bhārodvahane sāmarthyaṃ mandaṃ bhavati-hīyate, tadā tanutvaṃ bhavati|| 92. kiṃyattado nirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac‌| (5.3.92) `nirdhāryamārṇebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ' iti| `nirdhāryamāṇavācibhyaḥ ityetat‌ kuto labhyate? tata evotpanne pratyaye nidhariṇasya gamyamānatvat‌| `mahāvibhāṣā' ityādi| `samarthānāṃ prathamāt‌' (4.1.82) `niṣariṇe' ici| viṣaye pratyayo yathā syāt‌| `dvayoriti samudāyānnirdhāraṇavibhaktiḥḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhī, saptamī vā| sā punastasya `yataśca nirdhāraṇam‌ (2.3.41) ityenena| `ekasyeti nirdeśaḥ nirdhāryamāṇanirdeśaḥ' iti| ekasminnirṣāryamāṇe yathā syāt| nanu ca samudāyādekadeśasya pṛthak‌ karaṇaṃ nirdhāraṇam‌, dvayorityavayavasamudāyo nirdiṣṭo yata ekadeśo nirdhārayitavyaḥ, sa caikadeśe nirdhārayitavye eka eva sambhavati; ato'ntareṇāpyekagrahaṇamekasyaiva nirdhāraṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti niṣphalamekagrahaṇam‌? naitadevam‌; asati hi tasmin‌ dvayoriti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī vijñāyate, dvau cennirṣāryete kutaściditi, tataścehāpi pratyayaḥ syāt‌--asmin‌ grāme kau devadattayajñadattāviti| tasmādekagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 93. vā bahūnāṃ jātiparigraśne ḍatamac‌| (5.3.93) `jātiparipraśnaviṣayebhyaḥ' iti| jātiparipraśno yathāsambhavaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| `katamo bhavatāṃ kaṭaḥ' iti| "gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha" (ma. bhā. 2.225) iti tasya jātitvam‌| sā ca kaṭhajātiḥ kiṃ śabdena paripṛcchyate| kiṃśabdo'tra jātiparipraśnaviṣayo bhavati| `yatamo bhavatāṃ kaṭhastatama āgacchatu' iti| yattacchabdāviha jātiviṣayāveva, na paripraśnaviṣayo bhavati| `yatamo bhavatāṃ kaṭhastatama āgacchatu' iti| yattacchabdāviha jātiviṣayāveva, na paripraśnaviṣayau; asaṃbhavāt‌, na hi tābhyāṃ paripraśnaḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi? kiṃśabdena| ata eva vakṣyati--`paripraśnagrahaṇaṃ kima eva viśeṣaṇam‌, na yattadoḥ, asambhavāt‌' iti| `vāvacanamakajartham‌' iti| pakṣe'kajapi yathā syāt‌| yadyevam‌ vākyaṃ na sidhyati, yadā hi ḍatamaj‌ na bhavatyakacaiva bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`mahāvibhāṣā' ityādi| atra ca mahīvibāṣā pratyayavikalpārthā'nuvarttate, tayā pratyaye vikalpite pakṣe vākyamapi bhaviṣyati| `jātigrahaṇaṃ tu sarvaiḥ sambadhyate' iti| jātiḥ savatraiva bhavati, tatra jātyādinā kiṃ śabde viśeṣyamāṇe sāmardhyādeva tasya paripraśnaviṣayatvaṃ labhyate? naitadasti; sa hi kṣepe'pi varttate| tatrāsati paripraśnagrahaṇe yadā ātau kṣepe varttate, tadā pratyayaḥ syāt‌|| 94. ekacca prācām‌| (5.3.94) `svasmin‌ viṣaye' iti| ātmīye viṣaye| tatra dvayorekasya nirvāraṇaṃ ḍataraco viṣayaḥ bahūnāmekasya nirdhāraṇe ḍatamacaḥ| cakāro'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ| asati hi tasmin‌ `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā. pa. 19) iti ḍatamajeva syāt‌; dvayonirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarajityanuvṛtteḥ, bahūnāṃ nirdhāraṇe ḍatamajityanuvṛtteḥ| vikalpārthaṃ prāggrahaṇaṃ kas‌mānna bhavati? ityāha--`vikalpo'nuvarttata eva' iti| anantarasūtrādvetyanuvarttata eveti viklapa ityuktam‌, tenaiva pratyayavikalpaḥ siddhaḥ| tasamāt‌ pūjārthameva prāggrahaṇam‌, na dikalpārtham‌|| 95. avakṣepaṇe kan‌| (5.3.95) `vyākaraṇakena' ityādi| kathaṃ punarvyākaraṇamavakṣepaṇam‌, tasyādhyayanaṃ śāstravihitam‌, vedāṅgatvāt‌? tathāpi yatrāñaye tadavakṣepaṇamupasaṃharati, taṃ prati tasyāvakṣepaṇatvamupapadyate; doṣahetutvāt‌| `parasya' ityādinā `kutsite' (5.3.74) ityavakṣepaṇe kannityasya vibhāgaṃ darśayati|| 96. ive pratikṛtau| (5.3.96) `tadviśeṣaṇaṃ pratikṛtigrahaṇam‌' iti| pratakṛtiviṣayaṃ yatra sādṛśyaṃ tatra prayogo yathā syāt‌| gaurivagavaya ityatrāsti sādṛśyam‌, na tu pratikṛtiviṣayam‌; na hi gaurgavayapratikṛtiḥ| kāṣṭhādimayaṃ hi yat‌ praticchandekaṃ tat‌ prakṛticyate|| 97. saṃjñāyāñca| (5.3.97) 98. lummanuṣye| (5.3.98) cañce iti tṛṇapuruṣa ucyate| sādṛśyācca manuṣyaścañcā| `lupi yuktavadvyaktiyacane' (1.2.51) iti prakṛtigatameva liṅgaṃ bhavati| nanu ca `manuṣyalūpi pratiṣedhaḥ' (vā.21) iti vacanādyuktavadbhāvo na prāpnoti? naitadasti; viśeṣaṇānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, na lubantasya|| 99. jīvikārthe cāpaṇye| (5.3.99) 100. devapathādibhyaśca| (5.3.100) `devapadyaḥ' iti| devānāṃ panthā iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `ṛkpaḥ (5.4.74) ityādinākāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, kan‌, tasya sup‌|| 101. vasterḍhañ‌| (5.3.101) `itaḥ prabhati' ityādi| tatra pratikṛtau `ive pratikṛtau' (5.3.96) iti kani prāpte, itaḥ prabhṛti pratyayā bhavanti| apratikṛtau tavasaṃjñāyāṃ vākyenaivābhidhāne prāpte| saṃjñāyāṃ tu pratikṛtāvaprakṛtau ca ḍhañeva; vastiḥ-vṛtivikāraḥ| `vāsteyī' iti `ṭiṅḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌|| 102. śilāyā ḍhaḥ| (5.3.102) 103. śākhādibhyo yat| (5.3.103) 104. dravyañca bhavye| (5.3.104) 105. kuśāgrācchaḥ| (5.3.105) 106. samāsācca tadviṣayāt‌| (5.3.106) `idārthaviṣayāt‌ samāsāt‌' iti| ivaśabdasyārtha ivārthaḥ-sādṛśyaṃ viṣayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| yadi ivārthaviṣayāt‌ samāsāccho vidhīyate, śastrośyāmā, puruṣavyāghra ityatrāpi prapnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, na hyatra samāsa ivārthe varttate, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvapadamuttarapadaṃ vā--śastrīva śyāmā, puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iveti| athāpyekadeśasyevārthe varttamānatvāt‌ samāso'ṇīvārthaṃ ucyate, tathāpi samāsenaivoktatvānna bhaviṣyati, yastu samāsaḥ sa ka ivārthe varttete? samāsārthāvapara ivārtho yatrāsti tatrāyaṃ pratya uktaḥ| `parasminnivāyaṃ eva' iti| `iva' ityabhikārāt‌| `atarkitopanatam‌' iti| abuddhipūrvamupasthitamityarthaḥ| `citrikaraṇam‌' iti|vismayakaraṇamityarthaḥ| `tatkatham‌' iti| kena prakāreṇātarkitopanataṃ citrīkaraṇamiti? -- imamarthaṃ pṛcchati--tatkamityādi| `samāsaścāyam‌' ityādi| yadetadivārthaviṣayāt‌ samāsāt‌ pratyayavidhānam‌, ata eva jñāpakādavasīyate--samāso bhavati| kathaṃ punaretajjñāpakamiti? āha--`na hyasya' ityādi| ivārthaviṣayasya samāsasāmānyasya lakṣaṇaṃ nāstīti| tasmādyadetat‌ tataḥ pratyayavidhānam‌, etadeva tadbhāvasya jñāpakamupapadyate| atha vā--kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ jñāpakena tadbhāvaḥ pratipādyata iti? āha--`na hyasya' ityādi| `sa caivaṃ viṣaya eva' iti| ivārthaviṣaya evetyarthaḥ|| 107. śarkarādibhyo'ṇ‌| (5.3.107) 108. aṅgulyādibhyaṣṭhak‌| (5.3.108) 109. ekaśālāyāṣṭhajanyatarasyām‌| (5.3.109) `anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena' ityādi| pūrvasūtreṇa (5.3.108) vihitatvāṭṭhagevānantaraḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ samuccayārtham‌| atastena `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti sa eva prāpyate|| 110. karkalohitādīkak‌| (5.3.110) 111. pratnapūrvaviśvemātthāl‌ chandasi| `imatha' iti| imetīdamā samānārthaṃ prakṛtyantaramasti| tata idaṃ pratyayaviṣānam‌|| 112. pūgāññyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt‌| (5.3.112) `pūrvāt‌ iti| pūrvaśabdo'vayavavācī| grāmaṇīḥ pūrvo yasya tat‌ grāmaṇīpūrvam‌| pratiṣedhena ca svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavatīti vijñāyate| pūgaśabdena svarūpe gṛhyamāṇe grāmaṇīpūrvataḥ prāptireva nāsti; grahaṇavatā prātipādikena (vyā.pa.89) tadantavidhaḥ pratiṣedhāt‌| `lohaṣvajāḥ' iti kan‌| atra devadattaśabdaḥ pūrvagrāmaṇīravayava iti na pratyayaḥ|| 113. vrātacphañorastriyām‌| (5.3.113) `vrātavācibhyaḥ' iti| atha svarūpasyaiva grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? cphañoralpāctarasya paranipātāt‌; sa hi lakṣaṇāntarānapekṣatāmācaṣṭe| tena `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya (1.1.68) ityetadapīha nāpekṣyata iti na bhavati svarūpagrahaṇam‌| `kauñjāyānyaḥ' iti| `gotre kuñjādibhyaścphañ‌' (4.1.98) `kauñjāyano' iti| `jaterastrīviṣayāt‌' (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣ‌| jātitvaṃ tu `gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' (mā.bhā. 2 225) iti|| 114. āyudhajīvisaṅghāññyaṅvāhīkeṣvabrāhmaṇarājanyāt‌| (5.3.114) `vāhīkeṣu' iti| nirdhāraṇe (2.3.41) saptamī| `vāhokeṣu madhye ya āyudhajīvisaṅghaḥ' iti| nidharimñca samānajātīyasyaiva bhavatatyāyudhajīvisaṅgho'pi vāhīka eva vijñāyate| atha vā--deśavācino vāhokaśabdādadhikaraṇa evaiṣā saptamī; vāhikadeśaviśeṣa āyudhajīvisaṅgho vasatīti| `brāhmaṇe tadviśeṣagrahaṇam‌' iti| atha svarūpagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ata eva pratiṣedhāt‌| yadi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, brāhmaṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌| prāptipūrvako hi pratiṣedho bhavati| brāhmaṇaśabda āyudhajīvisaṅgho vāhīkeṣu na vidyata iti kiṃ brāhmaṇapratiṣedhena! brāhmaṇaviśeṣavācitastu ye gopālaprabhṛtayaḥ śabdāstadvācyā āyudha jīviṅghā vāhīkeṣu bhavanti; tatra yadi pratiṣedho na kriyeta, tadā tebhyo'pi syāt‌| atastannivṛttyartho'rthavān‌ viśeṣagrahaṇe pratiṣedho bhavati| tasmāt‌--`brāhmaṇe tadviśeṣagrahaṇam‌, rājanye tu svarūpāgrahaṇameva' iti| tadvācyasyāyudhajīvisaṅghasya vāhīkeṣu sattvāt‌; `sva rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā' (1.11.68) iti vacanācca| `tena' ityādi| yasmād‌ ṅībarthotra ṭakāraḥ kṛtastena `astriyām' (5.3.113) iti nānuvarttate| tadanuvṛttau ñyaṭpratyayāntaṃ striyāṃ na bhavatīti ṅībarthaṃ ṭitkaraṇanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmādastriyāmiti nivṛttam‌, ataḥ striyāmapi bhavati| `kauṇḍībṛsī' `kṣaudrakī' iti| `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) iti yakāralopaḥ|| 115. vṛkāṭṭeṇyaṇ‌| (5.3.115) yadi vāhīkeṣu vṛkaśabdasya vācya āyudhajīvisaṅgho bhavati, tato ñyaṭi prāpte'nyatrāptāpta eva kasmiścit‌ pratyayavidhānaṃ veditavyam‌| `vṛkāviva' iti| vṛkaśabdo'tra jātivacanaḥ|| 116. dāmanyāditrigartaṣaṣṭhācchaḥ| (5.3.116) `teṣu ceyaṃ smṛtiḥ' iti trigarttaṣaṣṭhāḥ smaryyante jñāyante'nayeti smṛtiḥ| sā punaḥ--`āhustrigarttaṣaṣṭhān‌' iti| ayamevāptapraṇītaślokaḥ eṣu ca trigarttaṣaṣṭheṣu prathamapañcamau śivādyaṇantau, śeṣāstviñantāḥ| kecidataddhitāntameva pañcamaṃ paṭhanti| teṣāṃ brahmaguptaśabdādeva ccho bhavati|| 117. parśvadiyaurdhayādibhyāmaṇañau| (5.3.117) kigartha punariha yaudheyādayaḥ paṭhyante, yāvatā lukpratiṣedhārthaṃ caturthe yaudheyādayaḥ samāmnātā eva, ta eva ceha gṛhyante? satyametat‌; vicitrā hi gaṇānāṃ kṛtirgaṇakāresyeti punaḥ paṭhitāḥ| parśvādiṣu satvacchaśabdo paṭhyate| sa ca satvacchabdaparakṛtirmatuppratyayānto veditavyaḥ|| 118. abhijidvidabhṛcchālāvac‌chikhāvacchamīvadūrṇāvacchrarumadaṇo yañ‌| (5.3.118) `abhijito'patyamityaṇ‌' iti| `prāgdīṣyato'ṇ‌' (4.1.83) ityautsargikaḥ| evamuttratrāpi| `gotrapratyayasyāṇo grahaṇamiṣyate' iti| tatkathaṃ jātināmna ityanuvarttate? tenāṇantaṃ yajjātināma tadeva grahīṣyate| yaśca gortra'ṇ‌ vihitastadantameva jātināma bhavati; `gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' (ma. bhā. 2.225) iti ātitvāt‌| `ābhijito muhūtatattṃḥ, ābhijītaḥ sthālīpākaḥ' iti| ekatra `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityaṇ‌, aparatra `sāsya devatā' (4.2.24) iti|| 119. ñyādayastadrājāḥ| (5.3.119) iti śrībodhisattvadeśīpācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ pañcamasyādhyāyasya tṛtīya pādaḥ|| <5.4> atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ caturthaḥ pādaḥ 1. pādaśatasya saṃkhyādervīpsāyāṃ vunlopaśca| (5.4.1) pratipadikāditi varttate, tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ pādaśatasyagrahaṇam‌, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhirbhavatadītyāha--`pādaśatāntasya' iti| ādiśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| na ca saṃkhyāśabdaḥ padaśataśabdayoravayava upapadyate; pṛthāgbhāvādanāraṃbhakatvāt‌| na hi pṛthagbhūtamanārambhakaṃ śabdāntarasyāvayavo yujyate, yathā ghaṭaśabdaḥ paṭaśabdasya| viparite tu yujyate, yathā--paṭasya samudāyātmanaḥ tantvādikāraṇaṃ samadeśamavayadamāhaḥ| tasmāt‌ `saṃkhyādeḥ' ityetadapi prātipadikasya vijñāyate, na pādaśataśabdayorityāha--`saṃkhyādeḥ' ityādi| ānantaryyalakṣaṇā ceyaṃ ṣaṣṭho, yathā--gāpoṣṭakaṃ (3.2.8) iti gāpoṣṭakpratyayo bhavatītyanantaramiti śeṣaḥ| `tatsanniyogena ca' iti| cakārasya sanniyogārthatvāt‌| `antasya' iti| alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā (1.1.52)| `punaḥ' ityādi| nimitte bhavo naimittikaḥ, adhyātmāditvāṭṭhañ (vā. 456), na naimittiko'naimittikaḥ| lopaḥ syāvityevamarthaṃ punarlopavacanam‌| vunāpi saha lopo vidhīyamānaḥ paranimittaṃ nāpekṣata ityanaimittiko bhavati| yasyeti (6.4.148) lopaḥ| `paranimittakaḥ' iti| īti taddhite ca parasminnimitte vidhānāt‌ tasya sthānivadbhāvāt‌, `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti lopasya sthānivadbhāvena pācchabdarūpasya vihitatvāt‌| anacko hi pācchabdaḥ sthānyupāttaḥ, tasya cānackatvaṃ sthānivadbhāve sati hīyate| asya tvanaimittikatvānna sthānivadbhāva iti padbhāvo bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `dvau dvau pādau' iti| pīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavati|| 2. daṇḍavyavasargayośca| (5.4.2) `damanaṃ daṇḍaḥ' iti| nanu daṇḍaśabdo'yaṃ yaṣṭyādāvapi varttate? satyam‌; tathāpīha damane varttamānasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌, damanasyaiva pratyayāntena gamyamānatvāt‌| `dānaṃ vyavasargaḥ' iti| yadyevam‌, tat‌ pūrvayoga udāhṛtaṃ dattaṃ tadā copapadyate yadyayaṃ yogo'dhikavidhānārtho bhavati; na tvapavādaḥ; tasmānnārtho'nena yogena? ityata āha--`avīpsārthaḥ' ityādi| tena dānamātre'nena vun‌| dānavīpsāyāṃ pūrvayogena punarbhavatyeva|| 3. sthūlādibhyaḥ prakāravacane kan‌| (5.4.3) `jātayaro'pavādaḥ' iti| etena yathā prakāravacane vidhīyamāno jātīyar‌ prakāravati na prakāramātre, tathāyamapīti darśayati; anyathā hi jātīyaroyaṃ viṣayabhedādapavādo nopapadyate, atha kimartha `prakāravacane jātīyar‌' (5.3.69) ityasyaivānantaraṃ sthūlādibhyaḥ kan‌ na vidhīyate? kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? kan‌ prakāravacanaṃ na vaktavyaṃ bhavati? naivaṃ śakyam‌; sthūlādīnāṃ hi prakārasyājñātādīnāṃ ca yugapadvivakṣāyāṃ paratvāt‌ ke kṛte kanna syāt‌; śabdāntaratvāt‌| athāpi syāt‌? evamapi sthūlaka ityādyudāttatvaṃ syāt‌, iha tu kano vidhāne paratvāt‌ paratvāt‌ kani kṛti tataḥ ka ityantodāttatvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| `cañcadbṛhatoḥ' ityādi| sthālādiṣu cañcadbṛhatorapāṭhāt‌ tanna prāpnoti| tasmādupasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ karttavyam‌| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena cañcadbṛhatorapi bhaviṣyatīti| `sthālāṇumāṣeṣu' iti| kecidetāścatasraḥ prakṛtasya iti varṇayanti| sthūlakaḥ aṇukaḥ| māṣakaḥ| iṣukaḥ| apare tu sthūlāṇuśabdau prakṛtī, māṣeṣvityayaṃ tapādhinirdeśa ityāhaḥ| anye tvānantaryyādaṇuśapabdasyaiva māṣagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇamācakṣate| ādyameva darśanaṃ nyāyyam‌; tathā hi--sthūlakādayaḥ tadviśeṣamam‌| kṛṣṇakāstilāḥ| `yava vrīhiṣu' iti| yava iti prakṛtiḥ, vrīhiṣviti tadviśeṣaṇam‌| yavako vrīhiḥ| `pādyakālavadātāḥ surāyām‌' iti| apare punarānantaryyadavadātaśabdasya surāgrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ pādyakālayorna viśeṣaṇatvaṃ bhavatītyāhuḥ| `gomūtrādācchādane' [`gomūtra ācchādane'-kāśikā] iti| gomūtraśabdaḥ prakṛtiḥ, ācchādane iti tadviśeṣaṇam‌| gomūtraprakārakamācchādanaṃ gomūtrakam‌| `surāhau' [`surāyā ahau'-kāśikā] iti| sureti prakṛtiḥ ahāviti viśeṣaṇam‌| surāvarṇo'hiriti surakaḥ| `jīrṇaśāliṣu' iti| patramūle ityete śabdarūpe samastavyaste pratyayamutpādayataḥ--patrakam‌, mūlakam‌|| 4. anatyantagatau ktāt‌| (5.4.4) `aśeṣasambandhaḥ' iti| aśeṣasya svena sambandhinā bhedanādīnāṃ vyāptirityarthaḥ| `bhinnakam‌' iti| na tu yasyāśeṣasya bhedena sambandhaḥ, api tvekadeśasya tadbhinnakamityucyate| bhinnamityatrāśeṣasambandha eva gamyate| yadyaśeṣaṃ bhidikriyāvyāptaṃ ghaṭādi tadbhinnamityabhidhīyate|| 5. na sāmivacane| (5.4.5) `sāmivacane' iti| sāmyucyate yena tat‌ sāmivacanam‌| `sāmikṛtam‌' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, viśeṣaṇasamāso vā| `prakṛtyābhihitatvāt‌' iti| pratiṣedhānarthasye hetuḥ| anatyantagatiṃ gamayituṃ kan‌ vidhīyate| sā ca sāmiśabdenaiva gamiteti kanaḥ prāptireva nāsti| ato'narthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| svārthamātreṇaiva kano vidhāyakaṃ lakṣaṇamastīti manyamāna āha--`kena punaḥ' ityādi| yadetat pratiṣedhavacanam‌, etadeva jñāpayati--bhavati svārthe kan‌ iti, anyathā pratiṣeṣavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| ardhakṛtam‌| nemikṛtam‌|| 6. bṛhatyā ācchādane| (5.4.6) `kannanuvarttate' iti| svaritatvāt‌| `na pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| viparyayāt‌| `bṛhatikā' iti| ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ|| 7. aṣaḍakṣāśitaṅgvalaṅkarmālampuruṣādhyuttarapadāt‌ ravaḥ| (5.4.7) `avidyamānāni ṣaḍakṣīṇyasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ' iti| tataḥ `bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ (5.4.113) iti ṣac‌| rājaśabdāt‌ saptamī| rājanyathīti vigṛhya `saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ' (2.1.40) iti samāsaḥ| `tamabādayaḥ' iti| `atiśāyena tamabiṣṭhanau' (5.3.55) ityevamādayaḥ| `prāk‌ kanaḥ' iti| `yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām‌' (5.3.64) ityayam‌| `ñyādayaḥ' iti| `pūgāññyo'grāmaṇīpūrvāt‌ (5.3.112) ityādayaḥ| `prāgvṛnaḥ' iti| `pādaśatasya' (5.4.1) ityādisūtreṇa vihitatvāt‌| `āmādayaḥ' iti| `kimettiṅavyayaghāt‌' (5.4.11) ityevamādayaḥ| `prāṅmayaṭaḥ' iti| `tatprakṛtavacane mayaṭ‌' (5.4.21) ityataḥ| `bṛhatījātyantāḥ' iti| `bṛhatyā ācchadane' (5.4.6) ityetat‌ sūtraṃ kanamupalakṣayati| jātyantaśabdenāpi `jātyantāccha bandhuni' (5.4.9) ityetat‌| bahuvacananirdeśo'ṣaḍakṣādisūtrāvihitasya parigrahārthaḥ|| 8. vibhāṣāñceradikstriyām‌| (5.4.8) 9. jātyantāccha bandhuni| (5.4.9) 10. sthānāntadvibhāṣā sasthāneneti cet‌| (5.4.10) `sasthānena' iti| karaṇe tṛtīyā| sthānena sthānavācyenārthena tulyaparyāyeṇa sthānāntaṃ yadyarthavadbhavatyevaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyathā| kathaṃ punaḥ sthānaśabdena tulyatvamucyate? ityāha--`samānam‌' ityādi| yasya samānaṃ sthānaṃ sa sasthāna ityucyate| yaścaivaṃvidhaṃ sa yadapekṣaṃ tasya samānaṃ sthānaṃ sa tena tulyo bhavatīti| `pitṛsthānīyaḥ' iti| pitṛsthānamiva sthānaṃ yasyeti `saptamyupamāna' (vā. 99) ityādinottarapadalopo bahuvrīhiḥ| `gosthānama' iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'yam‌| bhavati hyetat‌ sthānāntaṃ prātipadikam‌, na tu sthānena tulyārthenārthaktaḥ| yathā sthānāntāt‌ pratyayo bhavati, tathā tatpuruṣeṇāpi svasthānaśabdenārtha upasthāpite tenārthenārthavataḥ sthānāt‌ pratyayena bhavitavyam‌; viśeṣānupādānāt‌| tataśca tulyañca tat stānāntaṃ pratipadikaṃ sthānavācyenārthenārthavaditiyaścodayet‌ taṃ pratyāha--`itikaraṇo vivakṣārthaḥ' iti| itikaraṇo hyatra vivakṣārthaḥ kriyate, tenāyamartho labhyatetataścedvivakṣā bhavatīti| bahuvrīhyarthenārthavataḥ sthānāt‌ pratyayotpattau lokasya vivakṣā bhavati, na tatpuruṣārthenārthavataḥ| tasmāt‌ sthānāntasyārthamutpādayituṃ bahuvrīhireva sthānaśabdārthamutpādayati; na tu tatpuruṣaḥ| tena na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ| `cacchabdaḥ smabandhārthaḥ' iti| sthānāntasya sasthānasambandho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ cecchabdaḥ; anyathā pratyayaṃ prati pañcasyā sthānāntasya nirdeśāt‌ sthānāntasya sasthānena sambandho na syāt‌| na hi pañcamyantena tasya sambandhaḥ śakyate karttum‌| cecchabde tu sa cet‌ sthānenārthavadvatītyupapadyate, na tu sambandhaḥ| `dvayorvibhāṣayormadhye nityavidhayaḥ' iti| yadi nityā na syuḥ, pūrvaiva vibhāṣottaratrānuvarttiṣyata ityuttaraṃ vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌|| 11. kimettihvyayaghādābhvadravyaprakarṣe| (5.4.11) `adravyaprakarṣe' iti| nanu ca dravyasya na prakarṣo'sti; tathā ca bhāṣye uktam‌--`na vai dravyasya prakarṣo'sti' iti, ataḥ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ? ityata āha--`yadyapi' ityādi| dṛśyate cādheyadharmasyādhāra upacāraḥ, yathā--mañcāḥ ṛśantīti| tasmādādhārādheyayoḥ kriyāguṇayordharmaḥ prakarṣaḥ| sa yadādhāradravya upacaryate tadāsau dravyadharmatvādupacāreṇa dravyadharmo bhavati| ato'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| `kriyāguṇayoreva' ityādi| kriyāyā guṇasya prakarṣo yadā dravye nopacayaṃte kriyāguṇayoreva prakarṣaḥ, tatraiva pratyayaḥ| yadi tu dravye upacaryate tato dravyaprakarṣa iti vacanāt‌| `kintarām‌' iti| vastuno bahavo viśeṣāḥ, tatra praśnaḥ kiṃśabdārthaḥ| `pūrvāhṇetarām‌' iti| `ghakālataneṣu kālānāmnaḥ' (6.3.17) iti sampamyā aluk‌| nanu ca pūrvāhṇaḥ kālaḥ, kālaśca dravyam‌, dravyaprakarṣe pratyayena na bhavitvyam‌; adravyaprakarṣa iti pratiṣedhāt‌? naiva doṣaḥ; na hyatra prātipadikārthaḥ prakarṣe varttate, kiṃ tarhi? vibhaktyarthaḥ, sa ca guma eva; dravyaśaktisvarūpatvāt‌ kārakāṇām‌| atha vā--vacanasāmarthyāt‌ kālaprakarṣe bhavati| na hi kālādanyasyasmādekārāt‌ paro gho bhavati| `kālanāmnaḥ' iti parataḥ saptamyā alugvidhānāt‌| `uccaistarām‌' iti|| 12. amu ca cchandasi| (5.4.12) 13. anugādinaṣṭhak‌| (5.4.13) `anugadatītyanugādī' iti| grahāditvāṇṇiniḥ| āvāśyake vā, tācchīlye vā, asmādeva nipātanācca|| 14. ṇacaḥ striyāmañ‌| (5.4.14) `vyāvakrośī' iti| `kraśa āhvāne' (dhā. pā. 856) ityasmāṇṇaca, laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, ṇajantādañ‌| sa ca kṛdagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā. pa. 126) sagatikādbavati| tena sagatikameveha pratipadikasaṃjñāṃ pratipadyate, na karmavyatihāra iti pratiṣedhādeva vṛddhipratiṣedhayorādivṛddhireva bhavati| `ṭiṅḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌| `vyāvahāsī' iti| `ata upadāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ| `tataḥ' iti| ṇajantāditi yāvat‌| `svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvarttante (jai.pa.vṛ. 95) iti kṛtvā| `evaṃ tarhi' ityādinā strīgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ darśayati| `tena' ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanam‌| `ativartante'pi' iti| vyabhicarantyapītyarthaḥ| apiśabdādanuvarttante'ṇīti| yadi svārthikānāṃ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānuvṛttivyabhicāro jñāpyate, tato guḍādibhyaḥ puṃliṅgādyanugatebhyaśca svārthe kalpabādayo bhavati, teṣāṃ puṃlliṅgavacanaṃ ca tadaiva bhavet‌ tataśca guḍakalpā drakṣetyevamādi nopapadyate| tasmiṃstu jñāpite liṅgāntarañca bhavatīti| tena sarvametadupapannaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdenāpi tailakalpā, cāturvarṇyam‌, trailokyamityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌|| 15. aṇinuṇaḥ| (5.4.15) `sāṃrāviṇam‌' iti| `ru śabde' (dhā. pā. 1034) ityetasmādinuṇ‌, `aco ñṇiti'(7.2.115) iti vṛddhiḥ, inuṇantādaṇ‌| sa ca pūrvavat‌ sagatereva bhavati| `inaṇyanapatye' (6.4.164) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `sāṃkūṭinam‌' iti| `kūṭa dāhe' (dhā. pā| 1890) iti, `mṛjūṣ‌ śuddhau' (dhā. pā. 1066), `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114), `śamityāṣṭābhyo ghinuṇ‌' (3.2.141)| ghakāre lupte yadyapīnuṇ‌ bhavati, tathāpi tasmādaṇ‌ na bhavati; `sthānāntādvibhāṣā' (5.4.10) ityato vivakṣārthasyetikaraṇasyānuvṛtteḥ|| 16. visāriṇo matsye| (5.4.16) `visārī' iti| pūrvavaṇṇiniḥ| `vaisāriṇaḥ' iti| pūrvavatprakṛtibhāvaḥ|| 17. saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc‌| (5.4.17) `paunaḥpunyamabhyāvṛttiḥ' iti| paunaḥ punyenātra sāhacaryādekakarttṛkāṇāṃ tulyajātīyānāṃ sopalakṣyate, ata evāha--`ekakarttṛkāṇām‌' ityādi| ekakarttṛkāṇāmityatra hi saṃkhyeyānukṛṣṭa upasaṃkhyātaguṇastanmātre varttate| saṃkhyāśabde'ta eva vyatirekanibandhanā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati| kriyāgaṇanamabhyāvṛttirbhavatyeva| `pañcakṛtvo bhuṅkte' iti| kriyāyāḥ pañcotpattīḥ karotītyarthaḥ| `bhūrīn‌ vārān‌ bhuṅkte' iti| yadi saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tato yathā pañcādibhyaḥ saṃkhyāśabdebhyaḥ pratyayo bhavati, tathā bhūryyādibhyo'pi syāt‌; saṃkhyāgrahaṇānna bhavati| `abhyāvṛttiḥ kriyāyā eva sambhavati' ityādī| nanu ca dravyaguṇayorapi sambhavati--punaḥ punardaṇḍī, punaḥ punaḥ sthūla ityādi? naitadasti; atra sāmarthyāt‌ kriyābhyāvṛttiḥ--punaḥ punardaṇḍī bhavati, punaḥpunaḥ sthūlo bhavatīti| tasmādabhyāvṛttiḥ kriyāyā eva sambhavati, na dravyaguṇayorapi| punaḥ punardaṇḍīti--atra sāmarthyāllabhyā kriyeti kriyāgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌| `ekasya sakṛccetyatra' ityādi| ekaśabdena hyekaiva kriyāvyaktirākhyāyate| na caikasyāṃ kriyāvyaktāvabhyāvṛttiḥ sambhavati, kiṃ tarhi? anekāsu kriyāvyaktiṣu| tathā ca prāguktam‌--ekakarttṛkāṇāmityādi| tasmādekasya sakṛcca kriyaiva gaṇyate, nābhyāvṛttiḥ| tasmādasati kriyāgrahaṇe ekaśabdāt‌ kriyāgaṇane pratyayo na labhyate| tasmāduttarārthaṃ kriyāgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| `pañcapākāḥ' iti| `kriyāgaṇane' ityetāvatyucyamāne'trāpi syāt‌, asti hyatra kriyāgaṇanam‌| abhyāvṛttirhi bhinnakālānāṃ kriyāṇāṃ bhavati, iha tvabhinnakālā eva pākā gaṇyante, atastadvyāvṛttiḥ| nanu ca kriyāpyatra nāstyeva, dhātvarthasya siddhatākhyo yo dharmastasmin‌ ghaño vidhānāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāpi siddhatā kriyāpradeśeṣu kriyāgarahaṇena gṛhyata eva; dharmadharmiṇorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt‌| anyathā kārakasya gatiḥ, kārakasya vrajyetyatra `tumunṇvuṇau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām‌' (3.3.10) iti ṇvul‌ na syāt‌| `akriyamāṇe' ityādi| dvividhāḥ saṃkhyeyevarttamānebhyaḥ saṃkhyeyavacanebhya eva pratyayaḥ syāt‌| `śataṃ vārān‌ bhuṅkte śatakṛtvo bhuṅkte' iti| atra so'yamityabhisambandhena kriyābhyāvṛttau saṃkhyeye śataśabdo varttate| ata eva sāmānādhikaraṇyam‌| śataṃ vārāniti saṃkhyāne parttamānebhyo na syāditi darśayitumāha--`iha na syāt‌' iti| kuta etadityāha--`saṃkhyānamātravṛttitvāt‌' iti| mātraśabdaḥ saṃkhyeyaṃ vihāya śataṃ vārāṇāmiti syāt|| 18. dvitricaturbhyaḥ suc‌| (5.4.18) `caturbhuktam‌' iti| `rāt‌ sasya' (8.2.24) iti sakāralopaḥ| `cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ' iti| prakṛterantodāttatvaṃ yatā syāditi| pratyayasya tu cakāraḥ svarārthaṃ nopapadyate; tasyānackatvāt‌| catuḥśabdameva prakṛtaṃ prati cakārasya svarārthatvam‌, nottarayoḥ; tayorudāttatvāt‌| catuḥśabdastu `cateruran‌' (da.u.8.78) ityuranpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ|| 19. ekasya sakṛcca| (5.4.19) `sakṛdbhuktam‌' iti| `saṃyogāntasya' (8.2.23) iti pratyayasakāralopaḥ| cakāro'ntodāttārthaḥ| asati tu tasmina `iṇbhīkāpāśalyatimarcibhyaḥ kan‌' (da.u. 3.21) iti kanpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇaikaśabda ādyudātta iti sthānivadbhādādeśo'pyādyudātta eva syāt‌, cittvādantodātto bhavati| athaikaḥ pāka ityatra kasmānna bhavati, asti hyatra kriyāgaṇanam‌? ityāha--`ekaḥ pākaḥ' ityādi|| 20. vibhāṣā bahordhā'viprakṛṣṭakāle| bahuśabde'pi sāmānya eva; prakāre'pi vṛtteḥ| tatrānekakriyābhyāvṛtteraviprakarṣa eva tāvannyāyyaḥ, prakaraṇādyapekṣaśca| kṛtvasujāpi na śaknotyasmin‌ viṣaye varttitum‌| tasmādvibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌|| 21. tatprakṛtavacane mayaṭ‌| (5.4.21) `prācuryeṇa prastutaṃ prakṛtam‌' iti| kṛtaḥ punarayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatā prastutamātravacanaḥ prakṛtaśabdaḥ vacanagrahaṇādiha prakṛta iti vaktavye vacanagrahaṇam‌--yādṛśasya loke prakṛtasya mayaṭo vacanaṃ pratyayāntena dṛṣṭaṃ tatraiva mayaḍyathā syādityevamartham‌| loke ca mayaṭpratyayāntaṃ rannamayādiśabdaiḥ prakṛtasya prācuryamucyata iti vacanagrahaṇādeva viśeṣo labhyate| `apare tu' ityādi| atra prakṛtyarthādarthāntara eva pratyayaḥ| prakṛtaśabdena prastutamātramucyate| na tu prācuryyaviśiṣṭaṃ prakṛtamityeṣa viśeṣaḥ| `ubhayathā' ityādi| ubhayathāpyasminnarthe sūtrasya praṇayanādityarthaḥ|| 22. samūhavacca bahuṣu| (5.4.22) `maudakikam‌' iti| yathā samūhe `acittahastidhenoṣṭhak‌' (4.2.47) iti ṭhag‌ modakādibhyo bhavati; tathehāpi ca modakaśabdāt‌, svārthavācinaḥ puṃlliṅgācca| strīliṅgādibhyaḥ svārthe ṭhagvihitaḥ, tataśca `svārthikāḥ prakṛtito liṅgavacanānyanuvarttante' (vyā.pa. 74) iti prakṛtigatenaiva liṅgādinā bhavitadhyam‌; tatkathamidaṃ pratyayāntarasya napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ vacanāntaraṃ ca? ityata āha--`ativarttante'pi' ityādi| etacca `ṇacaḥ striyām‌' (5.4.14) ityatra jñāpitam‌|| 23. anantāvasathetihabheṣajāññyaḥ| (5.4.23) `upadeśapāramparye varttate' iti| ha smopādhyāyaḥ kathayati, iti ha sma pitā kayayatītyatraivā prayogadarśanāt‌|| 24. devatāntāttādarthye yat‌| (5.4.24) `caturthosamarthāt‌' iti| tādarthye caturthī; upasaṃkhyānāt‌| `caturthī tadarthārtha' (2.1.36) iti caturthe bhavatīti jñāpakādvā| `tādarthye caturthyā bhavitavyam‌' iti caturthīsamarthāt‌ pratyayo vijñāyate| tadartha eva tādarthyamiti svārthe ṣyañaṃ darśayati| kathaṃ punaḥ svārthe ṣyañ‌? ityāha--`cāturva rṣyādi' ityādinā| cātuvairṇyādisiddhyartha svārthe ṣyaja upasaṃkhyānaṃ kṛtam‌, ayaṃ tu cāturvarṇyāditvāt‌ svārthe ṣyaña| `agnidevatāyai' iti| agniścāsau devataḥ ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ|| 25. pādārghābhyāñca| (5.4.25) `chabdasyaḥ' iti| saptavaśākṣarasamāhārābhiṣāyinaśchapdaḥśabdāt‌ svārthe yatpratyayo bhavati| `dvitīyābahuvacanasyāluk‌' iti| apśabdād‌dvitīyābahuvacanāntādyati kṛte `supo dhātuprātapadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti supo luki -- , `sarve viṣayaśchandasi vikalpyante' (pu.pa.vṛ. 56) iti kṛtvā| `āmuṣyāyaṇāmuṣyaputriketyupasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| vibhakteralugarthametadupasaṃkhyānāntaram‌, na pratyayārtham‌| āmuṣyāyaṇamityamuṣyaśabdo naḍādiṣu paṭhyate, tataḥ phaki kṛte vibhakterluki prāpte'lugvaktavyaḥ| naḍādiṣu savibhaktikasya pāṭhasāmarthyāddhyalugbhaviṣyati| amuṣyaputriketyatra tvamuṣyaputraśabdo manojñādiṣu paṭhyata iti vibhkerluki prāpte'lugvaktavyaḥ| manojñādiṣu pāṭhādvā siddhamiti na vaktavyam‌| ubhayatra `adaso'serdādu vo maḥ' (8.2.80) iti matvotve|| 26. atitherñyaḥ| (5.4.26) 27. devāttal‌| (5.4.27) 28. aveḥ kaḥ| (5.4.28) 29. yavādibhyaḥ kan‌| (5.4.29) `ṛtau' ityādi| uṣṇaśīte śabdarūpe kanamutpādayata ṛtāvabhidheye--uṣṇaka ṛtuḥ śītaka ṛtuḥ| anyatra uṣṇaḥ, śīta ityeva bhavati| `paśau lunaviyāte' iti| lūnaviyāte śabdarape kanamutpādayataḥ paśāvabhidheye--lūnakaḥ paśuḥ, viyātakaḥ paśuḥ| paśoranyatra lūnam‌, viyātam‌| `aṇu nipuṇe' iti| aṇuśabdo nipuṇārthaḥ kanamutpādayati--putrakaḥ| anyatra putraḥ| `snāta vedasamāptau' iti| snātaśabdaḥ kanamutpādayati vedasamāptau vivakṣitāyām‌| yasya vedaḥ samāptaḥ sa snātaka ityucyate| vedasamāptāvapiti kim‌? nadyāṃ snātaḥ| `śūnya rikte' iti| śūnyaśabdaḥ kanamutpādayati rikte tacche'bhidheye--śūnyakaḥ, tukcha ityarthaḥ| anyatra śūnyam‌| `dāna kutsite' iti| dānaśabdaḥ kutsite kanamutpādayati--kṛtsitaṃ dānaṃ dānakam‌| anyatra tu dānam‌| `tenu sūtre' iti| tanuśabdaḥ pratyamutpādayati sūtre--tanukam‌| anyatra tanuḥ| `īyasaśca' iti| īyaspratyāntāt‌ kan‌ bhavati--śeyaskaḥ| `kumārīkrīḍanakāni ca' iti| kumārīṇāṃ yāni krīḍanakāni tāni kanamutpādayanti--kandukam‌|| 30. lohatānmaṇau| (5.3.30) 31. vaṇa cānitye| (5.3.31) lohitakaḥ kopena' iti| lohitaśabdavācyo varṇaḥ kope sati bhavati| sthita eva ca devadatte kopavigame gacchatītyanityo bhavati| atha varṇagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā lohitaśabdo varṇa eva varttate? naitadasti; maṇinimitto'pyayaṃ dravye'pi varttata eva, tatrāsati varṇagrahaṇe dravyasyāpyanityagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyeta, tataśca lohitakāḥ pārthivāḥ paramāṇava iti pratyayo na syāt‌; teṣāṃ nityatvāt‌| varṇagrahaṇe tu sati varṇasyaivānityagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti nitye pratyayaḥ siddho bhavati| api ca--lohitaśabdo varmanimitta eva rudhirākhye varttate| tacca sarvatraivānitya iti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyādanitye kāryaviśeṣa ucyate| sa punaḥ satyevāśraye kadācidbhavati, kadācinneti| tena yadetat‌ stroṇāmārttavaṃ lohitaṃ tatraiva syāt‌| tasmādvarṇagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| `lohito gauḥ, lohitaṃ rudhiram‌' ityatra yāvadāśrayastāvadavasthānādanityo varṇo na bhavati| nanu cāyamapyāśrayavināśena vināśādanitya eva? satyametat‌; sarva eva hi varṇa īdṛśaḥ| ucyate cedamanitya iti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāt‌| tena prakarṣeṇa yo'ntya iti vijñāyate, sa panaḥ satyevāśraye, abhūtvā bhavatīti yo bhūtvā pratigacchati sa eva bhavitumarhati| `lohitālliṅgabādhanam‌' ityādi| liṅgadhikāre yo vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ sa upacārāliṅgaśabdenoktaḥ, tasya lohitaśabdādbādhanaṃ bhavatīti vaktavyam‌; anyathā strītvasya varṇānityasya yugapadvikṣāyāṃ lohitaśabdāt‌ `varṇādanudāttāttopadhātto naḥ' (4.1.39) iti yo ṅīp‌ prāpnoti, sa kanā nityaṃ bādhyeta| tasya hi harita varṇādiravakāśaḥ prāpnoti, tatra kani kṛte tadantāṭṭāpi lohitaketyeva stāt‌ lohiniketyevaṃ tu na prāpnoti| `tasmāddhi liṅgabādhanaṃ karttavyam‌| evaṃ lohitaśabdāt‌ `varṇādanudāttāt‌' (4.1.39) ityādinā ṅīpi takārasya nakāre tato'nena kan‌| `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvatve kṛte lohiniketi bhavati|| 32. rakte| (5.4.32) `lākṣādinā rakte' iti| nanu ca lākṣādinā ya ādhīyate lohito varṇaḥ, tasyānityatvāt‌ pūrvasūtreṇaiva siddham‌? yadā hi te yogaviśeṣeṇa tathāvidhaṃ sthairyamutpadyate; yataḥ svāśrayaṃ na jahāti tadā nityatvānna prāpnoti, tadarthamidamucyate|| 33. kālācc| (5.4.33) 34. vinayādibhyaṣṭhak‌| (5.4.34) `upāyādhrasvatvañca' iti| upāyaśabdaṭhakamutpādayati, hrasvatvañca pratipadyate--aupayikaḥ|| 35. vāco vyāhṛtārthāyām‌| (5.4.35) `vyāhṛtaḥ' iti| ukta ityarthaḥ| `anyena' iti| sandeṣṭrā| na hi pūrvaṃ sā vāk‌ saṃdiṣṭā| tena hi pūrvaṃ sandiśatā sandeśavāk‌ bhavati| yayā sandiṣṭo'rtho'bhidhīyate, sā ca sandeśavāgucyate|| 36. tadyuktātkarmaṇo'ṇ‌| (5.4.36) `karmaśabdāt‌' iti| etena karmaṇa iti svarūpasya grahaṇam‌, nepsitatamasyeti darśayati| nanu ca karmaśabdasya saṃjñāśabdatvādīpsitatamasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌, na svarūpasyeti? naitadasti; iha hi `sthānāntāt‌' (5.4.10) ityādeḥ sūtrāditikaraṇo'nuvarttate, tenāyamartho labhyate--tataścedvivakṣā bhavatīti| karmaśabdācca pratyayotpattau loke vivakṣā bhavati, nepsitatamāt‌| na hi tata utpannenāṇā vyāhṛtārthavācā yuktaṃ karma śakyate dyotayitum‌, karmaśabdāttūtpannena śakyate| tasmāt‌ svarūpasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌| `kārmaṇam‌' iti| `an‌' (6.4.16) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `tathaiva' iti| yathaiva vyāhṛtārthayā vācā pratipāditam‌--evaṃ karttavyamiti, tenaiva prakāreṇetyarthaḥ| `aṇprakaraṇe' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatrevaṃ pratipādanam‌--prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvāt‌ kulālādayastatraiva draṣṭaṣyāḥ| tena `prajñādibhyaśca' (5.3.38) ityaṇ‌ bhaviṣyatīti| yadyevam‌, bhāṣāyāmapi syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `vibhāṣā bahoḥ' (5.4.20) ityādisūtrādvibhāṣetyanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā chandasyeva bhaviṣyati, na bhāṣāyāmiti| `sānnāya' [sānnayya-kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] ityādi| sānnāyānujāvarānuṣūkānuṣṭubhacātuṣprāśyarākṣodhvavaiyātavaikṛtavārivaskṛtāgrāyaṇāgrahāyaṇasāntapanāśchandasi bhāṣāyāñceṣyante| tasmātsānnāyādayaḥ| eṣāṃ prakṛtayaḥ prajñādiṣveva draṣṭavyāḥ| atra cāgrāyaṇāgrahāyaṇa--ityatrekārāntābhyāmāgrāyaṇyagrahāyaṇīśabdābhyāmanyatrākārāntebhyo'nujāvarādibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ| sānnāyyaśabdasya cehāntodāttārtha grahaṇam‌| rūpaṃ tu `pāyyasānnāyya' (3.1.129) iti nipātanādeva siddham‌||ṣa 37. oṣadherajātau| (5.4.37) `auṣadhaṃ pivati' iti| phalādau varttamānādoṣadhiśabdāt‌ pratyayaḥ, sa ca jātirna bhavati; `ākṛtigrahaṇā jātiḥ' (kāśikā. 4.1.63) ityāderlakṣaṇasyābhāvāt‌| oṣadhayaḥ kṣetre rūḍhā bhavanti| atra phalapākāntā jātiḥ, tatrauṣadhiśabdo varttate|| 38. prajñādibhyaśca| (5.4.38) `prajānātīti prajñaḥ' iti| `igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' (3.1.135)| nanu ca yaḥ prajānāti tasya prajñāstīti `prajñaśraddhārcāvṛttibhyo'ṇ‌' (5.2.101) iti matvarthenaiva ṇena siddham‌, tat‌ kimarthaṃ prajñāśabdādaṇ‌ vidhīyata iti? asya codyasya nirākaraṇāya striyāṃ viśeṣaṃ darśayannāha--`stro prājñī' ityādi| `videḥ śatrantasya grahaṇam‌' iti| na tu `videḥ śaturvasuḥ' (7.1.36) ityādi| `śrotra śarīre' iti| śarīre yaḥ śrotraśabdo varttate tasmādaṇ‌ bhavati-śrautram‌| anyatra śotram‌| `juhvat‌' iti| juhvacchabdāt‌ kṛṣṇamṛge varttamānādaṇa bhavati--jauhvataḥ| juhvadityevānyatra| anye `kṛṣṇa mṛge' iti pṛthak‌ paṭhanti| kṛṣṇaśabdādaṇ‌ bhavati mṛge'bhidheye--kārṣṇo mṛgaḥ, kṛṣṇa evānyatra| juhvacchabadādaviśeṣeṇāsmin‌ pāṭhe pratyayaḥ| `satvantu' iti| sacchabdo yo matuppratyayāntaḥ saḥ satvāneva sātvataḥ| `prajñādirayamākṛtigaṇaḥ| tāmevāsyākṛtigaṇatāṃ bodhayitumanuktasamuccayārthaścākāḥ kṛtaḥ| tena kulālakukkuṭādibhyo'ṇ‌ siddho bhavati| 39. mṛdastikan‌| (5.4.39) kimarthaṃ punastikan‌ vidhīyate, na takanneva vidhīyeta, nityaśca strīpratyayo'yam‌, tatra ṭāpi kṛte `pratyayasthāt‌ kāt‌' (7.3.44) itīttvenaiva siddham‌? yatra tarhi lugbhāvaḥ kriyate, tatra na siddhyet‌--pañcabhirmṛttikābhiḥ krītaḥ pañcamṛttika iti| tatra hi `aṣyarddhaparvadvigoḥ' (5.1.28) ityādinā''rhīyasya ṭha ko luki kṛte `luk‌ taddhitaluki' (1.2.49) iti strīpratyayasyāpi luk‌| tatra yadi takan‌ vidhīyate, tadā ṭāpo'bhāvādikāro na na śrūyeta, prakrayāgauravaṃ syāt‌; ikagārasya śāstrāntareṇa vidhīyamānatvāt‌|| 40. sasnau praśaṃsāyām‌| (5.4.40) 41. vṛkajyeṣṭhābhyāṃ tiltātilau ca cchandasi| (5.4.41) 42. bahvalpārthācchaskārakādanyatarasyām‌| (5.4.42) `ityevamādīni' iti| ādiśabdenāpādānādikaraṇaviṣayodāharaṇaparibhāṣāgrahaṇam‌--bahubhyo hyatrāgacchati bahuśa āgacchatati, alpaśa āgacchatīti| bahuśo nidadhāti| `bahūnāṃ svāmī' ityatra śeṣasya vivakṣitakārakābhidhāyī bahuśabdo na bhavati| `arthagrahaṇāt‌' ityādi| asati hyarthagrahaṇe bahavalpaśabdābhyāmeva pratyayaḥ syāt‌ | tasmiṃstu sati paryāyebhyo'pi bhavati| `bahvalpārthāt‌' ityādi| vahvalpārthāt‌ pratyaye vidhātavye maṅgalavacaṭanaṃ karttavyam‌| bhaṅgalavacanena ceha vyākhyānamucyate, vyākhyāyate teneti kṛtvā| kathaṃ punaḥ kāraṇasya maṅgalavacanaṃ karttavyam‌? ityāha--`yatra' ityādi| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--iha praśaṃsāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, praśaṃśāyāṃ pratyayena bhavitavyam‌, tacchābhyudayikeṣu| bahuśo dadāti, nālpaśaḥ--evaṃ praśaṃsā bhavati| idameva vacanamābhyudayikeṣu bahuśo loke dānaviṣayeṣu; anyatā tenāsya grahaṇān‌vṛttermaṅgale gamyamāne pratyayo na bhavatīti| atha vā--ihāpītikaraṇānuvṛttermaṅagala eva bhavati, nānyatreti| śasaḥ sakārasyetsaṃjñā na bhavati; prayojanābhāvāt‌|| 43. saṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyām‌| (5.4.43) `nityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) iti dvirvacanena tadapavādaḥ śasvidhīyate| `eko'rtha ucyate yena tadekavacanam‌' iti| etena sahārthekavacanāntādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu cānvarthagrahaṇena ca prāpnotyeva, bhavati hyekavacanam‌, ekārthavṛttitvāt‌? naiṣaḥ, na hi vākyasyaikārthatā pratyayavidāvāśrīyate| kiṃ tarhi? vṛttisthā| na vṛttau ca nivṛttāyāṃ vibhaktau ghaṭādaya eva śabdā ekavacanāntā bhavanti; jātiśabdatvāt‌| jātiśabdā hi naikasyāmekajātyādhārabhūtāyāṃ vyaktau varttante, kiṃ tarhi? anekasyāmapi| tadeṣāmekārthavṛttitvaṃ vākya eva vibhaktisaṃkhyāśrayaṇe pratīyate, na vṛttau; vibhakternivṛttatvāt‌| `kārṣāpaṇādayaśca' ityādi| `kārṣāpaṇādayaḥ śabdāḥ parimāṇāḥ' ityuktam‌| parimāṇasya viseṣasya vācakā ityarthasyādhikye teṣāṃ vṛttirna sambhavati| vākye tu teṣāṃ prayoge'nekārthapratītiḥ--kārṣāpaṇau, kārṣāpaṇā iti, sā vibhaktirna tebhyaḥ| vṛttau tu sā vibhaktirnāstīti tenaikārthā bhavanti| vṛttisthaikārthatā pratyayavidhāvāśrīyate, na vākyasthetyuktametat‌| `ghaṭaṃ ghaṭaṃ dadāti' iti| ghaṭādayaḥ sabdā vṛttāvekārthā na bhavanti| etacca pratipāditam‌| yadānvarthāḥ prakaraṇādisahitā ghaṭādayo'pi jātiśabdā ekārthā bhavanti, tadā bhavitavyameva śasā; anyathā `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20) ityatra yadvakṣyati--jasā sahacaritasya śaso grahaṇamityatra na bhavati--`kuḍavaśo dadāti, śataśaḥ praviśati' iti, tadvyāhanyate; kuḍavādiśabdasyāpi jātiśabdatvāt‌|| 44. pratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ| (5.4.44) `pradyumno vāsudevataḥ prati' iti| `pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt‌' (2.3.11) iti pañcamī, tatastasiḥ| taserikāro mukhamukhārthaḥ| nanu ca sakārasyetsaṃjñā mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ syāt‌? naitadasti; prayojanābhāvādeva hi tasyetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati| `ādyādibhya upasaṃkhyanam‌' iti| ādyādibhyasataserupasaṃkhyānamiti pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--uttarasūtre cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena ādyādibhāstasirbhaviṣyatīti| anuktasamuccayārthatve cakārasya `tasyādita udāttamardhahrasvam‌' (1.2.32) iti nirdeśaḥ|| 45. apādāne cāhīyarūhoḥ| (5.4.45)
