`grāmādāgacchati' iti| `ghruvamapāye'pādānam‌' (1.4.24) ityapādānasaṃjñā| `caurebhyo bibheti' iti| `bhitrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ' (1.4.25) iti| `adhyayanāt‌ parājayate' iti| `parājerasoḍhaḥ' (1.4.26) iti| `sārthāddhīyate' iti| `ohāk‌ tyāge' (dhā. pā. 1090), laḥ karmaṇyātmanapadam‌, yak‌, `ghumāsthā' (6.4.66) ityādisūtreṇettvam‌| nanu cākarttṛkaṃ karma nāsti, `kartturīpsitatamaṃ karma' (1.4.49) iti vacanāt‌; sārthaścātra na karma, kiṃ tarhi? apādānam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; karmasaṃjñāyāṃ hi karttṛgrahaṇaṃ svātantryopalakṣaṇārtham‌| kṛta etat‌? kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt‌| karttari ca dvayamasti--svātantrayam‌, kartṛsaṃjñā ca| tatra saṃjñāyāḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇatvaṃ nopapadyate| yaddhi tasyāḥ kāraṇaṃ tenaiva sā yuktā viśeṣayitum‌| na ca tasyāḥ karttṛsaṃjñā kāraṇam‌, kiṃ tarhi? svātantryam‌;tasya karttṛsvarūpatvāt‌| bhavati kriyāṃ prati yadā kāraṇabhāvaḥ; karmaṇā ca naiva kriyā viśeṣyate, tadāyamartho bhavati--svātantryasya kriyāyā yadīpsitatamaṃ tatkarmasaṃjñaṃ bhavatīti| sārthasyāpi devadattena tasyābhidhānam‌| tasya tasmiṃstvasatyapādānamapi na syādeva| tasmāddevadattaḥ karma| jahātereva sārthasyāpādānena bhavitavyam‌| tatrāpādānasyāpi sataḥ sārthasya hānakriyāyāṃ yat‌ svātantryaṃ tatkriyāvivakṣayaiva devadattasya karmasaṃjñā bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ yakā nirdeśaḥ kriyate, na `hāruhoḥ' ityevocyeta? ityata āha--`vikāranirdeśaḥ' ityādi| vikriyate tasmin‌ rūpamiti vikāraḥ, sa punariha yageva--hīyeti| tatra hi dhumāstādisūtremekārasya (6.4.66) vidhānāt‌ vikriyate jahāte rūpam‌| atha vā--vikṛtiḥ-vikāraḥ, tena vikāreṇa nirdeśaḥ. kathaṃ nāma? jahāteḥ pratipattiryathā syāt‌, jihītermā bhūdityevamartham‌; anyathā hi jīhīterapi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| vikāranirdeśe tu yasyedṛśaṃ rūpaṃ tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti na bhavatyeṣa prasaṅgaḥ| `bhūmita ujjihote' iti| jihīterihāgrahaṇāt‌ tatsambandhino'pādānādbhavatyeva| hāṅo ṅitvādātmanepadam‌, `bhṛjāmit‌' (7.4.76) ityabhyāsasyettvam‌, `ī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) iti dhātorīttvam‌| `kathaṃ mantro hīnaḥ svarato varṇato vā' iti? yadāha--jahāteḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate tatastasminna prāpnetī tyabhiprāyaḥ| `naiṣā pañcamī' iti| pañcamyā avihitatvā|, upacāreṇa tasiḥ, naiṣā pañcamītyuktam‌| kiṃ tarhi? tṛtīyeti| atrāpi tṛtīyāyā vihitatvāt‌| tṛtīyetyuktastasiḥ| tenaitat‌ sūcayati--nāyamiha tasiranena sūtreṇa pañcamyā vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `atigrahāvyathanakṣe peṣvakarttari tṛtīyāyāḥ' (5.4.46) ityanuvarttamānaṃ `hīyamānapāpayogacca' (5.4.47) iti tṛtīyāyā iti| sā ca tṛtīyā hetau karaṇe vā draṣṭavyā|| 46. atigrahāvyathanakṣepeṣvakarttari tṛtīyāyāḥ| (5.4.46) `atikramya' iti| anenātiśabdo'trātikrame varttata iti darśayati| `acalanamadhyathanam‌' iti| `vyathabhayacalanayoḥ' (dhā.pā. 764) iti paṭhyate, tasyeha calane vṛttimācaṣṭe| vṛtteneti hetau karaṇe vā tṛtīyā|| 47. hīyamānapāpayogācca| (5.4.47) `vṛttena hīyate, vṛttataḥ pāpaḥ' ityatra vṛttasya hīyamānena pāpena yoge tṛtīyā hetau, karaṇe vā| kṣepavivakṣāyāmidamudāharaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`kṣepasya ca' ityādi|| 48. ṣaṣṭhyā vyāśraye| (5.4.48) 49. rogāccāpanayane| (5.4.49) `pravāhikātaḥ' iti| pravāhikāśabdāt‌ pratīkārāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, tatastasiḥ|| 50. abhūtatadbhāve kṛbhvastiyoge sampadyakartari cviḥ| (5.4.50) `kāraṇasya vikārarūpeṇābhūtasya' iti| kāraṇam‌-prakṛtiḥ, tasyaivottaramavasthāntaram‌-vikāraḥ| tena vikārarūpeṇābhūtasyājātasyetyarthaḥ| kutaḥ punarayamabhūtatadbhāvaviśeṣo labhyate? abhūtagrahaṇādiha hi bhāvaḥ-janma, sattā vā| yadi hi sattā bhāvaḥ syāt‌, bhvastibhyāmeva sambandhaḥ syāt‌, na karotinā| na hi yat‌ kriyate sā sattā| dhātutrayopādāne ca sati yasminnarthe gṛhyamāṇe tribhirapi dhātubhiryogo'sti sa evāśrayituṃ yuktaḥ; sa ca janmaiva, na sattā | kṛgarahaṇādeṣa viśeṣo labhyate| `tadātmanā bhāvaḥ' iti| tacchabdena vikāraḥ parāmṛśyate, sa eva vikāraḥ; ātmā-svabhāvaḥ, tena vikārātmā-abhūtatadbhāvaḥ| api tu labdhasattākasyaiva kāraṇasya prāgapratipannavikārasyottarakālavikārabhūmāvāptirabhūtatadbhāva ityuktaṃ bhavati| tena yatra prakṛtirna vivakṣyate, tatra pratyo na bhavati, yathāśuklaṃ karotīti pratyudāharaṇe| na hi prakṛtāvatra vivakṣitāyāmevaṃvidho'bhūtatadbhāvo gamyate| tacchabdena prakṛtivikārayorabhedavivakṣā pratipādyate| tena yatra prakṛtivikārarūpamāpadyamānā tasmādabhinnā vivakṣyate, tatraiva pratyayo bhavati; na tu yatra kāraṇataḥ kāryasya bhedo vivakṣyate| yatra tu bhevaḥ, yathā--paṭaṃ karotīti, na tatra| `sampadyateḥ karttā sampadyakarttā' iti| kathaṃ punastiṅntena samāsaḥ? kathaṃ ca tiṅo lopaḥ? sautratvāt‌? nirdeśasya sattvāt sarvamidamupapadyate| atha vā--sampūrvāt‌ paderata eva nipātanādyatpratyayaḥ, tadantasyāyaṃ viśeṣamasamāsaḥ| tat‌ tiṅntasya vṛttikaraṇe tvarthapradarśanamātraṃ kṛtam‌; na punaretadvigrahavākyam‌| `sampattiḥ' iti vaktavye, `sampadyakartteri' ityuktaṃ vaicitryārtham‌ `śūklīkaroti' iti| `asya cvau' (7.4.32) itīttve `cvau' (7.4.26) iti dīrghatvam‌| cavyantasyāvyayatvāt‌ sorlopaḥ| `nātra prakṛtivivakṣitā' iti| vikāramātrasya vivakṣitatvāt‌| yatra ca prakṛtirna vivakṣvate, nātrābhūtatadbhāvo gamyata iti na bhavati pratyayaḥ| `abhūtatadbhāvasāmartyāllabdhameva' ityādi| yo hyavikārarūpeṇa bhūto vikārātmānā bhavati, sa niyogatastena rapeṇa sampadyamānaḥ sampadyakarttā bhavatītyetat‌ sāmarthyāt‌ svarūpāntareṇa sampadyate| tat karttṛsaṃjñakameva bhavatīti nāyaṃ niyogata ityabhiprāyeṇāha--`kārakāntarasampattau mā bhūt‌' iti| `adevagṛhe' ityādi| atra devagṛhasya devatārādhanatvenābhūtasya prāguttarakālaṃ devatādeyasambandhena tadātmakatvamāpadyamānasya bhavatyayamabhūtatadbhāvaḥ; sa tvadhikaraṇasya, na karttuḥ| tathā hi--tadrūpāntaramāpadyamānamapi na karttṛsaṃjñam‌, kiṃ tarhi? adhikaraṇasaṃjñameva; anyathā saptamī na syāt‌| cvau ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| cakāraḥ prakṛtaderantodāttārthaṛḥ| vakārasya `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) iti lopaḥ|| 51. arurmanaścakṣuścetorahorajasāṃ lopaśca| (5.4.51) `atra viśeṣaṇasambandhāt‌' ityādi| abhūtatadbhāvādīni sarvāṇi viśeṣaṇānīha pūrvasūtrādanuvarttante| tasmāt‌ sarvaviśeṣaṇasambandhāt‌ pūrveṇaivāruḥprabhṛtibhyaḥ pratyayaḥ siddha iti nāsau didhīyate, lopamātraṃ tu na prāpnoti| atastadartha vacanam‌| yadi punaranenaiva pratyayavidhiḥ syātad‌, durmanīkarotītyādau pratyayo na syāt‌; grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidheḥ pratiṣedhāt‌ (vyā.pa. 89) pūrveṇa tu tadantādapi bhavati; tatra grahaṇavatprātipadikasyābhāvāt‌| `unmanīkaroti' ityevamādau bahuvrīheḥ pratyayaḥ|| 52. vibhāṣā sāti kārtsnye| (5.4.52) `vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ cveḥ prāpakam‌' iti| samuccayārthatvāt‌| samuccayārthatvaṃ tvanekārthatvānnipātasya| yadyevam‌, cakāra eva kasmānnohyaḥ? vaicitryāt‌ sūtrakṛteḥ| atha pratyayadikalpārthameveti vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`pratyayavikalpastu' ityādi|| 53. abhividhau sampadā ca| (5.4.53) `sa tu kṛbhvastibhireva yoge bhavati' iti| kṛbhvastibhirityeva yoga ityanena sambandhasyava tasyehānuvṛtteḥ| abhividheḥ kārtsnyasya cāvaśyaṃ viśeṣeṇa bhavitavyam‌; anyathā sūtradvayārambho niṣphalaḥ syāt‌, ekenaiva siddhatvāt‌| sa ca viśeṣo na jñāyate, ityatastat‌ pṛcchati--`atābhividheḥ' ityādi| `yathāsyāṃ senāyām‌' ityādi| atha śeṣāṇāṃ śastrāṇāmekadeśena hyātmanā sambandhamātraṃ vivakṣitam‌, na sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpattiḥ| `varṣāsu sarva lavaṇamudakasātsampadyate' iti| atrāpi sarvāsāṃ lavaṇavyaktīnāmekadeśenodakātmatāvikāreṇa sambandhamātraṃ vivakṣitam‌| na tvekasya sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpattiḥ| `kātsnyaṃ tu' ityādi| yatra hyekasyāpi dravyasya sarvātmanā vikārarūpāpattiḥ, na tvekadeśena, tatra kārtsnya bhavati| tatra yadi pūrvo yogo nārabyeta, yatraikadravyaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ kātsnyaṃ tatra pratyayogo na syāt‌; abhividherabhāvāt‌| athāyaṃ nārabhyeta? yatra sarvāḥ prakṛtaya ekadeśena vikāramāpadyante na syat‌| tasmādubhayamārabdhadhyam‌|| 54. tadadhīnavacane| (5.4.54) `tadadhīnaṃ tadāyattam‌' iti| tasyāyattaṃ tadāyattam‌| tacchabdena svāmisāmānyamucyate| adhīnaśabdenāpīśitavyasāmānyam‌| anantaroktamevārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha--`tatsvamikamityarthaḥ' iti| sa svāmī yasya tat‌ tatsvāmikam‌| atrāpyanyapadārthapradhānatvādṛbahuvrīhiḥ| īśitavyasya cānyapadārthatvāt‌ tasya pradhānabhāvaḥ| svāminastu tadupalakṣaṇatvādguṇabhāvaḥ| `svāmisāmānyam‌' ityādi| svāmisāmānyam‌-īśvarasāmānyam‌, īśitavyasāmānyamitatatatatyetadubhayaṃ tadadhīnaśabdenocyate| kathaṃ kṛtvā? iha `adhirīśvare' (1.4.97) ityadhiśabdasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tena yoge `yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvara' (2.3.9) iti ca saptamī| sa ceśvara īśitavyāpekṣita iti sāmarthyādīśitavyābhidhānamadhiśabdena yoge bhavati| adiśabdaścāyaṃ śauṇḍādiṣu paṭhyate, tatra `saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ' (2.1.40) iti samāse kṛte pūrvapadasya svābhisāmānyamartho bhavati, uttarapadasya ceśitavyasāmānyam‌| avaḍakṣādisūtreṇa (5.4.7) khapratyaye kṛte sa evāyamartho bhavati, tasya tatsvāmikatvādityevaṃ ca kṛtvā| svāmisāmānyamīśitavyāsāmānyaṃ tadadhīnaśabdenocyate| tatra svāmisāmānyaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ, īśitavyasāmānyaṃ tu pratyāyartha ityata āha--`svāmiviśeṣavācinaḥ' ityādi|| 55. deye trā ca| (5.4.55) `rājasādbhavati rāṣṭam‌' iti| pūrveṇa sātireva bhavati|| 56. devamanuṣyapuruṣapurumartyebhyo dvitīyāsaptamyorbahulam‌| (5.4.56) atha bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `dibhāṣā sāti kārtsnye' (5.4.52) ityatra vibhāṣāgrahamanuvarttiṣyata eva, vikalpena pratyayo bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`bahulagrahaṇādanyatrāpi labhyate' iti| tasmādvibhāṣāyāṃ prakṛtāyāṃ yadbahulavacanaṃ kṛtam‌, tadanyatrāpi yathā syādityabhiprayaḥ|| 57. avyaktānukaraṇāddvyajavarārddhadanitau ḍāc‌| (5.4.57) `avyakatasyānukaraṇamavyaktānukaraṇam‌' iti| yadyapyanukaraṇe varṇaviśeṣo rūpeṇa na prakāśate, tathāpi dhvaneḥ samānatayā tanmātrasādṛśyena sa tavanukriyata iti tasyāpyanukaraṇamityucyate| dvyajarddhaṃ bhavati tasmāt‌ pratyayo bhavati, yasya na tato'pi nyūnataramekājbhavati| yadyakṛte dvivacane yasya dvyajavarārddhatā tato ḍājbhavatīti jñāyate, tataḥ paṭadityāderna syāt‌; na hyatra dvyajavaramarddhaṃ bhavatītyetacchetasi kṛtvā''ha--`yasya ca' ityādi| nanvevaṃ sati ḍāci parabhūte tadāśraye dvirvacane kṛte dvyajavarārddhatā bhavati, tasyāñca satyāṃ ḍājitītaretarāśrayaḥ prasajati| itaretarāśrayāṇi kāryāṇi śāstre na prakalpante? ityāha--`ḍāci bahulam‌' ityādi| yadyeṣā parasaptamī syāt‌, syādeṣa doṣaḥ; na caiṣā parasaptamī, kiṃ tarhi? viṣayasaptamī| `paṭapaṭākaroti' iti| paṭacchabdāḍḍāci vivakṣite viṣayabhūte buddhisthe'nutpanna eva pūrvaṃ tāvad‌dvivaicanaṃ paṭacchabdasya kriyate, tasmin‌ kṛte dvyajavarārddhatāyāmupajātāyāṃ ḍāci ṭilopaḥ, `nityamābhreḍite ḍāci' (6.1.100) iti pūrvasya takārasya pararapatvalam‌, `damadamākaroti' iti| vamacchabdasya pūrvavad‌ddhirvacanam‌, tato ḍāc‌| `dṛṣatkaroti' iti| atrāpi dvirvacane kṛte dvyajavarārddhata bhavatīti| nāvyaktasyedamanukaraṇam‌| `śratkaroti' iti| bhavatyetadavyaktānukaraṇam‌, na dvyajavarārddham‌| kṛte'pi hyatra dvirvacane ekājavaramarddhaṃ sampadyate| `kharaṭakharaṭākaroti' iti| kharaṭavityetasyānukaraṇasyātra paṭadityetasyānukaraṇasyeva pūrvavad‌ddhirvacanam‌, tato ḍāc‌| yadi `dvyajarddham‌' etāvaducyeta, iha pratyayo na syāt‌, na hyatra dvyajarddhatāsti| avaragrahaṇe tu satīhāpi bhavati| tatra hi dvyaco'rddhādyasya nyūnataramarddha tata eva pratyayena bhavitavyam‌, anyatastu sarvato bhavitavyameva; anyathā'varagrahaṇamanarthakameveti dvyajarddhādityevaṃ brayāt‌| `paṭiti karoti' iti| `adhyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau' (6.1.98) ityacchabdasya pararūpatvam‌| yadyatra ḍāc‌ syāt‌, tasya ḍājantasya paramiti śabdamuccārya karotiranantaraḥ syāditi, na ca tatparam‌; taccāniṣṭam‌| atha cakāraḥ kimarthaḥ, yāvalatāntodāttatvaṃ kṛtvādasya pratyayasvareṇaiva siddham‌? ityata āha--`cakāraḥ' ityādi| paṭapaṭā asi iti sthite `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) ityasiśabdasya nighāte kṛte `svarito vānudātte'padādau' (8.2.6) iti svarita ekādeśaḥ prāpneti, na ca svarita iṣyate, tadartha cakāraḥ| `svārthiko vijñeyaḥ' iti| vyatiriktasyārthasyābhāvāt‌| kena punaḥ svārthiko yakāraḥ? anenaiva nipātanena|| 58. kṛño dvitīyatṛtīyaśabhbavījāt‌ kṛṣau| (5.4.58) nanu kṛbhbastiyoga ityataḥ karotiranuvarttate, tat‌ kimarthaṃ kañgrahaṇam‌? ityādi| dhātutryaṃ prakṛtam‌, tatrāsati kṛñgrahaṇe yathā kṛño bhavati, tathā bhvastyorapi syāt‌| tasmāt‌ kṛño grahaṇaṃ bhvastinivṛttyartham‌|| 59. saṃkhyāyāśca guṇāntāyāḥ| `saṃkyāyāḥ' iti sāmīpyasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī| `guṇāntāyāḥ' iti pratyayavidhau saṃkhyāvācinaḥ śabdasyetyanena saṃkhyāśabdasya ṣaṣṭhyantatāṃ darśayati| antaśabdo'vayavavacano'pyasti, tasyeha grahaṇe saṃkhyāśabdena sambandho na syāt‌, na hi saṃkhyāśabdasya guṇaśabdo'vayava upapadyate--iti matvā sāmīpyavacano'yamanta śabda iti darśayannāha--`guṇaśabdo'nte samīpe' iti| `yatra' iti| anena prakṛtinirddiśyate| `sā' ityādi| sā prakṛtiḥ saṃkhyā guṇāntenābhidhīyata ityarthaḥ| guṇaśabdo'nte yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `tādṛśāt‌' ityādinā tathābhūtāt‌ saṃkhyāśabdāt‌ sāmīpyavarttiguṇaśabdādityarthaḥ| nanu ca sāmīpyavacanāntaśabde saṃkhyāyāḥ pūrvaḥ paro vā guṇa iti viśeṣo nāvadhāryyate, tathā ca yatrāpyasau pūrvastatrāpi syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāmīpye'yaṃ varttamāno niyatadeśameva parāśrayaṃ vā yat‌ sāmīpyaṃ tadācaṣṭe, na sāmīpyamātram‌; yathā--avayave varttamāno nāvayavamātramabhidhatte, kiṃ tarhi? viśiṣṭaveśamevādayavam‌--`dviguṇaṃ vilekhanaṃ karoti' iti|| 60. samayācca yāpanāyām‌| (5.4.60) 61. sapattraniṣpattrādativyathane (5.4.61) saha tpatreṇa sapattraḥ| nirgataṃ pattraṃ yasmānniṣpattraḥ| atipīḍanam‌-atibādhanam‌|| 62. niṣkulānniṣkoṣaṇe (5.4.62) `nikuṣlān‌ karoti' iti| nirdiṣṭaṃ kulaṃ yasyeti sa niṣkulaḥ| kulaśabdo'tra bandhuṣu varttate|| 63. sukhaprirayādānulobhye `ārādhyacittānuvarttanam‌' iti| svāmyāderanabhimatānuṣṭhānenābhimatānanuṣṭhānena vā cittasya pīḍanaṃ duḥkham‌-prātilomyam‌| tadapi prāṇidharma eva|| 64. duḥkhātprātilomye| (5.4.64) `svāmyādeścittapīḍanam‌' iti| svāmyāderanabhimatānuṣṭhānenābhimatānanuṣṭhānena vā cittasya pīḍanaṃ duḥkham‌-prātilomyam‌| tadapi prāṇidharma eva|| 65. śūlātpāke| (5.4.65) `śūlākaroti māṃsam‌' iti| pacatītyarthaḥ|| 66. satyādaśapathe| (5.4.66) 67. madrātparivāpaṇe| (5.4.67) `madrākaroti' iti| maṅgalapūrvaṃ muṇḍanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| `bhadrācceti vaktavyam‌' iti| bhadraśabdācca ḍājbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`samayācca yāpanāyām‌' (5.4.60) ityataścakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena bhadrādapi bhaviṣyatīti|| 68. samāsāntāḥ| (5.4.68) "samāsāntāḥ" ityayamadhikāraḥ' iti| vakṣyamāṇena `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt‌' (5.4.73) ityādinā bahuvrīhyāditvena samāsaviśeṣādvidhāsyante; yatrāpi bahuvrīhyādigrahaṇaṃ nāsti, tatra saṅghātaḥ prakṛtitvena nirdiśyate| yatā--`ac‌ pratyanvavapūrvāt‌ sāmalomnaḥ' (5.4.75) iti, tataśca sāmarthyādeva samāsāntāḥ pratyāya vijñāsyante, tatkiṃ samāsagrahaṇena? yatraitadubhayaṃ nāsti--yathā--`ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) iti, tadarthaṃ samāsāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| antaśabdo'yaṃ sāmīpyavacano'pyasti, yadi tasyeha grahaṇaṃ syāt‌ pratyayaparatvenaiva ḍajādīnāṃ sāmīpyasya siddhatvādantaśabdo'narthakaḥ syāditi matvā''ha--avayavavacano'yamantaśabdo gṛhyata iti darśayannāha--avayavā iti asya paryāyeṇa vṛttiṃ kartumāha--`ekadeśāḥ' iti| ekadeśaśabdamihāśrayatā prāksamāsavidheḥ samāsārthāduttarapadāt‌ vakṣyamāṇāḥ pratyayā bhavanti, paścāt‌ samāsaḥ--ityuktaṃ bhavati| evaṃ hi te samāsasyaikadeśā bhavanti yadi prāk‌ samāsavṛtteḥ syāt‌| samāsāntān‌ kṛtvā paścāt‌ tadantena samāsaḥ kriyate| evañca taiḥ saha samāsasaṃjñā bavatītyupapadyate ḍajādīnāṃ samāsāvayavatvam‌| ataścaitadevaṃ vijñeyam‌| yo'bhimanyatesamāse kṛte ḍajādibhirbhavitavyamiti, tasya `na kapi' (7.4.14) ityatra yadvakṣyati vṛttikāraḥ--`samāsārthe hyu ttarapade kapi kṛte paścāt‌ samāsena bhaktivyam‌' iti, tadvirudhyate| nanu ca samāsārthāduttarapadāḍḍajādiṣu kṛteṣu paścāt‌ tadantena samāsaḥ kriyate--ityasminnapi pakṣe samāno doṣaḥ, yataḥ `patho vibhāṣā' (5.4.72) ityevamādiṣu nañaḥ paro yaḥ pathin‌śabdastadantāt‌ tatpuruṣādvibhāṣā samāsānto bhavatītyevamādayo nirdeśā virudhyanta eva? naitadasti; tadavirodhasya `ṅyāpprātipadikāt‌' (4.1.1) ityatra pratipāditatvāt‌| `tadgrahaṇena gṛhyante' iti tacchabdena samāsaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| samāsāvayavatve sati teṣāmapi tadanupradeśo bhavati| ataste| samāsagrahaṇena gṛhyanta iti| atha samāsāvayavatve pratyayasya kiṃ prayojanam‌? ityāha--`prayojanam‌' ityādi| `adhirājam‌, uparājam‌' iti| yatākramaṃ vibhaktyarthe sāmīpye'vyayībhāvaḥ| `avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ' (5.4.107), `anaśca' (5.4.108) iti ṭajantasyāvyayībhāvagrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌ `nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ' (2.4.83) iti vibhakteraluk‌, amantabhāvaśca bhavati| dve purī samāhṛte iti `taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti samātaḥ| sa ca `saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ' (2.1.52) iti dvigusaṃjñaḥ, `ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathām‌' (5.4.74) ityakārapratyayāntasya dvigugrahaṇena grahaṇāvakārāntāt‌ `dvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīp‌ siddho bhavati| kośaniṣadinīti| kośaśca niṣacceti samāhāradvandvaḥ, `dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt‌ samāhāre' (5.4.106) iti ṭac‌ tasya dvandvagrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌ kośaniṣadamasyā astīti `dvandvopatāpagarhyāta' (5.2.128) prāṇisthādinirbhavati, `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' (4.1.5) iti ṅīp‌| sraktvacinīti| pūrveṇa tulyam‌| `vidhuraḥ' pradhuraḥ' iti| vigato dhuraḥ, pragato dhura iti `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti prāditatpuruṣasamāsaḥ| pūrvavadakārasyeha tatpuruṣagrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌ `tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyā' (6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ siddho bhavati| pūrvapadaṃ punaratara nipāta ādyudāttaḥ| asati tu samāsāntatve pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatā syāt‌| `uccairdhuraḥ, nīcairdhuraḥ' iti| uccairdhūrasyeti nīcairdhūrasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| pūrvavadakārapratyayaḥ, tasya bahuvrīhigrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌ `bahuvrīhau prakṛtayā pūrvapadam‌' (6.2.1) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarastvihāntodāt‌taḥ| sanutar‌, uccais‌, nīcais‌, śanaisa, ṛdhak‌, ṛte, yugapat‌, ārāt‌, pṛthagityete sanutar‌prabhṛtayo'ntodāttāḥ, svarādiṣu pāṭhāt‌|| 69. na pajanāt‌| (5.4.69) `surājā, atirājā' iti| śobhano rājā, atiśayitaḥ rājeti vigṛhya `kugatiprādayaḥ (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| `sugauḥ' iti| pūrvavatsamāsaḥ| atra `gorataddhitaluki' (5.4.92) iti ṭac‌ prāpnoti; asmādvacanānna bhavati| `paramarājaḥ, paramagavaḥ' iti| `sanmahat‌' (2.1.64) iti samāsaḥ| `susakthaḥ' iti| `bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgāt‌ ṣac‌' (5.4.113) iti ṣac‌|| 70. kimaḥ kṣepe| (5.4.70) `kiṃrājā' iti| nindito rājeti vigṛhya `kiṃ kṣepe' (2.1.64) iti samāsaḥ| kiṃrāja ityatra praśne kiṃśabdaḥ, na kṣepe, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| nanu `lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.3) iti pratipadokto yaḥ kimaḥ samāsaḥ `kiṃ kṣepe'(2.1.64) ityanena vihitaḥ sa eva grahīṣyata iti kṣepagrahaṇamanarthakam‌? evaṃ tarhi kṣepagrahaṇenai tadeva jñāpayati--iyaṃ paribhāṣā nāvatiṣṭhata iti| tena bahuvrīhāvapi pratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati--ninditā dhūrasya kindhuraṃ śakaṭam‌, nirdharaṃ śakaṭamiti|| 71. nañastatpuruṣāt‌| (5.4.71) `arājā' iti| tatpuruṣa'yam‌| `anṛco māṇavakaḥ, adhuraṃ śakaṭam‌' iti| dvāvapi bahuvrīhi| pūrvavadakāraḥ|| 72. patho vibhāṣā| (5.4.72) apatham‌' ityatra pūrvavadakāraḥ| `apathaṃ napuṃsakam‌' (2.4.30) iti napuṃsakaliṅgatā|| 73. bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt‌| (5.4.73) bahuvrīhāviti subvyatyayena pañcamyarthe saptamī| `saṃkhyāvyayāsanna' (2.2.25) ityādinā yo bahuvrīhiḥ, tasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti| tasyaiva saṃkhyeye vṛttiḥ| yattarhi vārthe varttate--dvitrāḥ, pañcaṣā iti, yaśca sujarthe--dvidaśāḥ, tridaśā iti, tatra na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tāvapi saṃkhyeye varttata eva; saṃkhyeyatayaiva vārthasya sujarthasya cābhidhānāt‌| daśānāṃ ca samīpe upadaśāḥ| viśateḥ samīpe upaviṃśāḥ| viśateḥ samīpe upaviṃśāḥ| `tiviṃśateḍiti' (6.4.142) iti tilopaḥ, dvayorapyakārayoḥ `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| daśānāmāsannā `āsannadaśāḥ'| daśānāmadūrā `adūradaśāḥ' daśānāmadhikā `adhikadaśāḥ' dvau vā trayo vā `dvitrā'| pañca vā ṣaṅvā `pañcaṣāḥ'| sarvatra `saṃkhyāvyayāsanna' (2.2.24) ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ| `citraguḥ iti| `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvaḥ| nanu ca nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) bahugaṇaparatiṣedhāt‌ tatsadṛśavijñānena saṃkhyottarapada eva bahuvrīhivijñāsyate, evañca citraguprabhṛtiṣu prāptireva nāstīti kiṃ saṃkhyāgrahaṇena? syādetadevaṃ yadi bahuśabdaḥ saṃkhyeyapadameva syāt‌; sa ca vaipulyavacano'pyasti, tenāsati saṃkhyeyagrahaṇe saṃkhyottarapadagrahaṇaṃ na syāt‌| `upabahavaḥ, upagaṇāḥ' iti pūrvavadvahuvrīhīḥ| `atra' ityādi| upagaṇā ityatra satyasati vā ḍāci rūpaṃ prati viśeṣo nāstīti| svare tu vidyate--ḍaci hi satyantodāttatvaṃ syāt‌, tasminnasati pūrvapadaprakṛtibhāvenādyudāttaṃ bhavati| `saṃkhyāyāḥ' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatpuruṣasya saṃkhyāvāci yaduttarapadaṃ tato ḍacaḥ pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--`saṃkhyāyāśca guṇāntāyāḥ' (5.4.59) ityataścakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ tena saṃkhyāyāstutpuruṣasya ḍajbhaviṣyatīti| `nistriṃśādyartham‌ iti| ādiśabdaḥ prakāre| `nistriśāḥ'[`nistriṃśāni, nistriṃśaḥ' ityeva mūlopātte pade] iti| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti tatpuruṣaḥ| ḍacaścitkaraṇamantodāttārtham‌| anyathā hi pratyayasya samāsaikadeśatvāt‌ pratyasvaro bahuvrīhisvareṇa bādhyate|| 74. ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe| (5.4.74) `sāmarthyāt‌' iti| yasya yena sambandho'sti tat‌ tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati; dhura eva cākṣema sambandho'sti, netareṣām‌| ataḥ samarthyāt‌ tasyaivānakṣa ityetadviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate, na ṛgādīnām‌| `anakṣe' iti ca ṣaṣṭhyarthe saptamī subbyatyayena| ata evāha--`anakṣasambandhinī' ityādi| akṣeṇa sambandho'vayavāvayavilakṣaṇaḥ, so'syā astītyakṣasmabandhinī| sā dhūryasyāṃ tasyā na bhavati| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate--akṣe'bhidheye na bhavatīti? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum‌; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāna ihaiva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌--dṛḍhā dhūrasyākṣasya dṛḍhadhūrakṣa iti| iha tu na syāt‌--akṣasya dhūrakṣadhūriti, evaṃ tarhi vijñāyate--akṣe pūrvapade na bhavatīti? evamapyaśakyaṃ vijñātum‌; tathā hyevaṃ vijñāyamāna ihaiva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌--akṣadhūriti| iha tu na syāt‌--dṛḍhadhūrakṣa iti| yathā vṛtti kārema vyākhyātaṃ tathobhatrāpi bhavati| akṣasambandhinī yā dhūḥ, tadantatvāt‌ samāsasya| `arddharcaḥ' iti| ṛcorddhamiti `ardhaṃ napuṃsakam‌' (2.2.2) iti samāsaḥ| `arddharcā puṃsi ca (2.4.31) iti napuṃsakaliṅgatā ca| `bahavṛcaḥ' iti| bahava ṛco'sya santīti bahuvrīhiḥ| `lalāṭapuram‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'yam‌| atha vā--lalāṭaṃ pūriveti `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ' (2.1.56) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `nāndīpuram‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| yadyapyakārāntena puraśabdena samāse kṛta etat‌ sidhyati, tathāpi vyañjanāntena pūḥśabdena yadi samāsaḥ kriyate, tadā vyañjanāntasya śravaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ puro grahaṇam‌| `dvīpam‌' iti `antarīpam‌' iti `samīpam‌' iti| dvirgatā āpo'smin‌, antargatā āpo'smin‌, saṅgatā āposminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| `dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt‌'(6.3.97) itīttvam‌| `rājadhūrā' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `mahādhuraḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, `ānmahataḥ' (6.3.46) ityāttvam‌, `striyāḥ puṃvat‌' (6.3.34) ityādinā puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `sthalapathaḥ, jalapathaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| saptamīti (2.1.40) yogavibhāgāt‌ sapatamīsamāso vā| ṛgantasya yo bahuvrīhirnañpūrvapadaḥ, tasya māṇavaka evābhidheye pratyaya iṣyate, yo bahupūrvapado bahuvrīhirṛgantaḥ, tasya caraṇā khyāyāmeva iṣyata iti darśayati--`anṛco māṇavako jñeyaḥ' ityādi| etacca `patho vibhāṣā' (5.4.72) ityato vibhāṣāgrahānuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣātvaṃ copalabhyamiti veditavyam‌| `anṛkkaḥ, bahavṛkkaḥ' iti| `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kapa| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌--cakārasya kakāraḥ|| 75. ac‌ pratyanvapūrvātsāmalomnaḥ| (5.4.75) `pratisāmam‌' iti| pratigataṃ sāma pratisāmam‌| prādisamāsaḥ| pratigataṃ vā sāmāsyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| gataśabdo gatārthatvādvṛttau na prayujyate| atha vā--sāma pratīti yathārthe `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādināvyayībhāvaḥ| anugataṃ sāmāneneti bahuvrīhirvā| `avasāmam‌' iti| pūrveṇa tulyam‌| `anulomam‌' ityādau pūrveṇa tulyam‌| `valomam‌' ityādi pūrvavataprādisamāsādayo veditavyāḥ| `kṛṣṇodakpāṇḍupūrvāyāḥ' iti| kṛṣṇodakpāṇḍuśabdāḥ pūrve yasyā bhūmestasyā acpratyayaḥ smṛtaḥ| kṛṣṇā bhūmirasmin‌ deśe kṛṣṇabhūmo deśaḥ| udīcī bhūmirasmin‌ deśa udagbhūmaḥ| pāṇḍurmūmirasmin‌ pāṇḍubhūmaḥ| godāvaryyāśca nadyāścācpratyayaḥ smṛtaḥ te cennadagodavaryau saṃkhyāyā uttare bhavataḥ| pañcānāṃ godāvarīṇāṃ samāhāraḥ; `nadībhiśca' (2.1.20) iti samāhāre'vyayībhāvaḥ--pañcagodāvaram‌, pañcanadam‌| `bhūmerapi' ityādi| na kevalaṃ nadīgīdāvarībhyām‌, api tu bhūmerapi saṃkhyāpūrvāyā iṣyate| `dvibhūmaḥ' ityādau sarvatra bahuvrīhiḥ| `tat‌' ityādi| etat‌ kṛṣṇabhūmādyapi yogavibhāgaṃ kṛtvā''cāryāḥ sādhayanti|| 76. akṣṇo'darśanāt‌| (5.4.76) `adarśanāt‌' iti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| `kabarākṣam‌, gavākṣam‌' iti| rūḍhiubdāvetau, nātrāvayavārthe'bhiniveśaḥ kāryaḥ| kabarākṣaṃ gavākṣamiti na sidhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| syādetat‌--darśanapratiṣedhāt‌ siddhametat‌, dṛśyate'neneti; na darśanam‌, na ca kabarākṣema dṛśyate, nāpi gavākṣeṇa? ityata āha--`tenāpi' ityādi| darśanaśbdo'yaṃ cakṣuṣi prāṇyaṅge prasiddhaḥ| tathā hi darśanaṃ prayuṅkte cakṣurgrāhyamapi| tasmāt‌ prasiddhivaśena cakṣuṣparyāyo darśanaśabdaḥ, sa ihāśrīyate|| 77. acaturavicaturasucaturastrīpuṃsadhenvanaḍuharksāmavāṅmanasākṣibhruvadāragavorvaṣṭhīvapadaṣṭhīvanaktandivarātrindivāhardivasarajasaniśśreyasapuruṣāyuṣadvyāyuṣatryāyuṣargyajuṣajātokṣamahokṣavṛddhokṣopaśunagoṣṭhaśvāḥ| (5.4.77) `samāse vyavasthā'pi' ityādi| samāsavyavasthā-samāsaniyamaḥ--kvacidvahuvrīhireva, kvaciddvandva ityevamādikā nipātanādeva veditavyā; vyavasthābhedasyānyasyābhāvāt‌| apiśabdādanyadapi ṭilopādi kāryaṃ nipātanādeva veditavyam‌| `saptamyarthavṛttayoḥ' ityādinā hi saptamyarthavṛttayoravyayayorādheyapradhānayoḥ samāso vidyate| tasmānnipātanādeva ca bhavatīti veditavayam‌| apiśabdāt‌ samāso'pi nipātanādeva| `ahardivam‌' iti| `ro'supi' (8.2.69) iti nakārasya rephaḥ| `nanu ca' ityādi| arthagatyartho hi śabdaprayogaḥ| paryāyaṇāñcaṃkenaivārthasyoktatvāt‌ dvitīyasya prayogo na sambhavati| ahardivāśabdau paryāyau, tat‌ kathamanayordvandvaḥ! na kathañciditi bhāvaḥ| vīpsādyotanārthamuktasyāpi prayogo na virudhyata iti manyamāna āha--`vīpsāyām‌' ityādi| cārtha utpadyamāno dvandvo vīpsāyāṃ na prāpnotītyato nipātyate| eko| eko'vyayībhāvaḥ| `sākalye' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā| `sarajasam‌' iti| `avyayībhāve cakāle' (6.3.81) iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| `niḥśreyasam‌' iti| prādisamāsaḥ| `niśreyaskaḥ' iti| niścitaṃ śreyo'neneti bahuvrīhiḥ, `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌| `ṛgyajurunmugdhaḥ' iti| ya unmugdhatvādṛco yajūṃṣi manyate sa ṛgyajuriti bahuvrīhiṇocyate| `tato'vyayībhāvaḥ' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā sāmīpye| `ṭilopābhāvaḥ' ityādi| upaśuna ityatra `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopābhāvo nipātanādeva| śvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' (6.4.133) iti taddhitādanyatra samprasāraṇamucyamānaṃ taddhite na prāpnotīti tadeva nipātanādeva bhavatīti| `caturocprakaraṇe' ityādi| triśabdādupaśabdāt‌ paro yaścaturaśabdastasmādaca upasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tat‌ pūrvamiva yogavibhāgamāśritya karttavyam‌| trayo vā catvāro vā `tricaturāḥ' iti| caturṇā samīpe `upacaturāḥ'| `saṃkhyāvyayāsanna' (2.2.25) ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ| tatra `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye ḍajabahugaṇāt‌' (5.4.73) iti ḍaci prāpte'jvidhīyate|| 78. brahmahastibhyāṃ varcasaḥ| (5.4.78) `brahmavarcasam‌, hastivarcasam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau| varcaḥśabdo'yaṃ dīptivacanaḥ| `palyarājaśabdābhyāñceti vaktavyam‌' [`palyarājabhyām‌--kāśikā] (iti)| palyaśabdādrājaśabdācca paro yo varcas‌śabdastasmāccājbhavatītyevamartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ cāsya pūrvameva yogavibhāgamāśritya karttavyam‌|| 79. avasamandhebhyastamasaḥ| (5.4.79) `avatamasam‌' iti| avahīnaṃ tamasā, avahīnaṃ vā tama iti prādisamāso vā'yam‌| evaṃ saṅgataṃ tamasā, saṅgataṃ tamaḥ--`santamasam‌'| andhaṃ karotīti ṇic‌, tadantāt‌, andhayatītyandham‌| andhañca tat‌ tamaśceti `andhatamasam‌'| yadandhaṃ tamaḥ karotīti tadevamucyate|| 80.śvaso vasīyaḥśreyasaḥ| (5.4.80) `śvovasīyam‌| śvaḥśreyasam‌' iti| śvovasīyaḥ, śvaḥ śreya iti vigṛhya mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt‌ samāsaḥ| `svabhāvācca' ityādi| yadyapi śvaḥśabdo'nyatra kālaviśeṣe varttate, tathāpīha samāsa uttarapadārthasya praśaṃsāṃ stutimāśīrviṣayāṃ pratipādayati| kutaḥ? svabhāvāt‌| śabdānāṃ hyarthābhidhānaṃ svābhāvikam| tatra svabhāva evātra hetuḥ| `śvovasīyasamityasyaivāyaṃ paryāyaḥ' iti| asyetyanena ca śvaḥśreyasamityeṣa śabdo nirdiśyate|| 81. anvavataprādrahasaḥ| (5.4.81) `anurahasam‌' iti| rahaḥśabdo'yamaprakāśe varttate| anugataṃ rahasaḥ, anugataṃ raha iti vā prādisamāsaḥ| anugataṃ raho'sminniti bahuvrīhirvā| `avarahasam‌' iti| avahīnaṃ rahasā'vahīnaṃ raha iti vā prādisamāsaḥ| avahīnaṃ vā raho'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| taptañca tadrahaśceti `taptarahasam‌' viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| yadutpannaṃ raho lote na kenacidavagamyate, tat‌ taptarahasamityucyate| tapatamiva taptam‌, yathaiva hyagninā taptaṃ na kenacidavagamyate, tathedamiti|| 82. praterurasaḥ saptamīsthāt‌| (5.4.82) `saptamīsthāt‌' iti| saptamyāṃ tiṣṭhatīti saptamīsthaḥ, `supi s‌thaḥ' (3.2.4) iti kapratyayaḥ| yaśca saptamyarthe varttate, evaṃ saptamīstho bhavatītyāha--`saptamyarthe varttate' iti| `pratigatamuraḥ pratyuraḥ' iti| `atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā' (vā. 91) iti samāsaḥ|| 83. anugavamāyāme| (5.4.83) `āyāme'bhidheye' iti| āyāmaḥ-dairṣyam‌| matvarthīyākārāntaścāyam‌| āyāme cetyabhideya ityarthaḥ| anyatā'nugavaṃ yānamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt‌| yānam‌-āyāmaḥ| `anugavaṃ yānam‌' iti| gāvo yathā tathā yānamāyātamityarthaḥ| `gavāṃ paścāt‌' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādināvyayībhāvaḥ paścādarthe ca| pūrvavadgośabdasya hrasvaḥ| anuśabdātpratyaye vidhātavye yadanugavamiti nipātanaṃ tatprasiddhyupasaṃgrahārtham‌| tena yadgavā bāhyaṃ gobhiśca tulyāmāmaṃ tatraiva bhavati, nānyatra|| 84. dvistāvā tristāvā vediḥ| (5.4.84) dvistāvā tristāvā vediḥ| (6.4.148) lope kṛte tāvacchabśadasya ṭilopo nipātyate| `samāsaśca' iti| dvitriśabdayornipātyate| `yāvato prakṛtau' ityādinā napātanasya phalaṃ darśayati| prakṛtivikṛtiśabdau kāryaviśeṣavacanau| karmaviśeṣe hi kaścit‌ yāgākhyaḥ prakṛtiśabdenocyate, kaścidvikṛtitaśbadena|| 85. upasargādadhvanaḥ| (5.4.85) `prādhvam‌' iti| prādisamāmaḥ| tatra prādhvamiti `atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā' (vā.91) iti samāsaḥ| niṣkrāntamadhvana iti `nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā' (vā.95)`atyadhvam‌' iti| prādhvamityanena tulyametat‌| upasargaścātra na gatyupalakṣaṇam‌| kuta etat‌? kriyāyogābhāvāt‌|| 86. tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ| (5.4.86) `mātraco lopaḥ' iti| `pramāṇe dvayasac‌' (5.2.37) ityādinā vihitasya| `niraṅgulam‌' iti| niradhvamityanena tulyametat‌| `atyaṅgulam‌' iti| etadapyatyadhvamityanena tulyam‌| `pañcāṅguliḥ' iti bahuvrīhiḥ|| 87. ahaḥ sarvaikadeśasaṃkhyātapuṇyācca rātreḥ| (5.4.87) `ahargrahaṇaṃ dvāndvārtham‌' iti| iṣṭiriyam‌| na tatpuruṣārtham‌; mukhyārthe tatpuruṣasyāsambhavāt‌| dvandvārthe padārthaṃ pratyāśrayaḥ| tathā hi--yadyaharguṇā rātrirahaḥ śabdenīcyate, rātriguṇaṃ vāho rātriśabdena gauṇyā kalpanayā, tadāhaśca rātriśceti samānādhikaraṇastatpuruṣaḥ sambhavatyeva| tasmādiṣṭiriyam‌| etāvaduktaṃ syāt‌--dvandva iṣyata iti| atra ca jñāpakam--`hemantaśiśirāvahorātre ca cchandasi' (2.4.28) iti dvandve samāsantasya rātriśabdasya nipātanam‌| `ahorātraḥ' iti| `rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi' (2.4.29) iti puṃlliṅgatā| `ahan‌' (8.2.68) iti `rūparātrirathantareṣūpasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā. 924) iti nakārasya rutvādguṇaḥ| `sarvarātraḥ' iti| `pūrvakālaika sarva' (2.1.49) ityādinā samānādhikaraṇastatpuruṣaḥ| `dvirātraḥ' iti `taddhitārthottarapada' (2.1.51) ityādinā samāhāre dviguḥ, `dviguśca' (2.1.23) iti tatpuruṣasaṃjñā| `atirātraḥ' iti| atyadhvamityanena tulyamet‌| `nīrātraḥ' iti| `rori' (8.3.14) iti rephalopaḥ| `ḍhralope pūrvasya' (6.3.111) iti dīrghaḥ|| 88. ahno'hna etebhyaḥ| (5.4.88) `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac‌ iti ṭacpratyayaṃ vakṣyati' iti| atha parakṛta evāci kasmādādeśo na vijñāyate? aśakyastatrāyaṃ vijñātum‌, na hyahaḥśabdātāt‌ tatpuruṣāt‌ kenacidajvihitaḥ, tat‌ kathamādeśasya nimittaṃ syāt‌| atha `ac‌ (5.4.75) iti yogavibhāgenājvidhīyate? evamapyetadvacanemanarthakaṃ syāt‌; aci kṛte `allo'ponaḥ' (6.4.134) ityanenāhnādeśasya siddhatvāt‌| na ca ṭilopaḥ prāpnotīti mantavyam‌; `ahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.134) iti niyamāt‌| tasmādacyeva ṭilopāpavādo'yam‌| ādeśo'yamayuktaḥ| kiṃ punastat‌ sāmarthyam‌, yato'haḥśabdaḥ pūrvatvena nāśrīyate? ityāha--`na hyahaḥśabdāt‌'--ityādi| `dvyahnaḥ' iti| dvayorahnorbhava iti `tadadhitārtha' (2.1.51) ityādinā samāsaḥ, `tatra bhavaḥ (4.3.53) ityaṇ‌, tasya `dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) iti luk‌| `ātyahnaḥ' iti| atyadhvavatsamāsaḥ| `nirahnaḥ' iti| atrāpi niradhvavat‌ samāsaḥ| `sarvāhṇaḥ' iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyatīti| `uttarmakābhyāñca' (5.4.90) iti|| 89. na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre| (5.4.89) `dvyahaḥ' iti| `ahnaṣṭakhoreva' (6.4.145) iti ṭilopaḥ|| 90. uttamaikābhyāñca| (5.4.90) `puṇyāham‌' [`puṇyāhaḥ'--kāśikā] iti| viśeṣaṇam‌ (2.1.57) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `ekāhaḥ' iti| atrāpi `pūrvakālaika' (2.1.49) ityādinā| kathaṃ punaḥ `uttamaikābhyām‌' puṇyaśabdāt‌ pratiṣedho labhyate? ityata āha--`uttamaśabdo'ntyavacanaḥ' ityādi| `ahaḥsarvekadeśa' (5.4.87) ityādau sūtre puṇyaśakhabdasyānte nadiṣṭatvāt‌| `agtyaḥ' iti| uttamaśabde'pi pratiṣedhārtha ihāntyavacana upāttaḥ| tasmāt‌ puṇyaśabdamācaṣṭe| atha puṇyagrahaṇameva kasmānna kṛtam‌, laraghu hyevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati? ityāha--`puṇyagrahaṇameva' ityādi| vaicitryaṃ hi sūtrakṛteriṣyate, taccottamagrahaṇe sati sampadyate| yasmādvaicitryārthamuttamagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam na puṇyagrahaṇam‌| `keci' ityādi| puṇyagrahaṇe karttavye yaduttamagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat‌prayojanam‌--uttamaśabdasyāpi saṃkhakyātasya pratiṣedhapratipattiryathā syādityevaṃ kecidvarṇayanti| bhavati tatsāmīpyāt‌ tācchabdyam‌--gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādi| tasmācchakta uttamaśabdaḥ sāmīpyādupottamaśabdamabhidhātumiti teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ| `tena' ityādinā pratiṣedhasyopottamaśabdapratipatteḥ palaṃ darśayati|| 91. rājāhassakhibhyaṣṭac‌| (5.4.91) `paramāhaḥ, uttamāhaḥ' iti `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ| `madrarājaḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ| kathaṃ punā rājaśabdagrahaṇe rājñīśabdasya prāpnoti? ityata āha--`liṅgaviṣṭiparibhāṣayā' ityīdi| `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.29) ityevā liṅgaviśiṣṭaparibhāṣā| `ladhvakṣarasya' iti| savarṇadīrgho'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya prathamaprayogasarya sa tathoktaḥ| atraha ladhvakṣaraṃ pūrva nipatatīti sakhyurahno vā pūrvānipāte prāpte yo'haśabdasya paranipātaḥ sa rājaśabdasya savarṇadīrdhārthaḥ| prayogastu kvacinnaitajjñāpayati--akāravata eva rājaśabdāṭṭaj‌ bhavati| īkārāntānna, īkārasyākāreṇa savarṇadorghāntasyā sambhavāt‌|| 92. gorataddhitaluki| (5.4.92) pañcagavamiti| `taddhitārtha' (2.1.51) iti samāhāre dviguḥ| `pañcaguḥ' ityatrāpi taddhinārthe| `rājagavam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti supo luk‌| `rājagavīyati' iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8), subluk‌, `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam‌| astyatra luk‌, sa tu supaḥ; na taddhitasya| paravyatyayenātra pañcamyarthe saptamī| kuta etat‌? pañcamyantena gośabdena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt‌|| 93. agrākhyāyāmurasaḥ| (5.4.93) sa ceduraḥśabdo'grasyākhyā bhavatītyenena darśitam‌| `aśvorasam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| aśvānāṃ pradhānamityarthaḥ| `hastyurasam‌, rathorasam‌' iti|| 94. ano'śmāyassarasāṃ jātisaṃjñayoḥ| (5.4.94) `upānasam‌' iti| upagatamana iti prādisamāsaḥ| `mahānasam‌' iti| mahadana iti `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā karmadhārayasamāsaḥ| `amṛtāśmaḥ, piṇḍāśmaḥ' iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsau| evaṃ `kālāyasam‌' `lohitāyasam‌' iti| `maṇḍūkasarasam‌, jalasarasam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau| `sadanaḥ' iti| mahānasavatsamāsaḥ|| 95. grāmakauṭābhyāñca takṣṇaḥ| (5.4.95) `bahūnāṃ sādhāraṇa ityarthaḥ' iti| grāmaśabdasya janapadasamudāye vṛtteḥ| `kauṭatakṣaḥ' iti| pūrvavatsamāsaḥ|| 96. ateḥ śunaḥ| (5.4.96) `atiśvaḥ' iti| prādisamāsaḥ|| 97. upamānādaprāṇiṣu| (5.4.97) `ākarśaśvaḥ' iti| atra śvā upamānam‌| `aśvā loṣṭaḥ' iti| atrāśvaśabdo'prāṇini loṣṭe varttate, na tūpamānam‌| `vānaraśvā' iti| upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ' (2.12.56) iti samāsaḥ| atra prāṇini vānaraśveti śabdo varttate|| 98. uttaramṛgapūrvācca sakthnaḥ| (5.4.98) `uttarasaktham‌' iti| uttaraṃ sakthna iti pūrvāparādiśūtreṇa (2.1.58) samāsaḥ| atha vā--uttaraṃ sakthīti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `mṛgasaktham‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `pūrvasaktham‌' iti| uttarasakthamityanena tulyametat‌| `phalakasaktham‌' iti| `viśeṣaṇam‌' (2.1.57) ityādinā samāsaḥ|| 99. nāvo dvigoḥ| (5.4.99) `dvināvam‌ trināvam‌' iti| `taddhitārthottarapada' (2.1.51) ityādinā dviguḥ| `dvināvadhanaḥ' iti| dve nāvau dhanaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhau kṛte pūrvayoḥ padayostenaiva sūtreṇottarapade dviguḥ| pañcanāvapriyam‌ iti| pūrveṇa tulyametat‌ dvināvarūpyam‌, dvināvamayam‌' iti| tenaiva sūtrema taddhitārthe dviguḥ| pūrvavadrūpyamayaṭau| `rājanauḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `pañcanauḥ' iti ārhīyasya (5.1.19) ṭhakaḥ `adhyardhapūrvaṃ' (5.1.28) ityādinā luk‌|| 100. ardhācca| (5.4.100) `ardhanāvam‌' iti| nanu ca `paravalliṅgaṃ dvandatatpuruṣayoḥ' (2.4.26) iti strīliṅgenātra bhavitavyamiti? ata āha--`paravallihgaṃ na bhavati' ityādi|| 101. khāryāḥ prācām‌| (5.4.101) `dvikhāri' iti| `trikhāri' iti| pūrvavadupasarjanahrasvaḥ| kvacidardhakhārīti pāṭhaḥ| atraicorupasarjanahrasvatve kṛte `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke' (ga. sū.51) iti bahvādipāṭhān‌ ṅīṣa|| 102. dvitribhyāmañjaleḥ| (5.4.102) `dvābyāmañjalibhyāṃ krīto dvyañjaliḥ' iti| pūrvavadarhīyasya luk‌| `devyañjalipriyaḥ' iti| pūrvavaduttarapade dviguḥ|| 103. anasantānnaṃpusakācchandasi| (5.4.103) `hasticarma' ityādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| `sutrāmāṇam‌' iti| śobhanastrāmā iti prādisamāsaḥ, `anyeṣāmapi vṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti pūrvapadasya dīrghaḥ, dvitīyai kavacanam‌ `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) ityādinopadhādīrghatvam‌, `aṭ‌ kupvāṅ‌' (8.4.2) ityādinā ṇatvam‌| `anehasām‌' iti| anehaḥśabdāt‌ puṃlliṅgāt‌ ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanam‌| vāvacanamityanuvarttata iti śeṣaḥ| vāvacanaśabdeneha prāggrahaṇaṃ vivakṣitam‌; tena vikalpya ucyante, pratyāyyate pratyayo'neneti kṛtvā| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--" `khāryāḥ prācam‌' (5.4.101) ityataḥ prāggrahaṇamanuvarttate" iti| prāggrahaṇānuvṛttau tu yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati--`brahmasāma' iti| `devacchandaḥ' iti| ubhayatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|| 104. brahmaṇo jānapadākhyāyām‌| (5.4.104) `jānapadākhyāyām‌' iti| bhāvapradhāno'tra jānapadaśabdaḥ| ata eva vṛttāvāha--`samāsena cedbrahmaṇo jānapadatvamākhyāyate' iti| bhavati hi bhāvapratyayamantareṇāpi bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ, yathā--`dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane' (1.4.22) iti| kathaṃ punarbrahmaṇo jānapadatvaṃ śakyaṃ viśeṣayitum‌, yāvataikamiha brahmagrahaṇam‌, tena ca samāso viśeṣitaḥ? naitadasti; tantreṇa dvau brahmaśabdāvṛccaritau--tatraikena samāso viśeṣyate, apareṇa jānapadatvam‌, yasya tatpuruṣasya janapadaśabdaḥ purvapadam‌| pūrvavat‌ samāsaḥ|| 105. kumahadbhāmanyatarasyām‌| (5.4.105) 106. dvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamāhāre| (5.4.106) `vāk‌ ca tvak‌ ca vāktvacam‌' `sruk‌ ca tvak‌ ca sruktvacam‌'| `śrīśca sruk‌ ca śrīsrajam‌| `vāk‌ ca ūrkca vāgūrjam‌| `samicca dṛṣacca samid‌dṛṣadam‌' `sampacca vipacca sampadvipadam‌' `vāk‌ ca tviṭ‌ ca vāktvivam‌| `vāk‌ ca vipruṭ‌ ca vāgvipruṣam‌'| `chatttrañca upānacca chatttropānaham‌'| `dhatttrañca upānacca chatttropānaham‌'| `śrenuśca godhuk‌ ca dhenugoduham‌'| `pañcavāk‌' iti samāhāre dviguḥ| `vāksamit‌' iti| dhakārānto'yam‌| dhakārasya `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvam‌--dakāraḥ; `vā'vasāne' (8.456) iti cartvam‌--takāraḥ|| 107. avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ| (5.4.106) `upaśaradam‌' iti| sāmīpye'vyayībhāvaḥ| śarada ābhimukhye `pratiśaradam‌' `lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye'(2.1.14) ityavyayībhāvaḥ| `upavipāśam‌ parativipāśam‌' iti| pūrvevat‌| atra ye jhayantāḥ paṭhyante teṣāṃ kimarthaṃ grahaṇam‌, yāvatā `jhayaḥ' (5.4.111) iti vakṣyamāṇena tadantāt‌ pratyayaḥ sidhyati? ityata āha--`ye tvatra' ityādi| yadyatra te na gṛhyeraṃstataḥ `jhayaḥ' (5.4.111) iti vikalpena ṭacprasajyeta| tasmānnityaṃ yathā syāditi--evamarthaṃ jhayantānāṃ pṛthaggraṇam‌| `jarāyā jaraśca' iti| jarāśabdāṭṭaj‌ bhavatyavyayībhāve, jarasādeśaśca--jarāyāḥ samīpamupajarasamiti| pratiparasamanubhyo'kṣyaṇaḥ' iti| akṣiśabdāt‌ prati, para sam‌, anu--ityetebhyaḥ parasmāṭṭaj‌ bhavati--`pratyakṣam‌| parokṣam‌'--`parokṣe liṭ‌' (3.2.115) iti nipātanādutvam‌| `samakṣam‌| anvakṣam‌'|| 108. anaśca| (5.4.108) `uparājam‌, pratirājam‌' iti| upaśaradaṃ pratiśaradamitivadavyayībhāvaḥ| `avyātmam‌' iti| ātmanyadhīti vibhaktyarthe| `pratyātmam‌' iti| pūrvavadābhimukhye|| 109. napuṃsakādanyatarasyām‌| (5.4.109) 110. nadīpaurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇībhyaḥ| (5.4.110) nadīgrahaṇena svarūpaṃ gṛhyate, na saṃjñā| yadi saṃjñā gṛhyeta, paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇīgrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌| nanu ca niyamārthametat‌ syāt‌ īkārāntasyāpi nadyoḥ paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇyoreva bhavatīti? naitadasti; yadyetat‌ prayojanaṃ syāt‌ "paurṇamāsyāgrahāyaṇī" ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| `tasmāt‌' svarapagrahaṇamiti| `upanadi' iti `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvaḥ|| 111. jhayaḥ| (5.4.111) 112. gireśca senakasya| (5.4.112) `antagiram‌' iti| girerantarita vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥ| antaḥ śabdo hi saptamyarthavṛttitvādvibhaktyarthe varttate| vikalpārthameva senakagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`vikalpo'nuvarttata eva' iti| vikalpārthatvāt‌| vikalpyate vānena saḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpa ityuktam‌, tadiha `napuṃsakādanyatarasyām‌' (5.4.109) ityato'nuvarttate| tasmāt‌ tenaiva vikalpasya siddhatvāt‌ pūjārthameva senakagrahaṇamuktam‌, na vikalpārtham‌| nanu ca `vibhāṣayordvayormadhye nityā vidhayo bhavanti' (kā. pa. vṛ. 11) iti pūrvasya vidhenityatāṃ sampādayituṃ vikalpārthameva senakagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌ ? naitadasti; yadi hi pūrvo vidhinityaḥ syāt‌, jhayantānāṃ śaratprabhṛtiṣu pāṭho'narthakaḥ syāt‌, `jhayaḥ' (5.4.111) ityanenaiva siddhatvāt‌| tasmānna vikalpārthaṃ senakagrahaṇam‌; pūjārthameva|| 113. bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgat‌ ṣac‌| (5.4.114) `adravaṃ mūrttimat‌' (ma. bhā. 2.222 kā. 4.1.554) ityādinā prāribhāṣikaṃ yat‌ svāṅgaṃ tadiha gṛhyate| `duḥśliṣṭa vibhaktini' iti| duḥkhena kaṣṭena śliṣṭāḥ sambaddhā vibhaktayo yeṣu tāni duḥśliṣṭavibhaktīni| tathā ca--pratyayasambandhena ṣaṣṭhyā bhavitavyam‌, yathā `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ' (5.4.86) iti| sakthyakṣipragahaṇena ceha tadantatayā bahuvrīherviśeṣayitumiṣṭatvāt‌| bahuvrīhau yadvibhaktivacanaṃ tato'pi tenaiva bhavituṃ yuktam‌| iha tu bahuvrīhau saptamyekavacanam‌| sakavyakṣiśabdābhyāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanam‌, saptamīdvivacanaṃ vā| svāṅgagrahaṇaṃ sakthyakṣṇoriha samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌, tataśca sakthyakṣiśabdābhyāṃ yā vibhaktistadvibhatikaṃ samānādhikaraṇaviśeṣaṇamupapadyate| evaṃ vidhavibhaktibhiḥ padaiḥ kaścid‌duḥkhena kṛcchreṇa yukto yāmāśritya vibhaktimevārthaṃ pratipadyate| tasmāt‌ tāni duḥśliṣṭavibhaktīni| kimartha punastāni padāni kṛtāni? vaicitryārtham‌| `dīrghasakthi śakaṭam‌, sthūlākṣirikṣuḥ' iti| atra sakthyakṣiśabdau svāṅgaṃ na bhavataḥ| śakaṭasya kaścidavayavastathekṣośca tathā'bhidhīyate| na tu tatra `adravaṃ mūrttimat‌ (ma. bhā. 2.222) ityādikaṃ svāṅgalakṣaṇamasti| nanu ca ṭacāpi prakṛtena sarvametat‌ sidhyati, tat‌ kimarthaṃ ṣajiti pratyayāntaramupāttam‌? ityāha--`ṭaci prakṛte' ityādi| dīrghasakthī strī--ṭaci ṅībanudāttaḥ syāt‌, ṣaci tu sati `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣudāttaḥ siddho bhavati| nanu ca ṅīpyanudāt‌ta udāttanivṛttisvareṇodātta eva bhavati| ataḥ svarārthamapi naiva pratyayāntaramupādeyam‌? ityāha--`sakathñcākrāntāt‌' iti| `vibhāṣotpucche' (6.2.106) ityato vibhāṣetyanuvarttanamāne `sakthañcākrāntāt‌' (6.2.198) iti vikalpenottarapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| yasmin‌ pakṣa udāttaṃ bhavati, tatra ṅīpi parataḥ, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakārasyodāttasya lope kṛte `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) iti ṅīpyudāttatvena bhavitavyam‌, ato nāsti ṅīpi virodhaḥ| yasmin‌ pakṣa udāttaṃ na sambhavati tasmin‌ ṅīpi styudāttanivṛttisvaro nāsti, udāttaścāśrīyate| ṅīṣi tu sati sarvatrodāttaḥ siddho bhavati; ṅīṣpratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvāt‌|| 114. aṅgulerdāruṇi| (5.4.114) dve aṅgulī yasya tat‌| dāruṇi samāsārthe mukhyābhiraṅlībhiḥ sambandhastatra nopapadyate| tasmāt‌ sāmarthyāt‌ dvyaṅgulīsadṛśeṣu dārvavayaveṣvaṅguliśabdo varttamānaḥ samāsa āśrīyata iti matvā''ha--`aṅgulisadṛśāvayavam‌' ityādi| `nanu ca dve aṅgulī pramāṇamasya dāruṇa ityādau mukhyābhiraṅgulībhiḥ sambandhaḥ, tatra mukhyāṅgulībhiḥ sambandha iti mukhye sambhavati, ato gauṇasya grahamamayuktam‌? ityāha--`yasya tu' ityādi| bahuvrīhigrahaṇānuvṛtteriha bahuvrīheḥ pratyayo vidhīyate| dve aṅgulī pramāṇamasyetyekārthavivakṣāyāṃ taddhitārthe tatpuruṣaḥ karttavyaḥ| tasmistu kṛte `tatpurusyāṅguleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ' (5.4.86) ityacā bhavitavyameva| yaśca gauṇo'ṅguliśabdaḥ sa evaṃ samāmarthyādeva yogasya viṣaya ityuktaṃ bhavati|| 115. dvitribhyāṃ ṣa mūrdhnaḥ| (5.4.116) atha kimartha ṣaḥ pratyayāntaraṃ vidhīyate, na prakṛtaḥ ṣajeva vidhīyate? vikalpenāntodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| `vibhāṣotpucche' (6.2.196) ityato vibhāṣetyanuvarttamāne `dvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrdhasu bahuvrīhau' (6.2.197) iti nakārāntasya mūrdhanśabdasya nirdeśād‌dvitribhyāmuttaro yatra nakārānto mūrdhanśabdastatra bahuvrīherantodāttatvaṃ pākṣikaṃ vidhīyate; anyathā'kārāntamurdhaśabda uttarapadodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, kṛtasamāsāntameva nirdiśet‌| tatra yadi ṣacpratyayo vidhīyate, tataḥ pākṣikamantodāttatvaṃ bādhitvā citkaraṇasāmarthyānnityamantodāttatvaṃ syāt‌| vibhāṣāntodāttavacanasya tu yatra samāsānto nāsti so'vakāśaḥ| asmiṃstu pratyayāntarasamāsānte kṛte vikalpenāntodāttatvaṃ sidhyati| nanu ca nakārāntanirdeśānnakārānta eva hi mūrghanśabdaḥ, uttarapade vibhāṣāntodāttena bhavitavyam‌, tatkathaṃ samāsāntādbhavet‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyati--`yatrāpi samāsāntaḥ kriyate tatrāpi bahuvrīhikāryatvāt‌ tadekadeśatvācca samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva' iti| atha kimarthaṃ bahuvrīhau dvitribhyāmuttaro mūrdhanśabdo nakārāntaḥ sambhavati, yāvatā nityaṃ samāsāntena bhavitavyam‌, na hi sūtre vibhāṣāgrahaṇasti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sa eva hi nakārāntanirdeśo jñāpayati--vikalpena samāsānto na bhavatīti|| 116. appūraṇīpramāṇyoḥ| (5.4.116) `pūraṇāpratyayāntāḥ' iti| `tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ‌' (5.2.48) ityavamādinā prakaraṇena ye pūraṇārthe vihitāste tatsāhacaryāt‌ pūraṇaśabdenocyante| pūraṇapratyayonte yeṣāṃ te pūraṇapratyayāntāḥ| `api pradhānapūraṇīgrahaṇam‌' iti| api pratyaye vidhātavye pradhānā yā pūraṇī tasyā grahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌--tata eva prayogo yathā syāt‌, anyato mā bhūt‌| kva punarasyāḥ pradhānyam? ityata āha--`yatra' ityādī| yatrābhidheyatvenānyapadārthena pūraṇyanupraviśati na kevalaṃ varttipadārthasyaiva samāsāvayavabhūtasya padārthaḥ, tatra pūraṇyāḥ prādhānyam‌, yathā--kalyāṇīpañcamā rātraya iti| atra hi na kevalamavayavena vigrahaḥ kriyate, rātraya eva pratyayenākhyāyante, sahapañcamīkāḥ| saha pañcamyā samudito'nyapadārthaḥ, na tu tābhirābdhamarthāntaram‌| yathā--kalyāṇapañcamīkaḥ pakṣa iti| na bhinnāvayavaḥ samāsārthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tadārabdhaḥ samudāyaḥ pakṣākhyaḥ| pūraṇī--kalyāṇa pañcamīkaḥ pakṣa iti| na bhinnāvayavaḥ samāsārthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tadārabdhaḥ samudāyaḥ pakṣākhyaḥ| pūraṇī tu samāsāvayavabhūtā nābhīdhīyata iti, anyapadārthenānupraveśādaprādhānyamiha tasyāḥ| `puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhe'pi' ityādi| na kevalamihāpi, api tu "striyāḥ puṃvadbhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ‌" (6.3.34) ityādinā sūtreṇa puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhe'pītyādi| na kevalamihāpyapi tu striyāḥ puṃvadbhāṣitapuṃskādanuṅ" (6.3.34) ityādinā sūtreṇa puṃvadbhāvaparatiṣedhe'pītyādi| na kevalamihāpyapi tu striyāmiti pradhānapūraṇyeva gṛhyate| `iha tu' ityādi| appratyayaḥ puṃbadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ kalyāṇapañcamīkaḥ pakṣaḥ ityatra na bhavati| `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌| `netuḥ' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| nakṣatre yo netṛśabdo varttate tadantādbahuvrīherapaḥ pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tūttarasūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthamāśritya karttavyam‌ `devadattanetṛkāḥ' (iti) `nadyṛtaśca' (5.4.153) iti kap‌| `chandasi' ityādi| `māsāt‌' ityādi| bhṛtyarthe yo vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ sa bhṛtisāhacaryādbhṛtirityuccate| bhṛtiḥ pratyayo yasya tat‌| bhṛtipratyayaṃ pūrvapadaṃ yasya bahuvrīheḥ sa bhṛtipūrvapadaḥ| tasmānmasaśabdāṭṭhaco vidhiḥ citkaraṇaṃ bahuvrīhisvarabādhanārtham‌| pañcāsya māsasaya bhṛtayaḥ `so'syāṃśavasnabhṛtayaḥ' (5.1.56) iti `saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kan‌' (5.1.22) pañcakaḥ, pañcako māso'sya pañcakamāsikaḥ| `apaḥ pitkaraṇaṃ yatra bahuvrīhāvuttarapadāntodāttatvamārabhyate tatra tadbādhanārtham‌--śobhanā pañcamī āsāṃ rātrīṇāṃ supañcamāḥ, avidyamānā pañcamī āsāṃ rātrīṇāmapañcamā iti| atra hyasati pitkaraṇe `nañsubhyām‌' (6.2.172) ityuttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ syāt‌|| 117. antarbahirbhyāṃ ca lomnaḥ| (5.4.117) 118. añnāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ nasaṃ cāsthūlāt‌| (5.4.118) `saṃjñāyāmiti samudāyopādhiḥ' iti| etena yadi prakṛtipratyayasamudāyaḥ kasyācit‌ saṃjñā bhavatyevaṃ pratyayo bhavati, nānyatheti darśayati| `druṇasaḥ' iti| `pūrvapadāt‌ saṃjñāyāmagaḥ' (8.4.3) iti ṇatvam‌| vardhre bhavā strī vārdhrī, sā nāsikā yasya sa `vārdhrīṇasaḥ' iti| `vṛddhinimittasya ca tadvitasyaraktavikāre' (6.3.39) iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ| gauriva nāsikāsya gonasaḥ| aca ścitkaraṇaṃ bahuvrīhisvarabādhanārtham‌| `kharaṇāḥ khuraṇāḥ' iti| `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| śitarnāsikāsya `śitināḥ'| ahiriva nāsikāsya `ahināḥ'| arceva nāsikāsya `arcanāḥ'| `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam‌' (6.3.63) iti hrasvaḥ|| 119. upasargācca| (5.4.119) upasargagrahaṇaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇārtham‌; nāsikāṃ prati kriyāyogābhāvāt‌| `vergro vaktavyaḥ' iti| viśabdāt‌ parasya nāsikāyā graśabda ādeśo bhavatīti vaktavyam‌| vigraḥ| pratyayo'jeva|| 120. suprātasuśvasudivaśārikukṣacaturaśrauṇīpadājapadaproṣṭhapadāḥ| (5.4.120) `ṭilopādikam' iti| ādiśabdena suśabdaśca karmaviśeṣaṇaṃ gṛhyate| `śobhanaṃ prātarasya' iti| śobhanamityetadiha karmaṇo viśeṣaṇam‌| śobhanaṃ prātaḥkāle karmāsyetyarthaḥ| evamuttaratrāpi śobhanamityetatkarmaṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ vedivyam‌| 121. nañduḥsubhyo halisakthyoranyatarasyām‌| (5.4.121) `akārānto'pi halaśabdo'sti; tatra yadā tena samāsaḥ tadā hala iti bhaviṣyati, yadā tvikārāntena tadā haliriti, tadanarthakaṃ haligrahaṇam‌? nānarthakam‌; bhinnārthatvāt‌| tena yo mahaddhalaṃ haliḥ, tasmin‌ viṣaye vivakṣite, ahala iti na sidhyati, ahala iti yadākārāntena samāsaḥ kriyate, pūrvavat‌ prakṛtebhāvenādyudāttatvaṃ ceṣyate, `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌ prasajyeta| tasmādyuktaṃ haligrahaṇam‌|| 122. nityamasica prajāmedhayoḥ| (5.4.122) `evaṃ tarhi nityagrahaṇenānyatrāpi sūcyate' iti| grantādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ bhavatīti kṛtvā| asicaścitkaraṇaṃ duṣprajāḥ, durmedhā ityantodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌ aprajāḥ, ityādau tu nārthaścitkaraṇena; `nañsubhyām‌' (6.2.162) ityanenaivottarapadāntodāttatvasya siddhatvāt‌|| 123. bahuprajāśchandasi| (5.4.123) 124. dharmādanic‌ kevalāt‌| (5.4.124) `asamastaḥ' [nāsti--kāśikāyām‌] iti| asamāsaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| `paramasvadharmaḥ' iti| svaścāsau dharmaśceti svadharmaḥ, paramaścāsau svadharmaśceti paramasvadharmaḥ| `yadyevam‌ ityādi| yadi kevalagrahaṇena dharmo viśeṣyate paramasvadharmaśceti na, paramasvadharahmeti syāt‌| `kevalāt‌ pūrvapadāt‌' iti| dharmasya asahāyāt‌ pūrvapadādityarthaḥ| `na padasamudāyāt‌' iti| paramo dharma iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| atra vyākhyāne tripade bahuvrīhau na bhavati prasaṅgaḥ, padasamudāyāddhi paramo dharmaśabdo na kevalāt‌ pūrvapadāt‌| anicaścitkaraṇaṃ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraṃ bādhitvā'ntodāttameva yathā syāt‌|| 125. jambhā suharitatṛṇasomebhyaḥ| (5.4.125) jambhavacanena tṛṇamiva jambho'sya, soma iva jambho'syeti vigrahītavyamiti| nanu tṛṇaṃ jambho'sya, somo jambho'syetyevaṃ vigrahītavyam‌, na hi tṛṇaṃ jambhaḥ, na ca somaḥ| abhyavahārahyavacane tu--tṛṃ jambho'sya, somojambho'syetyavameva vihagrahaḥ kāryaḥ; tṛṇasomayorabhyavahārahthatvāt‌|| 126. dakṣiṇarmā lubdhayoge| (5.4.126) 127. ic‌ karmavyatihāre| (5.4.127) `tatra tenedamiti sarūpe' ityayaṃ bahuvrīhirgṛhyate' iti| asyaiva karmadhyatihāre vṛtteḥ `keśākeśi' (iti) `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti dīrghaḥ| tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣvicpratyasya pāṭhādavyayībhāvasaṃjñā, avyayībhāvaśca samāso'vyayasaṃjño bhavatīti| tena sublugbhavatīti bhāvaḥ| icaścitkaraṇaṃ viśeṣārtham‌| yadi hyatra cakāro na kriyate, tadā tiṣṭhadguprabhṛtiṣvapīkāramātraṃ paṭhyeta, tadekāramātrasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌|| 128. dvidaṇḍyādibhyaśca| (5.4.128) `dvidaṇḍyādibhya iti tādarthya eṣā caturthī' ityādi| dvidaṇḍyādayo hi pratapadikeṣvicpratyayāntā eva paṭhyanta iti tebhyaḥ punarijvidhātuṃ na śakyate, vidhīyamāno'pi niṣpyojanaḥ syāt‌, tasmānneyaṃ pañcamī, kiṃ tarhi? tādarthye caturthī| dvidaṇḍyādyarthamic‌paratyayo bhavatītyanena tādarthyaṃ darśayati| asyaivārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha--`tattathā bhavati' ityādi| evaṃ bruvāṇena `dvidaṇḍyādibhyaḥ pratyayo bhavati, na dvidaṇḍādibhyaḥ' ityuktam‌| evaṃ te sidhyanti; nānyathā| atha kimarthaṃ samudāyānāṃ nipātanaśuddhā eva prakṛtīḥ prātipadikeṣu paṭhitvā tataḥ pratyayo didhīyate? ityata āha--`samudāyanipātanācca' ityādi| prātipadikeṣu prakṛtīḥ paṭhitvā tābhyaḥ pratyayamātraṃ vidhīyate, tato niyamaḥ syāt‌--samudāyanipātanādyatrārathaviśeṣe te prasiddhāstatraiva viśeṣyante| tatraiva bhavantītyarthaḥ| `dvidaṇḍi praharati' iti| dvau dḍau yasmin‌ praharaṇe| `iha bhavati' iti| dvidaṇḍītyetacchabdarūpamatrārthe sādhurna bhavatītyarthaḥ| `bahuvrīhyedhikārāt‌ tatpuruṣānna kvacit‌ pratyayavidhānaṃ syāt‌| samudāyanipātanāt‌ tu kvacit‌ tatpuruṣādapi bhavati| yadā pratyasya lopo bhavatyavyayobhāvasaṃjñā, tadā na prapnotītyata āha--`pratyayalakṣaṇena' ityādi|| 129. prasambhyāṃ jānunorjñuḥ| (5.4.129) `jānuśabdasyādeśo bhavati' iti| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--ādeśo'yam‌ na pratyama iti? yadi pratyayaḥ syāt‌, `jānunaḥ' ityekavacanenaiva nirddeśaṃ kuryāt‌; ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanenaiva nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| tasmādāveśo'yaṃ na pratyaya iti vijñāyate| ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanena nirdeśo'sandehārthaḥ kṛtaḥ--sthānaṣaṣṭhītvamasandigdhaṃ yatā vijñāyeteti| jānuna ityuccamānaṃ sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimiyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī, uta pañcamīti|| 130. ūrdhvādvibhāṣā| (5.4.130) 131. ūdhaso'naṅ| (5.4.131) `anaṅādeśo'yaṃ bhavati' iti| kathaṃ punarvijñāyate--ādeśo'yaṃ na pratyaya iti ? yadyeṣa pratyayaḥ syāt‌ ṅitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌ ādeśo hyasminnantyādeśārthaṃ ṅittvamarthavadbhavati| tasmānṅittvādevāyamādeśo bhavatīti vijñāyate| `kuṇḍodhnī' iti| anaṅi kṛte `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌, `bahuvrīherūdhaso ṅīṣ‌' (4.1.25) iti ṅīṣ‌ `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134)| `strīgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| strī gṛhyate yenābhidheyanityatvena tataḥ strīgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| etaduktaṃ bhavati--tathā vyākhyānaṃ karttavyaṃ yathā striyāmabhidheyāyāmanaṅ bhavatīti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`ūrdhvādvibhāṣā' (5.4.130) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyasthitavibhāṣā, tena striyāmeva bhavati, nānyatreti| anaṅ'kārāditvamuttarārtham‌| iha vināpi tena sidhyatyeva|| 132. dhanuṣaśca| (5.4.132) `śāṅgadhanvā' iti| anaṅi kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ, `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ|| 133. vā saṃjñāyām‌| (5.4.133) 134. jāyāyā niṅ| (5.4.134) `niṅādeśo bhavati' iti| ādeśatvamasya pūrvavad‌ ṅittvādeva vijñāyate| `yuvajāniḥ' iti| lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yalopaḥ| `striyāḥ puṃvat‌' (6.3.34) iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ|| 135. gandhasyedutpūtisusurabhibhyaḥ| (5.4.135) `ikā ādeśo bhavati' iti| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--ādeśo'yaṃ na pratyaya iti? `gandhasya' iti ṣaṣṭhyā nirdeśāt‌| yadi hi pratyayaḥ syāt‌ asandigdhārthaṃ `gandhāt‌' iti pañcamyā nirdeśaṃ kuryāt‌, ṣaṣṭhyā tu nirdeśaḥ| tasmādādeśo'yamiti vijñāyate| `gandhasyettve' ityādi| gandho dvividhaḥ| guṇo gandhaḥ, so'nyapadārthasyaikānto na bhavati| yastu śobhano gando'syeti sugandha āpaṇika iti tatra dravyagandho gandhaśabdenocyate, taccāpaṇikasyaikadeśo bhavati| tatra guṇagandhe yathā syāt‌, dravyagandhe mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ gandhasyettve vidheye tadekāntagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| tadityanena bahuvrīhyarthaḥ sāmarthyānnirdiśyate| tasyaikānta ekadeśo vā dharmo'vayavastadekāntaḥ saṃgṛhyate| yena tadekāntagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| etaduktaṃ bhavati--tādṛśaṃ vyākhyānaṃ karttavyaṃ yenettvavidhāviha gandho'nyapadārthasyaikadeśāt‌ tata āśrayitavya iti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vā saṃjñāyām‌' (5.4.133) ityato vāgrahamamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena yatra gandho'nyapadārthasyaikadeśabhūtastatraivettvaṃ bhavati, nānyatreti| atha vā--astyayaṃ gandhaśabdo dravyavacanaḥ--gandhān‌ vikrīṇīta iti| asti guṇavacano yathā--gandhavatī pṛthivī| tatra guṇavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌, na dravyavacanasya| tasmāddravyavacano bahavacanānta eva dravye varttate--gandhāna vikrīṇīte, gandhāḥ paṇyamasyeti| iha gandhasyetyakavacanenaiva nirdeśaḥ| tasmādavasīyate--guṇavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti| guṇavacanasya tu grahaṇe tatra guṇo gandho'nyapadārthasyaikadeśo bhavati, tena tadekāntabhūtasyaiva gandhasyettvaṃ bhavati|| 136. alpākhyāyām‌| (5.4.136) 137. upamānācca| (5.4.137) 138. pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ| (5.4.138) `lopo bhavati samāsāntaḥ' iti| kiṃ punaḥ syāt‌ samāsānto na syāt‌? `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityādereva syāt‌| samāsāntatve satyantaśabdo'yaṃ niyatadeśamevāvayavamācaṣṭa ityantasyaiva bhavati| evañca samāsānto bhavati yadyantasya bhavati, nānyathā| nanu ca lopasyābhāvarūpabatvāt‌ samansānto nopapadyate? ityāha--`sthānidvāreṇa' ityādi| sthānino'kārasya samāsāntatvādupacāreṇa lopo'pi samāsānta ucyata iti darśayati|| 139. kumbhapadīṣu ca| (5.4.139) `kumbhapadīprabhṛtayaḥ kṛtapādalopāḥ samudāyā eva paṭhyante' iti| yadyevam‌, kathamidaṃ netavyam‌? ityāha--`tatraivam‌' ityādi| tatra teṣu kumbhapadīprabhṛtiṣu kṛtapādalopeṣu paṭhiteṣvevaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kumbhapadyādiviṣayeya yathā kumbhapadyādayaḥ sambhavantīti| kimarthaṃ punaḥ samudāyā eva paṭhyante, na kumbhapadādīn‌ śabdān‌ prātipadikeṣu paṭhitvā tebhyaḥ parasya pādaśabdasya lopo vidhīyeta? ityāha--`samudāyapāṭhasya ca' ityādi| yadi kumbhādibhyaḥ parasya pādasya sa lopa ucyeta, `kṛtapādalopāḥ samudāyā eva na paṭhyeran‌' iti niyamo na labhyeta| tatastriṣvapi liṅgeṣu syuḥ, striyāmeva ceṣyante| samudāyapāṭhe sati striyāṃ ṅīppratyaya eva viṣayabhūte bhavati| `nānyadā' iti| `kumbhapadī' iti| `pādo'nyatarasyām‌' (4.1.8) iti ṅīpi viṣayabhūte pādasya lopaḥ tato ṅīp‌, tasmin‌ `pādaḥ pat‌' (6.4.130) iti padbhāvaḥ| `yaccehopamānapūrvam‌' iti--kumbhapadī, jālapadītyevamādi| `saṃkhyāpūrvapadañca' iti--ekapadī śatapadītyevamādi| `tasya siddhe' iti| upamānapūrvasya pūrveṇaiva siddhe saṃkhyāpūrvasya tūttareṇa| `aṣṭāpadī' ityasmin‌ paṭhyate| tatra nipātanaṃ dīrghatvārtham‌| `aṣṭanaḥ saṃjñāyām‌' (6.3.125) iti vā|| 140. saṃkhyāsupūrvasya| (5.4.140) anupamānārthamidam‌|| 141. vayasi dantasya datṛ| (5.4.141) `dvidan‌' iti| ṛkārasyogitkāryārthatvāt‌ `ugidacām‌ (7.1.70) iti num‌; halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau (6.1.68, 8.2.23) `sudanto dākṣiṇātyaḥ' ti| śobhanatvamiha gamyate, na vayaḥ|| 142. chandasi ca| (5.4.142) avayo'rtham‌, asaṃkhyāpūrvapadārthañca vacanam‌| `ubhayatodataḥ' iti| śāsantametat‌|| 143. striyāṃ saṃjñāyām‌| (5.4.143) acchando'parthametat‌| aya iva dantā asyā `ayodatī' iti| śāsantametat‌|| `samadantī' iti| `nāsikodara' (4.1.55) ityādinā ṅīṣ‌|| 144. vibhāṣā śyāvārokābhyām‌| (5.4.144) `striyām‌' iti nivṛttam‌| rokaḥ-rocanam‌, dīptiḥ| `ruca dīptau' (dhā. pā.745), bhāve ghañ‌, `cajoḥ kughiṇṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutvam‌| avidyamāno roko'syetyarokaśabdasya vyutpattiṃ hṛdi kṛtvā tasyārthaṃ darśayitumāha--`aroko nirdīptiḥ' iti|| 145. agrāntaśuddhaśubhravṛṣavarāhebhyaśca| (5.4.145) 146. kakudasyāvasthāyāṃ lopaḥ| (5.4.146) `kālādikṛtā' iti| ādiśabdenāhārādayo gṛhyante|| 147. trikakutparvate| (5.4.147) anavasthārthamidam‌| parvate'nyapadārte mukhyaṃ kakuṭaṃ na sambhavati; ucyate cedam‌--trikakut‌ parvata iti| tatra sāmarthyātkakudākāre parvataśikhare sādṛśyāt‌ kakudaśabdo varttate, tasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ kakudākārāṇi śrṛṅgāṇi tasya sarvasya trikakudabhidhānaṃ prāpnoti? ata--`na ca' ityādi| `ucyate' iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `saṃjñaiṣā' ityādi| etena yasyaiṣā saṃjñā trikakucchabdenocyata iti taddarśayati| etacca nipātanāt‌ `striyāṃ saṃjñāyām‌' (5.4.143) ityataḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇānuvṛtterlabhyate| nanu cābhidheyaniyamo'pi tata eva labhyata iti parvatagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌? naitadasti; śailīyamācāryasya yat‌ prasaddheṣvapi nityareṣvabhidheyanimittamācaṣṭe, yathā--`puṣyasiddhyau nakṣatre' (3.1.116) iti,kiṃ punaryatra prasiddhirnāsti! sā tu laukikī|| 148. udvibhyāṃ kākudasya| (5.4.148) `utkākut‌, vikākut‌' iti| antyasya lope kṛte `vā'vasāne' (8.4.56) iti cartvam‌| nanu ca `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityādilopena bhavitavyam‌, tatkathamantyasya bhavati? antyavacano hyavayavavacano'pi, sa niyatadeśāvayavamācaṣṭa ityuktam‌| tatra yadyādeḥ syāt‌, samāsāntatā nopapadyate|| 149. pūrṇādvibhāṣā| (5.4.149) 150. suhṛdradurhṛdau mittrāmitrayoḥ| (5.4.150) 151. uraḥprabhṛtibhyaḥ kap‌| (5.4.151) `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kapi siddhe nityārthaṃ vacanam‌| `priyasapiṣkaḥ' iti| `iṇaḥ ṣaḥ' (8.3.39) iti viṣarsanīyasya ṣakāraḥ| avamukte upānahau yena sa `avamuktopānatkaḥ' iti| `naho dhaḥ' (8.2.34) iti vihitasya dhakārasya `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvam‌--dakāraḥ, tasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌--takāraḥ| kiṃ punaretadvibhaktyantānāṃ pāṭhe prayojanam‌? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| tattretyanena vibhaktyantānāṃ pāṭhaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| `arthānnañaḥ' iti| nañparo yo'rthaśabdastadantādbahuvrīheḥ kabbhavati| nāstyartho'syeti anarthakaḥ|| 152. inaḥ striyām‌| (5.4.152) `idamapi pūrvavat‌ kapi siddhe nityārthameva| `bahudaṇḍikaḥ' iti| `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nalopaḥ|| 153. nadyṛtaśca| (5.4.153) 154. śeṣādvibhāṣā| (5.4.154) śeṣaḥ kabapekṣo vā syāt‌--yasmādbahuvrīheḥ kabna vihitaḥ sa śeṣa iti? samāsāntāpekṣo vā--yasmād‌bahuvrīheḥ samāsānto na vihitaḥ sa śeṣa iti? tatra yadi kabapekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ syāt‌--anṛcaḥ, vyāghrapāt‌, sugandhirityatrāpi syāt‌| na hyataḥ kenacit‌ kabvihita iti kabapekṣe śeṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāsāntāpekṣayā śeṣa iti darśayannāha--`yasmādbahuvrīheḥ samāsānto na bhavati sa śeṣaḥ' iti| kathaṃ jñāyate--samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣa iti? śeṣagrahaṇāt‌| tatra yadi kabapekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ syāt‌, śeṣagrahaṇanarthakaṃ syāt‌| ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi śeṣaviṣaya eva vikalpo bhaviṣyati; anyathā yadi yato'pi pūrvevidhivākyaiḥ kabvihitastato'pyanena vibhāṣā vidhīyate, vidhivākyānāmānarthakyamāpadyeta| tasmāccheṣagrahaṇāt‌ samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣo vijñāyate. `bahūkhaṭvakaḥ' iti `āpo'nyatarasyām‌' (7.4.15) iti hrasvaḥ| `bahukhaṭvaḥ' ityatrāpi `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti| `katham‌' ityādi| yadi samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ; anṛkkaṃ sāma, bah‌ vṛkkaṃ sūktamityatra kabna sidhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| `viśeṣe sa iṣyate' iti| sa hyakāraḥ samāsānto viśeṣe māṇave caraṇākhyāyāṃ ceṣyata iti tatrākāro vihitaḥ| na cāpi tatraiva viśeṣa kabvihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? viṣayāntare--sāmani, sūkte ca| tatra bahuvrīheḥ samāsāntāpekṣaḥ śeṣaḥ| tena ca priyapathaḥ, priyamadhura iti `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' (5.4.74) ityādinā'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ śeṣagrahaṇam‌, yāvatā yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyaḥ samāsāntā vihitāḥ, tābhyasta eva bādhakā bhaviṣyanti? naitadasti; niravakāśā hi viṣayo bādhakā bhaviṣyanti, sāvakāśāśca samāsāntāḥ| ko'vakāśaḥ? pratipadopāttaprakṛtayaḥ; yābhyaḥ samāsāntā arthaviśeṣe samāsaviśeṣaṃ prati pratipadamupādāya vihitāḥ so'vukāśaḥ; viśeṣa prakṛtibhyaḥ prasaṅge satyubhayaprāptau paratvāt‌ kapratyayaḥ syāt‌| tasmāccheṣagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 155. na saṃjñāyām‌| (5.4.155) 156. īyasaśca| (5.4.156) `sarvā prāptiḥ pratiṣidhyate' iti| nanu `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā. pa. 19) iti śeṣalakṣaṇasyaiva kapaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; kabatrānuvarttate, na śeṣāditi| tenāyaṃ kabmātrasya pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| `bahavaḥ śreyāṃsaḥ' iti| `dvivacanavibhajyopapade' (5.3.57) ityādineyasun‌, `praśasyasya śraḥ' (5.3.60) iti śraḥ| `hrasvatvamapi na bhavati' iti| `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvatvaṃ prāpnoti, tadapi na bhavati| kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`īyaso bahuvrīheḥ' ityādinā| nātra puṃvadvacanena strīpratyayasya nivṛttirabhipretā, kiṃ tarhi? hrasvatvaprakaraṇāt‌ tadabhāvaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati--yathā puṃvadbhāve satīkārasya hrasvonabhavati evamīyasaḥ parasya strīpratyayasyāpi na bhavati|| 157. vandite bhrātuḥ| (5.4.157) `nadyutaśca' (5.4.153) iti prāptasya kapo'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `vadi abhivādanastutyoḥ' (dhā.pā.11) iti yadyapi vadirabhivādane varttate, tathāpīha stutāveva varttamāna āśrīyate, ata evāha--`vanditaḥ stutaḥ' iti|| 158. ṛtaśchandasi| (5.4.158.) `ayamapi pūrvavat‌ prāptasya kapaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ|| 159. nāḍatantryoḥ svāṅge| (5.4.151) ayapapi `nadyṛtaśca' (5.4.153) iti prāptasya kapaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| svāṅgamiha pāribhāṣikaṃ gṛhyate| `bahunāḍiḥ' iti| pūrvavadupasarjanahrasvatvam‌| `bahutantrīḥ' iti| atra hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati; `kṛtaḥ striyāḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti cacanāt‌| tathā coktam‌ `strīgrahaṇaṃ svarayiṣyati' (ma.bhā.1.2.48) iti|| 160. niṣpravāṇiśca| (5.4.160) iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ pañcamādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ|| samāptaścāyaṃ pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ <6> <6.1> ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ pādaḥ 1. ekāco dve prathamasya| (6.1.1) iha kecit‌ svārthā eva vidhayo bhavanti, na padārthāḥ, tadyathā--`aṇkuṭilikāyāḥ' (4.4.18) iti kuṭilikāśabdādaṇ‌ vidhīyamānaḥ svārtho bhavati| kecit‌ punaḥ svārthāḥ, parārthaśca tadyathā--`padarujaviśaspṛśo ghañ‌' (3.3.16) iti padādibhyo ghañ‌ vidhīyamānaḥ svārtho bhavati, svaritaliṅgāsaṅgāduttareṣu yogeṣvanuvarttamānaḥ parārthaśca| kecit‌ punaḥ parārthā evādhikārā bhavanti, na svārthāḥ, yathā--`samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' (4.1.82) iti; tat‌ kimayaṃ svārtha eva? athobhayārtha evādhikāraḥ? uta parārtha eveti sandehāpanayanāya parārthatāmevāsya darśayitumāha--`ekāca iti ca' ityādi| etadgrahaṇakaṃ vākyam‌, asya ca `ita uttaram‌' ityādi| vivaraṇam‌| siṃhāvalokitanyāyena pūrvatrāpyadhikārāṇāmanuvṛttirbhavati, atastannivṛttirasvaritatvādvijñeyā| kasya punaḥ `ekāco dve bhavataḥ' ityevaṃ tadveditavyam‌? ityata yadyeṣā dhātorev‌ samānādhikaraṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt‌, tadā pacādīnāmeva dvirvacanaṃ syāt‌, na jāgarttyādīnām‌, na hi tatraikāca iti manyamāno naiṣaikāca iti sāmānādhikaraṇā ṣaṣṭhī--dhātorekāca iti, api tvavayavayogā--dhātoryo'vayava ekāca iti darśayitumāha--`dhātoravayavasya' iti| `jajāgāra' ityatra jāgityetad‌dvirucyatade, `papāca' ityatra pacchabdaḥ; pūrvatra `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddhiḥ, uttaratra `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti| `iyāya' iti| `iṇ‌ gartau (dhā.pā.1045) `aco ñṇiti'(7.2.115) iti vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti sthānivadbhāvādikāro dvirucyate, āyādeśaḥ, `abhyāsasyāsavarṇo' (6.4.78) itīyaṅ‌| `āra iti| `ṛ gatau' (dhā. pā. 1098) ṛ ityetasya dvirvacanam‌, `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityattvam‌ raparatvam‌, `ata ādeḥ' (7.4.70) iti dīrghaḥ, sarvarṇadīrghatvañca| ekāca iti tatpuruṣo'yaṃ vā syāt‌ ekaścāsāvacceti ekāc‌, bahuvrīhirvā eko'ñ‌ yasyeti? tatra yadyayaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ syāt‌, iṇādīnāmeva dviruktiḥ syāt‌--iyāya āretyevamādau; pacādīnāṃ tu papācetyādau na syāt‌, teṣāmajjhalsamudāyātmakatvādityetanmanasi kṛtvā''ha--`ekāca iti bahuvrīhanirdeśo'yam‌' iti| bahuvrīhiṇā vivakṣitasyārthasya nirdeśaḥ-kathanam‌| bahuvrīhernirdeśaḥ-kathanam‌, uccāraṇaṃ vā bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ| kutaḥ punaretadavasitam‌--bahuvrīhenirdeśo'yamiti? `halādiḥ śeṣaḥ', (7.4.60) `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' (7.4.61) ityevamādiliṅgāt‌| nanu ca tatpuruṣasyāpi liṅgamasti--`dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti' (7.4.69) itīṇo'bhyāsasya dīrghavidhānam‌? naitadas‌ti; bahuvrīhāvapi hyasmin‌ vyapadeśivadbhāvādiṇo dvirvacane'bhyāsasya dīrghavidhānamupapadyata eva, na tu tatpuruṣe'smin‌ halādiśeṣādikāryamupapadyateḥ pacādīnāmajjhalsamudāyānāṃ dvirvacanānupapatteḥ| tasmādbahuvrīhereva liṅgamasti, na tatpuruṣasyeti bahuvrīhinirdeśa evāyam‌| yadyevam‌; bahuvrīherevānyapadārthapradhānatvādupalakṣaṇavinirmuktasya śuddhasyaivānyārthasya bahuvrīhiṇābhidhānādacāvayavena ya upalakṣito'nyapadārthastasyaivānackasya dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, na tūpalakṣaṇabhūtasyāpi| na hyupalakṣaṇaṃ kāryopayogi bhavati| tathā hi yathā citragurānīyatāmityukte yasya citrāgāvaḥ santi sa eva ānīyate, na tūpalakṣamabhūtā gāvo'pi| ata eva tasya nirāsāya tadguṇasaṃvijñāno'yaṃ bahuvrīhirita darśayannāha--`tatra' ityādi| `samudāyaḥ samāsārthaḥ' iti| saha tenopalakṣaṇabhūtenācāvayavena samudāya evānyapadārtha ityarthaḥ| `ubhyantaraśca' iti| tadantarbhūta ityarthaḥ| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe| abhyantara evetyarthaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt‌ samudāye samāsārthe'vayavo'bhyantaro bhavati, tasmāt‌ sāckasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ bhavati| loke'pi kvacidupalakṣaṇasya samāse'ntarbhāvāt‌ kāryopayogitvaṃ dṛṣṭameva, yathā śukalavāsasamānayetyukte sahaiva śuklena vāsasānīyate| pacityatra yanaivācā samudāya ekāc‌ tenaiva tadavayavo'pyacchabdaḥ paśabdaśceti, tataśvāvayavānimapi pratyekaṃ dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti| yathā yanaiva hastenāvayavena bāhurhastavān‌ bhavati, tenaiva devadatto'pi hastavān‌ bhavati; tathā pacatau ghātau yenaivākārema pacchabdaḥ samudāya ekāc‌ tenaiva tadavayavo'pyacchabdaḥ paśabdaśteti| tataścāvayavānamapi pratyekaṃ dvirvacanaṃ prāpnotyeva| dvirvacanañca kāyiṇa ekācaḥ, sāmānyena nirdeśāt‌| evañca samudāyasya tadavayavanāñcaikācāṃ pṛthagdvirvacane kṛte'nṣyaṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌, ata etaddveṣyamapākartumāha--`tatra' ityādi| teṣu samudāyeṣvekākṣu madhye pṛthagavayavaikāco na dvirucyante| kiṃ tarhi? samudāyaikājeva| avayavaikājiti karmadhārayaḥ| `samudāyaikāc‌' iti| ayamapi karmadhāraya eva| kutaḥ punarayaṃ sāmānyābhidhāne viśeṣo labhyate? ityata āha--`tathā hi' ityādi| yadyapi samudāyī'vayavaścaikāc‌, tathāpi yasya dvirvacane kṛte sarveṣāmanugraho bhavati tasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ yuktam‌| evaṃ śāstrahāninaṃ bhavati; sarveṣāmeva śāstravihitakāryasya niṣpatteḥ| ayamevānugraho yā śāstravihitakāryasya niṣpattiḥ| samudāyasyaiva dvirvacane kṛte sarveṣāmanugraho bhavati| yathā vṛkṣaḥ pracalan‌ sahāvayavaiḥ pracalati, tathaikayaiva śāstrapravṛttyā samudāyo dvirucyamānaḥ sahāvayavaidvirucyate, na hi vināvayavaiḥ samudāyo dvirvaktuṃ śakyate; tasya tadātmakatvāt| avayavānāṃ tu dvirvacanaṃ naikayā pravṛttyā sarveṣāṃ karttu śakyate| na tad‌dviruktau sarveṣāmanugraho bhavati| katham‌? sarveṣāṃ hi teṣāmekājvyapadeśa eko'jiti hetuḥ; tatra yadā yenācaiko'vayava ekājiti vyapadiṣyate, tadā tenaiva tasyākṣiptatvānna śakyate'para ekājiti vyapadeṣṭum‌| tataścaikasya dvirvacane vidhitsite tadedānīṃ tenācā ya ekagāc‌ kaścidavayavastasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ syāt‌, netarasya; anackatvāt‌| atraitat‌ syāt‌ "ekācaḥ' (6.1.1) iti sarveṣāṃ paṣṭhyā nirdiṣṭatvāt‌ sarveṣāmeva teṣāṃ dvirvacanaṃ kartavyam‌, na ca tadyugapat‌ sambhavati, ata ekasya tāvat‌ kriyate| ekasmin‌ kṛte punaḥ pravṛttyantareṇāparasyāpi kariṣyata" iti? etacca na; yasya hyavayavasya pūrvaṃ dvirvacanaṃ kṛtaṃ tenaiva sahāco dviruktatvānna yujyate punastasyāvayavāntarema dvirvacanaṃ karttum‌| akṛtadviruktasya hi dvirvacanaṃ kriyate, na dviruktasya; anyathā hyanavasthā syāt‌| `anabhyāsasya' (6.1.8) iti vacanāccāyuktamevaikasminnavayave dvirukte'parasya dvirvacanaṃ kartum‌| ato nāvayavadvirvacane sarveṣāmanugrahaḥ sambhavati| tatra yasaya dvirvacanaṃ na sambhavati tasya śāstrahāniḥ syāt‌| tadayuktamavayavānāṃ pratyekaṃ dvirvacanam‌| athaiṣāṃ yugapadavayavānāṃ dvirvacanaṃ na sambhavatīti prayogāntare paryāyeṇa kariṣyate pūrvoktadoṣaparihārārtham‌? evamapi yadā paceracchabdasya dvirvacanaṃ syāt‌, tadā papācetyevamādi na sidhyet‌| kiñca `ṇijir‌ śaucapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1093) ityastrāllaṭ‌, jhi, śap‌, tasya juhotyāditvāt‌ śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvarvacanam‌| tatra yadi niśabdamātrasya dvirvacanaṃ kriyate tadā `ṇijāṃ trayāṇām‌' (7.4.75) iti guṇaḥ| atredānīm‌ `adabhyastāt‌' (7.1.4) ityadādeśa iṣyate--tenijatīti rūpaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌, sa ca na prāpnoti; jakāreṇa vyavahitatvāt‌| na hi jakārasyābhyastasaṃjñā, kiṃ tarhi? niśabdasya; dviruktatvāt‌, jakārasya cādviruktatvāt‌| anenijuriti--atra laṅādeśasya jheḥ `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jus‌ na prāpnoti; pūrvasmādeva hetoḥ| nenijadityatra `nābhyastācchatuḥ' (7.1.78) iti numpratiṣadho na syāt‌, ata eva hetoḥ| na ca śakyate vaktum‌--vacanasāmarthyādvyavadhāne'pi bhaviṣyatīti; yadā samudāyasya dvirvacanaṃ tadā vacanasya sāvakāśatvāt‌| yadā tvikārasahitasya jakārasaya dvirvacanaṃ tadā nenijatītyādikaṃ rūpameva na syāt‌| tasmādayuktamavayavānāṃ dvirvacanam‌| ataḥ samudāya eva dvirvaktavyaḥ| atha papācetyatra kathaṃ dvirvacanam‌, yāvatā `ekāco dve prathamasya (6.1.1) ityucyate, na cātraikācaḥ prathamavyapadeśo'sti, prathamaśabdo hyaprathamāpekṣo bhavati, sambandhiśabdatvāt‌; satsvanekeṣu yasmāt‌ pūrvo nāsti sa prathamaḥ, yaḥ punareka eva nāsau prathamavyapadeśaṃ labhate, ekaścātraikāc‌| tenātra dvirvacanaṃ na syāt‌, jajāgāretyādāveva syāt‌? iyāya, āretyatrāpi kathaṃ dvirvacanam‌, yāvataikācastaducyate, na caikāctvamasti, ajvyatiriktasyānaca ekājvyapadeśahetorabhāvāt‌? ityata āha--`papācetyatra' ityādi| ekasaṃkhyāvyavacchinnasvarasambanadhahetuko vyapadeśaḥ, sa yasyāsti sa vyapadeśī| jāgarttyādiṣu dhātuṣu jāgityevamādiḥ| `tena tulyaṃ varttate'(5.1.115) iti vyapadeśivat‌, tasya bhāvo vyapadeśivadbhāvaḥ| ekāctvamapītyapiśabdādadvitīyatvamapīti| tato'nena jajāgāretyatra yathā vāstave prathamatve jāg‌ ityetasya prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ bhavati, tathā paramārthato satyapi prathamatve prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ bhavati vyapadeśivadbhāvena papācetyatra pacchabdasya| iyāya, āretyatrāpyasati vāstava ekāctve dvitīyatve ca vyapadeśivadbhāvena dvirvacanaṃ bhavati; yathā--aṭiṭiṣatītyatra vastuta evaikāco dvitīyasya ṭiśabdasyeti| na cai tadvaktavyam‌--`yasmādaprathamasyāpi pac‌ ityevamprakārasya vyapadeśivadbhāvena dvirvacanaṃ bhavati' iti| atra `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām‌' (6.1.17) iti vacanaṃ jñāpakam‌, asatyapi vāstava ekāctve dvitīyatve ca punarvyapadeśivadbhāvena ceṇprabhṛtanāṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavatati| atrābhyāsasya dīrghavidhānārtham‌ `dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti' (7.4.69) iti vacanaṃ jñāpakam| iha `ādaśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye varttante na tu saṃkhyānamātre' iti dviśabdo'tra saṃkhyeye varttate| tacca saṃkhyeyaṃ śabdarūpaṃ vā syāt‌? uccāraṇaṃ vā? tatra yadi śabdarūpaṃ saṃkhyeyaṃ syāt‌ tadā `dve' ityanena dviśabdarūpe bhāvyamānatayā nirdiśyete iti| ata ekāca ityasya ca scāne yogalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho bhavati, ataḥ `sthāne dvirvacanam‌' ityeṣa pakṣo bhavati| tadaikāca iti sthānaṣaṣṭhī jāyate| atha punaruccāraṇaṃ sakhyeyaṃ tadā sthānyādeśasambandho na bhavati| uccāraṇaṃ nāma śabdānugato dharmaḥ| yadyasāvadeśo vidīyate tadā nivṛttidharmā sthānī bhavatīti śapabdasya sthānino nivṛttyā bhavitavyam‌, tataścoccāraṇamapi na syāt‌; tasya taddharmatvāt‌| tasmāduccāraṇe saṃkhyeye sthāne dvirvacanaṃ na sambhavatīti `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam' ityeṣa pakṣo bhavatīti| tadaikāca iti `karttṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, sā hyaikājuccāraṇakriyayā vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt‌ karma bhavati| tatra yadi `sthāne dvirvacanam‌' ityeṣa pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadā jighāṃsatīta hantaḥ kutvaṃ na syāt‌| samudāyasya hi sannantasya samudāyaḥ sannanta ādeśaḥ, tatra kṛta āśrīyeta, tadā jīghāṃsatīti hanteḥ kutvaṃ na syāt‌| samudāyasya hi sannantasya samudāyaḥ sannanta ādeśaḥ, tatra kṛta etannāsti| ayaṃ pratyayaḥ iyaṃ prakṛtiriti sandigdhatvāt‌ prakṛtipratyayasya hantirnaṣṭo bhavatīti `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti kutvaṃ hantihakārasya na syāditīmaṃ sthānedvirvacanapakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā dviṣprayogo dvirvacanamiti pakṣamāśrityāha--`dviṣprayogaśca' ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇe| dviṣprayoga evetyarthaḥ| na sthāne dviṣprayoga ityarthaḥ| atha dviṣprayogadvirvacane kathamayaṃ doṣo na bhavati? ityāha--`āvṛttisaṃkhyā hi' ityādi| punaḥ punaruccāraṇam‌-āvṛttiḥ| tat‌ punaḥ saṃkhyāvyavasthitasyaiva dhātorvidhīyate| `tena' ityādi| yasmādāvṛttiḥ sakhyāvyavasthitasyaiva dhātorvidhīyate, tena sa eva śabdo vyavasthita eva dviruccāryate, na tu tasya stāne śabdāntaraṃ vidhīyata iti kutaḥ punaḥ pūrvoktadoṣāva saraprasaṅgaḥ! yadi tarhī dviṣprayogo dvirvacanamityeṣa pakṣa ākṣīyate, evaṃ ca sati `vasvekājādghasām‌' (7.2.67) ityatrādivān‌, āśivān‌, pecivān‌, śekivān‌, ityudāhṛtya yadvakṣyati--`dhātvabhyāsayorekādeśe kṛta evābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayoḥ kṛtadvirvacanā eta ekāco na bhavanti' iti, tanna yujyate; akṛte'pi dhātvabhyāsayorekādeśe'kṛtayorapi caitvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtadvirvacanānāmaṣyeṣāmekāctvāt‌| sthāne dvirvacane hi śabdāntaramevā nekājādiśyata iti syādeṣāṃ kṛtadvirvacanānāmanekāctvam‌, na tu dviṣprayogapakṣe| tatra hi sa eva śabdo dviruccāryate| na cāsau śatakṛtvo'pyuccāryamāma ekāctvaṃ jahāti, kiṃ punardvirucyamānaḥ| yadapi niyamasya vyavacchedyacaṃ darśayituṃ bibhidvānityādi tatropanyasiṣyati, tadapyayuktameva; bhiviprabhṛtīnāmeva yathoktādeva hetoḥ kṛtadvirvacanānāmapyekāctvāt‌| yadapyādgrahaṇamanekājarthamityabhidhāsyati, tadapyayuktameva; tata eva hetorākārāntānāṃ kṛtadvirvacanānāmapyanekāctvānupapatteḥ| tasmāt‌ sthāne kṛtadvirvacanapakṣo'pyaṅgīkarttavyaḥ| evaṃ tarhyanyathā vyākhyāyate| iha pakṣadvayaṃ pūrvoktaṃ, sambhavati| tatra kiṃ dviṣprayogo dvirvacanamityeṣa pakṣa āśrīyate? uta sthāne dvirvacanapakṣaḥ?--iti praśnāvasara idamāha--`dviṣprayogaśca dvirvacanam‌' iti| cakāraḥ sthāne dvirvacanamityamumarthaṃ dyotayati| nanu ca `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' (1.1.49) iti vacanāt‌ sthāne dvirvacanapakṣemātra [dvirvacanapakṣe nātra--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] bhavituṃ yuktam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ dviṣprayogapakṣo'pyupapadyata ityata āha--`āvṛttisaṃkhyā hi' ityādi| yadi śabdāntaraṃ tasya sthāne vidhīyate tadā sthānyādeśasambandhe pratisthāne dvirvacanamityeṣa pakṣo jāyata ityaktam‌| yadā tvāvṛttisaṃkhyā vidhīyate tadetaraḥ pakṣo bhavatīti| edapi pratipāditaṃ prāk‌| tasmāt‌ dviṣprayogapakṣo yadāṅgīkartumiṣyate, tadāvṛttisaṃkhyā dve iti vidhīyate, tena sa eva śabdo dviruccāryate, na tu śabdāntaraṃ tasya sthāne vidīyate| tasmād‌dviṣprayogadvirvacanapakṣo'pyaṅgīkarttavyaḥ| atha kathaṃ sthāne dvirvacanamityeṣo'pi pakṣa āśrīyate, yāvatā jighāṃsatītyatra hanterhakārasya kutvaṃ na prāpnotītyuktam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ucyate cedam‌--abyāsācca (7.3.55) hanteḥ kutvaṃ bhavatīti| na ca tasya sthāne śabdāntara evādeśe kṛte hantirasti| tatra vacanasāmarthyādādeśaikadeśe hantipratirūpake hantiśabdo vijñāsyate| anye tvanayoḥ pakṣayordoṣā ya āśaṅkyante te bhāṣya evotkṣipya pratikṣiptāḥ| iha tvativistaragranthabhayānna likhyante|| 2. ajāderdvitīyasya| (6.1.2) `prathamadvirvacanāpavādo'yam‌' iti| nanu ca `ekāco dve prathamasya' (6.1.1) ityanena prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate, `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) ityanena tu dvitīyasya; tat‌ kathamanyasyocyamānamidamanyasya bādhakaṃ syāt‌? sati khalu sambhave bādhakaṃ bhavati, asti ca sambhavo yadubhayaṃ syāt‌| syādetat‌--ghātorityeṣā ṣaṣṭhī, tasayā dvitīyenaikācā prathamena ca sambandho nopapadyate, ato nāstyubhayasambhava iti? etacca nāsti; anyaddhi vākyaṃ prathamadvirvacanasya vidhāyakam‌, anyacaca dvitīyadvirvacanasya| tatra vākyabede ca sati kimiti sambandho nopapadyate, tasmāt‌ kṛte'pi dvitīyadvirvacane prathamadvirvacanaṃ sambhavatyevetyuktaṃ bādhanam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha dvīpam‌, antarīpamityatra `dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt‌' (6.3.97) itīttvam‌, `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityanaināntasyālaḥ prāptam‌ `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityanenādervidhīyate, tatra yathā satyapi sambhave'nantyavikārontyavikāraṃ bādhate, tathā dvitīyadvirvacanaṃ prathamadvirvacanaṃ bādhiṣyate| yadi tarhi prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanamanena bādhyate, vyañjanasyāpi prathamadvivacanasambandhino dvirvacanaṃ bādhyeta| tadyathābhūtasyaiva prasaṅgastathābhūtasyaiva dvirvacananivṛttirbhavati| kimbhūtasya ca prathamadvirvacanasya prasaṅgaḥ? savyañjanasya| tatra yathā prathamasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati, evamekājvyapadeśino vyañjanasyāpi na syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayaṃ `na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' (6.1.3) iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayati--vyañjanasya dvirvacananivṛttirna bhavati| anyatā hi nadarāṇāṃ dvirvacanapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌, prāptyabhāvāt‌| `aṭiṭiṣati; aśiśiṣati' iti| aṭeraśeśca sanīṭi kṛte ṭiṣśabadaḥ, śiṣśabdaśca dvirucyate| `aririṣati' iti artteḥ sanniṅguṇaraparatveṣu kṛteṣu riṣśabdo dvirucyate| `sthānivadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti' iti| `sanyaṅoḥ' (6.1.9) ityanena sannantasya dvirvacanamucyate, iṭ‌ ca sambhaktaḥ| tasmādasau dvirvacanasya nimittamityabhiprāyaḥ| sthānivadbāve ca sati repharahitasyeṣo dvirvacane kṛte savarṇadīrghatve cārīṣatītyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| `kāryī' iti| dviruktireva kāryam‌, tadasyāstīti kāryī| syādetat‌--yadyapyasau kāryī tathāpi kārye| syādetat‌--yadyapyasau kāryī tathāpi kāryaṃ prati nimittamevetyādaha--`na ca' ityādi| kathaṃ punarjñāyate etat‌ kāryī nimittatvenāśrīyate iti? ata āha--`tathā hi' ityādi| tathā hīti yasmādityarthe| itikaraṇaḥ prakāre| yasmāt‌ kṅinnimittayoḥ guṇavṛddhyoḥ `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti pratiṣedho vidhīyamānaḥ śayitetyevamprakāraviṣaye na bhavati, tato jñāyate--na hi kāryī nimittatvenāśrīyata iti| yadi hyāśrīyeta, tadā śīṅo ṅitvāt‌ tannimittācca guṇavṛddhyoḥ `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti vidhīyamānaḥ śayitetyatra guṇapratiṣedhaśca syāt‌, śāyaka ityatra vṛddhipratiṣedhaśca| nanu ca yena vinā yanna bhavati tat‌ tasya nimittam‌, yathā--vṛṣṭermeghaḥ| yathā ca pratyayena vinā guṇavṛddhī na bhavatastathā kāryeṇāpi; tat‌ kathaṃ śīṅo guṇabuddhipratiṣedho neha bhavati? ityata āha--`na hi kāryiṇaḥ' ityādi| atrāśrīyata ityadhyāharyam‌| satyam‌, kāryapi śīṅnimitam‌, tasya guṇaṃ prati vṛddhiṃ draṣṭavyam‌| itikaraṇo'nantaro'syapratividhānasya svarūpaṃ darśayati| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--na hi kāryī nimittatvenāśrīyata iti? `dīdhīvevīṭām‌' guṇavṛddhyoḥ `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti phāryo pratiṣedhaḥ siddha eveti tayorguṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌| `atra kecidajāderiti karmadhārayāt‌ pañcamīmicchanti' iti| `accāsāvādiścetyajādiḥ, tasmādajādeḥ' iti| evaṃ varṇayantaḥ karmadhārayāt‌ pañcamīmicchanti| yadi tarhi karmadhārayādiyaṃ pañcamī teṣāṃ dvitīyagrahaṇamanarthakam‌; yasmāt‌ tṛtīyasya prāptireva nāsti| yeṣāṃ bahuvrīheriyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyabhimatā, teṣāmakriyamāṇe dvitīyagrahaṇe tṛtīyasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ prāptireva nāsti| yeṣāṃ bahuvrīheriyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyabhimatā, teṣāmakriyamāṇe dvitīyagrahaṇe tṛtīyasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ prāpnotīti tannivṛttyarthaṃ yuktaṃ dvitīyagrahaṇam‌| yeṣāṃ ca karmadhārayādiyaṃ pañcamyabhimatā teṣāṃ dvitīya grahaṇamanarthakam‌; `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityanenānantarasyaiva dvitīyasya bhaviṣyati, na tṛtīyasya, vyavahitatvāt‌? ityata āha--teṣām‌' ityādi|| 3. na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ| (6.1.3) `tadantarbhāvāt‌' iti| avayavānāṃ samudāyābhyantaratvāt‌ tadantabhaviḥ| `avayavabhūtāḥ' iti| ādiśabdasya niyatadeśāvayavavācitvādviśiṣṭadeśāvayavabhūtā ityeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ| `andiviṣati' iti| `undī kledane', (dhā.pa.1457) sanīṭa ca kṛte diṣśabdasya dvirvacanam‌| `aḍḍiḍiṣati' iti| `adḍa abhiyoge (dhā.pā.348) ityatra yaḥ saṃyogaḥ sa dakārādiḥ, tasya ṣṭutvena dakārasya ḍakāraḥ, ṣṭutvañca dvirvacane'siddham‌, tena sanīṭi kṛte viṣśabdo dvirucyate tataḥ ṣṭutvam| `arciciṣati' iti `arca pūjāyām‌' (dhā.pā.204), ciṣśabdasya dvirvacanam‌| `īcikṣiṣate' iti| `īkṣa darśane' (dhā.pā.610) sanīṭi ca kṛte kṣiṣśabdasya dvirvacanam‌ `halādiḥ śeṣaḥ' (7.4.60), `kuhoścuḥ'
