(7.4.62) iti cutvam‌| `prāṇiṇiṣati' iti| `śvasa prāṇane' (dhā.pā.1069), `ana ca' (dhā.pā.1070) prapūrvaḥ| `didrāsati' iti| `drā kutsitāyāṅgatau' (dhā.pā.1054)| `kecidajādeḥ' ityādi| teṣāṃ matenājāderuttare ye nakārādayaḥ saṃyogādibhūtāste na dvirucyanta iti śūtrārthaḥ| kiṃ punastadanuvartanasya prayojanam‌? ityata āha--`tasya' ityādi| dakārastu dvirucyata eveti karmadhārayapañcamyantānuvṛttau hi `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityanantarāṇāmeva nakārādīnāṃ dvirvacanapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌; nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāt‌| dakārastatra yadyapi rephadakārayoryaḥ saṃyogastadādibhūtaḥ, tathāpi nakāreṇa vyavahitaḥ| tasmāddakāro'pi dvirucyata eva| `indidrīyiṣati' iti| indraśabdāt‌ kvaci kṛte `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam‌, kyajantāt‌ san‌, iṭ‌, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ| `ubjijiṣati' iti| `ubja ārjave' (dhā.pā.1303)| `yadā bakāropadha ubjarupadiśyate tadāyaṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| dakāropadeśe tu na vaktavyaḥ `na ndrāḥ' ityanenaiva siddhatvāt‌| `batvaṃ tu tadā dakārasya vidhātavyam‌' iti| ubjita, ubjijiṣatīti yathā syāt‌| tadapi batadvamakutvaviṣaye vidhātavyam‌; anyathā'bhyudgaḥ, samudga iti na sidhyet‌| dakāropadhasyaiva yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ| batvamātraṃ vaktavyam‌? tadapi na vaktavayam‌; tatra `bhujanyubjau pāṇyupatāpayoḥ' (7.3.61) iti nipātanādeva liṅgāv‌ batvaṃ labhyate| na cābhyudgaḥ, samudga ityatrāpi prasajyeta, akṛtvaviṣayatvānnipātanasya; yatra kutvaṃ nāsti tatraiva batvaṃ vijñāyate, na tu kutvaviṣaye| `yakāraparasya' ityādi| yakāraḥ paro yasmāt‌ tasya pratiṣedho na syādityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatra kaiścidevaṃ vyākhyāyate--bahiraṅgo rephaḥ, `guṇo'rttisaṃyogādyoḥ' (7.4.29) `yaṅi ca' (7.4.30) iti guṇo'ṅgasya vidhīyamāno yaṅi bhavati bahiraṅgaḥ, tadāśrito repho'pi bahirahga eva, tataśca so'ntaraṅge pratiṣe'saddhaḥ| tasmāt‌ tasaya dvirvacanapratiṣedho na bhavatīti| yadyevam‌, indidiṣatīti numo'pi pratiṣedho na prāpnotīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyati hyetat‌--numviṣāvupadeśivadvacanamiti| naiyāyikāstvanyathā varṇayanti--`na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' (6.1.3) iti| taiḥ kimuktam‌? saṃyogāt‌ pūrve nakārādayo na dvirucyante sa cedbhavati yakārāntaḥ saṃyogaḥ' iti tenārāryyata ityatra saṃyogasya yakārāntatvāt‌ pratiṣedho na bhavatīti | `arāryyate' iti| `yaṅi ca' (7.4.30) iti guṇe rapatve ca ryaśabdasya dvivacanam‌, halādiśeṣaḥ (7.4.60) `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) iti dīrghaḥ| nanu cārterahalāditvād‌yaṅā na bhavitavyam‌, sa hi `dhātorekācaḥ' (3.1.22) ityādinā halādereva dhātorvidhīyate? ityāha--`artteḥ' ityādi| `vyañjanasya' iti| īrṣyatervyañjanaṃ yadekāc‌ dvirvacanaṃ karttavyam‌| tacca vyañjanaṃ yakāraḥ, tasyeṭi kṛte sāckasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ karttavyamam‌| `ekācaḥ' iti| sanaḥ| sa hīṭi kṛte tṛtīya ekāj‌ bhavati| tasya dvirvacane kṛte `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itīttvam‌| pūrvaṃ pūrvamiṇamāśritya sarvasakārāṇāṃ ṣatvam‌| `kaṇḍūyiyiṣati' iti| `asūyiyiṣati' iti| `kaṇḍūñ‌', `asūñ‌' iti kaṇḍvādiṣu paṭhyete, tataḥ `kaṇḍvādibhyo yak‌' (3.1.27)| `vā nāmadhātūnām‌' iti| subdhāturnāmadhāturabhidhīyate| `aśvīyiyiṣati' iti| aśvaśabdāt‌ kyajantāt‌ sanīṭi ca kṛte yiṣśabdasya dvirvacanam‌| `āśiśvīyiṣati' iti| śvīśabdasya dvirvacanam‌, hrasvatvam‌, halādiśeṣaḥ (7.4.60)| `yatheṣṭam‌' iti| prathamādīnāmanyatarasya yasyeṣyate tasya karttavyamiti|| 4. pūrvo'bhyāsaḥ| (6.1.4) abhyāsaśabdo'yamāvṛttivacano loke prasiddha eva| sā cāvṛtatiḥ prathamasya nāstītyabhyāsapradeśeṣu parasya grahaṇe prāpte pūrvasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāvityevamarthaṃ tasyābhyāsasaṃjñā vidhīyate| pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ, yathā--pūrvaṃ kāyasya paśoriti| avayavāścāvayavino bhavanti, sa ceha yadyapi na nirdiśyate, tathāpi `dve' (6.1.1) ityunuvṛttestadvācyasyaivārthasya pūrvo vijñāyata ityāha--`dve iti prathamantaṃ yadanuvarttate' ityādi| nanu ca `dve' iti prathamantamanuvarttate, ṣaṣṭhyantena cehārthaḥ, na hyaṭanyathā pūrvaśabdena sambhandhaḥ śakyate darśayitumityata āha--`tadarthāt‌' ityādi| arthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatīti| tadiha ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ jayata ityarthaḥ| atha punaratrāvayavāvayavilakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati, yathā vṛkṣasya śākheti? evamapi yadi `dve' ityanuvṛtterdvayoryaḥ pūrvastasyābhyāsasaṃjñā vidhīyate tadā `sarvasya dve' (8.1.1) ityatrāpi prakāraṇe ye dve vihite tayoryaḥ pūrvastasyāpyabhyāsasaṃjñā prāpnotītyata āha--`tatra' ityādi'| `pūrvo'vayavaḥ' iti| pūrvaśabdo vyavasthāvacano'pyasti, atastadvyavacchedārthamavayavagrahaṇam‌, papācetyatrābhyāsasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `hrasvaḥ (7.4.59) ityabhyāsasya hrasvatvam‌, halādiśeṣaḥ (7.4.60), prakṛticarāṃ prakṛticaro bhavantīti cartvam‌| `pipakṣati' iti| `juhoti' iti pūrvavaddhakārasya cutvam‌, tasya `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) cakāraḥ| `apipacat‌' iti| pacerṇyantāc‌cleścaṅ‌, ṇilopaḥ, `ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ' (7.4.1) dvirvacanam‌, `sanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) itīttvam‌, `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghaḥ| sarvāṇyabhyāsasaṃjñāyāḥ prayojanānyetāni|| 5. ubhe abhyastam‌| (6.1.5) iha ubhegrahaṇaṃ saṃjñinirdeśārthaṃ kriyate| sa ca saṃjñinirdeśaḥ `dve' (6.1.1) ityanuvṛtterantareṇāpyubhegrahaṇaṃ prakalpyata eva, tat‌ kimarthaṃ dve ityanuvarttamāna ubhegrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha--`dve ityanuvarttamāne' ityādi| yadyubhegrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā pratyekamabhyastasaṃjñā pravartate| pratyekamapi hi tayoḥ pravartamānāsau pravṛttaiva bhavati| tathā hi dvāvānīyeyātāmityukte pratyekamapyānayanena tāvānītau bhavataḥ| tasmāt‌ samudāye saṃjñāyāḥ pravṛttiryathā syādekaikasya mā bhūdityevamarthamubhegrahaṇam‌| `samudite' iti| sahite samudābhūte ityarthaḥ| nanu ca yatrābhyāsaḥ śrūyate tatraiva yathā syāt‌, yatra tu na śrūyate tatra mā bhūta| īpsanti, īpsan‌, aipsannityādau viṣaye mā bhūdityevamarthamubhegrahaṇaṃ syāt‌? naitadasti; abhyāsagrahaṇaṃ hyanuvarttate, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate--dve abhyastasaṃjñe bhavataḥ, abhyāsaścedastīti| evacca sati vināpyabhegrahaṇaṃ yatrābhyāsaḥ śrūyate, tatraiva bhaviṣyati, nānyatra| tasmādvṛttikāropadarśitamevobhegrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ yuktam‌| `dadati' iti| dadāterlaṭ‌, jhi, śap‌, `juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ' (2.4.75) `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌| atrābyastasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ, `adabhyastāt‌' (7.1.4) iti jheradādeśaḥ| `dadhātu' [`dadhatu'--kāśikā] iti| loṭ‌, `eruḥ' (3.4.86) `samudāya udāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌' iti| ubhegrahaṇe hyasati pratyakamabhyastasaṃjñā syāt‌| tasmāt‌ `abhyastānāmādiḥ' (6.1.189) ityādyudāttamapi pratyekaṃ syāt‌| athapi `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam‌' (6.1.158) iti nāsti yaugapadyasambhavaḥ, evamapi paryāyeṇa syāt‌? tasmāt‌ `amyastānāmādiḥ' (6.1.189) ityetat‌ kāryaṃ samudāye yathā syāt‌, pratyekaṃ paryāyeṇa vā mā bhūdityevamarthamubhegrahaṇam‌| | 6. jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ‌| (6.1.6) `jakṣityādayaḥ' iti| eṣa nidaśo jakṣeḥ śtibantasyādiśabdena bahuvrīhāvapi kṛte bhavati, dvandve'pi--yadā jakṣeranajantasyetyādiśabdasya ca dvandvaḥ kriyate| vākye'pi yadānayoranantaroktayorubhayorapi prayogo bhavati, tadā tatra bahuvrīhau gṛhyamāṇe yadi tadguṇasaṃvijñāno'yaṃ bahuvrīhirāśrīyeta, tadā vevīṅo grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌; athātadguṇasaṃvijñāno'yam‌, tadā jakṣerna syāditīmaṃ bahuvrīherāśrayaṇe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvetarayoḥ pakṣaroranyataramāśrityāha--`jakṣityayaṃ dhāturityādayaśca' ityādi atretiśabde'tikrāntapratyavamarśī| jakṣityayaṃ dhāturanantaramatikrānta iti sa eva tena pratyavamṛśyate| iti ādiryeṣāṃ ta ityādayaḥ, jakṣādaya ityarthaḥ| te punarjāgṛprabhṛtayo vevīṅparyantāḥ| `seyaṃ saptānāṃ dhātūnāmabhyastasaṃjñā' iti| jakṣityetadupalakṣitānāṃ jāgartiprabhṛtīnāṃ ṣaṣṇāṃ jakṣitirityetasya ca saptamasya tebhyaḥ pṛthagnirdiṣṭasya| nanu ca dīdhyate, vevyata ityatrādādeśaḥ `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityanenaiva siddhaḥ, śeṣaṃ cābhyasta kāryamākāralopādikam‌ tacca dīdhīvevyorna sambhavatyeva, tatrākāralopastāvadākārasyābhāvānna sambhavati; jusbhāvo'pi jherabhāvāt‌, numpratiṣedho'pi ṅitvādātmanepaditvācchatuḥ, tat‌ kimarthamanayorabhyastasaṃjñā vidhīyate? ityāha--`dīdhyate vevyate' ityādi| `dīṣyaditi ca śatari' ityādinā prayojanāntaramapi darśayati| ātmanepaditvādanayorvyatyayena vinā śatā na sambhavatīti vyatyagrahaṇam‌|| 7. tujādīnāṃ dīrgho'bhyāsasya| (6.1.7) ādiśabdo'yamastyeva vyavasthāyām‌, asti ca prakāre, tatra yadi vyavasthāyāṃ varttamāno gṛhyeta, tadā `tuja pija hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1566,1567) ityata ārabhya ye paṭhitāsteṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌; evañca sautrāṇāṃ gaṇāntarapaṭhitānāñca dīrgho na syādityetadālocyāha--`tujādīnām‌' ityādi| `prakāra ādiśabdaḥ' iti| sa ca prakāro'nirdiṣṭatvānna jñāyata iti pṛcchati--`kaśca prakāraḥ' iti| tujo dīrghatvamityādinā prakārārthatvaṃ darśayati| `ye tathābhūtāḥ' iti| anantaroktaprakāramāpannā ityarthaḥ| `dīrghaḥ sādhurbhavati' iti| etena sata eva dīrghasya sādhutvamātramanena kriyate| na tvapūrvo dīrgha iti darśayati| `tūtujānaḥ' iti| liṭ‌| etacca prakāravācina ādiśabdasya parigrahāllabhyate, tasya kanāc‌| `māmahānaḥ' iti| `maha pūjāyām‌' (dhā.pa.730) śeṣaṃ pūrvavat‌| `dadhāna' [udāharaṇamidaṃ nāsti--kāśikā] iti| `ḍudhāñ‌ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1092)| `mīmāya' iti| `ḍumiñ‌ prakṣepaṇe', (dhā.pā.1250) liṭ‌ ṇal‌| `dadhāra' iti| `dhṛñ‌ dhāraṇe' (dhā.pā.900) `tūnāva' iti| `tu' iti sautro dhātuḥ; `turustuśamyama' (7.3.95) ityādisūtre paṭhitatvāt‌| `dīrghaścaiṣām‌' ityādinā yasya sata eva sādhutvamanena kriyate, sa ca dīrghaśchandasyeva dṛśyate, na bhāṣāyām‌| tatrāpi cchandasi viṣaye pratyayaviṣaye kānajādau, na pratyayamātre| `tato'nyatra na bhavati' iti| yathoktādviṣayādanyatra na bhavatītyarthaḥ| tujeśchandasi kānaci dṛṣṭaḥ, tato'nyatra bhāṣāyāṃ chandasyapi kānajādau pratyayāntare na bhavati| yaccaivaṃ tenāsyānyatrāvyāpāraḥ| sata eva dīrghasya sādhutvamātramanena vidhīyate| na cānyatra dīrgho'sti yasyānena vidhīyeta sādhutvam‌| etacca prakāravācina ādiśabdāllabhyata iti| `tutoja' iti| bhāṣāyāṃ prayogaḥ| yadi tarhi cchandasi sata eva dīrghasya sādhutvamanena vidhīyate, `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) ityanena subbyatyayasya vihitatvādapārthakametat‌? nāpārthakam‌; tasyaiva prapañcārthatvāt‌|| 8. liṭi dhātoranabhyāsasya| (6.1.8) `ekāco dve prathamasya' (6.1.1) iti, `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti cānuvarttate| dhātorityavayavayogā ṣaṣṭhī| sāmānādikaraṇye hi prathamasya dvitīyasyeti ca sambandho nopapadyate| `anabhyāsasya' iti ca pratiṣedhācca| sāmānādhikaraṇye hi pratiṣadho'narthakaḥ syāt‌, na hyabhyāsavānekāja dhātuḥ sambhavati| `yathāyogam‌' iti| halādeḥ prathamasyaikāco'vayavasya, ajādestu dvitīyasyetyeṣa yathāyogārthaḥ| `prorṇanāva' iti| `ūrṇuñ‌ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1039) `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti nuśabdasya dvirvacanam‌| rephasya tu `na ndrāḥ' (6.1.3) iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati| nanu corṇoterijāditvāt‌ `ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ' (3.1.36) ityāmi kṛte `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti lerluk‌, `kṛñcānuprayujyate liṭi' (3.1.40) iti kṛño liṭ‌parasyānuprayogaḥ, tataśca prorṇuvāñcakāreti bhaviṣyati, tatkathaṃ prorṇanāveti? ata āha--`vācya ūrṇoḥ' ityādi| nuvadbhāvena yathā nauterām‌ na bhavati, tathorṇoterapīti darśayati| `viśrṛṇvire' iti| `śru śravaṇe' (dhā.pā.942) `liṭastajhayoreśiraic‌ (3.4.81) iti irec‌| `chandasyubhayathā' (3.4.117) iti liṭaḥ sārvadhātukatvam‌, tataḥ `śruvaḥ śṛ ca' (3.1.74) iti śnuḥ śrṛbhāvaśca| `huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke' (6.4.87) iti yaṇādeśaḥ| `sunvire' iti| `ṣuñ‌ abhiṣave' (dhā.pā.1247)| dhātugrahaṇādiha vikaraṇasya dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| yatastatra dhātustasya vikaraṇena vyavahitatvānna bhavatītyeke| chandasatvādityapare, `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' (pu.pa.pā.35) iti| etacca `vyavahitatvānnabhavatītyeke| chandasatvādityapare, `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' (pu.pa.pā.35) iti| etacca `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) ityasmādbahulagrahaṇāllabhyate| evañca kṛtvā `dvirvacanaprakaraṇe chandasi vā' (vā. 656) ityetanna karttavyaṃ bhavati| `nonāva' iti| `ṇu stotau' (dhā.pā.1035), yaṅ, dvirvacanam‌, `guṇo yaṅlukoḥ (7.4.82) iti guṇaḥ, `nonūya' iti guṇaḥ, `nonūya' iti sthite `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti yaṅo luk‌, liṭ‌| `amantre' (3.1.35) iti niṣedhādna bhavati| `sasmimikṣuḥ' iti| `miha secane' (dhā.pā.992), ataḥ sampūrvāt‌ san‌ `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam‌, `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti kitvādguṇaḥ, dvirvacanam‌, ṣatvam‌; sammimikṣa iti sthite liṭ‌, `amantre' (3.1.35) iti pratiṣedhādām‌, na bhavati| jhi, tasya us‌, ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48)| `jāgāra' iti| liṭ‌| `dāti' iti| śluḥ| veti vacanāt‌ pakṣe jajāgāra, dadātītyapi bhavati|| 9. sanyoriti saptamyantamidaṃ vā syāt‌? ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vā? tatra yadi saptamyantaṃ syāt tadāyamarthaḥ syāt‌--sanyaṅoḥ parata iti, tataśceṭaḥ sanbhaktatvāt‌ sangrahaṇenena grahaṇāt‌, sanaśceha dvirvacananimittattvānnimittasya ca kāryiṇo'yogādiṭo dvirvacanaṃ na syāt‌, tataścāṭiṭiṣatītyādi na siddhyet‌| ṣaṣṭhyante tvasmin‌ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho.pasū.7) tadanta upasthāpite satyayamartho jāyate--sanantasya yaṅantasya ca yaḥ prathama ekāj‌ dvitīyo vā teneṭo dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti| tathā cāṭiṭiṣatītyādi sidhyatītyatadālocyā''ha--`sanyaṅoriti ṣaṣṭhyantametat‌' iti| atra ca jñāpako yogavibāga iti| yadi hi `sanyaṅoḥ' iti saptamyantaṃ syāt‌ `ślusanyaṅaḥ' ityekameva yogaṃ kuryāt‌| nanu cāsatyapi prayojane jñāpakamasti, asti ceha yogavibhāgasya prayojanam‌, kiṃ tat‌? sāmarthyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ yathā syāt‌--sani prathamasya, yaṅi dvitīyasyeti? naitadasti; yadi hyatra yathāsaṃkhyamabhipretaṃ syāt‌ tadā `nīgvañcu' (7.4.84) ityādinā vañcaprabhṛtīnāmabhyāsasya yaṅluko nīgāgamavidhānaṃ nopapadyate| yathāsaṃkhye hi sati yadyeṣāṃ dvirvacanaṃ nāstīti nīgāgamaṃ na vidadhyāt‌| tasmādyogavibhāgāt‌ ṣaṣṭhyantametadityavasīyate| `aṭāṭyate' iti| yaṅ‌vidhau `sūcisūtrimūtryaṭyartyaśūrṇotīnāmupasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.198) ti yaṅ‌| `rprorṇonūyate' iti| `akṛt‌sārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ| `jugupsiṣate' iti| gupeḥ `guptijkidbhyaḥ san‌' (3.1.5) ti san‌ tadantāt‌ `dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkāt‌' (3.1.7) ityādinecchāyāṃ punaḥ san‌| `lolūyiṣate' iti| yaṅntāt san‌|| 10. ślau| (6.1.10) `ślau parataḥ' iti| nanu ca pratyayādarśananaṃ śluḥ, taccābhāvarūpam‌, na cābhāve paurvāparyamasti, taduyuktamuktam‌ ślau parata iti? sthāninaḥ parattvāttsyāpi tad‌dvāreṇa paurvāparyamaupacārikaṃ gṛhītvaiva yuktamuktamityadoṣaḥ|| 11. caṅi| (6.1.11) `apīpacat‌' ityādi| pacādibhyo ṇyantebhyo luṅ‌, aḍāgamaḥ, cliḥ, `ṇiśri' (3.1.48) ityādinā cleścaṅ‌| atredānīṃ dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti ṇilopaśca; dvayorapi kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnityatvam‌, tataścobhayostulyabalatvāt‌ paratvāṇṇilopaḥ| `āṭiṭat‌' iti| atrāpi ṇilope kṛte ṇilopasya sthānivatvādadvirvacanaṃ bhavatyeva| sthānivadbhāvastu `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) ityanena| ṇilopo'pi nityaḥ, akṛte'pi dvirvacane tena bhavitavyam‌, kṛte'pi| na ca śabdāntaraprāptiḥ, dviṣprayogo dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti kṛtvā| sthāne dvirvacanaṃ tvatra na svīkriyate; lakṣyānurodhāt‌| tataścobhayostulyabalayoḥ paratvāṇiṇalopaḥ| tatra kṛte dvirvacanaṃ prāpnotyupadhāhrasvaśca; tayorapi kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnityatvam‌| dvirvacanamapi hyakṛte hrasvatve prāpnoti, kṛte'pi| na ca śabdāntaraprāptiḥ; `ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati' (vyā.pa.16) iti vacanāt‌| hrasvatvamapi kṛte dvirvacane prāpnotyakṛte'pi| na ca śabdāntaraprāptiḥ, sa eva śabdo dvirucyata iti kṛtvā| sthāne dvirvacanaṃ tvatra nāśrīyate; lakṣyānurodhāt‌| tatrobhayostulyabalayoḥ paratvād‌ hrasvatvam‌, tato dvirvacanena `sanvallaghuni' (7.4.93) iti sanvadbhāvāditvam‌, `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghaḥ--ityetāni kāryyāṇi karttavyāni| ata evāha vṛttau--`pacādīnām‌' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tathā śāstrapravṛttiḥ kriyate, yathaiṣāṃ kāryāṇāmayaṃ pravṛttikramo bhavati? ityāha--`tathā ca' ityādi| `hrasvasya sthānivadbhāvānna pratiṣidhyate' iti| tasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| hetau ceyaṃ pañcamī| yathā--`tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt‌' (1.2.53) iti| atra hi `sanvalladhuni' (7.4.93) ityādinā laghuni dhātvakṣare pare sandadbhāvo vidhīyamāno hrasvasya sthānivadbhāvāddhetoḥ pratiṣiṣyate, tasmin‌ sati laghutā nivarttata iti kṛtvā| sa cāsmin‌ krame sati sthānivadbhāvo na sambhavatati sanvadbhāvo na pratiṣidhyate; pratibandhahetorabhāvāt‌| kathaṃ punarasmin‌ krame sati kāryāṇāṃ sthānivadbhāvo na sambhavatītyāha--`yo hyānādiṣṭāt‌' ityādi| `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau" (1.1.57) ityatra yo hyanādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhiṃ prati sthānivadbhāvo bhavatītyeṣa sūtrārtho vyavasthitaḥ| na cāsmin‌ krame satyatrābhyāso'nādiṣṭadacaḥ pūrvo bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? ādiṣṭādeva| tena tasya vidhau karttavye hrasvasya sthānivadbhāvo na bhavatīti laghutvaṃ na nivarttate| tataśca `sanvat‌' (7.4.93) ityādinā laghunimittakaḥ sanvadbhāvo vidhīyamāno na vyāhanyate| yadi punardvirvacanaṃ kṛtvā hrasvādikāryaṃ vidhīyate tato'nādiṣṭādacaḥ pūrvo'bhyāsaḥ syāt‌, tataśca tasya vidhau karttavye hrasvasya sthānivadbhāvaḥ syādeva | evaṃ `dīrghañca' (1.4.12) iti labdhasvabhāvayā gurusaṃjñayā laghusaṃjñāyāṃ nistāyāṃ sanvadbhāvo'yantra sāvakāśa iha na syāt‌| kaḥ punastasyāvakāśaḥ? aśīśamadityādi| atra hi ṇau parabhūte prāgeva `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) vidhīyate| yadi tarhyayaṃ kāryakramaḥ, āṭiṭadityatra ṇilāpe kṛte dvitīyasyaikācaṣṭiśabdasya dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnoti; tadabhāvāt‌? ityata āha--`āṭiṭadityatra dvirvacane'ci' ityādi| atha kimarthametāni trīṇi sūtrāṇi pṛthak‌ kriyante--`liṭi dhātoranabhyāsasya', `ślau', `caṅi' iti, na `liṅślucaṅkṣu' ityeka eva yogaḥ kriyatām‌; tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--punaḥ punarvibhaktirnoccāra yitavyā, liṭi ślau ca dvirvacanam‌? tadanityamiti jñāpanārthaṃ pṛthagyokaraṇam‌| tena `yo jāgāra tamṛcaḥ kāmayante' `dāti priyāṇi' `dhāti priyāṇi' ityatra na bhavati dvirvacanam‌, tataśca `dvirvacanaprakaraṇe chandasi vā' (vā.656) ityetanna karttavyaṃ bhavati|| 12. dāśvān‌ sāhvān‌ mīḍhvāṃśca| (6.1.12) `aviśeṣeṇa nipātyante' iti| viśeṣānupādānāt‌| `aniṭtvaṃ ca' iti| `vasvekājādghasām‌' (7.2.67) itīṭ‌ prāpnoti, atastadabhāvo nipātyate| nanu ca kṛtadvirvacanānāmekācāmiṅ vidhāsyate, ayaṃcākṛtadvirvacanamekāj‌ bhavati; akṛtadvirvacanatvāt‌, tadayuktamaniṭtvanipātanam‌? naitadasti; liṭi hi śrūyamāṇaikājupalakṣaṇārthaṃ tatra kṛtadvirvacanagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌| asti cātra liṭi śrūyamāṇaikāctvamiti kātrāyuktatā? `parasmaipadam‌' iti| saherātmanepaditvāt‌ parasmaipadaṃ na prāpnotītyatastannipātyate| kiṃ punaḥ samārthyamityāha--`halādiśeṣaḥ' ityādi| yadi halādiśeṣaḥ syāt‌, evañca satyāmākārādeśameva kuryāt‌, na hi halādiśeṣe satyāgamasyādeśasya vā viśoṣo'sti| ṇilukceti| `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilope siddhe lugvacanaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇenopadhāvṛddhirmābhūdityevamartham‌| lope hi sati pratyalakṣamenopadhāvṛddhiḥ syāt‌, luki tu `na luyatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati|| 13. ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ putrapatyostatyuruṣe| (6.1.13) samprasāraṇamiti yaṇsthānikasyeka eṣā saṃjñā vihitā, vākyārthasya ca| `igyaṇaḥ' (1.1.45) iti yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ sthānyādeśasambandhalakṣaṇastasya tatra cedamuktamanuvāde varṇa upatiṣṭhate, vidhau tu vākyārtha iti; vidhiścāyam‌, ato vākyārthasyaivopasthānamityāha--`yaṇaḥ sthāne' ityādi| `tataścāpi vihite' iti| `yaṅścāp‌' (4.1.74) ityenena| `ibhyāputraḥ' iti| ibhamaītīti `daṇḍādibhyo yaḥ' (5.1.66)| `kṣatriyāputraḥ' iti| kṣatatrasyāpatyamiti `kṣatrāt‌ dhaḥ' (4.1.138) iti dhaḥ| `ṣyaṅaḥ' iti pratyayagrahaṇamidam‌, tatra pratyagrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā (pu.pa.vṛ.44) apasthānād‌ yasmāt‌ sa vihitastadādestadantasyeti tadāditadantagrahaṇamihaiva syāt‌--kārīṣagandhīputra iti, iha tu na syāt‌--paramakāroṣagandhīputra iti; kārīṣagandhaśabdāddhi ṣyaṅ vihitaḥ, na paramakārīṣagandhaśabdāt‌? ata idaṃ dveṣyamapākarttu māha--`ṣyaṅiti strīpratyayagrahaṇam‌' iti `striyām‌' (4.1.3) ityadhikṛtya vihitatvāt‌| strītvaṃ sthānivadbāvena ca pratyayatvaṃ ṣyaṅaḥ, na hi tasyānyathā strīpratyayatvamupapadyate; ādeśapakṣasya ca tatrāśritatvāt‌| yadi strīpratyayagrahaṇametat‌; tataśca kimiti? tadādiniyamo na bhavati; yato'dhikasyāpyatra grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, atiprasaṅgo vā| asati hi niyame yatheha bhavati--paramakārīṣagandhīputra iti, tathehāpi syāt‌--atikārīṣagndhyāputra iti, ata āha--`nastrīpratyaye ca' ityādi| pratyagrahaṇaparibhāṣāyā `na strīpratyaye cānupasarjane' (pu.pa.vṛ.45) ityayamapavādaḥ kṛtaḥ| tena yatrānupasarjanaḥ strīpratyayastatraiṣā pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣāṃ na pravarttata iti tadādiniyamo nāsti, tena paramakārīṣandhīputra ityatra bhavatyeva| atra hi paramācāsau kārīṣagandhyā ceti `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāsaḥ, strīpratyayasya prādhānyam‌, `striyāḥ puṃvat‌' (6.3.34) ityādinā puṃvadbhāvaḥ| yatra tūpasarjanaṃ strīpratyayastatrānuparjana iti vacanādupatiṣṭhata evaiṣā paribhāvā| tena bhavatyevātra tadādiniyamaḥ| teneha na bhavati--atikārīṣandhyāputra iti| atra hi kārīṣagandhyāmatikrānta iti prādisamāsaḥ| atra yosāvatikrāntaḥ sa pradhānam‌, kāriṣagandhyā tūpasarjanam‌| ata eva `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvo bhavati| putrapatyoḥ samprasasāraṇe tadādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ| ihāpi prāpnoti--kārīṣagandhyāputrakulamiti| tathā hi--putrapatyoriti saptamī kāryiṇa ānantaryamācaṣṭe, tataśca śuddhayostadādau cāviśiṣṭam‌| athāpi kathañcit‌ tadādau na syāt‌, evamapi `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) iti tadante'tiprasaṅga ihāpi prāpnoti--karīṣagandhyā paramaputra iti| vidhividhānavidhibhājāṃ trayāṇāṃ sannidhāne tadantarvidhirbhavati| te ceha santi--vidhiḥ samprasāraṇam‌, vidhibhāk‌ ṣyaṅ‌, vidhānaṃ patiputraśabdau| iha ca tatpuruṣemāvyabhicārāt‌ sannidhāpitaṃ yaduttarapadaṃ tat‌ putrapatiśabdābhyāṃ viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantarvidhirbhavatīti putraśabdānte patiśabdānte cottarapade samprasāraṇaṃ bhavatīti kasyacit‌ bhrāntiḥ syāt‌, astāṃ nirākarttumāha--`putrapatyoḥ' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--tatpuruṣo'tra putrapatyoḥ ṣyaṅścādhikaraṇabhūto nirdiśyamānastatpuruṣāvayavatvaṃ putrapatyoḥ khyāpayati, tadyathā--vṛkṣe śākheti| vṛkṣaḥ śākhāyā adhikaraṇatvena nirdiśyamānaḥ śākhāyāḥ vṛkṣāvayavatvaṃ bodhayati; tatra pratyāsatteḥ| yatra tatpuruṣe ṣyaṅ kāryabhāgavayavaḥ sthitaḥ, tasyaiva tatpuruṣasya yāvavayavau putrapatī tayoreva grahaṇam‌, na tu putrapatyādāvuttarapade yau putrapatiśabdau tau tasyaiva ṣyaṅaḥ pūrvapadasya tatparuruṣasyāvayavau| ati tu tatpuruṣāntarasyāpi putrakulaśabdasya patikulaśabtadasya ca| tasmāt‌ tadādau tāvanna bhavatyatiprasaṃgaḥ| tadante'pi na bhavatyeva; yasmādiha putrapatigrahaṇaṃ yacca tatapuruṣeṇa sandhāpitamuttarapadaṃ tayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ prati kāmacāraḥ| tatra yadīhottarapadaṃ putrapatiśabdābhyāṃ viśiṣyeta tadā syāt‌ tadantavidhiḥ, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhirbhavatīti kṛtvā| na ceha tābhyāṃ tadviśiṣyate, api tu tāveva tena; tataśca tadantaravidherabhāvāt‌ kevalayorevedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti kutastadanto'tiprasaṅga? nanu ca yadyuttarapadena putrapatī viśiṣyete tena tayostadantatā vijñāyate, tataścottarapadapadāntayoreva grahaṇaṃ, na kevalayoḥ, evañca tadādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ? naitadasti; na hi putrapatiśabdāvuttarapadāntau sambhavataḥ| yasmādayamantaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| na ca putrapatiśabdayorahuttarapadamavayavaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? samāsasya, na ca tau samāsau| tasmānannaivaṃ vijñāyate--uttarapadāntayoḥsa putrapatiśabdayoriti, kiṃ tarhi? putrapatyorevottarapadayoḥ kevalayoriti| `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) iti tadantavidhinā'tra ṣyaṅantasya samprasāraṇaṃ vijñāyate, tataśca vārāhīputra ityatra vakārasayāpi sabhprasāraṇaṃ prāpnotītyata āha--`ṣyaṅnte ca' ityādi| tatraiva kāraṇamāha--`nirdiśyamānasya' ityādi| samprasāraṇagarahaṇamuttarārtham‌| ati hikāragrahaṇenāpi sidhyatyeva| tāṃ cottarārthatāṃ tatraiva darśayiṣyāmaḥ| tāmevottarārthatāṃ sūcayannāha--`samprasāraṇam‌' ityādi|| 14. bandhuni bahuvrīhau| (6.1.14) `bandhunīti napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ' ityādi| bandhunīti śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakaliṅgana nirdeśaḥ kṛta ityarthaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha--`puliṅgābhidheyo'yam‌' ityādi| nanu bandhāviti puliṅgenaiva nirdeśaḥ kasmānna kṛtaḥ/ paryāyeṣu mā bhūt‌| evaṃ hi kriyamāṇe'rthapradhāno'yaṃ nirdeśa ityādiḥ syāt‌, tataśca paryāyeṣvapi prasajyeta| arthapradhāne nirdeśe svarūpaparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhata ityuktam‌| `mātac‌' ityādi| nanu ca mātajiti śabdarūpaṃ nāstyeva, na hyasya svatantrasya kvacit‌ prayogo labhyate, kathaṃ tatra samprasāraṇaṃ karttaṃ śakyam‌? ityata āha `asmādeva' ityādi| `tatra' ityādi| yadi ca `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam‌' (6.2.1) iti bahuvrīhisvaraḥ syāt‌, citkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmānmā bhūt‌ tasyānarthakyamiti citkāraṇasāmarthyām‌ bahuvrīhisvara' `citaḥ' (6.1.163) ityantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ bādhate| nanu ca mātṛśabdo bahuvrīhāvuttarapadaṃ na sambhavatyeva, `nadyutaśca' (5.4.153) iti nityaṃ kapā bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ tatrottarapade bahuvrīhau ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇamupapadyate? ityāha--`mātṛmātṛkayośca' ityādi| yadi ca nityaṃ kap‌ syāt‌ mātṛmātṛkayorbhedenopādānaṃ na kuryāt‌, kṛtañca| tasmādbhedenopādānāt‌ kab‌ vikalpena kriyate, na kevalaṃ mātajādeśa ityapiśabdasyārthaḥ|| 15. vacisvapiyajādīnāṃ kiti| (6.1.15) ādiśabdo'yaṃ yajinaiva sambadhya iti, na vacyādibhiḥ pratyekam‌| yadi hi pratyekamabhisambandho'bhimataḥ syāt‌ `vaca bhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1063) ityadhītya `ñiṣvap‌ śaye' (dhā.pā.1068) ityadhīyatām‌, tatra vacyādīnāmityevaṃ svaperapi sidhyatīti pṛthagupādānaṃ na karttavyaṃ jāyate| nanvevam‌, `rudaśca pañcabhyaḥ' (7.3.98) ityatra svapergrahaṇaṃ ca syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; śakyate hi rudādīnāmādau svapimadhītya `svapaśca pañcabhyaḥ' ityevaṃ sūtraṃ praṇetum‌| tasmādyuktamuktam‌--yajinaiva sambadhyata iti| vaceḥ svapinā sāhacaryyāddhātunirdeśārtha ikāraḥ, na viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| tena ca brañādeśasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyāha--`vaca paribhāṣaṇe, bruvo vaciriti ca' iti| `uktaḥ' iti| `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti paraparvatvam‌| `iṣṭaḥ' iti| vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, tataḥ ṣṭutvam‌| `ūḍhaḥ' iti| `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌, `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti ṣṭutvam‌, `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13) iti ḍhakāralopaḥ, `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111) iti dīrghatvam‌| `uṣitam‌' iti| `śāsivasighasīnāñca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam‌| `saṃvītaḥ āhūtaḥ, śūnaḥ' iti| `halaḥ' (6.4.2) itī dīrghaḥ| `śūnaḥ' ityatra `oditaśca' (8.2.45) niṣṭhānatvam‌| atheha kasmānna bhavati--vācamicchati vācā taratīti ṭhak‌ vācyati vācika iti? yadyapi vaceḥ `kvibvacipracchyāyatastukaṭaprujuśrīṇāṃ dīrgho'saprasāraṇañca' (vā.288) iti vā dīrghaḥ kṛtaḥ, tathāpi `ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati' ityasti prāptirityāha--`dhātoḥ' ityādi| yatra dhātuḥ sāmānyavācinā dhātuśabdena nopādīyate, api tu svaśabdenaiva, tatra tatpratyaye dātorityevaṃ yo vihitaḥ pratyayastatraiva kāryaṃ vijñāyate| etacca bhrauṇahatyeti nipātanaṃ kurvan‌ jñāpayati--taddhitatvārtha nipātanam‌| yadi ca dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaya eva kāryaṃ na vijñāyeta, tatvanipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ' (7.3.32) ityanenaiva tatvasya siddhatvāt‌| `vācyati vācikaḥ' ityatra yadyapi `vivabantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati' (vyā.pa.132) iti, tathāpi dhātorityevaṃ nāsau pratyayo vihitaḥ| tathā hyekatra supa ityevaṃ pratyayo vihitaḥ--`supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8) iti, itaratra ca `prātipadikāt‌' ityevaṃ ṅyāpprātipadikādhikārāt‌ (4.1.1.)| tasmādiha vaceḥ svarūpagrahaṇāt‌ tatpratyaya eva kāryasaṃvijñānaṃ na bhavati|| 16. grahijyāvayivyadhivaṣṭivicativṛścatipṛcchatibhṛjjatīnāṃ ṅiti ca| (6.1.16) `gṛhītam‌' iti| `graho'liṭi' (7.2.37) iti dīrghaḥ| `jarīgṛhyate' iti| yaṅi samprasāraṇaṃ dvirvacanam‌| `rīgṛdupadhasya' (7.4.90) iti rīgāgamaḥ| vayirayamastyevātmanepadī--`aya vaya gatau (dhā.pā.474,475) asti ca parasmaipadī--`vetro vayiḥ' (2.4.42) iti; tatra grahyādibhiranātmanepadibhiḥ sāhacaryādanātmanepadī gṛhyate? ityāha--`vayirliṭi' ityādi| tasmācca parasya liṭaḥ `asaṃyogālliṭ‌ kit‌' (1.2.5) iti kittvena bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`tasya' ityādi| `yadyevam‌' iti| yadi veñādeśasya vayergrahaṇamityarthaḥ. `yajādiṣu veñ‌ paṭhyate' iti| tataśca pūrvasūtreṇaiva tasya sthānivadbhāvāt‌ samprasāraṇaṃ siddhamityabhiprāyaḥ| `naivaṃ śakyam‌' iti| vijñātumiti śeṣaḥ| nānayopapattyā vayigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātumityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam‌? ityāha--`liṭi tasya' ityādi| syādetat‌--vidhipratiṣedhayorvirodhādekatra vidhireva bhaviṣyati, na pratiṣedha iti? ata āha--`atra yataiva' ityādi| syādetat‌--vidhipratiṣedhayorvirodhādekatra vidhireva bhaviṣyati, na pratiṣedha iti? ata āha--`atra yathaiva' ityādi| yadi virodhādekatrāsambhavaḥ, paryāyo'stu, na tu dvayoranyatra caritārthatvādekenaiva bhavitavyam‌| nāpareṇetyeṣo'rtho labhyata iti bhavāḥ| `naiṣa doṣaḥ' iti| kathaṃ naiṣa doṣaḥ? ityata āha--`liṭi' ityādi| `liṭi vayo yaḥ' iti yakārasya samprasāraṇapratiṣedho liṅgam‌--vidho veñograhaṇena vayigrahaṇaṃ bhavatītyasyārthasya| asati vidhau grahaṇe prāpterasambhavāt‌ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌| veña ityatra pratiṣedhe vayergrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti atrāpyetadeva pratiṣedhavacanaṃ liṅgam‌| sati hi veñ‌grahaṇe veña ityanenaiva pratiṣedhasya siddhattvāt‌, panaḥ `liṭi vayo yaḥ' (6.1.38) iti| anantaroktamarthamabhyanujānāti| yadi satyametat‌, tarhi kimarthaṃ vayigrahaṇam‌? ityāha--`eṣa eva' ityādi| tena spaṣṭīkaraṇārthaṃ vayigrahaṇamityācaṣṭe| `vidhyati' iti| divāditvācchyan‌| `uṣṭaḥ' iti| tasantametat‌, adāditvācchapo luk‌ vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| `vicati' iti| tudāditvācchaḥ| vṛkṇa iti pūrvavannatvam‌, `skoḥ' (8.2.29) iti salopaḥ| `jhalādirniṣṭhā na bhavati' iti| tenātra ṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| jhalācau hi tadvidhīyate; `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) ityato jhalgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `kṛtve tu karttavye tadasiddhameva' iti| na hi yathā ṣatvādau niṣṭhādeśasya siddhatvamucyate, tathā kutve'pi, tena tat‌ pravartata eva| `vṛścati' iti| pūrvavacchaḥ| `varīvṛścyate' iti| `rīgṛtvata iti vaktavyam‌' (vā.880) iti rīgāgamaḥ| `pṛṣṭaḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ ṣatvam‌| `yajayāca' (3.3.90) ityādinā naṅi vihite praśna ityatra samprasāraṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`naṅi' ityādi| `bhṛṣṭaḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ ṣatvam‌| `bhṛjjati' iti| pūrvavacchaḥ| `barībhṛjyate' iti| pūrvavad rīk‌| `sakālasya' ityādi| nanu skhoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti tasya lopena bhavitavyam‌? naitadasti; jhali padānte ca sa ucyata iti|| 17. liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām‌| (6.1.17) `uvayitha' iti| krādiniyamādiṭ‌ prāptaḥ `upadeśe'tvataḥ' (7.2.62) iti pratiṣiddhaḥ `ṛto bhāradvājasya' (7.2.63) iti niyamāt‌ punarbhavati| `graheraviśeṣaḥ' iti| yasmāt‌ sati samprasāraṇe halādiśeṣeṇa (7.4.60) rephanivṛttau jagrāheti graheryadrūpaṃ bhavati, satyapi samprasāraṇa uratvaraparatvahalādiśeṣeṣvapi kṛteṣu tadeva bhavati| `jijyau' iti| `āta au ṇalaḥ' (7.1.34)| `jijyatha' iti| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ. `vṛścateḥ satyasati vā yoge nāsti viśeṣaḥ' iti| yadyanyārtho yoga ārabhyate na vṛścatyarthaḥ, tato vṛścatyarthametadvacanaṃ na bhavatīti satyapyetasminnanyārthavacane vṛścaterabhyāsasya naiva samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam‌| na hyasati tadarthe vacane kenacit‌ prakāreṇa samprasāraṇamupapadyata ityabhiprāyaḥ tataścāsatyasmin‌ yoge vavraśceti yadrūpaṃ bhavati satyapi tadeveti nāsti vṛścaterviśeṣaḥ| etacca vṛttikāramatenoktam‌| bhāṣyakāramatena tvāha--`yogārambe' ityādi| tasyāyaṃ bhāvaḥ--sati vaca'nenyārtho kriyamāṇe tasya vṛścatyarthatāpi bhavati; vṛścaterahapi grahyādiṣvantarbhāvāt‌| tataśca tadartho'pyayaṃ yogārambha iti tadabhyāsasyāpi samprasāraṇena bhavitavyamiti tuśabdo vṛttikāramatādviśeṣaṃ darśayati| `yadi samprasāraṇamakṛtvā' ityādi| nanu cobhayagrahamasya prayojanaṃ vakṣyati--halādiśeṣaṃ (7.4.60) paramapi bādhitvā samprasāraṇameva yathā syāditadi, tat‌ kuto'sya pakṣasya sambhavaḥ? ubhayagrahaṇarahite yoge satītyabhiprāyaḥ| `atha rephasya' ityādi| ubhayagrahaṇasahite yoge satīti bhāvaḥ| `uradatvasya sthānivadbhāvāt‌' iti| kena punaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ? `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti| kaḥ punarasau? pratyayo'caḥ paraḥ, yannimittamoratvaṃ syāt‌| ahgasya yo'bhyāsa iti vijñāyamāne sāmarthyāt‌ pratyaya āśrito bhavati; vinā tenāhgavyapadeśābhāvāt‌ vṛttikāramataṃ ceṣitavyam‌; anyathā tatrobhayagrahaṇābhāvāt‌ halādiśeṣeṇa (7.4.60) prāgeva samprasāraṇādrephe nivarttite vakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ syāt‌| tataśca uvraścetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| `pṛcchatibhṛjjatyīraviśeṣaḥ' iti| graheriva veditavyaḥ| `akidartham‌' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamakidarthaṃ midaṃ vyākhyeyam‌? ityata āha--`kiti' ityādi| yasmāt‌ kiti paratvāt‌ samprasāraṇa kṛte kṛtasamprasāraṇasya punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānād‌dvirvacane kṛte'ntareṇāpyetadvacanam‌, ūcaturityādi siddhyatyeva| tasmānnedaṃ kidartham‌, api tvakidarthameveti| atha kimarthamubhayeṣāmityucyate, yāvatā svaritaliṅgāsaṅgādevobhayeṣāmityasyānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati? na cānuvṛttau satyāṃ ṅiti vacyādīnāmapi samprasāraṇaṃ prāpnotītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam‌; yadi vacyādīnāmapi ṅiti samprasāraṇaṃ syādyogavibhāgo'narthakaḥ syāt‌; maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vā vracyādīnāmanuvṛttirbhaviṣyati, tatkuto'sya doṣasyāvasaraḥ? ityāha--`adhikārādeva' ityādi| adhikārādevobhayagrahaṇe siddhe punarubhayeṣāṃgrahaṇāt‌ punaḥśrutirbhavati| tasyāścaitadeva prayojanam‌--yatra samprasāraṇaṃ cānyacca prāpnoti tatra samprasāraṇameva yathā syāt‌, mā bhūdanyaditi| tena vivyādha, vivyadhitha ityatra halādiśeṣaṃ (7.4.60) paramapi bādhitvā samprasāraṇameva bhavati; anyathātra paratvāt‌ prāk‌ pravartamānena halādiśeṣeṇa yakārasya nivṛttau kṛtāyāṃ vakārasya samprasāraṇamāpadyeta, tataśca--uvyādha uvyadhithetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌|| 18. svāpeścaṅi| (6.1.18) `svāpeḥ' iti| `āplṛ vyāptau' (dhā.pā. 1260) ityasyāpi suparvasyekā nirdeśaḥ sambhavati, atastadgrahaṇāśaṅkānirākaraṇāyāha--`svaperṇyantasya grahaṇam‌' iti| ṇyantasya grahaṇaṃ caṅgrahaṇādvijñāyate, na hyaṇyantāccaṅ‌ sambhavati| `asūṣupat‌' iti| `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic‌| `dvirvacanāt parvamatra samprasāraṇam‌' iti| paratvāt‌| `svāpyate' iti| karmaṇi lakāraḥ, `sārvadhātuke yak‌' (3.1.67)| `svāpitam‌' iti| `niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' (6.4.52) iti ṇilopaḥ| nanu ca grahyādi (6.1.16) sūtrāt‌ ṅitotyanuvarttate, na ca svāpeścaṅo'nyo ṅidasti, tatra sāmarthyācacaṅyeva bhaviṣyatīti na karttavyameva caṅgrahaṇam‌? ityata āha--`ṅititi kevalam‌' ityādi| grahyādisūtre hyubhayaṃ sannihitam--kidgrahaṇam‌, ṅidgrahaṇañca, tatrobhayoraviśeṣeṇa sannidhāne ṅidgrahaṇamevānuvarttate, na kidgrahaṇamiti mandadhiyā durbodham‌| ataḥ sukhapratipattye mandabuddheścaṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti bhāvaḥ|| 19. svapisyamivyeñāṃ yaṅi| (6.1.19) `svapnak‌' iti| `svapitṛṣornajiṅ' (3.2.172)|| 20. na vaśaḥ| (6.1.20 21. cāyaḥ kī| (6.1.21) atha kimarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇam‌, yāvatā hrasvādeśe'pi `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghatvena cekīyata iti siddhatyeva? ityāha--`dīrghoccāraṇam‌' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ `yaṅi ca' (7.4.30) ityucyamāne ādeśo yaṅluki syāt‌? pratyayalakṣaṇena syāt‌| athāpi `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ pratiṣidhyate? evamapyasmādeva dīrghoccāramādyaṅluki bhavatīti vijñāyate, anyathā tadapārthakaṃ syāt‌! `cekītaḥ' iti| tasantametat‌| `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti yaṅo luk‌|| 22. sphāyaḥ sphī niṣṭhāyām‌| (6.1.22) `sphātiḥ' iti| `striyāṃ ktin‌' (3.3.94) vali (6.1.66) yalopaḥ| `sphātībhavati' iti| sphāyaterniṣṭhāntāccavau kṛte `asya cvau (7.4.32) itītve satīdaṃ rūpaṃ bhavatīti manyamāno yaścodayet‌--atha kathaṃ sphātībhavatītyetadrūpam‌, yāvatā'trāpi niṣṭhāyāmasminnādeśe sphītibhavatītyevaṃ bhavitavyamiti? taṃ pratyāha--`sphātībhavatītyetadapi' ityādi| etadapi sphātiśabdāt‌ ktinnantāccvau kṛte `cvau ca' (7.4.26) iti dīrghatve ca ktinnantasyaiva rūpam‌| ato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ|| 23. styaḥ prapūrvasya| (6.1.23) `sāmānyena grahaṇam‌' ti| dvayorapyāttve kṛte pūrvasya `dhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ (6.1.64) iti satve samānatvādrūpasya| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā (vyā.pa.3) ca nehopatadiṣṭhate; ubhayolakṣiṇikatvāt‌| athātra--`saṃyogāderāto dhātoryaṇvataḥ' (8.2.43) iti niṣṭhānatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`samprasāraṇe' ityādi| na tvasya pūrvatrāsiddhatvāt‌ pūrvaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ kriyata iti, tatra kṛte ca yaṇvattā nāstīti natvaṃ na bhavati| `prastya ityevaṃ siddhe' iti| nanu caivamucyamāne praśabdasyāpi samprasāraṇaṃ syāt‌, tataśca prastīta iti rūpaṃ syāt‌, tat‌ kimucyate--prastya ityevaṃ siddha iti? `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' (vyā.pa.63) iti na bhavatyeṣa doṣa iti manyate| `ihāpi yathā syāt‌' iti| kasmāt‌ punarna prāpnoti? saṃśabdena vyavahitatvāt‌| kiṃ pūrvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe śabdārthaṃ eva tathāvido bhavati yenātrāpi bhavati? atha granthādhikyādarthādhikyaṃ sūcayatītyābhiprāyeṇāha--`tat‌ katham‌' iti| prathamakalpaṃ darśannāha--`prapūrvasya' iti| `ṣaṣṭhyarthe bahuvrīhiḥ' iti| pūrvaśabdo'yamavayavavacana iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe bahuvrīhirbhavati| avayavavācini pūrvaśabde dhāturanyapadārtho nopapadyate| na hi dhātoḥ praśabdo'yamavayavo bhavati, api tu dhātūpasargasamudāyasya| tasmāt‌ sa evānyapadārtho yukta ityāha--`praḥ pūrvo yasya' ityādi| `tadavayavasya' iti| tasyāvayavastadavayava iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tacchabdena dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ parāmṛśyate| `vyadhikaraṇaṣaṣṭhyau' iti| `prapūrvasya' iti| styāvayavāpekṣayā yo'yamavayavāvayavisambandhastatra ṣaṣṭhī, `styaḥ' ityeṣā tu yaṇavayavāpekṣayā yaḥ sambandhastatra| tena bhinnābhideyatvāt‌ `satyaḥ', `pravūrvasya' iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| syādevam‌, prasaṃstīta ityatra prapūrvasamudāyāvayavaḥ styāśabdo na sambhavati ityata āha--`tatra' ityādi|| 24. dravamūrttisparśayoḥ śyaḥ| (6.1.24) `dravamūrttau dravakāṭhinye' iti| anena dravamūrttiśabdasyārthamācaṣṭe| dravāvasthāyā uttaro'vasthāviśeṣaḥ kāṭhinyākhyo'tra dravamūrttiśabdenocyate| `sparśe ca' iti| rūpādisahacarito guṇaḥ sparśa ityucyate| `śītamudakam' iti| kathaṃ punaratra sāmānādhikaraṇyam‌, yāvatā śītaśabdena guṇaviśeṣo'bhidhīyate| vāyvādiśabdena tu dravyaviśeṣa ityata āha--`guṇamātre' ityādi| yathā--śuklādiśabdā kadācidguṇamātre varttante, yatā--paṭasya śukla iti; kadācittu tadvati dravye so'yamityabhedasambandhatadvānmatublopānmatvarthīyākārapratyayāntatvādvā śuklaḥ paṭa iti, tathā śītaśabdo'pi| tena yadā tadvati dravye varttate, tadobhayorekadravye niveśitatvādupapadyate sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti bhāvaḥ| `saṃśyānaḥ' iti| `saṃyogādeḥ' (8.2.43) ityādinā natvam‌|| 25. prateśca| (6.1.25) 26. vibhāṣā'bhyavapūrvasya| (6.1.26) `seyamubhayatra vibhāṣā' iti| dravamūrttisparśaviṣaye pūrveṇa prāpte, anyatrāprāpte| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na `vibhāṣā'bhyavābhyām‌' ityevocyeta? ata āha--`pūrvagrahaṇasya' ityādi| kriyamāṇe pūrvagrahaṇe kasmādevātra na bhavatītyāha--`na kila' ityādi| ayaṃ hi dvividho'pi samudāyo nābhipūrvaḥ; nāpyavapūrvaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? sampūrvaḥ| tena pūrvagrahaṇādatra na bhavati| kriyamāṇe'pi pūrvagrahaṇe prāpnotyeveti manyamānaḥ kilaśabdamarucisūcanārthaṃ prayuktavān‌| tāmeva prāpti darśayannāha--`yo'tra' ityādi| samūśabdāt‌ paro yo dhātūpasargasamudāyastadāśrayo vikalpaḥ kasmānna bhavati, bhavati hyasāvabyavapūrva ityasti prāpti? ata āha--`yatnāntaramāstheyam‌' iti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇamiha kriyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate, teneha na bhavatīti yatanāntaram‌| `pūrvagrahaṇasya cānyatprayojanaṃ vaktavyam‌' iti| tat‌ punarabhisaṃśīnam‌, abhisaṃśyānam‌, avasaṃśīnam‌, avasaṃśyānam‌--ityatrāpi vikalpo yathā syādityevaṃ tadveditavyam‌| etacca pūrvagrahaṇae kriyamāṇe yatopapadyate tathā `styaḥ prapūrvasya' (6.1.23) ityatra `prapūrvasyeti ṣaṣṭhyarthe bahuvrīhiḥ' ityādinā vyākhyātam‌|| 27. śrutaṃ pāke| (6.1.27) ``śrā pāke' ityasya dhātoḥ' iti| `śrā pāke' (dhā.pā.1053) ityadādau paṭhyate ghaṭādau (dhā.pā.810) ca mitsaṃjñārtham‌| kaiściccurādāvapi, `śrai pāke' (dhā.pā.919) iti bhvādau, tatrehāviśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ prāptam‌| śrāyaterapi hi kṛtāttvasyaitadrūpaṃ bhavatyeva| nipātanācca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā (vyā.pa.3) pratibandhaṃ na karoti| `ṇantasyāṇyantasya ca' iti| viśeṣānupādānāt‌| tathā coktam‌--śrāśrapyoḥ śrṛtamiti| yadi vibhāṣetyanuvarttate kṣīrahaviṣorapi pakṣe śrāṇam‌, śrapitamiti syāt‌; tābhyāmanyatrāpi pakṣe śrṛtamiti prasajyeta? ityata āha--`vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam‌' iti| `yadāpi' ityādi| prayojakavyāpāraḥ preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādiḥ kārye kāraṇopacāraṃ kṛtvā prayojakaśabdenoktaḥ| sa hi prākṛtādarthādbāhyo bhavati, tatra tasyānantarbhāvāt‌| tatra yadā `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti dvitīyo ṇijutpadyate, tadāpi kṣīrahaviṣorapi nipātanametanneṣyate; vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādeva| tathā coktam‌--śrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hatoriti| hetumāṇṇico'nyatretyarthaḥ| dvitīyagrahaṇaṃ yadaikameva bhavati, tadeṣṭattvāc‌ śrapitaṃ kṣīraṃ devadattena yajñadatteneti tatprayojako hetuśca' (1.4.55) iti cakārāddevadattayajñadattayoḥ karttṛ saṃjñāvidhānādubhayatrāpi karttari tṛtīyā| `śrapitam‌' iti| śrāterṇica kṛte `arttihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk‌, `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) kṣīraṃ svayameva śrāti sma--tadyadā devadattadena prayujyate sma tadā `hetumati ca (3.1.26) iti prathamo ṇic‌| so'pi śrapayan‌ yadā yajñadattena prayujyate sma tadā dvitīyaḥ| `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti pūrvasya ṇerlopaḥ, tataḥ kṣīre prayojye karmaṇi niṣṭhā--śrṛtamiti| `ṇyantasyāṇyāntasya ca nipātyete' iti pratijñāte sati yuktaṃ ṇyantasyāpyetannipātanam‌--yeṣāṃ śrātiścurādāvapi paṭhyate ityabhyupagamaḥ| ye tu curādāvasya pāṭhaṃ na pratijānate teṣāṃ kathaṃ ṇyantasyetannipātanaṃ yujyate, na ca śakyate vaktum‌--teṣāmapi hetumaṇṇyantarayaitannipātanaṃ yujyate; `śrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hetauḥ' iti bhāṣyakāravacanāditi yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`śrātirayam‌' ityādi| karmabhāvāpanne'pi yo'rthaḥ saukaryyāt‌ svātantryeṇa vivakṣyate sa karmakarttā, karma kartā bhavatīti kṛtvā| karma cāsau karttā ceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, sa yasya viṣayaḥ sa karmakarttṛviṣayaḥ| arthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ paceḥ karmakarttṛviṣayatvaṃ veditavyam‌| tasya yo'rthaḥ pacyamānakarttṛkatvaṃ vikledanamātraṃ tatrāyamakarmakaḥ--śrātirvarttate| yadā tu sa ṇyanto bhavati tadā prākṛtaṃ pacyarthamāha| prakṛtau bhavaḥ prākṛtaḥ, sa punaryaḥ prakṛtyantasya pacerarthaḥ paktṛkarttṛko vikledanopasaṃhārādiḥ sa iha veditavyaḥ| devadattādipaktṛkartṛkaṃ prākṛtaṃ pākākhyaṃ pacyarthamāhetyarthaḥ| tatra dvayorapi śṛtamiṣyata iti yo'ṇyantaḥ śrātiḥ karmakartṛviṣayeṇa pacinā samānārthastratrāpīṣyate| yo'pi ṇyantaḥ prākṛtaṃ pacyarthamāha tatrāpīṣyate| tatra śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ svayameveti prathamasyodāharaṇam‌| śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ devadatteneti dvitīyasya| nanu ca `śrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hetoḥ' iti bhāṣye uktam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ dvayorapīṣyate? evaṃ manyate--yadidaṃ bhāṣye uktam‌--`śrapeḥ śṛtamanyatra hetoḥ' iti, tatra `anyatra hetoḥ' ityanena sarvasya hetumaṇṇicaḥ paryudāso na vidhitsitaḥ anyathā vipratiṣiddhamidaṃ syāt‌, asati hi śrāteścurādau pāṭhe yadi śrapeḥ śṛtamiti nipātyate, kathamanyatra hetoriti paryudāsaḥ! athānyatra hetoriti paryudāso na tarhi śrapeḥ śṛtamiti nipātanamupapadyate| na hi śrāteścurādāvasata pāṭhe śrāterhetumaṇṇicaṃ tyatkvā'nyastato ṇijasti| tasmādyasya hetumaṇṇico na kenacit‌ prakāreṇa svārthikatvamupapadyate sa eva bhāṣyakārasya paryudāsaviṣayatvenābhīṣṭaḥ| sa punaryo bāhye prayojake dvitīyo ṇijutpadyate sa vijñeyaḥ| yasya tu kenacit‌ prakāreṇa svārthikatvamupapadyate, sa eva bhāṣyakārasya paryudāsaviṣayatvena na prakalpyate, tasyaitannipātanamiṣṭameva| sa punaryasminnutpanne śrātiḥ prākṛtaṃ pacyarthamāha sa vijñeyaḥ, śakyate hi tasya pacinā prakṛtyarthena samānārthatvāt‌ svārthikatvamupacāreṇābhidhātumiti| tadevamiha pāṭhe'pi curādau śrāterṇyantasyāpyetannipātanaṃ yujyata eveti|| 28. pyāyaḥ pī| (6.1.28) `pīnam‌' iti| `oditaśca' (8.2.45) iti niṣṭhānatvam‌| `ityamapi' ityādi| apiśabdena na kevalaṃ pūrvasūtre yā vibhāṣā saiva vyavasthitavibhāṣā, api tveṣāpīti darśayati| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| sopasargasya tu naiva bhavatītyasyāpavādamāha--`āṅpūrvasya' ityādi| nityaścāyamandhūdhasoḥ pībhāvaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣaiva|| 29. liṅyaṅośca| (6.1.29) `vibhāṣeti nivṛttam‌' iti| uttarasūtre punarvibhāṣāgrahaṇāt‌| anyathāpīdameva tatrānuvarttiṣyata iti tanna kuryāt‌| ata evocyate--dvayordibhāṣayārmadhye ye vidhayaste nityā bhavantīti| `pyāyaḥ pītyetaccaśabdenānukṛṣyate' iti| itarathā hi samprasāraṇasya prakṛtatvālliṅyaṅoḥ pyāyaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ vijñāyeta| caśabde tu satyanantareṇaivapībhāvena sambandhaḥ sukhamavasīyate| nāprāpte dvirvacane pībhāvo vidhīyate| tena tasya bādhakaṃ prāpnotīti kasyacidāśaṅkā syāt‌| atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`paratvāt‌' ityādi| virodhe hi sati bādhā syāt‌, iha tu virodho nāsti| ataḥ paratvāt‌ pībhāve kṛte punaḥprasaṅgavajñānāt‌ siddhamiti dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti|| 30. vibhāṣā śveḥ| (6.1.30) `śuśāva' iti| liṭi ṇali samprasāraṇe kṛte vṛddhyāvādeśau| `śiśvāya' iti| yadā na samprasāraṇaṃ tadā vṛddhyāyādeśau| `śuśuvatuḥ, śiśviyatuḥ, iti| yadā samprasāraṇaṃ tadovaṅ‌, anyadeyaṅ| `aprāptam‌' iti| kenacivavihitatvāt‌| `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām‌' (6.1.17) ityubhayatrobhayagrahaṇādanyat‌ kāryaṃ pravartamānamapāsyābhyāsasya samprasāraṇameva yathā syādityetadubhayeṣāṃgrahaṇasya prayojanamuktam‌| tataśceyamapi vikalpaṃ bādhitvā nityaṃ samprasāraṇa meva syāditi kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌ atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`yadā ca' ityādi| atra śvayatervibhāṣā samprasāraṇamucyate, yadi kadāciddhātorna samprasāraṇaṃ bhavati tadābyāsasya syāt‌ tataśca śvayateḥ samprasāraṇaṃ pākṣikaṃ na kṛtaṃ syāt‌| syādetat‌--liṭparasya śakyateridaṃ vikalpena kāryaṃ vidhīyate, tasya ca tadastyeveti? asamyagetat‌; dviṣprayoge hi dvirvacane kriyāmātraṃ bhidyate, na dhāturūpamiti kutaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ kāryasambandhaṃ prati bhedaḥ? tasmādyadā dhātorna bhavati tadābhyāsasyāpi na bhavatyeva|| 31. ṇau ca saṃścaṅoḥ| (6.1.31) `ṇau ca saṃścaṅoḥ' iti bhinnādhikaraṇe saptamyau--saṃścaṅoḥ parato yo ṇistasmiṃṇṇau parato yaḥ śvayatiriti| `śuśāvayiṣati' iti| śvayaterṇic‌, san‌, samprasāraṇam‌, vṛddhirāvādeśaḥ `śu' ityetasya dvirvacanam‌| `aśūśavat‌' iti| luṅ, cleścaṅ, samprasāraṇādikam‌, pūrvavaṇṇilopaḥ, `ṇau caṅi' (7.4.1) iti hrasvaḥ, dvirvacanam‌, `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghaḥ| nanu ca śvayaterṇici tadantācca sani kṛte caṅi cāntaraṅgatvāt‌ pūrvavṛddhyāyādeśābyāṃ bhavitavyam‌, tataḥ samprasāraṇena| tathā ca sati śuśuyayiṣatīti sanpare ṇau bhavitavyam‌, caṅpare tu--aśūśuyaditi, tat‌ kathaṃ śuśāvayiṣati, aśūśavaditi codāhṛtam‌? ityāha--`samprasāraṇam‌' ityādi| ādiśabdenāyāveśaḥ parigṛhyate| samprasāraṇāśrayaṃ punaratra `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti parapūrvatvam‌| `tenāpi vṛddhyādikaṃ bādhyate' iti| nanvevamapi vṛddhyāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ śāvityasya dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti na kenacit‌ ṇau sthānivadbhāvo vihitaḥ? ityata āha--`oḥ puyaṇjyapare' ityādi| yatra caitajjñāpakaṃ tathā tasyaiva vṛttāvupapādayiṣyāmaḥ|| 32. hvaḥ samprasāraṇam‌| (6.1.32) `juhāvayiṣati' iti| atrāpi pūrvavadbalīyastvādbṛddhyādeḥ prāk‌ samprasāraṇaṃ bhavati, abhyāsasya `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam‌--hakārasya jhakāraḥ| tasya `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) iti jaśtvam‌--jakāraḥ| athātra kasmāt‌ `sācchāśāhvā' (7.3.37) ityādinā prāgeva samprasāraṇādyugāgamo na bhavati? ityāha--`samprasāraṇasya' ityādi| nanu ca samprasāraṇagrahaṇamanuvarttata eva, tat‌ kimartha punaḥ samprasāraṇamityucyate? ityāha--`samprasāraṇamiti' ityādi| pūrvakaṃ hi samprasāraṇagrahaṇaṃ vibhāṣetyanena sambaddham‌, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt‌| tasmādvibhāṣetyasya nivṛttaye punaḥ samprasāraṇamityuktam‌| atha kasmādyogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, yāvatā `hvaḥ samprasāraṇamabhyastasya ca' ityekayāge'pi juhāvayiṣatītyādi siddhyatyeva, atrāpi hvayatarabhyastasya kāraṇatvena sambandhī bhavtyeva, tathā ca`ekāco dve prathamasya' (6.1.1) iti sa eva dvirucyamānobhyasatasya kāraṇaṃ bhavatyeva? ityāha--`hvaḥ samprasāraṇam‌' ityādi| ekayogenaiva siddhe pṛthagyogakaraṇenāyamartho na jñāpyeta, tadā syādevātra samprasāraṇam‌| bhavati hyatrāpi hvapatirabhyastasya nimittm‌| hvāyakaśabdāṇṇvulantāt‌ kyac‌, `kyati ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam‌, kyajantāt‌ san‌, iṭ‌, `ato lopaḥ (6.4.48) dvirvacanam‌|| 33. abhyastasya ca| (6.1.33) cakāraḥ `hvaḥ' ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ, ata evāha--`hva ityanuvarttate' iti| yadi `hvaḥ' ityetannānuvarttate tato'bhyastamātrasya syāt‌| tatra `hvaḥ' ityanuvarttamānasyābhyastasyetyanena yadi samānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāt‌, tadā dvirvacane kṛte'bhyastasaṃjñāyāmupajātāyāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ syāt‌| evañca `na samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam‌ (6.1.37) ityabhyāsasya samprasāraṇaṃ na syāt‌| yadyapi pareṇa harūpeṇa vyavadhānam‌, tathāpi samānāṅgagrahaṇāt‌ tasya vyavadhāne'pi prāpnotyevātra pratiṣedhaḥ, yathā yūnetyatra--itīmaṃ pakṣe sāmānādhikaraṇye doṣaṃ paśyannāha--`tadabhyastasyetyanena vyadhikaraṇam‌' iti| bhinnābhidheyamityarthaḥ| `abyastasya yo hvayatiḥ' ityādinā sambandhalakṣaṇāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ khyāpayaṃstadeva vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ darśayati| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| `juhāva' iti| samprasāraṇe vṛddhyāvādeśayoḥ sthānivadbhāvena hu ityasya dvirvacanam‌|| 34. bahulaṃ chandasi| (6.1.34) 35. cāyaḥ kī| (6.1.35) `nicikyu' iti| `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ| `nicāyya' iti| lyabantametat‌| dīrghoccāraṇaṃ cikīvānityatra dīrghasya śravaṇārtham‌| idaṃ kvasau rūpam‌|| 36. apaspṛdhethāmānṛcurānṛhuścicyuṣetatyājaśrātāḥ śritamāśīrāśīrttāḥ| (6.1.36) `akāralopaśca' iti| dhātoravayavo yo'kārastasya nipātanāllopaḥ| `apāspaddhaithām‌' iti| apākārasya `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti savarṇadīrghatvam‌| `viṣayavibhāgamicchati' iti| sa ca nipātanasāmarthyālallabhyata iti veditavyam‌| yadikvacidapyekasmin‌ śrābhāvo dṛśyate, tadarthaṃ tarhi yatnāntaramāstheyam‌| na hi śrātā ityanenaitadapi siddhayati; sūtre bahuvacananirdeśāt‌| ata āha--`tasya' ityādi|| 37. na samprasārahaṇe samprasāraṇam‌| (6.1.37) yeṣāṃ samprasāramuktaṃ teṣāṃ yāvanto yaṇaḥ sambhavanti teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ prāptamiti pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate| nanu cālo'ntyaparibhāṣayā (1.1.52) antyasyaiva bhaviṣyati, nānantyasya? naitadasti; na hyanayā paribhāṣayā śakyamihopasthātum‌| vicasvapiyajādīnāmantyasya yaṇo'sambhavāt‌| evaṃ tarhi `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' (vyā.pa.63) ityantyasadeśasya kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati--antyasadeśo yo yaṇ‌ tasyaiva kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati, naitarasya? naiṣāsti paribhāṣā; prayojanābhāvāt‌| yadāha--tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā santi prayojanātīti| tasmāt‌ karttavyametat‌ sūtram‌| nanu ca pūrvaparayorekayogalakṣaṇaṃ samprasārahaṇam‌, tato yadi tat‌ parasyābhinirvṛttaṃ tadā pūrvasyāpyabhinirvṛttameva, na cābhinirvṛttasya nivṛttiḥ śakyate karttum‌, nāpyanabhinirvṛttasya nimittatvenāśrayaṇaṃ yujyate, tato'smādeva pratiṣedhavacanāt‌ tat‌ parasya tāvat‌ kriyate; tatra kṛte tu pūrvasyāpi prāptaṃ pratiṣidhyate| atha samprasāraṇamityanuvarttamāne punaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ kimartham‌? ityāha--`samprasāraṇam‌' ityādi| asati punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇe `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā. pa.19) iti prakṛtasyaiva samprasāraṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, na videśasthasya| tasmādvideśasthasyāpi bhinnaprakāraṇavihitasya pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇam‌| `yūno yūnā' iti| samprasāraṇe kṛte parapūrvatve kṛte ca `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101)| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇe tatra pratiṣedho na syāt‌, savarṇadīrghatvasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāve satyukāravyavahitatvāt‌? ata āha--`samprasāraṇagrahaṇasāmarthyadeva' ityādi| yadi sthānivadbhāvaḥ syāt‌, anarthakaṃ punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| abhyupetya punaḥ parihārāntaramāha--`sati vā' ityādi| samprasāraṇagrahaṇasāmarthyādevātrāśrūyamāṇo'piśāstarāntareṇa sthānivadbhāvamāpanno yo'j‌ vyavadhānaṃ karoti, tanmātreṇa vyavadhānaṃ nāśrayiṣyate--mā bhūt‌ samprasāraṇagrahaṇamanarthakamiti| nanu ca `yūnaśca kutsāyām‌ (4.1.167), `vṛddho yūnā' (1.2.65) iti nipātanādeva yūnaḥ, yūnetyatra samprasāraṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kimetannivṛttyarthena punaḥ samprasāraṇagrahaṇena? naitadasti; abādhakanyapi nipātanāni bhavantītyuktam‌| api caitadviṣayameva nipātanaṃ vijñāyate, tathā ca--yūnaḥ, yūnā yūnītyatra samprasāraṇaṃ syādeveti| `ārevān‌' iti| rayirasyāstīti matup‌| samprasāraṇe kṛte `ādguṇaḥ'; (6.1.87), `chandasīraḥ' (8.2.15) iti vatvam‌|| 38. liṭi vayo yaḥ| (6.1.38) vayerdvau yaṇau, tatra pūrvaṇa vakārasya samprasāraṇapratiṣedhe prāpte yakārasyānena samprasāraṇaṃ liṭi pratiṣiddhyate| tatra pratiṣiddhe yakāraḥ samprasāraṇabhāgna bhavatīti vakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ bhavati dhātorabhyāsasya ca; tatra dhātorgrahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) abhyāsasya `liṭyabyāsasyobhayeṣām‌' (6.1.17) ityanena| atha kimarthaṃ lihgrahaṇam‌, yāvatā vayerādeśasya liṭo'nyatra sambhavo nāsti, tadvidhau `liṭyanyatarasyām‌' (2.4.40) ityato liṅgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ, tatsāmarthyādeva liṭi bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`liṅgrahaṇamuttarārtham‌' iti| `veñaḥ' (6.1.40) iti pratiṣedho liṭi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ liṅgrahaṇam‌|| 39. vaścāsyānyatarasyāṃ kiti| (6.1.39) 40. veñaḥ| (6.1.40) 41. lyapi ca| (6.1.41) 42. jyaśca| (6.1.42) 43.vyaśca| (6.1.43) `yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| uttaratra vyeña eva vibhāṣā samprasāraṇaṃ yathā syāt‌, `jyā' ityasya mā bhūdityevamartho yogavibhāgaḥ|| 44. vibhāṣā pareḥ| (6.1.44) 45. ādeca upadeśe'śiti| (6.1.45) `dhātoriti varttate' iti| `liṭi dhātoranabhyāsasya' (6.1.8) ityata; tasya ca dhātorevaica iti viśeṣaṇam‌, viśeṣamena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--`ejanto yo dhātuḥ' iti| `upadeśe' iti| ādyuccāraṇe gaṇapāṭha ityārthaḥ| `cetā, stotā' iti| nanu ca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayaivātra (vyā.pa.3) na bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kimupadeśagrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhi upadeśagrahaṇamatetajjñāpayati--anityaiṣā paribhāṣeti| etena `arttihrī' (7.3.36) ityādisūtre lākṣaṇikasyāpyākārasya grahaṇe sati krāpayatītyādāvapi puk‌ siddho bhavati| `śa id‌ yasya so'yaṃ śit‌' iti| yaśca `liṭastajhayoreśirec‌' (3.4.81) ityeśādeśaḥ sa śidbhavati, tataśca śiti pratiṣedhe kriyamāṇa eśyapyāttvaṃ na prāpnoti| atrāyādeśe kṛte sthānivadbhāvena `glai' ityasya dvirvacane `jaglāya' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌--iti manyamāna āha--`katham‌' ityādi| `glai ityādau `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| `naivam‌' ityādinā parihāraḥ| śa eva it‌ śiditi vijñāyamāne satyalgrahaṇameva bhavati| tatra `yasmin‌ vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) paribhāṣayā śidādau pratyaye pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌, na caiś‌ śidādiḥ; kiṃ tarhi? śidantaḥ śidantasyaivoccāraṇāt‌| tasmādatraiśi pratiṣedho na bhavati| aśitīti paryudāso vā? prasajyapratiṣedho vā? tatra yadi paryudāsaḥ, tadā śito'nyadāttvanimittamāśritaṃ syāt‌| evañca yāvadāttvasya nimittaṃ na bhavati tāvadātt‌vena bhavitavyamiti; anākārāntatvāt‌| `sugalaḥ' ityādāvākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ kapratyayo na syādityeccetasikṛtvā''ha--`aśati' ityādi| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| prasajyapratiṣedhe hyāttvasya śiti pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, na tu kiñcinnimittmāśrīyata iti tadanaimittikaṃ bhavati| ataḥ prāgeva pratyayotpatterāttvaṃ bhavatītyākārāntalakṣaṇa) pratyayaḥ siddhyati, tena `suglaḥ' ityādi| siddhaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdena suglaḥ, suglā--ityādergrahaṇam‌| tatra hi striyām‌ `ātaścopasarge (3.3.106) ityaṅ|| 46. na vyo liṭi| (6.1.46) `vyeñ saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1007)| athāliṭīti kasmānna jñāyate, tulyā hi saṃhitā? naitadasti; yadi hyevaṃ syāt‌, `liṭi vyaḥ' iti niyama eva kṛtaḥ syāt‌--liṭyevāttvam‌, nānyatreti| lakṣyasthityā ca viparītaniyamo bhaviṣyati| dvivacanabahuvacanayoḥ samprasāraṇe pūrvarūpatva ātt‌ve ca satyasati vā nāsti viśeṣa ityekavacanāntamudāhṛtam‌| `saṃvivyayirthaḥ' iti| thali valādilakṣaṇasyeṭaḥ `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityādinā pratiṣedhaḥ| punarapi krādiniyamārthaḥ prāptaḥ, so'pi `acastāsvat‌ (7.2.61) ityādinā pratiṣiddhaḥ, punaḥ `ṛto bhāradvājasya' (7.2.63) iti niyamādvikalpe prāpte `iḍarttivyayatīnām‌' (7.2.66) iti nityaṃ kriyate|| 47. sphuratisphulatyorghañi| (6.1.47) `visphāraḥ, visphālaḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ‌, `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti karaṇādhikaraṇayorvā|| 48. krīṅjīnāṃ ṇau| (6.1.48) `ḍukrīñ‌ dravyavinimaye' (dhā.pā.1473) `iṅ adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1046) `ji jaye' (dhā.pā.561)| anupadeśārtha ārambhaḥ| krāpayatītyādāvātve kṛte `arttihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk‌| kimarthamidamucyate, na `krapa kutsāyāṃ gatau' (dhā.pā.771), `japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.397,398), `āplu vyāptau (dhā.pā.1260) ityasya cādhipūrvasya ṇici kṛte krāpayatītyādikaṃ rūpaṃ siddham‌, anekārthatvād‌dhātunāṃ kroṇātyādyarthe krapādayo varttiṣyante? ucyate; krīṇātyādīnāṃ ṇici prayogāntaranivṛttyartham‌| atha karoteḥ` īṅ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.1143) ityasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? ucyate; karotestāvanna sambhavati, eca ityadhikārāt‌| ata eva vṛttikṛtā `ecaḥ' ityanuvarttitam‌| vacanasāmarthyādvā tasya hi vṛddhyaivāttvaṃ siddham‌? naitadasti; niyamārthahi syāt‌--āttvameva, na punā raparatvāmiti? naitadasti; `vidhiniyamasambhave vidhireva jyāyān‌' (vyā.pa.130) iti krīṇātereva grahaṇam‌| na karoteḥ, tasya niyamārthatvāt‌| krīṇātestu vidhyarthatvāt‌| `īṅ gatau' (dhā.pā.1143) ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ na sambhavati; jayatinā harasvāntena sāhacaryyāt‌| iṅ‌ hrasvānto grahīṣyate, na dīrghāntaḥ; śabdaparavipratiṣedhāt‌| jayatinā sāhacaryyam‌, na krīṇātinā| vyākhyānato vā viśeṣo'vaseyaḥ.. 49. sidhyaterapāralaukike| (6.1.49) `annaṃ sādhyati' iti| annaṃ niṣpādayatītyarthaḥ| atra hi sidhiḥ pāralaukikerthe jñānaviśeṣe varttata iti| asyārthaṃ--`tāpasaḥ sidhyati' ityādinā spaṣṭīkaroti| `upasaṃhāran‌' iti| niṣpādayannityarthaḥ| `iha kasmānna bhavati' ityādi| evaṃ manyante--brāhmaṇebhyo dāsyāmītyanenābhiprāyeṇa yo'nnaṃ sādhayati sa jamāntare bhavan‌ phalamabhyudayalakṣaṇaṃ prāpnoti, tasmāt‌ pāralaukike'rthe sidhiratra varttata iti paryudāsena bhavitavyamiti| sidhyateratrārtho niṣpattirityādinehalokārthatāṃ tvasya darśayati| `tasyāḥ prayojanamannam‌' iti| annamuddiśya pravṛttatvāt‌| `tasya' iti| annasya| `na punaḥ siddhireveti' iti| artālliṅgavipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā na punaḥ siddhireva pāralaukikīti sambandhanīyam‌| siddhirniṣpattirityarthaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt‌ siddho dhāturvarttate| atra siddhiḥ pāralaukikī na bhavati, tasmānnātrātvaṃ paryudasyate| syādetat‌ yadyapi sākṣād‌dhātuḥ paralokārtho na bhavati, pāramparyeṇa tu bhavatyeva, tasmādbhavitavyameva pratiṣedhena ityāha--`sākṣāt‌' ityādi| yadi sākṣādavyavadhānena paralokārtho yaḥ siddhyaterarthaḥ, tatrāpi pāralaukika itīdaṃ vacanaṃ na kṛtārthaṃ syāt‌, tadā pāramparyeṇāpi yaḥ paralokārthastatra vyāpriyeta--mā bhūdvacanavaiyarthyamiti| idaṃ tu jñānaviśeṣe sākṣāt‌ paralokārthe sidhyatyarthe caritārtham‌, tato notsahata evaṃvidhaviṣayamavagāhitum‌| na śaknotyevamprakāre viṣaye ni,edhaḥ pravarttitumityarthaḥ| atha siddhyateḥ śyanā nirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na sidherityevocyeta, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati? ityāha--`siddhyateḥ' ityādi|| 50. mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca| (6.1.50) `upadeśa' (6.1.45) ityanuvṛtteḥ prāgeva pratyayotpatterāttvena bhavitavyamiti, ata ātvavidhānakāle lyapaḥ paratvaṃ na sambhavatīti tasmāllyapīti viṣayasaptamīyaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`lyapi viṣaye' iti| eca iti yadyapi prakṛtaviśeṣaṇaṃ prāgāsīt‌, tathāpīhopadeśādhikārānmīnātiprabhṛtīnāṃ copadeśāvasthāyāmeco'sambhavāt‌ sāmarthyādviṣayaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`ecaśca viṣaye' iti| `upadeśe' ityasya prāgityādinārthamācaṣṭe| `pramāya' iti| `samāse'nañ‌' (7.1.37) iti lyap‌| kaḥ punarupadeśāvasthāyāmevāttvavidhāne'rthaḥ sampadyate, yadarthamupadeśāvasthāyāmāttvaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`upadeśa eva' ityādi| ivarṇāntalakṣaṇaḥ `erac‌' (3.3.56) ityaca, ākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ `āto yuc‌' (3.3.128) `upadāyaḥ' iti| upadeśa evāttve kṛte satyaco nimittaṃ vihitamityusarga eva `bhāve' (3.3.18) iti ghañ‌ siddho bhavati| `āto yuk‌ ciṣkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk‌| `īṣadupadānam‌' iti| upadeśāvasthāyāmāttve khalapavādo yuc‌ siddho bhavati|| 51. vibhāṣā līyateḥ| (6.1.51) `tayorubhayorapi yakā nirdeśaḥ smaryate' iti| ācāryaiḥ| atha daivādikasyāyaṃ śyanā nirdeśaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? ata eva nirdeśāt‌| yadi daivādika evātra nirdeṣṭumabhīṣṭaḥ syāt‌, anubandhena līṅa iti nirdeśaṃ kuryāt‌| tasmāt‌ sādhāraṇenāgantukena yakāyamubhayornirdeśaḥ| `īṣatpramayaḥ' iti| `īṣad‌duḥsuṣu' (3.3.126) ityādinā khal‌| `nimayo varttate' iti| `erac‌' (3.3.56) ityac‌| `atra tu liyo vyavasthitavibhāṣayā vijñānāt‌ siddham‌' iti| `liyaḥ' ityupalakṣaṇamātram‌, itarayorapi siddha eva; vibhāṣāgrahaṇasya pūrveṇāpi sūtreṇa sambandhāt‌| vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt‌ pralambhanaśālīnīkaraṇayośca ṇau nityamāttvaṃ bhavati| vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānādeva| `ullāpayate, apalāpayate' iti| `liyaḥ sammānanaśālīnīkaraṇayoḥ' (1.3.70) ityātmanepadam‌|| 52. khideśchandasi| (6.1.52) `cikhāda' iti| `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇe kṛta ākāraḥ| yadi khādirapi khiderarthe varttate, tato'yaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'karttum‌; khādestu--cakhādeti bhaviṣyati, khidestu--cikhedeti|| 53. apaguro ṇamuli| (6.1.53) `apagāramapagāram‌' iti| `ābhīkṣṇye dve bhavataḥ' (vā.887) iti dvitvam‌|| 54. cisphurorṇau| (6.1.54) `krīṅjīnāṃ ṇau' (6.1.47) ityatra pradeśa idaṃ noktam‌; nityaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌|| 55. prajane vīyateḥ| (6.1.55) yadi `vā gatigandhanayoḥ (dhā.pā.1050) ityayaṃ dhātuḥ prajane varttate, tataḥ śakyate'pi yogo'vaktum‌; vāterhi--vāpayatīti bhaviṣyati, vīyatestu--vāyayatīti|| 56. bibheterhetubhaye| (6.1.56) `hatubhaye' iti| `pañcamī bhayena' (2.1.37) iti pañcamīsamāso'yamityāha--`tato yadbhayam‌' iti| kiṃ punastato bhayam‌? ityāha--`sa yasya bhayasya' ityādi| athāttvapakṣe ṣugāgamaḥ kasmānna bhavati? asti hyatrāpi prāptiḥ--`ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati' (vyā.pa.16) ityata āha--`sa ca' ityādi| `bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk‌' (7.3.40) ityatra hi bhī-ī i ta īkāreṇa praśliṣṭasya nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ--īkārāntasyaiva ṣug‌ yathā syāt‌, ākārāntasya mā bhūdīti| tathā liyo grahaṇam‌, tasyāpyāttvapakṣe `līlornuklukāvanyatarasyāṃ snehavipātane' (7.3.39) iti nugna bhavati| īkārapraśleṣanirdeśādeveti prasaṅgena vyutpāditam‌|| 57. nityaṃ smayateḥ| (6.1.57) `bhayaśabdena dhātvarthasāmyāt‌' ityādi| yaśca bibhetarartho yaśca smayateḥ, tau dvāpi sadṛśau; cittavikāra svabhāvatayā| dvāvapi tau cittasaṃkṣobhalakṣaṇau, ato dvayorapi yat‌ sāmānyaṃ tat‌ sādṛśyam‌| tasmādbhayaśabdenātra smayaterartho'bhidhīyate| dṛśyate hi sādṛśyādarthāntare'pi śabdānāṃ vṛttiḥ, yathā--siṃho māṇavaka iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha--`na hi' ityādi| `hetubhaye' (6.1.56) ityanuvarttate| ucyate cedaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌| na ca mukhye bhaye smayatervṛttisti| tatra sāmarthyāt‌ kenacit‌ sādṛśyena smayatyartha eva bhayaśabdenātrābhidhīyata iti vijñāyate|| 58. sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti| (6.1.58) `sraṣṭā, draṣṭā' iti| umāgame kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ, vraścādi (8.2.36) sūtreṇa ṣatvam‌| `laghūpadhaguṇāpavādau'yam‌' ityādi| nanu cāsati sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavati, asti ca sambhavo yadubhayaṃ syāditi, tatra guṇe kṛte'māgamo bhaviṣyati? naitadevam‌; sāmānyavihito guṇaḥ viśeṣavihitastvamāgamaḥ, sāmānyavihitasya ca viśeṣavihito bādhako bhavati, yathā--brāhyaṇebhyo dadhidīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇjanyāyeti| yathā sāmānyavihitasya dadhidānasya viśeṣavihitaṃ takradānaṃ bādhakaṃ bhavati tathehāpi yuktā'māgamamena guṇasya bādhā| `asrākṣīt‌, adrākṣīt‌' iti| `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvam‌, `asti sico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ‌, `vadavrajahalantasyācaḥ' (7.2.3) iti vṛddhiḥ, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam‌| `vṛddhiramikṛte bhavati' iti| atha prāgeva vṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`pūrvantu bādhyate' iti| yathaiva hi viśeṣavihitatvādamāgamena sāmānyavihito guṇo bādhyate, tathā vṛddhirapi sāmānyavihitaivāmāgame kṛte paścāt‌ punaḥprasahgavijñānāt‌ siddhamiti sāpi bhavati| guṇastvamāgame kṛte na bhavati; nimittasya vihitatvāt‌| na hyamāgame kṛta upadhā laghvī guṇabhāvinyupapadyate| atheha kasmānna bhavati--rajjusṛṅbhyām‌, devadṛgbhyāmiti; satyapi dhātvadhikāre `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati (vyā.pa.132) iti bhyāmpratyayamakitamāśrityāmāgamaḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`dhātoḥ' ityādi|| 59. anudāttasya cardupadhasyānyatarasyām‌| (6.1.59) `upadeśa iti vartate' iti| anudāttasya viśeṣaṇārtham‌| tena traptetyatra yadyapi tṛni vihite nitsvareṇa dhātorudāttatvam‌, tathāpyupadeśāvasthāyāmanudātta ityamāgamaḥ siddho bhavati; iha ca varḍheti yadyapi tṛci kṛte dhāturanudātto bhavati, tathāpyupadeśāvasthāyānnāyamanudātta ityamāgamo na pravartate; kimarthaṃ punaranudāttasyetyucyate, aniṭa ityeva nocyeta, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tṛpa prīṇane' ityādi| tṛpyatidṛpyatyoḥ `radhādhibhyaśca' (7.2.45) itīṭ‌ vikalpyate, tato yadyaniṭa evocyeta, tadā pākṣikeṇeṭā naitāvaniṭāviti tayoramāgamo na syat‌| atha pākṣikeṇeṅbhāvena tayorniṭtvādamāgamo bhavati, tathā ca sati `vṛhū udyamane (dhā.pā.1347) ityasyāpi syāt‌, ayamapyūdittvāt‌, pākṣikeṅbhāvādaniṅbhavati| tasmānna śakyate'niṭa iti vaktumityabhiprāyaḥ| yadi tarhyanayoriṅvikalpyate, tadānudāttopadeśaḥ kimarthaḥ? sa hyevamarthaḥ kriyate--`anudāttātt‌' (7.2.10) itīṭpratiṣedho yathā syāt‌| yadi tarhyanayoriṅvikalpyate, kiṃ tena? ityata āha--`anudāttopadeśaḥ punaramartha eva' iti| `varḍhā' iti| `hoḥ ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31), `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ', (8.4.41) `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13)| yadāpyudāttopadeśastadeḍatra prāpnoti? ityāha--`udittvāt‌' ityādi| `svaratisūti' (7.2.44) ityādināsyodittvādiṅvikalpyate, tatastena satyudāttatve pakṣa iḍabhāvo na bhavati| cakāro'pamanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tenottaratra tasyānuvṛttirna bhavati|| 60. śīrṣaṃśchandasi| (6.1.60) kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamādeśo neṣyate? ityāha--`so'pi hi' ityādi| yataḥ śiraḥśabdo'pi cchandati prayucyate, tato nāyamādeśaḥ prayujyate| ādeśe hi sati śiraḥśabdasya cchandasi viṣaye prayogo na syāt‌, nivṛttidharmatvāt‌ sthāninaḥ| yadyanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamihānuvarttate tadādeśe'pyadoṣaḥ| `śīrṣā' iti| `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) iti dīrdhaḥ| kvacit‌ śīrṣṇeti paṭhyate, tat‌ tṛtīyāntaṃ draṣṭavyam‌| `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopaḥ| `śīrṣṇaḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntametat‌|| 61. ye ca taddhite| (6.1.61) yadi yakārādāvapi taddhite prakṛtyantaraṃ vijñāyate tato yadi śiraḥśabdādyakārādistaddhita utpadyate, tadā tasya śravaṇamāpadyeta, na ceṣyate ityata āha--`ādeśo'yamiṣyate' iti| svānino'nupādānādihāpyādeśī na yujyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha--`sa katham‌' iti| `taddhita iti hi' ityādi| yasmādiha yakārādistaddhitaḥ paranimittamupā dīyate, na cānupādāya prakṛtiṃ taddhita utpadyate, na ca śīrpañśabda eva prakṛtiryuktā; tasya bhāṣāyāmasambhavāt‌| sa hi cchandasi nipātitaḥ, bhāṣāyāñcedam‌| tasmāt‌ prakṛtyantarādutpanne yakārādau taddhite vidhīyamāne yā tena prakṛtirākṣiptā tasyā ādeśo'yaṃ vijñāyate| ādeśo'pi hi vijñāyamāno na yasya kasyacidvijñāyate, api tu śiraḥśabdasyaiva| yataḥ sa taddhitastadanurūpāṃ tasyādeśasya śabdataścārthataścāntaratamāṃ prakṛti śiraḥśabdamevākṣipati| `śīrṣaṇyaḥ' iti| aṭkupvādinā (8.4.2) ṇatvam‌| `śirasyati' iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8)| `vā keśeṣu' iti| keśeṣvabhidheyeṣu śiraśabdasya śīrṣannityādeśī vā vakvyo vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena śirasaḥ keśeṣu vā śīrṣannādośo bhaviṣyatīti|| 62. aci śīr‌ṣaḥ| (6.1.62) `sthaulaśīrṣam‌' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| kimarthaṃ punarādeśāntaraṃ vidhīyate, na prakṛta eva śīrṣannādeśo vidhīyatām‌? tatrāpi `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilope kṛte sidhyatyeveṣṭamityāha--`śīrṣambhāve' ityādi| `ṣyaṅādeśe' kṛte' ityādi| `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādinā, tasya śīrṣasya śiraḥśabdagrahaṇena grahaṇāditi sthānivadbhāvena śīrṣannādeśaḥ prāpnotīti| `ye ca taddhite' (6.1.61) ityanenaiva| `tatra' ityādi| prakṛtibhāvaprāptistu `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168) ityanena| `hāstiśīrṣaṇyā, hāstiśīrṣyā' iti| `yaṅaścāp‌' (4.1.74) iti cāp‌| tat‌ kathamiti hāstiśīrṣyeti| kathamiṣṭaṃ sidhyatītyarthaḥ| `karttavyo'tra yatnaḥ' iti| sa punaryatnaḥ--śirasyāḥ keśā ityasaya siddhaye ya eva prakṛtaḥ sa eva veditavyaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣayaiva hi śīrṣaśabdasya śiraḥśabdena grahaṇāc‌śīrṣannādeśo na bhaviṣyatīti; tena hāstiśīrṣyetyevaṃ bhavati, na hāstiśīrṣaṇyeti| `aṇiñantādvā' ityādi| `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' (4.1.78) ityatra sūtre dvau pakṣau--aṇiñoḥ sthāna ādeśa ṣyaṅ vidhīyata ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ, aṇiñantāt‌ paraḥ ṣyaṅpratyayo bhavatīti dvitīyaḥ tatrādeśapakṣe'yaṃ doṣaḥ āpatatītyaṇiñantāt‌ paraḥ ṣyaṅāśrayitavya iti pratyayapakṣa āśrāyitavya ityarthaḥ| ādeśapakṣe `yetno vā karttavyaḥ' iti| vikalpārtho vā vāśabdaḥ| atha tatrāpi pratyapakṣa āśrīyamāṇe śīrṣasya śīrṣannādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| yadā pratyayaḥ ṣyaṅ tadā tasmin‌ parato yo'sāviñaḥ `yasyeta ca' (6.4.148) iti lopastasya pūrvavidhau karttavye sthānivadbhāvād‌vyavadhānam‌| ato yakārādeḥ śīrṣannādeśanimittasya taddhitasya vyavadhānādādeśo na prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ|| 63. paddannomāshṛnniśasanyūṣandoṣanyakañchakannudannāsañchasprabhṛtiṣu| (6.1.63) ihāpi śasprabhṛtayo nimittatvenopādīyante, te ca prakṛtyā vinā nopapadyanta iti bhāvaḥ| teṣu prakṛtyantarādvihiteṣu vidhīyamānāḥ padādaya ādeśā vijñāyante| na ca sthānino'nupādānādiyamenādeśaprasaṅgaḥ, yatasteṣvādiśyamāneṣu śasprabhṛtayo'nurūpameva pādādikāṃ svārthikīṃ prakṛtimākṣipantītyāha--`pādadantanāsikā' ityādi| padityādyudāharaṇeṣu pado data iti śasante| `yūṣṇaḥ, doṣṇaḥ, yaknaḥ, śaknaḥ' ti ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntāni| `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopaḥ| `māsi, niśi, āsani' iti saptamyekavacanāntāni| āsanītyatra `vibhāṣāṅiśyoḥ' (6.4.136) iti pakṣe'kāralopo na bhavati| śeṣāṇi tṛtīyaikavacanāntāni| `pādau, nāsike' iti prathamādvivacanānte| kasmāt‌ punaranyatarasyāmityetadanuvarttayanti? ityāha--`tena pādādayo'pi' ityādi| yasmāt‌ pādādayo'pi prayujyante tasmādanyatarasyāmityanuvarttayanti| vyavasthāvācini prabhṛtiśabda āśroyamāṇe śasprabhṛtibhyo'nyatrādeśo na sidhyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha--`prakārārthe prabhṛtiśabdaḥ' iti| `doṣaṇī' iti| kecidāhuḥ--prathamādvivacane doṣannādeśaḥ, auṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ--doṣaṇīti ṅībantametat‌, ṅīpi viṣayabhūte doṣannādeśaḥ, tataḥ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' (4.1.5)| `nasyam‌' iti| hitārthe `śarīrāvayavādyat‌' (5.1.6)| `nastaḥ' iti| `apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' (5.4.45) tasiḥ| `naḥkṣudraḥ' iti| nāsikā kṣudrā yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `nāsikyo varṇaḥ' iti| bhavārthe `śarīrāvayavāt‌' (5.1.6) iti yat‌| nāsikyaṃ nagaramiti atra hitārthe yat‌|| 64. dhātvādeḥ paḥ saḥ| (6.1.64) `siñciti' iti| `śe mucādīnām‌' (7.1.59) iti num‌| `ṣoḍaśa' iti| ṣaṭ‌ vā daśa vāsyeti `saṃkhyāyāvyaya' (2.2.25) ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ, `saṃkhyeye ṅac‌' (5.4.73) ityādinā samāsānto ṅac‌| `ṣoḍan‌' iti| ṣaṭ‌ dantā asyeti bahavrīhiḥ, `vayasi dantasya datṛ' (5.4.141) iti dantaśabdasya datrādeśaḥ| `ṣaṣa uttvaṃ datṛdaśadhāsūttarapadādeḥ ṣṭutvaṃ ca' (vā.765) iti ṣaṣa utvam‌, uttarapadādeśca ṣṭutvam‌--ḍakāraḥ| `ṣaṇḍaḥ' iti| prātipadikāntametadavyutpannam‌| `ṣaḍikaḥ iti| anukampitaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulidatta iti `bahvaco manuṣyanāmnaṣṭhac‌' (5.3.78) iti ṭhac‌ ṭhājādāvūrdhvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ' (5.3.83) ityaṅgulidattaśabdasya lopaḥ| nanu ca `liṭi dhātoḥ' (6.1.8) ityato'tra dhātugrahaṇamanuvarttiṣyate, tadiha kiṃ punardhātugrahaṇena? evaṃ tarahhi etajjñāpayati--tannivṛttamiti| tasya hyanuvṛttau `lopo vyorvali (6.1.66) ityayamapi lopo dhātvavayavasyaiva vijñāyate| knūyī (dhā.pā485), ktaḥ--knūtaḥ kṣmayī (dhā.pā.486), ktaḥ--kṣmāta ityatraiva syāt‌; gaudharaḥ, pacerannityatra na syāt‌| nanvevamapi dhātugrahaṇamanarthakameva, yasmādupadeśa iti varttata eva, na ca prātipadikānāmupadeśaḥ, keṣāṃ tarhi upadeśaḥ? dhātūnām‌? naitadasti; upadeśādhikāro'yupadeśagrahaṇena ṣakāro viśiṣyate, ṣaṣaśca ṣakāra upadeśo bhavati| `ṣaṣa uttvaṃ datṛdaśadhāsūttarapadādeḥ (vā.765) iti sūtre pāṭhāt‌| tasmāt‌ dhātugrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| `kaṣati' iti| bhvādau kaṣasidhetyādihisārtho dhātuvarge paṭhyate| `laṣati' iti| `laṣa kānto'(dhā.pā.888) anayorādigārahaṇasya bhavati| nanu copadeśasāmarthyādevātra na bhaviṣyatīti, anyathā hyupadeśasya vaiyarthya syāt‌? naitasti; asti hyanyatūpadeśasya prayojanam‌| kiṃ tat‌?--`śeṣe vibhāṣā'kakhādāvavānta upedeśe' (8.4.17) ityatra keṣergrahaṇaṃ mā bhūta; leṣatuḥ, leṣuriti ṣatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| kimarthaṃ punaḥ ṣādayo upadṣṭāḥ, na sādayo hyupadiśyeran‌, evaṃ hyetat‌ sūtraṃ na karttavayaṃ bhavati? ityata āha--`ādeśapratyayoḥ' ityādi| ṣatvavyavasthāṃ-ṣatvaniyamaḥ| `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) ityanena sahādīnāmeva ṣatvavyavasthā yathā sthādityevamartham‌| ṣādapaḥ kecidupadiṣṭāḥ anyathā sahādīnāṃ ṣatvārtha yatnāntaraṃ karttavyaṃ syāt‌| tacca guru bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| yadyapi ṣakārādiṣu sandeho na bhavati, sakārādiṣu ca bhavatyeva| atra hi na jñāyate--kiṃ ṣopadeśā eva santaḥ `dhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ' (6.1.64) ityanena kṛtasatvā uccāritāḥ? uta sakārādaya eva? iti sandihya pṛcchati--`ke punaste' iti| `ye yathā paṭhyante' iti| ṣādayo ye yathā paṭhyante sannidhānāt‌ ta eva ṣopadeśā avagantavyāḥ| `ajdantyaparāḥ' ityādi| ajdantyau parau yeṣāmiti te'bdantyaparāḥ| paraśabdo'trāvayave varttate| taccācdantyayoḥ paratvamavayavāntarāpekṣaṃ vijñāyamānaṃ sannidhānāt‌ sakārāpekṣaṃ vijñāyate| `smisvidisvañjisvapayaśca' iti| `ṣmiṅīṣaddhamane' (dhā.pā.948), `ñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1188), `ṣvanja pariṣvaṅge' (dhā.pā.976) `ñiṣvap‌ śaye' (dhā.pā.1068) ete svarūpeṇākhyāyante; makāravakārayorajdantyatvābhāvāt‌| kecit smisvadisvadisvañjisvapayaśceti svidisthāne svadiṃ paṭhanti, teṣāṃ `teṣāṃ svada [`ṣvada'--dhātupāṭhaḥ ] svarda āsvādane' (dhā.pā.18,19) iti svadirapi ṣopadeśa eva| `sṛpisṛjistṛstyāsekṛsṛvarjam‌' iti| `gamlu suplṛ gatau (dhā.pā.982,983), `sṛja visarge (dhā.pā.1178), `stṛñ‌ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1252), `ṣṭya styai śabdasaṅghātayoḥ', (dhā.pā.911,910) `seka [sekṛ, sreka--dhā.pā.] sekṛ śraki ślaki gatyarthāḥ' (dhā.pā.81,82,84,85), `sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.935) etān‌ varjayitvā ye'nye'jdantatyaparāste ṣopadeśāḥ| `subdhātu' ityādi| subdhātuḥ kyajādyantaḥ| `ṣṭhic‌ nirasane' (dhā.pā.560), `ṣvakka [atratyāḥdhātavaḥ kecana dhātupāṭhe na santi] vukka makkatikka ṭikka ṭīkka vagi lagi gatyarthāḥ--eṣāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyo vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--subdhātautāvat‌ ṣoḍīyatītyādau naiva dhātvādiḥ ṣakāraḥ, tathā hyādiravayavaḥ| ārambhakaścāvayavo bhavati, subdātuḥ sabantena kyacā cārabhyate| na ca ṣakāreṇāpi varṇāntareṇeti kutastasya ṣakārāditvam‌? sahādayastu ṣakārādibhireva varṇerārabhyanta iti yuktaṃ teṣāṃ ṣakārāditvam‌| ṣṭhiverapi nipātanānna bhavati, kiṃ tannipātanam‌? `ṣṭivuklamucamāṃ śiti' (7.3.75) iti| yasya hi satvaṃ bhavati tamayaṃ pradeśeṣu kṛtasatbamevoccārayati yathā pradeśe--`sthādhvoricca' (1.2.17) iti| ṣvakkerapyajdantyaparā ityanena nivarttitatvānna bhavati| vakārasya dantyauṣṭhyatvādajdantyagrahaṇena na gṛhyate| atha vā yādityāt‌ ṣṭhivuṣvakkorna bhaviṣyati, yakārastu luptanirdiṣṭatvānna śrūyate| atha vā--anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamatrānuvarttate sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate, tena subdhātvādīnāṃ na bhavatīti| `ṣaṣṭhīvati' iti| `ṣṭhivuklamucamāṃ śiti' (7.3.75) iti dīrghaḥ| `ṣvakkate' iti| anudāttettvādātmanepadam‌| atha ṣṭhivo dvitīyavarṇaḥ kiṃ ṭhakāra iṣyate? uta thakāraḥ? yadi ṭhakārastadā siddham‌--ṭeṣṭhīṣyata iti, na sidhyati--teṣṭhīvyata iti, `abhyāse carcca' (8.4.54) iti ṭakāra evāntaratamaṣṭhakārasya sthāne prāpnotīti kṛtvā; atha thakārastadā siddham‌--teṣṭhīvyata iti, etanna sidhyati--ṭeṣṭhīvyata iti, āntaratamyādvidhīyamānasthakārasya sthāne takāra eva prāpnotītyata āha--`ṣṭhivu ityetasya' ityādi| byāsasya dvairūpyaṃ yathā syāditi| kecidācāryema śiṣyā `ṭhakāro'yam‌' ityupadiṣṭāḥ| apare punaḥ `thakāro'yaṃ ṣṭutvena ṭhakāraḥ śrūyate' itīmamarthaṃ grāhitāḥ| ubhayaṃ caitat‌ prayojanam‌| anye punarahuḥ--ṣṭhivurdivādiṣvapi punaradhīyate, tatraikasya dvitoyasthākāraḥ, aparasya tu ṭhakāra iti| teṣṭhīvyata iti `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' (7.4.61) śeṣaḥ|| 65. ṇo naḥ| (6.1.65) `subdhātorayamapi neṣyate' iti| pūrvasmadeva hetoḥ| `upasargādasamāse'pi' ityādi| atra pūrvānusāreṇa pūrvapakṣo vijñeyaḥ| `nṛtīnandi' ityādi| `nṛtī gātravikṣeepe' (dhā.pā.1116), `ṭunadi samṛddhau' (dhā.pā.67), `narda gardda śabde' (dhā.pā.56,57), `nakka vakka [`dhakka'--ghātupāṭhaḥ] nāśane' (dhā.pā.1593,1594), `naṭa avasyandane' [avaspandane--ghātupāṭhaḥ] (dhācapā.1545) curādiṇijantaḥ, `nāthṛ nādhṛ yāñcopatāpaiśvaryāśīḥṣu' (dhā.pā.6.7), `nṛ naye' (dhā.pā.809,1495)|| 66. lopo vyorvali| (6.1.66) `liṭi dhātoḥ' (6.1.8) ityasya dhātugrahaṇasya dṛṣṭānuvṛttisāmarthyādihāpyanuvṛttiriti manyamānasya dhātorevāyaṃ vali vyalopo vidhīyata iti kasyācidbhrāntiḥ syāt, atastaṃ nirakarttumāha--`dhātoriti yat‌ prakṛtam‌' ityādi| `didivān‌' iti| diveḥ kvasau rūpam‌| `ūyī' iti| `ūyī tantusantāne (dhā.pā.483) `knūyo' iti| `knūyī śabde' (dhā.pā.485) `gauderaḥ' iti| `godhāyā ḍhrak‌' (4.1.129) ḍhasyaiyādeśaḥ, yakāralopaḥ| `paceran‌' iti| sīyuḍyakārasya lopaḥ| `jīveḥ' iti| `jīva prāṇadhāraṇe' (dhā.pā.562) ityasya| `sriveḥ' iti| `srivu gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1109) ityetasya| `āsremāṇam‌' iti| auṇādiko'yaṃ manin‌| kathaṃ punaretadihodāharaṇam‌, yāvatā paratvāt‌ `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyo bhavati' (vyā.pa.39) iti balīyastvāt‌ `cchavoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityādinoṭhādeśenātra bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`uṇādayo bahulam‌' ityādi| bahulagrahaṇasya sarvavidhivyabhicārārthatvānna bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅga iti| paścāllopagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe pakārāt‌ pareṇādhyardhamātroccārayitavyā bhavati, akagāro hi mātrā, visajaṃ nīyastvardhamātraḥ| pūrvaṃ tu lopagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe mātrādvayamuccārayitavyaṃ jāyate; okārasya dvimātrikatvāt‌| tatra lāghavārthaṃ paścādeva lopagrahaṇaṃ karttu yuktam‌, tat‌ kiṃ pūrvaṃ kriyate? ityata āha--`pūrvam‌' ityādi| anyastu pūrva kāryinirdeśo yuktaḥ, paścāt‌ karyanirdeśa iti pūrva vyorgrahaṇe karttavye kimartha lopagrahaṇaṃ kriyata iti pūrvapakṣaṃ varṇayati, sa cāyuktaḥ `lugaṇiñoḥ' (2.4.58) ityatra kāryasyāpi pūrva nidaśāt‌| `verapṛktalopāt‌' ityādi| kaṇḍūyaterlolūyateśca kvipi kṛte vali lopāt‌ paratvāt‌ kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena nityatvācca pūrvaṃ verapṛktalopa eva syāt‌| asmiṃśca sati nimittābhāvāt‌ varṇāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇābhādvavali lopo na syāt‌ tasmāt‌ pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇaṃ kriyate--vali lopa eva pūrvaṃ yathā syāt‌| pūrvaṃ lopagrahaṇe hyayamarthaḥ sūcyate--verṛktalopat‌ pūrva vali lopa eva karttavyamiti| `kaṇḍūḥ' iti| `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ| kvilugupadhātvacaṅgaparanihrasikutveṣu na sthānivat‌' (1.1.58 vā.2) ityakārasya sthānivadbhāvo na bhavati vali lopaḥ| atha vraścakaḥ, vraścana ityatra rephe vali parato vakagāralopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`vraścādīnām‌' ityādi| yadyeṣāmapi lopaḥ syāt‌, vakāroccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| ataścoccāraṇasāmarthyādvraścādīnāṃ vali lopo na bhavati| syādetat‌--vṛścati, vavraścetyatra samprasāraṇe halādiśeṣe ca vakārasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌, tat‌ kuta upadeśasya vaiyarthyam‌? ata āha--`vṛścati' ityādi| yathā vraścaka ityādau lopasya prāptiḥ, evaṃ vṛścatītyādāvapi samprasāraṇādau kārye kṛte'pi; tasya bahiraṅgatvenāsiddhatvāt‌| tatra samprasāraṇaṃ ṅitpratyayāpekṣatvāt‌ bahiraṅgam‌| halādiśeṣe'bhyāsāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgaḥ, vali yalopastu varṇamātrāśrayatvādantaraṅgaḥ| tasmāt‌ sarvatraiva vraś‌cervakāralopaḥ prāpnoti| kriyate cāsyo padeśaḥ, ata upadeśasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti tadevāvasthitam‌|| 67. verapṛktasya| (6.1.67) `veḥ' ityādi| kvibāderanyasya verapṛktasaṃjñakasayābhāvāt‌ kvibādaya eva gṛhyante, kathaṃ punarverityucyamāne kvibādīnāṃ sāmānyena grahaṇamupapadyate, yāvatā prakārādayasyeṣāṃ viśeṣā anubandhāḥ santi? iti codyanirāsāye damuktam‌--`viśeṣānanubandhānutsṛjya' iti| `brahyahā, bhrūṇahā' iti| `sau ca' (6.4.13) iti dīrghaḥ `ghṛtaspṛk‌' iti| `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvam‌| `ardhabhāk‌' iti| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌| darvirityādau `uṇādayo bahulam‌' (3.3.1) iti bahulagrahaṇādeva lopo na bhavatīti śakyate vaktum‌, ataḥ prapañcārtham‌| vaicitryārthaṃ vā'pṛktagrahaṇam‌|| 68. halṅyābbhyo dīrghātsutisyapṛkta hal‌| (6.1.68) yadi lopa iti ihānuvarttamānaṃ śāstrīyeṇārthenaivārthavat‌ syāt tadā tena halityasya prathamāntasya sāmānādhikaraṇyena sambandho nopapadyate| śāstrīyasya hi lopaśabdasyārthaḥ--darśanābhāvaḥ-ādarśanam‌, na ca haladarśanaṃ bhavati| na ca `halṅyābbhyaḥ' iti pañcamī haliti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati| sāmarthyādvā halityasya ṣaṣṭhyantatayā vipariṇāmo bhaviṣyati, ataḥ ṣaṣṭhyantasya lopaśabdena sambandho bhavaṣyatīti śakyaṃ prakalpayitum‌; akṛtārthatvāt‌ prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhībhāvasyānupapatterityetadālocyāha--`tadiha' ityādi| `lupyata iti lopaḥ'| karmaṇi ghañ‌| etena laukikārthenārthavattvaṃ lopaśabdasya darśayati| lupyata iti nirudhyata ityarthaḥ| laukikenārthenārthavatā karmasādhanena lopaśabdena halityetasya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabāva upapadyate| lopaśabdena hi lupyamānaṃ varṇamātramucyate| ` sutisyapṛktaṃ hal‌' iti| anena ca tadeva viśiṣyate| `dīrghāt‌' iti| etacca ṅyāporeva viśeṣaṇam‌; sambhavāvyabhicārāt‌, na tu halantasya; asambhavāt‌| `ukhāsrat‌; parṇadhvat‌ iti| `sransu dhvansu adhaḥpatane;, (dhā.pā.754,755) ukhāyāṃ sraṃsate parṇāni dhvaṃsata iti kvip‌ `aniditām‌' (8.4.56) cartvam‌--takāraḥ| `kumārī' ti| `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti ṅīṣ‌| `gaurī' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ‌| `śārṅgaravī' iti| `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn‌' (4.1.13) iti ḍāp‌| `kārīṣagandhyā iti| `yaṅścāp‌' (4.1.74)| `halantādeva tilopaḥ silopaśca' iti| nanu ṅyābantādityekāreṇa darśayati, na hi ṅyābantāt‌ parau tisī sambhavataḥ, dhātoreva parasya lakārasya tayorvidhānāt‌| `abibharbhavān‌' iti| guṇe raparatve ca kṛte tilopaḥ| `ajāgarbhavān‌' iti| `jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu' (7.3.85) iti guṇaḥ| bhavānityanuprayogastiśabdābhivyaktaye| `abhinaḥ' iti| bhiderlaṅ `daśca' (8.2.75) iti rutvam‌, `ato roraplutādaplute' (6.1.113) ityuttvam‌, inamo'kāreṇa saha `ād‌ guṇaḥ, (6.1.87) `eṅaḥ padāntādati' (6.1.109) iti pūrvarūpatvam‌| `grāmaṇīḥ' iti| grāmaṃ nayatīti `satsūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip‌| `niṣkauśāmbiḥ' iti nirgataḥ kauśāmbyā iti prādisamāsaḥ, `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvatvam‌| `atikhaṭavaḥ' iti| khaṭvāmatikrānta iti pūrvavat‌ samāse kṛte hrasvaḥ| `abhaitsīt‌' iti| `vadavraja' (7.2.3) iti vṛddhiḥ, apṛkta iṭ‌| nanu sīti sāmānyena nidaśāt‌ sico'pi garahaṇam‌, ato na yuktamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇam‌? ata āha--`tisahacaritasya' ityādi| tiṅ‌tiśabdena sāhacaryāt‌ tiṅ eva sergrahaṇam‌, na sica iti kimatrāyuktam‌| `bibheda' iti| ṇalo'kāro'tra bhavatyapṛkataḥ, na tu hal‌ iti nāsau lupyate| `saṃyogāntalopenaiva siddham‌' iti| rājetyādikamudāharaṇamiti śeṣaḥ| kathaṃ punarna sidhyati? ityata āha--`rājā, takṣā' ityādi| yathā pacannityatra saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvānnalopo na bhavati; tathā rājā, takṣetyādāvapi na syāt‌| saṃyogāntalopāsiddhatvaṃ cātra pāramparyeṇa hetuḥ| tasmin‌ sati hi sau parataḥ pūrvasya padasaṃjñā na bhavati; `asarvanāmasthāne' (1.4.17) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| tasyāṃ cāsatyāṃ padasyetyucyamāno nalopo na syāt‌, nalope cāsati rājetyādikaṃ rūpaṃ na sidhyet‌| `datvam‌' iti| na syāditi prakṛtena sambandhanīyam‌| datvamapi hi saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvādasatyāṃ padasaṃjñāyāṃ na syāt‌| atha vā--saṃyogāntalopo'tra na pravarttata eva, tasya `skoḥsaṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti saṃyogādilopo'pavādabhūta iti sa eva syāt‌, yathā--kāṣṭhaṃ takṣṇotīti kāṣṭhataṅityatra| tasmiṃśca sati vibhaktisakārasya rutvavisargau syātāmiti kuto dattvam‌! `uttvam‌' iti| na syādityapekṣate, etadapi saṃyogāntalopasyāsiddhatvāt‌| alabdhapadavyapadeśasya na syāt‌| `rātsasya' (8.2.24) iti `niyamāt‌' iti| `saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' (8.2.23) ityanenaiva siddheḥ| `rātsasya' (8.2.24) iti `niyamāt‌' iti| `saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' (8.2.23) ityanenaiva siddheḥ| `rātsasya' (8.2.24) iti niyamārthamidam‌--rātsasyaiva lopo yathā syāt‌, nānyasyeti| tataścābibharbhavānityatra takārasya lopa eva na syāt‌| tasmāt‌ saṃyogāntalopena na sidhyatīti halantāllopa ucyate|
