asyaivārthasya sukhopagrahaṇārthaṃ `saṃyogāntasyalope hi' ityādi| saṅgrahaślokasyopanyāsaḥ| hiśabdo hetau| yasmāt‌ saṃyogāntalopa āśrīyamāṇe nalopādikaṃ kāryaṃ na sidhyatīti| kiñca--te-tava, bhavataḥ saṃyogāntalopavādinaḥ rāttu rephāttu parasya takārasyābibharbhavānajagarbhavānityatra naiva lopaḥ syāt‌| tasmādvalantāt‌ sutisīnāṃ lopo vidhīyate|| 69. eṅhasvātsambuddheḥ| (6.1.69) `haliti ca' iti| varttata ityapekṣate| yadi haliti nānuvartteta, tadā he kuṇḍa-su iti sthite lopāt‌ paratvādambhāve kṛte `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityakāralope `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghatve ca he kuṇḍamityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `apṛktamiti nādhikriyate' iti| yadi hyapṛktamihānuvarteta, tarhi he kuṇḍetyatra lopo na syāt‌; apṛktasaṃjñāyā abhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--apukta iha nānuvarttate? ityāha--`tathā ca' ityādi| tathā ceti hitau| yasmāt pūrvasūtre'pṛktagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamato'vasīyate--nātra prakaraṇe'pṛktagrahaṇasyānuvṛttirastauti; anyathā hi `verapṛktasya' (6.1.67) ityata evāpṛktagrahaṇamanuvarttiṣyata iti punarapṛktagrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre na kriyeteti| `sa cet‌ sambuddherbhavati' iti| yadi sambuddheḥ sambaddho bhavatītyarthaḥ| etena sambuddherityasyāvayavaṣaṣṭhyantatāṃ darśayati| `he agne, he vāyo' iti| `hrasvasya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108)| `he nadi, he vadhu' iti| `ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ' (7.3.107) iti hrasvatvam‌| `halmātrasya makārasya lopaḥ' iti| halityanuvṛtteḥ| he kataradityatraikādeśe kṛte hrasvāt‌ sambuddherhal‌ bhavatīti tasya lopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`he katarat‌' ityādi| `adḍḍatarādibhyaḥ' (7.1.25) ityatra dviḍakāranirdeśāt‌ ḍicchabda ādeśo bhavatīti ḍitvāṭ‌ ṭilope hrasavo nāstīti na bhavati lopaḥ| athaiṅgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā he agne ityādāvapi prāgeva sambud‌dhiguṇād‌ hrasvādityevaṃ lope na bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`eṅgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| nityatvāt‌ paratvācca sambuddhigumo balīyāniti tanaiva tāvat‌ bhavitavyam‌, tatra kṛte hrasvāt‌ paraḥ sambuddherhal‌ na sambhavatīti lopo na prāpnoti, ata eṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| nanu ca vihitaviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāsyate--hrasvādvihitāyāḥ sambuddheriti? naitadasti; ekā hīyaṃ pañcamī, tatra yadi hrasvādvihiti viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate tadaiṅantādapi vijñāyeta| tathā ca --he gaurityatrāpi syāt‌| tasmādeṅgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 70. śeśchandasi bahulam‌| (6.1.70) `jas‌śasoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20) iti yaḥ śirādeśastasyāyaṃ lopo vidhīyate| `yā kṣetrā, yā vanā' iti| śerlope kṛte pratyalakṣaṇena `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) iti num‌, `sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ, `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya (8.2.7) iti nalopaḥ| veti karttavye bahulagrahaṇaṃ sarvavidhivyabhicārārtham‌| `tena sarve vidhayaśchandasi viklpyante' (pu.pa.vṛ.56), ityupapannaṃ bhavati|| 71. hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk‌| (6.1.71) kṛtātra pratyayena dhāturupasthāpyate, hrasvena ca sa eva viśeṣyate, ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyato hrasvānto dhāturāgamī vijñāyata ityāha--`hrasvāntasya dhātoḥ' ityādi| `agnicit‌' iti| `agnau ceḥ' (3.2.91) iti kvip‌| `somasut‌' iti| `some suñaḥ' (3.2.90) ityubhayatropapadasamāsaḥ| `prakṛtya'ityādau prādisamāsaḥ| `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap‌' (7.1.37) iti lyap‌| atha grāmaṃ nayatīti--grāmaṇi brāhamaṇakulamityatra napuṃsakahrasvatve kṛte hrasvāśrayastuk‌ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`grāmaṇi brāhmaṇakulam‌' ityādi| hrasvatvaṃ hi napuṃsakārthavṛttiprātipadikamapekṣata iti bahiraṅgam‌, antaraṅgastu tuk‌; varṇamātrāpekṣatāvt‌| `āsiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge (vyā.pa.42) iti tugnātra bhavati|| 72. saṃhitāyām‌| (6.1.72) `saṃhitāyām‌' iti viṣayasaptamīyam‌| tena yadi kāryinimittayoḥ saṃhitā viṣayabhūtā bhavati, tarhyevaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati; nānyartheti veditavyam‌| 73. che ca| (6.1.73) `che' iti yadyapyakāravataśchakārādeṣā saptamī tathāpi cchakāra eva kevalastuko nimittam‌, akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ| etacca `ijādeśca gurumato'nṛcchaḥ' (3.1.36) ityāmpratiṣedhādavasīyate| yadi hyakārasahitaśchakārastuko nimittaṃ syāt‌, tadā ṛcchestugabhāvādasati gurumatvaṃ āmaḥ prasaṅgo nāstīti pratiṣedhaṃ na kuryāt‌| `icchati' iti| `iṣugamiyamāṃ chaḥ' (7.3.77) tuk‌ cutvam‌| pūrvasmiṃstugvidhau hrasvānta āgamī, ataḥ sa evātrāgamīti kasya cid‌ bhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`hrasva eva' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--hrasvānukarṣaṇārthaścakāro'tra kriyate--hrasava evāgamī yathā syāt‌, tadanto mā bhūdityevamartham‌'; anyathā svaritatvādanantarattvācca pūrvasūtre ya āgamī, sa evehāpi vijñāsyata ityanarthakaścakāraḥ syāt‌, hrasva evāgamini sati kimiṣṭaṃ sidhyati, yatastadarto'yaṃ yatnaḥ kriyate? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| yadi hrasvāntasya tuk‌ syāt‌ tadā cicchidaturityādau tasyābhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttiḥ syāt‌| hrasve tvāgamini nāyamabhyāsasya haliti na bhavatyeva doṣaḥ| kathaṃ punarhrasva āgamini tugabyāsagrahaṇena gṛhyate? ityāha--`nāvayavāvayavaḥ' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādavayavasya yo'vayavaḥ sa samudāyasyāvayavo na bhavati| tasmāt‌ hrasva evāgamini tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇena na grahaṇaṃ bhavati| nāvayavāvayavaḥ samudāyasyāvayavo bhavatītyatra caitat‌ sūtravihitastugityābhiprāyo veditavyaḥ| yadi hyaviśeṣeṇāvayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo na syāt‌, evaṃ sati `śerate' ityatra ruṅāgamaḥ sāvaidhātukasyāvyavasya jhādeśasyāto'vaya iti so'pi samudāyasya sārvadhātukasyāvayavo na syāt‌| tataḥ `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ' (7.4.21) iti guṇo na syāt‌; ruṭā sārvadhātukasya vyavahitatvāt‌ sa hyavayava uktastameva vyavadadhyāt‌, sa samudāyaṃ tu na vyavadadhātyeva| tasmāt‌ pūrvokta evābhiprāyo vṛttikārasya veditavyaḥ| kasmāt‌ punaretat‌ satravihito'vayavāvayavaḥ samudāyasyāvayavo na bhavati? hrasvānukarṣaṇārthacakārakaraṇa sāmarthyāt‌| sa hi cakāro hrasvānukarṣaṇārtha evamarthaḥ kriyate--hrasvamātra āgamini tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇenāgrahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttirmā bhūditi| yadi caitatsūtravihito'pyavayavāyavaḥ samudāyāvayavaḥ syāt‌, tadā hrasve'pyāgamini tukastu tadavayavayasyāpyabhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttyā bhavitavyamiti cakāro hrasvānukarṣaṇārtho niṣphalaḥ syāt‌| tasmādayameva tugavayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo na bhavati, anyastu bhavatyeva| yuktaṃ caitat‌| tathā hi bāhoryo'vayavo hastaḥ sa devadattasyāpyavayavo bhavatyeva, anyathā hastāvan‌ devadatta iti prayogo na syāt‌| 74. āṅmāṅośca| (6.1.74) atrākāro ṅidupāttaḥ sa ceṣadādāvarte varttata ityāha--`āṅ‌' [`aṅaḥ' kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] ityādi| māśabdo'pi ṅidupāttaḥ, so'pi niṣedhe vartata ityāha--`māṅaśca pratiṣedhavacanasya' iti| `ācchādayati' ityādi| `chada apavāraṇe' (dhā.pa.1935) caurādikaḥ| atra `chādanakriyāṅā viśiṣyata iti sa kriyāyoge varttate| `ācchāyāyāḥ' iti| maryādāyāmaṅ‌| chāyām‌-maryādāṃ parivṛttyetyarthaḥ. `āṅ maryādāvacane (1.4.89) ityāṅaśca karmapravacanīyasaṃjñakasya yoge `pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' (2.3.10) iti pañcamī| `ācchāyam‌' iti| chāyāmabhivyāpyetyarthaḥ| `āṅmaryādābhivivyoḥ' (2.1.13) iti pañcamyantenāvyayībhāvaḥ, `nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ' (2.4.83) iti vibhakterlugambhāvaśca| `mā cchidat‌ iti| irittvāccaleraṅ‌| `āchāyā, ācchāyā' iti| atrākāraḥ smaraṇae varttate, tatra cāsya ṅittvaṃ nāsti; `vākyasmaraṇayoraṅit‌' iti vacanāt‌| tenātra `padāntādvā' (6.1.76) iti vikalpo bhavati| `pramāchandaḥ' iti| `māṅ‌ māne' (dhā.pā.1142) prapūrvaḥ `ātaścopasarge' (3.3.106) ityaṅ‌, striyām‌ `ajādyataṣṭāp‌' (4.1.4)| nanu ca lākṣaṇikatvādevātra na bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; `gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) iti vacanāt‌|| 75. dīrghāt‌| (6.1.75) `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān‌' (śākaṭāyana.pa.97) dīrghāditi pañcamyāśche ityasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prakalpitāyām‌ `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti cchakārasyaiva tuk‌ prāpnotīti kasyācidbhrāntiḥ syatt, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`dīrgāt‌ paro yaśchakāraḥ tasmin‌ parataḥ pūrvasya' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--`tasmādityattarasya' (1.1.67) ityatra tasmāditi yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, `pūrvasya' iti pūrvasūtrādanuvarttate, tena dīrghādityādau satyapi pañcamīnirdeśe pūrvasyaiva kāryaṃ bhavati, nottarasya| na cātiprasaṅgaḥ yogavibhāgādiṣṭasiddheriti| `hrīcchati' iti| `hrīccha lajjāyām‌' (dhā.pā.210)| `mlecchati' iti| `mleccha avyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.1662)| `apacācchāyate' iti| `cho chedane' (dhā.pā.1146), `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityātvam‌, yaṅ‌ `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityābhyāsasya dīrghaḥ|| 76. padāntādvā| (6.1.76) `kuṭīchāyā' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, asamāso vā| `diśvajanādīnām‌' ityādi| `viśvajana' ityevamādīnāṃ chandasi viṣaye vikalpena tugbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`sarve vidhayaścandasi vikalpyante' (pu.pa.vṛ.56) iti prāk‌ pratipāditametat‌| tena viśvajanādīnāṃ chandasi vā tugbhavatīti|| 77. iko yaṇaci| (6.1.77) `iko yaṇādeśo bhavati' iti| ikāṃ yaṇāṃ ca sāmyāt‌ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavatīti veditavyam‌| yaśca savarṇo'c‌ tatra dīrghavidhānasāmarthyāt‌ asavarṇe'ci yaṇādeśo vijñāyata iti| ika iti kim‌? vāgatretyatra kutvādeva siddhatvādyaṇādeśo mā bhūditi| acīti kim‌? dadhi karoti| `plutapūrvasya' iti| plutaḥ pūrvo yasmāt‌ sa plutapūrvaḥ| vaktavyaḥ-vyākhyeyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`iko yaṇaci' ityatra tantreṇa dvau yogāvṛccāritau; tatraiko yaṇādeśārthaḥ, aparastvikaḥ plutapūrvasya savarṇadīrghabādhanārtho bhaviṣyatīti| bho yidam‌--bho-i-idamiti sthite `guroranṛto'nantasyāpyekaikasya prācām‌' (8.2.86) ityanena dūrāddhūte'rthe bhośabdasya plutaḥ kṛtaḥ, tataḥ savarṇadīrghatve prāpte yaṇādeśaḥ|| 78. eco'yavāyāvaḥ| (6.1.78) `kayete, yayete' iti| ke-ete, ye-eta iti sthite'yādeśaḥ. `vāyāvavaruṇaddhi' iti| vāyau-avaruṇaddhīti sthita āvādeśaḥ|| 79. vānto yi pratyaye| (6.1.79) yīti darṇagrahaṇam‌, tena `yasmin‌ vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) iti yakārādau pratyaye kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha--`yakārādau pratyaye' iti| yadyapīha sthānī na nirdiṣṭaḥ, tathāpyāvādeśa okārasya sthāne, āvādeśo'yaukārastha sthāne bhavatīti veditavyam‌| katham‌? pūrvayoge hi yaddharmā vānta ādeśo dṛṣṭaḥ, ihāpi tadaddharmevānuvarttate| kaśca pūrvayoge taddharmā dṛṣṭaḥ? avādeśasyaukārasya sthānitvam‌| āvādeśasyāpyaukārasya sthānitvam‌, ata ihāpi svadharmamajahato'nuvṛttasya vāntādeśasya pūrvaka eva sthāni vijñāyate| `bābhravyaḥ' iti| babhrūśapabdādapatye'rthe `madhūbabhvrorbrāhmaṇakauśikayoḥ (4.1.106) iti yañ‌ `orguṇa-' (6.4.140) iti guṇaḥ| `māṇḍavyaḥ' iti| `gargādibhyo yañ‌' (4.1.105) iti yañ‌| `śaṅkavyam‌' iti| śaṅkuśabdāt‌ `tasmai guṇaḥ| `māṇḍavyaḥ' iti| `gargādibhyo yañ‌' (4.1.105) iti yañ‌| `śaṅkavyam‌' iti| śaṅkuśabdāt‌ `tasmai hitam‌' (5.1.5) iti `ugavādibhyo yat‌' (5.1.2) iti yat‌| `nāvyaḥ' iti| nāvā taryata iti `nauvayodharmaviṣa' (4.4.91) ityādinā yat‌| `raiyati' iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8) iti kyac‌| `goyānam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `goryūto chandasi' ityādi| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeya ityeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vānto yi' iti yogavibhāgo'tri kriyate tena gośabdasya yūtau parataścandasi viṣaye'vādeśo bhavati| `adhvaparimāṇe ca' iti| `gauryūtau' iti vartate| tatrāpi vaktavyaśabdasya sa evārthaḥ| vyākhyānamapi tadeva| idaṃ ca sāmānyena vacanam‌, tena bhāṣāyāmadhvaparimāṇe bhavati|| 80. dhātostannimittasyaiva| (6.1.80) pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam‌| `tannimittasya' iti| tacchabdena yakārādipratyayaḥ pratyavamṛśyate, sa nimittaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `lavyam‌' iti| `aco yat‌' (3.1.97) iti yat‌ tameva vakāramāśritya `sārvadhātukārthadhātakayoḥ' (7.3.84) ityokāro vidhīyamānastannimitto bhavati| `avaśyalāvyam‌' iti| `orāvaśyake' (3.1.125) iti ṇyat‌, `mayūravyaṃsakādayaśca' (2.1.72) iti samāsaḥ, `lumpedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye' (kāśikā.6.1.144) iti makāralopaḥ| atrāpi ṇyatamāśritya `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vidhīyamāna aukārastannimitto bhavatati| `prātipadikasaya niyamo mā bhūt‌' iti| asati hi dhātugrahaṇe prātipadikasyāpi niyamaḥ syāt‌| nanu ca prātipadikasyāpi niyama etannimittsyaiva bhavati, nātanimittasyetyarthaḥ syāta, tathā ca--pūrvasūtrasyārambho'narthakaḥ syāt‌, nirviṣayatvāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yo hi dhātoriti kimiti pṛcchati sa pūrvayogasyārambhaṃ pṛthaṅ‌ necchatyeva| sa hyevaṃ manyate--`vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) tannimittasyaivetyeko yogaḥ karttavya iti| tatra ko doṣa iti prātipadikaniyame sati yadi kaściddoṣa āpadyeta tatastannivṛttaye kriyamāṇaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ śobhata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `bābhravya ityatraiva syāt‌' iti| etastannimittatvāt‌| `iha tu na syāt‌--gavyam‌, nāvyam‌' iti| atannimittatvādecaḥ| `upoyate' iti| veña eca ātve kṛta upapūrvāllaṭ‌, `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityātmanepadam‌, `sārvadhātuke yak‌' (3.1.67) iti yak‌, yajāditvāt‌ sasprasāraṇam‌, `akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ, upākāreṇa saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) `auyata' iti| tasyaiva dhātorlaṅ‌, pūrvavadātmanepadādi, āḍajādīnām‌' (6.4.72) ityaṭ‌, `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| ayamaukāraḥ pūrvaka okāraśca etadubhayamapyatannimittam‌, etasya mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tannimittagarhaṇam‌| nanu cāntaraṅgo yaṇādeśo varṇamātrāśrayatvāt‌, bahiraṅgastvekādeśa ubhayapadāśrayatvāt‌, tataśca `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) ityasiddhatvādevātra na bhaviṣyati? evaṃ tarhyotajjñāpayati--neyamiha paribhāṣopatiṣṭhata iti| tenākṣadyūrityatra bahiṅgo'pyūḍādeśo'ntaraṅge yaṇādeśe karttavye nāsiddho bhavati| anyathā yadyayamartho na jñāpyeta tadākṣairdīvyatati kvipi kṛte `cchvoḥ śuḍa--nunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityūḍādeśe kṛte tasyāsiddhatvāt‌ yaṇādeśo na syāt‌| `lauyamāniḥ' iti| lūyamānasyāyatyamityarthe `ata iñ‌' (4.1.95) itīñ‌ `taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' (7.2.117) iti vṛddhiḥ, sā ca taddhitanimittā, na tu yakārādipratyayanimittā| siddhe hi vidhirārabhyamāṇaḥ vināpyevakārakāraṇaṃ niyamārtho bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha--`evakāraḥ kim‌' iti| iṣṭato'vadhāraṇārthamevakārakāraṇaṃ kriyata iti darśayannāha--`dhātvavadhāraṇam‌' ityādi| evakāre tannimittaśabdānantaramuccāryamāṇe yata evakārakāraṇaṃ tato'nyatrāvadhāraṇārthamiti dhātvadhāraṇaṃ bhavati| asati hyevakārakāraṇe dhātereva tannimittasyeti tannimittāvadhāraṇamapyaniṣṭaṃ vijñāyeta| tasmāddhātvavadhāraṇaṃ yathā syāt‌, tannimittāvadhāraṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamevakārakāraṇam‌| kiṃ punardhātvavadhāraṇe satīṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ sidhyati yatastadiṣyate? ityata āha--`tannimittsya hi' ityādi| dhātvavadhāraṇe hi sati tannimittsyāniyatatvādadhātośca bhavati bābhravya iti dhātośca bhavati--lavyam‌, avaśyalāvyamiti| yadi tannimittāvadhāraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ syāt‌ tadā dhātoreva tannimittasyeti| tato bābhravya ityatra na syāt‌, na hi babhrūśabdo dhātuḥ| tasmādvātvavadhāraṇamitīṣyate|| 81. kṣayyajayyau śakyārthe| (6.1.81) ``kṣi' `ji' ityetayordhātvoḥ' iti| kṣigrahaṇena `kṣi kṣaye' (dhā.pā.236) `kṣi vāsagatyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1407) kṣiṣ‌ [`kṣīṣa hiṃsāyām‌'--dhātupāṭhaḥ| `kṣi hiṃsāyām‌' (1276)--dhātupāṭhaḥ] hiṃsāyām‌ (dhā.pā.1506) ityeṣāṃ grahaṇam‌, jigraṇe tu `ji jaye (dhā.pā.561) ityetasya| nanu ca `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) ityanayā paribhāṣayā `kṣiṣ‌ hiṃsāyām‌' ityasya grahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ nipātanāt‌ bhaviṣyati| kiṃ hi nipātanānna labhyate? yathaiva hi tato'nyadalākṣikaṃ kāryaṃ kiñcidbhaviṣyati, tathedamapi syāt‌| arthagrahaṇaṃ karmaṇyapabi yatā syāt‌; anyathā śakerakarmakatvāt‌ bhāva eva nipātanaṃ vijñāyate--kṣayyaṃ devadatteneti| karmaṇi tu na syāt‌--kṣayyo vyadhiriti, na hyakarmakebhyaḥ karmaṇi kṛtyapratyaya upapadyate| arthagrahaṇena tu kṛtyārtha upalakṣyate| kṛtyāśca karmaṇyapi vihitāḥ, tena tatrāpi nipātanādvijñāyate|| 82. krayayastadrthe| (6.1.82) `krayyaḥ' iti| atra pratyayārthaśca karma vidayate; karmaṇi kṛtyavidhānāt‌| prakṛtyarthaśca vinimayaḥ, krīṇātervinimayārthatvāt‌| tatra pratayayārthaḥ pradhānam‌, `prakṛtipratyau pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ' iti kṛtvā| prakṛtyarthastūpasarjanam‌, pratatyayārthaviśeṣaṇamiti kṛtvā| tatra yadi pradhānatvāt‌ tadityanena pratyārtho nirdiśyeta tadāyamarthaḥ syāt‌--sa krayyo'rtho yasya śabdasya sa tadarthaḥ, tasminnabhidheye ṛyya ityeṣa śabdo nipātyata iti? ayuktaścāyam‌; na hyatra krayyaśabdasya krayyārthaḥ kaścicchabdo'bhidheyo'sti, tatastasyāpratīteḥ| athaivaṃ vijñāyeta--sa evārthastadartha iti? evamapi tadarthagrahaṇamanarthakam‌| avaśyameva hi krayyaśabdo yatpratayayāntastasmin‌ yatpratyayārthe varttate| tasmāt‌ tacchabdena pradhānanirdeśe sati tadarthagrahaṇasyānarthakyam‌| ato guṇabhūto'pi prakṛtyartho nirdiśyata iti matvā''ha--`tadarthe krayārthaṃ yat‌ tasminnabhidheye' iti| tasmai idaṃ tadartham‌| krayārthamityanena krīṇātyarthastacchabdena nirdiśyata iti darśayati| krayaṇaṃ krayaḥ, viniyama ityarthaḥ| krayārthamityatrāpi caturthīsamāsa eva--krayāya idaṃ krayārtham‌| `krāyārtha yaḥ prasāritaḥ' iti| vinimayārthaṃ ya upanyasta ityarthaḥ| `kreyaṃ no dhānyam‌' iti| kretavyam‌-grahītavyam‌, svīkarttavyamitadyarthaḥ| `na cāsti kravyam‌' iti| na cātra krayārthamupanyastaṃ dhānyamastītyarthaḥ| 83. bhayyapravayye ca cchandasi| (6.1.83) `vī ityetasya' iti| gatiprajanādiṣu yo vī paṭhyate tasya, `ajervyaghañapoḥ' (2.4.56) ityajeryo vī ādeśastasya vā| `hradayyā āpa upasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| hradayyā hatyasya pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena hradayyā ityapi bhaviṣyatīti|| 84. ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ| (6.1.84) atha pūrvaparagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) ityādādādityeṣā pañcamī acītyasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti vacanāt‌| tathācītyeṣā saptamyādityasyāḥ pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti vacanāt‌| tatrāntareṇāpi pūrvaparagrahaṇaṃ pūrvaparayordvayorapi bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`pūrvaparagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasati pūrvaparagrahaṇe dvayorapi yugapadādeśo na sidhyati? ityata āha--`ekasyaiva hi' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--acatyeṣā saptamī yaṇādeśādividhau caritārthā; ādityeṣāṃ tu pañcamī na kvaciccaritārthā, ataḥ sā saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayet‌| tatrāsati pūrvaparagrahaṇe'ca eva sthāne guṇaḥ syat‌| `bṛddhireci' (6.1.88) ityatra ca gaṇavidhāvāditi pañcamī kṛtārthe ti tasyā ecīti saptamyakṛtārthā ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayet‌| evaṃ ca vṛddhiravarṇasyaiva prasajyeta| `upasargādṛti dhātau' (6.1.91) ityatara dvayorapi pañcamīsaptamyorakṛtārthatvāt‌ paryāyeṇa parasparaṃ ṣaṣṭhīparakalpaneti paryāyeṇaiva vṛddhiḥ syāt‌| yat‌ punaḥ parasyābhimataṃ pañcamī saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati, saptamyapi pañcamyāḥ, tato'ntareṇāpi parvaparagrahaṇaṃ dvyorapyādeśo bhaviṣyatīti? tannirāsāyāha--`nobhe' ityādi| nivṛttidharmā hi sthānī bhavati, śrūyamāṇasya ca ṣaṣṭhīprakalpanaṃ prati nimittabhāvaḥ| kathaṃ pūrvaparau nivartteyātām‌? ṣaṣṭhīprakalpanaṃ ca prati nimittabhāvamupagacchetātam? ata evānivṛtternimittabhāvasya cāsambhavānnobhe saptamīpañcamyau yugayatprakalpike bhavataḥ| tasmādekasyaiva syāt‌, nobhayoḥ| athaikagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `bhrasjo ropadhayo ramanyatarasyām‌' (6.4.47) ityatra vināpyekagrahaṇameka eva sambhavati, tathāpyatraikagrahaṇena vināpyeka eva bhavaṣyatītyāha--`ekam‌' ityādi| ramāgamena hi mitvāt‌ `midacontyātparaḥ' (1.1.47) ityaco'ntyāt‌ pareṇa bhavitavyam‌| na ca dvayo ramorbhṛjjātavaco'ntyāt‌ pareṇa sambhavo'sti| tato yuktaṃ tadvināpyekagrahaṇam‌| eka eva ram‌ bhavatīti guṇādistvādeśaḥ| sambhavati ca sthānibhede satyekaikasya sthānino guṇādiḥ pṛthagādeśaḥ tatrāsatyekagrahaṇe pṛthagādeśaḥ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ pūrvaparayordvayoḥ sthāninoḥ pṛthagadeśo mā bhūdityevamarthamekagrahaṇam‌| asati punarekagrahama ādeśaśca dvayaṃ prāpnotītyamumarthaṃ sopapattikaṃ pratipādayitumāha--`sthānibhedāddhi' ityādi| yatā `radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ' (8.2.42) iti sthānibhedāddhetorbhinnaṃ chinnamityevamādiṣu dvāvevādeśau bhavataḥ, tathā khaṭvendra ityevamādiṣvapi dvāvādeśau syātām‌|| 85. antādivacca| (6.1.85) antādivadityukte na jñāyate--ko'syātideśasyārtha ityatastatparijñānāyāha--`yathā' ityādi| `ityeṣo'tideśasyārthaḥ' iti| itiśabdvo'tikrāntapratyavamarśī-atidiśye'nenetyatideśaḥ, sa punaḥ `antadivacca' ityeṣa eva yoga ityeṣo'nantarokto'syātideśasyārtha ityarthaḥ| `varṇāśrayavidhāvayamantādivadbhāvo neṣyate' iti| kathametajjñāyate? ityāha--`tathāhi' ityādi| `obhisa ais‌ (7.1.9) ityakāravarṇāśrayo vidhiḥ; tatra karttavye khaṭvābhirityatra savarṇadīrghatvaṃ pūrvasyānatavanna bhavati| `āta au ṇalaḥ' (7.1.34) ityākāravarṇāśrayo'yaṃ vidhiḥ| tatra karttavye varṇāśraye juhāvetyatra `abhyastasya ca' (6.1.33) iti hvayateḥ samprasāraṇe kṛte yat‌ pūrvarūpatvamākārasya tannādivadbhavakati| eṅaḥ padāntādati' (6.1.109) ityeṣa vidhireṅvarṇāśrayaḥ| tatra karttavye--asyai aśva ityatra `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ parasyādivanna bhavati, tadabhāvādāyādeśaḥ, `lopaḥ śākalyasya' (8.3.19) iti yakāralopaḥ, tat‌ kimetadvaktavyam‌--varṇāśraye nāntādivaditi? na vaktavayam‌| katham‌? atādrūpyātideśāt‌| neha tādrūpyamatidiśyate, rūpāśrayāścaite viṣayaḥ, tenātādrūpyānna bhaviṣyanti| kimarthaṃ punarayamantādivadbhāvo vidhīyate, yāvatā pūrvaparāvuktāvekādeśasya sthāninau, atra sthānivadbhāvādeva tadāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`pūrvaparasamudāya ekādeśasya sthānī' iti| kathaṃ jñāyate? ityāha--`sa hi' ityādi| yena hi yo nivarttyata ādeśena sa tasya sthānīti, tadyathā--`asterbhūḥ' (2.4.52) iti| atra bhūvo'stiḥ, samudāyaścehaikādeśena nirvarttyata iti sa eva tasya sthānī, na pūrvaparau samudāyinau| syādetat‌--avayavasya samudāyābhyāntaratvāt‌ samudāya ādeśena nivarttyamāne'vayavāvapi nivarttyete, tasmāt‌ tayorapi sthānitvam‌? ityata āha--`tatra' ityādi| itikaraṇau dvāvapi hetau| tatra samudāye sthāninyavayavayoryat‌ sthānitvaṃ tadānumānikam‌, samudāya ekādeśasya ādeśena nivarttyamāne tayorapi nivarttanaṃ nāntarīyakamiti kṛtvā| na hi vināvayavanivarttanena samudāyaḥ śakyate nivartayitum‌, tasya tadātmakatvāt‌| samudāyasya tu pratyakṣaṃsthānitvam‌| `pūrvaparayoḥ' iti sthānaṣaṣṭhyantasya sākṣāc‌ śravaṇāt‌ `śrutānumitayoḥ śrautaḥ sambandho garīyān‌' (cāṃ.pa.pā.49) iti `sthānivadādeśo'nalvidhau' (1.1.56) ityanena yasya pratyakṣaṃ sākṣāt‌ śrutam‌, sthānitvaṃ tadāśrayameva kāryamādeśe vidhīyate| avayavayoścānumānikaṃ sthānitvaṃ na pratyakṣam‌, atastadāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ nātidiśyate| tena tadāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ sthānivadbhāvādeśe na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca| tadarthamayamantāvivadbāvo vidhīyate|| 86. ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ| (6.1.86) ihāsiddhavacanenakādeśasyābhāvo vā kriyate? tatkāryasāmarthya vā pratipādyate? siddhamapi hi vastu siddhakāryaṃ kartumasāmarthyādasiddhamityucyate, yathā--putrakāryakaraṇe'sāmarthyāt‌ putro'pyaputra iti| tatra yadyanenaikādeśasyābhāvaḥ kriyate tadādhītyetyatra tugna syāt‌, na hīha hrasvo'sti; ekādeśena nivarttitattvāt‌| na cāsiddhavacanenaikādeśe nivarttite hrasvasya prādurbāvo bhavati, na hi devadattasya hantari hate punardevadattasya prādurbhāvo bhavatītimamādye pakṣe doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāryasāmarthyamekādeśasyāsiddhatvaśrutyā pratyāyyata iti darśayannāha--`siddhakāryaṃ na karotītyarthaḥ' iti| siddhasya niṣpannasya yat‌ kāryaṃ tadekādeśaḥ siddho niṣpanno'pi na karotītyayamasya vacanasyārthaḥ| `asiddhavacanam‌' ityādinā sūtrasya prayojanamācaṣṭe| ādeśe ca kṛte yatkāryaṃ taddhetukaṃ prāpnoti tadādeśalakṣaṇam‌, ādeśo lakṣaṇaṃ nimittamasyeti kṛtvā| tasya pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthamasiddhavacanam‌| utasṛjyate nivarttyata ityutsargaḥ, sthānyabhidhīyate| utsargo lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tadutsargalakṣaṇam‌, tadbhāvo yathā syādityevamarthañcāsiddhavacanam‌| `ko'sicat‌' iti| sicerluhi cliḥ, `lipisicihvaśca' (3.1.53) iti cleraṅ, kiṃśabdāt‌ parasya sakārasya rutvam‌ `ato roraplutādaplute' (6.1.113) ityuttvam‌, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) iti guṇaḥ, `eṅaḥ padāntādati'(6.1.109) iti parapūrvatvam‌, `paraṃ pratyādivadbhāvāt‌' ityādi| asicadityatra yo'kārastaṃ pratyekādeśasya `antādivacca' (6.1.85) ityanenādivadbhāvaḥ| ayañcāpadāditve hetuḥ| `asiddhattvānna bhavati' iti| asiddhattve hi sati sakāro'trādireva padasya bhavati, tena `sātpadadyoḥ' (8.3.109) iti ṣatvapratiṣedho bhavati| `ko'sya' iti| idamaḥ ṣaṣṭhyekavacanam‌, `tyadādīnāmaḥ'(7.2.102) ityatvam‌, `ṭāṅasiṅsāminātsyāḥ' (7.1.12) iti syabhāvaḥ `hali lopaḥ' (7.2.113) itīdrūpasya lopaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat‌| etadādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedhasyodāharaṇam‌| utsargalakṣaṇabhāvasya tu `adhītya, pretya' iti| nanu ca bahiraṅga ekādeśo dvipadāśrayatvāt‌; antaraṅgādeva ṣatvatukau, ekapadāśrayatvāt‌, tatra `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) ityanayā paribhāṣayaivātrāsiddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti nirarthakamidaṃ vacanam‌? evaṃ tarhi saiva paribhāṣā'tra prakaraṇe ṣatvatukoniyamyate| tenākṣadyūrityatra bahiraṅgalakṣaṇo'pyūḍādeśo'ntaraṅgayaṇādeśe karttavye nāsiddho bhavati| `samprasāraṇa' ityādi| samprasāraṇe ṅau iṭi ca ya ekādeśastasyāsiddhatvaparatiṣedo vaktavyaḥ| `brahmahūṣu' iti| brahmāṇaṃ hvayatīti kvip‌, yajāditvāt‌ samprasāraṇam‌, `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.198) ti parapūrvatvam‌, `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghaḥ| saptamībahuvacanam‌| `parivīṣu' iti veñaḥ paripūrvasaya pūrvavat‌ kvidādiṣu kṛteṣu rūpam| `apacecchatram‌' iti| pacerlaṅyuttamapuruṣaikavacanamiṭ‌, `karttari śap‌' (3.1.68) iti śapa; `ādaguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) iti guṇaḥ|| ? 87. ādraguṇaḥ| (6.1.87) `tavalkāraḥ; khaṭvalkāraḥ' iti| kathaṃ punaratra laparatvam‌? ityāha--`lṛkārasya sthāne' ityādi| etacca `lṛkāraṛkārayoḥ savarṇasajñā vaktavyā' (vā.3) ityupasaṃkhyānāt‌ `uraṇ‌ raparaḥ' (1.1.51) ityatra rapratyāhāragrahaṇāllabhyate| uktaṃ hyakṣarasamamnāye--`hakārādiṣu varṇoṣvakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, lakāre tvanunāsika itsaṃjñakaḥ pratijñāyate' iti| tatra rephādārabhya laṇakāreṇa pratyāhāre sati lṛkārasya ṛkāragrahaṇena gṛhītasya sthāne'ṇ‌ vidhīyamāno laparaḥ sampadyate|| 88. vṛddhireci| (6.1.88) 89. etyedhatyūdasu| (6.1.89) sambhave vyabhicāre ca sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavati, tau ca sambhavavyabhicārāvetādeva dhātau staḥ, netaratretyāha--`tadetadejgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| `praṣṭhauhaḥ' iti| praṣṭhaṃ bahatīti `chandasi sahaḥ' (3.2.63) iti `vahaśca' (3.2.64) iti ṇvipratyayaḥ `vāha ūṭh‌' (6.4.132) ityūṭh‌ samprasāraṇasaṃjñakaḥ, `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti parapūrvatvam‌, tato vṛddhiḥ| `etyedhatyoreṅi pararūpāpavādaḥ' iti vṛddhirvidhīyata iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| atha `omāṅośca' (6.1.95) ityasyāpyāṅi pararūpāpavādo vṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati, nāprāpte hi pararūpa iyaṃ vṛddhirārabhyata iti mā yathaiṅi pararūpaṃ bādhate tathāṅi pararūpamapi bādheta, tataścehāpi syāt‌--ā-itaḥ-etaḥ, upa-etaḥ-upetaḥ? ityata āha--`omāṅoścetyetat‌' ityādi| atraiva kāraṇamāha--`yena nāprāpte yo vidhirārabhyate sa tasya bādhako bhavati' (iti)| nāprapta eṅi pararūpe iyaṃ vṛddhirārabhyata iti yuktaṃ yat‌ tasya bādhikā bhavati| āṅi pararūpe tu prāpte cāprāpte caiṣā vṛddhirārabhyate| ā-itaḥ-etaḥ, pra-etaḥ-pretaḥ, paretaḥ ityatra prāpta āṅi pararūpe tu prāpte cāprāpte caiṣā vṛddhirārabhyate| ā-itaḥ-etaḥ, pra-etaḥ-pretaḥ, paretaḥ ityatra prāpta āṅi pararūpe upa-eti-upaitīti--atra tvaprāpte| tasmādeṣā vṛddhirāṅi pararūpatvaṃ na bādhate| `purastādapavādāḥ' ityādinā parīhārāntaramāha--`purastādapavādā anantarān‌ vidhīn‌ bādhante nottarān‌' (vyā.pa.9) iti, iyaṃ ca vṛddhiḥ purastādapavādaḥ, asyāś‌caihi pararūpamevānantaram‌, atastadeva tayā bādhyate, nāṅi pararūpam‌, tasyāntaratvāt‌| `akṣāt‌' ityādi| `vaktavyā' iti| vyākhyeyetyarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--uttarasūtre cakāro'dhikavidhānārthaḥ| tenākṣaśabdādūhinīśabde parato vṛddhirbhaviṣyatīti| evamuttaratrāpi vaktavyaśabdasyārthaḥ, vyākhyānamapyevameva veditavyam‌| akṣāṇāmūhaḥ, so'syāstīti matvarthīyaḥ iniḥ| `ṛnnebyo ṅīp‌' (4.1.5) iti ṅīp‌--`akṣauhiṇo'| `svairam‌' iti| `īra gatau' (dhā.pā.1018) īraṇamīraḥ, bhāve ghañ‌ svasya īraḥ svairaḥ| kriyaviśeṣaṇatvāt‌ svairamiti vṛttau napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśaḥ| kriyā tu kācidatrādhyāharttavyā| atha vā sva īro yasya kulasya tat‌ svairaṃ kulam‌| napuṃsakasya kulāderanyapadārthatvānnapuṃsakaliṅgatvam‌| `svairī' [svairiṇī--kāśikā] iti| svamīrituṃ śīlamasyeti `supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye' (3.2.78) iti ṇiniḥ| ūḍha, ūḍhiriti śabdau niṣṭhāktinnantau| `praiṣaḥ' iti| `iṣa gatirahisādāneṣu' (dhā.pā.1127) `iṣu icchāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1351) iti vā, abhyāṃ prapūrvābhyāṃ yadā ghañ‌ tadā praiṣaḥ, yadā tu ṇyat‌ tadā praiṣya iti| `sukhārttaḥ' iti| `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ|| 90. āṭaśca| (6.1.90) `ekṣata' iti| `īkṣa darśane' (dhā.pā.610) iti laṅ‌| `aikṣiṣṭa' iti| luṅ‌| `aikṣiṣyata' iti| lṛṅ‌| `aumbhīt‌' iti| `ubha umbha pūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1319,1320) iti luṅ‌, iṭ‌, astisico'yukte' (7.3.96) itīṭ‌| `īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| `aubjīt‌' iti| `ubja ārjave' (dhā.pā.1303)| `ārdhnot‌' iti| `ṛṣu vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.1271) iti laṅ, `svādibhyaḥ śnuḥ' (3.1.73) iti śnuḥ| `cakāro'dhikavidhānārthaḥ' iti| na tu vṛddheranukarṣaṇārthaḥ; tadanuvṛtteḥ svaritatvādeva siddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| adhikavidhānārtha ityasyārthaṃ vākyāntareṇa trispaṣṭīkarttumāha--`usyomāṅośceti pararūpabādhanārthaḥ' iti| usiomi āṅi ca yat‌ pararūpaṃ prāpnoti tadbādhanārtha ityarthaḥ| cakārema hi dvirvṛddhividhānaṃ vijñāpayati| tatra yaddvitīyaṃ vidhānaṃ tad‌ bādhakabādhanārthaṃ bhavati| tena `usyapadāntāt‌' (6.1.96) iti yatpararūpaṃ prāpnoti, yacca `omāṅośca' (6.1.95) iti tadapi bādhitvā vṛddhireva bhavati| `ausrīyat‌' `auṅkārīyat‌' iti| usraśabdādoṅkāraśabdācca `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8), `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam‌, kyajantālluṅ, āṭ‌ `usyapadāntāt‌' (6.1.96) iti pararūpe bādhake prāpte cakārasyādhikavidhānārthatvādvṛddhireva bhavati| `auḍhīyat‌' iti| oḍhāśabdāt‌ kyajantalluṅ, āḍāgame kṛte `omāṅośca' (6.1.95) iti pararūpe bādhake prāpte cakārasyādhikavidhānārthatvād‌vṛddhireva bhavati|| 91. upasargādṛti dhātoṃ| (6.1.91) `upārcchati' iti| `ṛccha gatandriyapralayamūrtibhāveṣu' (dhā.pa.1296) `pragatā ṛcchakā asmāddeśāt‌ pracchako deśaḥ' iti| atra `yaṃ prati kriyāyuktā prādayastaṃ prata gatyapasargasaṃjñakā bhavanti' iti gamiṃ prati praśabdo gatyupasargasaṃjñakaḥ, na ṛcchatiṃ paratīti bhavati pratyudāharaṇamidam‌| `vā supyāpiśaleriti vikalpaḥ syat' iti| etenottarārthatāṃ taparakaraṇasya darśayati| atha dhātagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvata sambandhiśabdā hi niyataṃ pratayoginamupasthāpayanti, tadyathā--putrādaśabdāḥ, upasargaścāyaṃ dhātvapekṣatvāt‌ sambandhiśabdaḥ tatropasargagrahaṇādeva dhātugrahaṇaṃ sidhyati? ata āha--`upasargagrahaṇādeva' ityādi| yadi dhātugrahaṇaṃ na krayeta, tadā parārcchatītyatra `ṛtyakaḥ' (6.1.128) iti paratvāt‌ śākalyasya matena parakṛtavadbhāvaḥ lyāt‌| tasmāt tasya śākalyasya prakṛtivadbhāvasya nivṛttyarthaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ kriyate| kathaṃ punaḥ kriyamāṇe dhātagrahaṇe śākalyasya prakṛtavadbhāvanivṛttirlabhyate? yogavibhāgakāraṇāt‌| sati hi dhātugrahaṇe yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate--upasargāvṛtti vṛddhirbhavatīti; tato dhātāviti, ihopasargāditi varttate| tato dvitīyo yogo bādhakabādhanārtho vijñāyate| atha `upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe' (5.1.118) ityatra yathā prādyupalakṣaṇārthamupasargagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, tathehāpi kasmānna vijñāyeta? aśakyatvāt‌| `upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe' ityatra hi dhātorupasthānaṃ na sambhavatīti yuktaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇārthamupasargagrahaṇam‌| iha hi dhātorupasthānaṃ sambhavatītyayuktam‌|| 92. vā sapyāpaśaleḥ| (6.1.92) dhātāvityanuvartate, supīti cocyate, na ca subanto dhāturasti, tatra samarthyāddhātvekadeśe varttamānaṃ supatyetadiha viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha--`subantāvayave dhātau' ityādi| `upālkārīyati' iti| kathaṃ punarṛtītayucyamāne lukāre vṛddhiḥ pravarttate? ityāha--`ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ' ityādi| ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ savarṇasaṃjñā vihiteti ṛkāro gṛhyamāṇa lṛkāramapi grāhayatīti tatrāpi vṛddhirbhavati| `āpiśaligrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham‌' iti| atha vikalpārthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`vetyucyata eva' iti| yadyapyācāryagrahaṇenaiva pūjā, vikalpaścobhayaṃ sampadyate; tathāpyācāryagrahaṇasya prādhānyena pūjāṃ khyāpayituṃ vāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ|| 93. auto'mśasoḥ| (6.1.93) `gāmpaśya' iti| kathaṃ punaretadudahṛtam‌, yāvatā `goto ṇit‌' (7.1.90) iti ṇittve sati paratvāt‌ vṛddhyātra bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`dyośabdo'pyokārāntaḥ' ityādi| taparakaraṇaṃ hi varṇanirdeśeṣu prasiddhamiti `gotaḥ' iti taparanirdeśa okārāntopalakṣamārtho vijñāyate, tataśca dyośabdādapi paraṃ sarvanāmasthānaṃ ṇidvadbhavati| yadyevam‌, tat‌ kimiti vṛddharnātra bhavati? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| yadi dyośabdāt‌ parasya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇittvaṃ na syāt, tato dyāṃ paśyetyatra sāvakāśamātvaṃ gāṃ paśyetyatra paratvādvṛddhyā bādhyeta| yadi tu dyośabdādapi paraṃ sarvanāmasthānaṃ ṇidbhavatīti, tadā dyāṃ paśyetyatra vṛddhiḥ prāpnotyeva| tato nāprāptāyāṃ vṛddhāvidamātvaṃ vidhīyamānamanavakāśatvād‌vṛddhiṃ bādhate| tataśca yukatameva gāṃ paśyetyetadudāharaṇam‌| athehāpyacinavam‌, asunavamityatra cinoteḥ sunoteśca laṅi mipi vikaraṇasya guṇe kṛte mipaḥ `tasthasthamipām‌' (3.4.101) ityādināmbhāve caukārasyātvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`ami' ityādi| śasā sāhacaryāt‌ subadhikārādvā supa evāma idaṃ grahaṇam‌| ato nātrātvasya prasaṅgaḥ| citraguṃ paśyetyatra tu hrasvatve kṛta okārābhāvāt‌ `analvidhau' (1.1.56) iti sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhādātvaṃ na bhavati|| 94. eṅi pararūpam‌| (6.1.94) `upelayati' iti| `ila preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1660) curādiṇic‌| `prokhati iti| `ukha nakha' (dhā. pā. 128,134) ityukhirgatyartho bhyādau paṭhyate| yadi `vā supi' (6.1.92) ityanuvarttayanti, evaṃ sati tena sahāsyaikavākyatāyāṃ subadhātorevānena vikalpena pararūpaṃ kriyate, asupi tu pararūpaṃ na syādevetyāha--`tacca' ityādi| ekavākyatve hi satyeṣa doṣaḥ syāt‌| na cātraikavākyatā, kiṃ tarhi? vākyabhedaḥ| tena tadihānuvarttamānaṃ subdhātāveva vikalpaṃ karoti, itaratara tu nityameva pararūpaṃ pravarttate| tatrāvarṇāntādupasargādasubantāvayave dhātāveṅādau pūrvaparayoḥ pararūpamekādeśo bhavatītyekaṃ vākyam‌, avarṇāntādupasargāt‌ subantāvayave dhātāveṅādau pūrvaparamorvā pararūpamekādeśo bhavatīti dvitīyam‌| tatra pūrveṇa vākyenāsubantāvayave dhātāvupelayatatyādau nityaṃ pararūpaṃ didhīyate| dvitīyena tu subantāvayave dhātāvupeṅakīyatītyevamādau vikalpena pararūpaṃ vidhīyate| vākyabhedastu `eṅi pararūpam‌' iti tantreṇa sūtradvayoccāraṇāllabhyate| sūtradvaye tūccāryamāṇe satyeka eva `vā supyāpiśaleḥ' (6.1.92) ityedanuvartamānamapi labhyānurodhānnābhisambadhyate, dvitīye tu sambadhyata eva| tena vākyadvayaṃ pūrvoktaṃ sampadyate| `vaktavyam‌' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānām‌--uttarasūtre cakāro'dhikavidhānārthaḥ, tena śakandhvādiṣu pararūpaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| uttaratrāpa vaktavyaśabdasyāyamartho vyākhyānaṃ caitadadeva veditavyam‌| `eve cāniyoge' iti| niyogaḥ-niyojanam‌, vyāpāraṇamityarthaḥ| na niyogo'niyogaḥ-anavaklṛptiḥ| tatraivaśabde pararūpaṃ veditavyam‌| evaśabdo'niyame vartate| yadā tameva kevalaṃ niyamaṃ vyāpāreṇāviśiṣṭaṃ brūte tadā pararūpaṃ bhavati| yadā tu vyāpārema viśiṣṭaṃ tadā vṛddhireva| `bimboṣṭhī' iti| `nāsikodarauṣṭha' (4.1.55) iti ṅīṣ‌| `tiṣṭha devadattauṣṭhaṃ paśya' iti vākyametat‌ na tu samāsaḥ| devadattaśabdāt‌ `eṅ hrasvāt‌ sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sorlopaḥ|| 95. omāṅośca| (6.1.95) `adyoḍhā' iti| adya-oḍhā| nanu ca `ādaguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) ityanenāṅo nivarttitatvādidamāṅa udāharaṇaṃ yujyate? āṅmāṅorekādeśastvāṅgrahaṇena guhyata ityadoṣaḥ| pūrvameva hīdamuktam‌--`dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭayoḥ sthāne yo bhavati labhate'sāvanyataravyapadeśam‌' iti| kimarthaṃ punarāṅo grahaṇam‌, yāvatā prāgevāṅaḥ pūrvema saha `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101) iti dīrghatve kṛte tataḥ pareṇa saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) iti guṇe cādyoḍhetyādi siddhameva? na sidhyati, yataḥ `dhātūpasargayoḥ kāryamantaraṅgam‌' (vyā.vṛ.37) iti pūrvamādguṇena bhavitavyam‌, tathā ca sati vṛddhiḥ syāt‌| ata āṅo'pi grahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| `iha tvakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ bādhyate' iti| asya vidheraviśeṣavihitatvāt‌, akaḥ savaraṇe dīrghasya ca sāmānyavihitatvāt‌| viśeṣavihito'pi sāmānyavihitasya bādhako bhavatīti pratipāditametat‌|| 96. usyapadāntāt‌| (6.1.96) `bhindyuḥ' iti| bhiderliṅ‌, jhi, yāsuṭ‌ `jherjus‌' (3.4.108) iti jus‌, śnam‌, `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ, `liṅaḥ salopo'nantayasya' (7.2.79) iti sakāralopaḥ, bhindyā-usiti sthite'nena pararūpatvam‌| `aduḥ' iti| dadāterluṅ‌, jhi, `ātaḥ' (3.4.110) iti jherjas‌, `gātisthāṭa (2.4.77) iti sico luk, adā-usiti sthite'nena pararūpatvam‌| `kosrā, koṣitā' iti| nanu cātraikasmin‌ pratyudāharaṇe `arthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya' (vyā.pa.1) ityanayā paribhāṣayaiva na bhaviṣyati, usrāśabdo hi samudāyo'rthavān‌, na tūsityeṣa tadavayavaḥ| dvitīye tu `lakṣaṇapratapadoktayoḥ pratapadokatasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na tu lākṣaṇikasya' (vyā.pa.3) ityanayā paribhāṣayā'pi na bhaviṣyati, lākṣaṇiko hi tatros‌ tathā hi vaserniṣṭhāyāṃ `vasatikṣudhoriṭ‌' (7.2.52) yajāditvāt‌ samprasāraṇe kṛte--uṣiteti, tatra pararūpaṃ na sampadyate, tat‌ kimapadāntādityanena? evaṃ tarhyetadatiricyamānamapadāntagrahamamarthavadanarthavattvādikaṃ viśeṣamanapekṣyosmātre pararūpaṃ bhavatītyamumarthaṃ dyotayati| tena nānarthake `usyapadāntāt‌' ityetadbhavati| bhindyurityatra hi yāsuḍādiḥ samudāyo'rthavān‌, na tu tadavayava us‌| lākṣaṇike'pi bhavatīti--babhuṣaḥ paśyeti| `bhā dīptau', (dhā.pā.1051) liṭaḥ kvasuḥ; śas‌, `vasoḥ samprasāraṇam‌' (6.4.131) iti samprasāraṇam‌; `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti pūrvarūpam, babhā usa as‌ iti sthite'nena pararūpatvam‌| etat‌ sārvadhātukapakṣa udāharaṇaṃ veditavyam‌| ardhadhātukapakṣe hyakāralopenaiva siddham‌| sānubandhake'pi bhavati--adhuriti| kva tarhi syāt‌? babhūriti| nanu cānarthakye satyapadāntagrahaṇasyāyamarthaḥ parikalpyeta, asti cāsyoktasūtre prayojanam‌, kiṃ tat? apadāntādyathā syādiha mā bhūditi--daṇḍāgramiti? naitadasti; yadyetadeva prayojanamabhimataṃ syāt‌, tadottarasūtra evedaṃ kuryāt‌| iha karaṇāttu yathoktārthapratipādanaparataiva tasyāvagamyate| adhikārāccottarārthatāpi bhavatyeva| koṣitetyatra `vasatikṣūdhoḥ' (7.2.52) itīṭ‌, `śāsavasighasīnāṃ ca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam‌, tasya cāsiddhatvāt‌ pararūpatvaprāptirveditavyā| `caṛḥ' iti| kṛtro liṭyusi rūpam‌| `abibhayuḥ' iti| `ñibhī bhaye' (dhā.pa.1084) laṅ, śap‌, `juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ' (2.4.75) iti śluḥ, dvirvacanam‌, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjus‌ `jusi ca' (7.3.83) iti guṇaḥ|| 97. ato guṇe| (6.1.97) `pace, yaje'- ityatra `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, tena tasyā eva pararūpatvamapabāda ityabhiprāyaḥ| `ādgumaḥ' (6.1.87) ityata ādityanuvarttata eveti manyamāna āha--`ata iti kim‌' iti| dīrghanivṛtyartha iha taparasyākārasya nirdeśaḥ kriyata iti darśayitumāha--`yānti, vānti' iti| `apace' iti| laṅyātmanepadottamapuruṣaikavacana iṭ‌, atara `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| pararūpe tu sati sa guṇo na labhyate|| 98. avyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau| (6.1.98) `avyaktamaparisphuṭavarṇam‌' iti| aparisphuṭā-avyaktā, anabhivyaktā akāradayo varṇā yatra tat tathoktam| yadyevam‌, tadanukaraṇenāpi tathāvidhana bhavitavyam, sadṛśaṃ hyanukaraṇaṃ bhavati na tvasadṛśam‌, tataścānukārya ivānukaraṇe'pi naivācchabdo'vadhāryate, anavadhāritasya ca kathaṃ śakyate pararūpatavaṃ vidhātum‌? ityata āha--`tadanukaraṇam‌' ityādi| yadi tarhi tadanukaraṇaṃ parisphuṭavarṇam‌, evaṃ sati tat‌ tasyānukaraṇameva na syāt‌, na hi visadṛśamanukaraṇaṃ bhavati, tenānukarttumaśakyatvāt‌, atiprasaṅgo vetyata āha--`kenacit‌' ityādi| tat punaḥ sādṛśyaṃ dhvanesatulyatā, ubhayorapi tayoḥ samāno dhvaniḥ| tena yadyapyanukaraṇe varmaviśeṣā avadhāryante, tathāpi dhvaneḥ samānatayā tadavayaktamapyanukāryamanukaroti| `paṭiti' iti| nanu ca `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityanayā paribhāṣayāntyasya bhavitavyam‌, tatkathaṃ sarvasyaivācchabdasya bhavati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `nānarthake'lontyavidhiḥ' (vyā.pa.62) iti| atha vā--yadayam‌ `nāmreḍitasyāntyasya tu va' (6.1.99) ityatrāntyagarahaṇaṃ karoti, tato'vasīyate--nātrālo'ntyasyetyeṣā paribhāṣā pravarttata iti| kathaṃ punaḥ pararūpe kṛte tadanukāryasya pratipādanaṃ bhavati, kutaśca na bhaviṣyati? nyūnatvāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathaiva hi vyakatavarmamapi tasya kenacitsādharmyeṇa pratipādakaṃ bhavati tathā nyūnamapi bhaviṣyatīti| `anekāca iti vaktavyam‌' iti| anekāco'vyaktānukaraṇasya pararūpaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--uttarasūtre vāgrahamamubhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣaḥ| sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenānekāca eva bhaviṣyati, na tvekāca iti| `katham‌' iti| takarāntametadavyakatamanukaraṇamiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ|| 99. nāmreḍitasyāntyasya tu vā| (6.1.99) `yadā tu' ityādi| paṭatpaṭadityeṣa śabdaḥ samudāya evānukaraṇam‌, tadā tasyādviruktatvātaparasyāvayavasya paṭacchabdasyāmreḍitasaṃjñā nāstīti pūrvema pararūpaṃ bhavatyeva|| 100. nityamāmreḍite ḍāci| (6.1.100) `ḍācaparam‌' iti| ḍāc paro yasmāt‌ tat tathoktam‌| `ḍāci vihite' ityādi| vihita iti `hi gatau (dhā.pā.1257) ityasya vipūrvasya rapamidam‌| asaya ca `sarve gatyarthā jñānārathāḥ' iti vihite-vijñāte buddhistha evetyeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ| tenāyamartho bhavati--ḍāci vihite buddhisthaviṣayabhūta evānutpanne `ḍāci bahulaṃ dve' (vā.888) iti dvirvacanamiti| avaśyañcaitadevaṃ vijñeyam‌; anyathā hi yadi ḍāci vihite kṛta ityeṣo'rthaḥ syāta, tadā ḍāca parabhūte `ḍāci bahulaṃ dve' (vā.888) ityanena dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate| tathā ca yadvakṣyati--`ḍācīti viṣayasaptamīyam‌' iti tadvirudhyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam‌--ḍāci vihite buddhiviṣayībhūta evānutpanne dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate? ityāha--`tacca' ityādi| caśabdo hetau| yasmād‌dviravacanaṃ ṭilopāt‌ pūravamiṣyate tasmāḍḍāci vihite buddhisthe viṣayabhūte evānutapanne dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate na parabhūte| evaṃ taṭṭilopāt‌ pūrvaṃ sidhyati; nānyathā| yadi he ḍāci parabhūte dvirvacanaṃ na kriyate, tadāntaraṅgatvāṭṭilope kṛte paścāṭṭakārāntasya dvirvacanamāpadyeta, tathā ca paṭapaṭeti na sidhyet‌| na ca śakyate vaktum‌--`nityamāmreḍitaṃ ḍāci' ityetadvacanaṃ jñāpakaṃ pūrvaṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavati tataṣṭilopaḥ' iti; yasmāt‌ paṭadityādikaṃ ṭilope kṛte dvirucyamānaṃ yacchabdāntaṃ bhavati tadarthamevedaṃ syāt‌--paṭapaṭākarotīti| atha vā--ḍācīti ḍāci vihite sati parasaptamyāmadoṣa iti manyamānena `ḍāci vihite' ityuktam‌| ḍāci vihite sati `ḍāci bahulaṃ dve' (vā.888) ityanenopasaṃkhyānena davirvacanam‌| nanu caivaṃ sati `sarvavidhibhyo lopavidhirabalīyān‌' (vyā.pa.70) iti dvirvacanāt‌ prāk‌ ṭilopaḥ syāt‌, tathā cāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prasajyeta? ityata āha--`tacca' ityādi| kathaṃ punaṣṭilopāt‌ pūrvamiṣyamāṇametallabhyate? bahulagrahaṇāt‌| asmistu vyākhyāne vihita iti dadhātereva tad‌rūpaṃ tadrūpaṃ veditavyam‌|| 101. akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ| (6.1.11) `agnaye' iti| paratvāt‌ `gheṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇe kṛte'gabhāvādatra na bhavati| `dadhyatra' iti| nanu ca yaṇādeśo'tra bādhako bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kimetannivṛtyarthena savarṇagrahaṇena? ihāpi tarhi bādhakaḥ syāt‌--dadhīndraḥ, madhūṣṇamiti| tasmādviṣayavibhāgārtha savaraṇagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| `kumārī śete' iti| atra `icuyaśāstālavyāḥ' iti, `vivṛttaṃ karaṇamūṣmaṇāṃ svarāṇāṃ ca' itīkārasya savarṇaḥ śakāro yadyapi bhavati, tathāpyajgrahaṇānuvṛtterna bhavati| na ca sāvarṇyamapyatra nāsti| `nājjhalau' ityatra `aṇudit‌ savarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' (1.1.69) ityetat‌ grahaṇakaśāstramabhinirvṛttaṃ syāt‌, evamikāro guhyamāṇa īkārasyāpi grāhako bhavati, tataśca hi śāstrasya savarṇasaṃjñāṅgaṃ nimittam‌, tato yāvat‌ sā na pravarttate tāvadaṅgavaikalyādgrahamakaśāstramanabhinirvṛttam‌, evaṃ savarṇasaṃjñāpi yāvadapavādo nābhinirvṛtto bhavati, tāvat kva mayā pravarttitavyamiti svaviṣayamajānānā na pravartate, tato `nājjhalau' ityasyāpavādasyānābhinirvṛttatvāt‌ savarṇasaṃjñā na pravartate| tenāṅgavaikalyādgrahaṇakaśāstramapariniṣpannam‌, ato'kaḥ savarṇā gṛhyante, tenāgṛhītasavarṇānāmeva pratyahārasanniviṣṭānāmayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| na cāyamīkaro'kṣu sanniviṣṭa iti nāsau `nājjhalau' ityājiti pratyāhāragrahaṇena gṛhyate| tena savarṇatvamīkāraśakārayorapratiṣiddham‌| `holllṛkāraḥ, hotṝkāraḥ' iti| kathaṃ punaratra dīrghatvam‌, yāvatā ṛkāralṛkārayorbhinnasthānatvāt‌ savarṇasaṃjñā nāsti? ityata āha--`ṛkāralṛkārayoḥ savarmasaṃjñāvidhiruktaḥ' iti| nanu ca ṛkāralṛkārasamudāyo'tra sthānīti tasyaiva yo'ntaratamasatenaiva yukatamādeśena bhavitum‌, na ca ṛkārasatasyāntaratamastat‌ kathaṃ sa bhavati? ityata āha--`dīrghapakṣe tu' ityādi| samudāyāntaratamasyābhāvāditi| ṛkāralṛkārasamudāyo'tri sthānī, tasya cāntaratamo dīrgho na sambhavatītyavayavasya yo'ntaratastenaiva yuktamādeśena bhatritum‌| tatrāpi lṛkārasya dīrgho na sambhavatīti ṛkārasya yo'ntaratamo dīrghaḥ sa eva ṛkāro bhavati|| 102. prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ| (6.1.102) prathamaśabdo'yaṃ sanniveśaviśeṣāpekṣe'bhidheye varttate| pareṣvabhisamīkṣiteṣu yasmātpūrvo nāsti sa prathamaśabdābhidheyaḥ| iha ca `prathamayoḥ' iti sāmānyena nirdeśānna jñāyate--kayoḥ prathamayorivaṃ grahaṇamityatastatparijñānāyāha--`prathamāśabdaḥ' ityādi| prathamaśabdo'yamiha śāstre vibhaktiviśeṣa rūḍhaḥ, supāṃ yadādyaṃ trikaṃ tatra prasiddhaḥ| tathā hi--`sapūrvayoḥ prathamayorvibhāṣā' (8.1.26), `saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyaḥ' (5.3.27) ityevamādiṣu nirdeśeṣu prathamāśabdena sa eva vibhaktiviśeṣo nirdiṣṭaḥ| tasmādrūḍhiśabdatvādiha prathamāśabdo vibhaktiviśeṣe varttata iti vijñāyate| nanu ca strīliṅgo yaḥ prathamāśabdaḥ sa iha śāstre vibhaktiviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ, asya ca strīliṅgataiva sandigdhā? naitadasti; prathamaśabdopādānādeva strīliṅgo'yamupātta ityavasīyate| yadi hi puṃlliṅgasyedamupādānaṃ syādeyaṃ sati pratyayagrahaṇeva syāt‌| yadi ca pratyayagrahaṇamabhīṣṭaṃ syāt‌ tadaujasorityevaṃ brūyāt‌| na caivamucyamāne dvitīyāsambandhino'pyaukārasya grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ; iha jasā sāhacaryāt‌ prathamāsambandhina evaukārasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāsyate| tasmāt‌ strīliṅgasyedaṃ grahamamityasandigdhametat‌| nanu ca yadi prathamāśabdo'yamiha śāstre vibhaktiviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ, evaṃ sati vibhaktiviśeṣa eka ityekavacanenaiva bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ prathamayoriti dvivacanam‌? ityata āha--`tatsāhacaryāt‌' ityādi| tena prathamākhyena vibhaktiviśeṣeṇa sāhacaryād‌dvitīyāpi vibhaktiḥ prathametyuktā, tataśca dvitvād‌dvivacanameva nyāyyam‌| tadetena prathamayoriti vibhaktyoridaṃ garahaṇaṃ na pratadyayayoriti darśayati| `vṛkṣāḥ `lakṣāḥ' iti| kathamidamudāhṛtam‌? yāvatā `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) ityanena pararūpeṇātra bhavitavyam‌ taddhi nāprāpate vabhaktyantara ārabhyamāṇaṃ yathā'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ bādhate, tathā `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' iti dīrghatvamapi bādheta? ityata āha--`ato guṇe' ityādi| atraivopapattimāha--`purastāt‌' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt‌ `purastādapavādā anantarān‌ vidhīn‌ bādhante nottarān‌' (vyā.pa.9) iti tasmāt‌ `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpam‌ `akaḥ savarṇe dīraghaḥ' (6.1.101) dīrghatvaṃ bādhate; tasyaiva tadanantaratvāt‌| `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarmaḥ' iti dīrghatvaṃ tu na bādhyate; viparyayāt‌| `agnī ityatra' ityādi| asati pūrvagarahaṇe agnī itayatra parvaparasamudayaḥ sthānī, tasya cāntaratamo dīrgha ādeśo nāstītyavayavāntaratamo yastena bhavitavyam‌| avayavau cātra dvau--pūrvaḥ, paraśceti; tatra ca pūrvasyaiva bhavitavyamiti niyamo na labhyate, niyamakaraṇābhāvāditi tayoḥ paryāyeṇa bhavannādeśaḥ pakṣe parasavarṇo vā syāt‌| atastannivṛtyarthaṃ pūrvagrahaṇam‌| savarṇagrahaṇaṃ tu vipratiṣedhanirāsārtham‌| asati hi tasmin‌ dīrgha ityanuvarttamāne'gnī ityatra vipratiṣiddhitvamāpadyeta yadi pūrvo na dīrghaḥ; atha dīrgho na pūrvaḥ| yadi pūrvo na dīrghaḥ; atha dīrgho na pūrvaḥ| yadi ca pūrvaśabdena pūrvākṛtirucyet‌, dīrghādanuvṛtteḥ pūrvasyeti ṣaṣṭhī vā kriyeta| tathā ca savarṇagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttam‌| kriyamāṇaṃ vā tat‌ sukhapratipatyartha veditavyam‌| `dīrghagrahaṇaṃ trimātre sthānini' ityādi| agni au-iti sthite, asati dīrghagrahaṇa ekādeśaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ sthānina āntaratamyāt‌ trimātraḥ prāpnoti; sthāninastrimātrakatvāt‌| tathā hi--agniśabdasyekāra ekamātraḥ aukāro dvimātra ityetatsamudāyātmakaścātra sthānī| tasmāt‌ trimātre sthāninyantaratamastrimātra ādeśo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ dīrghagrahaṇam‌| dīrghagrahaṇe hi sati tenādeśe viśiṣyamāṇe trimātrasyādeśaprasaṅgo na bhavati; dvimātrasyaiva dīrghasaṃjñāvidhānāt‌|| 103. tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi| (6.1.103) `tasmāt‌ pūrvasavarṇadīrghāt‌' iti| etena tasmādityanenāntaraḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrgho nirdiṣṭa iti darśayati| `śaso'vayavasya sakārasya' iti| anena śasa iti sakārāvayavāpekṣayāvayavaṣaṣṭhīti puṃsīti pratyayārthasyedaṃ vā viśeṣaṇam‌--`puṃsāṃ [puṃsi--mu. pāṭhaḥ] cedbahutve śasutpanna iti| prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ vā--puṃśabdāccet‌ paraḥ śasiti| tatra yadā pratyayārthasya viśeṣamaṃ tavā `sarva ete' ityāderayaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ--vṛkṣān‌, agnīnityādikaṃ yuktamudāharaṇam‌; pusāṃ bahutve'tra śasa utpannatvāt‌| ṣaṇḍakān‌ paṇḍakāniti--etadudāharaṇadvayamayuktam‌, na hyatara puṃsāṃ bahatve śas‌ utpannaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? napuṃsakānāmityata āha--`sarva ete' ityādi| sarvagrahaṇena na kevalaṃ vṛkṣādayaḥ śabdā puṃlliṅgena sāmānyaviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭaṃ svārthaṃ pratipādayanti, api tu ṣaṇḍakapaṇḍakaśabdāvapīti darśayati| svārthaḥ panareṣā puṃstvena sāmānyaviśeṣeṇāvacchinnaṃ vṛkṣādikaṃ dravyam‌| tadevaṃ yataḥ sarva ete puṃlliṅgaviśiṣṭārthābhidhāyinaḥ, tenaitebhya utpadyamānaḥ śas‌ puṃsāmeva bahutve utpadyata iti pūrvapakṣo nirākṛto bhavati| yadā tu prakṛtiviśeṣaṇaṃ tadāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ--vṛkṣānityādikamityudāharaṇamupapadyate, tatra hi puṃśabdāt‌ paraḥ śas‌ bhavati; sthūrān‌, ararakāniti idamudāharaṇadvayaṃ nopapadyate; tathā hi sthūrāyā apatyāni ararakāyā apatyānīti `gargādibhyo yañ‌' (4.1.105) iti yañ‌, `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti luki kṛte strīpratyayasyāpi `luk‌ taddhitalaki' (1.2.49) iti luk‌--sthūra, araraka, ityetābhyāṃ strīśabdābhyāmutpanno'tri śas‌ strīśabdābhyāṃ paro bhavati, na napuṃsakaśabdābhyām‌? ityata āha--`sarva ete' ityādi| prakṛtireva hyatra taddhitalugantā pratyayārthe varttate, sa ca pratyayārthaḥ, puṃlliṅgena viśiṣṭaḥ| tasmānna kevalaṃ vṛkṣādayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃlliṅgena viśiṣṭaṃ vṛkṣādikaṃ svārthaṃ pratipādayanti, api tu sthūrārarakaśabdāvapīti pūrvapakṣaḥ pratikṣipto bhavati| ayaṃ tarhi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe doṣaḥ--cañceva cañcā pumāṃsa iti| `ive pratikṛtau' (5.3.96) kan‌ `lummanuṣye' (5.3.98) iti lup‌; yadā lubantāccañcāśabdāt‌ pusāṃ bahutve śas‌ utpadyate tadā cañcāḥ paśyetyatra natvaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`iha tu' ityādi| naiva hyatra puṃbahutve śas‌ utpannaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? strībahutve; puṃso'pi yuktatadbhāvena strītvātideśāt‌| tato'tra natvaṃ na bhavati| dīrghagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtam‌, tasya cehārthavaśena pañcamyantasyopasthāne satyantareṇāpi tasmādityetadvavacanaṃ dīrghādevottarasya śaso natvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha--`iha tu' ityādi| naiva hyatra puṃbahutve śas‌ utpannaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? strībahutve; puṃso'pi yuktavadbhāvena strītvātideśāt‌| tato'tra natvaṃ na bhavati| dīrghagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtam‌, tasya cehārthavaśena pañcamyantasyopasathāne satyantareṇāpi tasmādityetadvavacanaṃ dīrghādevottarasya śaso natvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyeṇāha--`tasmāditi kim‌' iti| `etān‌ gāścarataḥ paśca' iti| `auto'mśasoḥ' (6.1.93) ityātvam‌| yadyanantaradīrghapratyavamarśī tacchabdenopādīyeta, tadā'viśeṣeṇa dīrghamātrānnatvaṃ vidhīyamānam‌--etān‌ gāścarataḥ paśyetyatrāpi syāt‌, bhavati hyayamākāro dīrghaḥ| tasmāt‌ tacchabde tu na doṣaḥ; na hyayamananatarasūtravihita ākāraḥ|| 104. nādici| (6.1.104) `khaṭve' iti| `auṅa āpaḥ' (7.1.18) iti śībhāvaḥ| `kuṇḍe' iti| atrāpi `napuṃsakācca' (7.1.19) iti, tatra kṛte `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) iti guṇaḥ|| 105. dīrghājjasi ca| (6.1.105) `āt‌' iti nānuvarttate, tenā'yaṃ dīrghāmātrāt‌ pūrvasavarṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ| atha khaṭvā ityatra kathaṃ `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) iti dīrghatvam‌? dīrghāditi vacanaṃ spaṣṭārtham‌| nanu cāsati tasmin‌ vṛkṣā ityatrāpi syāt‌? naitadasti; yadi hyatrāpi syāt‌, tadā pūrvasatre `ici' ityetadapārthakaṃ syāt‌| iha tarhi syāt--agnaye iti? iṣṭatvādadoṣaḥ| atra hi paratvāt‌ `jasi ca' (7.3.109) iti guṇa eva bhavati| uttarārtha tarhi syāt‌--`vā chandasi' (6.1.106) iti dīrghādyathā syāt‌? naitadasti; vāgrahaṇasya tatra vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt‌--dīrghādeva bhaviṣyati na hrasvāt‌| `jasi ca' (7.3.109) ityetadapi spaṣṭārthameva| nanu cāsati `jasi ca' ityetasmin‌ yuvatīḥ paśya, paddhatīḥ paśyetyādau śasyapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌? jñāpakānna bhaviṣyati, yadayaṃ `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (6.1.103) iti puṃgrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--śasi pratiṣedho na bhavatīti| taddhi napuṃsake pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvāsambhavāt‌ strīnivṛttyarthameva kriyate| yadi ca stiriyāmapyayaṃ yuvatīḥ paśyetyādau pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, tadā pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvābhāvānnatvasya pratiptireva nāstīti kiṃ puṃgrahaṇena? uttarārthaṃ tarhi jasgrahaṇam‌? naitadasti; vāgrahaṇasya tatra vyavasthitavibhāṣātvavijñānādeva jaso'nyatra na bhaviṣyati|| 106. vā chandasi| (6.1.106) `mārutīḥ' iti| marud‌devatā āsāmiti `sāsya devatā' (4.2.24) ityaṇ‌ `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌; savarṇadīrghatvam‌| `vārāhīḥ' [vārāhī--kāśikā padamaṃjarī ca] iti| varāhasya vikāra ti `avayave ca prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyaḥ' (4.3.135) ityaṇ‌, pūrvavanṅīp‌| `upānahī' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ‌|| 107. ami pūrvaḥ| (6.1.107) pūrvasavarṇadīrghatve prāpte vacanamidam‌| dīrgha iti cehānuvarttate, anyathā hīdaṃ vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā prakṛtaṃ yat‌ pūrvaṃgrahaṇaṃ tadevehānuvarttiṣyata iti? ata āha--`pūrvagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yathājātīyakaḥ pūrvastathājātīyaka eva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ pūrvagrahaṇam‌| evakāreṇa yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayitumāha--`pūrvasavarṇāntaratamo mā bhūt‌' iti| pūrvasavarṇaścāsāvantaratamaśceti karmadhārayaḥ| asati hi pūrvagrahaṇe yat‌ pūrvakaṃ pūrvagrahaṇaṃ tenaivānuvarttitavyam‌, tasmiścānuvartamāne tatasambaddhaṃ savraṇagrahaṇapi anuvartteta, tathā ca `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ' (1.1.50) ityanayā paribhāṣayā pūrvasya yaḥ savarṇaḥ sa eva parasajyeta| kiṃ punarevaṃ satyaniṣṭaṃ syāt‌, vṛkṣamityādau dvimātrasya sthānino dvimātra eva syāditi cet‌? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) ityanena siddhatvādityata āha--`kumārimityatra hi' ityādi| kumārīśabdasyekāro dvimātraḥ, amo'kāro mātrikaḥ; tatsamudāyātmakaścātra sthānī, tatra pūrvasavarṇo vidhīyamānastrimātralasya sthānino'ntaratamastrimātra eva syāt, pūrvagrahaṇe tu sati yathājātīyaka eva pūrvaḥ, tathājātīyaka eva dvimātro bhavati| `vā chandasītyeva' ityādi| yadi tarahi `vā chandasi' (6.1.106) ityanuvarttate, tena sahāsyaikavākyatāyāṃ bhāṣāyāṃ parapūrvatvaṃ na sidhyati? naitadasti; yasmāt‌ tadihānuvartamānaṃ pūrvavadvākyabhedena cchandasyeva vikalpaṃ karoti, na bhāṣāyām‌|| 108. samprasāraṇācca| (6.1.108) samprasāraṇasya yaṇādeśo mā bhūdityevamarthamidaṃ parapūrvatvaṃ vidhīyate| yadi cātra yaṇādeśaḥ syāt‌, tadā saṃprasāraṇavidhānāmanarthakaṃ syāt‌ tasmāt| samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyādeva yaṇādeśo na bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kimarthamidaṃ vidhīyate? ityāha--`sabhprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyāt‌' ityādi| samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyādyaṇādeśo na bhavatīti vigṛhītasyākṛtasaṃhitākāryasya śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti parapūrvatvaṃ vidhīyate| `vā cchandasītyeva' ityādi| atrāpi pūrvavadvākyabhedo draṣṭavyaḥ; anyathā bhāṣāyāṃ na syāt‌| `yajyamānaḥ' [yajyamānau--kāśikā] iti| parapūrvatvābhāvapakṣe yaṇādeśaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra yaṇādeśaḥ, yāvatā vigṛhītasyaiva grahaṇena bhavitavyam‌, idānīmeva hyuktam‌--samprasāraṇavidhānasāmarthyādvigṛhītasyaiva śravaṇe prāpte parapūrvatvaṃ vidhīyate? ityata āha--parapūrvatvavidhāne' ityādi| anārabdhe hi parapūrvatve vigṛhītasyaiva śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti, mā bhūt‌ samprasāraṇasya vaiyyarthyamiti kṛtvā| sati tu parapūrvatve yatra parapūrvatvam‌--iṣṭamityādau, tatrārthavat‌ samprasāraṇam‌| ataḥ parapūrvatvābhāvapakṣe yaṇādeśo bhavatyeva| atheha kasmānna bhavati--śakahvau śakahvarthamiti; atra hi śakaṃ hvayatīti kvip‌, yajāditvāt‌ samprasāraṇam‌, parapūrvatvam‌, tasya `agtādivacca' (6.1.85) iti samprasāraṇagrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌ samprasāraṇāsamprasāraṇayorekādeśasya samprasāraṇasya vyapadeśabhāvatvāt‌, aukāre'rthaśabde ca parato vyavasthite `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti parapūrvatvaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`antaraṅge cāci' ityādi| yo'yaṃ hvayaterecaḥ sthāne vihita ākāraḥ sa samprasāraṇasyāntaraṅgaḥ pratyāsannaḥ; ubhayorapyekadhātvantargatatvāt‌| aukāro'rthaśabdākāraśca viprakṛṣṭaḥ| viprakṛṣṭastu deśataḥ kālataśca, yadāha--`brāhye' iti| yasya dhātoḥ samprasāraṇamavayavaḥ, tatrānantarbhāvādbāhyaḥ| kālataśca, yadāha--`paścāt‌ sannipatite' iti| pūrvarūpavidhānakālādutarakālaṃ sannihita ityarthaḥ| tatra sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭayoracoḥ pratyāsatterantaraṅgo yo'c‌ tatredaṃ vacanaṃ pravarttate, tatara caritārthamiti viprakṛṣṭa aukārādau paścāt‌ sannihate na bhavati|| 109. eṅaḥ padāntādati| (6.1.109) `agne'tra' iti| `sambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) iti guṇaḥ|| 110. ṅasiṅasośca| (6.1.110) `eṅa uttarayoḥ' ityādi| eṅa uttarau yau ṅasiṅasau tayoḥ sambandhyavayavo yo't‌ tasmin‌ parata ityarthaḥ| `agnerāgacchati' iti| `gheṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇaḥ| atha kasmādatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati, eṅāvapi hi dvau, ṅasiṅsāvapi dvāveveti prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, na hyatra ṅasiṅasoḥ parataḥ kāryaṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? tatsambandhina iti, sa caika eva| athāpi sambandhibhedena bhedaḥ syāt‌? evamapyadoṣaḥ, cakāro'tra samuccāyarthaḥ kriyate| evaṃ ca samuccayo bhavati yadyakaikasyaiṅo ṅasiṅasoḥ pratyekamapi parataḥ parapūrvatvaṃ bhavati; nānyathā| `īdagneḥ somaruṇayoḥ' (6.3.27), `orāvaśyake' (3.1.125) iti ca nirdeśastadabhāvaṃ jñāpayati| lakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnena vā| alpāctarasya ṅasaḥ paranipātena yathāsaṃkhyābhāvo'vasīyate|| 111. ṛta ut‌| (6.1.111) `dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭayoḥ sthāne' ityādi| kiṃ punarhoturityādāvaniṣṭaṃ syādyadi raparatvaṃ na kriyeta? na kiñcit‌; nyāyatastu prāpnoti raparatvamapi, tadavaśyaṃ karttavyam‌| tameva nyāyaṃ nyāṃ darśayitum‌--`dvayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭayoḥ sthāne' ityuktam‌| ṛta iti tapakaraṇaṃ dirghanivṛttyartham‌| tena `unyorgraḥ' (3.3.29) `pre stro'yajñe' (3.3.32) ityādau na bhavati| udityetadapi taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛttyarthameva, āntaratamyād‌dvimātrasya sthāne dvimātra eva prāpnoti| nanu ca `bhāvyamano'ṇ‌ savarṇān‌ na gṛhṇāti'(vyā.pa.35) iti savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti tat‌ kimetannivṛtyarthena taparakaraṇena? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--bhavatyatra hyukarema bhāvyamānena savarṇasya grahaṇamiti| tenāmū, amūbhyāmityatra `adaso'serdādu do maḥ' (8.2.80) iti dīrghasya sthāne dīrgha ūkāro bhavati|| 112. khyatyātparasya| (6.1.112) `khyatyāditi khiśabdakhīśabdayostiśabdatīśabdayośca kṛtayaṇādeśayoridaṃ grahaṇam‌' iti| yamādeśe kṛte tulyaṃ rūpamiti viśeṣābhāvāt‌| atha kasmādatrākārāntayoreva khyaśabdatyaśabdayoridaṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati? kevalasya khyaśabdasya tyaśabdasyāsambhavāditi cet‌? na; yadi kevalau na staḥ, tadantānāṃ tarhi mukhyagosaṃkhyādīnāmapatya gārhapatyādīnāñca grahaṇamastu? naitadasti; evaṃ hi--`sakhyurasambuddhau' (7.1.92), `patyurno yajñasaṃyoge' (4.1.33) iti nirdeśau nopapadyeyātām‌| `saha khena varttata iti sakhaḥ' iti| `tena saheti tulyayoge' (2.2.28) iti bahuvrīhiḥ, `vopasarjanasya' (6.3.82) iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| `sakhīyati' iti| `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam‌| `sakhīḥ' iti| kvip‌ `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ `lopo vyoravali' (6.1.66) iti yakārasya ca| `lunam' iti| `lvādibhya' (8.2.44) iti niṣṭhānatvam‌| nanu ca nāyaṃ tīśabdaḥ, tatkathaṃ tasyodamudāharaṇamityata āha--`niṣṭhānatvam‌' ityādi| atheha kasmānna bhavati--atasakherāgacchati, senāpaterāgacchatīti, asati hyatrāpi khiśabdaḥ tiśabdaśca? ityata āha--`vikṛtanirdeśāt‌' ityādi| yo'yaṃ khyatyādityāgantukenākārema yaṇādeśaṃ kṛtvā vikṛtanirdeśaḥ kṛtastasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--yatra yaṇādeśaḥ, tatraiva yathā syāt‌| na cātra yaṇādeśo'sti, ato na bhavati, anyathā hi vikṛtanirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt‌| nanu ca ladhvarthaḥ syāt‌, anyathā hi `khitikhītībhyaḥ' ityucyamāne gauravaṃ syāt‌? evaṃ manyate--yadi yatara yaṇ‌ na bhavati, tatrāpi bhavitavyam‌, tadā khītībhyāmityevaṃ brūyāt‌| na caivamucyamāne hrasvantābhyānna prāpnoti; khiśabdāt‌ `sakhyuryaḥ', (5.1.126) tiśabdāt‌ `patyurno yajñasaṃyoge' (4.1.33) iti nirdeśābhyāmeva siddheḥ atra hi sakhipatiśabdayorgrahaṇam‌, na sakhīpatīśabdayoḥ| na hīha patīśabdasya yajñena saṃyogo'sti, nāpi `saha khena varttate' ityādinā prakārema vyutpādito yaḥ sakhīśabdastata utpanno yaḥ pratyayaḥ sa prakṛtyarthābhidhāne samartho bhavati; yato'bhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā bhavanti| tasmādvikṛtanirdeśasya pūrvoktameva prayojanamiti| atha sa yaṇādeśo'tara kasmānna bhavati yasmin‌ satyuttvena bhavitavyam‌? `gheṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇena bādhitatvāditi cet‌? na; `śeṣo dhyasakhiḥ (1.4.7) iti dhisaṃjñāpratiṣedhāditi cetyata āha--`sakhīśabdasya' ityādi| atra ca `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti' (vyā.pa.89) iti pratiṣedho hetuḥ| parasyeti kimartham‌? pūrvaparayormā bhūt‌| itaścārabhya pūrvaparayorityetannānuvarttate|| 113. ato roraplutādapalute| (6.1.113) `ukārānubandhakasya' iti| yadi ruśabdaḥ samudāyaḥ sthāno syāt‌, tadā mahātaruvanamityatrāpi `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityutvaṃ prasajyeta| kiñca `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66) ityukārānubandhakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tatra hyu kāro'sya sūtrasaya viśeṣaṇārthaḥ kriyate, sa iha samudāye sthāninyanarthako jāyate| tasmādukārānubandhavata idaṃ grahaṇam‌| nanu cottve karttavye `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) iti ruttvamasiddham‌, tadasato roḥ kathamuttvaṃ śakyate vidhātum‌? ityata āha--`rutvamapyāśrayāt‌ siddham‌' iti| yadi rutvamasiddhaṃ syāt‌, tadā sthānitvena rorāśrayaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; kasyacidukārānubandhaviśiṣṭasya rorasambhavāt‌| tasmādāśrayādeva rorasiddhatvaṃ nāstīti| `tasyāpi' iti| yatrāpi parato roruttvamucyate tasya `susrotā 3 atra' iti `dūrāddhūte ca' (8.2.84) iti plutaḥ| `devadattā 3 atra' iti| atrāpi `guro'nṛto'nantasyāpyekaikasaya prācām‌' (8.2.86) ityanena| atha kimarthaṃ `aplutādaplute' ityucyate? na hyato'tīti ca taparakaraṇasya varṇasya nirdeśe kriyamāṇe plutātparasya plute vā parataḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`plutasya' ityādi| nanu ca siddhaḥ plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu, yadayam‌ `plutapragṛhyā āci' (6.1.125) iti prakṛtibhāvaṃ śāsti? evaṃ manyate--prakṛtibhāva evaitajjñāpakaṃ syāt‌| athāpi kathañcit‌ svarasandhiviṣayaṃ jñāpakaṃ syāt‌, tathā rodattvaṃ svarasandhirna bhavati| athāpi saṃhitā kāryyaviṣayaṃ jñāpakaṃ syāt‌, tathāpi roruttvaṃ maṃhitākāryyaṃ na bhavati| yena hi varṇāḥ sandhīyante tat‌ saṃhitākāryam‌, na cottvena varṇāḥ saṃhitā bhavanti; punarapyādguṇādyapekṣaṇāditi|| 114. haśi ca| (6.1.114) pūrvatrātītyanuvṛtterhaśyuttvamaprāptamevānena vidhīyate| cakāraḥ `aplutāt‌ (6.1.113) ityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| teneha na bhavati--susrotā 3 vehīti|| 115. prakṛtyā'ntaḥpādamavyapare| (6.1.115) `prakṛtyā' iti| karaṇe tṛtīyā| `antaḥpādam‌' iti| saptamyantametat‌| vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaṃ vidhāya tataḥ saptamī, tasyāḥ `tṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulam‌' (2.4.84) ityambhāvaḥ kṛtaḥ| `eṅaḥ' ityādi| pañcamyantasyaiṅaḥ prakṛtyā bhavatītyanena sambandho nopapadyate| tasmādihārthādeṅgrahaṇaṃ prathamāntamupajāyate| `prakṛtiḥ' ityādinā prakṛtiśabdasyāmācaṣṭe| prakṛtiśabdo hi loke svabhāve prayujyate, yatā--dustyajā prakṛtiriti, kāraṇe'pi yathā--dadhnaḥ kṣīraṃ prakṛti rati, tadihāpi sa evārthastasya vijñāyate| antarityavyayamadhikaraṇabhūtamiti| ata evāntaḥ-pādamityavyayībhāvo bhavati| `pādaśabdena' ityādi| kathaṃ punarṛkpādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ labhyate, yāvatā pādaśabdaḥ sāmānyavācī? evaṃ manyate--`vā chandāsa' (6.1.106) ityataḥ chandograhaṇamiha maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttate, tena ṛkpādasyaiva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| atha `sarvatra vibhāṣā goḥ' (6.1.122) ityataḥ sūtrāt‌ prākchandasyeva kāryaṃ vijñāyate| evaṃ hi tatra sarvatragarahaṇamarthavadbhavati yadi cchandasi pūrvaṃ vidhānaṃ bhavati| evamavayavānāparthamākhyāya `avakārayakāra' ityādinā samudāyasyārthamācaṣṭe| avidyamānau vakārayakārau yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `svabhāvena' ityādi| yadā prakṛtiśabdaḥ svabāve varttamāno gṛhyate, tadāyamarthaḥ--eṅ‌ svabhāvena bhavati| svabhāvaparatyāgena saṃhitākāryaṃ nopapadyata iti| yadā tu kāraṇe varttamānasya prakṛtiśabdasya parigrahastadāyamarthaḥ--eṅ‌ kāraṇātmanā bhavatīti| kāraṇaṃ parapūrvatvādeḥ kāryasyaiṅa, tasya ya ātmā svarūpaṃ tenaivātmanaiṅ‌ bhavatītyetaduktaṃ bhavati--prāk‌ saṃhitākāryādyadeṅo rūpaṃ tenaiva tadavatiṣṭhata iti| anantaroktamevārthadvayaṃ spaṣṭīkarttumāha--na `vikāramāpadyate' iti| evaṃ hi svabhāvena bhavati, yadi svabhāvādandathālakṣaṇā vikārāvasthā notpadyeta| tadaivaṃ kāraṇātmanāpi bhavati, yadi vikārabhāvaṃ notpadyate| yadi kāryātmanā na vipariṇamatītyarthaḥ| `no cennimittakāyaṇau' iti| nimittaṃ paratvaviśiṣṭo'kāraḥ| tatra hi parataḥ prakṛtibhāvo vidhīyate| kāryī tveṅ‌, tasya hi kāryaṃ prakṛtibhāvo'sti| `te agre aścamāyuñjan‌' iti| asya ṛkpādasya madhye ya eṅ ekārasteśabde'greśabde ca tasaya tadanantare prakṛtibhāvat‌ `eṅaḥ padāntādāti' (6.1.109) iti pūrvarūpaṃ na bhavati, ayādeśaśca| `upaprayanto adhvaram‌' iti| atrāpi prayanta iti śabdaukārasyaiṅo'dhvaraśabdasyānantare prakṛtabhāvāt‌ pūrvarūpaṃ na bhavati, avādeśaśca| evaṃ `sujāte aśva' ityādāvapi prakṛtibhāvāt‌ pūrvarūpā dakāryasyābhāvo veditavyaḥ| `ete'rcayanti' iti| atrete śabde ya eṅ ekāraḥ sa padānte varttate| tadanantarastvakāraḥ pādādau, na pādamadhye| `te'vadan‌' iti| atra teśabde ya eṅ tasya prakṛtibhāvo na bhavati; tadanantarasyāto vakāraparatvāt‌| `avadan‌' iti| vadaterlaṅi prathamapuruṣabahuvacanāntam‌| `te'yajān‌' iti| atrāpi teśabde ya eṅ tasya prakṛtibhāvo na bhavati| tadanantarasyāto yakāraparatvāt‌| `anvagni' ityādi| sarvamatrāsti, na tvanuśabda ukāra eṅ bhavati, nāsya prakṛtibhāvaḥ| `kecit‌' ityādi| yadi tarhi `nāntaḥpādamavyapare' iti sūtraṃ paṭhanti, evaṃ sati parapūrvasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt‌, nāyavoḥ; tathā hi--parapūrvatvameṅo'nantaravihitam‌? ityat‌ āha--`te saṃhitāyām‌' ityādi| yadi parapūrvatvaṃ saṃhitākāryaṃ viśeṣaṇamapekṣyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, tadāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt‌| yadā tu saṃhitādhikāravihitaṃ kāryaṃmātramapekṣya pratiṣedho vidhīyate, tadā sarvasyaiva saṃhitādhikāravihitasya kāryasya pratiṣedho yukta iti teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ|| 116. avyādavadyādavakramuravratāyamavantvavasyuṣu ca| (6.1.116) `no avyāt‌' iti| asmādo dvitīyabahuvacanāntasya `bahuvacanasya vasnaso' (8.2.21) iti nasi rutve `ato roraplutādaplute' (6.1.113) ityuttve `ād‌ guṇaḥ' (6.1.87) iti guṇe kṛte `no' iti bhavati| `ava rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pa.600) ityasmādāśiṣi liṅi yāsuṭi tipi `itaśca' (3.4.97) itīkāralope `skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti sakaralope ca kṛte `avyāt‌' iti bhavati| `avadyāta' iti| avadyaśabdo'yaṃ pañcamyekavacanāntaḥ| `avakramuḥ' iti| avapūrvāt‌ kramerliṭyusi rūpametat‌| anye tu luṅi varṇayanti--`bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.76) iti cleḥ śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌, jusbhāvaśchāndasaḥ| `avantu' iti| avaterloṭ‌, jherantādeśaḥ, `eruḥ' (3.4.76) ityuttvam‌| `avasyavaḥ' iti| avateḥ `sarvadhātabhyo'sun‌' (da.u.9.49) iti asun‌--avas‌ iti, tataḥ `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8) iti kyac‌, tadantāt‌ `kyācchandasi' (3.2.170) ityupratyayaḥ, tato jas‌, `jasi ca' (7.3.109) iti guṇaḥ--okāraḥ, `eco'yavāyāvaḥ' (6.1.78) ityavādeśaḥ|| 117. yajuṣyuraḥ| (6.1.117) `uro antarikṣam‌' iti| uraḥśabdasyottvam, `ād‌ guṇaḥ' iti guṇaḥ| `okārāntamurośabdaṃ [`ukārāntamuruśabda'--kāśikā] sambuddhyantamadhīyate' iti| uruśabdasya `sambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) iti guṇe kṛte `uro' iti bhavati|| 118. āpojuṣāṇovṛṣṇovarṣiṣṭhe'mbe'mbāle'mbikepūrve| (6.1.118) āpo--ityevamādīni sarvāṇyetānyanukaraṇānyavibhaktikāni; `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) ityādinā tebhya utpannāyā vibhakterluptatvāt‌| atrāpo iti prathamābahuvacanāntasyānukāraṇam‌| `juṣāṇo' iti| prathamaika vacanāntasya| `vṛṣṇo' iti| ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntasya| `vaṣiṣṭhe' iti| saptamyekavacanāntasya| `amba, ambāle' ityetayorviśeṣaṇam‌| ambikeśabdāt‌ pūrve ambikepūrve, asmādeva nipātanāt samāsaḥ| nanu ca `ambe' iti sambuddhyantasyānukaraṇam‌? tataśca `ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ' (7.3.107) iti hrasvenaittvāpavādena bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathamambe ityatraittvam‌? ityata āha--`asmādeva' ityādi| ambāle ambike--ityetayostu yuktamevaittvam‌| vakṣyati hi hrasvavidhāne--`ambārthaṃ dvyakṣaraṃ yadi' (vā.7.3.107) iti|| 119. aṅga ityādau ca| (6.1.119) `aṅga ityādau ca' iti| itikaraṇenāntarokto'ṅgaśabdaḥ pratyavamuśyate| `tadādau cākāre' iti| samānādhikaraṇe saptamyau| tacchabdenātikrāntapratyavamarśinetikaraṇasyārthamācaṣṭe--tadādāviti| aṅgaśabdādāvityarthaḥ| `yaḥ pūrvaḥ' iti| `eṅ' iti sambadhyate| cakāro'ṅgaśabdasyādau yo'kārasatatrāpa parataḥ pūrvasyaiṅaḥ prakṛtibhāvo yathā syāditi samuccayārthaḥ kriyate| tatra hyasatyaṅgaśabdākāre parato'ṅgaśabdasya ya eṅ tasyaiva prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt‌| yastvaṅgaśabde parato'naṅgaśabdasyaiṅ tatra na syāt‌| `prāṇo aṅge' ityādi| atra prāṇo-śabde ya eṅ aṅgaśabdādāvakāre prakṛtyā bhavati| `aṅga aṅge adīdhyat‌' iti| atrāṅgaśabde ya eṅ tasyāṅgaśabdādāvakāre'dīdhyacchabdādau prakṛtibhāvo bhavati|| 120. anudātte ca kudhapare| (6.1.120) `kudhapare' iti| akāraviśeṣamametat‌| kudhau parau yasmāt‌ sa tathoktaḥ| dhakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `ayaṃ so agniḥ' iti| agniśabdaḥ `aṅgernirnalopaśca' [aṅgernalopaśca--da.u.] (da.u.1.20) iti nipratyayānto vyutpādita iti pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, śaṣo'nudātta ityakārasyānudāttatvam‌| `ayaṃ so adhvaraḥ' iti| adhvaraśabdo'pi prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tadādirapyakāro'nudātta eva| `ādyudātto nipātyate' iti| ṛḍajtrendrāgravajraviprakuvracuvrakṣurakhurabhadrograbherabhelaśukaraśuklagauravanarerāmalāḥ (da.u.8.46) ityanena| `so'yam‌' iti| ayaṃśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tasyādiranudāttaḥ|| 121. avapathāsi ca| (6.1.121) `yadrudrebhyo'vapathāḥ' iti| aṭaḥ svareṇādyuvātto'yamavapathāḥśabdaḥ|| 122. sarvatra vibhāṣā goḥ| (6.1.122) 123. avaṅ sphoṭāyanasya| (6.1.123) `atīti nivṛttam‌' iti| yadyapītyanuvartteta tadā gavaudanādau na syāt‌, tasmādatītyetadasvaritatvā nnivṛtam‌| halyapi tarhi prāpnoti? ityata āha--`acītyetatpunaranuvarttate' iti| `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityataḥ; sā punastasyānuvṛttirmaṇḍūkapalutinyāyena veditavyā| na hi `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) ityataḥ pareṇa ye yogā asmādyogāt‌ pūrvaṃ teṣu `ati' ityasyānuvṛttirasti| tathā ca pūrvamuktam‌--`acīti cāyamadhikāraḥ `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti yāvata' iti| `gavāgraham‌, gavājinam‌' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, tatpuruṣo vā| `gavoṣṭram‌' iti dvandvaḥ| `ādyudāttaścāyam‌' ityādi| iha gāvo'gramasyeti bahuvrīhau kṛte pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca ca prāpnoti, avaṅādeśaśca, tatrāntaraṅgatvādavaṅbhavati, sa ca bhavan‌ prātipadekasvareṇāntodāttasya gośabdasya sthāna āntarayato'ntodātta eva syāt‌| tasmin‌ sati paścāt‌ prakṛtisvare kṛte'ntodāttatvaṃ pūrvapadasyāpadyeta, ādyudāttaśceṣyate, tasmādādyudātto'yamādeśo nipātyate| yadyevam‌, tatpuruṣādāvapi sa eva nipātanasvaraḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`anyatra tu' ityādi| anyatreti--tatpuruṣe, dvandve ca| gośabdasyāyamādeśa iti tatsambandhyeva śabdāntaraṃ nipātanasvareṇa bādhyate, na samāsasvaraḥ| tasmādvahuvrīheranyatra tatpuraṣādau samāsāntodāttatvena nipātanasvaro bādhyate, `sphoṭāyanagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham‌' iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ vikalpārthaṃ na bhavati? ityāha--vibhāṣetyeva hi varttate' iti| kimarthaṃ punaravaṅ vidhīyate? ageva na vidhīyeta, tatrāpi hyavādeśena sidhyatyeva? sidhyati; `eṅaḥ padāntādati' (6.1.109) iti pūrvarūpatvaṃ prāpnoti| nanu cāki vihite sati tadanto na bhavati? āgamasya tadgrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌|na hyokārasya prāk‌ pravṛttā padāntatā nāstīti śakyaṃ vaktum‌|| 124. indre ca nityam‌| (6.1.124) `indraśabdasthe' iti| ya indraśabde tiṣṭhati sa indaraśabdasyaḥ, sa punarya indraśabdasthāvayavaḥ sa veditavyaḥ| pūrveṇa vikalpaḥ siddha eva, tatrārambhasāmarvyādeva nitye vidhāvasmiṃllabdhe nityagrahaṇamuttarārtham‌|| 125. plutapṛgṛhyā aci| (6.1.125) `devadattā 3 atra tvasi' iti| `dūrāddhūte ca' (8.2.84) iti plutaḥ| nanu ca `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) ityasiddhaḥ plutaḥ, tadasatasatasaya kathaṃ śakyate parakṛtibhāvo vidhātum‌? ityata āha--`āśrayāt‌' ityādi| āśrayaṇamāśrayaḥ| tadetat‌ prakṛtibhāvakāryaṃ vidhātuṃ plutasya kāryiṇa āśrayaṇam‌| asmādevātra prakṛtibhāve karttavye siddhaḥ plutaḥ, anyathā tasya kāryitvenāśrayaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| `agnī' ityādi| `īdūded‌dvivacanam‌' (1.1.11) ityādinā atra pragṛhyasaṃjñā| athācīti kimartham‌, yāvatā'cītyanuvarttata eva? ityata āha--`acītyanuvarttamāne' ityādi| ādeśasya nimittaṃ yo'c‌ tasya parakṛtibhāvanimittatvena parigraho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punarajgrahaṇam‌| ādeśastvatra yatrāci prakṛtibhāvaḥ--jānu-u asya rujati jānū atya rujatīti| na hi ja nuśabde ya ukāro yaśca tadanantaraḥ pragṛhyasaṃjñakastayoḥ savarṇadīrghatvaṃ prati pragṛhyasaṃjñakādukārāta parasyākārasya nimittabhāvaḥ| iha ca na bhavati--jānvasya rujatīti| tena pūrvaparayorukārayorya ekādeśaḥ, sa yadyapi `antādivacca' (6.1.85) ityādivadbhāvāt‌ pragṛhyasaṃjñakokāragrahaṇena gṛhyate, tathāpi yaṇādeśo'kāre parato bhavatyeva| na hyatrāpyakāra ekādeśanimittam‌| yadi tu viśiṣṭācparigrahārthaṃ punarajgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā'ñmātre prakṛtibhāvo vidhīyamāna ihāpi syādeva| pragṛhyasaṃjñā punarakārapūravasyokārasya `nipāta ekājanāṅ' (1.1.14) ityanena| `nityagarahaṇam‌' ityādi| yadi nityagrahaṇamihānuvarttate, tadāgnī-itītyādau asya vidheḥ kṛtārthatvātta vāyū-atretyādau paratvācchākalau vidhiḥ prasajyeta| tasmāt‌ prakṛtibhāva eva yathā syāt‌--ityevamarthaṃ nityagrahaṇamihānuvarttate|| 126. āṅo'nunāsikaśchandasi| (6.1.126) `āṅaḥ' iti| ṅidviśiṣṭasyākarasyopādānam‌| īṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādābhividhau ca yaḥ'--tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌, vākyasmaraṇayoryaḥ tasya mā bhūdityevamartham‌| asati prakṛtibhāve vihite'pyāṅo'nunāsikatve syādeva svarasagdhiḥ| anunāsikavidhānaṃ tvādeśasya sānunāsikatvārthaṃ syādityetanmanasi kṛtvā''ha--`na ca prakṛtyā bhavati' iti| `ātarat‌' iti| taraterāṅapūrvāllaṅ, aḍāgamaḥ, aṭā saha savarṇadīrghatvam‌|| 127. iko'savarṇe śākalayasya hvasvaśca| (6.1.127) `hrasvaśca tasyekaḥ sthāne bhavati' iti| yadyevam‌, `prakṛtyā' (6.1.115) ityasyānukarṣaṇārthaścakāro na karttavyaḥ, hrasvavidhānasāmarthyādeva hi svarasandhirna bhaviṣyati? atraitat‌ syāt‌--dīrghāṇāmeva hrasvavidhānasāmarthyāt‌ svarasandhirna syāt‌| hrasvānāṃ tu syādeva, na hi teṣāṃ hrasvā bhavanti| prayojanābhāvādityetacca nāsti; hrasvānāmapi hi svarasandhibādhanārthaṃ hrasvo bhavatyeva| kṛtakāri khalvidaṃ śāstram‌, parjanyavat‌; nākṛtakāri dahanavat‌| evaṃ tarhi cakāreṇaitadākhyāyate--kvacid‌ īṣā-akṣādau prakṛtibhāva eva bhavati, na hrasvatvamiti| tena yaduktāmīṣā akṣādau prakṛtabhāvamātramiti, tanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati| yaṇādeśena saha vikalpārthaṃ śākalyagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi' ityādi| yaṇādeśasya hyasavarṇa evājviṣayaḥ; savarṇe tu `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101) iti dīrghavidhānāt‌| ayamapi ca śākalo hrasvo vidhīyate| ata evāsmin‌ viṣaya ārambhasāmarthyādevāsya vidheryaṇādeśena saha vikalpaḥ siddha iti na tadarthamācāryagrahaṇam‌| `sinnityasamāsayoḥ' ityādi| ekāpi saptamī dvidhā bhidyate; apekṣābhedāt‌| sidapekṣayā parasaptamī, nitsasamāsāpekṣayā viṣayasaptamī| sicca nityasamāsaśceti dvandvaḥ--sa idyasya sa sit‌| nityādhikāre vihitaḥ samāso nityasamāsaḥ| śākalyasyāyaṃ vidhiḥ śākalaḥ--`kaṇvādibhyo gotre' (4.2.111) ityaṇ‌ `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ, `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) iti yakāralopaḥ| śākalasya pratiṣedhaḥ śākalapratiṣedhaḥ| `vaktavya' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌, `sarvatra vibhāṣā goḥ' (6.1.122) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena sinnityasamāsayoḥ śākalapratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| `ṛtviyaḥ' iti| ṛtuḥ prāpto'syeti `ṛtoraṇ‌' (5.1.105) `chandasi ghas‌' (5.1.106) iti ghas‌| `vyākaraṇam‌' iti| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| atra hi `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ' (2.2.17) ityato nityagrahaṇānuvṛtternitayasamāso'yam‌| `kumāryarthama' iti| kumāryā idaṃ kumāryarthamiti| `arthaśabdena saha' samāsavacanaṃ sarvaliṅgatā ca' (vā.78) ityayamapi nityasamāsa eva| sarvatra śākalavidhau pratiṣiddhe yaṇādeśo bhavatyeva|| 128. ṛtyakaḥ| (6.1.128) `savarṇārthamanigarthañca vacanam‌' iti| anyatra pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌| yadi savarṇārthaṃ vacanam‌, kathaṃ tarhi khaṭvarśya ityudāharaṇam‌, na hyatra savarṇo'cparaḥ naitadasti; `anigarthañca' iti yaduktaṃ tasyodāharaṇam‌| ata evāka ityupāttaṃ sūtre; anyatheka ityanuvarttanīyaṃ syāt‌| satyasmin‌ yoge savarṇārthe'pyako'nenaiva yukto hrasvaprakṛtibhāvo paratvādatyasyodāharaṇasyopanyāsaḥ|| 129. aplutavadupasthite| (6.1.129) ṛṣau-vede bhava ārṣaḥ, tasmādanyo laukiko'nārṣaḥ| `samudāyāt‌' iti| vākyādityarthaḥ| kuta etata? padarahitasya vakyasyāprayogāt‌| vākyasya ca samudayātmakatvāt‌| `avacchidya' iti| pṛthak‌ kṛtvetyarthaḥ| `svarūpe vyavasthāpyate' [svarūpe'vasthāpyate--kāśikā] iti| śabdapadātmakatāyāṃ vyavasthāpyata ityarthaḥ| `aplutavat‌' iti| aplutena tulyaṃ varttata ityaplutavat‌| yena sādharmyeṇāplutavadbhavati taddarśayitumāha--`plutakāryam‌' ityādi| tadanena plutakāryasyārthaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, na tu plutasyeti darśitaṃ bhavati| `suślokā 3' iti| `dūrāddhūte ca' (8.2.84) iti plutaḥ| `suślokā' iti| plutakāryasyākaraṇādekādeśo bhavatyeva| nanu caikādeśenāpi na bhavitavyam‌, tasyāpi plutakāryatvāt‌? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vacanasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ plutasaṃśabdanenaiva plutasya yatkāryaṃ vihitaṃ tasyaiva pratiṣedhaḥ, na sarvasya plṛtakāryasya| na caikādeśa evaṃ vihitaḥ| `vatkaraṇaṃ kim‌' iti| kāryamātrasya pratiṣedhe sati plutasya dhavaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ vatkaraṇaṃ syāt‌| satyapi ca kāryamātrasya prakṛtibhāvasya pratiṣedhenaiva plutaśrutyā bhavitavyam‌; ekadeśena nivarttitatvāt‌| tat‌ kasmāt‌ plutasyaiva pratiṣedho na kriyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| plutapratiṣedhe vakṣyamāṇaṃ doṣaṃ cetasi kṛtvā''ha--`pluta ityucyamāne' ityādi| `tatra ko doṣaḥ' iti| yo vatkaraṇe sati na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `pragṛhyāśraye' ityādi| pragṛhya āśrayo yasya tasmin‌ pratibhāve sati pragṛhyasaṃjñako yaḥ plutastasya śravaṇaṃ na syāt‌, yadi pluta eva pratiṣidhyeta| vatkaraṇe tu sati plutakāryasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho bhavati na plutasyaiva| tatra plutāśraye prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe'pi pragṛhyāśrayasyāpratiṣiddhatvādasatyekādeśa eva doṣo na bhavati| `agnī iti'| `idūded‌dvivacanam‌' (1.1.11) ityādinā pragṛhayasaṃjñā, `guroranṛta' (8.2.86) ityādinā plutaḥ|| 130. ī 3 cākravarmaṇasya| (6.1.130) `aci parataḥ' iti| etena `upasthite' ityetannivṛttam‌; asvaritatvāditi sūcayati| `astu hī 3' iti| `asu kṣepaṇe', (dhā.pā.1209) loṭ‌, sip‌| `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti sehiḥ, vyatyanena śluḥ| `kṣiyāśīḥ-praiṣeṣu tiṅākāṅkṣam‌' (8.2.104) iti plutaḥ| `tadupasthite nivṛttyartham‌' iti| tatra pūrveṇāplutavadbhāvasya nityaṃ prāpatatvāt‌| `anuyasthite prāptyartham‌' iti| tatra kenacidaprāptatvāt‌| `īkārāt‌' ityādi| kathaṃ punarikārādanyatrāpīṣyamāṇo'pyeṣo'plutavadabhāvo labhyate? `iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca' (6.1.127) ityato'nuvṛttasya cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt‌|| 131. diva ut‌| (6.1.131) `sānubandhakatvāt‌' iti| kasya dhātoranantaram‌? prakṛtatvāt‌ tasyaiva| dīvyatirghātuḥ sānubandhaḥ, pratipadikaṃ tu divityetanniranubandhakam‌, niranubandhakasya ca sūtra upādānam‌; tasmāt‌ `niranubandhakasya grahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti prātipadikasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌, na dhātoriti| `dyukāmaḥ' iti| divikāmo'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ, divaṃ kāmayata iti vā| `śīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇo vaktavyaḥ' (vā.229) iti ṇapratyayaḥ| `dyumāna' iti| dyaurasyāstīti `tadasyāstyasminniti matup‌' (5.2.94)| `vimaladyu dinam‌' iti| vimalā dyaurasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| `akṣadyūbhyām‌, akṣadyūbhiḥ' iti| akṣaśabda upapade dīvyaterdhātoḥ kvip‌, `cchṣoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityūṭh‌| atha tapakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā yadyapi `ṛta ut‌' (6.1.111) ityatra tapakaraṇena `bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān‌ gṛhlāti' (cāṃ.pa.pā.44) iti jñāpitam‌, tathāpyatrāntaryato'rddhamātrākālasya vyajañjanasya mātrika eva bhaviṣyati; na dīrghaḥ? ityata āha--`tapakaraṇam‌' ityādi| yadyapyanena dīrgo na prāpnoti, lakṣaṇāntareṇa tu dyubhyāṃ dyubhiḥ--ityatroṭh‌ prāpnoti, ataḥ sa mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ taparakaraṇam‌| syādetat‌| nanu coṭhprāptireva nāsti, kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena taparakaraṇena? ityata āha--`dyubhyām‌, dyubhiḥ' iti| `atra hi' ityādi| uttvasyāvakāśo yatra jhalādiḥ kvipparo na vidyate--vimaladyu dinamiti, ūṭho'vakāśaḥ--akṣadyūbhyāmiti; dyubhyāmityādāvubhayaprasaṅge paratvādūṭh prāpnoti, taparakaraṇāduttvameva bhavati| yadi tarhi prāptasyoṭho nivṛttye taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate, evaṃ sati `cachvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityatara kathaṃ `dyubhyām‌ dyubhiḥ' iti pareṇa codite yadvakṣyati--"ūṭhi kṛte `diva ut‌' iti paratvānmātrākālo bhaviṣyati" iti, tadvirudhyate; tasyoṭhi kṛte'bhinivṛtte tasya sthāne mātrākāla ukāro bhaviṣyatītyayamarthaḥ? nāsti virodhaḥ; `ūṭhi kṛte' ityasya hi granthasya pūrveṇa codyagranthena saha sambandhaḥ, netareṇa parihāragranthena| tatra `kecidatra kṅitīti nānuvarttayanti' ityasmin‌ darśanāntare upanyaste `kathaṃ dyubhyāṃ dyubhirityūṭhi kṛte' iti deśyam‌| tatrāyaṃ codayiturabhiprāyaḥ--yadi kṅitīti nānuvartteta, tadā dyubhyāṃ dyubhiritayatarāpyūḍeva karttavayaḥ, tataścoṭhi kṛte kathaṃ dyubhyāṃ dyubhiriti sidhyati, yāvatā dyūbhyāṃ dyūbhiriti bhavitavyamityasya deśyasya `diva ut‌' iti taparatvānmātrākālo bhaviṣyatītyeṣa parihāraḥ| atrāpyayaṃ pariharttarabhiprāyaḥ--taparakaraṇasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--ūṭh‌ mā bhūdati; anyathā tadanarthakaṃ syāt‌, tasmāduttvameva karttavyam‌ na tūḍbhāva iti| ye tu `kṅiti' ityanuvarttayanti, teṣāṃ taparakaraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌|| 132. etattadoḥ sulopo'ko'nañsamāse hali| (6.1.132) `nañsamāse na varttete' iti| anena kriyāsambandhaṃ darśayan‌ `anañsamāse iti prasajyapratiṣedho'yamiti darśayati| paryudāse hi sati nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) nañsamāsādanyasmin‌ samāse vartamānayoḥ syāt‌--paramaiṣa dadāti, paramasa dadātīti; eṣa dadāti, sa dadātītyatra na syāt‌| atha `sa sampradānam‌' (1.4.32) ityādiko nirdeśo jñāpayati--asamāse'pi bhavatīti? ucyate; evamapyetacchabdasya na syāt‌, yogāpekṣe tu jñāpaka āśrīyamāṇe pratipattigauravaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `tayoryaḥ suśabdaḥ' iti| etena `etattadoḥ' iti suśabdāpekṣayā sambandhalakṣaṇeyaṃ ṣaṣṭhītyācaṣṭe| yadyavam‌, suśabdasya sāpekṣatvādasāmarthye sati lopaśabdena saha samāso nopapadyate| gamakatvat‌ sāpekṣasyāpi samāso bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| atha vā--asamānanirdeśa sati lopaśabdena saha samāso nopapadyate| gamakatvākat‌ sāpekṣasyāpi samāso bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| atha vā--asamānanirdeśa evāyam‌, ṣaṣṭhī tu `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) ityanenaiva luptatvānna śrūyate| `kaśca tayoḥ suśabdaḥ' iti| evaṃ manyate--ānantaryalakṣaṇena vā sambandenaitattadoḥ suśabdaḥ sambandhī syāt‌, arthadvāreṇa vā; tatra hi pūrvasmin‌ pakṣe saptamībahuvacanasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| bhavati hi tadetadorānantaryalakṣamena sambandhena sambandhī| itarasmin‌ `anañsamāse' iti pratiṣedhasyaiva vaiyarthya syāt‌--aneṣo dadāti, aso dadātīti| atra hi samāsadvāreṇa suśabdaḥ samāsatyaiva sambandhī, na tvetattadoriti| nanu ca sānubandhakatvāt‌ saptamībahuvacanaṃ nāśaṅkanīyameva? naitadasti; prathamaikavacanamapi hi tadgaṇasaṃvijñāne bahuvrīhau sānubandhakameva| tadguṇasaṃvijñāna iti `ekānubandhagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.52) ityatara yadastyekānubandhagrahaṇaṃ tadapekṣya bodhyam‌| tatrātadguṇasaṃvijñāne'ṅgīkṛta etadvacanaṃ na ghaṭate; anubandhaṃ tyaktvā suśabdo nāsti, kiṃ tarhi? saśabdaḥ| iyām̐stu viśeṣaḥ--ekasaya pakāro'nubandhaḥ, aparasya tūkāra iti| tasmād‌dvayorapi sānubandhakatvāt‌ sapatamībahuvacanamapi yuktamāśaṅkitum‌| dvitīye tu pakṣe yo doṣaḥ, tamuttaratra parihariyiṣyāmīti cetasi
