kṛtvā''ha--`yastadarthena sambandhaḥ' iti| evaṃ bruvatā prathamaikavacanaṃ tayoḥ sambandhītyuktaṃ bhavati| kathaṃ kṛtvā? etattacchabdau hi prātipadike| `trikaśca prātipadikārthaḥ' itīdamatra darśanamāśritam‌| tathā hi `bahuṣu bahuvacanam‌' (1.4.21) ityatra bahuṣu bahavacanaṃ bhavati| bahutvamasasaya vācyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| `karmādayo'pyapare vibhaktīnāṃ vācyāstadīye' (1.4.21) ityatra bruvāṇena saṃkhyāyāḥ karmādīnāṃ ca vibhakti vācyatvamiti darśitam‌, arthācca trikatvam‌, `svārthadravyaliṅgātmakaṃ prātipadikārthaḥ' iti tasya prātipadikārthasya yadekatvaṃ tatra prathamaikavacanameva bhavati, na saptamībahuvacanam‌| tad‌vyadhikaraṇasyaiva bahutve bhavati| tasmādetattadorarthadvārakeṇa prathamaikavacanameva sambaddham‌, na saptamībahuvacanam‌| `eṣa dadāti' iti| `tado saḥ sāvanantyayoḥ' (7.2.106) iti satvam‌, tyadādyatvam‌, `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvam‌| `eṣakaḥ' iti| `avyayasaravanāmnāmakac‌ prāk‌ ṭeḥ' (5.3.71) ityakac‌| nanu sākackāvetau bhinnarūpatvādetattadau na bhavataḥ, tat‌ kim‌ `akoḥ' iti pratiṣedhena? ityata āha--`tanmadhyayatitaḥ' ityādi| tasmāśca paribhāṣāyā (vyā.pa.21) astitva eṣa eva `akoḥ' iti pratiṣedho jñāpakaḥ, `nedamadasorakoḥ' (7.1.11) iti ca| nanu ca nañsamāse kṛte śabdāntarasya sambandhī surbhavati, naitattadauḥ, tataśca prasaṅgo nāstīti kim‌ `anañsamāse iti paratiṣedhena? ityata āha--`uttarapadārthapradhānatvāt‌' ityādi| yadyapi śabdāntaraṃ nañsamāsaḥ, tathāpi tasyottarapadārthapradhānatvādetattadoścottarapadatvāt‌ tatsambandhinyāmeva saṃkhyāyāṃ suśabda utpanna iti tayoreva surbhavati| tasmādasti prāptiriti pratiṣedhaḥ| kriyate| samāsa iti kim‌? vākye pratiṣedho mā bhūt‌--naiṣa dadāti, na sa paśyatīti|| 133. syaśchandasi bahulam‌| (6.1.133) `syaḥ' iti tyadaḥ prathamaikavacanam‌, tasyānukaraṇam‌| tasmācca yā ṣaṣṭhyutpannā tasyāḥ `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) ityādinā luk‌| anutpattireva tasyāḥ, anukāryānukaraṇayorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt‌, yathā--gavityayamāheti| udāharaṇe tu pūrvavat‌ satvādi kāryam‌|| 134. so'ci lope cetpādapūraṇam‌| (6.1.134) so'cīti pūrvavat‌ tasya prathamaikavacanāntasyānukaraṇam‌| pādapūraṇam‌-pādaniṣpattiḥ| nanu cārambhasāmarthyādevāci vijñāyate, hali hi pūrvoṇaiva siddhatvāt‌, tat‌ kimarthamacīti kriyate? ityāha-`acīti vispaṣṭārtham‌' iti| `kecidicchanti' iti| te cchandograhaṇaṃ nānuvarttayantīti|| 135. suṭ‌ kātpūrvaḥ| (6.1.135) `saṃskārttā' iti| `sampuṃkānāṃ satvam‌' (vā.936) iti vacanāt‌ `samaḥ suṭi' (8.3.5) iti nirdeśādvā samo makārasya sakāraḥ, `atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu vā' (8.3.2) iti pūrvākārasyānunāsikaḥ| atha kātpūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā suḍayamādiliṅgaḥ, karotiśca kakārādiḥ, tatrāntareṇāpi kātpūrvagrahaṇaṃ `ādyantau ṭakitau' (1.1.46) iti kātpūrvaṃ eva suṅbhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`kātpūrvagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| kiṃ punarabhaktatve satīṣṭaṃ sidhyatīti, atastajjñāpakaṃ prati yatnaḥ kriyate? ityāha--`tathā hi' ityādi| `kiṃ punarabhaktatve satīṣṭaṃ sidhyatīti, atastajjñāpakaṃ prati yatnaḥ kriyate? ityāha--`tathā hi' ityādi| `saṃskṛṣīṣṭa' iti| āśiṣi liṅ‌ sīyuṭ‌ āmanepadam‌, `uśca' (1.2.12) iti kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ, `suṭ‌tiyoḥ' (3.4.107) iti takārasaya suḍāgamaḥ, kātpūrvaḥ suṭ, sa yadi karoterbhaktaḥ syāt‌ tatastasya karotigrahaṇena grahamāt‌ kṛñaḥ saṃyogāditvaṃ jātamiti `ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ' (7.2.43) itīṭ‌ prasajyeta| `saṃskriyate' iti| laṭ‌ karmaṇyātmanepadam‌, yak‌, `riṅ‌ śayagliṅkṣu' (7.4.28) iti riṅādeśaḥ| tatra yadi karotibhaktatvaṃ suṭaḥ syāt‌, tataśca saṃyogāditvaṃ karoterjātamiti `guṇo'rttisaṃyogādyoḥ' (7.4.29) iti guṇaḥ syāt‌| abhaktatve tu suṭaḥ saṃyogāditvādiṅguṇau na bhavataḥ| `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' ityādi| yadyabhaktaḥ suṭ‌, tadā saṃskriyata ityatra samaḥ padasya suṭā vyavahitatvāt‌ `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighāto na sidhyati| na ca suṭa eva padasya tiṅo labhyate; `padāt‌' (8.1.17) ityadhikārāt‌ suṭaścāpadatvāt‌| `svaravidhau' ityādi parihāraḥ| `ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ' (7.2.43) ityanena ṛkārāntasyāṅgasaya saṃyogāderliṭi guṇo vidhīyate, sa cābhakte suṭi karoterasaṃyogāditvānnopapadyata iti manyamāna āha--`sañcaskaratuḥ' ityādi| guṇaḥ katham‌? na kathañcidityarthaḥ| `tanmadhya' ityādi| dvirvacane kṛte dvau karotī bhavataḥ tanmadhye cāyaṃ vartate suṭ‌, ataḥ `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate'(vyā.pa.29) iti karotigrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate, tato nāstyasaṃyogāditvaṃ kṛña iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam‌' ityasmin‌ pakṣa uccāraṇamātraṃ bhidyate, dhātustveka eva, tatkarthaṃ karoterdvitvam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ, yadyapi dhāturabhinnaḥ tathāpyuccāraṇabhedād‌bhedastasyāśrita iti; `aṅabhyāsavyavāye'pi' (6.1.136) iti vacanāt‌| abhede hi vyavāya eva nāstītyabhyāsagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| athāpi kathañcit‌ sa tadgrahaṇena gṛhayate, evamapi guṇo bhavatyeveti darśayannāha--`saṃyoga' ityādi| saṃyogopadhagrahaṇe hi sati saṃyoga upadhā yasyeti saṃyogopadhatvena--ṛkāraṃ viśeṣya paścāt‌ tenāṅgaṃ viśiṣyeta--tadantasyāṅgasyeti| tatra yadyapi karoteraṅgaṃ saṃyogopadhaṃ na bhavati, ṛkārastu bhavatīti guṇo bhavatyeva| tarhyabhaktaḥ suṭ‌| ṭitkaraṇaṃ kimartham‌? taddhi tadāditvāt‌ tadbhaktatā yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate| abhaktaścet‌ suṭ‌ tadā ṭitkaraṇasya vaiyarthyamevāpannamityata āha--`ṭitkaraṇam‌' ityādi| `suṭstusavañjām‌' ityucyamāne suretyādau yaḥ suśabdo yaścopasaryastasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| tataścātisusthiraḥ, atisusthita ityādāvapi ṣatvaṃ prasajyeta| tasmādviśeṣaṇārthaṃ ṭitkaraṇam‌|| 136. aḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi| (6.1.136) `aṅvyavāye'bhyāsavyavāye'pi' iti| vyavāyaḥ-vyavadhānam‌| apiśabdādavyavāye'pi| asatyapiśabde vyavāya eva syāt‌| `samaskarot‌' iti| laṅ| `samaskārṣīt‌' iti| luṅ‌, cliḥ, tasya sic‌, `sici vṛddhiḥ' (7.2.1) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ, `astisico'pukte' (7.3.96) itīṭ‌| `sañcaskaratuḥ' iti| liṭ‌| yadi pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate, tadā sādhanābhidhāyini prāglakāre kṛte tannimittābhyāmaḍabhyāsābhyāṃ bhavitavyam, tataśca tadvyavadhāne sati suṅna prāpnotīti tadarthaṃ yujyate'syārambhaḥ| na ca pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate, kiṃ tarhi? upasargeṇa| yadi hi pūrvaṃ dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyeta paścādupasargeṇa, tato'nubhūyate kambalo devadattenetyatra karmaṇi lakāro na syāt‌; bhavaterakarmakatvāt‌| upasargeṇa pūrvaṃ dhātau sambandhyamāne na bhavatyeva doṣaḥ; akarmakā api dhātavaḥ sopasargāḥ sakarmakā bhavantīti| tasmāt‌ pūrva dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate, tataśca dhātūpasargayoḥ kāryamantaraṅgam‌; tannimitayordhātūpasargayoraḍabhyāsanimittāt‌ pratyaviśeṣāt‌ prāgeva saṃvidhānāt‌| aḍabhyāsau tu bahiraṅgau; uttarakālabhāvipratyayaviśeṣāpekṣatvāt‌| dhātūpasargakāryañca suṭ‌, tannimitatvāt‌| atastenāntaraṅgatvād‌dhātūpasargayorupādanamanantarameva bhavitavyam‌| na hyasāvupajātanimitto lakārasya tāvadutpattiṃ prayokṣate| kutaḥ punaraḍabhyāsau? ityabhiprāyeṇāha--`kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate' ityādi| itarastu naivedamaprāptasya suṭaḥ prāpaṇārthamārabhyate| kiṃ tarhi? kṛtayoraḍabhyāsayostadvyavāye katpūrvaḥ suṅyathā syāt‌, akṛtayormā bhūdityevamarthamiti darśayitumāha--`pūrvam‌' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetvarthaḥ| tatra dhātoḥ pūrvamupasargeṇa yogaḥ suṭo'ntarahgatāyāṃ hetuḥ pūrvaṃ suṭkaraṇasya, tadapi `paścādaḍabhyāsau' iti| karttavyāviti śeṣaḥ| yato dhātuḥ pūrvamupasargeṇa yujyate, tena dhātūpasargayoḥ kāryaṃ naiva kiñcida niṣṭamāpadyate? ityāha--`ubhaktaśca suḍityuktam‌, ityādi| pūrvameva hyabhaktatvaṃ suṭaḥ pratipāditam‌, atastasya karotigrahaṇenāgrahaṇe sati paścādbhavantau sakārāt‌ parāvaḍabhyāsāvaniṣṭe deśe syātān‌, tataśceṣṭarūpaṃ na sidhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| atha satyapyasmin‌ kathamayaṃ doṣo na bhavatītyāha--`etasmiṃstu satyata eva' ityādi| atra tu sutre satyata eva yāvadaḍabhyāsavyavāyo na bhavati tāvat‌ suṭā bhavitavyameva| tasmāt‌ pūrvamaḍabhyāsau karttavyau, tatastad‌vyavāye sati kāt‌ pūrvaṃ suḍiti sarvamiṣṭaṃ sidhyati|| 137. samparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe| (6.1.137) `sampūrvasya kvacidabhūṣaṇe'pīṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo labhyate? `saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' (4.2.16) ityācāryapravṛtteliṅgāt‌|| 138. samavāye ca| (6.1.138) `samavāyaḥ samudāyaḥ' iti| samavapūrvādimo bhāve `erac‌' (3.3.56) ityac‌| samavāya iti saṅghāt‌ ityarthaḥ| `samudita ityarthaḥ' iti| bhāve niṣṭhā|| 139. upātpratiyatnavaikṛtavākyādhyāhāreṣu| (6.1.139) `sataḥ' ityādi| labdhasattākasyārthasya purvotpannobhyo guṇebhyo yo'nyo guṇastadguṇāntaram‌, tadādhīyata utpādyate yena tadguṇāntarādhānam‌| tatpunaḥ kimartham‌? ityāha--`ādhikyāya' ityādi| kiṃ tat‌? ityāha--`samīhā' iti| tadevaṃ vidyamānasya vastana ādhikyāya vṛddhaye vṛddhasya caiva tādavasthyāya tasyā vṛddhāvasthāyā aparihāṇāya guṇāntarādhānaṃ yayādhīyate samīhayāṃ ceṣṭayā sa pratiyatna ityucyate| `vikṛtam' iti| jātavikriyamityarthaḥ| `gamyamānārthasya vākyasya svarapeṇa' iti| `samudāyeṣu hi pravṛttāḥ śabdā avayaveṣvapi varttante' (vyā pa.sū.85) iti pratīyamāno'rthaḥ prakaraṇādivākyasyaikadeśo vākyaśabdenoktaḥ| gamyamānārthasyāpi sukhapratipattaye svarūpeṇopādānaṃ vākyādhyāhāraḥ|| 140. kiratau lavane| (6.1.140) `lavanaviṣaye' ityādi| anena lavanaṃ kiraternābhidheyatayā viśeṣaṇam‌, api tu tadarthasya viṣayabhāvaneti darśayati| kena punaratra ṇamul‌, yāvatā `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul‌ ca' (3.4.22) ityādinā śāstreṇa sa ābhīkṣṇyādāvapyarthe vidhīyate| na cātra so'rto vivakṣitaḥ, nāpi pratīyata ityāha--`ṇamulatra' ityādi| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatreva vyākhyānam‌--`kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam‌ (3.3.113) ityato bahulavacanāt‌ bhaviṣyati|| 141. hiṃsāyāṃ prateśca| (6.1.141) `hiṃsāyāṃ viṣaye' iti| etena kiraternābhidheyatvena hiṃsā viśeṣaṇam‌| api tu tadarthasya viṣayabhāveneti darśayati| `pratiskīrṇam‌' iti| `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam‌, raparatvañca, `radābhyām‌' (8.2.42) ityādinā niṣṭhānatvam‌, `hali ca' (8.2.77) itī dīrghatvam‌| `tathā' ityādinā kiraterarthasya hiṃsāviṣayatāṃ darśayati| `anubadhnāti' iti| anugacchatītyarthaḥ|| 142. apāccatuṣpācchakaniṣvālekhane| (6.1.142) `tasmin‌ viṣaye' ityādi| anenāpyālekhanaṃ kiraternābhidheyatayā viśeṣaṇam‌, api tu tadarthasya viṣayabhāveneti darśayati| `apaskirate' iti| `tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ' (3.1.77) iti śaḥ, pūrvavaditvaṃ rapatvam‌| `ālikhya' ityādinā lekhanasya kiratyarthasya viṣayatāmudbhāvayati| ālikhyeti ākṛṣyetyarthaḥ| catuṣpācchakunisādhanasya lekhanasya sāmānyenopādānādihāpi prāpnoti--apakirati śvaudanapiṇḍamāśita iti, ata idamālekhanaviśeṣaṇamāha--`harṣajīvikā' ityādi| harṣaḥ-pramodaḥ| jīvikā-prāṇadhāraṇopāyaḥ| kulāyaḥ-āśramaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ harṣādaṣvātmanepadaṃ bhavati, na tviha pratyudāharaṇe? ityāha--`harṣajīvikākulāyakaraṇeṣveva' ityādi| 143. kustusburūṇi jātiḥ| (6.1.143) nanu ca sūtre napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśānnapuṃsakaliṅgatāyāṃ phalajātāveva bhavitavyam‌, nānyaliṅgatāyām‌, auṣadhajātau bahuvacana eva bhavitavyam‌, nānyatra, bahuvacanena nirdeśāt‌; tat‌ kathaṃ kustumbuvarityatra pulliṅgatayāmekavacane ca bhavati? ityata āha--`sūtranirdeśe' ityādi| napuṃsakagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇamātram‌| bahuvacanamapi hyatantrameva sūtre| tathā coktam‌--`sūtre [sūtranirdeśe napuṃsakaliṅgamavivakṣitam‌--kāśikā. padamaṃjarī ca] liṅgavacanamatantram‌ `tasyāvivakṣitatvāt‌' [nāsti--kāśikā] iti|| 144. aparasaparāḥ kriyāsātatye| (6.1.144) `aparasparāḥ' iti| apare ca pare ceti dvandvaḥ| santataśabdādbhāvapratyaya utpanne sāntatyamiti bhavitavyamityabhiprāyeṇāya--`kimidam‌' ityādi| satataśabdādevāyaṃ bhāvapratya utpanna iti darśayannāha--`satatasya bhāvaḥ' ityādi| `kathaṃ satatam‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--samo makāralopasya lakṣaṇaṃ tāvadiha śāstre nāsti| atha sātatya ityetadeva nipātanam‌, tataśabde parataḥ samo makārasya lopo bhaviṣyatītyasyārthasya jñāpanaṃ kalpyeta, evaṃ sati santatamiti na sidhyati? ityata āha--`samastate vikalpena' ityādi| ayamabhiprāyaḥ--sātatyaśabdaṃ pūrvācāryalakṣaṇaprasiddhamuccārayatā pūrvācāryalakṣaṇamapyāśritam‌| atastena samo makārasyātra lopo vidhīyate| etañca kṛtvā'vaśyamprabhṛtīnāmapi kṛtyādiṣu lopaḥ siddho bhavati| atastadeva pūrvācāryalakṣaṇaṃ darśayati--`lumpet‌' ityādi| antyamiti śeṣaḥ| avaśyaṃśabdasya kṛtyapratyayānte parato lumpet‌ antyalopamasya kuryādityarthaḥ| avaśyakarttavyam‌| tumun‌pratyayāntasyāpyāntyaṃ lumpet‌, kāmamanasośca śabdayoḥ parataḥ--karttuṃ kāmo'syeti karttukāmaḥ, harttu mano'syeti harttumanāḥ| samśabdasya cāntyaṃ lumpedvikalpena hitatayoḥ śabdayoḥ parataḥ--sahitam‌, satatam‌, santatam‌| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| māṃsaśabdasyāntyaṃ lumpet‌, kva? paci| `ḍupacaṣ‌ pāke' (dhā.pā.996) ityetasmin‌ dhātau| kiṃ viśiṣṭe? `yuṅghañoḥ' iti| lyuṭi ghañi ca pratyaye parato yaḥ pacistasminnityarthaḥ| atrāpi vāgrahaṇaṃ sambadhyate| māṃspacanam‌, māṃsapacanam‌| māṃspākaḥ, māṃsapākaḥ| `kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate' (vā.86) iti samāsaḥ| samāse'yaṃ lopaḥ pūrvācāryāṇāmabhiprāyaḥ, saṃhitāyāṃ ca| tena vākye vicchidyapāṭhe na bhavati|| 145. goṣpadaṃ sevitāsevitapramāṇeṣu| (6.1.145) `tasya ca ṣatvam‌' iti| anādeśapratyayasakāratvāt‌ suṭaḥ ṣatvaṃ na prāpnotītyatastadapi nipātyate| `gāvaḥ padyante' ityādinā deśasya sevitatvaṃ darśayati| `asevite' ityādi| nanu ca goṣpadaśabdaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ, tat‌ kasmādasevite'goṣpadādīnītyādyudāhriyate? ityāha--`asevite' ityādi| nanu ca goṣpadaśabdaḥ sūtra upātaḥ, tat‌ kasmādasevite'goṣpadādīnītyādyudāhriyate? ityāha--`asevite' ityādi| kriyate cedamasevitagrahaṇam‌, na ca tatra goṣpadaśabdaḥ sambhavati; tasmādasevite'goṣpadārthaṃ nipātanaṃ vijñāyate| `yadyevam‌' iti| yadyasevite'goṣpadārthaṃ nipātanamityarthaḥ| `nārtha etena' iti| asevitagrahaṇena| kathaṃ tena vinā sidhyati? ityāha--`goṣpadapratiṣedhāt‌'tyādi| `satyamevaitat‌' iti| goṣpadaparatiṣedhādityādi yaduktaṃ tasya satyatāmāha, na tu `nārthaṃ etena' ityasyārthaḥ| yadi tarhi satyamevaitat‌' tat‌ kimarthaṃ sevitagrahaṇamiha kriyate? ityāha--`yatra tu' ityādi| nañsamāse'goṣpada ityeṣa tatpuruṣaḥ svabhāvāduttarapadarthasadṛśamarthamācaṣṭe' abrāhmaṇavat‌| tataśca na goṣpadamagoṣpadamiti tatpuruṣe kṛte yatra sevitasaya sevanasya prasaṅgo'sti tatraivāgoṣpadamityetat‌ tathāpi bhavati' iti| apiśabdo na kevalaṃ yatra sevataprasaṅgo'sti tatraivāgoṣpadamityamumarthaṃ dyotayati| kasmāt‌? punaratrāsevitagrahaṇāt‌| tatrā'pi bhavatītyata āha--`yāni hi' iti| `evam‌' iti| asevitagrahaṇārthakaḥ prakāraḥ pratyavamṛśyate| asevitagrahaṇe hi sati mā bhūt‌ tasya vaiyarthyamita bahuvrīhirayaṃ bhāvasādhanenāsevitaśabdena vijñāsyate| avidyamānaṃ sevitamasminniti bahuvrīhiścātyantābhāve'pi bhavatīti yeṣu gavāmatyantāsambhavastānyaraṇyānyāsevitaśabdenocyante| tataśca tatrāpyagoṣpadamiti bhavati| `goṣpadapūram‌' iti| `varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām‌' (3.4.32) iti ṇamul‌| nanu ca goṣpadamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'yam‌, tasya ca gosambandhi padamarthaḥ, na tu pramāṇam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ goṣpadamātraṃ kṣetramityādi udāharaṇaṃ pramāṇe yujyatade? ityata āha--`nātra' ityādi| na hyatra svārthapratipādanārthameva goṣpadamityupādīyate| kiṃ tarhi? kṣetrāderiyattāṃ paricchettum‌| tasmāt‌ kṣetrāderiyattā tena paricchidyate- pramīyata iti bhavati pramāṇam‌| na cātra pramāṇaśabdenāyāma ucyate, kiṃ tarhi? paricchedamātram‌| kuta etat‌? nipātanasāmarthyāt‌| nipātanaṃ hi vastvaprasiddhamapyupādatte|| 146. āspadaṃ pratiṣṭāyām‌| (6.1.146) `ātmayāpanāya' iti| ātmayāpanam‌-prāṇadhāraṇam‌| tadarthaṃ yat‌ sthāpanaṃ tat‌ pratiṣṭhetyucyate| `āsapadam‌' iti| āṅaḥ parasya padasya suṭ‌ nipātyate| `āpadam‌' iti| `āṅ‌ maryādāvacane' (1.4.89) ityāṅaḥ karmapravacanīyatvam‌, tadyoge `pañcamyapāṅ‌ paribhiḥ' (2.3.10) iti pañcamī, tadantena `āṅ maryādābhi vidhyoḥ' (2.1.13) ityavyayībhāvasamāsaḥ|| 147. ārścayamanitye| (6.1.147) yadyanitye'śāśvatika āścaryamiti nipātyate, tato, ghaṭādiṣvapi syādityetaṃ doṣaṃ parijihīrṣurāha--`anityatayā' ityādi| adbhutam‌-citramityucyate| yalloke'dbhutaṃ taccitram‌, tasya bhāvo'dbhutatvam‌| tasya cānyatrābhāvādanityatā viṣayabhūtā, na hi tatra tato'nyatra sambhavati| tasmāt‌ tayā viṣayabhūtayā'dbhutatvamupalakṣyate| `āśascaryaṃ yadi sa bhuñjīta' iti| `anavaklṛptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛtte'pi' (3.3.145) ityanavaklṛptāvasambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ| bhojanaṃ kasyacidviśiṣṭakālādāvadṛṣṭapūrvam‌| atastatra bhavat‌ tadadbhutaṃ bhavati|| 148. varcaske'vaskaraḥ| (6.2.148) `kutsitaṃ varcaḥ varcaskam‌' iti| `kutsite' iti kanā nirdeśo dīptau mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| dīptādapi hi varcaḥśabdo varttata iti tatrāpi syāt‌| yadi varcaske'vaskaraśabdo nipātyate tadā tatsambandhideśe na prāpnoti| tatrāpi ca loke'vaskaraśabdaḥ prayujyata ityata āha--`tatsambandhāt‌' ityādi| yathā yaṣṭīḥ praveśayeti yaṣṭisambandhāt‌ puruṣā api yaṣṭiśabdenocyante, tathā avaskarasambandhādavaskaraśabdena deśaḥ|| 149. apaskaro rathāṅgam‌| (6.1.149) `rathāvayavaḥ' iti| anenādiśabdasthāvayavavacanamācaṣṭe|| 150. viṣkiraḥ śakunirvikiro vā| (6.1.150) nanu ca `viṣkiraḥ śakunau vā' ityetāvataiva suṅ‌viklapaḥ siddhaḥ, tatra kimarthaṃ vikiragrahaṇam‌? ityata āha--`śakunāveva vikiraśabdasya prayogo yathā syādanyatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vikirāgrahaṇam‌' (iti)|| 151. havasvāccandrottarapade mantre| (6.1.151) pūrvaṃ kātpūrvagrahaṇādabhaktaḥ suḍityuktam‌| iha kāt‌ pūrvatvaṃ na sambhavati, āgamaliṅgaṃ cāsya ṭittvamasti, tata āgama eva suṅ‌ vijñāyata ityāha--`suḍāgamo bhavati' iti| sa ca bhavan‌ `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān‌' (śāka.pa.pa.97) iti hrasvāditi pañcamyāḥ, candrotatarapada iti ca saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prakalpitāyāṃ candraśabadasyaiva bhavati| `suścandraḥ' iti| prādisamāsaḥ| `sūryācandramasau' iti| dvandvaḥ `devatādvandve ca' (6.3.26) ityānaṅ| atheha kasmānna bhavati--śuklamasi, candramasīti, atrāpi hrasvāt‌ paraścandraśabda uttarapadamasti? ityata āha--`uttarapadam‌' ityādi| śuklamasi, candramasati vākye| tasmādiha candraśabda uttarapadagrahaṇena na gṛhyata eva| yasmāduttarapadaṃ samāsa eva prasiddham‌|| 152. pratiṣkaśaśca kaśeḥ| (6.1.152) `pratigataḥ kaśāṃ pratikaśo'śvaḥ' iti| prādisamāsaḥ| nanu ca kaśāśabdo'pi kaśereva dhātoḥ pacādyacamutpādya sādhyate, tadihāpi suṭā bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`yadyapi' ityādi| kaśereva dhātoryadupādānaṃ tat‌ tasyaiva kaśeryaṃ upasargaḥ paratiśabdastasya pratipattiryathā syādityevamartham‌| na ca kaśeḥ pratirupasargaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? gameḥ| 153. praskaṇvahariścandrāvṛṣī| (6.1.153) `praskaṇvahariścandrau' iti| prakṛṣṭaḥ kaṇvo'syeti prasakaṇvaḥ| hariścandro'syeti hariścandraḥ| vyutpattimātarametat‌ kṛtam‌, na tvatrāvayavārtho'sti| rūḍhiśabdau hyetau pratyastamitāvayavārthau kvacideva ṛṣiviśeṣe vartete| nanu ca hariścandre `hrasvāccandrottarapade' (6.1.151) ityanenaiva suṭ‌ siddhaḥ, tatkimarthaṃ hariścandragrahaṇam‌? ityata āha--`hariścandragrahaṇam‌' ityādi| `prakaṇvaḥ' iti| pragataḥ kaṇvo'smāditi prakaṇvaḥ| haririva candro'syeti haricandraḥ|| 154. maskaramaskariṇau veṇuparivrājakayoḥ| (6.1.154) `parivrājake tavinirapi' iti| nipātyata ityapekṣate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam‌? na prāpnotīti, mātvārthāmāvāt‌| avidyamānamaskaro'pi parivrājako maskarītayucayate; maskariśabdasya tatraiva rūḍhatvāt‌| `acpratyayamapi nipātayanti' iti karttaryucyamānaḥ karaṇe na prāpnotītyacpratyayamapi nipātayanti| yadi ceha veṇau maskaraśabdo nipatyate tadā daṇḍe na prāpnoti, tatrāpi cāsau loke prayujyate? ityāha--`veṇugrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yena nivāryate tadapalakṣaṇārthaṃ veṇugrahaṇam‌| daṇḍenāpi nivāryata ityatrāpi bhavatyeva| `kamapivāditvāt‌' iti| sāṃsārikaṃ phalaṃ karmaṃ| tadapadadituṃ pratiṣeddhaṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa karmāpavādī, tasya bhavāḥ karmāpavāditvam‌| `sa hi' ityādinā tadeva karmāpavāditvaṃ darśayati|| 155. kāstīrājastunde nagare| (6.1.155) 156. kāraskaro vṛkṣaḥ| (6.1.156) `kecit‌' iti| yadi tarhi sūtrametat‌ kecinnādhīyate tat‌ kathaṃ teṣāṃ kāraskaśabdo vṛkṣe sidhyati? ityāha--`pāraskaraprabhṛtiṣveva' ityādi|| 157. pāraskaraprabhṛtīni ca saṃjñāyām‌| (6.1.157) pāraskaraprabhṛtayo rūḍhiśabdā yathākathañcidvayutpādyāḥ| nātrāvayavārthaṃ pratyabhiniveṣṭavyam‌| pāraṃ karotīti paraskaraḥ `kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu' (3.2.20) iti ṭaḥ| rayaṃ pātīti `rathaspā'| `ātonupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3)| kārya karotīti karoteḥrḍuḥ, kāryasya ca kirādeśaḥ--`kiṣkuḥ'| kimapyantardaghātīti dadhāteḥ pūrvavat‌ kaḥ, kimo rdvirvacanam‌, pūrvasya ca makārasya lopaḥ--`kiṣkindhā'| `tadbṛhatoḥ' ityādi| tat‌, bṛhat‌--ityetayoryathākramaṃ karapatiśabdayoḥ parataścore devatāyāñcābhidheyāyāṃ suṅ‌ bhavati, antyasya ca takārasya lopaḥ| tat‌ karotīti `kiṃ yattadbahuṣu' (vā.242) ityajvidhānam‌, tasakaraścauraḥ, tatkaro'nyaḥ| bṛhatāṃ patirbṛhaspatirdevatā, bṛhatpatiranyaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ cauradevatayorityupādhirupādīyate, yāvatā saṃjñāgrahaṇādeva tatparigrahaḥ siddhaḥ, na hyanyasya taskarabṛhasapatiśabdau saṃjñā? ityata āha--`saṃjñāgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| `prāttumpatau' ityādi| `tupa tumpa tṛptau' (dhā.pā.1309,1360?) iti parataḥ praśabdāt‌ parasya suṅbhavati gavi karttari| `prastumpati gauḥ'| pratumpatyevānyaḥ `yaduktam‌' iti bhāṣye| yadi tarhi pāraskaraparabhṛtirākṛtigaṇaḥ, `pratiṣkaśaśca kaśeḥ' (6.1.152) ityārabhya pūrvaṃ sūtraṃ na paṭhitavyam‌, tasyāpyanenaiva saṅgrahāt‌? satyametat‌; prapañcārthaṃ tu paṭhitavyam‌|| 158. anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam‌| (6.1.158) `ekavarjam‌' iti| ekaṃ varjayitvetyarthaḥ| `dvitīyāyāñca' (3.4.53) iti ṇamulpratyayaḥ| yadyayamadhikārārthaḥ syāt‌, tat‌ ṣāṣṭhika eva svaraḥ saṅgṛhītaḥ syāt‌| ye tvanye svarāḥ `samānodare śayita o codāttaḥ' (4.4.108), `asthidadhisakthyakṣṇāmanaṅudāttaḥ' (7.1.75) ityevamādayaḥ saptādhyāyyām‌, te na saṃgṛhītā syuḥ| paribhāṣāyāṃ tvasyāṃ te'pi saṃgṛhītā bhavanti| sā hyekadeśe sthitāpi sakalaṃ śāstramabhijvalayati, yathā veśma pradīpa ivetyālocyāha--`paribhāṣeyam‌' iti| vidhyaṅgaśeṣabhūtā ceyam‌| paribhāṣā hi kāryavākyānāṃ śeṣabhāvagatā| yasya padādayavasya svarita udātto vā vidhīyate tatra śeṣamanudāttaṃ bhavati| `svaravidhiviṣayā' iti| svaravidhirviṣayo'syā iti vigrahaḥ| `yatrānyaḥ' iti| anudāttāpekṣamanyatvam‌| `tatrānudāttaṃ padam‌' iti| nanu ca `nīcairanudāttaḥ' (1.2.30) ityanudāttaśabdo viśiṣṭaguṇe'vasaṅgītaḥ, tatrājjhalalakṣaṇañca padam‌, padaśabdasyārthastat‌ kathamatra sāmānādhikaraṇyam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; anudāttāckamanudāttaṃ padamihābhimatam‌, tena pada evānudāttaśabdo varttate| katham‌? matvarthīyākārāntatvāt‌| anudāttā asya santītyanudāttam‌| arśa āderākṛtigaṇatvādatrāc‌| ekavarjamityuktam‌, sa tveko na jñāyate yo varjanīyaḥ, tasyābhivyaktaye pṛcchati--`kaḥ punaḥ' ityādi| yasya codāttaḥ svarato vā vidhīyate sa evāko varjyate| yadi hyasāvapi na varjyate tasya tat‌ svaravidhānamanrathakaṃ syāt‌| `gopāyati, dhūpāyati' iti| `gupū rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.395) `dhīpa santāpe' (dhā.pā.396) `gupūdhūpa' (3.1.28) ityādinā''yaparatyayāntasya `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ (3.1.32) iti dhātusaṃjñā, `dhātoḥ' (6.1.162) iti dhātoścāntodāttatvam‌, āyapratyayāntasyāntyayakārākārasya dhātusvaratvam‌| `dhātusvaraṃ śnāsvaro bādhate' iti| satiśiṣṭasvaratvāt‌, satiśiṣṭasaya valīyastvāt‌| tathā hyu katam‌--`satiśiṣṭasvaro balīyāniti vaktavyam‌'| (vā.6.1.168) iti| `lunāti, punāti' iti| `pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ' (7.3.80) iti hrasvaḥ| śnāpratyayasaya ca pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvam‌| `śnāsvaram‌' iti| bādhata iti sambadhyate| nanu paratvāt‌ tibādiṣu kṛteṣu vikaraṇairbhavitavyam‌, ataḥ sati sārvadhātukasvare śnāsvarasya śiṣyamāṇatvāt‌ tasya satiśiṣṭatvam‌; evañca śnāsvareṇaiva bādhā yuktā tatasvarasya? evaṃ manyate yat‌ `tāsyanudāttenṅidupadeśa' (6.1.186) ityādinā tāseḥ parasya lasārvadhātukatvaṃ śāsti tajjñāpayati--śiṣṭo'pi vikaraṇasvaraḥ sārvadhātukasvareṇa bādhyata iti| `lunītaḥ, punītaḥ' iti| `ī halyadhoḥ (6.4.113) itītvam‌| `tassvaramāmsvaraḥ' iti| bādhata iti sambandhaḥ. bādhakatve tasya hetuḥ satiśiṣṭatvameva| `lunītastarām‌' iti| `tiṅśca' (5.3.56) iti tasantāttarap‌, tadantāt‌ `kimetiṅvyaya' (5.4.11) ityādinā''mupratyayaḥ| kimarthaṃ punarayamekavarjapadasvaro vidhīyate? ityāha--`āgamasya' ityādi| āgamādīnāṃ pṛthak‌ svaro mā mudityevamarthamekaṃ varjayitvā padānudāttvaṃ vidhīyate| `āgamasvaraḥ prakṛtisvaraṃ vādhate' iti| satyasminnekavarjaṃ padaṃ svare| asati tavasmin‌ parakṛterāgamasya ca pṛthageva svaraḥ syāt‌| `catvāraḥ' iti| prakṛtisvaraḥ punarādyudāttatvam‌| tathā hi `caterurana' (da.u.8.78) ityuranpratyayāntaścatuḥśabdo vyutpādyata iti sa nitsvareṇādyudātto bhavati| `anaṅvāhaḥ' iti| anuḍuho'pyevaṃ vyutpattiḥ kriyate| `ana prāṇane' (dhā.pā.1070) asmāt‌ `sarvadhātubhyo'sun‌' (da.u.9.49) ityasunpratyayāntatvādanaḥśabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| ano bahatotyanasi vaheḥ kvip‌ `uścānasaḥ' (da.u.9.49) ityasunparatayayāntatvādanaḥśabdo nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| ano bahatotyanasi vaheḥ kvip‌ `uścānasaḥ' (da.u.9.107) ityanasyupapade vaherdhātoḥ kvip‌, anaścokārādeśaḥ| vaheryajāditvāt‌ samprasāraṇam‌, upapadasamāsaḥ, `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvam‌| tasmādanuḍuho'pyevaṃ vyutpāditasya syādādyudāttatvam‌| vikāraḥ-ādeśaḥ| `anaṅsvaraḥ prakṛte' iti| dadhyasathiśabdāvādyudāttau| tathā hi `asu kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209) `asisañjibhyāṃ kthin‌' (da.u.1.10) iti kthinpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇāsthiśabda ādyudāttaḥ| dadhiśabdo'pi kinpratyayāntatvādādyudātta eva| dhādhātoḥ `ādṛgamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ‌ ca' (3.2.171) iti kinpratyayaḥ, tatra dvirvacane kṛta ākāralope ca dadhīti bhavati| `asthidadhi' (7.1.75) ityādinā'naṅi kṛte tasya yaḥ svaraḥ sa ca karttavayaḥ, tasyāpyasatyasminnasthidadhiśabdayoranaṅaśca prathagevodāttatvaṃ tu syāt‌| asmiṃstu satyanaṅa eva bhavati| `prakṛteḥ' ityādi| `gopāyati, dhūpāyati' iti| atra prakṛterguperdhūpeśca `dhātoḥ' (6.1.162) ityantodātttve āyapratyayāderapyākārasya pratyayādyudāttatvam‌| gopāyadhūpāyaśabdayorapi `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (3.1.32) iti dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyām‌ `dhātoḥ' (6.1.162) ityantodāttameva prāpnoti| evaṃ pṛthak‌ svaraprasaṃge yakārākārasyaiva dhātusvaro bhavati, na gupidhūpyoḥ, nāpi pratyayākārasya| `karttavyam‌' iti| dhātorantodāttatve pratyayasyādyudāttatve ca prāpte pratyayādyudāttatvameva bhavati, na tu dhātusvaraḥ| athāniyamenaikasvarasya varjayamānatā kasmānna bhavati, na hyatra sūtre kaścid‌vyavasthāheturupāttaḥ, na ca vinā vyavasthāhetunā sā labhyate? ityāha--`paranityāntaraṅga' ityādi| yatra parādisvarāḥ prāpnuvanti, tadvipakṣāśca, tatra parādīnāṃ balīyastvāt‌ tata eva varjayaṃ na, itare tu nivarttyante| yatra tu paranityāntaraṅgāpavāde'pi kvacidiṣṭaṃ na sidhyati, tatra satiśiṣṭena vyavasthā bhavati, tasya hi valīyasatvamuktam‌| ataḥ satiśiṣṭetarasvaraprāptau satiśiṣṭa eva varjyate, metaraḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ satiśiṣṭe na vyavasthā? ityata āha--`yo hi' ityādi| kathametajjñāyate? ityāha--`tathā hi' ityādi| `gopāyati' iti| atrāyapratyayasya pratyayasvareṇādyudāttatvam‌| sa ca svaro dhātusvarasyāpavādo'pi sannāyapratyayāntasya dhātusaṃjñāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ punastena dhātusvareṇa satiśiṣṭena bādhyate| `kārṣṇottarāsaṅgaputraḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiṃ kṛtvā tatpuruṣaḥ karttavyaḥ| `bahuvrīhisvaraḥ' iti| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1) ityādinoktaḥ| pūrvakaṃ jñāpakaṃ cetasa kṛtvā''ha--`vikaraṇasvarastu' ityādi| `vibhaktisvarāt‌' ityādi| `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) iti nañudāttaḥ| tatra tatpuruṣa samāse kṛte `tatpureṣe tulyārthaṃ' (6.2.2) ityadivā prakṛtasvarādudāttatvameva bhavati| yadā tu nañsvarādvibhaktisavaraḥ prāpnoti nañsvaraśceṣyate, tasmādvibhaktisvaro `balīyāniti vaktavyam‌| balīyastve sati kiṃ bhavati? ityāha--`atistara ityatra' ityādi| `tisṛbyo jasaḥ' (6.1.166) ityanena vibhakterudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| tadbalīyastvāt‌ satiśiṣṭamapi nañsavareṇa bādhyate| vibhaktasvarasya tu--tisraḥ, trisṛṣvityeṣo'vakāśaḥ| `vibhaktinimittasvarācca' ityādi| vibhaktirnimittaṃ yasya sa svaro vibhaktinimittasvaraḥ| `yasya vibhaktirnimittamāmaḥ' iti| āmo vibhaktinimittatvaṃ, `pathamathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne' (6.1.199) ityataḥ sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tasya `yadudāttatvam‌' ityādinā balīyastvasya phalaṃ darśayati| vibhaktinimittasvarasya--catvāraḥ, anaṅvāha itatyeṣo'vakāśaḥ| `vākye hi' ityādi| devadattaśabda āmantritasvareṇādyudāttatvam‌, gośabdo hi prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tasya `auto'mśasoḥ' (6.1.93) ityākāro'pi sthānivadbhāvenodātta eva| tathā vibhaktyā sahaikādeśe'pi `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) iti vacanāt‌| abhiśabdo'ntodāttaḥ, tasya `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80), `upasargāścābhivarjam‌' (phi.sū.4.81) ityādyudāttavidhāne varjitatvāt‌ prātipadikasvara eva bhavati| āṅupasargasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| ajityeṣa tu loḍantaḥ `tiṅṅatiṅa' (8.1.28) iti nidhātenānudāttaḥ| śuklaśabdo hi prātipadikasvareṇāntodātta iti tasya `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) iti ṭāpā sahaikādeśe kṛte'ntodātta eva bhavati| evamamipūravatve kṛte veditavyam‌| tadevaṃ padagrahaṇādvākya ekaikasmin‌ pade pṛthageva svaro bhavati| yadyanudāttaṃ padamekavarjaṃ bhavati, evaṃ sati yāvat‌ padasaṃjñā na bhavati tāvadekaṃ varjayitvā pariśiṣṭasyānudāttatvena bhavitavyam‌, tataśca kuvalyā vikāraḥ, kauvalamityatra `anudāttādeśca' (4.2.140) ityenenāñ‌pratyayo na syāt‌| yata kuvalaśabdoyaṃ `grāmadīnāñca' (phi.sū.2.38) ityādyudāttaḥ, gaurāditvānṅīṣi vihate'pi padavyapadeśābhāvādādyudāttatvaṃ na parityajatītyāha--`parimāṇārthaṃ cedam‌' ityādi| padamatra gauṇamabhipretam‌ na mukhyam‌; anyathā padādhikāre sati punaḥ padagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmāduttarakālaṃ yasya padasaṃjñā bhaviṣyati, tadiha padamabhipretamiti veditavyam‌| asati padagrahaṇe na jñāyate--kiyatāmacāmanudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti| padagrahaṇe tu satyekasmin‌ pade yāvanto'castāvatāmanudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyeṣo'rtho jñāyate, tasmāt‌ paramāṇārthamiti| natu subantasya tiṅntasya vā pratipādanārtham‌| tena prāgeva padavyadaiśādanudāttatvena bhavitavyamiti na bhavati pūrvoktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ| syādetat‌--yadyapi padamityanena mukhyaṃ padaṃ na pratyāyyate, tathāpi padādhikāreṇa tadiha sannidhāpyata iti tadavastha eva sa doṣaḥ? ityata āha--`padādhikārasya nivṛttiṃ karoti' iti| etat‌ padagrahaṇaṃ gauṇamarthaṃ pratipādayan‌ mukhyapadadhikāraṃ nivarttayati| tena kimiṣṭaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| `tathā ca' iti| evaṃ ca satītyarthaḥ prāgeva padavayapadeśāt svaravidhānatulyakālameva pariśiṣṭatasyānudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti| amumevārthaṃ draḍhayitamāha--`garbhiṇī' ityādi| garbho'syā astītīniḥ, `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp' (4.1.5) iti ṅīp‌| garbhaśabdo'yaṃ kuvalaśabdavadādyudāttaḥ| tatra yadīnipratyayasyodāttatvasamakālamevānudāttatvaṃ bhavati tato garbhiṇīśabdasyānudātatāditvāt‌ `anudātatāderañ‌ (4.2.44) ityañ‌ prāpnotīti tadbādhanārthaṃ yujyate tasya bhikṣādiṣu pāṭhaḥ| tasya tūttarakālaṃ padasaṃjñāyāmupajātāyāmavaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ syāt‌| evaṃ sati garbhiṇī śabda ādyudāttaḥ syāt‌| tataścāṇo bādhanārta bhikṣādiṣu na paṭhyeta, paṭhyate ca| tasmāt‌ tato vijñāyate--prāgeva padavyapadeśāt‌ svaravidhisamakālamevāvaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ labdhāyāṃ padasaṃjñāyāmavaśiṣṭasyānudātttve vidhīyamāne kuvalaśabdāvañ‌ na sidhyati, kathañca garbhiṇīśabdasyānudāttādilakṣamasyāño bādhanārtho bhikṣādiṣu pāṭhaḥ prāgeva padavayapadeśāt‌ svaravidhisamakālamevāvaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyasyārthasya jñāpakaḥ? ityāha--`kuvalagarbhaśabdau' ityādi| ādyudātttve hyanayoryadi padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāmavaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ syāt‌, kuvalīśabdasya ca syāt‌ tataśca kuvalīśabdādvikāre'rthe'ñ‌ na syāt‌| garbhiṇīśabdasyādyudāttatvādañ‌ prāpnoti, tatastadbādhanarthaṃ bhikṣādiṣu na paṭhyeta, paṭhyate ca, tasmādavasīyate--prāgeva padavyapadeśādavaśiṣṭasyānudāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 159. karṣātvato dhaño'nta udāttaḥ| (6.1.59) `karṣātvataḥ' iti| karṣaścātvāṃśceti karṣātvat‌--samāhāradvandvaḥ| ākāro'syāstītyātvān‌| `karṣaterdhātoḥ' iti| `kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā.1286) ityasyākāravataśceti sambadhyate| karṣatinā dātunā sāhacaryadātvo'pi dhātoreva grahaṇam‌| `dhañaḥ' iti pratyayagrahaṇam‌, ataḥ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantasya kāryaṃ jñāyata ityāha--`ghañantasya' iti| etacca karṣaterātvataśca samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌| `pākaḥ' ityādi| `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ dhātorākāravattvam‌| `dāyaḥ dhāyaḥ' iti| `āto yak‌ ciṇ‌kṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk‌| kimarthaṃ panaḥ prakṛte vikṛtasaya grahaṇaṃ kriyate na `kṛṣātaḥ ityevocyate? ityata āha--`karṣa iti vikṛtinirdeśaḥ' ityādi| kṛṣirvilekhanārtho bhvādau tudādau ca paṭhyate, tatra yasya vikaraṇe parato guṇātmako vikāro bhavati tasyaiva bhauvādikasya grahaṇamiṣyate, netarasya| etacca vikṛtanirdeśe sati labhyate| tasmāt‌ kṛṣatestaudādikasya nivṛttiryathā syadityevamartho vikṛtirdeśaḥ| kasmāt‌ punastaudādikasaya nivṛttiriṣyate? ityata āha--`taudīdikasya' ityādi| atha kimarthaṃ matupā nirdeśaḥ kriyate, na karṣāta ityovocyeta? naivaṃ śakyam‌, vihitaviśeṣaṇasyākārasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate--ākārāntādyo vihita iti| tathā ca dāya ityādādeva syāt‌, pāka ityādau na syāt‌| matub‌grahaṇe tu sati na doṣaḥ| antagrahaṇamuttarārtham‌, iha hi `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti bhaviṣyati|| 160. uñchādīnāṃ ca| (6.1.160) `uñchaḥ, mlecchaḥ, jañjaḥ, jalpaḥ' iti| `uchi uñche (dhā.pā.295) `mleccha avyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.1662), `jaja jaji yuddhe' (dhā.pā.242,243), `japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.397,398)| jañjeḥ kutvābhāvo nipātanāt‌| `japo vyadha ityavantau' iti| tatra `vyaghajaporanupasarge' (3.3.61) ityabantatvam‌| badhaśabdo hi `hanaśca vadhaḥ' (3.3.76) iti| `tayordhātusavaraḥ prāptaḥ' iti| `dhātoḥ' (6.1.162) ityudāttatvam‌| `vyadhaḥ' iti| `vyadha tāḍane' (dhā.pā.1181)| atrāpi vyadhajaporityabantatvam‌, pūrvavaddhātusvaraḥ prāptaḥ| `kālaviśeṣe' iti| kṛtadvāparādau| `rathādyupakaraṇe ca' iti| ādiśabdena halādergrahaṇam‌| `garaḥ' iti| `gṛ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410)| `ṛdorap‌' (3.3.57) ityabantaḥ| `viṣam‌' ityanena dūṣyaśabdasya viśeṣe vṛttiṃ darśayati| `anyatrādyudātta eva' iti| dhātusvareṇa| `vedavegaveṣṭabandhāḥ' iti| `vida jñāne (dhā.pā.1064) `vicir‌ pṛthagabhāve' (dhā.pā.1442) `veṣṭa veṣṭane' (dhāyapā.255) `bandha bandhane' (dhā.pā.1508)| ebhyo yathāyogaṃ paryādyupasargapūrvebhyaḥ kvip‌, prādasamāsaḥ| `anyatra madhyodāttaḥ' iti| varttaniśabdo hi `arttisṝghṝ' (da.u.1.2) ityato'nipratyaye'nuvarttamāne `vṛteśca' (da.3.1.6) ityanena `vṛtu varttane (dhā.pā.758) ityetasmādanipratyayamutpādya vyutpādyate| tasmāt‌ pratyayasvareṇa madhyodātto bhavati| `daraḥ' iti| `dṛ vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1493) ṛkārāntatvādabantaḥ| `sāmbatāpau bhāvagrarhāyām‌' iti| sahāmbayā vartata iti sāmbaḥ, `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam‌' (6.2.1) iti prakṛtisvareṇa sahaśabdasya `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) ityudāttatve prāpte bhāvagarhāyāmantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| sāmbo bhikṣate| bhikṣaṇamatra bhāvagrarhā| tapanaṃ tāpaḥ `tapa santāpe' (dhā.pā.985) ityasmādghañ‌| ādyudāttatve prāpte vacanam‌| tāpo dasyūnāṃ dhārmikeṣu bhāvagarhāyāmiti kim‌? sāmbastiṣṭati, tāpo mahān‌ grīṣmasya| anayorādyudāttatvameva| `uttamaśaśvattamau' iti| etau tamappratyayānto| pittvāt‌ pratyayasyānudāttatve ucchabdasya `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) ityudāttatvamityata ādyudāttatve prāpte'ntodāttārthamuttamaśabdaḥ paṭhyate| śaśvacchabdo'pi pratipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, tato madhyodāttatve prāpte'ntodāttārthameva paṭhyate| `sarvatra' iti| bhāvagarhāyām‌, anyatra ca| `bhakṣa--mantha' ityādi| `bhakṣa bhakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1557), [bhakṣa adane--dhā.pā.] `mantha viloḍane' (dhā.pā.42) `bhujakauṭilye' (dhā.pā.1417), [bhujo--dhā.pā.] `diha upacaye' (dhā.pā.1015)| nanu bhakṣiścurāditvāṇṇyanta iti tat‌ `erac‌' (3.3.56) ityacā bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathamasau ghañantaḥ? ityāha--`bhakṣirṇyanto'pi' ityādi| atraiva kāraṇamāha--`erajaṇyantānām‌' iti|| 161. anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ| (6.1.161) `kumārau' iti| `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti ṅīp‌, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ| `kumāraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ' iti| prātapadikasvareṇa| evamuttaratrāpyantodātatatā veditavyā| `ṅīp‌' iti| `anudāttaḥ' iti| pittvāt‌| `prāsaṅgyaḥ' iti| `tadvahati' (4.4.76) ityādinā prāgghitīyo yat‌| `prasaṅgaśabdaḥ' ityādi| `ṣanja saṅge' (dhā.pā.987) ityasmādghañamutpādya prāsaṅgaśabdo vyutpādyate, tasya `gatikārakopapadāt‌' (6.2.139) iti `tatpuruṣe' (6.2.123) iti varattamāne `thāthaghañktājabitrakāṇām‌' (6.2.144) ityantodāttatvaṃ vihitam‌, ato|sāvantodāttaḥ| `naitadasti' iti| `udātto luptate' iti yaduktaṃ tasya pratiṣedhaḥ| kasmānnaitadastītyāha--`svarite hi' ityādi| svaravidhisamakālameva śiṣṭasyānudāttattvaṃ bhavatīti prātipadikametat‌| tasmāt‌ svarite vidhīyamāne pariśiṣṭasyānudāttatvena bhavitavyam‌| tat‌ kuta udāttalopaḥ? na kutaścidityarthaḥ| `tadetat‌' ityādi| yasmādevamanudāttagrahaṇasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ na sambhavati, tasmādanudāttagrahaṇametadāderanudāttasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌; anyathā hyasyānarthakyameva syāt‌| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamāderanudāttasyodātto na sidhyati, yatastadarthamanudāttagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha--`anta iti hi' ityādi| avadhāraṇamātraṃ draṣṭaṣyam‌| antasyaiva syāt, nāderityarthaḥ| kva punarāderudāttārthamanudāttagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`mā hi dhukṣātām‌' ityādi| duherluṅ‌, ātmanepadamātāmāthām‌, tataśca `śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ' (3.1.45) iti cleḥ ksādeśaḥ, `tāsyānudātta' (6.1.186) ityādinā lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatvam‌, `ksasyāci' (7.3.72) ityakāralopaḥ, ksasyākāraḥ pratyayasvareṇodāttaḥ, `dāderdhātorghaḥ' (8.2.32) `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌, ghakārasya kakāraḥ, ṣatvam‌| atrāsatyanudāttagrahaṇa ātāmāthāmākārasyādibhūtasyānudāttatvaṃ na syāt‌, sati tvasminnākārasyādibhūtasyodāttatvaṃ syāt‌| hiśabdasya prayoge `hi ca' (8.1.34) iti nighātapratiṣedho na syāt‌| nighāte hi tiṅntasyāsatyudāttalopo na syāt‌| māṅprayogo'pyaṭaḥ `na māṅyoge' (6.4.74) iti pratiṣedho yathā syāt‌| aṭi hi tasyodāttatvāccheṣasyānudāttatvaṃ syāt‌, tathā ca satyanudāttasthākāralopaḥ syāt‌, nodāttasya| `bhṛgavaḥ' iti| bhṛgorapatyāni `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇi' (4.1.114) ityādinā ṛṣyaṇa, tasya `atribhṛgukutsa' (2.4.65) ityādinā bahuṣu luk‌| nanu cātrāpi vibhaktāvutpannāyāmudāttasya lopaḥ, tasmādihāpi bhavitavyameva? ityata āha--`prāk‌ subutpatteḥ' ityādi| na hi gotrapratyayasaya lugvidhau vibhaktirnimittatvenāśrīyate| tasmāt‌ prāgeva gotrapratyayasya luk‌, tato nātrānuvāttatvam‌| `baidī, aurvī' iti| vidasyāpatyam‌, urvasyāpatyamiti `anṛṣyānantaryye bidādibhyo'ñ‌' (4.1.104) ityañ‌, ñitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ `ṭiḍhḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌|| 162. dhātoḥ| (6.1.162) `ūrṇoti' iti| adāditvācchapo luk‌|| 163. citaḥ| (6.1.163) `bhaṅaguram‌' ityādau pratyayasvarasyāpavādo'ntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| `kuṇḍināḥ' iti| atra tu sthānivadbhāvaḥ svarasya| kuṇḍinośabdasyāyamādeśaḥ, sa ca pratayayasvareṇa madhyodātta iti tadādeśo'pi madhyodātta eva sāt‌| kuṇḍamasyāstītīniḥ, tadantāt‌ striyāṃ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' (4.1.5) itī ṅīp‌| kuṇḍinyā apatyāni bahunīti gargāditvāt‌ yañ‌ (4.1.105), tasya bahuṣu luk‌| pariśiṣṭasya kuṇḍinajādeśaḥ| `citi pratayaye' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyāntodāttatvaṃ labhyate? yathā labhyate tathākhyāyate--iha cita iti samudāyasambandhe'vayavādeṣā ṣaṣṭhī| cito'vayavasya sambandhī yaḥ samudāyaḥ tasyāntodāttatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| atha vā cita iti matvarthīyācpratyayāntametat--cidasyāstīti citaḥ, tasyāntodāttatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| tena prakṛtipratyayasamudāyasyāntodāttatvaṃ sidhyati| yadi tarhi cita iti matvarthīyākārapratyayāntametat‌, tarhi subvyatyayena ṣaṣṭhyāḥ prasaṅge prathamā bhaviṣyati| `bahupaṭavaḥ' iti| īṣadasamāptāḥ paṭava iti `vibhāvā supo bahuc‌ purastāttu' (5.3.68) iti bahuc‌| `uccakaiḥ' iti| `avyayasarvanāmnāmakac‌ prākṭeḥ (5.3.72) ityakac‌|| 164. taddhitasya| (6.1.164) `kauñjāyanāḥ' iti| `kuñjādibhyaścphañ‌' (4.1.98) iti cphañantāt‌ `vrātacphañorastriyām‌' (5.3.113) ityāgatasya apratyayasya `tadrājasya bahuṣu' (2.4.62) ityādinā luk‌| `kimartham‌' iti| purveṇaiva siddhamiti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| `paramapi' ityādi| cphaño hi cakāraḥ `vrātacphañorastriyām‌' (5.3.113) ityatra viśeṣaṇena caritārthaḥ| ñakāro'pi vṛddhau| yadyevaṃ nocyeta tadā paratvān‌ñitsvaraḥ syāt‌| tasmāttamapi bādhitvāntodāttatvameva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyate|| 165. kitaḥ| (6.1.165) pratyayasvarasyāpavādo'yam‌| `ākṣikaḥ, śālākikaḥ' iti| `tena dīvyati' (4.4.2) ityarthe ṭhak‌|| 166. tisṛbhyo jasaḥ| (6.1.166) `tisrastaṣṭhanti' iti| `tricaturoḥ striyāṃ tisṛcatasṛ' (7.2.99) iti tisrādeśaḥ, `aci ra ṛtaḥ' (7.2.100) iti ṛkārasya rādeśaḥ| `udāttasvaritayoḥ' ityādi| triśabdaḥ prātapadikasvareṇāntodātta iti tadādeśo'pi tisṛśabdo'ntodātta eva| tatra ṛkārasyāntodāttasya sthāne vihito rapha udāttayaṇ‌ na bhavati| tataḥ parasya jasaḥ `udāttasvaritayoḥ' (8.2.4) ityādinā svaritaḥ prāpnoti, ato'syāyamapavādaḥ| atha jasgrahamaṃ kimartham‌, tisṛke'pyatra mā bhūditi cet‌? syādetat‌--triśabdāt‌ saṃjñāyāṃ kani kṛte tatra ca `tisṛbhāve kanyupasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.837) iti tisrādeśe tisṛketyatrāpi syāt‌ asati jas‌grahaṇa iti naitadasti; nitsvaro'tra bādhako bhaviṣyati| nāprāpate svarāntare tisṛsvara ārabhyate, sa yathaiva `anudāttau suptitau' (3.1.4) ityetatsvaraṃ bādhate tathā nitsvaramiti cet‌? naitadasti; yasmādyena nāprāpte tasya bādhanaṃ bhavati| na cāprāpte `anudāttau suptitau' (3.1.4) ityetasmin‌ tisṛsvara ārabhyate, nitsvare punaḥ prāpte cāprāpte ca| atha vā madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān‌ vidhīn‌ bādhante' (vyā.pa.10) ityeva tisṛsvare `anudāttau suptitau' (3.1.4) etyetaṃ bādhiṣyate, na nitsvaram‌| śasādinivṛttyarthaṃ tarhi jasgrahaṇamiti cet‌? etadapi nāsti; śasi tāvadbhavitavyamevāntodāttena--`udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt‌ (6.1.174) iti| anyāni sarvāṇi bahuvacanāni halādīni, tatra `ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' (6.1.174) iti| anyāni sarvāṇi bahuvacanāni halādīni, tatra `ṣaṭtricaturbhyo halādiḥ' (6.1.179) iti `jhalyupottamam‌' (6.1.80) ityudāttatvena bhavitavyam‌| bahuvacanaviṣayatvācca tisṛśabdasaya dvivacanaikavacane na staḥ| tatrāntareṇa jasgrahaṇaṃ jasa eva bhaviṣyatītyata āha--`jasgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| eke bhāṣyakārādayaḥ| asati jasgrahaṇe tisṛ atikrāntāviti prādisamāse kṛte atitisrāvityatrāpi syāt‌, tanmā bhūdityeṣa doṣa ityupasamastārthaṃ jasgrahaṇamicchanti|| 167. caturaḥ śasi| (6.1.167) `cateruran‌' (da.u.8.78) ityuranpratyayāntatvāccatuḥśabda ādyudāttaḥ, tasya hi śasi parato'nenānto dāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| atheha kasmānna bhavati--catasraḥ paśyeti, catasrādeśe'pi caturaḥ kṛte sthānivadbhāvena na prāpnoti? ityata āha--`catasrādeśa' ityādi| catasrādeśa kṛta ādyudātatanipātanaṃ kariṣyate, sa nipātanasvaraḥ śasi svarasya bādhaka ityādyudāttatvanipātanācyatannaḥ paśyetyatrāyaṃ svaro na bhavati| atha vā purāvāt‌ `aci ra ṛtaḥ' (7.2.100) iti rādeśe kṛta ṛkārasaya tāvanna bhavitavyam‌| akārasyāpi "acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau" (1.1.57) iti yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvadṛkārema vyavadhāne sati na bhavitavyameva| nanu ca `na padāntadvirvacana' (1.1.58) ityādinā svaravidhau pratiṣidhyate sthānivadbhāvaḥ? naitadasti; uktaṃ hi tatra `svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśo na sthānivat‌' (kā.vṛ.1.1.58) iti, na cāyaṃ lopājādeśaḥ|| 168. sāvekācastṛtīyādirvibhaktiḥ| (6.1.168) sāviti prathamaikavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt‌? saptamībahuvacanasya vā? ubhayorvā? tatra yadi prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tvāyā tvayi ityatrāpi syāt‌| bhavati hi yuṣmacchabdasaya `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94) iti tvādeśe kṛte prathamaikavacane parata ekāctvam‌| sāmānyenobhayagrahaṇe'pyeṣa doṣaḥ| saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇe nāyaṃ doṣaḥ prasajyet‌, yuṣmāsvityatra yuṣmacchabdasyānekāctvamityetat‌ sarvaṃ hṛdi kṛtvā''ha--`sāviti saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇam‌' iti| `yādbhyām‌' iti| yācchabdācchatrantāt‌ tṛtīyā| `rājñe' iti| bhavati rājañśabdo bhasaṃjñake parato lope kṛta ekāc‌, na tula sau rājasviti; tatrānekāctvāt‌ `vāktarā, vāktamā' iti| taraptamabiti bhavati vā tṛtīyādiḥ, na tu vibhaktiḥ| atha kasmāt‌ saptamībahuvacanagrahaṇam‌? ityāha--`saptamībahuvacanasya' ityādi| `tvayā tvayi' iti| yuṣmadasmadoḥ `maparyantasya' (7.2.91) `tvamāvekavacane' (7.2.97) iti tvādeśaḥ| pariśiṣṭasya `yo'ci' (7.2.89) iti yakāraḥ|| 169. antodāttādutatarapadādanyatarasyāmanityasamāse| (6.1.169) yadi vigrahābhāvena yo nityasamāsaḥ sa iha nityasamāsagrahaṇena gṛhyet‌ tato'vācā, suvacā brāhmaṇenetyatrāpi vikalpena syādityetaccetasi kṛtvā''ha--`nityaśabdaḥ svaryate' iti| svaritatvamasya kriyata ityarthaḥ| tena kiṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| svaritatvena hyadhikāragatirbhavati| tena nityādhikāro yo vihitaḥ samāsaḥ| sa ca nityādhikāravihitasamāso na bhavatītyanityasamāsaḥ| `suvācā' iti| `kugati' (2.2.18) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ' [`tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyāsaptamyupamānāvyaya' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ--kāśikā] iti| sa punarudāttaḥ; `nipātāścādyudāttāḥ', `upasargāścābhivarjam‌' (phi.sū.4.80,81) iti vacanāt‌| yathātrottarapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ nāsti, evamanityasamāsatvamapi; `kugati' (2.2.18) ityādāvapi nityagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| evaṃ sati `mayūravyaṃsakādayaśca' (2.1.72) ityanenātra samāso draṣṭavyaḥ; maravyūyaṃsakāderākṛtigaṇatvāt‌| `anyathā hi' iti| yadyuttarapadagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadaikājgrahaṇaṃ samāsaviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt‌| tatra ko doṣaḥ syāt‌? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| ūrk‌śabdaḥ sampadādittvāt‌ kvibantaḥ| `agnicitā, somasutā' iti| `agnau ceḥ' (3.2.91) `some suñaḥ' (3.2.90) iti kvip‌| `ayaṃ nityādhikāre samāso vidhīyate' iti| tatra `nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ' (2.2.18) ityato nityagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `tatra' ityād| `gatikārakopapadāt‌' kṛt‌ (6.2.139) ityanenottarapadasya prakṛtisvaro vidhīyate| uttarapadaṃ ca dhātusvareṇāntodāttam‌, tena cicchabda udātto bhavati| evaṃ somasucchabdo'pi| `yastu' ityādi| `nityaśabdaḥ svaryyate' (kā.6.1.169) iti yaduktam‌, tasyānena prayojanaṃ darśayati| `avācā, suvācā' iti| atrākāreṇa pūrvapadena suśabdena ca vigraho nopapadyate, tayoriha prayogābhāvānnatyasamāsāvetau, na tu nityādhikāravidhānāt‌|| 170. añceśchandasyasarvanāmasthānam‌| (6.1.170) `indro dadhīcaḥ' iti| dadhyañcatīti `ṛtvik‌' (3.2.59) ityādinā kvin‌ anunāsikalopaḥ, ṣaṣṭhyekavacanam‌, `acaḥ' (6.4.138) ityakāralopaḥ, `cau' (6.3.138) iti dīrghaḥ| `tṛtīyādiḥ' ityādi| yadi sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tadā śaso na syāt‌; tasyātṛtīyāditvāt‌| athāpi tṛtīyādigrahaṇaṃ nivarttyata, evamapi sarvanāmasthāne'pi syāt‌| `pratīcaḥ' iti| pūrveṇa tulyam‌|| 171. ūḍidampadādyappumraidyubhyaḥ| (6.1.171) `praṣṭhauhaḥ' iti| `vahaśca' (3.2.64) iti ṇviḥ, `vāha ūṭh‌' (6.4.132) ityūṭh‌, `etyedhatyūṭh‌su' (6.1.89) iti vṛddhiḥ| `ūṭhyupadhāgrahaṇam‌' iti| upadābhūta ūḍ‌ gṛhyate yena tadupadhāgrahaṇam‌' iti vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| kimartham‌? ityata āha--`iha mā bhūt‌' iti| tatraidaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`antodāttāt‌' (6.1.169) ityādisutrādihānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate, tenopadhābhūtādeva bhavitavyamiti tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti| `akṣadyuvā' iti| akṣairdīṣyatīti kvip‌ `cchñoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) iti vakārasyoṭh‌, yaṇādeśaḥ| `ābhyām‌' iti| idamastyadādyatvam, `hali lopaḥ' (7.2.113) itīdrūpasya lopaḥ| `atho ābhyām‌' iti| `idamo'nvādeśe'śanudāttastṛtīyādau' (2.4.32) ityaśādeśaḥ| `niśparyantā iha gṛhyante' iti| etadapi pūrvavadvyavasthitavibhāṣayā labhyate, tasyāṃ hi satyāṃ niśparyantebhya eva bhavitavyam‌| teṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti ta eva gṛhyante| `nipadaḥ' iti| śasi parataḥ pādasya padādeśaḥ| `dataḥ' iti| atrāpi dantaśabdasya dadādeśaḥ| `āsan‌' iti| atrāsan‌śabdasya saptamyekavacane'sannityayamādeśaḥ| `udan‌' iti| atrāpayudakaśabdasyodannādeśa-| `adbhiḥ' iti| pakārasya takāraḥ, tasya jaśtvam‌--dakāraḥ| `rābhyām‌' iti| `rāyo hali' (7.2.85) ityāttvam‌|| 172. aṣṭano dīrghāt‌| (6.1.172) `aṣṭābhiḥ' ityādi| `aṣṭana ā vibhaktau' (7.2.84) ityāttvam‌| `aṣṭasu' iti| nanu cātrāpi bhavitavyamevātvena, na hi tadvidhau vikalpapratipādakaṃ vacanamasti, nāpi prakṛtam‌? ityata āha--`idameva' ityādi| yadi hi nityamātvaṃ syādiha dīrghagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, vyāvarttyābhāvāt‌, kṛtātvasya ca ṣaṭsaṃjñāmiti? idameva hi dīrghagrahaṇamaṣṭano jñāpayatīti sambandhanīyam‌| kathaṃ punarjñāpayati? ityāha--`anyathā hi' ityādi| dīrghagrahaṇaṃ hyevamarthaṃ kriyate--yatrātvaṃ nāsti tatrāyaṃ svaro mā bhūditi| yadi kṛtvapātvasayāṣṭanaḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñā na syāt‌, tadātvapakṣe ṣaṭsaṃjñāyāmasatyāṃ sāvakāśo'ṣṭanaḥ svaraḥ, tatrāpi ṣaṭ‌svaraḥ prāpnotīti kṛtvā| tataśca yadi dīrghagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadānavakāśatvādyadātvapakṣe'ṣṭanaḥ svaro na bhavati, tadetarasminnapi pakṣe syāt‌| atastannivṛttye dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇamarthavadbhavati| kṛtātvasyāṣṭanaḥ ṣaṭsaṃjñāyām‌--aṣṭānāmityatra `ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca' (7.1.55) iti nuṭ‌ siddho bhavati|| 173. śaturanumo nadyajādī| (6.1.173) `tudati, nudati' iti| tudāditvācchaḥ| `lunatī, punatī' iti| `śnābhyasatayorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ| pratayayasvareṇa śatrantamihāntodāttaṃ veditavyam‌| `tasya' ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati? `na mu ne' (8.2.3) ityatra neti yogavibhāgāt‌| `bṛhanmahatoḥ' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipadanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--`ḍyāśchandasi' (6.1.178) ityataḥ siṃhāvalokitanyāyena bahulagrahaṇamupatiṣṭhate, tena bṛhanmahadbhyāmapi bhavatīti|| 174. udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt‌| (6.1.174) `udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya' (8.2.4) iti prāpte vacanam‌| `tṛnnanto'yamādyudātaḥ' iti| nitsvareṇa| `bahutitavā' iti| vahavastitavo yasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ, tayā bahutitaveti| titauśabdo'yaṃ `bahorna ñcaduttarapadabhūmni' (6.2.175) ityantodāttaḥ| `nakāragrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| nakāro gṛhyate yena tannakāragrahaṇaṃ vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--ihāpi pūrvavadbahulagrahaṇamanuvarttate| tenodāttasya sthāne yo nakārastato'pi na bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā--nakārasyātra praśleṣaḥ--halpūrvāt‌ `noṅdhātvoḥ' (6.1.75) iti, tathā cāyamartho bhavati--udāttayaṇa udāttanakāracceti| tenodāttanakārādapi bhaviṣyatīti| `vākpatnī' iti| patiśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| tatra `vibhāṣā sapūrvasya' (4.1.34) iti nakārāntādeśaḥ, `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' (4.1.5) iti ṅīp‌|| 175. noṅdātvoḥ| (6.1.175) `brahmabandhvā' iti| brahmā bandhurasyā iti vigṛhya bahuvrīhiḥ| tasmāt‌ `ūṅutaḥ' (4.1.66) ityūṅ‌| `tena saha ya ekādeśaḥ so'pyudāttaḥ' iti| `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) iti vacanāt‌| `svaryate' iti| svaritaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| `kuduttarapada' ityādi| ūkāro'tra dātusvareṇāntodāttaḥ| saḥ `gatikārakopapādāt‌' (6.2.139) ityudātatastiṣṭhati prakṛtisvareṇa|| 176.hrasvanuṅbhyāṃ matup‌| (6.1.176) pitvānmatupo'nudāttatve prāpte'yaṃ vidhirārabhyate| `akṣaṇvatā' iti| akṣamasyāstīti matup‌, `chandasyapi dṛśyate' (7.1.76) ityanaṅ, `ano nuṭ‌' (8.2.13) iti nuḍāgamaḥ, pūrvasaya nakārasya `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti lopaḥ| `śīrṣaṇvatā' iti| śīrṣanniti `śīrṣañśabdaḥ' śīrṣaścandasi' (6.1.60) iti nipātitaḥ| `vasuśabda ādyudāttaḥ' iti| sa hi `bhṛmṛśītṝcaritsaritanidhanimimasjibhya uḥ' (da.u.1.92) iti vartamāne `dhānye nit‌' (da.u.1.94) ityato nidgrahaṇe `śṝsvṝsvihitrapyasivasihaniklidibandhimanibhyaśca' (da.u.1.95) iti vyutpādyate| tena nitsvareṇādyudātto bhavati| atheha kasmānna bhavati--maruto'sya santi marutvāniti, marucchabdo'pi `mṛgrerutiḥ (da.u.6.1) ityutipratyayāntatvāt‌ pratyayasvareṇāntodātta ityastyatra prāptiḥ, ato nakārema vyavadhānānna bhavatīti cet‌? na; tasya luptatvāt‌| athāpi svarasiddhau nalopasyāsiddhatvam‌? evamapi `svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavat‌' (vyā.pā.37) iti nāsti vyavadhānam‌? ityata āha--`svarividhau' ityādi| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--nāśrīyata iti? nuṅgrahaṇāt‌| nuḍāgamo hyayaṃ matupa eva bhakta iti tadgrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate| yadyeṣā paribhāṣā''śrīyeta, tadā nakārasya vyañjanasyāvidyamānatvād‌ hrasvādityeva sidhyati nuṅgrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌, kṛtaṃ ca| tato jñāyate--neyamiha paribhāṣāśrīyata iti| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| uttaratrāpi vaktavyaśabdasyāyamevārthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvavadbahulagrahaṇānuvṛttimāśritya karttavyam‌|| 177. nāmanyatarasyām‌| (6.1.177) `nām‌' iti| sanuṭkasya ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasya grahaṇam‌| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ matupā hrasvo viśeṣyate? ityāha--`anyathā hi' ityādi| samprati bhavaḥ sāmpratikaḥ, adhyātmāditvaṭṭhañ‌| `tisṛṇām‌' iti| atra `na tisṛcatasṛ' (6.4.4) iti dīrghatvapratiṣedhāt‌ sāmpratikaḥ, adhyātmāditvaṭṭhañ‌| `tisṛṇām‌' iti| atra `na tisṛcatasṛ' (6.4.4) iti dīrghatvapratiṣedhāt‌ sāmpratika eva hrasvo vidyate| na tu sāmpratike sati bhūtapūrvagatiryuktā| atra yadi matupā hrasvo na viśeṣyeta? iha naiva syāt‌--agnīnāmiti| `nāmi' (6.4.3) iti dīrghatve kṛte na syāt‌; hrasvābhāvāt‌| tasmādbhūtapūrve'pi hrasvo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ matupā hrasvo viśeṣyate| `dhenvām‌, śakaṭ‌yām‌' iti| yadi sanuṭkasya grahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadānīṃ saptamyādeśasyāpyāmo grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tataśca dhenvāmityādāvapi syāt‌| sanuṭkasya grahaṇe tuna bhavati, tasminnasati dhenuśakaṭiśabdayoḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttayorantyasya yaṇādeśe kṛte `udāttayaṇaḥ' (6.1.174) ityādanāntodātto nityo bhavati| `trapūṇām‌' iti| trapuśabdo vasuśabdavadādyudāttaḥ|| 178. ṅyāśchandasi bahulam‌| (6.1.178) 179. ṣaṭūtricaturbhyo halādiḥ| (6.1.179) `antodāttādityetannivṛttam‌' iti| yadyetadanuvartteta, pañcānām‌, saptānām‌, caturṇāmityatra na syāt‌| pañcādīnāṃ śabdādīnāṃ `nraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ (phi.sū.2.28) ityudāttatvāt‌ `nraḥ' iti rephanakārāntayoḥ saṃkhyāśabdayorgrahaṇam‌|| 180. jhalyupottamam‌| (6.1.180) `triprabhṛtīnāmantyamuttamam‌' iti| uttamaśabdasyāvyutpannasyeha grahaṇam‌| sa ca svabhāvāt‌ triprabhṛtīnāmantyamāheti kṛtvā| `tatsamīpe yat‌ tadupottamam‌' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā'vyayībhāvaḥ|| 181. vibhāṣā bhāṣāyām‌| (6.1.181) pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam‌|| 182. na gośvansāvavarṇarāḍaṅkruṅkṛdbhyaḥ| (6.1.182) `sau' iti| prathamaikavacanasya suśabdasya grahaṇaṃ vā syāt‌? saptamī bahuvacanasya vā? tatra yadi saptamībahuvacanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, kebhyaḥ, tebhya ityatra na syāt‌, kiṃtacchabdayoḥ saptamībahuvacane parato nāvarṇāntatvamupapadyate; kṛte'pi tyādādyatve `bahuvacane jhalyet‌ (7.3.103) ityettvavidhānāt‌| prathamaikavacanasya tu grahaṇe satyatrāpi bhavati| tasmādasaptamyāṃ eva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti matvā''ha--`prathamaikavacane yadavarṇāntam‌' iti| anantaramiha pratiṣedhyaṃ na bhavatīti sarvasya ṣāṣṭhikasvarasya pratiṣedho'yaṃ vijñāyata itatyāha--`ityetebhyo yaduktaṃ tanna bhavati' iti| śobhanā gāvo'syeti suguḥ, `gostriyoḥ' (1.2.48) ityādinā hrasvaḥ, `nañsubhyām‌' (6.2.172) ityuttarapadasyāntodāttatvam‌| `śunā' iti `śvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' (6.4.133) iti samprasāraṇam‌| `pūrvavat‌ prāptiḥ' iti| śunā, śvabhyāmityatra `sāvekācaḥ' (6.1.168) ityādinā prāptiḥ| `paramaśunā' iti| atrāti `antodāttāduttarapadāt‌' (6.1.169) ityantodāttatvaṃ tu samāsasvareṇa| `rājā, paramarājaḥ' iti| atrāpi pūrvavatprāptiḥ| `añcatiḥ kvinnantaḥ' iti| yadyevam‌, tarhi tatra nakāralopena na bhavitavyaṃ tasyaiva sanakārasya grahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| kimarthaṃ sanakārasya grahaṇam‌? ityāha--`tasya' ityādi| etadapi kimartham‌? ityāha--`yatrāsya' ityādi| nanu ca sarvatraiva lopena bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ nalopasyābhāvaḥ ityāha--`nāñceḥ' ityādi| `prāñcā' iti| pūrvavat‌ prāpatiḥ| prāñcatīti kvin‌| `prācā' iti| pūrvavallopadīrghatve| `kruñcā' iti| `kruca kruñca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ' [ kutva krucca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.185,186), kvin‌ kruñceti nipātanānnalopābhāvaḥ| `paramakruñcā' iti| samāsasvareṇāntodāttatvam‌| `paramakṛtā' iti| atrāpi| `kṛtirvā' iti| `kṛtī chedane' (dhā.pā.1435) ityeṣaḥ|| 183. divo jhal‌| (6.1.183) 184. nṛ cānyatarasyām‌| (6.1.184) nṛśabdāt‌ `sāvekācaḥ' (6.1.168) iti, `na gośvansāvarṇa'(6.1.182) iti nitye pratiṣedhe ca prāpte vibhāṣeyamārabhyate|| 185. titsvaritam‌| (6.1.185) `cikīrṣyam‌, jihīrṣyam‌' iti, `na gośvansāvarṇa' (6.1.182) iti nitye pratiṣedhe ca prāpte vibhāṣeyamārabhyate|| 186. tāsyanudāttenṅidadupadeśāllasarvadhātukamanudāttamahanviṅoḥ| (6.1.186) tāsiprabhṛtīnāṃ samāhāradvandvena nirdeśaḥ| `adrupadeśāt‌' iti| upadiśyata ityupadeśaḥ, śāstravākyeṣu khilapāṭhe ca yaḥ prathamamuccāryate sa ityarthaḥ| accāsāvupadeśaścetyadupadeśaḥ| karmasādhanasyopadeśaśabdasyāśrayaṇam‌, bhāvasādhanasya vā, nānena sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatteḥ| `lasārvadhātukam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `adupadeśāt‌' iti| pūrvavat‌ karmasādhanenopadeśaśabdena karmadhārayaḥ| varṇagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra tadantavidhiṃ prayojayatityakārantopadeśādityarthaḥ| `karttā' iti| karoterluṭ‌, ātmanepadaparathamapuruṣaḥ, tasya ḍāraurasaḥ| ekavacane ṭerlopaḥ| dvivacanabahuvacanayoḥ `ri ca' (7.4.51) iti sakārasya| `āste' ityevamādiṣu `śete' ityevaṃparyanteṣvadāditvācchapo luk‌| `vaste' iti| `vasa ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1023)| `sūte' iti| `ṣūṅ‌ prāṇigarbhavimocane' (dhā.pā.1031)| `śete' iti| śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ' (7.4.21) iti guṇaḥ| `tudataḥ nudataḥ' iti| tasante ete| evaṃ `pacataḥ, paṭhataḥ' ityete api| nanu ca vyañjanānto'yamupadeśe śap‌, nakārāntaḥ, tat‌ kathamihānudāttatvaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`anubandhasya' ityādi| ekāntaḥ-ekadeśaḥ; naikānto'nekāntaḥ, tadgrahaṇena gṛhyata iti yāvat‌, anekāntasya bhāvo'nekāntatvam‌| tato hetorakārāntopadeśa eva śap‌, na vyañjanāntaḥ| tena pacate--ityādāvanudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| akārāntatvaṃ tu śabakārasya vyapadeśivadbhāvāt‌| `pacamānaḥ, yajamānaḥ' iti| śānac‌| kathaṃ punarihānudāttatvam‌, yāvatā mukā'tra vyavadhānam‌? ityāha--`yadyatra' ityādi| mugāgamo'yamakāramātrasya vā syāt‌? akārāntāṅgasya vā? tatra yadyakāramātrasya tadā'dupadeśagrahaṇenaiva tasya grahaṇamiti lasarvadhātukamadupadeśādanantarameva bhavati, vyavadhānābhāvāt‌, na hi svāvayavo vyavadhāyako bhavati| tenāntaraṅgatvāt‌ siddho nighātaḥ| `atha' ityādinā dvitīye pakṣe nidhātasyāsiddhatvāt‌ pratipādayati--`tathāpi' iti| evamapītyarthaḥ| lasarvadhātukasyetyasya siddho nighāta iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| `asiddhaḥ' ityasyāpi mugityanena prakṛtena| itikaraṇo hetau| tadayamarthaḥ--yasmāllasārvadhātukānudātte bahiraṅgatvānmugasiddhaḥ, tasmādevamapi sārvadhātukasyānudāttatvam‌| bahiraṅgatvaṃ tu muko bahvapekṣatvāt‌| sa hyakārāntaviśiṣṭamaṅgamāśrayati, ānañca pratyayaviśeṣam‌| aṅgāvayavamadupadeśaṃ lasārvadhātukāmātraṃ nidhātaḥ| tasmādasāvantaraṅgaḥ| svaravidhitvācca, ukagtaṃ hi svaravidherbhāvye'ntarahgattvam‌| nanu cādye pakṣe muki kṛte nighāto na sidhyati, adupadeśāditi taparakaraṇāt‌, muki ca kṛte kālasyātiricyamānatvāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadyavamapi kṛte'rdhamātrādhikā bhavati, tathāpyupadeśagrahaṇāt‌ sidhyatyeva, upadeśe mātrikasyaivoccāraṇāt‌| `citsvaro'pyanena' ityādi| citsvarasyāvakāśaḥ--`calanaśabdārthādakarmakādyuc‌' (3.2.148) calanam‌, copanamiti, tāsyādibhyo'nudāttasyāvakāśaḥ--āste, śeta iti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--pacamāno yajamāna iti paratvāllasārvadhātukānudāttatvameva citsvaraṃ bāghitvā pravarttate| `cinutaḥ, cinvanti' iti| nu `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) iti śnurapi ṅideva, tatkathamidaṃ pratyudāharaṇamupapadyate? ityāha--`ṅidayam‌' ityādi| `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) ityanena pūrvasya kāryamatidiśyate, na parasya| tathā coktam‌--siddhaṃ tu pūrvasya kāryātideśāditi| tasmāt‌ pūrvasya kāryaṃ prati ṅitvaṃ bhavati, na tu parasyeta kimatra nopapadyate| `iha ca' ityādi| pacāvaḥ pacāmaḥ ityatra hi `ato dīrgho yañi' (7.3.101) iti dīrghatve kṛte na syāt‌ asatyupadeśagrahaṇe| tasmiṃstu sati śabakāro'pi mātrika evopadiṣṭa iti yadyapyuttarakāla dīrghatvaṃ bhavati tathāpi nighāto na bhavatīti| `iha ca mā bhūditi--hataḥ; hatha' iti| atra `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinā'nunāsikalope satyupadeśātparaṃ lasārvadhātukaṃ bhavati, tatrāsatyupadeśagrahaṇa ihāpi syāt‌| asmistu sati na bhavati, na hi hantiravarṇānta upadiśyate| kiṃ tarhi? vyañjanāntaḥ| `pacamānāḥ' iti| `tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś‌' (3.2.129) na ca sa lādeśaḥ, api tu pratyayaḥ| lasarvadhātukatvaṃ tvasya na vidyate| `śiśye' iti| śīṅo hyātmanepade rūpam‌, `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ| `liṭ‌ ca' (3.4.115) ityārdhadhātukametat‌| `śiśyāte' iti| liṭyātāmi rūpam‌| nānudāttatvam‌, asārvadhātukasaṃjñāvidhānāt‌| `hru te, yadadhīte' iti| `hru ṅ‌ apanayane' (dhā.pā.1082) `iṅ‌ adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1046) yacchabdasya prayogaḥ `nipātaiyaidyadi' (8.1.30) iti nighātapratiṣedho yathā syāt‌|| 187. ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām‌| (6.1.187) `mā hi kārṣṭām‌' iti| heḥ, māṅaśca prayogo prayojanaṃ pūrvamevoktam‌| `aparo'ntodāttaḥ' iti| pratyayasvareṇa| `aparo madhyodāttaḥ' iti| pratyayasvareṇaiva| nanu ca valādiriha pratyayaḥ, iṭ‌ cāgamaḥ, āgamānāṃ cānudāttatvaṃ bhavati, tasmādihāpyantodāttenaiva bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ madhyodāttatvam‌? ityāha--`sicaścitkāraṇāt‌' ityādi| sicaścitkaraṇenānudāttatve bādhite citsvara eva bhavatīti yuktaṃ madhyodāttatvam‌| `sica ādyudātta' ityādi| sica ādyudāttatve karttavye'niṭo vidyamāno sicaḥ paro yaścitpratyayastasyodāttatvaṃ vaktavyam‌| `mā hi kārṣam‌' iti| pakṣe sarvānudāttaṃ padaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamidam‌| pakṣe tūdāttatvena mukte sarvānudāttameva padaṃ bhavati|| 188. svapādihiṃsāmacyaniṭi| (6.1.188) `sārvadhātukagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| `aci' ityetat‌ saptamyantaṃ lasārvadhātukasya samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśaṣaṇam‌, na ca prathamāntasya saptamyantena sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate| tasmāt‌ `aci' ityanena sambandhādviviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyalakṣaṇāllasārvadhātukagrahaṇādityāha--`saptamyantamupajāyate| `svapādirā vṛtkaraṇāt‌' iti| yadyapyetadevam‌, tathāpi `ñiṣvap‌ śaye' (dhā.pā.1068) `śvasa prāṇane' (dhā.pā.1069), `ana ca' (dhā.pā.1070) ityeta eva ye, te iha svapādigrahaṇena gṛhyante| pare'pi ye jakṣityādayo'bhyastasaṃjñāḥ, teṣu paratvāt‌ `abhyastānāmādiḥ' (6.1.189) ityanena nityamādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `hiṃsanti' iti| `tṛha hisi hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1455,1456), rudhāditvāc‌ śnam‌, `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ `śnānnalopaḥ' (6.4.23) iti parasya nakārasya| `svapyāt‌' iti| liṅ‌ adāditvācchapo luk‌| `svapitaḥ' iti| `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) itīṭ‌|| 189. abhyastānāmādiḥ| (6.1.189) pratyayasvareṇa prāpte tadapavādo'bhyastānāṃ dhātūnāmādervidhīyate| dadhatītyādau "śnābhyastayorātaḥ" (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ, `ubhe abhyastam‌' (6.1.5) ityabhyastasaṃjñā| `jakṣati, jāgrati' iti| atrāpi `jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ‌' (6.1.6) iti sarvatra `adabhyastāt‌' (7.1.4) iti jheradādeśaḥ| `jakṣitaḥ' iti| pūrvavadiṭ‌| athādigrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `ādiḥ siconyatarasyām‌' (6.1.187) ityata ādirityanuvarttate? ityata āha--`ādiriti varttamāne ityādi| pūrvakaṃ hyādigrahaṇamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena sambaddham‌, atastanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt‌| tasmānnityarthaṃ punarādigrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 190. anudātte ca| (6.1.190) anajādyarthamidam‌| ajādau tvanudātte pūrvaṇaiva siddham‌| `jihīte, mimīte' iti| atra `tāsyanudāttet‌' (6.1.186) ityādinā lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatvam‌| `bhṛñāmit‌' (7.4.76) ityabhyāsasyettvam‌| `anudātte' iti śāstrīyasyānudāttasyāyaṃ nirdeśa iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌ atastannirāsārthamāha--`anudātta ti bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ' iti avidyamānamudāttamasminnityanudāttam‌| kimarthaṃ punarbahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ? ityāha--`lopapaṇādeśārthaḥ' iti| lopayaṇādeśayoḥ kṛtayorapyādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| `mā hi sma dadhāt‌| dadhātyatra' iti| smaśabdasya prayogaḥ smottare laṅ‌ yathā syāt‌| atra yadi śāstrīyasyāyaṃ nirdeśaḥ syāt‌, `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralāpe kṛte yaṇādeśe codāttaṃ na syāt‌, śāstrīyasyānudāttasyābhāvāt‌| bahuvrīhinirdeśe cātrāpi bhavati; udāttasyehāvidyamānatvāt‌|| 191. sarvasya supi| (6.1.191) `iṣśībhyāṃ van‌ (da.u.8.126) iti prakṛtya `sarvanīdhṛdhariṣvalaṣvaśivapaṭ‌vapreṣvā asvatantre' [`sarvanidhṛṣvariṣvaliṣpaśipahrasvapadvapraheṣvā atantre'--da.u.] (da.u.8.127) iti sarvaśabdo'ntodātto nipātitaḥ| tena tasya supyādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| antodāttatvanipātanaṃ tu sarvasya vikāraḥ sārvaṃ ityatra `anudāttāderañ‌' (4.2.44) yathā syāt‌| `pratyayalakṣaṇenāpi' ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate, yāvatā sarvastoma ityatra `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti lumatā luptam‌, tataśca `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣalasya pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nuvarttate, sa ca samuccayārthaḥ| tena pratiṣedhaviṣaye'pyeṣa svaro bhaviṣyati| `sarvasvaro'nakackasya' ityādi| yo'yaṃ sarvaśabdasya svaro vidhīyate sa tasyāvidyamānākackasya bhavatītyetadartharūp vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`ādiḥ sico'nyatarasyām‌' (6.1.187) ityato'nya tarasyāṃgrahaṇamiha maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānurttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tenānakackasya bhavati|| 192. bhīhvībhṛhumadajanadhanadaridrājāgarāṃ pratyayātpūṃrva piti| (6.1.192) `anudātte ca' (6.1.190) ityādyudātte prāpte pratyayāt‌ pūrvasya bhīhraprabhṛtīnāmudātto vidhīyate| 193. liti| (6.1.193) `lakāretsaṃjñake' iti| lakāra itsaṃjñako yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `cikīrṣakaḥ' iti| sannantāṇṇvul‌| tatra `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) itkāralope kṛte ṇvulaḥ pūrvasyekārasyodāttatvam‌| `bhaurikavidham‌' iti `bhaurikyādyaiṣukāryādibhyo vidhalbhaktalau' (4.2.54) iti vidhalpratyayaḥ| bhaurikirviṣayo deśa iti `aiṣukāribhaktam‌' aiṣukārirviṣayo deśa iti| pūrvasūtreṇaiva bhaktalpratyayaḥ|| 194. ādirṇamulyanyatarasyām‌| (6.1.194) litsvare prāpte ṇamuli parata ādyudāttatvaṃ vikalpena vidhīyate| tena mukte pakṣe litsvaro'pi bhavatyeva| anekācaśca dhātavo vikalpaṃ prayojayantīti| ye tvekācasteṣāṃ litsvareṇānena vā viśeṣo nāsti| `loluyaṃ lolūyam‌, `popūyampopūyam‌' iti| yadantāṇṇamul‌, tasya `ābhīkṣṇe dve bhavataḥ' (vā.887) iti dvirdacanam‌| `anudāttaṃ ca (8.1.3) ityāmreḍitasyānudāttatvam‌|| 195. acaḥ kartṛyaki| (6.1.195) `kartṛyaki' iti| sārvadhātukaṃ kartṛśabdenoktam‌| abhidhāne'bhidheyopacārāt‌| tatra yaḥ karttari yak‌ sa kartṛyak‌, `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| `lūyate kedāraḥ svayameva' iti| lunāti kedāraṃ devadattaḥ, kedāro lavanakriyayā vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt‌ karma| yadā tu saukāryāt‌ tasyaiva karttṛtvaṃ vivakṣyate tadā'sau karttā bhavati; `karmavat‌ karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' (3.1.87) ityatideśāt‌ yagātmanepadañca| `stīryate' iti| `stṛ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1252) [stṛñ‌ ācachādane--dhā.pā.] `ṝta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100), `hali ca' (8.2.77) itī dīrghaḥ| `lasārvadhātukanighāte kṛte' iti| `adupadeśabhaktayaka eva svaro bhavati' iti| pratyayalakṣaṇaḥ| atheha kathaṃ bhavati--jāyate svayameva, sāyate svayameva, khāyate svayameveti, yāvatā `ye vibhāṣā' (6.4.43) ityātve kṛte satyuttarakālaṃ janādayo'jantā bhavanti, na tūpadeśa? ityāha--`janādanām‌' ityādi| janādīnāṃ hyātvavidhāvanudāttopadeśagrahaṇamanuvarttate| tena teṣāmupadeśa evāttvaṃ draṣṭavyam‌| `jāyate svayameva' iti| kathaṃ punarakarmakarttā, yāvatā janirakarmakaḥ? antarbhāvitaṇyarthaṃ sakarmako bhavatītyadoṣaḥ| `lūyate kedāro devadattena' iti| atra śuddhakarmaṇyātmanepadavidhānāt‌ kartṛyagna bhavati|| 196. thali ca seṭīḍanto vā| (6.1.196) `anyatarasyām‌' (6.1.194) ityanuvarttamāne vāgrahaṇaṃ kāryiṇo vikalpārtham‌| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena kāryaṃ vikalpyate vāgrahaṇena tu kāryiṇaḥ| teneḍādayaḥ paryāyeṇa kārya pratipadyante| `lulavitha' iti| krādiniyamādiṭ‌| `yayātha' iti| `acastāsvatthalyaniṭo nityam‌' (7.2.61) itīṭo vā pratiṣedhaḥ|| 197. ñnityādirnityam‌| (6.1.197) `vāsudevakaḥ' iti| vāsudeve bhaktirasyetyarthe vun‌| atheha gargā, vidā iti `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti bahuṣu luki kṛte, cañceva cañcetyatra ca `ive pratikṛtau' (5.3.96) ityutpannasya kanaḥ `lum‌ manuṣye' (5.2.98) iti lupi kṛte kasmānna bhavati, lupte'pi pratyaye `pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam‌ (1.1.62) ityasti prāpti? ityata āha--`pratyayalakṣaṇamatra neṣyate' iti| tat‌ kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo na bhavati? `saṃjñāyāmupamānam‌' (6.1.204) ityatra vakṣyamāṇājjñāpakāt‌| atha vā `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) ityanena yannāma kiñcidaṅgasya kāryamaṅgādhikāre vihitameva, tena pratiṣedhādiha pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ svīkāryaṃ na bhaviṣyati| evamuttarātrāpi pratyayalakṣaṇābhāvo veditavyaḥ| `yañi kani ca lupte' iti| cakārād‌vidādhañi ca|| 198. āmantritasya ca| (6.1.198) `devadatt' iti| dadāteḥ `kticktau ca saṃjñāyām‌' (3.3.174) ityāśivi ktaḥ, `vo vad‌ ghoḥ' (7.4.46) iti dhātordadādeśaḥ| dattaśabdasya devaśabdena `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ| `sapirāgaccha' iti| `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) iti vibhakterluk‌| `saptāgacchata' iti| atrāpi `ṣaṅbhyo luk‌' (7.1.22) iti ca|| 199. pathimathoḥ sarvanāmasthāne| (6.1.199) `pathimathiśabdo' ityādi| `gameriniḥ' (da.u.6.57) ityata inipratyaye varttamāne `manthaḥ' (da.u.6.62) itīnipratyayaḥ, ato mathiñśabdo vyutpādyate, `parame kit‌' (da.u.6.61) ityataḥ kidgrahaṇānuvṛttermanatheranunāsikalopaḥ| `patastha ca' (da.u.6.63) iti pathiñśabdo'pīnitpratyayānta iti tenetau pratyayasvareṇāntodāttau| `panthāḥ' iti| `pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt‌' (7.1.87) ityakarāntādeśaḥ| `ito't‌ sarvanāmasthāne' (7.1.86) itīkārasyāttvam‌, `tho nthaḥ' (7.1.87) iti thasya nthādeśaḥ| `pathaḥ paśya' iti| `bhasya ṭerlopaḥ' (7.1.88) iti ṭilopaḥ| tatra kṛte `anudāttasya ca yatrodātta lopaḥ' (6.1.161) ityantodāttatvam‌| `pathipriyaḥ' iti| panthāḥ priyo yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `vā priyasya' (vā.114) iti priyaśabdasya pakṣe paranipātaḥ|| 200. antaśce tavai yugapat‌| (6.1.200) `karttavā' [`karttavai' iti kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `kṛtyārthe tavaikenkenyatāvanaḥ' (3.4.14) iti tavaipratyayaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ paryāyanivṛttaye yatnaḥ kriyate? ityāha--`ekavarjam‌' ityādi|| 201. kṣayo nivāse| (6.1.201) `kṣayaḥ' iti| `kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1407) ityasyedaṃ rūpamiti|| 202. jayaḥ karaṇam‌| (6.1.202) `jayaḥ' iti| `ji jri abhibhave' (dhā.pā.946,947) ityasya jayate rūpametat‌| `jayo brāhmaṇānām‌' iti| bhāve `erac‌' (3.3.56)|| 203. vṛṣādīnāṃ ca| (6.1.203) `vṛṣaḥ, janaḥ, jvaraḥ, grahaḥ, hayaḥ, gayaḥ' iti| `vṛṣu mṛṣu secane' (dhā.pā.706,707) `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149) `jvara roge' (dhā.pā.776) `graha upādāne' (dhā.pā.1533) `hi gatau' (dhā.pā.1257) `kai gai' śabde' (dhā.pā.916,917) `sarvaṃ ete'cpratayayāntāḥ' iti| pacāditvāt‌| etena citsvare prāpte pāṭha eṣāmiti darśayati| `nayaḥ, tayaḥ, ayaḥ, aṃśaḥ, vedaḥ, sūdaḥ, aśaḥ' iti| `ṇīñ‌ prāpaṇe' (dhā.pā.901) `tāyṛ santānapālanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.489) kvacit‌ `tayaḥ' ityasya sthāne `cayaḥ' iti paṭhyate, sa cinoterdraṣṭavyaḥ| `iṇ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.1045)| atha vā aya vaya maya caya (dhā.pā.474)-478) ityādeḥ| `aṃśa samādhāne' (dhā.pā.1918), `vida jñāne' `(dhā.pā.1064) `ṣūda rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1717) `aśa bhojane' (dhā.pā.1523)| `sūdaḥ--igupadheti kapratyayāntaḥ' iti| `ete'pi' iti yaduktam‌, tasyāyamapavādaḥ| `guha' iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.896)| `śamaraṇau saṃjñāyām‌' iti| `śam‌ upaśame' (dhā.pā.1201) `aṇa raṇa' (dhā.pā.444,445) iti śabdārthaḥ| saṃjñāyā anyatrāntodāttādeva bhavataḥ| `sammatau bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' iti| śamaraṇāditi varttate| sammatāvarthe vivakṣite śamaraṇau bhāvakarmaṇoryathākramamādyudāttau bhavataḥ| `mantraḥ' iti| `matri guptabhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1679) kecittu--`sammatau bhāvakarmaṇormaṇormantraḥ' iti paṭhanti| tasya mantre viṣayībhūta ityeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ| `śāntiḥ' iti| `śamu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1201) `kticktau ca saṃjñāyām‌' (3.3.174) iti ktic‌| `kāmaḥ, yāmaḥ' iti| `kamu kārtau' (dhā.pā.443) `yama uparame' (dhā.pā984)| `ghañantau' iti| `karṣātvato dhaño'nta udāttaḥ' (6.1.159) ityetasmin‌ prāpte'sya pāṭhaḥ| `kalpaḥ' iti| `kṛpū sāmarthye' (dhā.pā.762)| `pādaḥ' iti| `pada gatau' (dhā.pā.1169)| `vṛṣādirākṛtigaṇaḥ' iti| tadeva cākṛtigaṇatvaṃ jñāpayituṃ cakāraḥ kṛtaḥ|| 204. saṃjñāyāmupamānam‌| (6.1.204) `yadyevam‌' iti| yadi kano lubityarthaḥ, kano'pu lupi satyapi pratyayalakṣaṇenaiva siddhameṣāṃ hi nitsvareṇādyudāttatvam‌, tadapārthakamityabhiprāyaḥ| `etadeva' ityādi| yadi hi kvacit‌ svaravidhau pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ syāt‌, karttavyamevedaṃ vacanaṃ syāt‌| pratyayalakṣaṇena siddhatvāt‌, kṛtañca| tasmādetajjñāpayati--pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ syāt‌, karttavyamevedaṃ vacanaṃ syāt‌| pratyayalakṣaṇena siddhatvāt‌, kṛtañca| tasmādetajjñāpayati--pratyayalakṣaṇamiha svaravidhau na bhavatīti| kvacidgrahaṇaṃ kvacittu bhavatīti pradarśanārtham‌, tathā hi `sarvasya supi' (6.1.191) ityatroktam‌--pratyayalakṣaṇenāpyayaṃ svara iṣyata iti| `tathā ca' ityādinā jñāpanasya prayojanamāha| `agnirmāṇavakaḥ' iti| bhavatyagniśabda upamānam‌| tathā hyagnireveti gamyate, nāsau māṇavakasya saṃjñā|| 205. niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt‌| (6.1.205) `guptaḥ' iti `gupū rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.395)| `buddhaḥ' iti| `budha avagamane' (dhā.pā.858)| `devaḥ' iti| devaśabdaḥ pacādyajantatvādantodāttaḥ| bhīmaśabdo'pi magantatvāt‌ pratyasvareṇa| `iṣiyudhi' (da.u.7.31) ityādyadhikṛtya `bhiyaḥ ṣugvā' (da.u.7.35) iti makpratyayānto vyutpādyate| `cintitaḥ' iti| `citi smṛtyām‌' (dhā.pā.1535), caurādikaḥ, `niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' (6.4.52) iti ṇilopaḥ| `rakṣitaḥ' iti| `rakṣa pālane' (dhā.pā.658)| `trātaḥ, āptaḥ' iti| `traiṅa pālane' (dhā.pā.965), `āplṛ vyātau' (dhā.pā.1260)|| 206. śuṣkadhṛṣṭau| (6.1.206) `śuṣkaḥ' iti| `śuṣa śoṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1183) `śuṣaḥ kaḥ' (8.2.51) iti ktasya kādeśaḥ| `dhṛṣṭaḥ' iti| ñidhṛṣā prāgalbhye' (dhā.pā.1269) ṣṭutvam‌| katvaṣṭutvayorasiddhatvādiha niṣṭhāntatvaṃ veditavyam‌| `asaṃjñārthaṃ ārambhaḥ' iti| saṃjñāyāṃ pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌|| 207. āśitaḥ karttā| (6.1.207) `aśeḥ' iti| `aśa bhojane' (dhā.pā.1523) ityasmāt karttari kto nipātyate| `gatyarthākarmaka' (3.4.72) ityādinā| `pūrvavat‌ karmaṇi ktaḥ' [`pūrvatra'--kāśikā] iti| `tayoreva' (3.4.70) ityādinā| `uttaratra bhāve' iti| `napuṃsake' `bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) iti|| 208. rikte vibhāṣā| (6.1.208) `riktaḥ' iti| `ricir‌ virecane' (dhā.pā.1441)| pratyayasvare prāpta ādervibhāṣodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| `saṃjñāyām‌' ityādi| `niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt‌' (6.1.205) ityasyāvakāśaḥ--dattaḥ, gupta iti| asyāvakaśo'saṃjñāyām‌--rikto ghaṭa iti; yadā tu riktaśabdaḥ kasyacit‌ saṃjñā bhavati tadobhayoḥ prāptau pūrvavipratiṣedhena `niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt‌' (6.1.205) iti nityamādyudātto bhavati| na ca pūrvavipratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, paraśabdasyeṣṭavācitvāt‌|| 209. juṣṭārpite ca cchandasi| (6.1.209) `juṣṭaḥ' iti| `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1288)| `arpitaḥ' iti| artterṇica, `arttihro' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk‌|| 210. nityaṃ mantre| (6.1.210) `kecidatra' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ juṣṭaśabda evāvanuvarttayanti? ityāha--`arpitaśabdasya' ityādi| atrāpi kiṃ kāraṇam‌? ityāha--`antodātto'pi' ityādi| tamevāntodāttasya pāṭhamantraṃ darśayitumāha--`tasmin‌ sākaṃ triśatā' ityādi| ārambhasāmarthyādeva nityatve siddhe nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌, uttarārthaṃ ca|| 211. yuṣmadasmadorṅasi| (6.1.211) `yuṣmadasmadī madikpratyayānte' iti| `yuṣyasibhyāṃ madik‌' (da.u.6.50) madikpratyayamutpādya tayorṣyutpādanāt‌| etena yuṣmadasmadoḥ pratyayasvareṇaāntodāttatvaṃ darśayati| `tava mamau ṅasi' (7.2.96) iti yuṣmadasmadormaparyantasya tavamamau, śeṣe lope (7.2.90) kṛte `ato gṛṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| yuṣmadasmadorādeśasya sthānivadbhāvādantodāttatvam| evaṃ ca yo hyaśādeśena sahaikādeśaḥ, so'pi `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) ityudātta evetyanena krameṇa vibhaktisvare prāpta idamucyate|| 212. ṅayi ca| (6.1.212) `tubhyam‌, mahyam‌' iti| `ṅe prathamayoram‌' (7.1.28) ityambhāvaḥ, `tumyamahyau ṅayi' (7.2.95) iti yuṣmadasmadostubhyamahyāvādeśau| kimarthaṃ pṛthagayaṃ yogaḥ kriyate? ityata āha--`pṛthagyogakaraṇam‌' ityādi| ekayoge hi kāryiṇoḥ, nimittayośca samānatvādyathāsaṃkhyamatra bhavitavyamiti kasyacidāśaṅkā syāt‌| ataḥ pṛthagyogakaraṇaṃ yathāsaṃkhyanirāsārthamiti pradarśanārtham‌| tataścāsvaritatvādeva yatāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhaviṣyati| āśaṅkātaḥ kasyacinmandabuddheḥ syāditi tannirāsārthaṃ pṛthagyogakaraṇam‌| ayamapi pūrvavadeva vibhaktisvarāpavādaḥ|| 213. yato'nāvaḥ| (6.1.213) `kaṇṭhyam‌, oṣṭhyam‌' iti| bhāvārthe taddhitaḥ| `nāvyam‌' iti| nāvā tāryamityasminnarthe `nauvayodharma' (4.4.91) ityādinā yat‌| atra `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśe kṛte vyañjanasya svaravidhāvavidyamānatvāt‌ tataḥ pūrvasya syāditi nāvaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| `lalāṭyam‌' iti| `śarīrāvayavādyat‌' (5.1.6) iti yat‌|| 214. īḍavandavṛśaṃsaduhāṃ ṇyataḥ| (6.1.214) `īḍa stutau' (dhā.pā.1667) `vadi abhivādanastutyoḥ' (dhā.pā.11) `vṛṅ‌ sambhaktau' (dhā.pā.1509) `śaṃsa stutau' (dhā.pā.728) [śaṃsu--dhā.pā.] `duha prapūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1014)--etebhyo dhātubhyaḥ `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124) iti ṇyat‌ pratyayaḥ| kasmin‌ punaḥ prāpta idamārabhyate? ityāha--`dvyanubandhakatvāt‌' ityādi| atha kathaṃ punarvāryamityatra ṇyatpratyayaḥ, 215. vibhāṣā veṇvindhānayoḥ| (6.1.215) `ṇupratyayānta' iti| tadvidhau `stho ṇuḥ' (da.u.1.147) ityato ṇugrahaṇānuvṛtte| `yadi cānaśantaḥ' [`yadā--kāśikā] iti| `tācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaś‌ (3.2.129) ityanena| `atha śānajantaḥ' iti| `laṭa) śatṛśānaco' (3.2.124) ityādinā| `lasārvadhātukanighāte kṛte' iti| `tāsyanudāttet‌' (6.1.186) ityādinā| indhāne' iti| asyānudāttatvāt‌| `udāttanivṛttisvareṇa' iti| `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ'(6.1.161) ityanena| `veṇuḥ' ityādi| `saṃjñāyāmupamānam‌' (6.1.204) ityasyāvakāśaḥ--cañcā, varghriketi, asyā vibhāṣāyā avakāśaḥ--anupamāno
