tyāgarāgahāsakuhaśvaṭhakrathānām‌| (6.1.216) `kuha vismāpane', (dhā.pā.1901) `śaṭha śvaṭha samyagavabhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1854,1855)--etau caurādikau| `śratha ślatha kratha valatha hiṃsārthāḥ' (dhā.pā799,801,802)|| 217. upottamaṃ riti| (6.1.217) 218. caṅyanyatarasyām‌| (6.1.218) `mā hi cīkaratām‌' iti| `sanvallaghuni caṅpare'naglope' (7.4.93) ityabhyāsasyettvam‌| `aṭi pratiṣiddhe' iti| yadyaṭaḥ pratiṣedho yasya tasyaiva svaraḥ syāddhātvakārasya| `hi ca' iti `nighātaḥ' iti| pratiṣiddha ityapekṣate| yadi nighāto na pratiṣidhyeta, tadā caṅantasyodāttasyābhāva eva syāt‌| `mā hi dadhat‌' iti| `vibhāṣā dheṭśvyoḥ' (3.1.49) iti cleścaṅ‌|| 219. matoḥ pūrvamātsaṃjñāyāṃ striyām‌| (6.1.219) `udumbarāvatī' iti| udumbarā asyāṃ santīti cāturarthiko matup‌, `matau bahvaco'najirādīnām‌' (6.3.119) iti dīrghatvam‌| `śarāvatī' iti| atra `śarādīnāñca' (6.3.120) iti| `matoriti kim‌ gavādinī' iti| `matoḥ' ityasminnanucyamāne tatsambaddhaṃ pūrvagrahaṇamapi nocyeta, saṃjñāśabdasyākāramātra syodāttatvaṃ prasajyeta| pūrvagrahaṇaṃ matoranantarasyāsya yathā syāt‌| iha mā bhūt‌--sānumatīti| lakṣaṇapratipadokta paribhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) cehaiva syāt‌--śyamāvatī, udumbarāvatītyādi na syāt‌| pūrvagrahaṇāt‌ pūrvamātrasya bhavati|| 220. anto'vatyāḥ| (6.1.220) `ajiravatī' ityādi| pūrvavanmatup‌| `pittvādanudāttatvaṃ prāptam‌' iti| atasatasyāyamapavāda iti śeṣaḥ| athāvatyā ityucyamāne rājavatītyetasmānna bhavati, asti hyetadapi nalope kṛte'vatīśabdāntam‌? ityāha--`svaravidhau' ityādi| kathamudāharaṇam‌, yāvata matorvatvasyāsiddhatvādatrādatīśabdāntatvaṃ nāsti? ityāha--`vatvaṃ punaḥ'--ityādi| punaḥśabdena nalopādviśeṣaṃ darśayati| lopo hyasiddhaḥ, vatvaṃ punaḥ siddham‌| kutaḥ? āśrayāt‌| āśrayaḥ svaravidhau nimittatvenopādānamityarthaḥ| avatīśabdasyāntodāttatvaṃ bruvatā vatvamāśritam‌, tasmādāśrayāttasya siddhatvam‌, anyathaiva vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt| na hi vatvasya siddhatvamantareṇāvatīśabdāntaṃ kiñcidasti|| 221. īvatyāḥ| (6.1.221) ayamapi pittvānudāttasyaivāpavādaḥ `ahīvatī' ityādi| `śarādīnāñca' (6.3.120) iti dīrghaḥ, `saṃjñāyām‌' (8.2.11) iti ca vatvam‌|| 222. cau| (6.1.222) `udāttanivṛttisvarāpavādo'yam‌' iti| `dadhīcaḥ' iti| dadhyañcatīti kvin‌, `gatikārakopapadāt‌' (6.2.139) ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇāñcerakāra udāttaḥ| vibhaktāvajādāvasarvanāmasthāne `acaḥ' (6.4.138) ityakāralope kṛte `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) ityudāttanivṛttisvaraḥ prāpnoti, atasyasyāya mapavādaḥ| `cāvataddhite' ityādi| yadidamañceḥ pūrvasyāntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, tadā taddhitaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānañcedam‌--anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena taddhite na bhaviṣyatīti|| 223. samāsasya| (6.1.223) `rājapuruṣaḥ' ityādiṣūdaharaṇeṣu samāsapadānāṃ tasmiṃstasmin‌ svare prāpte satīdamārabhyate, sa ākhyāyate| rājaśabde tāvat‌ `kanin‌ yuvṛṣitakṣirāji' (da.u.6.51) iti kaninpratyayāntatvāt‌ nitsvareṇādyudāttatvam‌| evaṃ puruṣe'pi, sa hi `puraḥ kuṣan‌' (da.u.6.51) iti kuṣanpratyayānto vyutpādyate| brahmaṇa idamiti `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) iti brāhmaṇaśabdo'ṇantaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `kalastṛpaśca' (dā.u.8.107) iti `bṛṣādibhyaścit‌' (da.u.8.109) bahulavacanāt‌ `kamerbuk‌' (da.u.8.114?) iti kambalaśabdo vyutpādyate, tenāyaṃ citsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| kanyaśabdo'ntasvarita; `adhnyādayaśca' (da.u.8.14) iti nipātyate| atha vā--`kanī [`kana'--dhā.pā.] dīptikāntigatiṣu' (dhā.pā.460) ityasmāt‌ `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124) iti ṇyat‌, `kanyāyāḥ kanīna ca' (4.1.116) iti nipātanāt‌ vṛddhyabhāvaḥ| titsvareṇāyamantasvaritaḥ sampadyate| svanaśabdaḥ `svanahasorvā' (3.3.62) ityabantatvāt‌ dhātusvareṇādyudāttaḥ| paṭat‌ paṭad‌ ṣyanyata iti paṭahaśabdaḥ pṛṣodarāditvādantodāttaḥ| śabdaśabdaḥ `śāśapibhyāṃ dadanau' (da.u6.48) iti danpratyayāntatvānnitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| pacādiṣu `nadaṭ‌' iti paṭhyate, tena `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīpi kṛte tatra ca `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralope kṛta udāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodātto nadīśabdo bhavati| ghośabdo ghañantatvān‌ ñitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| pṛṣatsamicchabdau prātipadikasdareṇāntodāttau| atha rājapṛṣat‌, brāhmaṇasamidityatra kathamanto bhavati, yāvatā yo'tra samāsasyānto nāsau svarabhāk‌ yastu tasmāt‌ pūrvaḥ sa takāreṇa vyavahitaḥ? ityāha--`svaravidhau' itadyādi| `halante'pi' iti| samāsasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌| `antodāttatvam‌' iti| samāse ye'caḥ pūrve tadapekṣayā parasyāco'ntatvaṃ veditvayam| tena `nānapadasvarasyāpavādaḥ' iti| samāse hi padānāṃ pṛthak‌ svaro bhavati| yadivaṃ nocyeta tato nānāpṛthakpadānāṃ svaraḥ prāpnoti| atastadapavādo'yamucyate|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ|| <6.2> atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. bahubrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam‌| (6.2.1) `pūrvapadagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| prakṛtibhāvo hyatra tasya yūjyate vidhātum‌, yasyānudāttalakṣaṇo vikāraḥ prāpnoti| naca pūrvapadasyājjhalsamudāyasyāsau prāpnoti, kiṃ tarhi? svaritasya, udāttasya vā| tatra yadīha pūrvapadagrahaṇaṃ pūrvapada eva varttate, apārthakamevedaṃ vacanaṃ syāt‌! tasmāt‌ pūrvapadasye svara udātte svarite vā pūrvapadagrahaṇaṃ vartata iti vijñāyate| bhavati hi tātsthyāt‌ tācchabdyam‌, yathā--`mañcāḥ krośanti' iti| `svabhāvenāvatiṣṭhate' iti| anena prakṛtyā bhavatītayasyārthamācaṣṭe| tameva vākyāntareṇa spaṣṭīkarttumāha--`vikāramanudāttatvamāpadyate' iti| kathaṃ panaranudāttalakṣaṇo vikāraḥ prāpnoti, yannivṛttaye prakṛtibhāvo'yamārabhyate? ityāha--`samāsāntodāttatve hi sati' ityādi| `samāsāntodāttatvāpavādo'yam‌' iti| nāprāpte tasminnārambhāt‌| `kṛṣṇo mṛgaḥ' iti| kṛṣṇagṛṇatvāt‌| `ādyudāttaḥ' iti| ñitsvareṇa| `tatra ca' ityādi| tatra `stuvo dīrghaśca' (da.u7.4) iti dīrghagrahaṇamanuvarttate| `suśṛbhyāṃ nicca' (da.u.7.6) [sṛśṛbhyāmūrca--da.u.] ityato nicceti ca| `tenādyudāttaḥ' iti| nitsvareṇa| `kṛduttarapada' ityādi| brahmacārīti `vrate' (3.2.80) iti ṇiniḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ| tatra `gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) iti brahmacārīti śabdaḥ kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `snātakaśabdaḥ kanpratyayāntaḥ' [snātaśabdaḥ--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ--kāśikā] iti| kṣotriyam̐śchando'dīte' (5.2.74) iti nipātyate, tena nitsavareṇādyudāttaḥ| `manuṣyaśabdastitsvaritamiti' iti| `manorjātāvañyatau ṣukca' (4.1.161) iti yatpratyayāntatvāt‌| `udāttagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| tatrodāttagrahaṇam‌ `karṣātvato ghaño'nta udātta' (6.1.159) ityato'nuvartate| `svaritagrahaṇam‌' iti| `tit‌ svaritam‌' (6.1.1.85) ityataḥ| tataḥ kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| udāttasaritānuvṛtterhyetadeva prayojanam‌--yatrodāttaḥ svarito vāsti tatraiva yatā syāt‌| samaśabdo hi `sunoterḍamap‌' (?) iti ḍamappratayayānto vyutpādyate, tena dhātoṣṭilope kṛte pratyasya pittvāt‌ sarvānudātto bhavati|| 2. tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyāsaptamyupamānāvyayadvitīyākṛtyāḥ| (6.2.2) `yato'nāva ityādyudāttaḥ' iti| `nauvayodharma' (4.4.91) ityādinā yatpratyayāntasya tulyaśabdasya vyutpāditatvāt‌--tulayā sammitaṃ tulyamiti| `sadṛk‌śabdaḥ' ityādi| `tyādādiṣu dṛśo'nālocane kañca' (3.2.60) ityatra `samānānyayośceti vaktavyam‌' (vā.261) ityupasaṃkhyānaṃ kṛtam, tena sadṛkchabdaḥ kannantaḥ. `dṛgdṛśatuṣu' (6.3.89) iti samānasya sabhāvaḥ| `sadṛśaśabdo'pi' ityādi| kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvareṇetyapekṣate| `ikāraḥ pratyayaḥ' [ikārapratyayaḥ--kāśikā] iti| tatra `atra iḥ' (da.u.1.67) ityata ikāra pratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `kit‌' iti| `bhujeḥ kicca' (da.u.1.71) ityataḥ kidgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `sapratyayānto'kṣaśabdaḥ' iti| `aśerdevane' (da.u.9.24) ityatra `vṝtṝvadihanikamikaṣibhyaḥ saḥ' (da.u.9.21) [`kamikaṣiyumucibhyaḥ'--da.u.] ityataḥ sapratayayānuvṛtteḥ| `nabviṣayasya' iti| napuṃsakaliṅgaviṣayasyetyarthaḥ| `madhyodāttatvañca' iti| `nyagrodhasya ca kevalasya' iti| nipātanādityanena sambandhaḥ| `abrāhmaṇaḥ' iti| nañsamāsaḥ| `kubrahmaṇaḥ' ityādau `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti| `etānyavyayānyādyudāttāni' iti| `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.80) iti vacanāt‌, eṣāṃ ca nipātatvāt‌| tatra nkuśabdayoḥ `cādayo|satve' (1.4.57) iti cādiṣu pāṭhānnipātatvam‌, niratiśabdayostu `prādayaḥ' (1.4.58) iti, tayoḥ prādiṣu pāṭhāt‌| `avyaye' ityādi| avyaye pūrvapade prakṛtibhāve karttavye nañprabhṛtīnāmeva bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyam‌| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`caṅyanyatarasyām‌' (6.1.218) ityato'nayatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate; sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena nañkunipātānāmeva bhaviṣyatīti| `svātvākālakaḥ' iti| `mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt‌' (2.1.72) samāsaḥ `ktvātosunkasunaḥ' (1.1.40) iti pūrvapadasyāvyayatvam‌| `muhūrttasukham‌' ityādau `kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) iti dvitīyā| `sarvarātraśabdo'pyacpratyāntaḥ' iti| sarvā ca rātriśceti `pūrvakālaika' (2.1.49) ityādinā samāse `ahaḥ sarvaika' (5.4.87) ityādinācapratyayavidhānāt‌|| 3. varṇau varṇoṣvanete| (6.2.3) `ruhe raśca lo vā' iti| atra `hṛśyābhyāmitan‌' (da.u.6.12) itītano'nuvartanāt‌| `paramakṛṣṇaḥ' iti| atra samāsāntodāttatvameva|| 4. gādhalavaṇayoḥ pramāṇe| (6.2.4) `śambagādham‌' iti| gādhyata iti gādhaḥ, `gādhṛ `pratiṣṭhālipsayoḥ' (dhā.pā.4) [pratiṣṭhālipsayorgranthe ca--dhā.pā.] ardharcāditvāt‌ (2.4.31) pakṣe napuṃsakatvam‌| `artilūdhūsū' iti| anena sūtraikadeśena `artilūdhūsūkhanasahacara itraḥ' (3.2.184) ityetatsūtramupalakṣyate| `madhyodāttaḥ' iti| pratyayasvareṇa| `aśūpruṣi' iti| `aśūpruṣilaṭikaṇighaṭiviśibhyaḥ kan‌' (da.u.8.125) [aśūpruṣipluṣilaṭikaṭikaṇikhaṭiviśibhya) kvan‌--da.u.] iti sūtramupalakṣayati| nanu cāyāmaḥ-pramāṇam‌, `āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ syāt‌' iti vacanāt‌; na ca śambagādhamityādistatpuruṣaḥ pramāṇavācī, kiṃ tarhi, iyattāvācī? ityāha--`pramāṇam‌' ityādi| iyato bhāva iyattā, sā paricchidyate yena sa iyattāparicchedaḥ, sa evātra pramāṇaṃ veditavyam‌| na punarāyāma eva| tat‌ katham‌? pramīyate'neneti pramāṇamiti kriyāśabdo'tra pramāṇaśabdo gṛhyate, na tu rūḍhiśabdaḥ; lakṣyānurodhāt‌| tena yeneyattā paricchidyate tat‌ sarvaṃ pramāṇam‌| `svaravyaṅgyaṃ ca' iti| asya svare yo'yaṃ prakṛtibhāvo vidhīyate tena vyaṅgyaṃ dyotyamityartha-. `eteṣām‌' iti| śambagādhādīnām‌|| 5. dāyādyaṃ dāyāde| (6.2.5) dāyaḥ-bhāgaḥ, aṃśa ityarthaḥ| dāyamādatta iti dāyādaḥ| mūlavibhujāditvāt‌ kaḥ (vā.232)| dāyādasya karma dāyādyam‌| kiṃ punastat‌? dāya eva| sa hi dāyādirādīyamānaḥ karma bhavati| `udātta iti ca tanna vartate' iti| `mantre vṛṣa' (3.3.96) ityādeḥ sūtrāt‌| nanu ca nipūrvaḥ sūtre dhāturudāttaḥ tat‌ kathaṃ kevalādbhavati? ityāha--`bahulavacanāt‌' ityādi| yadi `svāmīśvarādhipati' (2.3.39) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhī vidhīyate| saptamyeva hi vidhātavyā, na ṣaṣṭhī, tasyāḥ `śeṣe' (2.3.50) ityeva siddhatvāt‌? ityata āha--`tasyāstu' ityādi| yadi saptamyeva vidhīyate, tato'sau viśeṣavihitatvāt‌ ṣaṣṭhyā bādhikā vijñāyeta, na tvevaṃ vijñāyeteti punaranayaiva śeṣalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyabhyanujñāyate, na tvapūrvā vidhīyate| tenāpratipadavihitatvādbhavatyeva samāsaḥ| `paramadāyādaḥ' iti| atra pūrvapadaṃ pūjāvāci, na dāyādyavāci|| 6. pratibandhi cirakṛcchrayoḥ| (6.2.6) kāryasiddhiṃ prativadhnāti vihantīti pratibandhi| tācchīlya āvaśyake vā ṇiniḥ| `viśeṣaṇasamāse kṛte' iti| nanu ca viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇye bhavati; na cedaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam‌, kathaṃ punaratra pūrvapadaṃ pratibandhi bhavati? ityāha--`gamanam‌' ityādi| acirakālabhāvini gamane kāryasiddhirniṣpadyate| `kṛcchrayogi ca' iti| kṛcchram‌-duḥkham‌, tadyogini gamane gantā prāpyamarthaṃ duḥkhenābhihanyamāno na prāpnoti tasmāccirakālabhāvi kṛcchrayogi vā yad‌ gamanaṃ tat‌ kāryasiddheḥ pratibandhi jāyate|| 7. pade'padeśe| (6.2.7) `vyājaḥ' iti| chadmetyarthaḥ| `mūtrapadena' iti| mūtravyājenetyarthaḥ| `ṣṭranpratyayāntaḥ' iti| `sivimucyoṣṭerūcca' (da.u.8.83) [ṣivimucyoṣṭerū ca-da.u.] ityatra ṣṭrannityasyānuvṛtteḥ| `mūtrayateḥ' iti| `mūtra parasravaṇe' (dhā.pā.1909)| uccāraśabdo'pi ghañantaḥ| ``thāthādi' ityādi| `ghañantatvāt‌|| 8. nivāte vātatrāṇe| (6.2.8) `kuḍyādihetuke' ityāda| kuḍyādihetuke vartante; kārye kāraṇopacārāt‌| bhavati kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ, yathā--`sarvamidaṃ purātanaṃ karma bhujayate' iti| `kavateḥ' iti| `ku śabde (dhā.pā.1042)| `ādyudāttaḥ' iti| `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) ityanena| `ḍyakpratyayāṃnto'ntodātta ityapare' iti| te `kavaterḍyak‌' (da.u.8.20) iti sūtramadhīyate|| 9. śārade'nārtave| (6.2.9) `rajjuśāradam‌, `dṛṣacchāradam‌' [dṛṣacchāradāḥ--kāśikā] iti| yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| `śāradaśabdo'ya pratyagravācī' iti| pratyagram‌-abhinavam‌, acirakālabhāvītyarthaḥ| etena nānārthavācitvaṃ śāradaśabdasya darśayati| `nityasamāsaḥ' iti| mahāvibhāṣāyāḥ prakṛtāyā vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt‌| `anupahatam‌' iti| rajobhiḥ| anupahatatvaṃ tu sadyaud‌dhṛtatvāt‌| `upratyayāntaḥ' iti| `sṛjerasuṃ ca' (da.u.1.100) ityatra `bhṛmṛśītṝcaritsaritanidhanimimasjibhya uḥ' (da.u.1.92) [bhṛmṛśītṝcaritsaritanimimasjibyaḥ uḥ--da.u.] ityata ukārapratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `adipratyayāntaḥ' [adikpratyayāntaḥ--mudritakāśikā, ādipratyayāntaḥ--mudritanyāsaḥ] iti| `dṛṇāteḥ ṣug‌ hrasvaśca' (da.u.6.45) ityatra `śṝdṝbhaso'diḥ' (da.u.6.42) ityato'dipratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `paramaśāradam‌' iti| śaradi bhavaṃ śāradam‌| `sandhivelādyṛtunakṣatrebhyo'ṇ‌' (4.3.16) iti sūtreṇotpanno'yaṃ śabdaḥ|| 10. adhvaryukaṣāyayorjātau| (6.2.10) `jātivācino niyataviṣayāḥ' iti| niyato viṣayo yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ| niyataviṣayatvaṃ tu jātiviśeṣatva eva vartamānatvāt‌| adhvaryuprabhṝtīnām‌ `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ' (kā.vṛ.4.1.63) iti caraṇatvājjātitvam‌| `yatpratyayāntaḥ' iti| `dyuprāgapāgudakpratīco yat‌' (4.2.101) iti| `kaṭhaśabdaḥ pacādyaci vyutpāditaḥ' iti| `kaṭha kṛcchrajīvane' (dhā.pā.333) ityasmāt‌| `tadevam‌' iti| yasmādedaṃ kālāpaśabdo'ṇantaḥ, tasmāt‌ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `ṭhaki satyantodāttaḥ' iti| `kitaḥ' (6.1.165) ityanena|| 11. sadṛśapratirūpayoḥ sādṛśye| (6.2.11) `pitṛsadṛśaḥ' iti| `tulyārtheḥ' (2.3.72) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhī, tṛtīyā ca, `pūrvasadṛśa' (2.1.31) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `pitṛmātṛśabdāvuṇādiṣvantodāttau nipātitau' iti| `naptṛneṣṭṛtvaṣṭṛhotṛpotṛbhātṛjāmātṛpitṛduhitṛ' (da.u.2.3) ityatra| atha sadṛśagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā mātṛsādṛśa pitṛsadṛśa ityatra `tatpuruṣe tulyārthaṃ' (6.2.2) ityeva siddham‌? ityata āha--`ṣaṣṭhīsamāsārthañca' ityādi| tulyārthe hi prayoge ṣaṣṭhyapi vidhīyate| tatra yadā mātṛsadṛśa iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ kriyate, tadapi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ sadṛśagrahaṇam‌| sati tvasyārambhe tṛtīyāsamānase'pi sadṛśagrahaṇaṃ karttavyamityata āha--`iha' ityādi| `dāsyāḥ sadṛśaḥ, vṛṣalyāḥ sadṛsa' iti atra `ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe' (6.3.21) ityaluki kṛte ṣaṣṭhīsamāsastatsadṛśagrahaṇaṃ prayojayati; aluki sati rūpaviśeṣasya vidyamānatvāt‌| yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsārthaṃ sadṛśagrahaṇamiha kriyate, tṛtīyāsamāso na kartavayaḥ; viśeṣābhāvāt‌? naitadasti; tatrāpi hi karttavya eva yatra ṣaṣṭhyarthe nāsti tadarthaḥ, yathā--vidyayā sadṛśo vidyāsadṛśa iti, na hyatra ṣaṣṭhyartho vidyate, kiṃ tarhi? tṛtīyārthaḥ, vidyayā hetunā sadṛśa ityarthaḥ| `atra' ityādi| tatra dāsīśabdasya ṅībudāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodāttārthaḥ| `daśi sevane' (dhā.pā.1786) [dasi āpyāyane--dhā.pā] iti, `daṃśeṣṭaṭanau na ā ca' (da.u.9.103) iti ṭapratyayānto nakārasya cākārādeśaḥ| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌, `yasyeti' (6.4.148) lopaḥ `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) ityudāttatvam‌| vṛṣalīśabdaḥ `jāterastrīviṣayāt‌' (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣanto'ntodātto bhavati pratyayasvareṇa|| 12. dvigau pramāṇe| (6.2.12) `prācyasaptaśamaḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `prācyaśabda ādyudāttaḥ' iti| yatpratyayāntatvāt‌ `yato'nāvaḥ (6.1.213) iti| `gāndhāriśabdaḥ kardamāditvādādyudātto madhyodātto vā' iti| `kardamādīnāñca' (phi.sū.3.10) ityatrādigrahaṇaṃ cānuvartate, tatra yadāderudātto vidhīyate tadā''dyudātto bhavati; yadā tu dvitīyasya tadā madhyodāttaḥ| 13. gantavyapaṇyaṃ vāṇije| (6.2.13) gamanīyam‌-gantavyam‌| paṇyam‌-vyavaharttavyamiti| `madravāṇijaḥ' iti| madreṣu yo vyavaharati sa evamucyate| `saptamīsamāsaḥ' [saptamīsamāsāḥ--kāśikā] iti| `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt‌| `rakpratyayāntatvāt‌' iti| `sphayitañci' (da.3.8.31) ityādinā made rakaṃ vidhāya vyutpāditatvāt‌|| 14. mātropajñopakramacchāye napuṃsake| (6.2.14) `tulyapramāṇe vartate' [tulyapramāṇaṃ--mudripāṭhaḥ] iti| tulyaṃ pramāṇaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ| `asvapadavigrahaḥ' iti svapadavigrahaḥ kasmānna bhavati? tāśaṃ hi--vākyaṃ kartavyaṃ yathā samāsārthaḥ pratīyate| `bhakṣāmātram‌' iti| asya ca bhikṣāyāstulyapramāṇamityeṣo'rthaḥ| na cāyaṃ svapadavigraheṇa śakyaḥ pratipādayitum‌; mātraśabdasya tulyapramāṇavṛttitvāt‌| sa hi samāsa eva tulyapramāṇe vartate, na vākye| ata evoktam‌--`mātraśabdo'yaṃ vṛttiviṣayaḥ' ityādi| vṛttiriha samāsavṛttireva viṣayaḥ| `apratyayā'ntodāttaḥ' [apratyayāntodāttaḥ--kāśikāmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| ṭāpā sahaikadeśa udāttanodāttatvāt‌| 15. sukhapriyayorhite| (6.2.15) `tatra sukhapriyaśabdau' ityādi| tacchabdena sukhapriyayoḥ pratyavamarśaḥ, tayoḥ suśapriyayoḥ heturāyatyām‌-janmāntare prītikaraḥ| tatra sukhapriyaśabdau varttate| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha--`taddhi hitam‌' ityādi| hi tadā cetyarthaḥ| tatpuruṣe prakṛtibhāvocyaṃ vidhīyate| eṣa hi tatpuruṣo hitavācī bhavati, yadi sukhapriyaśabdāvṛttarapade hitahotau varttate| hitañca kim‌? yadāyatyāṃ prīti karoti| kathaṃ punaḥ sukhāpriyaśabdau taddhetau varttate kāraṇe kāryopacārāt‌, yathā --naḍvalodakaṃ pādaroga iti|| 16. prītau ca| (6.2.16) atha prītau cetīdaṃ grahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā sukhapriyayoḥ prītyavyabhicārāt‌| evaṃ prītau gamyamānāyāṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`sukhapriyayoḥ prīti' [prītyetyādi--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| prītigrahaṇamantareṇāpi siddhe sukhapriyayoḥ prītyavyabhicārādyadiha prītigrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tadatiśayitā yā prītistasyā yathā syādityevamartham‌| `brāhmaṇacchātraśabdau pratyayasvareṇāntodāttau' iti| brāhmaṇaśabdo'ṇantaḥ| chātraśabdaḥ `chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ' (4.4.62) iti ṇapratyayāntaḥ| `kanyāśabdaḥ svaritāntaḥ' iti| adhnyādiṣu (da.u.8.14) tathā bhūtasyaiva pāṭhāt‌| `rājasukhaṃ rājaprīyam‌' iti| atra yadyapi sukhapriyayoḥ prītyavyabhicāritvāt‌ prītirgamyate, tathāpyatiśayena yā prītiḥ sā na gamyata iti bhavati pratyudāharaṇam‌|| 17. svaṃ svāmini| (6.2.17) 18. patyāvaiśvarye| (6.2.18) `dhānyamantaḥsvaritam‌' iti| ṇyadantatvāt‌ titsavareṇa| `vṛṣalyā bharttetyarthaḥ' iti| vṛṣalyāḥ kāmayiteti yāvat‌|| 19. nabhūvākciddidhiṣu| (6.2.19) `bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ' (3.2.179) iti kvipā bhūśabdo dhātusvareṇāntodāttaḥ| evaṃ vāk‌śabdaḥ, vacaḥ `kvibvacipracchi' (da.u.10.2) ityādinā kvip‌| `cit‌' iti| `citau saṃjñāne' (dhā.pā.39) ityasmāt‌ `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.187) iti kvip‌| `nṛtiśṛdhyoḥ kūḥ' (da.u.1.174) ityadhikṛtya `andūdṛmbhūjambūkaphelūkarkandhūdidhiṣūḥ (da.u.1.176) didhiṣūśabdaḥ kūpratyayānto'ntodātta iti|| 20. vā bhūvanam‌| (6.2.20) 21. āśaṅkābādhanediyaḥsu sambhāvane| (6.2.21) `śaki śaṅkāyām‌' (dhā.pā.86) ityetasmāt‌ `gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103) ityakārapratyayaḥ| kecittu ghañantasaya śaṅkaśabdasya grahaṇamiti varṇayanti| `bādhu loḍane' (dhā.pā.5) ityasmādāṅpūrvāt‌ dhañi `ābādhaḥ'| atyarthamantikaṃ `nedīyaḥ'| antikaśabdasya `antikabāḍhayornedasādhau' (5.3.63) itīyasuni paratonedādeśaḥ| `astitvādhyavasāyaḥ' iti| asatitvaniścaya ityarthaḥ. `gamanāśaṅkam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaṇatvānnapuṃsakaliṅgam‌, lokāśrayatvādvā liṅgasya|| 22. pūrvo bhūtapūrve| (6.2.22) `āḍhyo bhūtapūrvaḥ' iti| yaḥ pūrvamāḍhya āsīt‌ sa evamucyate| samāse gamyamānārthatvādbhūtaśabdo na prayajyate, yathā--dadhyodana ityatropasiktaśabdaḥ| `paramapūrvaḥ' iti| atra `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `atra paramaścāsau pūrvaśceti samāsaḥ' iti| itikaraṇo'rthanirdeśārthaḥ| paramaścasau pūrvaśceti yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ pūjyamānatālakṣaṇaḥ, tasminniha pratyudāharaṇe samāsa ityarthaḥ| `na tu paramo bhūtaḥ' iti| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| paramo bhūtapūrva iti yo'yaṃ vākyārthaḥ paramapūrvakālalakṣaṇaḥ, tasminnevātara samāsa ityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam‌? ityāha--`tathā ca' ityādi| caśabdo hi hītyarthe| ayaṃ samāso na bhavati| evaṃ satyadāharaṇamevedaṃ bhavati, na pratyudāharaṇam‌, pūrvaśabdasya bhūtapūrvavācitvāt‌| yastu prāyeṇa pustakeṣu pāṭho'tra `paramaścāsau bhūtapūrvaśceti vigraho na tu paramo bhūtapūrvaḥ' iti; sa pramādapāṭho veditavyaḥ; vākyadvaye'pi bhūtapūrvayorgamyamānatvāt‌|| 23. savidhasanīḍasamaryādasaveśasadeśeṣu sāmīpye| (6.2.23) saha viṣayā savidhaḥ, `tena saheti tulyayoge' (2.2.28) iti bahuvrīhiḥ, `vopasarjanasya' (6.3.82) iti sahasaya sabhāvaḥ| evaṃ sanīḍādiṣvapi bahuvrīhiḥ sabhāvaśca veditavyaḥ| madrasavidhamityādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| nanu ca saha viṣayetyevamādāvarthe savidhādayaḥ śabdā vyutpādyante, tat kathameṣāṃ sāmīpye vṛttiḥ? ityāha--`saha viṣayetyavamādikā' ityādi| ādiśabdena saha nīḍena saha maryādayetyevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌| evakāro'vadhāraṇārtho'bhidheyavyavacchedaṃ karoti--vyutpattinimittameva, nābhidheyamiti| `samīpavācinastvete' iti| atrāpi tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārtha eva| vasamīpavācina eva, na tu saha vidhayetyevamādivākyārthavācina iti|| 24. vispaṣṭādīni gaṇavacaneṣu| (6.2.24) `vispaṣṭakaṭukam‌' iti| kaṭuśabdāt‌ `saṃjñāyāṃ kan‌' (4.3.147)| `supseti samāsaḥ' iti| atha `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam‌' (2.1.57) iti vispaṣṭakaṭukamityatra vigṛhya kasmāt‌ karmadhāraya eva na kriyate? ityāha--`vispaṣṭādayo hyatra' ityādi| karmadhārayo hi sāmānādhikaraṇye sati bhavati| na ceha sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti| tasmādvispaṣṭādayo'tra kaṭukādeḥ śabdasya yat‌ pravṛttinimittaṃ kaṭukatvādi tasya viśeṣaṇam‌, na tadvato dravyasya| kaṭukādibhiśca śabdaiḥ kaṭukatvalakṣaṇo [kaṭukasyāstilakṣaṇo yasyāsti--iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] guṇo yasyāsti tadguṇavad‌dravyamabhidhīyate| tato vaiyadhikaraṇye nāsti karmadhārāyaḥ| tasmādyathoktena vidhinā samāso'tri karttavyaḥ| `vispaṣṭaḥ' [vispaṣṭaśabdaḥ--kāśikā] iti| `spaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.887) ityasya niṣṭhāyām‌ `dastaspaṣṭacchannajñaptāḥ' [vā dāntaśāntapūrṇadastaspaṣṭacchannajñaptāḥ--pā.sū.] (7.2.27) iti spaṣṭaśabdo nipatitaḥ, tasya viśabdena gatasamāsaḥ| `vicitraśabdaḥ' ityādi| `citra citrī karaṇe' (dhā.pā.1917) curādi, tasmādghaña, viśeṣeṇa citraṃ vicitram‌, prādisamāsaḥ| `avyayasvareṇa' iti| `tatpuruṣe tulyārthaṃ' (6.2.2) ityādinā vihitena| avayayaṃ punaratra viśabdaḥ, tasya ca `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) ityādyudāttatvam‌| `vicittaśabdam‌' iti| citī saṃjñāne' (dhā.pā.39) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ cittam‌| vigataṃ cittamasyeti bahuvrīhi| `bahuvrīhisvareṇa' iti| `citī saṃjñāne' (dhā.pā.39) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ cittam‌| vigataṃ cittamasyeti bahuvrīhi| `bahuvrīhisvareṇa' iti| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1) iti vihitena| `vyaktaśabdaḥ' ityādi| añjervipūrvasya niṣṭhāyāṃ gatisvara udāttaḥ, tatrekārasya sthāne yo yaṇ‌ sa udāttayaṇ‌ bhavati, tataḥ parasyakārasyānudāttasya svaritaḥ| `sampannaśabda' ityādi| padeḥ sampūrvasya niṣṭhāyāṃ sampannaśabdaḥ karttari ceti| `paṭupaṇḍitaśabdau pratyayasvareṇa' iti| antodāttagrahaṇamekavacanāntaṃ yat‌ prakṛtaṃ tasya vipariṇāmaṃ kṛtvā'ntodāttāviti sambandhaḥ karttavyaḥ| pāṭayateḥ `phalipāṭinamijanīnāṃ guk‌ pāṭinākidhaśca' [phalipāṭinamimanijanāṃ guk‌paṭinākidhataśca--da.u.] (da.u.1.103) ityupratyayaḥ, paṭiśabdaścādeśaḥ--paṭuḥ| `paḍi gatau' (dhā.pā.281) asmānniṣṭhāyāṃ `paṇḍitaḥ'| `kuśalaḥ' iti| kuśām̐llātīti `lā''dāne' (dhā.pā.1058) ityasmāt‌ `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) iti kaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ, `gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) ityuttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| `capalaśabdaścitsvareṇa' iti| antodatta ityapekṣate| kathamayamantodāttaścitsvareṇa? ityāha--`kalastṛpaśca' (da.u.8.107) ityataḥ kalapratyayānto vyutpādyate| tatra `bṛṣādibhyaścit‌' (da.u.8.109) ityataścidgrahaṇamanuvarttate| tena citsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `nipuṇaśabdaḥ' ityādi| `antodāttaḥ' iti| prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `puṇeḥ' iti `puṇa karmaṇi śune' (dhā.pā.1333) ityasmāt‌ `igupadhājñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ (3.1.135) iti kapratyayaḥ|| 25. śrajyāvamakanpāpavatmu bhāve karmadhāraye| (6.2.25) `gamanaśreṣṭham‌' iti| `lyuṭ‌ ca' (3.3.115) iti lyuṭ‌; viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| atiśayena praśasyaḥ śreyaḥ| dṛṣṭhannīyasunoḥ `praśasyasya śraḥ' (5.3.60) iti śrādeśaḥ| `vacanajyeṣṭham‌' iti| atrāpi| tayoreva pratyayayoḥ parataḥ praśasyaśabdasya jyādeśaḥ| `gamanakaniṣṭham‌, gamanakanīyaḥ' iti| iṣṭhannīyasunoḥ parato yuvaśabdasyālyaśabdasya ca `yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām‌' (5.3.64) iti kanādeśaḥ| nanu ca `śrajyakanām‌' iti katham‌? itikaraṇo hetau| yasmācchrajyakanāmihādeśānāṃ grahaṇaṃ te cājādau pratyaye praśasyādīnāṃ vidhīyanta iti kevalānāmasambhavaḥ| tasmāt‌ sāmarthyāt‌ tadvaduttarapadaṃ gṛhyate|| 26. kumāraśca| (6.2.26) `kumāraśramaṇā' iti| `prātapadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pā.21) iti kumārīśabdo'tra samasyate| evaṃ hi śramaṇaśabdena strīliṅgena sāmānādikaraṇyamupapadyate; nānyathā| `kumāraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ' iti| `kumāra krīḍāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1877) ityasmāt‌ pacādyaci vyutpāditatvāt‌| `kecit‌ punaḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ punarlakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣāyāṃ (vyā.pa.3) satyāmaviśeṣeṇeti labhyate? evaṃ manyate--cakāro'tra kriyate| sa cāsyaiva vidheḥ samuccayārthaḥ. tena sarvatrāviśeṣeṇa bhavati| evaṃ hi samuccayo bhavati, nānyatheti| ye tu `kumāraḥ śramaṇādibhiḥ' (2.1.70) ityatraiva samāsamicchanti, te pūrvavidhyapekṣayā cakāramiha samuccayārthaṃ varṇayanti|| 27. ādiḥ pratyenasi| (6.2.27) `pratigata enasā' iti| anena `avādayaḥ kruṣṭādyarthe tṛtīyayā' (vā.92) iti tatpuruṣatvaṃ pratyenaḥśabdasya darśayati| `pratigatameno vā yasya' iti| anena bahuvrīhitvam‌| `kumārapratyenāḥ' iti| `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| nanu ca neha sūtra udāttagrahaṇamasti, tat‌ kathamudāttasvaro labhyate? ityāha--`udātta ityetadiha' ityādi| kiṃ punastatsāmarthyam‌? ityāha--`pūrvapada' ityādi| na hi prakṛtisvarādanya eva svara ucyate| kiṃ tarhi? prakṛtisvara eva; yataḥ prakṛtyeti vartate| tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate--prakṛtibhāvena kamāraśabdasya yaḥ svaraḥ prāptaḥ sa āderbhavatīti| evañca sāmarthyādudātto labhyate| sa eva hi kumāraśabdasya prakṛtibhāvena svaraḥ|| 28. pūgeṣvanyatarasyām‌| (6.2.28) 29. igantakālakapālabhagālaśarāveṣu dvigau| (6.2.29) `taddhitārthe dvigoryap‌' iti| `māsādvyasi' (5.1.81) ityanuvarttamāne `dvigoryaṣ‌' (5.1.82) iti yap‌| `ṭhaño luk‌' iti| prāgvatīyasya| `pañcakapalaḥ' iti| pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ puroḍāśa iti `saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' (4.2.16) ityaṇ‌, tasya `dvigoḥ' (4.1.88) ityādinā luk‌| `ete samāsāḥ' iti| pañcakapāla ityevamādayo daśaśarāvaparyantāḥ| `kṛtāṣpratyayalopā' iti| kṛto'ṇpratyayalopo yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| pañ‌cadaśaśabdāvatra `graḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ' (phi.sū.2.28) ityudāttau| `pañcāśvaḥ' iti| taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| `ārhādagopuccha' (5.1.19) ityādinā ṭhak‌| `adhyardhapūrva' (5.1.28) ityādinā luk‌| pañca śarāvāṇyasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| atheha kathaṃ bhavati?--pañcāratnyo daśāratnya iti, yavātā yaṇādeśe kṛte guṇe ca nātregantamuttarapadam‌? ityāha--`pañcāratnyaḥ' ityādi| yad‌ yaṇguṇau hyajādau vibhaktau parata iti tāviha bahiraṅgau, svarastvantaraṅga; prāgvibhaktyutpatterbhāvāt‌, `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vya.pa.42)| tena pañcāratnya ityatrāpi dvigusvara igantalakṣaṇaḥ pravarttate| `sthānivadbhāvādvā' iti| `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti pūrvasvare karttavyo yo guṇaḥ sthānivadbhāvenegantalakṣaṇaḥ pravartate| nanu ca svaravidhau `na padanta' (1.1.58) ityādinā sthānivadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate? naitadasti; `svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśo na sthānivat‌' ityuktatvāt‌ (kā.1.1.58) na caivamiko yaṇguṇau lopājādeśau| `pañcāratnyaḥ' iti| aratniśabdo'tra `kṛdikārādaktinaḥ' (ga.sū.50) `sarvato'ktinnarthādityeke' (ga.sū.51) iti bahvādiṣu pāṭhānṅīṣantaḥ| ihāpi pūrvavat‌ taddhitārthe dviguḥ, mātracastu lopaḥ|| 30. bahvanyatarasyām‌| (6.2.30) pūrvoṇegantādiṣūttarapadeṣu bahuśabdasyāpi nityaṃ prakṛtisvare prāpte vikalpo'yamucyate| `bahuratniḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ samāsādi| `bahumāsyaḥ' iti| pūrvavadyap‌| bahukapālādayaḥ samāsāḥ, ihapi `saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' (4.2.16) ityatrāpi taddhitārthe kṛte'ṇpratyayalopā
