pratyayasavareṇāntodāttaḥ|| 42. kurugārahapatiriktagurvasūtajaratyaślīladṛḍharūpā pārevaḍavā taitilakadrūḥ paṇyakambalo dāsībhārāṇāṃ ca| (6.2.42) atra `kurugārhapata' ityevamādayaḥ paṇyakambalaparayantāḥ samastā-| tatra kurugārhapata--riṣataguru--ityetāvavibhaktikau| itare tu asūtajaratītayevamādayaḥ prathamaikavacanāntāḥ| sā ca prathamā subadhyatyayena ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne veditavyā| `dāsībhārāṇām‌' iti bahuvacanaṃ gaṇasya sūcanārtham‌| ata evāha--`dāsābhārādīnāṃ ca' iti| `kuruśabdaḥ kupratyayāntaḥ' iti| `kurbhraśca' (da.u.1.107) ityataḥ `ku' ityadhikṛtya `kṛgrorucaca' (da.u.1.109) iti kupratayayāntatvena vyutpāditatvāt‌| `kuruvṛjyorgārhapata iti vaktavyam‌' iti| kuruvṛjiśabdayorgārhapataśabda uttarapade prakṛtibhāvo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--kuruśabdasya tāvat‌ `kurugārhapata' (6.2.42) iti sūtadra evopādānādbhaviṣyati| vṛjiśabdasyāpi cakārasyehānuktasamuccayārthatvāditi| `vṛjiśabda ādyudāttaḥ' iti| vṛjerin‌| `igupadhāt‌ kicca' (da.u.1.48) ityevaṃ vyutpāditatvāt‌| `riktaguruḥ' iti| riktaguruśabdasya samānādhikaraṇasamāsatāṃ darśayati| evaṃ `asūtā jaratī' ityanenāpyasyāsūtajaratīśabdasya| `aślaulā dṛḍharūpā' ityanenāślīladṛḍharūpaśabdasāya| na sūtetyasūtāśabdo'pi nañsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| evamaślīlāśabdo'pi| na ślīlā'ślīlā| `sidhmāderākṛtigaṇatvāllac‌' iti| `sidhmādibhyaśca' (5.2.97) iti `prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasayām‌' (5.2.96) ityato lajitayasyānuvṛtteḥ| `kapilakāditvācca latvam‌' iti| `kṛpo ro laḥ' (8.2.18) ityatra `kapilakādīnāñcopasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.915) iti latvasyopasaṃkhyānāt‌| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--śrīryasyāsti tacślīlaśabdenīcyate? ityāha--`aślīladṛḍharūpā' ityādi| na ślīlamaślīlamiti aślolaśabdasyārthaḥ pratiṣidhyate| tatra yadi ślīlaśabdasya śrīryasyāsti sa ityartho na syādaślīladṛḍharūpetyatra niḥśrīkā nocyeta, ucyate ca, tato jñāyate śrīmadadvastu ślīlaśabdenocyata iti| `saṃkhthānamātreṇa śobhanā' iti| dṛḍhatvācca saṃsthānasya| śrīrahitatvācca saṃsthānamātreṇa śobhanā| mātraśabdaḥ śrīmattāyā vyavacchedakaḥ| `lāvaṇyarahitā' ityanena niḥśrīketyasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| `pāre vaḍaveva pārevaḍavā' iti| kena punaratra samāsaḥ? na hīvārthe samāsasya kiñcillakṣaṇamasti| athāpi kathañtit‌ samāsaḥ syāt‌| evamapi `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti vibhaktilopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`nipātanādeva' ityādi| `titilino'patyam‌' iti etenāpatyārthe titiliñśabdāt‌ taddhitotpattimiha darśayati| `chāttrā vā' [chāttro vā taitilaḥ--kāśikā] iti| titilana ityapeśrate| etenāpi `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityarthe taitilā iti| pūrvavadupasaṃkhyānāṭṭilopaḥ| `yadantatvāt‌' iti| `avadyapaṇya' (3.1.101) iti yadantasya nipātanāt‌| `ādyudāttaḥ' iti| `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) ityanena| `paṇyakambalaḥ saṃjñāyāmiti vaktvyam‌' [`saṃjñāyāṃ vaktavyam‌' iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| paṇyakambalaśabdaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ pūrvapadaprakṛtisavaro bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ, tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`pūgeṣvanyatarasyām‌' (6.2.28) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| saṃjñāyāmeva paṇyakambalaśabdaḥ pūragvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati, nānyatreti| `anyatra samāsāntodāttatvameva' iti| nanu ca paṇyaśabdo'yaṃ kṛtyapratyayāntaḥ `tatpuruṣe' (6.2.2) ityādinā tavasmin‌ paṇitavye pūrvapadasya prakṛtisavareṇaiva bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ samāsantodāttatvam‌? ityāha--`pratipadokte hi' ityādi| `kutyatulyākhyā ajātyā' (2.1.68) iti yaḥ kṛtyasamāsaḥ pratipadoktaḥ tatra `dvitīyākṛtyāḥ' (6.2.2) iti pūrvapadasya prakṛtibhāvo vihitaḥ| na cāyaṃ pratipadoktaḥ samāsaḥ| `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa (2.1.57) iti samānyena vihitatvāt‌| kuta etat‌? kambalaśabdasya jātiśabdatvāt‌| `dvitīyākṛtyā' ityanena sūtraikadeśena `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' ityādikaṃ sūtramupalakṣayati| `dāsībhāraḥ' iti| dāsīśabdaḥ pūrvamuktasvara| `devahūtiḥ' iti| pacādyajantatvādantodāttaḥ| `oṣaśabdo ghañantatvāt‌' iti| `uṣa dāhe' (dā.pā.696) ityasya ghañi vyutpāditatvāt‌| `candre māṅo ḍit‌' [candre mo ḍit‌--da.u.,paṃ.u.--`candre mo'siḥ'--kāśikāmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] (da.u.9.88) ityasiparatyayānto'yam‌| `mithune'siḥ pūrvavacca sarvam‌' (da.u.9.82) ityato'sipratyayasyānuvṛtteḥ| `candraśabdastu rakpratayayāntatvāt‌' iti| `sphāyitañci' (da.u.8.31) ityādinā sūtreṇa rakpratyayāntatvena vyutpāditatvāt‌| `sa sarvo dāsībhārādiṣu draṣṭavyaḥ' iti| dāsībhārāderākṛtigaṇatvāt‌|| 43. caturthī tadarthe| (6.2.43) `tadarthe' iti| tasmai idam‌, caturthyantam‌, tasya yorthastadartha ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaryūpaśabda ādyudātta? ityāha--`kusuyubhyāñca' ityādi| `pānīviṣibhyaḥ paḥ' (da.u.7.2) ityataḥ `paḥ' ityanuvarttamāne `kusuyubhyāñca' (da.u.7.5) [kuyubhyāñca--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti yūpaśabdaḥ papratyayānto vyutpādyate| tatra `suśṝbhyāṃ nicca' (paṃ.u.3.26) ityato niditi vartate, tenādayudātto bhavati| dīrghatvaṃ tu `stuvo dīrghaśca' (paṃ.u.3.25) ityato dīrghagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `kalapratyayāntaḥ' iti| `vṛṣādibhyaścit‌ (da.u.8.109) ityatra `kalastṛpaśaca' (da.u.8.107) ityataḥ kalapratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `rathaśabda ādyudāttaḥ' iti| hanikuṣinīramikāśibhyaḥ kthan' (da.u.8.107) ityataḥ kalapratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `rathaśabda ādyudattaḥ' iti| `hanikuṣinīramikāśibhyaḥ kthan‌' (da.u.8.107) ityataḥ kalapratyayānuvṛtteḥ| `rathaśabda ādyudāttaḥ' iti| `hanikuṣinīramikāśibhyaḥ kthan‌' (da.u.6.27) iti kathanpratyayāntatvāt‌| `vallīśabdo ṅīṣaḥ svareṇāntodāttaḥ' iti| ṅīṣ‌pratyayastu gaurāditvāt‌| (4.1.41) veditavyaḥ| `prakṛtivikārabhāve' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyenocyamānaḥ prakṛtivikārabhāve labhyate? pūrvavadanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tasya ca vyavasthitavibhāṣātvādvakṣyamāṇajñāpakāt‌|| 44. arthe| (6.2.44) `mātṛpitṛśabdāvantodāttau' iti| `naptṛneṣṭṭa' (da.u.2.3) ityādau tṛjantayostayornipātitatvāt‌| `litsvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ' iti| `devāt‌ tal‌' (5.4.27) iti tal‌pratyayantatvāt‌| kimarthaṃ punaretat‌, na `caturthī tadathe' (6.2.43) ityevaṃ siddham‌, arthaśabdo'pi tadarthamevottarapadaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tadarthaviśeṣā eva' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--arthaśabdo'pi vṛttau viśeṣavācī bhavatīti| yuktañcaitat‌| tadā mātrarthamityukte mātrādibhyo vyāvṛttarūpaṃ viśiṣṭameva mātrarthaṃ vastu pratīyate| `aśvadhāsaḥ' ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanaṃ darśayati|| 45. kte ca| (6.2.45) `aśvaśabda ādyudāttaḥ' iti| kvanparatyayāntatvat‌| `manuṣyaśabdo'ntasvaritaḥ' iti| `manordhātāvañyatau ṣukca' (4.1.161) iti yatpratyayāntatvāt‌| `pariśiṣṭamantodāttam‌' iti| tat‌ punargośabdaḥ, tāpasaśabdaśca| tatra `gamerḍos‌' (da.u.2.11) [gomarḍoḥ--da.u; paṃ.u.] iti ḍospratyayāntatvādgośabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| tāpasaśabdo'payaṇpratyayāntatvāt‌| sa hi `tapaḥsahasrābhyāṃ vinīnī' (5.2.102) `aṇ‌ ca' (5.2.103) ityaṇpratyayānto vyutpādyate| atha `gorakṣitam‌' iti kathamidamasyodāharaṇam‌, yāvatā gobhyo rakṣimiti tādarthye caturthī, tatra hi yogata uttarapadena bhavitavayam‌? ityata āha--`gobhyo rakṣitam‌' ityādi| na hyatra gavārthaṃ rakṣita ityeṣo'rtho vivakṣitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? gobhyo rakṣitaṃ dīyate ityetadadhyāhāryam‌| tasmāt‌ sampradāna eṣā caturthī, tat‌ kutastādarthyam‌!|| 46. karmadhāraye'niṣṭhā| (6.2.46) `śreṇikṛtāḥ' ityādi| `śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ' (2.1.59) iti samāsaḥ| `śreṇiśabda ādyudāttaḥ' iti| nitsvareṇa| sa hi `vījyājvaribhyo niḥ' (da.u.1.18) ityato niriti varttamāne `vahiśriśruyudruglāhātvaribhyo nit‌' (da.u.1.21) [`vahiśriyuśruglāhātvaribhyo nit‌' da.u.] ityevaṃ vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| `pūgaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ' iti| `mudigrorgaggau' (da.u.3.66) iti bahulavacanāt‌ pūño'pi gak‌| tena pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `kṛtākṛtam‌' iti| kṛtañca tadakṛtaṃ ceti `ktena nañviviśiṣṭenānañ‌' (2.1.60) iti samāsaḥ| ekadeśasya kṛtatvāt‌ kṛtam, tadaivaikadeśasyākṛtatvādakṛtam‌|| 47. ahīne dvitīyā| (6.2.47) hīnam‌-tyaktam‌, na hīnamahīnam‌| `kaṣṭaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ' iti| ktapratyayāntatvāt‌ pratyayasvareṇa| `kṛcchragahanayoḥ kaṣa' (7.2.22) itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ| `bahuvirīhisvareṇādyudāttaḥ' iti| triśabdo hi prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| tatra `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1) iti prakṛtisvare kṛte bahuvrīhisvareṇa triśakalaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| grāmaśabdo'pi ādyudāt‌ta eva| tathā hyasau `artistusuhusṛdhukṣi' (da.u.7.26) ityato manparatayaye'nuvartamāne `avateṣṭilopaśca' (da.u.7.27) `grasaterā ca' (da.u.7.28) iti manpratyayānto vyutpādyate| `kāntārātītaḥ' iti| kāntāramatītavān‌, tyaktavānityarthaḥ| kāntārātītaśabdo'tri hīnaśabdavacī| `dvitīyānupasarga iti vaktavyam‌' iti| dvitīyāntamanupasarge ktante prakṛtisvaraṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi tasyaivānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasyānuvṛttiṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣātvaṃ cāśritya kartavyam‌|| 48. tṛtīyā karmaṇi| (6.2.48) `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityeva siddhe pūrvapadaprakṛtisvare ca kṛtsavareṇa thāthādisvareṇa (6.2.144) bādhite tatpratipādanārtha vacanam‌| `ahihataḥ' iti| `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ| `ahirantodātto vyutpādataḥ' iti| āṅpūrvāddhanteḥ `janighasibhyāmiṇ‌' (da.u.1.58) iti vartamāne `vāterḍicaca' iti ḍiditi ca `āṅiśrihanibhyāṃ hrasvaśca' (da.u.1.66) ityanenāhiriṇanto vyutpāditaḥ| `kecidādayudāttamicchanti' iti| te `samāne khyaḥ sa codāttaḥ' (paṃ.u.4.136) ityudāttagrahaṇamapyanuvartayanti| `rakpratyayāntaḥ' iti| `sphāyitañci' (da.u.8.31) ityādinā rakpratyayāntatvena vyutpāditatvāt‌| `mahārājaṣṭacpratyayāntaḥ' iti| `sphāyitañci' (da.u.8.31) ityādinā rakpratyayāntatvena vyutvāditatvāt‌| `mahārājaṣṭacparatyayāntaḥ' iti| `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac‌' (5.4.91) iti ṭac‌pratyayāntatvāt‌| `dātralūnā' iti| `dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran‌' (3.2.181) ityanuvarttamāne `dāmnīśas‌' (3.2.182) ityādinā ṣṭran‌ pratyayānto dātraśabdo vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| sarvatra `tayoreva kṛtyatakhalārthāḥ' (3.4.70) iti karmaṇi ktaḥ|| 49. gatiranantaraḥ| (6.2.49) `prakṛtaḥ' iti| kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| prādayo'bivarjitā ādyudāttagaṇe nipātyante, tena praśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `abhyud‌dhṛtaḥ' iti| atra abhiśabdasyānantarasya na bhavati; atrocchaśabdasya ktāntena samāsaṃ kṛtvā paścādabhiśabdasyod‌dhṛśabdena samāsaḥ karttavyaḥ| atha vā--`kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) ityatra subgrahaṇasya nivartitatvādanekasaryāpi samāso bhavati| `samudāhṛtaḥ' iti| atrāpi samudorantarayorna bhavati| `kārakapūrvasya ti' ityādi| dūrādāgata ityatrāṅī gatisamāse kṛte satyanena prakṛtisvaraḥ, tata udātto bhavati| tato dūrādāgata iti `stokāntika' (2.1.39) ityādinā pañcamīsamāsaḥ, tasmin‌ kṛte `gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) iti vartamāne `thāthaghañ‌' (6.2.144) ityādinotatarapadasyāntodattatvaṃ vidhīyate| sa ca gatisvare sati vidhīyata iti śiṣṭatvena sa eva bhavati| `pañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ' (6.3.2) ityaluk‌| atha kathaṃ `samudghṛtaḥ' ityādi pratyudāharaṇamupapadyate, yāvatā `kṛdgrahaṇe gatakārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.126) iti gatiriha niṣṭhāgrahaṇenaiva gṛhyate, evañcānantara eva samuddhṛta ityatra samśabdaḥ, samudāhṛta ityatrāpi samucchabdau? ityata āha--`anantaragrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌' iti| anantaragarahaṇena hyevamarthaḥ kriyate--samuddhṛtamityādau mā bhūditi| yadi paribāṣeyamihaśrīyateta, tadā hi uddhṛta ityādau gatiranantara eveti vyāvartyābhāvādanantaragrahaṇamapārthakaṃ syāt‌| `prakṛtaḥ kaṭaṃ devadattaḥ' iti| `ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ karttari ca' (3.4.71) iti karattari hi kvapratyayaḥ|| 50. tādau ca niti kṛtyatau| (6.2.50) `prakartum‌' iti| tumun‌| `prakarteti tṛnnantaḥ' iti| tṛjantāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| `kṛtsvarabādhanārtham‌' ityādi| avyayasvarāpavādaḥ `gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) iti kṛtsvaraḥ prāpnoti, atastadbādhanārthaṃ vacanam‌| `prajalpākaḥ' iti| `jalpabhikṣa' (3.2.155) ityādinā ṣākan‌| `tṛjantaḥ' iti| tṛnnantāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti| atha nidgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌? prakṛṣṭamṛṣṭamṛttikā prabhṛttikā ityatara mā bhūditi cet‌? naitadasti; tathā hi--yatkrayāyuktāḥ prādayaḥ taṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñakāḥ bhavanti, (jai.pa.vṛ.99) mṛttikāśabdaścāyaṃ nāmadheyatvāt‌ kriyāvacī na bhavati, tena taṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñā nāstyeva? ityata āha--`kṛdgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| `kṛti' ityanena saṃjñāsambandhakālo lakṣyate, tena kṛtsaṃjñāvelāyāṃ yastādirityeṣo'rthaḥ sampadyata iti kṛdgrahaṇamupadeśe tādyarthaṃ bhavati; kṛtsaṃjñāpratipattikālasyopadeśakālatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ punarupadeśe yastādistadarthaṃ yatnaḥ kriyata ityāha--`iha' ityādi| yadi tadupadeśagrahaṇaṃ tādyartha na kriyeta, tadā pralapitetyatra na syāt‌; iṭā tāditāyā vihatatvāt‌| yasmiṃśca satadyupadeśa eva tādirbhatīti yadyapyuttarakālaṃ tāditā vihanyate, tathāpi bhavatyeva| `āgantuḥ' iti| `sitanigamimasi' (da.u.1.122) ityādanā tan‌ pratyayaḥ|| 51. tavai cāntaśca yugapat‌| (6.2.51) `anta udātto bhavati' iti| kathaṃ punarudātto bhavatītyeṣo labhyate, nehodāttagrahaṇamasti? na hyatrāpūrva eva svaro vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? `tikārakopapadat‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) iti prakṛtibhāvenāderyaḥ svaraḥ prāpnoti na eva, tat‌ kathaṃ prakṛtyeti vartate? tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate--tavāparatyayāntasya yaḥ prāpnoti so'ntyasya bhavatīti| sa codātta eveti samārthyādudātto labhyate| yugapadgrahaṇaṃ paryāyanivṛttyartham‌| `anvetavā' [āmvetavai--kāśikā] iti| anupūrvādeteḥ `kṛtyārthe `tavaikenkenyatvanaḥ' (3.4.14) iti tavaipratyayaḥ, guṇaḥ| `paripātavā' [paripātavai--kāśikā] iti| paripūrvāt‌ vibāteḥ| `abhicaritavā' [abhicaritavai--kāśikā] iti| abhipūrvāccarateḥ| `abhirantodāttaḥ' iti| prātipadakasvareṇa| 52. aniganto'ñcatau vapratyaye| (6.2.52) `vapratyaye' iti| vakāraḥ pratyayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `prāṅ‌' ityādi| prāñcītīti `ṛtvik‌' (3.2.59) ityādinā kvinpratyayaḥ, sa ca vakāramātra eva; kakārādīnāmanubandhatvāt‌; teṣāṃ cānaikāntatvāt‌| `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌, ekavacane halṅyādi (6.1.68) saṃyogāntalopau (8.2.23), `kvin‌ pratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti nakārasya kutvaṃ ṅkāraḥ| dvivacanabahuvacanayostu `stoścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti ścutvaṃ ñakāraḥ| upasargākāreṇa saha `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101)| `parāṅ‌' ityādi| parāśabda ādyudāttaḥ| tena `svarito vānudātte padādau' [`svarite vā'nudāte'padādau' iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ--nyāsaḥ kāśikā, padamaṃjarī ca] (8.2.6) ityeṣa vidhirna bhavati| `pratyaṅ' iti| atra pratiśabdasyegantatvāt‌ parakṛtibhāvo na bhavati| nanu ca yaṇādeśe kṛte so'pyaniganta eṣa? sthānivadbhāvādigantavyapadeśaḥ kṛte'pi yaṇādeśe bhaviṣyatītyadīṣaḥ| svaravidhau sthānivadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti cet‌? naitadasti; `svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśau na sthānivat‌, anyastu sthānivadeva' (kā.vṛ.1.1.58) ityuktametat‌| `udañcanaḥ' iti| lyuṭ‌| atrāpyuttarapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| `coraniganto'ñcatau' ityādi| corityanena `cau' (6.1.222) ityanena yadantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate tadupalakṣayati| coritayasyāvakāśaḥ--dadhīcaḥ, yatra gatirna bhavati; anigantasavarasyāvakāśo yatrāñcaterakāranakārau na lupyete--parāṅ‌, parāñcāditi; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--parācaḥ parāceti anigantaḥ svaro vati vipratiṣedhena| pratiṣedhaśabdastatrādhyāhāryaḥ|| 53. nyadhī ca| (6.2.53) igantārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `udātatasavaritayoḥ' ityādi| nirudāttaḥ `upasargāścābhivarjam‌' (phi.sū.4.81) iti, tena tadakārasthāne yo yaṇādeśaḥ sa udāttayaṇ‌| tena `udāttasvaritayoḥ' (8.2.4) ityādinā tataḥ paramañcaterakāraḥ svarito bhavati| adhyaṅityādau tu na bhavati; ādeśādyudāttatvāt‌, yaṇādeśa udattayaṇ‌ na bhavatīti kṛtvā|| 54. īṣadanyatarasyām‌| samāsasvarāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ| `īṣatkaḍāraḥ' iti| `īṣadakṛtā' (2.2.7) iti samāsaḥ| yadāyaṃ prakṛtibhāvo na bhavati, tadā samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| `īṣadbheda ityevamādau kṛtsvara eva bhavati' iti| paratvāditi bhāvaḥ| ādiśabdena īṣatkara ityādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌| `īṣad‌duḥsuṣu' (3.3.126) ityādinā khal‌|| 55. hiraṇyaparimāṇaṃ dhane| (6.2.55) hiraṇyaparimāṇaṃ parimāṇavad hiraṇyamityarthaḥ| iha tu tadvāciśabdarūpaṃ gṛhyate| `dvisuvarṇadhanam‌' iti| suvarṇaśabdo hiraṇyaparimāṇaviśeṣavācī| dve suvarṇe parimāṇamasyeti `taddhitārtha' (2.1.51) iti samāsaḥ| `tadasya parimāṇam‌' (5.1.57) iti `prāgvateṣṭhañ‌' (5.1.18) `adhyardhapūrva' (5.1.28 ityādinā luk‌, tato dhanaśabdena saha karmadhārayaḥ| dvisuvarṇaśabdaḥ samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `bahuvrīhāvapi' ityādi| yadvā--dvisuvarṇa dhanaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ; tadapi paratvādvikalpa eva bhavati; na tu `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1) ityeṣa nityo vidhiḥ| `prasthadhanam‌' iti| ayamapi karmadhārayaḥ| bahuvrīhirvā| prasthaśabdo bhavati parimāṇaṃ, na tu hiraṇyasaya, kiṃ tarhi? dhānyādeḥ| `kāñcanadhanam‌' iti| yadi parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā `hiraṇyam‌' ityetādaducyamāna ihāpi syāt‌; kāñcanaśabdasya hiraṇyavācitvāt‌| hiraṇyavācyapi parimāṇavācī na bhavatīti na bhavatyeṣa prasaṅgaḥ| ayamapi samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ|| 56. prathamo'ciropasampattau| (6.2.56) `aciropaśleṣaḥ' iti| acirakālasambandha ityartha-| asyaivārtha prasiddhatarārthena pradarśayatumāha--`abhinavatvam‌' iti| `prathamavaiyākaraṇaḥ' iti| prathamaśca vaiyākaraṇaśceti `pūrvāpara' (2.1.58) ityādinā samāsaḥ| tatra yattadvaiyākaraṇatvaṃ vyākaraṇasyādhyetṛtvam‌| anenācirakālasambandho'dhyeturgamyate| abhinavavaiyākaraṇādinā'cirakālopasampattimudāharaṇe darśayati| `ādyo mukhyo yaḥ saḥ' iti| anenāpi pratyudāharaṇaviṣayasya prathamaśabdasyānyārthatāṃ ca pakṣe'ciropasampatterabhāvaṃ ca| ayamapi samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ. evamuttare'pi|| 57. katarakatamau karmadhāraye| (6.2.57) `kiṃyattado nirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac‌' (5.3.92) `vā būnāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac‌' (5.3.93) iti katarakatamaśabdau vyutpādyete, tena tau citsvareṇāntodāttau| `katarakaṭhaḥ' iti| `katarakatamau jātiparipraśne' (2.1.63) iti samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ| etadarthamapi karmadhārayagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`iha tu' ityādi| katarakatamaśabdayorhi yaḥ pratipadasamāsaḥ sa eva lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) vijñāyate| sa ca karmadhāraya eva| tasmāt‌ pratipadoktatvādevaitatsamāsasya karmadhārayatvam‌| tasmannaitadarthaṃ karmadhārayagrahaṇamupapadyate|| 58. āryo brāhmaṇakumārayoḥ| (6.2.58) `āryabrāhmaṇaḥ' iti| āryaścāsau brāhmaṇaśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `āryaśabdo ṇyadantaḥ' iti| `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124) iti ṇyati vyutpāditatvāt‌| `antasvaritaḥ' iti| titsvareṇa| pratyudāharaṇe tu samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati|| 59. rājā ca| (6.2.59) rājabrāhmaṇam‌' [`rājabrāhmaṇaḥ'--kāśikā] iti| pūrvavat‌ samāsaḥ| pratyudāharaṇe'pi pūrvavat‌| rājaśabdaḥ kvaninpratayayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ| `pṛthagyogakaraṇamuttarārtham‌' iti| uttaro vidhī rājaśabdasyaiva yathā syāt‌| āryaśabdasya mā bhūditi|| 60. ṣaṣṭhī pratyanasi| (6.2.60) `rājña) pratyenāḥ' iti| `ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe' (6.3.21) iti vibhakteraluk‌|| 61. kte nityārthe| (6.2.61) nityaśabda ābhīkṣṇye, na kūṭasthe| kuta etat‌? kta ityucyate, ktaśca dhātorvidhīyate, dhātuśca kriyāvacanaḥ| kriyāpāśca kauṭasthyaṃ nopapadyate; kṣaṇikatvāt‌ kriyāyāḥ| tasyāstu paunaḥpunyādyapekṣayā yuktamābhīkṣṇyam‌| `kālāḥ (2.1.28) iti dvitīyāsamāso'yam‌' iti| dvitīyā tu `kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' (2.3.5) iti| atha vā--karmaṇyeva| karmasaṃjñā tu `kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām‌' (ma.bhā.1.4.51) iti vacanāt‌| `nityaśabdaḥ' ityādi| anena `dhruva upasaṃkyānam‌' (vā.434) iti nernityaśabdo vyutpādyate tyadantaḥ| tataśca tyapaḥ pittvenānudāttatvānneścodāttatvādādyudātto bhavati| `satatamiti yadā karmaṇi ktastadā thāthādisvareṇāntodāttaḥ' iti--ayukto'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ| yadā hi karmaṇi ktastadā `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti gateḥ prakṛtibhāve satyādyudāttena satataśabdena bhavitavyam‌| tasmāt‌ `satatamiti yadā bhāve ktastadā thāthādi (6.2.144) svareṇāntodāttaḥ' ityayaṃ tatrānavadyaḥ pāṭho veditavyaḥ| tathā hi satataśabdo'pi thāthādisvareṇāntodāttaḥ (6.2.144)| bhāve hīyaṃ niṣṭheti gatisvaro na bhavatītyuktam‌| yadā tu kramaṇi ktastadā tu gatisvareṇa satataśabda dyudātta eva bhavati| `samo vā hitatatayoḥ' (vapā.6.1.144) iti samo makāralopaḥ| `muhūrtaprahasitaḥ' iti| atra thāthādisvara (6.2.144) eva bhavati prahasita iti haserakarmaktāvat‌ kartari ktaḥ| samāsasvare dvitīyāpūrvapadaprakṛtisavareṇa bādhite sati thāthādisvaraḥ prāpnoti| atastadapadādo yogaḥ|| 62. grāmaḥ śilpini| (6.2.62) saptamīnirdiṣṭagrahaṇamanuvartate| tena śilpinītyarthagrahaṇam‌| grāma iti svarūpagrahaṇameva| `grāmanāpitaḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttaro'pi|| 63. rājā ca praśaṃsāyām‌| (6.2.63) `karmadhāraye' ityādi| rājanāpitaḥ' iti| karmadhārayo'yaṃ vā syāt‌, ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo vā? tatra yadā karmadhārayastadā rājaśabdasya nāpita upacāreṇa vṛttiḥ| upacārastu rājaguṇāropanibandhanaḥ, atastenaivottarapadasya praśaṃsā bhavati| kathaṃ punarnāpitaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsena rājanāpitaśabdenocyate? ityāha `rājayogyatayā tasya' ityādi| sa hi svakarmaṇi pravīṇatvādrājānaṃ prati yogyo bhavati| ato'pi rājanāpita iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsenocyate| atra pakṣe tasyaiva yogyatayottarapadasya praśaṃsā veditavyā|| 64. ādirudāttaḥ| (6.2.64) `adiḥ' ityādinādyadhikārasyāvadhiṃ darśayati| `udāttaḥ' ityādināpyudāttādhikārasya|| 65. saptamīhāriṇau dharmye'haraṇe| (6.2.65) hārītyāvaśyake ṇiniḥ| saptamītyanena sāhacaryādhārīti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati| ata evāha--`hārivāci parvapadam‌' iti| `dharmye' ityatrāpi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; aharaṇa iti pratiṣedhāt‌| ata evāha--`dharmyavācini' iti| `ācāraniyatam‌' iti| ācāre niyatamiti; tato'nyatrābhāvat‌. ācāre niyatam‌, ācāreṇa vā niyatamācāraniyatam‌| yadācāravaśādavaśyakarttavyaṃ tadācāraniyataṃ bhavati| kathaṃ punarācāraniyataṃ dharmayamucyate? ityāha--`dharmo hyanuvṛttaḥ' ityādi| anuvṛtta iti vyavasthita ityarthaḥ| `tasmāt‌' iti| dharmādanapetamiti| anugatamityarthaḥ| `tena' iti| dharmeṇa| `prāptam‌' iti| labhyamityarthaḥ| ubhayathāpyarthe `nauvayodharma' (4.4.91) ityādinā yat‌| itikaraṇo hiśabdaśca hetau| yasmādācāraviśeṣo dharma ucyate, yacca tasmāddharmādanapetam‌| yadvā tena prāpyaṃ taddharmyam‌| tenācāraniyataṃ dharmyamityucyate| `saṃjñāyām‌' (2.1.44) iti saptamīsagāsaḥ' iti| yadyevam‌, vibhakterluk‌ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`kāranāmni ca' ityādi| `yājñikāśvaḥ' ityādau tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `kvacit' ityādinā stūpeśāṇa ityādyudāharaṇeṣu śāṇāderyasyācāraniyatatāṃ darśayat‌ uttarapadasya dharmyavācitvaṃ darśayati--`yājñikādīnāmaśvādi' iti| kvacidayamācāre vyavasthita ityanena dātavyamityanena ca sambandhaḥ| yājñikādayo hi hāriṇaḥ, te deyamaśvādikaṃ svīkurvanti| `stamberamaḥ' iti| mtambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ' (3.2.13) ityac‌, upapadasamāsaḥ, `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam‌' (6.3.14) iti vibhakteralugbhavati| atra stamberama ityatra stamba ityet‌ saptamyantam‌, na tu ramaśabdo dharmyavācī| `karmakaravarddhitakaḥ' iti| atra karmakaro hārī bhavati, sa hi varddhitakaṃ svīkaroti| na tu varddhitakaśabdo dharmyavācī| na hi kvacidayamācāro vyavasthitaḥ karmakarāya varddhitako dātavya iti| `vaḍavāyā ayaṃ vāḍavaḥ' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| `bījaniṣekāt‌' iti| garbhādhānam‌-bījaniṣekaḥ| atra vāḍavo'śvo hārī sa hi haraṇaṃ deyaṃ svīkaroti| haraṇam‌-deyaṃ dharmyam‌| kvacidayamācāro vyavasthitaḥ--yenāśvena vaḍavāyāṃ garbha ādhīyate tasya bījaniṣekāduttarakalaṃ śarīrapuṣṭyarthaṃ yogyāśanādikaṃ dātavyamiti| tena haraṇaśabdo dharmyavācī bhavati| tathāpyaharaṇa iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati| tataśca kṛtsvare prāpte `ano bhāvakarmavacanaḥ' (6.2.150) ityuttarapadaṃ lyuḍantamantodāttaṃ bhavati| nanu ca paratvādevāyaṃ svaro bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kimaharaṇa iti pratiṣedhena? ityata āha--`paro'pi' ityādi| tenetyādinā jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `vāḍavahāryam‌' iti| `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124) iti haraterṇyat‌--hāryam‌, tat‌ punastadeva grahaṇam‌| vāḍavasya hāryaṃ vāḍavahāryam‌| tatra yadi jñāpanārthamanantaroktasyārthasya haraṇapratiṣedho na kriyeta, tadā paratvāt‌ `gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌ (6.2.139) iti kṛtsvareṇottarapadasyāntasvaritatvaṃ syāt‌| asmiṃstu satyayameva hārisvaro bhavati| stūpeśāṇa ityādau yatra sampamyantaṃ pūrvapadaṃ tatra `samāsasya' (6.1.223) ityasyāpavāde `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtitvare prāpte pūrvavadādyudāttamidamucyate| pūrvapadāni ca prāyeṇāntodāttāni, tathā hi--`sṭūpa samucchrāye' (dhā.pā.1672) ityasya caurādikasya pacādyaci stūpaśabdo vyutpādyate, tenā'sāvantodāttaḥ| saptamyā sahaikadeśe vikṛte'ntodātta eva bhavati| `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) iti| `maki maṇḍane' (dhā.pā.89) ityetasmāt‌ `uṇādayo bahulam‌', (3.3.1) ityuṇāditvam‌, nalopaśca, tena makuṭaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `hala vilekhane' (dhā.pā.837) ityetasmāt‌ `khano gha ca' (3.3.125) iti ghitkaraṇenānyato'di gho bhavatīti jñāpitatvādghapratyayaḥ| tena halaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `dṝ vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1493) ityasmāt‌ `śṛdṝbhaso'diḥ' (da.u.6.42) iti, `dṛṇāteḥ ṣug‌ hrasavaśca' (da.u.6.45) iti dṛṣacchabdo vyutpādyate, tena so'pyantodāttaḥ| `yājñikāśvaḥ' ityādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| tatra samāsasvare prāpte hārivācinaḥ pūrvapavasyādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syādityevamarthamidam‌| atra ca pūrvapadānāmuttarapadānāṃ cāsamāsāvasthāyāṃ yaḥ svaraḥ sa nā''khyāyate; samāse kṛte tasya prayogasamavāyitvāt‌| nāpi samāse kṛte tasya prāptirasati| sa `prakṛtibhāvena tasmin‌ prāpte satīdamārabhyate' ityasyārthasya pradarśanārthamākhyāyate| ata eva ca pūrvatrāpi nākhyātaḥ|| 66. yukte ca| (6.2.66) yuktaḥ-samāhitaḥ, kārye tatpara ityucyate| `goballavaḥ' iti| adhikāranāma, so'syāstīti `vaprakaraṇe'nyebhyo'pi dṛśyate (vā.580) iti vapratyayaḥ, gavāṃ ballava iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atrāpi samāsasvara eva prāpte pūrvapadādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| `gomaṇindaḥ' iti| maṇiṃ dadātīti `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3), `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam‌' (6.3.14) iti vibhkteraluk‌, tato gavāṃ maṇinda iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atrāpi samāsasvara eva prāpte'yaṃ vidhiḥ| `gosaṃkhyaḥ' iti| gāṃ sañcaṣṭa iti `sami khyaḥ' (3.2.7) iti kaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ `gatikārakopapadāt‌' (6.2.139) iti kṛtsvare prāpte pūrvapadasyodāttārthamihāpi vacanam‌! nanu ca paratvāt‌ thāthādisvaraḥ (6.2.144) prāpnoti, tasmādgoballavādau kathamidaṃ vacanamiti, yuktasvaraṃ kṛtsavara eva bādheta? evaṃ tarhi pūrvavipratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ; paraśabdasyeṣṭavācitvāt‌| goballava ityevamādayaḥ samāsāḥ sarve yuktavācina iti darśayannāha--`yukta iti samāhitaḥ' ityādi| anena `yuja samādhau' (dhā.pa.1177) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ yukta ityetaddarśayati|| 67. vibhāṣā'dhyakṣe| (6.2.67) adhyakṣaśabdo'pi samāse yuktavācyeva, tatra pūrveṇa nityamādyudāttatve prāpte vibhāṣeyamārabhyate| ādyudāttatvena mukte samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| gavāmadhyakṣa iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ|| 68. pāpaṃ ca śilpini| (6.2.68) pāpamiti svarūpagrahaṇam‌| śilpinītyatrārthagrahaṇam‌| arthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, grāmaśilpinītyatra śilpigrahaṇādarthagrahaṇaṃ prasiddham‌, ata ihāpyarthagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate? nityaṃ samāsasvare prāpte vikalpena pūrvapadasyādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, tenamukte samāsasvara eva bhavati| atheha kasmānna bhavati--pāpasya nāpita iti? ata āha--`pāpaśabdasya pratipadoktaḥ' iti| `tasmāt‌ ṣaṣṭhī samāse na bhavati' iti| pratipadokte hi samāse sati lakṣaṇa pratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati; nānyasya|| 69. gotrāntevāsimāṇavabrāhmaṇeṣu kṣepe| (6.2.69) `gotrādhikārādanyatra gotragrahaṇe lokikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhate' (kā.vṛ.4.2.39) ityuktam‌| loke cāpatyamātre prasiddham‌, teneha tasyaiva grahaṇam‌, na tu pāribhāṣikasya| antevāsī-śiṣyaḥ| tatrāntevasigrahaṇādarthagrahaṇaṃ prasiddham‌| ata ihāpyartha eva gṛhyate, na svarūpam‌| māṇavabrāhmaṇayoḥ svarūpameva| manorayaṃ māṇavaḥ, asmādeva nipātanāṇṇatvam‌| `abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti' (pu.pa.vṛ.99) iti pakṣe mānava ityapi bhavati| brahmaṇo'yaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ| yastu `apatye kutsite mūḍhe manorautsargikaḥ smṛtaḥ' (kā.vṛ.4.1.161) iti māṇavakaśabdo vyutpādyate, yaśca brahmaṇo'patyaṃ brāhmaṇa ityarthe brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ tayorgotragrahaṇenaiva siddham‌| kṣepaḥ nindā| `jaṅghāvātsyaḥ' iti| `sup‌ supā' (2.1.4) iti samāsaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra kṣepaḥ? ityāha--`yo jaṅghādānam‌' ityādi| jaṅghādānaṃ kimapyācāraniyataṃ deyamucyate, taddadānyahamityato'bhiprāyeṇa vātsyaḥ sampadyate| vātsyo'hamityabhyupagacchati yaḥ saḥ jaṅghāvātsya ityevaṃ nindyate| avātsyasyāpi sato jaṅghādānaṃ prati vātsyatvābhyupagamāt‌| vātsyaśabdo'yaṃ gargādiḥ| `bhāryāsauśrutaḥ' iti| suśruto'patyaṃ sauśruta ityaṇ‌, bhāryāpradhānaḥ sauśruto bhāryāsauśrutaḥ| `samānādhikaraṇādhikāre śākapārthivādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamuttarapadalopaśca' (vā.83) iti samāsaḥ| suśrutasya bhāryāpradhānatayetyanena samānādhikaraṇenātra samāsa iti darśayati| suśruto'patyamityanenāpi sauśrutasyāṇpratayayāntatvam‌| `vaśābrāhmakṛteyaḥ' iti| tenaivopasaṃkhyānena samāsaḥ| atrāpi vaśāpradhānatayā brahmakṛtāpatyasya kṣepaḥ| `kumārīdīkṣāḥ' iti| `sup‌ supā' (2.1.4) iti samāsaḥ| evaṃ `kambalacārāyaṇīyāḥ' ityatrāpi| dākṣiṇā proktaṃ dākṣaṃ śāstram‌| `iñaśca' (4.2.112) ityaṇ‌, dākṣamadhīyate tadvettīti vā punaraṇ‌, tasya `proktālluk‌' (4.2.64) iti luk‌| caraśabdo naḍādiḥ, carasyāpatyaṃ cārāyaṇaḥ, tena proktaṃ cārāyaṇīyam‌| `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114), `tadadhīte' (4.2.59) iti pūrvavadaṇ‌| pāṇinā proktaṃ pāṇanīyam‌, tataḥ pūrvavadadhyetaryaṇ‌ tasya ca luk‌| `kamāryādilābhakāmāḥ' iti| ādiśabdena kambalaudanādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌| atrāpi `sup‌ supā' (2.1.4) iti samāsaḥ| tenaivopasaṃkhyānena vā kumārīlābhakāmā dākṣāḥ kumārīdākṣāḥ| `bhikṣāmāṇavaḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ samāsaḥ| bhikṣālābhakāmo māṇavo bhikṣāmāṇavaḥ| `dāsībrāhmaṇaḥ' iti| dāsyāḥ kāmayitā brāhmaṇo dāsībrāhmaṇaḥ| evaṃ `vṛṣalībrāhmaṇaḥ' iti| `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti bahulavacanādakṛtāpi samāsaḥ| `tṛtīyā' (2.3.18) iti yogavibhāgādvā| `dāsīśrotriyaḥ' iti| dāsībrāhmaṇa ityanena tulyam‌| samāsasvarāpavāyo yogaḥ|| 70. aṅgāni maireye| (6.2.70) aṅgaśabdo'yaṃ kāraṇavācī| ārambhakaṃ yat‌ tadaṅgamucyate| aṅgānīti bahuvacanaṃ svarūpavidhinirāsārtham‌| surāvarjyaṃ madyam‌-maireyamityabhidhīyate| `guḍamaireyaḥ, madhumaireyaḥ' iti| ṣṭhāsamāsaḥ| `guḍavikārasya mairayasya guḍo'ṅgam‌' iti| tatkāraṇatvāt‌| ayamapi samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ|| 71. bhaktakhyāstadartheṣu| (6.2.71) ākhyāgrahaṇaṃ svarūpavidhinirāsārtham‌| nanu ca bahuvacanādeva svarūpavidhirna bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; bahuvacanaṃ hyetadarthasyaiva bahutvamācakṣīta--bahvarthavṛttiryo bhaktaśabda iti| api ca bahuvacanena svarūpavidhau bādhite'nnādaya eva ye bhaktaśabdena samāsārthaparyāyāste gṛhyeran‌, na tu bhakataviśeṣavācino bhikṣādayaḥ| ākhyāgrahaṇe tu svarūpavidau bādhite bahuvacanena tadviśeṣāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ sampadyate| tasmā idaṃ tadartham‌| tacchabdena bhaktākhyānāmartho nirdiśyate| `bhikṣākaṃsaḥ' ityevamādayaḥ `caturthī tadarthārtha' (2.1.36) iti caturthīsamāsāḥ| nanu ca prakṛtivikṛtigrahaṇaṃ tatra codyate, na ceha prakṛtivikārabhāvaḥ? satyametat‌; idameva tu vacanaṃ jñāpakam--bhaktākhyāyāṃ tādarthyamātre caturthī samasyata iti| `samaśanaṃ samāśaḥ' iti| `aśū bhojane' (dhā.pā.1523) [aśa bhojane--dhā.pā] ityasmāt‌ sampūrvādbhāve ghañ‌| `kriyāmātramucyate' iti| mātraśabdena bhaktavyavacchedaṃ karoti| `atra pūrvapadamantodāttam‌' iti| bhikṣāśabdaḥ `gurośca halaḥ' (3.3.103) iti bhikṣerapratyayaṃ kṛtvā vyutpādyate, śrāṇāśabdo'pi `śrai pāke' (dhā.pā.919) ityasmāt‌ ktapratyayam‌| tena dvāvapi pratyayasvareṇāntodāttau| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1) iti prakṛtibhāvenāntodāttādeva bhavataḥ| samāsasavarāpavādo yogaḥ|| 72. gobiḍālāsiṃhasaindhaveṣūpamāne| (6.2.72) upamānaśabdo'yaṃ gavādibhiḥ pratyekamabhimasambadhyate; anyathaikavacanāntasya bahuvacanāntaiḥ samānādhikaraṇena viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo na syāt‌| tha vā subvyatyaye bahuvacanasyaiva sthāna idamekavacanaṃ draṣṭavyam‌| `dhānyagavaḥ' iti| `gorataddhitaluki' (5.4.91) ṭaca samāsāntaḥ| atra citsvare prāpte pūrvapadasyādyudāttatavaṃ vidhīyate| `bhikṣābiḍālaḥ' ityevamādau samāsasvare| upamānārtho'pi' ityādi| yo'yamatrodāharaṇe upamānārthaḥ sambhavati, sa tatra yojayitavyaḥ| `yathāprasiddhi ca' iti| yasyopamānasyārthasya ca loke prasiddhiḥ sa tathā yojayitavyaḥ| tatra diṅmātramupamānārthayojanasya darśayitumāha--gavākṛtiḥ-gosaṃsthānam‌, tayā sanniveśitaṃ goryatsaṃsthānaṃ tena sanniveśitaṃ vyavasthāpitaṃ dhānyagavaśabdenocyate; tulyākṛtitvāt‌| evamanyatrāpi yat‌ kiñcit‌ sādṛśyaṃ yojyam‌| yathā goracanāviśeṣāvayavānāmevaṃ yasya hiraṇyasya taddhiraṇyaṃ hiraṇyagavaśabdenocyate| yathā biḍālā alpapramāṇāstathā hi bhikṣā, yathā vā biḍālāḥ kvacidbhavanti na sarvatra tathā bhikṣāpi| evaṃ śrāṇābiḍālayoḥ sādṛśyamevañjātīyakaṃ yojayitavyam‌| siṃhākṛtyā sanniviṣṭaṃ tṛṇaṃ tṛṇasiṃhaḥ| yathā saindhavaṃ śuklamevaṃ saktuḥ saktusaindhavaḥ| evaṃ pānasaindhavaḥ|| 73. ake jīvikārthe| (6.2.73) `ake iti pratyayagrahaṇam‌| tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (nī.pa.vṛ.31) tadantasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`akapratyayānta uttarapade' iti| `jīvikāvācini' iti| jīvikā-jīvakaḥ tadvācinītyarthaḥ| jīvikāśabdo hyarśaāderākṛtigaṇatvānmatvarthīyākārāntaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ| ata eva vṛttau dantalekhanādibhiryeṣāṃ jīvikā ta evamucyanta ityāha--`dantalekhalaḥ' iti| likerṇvul‌, ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṣaṣṭhī punaḥ `kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti karmaṇi| `avaskaraśodhakaḥ' iti| `śudha śaucakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1191) [`śauce'--dhā.pā.] ityasmāṇṇyantāṇṇvul‌| `ramaṇīyakārakaḥ' ityatrāpi karoteḥ| `ramaṇīyakarttā' iti| pūrvavat‌ samāsaḥ| atra `gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) iti prakṛtibhāvenottarapadamantodāttam‌| `ikṣubhakṣikām‌' ityādi| `paryāyarhaṇotpattiṣu ṇvac‌' (3.3.111) iti bhakṣayaterṇvuc‌| atra `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) iti samāsalakṣaṇenaiva samāsaḥ| atrāpi pūrvavaduttarapadamantodāttam‌| kṛtsvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttaratrāpi yogāḥ| `yuktārohyādayaśca' (6.2.81) ityataḥ prāk‌ kṛtsvarāpavādo veditavyaḥ|| 74. prācāṃ krīḍāyām‌| (6.2.81) `prāgdeśavarttināṃ yā krīḍā' iti| etena prāggrahaṇamiha na vibhāṣārtham‌, kiñca kriyāviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| `uddālakpuṣpabhañjikā' ityādi| udyālakapuṣpādiṣu kṛdyoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| `jīvaputrapracāyikā' iti| atrāpi prapūrvācchinoteḥ saṃjñāyāṃ ṇvul‌| pūrvavat‌ samāsaḥ| litsvareṇottarapadaṃ madhyodāttam‌| `tava puṣpapracāyikā' iti| `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) ityanenaivātra samāsaḥ| citsvarereṇottarapadaṃ madyodāttam‌|| 75. aṇi niyukte| (6.2.75) `chattradhāraḥ' iti| `karmaṇyaṇ‌' (3.2.1)|.. kimarthaṃ punaridam‌, yāvatā yukto'bhimataḥ, tadvācī na bhavati? `niyukto'dhikṛtaḥ' ityādi| `yukte ca' (6.2.66) ityanena hi yaḥ kartavye yuktaḥ samāhitaḥ tasya pūrvapadasyādyudāttatvam‌, tenādhikṛtavācini na sidhyati| tasmādadhikṛtacchattrādiṣu yaḥ sahiniyukto'bhipretaḥ, sa ca kasmiṃścicchattradhāraṇe tatparo na bhavati tena cchatradhāra ityādisamāso yādṛśaḥ `yukte ca' (6.2.66) ityatra yukto'bhimatastadvācī na bhavati| `niyukto'dhikṛtaḥ' ityanena `yujir‌ yoge' (dhā.pā.1444) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ niyukta ityetadrūpamiti darśayati| `kāṇḍalāvaḥ' iti| atra kāṇḍalavanakriyāṃ prati kartṛtvamātraṃ gamyate, nādikṛtatvam‌| teneṣa svaro na bhavati|| 76. śilpini cākṛñaḥ| (6.2.76) aniyuktārtha vacanam‌| `akṛñaḥ' iti| śilpivaśeṣe pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyāmītyevamarthañca| `tantuvāyaḥ' iti| `veñ‌ tantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1006) iti| tantūn‌ vayatīti hvāvāmaśca' (3.2.2) ityaṇ‌, `āto yuk‌ ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk‌| `ayaskāraḥ' ti| `ataḥ kṛkami' (8.3.46) ityādinā visarjanīyasya sakāraḥ| pratyudāharaṇeṣu kṛtsvara eva bhavati|| 77. saṃjñāyāṃ ca| (6.2.77) 78. gotantiyavaṃ pāle| (6.2.78) `gopālaḥ' iti| `pā rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1056), pūrvavadaṇ‌| `aniyuktārtha ārambhaḥ' iti| niyukte `aṇi niyukte' (6.2.75) ityanenaiva siddhatvāt‌| `gorakṣaḥ' iti| `rakṣa pālane' (dhā.pā.658)|| 79.ṇiniḥ| (6.2.79) `pūṣpahārī' iti harateḥ `vrate' (3.2.80) `bahulamābhīkṣṇye' (3.2.81) iti vā ṇiniḥ|| 80. upamānaṃ śabdārthaprakṛtāveva| (6.2.80) `śabdārthaprakṛtau' iti| śabdārthaḥ prakṛtiryasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| `upamānaṃ niyamyate' ti| yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇaṃ bhavati| iha ca śabdārthaprakṛterevakāraḥ, tasmādupamānaniyamo bhavati, atastanniyamyate| `uṣṭrakośī' iti| `kruśa āhvāne' (dhā.pā.856) [āhvāne rodane ca--dhā.pā.] ityasmāt‌ `karttaryupamāne' (3.2.79) iti ṇiniḥ| ṇininaiva sādṛśyasyoktatvādvṛttāvivaśabdo na prayujyate| `dhvāṅkṣarāvī' iti| `ru śabde' (dhā.pā.1034) pūrvalakṣaṇāṇṇiniḥ| `kharanādī' iti| `ṇada avyakte śabde' (dhā.pā.54)| `upamānagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yadyupamānagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā pūrvasya yogasyāsya ca viṣayavibhāgo na jñāyeta| yadi yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyādviṣayāntaramya kalpyeta, tathāpīṣṭo viṣayavibhāgo na jñāyeta| upamānagrahaṇe tu sati pūrvasya sāmānyaṃ viṣayaḥ, asya tu viśeṣa upamānamiti viṣayavibhāgo niścīyeta| tena viṣayavibhāgārthamupamānagrahaṇam‌| `vṛkavañcī' iti| `vañcu pralambhane' (dhā.pā.1703)| `vṛkaprekṣī' iti| `īkṣa darśane' (dhā.pā.610) prapūrvaḥ| atra kṛtsvara eva bhavati| `prakṛtireva' ityādi| yadi prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā śabdārthāt‌ paro yo ṇinistadanta uttarapada ityevaṃ vijñāyeta? tataśca gardabhoccārī kokilābhivyāhārītyasyāpi syāt‌; bhavati hyatrāpi dhātūpasargasamudāyācchabdārthāt‌ paro ṇiniḥ, atastadantamutatarapadam‌| tasmādiha mā bhūditi prakṛtigrahaṇaṃ kriyate, teneha na bhavati| prakṛtigrahaṇe sati yatropasarganirapekṣā gatyarthatvāt‌, harateśca haraṇārthatvāt‌| yadvā--yo'tra śabdārtho dhātūpasargasamudāyaḥ, na tasmāṇṇinervidhānam‌| yadi pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam‌, evaṃ siddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo niyamāya bhavatītyanarthakamevakārakaraṇam‌? ityāha--`evakārakaraṇam‌' ityādi| asati hyevakāra upamāna eva śabdārthaprakṛtāvityevamavadhāraṇaṃ syāt‌, tataśca śabdārthaprakṛtireva niyamyeta--śabdārthaprakṛtau yadi bhavatyupamāna eva bhavati, nānupamāna iti| tataścānupamāne na syāt‌| tasmādupamānāvadhāraṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthamevakāraḥ kriyate| kiṃ kāraṇam‌? ityāha--`śabdārthaprakṛtau tu' ityādi| tuśabdo hetau| tasmāt‌ śabdārthaprakṛtāvupamānamanupamānaṃ cādyudāttaṃ bhavati| tasmādupamānāvadhāraṇārthamevakārakaraṇam‌| upamānaniyame hi sati śabdārthaprakṛteraniyatatvāt‌ tatrāviśeṣeṇa sarvasyādyudāttatvaṃ labhyate| `siṃhavinardī' iti| upamānasyodāhaṇam‌| `puṣkalajalpī' iti| anupamānasya| puṣkalajalpītyatra `vratte' (3.2.80) `bahulamābhīkṣṇye' (3.2.81) iti vā ṇiniḥ|| 81. yuktārohyādayaśca| (6.2.81) `yuktārohi' ityādiṣu yatra kṛdantamuttarapadaṃ tatra kṛtsvarāpavādo yogaḥ| anyeṣu tu samāsasvarāpavādaḥ| yuktārohītyevamādiṣu āgataprahārītyevamyaryanteṣu `ruha janmani' (dhā.pā.859), [ruha bājajanmani prādurbhāve ca--dhā.pā.] `yudha samprahāre (dhā.pā.1173), `vañcu pralambhane' (dhā.pā.1703), `ṭuṇadi samṛddhau' (dhā.pā.67) [ṭu nadi samṛddhau--dhā.pā.] `hṛñ‌ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899) prapūrvaḥ--ityebhyo dhātubhyo yathāyogaṃ yuktāgatapūrvabhyaḥ `supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye' (3.2.78) iti ṇiniḥ| yadyete ṇinyantāstat‌ kimarthamiha paṭhyante yāvatā `ṇini' (6.2.79) ityanenaiva siddham‌? ityata āha--`ṇinītyasyaivodāharaṇārthaṃ paṭhyante' iti| `pūrvottarapada' ityādinā keṣāṃcinmatena teṣāmiha pāṭhasya prayojanāntaraṃ darśayati| pūrvottarapadayoniryamo'rtho yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| yatra yuktādīnyeva pūrvapadānyārohyādīnyeva cottarapadāni tatraiva yathā syāditi, iha mā bhūt‌--dhvāṅkṣārohī, vṛkṣārohīti, atrānyatpūrvapadam‌| yuktādhyāyītyatrānyaduttarapadam‌| `iṅ‌ adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1046) ityasmāṇṇiniḥ| `āgatamatasyā' iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `kṣīrahotā' iti| kṣīrasya hotā| asmādeva nipātanāt‌ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| yājakāditvādvā (2.2.9) `hu' ityetasmāt‌ tṛc‌| `bhaginībhartā' iti| ayamapi pūrvavat‌ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| bhṛñastṛc‌| `grāmagodhuk‌' iti| duheḥ kvip‌, `dāderdhātorghaḥ' (8.2.32)| `ekāco baśo bhaṣ‌' (8.2.37) ityādinā dakārasya dhakāraḥ, `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti ghakārasya gakāraḥ, tasya `vā'vasāne' (8.4.56) iti cartvam‌--kakāraḥ| `trirātraḥ' iti| tisro rātrasyaḥ samāhṛtāḥ iti samāhāre dviguḥ| `ahaḥsarvaikadeśa' (5.4.87) ityādinā'c‌ samāsāntaḥ| `ekaśitipāt‌' iti| `pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ' (5.4.138) ityakāralopaḥ| nanu caikaśabdo'yam‌ `iṣbhīkāpāśalpatimarcibhyaḥ kan‌' (da.u.3.21) iti kanpratyayānto nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| tatraikaḥ śitiḥ pādo'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ| tatra kṛte prakṛtibhāvenaiva siddhamihādyudāttatvam‌, tato nārtha ihāsya pāṭhena? ityata āha--`ekaḥ śitiḥ pādo'sya' iti| dvipade bahuvrīhāveṣa doṣaḥ syāt‌, na cāyaṃ dvipadaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tripadaḥ| atra pādaśabda uttarapade parataḥ `taddhitārthottarapada' (2.1.51) iti pūrvapadayorekaśitiśabdasyāntodāttatvaṃ prāptamiti `samāsasya' (6.1.223) ityanena| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt‌ tasyāntodāttatvaṃ prāptaṃ tasmāt‌ tasyādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| tato nāpārthaka ekaśitipācchabdasya pāṭha ityabhiprāyaḥ| kasmāt‌ punastasyāntodāttatvaṃ prāpnoti, bahuvrīhisvareṇaiva hi paratvādantodāttatvaṃ bādhitvā yuktaṃ bhavitum‌? ityāha--`nimittasvarabalīyastvāt‌' iti| nimittapadaṃ dvigostripadabahuvrīhiḥ| tatra hi kṛte dviguttarapade parataḥ pūrvapadayorbhavati| yacca yasmin‌ sati bhavati tat‌ tasya nimittam‌, tasya nimittasya bahuvrīhisvaro nimittasvaraḥ, tasmādbalīyastvaṃ nimittasvarabalīyastvam‌| `pañcamī' (2.1.37) iti yogavibhāgāta samāsaḥ| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--tasmādbahuvrīhisvarāt‌ samāsāntodattatvamasya balīyastvam‌, tasmāt‌ tat‌ prāpnotīti| balīyastvaṃ tu tasya satiśiṣṭatvāt‌| taddhi bahuvrīhorādyudāttatve sati bhavati| tasmāt‌ satiśiṣṭasya balīyastvamuktam‌| vakṣyamāmajñāpakādvā nimittasvarabalīyastvam‌| `evamapi' ityādi| evamapi tripade bahuvrīhau kalpyamāne'pi| `nārtha etena' iti| ekaśitipācchabdeneha bhavati nārthaḥ| kasmāt‌? ityāha--`iganta' ityādi| tripade hi bahuvrīhāvekaśitiśabdayoruttarapade yaḥ samāsaḥ `saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ' (2.1.52) iti dvigusaṃjñaḥ sa igantaśca bhavati| tataśca `iganta--dvigau' (6.2.29) ityādyudāttatvaṃ siddham‌, tato nārtha etena| `evaṃ tarhītyādinaikaśitipācchabdapāṭhasya jñāpakatvaṃ darśayati| kiṃ punastajjñāpayati? ityāha--`etat‌' ityādi| `tena' ityādinā prayojanaṃ darśayati| yadyeṣo'rtho na jñāpyate, tena dvau śiti pādāvasyeti tripade bahuvrīhau kṛte, tatra cottarapade parataḥ pūrvapadayordvigau sati `iganta--dvigau' (6.2.29) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtasvare kṛte tiśabdo dviśitipādityatrodāttaḥ syāt‌| asmistvarye jñāpite `iganta--dvigau' (6.2.29) ityeṣa svaro na bhavati| tasmiṃścāsati samāsasvareṇa tiśabda udātto bhavati, nimittasvarabalīyastvaṃ na syāt‌| tatakca tripade hi bahuvrīhau paratvāt‌ samāsasvaraṃ bādhitvā bahuvrīhisvara eva bhavati, tatastenaiva siddhatvādekaśitipācchabdasyeha pāṭho na kriyeta, kṛtaśca| tasmāt‌ sa eva jñāpayati--nimittasvarabalīyastvamiti|| 82. dīrghakāśatuṣabhrāṣṭravaṭaṃ je| (6.2.82) kṛtsvarāpavādo yogaḥ| `kṛṭījaḥ' iti| kuṭyāṃ jāta iti `saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ (3.2.97) iti ḍapratyayaḥ|| 83. antyātpūṃrva bahvacaḥ| (6.2.83) ayamapi kṛtsvarapabādo yogaḥ| `dagdhajāni' iti| atra kṛtsvara eva bhavati|| 84. grāme'nivasantaḥ| (6.2.84) `nivasantaśabdo'yamauṇādiko gṛhyate| `jṛviśibhyāṃ jhac‌' (da.u.6.17) iti vartamāne `tṝbhūvahivasibhāsisādhigatimaṇḍijinandibhyaśca' (da.u.6.19) [tṝbhṛvahivasibhāsisādhigāḍimaṇḍijivandibhyaśca--da.u.] iti vasernipūrvājjhac‌| nivasatīti nivasantaḥ| kecicchannantasya vasacchabdasaya grahaṇaṃ varṇayanti| `mallagrāmaḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `devagrāmaḥ' iti| vāṭakaparikṣipte gṛhasamudāye grāmaśabdo vartate| tasmāddevasvāmika ityarthaḥ| etena svasvāmibhāvasambandhā yā sā'tra ṣaṣṭhī samasyate, na tu kriyāvāsasambandheti darśayati; anyathā devaśabdaḥ pūrvapada nivasantavācyeva syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `dākṣyādayo nivasanti yasmin‌' ityādinā pratyudāharaṇe pūrvapadasya nivasantavācitvaṃ darśayati|| 85. ghoṣādiṣu ca| (6.2.85) samāsasavarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi| `na bhūtādhikasañjīva' (6.2.91) ityādeḥ sūtrādye yogāsta samāsasvarāpavādā draṣṭavyāḥ| `dākṣīghoṣaḥ'ityevamādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| `yānayatra' ityādi| kathaṃ punaretalalabhyate, yāvatā'nivasanta iti prakṛtam‌? ityata āha--`anivasantaḥ' iti| `apare' ityādi| teṣāṃ matena yānyatra nivāsanāmadheyāni teṣu nivasadvācīnyapyudāttā bhavanti|| 86. chāttryādayaḥ śālāyām‌| (6.2.86) `yadā śālāntaḥ' ityādi| `vibhāṣā senāsurā' (2.4.25) ityādinā śālāntasya tatpuruṣasya vibhāṣā napuṃsakatvamuktam‌? iha ca śālāśabdasya strīliṅgasya grahaṇam‌| tatra yathā samāso napuṃsakaliṅgo na bhavati tathā `tatpuruṣe śālāyāṃ napuṃsake' (6.2.123) ityanena paratvāduttarapadādyudāttatvena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌| atastannirāsāya `yadā śālāntaḥ' ityādergranthasyopanyāsaḥ| yo napuṃsakaliṅgaḥ śālāntatatpuruṣo na bhavati so'syāvakāśaḥ--chāttriśālā, ailiśāleti| yastu napuṃsakaliṅgo na chāttrādipūrvapadastatpuruṣaḥ sa `śālāyāṃ napuṃsake' (6.2.123) ityasyāvakāśaḥ--brāhmaṇaśālam‌, kṣattriyaśālamiti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--chāttriśālamiti, pūrvavipratiṣedhenāyameva svaro bhavati|| 87. prasthe'vṛddhamakarkyādīnām‌| (6.2.87) prasthaśabdo yadi vyutpādyate `ghañarthe kavidhānaṃ sthāsnapāvyadhihaniyudhyartham‌' (vā.306) iti, tadā thāthādisvare (6.2.144) prāpte| atha na vyutpādyate, tadā samāsāntodāttatve| `indraprasthaḥ' ityādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ|| 88. mālādīnāṃ ca| (6.2.88) 89. amahannavaṃ nagare'nudīcām‌| (6.2.89) `suhyanagaram‌' ityādayo'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsā eva| kimarthaṃ prācāmityevaṃ nocyate, [nocyeta--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ladhu hi prācāmiti vacanamanudīcāmiti vacanāt‌? naivaṃ śakyam‌; madhyadeśanagare virāṭanagaramityatra na syāt‌| pūrvapadādyudāttatve prāpte pratiṣedho'mucyate, na samāsa eva bhavati|| 90. arme cāvarṇaṃ dvyactryac‌| (6.2.90) 91. na bhūtādhikasañjīvamadrāśmakajjalam‌| (6.2.91) `madrāśmagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| ubhayatrāpi dvyac‌ tryajiti ca prāptirasti| tasmāt‌ saṅghātārthaṃ vigṛhītārthañca vacanam‌| kathaṃ punaḥ saṃghātavigṛhītārthatvaṃ labhyate? ekāśeṣaṃ kṛtvā madrāśma iti nirdeśāt‌| madrāśmā ca madrāśmānau cetyekaśeṣaḥ| ekaśeṣe sati madraśabdasya kevalasya, madraśabdasya ca saṅghātasya pratiṣedha upapadyate| ādyudāttasya prakaraṇamityādyudāttaprakaraṇam‌, prakāntam‌| tatra divodāsā dīnāṃ chandasyādyudātto bhavatītyeta dartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānāṃ tu--`yukte ca' (6.2.66) ityevamādau ye'smin‌ prakaraṇe cakārāḥ, teṣāmanyatamasyānuktasamuccayārthatāmāśritya karttavyam‌|| 92. antaḥ| (6.2.92) 93. saṃrva guṇakārtsnye| (6.2.93) `guṇakārtsnye' iti| guṇakārtsnya guṇasya sarvatrābhāvaḥ| `sarvaśvetaḥ' iti| `pūrvakālaika' (2.1.49) ityādinā samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ| atra samudāyaguṇasya sarvatra bhāvaḥ| na tu tadavayave tatra sarvaśabdo vartata iti guṇakārtsnyasya vṛttirbhavati| `paramaśvetaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punaratra guṇakārtsnye paramaśabdo vartate, yāvatāsau prakarṣavācī, anyaśca prakarṣaḥ, anyacca guṇakārtsnyam‌? ityata āha--`āśrayavyāptyā' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādāśrayavyāptyā paramatvamutkarṣe bhavati, nānyathā| evaṃ hi tasyotkarṣa upapadyate yadi sarvamāśrayaṃ vyāpnoti| tasmādguṇakārtsnyaṃ iha paramaśabdo vartate| `sarvasauvarṇaḥ, sarvarājataḥ' iti| suvarṇasya vikāraḥ sauvarṇaḥ, rajatasya vikāro rājataḥ--nātra guṇakārtsnyam‌, kiṃ tarhi? jātiyuktasya vikāravaṣayaṃ kārtsnyam‌| sarva hi vikāradravyaṃ prakṛtibhāvena vyāpnotīti dravyakārtsnyamiha, tatra ca sarvaśabdo vartate| `sarveṣāṃ śvetataraḥ sarvaśvetaḥ' iti| atra guṇakārtsnye| kathaṃ punaratra samāsaḥ, yāvatā `pūraṇagaṇasuhita' (2.2.11) ityādinā guṇavacanena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ? athāpi kathañcit‌ samāsaḥ syāt‌, evamapi śvetataraśabdena samāse kṛte sarvaśvetataramiti vaktavyam‌? ityata āha--`guṇāt‌ tareṇa samāsaḥ' ityādi| aupasaṃkhyānikāviha samāsataralopāviti darśayati| samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi yogāḥ| `na hāstinaphalakamārdeyāḥ' (6.2.101) ityataḥ prāk‌ samāsasvarāpavādo veditavyaḥ|| 94. saṃjñāyāṃ girinikāyayoḥ| (6.2.94) `añjanāgiriḥ' ityevamādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| añjanabhañjanaśabdayoḥ `vanagiryoḥ saṃjñāyām‌' (6.3.117) iti dīrghatvam‌| `śāpiṇḍimauṇḍiśabdau' iñantau| `cikhilliśabdaḥ' matvarthīyenipratyayāntaḥ|| 95. kumāryāṃ vayasi| (6.2.95) `vṛddhakumārī' iti| `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' (2.1.57) iti samāsaḥ| `jaratkumārī' iti| jaratī cāsau kumārī ceti `pūrvakāla' (2.1.49) ityādinā samāsaḥ| ubhayatra `puṃvat‌ karmadhāraya' (6.3.42) ityādinā puṃvadbhāvaḥ| nanu ca kumārīśabdaḥ prathame vayasi vartate, tathā hi `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti ṅībatra vihitaḥ, vṛddhājaratīśabdau carame vayasi vartate, tatkathamiha sāmānādhikaraṇyam‌? ityata āha--`kumārīśabdaḥ puṃsā sahāsamprayogamātraṃ pravṛttinimittamupādāya prayuktaḥ' iti| asamprayogaḥ-asambandhaḥ| tanmātrapravṛttinivṛttisamudāyāvayavaḥ sāmānye pravṛttaḥ| kumārīśabdo yathā vṛddhādibhiḥ vayoviśeṣavacanairviśeṣyate tadā taiḥ samānādhikaraṇo bhavati| vayoviśeṣo'ntyaṃ vayaḥ| kathaṃ punarviśeṣavacanaṃ sāmānye vartate? vayograhaṇasāmarthyāt‌| yadi vṛddhakumārīśabdaḥ prathame vayasi vartate vayograhaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| yatara kumārīśabdaḥ prayujyate prathamavayovācī, tatra niyogato vayo gamyata eveti kiṃ vayograhaṇena! tasmādvayograhaṇasāmarthyāt‌ yathoktena prakāreṇa vayaḥsāmānye pravartate| vayograhaṇena hi tasmādviśeṣādapanīyāsau sāmānyavṛttirāśrīyate| `tacca vaya iha gṛhyate' iti| yatra varttamāno viśeṣavacanaiḥ saha samānādhikaraṇo bhavati, tacca vayo gṛhyate| caśabdādanyacca yauvanādīnakumāratvameveti, na prathamavaya ityarthaḥ| `paramakumārī' iti| atra samāsāt‌ pūjyamānatā; pūjyamānatvaṃ tu darśanīyatvāt‌| darśanīyā kanyetyarthaḥ| na hyatra samāso vayo'bhidhānaparaḥ| nāpayuttarapadaṃ vayaḥsāmānye vartate|| 96. udake'kevale| (6.2.96) `miśram‌' iti| dravyāntarasampṛktamityarthaḥ| `guḍamiśram‌' iti| śākapārthivāditvā(vā.83)duttarapadalopisamāsaḥ| `śītodakam‌' iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| pūrvapadamatra guṇopasarjanamudakaṃ brūte| uttarapadamapi jātyupasarjanam‌| tathaiva tenaikameva vastu jātiguṇābyāmucyata iti kevalodakavācisamāsaḥ|| 97. dvigau kratau| (6.2.97) `gargatrirātrādayaḥ' ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| tisṛṇāṃ rātrīṇāṃ samāhārastriratraḥ| `ahaḥsarvekadeśa (5.4.87) ityādināc‌ samāsāntaḥ| `atirātraḥ' iti| rātrimatikrānta iti prādisamāsaḥ|| 98. sabhāyāṃ napuṃsake| (6.2.98) `gopālasabham‌' ityevamādayo'pi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ, `sabhārājā'manuṣyapūrvā' (2.4.23) iti napuṃsakatvam‌| `rājasabhā, brāhmaṇasabhā' ityatra `amanuṣyapūrvā' iti pratiṣedhānnapuṃsakatā na bhavati| atheha kasmānna bhavati--ramaṇīyā sabhā'sya brāhmaṇakulasya ramaṇīyasabham‌? ityata āha--`pratipadoktam‌' ityādi| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) yat‌ pratipadoktaṃ napuṃsakaṃ tadiha gṛhyate| na ceha tathāvidhaṃ napuṃsakatvam‌| atra tu `abhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti' (vyā.pa.73) iti brāhmaṇakulasyābhidheyasaya napuṃsakatvāt‌| na tat‌ pratipadoktam‌|| 99. pure prācām‌| (6.2.99) `lalāṭapuram‌' ityevamādayaḥ ṣaṣṭīsamāsāḥ|| 100. ariṣṭagauḍapūrve ca| (6.2.100) `ariṣṭapuram‌ gauḍapuram‌' iti| etāvapi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāveva| `pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kim‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--ariṣṭagauḍayoriti vaktavyam‌, evamapyucyamāne'riṣṭagoḍayoḥ puraśabda uttarapade'ntodāttatavaṃ sidhyatyeveti| `ihāpi yathā syāt‌' iti| yadi pūrvagrahaṇaṃ na kriyet‌ tadāriṣṭaṃ śritastasya puramariṣṭaśritapuramiti| gauḍānāṃ bhṛtyā gauḍaśabdau| pūrvagrahaṇe tu sati bahuvrīhirlabhyate--ariṣṭagauḍau pūrvau yasmin‌ samāse so'riṣṭagauḍapūrva iti| tenāriṣṭaśritapuram‌, gauḍabhṛtyapuramityatrāpi yaduttarapadaṃ tasyāpyantodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva| atrāpi hyariṣṭaśabdo gauḍaśabdaśca pūrvaḥ| pūrvaścāyamavayavavacanaḥ|| 101. na hāstinaphalakamārdeyāḥ| (6.2.101) 102. kusūlakūpakumbhaśālaṃ bile| (6.2.102) `kusūlabilam‌' ityevamādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi `bahuvrīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām‌' (6.2.106) ityataḥ prāgyogāḥ samāsasvarāpavādāḥ veditavyāḥ|| 103. dikśabdā grāmajanapadākhyānacānarāṭeṣu| (6.2.103) `pūrveṣukāmaśamī' iti| `diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām‌' (2.1.50) iti samāsaḥ| evaṃ `apareṣukāmaśamī' ityatrāpi| `pūrvakṛṣṇamṛttikā' iti| pūrvā cāsau kṛṣmamṛttikā ceti `pūrvāpara' (2.1.58) ityādinā samāsaḥ| evaṃ `aparakṛṣṇamṛttikā' ityevamādāvapi| adhirāmamadhikṛtya kṛto grantha ādhirāmam‌| `adhikṛtya kṛte granthe' (4.3.87) ityaṇ‌| atha yatā--cānarāṭe rūpagrahaṇaṃ tathā grāmādiṣvapi kasmānna bhavati? arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ bhavatītyuktam‌| iha cānarāṭa eva śabdapradhāno nirdeśa, grāmādiṣvarthapradhāna eva| atha śabdagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na digityevocyate? ityata āha--`śabdagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| asati hi śabdagrahaṇe pūrvādhirāmam‌, pūrvayāyātamityatra na syāt‌| kasmāt‌?iha kālavācī pūrvaśabdaḥ| digvāciśabdagrahaṇe sati dikśabdamātragrahaṇaṃ bhavati| tasmāt‌ kālavācino'pi dikśabdasya parigraho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ śabdagrahaṇam‌|| 104. ācāryopasarajanaścāntevāsini| (6.2.104) `ācāryopasarjanaśca' iti| supāṃ surbhavatīti saptamyekavacanasya sthāne prathamaikavacanam‌, etaccāntevāsiviśeṣaṇam‌| `ācāryopasarjanāntevācinyuttarapade' iti| ācārya upasarjanam‌-apradhānaṃ yasya antevāsinaḥ sa tathoktaḥ| ācāryopasarjanaścāntevāsī cācāryopasarjanāntevāsī, taṃ vaktuṃ śīlaṃ yasayottarapadasya tadācāryopasarjanāntevāsivāci| `pūrvapāṇinīyāḥ' iti| `pūrvāpara' (2.1.58) ityādinā samāsaḥ pāṇinerācāryasyāntevāsinaḥ pāṇinīyāḥ, atrāntevāsinaḥ prādhānyenocyante pratyayāntena; ācāryastu tadviśeṣaṇatvādupasarjanabhāvenetyācaryopasarjanāntevāsivācyuttarapadaṃ bhavati| `pūrvakāśakṛtsnāḥ' iti| kāśakṛtsnasyeme kāśakṛtsnāḥ, autsargiko'ṇ‌| `pūrvapāṇinīyaṃ śāstram‌' iti| pāṇinā proktaṃ pāṇinīyam‌, atrācāryopasarjanaśāstravācyuttarapadam‌, na tvācāryopasarjanāntevāsivāci|| 105. uttarapadavṛddhau sarvaṃ ca| (6.2.105) `uttarapadavṛddhau' iti| uttarapadādhikāravihitā vṛddhiruttarapadavṛddhiḥ, iha tu tadvaduttarapadaṃ gṛhyate| tamevārthaṃ darśayitumāha--`uttarapadasyotyevam‌' ityādi| kathaṃ punaruttarapadavṛdadhāvityucyamāna eṣo'rthaḥ śakyate vijñātum‌? taducyate; uttarapadaṃ svaryate, svaritenādhikāro lakṣyate, tenottarapadasyetyadhikṛtya yā vihitā vṛddhistāsyāstāvadgrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| pūrvapadasyedamantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| pūrvapadaṃ ca sambandhiśabdatvāduttarapadamupasthāpayati| na ca vṛddhimātra uttarapadamupapadyata iti sāmarthyādvṛddhiśabdasāhacaryāduttarapadaṃ vṛddhimupalakṣayati| tenottarapadādhikāre vṛddhimatyuttarapada eṣa svaro bhavatīti vijñāyate| `sarvapāñcālakaḥ' iti| `pūrvakālaika' (2.1.49) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `pūrvapāñcālakaḥ' ityādau `pūrvāpara' (2.1.58) ityādinā| `janapadalakṣaṇo vṛñpratyayaḥ' iti| `dhanvayopadhādvuñ‌' (4.2.121) ityanuvarttamāne `janapadatadavadhyośca' (4.2.124) ityato janapadagrahaṇe ca `avṛddhādapi bahuvacanaviṣayāt‌' (4.2.125) ityanena vañ‌| `susarvārddhāt‌' ityādi| `sarvapāñcālakaḥ' iti| `susarvardhājjanapadasya' (7.3.12) ityuttarapadavṛddhiḥ| `pūrvapāñcālakaḥ' ityādau tu `diśo'madrāṇām‌' (7.3.13) iti| eṣā cottarapadādhikāravihitā, tatra cottarapadasyetyanuvṛtteḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamuttarapadādhikāra uttarapadagrahaṇena lakṣyata ityevaṃ vijñāyate? ityāha--`adhikāra lakṣaṇāt‌' ityādi| yadyuttarapadagrahaṇenottarapadādhikāro lakṣyeta, tadā vṛddhimātravatyuttarapade vaitadvuño hyu vāttatvaṃ bhavatītyuktaṃ syāt‌| tathā ca sarvabhāsaḥ, sarvakāraka ityatrāpi syāt‌| adhikāralakṣaṇe tu na bhavati, na hyudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyuktaṃ syāt‌| tathā ca sarvabhāsaḥ, sarvakāraka ityatrāpi syāt‌| adhikāralakṣaṇe tu na bhavati, na hyuttarapadādhikāravihitā vṛddhiḥ| `bhāsṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.624) bhāsata iti bhāsaḥ, pacādyac‌| karotīti kārakaḥ, ṇvul‌, `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddhiḥ, sā cottarapadādhikāravihitā na bhavati|| 106. bahuvrīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām‌| (6.2.106) `pūrvapadakṛtisvaratvenādyudāttatvaṃ prāptam‌' iti| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1)| ityādinā viśve ca te devā viśvavevā iti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ, tatpuruṣo'yam‌| atra samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| `viśvadevaḥ' iti| atra pūrvapadaprakṛtisparatvenādyadāttatvameva bhavati| viśvaśabdasaya kvanpratayayantasya nitsvareṇādyudāttatvam‌| `viśvāmitraḥ' iti| `bahuvarīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām‌' (6.2.106) iti pūrvapadāntodāttasyāvakāśaḥ--viśvadevaḥ, viśvayaśā iti| `saṃjñāyāṃ mittrājinayoḥ' (6.2.165) ityuttarapadāntodāttatvasyāvakāśaḥ--kulamittram‌, kulājinamiti; viśvāmittraḥ, viśvājina ityatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti, `saṃjñāyāṃ mitrājinayo' (6.2.165) ityetattu bhavati vipratiṣedhena|| 107. udarāśveṣuṣu| (6.2.107) vṛkasyevodaramasya `vṛkodaraḥ'| dāma udare yasyeti `dāmodaraḥ'| hariraśvo yasyeti `haryaśvaḥ'| yauvanameva aśvo yasya sa `yauvanāśvaḥ'| śobhano varṇo yeṣāṃ te suvarṇāḥ puṅkhāṃ yeṣāmiṣūṇāṃ te suvarṇapuṅkhāḥ, suvarṇapuṅkhā iṣavo yasya saḥ `suvarṇapuṅkheṣuḥ| mahānta iṣavo yasya sa `maheṣuḥ'| `ānmahataḥ' (6.3.46) ityāttvam‌| atra pūrvapadānām‌ `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ| yatara svare prāpte'yaṃ vidhirārabdhaḥ sa ākhyāyate| `kṛdādhārārcikalibhyaḥ kaḥ' (paṃ.u.3.40) ityataḥ `kaḥ' ityānuvartamāne `ajivṛrībhyo nicca' (paṃ.u.3.38) ityato nidgrahaṇe `sṛvṛbhūśuṣimuṣibhyaḥ kak‌' (paṃ.u.3.41) iti kakaparatyayānto vṛkaśabdo vyutpādyate, tenāyamādyudāttaḥ| evaṃ dāmanśabdo'pi; maninpratyayāntatvāt‌| hṛñityetasmāt‌ `sarvadhātubhya in‌' (paṃu.4.117) iti hariśabda ādyudāttaḥ|| 108. kṣepe| (6.2.108) `kuṇḍodaraḥ' iti| `śakiśamyornit‌' (paṃ.u.1.111) iti vartamāne `kvādibhya kit‌ (paṃ.u.1.114) ityataḥ kidgrahaṇe ca `kuḍi dāhe' (dhā.pā.270) ityetasmāt‌ `amantāḍḍaḥ' (paṃ.u.113) iti ḍapratyaye kuṇḍamādyudattam‌| `ghaṭodaraḥ' iti| ghaṭaśabdo'yam‌ `ghaṭa ceṣṭāyām‌' (dhā.pā.763) ityasya pacādyaci vyutpāditatvādantodāttaḥ| tasmāt‌ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇaiva siddhe sati tvasyānyārtha ārambhe'pavādatvāt‌ pacādyajantādanenaivāntodāttatvaṃ yuktamiti manyamāno vṛttikāra etadapyudāharati| `kaṭukāśvaḥ' iti| kaṭuko'svo yasya sa kaṭukāśvaḥ| kaṭuśabdāt‌ `saṃjñāyāṃ kan‌' (5.3.87) iti kan‌ te na kaṭukaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| spāndito'śvo'sya `spanditāśvaḥ'| `spadi kiñciccalane' (dhā.pā.14) ityasmāt‌ ktaḥ| tena syanditaśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| anighāta iṣurasyeti `anighāteṣuḥ'| nihanyate'neneti nighātaḥ, `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti ghañ‌, na nighāto'nighātaḥ `tatpureṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā'vyayaprakṛtibhāvādanighātaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| calācala iṣurasya `calācaleṣuḥ'| `cala kampane' (dhā.pā.832) tasya pacādyaci `caricalipativadīnāṃ vā dvitvamacyākcābhyāsasya' (vā.658) iti dvirvacanam‌, abhyāsasyāgāgamaśca| etena calācalaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `anudaraḥ' ityādi| `udarāśveṣuṣu' (6.2.107) `kṣeṣe' (6.2.108) ityasyāvakaśaḥ--kuṇḍīdaraḥ, ghaṭodara iti, `nañsubhyām‌' (6.2.172) ityuttarapadāntodāttasyāvakāśaḥ--ayavaḥ, suyava iti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--anudaraḥ sūdara iti| `nañsubhyām‌' (6.2.172) ityetadbhavati vipratiṣedhena|| 109. nadī bandhuni| (6.2.109) `bandhuni' iti| śabdarūpāpekṣayā napuṃsakaliṅganirdeśaḥ, anyathā bandhuśabdasya puṃlliṅgatvāt‌ `bandhau' iti nirdeśaṃ kuryāt‌| `gārgībandhuḥ, vātsībandhuḥ' iti| gargavatsaśabdābhyāṃ gargāditvāt‌ (4.1.105) yañ‌ tadantāt‌ `yañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīp‌| gārgīvātsīśabdau ñitsvareṇādyudāttau| `brahmabandhuḥ' iti| atra prakṛtibhāva eva bhavati pūrvapadasya| brahmaśabdaścāyaṃ `manin‌' (da.u.6.73) ityanuvarttamāne `bṛherno'cca' (da.u.6.74) iti bhaninpratyayānto vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| `gārgīpriyaḥ' iti| gārgīśabdo'pi prakṛtibhāvenādyudātta eva bhavati|| 110. niṣṭhopasargapūrvamanyatarasyām‌| (6.2.110) `prakṣālitapādaḥ' iti| `kṣala śaucakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1597) asmāṇṇayantāt‌ ktaḥ| pakṣālitaśabdaḥ `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) ityādyudāttaḥ| `pradhautamukham‌' iti| `dhāvu gatiśuddhyoḥ' (dhā.pā.601) asmāt‌ ktaḥ| `cchvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityūṭh‌, `etyedhatyūṭh‌su' (6.1.89) iti vṛddhiḥ| `yadi mukhaśabdaḥ' ityādi| mukhaśabdo'yaṃ svāṅgavācyapi| tatra yadyayamiha svāṅgavācī tadānena pūrvapadāntodāttatvameva| mukte pakṣe `mukhaṃ svāṅgam‌' (6.2.167) ityuttarapadādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| atra niṣṭhopasargapūrvamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtteryadā'ntodāntatvaṃ bhavati tadā `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) ityetat‌| tena svāṅgavācini mukhaśabde trayaḥ svarā bhavanti| anena pūrvapadāntodāttatvam‌, `mukhaṃ svāhgam‌' (6.2.167) ityanenottarapadantodāttatvam‌, `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti prakṛtibhāvāt‌ pūrvapadasyādyudāttatvam‌| `na cet‌' ityādi| yadi mukhaśabdo'tra svāṅgāvacī na bhavati tadā `mukhaṃ svāṅgam‌' (6.2.167) ityasyāyaṃ viṣayo na bhavatauti `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti vidhinā mukte pravartate| tena svāṅgavācini mukhaśabde dvau svarau bhavataḥ--pūrvapadasyādyudāttatvam‌, antodāttatvañca| `prasecakamukham‌' [prasecakamukhaḥ--kāśikā] iti| atra pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| prasicyata iti prasecakaḥ `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam‌' (3.3.113) iti karmaṇi ṇvul‌, `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ, `tatpuruṣe tulyārthe' (6.2.2) ityādinā'vyayaprakṛtibhāvaḥ| tena prasecakaśabda ādyudātta iti| `śuṣkamukhaḥ' iti| `śuṣaḥ kaḥ' (8.2.51) iti niṣṭhāyāṃ kādeśaḥ| pratyayasvareṇa śuṣkaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| bahuvrībau prakṛtibhāvena nityamevāntodātto bhavati|| 111. uttarapadādiḥ| (6.2.111) 112. karṇau varṇalakṣaṇāt‌| (6.2.112) varṇam‌-śukalādi, lakṣyate'neneti lakṣaṇam‌-cihnam‌, varṇañca lakṣaṇañca varṇalakṣaṇam| dvandva ekavadbhāvaḥ| arthagrahaṇaṃ ceha varṇalakṣaṇayoḥ; arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya| `śvetakarṇaḥ kṛṣṇakarṇaḥ' iti| śvetakṛṣṇaśabdāvantodāttau| tathā hi--`śitā varṇe' (dhā.pā.742) ityasmāt‌ pacādyaci śvetaśabdo vyutpādyate| kṛṣmaśabdo'pi `iṇsiñcidīṅyuṣyavibhyo nak‌' (da.u.5.35) [iṇsiñdīṅuṣvavibhyo nak‌--da.u.] ityanuvartamāne `kṛṣervarṇe' (da.u.5.37) iti nakpratyaye| `dātrākarṇaḥ' iti| `dhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran‌' (3.2.181) iti vartamāne `dāmnīśas‌' (3.2.182) ityādinā ṣṭranpratyayaḥ, tena dātraśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `śaṅkūkarṇaḥ iti| `kṛgrorucca' (da.u.1.109) [kṛgrorucca--da.u.] ityanuvartamāne `kharuśaṅkupīyunīlaṅguligu (da.u.1.120) iti kupratyayāntaḥ śaṅkuśabdo'ntodātto nipātyate| `dhāpṛvasyajyatibhyo naḥ' (da.u.5.39) ityadhikṛtya `kṝvṝcchasidrūpanyanisvapibhyo nit‌' (da.u.5.42) [kṝvṝjṝsidrupanyanisvapibhyo nit‌--da.u] iti karṇaśabdo vyutpādyate, bhinnacchinnadrasruvasvastikasya' (6.3.115) iti sūtramupalakṣayati| `śvetapādaḥ' ityādi| pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara eva bhavati| atheha kasmānna bhavati--sthūlakarṇa iti, sthūlenāpi hi karṇena lakṣyata eva tataśca lakṣaṇādityeva siddham‌? ityata āha--`paśūnāṃ vibhāgajñāpanārtham‌' ityādi| tena sthūlakarṇa ityatra na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyenoktau viśeṣasaya grahaṇaṃ labhyate? varṇagrahaṇājjñāpakāt‌| yadi lakṣaṇamātrasyeha grahaṇabhimataṃ syādvarṇagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, varṇo hi lakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeva| tenāpi lakṣyata iti kṛtvā, kṛtaśca| tasmāt‌ tadeva jñāpayati--viśiṣṭamiha lakṣaṇaṃ guhyata iti| yat‌ punarviśiṣṭaṃ vyākhyānāt‌ tadvijñeyam‌| `śvetapādaḥ' iti| `śvitā varṇe' (dhā.pā.742) ityasmātad‌ pacādyaci śvetaśabdo vyutpādyate, tenāntodātto'yam‌| `kūṭaśṛṅgaḥ' iti| `kūṭa dāhe' (dhā.pā.1890) [kūṭa paritāpe (paridāhe ityanye) dhā.pā.] iti, asmādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ (3.1.135) kaḥ, tena kūṭaśabdo'pyantodātta eva| `śobhanakarṇaḥ' iti| `śubha śumbha śobhārthe' (dhā.pā.1321,1322) asmāt‌ `anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' (3.2.149) iti yuc‌| citsvareṇa śobhanaśabdo'pyantodāttaḥ| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarāpadādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi yogāḥ prāgavyayībhāvasaṃśabdanāt‌| tena sarvatra pratyudāharaṇeṣu pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ pratyudāhāryaḥ|| 113. saṃjñaupamyayośca| (6.2.113) `kuñci karṇaḥ, maṇikarṇaḥ' iti| `kuci śabde tāre' (dhā.pā.184) [kuca--dhā.pā.] `aṇa raṇa vaṇa bhaṇa maṇa' (dhā.pā.444.448) iti maṇirbhvādau paṭhyate ābhyām‌ `sarvadhātubhya in‌' (paṃ.u.4.117) `igupadhāt‌ kit‌' (paṃu.4.119) itīnpratyayaḥ, kicca| tena kuñci| tena kuñcimaṇiśabdāvādyudāttau| `gokarṇaḥ' iti| gauriva karṇo'syeti vigrahaḥ| gośabda uktasvaraḥ| `kharakarṇaḥ' iti| kharasyetyādi vigrahaḥ| khamasyāstīti `raprakaraṇe khamukhakuñjebhya upasaṃkhyānam‌ (vā.577) iti rapratyayaḥ, tena kharaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ|| 114. kaṇṭhapṛṣṭhagrīvājaṅghaṃ ca| (6.2.114) `kaṇeṣṭhaḥ' (paṃ.u.1.105) iti ṭhapratyayāntatvāt‌ kaṇṭhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `ḍityapṛṣṭhagūthayūthaprothāḥ' (da.u.6.37) [titha--da.u; paṃ.u.] iti pṛṣṭhaśabdo'ntodātto nipātyate| `iṇśībhyāṃ van‌' (da.u.8.126) ityato vanpratyaye'nuvartamāne `śevayahvajihvāgrīvāpvamāvāḥ' (da.u.8.128) iti grīvāśabdo'ntodātto nipātyate| atyantaṃ hanita gacchatīti hanteryaṅ‌, dvirvacanam‌, nugato'nunāsikāntasya' (7.4.85) iti nuk‌, `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti kutvam‌, jaṅghanya iti sthite pacādyac‌ `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti yaṅo luk‌; ṭāp‌, citsvareṇa jaṅghāśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| atha vā--`hanterac‌ jaṅgha ca' (2.4.74) iti yaṅo luk‌; ṭāp‌, citsvareṇa jaṅghāśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| atha vā--`hanterac‌ jaṅgha ca' (paṃ.u.5.31) [`ac‌ tasya jaṅgha ca--paṃ.u.] iti hanteracpratyayo jaṅgha ityayamādeśa ityevaṃ vā jaṅghaśabdo vyutpādyate| eṣāṃ kaṇṭhādīnāṃ samāhāre dvandvaḥ| `śitikaṇṭhaḥ' iti| `sarvadhātubhya in‌' (paṃ.u.4.117) iti vartamānaṃ `kramitamiśāḍistambhāmata icca' (paṃ.u.4.121) [śati--paṃ.u.] iti śitiśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `nīlakaṇṭhaḥ' iti| `nīla varṇe' (dhā.pā.522), [`nīla varṇe--dhā.pa.] asmāt‌ ghañ‌, tena nīlaśabdo'pyādyudāttaḥ| `kharakaṇṭhaḥ' iti| kharasyeva kaṇṭho'syeti vigrahaḥ| khamasyāstīti `raprakaraṇe khamukhakuñjebhya upasaṃkhyānāt‌ (vā.577) rapratyayaḥ, tena kharo'ntodāttaḥ| `uṣṭrakaṇṭhaḥ' iti| uṣṭrasyeva kaṇṭho'syeti `ṣṭran‌' (da.u.8.79) iti vartamāne `uṣakhanibyāṃ kit‌' (da.u.8.82) iti `uṣa dāhe' (dhā.pā.696) ityasmāt‌ ṣṭran‌, kicca| tenoṣṭraśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `kāṇḍapṛṣṭhaḥ' iti| kāṇḍaṃ pṛṣṭhamasyeti kāṇḍaśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasyānisantasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityudāttaḥ| `nākapṛṣṭham‌' iti| nāsyākamastīti `na bhrāṭ‌' (6.3.75) ityādinā prakṛtibhāvānnalopābhāvaḥ| `nañsubhyām‌' (6.2.172) ityuttarapadāntodāttavidhānānnākaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ `gopṛṣṭham‌' i| goriva pṛṣṭhamasyeti| gośabda uktasvaraḥ| `ajapṛṣṭham‌' iti| ajasyeva pṛṣṭhamasyeti `aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.230) asmāt‌ pacādyac‌| ajādiṣvajāśabdasya pāṭhādvībhāvo na bhavati| citsvareṇājaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `sugarīvaḥ' iti| śobhanā grīvā'syeti `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) iti suśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `nīlagrīvaḥ' iti| nīlā grīvā'syeti `nīla varṇe' (dhā.pā.522) [`nīla varṇe--dhā.pa.] asmāt‌ ghañ‌| tena nīlaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `daśagrīvaḥ' iti| daśa grīvā asyeti daśaśabdaḥ `nraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ' (phi.sū2.28) ityādyudāttaḥ| `aśvagrīvaḥ' iti| aśvasyeva grīvā'syeti| gośabdo'śvaśabdaścoktasvaraḥ| `nārījaṅghaḥ' iti| nārī jaṅghā yasyeti| śarṅgaravādiṣu `nṛnarayośca' (ga.sū.57) iti paṭhayante, tenādyudāttaḥ| `tālajaṅghaḥ' iti| tālo jaṅghā yasyeti `tala pratiṣṭhākaraṇe (dhā.pā.1598) [pratiṣṭhāyām‌--dhā.pā.] curādiḥ, tasmāt‌ vacādyac‌| tena tālaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `gojaṅghaḥ' iti| eṇyā iva jaṅghā yasyeti| eṇīśabdaḥ `jāterastrīviṣayāt‌' (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣantaḥ| tenāntodāttaḥ|| 115. śṛṅgamavasthāyāṃ ca| (6.2.115) `udgataśṛṅgaḥ' iti| `gangamyadyoḥ' (paṃ u.1.122) ityadhikṛtya `bhṛñaḥ kinnuṭ‌ ca' (paṃ.u.1.124) iti ca `śṛṇāterhrasvaśca' (paṃ.u.1.125) iti ganpratyayāntaḥ śṛṅgaśabdo vyutpādyate| tenāyamādyudāttaḥ| udgataśabdasthāthādi(6.2.144)svareṇāntodāttaḥ| `dvyaṅgulaśṛṅgaḥ' iti| dve aṅgulī pramāṇamasyeti taddhitārthe dviguḥ `pramāṇe dvayasac‌' (5.2.37) ityādinā vihitasya mātraca āgatasya lopaḥ| `pramāṇe lo dvigornityam‌' (vā.558,559) iti `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ' (5.4.86) ityac‌ samāsāntaḥ| tena dvyaṅgulaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| dvyaṅgulaṃ śṛṅgamasyeti| `ttraṅgulaśṛṅgaḥ' iti| pūrveṇa tulyam‌| `atra' ityādi| ādiśabdena dvyaṅgulāvigrahaṇam‌| `ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ' iti| ṛṣyaṃ śṛṅgaṃyasyeti| `ardhyādayaśca' ityādyudātta ṛṣyaśabdo naño jaramaramittramṛtāḥ| (6.2.116) `ajaraḥ' iti| jaraṇaṃ jaraḥ `ṛdorap‌' (3.3.57)| tenāyaṃ dhātusvareṇādyudāttaḥ| avidyamāno jaro'syeti| `amaraḥ' iti| maraṇaṃ maraḥ, `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam‌' (3.3.113) (6.2.117) `sukarmā' iti| `kṛdṛcaribhyo manin‌' (da.u.6.73) [`manin‌' ityeva da.u.pāṭhaḥ; `sarvadhātubhyo manin‌' iti.paṃ.u.pāṭha--4.144] `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ| `suprathimā' iti| (paṃ.u.4.188) iti varttamāne `srūribhyāṃ tuṭ‌ ca' (da.u.9.62) [srūrībhyāṃ--paṃ.u.da.u.] iti| `susrat‌ sudhvat‌' iti| sransudhvanasubhyāṃ kvip‌ `vasusraṃsu' (8.2.72) ityādinā dattvam‌, `uṣaḥ kit‌' (paṃ.u.4.234) iti kit‌| atha kathaṃ suprathimetyatara susrotāḥ, susrat‌, sudhvadityeteṣu cottarapadamādyudāttaṃ bhavati, yāvatārthavatormanasorarthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayeha grahaṇam‌, na ceha tāvarthavantau? ityata āha--`aninasman‌' ityādi| `aninasman‌ grahaṇānyanarthavatā cānarthakena ca tadantavidhi prayojayanti' (vyā.pā.129) iti bruvatā vākyakāreṇāninasmanprabhṛtīnāmanarthakānāmapi ityasyāvakāśaḥ--ayavakaḥ, suyavaka iti, `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌| ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--sukarmakaḥ, susrotaska iti, `kapi pūrvam‌' (6.2.173) ityetadbhavati vipratiṣedhena|| 118. kratvādayaśca| (6.2.118) kṛñaḥ kratuḥ, tena nitsvareṇa kraturādyudāttaḥ| dṛśīkapratīkaśabdau `ardhyādayaśca' ityādyudāttau| sūpūrvasyatvarateḥ ktin‌| `tādau ca niti kṛtyatau' (6.2.50) iti gatisvarema pratūrtiśabda ca| (6.2.120) `sphāyitañci' (da.u.8.31) ityādinā'je rakipratyaye vīraśabdo vyutpādyate| tenāntodāttaḥ| atha vā--`vīra vikrāntau' (dhā.pā.1903) ityasya pacādyaci vyutpāditatvāt‌| `vīryamiti yatpratyayāntam‌' iti| vīre sādhuḥ, `tatra sādhuḥ' (4.4.98) iti prāgghitīyo yat‌| atha vā--vīra ityasamāccaurādikādasmādeva nipātanāt `aco yat‌' (3.1.97), tena vīryamiti yatpratyayāntam‌| evaṃ sati ityantasvaritameva bhavati|| 121. kūlatīratūlamūlaśālākṣasamamavyayībhāve| (6.2.121) `kūla saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.525), [`kūla āvaraṇe--dhā.pā.] `pāra tīra karmasamāptau' (dhā.pa.1911,1912), `tūla niṣkarṣe' (dhā.pā.527), `mūla pratiṣṭhāyām‌' (dhā.pā.529)--ebhyo ghañ‌, tenaite kūlādaya ādyudāttaḥ| `śula hula patlṛ gatau'--(dhā.pā.843,844,845) asmādghañ‌| śālāpyādyudāttā| strītvam‌ `tatpuruṣe [ṣama avaikalye--dhā.pā.] asmāt‌ pacādyac‌, tena samo'ntodāttaḥ| yastu sarvādiṣu samaśabdaḥ so'nudāttastatraiva paṭhyate, tasyāpīha grahaṇam‌| `upakūlam‌' iti| kūlasya samīpamiti `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādināvyayībhāvaḥ| `parikūlam‌' iti| `upaparī varjane' (1.4.88) iti pariśabdaḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjña)| tena yoge `pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' (2.3.10) iti kūlāt‌ pañcamī| `apaparibahirañcavaḥ (2.1,17) ityete'vyayībhāvā iti darśayati| `upakumbham‌' iti| atra samāsāntodāttatvameva| `paramakūlam‌, uttamakūlam‌' iti| paramaṃ kūlamasyottamaṃ kūlamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| atra pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara pūrveṇottarapadasya siddhe'yaṃ pūrvapadasyādyudāttatvārtha ārambhaḥ| cinoteḥ kvip‌ cit‌| hanteḥ pacādyac‌ hanaḥ| nipātanāt‌ talopo ṇatvaṃ ca cihaṇaḥ| `mala malla dhāraṇe'--(dā.pā.493,494) ābhyāṃ
