[pūño hrasvaśca--da.u.,puvo hrasvaśca--paṃ.u.] iti putraśabdaḥ ktapratyayānto vyutpādyate| bhāryāśabdaḥ `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124) iti ṇyadantatvādantasvaritaḥ| `ṇaha bandhane' (dā.pā.1166) asmādupapūrvāt‌ kvip‌ `nahivṛti' (6.3.116) ityādinā pūrvapadasya dīrghatvam‌, `naho dhaḥ' (8.2.34) iti nakārasya dhakāraḥ, tasya cartvam‌--takāraḥ| upānacchabdaḥ kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| nagā asmin‌ vidyanta iti `nagarāt‌ kutsanaprāvīṇyayoḥ' (4.2.128) ityasmādeda nipātanādrapratyayaḥ, tena nagaramantodāttam‌| dadhīti `ādṛgama' (3.2.171) ityādina kvinpratyayānto dadhātervyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| udakena śūyata ityudaśvit‌, kvip‌| `kvibvacipracchi' (da.u.10.2) ityādinā bahulavacanāddīrdho'sya na bhavati| `udakasyodaḥ saṃjñāyām‌' (6.3.57) ityudabhāvaḥ, kṛtsvareṇāntādāttaḥ| būtaśabdo'pi niṣṭhāntatvādantodāttaḥ| prajāśabdaḥ `upasarge ca saṃjñāyām‌' (3.2.99) iti ḍapratyayāntaḥ,--katena kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `paramacelam‌' iti| atra pūjā gamyate, na garhā|| 127. cīramupamānam‌| (6.2.127) `susūdāgṛdhibhyaḥ kran‌' (da.u.8.42,paṃ.u.2.25)[susūdāñgṛdhibyaḥ kran‌--da.u.,paṃ.u.] iti vartamāne--`śusicimīnāṃ dīrghaśca' (da.u.8.43,paṃ.u.2.26) iti kranpratyayāntaścīraśabdaḥ, tenādyudāttaḥ| `vastracīram‌' iti| pūrvavad‌vyāghrāditvāt‌ samāsaḥ. vaserācchādanārthāt‌ ṣṭran‌ vastram‌, tenādyudāttam‌| `kambalacīram‌' iti| `ghṛtādīnāñca' (phi.sū.1.21) iti kambalaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ|| 128. palalasūpaśākaṃ miśre| (6.2.128) `pala rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.839), [pala gatau--dhā.pā.] `kalastṛpaśca' (da.u.8.107) iti vartamāne `vṛṣādibhyaścit‌' (da.u.8.109) iti kalapratyayasya citvāt‌ palaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `roderṇiluk‌ ca' (da.u.8.39) iti vidyamāne `bahulamanyatrāpi saṃjñācchandasoḥ (da.u.8.40) iti bahulavacanāṇṇiluk‌, ca| `pānī viṣibhyaḥ paḥ' (da.u.7.2) ityadhikṛtya `stuvo dīrghaśca' (da.u.7.4) iti ca `suśṛbhyāṃ nicca' (da.u.7.6) [muśṛmyāmūrca--da.u.] iti sūpaśabdaḥ papratyayānto vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| `iṇbhīkāpāśalyatimarcibhyaḥ kan‌' (da.u.3.21) iti bahulavacanāt‌ `śo tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1270) asmādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ, tena guḍaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `dhṛ `kṣaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1096) ityasmāt‌ `añcighṛsibhyaḥ ktaḥ' (da.u.6.9) ti ktaḥ, tena ghṛtamantodāttam‌| `mudigrorgaggau' (da.u.3.66) iti mudergak‌ tena mudgo'ntodāttaḥ|| 129. kūlasūdasthalakarṣāḥ saṃjñāyām‌| (6.2.129) kūlaśabda uktasvaraḥ, `ṣūda kṣaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1717) ityasmāt‌ `igupadāt‌ kaḥ' (3.1.135), tena sūdo'ntodāttaḥ| `sthala sthāne' (?) ityasmāt‌ pacādyac‌, tena sthalamantodāttam‌| karṣaśabdaḥ `karṣātvato dhaño'nta udāttaḥ' (5.1.159) ityantodāttaḥ| `dākṣikūlam‌' ityādi| dākṣimāhakiśabdāviñantāvādyudātau| devaśabdaḥ pacādyajantatvādādyudāttaḥ| bhājīśabdo jānapadādisūtreṇa (4.1.42) ṅīṣantatvādantodāttaḥ| dāṇḍāyanaśabdo naḍāditvāt‌ (4.1.99) phagantaḥ, tena `kitaḥ' (6.1.165) ityantodāttaḥ| nanu ca sūtre sthalaśabda upāttaḥ, tatkathaṃ sthalīśabda uttarapadamādyudāttaṃ codāhriyate? ityāha--`sthalagrahaṇam‌' ityādi|| 130. akarmadhārahaye rājyam‌| (6.2.130) rājño bhāvaḥ, karma vā rājyam‌, ṣyantatvādādyudattam‌| brāhmaṇakṣatriyaśabdau uktasvarau| `celarājya' ityādi| celarājyasvarasyāvakāśaḥ--bhāryācelam‌, brāhmaṇarājyamiti, `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.1.2) ityādinā vihitasya svarasyāvakāśaḥ--niṣkauśāmbiriti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--kucelam‌, kurājayamiti, avyayasvaro bhavati pūrvapratiṣedhena| ādiśabdena vargyādisvaraparigrahaḥ|| 131. vargyādayaśca| (6.2.131) vargyādayo digādiyadantāḥ| teṣu ye dvyacaste `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) ityādyudāttāḥ| pariśiṣṭāstu `tit‌ svaritam‌' (6.1.185) ityantasvaritāḥ| vasudevasyāpatyam‌ `ṛṣyandhaka' (4.1.114) ityādināṇ‌, tena vāsudevaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `araja arjane' (dhā.pā.224) ityasmāccurādiṇijantāt‌ `ajerṇiluk‌ ca' (da.u.5.57) ityunaṇpratyayaḥ| tenārjuno madhyodāttaḥ| `ityevamādayaḥ' iti| ādiśabdena pakṣaśabdāt‌ pare ye paṭhyante teṣāṃ grahaṇam‌|| 132. putraḥ pumbhyaḥ| (6.2.132) `kaunaṭiputraḥ' iti| putraśabda uktasvarahaḥ| kunaṭasyāpatyaṃ kaunaṭiḥ, tenāyamādyudāttaḥ| dāmakamāhiṣakaśabdāvapi kannantāvādyudāttau| `gārgīputraḥ, vātsīputraḥ' iti| gārgayavātsyaśabdābhyām‌ `yañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīp‌| tena gārgīvātsīśabdau ñitsvareṇādyudātau| sarvatrāsmiṃstatpuruṣādhikāre pratyudāharaṇe `samāsasya' (6.1.223) ityantodāttatvaṃ veditavyam‌|| 133. nācāryarājartviksaṃyuktajñātyākhyebhyaḥ| (6.2.133) pūrveṇācāryādibhyo'pi parasya putraśabdasyādyudāttatve prāpte pratiṣedho'yamucyate| tathā ca samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| `ākhyāgrahāt‌' ityādi| ākhyāgrahaṇamācāryādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| tathā cākhyāgrahaṇe'niraste tasyācāryādeḥ paryāyāṇaṃ viśeṣaṇāñca grahaṇaṃ bhavati| `ācāryaputraḥ' iti svarūpasyodāharaṇam‌| `upādhyāyaputraḥ' iti paryāyasya| `śākaṭāyanaputraḥ' iti viśeṣasya| `rājaputraḥ' iti svarūpasya| `īśvaraputraḥ' iti paryāyasya| `nandaputraḥ' iti viśeṣasya| `ṛtvikputraḥ' iti svarūpasya| `yājakaputraḥ' iti paryāyasya| `hotuḥputraḥ' iti viśeṣasya| `saṃyuktaputraḥ' iti svarūpasya| `sambandhiputraḥ' iti paryāyasya| `syālaputraḥ' iti| viśeṣasya| `jñātiputraḥ' iti svarūpasya| `bhrātuṣputraḥ' iti viśeṣasya| `kasyādiṣu ca' (8.3.48) iti ṣatvam‌| tatrācāryaśabdaḥ kṛtsvareṇāntasvaritaḥ| sa hi carerāṅpūrvasya ṇyati vyutpādyate| upādhyāyaśabdo'ntodāttasthāthādisvareṇa (6.2.144), sa `iṅaśca' (3.3.21) iti ghañanto vyutpādyate| rājaśabda ādyudattaḥ, kaninpratyayāntatvāt‌| īśvaraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ; `stheśabhāsa' (3.2.175) ityādinā varacpratyayāntatvāt‌| nandaśabdo'pyantodāttaḥ; ajantatvāt‌| ṛtvikśabdaḥ `ṛtvigdadhṛk‌' (3.2.59) ityādinā kvin‌ pratyayāntaḥ| kṛtsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| yājakaśabdo ṇvulantaḥ, tena litsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| hotṛśabdastṛnnantatvādādyudāttaḥ| saṃyuktaśabdaḥ `gatirantaraḥ' (6.2.49) ityādyudāttaḥ| `syala vitarkage' (?) asmāccurādiṇijantātt‌ pacādyaci syālaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `jñā' ityasmāt‌ `kticktau ca saṃjñāyām‌' (3.3.174) iti jñātiśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `tṛnstṛcau śaṃsikṣadādibhyaḥ' (da.u.2.1) iti prakṛtya bhātṛśabdastṛnnnanto vyutpādyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| saṃyuktaśabdo'yamastyeva rūḍhiśabdo yo vivāhakṛtena sambandhena syālaśvaśurādiṣu vartate, asti kriyāśabdo yaḥ sarvatra kenacit‌ sambandhena vartate; tatreha rūḍhiśabdasya grahaṇam‌| kuta etat‌? ācāryānīnāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇāt‌| yadi hi kriyāśabdasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tadā saṃyuktagrahaṇenaiva niṣiddhattvādācāryādīnāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌| te'pi hi vidyādikṛtena sambandhena saṃyuktā bhavantyeva| tasmādrūḍhiśabdasya grahaṇam‌| tena kriyāśabdo yaḥ saṃyuktaśabdastasmāt‌ pratiṣedo na bhavati|| 134. cūrṇādīnyaprāṇiṣaṣṭhyāḥ| (6.2.134) `cūrī dāhe' (dhā.pā.1158), asmānniṣṭhā, te cūrṇamantodāttam‌| kariṇaḥ pātīti `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) pakārasya pakṣe vakāro nipātyate--karipaḥ, karivaḥ| kṛtsvareṇa thāthādisvareṇa vāntodāttaḥ| `maheritaṇ‌ ca' (da.u.5.19) bahulavacanācchakerapi bhavati, śākinam‌, pratyayasvareṇa madyodāttam‌| `śakādibhyo'ṭac‌' (da.u.5.2;paṃ.u.4.81) [śakādibhyo'ṭan‌--.dau;paṃ.u.] śakaṭam‌| tadvahatīti śakaṭavaṇ‌ śākaṭam‌| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| drāgdrūtaṃ kṣīyata iti drākṣā, pṛṣodarāditvāt‌| antodātto'yaṃ śabdaḥ| `tusa hrasa hlasa rasaśabde' (dhā.pā.710, 711,712,713), tato bahulavacanāt‌ `hasimṛgriṇavāmidamilūpūdhurvībhyastan‌' (da.u.6.7,paṃ.u.3.86) [hasimṛgriṇvamidamitamilūpūdhūrvibhyastan‌--da.u; hasimṛgaraṇvāmidamūlapūrvibhyastan‌--paṃ.u.] iti tan‌, nipātanāddīrghaśca| tūstamādyudāttam‌| `kutsitaṃ dunotīti `kvibavacipracchi' ityādau sūtre (vā.288) kvibiti yogavibhāgaḥ| `dudu upatāpe' (dā.pā.1256) ityasmādapi kvip‌, `bahulavacanāt‌ anityatvādvāgamaśāsanasya' (vyā.pa.99) tugabhāvaḥ, pūrvapadasya ca bahulavacanādeva mum‌--kundu, tanmimīta iti `māṅmāne' (dā.pā.1088) ityasmāt‌ kaḥ, kundumo'ntodāttaḥ| `uṣikuṭidalikacikhajibhyaḥ kapan‌' (da.u.7.9) tena dalapa ādyudāttaḥ| `atyavicamitaminami' (da.u.9.44) ityādinā'sac‌--camasaḥ, tato jātilakṣaṇo ṅīṣ‌ (4.1.63) camasī| `caka tṛptau' (dhā.pā.783) ityasmāt‌ kavip‌, cak‌| `kanī dīptikāntigatiṣu' (dhā.pā.460) [kana dīptikāntigatiṣu--dhā.pā.] tasmādac‌, kanaḥ| cakakanaḥ| colasyāpatyaṃ caulaḥ, `dvyañmagadha' (4.1.170) ityādinā'ṇ‌| ete cūrṇādayaḥ| `mudgacūrṇam‌' iti| `mudi grorgaggau' (da.u.3.66) iti mudgo'ntodāttaḥ| `masūracūrṇam‌' iti| `maserūran‌' (da.u.8.95) masūra ādyudāttaḥ| `matsyacūrṇam‌' iti| matsyaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `tatroyagraha iti ṣaṣṭhyantameva' iti| anena tulyārthatāṃ sūtrayordarśayati| kathaṃ punarupagrahaḥ ṣaṣṭhyantameva gṛhyate? ityāha--`pūrvācāryopacāreṇa' iti| pūrvācāryā hi ṣaṣṭhyantamupagraha ityevamupacaranti sma| teneha pūrvā cāryopacāreṇa hetunā ṣaṣṭhyantamevopagraha iti gṛhyate| samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ evamuttare'pi trayaḥ|| 135. ṣaṭ‌ ca kāṇḍādīni| (6.2.135) `celakheṭakaṭukakāṇḍam‌' (6.2.126) ityādiṣu caturṣu yogeṣu sanniviṣṭāni kāṇḍādīni ṣaṭ‌ gṛhyante| yadyevaṃ taireva yogaireṣāmādyudāttatvaṃ siddham‌, tatkimarthamidam‌? yatra tairvihita tato'nyatrāpi yathā syāt‌ prāṇiṣaṣṭhyāśca mā bhūdityevamarthañca| `darbhakāṇḍam‌' iti| `dṝdalibhyāṃ bhaḥ' (paṃ.u.3.151) iti bhapratyayānto darbhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `tṛṇadhānyānāñca dvyaṣām‌' (phi.sū.2.27) iti vā| `śarakāṇḍam‌' iti| śaraśabdo'pyanantareṇaiva `dvyaṣām‌' ityādyudāttaḥ| evaṃ kuśaśabdo'pi| tathā tilaśabdo'pi| palalamūlakaśabdāvuktasvarau| nadaḍati pacādiṣu paṭhyate, tena ṭittvānnadaśabdānṅīp‌ `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralopaḥ, `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) iti ṅīpa udāttatvam‌| tena nadīśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `pāṭalāpālaṅkāmbāsāgarārthānām‌' (phi.sū.1.2) iti phiṣā samudraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `rājasūdaḥ' iti| śūdaśabdaḥ ṣaṅbhyaḥ paraḥ paṭhyate| tenātra samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati| sarve ca te darbhakāṇḍādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ|| 136. kuṇḍaṃ vanam‌| (6.2.136) `kuṇḍaśabde'tri kuṇḍasādṛśyetana vane varttate' iti| yathā kuṇjaṃ kasyacidudakāderāśrayastathā vanamapi| ataḥ kuṇjasādṛśyenātra kuṇḍaśabdo vane vartate| bhavati hi sādṛśyena tācchabdyaṃ yathā--agnimaṇivaka iti| `mṛtkuṇḍam‌' iti| atra kuṇḍa ākāraviseṣo mṛdvikāre vartate, na vane| tena samāsāntodāttatvameva bhavati|| 137. prakṛtyā bhagālam‌| (6.2.137) bhagālamityarthagrahaṇam‌; arthapradhānatvānnirdeśasya, arthapradhāne hi nirdeśa svarūpagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatītyuktam‌| arthagrahaṇe ca sati tadvācināmetat‌ kāryaṃ vijñāyate| ata evāha--`bhagālavāci' ityādi| `kumbhībhāgālam‌' iti| kumbhīśabdaḥ `jāterastrīviṣayādayoṣadāt‌' (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣantatvādantodāttaḥ| `bhagālādayo madhyodāttāḥ' iti| `lagāvante dvayośca bahavaṣo guruḥ' (phi.sū.2.42) iti phiṣaiṣāmākārasyodāttatvavidhānāt‌|| 138. śiternityābahvaj bahuvrīhāvabhasat‌| (6.2.138) `śitipādaḥ' iti| śitiśabdaḥ `varṇānāṃ taṇatinitāntānām‌' (phi.sū.2.33) iti phiṣādyudāttaḥ| `aṃsauṣṭhaśabdau' ityādi| `ama roge' (dhā.pā.1720) ityasmāt‌ `amaḥ san‌' (paṃ.u.5.21) iti sanpratyayārnto'saśabdo vyatpādyate| oṣṭhaśabdo'pi `uṣikuṣigarttibyasthan‌' (da.u.6.29) iti thanpratyayāntaḥ| tenaitau pratyayasya nitvādādyudāttau| `darśanīyapādaḥ' iti| darśanīyaśabdo'nīyar‌ pratyayantaḥ| tena `upottamaṃ riti' (6.1.217) iti madhyodāttaḥ| tato'tra pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara eva bhavati| evamuttareṣvapi pratyudāharaṇeṣu| kathaṃ punaḥ kakudaśabdo nityaṃ bahvaj‌ na bhavati? ityāha--`kakudasyāvasthāyāṃ lopaḥ' ityādi| `śitilalāṭaḥ' iti| `lala īpsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1687), asmāt‌ `uṇādayo bahulam‌' (3.3.1) ityāṭapratyayaḥ, tena lalāṭaśabdo madyodāttaḥ| `śitipādaḥ' iti| śiteḥ pāda ityatra samāsasvara eva bhavati| `śitibhasat‌' iti `śṝdṝbhasodiḥ' (da.u.6.42) iti bhasacchabdo vyutpādyate| tato'yamantodātta-|| 139. gatikārakopapadātkṛt‌| (6.2.139) `prakārakaḥ, prahārakaḥ' iti| ṇvul‌| `prakaram‌' ityādiṣu lyuṭ‌| `īṣatkaraḥ' ityādiṣu `īṣad‌duḥsuṣu' (3.3.926) iti khal‌| yadatrāvyayapūrvapadaṃ tatra `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (2.2.17) iti samāsaḥ| `kārakāt‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhī tu `karttukarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti karmaṇi kārake veditavyā| idhmādayo hi vraścanakriyāyā vyāptumiṣṭatamatvāt‌ karmabāvamanubhavanti| `īṣatkaraḥ' ityādau tu `upapadamatiṅ‌' (2.2.19) iti samāsaḥ| tatra praśabdaḥ `upasargāścābhivarjam‌' (phi.sū.4.81) ityādyudāttaḥ| idhmaśabdo hi `iṣiyudhīndhi' (da.u.7.31) ityādinā makpratyayāntatvādantodāttaḥ| `śo tanūkaraṇe' (dā.pā.1145), palaṃ śyatoti [śyatoti--mudrītaḥ pāṭhaḥ] `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3)| palāśaḥ kṛtsvareṇathāthādisvareṇa (6.2.144) vāntodāttaḥ| śaderṇijantasya `śaderagatau taḥ (7.3.42) iti takāre kṛte lyuṭi `śātanaḥ' iti bhavati| `śmani śrayaterḍan‌' (da.u.1.161) iti latve kṛte `kalpanaḥ' iti bhavati| īṣacchabdo'ntodāttaḥ; svarādiṣu tathābhūteṣu tathāṃbhūtasyaiva pāṭhāt‌| sudurāvādyudāttau; prādiṣu tathābhūtayoḥ pāṭhāt‌| `sarvatraivātra litsvaraḥ' iti| sa punaḥ pratyayāt‌ pūrvasyodāttatvam‌| `devadattasyeti seṣalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī' iti| karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ nirākaroti| karmaṣaṣṭhyāṃ hyasyāṃ kārakameva devadattaḥ syāt‌, tathā ca pratyudāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate| atha kārakagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, nirgataḥ kauśāmbyā niṣkauśāmbirityatra mā bhūditi cet‌? naitadasti; tathā hi--yātkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñā bhavanti (jai.pa.vṛ.99), na hi kauśāmbīśabdaḥ kriyāvācī, tat‌ kutastaṃ prati niso'tra gatisaṃjñā? ityata āha--`kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌' iti| yadi tarhi kṛdgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, prapacatitarāmityatra parakṛtisavaro na prāpnoti| tataśca samāsasvaraṃ bādhitvāvyayasvara eva syāt‌? ityata āha--`prapacatitarām‌' ityādi| atra hi pacatiśabdādatiśayavivakṣāyāṃ taraptapamau| tatasatarabādyante `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti praśabadasya samāsaḥ| samāse tu kṛte pūrvapadasya `tatpuruṣaṃ tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā prakṛtisvaraḥ| paścāt‌ `kimettiṅvyaya' (5.4.11) ityādināmuḥ| āmantasaya ca `ādyudāttaśca' (3.1.3) iti pratyayasavaraḥ prāpraḥ, so'vyayasavare sati satiśiṣṭaḥ, sataśiṣṭasya ca balīyastvamuktam‌| tena yadyapyanenāmantasya kṛdgrahaṇe kriyamāṇe sati prakṛtisvaro bhavati, tathāpyāmsvaro bhavatyeva; tasya satiśiṣṭatvāt‌| atha kathaṃ taravādyantena samāsaḥ? kathaṃ ca na syāt‌? `gatikārakopapadādīnāṃ kṛddhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāksubutpatteḥ' (hai.pa.pā.88) iti vacanāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atra hi dve darśane gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛdbhireva samāso bhavati, sa ca prāk‌ subutpatterityekaṃ darśanam‌; gatikārakopapadānāmaviśeṣeṇa samāso bhavati, kṛdbhistu prāk‌ subutpatteriti dvitīyam‌| tatra dvitaye darśane yujyata eva tarabādyantena samāsaḥ| tatra kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamityanena sambaddham‌| eka ācāryāḥ kṛdgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthamityeva vyācakṣata ityarthaḥ| `prapacati deśyādyartha tu' ityādi| tuśabdaḥ pūrvasmād‌ vyākhyānādviśeṣadyotanāya| prapacatideśya ādiryasya sa prapacatideśyādiḥ| ādiśabdena prapacatideśīya ityasya grahaṇam‌| prapacatideśyādāvarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat‌ prapacatideśyādyartham‌| `kṛdgrahaṇaṃ dṛśyate' iti| evaṃ `īṣadasamāptau kalpabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ' (5.3.67) ityatra `tiṅśca' (5.3.56) ityanuvṛtteḥ prapacatiśabdād‌ deśyadeśīyarau| tadantena ca praśabdasya gatisamāse kṛdgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta| tathā prapacatideśyaḥ, prapacati veśīya ityatrāpyuttarapadasya prakṛtisvaraḥ syāt‌, na ceṣyate| tasmādiha mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kṛdgrahaṇaṃ dṛśyata eva| tasmādetanna vispaṣṭārtham‌| tadapi tu prapacatideśya ityādau viṣaye mā bhūdityevamartha mityabhiprāyaḥ|| 140. ubhe vanaspatyādiṣu yūgapat‌| (6.2.140) vanaśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasyānisantasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttaḥ| patiśabdo'pi pratyayasvareṇa| sa `pāterḍatiḥ' asminnāsīnāḥ śaṃsanti' iti| etenādhikaraṇasādhanaṃ śaṃsaśabdaṃ darśayati| evaṃ śaṃsantītyanenāpi karmasādhanam‌| `śaṃsa stutau' (dhā.pā.728) ityasmāt‌ `aṃkarttari ca kārake' (3.3.19) iti ghañ‌| `abantaḥ' iti| `ṛdorap‌' (3.3.57) ityanena| `śunaḥśepaḥ' iti| bahuvrīhirayam‌| tenātra pūrvapadasya prakṛtibhāve prāpte vacanam‌| `ubhāvādyudāttau' iti| tatra śvañśabdaḥ `śvannukṣan‌' (da.u.6.55) (dhā.pā.279) ityasya ghañi śaṇḍa iti bhavati| `pṛcī samparke' (dhā.pā.1462) ityasyāpi tatraiva paraka iti bhavati| `tṛṣṇāśabda ādyudāttaḥ' iti| sa hi tṛṣerniṣṭhāyāṃ vyutpadyate| tena `niṣṭhā ca dvyajanāt‌' (6.1.205) ityādyudāttaḥ| `vambaśabdaḥ' iti| `lavi avasraṃsane' (dhā.pā.379) [labi avasraṃsane ca--dhā.pā.] asya pacādyaci vyutpāditvādasmādeva nipātanādvattvam‌| `viśvavayaḥśabdaḥ' iti| viśvaṃ vayo yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| tatra `bahuvrīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām‌' (6.2.106) iti viśvaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `tayoḥ' iti| vambaviśvayaḥśabdayoḥ| `mṛṅo vicpratyayaḥ' [mṛñaḥ--kāśikā. mṛḍaḥ--padamañjarī] tyukpratyayāntatvāt‌| `dvandvānām‌' ityādi| ye'tra dvandvāḥ, teṣāmadevatādvandvārthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| devatādvandve hi `devatādvandve ca' (6.2.141) ityanenaiva siddham‌| `anudattādyuttarapadārthaśca' iti| dvandvānāṃ pāṭhaḥ| yadi hi teṣāmiha pāṭho na syāt‌, tadā `nottarapade'nudāttādau' (6.2.142) iti pratiṣedādantodāttatvaṃ syāt‌|| 141. devatādvandve ca| (6.2.141) `indrāsomau' iti| `devatādvandve ca' iti pūrvapadasyānaṅ‌| `ṛjrendra' ityādi| `vṛdhivapibhyāṃ ran‌' (da.u.8.45), ityato rannityanuvartagāne `ṛjrendraḥ' (da.u.8.46) itīndraśabdo ranpratyayānto nipātyate, tenādyudāttaḥ| `soma iti samāsasvarāpavādo yogaḥ|| 142. nottarapade'nudāttādāvapṛthivīrudrapūṣamanthiṣu| (6.2.142) `agnivāyuśabdāvantodāttau' iti| agniśabdaḥ `vījyājvaribhyo niḥ' (da.u.1.18) iti vartamāne `aṅgernalopaśca' (da.u.1.20) iti nipratyayāntaḥ| vāyuśabdo'pi `kṛvāpāji' (da.u.1.86) ityādinoṇpratyayāntaḥ, tena pratyayasvareṇa dvāvapyantodāttau| athottarapadagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `anudāttādau' iti saptamyevātrānudāttāderapadattvaṃ bodhayiṣyati? ityata āha--`uttarapadagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| iha hi prakaraṇe dvandvaḥ saptamyā nirdiṣṭaḥ, nottarapadam‌| tatrānudāttādāviti saptamī dvagdvasyaiva viśeṣaṇamāpadyate--anudāttādau dvandvaḥ| uttarapadagrahaṇe tu sati dvandve saptamyāṃvihitāyāmanudāttā(dā) vityetaduttarapadasya viśeṣaṇaṃ sampadyate| tasmāduttarapadaviśeṣaṇametadyathā stāt‌, dvandvaviśeṣaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamuttarapadagrahaṇam‌| `anudāttādau' iti| asatyetasminnaviśeṣaṇe vidhirapi devatādvandva ucyate, pratiṣedho'pi, tataśca tayorviṣayavibāgo na syāt‌; evañca samānaviṣayatvādvikalpaḥ prasajyeta| anudattādāvityasmiṃstu sati yatrānudāttādyuttarapado devatādvandvastagtra pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, tato'nyastu vidhiriti vidhipratiṣedhayorviṣayavibhāgo bhavati| ato viṣayavibāgārthamanudāttādāvityucyate| `pṛthivīśabdo ṅīṣpratyayāntaḥ' iti| gaurādiṣu pāṭhāt‌| `roderṇiluk‌ ca' iti| `rudir‌ aśruvimocane' (dhā.pā.1067) ityasmāṇṇyantāt‌ `sphāyitañci' (da.u.8.31) ityādi--sūtradragityanuvartamāne `roderṇiluk‌ ca' (da.u.8.39) iti rak‌, tena rudro'ntodāttaḥ| `śukrāmanthinau' iti| śukraśabdaḥ `ṛjendraḥ' (da.u.8.46) ityādinā ran‌pratyayāntaḥ, tenādyudāttaḥ|| 143. antaḥ| (6.2.143) 144. thāthaghañktājabitrakāṇām‌ (6.2.144) `atra kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaratvenādyudāttamuttarapadaṃ syāt‌' iti| yadīdaṃ nārabhyeteti bhāvaḥ| `upasarge vaseḥ ityathapratyayaḥ' iti| kādeśaḥ| ubhayatrātra karmaṇi niṣṭhā| tatra `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti prāpte tadapavāda uttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| yadā tu kartari ktaḥ, tadā tu kṛtsvareṇottarapadasya prakṛtibhāve ityeke' iti| teṣāmanena yānādibhyo'nyatra na bhavitavyam‌| `asaṃjñārtho'yamārambhaḥ' iti| saṃjñāyāṃ pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌| `ākṛtigaṇaśca pravṛddhādirdraṣṭavyaḥ' iti| kuta et‌? akṛtigaṇatāṃ tasya sūcayitumanuktasamuccayārthasya cakārasyeha karaṇāt‌; ākṛtigaṇatve yat‌ siddhaṃ bhavati, taddarśayitumāha--`punarutsyūtaṃ vāsaḥ' ityādi| `ṣivu tantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1108) `cachvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityūṭh‌, yaṇādeśaḥ| `punarniṣkṛtaḥ' iti| `idudupadhasya cāpratyasya' (8.3.41) iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam‌|| 148. kārakāddattaśrutayorevāśiṣi| (6.2.148) `devadāttaḥ' iti| `āśiṣi liṅloṭau' (3.3.163) iti varatamāne `kticktau ca saṃjñāyām‌' (3.3.174) iti ktaḥ| `do dad‌ ghoḥ' (7.4.46) iti dadādeśaḥ, pūrvavat‌ tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ| devaśabdaḥ pacādayajantatvāccitsvareṇāntodātta-| viṣṇuśabdo'pi prātipadikasvareṇa| brahmaśabdo maninpratayayāntatvādādyudātta ityuktam‌| `sambhūto rāmāyaṇaḥ' iti| kārakādityanucyamāne `gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) ityadhikārādyataiva kārakānniyamo bhavatyevaṃ gaterapi syāt‌, kārakagrahaṇe tu sati na bhavati| tena gateḥ parasya `saṃjñāyāmanācitādīnām‌' (6.2.146 ityanena) antodāttatvaṃ bhavedeva| asmiṃstūcyamāne satyeṣa viṣayo na bhavati; niyamena vyāvārtitatvāt‌| `tṛtiyā karmaṇi' (6.2.48) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| `ekakārakaraṇaṃ kim‌' iti| siddhe vidhirārabyamāṇo'ntareṇāpyevakārakaraṇaṃ niyamārtho bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| `kārakāvadhārahaṇam‌' ityādi| asati hyevakāre kārakādevetyeṣo'pi niyamaḥ syāt‌| tatā caivakārantato'nyatrāvadhāraṇamiti dattaśrūtāvadāraṇaṃ syāt‌--kārakādeva dattaśrutayoriti| evaṃ ca kārakāddattaśrutayoranantaraṃ kriyamāṇe kārakāvadhāraṇamiṣṭaṃ bhavati, na dattaśrutāvadāraṇamiṣṭam‌| tenaivakāraḥ kṛtaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ kārakāvadhāraṇamiṣyate, na dattaśrutāvadhāraṇam‌? ityāha--`akārakādapi hi' ityādi| `devaiḥ khātā devakhātā' iti| nātrāśīrvidyate, tenāśiṣīti vacanānniyamo na bhavati| tataśca `saṃjñāyām‌' (6.2.146) ityādināntodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva| `kārakāddattaśrutayorāśiṣyevetyayamapyatra niyamaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punarekena yogena hi niyamadvayaṃ labhyate, ekaḥ punaratra yoga iti? yataiva hi śveto dhāvatīti kaścit‌ tantreṇa vākyadavayamuccārayati tathehāpyācaryastantreṇa vākyamuccāritavān‌| tatraikena yogena kārakāddattaśrutayorevāśiṣītyeva niyamo bhavati, apareṇa tu kārakāddattaśrutayorāśiṣyevetyeṣa-. tenāhato nadati devadatta ityatrānāśiṣi na bhavati| `devadatt iti kasyacicchaṅkhasya nāma' iti yadṛcchāśabdatāṃ devadattasya darśayannāśīriha na datta iti prakāśayati|| 149. itthambhūtena kṛtamiti ca| (6.2.149) itikaraṇo'rthanirdeśārthaḥ| `āpannaḥ' iti| prāpta ityarthaḥ| `suptapralapitam‌' iti| `rapa lapa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.401,402), atra suptatvaṃ prakāramāpannam‌, tena pralapitaṃ kṛtam‌, tatra samāso vartate| `unmattapralapitam‌' iti| atrāpyunmattatvaṃ prakāramāpannaṃ tena pralapitaṃ kṛtam‌| `pramattagītam‌' iti| atrāpi pramattatvaṃ prakāramāpannaṃ tena gītaṃ kṛtam‌| `kai gai śabde' (dhā.pā.916,917), `ghumāsthā' (6.4.66) ityādisūtreṇettvam‌| `vipannaśrutam‌' iti| atrāpi vipannatvaṃ prakāramāpannaṃ tena śrutaṃ kṛtam‌| sarvatra `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ| tatra suptaśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| pralapitaśabdo yadi karmaṇi niṣṭhā, tataḥ `gatirantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti gatisvareṇādyudāttaḥ; atha bhāve, tatasthāthādi (6.2.144) svareṇāntodāttaḥ| evamutpannaprakārā āpannavipannādiśabdā api thāthādisvareṇai(6.2.144) vāntodāttāḥ| `gatiranantaraḥ'(6.2.49) ityetattviha na pravartate; tatra karmaṇītyanuvṛtteḥ. ihākarmakāddhātoḥ karmaṇi ktapratyasyānupapatteḥ| gītaśrutaśabdau suptaśabdavadantodāttau| atha kathametānyudāharaṇādhyupalabhyante, yāvatetyambhūtena kṛtamityetasminnartha etat‌ kāryamucyate, na cāyamatrārthaḥ sambhavati, pralapitādīnāmakṛtārthatvāt‌? prakṛte pralapanādau karoterapravṛtteḥ| abhūtaprādurbhāva eva hi karotirvartate, na pralapanādau| kasmānna pralapanādikṛtam? ityetaccodyamapākarttumāha--`kṛtamiti kriyāsāmānyām‌' ityādi| na hi karotirabhūtaprādurbhāva eva vartate? kiṃ tarhi? kriyāsāmānye'pi| tacca kriyāsāmānyaṃ pralapanādapyasti| tena tena pralapanādyapi kṛtaṃ bhavati| `tṛtīyā karmaṇītyasya' iti| pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarabhāva iti| yadītyādinā yadā bhāve niṣṭhā, tadāsyānupayogaṃ darśayati|| 150. ano bhāvakarmavacanaḥ| (6.2.150) `kārakāt‌' (6.2.148) iti vartate, `anaḥ' iti pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (pu.pa.vṛ.44) tadantasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate? ityāha--`anapratyayāntam‌' ityādi| `odanabhojanam‌' ityādau sarvatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| ṣaṣṭhī tu kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi| `rājabhojanāḥ' ityādau tu kartari| odanaśabdaḥ `laghāvante' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādyudāttaḥ| bhojanamityādikaṃ tūttarapadaṃ litsvareṇādyudāttam‌| payaḥśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya' (phi.sū.2.42) ityādyudāttaḥ| bhojanamityādikaṃ tūttarapadaṃ litsvareṇādyudāttam‌| payaḥśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudātta eva| candanapriyaṅgukāśabdo dvandvaḥ, tena samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `lepanam‌' iti| `lipa upadāhe' (dhā.pā.1433) [lipa upadehe--dhā.pā.] ityasyaivaṃ rūpam‌| rājaśabda uktasvaraḥ| ācchādanaśabdaḥ `chada apavāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1935) ityasya rūpam‌| `karmaṇi ca yena' ityādinaikenaiva yogena bhāvavacanaḥ karmavacanaśca lyuṅbhavatīti darśayati| `hastahāryam‌' iti| hastaśabdaḥ `hasimṛgriṇavāmidamipūdhurvībhyastan‌' (da.u.6.7.;paṃ.u.3.86) [hasimṛgriṇvamidamitamilūpūdhūrvibhyastan‌--da.u; hasimṛgriṇvāmidamalūpūdhūrvibhyastan‌--paṃ.sa.] iti statpratyayāntaḥ, tenādyudāttaḥ,| hāryaśabdastu `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124) iti ṇyadantastitsvareṇāntasvaritaḥ| `dantadhāvanam‌' iti| `dhāvu gatiśuddhoḥ' (dhā.pā.601) ityasmātkaraṇe lyuṭ| dantaśabdaḥ `svāṅgaśiṭām‌' phi.sū.2.29) ityādyudāttaḥ| `nidarśanam‌' iti| dṛśerbhāve lyuṭ‌| `avalekhanam‌' iti| atrāpi likheḥ| `sarveṣu pratyudāharaṇeṣu' ityādi| etena `gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛt‌ (6.2.139) ityasyāyamapavāda iti darśayati|| 151. manktinvyākhyānaśayanāsanasthānayājakādikrītāḥ| (6.2.151) manktinniti pratyayagrahaṇam‌| tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (pu.pa.vṛ.44) tadavatasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha--`mannantaṃ ktinnantañca' iti| rathavartmetyādayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ| rathaśabdaḥ kthanpratyayānta ādyudātta ityuktam‌| `vṛtu vartane' (dhā.pā.748) ityasmānmanin‌| tena vartmaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| śakaṭaśabdaḥ payaḥśabdaśca nittvādādyudāttaḥ. pāṇinyāpiśaliśabdāviñantatvāt‌| kṛtiśabdo'pi ktinnantatvāt‌| karaṇasādhanaścāyaṃ vyākhyānaśabdo lyuṅantaḥ| kṛtsvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ| chandaḥśabdaḥ `sarvadhātubyo'sun‌' (paṃ.u.4.188) [`asan‌' ityeva sūtram‌--da.u.] iti pratyayagrahaṇam‌| tatra kṛte `canderādeśca cchaḥ' (paṃ u.4.218) ityasunpratyayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ| ayantyanenetyayanam‌, ṛcāmayanam‌| ṛcāmiti karṇi ṣaṣṭhī| ṛgayanaśabdaḥ kṛtsvareṇa madyodāttaḥ| `rājaśayanam‌' ityādi| serate'sminniti śayanam‌, āsate'sminnityāsanam‌ tābhyāṃ rājabrāhmaṇaśabdayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| rājabrāhmaṇaśabdābuktasvarau| śayanāsanaśabdau litsvareṇādyudāttau| atra kṛdyogalakṣaṇā pūrvavadeva karttari ṣaṣṭhī| evaṃ `gosthānamaśvasthānam‌' ityatrāpi| gavāśvaśabdāvuktasvarau| tiṣṭhatyasminniti sthānam‌, litsvareṇādyudāttam‌| `brāhmaṇayājyaḥ' ityādau kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| yājakādiṣu ye ṇvulantāḥ paṭhyante, teṣu ye'nupasargāḥ--yājakapūjakasnāpakā iti, ta ādyudāttaḥ| ye tu sopasargāḥ--pariveṣakādhyāpakodvarttakotsādakā iti, te kṛtsvareṇa madhyodāttāḥ| hotabhartṛśabdo tṛnnantau prayojayataḥ| yau tu tṛjantau tayoḥ kṛtsvareṇāntodāttvaṃ siddham‌| `gokrītaḥ, aśvakrītaḥ' ityādi| `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā (2.1.32) iti samāsāvetau| krītaśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `kṛtsvarāpavādo yogaḥ' iti| krītaśabdādanyeṣu manktitanvyākhyānādiṣu| krītaśabde tu `tṛtīyā karmaṇa' (6.2.48) ityasyeti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarasya| `vyākhyānaśayanāsanasthānānāmabhāvakarmārtha grahaṇam‌' iti| bhāvakarmavacanasyānantasya `ano bhāvakarmavacanaḥ' (6.2.150) ityanenaiva siddhatvāt‌| `prakṛtiḥ, prahṛtiḥ' iti| atra `tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā pūravapadasya prakṛtisvaratvameva bhavati| gatisamāsāvetau|| 152. saptabhyāḥ puṇyam‌| (6.2.152) `adhyanapuṇyam‌' ityādi| adhyayanaśabdo lyuḍantaḥ kṛtsvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ| puṇyam‌ `nabviṣayasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttam‌| vidyate'ne'neti vedaḥ, ghañ‌| tena vedaśabdaścādyudāttaḥ| `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' ityādi| etat‌ `uṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni' (hai.pa.pā.103) ityevaṃ pakṣamāśrityoktam‌| idānīṃ vyutpattilakṣaṇamāśrityāha--`uṇādīnāṃ tu' ityādi| vyutpattipakṣe hi puṇyaśabdaḥ `puño yaṇṇug‌ hrasvaśca' (paṃ.u.5.15) iti yatpratyayānto vyutpādyate| tatra yadīda nārabhyeta tadā `gatikāraka' (6.2.139) iti kṛtsvareṇādyudātto'dhyayanamityādau puṇyaśabdasya syāt‌| tasmāt‌ tadapadādo'yamantodāttaviṣirityabhiprāyaḥ| `vedena puṇyaṃ vedapuṇyam‌' iti| vyutpattipakṣe `tṛtīyā' (2.1.30) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| pūrvapadaparakṛtisvaratvañca| avyutpattipakṣe `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ, kṛtsvareṇa puṇyaśabdasyādyudāttatvaṃ ca|| 153. ūnārthakalahaṃ tṛtīyāyāḥ| (6.2.153) `māṣonam‌' iti| `pūrvasadṛśa' (2.1.31) ityādinā tṛtīyā samāsaḥ| evaṃ `kārṣāpaṇonam‌' ityādāvapi| `kaṣa khaṣa śiṣa jaṣa jhaṣa śaṣa vaṣa maṣa' (dhā.pā.685-692) ityasmādghañ‌, tena māṣaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `iṇsiñjidīṅuṣyavibhyo nak‌' (da.u.5.36) iti, tenonaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| kārṣasyāpaṇaḥ kārṣāpaṇaḥ| kārṣāpaṇaśabdaḥ samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| vigataḥ kalo'syeti vikalaḥ| bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvena vikalaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `asikalahaḥ' iti| `aca iḥ' (da.u.1.67) iti vartamāne `khanikaṣyañjyasi' (da.u.1.68) ityādinā sintodāttaḥ `kala gatau' (dhā.pā.1865), asmāt‌ pacādyac‌| kalayatīti kalaḥ, kalaṃ hantīti `anyeṣvapi dṛsyate' (3.2.101) iti ḍaḥ| tena kalahaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `atra kecit‌' ityādi| tarhyartha iti svarūpagrahaṇam‌, evaṃ satyūnaśabde'pi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ prasajyet‌, tataśca tadarthānāmanyeṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌? ityata āha--`unaśabdenaiva' ityādi| ūnaśabdo'nyamatānāṃ viśeṣaṃ darśayati| anye hi--arthagrahaṇe nānarthakānāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti manyante| kecittu-ūnaśabdenaivārthanirdeśārthenārthanirdeśaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśe svarūpagrahaṇaṃ [svarūpaṃ grahaṇam‌--iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] bhavatītyuktam‌| iha cona ityarthapradhānanirdeśaḥ| tenonaśabdo'rthanirdeśārthaḥ' ityāhuḥ| tasmāt‌ tatraiva tadarthānāṃ grahaṇam‌| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādūnaśabdenaivārthanirdeśārthana tadarthānāṃ grahaṇam‌, tasmādatra kecidartha iti svarūpagrahaṇamicchanti| `dhānyārthaḥ' iti| `tṛtīyā tatkṛtārthena' (2.1.30) iti samāsaḥ| `dhane dhānye' (dhā.pā.1104), asmāṇṇyat‌| dhānyamantasvaritam‌| atha dhāne sādhu dhānyam‌, `prāgdhitādyat‌' (4.4.75) tena `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) iti dhānyamādyudāttam‌| atrārthaśabdaḥ `prāmādīnāñca' (phi.sū.2.38) ityādyudāttaḥ| tṛtīyāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌? anūnam‌, akalaha ityatra mā bhūditi cet‌? naitadasti;iha hi pratipadoktaparibhāṣayo(vyā.pa.3)nārthakalahādīnāṃ pratipadokto yaḥ samāsaḥ sa eva parigṛhyate| tat‌ kimanūmakalaha ityetannivṛtyarthena tṛtīyāgrahaṇena? ityata āha--`pratipadoktam‌' ityādi| gatārtham‌| 154. miśraṃ cānupasargamasandhau| (6.2.154) `guḍamiśrāḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ `pūrvasadṛśa' (2.1.31) ityādinā samāsaḥ| guḍaśabdaḥ `igupadha' (3.1.135) iti `guḍa rakṣāyām‌' (dā.pā.1370) ityasmāt‌ kaḥ, tenāntodāttaḥ| `sphāyitañci' (da.u.8.31) ityādinā ragvidhīyamāno bahulavacanān‌ miśerapi ragbhavati, tena mitraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| tilaśabdaḥ `tṛṇadhānyānāñca dvyaṣām‌' (phi.sū.2.27) ityādyudāttaḥ| pramiśram‌, sanmiśramityasya prāpnoti, atastannivṛttaye'nupasargagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`iha' ityādi| atha vā--miśraśabdena tṛtīyāsamāsa ucyamānaḥ kathaṃ sopasarge labhyate? ityāha--`iha' ityādi| yadi tadihānupasargagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tarhyanyatra miśraśabdagrahaṇe sopasargasya grahaṇaṃ nāstītīhānupasargagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `tena' ityādi| jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `brāhmaṇamiśro rājā' iti| `pūrvasadṛśa'(2.1.31) ityādinaiva samāsaḥ| `brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saṃhitaḥ' ityanena pratyudāharaṇe sandhiṃ darśayati| `aikārthamāpannaḥ' iti| anantaroktamevārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| ekaḥ-abhinno'rtho yasya sa ekārthaḥ, tadbhāva aikārthyam‌| tadāpannaḥ prāpta ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--sandhiśabdasyāyamarthaḥ? ityāha--`sandhiḥ' ityādi| paṇabandhaḥ-paribhāṣaṇam‌--yadi me bhavānidaṃ kuryāt‌ tato'hamapi bhavata idaṃ kariṣyāmītyevañjātīyakam‌| tena paṇabandhena yadaikārthyaṃ tat‌ sandhirucyate| tasmāt‌ pratyudāharaṇe sandhau sati brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saṃhita aikārthyamāpannaḥ--ityeṣo'rtho vijñāyate| `kecit‌ punarāhuḥ' ityādi| gṛhyamāṇo viśeṣo yasyāṃ pratyāsattau sā gṛhyamaṇaviśeṣā sandhiriti kecidevamāhuḥ, tatraiva syāt‌| evaṃvidhaḥ sandhiḥ pratyudāharaṇe nāstītyata āha--`atra rājño brāhmaṇau saha' ityādi| yadyapi rājñā brāhmaṇaiḥ saha pratyāsattiḥ-deśasāmīpyamasti, tadhāpi satyāmapi tasyāṃ mūrtivibhāgo mūrtiviśeṣo rājño brāhmaṇānāñca gṛhyata ityeva| itikaraṇo hetau| yata evam‌, tena brāhmaṇaiḥ saha miśro rājeti pratayudāhriyate| `udāhaṇeṣvavibhāgāpattireva' iti| etena gṛḍamiśrā ityādau tu sandherabhāvaṃ darśayati| yathā hi vilīnena miśrā dhānādayo bhavanti, tathāsya guḍāḥ, teṣāṃ ca mūrttivibhāgo na gṛhyate; na tatra sandheravibhāgāpattiriti| na vibhāgo'vibhāgaḥ, tasyāpattiḥ-prāptiḥ| yadā paṇabandhenaikārthyaṃ sandhistadodaharaṇeṣu tasyābhāvo veditavyaḥ sa hi paribhāṣaṇaviśeṣaṇalakṣaṇaḥ| na cāsau guḍamiśreṣu dhānāsvacetaneṣu vidyate; tasya prāṇidharmatvāt‌|| 155. naño guṇapratiṣedhe sampādyarhahitālamarthāstaddhitāḥ| (6.2.155) `sampādyādyarthāstaddhitāḥ' iti| taddhitapratyayāḥ| tasmāt‌ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (pu.pa.vṛ.44) tadantavidhirjñāyate| `guṇaprataṣedhe' iti| yasmin‌ vākyārthe taddhita utpadyate sa taddhitasya pravṛttinimittaṃ vidhīyate--yathoktam‌--`upakāri siddhamaṅgam‌, sādhyo'nupakārakastvaṅgī' iti| aṅgī, guṇa iti paryāyāvetau| guṇasya pratiṣedho guṇapratiṣedhaḥ| etacaca ऩño viśeṣaṇam‌, guṇapratiṣedhe cennañvartata ityarthaḥ| `kārṇaveṣṭakikam‌' iti| karṇaveṣṭakabhyāṃ śobhata ityarthaḥ| `sampādini' (5.1.99) iti `prāgvateṣṭhañ‌' (5.1.18), na karṇaveṣṭakikamakārṇaveṣṭakikamiti| atra karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ sampadyata iti vākyārthe taddhitāntasya pravṛttinimittaṃ yo guṇastasya pratiṣena nañvartate| tat‌ punaḥ pravṛttinimittvam‌| `chaidikaḥ' iti| chedamarhatīti `ārhādagopuccha' (5.1.19) ityādināṃ ṭhak‌| `vatsīyaḥ' iti| `prakkrītācchaḥ' (5.1.1)| `sāntāpikaḥ' iti| `tasmai prabhavati santāpādibhyaḥ' (5.1.101) iti `prāgvateṣṭhañ‌' (5.1.18)| `vigārdabharathikaḥ' iti| `tadarhati' (5.1.63) ityārhīyaṣṭhañ‌| viśabdena prādisamāsaḥ| viśabdo'yamiha gārdabharathika ityasya guṇapratiṣedhe vartate| atra `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara eva bhavati| evamuttaratrāpi| nañyasati, asmin‌ pratyudāharaṇe'pi yat‌ pūrvapadaṃ prakṛtisvaraḥ pratyudāhāryaḥ| `gārdabharathikadanyo'gārdabharathikaḥ' iti| atra gārdabharathikādanyatra nañvartate, na tu gārdabharathikatvasya pratiṣedhe; paryudāsatvādasya| `guṇa iti taddhitārthapravṛttinimittam‌' ityādi| taddhitārthaḥ--karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ sampādītyevamādivākyārthaḥ, tatra yat‌ pravṛttinimittaṃ taddhitāntasya śabdasya sampāditvādi tat‌ guṇa ityucyate| ādiśabdena tadarhatvādergrahaṇam‌| taddhitāntamalamarthañca parigrahyate| `tatpratiṣedhaḥ' ityādi| tasya pratiṣedho yatra samāsa ucyate tatrāyaṃ vidhiḥ| kathaṃ tasaya guṇasya pratiṣedha ucyate? ityāha--`karṇaveṣṭakābhyāṃ na sampādi mukham‌' iti| etena sarveṇa prasajyaparatiṣedhe'yaṃ vidhiḥ, na paryudāsa iti darśayannagārdabharathika ityatara pratyudāharaṇe'sya vidherabhāvaṃ darśayati| `pāṇinīyam‌' iti| `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114| `apāṇinīyaḥ' iti| atrādhyetaryarthe yastaddhitastadantamuttarapadam‌| na sampādyarhahitādyamalamarthā ye taddhitāstadantam‌| `voḍhā' iti| pūrvavad‌ dhatvaḍhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopā vidheyāḥ, `sahivahorodavarṇasya' (6.3.112) ityottvam‌| `avoḍhā' iti| atrāhārtho ya kṛdataḥ sa uttarapadam‌| tena taddhitagarahaṇādantodāttatvamuttarapadasya na bhavati| avyayapūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| pūrvapadaprakṛtasvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi yogā draṣṭavyāḥ| `prāgbahuvrīhāvidametat‌' (6.2.162) ityādiyogāt‌|| 156. yayatoścātadarthe| (6.2.156) `pāśyā' iti| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatvam‌| `adantyam‌' iti| `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) ityādyudāttatvam‌| evam‌--`akarṇyam‌' ityetadapi tadvadevādyudāttam‌| `pādyam‌' iti| `pādārdhābhyāñca' (5.4.25) iti yat‌| `dantyādanyadadanatyam‌' iti| atra dantyādanyatra nañ‌ vartate, na tu tadantasya pratiṣede| `adeyam‌' iti| `arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca' (3.3.169) ityatrārhārthe yat‌, `īdyati' (6.4.65) itīttvam‌| atheha kasmānna bhavati--vāmadevena dṛṣṭaṃ sāma vāmadevyam‌? ityata āha--`niranubandhaka' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 157. ackāvaśaktau| (6.2.157) `apacaḥ' iti| pacādyac‌| `avikṣipaḥ' iti| `igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' (3.1.135) `apaco'dīkṣitaḥ' ityādi| dīkṣitaparivrājakau śāstre pratiṣiddhatvānna pacataḥ; na tvaśaktatvāt‌| tenātra vrataṃ gampate, na tvaśaktiḥ|| 158. ākrośe ca| (6.2.158) atrākrośe doṣavacanamākrośaḥ| agamyamānāyāmapyaśaktau yathā syāditi vacanam‌|| 159. saṃjñāyām‌| (6.2.159) `adevadatto'pajñadattaḥ' iti| devadattayajñadattaśabdāvantodāttau| prātipadikasvareṇa| yo devadattaḥ san‌ tat‌ kārya na karoti sa evamākruśyate| evaṃ `aviṣṇumittraḥ' ityatrāpi veditavyam‌|| 160. kṛtyokeṣṇuccārvādayaśca| (6.2.160) kṛtya, uka, iṣṇujiti pratyayagrahaṇam‌| tatra pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (pu.pa.vṛ44) tadantopasthāpanaṃ bhavati| cārvādīni prātipadikānyeva| `akarttavyam‌' iti| yadā tavyadantastadā kartavyaśabdo'ntasvaritaḥ| yadā tavyāntastadā madhyodāttaḥ| `akaraṇīyam‌' iti| anīyar‌pratyayāntatvāt‌ `upottamaṃ riti' (6.1.217) iti ritsvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ karaṇīyaśabdaḥ| `anāgāmṛkam‌, anapalāṣukam‌' iti| `laṣapatapada' (3.2.154) ityādinokañ‌| āgāmukāpalāṣukaśabdau kṛtsvareṇa madhyodāttau| `analaṅkariṣṇuḥ' iti| `alaṃkṛñ‌' (3.2.136) ityādineṣṇuc‌| alaṅkariṣṇuśabdaścitsvareṇāntodāttaḥ| evaṃ `nirākariṣṇu' śabdo'pi| ekānubandhakagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā(vyā.pa.42)iṣṇujgrahaṇe dbyanubandhakasya khiṣṇuco grahaṇena na bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`iṣṇujgrahaṇe kartari bhuvaḥ' (3.2.57) khiṣṇujityasya dvyanubandhakasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| atraiva kāraṇamāha--`ikārādervidhānasāmarthyāt‌' iti| khiṣṇuca ikārādervidhānasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--iha sūtre sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌, anyathā tadapārthakaṃ syāt‌, udāttatvādbhavateḥ tataḥ parasya khiṣṇuca iṭaivekārāditvat‌| `acāruḥ' ityādi| `dṛsanijanicaribhyo ñuṇ‌' (da.u.1.88) [dṛsanijanicaricaṭirahibhyo ñuṇ‌--da.u; dṛ.u; dṝsanijanicaricaṭibhyo ñuṇ‌--paṃu.] tenādyudāttaścāruśabdaḥ| sādyuśabdo'ntodātta; `kṛvāpā' (da.u.1.86) ityādinoṇpratyayāntatvāt‌| yudhā carati yaudhikaḥ, `prāgvahateṣṭhak‌' (4.4.1) `kitaḥ' (6.1.165) ityantodāttaḥ| `anaṅgamejayaḥ' iti| avyayasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| atra dvitoye nañsamāse samāsāntodāttatvamiti nañsamāsaḥ syāt‌| `atrāpi' ityādi| kasmācchabdasya naña uttarasyādyudāttatvavidhānāt‌| atrāpi dvitīyena nañsamāsenāntodāttatvamiti| vartamāna, vardhamāna--ityedamādayaḥ śānajantatvādantodāttāḥ| vikārasadṛśaśabdaḥ samāsasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| gṛhapatikaśabdaḥ `saṃjñāyāṃ kan‌' (5.3.87) iti kannantatvādādyudāttaḥ| `vaderānyaḥ' (da.u.8.9), vadānyaśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ|| 161. vibhāṣā tṛnnannatīkṣṇaśuciṣu| (6.2.161) tṛnniti pratyayagrahaṇam‌, tena pūrvavat‌ tadantasyopasthānam‌| annādīni prātipadikāni| `akarttā' iti| tācchīlikastṛn‌| tena nitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ karttṛśabdaḥ| annaśabdo'pi `nabviṣayasya' (phi.sū.2.26) iti| `kṛtyasūbhyāṃ ksnaḥ' (da.u.5.49) iti `tijerdīrghaśca' (da.u.5.50) iti tīkṣṇaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `in‌' (da.u.1.46) iti varttamāne `igupadhātu kit‌' (da.u.1.48), tena śuciśabda ādyudāttaḥ|| 162. bahuvarīhāvidametattadbhyaḥ prathamapūraṇayoḥ kriyāgaṇane| (6.2.162) `prathamapūraṇayoḥ' iti| prathame svarūpagrahaṇam‌| pūraṇagrahaṇe pūraṇe'rthe ye pratyayā vihitāste gṛhyante, prathamasāhacaryāt‌| atha vā--pūraṇagrahaṇaṃ svaryyate, svaritena cādhikāragatirbhavati| tena `tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ‌'(5.2.48) ityadhikṛtya ye pratyayā vihitāsteṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati| `idamprathamaḥ' iti| prathamo'ntodāttaḥ| `pratheramat‌' (da.u.7.46) ityamacparatyayāntatvāt‌| idamādayastyadādiṣvantodāttā nipātyante; `idandvitīyaḥ idantṛtīyaḥ' iti| dvestīyaḥ' (5.2.54) `treḥ samprasāraṇaṃ ca' (5.2.55) iti tīyapratyayāntatvānmadhyodāttau dvitīya tṛtīyaśabdau| `anena prathama idaṃ prathamaḥ' iti| atra `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| `yatprathamaḥ' iti| yat‌ prathamameṣāmiti bahuvrīhriḥ| atra `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhavati| evamuttareṣvapyasmin‌ bahuvrīhyadhikāre pratyudāharaṇeṣu veditavyam‌| `idaṃ pradhānā ityarthaḥ' iti| etenāntarokte pratyudāharaṇe prathamaśabdaḥ pradhānavacanaḥ, na tvekasaṃkhyāvacana iti darśayan‌ gaṇānābhāvaṃ darśayati| `uttarapadasya' ityādi| iha sūtre `prathamapūraṇayoḥ' iti tvanyavibhaktyoruttarapadanirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ, na bahuvrīhinirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| tenottarapadasyaiva kāryitvam‌, na bahuvrīheḥ| tataśca yadā kabutpadyate tadā `kapi pūrvam‌' (6.2.173) antodāttaṃ bhavati| kappratyayo hi [`kapratyayo hi'--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] samāsādhikāre vihitatvāt‌ samāsasyaivāntau bhavati, nottarapadasya| na hyuttarapadaṃ samāsaḥ, tena `kabuttarapadakrameṇa gṛhyate' ityuttarapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ kapo na bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvasya| `idamprathamakāḥ' iti| `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌| `bahuvrīhau parakṛtyā' (6.2.1) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarāpavādau yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi bahuvrīhyadhikāre'smin‌ yogā draṣṭavyāḥ|| 163. saṃkhyāyāḥ stanaḥ| (6.2.163) `dvistanā, trisatanā' iti| dvitriśabdau prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttau| `stanagadī devaśabde' (dhā.pā.1859,1860) curādiradantaḥ, tasmādghañ‌, tena stanaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `catuḥstanā' iti| `careruran‌' (da.u.8.78) ityuranpratayayāntatvāccatuḥśabda ādyudāttaḥ| darśanīyaśabdo'nīyar‌pratyayāntaḥ `upīttamaṃ riti' (6.1.217) iti madhyodāttaḥ| `dviśirāḥ' iti| śiraḥśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttaḥ|| 164. vibhāṣā chandasi| (6.2.164) 165. saṃjñāyāṃ mittrājinayoḥ| (6.2.165) `devamittro brahmamittraḥ' iti| devabrahmaśabdāvuktasvarau| `amicimidiśasibhyaḥ ktraḥ' (da.u.8.86) iti mittraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `vṛkajinaḥ' iti| prakṛtivikārayorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvādvṛkavikāre vṛkaśabdo'tra vartate| vṛkamajinamasya vṛkājinaḥ| vṛkaśabdaḥ `prāṇināṃ kupūrvāṇām‌ (phi.sū.2.30) [`prāṇināṃ kupūrvam‌'--phi.sū.] ityādyudāttaḥ| `śyāstyāhveñavibhya inac‌' (da.u.5.12) ityadhikṛtya `ajeraja ca' (da.u.5.14) itīnajādeśaśca| tenājinamantodāttam‌| `kūlājinaḥ' iti| ku iti nipātaḥ, tasminnupapade `lā ādāne' (dhā.pā.1058) ityetasmāt‌ `anyeṣvapi dṛśyate' (3.2.101) ita ḍaḥ, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti pūrvapadasaya dīrghatvam‌| tena kūla ityantodāttaḥ| `kṛṣṇājinaḥ' iti| `iṇsiñjidīṅuṇyavibhyo nak‌'(da.u.5.35) ityadhikṛtya `kṛṣervarṇe' (da.u.5.37) iti nak‌| tena kṛṣṇo'ntodātta-| `priyamittraḥ' iti| prīṇātīti priyaḥ, `igupadha' (3.1.135) ityādinā kaḥ| tena priyo'ntodāttaḥ| `mahājinaḥ' iti| `narttamāne pṛṣadbṛhanmahajajagacchatṛvacca' (da.u.6.5) ita mahacchabdo'ntodātta|| 166.vyāvāyino'ntaram‌| (6.2.166.) 167.mukhaṃ svāṅgam‌| (6.2.167) `gauramukhaḥ' iti| `gurī udyamane' (dhā.pā.1396) etasmādac‌| tadantadapi prajñāderavṛtkaraṇāt‌ `parajñādibhyaśca' (5.4.38) ityaṇ‌, tena gauro'ntodāttaḥ| `udi dṛṇāterajalau [dṛṇāterajalau--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] pūrvapadāntyalopaśca' (paṃ.u.5.19) iti prakṛtya `ḍit‌ khanermuṭ‌ sa codāttaḥ' (paṃ.u.5.20) iti khanerajalāvityetau pratyayau bhavataḥ, tau ca ḍitau, muṭ‌ codāttaḥ| tena mukhaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `bhadaramukhaḥ' iti| `ṛjendra' (da.u.8.46) ityādisūtreṇa bhadraśabdo vyutpādyate| tena bhadra ityantodāttaḥ| `dīrghamukhā śalā' iti| mukhaśabdenātra dvārapradeśaḥ śālāyā ucyate| `svāṅgamadravalakṣaṇamiha gṛhyate' iti `adravaṃ mūrttimat‌ svāṅgam‌' (kā.vṛ.4.1.54) ityādi yatparibhāṣitaṃ svāṅgamadravādilakṣaṇaṃ tadiha gṛhyate| tena dīrghamukhā śāletyatra na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|| 168. nāvyayadikśabdagomahatsthūlamuṣṭhipṛthuvatsebhyaḥ| (6.2.168) pūrveṇa prāptasyāntodāttatvādayaṃ pratiṣedha ucyate| `uccairmukhaḥ' iti| uccairityete svarādau paṭhyante, te'ntodāttā iti nipātyante| `prāṅmukhaḥ' iti| prāṅityetat‌ kvinnantamādyudāttam‌, tatra `aniganto'ñcatau vapratyaye' (6.2.52) iti pūrvapadasaya prakṛtisvaraḥ| `pratyaṅamukhaḥ' iti| atra kṛduttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ| `gomukhaḥ mahāmukhaḥ' iti| gomahacchabdāvantodāttāvityuktam‌| `sthūlamukhaḥ' iti| `sthūla paribṛṃhaṇe' (dhā.pā.1904), curārdiḥ, tasmāt‌ pacādyac‌| tena sthūlaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `muṣṭimukhaḥ' iti| muṣeḥ ktic‌| tena muṣṭiśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `pṛthumukhaḥ' iti| `kurbhraśca' (paṃ.3.1.23) ityadhikṛtya prathimradibhrasjāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ `salopaśca' (paṃ.u.1.29) iti kupratyayaḥ| tena pṛthurantodāttaḥ| `vatsamukhaḥ' iti| `vṝtṝvadini' (da.u.9.21) ityādinā saḥ| tena vatso'ntodāttaḥ| `gomuṣṭi' ityādi| uttarasūtreṇa niṣṭhādipūrvapadasyopamānalakṣaṇo'pi yaḥ prāpnoti so'pyanena bādhyate| asya pratiṣedhasyāvakāśo yatra gavādyupamānaṃ na; gaurmukhamiva yasya, muṣṭirmukhamiva yasya, vatso mukhamiva yasyeti sarvatra gavādyupameyam‌, nopamānam‌| uttarasūtreṇa niṣṭhādipūrvapadasyopamānalakṣaṇasya vikalpasyāvakāśo yatra gavāderanyadupamānam‌--siṃhamukhaḥ, vyāghramukha iti| yatra gavādyupamānaṃ tad‌ yatra pūrvapadaṃ tatrobhayaprāptāvupamānalakṣaṇaṃ bādhitvā'yameva ptiṣedho pūrvapratiṣedhena|| 169. niṣṭhopamānādanyatarasyām‌| (6.1.169) `mukhaṃ svāṅgam‌' (6.2.167) iti nitye prāpte vikalpavacanametat‌| `yadaitaduttarapadāntodāttatvam‌' ityādi| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇādvikaspenaitaduttarapadāntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| tena yadaitanna bhavati tadā niṣṭhopasargapūrvapadasyānyatarasyām‌' (6.2.110) [niṣṭhopasargapūrvamanyatarasyām‌--pā.sū.] iti pakṣe pūrvapadāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati| tasyāpi vikalpena vidhānādyādāsyābhāvastadā `gatiranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti pūrvapadasya prakṛtibhāvavidhānādgatisvara eva| tenādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| yata evaṃ tatastrīṇyudāharaṇāni bhavanti--ekamanena sūtreṇottarapadasyāntodāttatvavidhānam‌, dvitīyaṃ `niṣṭhopasargapūrvādanyatarasyām‌' (6.2.110) [niṣṭhopasargapūrvamanyatarasyām‌--pā.sū.] ityādinā pūrvapadāntodāttatvavidhānam‌, tṛtayaṃ `gataranantaraḥ' (6.2.49) iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaravidhānam‌| `siṃhamukhaḥ' iti| siṃhaśabdaḥ pacādyajantatvādantodāttaḥ| `tṛhi hisi hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1455,1456), [`tṛha'--dhā.pā.] hinastīti siṃhaḥ--pṛṣodarāditvādvarṇavyatyayaḥ| `vyāghramukhaḥ' iti| `ghrā gandhopādāne' (dhā.pā.926) ityasmādvyāṅpūrvāt‌ `ātaścopasarge kaḥ', (3.1.136), tena vyāghraśabdo'pyantodātta eva|| 170. jātikālasukhādibhyo'nācchādanāt‌ kto'kṛtamitapratipannāḥ| (6.2.170) `śāṅgarajagdhaḥ' iti| guṇāteritervā `śami dhātoḥ saṃjñāyām‌' (3.2.14) ityac‌ śaṅgaraḥ, tato'pi prajñāderākṛtigaṇatvādaṇ‌| tena śāṅgaraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `palāṇḍubhakṣitaḥ' iti| `pala gatau' (dhā.pā.839) `uṇādayo bahulam‌' (3.3.1) ityāṇḍupratyayaḥ tena palāṇḍuśabdo madhyodāttaḥ| `surapītaḥ' iti| `susūdhāgudhibhyaḥ kran‌' (da.u.ya8.42) iti surāśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `māsajātaḥ' iti| `masī parimāṇe' (dhā.pā.1221) [`pariṇāme'dhā.pā.] asmādghañ‌, tena māsa ādyudāttaḥ| `saṃvatsarajātaḥ' iti| `aśeḥ saraḥ' (da.u.8.50) [`saran‌'--da.u.pa.u. (3.70)] ityadhikṛtya `vaseśca' (da.u.8.51) `sampūrvāccit‌' (da.u.8.52) iti| tena saṃvatsaro'ntodāttaḥ| `dvyahajātaḥ| tryahajātaḥ' iti| dvitriśabdāvantodātatāvityukatam‌| `sukhajātaḥ' iti| khanateḥ supūrvāt‌ `anyeṣvapi dṛśyate' (3.2.101) iti ḍaḥ| tena sukhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| evaṃ dṛḥkhaśabdo'pi veditavyaḥ| tena tṛpraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `kṛcchrajātaḥ' iti| `kṛtecchaḥ krū ca' (da.u.8.38,paṃ.u.2.21) [`kṛte cchak‌ ca--da.u. `kṛteśchakrū ca'--paṃ.u.] iti kṛcchraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `asu kṣeṇape' (dhā.pā.1209) asmād‌ `bahulamanyatrā'pi' (da.u.8.40) iti rak‌, tenāslamantodāttam‌| `vṝtṝvadahanikamikaṣibyaḥ saḥ' (da.u.9.21) [kaṣiyumucibhyaḥ--da.u.] iti bahulavacanādamerapi bhavati| aṃso vṛṣāditvādādyudāttaḥ| `alakam‌' iti| alateḥ `puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa' (3.3.118), tataḥ kanniti kannanto'plakaśabdaḥ| tenādyudāttaḥ| `kṝvṝdāribhya unan‌' (paṃ.u.3.53), tena karuṇaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `rañjeḥ kvun‌' (?) iti bahulavacanāt‌ kṛperapi bhavati| tena kṛpaṇamādyudāttam‌| `soḍhaḥ' iti ktāntam‌| tenaitadantodāttam‌| pūrvavadghatvaḍhatvādayaḥ karttavyāḥ| `pratīyam‌' iti| pratigatā āpo'sminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ṛkpūḥ' (5.4.74) ityādinā'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ, `dvyantarupasargebhyo'pi īt‌' (6.3.97) itīttvam‌| `putrajātaḥ' iti| atra bahuvrīhisvara eva bhavati| `amicimidiśasibhyaḥ ktraḥ' (da.u.8.86) `puvo hrasvaśca' (paṃ.3.4.164) tena putraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| kathaṃ punarjātaśabdasya paranipātaḥ, yāvatā `niṣṭhā' (2.2.36) iti pūrvanipātenātra bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`āhitāgnyāditvāt‌' ityādi| putrajātaśabdo'yamāhitāganyādiṣu ṣaṭhyate, tena `vā''hitāganyādiṣu' (2.2.37) iti jātādiśabdasaya paranipātaḥ| `vastracchannaḥ' iti| vastram‌-ācchādanam‌, ācchādyate'neneti kṛtvā| vastraśabda uktasvaraḥ| channaśabdaḥ `chada apavāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1833) ityasya ṇyantasya niṣṭhāyāṃ `vā dantaśānta' (7.2.27) ityādinā nipātitaḥ| `vasanacchannaḥ' iti| vaserācchādanārthāllyuṭ‌| tena vasanamādyudāttam‌| `kuṇḍalakṛtaḥ' iti| kuṇḍaśabdo'yaṃ `nabviṣayasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttaḥ| `kuṇḍamitaḥ' iti| `māṅ māne' (dhā.pā.1142), `dyatisyati' (7.4.40) ityādinettvam‌| atha kathameteṣu bahuvrīhiṣu `niṣṭhā' (2.2.36) ityanena niṣṭhāntasya parvanipāto na bhavati? ityāha--`eteṣu' ityādi| yasmādetat‌ kṛtam‌, tasmājjātyādibhyaḥ parasyāntodāttatvabidhānām‌| etasmādeva jñāpakānniṣṭhāntasya pūrvanipāto na bhavati; anyathā hyetadantodāttatvavidānaṃ nopapadyate|| 171. vā jāte| (6.2.171) jātaśabdo'pi ktānta iti tasyāpi jātyādibhyaḥ parasya pūrveṇa nityamantodāttatve vikalpo'yamucyate| `dantajātaḥ' iti| `hasimṛgriṇvamidami'(da.u.6.7) ityādinā tan‌--dantaḥ| tenāyamādyudāttaḥ| `stanajātaḥ' iti| stanaśabda uktasvaraḥ| 172. nañsubhyām‌| (6.2.172) `ayavo deśaḥ' ityādi| yavavrīhimāṣāḥ `tṛṇadhānyānāñca dvyaṣām‌' (phi.sū.2.27) ityādyudāttaḥ| `samāsasya' ityādi| iha samāsaḥ prakṛta uttarapadaṃ ca| tatra yadyuttarapadasyaitadantodāttatvaṃ syāt‌ anṛco bah‌vṛca ityatra `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' (5.4.74) ityādinākāre samāsānte kṛte tataḥ pūrvasya ṛkśabdasyottarapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ prasajyeta| samāsasya tvantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānamakārasyaiva bhavati; tasya samāsāvayavatvāt‌| samāsāvayavatvaṃ tu `samāsāntāḥ' (5.4.68) ityādhikṛtya vidhānāt‌| tasmāt‌ samāsāvayavasyaitadantodāttatvamiṣyate| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamupi labhyate? `kapi pūrvam‌' (6.2.173) ityatra pūrvagrahaṇāt‌| taddhi pūrvagrahaṇamanena samāssayāntodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ samāsāvayavasya kapa eva mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate| yadi tūbhayapadasyaitadantodāttatvaṃ syāt‌, tadāntareṇāpi kapipūrvagrahaṇaṃ kapipūrvasyottarapadasya sāt‌, na kapaḥ; na hi kabuttarapadasyāvayavaḥ, tataśca pūrvagrahaṇanarthakam‌| idaṃ tāvat‌--`samāsāntāḥpratyayāḥ samāsasyaivāvayavāḥ, nottarapadasya' ityetaddarśanamaṅgīkṛtyoktam‌| idānīṃ `uttarapadasyāpi te'vayavāḥ, ityetaddarśanamāśrityāha--`samāsāntāśca' ityādi| uttarapadaṃ ceti śeṣaḥ| etadantodāttatvamiṣyata iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| atha vā--uttarapadasyaivaitadantodāttatvamiṣyate| kutaḥ? samāsāntā uttarapadāvayavā bhavantītyato hetoḥ| tenānucaḥ bah‌vṛca ityatra kṛte samāsānte'ntodāttatvaṃ bhavati, taccottarapadasya bhavet‌| tasyaiva samāsāntasya bhavati, tasyottarapadāvayavatvāditi bhāvaḥ| sānte'ntodāttatvaṃ bhavati, taccotatarapadasaya bhavet‌| tasyaiva samāsāntasya bhavati, tasyottarapadāvayavatvāditi bhāvaḥ| yadi hi samāsāntā uttarapadāvayavā na syuḥ, tata uttarapadāvayavasyantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ samāsāntasya na syāt‌| uttarapadāvayavatve hi samāsāntānāṃ tasyaiva samāsāntasya bhavati| kathaṃ punaḥ samāsāntānāmuttarapadāvayavatvam‌? samāsārthāduttarapadāt‌ pūrvaṃ samāsāntaṃ vidhāya paścāt‌ tadantena samāsavidhānāt‌| tathā hi `na kapi' (7.4.14) ityatra vakṣyati "`gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) itayayamapi hrasavaḥ kapi na bhavati| samāsārthe hyuttarapade kapi kṛte paścāt‌ kabantena saha samāsena bhavitavyamamiti strīpratyayāntaṃ samāsaprātipadikaṃ na bhavati" iti| samāsāntapratyayāntena ca padena yadi samāsaḥ kriyate, tadā `tanmadhye patitāstadgrahaṇena gṛhyante' (vyā.pa.21) iti samāsāntaḥ pratyayaḥ uttarapadāvayavā bhavanti| yadyavam‌, samāsāvayavatvaṃ teṣāṃ nopapadyate? naitadasti; avayavāvayavo'pi hi samudāyāvayavo bhavati, tathā hi--`devadattāyāḥ sarve'vayavā alaṅkriyantām‌' ityukte devadattāvayakasya ye'vayavā aṅgulyādayasye'pyalaṅktiyante|| 173. kapi pūrvam‌| (6.2.173) pūrveṇa kapa evāntodāttatve prāpte kapi pūrvasyodāttatvamanena vidhīyate| `akumārīkaḥ' ityādi| `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌| kumārīśabda udāttanivṛttisvareṇāntodāttaḥ| vṛṣalīśabdo'pi jātilakṣaṇena ṅīṣā| brahmabandhūrapyūṅantatvāt‌ pratyayasvareṇa|| 174. hvasvānte'ntyātpūrvam‌| (6.2.174) `hrasvo'nto'sya' ityādi| anena hrasvānta ityasyaiva bahuvrīheranyapadārtha uttarapadaṃ samāso veti darśayati| `ayavako deśaḥ' iti| atra kapi parato yava ityetat‌ hrasvāntamuttarapadam‌, ayava ityayaṃ vā samāsaḥ| tatrāntyādvakārāt‌, pūrvamakṣaraṃ yakārākāra udātto bhavati| anayā diśānyatrāpari veditavyam‌| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kim‌, yāvatā `kapi pūrvam‌' (6.2.173) ityataḥ pūrvamiti vartata eva? ityata āha--`pūrvamiti vartamāne' ityādi| dvitīye hi pūrvagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe vākyabhedena pravṛttibhedo bhavati; pūrvagrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌, anyathā hi tadapārthakaṃ syāt‌| tatraikaya pravṛttyā hrasvante'ntyāt‌ pūrvamantodāttaṃ vithadhīyate| aparayā tu hrasvānte'ntyāt‌ pūrvamantodāttaṃ na bhavatīti niyamaḥ| tena kapi pūrvamantodāttaṃ na bhavati| `tena' ityādinā niyamo na syāt‌, tadātrāntyāt‌ pūrva udāttabhāvo nāstīti kapi pūrvamantodāttaṃ syāt‌| `kapi pūrvam‌' (6.2.173) ityanena niyame tu sati na bhavati| tena `nañsubhyām‌' (6.2.172) iti kabantasyaivāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati| yathā ca sa bhavati tathātraivopapāditam‌|| 175. bahornañvaduttarapadabhūmni| (6.2.175) `nañsubhyām‌' (6.2.172) ityādibhiryogairnaña uttarasya yat‌ svaravanidhānaṃ tadbahorapi yathā syādityevamarthamidam‌| naña iva nañvat‌| bahorbhāvo bhūmā, pṛthvāditvādimanic‌, `bahorlopo bhū ca bahoḥ' (6.4.158) iti bhūbhāvaḥ| uttarapadasya bhūmeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| athātideśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na `nañsubahubhya uttarapadabhūmni' ityevocyeta; na caivaṃ yoge kriyamāṇe nañsvorapyuttarapadabhūmnītyetadviśeṣaṇamāpādyate; sambhavāpekṣatvādasya, yathaiva hi' halṅyābbhyo dīrghāt‌' (6.1.68) ityatra dīrghagrahaṇaṃ sambhavāpekṣaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ ṅyāporeva bhavati na halaḥ; tathaitadapi bahoreva bhaviṣyati na nañsvoḥ, na hi tayoruttarapadārthabahutve bṛttiḥ sambhavatīti? evaṃ tarhi yadapi videśasthaṃ nañopalakṣitaṃ bahuvrīheḥ svaravidhānam‌, tadapyasmādatideśādyathā syādityevamartho'yamatideśaḥ kriyate| tena `naño jaramaramittramṛtāḥ' (6.2.116) ityuttarapadādyudāttatvamapi bahoratidiśyate| `bahumanāḥ' iti| atrottarapadabahutve bahuśabdo na vartate|| 176. na guṇādayo'vayavāḥ| (6.2.176) pūrvoṇātiprasakto'tideśa iti guṇādinā pratiṣidhyate--`bahuguṇā rajjuḥ' iti| bahvavayavā ityarthaḥ| `guṇa āmantraṇe' (dhā.pā.1894) curādiḥ, tasmādghañ‌| tena guṇaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `aśeḥ saraḥ' (da.u.8.50) [`saran‌'--da.u.(paṃ.u.-3.70)] ityanenākṣaraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| chando mīyate'neneti cchandomānam‌| kṛtsvareṇa chandomāne mānaśabda ādyudāttaḥ; tasya ghañantatvāt‌| śobhanamuktaṃ sūktam‌| prādisamāsaḥ| thāthādisvareṇa (6.2.144) sūktaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| adhīyate'smādityadhyāyaḥ| `iṅaśca' (3.3.21) iti ghañ‌| sūktavadadhyāyo'ntodāttaḥ|| 177. upasargāt‌ svāṅgaṃ dhruvamaparśu| (6.2.177) upasargāt‌ prādyupalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam‌| svaṅgaṃ prati kriyāyogābhāvāt‌| prādigrahaṇameva tu na kṛtaṃ vaicitryārtham‌| dhruvaśabdo'yamavayavepyasti, yathā `dhruvamapāye'pādānam‌' (1.4.24) iti, ekasvarūpepyasti, yathā dhruvamasya śīlamiti; tadihaikasvarūpe vartamāno gṛhyata iti darśayitumāha--`dhruvamityekarūpamucyate' ityādi| `satatam‌' ityādinā dhruvatvaṃ pṛṣṭhasya darśayati| pṛṣṭhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `pṛṣu mṛṣu vṛṣu secane' (dhā.pā.705.706,707) ityasya thaki vyutpāditatvāt‌| `darśanīyalalāṭaḥ' iti| darśanīyaśabdaḥ `upottamaṃ riti' (6.1.217) iti madhyodāttaḥ| `lala īpsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1687) ityasmāt‌ `uṇādayo bahulam‌' (3.3.1) ityāṭapratyayaḥ| tena lalāṭaśabdo madhyodāttaḥ| `praśākho vṛkṣaḥ' iti| `uṇādayo bahulam‌' (3.3.1) iti vacanāt‌ `śo tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1145) ityasmāt‌ khaḥ, ṭāp‌, savarṇadīrghatvam‌, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5)| tena śākhāśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| udbāhuḥ krarīśati' iti| atra bāhorekarūpatā nāstītyudhruvatvam‌| na hyasau nityamūrdhvabāhureva krīśati, api tu kadācidadho bāhurapi| `utparśuḥ' iti| `svṛśeḥ śvaṇśunau pṛ ca'(paṃ.u.5.27) [śvaṇ‌ śuno pṛ ca--mu.pāṭhaḥ] iti śunpratyayāntaḥ parśuḥ| tenāyamādyudāttaḥ|| 178. vanaṃ samāse| (6.2.178) `samāsamātre' iti| mātragrahaṇena bahuvrīhernivṛtti sūcayati| `pravaṇe' iti| yadāyaṃ bahuvrīhistadā prakṛṣṭaṃ prakṛtaṃ vā vanamasyeti vigrahaḥ| yadā tu tatpuruṣaḥ, tadā prakṛṣṭaṃ vanaṃ pragataṃ vā vanamiti vigrahaḥ| `nirvaṇe' iti| atrāpi yadā bahuvrīhiḥ, tadā nirgataṃ vanamasyeti vigrahaḥ| yadā tu tatpuruṣastadā niragato vanāditi tatpuruṣastu `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.28) iti| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadi samāsamātraparigrahārthaṃ samāsagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta? ityata āha--`bahuvrīhāveva hi syāt‌' iti| `rañjeḥ kyun‌'(da.u.5.24-paṃ.u.2.80)| [`rajeḥ'--da.u.] bahalavanāt‌ `vanu yācane' (dhā.pā.1470) ityasmādapi bhavati| tena vanamādyudāttam‌|| 179. antaḥ| (6.2.179) `antaḥ' iti svarādiṣvantodātto nipātyate| `antarvaṇo deśaḥ' iti| antarvanaṃ yasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ, `vane'ntaḥ' iti śauṇḍādipāṭhāt‌ (2.1.40) saptamīsamāso vā| `pranirantaraḥ' (8.4.5) ityādananā ṇatvam‌| `anupasargārtha ārambhaḥ' iti| upasargāt‌ pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌|| 180. antaśca| (6.2.180) antaḥśabdaḥ `hasimṛgriṇ‌vamidamilūpūdhurvibhyastan‌' (da.u.6.7) iti tanpratyayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ|| 181. na nivibhyām‌| (6.2.181) pūrveṇa nivibhyāmapyutatarasayāntodāttatve prāpte pratiṣedho'yamucyate| `pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratave kṛte' iti| yadā bahuvrīhistadā `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam‌' (6.2.1) iti prakṛtisvaratvam‌| yadā tu tatpuruṣastadā `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā|| 182. parerabhitobhāvi maṇjalam‌| (6.2.182) `parikūlam‌, paritīram‌' iti| kūlatīraśabdāvuktasvarau `kūlatīratūlamūla' (6.2.121) ityādau sūtre| `parimaṇḍalam‌' iti| paritaḥ-sarvato maṇaaḍalaṃ parimaṇḍalam‌| `maṇi bhūṣāyām‌' (dhā.pā.321)--asmāt‌ `kalastṛpaśca' (da.u.8.107) iti bāhulakāt‌ kalapratyayaḥ, `vṛṣādibhyaścit‌' (da.u.8.109) iti ca| tena maṇḍalamantodāttam‌| `bahuvrīhirayam‌' ityādi| yadā bahuvrīhistadā--paritaḥ kūlamasya, paritastīramasyeti tena maṇḍalamantodāttam‌| `bahuvrīhirayam‌' ityādi| yadā bahuvrīhistadā--paritaḥ kūlamasya, paritastīramasyeti vigrahaḥ| yadā tu prādisamāsastadā parigataṃ kūlam‌, parigataṃ tīramiti| yadā punaravyayībhāvastadā--pari kūlāt‌, pari tīrāditi| avyayībhāvastu `apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā' (2.1.12) ityanena| pari kūlāditi pañcamī `pañcamyapāṅaparibhiḥ' (2.3.10) iti karmapravacanīyayoge| karmapravacanīyatvaṃ tu pareḥ `apaparī varjane' (1.4.88) iti| yuktaṃ yadbahuvrīhau tatpuruṣe cedamantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate; tatra hi samāsāntodāttatvasyāpavādaḥ, pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prāpnoti| avyayībhāve tvayuktam‌; tatra hi samāsāntodāttatvenaiva siddham‌| na hi tasyāpavādaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ kenacit‌ prāpta ityata āha--`avyayībhāvapakṣe'pi hi' ityādi| yadāpyavyayībhāvapakṣaḥ, tadāpi `paripratyupapā' (6.2.33) ityādinā pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ prāptonenāntodāttatvavidhānena bādhyata iti kimatrāyuktam‌| `yaccaivaṃsvabhāvam‌' ityādi| abhito bhavanaṃ yasya svabhāvastadabhitobhāvigrahaṇena gṛhyate, na tu tadviparītasvabhāvam‌|| 183. prādasvāṅgaṃ saṃjñāyām‌| (6.2.183) `prakoṣṭham‌' iti| `uṣikuṣigārtibhyasthan‌' (da.u.6.29) iti kuṣesthan‌| tena kroṣṭhaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `pragṛham‌' iti| `gehi kaḥ' (3.1.144) iti kapratyayaḥ| tena gṛhamantodāttam‌| `pradvāram‌ iti| `nabviṣayasyānisantasya' (phi.sū.2.26) iti dvāramādyudāttam‌| `prapadam‌' iti| padaṃ dvāravadevādyaṭudāttam‌| `prahastam‌' iti| `hasimṛgriṇvamidami' (da.u.6.7) ityādinā hasestan‌| tena hastaśabda ādyudāttaḥ|| 184. nirudakādīni ca| (6.2.184) `nirudakam‌' iti| niṣkrāntamudakamasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ, niṣkrāntamudakāditi vā prādisamāsaḥ| udakaṃ kāyatīti `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3), `udakasyodaḥ saṃjñāyām‌' (6.3.57) ityudabhāvaḥ| tenodakamantodāttam‌| `nirupalam‌' iti| `viṭapaviṣṭapaviśipolapāḥ' (da.u.7.12) ityupalaśabdo'ntodātto nipātyate| `nirupalamityanye' iti| upapūrvāllāteḥ `ātaścopasarge' (3.1.136) iti kaḥ| tenopalaśabdasthāthādi (6.2.144) svareṇādyudāttaḥ| `nirmakṣikam‌, nirmaśakamityadīnām‌' iti| maśakamakṣikāśabdā(vā)dyudāttāntodāttau| tatra hi `athādiḥ, prāk‌, śakaṭeḥ'(phi.sū.2.24), `atha dvitīyaḥ prādīṣāt‌' (phi.sū.3.50) [`dvitīyaṃ'--phi.sū.] iti vartate| `eṣām‌' ityādi| yadi prādisamāsastadā nirgatamudakaṃ nirgataṃ vodakāditi vigrahaḥ| yadā tu bahuvrīhistadā nirgatamudakamasmāditi| athāvyayībhāvo'pyeṣāṃ kasyānna bhavati? ityāha--`avyayī bhāve tu' ityādi| bahuvrīhiprādisamāsayostu samāsāntodāttatvena na sidhyati| tathā hi--`bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam‌' (6.2.1) iti samāsasvarāpavādaḥ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bahuvrīhāvuktaḥ| prādisamāse'pi `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā| `niṣkālakaḥ' iti| kālaśabdaḥ kanpratyayāntatvādādyudāttaḥ| `niṣkālikaḥ' iti| niṣkrāntaḥ kālikāyā iti prādisamāsaḥ| kālīti jānapadādisūtreṇa (4.1.42) [`dvitīyaṃ'--phi.sū.] ṅīṣāntatvādantodāttaḥ, tataḥ svārthike kani kṛte'pyādyudātta eva bhavati| `niṣpeṣaḥ' iti| `viṣlṛ sañcūrṇane' (dhā.pā.1452) asmādghañ‌| tena peṣaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `tarīṃ pāti' iti| `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) iti tarīpaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| kutsitastarīpa iti kutsitagrahaṇena dustarīpaśabde duḥśabdaḥ kutsāyāṃ vartata iti darśayati| `nistarīpa iti kecit‌' iti| te ca nirgatastarīpa iti vigṛhya prādisamāsaṃ kurvanti| `apare nistarīka iti' iti| paṭhantīti sambandhaḥ| `nirajinam‌' ityādi| `ajinamantodāttam‌' ityuktam‌| `pareḥ' ityādi| hastapādakeśāḥ `svāṅgaśiṭāmadantānām‌' (phi.sū.2.29) ityādyudāttāḥ| śiṭām‌-sarvanāmnāmityarthaḥ| karṣaśabdaḥ `karṣātvato ghaño'nta udāttaḥ' (6.1.159) ityantodāttaḥ|| 185. abhermukham‌| (6.2.185) `abhimukhaḥ' iti| mukhaśabda uktasvaraḥ| abhiśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `bahuvrīhirayam‌' ityādi| yadā bahuvrīhistadā--abhigataṃ mukhamaneneti vigrahaḥ| yadā tu prādisamāsastadā abhigato mukham‌, abhigato vā mukheneti| kasmādayamavyayībhāvo na bhavati? ityāha--`avyayībāve tu' ityādi| `vacanamidamabahuvrīhyartham‌' iti| yadā mukhaṃ dhruvaṃ bhavati tadā'dhruvārtham‌, asvāṅgārtha ceti| adhruvamasvāṅgañca mukhaṃ bahuvrīhāvapi yadā bhavati| `abhimukhā śālā' iti| abhigataṃ mukhaṃ yasyā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| atra `upasargāt‌ svāṅgam‌' (6.2.177) iti na sidhyati; mukhaśabdasyāsvāṅgavācitvāt‌|| 186. apācc| (6.2.186) `avyayībhāvo'pyatra prayojayati' iti| na kevalaṃ bahuvrīhitatpuruṣāvityapiśabdārthaḥ| tatra yadā bahuvrīhistadā--apagataṃ mukhamasmāditi vigrahaḥ| yadā tu prādisamāsastadā apagataṃ mukhamiti| yadā punaravyayībhāvastadā--apamukhāditi, mukhaṃ varjayitvetyarthaḥ| avyayībhāvastu `apaparibahirañcavaḥ vañcamyā' (2.1.12) ityanena| kathaṃ punaravyayībhāvaḥ prayojayati, yāvatā samāsāntodāttatvenaiva siddham‌? ityāha--`tatrāpi hi' ityādi| prakṛtisvaratvamityatrādhyāhāryam‌| tatrāpyavyayībhāva `paripratyupāpā' (6.2.33) ityādinā pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvaratvamuktaṃ samāsasvarāpavādaḥ| tasmādavyayībhāvo'pi prayojayati| `yogavibāga uttarārthaḥ' iti| `uttarasūtre'pādityasyaivānuvṛttiryathā syāt‌, abhermā bhūt‌| avyayapūrvādapi prakṛtisvarāpavādo yogaḥ| evamuttare'pi yogāḥ `dvitribhyāṃ paddanmūrdhasu bahuvrīhau' (6.2.197) ityato yogāt‌ prāgveditavyāḥ|| 187. sphigapūtavīṇāñjo'dhvakukṣisīranāma nāma ca| (6.2.187) sphigadīnāṃ nāmaparyantānāṃ samāhāre dvandvaḥ| `sīranāmāni ca' iti| halādīni| `apasphigam‌, apapūtam‌' iti| prādisamāsaḥ, bahuvrīhirvā| sphigapūtaśabdau `svāṅgaśiṭāmadantānām‌' (phi.sū.2.29) ityādyudāttau| kecittu sphigaśabdaṃ dhṛtāditvā(phi.sū.1.21)dantodāttamicchanti| `rāsnāsāsnāsthūṇāvīṇāḥ' (da.u.5.47) iti vīṇāśabda ādyudātto nipātyate| `añjū' ityetadasmādasun‌| tenañja ādyudāttaḥ| `śīṅkruśiruhijikṣisṛdhṛbhyaḥ kvanip‌' [kvan‌--iti mu. pāṭhaḥ,] ityadhikṛtya `aderdhaca' [aderdhaśca--da.u.] ityadhvā| tenāyamādyudāttaḥ| `upasargādadhvanaḥ' ityādi| `acpratyanvavapūrvāt‌ sāmalobhnaḥ' (5.4.75) ityato'jhaṇe'nuvartamāne `upasargādadhvanaḥ' (5.4.85) ityanenāc‌ samāsānto vidhīyate| tena tasmin‌ samāsānte'cpratyayasya cittvādeva siddhamantodāttatvam‌| nanu ca nityaḥ samāsāntaḥ, tat‌ kimucyate--yadā samāsānto nāstīti? ata āha--`anityaśca' ityādi| yadi nityaḥ samāsāntaḥ syādadhvagrahaṇamiha na kṛtaṃ syāt‌; acpratyayasya cittvādevāntodāttasya siddhatvāt‌; kṛtaṃ ca, tasmādetadeva jñāpayati--`samāsāntavidhiranityaḥ' iti| tena `tatropāsitalokabharttari' ityevamādayaḥ prayogā upapannā bhavanti| `pluṣikuṣiśuṣibhyaḥ ksiḥ' (da.u.1.11) [`pluṣiśuṣikuṣibhyaḥ ksiḥ'--da.u.] 189. anorapradhānakanīyasī| (6.2.189) `anujyeṣṭhaḥ' iti| `vṛddhasya ca' (5.3.62) itīṣṭhani parato vṛddhasya jjyādeśaḥ| jeṣṭhaśabdo nitsavareṇāṇādyudāttaḥ| `anumadhyamaḥ' iti| `madhyānmaḥ' (4.3.8) iti madhyamaḥ, pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| `pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ prādisamaso'm‌' iti| atra hi yo'sau jyeṣṭhamanugato madhyamañca sa prādhānyena prādisamāsenocyate, jyeṣṭhamadhyamau tu guṇabhāvena| tasmāt‌ pūrvapadārthapradhāno'yam‌| `anukanīyān‌' iti| īyasuni parato yuvaśabdasya `yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām‌' (5.3.64) iti kanādeśaḥ| kanīyaśabdo nitsvareṇādyudātta-| `anugato jyeṣṭho'nujyeṣṭhaḥ' ti| uttarapadārthapradhāno'yam‌| tena pradhānavācitvaṃ jyeṣṭhaśabdasyāsti|| 190. puruṣaścānvādiṣṭaḥ| (6.2.190) `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dā.pā.1489)--asmāt‌ `puraḥ kuṣan‌' (da.u.9.14) iti kuṣanpratyayaḥ. tena puruṣaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `anvādiṣṭo'nvācitaḥ' iti| apradhānaśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ| yathā bhikṣāmaṭa gāñyānayetyatra gorānayanam‌, yathā vā--`karttuḥ kyaṅ‌ salopaśca' (3.1.11) ityatra salopaḥ. `kathitānukathito vā' iti| yaḥ kathitāt‌ paścāt‌ kathitaḥ sa kathitānukathitaḥ| yo vā kiñcit‌ pāk‌ kathayitvā paścāt kathyate kathyate sa kathitānukathita ityucyate| `anugataḥ puruṣo'nupuruṣaḥ' iti| yaḥ paścādbhavaḥ puruṣa sa evamucyate|| 191. aterakṛtpade| (6.2.191) `akṛtpade' iti| akṛcca padaṃ cākṛtpade--prathamādvivacanāntametat‌| `atyaṅkuśo nāgaḥ' iti| aṅkuśaśabdaḥ `sānasiparṇasi' (da.u.10.17) [sānasidharṇasiparṇasi--da.u. sānāsivarṇasiparṇasi--paṃ.u.paṃ.u.4.107) ityādinā `aki lakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1024) asmāt‌ pacādyac‌, ṭāp‌, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5)| tena kaśāntodāttā| `atipadā śakvarī' iti| `khano gha ca' (3.3.125) iti paderghaḥ| ghitkaraṇena hi jñāpitam‌--tatra gho'nyasmādapi bhavatīti| tena padamantodāttam‌| `atikārakaḥ' iti| karoterṇvul‌| atra `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadasyāvyayasvaro bhavati| `aterdhātulopaḥ' iti| yatra dhātorlopastatrāteruttarapadamantodāttaṃ bhavatīti vaktavyam‌| kimartham‌? ityāha--`iha' ityādi| yadyaterdhātulopa iti nocyeta, tadihāpi syāt‌--śobhano gārgyo'tigārgya iti| bhavati hyatrāteruttarapadamakṛdantam‌| iha ca na syāt‌--atikrāntaḥ kārakādatikāraka iti| `nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā' (vā.94) iti prādisamāsaḥ| atra hi kṛdantaḥ kārakaśabdaḥ uttarapadam‌| tatra yadyaterdhātulopa ti nocyate tadihāpi na syāt‌| evaṃ tūcyamāna ihāpi bhavati, asti hyatra kramerdhātorlopaḥ| lopaḥ punastasya samāse gamyamānārthatvādapratyujyamānasyādarśanam‌|| 192. neranidhāne| (6.2.192) `nidhānamaprakāśatā' iti| na nidhānamanidhānam‌| `nirmūlam‌, nyakṣam‌' iti| `mūla pratiṣṭhāyām‌' (dhā.pā.529)-asmāt‌ pacādyac‌| tasmānmūlaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `vṝtṝvadihani kamikaṣibhyaḥ saḥ' (da.u.9.21) [kamikaṣiyumucibhyaḥ--da.u.] ityadhikṛtya `aśerdevane' (da.u.9.24) iti sapratyayāntatvādakṣaśabdo'pyantodāttaḥ| `nitṝṇam‌' iti| `nabviṣayasya' (phi.sū.2.26) iti tṝṇamādyudāttam‌| `bahuvrīhirayam‌' ityādi| yadā bahuvrīhistadā--nigatāni mūlā nyasyeti vigrahaḥ| yadā prādisamāsastadā nigataṃ mūlamiti| avyayībhāvaḥ kasmādayaṃ na bhavati? ityāha--`avyayībhāve tu' ityādi| bahuvrīhau tu samāsāntodāttatvāpavādaḥ `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā' (6.2.1) ityādinā pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara uktaḥ| tatpuruṣe'pi `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā; tena tayorvinā'nena vacanenāntodāttatvaṃ na sidhyati| avyayībhāve tu samāsāntodāttatvenaiva sidadham‌, na hi tatra tasyāpavādaḥ uktaḥ| `nivāgvṛṣalaḥ; nidaṇḍaḥ' iti| atra pūrvapadasya prakṛtisvara eva bhavati| vākśabdaḥ `kvibvacipracchi' (da.u.10.2) ityādinā kvibanto vyutpādita ādyudāttaḥ| `damu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1203)--asmāt‌ `ñamantāṅṅaḥ' (da.u.5.7) iti| tena daṇḍaśabdo'pyantodāttaḥ| `niśabdo'tri nidhānārthaṃ bravīti' iti| aprakāśatāṃ bratītītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra niśabdo nidhānārthaṃ bravīti? ityāha--`prādayo hi' ityādi| vṛttiśabdeneha samāsavṛttyādirguhyate| prādayo hi svabhāvenaiva vṛttiviṣaye sasādhanāṃ kriyāmāhuḥ| tasmādiha samāsavṛttau viṣayeyāsāvaprakāśanātmikā kriyā nidhānaśabdavācyā vāksādhanā, daṇḍasādhanā ca tāṃ niśabdo bravīti|| 193. prateraṃśvādayastatpuruṣe| (6.2.193) pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarāpavādo yogaḥ| `pratyaṃśuḥ' iti| prādisamāsaḥ| `kurbhraśca' ityadhikṛtya `mugayvādayaśca' (da.u.1.121) ityaṃśuśabdo nipātitaḥ| tenāntodāttaḥ| janerghañ‌| tena jana ādyudāttaḥ| rājañśabdo'pi kaninpratyayāntatvāt‌| `rājaśabdaḥ' ityādi| `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac‌' (5.4.91) iti yadā'nityatvāṭṭaj‌ nāsti, tadā rājaśabda iha pāṭhe prayojayati| atha tasmin‌ samāsānte sati kasmānna prayojayati? ityāha--`tasmin‌ hi sati' ityādi| anityatvaṃ tu samāsāntavidheḥ pūrvameva jñāpitam‌| rājaśabdasya ceha pāṭhaḥ samāsāntavidheranityatvaṃ jñāpayati| `uṣa dāhe' (dhā.pā.696)--ityasmāt‌ ṣṭran‌| tena uṣṭraśabada ādyudāttaḥ `śiṭa santāpe' [`khiṭa trāse'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.302)--asmāṇvul‌| tena kheṭakaśabdo'pyādyudāttaḥ| `ajiraśiśira' (da.u.8.27) ityādinā kiracpratyayānto'jiraśabdo nipātitaḥ| tenāntodāttaḥ| `dro kutsāyāṃ gatau' (dhā.pā.1054)--asmādāṅpūrvāt‌ `ātaścopasarge' (3.3.106) ityaṅ‌ nipātanāt‌ pūrvapadasya rephāntatā| tataścāvyayarūpahānādasatyasmāt‌ pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratve ārdetyantodāttā bhavati| `śru śravaṇe' (dhā.pā.942) ityasmāllyuṭ‌| tena śravaṇaśabdo litsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| `vṛtestikan‌' (da.u.3.28) iti prakṛte `kṛtibhidilatibhyaḥ kit‌' (da.u.3.29) iti tikan‌, ṭāp‌| tena kṛttikāśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `ṛdha'--ityetasmādac‌, ghañ‌ vā| tenārdhaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ, ādyudātto vā| `pura agragamane' (dhā.pā.1346)--asmādigupadhalakṣaṇaḥ (3.1.135) kaḥ| tena puraśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `pratigatā aṃśavo'sya' ityādi| atra bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro bhavati|| 194. upāddvyajajinamagaurādayaḥ| (6.2.194) `upadevaḥ' iti| prādisamāso'yam‌| devaśabdaḥ pacādyajantatvādantodāttaḥ| `upasomaḥ' iti| atistusuhusṛ' (6.4.149) ityādinā man‌| tena somaśabda ādyudāttaḥ| `huḍṛ huḍṛ gatau' (dhā.pa.352,353) asmāt‌ pacādyac‌| tena hoḍaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| ajinamantodāttamityuktam‌, advyajarthaṃ cāsya grahaṇam‌| gauraśabdaḥ prajñadyaṇantatvādādyudāttaḥ| tiṣyeṇa yuktaḥ kālastaiṣaḥ, `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' (4.1.83)| `sūryatiṣya' (6.4.149) iti yalopaḥ| naiṣataiṭāvaṇantau| tenāntodātto| `raṭa paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.297)--asmādac‌| ralayorekatvādrephasya lakāraḥ| laṭaḥ| `luṭa viloḍane' (dhā.pā.314)--asmāt‌ pacādyac‌| tena laṭaloṭāvapyantodāttau| `śavayahvajihvāgrīvāpvāmīvāḥ' (da.u.8.128) iti jihvāntodāttā nipatyate| `iṇsiñji' (da.u.5.35) [iṇsiñ‌--da.u.paṃ.u. (3.2)] ityadhikṛtya `kṛṣervarṇe (da.u.5.37) iti kṛṣernak‌, ṭāp‌ savarṇadīrghatvam‌, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ (8.2.5)| tena kṛṣṇāśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `adhnyādayaśca' (da.u.8.14) iti kanyāśabdo'ntasvarito nipātyate| `guḍa ghanatve' [`guḍa rakṣāyām‌'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1370)--asmādigapadhalakṣaṇaḥ(3.1.135) kaḥ| tena guḍo'ntodāttaḥ| kalpavāhaśabdau vṛṣāditvādantodāttau|| 195. soravakṣepaṇe| (6.2.195) `susthaṇḍilaḥ' iti| sthānaṃ sthiramasminniti sthaṇḍilam‌| pṛṣodarāditvādādyudāttaḥ| `susphigābhyām‌' iti| sphigaśabdaḥ ādyudāttaḥ| `supratyavasitaḥ' iti| pratyavasitaśabdasthāthādi(6.2.144)svareṇāntodāttaḥ| nanu ca suśabdenāpi saha samāse kṛte thāthādisvareṇaivāntodāttatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kimarthamudāhṛtam‌? evaṃ manyate--satyanyārthe'syārambhe paratvādanenaivātrāpyantodāttatvaṃ yuktamiti| yadi suśabdo'tra pūjāyāmeva vartate, avakṣepaṇaṃ tarhi kasyārthaḥ? ityāha--`vākyārthastvavakṣepaṇam‌' iti| atraiva kāraṇamāha--`asūṇyā tathābhidhānāt‌' iti| iha khalvidānīṃ `assva susthaṇḍilaḥ' ityevamprakāraṃ vākyaṃ yasmādasūyayā prayujyate, tasmādvākyārthasyaivāvakṣepaṇam‌| `sutṛṇeṣu' iti| atra guṇodbhāvanecchayābhidhānam‌, nāsūyayā| tenāvakṣepaṇaṃ nāsti, pūjaiva tu vidyate|| 196. vibhāṣotpucche| (6.2.196) `utpucchaḥ' iti| pucchaśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttaḥ| `seyamubhayatra vibhāṣā bhavati' iti| yadotpucchaśabdo'cpratyayānto na bhavati tadā samāsāntodāttatvam‌| yadā samāsāntodāttatvāpavādaḥ `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadasyāvyayasya prakṛtisvaraḥ, tadā tenāprāptesminnantodāttatve vibhāṣeyam‌| yadā tu pucchamudasyatītyasyārthasya vivakṣāyāṃ `pucchabhāṇḍacīvarāṇṇiṅ‌' (3.1.20) ti ṇiṅaṃ vidāya tadantādutpucchayateḥ pacādyaci kṛte utpuccha ityetacchapabdarūpaṃ bhavati, tadā thāthādisvareṇa (6.2.144) nityamantodāttatve prāpte'yaṃ vikalpaḥ| tena prāpte vibhāṣeyam‌| `udastaṃ pucchamasyotpacchaḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiprakṛtisvara eva bhavati|| 197. dvitribhyāṃ pāddanmūrdhasu bahuvrīhau| (6.2.197) `dvitribhyām‌' iti| digyogalakṣaṇā(2.3.29)pañcamī| `pāddanmūrdhasu' iti| `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam‌' (2.3.37) iti bhāvalakṣaṇā saptamī| bahuvrīhīḥ kāryī| ata āha--`dvi tri ityetābhyām‌' ityādi| `dvipāt‌, tripāt‌' iti| `pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ' (5.4.138), `saṃkhyāsupūrvasya' (5.4.140) ityakāralopaḥ| pādaśabdo ghañantatvādādyudātta iti pācchabdaścādyudāttaḥ eva bhavati| `dvidan‌' iti| `vayasi dantasya' (5.4.141) iti datrādeśaḥ| dantaśabda ādyudātta ityuktam‌| tena datrādeśo'pi sthānivadbhāvenādyudātta eva bhavati| `dvimūrdhā' iti| mūrdhaśabdaḥ `śvannukṣanpūṣanplīhan‌' (da.u.6.55) ityādinā ran‌pratyayānto nipātyate| tenādyudāttaḥ| `mūrdhan‌' ityādi| `dvitribhyāṃ ṣa mūrdhnaḥ' (5.2.115) [`ṣo' iti mu. pāṭhaḥ] iti ṣaḥ samāsāntaḥ prāpnoti, sa na kṛtaḥ| tenātra nānta eva mūrdhaśabdaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamakṛtasamāsānta eva mūrdhañśabda upāttaḥ? ityāta āha--`tasya' ityādi| yadi kṛtasamāsānta upādīyeta tadā satyeva samāsānte'ntovāttatvaṃ syāt‌, asati na syāt‌| tasmādasatyapi samāsānte'ntodāttatvaṃ yathā syādityetat‌ prayojanamakṛtasamāsāntanirdeśasya| nanuca nityameva samāsantena bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kutastasyāsattvam‌? ityata āha--`etadeva' ityādi| yadidamasya prayojanasya sampādanārathamakṛtasamāsāntasya mūrdhan‌śabdasyopādanām‌, etadeva jñāpakam--anityaḥ samāsānto bhavatīti| tena dvimūrdhatyādiprayoga upapanno bhavati| yadi tarhyakṛtasamāsānta iha mūrdhan‌śabda upāttaḥ, evaṃ sati yadā samāsāntaḥ kriyate tadāntodāttena na bhavitavyam‌| kṛtasamāsāntasya śabdāntaratvādityata āha--`yadyapi' ityādi| iha hi bahuvrīhiḥ kāryī, tadekadeśitvaṃ ca samāsāntasya| ekadeśo'syāsatītyekadeśī, sa bahuvrīhirekadeśī yasaya samāsāntasya sa tadekadeśī, tadbhāvasatadekadeśitvam‌| etena bahuvrīhyavayavatvaṃ samāsāntasya darśayan‌ kṛtasamāsāntasya śabdāntaratvaṃ nirasyati| tadevaṃ yasmādiha bahuvrīhiḥ kāryī tadekadeśitvañca samāsāntasya, tasmādyadāpi samāsāntaḥ kriyate tadāpi pakṣe'ntodāttatvaṃ bhavatyeva| `kalyāṇamūrdhā' iti| kalyāṇaśabdaḥ `nabviṣayasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttaḥ| `dvayormūrdhā' iti| atra nityameva samāsāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 198. sakthaṃ cākrāntāt‌| (6.2.198) `sakthamiti' iti| `bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgāt‌ ṣac‌' (5.4.113) ityanena ṣac‌ samāsānto yasya sa sakyiśabdo'tra gṛhyate| `akrāntāt‌' iti| kraśabdo anto yasya saḥ krāntaḥ| na krānto'krāntaḥ| `gaurasakyaḥ' iti| gauraśabdaḥ prajñādyaṇantatvādantodāttaḥ| `ślakṣṇasakthaḥ' iti| `kṛtyaśūbhyāṃ ksnaḥ' (da.u.5.49) iti prakṛte `śliṣeraccopadhāyāḥ' (da.u.5.51) ksnapratyayāntaḥ ślakṣmaśabdaḥ| tenāntodāttaḥ| `cakrasakthaḥ' iti| `karoteḥ kin‌ dve ca' (da.u.8.103) [`karoterdve ca'--da.u.] iti cakraśabda ādyudāttaḥ|| 199. parādiśchandasi bahulam‌| (6.2.199) `paraśabdenātra sakthaśabda eva gahyate' iti| pratyasatteḥ, sa hi pūrvasūtre sannihitatvāt‌ pratyāsannaḥ| yadyevum‌, paraśabdagrahaṇamanarthakam‌, sakthaśabda eva hyatrānuvarttiṣyate? naitadasti; bahuvrīhigrahaṇapyatrānuvartata iti tasyāpyādyudāttatvamāśaṅkyeta| `añjisaktham‌' iti| añjiśabdaḥ prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ| athāpyañjaśabdāgmatvartha iniḥ kriyate, evamapyantodātta eva| `lomaśasaktham‌' iti| `lomādipāmādipicchādibhyaḥ śanelacaḥ' (5.2.100) iti śapratyayāntattvāllomaśaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `ṛjubāhuḥ' iti| `kurbhraśca' (da.u.1.107) ityadhikṛtya `arjidaśikamyamipaśibādhāmṛjipasitugdhugdīṃrghahakārāśca' (da.u.1.112) iti kupratyayāntau ṛjubāhuśabdau| tenāntodāttau| `vākpatiścitpattiḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāvetau| atrottarapadamādyudāttaṃ bhavati; bahulagrahaṇāt‌| vibhāṣāgrahaṇe hi prakṛte bahulagrahaṇena yat‌ sidhyati taddarśanārthamupanyastaḥ| `vyatyayo bahulaṃ tataḥ' iti| yata evaṃ bahulagrahaṇenānena kārya sidhyati, tena vyatyayo bahulaṃ bhavati| nanu ca pūrvameva svarāṇāṃ vyatyayo vihitaḥ? satyametat‌; tasyaiva tu prapañco'yam‌| `parādirudāhṛtaḥ' iti| vākpatiścitpattiriti| atra ca paragrahaṇenottarapadamuktam‌| `antodāttaprakaraṇe' iti| `antaḥ' `thāthaghañktājabitrakāṇām‌' (6.2.44) ityādau| `pūrvapadāntodāttaprakaraṇe' iti| `antaḥ' (6.2.92), `sarvaṃ guṇakārtsanye (6.2.93) ityādau| `pūrvapadādyudāttaprakaraṇe' iti| ādirudāttaḥ--`saptamīhāriṇau dhamya'haraṇe' (6.2.65) ityādau| `evamādi sarva saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavati' iti| bahulagrahaṇena| yatastena vibhāṣāgrahaṇe prakṛte bahulagrahaṇaṃ kṛtamityabhiprāyaḥ| tricakrādīnāṃ pūrvameva pūrvottarapadasvara ukta iti punariha nocyate|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ|| <6.3> atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. aluguttarapade| (6.3.1) `stokānmuktaḥ, alpānmuktaḥ' iti| `karaṇe stokālpakṛcachrakatipayasyāsatvavacanasya' (2.3.33) [`karaṇe ca'--pā.sū.] iti pañcamī, `stokāntikadurārthakṛcchrāṇi ktena' (2.1.39) iti samāsaḥ| nanu ca `vanaṃ samāse' (6.2.178) ityataḥ samāsagarahaṇamanuvartiṣyate, samāse ca niyataṃ sannihitamuttarapadam‌, ato'ntareṇāpyuttarapadagrahaṇamuttarapadaṃ labhyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha--`uttarapadamiti kim‌' iti| `niḥstokaḥ' iti| `nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā' (vā.94) iti prādisamāsaḥ| evaṃ manyate--asatyuttarapadagrahaṇe samāse ye stokādaya uttarapadabhūtāḥ pūrvapadabhūtā vā, tebhya uttarasyāḥ pañcabhyā alugbhavatītyetāvanmātraṃ labhyate, na tūttarapade parato ye stīkādaya ityeṣa viśeṣaḥ| tataśca niḥstoka ityatrāpyaluk‌ syāt‌| bhavati hyatrāpi samāsavartinaḥ stokādeḥ śabdāduttarā pañcamīti| nanvevamapi na karttavyemevottarapadagrahaṇam‌, lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā(vyā.pa.3) pratipadaṃ `stokādibhyaḥ karaṇe ca' (2.3.33) ityādisūtreṇa yā pañcamī vihitā, tasyā eva grahaṇam‌| natu `apādāne pañcamī' (2.3.28) ityanena sāmānyalakṣaṇena yā pañcamī vihitā, tasyā eva grahaṇam‌| na tu `apādāne pañcamī' (2.3.28) ityanena sāmānyalakṣaṇena yā pañcamī vihitā tsayāḥ| avaśyañca salakṣamapratipadoktaparibhāṣā'śrayitavyāḥ; anyathā hi stokādapetaḥ stokāpeta ityatrāpyaluk‌, syāt‌, evaṃ sati niḥstoka ityatrālukprāptireva nāsti, na hyatra stokaśabdāt‌ pratipadivihitā pañcamī, kiṃ tarhi? sāmānyalakṣaṇavihitā| tata kiṃ tannivṛttyarthenottarapadagarahaṇena? ityāha--`anyārtham‌' ityādi| ānaṅādyarthamidamuttarapadagarahaṇam‌| asati caitasmin‌ `ānaṅ ṛto dvandve' (6.3.25) ityānaṅ, `hotāpātṛbhyām‌' ityatra yathā pūrvapadasya bhavati, tathottarapadasyāpi syāt‌| tathā `ikohrasbo'ṅayo gālavasava' (6.3.61) iti hrasvo yatheha bhavati--`grāmaṇiputraḥ' iti, tathehāpi syāt‌--`grāmaṇīḥ' iti| nanu yadyanuttarapade'pi hlasvaḥ syāt‌, tadā `hrasvo yatheha bhavati--`grāmaṇiputraḥ' iti, tathehāpi syāt‌--`grāmaṇīḥ' iti| nanu yadyanuttarapade'pi hrasvaḥ syāt‌, tadā `hrasvo yatheha bhavati--`grāmaṇiputraḥ' iti, tathehāpi syāt‌--`grāmaṇīḥ' iti| nanu yadyanuttarapade'pi hlasvaḥ syāt‌, tadā `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' iti, tathehāpi syāt‌, `grāmaṇīḥ' iti| nanu yadyanuttarapade'pi hrasvaḥ syāt‌, tadā `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; anenaiva siddhatvāt‌? nānarthakam‌; anigantārthatvānnityārthatvācca| kiñca, asatyuttarapadagrahaṇe kṛtam‌| yadyevam‌, yadarthamidaṃ tadvidhāveva karttavyam‌, iha kimartha kriyate? ityāha--`ihāpyaluko nivṛttim‌' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| anyārthaṃ tāvadavaśyamidamuttaragrahaṇam‌| iha tu kriyamāṇe satyayaṃ viśeṣaḥ--niḥstoka ityatarāpyalug‌ nivṛttaḥ kriyate| tena lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā(vya.pa.3) nāśrayitavyā bhavati| atha kutaḥ prātimāvadhikārau? ityāha--`alugadhikāraḥ' ityādi| vidheyāntaraṃ vidheyāntarasya nivartakaṃ bhavatītyānaṅ‌ vidhīyamāna utatarapade'lukaṃ nivarttayati, tasmāt‌--`alagadhikāraḥ prāgānaṅaḥ'| uttarapadādhikāraḥ `prāgaṅgādhikārāt‌' iti| uttarapade parato yat‌ kāryaṃ vīdhīyate tasya sambandhiśabdatvāt‌ pūrvapadaṃ vidhibhāk‌| ato'ṅgaṃ vidhibhāktvena vijñāyamānamuttarapadādhikāraṃ nivartayati| aṅgasya hi yat‌ kāryaṃ tat‌ pratyaye parato vidhīyate, nottarapade| na hyuttarapade'ṅgasaṃjñā bhavati| atha vā--uttarapada iti saptamīnirdeśādanantara evottarapade bhavitavyamānaṅā| yadi cātra vibhakteraluk‌ syāt‌ tadā vyavadhānādānantarya na syāt‌| na ca vyavadhāne'pi vacanasāmarthyādānaṅsyāditi śakyate parikalpayitum‌| evaṃ hi `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti nirdiṣṭagrahaṇamānantaryārtha bādhyeta, aniṣṭaṃ ca rūpamāpadyeta| na cāniṣṭārthā śāstre praklṛpatiryuktā| tasmādalugadhikāraḥ prāgānaṅaḥ| aṅgasya pratyaye parato'bhāvāduttarapade paratastanna bhavatyeva, ata uttarapadādhikāraḥ prāgaṅgādhikārāt‌|| 2. pañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ| (6.3.2) stokādaya iti prātapadikagaṇeṣu na paṭhyante| tasmāt‌ sūtraparipaṭhitā eveha grahītavyā iti darśayannāha--`stokāntikadurārthakṛcchrāṇi' ityādi| atha `karaṇe' ca' (2.3.33) ityādau sūtre ye paripaṭhitāḥ stākādayaste kasmānna gṛhyante? evaṃ manyate--`ṅaseḥ stokādibhyaḥ' iti vaktavye `pañcamyāḥ' iti bahutarākṣaranirdeśenaitat‌ sūcitam‌--yeṣu stākādiṣu gṛhyamāṇeṣu bahutaralakṣyasaṃgraho bhavati te grahītavyāḥ' iti| stokāntikadūrārthakṛcchrāṇītyeteṣveva [`dūrārtha' iti nāsti mudrite nyāsapāṭhe] gṛhyamāṇeṣu bahutaralakṣyasaṃgraho bhavati, tatrārthagrahaṇāt‌; na tvitareṣu| tasmādeṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ nyāvyamiti| kathaṃ punaratra luk‌ prāpnoti, yasmin‌ prāpte pratiṣedho'yaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`samāse kṛte' ityādi| samāse kṛte sati tasya `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' (1.2.46) iti prātipadikatvam‌, ataḥ 'supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti supo luki prāpte pratiṣedho'yamucyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamekavacanāntānāṃ stokādīnāmalugudāhriyate, na dvivacanabahuvacanāntānām‌? ityāha--`dvivacanabahuvacanāntānām‌' ityādi| vṛttau hi viśeṣaṇapadānyekatvādikāṃ saṃkhyāṃ vihāyābhedaikatvasaṃkhyāṃ pratipadyante| sā punaḥ sakhyānamātramanupāttasaṃkhyāviśeṣaṃ sāmānyabhūtam‌; yata evamato vivakṣitārthānabhidhānādadvivacanabahuvacanāntanāṃ samāso na bhavatyeva| abhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā bhavantīti| `tena' ityādi| yata evaṃ dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ stokādīnāṃ samāso na bhavati, tena stokābhyāṃ muktaḥ, stokebhyo mukta ityatra na kadācidaikapadyamaikasvarya ca bhavati| stokābhyāmityasmāddhi padānmukta ityetat‌ padamanyadevātyantabhinnam‌, tathā stekebhya ityasmān‌ mukta ityetat‌| svaro'pyatrāneka eva| tathā hi--`stokābhyām‌' ityetat‌ prātipadikasvarema madhyodāttam‌, `muktaḥ' ityetat‌ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttam‌| evam‌ `stokebhyo muktaḥ' ityatrāpi nānāsvaratā veditavyā| mūlodāharaṇe tu samāse satyekapadyaṃ bhavati, svaro'pyeka eva| tathā hi--thāthādi(6.2.144)sūtreṇātrāntodāttatvam‌| yadi dvivacanabahuvacanāntānāṃ samāso na bhavatīha tarhi kathaṃ bhavati--goṣucaraḥ varṣāsuja iti? vivakṣitārthābhidhānāt‌| anabhidhānaṃ hyasamāse
