heturuktaḥ, iha tu vivakṣitārthasyārthasya bahuvacanasyābhidhānamastyeva| yatra hyabhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate, tatra saṃkhyāviśeṣasyābhidhānaṃ na bhavati, na cātrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate| tataśca vivakṣitārthābhidānādabhedaikatvasaṃkhyā nopapadyate| tathā hi--goṣucara ityatra gośabdo'psu vartate, sa cāpo'bhidadhāno bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭa evābhidadhāti, apśabdavat‌| varṣāsuja iti--varṣāśabdo'pi kālaviśeṣe bahutvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭa eva vartate| ataḥ prāpipadikenaiva bahutvasaṃkhyāyā āśritatvānnātrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate| yadi tu jāyeta, tadā bahutvasaṃkhyā nivarteta, tataśca gośabdasya varṣāśabdasya ca yaḥ prātipadikārto'bhipretaḥ sa iha na gamyeta| tasmānmābhūdgośabdavarṣāśabdayorabhipretasyārthasyānavagatiriti nātrābhedaikatvasaṃkhyopajāyate| tataśca vivakṣitārthābhidhānād goṣucaraḥ, varṣāsuja ityatra bhavatyeva samāsaḥ| `brāhyaṇācchaṃsina upasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam‌' iti| brāhmaṇācchaṃsīti yo'yaṃ śabdastasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratipādanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| kiṃ punaratra na sidhyati? pañcamīti| brāhmaṇaśabdenātrādhyayanaviśeṣa ucyate, taṃ śaṃsati-kathayati yaḥ saḥ brāhmaṇācchaṃsīti tācchiliko ṇiniḥ| atra brāhmaṇaśabdāt‌ `karmaṇi dvitīyā' (2.3.2) iti dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ pañcamyupasaṃkhyeyā| alukpunaḥ `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam‌' (6.3.14) ityeva siddhaḥ| yadā tu brāhmaṇādākṛṣyāvayavamarthaṃ vā śaṃsatīti vivakṣyate, tadā pañcamyapi nopasaṃkhyeyā| `apādāne pañcamī' (2.3.28) ityevameva tasyāḥ siddhatvāt‌| kathaṃ punaratrāsatā pañcamyarthena vyutpattiḥ kriyate? ityāha--`kratvigviśeṣa' ityādi| rūḍhiḥ-prasiddhiḥ, saṃjñeti yāvat‌| tasyā ityanena rūḍhimātraṃ pratyavamṛśyate, na tu brāhmaṇācchaṃsītyayaṃ rūḍhiśabdaḥ| rūḍhiśabdaḥ kasyācideva ṛtvigviśeṣasya vācakaḥ, tatraiva tasya saṃjñātvena praṇītatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ tasyāpyasatā satā vāvayavārthena vyutpattiḥ kriyate| tatra yadi brāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsatītyayamartho vivakṣyate, tadā pañcamyarthasyāpādānasyābhāvādasatāvayavārthena vyutpattiḥ kriyate| yadā tu brāhmaṇādavayabārthaṃ vā gṛhītvā śaṃsatītyayamartho vivakṣyate, tadā pañcamyarthasya bhāvāt‌ satā|| 3. ojaḥsahombhastamasastṛtīyāyāḥ| (6.3.3) ojasākṛtamityādau `kartṛkaraṇae kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) ityanena samāsaḥ| `añjasa upasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| añjasa uttarasyāstṛtīyāyā aluk‌ upasaṃkhyānam‌-pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--`ājñāyini ca' (6.3.5) ityatra cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāñjaḥśabdāduttarasyāstṛtīyāyā alugbhavatīti| anyadapi cātra pratpādanamuttaratra kariṣyāmaḥ| `puṃsānujaḥ' ityādi| puṃsānujo januṣāndha ityatrāpi tṛtīyāyā alukpratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ pūrvavat| puṃsā hetunānujaḥ puṃsānujaḥ| januṣā hetunā andhaḥ januṣāndhaḥ| `tṛtīyā' (2.1.30) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| januriti janmano nāmadheyametat‌|| 4. manasaḥ saṃjñāyām‌| (6.3.4) 5. ājñāyini ca| (6.3.5) `manasājñāyī' iti| tacchiliko ṇiniḥ, `āto yuk‌ ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yugāgamaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ|| 6. ātmanaśca pūraṇe| (6.3.6) pūraṇagarahaṇiha svaryate, svaritena cādhikārāvagatirbhavati| tena pūraṇagrahaṇadhikṛtya pūraṇagrahaṇamadhikṛtya pūraṇapratyayā vihitāsta eva pūraṇagrahaṇena gṛhyante, na tu svarūpam‌| `uttarapade' (6.3.1) ityanuvarttate ca, tataḥ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho.pa.sū.7) pūraṇapratyayānta uttarapade kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityālocyāha--`pūraṇapratyayānta uttarapade' ityādi| `pañcamaḥ' iti| pañcānāṃ pūraṇaḥ `tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ‌' (5.2.48) iti ḍaṭ‌, tasya `nāntādasaṃkhyādermaṭ‌' (5.2.49)| `ṣaṣṭhaḥ' iti| ṣaṇṇāṃ pūraṇa iti `ṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk‌' (5.2.51), ṣṭutvam‌| `ātmanāpañcamaḥ' ityādau kena tṛtīyā, na hyatra karaṇādistṛtīyārtho'sti, karaṇādi hi kārakam‌, kriyāyāśca kārakraṃ bhavati, na ceha kācit‌ kriyā vidyate? ityāha--`tṛtīyāvidhāne' ityādi| bhavatvevam‌, tṛtīyāsamāsāstu katham‌, na hyatra samāsalakṣaṇamasti? ityata āha--`tṛtīyāvidhāne' ityādi| bhavatvevam‌, tṛtīyāsamāsastu katham‌, na hyatra samāsalakṣaṇamasti? ityata āha--`tṛtīyeti ca' ityādi| atha vā--`kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā' (2.3.18) ityanenaivātra tṛtīyā, `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsa iti darśayannāha--`ātmanā vā' ityādi| atra kartara karaṇe vaiṣā tṛtīyā--kṛtaḥ pañcama iti| kṛte samāse kṛtaśabdo na prayajyate; tadarthasya vṛttāvantarbhāvāt‌| `katham‌' ityādi| atrāpyātmanā caturtha iti bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `bahuvrīhirayam‌' ityādi parihāraḥ| tatpuruṣe hyātmanācaturtha iti syāt‌, na cāyaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ| kiṃ tarhi? bahuvrīhiḥ| sa ca prathamāntayoreva padayoriti na bhavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu cānyapadārthe bahuvrīhirucyate, anyapadārthaśca vyatirikto bhavati| yathā citrā--gāvo yasya saḥ citraguriti, na ceha kaścidvyatirikto'nyapadārtho'sti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avyatirakto'pyanyapadārtho bhavati vayapadeśivadbhāvena| yathā--śobhanaśarīraḥ śilāputraka iti|| 7. vaiyākaraṇākhyāyāṃ caturthyāḥ| (6.3.7) `vaiyākaraṇānām‌' iti| vyākaraṇamadhīyate vidanti vā vaiyākaraṇā| kā punarvaiyākaraṇānāmākhyetyāha--`yayā' ityādi| athaivaṃ kasmānna vyākhyāyate--vyākaraṇe bhavā vaiyākaraṇī, `aṇugayanādibhyaḥ' (4.3.73) ityaṇ‌, vaiyākaraṇī cāsāvākhyā ceti vaiyākaraṇākhyā `puṃvat‌ karmadāraya' (6.3.42) ityādinā puṃvadbhavaḥ, tasyāṃ vaiyākaraṇākhyāyāmiti? aśakyamevaṃ vyākhyātum‌, iha hi na syāt‌--ātmanebhāṣaḥ, parasmaibhāṣa iti| vyākaraṇe hi kā bhāṣā? yā vyākaraṇe kṛtā| na caite kvacit‌ vyākaraṇe kṛte| pūrvatra vyākhyāne satīhāpi bhavati, ete api vaiyākaraṇānāmākhye, tathā hyābhyāmapi vaiyākaraṇā vyavaharantyeva| `ātmanepadam‌' iti| ātmārtha padam‌| tādarthye `caturthī' (2.1.36) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| nanu `caturthī tadartha' (2.1.36) ityevaṃ samāsaḥ siddhaḥ? na sidhyati; prakṛtivikārabhāve hi sa iṣyate|| 8. parasya ca| (6.3.8) 9. haladantātsaptamyāḥ saṃjñāyām‌| (6.3.9) `yudhiṣṭhiraḥ' iti| `saṃjñāyām‌' (2.1.44) iti samāsaḥ, `gaviyudhibhyāṃ sthiraḥ' (8.3.95) iti ṣatvam‌| atha gaviṣṭhira ityatra kathamaluk‌, na hi gośabdo halantaḥ, nāpyadantaḥ? syādetat‌--go-i-sthira iti sthite'ntaraṅgatvādavādeśe kṛte halantatvādbhaviṣyati, etacca nāsti; yataḥ `antaraṅgānapi vidhīn‌ vahiraṅgo lug‌ bādhate' (vyā.pa.128) iti, avaśyaṃ caitadabhyupeyam‌; anyathā hi nadyāṃ kukkuṭikā nadīkukkuṭika, bhūmyāṃ pāśo bhūmipāśa ityatrāpi yaṇādeśe kṛte'luk‌ prasajyeta? ityata āha--`gaviṣṭhira ityatra tu' ityādi| `hṛddyubhyām‌' iti| asaṃjñārthamidam‌| vaktavyamiti vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ cottaratra kariṣyate| atha vehāpi kriyate--ihāntagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌, vināpi tena sapatamyā prātipadike sannidhāpite haladantatā labhyata eva, tasamādadhikamihāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tadadhikaṃ kriyamāṇametat‌ sūcayati--adhikenāyamalugbhavatīti| tena kvacidasaṃjñāyāmalugbhavatīti| `hṛdispṛgdivispṛk‌' iti| `spṛśo'nudake kvin‌' (3.2.58) `kvinpratyasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) ti śakārasya khakāraḥ, tasya `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvam‌--gakāraḥ, tasyāpi `vā'vasāne' (8.4.56) iti cartvam‌--kakāraḥ| atra cāyamarthaḥ--hṛdayaṃ spṛśati, divaṃ spṛśatīti| tathā hi bhāṣye uktam‌--`dvitīyārthe saptamī caiṣā draṣṭavayā, hṛdayaṃ spṛśati, divaṃ spṛśatīti `hṛvispṛk‌, divispṛka' iti| kathaṃ punaḥ dvitīyārthe sā bhavati? ata eva bhāṣyakāravacanāt‌| atha vā--hṛdayaṃ yaḥ spṛśati sa hṛdaye spṛśatyeva, divaṃ yaḥ spṛśati sa divi spṛśatyeva atra `adhikaraṇe' (2.3.36) ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati saptamī| ākhyāgrahaṇe prakṛte punaḥ saṃjñāgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌|| 10. kāranāmni ca prācāṃ halādau| (6.3.10) vaṇigbhiḥ karṣakaiḥ paśupālaiśca rājñe deyo bhāgo rakṣānibandhanaḥ-kāraḥ, tasya nāma kāranāma| `kūpeśāṇam‌' ityādau `rsajñāyām‌' (2.1.44) iti samāsaḥ| `haledvipadikā' iti| dvau dvau pādau deyau dvipādikā, `pādaśatasya' (5.4.1) ityādinā vun‌, alontyalopaśca, `pādaḥ pat‌' (6.4.130) iti padādeśaḥ| `kāraviśeṣasya' ityādināsya sūtrasya niyamārthatāṃ darśayati| niyamavikalpāḥ--niyamaviśeṣā ityarthaḥ| `kāranāmni ca' ityādinā teṣāṃ niyamavikalapānāṃ svarūpaṃ darśayati| ete ca niyamavikalpāḥ kāranāmni, prācām, halādāvityeṣāṃ padānāmiha niyamavākya upādānālalabhyante| yadyādyo niyamo nābhipretaḥ syāt‌ tadā `kāranāmni' iti na brūyāt‌| evaṃ yadi dvitīyo niyamamo nābhipretaḥ syāt‌ tadā `prācām‌' ityevaṃ noktaṃ syāt‌| tathā yadi tṛtīyo niyamo nābhīṣṭaḥ syāt‌ `halādau' ityevaṃ noktaṃ syāt‌| atha kimarthaṃ nāmagrahaṇam‌, na pūrvayogāt‌ saṃjñāgrahaṇamanuvarttate? pūrvayoge saṃjñāyā upādheḥ prāyikatvasūcanārthaṃ nāmagrahaṇam‌| tena hṛdispṛk‌, divispṛgityatrāsaṃjñāyāmapyaluksiddho bhavati|| 11. madhyādra gurau| (6.3.11) `antācceti vaktavyam‌' iti| antaśabdāccottarasyāḥ saptamyā alugbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--pūrvayogāccakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccārthaḥ| tenāntaśabdādapyuttarasyāḥ saptamyā alugbhavatīti|| 12. amūrddhamastakāt‌ svāṅgādakāme| (6.3.12) svāṅgamadravādilakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ yat‌ tadiha gṛhyate| `kaṇṭhekālaḥ' iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `vyadhikaraṇānāmapi `bahuvrīhirbhavatyeva' iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `samānādhikaraṇa' (vā.97) ityetat‌ prāyakam‌| `akṣaśauṇḍaḥ' iti| `saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ' (2.1.40) iti samāsaḥ| `aṅgulitrāṇajaṅghāvalo' saptamītatpuruṣau|| 13. bandhe ca vibhāṣā| (6.3.13) `svāṅgāt‌' (6.3.12) iti nivṛttam‌, sāmānyena vidhiḥ| `bandhe' iti| badhnāteretadrūpam‌| `nentsiddhabadhnātiṣu ca' (6.3.19) ityanena tatpuruṣe badhnātau pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyanti| tatra viṣayavibhāgo na jñāyate--tatpuruṣe kva ca pratiṣedhaḥ? ityatastatparijñānārthamāha--`bandha iti dhañanto gṛhyate' iti| bandhanaṃ banadhaḥ, bhāve ghañ‌| anena dhañante badhnātau vibhāṣā| pratyayāntare tu pratiṣedha iti darśitaṃ bhavati| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--ghañanto'yamiti? ādyudāttatvāt‌| `hastebandhaḥ' iti| tatpuruṣaḥ, bahuvrīhirvā| `ubhayatra' iti| prāpte cāprāpte ca kathaṃ punarubhayatra vibhāṣeyam‌? ityāha--`svāṅgāddhi' ityādi|| 14. tatpuruṣe kṛtibahulam‌| (6.3.14) `stamberamaḥ, karṇejapaḥ' iti| `stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ' (3.2.13) ityac‌, `upapadamitaṅ' (2.2.19) iti tatpuruṣaḥ| `kurucaraḥ, madracaraḥ' iti| `careṣṭaḥ' (3.2.16) vibhāṣāyāṃ prakṛtāyāṃ bahulagrahaṇaṃ kvacitpravṛttyādīnāmarthānāṃ saṃgrahārtham‌| tenālukpravṛttiḥ kvacideva bhavati--`stamberamaḥ' ityādau| kvacidapravṛttireva--`kurucaraḥ' ityādau| kvacidubhayam‌--`sarajim‌, sarojam‌' ityādau| kvacidanyadeva--`brāhmaṇācchaṃsī' ityādau| saptamyā aluguktaḥ pañcamyā api bhavati| tathā kṛdanta uttarapade'luguktastaddhite'pi bhavati--apsu bhavo'psavya iti| digāditvādyat‌--`orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) iti guṇaḥ, `vānto yi pratya' (6.1.79) iti vāntādeśaḥ| tadevaṃ sarvatra bahulagrahaṇena siddhamiti `brāhmaṇācchaṃsina upasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.716) ityādi| yaduktam‌, yacca vakṣyate--`apoyoniyanmatuṣu saptamyā aluk‌' (vā.721) ityādi, tat‌ sarva na vaktavyaṃ bhavatīti| yadyevam‌ stokānmukta ityādapi sarvamanenaiva siddhamiti `pañcamyāḥ stākādibhyaḥ' (6.3.2) iti na vaktavyaṃ bhavati? satyametat‌; asyaiva prapañcārthaṃ tadveditavyam‌| evañca sati susaṃgṛhītaṃ lakṣyaṃ bhavati| tathā cāha--ta eva viṣayāḥ susaṃgṛhītā bhavanti yeṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prapañcaśca|| 15. pravṛṭśaratkāladivāṃ je| (6.3.15) `prāvṛṣijaḥ' iti| `saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ' (3.2.97), `ṭeḥ' (6.4.143) iti ṭilopaḥ, `apapadamatiṅa' (2.2.19) iti samāsaḥ|| 16. vibhāṣa varṣakṣaraśaravarāt‌| (6.3.16) 17. ghakālataneṣu kālanāmnaḥ| (6.3.17) `gha' iti tarapatamaporgahaṇam‌, `kāla' iti kālavācinaḥ śabdasya, `tana' iti ṭyuṭyuloranādeśasya satuṭkasya| `pūrvāhṇetarām‌' iti| ahnaḥ pūrvamiti vigṛhaya `pūrvāpara' (2.2.1) ityādinaikadeśisamāsaḥ| `rājāhaḥ--sakhibhyaṣṭac‌' (5.4.91) iti ṭac‌ samāsāntaḥ, `ahno'hana etebhyaḥ' (5.4.88) ityahnādeśaḥ| `ahno'dantāt‌' (8.4.7) iti ṇatvam‌| asmiṃśca pūrvāhṇe asmiṃśca pūrvāhṇe, asmistvanayoratiśayena pūrvāhṇe pūrvāhṇetara iti| `dvivacana' (5.3.57) ityādinā tarap‌| `pūrvāṅṇetamām‌' iti| `atiśāyane' (5.3.55) ityādinā tamap‌, `kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca' (1.2.46) iti prādipadikatve sati subluk‌ prāptaḥ pakṣe pratiṣidhyate| `pūrvāhṇetane' iti| `pūrvāhṇetare' ityatrārthe `vibhāṣā pūrvāhṇāparāhṇābhyām‌' (4.3.24) iti ṭyuṭyulau tuḍāgamaśca, `yuvoranākau (7.1.1) ityaṭanādeśaḥ| `rātritarāyām‌' iti| asyāñca rātrāvasyāñca rātrāvanayoratiśayena rātrāviti vigrahaḥ| nanu ca `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt‌ sa vihitastadādestadantasya' (pu.pa.vṛ.44) iti tadantagrahaṇaṃ bhavatīti ghasaṃjñakapratyayānte tanapratyayānte cottarapade parato'lugudāharttavayaḥ, tat‌ kasmāt‌ pratyayamātre sa udāhṛtaḥ? ityāha--`uttarapadādhikāre' ityādi| kutaḥ punaretadityāha--`lekhagrahaṇāt‌' ityādi| `hṛdayasya hṛllekhayadaṇlāseṣu' (6.4.50) ityatrāṇo lekhaśabdasya cāṇantasya bhedanopādanam‌| tatra yadyuttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantaravidhiriṣyate tadā lekhagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌; aṇgrahaṇenaiva tadgrahaṇasya siddhatvāt‌, kriyate ca| tasmāllekhagrahaṇādvijñāyate--`uttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirneṣyate' (pu.pa.26) iti| `tene' iti| tadantavidherihāniṣṭatvena| `kāla iti na svarūpagraham‌' iti| nāmagrahaṇāt‌| tasya hyetadeva prayojanam‌|| 18. śayavāsavāsiṣvakālāt‌| (6.3.18) `kheśayaḥ' iti| `adhikaraṇe śeteḥ' (3.2.15) ityac‌| `grāmevāsaḥ' iti| vasanaṃ vāsaḥ, bhāve ghañ‌| `grāmevāsī' iti| tācchīliko ṇiniḥ, vrate vā| `pūrvāhṇaśayaḥ' iti| nanu ca svarūpagrahaṇe sati kālaśaya iti pratyudāhāryam‌, naivedaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam‌| kiṃ tarhi? arthagrahaṇam‌| ata eva vṛttāvuktam‌--`akālavācinaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punararthagrahaṇaṃ labhyate? pūrvasūtrādiha nāmagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| yadyevam‌, tadā nārthaḥ kālagrahaṇena `kālanāmnaḥ' (6.3.17) ityetadanuvartiṣyate, tasya ca nañā saha sambandhaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ--kālanāmno neti, tatrāyamarthaḥ--`nensiddhabadhnātiṣu ca' (6.3.19) [`nensiddha' iti prācīnamudritapāṭhaḥ] ityatra neti vaktavyaṃ na bhavati, netyetadeva hyanuvarttiṣyate? naivaṃ śakyam‌; `na śayavāsavāsiṣi' ityucyamāne hyaluka evāyaṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyeta, tasyātra vidheyatayā prastutatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ kālasyaiva pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kālagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| vaktavyamiti vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvameva kṛtam‌|| 19. nontsiddhabadhnātiṣu ca| (6.3.19) [`nensiddha' iti prācīnamudritapāṭhaḥ] `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam‌' (6.3.14) iti prāptasyāluko'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `innanta uttarapade' iti| nanu ca `uttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhirnaṣyate' (pu.pa.26) iti jñāpitametat‌, tatkathamiha tadantamuttarapadaṃ gṛhyate? saptamyāḥ parasyenpratyayasyāsambhavāt‌| dvividha eva hīnpratyayaḥ--kṛt‌ taddhitaśca| tatra kṛddhātorevotpadyate iti na saptamyāḥ parasyenpratyayasyāsambhavāt‌| dvividha eva hīnpratyayaḥ--kṛt‌ taddhitaśca| tatra kṛddhātorevotpadyate iti na saptamyāḥ paraḥ sambhavati| taddhito'pi naiva kaścit‌ saptamīsamarthādutpadyata ityasāvapi naiva saptamyāḥ paraḥ sambhavati| tasmādinnantameva gṛhyata yuktamuktametat‌| `sthaṇḍilavarttī' iti| `vrate' (3.2.80) iti ṇiniḥ; `upapadamatiṅ' (2.2.19) iti samāsaḥ| `sāṅkāśyasiddhaḥ' iti| `siddhaśuṣka' (2.1.41) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `cakrabaddhaḥ' iti| baddhaśabdo niṣṭhāntaḥ, `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| bandhaśabdena `cakrabandhaḥ' iti| `siddha' (2.1.41) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `tat‌ pacādyacapratyayāntaṃ draṣṭavyam‌' iti| atha bandha ityetacchabdarūpaṃ ghañantaṃ kasmānna gṛhyate? ityāha `ghañante hi' ityādi|| 20. sthe ca bhāṣāyām‌| (6.3.20) ayamapi `tatpuruṣe' (6.3.14) ityādinā prāptasyālukaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| `samasthaḥ' iti| same tiṣṭhatīti kaḥ `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityakāralopaḥ| `kṛṣṇo'syākhareṣṭhaḥ' [`kṛṣṇo'syākhareṣṭhā' iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ `kṛṣṇo'syākhareṣṭhaḥ' kāśikā mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ--vārāṇasī. `kṛṣṇobhyāreṣṭhaḥ'--kāśikā--saṃ.pa.pāṭhaḥ] iti| `sthaḥ kaḥ ca' (3.2.77) iti kvippratyayaḥ|| 21. ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośe| (6.3.21) `caurasyakulam‌' iti| ākrośapratipādanaparametat‌, na tvanena tasya sambandho vivakṣitaḥ| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvameva kṛtam‌| `paśyatoharaḥ' iti| paśyata iti `ṣaṣṭhī cānādare' (2.3.38) iti ṣaṣṭhī| haratīti haraḥ pacādyac‌| `amuṣya' iti| adasastyadādyatvam‌, `adaso'serdādu do maḥ' (8.2.80) ityuttvamatve, uttvasyāsiddhavāt‌' ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ' (7.1.12) iti ṅasaḥ syādeśaḥ| tathā `amuṣyakuliketi' (iti)| yathā amuṣyaputriketyatra bhanojñāditvāt‌ (5.1.133) vuñ‌, tathātrāpītyarthaḥ| `devānāmpriyaḥ' iti| prīṇātīti priyaḥ, `igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' (3.1.135) iti kapratyayaḥ iyaṅādeśaḥ| `śunaḥśepaḥ' iti| `śvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' (6.4.133) iti samprasāraṇam‌|| 22. putre'nyatarasyām‌| (6.3.22) 23. ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ| (6.3.23) vidyā ca yoniśceti vidyāyonī, tatkṛtaḥ sambando yeṣāṃ te vidyāyonisambandhāḥ| kṛtaśabdasya vṛttāvaprayogaḥ; gamyamānārthatvāt‌, yathā--guḍadhānā ityatra miśraśabdasya| `ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyastatpūrvottarapadagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam‌' iti| tadityanena vidyāyonisambandhā ubhaye'pi nirdiśyante, teṣāṃ pūrvapadabūtānāmuttarapadabhūtānāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| gṛhyate yena tat‌ grahaṇam‌, yena te gṛhyante tādṛśaṃ vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| kiṃ punastadvyākhyānam? kimarthaṃ tatkarttavyam‌? ityāha--`vidyāyonivācinyeva' ityādi| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--ihoṅgitenonmiṣitena mahatā sūtraprabandhenācāryāṇāmabhiprāyā lakṣyante, `ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ' ityeṣa mahān‌ sūtraprabandhaḥ, yadi hyavidyāyonisambandhavācinyuttarapade'lugabhīṣṭaḥ syāt‌, evaṃ satyavidyāyonisambandhādityevaṃ brūyāt‌| atha vā--sambandhagrahaṇamapi na kuryāt‌, na hi kiñcidṛkārāntaṃ vidyāvāci yonivāci vā'sambandhamasti, tatrāntareṇāpi sambandhagrahaṇaṃ vidyāyonisambandhavācina iti vijñāsyate, tat‌ kiṃ sambandhagrahaṇena! tadetasmānmahataḥ sūtraprabandhādvidyāyonisambandhavācinyuttarapada ācāryasyāyamalugabhīṣṭa iti lakṣyata iti| `hotuḥ' iti| `ṛta ut‌' (6.1.111) ityuttvam‌, raparatvam‌, `rātsasya' (8.2.24) iti sakāralopaḥ|| 24. vibhāṣā svasṛpatyoḥ| (6.3.24) 25. ānaṅ ṛto dvandve| (6.3.25) `ṛkārāntānāṃ vidyāyonisambandhavācināṃ yo dvandvaḥ' ityādi| atha ṛkārāntasaya dvandva ānaṅ bhavatītyevaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum‌; ihāpi prasajyeta--pitṛpitāmahāviti| ṅakāro'ntyādeśārthaḥ| iha hi varṇānāmupadeśaḥ--kāryārthaḥ, śravaṇārtho veti, nakāraścāyaṃ na kvacit‌ śrūyate, sarvatraiva hyasya `nalopaḥ prātapadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti lopena bhavitavyam‌, nāpi kiñcit‌ kāryamasyopalabhyate, tat‌ kimarthaṃ nakārasyoccāraṇam‌? ityāha--`nakāroccāraṇam‌' ityādi| asati nakāra ṛkārasyā sthāne'ṇeva śiṣyate, tataśca `uraṇ‌ raparaḥ' (1.1.51) iti raparatvaṃ syāt‌| nakāre tu sati nāyamaṇeva śiṣyate, api tavaṇ‌ cānaṅ ceti na bhavati rapatvaprasaṅgaḥ| na hi yatrāṇ‌ anaṇ‌ ceti śiṣyate tatra raparatvaṃ bhavati| yathā `sudhāturakaṅ‌ ca' (4.1.97) iti saudhātakirityatra| tasmādatra raparatvanivṛttyartha nakāroccāraṇam‌| atha pitāputrau, mātāputrau ityatara kathamānaṅādeśaḥ, na hyatra ṛkārāntānāṃ dvandvaḥ? ityāha--`putra ityatrānuvarttate' iti| `putare'nyatarasyām‌' (6.3.22) ityataḥ putra ityetadatrānuvarttata ityabhiprāyaḥ| yadi tu putra ityanuvartate, tadā `vibhāṣā svasṛpatyoḥ' (6.3.24) ityatra putre'pi vibhāṣā prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena tadanuvarttate| ata evātretyuktaṃ tatraivānuvarttate, na parvatreti pratipādanārtham‌| nanvevamapi putraśabda uttarapade pūrpadamātrasyānaṅ prāpnati; kāryiṇehānirdeśāduttarapadaśabdena ca pūrvapadamātrasyākṣiptatvāt‌, na ca śakyate vaktum‌--ṛta iti vacanādṛkārasya bhaviṣyatīti, tasmādekamiha ṛta iti vacanaṃ dvandvasya viśeṣaṇam‌, na kāryiṇaḥ? ityāha--`ṛta iti ca' iti| atrānuvarttata iti sambandhaḥ| `ṛto vidyāyonisambandhebhyaḥ' (6.3.23) ityata ṛta ityanuvarttate, tat‌ kāryiṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| nanu tat‌ pañcamīnirdiṣṭam‌, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ? naiṣadoṣaḥ; putra ityeṣā saptamī ṛta ityasyāḥ pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati--`tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti| nanvevamapi virodhaḥ, tathā hi--yadi putraśabda uttarapadam‌, kathaṃ tadā ṛkārāntānāṃ dvandvaḥ, ṛkārāntānāṃ dvandvo na tarhi putraśabda uttarapadamiti? naitadasti; anya eva hi sa dvandvo yasya ṛta ityetadviśeṣaṇam‌| anyaśāca sa yasya putraśabda uttarapadamiti ko'tra virodhaḥ|| 26. devatādvandve ca| (6.3.26) anukārārthamavidyāyonisambandhārtha ca vacanam‌| nanu ca `ānaṅṛto dvandve' (6.3.25) ityato dvandvagarahaṇamanuvarttata eva, tat‌ kimarthamiha punardvandvagrahaṇam‌? ityāha--`dvandva ityanuvarttamāne' ityādi| pūrvakaṃ hi dvandvagrahaṇaṃ samāsaviśeṣapratipattyartham‌, idaṃ tu prasiddhasāhacaryārtham‌--yeṣāṃ loke vede ca prasiddhaṃ sāhacaryameṣāṃ punaḥ--parigraho yatā syādityevamartham‌| atha kriyamāṇe'pi punardvandvagrahaṇe kathamayamartho labhyate? ityāha--`atyantasahacarite' ityādi| `dvandvaṃ rahasyamaryādāvacanavyutkramaṇa' (8.1.15) ityatredamucyate| `atyantasahacarite lokavijñāte dvandvamityetannipātyate' iti| tenāyamartho labhyata iti darśayati| `vede ca ye sahavāpanirdiṣṭāḥ' iti| sahavāpaḥ-sahadānam‌, tatra nirdiṣṭāḥ sahavāpanirdiṣṭāḥ ke punarekahavisambandhinaḥ? ya ekaṃ hūyamānaṃ haviḥ prati sampradānatvena nirdiṣṭā ekatra mantre--indrāvaruṇābhyāṃ chāgaṃ havirnirvapāmītyādau, te veditavyāḥ| `ubhayatri' ityādi| pūrvapadatva uttarapadatve ca sati vāyorānaṅādeśasya pratiṣedho vaktavyo vyākhyeyaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vibhāṣā svasṛpatyoḥ' (6.3.24) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena vāyoruttarapadatve pūrvapadatve ca sati na bhaviṣyatīti|| 27. īdagneḥ somavaruṇayoḥ| (6.3.27) ānaṅādeśāpavādo'yamīkāro vidhīyate| takāra uccāraṇārthaḥ|| 28. idravṛddhau| (6.3.28) `agneḥ' (6.3.27) ityanuvarttate, `devatādvandve' (6.3.26) iti ca| `somavaruṇayoḥ' (6.3.27) iti nivṛttam‌| vṛddhiśabdena sāhacaryāt‌ kṛtavṛddhyuttarapadaṃ gṛhyate| ata evāha--`kṛtavṛddhāvuttarapade' iti| `āgnivāruṇīm‌' iti| autsargike'ṇi kṛte `ṭiṅḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.5) iti ṅīp‌| atrāpi takāra uccāraṇārthaḥ|| 29. divo dyāvā| (6.3.29) `devatādvandva uttarapade' iti| devatādvandve yaduttarapadaṃ tatra parata ityarthaḥ|| 30. divasaśca pṛthivyām‌| (6.3.30) ānaṅopavādaḥ| athākāraḥ kimarthamuccāryate, sakārasyetsaṃjñāparitrāṇārtha iti cet‌? na; prayojanābhāvādevetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyatītyāha--`akāraṇoccāraṇam‌' ityādi| asati hyakāre'ntarvarttinīṃ vibhaktimāśritya padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ sakārasya `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66) iti rutvaṃ vikāraḥ syāt‌, tasyāpi `kharavasānayorvisarjanīvaḥ' (8.3.15) tasyāpi `kupvoḥ ka pau ca' (8.3.37) ityupadhmānīyaḥ syāt‌| akāra syoccāraṇe tu sati na bhavati, katham‌? akārasyoccāraṇena yadvikṛtasya sakārasyopādānaṃ tasyaitadeva prayojam‌--avikṛtasyāsya prayogo yathā syāditi--dyāvā divasamityādikam‌| vākmetat‌| iha ca sūtre dvandvagrahaṇam‌, uttarapadagrahaṇaṃ cānuvarttate| dyāvā ityayamādeśo vākye na prāpnotītyāha--`katham‌' ityādi| `karttavyo'tra yatnaḥ' iti| tatrāyaṃ yatnaḥ--`tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam‌' (6.3.14) ityato bahulagrahaṇamanuvarttate tena dyāvā ityayamādeśaśchandasi vākye'pi bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā-cakārotra kriyate, tasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādbhaviṣyati| dyāvāśabdastu svaritatvādevānuvarttiṣyata iti nārthastadanukarṣaṇārthena cakāreṇa| atha vā--dikśabdena samānārtho dyāvāśabdaḥ prakṛtyantaramasti, tasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ| ādeśavacanaṃ tu divaḥ prayoganivṛttyarthamiti|| 31. upāsoṣasaḥ| (6.3.31) `ānaṅo'pavādaḥ' [nāstīdaṃ vākyaṃ kāśikāyām‌] iti evamuttarāvapi yogau| uṣāsānaktam‌' iti| uṣāṃśca naktañceti vigrahaḥ|| 32. mātarapitarāvudīcām‌| (6.3.32) 33. pitarāmātarā ca cchandasi| (6.3.33) 34. striyāḥ puṃvadbhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ‌ samānādhikaraṇe striyāmapūraṇīpriyādiṣu| (6.3.34) atra trayaḥ pakṣāḥ sambhāvyante--`striyāḥ' iti strīśabdena pratyayagrahaṇaṃ vā, arthagrahaṇaṃ vā, śabdagrahaṇaṃ veti| tatra yadi `striyāḥ' iti| strīpratayayagrahaṇaṃ svaryate, tadā svaritenādhikārāvagatiḥ (1.3.11) bhavatīti stryadhikāravihitāḥ pratyayā gṛhyante, yathā--`gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) ityatra| atha tu `strī' ityanena strītvaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamabhidhīyate, tadārthagrahaṇam‌| yadi tu stryarthavācī śabdaḥ strītyanenocyate, tadā śabdagrahaṇam‌| tatrādyapakṣe'yaṃ sūtrārthaḥ--bhāṣitapuṃskātparaḥ strīpratyayo'nūṅuttarapade puṃpadbhavati, nivarttata iti yāvat‌, tadā `striyāḥ' iti prathamārthe ṣaṣṭhā| kathaṃ punaḥ puṃvadityanena strīparatayayasya nivṛttiḥ śakyate vijñātum‌? bhavatīti vākyaśeṣādhyāhārāt‌| atra ca pakṣe paṭvī bhāryā'syeti paṭubhāryaṃ ityatra strīpratyayanivṛtteruttarapadanimittāyāḥ pūrvasmin‌ yaṇādeśe vidhātavye sati `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāve sati yaṇādeśaḥ syāt‌| iha ca--gārgyo vṛndārikā gargavṛndārikā ityatra `tadrājasya bahuṣu tenaivāstriyām‌' (2.4.62) ityanuvartamāne `yañañośca' (2.4.64) iti yaño lugna prāpnoti| puṃvadbhāvena hi stropratyayasya nivṛttiḥ kriyate, na tvarthasya strītvasya; tataścārthasyānivartitatvāt‌ kena punaryañna śrūyeta--ityevamādayaḥ pratyayapakṣe doṣā bhāṣye vistareṇoktāḥ| iha cātigranthavistarabhayānnocyante| arthapakṣe tūttarapade parato bhāṣitapuṃskasyānūṅpratyayāntasya strīśabdasya yorthastasya pumarthotidiśyate| bhāṣitapuṃskāditi pañcamī ṣaṣṭhyarthe--stryarthaḥ puṃvadbhavatīti| pumarthe cātidiṣṭe tadvacanaḥ śabdaḥ pravartate| atra pakṣe `khityanavyayasya' (6.3.66) iti hrasvatvasyāsya ca puṃvadbhāvasya vipratiṣedho na prāpnoti; bhinnaviṣayatvāt‌| tathā hi--śabdasya hrasvatvam‌, arthasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ; tataśca kālimmanyetyatra `vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam‌' (1.4.2) iti hrasvatvaṃ na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca vipratiṣedhaḥ| tathā hi--puṃvadbhāvasya vipratiṣedho na prāpnoti; bhinnaviṣayatvāt‌| tathā hi--śabdasya hrasvatvam‌, arthasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ; tataśca kālimmanyetyatra `vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam‌' (1.4.2) iti hrasvatvaṃ na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca vipratiṣedhaḥ| tathā hi--puṃvadbhāvasyāvakāśo yatra khidantamuttarapadaṃ nāsti--darśanīyabhāyaṃ iti, hrasvasyāvakāśo yatra puṃvadbhāvo nāsti--kālimmanyaḥ pumāniti; kālimmanyā strītyatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti, tatra paratvāt‌ hrasvatvaṃ bhavati| tadevamādyayoḥ pakṣayordoṣavattāṃ manyamānastṛtīyapakṣamāśrityāha--`bhāṣitaḥ pumān‌ yena' ityādi| yo hyaviśeṣeṇa kvacidbhāṣitapuṃskaḥ śabdaḥ sa ihāśrīyeta, tadā droṇībhārya ityatrāpi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāditi manasi kṛtvā''ha--`samānāyamākṛtau' ityādi| `ekasmin‌ pravṛttinimitte' iti| anena samānāyāmākṛtāvityasyārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkaroti| ākriyate-gṛhyate, paricchidyate yenārthastat‌ śabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ jātyādikamihākṛtiśabdenocyate| `bhāṣitapuṃskāt‌' ityetāvatyukte `samānāyāmākṛtau' ityeṣa viśeṣo na śakyo labdhumityabhiprāyeṇāha--`tadetadevam‌' ityādi| taditi vākyopanyāse| etasya vacanasyārtharūpamevamprakāram‌| kathaṃ bhavati? naivaṃ kathaṃcidityarthaḥ| yadi bhāṣitapuskaśabdasya bahuvriheḥ śabdo'nyapadārthatvenāśrīyeta--bhāṣitaḥ pumān‌ yena śabdena sa bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ śabda iti, tadā samānāyāmākṛtāvityeṣa viśeṣo na labhyate, sarva eva hi śabdaḥ kvacadākṛtau pumāṃsaṃ bhāṣitvā''kṛtyantare striyaṃ bhāṣata iti kṛtvā| arthe tvanyapadārthatvenāśrīyamāṇe labhyata eva ityeṣa viśeṣa ityālocyāha--`bhāṣitaḥ pumān‌ yasminnarthe' ityādi| śabdasya yat‌ pravṛttinimittaṃ jātyādikaṃ tadanyapadārthaḥ| kena punaḥ śabdena tatra bhāṣitaḥ pumān‌? pratyasatteryat‌ tasya pravṛttanimittaṃ tenaiveti vijñāyate; anyathā hi bhāṣitapuṃskagrahamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, vyavacchedyābhāvāt‌| sarvatraivābhidheye|rthe yena kenacit‌ śabdena pumān‌ bhāṣyate| antato'rthaśabdenāpi tasyārthasya bhāṣitapuṃskasya yaḥ prātapadikaḥ śabda so'pyabhidhyadharmasyābhidhāna upacaradbhāṣitapuṃska ityucyate| sa punaḥ pratyāsatteryasya yo'rthaḥ pravṛttinimittaṃ tatara yena pumān‌ bhāṣata iti sa eva veditavyaḥ| yaśca bhāṣitapuṃskasya pravṛttinimittasya vācakaḥ sa niyogata ekasmin‌ pravṛttinimitte pumāṃsaṃ bhāṣitvā striyaṃ bhāṣate| yathā mūlodāharaṇeṣu--darśanīyādayaḥ śabdā iti, samārthyādyena śabdena samānāyāmākṛtau pumān‌ bhāṣita ityeṣa viśeṣo labhyate| `anūṅ‌' iti yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ syāt‌, ūṅo'nyo'nūṅiti--tato nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) tatsadṛśānāṃ ṭābādīnāṃ pratyayānāṃ grahaṇe sati tadantasyaiva puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt‌, aiḍaviḍavṛndārikā, dāradavṛndāriketyatra na syāt‌| iḍaviḍo'patyaṃ strīti `janapadaśabdāt‌ kṣatriyādañ‌' (4.1.168) ityatrpratyayaḥ| darado'patyamiti `dvyañmagadha' (4.1.179) ityādināṇ‌ tayoḥ `ataśca' (4.1.177) iti luk‌, tata iḍaviṭ‌ cāsau vṛndārikā ceti, daraccāsau vṛndārikā ceti `vṛndārakanāgakuñjaraiḥ' (2.1.62) iti samāsaḥ, tatredānīṃ `puṃvatkarmadhāraya' (6.3.42) ityādinā puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti; ūṅsadṛśapratyayānatarābhāvāt‌, tataśceḍaviṭ‌śabdasyaiḍaviḍaśabdo daracchabdasya dāradaśabdo na syāt‌| prasajyapratiṣedhe sati tu bhavati; atrā'pyūṅabhāvasya bhāvādityālocya prasajayapratiṣedho'yamiti darśayannāha--ūṅo'bhāvo'nūṅiti| `bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ‌' iti| yadyayamasamāsaḥ syānna bahuvrīhiḥ, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt‌--bhāṣitapuskāduttarasyāvidyamānoṅaḥ stryarthavṛtteḥ śabdasyottarapade parataḥ puṃvadbhavatīti| evañca sati yathābhūtārthavācī strīśabdastathābhūtārthavācyeva puṃśabdasyādeśo bhavatīti sāmarthyāduktaṃ bhavati, tataścāniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ--aṅgārakā nāma śakunayaḥ teṣāṃ kālikā nāma striyaḥ, tata etāśca kālikāvṛndārikāśceti samāse kṛte satyetacchabdo bhā,itapuṃska iti tasmāduttarasya kālikāśabdasyānūṅo'rthato'ntaratamo'ṅgarakaśabdaḥ puṃśabdādeśaḥ prasajyeta; anyasyāntaratamasyābhāvāt‌| tataścaitadaṅgārakavṛndārikā iti hi syāt‌, etatkālikāvṛndārikā itīṣyate| bahuvrīhau tu satyaniṣṭaprasaṅgo na bhavati, tatra hi bhāṣitapuṃskasya śabdasyānūṅaḥ pūṃvadbhāvena bhavitavyam‌, na ca kālikāśabdo bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ--ityetatsarvamālocya bahuvrīhirayamiti darśayannāha--`bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ‌ yasmin‌ strīśabde' iti| `yadi bahuvrīhirayam‌' [`yadi--nāsti kāśikāyām‌] iti| evaṃ sati `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti pañcamyā luk‌ prāpnoti? ata āha--`alugnipātanāt‌' ityādi| nanu cālaukikatvādasya vākyasya nipātanādityayamaparīhāraḥ, nipātanaṃ hi laukikaṃ bhavati, tarhyevaṃ lukāpyatra na bhāvyam‌? atha lugbhaviṣyatītyevāvasīyate'lugapi bhavatītyavasīyatām‌| `darśanīyabhāryaḥ' iti| darśanīyā bhāryā'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvatvamuttarapadasya| darśanīyatvaṃ nāmātra sāmānye viśeṣo darśanīyaśabdasya pravṛttinimittam‌| tamekamevārthamupādāyāsī puṃsi striyāṃ ca varttate--darśanīyo devadattaḥ; darśanīyā bhāryeti| tasmāt‌ samānāyāmākṛtau darśanīyaśabdo bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati; striyāñca varttate, na cāsmādūṅ‌| ato bhāryāśabde strīliṅga uttarapade'sya strīśabdasya `puṃśabdasyeva rūpaṃ bhavati| [`puṃśabdasyaiva'--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] evaṃ `ślakṣṇacūḍaḥ' ityādāvapi yojanīyam‌| `grāmaṇidṛṣṭiḥ' iti| atra sarvamasti, na tu grāmaṇīśabdaḥ striyāṃ vartate, kiṃ tarhi? napuṃsaka iti na bhavati puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `droṇībhāryaḥ' iti| droṇaśabdena bhāṣitaḥ pumān‌, na tu samāne pravṛttinimitta| yasmāt‌ parimāṇaviśeṣaṃ pravṛttinimittamupādāya puṃsi parimāṇini vartate| jātiviśeṣaṃ tūpādāya striyāṃ gavādanyāṃ vartate| yatra gāvo'danti sā gavādanī droṇīśabdenocyate| tasmānna droṇaśabdaḥ samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ| `katham‌' ityādi| yadi samānāyāmākṛtau yo bhāṣitapuṃskastasya puṃvadbhāva ucyate, evaṃ ca `garbhibhāryaḥ' ityādau puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti| garbhaprabhṛtīnāṃ śabdānāṃ bhinnāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| anavayavabhūtāntarvartivastuviśeṣasambandhe hi sati strī garbhiṇītyucyate| vrīhistvantarvarttyavayavastuviśeṣasambandhe sati garbhītyucyate| tasmāt‌ puṃsi striyāṃ ca vartamānasya garbhiśabdasya pravṛttinimittaṃ bhidyate| prasūtaprajātaśabdayorapi pravṛttinimittaṃ kriyakṛtirbhinnā| striyāṃ hi vartamānau tau garbhavimokṣaṇaṃ pravṛttinimittamupādaya varttate, puṃsi tu garbhādhānam‌| `karttavyo'tra prayatnaḥ' iti| kecidvyācakṣate--upasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyamiti| apare punarāhuḥ--striyā puṃvaditi yogavibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ| atha vā--`kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ' ityanenedaṃ darśayati--yadyapi striyāṃ vrīhau ca garbhatvabhedaḥ, tathāpi sa nāśrayitavyaḥ| yattu tatrāvayavānavayavabhedamutsṛjya sāmānyenāntarvarttivastuviśeṣasambandhamātram‌, tadevāśrayitavyam‌| atastadapekṣayā striyāṃ vrīhau ca vartamānasya garbhiśabdasaya tulyameva pravṛttinimittamiti| evaṃ prasūtaprajātaśabdayorapyapatyādhānavimokṣaṇabhedaṃ tyaktvā'yamapatyavāniyamapatyavatītyapatyavatsambandhamātramākṣitamityetadvyākhyānamiīti pratyantaḥ karttavya iti| `brahmabandhūbhāryaḥ' iti| brahmabandhūśabdāt‌ `ūṅutaḥ' (4.1.66) ityūṅ‌| `kalyāṇīpañcamāḥ' iti| `ap‌ pūraṇīpramāṇyoḥ' (5.4.116) ityapsamāsāntaḥ, pañcānāṃ pūraṇīti ḍaṭ‌, tasya `nāntādasaṃkhyādermaṭ‌' (5.2.49), tataḥ `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīpi kṛte pañcamī bhavati| `pradhānapūraṇīgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| pradhānaṃ pūraṇī gṛhyate yena vyākhyānena tadvyākhyānaṃ pradhānapūraṇīgrahaṇam‌, tat‌ karttavyam‌--pradhānaṃ yā pūraṇī tasyāṃ pratiṣedho yathā syāt‌, apradhānabhūtāyāṃ tasyāṃ mā bhūditi| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--iha `dvandve dhi' (2.2.32) iti priyādiśabdasya pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipātalakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnena sūcitaṃ vyabhicāryayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kvacideva varttate, na sarvatreti| tena yatraiva pradhānabhūtā pūraṇī tatraiva bhavati, nānyatreti| tena yatrāsau bhavati tatra tasyā eva pradhānabhūtāyā pūraṇyā grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌| kva pūraṇyāḥ prādhānyam‌? yatra tasyāḥ samāse'bhidheyatvenāntarbhāvaḥ, yathānantaroktapratyudāharaṇe| tatra hyavayavena vigrahaḥ| samudāyastvavayavabhedādabhinnaḥ, samāsārtha eva| `tatra' iti| yathaivaṃ prathamā, dvitīyā, tṛtīyā, caturthī cābhidhīyate, tathā pañcamyapi| `kalyāṇapañcamīkaḥ pakṣaḥ' iti| atra tu tirohitāvayavabhedaḥ pakṣa evānyapādrathaḥ pradhānam‌, pañcamī tu rātriḥ| asmin‌ pakṣe'nyapadārtho'numeyaiva, na tvabhidheyā| yathā vṛkṣaśabde mūlādayaḥ, tatastadvadarthamapyanabhidheyatvādartho'pradhānam‌| athāp‌ samāsāntaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`appūraṇīpramāṇyo' ityādi| atha dṛḍhabhaktiḥ, śobhanabhaktirityādau kathaṃ puṃvadbhāvaḥ yāvatā priyāditvāt‌ pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌? ityāha--`dṛḍhabhaktirityevamādiṣu' ityādi| astrīvācinaḥ pūrvapadasya vivakṣitatvāddṛḍhabhaktirityevamādi lakṣyaṃ siddhamityevaṃ samādheyam‌| dveṣyaṃ pariharttavyamityarthaḥ| dṛḍhaśabdo'trādārḍhyanivṛttiparaḥ prayuktaḥ| atrādārḍhyanivṛttiparāyāṃ codanāyāṃ liṅgaviśeṣopādānamanupakārakameveti| ataḥ strītvamiha na vivakṣitam‌| tasmādastrīliṅgasya dṛḍhaśabdasyāyaṃ prayoga ityabhiprāyaḥ|| 35. tasilādaṣvākṛtvasucaḥ| (6.3.35) anuttarapadārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `tataḥ' iti| `pañcamyāstasil‌' (5.3.7)| tasya `prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ' (5.3.1) iti vibhaktisaṃjñakatvāt‌ tyadādyatvam‌ ṭāp‌, anena puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `tatra' iti| `saptamyāstral‌' (5.3.10)| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat‌| `tasilādiṣu' ityādi| `tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' ityucyamāne tasilādiṣvanantarbhūteṣvapi kvacit‌ puṃvadbhāva iṣyate, sa na prāpnoti| tatrāntarbhūte'pi kvacinneṣyate, evaṃ satyaniṣṭamapi prāpnoti| tasmāt‌ parigaṇanaṃ karttavyam‌| tatra tatasorudāharaṇamuktam‌| śeṣāṇāṃ tūcyate--iyaṃ ṣaṭvī, iyaṃ paṭvī iyamanayoratiśayena paṭvī--`dvivacana' (5.3.57) ityādinā tarap‌--paṭutarā| iyamāsamatiśayena paṭvī--`atiśāyane' (5.3.55) ityānā tamap‌--paṭutamā| paṭvī bhūtapūrvā--`bhūtapūrve caraṭ‌' (5.3.53) ṅīp‌, paṭucarī| paṭvīprakārā--prakāravacane jātīpar‌ (5.3.69)--paṭujātīyā| īṣadasamāptā paṭvī--`īṣadasamāptau kalpabdeśyadeśīyaraḥ' (5.3.67) paṭukalpā paṭudeśyā, paṭudeśīyā| praśastā paṭvī--`paśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap‌' (5.3.66)--paṭurūpā| yāpyā paṭvī--`yāpye pāśap‌' (5.3.47)--paṭupāśā| ajāyai hitā--`ajāvimyāṃ thyan‌' (5.1.8) ajathyā| thyaṃstasilādibhyaḥ pūrvaṃ paṭhyate| sarvaprakaraiḥ sarvathā, `prakāravacane thāl‌' (5.3.23)| tasyāṃ rātrau tadā--`sarvaikānyakiṃyattadaḥ kāle dā' (5.3.15)| asyāṃ rātrau etahiṃ--`idamorhil‌' (5.3.16)| tatredamaḥ `etetau rathoḥ' (5.3.4) ityetādeśaḥ, praśastā vṛkī vṛkatiḥ| praśastā jyeṣṭhā jyeṣṭhatātiḥ--`vṛkajyeṣṭhābhyāṃtiltātilau ca cchandasi' (5.4.41) iti tillātilau| etau ca kṛtvāsucaḥ paro paṭhyeti| tasilādiṣu parigaṇanaṃ karttavyamiti bhāvyakārasya matametat‌, na tu sūtrakārasya| na cāsati parigaṇane kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| yeṣu hi tasilādiṣvanantarbhūteṣu puṃvadbhāva iṣyate, teṣūtatarasūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvādbhaviṣyati| yeṣu tasilādiṣvantarbhūteṣu neṣyate, tatra `na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) iti neti yogavibhāganna bhaviṣyatīti| doṣaḥ khalvapi parigaṇane--daracchabdāt‌ kapratyaye dāradiketyatra puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti; kapratyayasyāparigaṇitatvāt‌| `śasi bahvalpārthasya' iti| śasi pratyaye parataḥ bahvarthasyālpārthasya ca puṃvadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ, vyakhyeya ityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tasyaiva cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāmāśritya karttavyam‌| `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' ityādi| `hāstikam‌' iti| `acittahastidhenoṣṭhak‌' (4.2.47) iti ṭhak‌| yadyatra puṃvadbhāvo na syāt‌ tada yasye (6.4.148) tīkāralope kṛte tasya `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāvāta `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopo na syāt‌ puṃvadbhāve tu sati hastiśabda evāyaṃ bhavati| nanu ca ṭhakchaso (vā.732) rityanenaivātra sidhyati puṃvadbhāvaḥ? na sidhyati; na sidhyati; chasā sāhacaryāt‌ `bhavataṣṭhakchasoḥ' (4.2.115) [`bhavataṣṭhakchasau'--iti sūtram‌] ityanaiva vihitasya tatra ṭhako grahaṇāt‌, na sarvasya| `katham‌' ityādi| yadi ca ḍhe parataḥ puṃvadbhāvasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, tadāgnāyī devatāsyeti `agnerḍhak‌' (4.2.33) iti ḍhaki kṛta āgnāyeya iti bhavitavyam‌, tatkathamāgneya iti bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| agneḥ strītyasyāṃ vivakṣāyāṃ `vṛṣākapyagnikusitakusīdānāmudāttaḥ' (4.1.37) ityanenāgniśabdānṅīpi kṛta aikāre cāntādeśe'gnāyīti bhavati| `karttavyo'tra yatnaḥ' iti| yatnaḥ kena punaḥ karttavyaḥ? yaḥ `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' (vā.731) ityupasaṃkhyānamicchati| na tu yaścakāramanuktasamuccayārthamuttarasūtre karoti| sa hyevamāha--yatraiveṣyate tatraiva cakāraḥ puvadbhāvaṃ samucacinoti, nānyatreti| kaḥ punarasau yatna iti? kaścidāha--`apatyagrahaṇaṃ ḍhasya viśeṣaṇaṃ karttavyam‌--yo'patye'ḍhe' iti| tenāyamartho bhavati--ḍhasya taddhete puṃvadbhāvo bhavatyapatyārthapratyayaṃ varjayitvā| na cāgneyaḥ, sthālopāka ityapatyārthe ḍhapratyayaḥ, kintu sāsya devatetyarthe, ato'tra bhavatyeva puṃvadbhāva iti| anyastvāha--`bhasyāḍhe taddhite' (vā.731) iti vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau| yaścātra nañ‌ so'lpārthe varttate, yathā alpalavaṇā yavāgūralavaṇetyucyate| tatrāyamartho bhavati--bhasya taddhite puṃvadbhāvo vaktavyo'lye ḍhaprātyaya iti| tenāgneyaḥ, sthālīpāka ityatra puṃvadbhāvo bhavati| śyaineya, rohiṇeya ityatra tu na bhavatīti| `ṭhakchasośca' ityādi| atha ṭhaggrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā ṭhasyekādeśe kṛte `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' (vā.731) ityanenaiva siddhaḥ| ṭhāvasthāyāmeva yathā syādityevamartham‌| kimevaṃ sati bhavati? `isusuktāntāt‌ kaḥ (7.3.51) iti kaḥ siddho bhavati; anyathā hi yadīkādeśe kṛte puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt‌ tato yathā māthitika ityatrekādeśo na bhavati, tathā bhāvatkā ityatrāpi na syāt‌| `bhāvatkāḥ, bhavadīyāḥ' iti| `bhavataṣṭhakchasau' (4.2.115) iti ṭhak‌chasau|| 36. kyaṅmāninośca| (6.3.36) `etāyate, śyetāyate' iti| etaśyetaśabdābhyāṃ `varṇādanudāttāt‌ topadhāt‌ to naḥ' (4.1.39) [`etaśvetaśabdābhyām‌'--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ityanena ṅīp‌, takārasya nakāraḥ| enīvācarati, śyenīvācarati--`karttuḥ kyaṅ‌ salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti kyaṅ‌, `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ(7.4.25) iti dīrghatvam‌| `ayamasyāṃ darśanīyamānī' [`darśanīyamānī ayamasyāḥ'--kāśikā] iti| darśanīyāmimāṃ manyate'yamiti| `manaḥ' (3.2.82) iti ṇiniḥ| `darśanīyamānanīyamasyāḥ' iti| darśanīyāmimāṃ manyata iti pūrvavaṇṇiniḥ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌| (4.1.5) iti ṅīp‌| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ striyāṃ samānādhikaraṇa ityanuvarttamāne'striyāmasamānādhikaraṇe ca māninyuttarapade puṃvadbhāva udāhriyata ityāha--`mānino grahaṇam‌' ityādi| kathametajjñāyate? ityāha--`iha tu' ityādi| yadyuttarapadaṃ striyāṃ vartate samānādhikaraṇaṃ ca bhavati--darśanīyāmātmānaṃ manyate darśanīyamāninītyevamādau| tatra yasmāt‌ `striyāṃ puṃvat‌' (6.3.34) ityanenaiva siddham‌, ato mānino garahaṇamastryartham‌| asamānādhikaraṇāccetyetadavasīyate; anyathā hi tadanarthakaṃ syāt‌|| 37. na kopadhāyāḥ| (6.3.37) purveṇa prakāreṇa prāptasya puṃvadbhāvasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `pācikābhāryaḥ, kārikābhāryaḥ' iti| pācakakāraka śabdabhyāṃ ṇvulantābhyāṃ ṭāp‌| `pratyayasthāt‌ kātpūrvasyāta idāpyasupaḥ' (7.3.44) itīttvam‌| atra `striyāḥ puṃvat‌' (6.3.34) ityādinā prāptiḥ| `madrikābhāryaḥ vṛjikābhāryaḥ' iti| madreṣu bhavā, vṛjiṣu bhaveti `madravṛjyoḥ kan‌ (4.2.131) iti kan‌| atrāpi `striyāḥ puṃvat‌ (6.3.34) ityādinā prāptiḥ| `madrikākalpā; vṛjikākalpā' iti| atra `tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' (6.3.35) ityanena prāp‌tiḥ| `madrikāyate' ityādau `kyaṅmāninośca' (6.3.36) iti prāptiḥ| `vilepikāyā dharmyam‌' iti| `lipa upadehe' (dhā.pā.1433) ityasmāṇṇvul‌| `vailepikam‌' iti| `aṇ‌ mahiṣyadibhyaḥ' (4.4.48) ityaṇ‌| atra `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' (vā.731) iti vā prāptiḥ| `kopadhapratiṣedhe' ityādi| asmin‌ kopadhapratiṣedhe taddhitavugrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| taddhitasambandhī vusambandhī kakāra upadhā yasya tatraiva pratiṣedho yathā syāt‌| iha mā bhūt‌--`pākabhāryaḥ' iti| pākaśabdo'yaṃ `arbhakapṛthukapākā vayasi' (da.u.3.50) ityanena kanpratyayānto nipātitaḥ| atrāsati vugrahaṇa ihāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌| yadi taddhitavugrahaṇaṃ kriyate, tarhi `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) ityatra yadvakṣyati--"śuṣkajaṅgha" ityatra--`śuṣaḥ kaḥ' (8.2.51) ityasyāsiddhatvāt‌ `na kopadhayāḥ' (6.3.37) iti pratiṣedho na prāpnotītyasiddhādhikārasya prayojanam‌' iti tannopapadyate, asatyapi `śuṣaḥ kaḥ' ityasyāsiddhatvenaivātra `na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) iti pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌, na hyatra taddhitasambandho kakāraḥ nāpi vusambandhī? darśanabhedamāśritya tathā'bhidhānādadoṣaḥ| idaṃ hi vārtikakāramatamāśrityoktam‌| tat‌ punaḥ ślokavārtikakārasya sūtrakāramatānusāriṇo darśanamāśritya vakṣyati|| 38. saṃjñāpūraṇyośca| (6.3.38) kathaṃ punaḥ saṃjñāśabdasya puṃvadbhavasya prāptiḥ, yāvatā bhāṣitapuṃskasya puṃvadbhāva uktaḥ, na ca yaḥ saṃjñāśabdaḥ striyāṃ vartate sa bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati, ekadravyaniveśitvāt‌ saṃjñāśabdānām‌? naitadasti; na hyayaṃ niyoga ekadravyaniveśitvāta saṃjñāśabdānām‌? naitadasti; na hyaṃ niyoga ekadravyaniveśibhireva saṃjñāśabdairbhavitavyamiti| tathā hi--devadattādiśabdo'nekadravyadānakriyādisambandānnaikavastusaṃjñābhūta eva laroke prayujyamāna upalabhyate, śāstreṣvapi svādiśabdaḥ| yā tvekadravyaniveśinī saṃjñā tāṃ prati naivāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyata ityasāraṃ codyam‌| nanu bhavantu saṃjñāśabdā anekārthavṛttayaḥ bhāṣitapuṃskāstvekasyāmākṛtau, kathaṃ tarhi teṣāṃ kiñcit‌ pravṛttinimittamasti, yadṛcchāśabdatvāt‌? etadapyasāram‌; yatasteṣāmapi keṣāṃcit‌ kiñcit‌ pravṛttinimittamastyeva, saptaparṇādiśabdavat‌| yatrāpyetannāsti, tatrāpi svarūpameva pravṛttinimittamupādāyābhidheye varttante| tatrābhinne pravṛttinimitte yairbhāṣitaḥ pumān‌ te bhāṣitapuṃskā iti kimatrānupapannam‌? `dattābhryaḥ' iti| atra yāsau dānakriyākṛtistasyāmeva dattāśabdo bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ| `guptābhāryaḥ' iti| atrāpi guptāśabdo gopanakriyākṛtau svarūpe vā pravṛttinimitte| ubhāvapi bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdau `dattāyate guptāyate' iti| kathamete pratiṣedhasyodāharaṇe upanyaste, yāvatā satyapi puṃvadbhāve `akṛtsārvadhātukayodīrghaḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghatvenobhayamapyetat‌ siddham‌? evaṃ manyate `saṃjñāpūrvo vidhiranityaḥ' (vya.pa.64) iti, tatra yadi puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na syāt‌, tadā dīrghatvābhāvo'numīyate| tasmin‌ pakṣe dattayate guptayata ityapi syāditi| `na kopadhāsaṃjñāpūraṇīnām‌' ityekasminneva yoge kattavye yogavibhāgaḥ `na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) ityasya pratiṣedhasyānityatvajñāpanārthaḥ kṛtaḥ| tena yaduktam‌--`kopadhapratiṣedhe taddhitavugrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌ (vā.733) iti, tanna karttavyaṃ bhavati|| 39. vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre| (6.3.39) vṛddhinimittaṃ ñaṇakāḥ| `sraudhnībhāryaḥ' iti| srudhne bhavā, `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityaṇ‌| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌| evaṃ `māthurībhāryaḥ' ityatrāpi| `madhyamabhāryaḥ' iti| madhye bhavā, `madhyānmaḥ' (4.3.8) iti mapratyayaḥ| `kāṇḍalāvabhāryaḥ' iti| kāṇḍaṃ lunātīti `karmaṇyaṇ‌' (3.2.1) pūrvavanṅīp‌| `tāvadbhāryaḥ' iti| tāvacchabdāt‌ tatparimāṇamasyā iti `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup‌' (5.2.39) `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) iti dakāramyākāraḥ, `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp‌| tāvatī bhāryā'sya tāvadbhāryaḥ, yadi vṛddhinimittasyeti tatpuruṣo gṛhyeta tadātrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, bhavati hi vatub‌ vṛddherākārāsya nimittam‌| bahuvrīhiparigrahe tu na doṣaḥ; na hi vatupi ñakārādikaṃ vṛddhernimittamasti| `kāṣāyī' iti| `tena raktam‌' (4.2.1) ityaṇ‌| `lauhī' iti| `prāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ‌' (4.3.154) ityañ‌, pūrvavan‌ ṅīp‌| `khādireṣaḥ' iti| `palāśādibhyo vā' (4.3.141) ityañaṇoranyataraḥ| khādirī īṣā yasya sa khādireṣaḥ|| 40. svaṅgācceto'mānini| (6.3.40) `dīrghakeśī' iti| `svāṅgāccopasarjanādasaṃyogopadhāt‌' (4.1.54) iti ṅīṣ‌| `ṣaṭvī' iti| paṭuśabdāt‌ `voto guṇavacanāt‌' (4.1.44) iti ṅīṣ‌| `akeśabhāryaḥ' iti| avidyamānāḥ keśā asyā akeśā `sahanañvidyamānapūrvācca' (4.1.57) iti ṅīpi pratiṣiddhe ṭāveva bhavati|| 41. jāteśca| (6.3.41) `kaṭhībhāryaḥ' iti| kaṭhaśabdāt‌ `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt‌ (4.1.63) iti ṅīṣ‌| jātitvaṃ tvasya `gotrañca caraṇaiḥ saha' (4.1.63; mā. bhā.2.225) iti lakṣaṇena| `ayam‌' ityādi| `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' (vā.731) ityaupasaṃkhyāniko yaḥ puṃvadbhāvastasyāyaṃ pratiṣedho neṣyate| yasmādasya pratiṣedhasya bādhanārthamuttarasūtre puṃvaditi yogavibhāgaḥ karttavya ityabhiprāyaḥ|| 42. puṃvatkarmadhārayajātīyadeśīyeṣu| (6.3.42) nanu ca karmadhāraye `striyāḥ puṃvat‌' (6.3.34) ityādinā puṃvadbhāvaḥ siddhaḥ, jātīyadeśīyaśabdayorapi `tasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' (6.3.35) ityādinā, tat‌ kimartho'yamāraṃbhaḥ? ityata āha--`pratiṣedhāryo'yamāramabhaḥ' iti| paratiṣedhaviṣayaḥ pratiṣedhaśabdenoktaḥ| sāhacaryāt‌ pratiṣedho'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasyeti sa tathoktaḥ| yatra viṣaye pratiṣedha uktastatra puṃvadbhāvaḥ prayojanamityarthaḥ| atha vā--arthaśabdo nivṛttāviha--varttate, yathā--maśakārtho dhūma iti| tenāyamartho bhavati--pratiṣedhanivṛtyartho'yamārambha iti| `bhāṣitapuṃskādityeva' iti| yadi `bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ‌' (6.3.34) iti ca nānuvarttate, tadā'bhāṣitapuṃskārthamanūṅarthañcedaṃ vacanaṃ syāt‌, na pratiṣedhārtham‌| evaṃ ca khaṭvāvṛndārikā, brahmabandhūvṛndāriketyātrāpi puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt‌| tasmādbhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅityanuvarttanīyam‌| `kukkuṭyādīnām‌' ityādi| uttarapadasyāntāderastrītvādasāmānādhikaraṇyācca puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnotītyupasaṃkhyāyate| `na vā' ityanenopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe-- na vā vaktavyaḥ, kasmāt‌? astrīpūrvapadasya vivakṣitatvāt‌| astrīliṅgasya pūrvapadasya vivakṣitatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| asyaivārthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha--`strītvena vinā' ityādi| atra hi mayūrādijātyantarasyā nivṛttirvivakṣitā| jātyantaranivṛttiparāyāṃ deśanāyāṃ liṅgaviśeṣopādānamanupakārakameva| vināpi tena jātyantaranivṛttiḥ śakyata eva karttam‌| tathā hi--mṛgamāṃsamityukte antareṇāpi liṅgaviśeṣopādānaṃ jātyantarasaya vyavaccheda upapadyate--mṛgajātisambandhi māṃsam‌, nānyajātisambandhīti| tasmāt‌ strītvamatrānupakāritvānna vivakṣitam‌, ataḥ strītvena vinā pūrvapadasyārtho'tri kukkuṭāṇḍādau jātisāmānyena strītvadaviśeṣavihito vivakṣita ityarthaḥ| tataścāstrīliṅgā evātra kukkuṭādayaḥ śabdā aṇḍādibhiḥ śabdaṃ samasyanta iti bhāvaḥ. kaḥ punarasau pūrvapadārthaḥ? kukkuṭādijātyā vyavachinnaṃ dravyamātram‌| `puṃvadbhāvāt‌' ityādi| atra khiti puṃvadbhāvādghrasvatvaṃ vipratiṣedhena bhavatīti pūrvameva vyākhyātam‌| ghādiṣu tu vyākhyāyate| ghādiṣu ṅyo hrasvo bhavatītyasyāvakāśaḥ--narttakitarā, narttakitamā, narttakirūpā, narttakikalpeti; puṃvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ--darśanīyatarā, darśanīyatamāṃ, darśanīyarūpā, darśanīyakalpeti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--paṭvitarā, paṭvitamā; paṭ‌virūpā, paṭvikalpeti; vipratiṣedhena hrasvatvaṃ bhavati| `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvasyāvakāśaḥ--nartakiketi; ajñātādāvarthe `prāgivāt‌ kaḥ' (5.3.70) pūrvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ--dāradiketi| daracchabdasyātra ke parataḥ `tasalādiṣvākṛtvāsucaḥ' (6.3.35) iti puṃvadbhāvena dāradaśabdo bhavati| ataṣṭāpi kṛte `pratyayasthāt‌ kāt‌' (7.3.44) ityādinettvamihobhayaṃ prāpnoti| `paṭvikā' iti| atra vipratiṣedhena hrasvatvaṃ bhaviṣyati| kena punaḥ puṃvadbhāvaḥ, yāvatā tasilādiṣu parigaṇanaṃ kṛtam‌, na ca tatara kapratyayaḥ parigaṇitaḥ? etat‌ bhāṣyakāraḥ praṣṭavyo yaḥ parigaṇanaṃ karoti, na tu sūtrakāraḥ| pūrva yasya siddhaye'nūṅiti prasajyapratiṣedha āśritastaddarśanārthamāha--`iha' ityādi| `tatra tadrājapratyayasya' ityādi| tatreḍaviṭ, pṛthu ityetābhyāṃ `janapadaśabdāt‌ kṣatriyādañ‌' (4.1.168) iti vihitasyāñastadrājapratyayasya `ataśca' (4.1.177) iti luk‌| darad‌ uśijityetābhyāṃ tu `dvyañmagadha' (4.1.170) ityādinā vihitasyāṇaḥ| iḍaviṭ‌ cāsau vṛndārikā ceti vigṛhya samāsa iti| `viśeṣaṇa' ityādinā, `atraiḍaviḍādayaḥ' [nāsti--kāśikā] iti ādiśabdena dāradaḥ, pārathaḥ, auśija ityete gṛhyante|| 43. gharūpakalpacelaṅbruvagotramatahateṣu ṅyo'nekāco hvasvaḥ| (6.3.43) celaḍabruvagotraśabdānāṃ kutsārthatvāt‌ `kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ (2.1.53) iti samāsaḥ| matahataśabdābhyāṃ tu `viśeṣaṇaṃ bahulam‌' (2.1.57) ityanena| celaḍiti pacādau paṭhyate, ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ| yadi `bruvaḥ' iti pacādyajantametat‌ evaṃ sati `bruvo vaciḥ' (2.4.53) iti vacyādeśo guṇaśca prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavatīti? yaścodayetat‌, taṃ pratyāha--`vacyādeśo guṇaśca nipātanānna bhavati' iti| `āmakalakītarā, kuvalītarā' iti| āmalakakuvalaśabdau vṛkṣe nityaṃ strīliṅgai| phale tu napuṃsakaliṃgāvityubhāvapyabhāṣitapuṃskau, tābhyāṃ gaurāditvānṅīṣ‌|| 44. nadyāḥ śeṣasyānyatarasyām‌| (6.3.44) `bhāṣitapuṃskādanūṅ‌' (6.3.34) iti nivṛttam‌| `kaśca śeṣaḥ' iti| yadi pūrvasūtreṇa yasya hrasvo na vihitaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tato yadbhāṣitapuṃskaṃ yacca bhinnāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskaṃ naicāc‌ tasyāpi śeṣatvaṃ syāt‌, tataścāmalakītarā, droṇītaretyatrāpi vikalpena hrasvatvapaṃ syāt‌| na hyat‌ra hrasvatvaṃ pūrvasūtreṇa vihitamityabhiprāyeṇā''ha--`aṅī ca yā nadī ṅyantaśca yadekāc‌' iti| etena śrutāpeśrayā'tra śeṣatvāmāśrīyate, na tu yasya hrasvo na vihitaḥ, tadapekṣayeti darśayati| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate? śeṣagrahaṇāt‌| antareṇāpi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śeṣasyaiva vikalpena hrasvatvaṃ bhaviṣyati| tathā hi yadi ṅyo'nekāco bhāṣitapuṃskasyāpi vibhāṣā hrasvaḥ syāt, tadā pūrvayoga evedamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt‌| iha kāraṇādyasya pūrveṇa hrasvo na vihitastasyaiva pākṣikaṃ hrasvatvamantareṇāpi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śeṣasyaiva bhaviṣyatītyavasīyata iti kiṃ śeṣagrahaṇena? tat‌ kriyate `ṅyo'nekācaḥ' (6.3.43) iti pūrvasūtre yo'c‌ śrūyate tadapekṣayā śeṣo vijñāyata ityevamartham‌| na camalakītarā, drīṇītaretyatra śrutāpekṣayā śeṣatvamupapadyate; ṅyo'nekāctvāt‌| tasmānna bhavatyatra hrasvatvaprasaṅgaḥ| `strītarā' iti| styāyaterḍaṭ‌ ḍitvāṭṭilopaḥ, valilopaśca (6.1.66), ṭitvān‌ ṅīp‌| vaktavayaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt‌ kṛnnadyā na bhaviṣyatīti| `lakṣmītarā' iti| `avitṝstṝtantribhya īḥ' (da.u.1.82) `rlakṣermuṭ‌ ca', (da.u.1.84) itīkārapratayayānto lakṣmīśabdo vyutpāditaḥ| kṛnnadyayaṃ bhavati|| 45. ugitaśca| (6.3.45) `śreyasitarā' iti| īyasuni parataḥ `praśasyasya śraḥ' (5.3.60) iti praśasyaśabdasya śrādeśaḥ, `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp‌| `viduṣītarā' iti| videḥ parasya laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, tasya `videḥ śaturvasuḥ' (7.1.36) iti vasvādeśaḥ, `vasoḥ samprasāraṇam‌' (6.4.131) parapūrvatvam‌, pūrvavanṅīp‌| `puṃvadbhāvo'pyatra pakṣe vaktavyaḥ' iti| śreyastarā, vidbattareti pakṣe yathā syāt‌| `vidbattarā' iti| `vasusraṃsu' (8.2.72) iti sakārasya dakāraḥ `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti takāraḥ| `prakarṣayogāt‌' ityādinopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe| śabdānāṃ vyutpattau pravṛttau ca na vastusannidhānaṃ pradhānaṃ kāraṇam‌, api tu vivakṣaiva| na caivaṃ pūrvaṃ prakarṣayogāt‌ strītvaṃ vivakṣitam‌| tasmādastrīpratyayāntādevātiśāyikena bhavitavyam‌| ātiśāyikapratyayāntāttu strīpratyayeneti siddhaṃ śreyastaretyādi rūpam‌| nanu ca ṅyābgrahaṇaṃ tadantāt taddhitavidhānārthamityuktam‌, tatkathamastrīpratyayāntāt‌ taddhitaprakarṣapratyayo yujyate? naitata; atra viṣaye strotvataddhitārthayoryugapadvivakṣāmabhipretya taduktam‌, na tu yatra viṣaye prāk‌ prakarṣārthena sambandhāt‌ strītvasya vivakṣā nāsti tamabhipretyeti kimatra na yujyate|| 46. ānmahataḥ samānādhikaraṇajātīyayoḥ| (6.3.46) `mahādevaḥ, mahābrāhmaṇaḥ' iti| `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ| `mahābāhuḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| `lakṣaṇoktatvāt‌' ityādinā paramatamāviṣkṛtya nirākaroti| syādetat‌--uttarapadena samāsaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ, samāse hi satyuttarapadaṃ bhavati, sa ca samāso lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) mahato yaḥ pratipadoktaḥ `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā sākṣādviśeṣavihita sa eva gṛhyate, na tu yo lākṣaṇikaḥ sāmānyalakṣaṇoktaśca samāsaḥ--mahatputra iti? atra `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) iti sāmānyalakṣaṇena vihitatvāt‌, tasmādatra na bhaviṣyatīti| yadyevam‌, bahuvrīhāvapi na syāt‌; tasyāpi lākṣaṇikatvāt‌| `tadartham‌' ityādi| bahuvrīhāvapyāttvaṃ yatā syādityevamarthaṃ samānādhikaraṇagraham̐ karttavyam‌| tatra satadyeṣā paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate| yadyupatiṣṭhate samānādhikaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; mahato yaḥ pratipadoktaḥ samāsastasya samānādhikaraṇapadatvāt‌| tasyāścānupasthāne sati bahuvrīhāvapyāttvaṃ bhavati| asati tu samānādhikaraṇagrahaṇe tayā paribhāṣayehopasthātavyam‌| tataśca yatā mahatputra ityatra na bhavati, tathā bahuvrīhāvapi mahābāhurityatra na syāt‌| `amāhan‌ mahān‌ sampanno mahadbhūtaścandramā iti yatrārthe cvyanto mahacchabdo varttate tatraiva bhūtaśabdo'pi, tasmāt‌ sāmānādhikaraṇye satadyāttvena bhavitavyam‌'--iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākattumāha--`amahān‌ mahan‌' ityādi| `mahadbhūtaḥ' iti| mahacchabdāt `abhūtatadbhāve' (5.4.50) ityādinā cviḥ, tasya `ūryādicviḍācaśca' (1.4.61) iti gatisaṃjñakatvādbhūtaśabdena `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| `gauṇatvāt‌' ityādi| loke hi śabdāduccaritādgauṇamukhyārthasambhave sati mukhyārthaṃevaṃ sampratyayo bhavati, na tu gauṇe'pradāne| tathā hi--`gaurānīyatām‌' ityukte sāsnādimānevānīyate, na tu bāhīka iti| tasmādihāpi mahacchabdāduccāritānmukhya eva mahadarthe sampratyayo bhavati, na gauṇe| gauṇaścātra mahadarthaḥ| tadabhidhānācca mahacchabdo'pi gauṇa iti na bhavatyāttvam| nanu ca mahattvena yuktaścandramā mahāneva, tadayuktaṃ mahadarthasya gauṇatvam‌? naitadasti; sarvatraiva hi cvyantenārtha āśritapūrvāvastha upacaritottarāvastha ucyate, tasmādihāpi candramā amahattvapūrvāvastho mahacchabdenocyamāna upacaritamahattvānugatottarāvastha eva ucyata iti yuktāsya gauṇatā| yadi gauṇatvānmahacchabdasyāttvamiha na bhavati, tadā puṃvadbhāvo'pi na syāt‌, amahatī brāhmaṇī mahatī sampannā mahadbhūteti; vṛddhyāttve ca gauṇasya gośabdakhya na syātām‌, gaurvāhīkastiṣṭhatīti vṛddhirna syāt‌ `gauto ṇit‌' (7.1.99) iti gauṇād‌ gauśabdāt‌ parasya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇittve'sati gāṃ vāhīkamānayetyatra `auto'mśasoḥ' (6.1.93) ityāttvaṃ na syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; puṃvadbhāvastāvat‌ `striyāḥ puṃvat‌' (6.3.34) iti yogavibhāgādbhaviṣyati| yogavibāgaścāvaśyaṃ karttavyo garbhibhārya ityādyarthaḥ, mahatyā ghāso mahāghāsa ityādyarthaśca; so'nyārthaḥ kriyamāṇa etadartho'pi bhaviṣyati| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi yogavibhāge naivātra puṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, mahadarthasya gauṇatvāt‌, yogavibhāgasya cānyatra caritārthatvāt‌? evaṃ tarhi `puṃvatkarmadhāraya' (6.3.42) iti sūtre dvitīyaḥ puṃvaditi yogavibhāgaḥ kiṣyate, sa gauṇārtho bhaviṣyati| vṛddhyāttvābhāvadoṣo'pi na prasajati; yasmād‌vākyāt‌ tatra gauṇatvaṃ pratīyate| padsaya tu mukhya evārthaḥ, na ca padasaṃskāravelāyāṃ vākyārtho'pekṣyate| `mahādāttve' ityādi| samānādhikaraṇa āttvapuṃvadbhāvau vidhīyamānau vyadhikaraṇe na prāpnutaḥ| tasmādvayadhikaraṇe'pyuttarapade ghāsādau mahadāttavasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam‌| upasaṃkhyānamityasya pratipādanamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--`ānmahataḥ' (6.3.46) ityatrāpi `āt‌' iti yogavibhāgaṃ kariṣyati, tena mahatyā ghāso mahāghāsa ityādāvāttvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| sa cāvaśyaṃ yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ--aṣṭākapālamityādyartham‌, so'nyārthaṃ kriyamāṇa etadartho'pi bhavati| `puṃvadvacanaṃ ca' ityādi| ghāsakaraviśiṣṭeṣvityapekṣyate| puṃvadbhāvasya vacanaṃ vyākhyānaṃ karttavyam‌, tacca pūrvameva kṛtam‌| `aṣṭanaḥ kapāle' ityādi| atrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tacca pratipādanaṃ pūrvameva kṛtam‌| `aṣṭākāpālam‌' iti| aṣṭasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtamiti `taddhitārtha' (2.1.51) ityādinā samāsaḥ, `saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' (4.2.16) ityaṇ‌, tasya `dvigorluganapatye' (4.1.88) iti luka| `aṣṭakapālaṃ brāhmaṇasya' iti| aṣṭānāṃ kapālānāṃ samāhāroṣṭakapālam‌, samāhāre dviguḥ| atra pātrāditvāt (vā.159) striyāṃ na bhāṣyate| tena `dvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅīb‌ na bhavati| `gavi ca yukte' ityādi| gośabde cottarapeda yuktārthe gamyamāne'ṣṭanśabdasyāttvasya pratipādanaṃ karttavyam‌| tacca pratipādanaṃ pūrvameva kṛtam‌| `aṣṭāgavena śakaṭena' iti| aṣṭhau gāvo yuktā asminniti tripado'yaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ| yuktaśabdastu gamyamānatvādvatau na prayujyate, yathā dadhyodana ityatropasiktaśabdaḥ| yadi ca bahuvrīhirayam‌, tadā `gorataddhitaluki' (5.4.92) iti ṭac‌ samāsānto na prāpnoti; tatpuruṣādhikārāt‌? mā bhūt‌ ṭac‌ `ac‌ pratyanvavapūrvāt‌' (5.4.75) ityatra ajiti yogavibhāgāt‌ bhaviṣyati, yathā--kṛṣṇabhūmaḥ, padyanāma ityādau| atha vā--aṣṭānāṃ gavāṃ samāhāro'ṣṭagavam‌, aṣṭagavena yuktamaṣṭāgavam‌| na caivaṃ yuktaśabdasya prayogaḥ prasajati; padaikadeśasya prayogāt‌, yathā--satyabhāmā bhāmā, bhīmaseno bhīmaḥ, balabhadro bala iti| `ekādaśa' ityatrāpi tata eva yogavibhāgādāttvaṃ veditavyam‌| yogavibhāgasya ca liṅgam‌--`prāgekādaśabhyaḥ' (5.3.49) iti nirdeśaḥ| `tapakaram̐ vispaṣṭārtham‌' iti| atha bhinnakālānāṃ nivṛttyartha kasmānna bhavati? bhāvyamānenāṇā savarṇānāmagrahaṇāt‌| guṇāntarabhinnānāṃ tarhi grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? guṇānāmabhedakatvāt‌|| 47. dvyaṣṭanaḥ saṃkhyāyāmabahuvrīhyaśītyoḥ| (6.3.47) saṃkhyātānudeśo'tra na bhavati| yadi hi syādaṣṭano'śītau pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, tathā ca tasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt‌| pratiṣiddhe hyāttve savarṇadīrghatvena bhavitavyam| alpāctaratvāccāśītiśabdasya pūrvanipātekarttavye paranipātena lakṣaṇavyabhicāracihnena sakhyātānudeśābhāvaḥ sūcitaḥ| `dvādaśa' iti| dvau ca daśa ceti dvandvaḥ| atha vā dvābhyāmadhikādaśeti samānādhikaraṇādhikāre śākapārthivādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamuttarapadalopaśca' (vā.83) ityuttarapadalopī tatpuruṣa samāsaḥ| evaṃ `dvāviṃśatiḥ' ityādāvapi veditavyam‌| `dvaumāturaḥ' iti| dvayormātrorapatyamiti vigṛhya taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tataḥ `māturutsaṃkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ' (4.1.115) ityaṇ‌; ukāraścāntādeśaḥ| `dvitrāḥ' iti| dvau vā trayo veti vigṛhya `saṅkhyayāvyaya' (2.2.25) ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ, `bahuvrīhau saṃkhyeye' (5.4.73) ityādinā ḍac‌ samāsāntaḥ, ṭilopaḥ| `dvidaśāḥ' iti| pūrvavaḍḍac‌, bahuvrīhiḥ| dvirdaśeti vigrahaḥ| subarthe'yaṃ samāsaḥ| atra hi daśasambandhinyāvṛttirdaśaśabdena lakṣyamāṇā dviśabdena saṃkhyāyate| tena dvau daśakāvityayamartho veditavyaḥ| samāsaḥ subarthaṃ gamayituṃ samartha iti vṛttau suj‌ na prayujyate| `dvyaśītiḥ' iti| pūrvavaddvandvaḥ; uttarapadalopī vā tatpuruṣaḥ| `prāk‌ śatāt‌' ityādi| śatāt‌ prāgayā saṃkhyā tadvācinyuttarapade dvyaṣṭana āttvaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vibhāṣā catvariṃśata' (6.3.49) ityatra vakṣyamāṇavibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ siṃhāvalokinatanyāyenehāpyupatiṣṭate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena prāk‌ śatādyā saṃkhyā tadvācinyattarapade bhaviṣyati| śatādivācini tu na bhaviṣyati| evamuttarayorapi yogayoḥ prākśatāt‌ kāryaṃ bhavatīti veditavyam‌| 48. trestrayaḥ| (6.3.48) `trayaḥ' iti| sakārānto'yamādeśaḥ| kuta etat‌? sandhivelādiṣu trayodaśīśabdapāṭhāt‌| akārānte hi sati trayadaśīti pāṭhaḥ syāt‌| `trayodaśa, trayorviśatiḥ' iti| `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66) iti rutvam‌ `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityattvam‌, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) trirdaśa iti pūrvavat‌ sujarthe bahuvrīhiḥ, ḍac‌ samāsāntaḥ|| 49. vibhāṣā catvāriṃśatprabhṛtau sarveṣām‌| (6.3.49) sarvagrahaṇaṃ dvyaṣṭanorapi yathā syādityevamartham‌; itarathā hi `anantarasyā vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti trereva syāt‌| maṇḍukaplutinyāyena dvyaṣṭana ityetadapīhānuvartiṣyate, tato'yamadoṣa iti cet‌? evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthaṃ sarvagrahaṇamiti|| 50. hṛdayasya hṛllekhayadaṇlāseṣu| (6.3.50) `hṛlleśaḥ'| `karmaṇyaṇ‌' (3.2.1) `hṛdyaḥ' iti| `prāgdhitād‌ yat‌' (4.4.75)| `hārdam‌' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) iti prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌| `hṛllāsaḥ' iti| lasanaṃ lāsaḥ, bhāve ghañ‌| `kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate' (vā.86) iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `lekha ityaṇantasya grahaṇam‌' iti| etacca kātyayanaprabhṛtīnāṃ pramāṇabhūtānāṃ vacanādbijñāyate| kātyāyanenoktaṃ yat‌--`aṇgrahaṇe svarūpagrahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam‌, kṛtaḥ? lekhagrahaṇāt‌' iti| bhāṣyakṛtāpyuktam‌--`sarvatraivottarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe svarapagrahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam‌, kutaḥ? lekhagarahaṇāt‌' iti| etacca vacanadvayaṃ kathamupapadyate? yadi lekha ityaṇantasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati, nānyathā| atha ghañantasyāpi lekhaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate? ityāha--`ghañi tu' ityādi| `etadeva' ityādi| aṇgrahaṇādeva tadantasya lekhaśabdasya grahaṇe siddhe tasya pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ kriyaṇāṇametajjñāpayati--uttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantaṃ na gṛhyata iti| teneha yadaṇgrahaṇe gharūpādisūtre ca (6.3.43) ghādipratyayagrahaṇe pratyayamātraṃ gṛhyate, na tadantavidhiriti bhāvaḥ|| 51. vā śokaṣyañrogeṣu| (6.3.51) `sauhārdyam‌' iti| śobhanaṃ hṛdayamasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| tataḥ ṣyañ‌| `hṛdayaśabdena' ityādi| hṛdayaśabdeneha samānarthe hṛcchabde sati yadā hṛcchabadasya prayogaḥ, tadā hṛcchoka iti bhaviṣyati, yadā hṛdayaśabdasaya tadā hṛdayaśoka iti, tataśca tenaiva prakṛtyantareṇa siddhe vikalpavidhānamidaṃ na karttavyam‌| etat‌ kriyate tu prapañcārtham| sa eva siddhaprayogo'nena sūtreṇa kathyata iti|| 52. pādasya padājyātigopahateṣu| (6.3.52) `padājiḥ' iti| `aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.230)| `padātiḥ' iti| `ata sātatyagamane' (dhā.pā.38)| `ajyatibhyāñca pāde ca' ityauṇādika iṇpratyayaḥ' iti| atra `janighasibhyāmiṇ‌' (da.u.1.58) ityata iṣgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| yadauṇādika iṇpratyayaḥ, evaṃ sati tatra `ajervyaghañapoḥ' (2.4.56) iti vībhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| `padagaḥ' iti| `antātyantādhvadūrapāra' (3.2.48) ityādau sūtre `ḍaprakaraṇa'nyatrāpi dṛśyate iti vaktavyam‌' (vā.256) ityuktam‌| tena pādaśabde'pyupapade gamerḍapratyayaḥ| `padopahataḥ' iti| `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ, pūrvatra tūpapadasamāsaḥ| akārānto'yamādeśaḥ| prathamāyāśca lukaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśa| `pādaśabdo'yam‌' ityādi| `karṣātvato ghaño'nta udāttaḥ' (6.1.159) ityantodāttatve prāpte pādaśabdasya vṛṣaditvādādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, tataśca tasya sthāne padādeśo vidhīyamāna āntaratamyādādyudātta eva syāt‌ antodāttaśceṣyate| tasmādāntodātto nipātyate upadeśāvasthāyāmeva| `tena' ityādināntodāttanipādanasya phalaṃ darśayati| `padājiḥ, padātiḥ' ityādināpyupadeśagrahaṇasya| yadi `gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) iti prakṛtasvare kṛte padaśabdasyāntodāttatavaṃ nipātyate, tadā tasya satiśiṣṭatvaṃ syāt‌, tataśca padājiḥ padātiḥ padaga ityeṣu kṛtsvaro bādhyate; satiśiṣṭasvarasya balīyastvāta| upadeśāvasthāyāṃtvantodāttatvanipātane kṛtsvara eva satiśiṣṭo bhavati| atastena samāsasyaivāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati na padaśabdasya|| 53. padyatyatadarthe| (6.3.53) `padyāḥ' iti| `vidhyatyadhanuṣā' (4.4.83) iti yat‌| `pādyam‌' iti| pādaśabdāt‌ `tādarthye yat‌' (5.4.24) ityanuvartamāne `pādārghābhyāñca' (5.4.25) iti yat‌| `padbhāve' ityādi| padbhāve karttavye'smiṃścaratyarthe ya ik‌ tasmin‌ kṛte padbhāvasyopasaṃkhyānam‌-pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--paditi yogavibāgāt‌ siddhamiti| parpādiṣveva `pādaḥ pacc' (4.4.10) iti pāṭhāt‌ siddhamiti vā| `śarīrāvayavasya' [`śarīrāvayavavacanasya--kāśikā] ityādi| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate? kecidāhuḥ--pūrvasūtre sāmarthyāccharīrāvayavasaya pādaśabdasya grahaṇam‌| tatrājyātiprabhṛtīni trīṇyuttarapadāni gamanārthāni, caturthaṃ tu hananārtham‌| teṣu gamanādhiṣu prāṇyaṅgasyaiva pādaśabdasya karaṇabhāvaḥ sambhavati, naitarasya| tasmāt‌ tatra prāṇyahgavācinaḥ pādaśabdasya grahaṇam‌, ihapi tadevānuvarttata iti yuktam‌--śarīrāvayavasya grahaṇamiti| yadyevam‌, tadā `ṛcaḥ śe' (6.3.55) ityatrāpi śarīrāvayavasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ṛksambandhina śarārāvayavavacanasyāsambhavāt‌| caturthabhāgavacanaḥ pādaśabdo'tri grahiṣyate| `tena' ityādi| yata evaṃ śarārāvayavavacanapādaśabdasyeha grahaṇam‌, tena `paṇapādamāṣa' (5.1.34) ityādo sūtre yaḥ pādaśabdastasya na padādeśo bhavati; na hyasau śarīrāvayavavacanaḥ, ki tarhi? parimāṇavacanaḥ| kuta etat‌? paṇādibhiḥ parimāṇavacanaiḥ sāhacaryāt‌| `dvipādyam‌, tripādyam‌' iti| `tena krītam‌' (5.1.37) ityarthe yatpratyayaḥ|| 54. himakāṣihatiṣu ca| (6.3.54) `paddhimam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `patkāṣiṇaḥ' iti| `supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye' (3.2.78) iti ṇiniḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ| `paddhatiḥ' iti| pādābhyāṃ hanyata iti paddhatiḥ| ktinnantena hatiśabdena `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ|| 55. ṛcaḥ śe| (6.3.55) `śe' iti taddhitasya śaspratyayasyāvayavabhūto yaḥ śaśabdastasyeha grahaṇam‌; ṛkpādāt‌ parasayāsambhavāt‌| nanu ca pāde śete iti `adhikāraṇe śeteḥ' (3.2.15) ityaci kṛte pādaśa itayatra śīṅsambandhī śaśabdaḥ sambhavati? naitadasti; na hi ṛkpāda upapade śeterdhātoracā bhavitavyam‌; tatra tu śayanagsambhavat‌, anabhidhānādvā| yo'pi `lomādipāmādipicchādibyaḥ sanelacaḥ' (5.2.100) iti śo vidhīyate, so'pi naiva ṛkpādat‌ paraḥ sambhavati; tatrānabhidhānāt‌| lomādiṣu tasyāpāṭhācca|| 56. vā ghoṣamiśraśabdeṣu| (6.3.56) ghoṣaśabdaśabadaśabdābyāṃ [`ghoṣaśabdaśabdābhyāṃ--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, miśraśabde ca `pūrvasadṛśa' (2.1.31) ityādinā tṛtīyāsamāsaḥ| `niṣke ceti vakatavyam‌' iti| niṣkaśabde cottarapade pādaśabdasya padityayamādeśo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`himakāṣihatiṣu ca' (6.3.54) ityataścakāro'trānuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| atha vā--sūtre `vā' iti yoga vibhāgaḥ kriyate tena niṣke cottarapade bhaviṣyatīti|| 57. udakasyodaḥ saṃjñāyām‌| (6.3.57) `udamegho nāma yasyodameghiḥ putraḥ' iti| pituraprasiddhatvādudameghasya tadapatyena samākhyātuṃ yasyodameghiḥ putra ityuktam‌| etena yasyaudameghirapatyaṃ sa udamegho veditavyamiti darśayati| evam‌--`udavāho nāma yasyaudavāhiḥ putraḥ' ityatrāpi veditavyam‌| udamegha iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, udakapūrṇo vā meghaḥ--śākapārthivāditvā(vā.83) nmadhyamapadalopī tatpuruṣaḥ, udakaṃ bahatati udavāhaḥ--`karmaṇyaṇ‌' (3.2.1)| `vaktavayaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--ihāpi sa eva cakāro'nuvarttate anuktasa muccayārthaḥ, na cānyat‌ samuccetavyamastīti| udabhāvamevāsāvudakaśabdasya saṃjñāyāṃ samuccinoti| tatra kasya samuccinoti? yasya na prāpnoti| kasya na prāpnoti? uttarapadabhūtasya| tena saṃjñāyāmuttarapadasyāpyudakaśabdayoda ityayamādeśo bhavati| `lohitodaḥ, kṣīrodaḥ' iti bahuvrīhi-|| 58. peṣaṃvāsavāhanadhiṣu ca| (6.3.48) `upadeṣam‌' iti| `piṣlṛ sañcūrṇane' (dā.pā.1452) `udadhiḥ' iti| `karmaṇyadhikaraṇe ca' (3.3.93) iti kripratyayaḥ| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| asaṃjñārthamidaṃ vacanam‌; tenodadhiriti ghaṭādiriha veditavyaḥ, na samudraḥ; tatra pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌--udadhiśabde samudrasya saṃjñeti kṛtvā|| 59. ekahalādau pūrayitavye'nyatarasyām‌| (6.3.59) yadyekaśabdaḥ sukhyāvacana iha gṛhyate, tadānarthakaṃ tasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| na hi kvacit‌ dvau bahavo vā hala ādibhūtāḥ sambhavanti, yadvyavacchedārthamekagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tasmādasahāyavacano'yamekaśabdaḥ| evamapi yaḥ kaścidaviśiṣṭa eko'sahāyo hal‌ ādiryasya tadekahalādyuttarapadaṃ gṛhyeta, tadodakasthānamityatrāpi syāt‌| atrāpi hi sakāro'sahāya eva ekahal‌| yadyaneke varṇā yugapaduccāryeran‌, uccaritā vā varṇā na pradhvaṃseran‌, tadā sasahāyasyāpi syādāditvam‌| na caivam‌; yato varṇā na yugapaduccāryante, te coccāritapradhvasinaḥ| tasmānnāstyeva kvacit‌ kiṃcidanekahalāditvaṃ yadvyavacchedārthamekahalādāvityucyate| uktaṃ cedam‌| ato'smādeva vacanādviśiṣṭamātraikahalāditvaṃ vivakṣitamityetat‌ sarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvā tadeva viśiṣṭaṃ darśayitumāha--`eko'sahāyaḥ' ityādi| yaścātulyajātīyenāpyacā vinaiko hal‌ sa ādiryasyeti tadekahalādi| tulyajātīyena cavyavahitenāpi yasya tadekahalādīhāśrīyeta tadā na kvacit‌ syāt‌; tathāvidhasyottarapadasya pūrayitavyavācino'bhāvāt‌, ucyate cedam‌| tasmādvacanaprāmāṇyāt‌ tulyajātīyena halā'nantareṇāvyavahitena vinā yo varttate so'sahāya evehaikaśabdenāsahāyavācinā vivakṣita iti gamyate| evaṃdidho halādiryasya tadekahālādi| na caivaṃvidhaḥ sthānaśabdasyādirhalastītyekahalādigarahaṇena sthānaśabdo nivarttate| `pūriyatavyavācini' iti| udakādinā dravyeṇāntarvyāptavyaḥ pūrayitavya ityucyeta| tadvaktuṃ śīlamasyeti tācchīliko ṇiniḥ|| 60. manthaidanasaktubindujarabhārahāravīvadhagāheṣu ca| (6.3.60) dravadravyasaṃpṛktāḥ saktavo mantha ityucyate| tatra manthaśabdo'yaṃ yadyavyutpannaṃ prātipadikam‌, tadodakena mantha iti `tṛtīyā' (2.1.30) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| atha vyutpādyate--madhyata iti manthaḥ, tadā `karttṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ| sakatvodanābhyāṃ `annena vyañjanam‌' (2.1.34) iti samāsaḥ| binduvajravīvadhaiḥ `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) iti bhārahāragāhairaṇantaiḥ `upapadamatiṅ' (2.2.19) iti|| 61. iko hvasvo'ṅ‌yo gālasya| (6.3.61) `grāmaṇiputraḥ' iti| grāmaṃ nayatītī `satyūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip‌| `agragrāmābhyāñca nayateḥ' (kātyā.vā.5064) iti ṇatvam‌| `gārgīputraḥ' iti| `yañaśca' (4.1.16) iti gārgyaśabdānṅīp‌, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakārasya lopaḥ, `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) iti yakārasya ca| atha dikalpārthameva gālavagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`anyatarasyām‌' ityādi| `kārīṣagandhīputraḥ' iti| karīṣagandhyāyāyaḥ putra iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ `ṣyaṅaḥ samprasāraṇam‌' (6.1.13) ityādinā samprasāraṇam‌, `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti parapūravatvam‌, `halaḥ' (6.4.2) (iti) samprasāraṇasya dīrghaḥ| `iyaṅuvaṅbhāvinām‌' ityādi| iyaṅuvaṅau bhāvinau yeṣāṃ te tathocyante| `śrīkulam‌' iti| iyaṅbhāvina udāharaṇam‌| `bhrūkulam‌' iti| uvaṅbhāvinaśca| `kaṇḍībhūtam‌, vṛṣalībhūtam‌' iti| avapyayānām‌| kāṇḍavṛṣalaśabdābhyāṃ `abhūtatadbhāve' (5.4.50) ityādinā cviḥ, `asya cvau' (7.4.32) itītvam‌| `bhrūkuṃsaḥ' iti| bhrūścāsau kuṃsaśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| evaṃ `bhrukuṭiḥ' ityatrāpi| `vaktavyam‌' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--pṛṣodarāditvādbhrukuṃsādīnāmakāro bhaviṣyatīti|| 62. eka taddhite ca| (6.3.62) `ekarūpyam‌' iti| `hetumanuṣyabhyo'nyatarasyāṃ rūpyaḥ' (4.3.81) iti rūpyaḥ| `ekamayam‌' iti| `mayaṭ‌ ca' (4.3.82) iti, mayaṭ‌| `ekatvam‌, ekatā' iti| ` tasya bhāvasatvatalau' (5.1.119) iti tvatalau| yadaikaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāparo bhavati tadaitadudāharaṇam‌| yadā saṃkhyeyaparo bhavati| tadā `tvalorguṇavacanasya' (vā.730) iti puṃvadbhāvenaiva siddham‌| nanu ca guṇamuktavān‌ guṇavacanaḥ, yaśca guṇamātramabhidhāya tadviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamāha sa guṇavacano bhavati| tadyathā--kṛṣṇaḥ paṭaḥ, śuklaḥ paṭa iti; ayaṃ punarekaśabdo na kvacidapi dravyavyatiriktaṃ guṇamāha, sarvadā saṃkhyeye dravye vartata iti kṛtvā, tat‌ kuto'saya puṃvadbhāvaḥ? ayuktamidamabhidhīyate; tathā hi--prasiddhamāmāśrityaikādayaḥ saṃkhyeyavacanā ityucyante, na tveṣāṃ saṃkhyāne vṛttirnābhyupeyeti| tathā hi--`dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane' (1.4.22) ityatra tvekaśabdaḥ saṃkhyāyāmeva prayukto na saṃkhyeye dravye| `liṅgaviśiṣṭasya' ityādi| puṃlliṅgo ya ekaśabdaḥ sa svabhāvata eva hrasvānta iti na tadgrahaṇaṃ prayojayati, api tu strīliṃgaviśiṣṭasyaiva| tasyaiva hi hrasvatvaṃ vidhīyamānamarthavadbhavati| nanu naitasyāpyekaśabdasya ya ekārastasya hrasvatvaṃ vidhīyamānamarthavadbhavati, tat‌ kimucyate liṅgaviśiṣṭasyaikaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ prayojayati? ityāha--`acā gṛhyamāṇam‌' ityādi| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ prati kāmacāraḥ| tathā hyuktam‌--viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvayoryatheṣṭatvāditi| tatra yadi gṛhyamāṇenaikaśabdenājviśiṣyate--ekaśabdasya yo'jiti, tadaikasambandhina ekārasya harasvatvaṃ vidhīyamānamarthavadbhavati| puṃlliṅgasyāpyekaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ prayojati| na cātra gṛhyamāṇenājviśiṣyate; ekārasya hrasavasyāniṣṭatvāt‌| na hyaniṣṭārthā śāstre praklṛptiryuktā (bho.pa.sū.107), tasmādācā gṛhyamāṇa ekaśabdo'tra viśiṣyate| tena liṅgaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇam‌| ekaśabdasya hrasvo bhavati, kiṃ viśiṣṭascācaḥ? ajantasyetyarthaḥ| tatrālo'ntyasyaiva hrasvatvena bhavitavyam‌, tacca ṭābantasyaiva sārthakam‌, na puṃlliṅgasya; na hi hrasvasyaiva hrasve vidhīyamāne kaścidarthaḥ sidhyati| itikaraṇo hetau| yata evācā gṛhyamāṇa ekaśabdo'tra viśiṣyate, tena liṅgaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇamekaśabdasya prayojayati|| 63. ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasorbahulam‌| (6.3.63) `revatiputraḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| evaṃ `rohiṇiputraḥ' ityādāvapi| kumārīṃ dadātīti `kumāridā'| urvī dadātīti `urvidā'| `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3)| `phālgunī' ityādi| phālgunī cāsau paurṇamāsau ceti phālgunī paurṇamāsau, `viśeṣaṇam‌' (2.1.57) ityādinā samāsaḥ| evaṃ `jagatīcchandaḥ' ityatrāpi| `śilavaham‌, śilaprastham‌' iti| śilāśabdasaya vahaprasthaśabdābhyāṃ `ṣaṣṭhī' (2.2.8) ityanena samāsaḥ| `lomakāgṛham‌, lomakāṣaṇḍam‌' iti| atrāpi lomakāśabdasaya gṛhaṣaṇḍaśabdābhyām‌| `ajakṣīreṇa iti| atrāpyajāśabdasya kṣīraśabdena| `ūrṇamṛt‌' [`ūrṇamṛdā'--kāśikā. ūrṇamravā--padamañjarī] iti| ūrṇāsahitā mṛd‌ ūrṇamṛt‌| śākaparthivāditvāduttarapadalopī samāsaḥ|| 64. tve ca| (6.3.64) `saṃjñāyāmasambhavācchandasyevodāharaṇāni bhavanti' iti| evakāreṇa saṃjñāyā vyavacchedaḥ kriyate| na hi tvapratyaye ṅyāporhrasvatve kṛte kasyacit‌ saṃjñā gamyate| tena saṃjñāyāmasambhavācchandasyevodāharaṇāni bhavanti|| 65. iṣṭakeṣīkāmalānāṃ citatūlabhāriṣu| (6.3.65) `iṣṭakacitam‌' iti| `kartṛkaraṇe' (2.1.32) ityādinā samāsaḥ| `iṣīkatūlam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `mālabhāriṇī' iti| mālāṃ bharttuṃ śīlamasyā iti tācchīlye ṇiniḥ (3.2.78), `upapadamatiṅ‌' (2.2.19) iti samāsaḥ| `iṣṭakādibhistadantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' iti| bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterityabhiprāyaḥ|| 66. khityanavyayasya| (6.3.66) `kālimmanyā, hariṇimmanyā' iti| kālīmātmānaṃ manyate hariṇīmātmānaṃ manyata iti `ātmamāne khaśca' (3.2.83) iti khaś‌, divāditvācchyan‌, anena hrasvatvam‌, uttarasūtreṇa mum‌| ihājantasya hrasvatvamabhyupagamyam‌; anyathā vāṅmanya ityatrāpi syāt‌| ajantasya hrasvavidhāne sati paratvānmumi kṛte'najantatvādhrasvo na prāpnotīti yo manyeta taṃ pratyāha--`mumā hrasvo na bādhyate' iti| atraiva hetumāha--`anyathā hi' ityādi| hrasvaḥ śiṣyate-vidhīyate yena tat‌ hrasvaśāsanaṃ `khityanavayayasya ' ityetadvavacanam‌| yadi hi mumā hrasvo bādhyeta, tato hrasvaśāsanāmidamanavakāśaṃ syāt‌, tatastasyānarthakyameva syāt‌| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti mumā hrasvo na bādhyate| tena virodhābhāvādubhayaṃ bhavati--hrasavaḥ, mum‌ ca| kathaṃ punarmumā hrasvasaya bādhā śaṅkitā? kathaṃ vā hrasvaśāsanasyānavakāśatvam‌, yāvatā khityajantasyāviśeṣeṇa mum‌ vidhīyate, hrasvatvaṃ bādhā śaṅkitā? kathaṃ vā hrasvaśāsanasyānavakāśatvam‌, yāvatā khityajantasyāviśeṣeṇa mum‌ ca| kathaṃ punarmumā hrasvasya bādhā śaṅkitā? kathaṃ vā hrasvaśāsanasyānavakāśatvam‌, yāvatā khityajantasyāviśeṣeṇa mum‌ vidhīyate, hrasvatavaṃ tu sāmarthyāddīrghasya, na hi hrasavasya hrasvavidhānamarthavadbhavati, evaṃ ca stanandhayādiṣu kṛtārthatvānmumeva hrasvenāpavādena kālimmanyādiṣu bādhyeta? evaṃ manyate--apavādaviṣaye'pi mumā vidhānārthaṃ mumśāstrasyāvaśyamāvṛttiḥ kartatavyā; anyathā kālimmanyetyatara mum‌ na syāt‌| tataścāpavādaviṣaye'pi mumā pravarttamānena hrasavasya bādhā sambhāvyeta| anavakāśatvaṃ cātaevāpavādaviṣaye'pi mumpravṛtteriti| atha kathamatra khidantasya garahaṇam‌, yāvatā jñāpitametaduttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantavidhīrnāsti? (pu.pa.pā.26) tyata āha--`anavayayasyetyetadeva' ityādi| yadyatra khitpratayayamātraṃ gṛhyeta na tadantam‌, tatonavyayasyeti pratiṣedho'pārthakaḥ syāt‌| na hyavyayāt paraḥ khit‌ pratayayaḥ sambhavati; dhātoreva tasya vidhānāt‌| tataścānarthakatvādanavyayasyetyetannoktaṃ syāt‌| uktañca--tasmādetadevai tajjñāpayati--khidantasyātra grahaṇamiti|| 67. arurdviṣadajantasya mum‌| (6.3.67) `aruntudaḥ' iti| arustudatīti `viṣvaruṣostudaḥ' (3.2.35) iti khaś‌ saṃyogāntalopaḥ, tudādītvācchaḥ, ato guṇe (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| `dviṣantapaḥ' iti| dviṣantaṃ tāpayatīti `dviṣatparayostāpeḥ' (3.2.39) iti khac‌, `khaci hrasavaḥ' (6.4.94) iti hrasvatvam‌| `vidvanmanyaḥ' iti| vidvāṃsamātmānaṃ manyata iti, `ātmamāne khaśca' (3.2.83) iti khaś‌, `vasusraṃsudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ' (8.2.72) iti sakārasya dakāraḥ, `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) iti tasya nakāraḥ| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `yena vidhastadantasya' (1.1.72) ityanena tadantasyaiva bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`antagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| kṛtamajantakāryaṃ yasya sa kṛtājantakāryaṃ āgamī, tasyaivavidhasya pratipattiḥ pratītiryathā syādityevamarthamantagrahaṇam‌| antagrahaṇena hi kāryāntarasyānte'vasāne mum‌ kartavaya ityeṣo'rthaḥ sūcyate| ato'jantakārye hrasavatve kṛte paścānmum‌ bhavati| nanu ca mumā hrasvo na bādhyata ityanenaiva bhaviṣyatati sopapatiko'yamarthaḥ pratipāditaḥ, tat‌ kimarthametadantagrahaṇam‌? naitadasti; tena hi niravakāśād‌ hrasvaśāsanasya mumā hrasvo na bādhyata ityetāvanmātraṃ pratapāditam‌, na tu kṛtājantakāryasya mum‌ bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ, tataḥ paratvānmumi kṛta satyanajantasyāpi hrasvatvaṃ prasajyeta| atra ko doṣaḥ? khityantaharasavabhāvī nāstīti| yathā kālimmanya ityatra mumi kṛte satyanajantasyāpi hrasvatvaṃ bhavati, tathā vāṅmanya ityatra syāditi| tasmādantagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 68. ica ekāco'mpratyayavacca| (6.3.68) atra yadi `pratyayavacca' ityetāvaducyeta, tadā gāmmanya ityatra `auto'mśasoḥ' (6.1.93) ityāttvaṃ na sāt‌, iha ca strīmmanya iti--atrāpi `ami pūrvaḥ' (6.1.107) iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ, iha ca narammanya iti nṛśabdasya `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' (7.3.110) iti guṇaḥ| sāmānyātideśe viśeṣasyānatideśādvacanaṃ tviyaṅuvaṅarthameva kevalaṃ syāt‌, iyaṅuvaṅāvajādau pratyayamātrasāmānyena vidhīyamānau sāmānyātideśe'pi bhavata iti kṛtvā| `ampratyayavacca' ityevamucyamāne satyāttvādayo bhavanti, teṣāmapyampratyaya iṣṭatvāt‌| etat‌ sarvaṃ buddhau kṛtvāha--`ampratyayavacca' iti| etadeva vivṛṇoti--`dvitīyaikavacanavacca' iti| kathadhaṃ punarayamartho labhyate, yāvataikamamgrahaṇam‌, tena cābhāgamo niradiśyate, pratyayavaccetyetadaniṣṭaṃ syāt‌| atha pratyayastena viśiṣyata āgamo na nirdiṣṭaḥ syādityata āha--`amiti hi' ityādi| ekamapayamgrahaṇamārabhyamāṇaṃ yasmādubhayametat‌ sampādayati tasmādayamartho labhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `śriyammanyaḥ; bhrūvammanyaḥ' iti| `aciṃ śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādine yaṅvaṅau| `lekhābhrummanyaḥ' iti| pūrvasūtreṇa mumāgamaḥ| `atheha' ityādi| śriyamātmānaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ manyata ityupakramya-prastutya khaśpratyaye vihite kathaṃ bhavitavyam‌--kiṃ śriyammanyamati bhavitavyam‌, uta śrimanyamiti ? kathaṃ punaretatapakṣadvayaṃ sambhāvyate, yata evaṃ pṛcchati? śabdānāṃ dvidhā pravṛttidarśanāt‌| tathā hi--keṣāñcit‌ svaliṅgāparityāgeṇāpyarthāntare pravṛttirdṛṣṭā, yathā bhūtaśabdasya--bhūtamithaṃ brāhmaṇīti; keṣāñcit‌ svaliṅgapitayāgenā'pi sā dṛṣṭā, yathā praṣṭhaśabdasya--praṣṭhīti| tatra śrīśabdo brāhmaṇakule varttamāno yada svaliṅgaṃ na paratyajati, tadā śriyammanyamiti bhavitavyam; atha svaliṅgaṃ parityajaya napuṃsakaliṅgaṃ gṛhṇāti tadā `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) ityamo luki kṛte `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvatve ca śrimanyamiti bhavitavyamiti--evamimau dvāvapi pakṣau sambhāvyete| ata ubhayapakṣasambhave na jñāyate--kathaṃ bhavitavyam‌? atastatparijñānārthaṃ praśnaḥ| `śrimanyamiti bhavitavyamiti bhāṣye vyavasthāpitam‌' [`sthitam‌'--kāśikā] iti| nanu ca śrīśabdo'yaṃ strīliṅgo'rthāntare'pi vartamānaḥ svaliṅgamajahadeva varttate, tathā ca prayogo'pi dṛśyate--śiro me śrīḥ, yaśo me śrīriti; tat‌ kathaṃ śrimanyamiti bhāṣye vyavasthāpitam‌? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| yathā praṣṭhādayaḥ śabdāḥ puṃyogāt‌ striyāṃ vartamānāḥ paratyakatasvaliṅgā eva vartante--praṣṭhī, pravarī, gaṇakīti; tathā śrīśabdo'pyatra kulaviṣaye vartamāna iti bhāṣyakārasya matam‌| atasatanmatena `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) ityamo luki kṛte--śrimanyamiti| nanu ca nāprāpte lukyayamārabhyate, yathaiva `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) itīmaṃ lukaṃ bādhate, tathā `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) itīmamapi lukaṃ bādheta? api ca lugekapadāśrayatvādantaraṅgo viparyayāccāmāgamo bahiraṅgaḥ, tataḥ `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) ityantaraṅge luki karttavye bahiraṅgo'māgamo nāstyeva, tat kuto'tra luk‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvān‌ vidhīn‌ bādhante nottarān‌' (vyā.pa.10) iti| evamayamamāgamaḥ `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) itīmaṃ lukaṃ bādhiṣyate, na `khamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) itīmam‌| bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāpyatrāśakyā''śrayitum‌, iha hi doṣaḥ syāt‌--aruntuda iti| tadāśrayaṇe tu saṃyogāntalopo na syāt‌| saṃyogāntalope cāntaraṅge karttavye bahiraṅgasya mumāgamasyāsiddhatvena saṃyogāntatānupapatteḥ| tasmāt‌ prāptanimittā satīyamiha nāśrīyate| doṣā eva hi tasyā evamādayaḥ|| 69. vācaṃyamapurandarau ca| (6.3.69) `vācaṃyamaḥ' iti| vācaṃ yacchatīti `vaci yamo vrate' (3.2.40) iti khac‌| tatra vākśabdasayāmantatā nipātyate| `purandaraḥ' iti| `pūḥsaravayordārisahoḥ' (3.2.41) iti khac‌, `khaci hrasvaḥ' (6.4.94) iti hrasvatvam‌| atrāpi pūḥśabdasyāmantatā nipātyate| cākāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena `astusatyāgadasaya kāre' (vā.744) iti sarvaṃ na vaktavyaṃ bhavati|| 70. kāre satyāgadasya| (6.3.70) `satyaṃ karoti' ityanena karmaṇyaṇaṃ sūcayati| `satyasya kāraḥ' ityanenāpi ghañam‌| evaṃ `agadaṅkāraḥ' ityatrāpyaṇghañau veditavyau| `astuṅkāraḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ‌| astuśabdo vibhaktipratirūpako nipāto'bhyupagame vartate| astvityabhyupagamasya karaṇastuṅkāraḥ| `bhakṣaṅkāraḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ‌| `dhenumbhavyā' iti| `bhavyageya' (3.4.68) ityādinā kartari kṛtyaḥ| dhenuścāsau bhavyā ceti dhenumbhavyā| `lokampṛmaḥ' iti| `pṛṇa prīṇane', (dhā.pā.1329) lokaṃ pṛṇatīti mūlavibhujāditvāt‌ kaḥ| `anabhyāśamityaḥ' [`anamyāśamityam‌'--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| anabhyāśaṃ dūramityaṃ gantavyamasyetyanabhyāśamityaḥ| indhanamindhaḥ, bhāve ghañ‌| bhrāṣṭrasyendo `bhrāṣṭramindhaḥ'| agnerindho'gnimindhaḥ| `timiṅgilaḥ' iti| `gṛ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410)| timiṃ gilatīti parvavat‌ kaḥ, `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam‌, raparatvam‌, `aci vibhāṣā' (8.2.21) iti latvam‌| `giligilaḥ' iti| gilaṃ gilatīti pūrvavavat‌ kaḥ, ittvādi ca| `gilagile ca' iti| gilaṃ gilatīti gilagilaḥ| `ātaścopasarge' (3.1.136) ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt‌ kaḥ| pūrvatrāpyevaṃ kavidhāne na doṣaḥ| timīnāṃ gilagila ityasminnarthe vivakṣita idaṃ vaktavyam‌| atha timiṃ gilatīti timiṅgilaḥ, timiṅgalaṃ gilatītyedho'rtho yadā vivakṣyate tadā pūrveṇaiva siddhamiti nārtha etena| `uṣṭraṅkaraṇam‌, bhadraṅkaraṇam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsau| `putraṭ‌' iti| ṭakāro ṅībarthaḥ| kecittu śārṅgaravādiṣu putraśabdaṃ paṭhanti' iti| tān‌ prati nedamupasaṅkhyānaṃ karttavyam‌| `anyatrāpi dṛśyate' iti| anena śārṅgaravādiṣu putraśabdasya pāṭhaṃ draḍhayati|| 71. śyenatilasya pāte ñe| (6.3.71) `ñapratyaye pare' iti| ñaḥ pratyayo yasmāduttarapadāt‌ tat‌ tathoktam‌| `śyainampātā' iti| patanaṃ pātaḥ, bhāve ghañ‌, śyenasya pātaḥ śyenapātaḥ| `kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate' (vā.86) iti samāsaḥ, `ghañaḥ sāsyāṃ kriyeti ñaḥ' (4.2.58)|| 72. rātreḥ kṛti vibhāṣā| śra(6.3.72) `kṛdanta uttarade' iti| kathaṃ punastadantavidhirlabhyate, yāvatā jñāpitametat‌--`uttarapadādhikāre pratyayagrahaṇe tadantarvidhirnāsti' (pu.pa.pā.26) iti| rātriśabdādanantarasya kṛtayapratyayasyāsambhavāt‌ tadantavidhiravijñāyata iti cet‌? ayuktametat‌; sambhavati hi rātareranantaraḥ kṛtpratyayaḥ|
