rātririvācaratīti `acāre sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ kviv‌ vā' (vā.187) iti kvip‌, `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (3.1.32) iti dhātusaṃjñā, tṛc‌, iṭ‌, guṇāyādeśau--rātrayiteti| tadevaṃ sambhavatyanantare kṛtpratyaye tatraiva syāt‌ na tadante? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `arurdviṣadajantasya' (6.3.67) ityato'ntagrahaṇamanuvartate, tena tadanta eva kāryaṃ vijñāyata iti| evaṃ tarhyacārakvibantasyāpi rātriśabdasya kṛdanta uttarapade syāt‌| bhavatu| atha tu neṣyate? vyavasthitavibhāṣā'ṅgīkarttavyā| gauṇatvādvā rātriśabdasya na bhaviṣyati| gauṇatvaṃ punaḥ prāthamakalpikādarthadapetatvāt‌, yathā--vāhīko gaurityatra gośabdasya| `rātriñcaraḥ' iti| rātrau caratīti `careṣṭaḥ' (3.2.16) iti ṭaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ| `rātrimaṭaḥ' iti| aṭatītyaṭaḥ, pacādyac‌, `rātryaṭaḥ' [`rātrāvaṭaḥ' iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| `aprāptavibhādheyam‌' iti| nanu ca khidapi kṛdasti--rātrimmanyamiti, atra hi `arurdviṣadajantasya' (6.3.76) iti nityaṃ prāpnoti, `rātriñcaraḥ' ityādau na kenacit‌ prāpnoti; evañca prāpte cāprāpta iyaṃ vibhāṣā yuktetyata āha--`khiti hi nityaṃ mum‌ bhavati' iti| pūrvavipratiṣedhenetyabhiprāyaḥ| atra hi pūrvavipratiṣedha āśrīyate, khiti pūrveṇa nityaṃ mumbhavati| evañca khito'nyadeva kṛdantamasya vacanasyāvakāśaḥ| na ca kenacit‌ tatra prāpnotīti yuktamasyāprāptavibhāṣātvam‌|| 73. nalopo nañaḥ| (6.3.73) sānubandhakagrahaṇamiha mā bhūt‌--`pāmanaputraḥ' iti| pāmānyasya santīti `lomādipāmādi' (5.2.100) ityādinā napratyayaḥ| tadantasya putraśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atha kriyamāṇe sānubandhakagrahaṇe striyā ayamiti `stripuṃsābhyām‌' (4.1.87) ityādinā nañ‌--straiṇaḥ, straiṇaścāsāvarthaśceti straiṇārthaṃ ityatra kasmānna bhavati? pūrvapadabhūtasya naño grahaṇāt‌| kuta etat‌? uttarapadasya sambandhiśabdatvāt‌| pūrvapadaṃ hyapekṣyottarapadaṃ sambhavati| ata uttarapadādhikārāt‌ pūrvapadabhūtasyātra naño grahaṇam‌| atha vā--vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, tasya vyavasthitavibhāṣātvavijñānānna bhaviṣyati| yadyevam‌, pāmanaputra ityatrāpyata eva na bhaviṣyatīti nārthaḥ sānubandhakagrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthaṃ sānubandhakagrahaṇam‌| na ca `nasya' ityucyamāne kaścillāghavakṛto viśeṣo bhavati| `avakṣepe tiṅyupasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| avakṣepaḥ-nindā| uttarapade nalopo vidhīyamānastiṅante na prāpnoti, tasmāt‌ tasyopasaṃkhyānāṃ karttavyam‌| nanu cāstyevākāraḥ paratiṣedhavācī, `a mā no nāḥ pratiṣedhavacanāḥ' iti vacanāt‌, tataśca tasyaivākṣepe tiṅi prayogo bhaviṣyatīti kimupasaṃkhyānena? naño'pi tarhyavakṣepe tiṅi parataḥ prayogaḥ prāpnoti| tasmādavakṣepe nañokṛtanalopasya prayoganivuttyarthamupasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyamiti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--`vācaṃyamapurandarau ca' (6.3.69) ityataścakaro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamucyārthaḥ| tena tiṅante'pyavakṣepe gamyamāne naño nalopo bhaviṣyati|| 74. tasmānnuḍaci| (6.3.74) `naña eva hi syāt‌' iti| acīti saptamīnirdeśāt‌, `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasaya' (1.1.66) iti datanāt‌| naño nuḍāgame satyaniṣṭaṃ rapaṃ syāt‌| tasmādgrahaṇe tu sati `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśī balīyān‌' (śāka.pa.97) ityuttarapadasyaiva bhavati, ato na bhavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu ca yadi naño nuṭ‌ syāt‌, nalopavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌? nānarthakam‌; abrāhmaṇaḥ, avṛṣala ityanajādau nakāraśravaṇaṃ mābhūdityevamarthatvāt‌| yadi naño mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ `tasmāt‌' ityucyate, tarhi na vācyam‌, pūrvānto hyayaṃ nuk‌ kariṣyate? ityāha--`pūrvānte hi' iti| pūrvānte nuṭi kriyamāṇe ṅamantasya padasya vidhīyamānaḥ `ṅamo hrasvādaci ṅamuṇ‌ nityam‌' (8.3.32) iti nuṭ‌ prāpnoti, tataśca sa evāniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ| tasmānnuḍeva karttavyaḥ| asmistu kriyamāṇe naña eva mā bhūdityevamartha tasmādgrahaṇam‌|| 75. nabhraṇnapānnavedānāsatyānamucinakulanakhanapuṃsakanakṣatranakranākeṣu prakṛtyā| (6.3.75) `nabhrāṭ‌' iti| `bhrājṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.181) asmāt‌ `bhrājabhrāsa' (3.2.177) ityādinā kvip‌, jakārasya `vraśca' (8.2.36) ityādinā ṣakāraḥ, tasya jaśatvam‌--ḍakāraḥ, tasyāpi cartvam‌--ṭakāraḥ| `napāt‌' iti| napuṃsakatvādasatyāṃ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñāyāmugillakṣaṇo num‌ na bhavati| `navedāḥ' iti| `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| `satsu sādhavaḥ satyāḥ' iti| anena `tatra sādhuḥ' (4.4.98) iti sacchabdāt‌ prāgghitīyaṃ yataṃ darśayati| `auṇādikaḥ kipratyayaḥ' iti| `igupadhāt‌ kit‌' (da.u.1.48) iti kipratyayaḥ| `kṣiyaḥ' iti| `kṣiṣ‌ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1506), [`kṣīṣ‌'--dhā.pā.] `kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1407) iti| `kṣaratervā' iti| `kṣara saṃñcalane' (dhā.pā.851)| nakṣatramiti nipātyate| kimatra nipātyate? yadi kṣiyaḥ, tadā trapratyaya ikārasyāttvam‌; yada kṣaratestadāpi trapratyayo rephalopaśca| `nāsminnakamastīti nākam‌' iti| kamiti sukhamucyate| na kam‌-duḥkham‌| nāsminnakamasti iti nākaḥ-svargaḥ| rūḍhiśabdā hyate yathākathañcit‌ vyutpādyante|| 76. ekādiścaikasya cāduk‌| (6.3.76) ekādiriti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ekānnaviṃśatiḥ' iti| pūrvaṃ naño viṃśatiśabdena samāsaṃ kṛtvā tatastṛtīyasamāsaḥ karttavyaḥ| kimarthaṃ punarayaṃ pūrvānta āduk‌ kriyate, na parādirevāduṭ‌ kriyeta? tatrāṇyamarthaḥ--ekasya cetyeṣa āgamino dirdeśo na karttavyo bhavati| parādau hi kriyamāṇe nañevāgamo bhavati, sa ca prakṛtatvādeva lakṣyate; tatrāyaṃ vakyārtho bhavati--`ekādiśca nañ‌ prakṛtyā bhavati, āduṭ‌ ca tasyāgamo bhavati' iti siddhamiṣṭam‌? ityāha--`pūrvānto'yam‌' ityādi| `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) ityatra hi `na padāntāṭṭoranām‌' (8.4.42) ityataḥ padantādityanuvarttate| tatra yadi paradiḥ kriyate padāntatā'sya na syāt‌, tataśca padāntalakṣaṇo'nunāsikavikalpo na syāt‌, iṣyate ca| tasmādvikalpena yathā syādityevamarthaṃ pūrvānta āduk‌ kriyate| atha kimarthamāduk kriyate? ādugeva nocyeta, adukyapi kriyamāṇe'kaḥ savarṇo dīrghatvena (6.1.101) sidhyati? na sidhyati; `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti, tadapayakāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati, yadi hyatra pararūpatvaṃ syāddukameva vidadhyāt‌, tarhi savarṇadīrghatvamapyakāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna syāt‌? naitadasti; tathā hi--yaṃ vidhiṃ pratyupadeśo'narthakaḥ syāt‌ sa vidhirbādhyate (vyā.pa.56) yasya tu vidhestadeva nimittaṃ nāsau vidhirbādhyate| pararūpatvaṃ ca pratyakāroccāraṇamanarthakam‌, savarmadīrghatvaṃ tu prati nimittameva| evaṃ tarhyadugevāyam‌| tulyā hi saṃhitā|| 77. nago'praṇiṣvanyatarasyām‌| (6.3.77) `gamerḍapratyayaḥ' iti| `ḍaprakaraṇe anyatrāpi dṛśyate' (vā.256) iti vacanāt‌|| 78. sahasya saḥ saṃjñāyām‌| (6.3.78) `sāśvattham‌' iti| sahāśvattheneti `tena saheti tulyayoge' (2.2.28) iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `sahayudhvā, sahakṛtvā' iti| `dṛśeḥ kvanip‌' (3.2.94) ityanuvarttamāne `rājani yudhi kṛñaḥ' (3.2.95), `sahe ca' (3.2.96) iti kvanip‌, upapadasamāsaḥ, `sarvanāmasthāne; (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sādeśa udātto nipātyate? ityata āha--`udāttānudāttavato hi' ityādi| nipātā ādyudātā bhavanti' (phi.sū.4.80) iti sahaśabda ādyudātta eva, śeṣamanudāttam‌| tenāsāvudāttānudāttavān‌, tataścāntaryatastasya sthāne saśabdaḥ svaritaḥ| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityudātto nipātyate| yadyevam‌, avyayībhāve'pi udātta eva svaraḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`sa ca nipātasvaraḥ' ityādi| `yatra' ityādi| bahuvrīhau tatpuruṣe vā| `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam‌' (6.2.1) iti sahetyetasya samāsāntodāttatvāpavādaḥ prakṛtisvaratvaṃ bhavati| tatpuruṣe'pi `tatpuruṣe tulyārtha' (6.2.2) ityādinā| tasmāt‌ tatraiva sa nipātasvaraḥ prasajyate| avyayībhāve tu samāsāntodāttatvāpavādaḥ prakṛtisvaro na kenacidvihita iti tatara samāsāntodāttatvenaiva bhavitavyam‌| atastena bādhyata eva| `seṣṭi, sapaśṛbandham‌' iti| iṣṭiranto yasya paśubandho'nto yasyeti, `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādinā samāsaḥ, antavacane| atra paratvāt‌ prathamasatāvannapatasvaraḥ, tataḥ samāsāntodāttatvam‌| tacca sati nipātasvare śiṣyata iti satiśiṣṭam‌, atastena nipātasvaro bādhyate; satiśiṣṭasvarasya valayastvāt‌|| 79. granthāntādhike ca| (6.3.79) `sakalam‌' iti| kalā-kālaviśeṣaḥ, tatsahacārito granthastathocyate| saha kalayā varttata iti sakalam‌| evaṃ `samuhūrttam‌' ityetadapi veditavyam‌| `sasaṃgraham‌' iti| etadudāharaṇaṃ pramādādidānīntanaiḥ kulekhakairlikhitam‌, tatra hi `avyayībhāve cākāle' (6.3.81) ityevaṃ sabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ? ityāha--tatra' ityādi| kathaṃ punanaṃ prāpnoti, yāvatā kālamuhūrtaśabdau tāvat‌ sāhacaryādatra granthe varttate? evaṃ manyate--prakaraṇādinā vākyena granthaviṣayatā tayorgamyate| mukhyastu kāla evābhidheya iti| `sadroṇā khārī' ityādi| `tena saha' (2.2.28) ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ|| 80. dvitīye cānupāravye| (6.3.80) `dvayo sahaprayuktayorapradhāno yaḥ sa dvitīyaḥ' iti| pradhānetarasannipāte satyapradhāna eva dvitīyaśabdasya prayogāt‌| tathā hi--svāmibhṛtyayoḥ sahayuktayorbhṛtya eva svāminaṃ prati dvitīya ucyate, na tu bhṛtyaṃ prati svāmī| `upākhyāyate yaḥ sa upākhyaḥ' iti| `ātaścopasarge' (3.1.136) iti kaḥ, sa ca bhavan‌ `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam‌' (3.3.113) iti karmaṇi bhavati| `sāgniḥ kapotaḥ' iti| pūrvavadbahuvrīhiḥ| atrāganisahayuktaḥ kapotaḥ, tayorhi sāhacarya loke prasiddham‌| tatrāgnirapradhānaḥ| tathā hyagniḥ kapotamanuvidhatte--yatra hi kapotastatrāgninā'vaśyaṃ bhavitavyam‌, na tu yatrāgnistatra kapoteneti nāsāvagnimanuvidhatte, tena kapotasya prādhānyam‌| agnyādayaḥ punarapradhānā eva| `agnyādayaḥ' iti| atrādiśabdena piśācadayo gṛhayante| tena hi kvacit‌ pratyakṣeṇa upalabhyante, api tu kapotādibhiravinābhāvibhiranumīyanta ityanupākhyā bhavanti|| 81. avyayībhāve cākāle| (6.3.81) `akālavācini' iti| anena `kāle' iti neha savarūpasya grahaṇam‌, api tu kālaviśeṣavācināṃ pūrvāhṇādiśabdānāmiti darśayati| kuta etata punaravasitam‌? `granthāntādhike ca' (6.3.79) ityatra granthāntagrahaṇāt‌| anena hi kālavācinyuttarapade pratiṣedhaḥ parrāpnoti, sa mā bhūditi| tatra granthāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, yadi cātra `kāle' iti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌| tatastenaiva sakalam‌, samuhūrttamityatra sabhāvaḥ siddha iti tatra gnthāntagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `sacakram‌' iti| `avyayaṃ vibhakti' (2.1.6) ityādanā yaugapadye'vyayībhāvaḥ| `sadhuram‌' iti| `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ pathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityakāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| `sahapūrvāhṇam‌' iti| tenaiva sūtreva sākalye'vyayībhāvaḥ|| 82. vopasarjanasya| (6.3.82) yadi `upasarjanasya' ityetat‌ sahaśabdasaya viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt‌ tadā'tiprasaṅgaḥ syāt‌| viśeṣānupādānādihāpi syāt‌--sahayudhvā, sahakṛtveti| atrāpi sahaśabda upasarjanam‌; `upapadamatiṅ‌' (2.2.19) iti prathamā nirdeśāt‌, aprādhānyācca| anarthakañca viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt‌; sarvatraiva hi samāse sahaśabdasyopasarjanatvāt‌| samāsaścehottarapadena sannidhāpitaḥ, yasmāt‌ samāse hyuttarapadaṃ bhavati, atasatasyaivedaṃ viśeṣaṇamiti manyamāna āha--`upasarajanasarvāvayavaḥ' iti| upasarjanaṃ sarvo'vayavo yasya sa tathoktaḥ; avayavadharmeṇa samudāyadharmasya tathā nirdeśāt‌, yathā--āḍhyamidaṃ nagaramiti| yadi kasyacitkaścidupasarajanamavayavaḥ kaścidanupasarjanaṃ so'pyupasarjanamityucyate, tadā'tiprasaṅgadoṣastadavasthaḥ syāditi sarvagrahaṇam‌| kaḥ punarasau sarvopasajenāvayavaḥ samāsaḥ? bahuvrīhiḥ| nanu dvandvo'pyupasarjanasarvāvayava eva, tasyāpi grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hi sahapadena tu guṇabhāvastatraiva prayujyate| atha vā--ubhayagatiriha śāstre sambhavatati laukikamapyupasarjanamiha gṛhyate| tena śāstrīyopasarjanena laukikena copasarjanībhūtāḥ sarvo'vayava yasya sa evopasarjanaśabdena vivakṣita iti vijñāyate| na caivaṃvidho dvandvaḥ| tasya hyavayavānāṃ śāstrīyeṇaivopasarjanenopasarjatvam‌, na tu laukikena| bahuvrīhistu laukikenāpi| tasmāt‌ tasyaivopasarjanagrahaṇena grahaṇam‌| `tadavayavasya' iti| anenopasarjanasyetyeṣā'vayavaṣaṣṭhīti dariśayati| `saputraḥ' iti| pūrvavadbahuvarīhiḥ| `sahayuṣvā, sahakṛtvā' iti| tatpuruṣo'yamuttarapadārthapradhānaḥ| atheha kasmānna bhavati--sahakṛtvapriyaḥ, priyasahakṛtve'ti, bhavati hyatrāpi sahaśabdo bahuvrīhyavayavaḥ? ityāha--`iha' ityādi| `vā priyasya' (vā.114) iti priyaśabdasya vikalpena pūrvanipataḥ| uttarapadādhikārādiha bahuvrīhyāśrayaṇācca bahuvrīhau yaduttarapadaṃ tat‌ paraṃ yasmāt‌ sahaśabdāt‌ tasaya sabhāvena bhavitavyam‌| na ceha bahuvrīhau yaduttarapadaṃ tat‌ sahaśabdāt‌ param‌, śabdāntareṇa vyavadhānāditi na bhavati sabhāvaḥ|| 83. prakṛtyāśiṣyagovatsahaleṣu| (6.3.83) pūrveṇātiprasaktasya sabhāvasya prakṛtibhāvena nivṛttiḥ kriyate| neti vaktavye prakṛtyeti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham‌|| 84. samānasya chandasyamūrdhaprabhṛtyudarkeṣu| (6.3.84) `sagarbhaḥ, sapūthyaḥ' iti| samāno garbhaḥ, samānaṃ yūthamiti vigṛhya `pūrvāparaprathama' (2.1.58) ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ| `sādharmyam‌' iti| bahuvrīherbhāvapratyayaḥ| `sajātīyaḥ' iti| atrāpi bahuvrīhereva `jātyantāccha bandhuni' (5.4.9) iti cchaḥ| `sasthānīyaḥ' iti| `sthānāntādvibhāṣā sasthāneneti cet‌' (5.4.10) iti cchapratyayaḥ|| 85. jyotirjanapadarātrinābhināmagotrarūpasthānavarṇavayovacanabandhuṣu| (6.3.85) `sajyoti' iti| samānaṃ jyotirasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| evaṃ sajanapadādayo veditavyāḥ| tatpuruṣe'pi bhavitavyameva; viśeṣānupātānāt‌| `sanāmā' iti| `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| `savayāḥ' iti| atrāpi `atvasantasya' (6.4.14) iti dīrgha|| 86. caraṇe brahmacāriṇi| (6.3.86) caraṇaśabdo'yamadhyayananimittamupādāya puruṣādiṣu varttate| brahmā caratīti brahamacārī, `vrate' (3.2.80) iti ṇiniḥ| `sabrahmacārī' iti| pūrvavat‌ karmadhārayaḥ| sabrahmacārītyasyāyamartho'bhimataḥ--samāne brahmaṇi vrataṃ caratīti| eṣa cātrārtho yathopapadyate, tathā darśayitumāha--`brahma vedaḥ' ityādi| tadadhyanārtha yadvrataṃ tadapi brahyeti| tādarthyāt‌ tācchabdyam‌, yathā--indrārthā sthūṇā inda iti| taccaratīti tat‌ sampādayati, paripālayatītyarthaḥ| kena punarasau samānaḥ? ityāha--`samānastasyaiva' ityādi| tasyaiveti vedākhyasya brahmaṇaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| yata eva mupacāreṇa labdhabrahmavyapadeśaṃ vrataṃ yaścarati brahmaṇaśca samānatvādayaḥ samānaḥ sa sabrahmacārī| tena sabahmacārītyasyāyamartho bhavati--samāne brahmaṇi vratacārīti| yadi hyasamāne brahmaṇi vrataṃ caret‌ tadā samānatvaṃ na syāt‌| tathāpi brahmākhyaṃ vrataṃ na caredevamapi brahmacāritvaṃ na syāt‌| tasmādyaḥ samāne brahmaṇi brahmacārī, so'vaśyaṃ samāne brahmaṇi vratacārīti bhavati| sabrahmacārītyayamasyarthaḥ sampadayate--samāne brahmaṇi vratacārīti| atha vā--tasyaivetyupacāreṇa labdhabrahmavyapadeśasya vratasyātra pakṣe paramarśaḥ| samāne brahmaṇi ityatra brahmaśabdo vede varttate, prativedaṃ hi bhidyate, tadadhyayanārthaṃ yadvrataṃ tatra yaḥ samāne vede'dhyetavye vrataṃ carati sa eva sabrahmacārītyucyate|| 87. tīrthe ye| (6.3.87) `satīrthyaḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ karmadhārayaṃ kṛtvā taddhitaḥ karttavyaḥ| samāne tīrthe vasatīti satīrthyaḥ|| 88. vibhāṣodare| (6.3.88) 89. dṛgdṛśavatuṣu| (6.3.89) samānamātmānaṃ paśyatīti sadṛk‌, upapadasamāsaḥ, `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvam‌| kathaṃ punariha kañkvinau, yāvatā tyadādiṣūpapadeṣu tau vihitau, na ca samānaśabdastyadādiṣu paṭhyate? ityata āha--`tyadādiṣu' ityādi| `vṛkṣe ceti vaktavyam‌' iti| dṛkṣaśabde cottarapade samānasya sabhāvo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--pūrvakādyogavibhāgād‌ dṛkṣi'pi bhaviṣyatīti| ata eva tatra (6.3.84) vṛtti kṛtoktam‌--evamādayaḥ siddhā bhavantīti| kena punaratara dṛśeḥ ksapratyayo vihito yena dṛkṣaśabda uttarapadaṃ bhavati? ityata āha--`dṛśeḥ ksapratyayo'pi' ityādi| `tatraiva' iti| `tyadādiṣu' (3.2.60) ityādau sūtre| atha vatugrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā samānaśabdāduttaro vatup‌ na sambhavatyeva, sa hi `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup‌' (5.2.39) iti yadādibhya eva vihataḥ? ityāha--`vatubgrahaṇamuttarārtham‌' iti|| 90. idaṃkimorīśkī| (6.3.90) śakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ| idamiva paśyatīti `īdṛk‌ idṛśaḥ'| pūrvavat‌ kañkivanau| kimiva yaśyatīti `kīdṛk‌ kīdṛśaḥ'| vyutpattimātrārtho vigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ| nātrāvayavārtho vigrahavākyopadarśito vidyate| tathā hīdṛg‌ īdṛśa ityanena tulya ityeṣo'rthaḥ samudāyādeva pratīyate| kīdṛk‌, kīdṛśa ityatrāpi kena tulya iti| kiṃ parimāṇamasyeti `kayāna'| idaṃ parimāṇamasyeti `iyān‌'| `kimidaṃbhyāṃ vo ghaḥ' (5.2.40) iti vatupo ghatvam‌, tasyeyādeśe kṛte `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) itīkāralopaḥ| nanu ca vatupo vakārasyeyādeśo'nena vidhīyate, na tu vatup‌ kimidaṃbhyāṃ vidhīyate? evaṃ manyate--vatubasmādādeśavacanādvijñāyate, na hyanyadvatupo lakṣaṇamasti| na cāsato vatupo ghādeśaḥ śakyo vijñātumiti|| 91. ā sarvanāmnaḥ| (6.3.91) `dṛkṣe ceti vaktavyam‌' iti| dṛkṣaśabde parataḥ sarvanāmna ātvaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--uttarasūtrādiha siṃhāvalokitanyāyena cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena dṛkṣaśabde cottarapade bhaviṣyatīti| atha kimartho dīrgho vidhīyate, na, hrasva eva vidhīyatām‌, hrasve'pyādeśe savarṇadīrghatvena sidhyati? na; yasmāt‌ `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti| na ca śakyate vaktum‌--akāroccāraṇasāmarthānna bhaviṣyatati; akāravidherdakāranivarttanārthatvāt lopavidhau hi gauravaṃ syāt‌| kiñca--tvādṛk‌, tvādṛśa ityatra dīrghaśravaṇaṃ na syāt‌| tasmāddīrgha eva vidheyaḥ|| 92. viṣpagdevayośca ṭeradryañcatau vapratyaye| (6.3.92) `viṣvadryaṅ‌' iti| viṣvagañcatīti ṛtvigādisūtreṇa (3.2.59) kvin‌, `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau, `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvam‌| `adrisadhryorantodāttanipātam‌' ityādi| viṣvadryaṅityatrānenādryādeśe kṛte sadhyraṅityatra sahasya sadhyrāde deśe ca `gitakārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) iti prakṛtisvareṇottarapadasaryāntodāttatvaṃ prāpnoti, svaritatvaṃ ceṣyate| tasmāduttarapadāntodāttatavavidhānārthamihādrisadhyrārentodāttatvaṃ nipātyate| tena śeṣaṃ bhavatyanudāttam‌| tatra yaṇādeśe kṛte sati `udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya' (8.2.4) iti svaritatvamuttarapadasya siddham‌| atha vapratayayagarahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `añcatau' ityukte kevala evāñcatāvuttarapade kāryeṇa bhavitavyam‌| vapratyayānta evāñcatiḥ kevalamuttarapadaṃ bhavati| tatraitadvaktavyamañcatāvityāha--`vapratyayagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| anyatra dhātugrahaṇe, dhātvādeḥ prakṛtiparatayayasamudāyasya pratipattiḥ-pratītiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ vapratyayagrahaṇam‌| anena hyayamartho vijñāpyate--ito'nyatra dhātugarahaṇe sati na kevalaṃ dhātureva gṛhyate, api tu dhātvādiḥ śabda iti| tenāyaskṛtam‌, ayaskāra ityatra `ataḥ kṛkami' (8.3.46) ityādinā visarajanīyasya sakāraḥ siddho bhavati| yadi punarayamartho na vijñāpyeta, tadā karotereva kevalasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌; tato yatra karoteḥ kevalasya pratyayarahitasya prayogastatraiva syāt‌--ayaskṛditi| atra tugāgamaḥ karotereva bhakatatvāt‌ tadgrahaṇenaiva gṛhyata iti karotereva kevalasya prayogaḥ| `aśvācī' iti| aśvamañcati iti kvin‌, `añcateścopasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.336) iti ṅīp‌, `acaḥ' (6.4.138) ityakāralopaḥ `cau' (6.3.138) iti dīrghaḥ| `viṣvagyuk‌' iti| viṣvagayunaktīti `satsūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip‌| `viṣvagañcanam‌' iti| `lyuṭ‌ ca' (3.3.115) iti lyuṭ‌| `chandasi' ityādi| chandasi viṣaye striyāmabhidheyāyāṃ bahulamadryādeśe bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vibhāṣodare' (6.3.88) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| iha vā cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena cchandasi viṣaye viṣvagāveranyatrāpi kvacidadryādeśo bhavatīti, kvacinna bhavatyeva| nanu ca sarvanāmno'nukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ? naitadasti; svaritatvādeva hi sarvanāmno'nuvṛttirbhaviṣyati| `viśvācī' ityādi| viśvaghṛtakiṃśabdeṣūpapadeṣvañcateḥ pūrvavat‌ kvin‌, ṅībādikāryañca|| 93. samaḥ sami| (6.3.93) 94. tirasastiryalope| (6.3.94) 95. sahasya sadhriḥ| (6.3.95) `sadhrīcā' iti| pūrvavadakāralopaḥ, dīrghatvaṃ ca|| 96. sadha mādasthayośchandasi| (6.3.96) `sadhamādaḥ' iti| saha mādena varttata iti `tena saha' (2.2.28) ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ, mādaśabdo ghañantaḥ| nanu ca `mado'nupasarge' (3.3.67) ityapā bhavitavyam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tatra hi `svanahasorvā' (3.3.62) ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvartate, sāṃ ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena chandasi ghañeva bhaviṣyati| atha eva nirdeśādvā| `sadhasthaḥ' [`sadhasthāḥ'--kāśikā mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ, `sadhasthā'--(kāśikā) saṃ.paṃ. mudritapāṭhaḥ] iti| saha tiṣṭhīti `supi sthaḥ' (3.2.4) iti kaḥ|| 97. dvyantarupasargebhyo'pa īt‌| (6.3.97) `dvīpam‌' iti| dvirgatā āpo'sminnityasvapadavigraho bahuvrīhiḥ| yathā--śobhanaṃ mukhamasyāḥ sumukhīti| `ṛkpūrabdhūḥ' (5.4.74) ityādinā'kāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| antargatā āpo'sminnityantarīpam‌| saṅgatā vigatā nirgatā āpo'sminniti sapīpam‌, vīpam‌, nīpam‌| `vaktavyam‌' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| uttaratrāpi vaktavayaśabdasyāyamevārthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi pūrvavat‌ `vibhāṣodare' ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttervyavasthitavibhāṣātvāllabhyate| anyadapi catra vyākhyānaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ| `apśabdaṃ prati' ityādi| iha yaṃ prati kriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñakā bhavantīti apśabdasaya tu kriyātvaṃ na sambhavati; dravyavacitvāt‌| tasmāt‌ taṃ prati nāsti kasyacidupasargasaṃjñeti| kriyate cedamupasargagrahaṇam‌| tatsāmarthyādyatra prāderanyatropasaragatavaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadupalakṣaṇārthamupasargagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| yadyevam‌, antaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌, yathaiva hi prādaya upasargagrahaṇena lakṣyante tathāntaḥśabdo'pi, tasyāṅkavidhiṇatvepūpasargatvaṃ dṛṣṭameva? evaṃ tarhyantargrahaṇena jñāpyate--upasargagrahaṇopalakṣitamīttvamanityamiti| tena samāpam‌, parāpam‌, prāpamiti siddhaṃ bhavati|| 98. ūdanordeśe| (6.3.98) `anūpaḥ' iti| anugatā āpo'sminniti vigrahaḥ, pūrvavat‌ samāsāntaḥ, savarṇadīrghaḥ| atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā hrasvo'pi vihite'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvenānūpa iti sidhyatyeva? ata āha--`dīrghoccāraṇam‌' ityādi| asati dīrghoccāraṇe saṃhitāyāmeva dīrghatvaṃ syāt‌, nāvagrahe| tasmādavagrahe'pi yathā syādityevamartha dīrghoccāraṇam‌|| 99. aṣaṣṭhyatṛtīyāsthasyānyasya dugāśīrāśāsthāsthitotsakotikārakarāgaccheṣu| (6.3.99) `anyāśīranyadāśīḥ' ityādi| vigrahaviśeṣeṇa sarvatra viśeṣaṇasamāsaṃ darśayati `anyenāsthito'nyadasthitaḥ' iti| `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌' (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ| `dṛgāgamo'viśeṣeṇa' ityādi| kārakaśabde chapratyaye parato'viśeṣeṇa sāmānyena dugāgamaḥ karttavyaḥ| anyeṣvāśīrādiṣu saptasūttarapadeṣu ṣaṣṭhītṛtīyāsthayorneṣṭo nābhimataḥ| kiṃ punarasyārthasya liṅgaṃ yato'yamavasīyate? ityata āha--`asya ca' ityādi| aṣaṣṭhītṛtīyāsthasyetyevaṃ siddhe dvirnañupādānamasya pratiṣedhasyānityatve liṅgam‌| tena kvacit‌ ṣaṣṭhītṛtīyāsthasyāpi samāse dugāgamo bhavatyeva|| 100. arthe vibhāṣā| (6.3.100) `anyārthaḥ' iti| anyasmai idamiti `caturthī tadarthārtha' (2.1.36) ityādinā samāsaḥ|| 101. koḥ kattatpuruṣeci| (6.3.101) `kadajaḥ' iti| kutsito'ja iti `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ kūṣṭro rājeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `kadbhāve' ityādi| ajādāvattarapade kadbhāva ucyamānastriśabda uttarapade na prāpnoti| tasmāt triśabdāduttarapadāt‌ pūrvo yaḥ kuśabdaḥ, tasya kadbhāvasyopasaṃkhyānam‌-pratipādanaṃ karttavyam‌| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--uttarasūtre cakāraḥ kriyate, sacānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena triśapabde'pyuttarapade parataḥ kadbhāvo bhaviṣyatīti|| 102. rathavadayośca| (6.3.102) anajādyartho'yaṃ yogaḥ| evamuttaratrāpi|| 103. tṛṇe ca jātau| (6.3.103) 104. kā pathyakṣayoḥ| (6.3.104) anīṣadartha ārambhaḥ| `kāpathaḥ' iti| kutsitaḥ panthāḥ kāpathaḥ, `ṛkpūḥ' (5.4.74) ityādinākāraḥ samāsāntaḥ| `kākṣaḥ' iti| kutsito'kṣa iti tatpuruṣaḥ| atha vā--kutsite akṣiṇī asyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, `bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgāt‌ ṣac‌' (5.4.113) iti ṣac‌ samāsāntaḥ|| 105. īṣadarthe ca| (6.3.105) īṣanmadhuraṃ `kāmadhuram‌' iti| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| `kuśabdaḥ pāpārthaḥ' ityetattu prāyikamupādhivacanamityuktam‌| tatra prāyikatve caitadeva kādeśavacanaṃ jñāpakam‌| `kāmlam‌' iti| nanu cātra `koḥ kattatpuṣaṣe' (6.3.101) iti kadādeśena bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`ajādāvapi' ityādi|| 106. vibhāṣā puruṣe| (6.3.106) `aprāpte vibhāṣe'yam‌' iti| īṣadarthasya nivṛttatvāt‌| nanu cānīṣadarthe kenacidaprāpte, īṣadarthe pūrveṇa prāpta ityubhayatra vibhāṣe'yaṃ yuktetyāha--`īṣadarthe tu pūrvavipratiṣedhena' ityādi| `īṣadarthe ca' (6.3.105) ityasyāvakāśa īṣanmadhuraṃ kāmadhum‌, `vibhāṣā puruṣe' ityasyāvakāśaḥ--kutsitaḥ puruṣaḥ kāpuruṣa iti; iha cobhayaṃ prāpnoti--īṣatpuruṣaḥ kāpuruṣa iti| atreṣadartha ityanenaiva bhavati pūrvaviparatiṣedhena|| 107. kavañcoṣṇe| (6.3.107) 108. pathi ca cchandasi| (6.3.108) 109. pṛṣodarādīni yathopadiṣṭam‌| (6.3.109) `ādiśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ' iti| yadyatrādiśabdo vyavasthāvacana āśrīyeta, tato, yānyeva gaṇe paṭhyante teṣāmeva sādhutvaṃ syāt‌, nānyeṣām‌| prakāravacana ādiśabda āśrīyamāṇe satyaparipaṭhitānāmapimapi sādhubhāvo bhavatītyetat‌ sarva cetasi kṛtvā''viśabdo'yaṃ prakāravacana iti darśayannāha--`pṛṣodaraprakārāṇi' ityādi| prakāraḥ-sādṛśyam‌| atastaddarśayitumāha--`yeṣu' ityādi| yathā pṛṣodaraśabde lopakāryaṃ śāstreṇāvihitaṃ dṛśyate, tathānyatrāpi lopādikāryaṃ śāstreṇāvihitaṃ dṛśyate| tāni ca pṛṣodaraprakārāṇi bhavanti| `yathopadiṣṭam‌' iti| `yathā'sādṛśyate' (2.1.7) iti vīpasāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| ata evāsya vivaraṇaṃ karoti--`yāni yānyupadiṣṭāni' ityādi| diśistroccāraṇakriyaḥ| upadiṣṭānyuccāritānīttayarthaḥ| kaiḥ punarupadiṣṭāni? śiṣṭaiḥ| śiṣṭāḥ punarācāranivāsādinā veditavyāḥ| `tāni tathaivānumantavyāni' iti| yathā taiḥ prayuktāni tathaiva tāni sādhutvenānumantavyānītyarthaḥ| yadi śiṣṭāḥ śabdeṣu pramāṇaṃ tada kimanayā'ṣṭādhyāyyā, śiṣṭavacanādeva hi śabdānāṃ sādhutvaṃ vijñāsyate? ucyate; śiṣṭaparijñānārthā'ṣṭādhyāyī| aṣṭādhyāyīmadhīyāno'nadhītāṣṭādhyāyīkamapi ye'syāmaṣṭādhyāyyāṃ vihitāḥ śabdāstān‌ prayañjānaṃ paśyannevamadhyavasyati--śiṣṭo'yamiti, na cāsāvaṣṭādhyāyīmadhītavān‌, atha ca tasyāṃ ye vyutpāditāḥ śabdāstān‌ prayuṅkte, nūnamayamanyānapi jānāti--ityeṣā śiṣṭaparijñānārthā'ṣṭādhyāyī| `evamanye'pi' ityādi| kapyaśvamahīśabdepūpapadeṣu `supi sthaḥ' (3.2.4) iti tiṣṭhateḥ kapratyayaḥ| sakārasya takāraḥ kriyate| mahīśabdasyāpi hrasvatvam‌| `dakṣiṇatāram‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ' (vā.104) iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ| atha vā--dakṣiṇaśabdasyāyaṃ tīraśabdena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `vācovāde' iti| vākyaśabdasya vādaśabda uttarapade parato ḍakārādeśo bhavati| uttarapadasya ca vādaśabdasya vala ityayamādeśo bhavatīñi pratyaye parata iti| vācaṃ vadatīti `karmaṇyaṇ‌' (3.2.1)--vāgvāda, tasyāpatyam‌ ' ata iñ‌' (4.1.95) vāṅvaliḥ| `ṣaṣa utvam‌' ityādi| ṣaṣśabdasyotvaṃ bhavati datṛ, daśa-ityetayoruttarapadayoḥ, uttarapadādeḥ ṣṭutvaṃ ca| ṣaṅ‌ dantā yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `vayasa dantasya datṛ' (5.4.141) iti datrādeśaḥ--ṣoḍan‌| ṣaṭ‌ ca daśa ceti dvandvaḥ--ṣoḍaśa| `dhāsu vā' iti| utvatyaivāyaṃ vikalpaḥ| ṣṭutvaṃ tu nityameva bhavati| `ṣoḍhā, ṣaṅdhā' iti| `adhikaraṇavicāle ca' (5.3.43) iti dhāpratyayaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ dhāsviti bahuvacananirdeśaḥ kriyate? ityāha--`bahuvacananirdeśaḥ' ityādi| `ṣaṅdhā' iti| dhāño dheṭo vā striyāṃ `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) iti kapratyayaḥ| `dāśyate' itiṣa `dāśrṛ dāne' (dhā.pā.882), nāśyate' iti, `ṇaśa adarśane' (dhā.pā.1194), `dabhyate' iti, `dambha [`dambhu dambhane' (1270) iti dhātu pāṭhaḥ] dambhe--etebhyaḥ karmaṇi ghañ‌| durśaśabdasya dāśaśabdādibhiḥ prādisamāse--dūḍāśaḥ dūṇāśaḥ, dūḍabhaḥ| `dambheranunāsikalopaḥ' ityādi| yadetat‌ `dāśanāśadabhadhyeṣu' (kācavṛ.6.3.109) ityatra kṛtānunāsikalopasya dambheruccāraṇaṃ tannipātanam‌, tata evātra dambheranunāsilopo bhavati| pīda upavasanaṃ yeṣāṃ te `pīvopavasanāḥ' evaṃ `payopavasanāḥ'| ubhayatra sakāralopaḥ| `varṇāgamaḥ' iti| niruktaśāstre ye śabdā vyutpādyante teṣāṃ pūṣodarāditvādeva sādhutvamiṣyati itīmaṃ ślokamāha--`varṇāgamaḥ' ityādi| apūrvasya varṇasyāgamo varṇāgamaḥ--nakārāderapūrvasya varṇasya prāptiḥ, yathā--ko jīryate kuñjara iti| atra kuśabdasaya nugāgamaḥ kriyate| varṇaviparyayaḥ--varṇasthānavyatyāsaḥ, yathā `hisi hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1456), hinastīti siṃha ityatra pacādyaci kṛte hakārasakārayoḥ sthānavyatyāsaḥ| varṇavikāraḥ--varṇasya rūpāntarāpattiḥ, yathā--ṣoḍanniti| atra ,khārasyotvarūpāpattiḥ| dakārasya ca ḍakārarūpāpattiḥ| varṇanāśaḥ--varṇasya lopaḥ, yathā pṛṣodara iti| atra takārasya lopaḥ| arthātiśayaḥ-arthaviśeṣaḥ, prasiddhādarthādarthāntaram‌, tena dhātoryogaḥ-sambanadhaḥ, yathā mahyāṃ rotīti mayūraḥ| atra raute ramaṇenārthenātiśayena yogaḥ| etat‌ pañcavidhaṃ pañcaprakāraṃ niruktam‌, niścayenocyate'rtho'neneti niruktam‌|| 110. saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyāhnasyāhananyatarasyāṃ ṅau| (6.3.110) `dvyorahnorbhavaḥ' iti| bhavārthavivakṣāyāṃ `taddhitārtha' (2.1.51) iti samāsaḥ, tataḥ `kālāṭṭhañ‌' (4.3.11) iti ṭhañ‌, tasya `dvigorlṛganapatye' (4.1.88) iti luk‌, `rājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac‌' (5.4.91) iti ṭac‌ samāsāntaḥ, `ahno'hna etebyaḥ' (5.4.88) ityahnādeśaḥ| `dryahni' iti| vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ' (6.4.136) ityakāralopaḥ pākṣikaḥ| `dvyahnaḥ' iti| `ād‌ guṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `vyahnaḥ' iti prādisamāsaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat‌| `sāyāhnaḥ' iti| ekadeśisamāso'yam‌| tatredaṃ codyamāśaṅkyate--nanu ca `pūrvāparādharottaram‌' (2.2.1) ityādinā samāso vihitaḥ, na ca sāyaṃśabdastatra paṭhyate, tatkathamiha sāyaṃśabdasāyahaḥśabdena samāsaḥ sambhavatīti? etannirākarttumāha--`ekadeśisamāsaḥ pūrvādibhyo'nyasyāpi' ityādi| tatpuruṣasamāse `ahno'hna etebhyaḥ' (5.4.88) ityanenāhnādeśo vidhīyate, `etebhyaḥ' ityanena ca `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ saṃkhyāvyayādeḥ? (5.4.86) iti, tathā `ahaḥsarvaikadeśasaṃkhyātapuṇyācca rātreḥ' (5.4.87) iti prakrāntāḥ saṃkhyāvyayādayaḥ pratyavamṛśyante| tatra yadi pūrvādaya evaikadeśinā samasyeran‌, tadā na sāyaṃśabdaḥ `etebhyaḥ' ityanena pratyavamṛśyeta; tasya saṃkhyādiṣvaparipaṭhitatvāt‌| tataśca sāyaṃśabdāt‌ parasyāhrādeśo na syāt‌| evañca sāyampūrvasyāhnaśabdasyābhāvāt‌ tasyeha grahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, kṛtañca, tasmādetadeva sāyampūrvasyāhnaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ jñāpayati--pūrvādibhyo'nyasyāpyekadeśisamāso bhavatīti| tena `madhyamahno madhyāhnaḥ' iti siddhaṃ bhavati| `pūrvāhṇe' iti| `ahno'dantāt‌' (8.4.7) iti ṇatvam‌| `saṃkhyāvisāyebhyaḥ' ityeva vaktavye pūrvaśabdasyādhikasya grahaṇaṃ tadadhikakāryavadhānasūcanārtham‌| tena sāyāhna ityatra makāralopaḥ siddho bhavati|| 111. ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ| (6.3.111) `ḍhralope' iti tatpuruṣo'yaṃ vā syāt‌, bahuvrīhirvā? tatra yadi tatpuruṣaḥ syāt‌--ḍhrayorlopo ḍhralopa iti, tadāṇaḥ pūrvatvaṃ nopapadyate; lopasyābhāvarūpatvāt‌, abhāve ca paurvāparyāsambhavāt‌| athāpi sthānidvārakaṃ porvāparyamāśritya pūrvatvamucyate, karaṇīyaḥ--ityatrāpayanīyaro rephasya lope kṛte pūrvasya dīrghatvaṃ syāditīmaṃ doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā bahuvrīhirayamiti darśayannāha--`ḍhakārarephayorlopo yasmin‌' ityādi| gamakatvādvaiyadhikaraṇye'pi bahuvrīhirbhavatyeva, yathā--kāṇṭhekāla iti| `līḍham‌' iti| `liha āsvādane', (dhā.pā.1066) `niṣṭhā, `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) `jhaṣastathordo'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) `ḍhoḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13)--ityeto vidhayaḥ karttavyāḥ| `mīḍham‌' iti| `miha secane' (dhā.pā.992)| `upagūḍham‌' iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe (dhā.pā.896)| `mūḍhaḥ' iti| `muha vaicitye' (dhā.pā.1198)| `nīraktam‌' iti| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ, `ro ri' (8.3.14) iti rephasya lopaḥ| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `ḍhralope' iti| saptamyā nirdeśaḥ, tatrāntareṇāpi pūrvagrahaṃ `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti pūrvasyaiva bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`pūrvagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| asati pūrvagrahaṇe, uttarapadādhikārāduttarapada eva syāt‌--`nīraktam‌' ityādau, anuttarapade na syāt‌--`līḍham‌' ityādau| yadyapi ḍhalopasyottarapade'sambhavādanuttarapade'pi vacanaprāmaṇyāddīrghatvaṃ syāt‌, ralope tvanuttarapade na prāpnoti; uttarapade ralopasya sambhavāt‌| tasmādanuttarapade'pi pūrvamātrasyāṇo dīrgho yathā syāditi pūrvagrahaṇam‌| `ātṛḍham‌' iti| `tṛhū tṛnhū hiṃsārthau' (dhā.pā.1348,1350)| `ādṛḍham‌' iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| `dṛha dṛhi dṛhi vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.733-736) ityasya niṣṭhāyāṃ kiledaṃ rūpam‌, etattu nopapadyate; dṛheḥ seṭtvāt‌ tasyeṭā bhavitavyam‌| athāpi kathañcinna syāt‌, evamapi `dāderdhātorghaḥ' (8.2.32) iti ghatvena bhavitavyam‌| sthūlabalavadvivakṣāyāṃ `dṛḍhaḥ sthūlabalayoḥ' (7.2.20) iti nirdeśādubhayaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? dīrghatvamapyata eva tarhi na syāt‌| kecidatrānityatvādāgamaśāsanasyābhāvamiṭo varṇayanti| `vā druha' (8.2.33) ityādau sūtre `vā' iti yogavibhāgāt‌ pakṣe ghatvasyābhāvaḥ| `āvṛḍham‌' iti| vṛhū udyamanas (dhā.pā.1347)|| 112. sahivahorodavarṇasya| (6.3.112) `ūḍhaḥ, ūḍhavān‌' iti| yajāditvāt‌ samprasāraṇam‌| `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti paraparvatvam‌, dīrghatvaṃ ca| tatredānīmasatyavarṇagrahaṇe ūkārasyāpyottvaṃ syāt‌| nanu ca samparasāraṇādibhyaḥ paratvādottvena bhavitavyam‌, tathā ca bhāvye `ubhayornityayoḥ paratvādottvena bhavitavyam‌, ātve kṛte samprasāraṇam‌, samprasāraṇe kṛte samparasāraṇaparapūrvatvam‌, kṛtakāryatvāt‌ punarottvaṃ na bhaviṣyati' iti| tasmādbhavitavyamevauttvena, tasmin‌ sati paścā samprasāraṇādibhiḥ| na caivaṃ kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata iti nārtho varṇagrahaṇena| evaṃ tarhyavarṇagrahaṇaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati--kvacit‌ `samprasāraṇaṃ tadāśrayañca kāryaṃ balīyo bhavatīti| tena yaduktam‌--`samprasāraṇaṃ samprasāraṇāśrayañca kāryaṃ balīyo bhavati' (pu.pa.vṛ.103) iti tadupapannaṃ bhavati| `varṇagrahaṇaṃ kim‌' iti| `odasya' itāvatyapi sati soḍhā, soḍhumityādi sidhyatyevetyabhiprāyaḥ| `kṛtāyāmapi' ityādi| utpūrvādvaherlṛṅi cliḥ, `cleḥ sic‌' (3.1.44)tasastām‌, thasastam‌ aḍāgamaḥ, ḍhatvāderasiddhatvāt‌ tataḥ pūrvam‌ `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, tato ḍhatvādi| athedānīmasati varṇagrahaṇe mātrikasyākārasyocyamānamottvaṃ dīrghasya na syāt‌, varṇagrahaṇādvarṇamātrasya bhavatīti siddham‌--udavoḍhām‌, udavoḍhamiti? nanu ca `aṇudit‌ savarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' (1.1.69) ityakāro gṛhyamāṇa ākāramapi grāhayiṣyati, tat‌ kiṃ varṇagrahaṇena? ityata āha--`tādapi paraḥ' ityādi| `taparastatkālasya' (1.1.70) ityatra tādapi parastapara ityayamapi samāsa āśritaḥ khaṭvaiḍakā, khaṭvaitikāyanaḥ--ityevamādiṣu trimātrike caturmātrike varttamānasyaikārasya vṛddhisaṃjñā mā bhūdityevamartham‌| tatrāsati varṇagrahaṇe'karasya taparatvādākāro na gṛhyet‌ tataśca tasyottvaṃ na syāt‌| tasmādavarṇamātrasya yathā syādityevamartha varṇagrahaṇaṃ karttavayam‌| tādapi parastaparaḥ--ityasya ca samāsasyaitadeva varṇagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ veditavyam‌|| 113. sāḍhyai saḍhvā sāḍheti nigame| (6.3.113) sāḍhvetyādau ottvābhāvo nipātyate| dīrghastu `ḍhralope' (6.3.111) ityādinaiva siddhaḥ|| 114. saṃhitāyām‌| (6.3.114) `uttarapade' (6.3.1) iti varttate uttarapadaṃ ca samāse bhavati, tatra cāntareṇāpi vacanaṃ nityameva saṃhitayā bhavitavyam‌, tasmāduttarapade parato vakṣyamāṇānāṃ yat‌ kāryaṃ na tadarthatādhikārasyopapadyata iti yadanuttarapade kāryaṃ tadarthamevāyamadhikāraḥ| tena yairyogairuttarapade kāryaṃ vidhīyate tānullaṅghya tena yogenānuttarapade kāryaṃ vidhīyate tatrāsyopayogaṃ darśayannāha--`vakṣyati dvyaco'tastiṅaḥ' ityādi| `vidmā hi tvā' ityādi| viderloṭi masaḥ `sa uttamasya' (3.4.98) iti sakāralopaḥ, adāditvācchāpo luk‌|| 115. karṇe lakṣaṇasyāviṣṭāṣṭapañcamaṇibhinnacchinnacchidrasravasvastikasya| (6.3.115) lakṣyate'nena svāmiviśeṣasya sambandha iti lakṣaṇam‌-cihnam‌| `dātrākarṇaḥ' iti| dātramiva dātram‌, sādṛśyāttadākāraṃ cihnamucyate| dātraṃ karṇe yasya sa dātrākarṇaḥ| evamuttaratrāpi bahuvrīhireva veditavyaḥ| dvau guṇau yasya sa dviguṇaḥ| tadākaramapi cihnaṃ dviguṇam‌| guṇaśabdo'yaṃ bandhanavacanaḥ| dvayoraṅgulyoḥ samāhāro dvyaṅgulam‌, `tatpuruṣasyāṅguleḥ' (5.4.86) ityādinā ca samāsāntaḥ, dvyaṅgulākāramapi cihnaṃ dvyaṅgulam‌| `tadiha lakṣaṇaṃ gṛhyate' iti| kuta etat‌? lakṣaṇagrahaṇādyadiha sāmānyena yena kenacillakṣyate talalakṣaṇaṃ gṛhyeta cihnasyetyevaṃ brūyāt‌, laghu hyevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati| tasmāccihnagrahaṇe karttavaye yallakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tena lakṣaṇaviśeṣo'tra grāhyaḥ, na tu lakṣaṇamātramityasyārthasya pratipādanaṃ kṛtamiti lakṣyate| tathā coktam‌--iṅgitenonmiṣitena mahatā sūtraprabandhena vehā cāryāṇāmabhiprāyā lakṣanta iti| nanu ca lakṣaṇagrahaṇena lakṣaṇaviśeṣo'trābhimataḥ, na tu lakṣaṇamātramityetāvanmātraṃ gamyate, sa tu viśeṣo na vṛttikāreṇopadarśitaḥ kuto'vaseyaḥ? ācāryāṇaṃ svīkaraṇāt‌| `śobhanakarṇaḥ' iti| yadyapyanenāpi lakṣyate, na tvevaṃvidhasya lakṣaṇasyeha grahaṇam‌| nāpi śobhanatvaṃ loke lakṣaṇatvena pratīyata iti bhavatyetatpratyudāharaṇam‌|| 116. nahivṛtivṛṣivyadhirucisahitaniṣu kvau| (6.3.116) `ṇaha bandhane' (dhā.pā.1166)| upanahyata iti `upānat‌' sampadāditvāt‌ kvip‌ `naho dhaḥ' (8.2.34) iti dhatvam‌, tato jaśtvam‌, cartvañca| pariṇahyatīti `pariṇat‌'| `upasargādasamāse' (8.4.14) ityādinā ṇatvam‌| nivarttata iti `nīvṛt‌'| `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip‌| evamuttaratrāpi kvibeva veditavyaḥ| `vṛṣu secane' (dhā.pā.706) pravarṣatīti `prāvṛṭ‌'| ṣakārasya jaśtvam‌--ḍakāraḥ, tasya cartveṭakāraḥ| `vyadha tāḍane' (dhā.pā.1181), marmāṇi vidhyatīti `marmāvit‌' grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam‌| `ruca dīptau' [`ruca dīptāvabhiprītau ca'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.745), nirocaṇaṃ `nīruk‌'| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌| ṛtiṃ sahata iti `ṛtīṣaṭ‌'| `saheḥ pṛtanarttābhyāñja' (8.3.107) ityatra `saheḥ' iti yogavibhāgādanuktasamuccayārthatvādvā cakārasya ṣatvam‌| paritanotīti `parītat‌'| anunāsikalope kṛte tuk‌| kena punaratrānunāsikalopaḥ? ityāha--`gamaḥ kvau' ityādi| gatikārakayoreveṣyata iti| tadartham‌ `vibhāṣā puruṣe' (6.3.106) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñeyā|| 117. vanagiryoḥ saṃjñāyāṃ koṭarakiṃśulakādīnām‌| (6.3.117) `koṭarāvaṇam‌' iti| ṣaṣṭīsamāsaḥ| `vanaṃ purugā' (8.4.4) ityādinā ṇatvam‌|| 118. vale| (6.3.118) `valacpratyayo gṛhyate, na prātipadikam‌' iti| etacca vakṣyamāṇasyeha bahulagrahaṇasya siṃhāvalokitavyāyenopasthānāllabhyata ityeke| anantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇena matupā ptyayena sāhacaryāccetpapare|| 119. matau bahvaco'najirādīnām‌| (6.3.119) `vrīhimatī' ityādau pūrvavanmatup| `valayavatī' ityatra tu `tadasyāstyasminniti matup‌' (5.2.94)|| 120. śarādīnāṃ ca| (6.3.120) abahvartho'yamārambhaḥ| `śarāvatī' iti| `nadyāṃ matup‌' (4.2.85) iti matup‌|| 121. iko vahe'pīloḥ| (6.3.121) `ṛṣīvahaḥ' [`ṛṣīvaham‌'--kāśikā] iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| vahaśabdaḥ pacādyajantaḥ| `apīlvādīnām‌' ityādi| yadetadiko dīrghavidhānaṃ tat‌ pīlvādīnāṃ na bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatraidaṃ vyākhyānam‌--ihāpi tadeva bahulagrahaṇaṃ pūrvavadupatiṣṭhate, tena pīluśabdādanyeṣāmapi keṣāñciddīrghatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti|| 122. upasargasya ghañyamanuṣye bahulam‌| (6.3.122) upasargāt‌ kevalaṃ ghañpratyayo na sambhavati, ato ghañanta uttarapade kāryaṃ vajñāyata ityāha--`ghañanta uttarapade' ityādi| `vīkledaḥ' iti| `klida ārdrībhāve' (dhā.pā.1242), [`klidū'--dhā.pā.] `akartari ca kārake' (3.3.19) ityādinā ghañ‌| `vīmārgaḥ' iti| `mṛjū' śūddhau' (dhā.pā.1066), `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114), `cajoḥ ku ghiṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutvam‌| `prasevaḥ' iti| `ṣivu tantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1108)| `kṛtrimam‌' iti| karaṇena nirvṛttaṃ kṛtrimam‌| puruṣavyāpārādibhirnirvṛttamityarthaḥ| `niṣādaḥ' iti| `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu' (dhā.pā.854), niṣīdatyasmin‌ pāpamiti niṣādaḥ| `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti ghañ‌|| 123. ikaḥ kāśe| (6.3.123) `nīkāśaḥ' iti| `kāsṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.647)| `pacādyajanto'yaṃ kāśaśabdaḥ na tu ghañantaḥ' iti| tatra pūrveṇaiva siddhamityabhiprāyaḥ| `pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthametat‌--ika eva kāśe nānyasya' iti kvacid‌ granthaḥ, eṣa tu nopapadyate; ghañi pūrveṇa dīrghavidhānāt‌, etasya ca kāśaśabdasya pacādyajantatvāt‌| atha bahulagrahaṇāt‌ pacādyajante'pi pūrveṇaiva siddhamityucyate, tathā ca tata eva bahulagrahaṇādiko'nyasyana bhaviṣyatīti na karattavyamevedaṃ sūtram‌| kriyamāṇañca pūrvasyaiva prapañcārtha draṣṭavyam‌|| 124. dasti| (6.3.124) `dā' ityetasya yastakārādirādeśaḥ' iti| etena sthānyādeśasambandhe `daḥ' ityeṣā ṣaṣṭhīti vijñāyate| `vīttam‌' iti| dadāterniṣṭhāyāṃ rūpam‌| nanu catra takārādirādeśaḥ paro na sambhavatyeva, tathā hi--yastāvat‌ `aca upasargāttaḥ' (7.4.47) iti takāra saḥ `alontyasya' (1.1.52) iti vacanādantyasya kriyate, sa ca varṇāntaro vyavadhānādanantarastakāraḥ paro na sambhavati; yo'pi `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti dakārasaya takāro vidhīyate, so'pina sambhavatyeva; dīrghatve karttavye cartvasyāsiddhatvenāvidyamānatvādityata āha--`aca upasargāttaḥ' ityādi| āśrayaṇamāśrayaḥ-aṅgīkaraṇam‌| `dā' ityatra yasatakārādirādeśaḥ, tasmin‌ parata igantasyopasargasya dīrgho bhavatīti bruvatā cartvamāśritam‌, na hyanyathā takārādirādeśaḥ paraḥ sambhavati| tasmāt‌ cartvasyāśrayaṇāt‌ siddham‌| atastakārādirādeśo bhavatīti| `nitīrṇam‌' iti| `tṝ plavanataraṇayoḥ' (dā.pā.969) `ṛta id‌ dhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam‌, `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ| `aṭkupvāṅ‌' (8.4.2) ityādinā ṇatvam‌| `sudattam‌' iti| `do dadghoḥ' (7.4.46) ityatra-- `avadattaṃ vidattaṃ ca prādattaṃ cādikarmaṇi| sudattamanudattaṃ ca nidattamiti ceṣyate'|| tyanayeṣṭyā dadāterdadādeśa-|| 125. aṣṭanaḥ saṃjñāyām‌| (6.3.125) `aṣṭāvakraḥ' iti| aṣṭau vakrāṇyasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ|| 126. chandasi ca| `aṣṭākapālam‌' iti| aṣṭasu kapaleṣu saṃskṛtamiti `saṃskṛtam‌' (4.4.3) ityaṇ‌, tasya `dvigorluganapatye bahulavacanādvā| anye tu--`uruṣya iti nipātaḥ' ityācakṣate|| 134. ikaḥ suñi| (6.3.134) suñiti nipātasya grahaṇam‌| `abhi ṣu ṇaḥ' iti| abhiśabdasya dīrghatvam‌| `suñaḥ (8.3.105) iti ṣatvam‌| `naḥ' nipātasya ca| (6.3.136) `evā te, acchā te' iti| evācchaśabdau nipāttau; cādiṣu pāṭhāt‌|| 137. anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate| (6.3.137) ṛcīti nivṛttam‌| `keśākeśi' iti| keśeṣu keśeṣu gṛhītvedaṃ yuddhaṃ vṝttamiti `tatra tena' (2.2.27) ityādinā bahuvrīhiḥ `ic‌ karmavyatihāre' (5.4.127) itīc‌ samāsāntaḥ| `jalāṣāṭ‌' iti| jalaṃ sahata iti `chandasi sahaḥ' (3.2.63) iti ṣviḥ, `saheḥ ṣāḍaḥ ṣaḥ' (8.3.56) iti ṣatvam‌| dadhyañcatīti ṛtvigādinā (3.2.59) kvin‌, tataḥ, śas‌, `acaḥ' (6.4.138) ityakāralopaḥ| nanu cāntaraṅgatvādyaṇāveśenātrākāralopāddīrghācca prāg‌ bhavitavyam‌, sa hi varṇāśrayatvādantaraṅgaḥ, itarau tu bahiraṅgau, akāralopo hi tasya vidhīyate, bhasaṃjñā ca yakārādāvajādau ca svādau vidhīyate, dīrghatvamapyuttarapade parataḥ pūrvapadasya vidhīyamānaṃ dvipadāśrayatvatdbahiraṅgam‌, tataścāntaraṅge yaṇādeśe kṛte pūrvaṃ cau dīrghatvaṃ na sidhyati? ityata āha--`antaraṅgo'pi' ityādi| yadi yaṇādeśa eva pravarttate, tadā dīrghavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmāddīrghavacanasāmarthyādyaṇādeśo na pravarttate| nanu ca kṛte yaṇādeśe'nantaro dīrghabhāvo nāstīta kṛtvā vyavahitasyāpi dīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati, yathā--`śamāmaṣṭānāṃ dīrghaḥ śyani' (7.3.74) iti śamādīnāṃ śyani dīrghatvam‌, tasmādbhavitavyamevātra yaṇādeśena, tathā ca vyavahitasya dīrghatve kṛte'niṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌? naitadasti; idaṃ ca tāvadvicāryatām‌| kiṃ tat‌? `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) ityeṣā paribhāṣā bādhyeta, āhosvidantaraṅgaparibhāṣeti? tatrāntaṅgaparibhāṣāyā liṅgādanumānādvā siddhā, tasyā hi `vāha ūṭh‌ (6.4.132) ityūṅvacanaṃ liṅgam‌| yathā caitalliṅgaṃ tathā tatraiva vṛttikāro darśayiṣyati| itarā tu paribhāṣā sākṣāt‌ śrutā| tatra yuktaṃ yadanumito'rtho bādhyate, na tu sākṣāddṛṣṭa ityantaraṅgaparibhāṣā bādhyate, netareti| tathā cānantarasyaiva dīrghatvena bhavitavyamiti yaṇādeśo na pravarttate|| 139. samparasaraṇasya| (6.3.139) `kārīṣāgandhīputraḥ' iti| kārīṣagandherapatyamiti `tasyāpatyam‌' (4.1.92) ityaṇ‌, `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādinā ṣyaṅādeśaḥ, tataḥ `yaṅaścāp‌' (4.1.74) iti cāppratyayaḥ, tataḥ karīṣagandhyāyāḥ putra iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, tataḥ `ṣyaṅaḥ samprasaraṇam‌' (6.1.13) ityādinā samprasāraṇam‌, anena dīrghatvam‌| `vyavasthitavibhāṣā hi sā' iti| iko hrasvādau (6.3.61) sūtre `eka haladau' (6.3.51) ityataḥ sūtrādanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena kārīṣagandhīputra ityatra na bhavati| `akṛta eva' ityādi| atha vā--akṛta eva samprasāraṇadīrghatve kārīṣagandhiputra iti sthite hrasvatvaṃ prāpnoti, samprasāraṇadīrghatvaṃ ca; ubhayaṃ caitat‌ sāvakāśam‌, iko hrasvatavasyāvakāśaḥ--grāmaṇiputra iti, samprasāraṇasyāvakāśaḥ--hrasvābhāvaḥ; pakṣe tūbhayaṃ prāpnoti| tatra yadyapi hrasvābhāvapakṣe kṛtārtha dīrghatvam‌, tathāpi tena paratvād‌ hrasvo bādhyate| atha kṛte dīrghatve kasmāt punaḥprasaṅgavijñānānna bhavati? ata āha--`punaḥprasaṅgavijñānañca' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ|| <6.4> atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ caturthaḥ pādaḥ 1. aṅgasya| (6.4.1) `adhikāro'yam‌' iti| svaritaliṅgāsaṅgāt‌| iha kecit‌ prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'yamaṅgādhikāro yukta iti manyante| evaṃ hi `guṇo yaṅlukoḥ' (7.4.82) ityasmin‌ satre luggrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati; yaṅlukyāpi pratyayalakṣaṇena guṇasya siddhatvāt‌| yadi punarā saptamādhyāyaparisamāpterayamaṅgādhikāraḥ syāt‌, tato'vaśyaṃ luggrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌, na hyanyathā yaṅluki guṇaḥ sidhyati; `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratiṣedhādityedaṃ teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ| vṛttikārastu--yadi prāgabhyāsavikārebhyo'yamaṅgādhikāraḥ syāt‌, tato vavraścetyatra vṛścaterliṭi dvirvavacane kṛte halādiśeṣāt‌ prāk‌ samprasāraṇaṃ pūrvapratiṣedhena, `ubhayeṣām‌' iti vacanasāmarthyāddhāparamapi halādiśeṣaṃ bādhitvā samprasāraṇaṃ syāt‌, tataśca `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti pūrvarūpatve `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityattve raparatve halādiśeṣe ca kṛte vakārasyāpi samprasāraṇaṃ prasajyeta| ā saptamādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ punaraṅgādhikāre sati `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityasya paranimittatvāt‌ pratyayo nimittatvenāśrīyate| tena paranimittatvāduradattavasya samparasāraṇam‌' (6.1.37) iti vakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ pratiṣidhyate| prāgabhyāsavikārebhyaḥ punaraṅgādhikāre satyaparanimittatvā duradattvasaya sthānivadbhāvo na syāt‌, tataśca `na samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇam‌' (6.1.37) ityasya pratiṣedhasyābhāvādvakārasaya samaprasāraṇaṃ syādeva| tataścovraścetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| tasmādā saptamādhyāyaparasamāpteraṅgādhikāro yuktaḥ, na tu prāgabhyāsavikārebhya iti manyamāna āha--`ā saptamādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ' iti| saptamādhyāyaparisamāptestu pareṇa `padasya' (8.1.16) ityadhikṛtaya kāryaṃ vidhīyate| tena tatrāṅgādhikāro nānuvarttate| `hveñ‌ spardhāyām‌' [hveñ‌ spardhāyāṃ śabde ca--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1008) niṣṭhā, yajādītvāt‌ samprasāraṇam‌| `jīnaḥ' iti| ` jyā vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1499) grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam‌, `lvādibhyaḥ' (8.2.44) iti niṣṭhānatvam‌| `saṃvītaḥ' iti| `vyeñ‌ saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1007) vacyādinā (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam‌| `nirutam‌, durutam‌' iti| `veñ‌ tantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1006) pūrvavat‌ samprasāraṇam‌| asatyaṅgādhikāre nirduroravayavo yo hal‌ tato'pyuttarasya samprasāraṇasya dīrghaḥ syāt‌| aṅgādhikāre punaraṅgāvayavo yo hal‌ taduttaraṃ yat‌ samprasāraṇaṃ tadantasyāṅgasya dīrghatvaṃ vijñāyata iti na bhavati dīrghatvaprasaṅgaḥ| na hyatrāṅgāvayavāddhala uttaraṃ samprasāraṇam‌| `agnīnām‌' iti| `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ‌' (7.1.54)| `krimiṇāṃ paśya pāmanāṃ paśya' iti| kriyamo'syāṃ santīti, pāmāno'syāṃ santīti `lomādi' (5.2.100) ityādinā napratyayaḥ, tataṣṭāp‌, dvitīyaikavacanam‌| `ami pūrvaḥ' (6.1.107) iti pūrvarūpatvam‌| yadyaṅgasyeti nādhikriyate, tato'trāpi krimiśabdasya pāmaśabdasaya ca nāmi parato dīrghatvaṃ syāt‌| aṅgādhikāre tu na doṣaḥ, na hyatra krimipāmaśabdayornāmi parato'ṅgatvamasti, api tu napratyaye `brāhmaṇabhissā, odanabhissiṭā' iti| bhissābhissiṭāśabdau ṭābantau| tatraika odanasya vācakaḥ, aparastu taddagdhikāyāḥ| tābhyāṃ yathākramaṃ brāhmaṇaudanaśabdayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| tatrāsatyaṅgādhikāre anaṅgābyāmapi brāhmaṇaudanaśabdābhyāṃ parasya bhisa aisbhāvaḥ prasajyeta| nanu ca `tarthavadgrahaṇe nānarthakasya' (vyā.pa.1) iti vacanādyathā krimiṇāṃ paśya, pāmanāṃ paśyetyatra dīrghatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati, tathā brāhmaṇabhissaudanabhissiṭetyatrāpyaisbhāvaḥ, na hyatra nāmo'rthavattvam‌, nāpi bhisaḥ, tat‌ kiṃ tannivṛtyarthenāṅgādhikāreṇa? ityāha--`aṅgādhikāraḥ' ityādi| `nāmidīrghatvādyapi' ityādi| ādaśabdena `ato bhisa ais‌' (7.1.9) ityais‌ gṛhyate| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādasatyaṅgādhikāre `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghatvaṃ yathā hūtaḥ jīna ityatra bhavati, tathā nirutam‌, duratamityatrāpi syāt‌| `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghatvaṃ yathā cikīrṣatītyatra bhavati, tathā dadhi sanoti, madhu sanotītyatrāpi syāt‌| `erliṅi' (6.4.67) `vānyasaya saṃyogādeḥ' (6.4.68) ityettvaṃ yathā gleyādityatra bhavati, tathā niryāyāt‌ nirvāyādityatrāpi bhavet‌| tasmādevamādyartho'vaśyakarttavyo'ṅgādhikāraḥ| so'nyārthaḥ kriyamāṇo nāmi dīrghatvādyapi vyavasthāpayati-viṣayāntarādvyāvarttyābhimate viṣaye niyamati| tena tadarthameṣā paribhāṣā nāśrayitavyā bhavati| agatyā hi khalu paribhāṣā''śrīyata iti bhāvaḥ| nanu `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' (1.1.49) iti vacanādaṅgasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyam‌, tataśca `ato bhisaaisa' (7.1.9) ityetat‌ pañcamyantenāṅgasyetyetatṣaṣṭhyantasya samānādhikaraṇatvaṃ na syāt‌; bhinnavibhaktikatvāt‌| tathā ca satyakārāntāt‌ parasya bhissetyatrasyaisbhāvaḥ prasajyeta `ūdupaghāyā gohaḥ' (6.4.89) ityatra `gohaḥ' ityasyāḥ sthānaṣaṣṭhyā `alo'ntyasya' (1.2.52) ityante'lyupasaṃhārādupadhāgarahaṇasāmarthyāccha gohaścāntyasya syādūttvam‌| upadhāmātrasya ca `śāsa idaṅhaloḥ' (6.4.34) ityatrāpi śāsa iti sthānaṣaṣṭhītvena vijñātāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyā ante'lyupasaṃhārādupadhāgrahaṇānuvṛttisāmarthyācca śāsaścāntyasyettvam‌, upadhāmātrasya cetyetaddeśyamapākarttumāha--`aṅgasyeti sambandhasāmānya eṣā ṣaṣṭhī' ityādi| sambandhasāmānye-aviśeṣitasambandhamātre| tatrānekasambandhānugrahārthamanāśritaviśeṣaṃ sambandhasāmānyamupādāya pravṛttā satyuttareṣu bhinnārtheṣu lakṣamavākyeṣu yathāyogaṃ viśeṣeṣvavatiṣṭhate| sā kvacit‌ sthāne yogā bhavati, yathā `hanterjaḥ' (6.4.36) ityevamādau| kvacinnimittanimittisambandhaviṣayā, yathā--`yuvoranākau' (7.1.1) ityādau| yathaiva hi devadattasyetyekā ṣaṣṭhyabhedena pravṛttā jñātyavayavādiṣu sambandhabhedairbhidyamānā janyajanakabhāvādyaiḥ sambandhaviśeṣe yathāyogamupatiṣṭhate--devadattasya putraḥ pāṇiḥ kambala iti, tathāṅgasyetyeṣāpi| tatra yasmin‌ vākye `śāsa idaṅhaloḥ' (7.4.34) ityevamādau sambandhiviśeṣo vidyate--avayavo'nyo vā, tatra yathāyogamavayavādisambandhe ṣaṣṭhī vedatavyā| yatra na vidyate tatra sthāne ṣaṣṭhī, yathā--`hanterjaḥ' (6.4.36) itayavamādau| kathaṃ punareṣā sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhīti labhyate, yāvatā `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' (1.1.49) ityuktam‌? evaṃ manyate--na hi sarvā ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā bhavati, api tu yasyāḥ kalādikaṃ liṅgaṃ pratijñāyate; anyathā hi `udīcāmātaḥ sāthāne' (77.3.46) iti sthānagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmādviśiṣṭaiva yā ṣaṣṭhī yasyāḥ kalādikaṃ liṅgaṃ pratijñāyate sā sthāneyogetyuktam‌| na cāsyāḥ kalādikaṃ liṅgaṃ pratijñāyate| tato neyaṃ sthāneyogā bhavitumarhati| `atha vā' ityādi| aṅgaśabdasya prātipadikasya yo'rthastanmātradhikriyate, na tveṅsyetyetacchabdarūpam‌| mātraśabdo vibhaktyarthavyavacchedāya| ata evāha--`avivakṣitavibhaktyartham‌' iti| na vivakṣito vibhaktyarthī yasminnarthamātre tat‌ tathoktam‌| yataścetadevaṃ tena ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogeti| nātreyaṃ paribhāṣopatiṣṭhate| anekasambandhaprasaṅge hi sambandhāntaravyavacchedārthameṣā praṇītā| tato yatra sambandho vivakṣyate tatraiva niyamārthamupatiṣṭhate, na cātra kaścit‌ sambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vivakṣitaḥ kevalaṃ nirdeśārtha evāsyāḥ prayogaḥ| avaśyaṃ hi yathā kayācidvibhaktyā nirdeśaḥ karttavya iti ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| nanu ca svaritenādhikāraḥ, sa ca śabdadharmaḥ, nārthadharmaḥ, tat‌ kathaṃ svaritarahito'rthaḥ śakyato'dhikarttum‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; aṅgaśabdapratipādito yo'rthaḥ sa śabdātmaka eva| tathā hi yasmāt‌ pratayayavivistadādeḥ śabdasyāṅgasaṃjñā vihitā| `taduttaratra yathāyogaṃ vipariṇamyate' ityādi| arthavaśāt‌ kvacit‌ ṣaṣṭhyantatvenaiva kvacidvibhaktyantaratvena, yathā--āḍhyo rbadhaveyo devadettaḥ, uccānyasya gṛhāṇi, āmantrayasvainaṃ devadattamiti| tena `ato bhisa ais‌ (7.1.9) ityatra pañcamyantatayā vibhaktivipariṇāme hi satyakārāntādaṅgāduttarasya bhisa aisādeśo bhavatītyevamādyartharūpaṃ sampannaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdena yuṣmadasmadbhyāmuttarasya ṅaso'ś‌ bhavatīti parigṛhyate| piśabdādavayavaṣaṣṭhyādayo'pi parisampannā bhavanti| pūrvatra tu parihāre `ato bhis‌ ais‌' (7.1.9) ityatrāt‌ ityeṣā nimittanimittisambande ṣaṣṭhī draṣṭavyā| tatrāyaṃ sūtrārthaḥ--akārāntasyāṅgasya yī bhis‌ tasyaisbhavatīti| tena brāhmaṇabhissetyevamādau na bhavati| aṅgasya hi ko bhim‌? yastasya nimittam‌| kastasya punarnimittam‌ bhis‌? parabhūte yasminnaṅgamityeṣaṃ bhavati| kasmiṃścaitadbhavati? pratyaye| na ca brāhmaṇabhissetyevamādau bhispratyaya iti kutastasyaisprasaṅgaḥ|| 2. halaḥ (6.4.2) aṇgrahaṇaṃ samprasāraṇagrahaṇaṃ dīrghagrahaṇañcaitat‌ tarayamanuvarttate| kutaḥ punaḥ prakṛtamaṇgrahaṇam‌? `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111) ityataḥ| nanu tat‌ `ikaḥ kāśe' (6.3.123) itīggrahaṇena vyavacchinnam‌, tat‌ kathamihānuvarttate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, iggrahaṇena hyaṇeva viśiṣyate--aṇṇigita| tato virodhābhāvanneggrahaṇenāṇgrahaṇaṃ vyavacchidyate| nanu ca yadīggrahaṇenāṇgrahaṇaṃ viśiṣyate, tadā--`avācā, svarācā' ityatra dīrghatvaṃ na syāt‌| `cau' (6.3.138) ittrāṇgrahaṇamevātrānuvarttiṣyate, iggrahaṇaṃ tu nivṛttamityeṣo'payadoṣaḥ| atha vā--yadyapīggrahaṇenāṇgrahaṇaṃ vyavacchinnam‌, tathāpīha maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttate| nanu yathā `śeṣe' (4.2.92) ityetallakṣaṇaṃ vidhiradhikāraśca, tathā `aṅgasya' (6.4.1) ityetadapi, tataścānenaiva hūtaḥ, jīna ityādeḥ siddhatvādapārthakaṃ `halaḥ' ityetadvacanam‌| ato na karttavyameveti manyamāna āha--`hala iti kim‌' iti| kimarthaṃ `halaḥ' ityetat‌ sūtramārabhyata ityartha| `utaḥ, utavān‌' iti| asatyasmin‌ sūtre sanprasāraṇāntasyāṅgasya dīrgho bhavatītyucyamāna ihāpi dīrghatvaṃ syāt‌| bhavati hyetadapi vyapadeśivadbhāvena samprasāraṇāntamaṅgam‌, tasmāt `halaḥ' iti sūtraṃ karttavyam‌| `viddhaḥ' vicitaḥ' iti| `vyadha tāḍane' (dhā.pā.1181) `vyaca vyājīkaraṇe' (dā.pā.1293) niṣṭhā, grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam‌| samprasāraṇāntasyāṅgasya grahaṇādiha na bhavati dīrghaḥ| yadyapi `vidhyatyadhanuṣā' (4.4.83) `grahijyāvayivyadhivaṣṭivicati' (6.1.16) iti nirdeśāt‌ halantasya yat‌ samprasāraṇaṃ tasya dīrgho na bhaviṣyatīti vijñāyate, tathāpi jñāpakadvāreṇāsminnarthe pratipādyamāne pratipattigauravaṃ syādityetatparihārārthaṃ samprasāraṇāntasyetyuktam‌| `tṛtīyaḥ' iti| `dvestīyaḥ' (5.2.54) iti `treḥ samprasāraṇañca' (5.4.55) iti tīyapratyayaḥ samprasāraṇañca| sarvamātrāsti, na tvaṇ‌? kasmānnāstyaṇ‌? yasmāt‌ `ḍhralope' pūravasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111) ityata ihāṇgrahaṇamanuvarttate, tatra ca pūrveṇaiva ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇam‌, na ca tatra ṛkāraḥ sanniviṣṭa iti bhavatyeva pratyudāharaṇam‌| `tṛtīyeti vā' ityādi| atha vā `aṇa' ityetannivṛttameva| tathāpyatra na bhavatyeva dīrghaḥ; `karttukaraṇayīstṛtīyā' (2.3.18) iti nipātanāt‌| `halaḥ' ityetasaya trayo'rthāḥ sambhāvyante, hala uttarasya samprasāraṇāntasyāṅagsay dīrgho bhavati--ayameko'rthaḥ, aṅgavayavāddhala uttarasya samprasāraṇasya dīrgho bhavati--iti dvitīyaḥ, tṛtīyastu vṛttikāreṇaiva darśitaḥ| tatra yadi prathamaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate, tadā nirutam‌, durutamityatrāpi syāt‌| bhavati hyetadapi hala uttaraṃ samaprasāraṇāntamaṅgam‌| atha dvitīyastadā viddhaḥ, vicita ityatrāpi syāt‌| atrāpyāṅgavayavāddhala uttaraṃ samprasāraṇamiti| atha `vidhyatyadhanuṣā' (4.4.83), `grahijyāvayivyadhivaṣṭivicati' (6.1.16) iti nirdeśānna bhaviṣyati? tataśca jñāpakadvāreṇaivaṃvidhe dīrghatvābhāve pratipattigauravaṃ syādeva| tasmādetasyaiva doṣasya parijihīrṣayā tṛtīyo'rtho vṛttikāreṇa draśitaḥ| atrāpi deśyamidamāśaṅkyate--nanu cāyamartho'sya sūtrasya nopapadyata eva, yasmādaṅgasyetyekamaṅgagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtam‌| tacca halo viśeṣaṇaṃ vā syāt‌, aṅgasya kāryapratipattyarthaṃ vā| tatra yadi pūrvakaḥ pakṣa āśrīyate tadāṅgaviśiṣṭa samprasāraṇāntasyāṅgasyeti yāvaddīrgho na labhyate| atha dvitīyastadā hal‌ viśeṣito na syāt‌| tasmād‌dvitīyamaṅgagrahaṇaṃ karttavyaṃ syāt‌| na hyekena śakyametadubhayaṃ pratipādayitum‌| ato'sya deśyasya nirāsāyā''vṛttinyāyamāśrityāha--`aṅgagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| ekamapi hi vastvāvarttyamānamanekatropayujyate| yathaikaṃ bhājanamasahabhujāmanekeṣāṃ bhujikriyāyām‌, tathedamaṅgagrahaṇamāvarttyate| tatrānāvṛttena hal‌ viśiṣyate, āvṛttena tvaṅgasya dīrghatvaṃ bhavatītyubhayathārthapratipattirbhavati|| 3. nāmi| (6.4.3) aṇgrahaṇaṃ samprasāraṇagraham̐ dīrghagrahaṇañcaitat‌ trayamanuvarttate| kutaḥ punaḥ parakṛtamaṇgrahaṇam‌? `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' vidhīyate| aṅgañca pratyaye parato bhavati| na ceha śāstre kvācinnāmpratyayo vihitaḥ, tato na jñāyate--nāmīti kasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti? atastatparijñānārthamāha--`nāmīti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanam‌' ityādi| āgataḥ prāpto nuḍ‌ yena tadāgatanuṭkam‌| atha vā āgataḥ- prāpto nuḍ‌ yatara tadāgatanuṭkam‌| `kartatṝṇam‌' iti| kathaṃ punaratra dīrghatvam‌, yāvatā'ṇgrahaṇamatrānuvarttate? ata māha--`aṇa ityetannivṛttam‌' iti| `na tisṝcatasṛ' (6.4.4) iti tusṛcatasrordīrghatvapratiṣedhādītyabhiprāyaḥ| `uttarārtham‌' iti| `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) iti| atra nāmi parato nopadhāyā dīrghatvaṃ yathā syāt‌, āmi mā bhūditi--evamarthamāgatanuṭkagrahaṇam‌| tena varmaṇāmityatra dīrgho na bhavati| kṛte ca nuṭu dīrghatvapratipattyarthamityāgatanuṭkasya grahaṇamiti parakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `anyathā hi' ityādi| anyathā yadyāgatanuṭkasyāmo grahaṇaṃ na kriyate tadā nuṭa āmbhaktatvādāmgrahaṇena grahaṇe kṛte sati nuṭi dīrghatvena bhavitavyam‌, akṛte'pi| tataśca kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgo yo vidhiḥsa nitya iti nityatvāt‌ paramapi nuṭaṃ bādhitvā dīrghatvameva syāt‌| evañca sati hrasvāntamaṅgaṃ na bhavatīti nuḍeva na syāt‌| nanu na nuḍu hrasvāntādvidhīyate, na ca nityatvāddīrghatve kṛte hrasvāntamaṅgamāsti, tatra vacanasāmarthyādbhūtapūrvagatirbhaviṣyati, bhūtapūrvagatyā hrasvāntādaṅgāduttarasyāmo nuṅbhavatīti, na ca śakyate vaktum‌; tisṛṇām‌, catasṛṇāmityatra `na tisṛcatasṛ' (6.4.4) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| hrasvavacanaṃ sāvakāśamiti| yasmāt‌ `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ‌' (7.1.54) ityatara--`trestrayaḥ' (6.3.48) ityatastrigrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena trigrahaṇānuvṛttereva sthānivadbhavena tisṛṇāmityatra nuṅbhaviṣyati| tathā catasṛṇāmityatrāpi `ṣaṭ‌ caturbhyaśca' (7.1.55) ityanena sthānivadbhāvāditi| nāpi śakyate vaktum‌--nṛṇāmityatra `nṛ ca' (6.4.6) iti pakṣe dīrghatvābhāvāt‌ hrasvavacanasya sāvakāśatvamiti| na hyekamudāharaṇaṃ prati hrasvavacanaṃ prayojayati| yadi hyetāvat‌ prayojanaṃ syāt `nṛnadyāpo nuṭ‌' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| tadevaṃ hrasvavacanamanavakāśam‌| ataḥ kṛte'pi dīrghatve agnīnāmityādau bhūtapūrvagatyā nuṅ bhaviṣyati; hrasvagrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌| tasmādayuktamidamuktam‌--anyathā hi nuḍeva na syāditi| evaṃ tarhyanyathā vyākhyāyate vṛttigranthe--`āgatanuṭkasya grahaṇamuttarārtham‌' ityukte codaka āha--`kṛte ca nuṭi' ityādi| kasmānna bhavatīti vākyaśeṣaḥ| kṛte ca nuṭi dīrghasya pratipatiryathā syādityevamarthamāgatanuṭkasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatīti| yuktaṃ caitat‌, tathadhā hi yadyāgatanuṭkasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌ tato nityatvāddīrghatve kṛte hrasvābhāvādagnīnāmityādau nuḍ‌ na syāt‌| sanuṭkasya grahaṇe tu bhavatītyevaṃ cādakenokte satīdamāha--`anyathā hi' ityādi| hiśabdo'yamapiśabdārthe varttate| naśabdo'pi nanvityarthe varttate| anekārthatvā nnepātānām‌| evakāro bhinnakramaḥ, syādityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| tadayamatrārthaḥ--anyathāpi nanu nuṭ syādeva, na kevalaṃ sanuṭkasaya grahaṇe satyagnīnāmityādau nuḍ bhavati, api tvanyathāpyanāgatanuṭkasyāpi grahaṇe nuṭ‌ syādeveti| atha kimarthamāgatanuṭkasaya grahaṇam‌, `āmi dīrghaḥ' ityeva nocyeta? asmin‌ paryanuyoge sati `nāmi dīrghaḥ' ityādeḥ ślokasyopanyāsaḥ| yo'yaṃ nāmi dīrgha uktaḥ sa yadyāmi bhavedāmītyevaṃ sūtrapraṇayane sati kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena nityatvāt‌ paramapi nuṭaṃ bādhitvā dīrghatvameva syāt‌, tataśca nuṅ na syādeva, ahrasvāntatvādaṅgasya? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `vacanāt‌' iti| vacanānnuḍu bhaviṣyati| yadi dīrghatve nuḍ‌ na syāt‌, tadā `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ‌' (7.1.54) ityatra hrasvavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; anavakāśatvāt‌| tasmād‌ hrasvavacanasāmarthyādasati sāmpratike hrasvānte'ṅge bhūtapūrvagatyā kṛte'pi dīrghatve'ṅgasya nuṅa bhaviṣyati| yatra tannāstīti tatra vacanasyāvakāśa iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| yatra dīrghatvaṃ nāsti--tisṛṇām‌, catusṛṇāmiti tatra hrasvavacanasyāvakāśaḥ| ato'gnīnāmityādau dīrghatve kṛte bhūtapūrvagatyā nuḍāgamo na lakṣyate| sāmpratikābhāve hi bhūtapūrvagatirbhavati| nanu tisṛṇāmityādāvapi naiva hrasvavacanasyāvakāśaḥ| anyathaivātra nuṭaḥ siddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| ha tāvat‌ tisṛṇāmiti vināpi hrasavagrahaṇenānenaiva sūtreṇa nuṅ bhaviṣyati, trigrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| catasṛṇāmityatra `ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca (7.1.55) ityanenaiva nṛṇāmityatra yadyapi hrasvāntamaṅgaṃ tathāpi naikamudāharaṇaṃ prati hrasvavacanaṃ prayojayati, anyathā hi nṛgrahaṇameva kuryāt‌, na hrasvagrahaṇam‌| tasmannāstyeva hrasvavacanasyāvakāśaḥ| tadetadapārthakaṃ mā bhūditi hrasavavacana sāmarthyāt‌ kṛte'pi nuḍ‌ bhavatītayavicalametat‌| evamakriyamāṇe'pi sanuṭkasya grahaṇe dīrghatve kṛte'pi nuṅa bhaviṣyatīti paramatamāśaṅkya prayojanāntaramāha--`nopadhāyāśca' ityādi| caśabdastarhyarthe| evaṃ tarhi `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) iti dīrghatvaṃ nāmi parabhūte yā nopadhā tasyā yathā syāt‌--pañcānām‌, saptānāmityādau| atra hi `ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca' (7.1.55) ityanena pañcanāmityevamādernāntādaṅgādāmo nuṭi kṛte nāmi parato nopadhā bhavati| yadi punaḥ `āmi' ityevocyeta, tadā varmaṇāmityādāvapi dīrghatvaṃ prasajyeta| sanuṭkasya grahaṇe sati na bhavati, nuṭo lakṣaṇābhāvāt‌| atra hi kevala āmi nopadhā, na tu sanuṭke| tadevaṃ varmaṇāmityatra `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) iti dīrghatvaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ nāmītyuktam‌|| 4. na tisṛcatasṛ| (6.4.4) `tisṛ, catasṛ' iti `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) iti ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanasya lukaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| `tisṛṇām‌, catasṛṇām‌' iti| `tricaturoḥ striyāṃ tisṛcatasṛ' (7.2.99) iti tisṛcatasrādeśau bhavataḥ| nanu cātra dīrghatvasya prāptireva nāsti| tat‌ kiṃ pratiṣedheneti? tathā hyatrādeśayoḥ kṛtayorubhayaṃ prāpnoti--nuḍāgamaḥ, `aci ra ṛtaḥ' (7.2.100) iti rephādeśaśca, tatra paratvādrephādeśe satyanajantamaṅgaṃ bhavati| ajantasya dīrghatvena bhavitavyam‌, dīrghagrahaṇena `acaśca' (1.2.28) ityasyā upasthāpitatvādityata āha--`idameva' ityādi| yadyatra rephādeśaḥ syādayaṃ pratiṣedho na kṛtaḥ syāt‌, kṛtaśca, tas‌mādayaṃ pratiṣedho jñāpayati--`aci ra ṛtaḥ' (7.2.100) ityasmāt‌ pūrvavipratiṣedhena nuḍāgamo bhavatīti| tena `numaciraṛta jvadbhāvebhyo nuḍ‌ bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena' ityetaduktaṃ bhavati|| 5. chandasyubhayathā| (6.4.5) veti vaktavye `ubhayathā' iti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham‌|| 6. nṛ ca| (6.4.6) `kecidetacachandasīti nānuvarttayanti' iti| ta evaṃ manyante--yadyayaṃ yogaścandasyeva syāt‌ `chandasi nṛ cobhayathā' ityekayogameva kuryāt‌| cakāro hi tisṛcatasroranukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tatraikayogenaiva siddhe pṛthagyogakaraṇānniścīyate--bhāṣāyāmapyeṣa yoga iti|| 7. nopadhāyāḥ| (6.4.7) anajantārtha ārambhaḥ| na iti ṣaṣṭhyekavacanāntam‌, sautratvannirdeśasya yakāralopasyāsiddhatvamanāśritya `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) kṛtaḥ| na iti varṇagrahaṇam‌, tatra varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidhiṃ prayojayantīti nakārāntasyāṅgasyopadhāyāḥ tasyā dīrghatvaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`nakārāntasyāṅgasya' iti| `pañcānām‌' iti| `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nakāralopaḥ|| 8. sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddho| (6.4.8) `sāmāni' iti| `jasśoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20) iti śibhāvaḥ| `rājani' iti| sapatamyekavacanāntam‌| cakāraḥ `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| yadyevam‌, `cānukṛṣṭaṃ nottaratrāmisambadhyate' (vyā.pa.76) ityetadanuvṛttirna prāpnoti? evaṃ tarhyatadasandehārthaścakāra iti| asati hi cakāre sarvanāmasthāne sambuddhāvityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimayasambuddhāvatha sambuddhāviti| yadyetat‌ prayojanaṃ syāt‌ `asambuddhau sarvanāmasthāne' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| evaṃ tarhi vaicitryārthaścakāraḥ|| 9. vā ṣapūrvasya nigame| (6.4.9) atra dīrghagrahaṇena `acaśca' (1.2.28) ityasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā upasthāne satyac‌ sannidhāpitaḥ| `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) ityadhikārādupadhāpi| `ṣapūrvasya' iti| ṣaḥ pūrvo yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ| tatra yadyupadhā'nyapadārthatvenāśrīyeta, `ṣapūrvasya' ityastrīliṅgena nirdeśo nopapadyate, tasmādajatrānyapadārthatvenāśrīyata ityāha--`ṣapūrvasyācaḥ' ityādi| `upadhāyāḥ' ityetadacaḥ samānādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌| ṛbhukṣāṇām‌' iti| ṛbhṛkṣo'syāstīti dvitīyaikavacanam‌, `pathimathyṛbhukṣāṇām‌' (7.1.85) ityanuvarttamāne `ito'tsarvanāmasthāne' (7.1.86) ityattvam‌| pūrvagrahaṇamuttarārtham‌| iha tu `vā ṣo nigame' ityetāvatyucyamāne ṣakārāt‌ parasyācaḥ `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) iti vikalpena dīrghatvaṃ lakṣyata eva|| 10. sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya| (6.4.10) sakāre'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| sonto'sya sa tathoktaḥ| `sānta' ityavibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, tatrotpannāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyā luptatvāt‌| `sakārāntasya saṃyogo nakāro mahataśca' iti| tatrāpi nakāra ityapekṣate| sakārāntasya mahataśceti dve apyavayavaṣaṣṭhyau, sāntasaṃyogo yo nakāro'vayavo mahacchabdasya ca yo'vayava ityarthaḥ| etena sāntasaṃyogo mahacchabdaścobhayamapyetannakārasya viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| `tasyopadhāyāḥ' iti| tasyetyanena nakāraḥ pratyavamṛśyate| tasya nakārasya sambandhinyā upadhāyā ityarthaḥ| etaināpi nakāra upadhāyā viśeṣaṇamityācaṣṭe| kaḥ punarnakārasyopadhāyāśca sambandhaḥ yenāsau tasyeti vyapadiśyate? nimittanimittibhāvaḥ| antayanakārāpekṣayā hi parvatve satyantanakārāt‌ pūrvo varṇa upadhā bhavati| tasmānnakāro nimittam‌, uparadhā nimittanau| atha vā--samīpasamīpilakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ, etena nakārasamīpavarttinyā upadhāyā ityarthaḥ| `śreyān‌' iti| praśasyo'yam‌, praśasyo'yam‌, anayorayamprakarṣeṇa praśasya iti `dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunau' (5.3.57) itīyasun‌, `praśasyasya śraḥ' (5.3.60) iti śrādeśaḥ, `prakṛtyaikāc‌' (6.4.163) iti prakṛtivadbhāvāṭṭilopaḥ, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopaśca na bhavati| `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) ityādinā num‌, halṅyādi (6.1.68) saṃyogānta (8.2.23) lopau| `śreyāṃsi, payāṃsi' iti| pūrvavajjasaḥ śibhāvaḥ `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) iti num‌| kathaṃ punaratra nakārāt‌ pūrvasyopadhātvam‌, yāvatā `alontyātpūrva upadhā' (1.1.65) ityalāṃ sanniviṣṭānāṃ yo'ntyo'l‌ tataḥ pūrvasyopadhāsaṃjñā vihitā| na cātra nakāro'ntyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? sakāraḥ? naiṣa dīṣaḥ; apekṣitaṃ hyantyatvam‌| tat‌ sakārāt‌ pūrve ye varṇāsteṣāṃ nakāro'ntya iti| tataḥ pūrvo varṇa upadhā bhavati| yadyevam‌, takṣako rakṣaka ityatrāpi sakārāt‌ pūrve ye varṇāsteṣāṃ kakāro'ntya iti, tataḥ pūrvo'varṇa upadhā syāt‌, tataśca `ata upadhāyāḥ, (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ syāt‌? naitadasti; aṅgasya yo'kāra upadhā tasyā vṛddhirvidhīyate| na cātrākāro'ṅgasyīpadhā, ato na bhaviṣyatīti--etacacāśakyaṃ vaktum‌, akārasyāṅgāvayavatvāt‌| pācaka ityādāvapyaṅgāvayavatvādakāro'ṅgasyopadhetyucyate, tasmāt‌ prāpnotyeva vṛddhiḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) ityatra hi 'ñṇiti' (7.2.115) ityanuvarttate, tenopadhā viśiṣyate--ñiti pratyaye parato yopadheti, tatra `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt‌' (vyā.pa.49) ityekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśroyate, na punaranekena| takṣakaḥ, rakṣaka ityatrānekena varṇena vyavadhānam‌ ato na bhavati vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ| iha tu sūtrena sarvanāmasthānenopadhā viśiṣyate, kiṃ tarhi? saṃyogaḥ--tena sarvanāmasthāne parato yaḥ saṃyoga iti| tena yatra saṃyogādanantaraṃ sarvanāmasthānaṃ tatra yadyupadhāyāḥ sarvanāmasthānasya cānekavarṇakṛtaṃ vyavadhānam‌, tathāpi dīrghatvaṃ bhavatyeva| ata eva sarvanāmasthānaṃ tatra yadyupadhāyāḥ sarvanāmasthānasya cānekavarṇakṛtaṃ vyavadhānam‌, tathāpi dīrghatvaṃ bhavatyeva| ata eva sarvanāmasthānena saṃyogasaya viśeṣaṇāt‌ haṃsau, haṃsā ityatra dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati| na hyatra saṃyogādanantaraṃ sarvanāmasthānamasti, akāreṇa vyavadhānāt‌| atheha kasmānna bhavati--haṃsamācaṣṭa iti, `tadācaṣṭe' (vā.201) iti ṇic‌ ṇāviṣṭhavat‌ kāryaṃ prātipadikasya (vā.813) iti ṭilopaḥ, haṃsayateḥ kvip‌--han‌, haṃsau haṃsa iti? `vā ṣapūrvasya nigame' (6.4.9) ityato vāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| na caivaṃ sati sarvatra vikalpaprasaṅgaḥ; vyavasthitavibhāṣātvāt‌| etena `hisi hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1829) ityasya kvibantasya suhin‌ suhiṃsau suhiṃsa ityatra dīrghatvābhāvo veditavyaḥ| yastvāha--`idito num‌ dhātoḥ' (7.1.58) ityanena nityo num‌; numvidhāvupadeśivadvacanāt‌, tato numaḥ pṛthaksiddhatvaṃ nāsti, atra tu siddhānāṃ sambandhaḥ samavāyo bhavati, na tu saṃyogaḥ| tena saṃyogābhāvādiha dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati tanmatena saṃyogāntalopo'pi suhannityatra na syāt‌| neha vaiśeṣikaśāstraprasiddho'yaṃ saṃyogo gṛhyate api tu `halo'ntarāḥ saṃyogaḥ' (1.1.7) iti halānnairantaryalakṣaṇa iha śāstre prasiddhaḥ saṃyoga eva| sa cehāstyevetyasāraḥ parihāraḥ| `mahān‌' iti| `varttamāne pṛṣadvṛhanmahajjagacchatṛvacca' (da.u.6.5) iti nipātanasūtreṇa śatṛvadityatideśādugitkāryaṃ num‌| sāntamahata iti kim‌? bṛhanti|| 11. aptṛntṛcsvasṛnaptṛneṣṭṭakṣattṛhotṛpotṛpraśāstṝṇām‌| (6.4.11) `āpaḥ' iti| apśabdasya bahutvādekavacanadvivacane na sambhavata iti bahuvacanamupanyastam‌| `bahvāmpi' iti| bahava āpa eṣviti bahuvrīhiḥ| tadantavidheriṣṭatvāt‌ tadantasyāpi dīrghatvaṃ bhavati| tathā hi `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityatra sūtre `kāni punaratra prayojanāni' iti praśne idamuktaṃ prayojanam‌--mahadapasvasṛnaptṛneṣṭṛtvaṣṭṛ iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi tadantavidhirlabhyate yāvatā `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate' (vyā.pā.89)? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `sarvanāmasthāne cāsambṛddhau' (6.4.8) ityataścakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena tadantasyāpi dīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati| `kecit' iti vacanāt‌ kecinnecchantītyuktam‌| tanmatena bahvampītyevaṃ bhavati| kasmāt‌ punaratra `ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityanenākāraḥ samāsānto na kriyate? ityāha--`tatra samāsānto vidhiranityaḥ' ityādi| iyañca paribhāṣā `sphigapūtavīṇāñjo'dhvakukṣisīranāma nāma ca' (6.2.187) ityatrādhvagrahaṇena jñāpitā| yathādhvagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ tathā tatraidoktam‌| nanvevamapi bahvāmpīti naiva sambhavati, tathā hi--bahvap‌-śi iti sthite'nena dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti, `napusakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) iti num‌ ca, tatra kṛtakṛtapraṅgitvena nityatvāt‌ paratvācca num‌ karttavyaḥ, tasmin‌ kṛta upadhāyā adīrghabhāvinītvāddīrghatvaṃ na prāpnoti? ityata āha--`nityamapi ca' ityādi| nityamapītyapiśabdāt‌ paramapi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇaṃ numamakṛtvā dīrghatvaṃ lakṣyate? `vā ṣapūrvasya nigame' (6.4.9) ityataḥ pūrvagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--yadanyat‌ kāryaṃ prāpnoti tadakṛtvā dīrghatvameva pūrva karttavyamiti| anyastvāha--`napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) iti num‌ vidhīyate, napuṃsakañcārthadharmaḥ, arthe ca śabdānuśāsane'smin‌ kāryābhāvānnapuṃsakāmidhāyī śabdo numvidhāvāśrayaṇīyaḥ| tañca śabdaṃ grahītuṃ prayogo'nugamanīya iti numo bahiraṅgatvam‌| ayaṃ tu dīrghaḥ sākṣādapśabdamuccārya vidhīyamāno yathoccāritasyaiva kriyamāṇo'lpāśrayatvādantaraṅga iti pūrvaṃ dīrghaḥ pravarttate, paścānnumiti| etaccāyuktam‌, anena hi nyāyena bahvāmpīti na sidhyet‌| evadapi kaiścidiṣyate--asya ca nyāyasya sādhāraṇatvādihāpi parvameva dīrghatvena bhavitavyam‌, paścānnumā| pūrvasmiṃstu parihāre na doṣaḥ| ye hi bahvampītīcchanti te pūrvagrahaṇamiha nānuvarttayanti| `karttāraḥ' iti| tacchīlādāvarthe tṛnniti `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' (7.3.110) iti guṇaḥ| `janāpavādān‌' iti| dvitīyāntasyānuprayogastṛnnantatāṃ darśayitum‌| tṛno hi prayoge `na lokāvyayaniṣṭhā' (2.3.69) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyām‌, dvitīyaiva bhavati| ekavacanaṃ nodāhṛtam‌| tatra `ṛduśanaspurudaṃśo'nehasāñca' (7.1.94) ityanaṅādeśe kṛte `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) ityādinā dīrghasya siddhatvāt‌| `kaṭasya' iti ṣaṣṭhyantasyānuprayogastṛco'bhivyaktaye| tasya prayoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī bhavati `karttṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) ityanena| atha yathā `turiṣṭhemeyassu' (6.4.154) ityatra turiti tṛṃstṛcoryat‌ samānaṃ rūpaṃ tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌, na tu tayorbhedena, tatehāpi kimarthaṃ na kṛtām‌? `arvaṇastrasāvanañaḥ' (6.4.127) ityarvādeśasya tṛśabdasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthamiti cet‌, naitat‌ prayojanam‌; arthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayaiva (vyā.pa.1) hi tasya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tṛṃstṛcorbhedenopādānamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anityatvajñāpanārtham‌| tena `aninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena ca prayojayanti' (vyā.pa.129) ityupapannaṃ bhavati| atha vā--`sāmānyanirdeśe kvacidviśeṣa eva gṛhyate' iti jñāpanārtham‌| tena `na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) ityatra sāmānyoktāvapi taddhitavusambandhyeva kakāro gṛhyate, na kakāramātram‌| atha naptrādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā te hi kecit‌ tṛjantā vyutpādyante kecit‌ tṛnnantāḥ| tatra tṛstṛjgrahaṇenaiva sidadham‌? ityāha--`naptrādīnām‌' ityādi| kecidāryā naptrādīnyakṣyutpannāni prātipadikānīcchanti, kecidvyutpannāni| tatraiṣā vyutpattiḥ--naptriti namestṛci makārasya pakāro nipātyate| neṣṭrati--nayatestṛci ṣuk‌ ca| tvaṣṭriti--tviṣestatraivākāra upa(dhāyā aniṭtvañca| kṣitriti--kṣadestṛc‌| hotṛpotriti-jṛhoteḥ punāteśca sa eva| praśāstriti--śāseḥ [tṛn‌tṛcau śaṃsikṣadādibyaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ cāniṭau--paṃ.u.2.94] prapūrvācchasikṣadādibhyaḥ saṃjñāyāṃ cāniṭtvañceti tṛnnaniṭtvañca| tatrāvyutpattipakṣa eṣāṃ tṛntṛjantatvābhāvāt‌ tṛṃstṛjgrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti vidhyartha pṛthagupādānam‌| vyutpattipakṣe tu tṛṃstṛjantādeva siddhe niyamārtham‌--eṣāmeva saṃjñāśabdānāṃ yathā syāt‌, anye ya evambhūtāḥ saṃjñāśabdāsteṣāṃ mā bhūditi| tena mātarau mātaraḥ ityādau na bhavati| atha praśāstṛṇāmityatra kena ṇatvam‌, `raṣābhyām‌' (8.4.1) ityādineti cet‌? na; yasmāt‌ `raṣābhyām‌' ityucyate, na cātra raṣau staḥ| evaṃ tarhyeṣa nirdeśī jñāpayati--yato vihitaṃ ṇatvaṃ tato'nyatrāpi bhavatīti| tena mātṝṇām‌ pitṝṇām‌, grāmaṇīḥ agraṇorityādau ṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| tataśca raṣābhyāṃ ṇatve `ṛvarṇāccaceti vaktavyam‌' (vā.946) na vaktavyaṃ bhavati|| 12. inhanpūṣāryamṇāṃ śau| (6.4.12) `aninasmangrahaṇānyarthavatā cānarthakena ca tadantavidhiṃ prayojayanti' (vyā.pa.129) itīngrahaṇena tadantaṃ gṛhyate| itarebhyo'pi kevalebhyaḥ śinaṃ bhavatīti| tathā hi--hanniti hanteḥ kyibantasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌, na ca kevalasya hanteḥ kvibdṛśyate| itarau tu puṃlliṅgau| napuṃsakāduttarayoḥ jasśasoḥ śirvidhīyate| tasmāt‌ tairapi sāmarthāttadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha--`in‌, han‌, pūṣan‌, aryaman‌ ityevamantānāmaṅgānām‌' iti| `bahudaṇḍīni' iti| daṇḍa eṣāmastīti matvarthīya iniḥ, bahavo daṇḍinaḥ eṣāṃ santīti bahuvrīhiḥ, tato jaśśasau, tayośca pūrvavacchibhāvaḥ, anena dīrghatvam‌| nanu cennitipratyayagrahaṇam‌, tatra `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmāt‌ sa vihitastadādesatadantasya ca grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (bho.pa.sū.7) iti daṇḍinītyatraiva dīrghatvena bhavitavyam‌, na tu bahudaṇḍīnītyatra? netadasti; yatra hi pratyasyaiva grahaṇaṃ tatraiveyaṃ paribhāṣā, nedaṃ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇam‌, api tu prasyayāpratyayayoḥ; anyathā vāca eṣāṃ santīti `vāco gminaḥ' (5.2.124) vāg‌mīni, sraja eṣāṃ santīti `asmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121) `sragviṇītyevamādau na syāt‌| tasmānnātrāsau paribhāṣopatiṣṭhate| `bahubṛtrahāṇi' iti| bṛtraṃ hatavantaḥ `brahamabhruṇavṛtreṣu kvip‌' (3.2.87) bahavo vṛtrahaṇo yeṣu tāni bahuvṛtrahāṇi| `prātapadikāntanumvibhāktiṣu ca (8.4.11) iti ṇatvam‌| bahavaḥ pūṣaṇo yeṣu tānibahupūṣāṇi| bahavo'ryamaṇo yeṣu tāni bahvaryamāṇi| nanu `sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau' (6.4.8) ityanena dīrghatvaṃ siddham‌, tat‌ kimartho'yamārambhaḥ? ityata āha--`siddhe satyārambhaḥ' ityādi| yukto'saya niyamārthaḥ ārambhaḥ, kintvārabhyamāṇe'pyetasmin‌ niyamarthe bhrūṇahanītyatra `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnotyeva, tathā hyayaṃ śau sarvanāmasthāne niyama ārabhyate| atra yathā viśiṣṭāyāḥ prakṛterniyama ārabhyamāṇaḥ prakṛtyantarasya na bhavati--pratāmau, pratāma iti, tathā sarvanāmasaṃjñāviśiṣṭe śitpratyaya ārabhyamāṇaḥ sarvanāmasthāna eva syāt‌, anyatra na syāt‌; tulyajātīyāpekṣatvānniyamasya| tataścāsaravanāmasthāne niyamābhāvāddīrghatvaṃ syādevetyata āha--`dīrghavidhiḥ' ityādi ślokam‌| ya iha śāstra innantādīnāṃ dīrghatvivadhānaṃ taṃ viniyamya tasya niyamaṃ kṛtvā| kava viniyamya? suṭi| sarvanāmasthānopalakṣaṇametat‌ saṅgrahaṇam‌| sarvanāmasthāna ityarthaḥ| tataḥ kiṃ kuryāt‌? ityata āha--`śau niyamam‌' ityādi| sarvanāmasthāne niyamaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ śau niyamaṃ kuryāt‌| evakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ, sa tu bhinnakramaḥ, vidadhyādityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ suviddhān‌-supaṇḍitaḥ| kathaṃ punarekena yogena dvau niyamau śakyete karttum? evaṃ manyate--imaṃ yogaṃ vibhajya dvau yogau karttavyāviti| `inhanpūṣāryamṇām‌' ityeko yogaḥ, tataḥ `śau' iti dvitīyaḥ| sarvanāmagrahaṇaṃ cātrānuvarttate| tatra pūrvayogaḥ--darghavidhirya ihenprabhṛtīnāṃ taṃ vidhiṃ viniyamya suṭītyanena darśitaḥ| dvitīyastu `śau niyamaṃ punareva vidadhyāt‌' ityanena| tatra pūrveṇa yogena dīrghatvaṃ bhavet‌| `sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau' (6.4.8) ityanena `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) ityanena vā dīrghatvaṃ viniyamyate--inprabhṛtīnāṃ sarvanāmasthāna eva dīrghatvam‌, nānyatra| tena saptamyāṃ dīrgho na bhavati--vṛtrahaṇi, bhrūṇahanītyatra| dvitīyena tu śau niyamyate, tatrāpi sarvanāmasthāne śāveva dīrgho bhavati, nānyatreti| tena bahuvṛtrahāṇītyatra bhavati, vṛtrahaṇa ityatra na bhavati| evaṃ yogadvayena niyamadvaye kriyamāṇe sati yo'rthaḥ sampadyate taṃ darśayitumāha--`bhrūṇahani' iti| `tathāsya na duṣyet‌' iti| tathaivaṃ yogadvaye kṛte'sya pāṇineḥ bhrūṇahanītyetacchabdarūpaṃ naiva duṣyennāsiddhatvadoṣavadbhavavatītyarthaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādevaṃ yogadvayena niyamadvaye kriyamāṇe bhrūṇahanītyetanna duṣyeta; tasmāddīrghavidhirya ihenprabhṛtīnāṃ taṃ viniyamya suṭi śau niyamaṃ suviddhān‌ punarvidadhyāt‌| dvitīyastvitikaraṇo bhrūṇahanītyetasya svarūpapadārthakatāṃ dyotayati| evaṃ yogadvayena bhrūṇahanītyatra dīrghatvaṃ parihṛtyaikasmin‌ yoge pariharttumāha--`śāsmi' ityādi| śāsmi-upadaśāmi tamaparamupāyam‌, yenaikasmin‌ yoge sati bhrūṇahanau, bhrūṇahana iti na duṣyati| nāpi bhrūṇahanītyetat‌| kaḥ punarasāvupāyaḥ? ityāha--`nivarttya' ityādi| suṭītyekayogena sarvanāmasthānaṃ lakṣyate| `sarvanāmasthāne' iti yadetatprakṛtaṃ taṃ nivarttya| `aviśeṣe' iti| nāsya viśeṣo vidyata ityaviśeṣaḥ; tasminnaviśeṣe-anāśritaviśeṣe pratyayamātre śau ityevaṃ taṃ niyamaṃ kuru| evaṃ vā niyamaṃ kurvityarthaḥ| vāśabdaḥ pakṣāntaratvamasya parīhārasya dyotayati| apiśabdo bhrūṇahanītyatrāpi pakṣāntara āśrīyamāṇe na duṣyati? śāveva dīrghatvasya niyatatvāt‌| inprabhṛtonāṃ yadi dīrghatvaṃ bhavati tadā śāveva pratyaye, nānyatreti| nivarttya suṭītyanena śāstrīyasyādhikārasya nivṛttirdarśitā| nivṛtte tu tasmin‌ yadi laukiko'dhikāro'pekṣālakṣaṇa āśrīyate tadā pūrvavat‌ bhrūṇahanītyatra syādeva dīrghatvam‌| ato laukikādhāranirāsāyāha--`asamīkṣya' iti| suṭītyanenāsya sambandha-| sarvanāmasthānamapekṣyetyarethaḥ| evaṃ sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇanivṛtte'napekṣite ca pratyayamātrāpekṣayā śāvityayaṃ niyamaḥ pratyayamātraṃ niyamayati, na tu tulyajātīyaṃ sarvanāmasthānameva| tena na kevalamanyatra sarvanāmasthāne dīrgho na bhavati, api tu bhrūṇahanītyatrāpi| yadi tarhi pratyayamāśritya sarvanāmasthānaviṣayamanapekṣya śau niyamaḥ, evaṃ hi sati dīrghatvasya śāveva niyatatvādyathā bhrūṇahanītyatra na bhavatiṣa tathācāre kyaṅyapi `akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghatvaṃ na syāt, tataśca bhrūṇahevācaratīti `karttuḥ kyaṅ‌ salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti kyaṅi vihite bhrūṇahayata ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpamāpadyetetyata āha--`dīrghavidheḥ' ityādi| `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) ityata upadhāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena na sarvasya dīrghavidherayaṃ niyamaḥ, api tūpadhādīrghavidheḥ| na ca `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) ityupadhādīrghavidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? ajantadīrghavidhiḥ| tasmādayamatra pravarttata eva| hanta! `yi dīrghavidhau ca na doṣaḥ' iti| yakārādau pratyaye kpaṅi doṣo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| hanteti nipāto vacanārambhe'bhimukhīkaraṇe vā varttate| anye tu `hantayi dīrghavidhau ca na doṣaḥ' iti paṭhanti| ta evaṃ vyācakṣate--hantaryo hantiyaḥ, `pañcamī' (2.1.37) iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ, tasmin‌ hantiyi| saptamyekavacanametat‌| hanterdhātoryakārādiryaḥ pratya iti| tatra dīrghavidhau na doṣaḥ| cakāraḥ pūrvatra parīhāre vakṣyamāṇe ca| ata evopadhāniyamāddhanteryakārādau pratyaye na doṣa ityasyārthasya dyotanāya| samprati sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇe'nuvarttamāne, asati ca yogavibhāge bhrūṇahanītyatra yathā dīrghatvaṃ na bhavati tathā taddarśayitumāha--`suṭyapi vā' ityādi| vāśabdo'tra pakṣāntaraṃ dyotayati| apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ `aprakṛtapratiṣedhe' ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| atrāpi suṭītyetat‌ sarvanāmasthānopalakṣaṇārthaṃ veditavyam‌| nāsya vidyate'vakāśaḥ| vyāvṛttiviṣayo vyavacchedya ityanavakāśaḥ| prakṛtāt‌ sarvanāmasthānadanyadaprakṛtam‌| sarvanāsasthānavyatiriktaṃ pratyayāntaramaprakṛtam‌, tatra dīrghatvasya pratiṣedho'prakṛtapratiṣedhaḥ| aprakṛte pratiṣedho'prakṛtapratiṣedhaḥ| `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| `aprakṛtapratiṣedhe' iti| viṣayasaptamīyam‌| ayaṃ tādat‌ pūrvārdhasyāvayavārthaḥ| samudāyārthastūcyate--atha vā'nuvarttamāne'pi sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇe tatra śāvityasya niyamasya kiñcidvyāvattyamastītyanavakāśaḥ san‌ sāmarthyāda kṛtapratiṣedhe'pi karttavyatā viṣayabhūte pravarttate-vyāpriyate| apiśabdādanyatrāpi sarvanāmasthāne| kathaṃ punaravakāśaḥ? ityāha--`yasya hi' ityādi| yasyeti śāvityapekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī| hiśabdo yasmādarthe| dvividhaṃ hi sarvanāmasthānam‌--suṭ‌, śiśca| tayoḥ pūrvaṃ strīpuṃsayoḥ sambandhi, na napuṃsakasya; `suḍanapuṃsakasya' (1.1.43) iti vacanāt‌| itarat‌ punarnapuṃsakasya; tata eva tasya vidhānāt‌| tatra yatsambandhini śau sarvanāmasthāne śāvityayaṃ niyamaḥ kriyate, suṭi naitat‌| suṭi sarvanāmasthāne paratastannapuṃsakaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ| anena suṭaḥ sarvanāmasthānasyānapuṃsakasambandhitvamākhyātam‌| tena na tatra bhavedviniyamyam‌| yasmādeva suṭ‌ sarvanāmasthānaṃ napuṃsakasya sambandhi na bhavati, tena kāraṇena tatrānapuṃsakasambandhini sarvanāmasthāne śāvityasya niyamasya viniyamyaṃ vyāvattyaṃ nāstīti napuṃsakasambandhini hi kriyamāṇo niyamo yuktaḥ| anapuṃsakasambandhinyevāsmin‌ sarvanāmasthāne tulyajātīye nivṛttiṃ kuryāt‌| na ca śivyatiriktaṃ napuṃsakasambandhi sarvanāmasthānamasti, tato nāsti tulyajātīye vyāvarttyam‌| śau niyamasyeti tasyānavakāśatvam‌| tasmādaprakṛtapratiṣedhe'pi vyāpriyate| `hanteranunāsikasya' ityādinā kārikātrayasyāpi yathāpradhānamarthamācaṣṭe| tatra hanteranunāsikasyetyādinā `bhrūṇahanīti tathāsya na duṣyet‌' ityasyārtha ākhyātaḥ| `yogavibhāgaḥ' ityādinā `dīrghavidhirya ihenprabhṛtīnāṃ taṃ viniyamya suṭi' ityasya| `tataḥ' ityādinā `śau niyamaṃ punareva vidadhyāt‌' ityasya| `sarvanāmasthāna' ityādinā dvitīyaślokapūrvārdhasya| `yastu' ityādinottarārdhasya| `atha vā' ityādinā `suṭyapi vā prakṛteranavakāśaḥ' ityasya| `sāmarthyāt‌' iti| sāmarthyām‌-anavakāśatvam‌| `aviśeṣeṇa niyamaḥ' ityanena `śau niyamo'prakṛtapratiṣedhe' ityasaya| aviśeṣeṇeti sāmānyena, na prakṛta eva, api tu pratyayamātra ityarthaḥ| yastvaprakṛtaparatiṣedhārathatāmevāsya niyamasya vyācaṣṭe tasyaiva tadvacanamaviśeṣeṇetyanena vṛttikāravacanena virudhyate| evaṃ hyaviśeṣeṇa niyamo bhavati yadi sarvatra prakṛte cāprakṛte ca pratyayamātre bhavati| atha tu prakṛtaṃ paritayajyāprakṛta eva syāt‌ tato viśeṣeṇaiva syāt‌, nāviśeṣeṇa| aviśeṣeṇa vāsminniyame satyanenaiva sarvatra dīrghatvasya nivarttitatvāt‌ `sau ca' (6.4.13) ityayaṃ yogo vidhyartho veditavyaḥ| sāmarthyādaviśeṣeṇa niyama ityuktam‌| atastatsāmarthyaṃ darśayan‌ `śiśabde hi' ityādinā `yasya hi śau niyamaḥ' ityasyārthamācaṣṭe| yatra śiśabde niyamaḥ kriyate sa yasmānnapuṃsakasya sarvanāmasthānaṃ na strīpuṃsayoḥ; napuṃsakāduttarayorjaśśasoḥ vyādeśasya vidhānāt‌| `na ca tasyānyat‌ sarvanāmasthānamasti' iti| anena suṭaḥ sarvanāmasthānasya napuṃsakasambandhitvaṃ darśayati| itikaraṇo hetau| yata evaṃ niyamo vidhīyate napuṃsakasambandhini śau sarvanāmasthāne tajjātīyamanyat‌ sarvanāmasthānaṃ hi nāsti| tasmāt‌
