tulyajātīyavyavacachedyasyāsambhavādaviśeṣema niyamaḥ| `tatra tu' ityādi| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārtho bhinnakramaśca netyasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| tatraitasminniyame kriyamāṇa innādīnāṃ napuṃsakasyetyetadviśeṣaṇaṃ naivāśrīyate| anāśrīyamāṇe ca tasminneṣo'rthaḥ sampadyate--innādīnāṃ śāveva dīrgho bhavati, nānyatreti| tenānapuṃsakasyāpi bhrūṇahanītyatra niyamena vyāvarttitatvāddīrgho na bhavati| yadi napuṃsakasyetyetadviśeṣamaṃ teṣāmāśrīyate, tato'yamarthaḥ syāt‌--inprabhṛtīnāṃ napuṃsakānāṃ śāveva dīrgho bhavati, nānyatreti| tataśca napuṃsaka eva niyamaḥ syāt‌| tatra ko doṣaḥ? bhrūṇahani brāhmaṇakule ityatraiva dīrghanivṛttiḥ syāt‌, bhrūṇahani brāhmaṇe ityatra na syāt‌| tasmāt‌ taddoṣaparijihīrṣayā napuṃsakasyetyetadviśeṣaṇaṃ nāśrīyate| yadyevam‌, yaduktam‌--`anavakāśaḥ śau niyamaḥ' iti, tannopapadyate, anāśrite hyetasmin‌ viśeṣaṇe teṣāmanāśritaviśeṣaṇānāṃ napuṃsakānāmanapuṃsakātāñca sambandhini śau sarvanāmasthāne niyamaḥ syāt‌, tathābhūtānāñca teṣāmanyadapi suṭsarvanāmasthānamastyeva, tataśca tulyajātīyavayavacchedaviṣaye sati kuto niyamasyānavakāśatvam‌? naitadasti; niyamavidhānavelāyāṃ teṣāṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yadyapi nāśrīyate, tathāpi teṣāṃ napuṃsakādeva śervidhānānnapuṃsakasya nimittabhāvaḥ, śestu nimittibhāva iti nimittanimittibhāvalakṣaṇena sambandhena śeḥ sarvanāmasthānasya napuṃsakasambandhitvaṃ vidyata eva| na cānyannapuṃsakasambandhi saravanāmasthānaṃ vidyata ityupapannametat‌--anavakāśaḥ śau niyama iti| nanu cātra napuṃsakasyeti na prakṛtam‌, nāpyupāttam‌, tataśca tadāśrayaṇaśaṅkā nāstyeveti tannivṛttaye na yuktamidam‌, tatra tu `napuṃsakasya' ityetannāśrīyate? ityata āha--`sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñāvidhāne tu' ityādi| tuśabdo hetau| yato napuṃsakenotpāditasya viśabdasya `śi sarvanāmasthānam‌' (1.1.42) iti sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñā vidhīyate, tasmāt‌ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ prati napuṃsakamiti nimittabhāvamāpadyate| tadevaṃ nimittabhāvopayamanaṃ napuṃsakasya sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñāvidhāne vyāpāraḥ| tasmādyatra śiśabdaḥ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñakastatrāvaśyaṃ napuṃsakenopasthātavyam‌| iha tu sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ sarvanāmasthānasaṃjñakasya śiśabdasya grahaṇam‌| tato napuṃsakaṃ sāmarthyāt‌ sannihitam‌| tena sambhāvyate tadāśrayaṇamityabhiprāyaḥ|| 13. sau ca| (6.4.13) pūrveṇa niyamena sau dīrghatvaṃ na prāpnotīti vidhyartho'yamārambhaḥ| cakāra inprabhṛtīnāmanukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 14. atvasantasya cādhātoḥ| (6.4.14) `atra kṛte dīrghatve numāgamaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate, yāvatā kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt‌ paratvācca numaiva bhavitavyaṃ pūrvamityāha--`yadi hi' ityādi| iha dīrghagrahaṇena `acaśca' (1.2.28) ityupasthāpite satyajlakṣaṇāyā upadhāyā dīrgo vidhīyate| yadi ca paratvānnityatvānnum‌ prāgvidhīyate, aca upadhātvaṃ vihanyeta| tasmādvacanasāmarthyāddīrghaḥ prāgbhavati, tato numāgamaḥ| `supayāḥ, suyakṣāḥ, `susrotāḥ' [`suśrotāḥ--kāśikā] iti| `asun‌' (da.u.9.49) iti varttamāne `pibatericca' (da.u.9.50) [`pibateri ca'--da.u.] iti, `aśerdevane yuṭ‌ ca' (da.u.9.51) [`aśerdhane'--da.u.] `sruribhyāṃ tuṭ‌ ca' (da.u.9.62) [srarībhyāṃ--da.u.] iti--ete yathākramamasunparatyayāntā payoyaśaḥsrotaḥśabdā vyutpadyante| `piṇḍagraḥ, carmavaḥ' iti| `grasu glasu adane' (dhā.pā.630,631), `vasa ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1023), `anyemyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip‌| nanu cārthavadgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā(vyā.pa.1)'rthavānevāsityayaṃ gṛhyate, yathā mūlodāharaṇeṣu, payaḥprabhṛtīnāmasunpratayayāntatvāt‌ pratyayārthenārthavānasau, na tathā pratyudāharaṇayoḥ, dhātvavayavastatra dorghatvasyāparasaṅgādapārthako'dātoriti pratiṣedhaḥ? ityata āha--`anarthako'pi' ityādi| kathametallabhyate? ityāha--`aninasmangrahaṇāni' ityādi| atheha kathaṃ dīrghatvam‌--gomantamicchati gomatyati, `supaātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8) gomatyaterapratyayo gomāniti, kathañca na syāt‌? adhātoriti pratiṣedhāt‌ asya `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (3.1.32) iti dhātutvāt‌? naitadasti; `adhātoḥ' iti pratiṣedha ānantaryyādanantarasyaiva, nāntarasya| atha vā cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, teneha dhātorapi bhaviṣyate| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `aṅgasya' (6.4.1) ityanuvarttate, tatra gṛhyamāṇenātuśabdenāsaśabdena ca prakṛte'ṅge viśiṣyamāṇe viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyantareāpyantagrahaṇaṃ tadantasyaiva dīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`antagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| upeśaḥ-lakṣamadākyāni, gaṇapāṭhaḥ, prātipadikapāṭha| prayujyata iti prayogaḥ, karmaṇi ghañ‌| upadeśe prayoga upadeśaprayoga iti| `saptamo' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| tadayamasya vākyasyārthaḥ--upadeśe prayujyate yacchabdarūpaṃ tadekadeśasyāpyatvantasya parigraho yathāsyā dityevamarthamantagrahaṇamiti| kasya punarasatyantagrahaṇa upadeśe prayogaikadeśasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌, yatastatparigrahārthamantagrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`anyathā hi' ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na syāt‌? ityāha--`upadeśe rūpanirgrahahetau' ityādi| nirgrahaṇaṃ nigrahaḥ-niścaya ityarthaḥ| rūpasya svarūpasya śabdasya nirgraho niścayano rūpanirgrahaḥ, tasya hetū rūpanirgrahahetuḥ| upadeśagrahaṇamupalakṣamamātram‌| laukiko'pi hi prayogo gṛhyate| upadeśāddhi śabdarūpaṃ niścīyate, laukikādvā prayogāt‌| matupcāyaṃ laukike prayoge nātvantaḥ śrayate, nāpyupadeśe, ato'tvantatayā nāvadhāryate| tataścānavadhāryamāṇatvānna gṛhyate| antagrahaṇe ca satyantagrahaṇa sāmarthyādatvantamātragrahaṇe vijñāyamāne yo hyupadeśe prayogaikadeśabhūtastasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavatītyupapadyate matupo grahaṇam‌|| 15. anunāsikasya kvijhalo kṅiti| (6.4.15) `kvippratyaye parato jhalādau ca kṅiti' iti| atra `kṅiti' ityetajjhalādāvityanenaiva sambadhyate, na tu kvippratyayena; yataḥ sambhavavyabhicāre hi viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvo bhavati| kittvaṅittvayostu sambhavyabhicārā vubhāvapi jhalādau staḥ, na tu kvau| tathā hi kittvasya kvāvavyabhicāraḥ, ṅittvasya tavasambhavaḥ| `praśān‌ pratān‌ pradān‌' iti| `śamu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1201), `tamu kāṃkṣāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1202), `damu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1203)--etebhyaḥ prapūrvebhyaḥ kvipi `mo no dhātoḥ' (8.2.64) iti natvam‌| `śaṃśāntaḥ' iti| śameryaṅaḥ, dvivacanam‌, `nṛgato'nunāsikāntasya' (7.4.85) iti nuk‌, `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti yaṅo luk‌, laṭ‌, tas‌, tasya `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) iti ṅittvam‌, `carkarītañca' (dhā.pā.1081) ityadādau pāṭhādadāditvācchapo luk‌|| 16. ajjhanagamāṃ sani| (6.4.16) `upadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) iti nivṛttam‌, ata eva vṛttau `upadhāyāḥ' iti noktam‌| kaḥ punastadanuvṛttau doṣaḥ syāt‌? vyañjanasyāpi dīrghatvaṃ prasajyeta| cikīrṣati, tuṣṭūṣatītyatra hi yathā `acaḥ' (1.2.28) iti vacanādaco bhavati, tathā `upadhāyāḥ' iti vacanādanaco'pi syāt‌| yadyevam‌, hanigamyoracyupadhāyā dīrghatvaṃ na syāt‌, kasya tarhi syāt‌? `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityantyasya? naitadasti; atra hi dīrghagrahaṇena yat‌ `acaḥ' (1.2.28) ityupasthāpitaṃ taddhanigamibhyāṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ--aco dīrgho bhavati sa ceddhanigamyoriti| yadyevam‌, abhyāsasyāpi syāt‌? naitat‌; kṛtadīrghasyaiva dvirvacanavidhānāt‌| kuta etat‌? dvirvacanāt‌ dīrghasya paratvāt‌| `tuṣṭūṣati' iti| `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ śeṣaḥ' [`śeṣaḥ' iti sūtre nāsti--7.4.61] (7.4.61)| `cikīrṣati' iti| `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam‌, raparatvam‌, `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ, abhyāsasya `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam‌| `jighāṃsati' iti| `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti hanteḥ kutvam‌--ghakāraḥ, abhyāsasya pūrvavaccutvam‌--jhakāraḥ, tasya `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) iti jakāraḥ| `adhijighāṃsate' iti| `iṅaśca' (2.4.48) itīṅo gamirādeśaḥ, `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam‌| `sañjigāṃsate' iti| atrāpi `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) iti taṅa| gamerhyasanantāt‌ `samo gamyucchi' (1.3.29) ityādinātmanepadaṃ vihitam‌| iṅo'pi `anudāttaṅitaḥ' (1.3.12) ityādinā| yadi gameriṅādeśasyeti vacanaṃ, tatkathaṃ chandasyaniṅādeśasyāpi svargaṃ lokaṃ samajigāṃsadityatra dīrghatvaṃ dṛśyate? ityāha--chandasi yadaniṅādeśasyāpi' ityādi| `samajigāṃsat‌' iti| gameḥ sanantālluṅa, `gameriṭ‌ pasmaipadeṣu (7.2.58) itīḍāgamo na bhavati; `na vṛdbhyaścaturbhyaḥ' (7.2.59) ityatra neti yogavibhāgāt‌| `iha' ityādinā yaduktaṃ `gameriṅādeśasya' (vā.775) iti, tatpratyācaṣṭe| `sani' iti prathamo yogaḥ, hanigamyostu dīrghavidhānāya `hanigamyoḥ' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ kattavya ityabhiprāyaḥ| kathaṃ punaretāvati yoge kriyamāṇe'jantasyaiva dīrghatvaṃ sidhyati? ityata āha--`tatra' ityādi| `gṛhyamāṇasya' iti| kṛdyoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī| `viśeṣaṇe'iti| bhāve lyuṭ‌| viśeṣaṇamanajanatavyavacchedāya| yatra hrasvadīrghaplutāḥ śiṣyanete tatra `acaśca' (1.2.28) ityetadupatiṣṭate, tatrāṅgasya dīrgho bhavati, kiṃviśiṣṭasyācaḥ? evamacā gṛhyamāṇasyāṅgasya viśeṣaṇe vyavacchede sati vinā'pyajgrahaṇenāntasyaiva dīrghatvaṃ siddham‌, yathā--`akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) ityatra| tasmādapārthakatvānna karttavyameva| kimarthaṃ taddhi kriyate? ityāha--`tatkriyate' iti| pravarttanaṃ pravṛttiḥ-vyāpāraḥ, tasya bhedo nānātvam‌| pravṛttibhedaścaikasyāṃ satyāmāvṛtto na sambhavatītyāvṛttirabhyupagantavyā| nanu ca `acaśca' (1.2.28) ityasyopaśtāne sati dve ajgrahaṇe bhavata iti kimityāvṛttirāśrīyate? naitadasti; asati hyajagrahaṇe `acaśca' (1.2.28) ityasyopasthānaṃ bhavati| atrājagrahaṇe tu sati nirdiṣṭasthānikatvāt‌ `acaśca' (1.2.28) ityetannopatiṣṭate, yathā `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) ityatrekparibhāṣā `ajantasyāṅgasya' ityādinā pravṛttibhedenāṅgamacā gamiñca viśeṣayati| `tato na vaktavyamidam‌' iti| ajgarahaṇenaivaitatpratipādyasayārthasyāsiddhatvāt‌| na hīṅādeśamuktvā'nyo gamiracaḥ sthāne sambhavati|| 17. tanotervibhāṣā| (6.4.17) `tanoterupasaṃkhyānāt‌' iti| `tanipatidaridrāṇām‌' (kātyā.vā.5059-7.2.49) ityasmāt‌| śtipā nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ| prakṛtigarahaṇaparibhāṣāyā (vyā.pa.77) tadantādapi vikalpaḥ sambhavet‌--tantaṃsati|| 18. kramaśca ktvi| (6.4.18) `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ' (6.4.15) ityādinā nitye prāpte vikalpārtha vacanam‌| `upadhāyāḥ' iti| kuta etat‌? `acaśca' (1.2.28) ityasyopasthānādupadhāyā eva kramo'ctvāt‌| `kramitvā' iti| `udito vā' (7.2.56) iti pakṣa iḍāgamaḥ| `prakramya' iti| `samāse'nañpūrvektvo lyap‌' (7.1.37)| nanu dīrghatvaṃ katvāpratyayamapekṣata ityantaraṅgam‌| lyabādeśastvanekapadāśrayatvāt‌ samāsamapekṣamāṇo bahiraṅgo bhavati| tatrāntaraṅgatvāllayabadeśāt‌ prāgeva jhalādau dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`bahiraṅgo'pi' ityādi| `ado jagdhirlyapti kiti' (2.4.36) ityatra jñāpitametat‌--`bahiraṅgo lyabādeśo'ntaraṅgān‌ vidhīn‌ bādhate' iti|| 19. cchvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca| (6.4.19) yadi kevalasya cchakāramātrasya grahaṇaṃ kriyate, tadā `praccha jñīpsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1413) ityasya ktapratyaye kṛte'ntaraṅgatvāt‌ `cche ca' (6.1.73) iti tuki kṛte chakāramātrasya śakārādeśe kṛte pṛṭṣṭa ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| satukkasaya grahaṇe tu sati sthānyantarbhāvāt‌ tugapyādeśena nivarttyata iti na bhavatyeva doṣaprasaṅga ityetadālocya satukkasya grahaṇamiti darśayitumā--``cha' ityetasya satukkasya' iti| satukkasya grahaṇaṃ `yajayācayatavicchapracchirakṣo naṅaḥ' (3.3.90) iti ṅitkaraṇādavagamyate| tasya hi ṅitkaraṇasyaitatprayojanam‌--viśna ityatra `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti gaṇo mā bhūditi; yadi cātra tugrahitaḥ kevala eva cchakāraḥ sthānitvena parigṛhyate tadā tuki kṛte chakāramātrasya sakāre kṛte gurūpadhatvādeva guṇona bhaviṣyatīti ṅitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| satukkasya tu grahaṇe kṛte tuki satukakasyaiva śakārādeśaḥ kriyate, tataśca ladhvyāmupadhāyāṃ samupajātāyāṃ guṇaḥ prāpnotīti tatpratiṣedhāryaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ kriyamāṇamathavadbhavatītyeke varṇayanti, etaccāyuktam‌; satupajātāyāṃ guṇaḥ prāpnotīti tatpratiṣadhār‌thaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ kriyamāṇamathavadbhavatītyeke varṇayanti, etaccāyuktam‌; satupajātāyāṃ guṇaḥ prapnotīti tatpratiṣedhārthaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ kriyamāṇamathavadbhavatītyeke varṇayanti, etaccāyuktam‌; satukkasyāpyādeśe kṛte niṣṭhitamaṅgaṃ bhavati, prayogārhatvāt‌| tatra `aṅgavṛtte punaraṅgavṛttāvavidhirniṣṭhitasya' (vyā.pa.38) ityanayā paribhāṣayā guṇo na bhaviṣyatīti| tasmāt‌ satukkasyāpyādeśe kriyamāṇe sati ṅitkaraṇamanarthakameva, kathaṃ tena satukkasya grahaṇamavasīyate? evaṃ tarhi `nanau pṛṣṭaparativacane (3.2.120) iti nirdeśāt‌ satukkasya grahaṇamavasīyate| tugrahitasya grahaṇe pṛṭṣṭetyevaṃ yathokta prāk‌| naṅastu ṅitkaraṇaṃ `anityamāgamaśāsanam‌' (vyā.pa.99) iti jñāpanārtham‌| anityatve hi tasya yadā tugabhāvastadā'sati ṅitkaraṇe guṇaḥ prasajyeta| nanu cāsati prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati, asti ca tasya ṅitkaraṇasya prayoḍajanam‌, kiṃ tat‌? grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) praccheḥ samprasāraṇaṃ yathā syāditi? naitadasti; na hi pracchernaṅi samprasāraṇamiṣyate| kathametajjñāyate? `praśne cāsannakāle' (3.2.117) iti nirdeśāt‌| tadetat‌ ṅitkaraṇam‌ `anityamāgamaśāsanam' (vyā.pa.99) ityasya jñāpakameva| atha tu satukkasyāpi grahaṇe kathaṃ satukkasyādeśo bhavati, yāvatā `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti vacanādantyasyaiva syāt‌? naitadasti; satukkasya grahaṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati| evamapi tadantasyāṅgasya syāt‌| `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' (vyā.pa.106) iti tadantasya na bhaviṣyati| `praśnaḥ' viśna' iti| `praccha jñīpsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1413) `viccha gatau' (dhā.pā.1423) `yajayāca' (3.3.90) iti naṅ‌| `antaraṅgatvāt‌' ityādi| `che ca' (6.1.73) iti hrasvasya varṇasya tugvidhīyata iti varṇāśrayatvāt‌ tugantaraṅgaḥ, śakārastvaṅgāśrayaḥ| tatrāṅgasyaiva tāvad‌ pratyayāśrayatvādvahiraṅgatvam‌| kiṃ punastadāśrayasya śakārasya| nanu ca `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' (vyā.pa.39) iti śakārasyaiva balīyastvam‌? naitadasti; yatra hyāṅgavārṇayoryugapadekanimittamāśritya prāptistatrāsyā upasthānaṃ bhavati| yathā `iyāya' ityatra yamevākāramāśritya `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityabhyāsekārakasya yaṇādeśaḥ prāpnoti, tamevākāramāśritya `abhyāsasyāsavarṇe' (6.4.78) itīyaṅapi| tatra yugapadekatrobhayaprāptau `vārṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' (vyā.pa.39) ityasyā upasthāne satyaṅgakāryamiṅeva bhavati| iha tu prāgeva naṅutpatteśchakāramāśritya tukprāpnoti, uttarakālaṃ naṅi vihite tadāśraḥ śakāra iti bhinnāśrayatvam‌, ato neyamupatiṣṭate| `sideḥ' iti| `ṣivu tantusantāne' (dhā.pa.1108) ityasya| `auṇādike napratyaye' iti| `dhāpṛvasyajatibhyo naḥ' (da.u.5.39) iti vādibhyo vidhīyamāno napratyayo bahulavanāt‌ siverapi bhavati| kenacit‌`siveṣṭheryū ca' (da.u.4.5) [`siveṣṭerūca'--ityuttvam‌] ityanena sūnaśabdasya vyutpattaye nakāro vidhīyate, dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyāt‌ tatra guṇo na bhavati| ye tu syonaśabdavyutpattaya evedaṃ sūtraṃ varṇayanti, teṣāṃ dīrghoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| ta na hi hrasvasya dīrghasya vā guṇe kṛte kaścidviśeṣo'sti| `laghūpadhaguṇāt‌ pūrvamūṭh‌ kriyate' iti| `antaraṅgatvāt‌' iti| vakṣyamāṇo heturihāpi draṣṭavyaḥ| guṇo hyārddhadhātukamaṅgasambandhinīñcopadhāṃ ladhvīmiglakṣaṇāṃ viśiṣṭāmevāśrayati| ūḍādeśastvanunāsikādiṃ pratyayamaṅgasambandhitāviśiṣṭaṃ vakāramātram‌| tasmādguṇo bahiraṅgaḥ| ūḍādeśastvantaraṅgaḥ| ato'ntaraṅgatvālladhūpadhaguṇāt‌ pūrvamevoṭh‌ kriyate| tatara kṛte'ntaraṅgatvādyaṇādeśa iti laghūpadhagūṇāt‌ pūrva kriyata iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| antaraṅgatvaṃ tu varṇāśrayatvādyaṇādeśasya| nanu ca `varṇādāṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' (vyā.pa.39) ityāṅgasya guṇasyaiva balīyastvam‌, tataḥ sa eva yaṇādeśāt‌ pūrvaṃ kasmānna kriyate? ityāha--`nānāśrayatvāt‌' ityādi| yatra hyubhāvapyāṅgavārṇau vidhī ekaṃ nimittamāśritya prāpnutastatreyamupatiṣṭhata ityuktam‌| iha tu yaṇādeśa ūḍāśrayaḥ, guṇastvārddhadhātukāśraya iti bhinnāśrayatvam‌| ato naiyaṃ paribhāṣopatiṣṭate| `śabdaprāṭ‌' iti| śabdaṃ pṛcchatīti `kvibvaci' (vā.288) ityādinā kvip‌, dīrghaśca, vaścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) śakārasya ṣakāraḥ, tasyāpi jaśtavaṃ ḍakāraḥ, tasyāpi cartvaṃ ṭakāraḥ| `goviṭ‌' iti| `viccha gatau' (dā.pā.1423) gāṃ vicchatīti kvip‌| `kvipca' (3.2.76) ityanena| tathā `akṣudyaḥ, hiraṇyaṣṭhyūḥ' ityatrāpi diviṣṭhivibhyām‌| nanu yaṇādeśo'ntaraṅgo varṇāśrayatvāt‌| ūḍādeśastu pratyayāśrayatvādbahiraṅgaḥ, tatra `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) iti yaṇādeśanātra na bhavitavyam‌? ityatada āha--`asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' ityādi| yatra dvayoracorānantaryyaṃ tatraiṣā pratiṣidhyate `nājānantarye bahiṣṭvaparaklṛptiḥ' (vyā.pa.44) iti| asyā ayamarthaḥ--acorānantarye sati bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā na prakalpate, na bhavatītyarthaḥ| atrārthe jñāpakam--`ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ' (6.1.86) iti tuki karttavye'siddhavacanam‌| tasya hyetadeva prayojanam‌--adhītyetyatra savarṇadīrghasyāsiddhatvāddhrasvalakṣaṇastugyathā syāditi| yadi cācorānantarye bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā syāt‌ tadaikapadāśrayatvādantaraṅge tuki karttavye padadvayāśrayatvādbahiraṅgasyaikādesyāsiddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti kimasiddhavacanena? tadaikapadāśrayatvādantaraṅge tuki karttavye paddvayāśrayatvādbahiraṅgasyaikādesyāsiddhatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti kimasiddhavacanena? tatkriyatejānantarye bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā nāstīti jñāpanārtham‌| `hiraṇyaṣṭhyūḥ' ityatra `dhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ' (6.1.64) iti satvaṃ na bhavati; `subdhātuṣṭivuṣvaṣkatīnaṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' (vā.671) iti vacanāt‌| `pṛṣṭaḥ' iti| grahyādisūtadreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam‌, pūrvavat ṣatvaṃ ṣṭutvañca| `dyubhyām‌' iti| `diva ut‌' (6.1.131) ityuttavam‌| `ye'tra kṅitīti nānuvarttayanti teṣāmanyatrāpyanena vidhinā bhavitavyam‌, tataḥ dyubhyām‌, dyubhiriti na sidhyatīti manyamāna āha--`kathaṃ dyubhyām‌, dyubhiriti ūṭhi kṛte' iti| ūṭhi kṛte na kiñcit‌ sidhyatītyarthaḥ| `diva uditi taparatvānmātrākālo bhaviṣyati' iti| `diva ut‌' (6.1.131) ityatra taparakaraṇaṃ na karttavyam‌| yadyapi hi `bhāvyamāna ukāraḥ savarṇān‌ gṛhṇāti' (cāndra pa.44), tathāpyāntaratamyādardhamātrākālasya vyañjanasya mātrākāla evokāro bhaviṣyati| na dīrgha iti kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena taparakaraṇena? takriyate lakṣaṇāntareṇāpi yo dīrghaḥ prāpnoti sa mā bhūdityevamartham‌| tenātra `diva utta' (6.1.131) ityanenaiva taparatvānmātrākālo bhaviṣyati, anyathā yadi `cchvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityanena dīrghaḥ syāt‌ tato niṣphalaṃ `diva ut‌' (6.1.131) ityatra taparakaraṇaṃ syāt‌; vyāvarttyābhāvāt‌| atha vā `ūṭhi kṛte' ityuttareṇa parihāragranthena sambadhyate| tatrāyamarthaḥ--kriyatāṃ nāma sāmānyena kṅiti cākhiti coṭh‌| kṛte'pi tatra `ekādeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati' (vyā.pa.16) iti tasyaiva sthāne `diva ut‌' (6.1.131) ityanena taparatvāddhrasvo bhaviṣyati| etadeva hi tasya prayojanam‌--ūṭhsthāne bhavan‌ mātriko yathā syāt‌, āntaratamyāddīrgho mā bhūditi| asmiṃśca vyākhyāne yadukagtam‌--`diva uditi tapakaraṇamūṭho nivṛttyarvam‌, dyubhyām‌, dyubhirityatra paratvādūṭh‌ prāpnoti' iti tadvirudhyate| na hi tenottvasyoṭhaḥ sthānyādeśabhāva upapadyate, kiṃ tarhi? bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ| tathā hi tasyāyamratho varṇyate--ūṭho nivṛttyartha bādhanārtha taparakaraṇam‌| asati hi tasmin‌ paratvāṭūṭh‌ prāpnoti, tasmāt‌ tadbādhanārthaṃ taparakaraṇam‌| paramapyūṭhaṃ bādhitvā'nenaivamātrika ukāro yathā syāditi nāsti virodhaḥ| ye hi sthānyādeśabhāvamicchanti ta evaṃ granthaṃ vyācakṣate| ūṭho nivṛttyartha sthānibhūtasyoṭho nivṛttyarthamityarthaḥ| ūḍādeśe kṛta ūṭh‌sthitimato nivṛttiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ taparakaraṇamityarthaḥ| paratvādūṭh‌ prāpnotītyatra vihitaśca| śrutimānityadhyāhāryyam‌| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--atra hi paratvādūḍ‌vihitaḥ san‌ śratimāneva prāpnoti, nivṛttimāṃśceṣyate| tasmāt‌ tasya nivṛttaye taparatvamiti| atapare'pyādeśe vidhīyamāne satyūṭho nivṛttirbhavatyeva; nivṛttidharmatvāt‌ sthāninaḥ| ucyate cedaṃ taparakaraṇasūṭho nivṛttyarthamiti| tatra vacanasāmarthyādyasyāṃ nivṛttau satyāṃ viśeṣo bhavati tadarthaṃ taparakaraṇamiti vijñāyate| tataśca sāmarthyādidamuktam‌--bhavatyūṭho hrasvādeśārthaṃ taparakaraṇamiti| yatastapara ādeśe satyūṭho yā nivṛttiḥ kriyate tasyāṃ satyāṃ viśeṣo bhavati| nātapare| atapare hyādeśe satyāntaratamyāddīrghasya dīrgha eva syāditi kuto viśeṣaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kidgrahaṇe nivṛtte satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati, yadartaṃ kecidatra kṅitīti nānuvarttayantītyāha--`chaśāṃ ṣaḥ ityatra' ityādi| kṅidgrahaṇe nivṛtte satyaviśeṣeṇa kṅiti cākṅiti cānene cchakārasya śakāro vidhīyate, tena vraścādisūtre (8.2.66) chagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavet‌| śakārasya ṣatvavidhānenaiva sarvasya ṣatvasyābhāvācchakārasya ṣatvavidhānārthaṃ vraścādisūtre (8.2.36) chagrahaṇaṃ karttavyameva| atha teṣāṃ kathaṃ praṣṭheti sidhyati, yāvatā tuki kṛte chakāramātrasya ṣatve praṭṣṭetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, te hi vraścādisūtre (8.2.36) satukkasya cchakārasya grahaṇamicchanti| ūḍayaṃ yadi ṭit‌ syāt‌ `ādyantau ṭakitau' (1.1.46) ityādau syāt‌| tatra yadyapi vakārasya vali lope kṛte satyakṣadyūrityādi sidhyati, jūrityādi tu na sidhye| ṭittve hi sati jvaratvarādi (6.4.20) sūtreṇaiko vakārāt‌ pūrvamūḍaparo'kārāditi dvāvūṭhau syātām‌| tasmādūṭhaṣṭhittvamaṅgīkarttavyam‌ na ṭittvam‌| tasyāpi ṭhittvasya yadi prayojanaṃ na syādvaiyarthya syādityetaccetasi kṛtvoḍādeśasya yaṭṭhittvaṃ tasya prayojanaṃ darśayitumāha--`ūṭhaṣṭhitkaraṇam‌' ityādi| evaṃ brūvatā `etyedhatyūṭhsu' (6.1.89) ityatrāpi ṭhita eva grahaṇaṃ bhavati| evaṃ hyūṭhaṣṭhitkaraṇasya viśeṣaṇārthatopapadyate, yadi tatrāpi ṭhita eva grahaṇaṃ bhavati, nānyathā| yadyatra ṭhakāro'nubandho na kriyate tadā `etyedhatyūṭhsu' (6.1.89) ityatrāpi na karttavyam‌; ṭhakārānubandhavata ūkārasya kvacidasambhavāt‌| evañcocyamāne praūhate, prohata ityatrāpi vṛddhiḥ syāt‌| tasmādviśeṣaṇārthaṃ ṭhitkaraṇaṃ kriyate| ṭhakārasya tu śravaṇaṃ na bhavati; kṛtacartvasya nirdeśāt‌| yadi tarhi ṭhidayam‌, `etyedhatyūṭhsu' (6.1.89) ityatrāpi ṭhita eva grahaṇam‌, evaṃ sati `vāha ūṭh‌' (6.4.132) ityasya tatra grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌, tataśca praṣṭhauha ityatra vṛddhirna syādityata āha--`vāha ūṭhityayamapi' ityādi| ṭhakārasyāpi pūrvavadevāśravaṇam‌|| 20. jvaratvarasrivyavimavāmupadhāyāśca| (6.4.20) srivyavimavāṃ vakārasaya pūrṇeṇaiva siddham‌| upadhāyāstu na sidhyatīti tadarthameṣāṃ grahaṇam‌| jvaratvarayostu vakārasyāpi pūrveṇa na sidhyati; anayorakārarephābhyāṃ jhalādeḥ kvipaśca vyavadhānāt‌| tasmāt‌ tayorvakārārthamupadhārthañca grahaṇam‌| `jūḥ, jurau, juraḥ' iti| `jvara roge' (dhā.pā.776) vakārasyopadhāyāścoṭhi kṛte `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti pūrvarūpatvam‌| `jarttiḥ' iti| ktin‌| `tūḥ' iti| `ñi tvarā sambhrame' (dhā.pā.775) `tūrṇaḥ'[`tūrttiḥ--kāśikā-`tūrṇaḥ' iti nāsti] iti| `radābyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ' (8.2.42) iti natvam‌| `srūḥ iti| `srivugatiśoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1109)| savaraṇadīrghaḥ| `sruvau, sruvaḥ' iti| `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinovaṅa| `ūḥ' iti| `ava rakṣaṇe' [rakṣaṇa kāntiprītitṛpatyavagamapraveśaśravaṇasvaṇasvamyarthayācanakriyecchādīptyavāpatyāliṅganahiṃsādānabhāgavṛddhiṣu--dhā.pā] (dhā.pā.600)| `mūḥ' iti| `mava bandhane' (dhā.pā.599)| iha jvarādisambandhinyā upadāyā ūṅ‌vidhīyate, upadhā cālo'ntyātpūrvo varṇaḥ, antyatvañcāpekṣitam‌; tatra yathā--śreyān, śreyāṃsāvityatra sakārāt‌ pūrve ye varṇāsteṣāmantyo yo nakārastasmāt‌ pūrvo varṇa upadā, tathā jvarādīnāmapi yo pūrvau varṇau tayoryo'ntyo varṇastasmāt‌ pūrva upadhā, sā ca jvarādīnāṃ sambandhinī; tadavayavatvāt‌, tataśca tasyā apyupadāyā ūṭhā bhavitavyamiti kasyācit‌ bhrāntiḥ syāt‌| atastāṃ nirākartuṃ yasyā upadāyā ūṭhā bhavitavyaṃ tāṃ darśayitumāha--`jvaratvarayorupadhā vakārātparā' ityādi| yasyā upadhāyā ūṭhā bhavitavyam‌, sohopadhāśabdena vivakṣitā| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇasyā vṛttikāropadarśitāyā upadhāyā ūṅbhavati, nānyasyāḥ? kvajhalbhyāṃ kṅitā copadhāviseṣaṇāt‌| atra kvippratyayena jhalādinā kṅitā copadhā viśiṣyate--jvarādīnāṃ yopadhā kvau jhalādau ca paratastasyā upadhāyā ūṅbhavatīti| atra `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi' (vyā.pa.46) ityādinā yatraikena varṇena vyavadhānaṃ vṛttikāreṇoktāyā upadāyāḥ sambhavati, tasyā evoṅbhavati, 21. rāllopaḥ| (6.4.21) `mūrchā' iti| `murchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ' (dhā.pā.212)| `hūrchā' iti| `hurchā kauṭilye' (dhā.pā.211) kathaṃ punaratra cchakāralopo bhavati, yāvatā nātra sūtre chakāra upāttaḥ; yo'pi prakṛtaḥ so'pi satukkaḥ, nātra tugasti, na hi rephasya cche kvacit‌ tugvihitaḥ? ityāha--`rāllope satukkasya' ityādi| uttaratrānuvṛttiryathā syāditi pūrvasūtre cchakārasya svaritatvaṃ pratijñātam‌, na ca raḥ paraḥ satukkaḥ sambhavati| tatra samārthyāt‌ tugrahita evānuvarttate| atha vā--pūrvasūtre dvicchakānirdeśaḥ; tatraikaḥ satukkaḥ, parastugrahitaḥ| sambhavati cāgamaśāsanasyānityatvāddhā tugrahitaśchakāraḥ| evañca kṛtvā yaduktam‌--naṅo ṅittvaṃ guṇapratiṣedhārthamiti, tadupapannaṃ bhavati| tadevaṃ yadyapi pūrvasūtre chakārau prakṛtau, tathāpi repāt‌ paraḥ satukko na sambhavati| kevalo yastugrahitaḥ sa evānuvarttate| `tūḥ, dhūḥ' iti| `turvī thurvī durvī dhurvī hiṃsārthāḥ' (dhā.pā.570-573)|| 22. asiddhavadatrā bhāt‌| (6.4.22) `asiddhavadbhavatītyevaṃ veditavyam‌' iti| siddhaśabdo'yaṃ pariniṣpannavacanaḥ| yathā--`siddha odanaḥ' iti| na siddhamasiddham‌, siddhakāryākaraṇasādharmyeṇāsiddhena tulyaṃ varttata ityasiddhavat‌| kiṃ punastat‌? prādhānyāt‌ kāryamityeke; śāstraṃ hi kāryārtham‌, ataḥ śāstrāpekṣayā kāryasya prādhānyam‌; vyāpternyāyāt‌| śāstrasyāvadhitvenopādānācca śāstrasyāsiddhavadabhāvo yuktaḥ, anyathā hi kāryameva kiñcidavadhitvenopādīyeta| athābhāṭgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā svaritaliṅgāsaṅgādantareṇāpyābhādgrahaṇamā pādaparisamāpterasiddhavadityanuvarttiṣyate? ityāha--`ā bhāditi viṣayanirdeśaḥ' iti| asati hyā bhādgrahaṇe na jñāyate--kasmin‌ karttavya idaṃ prakaraṇamasiddhavadbhavati; tasmādā bhāditi viṣayanirdeśaḥ kriyate--ā bhasaṃśabdanādyadvakṣyate tasmin‌ karttavyatayā viṣayabhūte'siddhavadbhavatītyasyārthasya parijñānāya| yadyevam, atretyetapadārthakalametadviṣayanirdeśārthaṃ kriyate, sa ca viṣaya ā bhādityanenaiva nirdiṣṭaḥ? ityata āha--`atra' ityādi| samāna eva āśrayo nimittaṃ yasya tat‌ samānāśrayam‌, tasya bhāvaḥ samānāśrayatvam| tasya prasiddhaye parijñānāyātragrahaṇam, taccedatreti bhavatīti vākśeṣaḥ| tadityanena yasyāsiddhavadbhāvo vidhīyate tannirdiśyate| atretyanenāpi yatra tato'nyadābhācchāstrīyaṃ tat‌ tadāśrayameva bhavatīti| asiddhavaditi vakṣyamāṇenābhisambadhyate| tadityanena yatrā bhācchāstrīyaṃ vidhīyate tasya parāmarśaḥ| sa āśrayo nimittaṃ yasya tat‌ tadāśrayam‌| evakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| tadevāsiddhavadbhavatīti yāvat‌| `vyāśrayastu nāsiddhavadbhavati' iti| evakāreṇa yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayati| yatra tadābhācchāstroyaṃ kāryaṃ vidhīyate tato bhinno'rthāntarabhūta āśrayo yasya tat‌ tathocyata ityartha iti| itikaraṇenānantaraṃ vyākhyāto'rthaḥ pratyavamṛśyate| atragrahaṇe samānāśrayatvaprasiddhyarthe satadyeṣo'sya sūtrasyārthaḥ sampadyata iti yāvat‌| kimarthaṃ punarasiddhavadbhavatītyata āha--`asiddhavacanam‌' ityādi| utsargaśabdena sthānyatropadiśyate, utsṛjayata ādeśena nivarttyata iti kṛtvā| utsargasādharmyādvotsargaḥ| yathā hyutsargasya sāmānyena pravṛttasya sataḥ kutaścidviseṣānnivṛttirbhavati, evaṃ sthānino'pyādeśāt‌| utsargau lakṣaṇam‌-nimittaṃ yasya tadutsargalakṣaṇam‌ ādeśo lakṣaṇaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tadādeśalakṣaṇam‌, tayoryathākramaṃ bhāvapratiṣedhau yathā syātam‌--ityevamarthamasiddhavacanam‌| `edhi, śādhi' iti| utsargalakṣaṇabhāvasyodāharaṇam‌| `asa bhūvi' (dhā.pā.1065), `śāsa anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075), [`śāsu' dhā.pā.] loṭ‌, sip‌, `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti harādeśaḥ, adāditvācchapo luk‌, śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ| paratvānnityatvācca ghibhāvāt‌ pūrvaṃ `dhvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca' (6.4.119) ityettvam‌| śāserapi nityatvāt‌ `śā hau' (6.4.35) iti śādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ ghibhāvāt‌ tayorettvaśābhāvayoḥ `hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ' (6.4.101) iti jhalantalakṣaṇaṃ dhitvaṃ na prāpnoti, nimittābhāvāt‌| asiddhatvādbhavati| `āgahi, jahi' iti| ādeśalakṣaṇapratiṣedhasyodāharaṇam‌| agāhīti--gamerāṅapūrvālloṭ‌, sip‌, tasya hirādeśaḥ, `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.76) iti śapo luk‌, `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.36) ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ| jahīti--hanteraloḍādi pūrvavat‌, adāditvācchapo luk‌, `hanterjaḥ' (6.4.36) iti jabhāvaḥ| atredānīmanunāsikalopajādeśayoruttarakālaṃ `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti herlopaḥ prāpnoti; asiddhatvānna bhavati| `abhāji' iti| `bhanjo āmardane' (dhā.pā.1453) luṅaḥ, karmaṇyātmanepadam‌, `ciṇbāvakarmaṇoḥ' (3.1.66) iti cleściṇ‌, `ciṇo luk‌' (6.4.104) iti takāralopaḥ, `bhañjeśca ciṇi' (6.4.33) ityununāsikalopaḥ| tasya samānāśrayasyāpi vṛddhāvanābācchāstrīyāyāṃ karttavyāyāmā bhāditi vacanādasiddhatvaṃ na bhavati| `rāgaḥ' iti| rañjerghañ‌, `ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' (6.4.27) ityanunāsikalopaḥ| tasyāpi samānāśrayāyamapi sāptamikyāṃ vṛddhau karttavyāyāmā bhādati vacanādasiddhatvaṃ na bhavati| `papuṣaḥ cicyuṣaḥ luluvuṣaḥ' iti| pāteścinoterlunāteśca liṭaḥ kvasuḥ, dvirvacanam‌, `vasoḥ samprasāraṇam‌' (6.4.131) tasya vyāśrayatvāt‌ iti| pāteścinoterlunāteśca liṭaḥ kvasuḥ, dvirvacanam‌, `vasoḥ samprasāraṇam‌' (6.4.131) tasya vyāśrayatvāt‌ `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityakāralopaḥ, `eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasaya' (6.4.82) iti yaṇādeśe `aci in‌ dhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinovaṅādeśe ca karttavye'siddhavattvaṃ na bhavati| nanu ca `usyapadāntāt‌' (6.1.96) ityanenaiva pararupeṇa saravaṃ siddham‌? naitadasti; pratipadoktasya hyusśabdasya tatra grahaṇam‌, lākṣaṇikoścātros‌| kathaṃ punaratra vyāśrayatvamityāha--`āllopādīni hi' [`hi'--nāsti kāśikāyām‌] ityādi| hiśabdo yasmādarthe| itikaraṇastasmādarthe| nanvevamapi `asiddhaṃ baharaṅgamantaraṅga' (vyā.pa.42) iti antaraṅgeṣvāllopādiṣu bahiraṅgasya samaprasāraṇasyāsiddhatvādāllopādayo na prāpnuvantyeva| tatra hi vibhakteḥ, pūrvo vasavanto bhāgaḥ, tadāśrayā lopādaya iti, samprasāraṇaṃ tu vibhaktyāśrayam‌, prakṛtyāśrayañcāntaraṅgam‌, pratyayāśrayaṃ ca bahiraṅgamityāha--`asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam‌' ityādi| `etadapi' iti| etadapīti vacanāpekṣayā napuṃsakena nirveśaḥ| `eṣā hi' ityādinā paribhāṣāyā apravṛttau kāraṇamāha| yatrāntaraṅgabahiraṅgayoryugapadupasthānaṃ tatraiṣā paribhāṣā pravarttate, antaraṅge karttavye bahiraṅgasyāsiddhatāmāpādayitum‌| iyañca paribhāṣā `vāha ūṭh‌' (6.1.132) ityatrābhācchāstre jñāpitatvādābhācchāstrīyā| ato'syāṃ karttavyāyāṃ `asiddhavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) iti `vasoḥ samprasāraṇa' (6.4.131) syāllopādīnāñcāsiddhatvādantaraṅgabahiraṅgayoyurgapadupasthānaṃ nāstīti na pravarttate| tadapravṛttau nāsti bahiraṅgasamprasāraṇasyāsiddhatvam‌| tena bhavantyevāllopadayaḥ| `vugyuṭau' ityādi| vugyuḍityetau yathā kramamuvaṅi yaṇi ca karttavye siddhau bhavata ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--iha vatigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌, vināpi tenātideśaḥ siddha eva, yathā--`ṣatvatukorasiddhaḥ' (6.1.86), `pūrvatarāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) iti ca| tat‌ kriyate kvacit‌ svāśrayamapi siddhaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌| tena vugyṛṭāvuvaṅyaṇoḥ siddhau bhaviṣyataḥ| `babhūva' iti| `bhavateraḥ' (7.4.73) ityabhyāsasyātvam‌, `bhuvo vugluṅaliṭoḥ' (6.4.88) iti vuk‌| tatra yadyasiddhaṃ syāt‌ `aciśnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinā uvaṅa syāt‌, tasya siddhatvānna bhavati| `upadidīye' iti| `dīṅaḥ kṣaye' (dhā.pā.1134) liṭ‌ tasya `liṭastajhayoḥ' (3.4.81) ityādineśu, `dīṅo yuḍaci kṅici' (6.4.63) iti yuṭ‌| tasyāpi yadyasiddhatvaṃ syāt‌ `eranekoco'saṃyogapūrvasya' (6.4.82) iti yaṇādeśaḥ syāt‌| siddhatvānna bhavati| ā bhādityāṅa maryādāyāṃ vā syāt‌? abhividhau vā? tatra yadyādya pakṣa āśrīyata bhādhikārīyasyāsiddhatvaṃ na syāt‌| tataśca `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) ityasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā anābhācchāstrīyatvādasthāṃ pravarttamānāyāṃ vasoḥ samprasāraṇasyāllopādīnāṃ cāsiddhatvaṃ na syāt‌| evamapi vasoḥ samprasāraṇasya bahiraṅgasyāntaraṅgāṇāñcālopādīnāṃ yugapadupasthāne sati tayā paribhāṣayā pravarttamānayā vasoḥ samprasāraṇasya bahiraṅgasyāntaraṅgāṇāñcālopādīnāṃ yugapadupasthāne sati tayā paribhāṣayā pravarttamānayā vasoḥ samprasāraṇasyāsiddhatve utpādite'ntaraṅgatvādallopādayaḥ papuṣaḥ, cicyuṣaḥ, luluvaṣa ityatra na syuḥ? itomaṃ maryādāpakṣe doṣaṃ vṛṣṭvā dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrityāha--`ā bhādityayamabhividhāvāṅ‌' iti| gatārthaśca|| 23. śnānnalopaḥ| (6.4.23) anyasya śnaśabdasyāsambhavādasatyapi śnamo makārasya śravaṇe sāmarthyāt‌ śnama eva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, ityata āha--`śnamayamutsṛṣṭamukāraḥ' iti| utsṛṣṭaḥ-parityakto makāro yasya sa tathoktaḥ| `anakti' ityādi| `añjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu' (dhā.pā.1458) `bhanjo āmardane' (dhā.pā.1453) `hisi hiṃsāyām‌', (dhā.pā.1456) asyodittvānnum‌, rudhāditvāt‌ śnam‌| śakāravatograhaṇametadarthaṃ kriyate--`nanditā, nandakaḥ' ityatra mā bhūditi, etaccāprayojanam‌; `pratyayāpratayayayoḥ pratyayasyaiva grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.72) ityanayā paribhāṣayā'tra na bhaviṣyati| jñāpakācca, yadayaṃ nandinandanaśabdau kṣubhnādiṣu paṭhati, tajjñāpayati--nandernakāralopo na bhavatīti| sāmānyāpekṣañca jñāpakam‌, tena `nanditā, nandakaḥ' ityatrāpi na bhaviṣyati| tasmāt‌ `nānna lopaḥ' ityevaṃ vaktavyamityabhiprāyeṇāha--`śakāravato grahaṇaṃ kim‌' iti| `yajñānām‌, yatnānām‌' iti| `yajayāca' (3.3.90) iti naṅ‌, tadantāt‌ ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanam‌, nuṭ‌| yadi śakāravato grahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tadā tatra nalopaḥ syādeva| syādetat‌--dīrghe kṛte `nāt‌' iti vyapadeśābhāvānna bhaviṣyatīti? ata āha--`supi ca' ityādi| `supi ca' (7.3.102) ityartha dīrgho'jādeśaḥ, tasya nakāralopapūrvavidhau karttavye `acaḥ parasmin‌ parvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāvena tadrūpatāmāpanne parātvāddīrghatve yadi kṛte'pi śakāraviśiṣṭasya grahaṇaṃ na kriyate tadā syādevātra nalopaḥ| kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvācca| dīrghatvaṃ tu nakāralope kṛte nimittavihitatvānna prāpnotīti tadanityam‌| nanu ca pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāva uktaḥ, na cāyaṃ pūrvavidhiḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ayamapi pūrvavadhireva| `pūrvasmād‌ vidhiḥ pūrvavidhiḥ' ityasyāpi samāmasya tatrāśrayaṇāt‌| atha kriyamāṇe'pi śakāravato grahaṇe kasmādiha na bhavati--`viśvānām‌, praśnānām‌' iti, bhavati hyatrāpi śakāravānnakāraḥ? ityāha--`viśnānāṃ praśnānāmityatra' ityādi| iha hi lakṣaṇapratipadokataparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3.) pratapadokto yaḥ sākṣānnirdiṣṭaḥ śnaśabdastasya grahaṇam‌, na tu lākṣaṇikasya| `viśnānām‌, paraśnānām‌' ityatra hi `cchvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) iti śakāre kṛte śnaśabdaḥ sampadyate, sa ca lākṣamikaḥ| tasmāt‌ tataḥ parasya lopo na bhavati| `rāllopaḥ' (6.4.21) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena lopagrahaṇānuvṛttau satyāṃ siddhāyāṃ yat‌ punarlopagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tad‌ yoga vebhāgārtham‌| `śnānna' ityeko yogaḥ, atra ca netyavibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, lopagrahaṇañcānuvartate, tenāyamartho bhavati--śnāduttarasya nakārasya lopo bhavatīti; tataḥ `lopaḥ' iti dvitīyo yogaḥ, tataḥ `śnānna' ityato netyanuvartate--iṣṭe viṣaye nakāralopo yathā syāditi| tena laṅgikampiprabhṛtīnāmupatāpaśarīravikārādiṣu nalopaḥ siddho bhavati|| 24. aniditāṃ hala upadhāyāḥ kṅiti| (6.4.24) id‌ id‌ yeṣāṃ ta iditaḥ, na idito'nidita iti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasya sthāne subvyatyenaikavacanam‌, taccāniditāṃ viśeṣaṇam‌, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyata āha--`halāntānām‌' ityādi| `upadhāyā nakārasya' iti| upadhāyā ityetannakārasya viśeṣaṇam‌| `srastaḥ, dhvalastaḥ' iti| `sransu dhvansu adhaḥ [`avannaṃsane'--dhā.pā] patane (dhā.pa.754,755) niṣṭhā| `srasyate, dhvasyate' iti| bhāve karmaṇi vā lakāra| `sanīsrasyate danīdhvasyate' iti| yaṅante ete| `nīgvañcu' (7.4.84) ityādinābhyāsasya nīgāgamaḥ| `nandyate' iti| `ṭu ṇadi samṛddhau' (dhā.pā.67) [`ṭu nadi'--dhā.pā.] `nānandyate' iti| yaṅantam‌| `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ| `nenīyate' iti| nayateḥ `gaṇo yaṅlukoḥ' (7.4.82) iti guṇo'bhyāsasya| `nahyate' iti| `ṇaha bandhane' (dhā.pā.1166)| `laṅgikampyoḥ' ityādi| laṅgikampyoridittvānnalopo na prāpnoti, atastayorupatāpaśarīravikārayorupasaṃkhyānaṃ kartavyam‌| upasaṃkhyānām‌-pratipādanam‌| uttaratrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanantu kṛtameva| upatāpaḥ-vyādhiḥ| śarīravikāraḥ-śarīrasyānyathātvam‌| sa punarihopatāpādanayo gṛhyate, anyathā `upatāpa' ityevaṃ siddhe śarīravikāragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `vilagitaḥ' iti| `agi vagi lagi' gatyārthāḥ| (dhā.pā.146,147,145)| `upatāpe vilaṅgitaḥ' ityeva prayogo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ laṅgarllopo vidhīyate, na tu rūpasiddhyartham‌; `lage saṅge' (dhā.pā.786) ityasya prakṛtyantarasya tasya siddhatvāt‌| `rañjerṇau' ityādi| akṅidarthaṃ vacanam‌| mṛgaramaṇam‌-mṛgakrīḍā| `rajayatiḥ mṛgān‌' iti| ramamāṇān‌ mṛgān‌ prayuṅkte ityarthaḥ| `rajanarajakarajaḥsūpasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| atra bhūyaḥ pratipādanaṃ kriyate| `ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' (6.4.27) ityatra cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena rajakādiṣu pratipādyeṣu rañjeḥ ṣvunnādipratyaye parato nalopo bhavati| `rajakaḥ' iti| `śilpini ṣvun‌' (3.1.145)| `rajanam‌' iti| lyuṭ| `rajaḥ' iti| `sārvadhātubhyo'sun‌' (da.u.9.49)[`asun‌'--da.u.] ityasun‌| `ghinuṇi ca' ityādi| `rāgī' iti| sampṛcānvādisūtreṇa(3.2.142) ghinuṇ‌, `cajo ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutvam‌| `tyaja raja bhaja' iti nipātanāt‌ siddham‌' iti| yato'yamakṅiti nimitte sampṛcādisūtre (3.2.142) rañjeranunāsikalopaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--ghinupyati nalopo bhavatīti| nanu ca `rañjeśca' (6.4.26) iti lakṣaṇenaiva śapi nalopo'bhinirvṛttaḥ? na tadasti; yathaiva `indhibhavatibhyāñca' (1.2.6) ityāgantukenekāreṇendhernirdeśaḥ, tathehāpyāgantukenākāreṇa, na tu śapā| na hi `indhibhavatibhyāñca' (1.2.6) ityatrekā nirdeśaḥ, anyathā hi `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ syāt‌|| 25. daṃśasañjasvañjāṃ śapi| (6.4.25) `daṃśa daṃśane' (dhā.pa.989), `ṣvanja pariṣvaṅge (dhā.pā.976)| `pariṣvajate' iti| `upasargāt‌ sunoti' (8.3.65) ityādinā ṣatvam‌|| 26. rañjeśca| (6.4.26) atha pṛthagyogakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, na pūrvayoga eva rañjergrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`pṛthagyogakaraṇam‌' ityādi| uttarasūtre rañjerevānuvṛttiryathā syāt‌ daṃśaprabhṛtīnāṃ mā bhūditi|| 27. ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ| (6.4.27) `rajyate'neneti rāgaḥ' iti| `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti ghañ‌| evaṃ `raṅgaḥ' ityatrāpi|| 28. syado jave| (6.4.28) javaḥ-vegaḥ, gativiśeṣaḥ| `vṛddhyabhāvaśca' iti| `ata upadhāyāḥ' iti| nalope kṛte `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.1.116) iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, atastadabhāvo nipātyate| nanu ca `na dhātulopa ārdhadhātuke' (1.1.4) ityanenaiva vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, tat‌ kimarthaṃ vṛddhyabhāvo nipātyate? ityāha--`ikprakaraṇāt‌' ityādi| tatra `iko guṇavṛddhī' (1.1.3) ityata `ik‌' iti parakṛtamanuvartate, teneglakṣaṇayorguṇavṛddhyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| na ceyaminlakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ, kintūpadhālakṣaṇā| na ceyamupadhālakṣaṇā vṛddhiriglākṣaṇā bhavati, nirdiṣṭasthānikatvāt‌| tena nāstyatra tasyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ| `gosyadaḥ' iti| bhāve dhañ‌| gavāṃ syada iti gosyadaḥ, `kṛdyogā ṣaṣṭhī samasyate' (dhā.86) iti samāsaḥ| `tailasyandaḥ' iti| tailasya sravaṇamityarthaḥ| `syandū sravaṇe'[`prasravaṇe' dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.761)|| 29. avodaidhodmaparaśrathahimaśrathāḥ| (6.4.29) `avodaḥ' iti| upasargeṇa saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `na dhātulopaḥ' (1.1.4) ityādinā pratiṣedho na bhavati; aniglakṣaṇatvādguṇasya| `guṇaśca nipātyate' iti| nanu ca `pugantaladhūpadhasya' (7.3.86) ityevaṃ guṇaḥ siddhaḥ| tat‌ kimarthaṃ nipātyate? ityāha--`na dhātulopaḥ' ityādi| `auṇādike manpratyayaḥ' iti| `arttisatusuhusṛdhṛkṣikṣubhāyāvāpadayakṣinaubyo man‌' (da.u.7.26) [arttistusuhusṛdhṛkṣikṣubhāyāpadiyakṣinībhyo man‌--da.u.] ityarttyādibhyo vidhīyamāno bahulavacanādunderapi bhavati| `śranteḥ' iti| `śrantha mocanapratiharṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pa.1510) ityasya|| 30. nāñceḥ pūjāyām‌| (6.4.30) `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityanena prāptasya nalopasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| etasmādeva pratiṣedhānnakāro'yaṃ itacutvo nirdiśyata iti gamyate| atha `nāñceriṭi' ityeva kasmānnoktam‌ evamapi hyucyamāne pūjāyameva prataṣedho labhyeta, tathā hi--pūjāyāmevāñcateriṅ vihitaḥ? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum‌, `añceḥ pūjāyām‌' (7.2.53) ityanena ktvāniṣṭhayornityamiṅa vihitaḥ| yastu ktvāpratyayaḥ `udito vā' (7.2.56) iti pākṣika iḍāgamaḥ, sa pūjāyāmapi bhavati, tatraivamucyamāne yadā ktvāpratyayasya pūjāyāmiṇna syāt‌, tadā pratiṣedho na syāt‌| `gurumaṅktvā' iti| `na' ityetatpratiṣedhavacanamuttarārtham‌| iha `añcerapūjāyām‌' ityucyamāne satīṣṭaṃ siddhyatyeva| `añcitā asya guravaḥ' iti| `matibuddhi' (3.2.188) ityādanā ktaḥ| `ktasya ca vartamāne' (2.3.67) iti ṣaṣṭhī| `yasya vibhāṣetīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| añciteḥ `udito vā' (7.2.56) iti vikapleneṅavidhānāt‌|| 31. ktvi skandisyandoḥ| (6.4.31) `skantvā' iti| `skandira gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pa.979) `pakṣe iḍāgamaḥ' iti| `svarati' (7.2.44) ityādinā| `kittvapratiṣedhānnalopabhāvaḥ' iti| `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityādinā hi kṅiti nalopo vidhīyate| seṭktvāpratyayasya `na ktvā seṭ‌' (1.2.18) iti kittvapratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ, tataśceḍāgamapakṣe kittvābhāvādeva nalopābhāva iti nāsāvimaṃ yogaṃ prayojayati| tena na seṭktvāparatyayasyodāharaṇaṃ pradarśitamityabhiprāyaḥ|| 32. jāntanaśāṃ vibhāṣā| (6.4.32) `naṣṭvā, naṃṣṭvā' iti| naśeḥ vraścādi (8.2.36) sūtreṇa ṣatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| `masjinaśorjhali' (7.1.60) iti mumāgamaḥ| `ja' iti varṇagrahaṇam‌, tatra varṇagrahaṇe sarvatra tadantavidhiṃ prayojayatatyantareṇāpyantagrahaṇena tadantavidhau siddhe, yadihāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyate taddhispaṣṭārtham‌, yattvāha--anupadhāyā api pakṣe lopasya pratiṣedhārthamantagrahaṇam‌, tadyathā--`bhaktvā, bhaṅktvā' iti, tanna; kena punaranupadhābhūtasya nakārasyā lopaḥ prāpnoti, yato'sau pakṣe pratiṣidhyate| upadhānakārasya lopa uktaḥ, na cāyamupadhānakāraḥ| evaṃ tarhi vidhi viṣayādanyatrāpi kvacillopo nakārasya bhavatīti jñāpayati| tenaitat‌ siddhaṃ bhavita--`magnaḥ, magnadān‌' iti| tataścaitadrathaṃ `masjerantyātpūrvaṃ numamicchantyanuṣaṅgalopārtham‌' ityetanna vaktavyaṃ bhavati| tatra yadīdaṃ nocyeta, tadā yasmin‌ pakṣe ktvāpratyayena lopo na bhavati, tasmin‌ pakṣe `skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti salopo'pi na syāt‌; asaṃyogāditvāt‌| tasmādvaktavyamevedam‌--`masjerantyātpūrvaṃ numamicchanti' iti| tataścānupadhābhūtasya nakārasya lopabhāvino'sambhavādanupadhābhūtasya nakārasya lopapratiṣedho yathā syādevamarthamantagrahaṇaṃ na yujyate|| 33. bhañjeśca ciṇi| (6.4.33) cakāraḥ `vibhāṣā' (6.4.32) ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `abhāji' iti| pūrvameva vyutpāditam‌| `aprāpto'yaṃ nakāralopaḥ' iti| kṅiti nalopavidhānāt‌, ciṇaścākṅitvāt‌| ataḥ pratiṣedhyābhābānnati nānuvartate| tena vidhirevāyamityabhiprāyaḥ|| 34. śāsa idaṅhaloḥ| (6.4.34) `anvaśiṣat‌' iti| `sarttiśāstyartibhyaśca' (3.1.56) iti cleraṅādeśaḥ `śiṣvaḥ, śiṣmaḥ' iti| vasmasorudāharaṇe, adāditvācchapo luk‌| `śāsati' iti| `jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ‌' (6.1.6) ityabhyastasaṃjñā, `adabhyastāt‌' (7.1.4) iti jheradādeśaḥ| `śaśāsatuḥ, śaśāsuḥ' iti| liṭyatusyusi rūpe| `kvau ca śāsaḥ' iti| kvau parataḥ śāserittvaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--yadyapi kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena nityatvādatra pūrvamittvāt‌ kviblopasya vidhānam, tathāpi lupte'pi tasmin‌ pratyayalakṣaṇenātrettvaṃ bhaviṣyati| `varṇāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti' (vyā.pa.96) ityetattu prāyikam‌| tathā hi--varṇaśraye'pi kvacidbhavati| tadyathā--`atṛṇeṭ‌' iti| atra `tṛ ha im‌' (7.3.92) itīmāgamaḥ| atha vā varṇāśrayamevedamittvaṃ na bhavati| katham‌? aṅgagrahaṇenātra pratyayaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ| sa halgrahaṇena viśiṣyate| ata eva vṛttāvuktam‌--`halādau kṅiti' iti| tena yadyapi kvib‌ varṇātmakaḥ pratyayaḥ, tathāpi nāsau varṇarūpatvenāśrīyate, kiṃ tarhi? pratyayarūpatvena| `āryaśīḥ' iti| sakārasya rutve kṛte `rvorupadhāyā dīrghaḥ' (8.2.76) iti dīrghaḥ| atha `āśāste, āśāsyamānaḥ' ityatra kathamittvaṃ na bhavati? ityāha--`yasmācchāseḥ' ityādi dvāvimau śāsī--ekaḥ parasmaipadī, aparastvātmanepadī, tatra yasmāt‌ śāseraṅ vihitaṃ tasyevaṃ grahaṇam‌| sa ca `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075) ityasya `sattiśāstyarttibhyaśca' (3.1.56) iti vidhīyate, tatra `parasmaipadeṣu' (3.1.55) ityanuvartate, asyaiva parasmaipade sambhavāt‌| kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyenopādāne parasmaipadina eva vijñāyate? aṅaḥ saṃsargāt‌| saṃsarge hi sati viśeṣaparicchedo bhavati, tathā hi--`sakiśorā dhenurānīyatām‌' ityukte kiśoreṇa saṃsargād‌ vaḍavāyāmeva sampratyayo bhavati| iha śāserittvaṃ pratyaṅa nimittatvenopāttaḥ, atastena saṃsargād‌ viśiṣṭha eva parasmaipadī śāsiḥ pratīyate| nanu cāṅevātra kevalo nimittatvena nopāttaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? halapi, sa cātmanepadino'pi sambhavati, tat‌ kuto'ṅsaṃsargād‌ viśiṣṭasya śāseḥ pratīti? naitadasti; sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇasambandhisannipāte yasyāsādhāraṇaḥ sannihitaḥ sambandhī tatraiva pratyayo jāyate| tathā hi `vṛddhānāṃ kiśoraṇāñca madhye dhenavo'nubadhyantām‌' ityukte baḍavā eva pratīyante| tasmādaṅahalorupadāne'pi yasmādaṅa vihitastasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌| yadi tarhi yato'ṅa vihitastasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌, evaṃ sati yathāśāste, āśāsyamāna ityatra na bhavati, tathā kvippratyaye'pi na syāt‌? ityata āha--`kvippratyaye ti' ityādi| `kṣiyāsīḥ' ityādi| atha vā naiva tasyā hyapi kviṣpratyaya ityevaṃ vaktavyamiti| viklapartho vāśabdaḥ| atha taśabdaḥ kimarthaḥ, āntaratamyāddīrgho mā bhūditi cet‌? naitadasti; `bhāvyamāno'ṇ‌ savarṇānna gṛhṇāti' (vyā.pa.35) iti na bhaviṣyati? evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthaḥ| athāsandehārthaḥ kasmānna bhavati? `śāsa yaṅaṅaloḥ' ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimayamikāraḥ kṛtayaṇādeśo nirdiṣṭaḥ? āhosvidīkāraḥ? atha vā yakāra iti? nāsti sandehaḥ, yadayam‌ `tadaśiṣyaṃ saṃjñāpramāṇatvāt‌' (1.2.53) iti nirdeśaṃ karoti, tato niścīyate--ikāroyam‌, na hīkāraḥ, nāpi yakāra iti|| 35. śā hau| (6.4.35) yadyatra `upadhāyāḥ' (6.4.24) iti varttate, tato yathā pūrvasūtre `śāsaḥ' (6.4.34) ityavayavabhūtā ṣaṣṭhī, tathehāpi syāt‌ evañcopadhāyā evāyamādeśaḥ, prasajyeta, sarvādeśaśceṣyata iti manasi kṛtvāha--`upadhāyā iti nivṛttam‌' iti| taddhi upadhāgarahaṇaṃ kṅidgrahaṇena sambaddham‌, iha ca kṅidgrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam‌| tasmāt‌ `upadhāyāḥ' (6.4.24) ityasyāpi nivṛttirbhavati| `kṅiti' ityetadapi nivṛttam‌' iti| `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādau sūtre punaḥ kṅidgrahaṇāt‌| `tena' ityādinā kṅidgrahaṇe nivṛtte yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate taddarśayati--yadyatra `kṅiti' (6.4.24) ityetadanuvarttetatato `vā cchandasi' (3.4.88) iti yasaminpakṣe herapittvaṃ na bhavati tasmin‌ pakṣe `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) iti vacanāt‌ ṅittvaṃ nāstīti śābhāvo na syāt‌| kṅidgrahaṇe tu nivṛtte'pittvapakṣe'pi bhavatyeva| syādetat‌--vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācchāsa uttarasya heḥ pittvaṃ na bhaviṣyati, tato nārthaḥ kṅidgrahaṇena nivarttitena? ityata āha--`śādhītyetat‌' ityādi| yadi śāsa uttarasya heḥ pakṣe pittvaṃ na syāt‌, tadā śādhītyetat‌ satiśiṣṭatvena pratyayasvareṇāntodāttameva syāt‌| ādyudāttamapi cchandasīṣyate| tacca heḥ pittve sati dhātusvareṇa sampadyate, nānyathā| tasmādavaśyaṃ cchandasi yakṣe pittvaṃ vidheyam‌| atha `ā hau' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam‌, akore'pi hi `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti sakārasya vihite savarṇadīrghatvena śādhītyetat‌ siddhaṃ bhavati? na siddhyati; pūrvasūtreṇopadhāyā ittvaṃ syāt‌| na cāyaṃ tasya bādhako yujyate; asati ca sambhave bādhanaṃ bhavati, asti ca sambhavo yadubhayaṃ syāt‌, atrāsti sambhavaḥ| tasmādakāre'ntyasaya vihita upadhāyā ittvaṃ syādeva|| 36. interjaḥ| `hanteḥ' iti| spipā nirdeśo yaṅalugnivṛttyarthaḥ--`jaṅghahi'|| 37. anudāttopadeśavanatitanotyādīnāmanunāsikalopo jhali kṅiti| (6.4.37) `anunāsika' iti ṣaṣṭhyā bahuvacanasya lukaṃ kṛtvā'vibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ| ata evāha--`anunāsikāntānām‌' iti| `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) iti dīrghatve prāpte lopo'yaṃ vidhīyate| atra lope kṛte dīrghatvaṃ na prāpnoti; vihitanimittatvāt‌| `yami rami gami nami hani manyatayaḥ' iti--`yama uparame' (dhā.pā.984) `ramu krīḍāyām‌' (dhā.pā.853) `ganlṛ sṛplṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.982,983) `ṇama pahvatve' (dhā.pā.981) [prahvatve śabde ca--dhā.pā] `hana hiṃsāgatyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1012) `mana jñāne' (dhā.pā.1176)| `vatiḥ' iti| `vana ṣaṇa sambhaktau' (dhā.pā.463,464)| `titutratatha' (7.2.9) ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `ktini' ityanena ktinyeva vanaterudāharaṇaṃ sambhavati, nānyatreti darśayati| kiṃ kāramam‌? ityāha--`ktici tu' ityādi| ktici tu `na ktici dīrghaśca' (6.4.39) iti pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyati| ye tvanye jhalādayaḥ pratyayāsteṣvapīṭā bhavitavyam‌, tato jhalāditvābhāvādvanateranunāsikalopaṃ prati te nimittabhāvaṃ nopayāntīti pāriśeṣyāt‌ ktinyeva vanateranunāsikalopena bhavitavyam‌| `sanoterāttvaṃ vakṣyati' iti| tena tasyānunāsikalopodāharaṇaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| āttvaṃ punaḥ `janasanakhanām‌' (6.4.42) ityādinā vakṣyati| `kṣataḥ' iti| `kṣaṇu hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1465)| `ṛtaḥ' iti--`ṛṇu gatau' (dhā.pā.1467)| `tṛtaḥ' iti| `tṛṇu dāne' [`adane' dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1468)| `ghṛtaḥ' iti| `ghṛṇu dīptau' (dhā.pā.1469) `vataḥ' iti| `vanu yācane' (dhā.pā.1470) `mataḥ' iti| `manu avabodhane' (dhā.pā.1471) `atata, atathā' iti| tanoterluṅa| ātmanepadaprathamamadhyamaikapuruṣavacane| `tanādibhyastathāsoḥ' (2.4.79) iti sico luk‌| `śāntaḥ, tāntaḥ, dāntaḥ' ti| śamitamidamīnāṃ rūpāṇi| ete nānudāttopadeśāḥ| `iha ca' ityādi| gamiramibhyāṃ ktini kṛte tayornitsvareṇādyudāttatve'nudāttatvābhāvādasatyupadeśagrahaṇe lopo na syāt‌, asmiṃstu sati bhavati| kiñca--asatyupadeśagrahaṇe śāntaḥ, dānta ityatrāpi syāt‌| bhavati hi śamiḥ satiśiṣṭapratyayasvare kṛte `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam‌' (6.1.158) iti śeṣasyānudāttatve'nudāttaḥ| upadeśagrahaṇāttu na bhavati, na hyamupadeśe'nudāttaḥ|| 38. vā lyapi| (6.4.38) ajhalādyartha ārambhaḥ| `prayatya' iti| prādasamāse kṛte `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap‌ (7.1.37) `hrasvasaya piti kṛti tuk‌' (6.1.71)|| 39. na ktici dīrghaśca| (6.4.39) `yantiḥ' ityādi| `ktickatau ca saṃjñāyām‌' (3.3.174) iti ktic‌| atra cānudāttopadeśādiprahaṇamanuvartate, tena `kāntiḥ śāntiḥ' ityatra dhīrghapratiṣedho na bhavati| anunāsakalopasya tvatra prāptireva nāsti; udāttopadeśatvāt‌| `anunāsikalope pratiṣiddhe' ityādinā dīrghagrahaṇasya prayojanamācaṣṭhe| nanu ca prakaraṇāpekṣayā yadasminaprakaraṇe vihitaṃ tanna bhavatīti vijñāyamāne'ntareṇāpi dīrghagrahaṇaṃ dīrghasyāpi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kiṃ dīrghagrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhyatajjñāpayati--astīyaṃ paribhāṣā `anantarasaya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti|| 40. gamaḥ kvau| (6.4.40) ayamapyajhalādyartha ārambhaḥ| `adhvagato harayaḥ' iti| adhvānaṃ gacchantīti kvip‌, tadantajjas‌| `gamādīnām‌' ityādi| gamādīnāmanunāsikalopaḥ kvau bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyemityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--pūrvasūtrāccakāro'nuvartate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena gamādīnāṃ bhaviṣyati, na tu gamereva kevalasyeti| `saṃyat‌' iti| saṃpūrvād‌ yameḥ kvip‌| `paritat‌' iti| paripūrvāt‌ tanoteḥ, `nahivṛti' (6.3.116) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| `ū ca' ityādi| cakārādanunāsikalopaḥ| kvacid‌ `ūṅa ca' iti paṭhyate, tatra ṅakārasya prayojanaṃ cintyam‌| alo'ntyaparibhāṣayaivātra bhaviṣyati| `agregūḥ' iti| gameḥ, bhrameścānunāsikalope kṛte'kārasyokāraḥ|| 41. viṅvanoranunāsikasyāt‌| (6.4.41) `abjāḥ' iti| apsu jāyata ityupapadasamāsaḥ, pakārasya jaśtvam‌--bakāraḥ| `goṣā' iti| `ṣaṇu dāne' (dhā.pā.1464) `vijavā' iti| `jana janane' (dhā.pā.1105), `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149) iti vā| `agregāva' [`agrejāvā' iti kāśikā pāṭhaḥ] iti| `tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam‌' (6.3.14) iti saptamyā aluk‌| athānunāsikagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatānudāttopadeśetyādeḥ (6.4.37) sūtrādanunāsikagarahaṇamanuvartata eva? ityāha--`anunāsakasyeti vartamāne'--ityādi| taddhi prakṛtamanunāsikagrahaṇamanudāttopadeśagrahaṇena sambaddham‌, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt‌| tasmādadamanyadanunāsikagrahaṇaṃ kriyate--anunāsikamātrasya yathā syāt‌| atheha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham‌? hrasva evocyeta, hrasve'pi kṛte satyakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena siddhyatyeva; `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpattvaṃ prāpnoti, ato na siddhayatītyetannāśaṅkanīyam‌, akāravidhānasāmarthyāt‌; yadi hi `ato guṇe' pararūpatvaṃ syāt‌, tadā prakṛtaṃ lopagrahaṇameva vidadhyāt‌ tato hrasva eva kartarvyaḥ| naitadasti; hratve hi sati `ghuṇa dhūrṇane' (dhā.pā.437) [`bhramaṇe'--dhā.pā.] ityasmādvanipi vihite `dhvāvā' iti na siddhyet‌? tato dīrghasyaiva vidhānaṃ yuktam‌|| 42. janasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ| (6.4.42) `jhali kṅiti cānuvartate' iti| yathākramaṃ sano jhalaśca viśeṣaṇam‌ sūtropāttena tu jhalgrahaṇena na śakyate san‌ viśeṣayitum‌, viśeṣaṇaṃ hyaprādhānaṃ bhavati, viśeṣyantu pradhānam‌| `sañjhaloḥ' iti cārya dvandvaḥ| tatra sarveṣāṃ dvandvapadānāṃ prādhānyādanyo'nyaṃ pradhānaguṇabhāvo nopapadyate| sangrahaṇañcākṅidartham‌| `tadiha' ityādi| yasmāt‌ sanoteḥ pakṣa iḍāgamastasmāt‌ tata eva paro jhalādiḥ san‌ sambhavatīti tadarthameva sangrahaṇam‌, na tu janakhanārtham‌| na hi tābhyāṃ paro jhalādiḥ san‌ sambhavati, tayornityaṃ seṭtvāt‌| yadyevaṃ, sanoteḥ sani kṛtārthatvādāttvaṃ na syāt‌, anyatra niṣṭhādau jhalādau kṅitipratyaye `anudāttopadeśaḥ' (6.4.37) ityādinā nalopaḥ syāt‌? ityata āha--`anyatra' ityādi| sanotestanotyādiṣu pāṭhasyāvakāśo'nyat‌ tanādikaṃ kāryam‌--`tanādibhyastathāsoḥ' (2.4.79) ityādi, āttvavidhau ca sangrahaṇasyāvakāśaḥ--san‌, siṣāsatīti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--sātaḥ, sātavāniti| atrānunāsikalopaṃ bādhitvā''ttvaṃ bhavati vipratiṣedhena| nanu cobhayaḥ siddhayorvipratiṣedho bhavati, iha ca `asiddhavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) ityubhayamapyasiddham‌, tat‌ kuto vipratiṣedhaḥ? ityata āha--`ghumāsthāgā' ityādi| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam‌? halgrahaṇasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--halādāvīttvaṃ yathā syāt‌, iha mā bhūt‌--`āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) godāḥ, kambalada iti yadi cātra vipratiṣedhaḥ? ityata āha--`ghumāsthāgā' ityādi| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam‌? halgrahaṇasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--halādāvīttvaṃ yathā syāt‌, iha mā bhūt‌--`āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) godaḥ, kambalada iti| yadi cātra vipratiṣedho na syād‌ halgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| astvatrettvam‌, tasyāsiddhatvāllopo bhaviṣyata| paśyati tvācāryaḥ--bhavatīha prakaraṇe vipratiṣedha iti; yato halgrahaṇaṃ karoti| nanu cāsati halgrahaṇe'jādāvapīttvaṃ syāt‌, tataścepaṅaḥ prasajyetetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpamāpadyeta| tasmādaniṣṭanivṛttyarthatvāddhalgrahaṇasya na yujyate jñāpakatvam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; asiddhatvādevettvasyeyaṅādeśo na bhaviṣyati| vyavasthārthaṃ tarhi halgrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, asati hi tasminnīttvasyāsiddhatvā dāllopaḥ, ākāralopasyāsiddhatvādīttvamīti cakravadvyavasthā syāt‌? etadapyaprayojanam‌, yadi vyavasthārthaṃ halgrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, naivāyaṃ halgrahaham̐ kurvīta| aviśeṣeṇekāramuktvā tasyājādau lopamapavādaṃ vidadhyāt‌| tat‌ kathamidamastu `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) iti? tataḥ `dhumāsthāgāpājahātisām‌' (6.4.66) ākāralopo bhavatīṭayajādau ca kṅiti| kimarthamidam‌? pratyayamātre dhvādīnāṃ yadīttvaṃ vakṣyate, tasyāyamiṭyajādau ca kṅityapadādaḥ, tataḥ `īt‌' (6.4.68) itīttvaṃ bhavati ghādīnāmanaci kṅiti, tataḥ `erliṅi' (6.4.37) `dānyasya saṃyogādeḥ' (6.4.68) `na lyapi' (6.4.69), `mayateridanyatarasyām‌' (6.4.70); tato yatīttvaṃ bhavati--so'yameva lagīyasā nyāsena siddhe yaddhalgrahaṇaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayatyācāryaḥ--`bhavatīha vipratiṣedhaḥ' iti|| 43. ye vibhāṣā| (6.4.43) asajjhalādyartha ārambhaḥ| `jāyate, janyate' iti| bhāve lakāraḥ| `jājāyate' iti| yaṅ‌, `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityabhyāsasya dīrghatvam‌| `jañjanyate' iti| `nugato'nunāsikāntasya' (7.4.85) nugāgamaḥ `sāyate, sanyate' iti| bhāve karmaṇi vā lakāraḥ| janeḥ śyanyapi vibhāṣā''ttvena bhavitavyamiti kasyacid‌ bhrānti syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākartumāha--`janeḥ śyani' ityādi| janerdivāditvāt‌ śyani vihite satyumayaṃ prāpnoti, anena vibhāṣā''ttvam‌, `jñājanorjā' (7.3.79) iti jābhāvaśca, tatra jādeśasyānavakāśatvāt‌ sa eva nityaṃ bhavati| tena śyani `jāyate' ityevaṃ nityaṃ bhavati, na tu kadācit‌ `janyate' iti|| 44. tanoteryaki| (6.4.44) 45. sanaḥ ktici lopaścāsyānyatarasyām‌| (6.4.45) asyagrahaṇamanantarasya ktico lopo mā bhūta; vyavahitasyāpi nalopo yathā syādityevamartham‌| atha kriyamāṇe'pyasyagrahaṇe kasmādeva ktico lopo na bhavati? asyagrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌| athānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `vibhāṣā' (6.4.46) ityanuvartate? ityāha--`anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| kathaṃ punarvibhāṣāgrahaṇasya nivṛttirāśaṅkyate, yato vispaṣṭārthamanyatarasyāṃgraham̐ kṛtam? ityāha--`yakārasambhandhaṃ hi' [ye sambabaddhaṃ hi--kāśikā] ityādi| tadvibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ yakārādipratyayasya sambandhena| iha ca `ye' ityetasmin‌ nivṛtte ktico nimittāntarasyopādānātadatastānnivṛttau vibhāṣāgrahaṇamapi nivṛttamiti kasyacidāśaṅkā syāt‌, ato vispaṣṭārthamanyatasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 46. ārdhadhātuke| (6.4.46) `cikīrṣitā' iti| sannantāt‌ tuc‌| `bhavati, bhavataḥ' iti| `ārdhadhātuke' ityadhikārāt‌ sārvadhātuke'tra śapo lopo na bhavati| yadyatra śapo lopo mā bhūdityevamartha ārdhadhātukādhikāraḥ kriyate, tarhi na kartavyaḥ, jñāpakādeva śapo lopo na bhaviṣyati, ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--`nānena śapo lopo bhavati' iti yadayam‌ `adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapaḥ' (2.4.72) iti śapo lukaṃ śasti? ityata āha--`adiprabhṛtibhyaḥ' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| asati hi prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati| asti cādiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapo lugvacanasya prayojanam‌| kiṃ tat‌? `vittaḥ' ityatra guṇo mā bhūt‌| yadi `vittaḥ' ityatra lopaḥ syāt‌, pratyayalakṣaṇena `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ syāt‌| `mṛṣṭaḥ' ityatra `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114) luki tu sati na bhavati, `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt‌| tasmādadiprabhṛtibhyaḥ śapo lugvacanaṃ pratyayalakṣamapratiṣedhārthaṃ syāditi na jñāpakaṃ śapo lopābhāvasya| `bebhiditā' iti| yaṅo lopaḥ| `bebhidyate' ityatra śapi sārvadhātuke na bhavati| `kāraṇā' iti| `ṇyāsaśrantho yuc‌' (3.3.107)| `kārayati' iti śapi sārvadhātuke na bhavati| `papatuḥ, papuḥ'| `vavatuḥ' vavuḥ' iti| atususau| pātervāteśca `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityakāralopaḥ| `dīyate dhīyate' iti| ārdhadhātuke yakīttvam‌| `adātām‌ adhātām‌' iti| luṅa, `tasthastha' (3.4.101) iti tasastām‌; `gātisthā' (2.4.77) ityādinā sico luk‌| `snāyāt‌, sneyāt‌' iti| snāterāśiṣi liṅa, tasya `liṅāśiṣi' (3.4.116) ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñā, yāsuṭ‌, `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' (8.2.29) ityādinā sakāralopaḥ| `āśīrliṅo'kyatra na bhavati' iti| āśīrliṅo'nyad‌ viṣyādiliṅaḥ, tatra na bhavati; tasya sārvadhātukasaṃjñakatvāt‌| tena tatra nityaṃ `snāyāt‌' ityevaṃ bhavati| atra `liṅaḥ salopo'nantyasya' (7.2.79) iti sakāralopaḥ| `kāriṣīṣṭa' iti| āśiṣi liṅaḥ, sīyuṭ‌, `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityātmanepadam‌, `suṭ‌ tithoḥ' (3.4.107) iti suṭ‌ ciṇvadbhāvādvṛddhiḥ| `kriyeta' iti| viṣyādiliṅaḥ| pūrvavadātmanepadam‌, sārvadhātuke yak‌, sīyuḍīkareṇa saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yakāralopaḥ, `riṅaśayagliṅakṣu' (7.4.28) iti riṅādeśaḥ| atra ciṇvadbhādena yo doṣaḥ syāt‌ taṃ `yagantasya' ityādinā darśayati| yadyatra ciṇvadbhāvāt‌ vṛddhiḥ syāt‌, tataśca `āto yuk‌ ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuk‌ prasajyeta| `ato lopo yalopaśca' ityādi| ārdhadhātukādhikāraprayojanasaṃgrahaślokaḥ| gatārthaḥ| nanvatra `bhrasjo ropadhayo ramanyatarasyām‌' (6.4.47) iti ram‌, `dīṅo yuḍaci kṅiti' (6.4.63) iti yuḍārdhadhātukādhikāra eva vidhāsyate, tat‌ kasmāt‌ tau tatra prayojanatvena nopāttau? evaṃ manyate--bhrasjo rambhāva ārdhadhātukādhikāraṃ na prayojayati, sa, tu tudādau paṭhyate, tataḥ sārvadhātuke parataḥ śena bhavitavyam‌| śe ca sati pūrvavipratiṣedhād‌ grahijayādi (6.1.16) sūtreṇa samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam‌| yuḍapi naiva prayojayati, dīṅo hi divāditvāt‌ sārvadhātuke śyanā bhavitavyam‌| tato'jāditvābhāvādeva yuḍāgamasyābhāva eva| `ārdhadhātuke' iti yadārdhadhātukasāmānyaṃ vivakṣyate, tadā sāmānye paurvāparyāsambhavāt‌ viṣayasaptamīyam‌| yadārdhadhātukavyaktistadā parasaptamī| pratipāditañcāsmabhiḥ `na dhātulopaḥ' (1.1.4) ityatra jñāpakadvāreṇa parasaptamītvaṃ viṣayasaptamītvañcāsyeti|| 47. bhrasjo ropadhayo ramanyatarasyām‌| (6.4.47) ramayaṃ yadi rephopadhayoḥ sthāne syāt‌ mittvamanarthakaṃ syāt‌ athāyaṃ ramāgamo'co'nyāt‌ paro bhavati rephopadhayoḥ avaṇamāpadyeta? ityetaccodyamāśaṅkyāha--`ropadhayoḥ' ityādi| mittvādramanenāvaśyamaco'ntyāt‌ pareṇa bhavitavyam‌, anyathā tadanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tatra yadi rephopadhayoḥ śravaṇaṃ syāt‌ `ropadhayoḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśa eva tayornivṛttimācaṣṭe| tasyā hyetadeva prayojanam‌--ṣaṣṭhyā nirdiruyamānasya yo dharmo nivṛttiḥ, sā yathā syāt‌| na hyanyat‌ ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasya prayojanamasti| tasmānmittvādaco'ntyāparo bhavati rama| ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasāmarthyād‌ rephopadhe sthānidharmanivṛttiṃ pratipadyete| `bhraṣṭā' iti| `bhrasja pāke' (dhā.pā.1284) vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌| `bhrajjanam‌' iti| sakārasya jaśtvam‌--dakāraḥ, tasyāpi ścutvam‌--jakāraḥ| atheha kasmānna bhavati--bhṛṣṭaḥ, bhṛṣṭavān‌? ityāha--`bhṛṣṭaḥ, bhṛṣṭavān‌' ityādi| ramo'vakāśaḥ--bharṣṭā, bhraṣṭāḥ sumprasāraṇasyāvakāśaḥ--`bhṛjjati' iti, ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--bhṛṣṭā, bhṛṣṭavāniti, grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇameva bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena| pūrvavipratiṣedhaśceṣṭavācitvāt‌ paraśabdasya labhyate| `barībhṛjyate' iti| yaṅ| `rīgṛdupadhasya' (7.4.90) iti rogāgamaḥ| `atra upadeśa' (6.4.45) ityato hi yadantarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtaṃ, tat‌ sanādisambaddham‌, iha ca sanādernivṛttiḥ| atastannivṛttau tasyāpi nivṛttirāśaṅkyeta| anantarayogasya cānyārthatvāt‌, tatrānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya prayojanābhāvāt‌| atha bhrasjo bharjetyevaṃ kasmānnoktatam‌? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum‌| evaṃ hyucyamāne `prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅalugantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.77) iti yaṅlugantādārthadhātuka utpanne satyabhyāsasya bhrasjo bharjjādeśaḥ syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; upadeśagrahaṇena bhrajjiṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ--`upadeśa yo bhrajjiḥ' iti| śtipā nirdeśo'tra vā kariṣyate--bhṛjjaterbhajaṃ iti; tena yaṅaḥlugantasya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati| etamapi `bhujjayate' ityatra prāpnoti, bhavati hyatropadeśe bhrasjiriti? naitadasti; atra hi pūrvavipratiṣedhāt‌ samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam‌, yathā--bhṛṣṭa ityatra| evaṃ tarhi vaicitryārtha tathā noktam‌|| 48. ato lopaḥ| (6.4.48) `dhinutaḥ, kṛṇutaḥ' iti| `hivi divi dhivi prāṇanārthāḥ' (dhā.pā.591,592,593), `kṛvi hiṃsākaraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.598) iditvānnum‌, laṭ‌, tas‌, `dhinvikṛṇvyora ca' (3.1.80) ityupratyayaḥ, akāraścāntādeśaḥ, tasyānena lopaḥ| atha tapakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā dhātetyatra mā bhūt‌? nanu ca `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) iti niyamārtha bhaviṣyati--ākārasyeṭyevājādau kṅiti lopo bhavati? naitadsita; viparītaniyamo'pi sambhāvyeta--āta eveṭi kṅiti nānyasyeti| tathā ca cikīrṣitetyatra na syāt‌| tasmād‌ viparītaniyamasambhāvanānivṛttyartha taparakaraṇam‌| vispaṣṭārthaṃ vā| `vṛddhidīrdhābhyām‌' ityādi| `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) ityasyāvakāśa--kārayati, hārayati, ato lopasyāvakāśaḥ--cikīrṣitā, jihīrṣiteti; ihomayaṃ prāpnoti--cikīrṣakaḥ, jihīrṣaka iti, ato lopa eva bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena| `akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ' (7.4.25) ityasyāvakāśaḥ--cīyate, lūyata iti, ato lopasyāvakāśaḥ sa eva; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--cikīrṣyate, jihīrṣyata iti, lopa eva bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena|| 49. yasya halaḥ| (6.4.49) `bebhiditā' iti| yaṅntādārdhadhātukaṃ tṛc‌, tasmin‌ parato yaśabdasya lopaḥ| `yasya' itīdaṃ varṇanirdeśo vā syāt‌ yakārākāragrahaṇaṃ vā? tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta tadorṣyitā, mavyitetyatrāpi syāditi dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāśrītyāha--`yasyeti saṅghātagrahaṇam‌' iti| kuta etat‌? nirdeśāt‌| yadi varṇagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tadā `yo halaḥ' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| yadi tarhi saṅghātagrahaṇam‌? evaṃ tarhi `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityantyasya syādityata āha--`tatrālo'ntyasya' ityādi| kasmānna pravartate? ityāha--`ato lopaḥ' ityādi| pūrveṇāpyalo'ntyasya lopaḥ siddhaḥ, tatrārambhasāmarthyāt‌ sarvasya bhavati| `hala iti vā' ityādinā parīhārāntaramāha| `halaḥ' iti pañcamīnirdeśaḥ, tatra `hala uttaro yo yaśabdastasya lopaḥ' ityucyamāne `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti vacanād‌ yakārasyaivanena lopo bhavati| akārasya tu `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityanena| `īrṣyitā, mavyita'[`bhavyitā' iti nyāsamadritapāṭhaḥ] iti| `sūrkṣyaṃ ikṣyaṃ īrṣya īrṣyārthāḥ' (dhā.pā.509,510,511), `mavya bandhane' (dhā.pā.508)| atra saṅghātātmako yaśabdo na bhavatīti na pravartate lopaḥ| `loluyitā' iti| yaṅaḥ, `guṇo yaṅalukoḥ' (7.4.82) iti gaṇaḥ|| 50. kyasya vibhāṣā| (6.4.50) `kya' iti kyackyaṅorutsṛṣṭānubandhayoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam‌; viśeṣānupādānāt‌| `samidhamivātmānamācarati' iti| veti vāśabdaḥ samuccaye varttamānaḥ samidivācaratītyamumarthaṃ grāhayati| `yathāyogam‌' iti| yadātmanaḥ samidhamicchatītyartho vivakṣyate, tadā `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8) iti kyac‌ karttavyaḥ, yadā samidhamivātmānāmācaratīti tadā `upamānādācāre' (3.1.10) iti kyajeva, yadā samidivācaratīti tadā `kartuḥ kyaṅ‌ salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti kyaṅ--ityeṣa yathāyogaśabdārthaḥ|| 51. ṇeraniṭi| (6.4.51) `ṇeḥ' iti| ṇiṅaṇicorviśeṣakarāvanubandhāvubandhāvutsṝjya yat‌ samānyaṃ ṇimātraṃ tasya grahaṇam‌| iyaṅādibhiḥ sarvasya viṣayasyāvaṣṭabdhatvādanavakāśī'yaṃ ṇilopasteṣāmapavādo'yaṃ vijñāyata ityata āha--`iyaṅyaṇ‌' ityādi| `atatakṣat‌, ararakṣat‌' iti| takṣirakṣibhyāṃ hetumaṇṇic‌, tadantāluṅ‌ `ṇiśridusrubhyaḥ (3.1.48) ityādinā cleścaṅ‌, ṅittvād‌ guṇasya prasaṅga eva nāstītīyaṅādeśaḥ syāt‌| atastasyāpavādo ṇilopaḥ| `āṭiṭat‌, āśiśat‌'| aṭyaśibhyāṃ pūrvaṃ ṇijādiṣu kṛteṣu `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti ṭiśabdaśiśabdau dvirucyete| atra `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) ityādinā prāptasya yaṇādeśasyāyamapavādaḥ| `kāraṇā, hāraṇā' iti| atra `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti prāptasya guṇasya| `kārakaḥ, hārakaḥ' iti| atra `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddheḥ| `kāryate, hāryate' iti| atra `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti prāptasya dīrghasya| `jñīpsati' iti| `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti prāptasya dīrghasyaiva| jānāterṇici `arttihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk‌, `māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā' (dhā.pā.811) iti ghaṭādipāṭhāt‌ `ghaṭādayo mitaḥ' (ga.sū.dhā.pā.817) iti mitsaṃjñā, `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvatvam‌, `atra lopo'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityabhyāsalopaḥ| `kārayitā, hārayitā' iti| `aniṭi' iti vacanādiha na bhavati| `aniṭi' iti śakyamakartum‌| katham‌? `niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' (6.4.52) iti niyamārthaṃ bhaviṣyati--niṣṭhāyāmeva seṭi, nānyatreti? ayuktametat‌, viparītaniyamo'pyāśaṅkyeta--`seṭyeva niṣṭhāyām‌' iti| tathā ca sati `kārayitā' ityatra syādeva ṇilopaḥ| tasmādviparītaniyamāśaṅkānirāsārthaṃ `aniṭi' ityuktam‌|| 52. niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi| (6.4.52) `gaṇitam‌, lakṣitam‌' iti| `gaṇa saṃkhyāne' (dhā.pā.1853) `lakṣa darśanāṅkanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1538)| `saṃjñapitaḥ paśuḥ' iti| nanu cātra yadi `seṭi' iti vacanādanena na bhavitavyam‌, tadā pūrvasūtreṇa kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`seṅgrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌' ityādi| yadi hyaniṭi pūrveṇa ṇilopaḥ syāt‌ seṅgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, `niṣṭhāyām‌' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌, ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi seṅartho bhaviṣyati| tasmāt‌ seṅgrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌ pūrveṇāpi `saṃjñāpitaḥ paśuḥ' ityatra ṇilopo na bhavati| kathaṃ punaratra seṅ‌ niṣṭhā na bhavati? ityāha--`sanīvantardha' ityādi| `atha' ityādi| atha `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) ityatra `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt‌' (7.2.10) ityatra ekājgrahaṇamanuvartate, tato'nekāctvājjñapeḥ pratiṣedhābhāvād‌ bhavitavyamiḍāgamena niṣṭhāyām‌| tasmāt‌ seṅgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; vyāvarttyābhāvāt‌| nanu ca `jñaptaḥ' ityatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ seṅgrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; kriyamāṇe'pi seṅgrahaṇe `vā dāntaśāntapūrṇadastaspaṣṭacchannajñaptāḥ' (7.2.27) iti nipātānādatra bhavitavyameva ṇilopena| yadi tarhyanarthakaṃ seṅgrahaṇam‌, tat‌ kimarthaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`tat‌ kriyate' ityādi| pūrvamiḍāgame kṛte seṭi niṣṭhāyāṃ jātāyāṃ paścāṇṇilopo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ seṅgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌| kaḥ punarakṛta iṭi ṇilope sati doṣaḥ syāt‌, yannivṛttyarthaṃ pūrvamiḍāgama iṣyate? ityāha--`akṛte hi' ityādi| asati seṅgrahaṇe kārita iti sthite ṇilopaḥ prāpnoti, iṭ‌ c‌, tatra kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena ṇilopenaiva bhavitavyam‌; ṇilope ca satyekadeśavikṛtasayānanyatvāt‌ sa evāyaṃ karotiriti `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt‌' (7.2.10) itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyeta, tataśca `kāritam‌' ityetanna siddhyet‌| tasmāt‌ seṅgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 53. janitā mantre| (6.4.53) `iṅādau ṇilopo nipātyate' iti| `janitā' iti tṛjantam‌, tatra `aniṭi' iti pratiṣedhādiḍādau na na prāpnauti, ato nipātyate| hrasavatvantu `janījṝṣknasurañjo'mantāśca' (ga.sū.dhā.pā.817) iti mitsaṃjñakatvāt‌ `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) ityanenaiva siddham‌|| 54. śamitā yajñe| (6.4.54) `śamitaḥ' ityatra pūrdhavad‌ hrasvatvam‌| `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' (7.3.110) iti guṇaḥ, halṅyādinā (6.1.68) sulopaḥ, rephasya visargaḥ| `tṛci sambuddhyantametat‌' iti| niṣṭhāntametaditi kasyacidāśaṅkā syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākartumidamuktam‌| `śamayitaḥ' ityetadapi tṛci sambuddhyantam‌|| 55. ayāmantālvāyyentviṣṇuṣu| (6.4.55) `kārayāñcakāra' iti| `kāspratyayāt‌' (3.1.35) ityādinām‌, `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti lerluk‌, `kṛñca' (3.1.40) ityādinā liṭparasya kṛño'nuprayogaḥ dvirvacanamabyāsakāryam‌| `gaṇḍayantaḥ, maṇḍayantaḥ' iti| `gaḍi secane' (dhā.pā.777) [`gaḍa' dhā.pā.(gaḍi vadanaikadeśe--dhā.65,361)] `maḍi bhūṣāyām‌' (dhā.pā.321), hetumaṇṇic‌, gaḍerghaṭāditvāmmittve sati pūrvavad‌ hrasvatvam‌| `jṛvṛṣibyāṃ jhac‌' (da.u.6.17)[`jṛviśibhyāṃ--da.u.] ityanuvarttamāne `tṝbhūvahivasabhāsisādhigamimaṇḍijinandibhyaśca' (da.u.6.19) [tṝbhūvahivasibhāsisādhigaḍimaṇḍijivandibhyaśca--da.u.] iti jhac‌, antādeśaḥ| `spṛhayāluḥ, gṛhayāluḥ' iti| `spṛha īpsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1871) `gṛha grahaṇe' (dhā.pā.1899) caurādikāvadantau, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakaralopaḥ, tasya sthānivattvālladhūpadhaguṇābhāvaḥ, `spṛhi gṛhi' (3.2.158) ityādinā''luc‌| `spṛhayāyyaḥ' iti| `tanudakṣispṛhigṛhibhya [śrudakṣispṛhigṛhibhya āyyaḥ--paṃ.u.] āyyaḥ' (paṃu.3.96) iti āyyapratyayaḥ| `stanayitnuḥ' iti| `stata gadī devaśabde' (dhā.pā.1859,1860) curādāvadantaḥ, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48)| tatrakāralopasya sthānivadbhāvāt‌ `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhirna bhavati| `stanihṛṣipuṣigadimadibhyo ṇeritnuc‌' [stanihṛṣipuṣigadimadidhuṣigandhimaḍijaninadibhyo ṇeritnuc‌--da.u.] (da.u.1.140) itīluṣpratyayaḥ| `poṣayiṣṇavaḥ, pārayiṣṇavaḥ' iti| `puṣa puṣṭau' (dhā.pa.700) hetumāṇṇic‌, `pāra tīra karmasamāptau' (dhā.pā.1911,1912), curādiṇic‌, `ṇeśchandasi' (3.2.137) itīṣṇuc‌| atha `na' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam‌, ṇilope hi pratiṣiddhe guṇa eva syāt‌, tatra `eco'yavāyāvaḥ' (6.1.78) ityayādeśo bhaviṣyati; ladhu caivaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati, `aya' ityucyamāne mātrādhikyena sūtraṃ guru bhavatīti matvā''ha--`na itivaktavye' ityādi| `lyapi laghupūrvāt‌' (6.4.56) ityatra guṇābhāvādayādeśo na syādyadi netyucyate| tasmāduttarārthamayādeśavacanam‌|| 56. lyapi laghupūrvāt‌| (6.4.56) `ladhūpūrvāt‌' iti| laghuḥ pūrvo yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ| varṇo'nyapadārthaḥ| `praṇamapya, pratamayya, pradamayya, praśamayya' iti| atra namādīnāṃ mittvāt‌ pūrvavad‌ hrasvatve kṛte makāro laghūpūrvaḥ| `pravebhidayya gataḥ' iti| bhideryaṅantāṇṇic‌| `yasya halaḥ' (6.4.49) iti yakālopaḥ| atrāpi dakāro laghūpūrvaḥ| `pragaṇayya' iti| `gaṇa saṃkhyāne' (dhā.pā.1853), curādāvantaḥ pūrdhavadallopaḥ| atrāpi ṇakāro laghūpūrvaḥ| nanu hrasvādaya evā bhācchāstrīyāḥ, ayādeśo'pi; tatra `asiddhavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) iti hlasvādīnāmasiddhatvālladhupūrvatvaṃ makārādervarṇasya nopapadyate? ityata āha--`hrasvayalopāllopānām‌' ityādi| kathamasamānāśrayatvam‌? ityāha--`hrasvādayo hi' ityādi| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na laghorityevocyeta? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum‌; evamucyamāne laghoruttarasya ṇerlyapyayādeśo bhavatītyeṣa vākyārthaḥ| tathā ca `pratamayya' ityādau na syāt‌, halā vyavadhānāt‌| kva tarahi syāt‌? `pragaṇayya' ityādau| nanu cātrāpyato lope kṛte laghoruttaro ṇinaṃ sambhavatyeva, tatra vacanasāmarthyāddhyavadhānamāśrayiṣyate? naitadevam‌; vacanasāmarthyādbhūtapūrvagatirāśrāyiṣyate| kṛta etallabhyate--vacanasāmarthyāddhyavadhānamāśrayitavyam‌, na tu bhūtapūrvagatiriti? bhūtapūrvagatāvāśrīyamāṇāyāṃ `pragaṇayya' ityādādeva syāt‌, `praṇamayya gataḥ' ityādau tu na syāt‌| tasmāt‌ pūrvagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 57. vibhāṣā''paḥ| (6.4.57) `prāpayya' iti| `āplṛ lambhane' (dhā.pa.1839), `āplṛ vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1260) dvayorapi grahaṇam‌| pūrdhakaścurādiḥ, aparaḥ svādiḥ| atha `adhyāpya gataḥ' ityatara kasmānna bhavati, atrāpi `krīṅajīnāṃ ṇau' (6.1.48) itīṅa āttve kṛte `arttihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā pukyāpa uttaro ṇirbhavati? ityata āha--`iṅādeśasya' ityādi| yadyevam‌, `apa ācaṣṭe' ityapśabdāṇṇici kṛte `prāpayya' ityādi na syāt‌, lākṣaṇikatvādeva mā bhūdanena, pūrveṇa sūtreṇa bhaviṣyati, nanu caikādeśe kṛte satyalaghupūrvatvānna prāpnoti? ekādeśasyāsiddhatvānna doṣaḥ| katham‌? `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pā.42) iti bahiraṅgatvantvekādeśasya dvipadāśrayatvāt‌| ayādeśasya punarṇimātrāśrayatvādantaraṅgatvam‌|| 58. yupluvordīrghaśchandasi| (6.4.58) `yu miśraṇe' (dhā.pā.1033) [miśraṇe'miśraṇe ca--dhā.pā.] `pluṅaḥ gatau' (dhā.pā.958) anayordhātvostuki prāpte dīrghāthaṃ vacanam‌|| 59. kṣiyaḥ| (6.4.59) `chandasi' iti nivṛttam‌| `kṣiyaḥ' iti `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti `kṣi kṣaye' (dhā.pā.236) `kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1407) ityanayorgrahaṇam‌, na `kṣiṣ‌ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1506) [`kṣīṣ‌'--dhā.pā.] ityasaya|| 60. niṣṭhāyāmaṇyadartha| (6.4.60) `ṣyataḥ kṛtyasyārtho bhāvakarmaṇī' iti| tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' (3.4.70) iti vacanāt‌| `tābhyāmanyatra' iti| karttaryadhikaraṇe ca| `ākṣīṇaḥ' iti| `kṣiyo dīrghāt‌' (8.2.46) iti niṣṭhānatvam‌| `akaramakāt‌ kṣiyaḥ kartari ktapratyayo'yam‌' iti| `gatyartha'(3.4.72) ityādinā| `prakṣīṇamidaṃ devadattasya' iti| `adhikaraṇavācinaśca' (2.3.68) iti karttari ṣaṣṭhī| `adhikaraṇe' iti| ktapratyayo'yamiti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| prakṣīyatesminniti prakṣīṇam‌--adhikaraṇabhūtaṃ dravyamucyate| `kṣitamiti bhāve' iti| asyāpi pūrvavatsambandhaḥ| karmaṇi na pratyudāharati; kṣiyo'karmakatvāt‌|| 61. vā''krośadainyayoḥ| (6.4.61) `kṣitāyuḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ kartari ktaḥ| evamutaratrāpi| `kṣitakaḥ' iti| anukampāyāṃ kan‌| ākośadainyābhyāmanyatra pūrveṇa nityaṃ bhavati| aṇyadartha iti kim‌? kṣitaṃ jālmasya, kṣitakamasya tapasvinaḥ|| 62. syasicsīyudtāsiṣu bhāvakarmaṇorupadeśe'jjhanagrahadṛśāṃ vā ciṇvadiṭ‌ ca| (6.4.62) `syasicsīyuṭtāsiṣu' iti saptamyā pratiyogino nirdeśācciṇīva ciṇvaditi saptamīsamarthādvatirvijñāyate, yathā--mathurāvat‌ pāṭaliputre prakāra iti| `bhāvakarmaviṣayeṣu' iti| anena `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ ityasya viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayati| bhāvakarmaṇī viṣayau yeṣānte tathoktāḥ ke punaḥ syādayo bhāvakarmaviṣayāḥ? ye syādayo lādeśena bhāvakarmaṇorvivakṣitayorbhavatanti| cakāro'tra sanniyogārthaḥ kriyate| tena yadā ciṇvadbhāvo ityādi| `kasya' iti| ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭasya hyāgamā bhavanti, syādayaśceha saptamyā nirdiṣṭāḥ; na cānya āgamīśrūyata iti praśnaḥ| yadyapi te saptamyā nirdiṣṭāḥ, na cānya āgamī śrūyata iti praśnaḥ| yadyapi te saptamyā nirdiṣṭāḥ, tathāpi yathā `hanaśca vadhaḥ' (3.3.76) iti pañcamī nirdiṣṭo'pi hantiḥ pratyayamutpādyadeśena sambandhamanubhavan‌ ṣaṣṭhyantatāṃ pratipadyate tathā syādayo'pi yadāgamena sambandhamanubhavanti tadā ṣaṣṭhyantatāṃ pratipadyanta ityabhiprāyeṇāha--`syasic‌' ityādi| atraiva hetamāha--`te hi prakṛtāḥ' ityādi| iḍayamāgamaliṅgaḥ, tasyāvaśyamāgaminā bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kimaśrutānāmāgamitvaṃ parikalpya, tasyaiva vidhīyatāmuta prakṛtānāmeva syādīnāmiti? yuktaṃ yat‌ prakṛtānāmeva vidhīyate; aśrutaprakalpanāyā garīyastvāt‌| nanu cāṅgamapi prakṛtam‌, tasya kasmānna kriyate? ityata āha--`aṅgasya' ityādi| aṅgasya na kriyate, lakṣyavirodhāt‌| yadyaṅgasya syāt‌, tadeṭi kṛte lakṣyāvaradhādaniṣṭaṃ syāt‌| na hyanaṇṭārthā śāstre praklṛptirayuktā| tasmānmā bhūllakṣyavirodha iti yadyapyaṅgamapi prakṛtam‌, tathāpi syādīnāmeva kriyate, nāṅgasya| iha dvau pakṣau sambhavataḥ--ciṇnimittaṃ yatkāryaṃ, yadāhatya ciṇi vidhīyate tadvātidiśyate| yadvā ciṇiyaddṛṣṭaṃ ciṇṇimattamaciṇṇimittñca tat‌ sāmānyena| tatra yadi parvakaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadā `āto yuk‌ ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yugāgamaḥ| `viṇṇamulordorgho'nyatarasyām‌' (6.4.93) iti dīrghatvañca--ete dve evāṅgakārye'tiviśye syātām‌| nānyāt‌ vṛddhyādikam‌, na hi tadāhatya ciṇi vidhīyate| āhatya-uccāryetyarthaḥ| yaddhi sākṣācciṇaṃ nimittamupādāya vidhīyate tacciṇyāhatya vidhīyate, na caivaṃ vṛddhyādikaṃ vidhīyate| atha dvitīyastato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ; vṛddhyādīnāmapi ciṇi dṛṣṭatvāt‌| yadi ciṇi yaddṛṣṭaṃ tadatidiśyate, tarhi haniṇiṅāmādeśā api prāpnuvanti, teṣāmapi tatra dṛṣṭatvāditi? anenābhiprāyeṇāha--`kāni punaḥ' ityādi| dvitīye pakṣe yo doṣastamuttaratra parihariṣyāmīti cetasi kṛtvā ciṇi yaddṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ tannimittamitaradvā tadiha sāmānyena nirdiśyata iti darśayannasya yogasya yāni prayojanāni teṣāṃ saṃgrahaślokasamāha--`vṛddhiściṇvat‌' ityādi| `cāyiṣyate' ityatra vṛddhiḥ prayojanam‌| cinoterluṭ‌, syapragatayayaḥ| `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityātmanepadam‌, atredānīṃ ciṇvadbhāvād‌ vṛddhirbhavati yathā--ciṇi `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddhirbhavatya cāyīti, evamuttaratrāpi ciṇvadityetasya pratyekamabhisambandhaṃ kṛtvā yathāyogamatideśo yojanīyaḥ| `acāyiṣyate' iti| luṅaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat‌| yuk‌ ca prayojanam‌--`dāyiṣyate' ityatra| dīrghaścokto yo mitāṃ vā ciṇoti sa ca| prayojanaṃ śamiṣyate, śāmiṣyata ityatra| śameḥ `janijṛṣknasurañjo'mantāśca' (dhā.pā.817) iti mitsaṃjñā, sa ca ṇyantaḥ `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (3.1.32) ityatropadiṣṭa ityupadeśe'janto bhavati| yattu hanteḥ `ho hanteñcinneṣu' (7.3.54) iti kutvaṃ vidhāsyate, tacca prayojanaṃ `ghāniṣyate' ityatra| haniṣyata ityatra tu `ṛddhanoḥ sye' (7.1.70) itīṭ‌| santyetāni prayojanāni, kintvaneneṭi kṛte śamiṣyate, śamiṣyata ityatra `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopo na siddhyatiḥ seṭtvāt‌| ata āha--`iṭ‌ cāsiddhaḥ' ityādi| `asiddhavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) ityasiddhe'yaṃ ciṇvadiṭ‌, tena ṇilopo bhaviṣyati| syādetat‌--ye'nudāttopadeśāścinotyādayastebhyaḥ pareṣāṃ syādīnāmaneneṅvidhīyata iti yuktamasiddhatvam‌, ye tūdāttopadeśāḥ śamiprabhṛtayastemyaḥ paratvāt‌ `ārdhadhātukasyeṅvalādeḥ' (7.2.35) iti valnimitteneṭā bhavitavyam‌, sa ca siddha eva; tasmiṃstu tadavastha eva doṣaḥ? ityata āha--`nityaścāyam‌' ityādi| kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgī yo vidhiḥ sa nityaḥ--ityetadāśrityāyaṃ ciṇvadiṇnityaḥ| kṛte'pi hi valāditvasya vihitatvāt‌| `valnimitto vidhātī' iti| val‌ nimittaṃ kāraṇaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ| vighāto'syāstīti vighātī| vighātaḥ-nimittābhāvādapravṛttiḥ| tadevaṃ nityatvādudāttebhyo'pyanenaiva ciṇvadiṭā bhavitavyam‌, ayañcāsiddha iti na bhavati ṇilopābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| `grāhiṣyate' iti| `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ prayojanam‌| atheha `graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ' (7.2.37) iti dīrghaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`graho'liṭi' ityādi| valādilakṣaṇastatreṭ‌ prakṛta iti tasyaiva dīrgho vijñāyate, nānyasya| `drakṣyate' iti| `sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti (6.1.58) ityamāgamaḥ, vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌ `ṣaṅoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam‌ `iṇkoḥ (8.3.57) iti ṣatvam‌| `darśiṣyate' iti| `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) ityanenātra guṇaḥ siddhyatyeva| iḍarthastu ciṇvadbhāvo vidhīyate| `aceṣātām‌' iti| ātām‌, sici rūpam‌| `adiṣātām‌' iti| `sthādhvoricca' (1.2.17) itīttvam‌, sicaśca kitvam‌| `avadhiṣātām‌' iti| `ātmanepadeṣvanyatarasyām‌' (2.4.44) iti vadhādeśaḥ| `adṛkṣātām‌' iti| `liṅasicāvātmanepadeṣu' (1.2.11) iti kittvam‌| tenāmāgamaguṇau na bhavataḥ, ṣatvādi pūrvavat‌| `cetā' iti| luṭ‌, tāsiḥ, `luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ' (2.4.85) iti ḍādeśaḥ, ṭilopaḥ| `draṣṭā' iti| pūrvavadamādiḥ| `cetavyam‌' iti| karmaṇi tavyaḥ| `ceṣyati' iti| atra karturlādeśena vivakṣitvāt‌ kartṛviṣayaḥ syapratyayaḥ| `guṇe kṛte raparatve ca na prāpnoti' iti| kṛ ṣyata iti sthite guṇaḥ prāpnoti, ciṇvadbhāvaśca; tatra paratvādguṇaḥ, tatra kṛte raparatvam‌| yadyupadeśagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta tato'najantatvādiha na syāt‌| upadeśagrahaṇādbhavati| yadyapi karotiruttarakālamanajantaḥ, upadeśe tvajanta eva| yadi ciṇi yaddṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ tadatidiṣṭaṃ haniṇiṅādeśā api prāpnuvanti| teṣāmapi tanna dṛṣṭatvāt‌? ityata āha--`aṅgādhikāravihitam‌' ityādi| `aṅgasya' ityadhikāre sati pratyasatteraṅgādhikāre vihitaṃ kāryaṃ yacciṇi dṛśyate sāmānyena tadatidiśyate, na tu yadviprakṛṣṭaṃ prakaraṇāntaravihitam‌| na ca haniṇiṅāmādeśā aṅgādhikāre vihitāḥ, api tu prakaraṇāntare| tasmān te'tidiśyanta iti na bhavanti tatra| `dhāniṣyate' ityatra `luṅi ca' (2.4.43) ityanena vihito vadhādeśo na bhavati| `āyiṣyate' iti| `iṇo gā luṅi' (2.4.45) ityanena vihito gādeśaḥ| `adhyāyiṣyate' iti| atra `vibhāṣā luṅlṛṅoḥ' (2.4.50) ityanena vihitau gāṅādeśaḥ| evamapi syādibhyaḥ parasya pratyayasaya luk‌ prāpnoti; aṅgādhikāre ciṇa uttarasaya pratyayasya `ciṇoluk‌' (6.4.104) iti lugvidhānāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha hi saptamīsamarthādvihitasya vaterāśrayaṇam‌| tena ciṇi yaddṛṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvasya sambhavati tadatidiśyate, na tūttarasya yat‌ kāryaṃ tadapi|| 63. dīṅo yuḍaci kṅiti| (6.4.63) `upadidīye' iti| `dīṅa kṣaye' (dhā.pā.1134), `asaṃyogālliṭ‌ kit‌' (1.2.5) iti kittvam‌, liṭastajhayoreśirecau| `dīṅaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭīyaṃ vā syāt‌, pañcamī veti dvau pakṣau| tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadā `ādyantau ṭikitau' (1.1.46) ityādau yuṭi kṛte dhātoraniṣṭaṃ rūpamāpadyate; ata idaṃ ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe dūṣaṇamālakṣya pañcamīpakṣaṃ puraskṛtyāha--`dīṅa iti pañcamīnirdeśāt‌' ityādi| pañcamīnirdeśe hi sati `ubhayanirdeśa pañcamanirdeśo balīyān‌' (śāka.pa.97) iti `dīṅaḥ' iti pañcamyāḥ `aci' iti sampamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītve prakalpate `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityajāderādiryuḍāgamo bhavati| `aci' iti saptamīnirdeśastūttarārthaḥ| nanu cātra `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) iti yaṇādeśe kartavye yuḍasiddha iti yaṇādeśena bhavitavyam‌, tataścopadidīya iti na siddhyet‌, `upadidye' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prāpnoti, ata āha--`vidhānasāmarthyāt‌' ityādi| yadi yaṇādeśe karttavye yuṭo'siddhatvaṃ syāt‌, tadā yuṭo vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; viśeṣābhāvāt‌| kathaṃ punarviśeṣābhāvaḥ, yāvatā'sati hi yuṭyekasya yakārasya śravaṇaṃ bhavati, sati tu dvayoḥ? naiṣo'sti viśeṣaḥ; na hi vyañjanaparasyaikasyānekasya vā halaḥ śravaṇaṃ prati viśeṣo'sti| ye tu viśeṣamicchanti, tanmatenāsmābhiḥ pūrvameva yaṇādeśe yuṭaḥ siddhatvamanyathā pratipāditam‌| `upadedīyate' iti| `dīṅa kṣaye' (dhā.pā.1134), `asaṃyogālliṭ‌ kit‌' (1.2.5) iti kittvam‌, liṭastajhayoreśireco| `dīṅaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭīyaṃ vā syāt‌, pañcamī veti dvau pakṣau| tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadā `ādyantau ṭakitau' (1.1.46) ityādau yuṭi kṛte dhātoraniṣṭaṃ rūpamāpadyeta; ata idaṃ ṣaṣṭhīpakṣe dūṣaṇamālakṣya pañcamīpakṣaṃ puraskṛtyāha--`dīṅa iti pañcamīnirdeśāt‌' ityādi| pañcamīnirdeśe hi sati `ubhayanirdeśa pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān‌' (śāka.pa.97) iti `dīṅaḥ' iti pañcamyāḥ `aci' iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītve prakalpite `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityajāderādiryuḍāgamo bhavati| `aci' iti| saptamīnirdeśastūttarārthaḥ| nanu cātra `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) iti yaṇādeśe karttavye yuḍasiddha iti yaṇādeśena bhavitavyam‌, tataścopadidīya iti na siddhyet‌, `upadidye' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prāpnoti| ata āha--`vidhānasāmarthyāt‌' ityādi| yadi yaṇādeśe karttavye puṭo'siddhatvaṃ syāt‌, tadā yuṭo vidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; viśeṣābhāvāt‌| kathaṃ punarviśeṣābhāvaḥ, yāvatā'sati hi yuṭyekasya yakārasya śravaṇaṃ bhavati, sati tu dvayoḥ? naiṣo'sti viśeṣaḥ; na hi vyañjanaparasyaikasyānekasya kā halā śravaṇaṃ prati viśeṣo'sti| ye tu viśeṣamicchanti, tanmatenāsmābhiḥ pūrvameva yaṇādeśe yuṭaḥ siddhatvamanyathā pratipāditam‌| `upadedīyate' iti| yaṅaḥ| `upadānam‌' iti| lyuṭ‌, `mīnātiminotidīṅīṃ lyapi ca' (6.1.50) ityāttvam‌| `dīṅa' ityanubandhanirdeśo yaṅaluki mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ--dedyatu, dedyuriti| nanu cātra `kāspratyayādāmamantre' (3.1.35) ityāmā bhavitavyam‌, tenākṅitvādeva na bhaviṣyati? satyametat‌; amantre na bhaviṣyati, mantre tu syādeva; tatrāmo'bhāvāt‌| atha yaṅlugantasya mantre prayogo na dṛśyate, tadā vispaṣṭārtham‌|| 64. ato lopa iṭi ca| (6.4.64) `iṭyajādāvārdhadhātuke kṅiti ca' iti| `ajādāvārdhadhātuke' iti pratyekamabhisambadhyate--iṭyajādāvārdhadhātuke, kṅiti cājādāvārdhadhātuka iti| iṅgrahaṇamakṅidartham‌| `papitha' iti| pāteḥ vibatervā liṭ‌, sip‌, `parasmaipadānām‌' (3.4.82) ityādinā tasya thal‌ `ṛto bhāradvājasya' (7.2.63) iti niyamādiṭ‌| `godaḥ' iti| `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3)| `vyatyare, vyatyale' ti| `karttari karmavyatīhāre' (1.3.14) ityātmanepadam‌ uttamapuruṣaikavacanam‌--iṭ‌, tasya
