`sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) iti ṅittvam‌| tatrārdhadhātukatvaṃ nāstīti na bhavati lopaḥ| `glāyate' iti| bhāve lakāraḥ| `dāsīya' iti| āśiṣi liṅaḥ, ātmanepadottamaikavacanam‌, tasya `iṭo't‌' (3.4.106) ityadādeśaḥ| atra sīyuṭastadbhaktatvādiṭojāditvaṃ nāstīti satyapayārdhadhātukājādītve lopābhāvaḥ|| 65. īdyati| (6.4.65) `kṅiti' ityuttarārthamanuvartamānamapīha nābhisambadhyate; yata kṅittvāsambhavāt‌| takāra uccāraṇārthaḥ; anaṇtvādeva hi savarṇagrahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati| asatyapi vā jātipakṣe savarṇagrahaṇa āntaramyāddīrgha eva bhaviṣyati; na hrasvaḥ| dīrghoccāraṇamuttarārtham‌| iha tu guṇena bhavitavyam‌| na cātra dīrghasya hrasvasya vā guṇe kṛte kaścidviviśeṣo'sti| `deyam‌' iti| `aco yat‌' (3.1.97)|| 66. ghumāsthāgāpājahātisāṃ hali| (6.4.66) `dīyate' iti| karmaṇi lakāraḥ| `dedīyate' iti| yaṅaḥ| atha meti kasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌, kim‌ `meṅ‌ praṇidāne' (dhā.pā.961) ityasya bhauvādikasya? utta `māṅ‌ māne' (dhā.pā.1088) [`māne śabde ca'--dhā.pā.] ityasya jauhotyādikasya? āhosvit‌ `mā māne' (dhā.pā.1062) ityasyādādikasya? tatra kecidāhuḥ--`niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) ityādādikasya grahaṇam‌| anye tvāhuḥ--`lugvikaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.50) ityalugvikaraṇayormāṅameṅoriti| apare bruvate--`gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) iti trayāṇāmapīti; etadeva vṛttikārasyābhimatamiti lakṣyate| tathā hi--`pāteriha grahaṇaṃ nāsti, lugvikaraṇatvāt‌' iti| bruvatā `pā rakṣaṇe (dhā.pā.1056) ityasya grahaṇābhāvaḥ svayamevoktaḥ| yadi cātrālugvikaraṇayorlugvikaraṇasya vā grahaṇamabhimataṃ syāt‌, tadapi pratipādayet‌, na ca pratipāditam‌, ato'vagamyate--trayāṇāmāpi grahaṇamabhimatamiti| `gā' iti| `gāṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.950) `ke gai śabde' (dhā.pā.916,917) etau bhauvādikau; `gā stutau chandasi' (dhā.pā.1106) [`chandasi' nāsti--dhāpā.] iti jauhotyādikaḥ, `iṇo gā luṅi' (2.4.45) itīṇo gādeśaḥ, `iṇvādika iti vaktavyam‌' (vā.167) itīko gādeśaḥ `gāṅ‌ liṭi' (2.4.49), `vibhāṣā luṅlṛṅo (2.4.50) iti ceṅo gāṅādeśaḥ--eṣāṃ pūrvavat‌ sarveṣāmaviśeṣeṇa grahaṇam‌| satyapi sarveṣāṃ grahaṇe yasya kṅidārdhadhātukaparaṃ sambhavati tasyaivettvaṃ bhavati, netarasya; nimittābhāvāt‌| `gīyate, jegīyate' iti| bhauvādikayorudāharaṇe| `adhyagīṣṭa' ityādi| iṅo gāṅ‌, gāṅkuṭādi(1.2.1) sūtreṇa sico ṅittvam‌, `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityadādeśaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ `jahāti' iti stipā sirdeśaḥ kriyate, na hetyevocyeta? ityata āha--`jahāteḥ' ityādi| yadi heti nirdeśaḥ kriyate, tadā jihāteḥ `o hāṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.1089) ityasyāpi syāt‌, jahātīti nirdeśe tu na bhavati| atra hinirdeśe sāta yasyaitadrūpaṃ bhavati tasyaiva grahaṇena bhavitavyam‌| kasya caitadrūpam‌? `o hāk‌ tyāge' (dhā.pā.1090) ityasya, itarasaya `bhṛñāmit‌' (7.4.76) ityabhyālasyettve kṛte jihātīti rūpaṃ bhavatīti| kāmaṃ hāgityapi nirdeśe na bhavati jihīteḥ prasaṅgaḥ, vaicitryārthastu na tathā nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| `avasīyate' iti| `ṣo'ntakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1147)| `dadatuḥ' ityādi| nanu cātra `āto lopaḥ' (6.4.64) ityādinākāralopo bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kimetannivṛttyarthena halītyanena? ityata āha--`āto lopāddhi' ityādi| āto lopasyāvakāśaḥ--yayatuḥ, yayuriti, īttvasyāvakāśaḥ--dīyate, dhīyata iti; ihobhaya prāpnoti--dadatuḥ daduriti| tatra yadi halgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā paratvādīttvaṃ syāt‌| nanu siddhayordvayorvipratiṣedha upapadyate, iha tu `asiddhavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) iti dvayorapyasiddhatvam‌, tat‌ kuto vipratiṣedhaḥ, asmiṃśca sati paratvādīttvaṃ syāditi na yuktaṃ vaktum‌, tathā hi--`vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam‌' (1.4.2) ityuktam‌? ata āha--`etadeva' ityādi| yadyatra vipratiṣedhe karttavye'siddhatvaṃ syāt‌, halgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| bhavatvatrettvam‌, tasyāsiddhatvāta `āto lopaḥ' (6.4.64) bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kiṃ halgrahaṇena? tadetatkathamarthavadbhavati? yadi vipratiṣedhe karttavye siddhatvaṃ syāt‌ nānyathā|| 67. erliṅi| (6.4.67) `pūrveṇettve prāpta etvaṃ vidhīyate| `meyāt‌' iti| `mā māne' (dhā.pā.1062) ityasyedam‌dāharaṇam‌, na tu māṅ meṅoḥ, tayorhyātmanepaditvātparasmaipadaṃ na sambhavati| `geyāt‌' iti| `kai gai' (dhā.pā.916,917) ityasyodāharaṇam‌, na tu gāṅaḥ; tasya parasmaipadāsambhavāt‌| nāpīṇigiṅādeśānām‌; teṣāmapi liṅyasambhavāt‌| iṅādeśasya tu pūrvasmācca hetoḥ|| 68. vā'nyasya saṃyogādeḥ| (6.4.68) `anyasyeti kiṃ? `stheyāt‌' iti| yadyanyasyeti na kriyeta, tadā pūrvayāgo'nyeṣu dhvādiṣu sāvakāśaḥ, ayamapi glāyādityādiṣu; stheyādityatrobhayaprāptau paratvādanena vikalpaḥ syādityanyagrahaṇam‌| yadi pūrvayogastiṣṭhyatyartho'pyārabhyeta tadā tadarthasya tasyārambhasāmarthyāt‌ pūrveṇa nityamettvaṃ bhaviṣyati, anyathāṃ tadarthasya tasyārambho niṣphalaḥ syāditi śakyamanyagrahaṇamakartum‌| tat‌ kriyate vispaṣṭārtham‌|| 69. na lyapi| (6.4.69) veti nivṛttam‌; uttarasūtre punaranyatasyāṃgrahaṇāt‌| `yaduktam‌' iti| īttvam‌, na punaranantaramettvam‌; tasya lyapi prāptyabhāvāt‌| pratiṣedhasya ca prāptipūrvakatvāt‌|| 70. mayateridanyatarasyām‌| (6.4.70) `na lyapi' (6.4.69) iti pratiṣedhādākārasya śravaṇe prāpte satīttvamārabhyate| `apamitya' iti| `meṅ‌ praṇidāne' (dhā.pā.961)| `udīcāṃ māṅī vyatīhāre' (3.4.19) iti ktvā, ittve kṛte tuk‌| nanu ca `apamityayācitābhyāṃ kakkanau' (4.4.21) iti nipātanāt‌ siddhametat‌ tadapārthako'yamārambhaḥ? naitadasti; `cādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti' (nī.pa.vṛ.109) iti pakṣe apamāyeti na syāt‌| `māṅ‌ māne' (dhā.pā.1088) [`māne śabde ca'--dhā.pā.] ityasya bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? na; arthabhedāt‌| athāpi `abādhakānyapi nipātanāni' (nau.pa.vṛ.110) syuḥ? evamapyārabdhavyamevedamasandehārtham‌? asati hyasmin‌ sandehaḥ syāt‌--kiṃ mayateridaṃ nipātanam‌, atha dhātvantarasyeti| upasarganiyamaśca vijñāyeta--apapūrvasyaiveti| asmiṃstu satyanyopasargasyāpi bhavatītyetadartho yukta ārambhaḥ|| 71. luṅlaṅlṛṅkṣvaḍudāttaḥ| (6.4.71) `udāttaśca sa bhavati' iti| āgamānudāttatve prāpta udāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| etaccodāttavacanam‌ abhedakā iha śāstre guṇāḥ` (pu.pa.vṛ.57) ityasyārthasya jñāpakam‌| kathaṃ kṛtvā? yadi ca bhedakā guṇāḥ syuḥ, tadodāttayuktenaivāṭaṃ samuccārayet‌| paśyatvācāryaḥ--`abhedakā iha śāstre guṇāḥ' iti, yataḥ svarāntaranivṛttyarthamudāttavacanaṃ kṛtavān‌| kimetasya jñāpanena prayojanam‌? `vṛddhirādaic‌' (1.1.1) ityatrodāttādibhedabhinnānāmapi vṛddhisaṃjñā sidhyatīti|| 72. āḍajādīnām‌| (6.4.72) `aikṣiṣṭa, aihiṣṭa' iti| `īkṣa darśane' (dhā.pā.610) `īha ceṣṭāyām‌' (dhā.pā.632)--anudāttetau, `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| `aubjīt‌ `aumbhīt‌' iti| `ubja ārjane' (dhā.pā.1303), `ubha unbhapūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1319,1320), `ārdhadhātukasyeṭ‌' (7.2.35), `asti sico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ‌ `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| athaijyata, aupyata, auhyatetyatra kathamāṭ‌; yato yajivapivahibhyo laṅaḥ vihitaḥ karmaṇi, te ca halādayaḥ, nājādayaḥ| na ca śakyate vaktum‌--samprasāraṇe kṛte'jāditvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| yasmāt‌ prāgeva lādeśāt‌ paratvādaḍāgamena bhavitavyam‌, tato lādeśena, tato yakā, tataḥ samprasāraṇena? ityata āha--`iha' ityādi| yadyapyaḍāgamaḥ paraḥ, tathāpyantaraṅgatvādādeśasya pūrva sa eva kriyate| lādeśo hi dhātorvihitaṃ lakāramātramapekṣya bhavatītyantaraṅgaḥ| aḍāgamastu lakāraviśeṣam‌; aṅgasya vidhīyamānatvāt‌| aṅgañca pratyayamapekṣata iti bariraṅgaḥ| pūrvotpattiniyittopalakṣaṇamātraṃ cehāntaraṅgatvam‌, tena nityatvamapyuktaṃ bhavati| lādeśo hi nityaḥ, kṛte'pyaṭi prāpnoti, akṛte'pi; aḍāgamastvanityaḥ, śabdāntaraprapteḥ| kṛte hi lādeśe nityatvādvikaraṇena bhavitavyam‌| vikaraṇe ca kṛte vikaraṇāntarasyāṅgasya tena bhavitavyam‌, akṛte tu dhātumātrasya| tasmādantaraṅgatvānnityatvāccāḍāgamātpūrvaṃ lādeśaḥ kriyate| `tatra kṛte' iti| lādeśe kṛte| `vikaraṇaḥ' iti| yak‌| `nityatvāt‌' iti| kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena vikaraṇasya nityatvam‌| sa hi kṛte'pyaṭi prāpnoti, akṛte'pi| syādetat‌--aḍāgamo'pi kṛte vikaraṇe prāpnoti akṛte'pi, atastasyāpi nityatvam‌, tatrobhayornityatve paratvādaḍāgama eva pūrvaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`śabdāntaraprāptiḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ śabdāntaraprāptiḥ? ityāha--`kṛte hi' ityādi| aṅgasyāḍāgamo vidhīyate; kṛte ca vikaraṇe tadādigrahaṇasya syāditi numarthatvādvikaraṇāntamaṅge bhavati, akṛte tu dhātumātram‌| anyacca vikaraṇāntādaṅgāddhātumātramaṅgam‌, ato'nyasaya kṛte prāpnoti, akṛte tvanyasya iti sphuṭaiva śabdāntaraprāptiḥ, tatraitatsyāt‌| vikaraṇasyāpi śabdāntaraprāpterevānityatvam‌, tathā hi--tenāpi kṛte satyaḍāgame tadāderdhātorbhavitavyam‌; akṛte dhātumātrādityata āha--`śabdāntarasya ca' ityīdi| yadyapyaṭaḥ kṛtākṛtayorevāvasthayorvikaramaḥ śabdāntarāt‌ prāpnoti, tathāpi na tasyānityatvamupapadyate, yasmāt‌ `śabdāntarasya prāpnuvan‌ vidhiranityo bhavati' (vyā.pa.100) ityeṣā hi śāstravyavasthā; na tu `śabdāntarāt‌ prāpnuvan‌ vidhiranityaḥ' ityeṣā| na ca vikaraṇaḥ kasyacicchabdasyāgama ādeśo vā vidhīyate; yataḥ `śabdāntarasya prāpnuvan‌ vidhiranityaḥ' syāt‌| tathā hi--sārvadhātuke pare dhātoḥ paraḥ pratyayo vidhīyate, na tu tasyāgamaḥ, ādeśo veti kuto vikaraṇasyānityatvam‌| vikaraṇe tarhi kṛte samprasāraṇātpūrvamāḍāgamo bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`vikaraṇe kṛte samprasāraṇam‌' ityādi| nityatvantu samprasāraṇasya pūrvavat‌; kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt‌| āḍāgamastu kṛte samprasāraṇe prāpnoti, kṛte hi samprasāraṇe'jāditvādāṭā bhavitavyamityanityo'yamāḍāgamaḥ|| 73. chandasyapi dṛśyate| (6.4.73) `yato vihitastato'nyatrāpi bhavati' iti| apiśabdāt‌ tatrāpi| `āvaḥ' iti| guṇe raparatvape ca kṛte tipo halaṅyādinā (6.1.68) lopaḥ, rephasya visarjanīyaḥ| `tathā' ityādi| yathā `āvaḥ' iti `mantre ghasahvara' (2.4.80) ityādinā lerluki kṛte bhavati, tathānagiti lerluki kṛte naśerbhavatītyarthaḥ| tatra `narśarvā' (8.2.63) iti kutvam‌| `āyunak‌' iti| `yujir‌ yoge' (dhā.pā.1444) rudhāditvāt‌ śnam‌, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌--gakāraḥ, tasya cartvam‌--kakāraḥ| `bahulaṃ chandasyāmāṅyoge'pi' (6.4.75) iti vakṣyati, tasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ|| 74. na māṅyoge| (6.4.74) `anantarasya vā vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) ityāṭa evāyaṃ pratiṣedha iti kasyacid‌bhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`māṅyoge luṅalaṅalṛṅakṣu parato yaduktaṃ tanna bhavati' iti| etonobhayorapyaḍāṭoḥ pratiṣedha iti darśayati| ubhāvapi tau lṛṅlaṅ‌lṛṅkṣūktau| kathaṃ punardvayorapi pratiṣedho labhyate? āṭāpyatrānuvṛtteḥ| na ca tasminnanuvartamāne satyajādīnāmaṣyaṭ‌ prāpnotītyeṣa doṣaḥ prasajyate; maṇḍūkapalutinyāyenātrāṭo'nuvṛtteḥ| yogavibhāgādvā, ayamaṭo'pi pratiṣedha ityavasīyate; yadi hyāṭa eva pratiṣedho'bhimataḥ syāt‌ tadā `āḍajādīnāṃ na māṅyoge' ityekameva yogaṃ kuryāta| atha vā--`luṅlaṅlṛṅkṣu' (6.4.71) ityetāvanmātramanuvartate, tena luḍādiṣu yaduktaṃ tasya sarvasya pratiṣedho na vijñāyate| na caivamatiprasaṅga; yataḥ pratyāganterasminneva luṅalaṅlṛṅprakaraṇe yat‌ kāryaṃ vihitaṃ tasyaiva pratiṣedho labhyate, na sarvasya prakaraṇāntaravihitasya| atra tu prakaraṇe'ḍāṭāveva vihitau, atastayoreva pratiṣedhaḥ| `mā bhavān‌ kārṣīt‌' iti| `māṅi luṅa', (3.3.175) iti luṅaḥ| `mā sma karot‌' iti| `smottare laṅaḥ ca' (3.3.176) iti laṅaḥ| `māṅ‌' iti ṅkārānubandhavata upādānam‌--asmādādeśī yo māśabdastasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌; anyathā `bhavān‌ sukhinaṃ mātrākārṣīṃt‌' ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāditi kecit‌| lākṣaṇikatvādevāsmadādeśasyāgrahaṇamityayuktametat‌| nipāta eva tvanayo'ṅinmāśabdo'sti--`mā bālipathamanvagāḥ'| `mā bhavatu tasya pāpam‌' iti tu yasya prayogastadyoge pratiṣedho mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ ṅidviśiṣṭasya grahaṇam‌| yogagrahaṇantu--yogamātre pratiṣedho yathā syāditi, tena vyavahite'pi bhavati|| 75. bahulaṃ chandasyāmāṅyoge'pi| `amāṅyoge'pi na bhavataḥ' ityādinā māṅyoge'pītyasyārthamācaṣṭe| atra ca vākyadvaye'pi `bahulaṃ chandasi' ityetatsambadhyate| `bahulaṃ chandasi' ityetāvataiva siddhe'māṅyoge'pīti vacanaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌| anucyamāne hyesmin‌ māṅyogasaya prakṛtatvāt‌ tatraiva chandasi bahulamaḍāṭau na bhavata ityāśaṃkyeta| `janiṣṭhāḥ' iti| janerluṅ, thāsa, iṭ‌, ṣatvam‌ ṣṭutvañca| `ūnayīt‌, ardayīt‌' iti| `ūna parihāṇe' (dhā.pā.1888) `ardda hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1828) curādī| `hyantakṣaṇa' (7.2.5) ityādinā vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ, guṇāyādeśau | `avāpsuḥ' iti| `āplu vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1260) avapūrvaḥ| `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjusādeśaḥ| `mā abhitthāḥ' iti| bhidesthās‌, `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sico lopaḥ| `mā''vaḥ' iti| pūrvameva vyutpāditam‌|| 76. irayo re| (6.4.76) `dadhre' iti| dadhāterliṭ‌, `liṭasthajhayoreśirec‌' (3.4.81) itorec‌| tasyānena rayādeśaḥ `āto lopaḥ' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| `paridadṛśre' iti| dṛśaḥ paripūryālliḍādirātolopadarja vidheyaḥ| atha `dadhre ityatra kathamāto lopaḥ? yāvatā `davā-hare' iti sthita ākāralopaḥ prāpnoti? rebhāvaśca, tatra paratvādrebhāvaḥ; tasmin‌ kṛte'najāditvādākāralopo na prāpnoti? ata āha--`dhāño rebhāvasyāsiddhatvāt‌' ityādi asiddhatvantu `siddhavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) ityanena| `cakrire' iti| kṛño rūpam‌| nanu ca rebhāve kṛte dṛśiprabhṛtayo ye liṭi seṭo dhātavaḥ, krādimiyamāt‌ tebhyo ra ityasyeṭi kṛte dadṛśre iti rūpaṃ na siddhayet‌ dadṛśira ityādinā rūpeṇa bhavitavyam‌, na ca śakyate vaktum‌--rebhāvavidhānasāmarthyādiṅ na bhaviṣyati; rebhāvastha krādiṣu cāritārthatvāt‌ tebyo hi parasya liṭaḥ `kṛsṛ' (7.2.13) ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ? ityata āha--`atra' ityādi| kathaṃ punā rebhāvo labhyate? ityāha--`tadarthañca' ityādi| iṭi kṛte punā rebhāvo yatā syādityevamarthamireśca ireścetyekaśeṣaṃ kṛtverayoriti dvivacanena nirdeśaḥ| tena yaśca jhasthāna irec‌ śabdaḥ kriyate, yaścere ityasyeṭi kṛte satyuttarakālamireśabdaḥ sampadyate, tayorapi rebhāvaḥ siddho bhavati|| 77. aci śnudhātubhruvāṃ vyoriyaṅuvaṅau| (6.4.77) `ārdhadhātuke' iti nivṛttam‌| kutaḥ? `samaḥ kṣṇuvaḥ' (1.3.65), `kṣiyaḥ (6.4.59) iti nirdeśāt‌| hrasvayorivarṇoyoridaṃ grahaṇam‌| ku etat‌? tata eva nirdeśāt‌| atrāṇ‌ gṛhyamāṇaḥ savarṇān‌ grāhayatīti hrasvau gṛhayamāṇau dīrghāvapi grāhayataḥ, tena tadantasyāpi bhavataḥ| `aci' iti varṇagrahaṇam‌ tatra `yasminvidhistadādāvalagarahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) ityajādau vijñāyata ityāha--`ajādau pratyaye' iti| pratyaya ityetat‌ kṛto labhyate, aṅgadhikārāt‌| aṅgādhikāro hyasti, pratyasannidhāpitatvāt‌| pratyaye hi parato'ṅgasaṃjñā vidhīyate| yadyajadau pratyaya iyaṅuvaṅau bhavataḥ, niyau, luvau--ityatara na prāpnutaḥ| atra hyajeva pratyayaḥ, na tvajādiḥ? atrāpi vyapadeśivadbhāve, nājāditvamastītyadoṣaḥ| `ivarṇovarṇāntasya' iti| dhātorevedaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌, netarayoḥ; vyabhicārābhāvāt‌, asambhavācca| ivarṇovarṇāntatā cāṅgasya tābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇāllabhyate| iyaṅuvaṅoṅakāro'ntādeśār‌thaḥ| asati tvasminnanekālvāt‌ sarvasyāṅgasya syātām‌| nanu ca `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' (vyā.pa.106) ityantareṇāpi ṅkāramantavasyaiva bhavataḥ? evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārtham‌| `āpnuvanti, rādhnuvanti' iti| `āplu vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1260), `rādha sādha saṃsidau' (dhā.pā.1262,1263) svāditvācśnuḥ| śakāravato grahaṇaṃ kimartham‌? `dabhābhyāṃ nuḥ' (da.u.ya1.143) dānuḥ, bhānurityatra mā bhūt‌| `cikṣiyatuḥ, cikṣiyuḥ' iti| trayāṇāmapi kṣidhātūnāmanyatamasya rūpam‌| `niyau, niyaḥ, `luvau, luvaḥ' iti| atra `kvidantā dhātūtvaṃ na jahati' (vyā.pa.132) iti dhātutvaṃ veditavyam‌| tatra nayateḥ `satyūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip‌| lunātestu `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) ityanena| `iyaṅuvaṅbhyām‌' ityādi| guṇasyāvakāśaḥ--cetavyam‌, stotavyamityādi, iyaṅvaṅoḥ--cikṣiyatuḥ, cikṣiyuḥ, luluvatuḥ, luluvuriti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--cayanam‌, lavanamiti| vipratiṣedhena guṇa eva bhavati| vṛddheravakāśaḥ--sakhāyau, sakhāyaḥ, gāvau, gāva iti; iyaṅuvaṅoḥ sa eva; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--cāyakaḥ, lāvaka iti| vṛddhireva bhavati vipratiṣedhena| `iyaṅuvaṅprakaraṇe' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--`bahulaṃ chandasi' (6.4.75) ityādeḥ sūtrādbahulagrahaṇamanuvartate| tena tanvadīnāṃ chandasi vikalpeneyaṅuvaṅau bhaviṣyataḥ| `tanvam‌' iti| yatrovaṅ nāsti, tatrāmi parapūrvatvamapi nāsti; bahulavacanādeva| `vidhvam‌, viṣuvam‌' iti| sūdhātoḥ kvip‌; `upasargā sunoti' (8.3.65) ityādinā ṣatvam‌| `svargaḥ, suvargaḥ' iti| `su' ityetasmādargaśabde parata uvaṅādeśaḥ| yogaścāyaṃ yaṇādeśāpavādaḥ|| 78. abhyāsasyāsavarṇe| (6.4.78) `iyeṣa, uvoṣa' iti| `iṣu icchāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1351) [`iṣa'--dhā.pā.] `uṣa dāhe' (dhā.pā.696)--ābhyāṃ liṭ‌ ṇal‌| atra ca dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, `pugantalaghūpadhasya ca' (7.3.86) iti guṇaśca, tatra paratvādguṇaḥ--eṣa, oṣa iti sthite `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti sthānivadbhāvādiṣuṣityetayordvirvacanam‌, tata iyaṅvaṅau| nanu ca tayoḥ kartavyayoḥ `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāvātsavarṇatā nāsti? naitadasti; yo hyanādiṣṭhādacaḥ pūrvastasya vidhī kartavye sthānivadbhāvena bhavitavyam‌, ādiṣṭāccātrācaḥ pūrva eṣo'bhyāsaḥ, tat‌ kute'tra sthānivadbhāvaḥ| `iyarti' iti| `ṛ gato' (dhā.pā.1098) juhotyāditvācchapaḥ śluḥ, abhyāsasya `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityattvam‌, `artipiparttyośca' (7.4.77) itīttvam‌, tata iyaṅādeśaḥ| `īyatuḥ, īyuḥ' iti| `ūvatuḥ uvuḥ' iti| `asaṃyogālliṭ‌ kit‌' (1.2.5) iti| kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ, tena savarṇo'jna bhavati| `iyāja' iti| `uvāpa' iti| yajivapyoḥ `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām‌' (6.1.17) iti samprasāraṇam‌|| 79. striyāḥ| (6.4.79) `striyāḥ' iti| `āṇnadyāḥ' (7.3.112), `jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt‌' (4.1.63) iti nirdeśānnedaṃ strīpratyayānāṃ grahaṇam‌, nāpi stryarthavṛtteḥ śabdasyeti niścitya strīśabdasyaiva svarūpeṇa grahaṇamiti darśayitumāha--`strī ityetasya' ityādi| itikaraṇaḥ strīśabdasya svarūpapadārthatā darśayati| atha ṣaṣṭhībahuvacane kasmānna bhavatītyāha--`strīṇām‌' ityādi| paratvāt‌ ṣaṣṭhībahuvacane nuṭā bhavitavyam‌, tasmiṃśca satyajādiḥ paraḥ pratyayo na bhavatītīyaṅa na pravartate| atha kimarthaṃ pṛthagyogaḥ kriyate? na, `aci śnudhātustrībhruvām‌' ityeka eva yogaḥ kriyeteti? ata āha--`prathagyogakaraṇam‌' ityādi| `vā'mśasoḥ' (6.4.80) ityatra strīśabdasyaiva vikalpo yathā syāt‌, dhātubhruvormābhūdityevamarthaṃ pṛthagyogakaraṇam‌|| 80. vā'mśasoḥ| (6.4.80) 81. iṇo yaṇ‌| (6.4.81) atra pakṣadvayaṃ sambhāvyate--`iṇaḥ' iti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, dhātugrahaṇaṃ vā? tatra `erac‌' (3.3.56) iti, `orāvaśyake' (3.1.125) iti, `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityavamādibhyo nirdeśebhya eva nedaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇam‌| ataḥ pariśeṣyād‌dhātugrahaṇamevedaṃ vijñāyate| ṇakāroccāraṇamigiṅornivṛttyartham‌| ye tu `iṇvadikaḥ' (vā.167) iti sāmānyenātideśamicchanti, teṣāmiṅa eva nivṛttyartham‌| ikastvadhiyantīti bhavitavyameva yaṇā| atha `neṇaḥ' ityeva kasmānnoktam‌, iyaṅādeśe'ci pratiṣiddhe sati `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) iti yaṇ‌ bhaviṣyati? satyametat‌; uttarārthantu yaṇgrahaṇam‌| `yanti' ityadyudāharaṇeṣvadāditvācchapo luk‌| `āyan‌' iti| laṅ‌ jho'ntādeśe saṃyogāntalopaḥ, asiddhatvādajāditvādāṭ‌| atheha kasmānna bhavati--ayanam‌ āyaka iti? ata āha--`iyaṅādeśāpavādo'yam‌' iti| nanu yatheyaṅi prāpto'yamārabhyate, tathā guṇavṛddhyorapi, tat‌ kuta etallabhyate--ayamiyaṅo'pavādaḥ, na guṇavṛddhyorityāha--`madhye'pavādāḥ' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt‌ `madhye'pavādāḥ pūrvānvidhīnbādhante nottarān‌' (vyā.pa.10), tasmādiyaṅa eva pūrvasya vidherayamapavādaḥ, na tu parayorguṇavṛddhyoḥ yataścaitadevaṃ tena guṇavṛddhibhyāṃ tu paratvādbādhyate| asyāvakāśaḥ--yanti, yantviti| `guṇavṛddhyoḥ--cayanam‌, cāyaka iti; ayanam‌, āyaka ityatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti| paratvādyaṇaṃ bādhitvā guṇavṛddhī bhavataḥ|| 82. eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya| (6.4.82) `tena saṃyogo viśeṣyate' iti| nanu cānyapadārthe gūṇībhūtatvādupasarjanamatra saṃyogaḥ| nacopasarjanaṃ viśeṣaṇena sambandhamanubhavati| tathā hi śobhano rājapuruṣa ityukte puruṣasyeva pradhānasya śobhanatvena yogo gamyate, nopasarjanasya rājñaḥ; naitadasti; dhātorityanuvṛttisāmarthyādupasarjanamapi saṃyogaviśeṣaṇena sambandhamanubhaviṣyati, anyathā dhātvānuvṛttirapārthikā syāt‌| na tvivarṇaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇamihānuvṛttaṃ syāt‌? naitadasti; yadadhātorivarṇāntaṃ tasya hi bhavitavyameva yaṇādeśena `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityanenena| `ninyatu; ninyuḥ' iti| nayatorliṭ‌| iyaṅādeśe prāpte yaṇādeśaḥ| `unnyau unnyaḥ' iti| unnayatīti `satsūdviṣa' (3.1.61) ityādinā kvip‌| evaṃ `grāmaṇyau, grāmaṇyaḥ' ityatrāpi| `agragrāmābhyāñca' (vā?) iti ṇatvam‌| `asaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yadyeriti| nocyeta, tato'saṃyogapūrvaṅgasya viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt‌, evañca yavakriyau, yavakriya ityatrāpi syāt‌| bhavati hyetadaṃsayogapūrvamaṅgam‌, tasmāt‌ `eḥ' ityucyate| asaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamikārasya viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syādaṅgasya mā bhūdityevamartham‌| nanu ca `yvoḥ' iti prakṛtam‌, tatra yadyeriti nocyeta, tadovarṇāntasyāpi syāt‌; tataśca luluvatuḥ, luluvuriti na siddhyet‌| tasmāduvarṇāntasya mā bhūdityevamarthameriti syādityata āha--`luluvatuḥ, luluvuḥ' ityādi| ihairorityucyamāne, anenaivovarṇasyāpi siddhe sati `oḥ supi' (6.4.83) iti niyamarthaṃ syāt‌--uvarṇāntasya yadi bhavati tadā supyeva, nānyatreti| tataścāsmādeva niyamāt‌ lluluvatuḥ, luluvuriti siddhyatīti erityetaduvarṇāntanivṛttyarthaṃ nopapadyate| tasmāt‌ pūrvoktamevāsya prayojanaṃ yuktam‌| `yavakriyau yavakriyaḥ" iti| yavān‌ krīṇātīti `aneyabhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.187) iti kvip‌| atrekārasya dhātvavayavasaṃyogapūrvatvānna bhavati| `ihāpi na syāt‌' iti| yadi dhātunā saṃyogo na viśiṣyeteti śeṣaḥ| kvacidihāpi yathā syāditi pāṭhaḥ| tatra prakṛtatvādyaṇādeśa iti vijñāyate| yadi dhātunāsaṃyogo na viśiṣyeta, tadā dhātvavayavo'dhātvavayavo vā saṃyogaḥ pūrvo yasmādbhavati tadantasya na bhavatīti vijñāyate| tataśconnyau, unnya ityatrāpi na syāt‌; saṃyogapūrvatvādivarṇasya| dhātunā saṃyoge viśeṣite tu bhavati| na hyatrevarṇo dhātvavayavasaṃyogapūrvaḥ| tasmādihāpi yathā syādidi dhātunā saṃyogo viśiṣyatade| `gatikārakābhyām‌' ityādi| atha kathamidaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati? pūrvagrahaṇāt‌| iha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ na karttyam‌, `eranekāco'saṃyogāt‌' ityevocyeta| tatra, dhātvavayavasaṃyogādya ivarṇaḥ paro na bhavati tadantasyāṅgasya yaṇbhavati--ityevaṃ vijñāyamāne siddhyatyeveṣṭamiti kiṃ pūrvagrahaṇena? tat‌ kriyate pūrvācāryaiḥ--yasya vihito'yaṃ yaṇ‌ tasyaiva kartavyo nānyasyetyasyārthasya sūcanārtham‌| pūrvācāryāśca kvibantasya gatikārakapūrvasyaiva kṛtavantaḥ, nānyasyeti| tasmādihāpi gatikārakābhyāmanyapūrvasya na kriyate| atha vā `vāmśasoḥ' (6.4.80) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena `vā ityanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tena gatikārakābhyāmanyapūrvasya na bhaviṣyatīti| asmiṃśca vyākhyāne pūrvagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārthaṃ veditavyam‌| `paramaniyau' iti| `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāsaḥ| atra paramaśabdo na gatiḥ, na ca kārakamiti tat‌ pūrvasya na bhavati|| 83. oḥ supi| (6.4.83) `khalapvau' iti| khalaṃ punātīti `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip‌| `śatasvau' iti| atrāpi śataṃ sūtra iti `satsūdviṣa' (3.1.61) ityādinā kvip‌| `sakṛllvau' iti| `torli' (8.4.60) iti parasavarṇaḥ| `kaṭapruvau' iti| `prūṅ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.957), [`pruṅ‌'--dhā.pā.] `kvib‌ vacapracchyāyatastukaṭaprujuśrīṇāṃ dīrgho'samprasāraṇañca' iti kvip‌, dīrghatvañca| `oḥ' iti spaṣṭārtham‌| anukārāntanivṛtyarthantu na yujyate; `yvoḥ ityanuvṛtteḥ| ikārasya ca pūrveṇaiva siddho yaṇ‌--unnyau; grāmaṇyāviti|| 84. varṣābhvaśca| (6.4.84) `na bhūsudhiyoḥ' (6.4.85) iti pratiṣedhe prāpte tadapavādo'yamārabhyate| `varṣābhyau' iti| varṣāśabdādbhavateḥ kvip‌| `punarbhvaśceti vaktavyam‌' iti| `napunarbhvityetasyāci supi yaṇādeśo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--cakāro'tri kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena punarbhvityasyāpi bhaviṣyatīti| `kārāpūrvasyāpīṣyate' iti| so'pi tata eva cakārādbhavatīti veditavyam‌|| 85. na bhūsudhiyoḥ| (6.4.85) bhrūgrahaṇena tadantasya grahaṇam‌, na kevalasya| kevalasya hyekāco yaṇādeśaprāpatyasambhavādanarthakaṃ vacanaṃ syāt‌| uvaṅādeśapratiṣedhārthatvānnānarthakamiti cat‌? na; evaṃ hi `varṣābhvaśca' (6.4.84) iti yaṇādeśavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, yadi hyayaṃ yaṇādeśasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌--evaṃ hi tat‌ sarthakaṃ bhavati, nānyathā? naitadasti; uvaṅaparatiṣedhārthe'pi hyasmiṃstanniyamārthaṃ syāt‌| evaṃ tarhi yaṇo yatrānuvṛttistasyaivāyaṃ pratiṣedho yujyate| sa cānekāco vihita iti kevalasya grahaṇaṃ na prāpnotīti yuktamuktam‌--bhūgrahaṇena tadantasya grahaṇamiti| `pratibhuvau, pratibhuvaḥ' iti| `bhuvaḥ saṃjñāntarayoḥ' (3.2.179) iti kvip‌| `sudhiyau' iti| śobhanaṃ dhyāyatīti `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip‌, `dhyāyateḥ samprasāraṇañca' (vā.292) ityupasaṃkhyānāt‌ samprasāraṇam‌|| 86. chandasyubhayathā| (6.4.86) 87. huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke| (6.4.87) `yaṇ‌' (6.4.81) iti, `anekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya' (6.4.82), `oḥ' (6.4.83) iti cānuvarttete| nanu ca `hurityetat‌ śnupratayayāntañcāṅgamukārāntatāṃ na vyabhicaratyeva, tat‌ kimartham‌ `oḥ' itīhānuvartate? asaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamukārasya viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌; anyathā `huśnuvorevaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyeta| tataśca `takṣṇuvanti' ityādāveva pratiṣedho vijñāyeta| `rādhnuvanti' ityādau tu yaṇādeśaḥ syādeva| juhoterapi--`juhvati' ityatra saṃyogapūrvatvādyaṇādeśo na syāt‌| nanu ca dhātugrahaṇamanuvarttate, tatraivaṃ vijñāsyate--dhātvavayavaḥ saṃyogaḥ pūrvaḥ `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati' (vyā.pa.132) iti kṛtvā| anyathāpyavayavavacanaṃ pūrvaśabdamāśrityaivaṃ vijñāyate--dhātvavayavaḥ saṃyogo yasya pūrvo na bhavatīti? evamapi rādhnuvantītyatra yaṇādeśaḥ syāt‌, na hyatra śnupratyayasya dhātvavayavaḥ saṃyogapūrvaḥ| tasmāt‌ `o' ityetadanuvartanīyam‌, tadviśeṣaṇe huśnuvau| tatrāsaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇaṃ śnupratyayasyāvavasyokārasya viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam‌, juhotyavayavasya; tasyāvyabhicārāt‌| `śnupratyayāntasyāsaṃyogapūrvasya' iti| vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| śnupratyayāntasyāṅgasya yo'vayavo'saṃyogapūrva ukāraḥ, tasyetyarthaḥ| `anekācaḥ' ityetajjuhoteḥ śnupratyayāntasya samāndhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam‌| `sārvadhātuke' iti juhotyartham‌, na śnupratyayāntārtham‌; avyabhicārāt‌| `juhvati' iti| `adabhyastāt‌' (7.1.4) ityadādeśaḥ| `yoyuvati, roruvati' iti| `yu' `ru' ityetābhyāṃ yaṅa, tasya `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti luk‌, `guṇo yaṅlukoḥ' (7.4.82) ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ, pūrvavajjheravādeśaḥ| `idameva' ityādi| kathaṃ punaridaṃ jñāpakam? ityāha--chandasi' ityādi| yadi cchandasyeva yaṅluk‌ syāt‌, tadā `candasyubhayathā' (6.4.86) ityārdhadhātukatvādeva yoyuvati, roruvatītyatra na bhaviṣyatītyanarthakameva huśnugrahaṇaṃ syāt‌| yadā tu bhāṣāyāmapi yaṅlugasti, tadārdhadhātukatvābhāvādasati huśnugrahaṇe yoyuvatītyadau prāpnotīti tannivṛttyarthamupapadyate huśnugrahaṇam‌| tasmādetadeva jñāpayati--bhāṣāyamapi yaṅluṅastīti| tena bebhidīti, cecchidītītyādi bhāṣāyāmapyupapannaṃ bhavati| syādetat‌--yaṅlugāntādanyat‌ yaduvarṇāntamanekāc‌ saṃyogapūrvaṃ tannivṛttyarthametadbhaviṣyatīti? nedaṃ jñāpakamityata āha--`na ca' ityādi| nanu cedaṃ vidyate--yuvan‌ aruvanniti? naitadasti; yadyapyetadasaṃyogapūrvam‌, anekājna bhavati; aṭo'siddhatvāt‌|| 88. bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ| (6.4.88) `abhūvan‌' iti| `gātisthā' (2.4.77) ityādinā sico luk‌| jherantādeśe kṛte saṃyogāntalopaḥ| `abhūvam‌' iti| `tasthastha' (3.4.101) ityādinā mipo'mbhāvaḥ| `babhūva' ityādi| `bhavateraḥ' (7.4.73) ityabhyāsasyāttvam‌| `indhibhavatibhyāñca' (1.2.6) iti liṭaḥ kittvam‌, tena guṇabuddhī na bhavataḥ| kimarthaṃ punarbhaveteḥ parasya liṭaḥ kittvamārabhyate, yāvatā `ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati' (vyā.pa.16) iti kṛtayorapi guṇavṛddhyorvuk‌ prāpnotyakṛtayorapi, vuki kṛte'nigantatvādalaghūpadhatvādanajantatvācca nāsti guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptiḥ, tataḥ kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena nityatvād‌vuki kṛte guṇavṛddhyoḥ prāptireva nāstītyanarthakaṃ kittvam‌? naitadasti; vugapyanitya eva, na hyasau kṛtayorguṇavṛddhyoḥ prāpnoti, orityanuvṛtteruvarṇāntasya vukā bhavitavyamiti kṛtvā| atrobhayoranityayoḥ paratvāt‌ guṇavṛddhī syātām‌| tasmāt‌ kittvamārabdhavyam‌| kimarthaṃ punaḥ orityanuvartate? bobhāva, bobhaveti guṇavṛddhyoḥ kṛtayorvṛṅa mā bhūdityevamartham‌| nanu ca kittve satyatrāpi guṇavṛddhibhyāṃ na bhavitavyam‌? naitadasti; na hi yaṅalugantād‌ bhavateḥ parasya liṭaḥ kitvaṃ bhavati, `indhibhavatibhyāñca' (1.2.6) ityatra bhavatīti śtipā nirdeśāt‌|| 89. ūdupadhāyā gohaḥ| (6.4.89) `nigūhayati' iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.896), hetumāṇṇic‌| `nigūhakaḥ' iti| ṇvul‌| `sādhunigūhi' iti| `supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye' (3.2.78) iti ṇiniḥ| `nigūhaṃ nigūham‌' iti| `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul‌ ca' (3.4.22) iti ṇamul‌, `ābhīkṣṇye dve bhavataḥ' (vā.887) iti dvirvacanam‌| `nigūhaḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ‌| `alo'nyasya mā bhūt‌' iti| uttaratra ityabhiprāyaḥ| iha tvorityanuvartya vināpyupadhāgrahaṇena śakyata evāyamarthaḥ pratipādayitumityetadeva manasi kṛtvā paraṃ pṛṣṭavān‌--`upadhāgrahaṇaṃ kiṃ? iti; ittarārthañcopadhāgrahaṇaṃ kriyamāṇamatrāpyalo'ntyasya vidhiṃ nivarttayati| tena prayojanābhāvāt‌ orityetannānuvartate| atha kimartham‌ `gohaḥ' iti vikṛtanirdeśaḥ kriyate, na `guhaḥ' ityevocyeta, laghu hyevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati? ityāha--`goha iti vikṛtagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| ūttvasya viśiṣṭaviṣayo yathā syādityevamartham‌| `goha' iti vikṛtasya kṛtokārastha grahaṇamityarthaḥ| etadeva vyaktīkarttumāha--`yatra' ityādi| asya kaścidamumarthamācaṣṭe| etaduktaṃ bhavati--guṇe kṛte ūttvena bhavitavyamiti lakṣyate; etaccāyuktam‌; evaṃ hi vyākhyāyamāne `ayādeśapratiṣedhārthaṃ `nigūhya gataḥ' iti `kecidicchanti' ityuktvā yadvakṣyati--"uttvasyāsiddhatvāt‌ `lyapi laghūpūrvāt‌' (6.4.56) iti ṇerayādeśaḥ syāt‌" iti, tannopapadyate| yadi gūṇaṃ kṛtvokārasyottvaṃ vidhīyate, tataśca satyūkārasyāsiddhatvenaiva laghupūrvatvamupapadyate, okārapūrvatvāt‌; tat‌ kuta ūkārasyāsiddhatve'yādeśaprasaṅgaḥ? tasmādayamatrārthaḥ--yasmin‌ viṣaye guhergoha ityetadrūpaṃ sambhāvyate tatra yathā syāt‌| yatra pratyaye guṇaḥ sambhavati tasmin‌ kṛte'kṛta eva guṇe yathā syāt‌, anyatra mā bhūditi| tasmādvikṛtanirdeśasya viśiṣṭaviṣayopalakṣaṇārthatvāt‌ guṇaviṣaye sammukhībhūta evākṛta eva guṇa ūtvena bhavitavyam‌| evañca sati `ūttavasyāsiddhatvāt‌' ityādikaḥ prasaṅgagrantho yujyate, nānyathā| nanu ca guṇanimitte pratyaya utpanne paratvād‌ guṇenaiva bhavitavyam‌, tatkathamakṛta eva guṇa ūttvaṃ bhavet‌? kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt‌| taddhi kṛte guṇe prāpnotyakṛte'pi, vikṛtanirdeśasya viśiṣṭaviṣayopalakṣaṇārthatvāt‌| na tūttve kṛte guṇaḥ prāpnoti, alaghūpadhatvāt‌| tasmād‌ guṇāt‌ pūrvamūttvena nityatvādbhavitavyam‌| ata eva dīrghoccāraṇamarthavadbhavati, nānyathā| yadi guṇe kṛte satyayamādeśaḥ syāt‌, dīrghoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| āntaratamyādeva dīrghasya dīrgho bhaviṣyati| jñāpitaṃ hi `diva ut‌' (6.1.131) iti tapakaramena--`bhāvyamāno'pyukāraḥ savarṇān‌ gṛhṇati' (cāndra.pa.44) iti| yadanyat‌ prāpnoti tannivṛttyarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇamiti cet‌? syādetat‌--`ajugūhat‌' ityatra `ṇau caṅyapadhāyāḥ' (7.4.1) iti hrasvo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇamiti| kutaḥ punareṣa niyamo'tra hrasvatvena na bhavitavyamiti? na hīha kātyāyanasya bhāvyakārasya vā vacanamasti, nāpi śiṣṭaprayogaḥ, yata eṣa niścayaḥ syāt‌| `yathālakṣaṇamaprayukteṣu' iti cocyata| tasmāt‌ `ajūguhat‌' ityevaṃ bhavitavyam‌| yadi guṇe kṛte'yamādeśaḥ kriyeta, tataḥ kimaniṣṭaṃ syāt‌? dīrghoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| atrāpi dīrghoccāraṇaṃ vaicittryārthaṃ prakalpyeta? evamapi prakriyāgauravaṃ syāt‌| tasmāddīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyādakṛta eva guṇa ūttvena bhavitavyam‌| `nigūhya gataḥ' iti| ṇyantāt‌ katvā, prādisamāsaḥ| `samāso'nañpūrva' (7.1.37) ityādinā ktvo lyap‌| `tatra vyāśrayatvāt‌' ityādi| etenāyādeśapratiṣedhārthatāṃ vikṛtinirdeśasya pratyācaṣṭe| kathaṃ punarvyāśrayatvam‌? ityāha--`ṇāvūttvam‌' ityādi| `nigoḍhā' iti| tṛc‌| `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31), `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvam‌, `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti ṣṭuttvam‌, `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13)|| 90. doṣo ṇau| (6.4.90) `dīṣayati' iti| `duṣa vaikṛtye' (dhā.pā.1185)| atha kimartham‌ `doṣaḥ' iti vikṛtasya grahaṇam‌, na `duṣaḥ' ityevocyeta, viṣayāvadhāraṇārthamiti cet‌? na; ṇāviti sākṣādviṣayasya nirdeśādityata āha--`vikṛtagrahaṇam' ityādi pūrvasūtre hi `goṅaḥ' ityuktam‌, atra yadi `dūṣaḥ' ityevocyeta, prakramasyārambhasya bhedaḥ syāt‌, abhedaśceṣyate| atadastadarthaṃ vikṛtasya grahaṇam‌| kimarthaṃ punaḥ prakramasyābheda ityate? atyalpamidaṃ pṛcchyate, vaicittryasyāpi nāma prayojanaṃ praṣṭavyam‌| vaicittryasya hyayaṃ prakāraḥ--prakramābheda iti, kiṃ tadarthena praśnapariśrameṇa!|| 91. nā cittavirāge| (6.4.91) pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpo'yamārabhyate| `cittavirāge' iti| cittsyāprītatā| `cittaṃ doṣayati' iti| cittadamaprītaṃ vimukhaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| `cittavirāga iti kim‌? sādhanaṃ dūṣayata--atra pūrveṇa nityaṃ bhavati| ṇāvityeva--cittasya doṣaḥ| bhāve ghañ‌|| 92. mitāṃ hvasvaḥ| (6.4.92) `evamādinā' iti| ādiśabdena `janījṝṣkanasurañjo'mantāśca' (dhā.pā.817) ityevamādigrahaṇam‌| `ghaṭayati' vyathayati' janayati' iti| `ghaṭa ceṣṭāyām‌' (dhā.pā.763) `vyatha bhayacalanayoḥ (dhā.pā.764) `janau prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149)| nanu ca janeḥ `janivadhyośca' (7.3.35) iti vṛddhiḥ pratiṣidhyate, tadayuktamidamudāharaṇam‌, mitsajñāpyāpārthikā? naitadasti; ciṇkṛtorhi sa vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, tatra hi `āto yuk‌ ciṇkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) ityanuvarttate| `rajayita' iti| `rañjerṇau mṛgaramaṇa upasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.778)| ityanunāsikalope kṛte `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ| tasyānena hrasvaḥ| `śamayati' iti| śameramantatvānmittvam‌| asyāpi `nodāttopadeśa' (7.3.34) ityādinā vṛddhipratiṣedhaściṇkṛtoreva| `jñāpayati' iti| `jñā avabodhane' (dhā.pā.1507) ityasya kryādiparipaṭhitasya `māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu (dhā.pā.811) jñā, micca' iti mitsaṃjñā, `artihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puki kṛte hrasvaḥ| `kecidatra' ityādi| `kramu pādavikṣepe' (dhā.pā.437)ityasyāmantatvānmitsaṃjñā, tasya ca hrasvatve saṃkrāmayati, utkrāmayatīti na siddhyet‌| tasmādetatsiddhaye `vā cittavirāge' (6.4.91) ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvartayan‌ti| tasmiṃścānuvarttamāne sarvatra vikalpaḥ prasajyetetyatiprasaṅgaparihārārthaṃ `sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā' iti| vyācakṣate| atha `mitāmat‌' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam‌, laghu hyevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum‌, `veṣṭa veṣṭane' (dhā.pā.255) iti ghaṭādau paṭhyate, tatraivamucyamāne tasyāpkāraḥ prasajyet‌, `hrasvaḥ' ityucyamāne `eca ig‌ hrasvādeśe' (1.1.48) itīkāraḥ siddho bhavati|| 93. ciṇṇamulordīrgho'nyatarasyām‌| (6.4.93) `ṇau' iti varttate, ciṇṇamulau ca tadviśeṣaṇe| `aśami' iti| śamerṇyantālluṅa, `ciṇ‌ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (3.1.66) iti cleściṇ‌, `ciṇo luk‌' (6.4.104) iti taśabdasya luk‌ ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopaḥ| `śarmaśamamam‌, śāmaṃśāmam‌' iti| pūrvavaṇṇamuldivirvacane| `dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kim‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--hrasvasyaivānantarasaya prakṛtasya vikalpamātraṃ viṣeyam‌, evamapyabhīṣṭaṃ siddhyatyeva| tathā hi--yasmin‌ pakṣe hrasvo vidhīyate, tasminnaśamītyādi siddhyati| yasmiṃstu hrasvo na vidhīyate, tatra `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti dīrghe vṛddhisaṃjñake vihite tenaiva rūpeṇāvasthānāt‌ `aśāmi' ityādi siddhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| itarastu dīrghagrahaṇamantareṇa yanna siddhyati, taddarśayati--`śamayantaṃ prayuṅakte' ityādinā| śamerṇyantāt‌ punaḥ prayojakavivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyo ṇic‌, tatra pūrvasya ṇerlopaḥ, luṅa, ciṇ‌| pakṣe dīrghatvam‌| `aśami, aśāmi, śamaṃśamam‌, śāmaṃśāmam‌' iti| dvitīyaṇijantaṇṇamuli kṛte pakṣe dīrghatvam‌| `śaṃśamayateḥ' ityādi| atyarthaṃ śāmyatīti yaṅ‌, dvirvacanam‌, `nugato'nunāsikāntasya' (7.4.85) iti nuk‌--`śaṃśamya' iti| sthite hetumaṇṇic‌, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakārasya lopaḥ, `yasya halaḥ' (6.4.49) iti yakārasya, śaṃśamīti sthite yadā tataḥ paraściṇbhavati, tadā pakṣe dīrghatve kṛte'śaṃśamyaśaṃśāmīti bhavati| yada tu ṇamul‌ tadā śaṃśamaṃśaṃmam‌ śaṃśāmaṃśaṃśāmamiti, tatra yo'so ṇau ṇirlupyate, yaśca yaṅo'kārastayordīrdhagrahaṇe sati `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāvo na bhavati; `na padānta' (1.1.58) ityādinā pratiṣedhāt‌| tenāsati vyavadhāne dīrghaḥ siddho bhavati| syādetat‌--hrasvavikalpe vidhīyamāne yasmin‌ pakṣe hrasvo nāsti tasminpakṣe svarūpeṇaivāvasthito dīrghaḥ syāt‌? ityata āha--`hrasvavikalpe tu' ityādi| na hi hrasve vidhātavye kenacit‌ sthānivadbhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate| tatra hrasvavikalpe vidhīyamāne ṇerlopasya yaṅkārasya ca sthānivadbhāvaḥ syādeva| tataśca sthānivadbhāvādvikalpena hrasvatvaṃ na syāt‌| ciṇṇamṛlpare hi ṇau parato mitāmaṅgānāṃ hrasvatvaṃ vidheyam‌| yaścātra ṇiściṇṇamulparo na tatra midaṅgam; pūrvema ṇicā vyavadhānāt‌| yasmiṃśca ṇau midaṅgaṃ nāsau ciṇṇamulparaḥ; pareṇa ciṇā vyavadhānāt‌| tasmānnāyamasya yogasya viṣaya iti pākṣikaṃ hrasvatvamanena na syāt‌| pūrveṇaiva yogena nityaṃ syāt‌, tataśca dīrgho na syāt‌| `ṇiṇyante' ityādi| ṇeṇirantaḥ samīpo yasmin‌ sa ṇiṇyantaḥ| atha vā ṇeṇiḥ ṇiṇiḥ so'nto yasya sa ṇiṇyantaḥ| asmin‌ pakṣe'ntaśabdo'vayavavacanaḥ| `yaṅaṇyante tvasiddhireva' iti| yaṅṇyantaśabdasyāpi pūrvavad‌ dvidhā vyutpattiḥ| kasyāsiddhiḥ? prakṛtatvāddīrghasyeti veditavyam‌| evakāreṇaitaddarśayati--ṇiṇyante syādapi kenacit‌ prakāreṇa dīrghasya siddhiḥ, yaṅṇyante tvavasiddhireva| na kenacit‌ prakāreṇa siddhirityarthaḥ| katha punarṇiṇyante siddhirbhavati? ṇijāterāśrayaṇāt‌| ṇijātivivakṣāyāṃ hi yadyapi ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvaḥ, tathāpi nāstivyavadhānam‌; jāterekatvāt‌| na hi tatraiva tasyā vyavadhānamupapadyate| tena vyavadhānābhāvāṇṇiṇyante dīrghasya siddhiḥ| atha vaitadevakāreṇa darśayati--ṇiṇyante pūrvaṃ ṇicamāśritya `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhi vidhānādasti dīrghasya siddhiḥ, tasyāstu hrasvatvena nivṛttiḥ kriyate, na tu sarvathā nāstyeva| yaṅṇyante tu sarvathaiva dīrghasiddherabhāvaḥ, tatra vṛddherasambhavāditi| syādetat‌--viklape dīrghatve vidhīyamāne'pi naivā'tra dīrghaḥ sidhyati| `asiddhavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) iti ṇiyaṅorlopasyāsiddhatvādityata āha--`vyāśrayatvāt‌' ityādi| kathaṃ punardhyāśrayatvam‌? ityāha--`ṇau hi' ityādi| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌; śakyate hi `vā cittavirāge' (6.4.9) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāthena vāgrahaṇamanuvarttayitum‌|| 94. khaci hvasvaḥ| (6.4.94) `dviṣantapaḥ, parantapaḥ' iti| `dviṣatparayostāpe' (3.2.39) iti khac‌, `arurdviṣadajantasya' (6.3.67) iti mum‌| `purandaraḥ' iti| `pūḥsarvayordārisahoḥ' (3.2.41) iti khac‌, `vācaṃmapurandarau ca' (6.3.69) iti nipātanānmumāgamaḥ| hrasvagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌, śakyate `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena hrasvagrahaṇamanuvarttayitum‌|| 95. hlādo niṣṭhāyām‌| (6.4.95) `prahlannaḥ' iti| `hlādī sukhe ca' (dhā.pā.27) `radābhyām‌' (8.2.42) ityādinā nattvam‌| `prahlādayati' iti hetumaṇṇic‌|| 96. chāderghe'dvyupasargasya| (6.4.96) `uraśchadaḥ' iti| `chada apavāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1935), curādiṇic‌, `puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa' (3.3.118) iti ghaḥ| `urasaśchadaḥ' iti vigṛhya `kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate' (vā.86) iti samāsaḥ| nanu ca ṇilopasya `asiddhavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) ityasiddhatvāt‌ `acaḥ parasminpūrvavidhau' (1.2.57) iti sthānivadbhāvādvā hrasvabhāvinyajlakṣaṇopadhā na sambhavati, tat‌ kathaṃ hrasvattvaṃ pravarttate? ityāha--`ṇilopasya' ityādi| yadyatra ṇilopasyāsiddhatvaṃ sthānivadbhāvo vā syāt‌, tadā vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmādvacanasamarthyādubhayamapi na bhavati, tena hrasvabhāvinyupadhā bhavati| `adviprabhṛtyupasargasyeti vaktavyam‌' iti| nanu ca triprabhṛtayo yatra santi tatra dvāvapi staḥ, tataścādvyupasargasyetyevaṃ siddham‌? ityata āha--`uttarā hi' ityādi| yadyapi triprabhṛtiṣu dvāvapi staḥ, tathāpi na tāviha dviśabdenopāttau; yata uttarā hi saṃkhyā pūrvasaṃkhyāyā yaḥ kṛto vyapadeśastadabhidhānaṃ nivarttayati| kathaṃ jñāyate? ityāha--`na hi' ityādi| yadyuttarā saṃkhyā pūrvasaṃkhyākṛtavyapadeśaṃ na nivarttayet‌, tadā triputro'pi loke dviputra ityabhidhīyeta, na cābhidhīyate| tathā hi `dviputraḥ ānīyatām‌' ityukte naiva triputra ānīyate, api tu yasyaṃ dvādeva putrau sa eva| adviprabhṛtītyādeśca vākyasyāyamarthaḥ--addhiprabhṛtyupasargasya chāderhrasvatvaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--dviśabdo'trānekopalakṣaṇārtham‌, dvyupasargasyānekopasargasyeti yāvat‌| advyupasargasyete ca prasajyapratiṣedho'yam‌| tenāyamaryo bhavati--chāderaṅgasyānekopasargasya ghapratyaye parata upadhāhrasvo na bhavatīti| kena punaḥ prāptasya hrasvasyānena pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate? etasmādeva pratiṣedhādvidhāyakaṃ vākyamanumīyate| yogavibhāgādvā--`chāderghe' iti| yadi ca dviśabdo'trānekopalakṣaṇārthaḥ, yogavibhāgaścābhyupeyetaivaṃ tadā paryudāse'pyadoṣaḥ| katham‌? dvyupasargādanekopasargādanyo'dvyupasargaḥ-ekopasargaḥ, tasya hrasvattvaṃ bhavati| kimarthamidam‌, na `chāderghe' ityanenaiva siddham‌? siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ--ekopasargasyaiva bhavati, nānyasyeti| yadyedam‌ `uraśchadaḥ' ityatra na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, evaṃ hi yogavibhāgo'narthakaḥ syāt‌| tulyajātīyāpekṣatvānniyamasya, sopasargasya niyamaḥ kriyamāmaḥ sopasargasyeva hrasvatvaṃ nivarttayati, nānupasargasya| tena `uttaraśchadaḥ' ityatra pravartata eva|| 97. ismantrankviṣu ca| (6.4.97) cakāraścāderanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `chadiḥ' iti| `aciśucihusṛpicchādicchadibhya isiḥ' (da.u.9.30) itīsipratyayaḥ| `chadma' iti| `sarvadhātubhyo manin‌' (paṃ.u.4.156) iti min‌| `chattram‌' iti| `sarvadhātubhyaḥ ṣṭran‌' (da.u.8.79) iti ṣṭran‌| yogavibhāgo'nekopasargasyāpi yathā syāt‌--samupāticchadiriti|| 98. gamahanajanakhanaghasāṃ lopaḥ kṅityanaṅi| (6.4.98) `anaṅi' iti ajādāvayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, tena tattulye'jādāveva pratyaye kāryaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha--`ajādau pratyaye' iti| `jadhnatuḥ, jadhnuḥ' iti| `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti kutvam| `jajñatuḥ, jajñuḥ' iti| `jana janane' (dhā.pā.1105), parasmaipadī jauhotyādikaḥ, `stoḥ ścunā ścaḥ' (8.4.40) iti ścutvam‌| `jajñe' iti| `jani prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149) ātmanepadī divādiḥ, `liṭastajhayoreśirec‌' (3.4.81) ityeś‌| `jakṣatuḥ' iti| adeḥ `liṭyanyatarasyām‌' (2.4.40) iti ghaslādeśaḥ, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti ghakārasya kakāraḥ, `śāsivasidhasīnāñca' (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam‌| atha vā--`gharalṛ adane' (dhā.pā.715) ityasyaitadrūpam‌| `akṣan‌' iti| luṅ‌, `luṅsanorghaslṛ' (2.4.37) iti ghaslādeśaḥ, `mantre ghasahvara' (2.4.80) ityādinā lerluk‌, jherantādeśaḥ, saṃyogāntalopaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat‌| `adhasat‌, agamat‌' iti| puṣādisūtreṇa (3.1.55) aṅa|| 99. tanipatyoścandasi| (6.4.99) `vitatnire' iti| atra yadyupadhālopasyāsiddhatvam‌ tathāpi lopavidhānasāmarthyāt‌ `ata ekahalmadhye' (6.4.120) ityādinaitvābhyāsalopau na bhavataḥ| `paptimā' iti| liṭ‌ krādiniyamādiṭ‌|| 100. ghasibhasorhali ca| (6.4.100) `dhatvaṃ takārasya' iti| `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti| `jaśtvaṃ dhakārasya' iti| `jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti| `samāse kṛte' iti| `pūrvāparaprathama' (2.1.58) ityādinā| `samānasya sabhāvaḥ' iti| `samānasya cchandasi' (6.3.84) ityādinā| yadi dvirvacanātpūrvamupadhālopaḥ kriyate, tadaikāctvābhāvāddvirvacanaṃ na prāpnoti? ityat āha--`chāndasatvāt‌' ityādi| `bandhām‌' iti| chāndasametat‌| tatra `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.39) iti vacanādbahulaṃ viṣayo bhavanti| tena yadyapi paratvānnityantāvacca dvirvacanāt‌ pūrvamupadhālopaḥ prapnoti, tathāpi sa tathā na kriyate| dvirvacanāt‌ pūrvaṃ na kriyata iti bhāvaḥ| `bapsati' iti| bhaseḥ parasya jheradādeśaḥ, śapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌, abhyāsakāryam‌, upadhālope kṛte bhakārasya cartvam‌--pakāraḥ| `basti' iti| tipi rūpam‌|| 101. hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ| (6.4.101) `halādeḥ' iti| kutaḥ punarhalgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtaṃ yena hiśabdo viśiṣyate? anantarasūtrāditi cet‌? na; taddhi saptamīnirdiṣṭam‌, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ| `hujhalbhyaḥ' ityeṣā pañcamī `hali' (6.4.100) ityetasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati| `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti vacanādityadoṣaḥ| `bhindhi' iti| `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ| `krīṇīhi' iti| `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti hirādeśaḥ `ī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) ittīttvam‌| `juhutām‌' iti| loṭ‌, tasastām‌| `rudihi, svapihi' iti| adāditvācchapo luk‌, `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) itīṭ‌| atheha kasmānna bhavati--`juhutāt‌ tvam‌' iti? āha--`iha' ityādi| dhibhāvasyāvakāśo'nāśiṣi--jhuhudhīti| tātaṅo'vakāśaḥ--jīvatāt‌ tvamiti; āśiṣi loṭi ubhayaprāptau paratvāttātaṅeva bhavati| atha kṛte'pi tasmiṃstasya sthānivadbhāvāt‌ punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānād‌dhibhāvaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| yadyevam‌, bhindhaki, chindhakītyatra paratvād‌dhibhāve satyanantaroktādeva hetorakajna syāt‌? ityata āha--`bhindhaki, chindaki' ityādi| vyaktau hi padārthe `sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadbādhitaṃ tadbādhitameva' (vyā.pa.40) ityetat‌ pravarttate| jātau ca `punaḥprasaṅgavijñānāt‌ siddham‌' (vyā.pa.41) iti `vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam‌' (1.4.2) ityatra pratipāditam‌| pāṇinestūbhayaṃ matam‌, lakṣyānurodhātkvacit‌ kiñcidāśrīyate| tatra tātaṅavidhau vyaktipadārthasyāśrayaṇāt‌ `sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yad‌ bādhitaṃ tadbādhitameva' ityasyā upasthānam‌; akajvidhau tu jāteḥ padārthasyāśrayaṇāt‌ `punaḥprasaṅgavijñānātsiddham‌' ityasyāḥ| `bhindhaki' iti| `avyayasarvanāmnām‌' (5.3.71) ityādinākac‌| tatra `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) ityanuvarttate|| 102. śruśṛṇupṝkṛvṛbhyaśchandasi| (6.4.102) `śruṇudhī' iti| `śruvaḥ śṛ ca' (3.1.74) iti śnupratyayaḥ, śrṛbhāvaśca| `pūrddhi' iti| `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1086), `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuttvam‌, `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ| `uparuṇaskṛdhi' iti| uru asmākaṃ kṛdhīti sthite `bahuvacanasya vasnasau' (8.1.21) ityasmado nasādeśaḥ, `naśca dhātusthoruṣubhyaḥ' (8.4.27) iti ṇatvam‌, sakārasya rutvam‌, visarjanīyaḥ| tasya `ataḥ kṛkami' (8.3.46) ityādinā satvam‌| `apāvṛdhi' iti| vṛṅo vṛño vā rūpam‌| vṛṅo'pi hi `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) iti cchandasi parasmaipadaṃ bhavatyeva| atha śrṛṇudhītyatra `utaśca pratyayādasaṃyogapūrvāt‌' (6.4.106) ityanena luk‌ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`śrṛṇudhītyatra' ityādi| yadyatra luk‌ syāt‌ dhimāvasyānarthasyaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti dīrghatvamapāvṛdhītyatra| nanu ca śrudhatyatra `śruvaḥ śrṛ ca' (3.1.74) iti śṛbhāvena inupratyayena ca bhavitavyam‌, pūrdhītyatra kryāditvāt‌ śnāpratyayena, uruṇaskṛdhītyatra `tanādikṛñbhyaḥ uḥ' (3.1.79) ityupratyayena; apāvṛdhītyatatra yadi vṛṅa tadā kryāditvāt‌ śnāpratyayena, atha vṛñ‌ tadā svāditvāt‌ śnupratyayena; evañcaitāni rūpāṇi na sidhyanti? ityata āha--`ato'nyatara' ityādi| śrṛṇudhītyetasmādudāharaṇādanyeṣūdāharaṇeṣu `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) iti śap‌, tasyāpi `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.73) iti luk‌|| 103. aṅitaśca| (6.4.103) `vā chandasi' ityādi| `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) ityapitaḥ sārvadhātukasya ṅittvaṃ vidhīyate, chandasi viṣaye `vā chandasi' (3.4.88) ityanena heryadapittvaṃ tadvikalpyate| tena pakṣe tasya ṅittvaṃ na bhavati| atha rārandhīti kathaṃ parasmaipadam‌, yāvatā ramirayamātmatmanepadī? kathaṃ vātra śapaḥ śravaṇaṃ na bhavati? kathañcābyāsasya dīrghatvam‌, kathañca `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinā makāralopo na bhavati? ityāha--`rārandhi' ityādi| `śapaḥ śluḥ' iti bruvāmena `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanamityuktaṃ bhavati| makāralopābhāvastvaṅittvāde siddha iti nāsau yatnasādhya ityabhiprāyaḥ| `yameḥ śapaḥ' iti| `bahulaṃ chandasi (2.4.73) ityanena| `yoteḥ śapaḥ śluḥ' iti| `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.76) ityanena|| 104. ciṇo luk‌| (6.4.104) `ciṇa uttarasya pratyayasya' iti| atha pratyayasyaitatkuto labhyate? `aṅgasya'(8.4.1) ityanena pratyayasya sannidhāpitattvāt‌| yadi ciṇa uttarasaya pratyayasya lugbhavati, akāritarām‌, akāritamāmityatra taraptamamorluk‌ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`akāritarām‌' ityādi| yo'sau taśabdasya luk‌, tasya taraptamaporluki karttavye `asiddhavadatrābhāt‌' (6.4.22) ityasiddhatvam‌| atastaśabdena vyavadānācciṇo'nantarau taraptamapau na bhavata iti tayorlugna bhavati| nanu cānyasyānyāsmennasiddhavacanādekasya tatraivāsiddhatvaṃ nopapadyate? ityata āha--`ciṇo lugityetat‌' ityādi| `ciṇo luk‌' ityabhedenāpi śrutamidaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ viṣayasya lakṣyasya bhedādbhidyate, vyaktau padarthe prativyakti lakṣaṇaṃ bhidyata iti kṛtvā, tena bhede satyupapadyata evāsiddhatvam‌| akāri, ahārīti sthite atiśayavivakṣāyāṃ taraptamapau `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) ityanena, tadantāt `kimettiṅavyayaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe' (5.4.11) ityāmau kṛte, akāritamām‌, akāritamāmiti bhavati|| 105. ato heḥ| (6.4.105) `gaccha' iti| gamerloṭ‌, `iṣugamiyamāṃ chaḥ' (7.3.77) iti chatvam‌| `dhāva' iti| `dhāvu gatiśuddhyoḥ' (dhā.pā.601) atha vā sartteḥ `pāghrā' (7.3.78) ityādinā dhāvādeśaḥ| `yuhi, ruhi' iti| adāvitvācchapo luk‌| `lunohi, punīha' iti| `pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ' (7.3.80) iti hrasvatvam‌, `ī halyadhoḥ' (6.4.113) itīttvam‌| nanu cettve kṛte satyanakārāntatvānna bhaviṣyati, tataḥ kimetannivṛttyarthena taparakaraṇena? ityata āha--`ītvasaya' ityādi| asiddhatvāntu pūrvavat‌|| 106. utaśca pratyayādasaṃyogapūrvāt‌| (6.4.106) `ukāro yo'saṃyogapūrvaḥ' iti| avidyamānaḥ saṃyogaḥ pūrvo yasmāsta tathoktaḥ| etenāsaṃyogapūrvagrahaṇamakāraviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| sa evaṃ vidha ukāraḥ pratyayasya viseṣaṇam‌, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--`tadantāt‌' ityādi| kimarthaṃ punastadantadidhirabyupagamyate? `sun‌ cinvityatra yathā syāt astvetat‌ prayojanam‌, ayaṃ tu doṣaḥ--tanu, kurvityatra na prāpnoti, atra hyukāra eva pratyayaḥ na tadantaḥ? atrāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena tadantattvaṃ pratyayasyāstītyadoṣaḥ| `kuru' iti| dhātorguṇe raparatve ca kṛte `ata utsārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityuttvam‌| `taruṇuhi' iti| `tūnūkaraṇe takṣaḥ' (3.1.76) iti śnuḥ| `cchandovāvacanam‌' iti| abhidhāne'bhidheyopacārādvārtho vikalpo vāśabdena vivakṣitaḥ| ucyate vyākhyāyate'neneti vacanam‌, vārthasya vacanaṃ vāvacanam‌, chandasi vāvacanaṃ chandovāvacanamiti `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| `chandasi veti vaktavyam‌' iti| chandasi viṣaye vikalpenāyaṃ vidhirbhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--uttarasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣaḥ, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena chandasi viṣaye vikalpenāyaṃ vidhirbhavatīti| `dhinuhi, kṛṇuhi' iti| `hivi divi, dhivi, prīṇanārthāḥ' (dhā.pā.591-593), `kṛvi hiṃsākaraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.598) iditvānnum‌, `dhinvikṛṇvyora ca' (3.1.80) ityupratyayaḥ, akāraścāntādeśaḥ, tasya `ato lopaḥ (6.4.48) iti lopaḥ|| 107. lopaścāsyānyatarasyāṃ mvoḥ| (6.4.107) `yo'yamukāro'saṃyogapūrvaḥ' iti| etenāsyetyanena prakṛta ukāraḥ pratyavamṛśyata iti darśayati| nanu ca `ataḥ' (6.4.106) ityanuvṛtterukārasyaiva lopo vijñāsyate, tatkim‌ `asya' ityanena? ṣaṣṭhīpraklṛptyarthamasyetyetaditi cet‌? na; `mvoḥ' ityeṣaiva hi saptamyakṛtārthā `utaḥ' ityasyāḥ pañcamyāḥ pūrvayoge kṛtārthāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati, `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti vacanāt‌| syādetat‌| yadi `mvoḥ' ityeṣā saptamī vijñāyate, etadeva tu na vijñāyate--kimiyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī uta saptamīti? tasmāt‌ ṣaṣṭhīpraklṛpyarthamasyetyuktam‌| `lugittyanuvarttamāne' ityādi| yadi prakṛta eva luk‌ kriyate tadā sarvasyaiva pratyayasya luk‌ syāt‌, nāntyasya; yataḥ pratyayādarśanasya lugityeṣā saṃjñā vihitā, na tu pratyayāvayavasyādarśanasya| sarvasya tu luki kṛte `sunvaḥ sunmaḥ' iti na sidhyati? lopagrahaṇādadoṣaḥ. tatra hyukāramātrasya lopaḥ `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti vacanāt‌| tasmādantyasya lopārthaṃ lopagrahaṇam‌| kiñca kurvaḥ kumaṃ ityatra guṇo luki sati na syāt‌; `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇāpratiṣedhāt‌| lope tu sati bhavati| tato guṇārthamapi lopagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 108. nityaṃ karoteḥ| (6.4.108) `karoterukārapratyayasya' iti| nanu cakāreṇa pūrvasūtra ukāro'nukṛṣṭaḥ, `cānukṛṣṭañcottaratra nānuvarttate' (vyā.pa.76) tat‌ kathamukārasya lopo labhyate? naivam‌; pūrvasūtre hyukārasya sannidhānamasyetyanenaiva labhyata iti tatra tasya cakāreṇa yā'nukṛṣṭiḥ saitadarthaiva veditavyā| `ukāralopasya' ityādinā kurvaḥ kumaṃ ityatra sopapattikāṃ dīrghaprāptiṃ darśayati, `na bhakurchurām‌' (8.2.79) ityanena ca tatpratiṣedham‌| nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌| ārambhasāmarthyādeva hi nityo vidhirbhaviṣyati|| 109. ye ca| (6.4.109) `cakāro lopasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 110. ata utsārvadhātuke| (6.4.110) `ukārapratyayāntasya' ityādi| ukāraḥ pratyayo'nto yasya sa tathoktaḥ| ukārapratyayāntaśca karotiḥ sārvadhātukattvaṃ na vyabhicarati, anenābhiprāyeṇāha--`sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ kim‌' iti? `bhūtapūrve'pi' ityādi| asati sārvadhātukagrahaṇe karoterukārapratyayāntasya kṅiti pratyaye parata uttvamucyamānaṃ yatra kṅit‌ sārvadhātukaṃ parabhūtaṃ tatraiva syāt‌--kurutaḥ, kurvantītyādiṣu; kurvitra herluki kṛte kṅitpratyayasyābhāvāt‌ `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhāttu na syāt‌| tasmādbhūtapūrve'pi sārvadhātuke yathā syādityevamarthaṃ sārvadhātukgrahaṇ‌| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā yadyapi bhāvyamāna ukāraḥ savarṇānāṃ grāhako bhavati, tathāpyāntaratamyānmātrikastha sthāne mātrika eva bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--taparakaraṇam‌' ityādi| asati hi taparakaraṇa ukārapratyayamāśritya `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti guṇe kṛte raparatve ca yaduttvaṃ tasyokārasya `pugantalaghūpadhasya ca' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate--hrasvasyaiva śravuṇaṃ yathā syāt‌, lakṣamāntareṇa yo dīrghaḥ| prāpnoti sa mā bhūditi|| 111. śnasorallopaḥ| (6.4.111) `rundhaḥ' iti| `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti takārasya dhakāraḥ| `staḥ' iti| adāditvācchapo luk‌| atha śnasoriti ko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ, yāvatā `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101) iti dīrghatve kṛte `śnasoḥ' iti nirdeśena bhavitavyam‌? ityāha--`śnasorityākārasya pararūpatvam‌' ityādi| atra taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, āstām‌, āsannityatrāḍāgamasya mā bhūditi cet‌? naitadasti; iha hi laṅi kṛte lāvasthāyāmāḍāgamātpūrvamantaraṅgatvāllādeśaḥ kriyate| tatra kṛte vikaraṇaḥ kṛtākṛtaprasāṅgitvādāḍāgamaṃ bādhate| āḍāgamasya tvaśabdāntaraprāpteranityatvam‌| tathā hi kṛte vikaraṇe vikaraṇāntasyāṅgasya tena bhavitavyam‌, akṛte dhātumātrasya| kṛte vikaraṇe yadyapyāḍāgamākāralopayordvayorapi kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvena nityatvam‌, tathāpi paratvādakāralopaḥ kriyate, tasmin‌ kṛte tasyāsiddhatvādāṭ‌, tasyāsiddhatvādeva ca lopo na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ taparakaraṇena? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--`ābācchāstrīyamasiddhatvamanityam‌' iti| tena `vugyuṭāvuvaṅayaṇoḥ siddhau bhavataḥ' ityetadvaktavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ bhavati|| 112. śnābhyāstayorātaḥ| (6.4.112) `lunate' iti| `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityādeśaḥ| `lunatām‌' iti| loṭ‌ `āmetaḥ' (3.4.90)| `alunata' iti| laṅa| mimate' iti| `māṅa māne' (dhā.pā.1088) [`māne śebde ca'--dhā.pā.] abhyāsasya `bhṛñāmit‌' (7.4.76) itīttvam‌| evaṃ `sañjihate' ityatrāpi `ohāṅa gatau' (dhā.pā.1089) ityasya| `bibhrati' iti| pūrvāditvam‌| `alunāt‌' iti| nanu cāsati kṅitītyasminnītvenātra bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kuto lopasya prasaṅga? naitadasti; īttvamapi hi kṅitītyanuvartyam‌, tatra yadi `kṅiti' iti nānuvarttate tadā syādeva lopaḥ| nanvādgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, `śnābhyastayorataḥ' ityevocyeta, evaṃ hyekamātrayā laghu bhavati? ityata āha--`ādgrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham‌| jagarteḥ `jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ‌' (6.1.6) ityabhyastasaṃjñāyāmapi ṛkāralopo na bhavati--jāgratīti| etacca śnetyakārāntena sāhacaryādabhyastasyākārāntasyaiva grahaṇāllabhyate|| 113. ī halyaghoḥ| (6.4.113) `lunītaḥ, punītaḥ; `lunītha, punītha' iti| tasthasau| `mimīte' iti| ātmanepadaikavacanam‌| `mimīṣe' iti| `thāsaḥ sa' (3.4.80)| `mimīdhvam‌' iti| dhvam‌| `lunanti, punanti' iti| jhipratyayaḥ| nanu ca yadyapyajādāvapīttvaṃ syāt‌, lopo'navakāśaḥ syāt‌ ato'navakāśatvāllopa īttvaṃ bādhidhyate, tat‌ kiṃ `hali' ityanena? naitadasti; asati halgrahaṇe vacanādubhayaṃ syāt‌| ghusaṃjñakeṣvāllopaḥ prasajyeta| tasmāt‌ `hali' iti vaktavyam‌| `dattḥ' iti| `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti carttvam‌| `dhattaḥ' iti| dhāño dvirvacane kṛte `abhyāse carcca' (8.4.54) ityabhyāsasya jaśatve ca `dadhastathośca' (8.2.38) iti bhaṣbhāvena dakārasya dhakāraḥ, dhātostvākāralope kṛte jaśtvacarttve|| 114. iddaridrasya| (6.4.114) `daridrati' iti| `jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ‌' (6.1.6) ityabhyastasaṃjñā, tenābhyastalakṣaṇa ākāralopo bhavati| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityato maṇḍūkalputinyāyena lopagrahaṇamanuvarttya sārvadhātuke, hali, kṅitatyetān‌ viśeṣān‌ nivarttya daridrāteḥ sāmānyenettvalopau vidhātavyau| na caivaṃ sati tau saṅkarema prasajataḥ, yasmādvakṣyamāṇamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣabhūtam‌| sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena yatraiveṣyate yat‌ tat‌ tatraiva bhaviṣyati, nānyatreti| `siddhaśca pratyayavidhau' iti| tathāsau karttavyau yathā pratyayavidhau-pratyayavidhānakāle, siddhaḥ-niṣpanno bhavati| etaduktaṃ bhavati--ārdhadhātuke pratyaye viṣayabhūte'nutpanne eva lopaḥ karttavya iti| evaṃ hyasau pratyayavidhau siddho bhavati, nānyathā| `siddhaśca pratyayavidhau' ityasyopādāne yat‌ phalaṃ tad‌ `ākārāntalakṣaṇaḥ' ityādinā darśayati| yadyārdhadhātuka utpanne sati lopaḥ kriyate, tadā `śyādvyadhāsru' (3.1.141) iti sūtreṇa ṇapratyayaḥ syāt‌; daridrāterākārāntatvāt‌| tataśca `āto yuk‌ cimkṛtoḥ' (7.3.33) iti yuki kṛte, `daridrāya' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| `siddhaśca pratyayavidhau' ityucyamāne tu prāgeva pratyayotpatterlopaḥ, tasmin‌ syanākārāntatvāt‌ pacādyajeva bhavati| tena `daridraḥ' itīṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| `na daridrāyake lopaḥ' ityādinā ślokena yatrārddhadhātuke lopo neṣyate yatra vikalpena ceṣyate kaiścit‌, taddarśayati| `daridrāyake' ityatra ṇvulante śabde sisādhayiṣite lopo neṣyate| daridrātīti daridrāyāka iti| pūrvavadyuk‌| `daridrāṇe' iti| atrāpi lyuṅate lopo neṣyate| `didaridrāsatītyeke' iti| sani kṛte dvirvacanam‌, abhyāsakāryam‌| `didaridriṣatīti vā' iti| `sanīvantardha' (7.2.49) ityatra `tanipatidaridrāṇām‌' ityupasaṃkhyānādvikalpeneṭ‌| `adyatanyām‌' iti| luṅītyarthaḥ `luṅo'dyatani' iti pūrvācāryasaṃjñā| `adaridrāsaut‌' iti| `yamaramanamātāṃ sak‌ ca' (7.2.73) iti sagiṭau, `asti sico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ‌, `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| nanu ca `āto dhātoḥ' (6.4.140) ityākārālope kṛte daridra iti nirdeśena bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ daridrasyeti nirdeśa ityāha--`daridrasyeti nirdeśaḥ' ityādi| `chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti' ityataḥ `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam‌' (6.3.63) iti bahulavacanācchāndasamiha hrasvatvam‌| tapakaraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌| bhāvyamānatayā savarṇāgrahaṇādeva dīrgho na bhaviṣyati|| 115. bhiyo'nyatarasyām‌| (6.4.115) `halādau sārvadhātuke kṅiti parataḥ' iti| yadyapyete viśeṣāḥ pūrvasminnivartitāḥ, tathāpīha maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttanta ityabhiprāyaḥ| `bibhītaḥ' iti| `ñi bhī bhaye' (dā.pā.1084) juhotyāditvācchapaḥ śluḥ| halādāvityeva--bibhyatīti| ittvavidhānasāmarthyādeva `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) iti yaṇādeśo na syāt‌| sārvadhātuka ityeva--bhītaḥ, bhītavān‌| kṅitīti kim‌? bibheti|| 116. jahāteśca| (6.4.116) īttvāpavāda ittvamārabhyate; anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| pakṣe tadapi bhavatyeva| sārvadhātuka ityeva--hīnaḥ, hīnavān‌| iha kecit‌ `sārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityasyānuvṛttiṃ pratyācakṣate| katham‌? `hali parata īttvettve prāpnutaḥ, dvirvacanaṃ ca; tatra yadi paratvādīttvettve syātāṃ tataścevarṇantatābhyāsasya syāt‌; tasmādabhyasta grahaṇamanuvarttanīyam‌, tasmiṃścānuvarttamāne sārvadhātukānuvṛttirapārthikā' iti| etaccāyuktam‌; antaraṅgatvāt‌| `dvirvacanenaiva prāgīttvettvābhyāṃ bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kuto'bhyāsasyevarṇāntatāprasaṅgaḥ! antaraṅgatvantu dvirvacanasyālpāpekṣatvāt‌| taddhi ślumātramapekṣate| ittvettvayośca bahvapekṣatvādbahiraṅgatā, bahavapekṣā ca; tayoḥ punaraṅgasya halādau kṅiti sārvadhātuke vidhānāt‌| jahāteriti nirdeśāt‌ jihīta ityatadra jihāterna bhavati| `pṛthagyogakaraṇamuttarārtham‌' iti| `āca hau' (6.4.117) ityeṣa vidhirjahātereva yatā syāt‌, bibhetermā bhūditi|| 117. ā ca hau| (6.4.117) cakāra ittvānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇayoranukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 118. lopo yi| (6.4.118) 119. dhvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca| (6.4.119) `abhyāsalopaśca' iti dhusaṃjñakārthamabhyāsalopagrahaṇam‌; na tvastyartham‌; asterabhyāsambhavāt‌| `dehi cehi' iti| dāñ‌dhāñorete rūpe| anyeṣāntu ghusaṃjñakānāmudāharaṇaṃ na sambhavati; vikaraṇena hervyavadhānāt‌| asambhavācca yathāyogam‌| tatra `do' ityetasya śyanā hiśabdo vyavadhīyate, daṇo dheṭastu śāpā, deṅaḥ punarātmanepaditvāda herasambhavaḥ| `edhi' iti| sakārasyaittve kṛte tasyāsiddhatvāt‌ `hujhalabhyo herdhiḥ (6.4.101) iti dhibhāvaḥ| nanu ca `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityalāmantyasya lopena bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ sarvasyābhyāsasya lopo bhavati? ityata āha--`śidayam‌' ityādi| `lopaśca' ityatra dvau śakārau nirdiṣṭau| tatraiko lopasya samabandhī, dvitīyastu vibhakteḥ| yaśca lopasya sambandhī tasyetsaṃjñā pratijñāyata iti śidayaṃ lopo bhavati| tena sarvasyābhyāsastha lopo bhavati| `ā ca hau' (6.4.117) ityato hograhaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena śakyate'nuvarttayutum‌| tatranyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛttau `anyatarasyām‌' ityetasyāpyanuvṛttirityāśaṅkā syāt‌, atastannivṛttyarthaṃ `hau' ityuktam‌| cakārasya sanniyogarthatvāllopo bhavatyettvañca|| 120. ata ekahal‌madye'nādeśāderliṭi| (6.4.120) `ekahalmadhye' iti| ekaśabdo'yamasahāyavācī| ekaśca ekaśca ekau, ekau ca tau halau cetyekahalau, ekahalormadhya iti dvivacanāntasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| dvyoreva hi halormadhyaṃ sambhavati, naikasya| atra yadi liṭyādaśo na viśiṣyate tato nematuḥ, nemu; sehe sehāte, sehira ityatra na syāt‌| astihyatrāpyaṅgasyādeśa ādirityetaccetasi kṛtvā liṭyādeśaṃ viśeṣayitumāha--`liṭi parataḥ' ityādi| liṭi parabhūte ya ādeśo vidhīyate sa ādiyaṃsyāṅgasya nāstītyarthaḥ| `tasya' iti| tasyaivaṃvidhasyāṅgasyetyarthaḥ| tasyeti cāṅgasya yo'kāra ityanena sambandhaḥ| avayavaṣaṣṭhī ceyam‌, tasyaivaṃvidhasyāṅgasya yo|kāro'vayavastasyetyarthaḥ| `eka halmadhye' ityasyedaṃ vivaraṇam‌--`asahāyayo rhalormadhye' iti| tatyetyanantarokto'kāraḥ sambadhyate| tasyāṅgasyāvayavasyākārasyetyarthaḥ| sthānaṣaṣṭhī cem‌--tasya sthāna ekāra ādeśo bhavati| `reṇatuḥ, reṇuḥ' iti| `aṇa raṇa' (dhā.pā.444,445) iti `raṇiḥ śabdārthaḥ' paṭhyate| `yematuḥ, yemuḥ' iti| `yama uparame' (dhā.pā.984)| `dematuḥ, demuḥ' iti| `damu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1203)| `rarāśe'[rarāse--kāśikā.] iti| `rāśṛ śabde' [rāśṛ śabde--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.626) ātmanepadī| `śaśramatuḥ śaśramuḥ' iti| `śramu tapasi khede ca' (dhā.pā.1204)| kecittu tatakṣatuḥ, tatakṣurityetadekahalyadhyasya pratyudāharaṇaṃ paṭhanti; etaccāyuktam‌; kṅitītyanuvarttate, na ca pakṣeḥ parasya liṭaḥ kittvamasti| `asaṃyogāt‌' iti pratiṣedhāt‌ | `tatsaratuḥ, tatsaruḥ' iti| `tsara chadmagatau' (dhā.pā.554)| `cakaṇatuḥ, cakaṇuḥ' iti| `aṇa raṇa vaṇa bhaṇa kvaṇa kaṇa śabdārthāḥ' (dhā.pā.444,445,446,447,450449)| tatra kaṇatirbhvādau paṭhyate| `jagaṇatuḥ, jagaṇuḥ' iti| `gaṇa saṃkhyāne' (dhā.pa.1853) curādau paṭhyate| nanu ca caurādikatvāṇṇici kṛte `kāspratyayādāmamantre liṭi' (3.1.35) ityāmā bhavitavyam‌? `anityaṇyantāścurādayaḥ' (hai.pa.pā.97) ityadoṣaḥ| anityaṇyantatvantu teṣāṃ saptame jñāpayiṣyate| `babhaṇatuḥ' iti| bhaṇatirbhvādau paṭhyate śabdārtha eva| `nematuḥ' iti| `ṇama prahvatve śabde' (dhā.pā.981)| `ṇo naḥ' (6.1.65) iti natvam‌| `sehe' iti| `ṣaha marṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.852) `dhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ' (6.1.64) iti satvam‌| kathaṃ punarnatve satve ca liṭayādeśādī na bhavataḥ? ityata āha--`anaimittike natvasatve' ityādi| natvasatvavidhāne hi na kiñcinnimittamāśrīyata ityanaimittike ete bhavataḥ, tataśca prāgeva liḍutpattestābhyāṃ bhavitavyam‌| tena tadādi yadaṅgaṃ talliṭyādeśādi na bhavati| yadi tarhi liṭā'deśo viśiṣyata evaṃ satyaṅgamaviśeṣitaṃ syāt‌, tataśca pakvaḥ pakvavānityatrāpi prasajyeta, pacerapi hyaṅgasya liṭi parabhūte ya ādeśaḥ kriyate sa ihāpyādirnāsti? naitadasti; abhyāsalopasanniyogena hyettvamucyate| tena yatraivābhyāsalopaḥ tatraivaittvena bhavitavyam‌| na cātrābhyāsalopaḥ; asambhavāt‌| iha tarhi syāt‌--pāpacyata iti? ayamapyadoṣaḥ; iha paratvāt‌ `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) iti dīrgho bhaviṣyati| hrasvahalādiśeṣāvutsargau, tayordīrghatvamettvañcāpavādaḥ| tatra dīrghasyāvakāśaḥ--bābhāsyate, etvasyāvakāśaḥ--pecatuḥ, pecuriti; ihobhyaṃ prāpnoti--pāpacyata iti, apavādavipratiṣedhe sati paratvāddīrghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati| atha babhaṇatuḥ, babhaṇurityatrettvaṃ kasmānna bhavati, `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) iti jaśtve kṛta ādeśāditvāditi cet‌? na; ettve karttavye jaśtvasyāsiddhatvāt‌| tasmādbhavitavyamevaittvena| vipratiṣedhasya tu yatra `kuhoścuḥ (7.4.62) iti ścutvaṃ kriyate--cakaṇatuḥ, cakaṇuḥ, jahasatuḥ, jahasurityādāvavakaśaḥ syādityata āha--`iha' ityādi| kathametajjñāyate--nāstyasiddhatvam‌? ityāha--`tathā ca' ityādi| tadaiva `tṛphalabhajatrapaśca' (6.4.122) iti phalibhajyorettvamupapadyate yadi jaśtvacatvaṃyorasiddhatvaṃ na bhavati, nānyathā| anādeśāditvādanenaivaittvasya siddhatvāt‌ tannopapadyate| tasmāt‌ phalibhajyorettvavidhānādadasīyate--jaśtvacarttvayorasiddhatvamiha nāstīti| `rūpābhede ca' ityādi| `śabdarūpasya sthānino'bede sati ya ādeśaḥ sa iha nāśrīyate' ityasyārthasya `na śasadadavādiguṇānām‌' (6.4.126) iti śasidadyoḥ pratiṣedhavacanaṃ jñāpakam‌| `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) ityanena prakṛtijaśāṃ prakṛtijaśaḥ, prakṛticarāṃ prakṛticaro bhavantīti śasaḥ śakārasya śakāro bhavati, daderdakārasyāpi dakāra; tenobhāvapi tāvādeśādī bhavataḥ| tatra yadi sthānyabhede sati ya ādeśaḥ so'pīhāśrīyeta, tata ādeśāditvādeva na bhaviṣyatīti śasidyorettvapratiṣedho na vidhīyeta; vihitaśca, tasmādetadeva pratiṣedhavacanaṃ jñāpayati--rūpābhede sati ya ādeśaḥ sa iha nāśrīyata iti| yadi tarhyāśrīyata kiṃ syāt‌? ityata āha--`anyathā hi' ityādi| anyathā yo'pi rūpābhedādādeśaḥ sthāninābhinnarūpaḥ so'pīhāśrayeta, tato yathā cakaṇaturityevamādīnāmettvaṃ na bhavati, tathā pecatuḥ, pecurityevamādīnāmapi prakṛtijaścarādīnāṃ na syāt‌| prakṛtijaśaḥ prakṛticaraścādayo yeṣānte tathoktāḥ| `ahaṃ papaṭha, ahaṃ papaca' iti| atra sthānivadbhāvena pittvāt‌ kittvaṃ nāsti, tenaittvābhyāsalopau na bhavataḥ| vṛddhirapi na bhavati; `ṇaluttamo vā' (7.1.91) iti pakṣe ṇittvābhāvāt‌| ṇittvapakṣe tu paratvād‌vṛddhyā bādhitvādettvādettvābhāyāsalopābhyāṃ na bhavitavyam‌, ityaṇittvapakṣa evodāhṛtam‌| `dambheḥ' iti| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ dambherettvaṃ na bhavati, yāvatā `liṭyanādeśādhyetadaṅgam‌| `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityādinā na lope kṛta ekahalmadhya evākāraḥ? ityata āha--`nalopasya' ityādi| `granthiśranthidambhisvañjīnām‌' (vā.17) iti sūtre [?] dambheḥ parasya liṭaḥ kittvamuktam‌, tasmin‌ sati ya upadhāyā lopastasya `asiddhavadatrā bhāt‌' (6.4.22) ityasiddhatvānna prāpnoti| tasmāddambherettvaṃ vaktavyam‌| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`śnasorallopaḥ (6.4.111) ityatrā bhācchāstrīyasyāsiddhatvasyānityatvaṃ jñāpitam‌, tena dambherettve karttavye lopasyāsiddhttvaṃ na bhavati, tataśca dambherliṭyattvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā `ata ekahalmadhye' (6.4.120) ityatra `ataḥ' iti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, tena yatra yatrettvamiṣyate tatra tatra bhaviṣyatīti| evañca kṛtvā `naśimanyoraliṭyettvam‌' (vā.793) ityādyapi nopasaṃkhyeyam‌; yogavibhāgenaiva siddhatvāt‌| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeya ityeṣo'rtha iti sarvatra veditavyam‌| `aneśam‌' iti| `tasthastha' (3.4.101) ityādinā mipo'mbhāvaḥ| atha `menakā' ityatra `pratyayasthāt‌' (7.3.44) ityādinettvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`kṣipakādiṣu' ityādi| kṣipakādiṣvittvasya pratiṣedho vakṣyate| asya ca kṣipakādiṣu prakṣepaḥ, tenettvaṃ na kriyate| `cānaśi' iti| `tacchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu cānaśa' (3.2.129) `muk‌ na kriyate' iti| `āne muk‌' (7.2.82) iti muk‌ prāpnoti, sa na bhavati `anityamāgamaśāsanam‌' (vyā.pā.95) iti kṛtvā| chāndasatvādvā--`sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' (bho.pa.99) iti| `chāndasaṃ hrasvatvam‌' iti| `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam‌' (6.3.63) iti ṅyāporvidhīyamānaṃ hrasvatvaṃ bahulavacāt‌ `perirannityatrāpi vati| pacerliṅ, sīyuṭ‌, jhasya ran‌, śap‌, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| paceranniti prāpta ettve hrasvattve ca kṛte peciranniti bhavati|| 121. thali ca seṭi| (6.4.121) `pecitha, śekitha' iti| `upadeśe'tvataḥ' (7.2.62) itīṭpratiṣedhaprāptaḥ `ṛto bhāradhvājasya' (7.2.63) iti niyamādiheṅabhavati| tadayamatrārthaḥ--ṛta eva bhāradhvājasyeeti, nānyeṣāṃ dhātūnāmiti| `papaktha' iti| anyeṣāmācāryāṇāṃ mateneṭpratiṣedho bhavatyeva| atha thalgrahaṇaṃ kamartham‌, `na soṭi ityevocyeta; yatra hi pūrveṇa na siddhyate tadarthaṃ vacanam‌, anyatreḍādau kittvāt‌ pūrveṇaiva siddham‌, tatrāntareṇāpi thalgrahaṇaṃ thalyeva bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`thalgrahaṇam‌' ityādi asati thalgrahaṇe, ārambhasārthyādetāvān‌ niścayaḥ syāt‌--yatra pūrveṇa na siddhyati tadarthametaditi| akṅidarthamityetat‌ tu duravasānam‌; bahavo viśeṣāḥ prakāntāḥ, tatra sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimakṅidarthametat‌ syāt‌, utādeśārtham‌? āhosvidanekahalmadhyārtham‌? kimu anekākārārthamiti? tatrāsandehārtham‌ `ata ekahalmadhye'nādeśāderliṭi' (6.4.120) ityete viśeṣāḥ sarva evehānuvarttante| kṅidgrahaṇantu nivṛttam‌| tasmāt‌ kṅidartho'yamārambhaḥ| na ca thalo'nyadihākṅidasti seṭ‌| tataḥ sāmarthāt‌ thalyevāyaṃ vidhirvyākhyeyaḥ| vyākhyānadvāreṇa pratipattau mandadhiyāṃ pratipattigauravaṃ syāt‌| tasmādvispaṣṭārthaṃ thalgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| thalo hyakṅita upādāne sukhameva pratīyate--akṅidartho'yamārambha iti|| 122. tṝphalabhajatrapaśca| (6.4.122) `teratuḥ teruḥ' iti| `ṛcchatyṝtām‌'(7.4.11) iti guṇaḥ| `phelatuḥ, pheluḥ' iti| `phala niṣpattau' (dhā.pā.530), `ñi phalā viśaraṇe' (dhā.pā.516) iti ca| `taraterguṇārtham‌' iti| `na śasadadavādiguṇānām‌' (6.4.123) iti pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyati| atastrateridaṃ vacanaṃ guṇa ityevamabhinivṛttasyāpi yathā syādityevamartham‌| `śrantheśceti vaktavyam‌' iti| `grantha śrantha sandarthe' (dhā.pā.1511,1512) ityasyāpyettvaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--cakāro'tatra kyiye, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena śrantherapi bhaviṣyatīti| `śrethatuḥ, śrethuḥ' iti pūrvavadupasaṃkhyānena liṭaḥ kittve nakāralopaḥ|| 123. rādho hiṃsāyām‌| (6.4.121) `rādho hiṃsāyāmarthe' ityādi| yadyapi `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau' (dhā.pā.1262,2363) iti rādhiḥ saṃsiddhau paṭhyate, iha tathāpyanekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ hiṃsārthatā veditavyā| rādherhisāyamarthe'varṇasyaikārādeśo bhavatītyucyate| nanu ca nātra sūtre'varṇagrahaṇamasti, yo'pyatratyo'varṇaḥ prakṛtaḥ so'pi mātrākālaḥ, na ca rādhermātrākalopra'varṇo'sti, tat‌ kathamavarṇasya sthāna ettvaṃ labhyate? iti yaścodayet‌ taṃ pratyāha--`ata ityetadihopasthitam‌' ityādi| `ataḥ' iti svaritatvādihopasthitam‌, yadihopasthitaṃ tat‌ taparatvakṛtasya kālaviśeṣasyābhāvāt‌ tadapāsya-parityajyāvarṇamātraṃ sthānitvena pratyāyayati-dodhayati; anyathā tasyopasthānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `atha vā' ityādi| `śnābhyāstayoḥ' (6.4.112) ityanena yataḥ sūtrāt‌ sthānyanuvarttate tadupalakṣayati| `ātaḥ' ityanenāpi yaḥ sthānyanuvarttate taṃ darśayati--`śnābhyarattayorāt‌ ityata āta ityanuvarttata iti vyākhyeyam‌' iti| evañca vyākhyāyamāne rādheravarṇasyettvaṃ vijñāyate yadi tarhyata ityanuvarttate, evañca sati `ata ekahalmadhye' (6.4.120) ityatrāpi tasyātaḥ sannidhānādihāpi prāpnoti--śaśāsiva śaśasimeti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; maṇḍūkapalutinyāyena tasyehānuvṛttiḥ| `ekahalmadhye vā' ityādi| atha vā--ekahalmadhya ityanuvarttate, tatrāpyanuvarttamāne'sambhavādata itīha na vyāpriyate| tena rādheryaḥ ekahalmadhye'vayavaḥ sa sthānī bhavati, sa punarākāra eva bhavati, tasyaivaittvaṃ bhaviṣyati|| 124. vā jṝbhramutrasām‌| (6.4.124) `jṝ vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1494) [`jṛ--mu.pāṭhaḥ] ityasya guṇārthaṃ vacanam‌| bhramerādeśārtham‌, anekahalmadhyārthañca traseścānekahalmadhyartham‌| `jajaratuḥ' iti| pūrvavadguṇaḥ|| 125. phaṇāñca saptānām‌| (6.4.125) bahuvacananirdeśādādyartho gamyate| ata āha--`phaṇādīnām‌' ityādi| `phaṇa gatau' (dhā.pā.821) `rājṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.822) `ṭu bhrājṛ ṭu bhrāśrṛ ṭu bhlāśrṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.823-825)| `syamu svana dhvana śabde' (dhā.pā.826-828) ityete dhvanavarjitāḥ phaṇādayaḥ sapta| tatrādyasya nitye prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam‌, itareṣāmaprāpte| tatra rājṛprabhṛtīnāṃ caturṇāmavarṇasyaittvasya pratiprattaye `rādho hiṃsāyām‌' (6.4.123) ityatra `ata ityetadihopasthitam‌' ityādinā yaduktaṃ tadyathāsambhavaṃ veditavyam‌|| 126. na śasadadavādiguṇānām‌| (6.4.126) atra yadi guṇa ityenena yasyaittvaṃ vihitaṃ sa etrākāra ucyate, tato'yamarthaḥ--akārasya guṇasya na bhavatīti| tathā caittvavidhiranavakāśa eva syādityetadbuddhau kṛtvā nātra guṇenākāra evocyate, api tu guṇaśabdabhinirvṛtta iti darśayannāha--`guṇa ityevamabhinirvṛttasya ca' ityādi| guṇaśabdamuccārya yo'bhinirvṛttaḥ śabdastasya sambandhī yo'kārastasya sthāna ettvaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ| tatsambandhitvaṃ punastasya tatsthānikatvāt‌ tadavayavatvācca yadyāyogaṃ veditavyam‌| tadevaṃ guṇaśabdābhinirvṛttasya sambandhyakāraḥ pratiṣedhasya nimittam‌, itarastu vidherityeva vidhipratiṣedhayorviṣayavibhāgaḥ| `viśaśasatuḥ' iti| `śasu hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.727)| `dadade' iti| `dada dāne' dhā.pā.17)| `vavamatuḥ' iti| `ṭu vama ud‌giraṇe' (dhā.pā.849) `viśaśaratuḥ' iti| `śṛ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1488)| `guṇaśabdabhinirvṛttasya' ityādinā yaduktaṃ tasyārthamudāharaṇe darśayati| `viśaśaratuḥ' ityatrārityayaṃ śabdo guṇaśabdābhinirvṛttaḥ| tatsambandhyakārasya tadekadeśātvāt‌| `lulavitha' iti| atrāpyokāro guṇaśabdābhinirvṛttaḥ tatsambandhyakārasya tatsthānikatvāt‌| nanu `viśaśaratuḥ' ityatrākāramātraṃ guṇaśabdenābhinirvṛttam‌, nā'r‌śabdaḥ! naitadasti; rephasya guṇabhaktatvāt‌| tathā ca bhāṣyam‌--`arbhavati guṇo bhavati, ārbhavati vṛddhirbhavati--rephasahito guṇavṛddhisaṃjño bhavati' iti|| 127. arvaṇastrasāvanañaḥ| (6.4.127) `t‌' ityayamādeśo bhavati' iti| `nānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam‌' (vyā.pa.14) ityantasya bhavati; ekāltvāt‌, kārasyānubandhatvāt‌| ukārasyānubandhatvāt‌ prathamaikavacanaṃ suśabdo gṛhyate, tena saptamībahuvacane bhavatyeva--arvatsvita| sa ca naña uttaro na bhavatīti cediti yat‌ prakṛtaṃ tadihāpi sambadhyate| `arvantau' iti| ṛkārasyogitkāryārthatvāt‌ `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌| `arvati' iti| `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp‌| `ārvatam‌' iti| apatyārthavivakṣāyāmaṇ‌| nanu ca nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) sādṛśyāt‌ soranyatra vibhaktādeva bhavitavyam‌? naitat‌; asāviti prasajyapratiṣedho'yam‌| ata eva vṛttikṛtoktam‌--`suścet‌ tataḥ paro na bhavati' iti| anyathā soranyo yaḥ sup‌ sa cet‌ tataḥ paro bhavatīti brūyāt‌| athāpi paryudāsaḥ? evamapyadoṣaḥ; anityatvānnañivayuktaparibhāṣāyāḥ| anityatvantu tasyāḥ `oṣadheśca vibhaktāvaprathamāyām‌' (6.3.132) ityatra vibhaktigrahaṇādvijñāyate| yadi hi sā nityā syāt‌, prathamāparyudāsena vibharaktāveva bhaviṣyatīti viktaktigrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌| kurvannapi tajjñāpayati--anityeyaṃ paribhāṣeti|| 128. maghavā bahulam‌| (6.4.128) madhaveti suvvyatyayena ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthāne prathamā| `madhonaḥ' iti| `śvayuvamadhonām‌' (6.4.133) iti samaprasāraṇam‌, parapūrvatvam‌, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| nanu ca magho'syāstīti matvarthavivakṣāyāṃ `chandasīvanipo vakatavyau' (vā.582) iti vanip‌ratyayānto'yaṃ maghavanśabdaḥ| tatra vanipaḥ samprasāraṇe bhasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām‌, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopena bhavitavyam‌, tataśca `madhunaḥ' ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌? naitat‌; anyeva hīdamavyutpannaṃ prātipadikam‌, tathā hi bhāvāyāmapi tasya prayogo dṛśyate| athāpi vanippratyayāntaḥ syāt‌? evamapi bahulavacanāt‌ `yasyeti' (6.4.148) iti lopo na bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `maghonī' iti| `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' (4.1.5)| `māghavanam‌' iti| pūrvavadaṇ‌| `an‌' (6.4.67) iti prakṛtivadbhāvaḥ|| 129. bhasya| (6.4.129) 130. pādaḥ pat‌| (6.4.130) `pādaḥ' iti| `pādaśabdo luptākāro gṛhyate' iti| atha pādayateḥ kvibantasya yaḥ pācchabdaḥ sampadyate sa kasmānna gṛhyate? tasyāsambhavāt‌| pādayaterhi kvip‌ `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) ityanena syāt‌? sa ca `dṛśyate' iti vacanānna bhavati| yatra loke kvibantaproyago dṛśyate tatra yathā syādityevamarthaṃ hi tatra `duśyate' ittayuktam‌, na ca pādayateḥ kvibantasya prayogo dṛśyate? pādaśabdasya samāsa evākāro lupyate, tena sāmarthyāt‌ tadantasyāṅgasya kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`tadantasyāṅgasya' ityādi| yadi tarhi pācchabdantasyāṅgasya padityayamādeśo vijñāyeta, evaṃ tarhi `ye na vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) iti sarvasya tadantasya prāpnotītyāha--`sa ca' ityādi| `dvipadaḥ' iti| dvau pādavasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| `saṃkhyāsupūrvasya' (5.4.140) ityakāralopaḥ| `dvipadikām‌' iti| dvau dvau pādau dadātīti `pādaśatasya' (5.4.1) ityādinā vun‌| `vaiyāghrapadyaḥ' iti| vyāghrasyeva pādāvasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, `pādasya lopo'hastyādibhyaḥ' (5.4.138) ityakāralopaḥ, vyāghrapado'patyamiti gargāditvādyañ‌|| 131. vasoḥ samprasāraṇam‌| (6.4.131) pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho.pa.sū.7) tadantasya kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`vasvantasya, ityādi| `viduṣaḥ' iti| `videḥ śaturvasuḥ' (7.1.36)| `pecaṣaḥ' iti| `kvasuśca' (3.2.107) iti liṭaḥ kvamuḥ, `ata ekahalmadhye' (6.4.120) ityādinaittavābhyāsalopau| `papuṣaḥ' iti| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| nanu cākāralope karttavye samprasāraṇamasiddham‌, tat‌ kuto'trākāralopaḥ? ityāha--`ākāralope karttavye' ityādi| ākāralopaḥ samprasāraṇe, tattu vibhaktāviti vayāśrayatvam‌, ato nāstyasiddhatvam‌| nanu ca ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.52) iti, `tadanubandhakagrahaṇe nātadanubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.54) iti vā na kvasoriha grahaṇena bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ papuṣaḥ, pecuṣa ityatra samprasāraṇaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`vasugrahaṇe' ityādi| etattu śatrādeśasya vasorukārānubandhakaraṇādveditavyam‌| ukārānubandhasya hyetadeva phalam‌--iha sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌| nanu cogattvārthaṃ tat‌ syāt‌? naitat‌; ugitkāryasya sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddhatvāt‌|| 132. vāha ūṭh‌| (6.4.132) `vāhaḥ' iti| vahirayaṃ ṇvipratyayāntaḥ, sa cāsmātsopapadādeva ṇvirvihitaḥ| tena sāmarthyāt‌ tadantavidhirvijñāyata ityāha--`vāha ityevamantasya' ityādi| `ūḍityetat‌' iti| ṭhidayamūkāraḥ| `etyedhatyūṭhsu' (6.1.89) iti viśeṣaṇārthaḥ| `samprasāraṇaṃ bhavati' iti| samprasāraṇamityeṣa viśeṣaḥ kuto labhyate| pūrvasūtrāt‌ samprasāraṇamityasyānuvṛtteḥ| kimarthaṃ punaḥ samprasāraṇamanuvāryate? sthāniniyamārtham‌| yadyetannānuvartyate, yaṇa eva sthāne `igyaṇaḥ samprasāraṇam‌' (1.1.45) iti bhavitavyam‌| `praṣṭhauhaḥ' iti| praṣṭhaṃ vahatīti `bhajo ṇviḥ' (3.2.62) ityanuvarttamāne `vahaśca' (3.2.64) iti ṇviḥ| atha kimarthamūṭh‌ kriyate, na `vāha' ityetāvadeva sūtraṃ karttavyamityabhiprāyaḥ| `samprasaraṇa eva kṛte' iti| pūrvasatrāt‌ samaprasāraṇagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| `guṇe ca' iti| kṛta iti sambandhaḥ| guṇastu `pugantalaghūpadhasya ca' (7.3.86) iti lupte'pi ṇvau pratyalakṣaṇena| nanu ca `aṅgavṛtte punaraṅgavṛttāvavidhi niṣṭhitasya' (vyā.pa.38) iti samprasāraṇe kṛte guṇena na bhavitavyam‌? `niṣṭhitasya' iti| `vacanādadoṣaḥ| niṣṭhā hi śabdasya parisamāptiḥ, sā ca tadā bhavati yadā śabdasaya prayogārhatā bhavati| na ca yāvadguṇādisaṃskāro na kriyate tāvadasya prayogārhatā bhavati| tasmāt‌ kṛte'pi samprasāraṇe bhavatyeva guṇaḥ, tatretat‌ syāt‌| yadyūḍ na kriyate, tadā śārli vahati, ditiṃ vahati, śālyuhaḥ, dityūha ityevamādyanakārante śāliditiśabda upapade vaherṇvi pratyaye vihite sati na siddhyatītyata āha--`anakārānte copapade' ityādi| `vahaśca' (3.2.64) ityanena `chandasi sahaḥ' (3.2.63) ityato'tra chandograhaṇānuvṛtteśchandasyeva ṇvirvidhīyate, dṛṣṭārthavidhiśchandasi, akārānta eva copapade praṣṭhādau vaheśchandasi ṇvirdṛśyate na tvakārānte śālyādau| kathaṃ punaranena bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā jñāpyate? ityāha--`tasyāṃ hi' ityādi| bahiraṅgattvaṃ punaḥ samprasāraṇasya bāhyājādipratyayanimittāṃ bhasaṃjñāmāśritya pravṛttātvāt‌| guṇasya tvantaraṅgattvam‌; abāhmapratyaye pravṛttatvāt‌| kiṃ punarasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ jñāpanenaprayojanam‌? pacāvedam‌, yajāvedamityatraḥ siddhattvaṃ bahiraṅgalakṣaṇasya| ato'ntaraṅgalakṣaṇameta aitvaṃ na bhavati; bahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvādguṇasya| bahiraṅgatvantu padadvayāśritatvāt‌| aitvasya tvantaraṅgatvaṃ viparyayāt‌|| 133. śvayuvamaghonāmataddhite| (6.4.133) `yūnaḥ' iti| samprasāraṇe kṛte parapūrvatve ca savarṇadīrghatvam‌| `śauvam‌' iti| `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ| `yauvanam‌' iti| yūno bhāva iti `hāyanāntayuvādibhyo'ṇ‌' (5.1.130) ityaṇ‌, `an‌' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāvāt‌ `ṭeḥ' (6.4.143) iti ṭilopāllopau na bhavataḥ| `māghavanam‌' iti--maghavā devatā'syeti `sāsya devatā' (4.2.24) ityaṇ‌, pūrvavatprakṛtibhāvaḥ| `śauvam‌' ityetadvyutpādayitumāha--`śuno vikāraḥ' ityādi| yuvaśabdasya tipratyayāntasyāpi `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.29) iti samprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti| madhavannityasyāpi trityādeśe kṛte `ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati' (vyā.pa.16) iti takārāntasyāpi prāpnoti| tat‌ kathaṃ na bhavati? ityāha--`śvādīnām‌' ityādi| `tadartham‌' iti| nakārāntānāmeva yathā syāt‌, anakārāntānāṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌| `ana ityubhayoḥ śeṣaḥ' iti| ana ityasyobhayoryogayoḥ śeṣatve'vayavatve satyana ityanena samprasāraṇaśeṣasyātideśa iti na bhavati|| 134. allopo'naḥ| (6.4.134) taparakaraṇaṃ nañsamāso'yamityāśaṅkānirāsārtham‌| `rājakīyaḥ' [`rājakīyam‌'--kāśikā] iti| `garttottarapadācchaḥ' (4.2.137) iti che prakṛte `rājñaḥ ka ca' (4.2.140) iti chaḥ, kakāraścāntādeśaḥ| atrāpi `ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadbhavati' (vyā.pa.16) iti|| 135. ṣapūrvahandhṛtarājñāmaṇi| (6.4.135) `an‌' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāvenāllopasya nivṛttirmā bhūdityevamartha vacanam‌| `aukṣṇaḥ, tākṣṇaḥ' iti| ukṣan‌, takṣan‌, ityetābhyāmapatyārthe'ṇ‌| `bhrauṇādhnaḥ' iti| bhrūṇaṃ hatavāniti `brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu hanaḥ' (3.2.87) [`brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvip‌' iti sūtram‌] iti kvip‌, tadantādaṇ‌, `ho hanterñṇinneṣu' (7.3.54) iti kutvam‌| `dhārttarājñaḥ' iti| ghṛtarājaśabdādbahuvrīheraṇ‌| `sāmanaḥ, vaimanaḥ' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌, `ubhāvapi na bhavatiḥ' iti| allopaṭilopāvubhāvapi cāpekṣya prakṛtibhāvasya vidhānāt‌| `tākṣaṇyaḥ' iti| `kurvādibyo ṇyaḥ' (4.1.151) iti ṇye prakṛte senāntalakṣaṇakāritvāṇṇyapratyayaḥ' (4.1.152), `ye cābhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (6.4.168) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ|| 136. vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ| (6.4.136) `śīśabde ca' iti| etena `napuṃsakācca' (7.1.19) iti yo vihitaḥ śośabdastasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌, na tu `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20) iti yo vihitaḥ śiśabdastasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretajjñāyate? śiśabde bhasaṃjñāyā abhāvāt‌|| 137. na saṃyogādvamantāt‌| (6.4.137) `prati dīvnā' iti| `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na `damaḥ' ityevocyeta, vakāramakārābhyāṃ saṃyogena viśiṣyamāṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyantareṇāpyantagrahaṇaṃ tadantavidhirlabhyata eva? satyayetat‌, vispaṣṭārthamantagrahaṇam‌|| 138. acaḥ| (6.4.138) `aca ityayamañcatirluptanakāro gṛhyate' iti| kuta etat‌, pratyāhāraḥ kasmānna gṛhyate? `allopaḥ' (6.4.134) ityānuvṛtterna śakyate pratyāhāro grahītum‌| pratyāhāragrahaṇe sati tenākāro viśidhyeta, tathā cānarthakaṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ syāt‌| na hyakāro'catvaṃ vyabhicarati| nanu cāṅgaṃ prakṛtam‌, tat‌ pratyāhāreṇa viśiṣyate--ajantasyāṅgasyeti? na; evaṃ satyajantasyāṅgasyāllopo bhavatītyeṣa sūtrārthaḥ syāt‌| tathā ca `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopo'narthakaḥ syāt‌; anenaiva siddhatvāt‌| api ca `dyuprāgapāgudakpratīco yat‌' (4.2.101) ityetramādinirdeśo liṅgaṃ hyatrāpratyāhāragrahaṇasya| yadi hi pratyāhāragrahaṇa syāt‌, atrāñcatergrahaṇaṃ na syāt‌, na hyetadajantamaṅgam‌| ata eva nirdeśāt‌ pacādyajapi na gṛhyate| na hyetat‌ pacādyajantamaṅgam‌| `dadhīcaḥ' iti| dadhyañcatīti ṛtvigādinā (3.2.59) kvin‌, `āniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ; `cau' (6.3.138) iti dīrghaḥ|| 139. uda īt‌| (6.4.139) 140. āto dhātoḥ| (6.4.140) `kīlālapaḥ' iti| `vijupe chandasi' (3.2.73) iti vici prakṛte `āto maninkvanibvanipaśca' (3.2.74) iti vic‌| `niyeḥ' iti| kvip‌ iyaṅa|| 141. mantreṣvāṅyāderātmanaḥ| (6.4.141) `āṅa' iti tṛtīyaikavacanasyaiṣā saṃjñā pūrvācāryairvihitā| `āṅo'nyatrāpi dṛśyate' iti| `mantreṣu' iti bahuvacananirdeśādetallabhyate| bahuvacananirdeśena hyayamarthaḥ sūcitaḥ--bahuviṣayo'yaṃ nirdeśa iti| evañca bahuviṣayo bhavati yadyāṅo'nyatrāpi kvacidbhavati, nānyathā| `tmānyāsamañjata' iti| saptamyekavacane| atrādilopaḥ|
