ādigrahaṇamuttarārtham‌| iha tu pūrvasūtrāt‌ `ātaḥ' (6.4.140) ityanuvṛtterantareṇāpyādigrahaṇamāderevalopo bhavatīti śakyate vijñātum‌|| 142. ti viṃśaterḍiti| (6.4.142) `viṃśakaḥ' iti| `viṃśatirtriśadbhyāṃ ḍvunasaṃjñāyām‌' (5.1.24) iti ḍvun‌, tiśabdasya lope kṛte ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| `viṃśaṃ śatam‌' iti| viṃśatiradhikā'sminniti `śadantarviśateśca' (5.2.46) iti ḍapratyayaḥ| `viṃśaḥ, ekaviṃśaḥ' iti| tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ‌ (5.1.48)| tigrahaṇamanatyasya mā bhūdityevamartham‌|| 143. ṭeḥ| (6.4.143) `kumudvān‌' ityādi| kamudanaḍavetasebhyaścāturarthiko ḍmatup‌ (4.2.87)| `upasarajaḥ' iti| `saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ' (3.2.97) evaṃ `mandurajaḥ' ityatrāpi| atra hi `ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñācchandasorbahulam‌' (6.3.63) iti pūrvapadasya hrasvatvam‌| `triṃśakaḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ ḍvun‌| nanu ca `bhasya' (6.4.129) ityanuvarttate, na ca ḍmatupi ḍapratyaye ca dhātorvihite pūrvasya bhasaṃjñā prāpnoti, ubhayoranajāditvāt‌ asvāditvācca yathāyogam‌, tat‌ kathamatra lopo bhavati? ityāha--`ḍityabhasyāpi' ityādi| yadi ṭilopo na syāt‌, tadā ḍittvamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| athaivaṃ kasmānna vijñātum‌| evaṃ tarhi `prāvṛṭśaratkāladivāṃ je' (6.3.15) iti kṛtaṭilopasya janernirdeśo nopapadyeta? tasmādata eva nirdeśādavasīyate--bhavati dhātupratyayaḍakārasyetsaṃjñeti| tasyāñcāsatyāṃ yadi ṭilopo na syāt‌, tasyāstadā vaiyarthyaṃ syāt‌| ḍmatupo'pi yadi ḍakārasya lopo na syāt‌, tadantena tannāmādeśo na gamyeta, tatra ca `deśe tannāmni' (4.2.67) iti varttate| tasmādavaśyaṃ tatrāpi ḍakārasyetsaṃjñayā bhavitavyam‌, tasyāñca tatsāmarthyāṭṭilopena|| 144. nastaddhite| (6.4.144) `sātvataḥ' iti| satvato'patyamityaṇ‌| `nāntasya ṭilopaḥ' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na siddhyati yata upasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam‌? ityāha--`atra ya innantāḥ' ityādi| ye tvannantāsteṣām an‌' (6.4.167) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāpta iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `sābrahmacāraḥ' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| `pīṭhasarpiṇaḥ' iti| ima iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `paiṭhasarpāḥ' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| `pīṭhasarpiṇaḥ' iti| ima iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `paiṭhasarpāḥ' iti| pūrvavadaṇ‌| `kālāpāḥ' iti| pūrvavatproktārthe `kalāpivaiśamyāyanāntevāsibhyaśca' (4.3.104) iti vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāṇṇinipratyaye prāpte tadapavādaḥ `kalāpino'ṇ‌' (4.3.108), tataḥ `tadadhīte tadveva' (4.2.59) ityaṇ‌, tasya `proktālluk‌' (4.2.64) iti luk‌, `chandobrāhmaṇāni ca tadviṣayāṇi' (4.2.66) ityadhyetṛveditṛviṣayatā| `kothumāḥ' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| `tatkṛto grantha upacārāt‌' ityādi| upacārasya tu tatkṛtatvātra nibandhanam‌| bhavati hi tatkṛtatve tadupacāraḥ, yathā sarvamidaṃ purāṇaṃ karma śubhāśubhaṃ bhujyata iti| atha kasmādupacāra āśrīyate, na `adhikṛtya kṛte granthe' (4.3.87) ityevamādiśaiṣikārthavivakṣāyāṃ taddhita eva kriyeta? ityata āha--`śaiṣikeṣvartheṣu' ityādi| taitilijājaliśabdau vṛddhasaṃjñakau, tayorvṛddhatvāt‌ śaiṣikeṣvathaṣu vidhīyamāno'sau taddhitaḥ `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti chaḥ prasajyeta| tasmiṃśca sati `taitilāḥ, jājalāḥ' iti na siddhyet‌, tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityupacāra āśritaḥ| `evam‌' ityanenāntaroktāṃ vyutpattiṃ darśayati chapratyayanivṛttaye| lāṅgaliśabdasyāpyevaṃ vyutpattiḥ karttavyā| lāṅgaliḥ ācāryaḥ, tatkṛtī grantha upacārāt‌ lāṅgalaśabdenābhidhīyate| `lāṅgalāḥ' iti| `śikhaṇḍāḥ` ityādyudāharaṇatraye'pi `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| `āśmaḥ' iti| atrāpi `tasya vikāraḥ' (4.3.134) ityaṇ‌| `āśmano'nyatra' iti| atrāpi `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityatrārthābhidhāne| `cārmaḥ' ityatrāpi `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇeva| `carmaṇo'nyaḥ' iti| carmaṇo vikāra iti| `śauvaḥ' iti| `dvārādīnāñca' (7.3.4) ityaijāgamaḥ| sāyamprātikāyaḥ prātipadikeṣu na paṭhyanta ityataḥ pṛcchati--`ke punaḥ sāmamprātikādayaḥ iti| sāyamprātikaprakārā ityanena prakāravacanatāmādiśabdasya darśayati| nanu ca `sāyañciram‌' (4.3.23) ityādinā'vyayebhyaṣṭyulbhyāṃ bhavitavyam, tat‌ kathaṃ ṭhañ‌ bhavati? ityāha--`ṭyuṭyulau tu neṣyete' iti| anabhidhānāt‌| atra ca sarvatropasaṃkyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--mantreṣvityādeḥ (6.4.141) sūtrādādigrahaṇamanuvarttate, taddhitagrahaṇañcedamarthameva kṛtam‌| tadanuvṛttau cāyamartho bhavati--nāntādīnāṃ taddhite parataṣṭilopo bhavatīti| ādiśabdena sāyamprātikādayo gṛhyante| tena sarvatra ṭilopaḥ siddho bhavati| `ityevamādiṣu na dṛśyate ṭilopaḥ' iti| etenārātīyaḥ ityevamādīnāmasāyampprātikatvaṃ darśayati| atha `śāśvataḥ' ityatra kathamaṇ‌, yāvatā `kālaṭṭhaña' (4.3.11) iti ṭhañā bhavitavyam‌? naitadasti; `kālaṭṭhañ‌' (4.3.11) ityatra `kālāt‌' iti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, tena śaśvacchabdādyathādihitamaṇ‌ bhavati| na ca yogavibhāgena ṭhañ‌ bādhyate; `yeṣāñca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ' (2.4.9) iti nipātanāt‌| tena pakṣe ṭhañapi bhavatyeva| ṭyuṭyulau tu śāśvataśabdānneṣyete, anabhidhānādeva| atha `śāśvatikaḥ' ityatra `isusuktāntātkaḥ' (7.3.51) iti ṭhañaḥ kādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ata eva nirdeśāt‌|| 145. ahnaṣṭakhoreva| (6.4.145) `dvyahaḥ' iti| `taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti samāsaḥ, `rājahaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac‌' (5.4.91) iti ṭac‌ samāsāntaḥ| atra `ahnohna etebhyaḥ' (5.4.88) ityahnādeśaḥ prāptaḥ sa ca `na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre' (5.4.89) iti pratiṣedhānna bhavati| `dvyahīnaḥ' iti| taddhitārthe `samāyāḥ' (5.1.85) iti varttamāne `rātryahaḥsaṃvatsarācca' (5.1.87) iti khaḥ| kena punarahīna ityatra khapratyayaḥ? ityāha--`ahnaḥ samūhe kho vaktavvaḥ' iti| nanu ca ahno nakārāntatvāt‌ pūrveṇaiva siddhaṣṭilopaḥ, tat‌ kimartho'yamārambhaḥ? ityāha--`siddhe sati' ityādi| `āhnikam‌' iti| ārhīyaṣṭhak‌| yadi siddhe sati niyamartho'yamārambhaḥ, evaṃ satyevagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, vināpi tena siddhe satyārambo niyamārtho vijñāsyate? ityāha--`evakārakaraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌' iti| atha viparītaniyamāśaṅkānirāsārthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`ahna eva' ityādi| yadyahna eva ṭakhoḥ--ityeva viparītaniyamaḥ syāt‌, evaṃ satyanyasya khe ṭilopaprasaṅga eva nāsti| `ātmādhvāno khe' (6.4.169) iti prakṛtivadbhāvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ|| 146. orguṇaḥ| (6.4.146) `bābhraṣyaḥ' iti| `madhubabhvrorbrāhyaṇakauśikayoḥ' (4.1.106) iti babhruśabdādapatyārthe yañ‌| `māṇḍavyaḥ' iti| atrāpi gargāditvāt‌| `vānto yi pratyaye' (6.1.79) ityavādeśaḥ| `śaṅkavyam‌' ityadau `tasmai hitam‌' (5.1.5) ityasminnarthe `ugavādibhyo yat‌' (5.1.2)| `aupagavaḥ, kāpaṭavaḥ' iti| atrāpyapatyārthe'ṇ‌| taddhita ityeva--`voto guṇavacanāt‌' (4.1.44) iti ṅīṣ‌, paṭvī| `orot‌' iti vaktavye' ityādi| evamucyamāne laghu sūtraṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `svāyambhuvaḥ' iti| svayaṃ bhavatīti kvip‌--svayambhūḥ, svayambhuva itamityaṇ‌| saṃjñāpūrvakasya vidheranityatvādatra gumo na bhavati, tasmiścā satyuvaṅeva kriyate|| 147. ḍhe lopo'kadrūvāḥ| (6.4.147) `kāmaṇḍaleyaḥ, śaitabāheyaḥ' iti| `catuṣpādbhyo ḍhañ‌' (4.1.135) iti ḍhañ‌| evaṃ `jāmbeyaḥ' ityatrāpi| `mādrabāheyaḥ' iti| madrabāhuśabdāt‌ `bāhvantāt‌ saṃjñāyām‌' (4.1.67) ityūṅa, tadantāt‌ `strībhyo ḍhak‌' (4.1.120)| `kādraveyaḥ' iti| `kadrūkamaṇḍalvośchandasi saṃjñāyām‌' (4.1.71,72) ityūṅa tadantāt‌ pūrvavaṅḍhak‌|| 148. yasyeti ca| (6.4.148) atra yasyeti yakārasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vā syāt‌, ivarṇāvarṇayorvā? atra yadi yakārasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, uttarasūtre punaryagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌, etadeva hi tatrānuvarttiṣyate| tasmādivarṇāvarṇayoridaṃ grahaṇam| tatra varṇagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra tadantavidhiṃ prayojayatīti tadantavidhirvijñāyate--ityataccetasi kṛtvā''ha--`ivarṇāvarṇāntasya' ityādi| `dākṣī, plākṣī' iti| dākṣiplākṣiśabdābhyāṃ `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) iti ṅīṣ‌| `sakhī' ityatrāpi `sakhyaśiśvīti bhāṣāyām‌' (4.1.62) iti nipātanāt‌| nanu cātra savarṇadīrghatvenāpyetat‌ siddham‌, tat‌ kimarthamatra lopa vidhīyate? ityata āha--`savarṇadīrghatve hi' ityādi| `atikrāntā sakhī enam‌' iti `prādibhyo dhātujasya' (vā.101) iti bahuvrīhiruttarapadalopaśca, upasarjanahrasvatvam‌| tatra yadi savarṇadīrghattvaṃ kriyeta, na tu lopastadā sakhīkārekārayorekādeśaḥ sakhiśabdasyāntavadbhavatīti `śeṣo dhyasakhi' (1.4.7) itaci dhisaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌| tataścātisakherāganacchatīti `gheṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇo na syāt‌| lope satyupasarjanahrasvatve sati yadyapi praviśiṣṭaṃ rūpam‌, tathāpi lākṣaṇikam‌| ato lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) tanna gṛhyata iti na bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ| tasmāllopa eva karttavyaḥ| `dauleyaḥ' ityudāharaṇatraye `itaśṭacāniñaḥ' (4.1.122) ityapatyārthe ḍhak‌| `kumārī iti| `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti ṅīp‌| `gaurī' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ‌| `śārṅgaravī' iti| `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn‌' (4.1.73)| `bālākiḥ saumitriḥ' iti| bālakasumitrābhyāṃ bahvāditvādiñ‌| `yasyetyādau' iti| ādiśabdenottaro vidhiḥ parigṛhyate| vaktavya iti vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vibhāṣā ṅiśyoḥ' (6.4.136) ityetatsūtrādvibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena cānena sūtreṇa lopo vidhīyate, yaścottarasūtreṇa, tāvubhāvapi na bhavata iti| `kāṇḍe, kuḍaye' iti| `auṅa āpaḥ' (7.1.18) iti, `napuṃsakācca' (7.1.19) iti śobhāva iti, tatra yasyetyakāralopaḥ prāpnoti| `saurye' iti| `tenaikadik‌' (4.3.112) iti sūryaśabdādaṇ‌, tadantādauṅaḥ śībhāvaḥ, tatrānenākāralopaḥ prāpnoti, uttarasūtrema yakāralopaśca| `iyaṅvaṅabhyām‌' ityādi| iyaṅuvaṅoravakāśaḥ--śriyau, śriyaḥ, bhruvau bhruvaḥ, lopasyāvakāśaḥ--kāmaṇḍaleyaḥ, mādrabāheya iti; vātsapreyaḥ, laikhābhreya ityatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti, lopo bhavati vipratiṣedhena| `vatsaprīḥ' iti| kvibantametat‌|| 149. sūryatiṣyāgastyamatasyānāṃ ya upadhāyāḥ| (6.4.149) yadyatra bhasaṃjñayā sūryādayo viśiṣyeran‌--`sūryādīnāṃ bhasaṃjñakānāmiti, tadā saurī, balāketyatra lopo na syāt‌| na hi sūryaśabda iha bhasaṃjñaka iti, kiṃ tarhi? anyedavāṇantaṃ śabdāntaramiti buddhau nidhāyānāśritarūpabhedasya lopena sambandhaḥ sūryādibhiḥ sambandhibhiryakāro viśiṣyata iti darśayannāha--`sūryativyāgastyamatsya--`ityetevām‌' ityādi| `bhasya' iti| bhasaṃjñakasya| yo yakāra upadhā, tasya lopo bhavati sa cedyakāraḥ sūryādīnāṃ sambandhī bhavati--ayamatarārtho vivakṣitaḥ| te tu sūryādayo bhatvena na viśiṣyatante| tena yadāpi teṣāṃ bhasaṃjñā na bhavati, tadāpi tasyopadhāyakārasya lopo bhavatyeva yadyasau yakāraḥ sūryādīnāṃ sambandhī bhavati| `saurī, balākā' iti| nanu cātrākāralopasya vyāśrayatvenāsiddhatvaṃ nāstītyupadhāyakāro na bhavatītyetaduktam‌? ityāha--`aṇi yo yasyeti lopaḥ' ityādi| atra hi dvau yasyetilāpau--eko'ṇiparataḥ, apara īkāre| tatra prathamo vyāśrayaḥ, tathā hi--lopo'ṇamāśritya bhavati, yalopastvīkāram‌ ato vyāśrayatvādasiddhatvābhāvastasya yuktaḥ| itarastvīkāramāśritya bhavati samānāśraya eva, tataśca tasyāsiddhattvādupadhāyakāro bhavati| `bhasyāṇantasya' ittayādinā sūtrārthamudāharaṇe darśayati| `taiṣam‌, taiṣī' iti| `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' (4.2.3) ityaṇ‌, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌| `ṛṣitvādaṇi kṛte' iti| `ṛṣyandhaka' (4.1.114) ityādinā `matsyacarī' iti| matsyo bhūtapūrvaḥ--`bhūtapūrve caraṭ‌' (5.3.53) pūrvavanṅīp‌| bhavatyatra matsyacara iti bhasaṃjñakamatsyasambandhī yakāraḥ, natvasau bhasaṃjñakasyopadeti lopo na pravarttate| atha kimarthaṃ yagrahaṇam‌, yāvatā sūryādibhirūpadhāyāṃ viśiṣyamāṇāyāmantareṇāpi yagrahaṇaṃ yakārasyopadhābhūtasya lopo vijñāsyate, yakāra eva hi teṣāmupadhā, na tu varṇāntaram‌? ityata āha--`yagrahaṇamuttarārtham‌' iti| `vaktavyam‌' iti vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānantvihāpi pūrvavadvibhāṣāmāśritya karttavyam‌| `mātsyam‌' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.2.120) ityaṇ‌| `saurīyam‌' iti| aṇantāt‌ `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114)| evaṃ `āgastīyam‌' iti| `sauryam‌' iti| sūryo devata'syeti `sā|ḍasya devatā (4.2.24) ityaṇ| `āgastyaḥ' iti| apatyārthe ṛṣyaṇ‌| `nakṣatrāṇi' iti| nakṣatrasambandho yo'ṇ‌ tasminnityarthaḥ| `kakārādeḥ śabdasya' iti| kakārasyākārasyetyarthaḥ| `ādyudāttatvañca' iti| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttatve prāpte satyādyudāttārthaṃ vacanam‌| `antitaḥ' iti| `apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ' (5.4.45) iti tasiḥ| `tādeśca' iti| tikaśabdasyetyartha| cakārāt‌ kādeśca| `antamaḥ' iti| atiśāyane tamap‌' (5.3.55)| `antiṣat‌' iti| `satsūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip‌| `ye ca' iti| dṛśyata iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `antimaḥ' iti| `bhave chandasi' (4.4.110) iti yaḥ, `tatra sādhuḥ' (4.4.98) iti vā| kecit‌ sarvameva lopavidhānaṃ chandasyevecchanti|| 150. halastaddhitasya| (6.4.150) `taddhita iti nivṛttam‌' iti| uttarasūtre taddhitagrahaṇāt‌| tenāyamītyeva vidhiḥ| `gārgī' ityādi| gargādiśabdebhyo yañantebhyaḥ `yañaśca' (4.1.16) iti ṅīp‌| `kārikeyī' iti| `strībhyo ḍhak‌' (4.1.120), tadantāt‌ `ṭiṅḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌| `vaidhī' iti| `puṃyogādākhyāyām‌' (4.1.48) iti ṅīṣ‌|| 151. āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti| (6.4.151) `gārgakam‌' iti| `gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhra' (4.2.39) ityādinā gārgyaśabdādvuñ‌, tatra yaño lopaḥ| `sāṅkākhyakaḥ' iti| `kāmpilyakaḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ saṅkāśakampilaśabdābhyāñcāturārthikaḥ `duñchaṇ‌' (4.2.80) ityādinā ṇyaḥ, tadantājjātādau śaiṣike'rthe `dhanvayopadhād‌vuñ‌' (4.2.121) iti vuñ‌| atha taddhitagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti taddhitagrahaṇamanuvar‌ttiṣyate? ityata āha--`taddhitagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| somī devatasyeti `somāṭṭyaṇ‌' (4.2.30), `ṭiṅḍhāṇaña' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌| tatra parato'napatyayakārasyāpi `halastaddhitasya' (6.4.150) ityanena lopo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇam‌; anyathā yadi tadeva prakṛtaṃ taddhitagrahaṇamihānurteta, tadā tatsambanddhamīdgrahaṇamanuvartteta| tathā cobhayamihānuvarttamānaṃ pūrvayāge'pyanuvarttata| tathā ca pūrveṇaiva yogena siddhe satyubhayatra taddhita ī, ti ca niyamārtho'yamārambhaḥ syāt‌--āpatyasyevānākārādau taddhite lopo bhavati īti ca nānāpatye ca| evañca yathānapatyasya sāṅkaśyaka ityatra lopo na bhaviṣyati, tathā saumī iṣṭirityatrāpi na syāt‌; niyamena vyavarttitatvāt‌| iha tu taddhitagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe pūrvayoge taddhitagrahaṇasya nivṛttirākhyāyate| tena parvayogena taddhitamātrasya yakārasyānapatyasya cāpatyasya cāviśeṣeṇa lopo vidīyate| saumī iṣṭirityatrāpi lopo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇam‌| nanu ca yadyubhayatra taddhita iti cāyaṃ niyamaḥ syāt‌ sūtradvayasyārtho'pārthakaḥ syāt‌| `hala āpatyasyānāti' ityekameva yogaṃ kuryāt‌| tasmāt‌ sūtradvayasyārambhasāmarthyādanyatarasyaivehānuvṛttirbhavatiṣyati, na tūbhayasyāpi| iha tvetāvān‌ sandehaḥ syāt‌--kiṃ taddhitagrahaṇamihānuvarttate, utedgrahaṇamiti? atrāpi taddhitagrahaṇamanuvarttate, nedgrahaṇamiti; vyākhyānāt‌| saravasandeheṣvidamupatiṣṭhate `bhavati vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattirna hi sandehādalakṣaṇam‌' (pu.pa.vṛ 120) iti| taddhitagrahaṇe ca kevala ihānuvarttamāne taddhitaviṣaya evāyaṃ niyamo bhaviṣyati, na tvīdviṣaya iti| tathā cāsatyapi punariha taddhitagrahaṇa iti niyamābhāvāt‌ pūrvasūtreṇa saumī iṣṭirityatrāpi lopaḥ siddhyatyeva| tat‌ kathamidamuktam‌--taddhitagrahaṇītyanapatyasyāpi lopārthamiti? sukhena lopaḥ pratīyata ityetadarthamidamityabhiprāyo draṣṭavyaḥ| tataścāyamatrārthaḥ sampadyate--pratipattigauravaparīhārārthaṃ taddhitagrahaṇam‌| `gārgyāyaṇaḥ' iti| `yañiñośca' (4.1.101) iti phak‌| `kārakeyiḥ' iti| kārikāyā apatyamiti `strībyo ḍhak‌' (4.1.120), tatastasyāpatyam‌, `ata iñ‌' (4.1.95) kārikeyiḥ|| 152. kyacvyośca| (6.4.152) ataddhitārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `kya' iti kyackyaṅoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam‌| `gārgīyati iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8), `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam‌| `gārgīyaḥ' iti| `karttuḥ kyaṅa salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti kyaṅa, `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ| `gārgībhūtaḥ' iti| `abhūtatadbhāve' (5.4.50) iti cviḥ, `asya cvau' (7.4.32) itīttvam‌|| 153. bilvakādibhyaśchasya luk‌| (6.4.153) `bilvakadibhyaḥ' iti| āgantukenākāreṇa nirdeśaḥ| `bilvakīyā' iti| `utkarādibhyaśchaḥ' (4.2.90) `naḍādīnāṃ kukca' (4.2.91) iti cāturarthikaśchaḥ, kugāgamaḥ| `bailvakāḥ' iti| `prāgdīṣyate'ṇ‌' (4.1.83)| atha chagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā kṛtakugāgamā bilvakīdayo gṛhītāḥ, ebhyaśchapratyayaḥ sambhavatītyantareṇāpi chagrahaṇaṃ chasyaiva lopo bhavitavyatīti? ata āha--`chagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yadi chagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā sanniyogaśiṣṭaparibhāṣayā (ha.bhā.14) chakāre nivartamāne kuko nivṛttiḥ syāt‌| tasyāśca paribhāṣayā etedeva chagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam‌| atha luggrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, prakṛta eva lopo vidhīyate? ityata āha--`luggrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yakāragrahaṇamekadeśopalakṣaṇārthaṃ draṣṭavyam‌| sa hi lopa upadhāyā ityanena sambaddha iti tasminnanuvartamāne `ya upadhāyāḥ' (6.4.149) ityetadapyunuvartteta, chasyeyādeśe kṛte yakāramātrasya syāt‌| athāpi `upadhāyāḥ' ityetannānuvartteta? evamapi `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) itīkāramātrasya syāt‌| `luggrahaṇam‌' iti| lugiti pratyayādarśanasyaiṣā saṃjñā, na tu pratyasyaikadeśasyādarśanasyeti| luggrahaṇe sati sarvasyaiva luk‌ siddhyati| tadrathaṃ hi luggrahaṇam‌|| 154. turiṣṭhemayassu| (6.4.154) `tuḥ' iti| viseṣakarānanubandhānutsṛjya tṛṃstṛcoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam‌| `kariṣṭhaḥ' iti| karotestṛn‌| tadantādatiśāyana iṣṭhan‌, tṛśabdasya lopaḥ| `vijayiṣṭhaḥ' iti| vipūrvājjayatestṛn‌| `vahiṣṭhaḥ' iti| atrāpi vahestṛn‌| tadantādiṣṭhan‌, `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌| tṛśabdasya lope karttavye `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) ityasiddham‌, tena pūrvalopa eva kriyate, tasmin‌ kṛte jhali yadānte ca vidhīyamānaṃ ḍhatvaṃ nimittābhāvānna pravarttete| `dohīyasī' iti| duhestṛjantādīyasun‌, `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp‌| atrāpi lope karttavye `dāderdhātordhaḥ' (8.2.32) ityetadapyasiddhamiti pūrvaṃ lopaḥ, tasmin‌ sati pūrvavaddhatvaṃ na pravarttate| atha `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityantyasyāyaṃ lopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`sarvasya' ityādi| tatraiva kāraṇamāha--`antyasya' ityādi| yadyantyasya syādvacanavaiyarthyamāpadyeta; `antyasya ṭeḥ' ityevaṃ siddhatvāt‌| tasmādantyalopavacane prayojanaṃ nāstīti sarvasya tṛśabdasya lopo yatā syādityevamarthamidaṃ vacanaṃ vijñāyate| yadi tarhi tṛśabdasya lopārthaṃ vacanamanantaro lugeva kasmānna vidhīyate, evaṃ tarhi sarvasya sukhameva lopo'vasīyate, pratyayādarśanasya lugvidhānāt‌? ityata āha--`lugityetattu' ityādi| kaḥ punastatra sati doṣaḥ syāt‌? ityata āba--`tathā hi' ityādi| yadi lugityetadihānuvarttata, tataḥ `antaraṅgānapi vidhīn‌ bahiraṅgo lug‌ bādhate' (vyā.pa.128) iti kṛtvā pūrvaṃ lukā bhavitavyam‌, tataśca `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇaniṣedhaḥ syāt‌; kariṣṭhaḥ, vijayiṣṭha ityatrārdhadātukalakṣaṇo guṇo na syāt‌| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti lugityetadihānuvarttate| athemanijgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā tṛśabdāt‌ para imānijna sambhavati| tathāpi `pṛdhvādibhya imānijvā' (5.1.122) `varmadṛḍhādibhyaḥ vyañca' (5.1.123) ityanena yogadvayena sa vihitaḥ, na tṛśabdāntaṃ kiñcit‌ pṛthvādiṣu dṛḍhādiṣu vā madhye paṭhyate, nāpi varṇavācyastītyata āha--`itarau tu' ityādī|| 155. ṭeḥ| (6.4.155) `ṇāviṣṭhavat‌' iti| `tasilādiṣvā kṛtvasucaḥ' (6.3.35) iṣṭhani puṃvadbhāva uktaḥ, `ra ṛto halāderlaghoḥ' (6.4.161) iti rabhāvaḥ, `ṭeḥ' iti ṭilopaḥ, `sthūladūrayuvahrasva' (6.4.156) ityādinā yaṇādiparasya lopaḥ, pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ, `vinmatorluk‌' (5.3.65) iti luk‌, `yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyām‌' (5.3.64) iti kan‌| `priyasthira' (6.4.157) ityādinā prādaya ādeśāḥ--etāni kāryāṇi yatheṣṭhani bhavanti, tathā ṇāvapi yathā syuriti ṇāviṣṭhavat‌ prātipadikasya kāryaṃ bhavatīti vaktavyam‌| prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ śakyamakarttum‌, anyasyātideśasyāsambhavāt‌| vatiriha sādṛśyārthaḥ, tena yasyeṣṭhani yatkāryaṃ vivakṣitaṃ tato'nyasyātideśasyāsambhavāt‌ tadvyavacchedārtha prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌| tat‌ kriyate visapaṣṭārtham‌| kecittu bruvate pratyayasya kāryāṇāmatideśo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ prātipadikagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌| tat‌ kriyate vispaṣṭārtham‌| kecittu bruvate pratyayasya kāryāṇāmatideśo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ prātipadikagrahaṇ‌, tena bahumācaṣṭe bahayatatyatra `iṣṭhasya yiṭ‌ ca' (6.4.158) iti yiṇṇa bhavati? etaccāyuktam‌; iṣṭhavadityatra hi saptamī samarthādvatirdihitaḥ, ṇāditi pratiyogini sapatamīśravaṇāt‌| teneṣṭhani yatkāryaṃ vihitaṃ tadatidiśyate, na tviṣṭhasya yatkāryaṃ tadapi| na ca yiṅ‌ iṣṭhani yat‌ kāryam‌, api tviṣṭhana eva| tasyaiha prāptireva nāstīti kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena prātipadikagrahaṇena! `enīm‌' iti| etacchabdāt‌ `varṇādanudāttāttopadhāt‌' (4.1.39) ityādinā ṅīṣ‌, takārasya ca nakāraḥ| `etayati' iti| ṇau kṛte puṃvadbhāvena ṅīṣnakārāvubhāvapi nivarttete| nanu ca ṅīṣā vyavahito'tra ṇiriti ṇāvatideśaḥ kriyamāṇastadvyavadhāne na prāpnotīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iṣṭhanyapi hi ṅopā vyavadhānaeva prātipadakasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ| tasmādihāpi vyavadhāne'pi tadvadeva bhaviṣyati| `sragviṇam‌' iti| `asmāyāmedhāsrajo viniḥ' (5.2.121) iti viniḥ| srajayatītyatra `saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' (vyā.pa.64) iti `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhirna bhavati| `ahgavṛtte punaraṅgavṛttāvavidhirniṣṭhitasya' (vyā.pa.38) iti vapā| prāpayatītyevamādau bhavatyevāniṣṭhitatvāt‌| atra `arttihro' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk‌| nanu bhāradvājīyapāṭhe prādayo na siddhyanti; api tu srajayati vasayatīti luk‌, kanayatītyatra ca kannityata āha--`tadetadubhayamapyudāharaṇamātram‌' ityādi| tadetadbhāvadvājīyapāṭhe anyeṣāñca prayojanamupadarśitam‌, na tvetadudāharaṇamātraparigaṇanam‌| etāvadeva prayojanamiti yasmāt‌ prādayo'pīṣyante| nanu `prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca' (dhā.pā.ga.sū.186) iti curādigaṇa eva paṭhyate, tat‌ kasmāt‌ punariha ṇāviṣṭhavadbhāva ucyate? asyaiva prapañcārthamityeke| gaṇe vā sa vaktavyaḥ| `asau itaraḥ' iti vikalpapradarśanārthamityanye|| 156. sthūladūrayuvahvasvakṣiprakṣudrāṇāṃ yaṇādiparaṃ pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ| (6.4.156) yadyapi pūrvaṃ bhāvasādhano lopaśabda upāttaḥ, tathāpīha karmasādhano gṛhyate; yaṇādiparimiti nirdeśāt‌| bhāvasādhane hi tasmin‌ `karttṛkarmaṇaoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti ṣaṣṭhī syāt‌| karmasādhane tu karmaṇastenaiṣābhihitatvāt‌ prathamaiva yujyata iti manyamāno lāpaśabdasya karmaśabdasya karmasādhanatāṃ darśayannāha--`yaṇādiparaṃ lupyate' iti| kathaṃ punastasyaiva bhāvasādhanasya sataḥ karmasādhanatopapadyate? kaḥ punarāha--`tasyaiva' iti! pratisūtraṃ hyanuvarttamāno lopaśabdo bhidyate| nanu ca yaṇādau parasmin‌ lupte sāmarthyāt‌ tatpūrvasyaiva guṇo vijñāsyate, tat‌ kimarthaṃ pūrvagrahaṇam‌? ityāha--`pūrvagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌' ti|| 157. priyasthirasphirorubahulaguruvṛddhatṛpradīrghavṛndārakāṇāṃ prasthasphavaṃrbahigarvarṣitrabdrāghivṛndāḥ| (6.4.157) kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ priyorugurudīrghāṇāmevemanijudāhriyate, nānyeṣām‌? ityāha--`priyorubahulagurudīrghāḥ' ityādi| `priyādibhya evemanic‌ sambhavati, nānyebhyaḥ' ityevamparametadvākyamityarthaḥ| anyathā yadyapi priyādaya eva pṛthtrādiṣu paṭhyante, varṇāvācino vā syuḥ, tadodāhriyetemanic‌ teṣāmityakāraṇamedimanico'trodāharaṇaṃ syāt‌|| 158. bahorlopo bhū ca bahoḥ| (6.4.158) `bahoruttareṣām‌' iti| etena prathamasya bahoḥ pañcamyantatāṃ darśayati, tasya ca vahorityanenāpi dvitīyasya ṣaṣṭhyantatām‌| `bhūyān‌' iti| `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) itīkārasyava lopaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ bahoriti punargrahaṇam‌? ityāha--`bahoriti panaḥ' ityādi| asati hi bahoriti grahaṇe bahuśabdasya sthānitvaṃ na pratīyeta; pañcamyantena nirdeśāt‌| tasmāt‌ sthānitvapratipattaye punarbahorityacyate| `anyathā hi' ityādi| yadi bahoḥ iti nocyeta, tadā pratyayānāmeva bhūbhāvaḥ syāt‌; `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti vacanāt‌| nanu pṛthagnirdeśādeva pratyayānāṃ na bhaviṣyati, anyathā `bhūlopau' ityayaṃ brūyāt‌? naitadasti; asti hyanyat‌ pṛthagnirdeśasya prayojanam‌| kim‌? pṛthak‌sthānikau yathā stātām‌, ādermā bhūtāmiti| yadi `bhūlopau' ityevamucyeta, tadā `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityādyasyaiva varṇasya paryāyeṇa bhūlopo syātāmiti| ato bhinnasthānikau yatā syātāmityevamarthaḥ pṛthagyoganirdeśaḥ syāt‌| tasmādyuktamuktam‌--`anyathā hi pratyayānāmeva bhūbhāvaḥ syāt‌' iti| cakāro'tra sanniyogārthaḥ|| 159. iṣṭhasya yiṭ ca| (6.4.159) `lopāpavādo yiṅāgamaḥ' iti| nāprāpte tasminnasyārambhāt‌| `tasminnikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ' iti| prayojanāntarābhāvāt‌| cakāraḥ `bahośca bhūḥ' ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 160. jyādādīyasaḥ| (6.4.160) `jyāyān‌' iti| `praśasyasya śraḥ' (5.3.60) `jya ca' (5.3.61) iti jyādeśaḥ| `lopasya yiṭ‌ ca' iyādi| yadyatra lopo yiṭā na vyavadhīyate tadā tenaiva jyāyānityetat‌ siddhyatīti kṛtvā''diti nocyetetyabhiprāyaḥ| kathaṃ punarādityanucyamāne lopena siddhayati? ityata āha--`lope hi sati' ityādi| atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatāntaratamyādeva dīrghasya dīrgha eva bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; na hi `bhāvyamāno'ṇ‌ savarṇān‌ na gṛhṇāti' (vyā.pa.35) iti|| 161. ra ṛto halāderlaghoḥ| (6.4.161) `karttavyam‌' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--uttarasūtre yadvibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ tadihāpi sambadhyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena pṛthvādīnāmeva bhaviṣyati| yadyevam‌, `halāderlaghoḥ' ityetanna karttavyam‌, vyavasthitavibhāṣayā halāderlaghośca bhaviṣyati? satyametat‌; tadvispaṭārthaṃ kriyate| `tata iha na bhavati' ityādi| akriyamāṇe tu parigaṇane kṛtayatītyādāvapīṣṭhavadbāvena syādeveti bhāvaḥ|| 162. vibhāṣarjośchandasi| (6.4.162) 163. prakṛtyaikāc‌| (6.4.163) `srajiṣṭhaḥ' iti| atra prakṛtivadbhāvena ṭilopo na bhavati| nanu ca `vinmatorluk‌' (5.3.65) ṭilopaṃ bādhiṣyate, nāprāpte tvasmiṃstvasyārambhāt‌? naitadasti; dvau ṭilopau--eko vinmatvantasya, anyo luki kṛte satyavaśiṣṭasya; tatra yo'sau vinmatvantasya ṭilopastasminnāprāpte lugārabhyata iti yuktaṃ yadasau taṃ bādhate| yastvavaśiṣṭasya ṭilopastasya prāglukprāptyasambhavādaprāpta eva tasminnārabhyamāṇaḥ kathaṃ paścādupajātaprāptikaṃ lopaṃ bādheta| tasmādārabdhavyamidam‌| `prakṛtyāke rājanya' ityādi| kiṃ vaktavyametat‌? na; kathaṃ tarhi `turiṣṭhemeyastu' (6.4.154) ityetannivṛttam‌| sāmānyenayaṃ prakṛtivadbhāvo vidheyaḥ, vibhāṣati cānuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena yatra yatreṣyate tatra sarvatra bhaviṣyati, yatra tu neṣyate tatra na bhaviṣyatyeva| evam‌ `inaṇyanapatye' (6.4.164) ityevamādikaṃ prakṛtibhāvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāditi cet‌? na; prapañcārthatvāt‌| `rājanyakam‌' iti| `rājño'patyam‌' iti| `rājño'patyam‌' iti `rājaruṣasurādyat‌' (4.1.137) tasmātsamūherthe `gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhra' (4.2.39) ityādinātra vuñ‌| `mānuṣyakam‌' iti| manorapatyamiti `manorjātāvañyatau ṣukca' (4.1.169) iti yeṣāṃ mate'patyārthe yat‌, teṣāṃ pūrvasūtreṇa vuñi kṛte lopaḥ prāpnoti, sa prakṛtibāvānnivarttate| yeṣāntu matena jātimātre yat‌, nāpatye, teṣāṃ nārthaḥ prakṛtibhāvena; anāpatyayakāratvādeva hi lopo na bhaviṣyati|| 164. inaṇyanapatye| (6.4.164) `sāṅakūṭinam‌, sāṃrāviṇam‌, sāmmārjinam‌' iti| `kūṭa dāhe' (dhā.pā.1890), [paritāpe (paridāhe)--dhā.pā.] `ru śabde' (dhā.pā.1034), `mṛjū śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1066) `abhividhau bhāve inuṇ‌' (3.3.44), `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114) sāṃkūṭin‌, sāṃrāvin‌, sāṃmārjin‌--iti sthite `aṇinuṇaḥ' (5.4.15) iti svarthe'ṇ‌| `maidhāvaḥ' iti| `asmāyā' (5.2.121) ityādinā viniḥ, tadantāt‌ prāgdīvyato'ṇapatyārthe|| 165. (5.4.85) ityac‌|| 170. na mapūrvo'patye'varmaṇaḥ| (6.4.170) `cārmaṇaḥ' iti| `parivṛtto rathaḥ' (4.2.10) ityarthe `prāgdīvyato'ṇ‌' (4.1.83)| `vā hitanāmna iti vaktavyam' iti| hitanāmaśabdasya va pratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityrathaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--ihāpi tadeva vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tena hitanāmno vā pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati|| 171. brāhmo'jātau| (6.4.171) yadyetadekameva sūtraṃ syāt tato nimamārtha vā smāt‌? vidhyarthaṃ vā? yadyapatya iti varttate, tato'nantara sūtreṇaiva prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ siddhyatyeva, siddhe satyetanniyamārtha bhaviṣyati--`ajātāvevāpatyārthe yathā syāt‌' iti| tathā ca `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇi vihite brāhmo garbhaḥ, brāhmamastram‌, brāhmaṃ haviḥ, brāhmī oṣadhiriti na siddhyati; apatyāṇo'bhāvāt‌| athāpatya iti nivṛttam‌, tato vidhyarthameva bhaviṣyati| apatye hi pūrvasūtreṇa prakṛtibāvaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ, tataśca `an‌' (6.4.167) iti iti prakṛtibhāve prāpte'jāto brāhma ityetaṭṭilopārthaṃ nipātyate| evañca vidhyarthe'smin‌ siddham--brāhmo garbhaḥ, brāhmaṇastram‌, brāhmaṃ haviriti; brahmaṇa iyaṃ brāhmī oṣadirityetattu na siddhyet; `ajātau' iti pratiṣedhāt‌| apatye jātau ca `na mapūrvo'patye'varmaṇaḥ' (6.4.17)) iti prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe sati `nastaddhite'(6.4.144) iti bhavati ṭilopaḥ--brāhmo nārada iti, tathehāpi syāt‌--brahmaṇo'patyamiti brāhmaṇa iti| evamekayoge doṣaprasaṅgamabhivīkṣya tat‌ parijihīrṣurāha--`yogavibhāgho'tra kriyate' iti| yogavibhāge sati yadi `apatye' ityanuvṛtterapatya eva ṭilopo nipātyate, pūrvavat‌ siddhe sati niyamārthameva nipātanaṃ syāt‌, tataśca sa doṣastadavastha eva syāt‌, yaḥ prāṅaniyamapakṣe uktaḥ| tathā ca yogavibhāgakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmādapatyādhikāro'pi yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyādapatyādanyatara `brāhmaḥ' ityetannipātyate| evamanapatye'pi `brāhmaḥ' iti nipātanāt‌ `brāhmo garbhaḥ, brāhmastram‌, brāhma havirityetat‌ siddhyati| tataḥ `ajātau' ityayaṃ dvitīyo yogaḥ| `na mapūrvo'patye'varmaṇaḥ' (6.4.170) iti prakṛtibhāve pratiṣiddhe yaḥ `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ, sa mā bhūdityevamartho'patya ityeveti| etenāsmindvitīye yoge `apatye' ityanuvartata ityācaṣṭe| `ajātau' iti ca prasajyapratiṣedho'yam‌| tatra jāterapatyārthena sambandhaḥ, nañsatu bhavatinā| tamevārthaṃ vṛttau darśayannāha--`apatye jātāvaṇi brāhmaṇa iti lopo na bhavati' iti| jātiviśiṣṭe|patye vivakṣite'ṇi parato brāhmaṇa ityatra ṭilopo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| apatya ityeva--`brahmo oṣadhiḥ' iti| pratyudāhaṇavyājena yogavibhāge jātimātravivakṣyāṃ brāhmī oṣadhirityetadapi siddhaṃ bhavatīti darśayati|| 172. kārmastācchīlye| (6.4.172) `yadyevam‌' iti| yadi ṇakāro'tra pratyayaḥ, evaṃ sati kimarthamidam‌? naivāsya prayojanaṃ kiñcidityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam‌? ityāha--`nastaddhita ityevaṃ hi' ityādi| yaddhi lakṣaṇena na prāpnoti tadarthaṃ nipātanamārabhyate, iha tu `nastaddhine' (6.4.144) ityevaṃ siddhaḥ, na hi ṇe kenacit‌ prakṛtibhāva ukto yatastatra ṭilopātanamārabhyamāṇamidamarthavatsyāt‌| aṇi hi prakṛtibhāvo'ṇantasyoktaḥ, na tu ṇe| anantaroktamarthamabhyupagacchati--yadi satyam‌, kimarthamidamityāha--`jñāpakārtham‌' ityādi| `aṇkṛtāni' ityādi| aṇi kṛtāni kāryāṇi aṣkṛtāni, `saptamau' (2.1.40) iti yogāvibhāgātsamāsaḥ| atha vā aṇā kṛtāni `kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam‌ (2.1.32) iti samāsaḥ| `kimetasya jñāpanena prayojanam‌? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| curā śīlamasyāḥ, tapaḥ śīlamasyā iti `chattrādibhyo ṇaḥ' (4.4.62) iti ṇaḥ, tadantanṅīp‌| `tācchīlike ṇaḥ' ityasyārthasya jñāpitatvāt‌ `tadasyāṃ praharaṇamiti krīḍāyāṃ ṇaḥ' (4.2.57) iti daṇḍāt‌ ṇe dāṇḍeti--aṇkṛtaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavati| yadi tarhi tācchīlakeṣvaṇkṛtamiṣyeta, aṇeva chattrādibhyaḥ kasmānnocyeta, tatrāpyayamarthaḥ--jñāpanārthaṃ nipātanaṃ karttavyaṃ na bhavati? yuktametaduktavānasi; vaicitryārtha tvaṇkṛtaḥ| `kārmaṇam‌' iti| `tadyuktāt‌ karmaṇo'ṇ‌' (5.4.36) ityaṇ‌| karmaṇā yuktaṃ kārmaṇamiti|| 173. aukṣamanapatye| (6.4.173) `aukṣaṃ padam‌' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌|| 174. dāṇḍināyanahāstināyanātharvaṇikajaihmāśineyavāsināyanibhrauṇhatyedhaivatyasāravaikṣvākamaitreyahiraṇmayāni| (6.4.174) `upacārād‌ grantho'pyatharvannityucyate' iti| upacārasya tu tatproktatvameva ityanenaiva takāraḥ siddhaḥ, tatkiṃ nipātyate? ityāha--`inasto'ciṇṇaloḥ' ityādi| `dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kāryasampratyaya eva' (jai.vṛ.31)| `dhātoḥ' (6.1.162) ityevaṃ yo vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ, punarvijñāpate--dhātoḥ svarūpagrahaṇe tatpratyaye kāryaṃ bhavatīti? naitadasti; `na kvādeḥ' (7.3.59) ityatra hi neti yogadibhāgādapi śakyate kutvanivṛttiḥ karttum‌| `bhrauṇadhnaḥ vartradhnaḥ' iti| apatyārthe'ṇ‌| ikṣvākuśabdādyadā `janapadaśabdāt‌' (4.1.138) ityādināñ‌ bhavati, tadaikṣvākaśabdo ñitsvareṇādyudāttaḥ| yadā tu `kopadhāt‌' (4.2.132) iti śaiṣiko'ṇ‌, tadāntodāttaḥ| nanu caivaṃvidhasūtra ekasyopādāne'parasya grahaṇaṃ na siddhyati, tasmādubhayorapi svarabhinnayorupādānaṃ karttavyam‌--`eśvakaḥ, aikṣvakaḥ' iti| etaccodyamapākarttumāha--`svarasarvanāmnā' ityādi| udāttādīnāṃ svarāṇā mavibhāgenoccāraṇam‌, ekaśrutiḥ| sā ca svarāṇāṃ sarvanāmeva sarvanāma yathaiva hi `tasyāpatyam‌' (4.1.92) ityādau nirdeśa upaguprabhṛtīnviśeṣānvibhāgena pratipadayati, tataikaśrutirapyudāttādīnsvaraviśeṣān‌| tathātrāyamaikṣvākaśabdaḥ paṭhyate--nāpyādyudātto nāpyantodāttaḥ, tasya tvevaṃ paṭhitasya pratyayaviśeṣātsvaraviśeṣo bhavati--yadāñ‌ tadāntādottaḥ| `ityādeśāpavādaḥ' iti| kekayādi (7.3.2) sūtreṇeyādeśaḥ prāpnoti, tadapavādo lopo nipātyate| `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| `atha kimartham‌' iti| yenābhiprāyeṇa pṛṣṭavāṃstaṃ svayamevāviṣkarttumāha--`tato'ñi kṛte] ityādi| `siddham‌' iti| rūpasvarūpayorabhedāt‌| `yalopārthaśca' ityādinā bidādiṣu pāṭhe yo guṇastaṃ darśayati| `yaskādiṣu ca' ityādi| tatra hi tasya bahuṣu gotrapratyayasya lugyathā syādityevamarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ| sa ca lugbidādiṣu pāṭhe sati `yañañośca' (2.4.64) ityanenaiva siddhyatīti nārtho yaskādiṣu pāṭhena| `maitreyaḥ saṅghaḥ' ityādi| etena bidādiṣu pāṭhe yo doṣastaṃ darśayati| bidādiṣu pāṭhe sati sarvametadupapadyate yaduktavānāsi; kintu maitreyaśabdādañantāt‌ `saṅghāṅkalakṣaṇa' (4.3.127) ityādināṇpratyayaḥ syāt‌, tato maitreya ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌, na tu maitreyaka ityabhīṣṭam‌| ḍhañantāt‌ tu `gotracaraṇādvuñ‌' (4.3.126) bhavatīti maitreyaka ityabhīṣṭaṃ siddhyati| `hiraṇmayaḥ' iti| `mayaṅvaitayorbhāṣāyām‌' (4.3.143) iti mayaṭ‌|| 175. ṛtvyavāstvāstvyamādhvīhiraṇyayāni cchandasi| (6.4.175) `ṛtvyam‌, vāstvyam‌' iti| `bhave chandasi' (4.4.110) iti yat‌| `vāstvam‌' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| evaṃ `mādhvī' ityatrāpi| `hiraṇyayaḥ' iti| pūrvavanmayaṭ‌|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācāryaśrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivarahaṇapañjikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ|| <7> <7.1> śrībodhisattvadeśīyācārthajinendrabuddhipādaviracitā nyāsāparaparyāyā kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikākhyā kāśikāvyākhyā saptamo'dhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ pādaḥ 1. yuvoranākau| (7.1.1) śāstrasya lāghavārthamiha, yuvū pratyayāvupadiṣṭau, tayoḥ sthāne'nākāvādeśau vidhīyate| yadi hi yatra yatra yuvorupadeśastatra tatrānākāvādeśo vidhiyeyātām‌, tadā śāstrasya gauravaṃ syāt‌; tayoḥ prabhūtavarṇasamudāyātmakatvāt‌| iha yuvoranunāsikayaṇoḥ pratyayayoridaṃ grahaṇam‌, na ca tathāvidhāvananubandhakau yuvū śāstre sambhavataḥ; tatra sāmarthyādviśeṣakarānanubandhānutsṛjya sāmānyena tayorgrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate? ityāha--`yuvu--ityetayorutsṛṣṭaviśeṣaṇayoḥ' iti| idaṃ grahaṇamiti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| viśeṣaṇaṃ yadyoyogaṃ lakārādi, tadutsṛṣṭaṃ parityaktaṃ yayostau yathoktau| etena `yuvo' iti lyuḍādīnāṃ sāmānyena nirdeśa iti darśayati| yadyatra yuvorityāviśeṣeṇa grahaṇaṃ syāt‌ tadā `yu miśraṇe' (dhā.pā.1033) [`yu miśraṇe'miśraṇeṃ ca'--dhā.pā.] yutaḥ, yutavān‌, yutvā; `diṣu krīḍādau (dhā.pā.1107) dyūtaḥ, dhūtavān‌, dhūtvā; `ūrṇāyā yus‌' (5.2.123) ūrṇāyurityevamādāvapyanākau syātām‌, ato'syātiprasaṅganirāsāyāha--`anunāsikayaṇoḥ' iti| anunāsiko yaṇyayoriti bahuvrīhiḥ| santi hi yaṇaḥ sānunāsikāḥ niranunāsakāśca, tatra hi yayoranunāsiko yaṇ‌ tayoridaṃ grahaṇam‌| anunāsikayaṇau ca yau yuvū tau pratyayāveva, nāpratyayāviti darśayitumāha--`pratyayayoḥ' iti| anye ,tvapratyayanivṛttyarthaṃ pratyayayorityuktamiti varṇayanti, tadayuktam‌; anunāsikayaṇorityanenaivāpratyayanivṛtteḥ siddhatvāt‌| tana hyapratyayāvanunāsikayaṇau yuvū śāstre staḥ| tasmādanunāsikayaṇau yo yūvū tau pratyayāveva, nāpratyayāviti sambhavapradarśanārthaṃ pratyayayorityuktamiti vijñāyate| anunāsikayaṇośca pratyayorgrahaṇe satyaṅgasyeti sambandhalakṣaṇeyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī vitreyā| ṅgasambandhinoryuvoriti sambandhaḥ| sa punarnimittinimittabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ| pratyayanimitto hyaṅgasyātmalābha ityaṅgaṃ nimitti, pratyayo nimittam‌| `yorano vorakaḥ' iti| anena yathākramaṃ sthānyādeśasambandhamācaṣṭe'| `nandyādibhyo lyuḥ' iti| `nandigrahi' (3.1.134) ityādinā| `nandanaḥ, ramaṇaḥ' iti| `ṭu nadi samuddhau' (dhā.pā.67), `ramu `krīḍāyām‌' (dhā.pā.853)| hetumati ṇic‌, tadantāllayuḥ| `sāyantanaḥ' iti| sāyamādibhyaṣṭyuṭyalāditi| `sāyañciram‌' (4.3.23) ityādinā| jātādau śaiṣike'rthe taddhitaḥ| `vāsudevakaḥ, arjunakaḥ' iti| vasudevasyāpatyaṃ vāsudevaḥ, vāsudevo bhaktirasayeti `vasudevārjunābhyāṃ vun‌' (4.3.98) iti vun‌--vāsudevakaḥ, arjunakaḥ| ūrṇā asya santītyūrṇāyuḥ, tatrānunāsikayaṇatvābhāvānna bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevamādīnīṃ yaṇo'nunāsikatvaṃ nāsti? ityāha--`evamādīnām‌' ityādi| `pratijñānunāsikyāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ' iti| yatra tairanunāsikatvaṃ pratajñāyate tatraiva bhavati, nānyatra| na ca yusprabhṛtīnāṃ taistat‌ pratijñāyate, lakṣyānurodhāt‌| tena teṣāṃ yaṇo'nunāsikatvaṃ na bhavati| ādiśabdena `ahaṃ śubhamoryus‌' (5.2.140) ityevamādayo gṛhyante| nanu ca `ahaṃśubhamoryus‌' `kaṃśaṃbhyāṃ vabhayustitutayasaḥ' (5.2.138) ityatara, sitkaraṇādeva na bhaviṣyati, sitkaraṇaṃ hi padasaṃjñāryam‌, padasaṃjñā cānusvārārthā--tasyāṃ satyāṃ `mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.23) ityanusvāro yathā syāt‌| yadi cātrānādeśaḥ syāt‌ tadā sitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, na hyanādeśe kṛte'nusvāro bhavati, tadvidhau `hali sarveṣām‌' (8.3.22) ityato halītyanuvṛtteḥ| ādeśe kṛte na bhavati; halāditvābhāvāt‌? naitadasti; vacanasāmarthyādajādāvapyanusvāraḥ syāt‌| sitkaraṇasyānyadapi prayojanam‌--padasaṃjñā| tatprajanam‌--bhasaṃjñābādhaḥ| bhasaṃjñāyāmadhyayānāṃ bhamātre ṭilopaḥ syāt‌| avagrahārthe vā sitkaraṇaṃ syāt‌, kutasyānarthakyam‌! iha yuvoriti nirdeśe samāhāre vā dvandva āśrīyate, itaretarayoge vā; tatra pūrvasmin‌ pakṣe ṣaṣṭhyekavacane kṛte `sa napuṃsakam‌' (2.4.17) iti napuṃsakatvāt‌ `iko'ci vibhaktau' (7.1.73) iti numā bhavitavyam‌, tataśca `yuvunaḥ' iti nirddeśaḥ syāt‌| itarasmiṃstu pakṣa osi parato yaṇādeśe kṛte yuṣvoriti dvitīyavakāraśravaṇamāpadyeta? ityetaccodyanirāsāyāha--`iha yuvoriti nirdeśaḥ' ityādi| `anityamāgamaśāsanam‌' iti| āgamānāṃ śāsanam‌-vidhānam‌, tadanityamiti; kvacit‌ tadabhāvāt‌| atha vā--āgamāḥ śiṣyante vidhīyante yena śāstreṇa tadāgamaśāsanaṃ śāstram‌, tadanityam‌, avidyamānaṃ nityaṃ kāryamasyeti kṛtvā| anityatā punarāgamaśāsanasya `ghorlopo leṭi vā' (7.3.70) ityatra vāgrahaṇālliṅgādvijñāyate| taddhi dadad‌, dadādityatra nityaṃ ghorlopo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate| yadi ca nityamāgamaśāsanaṃ syādvāgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| bhavatu nityo lopaḥ, satyapi tasmin‌ `leṭo'ḍāṭau' (3.4.94) ityaṭi kṛte dadad‌ dadāditi siddhyatyeva| anityatve tvāgamaśāsanasyāḍāgamābhāvānna sidhyati| tato vāvacanamarthavadbhavati| `napuṃsakaliṅgatā vā' ityādi| atha vā napuṃsakaliṅgataivātra nāsti| kiṃ kāraṇam?ityāha--`liṅgamaśiṣyam‌' ityādi| liṅgasya hi lokadharmatvālloka evāśrayaḥ| tasmāllokata eva siddhatvāt‌ tadaśriṣyaṃ na vidhātavyam‌| liṅgaśāstramevātra tādarthyālliṅgaśabdenocyate| liṅgārtha śāstramaśiṣyaṃ na karttavyam‌, tatsādhyasya liṅgasya lokāśrayatvāt‌| tadanena `sa napuṃsakam‌' (2.4.17) ityādeḥ pratyākhyānaṃ darśayati| tasmiṃśca pratyākhyāte sati taddvāreṇa tasya napuṃsakatvaṃ na bhavatīti kuto numprasaṅgaḥ! `itaretarapakṣe tu cchāndasatvādvarṇalopaḥ' iti| `chandovat‌ sūtrāṇi bhavanti' iti| chāndasatvam‌| tena yatheṣkarttāramadhvara ityatra niso nakāralopaḥ tathehāpi vakārasyāpi lopo draṣṭavyaḥ|| 2. āyanneyīnīyiyaḥ [`āyaneyīnīyiyaḥ'--iti kāśikā pāṭhaḥ] phaḍharavacchaghāṃ pratyayādīnām‌| (7.1.2) phādayo'pīha śāstre lāghavārthamupadiṣṭāḥ, tatasteṣāmāyannādaya ādeśa vidhīyante| tena ca vidhīyamānāḥ phakārāderhalmātrasya bhavantīti veditavyam‌| kuta etat‌? ante ghāmityanackanirddeśāt‌; itarathā hi ghānāmityevaṃ brūyāt‌| anyatra tvāgantuko'kāra uccāraṇārtha eva| ata eva pratyayādau varttamānasya phādervyañjanamātrasya sthānitvenopādānānniranubandhakaparibhāṣātra (vyā.pa.53) nopatiṣṭhate; sarvatra hi phādayo niranubandhakāḥ| yatra cobhayaṃ sambhavati tatraivāsyā upasthānam‌, `nāḍāyanaḥ' iti| `naḍādibhyaḥ phak‌' (4.1.99) apatyārthe phakpratyayaḥ| uttareṣvapyudāharaṇeṣvīyādeśodāharaṇādanyatrāpatyārthe veditavyaḥ| `sauparyeṇaḥ, vainateyaḥ' iti| suparṇāvinatābhyāṃ ḍhak‌| `āṭhyakulīnaḥ' iti| `apūrvapadādanyatarasyāṃ yaṅḍhakañau' (4.1.140) ityatrāpūrvapadāditi vacanāt‌ `kulātkhaḥ' (4.1.139) ityanena sapūrvapadādapi kho bhavati| `gārgīyaḥ, vātsīyaḥ' iti| gārmyavātsyaśabdābhyāṃ yañantābhyāṃ `tasyedam‌' ityarthavivakṣāyāṃ chaḥ, `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakārālopaḥ, `āpatyasya ca taddhite'nāti' (6.4.151) iti yakāralaah_> `phakkati, ḍhaukate' iti| `phakka nīcairgatau' (dhā.pā.116), `ḍhokṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.98), `khanu avadāraṇe' (dhā.pā.878), `chidir‌ dvaidhīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1440), `ghūṇa ghūrṇa bhramaṇe'[`ghuṇa'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.437,438)-ityeteṣāṃ rūpāṇi| ḍhaukatidhūrṇatyoranudāttettvādātmanepadam‌| `ūrudadhnam‌, jānudadhnam‌' iti| ūrū pramāṇamasya `pramāṇe dvayasac‌' (5.2.37) ityādinā dadhnac‌| ihaita āyannādayo'hgādhikāre vidhīyamānāḥ prakṛtipratyayāvapekṣya bhavatīti bahiraṅgāḥ, pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ tu prakṛtyanapekṣatvāt‌ pratyayamātramāśritya bhavatītyantaraṅgam‌; tato bahiraṅgā yāvadāyannādayo na bhavanti tāvadeva pratyayādyudāttatvena bhavitavyam‌, tasmin‌ kṛte satyādeśā bhavanto yatra svarārtho'nubandho na vidhīyate `śilāyā ḍhaḥ' (5.3.102), `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) ityādau tatrāniyatasvarāḥ prāpnudantītyasya codyasya nirāsāyāha--`ihaita āyannādayaḥ' ityādi| ayamabhiprāyaḥ-āyannādayo'pyantaraṅgā eva| yadi hi `aṅgasya' (6.1.4) ityatrābhisambadhyate tadā syāt‌ teṣāṃ prakṛtipratyayāpekṣayā bahiraṅgatvam‌| na cātra tadabhisambadhyate; prayojanā bhāvāt‌| tathā hi--aṅgasya nimittaṃ ye pratyayāstadādīnāṃ phādīnāmāyannādayo yathā syuḥ, anyeṣāṃ mā bhūvannityetat‌ prayojanam‌| etacca vināpyaṅgādhikāraṃ sāmarthyādeva labhyate| na hi phādīnāṃ madye so'sti pratyayo yo'ṅgasya nimitta na bhavati| tasmāt‌ prayojanābhāvādaṅgasyetyetannābhisambadhyate| tena sthānimātramevādeśā apekṣante, na prakṛtimiti te'pyantaraṅgā eva| tataśca paratvāt‌ pratyayopadeśakāle taireva tāvadbhavitavyam‌, tataśca pratyayādyudāttatveneti pratyayopadeśakāla evāyannadayo bhavantīti teṣu kṛteṣu pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti| atra jñāpakamapyāha--`tathā ca' ityādi| evañcetyarthaḥ| ghacaścitkāraṇasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--`citaḥ' (6.1.163) ityantodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| yadi ca pratyayopadeśāvasthāyāmevāyannādayo bhavanti, evaṃ sati ghacaścitkaraṇamarthavadbhavati; nānyathā| anyathā hi yadyupadeśādasthāyā uttarakālamete syustato yatraivāsati citkaraṇa udāttatvaṃ bhavati, dhakārākāre satyapi citkaraṇe tatraiva tena bhavitavyamiti citkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmāccitkaraṇādavasīyate--pratyayopadeśakāla evaita āyannādyādeśāstāvadbhavanti, paścāt‌ pratyayādyudāttatvamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca vyañjanasyaite vidhīyante, tacca vyañjanamasvaram‌, evāñcāvaśyaṃ yena kenacit‌ svareṇa bhavitavyam‌, udāttādiguṇarahitasyāco'sambhavāt‌| tatra sthāninaḥ svarābhāvādāntaratamyaṃ nāstīti sthānentaratamaparibhāṣayā (1.1.50) anupasthāne satyaniyatasvarairebhirbhavitavyam‌, tataśca yadi cittvaṃ na syāt‌, paścādvidhīyamānānāmeṣāṃ yadādyudāttasvaro bhavati tadā sa eva svaraḥ prasajyeta; satiśiṣṭatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ tamapi satiśiṣṭasvaraṃ bādhitvā'ntodāttatvaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ ghacaścitkaraṇam‌| tataḥ kuto jñāpakatvametaccintyam‌| atha `śameḥ khaḥ' (p.u.1.104) śaṅkhaḥ, `ṣaṇo ḍhaḥ' (paṃ.u.4.104) ṣaṇḍhaḥ--ityevamādīnāṃ kasmādādeśā na bhavanti? ityāha--`śaṅkhaḥ, ṣaṇḍhaḥ' ityādi| `laśakvataddhite' (1.3.8), `cūṭū' (1.3.7) itītsaṃjñāpi bahulavacanādeva na bhavatīti veditavyam‌| `ṛterīyaṅa' ityādi| yadayaṃ `ṛterīyaṅa' (3.1.29) itīyaṅaṃ śāsti tajjñāpayati--dhātupratyayānāmāyannādayo na santīti| yadi hi syuḥ, `ṛteśchaṅa' iti| brūyāt‌| nanu siddhe vidhirārabhyamāṇo jñāpakāya bhavatīti? na ca cchaṅā sidhyatīti, chaṅi hi sati valādilakṣaṇa iṭ‌ prasajyeta, tataścānāditvādādeśo na syāt‌? naitadasti; yasmādantaraṅgatvādādeśenaiva bhavitavyam‌| antaraṅgatvantu tasyopadeśāvasthāyāmeva vidhīyamānatvāt‌| ādeśe ca kṛte valāditvābhāvādiṭprasaṅgo nāsti| tadetadīyaṅvacanaṃ jñapakameva| `ejeḥ khaś‌' ityādi| tu śabdaḥ śaṅkhaḥ, ṣaṇḍha ityedamādibhyo viśeṣapradarśanārthaḥ| yatretsaṃjñā nāsti--śaṅkhādau, tatrādeśaprasaṅge sati tannirāsārthaṃ bahulavacanamiti, `ṛterīyaṅ‌' (3.1.29) iti vāvacanamupanyastam‌| `ejeḥ khaś‌' (3.2.28) ityevamādau tu `laśakvataddhite' (1.3.8) itītsaṃjñayā bhavitavyamityādeśaprasaṅgo nāstyeva| tato na tatra tadabhāvārthaṃ bahulavacanam‌, `ṛterīyaṅa' iti vāvacanamupanyasanīyamiti bhāvaḥ| ādiśabdena `priyavase vadaḥ khac‌' (3.2.38), `puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa' (3.3.118) ityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌| syādetat‌--anavakāśaṃ khakāraghakārayorādeśavacanam‌, atastena bādhyamānetsaṃjñā kathamatra syāt‌? ityāha--`taddhite' ityādi| `khityanavyayasya' (6.3.66) iti hrasvavidhānam‌, `cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutvavidhānaṃ jñāpakam‌--na hyādeśavidhānenetsaṃjñāyāṃ bādhitāyāṃ tadupapadyate; khito ghitaścātyantāsambhavāt‌| `āyannīnornakārasya' ityādi| āyannīnornakāro'nte varttata iti tasya `halantyam‌' (1.3.3) itītsaṃjñā prāpnoti, tasyāñca styāṃ `tasya lopaḥ' (1.3.9) iti kṛte nāḍāyanaḥ, āḍhyakulīna ityādi na sidhyati| tasmādāyasrīnornakārasyetsaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ tatpratividhānaṃ karttavyam‌| syādetat‌| prayojanābhāvādevetsaṃjñā na bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`nitkārthaṃ hi' ityādi| tatpunaḥ `ñnityādirnityam‌' (6.1.197) ityādyudāttatvam‌| pratavidhānaṃ punaratra `prācāmavṛddhāt‌ phin‌ bahulam‌' (4.1.160) ityatra phino nakārānubandhakaraṇam‌| tasyāṃtat‌ prayojanam‌--nittvādādyudāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| tatra yadyāyannīnornakārasyetsaṃjñā syāt‌, nittve satyādyudāttatvasya siddhatvāt‌ phino nitkaraṇamanavarthakaṃ syāt‌| nanu `pheścha ca' (4.1.149) ityatatara sāmānyagrahaṇārthaṃ syāt‌, tasminnasati niranu bandhakaparibhāṣayāsyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, na phiñaḥ? naitadasti; tatra hi `vṛddhāṭṭhak‌ sauvīreṣu bahulam‌' (4.1.148) iti bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ phiña eva grahaṇamiṣyate, na phinaḥ| tadetat‌ phino nitkaraṇamitsaṃjñābhāvasya jñāpakameva| yogapakṣaṃ cedaṃ jñāpakam‌--anena yogena vihitasyādeśasya yo nakārastasmetsaṃjñā na bhavatīti| teneno'pi nakārasyetsaṃjñā'bhāvo na bhavati siddhaḥ|| 3. jho'ntaḥ| (7.1.3) `pratyayagrahaṇamanuvarttate' iti| anantarasūtrāt‌| yadyevam‌, ekayoganirdiṣṭatvādādigrahaṇamapyanuvartteta, tataśca śayāntai--ityatra na syāt‌, cakārasyāditvābhāvāt‌? ityata āha--`ādigrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--svaritatvapratibaddhā hi śabdānāmanuvṛttiḥ, tacca svaritatvaṃ pratijñādharmaḥ--`pratijñāsvaritāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ' iti--yatraiva taiḥ svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate tatraiva bhavati, nānyatreti| tenaikayoganirddiṣṭānāmapyekatarasyānuvṛttirna virudhyate| iha ca pratyayasyaiva svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyate, nādigrahaṇasya| tena satyapyekayoganirddiṣṭatve pratyayagrahaṇamanuvarttate| `ādigrahaṇaṃ nivṛttam‌' iti| `anta ityayamādeśo bhavati' iti| akārasahita evādeśaḥ karaṇīyaḥ| akāraḥ--takāretsaṃjñā mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| sa ca jarantaḥ, veśanta ityatra| kurvantītyādau `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ' (1.3.4) iti pratiṣedhādevetsaṃjñā na bhavati| atha tu `uṇādayo bahulam‌' (3.3.1) iti vacanājjarantaḥ, veśanta ityādau na bhavati? tathā ca satyakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `na vibhaktau tusmāḥ' (1.3.4) ityasyānityatvajñāpakārthaṃ vā'kāroccāraṇam‌| `tena kimo't‌' (5.3.12) ityādīnāṃ takāretsaṃjñā bhavati| `kurvanti' iti| `ata utsārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityuttvam‌| `śayāntai' iti| śīṅaḥ `liṅarthe leṭ‌' (3.4.7), `leṭo'ḍāṭau' (3.4.94) ityāṭ‌, ṭerettvam‌, `eta ai' (3.4.93) ityanuvarttamāne `vaito'yantra' (3.4.96) ityaittvam‌| `ujjhitā' iti| `ujjha utsarge' (dhā.pā.1304) tṛc‌| `ṛduśanas‌' (7.1.94) ityādinānaṅ, `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ| `ujjhitum‌' iti| tumun‌| `ujjhitavyam‌' iti| tavyaḥ| `asminnapi' ityādi| nanu cāntaraṅgatvāt‌ pratyayādyudāttatvena prāgbhavitavyam‌, paścādādeśena? naivam‌; antādeśasyāpyantaraṅgatvāt‌| antaraṅgatvaṃ tu tasyāyannādivadveditavyam‌| ubhayorantaraṅgatvāt‌ pūrvamantādeśaḥ, paścāt‌ pratyayādyudāttatvam‌| atraiva jñāpakamāha--`tathā ca' ityādi| etacca "`ghacchau ca' (4.4.117) iti ghacaścitkaraṇamanarthavadbhavati"--ityetadvākhyānena vyākhyātamiti| pratyayādyudāttatvāt‌ pūrvamantādeśasya bhāve sati dviṣantītyatra madhyodāttatvam‌; anyathā'ntodāttatā syāt‌| sā cāniṣṭeti pūrvamantādeśaḥ kriyate|| 4. adabyastāt‌| (7.1.4) anātmanepadārthaṃ ārambhaḥ; ātmanepadeṣūttarasūtreṇaiva siddhatvāt‌| `dadati' iti| `śnābyāstayorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ| `dadatu' iti| loṭ‌, `eruḥ' (3.4.86) ityutvam‌| jakṣati, jāgratītyatra `jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ‌' (6.1.6) ityabhyastasaṃjñaḥ| yuktaṃ jakṣityādikamudāharaṇam‌, dadatītyādyayuktam‌; atra jhakārasyātmalābhakālasamanantarameva tādadantaraṅgatvādantādeśena bhavitavyam‌, tataḥ śapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌, tato'bhyastasaṃjñā tadā jhakārasya sthānino'bhāvādadbhādo na prāpnoti| na ca śakyate vaktum‌--sthānivadbhāvādbhaviṣyati| na hyatra sthānivadbhāvo'sti; alvidhitvāt‌| nāpi bahiraṅgo'navakāśatvādantādeśaṃ bādhitvā'dādeśo bhaviṣyatīti yuktaṃ parikalpayitum‌| jakṣityādiṣūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva labdhābhyastasaṃjñakeṣu tasya sāvakāśatvāditi codyamapākartumāha--`antādeśāpavādo'yam‌' iti| antādeśasya sāmānyena sarvatra prasaktasyāyamadbhāvo'pavāda ārabhyate| na cāpavādaviṣayamutsargo'vagāhate| tathā coktam‌--`pūrvamapavādāḥ pravarttante paścādutsargāḥ, parihṛtyāpavādaviṣayamutsargaḥ pravartate' (pu.pa.56) iti| ata eva tarhi jusbhāvo na syāt‌| yathaiva hyantādeśasya sāmānyena pravṛttasya viśeṣo'dbhāva ārabhyamāṇo'pavādaḥ, tathā jutbhāvasyāpītyāha--`jusādeśena tu bādhyate' iti| `jusādeśasyānavakāśatvādityadādeśo bādhyate| `adaduḥ' iti| laṅ, `sijabhyastavidhibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjus‌| `ajāgaruḥ' iti| jāgartteryā guṇaprāptistasyāḥ `aviciṇṇalṅitsu' (7.3.85) iti pratiṣedhallakṣaṇāntareṇa, `jusica' (7.3.83) ityanena guṇaḥ| `atrāpyādeśe kṛte pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati' iti| tena punata ityādikaṃ padaṃ madhyodattaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| yadi tu viparyayaḥ syāt‌, antaraṅgatvātpratyayādyudāttatve kṛte vyañjanamātrasyādbhāvo vidhīyamāno'niyatasvaraḥ prasajyeta| tatra yadāsāvanudāttaḥ syāt‌, tadā punata ityādeḥ padasyāntodāttatā prasajyeta; yadā svaritastadā madhyasvaritatā, madhyodāttatā ceṣyate| nanu ca pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ pratyayamātrāpekṣayā'ntaraṅgam‌, ādeśastuprakṛtipratyayāpekṣatvādbahiraṅgaḥ| `antaraṅgabahiraṅgayorantaraṅgaṃ balīyaḥ' (vyā.pa.94) iti pratyayādyudāttatvenaiva pūrvaṃ bhavituṃ yuktam‌, paścādādeśeneti, tatkathamucyate--adādeśe kṛte pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti? naitadasti uktaṃ hi `upadeśivadvacanaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| kiñca--ādeśo nityaḥ, kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt‌| sa hi kṛte pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ punaranityam‌, śabdāntaraprāptyā| tathā hyakṛte'dādeśe jherikārasya prāpnoti, kṛte svadādeśākārasya `śabdāntarasya prāpnuvan‌ vidhiranityo bhavati' (vyā.pa.106)| `nityānityayornityaṃ balīyaḥ' (vyā.pa.93) iti balīyastvamasya| tadetannityatvādanayorbalapīyasoḥ paratvādadādeśena pūrvaṃ bhavitavyam‌, tataḥ pratyāyādyudāttatvena | tasmāt‌ suṣṭhūktam‌--ādese kṛte pratyayādyudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti|| 5. ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ| (7.1.5) `cincete' iti| laṭ‌, svaritatvādātmanepadam‌| `cinvatām‌' iti| leṭ‌, jhaḥ ṭerettvam‌, `āmetaḥ' (3.4.90)| `acinvata' iti| laṅ‌, aḍāgamaḥ, `huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke' (6.4.87) iti yaṇādeśaḥ| `punate, lunate' iti| pūrvavadākāralopaḥ| `cyavante, plavante' iti| atra śapi kṛte'nakārāntādaṅgāduttaro jhakāro na bhavati| nanu paratvādadādeśena bhavitavyam‌, paścādvikaraṇena? ityata āha--`nityatvādatadra' ityādi| nityatvaṃ tu kutākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt‌| vikaraṇo hi kṛte'pyadādeśe prāpnotyakṛte'pi, na tu tasmin‌ kṛte'dbhāvasya prāptirastītyanityatvamasya| `anakārāntena' ityādi| pratyayaḥ kasmādanakārāntenāṅgena na viśiṣyate? iti manyamāna āha--`iha' ityādi| yadi pratyayo viśiṣyeta śayāntaṃ--ityatrāpi syāt‌, bhavati hyatrāpyanakārāntādaṅgāduttaro jhapratyayaḥ| āṭā vyavahitatvānna bhavatīti cet‌? na; tasya tadbhaktatvānna hi tadekadeśena vyavadhānaṃ yuktam‌| jhakāre tu viśiṣyamāṇe na doṣaḥ; āṭā vyavahitatvāt‌| samudāyabhakto hyāṭ‌ samudāyameva na vyavadadhyāt‌| avayavaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva; na hyavayavo'vayavāntarasyāvyavadhāyako dṛṣṭaḥ| `taṅyanataḥ', `jhasyānataḥ' iti vā vaktavye `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' iti vaicitryārtham‌|| 6. śīṅo ruṭ‌| (7.1.6) `jhādeśasyāto ruḍāgamo bhavati' iti| nanu na cehādgrahaṇamasti, yadapi prakṛtaṃ tadapi prathamāntam‌, ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśena cehārthaḥ, tat‌ kathaṃ jhādeśasyāto ruḍāgamo bhavatīti śakyaṃ vijñātum‌? naitadasti; `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti śīṅa ityeṣā pañcamī adityasyāḥ prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ parikalapayiṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `śerate' iti| `śūṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ' (7.4.21)| nanu cātra ruṭā vyavahitaṃ sārvadhātukam‌, tatkuto guṇaḥ, na hyayaṃ sārvadhātukabhaktastat‌ kathaṃ vyavadhāyako na syāt‌, acachabdasya sārvadhātukāvayavasyāyamavayava iti tadgrahaṇena gṛhyate, na sārvadhātukagrahaṇena; avayavāvayavasya samudāyānavayavatvāt‌; tathā hi--`che ca' (6.1.73) ityatroktam‌--`nāvayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo bhavati' iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; avayavāvayavo'pi samudāyāvayavo bhavatyeva| tathā hi--devadatto'laṃktiyatāmityukte devadattasya ye'vayavā hastapādāyastavayavāścaṅgulyādayo'laṃkriyante| tasmāt‌ sārvadhātukāvayavasyācchabdasya yo'vayavo ruḍāgayaḥ, so'pi sārvadhātukāvayava iti tadgrahaṇena gṛhyate, ato nāsti vyavadhānam‌| yatpunaḥ `che ca' (6.1.73) ityatroktam‌--nāvayavāvayavaḥ samudāyāvayavo bhavatīti, tat‌ tatsūtravihitameva tugāgamamabhipretyoktam‌, sa tugavayavāvayavo'pi samudāyagrahaṇena na gṛhyata iti kṛtvā| kasmāt‌ punarna gṛhyate? hrasvānukarṣaṇasāmarthyāt‌| tatra hi cakāreṇa hrasvo'nukṛṣyate--hrasvamātrasyāgamitvaṃ yathā syāt‌, hrasvantasya mā bhūditi| yadi hrasvāntasyāgamitvaṃ syāt, cicchidatuḥ, cicchidurityatra tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāddhalādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttiḥ syāt‌| yadi ca tatsūtravihitastugavayavāvayavaḥ samudāyagrahaṇena na gṛhyate, tadā hrasvamātrasyāyamitve halādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttiḥ syādeva; hrasvavayavasya tuko'bhyāsagrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌| tataśca hrasvānukarṣaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| atha kimarthamadādeśasya ruṅ‌ vidhīyate, na jhakārasya vidhīyatām‌, tatrāyamarthaḥ--ata iti ṣaṣṭhī prakalpayitavyā na bhavati; jha ityasya ṣaṣṭhyantasya prakṛtatvāt‌? ata āha--`ruḍayam‌' ityādi| yadi kakāramanubandhamāsanya pūrvāntaḥ kriyata, tadā śerata ityatra guṇo na syāt‌; anigantatvāt‌| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti ruḍayaṃ parādiḥ kriyate; parādirapi kriyamāṇo yadi jhakārasyaiva syāt‌ kimaniṣṭaṃ syāt‌? ityāha--`yadi' ityādi| jhakārasyaiva ruṭ‌ syāt‌ tadā'dādeśo na syāt‌| tato yathā śayāntai--ityatrāṭā vyavahitatvādadādeśo na bhavati; tathā śerate ityatrāpi na syāt‌; ruṭā vyavahitatvāt‌| tasmādasya doṣasya parihārārtham‌--ata eva ruḍāgamo vidhīyate, na jhakārasyeti kecidvyācakṣate, etaccāsamyak‌; jhakārasya kriyamāṇo ruṭ‌ tasyaiva bhakto bhavati, tatkathaṃ tena vyavadhānaṃ bhavet‌! na hi svāvayavena vyavadadhātyeva| tasmādasadvyākhyanametadityanyathā vyākhyāyate--adādeśo na syādityatra jhakārasyetyetadapekṣate, tadayamartho bhavati--yadi ruḍāgamo jhakārasyaiva syāt‌ tadādādeśastasyaiva na syāt‌| kasya tarhi syāt‌? tasyaiva ruṭaḥ syāt‌; `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti vacanāt‌| anekāltve'pi sarvādeśo na bhavati; ruṭa ānarthakyaprasaṅgāt‌| ruṭo vidhānasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? naitadasti; uttarārtha ruṅavidhānaṃsyāt‌| `bahulaṃ chandasi' (7.1.8) ityatra rujāgamo yathā syāt‌| na hyadṛśrannityataṭā sidhyati| tasmājtākaśravaṇaṃ ruṅ‌vidheḥ prayojanam‌| tadetasya doṣasya nirāsāyādādeśasya ruṅvidhīyate; na jhakārsaya| `śīṅaḥ' ityanubandhena nirdeśe yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ--vyatiśesyata iti|| 7. vettervibhāṣā| (7.1.7) `saṃvidrate, saṃvidate' iti| `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064)| `samobhyṛcchi' (1.3.29) ityādinā'tmanepadam‌, adāditvācchapo luk‌| `saṃvidratām‌, saṃvidatām‌' iti| loṭ‌| derettve kṛte `āmetaḥ' (3.4.90) ityām‌| `vetteriti lugvikaraṇasya grahaṇaṃ kim‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--vidheriti sāmānyanirdeśena sarvavidīnāṃ grahaṇamastu, laghu hyevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati, satyapi sarvavidhīnāṃ grahaṇe lugvikaraṇādeva bhaviṣyati, nānyataḥ, vikaraṇena vyavadhānāt‌| yadyaviśeṣeṇa vidīnāṃ grahaṇa syāt‌ `vida vicāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1450) ityasmādapi raudhādikāt‌ syāt‌, na hyatra vikaraṇo vyavadhāyakaḥ; dhātvantaḥpātitvāt‌? ityata āha--`iha' ityādi| `vinte, vindāte, vindate' iti| anudāttettvādātmanepadam‌, `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111)| atra tu `vindate' iti bahuvacanāntaṃ pratyudāharaṇam‌| ekavacanadvivacanayorupanyāso vidervicāraṇārthasya rūpamiti pradarśanārthaḥ; anyathā `vindate' ityetācatyucyamāne lābhārvasya viderekavacanāntamidaṃ rūpamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌| śtipā nirdeśādyaṅluki na bhavati--saṃvevidate, vyativevidate|| 8. bahulaṃ chandasi| `aduhra' iti| svarirettvādātmanepadam‌| nanu ca vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtterevāduhratetyādi siddham‌, kiṃ bahulavacaneneti yaścodayet‌ taṃ pratyāha--`bahulavacanāt‌' ityādi| vibhāṣānuvṛttyā hi vikalpamātraṃ labhyate, na tvanyatrāpi bhavati| bahulavacanādanyatrāpi bhavati| tena vibhāṣāyāṃ prakṛtāyāṃ bahulavacanamiti bhāvaḥ| `adṛśran‌' iti| dṛśerluṅ‌, jherantādeśaḥ, `irito vāṭa (3.1.57) iti cleraṅ, tasya ruṭ‌ `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ, `saṃyogantasya' (8.2.23) iti takārasya ca, `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| athātra `ṛvṛśoraṅi' (7.4.16) iti guṇa kasmānna bhavati? `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti pratiṣedhāditi cet‌? na; tasaya ṅityeva vidhānāt‌| sārvadhatukasya ṅitamāśritya pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnotīti cet‌? na; ekādeśaḥ pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhavatīti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ' iti|| 9. ato bhisa ais‌| (7.1.9) `samāse kṛte' ityādi| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti krāntādyarthe'tiśabdasya| `hrasvatve ca' iti| `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvaḥ| nanu yadi hrasvaḥ kriyate, tadā jarāśabdasyocyamāno jarasādeśo jaraśabdasya na prāpnotīti codyamapākartumāha--`ekadeśavikṛtam‌' ityādi| nanu caikadeśavikṛtasyānanyatve'pi naivātra jarasādeśena bhavitavyam‌, `sannipātalaśraṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvidhātasya' (vyā.pa.12) iti paribhāṣayā jaraśabdasannipātalakṣaṇo hyais‌ vidhīyate, sa kathaṃ tasya vidhātasya tadvidhātasya' (vyā.pa.12) iti paribhāṣayā jaraśabdasannipātalakṣaṇo hyais‌ vidhīyate, sa kathaṃ tasya vighātasya nimittaṃ syāt? ityāha--`sannipāta' ityādi| anityatvaṃ punarasyāḥ `kaṣṭāya kramaṇe' (3.1.14) ityataḥ kaṣṭāyeti nirdeśādvevitavyam‌| yadi hyeṣā nityā syāt‌, tato'kārāntalakṣaṇo vidhirakārāntatāvidhātasya nimittaṃ na syāditi `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghatvaṃ na syāt‌, tataśca `kaṣṭāya' (3.1.14) iti nirdeśo nopapadyata iti| atha kimarthamais‌ vidhīyate, na eseva vidhīyatām‌, tatrāpi `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhau kṛtāyām‌--vṛkṣaiḥ, plakṣairityādi sidhyati? kaḥ punarevaṃ satadi guṇo labhyate? na hyaisyesi vā kriyamāṇo kaścillādhavakṛto viśeṣaḥ, prakriyāgauravameva tu syāt‌; evaṃ vidhāya lakṣaṇāntareṇa vṛddhervidhānāt‌? ajitarasairiti tu na siddhyati; vṛddhyabhāvāt‌| vṛddhyabhāvasatvakārāntatābhāvaditi yatkiñcidetat‌| iha vṛkṣairityatra bhisi parabhūte `ato bhisa ais‌' ityaisbhāvaḥ prāpnoti, `bahuvacane jhalyet‌' (7.3.103) ityesvañca, ubhayañcaitat‌ sāvakāśam‌, tatraisbhāvasya sāvakāśatvam‌--kṛte'pyettve bhūtapūrvamakārāntatvāmāśritya, evattvasyāvakāśaḥ--bhyasādiḥ' paratvādettvenātra bhavitavyamiti yo manyeta, taṃ pratyāha--`ettvaṃ bhisi paratvāt‌' ityādi| bhisi paratvādettvañcenmanyase, ata ais‌ kva bhaviṣyati? akārāntāt‌ parasya bhisa ais‌ vidhīyate, tatra yadi paratvādettvaṃ bhavet‌ kvedānīmais bhaviṣyati? na kvacit‌; akārāntatāyāḥ sarvatraittvena vihitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| aisbhāvasya viṣayaṃ darśayitumāha--`kṛte'pyettve' ityadi| kathaṃ punaḥ kṛta ettva ais‌ bhavati, yāvatā'kārāntādaṅgāduttarsya bhisa aisikati, na ca paratvādettve kṛte'kārāntāduttro bhis‌ bhavati, tatra vacanapramāṇyāt‌ kṛte'pyettve bhūtapūrvamakārāntatvamāśrityaismabhaviṣyati| `aistu nityastathā sati' iti| evaṃ kṛte'pyettva aisbhāvena bhavitavyamakṛte'pīti kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt‌; aistu nityaḥ, ettvaṃ tvanityam‌; na hi tadaisbhāve kṛte prāpnoti; jhalo nimittasyābhāvāt‌| nityānityayośca tulyabalatvādvipratiṣedho nopapadyate| tataśca paramapyettvamapāsya balavānaisbhavidhyatīti bhāvaḥ|| 10. bahulaṃ chandasi| (7.1.10) bahulagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌| śakyate hi maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena bahulagrahaṇamanuvarttayitum‌|| 11. nedamadasorakoḥ| (7.1.11) avidyamānaḥ kakāro yayostavakau| `ebhiḥ' iti| idamastyadādyatvam‌, `bahuvacane jhalyet‌' (7.3.103) ityettvam‌, `hali lopaḥ' (7.2.113) itīdrūpasya lopaḥ| `amībhiḥ' iti| adasa ettve kṛte `eta īdavahuvacane' (8.2.81) itīttvam‌, dasya ca matvam‌| `imakaiḥ' iti| `avyayasarvanāmnāmakacprakṭoḥ' (5.3.71) ityakac‌, `daśca' (7.2.109) iti dakārasya matvam‌| `amukaiḥ iti| `adaso'sordādu do maḥ' (8.2.80) iti matvotve| atha `nedamadasoḥ' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam‌, kimakoratyanena, akorityanucyamāne sakakārayorapi atiṣedhaḥ syāditi cet‌? naitadasti; idamadasorhi pratiṣedha ucyamānaḥ kaḥ prasahgo yā sakakārayoḥ syāt‌? naiva prāpnoti śabdāntaratvādityāha--`akorityet‌' ityādi| jñāpakasya prayojanam‌--akajvatāṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñā sarvādīnām‌, svarādīnāñcāvyayasaṃjñā| atha `idamadasoḥ kāt‌' iti kasmānnoktam‌, tatra pūvaṇaiva siddhe niyamārtha bhaviṣyati--idamadasoḥ sambandho yo bhis‌ tasya kādeva parasyais‌ bhavati, ityevaṃ vijñāyamāne niyame sarvamabhīṣṭaṃ niyame sarvamabhīṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva, laghu ca sūtraṃ bhaviṣyati? satyametat‌; kintvasmin‌ sūtravinyāse `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate' (vyā.pa.21) ityeṣā na jñāpitā syāt‌| viparītaniyamo'pi bhandadhībhirāśaṅkyeta--idamadasoreva kāditi| tatrāyaṃ niyamārthaḥ syāt‌--idamadasoreva yaḥ kakārastasmāt‌ parasya bhisa aisbhavatīti| tato viśvakaiḥ, sarvakairityatra na syāt‌; niyamena vyāvarttitatvāt‌| iha ca syādeva--ebhiḥ, amībhiriti| niyamenāvyāvarttitatvāt‌| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu|| 12. ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ| (7.1.12) `atijarasinā' ityādi| pūrvavat‌ samāse kṛte hrasvatve ca jarasādeśaḥ| `kecit‌' iti| sūtrakāramatānusāriṇaḥ| yadi hyatijarasinetyetat‌ sūtrakārasya sādhutvenābhimataṃ na syāt‌, ṭetyetasya nādeśameva kuryāt‌| tatrāpyetve kṛte vṛkṣeṇetyādi sidhyati| kathametatvamiti cet‌? evamettvavidhau yogavibhāgaḥ kariṣyate| idamasti--`bahuvacane jhalyet‌' (7.3.103), tataḥ `osi ca' (7.3.104), tataḥ `āṅi cāpaḥ' (7.3.105) iti; tatrāṅīti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ--āṅi parato'ta etvaṃ bhavati--vṛkṣeṇa, plakṣeṇa; tataḥ `āpaḥ', `sambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) iti| nanu ca nādeśe satīdama idrūpasya hali lopaḥ prasajyeta, tataścāneneti na sidhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `hali lopaḥ' (7.2.113) ityatra `jarāyā jarasanyatarasyām‌' (7.2.101) ityato'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavastitavibhāṣā vijñāyate tena nādeśe kṛte satīdrūpasya lopo na bhavati| tadevaṃ nādeśenaiva vṛkṣeṇetyādi| sidhyati| tataḥ sa eva karttavyaḥ, nenādeśaḥ; kṛtaścāsau, ato'vagamyate--nūnaṃ sūtadrakārasyāti jarasinetyetatsādhutvenābhimatam‌, yasya siddhyarthaminādeśaṃ kṛtavānititi| tathā yadyatijarasādityasya sādhutvamabhīṣṭaṃ na syāt‌ ṅaseradbhāvaṃ vidadhyāt‌| tatrāpi akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena (6.1.101) vṛkṣādityevamādi siddhyatyeva| nanu cākaḥ savarṇāvapavādaḥ `āto guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ prāpnoti, tat‌ kathaṃ siddhyati? naitadasti; akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati pararūpam‌, anyathā takārameva vidadhyāt‌| atra hi `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityakārasya takāre vihite saṃyogāntalope vṛkṣādityevamādi sidhyatyeva| atra hi `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityakārasya takāre vihite saṃyogāntalope vṛkṣādityevamādi sidhyatyeva| tasmādakāroccaraṇasāmarthyāt‌ pararūpatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatītyadbhāvo vidheyaḥ, kimādbhāveneti? vihitaścādbhāvaḥ, tato'vasīyate--nūnamatijarasādityasya sādhutvaṃ sūtrakārasyābhimataṃ yatsiddhyarthamādbhāvaṃ vihitavāniti| evaṃ sūtrakārasya matamanusarantaḥ kecidatijarasinā, atijarasādityasya sādhutvamicchanti| `yathā tu' ityādi| bhāṣye hi--`atha kimarthaminādeśa ucyate, na nādeśa evocyeta' ityevaṃ granthasandarbheṇenādeśaṃ pratyakhyāya nādeśa eva vyavasthāpitaḥ| `atha kimarthamādipyucyate, na adevocyeta' ityevamādinā granthasandarbheṇa ādādeśaṃ pratyākhyāya adādeśa eva vyavasthāpitaḥ| yadi cātijarasinā, atijarasādityasya sādhutvamiṣṭaṃ syādinādeśamādbhāvaṃ ca bhāṣyakṛnna pratyācakṣīta| na hi prayojane sati pratyākhyānaṃ yuktam‌, kṛtañca tayoḥ pratyākhyānam‌, tato'vagamyate--`naitadivyate' iti|| 13. ṅeryaḥ| (7.1.13) `ṅeḥ' iti| caturthyakavacanasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌| kasmānna bhavati saptamyekavacanasya grahaṇam‌? yadi hi tasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tadā--atyantasaṃyoge, bhāve apavarge, kārakamadhye--ityevamādi na siddhyati| tasmādetebhyo nirdeśebhyo nedamiha saptamyekavacanasya grahaṇam‌| ataḥ pariśeṣyāccaturthyekavacanasya grahaṇaṃ na niścīyata iti| `tasmai hitam‌' (5.1.5) iti nirdeśācca liṅgādattaratrāpyetadevānuvarttate| `vṛkṣāya' iti| `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghaḥ| nanu `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya' (vyā.pa.12) iti paribhāṣayā upasthāne sati sannipātalakṣaṇo yavidhirakāravidhātaṃ prati nimittaṃ nopapadyate, kuto dīrghatvam‌? ityāha--`sannipātalakṣaṇaḥ' ityādi| anityatvaṃ tvasyāḥ prāgeva pratipāditam‌| atha ṅakāroccāraṇaṃ kimartham‌? ekāramātrasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūditi| yadi syāt‌, pace, yaje--ityevamādāvapi syāt‌| nanu ca `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) iti pararūpatve kṛte nimittābhāvānna bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; nāprāpte hyato guṇe pararūpatve'yamādeśa ucyate; sa yathā vṛkṣāya ityatra `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ bādhate tathā pace, yaje--ityatrāpi bādheta pratipadoktasyekārasya grahaṇādiha na bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? na; asyāpyekārasya pratipadoktatvāt‌| `ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere' (3.4.79) iti nirddeśādekāraḥ pratipadokto bhavati| tasmādviśeṣaṇārtho ṅakāra karttavyaḥ|| 14. sarvanāmnaḥ smai| (7.1.14) `bhavate' iti| tyadādyatvaṃ na bhavati| `dviparyantāstyadādayaḥ' (vā.7.2.102) iti bhavacchabdasya tyadāditvābhāvādakārāntatā na bhavati| `atho atra' ityādi codyam‌| atra idam‌ e iti sthite `idamo'nvādeśe' (2.4.32) ityaśādeśe kṛte paramapi smaibhāvaṃ bādhitvā nityatvādekādeśo'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ (6.1.101) prāpnoti| nityatvaṃ punarasya kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt‌| ekādeśe ca kṛte'nakārāntatvāt‌ smaibāvo na prāpnoti| `tatra' ityādi parīhāraḥ| tatraikādeśe prāpte'ntaraṅgatvāt‌ pūrvaṃ smaibhāvo vidhīyate, paścādekādeśaḥ| antaraṅgatvaṃ tu smaibhāvasyaikapadāśrayatvāt‌| ekādeśasya dvipadāśrayatvāt‌ bahiraṅgatvam‌|| 15. ṅasiṅyoḥ smātsminnau| (7.1.15) ṅeralpāctarasya pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipāto vaicitryārthaḥ|| 16. pūrvādibhyo navabhyo vā| (7.1.16) pūrveṇa nityaṃ prāptayoḥ smātsminorvikalpārtha vacanam‌| nanu ca `pūrvāparāvaradakṣiṇottarāparādharāṇi vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām‌' (1.1.34), `svamajñātidhanākhyāyām‌' (1.1.35), `antaraṃ bahiryogopasaṃvyānayoḥ' (1.1.36) iti navaiva sūtre pūrvādīni paṭhyante, tadapārthakaṃ navagrahaṇam‌, naitadasti; na hīha sūtraparipaṭhitāni pūrvādīni gṛhyante, kiṃ tarhi? gaṇapaṭhitāni| kuta etat? jasi hi sūtraparipaṭhitānāṃ teṣāṃ sarvanāmasaṃjñā, na ṅasiṅyoḥ| `sarvanāmnaḥ' (7.1.14) cetīhānuvarttate, kiṃ prayojanam‌? vidyamāne sve yajate, svād‌ bibhetītyatra mā bhūt‌| tasmāt‌ gaṇaparipaṭhitānyeva pūrvādīni gṛhyante; tatrāsati navagrahaṇe tyadādibhyo'pi syāt‌| tasmānnavagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 17. jasaḥ śī| (7.1.17) śakaraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ, asati tasmin‌ `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti vacanādakāramātrasya syāt‌| atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham‌, na hrasva eva vidhīyatām‌, akārāntāddhyayaṃ vidhīyate| atrādguṇena' (6.1.87) bhavitavyamiti nāsti guṇe kṛte hrasvasya dīrghasya vā vidhāne viśeṣaḥ? ityāha--`dīrghoccāraṇam‌' ityādi| `napuṃsakācca' (7.1.19) iti vakṣyati; tatra trapuṇī, jatunī--ityatra dīrghasya śravaṇaṃ thā syādityevamarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇam‌| sarvanāmna ityeva--dakṣiṇā ime gāthakāḥ| ata ityeva--bhavantaḥ|| 18. auṅa āpaḥ| (7.1.18) `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhau prāptāyāmayamāram‌bhaḥ| `auṅaḥ' iti prathamādvitīyādvivacanayoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam‌| `āpaḥ' iti ṭāḍḍāpcāpām‌| `khaṭve' iti| `ajādyataṣṭāp‌' (4.1.4) tiṣṭhataḥ, paśyeti yathākramamanuprayogayorupanyāsaḥ prathamāntatāṃ dvitīyāntatāñca pratipādayitum‌ca anyathā khaṭve ityubhayatra rūpasya tulyatvāt‌ prathamāntatādau viśeṣe sandehaḥ syāt‌| `bahurāje' iti| karīṣasyeva gandho'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ, `upamānācca' (5.4.137) itīc‌| karīṣagandherapatyamityaṇ‌, tasya `aṇiñoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādinā ṣyaṅādeśaḥ| `yaṅaścāp‌' (4.1.74) iti cāp‌| `aukāro'yam‌' ityādi| śīvidhau-śīvidhāne| aukāro'yaṃ sthānī ṅidgṛhīto ṅakārānuvandha upātta ityarthaḥ| ṅakāra idyasya sa ṅit‌| ṅiccāsmākaṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ matena śāstra aukāro nāsti| tataḥ ko'yaṃ prakāraḥ, kiṃśabda kutsāyāṃ varttate| kutsito'yaṃ sūtrapraṇayanaprakāra ityarthaḥ| kutsitatvaṃ tvasata evopādanāt‌| ṅakārāsañjanaprayojanapradarśanadvāreṇa kutsitatvaṃ sūtrapraṇayanasya nirakarttumāha--`sāmānyārthaḥ' iti| yadi hyaukāro'nubandharahitaḥ sthānitvenopādīyeta, tataḥ `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti dvitīyādvivacanaṃ na gṛhyeta| atha tsaya ṭakāro'nubandha upādīyeta, evamapi prathamādvivacanaṃ na gṛhyeta| tasmāt‌ sāmānyena dvayorapi grahaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ ṅakāra āsajyate| nanu ca dvitīyādvivacane yaṣṭakāro nāsautasyānubandhaḥ, kasya tarhi? samudāyasya| pratyāharārthā hi ye'nubandhāste samudāyānubandhā eva vijñāyante, yathā--mahiṅo ṅakāraḥ, supaśca pakāraḥ| tasmānniranubandhakagrahaṇe dvayorapnubandhakatvāt‌ sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, tat‌ ki ṅakāreṇa? naitadasti; samudāyānubandhakatveṣa'vayavānubandhakatvamapi hyeṣāṃ pratijñāyate| na hi samudāyānubandhakatve pratyayānubandhakatvaṃ virudhyate| hatsaṃjñako hyanubandha ucyate, halaścāntyasyetsaṃjñā nidhīyate| auṭaśca ṭakāro yathā samudāyaṃ pratayantastathā pratyayaṃ pratyapi| tasmāt‌ tasya `halantyam‌' (1.3.3) itītsaṃjñāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ yathāsau samudāyaṃ pratyanubandhastathā pratyayamapi| prayojanābhāvāt‌ pratyayānubandhakatvamanupapannamiti cet‌? na; ihāsti prayojanam‌--dvitīyādvivacanasya sānubandhakatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| yadi tarhi pratyayānubandhastadā satyapi ṅakārāsañjane `tadanubandhakagrahaṇe nātadanubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.54) iti `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.52) iti ca prathamādvivacanasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tasya hi ṅakāra evaiko'nubandhaḥ; dvitīyādvivacanasaya tu sa cānyo'pi ṭakāraḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ, ṅakāroccāraṇasāmarthyād‌dvitīyādvivacanamapi grahīṣyate| antareṇaiva ṅakāraṃ prathamādvivacanasyaiva grahaṇe siddhe ṅakāra upadiśyate sāmānyārthaḥ| yadi ca satyapi ṅakāre prathamādvivacanameva gṛhyate ṅakāro'narthakaḥ syāt‌| kathaṃ punarasya ṅkārasyetsaṃjñā, yāvatopadeśe yo'ntyo hal‌ tasyetsaṃjñā vihitā, na cāyamupadeśe'ntyaḥ? bhavatu vā tasyetsaṃjñā, ṭakārasya auṭastarhi na syāt‌; kathaṃ hyekasminnupadeśe dvāvantyau syātām‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ, auṅiti vacanāt‌| dvayorapyaukārayorauṅityayamādeśo vijñāyate, tasya copadeśo'sti yathā `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ‌' (2.4.54) iti ñakāra upadeśe'ntya iti, yathā tasyetsaṃjñā tathā ṅakārasyāpi| ṭakārasya tu pūrvameva krameṇetsaṃjñā lopaśca kriyata iti nāsti doṣaḥ| yaścāsāvādeśa aukāraḥ sa eva śobhāṣasya sthānitvenanopātta iti veditavyam‌| `tasya ca' ityādinā--ṅakārāsañjane yo doṣaḥ prāpnoti taṃ darśayati| anubandhabhūtasaya ṅakārasyopādānamāsañjanam‌| ṅiti yat‌ kāryaṃ tat‌ `ṅitkāryam‌'--`saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| tatpanaḥ kāryaṃ `yāḍāpaḥ' (7.3.113) iti āṭ‌| yadi sāmānyārtho'yaṃ ṅakāra āsajyate, evaṃ sati ṅakārasyāsañjane ṅiti yatkāryaṃ tat‌ te-tava sūtrakārasya matena `śyāṃ prasaktaṃ' prāptam‌, `sa doṣaḥ'| `yāḍāpaḥ' (7.3.113) iti yāḍāgame sati khaṭve--iti rūpaṃ na sidhyet‌| ata śyāmiti kathamāmāṭau syātām‌? kathañca na syātām‌? anadītvāt‌; anadītvaṃ ca tasyāstryākhyatvāt‌? naitadasti; yathaiva hi khaṭvādayaḥ striyāṃ varttante tathā śīśabdo'pi| tathā cāha liṅgakārikākāraḥ--`īdūdantaṃ yaccaikāc‌ śaraddaraddṛṣatprāvṛṣaśca' iti| tasmāt‌ stryākhyatyādayamapi nadīsaṃjñaka eva; śrutitāmānādhikaraṇyāt‌| śrutau varttamānaḥ śīśabdo nadosaṃjñāṃ pratipadyate| śrutiḥ svarūpameva| `ṅittve' ityādi| `yāḍāpaḥ' (7.3.113) ityatra `dherṅiti' (7.3.111) ityato ṅidgrahaṇamanuvarttate| tatra ṅiditi nāyaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ--ṅakāra id‌ yasya sa ṅiditi, kiṃ tarhi? tatpuruṣaḥ--ṅakāra eva id‌ ṅit‌| tasmādaukāro yo ṅit‌ tasminnabhyupete sati ṅitītyasminnirdeśe ṅakārasyetsaṃjñakasya varṇamātrasakya nirdeśaṃ vidyādavagacchet‌ prājñaḥ| mātraśabdastato'nyavyavacchedāya| yadi ṅitītyatra ṅakārasya varṇamātrasya nirddeśo na ṅakārānubandhasya pratyayasya tat‌ kimiti śyāṃ ṅitkāryaṃ na bhavati? ityāha--`varṇe' ityādi| varṇe parabhūte yat‌ kāryaṃ vidhīyate tat‌ `yasmin‌ vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) iti paribhāṣayā tadādau varṇādau vidyāt‌| tataśca yatra ṅakāra ādāvitsaṃjñakastatraiva bhavitavyaṃ yāṭā, na śyām‌| na hyatrādau ṅakāraḥ, kva tarhi? ante| evamayaṃ ṅittvamabhyupetya parīhāra uktaḥ| idānīṃ ṅittvamanabhyupetya parohārāntaramāha--`varṇaścāyam‌' ityādi| vārthe caśabdaḥ| varṇo vāyamiti yāvat‌| auṅityauvarṇau'yamupattaḥ pratyaviśeṣaṇārthaḥ, na tu pratyayaḥ| ahgādhikārādādantāt‌ paro yaḥ sāmarthyaprāptaḥ pratayayaḥ sa aukāreṇa viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatīti| tenāyamartho jāyate--aukārānte'sya pratyayasyeti| aukārāntatvaṃ vyapadeśivadbhāvāt‌| ṅakāraścāyaṃ nānubandhaḥ, mukhasukhārthastvayam‌, yathā--`ṛdorap‌' (3.3.57) ityatra dakāraḥ| varṇarūpatayā ca tathaukārasya grahaṇe sati dvayorapyaukārayoḥ śībhāvaḥ siddhau bhavati| pratyayagrahaṇe hi niranubandhaka (vyā.pa.53) paribhāṣopatiṣṭhate, na ceha pratyayagrahaṇam‌| kiṃ tarhi? varṇamātrasya| nanu ca dvāvapyetau pratyayau, tatkimiti nopatiṣṭate? satyam‌; yadyapi tau pratyau, tathadhāpi nātra śāstre pratyarūpeṇaukāra upāttaḥ? kiṃ tarhi? varṇarūpeṇeti, atastasyā nehopasthānam‌| ṅittvamanabhyupetya parīhārāntaramāha--`nirddeśo'yam‌' ityādi| neha vyākaraṇa aukārasaya ṅakāro'nuvagdha upādīyate| pūrvācāryāṇāṃ tu sūtre dve apyete dvivacane ṅitī paṭhyete| tathā hi `ābauṭāvauṅ‌' iti tatra sūtrapāṭhaḥ| atastatsatrānurodhenāyaṃ nirddeśaḥ, tasyeha grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌| tasmānṅittvābhāvānnāsti ṅitkāryasya prasaṅgaḥ| na hi pūrvācāryasūtrānurodhenehānubandhakāryāṇi kriyante| `tena ṅittve'pyadoṣaḥ' iti| kiṃ punaryatra nāstyeva ṅittvamityapi śabdasyārthaḥ| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--ṅittve'byupete sati ṅittve vidyādvarṇanirdeśamātram‌| `varṇe yatsyāt‌ tacca vidyāttadādau' ityevaṃ ṅitkārayaprasaṅganirāsāya yasmātad‌ parīhāra uktaḥ| yasmādvarṇaścāyamityanena, `nirdeśo'yaṃ pūrvasūtreṇa vā syāt‌' ityanena caukārayoṅittvabhāvaḥ pratipāditaḥ| tena hetunā satyapi ṅittve'pyadoṣaḥ| kiṃ punarnāstyeva yatra ṅittvamiti|| 19. napuṃsakācca| (7.1.19) `dadhinī' iti| `iko'ci vibhaktau' (7.1.73) iti num‌|| 20. jasiśasoḥ śiḥ| (7.1.20) [`jaśśasīḥ śiḥ' iti mūle paṭhyate| ayaṃ tu `jasiśasoḥ śiḥ' iti nyāsakārābhiprāyeṇa pāṭhaḥ| ājjaserasuk' (7.1.50) iti sūtre'pi jasireva dṛśyate] jasītyatrekāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `kuṇḍāni' iti| `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) iti num‌, `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti dīrgha-| atheha kasmānna bhavati--kuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dadāti, `saṃkhyaikavacanācca vīpsāyām‌' (5.4.43) iti śas‌, kuṇaaḍaśo dadāti? ityāha--`jasā sāhacaryāt‌' ityādi| etaccodyaparihāravacanaṃ yadārthaprakaraṇādervṛtto kuṇḍādiśabda ekavacano bhavati tadā veditavyam‌, na tvanyadā| śasvidhau hi vṛttisthaikārthatā''śrīyate, na vākyasthā| arthaprakaraṇādirahitaḥ kuṇḍādiśabdo vṛttau nivṛttāyāṃ vibhaktāvekārtho na bhavatīti śasā na bhavitavyam‌| kasmāt‌ punaḥ kuṇḍādiśabdo vṛttau nivṛttāyaṃ vibhaktāvekārtho na bhavatīti śasā na bhavitavyam‌| kasmāt‌ punaḥ kuṇḍādiśabdo vṛttāvekārtho na bhavati? jātiśabdatvāt‌| jātiśabdā hi naikasayāmeva jātyādhārabhūtāyāṃ vyaktau varttante| kiṃ tarhi? anekasyāmapi| evañca yattatra śasvidhau pratyudāharaṇamupanyastam‌--`saṃkhyaikavacanāditi kim‌? ghaṭaṃ ghaṭaṃ dadāti', tadupapadyate| yadyarthaprakaraṇādirahito jātiśabdo vṛttāvekārtho na bhavati, tadā na bhavitavyameva śasā|| 21. aṣṭabhya auś‌| (7.1.21) `kṛtākāro'ṣṭan‌śabdo gṛhyate' iti| yatrātvaṃ tatrauśtvaṃ yathā syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `aṣṭau tiṣṭhanti' iti| ātve kṛta auśtvam‌| `aṣṭa tiṣṭhanti' iti| atrātvābhāvādauśtvaṃ na bhavati| kathaṃ punaratrātvābhāvaḥ, yāvatā na tatrātvavidhau vikalpasya pratipādakaṃ kiñcidanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇādikamasati? ityāha--`etadeva' ityādi| kṛtātvanirdeśasthaitadeva prayojanam‌--yatrātvaṃ tatraivauśatvaṃ yathā syāt‌, anyatra mā bhūditi| yadi ca nityamātvaṃ syāt‌ tadā kṛtātvasya nirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt‌; vyavarttyābhāvāt‌ `aṣṭanaḥ' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| tadevaṃ laghunirdeśe sambhavati sati yat‌ kṛtātvasya nirdeśo garīyān‌ kriyate, tajjñāpayati--vikalpenātvaṃ bhavatīti| yadyapi cāyamarthaḥ `aṣṭano dīrghāt‌' (6.1.172) ityatrāpi jñāpitaḥ, tathāpi vismaraṇaśīlānāmanugrahāya punariha jñāpyate| athāṣṭaputraḥ, aṣṭabhārya ityatra kasmānna bhavati, `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti lukā bādhitatvāditi cet‌? na; ihāpi tarhi na syāt‌--aṣṭau tiṣṭanti, aṣṭau paśyeti| `ṣaṅbhyo luk‌ (7.1.22) iti lukā bādhitatvāt‌| athauśbhāvasya lugapavādatvādatra lukraṃ bādhitvā sa eva bhavati| pūrvatrāpi tarhi sa eva stāt‌, ata eva hetoḥ? ityāha--`ṣaṅbhyo lugityasyāpavādo'yam‌' iti| atraivopapattimāha--`nāprāpte' ityādi| `ṣaṅbhyo luk‌' (7.1.22) ityasamāse prāpnoti--aṣṭau tiṣṭhantītyādau, samāse ca--aṣṭaputra ityādau| tasmānnāprāpte aṣṭabhāryaḥ--ityatra sublukaiva bhavitavyamityauśatvaṃ na bhavati| `tadantagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| kiṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi labhyate? `aṅgādhikāre tasya taduttarapadasya ca' (pu.pa.vṛ.85) iti vacanāt‌| atha vā--aṣṭābhya ityarthapradhānanirdeśo' yaṃ bahuvacananirddeśādavasīyate| śabdapradhāne hi nirdeśe `aṣṭanaḥ' brūyāt‌| arthācca śabdadvāreṇaiva jaśśasoḥ paratvaṃ vijñāyata iti kevalāccāṣṭano bhavati| tadantāccātadante'pi hi śabdadvereṇārthāt‌ parau jaśśasau bhavata iti| yadi tadantagrahaṇamatreṣyate, priyāṣṭana ityatrāpi prāpnoti? ata āha--`priyāṣṭanaḥ' ityādi| priyā aṣṭau yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| nanu ca vikalpenātvam‌| tatra yadātvaṃ na bhavati tadā mā bhūdauśtvam‌; yadātvaṃ tadā syādeva; vyavasthitavibhāṣayātrātvaṃ na bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ|| 22. ṣaṅbhyo luk‌| (7.1.22) `pañca, sapta' iti| `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nalopaḥ| `ṣaṭparadhānāt‌ tadantādapi bhavati' iti| atra pūrvako heturvakatavyaḥ| `yatra tu' ityādi| arthasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ bahulavacanādavasitam‌| sa cārtho dvividhaḥ--pradhāno'pradhānaśca| tatra `pradāne kāryasampratyayaḥ' (vyā.pa.120) iti yatrārthasya prādhānyaṃ tatraiva bhavati, na tu yatrārthasyāprādhānyaṃ tatra| eṣa ca hetuḥ priyāṣṭāna ityatrauśtvābhāve'pi veditavyaḥ| `priyaṣaṣaḥ' iti| priyāṣaḍeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| atrānyapadārthasya prādhānyam‌, ṣaḍarthastu tatra guṇabhāvādapradhānaḥ|| 23. svamornapuṃsakāt‌| (7.1.23) `su' iti yadyapi saptamībahuvacanamasti, tathāpyamā dvitīyaikavacanena sahacaryātprathamaikavacanameva gṛhyate| tadabrāhmaṇakulamityatra paratvāt‌ tyadādayatvenaiva bhavitavyam‌, tyadādyatve kṛte lugna prāpnoti; `ato'm‌, (7.1.24) ityambhāvaprasaṅgāt‌, tasmāttyadādyatvātprāg‌ lugvaktavyaḥ? ityāha--`tadbrāhmaṇakulamityatra' ityādi| luko'vakāśaḥ--dadhi, madhvityatra, tyadādyatvasyāvakāśaḥ--brāhmaṇa iti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--tadabrāhmaṇakulamiti, lugbhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena| na ca pūrvavipratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ; iṣṭavācitvātparaśabdasya| `nityatvādvā' iti| vāśabdaḥ samuccaye| yadyapi luk‌, tyadādyatvañcobhayaṃ prāpnoti, tathāpi luka eva nityatvaṃ vijñāyate| kutaḥ? sāmarthāt‌| `lukā tyadādyatve bādhyate' ityatra hīdaṃ hetvantaramuktam‌| evañcedamatrārthe hetvantaraṃ sambhavati yadi luko nityatvaṃ bhavati, nānyathā, nityatvaṃ punaḥ kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvāt‌| tyadādyatvaṃ hi vibhaktāvucyamānaṃ kṛte luki vibhaktyabhāvānna prāpnoti| pratyayalakṣaṇena cāsya prāptinaṃ yuktā; `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| lukpunaḥ kṛte tyadādyatve prāpnotyakṛte'pi| nanu ca kṛte tyadādyatve lukaḥ prāptireva nāsti; `ato'm‌' (7.1.24) ityapavādavidhānāt‌| tasmātso'pyanitya eva? ityāha--`luko hi' ityādi| asati `ato'm‌' (7.1.24) iti lakṣaṇe'kārāntamapyaṅgaṃ luko nimittamāsīt‌, tadanena lakṣaṇenopajāyamānenāpavādavidhānāllukaṃ pratyanimittabhāvamāpadyate| lugnimittābhāvāpādanameva vighātaḥ| `na punastyadādyatvena' iti| luko nimittabhāvo vihanyata iti sambandhanīyam‌| yadi `ato'm‌' (7.1.24) ityapavādavidhāyi lakṣaṇāntaraṃ na syāt‌, kṛte tyadādyatve syādevākārāntamaṅgaṃ luko nimittam‌| tacca `ato'm‌' (7.1.24) ityapavādenaiva luko nimittaṃ vyāhanyate, na punastyadādyatvena| yadyevam‌ tatkimityanityo lugna bhavati? ityāha--`yasya ca' ityādi| lakṣaṇāntaratvaṃ lakṣaṇāntaratvaṃ punarambhāvaśāstrasya tyadādyatvaśāstrāpekṣayā veditavyam‌|| 24. ato'm‌| (7.1.24) pūrveṇa prāpatasaya luko'yamapavādaḥ| taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham‌; na tu dīrghanivṛttyartham‌| dīrghasyābhāvāt‌| abhāvastu `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvavidhānāt‌| atha kimarthamambhāva ucyate, na makārādeśa evocyeta? na caivam‌; `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti dvitīyaikavacanākārasya makāre kṛte dvayormakārayoḥ śralaṇaṃ prāpnoti; ekasya saṃyogāntalopenāpahṛtatvāt‌| nāpi `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti yañādau supi vidhīyamānaṃ dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti; `sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiranimittaṃ tadvighātasya' (vyā.pa.12) iti vacanāt‌| akārāntasannipāte hi makāravidhiḥ, sa kathamakāravighātasya nimittaṃ syāt‌? evaṃ tarhi makārādeśe vighātavye'mā deśaṃ kurvannetajjñāpayati--nityaiṣā paribhāṣeti| tenātijarasāt‌, atijarasairiti jarasādeśaḥ siddho bhavati|| 25. adḍḍatarādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ| (7.1.25) dviḍākāro'yaṃ nirddaśaḥ--tatraiko ḍatarasambandhī dvitīyastvādeśambandhī| ḍatarādayaścaite sarvādyantaḥpātino gṛhyante; na tu `dvayorekasya ḍatarac‌' (5.3.92) ityevamādayaḥ pratyayāḥ| kuta etat‌? netarācchandasi' (7.1.26) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| pratyayagrahaṇe hītaraśabdāt‌ prāptereva nāstīti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌| teṣāṃ ḍatarādīnāṃ madhye'ntyāni trīṇi prātipadikāni; ḍataraḍatamau ca pratyayau; tatra pratyagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho.pa.sū.7) tadantayorgrahaṇaṃ bhavati| `katarat‌' iti| `kiṃyattadornirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac‌' (5.3.92)| `katamat‌' iti| `vā bahunāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac‌' (5.3.93)| `katarat‌ tiṣṭhatītyatra' ityādi| asati hi ṅitkaraṇe katarat‌ tiṣṭhatītyatra `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (6.1.101) ityanuvarttamāne `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) iti dīrghaḥ syāt‌, ataḥ sa mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ kriyate| atra hi kṛte dīrghatvaprasaṅgo na bhavati; ṭilopenā'ko'pahṛtatvāt‌| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam‌--prathamaikavacanasyaiva ṅitkaraṇasya dīrghābhāvaḥ prayojanamucyate, na tu dvitīyaikavacanasya? ityata āha--`iha tu' ityādi| amo hi sthāne ya ādeśastasya `sthānivadādeśo'nalvidho' (1.1.56) iti sthānivadbhāvādami pūrvatvenāpi sidhyati--kataradityetat‌, tasmāt‌ tatra ṅitkaraṇasya dīrghatvābhāvaḥ prayojanamiti nocyate| `takārādeśa eva kasmānna kriyate' iti| yadyatra dīrghatvaṃ neṣyate tadā takārādeśa eva karttavyaḥ| tatrāpyayamarthaḥ--dīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ na karttavyamiti| `he katarat‌' ityādi| yadi takārādeśa eva kriyate tadā tasya sthānivadbhāvena sambuddhibhāvo'stīti `eṅ hrasvāt‌ sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti lopaḥ prāpnoti, ataḥ sa mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ takārādeśo na kriyate| `apṛktaśca' ityādi| `halṅyābbhyo dīrghātsutisyapṛktam‌' (6.1.69) ityataścedapṛktagrahaṇaṃ sambuddhilope'nuvarttate tadāmo doṣaḥ--he kuṇḍetyatra| nivṛtte'pṛktādhikāre ḍatarādiṣu doṣaḥ--he kataraditi| tasmāḍḍitkaraṇādevākāralope kṛte hrasavābhāvānna lopaḥ, na ca dīrghateti|| 26. netarācchandasi| (7.1.26) pūrveṇādḍādeśasya prasakatasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| atha `ato'm‌' (7.1.24) ityasyānantaraṃ ` itarācchandasi' iti kasmānnoktam‌, evaṃ hi neti pratiṣedhaḥ
