karttavyo na bhavati, amādeśo'dḍādeśasyāpavādo bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`ato'mityasmādanantaram‌' ityādi| `yogavibhāgārtham‌' iti| netyekayogavibhāgo yathā syāditi| kimarthaṃ punaryogavibhāga iṣyate? ityāha--`ekatarāddhi' ityādi| ekaśabdāddhi sarvatra pratiṣedha iṣyate, sa ca neti yogavibhāgāllabhyate| tasmādyogavibhāga iṣyate| sa ca yathānyāse sidhyati; nānyatheti `netarācchandasi' ityucyate|| 27. yuṣmadasmadrabhyāṃ ṅso'ś‌| (7.1.27) yadi `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) ityantalopaḥ, tadāsya bhāve prāpta idaṃ vacanam‌| atha ṭilopaḥ, tadā vibhakteḥ śravaṇaprāpta ādeśārthaṃ vacanam‌| `tada svam‌, mama svam‌' iti| `tadamamau ṅasi' (7.2.96) iti maparyantayoryuṣmadasmadostavamamādeśau bhavataḥ| `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) iti dakaralope kṛte `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| `śitkaraṇaṃ sarvādeśārtham‌' iti| asati śitkaraṇe `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityākārasyādeśo'kāraḥ syāt‌| nanu cākārasyākāravacane prayojanaṃ nāstītyantareṇāpi śitkaraṇaṃ sarvādeśo bhaviṣyati, antasya vā| tatra dvayorakārayorato guṇe pararūpatveneṣṭaṃ sidhyati? ata āha--`anyathā hi' ityādi| anyathā yadi śitkaraṇaṃ na syāt‌ tadā''deśa iti yo'yaṃ vyapadeśastasya yā praklṛptiḥ-niṣpattistadarthamādereva syāt‌; `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti vacanāt‌| syādetat‌--yadyādeśavyapadeśapraklṛptitaḥ kaścidarthaḥ sampadyate tadā syāt‌ tadarthamādereva vacanam‌, na ca tataḥ kaścidarthaḥ sampadyate tasmādayuktameveti? ityata āha--`tataśca' ityādi| caśabdo hetau| liṅ‌ sambhāvanāyām‌| tata ādeśavyapadeśapraklṛpteḥ `yo'ci' (7.2.82) iti kāryaṃ na syāt‌| etaddhi yatra vibhaktāvādeśo nāsti tatra vidhīyate; `anādeśe' (7.2.86) ityadhikārāt‌| tasmāt‌ prayojanavatyādeśavayapadeśapraklṛptiriti tadarthamādereva syāt‌, tataśceṭaṃ rūpaṃ na sidhyet‌| tasmāt‌ sarvādiśārthaḥ śakāraḥ karttavyaḥ|| 28. ṅe prathamayoram‌| (7.1.28) `ṅe ityavibhaktiko'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ' (iti)| `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) iti ṣaṣṭhyā luptatvāt‌| prathamayoriti ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanāntam‌--prathamā ca prathamā ca te prathame, tayoḥ prathamayoḥ| ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśasyobhayatra tulyatvāt‌ prathamayoḥ pratyayayoḥ svaukārayorgrahaṇamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākartumāha--`vibhaktyoḥ' iti| etadeva spaṣṭīkartumāha--`prathamādvitīyayoḥ' iti| kathaṃ punardvitīyā prathamāśabdenocyate? upadeśe prathamāsāmīpyāt‌| bhavati hi sāmīpyāt‌ tācchabdyam‌, yathā--gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa iti| atha vibhaktyoridaṃ grahaṇaṃ na pratyayoḥ--iti kuto'yaṃ niścayaḥ? liṅgāt‌| tatpunarliṅgaṃ `dvitāyāyāñca' (7.2.87) ityattvavidhānam‌| taddhyādeśārthamucyate; anādeśe hi `yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe' nānyathā| nanu ca `yo'ci' (7.2.89) iti yatvabādhanārtham‌ `dvitīyāyāñca' (7.2.87) ityādvacanaṃ syāt‌? naitadasti; tadarthe dvivacane yakārameva viśeṣaṇaṃ vidadhyāt‌--`yo'cyadvitīyāyām‌' iti, `yo'cyanaci' iti vā drūyāta| ato dvitīyāyāmāttvavidhānaṃ jñāpakamevaitadvibhaktigrahaṇasya| `tabhyam‌, mahyam‌' iti| maparyantayoryuṣmadasmadostabhyamahyāvādeśau| `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90), `ami pūrvaḥ' (6.1.107)| `tvam‌, aham‌' iti| `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94)| `yuvām‌, āvām‌ iti| `yuvavau dvivacane' (7.2.92) iti yuvāvau, `prathāyaśca' (7.2.88) ityādinā'ttvam‌| `yūyam, vayam‌' iti| `yūyavayau jasi' (7.2.93)| `tvām‌, mām‌' iti| tvamāvekavacane' (7.2.97), `dvitīyāyāñca' (7.2.87) ityāttvam‌| atha kimarthamamādeśa ucyate, na makāra evocyate? sa caikāltvādāderbhaviṣyati, tatra parasya saṃyogāntalopena siddham‌, `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) iti ṭilopānna sidhyatīti cet‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; seṣe lopo yadyapi ṭilopaḥ syāt‌, tathāpi `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94) ityevamādīnāmakārāntatvāt‌ siddhyatyeva; te cāvaśyakamakārāntā vidheyāḥ, antodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| na ca makārādeśe `suci ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti; `aṅgavṛtte punaraṅgavṛttāvidhirniṣṭhitasya' (vyā.pa.38) iti vacanāt‌| evaṃ tarhi vaicitryārthamamādeśavidhānam‌| atha vā--makāra evādeśaḥ, akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ; na hyanyathāsminnirdeśa ādāvante vā'kāramakṛtvā makāra ucacārayituṃ śakyate| `ṅetsuṭoḥ' iti| vaktavye `ṅe prathamayoḥ' iti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham‌|| 29. śaso na| (7.1.29) pūrveṇāmādeśe prāpte śaso na vidhīyate| `yuṣmān‌ brāhmaṇān‌| asmān‌ brāhmaṇān‌' iti| `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityakārasya nakāraḥ, saṃyogāntalopaḥ, pūravavadāttvam‌| nanu caitadudāharaṇadvayamamādeśe kṛta āttve ca `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) iti dīrghatve ca `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (6.1.103) iti natvemaiva sidhyati? naitadasti; na hyatra pūrvasavaraṇadīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti, amipūrvatvena bādhitatvāt‌|| 30. bhyaso bhyam‌| (7.1.30) `yuṣmabhyam‌, asmabhyam‌' iti| `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) ityantalopaḥ| yadi bhyamādeśo'yam‌, evaṃ sati tatra vihite śeṣelope ca `bahuvacane jhalyet‌' (7.3.103) ityettvaṃ prāpnoti, tataścāniṣṭarūpamāpadyeta? ityata āha--`bhyamādeśe kṛte' ityādi| varttanaṃ vṛttam‌, aṅge vṛttaṃ yasya tadaṅgavṛttaṃ kāryam‌, tasminnaṅgavṛtte kārye punarattarakālamaṅgavṛttāvaparasya kāryasya prāptau tasya kāryasyādidhiḥ;-avidhānam‌| niṣṭhitasyetyanena yatsamambandhinaḥ kāryasyāvidhirbhavati tadaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate| niṣṭhitam‌-parisamāptam‌, prayogārhamaṅgam| tatsambandhinaḥ kāryasyāvidhirbhavati, nānyasambandhina ityarthaḥ| `kecit‌' ityādi| teṣāmantyalope kṛte `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ bhavati| `yeṣāṃ tu' ityādi| yaiḥ `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) ityantalopaḥ kriyate, teṣāṃ matabhedaḥ--te hi kecidbhyamādeśamicchanti, kecidabhyamādeśam‌| yeṣāṃ tu śeṣelopaṣṭilopaḥ teṣāṃ matenāyamabhyamādeśa eva, na bhyamādeśaḥ; anyathā yuṣmabyamiti na sidhyevitayabhiprāyaḥ| yadi tarhi śeṣelopaṣṭilopaḥ, evaṃ sati `anudāttasya yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.101) ityanenābhyam‌śabdasyān‌todāttatvaṃ syāt‌? ityata āha--`udāttanivṛttisvaraśca' ityādi| pūrvapakṣavādinodāttanivṛttisvaravidhau `karṣātvato ghaño'nta udāttaḥ' (6.1.159) ityato'ntagrahaṇamanuvarttata iti manyamānena coditan‌| uttarapakṣavādinā tu `antagrahaṇaṃ tatra nivṛttamuccāraṇakramapratayāsattyā cāderevodāttatvena bhavituṃ yuktam‌' iti| manyamānena parihṛtam‌|| 31. pañcamyā at‌| (7.1.31) pūrveṇa prāptasya bhyamo'yamapavādaḥ|| 32. ekavacanasya ca| (7.1.32) cakārodādeśānukarṣaṇārthaḥ, bhyasapekṣayā samuccayārtho vā| `ṅaseśca' iti| vaktavye, ekavacanakteti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham‌|| 33. sāma ākam‌| (7.1.33) `sama iti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanamāgatasuṭkaṃ parigṛhyate' iti| yuṣmadasmadbhyāmuttarasyānyasya sāmaśabdasyāsambhavāt‌| āgataḥ samprāptaḥ suṭ‌ yatra yena vā tattathoktam‌| `atha' ityādau vākya `āgatasuṭkaḥ' ityāmpratyayāpekṣayā puṃlliṅgatvaṃ veditavyam‌! `atha kimarthamāgatasuṭkaḥ parigṛhyate' iti pṛṣṭasya sasuṭkasyādeśo yathā syāditi prativacanamāśahkyāha--`na hi' ityādi| `āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ‌' (7.1.52) ityatra `ājjaserasuk‌' (7.1.50) ityata āditi varttate, tenākārāntāt‌ sarvanāmnaḥ suṅ‌ vidhīyate| akārāntatā ca yuṣmadasmadoḥ `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) ityantalope sati bhavati| śeṣelopenāpyākamādeśe kṛte bhavitavyam‌| tasmādādeśavidhānakāle suṇna vidyate| tataśca sasuṭkasyādeśo yathā syādityetatprayojanaṃ nopapadyata ityanyadvaktavayamityabhiprāyeṇāha--`tasyaiva' ityādi| yadyasuṭko gṛhyate `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' (vyā.pa.106) ityasuṭkasyaivādeśaḥ syāt‌| evañcābhinivṛtte sthānyādeśabhāve paścādbhavataḥ suṭaḥ kena nivṛttiḥ syāt‌? iṣyate ca tasyāpi nivṛttiḥ| atastasya bhāvino'pi nivṛttiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ samuṭko gṛhyate| nanu ca yuṣmadasmadbhyāmuttarasyāmaḥ suḍeva na prāpnoti, akārāddhi sarvanāmnaḥ suṅ‌ vidhīyate, yuṣmadasmādośca tyadādyatvaṃ nāsti, `dviparyantāstyadādayaḥ' iti tyadādyatvasyābhāvāccheṣelopasya ca ṭilopādakārāntatā na sambhavati; ato bhāvino'pi suṭo nivṛttirnaiva prayojanamupapadyate? etaccodyamapākarttum‌ "`śeṣe lopaḥ' ityantalopaḥ" iti hṛdi kṛtvā''ha--`kṛte hi' ityādi| atha kriyamāṇe samuṭkasya grahaṇe kathamasau nivarttate, śāstrāntarāddhi prasaktasya śāstreṇa nivṛttiḥ kriyate, na cādeśavidhānakale suṭprasaṅgo'sti? ityāha--`sa ca sthānyantarbhūtatvāt‌' ityādi| yadyādeśavidhānakāle suṭaḥ prasaṅgaḥ sambhavet‌ tato bhāvī na nivarttate, na cāsāvādeśakāle sambhavati| tasmādbhāvinaḥ suṭaḥ sasuṭkagrahaṇena sthānyantarbhūtatvādyasyāmavasthāyāṃ tasya prāptistasyāṃ prasaktaḥ sa nivarttate; manyathā hi tasya sthānyantarbhāvo'narthakaḥ syāt‌| syādetat‌--yadi `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) ityantalopastataḥ samuṭakasyopādānamarthavadbhavati, yadā tu seṣelopaṣṭilopastadā nārthaḥ kasmānnāśrīyate, tasyānupapatteḥ| anupapattistu lakṣaṇābhāvāt‌| antyalopasyāsyaitadevāsti lakṣaṇamiti sa evāśritaḥ| yadyevam‌, yuṣmadbrāhmaṇībhyogacchatītyantyalope sati `ajādyataṣṭāp‌' (4.1.4) iti ṭāpprasajyeta? `aliṅge yuṣmadasmadī' iti naiṣo'staprasaṅgaḥ| `dīrghoccāraṇam‌' ityādi| nanu cākamyapi akaḥ savarṇadīrghatve (6.1.101) na sidhyatyeva? na; sidhyati| `ato gaṇe' (6.1.97) iti pararūpatvamapavādaḥ prāpnotīti cet‌? na; akāroccāraṇasāmarthyāt‌| yadi ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ syāt‌ tadākāroccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, kamityeva brayādityata āha--`akami tu' ityādi| tuśabdo dīrghoccāraṇāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ| itikaraṇo hetau| yadi hyakāroccāraṇasya prayojanaṃ na syāt‌, śakyate vaktum‌--akārocacāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti; asti ca tasaya prayojanam‌, kiṃ tat‌? `brahuvacane jhalyet‌' (7.3.103) ityettvaṃ mā bhūt‌| tasmāt‌ satyapyakāroccāraṇa etattvanivṛttyarthe `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ syāt‌, na savarṇadīrghatvam‌| atastadarthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kriyate|| 34. āta au ṇalaḥ| (7.1.34) `tasyau' iti| `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' (7.4.61) iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ| `jaglau' iti| `kahoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam‌| iha `pā' ityādibhyo ṇali paratravasthite yugapat‌ trīṇi kāryāṇi prāpnuvanti--dvivacanam‌, ekādeśaḥ, autvañca| teṣāñca tathā prāptānāṃ yugapatpravṛttiḥ sambhavatīti sāmarthyāt‌ prāptaḥ krama āśrīyate| tatra yena krameṇa tāni karttavyāni, taṃ darśayitumāha--`atra' ityādi| atretyanena papavityādīnyudaharaṇāni pratyayamuśyante| yadi dvirvacanādekādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ kriyate tadā `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhāvekādeśe kṛte nimittanimittinoviṃśeṣābhāvālliṭi parataḥ pūrvasyocayamānaṃ dvivacanaṃ na prāpnotīti tasya nirāsāyedamuktam‌--sthānivadbhāvo dvirvacanamiti| kena punaratra sthānivadbhāvaḥ? `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) ityanena? naivam‌; dvirvacananimitte'pi parataḥ pūrvasyocyamānaṃ dvivacanaṃ na prāpnotīti tasya nirāsāyedamuktam‌--sthānivadbhāvo dvirvacanamiti| kena punaratara sthānivadbhāvaḥ? `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) ityanena? naivam‌; dvirvacananimitte'ci parataḥ pūrvasaya sthānivadbhāva ucyate, na cātra dvirvacananimittaṃ paramacaṃ paśyāmaḥ| atra kcidāhuḥ--acītyupalakṣaṇam‌, aci ya ādeśo dṛṣṭaḥ sa dvirvacane karttavye sthānivadbhavatītīmaṃ sūtrārthamāśrityaitaduktam‌| iha sampratyanacparatve'pyekādeśakaraṇakāle'caḥ parasya nimittabhāvenaśrayaṇādacyayamādeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| tasmādbhavitavyaṃ sthānivadbhāvena| anye tvāhu--`ekādeśaḥ pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhavatīti vaktavyam‌' ityanayeṣṭyā sthānivadbhāvaḥ| `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti yogāvibhāgādvā sthānivadbhāvaḥ ityapare| kathaṃ punarayameṣāṃ kāryāṇāṃ krama upalabhyate? ityata āha--`ekādeśāt‌' ityādi| pā-a iti sthite'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ (6.1.101) prāpnoti, autvañca| tatraikādeśaḥ--daṇḍāgramityādau sāvakāśaḥ, autvaṃ tu na kvacit‌ sāvakāśam‌; atastāvadanavakāśatvāt‌ prāgautvaṃ kriyate, tatara kṛte vṛddhiḥ prāpanoti, dvavacanañca, tatra paratvād‌vṛddhirbhavati| dvivacanaṃ hi--papācetyādau sāvakāśam‌, vṛddhestvavakāśaḥ--khaṭvaiḍaketyādau| ato vṛddhau kṛtāyāṃ paścādbhavati dvirvacanaṃ sthānivadbhāvena! `ṇalaḥ' iti| ṇakāroccāraṇaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌| ṇalo ṇakāroccāraṇe hi ṇalpratyayo'stīti tasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati| tasmiṃścāsatyala ityucyamāne satyalpratyayasyābhāvāt‌ pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ vijñāyeta| lakāroccāraṇaṃ `śyādvyadha' (3.1.141) ityādinā vihitasya ṇapratyayasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌| atha `ekavacanasya' (7.1.32) ityanuvarttate? tathā sati mukhasukhārtham‌|| 35. tuhyostātaṅāśiṣyanyatarasyām‌| (7.1.35) `jovatādbhavān‌' iti| `āśiṣi liṅloṭau' (3.3.173) iti loṭ‌ tip‌, śap‌ `eruḥ' (3.4.86) ityutvam‌, tasya tuśabdasya tātaṅ‌| jīvatāttvam‌' iti| sip‌, `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti hirādeśaḥ; tasya tātaṅ| `jīva tvam‌' iti| `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti herluk‌| atha jīvatāt‌ tvamityatra sthānivadbhāvena tātaṅo higrahaṇena grahaṇāllukkasmānna bhavati? `hujhalbhyo herghiḥ (6.4.101) ityato herityanuvarttamāne punaḥ `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti grahaṇāt‌| tasya hyetat‌ prayojanam‌--hirūpāvasthitasyaiva herlugyathā syāt‌| sthānivadbhāvena yacchabdāntaraṃ higrahaṇena gṛhyate tasya mā bhūt‌| atha `ṅicca' (1.1.53) iti vacanāt‌ tātaṅyamantyasya kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`ṅitkaraṇam‌' ityādi| gaṇapratiṣedhārtham‌--brūyāt‌ bhavānityatra| vṛddhipratiṣedhārtham‌--mṛṣṭādityatra| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmādguṇavṛddhipratiṣedhārthaṃ ṅitkaraṇaṃ tasmātsarvādeśastātaṅ bhavati| yadi hi tasyānyat‌ prayojanaṃ na syāt‌, syādevāntyasya tātaṅ‌| asti ca tasyānyat‌ prayojanaṃ guṇavṛddhiprataṣedhaḥ| tasmin‌ sati kiṃ `ṅicca' (1.1.53) ityantyasya bhavatu, atha `anekālśitsarvasya' (1.1.55) iti sarvasya vā? tatra paratvāt‌ sarvādeśenaiva yuktaṃ bhavitum‌| tasmāt‌ `anekālśitsarvasya' (1.1.55) iti sarvasya vā? tatra paratvāt‌ sardādeśenaiva yuktaṃ bhavitum‌| tasmāt‌ `anekālśitsarvasya' (1.1.55) iti sarvasyaiva syāditi sarvādeśo bhavati| nanu ca tusthānikasya tātaṅaḥ sthānivadabhāvena pittvaṃ prāpnoti; tataśca hali piti sārvadhātuke yatā bravītvityatreṅ bhavati, tathā brūtādbhavānityatrāṇīṭā bhavitavyam‌?--etaccodyamapākarttamāha--`ṅittvācca' ityādi| asyeti tātaṅaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ nivartate? ityāha--`ṅicca' ityādi| cakāro hetau| tusthānikasya tātaṅo nāprāpte pittve ṅittvamārabhyata iti ṅittvena hi pittvaṃ bādhyate| tathāsau ṅidbhavata yadi sthānivadbhāvena prāptaṃ pittvaṃ nivarttate| `tena' ityādi| yata evaṃ pittvaṃ nivarttate tena pittvāśraya īṇna bhavati| grāmaṃ gacchatu bhavān‌| tvaṃ gaccheti| `loṭ‌ ca' (3.3.62) iti bidhyādau loṭ‌|| 36. videḥ śaturvasuḥ| (7.1.36) yadyapi videriti sāmānyanirdeśo'yam‌, tathadhāpi jñānārthasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tasyaiva hi śatānantaraḥ sambhavati, nānyeṣāṃ vidīnām‌| tatra sattāvicāraṇārthayoḥ śaturasambhava eva; ātmanepaditvam‌| lābhārthasya tūbhayayaditvāt‌ sambhavatyasau, na tvanantaraḥ; śapratyayena vyavadhānāt‌| jñānārthasya tu lugvikaraṇatvācchaturvikaraṇakṛtaṃ vyavadhānaṃ nāsti, atastasyaiva grahaṇamityāha--`vida jñāne' iti| `vidvān‌' iti| ugittvānnum‌, `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ| anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvarttate| tena pakṣe vidan‌, vidantau, vidanta ityādyapi bhavati| ecaca gamyamānatvādvṛttau noktam‌| atha kimarthamukāro'nubandhaḥ kriyate, numādyugitkāryaṃ yathā syāditi cet‌? na; tasya sthānivadbhāvenaiva siddhatvādityata āha--`sthānivadbhāvāt‌' ityādi| `kvaso'pi' iti| apiśabdādasyāpi| asatyukāre sāmānyārthe kvasoreva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, nānyasya| atha `vasoḥ samprasāraṇam‌' (6.4.131) iti sūtraṃ kriyata evāsyaiva grahaṇārtham‌, na kvasoḥ; nanu ca satyapyukārakaraṇe sāmānyagrahaṇaṃ nopapadyate, ekānubandhakapari(vyā.pa.52) bhā,yāsyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, na kvasoḥ? ityāha--`ekānubandhakagrahaṇe' ityādi| etat‌ paribhāṣāsūtram‌| na bhavati| nopatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na bhavati? ityāha--`tathā ca sati' ityādi| evañca satītyarthaḥ| yadi kriyamāṇe'pyukāra ekānubandhaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate, evaṃ satyukārakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| vinā'pi tena `vasaḥ samprasāraṇam‌' ityucyamāne kevalasyāsya grahaṇaṃ labhyata eva| tasmādukārakaraṇasāmarthyādiyaṃ paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate|| 37. samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyup‌| (7.1.37) `anañpūrve' iti| na nañ‌ anañ‌ anañ‌ pūrvo yasaya so'nañpūrvaḥ| `prakṛtya' ityādi| `samānakarttukayoḥ pūrvakāle' (3.4.21) ktvā, `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ, `hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk‌' (6.1.71) iti tuk‌| `pārśvataḥkṛtya' iti| `svāṅge taspratyaye kṛbhvoḥ (3.4.61) iti ktvā, `tṛtīyāprabhṛtīnyanyatarasyām‌' (2.2.210 iti samāsaḥ| `nānākṛtya' iti| `nādhārthapratyaye cvyarthe' (3.4.62) iti ktvā, pūrvavatsamāsaḥ| `kṛtvā, hṛtvā' iti| etat pratyudāharaṇam‌| atra kṛtvāśabdo'nañpūrvo'sti; kintu samāso na bhavatīti lyababhāvaḥ| `paramakṛtvā, uttamakṛtvā' iti| `sanprahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāsaḥ| kathaṃ punaranena samāsaḥ? kathañcaṃ na syāt‌? sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvāt‌? vārttametat‌; karttari ktvā vihitaḥ, sa eva ca paramottamaśabdābhyāṃ viśiṣyate, tat‌ kathaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvaḥ! atha kriyāviśeṣaṇatvaṃ tayorāśritya sāmānādhikaraṇyabhāva ucyate, evamapi `viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam‌' (2.1.57) ityato bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtterasāmānādhikaraṇye'pi samāso bhavati| nanu cānañpūrvāvetau samāsau, tat‌ kathametatpratyudāharaṇamupapadyate? ityāha--`anañ‌' ityādi| anañiti nāyaṃ prasajyeparatiṣedhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? paryudāsaḥ--naño'nyadanañ‌| tatra nañivayuktanyāyena (vyā.pa.65) naño yadanyannañsadṛśamavyayaṃ tadanañiti parigṛhyate| tena kāraṇena nañavyayamanavyayañca paramaśabdādikamubhayamapyetadanañ‌ na bhavati, na tatrāvyayena nañā sādṛśyamasti| atyantābhedādanavyayatvācca yathākramam‌| tasmād‌ yathā akṛtvā, ahatvetyetat‌ pratyudāharaṇamupapannarūpam‌, evaṃ paramakṛtvā, uttamakṛtveyapi| yadi tarhi anañiti nañsadṛśamadhyayaṃ parigṛhyate--snātvākālakaḥ, pītvāsthiraka ityādāvapi syāt‌, asti hyatrāpi nañsadṛśamadhyayaṃ pūrvapadam‌; ktvāpratyayasyāvyayatvādityāha--`snātvākālakaḥ' ityādi| mayūravyaṃsakādiṣu samāsasaṃjñārthamete samudāyāḥ paṭhyante, tasmānnipātanāllyabādeśo na bhavati| `atha vā' ityādi| `samāse' ityadhikaraṇasaptamyāṃ satyāṃ snātvākālakādiṣu lyabādeśaprasaṅgo bhavatīti| tathā hyadhikaraṇasaptamyāmayamartho bhavati--samāse'nañpūrve yaḥ ktvā varttate tasya lyabbhavati| evañca sati deśaviśeṣaparigrahābhāvādyathā samāsasyānte varttamānasya ktvo lyabbhavati, tathā madhye'pi syāt‌| tasmānna ceyamadhikaraṇasaptamī, kiṃ tarhi? nirghāraṇasaptamī| tasmiṃśca pakṣe `samāse' iti jātāvekavacanam‌, yathā--`kārake' (1.4.23) iti| atha vā `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) iti subvyatyayena bahuvacanasya sthāna ekavacanaṃ veditavyam‌| `tena' ityādi| yato nirdhāraṇa iyaṃ saptamī, tena ktvāntaḥ samāsa eva gṛhyate, na samāsāvayavaḥ--snātveti| nirghāraṇaṃ hi samānajātīyasyaiva bhavati, yathā--kṛṣṇā gavāṃ sampannakṣīratametyukte gaureva nirdhāryamāṇā pratīyate, tathā'trāpi `samāso'nañpūrve' ityukte samāseṣvanañpūrveṣu madye yaḥ ktvāntaḥ samāsaḥ sa eva nirdhāyamāṇaḥ pratīyate| tena samāsasyaiva ktvāntasya grahaṇamiti tasyaiva lyabādeśena bhavitavyam‌, na ca snātvākālakādiṣu ktvāntaḥ samāsaḥ| snātvākālakādayo yadyapi samāsāḥ, na tu ktvāntā iti lyabādeśo na bhavati| sa ca samāsaḥ `yena vidhisatadantasya' (1.1.72) iti tadantavidhinā ktvānto gṛhyate| kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇena (vyā.pa.126) vā pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho.pa.sū.7) tadantagrahaṇaṃ na śakyate vaktum‌| na hi ktvāpratyayaḥ samāsādutpadyate| tatra yadi kṛdgrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.126) tadanto gṛhyate, nānākṛtyetyatra na syāt‌; na hyayaṃ gatikārakapūrvaḥ| ihaiva tu syāt‌--prakṛtya, pārśvataḥkṛtyeti| asiti hyatrāpi gatiḥ kārakaśca pūrvo'vayavaḥ, `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityanena tadantavidhau gamyamāne sarvatra bhavatīti manyamāna āha--`sa ca' ityādi| atraivopapattimāha--`tathā ca' ityādi| yasmāt‌ `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityanena ktvāntaḥ samāso gṛhyate, evañca kṛtvā `anañpūrve' ityucyate| `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityanena ktvāntaḥ samāso gṛhyate, evañca kṛtvā `anañpūrve, ityucyate| `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityanena hi sāmānyena tadantavidhau sati nañpūrvasyāpi prasajyeta| tasmāt‌ tannivṛttyartham‌ `anañpūrve' iti yuktamuktam‌| yadi kṛdgrahaṇaparibhā,yā (vyā.pa.126) ktvāntaḥ samāso gṛhyate, tadā gatikārakapūrvasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| evañca gatikārakapūrvasya grahaṇe sati nañpūrvasya prasaṅga eva nāsti| `nañ‌ na gatirna ca kārakam‌' iti| ato hetoryathaiva paramakṛtvetyatra prasaṅgo nāsti, paramaśabdasyāgatitvādakārakatvācc; tathā'kṛtvetyatrāpi, naño'gatitvādakārakatvācca| tataśca prasaṅgābhāvāt‌ `anañpūrve' iti na vaktavyaṃ syāt‌, uktañca| tadetasmādanañpūrva iti vacanāt‌ `yena vidhistadantasya (1.1.72) ityanena ktvāntaḥ samāso gṛhyate, na tu kṛdgahaṇaparibhāṣayeti sthitametat‌| `pradhāya' iti| atrāntaraṅgatvāt‌ `daghāterhiḥ' (7.4.42) iti hiḥ prāpnoti| `prasthāya' iti--atrāpi `dyatisyatimāsthāmitti kiti' (7.4.40) itīttvam‌| `prakhanya' iti| `janasanakhanām‌' (6.4.42) ityāttvam‌| `praṇabhya' iti| `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) iti dīrghaḥ| `āpṛcchya' iti `cchvoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) iti śatvam‌| `pratidīvya' iti| tenaivoṭ‌| `prapaṭhya' iti| `ārthadhātukasyeṅ valādeḥ' (7.2.35) itīṭ‌| antaraṅgatvaṃ panareṣāmekapadāśrayatvāt‌| lyabādeśasya tu bahirahgatvam‌, samarthānekapadāśrayasamāsāpekṣatvāt‌| hiprabhṛtiṣu kṛteṣu pradhāyetyādīni rūpāṇi na sidhyanti? iti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`pradhāya' ityādi| `jñāpitametat‌' iti| `ado jagghirlyapti kiti' (2.4.36) ityatra| atha pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌| nānañotyevamucyeta? naivaṃ śakyam‌; anañotyucyamāne bahuvrīhirayaṃ syāt‌--avidyamāno nañ‌ yatrāsāvanañiti| tataścehāpi na syāt‌--straiṇīkṛtyeti| striyā idaṃ straiṇam‌, `strīpuṃsābhyāṃ,nañsnañau bhavanāt‌' (4.1.87) iti nañ‌| tadantāt‌ `abhūtatadbhāve' (5.4.50) ityādinā cviḥ, `asya cvau' (7.4.32) itīttvam‌| `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| pūrvagrahaṇe tu sati pūrvaśabda ādibhūtāvayavamācaṣṭe| tena yatra samāsādibhūto nañ‌ tatra na lyapā bhavitavyam‌, tatra straiṇīkṛtyetyatra bhavatyeva| na hyatra samāsādibhūto nañavayavaḥ, kiṃ triha? madhyabhūtaḥ| litkaraṇam‌--pratikīrṣyetyatra litpratyayāt‌ pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| prakṛtyetyevamādāvṛdāttārthaṃ litkaraṇaṃ nopapadyate, dhātusvareṇaiva pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ sidhyati| tasmādanekājhavayava eva dhārlittvaṃ prayojayati|| 38. ktvāpi chandasi| (7.1.38) `paridhāpayitvā, pratyaryayitvā' iti| dadhāteḥ, artteśca hetumaṇṇic‌, `arttihrī' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk‌ `pugantalaghūpapadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ, ktvā, iṭ‌ ayādeśaḥ| `uddhṛtya' iti| `hṛñ‌ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899), `jhayo ho'nyatarasyām‌' (8.4.62) iti hakārasya dhakāraḥ| `vā chandasi' iti| vaktavye `ktvāpi chandasi' iti| vacanamasamāse'pi yathā syāt‌--arcya tān‌ devān‌ gata iti|| 39. supāṃ sulukpūrvasavarṇāccheyāḍāḍyāyājālaḥ| (7.1.39) `panthāḥ' iti| pathinnityetasmājjas‌, tasya suḥ, `pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt‌' (7.1.85) ityāttvam‌, `ito'tsarvanāmasthāne' (7.1.86) itīkārasyāttvam‌, `tho nthaḥ' (7.1.87) iti nthādeśaḥ| `supām‌' ityādinā supāṃ sthāne supa ādeśā bhavantītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--pūrvasūtrādapiśabdo'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena supāmanye'pi supo bhavanti| `dhuri dakṣiṇāyāḥ' iti| saptamyekavacanasya sthāna pañcamyekavacanam‌, ṣaṣṭhyekavacanaṃ vā| `tiṅām‌' ityādi| tiṅāñca tiṅo bhavantītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvapadeva vaktavyam‌| `ārdre carman‌' iti| saptamyekavacanasya carman‌śabdālluk‌| `yat‌' iti| atrāpi yacchabdāt‌, tacchabdācca| `dhītī' ityādi| `dhīti-mati-suṣṭutiśabdebhyaḥ parasaya tṛtīyaikavacanasya pūrvasavarṇa ikāraḥ, ubhayorakaḥ savarṇe (6.1.101) dīrghatvam‌| `ubhā' iti| ubhaśabdātprathamādvivacanasyākāraḥ| `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) ityekādeśaḥ| `na tād‌ brāhmaṇād‌ nindāmi' iti| tacchabdād‌ brāhmaṇaśabdācca dvitīyaikavacanasyāt‌| niśabde parataḥ `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) iti takārasya nakārādeśaḥ| `yuṣme, asme' iti| yuṣmadasmacchabdābhyāṃ parasya ca jasaḥ `śe' (1.1.13) ityayamādeśaḥ| śakāraḥ sarvādeśārthaḥ| atheha `yūyaṣayau jasi' (7.2.93) iti yūyavayādeśau kasmānna bhavataḥ? ityāha-`yūyādeśaḥ' ityādi| `uruyā, dhṛṣṇuyā' iti| urudhṛṣṇuśabdābhyāṃ parasya tṛtīyaikavacanasya yādeśaḥ| `nābhā' iti| nābhiśabdāt‌ saptamye kavacansaya ḍādeśaḥ ḍakāraṣṭilopārthaḥ| `anuṣṭyā' iti| anuṣṭup‌śabdāt‌ tṛtīyaikavacanasya ḍyādeśaḥ| `sādhuyā' iti| sādhuśabdāt‌ parasya prathamaikavacanasya yājādeśaḥ| cakāro'ntodāttārthaḥ| `sorluki prāpte iti| yājityayamādeśo vidhīyata iti śeṣaḥ| lukprāptistu `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) ityanena| `vasantā' iti| vakantaśabdāt‌ parasya saptamyekavacanasyālityayamādeśaḥ| litkaraṇaṃ litpratyayāt‌ pūrvasyodāttatvaṃ yathā syāt‌| `upasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| pratipādanamasyārthaḥ| uttaratrāpyupasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| pratipādanaṃ tvapiśabdamāśritya karttavyam‌| urviyā, dārviyā' iti| urudāruśabdābhyāṃ parasya tṛtīyaikavacanasyeyādeśaḥ| `sukṣetriyā' iti| sukṣetrinnityādermatvarthīyenipratyayāntāt‌ parasya tṛtīyaikavacanasya ṅiyājādeśaḥ| ḍakāraṣṭilopārthaḥ| cakāro'ntodāttārthaḥ| `sarasī' iti| saraḥśabdāt‌ saptamyekavacanasya īkāraḥ| `prabāhavā' iti| prabāhuśabdāt‌ tṛtīyaikavacanasyāṅādeśaḥ, `gheṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇaḥ, avādeśaḥ| nanu ca `ṅittve vidyādvarṇanirdeśamātraṃ varṇe yatsyāttacca vidyāttadādau||' (ma.bhā.3.247) ityuktam‌, na cehādau ṅakāraḥ, tat‌ kathaṃ guṇaḥ? ṅitkaraṇasāmarthyādbhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `svapnayā' iti| svapnaśabdāt‌ parasya tṛtīyaikavacanasyāyāc‌, `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| cakāraḥ svarārthaḥ| `nāvayā' iti| mauśabdāt‌ parasya tṛtīyaikavacanasyāyārādeśaḥ| rephaḥ `upottamaṃ riti' (6.1.217) ityupottamākārasyodāttatvārthaḥ|| 40. amo maś‌| (7.1.40) `amiti mibādeśo gṛhyate' iti dvitīyaikavacanāśaṅkāṃ nirākāroti| dvitīyaikavacanasyāgrahaṇam‌; chandasi yathādṛṣṭānuvidhānāt‌| apiśabdānuvṛttervā, tadanuvṛttau hyeṣaṃ sambandhaḥ kriyate--amo maśca bhavati, apiśabdāt‌ kvacicchravaṇamapīti| `vadhīm‌' iti| hanterluṅa, `caleḥ sic‌' (3.1.44) sip‌, tasya `tasthastha' (3.4.101) ityādinā'm‌, tasya maśādeśaḥ--akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, `luṅi ca' (2.4.43) iti hantervadhādeśā, `ārdhadhātukasya' (7.2.35) ityādineṭ‌ `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ‌ `iṭa īṭi (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ, savarṇadīrghatadvalam| `kramīm‌' iti| `kramu pādavikṣepe' (dhā.pā.473) sarvaṃ pūrvavat‌| ayamatra viśeṣaḥ--`snukramoranātmanepadanimitte' (7.2.36) itīṭ‌| avadhivam‌, akramiṣamiti prāpte| `śitkakaraṇaṃ sarvādeśārtham‌' iti| asati tasmin‌ `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu ca makārasya makāravacane prayojanaṃ nāstītyantareṇāpi śakāraṃ sarvādeśo bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`makārasya' ityādi| asti hi makāravidhāne prayojanam‌| kiṃ tat‌? `mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.23) prāpnoti; sa mā bhūditi| satyetasmin‌ prayojane yadi śakāro na kriyeta, tadā'ntyasyaiva syāt‌, na syāt‌, na sarvasya| tasmāt‌ sarvādeśārthaḥ śakāraḥ karttavyaḥ|| 41. lopasta ātmanepadeṣu| (7.1.41) `aduhra' iti| duherlaṅa, adāditvācchapo luk‌, `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityādeśaḥ, `bahulaṃ chandasi' (7.1.8) iti ruṭ‌, takāralope kṛte dvayorakārayoḥ `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) parūpatvam‌| duhrām‌' iti| loṭ‌, bahuvacanaṃ jhaḥ, ṭeretvam‌, āmādeśaḥ, jhādeśasyāte ruḍāgamaḥ, pūrvacchapo luk‌, takāralope kṛte `akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ, (6.1.10)| `śaye' iti| laṭ‌, ekavacanāntaḥ, `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ' (7.4.21), śapo luk‌| `duhām‌' iti| loṭ‌ ekavacanāntaḥ, ṭerettvam‌, `āmetaḥ' (3.4.90) ityām‌| `dugdhām‌' iti| `dāderdhātordhaḥ (8.2.32), `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvam‌, `jhalāṃ jaś‌ śaśi' (8.4.56) iti dhakārasyā gakāraḥ| `apītyadhikarāt‌' ityādi| `ktvādi chandasi' (7.1.38) ityato'pītyanuvarttate, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate--lopo bhavati śravaṇamapīti; tena kuruta ityatra na bhavati| karoterguṇe kṛte `ata utsārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityuttvam‌| yadi apiśabdānuvṛtteḥ kvacicchravaṇamipa bhavati, ata eva hetoḥ parasmaipadeṣu na bhavatīti kimātmanepadagrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthamātmanepadagrahaṇam‌|| 42. dhvamo dhvāt‌| (7.1.42) `vārayadhvāt‌' iti| vṛño vṛṅo vā hetumaṇṇijantāt‌ `vṛñ‌ āvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1813) ityasmādvā curādiṇaayantālloṭ‌, tasya dhvam‌, tasya dhvāt‌| `vārayadhvam‌' iti| ṭerettve kṛte `savābhyāṃ vāmau' (3.4.91) ityamādeśaḥ|| 43. yajadhvainamiti ca| (7.1.43) 44. tasya tāt‌| (7.1.44) `loṇmadhyamapuruṣabahuvacanasya' iti| atha prathamapuruṣaspaikavacanaṃ kasmānna bhavati? chandasi yathādṛṣṭānu vidhānāt‌, apiśabdānuvṛttervā| `kṛṇutāt‌' iti| `kṛvi hiṃsākaraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.598) ityasyaidittvānnum‌, `dhinvikṛṇvyora ca' (3.1.80) ityupratyayaḥ, akāraścāntādeśaḥ, ato lopaḥ (6.4.48)| `saṃsṛjatāt‌' iti| sṛjestudāditvācchaḥ| `gamayatāt‌' iti| ṇic‌, `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92)|| 45. taptanaptanathanāśca| (7.1.45) `śrṛṇoteḥ' iti| `śruvaḥ śṛ ca' (3.1.74) iti śnupratyayaḥ, śṛbhāvaśca| pittve ṅittvābhāvādguṇaḥ| `sunota' iti| `svadibhyaḥ śnuḥ' (3.1.73)| `dadhātana' iti| dadhāteḥ `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌| atrāpi pūrvalat‌ ṅittvābhāvāt‌ `śnābyastayorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopo na bhavati| `dhatta' iti| `dadhastathośca' (8.2.38) ityabhyāsādakārasya dhakāraḥ| dhātorakāralope kṛte `jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvam‌--ḍakāraḥ, tasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌--takāraḥ| `jujuṣṭana' iti| iṣericchārthāt‌ pūrvavacchaḥ, `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.73) iti tasya luk‌| `yadicchata' iti| `iṣugamiyamāṃ chaḥ' (7.3.77)| cakāra stasyetyasyehānukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 46. idanto masi| (7.1.46) `idantaḥ' iti| takāro'sandehārthaḥ| asati hi takāre yaṇādeśe kṛte `yantaḥ' iti bhavitavyam‌, tatra sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimayaṃ yakārāntaḥ, utekārānta iti| id‌ anto yasya idantaḥ| masityayaṃ śabdo'nyapadārthaḥ| sakārāntamasītyavibhaktiko'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ; `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) iti prathamaikavacanasya luptatvāt‌| ikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| bhasītyayaṃ śabda ikārānto bhavatītyasyārthaṃ `masaḥ sakārāntasya' ityādinā vyaktīkaroti| `sakārāntasya' ityanena mantraṃ vocemetyatrākārāntasya na bhavatīti darśayati| kathaṃ punaḥ sakārāntasyopādāne'sakārāntasya prāpnoti? ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt‌| yadyevam‌, kasmānna bhavati? chandasi yathādṛṣṭānuvidhānāt‌| apautyadhikārādvā| `vocema' iti| vaceḥ parasyāśiṣi liṅo mas‌, yāsuṭ‌, `liṅyāśiṣi' (3.1.86) ityaṅ‌, `ato yeyaḥ' (7.2.80) itīyādeśaḥ, vaceḥ parasyāśiṣi liṅo mas‌, yāsuṭ‌ `liṅyāśiṣi' (3.1.86) ityaṅ‌,`ato yeyaḥ' (7.2.80) itīyādeśaḥ, `vaca um‌' (7.4.20) ityumāgamaḥ| `chandasyubhayathā' (3.4.117) iti sārvadhātukatvāt‌ `liṅaḥ salopo'nantyasya' (7.2.79) iti salopaḥ, `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' (3.4.99) ityuttamasya salopaḥ, `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yakārasaya ca, `ādaguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `āgama ikāro bhavati' iti| kathampunarayamāgamaḥ? kathañca na syāt‌? āgamaliṅgābhāvāt‌| ṭittva--kittva-mittvānyāgamaliṅgāni, atra caiṣāmekamapi nāsti, tato nāsāvāgamaḥ, yathā--`asterbhūḥ' (2.4.52) iti bhūbhāvaḥ| yadyevam‌, `na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau ca tābhyāmaic‌' (7.3.3) ityaijāgamo na syāt‌| atha pūrvagrahaṇāt‌ tasyāgamatvamavasīyate? asyāpyantagrahaṇādavasīyatām‌| yathaiva hi pūrvaśabdo'vayavavacano niyatadeśamadayavamācaṣṭe, tathāntaśabdo'pīti samānametat‌| `sa ca tasyānto bhavati' iti| anta ekadeśo'vayava iti yāvat‌| ata evāsau tadgarahaṇena gṛhyata ityāha--`tadgrahaṇena ca prayojanam‌--pṛthak‌ svaranivṛttiriti; `tiṅṅatiṅā' (8.1.28) iti nighātaśca| `masa ik‌' iti noktam‌; asandehārtham‌| evaṃ hyucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimigāgamaḥ, uta pratyāhāra iti| `dīpayāmasi, jambhayamasi' iti| `dīpī dṛptau' (dhā.pā.1150),jabhi jṛbhī gātravināme'?[`jabhī, jṛbhi--dhā.pā] (dhā.pā.388,389)--ābhyāṃ ṇaayantābhyāṃ laṭ‌, `radhijabhoraci' (7.1.61) iti lum‌| kvacit‌ bhañjayāmasīti pāṭhaḥ| sa ca `bhañjo āmardane' (dhā.pā.1453) ityasya ṇyaktasya veditavyam‌|| 47. ktvo yak‌| (7.1.47) `dattvāya' iti| `do dad‌ ghoḥ' (7.4.46) iti dadādeśaḥ| `ktvāpi chandasi' ityādi| evamucyamāne dviḥ ktvāgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `samāsa ityatrānuvarttate' iti| `samāse'nañpūrve' (7.1.37) ityataḥ| yadi tasyānantaramidamucyate, tatrāpi samāsagrahaṇamanuvarttata ityāśaṅkā syāt‌, tatastasyānuvṛttinivṛttyarthaṃ tasyānantaramidaṃ noktamityabhiprāyaḥ|| 48. iṣṭvīnamiti ca| (7.1.48) `iṣṭvīnam‌' iti| vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam‌| `pītvīnam‌' iti| `dhumāsthā' (6.4.66) ityādinettvam‌| etaccetikaraṇādādyarthāccakarāsyānuktasamuccayārthatvādvā labhyate| anayoranyataropādānenaiva siddha ubhayorupādānaṃ vaicitryārtham‌|| 49. snātvyādayaśca| (7.1.49) `snātvī, pītvī' iti| ākārasya sthāna īttvannipātyate| nanu ca snātvyādayaḥ śabdāḥ prātipadikagaṇe na paṭhyante, tatkathaṃ te veditavyāḥ? kathaṃ cādiśabdena te śakyā lakṣayitum‌? ityāha `prakārārtho'yamādiśabdaḥ' iti| evamprakārā ya etatsadṛśāḥ śabdāste snātvyādayo veditavyaḥ|| 50. ājajaserasuk‌| (7.1.50) jaseriti pūrvācāryanirddeśaḥ| pūrvācāryā hi jasirityevaṃ vihatavantaḥ| `ye pūrvāso ye parāsa ityatra' ityādi codyam‌| etacca jātau padārthe| tatrānyatra caritārthatvācchāstrayostulyabalayorvirodhe sati paraspara pratibandhādapravṛttau prāptāyāṃ `vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam‌' (1.4.2) iti kriyate--vipratiṣedhe paraṃ bhavati, tatra kṛte yadi pūrvamapi prāpnoti tadapi bhavatīti jātipadārthaḥ puna prasaṅgavijñānasya viṣayaḥ| `sakṛt‌' ityādinā parīhāraḥ| eva ca ṣyakto padārthe'nyatrākṛtārthatvāddvayorapi śāstrayorīdṛśe viṣaye paryāyeṇa pravṛttau prāptāyāmayaṃ niyama ārabhyate--vipratiṣedhe parameva bhavati, na pūrvamiti| tena punaḥ prasaṅgavijñānābhāvādbādhitaḥ śobhāvo na bhavati| na hyasati punaḥprasaṅge yadvādhitaṃ tadutsahate punarbhavitum‌|| 51. aśvakṣīravṛṣalavaṇānāmātmaprītau kyaci| (7.1.51) `ātmaprītau' iti| viṣayasaptamīyam‌| ata evāha--`ātmaprītiviṣaye kyaci' iti| ātmaprītirviṣayo yasya kyacaḥ sa tathoktaḥ| `aśvasyati' iti| ātmano'śvamicchatīti `supaḥ ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8) anenāsuk‌, ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| evaṃ `kṣīrasyati' ityādāvapi veditavyam‌| sarvatrātmaprītiviṣaye kyac‌| yo hyātmano'śvādikamicchati sa niyogata ātmanaḥ protyarthamicchati| yadyevam‌, icchāyāṃ kyacvidhīyamānaḥ sarvatrātmaprītiviṣaye bhaviṣyatītīcchāyāṃ vaktavyam‌? prasiddhyupasaṃgrahārthamātmaprītāviti laukikasyārthasyopādānam‌, tena yatrātmaprītāvasugloke prayujyate tatraiva bhavati, nānyatra| tenāśvavṛṣayormaithunecchāyāṃ kṣīralavaṇayorlālasāyāmityupapannaṃ bhavati| `aśvīyati' iti| aśvamivācaratīti `upamānādācāre' (3.1.10) iti kyac‌, `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam‌| `aśvavṛṣayoḥ' ityādi| ` aśvavṛṣyormethunecchāyāmasugbhavati' ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| `kṣīralavaṇayoḥ' ityādi| vaktavyamityetadapekṣate| `kṣoralavaṇayorlālasāyāmasugbhavati' ityetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu kṛtameva| `anyatrātmaprītāvapi na bhavati' iti| ātmano'śvādikamicchatyaśvīyatīti| lavaṇīyati| `tṛṣṇātarekaḥ' iti| tṛṣṇāyā atirekaḥ-atiśayaḥ, prakarṣaḥ, adhikyamityartha-|| 52. āmi sarvanāmnaḥ suṭ‌| (7.1.52) `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ‌' (7.1.54) iti prāpte vacanam‌| `āmīti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanaṃ parigṛhyate' iti| iha bahava āmaḥ sambhavanti--ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanam‌, `ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' (7.3.116) iti, `kimettiṅavyayadhādāmvadravyaprakarṣe' (5.4.11) iti, `kāspratyayādāmamantre liṭi' (3.1.35) ityām‌; eteṣāṃ yadi sarveṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt‌ tadā sarveṣām‌ `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ‌' (7.1.54) iti nuṭ‌ prasajyeta, tatrāpyetadevāmgrahaṇamanuvarttate, ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanasyaiveṣyate atastadeva gṛhyata ityāha--`tasya hi paratvāt‌' ityādi| suṭo nuṭaśca ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanamavakāśaḥ, āṭprabhṛtīnāṃ tu caturarthyekavacanādiḥ ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ' (7.3.116) iti paratvādāḍādayo bhavanti| tatra `āṇnadyāḥ' (7.3.112) ityāṭ‌--kumāryāmiti| `yāḍāpaḥ' (7.3.113) iti yāṭ‌--khaṭvāyāmiti| `tarvanāmnaḥ syāṅḍhrasvaśca' (7.3.114) iti syāṭ‌--sarvasyāmiti| yastarhi ghāntādām‌ vidhīyate yaśca liṭyām‌ tau kasmānna gṛhyete? ityāha--`yaśca kim‌' ityādi| tayorhyako ghāntādvidhīyate'paro ghātoḥ| na ca ghāntasya sarvanāmasaṃjñā, nāpi ghātoriti| na tau sarvanāmnaḥ parau sambhavata iti na gṛhyete| atha tu sarvanāmnaḥ parau na sambhavata iti kṛtvaitadarthaṃ tayorgrahaṇamanupapannam‌, tathā'pyuttarārthaṃ tūpapadyate, vidyete tau hi harasvāntāt‌ parau--pacatitarām‌, pacatitamām‌, cikīrṣāñcakāra, kārāyāñcakāra? ityata āha--`sānubandhakāditi vā tau na gṛhyete' iti| niranubandhakaparibhāṣayeti bhāvaḥ| tatra ghādāmorukāro'nubandhaḥ, itarasya tvakāraḥ| tathā coktadam‌--āmo'mittvamadantatvāditi| `uttarārthaḥ' ityādi| `trestrayaḥ' (7.1.53) ityāmi parato yathā syāt‌| etadarto'pyāmīti saptamīnirddeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati, asti hyatrāpi prayojanam‌--āmi parataḥ sarvanāmnaḥ suṅ‌ yathā syāt‌? ityata āha--`iha tu' ityādi| `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirddeśo balīyān‌' (śāka.pa.97) iti `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti `sarvanāmnaḥ' ityanayā pañcamyā āmītyasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parikalpitāmāma eva suṭā bhavitavyamiti nāstīha nirddeśasya prayojanam‌|| 53. trestrayaḥ| (7.1.53) `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ‌' (7.1.44) iti prāpte vacanam‌| `trayāṇām‌' iti| `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghaḥ. nanu ca `ṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau' (7.4.75) iti nipātanādeva siddham‌, tatkimarthamidamārabhyate? evaṃ siddhe satīdamārabhyamāṇametajjñāpayati--`abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti (pu.pa.vṛ.99) iti, tena purātanamiti siddhaṃ bhavati; anyathā `purāṇaprokteṣu' (4.3.105) iti nipātanena bādhittvānna sidhyati| `trīṇāmapīṣyate chandasi' iti| etaccāpītyadhikārādvā, `sarve vighayaśchandasi vikalpyante (pu.pa.vṛ.56) iti vā labhyate|| 54. hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ‌| (7.1.54) `kumārīṇām‌' iti| `vayasi prathame' (4.1.20) iti ṅīṣ‌| `gaurīṇām‌' iti| `ṣidgaurādibhyaśca' (4.1.41) iti ṅīṣ‌| `śārṅgaravīṇām‌' iti| `śārṅgaravādyaño ṅīn‌' (4.1.73) iti ṅīn‌| `lakṣmīṇām‌' iti| `avitṝstṝtantribhya īḥ' (paṃ.u. 3-158) ityanuvṛttau `lakṣermuṭ‌ ca' (paṃ.u.3.160) itīrmuṭ‌ ca| `brahmabandhūnam‌' iti| brahmā bandhurāsāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ūṅutaḥ (4.1.66) ityūṅ‌| `khaṭvānām‌' iti| `ajādyataṣṭāp‌' (4.1.4)| `bahurājānām‌' iti| `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām‌' (4.1.13) iti ḍāp‌| `kārīṣagandhyānām‌' iti| kārīṣagandherapatyamityaṇa| tasya `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādinā ṣyaṅādeśaḥ, `yaṅścāp‌' (4.1.74) iti cāp‌|| 55. ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca| (7.1.55) `pañcānām‌' iti| `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) iti dīrghaḥ, `nalopaḥ prātipadakāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nalopaḥ| `ṣaṣṇām‌' iti| `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti ṣakārasya ḍakāraḥ, `yaro'nunāsike'nunāsiko vā' (8.4.45) iti ḍakārasya ṇakāraḥ, `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti nakārasya ṇakāraḥ| `ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ‌' (1.1.24) iti rephāntāyā api saṃkhyāyāḥ kasmānna vihitā ṣaṭsaṃjñeti, evaṃ satīha cuturgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`rephāntāyāḥ' ityādi| gatārtham‌| `bahuvacananirdeśāt‌' ityādi| yadi hi śabdasya pradhānasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tadetaretavayogapakṣe `ṣaṭcaturbhyām‌' iti dvivacane nirdeśaṃ kuryāt‌ samāhārapakṣe tve kavacanena `ṣaṭcaturaḥ' iti bahuvacanena tu nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ| tasmādbahuvacananirdeśāt‌ saṃkhyāpradhānasyaiva ṣaṭhsaṃjñakasya catuḥśabdasya ca grahaṇam‌| tasya cedaṃ prayojanam‌--yatra saṃkhakyāyāḥ prādhānyam‌, tena tadantādapi bhavati| arthapradhāne hi nirdeśe'rthagrahaṇetadbhavati, arthācca śabdadvāreṇaivāmaḥ paratvaṃ vijñāyate| ataḥ kevalebhyaḥ ṣadcaturbhyo bhavati, tadantācca| tadantādapi śabdadvāreṇaivāmaḥ paratvaṃ bhavatyeva| `upasarjanobhūtāyāstu' ityādi| bahuvacananirdeśādvi saṃkhyārthasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌| sa cārtho dvividhaḥ--pradhānaḥ apradhānaśca| tatra pradhāne kāryasampratyayādyatra saṃkhyāyāḥ prādhānyaṃ tatra tadantādapi bhavati| yatra tūpasarjanībhūtā saṃkhyā tatra na bhavati--priyaṣaṣāmityādau| anyapadārthasya hyatra prādhānyam‌, saṃkhyāyāstvaprādhānyam‌| `priyapañcñāma' iti| allope (6.4.134) kṛte `stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti ścutvam‌|| 56. śrīgrāmaṇyośchandasi| (7.1.56) śrīgrāmaṇyoriti sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| `nityārthaṃ `vacanam‌' iti| śrīśabdasya, na tu grāmaṇīśabdasya| tastu tu prāptyarthameva| yathaiva hi bhāṣāyāṃ nadīsaṃjñāpakṣe `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ‌' (7.1.54) iti sidhyati tathā chandasyapi| tasmānnitya yathā syādityevamartham‌| asati hyasmin‌ yadā nadīsaṃjñā, tadaiva syāt‌, nānyadā| `yadā sūtāśca' ityādi| etenaitaddarśayati--yadā sūtaśabdasya grāmaṇīśabdena saha karmadhārayaḥ kriyate tadā sūtagrāmaṇīśabdo na hrasvāntaḥ na nadyantaḥ, nāpyābanta iti na prāpnoti, iṣyate ca, tato yathā syādityavamarthaṃ vacanam‌| yadā sūtagrāmaṇīśabdayoḥ `sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavadbhavati' (pu.pa.vṛ.50) ityekavadbhāvī dvandvaḥ, tadā `sa napuṃsakam‌' (2.4.47) iti napuṃsakatvāt‌, `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvatvaṃ kṛtvā bahūnāṃ sūtagrāmaṇīśabdānāmekaśeṣañca, tataḥ ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanaṃ vidhīyate| tadā hrasvāntatvādeva siddhamiti nārthastavarthena vacanena|| 57. goḥ padānte| (7.1.57) `ṛkpādānte varttamānāt‌' iti| chandasi ṛkpāda eva sambhavati, na ślokapāda iti ṛkpādagrahaṇam‌|| 58. idīto num‌ dhātoḥ| `kuṇḍitā, huṇḍatā' iti| `kuḍi dāhe' (dhā.pā.270), `huḍi saṅghāte' (dhā.pā.269)--ābhyāṃ tṛc‌, iṭ‌, `ṛduśanas‌' (7.1.94) ityādinānaṅ‌| `kimayaṃ dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva numu vidhīyate? ityāha--`kuṇḍā, huṇaḍā' ityādi| yadi pratyaya utpanne num‌ syāt‌, tada pratyayavighadhānavelāyaṃ kuḍiḍuḍyoragurutvāt‌ ktinneva syāt‌, na tvakārapratyayaḥ, sa cedhyate| tasmāt‌ tadarthaṃ dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num‌ bhavatītyavasīyate| kathaṃ punardhātūpadeśāvasthāyāṃ num‌ bhavatītyavasīyate, yāvatātropadeśagrahaṇaṃ nāsti? ityāha--`tathā hi' ityādi| `dhinvikṛṇṣyora ca' (3.1.80) ityupratyayavidhānakāle numanuṣaktayorgrahaṇaṃ sanumkayoreva prakṛtatavaṃ yathā syāt‌| evaṃ sanumkayoḥ parakṛtatvaṃ bhavati yadyupadeśāvasthāyāmeva num‌ bhavati, nānyathā| tasmānnumanuṣaktayorgrahaṇājjñāpakādavasīyate--dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva num‌ bhavatāt| tasya hyatat‌ prayojanam‌--upadeśāvasthāyāmeva num‌ yathā vijñāyeteti| na hi tannumarthaṃ prayujyate; num‌ bhavatīti| tasya hyatat‌ prayojanam‌--upadeśāvasthāyāmeva num‌ yathā vijñāyeteti| na hi tannumarthaṃ prayujyate; numa bhavitavyam‌, tatra lakṣaṇavaśādeva `dhinvikṛccyora ca' (3.1.80) iti numanuṣaktayorgrahaṇam‌, tatkathamasyārthasya grahaṇaṃ jñāpakam‌? naitadasti; na hi `dhinvikṛṇvyora ca' (3.1.80) ityayamikā nirdeśaḥ, sa hi `rogākhyāyāṃ ṣvul‌ bahulam‌' (3.3.108) iti bahulavacanena sannidhānāt‌ kvacideva bhavati na sarvatra| evañca `guptijkidbhyaḥ san‌' (3.1.5) ityevamādayo nirdeśā upapadyante| tasmāt‌ `dhinvikṛṇvyoḥ' (3.1.80) iti nāyamikā nirddeśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? uccāraṇārthenekāreṇa, yathā--`indhibhavatibhyām‌' (1.2.6) ityatrekāreṇa nirddeśaḥ; anyathā `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ syāt‌| athāpi hi `dhinvikṛṇvyoḥ' (3.1.80) itīkā nirdeśaḥ syāt‌, evamapi yadi dhātūpadeśāvasthāyāmeva numbhavatītyayamartho jñāpayituṃ nābhīṣṭaḥ syāt‌, tato lāghavārthamanitayatvādāgamaśāsanasya numamakṛtvaiva nirddeśaṃ kuryāt‌, yathā--`yuvoranākau' (7.1.1) ityatra dvandvaikavadbhāvapakṣa uktam‌| tasmānnumanuṣaktayorgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakameva dhātugrahaṇādapyavasīyate| numupadeśāvasthāyāmeva bhavatīti darśayitumāha--`dhātugrahaṇaṃ ca' ityādi| dhātusaṃjñāpravṛttikālo dhātūpadeśakālaḥ, tatraiva num‌ bhavatītyevamarthamiha dhātugrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tasmādato'pi dhātugrahaṇādupadeśavasthāyā meva num‌ bhavatīti jñāyate, na hyanyaddhātugrahaṇasya prayojanamastītyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca bhettā, abhaitsodityatrāghātvostāsiscoriditīrnum‌ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ dhātugrahaṇaṃ syāt‌? ityāha--`tāsisicoḥ' ityādi| yadi tāsisicoriditkāryaṃ syāt‌, tadekārasyetsaṃjñārthamanunāsikatvaṃ pratijñāyeta, na cāsti prayojanamiti na pratijñāyate; tataśca niranunāsiko'pratilabdhetsaṃjñaka uccāraṇārthaṃ evānayorikāraḥ paṭhyata iti numaḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti, tat‌ kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena dhātugrahaṇena! nanu cāraṃsta, amaṃsta, mantā, saṃgantetyatra `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tāsisicoriditkāryam‌, tat‌ kimucyate iditkāryaṃ tāsisicornāsti? ityata āha--`araṃsta, amaṃsta' ityādi| `hanaḥ sic‌' (1.2.14) iti kittvavidhāvasyaitatprayojanam‌--āhatetyatrānunāsikalopo yathā syāt‌| yadi sijntasyānunāsikalopaḥ sārvadhātukaṅittvamāśritya syāt‌ `hanaḥ sic‌' (1.2.14) iti kittvamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, prayojanābhāvāt‌? naitadasti; asti hyanyat‌ kittvavidhānasya prayojanam‌--`anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinā sicyanunāsikalopo yathā syāditi; `anidatām‌' (6.4.24) ityādinā sijantasya sārvadhātuke mā bhūditi| kaḥ punaratra viśeṣaḥ--sārvadhātuke ṅiti vā? sici kiti vā? ayamasti viśeṣaḥ--samānāśraye sicyanunāsikalopasyāsiddhatvādato lopo (6.4.48) na bhavati; sārvadhātuke tūpadhālope tasya vyāśrayatvenāsiddhatvābhāvādato lopaḥ syādeva| naiṣo'sti viśeṣaḥ; ato lopavidhau `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādeḥ sūtrādupadeśagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tenārthadhātukopadeśe yadakārāntamaṅgaṃ tasya lopo vijñāyate; na cāhatetyatropadeśenkārāntametat‌| tasmāt‌ `hanaḥ sic‌' (1.2.14) iti kittvavidhānasāmarthyādaraṃstetyādau nakāralopo na bhavati| tadevaṃ sica iditkāryaṃ na bhavatīti pratipāditam‌| idānīṃ tāserapyanunāsikalopābhāva iditkāryaṃ na bhavatīti pratipādayitumāha--`mantā' ityādi| nakāralopo na bhavatīti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| upadhānakārasya `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityādinā lopa ucyate| na ca maktetyatra nakāra upadhā bhavati; ṭilopasyāsiddhatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ tāserapīditkāryaṃ na vidyate| tataśca yuktamuktam‌--`tāsisicoriditkārya nāsti' iti| atha numāgama iditkāryaṃ kasmānna bhavati? aniṣṭatvāt‌| na hyaniṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ śāstre parikalpayituṃ yuktam‌| yadi tarhi tāserniranunāsika ikāraḥ uccāraṇārthaḥ, evaṃ tarhi `syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ' (3.1.33) ityatra yaduktam‌--`iditkaraṇamanunāsikalopapratibandhartham‌', tatkathaṃ na virudhyate? yathā na virudhyate tadā tatraivoktam‌| atha bhidirityevamādīnāṃ num‌ kasmānna bhavati, sti hyeṣāmapīkāra itsaṃjñakaḥ? ityāha--`haritām‌' ityādi| bhidir‌prabhṛtayo hīritaḥ, na tviditaḥ; yasmāt‌ `ira upasaṃkhyānam‌' (1.3.7.vā) iti rephekārasya samudāyasya teṣāmitsaṃjñā, na pratyekamavayavasya| tatreditāmucyamāno num‌ kaḥ prasaṅgo yadiritāṃ syāt‌! syādetat‌--`upadeśe'janunāsika it‌' (1.3.2) itītsaṃjñekārasya, `halantyam‌' (1.3.3) iti rephasya, tasmādastyeva teṣāmidittvam‌? ityāha--`avayavasyāpi' iti| gatārtham‌|| 59. śe mucādīnām‌| (7.1.59) mucādayastudādau paṭhyante `muclṛ mokṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1430) ityataḥ prabhṛtyā gaṇaparisamāpteḥ| `moktā' iti| tṛc‌, `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) itīṭprataṣedhaḥ, `co kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌| `ke punastṛmphādayaḥ' iti| evaṃ manyate--tṛmphādiṣu tṛphādayo niranuṣaṅgā api gaṇe paṭhyante--`tṛphatṛnpha tṛptau' (dhā.pā.1307,1308) ityevamādayaḥ| tatra yadi te'pi tṛphādigrahaṇena gṛhyeran‌, tṛphatītyādi rūpaṃ nopapadyata ityata āha--`ye tatra sānuṣaṅgāḥ paṭhyante, te tṛmphādayaḥ' iti| ādiśabdo|yaṃ prakārārthaḥ, prakārastu sādṛśyam‌, tasmāt‌ tṛmphatinā sānuṣaṅgeṇa ye sadṛśāḥ, ta evādigrahaṇenopalakṣyanta ityabhiprāyaḥ| `sānuṣaṅgāḥ' iti| nakāro'nuṣaṅgaḥ, tena saha varttanta iti sadṛśāḥ, ta evādigrahaṇenopalakṣyanta ityabhiprāyaḥ| `sānuṣaṅgāḥ' iti nakāro'nuṣaṅgaḥ, tena saha varttanta iti sānu,ṅgāḥ| yadi tarhi ye sānuvaṅgāḥ paṭhyante te tṛmphādayaḥ, teṣāṃ numi kṛte parasyānusvāre kṛte tasya parasavarṇe dvayornakārayoḥ śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āhṛ--`teṣām‌' ityādi| kṛte hi nakāralope num‌ vidhīyate| ato na bhavatyeva doṣa iti bhāvaḥ| atha so'pi num‌ kasmānna lupyate? ityāha--`sa ca' ityādi| yadi so'pi lupyeta, numo vidhānamanarthakameva syāditi manyate| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--`dhātoḥ' (7.1.58) ityanuvarttate, `śe' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena tṛ-mphādīnāñca num‌ bhaviṣyati| mucādīnāmityevamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, `śe' ityanena siddhatvāt‌? nānarthakam‌, `śe' ityasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārthatvāt‌| evapaṃ hyatiprasaṅgo na bhavati| kathaṃ mucādiṣveva tṛmphādayo na paṭhitāḥ? ye'tra niranuṣaṅgāḥ paṭhyante teṣāṃ numāgamo mā bhūdityevamartham‌|| 60. masjinaśorjhali| (7.1.60) `maṅktā' iti| `ṭumasjo śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1415), tṛc‌, pūrvavadiḍabhāvaḥ, kutvañca, antyājjakārāt‌ pūrvo num‌, `skoḥ' (8.2.29) ityādinā sakāralopaḥ, anusvatraparasavarṇo| `neṣṭā' iti| `radhādibhyaśca' (7.2.45) iti yadeṇnāsti tadāyaṃ num‌, vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| iṭpakṣe jhalāditvābhāvānnum‌ nāsti--naśiteti| `majjanam‌, naśanam‌' iti| lyuṭ‌, `jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvam‌--sakārasya dakāraḥ, tasya catvaṃ jakāra-| `masjeḥ' ityādi| yadi masjerantyādacaḥ paro num‌ syāt‌, asaṃyogaditvāt‌ malopo na prāpnoti, anupadhatvānna nalopaḥ, sa ceṣyate; anyathā magno mānavāniti na sidhyat‌| tasmādantyātpūrvamācāryā masjernumamicchanti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pyayamartho labhyate? naśeralpāctarasya pūrvanipātalakṣamavyabhicāracihnāt‌| sa hi lakṣaṇanirapekṣatāṃ sūcayan‌ `midayo'ntyātparaḥ' (1.1.47) ityetadapīha lakṣaṇaṃ nāpeśrata iti sacayati| tasmiṃścānapekṣite lakṣyānurodhādyatra masjernumi kṛte satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati tatraiva vidhīyate| tena masjerantyāsparvaṃ num‌ siddho bhavati| `magnaḥ' iti| `oditaśca' (8.2.45) iti niṣṭhānatvam‌|| 61. radhijabhoraci| (7.1.61) `randhayati' iti| `radha hiṃsāsaṃrāddhyāḥ' (dhā.pā.1193) hetumaṇṇic‌| `rabdhakaḥ' iti ṇvula| `sādhurandhī' iti| `supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye' (3.2.78) iti ṇiniḥ| `randhaṃrandham‌' iti| `ābhīkṣaṇye| ṇamul‌' (3.4.22), `ābhīkṣaṇye dve bhavataḥ' (vā.887) iti dvirvacanam‌| `randho varttate' iti| bhāve ghañ‌| atha randhayatītyādiṣu paratvāt‌ `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, sā kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`parāpi satī' ityādi| nityatvaṃ panaḥ kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvānnumaḥ| sa hi kṛtāyāṃ vṛddhau prāpnotyakṛtāyāmapīti nityaḥ; vṛdadhistu numi kṛte na prāpnotyakārasyānupadhatvādityanityā| `raddhā' iti| `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti takārasya dhakāraḥ, dhātudhakārasya jaśtvam‌--dakāraḥ|| 62. neṭyaliṭi ratheḥ| (7.1.62) pūrveṇa prāptasya numaḥ pratiṣedha ucyate| `radhitā' ityādi| `radhādibhyaśca' (7.2.45) itīṭ‌| `rarandhiva, rarandhima' iti| krādiniyamādiṭ‌ (7.2.13) `parasmaipadānām‌' (3.4.82) ityādinā vasmasorvamādeśau| nanu radhirayamasaṃyogāntaḥ paṭhyate, tatra `asaṃyogālliṭ‌ kit‌' (1.2.5) iti kittve `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) iti nalopaḥ prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`numi kṛte' ityādi| `upadeśāvasthāyāmeva num‌ bhavati' ityuktametat‌, tenopadeśāvasthāyāmeva numi kṛte saṃyogāntatvaṃ jātamiti kittvaṃ nāstīti na bhavati nalopaḥ| `atha kvasau kathaṃ bhavitavyam‌' iti| kiṃ rarādhvāniti bhavitavyam‌, uta redhivāniti pṛcchati| apara āha--`redhivāt‌' iti| liṭaḥ `kvasuśca' (3.2.107) iti kvasuḥ, dvirvacanam‌, `ata ekahalmadhye'(6.4.120) ityādinaittvāṃbhyāsalopau, `vasvekājādghasām‌' (7.2.67) itīṭ‌ num‌, `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ| `katham‌' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--yadeṅ‌ bhavati tasmiṃśca numā bhavitavyam‌, numi ca satyekahalmadhyatā nāstītyettve'byāsalopayoḥ punaḥ pratyāpattyā bhavitavyam‌, tataśca kṛtadvirvacana ekāṇna bhavatītīṭā na bhavitavyam‌; tasmādraradhvāniti yuktaṃ bhavitumiti| itarastu kṛtasayāpi numo'tri lopena bhavitavyam‌, tataścaikahalmadhyatābhāvo nopapadyate, kutaḥ punarettvābhyāsalopayoḥ pratyāpattiḥ? ityāha--`ettvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtayoḥ' ityādi| kṛtadvirvacanānāmekācāṃ kvasoriṅ vidhīyate| `tato numāgamaḥ' iti| aci tadvidhānāt‌ tasyaupadeśikattvāśrayo lopa ityaupadeśikagrahaṇānnumi kṛte saṃyogāntatvādātideśikasya kittvasyāsambhavāt‌| `atha' ityādi| iṭi `neṭi' (7.2.4) ityucyamāne purveṇa siddhe sati niyamarthametadbhaviṣyati--liṭyeveḍādau, nānyasminniḍādāviti| tena rarandhiva, rarandhimetyādau bhaviṣyati, na radhitetyevamādau| tasmādiṭiliṭīti kasmānnoktam‌, evaṃ satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati, laghu ca sūtraṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `liṭyeva' iti| niyamasvarūpaṃ darśayati| `nānyatra' ityanenāpi tasya vyavacchedyam‌| yato hetorniyamo na kriyate, taṃ darśayitumāha--`viparītam‌' ityādi| `iṭyeva liṭi' iti| viparītaniyamasaya svarūpakathanam‌| `nānyatra' ityanenāpi taddhyavacchedyaṃ darśayati| kasmādviparītamavadhāraṇaṃ neṣyate? ityāha--`tathā hi' ityādi| iṭyeva liṭītyasya niyamasyāniḍādirlliṅ‌vyāvarttya itīḍādāveva liṭi bhavati, nāniḍādāviti| tataścāniḍāditvādrarandhetyatra num‌ na syāt‌| radhitetyatra pūrvema syādeva; niyamenāvyāvarttitatvāt‌| tasmāttaddoṣaparijihīrṣayā niyamo na kriyate|| 63. rabheśabliṭoḥ| (7.1.63) `ārebhe' iti| `rabha rābhasye' (dhā.pā.974) liṭ‌, anudāttettvādatmanepadam‌| `liṭastajhayoreśirec‌' (3.4.81) ityeśū, pūrvavadettvābhyāsalopau|| 64. labheśca| (7.1.64) `pṛthagyogakaraṇamuttarārtham‌' iti| uttaratrūtreṇa labhereva kāryaṃ yathā syāt| rabhermā bhūditi| yadi `rabhilabhyoraśavliṭoḥ' ityeko yogaḥ kriyate, tato rabhirityanuvṛttiruttaratra syāt‌| ataśca tasyāpyuttaratra kāryaṃ prasajyeta|| 65. āṅo yi| (7.1.65) `yakārādau pratyaya' iti| anena `yi' ityasyāḥ saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvaṃ darśayan‌ yakārādau pratyaye vavayabhūte'nutpanna eva num‌ bhavatīti darśayati| `prāk‌' ityādinā viṣayasaptamyāṃ satyāṃ yadiṣṭaṃ sampadyate tadācaṣṭe| parasaptamyāṃ hi pūrvaṃ pratyayena bhavitavyam‌, paścānnumā, tataśca `adupadhāt‌' (3.1.98) iti yat‌ prasajyeta| viṣayasaptamyāṃ tu prāgutpannena numā'dupadhatvasya vihatatvāt‌ `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124) ita ṇyadeva bhavati| kaḥ punarṇyati yata vā viśeṣaḥ; yāvatobhayatrāpi tadeva rūpamiti, vyatpratyaye'pi vṛddhyā na bhavitavyam‌, tathā ca prāguktam‌--`parāpi satī vṛddhirnityatvābhumā bādhyate' iti? ata āha--`tatra' ityādi| tatra ṇyati sati titsvaritatvāt‌ `gatikārakopapadāt‌ kṛt‌' (6.2.139) iti prakṛtisvaraḥ; tenālambhya ityudāharaṇamantyasvaritaṃ bhavati| yati tu `yato'nāvaḥ' (6.1.213) ityādyudāttatve sati prakṛtivadbhāvenāpyudāttatvamityasti viśeṣaḥ| `labhyam‌' iti| yadantametat‌| `evamālabhya' ityetadapi| ālabhyata iti bhāve karmaṇi vā lakāraḥ| `anuṣaṅgalopaḥ kriyate' iti| `anidatām‌' (6.4.24) ityādinā|| 66. upatpraśaṃsāyām‌| (7.1.66) `praśaṃsāyām‌' iti| upalabhya iti stutau| atipraśaṃsya ityarthaḥ| `upalabhyam‌' iti| praptavyamityarthaḥ|| 67. upasargātkhalghañoḥ| (7.1.67) `īṣatpralambhaḥ' iti `īṣad‌duḥsuṣu' (3.3.126) ityādinā khal‌| `duṣpralambhaḥ' iti| `idudupadhasya' (8.3.41) ityādinā ṣatvam‌| `vipralambhaḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ‌| nanu ca `labheśca' (7.1.64) ityanena num‌ siddhaḥ, tatkimartho'yamārambhaḥ? ityāha--`siddhe' ityādi| `anyatra na bhavati' iti tadvyavacchedyam‌| `upasargāt‌ khalghañoreva' ityeṣa tu viparītaniyamo'tra na sambhāvaniyaḥ; `gṛdhivañcyoḥ pralambhane' (1.3.69) iti nirdeśāt‌|| 68. na suṭurbhyāṃ kevalābhyām‌| (7.1.68)| `upasṛṣṭasya' iti| upasargeṇa sambaddhasyetyarthaḥ, `sulābhaḥ' iti| suśabdo'yamādhikyārthaḥ, nākṛcchrārthaḥ, yathā--suṣiktaṃ nāma kiṃ tavātreta| `durlābhaḥ' iti| `duśabdo nindārthaḥ, na kṛcchrārthaḥ, yathā--durbrahyaṇa iti| tena ghañeva bhavati, na khal‌| `sudurmyāmiti tṛtīyāṃ matvā kevalagrahaṇaṃ kriyate' iti| `sudirbhyām‌' iti| tṛtīyāyāmabhyupetāyāṃ sudurbhyāmupasṛṣṭasya labhernum‌ na bhavatītyeṣo'rthaḥ sampadyate| vyavahitenā'pyupasṛṣṭo bhavatyeva| tatrāsati kevalagrahaṇe supralambhaḥ, duṣpralambha ityatrāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ tṛtayāyāmabhyupetāyāṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| atha pañcatryāṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna kriyeteti praśnāvasarata āha--`paccamyāṃ hi' ityādi| pañcamyāṃ hyasyāṃ nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvādanantarasyaiva pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌, iha ca praśabdena vyavadhānam‌, ataḥ prasaṅga eva nāsti, tat‌ kiṃ kevalagrahaṇena? yadyevam‌ na karttavyameva kevalagrahaṇam‌, pañcamīmenāṃ pratijñāsyāma iti? naitadasti; supralambhaḥ duṣpralambha iti--pratyudāhaṇadvayamabhipretyaitaduktam‌| `pañcamyāṃ hi vyavahitatvādevāprasaṅgaḥ' iti| atisulambha ityatra yadābhiśabdo'pyupasargastadā hyasati kevalagrahaṇe pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyeta; avyavadhānāt‌| tasmāt‌ sarvadhā kevalagrahaṇasya karttavyatvāt‌, kamavyatikrame ca prayojanābhāvāt‌ tṛtīyaiveṣā yuktā pratijñātum‌| atisulabhamityatrātinopargena suśabdena labhirupasṛṣṭaḥ, tasmāt‌ pratiṣedhena bhavitavyamiti kasyācidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`atisulabhamityatra' ityādi| karmapravacanīyatvaṃ punaratiśabdasya `atiratikramaṇe ca' (1.4.95) iti karmapravacanīsaṃjñāvidhānāt‌| yasya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tasyopasargasaṃjñā nāsti; ekasaṃjñādhikārāt‌, karmapravavanāyasaṃjñayopasargasaṃjñāyā bādhatatvāt‌| kathaṃ punaḥ karmapracavanīyasya hi tasyāpi kevalatvamupapadyate? evaṃ manyate--kevagrahaṇāt‌ svaśabdopāttādanyat‌ tulyajātīyameva vyavacchedyam‌, na tu vijātīyam‌| tathā hi--`kevalabhyāṃ vijhātīyena karkaṭādinā sahitau praviśata eva| ata evānyopasargarahitābhyāmityanena tulyajātīyanivṛttayarthatā kevalagrahaṇasya darśitā| yadi tu sarvasya tulyajātīyasya vijātīyasyāpi kevalagrahaṇena nivṛttiḥ karttu śakyate, tadopasargagarahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, anyarahitābhyāmityevaṃ brūyāt‌| tasmādvijātīyena kevalagrahaṇena nivṛttiḥ karttu śakyate, tadopasargagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, anyarahitābhyāmityevaṃ brūyāt‌| tasmādvijātīyena sahitāvapi tau kevalāvevetyatisulabhamityatra karmapravacanīyasahitenāpi suśabdenopasṛṣṭasya bhavatyeva pratiṣedhaḥ| yatra tarhi pūjātikramaṇābhyāmanyatra vṛttiḥ, atiśabdasaya tatra karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā na bhavati, tadā katham‌? ityāha--`yadā tu' ityādi| pañcamīnirdeśe'pyevamarthaṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti; anyathā hyatra vyavadhānābhāvāt‌ pratiṣedhaḥ prasajyetetyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca prasulambhaḥ--ityevamarthaṃ kevalagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌? naitadasti; uktaṃ hi bhāṣeya--`naiṣo'sti prayogaḥ' iti|| 69. vibhāṣā ciṇṇamuloḥ| (7.1.69) `alābhi' iti| luṅ‌, `ciṇbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (3.1.66) iti ciṇ‌, `ciṇo luk‌' (6.4.104) iti takārasaya luk‌| `anupasṛṣṭasya' iti| upasargeṇāsambadadhasyetyarthaḥ|| 70. ugidacāṃ sarvanāmasthāne'ghātoḥ| (7.1.70) ugiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam‌--uk‌ id‌ yeṣāṃ tānyuginti, aṅgaviśeṣaṇañcaitat‌, ata āha--`ugitāmaṅgānām‌' iti| ajiti pratyāhārasya grahaṇamevedaṃ vā syāt‌, añcatervā luptanakārasya? tatra yadi pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) ityatra sūtre punarajgrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌, taddhi pratyāhāgrahaṇam‌, nāñceḥ; jhalā sāhacaryāt‌| tasmādañcateridaṃ grahaṇamityālocyāha--`añcateśca' ityādi| `bhavān‌' iti| `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| `śreyān‌' iti| praśasyaśabdāt‌ `dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunau' (5.3.57) itīyasun‌, `praśasyasya śraḥ' (5.3.60) iti śrādeśaḥ, `prakṛtyaikāc‌' (6.4.163) iti prakṛtivadbhāvāṭṭilopābhāvaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ| nanu cātra nāṅgamugit‌, kiṃ tarhi? pratyayaḥ? naitadasti; aṅgamapyugideva| katham‌? avayavāvayavenāpi samudāyasya sambandho bhavatyeva, yathā--devaidattasyāṅgulirityatra devadattasyāvayavasya hastasya yo'vayavo'ṅgulistena devadattasya sambandhaḥ| tasmādihāpi pratyayasyāvayavo ya uk‌ itsaṃjñakastenāṅgasyāpi sambandho'styevetyaṅgamapyugideva| `prāṅ‌' iti| prāñcatati ṛtvigādisūtraṇa (3.2.59) kvin‌, numhalṅyādi(6.1.68) saṃyogāntalopau (8.2.23), `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvam‌--nakārasya ṅakāraḥ| `prāñcau, prāñcaḥ' iti| cutvam‌--nakārasya ñakāraḥ| athāñcatigrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatogittvādeva tasya num‌ siddhaḥ? ityata āha--`añcatigrahaṇam‌' ityādi| ukhāsrat‌, parṇadhvat‌' iti| `srūnsu dhvansu `adhaḥ patane' (dhā.pā.754,755), [`avasraṃsane'--dhā.pā.] ukhāyāṃ sraṃsate, parṇāni dhvaṃsate| `kvipca' (3.2.76) iti kvip‌, nalopaḥ, `vasusraṃsudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ' (8.2.72) iti sakārasya dakāraḥ, tasya `vā'vasāne' (8.4.56) cartvam‌--takāraḥ| `adhātoriti kim‌' iti| añcatigrahaṇādeva niyamārthāddhāterna bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| adhātoriti nāyaṃ prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? paryudāsa iti manyamāna āha--`adhātubhūtapūrvasyāpi yathā syāt‌' iti| pūrvapakṣavādinā'dhātoriti prasajyaprataṣedho'yamiti manyamānena coditam‌| siddhāntavādinā paryudāsena parihṛtam‌| `gomatyati' iti| gomacchabdāt `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌ṭa (3.1.8)| `gomatyaterapratyayaḥ' iti| aśrāvī pratyayo'pratyayaḥ, sa punaḥ kvip‌, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) iti dīrghaḥ--gomān‌| kasmāt‌ punarasatyadhātugrahaṇe'tra na sidhyatītyata āha--`atra hi' ityādi| asatyadhātugrahaṇe'ñcatigrahaṇānniyamādyathokhasradityādau na bhavati, tathātrāpi na syāt‌| bhavati hyayamapi dhātuḥ--satadyapi dhātutve kvibantatve `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati' (vya.pa.132) iti kṛtvā| tasmādadhātugrahaṇaṃ kriyate--yo'pyavasthāntare'dhāturāsīt‌ tasya garahaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌| atha gomāniti kathamatra dīrghatvam‌? kathaṃ ca na syāt‌? adhātoriti pratiṣedhaḥ, nātvantasya| atra hyadhātoriti kim‌? piṇḍaṃ prasata iti piṇḍagraḥ, carma vasta iti carmavaḥ--ityasantasyaiva pratyudāharaṇamupanayastam‌, nātvantasya| atha vā--cakārantatra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena kvaciddhātorayīti bhaviṣyati|| 71. yujerasamāse| (7.1.71) `yuṅa, yuñjau, yuñjaḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ kvinnādi| `aśvayuk‌' iti| aśvaṃ yunaktīti `satsūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip‌| kathaṃ yujernubyucyamāne samāse'pi syāt‌? tadantavidhinā| kathamatra tadantavidhiḥ? etedeva jñāpakam‌--astīha tadantavidhiriti| uktañca--`aṅgādhikāre tasya taduttarapadasya' (pu.pa.vṛ.85) iti vacanāt‌| `yujeḥ' ityādi| ikāreṇa nirdeśo hyevamarthaḥ kriyate--yasya yujerikāro'nubandhastasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌, anyasya mā bhūditi| tena `yuja samādhau' (dhā.pā.1177) ityasya grahamaṃ na bhavati, na hi tasyekāro'nubandho'sti| `yujam‌' iti| sampadāditvātkvip‌| `āpannāḥ' iti| prāptā ityarthaḥ|| 72. napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ| (7.1.72) `paryāsi, śroyāṃsi' iti| `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ| `bahupuri, bahudhuri' iti| bahvyaḥ puraḥ, bahvyo dhuro yeṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| `ṛkpurabdhūḥ pathāmānakṣe' (5.4.74) ityakāraḥ samāsānto na bhavati--`samāsāntavidhiranityaḥ' (vyā.pa.94) iti kṛtvā| `vimaladivi' iti| vimalā dyauryeṣāmiti tāni| vimaladivi vakāro dantyauṣṭhyo jhal‌ na bhavati, jhalaḥ pūrveṇa paṭhitatvāt‌| `catvāri' iti| `caturanaḍuhorāmudāttaḥ' (7.1.98) ityām‌| iha yaduginnapuṃsakaṃ jhalantaṃ numi kṛte `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) ityādinā dvitīyo num‌ prāpnoti; sambhavati hi vidhānakālenekasya paratvam‌, yathā--pacatītyatra lakāravikaraṇayorekasmāddhātoriti| atra tudanti, nadantītyatra parasaya numo'nusvāre kṛte tasaya parasavarṇe ca dvayornakārayoḥ śravaṇamāpadyeta? bhavatu nāma, halparasya vyañjanasyaikasyānekasya śrutiṃ prati nāsti viśeṣaḥ śakyate vaktum‌| iha tvasti viśeṣaḥ--kurvanti, kṛṣantītyatra parasya numo'nusvārasavarṇayoḥ kṛtayoḥ pūrvasyājhalparatvādanusvāraparasavarṇau na sta iti aṭkupvādinā (8.4.2) ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti| ekasmiṃstu numi tasyānusvāre parasavarṇe kṛte na bhavati ṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ; parasavarṇasyāsiddhatvāt‌| tasmādugillakṣaṇasya numaḥ pratiṣedho vaktavya ityāha--`ugito jhalantasya' ityādi| jhalantalakṣaṇasya numo'vakāśo yadanuginnapuṃsakam‌--sarpīṣīti, ugillakṣaṇasyāvakāśo yadugidanapuṃsakam‌--gomān‌ yavamāniti; yadugijjhalantaṃ napuṃsakaṃ tasyobhayaprasaṅge sati paratvādanenaiva numā bhavitavyam‌, tasmin‌ sati punarugillakṣaṇo num‌ na bhavati--`sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadvādhitaṃ tadvādhitameva' (vya.pa.40) iti kṛtvā| `bhūyāṃsi' iti| bahuśabdādīyasun‌, `bahorlopo bhū ca bahoḥ' (6.4.158) itīkārasya lopaḥ, bahośca bhūbhāvaḥ| `kurvanti, kṛṣanti' iti| śatrantāt‌ `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20) iti śibhāvaḥ| `bahurji' ityādi| bahūrjītyasmin‌ nubhaḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vibhāṣā ciṇṇamuloḥ' (7.1.69) iti vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena bahūrjītyatra na bhavati| `urja balaprāṇadhāraṇayoḥ (dhā.pā.1549) [`balaprāṇanayoḥ' dhā.pā.] ityetasmāt‌ `bhrājabhrāsa' (3.2.177) ityādinā kvip‌, bahava ūrjo balāni yeṣāṃ tāni bahūrji brāhmaṇakulāni| `antyātpūrvam‌' iti| antyo jakāraḥ, tasmātpūrvaṃ numamicchanti kecit‌--bahūrñjīti|| 73. iko'ci vibhaktau| (7.1.73) `vibhaktau' iti vacanāt‌ `sarvanāmasthāne' (7.1.70) iti nivṛttam‌| `acīti kim‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--trapubhyām‌, trapubhirityatra vyañjanādau mā bhūdityevamarthamajgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, etaccāprayojanam‌; astvanna num‌, `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti lopo bhaviṣyati| itaro viditābhiprāya āha--`uttarārtham‌' iti| `asthidadhisakthyakṣṇāmanaṅudāttaḥ' (7.1.75) ityajādau yathā syāt‌, iha mā bhūt‌--asthibhyām‌, asthibhiriti, evamarthamajgrahaṇam‌| ihāsaya karaṇasya yatprayojanaṃ tanmayā pṛṣṭam‌, atastadeva kathyatām‌? ityabhiprāyeṇāha--`yadyevam‌' ityādi| itaro viditābhiprāya āha--`iha tu karaṇasya' ityādi| trapuśabdāt‌ sambodhane prathamaikavacane kṛte yadyacīti nocyeta, tadātrāpi num‌ syāt‌, tadatra num‌ mā bhūdityevamarthamacītyucyate| syādetat‌--bhavatu nāma num‌, tasya `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) iti sorluki kṛte `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nalopo bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`na ṅisambuddhyoḥ ityādi| `nanu ca' ityādi| evakāro'tra bhinnakramaḥ pratiṣedhānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| sa caupacārikamapi dibhakterastitvam‌ `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratiṣedhānnāstīti pratipādayati| dvividhaṃ hi vibhaktorastitvam‌--mukhyam‌, aupacārikañca| tatra mukhyaṃ śrūyamāṇāyā vibhakterbhavati, itarat‌ tu luptāyā api| kāryasyāstitvādvibhakterapyupacāreṇāstitvamucyate, yathā--astyatītaṃ karmeti tatrātītena karmaṇā yadāhitaṃ phaladānasāmarthyaṃ tasyastitvāt‌ tat‌ karmāntītyucyate| tadiha `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.26) iti vibhakterlaptatvānmukhyaṃ tāvadastitvaṃ nāsti| `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhādaupacārikamapi nāstveva| tatra vibhaktāvucyamāno num‌ kaḥ prasaṅgo yaḥ sarvathaivāsatyāṃ vibhaktau he trapo ityatra syāt‌! naiva prāpnoti; tasmānnaitadajgrahaṇasya prayojanam‌| `etadeva' ityādi| yadi hyatra pratyayalopalakṣamapratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, ajgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, kutaśca, tasmādetadevājgrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati--pratyayalopalakṣaṇapratiṣedho'tregante napuṃsake sambuddhiviṣaye nāstīti| `tathā ca' ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanamāha| sambuddhiviṣayo gaṇaḥ `sambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) iti varttamāne yaḥ `hrasvasya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108) ityanena guṇaḥ sa veditavyaḥ| `taumburavaṃ cūrṇam‌' iti| tum‌buruṇo vikāraḥ `aurañ‌ (4.2.71), `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146)| kvacit‌--`iko'ci vyañjane mā bhūvastu lopaḥ svaraḥ katham‌' ityādikaṃ ślokadvayaṃ paṭhyate| `iko'ci vibhaktau' (7.1.73) ityatrācīti kimarthamucyate, na `iko vibhaktau' ityevocyeta? prayojanamāha--`vyañjane mā bhūt‌' iti| prakaraṇānnumiti vijñāyate| trapubhyām, trapubhirityatra vyañjanādau mā bhūdityevarthamajgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| yadyevam‌, nārthastena, vyañjanādau numastu, na ca tasya śravaṇaṃ prasajyate; yasmāt‌ `nalopaḥ prātapadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nalopo bhaviṣyati| pañcatrapubhyām‌, pañcatrapubhirityatra kathaṃ svaraḥ? pañcabhistrapubhiḥ krītābhyāṃ krītairveti `taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti taddhitārthe samāsa; `saṃkhyāpūrvo dviguḥ'(2.1.52) iti dvigusaṃjñā, `ārhādagopuccha' (5.1.19) ityādinā ṭhak‌, tasya `adhyarddhapūrvadvigorlugasaṃjñāyām‌' (5.1.28) iti luk‌, tato vibhakto num‌, nakāralopaḥ, tasya `nalopaḥ supsavarasaṃjñātugvidhiṣu kṛti' (8.2.2.) ityasiddhatvāt‌ `igantakālakapālabhagālaśarāveṣu dvigau' (6.2.29) ityanena pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaro na prāpnoti; anigantatvāt‌ `bhraḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ' (phi.sū.2.28) ityādyudāttatvaṃ syāt‌| `bhraḥ' iti nakārarephāntayograhaṇamiti| `kharo ṣai' ityādi| vaiśabdo'kṣamāyām‌| pañcatrapuṇa ityatra śrūyamāṇe numi svaro bhavati| `lupte kiṃ na bhaviṣyati' ? (iti)| bhaviṣyatyevetyarthaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ śrūyamāṇe numi svaro bhavati? svaravidhau vyañjanasyādidyamānatvāt‌| atha vā--samudāyabhakto hyasau num‌ notsate'vayavasya trapuśabdasyegantatāṃ vihintum‌| iha tarhi rāyamatikrāntābhyāṃ brāhmaṇakulābhyām‌--atirābhyāmiti `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāse kṛte `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvatve ca kṛte yadi vyañjanādau num‌ syāt‌, tadā tasya lope kṛte nalopasyāsiddhatvāt‌ `rāyo hali' (7.2.85) iti halādāvucyamānamātvaṃ na prāpnoti, numā vyavadānāt‌, samudāyabhakto'sau samudāyameva na vyavadavyāt‌, avayavaṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva| tathā priyāstisro'nayorbrāhmaṇakulayoriti bahuvrīhau kṛte priyatisṛbhyāmiti--yadi vyañjanādau num‌ syāt‌, tadā `tricaturoḥ striyāṃ tisṛcatasṛ' (7.2.99) ityanena tisrādeśo na prāpnoti, samudāyabhaktena numā triśabdasya vyavadhānāt‌? naitadasti; `rāyātvaṃ tisṛbāvaṃ [`tisṛbhāvaśca'--mūlapāṭhaḥ] ca vyavadhānānnumāpi hi' (iti)| bhavatīti śeṣaḥ| vyavadhānāditi lyablope pañcamī, yathā--prāsādāt‌ prekṣata iti| prāsādamāruhyetyarthaḥ| tadayamarthaḥ--numā vyavadhānamapi prāpya rāya āttvaṃ tisṛbhāvañca bhavatīti| kasmāt‌ punarvyravadhāne tau bhavataḥ'? `rāyo hali' (7.2.85) ityatra rāyo yā vihitā vibhaktiḥ, triśabdācca yā vihitā vibhaktistasyāmiti vihitaviśeṣaṇapakṣasya tatraśrayaṇāt‌| atha vā--kiṃ vyavadhānacintayā, paratvādeva hi tau bhaviṣyataḥ, tayostu kṛtayoḥ `sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadvādhitaṃ tadvādhitameva' (vyā.pa.40) iti punarnum‌ na bhavati| numparatvamanaṅgīkṛtya `vyavadhānānnumāpi hi' ityuktam‌| ata evāpiśabdaḥ pakṣāntaradyotanāya prayuktaḥ| vyavadhāne ca yathā bhavati, tathoktameva| evaṃ tarhi numnuṭorvipratiṣedhārthamajgrahaṇamiti nuṭi kṛte numna kriyate| `hrasvanadyāyo nuṭ‌' (7.1.54) iti asyāvakāśaḥ--agnīnām‌, vāyūnamiti, igantanumo'va kāśaḥ--trapuṇe, jatuna iti; ihobhayaṃ prāpnoti--trapūṇām‌, jatūnāmiti, pūrvavipratiṣedhe nuḍāgamo bhavati, nuṭi ca sati `nāmi' (6.4.3) iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti, asmiṃstu sati na syāt‌; anajantatvāt‌, yathā--varmaṇāmityatra| sa cāyaṃ vipratiṣedho'jgrahaṇe satyupapadyate| nuṭi kṛte num‌ na prāpnoti; anajāditvāt‌| numyapi kṛte nuṇna prāpnoti, hrasvāntābhāvādityevamabhayostulyayorvipratiṣedha upapadyate| akriyamāṇe'jgrahaṇe nuṭi kṛtepyakṛte'pi halādāvajādau ca numā bhavitavyamiti tasya nityatvam‌| numi kṛte hrasvāntatvābhāvānnuṭā na bhavitavyamiti tasyānityatvam‌| nityānityayoścātulyabalatvādayukto vipratiṣedha iti nityatvānnumaiva bhavitavyamiti| tasmādajgrahaṇaṃ vipratiṣedhārthamiti| atra parīhārāntaramāha--`nuḍ vācyaḥ' iti| lāghavārtham‌| nuḍarthaḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ| tādardhyannudityuktaḥ| kriyamāṇe'pyajgrahaṇe vipratiṣedena numeva prāpnoti, tato'vaśyaṃ pūrvavipratiṣedhena nuḍ‌ vācyaḥ--`numaciratṛjvadbhāvebhyo nuṅ‌ bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena' (vā.11;7.1.96) iti| kriyamāṇe'pyajgrahaṇe pūrvavapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| akriyamāṇe tasmiṃstenaiva yatnena nuḍ‌ bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ yatnadvayena, tasmādajgrahaṇamanarthakam‌? nanu ceṣṭavācī paraśabdaḥ, iṣṭavācitvādbhaviṣyati, alaṃ yatnena/ asadetat‌, avaśyaṃ pūrvavipratiṣedhaḥ parigaṇayatavyaḥ, anyathedamiṣṭamidamaniṣṭamityetadeva na jñāyate| nanu ca trapūṇāmityatra pūrvaviprataṣedhena nuṭi kṛte num‌ mā bhūdityevamarthamajgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌? naitadasti; astvatra num‌ tasya lopo bhaviṣyati| nalopasya dīrghavidhāvasiddhatvāt‌ `nāmi' (6.4.3) iti dīrghatvamanajantatvānna syāditi cet‌? mā bhūdanena, `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) ityanena bhaviṣyati| iha tarhi śucīnāmityatara "inhanpūṣāryamṇāṃ śau" (6.4.12) iti niyamāddīrghatvaṃ na syāt‌? naitadasti; lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vya.pa.3) pratipadoktasyennantasya sa niyamaḥ| ayañca numi kṛte satonnanta iti lākṣaṇikatvādevāsya niyamena pratyākhyānaṃ kariṣyate| evaṃ pratyākhyāte'jgrahaṇe ata uttarato'jgrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayitu māha--`uttarārthaṃ tu' iti| tuśabdastarhyarte| tarhiśabdaḥ pakṣāntaropanyāse| yadyetat‌ prayojanaṃ nopapadyate, uttarārthaṃ tarhyajgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| `iha tu karaṇasya yatprayojanaṃ taducyatām‌? ityāha--`iha' ityādi| apiśabdo'tra gamyamānārthatvānna prayuktaḥ| ihāpi prayojanamasti, kiṃ punastat‌? ityāha--`trapo' iti| he trapo ityasyodāharaṇasya sādhutvārthamajgrahaṇam‌| akriyamāṇe tvajgrahaṇe pratyayalopalakṣaṇamihāstīti na jñāpyeta; yataśca he trapo ityatra lupatāyāṃ sambuddhāvucyamāno guṇo na syāt‌, ajgrahaṇe satyatrāpi pratyayalopalakṣaṇo bhavati| tasmādetadarthamajgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌, uttarārthañca|| 74. tṛtīyādiṣu bhāṣitapuṃskaṃ puṃvadūgālavasya| (7.1.74) `igantaṃ napuṃsakam‌' iti| napuṃsakasyeka ityanuvarttate| tacca yadyapi ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ prakṛtam‌, tathāpyetadarthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatīti prathamāntaṃ sampadyate| `puṃvadbhavati' iti| asyārthaṃ spaṣṭīkarttumāha--`yathā' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ `puṃvadbhavati' ityanena pratiṣedhātideśaḥ śakyate vaktum‌| evaṃ manyate--puṃsi tṛtīyādiṣvajādiṣu na kiñcit‌ kāryaṃ vidhīyate yannapuṃsake'tidaśyeta| tasmānnapuṃsakāśrayasya kāryasya puṃsyabhāvāt‌ pratiṣedhātideśa evāyaṃ vijñāyate| evamapi num‌ eva prakṛtasyābhāvātideśaḥ pakṣe syāt‌, hrasvasya; tasyāprakṛtatvāt‌, tataśca hrasvāśrayāṇi guṇa nābhāva nuḍauttvāttvāni prasajyeran‌--`gherṅiti' (7.3.111) ityauttvāttvam‌--grāmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇakula iti? naitadasti; numabhāvamātrātideśe hyatideśa evānarathakaḥ syāt‌| numa eva gālavasya matena pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt‌| tasmādatideśāsāmarthyād‌ hrasvābhāvo'pyatidiśyate| `grāmaṇīrbrāhmaṇaḥ, grāmāṇi brāhmaṇakulam‌' iti| bhāṣitapuṃskatvadarśanārthamidamuktam‌, na tūdāharaṇam‌| idamatrodāharaṇam‌--`grāmaṇyā brāhmaṇakulena' iti| atra puṃvadbhāvena hrasvo na bhavati, numapi| `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) iti hrasvatvam‌, `āṅo nā'striyām‌' (7.3.120) iti nābhāvaḥ| `grāmaṇīnām‌' iti| pūrvavipratiṣedhena nuṭi kṛte `nāmi' (6.4.3) iti dīrghatvam‌| nnuciśabdasya tṛtīyaikavacanaṃ nodāhṛtam; viśeṣābhāvāt‌| satyasati vā puṃvadbhāve `āṅo nā'striyām‌' (7.3.120) iti nābhāvena bhavitavyam‌| `śucaye' iti| puṃvadbhāvapakṣe na num‌, `gherṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇaḥ| `śucine' iti| puṃvadbhāvābhāvapakṣe num‌| `grāmaṇinī brāhmaṇakule' iti| puṃvadbhāvābhāvādiha hrasvanumau bhavataḥ| `trapuṇe, jatune' iti| sarvakālaṃ napuṃsakatvamevānayoriti bhāṣitapuṃskatvābhāvaḥ| tenātra puṃvadebhāvābhāvānnumbhavatyeva| `iha kasmānna bhavati' iti| bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdasya bahuvrīheḥ śabdo'nyapadārthaḥ| poluśabdaścāyaṃ puṃsi vṛkṣe varttitvā pīlorvikāraḥ phalamiti vivakṣite sati `orañ‌' (4.2.71) ityāgatasyāñaḥ `phale luk‌' (4.3.163) iti luk‌ kriyate, tadā napuṃsake phale varttata iti bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati, na ceha kaścidviśeṣa upāttaḥ, tasmādbhavitavyamedātra puṃvadbhāveneti manyamānasya praśnaḥ| `samānāyāmākṛtau' ityattaram‌| asyaivārthaṃ spaṣṭīkarttumāha `tulya pravṛttinimitte' iti| atra `tasya puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyate' ityadhyāhāryam‌| ākriyete vyutpādyete paricchidyete anayā vṛddhiśabdāditi `ākṛtiḥ'| śabdasya pravṛttikāraṇamihākṛtirabhipretā, na sannideśaḥ, nāpi jātimātram‌| tasmiṃstu tulye pravṛttinimitte yadbhāṣitapuṃskaṃ tasya puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyate| tathā ca--grāmaṇīśabdasya, śaciśabdasya ca samāse pravṛttinimatte puṃvadbhāva udāhṛtaḥ, yathā--grāmaṇīśabdasya puṃsi napuṃsake ca varttamānasya grāmanayanaṃ prati karttutvaṃ samānākṛtiḥ pravṛttinimittam‌| śuciśabdasyāpi śucitvaṃ guṇaḥ tatraivaitat‌ syāt‌| ihāpi samānaivākṛtiḥ? ityāha--`iha tu' ityādi| tu śabdo grāmaṇīśabdāderviśeṣaṃ darśayati| anena pīluśabdasya bhinnāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskatvaṃ darśayati| vṛkṣākṛtiḥ-vṛkṣajātiḥ| phalākṛtiḥ-phalajātiḥ| tadevaṃ samānāyāmākṛtau yadbhāṣitapuṃskaṃ tasya puṃdadbhāvo vidhīyate| na tu pīluśabdaḥ samānāyamākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃska iti na bhavati tasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `tadetadevam‌' ityādi| yadetaduktam‌--`samānāyamākṛtau' ityādi, tadetadevamprakāramartharūpaṃ kathambhavati? na kathañcidityarthaḥ| `samānāyāmākṛtau' ityasya viśeṣasyānupādānādityabhiprāyaḥ| `bhāṣitapuṃskagrahaṇāt‌' ityādinā yathaitadeva bhavati tathā darśayati| śabde hyanyapadārthe samāśrīyamāṇe satyetannopapadyate| na cātra śabdo'nyapadārthatvenāśritaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? arthaḥ| so'pi na sarvaḥ, api tu pratyāsatteryasya śabdasya yat‌ pravṛttinimittaṃ sa eva vijñāyata iti sa eva bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdonocyate; anyathā sarva eva hyartho bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati, antato'rthaśabdenāpi bhāṣitapuṃskatvasambhavāt‌| tatra yadi yena kenacicchabdena yo bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ sa ihāśrīyate, tadā bhāṣitapuṃskagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; vyāvarttyābhāvāt‌| tasmādyasya napuṃsakābhidhāyinaḥ śabdasya puṃvadbhāva iha vidhātumiṣṭastenaiva svamin‌ pravṛttinimitte pumān‌ bhāṣitaḥ, sa eva bhāṣitapuṃtko'trākṣīyate| `tedyogāt‌' ityādi| tena pravṛttinimittalakṣaṇenārthena yogāt‌ sambandhādabhidheyaṃ yannapuṃsakaṃ tadapi bhāṣitapuṃskamitayucyate| bhavati hi tadyogāt‌ tācchabdyam‌, yathā--yaṣṭīḥ praveśayeti| yogaḥ punaratra samavāyasamavāyilakṣaṇaḥ; śabdapravṛttinimittasyārthasya napuṃsakena samavāyāt‌| `yat‌ tasya' ityādi| tasya napuṃsakasya yat‌ pratipādakaṃ śabdarūpaṃ tadāpi bhāṣitapuṃtkena napuṃsakena yogādbhāṣitapuṃskamityucyate| yogaḥ punaranayorvācyavācakabhāvaḥ| tatra yadyapi sūtre'rtho bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdenopāttaḥ, tathā'pyarthe kāryāsambhavāt‌ yathoktana prakāreṇa yo bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ śabdastasyaivāyaṃ puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyate, evañca sa vidhīyamānaḥ samānāyāmākṛtau yo bhavitapuṃskaḥ śabdaḥ sāmarthyāt‌ tasya bhavatīti vijñāyate| yo hyevaṃ bhāṣitapuṃskena śabdapravṛttinimittena sambaddhaṃ napuṃsakamāha sa niyogataḥ samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati| yathā sa eva grāmaṇīśabdaḥ, śuciśabdaśca| pīluśabdena yatra bhāṣitaḥ pumān‌ pravṛttinimitte vṛkṣākṛtau na tatsambaddhamasau napuṃsakamāha| kiṃ tarhi? phalākṛtisambandham‌| tasmāt‌ pīluśabdo na samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃska iti na bhavati tasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ| `kīlālapā' iti| `ato maninkvanibvanipaśca' (3.2.74) iti vic‌| kolālapāśabdo'yaṃ samānāyāmākṛtau bhāṣitapuṃskaḥ--ubhayatrāpi varttamānaḥ kīlālapātvaṃ pravṛttinimittamādāya pravarttata iti kṛtvā| igantastu na bhavatīti na bhavati puṃvadbhāva; tena hrasvatvaṃ bhavatyeva| tasmin‌ satadi `ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ' (7.1.12) itīnādeśe kṛte kīlālapeneti bhavati| yadi punaratra puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt‌ tadā hrasvatvaṃ na syāt‌, tataśca `āto dhātoḥ' (6.4.140) ityakāralope kṛte kolālāpeti syāt‌|| 75. asthidadhisakthyakṣṇāmanaṅudāttaḥ| (7.1.75) `iko'ci vibhaktau' (7.1.73) iti numi prāpte'sdhyādīnāmanaṅa vidhīyate| ṅakāro'ntyādeśārthaḥ| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| asthyādayaścaite `nabviṣayasyānisantasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttāḥ, śeṣamanudāttam‌| tatrānaṅ‌ vidhīyamānaḥ sthānivadbhāvādanudāttatvaṃ prāpnotītyudāttatvāmucyate--nabviṣayasyeti| napuṃsakaviṣayasyetyarthaḥ| `asthnā' iti| anaṅi kṛte `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopaḥ| `etaiḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ punarotallabhyate, yāvatā prakṛtasyāsthyādibhirviśeṣaṇādviśeṣaṇena tadantavidhiriti vijñānāt‌ `aṅgādhikāre tasya saduttarapadasya' (pu.pa.vṛ.85) iti vacanādvā yadyapi tadantavidhirbhavati, tathāpi satyapi tasminnasthyādyantatyānapuṃsakasya grahaṇaṃ nopapadyate, napusakasyetyanuvṛtteḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hyatra napuṃsakenāṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, api tu śrutatvādasthyādaya eva| evañca tadantasyāṅgasya liṅgāntarepi varttamānasyāsthyādīnāṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ vidyata eva| tena napuṃsake ye varttante'sthyādayastadantasyānapuṃsake'pi varttamānasya grahaṇamupapannaṃ bhavati| yadi tarhi tadantasya grahaṇam‌, kevalānāṃ na sidhyati? ayamapyadoṣaḥ; vyadeśivadbhāvāt‌ kevalānāṃ na bhaviṣyati| `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'yatipadikena' (śāka.pa.65) ityeṣā paribhāṣā pratyayavidhiviṣayetīha nopatiṣṭhata eva| napuṃsakenāsthyādiviśeṣaṇaṃ kim‌? yadā te paducchāśabdāḥ santo'pi liṅgāntare varttante tadā mā bhūt‌--dadhirnāma kaścit‌ tena dadhineti|| 76. chandasyapi dṛśyate| (7.1.76) `yato vihitaḥ' ityādinā'piśabdasya sarvopāṣiṇyabhicārārthatāṃ darśayati| `asthabhiḥ' iti| anaṅi kṛte nalopaḥ| `asthānyutkṛtya' iti| śasyanaṅ| `akṣaṇvatā' iti| atrāpi matupi `ano nuṭ‌' (8.2.16) iti nulyam‌| dvitīyāntametat‌| `yadanasthaḥ' iti| asthi yasaya nāstīti sāvanaṅa, `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ|| 77. ī ca dvivacane| (7.1.77) cakāraśchandasītyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `akṣī te' iti akṣi au iti sthite `napuṃsakācca' (7.1.19) iti śībhāvaḥ, īkāre kṛte `prathamayo pūrvasavaṇaḥ' (6.1.102) itī dīrghaḥ, `dīrghājjasi ca' (6.1.105) iti pratiṣiddho'pi chāndasatvādbhavati| nanu savarṇe dīrghatvenā'pyetat‌ siddhyati? yadyapi rūpaṃ siddhyati, udāttatvaṃ tu na sidhyati| etenodatta īkāro vidhīyate| atha vā--rūpamapi na sidhyati| pūrvasavarṇāddhi paratvāt‌ pūrvaṃ numi kṛte naiva savarṇadīrghaḥ syāt‌| athākṣī ityatra `iko'ci vibhaktau' (7.1.73) iti num‌ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`akṣī ityatra' ityādi| numo'vakāśaḥ--trapuṇe, jatuna iti ikarasyāvakāśaḥ--akṣībhyamiti; prathamādvivacana ubhayaprasaṅge paratvādīkāra eva bhavati| athedānomīkāre kṛte punaḥprasaṅgavijñānānnum‌ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`sakṛdgato iti|| 78. nābhyastacchatuḥ| (7.1.78) `udatta, dadattau' iti| `śnabhyastayorāttaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ| akṣitijāgarttyāḥ `jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ‌' (6.1.6) ityabhyastasaṃjñā| kathaṃ punarayaṃ numaḥ pratiṣedho vijñāyate, yāvatā `anantasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho ṣā' (vyā.pa.19) itīkārasya pratiṣedho yuktaḥ? ityāha--`śaturanantaraḥ' ityādi| lakṣaṇāntareṇa vihitasya prataṣedho bhavati, na tu śaturanantara īkāraḥ kenacidvihitaḥ| aṅgasyeti varttate, na ca numo'nyat‌ kāryaṃ śatuḥ sambhavati| ataḥ sāmarthyādvya vahitasyāpi `ugivacām‌' (7.1.70) iti numaḥ pratiṣedho vijñāyata iti|| 79. vā napuṃsakasya| (7.1.79) śatupratyayamātraṃ napuṃsake na varttata ityabhyastādahgādusaro yaḥ śatā tadantasya napuṃsakasya vikalpo vijñāyata ityāha--`abhyāstādaṅgāt‌' ityādi|| 80. ācchīnadyornum‌| (7.1.80) `taduntī kule' iti| `napuṃsakācca' (7.1.19) iti śībhāvaḥ| `tudatī brāhmaṇī' iti| `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp‌, `yātī brāhmaṇī' iti| avāditvācchapo luk‌, `ugitaśca' (4.1.6) iti ṅīp‌| `kariṣyantī kule' iti| `lṛṭaḥ sadvā' (3.3.14) iti śatrādeśaḥ, `ṛddhanoḥ sye' (7.2.70) itīṭ‌| `atrāntaraṅgatvāt‌' ityādi codyam‌| akārāntādaṅgāt‌ pare śatari vyavasthite īkāre ca kiṃ num‌ kriyatām‌? uttaikādeśaḥ? atrāntaraṅgatvāt‌ `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpamekādeśaḥ| antaraṅgatvaṃ punastasya varṇāśrayatvākat‌ numastu bahvapekṣatvādvahiraṅgatvam‌| sa hyakarāntamaṅgaṃ śatṛpratyayāntaṃ tataśca parataḥ śīnadyorbhāvamapekṣate| `vārṇādāṅgam‌' (vya.pa.39) ityādīha nāsti; bhinnakālatvāt‌--śīnadyorhi parabhāve sati num‌ prāpnoti, ekādeśastu tataḥ prāgeva| `yatra ca vārṇāṅgayoryugapat‌ prāptiḥ, tatreyamupatiṣṭhate' ityuktaṃ prāk| vyapavargābhāvādavarṇāntādaṅgāduttarasya śaturiti śakyate vaktum‌| bhede hi satyavadhyavaśrimatoridamasmāduttaramidañca pūrvamityeva vyavahāro bhavati, nānyathā| syādetat‌--`antādivacca' (6.1.85) ityantādivadabhāvenaikādeśaḥ pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhavati parañca pratyādivadityekādeśasya pūrvaṃ pratyantattvāt‌ parañca pratyādivattvādyujyata evāvarṇādaṅgāduttarasya śatuḥ? ityāha--`ubhayata āśraye' ityādi| atra hyakārāntamaṅgaṃ śatā cobhayamāśritam‌| `ubhayata āśraye' ityādi| atra hyakārantamaṅgaṃ śatā cobhayamāśritam| `ubhayata āśraye nāntādivat‌' (vyā.pa.51) iti nāstyantādivadbhāvaḥ| na hyekasyaikadā pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvaḥ parañca pratyādivadbhāva upapadyate| tathā hi--yadi pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhavati, tadā śatṛrūpaṃ na sampadyate; atha paraṃ pratyādivadbhavati, tadā'kārāntatā'ṅgasya na parikalpyate; ucyate cedamācchīnadyornumiti, na cavarṇāntādaṅgāduttaraḥ śatā kvacit sambhavati; tatra vacanaprāmāṇyādbhūtapūrvagatadirāśrīyate--avarṇāntāduttaro yaḥ śata pūrvamāsīditi| ata āha--`bhūtapūrvagatyā' ityādi| yadi hi bhūtapūrvagatirāśrīyate, avatī, dhnatītyādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt‌; atrāpyavarṇāntādaṅgāduttaraḥ śatā pūrvamāsīt‌? ityāha--`atra kecitsamādhimāhuḥ' iti| samādhiḥ-parīhāraḥ| parīhāraśca--śaturavayava iti| śaturavayavastakāraḥ| tatreha śatṛśabdo varttate, yathā--paṭo dandha ityatra paṭāvayave paṭaśabdaḥ, samudāyeṣu pravṛttāḥ śabdāḥ kvacidavayeṣvapi varttanta iti| sa ca śatravayava ekādeśe hi kṛte'varṇāntādaṅgāduttaro bhavatīti `antaraṅgatvādekādeśe kṛte' ityādinā yat‌ kṛtañcodyaṃ tat‌ parihṛtaṃ bhavati| kiṃ punaranackasaya takārasya num‌? ruthañca num‌ syāt‌? kathañca na syāt‌? `midaco'ntyāt‌ paraḥ' (1.1.47) iti vacanāt‌| mā bhūt‌ takārasya, tadantasya bhaviṣyati| evañca sūtrārthaṃ varṇayiṣyāmaḥ--avarṇāntādaṅgāduttaro yaḥ śatravayavastadantasyāṅgasya num‌ bhavatīti| aṅgagrahaṇañca dvirāvarttayiṣyāmaḥ-- avarṇāntādaṅgaduttaro yaḥ śatravayavastadantasyāṅgasya num‌ bhavatīti| aṅgagrahaṇañca dvirāvarttayiṇyāmaḥ--śatravayavaviśeṣaṇārtham‌, aṅgakāryapratipattyarthañca| kathaṃ punastudatītyādī takārāt‌ pūrvasyāṅgatvam‌, yāvatā yataḥ pratyayo vihitastadādeḥ pratyaye parato'ṅgasaṃjñā, na ca takāraḥ pratyayaḥ asatyāñcāṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ
