yaduktamavarṇāntādaṅgāduttaro yaḥ śatravayava iti tannopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathaiva hi śatravayave śatṛśabado varttate, tathāṅgavayave takārāt‌ pūrvasminnaṅgaśabdaḥ| kiṃ punastadaṅgam‌? yasyāvayavaḥ śatrantam| tasya hi śaunadyoḥ parato'ṅgatsaṃjñā vidhīyate| ihāpi tarhi kasmānna bhavati--adatī, dhnatīti, atrāpi hyavarṇāntādaṅgāduttaraḥ śatravayado bhavati? yadyatrāpi syāt‌, āditi viśeṣaṇamanar‌thakaṃ syāt‌, śīnadyorityevaṃ brūyāt‌| yatra ca śīnadyoḥ parataḥ śatrantamaṅgaṃ bhavati, tatra niyogata evākārāntādaṅgādusaro śatravayavo bhavati| tasmāt‌ `ātaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāt‌ viśeṣaparigraho vijñāyate--śatravayavadakārāt‌ pūrṣo yo'kārastadantāduttaro yaḥ śatravayava iti neha numaḥ prasaṅgaḥ| `avarṇāntādaṅgāduttare ye śīnadyau' iti| atrāpi pūrvavadaṅgāvayave'ṅgaśabdo varttate| nanu ca tudantītyādāvavarṇāntādaṅgāduttare śīnadyau na sambhavata eva; takāreṇa vyavadhānāt‌? ityāha--`tatra yena' ityādi| gatārtham‌| atha numyanuvarttamāne kimartha punarnumgrahaṇam‌? neti, veti ca prakṛtam‌| tatra numgrahaṇamantareṇāniṣṭamapi vijñāyate--śīnadyorvibhāṣā numavarṇāntānna bhavatīti| kiñca syāt‌? kurvatī, tanvatītyatra vibhāṣā syāt‌, kariṣyantītyatra na syāt‌| kena punaḥ prāptasya numaḥ śonadyoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate? etadeva jñāpayati--astiśīnadyordibhāṣā numiti| numgrahaṇe tu kriyamāṇe vidhirevāyaṃ vijñāyata ityadoṣaḥ|| 81. śapśyanornityam‌| (7.1.81) 82. sāvanaḍuhaḥ| (7.1.82) 83. dṛksvavassvatavasāṃ chandasi| (7.1.83) `īdṛṅ‌, kīdṛṅ' [nāsti--kāśikāyām‌] iti| `tyadādidhu' (3.2.60) ityādinā kvin‌, `idaṃkimorīśkī' (6.3.90) itīśkī--ādeśo, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau (6.1.68,8.2.23), `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvām‌| `yāvṛṅ, tādṛṅ‌' iti| `ā sarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) ityātvam‌| `sadṛṅ‌' iti| `dṛgduśavatuṣu' (6.3.89) iti samānasya sabhāvaḥ|| 84. diva aut‌| (7.1.84) `dyauḥ' iti| auttve kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ| ihākṣadyūrityakṣairdīṣyatīti kvipi kṛte tadāśraye cāntaraṅgatvāt‌ `cchvoḥ śūjanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityuṭh‌| ekadeśavikṛtasayānanyatvāddivśabdaṃ evāyamityūkagārasyottvaṃ prāpnoti, tat‌ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`diviti prātipadikam‌' ityādi| astyevāyaṃ divśabdo dhātuḥ, asti cāvyutpannaṃ prātipadikam‌| tatra dhātuḥ sānubandhakaḥ, asya `udito vā' (7.2.56) ityuditkāryam| prātipadikaṃ tu niranubandhakam‌, na hi tasya kiñcidanubandhakāryamasti| tatra niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.56) dhāturiha gṛhyate| tenānnadyurityatra na bhavatyottvaprasaṅgaḥ| takāro mukhasukhārthaḥ|| 85. pathimathyṛbhukṣāmāt‌| (7.1.85) halṅyādilope prāpte nalope cāttvaṃ vidhīyate| `panthāḥ' iti| `tho nthaḥ' (7.1.80) iti nyādeśaḥ, `iti'sarvanāmasthāne' (7.1.86) ityattvam‌| nanu cāsya sthānyanunāsiko nakāraḥ, tatra `taparasatatkālasya' (1.1.70) iti savarṇānāṃ grahaṇe satyāntaratamyādanunāsikenaivākāreṇa bhavitavyam‌| kimiha śuddho'yamudāhriyate? ityāha--`sthāninyanunāsike'pi' ityādi| atraiva kāraṇamāha--`bhāvyamānaḥ' ityādi| yadi ca tapareṇāpi bhāvyamānenāṇā savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, evaṃ sati `viṅvanoranunāsikasyāt‌' (6.4.41) ityatrāpi na syāt‌, tathā `janasanakhanāṃ sañjhaloḥ' (6.4.42) ityatrānunāsikākāro na syāt‌| evaṃ tarhi naivāyamākārastaparaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? dakāraḥ| dakārastu mukhasukhārthaḥ, sa cartvabhūtatvānna śrūyate| syādetat‌--yadyapi bhāvyamāno'ṇ‌ savarṇānna gṛhṇātīti (vyā.pa.35) savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati, tathāpyanunāsikaviśiṣṭasyoccāraṇādanunāsikenaiva yuktaṃ bhavitum‌? ityāha--`śuddho hi' ityādi| ayaṃ hyakāraḥ śuddho niranunāsika ucyate tasmācchuddha eveti nānunāsikaviśiṣṭaḥ| athāyaṃ kimarthaṃ dīrgha ucyate, na hrasva eva kriyatām‌, atrāpi `akaḥ savarṇe' (6.1.101) iti dīrghatvena sidhyatyeva? na sidhyati; `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) iti pararūpatvaṃ syāt‌| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? na; asti hyanyadakāroccāraṇasya prayojanam‌| kiṃ tat‌? nakārasya śravaṇaṃ na syāditi| lopo hi kriyamāṇe gauravaṃ syāt‌, tasmāddīrgho vidhīyate|| 86. ito'tsarvanāmasthāne| (7.1.86) atha `āt‌' (7.1.85) ityanuvarttamāne kimarthamadvacanam‌, hrasvasya śravaṇaṃ yathā syāditi cet‌? naitat‌; kṛte hi hrasvatve sau paratau'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena (6.1.101) bhavitavyamanyatra `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7) ityanena, tatkuto hrasvasya śravaṇam‌? ityāha--`āditi varttamāne' ityādi| ṣapūrvo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat‌ tathoktam‌| kathaṃ punarivaṃ ṣapūrvārthaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`ṛbhukṣaṇam‌' ityādi| yadi prakṛto dīrgha eva vidhīyate, tadā ṛbhukṣamindramityatra hrasvasya śravaṇaṃ na syāt‌| hrasvavidhāne tu `vā ṣapūrvasya nigame' (6.4.9) iti dīrghavidhānāt‌ pakṣe bhavati| sthāninyādeśe ca taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārthamityeke| pathīrityatra dīrghanivṛttyarthamitayanye| panthānamicchati `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8), `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) dīrghaḥ--pathīyati; pathīyateḥ kvip‌, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityallopaḥ, `kyasya vibhāṣā' (6.4.50) iti yakārasaya lopaḥ--pathīḥ|| 87. tho nthaḥ| (7.1.87) thaḥ, nthaḥ--iti dvāvapi sthānyādeśāvanackau| yatttvantha ityatrākāraḥ śrūyate sa uccāraṇārthaḥ| satyapyādeśasyānekāltve `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' (vyā.pa.106) iti thakāramātrasyādeśo vijñāyate, na sarvasya|| 88. bhasya ṭerlopaḥ| (7.1.88) `sarvanāmasthāne' ityādi| `yaci bham‌' (1.4.18) pratyatra `svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāne' (1.4.17) ityataḥ `asarvanāmasthāne' ityanuvarttamāne bhasaṃjñā vihitā, tatra yadi sarvanāmasthāne parataḥ pathyādīnāṃ ṭilopaḥ syāt‌, tadā bhasaṃjñakāste na syuḥ, atha bhasaṃjñakāste syustadā sarvanāmasathānaṃ paraṃ tebyo na syāditi bhasaṃjñakānāṃ sarvanāmasthānasya ca sahānavasthānalakṣaṇo virodhaḥ| tasmādyadyapyuttarārthaṃ sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tathāpīha nābhisambadhyate|| 89. puṃso'suṅ‌| (7.1.89) asuṅo ṅakāro'ntyādeśārthaḥ| ukāra ugitkāryārthaḥ| `pumān‌' iti| `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) ityādinā num‌, `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| `iha paramapumān‌' ityādi| paramaścāsau pumāṃśceti `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāse kṛte yāvadvibhaktirnotpadyate tāvadasuṅādeśena na bhavitavyam‌; tasya tadāśrayatvāt‌| samāsāntodāttatvaṃ tu na kiñcidapekṣata iti antaraṅgatvāt‌ prāgeva vibhakterantodāttatvaṃ bhavati| paścādutpannāyāṃ vibhaktāvasuṅ asvarasya vyañjanasya syāne bhavanna niyatasvaraḥ syāt‌ tataścāniṣṭo'pi svaraḥ prāpnoti, antodāttameva cottarapadamiṣyate, ādyudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti| `tadartham‌' ityādi| arthaśabdo nivṛttivācī, yathā--maśakārtho dhūma iti| tadarthaṃ tasyāniṣṭasya svarasaya nivṛttyarthamupadeśivadvavacanaṃ karttavyam‌, akṛte samāsāntodāttatvaṃ upadeśāvasthāyāmeva vibhaktyutpatteḥ prāgasuṅ‌ yathā syāt‌| tenāsuṅi pūrvaṃ kṛte paścāt‌ samāsāntodāttatvena paramapumānityayaṃ śabdo'ntodātto bhavati| yadyevam‌, pumānityayaṃ śabdo'pyantodāttaḥ syāt‌, upadeśāvasthāyāmevāsuṅi kṛte paścāt‌ prātipadikasvareṇa bhavitavyam‌? ityāha--`pumānityayaṃ punaḥ' ityādi| pumsśabdo'yaṃ punāteḥ `muksuno hrasvaśca' (da.u.9.48) [pāteḥ ḍumsun‌-da.u. pāteḍussun‌ paṃ.u.4.177] iti muksunpratyayānto vyutapāditaḥ| tena nitsvareṇāyamādyudātto bhavati, nāntodāttaḥ|| 90. goto ṇit‌| (7.1.90) ṇiditi saṃjñā vā'nena kriyate--gotaḥ paraṃ sarvanāmasthānaṃ ṇidbhavati, ṇitsaṃjñaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ; atha vā--gotaḥ parasya sarvanāmasthadhānasya ṇakāra itsaṃjñako bhāvyate, tena gotaḥ parasakya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇakāra itsaṃjñako bhavatīti; ādeśo vā vidhīyate--gotaḥ parasya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇiṇakārānubandhavānādeśo bhavati; atideśo kriyate--gotaḥ ṇidbhavati, ṇidvadbhavatītyarthaḥ, vināpi vatinā vatyartho gamyate, yathā--gāṅakuṭādisūtre (1.2.1)| tatrādye paśe saṃjñoccāritā saṃjñinaṃ pratyāyayatīti ṇitpradeśeṣu kṛtrimatvādasyaiva sarvanāmasthānasya grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, na ṇvulādīnām‌| dvitīye tu ṇakāra itsaṃjñakaḥ sarvanāmasthānasya prasajyeta| tṛtīye tu punarṇit‌ sarvanāmasthānaṃ na kvaciddṛṣṭamiti| ya evaite ṣvulādayasya evādeśāḥ prasajyerannityete doṣā ādyeṣu triṣu pakṣeṣu yathākramaṃ pratividheyāḥ| tatpratividhāne pratipattigauravaṃ syāt‌, atideśapakṣe tu na kiñcit‌ pratividheyam‌, ataḥ sa eva sādhuriti| tamevāśrityāha--`gośabdāt‌' ityādi| `ṇitkāryam‌' ityādinā ṇidbhavatītyasyārthaṃ vyācakṣaṇaḥ kāryātideśo'yamityācaṣṭe| gauriti vṛddhirṇitkāryam‌| `citraguḥ' iti| yatra bahuvrīhau kṛte `gostriyorupasarjanasya ' (1.2.48) iti hrasvaḥ| tatrāsati taparakaraṇe `aṅgādhikāre tasya taduttarapadasya' (pu.pa.vṛ.85) iti vacanāttadantavidhimabhyupagamya sthānivadbhāvena gośabdāntametadaṅgaṃ bhavatīti ṇidbhāvaḥ prāpnoti| tapakaraṇe tu tatakālaniyame sati na bhavati; bhinnakālatvāt‌| `taparastatkālasya' (1.1.70) ityatrāṇgrahaṇasya nivṛttatvādanaṇo'pi tatkālaniyamo bhavatyeva| `katham‌' ityādi| satyapi taparakaraṇaṃ `hrasvasya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108), `jasi ca' (7.3.109) iti sambuddhijasorguṇe kṛte he citrago, he citragava ityatra prāpnoti| tatkālatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca lakṣamapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) na bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; yatra hi sthānivadbhāvastatraivā nopatiṣṭhate; adhyayā hi sthānivadbhāvo'narthakaḥ syāt‌| `aṅgavṛtte puna' ityādi parīhāraḥ| eṣa tu he citragavityatra parīhāraḥ, na tu citragava ityatra; aniṣṭhitatvāt‌| avādeśe hi kṛte niṣṭhitatvamatra bhaviṣyati, na ca guṇamātre; aprayogārhatvāt‌| ata evāvyāpakatvādasya parīhārasyāparituṣyan‌ parihārāntaramāha--`atha vā' ityādi| syādetat‌--atrāpi goḥ sambandhi sarvanāmasthānamānantaryalakṣaṇena bhavati sambandheneti/ ata āha--`yacca' ityādi| yadyānantaryalakṣaṇena goḥ sambandhi sarvanāmasthānaṃ gṛhyate tadā ṣaṣṭhyāśrayaṇāmanarthakaṃ syāt‌, pañcamyevāśrayitavyeti; kramavyatikrame prayojanābhāvāt‌| tasmāt‌ ṣaṣṭhyāśrayaṇasāmarthyādgośabdasyārthasya ya ekātvādayasteṣu yatsarvanāmasthānaṃ tadgoḥ sarvanāmasthānamityucyate| tat‌ punargośabdasyaikatvādīnāṃ veditavyam‌| ādiśabdena dvitvādipari grāhaḥ| tatraitat‌ syāt‌--citraguśabdādapi yat‌ sarvanāmasthānaṃ tadgośabdasyārthasyaikatvādiṣu varttate? ityāha--`citraguśabdāt‌' ityādi| yadi yadgoḥ sambandhi sarvanāmasthānaṃ tasya ṇidbhāvo vidhīyate, tadā taparakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, taddhi citragurityādau mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate| na cātra prāptiḥ, na hyatra goḥ sambandhi sarvanāmasthānam‌, kiṃ tarhi? anyapadārthasyetyāha--`taparakaraṇaṃ' tu ityādi| `kecit‌' ityādi| kimarthaṃ punasta evaṃ paṭhanti? ityāha--`dyośabdo'pi' ityādi| ya tvedaṃ na paṭhanti `gotaḥ' iti, teṣāṃ dyośabdāt‌ parasya sarvanāmasthānasya ṇidbhāvo na sidhyatītyāha--`gota ityetadeva' ityādi| kathaṃ punaretadokārāntopalakṣaṇārthaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum‌? ityāha--`varṇanirdeśeṣu' ityādi| yathā `vṛddhirādaic‌' (1.1.1), `adeṅguṇaḥ' (1.1.2) ityavamādiṣu yogeṣu varṇastaparo nirdiśyata iti taparakaraṇaṃ varṇanirdeśeṣu hi prasiddham‌| tasmādihāpi taparanirdeśāt‌ `gotaḥ' ityetadokārāntopalakṣaṇaṃ draṣṭavyamiti| ato vacanāt‌ taparakaraṇaṃ varṇanirdeśārtha mevetyasyaivaukārāntopalakṣaṇārthaṃ vijñāyate|| 91. ṇaluttamo vā| (7.1.91) `ṇitkāryaṃ vā bhavatotyarthaḥ' iti| anena ṇitkāryasya pakṣe'bāvāṇṇidvā bhavatītyucyate, na tu ṇittvasyaiva pratiṣedha iti darśayati| na tu ṇala upadeśāvasthāyāṃ siddhaṃ ṇittvaṃ tadvacanaśatenāpi śakyaṃ tiṣeddhumiti bhāvaḥ| `cakāra, cakara' iti| yadā ṇittvaṃ tadā `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddhiḥ, anyadārdhadhātukalakṣaṇo guṇaḥ| `papāca, papaca' iti| yadā ṇittvaṃ tadā `akata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ, anyadā tadabhāvaḥ|| 92. sakhyurasambuddhau| (7.1.92) `asambuddhau' iti paryudāsaḥ--sambuddheranyā'sambuddhiḥ| `he sakhe' iti| `hrasvasya gaṇaḥ' (7.3.108) iti guṇaḥ|| 93. anaṅ sau| (7.1.93) pūrveṇa ṇittve prāpte'naṅ‌ vidhīyate| tasya ṅakāro'ntyādeśārthaḥ| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `sakhā' iti| `sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisulopaḥ, (6.1.68), `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nakārasya| ākāre vidātavye'naṅvacanaṃ sorlopo yathā syāt‌| akāravidhāne tasya lopo na syāt‌, yathā--panthā iti|| 94. ṛduśanaspurudaṃso'nehasāṃ ca| (7.1.94) ṛkārāntasya `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' (7.3.110) iti guṇe prāpte| itareṣāmapi halṅyādilope (6.1.68) kṛte rutvavisarjanīyasāntadīrgheṣu prāpteṣu| `uśanasaḥ sambuddhāvapi pakṣa iṣyate' iti| tatkatham‌? cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena tambuddhāvapyuśanaso'naṅ‌ bhaviṣyati| yadyevam‌, nityaṃ syāt‌? naitat‌; `ṇaluttamo vā' (7.1.91) ityadhikārāt‌ pakṣe bhaviṣyati| vyavasthita vibhāṣāvijñānāccānyeṣāṃ nityam‌| `nalopapratiṣedho'pi pakṣa iṣyate' iti| kathametallabhyate? tatra hi svarito vā'nudātte padādau' (8.2.6) ityatau vetyanuvarttate, tenaivaṃ vijñāyata--na ṅisambuddhyornalopapratiṣedho vā bhavatīti| vyavasthitavibhāṣādijñānāccośanasaḥ sambuddhinakārasya lopo vā bhaviṣyati| anyeṣāṃ tu nityameva lopo na bhaviṣyatīti| `tathā coktam‌' ityādinā'nantaroktamarthamāgamavacanana draḍhayati| `sāntam‌' iti| yadā'naṅa na kriyate| `nāntam‌' iti| na tu nalopaḥ| `adantam‌' iti| yadā nalopaḥ kriyate| `taparakaraṇamasandehārtham‌' iti| asati hi tasminnuśanasi parato yaṇādeśe kṛte sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimṛkārantasya grahaṇam‌? utta rephāntasyeti?|| 95. tṛjvatkroṣṭuḥ| (7.1.95) `kroṣṭuśapabdastunpratyayāntaḥ saṃjñāśabdaḥ' iti| `kruśa āhvāne' (dhā.856)[`ahvāne rodane ca'--dhā.pā.] ityetasmāt‌ `sitanigamimasisacyavighāñkṛśibhyastun‌' (da.u.1.122)[`pasi'--da.u] iti tunpratyayāntasya saṃjñāyāṃ vyutpāditatvāt‌| saṃjñā punariyaṃ jambukasya| `tṛjvadbhavati' iti| tṛcā tulyaṃ varttata iti tṛjvat‌| `rūpātideśo'yam‌' iti vakṣayati| tatra `tṛjvadbhavati' ityukte tṛcchabdasaya yadrūpaṃ tadatidiśyata iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌ atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`tṛjantasaya yadrūpam‌' ityādi| etacca `pratyayagrahaṇe yasmātma vihitastadādestadantasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (pu.pa.vṛ.44) ityato labhyate| yadyapi śāstrātideśe'pyadoṣo bahudhā bhāvye pradarśitāḥ--tasyāduṣṭatvena prātipādanāt‌, kāryātideśo'payadīṣavāneva vyākhyātaḥ--tasya śāstrātideśenābhinnatvāt‌; tathāpi śāstrātideśakāryātideśayorarūpārthatvādrūpe guṇābhāvaḥ| rūpasya tu prādhānyam‌; tābhyāṃ tasya saṃskāryatvāt‌| ato rūpātideśo'yaṃ yukta ityāha--`rūpātideśo'yam‌' ityādi| yadi tarhi tṛjantasya yadrūpaṃ tat‌ kroṣṭuśabdasyātidiśyate tadā yatkiñcideva tṛjantasya rūpam‌--vaktṛ, paktṛ--ityevamādyapi prāpnoti? ata āha--`pratyāsatteśca' ityādi| iha dhātvantarasya pacatiprabhṛte stṛjantasya rūpamasti, kruśerapi, tat‌ kimaśrutasaya dhātostṛjantasya yadrūpaṃ tadatidiśyate, utta śrutasya kruśeriti? tatra śrutasyaiva yadrūpaṃ tadevātideṣṭuṃ iti| cakāroccāraṇasāmarthyāt‌ svaro'pyativiśyate| anyathā `tṛvat‌' ityeva brūyāditi bhāvaḥ| `kroṣṭā' iti| tṛjvadbhāve kṛte pūrvasūtreṇānaṅ‌| `kroṣṭārau' kroṣṭāraḥ' iti| `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' (7.3.110) iti guṇaḥ, raparatvam‌, aptrādisūtreṇa (6.4.11) dīrghaḥ| `kroṣṭan‌' iti| `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) iti dīrghaḥ| `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (6.1.103) iti natvam‌|| 96. striyāñca| (7.1.96) `krīṣṭrībhiḥ' iti| tṛjvadbhāve kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ| kena punaḥ kroṣṭuśabdādīkāraḥ, tṛjvadbhāve kṛte `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' (4.1.5) ityaneneti cet‌? na; anudāttatvaprasaṅgādityata āha--`kroṣṭuśabdaṃ kecit‌' ityādi| `pañcabhiḥ kroṣṭrībhiḥ krītaiḥ' iti| `taddhitārthottarapadasamāhāre ca' (2.1.51) iti samāsaḥ| `ārhādagopuccha' (5.1.19) ityādinā ṭhak‌, tasya `adhyarddhapūrva' (5.1.28) ityādinā lak‌, `luktaddhitaluki' (1.2.49) iti strīpratyayasya luk‌, tasmiṃllupte ye ṅīṣpratyaye kṛte tṛjvadbhāvaṃ kurvanti teṣāṃ tṛjavadbhāvo na bhavati, tasmāt‌ `prativiṣeyam‌' iti| pratividhānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratividhānam‌--cakāro'tra kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena lupte'pi strīpratyaye bhaviṣyati| ye tarhi gaurādiṣu na paṭhanti teṣāmīkāraḥ katham‌? ityāha--`gaurādiṣu' ityādi| teṣāṃ pañcakroṣṭubhirityatra na kiñcit‌ pratividheyam‌; parasya strīpratyayasya nimittatvenānāśritatvāt‌| nanu ca teṣāmapi strīpratyayasya luptatvādasasyāmaṅgasaṃjñāyāmaṅgasyocyamānastṛṇvadbhāvo na prāpnotīti pratividheyameva? naitadasti; lupte hi strīpratyaye pratyayalakṣaṇenāṅgasaṃjñā bhavatyeva| `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ so'ṅgādhikāra vihitasyaiva kāryasya| na cāṅgasaṃjñā'ṅgādhikāre vihitā| `kṛte'tideśe' ityādi| `iko'ci vibhaktau (7.1.73) ityanuvṛttervibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ tadāśrayāyāñcāṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ striyāṃ varttamānasya kroṣṭuśabdasyātideśaḥ kriyate| tasmin‌ kṛte ṛkārāntatvāt‌ `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' (4.1.5) iti ṅībbhavati| nanu ca ṅīppratyaye kṛte'ntodāttaḥ kroṣṭrīśabdo na sidhyati? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| kroṣṭrīśabdo'ntodātto'tidiśyata iti tṛsambandhina ṛkārasya sthāne yaṇādeśo bhavannudāttayaṇ‌ bhavati, tataśca `śaturanumo nadyajādī' (6.1.173) ityanuvarttamāne `udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt‌' (6.1.174) ityantodātto bhavati kroṣṭrīśabdaḥ|| 97. vibhāṣā tṛtīyādiṣvaci| (7.1.97) `striyām‌' (7.1.96) iti nānuvarttate, teneyamaprāptavibhāṣā| `kroṣṭunā' iti| `āṅo nāstriyām‌' (7.3.120) iti nābhāvaḥ| `kroṣṭave' iti| `gherṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇaḥ| `kroṣṭuḥ' iti| `ṛta ut‌' (6.1.111) ityuttvam‌, raparatvam‌, `rāt‌ sasya' (8.2.24) iti salopaḥ| `kroṣṭoḥ' iti| pūrvavadguṇaḥ, `ṅasiṅasośca' (6.1.110) iti pūrvarūpatvam‌ `kroṣṭari iti| `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' (7.3.110) iti guṇaḥ| `krīṣṭau' iti| `acca gheḥ' (7.3.119) ityattvam‌, auttvañca| `tṛjvadbhāvāt‌' ityādi| tṛjvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ--puṃsi kroṣṭro iti, numo'vakāśaḥ--trapuṇe, jatuna iti; priyakroṣṭune vanāyetyatrobhayaprasaṅge sati numbhavati pūrvavipratiṣedheneti| nuṭo'vakāśaḥ--agnīnām‌, vāyūnāmiti, tṛjvadbhāvasyāvakāśaḥ sa eva; kroṣṭranāmityatrobhayaprasaṅge sati nuṅ‌ bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedheneti| pūrvavipratiṣedhastu paraśabdasyeṣṭavācitvā llabhyate|| 98. caturanaḍuhorāmudāttaḥ| (7.1.98) `sarvanāmasthāne' (7.1.86) iti svaryate, na `tṛtīyādiṣu' (7.1.97) iti| `āgamā anudāttā bhavanti' (vyā.pa.105) ityanudāttatve prāpte, udāttatvārthaṃ vacanam‌| `tadantavidhiratreṣyate' iti| `aṅgādhikāre tasya taduttarapadasya' (pu.pa.vṛ.85) iti vacanāt‌| `priyacatvāḥ' iti| bahuvrīhiḥ| `sarvanāmasaṃkhyayorupasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.113) iti saṃkhyāyāḥ pūrvanipāte prāpte `vā priyasya' (vā.114) iti priyaśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ|| 99. abhsambuddhau| (7.1.99) pūrveṇāmi prāpte vacanam‌| `he priyacatvaḥ| he priyānaḍhavan‌' iti| atra catuḥśabdasya kevalasya sambuddhirna bhavatīti datantasyodāharaṇam‌| anajuhastu yadayapi kevalasya sambhavati, tathāpi tadantavidhiratreṣyata iti tadantasyodāharaṇam‌|| 100. ṛta iddhātoḥ| (7.1.100) `kiriti, girati' iti| `kṝ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1409), `gu nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410)| `tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ' (3.1.77)| `āstīrṇam‌' iti| `stṝ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1484),[stṝñ‌--dhā.pā.] `radābhyām‌' (8.2.42) iti natvam‌, `raṣābhyām‌' (8.4.1) iti ṇatvam‌, `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ| `viśīrṇam‌' iti| `śṝ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1488)| `mātṝṇām‌, pitṝṇām‌' iti| `nāmi' (6.4.3) iti dīrghaḥ| satyapi ṛkārāntatve'dhātutvādiha na bhavati| nanu ca lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayai (vyā.pa.3) vatra na bhaviṣyati, tatkimetannivṛttyarthena dhātugrahaṇena? ityāha--`lākṣaṇikasyāpi' ityādi| kimarthaṃ panarlākṣaṇikasya grahaṇam‌? ityāha--`cikrīrvati' ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi lākṣaṇikasyātra grahaṇaṃ labhyate? ata eva dhātugrahaṇājjñāpakāt‌| tasya hyetat‌ prayojanam‌--mātṝṇām‌, pitṛṇāmityatra mā bhūditi| yadīha lākṣaṇikasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌ tadā mātṝṇām‌, pitṝṇāmityādau lākṣaṇikatvādeva na bhaviṣyatīti dhātugrahaṇamanarthakam‌| tasmāllākṣikasyāpyatra grahaṇam‌| tena cikīrṣatītyeva mādiṣu `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghatve satyapi bhavatyeva| taparakaraṇamasandehārtham‌| `ra' ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimayaṃ rephasya nirdeśaḥ? utta yaṇādeśa ṝkārasyeti? 101. upadhāyāśca| (7.1.101) ṝkārāntasya dhātorittvamuktam‌| upadhābhūtasya dhātoṝkārasya na prāpnoti, iṣyate; tadarthametat‌| `kīrttayati' iti| `kṝta saṃśabdane' (dhā.pā.1656) curādau ṇyantaḥ| nanu ca `ūtiyūtijūtisātihetikīrtta yaśca' (3.3.97) iti nipātanādevettvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti kathaṃ tadartho yogarambhaḥ? naitadasti; ktinviṣaya eva nipātanaṃ syāt‌| evaṃ tarhi pūrvayoge dhātunā ṝkāraṃ viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ, atra tatsthasyeti? etadapi nāsti; evaṃ sati ṝkāramicchati ṝkārīyatītyatrāpi syāt‌| tasmādvaktavyamidam‌| `kṝtaśca' iti vaktavye `upadhāyāśca' iti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham‌| `kṛtaśca' ityucyamāne takārasya syāt‌? naitadanti; `ṝtaḥ' iti pūrvasūtre viśeṣaṇatvena prakakṛtam‌; na śakyate taddhi viśeṣyatvena vivakṣitumiti| tasya `upadhāyā ṝkārasyekārādeśo bhavati' ityeṣa vṛttigrantho virudhyate| atra hi ṛkārasya viśeṣyatā darśitā| tasmādyathāṅgasyaitat‌ kvacidviśeṣaṇam‌; tathā `ṝtaḥ' ityetadapi pūrvasūtre viśeṣaṇam‌, iha tu viśeṣyam‌|| 102. udoṣṭhyapūrvasya| (7.1.102) `ṝta iddhātoḥ] (7.1.100) itīttve prāpta uttvaṃ vidhīyate| `pūrttaḥ' [`pūrttāḥ'--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1086), ktaḥ| `na dhyākhyā' (8.2.57) ityādinā prativiṣaddhatvānna niṣṭhānatvaṃ bhavati| `vuvūrṣati' iti| `vṝ varaṇe' (dhā.pā.1490)| `mumūrṣati' iti| `mṝ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1492)| `sūsvūrṣati' iti| `sthṝ śabdopatāpayoḥ' (dhā.pā.932), `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghatvaṃ ṛkārāntatvamasya| atheha kathamuttvam‌--`vṛṅ‌ sambhaktau' (dhā.pā.1509), `vṛñ‌ varaṇe' (dhā.pā.1254)--prāvuvūrṣate, prāvuvūrṣatīti, na hyatra ṛkāra oṣṭhyapūrvaḥ kiṃ tarhi? dantyoṣṭhyapūrvaṃ iti? tadetadāha--`dantyauṣṭhyapurvo'pyoṣṭhyapūrvo bhavati' ityādi| yo hyubhayasthāne niṣpadyate labhate'sāvanyataravyapadeśam‌| tena dantyauṣṭhyo yo bhavati so'pyoṣṭhyo bhavatyeva| dantyauṣṭhyapūrvo'payoṣṭhyapūrva eva| atha samīrṇamityatra kasmānni bhavati, asti hyatrāpyoṣṭhagrapūrvatā? ityāha--`oṣṭhyo hyatra' ityādi| oṣṭhyo hyatrāṅgāvayavo'pi| tatreha pratyāsatteraṅgāvayavo gṛhyate, nopasargavayavaḥ| pratyāsannatvaṃ punāprasaṅgasya prakṛtatvāt‌ upasargasya tu nāsti pratyāsannatvam‌; viparyayāt‌| `ittvottvābhyām‌' ityādi| ittvottvayoravakāśaḥ--āstīrṇam‌, pūrtta iti; guṇavṛddhyoravakāśaḥ--cayanam‌, cāyaka iti; ihomayaṃ prāpnoti--āstaraṇam‌, āstārakaḥ, niparaṇam‌, nipāraka iti, atra guṇavṛddhī bhavato vipratiṣedhena|| 103. bahulaṃ chandasi| (7.1.103) `taturiḥ, jaguriḥ' iti| taratergirateśca `ādṛgamahanajanaḥ kikinau liṭ‌ ca' (3.2.171) iti kikinoranyataraḥ, tataścottve `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) iti sthānivadbhāvāt `tṝ gṝ', iti dviracyate, `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityattvam‌| `papritamam‌, vavritamam‌' iti| `pṝ, vṝ' ityetayoḥ kikinoranyataraḥ, yathadeśaḥ| kipratyayāntāt‌ `atiśāyane tamap‌' (5.3.55) ityādinā tamap‌|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañcikāyāṃ saptamādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ|| <7.2> atha saptamādhyāyaḥ dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu| (7.2.1) `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti guṇe prāpte vacanamidamārabhyate| sicīti, parasmaipadeṣviti ca dve apyeti parasaptamyau; tatra sico'ṅgāpekṣaṃ paratvaṃ, parasmaipadānāṃ tu sijapekṣam‌| `parasmaipadapare' iti| parasmaipadaṃ paraṃ yasmāt‌ sa tathoktaḥ| `igantasya' iti| `iko guṇabṛddhī' (1.1.3) ityasyopasthāne satīkā'ṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--`igantasyāṅgasya vṛddhirbhavati' iti| `acaiṣīt‌, anaiṣīt‌' iti| `ciñ‌ cayane' (dhā.pā.1251), `ṇoñ‌ prāpaṇe' (dhā.pā.91), bhūte luṅ, `cleḥ sic‌' (3.1.44), `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ, aḍāgamaḥ, `nityaṃ ṅitaḥ' (3.4.99) ityanuvarttamāne `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ, `astisico'pukte' (7.3.96) itīṭ‌, `iṣkoḥ' (8.3.57) ityanuvarttamāne `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvam‌| `alāvīt‌ apāvīt‌' iti| `pūrvavalluṅa, `ārdhadhātukasyeṅvalādeḥ' (7.2.35) itīṭ‌ pūrvavadīṭ‌, `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| `akārṣāt‌' iti| udāharaṇaṃ subodham‌| nanu cātrāntaraṅgatvādguṇena bhavitavyam‌, antaraṅgatvaṃ punastasyārdhadhātukāpekṣātvāt‌; vṛddhestvādguṇaviśeṣaṃ parasmaipadaparaṃ sicamapekṣya bahiraṅgatvam‌? ata āha--`antaraṅgamapi' ityādi| yadyantaraṅgatvādṇaḥ syāt‌, tadaitadvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmādvacanasāmarthyādvahiraṅgāpi vṛddhirguṇaṃ bādhate| yadyevam‌, tarhi yathā vacana sāmarthyādvṛddhirantaraṅgamapi guṇaṃ bādhate, tathovaṅādeśamapi bādheta tataśca nyanuvīt‌, nyadhuvīditi na sidhyet‌? ityata āha--`vyanuvīnnyadhuvīt‌' ityādi| yatra hi vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho nāsti, tatra vacanasāmarthyādvidhyantaraṃ bādhitvā'sau pravarttate| iha tu ṅittve sati `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti vṛddhiḥ pratiṣidhyate, pratiṣiddhā ca sato notsahata upaṅādeśaṃ bādhitum‌| tena tasyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinovaṅādeśaḥ kriyate| ṅittvaṃ punaratra `ṇū stavane' (dhā.pā.1397), `dhū vidhūnane' (dhā.pā.1398) ityetayoḥ kuṭādiṣu pāṭhādgāṅakuṭādisūtreṇa (1.2.1) yathā sāmarthyādvṛddhyā guṇo bādhyate, tathā pratiṣedho'pi bādhyeta eva? naitadasti; guṇe hi nāprāpte vṛddhirārabhyate, pratiṣedhe tu prāpte cāprāpte ca| tatra yena nāprāpti nānyena (vyā.pa.49) guṇasyaiva bādhā yuktā, na pratiṣedhasya| `acyoṣṭa, aploṣṭa' iti| `cyuṅ‌ chyuṅ‌ jyuṅ‌ (na staḥ--dhātupāṭhe) iyuṅ‌ pruṅ‌ pluṅ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.955,956,957) 2. ato lrāntasya| (7.2.2) antaśabdo'yamastyavayavavacanaḥ, yathā vastrāntaḥ, vasanānta iti| asti ca samīpavācī, yathā--udakāntaṃ priyaṃ prothamanuvrajediti| udakasamopamityarthaḥ| atrāvayavavācino'ntaśabdasya grahaṇe ihāntagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌? tasya hyupādanasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--rephalakārāntasya yathā syāditi| etacca `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityanenaiva sidhyati| tasmāt‌ samīpavācina eva grahaṇamiti matvā''ha--`rephalakāro yāvato'ntau- samīpī' iti| yadi tarhi lrāvantau yasaya samīpāvata ityanena nirdiśyate vṛddhibhāg‌ na nirdiṣṭaḥ syāt‌| evañca `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityantyasya syāt‌; akārasamīpabhūtasya lrāntasyāntyasya vṛddhibhāja iko'bhāvādityata āha--`ata eva sthāne' iti| evaṃ manyate--akārasya śrutatvādakārasyaiva sthāne vṛddhirvijñāyata iti| `akṣārīt‌' ityādi| `kṣara sañcalane' (dhā.pā.851), `tsara chadmagatau' (dhā.pā.554), `jvala dīptau' (dhā.pā.804), `hvala hyala calane' (dhā.pā.805,806) ityeteṣāṃ rūpāṇi| `ato halāderlaghorityasya vikalpasyāyamapavādaḥ' iti| etena niyamārthatāmasya yogasya darśayati| `nyakhorīt‌, nyamīlīt‌' ityādi| `khura chedane' (vā.yāṃ.1342), `mīla śmīla smīla śmīla nimeṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.517-520)| `mā bhavānaṭīt‌, mā bhavānaśīt‌' iti| `aṭa paṭa gatau' (dhā.pā.295,296), `aśabhojane' (dhā.pā.1523) `na māṅyoge' (6.4.74) ityāṭpratiṣedhārtho māṅyogaḥ| `bhavān‌' iti| ayaṃ sandehanirāsārthaḥ; ato'nyatra viśeṣābhāvāt‌| `avabhrīt‌' iti| `abhra vabhra mabhra cara gatyarthāḥ' (dhā.pā.556-559)| `aśvallīt‌' iti| `śvalaśvalla āśugamane' (dhā.pā.549,550)| `na tāvataḥ samīpau' iti| bhakāralakārābhyāṃ vyavadhānāditi|| 3. vadavrajahalantasyācaḥ| (7.2.3) anigantārtho'yamārambhaḥ| atha vadivrajyorgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā halantatvādeva vṛddhiḥ sidhyati? ityata āha--`vikalapabādhanārtham‌' ityādi| `ato halādeḥ' (7.2.7) vikalpaṃ vakṣyati, tasya bādho yathā syāt‌| `apākṣīt‌' iti| `ḍupacaṣ‌ pāke' (dhā.pā.996), `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌| `abhaistīt‌' iti| `bhidir‌ vidāraṇe (dhā.pā.1439), `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌--dakārasya takāraḥ| `arautsīt‌' iti| `rudhira āvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1438)| `atra' ityādi| `vadivrajyoḥ ityeko yogaḥ, `acaḥ' iti dvitīyaḥ; evaṃ yogavibhāge sati halantagrahaṇamantareṇāpīṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva| `katham‌' iti| asambhāvayataḥ praśnaḥ| `vadivravyoḥ' ityādinā yathā yogavibhāge sati sidhyati tathā darśayati| tatra prathamayoge pūrvasūtrāt‌ `ataḥ' iti sthānyanuvarttate| tenāvādīt‌, avrājīdityetāvatsidhyati| tato yadaca iti dvitīyaṃ sūtram‌, tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvayoryatheṣṭatvāt‌ prakṛtenāṅgenājiviśidhyate--aṅgasya yo'jiti| tenāṅgasyāco yatra tatrāvasthitasya sici parato vṛddhirbhavati| apākṣīdityādyapi sidhyati| yadyevam‌, yogavibhāga eva karttavyaḥ, kiṃ halgrahaṇena? ityata āha--`tadetat‌' ityādi| halsamudayaparigrahaḥ kimartho yatasatadartho'yaṃ yatnaḥ kriyate? ityāha--`ihāpi' ityādi| `arāṅkṣīt‌' iti| `rañja rāge' (dhā.pā.1167)| `asāṅkṣīt‌' iti| `ṣanja saṅge' (dhā.pā.987)| nanu cāṅgasya yo'c‌ tasya sici parato vṛddhirucyate, na cātrāṅgasambandhino'conantaraḥ paraḥ sic‌ sambhavati yasyānena vṛddhirvidhīyate| tathā hyakārāntasyāṅgasya tāvat‌ `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) iti lopena bhavitavyam‌| na ca vacanādato lopaṃ vṛddhirbādhiṣyata iti śakyate vaktum‌; yadi hyakārāntasyaiva vṛddhiḥ syāt‌ pratyāhāragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, `ataḥ' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| atha vā--tadapi sambhavati| akārāntasya tu kāmaṃ saṃbhavati yāvāprabhṛteḥ| na tu tasyāsti viśeṣaḥ satyāṃ vā vṛddhāvasatyāṃ vā| igantasya punaḥ `sici vṛddhiḥ' (7.2.1) ityādinaiva vṛddhirvihitā| sandhyakṣarāṇāṃ ca nāstyeva; `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityāttvavidhānāt‌| udavoḍhām‌, udavoḍhamityatrāstīti cet‌? na; ḍhalopasyāsiddhatvāt‌| tadayaṃ na kyacidaco'nantaraḥ parasmaipadaparaḥ sic‌ sambhavati| ucyate cedaṃ vacanam‌; tato `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt‌' (vyā.pa.46) yathā'pākṣīdityādau vṛddhirbhavati, tathā'rāṅkṣīdityādāvapi vṛddhirbhaviṣyati, tato nārtho halgrahaṇena? ityata āha--`anyathā hi' ityādi| ekena varṇena sarvatra vyavadhānamasti| halsamudāyena kyacidevārāṅkṣīdityādau| apākṣīdityadau nāsti, tatrasati halagrahaṇe'nantaroktayā nītyā yatraikena varṇena vyavadhānamasti--apākṣīdityādau, tatraiva syāt‌, yatra tvarnekavarṇena vyavadhānamasti--arāṅkṣīdityādau, tatra na syāt‌, yathā'pipaṭhiṣīdityādau ādayayoracorvyavadhānānna bhavati| halgrahaṇe tu sati halsamudāyena vyavadhāne'pi bhavati; halgrahaṇasāmarthyāt| udavoḍhām‌, udavoḍhamityatra vahervṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati, ḍhalope kṛte'halantāditi cet‌? na; ḍhalopasyāsiddhatvāditi yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--kriyate evātra vṛddhiḥ| tasyāstvottvaṃ vidhīyata iti darśayitumāha--`udavoḍhām‌' ityādi| ādiśabdena dhātvādayo gṛhyante| vaherutpūrvālluṅ‌, tasthasau, tayoḥ `tasthasthamipām‌' (3.4.101) ityādinā tāntamādeśau yathākramam‌, halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ, `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌, `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sico lopaḥ, `jhaṣastathorgho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti ṣatvam‌, `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti ṣṭutvam‌| `sahivaherodavarṇasya' (6.3.112) ityottvam‌| tatra hyottve punarvṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`tatra kṛte punaḥ' ityādi| ekaṃ hyatra vṛddhiśāstram‌, tena ca prāgeva kṛtā vṛddhiriti kṛtakāryatvād‌vṛddhiśāstrasya, punastanna vyāpriyata iti na bhavati punarvṛddhiḥ| sauḍhāmitrirityatra tarhi kathamottve kṛte vṛddhirbhavati? ityāha--`yatra tu' ityādi| yatra prāgvṛddhiḥ kṛtā tatra kṛtārthatvād‌vṛddhiśāstrasya punarna vyāpriyata iti na bhavati vṛddhiḥ, soḍhāmitrirityatra tu na kṛtā vṛddhiḥ| tasmādakṛtārthatvād‌vṛddhiśāstraṃ vyāpriyata iti bhavatyeva vṛddhiḥ| sā ca bhavtyokārasya bhavati, nākarasya vṛddhiriti; vṛddhividhānakāla okārasyaiva vṛddhibhājaḥ sannihitatvāt‌| saherniṣṭhā, tatra ḍhatvādiṣu kṛteṣu soḍha iti bhavati, soḍho'mitro'neneti soḍhāmitraḥ, tasyāpatyamiti `ata iñ‌' (4.1.95), `taddhiteṣvacāmāne' (7.2.117) vṛddhiḥ| `yena vidhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityeva siddhe tadantatve'ntagrahaṇamasandehārtham‌| `halo'caḥ' ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimajantasyāṅgasya halo vṛddhirbhavati? uta halantasyāca iti?|| 4. neṭi| (7.2.4) halantasyāca iti yā vṛddhiḥ prāptā sā halantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiranena pratiṣidhyate `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti kṛtvā| `adevīt‌, asevīt‌' iti| `divu krīḍādo' (dhā.pā.1107), `sivu tantusantāneṭa [`ṣivu'--dā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1108)| vṛddhau pratiṣiddhāyāṃ `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ| `akoṣīdamoṣīt‌' iti| `kuṣa niṣkarṇe' (dhā.pā.1518), `muṣa steye' (dhā.pā.1530)| `nanvatraitadantaraṅgatvāt‌'[nanvatraitadapyantaraṅgatvāt‌--kīśikā] iti codyam‌| `naitadevam‌' iti parihāraḥ| ubhayañcaitadgatārtham‌|| 5. hyyantakṣaṇaśvasajāgṛṇiśvyeditām‌| (7.2.5) `agrahīt‌' iti| graha upādāne' (dhā.pā. 1533)| `asyamīt‌' iti| `sthamu svana dhvana śabde'(dhā.pā.826)-828) `avamīt‌' iti| `ṭu vama udgiraṇe' (dhā.pā.849)| `adyatīt‌' iti| `vyayavittasamutsarge' (dhā.pā.1932) `akṣaṇīt‌' iti| `kṣaṇu hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1465) aśvasīditi| `śvasaprāṇane' (dā.pā.1069)| `ajāgarīt‌' iti| `jāgṛ nidrākṣaye' (dhā.pā.1072)| `aunayīt‌ ailayīt‌' `ūna parihāṇe' (dhā.pā.1888), [pariharaṇe--dhā.pā.] `īla preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1660), [`ila'--dhā.pā.] curādiṇic‌| `nonayati' (3.1.51) ityādinā caṅi pratiṣiddhe sijeva bhavati, `āḍajādīnām‌' (6.4.72) ityāṭ‌, `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| `aśvayīt‌' iti| `ṭu ośyi gativṛddyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1010)| `aragīt‌, alagīt‌ iti| `rage lage saṅge [rage śaṃkāyām‌--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.785,786)| `asthāgīt‌' iti| `sthage saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.790) [`ṣṭage'--dhā.pā.] `akakhīt‌' iti| `kakhe hasane' (dhā.pā.784)| `sā ca neṭīti na pratiṣidhyate' iti| anantarāyā halantakṣaṇāyā vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, na pūrvasyāḥ| atha kimarthaṃ ṇiśvigrahaṇam‌, yāvatāntaraṅgatvādevātra guṇena bhavitavyam‌, kṛte guṇe'yādeśena, tataśca yakārāntatvādeva tathoḥ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`na ca' ityādi| idamantaraṅgatvaṃ sicyabhyupetyoktam‌| idānīmantaraṅgatvameva sici nāstīti darśayitamāha--`yadi' ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ṇiśvigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌? ityāta āha--`guṇāyādeśayoḥ' iti| yadi tarhi sicyantaraṅgatvaṃ nāsti, yaduktaṃ `antaraṅgamapi guṇameṣā vṛddhirvacanādvādhate' iti tadvirudhyate? nāsti virodhaḥ, adhyāropyo tathābhidhānāt‌| `atha' ityādi| atra vakṣyamāṇo'bhiprāyaḥ| atha jāgṛgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti pṛṣṭasya kiṃ kāraṇaṃ jāgṛgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti praśnāvasare yenābhiprāyeṇa pṛṣṭavāṃstamāviṣkarttumāha--`jāgro'viciṇ‌' ityādi| yathā jāgarayatītyādau `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti prāptāṃ vṛddhiṃ jāgarttarguṇo bādhate tathā sicivṛddhimapi bādhidhyate, vṛddhyapavādatvādguṇaśāstrasaya| `gṛṇe kata' ityādi| akṛte hi gaṇe yā sici vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti sāpavādatvādguṇena bādhyate; akṛtārthatvādguṇaśāstrasya| na ca sā'nena vacanena bādhiṣyate; kiṃ tarhi? guṇe kṛte raparatve ca `ato lrāntasya' (7.2.2) ityuttarakālaṃ yā vṛddhi prāpnoti tasyāḥ pratiṣedho vidhīyate, na ca śakyā guṇena bādhituṃ sā| na hi `jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu' (7.3.85) iti śāstraṃ punaḥ pravarttitumutsahate; kṛtārthatvāt‌| na cānyad‌guṇalakṣaṇamastyuttarakālavṛddherbādhakam‌| tatra yadi jāgagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, `ato lrāntasya' (7.2.2) iti vṛddhi syāt‌| `atha' ityādi codakaḥ| yadi guṇe'pi kṛte punarvṛddhiḥ syāt‌, vṛddhiviṣaye guṇavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ guṇavidhānasāmarthyādyāpi guṇe kṛte raparatve ca paścāt‌ `ato lrāntasya' (7.2.2) iti vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti sā pratiṣidhyate, yathā--jāgarayatītyatra| guṇe kṛte raparatve ca yā prāpnoti `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) ityuttarakālabhādinī vṛddhiḥ, sā'pi na bhavati; guṇena bādhitatvāt‌| `tathā ca' ityādi| guṇāvidhānasāmarthyāduttarakālabhāvinyapi vṛddhirbādhyate; anyathā hi gūṇe kṛte raparatve ca `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.1.116) ityuttarakālabhāvinī vṛddhiḥ, sā'pi na bhavati; gaṇena bādhitatvāt‌| `tathā ca' ityādi| guṇavidhānasāmarthyādutarakālabhāvinyapi vṛddhirguṇena bādhyata iti, tadeva draḍhayati| evañca ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedho'rthavān‌ bhavati yadyuttarakālabhāvinyapi vṛddhirbādhyate; anyathā hi guṇe kṛte raparatve ca `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhyā bhavitavyam‌| ciṇṇaloryaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate so'narthakaḥ syāt‌| tasmāduttarakālabhāvinyapi vṛddhirguṇena bādhyata iti sthimetat‌| tataśca śakyameva jāgṛgrahaṇamakarttam‌| evaṃ pratyākhyāte jāgṛgrahaṇe, itara āha--`tat‌ kriyate' ityādi| ya evaṃ pratipattuṃ na śaktaḥ, taṃ prati vispaṣṭārthaṃ jāgṛgrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 6. ūrṇotervibhāṣā| (7.2.6) nityaṃ vṛddhiprasaṅge prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam‌|| 7. ato halāderlaghoḥ| (7.2,7) `neṭi' (7.2.4) iti pratiṣedhe prāpte vikalpārthamidamārabhyate| `akaṇīt‌, akāṇīt‌' iti| `aṇa raṇa vaṇa kaṇa bhaṇa kvaṇa' (dhā.pā.444-446,449,447,450) iti bhvādau paṭhyate| `araṇīt‌ arāṇīt‌' iti| raṇirapi tatraiva| `nyakuṭīt‌' iti| `kuṭa kauṭilye (dhā.pā.1366)| `nyapuṭīt‌' iti| `puṭa saṃśleṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1367) nanu cātra kuṭāditvānṅittve sati `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, tato naitanniyuyartham‌ `ataḥ ityetat‌ karttavyam‌? ityata āha--`ata ityetasminnasati' ityādi| yadi `ataḥ' iti nocyeta, tato'vaśyam‌ `vadavrajahalantasyācaḥ' (7.2.3) ityanuvarttayitavyam‌; anyathā hyanirdiṣṭasthānikatvādika eva laghorvikalpena vṛddhiḥ syāt‌--adevīdityādau, akāṇīdityādau tvakārasya na syāt| ajgrahaṇānuvṛttau tu satyāmajlakṣameyaṃ vṛddhiḥ syāt‌, neglakṣaṇā; nirddiṣṭasthānikatvāt‌| yatra hi sthānī na nirddiśyate sa iglakṣaṇāyā vṛddherviṣayaḥ, na tu yatra sthāno nirdiśyate so'pi, tataśca `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti pratiṣedho na syāt‌; tatra `ikaḥ' ityadhikārāt‌| tasmānnyakuṭīt‌, nyapuṭīdityatra vikalpena vṛddhirmā bhūdityevamarthamata iti vaktavyam‌| `atakṣīt‌, arakṣīt‌' iti| `takṣū tvakṣū tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.655,656), `rakṣa pālane' (dhā.pā.658)| iha sica ānantarye'kārasya vṛddhirucyate, na kvacidanantaraḥ sic‌ sambhavati| tatra `yena nāvyavacānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt‌' (vyā.pa.46) iti vyavadhāne'pi vṛddhyā bhavitavyam‌| evaṃ yathā akāṇīdityatra laghorakārasya bhavati, tathā acakāsīdityatrāpi laghorakārasya vṛddhyā bhaditavyameva? ityanenābhiprāyeṇāha--`atheha kasmānna bhavatyacakāsīt‌' iti| `cakāsṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.1074)| `yena' ityādi parīhāraḥ| `halā vyavadhānamāśritam‌' iti| halantasyetyanuvṛtterityabhiprāyaḥ| laghoriti kimiti yenaivaṃ pṛṣṭam‌, sa evaṃ laghugrahaṇaṃ pratyācikhyāsurāha--`atha punaḥ' ityādi| yadyevaṃ parikalpyate, vacanaprāmāṇyaddhalā vyavadhānamāśrīyate, na tvacā, `ato laghoḥ' iti vaktavyam‌, anyathā hyatakṣīdityādāvapi syāt‌? atra hi halā vyavadhānam‌, nācā| atha punarivaṃ parikalpyate--`yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahate'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāta' (vyā.pa.46) ityekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrīyate, na punaranekeneti nārtho laghorityaneneti, na hyevaṃ parikalpyamāne'takṣīdityādau prāpnoti yadyanekena varṇena vyavadhānam‌? ityata āha--`tat‌ kriyate' ityādi|| 8. neḍvaśi kṛti| (7.2.8) `ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ (7.2.35) itīṭaṃ vakṣyati, tasya yatra prakṛtilakṣaṇaḥ paratiṣedho nāsti tatrānena pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate| purastāt‌ pratiṣedhakāṇḍasya prayojanaṃ krādiniyamasūtre (7.2.13) vakṣyati| `īśitā' ityādi pratyayāntare tviṭo bhāvena `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt‌' (7.2.10) iti yaḥ prakṛtinimittakaḥ pratiṣedhastadabhāvamevācaṣṭe| `īśvaraḥ' iti| `īśa aiśvarye' (dhā.pā.1020), `stheśabhāsa' (3.2.175) ityādinā varac‌| `dīpraḥ' iti| `dīpī dīptau' (dhā.pā.1150), `namikamyi' (3.2.167) ityādinā raḥ| `bhasma' iti| `bhasa bharsanadīptyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1100)| `āto maninkvanibvanipaśca' (3.2.74) ityādau `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti manin‌| `yācñā' iti| `ṭu yācṛ yācñāyām‌' (dhā.pā.863)| `yajayāca' (7.3.66) ityādinā naṅ‌| `varamanādau prayojanam‌' iti yaduktaṃ tatra prarigaṇanatvamavadhārya ya evaṃ codayet‌--yadi varamanādāviti parigaṇanaṃ kriyate tadā `ṣaṇu dāne' (dhā.pā.1464), `ñamantāḍḍaḥ' (paṃ.u.1.104)--ṣaṇḍaḥ, `śamaḥ khaḥ' (paṃ.u.1.113)--śaṅkha ityādau pratiṣedho na prāpnotīti--taṃ prati nedaṃ parigaṇanamiti darśayitumāha--`varamanādāvityudāharaṇam‌' iti| `atha tatra' ityādi| tatrauṇādike ḍapratyaye samādhīyeteti parigaṇanapakṣabhādi codyaṃ parihriyata ityarthaḥ| `sambavodāharaṇapradarśanārthametat‌' iti| atrāpi na parigaṇanametaditi sambadhyate| pratiṣedhasya sambhava udāhriyate| yatra kṛti pratiṣedhaḥ sambhavati tasya pradarśanārthametaduktaṃ bhavati| yatra vasādau kṛtīdpratiṣedhaḥ sambhavati, tasya pradarśanārthaṃ varamanādāvityuktam‌, na punaretat‌ parigaṇanamiti| `rurudiva, rurudima' iti| atra kṛdgrahaṇādārdhadhātukasyeṭo na bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ|| 9. titutratathasisusarakaseṣu ca| (7.1.9) avaśādyartho'yamārambhaḥ| `tantiḥ' iti| `nanu vistāre' pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌ tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktamityauṇādikataśabdasya hpabaṇamiṣyate, na tu ktasya| tena hasitamityatreḍāgamo bhavatyeva| `kuṣṭham‌' iti| `kuva niṣkaṣe' (dhā.pā.1518)| `kāṣṭham‌' `ikṣuḥ' iti| `iṣu icchāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1351)[`iṣa'--dhā.pā.] pūrvavatkatvaṣatve| `akṣaram‌' iti| `aśū vvāptau' (dhā.pā.1264) [vyāptau saṃghāte ca--dhā.pā.] vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, pūrvavatkatvam‌| `śalkam‌' iti `śala gatau' (dhā.pā.843)| `vatsaḥ' iti| `bada vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.1009), cartvam‌--takāraḥ| `titutratheṣvagrahādīnāṃ vaktavyam‌' iti| `titutratha' (7.2.9) `striyāṃ ktin‌' (3.3.94), `graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ' (7.2.37) iti dīrghaḥ, grahyādīnā sūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasaraṇam‌| `upasnihitiḥ' iti| `ṣṇiha prītau' (dhā.pā.1200)| `nikucitiḥ' iti| `kuca saṅkoce' teṣvati na bhavitavyam‌? prapañcāpartha teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ veditavyam‌|| 10. ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt‌| (7.2.10) `anudāttāt‌' iti| bahuvrīhirayam‌--nāsyodātto'stītyanudāttaḥ| anvarthaśabdo'yamanudāttaśabdaḥ| śāstrīye hyanudātte gṛhyamāṇa ekavarṇā eva dhātavo gṛhyeran‌| tathā cānyevāṃ dhātūnāmanudāttapratijñānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| iha cekājgrahamamupadeśaviśeṣaṇam‌| `upadeśe' iti| prakṛtipāṭha ityarthaḥ| `anudāttaśca' iti| upadeśa ityapekṣate; tenopadeśagrahaṇamubhayaviśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| tasya prayojanaṃ pratyudāharaṇeṣvāviṣkariṣyati| `ye tathā gaṇe paṭhyante' iti| etena gaṇapāṭhādeva te veditavyā iti darśayati| `ta eva' ityādinā dvitīyaṃ parijñānahetumāha| kāḥ punastā aniṭ‌kārikāḥ? ityāha--`aniṭsvarāntaḥ' ityādi| yāvātan kaścit‌ svarānto'janto dhātuḥ sa sarvo'niṅbhavatotyetadadṛśyatām‌, avagamyatām‌| aniḍiti bahuvrīhiḥ--nāsmādiḍastīti| `aniṭ‌ svarāntaḥ' ityasyotsargasyāpavādamāha--`imāṃstu' ityādi| imāṃstvadantādīn‌ vakṣyamāṇān‌ seṭaḥ pravadanti| iṭā saha varttanta iti seṭaḥ| ke vadanti? tadvidaḥ seḍaniḍvida ityarthaḥ| `adantam‌' iti bahuvrīhiḥ--akārastaparo'nto yasaya sa tathoktaḥ| taparakaraṇaṃ dīrghanivṛttyartham‌| `ṝdantam‌' iti| ayamapi bahuvrīhiḥ| taparakaraṇamasandehārtham‌| rantamityucyamāne, kimayaṃ rephasya nirdeśaḥ? utta ṝkārasya? iti sandeha--syāt‌| `ṝtāṃ ca' iti| ṝtāmiti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| ṛkārāntānāṃ madhye vṛṅavṛño seṭau pravadanti| taparakaraṇaṃ pādaparaṇārtham‌| pūrvamṛkārāntagrahaṇāgena hi hrasvasya grahaṇamihāvasīyate| `śviḍīṅivarṇeṣu' iti| nirghāraṇe saptamī| ivarṇānteṣu, madhye śviḍīṅau seṭau pravadanta| `ṭu ośvi gativṛddhyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1010), `ḍīṅ‌ vihāyasāgatau' (dhā.pā.968)| `atha śīṅśriñāvapi' iti| `athetyānantarye| anayoḥ pūrvaktayoranantaraṃ śīṅśriñāvapi seṭau pravadanti| `ghīṅ‌ svapne' (dhā.pā.1032), avabodhane' (dhā.pā.1471) ityetasya tānādikasya| `dihiḥ' ityādi| `diha upacaye' (dhā.pā.1015), `duha prapūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1014), `miha secane' (dhā.pā.992) `ruha janmani prādurbhāve' (dā.pā.859), `vaha "natadasti; evaṃ hyekājgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tathā hi--jāgṛdaradrācakātprabhṛtīnāmudāttatvāt‌ naikājgrahaṇaṃ te prayojayanti| sanādyantānāṃ dhātūnāmupadeśatvaṃ nāsti; lākṣaṇikatvātsamudāyasaya| na
