`glājisthaśca ksnu ityatra' ityādi| gittve hi sati ksnoraṭpratiṣedhārthamevaṃ vyākhyāyate, na ca tasya gittvam‌| kiṃ tarhi? kittvameva| na ca kittve satīttvaṃ prasajyate, yasmāt‌ `glājisthaśca ksnuḥ' (3.2.139) ityatra sthā-ā ityakārapraśleṣaḥ kṛtaḥ| tiṣṭhateḥ ksnupratyayāntasyākārāntasyākārāntataiva yathā syātad‌, īkārāntatā mā bhūdityevamarthaḥ| ākārāpraśleṣe hi satīttvāpavādastiṣṭhaterākārādeśo bhavati, atastena bādhitvādīttvaṃ na pravarttate| tadevaṃ kittve satyakarapraśleṣāt‌ sthāsnuśabdasya siddhatvāt‌ na kiñcidetat‌| etadvyāsyānamasāramityarthaḥ| `tīrṇam‌' ityatrāpi kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamasatyupadeśagrahaṇe'tri na syāt‌, yāvatā taratirayamugantaḥ paṭhyate? ityāha--`ittve hi' ityādi| `ṛt‌ iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttve ca kṛta ugantatā vihatetyasatyupadeśagrahaṇe na syāt‌, tasmiṃstu sati bhavati| yadyapyuttarakālaṃ taratiruganto na bhavati, tathāpyupadeśa eva| `mā bhūdevam‌' ityādi| codakaḥ| `kasya punaḥ' ityādotaraḥ| `ṝtaḥ'[`kṛtaḥ' iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti codakaḥ| `yadyevam‌' ityādītaraḥ| `sthānivadbhāvāt‌' iti| alvidhitvaṃ punarugiti pratyāhāragrahaṇāt‌| `tasmāt‌' iti| āha--yasmādedamasatyupadeśagrahaṇe tīrṇa ityatra pratiṣedho na prāpnoti, tasmādupadeśa ityanuvarttanīyam‌| `tathā ca sati' ityādi| upadeśe'nuvarttamāne satītyarthaḥ| `jāgarita ityatrāpi prāpnoti' iti| jāgartterupadeśāvasthāyāmugantatvāt‌| `tadartham‌' iti| jāgarita ityādāviṭpratiṣedhaprāptinivṛttyartham‌; arthaśabdasya nivṛttivācitvāt‌| yadi tarhi `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityanuvarttate, prorṇutaḥ, prorṇutavanityatreṭpratiṣedho na prāpnoti; ūraṇoteranekāṇtvāt‌? ityata āha--`vācya ūrṇorṇuvat‌' ityādi| asyāḥ kārikāyāḥ pūrvamevārtho vyākhyāta iti na punarvyākhyāyate|| 12. sani grahaguhośca| (7.2.12) graheḥ sani cityamiṭi prāpte guherapyūdittvāt‌ `svarati' (7.2.44) ityādisūtreṇa vikalpe prāpte'syārambhaḥ| cakāraḥ `ukaḥ' (7.2.11) ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| nanu ca `iko jhal‌' (1.2.9) ityugantānāṃ kideva san‌ tatra pūrveṇaiva pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ kimuka ityanukarṣaṇārthena cakāreṇa? naitadasti; na hīṭpratiṣedhamantareṇa sano jhalāditvamupapadyate, kutaḥ kittvam‌! anena tviṭi pratiṣiddhe jhalāditvaṃ sano jāyate, paścādguṇapratiṣedhārthaṃ kittvamiti kramaḥ| `jighṛśrati' iti| `rudavida' (1.2.8) ityādinā sanaḥ kittve sati grahyādi (6.1.16) sūtreṇa samprasāraṇam‌, `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam‌, `iṇkoḥ' (8.2.57) iti ṣatvam‌, `ekāco vaśo bhaṣ‌' (8.2.37) ityādinā bhaṣbhāvena gakārasya ghakāraḥ, dvirvacanam‌, abhyāsakāryam‌| `judhukṣati' iti| `rudavida' (1.2.8) ityādinā sanaḥ kittve sati grahyādi (6.1.16) sūtreṇa samprasaraṇam‌, `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam‌, dvirvacanam‌, abhyāsakāryam‌| `jughukṣate' [`judhukṣati'--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `guhū saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.896), `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam‌| `rurūṣati' iti| `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ| atha cakāreṇa yathegantamanukṛṣyate, tathā caikayoganirdiṣṭaḥ śrayatirapyanukṛṣyeta? ityata āha--`śrisvṛyūrṇurabhajñapi' ityādi| śrayateḥ `sanīdantargha' (7.2.49) itīṭo vikalpaṃ vidhāsyatītyatastasyehānuvattirapārthiketi nānukṛṣyate| 13. kṛsṛbhṛvṛstudrusruśruvapo liṭi| (7.2.13) `sakṛva, cakṛma' iti| `parasmaipadānām‌' (3.4.82) ityādinā vasmasorvamādeśau| `krādaya eva' iti| niyamasya svarūpaṃ darśayati| `liṭyeva krādayo'niṭaḥ' ityeṣa tu viparītaniyamo nāśaṅkanīyaḥ; `kṛtalabdhakrītakuśalāḥ' (4.3.38) iti `tamadhiṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhāvī vā' (5.1.80) ityādinirdeśāt‌| kena punasteṣāmiṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, yataḥ siddhe satyārambho niyamārtha ucyate? ityata āha--`anudāttopadeśānām‌' ityādi| anudāttopadeśā vṛṅvṛñbhyāmanye karotyādayaḥ, teṣāmeva `acaḥ' (7.2.10) ityādinā prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ| vṛṅvṛñostu `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) iti pratyayāśrayaḥ, na tu prakṛtyāśrayaḥ; tayorudāttatvāt‌| `tat‌' ityādi| yata eva teṣāṃ yathāyogaṃ prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratyayāśrayaśca pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, tasmādubhayasyāpi pratiṣedhasya prayuktasyāyaṃ niyama ityarthaḥ| dhātvantarebhyo vyavacchidya karotyādīnāṃ pratiṣedhastheha niyamo veditavyaḥ| `kathaṃ punaretadvṛñaṃ prati thali niyamārthamupapadyate? sati hi pratiṣedhe niyamo bhavati| vṛñasthalīṭ‌pratiṣadhaḥ| tasya hi nātra prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ; udāttatvāt‌| nāpi pratyayāśrayaḥ; thalaḥ kittvābhāvāt‌| tasmāt‌ vṛñaṃ prati thalīṭpratiṣedhārthataiva yuktā, na niyamārthatā? ityata āha--`vṛño hi' ityādi| vyavasthā-niyamaḥ| `babhūthātatanthajagṛmbhavavartheti nigame' (7.2.64) iti nipātanāṭvṛño nigama eva thalīṭpratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌, na bhāṣāyām‌| yata evaṃ vyavasthā tasmānnāyaṃ vṛñasthalīṭpratiṣedhaḥ; anyathā vavartheti nipātanasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ pratiṣedhābhāvāt‌ vṛño'pyetat‌ sūtraṃ niyamārthameva vijñāyata ityekānta eṣaḥ| `studrusruśruvāṃ tu' ityādi| apiśabdaḥ ārdhadhātukalakṣaṇo'pi ya iṭ‌ prāpnoti so'pi neṣyata iti darśanārthaḥ| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pi labhyate, purastāt‌, pratiṣedhakāṇḍasya balīyastvāt‌| iha ca `na vṛdbhyāścaturbhyaḥ' (7.2.59) ityasyānantaramidaṃ pratiṣedhakāṇḍaṃ karttuṃ yuktam‌| evaṃ dviṣpratiṣedhāśrayaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ syāt‌| yadayaṃ purastāt‌ pratiṣedhaṃ karoti, tasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--iṣmātrasyānāśritaviśeṣavidhānasya pratiṣedho vijñāyate, purastāt‌ pratiṣedhe kriyamāṇe sati viśeṣamanāśrityeṇmātrasyāyamapavādo bhavati| tena yāvāniṭ‌ prāptastasya sarvasya pratiṣedho bhavati siddhaḥ| anyastvāha--`neṭi' (7.2.4) ityanuvarttamāne punariṅgrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌, punaḥ pratiṣedhasāmarthyācca iṇmānnasya pratiṣedho vijñāyate| `kuño'suṭkasyeti vaktavyam‌' iti| karoteravidyamānasuṭaḥ ṣatiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| kimartham‌? sasuṭkasyeḍāgamo yathā syāt‌| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`dvandve ghi' (2.2.32) ityanena stuprabhṛtīnāmanyatamasya ghisaṃjñakasya pūrvanipātamakṛtvaitat‌ sūcitam‌--yateha pūrvanipātalakṣaṇaṃ vyabhicarati svaviṣaye na pravarttate, tathedamapīti| tena yadā karotiḥ sasuṭkaḥ, tatra na pravarttata iti| `sañcaskariva, sañcaskarima' iti| `samparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe' (6.1.137) iti suḍityanuvarttamāne `aḍabyāsavyavāye'pi' (6.1.136) iti suṭ kriyate| `ṛto bhāradvājasya (7.2.63) ityetadapyasuyaṭkasyaiveṣyate' iti| `kṛñaḥ' iti sambadhyate| kathaṃ punarasuṭkasyaiva bhavatīti labhyate? yathā labhyate tacca śrūyatām‌--tatra hi `udito vā' (7.2.56) ityato vetyanuvarttate maṇḍūkalputinyāyena, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tenāsuṭkasyaiva bhavatīti|| 14. śvīdito niṣṭhāyām‌| (7.2.14) `śūnaḥ' iti| vacyādi (6.1.15) sūtreṇa samprasāraṇam‌, `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghaḥ| `lagnaḥ' iti| natvasyāsiddhatvāt‌ `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌| `uḍḍīnaḥ' iti| `ṅiṅ‌ vihāyasā gatau' (dhā.pā.1135)| `nanu ṅīṅa udāttatvānniṣṭhāyāmiṭ prāpnoti, tasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ; hi uḍḍayita ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāditi yo manyeta, taṃ pratyāha--`ṅīṅaḥ' ityādi| `oditām‌' iti| svādīnāmityarthaḥ| `svādaya oditaḥ' iti vacanāta| svādayaḥ `ṣūṅ‌ prāṇigarbhavimocane' (dhā.pā.1031) ityādayaḥ| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakaḥ? ityāha--`sa hi' ityādi| svadīnāṃ hyoditāṃ madhye tasyaivamarthaḥ pāṭhaḥ--niṣṭhātakārasyaudita uttarasya natvaṃ yathā syāt‌| syādetat‌--iṭyapi kṛte natvaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`natavaṃ ca' ityādi| `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityatra nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthasyānuvṛtterodito dhātoranantarasya niṣṭhātakārasya natvaṃ vidhīyate| tatra yadi ṅīṅa parasyā niṣṭhāyā iṭ‌ syāt‌, tadā satyapyodittve iṭā vyavahitatvānnatvena na bhavitavyam‌| nityoditāṃ madhye tasya pāṭho'narthakatvānna kṛtaḥ syāt‌, sa cāsti; tasmāt‌ sa eva pāṭho jñāpakaḥ? naitadasti; evaṃ hyānantaryaparibhāṣā bādhitā bhavati, śāstraṃ cāniṣṭaṃ syāt‌, etaccāyuktam‌; na hyaniṣṭārthā śāstre praklṛpti(bho pa.sū.107) rasti| tasmādyathānantaryaparibhāṣā na bādhyate śāstrañca nāniṣṭaṃ bhavati, oditāṃ madhye ṅīṅa pāṭhaśca saphalo bhavati--sa prakaro'bhyupagantavyaḥ| tataścauditāṃ madhye ṅīṅaḥ pāṭo jñāpaka eva| aparaḥ prakāraḥ--`oditaśca' (8.2.45) ityatraudita ityetad‌dvirāvarttayiṣyate `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā dvirupasthānārtham‌, tatrāsyā yad‌dvitauyamupasthānaṃ tasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--ṅīṅo'pyanantarasyaiva niṣṭhātakārasya natvaṃ yathā syāditi| yadi ca ṅīṅo niṣṭhāyāmiṭ‌ syāt‌ iṭā vyavahitatvānnatvaṃ na syāt‌| na ca śakyate vaktum‌--vyavadhāne'pi pāṭhasāmarthyādbhaviṣyatīti| evaṃ hi paribhāṣāyā dvirupasthānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌ etaccāyuktam‌; tasmādoditāṃ madhye ṅīṅaḥ pāṭho jñāpaka eva| śvigrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum‌, oditkaraṇādeva niṣṭhāyāmiṇna bhaviṣyati, odittvaṃ hi natvārthaṃ kriyate, natvaṃ ca niṣṭhāto'nantarasya vidhīyate; yadi ca tataḥ parasyā niṣṭhāyā iṭ‌ syāt‌ odittvamanarthakaṃ syāt‌? vaicitryārthaṃ śvigrahaṇaṃ veditavyam‌|| 15. yasya vibhāṣā| (7.2.15) `vidhūtaḥ' iti| `dhūñ‌ kampane' (dhā.pā.1836) `gūḍhaḥ' iti| `gūhū saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.986)| ḍhatvādiṣu kṛteṣu `ḍhralope' (6.3.111) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| ateha kasmāt‌ pratiṣedho na bhavati--patita--patita iti, bhavati hi patirvibhāṣiteṭ‌ `sanīvantargha' (7.2.49) ityatra `tanipatidaradrāṇāmupasaṃkhyānam‌' iti vikaplenopasaṃkhyānāt‌? ityata āha--`dvitīyāśrita' ityādi|| 16. āditaśca| (7.2.16) bhāvādikarmaṇoranantaraṃ vibhāṣāṃ vakṣyati, tato'nyatra karttari karmaṇi cāyaṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate| `āśvastaḥ' ita| `śvāsa prāṇane' (dhā.pā.1069) | `vāntaḥ' iti| `ṭu vama adgiraṇe' (dhā.pā.849)| `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) iti dīrghaḥ| `yogavibhāgakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌' iti| pṛṣṭasya `āditaśca vibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ' iti| yadyekayogaḥ kriyate, tato bhāvādikarmabhyāmanyatra pratiṣedho na syāditi prativacanamātraṅkyāha--`āditaśca' ityādi| `āditaśca vibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ' ityekayoge bhāvādakarmaṇorvibhāṣāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ tato'nyatra kartrādau `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, tasmādapārthaka yogavibhāgakaraṇam‌| `jñāpanārtham‌' ityādinā'pārthakatvaṃ pariharati| `yadupādhervibhāṣā tadupādheḥ' iti| ubhayatrāpi bahuvrīhiḥ| upādhiḥ-viśeṣaṇam‌| sa caitadarthaṃ upādhirvirjñeyaḥ| yadi yadupādhārvibhāṣā tadasyopādherapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, tadā yogavibhāgāṃ na kuryāt‌| ekayogenāpi bhāvādikarmaṇorvihite vikalpe tato'nyatra `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) iti pratiṣedho labhyata eva, kṛtaśca yogavibhāgaḥ, tasmādetena yogavibhāgakaraṇena sūcitam‌--yadupādhervibhāṣā tadupādherniṣedha iti| `tena' ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| atra viderlābhārthasya vibhāṣeti viśinā taudādikena sāhacarcāllābhārthasya taudādīkasya grahaṇam‌| `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) iti ca tasyaiva pratiṣedho bhavati, nānyasya| yadi yadupādhervibhāṣā tadupādherniṣedha iti jñāpyate, `jṛvraścoḥ ktviḥ' (7.2.55), `udito vā' (7.2.56) iti ktvāpratyaye bhāvaviṣaye vibhāṣite `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) iti bhāvaviṣaya eva niṣṭhāyāmiṭpratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, na karttṛkarmaṇoḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; āśrīyamāṇo hi dharmo bhedako bhavati| na ca ktvāpratyaye niṣṭhāyāṃ vā bhinnamabhidheyaṃ nimittatvenāśritam‌| tasmādbhavatyevātra pratiṣedhaḥ| atra liṅgam‌--`tena nirvṛttam‌' (4.2.68) iti nirddaśaḥ|| 17. vibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ| (7.2.17) `minnamanena' iti| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114)| `meditam‌' iti| `niṣṭhā śīṅa' (1.2.19) ityādinā kittvapratiṣedhe guṇaḥ| `praminnaḥ' iti| praśabda ādikarma dyotayati| `ādikarma' iti| ādibhūtakriyākṣaṇa iti| tasmin‌ bhūtatvena vivakṣite yaḥ ktaḥ sa punaḥ `ādikarmaṇi ktaḥ karttari ca' (3.4.71) ityanena karttari kārake bhavati| śakto ghaṭaḥ karttum‌, śakiko ghaṭaḥ karttumityasya siddhaye vibhāveti yogavibhāgo'tra karttavyaḥ| tatra `āditaḥ' (7.2.16) iti nānuvarattanīyam‌| `bhāvādikarmaṇoḥ' ityatra dvitīye yoge'nuvarttamīyameva|| 18. kṣubdhasvāntadhvāntalagnamliṣṭaviribdhaphāṇṭabāḍhāni manthamanastamaḥ saktāvispaṣṭasvarānāyāsabhṛśeṣu| (7.2.18) `kṣubdhaḥ' iti| `kṣubha sañcalane' (dhā.pā.1239) ityasyeḍabhāvo nipātyate| `manthābhidhānaṃ cet‌' iti| samudāyena cenmantho'bhidhīyate| mantha iti dravadravyasampṛktāḥ saktava ucyante| `kṣugdho manthaḥ' iti| calito mantha ityarthaḥ| `kṣubhitaṃ mantena' iti| nātra mantho'bhīdhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? tatsādhanaṃ calanam‌| atha manthābhidhāne kṣubdhaśabdo nipātyate, kṣubdhā girinaṭī, kṣubdhā senā, kṣubdhaḥ samudraḥ--ityādi| nopapadyate? ityata āha--`kṣubdhā girinadī' ittayādi| calitamanthasādharmyād‌girinadyādiṣu tathā vyavapeśa iti darśayati| yathā kṣubdhatvaṃ manthasya calanaṃ prati sādhanabhāvaḥ, tathā girinadyāderarthasya calanaṃ prati sādhanabhāvaḥ kṣubdhamanthasādharmyāt‌ kṣubdhaśabdena vyapadiśyate, yathā gosādharmyādgośabdena vāhīka ucyate| `svāntam‌, dhvāntam' iti| `svana dhvana śabde' (dhā.pā.827,828)| iḍabhāvo nipātyate| evamuttareṣvapyudāharaṇeṣu veditavyam‌| bāhyeṣu viṣayeṣvavikṣiptamanākulaṃ manaḥ-svaḥntamucyate| `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) iti dīrghaḥ| `svanitaṃ manasā' iti| manaḥ karttṛkaṃ svananamucyate, na tu manaḥ| `dhvanitaṃ tamasā' iti| atrāpi tamaḥkarttṛkaṃ dhvananamucyate, na tamaḥ| `lagnaḥ' iti| `rage lage saṅge' (dhā.pā.785,786)[`rage śaṅkāyām‌'--dhā.pā.] niṣṭhānatvaṃ nipātyate| `svaraścet‌' iti| svaraśapabdo'tra dhvanau varttate| `phāṣṭam‌' iti| `phaṇa gatau' (dhā.pā.821)| pūrvavaddīrghaḥ ṣṭutvañca| kaḥ punarayamanāyāso nāma? ityāha--`yadaśrṛtam‌' ityādi| aśrṛtamityapakvam‌| apiṣṭamityacūrṇitam‌| udakasamparkaḥ udakasaṃyogaḥ| mātraśabdena niṣpīḍanādervyavacchedaḥ| `vibhaktarasam‌' iti| pṛthagbhūtarasamityarthaḥ| īṣaduṣṇaṃ koṣṇam‌| `tadalpaprayatnasādhyatvādanāyāsena lakṣyate' iti| āyāsaḥ prayatnādhikyam‌, tadyasminna vidyate so'lpaprayatnāsādhyo'nāyāsaḥ| teneha yadaśṛtatvādiviśiṣṭaṃ vastu tadalpaprayatnāsādhyatvādanāyāsena lakṣyate| tadanenānāyāsopalakṣato yo vastuviśeṣastatra phāṣṭamiti nipātyate, na tvanāyāsa eva| nānyatrāpi sarvatrānāyasopalakṣita iti darśayati| ayaṃ cārtho nipātanasāmarthyāllabhyate| yathaiva hyanyat‌ kiñcidiḍabhāvādikaṃ nipatanasāmarthyāllabhyate tathā'rthaviśeṣe'pi| `bāḍham‌' iti| atra pūrvadad‌ ḍhatvādikāryam‌|| 19. ghṛṣiśasī veyātye| (7.2.19) `viyātasya bhāvo vaiyātyam‌' iti| yātam‌-yātiḥ, prāptiḥ virūpaṃ yātaṃ yasyāsanmārgaviṣayatvāt‌ sa viyātaḥ-avinīta ityucyate; tadbhāvo vaiyātyam‌| brāhmaṇāditvāt‌ (5.1.124) ṣyañ‌| `ṣuṣṭaḥ' iti| `ñi dhṛṣā pragalbhye' (dhā.pā.1269)| `viśtaḥ' iti| `śasu hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.727), śaserapi `udato vā' (7.2.56) iti vikalpavidhānāt‌ `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddha eveti sambadhyate| yadi tarhi siddha eva pratiṣedhaḥ tat‌ kimarthaṃ vacanam‌? ityāha--`niyamārtham‌' ityādi| vaiyātya eva varttamānoryathā syāt‌, anyatra mā bhūt‌| atha dhṛṣeḥ `vibhāṣā bhādivādikarmaṇoḥ' (7.2.17) iti vikalpe prāpte nityārtha vacanamiti kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`bhāvādikarṇaṇorapa , ityādi| atra cābhitrānaśaktisvābhāvyaṃ hetaḥ| `dhārṣitaḥ' iti| `dharṣitaḥ iti| pūrvavat‌ kittve pratiṣidde gūṇaḥ|| 20. dṛḍhaḥ sthūlabalayoḥ| (7.2.20) `balavati' iti matubantanirddaśenārśaāditvāt‌ sūtre matvarthīyākārānto balaśabdo nirddiṣṭa iti darśayati| `dṛṃheḥ' iti| `dṛhi vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.834) ityasya| `atha vā-- dṛhiḥ prakṛtyantaramasti' iti| `dṛha dṛhi dṛddhau' (dhā.pā.733,734), iti kaiścit‌ pāṭhāt‌| `nakārasyābhāvāt‌' iti| nakārasyopadeśābhāvādanidittvācca nakārasyopadeśābhāvādanidittvācca nakārasyābhāvāditi| atha hakāralopaḥ kimarthaṃ nipātyate? nāḍhakāra eva nipātyatām‌, parasya ca dhatve ṣṭutve kṛte, ḍho ḍhe lope ca kṛte siddhaṃ dṛḍha iti| atrāpyayamarthaḥ--parasya ḍhatvaṃ nipātayitavyaṃ na bhavati, ṣṭunaiva siddhatvāt‌? ityata āha--`halopanipātanam‌' ityādi| yadi hakārasya ḍhakāro nipātyate tadā `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13), tasya `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) ityasiddhatvaṃ syāt‌, siddhaścāsāviṣyate| tasmāt‌ pūrvatrāsiddhatvanivṛttaye halopo nipātyate, na ḍhakāra iti| kaḥ punarasiddhatve doṣo yatparihārāya pūrvatrāsiddhatvanivṛttyarthaṃ hakāralopo nipātyate, na ḍhakāraḥ? ityata āha--`ḍhalope' ityādi| yadi hi ḍhakāro nipātyate, tadā `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13) karttavyaḥ, tasmiṃstu sati lope draḍhimetyādau `ra ṛto halāderlaghoḥ' (6.4.161) iti ropho na syāt‌; ḍhalopasyāsiddhatve `saṃyoge guru' (1.4.11) iti gurusaṃjñāyāmupajātāyāṃ laghusaṃjñāyā bādhitatvāt‌| `draḍhimā' iti| `varṇadḍhādibhyaḥ ṣyañca' (5.1.123) itīmanic‌, `turiṣṭheyāḥsu' (6.4.154) iti ṭilopaḥ| `draḍhīyān‌' iti| `dvivacanavibhajyopaparade tarabīyasunau' (5.3.57) itīyasunpratyayaḥ| `draḍhayati' iti| draḍhamācaṣṭa iti `tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe' (dhā.pā.ga.sū.187) iti ṇic‌, `ṇāviṣṭhavat‌ kāryaṃ prātipadikasya' (dā.813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvena rephaṭilopau| `paridraḍhayya gataḥ' iti| dṛḍhamācaṣṭe iti ṇic‌| rabhāve kṛte ṇyantasya pariṇā yogaḥ, tataḥ ktvā, prādisamāsaḥ, `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap‌' (7.1.37) iti lyap‌| `pāridraḍhī kanyā' iti| paridraḍhaśabdādiñ‌, `ito manuṣyajāteḥ' (4.1.65) iti ṅīṣ‌| `ṣyaṅ‌ prasajyeta' iti| `aṇiñoranārṣayorgurūpottamayoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādinā| `dṛṃhitam‌' iti| dṛṃheḥ pratyudāharaṇam‌| `dṛhitam‌' iti dṛheḥ|| 21. prabhau parivṛḍhaḥ| (7.2.21) `pūrveṇa samānam‌' iti| nipātanasyeḍabhāvādestulyatvāt‌| yathaiva hi pūrvasmin‌ sūtre ktapratyaye kṛte hakāranakārasyorlopa iḍabhāvaśca parasya ḍhatvaṃ nipātitam‌, tathehāpi tatsarva nipātyate| `vṛṃhernipātanam‌' iti| `vṛhi vṛddhau' [`bṛhi'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.736) ityasya| `vṛhiśca yadi prakṛtyantaramasti tatastasyāpi' iti| nipātanametaditi kṛtena sambandhaḥ| prakṛtyantarāstitvaṃ tu `vṛha vṛddhau'[`bṛha'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.735) iti kaiściduktam‌| `tadeva prayojanam‌' iti| pūrvatrāsiddhatvanivṛttiḥ| `parivrajhayati' iti| atra ḍhalope sati pūrvavadrepho na syāt‌| `parivraḍhayya gataḥ' iti| halopanipātane tu bhavantyete doṣāḥ| `parivraḍhamācaṣṭe' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ parivṛḍhaśabdena vigrahe kṛte ṇico vṛ śabdādevotpatatirlabhyate? ityāha--`saṃgrāmayateḥ' ityādi| `prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca' (dhā.pā.ga.sū.186) ityanenaiva ṇici siddhe `saṃgrāme' ityasya sopasargasya gaṇe yaḥ pāṭhaḥ sa niyamārthaḥ--saṃgrāmayatereva sopasargāṇṇijutpattiryathā syāt‌, anyatra mā bhūditi| tadevaṃ saṃgrāmayatereva yasmāt‌ sopasargāṇṇijutpattiriṣyate, nānyasmāt‌| tasmād‌ yadyapi `parivṛḍhamācaṣṭe' iti vigrahaḥ kriyate, tathāpi vṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijutpattau satyāṃ lakāro bhavannayaṃ ṇij‌ yato vihitastadādereva bhavati pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā; `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (3.1.32) iti tadādereva dhātusaṃjñāvidhānāt‌| tena parestiṅantagrahaṇenāgrahaṇāt‌ tato'taṅantāt‌ padāt‌ parasya tiṅantasya padasya parivraḍhayatītyatra `tiṅṅatiṅaḥ' (8.1.28) iti nighātasvaraḥ siddho bhavati| yadi punaḥ parivṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijatpadyate tadā lakāro'pi nighāto na syāt‌| kiñca--yadā vṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijutpadyate na parivṛḍhaśabdāt‌, tadā ktvāpratyayo'pi vṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijantādbhavati| tena pariśabdasya ktāntena samrathena śabdāntareṇa `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāse kṛte parivraḍhayyetyatra lyabādeśaḥ siddho bhavati| parivṛḍhaśabdāṇṇijutpattau ktvāpratyayo'pi parivṛḍhaśabdādeva ṇijantādutpadyate, tataḥ samāso na syāt‌; kugatiprādayaḥ samarthena śabdāntareṇa samasyante, na cātra pareḥ paraṃ ktāntaṃ śabdāntaramasti| ekameva hīdaṃ ktāntaṃ pariṇā saha śabdarūpam‌; tatraiva pariśabdasyāntarbhāvāt‌| asati ca samāse `samāse'nañpūrve' (7.3.17) ityādinā lyabādeśo na syāt‌| `parivṛṃhitam‌' iti| vṛṃheḥ pratyudāharaṇam‌| `parivṛhitam‌' iti| vṛheḥ|| 22. kṛcchragahanayoḥ kaṣaḥ| (7.2.22) `kaṣṭaḥ' iti| kaṣiśiṣītyādihiṃsārthadhātuvarge kaṣiḥ paṭhyate| kiṃ punaḥ kṛcchraṃ nāma? ityāha--`kṛcchraṃ duḥkham‌' iti| yadyevam‌, duḥkhe prāṇidharme pratiṣedha ucyamāno'gnyādau na sidhyate? ityāha--`tatkāraṇamapyagnyādikaṃ kṛcchramucyate' iti| kāraṇe kāryopacārāt‌, yathā--naṅvalodakaṃ pādaroga iti| cintyaṃ punaretat‌ kiṃ mukhye sati gauṇasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌? uta neti? yadi tu kṛcchraśabdāṇṇijantāt‌ pacādyacamutvādya kṛcchrayatīti kṛcchra ityevaṃ vyutpādyate, tadā kṛcchraśabdo'pi mukhye'ganyādāvapīti na kiñciccintyam‌; na cāsyāṃ vyutpattau tatkāraṇamapyaganyādikaṃ kṛcchramityucyata ityetadvirudhyate| yaddhi kṛcchrayati tanniyogata eva duḥkhasya kāraṇaṃ bhavati|| 23. ghuṣiraviśabdane| (7.2.23) `viśabdanaṃ pratijñānam‌' iti| svābhiprāyasya śabdenāviṣkaraṇamityarthaḥ| `sāmānyena grahaṇam‌' iti| viśeṣānupādānāt‌| yadi `ghuṣiraviśabdene' (dhā.pā.1726) [`ghuṣir‌ viśabdene--dhā.pā.]iti curādau paṭhyate evaṃ sati ṇicā bhavitavyam‌, na ca ṇijantasyeṭi satyasati vā kaścidviśeṣo'sti| tathā hi--iṭi sati `niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi' (6.4.52) iti ṇilope kṛte ghoṣitamiti yadrūpaṃ bhavatyasatyapīṭi ṇilopābhāvāt‌ tadeva| na ca tadantāviṭpratiṣedhasya praptirasti; `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityadhikārāt‌| bhauvādikasya (dhā.pā.653) [`ghuṣir‌ aviśbadena'--dhā.pā.] ghuṣerviśabdane vṛttireva nāsti; śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt‌; tatkiṃ viśabdanapratiṣedhena? ityata āha--`viśabdanapratiṣedhaḥ' ityādi| yadi ca nityo ṇic‌ syāt‌, tadā yathoktayā rītyā pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌, tataśca na karttavya eva syāt‌, kṛtaśca, tasmādayameva pratiṣedho jñāpayita--curādiṇijviśabdanārthasyānitya iti| `jughuṣuḥ' iti| anityapratijñāprayojanam‌| asati hyanityatve ghoṣayāñcakruriti syāt‌|| 24. ardeḥ sannivibhyaḥ| (7.2.24) `ardeḥ' iti| `arda gatau yācane ca' (dhā.pā.55)|| 25. abheścāvidūrye| (7.2.25) `0vidūraṃ viprakṛṣṭam‌' iti| viśeṣeṇātiśayena dūraṃ vidūramiti kṛtvā, tato'nyadavidūram‌| tat‌ punaryadāsannaṃ yaccādūraṃ na tvativiprakṛṣṭaṃ taditi veditavyam‌| `tasya bhāva ādidūryam‌' iti| brāhmaṇāditvāt‌ (5.1.124) ṣyañ‌| nanu ca `na nañpūrvāt‌ tatpuruṣāt‌' (5.1.121) ityuttarasya bhāvapratyayasya pratiṣiddhatvāt‌ ṣyañā na bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`etasmādeva' ityādi| uttaratvaṃ tu bhāvapratyayasya tvatalāpekṣayā veditavyam‌|| 26. ṇeradhyāyane vṛttam‌| (7.2.26) `adhyayanam‌' iti| `kṛtyalyuṭo bahūlam‌' (3.3.113) iti lyuṭ‌| adhīyata ityadhyayanam‌--karmasādhano'dhyayanaśabdaḥ| bhāvasādhane hi vṛtto guṇo devadatteneti na syāt‌, vṛttaṃ guṇasya devadatteneti syāt‌| niṣṭhāviśeṣaṇañcaitat‌| adhyetavyābhidhāyinyāṃ niṣṭhāyāmityarthaḥ| `ṇiluk‌ ca' iti| ṇilugnipātanaṃ pratyayalakṣaṇa pratiṣedhārtham‌| lope hi pratayayalakṣaṇena guṇaḥ syāt‌| luki sati `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratiṣedhādguṇo na syāt‌| `vṛtto guṇaḥ' iti| guṇaḥ kaścidevādhyayanaviśeṣa ihocyate| `vṛttirayamakarmakaḥ' iti| dṛtaṃ guṇasya, vṛttaṃ pārāyaṇasyeti bhāve niṣṭhādarśanāt‌| akarmakāṇāṃ hi bhāve niṣṭhā bhavati, na sakarmakāṇām‌| `sa ṇyarthe' ityādi| so'ntarbhāvitaṇyartho yadā bhavati tadā prakṛtyanto ṇyarthe varttamānaḥ sakarmako bhavati, yathā--varddhantu tvāṃ suṣṭutaya ityatra vṛdhiḥ| kathametadvijñāyate? ityāha--`tena nirvṛttam‌' ityādi| na caitadvaktavyam‌--akarmakā iti| `dhātavaḥ sopasargāḥ sakarmakā bhavanti' iti sopasargatvādiha vṛtteḥ sakarmakatvam‌| na tu ṇyarthavṛttitvāditi kṛto ṇyarthāvagatiḥ? yadi sopasargātvādiha vṛtteḥ sakarmakatvaṃ syānna ṇyarthavṛttitvāt‌, tato yathānubhūtaḥ kmabalo devadattadenetyatra ṇyartho na gamyate, tathā tena nirvṛttaḥ ityatrāpi na gamyeta; gamyate ca, tasmāṇṇayarthavṛttitvādeva vṛtteḥ sakarmakatvam‌| yadā ca ṇyarthavṛttarbhavati tadā prayojakavyāpārāpekṣayā'sya karttā karmabhāvabhāpadyata iti| tena prayojyena karmaṇā sakarmako bhavati| `tadvadihāpi' ityādi| yasmādevākarmako'pi sa na prakṛtyanta eva ṇyarthe varttamānaḥ sakarmako bhavati tasmād‌vṛtto guṇo devadattenetyatrāpi ṇyarthavṛttereva karmaṇi ktapratyayo bhaviṣyati| tataśca nipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| vinā'pi tena siddhatvāt‌| kathamiti cet‌? vṛtteḥ kvāpratyaye `udito vā' (7.2.56) itīṅ‌vikalpe kṛte niṣṭhāyām‌, `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| yadyevam‌, kimarthaṃ tadityāha--`tat‌ kriyate' ityādi| kadāciṇṇyartho'ntarbhāvitaṇyarthatayā prakṛtyaivābhidhīyate, tatra yadi nipātanaṃ na kriyeta, tadādhyayane'pi varttitamiti syāt| tasmādetannivṛttyarthaṃ tadityeke pratipannaḥ| `apare tu' ityādi| anye tu vattito guṇa ityapīcchanti| ṇyantasyāṇyantasya ca--vṛtto guṇa iti| tanmatena nipātanaṃ na karttavyameva| kriyamāṇaṃ vaicitryārthaṃ veditavyam‌|| 27. vā dāntaśāntapūrṇadastaspaṣṭacchannajñaptāḥ| (7.2.27) `dāntaḥ, śāntaḥ' iti| `śamu damu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1201,1203)| hetumaṇṇic‌, ṇilugiṭpratiṣedhayoḥ kṛtayoḥ `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) iti dīrghaḥ| nanu ca ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvād‌vyavadhāne sati na prāpnoti? naitadasti; na hi nipātanena lope sati tasya paranimittatvavyapadeśo vidyate, tat‌ kutaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ! `na padānta' (1.1.58) ityādinā dīrghavidhau sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhācca| `damitaḥ, śamitaḥ' iti| `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvatvam‌| `pūrṇaḥ' iti| `pūrī āpyāyane' (dhā.pā.1803)| divādiścurādiśca| `dastaḥ' iti| `tasu utkṣepe' (dhā.pā.1212) [`upakṣaye'--dhā.pā.] `dasu ca' (dhā.pā.1213)| atropadhā hrasvatvamapi nipātyate| `spaṣṭaśchannaḥ' iti| `spaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ (dhā.pā.887), `chada apavāraṇe' (dhā.pā. 1935)| atrāpayupadhāhrasvatvamapi nipātyate| jñapta iti| `jñapa māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu' (dhā.pā.1624)[`jñānajñāpanamāraṇatoṣaṇaniśānaniśāmaneṣu--dhā.pā.] iti curādiḥ, `māraṇatoṣaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā micca' (dhā.pā.811) iti ghaṭādiśca, tato ṇic‌| `iṭpratiṣedho ṇilukca' iti| cakārāt‌ kvacidupadhāhrasvatvamapi nipātyate|| 28. ruṣyamatvarasaṃghuṣāsvanām‌| (7.2.28) `ruṣa roṣe' (dhā.pā.1670), `ama gatyādiṣu' (dhā.pā.465)| `ama roge' (dhā.pā.1720) ityetasya caurādikasya grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati; ekāca (7.2.10) ityadhikārāt‌| `ñi tvarā sambhrame' (dhā.pā.775) sampūrvaḥ| pūrvokto dhuṣiḥ| āṅpūrvaḥ pūrvokta eva svaniḥ| `āsvāntaḥ' iti| pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| `tūrṇaḥ' iti| `jvaratvarasravyavimavāmupadhāyāḥ' (6.4.20) ityūṭh‌| `sampūrva' ityādi| `ghuṣir‌ aviśabdene' (dhā.pā.653) ityasyāvakāśo'sampūrvatve satyaviśabdena--ghuṣṭā rajjuḥ, dhuṣṭau pādāviti| asya ca vacanasyāvakāśaḥ sampūrvatve sati viśabdane--saṃghuṣitaṃ vākyamāha, saṃghuṣṭaṃ vākyamāheti; sampūrvatve satyaviśabdana ubhayaprāptau paratvādanena viklapo bhavati--saṃghuṣṭau dantau, saṃghuṣitau dantāviti| `āṅpūrvasya' ityādi| `kṣubdhasvānta' (7.2.18) iti svanariṭpratiṣedhasyāvakāśaḥ| anāṅapūrvatve sati mano'bhidhāne svāntaṃ mana ityasyāvakāśaḥ, āṅpūrvatve satayamano'bhidhānam‌| `āsvanto devadattaḥ, āsvanito devadattaḥ' iti| āṅpūrvatve sati mano'bhidhāne svāntaṃ mana ityasyāvakāśaḥ, āṅpūrvatve satyamano'bhidhānam‌| `āsvanto devadattaḥ, āsvanito devadattaḥ' iti| āṅpūrvatve sati mona'bhidhāne paratvādayameva vikalapo bhavati--āsvāntaṃ manaḥ, āsvanitaṃ manaḥ|| 29. hṛṣerlomasu| (7.2.29) `hṛṣṭāni lomāni' iti| gatyarthāmakarmakādinā (3.4.72) akarmakatvāt‌ karttari ktaḥ| `hṛṣṭaṃ lomabhiḥ' iti| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) iti ktaḥ| niṣṭhāyāmaniṭ‌' iti| `udito vā' (7.2.56) iti ktvāpratyaya iṭi vikalpite niṣṭhāyāṃ `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| `ayaṃ seṭ‌' iti| udāttatvādiṭpratiṣedhābhāvāt‌| `ubhayatravibhāṣeyam‌' iti| prāpte cāprāpte ca| ālīkyārthasya pratiṣedhe prāpte vikalpaḥ, tuṣṭyarthasya cāprāpte; lomaśabdasyāṅgajateṣveva rūḍhatvāt‌| lomasvityucyamāneṅgajeṣveva na keśeṣu bhavitavyamiti kasyācidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`lomāni' ityādi| katham‌? ityāha--`yathā lomanakham‌' ityādi| atra hi sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ teṣām‌| tathā hi--keśānapi spṛṣṭvā śaucaṃ kriyata iti| kathaṃ punaḥ kriyāvacanasaya dhātordravyeṣu lomasu vṛttirupapadyate? ityāha--`tadviṣaye' ityādi| tāni lomāni viṣayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| hṛṣeryo'rthaḥ sa lomatsādhyatvāllomaviṣayaḥ| tatra varttamāno hṛṣirapyarthadvāreṇa lomasu varttate ityucyate| tadevamarthadvāreṇa lomnāṃ hṛṣiṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvaṃ darśitaṃ bhavati| `vismitapratidhātayośca' iti| nipātanamiti| vismipratidhātayorniṣṭhāyāmiṇ‌ na bhanatyevamartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--hṛṣeriti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tato vismitapratidhātayorapi bhaviṣyatīti| atha vā--bahuvacananirdeśo'tra kriyate, ādyartho'yaṃ vijñāyate lomādiṣu lomasviti tena vismatapratidhātayorapi bhaviṣyati|| 30. apacitaśca| (7.2.30) `cāyateḥ' iti| cāyṛ pūjāniśāmanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.880) iti| ayaṃ yogo yaścinoterapūrvasaya pūjāyāṃ vṛttiṃ na pratipadyate taṃ pratyārabhyate| yastu pratipadyate taṃ prati nārabdhabdha eva| tathā hi--cinoterapacita iti bhaviṣyatīti, cāyatestvavacāyita iti| `vaktavyam‌' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tetredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--cakāro'tra kriyate| sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tenāpacitirityetadapi nipātyata iti| etacca nipātayatā cāyateḥ ktini nityaṃ cibhāvo vaktavyaḥ|| 31. hrū hvareśchandasi| (7.2.31) `hvṛ kauṭilye' (dhā.pā.931) ityetasyānudāttatvādiṭpratiṣedho'styevetyādeśārtha vacanam‌|| 32. aparihūvṛtāśca| (7.2.32) "hru' ityetasyādeśasyābhāvo nipātyate' iti| pūrvasūtreṇa prāptasya| bahuvacananirdeśo bahavacana eva nipātanaṃ yathā syāt‌| tena kcanāntare hi aparihrutaḥ, aparihru, aparihrutāvityeva bhavati|| 33. some hvarita| (7.2.33) `iḍāgamo guṇaśca nipātyate' iti| cakārāt‌ `hru' ityetasyādeśābhāvaśca|| 34. grasitaskabhitastabhitottabhitacattavikastāviśastṛśaṃstṛśāstṛtarutṛtarūtṛvarutṛvarūtṛvarūtrīrujvalitikṣaritikṣamitivamityamitīti ca| (7.2.34) `grasu skanbhu stanbhu ityeteṣām‌' ityādi| `grasu glasu adane' (dhā.pā.630,631), `skanbhu', `stanbhu' (3.1.82) ityetau sautrau dhātū; `stambhustumbhuskambhuskumbhuskuñbhyaḥ śnuśca' (3.1.82) iti sūtre pāṭhāt‌| `skabhitam, stabhitam‌' iti| `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikasalopaḥ| `skabdhabh‌, stabdham‌' iti| `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvam‌, `jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi' (8.4.56) iti jaśtvam‌| `uttabhitam‌' iti| `udaḥ sthāstambhoḥta pūrvasya' (8.4.61) iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ| `anyopasargapūrvaḥ stabhitaśabdo na bhavatīti iti| yadi syāt‌, utpūrvasya nipātanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `cateḥ, kaseśca' iti| `cate cade yācane' (dhā.pā.865,866), `kasa gatau' (dhā.pā.860)| nanu sūtre vikastaśabdādvahuvacanaṃ śrūyate, tataśca kathamasau vṛttādekavacanānta udahṛtaḥ? ityata āha--`nipātanaṃ bahutvāpekṣam‌| vikastā iti bahuvacanam‌' iti| sūtre grasitādīni nipātanāni kṛtadvandvāni, atastadapekṣayā bahuvacanaṃ kṛtam‌| vṛttau tvasamasta eka evāyaṃ vikastaśabdaḥ| na caitadarthasya bahuvacanaṃ vivakṣim‌, ata ekavacanānta evodāhṛtaḥ| `apareṣu' iti| viśastṛprabhṛtiṣu| `pratyekaṃ vibhaktinirdeśaḥ' iti| bahutvābhāvādbahuvacanam‌, tena tatra na kṛtamityabhiprāyaḥ| śaservipūrvasya śaṃseḥ śāseśceti| `śasu hisāyām‌' (dhā.pā.727), `śansu stutau' (dhā.pā.728) `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075)| `tarītāram‌ varītāram‌' iti| `vṛto vā' (7.2.38) iti dīrghaḥ| `varūtrīḥ' iti| `ṛnnebhyo ṅīp‌' (4.2.5) iti ṅīp‌, tadantājjas‌, `vā chandasi' (6.1.106) iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghaḥ| jasi pūrvasavarṇoccāraṇam‌' ityādi| nanu yaṇādeśe kṛte varūtrya iti bhavitavyam‌, kathaṃ `varūtrayaḥ' iti bhavati? ityāha--`chāndasam‌' ityādi| chāndasatvena hi hrasvatve kṛte `jasi ca' (7.3.109) iti yaṇādeśāpavado guṇo vidhīyate| `prapañcārtham‌' iti| vistareṇānvākhyānamityarthaḥ| tathā hi `pacirvistāravacane' (dhā.pā.1651) iti tasyaivājantasya prapañca iti bhavati| prapañcastu vispaṣṭārthaḥ| vistareṇa hyanvākhyānaṃ spaṣṭaṃ bhavati| atha varūtrīśabdasya sidhyartha nipātanaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`vakhtṛśabdo hi' ityādi| jvalateriti `jvala dīptau' (dhā.pā.831), `kṣara sañcalane' (dhā.pā.851), `ṭu vama ud‌giraṇe' (dhā.pā.849) `ama gatyādiṣu (dhā.pā.465)| `itikaraṇaṃ pradarśanārtham‌' iti evamprakārasyāmyasyāpi pradarśanārthamitikaraṇam‌| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tena kvacit‌' ityādi| cakārasśchandasītyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tena cānukṛṣṭatvānnottaratrābhisambadhyate| tenottaratra vidhānamaviśeṣeṇa bhavati|| 35. ārghadhātukasyeṅūvalādeḥ| (7.2.35) `āste, śete, vaste' iti| `āsa upaveśane' (dhā.pā.1021), `śīṅ‌ svapne' (dhā.pā.1032), `dasa ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1023)| adāditvācchapo luk‌, `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ' (7.4.21)| ārdhadhātukagrahaṇādiha--sārvadhātukasyeṇna bhavatīti| nanu ca `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) ityetanniyamārtha vijñāyate--`rudādibhya eva sārvadhātukasya nānyebhya' iti| `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātukasyaiva' ityeṣā tu viparītaniyamāśaṅkā na karttavyā| yadi hyevaṃvidho niyamaḥ syāt‌, tadā rudādeḥ parasya sana iḍāgamo na syāt‌; niyamena vyāvarttitatvāt‌| tataśca `rudavida' (1.2.8) ityatra rudigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti kittvasya siddhatvāt‌| tasmānnātra viparītaniyamāśaṅkā| `rudādibhya eva sārvadhātukasya, nānyebhyaḥ' ityeṣa niyamo bhaviṣyati, tato nārthaḥ sārvadhātukanivṛttyarthenārddhadhātukagrahaṇena? ityata āha--`rudādibhyaḥ' ityādi| `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) ityetasminniyamārthe vijñāyamāne kaścinmandabuddhiḥ pratipattā viparītaniyamaṃ sambhāvayet‌, tatrānantaroktayā nītyā'bhimataniyame pratipadyamāne `pratipattigauravaṃ bhavati' iti| itikaraṇo hetau| yata eva `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) ityetasminniyamārthe vijñāyamāne pratipattigauravaṃ bhavati, ato hetorārdhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? nārhatītyevamarthaṃ bhavitum‌| yadi hyaṅgasya syāt‌, `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt‌' (7.2.10) iti pratyayasyeṭpratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌; prāptyabhāvā| `na ktvā seṭ‌' (1.2.18), `niṣṭhā śīṅ‌' (1.2.19) iti vacanācca| na hyasyeḍāgame sati ktvāniṣṭhayoḥ seṭtvamupapadyate| iha tarhi vṛkṣātvam‌, vṛkṣateti prātipadikapratyayasya mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? evamarthamapi nārhati bhavitum‌, `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) ityataḥ `dhātoḥ' ityanuvarttate| nanvevamapi lūbhyām‌, lūbhirityatra prāpnotītyeva, na hyatra prakṛteḥ pratipadikatvena dhātutvaṃ vihanyate `kvibantā dhātutvaṃ na jahati' (vyā.pa.132) iti kṛtvā, tasmādiha mā bhūdityevamarthamārdhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ yuktam‌? naitadasti; `ṝta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) ityatra hi svarūpapadātmakasya dhātuśabdasya grahaṇam‌| ata ihāpi `dhāto' rityanuvarttamānaṃ tathābhūtamevānuvarttate| tena `dhātoḥ' ityevaṃvihitasyeṅ‌vidhānāt‌ lūbhyām‌, lūbhirityatrāsatyārdhadhātukagrahaṇa iṭaḥ prasaṅgo na bhavati| tathā jugupsata ityevamādāvapi; na hyatra dhātorityevaṃ san‌ vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? gupādīn‌ dhātūn‌ svarūpeṇopādāya| tasmādetannivṛttyarthamapyārdhadhātukagrahaṇaṃ na bhavatīti veditavyam‌| `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) ityatra svarūpapadātmakasya dhātuśabdasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| tadā tasyāpi `ṛtaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇaṃ na parikalpyeta| tasya dhātuśabde'sambhavāt‌ tadarthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityadovaḥ| atha vā--tatra tantreṇa dve dhādugrahaṇa upātte; tatraikamarthapadātmakam‌, aparaṃ svarūpapadātmakam‌| tatra yadarthapadātmakaṃ tatra tasyopayogaḥ, aparasya tvatreti na kaściddoṣaḥ| tasmāt‌ pratipattigauravaparīhārārthamevārdhadhātukagrahaṇam‌| atheṅgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `neṅvaśi kṛti' (7.2.28) ityata iṅgrahaṇamanuvarattate? ityāha--`iḍiti varttamāne' ityādi| taddhiḍgrahaṇaṃ pratiṣedhena sambaddham‌, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt‌| tannivṛtyartha punariḍgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| nanu ca prāptau satyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, na ca valāderārdhadhātukasya kenacidiṭprāpnoti, ataḥ prāptyabhāvādeva vidhirayaṃ vijñāsyate, na pratiṣedhaḥ? naitadasti; etasmādeva pratiṣedhavacanādvidhirapyanumīyate| nūnamārdhadhātukasyeṅ‌vidhirastīti yena valādeḥ pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti| punariḍgrahaṇāt‌ tu vidhireṣa vijñāsyate|| 36. snukaramoranātmanepadanimitte| (7.2.36) `snu prasravaṇe' [`ṣṇu'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1038), `kramu pādavikṣepe' (dhā.pā.473)--anayorudāttatvādiṭi siddhe niyamārthaṃ vacanam‌--anātmanepadaviṣaya evānayoryathā syāt‌, anyatrā mā bhūditi| nanu ca snoterugantattvāt‌ kiti sani ca pratiṣedhavidhānāt‌ tasya vacanaṃ vidyarthamapi sambhavati? naitadasti; `ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ' (7.2.35) ityanuvarttate| tenāsyāḥ prāpterviṣaye yogo'yamiti vijñāyate| na cāsyāḥ prāpteḥ sankitau viṣayau; tayorapavādaviṣayatvāt‌| ātmanepadanimitte iti prathamādvivacanāntam‌| snukramoretadviśeṣaṇamiti darśayitumāha--`na cet‌' ityādi| `kva ca tāvātmanepadanimitte' iti| kiṃ yatrātmanepadaṃ prati yogyatāmātramapi tayorasti tatrāpi tāvātmanepadanimitte? uta yatra tadāśrayamātmanepadaṃ bhavati tatra? evamartha pṛcchati--`yatra' ityādi| atraivaṃ vyākhyānam‌--yatra tadāśrayamāt‌manepadaṃ sambhavati tatra tāvātmanepadanimitte| kiṃ punastad‌ yatra tadāśrayamātmanepadaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`bhāvakarmakarttṛkarmakarmavyatīhāraḥ, krameśca' iti| eṣu hi stukramyāśrayamātmanepadaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdena sargādiparigrahaḥ| nimittam‌-kāraṇam‌| na cākurvat‌ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavati| yatra tvakurvatyapi kāryaṃ kusūlasya bījādau kāraṇamapi vyapadeśaḥ, tatrāsau yogyatayaupacārikaḥ| tasmādyatra snukramāvāśrityātmanepadaṃ bhavati, tatraiva bhāvakarmādau tayorātmanepadanimittaṃ mukhyaṃ vijñāyate| `tena' ityādi| yasmādevaṃ yatra tāvāśrityātmanepadaṃ bhavati tatra tayorātmanepadanimittatvam‌| tena satyātmanepade pratiṣedho'yaṃ bhavati, nāsati| na hyasatyātmanepade tayormukhyamātmanepadanimittatvamupapadyate| tataśca prasnavitā, prasnavitum‌, prasnavitavyam‌, prakramitā, prakramitum‌, prakramitavyamityatra yadyapyātmanepadayogyatvāt‌ snukramāvātmanepadasya nimittavyapadeśamāsādayataḥ, tathāpi pratiṣedho na bhavati| na hyatra mukhyamātmanepadanimittatvam‌; ātmanepadābhāvāt‌| `prāpnoṣīṣṭeti| āśiṣi liṅ‌ sīyuṭ‌, `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityātmanapadam‌, `suṭ‌tithoḥ' (3.4.107) iti suṭ‌, ṣatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| `prakraṃsīṣṭa' iti| atra `propābhyāṃ samarthābhyāma' (1.3.42) iti karttarthātmanepadam‌| `prasnoṣyate' iti| `lṛṭ‌ śeṣe ca' (3.3.13) iti lṛṭ‌| `pracikraṃsate' [nāstīdamudāharaṇaṃ kāśikāyām‌| `pracikraṃsiṣyate' ityevāsti] iti| san‌, `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmānepadam‌| `sarvatraiva' ityādi| yuktaṃ prakraṃsīṣṭa, prasnīṣīṣṭetyādau snukramorātmanepadasya nimittatvam‌, tasmādātmanepadasya vidhānāt‌; pracikraṃsata ityatra tu kathaṃ kramirātmanepadasya nimittam‌, na hyatra kramimāśrityātmanepadaṃ bhavati, kiṃ tarhi? sanantaṃ dhātvantaram‌? ityāha--`sanantādapi' ityādi| sanantādapi hi yadātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityanena| tena tatrāpi pūrvavaditi vacanāt‌ pūrva dhātusvarūpamātmanepadasya nimittamāśrīyata iti| yadyapi sanantādātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate tathāpi kramestatra nimittābhāvo'styevetyabhiprāyaḥ| atha nimittagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamupādīyate, na `ātmanepade' ityevocyate? ityata āha--`nimittagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| sīyuṭ‌ ādiryasya sa sīyuḍādiḥ, tadātmanepade paraṃ yasmāt‌ sa tatparaḥ syapratyayaḥ, sa paro yasmāt‌ sa tatparaparaḥ sanpratyayaḥ; tayoḥ pratiṣedo yathā syādityavamarthaṃ nimittagrahaṇam‌| tatra sīyuḍādeḥ pratiṣedhārtham‌--prasnoṣīṣṭa, prakraṃsīṣṭeti; tatparaparasya ca pratiṣedhārtham‌--pracikraṃsiṣyata iti; atra hi nimittagrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadā `ātmanepade' ityeṣā parasaptamī vijñāyeta| na ca prasnīṣīṣṭa, prakraṃsīṣṭetyātmanepade parata ārdhadhātukamasti tathā hyātmanepadasyāgamaḥ sīyuṭ‌, tadekadeśātvadātmanepade parata uccārthamāṇaḥ pratiṣedho na syāt‌| pracikraṃsiṣyata ityatra `ātmanepade' ityetasyāṃ parasaptamyāṃ vijñāyamānāyāṃ `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāt‌ syena vyavadhāne sati sana iṭpratiṣedho na syāt‌ nimittagrahaṇe tu sati bhavati| asti hyatra sarvatra snukramoryathāyogamātmanepadaṃ prati nimittabhāvaḥ| tasmānnimittagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| prasnavitrīyata ityata snauterātmanepadaṃ paraṃ copalabdham‌; ataḥ snautirātmanepadasaya nimittamiti pratiṣedhena bhavitaśyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--iha prasnavitevācarati' ityādi| kvacit‌ `prasnavitāramivācarati' iti pāṭhaḥ, sa tu nopapadyate| na hi karmaṇaḥ kyaṅ‌ vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? subantāt‌ karttuḥ| tasmāt‌ pramādakṛto'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ| prasnavitevācaratīti tṝjantāt‌, `karttuḥ kyaṅa salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti kyaṅ‌, `rīṅṛtaḥ' (7.4.27) iti rīṅ‌| kyaṅantādātamanepadaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ ṅita ityevaṃ vidhīyate| sa ca snautirṅit‌ kiṃ tarhi? kyaṅantaḥ| tasmāt‌ kyaṅantamevātmanepadanimittaṃ na snautiriti na bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ| `kramestu' ityādi| nimittagrahaṇāt‌ satyevātmanepade pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌, nāsatīti| karttari kṛti pratiṣedho na prāpnotītyupasaṃkhyāyate| `prakrāntā, upakrāntā' iti| `propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām‌' (1.3.42) iti propāmyāmupasuṣṭāt‌ kramerātmanepadavaṣānādiha kramerātmanepadasya viṣayaḥ| `ātmanepadaviṣayaḥ' [ātmanepadaviṣayāt‌--mūlam‌] iti| ātmanepadaṃ viṣayo yasya sa ātmanepadaviṣayaḥ| `prakramitavyam‌, upakramitavyam‌' iti| `tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' (3.4.70) iti bhāve karmaṇi kṛtyaḥ| `niṣkramitā' iti| `idudupaṣasya' (8.3.41) iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam‌| niṣphūrvāt‌ kramerātmanepadasyābhāvādihātmanepadasya vaṣayo na bhavati| atha prasusnūṣati, prasnutaḥ, prasnutavānityatra kasmānna bhavati, na hyatra snautirātmanepadaviṣayaḥ? ityāta āha--`snauteḥ' ityādi| nanu `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11), `sani grahaguhośca' (7.2.12) itīṭpratiṣedhasya dhātvantaramugantamavakāśa iti paratvādidaivātra bhavitavyam‌, na pratiṣedhena? naitadasti; uktaṃ hi purastāt‌ pratiṣedhakāṇjasya balīyastvāt‌ prayojanamiṇmātrasthānāśritaviśeṣavidhānasya pratiṣedho yathā syāditi|| 37. graho'liṭi dīrghaḥ| (7.2.37) `graha uttarasya' `graha' iti pañcamīṃ darśayati| yadyevam‌, tadeṅgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌? na karttavyam; prakṛtameva tadanuvarttate| taddhi prathamāntanirdiṣṭam‌, ṣīṣṭhīnirdeśena cehārthaḥ? naiṣa doṣakhaḥ; `grahaḥ' ityeṣā pañcamīti prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti vacanāt‌| `jagṛhiva, jagṛhim‌' iti| grahyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam‌| tathā grāhitā, grāhiṣyata ityatra kathaṃ ciṇvadiṭo na bhavati? ityāha--`prakṛtasyaiva' ityādi| ārdhadhātukasyeti yaḥ prakṛta iṭ‌ tasyedaṃ daurghatvaṃ bhavati, na ciṇvadiṭaḥ; tasyāprakṛtatvāt‌| ciṇvadityanena ciṇvadbhāva upalakṣyate| tatsahacarita iṭ‌ ciṇvadityucyate| `grāhita' iti| `anadyatane luṭ‌' (3.3.35), `syatāsī lṛluṭoḥ' (3.1.33) iti tāsiḥ, bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityātmanepadam‌, `luṭa prathamasya' (2.4.85) ityādinā ḍādeśaḥ, ṭilopaḥ, `syasicsīyuṭtāsiṣu' (6.4.62) ityādineṭ‌ ciṇvadbhāvād‌vṛddhiḥ| atha jarīgṛhitā, jarīgṛhītumityatra yaṅantāt‌ tṛni tumuni ca yalopāllopayoḥ kṛtayordīrghaḥ kasmānna bhavati? uttarasūtre vāgrahaṇasyobhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣabhūtatvādvyavasthivibhāṣāvijñānāt‌| atha vā--vihitaviśeṣaṇapakṣo'tra vyākhyāyate| grahertho vihita iṭ‌ tasya dīrgho bhavati| na cātra grahervihita iṭ‌ kutastarhi? yaṅntāt‌| tasmānneha dīrghasya prasaṅgaḥ| atha `graha īḍaliṭi' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam‌, kiṃ dīrghagrahaṇena? naivaṃ śakyām‌; evaṃ satīṭkāryamīṭo na syāt‌, tataścāgrahīdityatra `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopo na syāt‌, `neṭi' (7.2.4) iti pratiṣedhaśca; iha cāgrahīḍhvam‌, agrahīdhvamityatreṭaḥ `vibhāṣeṭaḥ' (8.3.79) iti mūrghanyaśca; dīrgha iṭa ādeśe sati tasya sthānivadbhāvadiṭkāryamupapadyata iti dīrghaṃ eva vidhīyate|| 38. vṝto vā| (7.2.38) 1. `vṝ varaṇe' (dhā.pā.1490) ityasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ vā syāt‌?, 2. atha vā--asyānyeṣāñca ṛkārāntānām‌?, 3. utta tasyānyeṣāñca ṛkārāntānām‌?, 4. āhosvid‌ vṝṅavṛñoścānyeṣāñca ṛkārāntānām‌? atha vā--5. tayośca ṛkārāntānām‌? tatra yadi prathamaḥ pakṣa āśritaḥ syāt‌ tadā yaṇādeśaṃ kṛtvā `vraḥ' iti nirdeśaṃ kuryāt‌, yathā--`gro yaṅi' (8.2.20) iti| atha yadi dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ, tadā `dṛ' ityetasya grahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌; ṛkārāntagrahaṇenaiva tadgrahaṇasya siddhatvāt‌| atha tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ, `ṛtasya saṃyogādeḥ' (7.2.43) ityatra ṛtaśabdena hrasvasya grahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌, idameva hi tatra ṛkāragrahaṇamanuvarttidhyate| atha caturthaḥ pakṣaḥ, vṛṅvṝño prathaggrahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌; ṛkārāntagrahaṇenaitadgrahaṇasya siddhatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ pāriśeṣyāt‌ pañcamo'tra pakṣo'bhimata iti matvā''ha--`vṛṅvṛñoḥ sāmānyena grahaṇam‌' ityādi| sāmānyena grahaṇamiti viśeṣānupādānāt‌| `vṝta iti kim‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--`urṣā' ityevaṃ vaktavyam‌, evamapyucyamāne vṛṅvṛñoṝkārāntayoḥ savarṇagrahaṇādṛkārāntānāñca grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati| evamapyucyamāne satyatiprasaṅgo bhavatīti darśayannāha--`kariṣyati, hariṣyati' iti| atra `ṛddhanosye' (7.2.70) itīṭ‌|| 39. na liṅi| (7.2.39) `variṣauṣṭetyādau [`vivariṣīṣṭa'--iti kāśikāyāmudāharaṇam‌]`liṅ‌sicorātmanepadeṣu' (7.2.42) itīṭ‌| `vistariṣīṣṭa' iti| karmaṇyātmanepadam‌|| 40. sici ca parasmaipadeṣu| (7.2.40) `prāvāriṣṭām‌' iti| `tasthasthamipāṃ tāntantāmaḥ' (3.4.101) iti tasastām‌, sāmānyavihita iṭ‌ sici vṛddhiḥ| `prāvāriṣuḥ' iti| `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjus‌| vṛṅa udāharaṇaṃ nopanyastama; tasya parasmaipadāsambhavāt‌| `prāvariṣṭa, prāvarīṣṭa' iti| `liṅsicorātmanepadeṣu' (7.2.42) itīṭ‌|| 41. iṭ‌ sani vā| (7.2.41) `vuvūrṣate' iti| `iko jhal‌' (1.2.9) iti sanaḥ kittvam‌, `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ, `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityutvam‌, raparatvam‌| ateha kasmānna bhavati--cikīrṣati, jihīrṣatīti, asti dīrghatve kṛte prāptiḥ? ityata āha--`cikīrṣati, jihirṣati' iti| gatārtham‌|| 42. liṅ‌sicorātmanepadeṣu| (7.2.42) vṝta udāttatvādiṭi prāpte vikalpārtha ārambhaḥ| `ātmanepadeṣu' iti parasapatamīyam‌| sicaścaitadvi śeṣaṇam‌| yadyevam‌, liṅ‌ viśeṣito na syāt‌, tataśca liṅ‌ parasmaipadeṣvapi prasajyeta? naitadasti; `valādeḥ' (7.2.35) ityadhikārāt‌, liṅśca parasmaipadeṣu yāsuḍāditvābhāvāt‌| `ātmanepadapare' iti| ātmanepadaṃ paraṃ yasmāt‌ sa tathoktaḥ| etacca sijityanenaiva sambadhyate, na liṅityanema; sicameva pratyātmanepadagrahaṇasya viśeṣaṇabhāvāt‌| `vṝṣīṣṭa' iti| `uśca' (1.2.12) iti kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `āstīrṣīṣṭa'iti| pūrvavat‌ kittvadīrghatvādiḥ| `avṛta' iti| `hrasvādaṅgāt‌' (8.2.27) iti sico lopaḥ|| 43. ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ| (7.2.43) ṛkārāntānāmanudāttatvāt‌ pratiṣedhe prāpte vikalpārtha vacanam‌| `dhvṛṣīṣṭa' iti| `dhvṛ hūrcchane' (dhā.pā.139)| `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityātmanepadam‌| evamanyatrāpyātmanepadaṃ veditavyam‌| pūrvavat‌ kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `smṛṣīṣṭa' iti| `smṛ cintāyām‌ (dhā.pā.933)| `cyoṣīṣṭa' iti| `cyuṅ chyaṅ [nāsti--dhā.pā.] jyuṅityādi| (dhā.pā.955,956)| atra ṅittvāt‌ karttaryātmanepadam‌| `akṛṣata' iti| `ātmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) ityadādeśaḥ| atha saṃskṛṣīṣṭa samaskṛtetyatra kasmānna bhavati, bhavati hi karotiratra `saṃparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe' (6.1.137) iti suṭi kṛte saṃyogādiḥ? ityāha--`saṃskṛṣoṣṭa' ityādi| `ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt' (7.2.10) ityata upadeśagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tenopadeśāvasthāyāṃ yaḥ saṃyogādistata evaitena bhavitavyam‌, na ca karotirupadeśāvasthāyāṃ saṃyogādiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tata uttaram‌, ato na bhavati| `abhaktatvācca' ityādi| saṃskṛṣīṣṭetyatrāyaṃ parīhāraḥ, na samaskṛtetyatra| amra hyaḍāgamaḥ `tadbhaktastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate' (vyā.pa.20) iti aṭo'pyaṅgagrahaṇena grahaṇāditi `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate' (vyā.pa.21) iti suṭo'pyaṅgagrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌ karotirapi saṃyogādirbhavatyeva| aṅgādhikārāccāṅgāvayavo'tri saṃyogo'pi gṛhyate; pratyāsatteḥ| na ca saṃskṛṣīṣṭetyatrāṅgāvayavaḥ saṃyogādiḥ, yaścāṅgāvayavo nāsau saṃyoge bhavati, tadiha na bhavatīṭprasaṅgaḥ| atra `sampukānāṃ satvam‌' (vā 936) iti vacanāt samo makārasya sakāraḥ, pūrvasyānunāsikaḥ| samaskṛtetyatra pūrvavat‌ sico lopaḥ| cakāra ātmanepadānukarṣaṇārthaḥ, tenottaratra vidhiraviśeṣema bhavati; cānukṛṣṭasyottaratrānanuvṛtteḥ|| 44. svaratisūtisūyati ghūñūdito vā| (7.2.44) `svṛ śabdopatāpayoḥ' (dhā.pā.932), `ṣūṅ prāṇigarbhavimocane' (dhā.pā.1031) ityādādikaḥ, `ṣūṅ prāṇiprasave' (dhā.pā.1132) iti daivādikaḥ| `ghūñ‌ kampane' (dhā.pā.1255,1487,1385) iti svādiḥ, kryādiḥ, curādiśca| tatra `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityadhikārādādyayorgrahaṇam‌, netarasya| ūditaḥ--`gāhū viloḍane (dhā.pā.649), `gupū rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.395) ityādayaḥ| eteṣāṃ svarateścānudāttatvāt‌ pratiṣedhe prāpte, itareṣāmudāttatvānnityamiṭi prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam‌| `vigāḍhā' iti| pūrvavaṅḍhatvādi vidheyam‌| atha vāvacanaṃ kimartham‌? yāvatā `iṭ‌ sani vā' (7.2.41) ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvarttate? ityāha--`vetyanuvarttamāne' ityādi| taddhi vāgrahaṇaṃ liṅ‌sijbhyāṃ sambaddhamiti tadanuvṛttau tayorapyanuvṛttiḥ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ pūrvavāgrahaṇasambaddhayorliṅsicornivṛttyarthamanyadidaṃ vāgrahaṇamiti| nanu ca liṅ‌sicoranuvṛttiḥ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ pūrvavagrahaṇasambaddhayoraliṅ‌sicornivṛttyarthamandidaṃ vāgrahaṇamiti| nanu ca liṅ‌sicoranuvṛttau svaratigrahaṇa manarthakamāpadyate, pūrveṇaiva vikalpasya siddhatvāt‌? naitadasti; vacanaprāmāṇyāt‌ svaratigrahaṇaṃ nityārthaṃ vijñāyate| atha vā--svaritagrahaṇāt‌ `vā' ityetannivarttate| atha sūtisūyatyorvikaraṇa nirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na `sū' ityebodhyeta? ityata āha--`sūtisūyatyoḥ' ityādi| `sū' ityucyamāne `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti `sū preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1408) [`ṣū preraṇe'--dhā.pā.] ityasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| atastannivṛttyartho vikaraṇa nirdeśaḥ karaṇīyaḥ| yadyetat‌ prayojanam‌, sūṅiti nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ? naivaṃ śakyam‌; evaṃ hi sati nirdeśe kriyamāṇe `lugvakaraṇālugvikaraṇayoralugvikaraṇasyaiva grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.50) iti sūyatereva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, na sūteḥ| atastannivṛttaye vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ| asyāḥ paribhāṣāyā astitve'yameva nirdeśo jñāpakaḥ| asyāṃ hyasatyāṃ `sūṅ‌' iti nirdeśaṃ kuryāt‌| atha `dhūñ‌' iti sānubandhakasya grahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tato niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pā.53) `ṣū vidhūnane' (dhā.pā.1398) ityasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, etaccāniṣṭam‌| ato vidhūnanārthasya nivṛttyarthaḥ sānubandhakanirdeśaḥ| `svarateḥ' ityādi| asya vikalpasyāvakāśaḥ--svaritā, svartteti; ṛddhanīḥ sye' (7.2.70) ityasyāvakāśaḥ--kariṣyati, hariṣyatīti; svaraterasyobhayaprasaṅge `ṛddhanoḥ sye' (7.2.70) ityetadbhavati vipratiṣedhena--svariṣyati iti| `kiti tu pratyaye' ityādi| `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) ityasyāvakāśaḥ--sūtaḥ, sūtadāni, asya vikalpasyāvakāśaḥ--svarttā, svariteti; sotā savitā; dhotā, dhaviteti; ihomayaprasaṅge `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) iti nityaṃ [nityaḥ--kāśikā] pratiṣedho bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena--svṛtvā, sūtvā, dhūtvā'| etacca purastāt‌ pratiṣedhakāṇḍavidhānādeva siddham‌| uktaṃ hi prāk‌ purastāt‌ pratiṣedhavidhānasya prayojanam‌--iṇmātrasyānādhitadidhānaviśeṣasya pratiṣedho yathā syāditi| tadetat‌ purastāt‌ pratiṣedhavidhānaṃ pūrvadipratiṣedhena samānaphalakatvādiha pūrvavipratiṣedhaśabdenoktam‌|| 45. radhādibhyaśca| (7.2.45) `ratha hiṃsāsaṃrāddhyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1193), `ṇaśa adarśane' (dhā.pā.1194,) `tṛpa prīṇane' (dhā.pā.1195), `dṛpa harṣaṇamohanayoḥ' (dhā.1196),[`harṣamohanayo'--dhā.pā.] `druha jighāṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1197), `muha vaicittye' (dhā.pā.1198), `ṇṇuha ddhadgiraṇe' (dhā.pā.1199) ṣṇiha prītau' (dhā.pā.1200)--ityete radhādayaḥ| eṣu tṛpyatidṛpyatyoranudāttatvādiṭpratiṣedhe prāpte śeṣāṇāmudāttatvānnityamiṭi prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam‌| `naṃṣṭā' iti| `masjinaśojhaṃli' (7.1.60) iti num‌| vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| `traptaḥ' iti| `anudāttasya cardupadhasyānyatasyām‌' (6.1.59) ityam‌, yaṇādeśaḥ| `tarpitā' iti| laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| drogkṣā, megdhā, snodhyā, snegdhetīḍabhāvapakṣe `vā druhamuhaṇṇuhaṇṇihām‌' (8.2.33) iti ghatvam‌, `jhaṣastathorṣo'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvam‌, `jhalāṃ jaś jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvaṃ gakāraḥ| `d‌roḍhā, ñoḍhā, snoḍhā sneḍhā' iti| pūrvavaṅḍhatvādi vidheyam‌| `krādiniyamālliṭi radhādibhyaḥ paratvādvikalpaṃ kecidicchanti' iti| pakṣe raradhva, raradhmetyādyapi yathā syāt‌| `apare punaḥ' ityādi| etadeva hi pūrvavidheriṭ‌pratiṣedhavidhānasya prayojanam‌--pratiṣedhasya balīyastvaṃ yathā syāditi| tasmāt‌ pratiṣedhaniyayamasyā balīyastvānnityamiṭā bhavitavyam‌| tatra pūrveṣāmayamabhiprāyaḥ--pūrvavidheriṭpratiṣedhavidhānasāmārthyāt‌ pratiṣedhasya balīyastvaṃ bhavati, na tu pratiṣedhaniyamasyeti| itareṣāmayamabhiprāyaḥ--pratiṣedhasya balīyastvāt‌ taddharmasya niyamasyāpi balīyastvaṃ bhavati, na tu pratiṣedhasyaiveti tasya balīyastve sati tatprāptiḥ, tena nit‌yamiṭā bhavituṃ yuktamiti| pratiṣedhaniyamastu sa eva krādiniyamaḥ| `rarandhiva, rarandhima' iti| `radhijabhoraci' (7.1.61) iti num‌|| 46. niraḥ kuṣaḥ| (7.2.56) `kuṣa niṣkarṣe' (dhā.pā.1518)| asyodāttatvānnityāmiṭi prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam‌| `niṣkoṣṭā' iti| `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' (8.3.35) ityasyānuvṛtteḥ `idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya' (8.3.41) iti visarjanīyasya ṣatvam‌| nanu ca sakārānto'yamupasargaḥ, tathā prādiṣu nisiti paṭhyate, na tu niriti, tasmāt‌ `nisaḥ' iti vaktuṃ yuktam‌, na nira iti; yathā--nisastapatāvanāsevane' (8.3.102) iti, tat‌ kimarthaṃ tira iti nirdeśaḥ? ityāha--`nisaḥ' iti| `vaktavye' ityādinā rephāntasyāstitvajñāpane prayojanamāha| `tena' ityādi| syādetat‌| nisa iti rutve kṛte latvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha--`niso hi' ityādi| `nilayanam‌' iti| ayaterlyuṭi rūpam‌|| 47. iṇniṣṭhāyām‌| (7.2.47) kimarthamiḍiti varttamāne punariṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`iḍgrahaṇaṃ nityārtham‌' iti| asatīṅgrahaṇe hi vikalpasya prakṛtatvāt‌ pākṣika iḍavidhiḥ syāt‌| tasmānnityarthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| nanu ca siddhā vibhāvā pūrvasūtreṇa, āraṃbhasāmarthyādeva nityo'yaṃ vidhirbhavatiṣyati? ityāha--`ārambho hi' ityādi| pūrvasūtreṇeṭo vikalpitatvānniṣṭhāyāṃ, `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) iti pratiṣedhe prāpte nityo'yamārambhaḥ| tatra yadīṅgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā tasyaiva pratiṣedhasyāyamārambo bādhakaḥ syāt‌, tataśca vikalpa eva syāt‌, na nityo vidhiḥ| tasmānnityārthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| yadi hi nityārthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyeta tadā tena vikalpasya nivarttitatvāduttaratrāpi nitya eva vidhiḥ syādityata āha--`tatreva' ityādi| na cāneneṅgrahaṇena vikalpaḥ śakyate nivarttayitum‌; tasya svaritatvādiṅgrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌| anuvarttamāne'pi vāgrahaṇe nityo'yaṃ vidhirbhavati| yā tu tasyaiva vikalpasyānuvṛttiḥ, sottarārthā| tenottaratra vikalpa eva|| 48. tīṣasahalubharuṣariṣaḥ| (7.2.48) `iṣu icchāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1351),[`iṣa'--dhā.pā.] `ṣaha marṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.852); `lubha gārddhye (dhā.pā.1238), `lubha vimohane' (dhā.pā.1305)--dvayorapi grahaṇam‌; viśeṣānupādanāt‌| `ruṣa roṣe' (dhā.pā.1670), `ruṣa riṣa hiṃsāyām‌' dhā.pā.1230,1231)| sarva eṣaita udāttā iti nityāmiṭi prāpte vikalpārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `tadartham‌' iti| icchārthasyaiva vikalpo yathā syāditarayorma bhūdityevamartham‌| ye tūditaṃ na paṭhanti, te `vā' iti prakṛtasya vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt‌ sahinā bhauvādikena sāhacaryādvā icchārthasyaiva vikalpena bhaviṣyati, netarayoriti `nṛtī gātravikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1116)| sarvevāmeṣānudāttatvānnityamiṭi prāpte sico'nyatra sakārādau vikalpārthaṃ vacanam‌| `se' ityetasyākāroccāraṇamatantram‌; avivakṣitatvāt‌| tena sye'pari vikalpo pāṭhaḥ] pūrvakamiṅgrahaṇaṃ `udito vā' (7.2.56) iti vāgrahaṇena sambaddham‌, atastadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt‌, tathā ca vikalpeneṭ‌ prasajyeta| tasmāt tannivṛttyarthaṃ punariṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyeta| `saṃgaṃsīṣṭa' iti| sampūrvādgamerāśiṣi liṅ sīyuṭ‌, `samo gampṛcchi' (1.3.29) ityādinā''tmanepadam‌, `suṭ tithoḥ' (3.4.107) iti suṭ‌, dhatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| `sañjirgasate' iti| `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmaneṣadam‌| `adhijigāṃsate' iti| gameriṅādeśasya pratyudāharaṇam‌| atha sañcigaṃsata ityatra `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`gameriṅādeśasya' ityādi| taddhi dīrghatvamiṅādeśasya gameriṣyate, nānyasya| tathā hi tatroktam‌--gameriṅādeśasyeti vaktavyamiti| yadi parasmaipadeṣvityucyate, tadā kṛti parasmaipadaluki ca na prāpnoti? ityāha--`ātmanepadena' ityādi| `samānapadasthasya' iti| ekapadasthasyetyarthaḥ| `anyatra sarvatraiveṣyate' iti| etacca `kṛtyapi hi' ityādinā visapaṣṭīkaroti| `sañjigamiṣitā, adhijigamiṣitā' iti| kṛtyudāharaṇe dve| `jigamiva tvamiti' iti| etat‌ parasmaipadaluki| sannantatvādgamerloṭ‌, sip‌, `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti sehiṃrādeśaऱḥ, `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti luk‌| kathaṃ punaḥ parasmaipadeṣvityucyamāne kṛti parasmaipadaluki niyamārthaḥ| sa cāyaṃ niyamo yadyaviśeṣeṇa syāt‌ tadā pūrvayogo'narthakaḥ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ tulyajātīyāpekṣayā niyamaḥ, tulyajātīyaśca tiṅ‌--siṅ‌viṣaye yadi bhayati tadā parasmaipadeṣveva, nātmanepadeṣviti| te kṛti parasmaipadaluki ca pūrvayoge na bhavatyeva; niyamenāvyāvarttitatvaditi| `padaśeṣakārasya panaḥ' ityādi| padaśeṣakāraḥ punarevaṃ manyate--parasmaipadeṣviti neyaṃ parasaptamī, tasmādasatyapi parasmaipade sarvatra kṛti parasmaipadaluki ceḍ‌ bhavatyeva; parasmaipadaparatvena sakārāderārdhadhātukasyāviśetatvāt‌| tanmatena sañcirgasitā, adhijirgasitā vyākaraṇasyeti bhavitavyamiti; sampūrvasya, adhipūrvasya ca gameḥ parasmaipadeṣvanupalakṣitatvāt‌| tathā hi--sampūrvādgameḥ `samo gamyucchi' (1.3.29) ityādinā''tmanepadaṃ vihitam‌| adhipūrvādapi sthānivadbhāvāt‌ tantreṇānekaśaktito vā śabdānāṃ na kiñcidaniṣṭaṃ prāpnoti| evamapi viśāyamāna iṣṭasyaiva siddheratyabhiprāyaḥ| evaṃ pratyākhyāte caturgrahaṇe, prayojanamāha--`tatkriyate' ityādi| yadi caturgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā spanderūdillakṣaṇo'ntaraṅgatvādvikalpaḥ syāt‌| antaraṅgatvaṃ tu tasaya valādyardhadhātukamātrāśrayatvāt‌| asya tu pratiṣedhasyārthadhātukaviśeṣāśrayatvādvaharaṅgatvam‌| tasmādantaraṅgamapi syanderūdillakṣaṇaṃ vikalpamayaṃ pratiṣedho yathā bādhetetyevamarthañca caturgrahaṇaṃ kriyate| kathaṃ punaḥ kriyamāṇe'pi caturgrahaṇe, ayamartho labhyate? ityata āha--`caturgrahaṇe' ityādi| sa syandiḥ paraḥ pradhāno yasya tat‌ tatparam‌, tadbhāvastātparyam‌, tena tātparyeṇa tatpradhānatayetyarthaḥ| `sannidhāpitaḥ' iti| upasthāpita ityarthaḥ| tasya caivaṃ sannidhāpitasya vikalpo'nena pratiṣedhena kathaṃ nāma bādhyetatyetadeva prayojanam‌| tataścaturgrahaṇādantaraṅgamapi viklapaṃ pratiṣedho bādhate| `atrapi' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ `parasmaipadeṣu' (7.2.58) ityanuvarttamāne'nyatra sarvatra pratiṣedho labhyate? evaṃ manyate--gamerityanuvarttate, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate--gameḥ sakārādau yena prakāreṇa iṭ‌ tenaiva prakāreṇa vṛdādibyo neḍiti| tena yathā gamerātmanepadavarjanamanyatra sarvatraiveṅ bhavati, tathā vṛdādibhyo'pi pratiṣedha iti|| 60. tāsi ca klṛpaḥ| (7.2.60) `kṛpū sāmarthye' (dhā.pā.762)| tasmādūdittvādvikalpeneṭi prāpte pratiṣedho'yamārabyate| `kalptā' iti| luṭ‌, `luṭi ca klṛpaḥ' (1.3.93) iti parasmaipadaṃ vikalpena, `kṛpo ro laḥ' (8.2.18) iti latvam‌| `ciklṛpsati' iti| pūrvavatkittvam‌| `klṛperapi' ityādi| ayamartho vṛdādīnāmanuvṛttarlabhyate, tadanuvattau satyāmevābhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate--yathā vṛdādīnā pratiṣedho bhavati, tathā'yamapi klṛperiti| yadi tarhi vṛdadīnāṃ grahaṇamihānuvarttate, tadā vṛdādīnāmapi tāsau pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti? yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati| yadi vṛdādīnāmapi tāsau syāt‌, tadā `na vṛdbhyaḥ pañcabhyastāsi ca' ityekaraṇe kuryāt‌|| 61. acastāsvatthalyaniṭo nityam‌| (7.2.61) krādiniyamādiṭi prāptejjantānāṃ tāsau nityāniṭāṃ thali pratiṣedho vidhīyate| `pātā' ityādi| luḍupanyāsastāsau nityāniṭtvapradarśanārthaḥ'; aniṭtvaṃ [`aniṭpratiṣedhāt‌'--ityeva mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ca `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityādineṭ‌ prataṣedhāt‌| `lūtvā, lulavitha' iti| tāsvaditi vacanādiha na bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ| tasmiṃsvanucyamāna[`tasmiṃsatvanucyamāna ihāpi pratiṣedha syāt‌--bhavati, lunāti| kiti nityamaniṭaḥ `śrayukaḥ kiti' iti pratiṣedhāt‌'--iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ihāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌| bhavati lunātiḥ kiti nityamaniṭ‌| `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) iti pratiṣedhāt‌ `papiva, papima' iti| `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| `aniṅgrahaṇaṃ nityamityanena' ityādi| nityamityanenāniṭtvaṃ dhātoḥ kathaṃ nāma viśeṣyetetyevamarthamaniṅgrahaṇamityarthaḥ| atha savitā, lulavatheti tāsau seṭasthalauṭpratiṣedho mā bhūdityevamarthamaniḍgrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? nārhatyevamarthaṃ bhavitum‌| tathā hi--tāsvat‌ thalīṇna bhavatītyucyate; na ca yastāsau seṭ‌ tasya pratiṣedho bhavaṃstāsvaditi vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyate, yo hyamijabhāvasthali vidhīyate tasya tāsāviḍamāvenaiva sādṛśyaṃ vatirācaṣṭe| evaṃ tu vatigrahaṇādeva tāsau seṭasthali pratiṣedho na bhaviṣyati; anyathā vatinā yat‌ sādṛśyaṃ samākhyayate tanna syāt‌| tasmādyuktamuktemevānidgraṇasya prayojanam‌| athākrayamāṇe'niṅgrahaṇe nityamiti kasya viśeṣaṇaṃ vijñāyate? pratiṣedhasya| nanu ca nitya eva pratiṣedhaḥ prakṛtaḥ, tatra yadi nityagrahaṇe na pratiṣedho viśiṣyeta, tadā nityagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌? naitadasti; pūrvasūtre pratiṣedhasyānityatvaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ syāt‌| avaṃ ca pūrvasūtreṇa pakṣa iḍāgamaḥ syādeva| tasmāt‌ pūrvoktamevāniḍgrahaṇasya prayojanam‌| `tāsau vibāṣiteṭ‌' iti| svaratyādisūtrema (7.2.44) dhūña iṅ‌ vikalpitaḥ| tasya nityagrahaṇādvibhāṣiteṭasthali nityamiḍāgamo bhavati| asati ca nityagrahaṇe pratiṣedhaḥ syādeva| pākṣikeṇāpīḍabhāvenāniṅvyapadeśo bhavatyeva| tathā hi--guhervibhāṣiteṭo'pi `śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ' (3.1.45) iti kso bhavatyeva--adhukṣaditi| atha vatinā nirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na tāsāvityevocyeta? ityata āha--`tāsvat‌' ityādi| asati vatinā nirdeśe yo'pi tāsāvasan‌ asattvācca nityamaniṭ‌, tasyāpi thali pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌| vatinā nirdeśe tu sati, vateḥ sarvasādṛśyārthatvādyathābhūtasya tāsāviṇna bhavati tathābhūtasyaiva thalpapīṭā na bhavitavyamiti na bhavatyeva doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| yadi hi yastāsāvasat‌ asattvācca nityamaniṭ‌ tasyāpi thali pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌| evaṃ ca sati tasāvasata iḍabhāvaḥ, itaratra tu sata iti yathābhūtasya tāsādiḍabhāvastathābhūtasthāpi thali na syāt‌| yo hi tāsāvasannasattvācca nityamaniṭ‌, tasya thali pratiṣedo na bhavati--jaghasitheti--uttarasūtreṇetyabhiprāya ityata āha--`uttarasūtre'pi' ityādi| tadevamuttarārtho vatinā nirdeśo'yaṃ bhavati| iha tu nārtho vatinirdeśena, anajantatvādeva ghaservayeśca paratiṣedho na bhavatīti| `jaghasitha' iti| `liṭyanyatarasyām‌' (2.4.4.0) ityaderghaslādeśaḥ| `udayitha' iti| `veño vayiḥ' (2.4.41) iti vayirādeśaḥ; `liṭyabhyāsasyobhatheṣām‌' (6.1.17) iti samprasaraṇam‌| kasmāt‌ pūnarghaseḥ, vayeśca tāsāvasattvānnityāniṭtvam‌? ityāha--`adādeśo hi' ityādi| nāstitvaṃ tayoḥ punastāsāvavidhānādveditavyam‌|| 62. upadeśe'tvataḥ| (7.2.62) anajantārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `iyaṣṭha' [`iyaṣṭa' iti padamañjarī] iti| pūrvavadabhyāsasya samprasāram‌, vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| `cakarṣitha' iti| `kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā.990)| bhavatyayamakāravān‌, na tūpadeśe, kiṃ tarhi? paścādguṇe kṛte| upadeśagrahamiha śakyamakarttum‌, śakyata eva hi `ekāca upadeśe' (7.2.10) ityata upadeśagrahaṇamanuvarttayitum‌? tat‌ kriyate vispaṣṭārtham‌| asati tasmin‌, pūrvasūtre tasyānupayogānnivṛttiṃ manyamānaḥ `tāsāvatvataḥ' ityevamapi kaścit‌ pratipadyeta| `rarādhitha' iti| `rādha sādha saṃsiddhau' (dhā.pā.1262,1263)| `jighṛkṣati' iti| `sani grahaguhośca' (7.2.12) itīṭpratiṣedhādbhavati nityāniṭ‌, na tu tāsau, kiṃ tarhi? saci| `ānāñjatha' iti| `anjū `vyaktibhrakṣaṇādiṣu' [`vyaktimaraṣaṇakāntigatiṣu'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1458)| `ata ādeḥ' (7.4.70) ityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ, `tasmānnuṅ‌ dvihalaḥ' (7.4.71) nuṭ‌, bhavatyayaṃ dhāturupadeśe'kāravān‌, na tu tāsau nityāniṭ‌; svaratyādisūtreṇa (7.2.44) vikalpiteṭkatvāt‌|| 63. ṛto bhāradvājasya| (7.2.63) `sasmartha' iti| `smu cintāyām‌' (dhā.pā.933) | `dadhvartha' iti| `dhvṛ hūrchane' (dhā.pā.939)| nanu yadyapyakārāntānāṃ madye vṛṅvṛñāvudāttau tatrāpi vṛṅasthalna sambhavatyeva, ātmanepaditatvāt‌| vṛñastu `vavartheti nigame' (7.2.64) nipātanādbhāṣāyāmiṭā bhavitavyameva, tasmāt‌ tayoriṭpratiṣedhārthametannopapadyate; ye tvanye ṛkārāntāḥ, teṣāmanudattatvāt‌ tāsau nityamaniṭtvāmiti `acastāsvat‌ thalyaniṭo nityam‌' (7.2.61) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ siddha eva, paratvādguṇe kṛte raparatye cānajantatvānna sidhyatītyevametannāśaṅkanīyam‌; upadeśagrahaṇasya purastādanukṛṣṭasya `acaḥ' ityanenābhisambhandhāt‌; atha vā--`acaḥ' iti vihitaviśeṣaṇā pañcamī, tatraivaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ--ajantādyo vahitasthaliti, tasmādacastāsvadityanenaiva ṛkārantebhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkimartho'pyamārambhaḥ? ityāha--`siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ' iti| `nānyebhyaḥ' iti| ke punaste? ya ṛkārāntādanye'jantāḥ, anajantāścopadeśe'tvantaḥ| athaivaṃ kasmānniyamo na vijñāyate--ṛto bhāradvājyaiva, nānyeṣāmācāryāṇāmiti? evaṃ manyate--pūrvasūtrādayo'tvata iti canuvarttate, tadanuvṛtteretadeva prayojanam‌--anena niyamena sannidhānāt‌ tasyaivājantasyānuvṝttasyātvataśca prakṛtasya dhātoḥ| tathā ca tadanuvṛttirapārthikā syāt‌| tasmāvṛta eva bhāradvājasyetyayameva niyamo vijñāyata ityāha--`tat‌' ityādi| taditi hetau| yasmādevaṃvidho'tra niyamaḥ--tasmādṛta eva bhāradvājasya pratiṣedho bhavati, nānyebhyo dhātubhya ti| tena yadyapi pūrvayogābhyāṃ nityamiṭpratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ, tathāṃ ca sāmarththāt‌ pūrvayogayorayaṃ vikalpo bhavati| yadyapi tatra vāgrahaṇam‌, ācaryagrahaṇaṃ ca kriyate, tathāpyarthāllabhyate| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, na `urbhāradvājasya' ityevocyeta? ityāha--`taparakaraṇam‌' ityādi| yadi hyurityevocyeta, tato'ṇ‌ savarṇān‌ gṛhṇātīti ṛkārāntānāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| tatastannivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇam‌| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadyukārāntānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌? ityata āha--`tathā hi' ityādi| tathetyevamarthe| hiśabdo yasmādarye| evaṃ yasmāt‌ taparakaraṇamantareṇāpi ṛkārānātānāṃ grahaṇe sati vidhyarthametat‌ sambhāvyeta| asati hi vidheye niyamo bhavati| ṛkārāntānāṃ grahaṇe sati teṣāmeva pratiṣedho vidheyaḥ syāt‌, na hi teṣāṃ pūrveṇa pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ| sarveṣāmṛkārāntānāṃ tāsau nityam‌; seṭtvāt‌ | taparakaraṇe tu sati takāreṇa dīrghanivṛttau kṛtāyāṃ vidheyatābhāvānniyamo'yaṃ sampadyate|| 64. babhūthātatanthajagṛbhmavavartheti nigame| (7.2.64) babhūthetyādau sarvatra krādiniyamādiṭaḥ prāptasyābhāvo nipātyate| `babhūtha' iti| `bhavateraḥ' (7.4.73) ityabhyāsasyākārasyātvam‌| `babhūvitha' iti| `bhuvo vugluṅliṭoḥ' (6.4.88) iti vuk‌| `ātatantha' iti| `tanu vistāre' (dhā.pā.1463), āṅpūrvaḥ| `atenitha' iti| `thali ca seṭi' (6.4.121) ityettvābhyāsalopau| `jagṛbhma' iti| `bhuvo vugluṅ‌liṭoḥ' (6.488) iti vuk‌| `ātatantha' iti| `tanu vistāre' (dhā.pā.1463), āṅpūrvaḥ| `atenitha' iti| `thali ca seṭi' (6.4.121) ityettvābhyāsalopau| `jagṛbhma' iti| graherliṭ‌, `parasmaipadānām‌' (3.4.82) ityādinā maso mādeśaḥ, `grahijyā' (6.1.16) iti sūtreṇa samprasāraṇam‌| `vavapartha' iti| `vṛñ‌ vadaṇe' (dhā.pā.1254)|| 65. vibhāṣā sṛjiddaśoḥ| (7.2.65) `suja visarge' (dhā.pā.1414), `dṛśir‌ prekṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.988)--anayoḥ krādiniyamādiṭi nityaṃ prāpte vikalpārtha vacanam‌| `sasraṣṭha, dadraṣṭha' iti| vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, `sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti' (6.1.58) itvam‌|| 66. iḍattyarttivyayatīnām‌| (7.2.66) `āditha, āritha' iti| `ada bhakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1011), `ṛ gato' (dhā.pā.1098)| `ata ādeḥ' (7.4.70) ityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ| `viṣyayitha' iti| `vyeñ‌ saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1007), liṭyabhyāsatyobhayeṣām‌' (6.1.17) iti samprasāraṇam‌| kasmāt‌ punaratra vyeñaḥ `ādeca upadeśe' (6.1.45) ityāttvaṃ na bhavati? ityāha--`vyeño na vyo liṭi ityādi| `artterapi nityaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| `ṛto bhāradvājasya' (7.2.63) ityanena| `atreṅgraṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌' iti| nanu ca nityamiḍāgamo yathā syādityevamarthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, na hīṅ‌grahaṇamantareṇāyaṃ śakyata iṅ‌vidhirnityo vijñātam‌? ityāha--`vikalpavadhāne hi' ityādi| anena hi vikalpasyānantarasya vā vidhānaṃ kriyate, pūrvaparakṛtasya vā nityapratiṣedhasya? śakyate hyasāvapi maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttayutam‌| tatra yadi pūrvako vikalpastadā'rttivyayatigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; `upadeśe'tvataḥ' (7.2.62) ityanenaiva vikalpasya siddhatvāt‌| athetaraḥ, evaṃ satyarttigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; `ṛto bhāradvājasyaiva' (7.2.63) ityanenaiva pratiṣedhasya siddhatvāt‌| yata evaṃ na vikalpasya vidhānamupapadyate tena nāpi pratiṣedhasya| asmādantareṇāpīṅgrahaṇaṃ nityo'yamiṅvidhiriti śakyate vijñātum‌| pratipattigauravaṃ punarevaṃ vijñāyamāne syāditi vispaṣṭārthamiṅgrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 67. vasvekājādghasām‌| (7.2.67) `kṛtadvirvacanānāṃ dhātūnāmekācām‌' iti| kuta etadavasitam‌? ekājgrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌| na hi kaścidakṛte dvirvacane'nekājasti, yannivṛttyarthamekāngrahaṇaṃ kriyate| nanu ca jāgarttirasti, atastannivṛttyartha tat‌ syāt‌? naitadasti; na hyekamūdāharaṇaṃ prati yogārambhaṃ prayojayati| yadyetat‌ prayojanaṃ syāt‌, `jāgro na' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| tadāpyayamarthaḥ--pratipattigauravaṃ parihṛtaṃ bhavati| nanu corṇoternivṛttyarthamapi syāt‌? naitat‌; uktaṃ hi prāk--`vācyaūrṇorṇuvadbhāvaḥ' (kārikā.7.2.11) iti| tasmādyuktamuktam‌--kṛtadvirvacanānāṃ dhātūnāmekācāmiti| `ādivān‌,āśivān‌' iti| `ada bhakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1011), `aśa bhojane' (dhā.pā.1523)| liṭaḥ `kvasuśca' (3.2.107) iti kvasuḥ, dvirvacanam‌, abhyāsakārthañca, `ata ādeḥ (7.4.70) iti dīrghatvam‌| savarṇadīrghatvam‌, iṭ‌, `ugidacam‌' (7.2.70) iti num‌, `sāntamahataḥ' (6.4.10) ityādinā dīrghaḥ, halṅyādi-(6.1.68)saṃyogāntalopau (8.2.23)| `pecivan‌, śokivān‌' iti| `ata ekahalmadhye' (6.4.120) ityādinaittvābhyāsalopau| `dhātvabhyāsayorekādeśe kṛte' ityādi| nanu ca ṣāṣṭhike dvirṣacanavidhau `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam‌' ityeva pakṣo vṛttikāreṇāśritaḥ, evaṃ cākṛte dātvabhyāsayorekadeśe'kṛtayorapi caitvābhyāsalopayoḥ kṛtadvirvacanā apyeta ekāco bhavanti| sthāne dvirvacane hi śabdāntaramanekājatidiśyata iti syādeṣāṃ kṛtadvirvacanānāmanekāctvam, na tu dviṣprayoge dvirvacane; tatra hi sa eva dhāturdvirucyate, na cāsau śatakṛtvo'pyuccāryamāṇa ekāctvaṃ jahāti, kiṃpunarddhirucyamānaḥ, tat‌ krimucyate--dhātvabhyāsayorekādeśa etvābhyāsalopayośca kṛtayoḥ kṛtadvirvacanā eta ekāco bhavantīti? āvṛttikṛtamekāco bedamāśrityaivamuktamityadoṣaḥ| bhavati hi dharmabhedādapi dharmiṇo bhedavyavahāraḥ? tathā hi, vaktāro vadanti--parudbhāvān‌ paṭurāsīt‌, paṭutaraścaiṣamaḥ, paṭutamaḥ parāri, so'nya evāsi saṃvṛtta iti| atha vā--sthāne dvirvacanapakṣo'pi tatrāśritaḥ, dviṣprayogaśca dvirvacanamiti kṛtvā| cakārāt‌ sthāne dvirvacanamapīti sthāne dvirvacanapakṣasyāpi tatra sūcanāt‌| ye tu tatpakṣabhāvino doṣaste tatra prativihitā eva| `tasthivān‌' iti| `śarpūrvāḥ khathaḥ' (7.4.61) iti khyaḥ śeṣaḥ; `ato lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| `jakṣivān‌' iti| pūrvavadaderghaslādeśaḥ, iṭ‌ `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ, `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam‌--dhakārasya jhakāraḥ, `abhyāse carcca' (8.4.54) iti jhakārasya jakāraḥ| parasya dhakārasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌--kakāraḥ, `śāsivasi' (8.3.60) ityādinā ṣatvam‌| nanu cātra krādiniyamādiḍāgamaḥ siddha eva, tat kimartho'yamārambhaḥ? ityāha--`siddhe' ityādi| `krādiniyamāt‌ prasaktaḥ' ityādinā `siddhe satyārambho niyamārthaḥ' (kāta.pa.59) ityetadeva spaṣṭīkaroti| `prasaktaḥ' iti| prāpta ityarthaḥ| `niyamyate' iti| dhātvantarebhyo vyāvarttyekājādiṣveva vyavasthāpyata ityarthaḥ| athādgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā'kārāntā apyato lope kṛte kṛtadvirvacanā ekāco bhavantyeva, tatraikājgrahaṇenaiva siddham‌? ityāha--`ādgrahaṇamanekājgrahaṇārtham‌' iti| kathaṃ punasteṣāmanekāctvam‌? ityata āha--`dvirvacane' ityādi| iṇnimittatvādākāralopasyeṭi sati teṣāmākāralopena bhavitavyam‌, nāsati, ato yāvadiṇna kriyate tāvadākāralopābhāvāt‌ kṛtadvirvacanā ete'nekāca ityasatyādgrahaṇe [`ityasatyādigrahaṇe'--iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] teṣāṃ grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌| tasmādanekājarthamādgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| yadyevam‌, daridrāterapīṭ‌ prasajyeta? ityata āha--`daridrātestu' ityādi| daridrāteḥ kvaso sambhava eva nāsti, yataḥ `kāsyanekāngrahaṇam‌' (vā.305) iti vacanāddaridrāterāmā bhavitavyam‌, tasmiṃśca sati `āmaḥ' (2.4.81) iti lerlukā bhavitavyam‌ tatkuto'yamiṭprasaṅgaḥ! `daridrāñcakara' iti| `kṛñcānuprayujyate' (3.1.40) iti liṭparasya kṛño'nuprayogaḥ| abhyupagamyapi daridrāterāmo'bhāvaṃ parīhārāntaramāha--`athāpyāmna kriyate' ityādi| ākārāntānāṃ dhātūnāmiheṅ‌vidhīyate| daradrāterārdhadhātuke `lopaḥ siddhaśca pratyayavidhau' iti vacanāt‌ prāgeva pratyayotpatterākāro lupta itīḍāgamo'smānnimittābhāvānna bhavati| kriyatāṃ nāmādgrahaṇam‌, ghasigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti, asya dvirvacane kṛte `ghasibhasohaṃli ca' (6.4.100) ityupadhālope kṛte caikāca ityevaṃ siddha iḍāgamaḥ? ityāha--`ghaserapi' ityādi| `anackatvāt‌' iti| dvirvacanābhāvahetuḥ| ekāco dvirvacanamucyate; `ekācaḥ' (6.1.1) ityadhikārāt‌| tasmādupadhālope kṛte'nackatvānna dvirvacanaṃ syāt‌, tataśca jakṣivāniti na sidhyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| atha kriyamāṇe'pi ghasigrahaṇe kasmādeva doṣo va bhavati? ityāha--`kriyamāṇe' [`nāsti kāśikāyām‌| padamañjaryāṃ tu `kriyamāṇe tu' iti pratīkamupalabhyate] ityādi| subodham‌|| 68. vibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām‌| (7.2.68) pūrvasmānniyamādgamādīnāmiṅ‌ na bhavatīti vibhāṣeyamārabhyate| `jagmivān‌' iti| paratvādiṭ‌ tataḥ `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ, tato dvirvacanam‌| `jaghanvāniti, jadhnivāna' iti| `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti kutvam‌--hakārasya ghakāraḥ| `lābhārthasya' iti| `vidlṛ lābhe' (dhā.pā.1432) ityasya| `na jñānārthasya' iti| `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064) ityasya| `vida sattāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1171), `vida vicāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1450)--ityetayoścātmanepaditvādātmanepadeṣu kvasurna bhavatītyanupanyāsaḥ| `dṛśeśca' ityādi| `vṛśir‌ prekṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.988) ityasmācca pare kvasoriḍāgamo bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vibhāṣā' iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena dṛśerapi bhaviṣyatīti| na caivaṃ sati `gamahanavidaviśām‌' ityasyānarthakyam; pūrvayogasyāsarvavaṣayatvasūcanāt‌| evaṃ hyatiprasaṅgaḥ parihṛto bhavati|| 69. saniṃsasanivāṃsam‌| (7.2.69) `sanoteḥ' iti| `ṣaṇu dāne' (dhā.pā.1464) ityasya saniṃpūrvasya dvitīyāntasyoccāraṇena niyatā mānupūrvīmupalakṣayati| yatraiṣānupūrvī niyatā tatraiva yathā syāt‌| iyaṃ cānupūrvīṃ chandasyaiva niyateti tadviṣayamevaitannipānaṃ vijñāyate| ata eva vṛttikṛtā chāndasaḥ prayogo darśitaḥ| `senivāṃsam‌' iti| pūrvavadettvābhyāmyāsalopau| `vasvekā jād‌dhasām‌' (7.2.67) itīṭ‌|| 70. ṛddhanoḥ sye| (7.2.70) vibhāṣeti nivṛttam‌| ṛkārāntānāṃ hanteścānudāttatvāt‌ `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) ityādinā pratiṣiddhasyedaḥ sye vidhānārthametat‌| atha svarateḥ svaratyādisūtreṇa (7.2.44) pakṣa iṭ‌ athānena nityamityāha--`svarateḥ' sye vidhānārthametat‌| atha svarateḥ svaratyādisūtreṇa (7.2.44) pakṣa iṭ‌, athānena nityāmityāha--`svarateḥ' ityādi| svaraterdhātoryat‌ svaratyādi(7.2.44)sūtreṇa veṭtvaṃ vihitaṃ tasmādanena sye ṛkārāntebhyo vidhīyamānaṃ nityeṭtvaṃ bhavati vipratiṣadhena| añcārthaḥ svaratyādisūtra ukte'pi vismaraṇaśīlānāmanugrahāya punarihocyate| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌? dīrghāṇāṃ mā bhūditi cet‌? naitadasti; udāttatvāddhi teṣāṃ bhavitavyameveṭā| evaṃ tarhyasati taparakaraṇe yathā `smipūṅrañjvaśāṃ sani' (7.2.74) ityatra svaratyādisāhacaryāt‌ `ṛḥ' ityetasya dhātorgrahaṇam‌, tathehāpi hantinā sāhacāryāt‌ `ṛ' ityetasya dhātorgrahaṇaṃ syāt‌| taparatve tu sati varṇagrahaṇametadvijñāyate| varṇanirdeśe hi taparatvaṃ prasiddham‌| varṇagrahaṇe ca varṇagrahaṇāni sarvatra tadantavidhiṃ prayojayantīti ṛkārāntānāmiṭa siddho bhavati|| 71. añjeḥ sici| (7.2.71) `anjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu' [`vyaktimarṣaṇakāntigatiṣu--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1458)| ūdittvādatra svaratyādisūtreṇa (7.2.44) vikalpe prāpte nityārtha vacanam‌| `āñjīt‌' iti| `itaśca' (3.4.1001) itīkāralopaḥ, `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ‌ `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ, `āḍajādīnām‌' (6.4.72) ityāṭ‌ `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| `āñjiṣṭām‌' iti| `tasthasthamipām‌' (3.4.1010)iti jherjus‌|| 72. stusudhūñbhyaḥ parasmaipadeṣu| (7.2.72) `ṣṭuñ‌ stutau' (dhā.pā.1043), `ṣuñ‌ abhiṣave' (dhā.pā.1247)--anayoranudāttatvāt‌ pratiṣedhe prāpte, dhūñastu svaratyādisutreṇa (7.2.44) vikalpe prāpte satīdamārabhyate|| 73. yamaramanamātaṃ sak‌ ca| (7.2.73) `yama uparame' (dhā.pā.984), `ramu krīḍāyām‌' (dhā.pā.853), `ṇama prahvatve śabde ca' (dhā.pā.981)| ākārāntāḥ `yā prāpaṇe' (dhā.pā.1049) ityevamādayaḥ| sarveṣāmanudattatvādiṭpratiṣedhe prāpte'yamārambhaḥ| atra ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśādyamādīnāṃ sagbhavati, iṭ‌ punarārdhadhātukādhikārāt‌ sica eva| `vyaraṃsīt‌' iti| `vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ' (1.3.83) iti parasmaipadam‌| dvivacanabahuvacanayoryuktamudāharaṇam‌; asti hi tatra sagiṭoḥ śrutau viśeṣaḥ; ekavacanasya tvayuktam‌, viśeṣābhāvāt‌--iti yo veśayet‌, taṃ prati tatrāpi vṛddhipratiṣedho viśeṣo'stīti darśayitumāha--`yamādīnām‌' ityādi| `āyaṃsta' [`ayaṃsta'--kāśikā, padamañjayamipi--`āyaṃsta' ityeva pratīkīddhāraḥ] iti| `āṅo yamahanaḥ' (1.3.28) ityātmanepadam‌| `araṃsta' iti| atrāpi `anudātta' (1.3.12) ityādinā|| 74. smipūṅrañjvaśāṃ sani| (7.2.74) `ṇmiṅ‌ īṣaddhasane' (dhā.pā.948), `pūṅ pavane' (dhā.pā.966)| anubandhoccāraṇaṃpūñnivṛttyartham‌| `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ' (dā.pā.936) iti bhvādiḥ, `ṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098) iti juhotyādiḥ--ubhayorapi grahaṇam‌; viśeṣānupādanāt‌| ṛkārāntānāṃ tvetadgrahaṇaṃ na bhavati; uttaratra kiratyādīnāmiṭo vidhānāt‌| `anjū mrakṣaṇe' [`vyaktimarṣaṇakāntigatiṣu--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1458), `aśū vyāptau'[`vyāptau saṃdhe ca'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1264)| `aśa bhojane' (dhā.pā.1523) ityasya grahaṇaṃ na bhavati; udāttatvādeveṭ‌ siddha iti| tatrāñjeraśeścodittvādvikalpe prāpte, śeṣāṇāṃ tūgantatvāt‌ `sanigrahaguhośca' (7.2.12) iti pratiṣedhe prāpta idamārabhyate| `sismiyiṣate' iti| `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam‌| `pipaviṣate' iti| `oḥ puyaṇjyapare' (7.4.80) ityābhyāsasyettvam‌| `aririṣati' iti| iṭi sati guṇe kṛte'jāderdvitīyasyaikāco dvirvacanam‌| `añjijiṣati iti `aśiśiṣati' [`aśiśiṣate'--kāśikā| nāsti--mudritagranthe] iti| añjernakāro na dvirucyate; `na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' (6.1.3) iti niṣedhāt‌|| 75. kiraśca pañcabhyaḥ| (7.2.75) `kṝ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1409), `gṝ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410), `dṛṅ‌ anādare' (dhā.pā.1411), `dhṛṅ anavasthāne' [`avasthāne--dhā.pā.](dhā.pā.1412), `praccha jñīpasāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1413)| atrāntyasyānudāttatvādiṭ‌pratiṣedhe prāpte, dṛṅghṛṅorugantatvāt‌ `sani grahaguhośca' (7.2.12) iti niṣedhe prāpte, itarayostu vṛttikārapradarśitavikalpe prāpte satīdamārabhyate| `pipṛcchiṣati' iti| `rudavida' (1.2.8) ityādinā sanaḥ kittvam‌, `grahijyā' (6.1.16) ityādinā samprasāraṇam‌, `che ca' (6.1.73)| iti tuk‌, `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityabhyāsasyāttvam‌, pūrvavadittvam‌| `sisṛkṣati' iti| `sṛja visarge' (dhā.pā.1178)| pañcagrahaṇādasyeṇna bhavati| sāmānyalakṣaṇo'pīṇna bhavatyeva; `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) iti prataṣedhāt‌| `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti kittvam‌, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌, vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.66) ṣatvam‌, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam‌| `vṛto vetyasya dīrghatvaṃ necchanti' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi na bhavati? vyavasthivibhāṣāvijñānāt‌| `asya' iti| etatsūtravihitasyeṭaḥ|| 76. rūdādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke| (7.2.76) `rudir‌ aśruvimocane' (dhā.pā.1067), `ñi ṣvap‌ śaye' (dhā.pā.1068), `śvasa prāṇane' (dhā.pā.1069), `ana ca' (dhā.pā.1070), `jakṣa adane'[`bhakṣahasanayoḥ--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1071)| rudādayo'dādiṣu paṭhyante| `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyān‌' (śāka.pa.97) iti `rudādibhyaḥ' ityeṣā pañcamī `sārvadhātuke' ityasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayati| saptamīnirdeśastadūttarārthaḥ| tena sārvadhātukasya valāderiṅ‌ vijñāyata ityata āha--`rudādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ' ityādi| `prāṇiti' iti| `aniteḥ' (8.4.19) iti ṇatvam‌| `svaptā' iti| sārvadhātukagrahaṇādārdhadhātukasyeṇna bhavati| sāmānyalakṣaṇa iṇna bhavatyeva; `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| anyebhyastu rudādibhya udāttatvādārthadhātukasyāpīṭā bhavitavyameveti svapereva pratyudāharaṇam‌|| 77. īśaḥ se| (7.2.77) `se' iti| `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) iti ṣaṣṭhyā lakaṃ kṛtvā'vibhaktiko'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ| `īśiṣe' iti| `īśa aiśvarye' (dhā.pā.1020), laṭ‌ anudāttetvādātmanepadam, `thāsaḥ seṭa (3.4.80), adāditvācchapo luk‌| `īśiṣva' iti| loṭ‌, se, `savabhyāṃ vāmau' (3.4.91) iti vādeśe kṛte `ekadeśavikṛtamananya vadbhavati' (vyā.pa.16) itīhāpi bhavati|| 78. īḍajanordhve ca| (7.2.78) `dhve' iti| pūrvavadevāvibhaktiko'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ| `īḍidhve' iti| `īḍa stutau' (dhā.pā.1019), pūrvavadātmanepadam‌, pūrvavacchapo luk‌| `īḍidhvam‌' iti| loṭ‌, `savābhyāṃ vāmau' (3.4.91) ityamādeśaḥ| `janiṣvam‌' iti| pūrvadātamanepadam‌| chāndasatvācchyanī lṛk‌ `bahulaṃ chandasi' (3.2.88) ityanena| `upadhālopābhāvaśca' iti| `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ prāpnoti, tadabhāvaśchābdasatvādeva, `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' (pu.pa.vṛ.56) iti| `jana janana ityasya' ityādi| nanu sānubandhakatvādasyaiva[`cānubandhakatvāt‌'--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ|] grahaṇena bhavitavyam‌, na pūrvasya, uccāraṇārtho'kāraḥ, nānubandhaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha hi ladhvakṣaratvājjanaśabdasya pūrvanipāte prāpte paranipāto lakṣaṇavyabhicārāya| tena niranubandhakaparibhāṣāyā (vyā.pa.53) ihānupasthānādubhayorapi grahaṇaṃ bhavati| `vyatijajñidhvam‌' iti| `karttari karmavyatīhāre' (1.3.14) iti ātmanepadam‌| `tatra' ityādi| tatraivaṃ sūtrapāṭhe `yasmin‌ vidhistadāvāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) iti sakāragrahaṇe sakārādeḥ seśabdasya grahaṇam‌| sa ca sakārādiśabdaḥ sārvadhātukasaṃjñākaḥ seśabda eva sambhavati; anyasyā'sambhavāt‌| nanu ca svaśabdo'pi sambhavati? naitadevam‌; ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt‌ (vyā.pa.16) so'pi seśabda eva, atastadgrahaṇenāpi bhavitavyam‌| `ye tu `īḍajanordhye ca' iti| sūtraṃ paṭhanti, te `īśaḥ sa' (7.2.77) ityasyaiva yogasyānukarvaṇārtha cakāraṃ kurvanti| teneśerapi dhveśabda iḍāgamo bhavati| yadi tarhīśeऱpi dhva iḍāgama iṣyate, tadā `īśīḍajanāṃ sedhvayoḥ' ityekameva sūtraṃ kasmānna paṭhanti, evaṃ pṛthagvibhaktirnoccārayitavyā, cakāraśca na karttavyo bhavati? ityāha--`vicitrā sūtrasya' ityādi| `dhva iti kṛtaṭerettvasya' ityādi| kṛtaṭerettvasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--yatra ṭerettvaṃ kṛtaṃ tatraiva yathā syāt‌| na ca laṅi ṭeretttavamasiti, atastatreṭā na bhavitavyam‌| yadyevam‌, loṭyapi na bhavitavyam‌, amādeśe kṛte ṭerettvasyābhāvāt‌? ityāha--`loṭi punaḥ' ityādi|| 79. liṅaḥ salopo'nantyasya| (7.2.79) `sārvadhātuke yo liṅ‌' iti| `sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) ityeṣātra nirdhāraṇe saptamī, jātāvekavacanam‌, yathā `kārake' (1.4.23) iti| atha vā--subvyatyayena bahuvacanasya parasaṅga ekavacanam‌| parasaptamītyeṣā na na bhavati--sārvadhātuke parataḥ; pūrvasya liṅo'sambhavāt‌| `kuryāt‌' iti| vidhyādisūtrema (3.3.161) liṅ, yāsuṭ‌, `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ, dhātorguṇaḥ, raparatve `ata ut‌ sārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) (3.4.108), `usyapadāntāt‌' (6.1.96) iti pararūpatvam‌| `kurvīta' iti| ukārasya yaṇādeśaḥ| `kurvīran‌' iti| `jhasya ran‌' (3.4.105)| `kuryuḥ' kuryāḥ' iti| atrānantyagrahaṇājjusaḥ sipaśca na bhavati| `kriyāstām‌, kriyāsuḥ' iti| āśiṣi liṅ‌ (3.3.173), `riṅśayagliṅkṣu' (7.4.28) iti riṅādeśaḥ| sārvadhātukagrahaṇādārdhadhātuke na bhavati| ārdhadhātukatvaṃ ca `liṅāśiṣi' (3.4.116) ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñāvidhānāt‌| `kṛṣīṣṭa, hṛṣīṣṭa' iti| `uśca' (1.2.12) iti kittvam‌, guṇābhāvaḥ|| 80. ato yeyaḥ| (7.2.80) sārvadhātukaṃ yat‌ prakṛtaṃ tadarthādiha vibhaktivipariṇāmena ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ pratipadyate| ata evāha--`akārāntādaṅgāduttarasya sārvadhātukasya' iti| `paceta' [`paṭhet‌'--iti prācīnamudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| iyādeśe kṛte'kāreṇa saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yakāralopaḥ| `cinuyāt‌' iti| `svādibhyaḥ śnuḥ' (3.1.73) `yāyāt‌' iti| adāditvācchapo luk‌| `cikīrṣyāt‌' iti| sanantādāśiṣi liṅ‌| `nanu cāto lopenātra bhavitavyam‌' iti| nārtho'nuvṛttena sārvadātukagrahaṇenetyabhiprāyaḥ| `pacedityatrāpi' ityādi| yadyapi paceditodamasyodāharaṇamabhimatam‌, tatrāpi `ato dīrgo yañi' (7.2.101) iti dīrghatvena bhavitavyamiti, tataśca sarvaviṣayasya vidhyantareṇāvaṣṭabdhatvādanavakāśo'yamiyādeśaḥ| tasmādavaśyamanena vidhyantaraṃ bādhitavyam‌| evañca yathā dīrghasyāyaṃ bādhakaḥ, tathā'to lopasyāpi syāt‌| tasmāt‌ sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanuvarttayitanyamiti bhāvaḥ| `syādetadevam‌' ityādi| yadi ca dīrghatvaṃ `turustunnamyamaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.3.95) ityataḥ sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanuvattyaṃ vidhīyate, tataśca syādetadevaṃ yaduktavānasi; iyādeśasyānavakāśatvāt‌| atha `bhūsuvostiṅi' (7.3.88) iti tiṅgrahaṇamanuvarttya vidhīyate, tadā tiṅmātramabhāvi dīrghatvamiti liṅ‌ vidhīyamāna ityādeśe nāprāpte tasminnayamārabhyate, tataśca `yena nāprāpti' (vyā.pa.49) nyāyena tasyaiva bādhako bhavati, na tvato lopasya| iyo'to lope prāpte cāprāpte'yamārabhyate| ārdhadhātuke hi prāpte sārvadhātuke tvaprāpte| atha yeya iti ko'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ, atra hi `yā' ityeṣa yaḥ sthānī tatra ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛtāyāmato yā as‌ iya iti sthite `āto lopaḥ' (6.4.48) iti `ātaḥ `dhātoḥ'
