(6.4.140) iti yogavibhāgādvā ākāralope kṛte `sasajuṣoḥ' (8.2.66) iti ṣaṣṭhīsakārasya rutve kṛte tsaya `bhobhayoaghoapūrvasya yo'śi' (8.3.17) iti yakāraḥ| tasyāpi `lopaḥ śākasyasya' (8.3.19) iti lope ca `ya iyaḥ' iti nirddeśena bhavitavyamiti, na tu yata iti| na hyatrādguṇo bhavitumutsahate; `pūrvatrāsiddham' (8.2.1) iti yalopasyāsiddhatvāt‌? ityata āha--`yeya ityavibhaktiko'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ' iti| yeya ityasmin‌ sthānyādeśasamudayena `yā' iti| yo'yaṃ nirddeśaḥ so'vibhaktikaḥ; `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) iti vibhakterluptatvāt‌| aṅgīkṛtya ca savibhaktikatvaṃ nirdeśasya parīhārāntaramāha--`yaḥ' iti| `vā' ityādi| kathaṃ puna lopasyāsiddhatvaṃ śakyamanāśrayitum‌? ityatrāha--`sautro'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ' iti| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt‌ `sarve vidhayaśchandasi vikalpyante' (pu.pa.vu.56) iti `chandovat‌ sūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā) iti, tasmāt‌, sautratvādasya nirddeśasyāsiddhatvamanāśritya `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) kṛtaḥ| ityādeśe'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ|| 81. āto ṅitaḥ| (7.2.81) `ātaḥ', `ṅitaḥ' iti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| āta iyādeśāpekṣayā sthāne ṣaṣṭhīti| ṅita iti ākārāpekṣayāvayavaṣaṣṭhī' ṅito hyakāramātrasyāsambhavāt‌| ṅita ityeṣo'vacavayoge ṣaṣṭho vijñāyate--ṅidavayasyeti ṅakāra idyasya sa ṅit‌, tasyāvayavo ṅidavayavaḥ| `pacete' pacethe' iti| laṭ‌, svaritettvādātmanepadam‌, ātāmathām‌, `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2. 4) iti ṅittvam‌| `pacotām‌, pacethām‌' iti| loṭ‌, ṭerettve (3.4.79) kṛte `āmetaḥ' (3.4.90) ityām‌| nanu ca ṅidavayavo'trākāro na bhavati, yasmādgāṅakuṭādisūtre (1.2.1) ṅitīva ṅidvadityevamarvo'ṅgaukriyate, tathā `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) ityatrāpyayamarthaḥ, tathā hyasminnapi yoge tadeva ṅidgrahaṇamanuvarttate, tasmiṃścārthe'ṅgīkriyamāṇe ṅiti yatkāryaṃ tadapi hi sārvadhātuke parataḥ pūrvasya lakṣyate, na tu tasyaivāpitsārvadhātukasyaṅitvam‌? ityāha--`sārvadhātukamapidityatra' ityādi| `pūrvasūtra eva' iti| gāṅkuṭādisūtre (1.2.1) yadyevamaṅgīkriyate--gāṅkuṭādibhyaḥ paro yo'ñṇitpratyayo'sau ṅidavadbhavatīti, tadā kuṭādibhyaḥ parasya sano ṅittvaṃ bhavati, ṅittve sati `anudāttaṅitaḥ' (1.3.12) ityādinā''tmanedapaṃ syāt‌, tataścoccukuṭipatīti na sidhyet‌| tasmādetatsidhyarthaṃ ṅitīya ṅidvadityaṅgīkriyate| `sārvadhātukamapit‌ (1.2.4) ityatra tu tat‌ sārvadhātukaṃ ṅidbhavatītyeṣo'rtho'ṅgīkriyate| tasmādyuktamevākārasya ṅidavayavatvam‌| `pacante, yajante' iti| `bhavatyatra [`bhavatyaṅidavayavo'--mudritapāṭhaḥ] ṅidavayavo'ktādeśasyākāraḥ, tathāpyāta iti vacanātra bhavati| `pacāvahai, pacāmahai' iti| loṭ‌ vahimahiṅau| āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) ityāṭ‌, uttamaśca pidbhavatīti| atra pittvānṅittvaṃ na bhavatīti āto ṅidadayavākāro na bhavati| `mimāte, mimāthe' iti| `māṅa māne' [`māne śabde ca'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1088), juhotyāditvācchapaḥ śluḥ| `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌, `bhṛñāyit‌' (7.4.76) ityabhyāsasyettvam‌, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ|| 82. āne muk‌| (7.2.82) `aṅgasyātaḥ' iti| vyādhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyo--āṅgasya yo't‌ tasaya mugagamo bhavatīti| tadihādgrahaṇaṃ tarhi kriyatām‌? na karttavyam‌; `ato yeyaḥ' (7.2.80) ityato'ta ityanuvarttiṣyate| nanu ca pañcamīnirdiṣṭaṃ tatra, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ? naitadasti; ata ityeṣā tu pañcamī tatreyādeśe caritārthā, `āne' ityeṣā tu saptamyakṛtārthā| tasmādāna ityeṣā saptamyata ityasyāḥ pañcamī tatrepādeśe caratārthā, `āne ityeṣā tu saptamyakṛtārthā| tasmādāna ityeṣā saptamyata ityasyāḥ pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ parikalpabayiṣyati, `tasminniti nirddiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti niyamāt‌| nanu cākārovarṇo makāro'pi varṇa eva, mugayaṃ tvantaliṅgaḥ, antaścāvayavaḥ, na ca varṇo `varṇasyāvayavo [`varṇasyāvayavī--mudrita pāṭhaḥ] yujyate, tenānārabdhatvāt‌, tasmādayuktamuktam‌--ato mugāgamo bhavatati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sarvatraiva hi yasyāgamo vidhīyate, yaścāgamo vidhīyate tatsamudāyāpekṣayā''ditvamantatvaṃ vā vidhīyate| tasmādatto mugāgamo bhavatītyasyārtho'yaṃ vivakṣitaḥ--akārādirayaṃ samudāyo sakārāntaśca bhavatīti| `pacamānaḥ' iti| laṭ‌, tasya śānac‌| āne parato'hgasyāto mugāgamo bhavatītyukte samānādhikaraṇe ete ṣaṣṭhyāviti manyamāno'kārāntasya āne parato mugagagamo bhavatītīdaṃ sūtrārtha gṛhītvā ya evaṃ deśayet‌--yadyakārāntamaṅgamāgami, pacamāna ityatra `adupadeśāllasārvadhātukamanudāttam‌' (6.1.186) ityanudāttatvaṃ na syāt‌; akārasya mukā vyavahitatvāt‌| akāro ya upadeśa ityevaṃ hi tatara vyavasthitam‌, na tvakārānto'yamupadeśa iti| na ca śakyate vaktum‌--aṅgabhakto'yaṃ nuk‌, ato nāsti vyavadānamiti; aṅgabhakto hyayamaṅgameva na vyavadadhyāt‌, akāraṃ tu vyavadadhātyeva| avayavo hi samudāyasya vyavadhāyako na bhavati| avayavāntarasya tu vyavadhāyako bhavatyevetyata āha--`akāramātrabhakto hyayam‌' ityādi| mātraśabdo'yamaṅgabhaktatvavyavacchedāya| aṅgañcātrākāraviśeṣaṇam‌| akāra evāgamī, nāṅgam‌| tasmāt‌ tadabhaktatvāt‌ tadagrahaṇenaiva mug‌ gṛhayata iti vyavadhānābhāvāllasārvadhātukamanudattaṃ bhavati| nanu cākārāntabhakte'pi muki bhavitavyameva `lasārvadhātukamanudāttamahanviṅoḥ' (6.1.186) ityanudāttatvena, `svaravidhau vyañjanamavidyamānavat‌' (vyā.pa.37) iti muko'vidyamānavattvādvyavadhānābhāvāt‌? evaṃ manyate--naiṣā paribhāṣā bhāṣyakārasya sammatā| tathā hi--tenemāṃ paribāṣāṃ pratyākhyāyeyamanyā paribhāṣā gṛhītā--`halaḥsvaraprāptau [`halsvaraprāptau--nī.pa.vṛ] vyañjanamavidyamānavat‌' (nī.pā.vṛ.68), iti| na cātra halaḥ svaraprāpatirasti, kiṃ tarhi? acaḥ| `yadyevam‌' ityādi| yadyakārabhakto'ya mukaṃ tadgrahahaṇena gṛhya ityevaṃ styavyavadhāyakatvādeva tasya pacamāna ityatrākārādanantarasyāna iti, tasya `āto ṅitaḥ' (7.2.81) itīyadeśaḥ prāpnotītyata āta--`taparakaraṇanirdeśānna bhavati' iti| akāro hyatra mātrākālastaparo niradiṣṭo muki satayardhamātro bhavati| ataḥ kālabhedānna bhaviṣyati| adhikamarddha yasyāḥ sā'dhyarddhā, adhyarddhā mātrā yasyā so'dyarddhamātraḥ| lasārvadhātukamanudāttamapi tarhi na prāpnotīti tadvidhāvapi taparanirdeśāt‌| `upadeśagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| upadeśagrahaṇa tatra kriyate prāgavasthopalaśraṇārtham‌| tena upadeśāvasthāyāṃ mātrākālastasya yadyapyuttarakālaṃ muki kṛte kālabhedo'sti, tathāpayupadeśāvasthāyāṃ mātrākālatvādbhavatyevātrānudāttatvam‌| `tathā ca' ityādi| yatastatropadeśādūrdhvaṃ satyapi kālabhede'nudāttatvena bhavitavyam‌, evañca kṛtvā yatrāpi `ato dīrgho yañi' (7.3.101) iti dīrghatve kṛte kālabhedo'sti--pacāva ityādau, tatrāpi bhavati|| 83. īdāsaḥ| (7.2.83) `āsaḥ' iti pañcamyakṛtārthā `āne' (7.2.82) iti pūrvatra kṛtārthāyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti vacanāt‌| tenānasyaivāyamādeśo vidhīyate, ityāha--`āsa uttarasyānaśabdasya' iti| `āsīnaḥ' iti| `āsa upaveśane' (dhā.pā.1021)| anudāttettvādātmanepadam‌; `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) ityākārasyekāraḥ| adāditvācchayo luk‌| taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham‌|| 84. aṣṭana ā vibhaktau| (7.2.84) `ā iti vyaktinirdeśo'yam‌' iti| śuddhāyā niranunāsikāyā ākārasya vyaktereva nirdeśa ityarthaḥ| athākṛtinirdeśe ko doṣaḥ syāt‌, yatastatparīhārārtho vyaktinirdeśo'yamāśritaḥ? ityata āha--`ākṛtinirdeśe hi' ityādi| jātirihākṛtirvivakṣitā, na tu saṃsthānam‌| jātinirdeśe sati śuddhāyā jāternirdeṣṭumaśakyatvāt‌ tadādhārabhūtāsu vyaktiṣu kāryaṃ vijñāyate| tatra yadīha jātinirdeśa āśrīyeta, tadā sarvāsvakāravyaktiṣu jātyāvāratvamupagatāsu `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti nakārasya vidhopamāna ākāra āntaratamyādanunāsikasya sthāne'nunāsika eva syāt‌| vyaktinirdeśe tveṣa doṣo na bhavati; ityādi na sidhyati, na hyatra vikalpābhidhāyi vacanamasti, napi prakṛtam‌? ityata āha--`vikalpena' ityādi| `aṣṭano dīrghāt‌' (6.1.172) ityanenāṣṭanī dīrghādasarvanāmasthānāvibhakterudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate| yadi ca nityamāttvaṃ syāt‌, dīrghāditi viśeṣaṇaṃ nirarthakaṃ syāt‌| aṣṭābhya auś‌' (7.1.21)ityatra ca kṛtāttvasya nirdeśo'narthakaḥ syāt‌| vyavacchedyābhāvadaṣṭana ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| tasmāddīrghagrahena kṛtāttvanirdeśena vikalpenedamāttvaṃ bhavatīti jñāpitam‌| tenāṣṭabhirityādyapi pakṣe upāttaḥ; ekavacananirdeśāt‌| anyathā hi bahvarthatvādaṣṭānāmityevaṃ brūyāt‌| tasmāt‌ svarūpadhānoyam‌| tatrāṅge prakṛte'nena viśeṣyamāṇe tadantavidhirlabhyate| viśeṣaṇena hi tadantavidhirbhatītyuktam‌| `priyāṣṭā' [nedamadāharaṇaṃ mūle dṛśyate] iti| `sarvanāmasthāne' (6.4.8) ityādinā dīrghaḥ|| 85. rāyo hali| (7.2.85) 86. yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe| (7.2.86) `yuṣmat‌, asmat‌' iti| `pañcamyā at‌' (7.1.31) iti pañcamībhyaso'dādeśaḥ, `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.9) ityantalope kṛte `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌| yadi ca halītyadhikārādatrāpyāttvaṃ na syāt‌, tat‌ kimarthamanādeśagrahaṇam‌? ityāha--`uttaratra tu' ityādi| uttaratra `yo'ci' (7.2.89) iti sūtre'nādeśasya prayojanamiti| yadyevaṃ tatraiva karttavyam‌, iha kimarthaṃ kriyate? vispaṣṭārthamityabhiprāyaḥ|| 87. dvitīyāyāñca| (7.2.87) `tvām‌, mām‌' iti| `tvamāvekavacane' (7.2.97) iti tvamādeśau| `yuvām‌, āvām‌' iti| `yavāvau1 dvivacane' (7.2.92) iti yuvāvādeśau| sarvatra `ṅe prathamaporam‌' (7.1.28) ityambhāve vibhakteḥ kṛto'mi pūrvavatvam‌ (6.1.107)|| 88. prathamāyāśca dvivacane bhāṣāyām‌| (7.2.88) idamapyādeśārthaṃ vacanam‌| `yuvayoḥ, āvayoḥ' iti| nanu ca `yo'ci' (7.2.89) iti yatvamatra vādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati? prathamādvivacane'pi tarhi śeṣelopo (7.2.90) bādhakaḥ syāt‌| tatra yathā vacanasāmarthyāccheṣelopo'nena bādhyate, tathā yatvamapi bādhyeta| `purastādapavādā anantarān‌ vidhīn‌ bādhante nottarān' (vyā.pa.9) iti yatvamapi bādhyeta| tasmāt‌ `prathamāyāḥ' iti vaktavyam‌| `tvam‌ aham‌' iti| `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94) tvāhāvādeśau| `au' iti vaktavye prathamāyā dvivacanaṃ vaicitryārtham‌|| 89. yo'ci| (7.2.89) `yuṣmadasmodāramādeśa ityatra' ityādi| `yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe' (7.2.86) ityatra yadi pūrvasūtrād‌ (7.2.85) halgrahaṇamanuvarttate, tadā'viśeṣema vidhīyamānaṃ yatvamutsargo jñāpyate| ātvaṃ tu vibhaktiviśeṣe halādau vidhīyamānamasyāpyapavādaḥ| evaṃ cāpyantareṇāpyajgrahaṇam‌, yakāro'jādāvevāvatiṣṭhate, tasmadacītyecchakyamakarttum‌? tat‌ kriyate vispaṣṭārtham‌| `svad‌ gacchati, mad‌ gacchati' iti| `ekavacanasya ca' (7.1.32) iti ṅaseradādeśaḥ|| 90. śeṣe lopaḥ| (7.2.90) `yānyadvivacanāni' iti| ekavacanabahuvacanānītyarthaḥ| `atra' iti| pañcamyādiṣu vibhaktiṣu| `teṣu lopo vidhīyate' iti| teṣāmeva śeṣatvāt‌| `tubhyam, mahyam‌' iti| `tubhyamahyau ṅayi' (7.2.95) iti tubhyamahyāvādeśau bhavataḥ| `yuṣmabhyam‌' asmabhyam‌' iti| `bhyaso bhyam‌' (7.1.30) iti bhyamādeśaḥ| `tava, mama' iti| `tavamamau ṅasi' (7.2.96) iti tavamamādeśau| `yuṣmākam‌, asmākam‌' iti| `sāma ākam‌' (7.1.33) iti| atha śeṣagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na `lopaḥ' ityevocyeta, evamucyamāne satyaviśeṣeṇa lopaḥ syādityetacca nāśaṅkanīyam‌, aviśeṣeṇa hi lopo vidhīyamāna utsargo bhaviṣyati, tasyānādeśe vibhaktiviśeṣe yakārākārāpavādau, evañcāntareṇāpi śeṣagrahaṇaṃ śeṣa eva lopo'vasthāpyate? ityata āha--`śeṣagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌' iti| `śeṣelope kṛte striyāṃ ṭāp‌ kasmānna bhavati' iti| antyalope kṛte satyadantatvāt‌ `ajādyataṣṭāp‌' (4.1.4) iti ṭāpā bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `sannipāta' ityādi| vibhaktyānantarye hi sati yuṣmadasmadī akārānte samupajāte| tatra yadi ṭāpamutpādayeyātām‌, tadā vibhakterānantarya tābhyāṃ vihataṃ syāt‌| na ca yo yatsannipātalakṣaṇaḥ sa tadvighātasya nimittaṃ bhavatīti na bhavati ṭāp‌| yadyevam‌, tyadādibhyo'pi na syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; yadayam‌ `na yāsayoḥ' (7.3.45) iti nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--bhavati tyadādibhyaṣṭāviti| ayañca strīliṅgatvaṃ yuṣmadasmadorabhyupetya parīhāra uktaḥ| idānīṃ strīliṅgābhāvādeva ṭābna bhavatīti darśayitumāha--`aliṅge' ityādi| `kecittu śeṣelopaṃ ṭilopamicchanti' iti| tvaṃ brāhyaṇī, ahaṃ brāhmaṇī--ityatra ṭābmā bhūdityevamartham‌| yuṣmabhyam‌, asmabhyamityatra bhyamādeśe kṛte `bahuvacane jhalyet‌' (7.3.103) ityettvaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthañca| `katham‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--yatra vibhaktāvākāro yakāraśca na vihitaḥ sa śeṣaḥ, tatra śeṣelopa ucayamānaṣṭilopo na labhyate| `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti paribhāṣayā'ntyasyaiva prāpnotīti vakṣyamāṇādeśāpekṣayā śeṣa ityasyārthaṃ `te ca' ityādinā spaṣṭīkaroti| `maparyantādyo'nyaḥ sa śeṣaḥ' iti| sa punaṣṭireva| atrāyaṃ śeṣolopaṣṭilopo bhavatīti lopaṃ prati śeṣasyādhikaraṇavivakṣāyāṃ saptamī| kimarthaṃ punarlopa ityucyate, yāvatā tyadādyatvenaiva siddham‌? na sidhyati; atyadāditvāt‌| tyadāditvaṃ hi dvaparyantāstyadādayaḥ' iti| tatra caitadeva śeṣelopavacanaṃ jñāpakam‌| tena bhavacchabdasya tyadādyatvaṃ na bhavati--bhavāniti|| 91. maparyantasya| (7.2.91) `yuvakām‌, āvakām‌' iti| `avyayasarvanāmnāmakacprākṭeḥ' (5.3.71) ityakaca| atra yadi maparyantasyeti nocyate, tato'vadheranupādānāt‌ sākackasyāpi syādityata āha--`sākackasya sarvasya mā bhūt‌' iti| asati maparyantagrahaṇe, avadheranupādanādanekālvāccādeśasya sarvasyaiva syāt‌| kaḥ punaḥ sarvādeśe doṣaḥ syāt‌? ityata āha--`tathā ca' ityādi| `aniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌' iti| akārasya `yo'ci' (7.2.89) iti yakāre kṛte tvyā, myā iti syāt‌| maparyantagrahaṇe tu sati yuṣmadasmadormaparyantasya sthānitvenādhikṛtatvādasyaiva vakṣyamāṇā ādeśā bhavantīti na kaściddoṣa iti| atha parigrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na māntasyetyevocyateta, evamapi hyucayamāne'ntaśabdasya samīpavacanatvāt‌ tadguṇasaṃvijñānasya bahuvrīherāśrayaṇāt‌ siddhamiṣṭam‌? ityata āha--`māntasya' ityādi| etasmin‌ sākackasyādeśābhāve athavaitasmin‌ yuvakāmāvakāmityādike śabdarūpe māntasyetyevaṃ siddhaṃ yat‌ parigrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tadavadhidyotanārtham‌| yuṣṭadasmadoravayavasaya sthānino'vadhidyotanārtham‌| tasmānmānte yuṣmacchabde asmacchabde ca vakṣyamāṇaṃ kāryaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌| kadā? ityādi--`yadā ṇyantayoḥ' ityādi| tadācaṣṭa iti yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṇici kṛte `ṇāviṣṭhavat‌ kāryaṃ prātapadikasya' (vā.813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvāṭṭilopaḥ, tataḥ kvip‌, tatra `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇico lope kṛte yadā māntatvaṃ vidyate yuṣyadasmadostadā mā bhūditi| asatyapi parigrahaṇe mānsyetyena yuṣmadasmadorityayavāvasthānaṃ labhyate, tataśca yatra mānte yuṣmadasmadī, tatraiva vakṣyamāṇā ādeśā bhaveyuḥ| parigrahaṇe tvavadhidyotanārthe sati niyogato varjyamānena bhavitavyam‌; na hi tena vanā'vadhiḥ sambhavati| tatra samudāyāvayavasthānīnirddiśyate| yatrācchabdo varjanīyo'sti tatraiva bhaviṣyati, na tu māntayorayuṣmadasmādoreva| nanu ca vibhaktiparayoryuṣmadasmadorādeśā vidhāsyante, na ca māntavasthāyāṃ vibhaktiparatasti; ṇilopasya sthānivadbhāvāt‌, tat‌ kiṃ māntasya nivattyarthena parigrahaṇena? ityāha--āha--`sthānivattvaṃ ca' ityādi| `kvau lupte na sthānivat‌' (vā.1.1.58) iti vacanāt‌ sthānivadbhāvo'tra nāsti| tasmādvidyata eva vibhaktiparatvamityabhiprāyaḥ|| 92. yuvāvau dvivacane| (7.2.92) `dvivacane' iti| yadīdaṃ pāribhāṣikasya davivacanasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, syāt‌, tadā tasmin‌ parata eva tāvādeśo bhavetām‌| tathā ca yadā samāse dvyarthe yuṣmadasmadī bhavataḥ, samāsārthasya tvanyasaṃkhyatvādekavacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vā samāsādbhavati, tadā na syātāmiti; yadā yuṣmadasmadī ekatve vā bahutve vā varttete samāsārthasya dvittve sati samāsād‌dvavacanaṃ vati, tadā yuvādau syātāmeva, etaccāniṣṭam‌' iti| dvayorarthayarvacanamuktiḥ-dvivacanam‌| `dvivacane ye yuṣmadasmadī' iti| `dvivacane' iti| viṣayasapatamīyam‌| tadeva viṣayasapmītvamasyā vyaktīkartumāha--`dvyarthābhidhānaviṣaye' iti| `dvayorarthayorabhidhānaṃ dvyarthābhidhānam‌, tadviṣaya ye yuṣmadasmadī te tathokte| `tayoḥ' ityādi| tayoryuṣmadasmadormaparyantāvayavaḥ sthānī, tasya yuvāvau bhavataḥ| `yadā' ityādinārthagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati| yadi tarhi samāsādekavacanabahuvacanayorupajātayordvyarthābhidhānadiṣayatvādyuṣmadasmadoryuvāvau bhavataḥ, evaṃ sati `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94), `yūyavavau jasi' (7.2.93), `tubhyamahyau ṅapi' (7.2.95), `tadamamau ṅasi' (7.2.96)--ityeṣāmapi viṣaye syātām‌? ityata āha--`yadi tvāhau sau' ityādi| `atiyuvāmatyāvām‌' iti| `ātyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe' (vā.91) iti prādisamāsaḥ| tatra yo'sau yuṣmadasmadarthañcātikrāntaḥ sa ekasaṃkhyāvacchinno'rtha iti tatra yadyapyekavacanaṃ bhavati, tathāpi dvyarthābhidhānaviṣayatvādyuṣmadasmadoryuvāvau bhavata eva| atra hi `dvitīyāyāñca' (7.2.87) ityāttvam‌| `atiyuvān‌, atyāvān‌' iti| `śaso na' (7.1.29) iti natvam‌| `atyāvayā' iti| `yo'ci' (7.2.89) iti yatvam‌| `atiyuvābhiratyāvābhiḥ' iti| `yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe' (7.2.86) ityāttvam‌| `atiyuvabhyamatyāvabhyam‌' iti| `bhyaso bhyam‌' (7.1.30)| `atiyuvadatyāvat‌' iti| `ekavacanasya ca' (7.1.32) iti ṅaseradādeśaḥ| bahuvacanasya tu `pañcamyā at‌' (7.1.31) ityanena| `atiyudākam‌, atyāvākam‌' iti| `sāma ākam‌' (7.1.30)| `atiyuvadatyāvat‌' iti| `ekavacanasya ca' (7.1.32) iti ṅaseradādeśaḥ| bahuvacanasya tu `pañcamyā ut' (7.1.31) ityanena| `atiyuvākam‌, atyāvākam‌' iti| `sāma ākam‌' (7.1.33) `atiyuvayi, atyādayi' iti| pūrvavadyatvam‌| `atiyuvāsu atyāvāsu' iti| pūrvavadāttvam‌| `tvāhādīnāṃ viṣaye' ityādinā yaduktaṃ--`yadi tvahau (7.2.94) ityādinā''deśāntareṇa na bādhyete' iti, taddhispaṣṭīkaroti--`yadā tu' ityādinā| arthagrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭamupapadyate taddarśayati--`atitvāmatamām‌' iti| atra yo yuṣmadasmadarthāvatikrāntau tau dvisaṃkhyau samāsārthāviti samāsādyadyami dvivacanaṃ bhavati, tathāpi yuṣmadasmadordvyarthatā nāstīti yuvāvau na bhavataḥ| tvamāveva bhaktaḥ| `prathamāyāśca dvivacane bhāṣāyām‌' (7.2.88) ityāttvam‌| atha vā--dvitīyādvivacanametat‌, tataḥ `dvitīyāyāñca' (7.2.87) iti| `evasunneyam‌' iti| vacanāntareṣvapyādeśābhāvaṃ darśayati| yuṣmānatikrāntau paśya atiyuṣmām‌, atyasmām‌| atikrāntābhyāṃ tvāṃ kṛtamatitvābhyām‌, atimābhyām‌| atikrāntābhyāṃ yuṣmān‌ kṛtamatiyuṣmābhyāṃ kṛtam‌| tvāmatikrāntābhyāṃ dehi atitvābhyāṃ dehi, atimābhyāṃ dehi| atikrāntābhyāṃ yuṣmān‌ dehi atiyuṣmābhyāmatyasmābhyāṃ dehi| atikrāntābhyāṃ tvāmāgato'tisyābhyāmāgataḥ, atimābhyāmāgataḥ| atikrāntabhyāṃ yuṣmānāgato'tiyuṣmābhyāmāgataḥ, atyasmābhyāmāgataḥ| atikrāntayostvāṃ svamatitvayoḥ svam‌, atimayoḥ svam‌| yuṣmānatikrāntayoḥ svamatayuṣmayoḥ svam‌, atyasmayoḥ svam‌| atikrāntayostvāṃ nidhehi atitvayornidhehi, atimayornidhehi| atikrāntayoryuṣmānnidhehi, atiyuṣmayornidhehi, atyasmayornidehi|| 93. yūyavayau jasi| (7.2.93) `paramayūyam‌' iti| `aṅgādhikāre tasya ca taduttarapadasya ca' (pu.pa.vṛ.85) iti vacanāduttarapadayorapi bhavataḥ| atha vā--`jasi' iti parasaptamīyam‌, tena samastayorapi jasi parata iti bhavataḥ| paramayūyamityādāvapi yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ jasaḥ paratvamastyeva|| 94. tvāhau sau| (7.2.94) `tvamāvekavacane' (7.2.97) iti vakṣyati, tasyāyamapavādaḥ| atha tvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, `ahaḥ sau' ityevocyeta, tvādeśo hi `tvamāvekavacane' (7.2.97) ityevaṃ bhaviṣyati? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum‌; asati tvagrahaṇe yuṣmado'pyahādeśaḥ syāt‌| atha vā--atra `asmado'haḥ sau' iteyavocyeta? evamapi gauravaṃ syāt‌| tasmādyathānyā samevāstu|| 95. tubhyamahyau ṅayi| (7.2.95) 96. tavamamau ṅasi| (7.2.96) anantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇayostvamayoḥ prāptayorivaṃ vacanam‌|| 97. tvamāvekavacane| (7.2.97) `ekavacana ityarthenirdeśaḥ' iti| etenārthasyevaṃ grahaṇam‌, na tu pāribhāṣikasyaikavacanasyeti darśayati| pāribhāṣikasya tu grahaṇe yo doṣaḥ sa `yuvādhau dvivacane' (7.2.92) ityatrokta ityabhiprāyaḥ| arthagrahaṇaṃ tviha vacanagrahaṇāllabhyate| yadīha pratyayagrahaṇamabhimataṃ syāt‌, `ekatve' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| vibhaktāviti varttate, tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate--ekatve yā vibhaktiriti| atha vā--etaditi na brūyāt‌; ekavacane hi `pratyayottarapadayośca' (7.2.98) ityenenaivādeśayoḥ siddhatvāt‌| `tvām‌, mām‌' iti| `dvitīyāyāñca' (7.2.87) ityāttvam‌| `yadā samāsa ekārthe' ityādinā'rthagrahaṇaṃ sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati| yadāpi samāsāt‌ saṃkhyāntarayuktād‌dvivacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vā bhavati, tadāpyekārthayoryuṣmadasmadoretāvādeśo bhavataḥ| evaṃ sati `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94), `yūyvayau jasi' (7.2.93), `tubhyamahyau ṅayi' (7.2.95), `tavamamau ṅasi' (7.2.96)--ityeṣāmapyādeśāntarāṇāṃ viṣayaṃ syātāmityata āha--`ādeśāntarāṇāṃ tu' ityādi| pūrvavipratiṣedhasyeti vacanaṃ parasya vipratiṣedhasyāsambhavāt‌| asambhavastvanayoreva paratvāt‌| pūrvavipratiṣedhastu paraśabdasyeṣṭavācitvāllabhyate| tatra `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94) ityasyāvakāśo yatraikārthe yuṣmadasmadī na bhavataḥ--atikrānto yuṣmānityatitvamatyahamiti, tvamāvekavacana(7.2.97)syāvakāśo yatraikārthābhyāṃ vibhaktyantaraṃ bhavati--tvām‌, māmiti; atikrāntastvāmatitvamatikrānto māmatyahamityatrobhayaprasaṅge prāpte tvahau sau bhavataḥ pūrvavipratiṣedhena| anyā diśā''deśāntareṣu prāpteṣu pūrvaṃ vipratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| `atikrānto tvāmatitvām‌, atimām‌' iti| atra yadyapi samāsād‌dvivacana bhavati, tathāpyekārthe yuṣmadasmadī iti bhavata eva tvamādeśau| pāribhāṣikasya tvekavacanasya grahaṇe na syātām‌; tasyehāvidyamānatvāt‌| `evamādyudāharttavyam‌' iti| atikrāntau tvāṃ paśyātitvām‌, atimāṃ paśya| atitvābhiratimābhiḥ kṛtam| atakrāntābhyāṃ tvāṃ dehyatitvābhyāmatimābhyāṃ dehi| atikrāntebhyastvāṃ dehyatitvabhyamatimabhyaṃ dehi| atikrāntayostvāṃ tvāmāgato'titvābhyāmatimābyāmāgataḥ| atikrāntebhyastvāmāgato'titvadāgato'timadāgataḥ| atikrāntayostvāṃ svamatitvayoḥ svam‌, atimayoḥ svam‌| atikrāntānāṃ tvāṃ svamatitvākaṃ svam‌, atimākaṃ svam‌| atikrāntayostvāṃ nidhehyatitvayornidhehi, atimayornidhehi| atikrānteṣu tvāṃ nidhehyatitvāsu nidhehi, atimāsu nidhehi|| 98. pratyayottarapadayośca| (7.2.98) `ekavacane varttamānayoḥ' iti| ekārthābhidhānaviṣayoyorityarthaḥ| `tvadīyaḥ madīyaḥ' iti| `tyadādīni ca' (1.1.74) iti vṛddhasaṃjñakatvāt‌ `vṛddhācchaḥ' (4.2.114) iti cchapratyayaḥ| `tvattaraḥ, mattaraḥ' iti| `dvivacanavibhadajyopapade tarabīyasunau' (5.3.57) iti tarap‌| `tvadyati, madyati' iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8)| `tvadyate, madyate' iti| `karttuḥ kyaṅa salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti kyaṅa| nanu ca pūrveṇevadeśau siddhau, tat‌ kimartho'yamārambaḥ? ityata āha--`vibhaktāvityadhikārāt‌' ityādi| `nanu ca' ityādi deśakaḥ| prakṛtipratyayayoḥ pūrvottarapadayośca yā mardhye varttate sā'ntarvattinī vibhaktiḥ| naivaṃ śakyam‌' itītaraḥ| `lukā tasya bhavitavyam‌' iti, aśyatāyāṃ hetuḥ| `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti prāgevādeśābhyāṃ lukā bhavitavyamiti, tataśca tannimittāvādeśau na syātāmityabhiprāyaḥ| `bahiraṅgo luk‌' ityādi deśakaḥ| vibhaktimātraṃ hyādeśayorāśrayaḥ lukastu dhātutvaṃ prātipadikatvañcāparam‌| tadevaṃ dhātupratipadikatve yathāyogaṃ bāhyapratyayāpekṣatvāt‌ samāsāpekṣatvācca bahiraṅge kiṃ punastadapekṣayā luko bahiraṅgatā? `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) ityādeśāveva prathamaṃ bhaviṣyataḥ| `etadevetyādi' itaro'pi| `antaraṅgānapi vithīn‌ bahiraṅgo lugna bādhate' iti pūrveṇaiva siddhatvādadeśavacanaṃ na kuryāt‌, kṛtañca, tadeva jñāpayati--`antaraṅgānapi vidhīn‌ bahiraṅgo lug‌ bādhate' (vyā.pa.128) iti| kimetasya jñāpakasya prayojanam‌? ityata āha--`tena' ityādi| yadyayamartho na jñāpyate, tadā gomān‌ priyo'syeti gomatpriya ityantaraṅgatvāllukaḥ prāk‌ `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌ syāt‌, `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghatvam‌, tataśca saṃyogāntalope (8.2.23) kṛte gomānpriya ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prasajyeta| asmin‌ hayarthe jñāpite, antaraṅgamapi numādikaṃ bahiraṅgeṇa lukā bādhyata iti na bhavatyeṣa doṣaprasaṅgaḥ| ekenādiśabdena gomantamicchati gomatyati, gomānivācarati gomatyate--ityādergrahaṇam‌| dvitīyena dīrghatvasya halṅyādilopasya (6.1.66)| yadyantaraṅgatvād‌ halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.66) syāt‌, pratyayalakṣaṇena numādikaṃ syāt‌, tataśca tadevāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| luki ca sati `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇaprataṣedhānna bhavati| `evaṃ ca' ityādi| yata evaṃ bahiraṅgo'pi lugantaraṅgānapi vidhīn‌ bādhane, evañca kṛtvā, `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94), `yūyavayau jasi' (7.2.93), `tumyamahyau ṅayi' (7.2.95) `tavamamau ṅasi' (7.2.96)--ityeta ādeśāḥ pratyaya uttarapade ca parato na bhavantīti| `atha' ityādi| asati prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati, asti cāsyat‌ prayojanam‌--evāṃ tvahaṭīnāmādeśāntarāṇāṃ bādhanam‌| satyetasmin‌ prayojane, etadarthamevedaṃ yuktaṃ vijñātum‌, na tu jñāpanārthamiti bhāvaḥ| `lakṣyasthityapekṣayā' iti| lakṣyasya vyutpādyasya sthitiḥ-sthānaṃ lakṣyasthitiḥ, tadviṣaye'pekṣā-lakṣyasthityapekṣā; tathā hetu bhūtayā| nedamādeśāntarāṇāṃ bādhanārthaṃ vijñāyate| gomatpriyo gomatyatītyevamādikaṃ lakṣyaṃ loke sādhubhāvenādasthitam‌| ādeśāntarabādhanārthe hyetasmin‌' vijñāyamāne na saṃgṛhataṃ sāyat‌| jñāpanārthe tvetadapi saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavatatyetaddarśayati--`jñāpanārthe hyetasmin‌' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ satyevaṃ prayojane satyāmapi lakṣyasthityapekṣāyāṃ jñāpakārthametat‌ śakyaṃ vijñātum‌? evaṃ manyate--prayojanamevaitanna bhavati; maparyantagrahaṇasya cakāreṇānukarṣaṇārthatvāt‌| tadanukarṣaṇasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--maparyantayorādeśau yathā syātāmiti| yadi cādeśāntarāṇāṃ bādhanārthametat‌ syāt‌, anukarṣaṇaṃ tasyāpārthakaṃ syāt‌| yadbādhanārthamet‌ sūtraṃ prakalpyate tānyādeśāntarāṇi maparyantasyaiva prayuktāni, nānyasya| tataścāntareṇāpi maparyantagrahaṇānuvṛttimutsargasamānadeśatvādapavādānāṃ maparyantasyaiva bhaviṣyata iti kiṃ maparyantasyetyanuvarttanena! ādeśāntarāmabādhanārthe hyetasmin‌ sarvādeśivṛttyarthaṃ maparyantagrahaṇamanuvarttayituṃ yuktam‌| tasmādetasmānmaparyantagrahaṇānuvarttanānnādeśāntarabādhanamasya prayojanam‌| ato jñāpakaṃ vijñāyate| nanu ca kimarthameṣāṃ tvāhādīnāṃ bādhanārthametanna vijñāyata iti pareṇa deśitam‌| tasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ--maparyantasyetatyetannivarttyādeśāntarabādhanārthametat‌ kasmānna bhavatīti? tatrāyamarthaḥ--maparyantagrahaṇasyānukarṣaṇārthaścakāro na karttavyo bhavati| maparyantagrahaṇānuvṛttāvetadādeśāntarabādhanārthaṃ nopapadyate, tasminnivṛttau tūpapadyata eva|| 99. tricaturīḥ striyāṃ tusṛcatasṛ| (7.2.99) `trayaḥ' iti| `jasi ca' (7.3.109) iti guṇaḥ| `catvāraḥ' iti| `caturanaḍuhorāmudāttaḥ' (7.1.98) ityām‌| `trīṇi' iti| `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20) iti śibhāvaḥ, `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) num‌, `nopadhāyāḥ' (6.4.7), `saravanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau' (6.4.8) iti dīrghaḥ| `striyāmiti caitat‌ tricaturorviśeṣaṇam‌' iti| tayoreva śrutatvāt‌| `nāṅgasya' iti| evakārasya vyavacchedyaṃ darśayati--`tena' iti| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena| yadi hi striyāmityanenāṅgameva viśeṣyate,[`viśeṣyeta'--mudritapāṭhaḥ] tato yadā tricatuśabdau puṃsi napuṃsake vā varttete, aṅgaṃ [`aṅge'--mudritapāṭhaḥ] tu striyām‌, tadāpyetāvādeśau syātām‌| `tricaturoḥ striyām‌' ityanena viśeṣyamāṇayorna bhavataḥ| `priyatriḥ' ityādi| striyā anyapadārthatvādaṅgaṃ striyāṃ varttate, tricatuḥśabdau liṅgāntare| yadā tvaṅgaṃ puṃsi napuṃsake vā varttate, tricatuḥśabdau tu striyām‌, tadā bhavata eva| priyāstisro bāhyaṇyo'syeti priyatisā, priyatisrau, priyatisnaḥ| priyatisṛ brāhmaṇakulam‌, priyatisṛṇo, priyatisṛṇi| priyacatasṛ brāhmaṇakulam‌, priyacatasṛṇī, priyacatasṛṇi| `tisṛbhāve' ityādi| triśabdāt‌ saṃjñāyāṃ kan‌' (5.3.87) iti kani kṛte vibhaktyabhāvānna prāpnotītīdamārabhyate| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratapādanam‌--pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'navarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tena saṃjñāyāṃ kanyapi bhaviṣyati| `tisṛkā' iti| grāmasyaiṣā saṃjñā| `catasaryādyudāttatvanipātanam‌' iti| catasraḥ paśyetyatra `caturaḥ śasi' (6.1.167) ityantodāttatvaṃ prāpnoti, ādyudāttañceṣyate, tadarthamādyudāttatvanipātanaṃ karttavyam‌| nipātanasvareṇa bādhitatvādantodāttatvaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌| yathaivaṃ tarhi nipātanasvaraḥ śasisvaraṃ bādhate, tathā `ṣaṭ‌tricaturbhyo halādiḥ' (6.1.179) ityamena yadavibhakterādyudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate tadapi bādheta, tataścatasṛṇāmityatrāma udāttatvaṃ na syat‌? ityata āha--`catasṛṇāmityatra tu' ityādi| `halādigrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌' iti| tatraivāyaṃ hetuḥ| halādigrahaṇaṃ hi tatrājādinivṛttyartha kriyate| catuḥśabdaścāyaṃ huvacanaviṣayaḥ| sarvāṇi bahuvacāni prathamādvitīyāṣaṣṭhībahuvacanebhyo'nyāni halādīni| tatrāmo numaciratṛjvadbhāvebhyo pūrvavipratiṣedhena nuṭi kṛte bhavitavyamādyudāttatvena; halāditatvāt‌| jasastu `añjeśchandasyasarvanāmasthānām‌' (6.1.170) ityato'sarvanāmasthānagrahaṇasyānuvarttamānatvādādyudāttatvaṃ [`grahaṇānuvartamānatvāt‌'--mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] na bhavati| tasmācchaso mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ tatra halādigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| yadi ca nipātanasvaro na bhaviṣyati| tasmānmā bhūddhalādigrahaṇasya vaiyarthyam‌| iha halādigrahamasamarthyādvibhaktisvareṇa nipātatasvaro bādhyata iti, tena catasṛṇāmityatrāntodāttatvaṃ bhavati|| 100. aci ra ṛtaḥ| (7.2.100) kimarthaṃ punaraci rādeśa ucyate, na yaṇādeśena siddhatvāt‌? ityata āha--`pūrvasavarṇa' ityādi| asati hyetasmin‌ sūtre śasi `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) iti pūrvasavarṇaḥ syāt‌, `ṅasiṅasośca' (6.1.110) `ṛta ut‌' (6.1.111) ityuttvañca, sarvanāmasthāne ṅau ca `ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ' (7.3.110) guṇaḥ| tasmādeteṣāmapavādo'yaṃ rephādeśa ārabhyate| nanu yuktaḥ pūrvasavarṇasyottvasya cehāyamapavādo rephādeśaḥ, guṇasya tvayuktaḥ; yasmāt‌, `madhyepavādāḥ pūrvān‌ vidhīn‌ bādhante nottarān‌' (vyā.pa.10) iti? ata āha--`paramapi' ityādi| guṇasyāvakāśaḥ--karttārau, harttārau, karttarīti; rephasyāvakāśaḥ--tislaḥ paśyeti, tisrastiṣṭhantīti; priyatisri nidhehīti| atrobhayaprasaṅge pūrvavipratiṣedhena repho bhavan‌ paramapi ṅisarvanāmasthānaguṇaṃ bādhate| `ṛta iti kim‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--tisṛcatasṛśabdāvahānuvarttiṣyete| tau ca ṛkārāntāvevetyalo'ntyaparibhāṣayā (1.1.52) ṛta eva bhaviṣyati| tisṛcatasloḥ pratipattyartham‌' iti| tisṛcatasa--ityetayoracyapi paratastricaturoḥ sthāne pratipattiḥ-prāptiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ `ṛtaḥ' ityucyam‌| `anyathā hi' ityādi| yadi `ṛtaḥ' iti nocyeta, tadā tayoreva tisṛcatasrorayamapavādo vijñāyeta, tataścājādau tau na syātām‌|| 101. jarāyā jarasanyatarasyām‌| (7.2.101) `numo vidhānājjarasadeśo bhavati viprataṣedhena' iti| numo'vakāśaḥ--trapūṇi jatūni; jarasāveśasyāvakāśaḥ--jarasau; atijarāṃsi brāhmaṇakulānītayatrobhayaprasahge vipratiṣedhena paro jarasādeśo bhavati| yadi hi pūrvaṃ num‌ syāt‌, numā vyavahitatvājjarasādeśo na labhyate, tathāpi vihitaviśeṣaṇapāśrayaṇena labhyate| evamapi `nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' (vyā.pa.106) iti jarāśabdasyādeśe kṛte sakārat‌ paro num‌ śrūyeta| [`śrūyate' mudrita pāṭhaḥ] athāpi samuskasyādeśaḥ syāt‌? evamapi kṛtakāryatvānnumśāstrasya punarapravṛtterādeśe kṛte punarnamna syāt‌, tathāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prasajyeta| athehātijarasaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ paśyeti jarasādeśe kṛte `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) iti sukkasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`iha' ityādi| jarāmatikrāntamiti prādisamāsaḥ, `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvaḥ, dvitīyaikavacanamam‌ iti sthita ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt‌(vyā.pā.16)kṛte'pi hrasvatve luk‌, ambhāvaḥ, jarasbhāvaḥ--ityetāni trīṇi kāryāmi yugapat‌ prāpnuvanti, tatra lugapavādatvāt‌ `ato'm‌'(7.1.24) ityambhāvena bādhyate, ambhāvo'pi paratvājjarasādeśena| atha kṛte jarasādeśe luk‌ punaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`punarlukśāstram‌' ityādi| na ca lukśāstraṃ punaḥ pravarttate; bhraṣṭāvasaratvāt‌, tṛtīyābahuvacane kimatajarairbrāhmaṇakulairityevaṃ bhavitavyam‌; āhosavidatijarasam‌, atijarasairityevam‌? ityata āha--`atijarasam‌' ityādi| `gonarddīyamatena' iti| tathā hi bhāṣye uktam‌--`godardīya āha--`iṣaṭameṣaitat‌ saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavatīti--atijaramatijaraititi bhavitavyam‌' iti| kā punarasya yuktiḥ? ityata āha--`sannipātalakṣaṇa' ityādi| yadyambhāvaḥ, aisbhāvaśca jarasādeśasya nimittamātraṃ syāt‌, akārāntatā'ṅgasya tābhyāṃ vihatā syāt‌| etaccāyuktam‌; tasmannipāte hi tāvabhinirvṛttau notsahete sāṃ vihantum‌| `anye' iti| sūtrakāramatānusāriṇaḥ| kasmāt‌ punasta evaṃ manyante? ityata āha--`anityatvādasyāḥ' ityādi| anityatvaṃ punarasyāḥ--`ato bhisa ais‌' (7.1.9) ityatra pratipāditam‌|| 102. tyadādīnāmaḥ| (7.2.102) `syaḥ' iti| `tadoḥ saḥ sāvanantyayoḥ' (7.2.106) iti takārasya sakāraḥ| `tyaḥ' iti| `jasaḥ sī' (7.1.17) iti śībhāvaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `imau' iti| `daśca' (7.2.109) iti matvam‌| `asau' iti| `adasa au sulopaśca' (7.2.107)| `amū' iti| `adaso'serdādu do maḥ' 8.2.80) iti matvotve, `prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) iti dīrghaḥ| `amī' iti| `eta īdbahuvacane' (8.2.81) itīttvam‌| atheha kasmānna bhavati--bhavāniti? ata āha--`dviparyantānām‌' ityādi| etacca `śeṣe lopaḥ' (7.2.90) ityatra prāgvi jñāpitam‌| `bhavān' iti| `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌, `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghaḥ| atheha saṃjñopasarjanībhūtānāmapi kasmānna bhavati tyādadau--tyad‌ atisyad‌, atityadaḥ? ityata āha--`saṃjñopasarajanībhūtāḥ' ityādi| sarvādyantaḥpātinastyadādayaḥ| sarvādayaścāsaṃjñībhūtā anupasarjanībhūtaśca paṭhyante| tathā hi--teṣāṃ `sarvanāmāni' (1.1.27) iti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--sarveṣāṃ nāmabhūtānāṃ saṃjñā yathā syāt‌| ye tu kasyācideva saṃjñābhūtā upasarjanībhūtāśca, teṣāṃ mā bhūditi| tasmāt‌ saṃjñopasarjanībhūtāstyadādayaḥ pāṭhādeva paryudastāḥ, tyadādibhyo bahiṣkṛtā ityarthaḥ| tasmādatyadāditvāt‌ teṣāṃ na bhavati tyadādikāryam| `tyadādipradhāne śabde tu bhavatyeva' iti| tyadādayaḥ pradhānā yasmin‌ śabde sa tyadādipradhānaḥ, tatra bhavatyevāttvam‌; tasya pāṭhāpadaryudastatvāt‌| aparyudastatvaṃ tu sarvanāmasaṃjñāyastadantavidheḥ sarvāderabhyupagamāt‌|| 103. kimaḥ kaḥ| (7.2.103) athākāra eva kimaḥ kasmānna vidhīyate, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati, akāro hi prakṛto'nuvarttata iti, tatraivaṃ sutraṃ karttavyam‌, `kimo't‌' iti? ata āha--`sākackasyādeśo bhavati' iti| tenākāraḥ kimo na vidhīyate' iti| ayaṃ hyādeśaḥ `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate' (vyā.pā.21) akacaśca kimgrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌ sākackasyāpi bhavati; tenākāra eva kimaḥ sthāne na vidhīyate| yadi hi vidhīyeta, tadā'nakackasyādeśe kṛte yaścādakaci kaka ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ kimo'ttve kṛte ka iti bhavati, yāvatā makārasyāttve kṛte satakārasya yaṇādeśe kṛte kya iti syāt‌? naiṣa doṣa; ikārasyāpi hyattvaṃ vidhīyate, yadiha pūrvasūtrāt‌ `aḥ' ityanuvarttate| nālo'ntyasyātvaṃ bhavati yat‌ punarihākāragrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tena `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' (vyā.pa.63) itīkārasaya, tatra dvayorakārayoḥ parapūrvatve ka iti siddham‌| kyacit‌ pāṭhaḥ `imaḥ' iti| tatrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ--athākāra evemaḥ kasmānna vidhīyate? laghu hyevaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati; prakṛtasyākārasyehānuvṛtteḥ, tatraivaṃ tāvat‌ sūtraṃ karttavyam‌--`imaḥ' iti| na caivaṃ sati `tima ṣṭima ādrībhāve' (dhā.pā.1123,1124) ityasya kvibantasya tīn‌, timau, tima ityatrāpi prasajyeta, tyadādibhirimo viśeṣaṇāt‌--tyadādīnāṃ ya imiti? na; `daśca' (7.2.109) iti matve kṛta idama imau ima ityatrāpi prasajyeta| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) nāpīma ityucayamāne `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti prasajyetetyāśaṅkanīyam‌, yasmānnānarthake'lontyavidhiḥ (vyā.pa.62)? ityata āha--`sākackasyāpi' ityādi| pūrva eva pāṭhaḥ sādhutaraḥ| itaratra tu pāṭha uttarasūtreṇa kvādeśa imaḥ kṛte dvayoḥ kakārayośca saṃyuktayoḥ śravaṇaṃ prasajyeta, taccāniṣṭam‌|| 104. ku tihoḥ| (7.2.104) pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ| tiśabdasya vibhakterabhāvādikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| takārasyaiva prayojanam‌| tatra `yasminvidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) takārādeśo vibhaktau kāryaṃ vidhīyate| ata āha--`takārādau' ityādi| `kutaḥ' iti| `pañcamyāstasil‌' (5.3.7)| `kutra' iti| `kimo't‌' (5.3.12) ityatra parasūtrādvāgrahaṇaṃ purastādapakṛṣyate| tena pakṣe `saptamyāstral‌' (5.3.10) iti tralyapi bhavati| `kuha' iti| `vā ha ca cchabdasi' (5.3.13) iti haḥ| eṣāñca tasiladīnāṃ `prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ' (5.3.1) iti vibhaktisaṃjñā|| 105. kvāti| (7.2.105) kādeśasyāyamapavādaḥ| `kva' iti| `kimo't‌' (5.3.12) ityat‌| atha kimarthamādeśāntaraṃ vidhīyate, na prakṛtaḥ ku eva vidhīyatām‌, tatrāpi yaṇādeśo kveti sidhyatyeva; yogavibhāgaśca na karttavyo bhavati, `kutihātsu' ityeko yogaḥ kariṣyate? ityata āha--`ādeśāntaravacanam‌' ityādi| kuśabde hyādeśe sati yaṇādeśaṃ bādhitvā `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146) iti guṇaḥ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ tannivṛttyarthaṃ kvādeśa ityucyate| evamapi pratyayavidhāveva `kimo ḍvat‌' iti ḍvatpratyayo vidheyaḥ, tatrāpi ṭilope kṛte kveti rūpaṃ sidhyatyeva| padasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (7.2.39) iti kakārasya gakāraḥ prāpnotītyato na sidhyatīti cet‌? naitadasti; `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge (vyā.pa.42) iti ṭilopasyāsiddhatvājjaśtvaṃ na bhavati| ṭilopo hi ḍiti vidhīyate, tena ḍitamapekṣamāṇo bahiraṅgo bhavati| jaśtvaṃ tu padānte vidhīyamānaṃ nāparanimittamapekṣata ityantaraṅgamityata āha--`kimo ḍvaditi pratyayāntaram‌' ityādi| yadi ḍavaditi pratyayāntaraṃ vidhīyeta, sākackasya kveti rūpaṃ na sidhyati| asaci hi kṛte kakimiti sthite ḍvatpratyaye parataṣṭilope sati kakvetyaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syat‌| atpratyaye tu kvādeśo vidhīyamāno'nekāstvāt‌ sākackasya sarvādeśa eva bhavatīti na bhavatyaniṣṭarūpaprasaṅghaḥ| tasmāt‌ sākackārthaṃ ḍvaditi na pratyayāntaraṃ vidhīyate| sākacko'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat‌ sākackārtham‌|| 106. tadīḥ saḥ sāvanantyayoḥ| (7.2.106) `sai' iti| kimidaṃ prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇam‌? uta saptamībahuvacanasya? āhosvidubhayorapi? tatra prathamaikavacanasya grahaṇam‌| tathā hi--dvayorapi sāmānyena grahaṇaṃ na bhavati| yadi syāt‌, sīrtyevaṃ brūyāt‌| evaṃ hi sakārādau kāryaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ tayordvayorapi bhaviṣyati| tasmādanyatarasya grahaṇam‌| tathā hi--`syaśchandasi bahulam‌' (6.1.133) `so'ci lope cet‌' (6.1.134) ityevamādernirdeśāt‌ prathamaikavacanasyaiva grahaṇa yuktam‌| `he sa, sā' iti| he śabdo nipātasamudāyo'vadhāraṇārthe varttate| nanu ca tyadādyatvamatra bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; anavakāśā hi vidhayo badhakā bhavanti| sāvakāśaṃ cātvam‌| kovakāśaḥ? dviśabdaḥ-dvāviti| satyapi tasminnavakāśe yadyapi sakarasyāpyanantyovakāśaḥ, tathāpyantasya paratvāt‌ satvaṃ syāt‌| tataśca he sa ityatra `eṅ hrasvāt‌ sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sorlopo na syāt‌| tatra halṅyādilope kṛte rutvavisarjanīyayoḥ kṛtayoraniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| setyatra tu `ajādyataṣṭāp‌' (4.1.4) iti striyāṃ ṭābna syāt‌| tasmāt‌ `anantyayoḥ' iti vaktavyam‌|| 107. adasa au sulopaśca| (7.2.107) `sau' ityeva| tyadādyatvāpavādo'dasa autvaṃ vidhīyate| `asau' iti| pūrvasūtreṇa dakārasya sakāraḥ, `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhiḥ| `yadā ca' ityādi| `sādutvañca' iti| cakāraḥ sanniyogārthaḥ| tena yasmin‌ pakṣe autvapratiṣedhaḥ, tasminneva pakṣe sāduttarasyākārasyottvaṃ vidhīyate| `uttarapadamabhūtānām‌' ityādi| iha paramāham‌, paramāneneti `tvāhau sau' (7.2.94), `ido'y‌ puṃsi' (7.2.111), `anāpyakaḥ' (7.2.112) iti samāsād‌ yā vibhaktiḥ, tasyāmeta ādeśaḥ bhavanto bahiraṅgā bhavanti; prāgeva tu vibhaktyutpatteḥ| akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ prāpnuvadantaraṅgam‌, tasmāt‌ pūrvaṃ tadeva syāt‌, paścādādeśāḥ syuḥ; tataśca paramaham‌, paramayam‌, paramanenetyaniṣṭāni rūpāṇi rūpaṇi syuḥ| tasmāduttapadabhūtānāmakṛtasavarasandhīnāṃ tyadīdīnāmādeśā vaktavyāḥ-vyākhyeyā ityarthaḥ| ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--pūrvottarayoḥ padayostāvat‌ kāryaṃ prathamaṃ bhavati, paścādekādeśa ti| yadayaṃ `nendrasya parasya' (7.3.22) iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam‌? indre dvāvacau, tatraikaḥ--`yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopenāpahniyate, aparaḥ--ekādeśenetyanacka indraśabdaḥ sampannaḥ, tatra ko vṛddhiprasaṅgaḥ! paśyati tvācāryaḥ--purvottarayoḥ padayostāvat kāryaṃ bhavati, paścādekādeśa iti; yataḥ `nendrasya parasya' (7.3.22) iti vṛddhipratiṣedhaṃ śāsti| tadetasmājjñāpakādakṛtasvarasandhīnāmuttarapadabhūtānāṃ tyadādīnāmādeśā bhavantīti| `avasaḥ sorbhavedautvam‌' ityādi| avadhāraṇamatra draṣṭavyam‌| adaḥśabdāt‌ parasya sorevautvaṃ bhavet‌| bhavatu, mā vā bhūt‌| adaśśabdasya tyadādyatve kṛte `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhau kṛtāyāmasāviti sidhyatyeva, tat‌ kimarthaṃ sulope vidhīyate? nirarthakatavānnaivaṃ sorlopo vidheyaḥ, autvameva vidheyam‌| atra doṣamāha--`hrasvāllupyeta sambuddhiḥ' iti| he'sāvityatra `eṅa hrasvāt‌ sambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sorlopaḥ prasajyeta, tataśca sambuddhau he'sāviti na sidhyet‌? `na halaḥ prakṛtaṃ hi tat‌' iti| nāyaṃ deṣaḥ; halaḥ sambuddherlopa autve kṛte'ṇ‌ bhavati, na haliti, tatkuto lopaprasaṅgastatra! tarhi halgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌? na karttavyam‌; yasmāt‌ prakṛtaṃ tat‌| `halṅyābbhyaḥ sutisyapṛktaṃ hal‌' (6.1.68) ityato halgrahaṇaṃ prakṛtameva| yadyapi tatra prathamānirdiṣṭam‌, ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśena cehārthaḥ, tathāpi `eṅ‌ hrasvāt‌' (6.1.69) iti pañcamī halityasyāḥ prathamāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalapyiṣyati; `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti vacanāt‌| athaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ--`āpa etvaṃ bhavet‌ tasmin‌' ityādi| tasminnokāre paratastyadādyatve kṛte striyāṃ ṭāpi--he asau brāhmaṇītyatara `sambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) ityetvaṃ syāt‌, yathā hi he khaṭve ityatra? `na jñalītyanuvarttanāt‌' iti| nāyaṃ doṣaḥ; `sambuddho ca' (7.3.106) ityatra `bahuvacane jhalyet‌' (7.3.103) ityanuvarttate, tena jhalādau sambuddhāvetyena bhavitavyam‌| ca caukāre kṛte jhalādiḥ sambuddhirbhavati, kiṃ tarhi? ajādiḥ| `pratyayasthācca kādittvaṃ śībhāvaśca prasajyate' [`prasajyeta'--prā. mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| pūrvakaścakāraḥ tarhyarthe, itaraḥ samuccaye| ayaṃ tarhi doṣaḥ--asakau brāhmaṇītyatrājñātādyarthavivakṣāyāmakaci kṛte ṭāpi ca `pratyayasthāt‌ kāt‌' (7.3.44) ityādinā kāt‌ pūrvasyetvaṃ prāpnoti? asau brāhmaṇī ityatra `auṅa āpaḥ' (7.1.18) ityanena śībhāvo'dasastvavayava okāre kṛte ṭābeva nāstīti naitaddoṣadvayaṃ sambhavati| śībhāvadoṣaśca pākṣiko veditavyaḥ, yasmin‌ pakṣe sāmānyagrahaṇārtho ṅakāraḥ pratyayasyāsajyate| yadā tu pūrvasūtranirdeśastadā dvivacanayoreva śībhāvaḥ; tayoreva pūrvācāryairṅitvasya kṛtatvāt‌| anyasya prāptireva nāsti; āṅittvāt‌|| 108. idamo maḥ| (7.2.108) alo'ntyaparibhāṣayā (1.1.52) makārasyaivānena makāreṇa bhavitavyam‌, na ca makarasaya makārādeśe kṛte viśeṣo'sti, tatkimarthaṃ makārasya makāraḥ ityucyate? --ityetaccodyaṃ nirākartumāha--`makārasya' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 109. daśca| (7.2.109) `idamaḥ' iti varttate, `sau' iti nivṛttam‌; uttarasūtre punaḥ `sau' iti vacanāt‌| tenāyaṃ vibhaktimātre dākārasya makāro bhavati|| 110. yaḥ sau| (7.2.110) uttarasūtre puṃsīti vacanāt‌ striyāmayaṃ yakāraḥ| atha napaṃsake kasmānna vijñāyate? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum‌; napuṃsake hi `svamornarpusakāt‌' (7.1.23) iti sorlukā bhavitavyam‌| atra sāvucyamānaḥ kathaṃ tasmiṃtlupte yakāraḥ syāt‌; pratyayalakṣameneti cet‌? na; `na lumataṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇapratidhedhāt‌| tasmādyuktamuktam‌--`striyāmayaṃ yakāraḥ' iti|| 111. ido'y‌ puṃsi| (7.2.111) 112. anāpyakaḥ| (7.2.112) `anena' iti| tyadādyatve pararūpatve ca kṛta idrūpasyānādeśaḥ, `ṭāṅasiṅasāminātsyāḥ' (7.1.12) itīnādeśaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `anayoḥ' iti| `osi ca' (7.3.104) ityetvam‌, anādeśaḥ, sulopaḥ| `pakāreṇa' iti| atha kapaḥ pakāreṇa kasmānna bhavati? prayojanābhāvāt‌| nanu cehetyatra prāgdiśīyāyāṃ vibhaktau `hali lopaḥ' (7.2.113) yathā syāditīdamasti prayojanam‌? `idama iś‌' (5.3.3) itīśātra bādhakena bhavitavyam‌| atra ca `amehakvatisitrebhyaḥ' (kārikā 4.2.104) ityatra ihetyakṛtedrūpalopasya hakārāntasyedamo tirdeśo liṅgam‌|| 113. hali lopaḥ| (7.2.113) pūrveṇānādeśe prāpte halādāvidrūpasya lopo vidhīyate| `ābhyām‌' iti| tyadadyatvam; ato guṇe (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌, `supi ;ṭa (7.3.102) iti dīrghatvañca| athālo'ntyaparibhāṣayā(1.1.52)ntyasyāyaṃ lopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`nānarthake' ityādi| abhyupetyānarthake'lo'ntyavidhiṃ parihārāntaramāha--`atha vā' ityādi| na cālgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌, yatastadanuvarttate? ityata āha--`anāpyakaḥ' ityādi| yadyapi tatra prathamānirdiṣṭam, ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭena cehārthaḥ, tathāpi halīti saptamī anniti ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati; `tasminniti nirddiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti vacanāt‌| evaṃ parihāro bhāṣyakāramatena boddhavyaḥ; asyāḥ paribhāṣayā anaṅgīkaraṇāt‌| atra darśane tu trayāṇāmakarāṇāṃ pararūpamekādeśaṃ kṛtvā dīrghatvādi vidheyam‌|| 114. mṛjervṛddhiḥ| (7.2.114) `mārṣṭā' iti| `mṛjū śṛddhau' (dhā.pā.1066) vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, `ṣṭutvam‌| mṛjeḥ kvibantādvibhaktāvutpannāyāṃ kaṃsaparimṛṅbhyām‌, kaṃsaparimṛṅ‌bhirityatra vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, na ca kvibāśrayaḥ `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti vṛddhipratiṣedho bhavitumutsahate; yasmāt‌ kṅitīti niṃmittasaptamī| na cātra kvibnimittā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, kiṃ tarhi? vibhaktinimttā| tasmāt‌ tasyāḥ pratiṣedho vaktavya ityata āha--`mujariti dhātugrahaṇam‌' ityādi| bhrauṇahatya(6.4.174)miti nipātanena jñāpito'yamarthaḥ--dhātāḥ kāryamucyamānaṃ dhātupratyaya eva bhavatīti, tena kaṃsamṛṅbhyāmityatra na bhavati| yo hi dhātorityevaṃ vihitaḥ sa dhātupratayayaḥ| na ca bhyāmādikaṃ dhātorityevaṃ vihitam‌, kiṃ tarhi? prātipadikādityevam‌, tasmānnāso dhātupratyayaḥ| `kaṃsaparimṛṅbhyām‌' ityādi| pūrvavat‌ ṣatve kṛta ṣakārasya jaśtvaṃ ḍakāraḥ|| 115. aco ñṇiti| (7.2.115) `niścāyaniṣpāvau' [`ekasataṇḍulaniścāyaḥ, dvau śūrpaniṣpāvau'--kāśikā] iti| niṣpūrvāccinīteḥ, punāteśca `parimāṇākhyāyāṃ sarvebhyaḥ' (3.3.20) iti dhañ‌| `idupadhasya cāpratyayasya' (8.3.41) iti visarjanīyaṣatvam‌| `kāraḥ, hāraḥ' iti| kṛñaḥ hṛñaśca bhāve ghañ‌| `gauḥ, gāvo gāvaḥ' iti| `goto ṇit‌' (7.1.90) iti sarvanāmasthānasya ṇittvam‌| `sakhāyau, sakhāyaḥ' iti| atrāpi `sakhyurasambuddhau' (7.1.92) iti| `jayateḥ, yauteśca' iti| `ji jaye' (dhā.pā.561), `yu miśraṇe' [`miśraṇe'miśraṇe ca'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.1033)| `cyavateḥ' iti| `cyuṅa chyuṅ‌ jyuṅ‌ pruṅ‌ pluṅ‌ gatau'[nāsti--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.955-958)| ajgrahaṇamaniko'pi yathā syāt‌--goriti| nanu ṇitkaraṇasāmarthyādeva tatra bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; asti hyanyat‌ ṇitkaraṇasya prayojanam‌, kiṃ tat‌? gāvau, gāva ityavādeśe kṛte `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiryathā syāt‌| yadyevam‌, gaurityatrāguṇaviṣaye vṛddhiriyaṃ kṛtārtheti kārayatītyādiṣu paratvādguṇena bādhyeta? ṇitkaraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti| etaccānuttaram‌; `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) ityevamādau ṇitkaraṇasya caritārthatvāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--guṇaviṣaye'pi vṛddhirabhavatīti; yadayaṃ jāgarttarvṛddhiviṣaye pratiṣedhaviṣaye ca `jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu' (7.3.85) iti punarguma ārabhyate| yadi hi guṇaviṣaye vṛddharna syāt‌, tadā jāgarayatītyādiṣu guṇo'styeveti tadviṣaye guṇārambho'narthakaḥ syāt‌| vṛddhiviṣayatā cārambhasya ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedhādvijñāyate| atha yogavibhāgaḥ kimarthaḥ, na `ñṇityata upathāyāḥ' ityedocyeta? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum‌; evaṃ hyucyamāne yadyapi gāvo, gāva ityatrāvādeśe kṛte cāyakaḥ, lāvaka ityatra guṇe kṛte'yavādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ sidhyati--gauḥ, sakhāyau; jaitramityādau tu na sidhyati; ayavādeśayorguṇasya ca yathāyogamasambhavāt‌ smādyathāyogaṃ yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ|| 116. ata upadhāyāḥ| (7.2.116) pāka ityādau bhāve ghañ‌, `cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutvam‌| `rāgaḥ' iti| `ghañi ca bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' (6.4.27) ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `pācayati' iti| `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic‌| `cakāsayati' iti| upadhāgrahaṇādiha cakārādakārasya na bhavati| taparakaraṇaṃ lāghavārtham‌| asati hi sminnasyopadhāyā ityucyamāne gauravaṃ syāt‌| dīrghanivṛttyarthaṃ tu taparakaraṇaṃ na bhavati, na dīrghasya kṛtāyāṃ vṛddhau kaścidviśeṣo'sti|| 117. taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ| (7.2.117) `acām‌' iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| `acāmāderacaḥ sthāne' iti| nanu cekparibhāvopasthānādika eva sthāne vṛddhyā bhavitavyam‌, tasmādikaḥ sthāna ityevaṃ vaktavyam‌, na tvacaḥ sthāna iti? evaṃ manyate--`aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) ityataḥ sthāninirdeśārthaṃ dvitīyamajgrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena yathā `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) ityatra sthāninirdeśādikparibhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate, tathehāpītyadoṣaḥ| `gārgyaḥ, vātsyaḥ' iti| `gargādibhyo yañ‌' (4.1.105)| `dākṣiḥ, plākṣiḥ' iti| `ata iñ‌' (4.1.95)| `aupagavaḥ, kāpaṭavaḥ' iti| prāgdīvyatīyo'ṇ‌ (4.1.83)| atha tvāṣṭraḥ, jāgata ityatara tvaṣṭṛjagadbhyāṃ `tasyevam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇi kṛte yathākramaṃ `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) ityajlakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti, `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) ityupadhālakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`acāmādervṛddhirantyopadhāvṛrddhi bādhate' iti| kathaṃ punaranyasyocyamānā'nyasya bādhikā syāt‌? jñāpakāt‌| yadayamanuśatikādiṣu puṣkarasacchabdaṃ paṭhati, tajjñāpayati--yatrādivṛddhistatrānyā vṛddhirna bhavatīti| tasyānuśatikādiṣu pāṭhasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--ubhayapadavṛddhiryathā syāt‌, puṣkarasado'patyaṃ pauṣkarasādiriti| `bāhavādibhyaśca' (4.1.96) itīñ‌| yadi cādivṛddhiranyasyā vṛddherbādhikā na syāt‌, upadhālakṣaṇenaiva vṛddheḥ siddhatvāt‌ pauṣkarasādiśabdasya, puṣkarasacchabdo'nuśatikādiṣu na paṭhyeta| paśyatyācāryaḥ--yatrādipadavṛddhistatrānyā vṛddhirna bhavatīti; yato'nuśatikādiṣu puṣkarasacchabdaṃ paṭhati| nanu ṭhagarthastatra paṭhaḥ, tatra hyupadhālakṣaṇā vṛddhirna prāpnotīti ṭhako'ñṇittvāt‌--puṣkarasadā caratīti pauṣkarasādika iti? naitadasti; yadi puṣkarasacchabdāccaratyarthe ṭhagutpadyate| kasmāt‌ punarnotpadyate? anabhidhānāt‌| abhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā bhavantīti| tasmājjñāpaka evānuśatikādiṣu pāṭhaḥ puṣkarasacchabdasya|| 118. kiti ca| (7.2.118) yadyapi `taddhiteṣu' (7.2.117) iti bahuvacanāntaṃ prakṛtam‌, tathāpohaikavacananirdeśādekavacanaviṣayo bahuvacanasya vipariṇāmena vijñāyate, itayata āha--`kiti ca taddhite parataḥ' iti| `nāḍāyanaḥ, jārāyaṇaḥ' iti| `naḍādibhyaḥ phak‌' (4.1.99) iti phak‌| `ākṣikaḥ, śālākikaḥ ti| akṣiśalākāśabdābhyāṃ `tena dīvyata khanati jayati jitam' (4.4.2) iti ṭhak‌; `ṭhasyekaḥ' (7.3.50)|| iki bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ saptamādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ <7.3> atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. devikāśiṃśapādityavāḍdīrghasatraśreyasāmāt‌| (7.3.1) `taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' (7.2.117) ityāntaratamyādaikāre vṛddhau prāptāyāṃ devikādīnāmākāro vidhīyate| `atra pakṣatrayaṃ sambhāvyate--1. prakṛtenāṅgena devikādayo viśiṣyante--devikādīnāmaṅgānāmiti; 2. tairvāṅgam‌--`devikādyantasyāṅgasyeti, atha vā--3. tairādyo'c‌--devikadīnāṃ sambandhināmacāṃ madhye ya ādirajiti| tatra yadyādyaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, tadā devikākūle bhavāḥ śālayo dāvikākūlāḥ śālaya iti na sidhyet‌, na hyatara devikāśabdo'ṅgam‌, kiṃ tarhi? devikākūlaśabdaḥ| nanu cāṅgasyetyavayavaṣaṣṭhī, tatraivaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ kariṣyate--aṅgasya ye devikādayo'vayavabhūtā iti, bhavati cehāvayavo'ṅgasya devikāśabdaḥ, tato'yamodoṣa iti cet‌? satyametat‌ kintvatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt‌, sudevikāyāṃ bhavaḥ saudevikaḥ--ityatrāpi syāt‌| atha dvitīyapakṣa āśrīyeta, evamapi dāvikākūlāḥ śālaya iti na sidhyet‌| devikādibhiḥ prakṛte'ṅge viśeṣyamāṇe viśeṣaṇe ca tadantavidhiriti devikādyantasyāṅgasyeti bhavitavyam‌, na tadādeḥ| tasmāt‌ tadāderapi yathā sthāditi yatnāntaramāstheyamiti| tṛtīye tu pakṣa āśrīyamāṇe, vināpi yatnāntareṇa kevalasya tadādestadantasya bhavati| sarvatrācāmāderaco devikādisambandhitvāt‌| atastamevāśrityāha--`devikāśiṃśapādityavāḍ‌dīrghasattraśreyasa ityeteṣām‌' ityādi| eṣāṃ devikādīnāmacāṃ madhya ādibhūto yo'j‌ vṛddheraikārasya prasaṅge tasyākāro vidhīyate| `pūrvaśāṃśapa' iti| pūrvavaduttarapadasya vṛddhiḥ| sāpyākāra eva bhavatītyuttarapadādhikāre devikādīnāmanuvṛtterlabhyate| `vahīnarasyedvacanaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| akārasya yā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti tadvādhanārthamet‌| ikāre kṛte yā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti sā tu bhavatyeva| `kecittu' ityādi| kuṇaḍavāḍavādayaḥ| vihīno naraḥ kāmakrodhābhyāmiti pṛṣodarāditvānnalopaḥ, vihīnarasyāpatyaṃ vaihīnariḥ--`ata iñ‌' (4.1.95)|| 2. kekayamitrayupralayānāṃ yāderiyaḥ| (7.3.2) kekayamitrayupralayānāmiti yādyapekṣayā'vayavaṣaṣṭhī| yāderityeṣāpītyādeśāpekṣayā sthānaṣaṣṭhī-ya ādiryasya sa yādiḥ| akārasahito yakāra ukārasahitaśca| kekayādīnāṃ yo'vayavo yādistasyeyādeśo bhavati| nanu ca mitrayuśabdaḥ paramaprakṛtiḥ, na gotram‌; `apatyaṃ potraprabhṛti gotram‌' (4.1.162) ityapatyaviśeṣasya gotrasaṃjñāvidhānāt‌, tatkathaṃ gotrāducyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ paramaparakṛterbhavati? ityata āha--`laukikaṃ hi' ityādi| kiṃ punarlaukikaṃ gotram‌? ityata āha--`loke ca' ityādi| iha laukikaṃ gotraṃ gṛhyate| loke ca ṛṣiśabdaḥ `gotram‌' ityabhidhīyate| mitrayuśabdaścāyamuṣivacanaḥ, tasmāt‌ tato'pi gotrāducyamānaḥ pratyayo bhavatīti| `prāleyam‌' iti| `ata āgataḥ' (4.3.74) ityaṇ‌|| 3. na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau tu tābhyāmaic‌| (7.3.3) `taddhiteṣvacāmādeḥ' (7.2.117) ityādinā ñṇidādau taddhite vṛddhau prāptāyāṃ pratiṣedho'yamucyate, tatsanniyogenaijāgamau bhavataḥ| `yakārādaikāraḥ' ityādinā yatāsaṃkhyena sambandhaṃ darśayati| `vaiyasanam‌' iti| `asu kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209)| vipūrvādviśeṣeṇāsyate kṣipyate yeneti karaṇe lyuṭ‌, prādisamāsaḥ, yaṇādeśaḥ, tata, `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityaṇ‌| tatra yakārāt‌ padāntāt‌ parasyākārasya vṛddhirna bhavati, tasmāt‌ pūrvamaijāgamaḥ| `vaiyākaraṇaḥ' iti| viśeṣeṇākriyante vyutpādyante śabdā aneneti karaṇe lyuṭ‌, vyākaraṇamiti, prādisamāsaḥ, tataḥ `tadadhīte tadveva' (4.2.59) ityaṇ‌, tatra parjanyavallakṣaṇapravṛttyā padāntādyakārāt‌ parasaya yā vṛddhiḥ prāpnoti sā na bhavati, tasmāt‌ pūrvamaijāgamaḥ| `sauvaśvaḥ' iti| śobhano'śvaḥ svaśvaḥ, pūrvavat‌ samāsaḥ, tato'patyarthe śivādyaṇ‌ (4.1.112)| atra vakārāt‌ padāntāt‌ parasya vṛddhirna bhavati, tasmāt‌ pūrvamaijāgamo bhavati| `ārthiḥ' iti| nā artho yasya sa arthaḥ, tasyāpatyam‌ `uta iñ‌' (4.1.95)| `yāṣṭakaḥ' iti| `śaktiyaṣṭyorīkak‌' (4.4.59)| `yātāḥ' iti| iṇaḥ parasya laṭaḥ śatrādeśaḥ, `iṇo yaṇ‌' (6.4.81) iti yaṇ‌, tataḥ `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| tatrobhayatrāpi yakārasya padāntatā bhaviṣyataḥ, yathā--`brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya' iti dadhidānasya takradānāṃ bādhakam‌| athāpi bādhagau na syātām‌, tathāpi nityatvādaicoḥ kṛtayo paścād‌vṛrbhavantī tayoreva bhaviṣyatīti| na cātra śabdāntaraprāptyā tayorapyaicoranityatvamāśaṅkanīyam‌, na hi tau śabdāntarasaya vidhīyete, api tvabhakatāveva yvābhyāṃ pūrvau| yadyapi śabdātantarasya prāptiḥ syāt‌, tathāpi dvayoranityayoḥ paratvādaicoḥ kṛtayoḥ sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadbādhitaṃ tadbādhitameva' (vyā.pa.40) iti punarvṛddhirna bhavati| yadyapi punaḥprasaṅgavijñānād‌vṛddhiḥ syāt‌; tathāpīṣṭasiddhiḥ syādeva; viśeṣābhāvādityata āha--`pratiṣedhavacanam‌' ityādi| praklṛtiḥ-prakalpanam‌, vyavasyetyarthaḥ| yatra yvābhyāṃ parasya vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ sa evaicorviṣayaḥ kathannāma prakalpeta?vyavatiṣṭhetetyevamarthaḥ| pratiṣedha ucyate, kimarthaṃ punarai corviṣayaparaklṛptiḥ kriyate? ityata āha--`iha mā bhat‌' iti| yadi prataṣedhavacanenaicorviṣayanyavasthā na kriyeta, tadā dādhyaśviḥ, mādhvaśvirityatrāpi syāt| ato mā bhūdeṣa doṣa iti pratiṣedhavacanenaicorviṣayanyavasathā kriyate| dadhipriyo'śvo dadhyaśvaḥ madhupriyo'śvo madhyaśvaḥ| `sāmānādhikaraṇādhikāre śāpakapārthivādīnāṃ samāsa uttarapadalopaśca' (vā.83) iti madhyamapadalopau samāsaḥ| atha kriyamāṇe pratiṣedhavacane kasmādevātra na bhavati, yāvatā yvābhyāṃ parasya vṛddhirnāsti? ityata āha--`na hyatra' ityādi| prasaṅge hi sati vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho bhavati, nāsati; na cātra yvābhyāṃ parasya vṛddheḥ prasaṅgo'sti, ataḥ prateṣedho nāstyevetyabhiprāyaḥ| nanu ca `acāmādeḥ' (7.2.117) ityanuvarttate, tena yvau viśiṣyete--acāmāderacaḥ sthāne yau yvāditi| na ca dadhyaśvirityādāvevaṃvidhau tau sta iti| na cātraico bhaviṣyataḥ, ato nārthaḥ? naitadasti; evaṃ hayacāmādigrahaṇam‌, tena yadi yvau viśiṣyete tadā vṛddhiraviśeṣitā syāt‌| tataścehāpi vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌--dve aśītī bhṛto bhṛto bhāvī vā `prāgvateṣṭhañ‌' (5.1.18) dvyāśautika iti| atha vṛddhirviśiṣyate--acāmāderityevaṃ vā vṛddhiḥ, tato na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| na hyatrācāmāderityevaṃ vṛddhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `saṃkhyāyā saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' (7.3.15) ityevam‌| kiṃ tarhi yvau na viśeṣitau syātām‌? tataśca dādhyaśvirityādāvaicau syātāmeva| tasmāt‌ tayorviṣayavyavasthārthaṃ neti vaktavyam‌| `uttarapadavṛddherapyayaṃ pratiṣedha iṣyate' iti| sa cottarapadādhikāre'syānuvarttamānatvāllabhyate| `pūrvatraiyalinde' iti| atra `viśo'madrāṇām‌' (7.3.13) ityuttarapadavṛddhau prāptāyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| yadyuttarapadavṛddherapyayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, tadā dvyāśītika ityatrāpi `saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' (7.3.15) iti yā vṛddhiruttarapadasya āptetyasyā api pratiṣedhaḥ syādityata āha--`yatra tu' ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'pyatra pratiṣedho na bhavati? uttarapadasyācāmādyenācā hi yvorviśeṣaṇatvāt‌| uttarapadasambandī yo'cāmādirac‌ tasya sthāne yo yvau tābhyāmuttarapadasya vṛddhirna bhavati| na ca dvyāśītika ityatrottarapadasyācāmāderacaḥ sthāne yakāra iti nātra vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho bhavatīti|| 4. dvārādīnāñca| (7.3.4) `dauvārikaḥ' iti| `tatra niyuktaḥ' (4.4.69) iti ṭhak‌| `dvārapālasyedaṃ dauvārapālam' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| prāyeṇa tu pustakeṣu `dvārapālasyevaṃ dauvārapālikam' iti| pāṭhaḥ, sa cāyuktaḥ; na hi tasyaida(4.3.120)mityatrārthe dvārapālaśabdāt‌ lakṣaṇena kenaciṭṭhagvihitaḥ| kvacit‌ punaḥ `dvārapālasyāpatyaṃ dauvārapālikaḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ, tatra `revatyādibhyaṣṭhak‌ (4.1.146) iti ṭhak‌| nanu| tatra dvārapālīśabdaḥ paṭhyate, na tu dvārapālaśabdaḥ? evaṃ tarhi manyate--dvārapālaśabdastatra paṭhitavyaḥ, sa dvārapālīśabdamapi grāhayiṣyati; `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.29) iti| nyāyāt‌| ye tu tatra dvārapālaśabdaṃ na paṭhanti, te'patyārthe dauvārapāliritīñantamudaharanti| kathaṃ punardvārasya gaṇe dvārapālasya bhavati? atrāpi dvārādibhirādyaco viśeṣaṇat‌--dvārādīnāṃ śabdānāmacāṃ madhye ya ādirajiti| vakṣyamāṇādvā tadādividhejñapikāt‌| `sauvaraḥ' iti| svaramadhikṛtya kṛto grantha iti `athikṛtya kṛte granthe' (4.3.87) ityaṇ‌| `sauvaryyaḥ' iti| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.1.5) iti ṅīp‌| `vaiyalkaśaḥ' iti| `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityaṇ‌| `sauvastikaḥ' iti| `tadāheti māśabdādibhya upasaṃkhyānaṃm‌' (vā.482) iti ṭhak‌| `sovargamanikaḥ' [`sauvargamikaḥ'--kāśikā] iti| `āhau prabhūtādibhya upasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.483) iti ṭhak‌| `pūrveṇaiva siddham‌' iti| vakārasya padāntatvāt‌ tatraitat‌ syāt‌| yadyevaṃ vyutpattiḥ kriyate--svo'dhyāyaḥ svādhyāyaḥ, tadā'padāntatvānna prāpnoti, tasyāṃ vyutpattāvarthavān‌ svadhyāyaśabdasya pāṭhaḥ? ityata āha--`athāpyevam‌' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ svaśabdāt‌ svādhyāyaśabdasya sidhyati? ityāha--`tadādāvapi hi' ityādi| `sphaiyakṛtaḥ'[sphaikṛtaḥ--kāśikā] iti| `ṛṣyandhakavṛṣṇikurubhyaśca' (4.1.114) ityaṇ‌| `sauvādumṛdavaḥ'[sovādumṛdavam‌--kāśikā] iti| atrāpi `tasyaidam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| evaṃ `śauvanam‌' ityatrāpi| `śauvam‌' iti| `nastaddhite' (6.4.144) iti ṭilopaḥ| `śauvādaṃṣṭraḥ' iti| `anyeṣāmapi' (6.3.137) iti dīrghaḥ|| 5. nyagrodhasya ca kevalasya| (7.3.5) `naiyagrodhaḥ' iti| `tasya vikāraḥ' (4.3.134) ityaṇ‌| `nyaga rohatīti nyagrodhaḥ' iti| nyañcatīti ṛtvi(3.2.59)gādinā'ñcateḥ kvin‌, `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvam‌--kakāraḥ, neryaṇādeśaḥ| nyakpūrvādrūheḥ pacādyac‌| tatra `nyaṅkvādīnāñca' (7.3.53) iti hakārasya dhakāraḥ, `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti kakārasya gakāraḥ, laghūpadhaguṇaḥ--evaṃ yadā nyagrodhaśabdo vyutpādyate tadā padāntatvādyakārasya `na yvābhyām‌' (7.3.3) ityādinaiva siddhe niyamārthaṃmetat‌--kevalasyaiva yathā syāt‌, tadādermā bhūditi| `avyutpattipakṣe vidhyarthametat‌' iti| apadāntatvādyakārasya|| 6. na karmavyatihāre| (7.3.6) `yaduktam‌' iti| vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ, aijāgamaśca| `vyāvakrośo' [`vyākrośī' iti mu. pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| `kruśa āhvāne' [`āhvāne rodane ca'--dhā.pā.] (dhā.pā.856), `likha akṣaravinyāse' (dā.pā.1365), `carca adhyayane' (dhā.pā.1712) curādiḥ, `hase hasane' (dhā.pā.721)--ebhyo vyavapūrvebhyo ṇac‌, tadantādañ‌| atra yathokte kārye pratiṣiddhe vṛddhireva bhavati, dvau pratiṣedho prakṛtyarthaṃ gamayata iti kṛtvā| `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌|| 7. svāgatādīnāñca| (7.3.7) `svāgatikaḥ' iti| śobhanamāgataṃ svāgatam‌| `tadāhetyādau prabhūtādibya upasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.483) iti ṭhak| `svādhvarikaḥ' iti| atrāpi `carati' (4.4.8) iti ṭhak‌| śobhano'dhvaraḥ svadhvaraḥ| `svāṅgiḥ' ityādi| `svāṅgirṇyāḍiḥ' iti| `ata iṅ‌' (4.1.95)| śobhanānyaṅgānyasya svaṅgaḥ, vigatānyaṅgānyasya vyaṅgaḥ, vigato'ḍo'sya vyaṅaḥ| vyavaharaṇaṃ vyavahāraḥ, bhāve ghañ‌| nanu ca vyavahāraśabdo'yaṃ kramavyatīhāre varttate, tatra `na karmavyatīhāre' (7.3.6) iti pratiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ, tat‌ kasmādiha paṭhyate? ityāha--`vyavahāraśabdo'yam‌' iti| kiṃ punarlaukikam‌? laukikaṃ punarvṛttaṃ yenācāreṇa vyavahārālloke vyāvahārika ityucyate tadveditavyam‌| `svāpateyam‌' iti| `pathyatithivasatisvapateḍhaiñ‌' (4.4.104)| kathaṃ punaratra prāptiḥ, yāvatā nāsya vakāraḥ padantaḥ? ityāha--`dbārādiṣu svaśabdapāṭhādasya prāptiḥ' iti| tadādividhinetyabhiprāyaḥ| yatā tadādividhirbhavati tathā tatraivoktam‌|| 8. śvāderiñi| (7.3.8) `śvābhāstriḥ śvādaṃṣṭriḥ' iti| śveva bhastrā yasaya, śuna iva daṃṣṭrā yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, upasarjanahrasvatvam‌| kena punaḥ śvādervṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti; yato'yaṃ pratiṣedha ucyate, na hyasya vakāraḥ padānataḥ? ityata āha--`śvaśabdo drārādiṣu paṭhyate' iti| nanu ca kevalaḥ śvaśabdo dvārādiṣu paṭhyate, tatra kaḥ prasaṅgau yatastadādeḥ syāt‌! `yasmin‌ vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) it tadadividhirti cet‌? naitadasti; saptamīnirdiṣṭai halgrahaṇe ca sati tadādividhirbhavati, na cātraitadubhayamastītyata āha--`tatra ca' ityādi| yadi tatra tadādividhirna syāt‌, tadaitat‌ pratiṣedhavacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; prāptvabhāvādityabhiprāyaḥ| jñāpakasaya prayojanam‌--śauvādaṃṣṭro maṇirityādau vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ| `ikārādigrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| ikārāditaddhito gṛhyate, yena tadikārādigrahaṇaṃ vyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| kimarthamityāha--`śvāgaṇikādyartham‌' iti| śvāgaṇikādīnāmarthaḥ-prayojanaṃ yasmiṃstat‌ tathoktam| arthastu teṣāmādivṛddhireva| tatraivaṃ vyākhyānam‌--iñ‌grahaṇamihekārādestaddhitasyopalakṣaṇārtham‌, tenānyatrāpi taddhite pratiṣedho bhavatīti| `tadantasya' iti| iñantasyānyannāyīti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇo'nyatra labhyate, yāvatā'nyatrāpi taddhita utpanna iñaḥ `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) iti lopena bhavitavyam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iñīti neyaṃ nimittasaptamī, kiṃ tarhi? parasaptamī| nimittasaptamyāmaṇnimittāya vṛddheḥ pratiṣedhasya pratiṣedho na syāt‌| parasaptamyāṃ tu yadyapi lopaḥ kriyate, tathāpi sthānivadbhāvāt‌ pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati| `śvābhastram‌' iti| `iñaśca' (4.2.112) ityaṇ‌|| 9. padāntasyānyatarasyām‌| (7.3.9) pūrveṇa nitye prāpte pratiṣedhe vikalpa ucyate| `padāntasya' iti| padaśabdāntasyetyarthaḥ| `śvāpadam‌' iti| śuna iva padamasyeti śvapadaḥ, tasyedaṃ śvāpadam‌| `śauvāpadam‌' iti| `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti dīrghaḥ|| 10. uttarapadasya| (7.3.10) aṅgasyacāmāderaco vṛddhau prāptāyāmidamucyate| nanu ca `avayavādṛtauḥ' (7.3.11) ityadau pañcamīnirdeśādantareṇāpyuttarapadādhikāraṃ `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) ityuttarapadasyaiva bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kimuttarapadādhikāreṇa? itayata āha--`yatra'--ityādi| ādiśabdena `hṛdbhagasindhvante pūrvapadasya' (7.3.19), `anunnatikādīnāñca' (7.3.20), `devatādvandve ca' (7.3.21)--ityevamādayo gṛhyante| eṣu pañcamīnirdeśābhāvādasatyuttarapadādhikāro'ṅgasayācāmāderaca eva vṛddhiḥ syāt‌, nottarapadasya| tasmāt‌ tadarthamuttarapadādhikāraḥ kriyate| yadyevam‌, iha `avayavādṛtoḥ' (7.3.11) ityetannopanyasanīyam‌, atra pañcamīnirdeśasya vidyamānatvāt? iti codyamāśaṅkyānyārthaṃ kriyamāṇasya yatrāpi pañcamīnirdeśo'sti, tatrāpi prāsaṅkikaṃ kāryaṃmāha--`pañcamīnirdeśeṣvapi' ityādi| prayojanāntaramaparyāha--`vṛddheśca' ityādi| uttarapadādhikāre yā vihitā vṛddhirityeṣa vyapadeśo vṛddheryathā syādityavamakchañcottarapadādhikāraḥ kriyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamevaṃ vṛddheravyapadeśaḥ prārthyate? ityāha--`uttarapadavṛddhau' ityādi| uttarapadādhikāre vihite vṛddhimatyuttarapade pūrvapadasyāntodāttatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌| `uttarapadavṛddhau sarvañca' (6.2.105) ityatrottarapadādhikāre yā vihitā vṛddhirityevaṃ vidhāyate| etatkathaṃ śakyate vijñātum‌? yadi vyapadeśārtha uttarapadādhikāraḥ kriyate, nānyathā| tasmādvyapadeśārthaścottarapadādhikāraḥ karttavyaḥ|| 11. avayavādṛtoḥ| (7.3.11) `ṛtoḥ' [nāsti--mu. pustake] iti| nedaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam‌, kiṃ tarhi? arthagrahaṭhaṇam‌| tathā hyavayayavādityucyate, ṛtoścāyaṃ evāvayadhī bhavati| avayavithyenatau| vijñayamāne'rthanirdeśo'yaṃ vijñāyate, tataścāvayavavācinaḥ pūrvapadāduttarasyarttuvācinaḥ kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`avayavavācinaḥ' ityādi| `ekadeśisamāsaḥ' iti| pūrvāparādisūtreṇa (2.2.1)| nanu grahaṭhaṇavatā prāptipadhekena tadantavidhiḥ (vyā.pa.89) pratiṣidhyate, tatkathaṃ varṣāhemantābhyāṃ pratyayo vidhīyamānastadantābhyāṃ lakṣyate? ityāha--`tatra ṛtī vṛddhimadvidhāvavayavānām‌' iti| `paurvavarṣikaḥ' [paurvavārṣikam‌--kāśikā] iti| pūrvāśca tā varṣāśceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaṃ kṛtvā bhavārthe taddhito vidheyaḥ| pūrvaśabdo'tra kālavācī, na tvavayavavācītyaṅgasyādivṛddhireva bhavatoti| athātrāpi tadantavidhinā ṭhak‌ kasmānna bhavapati? ityāha--`avayavapūrvasyaiva hi' ityādi|| 12. susarvārdhājjanapadasya| (7.3.12) `janapadasya' iti| nevaṃ svarūpagrahaṇam‌, uttarasūtre `amadrāṇām‌' (7.3.13) iti niṣedhāt‌| uttarasūtrehīdameva janapadagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tato'tra yadi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, madrāṇāṃ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌, tasmādarthasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌, tena janapadavacinaḥ kāryaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`susarvārdhaṃ ityetebya uttarasya janapadavācinaḥ' ityādi| `supāñcālakaḥ' iti| śobhanāḥ pañcālā iti prādisamāsaḥ| `sarvapāñcālakaḥ' iti| `pūrvakālaika' (2.1.49) ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ| `ardhapāñcālakaḥ' iti| `ardha napuṃsakam‌' (2.2.2) ityardhaśabdena tatpuruṣaḥ| sarvatra śaiṣike jātādāvarthe taddhitaḥ| kathaṃ janapadāt‌ `janapadatadavadyośca' (4.2.124) ityucyamānaḥ pratyayastadantādbhavati? ityāha--`susarvārdhadikśabdebhyaḥ' ityādi|| 13. diśo'madrāṇām‌| (7.3.13) `pūrvapāñcālakaḥ' iti| pūrveṣu pāñcāleṣu bhavati iti taddhitārthe samāsaḥ, tato vṛñ‌| diśa iti kim‌? pūrvaṃ pāñcālānāṃ pūrvāpāñcālaḥ| pūrvāparādi (2.2.1) sūtreṇaikādeśisamāsaḥ, tatra bhavaḥ paurvapāñcālaḥ| diśi yo varttate sa iha dikśabdo'bhipretaḥ| na cāyaṃ pūrvaśabdo diśi varttate, kiṃ tarhi? avayave| tena pūrvapadavṛddhireva bhavati| yogavibhāga uttarārthaḥ| prācāṃ grāmanagarāṇāṃ diśa evottarapadasya yathā syāt‌, susarvārdhānmā bhūditi|| 14. prācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām‌| (7.3.14) `janapadasya' (7.3.12) ityanuvarttate, tena prācāmityetaddeśagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate na tvācāryagrahaṇamiti mātvā''ha--`prācāṃ deśe grāmāṇām‌' ityādi| `purveṣukāmaśamaḥ' iti| pūrvā cāsāviṣukāmaśamī ceti `diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām‌' (2.1.50) iti samāsaḥ, tato bhavārthe `dikpūrvapadādasaṃjñāyāṃ ñaḥ' (4.2.107) iti| `pūrvapāṭaliputrakaḥ' iti| pūrvasmin‌ pāṭaliputre bhava iti pūrvavat‌ taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| `ropadhetoḥ' (4.2.123) iti vuñ‌| nanu caikameva pāṭaliputram‌, tatra pāṭaliputrāntarasya vyavacchedyasyābhāvāt‌, tatkathaṃ pūrvaśabdena pāṭaliputraśabdo viśiṣyate? pāṭaliputraikadeśe pāṭaliputraśabdo varttata ityadoṣaḥ| atha nagaragrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na `grāmāṇām‌' ityevaṃ siddham‌, nagaramapi hi grāmo bhavatyeva; jananikāyanivāse grāmo rūḍhaḥ, nagarañca jananikāyanivāsa eva, ataśca nagaramapi grāmaḥ, yato ye grāme vidhayo neṣyante, nagare'pi te na kriyante| tathā hi--`abhakṣyo grāmyakukkuṭaḥ', `abhakṣyo grābhyaśūkaraḥ'--ityukte nāgaro'pi na bhakṣyate; `grāme nādhyetavyam‌' ityukte nagare'pi nādhīyate, tasmānnagaramapi grāmaḥ| evañca kṛtvā--`udīcyagrāmācca bahvaco'ntodāttāt‌', (4.2.109), `vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca' (4.2.117), `dikśabdā grāmajanapadākhyānacānarāṭeṣu' (6.2.103) ityatra grāmagrahaṇena nagaragrahaṇamapi bhavatītyāha--`grāmatvādeva' ityādi| yadi tarhi nagaramapi grāmaḥ, tadā `viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadīdeśo'grāmāḥ' (2.4.7) ityatra nagaragrahaṇaṃ prāpnoti? satyametat‌, tatra tu nagarāṇāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| sa eva ca sambandhabhedaḥ kuto hetorbhavati, yasya pratipattathe grāmanagarayorbhedenopādānaṃ kriyate! ityāha `dikpūrvapado hi' ityādi| yadi hi yathā dikpūrvapadaḥ pūrvottarasamudāyaḥ pūrveṣukāmaśamyādirgrāmanāmadheyam‌, tathā nagaranāmadheyamapi syāt‌, tataḥ sambandho na bhidyeta| yathā ca pāṭaliputrādiśabdarūpamuttarapadabhūtameva nagarasaya vācakam‌, tathā yadi grāmanāmadheyamapi grāmasya syāt‌, evamapi sambandho na bhidyeta? na caivam‌; anyādṛśa eva hi pūrvottarasamudayātamako grāmavācī śabdaḥ, anyādṛśaścotatarapadātmako nagaravācī śabdaḥ| tasmādgrāmanagarayorbhedāt‌ sambandhabhedo bhavati| evaṃ sambandhabhedahetuṃ darśayitvā sambandhabhedaṃ darśayannāha--`tatra' ityādi| `grāmavācinām‌' iti| pūrvoṣukamaśamītyevamādīnām‌| `avayavasya' iti| iṣukāmaśamī-kṛṣṇamṛttiketyevamādeḥ| `dikśabdāt‌' iti| purvādeḥ| `itaratra tu' ityādi| nagareṣu| `deśa uttareṣāṃ nagarāṇām‌' iti| atra vṛddhirbhavatītyabhisambandhaḥ kriyata ityetadapekṣyate|| pūrveṣukāmaśana ityevamādiṣu pūrvottarapadayorantaraṅgatvādguṇe kṛte dikśabdogrāmaścottarapadaṃ nāstīti vṛddhirna prāpnoti, vṛddhirhi taddhite kṛte tadāśrayeṇa bhavantī bahiraṅgā bhavati| prāgeva taddhitotpatterguṇaḥ prāpnuvannantaraṅgo bhavati| na ca vacanādvṛddhirbhaviṣyatīti śakyate vaktum‌, yatra hyekādeśo nāsti sa ca vacanasyāvakāśaḥ--pūrvakārṣṇamṛttika ityevamādau| na cāntāvivadbhāvo'sti; `ubhayata āśraye nāntādivat‌' (vyā.pa.51) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| ato'tra pūrvapadamuttarapadañcāśrīyate? iti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`purveṣukāmaśama ityevamādiṣu' ityādi| yathā `nendrasya parasya' (7.3.22) iti nirdeśanāyamartho jñāpitaḥ tathā `adasa au sulopaśca' (7.2.107) ityatra pratipāditaḥ| `grāmanagarāṇām‌' iti bahuvacanaṃ svarūpavidhinirāsārtham‌|| 15. saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca| (7.3.15) `dvisāṃvatsarikaḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌ taddhitārthe samāsaḥ| tataḥ prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ‌| `dviṣāṣṭikaḥ, dvisāptatikaḥ' iti| nanu ca `tamadhīṣṭo bhṛto bhṛto bhāvī' (5.1.80) ityatra kālāditi| (5.1.78) varttate, na dviṣaṣṭyādiḥ kālaśabdaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? saṃkhyāśabdaḥ, tatkathaṃ kālādhikāravihitaṃ pratyayamutpādayati? ityāha--`dviṣaṣṭyādiśabdaḥ' ityādi| kālavāciśabdastatra kālagrahaṇena gṛhyate, dviṣaṣṭyādiśabdo hi yadā varṣeṣu saṃkhyeyeṣu varttate, tadā kālavācitvāt‌ kālaśbdo bhavati| tataḥ kālādhikārīyaṃ pratyayamutyādayati| atha saṃvatsaragrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvataḥ `parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' (7.3.17) ityatra parimāṇaśabdena paricchedahetumātra gṛhyate, na tu prasthādivadārohapariṇāhaparicchedahetuḥ, anyathā hi śāṇapratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌, na hi śāṇaḥ parimāṇamārohaparaṇāhaparicchedahetuḥ, ataḥ kālo'pi paricchedaheturbhavati, tataśca so'pi parimāṇamiti saṃvatsaraśabdasya `parimāṇasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' (7.3.17) ityeva siddham‌? iti codyanirāsāyāha--`saṃvatsaragrahaṇam‌' ityādi| parimāṇagrahaṇena kālaparimāṇasya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ saṃvatsaragrahaṇam‌| saṃvatsaragrahaṇenāsāvartho jñāpyate--`parimāṇagrahaṇe kālaparimāṇagrahaṇaṃ na bhavati' iti| tataśca yatra parimāṇagrahaṇaṃ tatra kalaparimāṇaṃ na gṛhyate| `tena' ityādinā parimāṇagrahaṇe kālaparimāṇasyāgrahaṇe sati yadiṣṭaṃ sidhyati taddarśayati| `uttarapadavṛddhirana bhavati' iti| `parimāṇāntasya' (7.3.17) ityādinā| `dvivarṣā' iti| dve varṣe bhṛto bhūto bhāvī vā, pūrvavaṭṭhak, tasya `varṣālluk‌' (5.1.88) ityanuvarttamāne `cittavati nityam‌' (5.1.89) iti luk‌| `paryudāso na bhavati' iti| ṅīppratiṣedhe karttavye tena pratiṣedhaḥ| pravarttata eveti `dvigoḥ' (4.1.21) iti ṅībna bhavati|| 16. varṣasyābhaviṣyati| (7.3.16) `dve varṣe adhīṣṭo bhṛto vā karma kariṣyatati daivārṣiko manuṣyaḥ' iti| atrādhīṣṭabhṛtayostaddhita utpanne bhaviṣyatā pratīyate, tasmāt‌ tayorapi pratiṣedhena bhavitavyamiti kasyācidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākartumāha--`adhīṣṭabhṛtayoḥ' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ na bhavati? ityāha--`gamyate hi' ityādi| tatra yadi śabdāntaram‌ `dve varṣe adhīṣṭo bhṛto vā karma kariṣyati' iti prayujyate, tato bhaviṣyattā gamyate, nānyathā| tasmānnāsau taddhitārtha ityadhīṣṭabhṛtayorabhaviṣyatīti pratiṣedho na bhavati| nanu ca manuṣye'bhidheye `cittavati nityam‌' (5.1.89) iti ṭhaño lukā bhavitavyam‌, tatkathaṃ dvivārṣiko manuṣya iti sidhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hyasāvadiśeṣeṇa luk‌, kiṃ tarhi? viśiṣṭa eva viṣaye| katham‌? tatara nityagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌, pūrveṇaiva siddha ārambhasāmarthyādeva nityaṃ lugbhaviṣyatīti, tat‌ kṛtaṃ viśiṣṭe viṣaye bhūte yathā syāt‌, adhoṣṭādī mā bhūdityevamartham‌| tenādhīṣṭādau `varṣālluk‌' (5.1.88) iti vibhāṣaiva lugbhavati|| 17. paramāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ| (7.3.17) saṃjñāyāḥ paratvaṃ na sambhavatītyataḥ saṃjñāśāṇayoriti viṣayasaptamīṃ darśayannāha--`saṃjñāyāṃ viṣaye' ityādi| `śāṇe cottarapade' iti| viṣaya ityapekṣate| yadyapyuttarapadasya[yadyuttarapadasya--mudrita pāṭhaḥ] śāṇasya paratvamupapadyate, tathāpi durghaṭamekasyāḥ saptamyā viṣayasaptamītvam‌, parasaptamītavañceti| tena śāṇaśabdamapyuttarapadaṃ prati viṣayasaptamyeṣā yuktā| `dvikauḍavikam‌' iti| `prāgvateṣṭhaña' (5.1.18)| anārhīyatvācca pratyayasya `adhyarthapūrvadvigoḥ' (5.1.28) iti lugna bhavati| `dvisauvarṇikaḥ' [dvisauvaraṇikam--kāśikā] iti| sa eva pratyayaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra vṛddhiḥ, yāvatā parimāṇāntasyetyucyate, suvarṇañca gurutvamānādunmānam‌, na parimāṇamiti? naiva doṣaḥ; ācāryapravṛttirjñāyati--`gurutvaparimāṇamapīha paricchedahetutvāt‌ pūrimāṇaṃ gṛhyate' iti; yadayam‌ `asaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' iti śāṇapratiṣedhamāramate| atha `adhyardhapūrva' (5.1.28) iti lukkasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`vibhāvā' ityādi| `dvinaiṣkikam‌' iti| `asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' (5.120) iti ṭhak‌| `pāñcalohitikaḥ' [pāñcalohitikam‌--kāśikā] iti| tasminneva ṭhaki kṛte `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' (vā.731) iti puṃvadbhāvena `varṇādanudāttāt‌, topadhāt‌ to taḥ' (4.1.39) ityanena vihitayorṅībnakārayornivṛtti| `dvaikulijikam‌' [dvaikulijikaḥ--kāśikā] iti| prāgvatīyaṣṭhañca|| 18. je proṣṭhapadānām‌| (7.3.18) `saṃkhyāyāḥ' (7.3.15) iti nivṛttam‌| "`je' iti jātārtho nirdiśyate" iti| jātaśabdaikadeśasya `je' iti, tasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ| bhavati hi padaikadeśasyāpi prayogaḥ, yathā--bhomo bhīmasenaḥ, satyabhāmā bhāmeti| tasmājjātaśabdasyaikadeśasya prayogeṇa jātārtho nirdiśyata iti vijñeyam‌| `proṣṭhapadāsu' iti| `lupi yuktatavadvyaktivacane' (1.2.51) iti yuktavadabhāvaḥ| `bhadrayādāḥ' iti| bhadrapadena yuktaḥ kāla iti aṇādikāryaṃ pūrvavadvidheyam‌|| 19. hṛdbhagasindhvante pūrvapadasya ca| (7.3.19) `sauhārdam‌' iti| tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| yadā suhṛdayaśabdādaṇ‌, tadā `hṛdayasya hṛllekhayadaṇlāseṣu' (6.3.50) iti hṛdbhāvaḥ| `sauhārdyaṃm‌' iti| `guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ' (5.1.124) iti ṣyañ‌, `vā śokaṣyañrogeṣu' (6.3.51) iti hṛdbhāvaḥ| `saubhāgineyaḥ, dīrbhāginayaḥ' iti| `kasyāṇyādīnāminaṅa ca' (4.1.126) iti ḍhaki kṛta inaṅādeśaḥ| `saktusindhavaḥ' iti| śāpakapārthivāditvānmadhyamapadalopo samāsaḥ| `sāktusaindhavaḥ' iti| ordeśe (4.2.119) ṭhañi prāpte `kacchādibhyaśca' (4.2.133) ityaṇ‌| nanu ca kevalastatra sindhuśabdaḥ paṭhyate, kathaṃ tadantādbhavati? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| kathaṃ punastena sindhuśabdena tadantavidhirlabhyate, yāvatā `grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhirnāsti' (vyā.pa.89) iti tadantavidhiḥ pratiṣidhyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; cakārastatrānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena sindhuśabdāt‌ tadantādapi bhavati|| 20.anuśatikādīnāṃ ca| (7.3.20) `anuśatika' iti| śatena krītaḥ--`śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate' (5.1.21) iti ṭhan‌--śatikaḥ, anugataḥ śatikenānuśatikaḥ, tataḥ `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| ānuśātikam‌, ānuhauḍikam‌' iti| `carati' (4.4.8) iti ṭhak‌| `ānusāṃvatsarikam‌' iti| `tatra ca dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavat‌' (5.1.96) ityatideśāt‌ `bahvaco'ntodāttāt‌' (4.3.67) iti ṭhañ‌| `āṅgāravaiṇavaḥ' iti| `tasyāpatyam‌' (4.1.92) ityaṇ‌| `āsihātyam‌' iti| `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityaṇ‌| `āsyahātyam‌' iti| `vimuktādibhyo'ṇ‌' (5.2.61)| `āsyahaitikam‌' iti pāṭhe `tadasya prayojanam‌' (5.1.109) iti prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ‌| nanu ca prātipadikāditi varttate, asyahatyāsyahetiśca padasamudāyo'yam‌, na prātipadikam‌, tatkathamataḥ pratyayaḥ? satyapi vā pratyaye kathaṃ vibhakteraluk‌? ityāha--`ata eva' ityādi| `vādhyaugaḥ' iti| `anuṣyānantarye bidādibhyo'ñ‌' (4.1.104)| `pauṣkarasādirānuhāratiḥ' iti| `bāhvādibhyaśca' (4.1.96) itīṇ‌| `kaurukātyam‌' [kaurukātyaḥ--kāśikā] iti| garagāditvādayañ‌| `kaurupāñcālaḥ' iti| `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityaṇ‌| nanu ca janapadaśabdā `janapadatadavadhyośca' (4.2.124) iti vuñā bhavitavyam‌! ityata āha--`janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena' ityādi| kurupañcālaśabdo hi janapadamudāyavacanaḥ, na ca janapadasamudāyo janapadagrahaṇena gṛhyata iti kuto vuñprasaṅgaḥ? `audakaśauddhiḥ' iti| `ata iñ‌' (4.1.95)| `aihalaukikaḥ, pāralaukikaḥ' iti| `lokottarapadasya' [lokottarapadācca--iti vartikam‌](vā.459) iti ṭhañ‌| etat‌ `samānasya tadādeśca' ityevamādikāyāṃ kārikāyāmiyamiṣṭiriti paṭhyate| `sārvalaukikaḥ' iti| `lokasarvalokāṭṭhañ‌' (5.1.44)| `sārvapauruṣam‌' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| `sārvabhaumaḥ' iti| `sarvabhūmipṛthivībhyāmaṇañau' (5.1.41) ityaṇa, añcā| `prāyaugikaḥ' iti| adhyātmāditvāt‌ (vā.456) ṭhañ‌| `pārastraiṇeyaḥ' iti| `kulaṭāyā va' (4.1.127) itīnaṅ‌| tatra `strībhyo ḍhak‌' (4.1.120) `kalyāṇyādīnāminaṅ‌ ca' (4.1.146) ityanuvarttate| `rājapauruṣyam‌' iti| brāhmaṇāditvāt‌ (5.1.124) ṣyañ‌| `sautranāḍiḥ' iti| `ata iñ‌' (4.1.95) `ābhigāmikaḥ' iti| abhigamamarhatītyārhīyaṣṭhak‌ (5.1.63)| `ādhidaivikam‌, ādhibhautikam‌' iti| bhavārthe'dhyātmāditvāt‌ (vā.456) ṭhañ‌| `cāturvedyam‌' iti| ṣyañ‌| svārthiko vaktavyaścāturvarṇyādisiddhyarthamiti svārthaṃ eva ṣyañ‌|| 21. devatādvandve ca| (7.3.21) `āgnimārutīm‌' iti| agniśca marucceti dvandvaḥ, tau devate asyāḥ--`sāsya devatā' (4.2.24) ityaṇ‌; tataḥ pūrvottarayorvṛddhiḥ, `idvṛddhau' (6.3.28) ityagniśabdasyānaṅ‌viṣaya ikārādeśaḥ, `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌| `yo devatādvandvaḥ sūktasambandhī ityādi| yaḥ sūktaṃ bhajate sa sūktasambandhī, yasmai havirnirūpyate sa haviḥ sambandhīti| arthadvārakaṃ cedaṃ dvandvasya viśeṣaṇam‌| `iha ca na bhavati' ityādi| kathaṃ panaḥ sāmānyokto satyāmayaṃ viśeṣo labhyate? evaṃ manyate--`nendrasya parasya' (7.3.22) ityatara neti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, tena sūktasambandhino haviḥsambandhinaścānyatra na bhavatīti| `skāndaviśākhaḥ' iti| `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌| `brāhmaprajāpatyam‌' iti| `dityadityādityapatyattarapadāṇṇyaḥ' (4.1.85)| 22. nendrasya parasya| (7.3.22) `saimendraḥ, āgnendraḥ' iti| `sāsya devatā' (4.2.24) ityaṇ‌, `devatādvandve ca' (7.3.21) ityānaṅādeśaḥ, pūrvapadasyādguṇaḥ| `aindrāgnam‌' iti| atrāpi pūrvavadaṇādikāryam‌| `indraśabde dvāvacau' ityādi| prāgevoktatvāt‌ subodham‌|| 23. dīrghācca varuṇasya| (7.3.23) `aindrāvaruṇam‌, maitrāvaruṇam‌' iti| `devatādvandve ca' (7.3.21) ityānaṅi kṛte dīrghāt‌ paro varuṇaśabdaḥ|| 24. prācāṃ nagarānte| (7.3.24) yadyatra prācāmityatrācāryagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tataścottarasūtre (7.3.26) `vibhāṣitam‌' iti na brūyāt‌,etadeva vikalpārthaṃ prācāṃgrahaṇaṃ tatrānuvarttiṣyate| tasmāddeśagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate ityāha--`prācāṃ deśe' ityādi| nagaragrahaṇeneha svarūpagrahaṇam‌; `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya' (1.1.68) iti vacanāt‌|| 25. jaṅgaladhenuvalajāntasya vibhāṣitamuttaram‌| (7.3.25) `uttaram‌' ityanenottarapadaṃ lakṣyate; tasya cottarapadasya nityaṃ sannidhānāt‌ vibhāṣitatvaṃ nopapadyate| tasmāt‌ tatsambandhinyā vṛddhervibhāṣitatvāt‌ `vibhāṣitam‌' ityuktam‌| ata evāha--`uttarapadasya vibhāṣā bhavati' iti| vṛddhiriti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ|| 26. ardhāt‌ parimāṇasya pūrvasya tu vā| (7.3.26) `ārdhadrauṇikam‌' iti| `arthaṃ napuṃsakam‌' (2.2.2) iti samāsaḥ, `prāgvateṣṭhañ‌' (5.1.18)| atha vāvacanaṃ kimartham‌, na vibhāṣitamiti (7.3.25)pūrvasūtrādanuvarttaṣyate, uttaramityanena tat‌ sambaddham‌, atastadanuvṛttāvṛttarapadasyaiva vikalpaḥ syāditi cet‌? naitadasti; utatarapadamityetanna svariṣyate, tuśabdaśceha kriyate, sa niyamartho bhaviṣyati--pūrvasyaiva bhavati, nottarasyeti| evaṃ tarhyakayoge svaratatvakaraṇākaraṇāddhi vāvacanameva ladhīya iti punarvāvacanaṃ kriyate|| 27. nātaḥ parasya| (7.3.27) pūrveṇa parimāṇasya vṛddhirucyamānā akārasyācamādeḥ prāpnotīti pratiṣidhyate| pūrvapadasya tu vikalpo bhavatyeva; pūrvasya tvityanuvṛtteḥ| `ārdhaprasthikaḥ' iti| `ardhaṃ napuṃsakam‌' (2.2.2) iti samāsaḥ, pūrvavat‌ pratyayaḥ| `kiñca syāt‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--ākāro hi vṛddhimāneva, tatara nāsti viśeṣaḥ satyasati vā vṛddhiparatiṣedhe, tadeva rūpam‌, ato'satyapi taparakaraṇe naiva kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyata iti| `vṛddhinimittasya' ityādi| yasati taparakaraṇe tatkālārthe yadaniṣṭamāpadyate taddarśayati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho na syāt‌? ityata āha--`yatra hi' ityādi| vṛddhiṃ kurvanneva hi taddhito vṛddhinimittaṃ bhavati| tasmādyatra taddhite vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ kriyate sa vṛddhenimittaṃ na bhavati| tena vṛddhinimittasya taddhitasya puṃvadbhāvo na pratiṣidhyata iti puṃvadbhāvaḥ syāt‌| kva? `yathā' ityādi| `vaiyākaraṇī bhāryā'sya' iti| vṛddhipratiṣedhaḥ punaratra `na yvābhyām‌' (7.3.3) ityādinā| atha parasyeti kimarthaṃ, pūrvasya mā bhūditi? naitadasti; ata iti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāt‌ pūrvasya na bhaviṣyati| na hi pūrvasyārdhaśabdasyāto'nyo vṛddhimāk‌ sambhavati, `pūrvasya tu vā' (7.3.26) iti ca vikalpaśāsanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, yadi tasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌| idaṃ tarhi prayojanam‌--tadantavidhirmā bhūditi? tadantadidhau satīhāpi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌--ardhadrauṇikamiti| pūrvastu vidhiḥ--ardhena muṣṭinā krotamardhamauṣṭikam‌, ārdhamauṣṭikamityevamarthaḥ syāt‌, paragrahaṇe tu sati yadardhāt‌ paramanantaraṃ tadevāśritaṃ bhavatīti nāsti tadantavidhiprasaṅgaḥ|| 28. pravāhaṇasya ḍhe| (7.3.28) pravāhaṇaśabdasya ḍhe pratyaye parata uttarapadasyeti vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| pravāhaṇaśabdasaya yaduttarapadamavayavastasyetyarthaḥ| `pravāhaṇeyaḥ' iti| vaheḥ prapūrvāṇṇic‌--pravāhayatīti pravāhaṇaḥ| ṇijantāt‌ `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam‌' (3.3.113) iti karttari lyuṭ‌, prādisamāsaḥ, `ṇervibhāṣā' (8.4.30) iti ṇatvam‌, tato'patyārthe ḍhak‌| kimarthaṃ punaruttarapadasya vṛddhirvidhīyate, yāvatā vṛddhimavevaitat‌? yadapyevam‌, tathāpi vṛddhiravidhātavyā; taddhitasya vṛddhinimittatvāt‌, `vṛddhinimittasya ca taddhitasyāraktavikāre' (6.3.39) iti puṃvadbhāvaprataṣedho yathā syāt‌| yadi hyuttarapadavṛddhirna vidhīyate, tato yasmin‌ pakṣe pūrvapade vṛddhirna vidhīyate tasmin‌ pakṣe pravāhaṇeyī bhāryā asyeti pravāhaṇeyībhāyaṃ ityatra puṃvadbhāvaprataṣedho na syāt‌; vṛddheranimittatvāt‌ taddhitasya| yathā--vaiyākaraṇabhāyaṃ ityatra| nanu cāsatyapi vṛddhinimittatve taddhitasya' `jāteśca' (6.3.41) iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho bhaviṣyati, asti hyatrāpi `gotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ saha' (ma.bhā.2.225) iti jātitvam‌? evaṃ tarhi etajjñāpayati--anityo'yaṃ pratiṣedha iti| tena hastinīnāṃ samūho hāstikamityatra `bhasyāḍhe taddhite' (vā.731) ityaupasaṃkhyānikasya puṃvadbhāvasya pratiṣedho na bhavati|| 29. tatpratyayasya ca| (7.3.29) `prāvāhaṇeyiḥ' iti| `ata iñ‌' (4.1.95)| `prāvāhaṇeyakam‌' iti| `gotracaraṇādaṣuñ‌' (4.3.126)| atha kimarthamidamucyate, yāvatā ḍhapratyayantasya pravāhaṇeyaśabdasyottarapadaṃ nityaṃ vṛddhimadedeti, tadarthastāvadārambho na yuktaḥ; pūrvapadasya vṛddhervikalpo yathā syādityevamartho'pi naivāsyārambho yujyate; iñādāvapi taddhite tannimittāṃ vṛddhiṃ bādhitvā pūrvasūtreṇa ca nimitta eva vikalpo bhaviṣyati, na hīñādāvutapanne taddhite ḍhasya paratvamapaiti? ityāha--`bāhyataddhita' ityādi| bāhyataddhino nimittaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā| bāhmatvaṃ punaritradestaddhitasya prāvāhaṇeyaśabde'nantarbhāvāt‌| saivaṃ bāhyaṃ taddhitaṃ nimittamāśritya bhavantī bahiraṅgā| prāgeva tu brāhmataddhitotpatterḍhāśrayo vikalpo bhavannantaraṅgastāṃ bādhituṃ na śaknoti| tataśca yadīdaṃ nārabhyeta tadā syādeva| tasmādvikalpārthamidamārabhyate|| 30. nañaḥ śucīśvarakṣetrajñakuśalanipuṇānām‌| (7.3.30) udāharaṇānyuttaratra vyutpādayiṣyante| `atra kecadahuḥ' ityādi| grahaṇakavākyam‌| asya `na nañpūrvāt‌ tatpuruṣāt‌' iti vivaraṇam‌| `na nañpūrvāt‌ tatpuruṣāt‌' (5.1.121) iti tvatalbhyāmanyo bhāvapratyayaḥ pratiṣedhyate, tatrottaraṃ bhāvapratyayamicchatā śūcyādibhya eva, na tu nañsamāsebhya uttaro bhāvapratyayaḥ karttavyaḥ| tasmin‌ kṛte paścānnañsamāsaḥ, tataścāṅgasyāmāderaco vidhīyamānā vṛddhirna prāpnoti| na hi pūrvaṃ bhāvapratyaye kṛte paścānnañsamāse nañ‌ aṅgasayācāmādirbhavati,
