uttarapadasyaivāṅgatvāt‌; ucyate cedaṃ vacanam‌, tatra vacanasāmarthyādaṅgasyāpi vṛddhirbhavati| `tadapare' ityādi| yaduktamiyaṃ pūrvapadasya vṛddhiraprāptaiva vibhāṣa vidhīyata iti, tadapara ācāryā na kṣamante| kiṃ kāraṇam‌? ityāha--`bhāvavacanādanyo'pi hi' ityādi| evakāro bhinnakramo vidyata ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| yadi nañsamāsādapatyādiṣvartheṣu vṛddhinimittaṃ bhāvavacanādaparastaddhito na vidyeta, evaṃ bahuvrīheśca nañsamāsādbhāvavacanādanyo'pi na vidyeta; tato yujyate'śuccādiśabdānāmanaṅgatvādaṅgādhikāropamardanena vṛddhivacanasyākṛtārthatvāt‌| na tvetadevam; vidyata eva hyanyo'patyādivvartheṣu nañsamāsād‌vṛddhinimittasyaddhitaḥ--akuśalasyāpatyamākauśaliḥ, akuśalasyedamākauśalamiti| bahuvrīheśca nañsamāsādbhāvavacano'pi vidyata eva--nāsya śucayo vidayanta ityaśuciḥ, tasya bhāvaḥ, `igantācca laghupūrvāt‌' (5.1.131) ityaṇ‌--āśaucam‌| yata evamanyo'pi bhāvavacanāt‌ taddhito nañsamāsāddhidyate, vṛddhinimittako bahuvrīheśca nañsamāsādbhāvavacano'pi vidyate; tasmāt‌ tatra kṛtārthatvādvacanasyāṅgādhikārabādhanaṃ ca yucyate| yadapyuktam‌--`na nañpūrvāt‌ tatpuruṣādityṛttaro bhāvapratyayaḥ eva'(iti), tadapyayuktamiti darśayannāha--`akṣetrajño'nīśvaraḥ'[`akṣetrajñānīśvarau'--kāśikā] ityādi| etau hi dvau śabdau bāhmaṇādiṣu tatpuruṣāveva paṭhyete, tenābhyāṃ tatpuruṣābhyāmeva ṣyañ‌ bhavati, anyathā hi brāhmaṇādiṣvanayoḥ pāṭhasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt‌| tasmādaṅgasyaiveyaṃ vṛddhirnityaṃ prāptā satī bhāvapratyaye, anyatra ca taddhite vikalpena vidhīyate yathāyogam‌| tatarāśaucamiti yadi tatpuruṣaḥ kriyate--na śuciraśutaciḥ, tadā `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇi kṛte vṛddhiḥ; atha bahuvrīhiḥ--nāsti śucirasyenyaśuciḥ, tato yadi bhāvārtho vivakṣyate tadā `igantācaca laghupūrvāt‌' (5.1.131) ityaṇ‌; atha `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityartho vivakṣyate, tadā `prāgdīvayato'ṇ‌' (4.1.83) ityaṇ‌--ānaiśvaryyam‌, ākṣaitrajñyamiti| tatpuruṣābhyāṃ brāhmaṇāditvāt‌ vyañi kṛte vṛddhiḥ| ākīśalamānaipuṇamiti yadi bahuvrīhirayāpi tatpuruṣaḥ, ubhayathāpi `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇeva| yadyapi kuśalanipuṇaśabdau brāhmaṇādiṣu yudhādiṣu ca paṭhyete tathāpi tadantāt‌ tatpuruṣādvahuvrīherapi bhāvapratyayo nopapadyate; tadantavidherabhāvāt‌| 31.yathātathayathāpurayoḥ paryāyeṇa| (7.3.31) `brāhmaṇādiṣu nañsamāsāvetau draṣṭavyau' iti| tena nañsamāsābhyāṃ ṣyañ‌ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `etau' iti| yathātathā--yathāpuraśabdau| "`yathā'sāvṛśyate' ityavyayībhāvasamāsau" iti| nanu ca `asādṛśya' (2.1.7) iti pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; na hyatra sādṛśyaṃ gamyate| tathā hi--yathātathamiti satyamucyate, yathā--puramiti purātanam‌| kathaṃ punarjñāyate'vayayībhāvasamāsau? ityāha--`tathā hi' ityādi| atra hi `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti napuṃsakāśraya hrasvatvaṃ kṛtam‌| napuṃsakatvaṃ cāvyayībhāvasya vihitam‌, tasmādavyayībhāvasamāsāviti jñāyate| `bhāṣye tu' ityādi| ayathātathābhāva iti hrasvatvamakṛtvā vākyaṃ yathā darśitāṃ tathā `supsupā' (2.1.4) iti samāso lakṣyate nāvyayībhāvaḥ| avyayībhāve hi napuṃsakāśrayaṃ hrasvatvaṃ syāt‌| asmiṃstu pakṣe sautratvānnirdeśasya--`chandovatsūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā.) iti varṇavyatyayena dīrghasya sthāne hrasvo veditavyaḥ|| 32. hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ| (7.3.32) `taddhiteṣviti nivṛttam‌' iti| asvaritatvāt‌| `tatsambaddhaṃ kitītyapi' iti| nivṛttamityapekṣate| tatsambaddhatvaṃ punastasya `kiti ca' (7.2.118) ityatra `taddhiteṣu' (7.2.117) ityanuvṛtteḥ| yadi punaḥ kitītyanuvarttata, tato lakṣaṇe `jāyāpatyoṣṭak‌' (3.2.52) `amanuṣyakarttṛke ca' (3.2.53) iti ṭaki kṛte--jāyādhnastilakālaka ityatrāpi syāt‌| ñṇidgrahaṇaṃ tu pratyayamātreṇa sambaddham‌| ataḥ `taddhiteṣu' (7.2.117) ityetasmin‌ nivṛtte'pi tadanuvarttata eva| `ghātayati' iti| hetumaṇṇic‌| `hau hanterñṇinneṣu' (7.3.54) iti kṛtvam‌| `ghātakaḥ' iti| ṇdula| `sādhughātī' iti| `supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye' (3.2.78) iti ṇiniḥ| `ghātaṃghātam‌' iti| `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul‌ ca' (3.4.22), `ābhīkṣṇye dve bhavataḥ' (vā.887) iti dvirvacanam‌| `ghātaḥ' iti| bhāde ghañ‌ (3.3.18)| `adhāni' iti| luṅ‌, `ciṇ‌ bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (3.1.66) iti ciṇādeśaśca; `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ (1.3.13) ityātmanepadam‌, `ciṇo luk‌' (6.4.104) iti takārasya luk‌| `jaghāna' iti| liṭ‌, tip‌, tasya ṇal‌, `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti kutvam‌-ghakāraḥ| atheha kasmānna bhavati--vṛtraṃ hatavāniti| `brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvip‌' (3.2.87), tadantāt‌ `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌, `ṣapūrvahandhṛtarājñāmaṇi' (6.4.135) ityallopaḥ--vārtradhnaḥ, bhrauṇadhnaḥ? ityāha--`dhātoḥ' ityādi| dhātorityevamucyārya yo vihitaḥ pratyayaḥ sa dhātupratyayaḥ| dhātauḥ kāryamucyamānaṃ tatraiva dhātupratyaye bhavati| etacca bhauṇahatyamiti nipātanena (6.4.174) jñāpitam‌| tena vārtradhnaḥ, bhrauṇadhna ityādau na bhavati| na hyatra dhātorityevaṃ pratyayo vihitaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? prātapadikādittyevam‌|| 33. āto yukciṇkṛtoḥ| (7.3.33) `ciṇi kṛti ca' [`ca' nāsti--kāśikā] iti| ciṇgrahaṇamakṛdartham‌| akṛttvaṃ tu tasya dvitīyadhātvadhikāre'vihitatvāt‌| `adāyi, adhāyi' iti| dadātidadhātyoḥ pūrvavalluṅādikāryam‌| `dāyaḥ, dhāyaḥ' iti| dhañ‌| `dāyakaḥ, dhāyakaḥ' iti| ṣvul‌| `dadau, dadhau' iti| `āta au ṇalaḥ' (7.1.34) ityautvam‌| `cauṅiḥ, bālākiḥ' iti| cūḍābalākābhyāṃ bāhvādīñ‌| acāmāderityanuvṛtteratra na bhaviṣyatīti yo manyeta, taṃ pratyudāharaṇāntaramāha--`jñā devatā asyeti jñaḥ' (iti)| `sāsya devatā' (4.2.24) ityaṇ‌| atra vyapadeśivadabhāvenācāmādirākāro bhavati| atrāsati ciṇkṛdgrahaṇe satyāmapyacāmāderityanuvṛttau syādevātra yuk| `vyapadeśivadabhāvo'prātipadikena' (śāka.pa.65) ityetacca pratyayavadhiviṣaya eva hyuktam‌|| 34. nodāttopadeśasya māntasyānācameḥ| (7.3.34) `aśami, atami, adami' iti| `śamu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1201), `tamu kāṅakṣāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1202), `damu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1203), luṅādi pūrvavat‌| `śamakaḥ' ityādau ṇvul‌| `śamaḥ' ityādau ghañ‌| `yāmakaḥ, rāmakaḥ' iti| `yama uparame' (dhā.pā.984), `ramu krīḍāyām‌' (dhā.pā.856)| anudāttopadeśāvetau| atha kathamudyamoparamau? ityāha--`udyamoparamau' ityādi| `anugantaśyau' ityādi| sādhutveneti śeṣaḥ| nipātanādeto sādhutvena veditavyāvityarthaḥ| `śamī, tamī, damītyatra yathā syāt‌' iti| śamādibhyaḥ `śamityaṣṭābhyo dhinuṇ‌' (3.2.141)| asatyupadeśagrahaṇe'tra na syāt‌; pratyayasvare kṛte dhātoranudāttatvāt‌| upadeśagrahaṇe tu sati tenādyavasthā lakṣya iti yadyapyutatarakālamanudāttatvaṃ bhavati, tathāpi bhavatyeva pratiṣedhaḥ; upadeśāvasthāyāmudāttatvāt‌| `iha' ityādi| yadyupadeśagraharṇa na kriyate, tato yāmakaḥ, rāmaka ityatrāpi syāt‌; `liti' (6.1.193) iti pratyayāt‌ pūrvasyodāttatvavidhānāt‌| upadeśagrahaṇe tu na bhavati; upadeśe'nudāttatvāt‌| `anācamikamivamīnāmiti vaktavyam‌' iti| `kamu kāntau' (dhā.pā.443), `ṭuvama udgirarṇe' (dhā.pā.849), `cama chamu, camu, jhamu adane' (dhā.pā.469,470,471,472) eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ dhātunāṃ pratiṣedho na bhavatotyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--camestāvadanācameriti sūtra evopādānāt‌ pratiṣedho na bhavatīti| itarayostu `dhāmadevāṅ ḍyaḍaḍyau' (4.2.9), `dhanahiraṇyāt‌ kāme' (5.2.65) iti nipatanāditi| atha kathamāmaḥ? ityāha--`āma ti caurādikasya' ityādi| `ama roge' (dhā.pā.1720) ityasya caurādikasya ṇici vṛddhau, `erac‌' (3.3.56) ityaci kṛte-āma iti| na hi ṇicyapi vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho bhavati; tasyāciṇkṛttvāt‌| akṛttvaṃ tu pūrvavadveditavyam‌| nanu `janījṝṣksasurañjo'mantāśca' (dhā.pā.817 anantaram‌ ga.sū.) iti mitsaṃjñāyāṃ satyām‌ `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) ityaneneha ṇau bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`atra hi bhittvaṃ nāsti' iti| kathaṃ nāsti? ityāha--`nānye' ityādi| yastu bhvādiḥ `ama gatyādiṣu' (dhā.pā.465) paṭhyate, ama ityevaṃ tasya bhavitavyam‌| atha kathaṃ viśrāma iti, na cāyamasādhuriti śakyate vaktum‌, yataḥ `sūryaviśrāmā bhūmiḥ' iti prayogo dṛśyate? ityāha--`evamādikaṃ prayogam‌' ityādi|| 35. janivadhyośca| (7.3.35) vadhirayaṃ hanādeśo'sti, tasyaidaṃ grahaṇamiti kasyacidāśaṅkā syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`vadhiḥ prakṛtyantaram‌' ityādi| prakṛtyantaramapi bhavan‌ yadayakārāntaḥ syāt‌, anarthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, dhopadhatvādeva na vṛddhirbhavatīti matvā''ha--`vyañjanāntasya' iti| kutaḥ punarvidhiḥ prakṛtyantaramastītyetadavasitam‌? ityāha--`bhakṣakaśca' ityādi| atha hanādeśasyaiva vadherayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`hanādeśasya' ityādi| `jajāna garbham‌' ityādi| chāndasaḥ prayogaḥ|| 36. arttihvīvlīrīknūyīkṣmāyyātāṃ pugṇau| (7.3.36) arttīti śtitā nirdeśaḥ| ṛkārāntasya grahaṇaṃ mā vijñāyīti, yathā--`ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ' (7.4.16) iti| `arpayati' iti| hetumaṇṇic‌, `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ| `hrepayati, vlepayati' iti| `hrī lajjāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1085) `vlo varaṇe (dhā.pā.1502)| `knopayati, kṣmāpayati' iti| `knūyo śabde' (dhā.pā.4.85), `kṣmāyī vidhūnane' (dhā.pā.486)| `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti yakāralopaḥ| `dvayorapi dhātvorgrahaṇam‌' iti| viseṣābhāvāt‌| rotyetasyāpi `rī gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1500), `roṅ‌ śravaṇe' (dhā.pa.1138)--iti dvayorapi grahaṇamityapekṣyate| nanu ca `niranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.53) iti rīṅo grahaṇaṃ na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; atra hyalpāctaratvāt‌ hrovlyātāmanyatamasya pūrvanipāte karttavye `alpāctaram‌' (2.2.34) ityetadanapekṣyārttiśabdasya pūrvaṃ nipātaṃ kurvatā'nyadapi kiñcidiha śāstravacanaṃ nāpekṣyata ityetat‌ sūcitam‌| tena niranubandhakaparibhāṣā nāpekṣyata iti rīṅo'pi grahaṇaṃ bhavati| atha kimarthaṃ punaḥ puk pūrvāntaḥ kriyate, na parādireva puṅ‌ vidhīyatām‌; puṭi sati guṇavidhau pugantagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) ityevaṃ siddhatvāt‌ puṭi; avaśyaṃ puḍgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌, anyathā hi `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) iti vṛddhiḥ syāditi cet‌? naitadasti; nāprāpte ṇico vṛrddhi prati nimittatve puṭaṃ pratyāgamitvamucyata ityuttarasya bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti nāsti vṛddheḥ prasaṅgaḥ| ayaṃ tarhi parādau doṣaḥ--dāpyate, dāpyata iti--atra ṇerlopenāpahṛtatvāt‌ pakārasya śravaṇaṃ na syāditi? eṣo'pyadoṣa-; na hi ṇilopaḥ sarvāpahārī bhavati, yena ṇernivṛttau puḍāgamo'pi nivarttata| pratyayalaśraṇañcāstīti nivṛtte'pi ṇau puṭaḥ śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha--`pukaḥ pūrvāntakaraṇam‌' ityādi| dāpayaterluṅ‌, cliḥ, tasya `ṇiśridru srubhyaḥ karttara' (3.1.48) iti caṅi ṇilopaḥ, `ṇau caṅyupadhāyā hrasvaḥ' (7.4.1) iti hrasvatvam‌, `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti dvirvacanam‌, `sanvallaghuni caṅpare' (7.4.93) itīttvam‌, `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghatvam‌--adīdapat‌| atra yadi puṭ‌ kriyate tadā hrasvatvaṃ na syāt‌; anupadhātvāt‌| puki tu sati bhavati| ato hrasvārthaṃ pukaḥ pūrvāntakaraṇam‌|| 37. śācchāsāhvāvyāvepāṃ yuk‌| (7.3.37) `śo tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1145), `cho chedane' (dhā.pā.1146), `ṣo'ntakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1147), `hveñ‌ spardhāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1008), `vyeñ‌ saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1007), `veñ‌ tantusantāne' (dhā.pā.1006), `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925), `pai ovai śoṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.920,921)-iti dvayorapi| eṣāmākārāntatvāt‌ puki prāpte yuko vidhānam‌| `niśāyayati' ityādi| `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityāttvam‌| `pāgraṇe' `pai ovai śoṣaṇe' ityetasyāpi grahaṇamijchanti' iti| yatra hyasya grahaṇaṃ neṣyate, tatra pibaterityāha; yathā--`lopaḥ pibaterīcca' (7.4.4) iti bhāvaḥ| atha `pā rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1056) ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`pā rakṣaṇa ityasya tu' ityādi| `lugāgamastu tasya vaktavyaḥ' iti| nanu ca `pāla rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1609) iti curādau paṭhyate, tasya pālayatīti bhaviṣyati? satyametata; pukastu nivṛttyartho lugāgama upasaṃkhyāyate, anyathā hi pāteḥ pāyayatīti syāt‌| `dhūñprīñornugvaktavyaḥ' iti| `dhūñ‌ kampane' (dhā.pā.1835), `prīñ‌ tarpaṇe' (dhā.pā.1836) iti--etayornugvaktavyaḥ, vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--dhūñ‌ vidhūnane' (dhā.pā.1398), `tṛpa prīṇane' (dhā.pā.1195) iti nipātanādetayorlugbhaviṣyatīti| `ete'pi' iti| yugādayaḥ| niśāyayatītyādiṣu `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityāttvam| nyaśīśayadityādīni adīdapadityanena tulyāni, pūrvavalluṅādīni vidhāya vyutpādyāni| `adūdhanat‌' iti| anakārāntatvādiha sanvadbhāvo'bhyāsasya nāstīti| `apipriṇat‌' ityatrāpyalaghutvāddīrghatvaṃ nāsti| nanu ca śācchāsāhvāvyāḥ--ityeta ejantā gaṇe paṭhyante, tatkathameṣāṃ kṛtāttvānāṃ grahaṇam‌? ityāha--`śācchāsāhvā'[`śāhvetyādi'--mudritapāṭhaḥ] ityādi| kathaṃ panaḥ kṛtāttvānāṃ grahaṇena pukaḥ prāptirākhyāyate? ākārāntānāṃ pugvidhānāt‌| `adhyāpayati' ityādinā jñāpasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| adhyāpayatīti `kroṅjīnāṃ ṇau' (6.1.48) itvāttvam‌| ādiśabdena jāpayatītyādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌| yadu pukaḥ prāptimākhyātuṃ śāprabhṛtīnāṃ kṛtāttvānāṃ garahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌, tadā veño'pi kṛtāttvasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌? naivaṃ śakyam‌, vetyucyamāne `pai ovai śoṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.920,921) ityasyāpi grahaṇaṃ syāt‌| tasmādakṛtāttvasyaiva veño grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌|| 38. vo vidhūnane juk‌| (7.3.38) puki prāpti jugvidhīyate| `vā hatyetasya' iti| `vā gatigandhanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1050) ityetasya| `vidhūnane'rthe' iti| kampana ityarthaḥ| nanu `vaja vraja gatau' (dhā.pā.252,253) ityasya dhātorṇyantasyopavājayatīti siddham‌, tatkimarthametat‌? vāteḥ pugmā bhūdityevamarthaṃ juko vidhānam‌| `pai orva śoṣaṇa ityetasyaitadrūpam‌' iti| nanu ca lākṣaṇikasyākārāntatvām‌, ato jukā na bhavitavyam‌? naitadasti; idānomeva hyuktam‌--etasmin‌ prakaraṇe lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā nāstīti|| 39. līlornuglukāvanyatarasyāṃ snehavipātane| (7.3.39) `snehavipātane'rthe' iti| kimidaṃ snehavipātanaṃ nāma? vigacchataḥ snehasaya pātanaṃ vyāpāraṇam‌| tathā hi--pātervyantasya bhāve lyuṭi kṛte vapītanamiti| `vilīnayati' iti| guṇāyādeśau| atha `vibhāṣā līyateḥ' (6.1.51) ityattve kṛta ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādvilāpayatītyatra kasmānnugbhavati? ityāha--`lī' ityādi| lī-ī iti īkāro'tra praśliṣyate--īkārāntasyaiva yathā syāt‌ kṛtāttvasya na bhavati| `lī iti līlīṅorgrahaṇam‌' iti| nanu ca niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā `lī śleṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1501) ityetasyaiva kraiyādikasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌, na tu `līṅ‌ śleṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1139) ityetasya daivādikasya? evaṃ manyate--eka evāyaṃ dhāturvikaraṇadvayarthamātmanepadārthañca dvirupadiśyate| evañca kṛtvā `liyaḥ sammānanaśalinokaraṇayośca' (1.3.70) ityubhābhyāmātmanepadaṃ bhavatīti| `lā iti lāteḥ, kṛtātvasya ca loyateḥ' iti| grahaṇamiti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ|| 40. bhiyo hetubhaye ṣuk‌| (7.3.40) hetuḥ svatantrasya kartuḥ prayojakaḥ| vibhetyasmāditi bhayaḥ, hetuścāsau bhayaśceti hetubhayaḥ, tasmin‌ hetubhaye| `ñibhī bhaye' (dhā.pā.1084) ityasya vṛddhau prāptāyāṃ `bibheterhetubhaye' (6.1.56) ityāttve ca prāpte pakṣe ṇau dhugvidhīyate| `muṇḍo bhīṣayate' iti| `bhīsmyorhetubhaye' (1.3.78) ityātmanepadam‌| athāttve kṛte muṇḍo bhāpayata ityatra kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`atrāpi' ityādi|| 41. sphāyo vaḥ| (7.3.41) `sphāvayati' iti| `sphāyo, o pyāyī vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.487,488)|| 42. śaderagatau taḥ| (7.3.42) kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā `śadlṛ śātane' (dhā.pā.1428) ityasmādeva nipātanāt‌ takāro bhaviṣyatīti? gateranyatra yathā syāt‌ gatau mā bhūditi cet‌? na; śātanaśabdo hi gateranyamarthamācaṣṭe| evaṃ tarhi etajjñāpayati--`abādhakānyapi nipātanāni bhavanti' (pu.la.pa.vṛ.99) iti| tena purāśabdāt‌ `sāyañciram‌' (4.3.23) ityādinā vidhīyamānayoṣṭyuṭyuloḥ `purāṇaprokteṣu' (4.3.105) iti nipātanena tudo bādhanaṃ na bhavatītita| tena purātanamityapi siddhaṃ bhavati|| 43. ruhaḥ po'nyatarasyām‌| (7.3.43) `ropayati' iti| `ruha janmani prādurbhāve ca' (dhā.pā.859)| kimarthaṃ punaridamucyate, yāvatā divādiṣu `rupa lupa vimohane' (dhā.pā.1236,1237) iti rupiḥ paṭhyate, tasya ropayatīti bhaviṣyatī, ruhestu rohayatīti? janmārthe'pi ropayatīti prayogo yathā syāt‌; anyathā hi vimohanārthasyaiva syāt‌| anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ rupirjanmani varttiṣyata iti cet‌? naitadasti; anekārthā hi dhātavaḥ, na tu sarvārthāḥ| na hi rupyatītyukte anmārthaḥ prātīyate, kiṃ tarhi? vimohanārtha eva|| 44. pratyayasthātkātpūrvasyāta idāpayasupaḥ| (7.3.44) `supaḥ paro na bhavati' iti| subantātparo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ cārthaḥ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā veditavyaḥ| `jaṭilikā, muṇḍikā' iti| ajñātādiṣvartheṣu `prāgivāt‌ kaḥ' (5.3.70)| `kārikā, hārikā' iti| ṇvul‌| `etikā' iti| etadaḥ `avyayasarvanāmnām‌' (5.3.71) ityakac‌, tyādādyatvam‌, `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvam‌, ṭāp‌, akaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvam‌ (6.1.101)| `śakā' iti| pacādyac‌, ṭāp‌| `sthagrahaṇa vispuṣṭārtham‌' iti| atra yatra kakāramātraṃ hi pratayayasatatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`kakāramātraṃ hi' ityādi| kāditi varṇagrahaṇam‌| akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ| na tu kevalaḥ kakāraḥ pratyayo'sti yannivṛttyarthaṃ sthagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌| `kāt‌ pratyayāt‌' ityucyamāne pratyayāvayave pratyayaśabdo varttiṣyate, ato'ntareṇāpi sthagrahaṇaṃ pratyayasthasya kakārasya grahaṇaṃ śakyate vijñātum‌| tasmādvaspaṣṭārthaṃ sthagrahaṇam‌| `maṇḍanā, ramaṇā' iti| nandyādabhyo layuḥ (3.1.134| `paṭuka' mṛdukā, gokā, naukā' iti| pūrvavat kaḥ| `rākā, dhākā' iti| `rālā'dāne' (dhā.pā.1057,1058) ityasmāddaṣāteśca `kṛdādhārārcikalibhyaḥ kaḥ' (da.u.3.18) ityauṇādikaḥ kapratyayaḥ| `atha' ityādi| codataḥ| `kakāraḥ' itītaraḥ| kakarasya śrutatvāt‌ tasyaivāpīti viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktamityabhiprāyaḥ| yenābhiprāyeṇa codakaḥ pṛṣṭavāṃstamāviṣkartumāha--`yadyevam‌' ityādi| yadyapītyanena kakāro viśiṣyate--āpi parato yaḥ kakāra iti| evaṃ sati kariketyatra na prāpnoti; kakārasyākāreṇāyo vyavahitatvāt‌| `ekādeśe kṛte' ityādītaraḥ| vyavasarge hi sati vyavadhānaṃ bhavati| na caikādeśe kṛte vyavasargo'stītyato nāsti vyavadhānam‌| `ekādeśaḥ pūrva' ityādi| codakaḥ| sthānivadbhāvastu `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) ityanena| `vacanāt‌' itītaraḥ| ucyate cedaṃ vacanam‌, na cāpyanantaraṃ kakāraḥ sakambhavatīti tatra vacanasāmarthyāt sthānivadbhāve kṛte naikena varṇena sarvatra vyavadhānamāśrīyate| yada tarhi vacanasāmarthyāt‌ kāriketyādau vyavadhāne'pi bhavati, tadārathakaṭyā, putrakāmyetyatrāpi syāt‌? ityata āha--`rathakaṭyādiṣu' ityādi| rathānāṃ samūhaḥ `initrakaṭyacaśca' (4.2.51) iti kaṭyac‌, tataṣṭāp‌| putramicchatīti `kamyacca' (3.1.9) iti kāmyacpratyayaḥ| `a pratyayāt‌' (3.3.102) tataṣṭāp‌| tatra śrutikṛtamanekena varṇena vyavadhānamitīttvaṃ na bhavati| `yena nāvayavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt‌' (vyā.pa.46) ityekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrīyate| yena nāvayavadhānamapi tu sarvatra vyavadhānam‌, tenaikena varṇena vyavahite bhavittuṃ yuktam‌| sthānivadbhavakṛtamekena varṇena sarvatra vayavadhānamasti, saṅghātena tvasti nāsti ca| tasmāt‌ tadiha nāśrīyate| `subantādayam‌' iti| parivrājakaśabdāt‌ para ābiti pratayayalakṣaṇe subantatā veditavyā| `prasajyapratiṣedhaścāyam‌' iti| na cetsubantādāp‌ paro bhavati| kaḥ punaḥ parayudāse doṣo yataḥ sa sāśroyate? ityāha--`paryudāse hi' ityādi| yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ syāt‌ supo'nyo'sap‌, tataścodāp‌ paro bhavatīti; tato bahuparibrājaketyatrāpi syādevettvam, asubantāt‌ pūrvottarapadasamudāyāt‌ para ābiti kṛtvā| asubantatavaṃ punaḥ samudāyasya, tasmāt‌ sudanutpatteḥ; avayavāddhi parivrājakaśabdādatra subutpattiḥ, na tu samudāyāt‌| `avidyamānaḥ sub yasmin‌ so'yamasubityayamapi nāśrīyate' iti| bahuvrīhirapi nāśrīyata ityarthaḥ| kaḥ punastadāśrayaṇe doṣo yataḥ sa nāśrīyate? ityāha--tathā hi' ityādi| evaṃ tarhītyarthaḥ| bahuvrīhau pūrvottarapadayoḥ pratyayalakṣaṇena subantavyapadeśo'stīti nāsāvasupa, api tu vidyamānasubeva| tena bahucarmiketyatra nāsupaḥ para ābitīttvaṃ na syāt‌| bahūni carmāṇyasyāṃ vidyanta iti bahuvrīhiḥ| `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌, ṭāp‌| `māmikā' iti| mameyamiti `tasyedam‌' (4.3.120) ityaṇ‌ `tavakamamakau' (4.3.3) iti mamakādeśaḥ| nanvaṇantānmamakaśabdāt‌ `ṭiḍḍhāṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīpā bhavitavyam‌, tat‌ kathaṃ ṭābbhavati? `kevalamāmaketi niyamāt‌' ityādi| `narikā' iti| `kai ge śabde' (dhā.pā.916,917)| `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityattvam‌, `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3), tataṣṭāp‌| `dākṣiṇātyikā, ihatyikā' iti| dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi bhaveta `dakṣiṇāpaścātpurasastyak‌' (4.2.98) iti tyak‌| iha bhaveti `avyayātyap‌' (4.2.104)| ubhayatrājñātādiṣvartheṣu `prāgivātkaḥ' (5.3.70)| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatrevaṃ pratipādanam‌--`udīcāmātaḥ, sthāne' (7.3.46) ityatra vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt‌ tyaktyayornityaṃ bhaviṣyatīti|| 45. na yāsayoḥ| (7.3.45) yetayetasya `udīcāmātaḥ sthāne' (7.3.46) ityādinā vikalpe prāpte, setyasya pūrveṇa nitye prāpte pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate; prāptipūrvakatvāt‌ pratiṣedhasya| yadā tayorakajbhavati tadā'yaṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate| `yakā', `sakā' iti| yattadoḥ pūrvavadakac‌, suḥ, tyadādyatvañca| `yāseti nirdeśo'tantram‌' iti| apradhānamityarthaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam‌? ityāha--`yattadorupalakṣaṇārthametat‌' iti| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha--`ihāpi' ityādi| yāseti prathamaikavacanāntarūpam‌| tatara yadyayaṃ nirdeśastantraṃ syāt‌, prathamaikavacanantayorgrahaṇādvibhaktyantare yakām‌, takāmityatra na syāt‌, iṣyate ca tatrāpi| tasmādatantramayaṃ nirdeśo yattadoḥ prātipadikayorupalakṣaṇārthametat‌--ityucyate| `yāsayorittvapratiṣedhe' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--yattadoḥ pratiṣedha ityasmin‌ kriyamāṇe tyakanpratyayāntasya tyakanpratyayāntasya pratiṣedhapratipādanaṃ karttavyamiti| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--neti yogavibhāgo'tra kriyate, tena tyakanpratyayāntasya pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti| evamuttaratrāpyupasaṃkhaghyānaśabdasya pratipādanārtho veditavyaḥ| pratipādanamapyetadeva yogavibāgakaraṇamāśritaya karttavyam‌| `upatyakā, adhatyakā' iti| `upādhibhyāṃ tyakannāsannārūḍhayoḥ (5.2.34) iti tyakan‌| `pāvakā' iti| ṇvul‌| `alomakā' iti| nāsyā lomāni santīti bahuvrīhiḥ| `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌| `jīvakā, nandakā' ti| `āśiṣi ca' (3.1.150) iti vun‌| `devakā, yajñakā' iti| devadattayajñadattaśabdābhyāṃ `anukampāyāṃ kan‌' (5.3.76) iti kani kṛte `anajādau ca vibhāṣā lopo vaktavyaḥ' (vā. 614) ityuttarapadalopaḥ| `kṣipakā, dhruvakā' iti| `kṣipa preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1285), `dhruva sthairye' (dhā.pā.943), `igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' (3.1.135)| tadantādajñātādyarthe `prāgavātkaḥ' (5.3.70)| `tārakā' iti| taraterṇvul‌| `varṇakā' tāntavaḥ' iti| tantūnāṃ vikāra iti `orañ‌' (4.3.139), `orguṇaḥ' (6.4.146)| tāntavaḥ-prāvaraṇaviśeṣaḥ| tatra varṇaketyupasaṃkhyātavyā| `varṇa varṇakriyādhistāraguṇavacaneṣu'[`varṇaṃ'--nāsti mudritanyasapāṭhe] (dhā.pā.1938) iti caurādiko dhātuḥ, tato ṇvul‌--`varṇikā' iti| vyākhyatrītyarthaḥ| `varttakā' iti| `vṛtu varttane' (dhā.pā.758), ṇvul‌| `varttikā' iti| adhyetrītyarthaḥ| `aṣṭakā pitṛdaivatye' iti| pitṛdaivatyam-vaidikakaramaviśeṣaḥ, tatrāṣṭaketyupasaṃkhyāyate| `aśū vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1264) ityasmāt‌ `iṣyasibhyāṃ takan‌' (da.u.3-30) iti takan‌pratyayaḥ, vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| `aṣṭakā' iti| aṣṭau parimāṇamasyā iti `tadasya parimāṇam‌' (5.1.67) iti `saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ kam‌' (5.1.22)| `vā sūtakā' ityādi| upasaṃkhyātaśabdasaya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatraidaṃ pratipādanam--sūtakā, sūtikā--ityādayaḥ śabdā pṝṣodarāntaḥpātinaḥ, tena pṛṣodarāditvādevāyaṃ vikalpaḥ siddhaḥ|| 46. udicāmātaḥ sthāne yakapūrvāyāḥ| (7.3.46) pūrveṇa nityamittve prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam‌| yakau pūrve| yasyāḥ sā yakapūrvā| ko'nyapadārthaḥ? samudāyaḥ| tathā hi, pūrvaśabdo'vayave varttate| sa cāvayavaḥ samudāyasya bhavati, nāvayavāntarasya| na hi varṇo varṇasyāvayavo bhavati| avayavāntarāpekṣastu tasya pūrvatvavyapadeśaḥ| tat‌ punaravayāntaraṃ prakṛtatvāt‌ sthānyakāra eva vijñāyate| strīliṅganirdeśastu tasya[tasyetyārabhya `tu' iti paryantaṃ mudritanyāse nopalakṣyate] samudāyasyārthadharmeṇa strītvena veditavyaḥ| prayojanaṃ tu tasya vakṣyate| `ātaḥ sthāne' iti| yo'kāra iti vyavahitena sambandhaḥ| `ibhyikā' ityādi| ibhyādiśabdebhyaḥ `prāgivāt‌ kaḥ' (5.3.70), `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ| `sāṃkāśyikā' iti| `dhanvayopadhādvuñ‌' (4.2.121)| nātrātaḥ sthāne'kāra iti nityamevettvam‌| atha sthānagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatāt‌ ityeṣaiva ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogaṃ pratipādayiṣyati, `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' (1.1.49) iti vacanāt‌? ityata āha--`sthānagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| | akārasya sthāne lakṣaṇāntareṇa dihitasyākārasya saṃkīrttanam‌-anuvādaḥ| atrāpi sthāne sambandhapratipattiryathā syāt‌--ityevamarthaṃ sthānagrahaṇam‌| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam‌--asati sthānagrahaṇe'nuvāde sambandhapratipattirna syāt‌? ityāha--`āta ityanena' ityādi| ādeśavidhau `asterbhūḥ' (2.4.52) ityevamādau `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' (1.1.49) ityeṣā paribhāṣopatiṣṭhate, na tvanuvāde; vidhivākyaśeṣabhūtatvādasyāḥ| na cātrākārasya sthāne'kāro'nena vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? lakṣaṇāntareṇābhinirvṛtto'nena viśiṣyate--ātaḥ sthāne yo'kāra iti| tena nātra tasyāḥ paribhāṣāyā upasathānamiti tatra yadi sthānagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadātaḥ samīpo yo'kāra iti sāmīppasambandhapratipattiḥ syāt‌| atha vā pūrvavat‌ praśne kṛta ityāha--`āta ityanena' ityādi| ikārasya yaḥ sthānitvenopātto'kāraḥ sa āta ityanena viśiṣyate| evañca viśeṣyatvādakārasya pradhānyam‌; ākārasya viśeṣaṇatvādaprādhānyam‌| tatrāsati sthānagrahame yadyapi sā paribhāṣānuvāda upatiṣṭheta tathāpi pradhāne kāryasampratyayādāta ityasyā eva ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sthānasambandho vijñāyeta, na tvāta ityasyāḥ| sthānagrahaṇe tu satyasyā api vijñāyate--etadarthaṃ sthānagrahaṇam‌| `aśvikā' iti| pūrvavat‌ kaḥ, hrasvatvañca| atha `yakapūrvāyāḥ' iti strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ krimarthaḥ? ityāha--`strīliṅgena nirdeśaḥ| asati tasminnākāramātrasthāne yo'kārastasya sthānitvaṃ vijñāyeta, tataśca yāteḥ śubhambhadraṃśabdayorupapadataḥ `vijupe cchabdasi' (3.2.73) iti `āto manibkvanibvanipaśca' (3.2.74) iti vic‌| tadantāt‌ kapratyaye śurbhayikā, bhadraṃyikā ityatrāpi vikalpaḥ prasajyeta| tasmāt‌ tannivṛttyarthaṃ strīliṅganirdeśaḥ| śubhambhadraṃśabdau makārāntau nipātau| `yakapūrvāyāḥ' ityādi| grahaṇavākyām‌| tasya `dhātvantayoryakārakakārayoḥ' ityādi| vivaraṇam‌| `vaktavyam‌' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāddhātvantayorapi yakāravakārayoranantarasyākārasyettvapratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, sa na bhaviṣyatīti| `sunayikā, suśayikā' iti| ṇīñśīṅbhyāṃ `erac‌' (3.3.56) ityac‌| śobhano nayo'syāḥ, śobhanaḥ śayo'syāḥ--sunayā, suśayā, tataḥ `prāgivāt‌ kaḥ'(5.3.70), `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvatvam‌| `supākikā', `aśokikā' iti| `ḍupacaṣ‌ pāke' (dhā.pā.996), `śuca śoke' (dhā.pā.183), bhāve ghañ‌| śobhanaḥ pāko'syāḥ, avidyamānaḥ śoko'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ, `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌, `āpo'nyatarasyām‌' (7.4.15) iti hrasvatvam‌|| 47. bhastraiṣājājñādvāsvā nañpūrvāṇāmapi| (7.3.47) `bhastrakā, bhastrikā' iti| pūrvavat‌ kaḥ| `abhastrakā, abhastrikā' iti| pūrvavat‌ kapratyayaḥ, bahuvrīhiḥ, tatapuruṣo vā| atha kasmādeṣā--dve nañpūrve nodāhriyete? ityāha--`eṣādve nañpūrve na prayojayataḥ' iti| prakṛtatvādittvapratiṣedhavikalpa iti vijñeyam‌| `kiṃ kāraṇam‌' iti| anena nañpūrvayoraprayojakatve kāraṇaṃ pṛcchati| `atra hi' ityādinā tatkaraṃ darśayati| `so'ntarvartinyā vibhaktyā' iti| yā'sau samāsārthā vibhaktistayā luptayā'pi pratyayalakṣaṇena sa āpsubantādevaitacchabdād‌ dviśabdācca paraḥ sampadyate, tenettvasya prāptireva nāsti; `asupaḥ' (7.3.44) iti pratiṣedhāt‌, tatkiṃ pratiṣedhavikalpena? tasmādeṣādve nañpūrve na prayojayataḥ| yadyevam‌, anayaiva yuktyā svaśapabdo'pi na prayojayet‌? ityata āha--`svaśabdastu' ityādi| yuktaṃ yadeṣādva nañpūrve na prayojayataḥ, atra vyavadhānābhāvāt‌ subantāt‌ para āb bhavatīti kṛtvā, na hi prāk‌ ṭerbhavannakaj‌ vyavadhāyako bhavitumarhati; svaśabdastu `svamajñāti dhanākhyāyām‌' (1.1.35) iti vacanājjñātidhanayorasarvanāmasaṃjñakaḥ, tena tasmāt‌ kapratyayenaiva bhavitavyam‌, nākacā, tatra yadi nañsamāsaṃ kṛtvā kapratyayaḥ kriyate, tadantācca ṭāp‌, tadāsau subantāt‌ paro na bhavati; kapratyayena vyavadhānāditi asarvanāmaṃjñakaḥ svaśabdo nañpūrvo'pi vikalpaṃ prayojayati| `bhastretyayamabhāṣitapuṃskaḥ' iti| striyāmeva sarvadā vṛtteḥ| yadyevam‌, `abhāṣitapuṃskācca' (7.3.48) ityanenaiva vikalpaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkimarthamihopādīyate? ityata āha--`tasya' ityādi| upasarjanamarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat‌ tathoktam‌| yadānupasarjanaṃ bhastrāśabdo bhavati, tadāyamabhāṣitapuṃska iti satyamuttarasūtreṇa siddho vikalpaḥ; tatrāpi nañpūrvāṇāmityanuṣṛtteḥ| yadā tūpasarjanaṃ bhavati, tadā bhāṣitapuṃskatvaṃ pratipadyata iti na sidhyati| tasmādupasarjanasya bhāṣitapuṃskasyāpi yathā syādityevamarthamiha bhastrāśabdasya grahaṇam‌| `abhastrakā, abhastrikā' iti| `alpe' (5.3.85) ityarthe `prāgivāt‌ kaḥ' (5.3.70) `atra' iti| upanyasta udāharaṇe| `upasarjanahrasvatve kṛte' iti| avidyamānā bhastrā'sayā iti bahuvrīhau kṛte `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) ityanena| `punaḥ' ityādi| abhastraśabdo hi bahuvrīhiḥ, sa puṃsyapi varttata iti bhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati| tasmādyadā ṭāp‌ sa bhāṣitapuṃskaśabdādutpadayate| tasaya bhāṣitapuṃskādutpannasyāpi ṭāpo yaḥ `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvo bhavati, nāsāvabhāṣitapuṃskādvihitasyātaḥ sthāne bhavati| tasmādabhāṣitapuṃskādityanena na sidhyati--ityabhiprāyaḥ| `nañpūrvāṇāmapītyapiśabdādanyapūrvāṇāṃ kevalānāṃ ca vidhirayamiṣyate' iti| tatrodāharaṇamāha--`nirbhastrikā' ityādi| nirgatā bhastrā yasyāḥ sā nirbhastrikā| vahvyo bhastrā yasyāḥ sā bahubhastrikā| ādiśabdena subhastrakā, subhastrikā; bhastrakā, bhastrikā-ityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌| yadi tarhyanyapūrvāṇāṃ kevalānāṃ ca vidhiriṣyate, tadā `nañpūrvāṇām‌' iti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| nañādipūrvāṇāṃ tadantavidhinā bhaviṣyati, kevalanāñca vyapadeśivadbhāvena; `grahaṇavatā pratipadikena tadantavidhirna' (vyā.pa.89) iti| `vyapadeśivadbhāvo'prātapadikena' (dhā.pa.pā.65) iti vacanānna sidhyatītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam‌, ubhe api hyete paribhāṣe pratyayavidhiviṣaye evetyata āha--`atra' ityādi| tadantavadhinā vyapadeśivadbhāvenātra siddhasyaiva prakaravidhernañpūrvāṇāmapīti vacanānuvādaḥ| kimarthaḥ? mandabuddhipratapattyarthaḥ| nañpūrvāṇāmapīti vacanamantareṇa yaḥ pratipattumanantaroktamarthamasamarthastasyāpi mandabuddheḥ pratipattiryathā syādityevamartham‌|| 48. abhāṣitapuṃskācca| (7.3.48) nañpūrvāṇāmapītyanukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ| khaṭvakā, khaṭvikā' iti| pūrvavat‌ kaḥ| khaṭvāśabdo'yamādiṣṭaliṅgo nityaṃ striyāmeva varttata iti bhāṣitapuṃsko na bhavati| `akhaṭavikā' iti| na khaṭvā akhaṭveti nañsamāsaḥ| `paramakhaṭvikā' ityādi| `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityāpinā samāsaḥ| sarvatra `ko'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ| bahuvrīherbhāṣitapuṃskatvādatra na bhavitavyamanena vikalpeneti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarattumāha--`bahuvrīhau' ityādi| kathaṃ punarabhāṣitapuṃskādityucyamāne bahuvrīhau bhāṣitapuṃskādapi bhavati? ityāha--`atrāpyabhāṣitapuṃskāt‌' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yadyapi bahuvrīherbhāṣitapuṃsko bhavati, tathāpi yadā kapi `āpo'nyatarasyām‌' (7.4.15) iti hrasvaḥ kriyate, tadā'bhāṣitapuṃskādeva vihitasyākārasya sthāne yaḥ syādakārastasmādbhavatyeva vikalpaḥ| avidyamānā khaṭvā'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ, `śeṣādvibhādhā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌; tato hrasvaḥ| sa cābhāṣitapuṃskādeva vihitasyākārasya bhavati| tenākhaṭvakā, akhaṭ‌viketi vikalpo bhavatyeva| `yadā tu' ityādi| avidyamānā khaṭvā'syā iti bahuvrīhau kṛta upasarḍajanahrasvatvam‌; tataṣṭāp‌| alpā akhaṭveti `prāgivat‌ kaḥ' (5.3.70)--`akhaṭvikā' iti| atra vikalpo na bhaviṣyati; bhāṣitapuṃskatvādvahuvrīhevihitasyātaḥ sthāne'kārasya vihitatvāt‌| prādisamāse'pi na bhavatīti darśayannāha--`tathā' ityādi| `atikhaṭ‌vikā' iti| atrāpi prādisamāse kṛte, upasarjanahrasvatve ca, punastatpuruṣādbhāṣitapuṃskādvihitasyātaḥ sthāne vihito'kāra iti na pravarttate vikalpaḥ|| 49. ādācāryāṇām‌| (7.3.49) nañpūrvāṇāmapīta nivṛttam‌; pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt‌| ittvāpavādo'yaṃ yogaḥ| `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvapavādaśca| ācāryagrahaṇaṃ nityārtham‌| asati hi tasmin‌; `udīcām‌' (7.3.46) ityadhikārādvikalpaḥ syāt‌| ācāryagrahaṇe tu sati tena `udīcām‌' ityetasminnivarttite, nitya eṣa vidhirbhavatīti|| 50. ṭhasyekaḥ| (7.3.50) atra yadyaviśeṣeṇa ṭhasya grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, paṭhitā, paṭhitumityādau dhātvantasyāpi syāt‌| ata etaddoṣaparijihīrṣayā pratyayasaya ṭhasya grahaṇam‌, na tu ṭhamātrasyeti darśayitumāha--`aṅgasya nimittaṃ yaṣṭhaḥ' iti| aṅgasyeti sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī| atara yadyapi dhātvavayavo hyaṅgasya sambandhī bhavati, tathāpi yadā yato hyaṅgasyātmalābho yasminnaṅgamityetadbhavati, sa eva pratyāsatteraṅgasya nimittībhūtaḥ sambandhī gṛhyate, na tvarayavo'pi| `kaścāṅgasya nimittaṃ bhavati' iti| evaṃ manyate--yadi sāmānyenāṅgasya nimittaṃ yattadiha gṛhyate dhātvantasya ṭhasya syādeva, bhavanti hi avayavā aṅgasayāvayavino nimittam‌; taistasyārabhyamāṇatvādityāha--`pratyayaḥ' iti| asyāyamabhiprāyaḥ--satsvapyavayaveṣu yāvatpratyayo notpadyate tāvattasyāvayavino'ṅgātmalābho na bhavati, tasmiṃstūtpanne sati bhavati; tasmātpratyaya evāṅgasya nimittam‌, nāvayava iti| `ākṣikaḥ, śālākikaḥ' iti| akṣairdīvyati, [`akṣairdīvyatītyarthe ṭhak‌--mu. pāṭhaḥ] śalākābhirdīṣyatītyarthe ṭhak‌| `lāvaṇikaḥ' iti| atrāpi lavaṇaṃ paṇyamasyeti `lavaṇāṭṭhañ‌' (4.4.52)| iha ṭhasyeti varṇamātrasya grahaṇaṃ vā syāt‌? saṅghātasya vā? tatra pūrvasmina pakṣe ṭhasyeti nirdeśo nopadyate; itarasmiṃstvoṇādike'tiprasaṅgaḥ--`kaṇeṣṭhaḥ' (da.u.5-6) kaṇṭha ityādau| iha tu mathitaṃ paṇyamasyeti māthitika iti ṭhasyekādeśe kṛte prakṛteśca `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) ityakāralope sati tāntatāyāmupajātāyāmikādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāṭṭhagrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌ `isusuktāntāt‌ kaḥ' (7.3.51) iti kādeśaḥ prasajyeteti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`ṭhagādiṣu' ityādi| ādiśabdena ṭhañādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌, yadi teṣu varṇamātramanackapratyayo'kārastūccāraṇārthaḥ, tadā `ṭhasyekaḥ' (7.3.50) ityatrāpyakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| evaṃ varṇamātraṃ sthānitvenopādīyate| ihāpyakāra uccāraṇārtha eveti varṇamātragrahaṇena yo doṣaḥ parasya codayiṣyataḥ sa varṇamātraṃ sthānitvenopādīyate| ihāpyakāra uccāraṇārtha eveti varṇamātragrahaṇena yo doṣaḥ parasya codayiṣyataḥ sa nirākṛtaḥ| satyapi varṇamātrasya grahaṇe, āgantukenoccāraṇārthenākāreṇa ṭhasyeti nirdeśasyopādānāt‌| `saṅghātagrahaṇe tu' ityādi| atha ṭhagādiṣu saṅghātaḥ sāckaṣṭhaśabdaḥ pratyayaḥ, evaṃ satyatrāpi sūtre saṅghātasyeti sthānitvena grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌| yastvasmin‌ pakṣe prathamo doṣaścodayitumiṣṭaḥ parasya, taṃ jihīrṣurāha--`tatra' ityādi| yo'pyasmin‌ pakṣe dvitīyo doṣastaṃ `mathita paṇyamasya' ityādinā''viṣkṛtya--`sannipātalakṣaṇo vidhiḥ' ityādinā pariharati| ajādisannipātena takārāntatopajātā, sā notsahate'jāditvaṃ vihantumiti na bhavati kādeśaḥ| `yasyeti ceti lopasya sthānivadbhāvādvāvādvā' iti| na bhavati kādeśa iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ; sthānivadbhāvena takārāntatayā vihatatvāt‌| sthānivadbhāvaḥ punaḥ `acaḥ parasmin‌' (1.1.57) ityādinā| pūrvavidhau karttavye sthānivadbhavati, na cātra parvasya vidhiḥ, kiṃ tarhi? pūrvasmāduttarasya, tatkutaḥ sthānivadbhāvaḥ? ityāha--`pūrvasmādapi' ityādi| na kevalaṃ pūrvasya vidhiḥ pūrvavidhiriti ṣaṣṭhasamāso'bhimataḥ, api tu pūrvasmādvidhiḥ pūrvavidhiriti pañcamīsamāso'pītyabhiprāyaḥ|| 51. isusuktāntāt‌ kaḥ| (7.3.51) pūrveṇekādeśe prāpta isādyantāt‌ kādeśa ucyate| `sarpiṣkaḥ' iti| `tadasya pacyam‌' (4.4.51) iti prāgvahatīyaṣṭhak‌, rutvavisarjanīyau, visarjanīyasya `isusoḥ sāmarthye' (8.3.44) iti ṣatvam‌| `dhānuṣkaḥ' iti| `tadasya grahaṇam‌' (4.4.57) iti ṭhak‌| `yājuṣkaḥ' iti| `tena dīvyati' (4.4.2) iti ṭhak‌| `naiṣādakarṣukaḥ, śābarajambūkaḥ' iti| niṣādakarṣvāṃ jātaḥ, śābarajambāṃ jāta iti `ordeśe ṭhañ‌' (4.2.119), `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ| `mātṛkam‌' paitṛkam‌' iti| māturāgatam‌, piturāgatamiti--`ṛtaṣṭhañ‌' (4.3.78)| `audaśvitkaḥ' iti| `udaśvivato'nyatarasyām‌' (4.2.19) iti ṭhak‌| śākṛtkaḥ, yākṛtkaḥ' iti| śakṛtā yakṛtā saṃsṛṣṭe (4.4.22) iti ṭhak‌| atheha kasmānna bhavati--āśiṣā caratītyāśiṣikaḥ, uṣā caratītyauṣikaḥ? ityāha--`isusoḥ' ityādi| `arcisucihusṛpichādichardibhya isiḥ' (da.u.9.30), `janerusiḥ' (da.u.9.37), `arttipṝvapiyajitanidhanitapibhyo nit‌' (da.u.9.39) ityādinā prakaraṇena yau vihitau tayorlakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) pratipadoktayorisusorgrahaṇam‌| tenāśiṣikaḥ, auṣika ityatrāpi na bhavati; lākṣaṇikatvādisusoḥ| tathā hyāṅapūrvāt‌ `śāsu icchāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1022) ityasmāt‌, `vasa nivāse' (dhā.pā.1005) ityetasmācca kevalāt‌ kvipi kṛte `śāsa idaṅhaloḥ' (6.1.15) samprasāraṇe parapūrvatve ca kṛta isusati rūpaṃ pratipadyate| `āśiṣikaḥ, auṣikaḥ' iti| `śāsivasidhasīnāṃ ca| (8.3.60) iti ṣatvam‌| tasya tvasiddhatvāt‌ kādeśa prāptirāśaṅkitā| `doṣa upasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--`nañpūrvāṇāmapi' (7.3.47) ityato'pagarahaṇamanuvarttate; sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena doṣo'pi bhaviṣyati|| 52. cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ| (7.3.52) `pākaḥ, tyāgaḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ‌| `pākyam‌, vākyam‌' iti| `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124)| nanu cātra dhiṇṇyatoḥ kāryiṇoścajoḥ sāmyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti--cakārasya dhiti, jakārasya ṇyati, tatkathaṃ tyāgaḥ, rāga iti dhiti jakārasaya kutvaṃ prāpnoti? naitadasti; jñāpakādatra yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati| yat‌ `bhujanyubjau pāṇyupatāpayoḥ' (7.3.61), `prayājānuyājau yajñāṅge' (7.3.62) iti ghañi jakārasya kutvābhāvaṃ nipātayati, `tena raktaṃ rāgāt‌' (4.2.1) iti ca nirdeśaṃ karoti, tajjñāpayati--yathāsaṃkhyamiha na bhavatati|| 53. nyuṅkvādīnāṃ ca| (7.3.53) adhiṇṇyadartho'yamārambhaḥ| `nāvañcaterityupratyayaḥ' iti| tatra `bhṛmṛśītṝcaritsaritanidhanimimasjibhya uḥ' (da.u.1.92) ityanuvṛtteḥ| `madguḥ' iti| `ṭumasjo śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1415), `jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti sakārasya dakāraḥ| `mimasjibhya uḥ' iti| anena `bhṛmṛśītṝcari' (da.u.1.92) ityādikamupalakṣayati| `bhṛguḥ' iti| `bhrasja pāke' (dhā.pā.1284)| `prathibhradi' (da.u.1.113) ityādike sūtra'ta eva sūtrā(da.u.1.92)dupratyayo'nuvarttate| `dūrepākaḥ'[`dūrepākāḥ'--mu.pāṭha] iti| karmakarttari pacādyac‌| `ukārāntāvapera' iti| adhīyata ityapekṣyate| `tañcateḥ' iti| `tancu tvancu gatau' (dhā.pā.191,192) iti, `vancu pralambhane' (dhā.pā.1703) `sphāyitañcivañci' iti sūtraikadeśaḥ `sphāyitañcivañciśakikṣipikṣudisṛpidṛpitṛpivanyundiśvitivṛtyajinīpadimadimudikhidibhidichidimandicandidahidasidambhivahavasivāśiśīṅhasasidhiśubhibhyo rak‌' (da.u.8.31) ityetat‌ sūtramupalakṣayati| `vyatiṣaṅgaḥ' iti| `ṣanja saṅge' (dhā.pā.987) `avasargaḥ' iti| `sṛja visarge' (dhā.pā.1178) pacādyaca| `medhaḥ' iti| `miha secane' (dhā.pā.992)| ajeva| `śvapākaḥ' iti| karmopapadādaṇpratyayaḥ `karmaṣyaṇ‌' (3.2.1) ityanena| `arhateḥ' iti| `arha pūjāyām‌' (dhā.pā.740)| `daheḥ' iti| `dahabhasmīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.992)| `ruheḥ' iti| `ruha bījajanmani prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.859)| nanu ca nyaṅkvādayaḥ kṛtakutvāḥ prātapadikagaṇe paṭhyante, tatkimarthamidam‌, yathaiva hi kutvādanyat‌ kāryaṃ bhavati nipātanāt‌ tathā kutvamapi bhaviṣyati? tasyaiva prātapadikapāṭhasyābhyanujñānārthamitadamucyate| asati hyatasmin‌ pramādapāṭho vijñāyateta|| 54. ho hanterñṇinneṣu| (7.3.54) `dhātayati' ityādyudāharaṇāni `hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ' (7.3.32) ityatra vyutpāditāni| `dhnanti' iti| laṭ‌, jherantādeśaḥ, `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ| `dhnantu' iti| loṭ‌| `adhvan‌' iti| laṅ‌, `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ| `prahāraḥ, prahārakaḥ' iti| haraterghañṇavulau| iha ṇinnagrahaṇaṃ hantiviśeṣaṇaṃ vā syāt‌--ñṇinnakāraparasya hanteryo hakāra iti, hakāraviśeṣaṇaṃvā--ñṇinnakāraparasaya hakārasyeti sa ceddhanteriti? tatra yadi pūrvakaḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, dhnantyādau na syāt‌, na hyatra nakāraparo hantiḥ; avayavena samudāyasya paurvāparyānupapatteḥ, anyasya nakārasyābhāvāt‌| athetaraḥ pakṣa āśrīyeta, na kvacit‌ syāt‌, na hi hakārasya ñṇinnakāraparatā sambhavati| asambhavastu dhnantatyādāvakāralopasya pūrvavidhau sthānivadbhāve satyakāreṇa vyavadhānāt, ghātayatītyādāvapi hakārāt‌ pareṇa hantyavayavenānaśabdena vyavadhānāt‌| atha vacanasāmarthyādvyavadhāne'pi kṛtvaṃ syāt‌, evamapi hananamicchatīti `supa ātmanaḥ kyaca' (3.1.8), `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) itīttvam‌, kyajantāṇṇavul‌, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopo hananīyaka ityatrāpi syāditi yaścodayet‌, taṃ prati pakṣāntaramāśrityāha--`ñṇitpratyayo'tra hanterviśeṣaṇam‌' ityāda| na hi sarveṣāṃ ñṇinnakārāṇāṃ hantiṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvamupapadyate, nāpi hakāraṃ prati| tasmādyathāsambhavaṃ kiñcideva kasyacidviśeṣaṇam‌| ñṇitpratyayastu hanteḥ parataḥ upapadyate iti tasyāsau viśeṣaṇam‌--ñṇiti pratyaye parato'nantarasya hanteriti| nakārastu hanterviśeṣaṇam̐ nopapadyate; pūrvoktāt‌ kāraṇāt‌| ikārasya tūpapadyata iti tasyaiva viśeṣaṇam‌--nakāre paratonantarasya hantihakārasyānantara iti| ayaṃ tu `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāllabhyate| ānantaryāśrayaṇe tu--hantā, hantumityatrāpyatiprasaṅgo nirastaḥ| nanu cānantaryameva hakārasya ṇakāreṇa na sambhavati, akāralopasya sthānivadbhāve satyakāreṇa vyavadhānāt‌? ityata āha--`tacca' ityādi| `sannipātakṛtam' iti| śrutikṛtamityarthaḥ| nanu cāśrite'pi sannipātakṛtānantarye sthānivadbhāvaśāstreṇa yat‌ kṛtamanānantaryaṃ tadvihanyādeva kutvam‌? ityata āha--`sthānivadbhāvaśāstrakṛtaṃ tu' ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇamavidhātakam‌? ityāha--`vacanasāmarthyāt‌' iti| yadi sthānivadbhāvaśāsatadrakṛtamanānantarya vyavadhāyakaṃ bādhakaṃ syānnakāravacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; niravakāśatvāt‌| tasmādvacanasāmarthyānna vighātakam‌| `yadyapi' ityādinā yau dvau pakṣāvupanyastau, tatra dvitīye pakṣe yo doṣastasya parīhāraḥ| tatra nakāreṇa hakāre viśeṣyamāṇe yo doṣaḥ sa pūrvameva parihṛtaḥ| samprati tu ñṇitpratyayena hakāre viseṣyamāṇe yo doṣastaṃ pariharati| yo'yaṃ hanteravayavo hakārāt‌ paro'kārādirnakārāntaḥ, tena sarvatra ñṇitpratyayasya vyavadhānam‌| ananīyaśabdena tu cyavadhānaṃ sambhavati, na sambhavati ca tatra `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'ti vacanaprāmāṇyāt‌' (vyā.pa.46) iti ghātayatītyādau kutvaṃ bhavati| yena tvananīyaśabdena vyavadhānaṃ na sambhavati, sambhavati ca tena vyavadhāne hananīyaka ityatra na bhaviṣyati| ādye tu pakṣe yo doṣa uktaḥ, sa tasyānabhyupagamādevānavasaraḥ| hanteḥ śtipā nirdeśo dhātunirdeśārtha eva, na yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ| tatra hi `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti bhavitavyameva kutvena|| 55. abhyāsācca| (7.3.55) `jighāṃsati' iti| san‌, `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ, dvirvacanam, `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam‌--jhakāraḥ; `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) iti jaśtvam‌--jakāraḥ, `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) ittīttvam‌| `jaṅghanyate' iti| `nugato'nunāsikāntasya' (7.4.85) iti nuk‌| jaghāna' iti| uttamapuruṣeṇali yadā ṇitvaṃ nāsti tadedamudāharaṇam‌| ṇittvapakṣe tu pūrveṇaiva siddham‌| agra hananaśabdāt‌ kyaci kṛte tadantāt‌ sani jihananīyiṣatītyatra kasmānna bhavatīti, bhavati hyavābhyāsāt‌ paro hantihakaraḥ? ityāha--ihābhyāsanimittapratyaye' ityādi| iha `hanteḥ' (7.3.54) ityanuvarttate, aṅgasyeti ca| abhyāsenābhyāsanimittaṃ pratyayaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ, tasya pratyayaḥ viśeṣanimittatvāt‌, tatra tenābhyāsanimittena pratyayena hanteraṅgaṃ viśiṣyate| `abhyāsanimitte[abhyāsanimitte pratyeye hanteraṅgasya--kāśikā] pratyaye yadaṅgaṃ hantiḥ' iti| tenāpyevaṃvidhena hantinābhyāso viśiṣyate| yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya hanteraṅgasya yo'bhyāsaḥ--ityevaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve satyabhyāsanimitte sanādau pratyaye hanteraṅgasya yo'bhyāsastasmādeva kutvena bhavitavyam‌| `teneha [`tena' nāsti--kāśikā] na bhavati--`jihananīyiṣati' iti| na hyatarābhyāsanimitte pratyaye sani hantiraṅgam‌, kiṃ tarhi? hananīyaśabdaḥ| yasmiṃstu hantiraṅgam‌, lyuṭi sa nābhyāsanimittm‌|| 56. heracaṅi| (7.3.56) `prajighīṣati' iti| `hi gatau' (dhā.pā.1257) san‌, pūrvavaddīrghatvam‌| `prajedhīyate' iti| `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ, dvirvacanam‌, `guṇo yaṅlakoḥ' (7.4.72) ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ| `prajighāya' iti| ṇal‌, vṛddhyāyādeśo| `prācīhayat‌' iti| hetumaṇṇica, `ṇiśri' (3.1.48) ityādinā caṅādeśaḥ, `ṇau caṅyupadhāyāḥ' (7.4.1) iti hrasvaḥ; `caṅi' (6.1.11) iti dvirvacanam‌| tacca `ṇau kṛtaṃ sthānivadbhavati' (cāṃ.pa.21) iti hiśabdasaya `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghaḥ| `caṅyamyāsanimitte' ityādi| prājīhayadityatra caṅyabhyāsanimitte parato yo ṇic‌ tasmin‌ hinotiraṅgam‌, na tu tasminneva caṅyabhyāsanimitte; iha sūtre'byāsādhikārāt‌| abhyāsenākṣipte''bhyāsanimitte pratyaye yadaṅgaṃ hinotirityevaṃ vijñāyate, evañca vijñāyamāne kaḥ prasaṅgo yo vyadhikasya caṅi syāt‌? naivaṃ prāpnotīsyato nārtho'caṅīti pratiṣedhena| evaṃ pratyākhyāya caṅgrahaṇam‌, tasya prayojanamāha--`tatkriyate' ityādi| kiṃ punaranena jñāpyate? ityāha--`heracaṅi' ityādi| `heracaṅi' ityādi| `heracaṅi' ityanena caṅo'nyatra sanādau ṇyadhikasyāpi hinoteḥ kutvaṃ bhavatītyeṣo'rtho jñāpyate| `tena' ityādinā jñāpakasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `prajighāyayiṣati' iti| prahāyayitumicchatīti ṇyantāt‌ san‌|| 57. sanliṭorjeḥ| (7.3.57) `jigīṣati jigāya' iti| `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti parasyāderjakārasya kutvam‌, `jyā vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1499) ityasaya liṭ‌| grahijyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇe kṛte parapūrvatve ca jiratyeṣa rapaviśeṣo bhavati| atastasyāpi kutvaṃ prāpnoti, jigrahaṇena grahaṇāt‌| na ca śakyate vaktum‌, `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghatve kṛte jigrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati, ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt‌; (vyā.pa.16) anyathā hi jigīṣatītyatrāpi `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghatve kṛte jigrahaṇena grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati| atha vā--prāgeva dīrghāt‌ paratvāt‌ kutvena bhavitavyamiti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`jināteḥ' ityādi| lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) `ji jaye' (dhā.pā.561) iti yaḥ paṭhyate, tasyaivedaṃ pratipadoktasya grahaṇam‌, na jināteḥ| samprasāraṇe kṛte yajjīrūpaṃ sampadayate, tasya lākṣaṇikatvāt‌| `jijyatuḥ, jijyuḥ' iti| `liṭ, atus‌, us‌, `eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya' (6.4.82) iti yaṇādeśaḥ|| 58. vibhāṣā ceḥ| (7.3.58) 59. na kvādeḥ| (7.3.59) `cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇyatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutve prāpte pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate| `kūjaḥ, khajaḥ, garjaḥ' iti| `kūja avyakte śabde' (dhā.pā.223), `kharja vyathane' (dhā.pā.229) `garja śabde' (dhā.pā.226)|| 60. ajivrajyośca| (7.3.60) `samājaḥ udājaḥ' iti| `aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.230)| `samudorajaḥ paśuṣu' (3.3.69) iti ghañ‌| `parivrājaḥ, parivrājyam‌' iti| `vaja vraja gatau' (dhā.pā.252,253)| athājerṇyati kasmādudāharaṇaṃ nopanyastam‌? ityāha--`vībhāvasya' ityādi| tatra `ajervyaghañapoḥ' (2.4.56) iti vībhāvasya vidhānamiti; tena tasyodāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate, tato na darśitamityabhiprāyaḥ| cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena vajerapi pratiṣedho bhavati--vājaḥ, vācyamiti|| 61. bhujanyubjau pāṇyupatāpayoḥ| (7.3.61) `bhujaḥ' iti| `bhuja pālanābhyavahārayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1454), `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti dhañ‌| atra `ave tṝstrorghañ‌' (3.3.120) ityato ghañanuvarttate| `nyubjaḥ' iti| yadā dakāropadha ucyate `udja ārjave' iti tadā dakārasya bakāro nipātyate| atha vā--`asiddhebha udjeḥ' [`iyavaraṭ‌' sūtrasthametat‌ vacanaṃ mahābhāṣye] ityanayeṣṭyā dakārasya bhakāre kṛte jaśtvena bakāro bhavati| yadi tu bakāropadhaḥ `ubja ārjave' iti tadā samudga itayatara bakārasaya dakāro vaktavyaḥ|| 62. prayājānuyajau yajñāṅge| (7.3.62) `prayājaḥ, anuyājaḥ' iti| prapūrvādanupūrvācaca yajeḥ `akarttari ca kārake saṃjñāyām‌' (3.3.19) iti ghañ‌ tasminna kutvaṃ nipātyate| `pradarśanārtham‌' iti| anyasyāpyevaṃprakārasyopalakṣaṇārthamityarthaḥ| tenānyatrāpi prayājānuyājaprakāre yajñāṅge kutvaṃ na bhavati| pradarśanārthatā punaḥ prayājānuyājaśabdayoryajñāṅgagarahaṇādveditavyā, taddhyevamarthaṃ kriyate| kathaṃ nāma prayājanṛyājagarahaṇasyopalakṣaṇārthatā pratīyeta! [pratīyate--prā.mu. pāṭhaḥ] anyathā hi nipātanasāmarthyādeva yajñāṅgaviṣayatā vijñāyata iti tanna karttavyameva syāt‌|| 63. vañcergatau| (7.3.63) `vañcam‌' iti| `vañcu cañcu tañcu tvañca mruñcu mlañcu bhrucu mlucu gatyarthāḥ (dhā.pā.189-196)| karmaṇi ghañ‌| vañcyaṃ vañcanti gantavyaṃ gacchantītyarthaḥ| `caṅkam‌' iti| `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti ghañ‌|| 64. āka ucaḥ ke| (7.3.64) `nyokaḥ' iti| nipūrvāt‌ `uca samavāye' (dhā.pā.1223) ityasmāt‌ `igupadhajñaprīkiraḥ kaḥ' (3.1.135)--nyucatīti nyokaḥ, nivasatītyarthaḥ| nyucantyasminniti `ghañarthe kavidhānam‌' (vā.306) iti vā kaḥ--nyokaḥ, nivasantyasminnityarthaḥ| `kimarthaṃ punaḥ' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--rūḍhiśabdo'yam‌, nātra kaścidavayavārtho'sti, vyatpattiḥ kevalaṃ karttavyā, sā ca `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti ghañyapi kṛte bhavatyeva, tato nārtho'nena yogeneti| `ghañi satyādyudāttaḥ syāt‌' iti| `ñnityādernityam‌' (6.1.197) ityanena| atha divaukasaḥ, jalaukasa ityādau kathaṃ kutvamṣa yāvatā nātra kapratyayo'sti, nāpi dhiṇṇyatau, kiṃ tarhi? asunniti? ata āha--`divaukasaḥ' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 65. ṇya āvaśyake| (7.3.65) `avaśyapacyam‌' ityādi| `ḍupacaṣ‌ pāke' (dhā.pā.996), `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1842), `āvaśyakādhamarṇyayorṇiniḥ' (3.3.170) ityanuvṛttau `kṛtyāśca' (3.3.171) ityāvaśyake ṇyat‌| mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt‌ (2.1.72) samāsaḥ, `lubhyedavaśyamaḥ kṛtye tumkāmamanasorapi' (kāśikā 6.1.144) ityanayeṣṭyā'vaśyamo makāralopaḥ|| 66. yajayācarucapravacarcaśca| (7.3.66) `ṇye' ityeva| anāvaśyakārthamidam‌| `yājyam‌' ityādi| `yaja devapūjādau' (dhā.pā.1002), `ṭuyāc‌ yācñāyām‌' (dhā.pā.863), `ruca dīptau' (dhā.pā.745), `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1842) prapūrvaḥ, `ṛca stutau' (dhā.pā.1302)| kathaṃ punaṝcerṇyat‌, yāvatā `ṛdupadhāccāklṝpi cṛteḥ' (3.1.110) iti ṇyadapadādeva kyapā bhavitavyam‌? ityāha--ṛdupadhāt‌' ityādi| atha pravacigrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `vaco'śabdasaṃjñāyām‌' (7.3.67) ityanenaiva pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`pravacigrahaṇaṃ śabdasaṃjñārtham‌' iti| syādetat‌| nāstyeva kaścicchabdo yasya vācyamiti nāmadheyam‌? ityāha--`pravācyo nāma' ityādi| `apare punaḥ' ityādinā matāntaraṃ darśayati| `etattu' iti| avivākyametadrūpam‌| kaḥ punarasau viśeṣaḥ? ityāha--`daśarātrasya' ityādi| yasmin‌ yājñikā na vibruvate, tasya daśarātrasya yaddaśamāhastatraivaitacchaśabdarūpamiṣyate, nānyatra| yadyevam‌, anarthakaṃ niyamārthaṃ pravacigrahaṇam‌, avaśyaṃ tasya viśiṣṭaviṣaye vuttiryathā syādityavamartho yatnaḥ karttavyaḥ, tata eva yatnāt‌ tatra kutvamapi bhaviṣyati? naitadasti; niyamāddhyanyopasargasya kutvapratiṣedho nivarttate| abhidheyavyavasthā tu prasiddhivaśādeva vijñāsyate| `ṇyati pratiṣedhe' ityādi| ṇyati pratiṣedhe'smin‌ kriyamāṇe `tyaja hānau' (dhā.pā.986) ityasyopasaṃkhyānaṃ karttavyam‌| upasaṃkhyānaśabdasaya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena tyajerapi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti|| 67. vaco'śabdasaṃjñāyām‌| (7.3.67) 68. prayojyaniyojyau śakyārtho| (7.3.68) prapūrvasya nipūrvasya ca `yujir‌ yoge' (dhā.pā.1444) ityasaya ṣyati kutvābhāvo nipātyate, sa ceṇṇyacchakyārthe bhavati| śakyārthe punarṇyat `śaki liṅ‌ ca' (3.3.172) ityanena veditavyaḥ| tatra hi `kṛtyāśca' (3.3.171) ityanuvarttate| atha kimarthaṃ punarnipātanam‌, yāvatā `ṇye' (7.3.65) ityanuvarttata eva? tatra `prayujaniyujoḥ śakyarthe' iti vaktavye nipātanaṃ rūḍhyartham‌| aguṇabhūtā yatra śakyārthatā tatra yathā syāt‌--prayojyo bhṛtyaḥ, niyojyo dāsa iti| svamini prayojyo niyojya iti na bhavati| na hi tatra prayojyaniyojyaśabdau rūḍhau, kiṃ tarhi? guṇabhūtādeva|| 69. bhojyaṃ bhakṣye| (7.3.69) `bhojyam‌' iti| `bhuja pālanābhyavahārayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1454) ityasya ṇyati bhakṣye'bhidheye kutvābhāvo nipātyate| `bhojyā yavāgūḥ' iti| nanu ca bhakṣirayaṃ kharaviśade'bhyavahārye varttate, na tu dravadravye, yathā--`saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ' (4.2.16) ityatra, tatkathaṃ `bhakṣye' ityucyamāne yavāgvāṃ bhavati? ityāha--`iha bhakṣyam‌' ityādi| nāvaśyaṃ bhakṣiḥ kharavirāde varttate| tathā hi--dravadravye'pyasya prayogo drṛśyate| yathā--ababhakṣaḥ, vāyubhakṣaḥ, vāyubhakṣa iti| tasmādabhyavahāryasāmānye bhakṣirvartata iti yavāgvāmapi bhavati| `bhujo bhakṣye' iti vaktavye nipātanaṃ rūḍhyartham‌| abhyavahārye bhakṣye karmaṇi yathā syāt‌ paripālanīye mā bhūt‌--bhogyā apūpāḥ| pālanīyā ityarthaḥ|| 70. ghorlopo leṭi vā| (7.3.70) `dadan‌' iti| `ḍudāñ‌ dāne' (dhā.pā.1091), liṅarthe leṭ‌ (3.4.97), jherantādeśaḥ, (7.1.3), `itaśca lopaḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (3.4.97) itīkāralopaḥ, `leṭo'ḍāṭau' (3.4.94) ityaṭ, śap‌, tasya juhotyāditvāt‌ śluḥ `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌, saṃyogāntalopaḥ, (8.2.23) `ṅamo hrasvāvaci ṅamuṇṇityam‌' (8.3.32) iti ṅmuḍāgamaḥ| `somodadadgandharvāya' iti| dadātespip‌, śeṣaṃ purvavat‌| `yadagniragnaye dadāt‌' iti| dadā-āditi sthite'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvam‌ (6.1.101) śeṣaṃ pūrvavat‌| yadyāḍāgame [`yadyaḍāgame'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] kṛte satyapi lope ca dadāditi sidhyati, kimarthaṃ tarhi vetyucyate? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| syādetat‌--visṣṭārthaṃ tarhi vāgrahaṇaṇayuktam‌; vadādityasya rūpasyāsiddhiṃ pratyāśaṅkāyā abhāvāt‌? ityata āha--`eṣā hi' ityādi| subodham‌| 71. otaḥ śyani| (7.3.71) `niśyati' ityādi| `śo tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1145), `cho chedane'[`nāstyayaṃ dhātuḥ'--mudritagranthe] (dhā.pā.1146) `do avakhaṇḍane' (dhā.pā.1148) `ṣo antakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1147)| atha kimarthaṃ iyanītyucyate, na `śiti' ityevocyeta, evaṃ hyucyamāne śyanyeva lopo bhaviṣyati, na hyokārāntācchyano'nyacchit‌ sambhavati, laghu caivaṃ sūtraṃ bhavati, tatrāyamapyarthaḥ--`ṣṭhivuklamucamāṃ śiti' (7.3.75) ityatra śidgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavatītyetadeva tatrānuvarttiṣyate? satyaṃ sidhyatyeva, kintu pratipattigauravaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ pratipattigauravaparīhārārthaṃ śyanītyuktam‌| `otaḥ' iti| taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham‌| na hyanyadasya nivarttyaṃ vidheyaṃ vā sambhavati|| 72. ksasyāci| (7.3.72) `adhukṣātām‌, adhukṣāthām‌' iti| duherluṅ‌, cliḥ, `svaritañitaḥ' (1.3.72) ityātmanepadam‌, ātāmāthām‌, `śāla igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ' (3.1.45) iti ksādeśaścleḥ, tasyānena `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) lopaḥ, `dāderghātorghaḥ' (8.2.32) iti hakārasya dhakāraḥ, `ekāco vaśo bhaṣ‌' (8.2.37) ityādinā bhaṣ‌--dhakāraḥ, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌--dhakārasya kakāraḥ `iṇkoḥ' (8.3.57) iti ṣatvam‌| `adhikṣi' iti| uttamapuruṣaikavacanamiṭ‌| `adhukṣat‌' iti| tip‌, `itaśca' (3.4.100) itīkāralopaḥ| `adhukṣatām‌' iti| `tasthasthamipām‌' (3.4.101) ityādinā tasastām‌| kakārakta upādānam, iha mā bhūt‌--haṃsau haṃsāḥ, ṣatsau, vatsā iti|| 73. lugvā duhadihalihaguhāmātmanepade dantye| (7.3.73) `duha prapūraṇe' (dhā.pā.1014), `diha upacaye' (dhā.pā.1015), `liha āsvādane' (dhā.pā.1016), `guhū saṃvaraṇe' (dhā.pā.896)--sarvaṃ ete svaritetaḥ| svaritettvāt‌ `svaritiñitaḥ kartrabhiprāye kriyāphake' (1.3.72) ityāmanepadinaḥ| `adugdha' iti| pūvavaddhakaraḥ, `jhaṣastathordho'yaḥ' (8.2.40) iti takārasya dhakāraḥ, `jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti dhakārasya gakāraḥ| `adugdhām‌' iti| thās‌, pūrvavad‌ dhatvādi| `adugdhvam‌' iti| dhvam‌| `aduhvahi' iti| vahiḥ| `adigdha' iti| pūrvavad‌ ghatvādi| `alīḍha' iti| hakārasaya `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhakāraḥ pūrvavat‌, takārasya dhatvaṃ ṣṭutvañca, `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13), `ḍhralopaḥ pūravasya (6.3.111) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| `nyagūḍha' iti| etadapi pūrveṇa tulyam‌| `vyatyapukṣata' iti| `puṣa puṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1182) vyatipūrvaḥ| `karttari karmaṇyatihāre' (1.3.14) ityātamanepadam‌, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti ṣakārasya kakāraḥ| `ajukṣāmāhi' iti| mahiṅa| atha luggrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā lopa ityanuvarttata eva? ityāha--`lopa iti varttamāne' iti| yadi lopagrahaṇamanuvarttya lopo vidhīyate tat‌ `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityantyasya syāt‌| ki tu sarvasyaiva bhavati; pratyayādarśanasya luksaṃjñāvidhānāt‌| tasmāt‌ sarvasya ksasya lopo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ luggrahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌| `vahyartham‌' iti| uttamapuruṣadvivacanārthamityarthaḥ| vahirarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat‌ tathoktam‌| athānyārthaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`anyatra tu' ityādi| yadātmanepadaṃ dantyādi tatsarvaṃ jhalādyeva| tatrāntyasyaivākārasya lope kṛte `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sakārasaya lopeneṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva| syādetat‌--anyatrāpi lukā vinā na sidhyati; akāralopasya sakāralope karttavye `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadabhāvāditi? ata āha--`sthānivadbhāvo'pyakāralopasya nāsti' iti| kasmānnāsti? ityāha--`pūrvatrāsiddhe na sthānivat‌' iti| tasmānnānyārthaṃ luggrahaṇam‌, api tu vahyarthameva| atra hyajhalāditvāt‌ `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sakāralopo nāstīti na sidhyati| `nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi luggrahaṇe vahau lukā na bhavitavyameva, adantyāditvāt‌, na hi dantyauṣṭhyo vakāro dantyagrahaṇena guhyate? ityāha--`dantyauṣṭhyo'pi' ityādi| atraiva hetumāha--`yadi' ityādi| yadi dantyauṣṭhyau dakāro dantyagrahaṇena na gṛhyet‌, tadā tāvityevaṃ brūyāt‌, na dantya iti| tāvapyucyamāne sarvamiṣṭaṃ sidhyatyeva| na hi tadargādanyaddantyamātmanepadasyāsti| tasmāddantyauṣṭhyo'pi vakāro dantyagrahaṇena gṛhyate| tatredaṃ codyate--yaduktam‌--"anyatra hyantyasyaiva lope kṛte `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sakāralopeneṣṭaṃ siddhyatyeveti, tadayuktam‌; na hi `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) ityanena sakāramātrasya lopo vidhiyate, kiṃ tarhi? sicaḥ, tathā hi tatraiva vakṣyati--`ayamapa sica eva lopaḥ'" iti? naitadasti; sijgrahaṇasya clyādeśasyopalakṣaṇārthatvācclertha ādeśastatsambandhina eva sakārasya lopo bhavatītyayaṃ tatrārtho veditavyaḥ|| 74. śamāmaṣṭānāṃ dīrghaḥ śyani| (7.3.74) bahuvacananirdeśādaṣṭagrahaṇāccādyartho gamyata ityāha--`śamādīnām‌' ityādi| `śamu upaśame (dhā.pā.1201), `tamu kāṅkṣāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1202), `damu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1203), `śramu tapasi khede ca' (dhā.pā.1204) `kṣamu sahane' (dhā.pā.1206), `bhramu anavasthāne' (dhā.pā.1205), `klamu glānau' (dhā.pā.1207), `madī harṣe' (dhā.pā.1208)--ityete'ṣṭau śamādayaḥ| `asyati' iti| `asu kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209)| aṣṭābhyaḥ pareṇāyaṃ paṭhyate| `bhramati' iti| `vā bhrāśa' (3.1.70) ityādinā śyan‌ yasmin‌ pakṣe nāsti tatredaṃ pratyudāharaṇam‌| śyan‌grahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham| śakyate hi `otaḥ śyani' (7.3.71) iti yat‌ prakṛtaṃ śangrahaṇaṃ talluggraṇeva vyavahitamapi maṇḍūkaplatinyāyenehānuvarttayitum‌|| 75. ṣṭhivukalabhyācamāṃ śiti| (7.3.75) `ṣṭhivu nirasane' (dhā.pā.1110) `klamu glāgau' (dhā.pā.1207), `camu chamu jamu jhamu adane' (dhā.pā.469-472) āṅpūrvaḥ| `klāmati' iti `vā bhrāśa' (3.1.70) ityādinā śyano'bhāve śap‌| `klamigrahaṇaṃ śavartham‌' (iti| na tu śyanartham‌, tatra pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌| `camerāṅpūrvasya' ityādinā kevalasyānyopasargapūrvasya vā mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ camerāṅpūrvasya grahaṇamiti darśayati|| 76. kramaḥ parasmaipadeṣu| (7.3.76) `krāmati' iti| `kramu pādavikṣepe' (dhā.pā.473)| `ākramate' iti| āṅpūrvaḥ| `āṅa udgamane' (1.3.40) ityātmanepadam‌| `ihotkrāma, saṅkrāma' ityādinā codyam‌| utpūrvāt‌ sampūrvācca kramerloṭa `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti hirādeśaḥ, tasya `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti herluki kṛte `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇaniṣedhāt‌ utkrāma saṅkrāma' ityatra dīrghatvaṃ na prāpnoti; na hyasati pratyayalakṣaṇe hau lupte kramaḥ parasmaipadaparatā sambhavati| `naiṣa doṣaḥ, ityādi parīhāraḥ| syādetat‌ lumatā lupte kramaḥ pratyaye hāveva karamiratrāṅgamityāha--`na ca kramiraṅgam‌' iti| śapā vyavahitatvāt‌| `kiṃ tarhi? `śapi' iti| śapa eva tato vyavahitasya vidyamānatvāt‌|| 77. iṣugamiyamāṃ chaḥ| (7.3.77) `icchati' iti| `tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ' (3.1.77)| `gacchati, yacchati' iti| `karttari śap‌' (3.1.68)| atha kimartham‌, `iṣu icchāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1351) ityetasyodito grahaṇam‌? ityāha--`iṣeḥ' ityādi| `iṣa gatau' (dhā.pā.1127) ityasaya daivādikasyeṣyatītyatra mā bhūt‌| `iṣa ābhīkṣṇye' (dhā.pā.1525) ityasya kraiyādikasaya iṣṇātītyatra mā bhūdityevamarthamukārānubandha iṣiriha gṛhyate| ye tarhīṣimuditamiha na paṭhanti, teṣāmiṣyati, iṣṇātītyatrāpi prāpnoti? ityata āha--`ye tviṣimuditam‌' ityāda| ya iṣimukārānubandhaviśiṣṭamiha na paṭhanti; ta iṣyati, iṣṇātītyatra cchatvaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌, `ksasyāci' (7.3.72) ityato'jgrahaṇamanuvarttayanti| anuvarttamāne'pyasmin‌ yadi tena śitītyetadviśiṣyate--śita ccho bhavati, kiṃ viśiṣṭe? ajādāviti, tadeṣṇāterloṭ‌sipo hītyādeśe kṛte `halaḥ śnaḥ śānajjhau' (3.1.83) iti śnāpratyayasya śānajādeśe kṛte sati iṣaṇetyatra `yasmin‌ vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) iti tadādividhinā chatvaṃ syādeveti manyamāna āha--`tacca pradhānamangrahaṇaṃ śitītyanena viśiṣyata iti varṇayanti' iti| aci ccho bhavati sa cecchidbhavati| prādhānpaṃ punarajgrahaṇasya viśiṣyamāṇatvādeva| `tathā ca sati' ityādi| evamacītyasmin‌ pradhāne śitītyanena viśiṣyamāṇe tadādividhirna bhavati| kiṃ kāraṇam‌? ityāha--`yasmin‌ vidhiḥ' ityādi| na kevalaṃ `yena vadhistadantasya' (1.1.72) ityetadeva tadantavidhānaṃ viśeṣaṇeneṣyate, api tu `yasminvidhistadadāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) ityetadeva tadādividhānaṃ viśeṣaṇenaiveṣyate| tena ca tadādividherabhāvādaṣāṇetyatra chatvaṃ na bhavati| asatyapi tadādividhau śānajadeśasya yo'yamādirākārastatra śiti parataśchatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`na hyayam‌' ityādi| śakāraḥ samudāyānubandhaḥ, nākārasyācaḥ| tasmānnājeva śit‌, api tu samudāya eveti na bhavati cchatvam‌|| 78. pāghrādhmāsthāmnādāṇdṛśyarttisarttiśadasadāṃ pibajighradhamatiṣṭhamanayacchapaśyarcchadhauśīyasīdāḥ| (7.3.78) `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925), `ghrā gandhopādāne' (dhā.pā.926) `dhmā śabdāgnisaṃyogayoḥ' (dhā.pā.927), `ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau' (dhā.pā.928), `mnā abhyāse' (dhā.pā.929), `dāṇ‌ dāne' (dhā.pā.930), `dṛśira prekṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.988); `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ, (dhā.pā.936), `ṛ sṛ gatau ca' (dhā.pā.1298,1099); `śadlṛ śātane' (dhā.pā.1428), `ṣadlṛ vaśaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1427) taudādakaḥ, `ṣadlṝ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu' (dhā.pā.854) bhauvādikaḥ--eṣāṃ dhātūnāṃ sthāne yathāsaṃkyaṃ pibādaya ādeśā bhavanti| nanu ca dvau sadī, tatra vaiṣamyādyathāsaṃkhyaṃ na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; eka eva hi sadirvikaraṇadvayārtha dviyapadiśyate| `śīyate' iti| `śadeḥ śitaḥ' (1.3.60) ityātmanepadam‌| `atha vā' ityādi| `pibaterlaghūpaghaguṇaḥ prāpnoti' ityatra parihārāntaram‌| yadyādyadātto na nipātyeta, tato dhātusvareṇāntodāttatve sati `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) iti śapā sahaikadeśe sati `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatve udātte kṛte pibatīti madhyodāttaṃ padaṃ syāt‌, ādyudāttañceṣyate, tasmādādyudātto nipātyate| sa nipātanasvaro dhātusvarasaya bādhako yathā syāt‌| `sarttaḥ' ityādi| vegaḥ-javaḥ; sa yasyāsti sa vegī, tasya bhāvo vegitā, tasyāṃ gatau sartterdhāvādeśamicchanti| sa ca `lugvā duhadiha' (7.3.73) ityādeḥ sūtrādvāgrahaṇānuvṛtterṣyavasthitavibhāṣātvāllamyata iti veditavyam‌| arttisarttīti śitapā nirdeśo dhātunirdeśārtha eva, na yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ| na hi yaṅaluki śitparaḥ sambhavati; adādatvat‌ tato vihitasya śapo lugvadhānāt‌| `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.73) iti śapo lagna bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? na, chandasa yathādṛṣṭānuvidhānāt‌| arttiprabhṛteśchabdasi yaṅluki śabantasya prayogādarśanāt‌|| 79. jñājanorjā| (7.3.79) `janerdevādakasaya grahaṇam‌' iti| dvau janī--daivādikaḥ `janī prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149), jauhotyādikaḥ `jana janane' (dhā.pā.1105) iti| tatraiha daivādikasya grahaṇam‌, netarasya| na hi tataḥ paraḥ śit‌ sambhavati, śluvidhānāt‌| dīrghoccāraṇasya prayojanamuttaratra vakṣyati|| 80. pvādīnāṃ hvasvaḥ| (7.3.80) `vlī gatau vṛditi yāvat‌ kecidicchanti' iti| teṣāṃ tataḥ pareṇa paṭhitayoḥ `vrī varaṇe' (dhā.pā.1504), `bhrī bhaye' (dhā.pā.1505)--ityetayorhrasvatvena na bhavitavyam‌--vrīṇāti, bhrīṇātīti| nanu lvādīnāṃ parisamāptyarthaṃ tad‌vṛtkaraṇam‌, anyathā ā gaṇāntāt‌ tebhyo niṣṭhānatvaṃ syāt‌, lvādiparisamāptyarthe ca tasminnāgaṇāntāḥ pvādayo yuktāḥ? ityata āha--`vṛtkaraṇam‌' ityādi| na hyubhayagaṇaparisamāptyarthatā kenacidvirudhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| `apare' ityādi| lvādergaṇasyānantaratvāt‌ tatparisamāptyarthataiva vṛtkaraṇasya yukteti bhāvaḥ| teṣāmevamicchatāṃ vrī varaṇe, bhro bhaye--ityetayorapi bhavitavyaṃ hrasavatvena vriṇāti, bhriṇātoti; pvādiṣūbhayorantarbhāvāt‌| `jānātītyatra hrasvaḥ prāpnoti' iti| talyāpa pvādyantarbhāvādityāha--`jñājanorjā' ityādi| yadi `jā' ityādeśe kṛte hrasavaḥ syāt‌ tadā dīrghoccāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, `ja' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| tasmāt‌ dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthyajjānātītyatra hrasvo na bhaviṣyati| nanu ca dīrghoccāraṇaṃ janyarthaṃ syāt‌, na hi janerja ityādeśe kṛte jāyata iti rūpaṃ sidhyati? ityata āha--`ja ityapi hyādeśe kṛte' ityādi| yeṣāntūbhayagaṇaparisamāptyarthaṃ vṛtkaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ kimarthaṃ jā iti dīrghoccāraṇam‌? jānātītyatra dīrgho yathā syāt‌? naitadasti; `ato dīrgho yañi' (7.3.101) iti dīrgho bhaviṣyati? nanu ca `aṅgavṛtte punarvṛttāvavidhirniṣṭhitasya' (vyā.pa.38) iti na prāpnoti? naitadasti; `niṣṭhitasya' ityucyate, na ca ja ityādeśe kṛte niṣṭhitamaṅgaṃ bhavati; aprayogārhatvāt‌| pratipattilāghavārthaṃ dīrghoccāraṇam‌|| 81. mīnāternigame| (7.3.81) `pramiṇanti' iti| `hinu mīnā' (8.4.15) iti ṇatvam‌, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ| mīnāteriha vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ `mīñ‌ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1476) ityasya kraiyādikasya grahaṇaṃ yathā sāt‌, `mīṅ‌ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1137) ityasya daivādikasaya grahaṇaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌| `mīñaḥ' iti nirdeśo na kṛto vaicitryārthaḥ|| 82. miderguṇaḥ| (7.3.82) `ñimidā snehane' (dhā.pā.743,1243) iti bhauvādiko daivādikaśca, tatra divāderiha grahaṇam‌; itarasva hyaṅittvācchapaḥ `pugantalaghūpadhasya ca' (7.3.86) ityevaṃ guṇaḥ siddhaḥ| `midyate' iti| `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.2.13) ityātmanepadam‌, `sārvadhātuke yak‌' (3.1.67)|| 83. jusi ca| (7.3.83) ikātra sannihitena prakṛtamaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, viśeṣaṇena tadantavidhirbhavatītyata āha--`igantasya' ityādi| `ajuhavuḥ' iti| laṅ‌, `sijabhyastavidabhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjus‌, śapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌| `abibhayuḥ' iti| `ñibho bhaye' (dhā.pā.1084)| `abibharuḥ' iti| `ḍu bhṛñ‌ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1087), `bhuñāmit‌' (7.4.76) ityabhyāsasyettvam‌| `cinuyuḥ sunuyuḥ' iti| liṅ‌, yāsuṭ‌ jherjus‌, `svādibhyaḥ śnuḥ' (3.1.73) `usyapadāntāt‌' (6.1.96) iti pararūpatvām‌| `tatra nāprāpte' ityādi| sārvādhātukamāśrayo yasyatat‌ sārvadhātukāśrayam‌| ṅittvaṃ nimittaṃ yasya pratiṣedhasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa sarvatraiva jusi prāpnotīti tasminnāprāpte'yaṃ guṇa ārabhyamāṇastasyaiva bādhako bhaviṣyati; na tu yasya yāsuḍāśrayaṃ ṅittvaṃ nimittam‌, tasyāpi| atra hi prāpte cāprāpte'yamārabhyate| cinuyurityādau prāpte, ajuhavurityādāvaprāpte| cakāraḥ samuccaye| nānyat‌ samuccetavyamastītyasyaiva lakṣaṇasya punarāvṛttimācaṣṭe| tena prakṛtalakṣaṇasyāpi pratiṣedhaviṣaye bhavati| `adīdhayuḥ' iti| `dīdhīṅ‌ dīptidevanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1076), laṅ‌ vyatyayena parasmaipadam‌, jhiḥ, `jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ‌' (6.1.6) ityabhyastasaṃjñā, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjus‌, adāditvācchapo luk‌| tataḥ `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) iti guṇaḥ prāptaḥ, sa `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti pratiṣiddhaḥ, so'pyanena punaḥ prāptau `dīdhīvevīṭām‌' (1.1.6) iti pratiṣiddhaḥ samuccayārthatvāccakārasya bhavati|| 84. sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ| (7.3.84) `cetā, stetā' iti| tṛc‌| `ṛduśanaspurodaṃso'nehasāñca' (7.1.94) ityanaṅ‌, `sarvanāmasthāne' (6.4.8) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoriti kim‌'? iti| evaṃ manyate--pratyaya iti vaktavyam‌, saṅīti vā, evaṃ hyucyamāne bhavatītyādau guṇaḥ siddha eva, saṅīti pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ sanaḥ sakārādārabhya mahiṅo ṅakāreṇa| `agnitvam‌' iti| `tasya bhāvastvatalau' (5.1.119) iti tvapratyayaḥ| `agnikāmyati' iti| `kāmyacca' (3.1.9) iti kāmyac‌| `yadi ityādi| yadi pratyaya ityucyeta, tvākāmyacorapi syāt‌| athāpi saṅītyucyeta, kāmyaci syāt‌; tasyāpi pratyāhare'ntarbhāvāt‌|| 85. jāgro'viciṇṇalṅitsu| (7.3.85) `jāgarayati' iti| ṇic‌| `jāgarakaḥ' iti| ṇvul‌| `sādhujāgarī' iti| tācchīlye ṇiniḥ| `jāgarañjāgaram‌' iti| `ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul‌' (3.4.22), `ābhīkṣṇye dve bhavataḥ' (vā.887) iti dvirvacanam‌| `jāgaro varttate' iti| bhāve dhañ‌| etāni vṛddhiviṣaya udāharaṇāni| `jāgaritā, jagaritavān‌' iti pratiṣedhaviṣaye| kiṃ pūnaḥ kāraṇaṃ vṛddhiviṣaye pratiṣedhaviṣaye caivopanyastānyudāharaṇāni? ityata āha--`vṛddhiviṣaye pratiṣedhaviṣaye ca' ityādi| vṛddhipratiṣedhaviṣayādanyatra pūrvasūtreṇa guṇaḥ siddho bhavati| tasmādavṛddhipratiṣedhaviṣaye'yaṃ guṇa ārabhyate, tena tadviṣayāṇāmevodāharaṇānāsupanyāsaḥ| jāgarayatītyādau guṇe kṛte raparatve ca `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhyā bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirakarttumāha--`tasmin‌ kṛte' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ tasmin‌ kṛte na bhavati? ityāha--`yadi hi' ityādi| yadyasmin‌ kṛte'pi guṇe `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti vṛddhiḥ syāt‌, jāgarayatītyādikaṃ rūpaṃ na syāt‌, tathā cānarthako guṇaḥ syāt‌; `aco ñṇiti' (7.2.115) ityanayaiva vṛddhyā siddhatvāt‌| `ciṇṇalośca' ityādi| ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedhasyetat‌ prayojanam‌--vṛddheḥ śravaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌| yadi tu kṛte'pi guṇe `ata upadhāyāḥ' (7.2.116) iti syāt‌, ciṇṇaloḥ pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ yāt‌; astvatra guṇaḥ, satyapi tasmin‌ punarupadhāyā iti vṛddhyā bhavitavyam‌, tataśca vṛddheḥ śravatraṃ bhaviṣyatīti| `ajāgāri' iti| luṅ‌, cliḥ, `ciṇbhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (3.1.66) iti cleściṇ‌, `ciṇo luk‌' (6.4.104) iti takārasya luk‌| `jāgṛtaḥ, jāgṛthaḥ' iti| laṭ‌, tasthasau, tayoḥ `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) iti ṅittvam‌, adāditvācchayo luk‌| `vīti kecidikāramuccāraṇārthaṃ varṇayanti' iti| kiṃ punarevaṃ satīṣṭaṃ sidhyati, yata evaṃ vyācakṣate? āha--`kvasāvapa' ityādi| yadi samudāyastha veḥ pratyayasyevaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, kvāsau guṇapratiṣedho na syāt‌| yadi tvikāra uccāraṇārtho varṇamātrasyaivedaṃ grahaṇam‌, tadā `yasmin‌ vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) iti tadādividhinā kvāsāvapi guṇapratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati| `jajāgṛvān‌' iti| liṭaḥ `kvasuśca' (3.2.107) iti kvasurādeśaḥ, `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌, `jajāgṛvān‌' iti| liṭaḥ `kvasuśca' (3.2.107) iti kvasurādeśaḥ, `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌, `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau| `kecit‌' iti vacanāt‌--apara uccāraṇārthaṃ na varṇayantītyuktaṃ bhavati| ta evaṃ manyante--chāndasaḥ kvasuḥ, liṭ‌ ca chandasi sārvadhātukamapi bhavati; `chandasyubhayathā' (3.4.117) iti vacanāt‌ tataḥ `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) iti ṅittvādeva paryudāso bhaviṣyatīti| `ajāgaruḥ' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--`aviciṇṇalṅitsu' (1.2.4) iti ṅittvādeva paryudāso bhaviṣyatīti| `ajāgaruḥ' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--`aviciṇṇalṅitsu' iti prasajyapratiṣedho'yam‌--viciṇṇalṅitasu na bhavatīti, tataścājāgarurityatrāpi `jusi ca' (7.3.83) ityanenāpi prāptasya guṇasyā pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti| evamahaṃ jajāgaretyatra `ṇaluttamo vā' (7.1.91) iti vacanāṇṇittvaṃ yadā nāsti tadā `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukāyoḥ' (7.3.84) iti guṇa iṣyate, so'smāt‌ pratiṣedhānna prāpnoti| `na' apratiṣedhāt‌' iti parihāraḥ| nāyaṃ doṣaḥ; kutaḥ? apratiṣedhāt‌| aprasajyapratiṣedhā dityarthaḥ| yadi prasajyaprataṣedho na bhavati, kastarhyayam‌? ityāha--`aviciṇṇālṅitsviti paryudāso'yam‌' iti| prasajyapratiṣedhe hi lakṣaṇāntareṇāpi prasaktasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, na paryudāse| tathā hi paryudāse viciṇṇalṅidbhyo'nyatra guṇo vidhīyate, na tu teṣu viciṇṇalādiṣu pratiṣidhyate| paryudāsaścāyam‌| tasmājjusi ṇali ca guṇo bhavatyeva| abhyupetyāpi prasajyapratiṣedhaṃ parahārāntaramāha--`atha vā' ityādi| `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā. pa.19) ityānantaryāt‌ jāgra iti yā prāptistasyā ayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, yā tu `jusi ca' (7.3.83) ityādinā lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāptiḥ sā na pratiṣidhyate| `ajāgaruḥ' iti| laṅ‌, `jakṣityādayaḥ ṣaṭ‌' (6.1.6) ityabhyastasaṃjñā, `sijabhyastavidibhyaśca' (3.4.109) iti jherjus‌|| 86. pugantalaghūpaghasya ca| (7.3.86) pugantasyāṅgasya, laghūpadhasya cetyubhāvapi bahuvrīhī--puganto yasya tat‌ tathoktam‌, ladhvī upadhā yasya tallaghūpadham‌| `bhettā, chettā' iti| nanu ca pratyayāderhalo'ṅgāvayavasya cānantarye sati `saṃyoge guru' (1.4.11) iti gurusaṃjñayā laghusaṃjñāyāṃ vādhitāyāṃ guṇenātra na bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`pratyayādeḥ' ityādi| `trasigṛdhidhṛṣikṣipeḥ knuḥ' (3.2.140), `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti knusanoḥ kitkaraṇasyaitadeva prayojanam‌--gṛdhnuḥ, vibhatsatītyādau guṇo mā bhūditi| yadi pratyayāderhalo'ṅgāvayavasya cānaktarye sati laghūpadhaguṇo na syāt‌ tayoḥ kittvaṃ na kuryāt‌, kṛtañca, tasmāt‌ knusano kittvaṃ kurvatā--pratyayāṅgāvayavayorhalorānantarye'pi laghūpadhaguṇo na vyāvarttyata iti jñāpitametat‌| nanu ca sanaḥ kittvaṃ sisṛkṣatītyatrāmāgamo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ syāt‌? naitadasti; yadi hyetat‌ prayojanamabhimataṃ syāt‌ tatraivaṃ pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt‌--sūjadṛśorjhalyamakitsanoriti| tasmāt sanaḥ kitkaraṇaṃ jñāpakameva yada laghūpadhalyānena guṇo vidhīyate| evaṃ sati `iko guṇavṛddhī' (1.1.3) ityasyā upasthāne sati yatra tatra sthitasyeko guṇaḥ prasajyeta, tataścehāpi prāpnoti--bhinattīti, bhavati hyatara laghūpadhamaṅgam‌| na ca śakyate vaktum‌--`halo'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ' (1.1.7) iti saṃyogasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ laghūpadhametanna bhavatīti guṇo na bhaviṣyatīti| yajjñāpitametadidādhīmeva--pratyayāderaṅgāvayavasaya ca halorānantarye sati laghupadhaguṇo na vyāvarttyata iti? ata āha--`upadhā cātra' ityādi| ikparibhāṣayā hyatrakaḥ sanidhāpitatvādigevopadhā gṛhyate, tena bhinattītyatra guṇo na bhavati; na hyatrāṅgasyegupadhā, kiṃ tarhi? akāraḥ| `apare tu' ityādio| sūtrārtha varmayantī ta vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| puki antaḥ pugantaḥ--`saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| antaśabdo'yamavayavavacanaḥ, puki parato'vayava ityarthaḥ| kasyāvayavaḥ? `aṅgasya' ityanuvṛtteḥ pugiti vacanāt‌pugāgamavato'ṅgasya| na punaḥ puganta ikparibhāṣopaśtānādigeva veditavyaḥ| `ladhvī upadhā laghūpadhā' iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| `pugantalaghūpadham‌' iti| samāhāradvandvo'yam‌| `sūtrārtham' iti| tūtrārthaikadeśe sūtrārthaśabdo varttate, na hyetāvāneva sūtrārthaḥ, aparisamāptatvāt‌| aparisamāptistu pugantasya tasyāśca laghūpadhāyā guṇo bhavatītyasya sūtrārthasyaikadeśasyānabhidhānāt‌| `varṇayanti' iti| vyācakṣata iti| bhinattītyatra guṇo mā bhūdityevamartham‌| na hyatra sūtrārthe bhinattītyatra guṇaḥ prasajyeta| bahuvrīhau hyāśrīyamāṇe'ṅgasyānyapadārthasya yo nāma kaścidik‌ tasya yatra tatrāvasthitasya guṇaḥ prasajyeta| bahuvrīhau hayaśrīyamāṇo'ṅgasayānyapadārthasya yo nāma kaścidik‌ tasya yatra tatrāvasthitasya guṇaḥ prasajyeta| tatpureṣe tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, tatra hi laghūpadhegbhyāmaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate, atastasyā eva guṇo vidhīyate--aṅgasya yā laghūpadhā ik‌ tasyā guṇo bhavatīti| bhinattītyatrayā'ṅgasya laghūpadhā nāsāvik‌, yaścek‌ sa yadyapi laghurbhavati laghurbhavati na tvasyopadhā| tasmāt‌ tatpuruṣa āśrīyamāṇe neha guṇasya prasaṅgaḥ| sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayorityeva--`aganicittvam‌, agnicitakāmyati'| pugantagrahaṇaṃ laghūpadhārtham‌|| 87. nābhyastasyāci piti sārvadhātuke| (7.3.87) `nenijāni, vevijāni, pariveviṣāṇi' iti'| `ṇijir‌ śaucapovaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1093) `vijir‌ pṛthagbhāve' (dhā.pā.1094) `viṣu vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1095)-ebhyo loṭ‌, mip‌ `merniḥ' (3.4.89), `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) ityaṭ‌, `juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ' (2.4.75) iti śapaḥ śluḥ, `śalau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌, `nijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ ślau' (7.4.75) ityābhyāsasya guṇaḥ| `anenijam‌, avevijam‌, paryaveṣiṣam‌' iti| laṅ‌, `tasthastamipāṃ tāntantāmaḥ' tāntantāmaḥ' (3.4.101) iti mipo'mbhāvāḥ| `vedāni' iti| `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064)| `pūrvavalloḍādi yathāyogam‌, adāditāvācchapo luk‌| `nenekti' iti| laṭ‌, tip, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌| atha pidgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā'piti sārvadhātuke `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) iti ṅittve sati `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti niṣedhena bhavitavyamiti, na cānayoḥ pratiṣedhayoḥ kaścid‌viśeṣo'sti? ityata āha--`pidgrahaṇam‌' iti| `tṛṇaha im‌' (7.3.92) itīmaṃ vakṣyati, sa piti yathā syāt‌, apiti mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pidgrahaṇam‌| `nineja' iti| liṭ‌| sa ca `liṭ‌ ca' (3.4.115) ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñakaḥ| `juhavāni iti| `hu dāne' (dhā.pā.1083)| pūrvavalloḍādi| `ajuhavam‌' iti| pūrvavallaṅādi| atra `laghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) ityanuvṛtteḥ `sarvadhātukāryadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) itīgantasya yo guṇo vihitastasya pratiṣedho na bhavati| `bahulaṃ chandasīti vaktavyam‌' iti| chandasi viṣaye bahulaṃ guṇapratiṣedho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--ihedaṃ sūtraṃ vibhajya dvau yogau kriyete, tatra `na' ityeko yogaḥ; `abhyastasyāci piti sārvadhātuke' iti dvitīyaḥ, tatra ca netyanuvarttate, yañca yogaḥ pūrvayogasyāsarvaviṣayatvajñāpanārthaḥ| tena cchabdasi bahulaṃ pratiṣedho bhaviṣyati| `jujoṣat‌' iti| `juṣī pratisevanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1288) leṭ‌, tip‌; `leṭo'ḍāṭau' (3.4.94) ityaṭ‌, tudāditvācchaḥ, tasya `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.73) iti śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌| laghūpadhaguṇaḥ| yadyabhyastasyāci piti sārvadhātuke guṇapratiṣedha idhyate, paspaśāte, cakāśīti, vāvaśītityatropadhāhrasavatvamiṣyate, tanna prāpnoti; tasmādabhyastānāmupadhāhrasvatvameva vaktavyam‌, na guṇapratiṣedhaḥ; hrasvatve hi nenijānītyevamādi sidhyati; paśpaśāte ityādi ca? iti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`paspaśāte' ityādi| hi nenijānītyevamādi sidhyati; paspaśāte ityādi ca? iti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`paspaśāte' ityādi| `spaśiriti [`spāśiriti'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] gaṇaparipaṭhito dhātvantaramastyeva, tasmādyaṅ‌, tasya `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti luk‌, dvirvacanam‌, `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' (7.4.61) iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ; abhyāsasya hrasvatve kṛte `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) iti dīrghaḥ, `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) iti varṇavyatyayenopadhāyā abhyāsasya ca hrasvaḥ, leṭ‌, vyatyayenaivātmanepadam‌, āṭ| `cākaśīti' iti| `kāśṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.1162), `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) ityabhyāsasya cutvam‌, tip‌, `yaṅo vā' (7.3.94) itīṭ‌| `vāvaśīti' iti| `vāśṛ śabde' (dhā.pā.1163), śeṣaṃ yathāyogaṃ pūrvavat‌| `paspaśāte ityatrābhyāsahrasvatvaṃ ca' iti| cakārādupadhāhrasvatvañca| itaratra tūpadhāhrasvatvameva, nābhyāsasya hrasvatvam‌| `prakṛtyantarāṇāṃ vā' iti| `spaśa bādhanasparśanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.887), `kaśa ganiśāsanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1024), `vaśa kāntau' (dhā.pa.1080)--etāni prakṛtyantarāṇi hrasvopadhāni santīti, ata eṣāmevaitāni rūpāṇi| tasmādyathānyāsamevāstu|| 88. bhūsuvostiṅi| (7.3.88) `abhūt‌' iti| `luṅ‌, `gātasthā' (2.4.77) ityādinā sico luk‌| `suvāvahai, suvāmahai' iti| `ṣūṅ‌ prāṇigarbhavimocane' (dhā.pā.1031), loṭ‌ vahimahiṅau, ṭeretvam‌, `eta ai' (3.4.93), āditvācchapo luk‌, `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) ityāṭ‌ `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinovaṅ‌| atha kasmāt‌ sūterādādikasyopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ, na suvatisayatyostaudādikadaivādikayoḥ? ityata āha--`sūterlugvikaraṇasya' ityādi| nanu ca lugvikaraṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.50) `ṣū preraṇe' (dhā.pā.1408) ityetasya śavikaraṇasya taudādikasya, `ṣūṅ‌ prāṇiprasave' (dhā.pā.1132)--ityasya daivādikasaya ca grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌? ityata āha--`suvatisūyatyoḥ' ityādi| tiṅīti saptamīnirdeśādanantare tiṅi pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌| na ca suvatisūyatibhyāmanantarastiṅ‌ sambhavati, vikaraṇena vyavadhānāt‌| tasmānna tayorgrahaṇamiti sūtereva grahaṇaṃ yuktamityabhiprāyaḥ| syādetat‌--vacanaprāṇāṇyādvikaraṇena vyavadhāne'pi pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatītyatasyayoreva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti? ata āha--`vikaraṇasyaiva' ityādi| tayorhi `sārvadhātukamapit‌' (1.2.4) iti vikaraṇaṅittvam‌, tatra `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) ityanenaiva siddhaḥ pratiṣedha iti nirarthakaṃ tayorgrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, ato na tāviha gṛhyate| `bhavati' iti| tiṅīti vacanādihātiṅi śapi parato niṣedo na bhavati| `vyatibhaviṣīṣṭa' iti| āśiṣi liṅ‌ (3.3.173)| sa ca `liṅāśiṣi' (3.4.116) ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñakaḥ, sīyuṭ‌, `karttari `karttari karmaṇyatihāre' (1.3.14) ityātmanepadam‌, suṭ‌ ṣatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| `atha' ityādi| `prakṛtigrahaṇe yaṅlugantasyāpi grahaṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.79) iti yaṅluko'pi grahaṇe sati tatrāpi pratiṣedhena bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| `bobhavīti' iti| `guṇo yaṅlukoḥ' (7.4.82) ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ| `jñāpakāt‌' ityādi| yadi yaṅlukyapi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, guṇābhāvārthaṃ nipātanaṃ na kuryāt‌, kṛtañca, tasmādeva jñāpayati--yaṅalukyayaṃ pratiṣedho na bhavatīti|| 89.uto vṛddhirluki hali| (7.3.89) guṇe prāpta utto vṛddhirārabhyate| yautītyādau pūrvavacchapo luk‌| `sunoti' iti| śnuḥ| `yavāni' iti| loṭ‌| uttamapuruṣai kavacanam‌| `yutaḥ, rutaḥ' iti| laṭ‌, tas‌| taparakaraṇaṃ sūtītyatra mā bhūdati| atha `api stuyādrājānañ‌' ityatra kasmānna bhavati, asti hyatrāpi yāsuṭastiṅbhaktatvāt‌ tiṅgrahaṇena grahaṇamiti prāptiḥ, na ca śakyate vaktum‌--`kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti pratiṣedho bhaviṣyatīti; yasmādiglakṣaṇāyā vṛddheḥ pratiṣedho'sau, na ceyamiglakṣaṇā; sākṣānnirdeṣṭasthānikatvāt‌, `yasyā hi vṛddheḥ sthānī na nirdiśyate seglakṣaṇā' ityuktam‌? ityāha--`api stuyāt‌' ityādi| atra hi `yāsuṭ‌ parasmaipadeṣūdāttau ṅicca' (3.4.103) iti sārvadhātukaṃ ṅita; `ṅicca pinna bhavati' iti ṅittvena pittvasya bādhitatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ pityucyamānā vṛddhirihāpi na bhavati| atha `yoyoti, roroti' ityatra kasmānna bhavati, luki sati bhavati hyetadaṅgadvayamukārāntam‌? ityāha--`nābhayastasya' ityādi| gatārtham‌| ādiśabdena nonotītyevamādīnāṃ[`cokotītyādīnām‌'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] grahaṇam‌|| 90. ūrṇotervibhāṣā| (7.3.90) pūrveṇa nityāyāṃ vṛddhau prāptāyāṃ vikalpārtho'yamutyate| `prorṇoti' iti| pūrvavacchapo luk| `prorṇavāni' iti| loḍuttamapuruṣaikavacanama|| 91. guṇo'pṛkte| (7.3.91) vibhāṣeti nivṛttam‌| pūrveṇa prāptāyāḥ pākṣikyā vṛddherayamapavādaḥ| nanu halatyanuvarttata eva, tatra sāmarthyādapṛkta eva bhaviṣyatīti na tadādī, na hi halādisamudāyo hal‌ bhavati, tatkimapṛktagrahaṇena ityata āha--`halītyanuvarttamāne' ityādi| apuktagrahaṇaṃ hyevamarthaṃ kriyate--halītyanuvṛttestadādau mā bhūditi| yadi ceyaṃ paribhāṣā na syāt‌, apṛktagrahaṇamanarthakatvānna kuryāt‌| halyucayamāno guṇaḥ kaḥ prasaṅgo yastadādāvapi syāt‌? naiva prāpnoti; tasyā halātmakatvāt‌| kṛtañcedamapṛktagrahaṇam‌, atastonāstīyaṃ paribhāṣeti jñāpyate| atha `nāpṛkte' ityevaṃ kasmānnoktam‌, kiṃ guṇagrahaṇena, vṛddhau pratiṣiddhāyāmutsargeṇa guṇenaiva sidhyati? naitadasti; antaroktāyā vibhāṣāyāḥ pratiṣedho vijñāyeta, tathā ca nityaṃ vṛddhiḥ syāt‌|| 92. tṛṇaha im‌| (7.3.92) `tṛha hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1455) iti rudhādiḥ, `tṛhū tṛbhū hiṃsārthāḥ (dhā.pā.1348,1350) iti tudādī--tayorādyasyedaṃ grahaṇam‌, netarasya| tasya vikaraṇena vyavadhāvādanantaro hal‌ na sambhavatīti| `tṛṇeḍhi' iti| `ho ḍhaḥ' (7.2.31), `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvam‌, `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti ṣṭutvam‌, `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13), tasyemāgamaḥ, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `tṛṇekṣi' iti| `dhaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam‌| `atṛṇeṭ‌' iti| laṅ‌, tip‌, halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68), ḍhatve kṛte `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvam‌--ḍhakārasya ḍakāraḥ, tasya `vāvasāne' (8.4.56) iti cartvam‌--ṭakāraḥ| nanu cātra luptatvāt‌ sārvadhātukasyemāgamena na bhavitavyam‌, lupto'pi tatra pratyayalakṣaṇena bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? na; varṇāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ nāstītyata āha--`varṇāśraye' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--`varṇāśraye nāsti pratyayalakṣaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.96) iti nānena sarvadhā varṇāśrayasya pratyayalakṣaṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate, kiṃ tarhi? `pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam‌' (1.1.62) ityatra pratayayagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ vyākhyāyate| pratyaye lupte dvividhaṃ kāryaṃ vijñāyate--pratyayanimittam‌, apratyayanimittañca| tatra yat‌ pratyayanimittaṃ tat‌ pratyayalope yathā syāt‌, itaranmā bhūdityevamartham‌| tena gave hitaṃ gohitamityatra luptāyāṃ vibhaktāvavādeśo na bhavati| avādeśasya hyacītyadhikārādvarṇo nimittam‌, na pratayaya eva| iha tvaṅgādhakārāt‌ pratyaya eva halādirāśrīyata itīmāgamasya pratyayanimittatā| tenāsau pratyayalakṣaṇena bhavatyeva| yadi hyasau pratyayanimittastatkathaṃ varṇāśraye'payatretayuktam‌? atṛṇeḍityatrodāharaṇe tyayasya varṇamātratvāt‌ pratyayaviśeṣaṇatvena vī varṇasyāśrayaṇādevamuktam‌, na tvapratyayanimittatvāt‌, varṇasyāpi takārasya pratyayatvāparityāgat‌| `tṛṇahāni' ityatra tadeva loḍuttapuruṣaikavacanam‌| `tṛṇḍhaḥ' iti| tas‌, `śnasoranlopaḥ' (6.4.111), pūrvavaḍḍhatvādi, `naścāpadāntasya jhali' (8.3.24) ityanusvāraḥ, `anusvārasya yayiparasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58) iti parasavarṇo ṇakaraḥ| atha kimarthamiha tṛhīrāgataśnamko gṛhyate, na tṛha ityevocyeta? ityāha āha--`tṛṇaha' ityādi| yadyāgataśnamkasya grahaṇaṃ na kriyeta,
