tato nāprāpte śnamyayamārabhyate, deśahetukaśca tayorvirodho'stīti śnama ṇamā bādhā syāt‌| asatyāmapi bādhāyāmaniṣṭā vyavasthā syāt‌--pūrvamim‌, paścāt‌ śnam‌; tataścāniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| āgataśnamkasya grahaṇe saśnamkasya tṛherimi vidhīyamāne samāveśastayorbhavati, iṣṭā ca vyavaśthā sampadyate--pūrva śnam‌, paścādim‌; tasmāt‌ śnami kṛte satīmāgamo bhavedityevamarthamāgataśnamkastṛhirgrṛhyate|| 93. bruva īṭ‌| (7.3.93) bruvaḥ' ityeṣā pañcamyakṛtārthā pūrvatra kṛtārthāyāḥ `sārvadhātuke' ityasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati tasmāditayuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti vacanāt‌| tena halādeḥ pitaḥ sārvadhātukasyaivāyamiḍ‌ vijñāyata ityata āha--`brū ityetasmāduttarasya halādeḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ pūnarhala āgamitvena tadādirlabhyate, `yasmine vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) ityucyate, na tu yasya vidhiriti, asati hi tadādividhāvabravīdityādāveva syāt‌, bravītītyādau na syāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; uttaratra hyapṛktagrahaṇāt‌ tadādividheḥ sambhavo gamyate, anyathā hyasati tadādividhau vināpyapṛktagrahaṇenāpṛkta eva bhaviṣyati, apṛktagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `bravīti' iti| pūrvavacchapo luk‌| `bravāṇi' iti| tadeva loḍuttamapuruṣaikavacanam‌| `brūtaḥ' iti| laṭ‌, tas‌|| 94. yaṅo vā| (7.3.94) `lālapīti' ityādi| lapivadirautibhyo yaṅ; pūrvayoḥ `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ, rautestu `guṇo yaṅlukoḥ' (7.4.82) iti guṇaḥ, `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti yaṅo luk‌| `varvartti, carkatti' iti| vṛñkṛñoryaṅluki `ṛtaśca' (7.2.92) ityabhyāsasya rugāgamaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ yaṅlukyevodāhriyate, na yaṅante? ityāha--`halādeḥ' ityādi| yaṅante hi ṅittvādātmanepadam‌, na cātmanepadaṃ halādi pidasti| halādeḥ pitaḥ parasya sārvadhātukasyābhāvānneha yaṅantasyodāharaṇam‌, kiṃ tarhi? yaṅlugantasya| tatra hi halādi pit‌ sārvadhātukaṃ sambhavati, yaṅlugantasyādādau `carkarītañca parasmaibhāvam‌' iti pāṭhe sati parasmaipaditvāt‌, tena yaṅlṛkyevodāhriyate| carkarītamiti yaṅlugantasaya pūrvācārayasaṃjñā|| 95. turustuśamyamaḥ sārvadhātuke| (7.3.95) `tu' iti sautro dhāturvṛddhyarthe ityeke, hiṃsārthe ityapare| asya ca lugvikaraṇatvaṃ smaryate, tacca `bahula chandasi' (2.4.73) iti bahulagrahaṇena bhāṣāyāmapi lukasampādanāllabhyate| `śamīṣpam‌' iti| loṭ‌| `aśamīdhvam‌' iti| laṅ‌| `abhyamīti' iti| loṭ‌| `aśamīdhvam‌' iti| laṅ‌| `abhyamīti' iti| `ama gatyādiṣu' (dhā.pā.465) laṭ‌, tip‌| kathaṃ punaḥ śamyamibhyāmanantaraṃ halādi sārvadhātukaṃ sambhavati, yāvatā śamervyavadhāyakenaiva śyānā bhavitavyam‌| amerapi śap‌ kriyate? ityāha--`śadhyamoḥ' ityādi| vikaraṇasyātra luk‌ `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.3.73) ityamena| `sārvadhātukāsu' iti| strīliṅganirdeśā| strīliṅgasya sārvadhātukāśabdasyāpiśalinā saṃjñātyena pracītatvāt‌| atha sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `nābhyastasyāci piti sārvadhātuke' (7.3.87) ityataḥ sūtrāt‌ sārvadhātukagrahaṇamanuvartate? ityāha--`sārvadhātuka ityanuvarttamāne' ityādi| taddhi sārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ pitītyanena sambaddham‌| atastadanuvṛttau pidgrahaṇamapyamuvartteta tathā cāpiti na syāt‌| tasmādapityapi yathā syādiyevamarthaṃ tsārvadhātukagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 96. asatisico'pṛkte| (7.3.96) `apṛkte' iti| subvayatyayena ṣaṣṭhyarthe saptadamī, tenāyamapṛktasyaiveṭ‌| astigrahaṇaṃ laṅarthay‌| `āsīt‌' iti| `asa bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065), laṅ‌, adāditvācchapo luk‌, `āḍajādīnām‌' (6.4.72) ityāṭ‌| `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| `akārṣīt‌' iti| sici vṛddhiḥ| `alāvīt, apādhīt' iti| `iṭa īṭi' (8.2.28) iti sico lopaḥ| `āttha' iti| atra bruṣa uttarasya sipaḥ `bruvaḥ pañcānāmadita āhobruvaḥ' (3.4.84) iti thali kṛte bruvaścāhādeśe kṛte tasya sthānivadbhāve sati brūñgrahaṇena grahamāt‌ thalo'pi sārvadhātukagrahaṇena grahaṇādīṭ‌ prāpnoti| `abhūt‌' iti| asteḥ sic‌, `asterbhūḥ' (2.4.52) iti bhūbhāve tasya sthānivadbhāve satyastigrahaṇena grahaṇādīṭ‌ prāpnoti, sa kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`āhibhuvoḥ' ityādi| `īṭi pratiṣedhaḥ' iti| āherbhuvaśceṭi karttavye sthānivadbāvasya pratiṣedhaḥ| teneha na bhavati--ātva' iti| `āhasthaḥ'(8.2.35) iti hakārasya thakāraḥ, tasya `khari ca' iti takāraḥ| `abhūt' iti| `gātisthā'(2.4,77) iti sico luk‌|| 97. bahulaṃ chandasi| (7.3.97) `sarvamāḥ' iti| asterlaṅ‌, pūrvavadāṭ, siyo halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68), sakārasya rutvavisarjanīyo| `gobhirakṣāḥ pratyañcamatsāḥ' iti| `kṣara sañ‌calane' (dhā.pā.851), `tsara cchadmagato' (dhā.pā.554) inṅyādinā (6.1.68) sico lopaḥ, `ato lrāntasya' (7.2.2) iti vṛddhiḥ, pūrvavaddhisarjanīyaḥ| `abhaiṣīḥ' iti| `ñibhī bhaye' (dhā.pā.1084), sici vṛddhiḥ| athābhaiṣīrmā putraketyatra kathamaḍāgamaḥ, yāvatā `na māṅyoge' (6.4.74) iti pratiṣiddho'sau, iha cākṣāḥ, atsā ityat sica ījāgamaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`chābdasatvāt‌' ityādi| akṣāḥ, atasā ityatra ceḍāgamābhāva iti cchāndasatvāditi prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| `vā chandasi' iti vaktavye bahulagrahamuttarārtham‌| uttarārthatāṃ cāsyottaratra pratipādapiṣyāmaḥ|| 98. rudaśca pañcabhyaḥ| (7.3.98) `rudaḥ' iti subvyatyayena bahuvacanasyaikavacanama| etacaca `pañcabhyaḥ' iti bahuvacanādvijñāyate| `rudādibhyaḥ sārvadhātuke' (7.2.76) itīṭi prāpte tadapavāda īḍāgamo vidhīyate| `rudir‌ aśruvimocane' (dhā.pa.1067), `ñiṣvap‌ śaye' (dhā.pā.1068), `śvasa prāṇane' (dhā.pā.1069), `ana ca' (dhā.pā.1070), jakṣa bhakṣahasanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1071)-ityete rudādaya ādādikāḥ| `arodīt‌' iti| laṅ| `prāṇīt‌' iti| `aniteḥ' (8.4.19) iti ṇatvam‌| `ajāgarbhavān‌' iti| `ajāgarbhavān‌' iti| jāgarttiḥ pañcabhyaḥ pareṇāyaṃ paṭhyate| guṇe raparatve ca kṛte halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68)|| 99. aḍū gārgyagālavayoḥ| (7.3.99) pūrveṇeṭi prāpte'ḍāgamo vidhīyate| gārgyagālavagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham‌, na tu vikalpārtham‌| aḍīṭorādiliṅgatvādekaviṣayatvācca na sambhavati; samuccaya ityantareṇāpyācāryagrahaṇaṃ vikalpasya siddhatvāt‌|| 100. adaḥ sarveṣām‌| (7.3.100) sarveṣāṃgrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham‌, na tu nityārtham‌; gārgyagālavagrahasyāvikalpārthatvāt‌|| 101. ato dīrgho yañi| (7.3.101) taparakaraṇamuttarārtham‌| khaṭvābhirityatra `bahuvacane jhalyet‌' (7.3.103) ityettvaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌| `aṅganā' iti| praśastānyaṅgānyasyāḥ santīti lomādinā (5.2.100) napratyayaḥ| `keśavaḥ' iti| keśā yasya santīti `keśād‌ vo'nyatarasyām‌' (5.2.109) iti vapratyayaḥ| `kecidatra tiṅītyanuvarttayanti' iti| `bhūsuvostiṅi' (7.3.88) ityataḥ| teṣāṃ bhavavāniti kvasau sārvadhātuke dīrghatvena na bhavitavyamiti; kvasoratiṅantatvāt‌| `bhagavān‌' iti| bhavaterliṭ‌, kavasuḥ, `chandasyubhayathā' (3.4.117) iti tasya pakṣe sārvadhātukatvam‌, tena `karttari śap‌' (3.1.68) bhavati, `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopau (6.1.68; 8.2.23)| āditi vaktavye dīrghagrahaṇam‌--dīrgha eva yathā syāt‌, yadanyat‌ prāpnoti, tanmā bhūditi| kiñcānyat‌ prāpnoti? `vicāryamāṇānām‌' (8.2.97), `anantarasyāpyekaikasya prācām‌' `praśnākhyānayoḥ' (8.2.105) iti plutaḥ| atha prakṛto'jāgamaḥ kasmānna vidhīyate? tatrāpyakaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvena (6.1.101) vahīti `ksasyāci' (7.3.72) iti lopaḥ syāt‌, atijarābhyāmityatrācīti jarasbhāvaḥ syāt‌; tannivṛttyartha dīrghagrahamaṃ kṛtam‌| sa cātra plutaḥ prasajyeta|| 102. supi ca| (7.3.102) 103. bahuvacane jhalyet‌| (7.3.103) nanu ca vṛkṣāṇāmityatra `nāmi' (6.4.3) iti dīrghatvaṃ bādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kiṃ tannivṛttyarthena jhalgrahaṇena? naitadasti; `nāmi' (6.4.3) iti hyagnīnāmityatra sāvakāśam‌, tatrāsati jhalgrahaṇe dīrghatvaṃ bādhitvā paratvādettvameva syāt‌| `pacadhvam‌, yajadhvam‌' iti| loṭ‌ ṭerettvam‌, `savābhyāṃ vāmau' (3.4.91) ityāmādeśaḥ|| 104. osi ca| (7.3.104) 105. āṅi cāpaḥ| (7.3.105) `āṅiti pūrvācāryanirdeśena' ityādi| ācāryā hi pūrva āṅiti tṛtīyaikavacananirdeśaṃ kurvanti sma| tasmāt‌ tadīyenāṅiti nirdeśena tṛtīyaikavacanaṃ gṛhyate| `khaṭvayā' iti ṭābantasyodāharaṇam‌| `bahurājayā' iti| jāvantasyodāharaṇam‌| `ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām‌' (4.1.13) iti ḍāp‌| `kārīṣagandhyayā' iti| cābantasya| karīṣasyeva gandho'sya `upamānācca' (5.4.137) itīt‌--karīṣagandhiḥ, `tasyāpatyam‌' (4.1.92) ityaṇ‌, tasya `aṇiñoranārṣayoḥ' (4.1.78) ityādinā vyaṅ‌, tadantāt‌ `yaṅaścāp‌' (4.1.74) iti cāp‌| `kīlālapā' iti| kīlālaṃ pibatīti `ato maninkvanibvanipaśca' (3.2.74) iti vic‌, tadantāt‌ tṛtīyaikavacanam‌, `āto dhātoḥ' (6.4.140) ityakāralopaḥ| atheha kasmānna bhavati--khaṭvāmatikrāntenātikhaṭveneti, upasarjanahrasvatve kṛte sthānivadbhāvāt‌ tasya prāpnoti? ityāha--`ṅyābgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| kecidāhuḥ--ṅyābgrahaṇe dīrghagrahaṇamityetadvacanaṃ karttavyam‌, tena hrasvatve kṛte na bhavati apare tvāhuḥ--`halṅyābbhyo dīrghāt‌' (6.1.68) iti yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, yāvacchāstre ṅyāpoḥ kārya tat‌ sarvaṃ dīrghayoryathā syā hrasvayormā bhūditi; tataḥ `sutisyapṛktam‌ (6.1.68) iti dvitīyo yogaḥ, tatra `halṅyāgbhyaḥ' ityanuvarttata iti| cakāraḥ `opti ca' (7.3.104) ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 106. sambuddhau ca| (7.3.106) 107. ambārthanadyorhvasvaḥ| (7.3.107) pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ| ambārthāḥ-mātrarthāḥ| `ḍalakavatīnām‌' ityādi| ḍalākā yāsāṃ śrutīnāṃ santīti tā ḍalakavatyaḥ| asaṃyogāvayavabhūtā ḍalakā iha gṛhyante| anyathā he akka, he alla--ityatrāpi syāt‌| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyaya ityeṣo'rthaḥ| uttarayorapi vaktavyaśabdayorayamevārtho veditavyaḥ| tatraidaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`bahulaṃ chandasi' (7.3.97) ityato bahulagrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttate, tena sarvaṃ pratiṣedhādikaṃ kāryamapi bhaviṣyatīti| `arhate' iti| praśaṃsābhājanabhūtāyetyarthaḥ| `gārgomātā' iti| yo gārgyā mātrā ṣyapadeśena praśaṃsāmarhati sa evamucyate|| 108. hrasvasya guṇaḥ| (7.3.108) hrasvagrahaṇaṃ prakṛtāṅgaviśeṣaṇam‌, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--`hsvāntasya' ityādi| evamuttaratrāpi tadantavidhirveditavyaḥ| atha he kumāri, he brahmabandhvityevamādīnāṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`he kumāri' ityādi| yadi hrasvatve kṛte guṇaḥ syāt, hrasvakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| nanu ca guṇārthametat‌ syāt, asati hi tasmin‌ `hrasvasaya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108) iti guṇo na syāt‌, ahrasvāntatvāt‌? ityāha--`yadi' ityādi| evaṃ prakriyāgauravaṃ parihṛtaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|| 109. jasi ca| (7.3.109) `jasādiṣu' ityādi| ādiśabdaḥ prakāre| jasprakāreṣu pratyayeṣvityarthaḥ| `itaḥ prakaraṇāt‌' iti| `ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ' (7.3.107) ityevamādikāt‌| `chabadasīti vaktavyam‌' iti| chandasi viṣaye vā kāryaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu tadeva bahulavacanamāśritya karttavyam‌| `ambe' ityādi| `ambārthanadyorhrasvaḥ' (7.3.107) iti hrasvo na bhavati| `darvī' ityatra hrasvasya guṇaḥ| `śatakratvaḥ' ityatrāpi `jasi ca' (7.3.109) iti| `paśve' iti| `dherṅiti' (7.3.111) iti guṇaḥ| `kikidīvyā' iti| atra `āṅo nāstriyām‌' (7.3.120) iti nābhāvaḥ|| 110. ṛto ṅisarvanāmasthānayoḥ| (7.3.110) `taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham‌' iti| na hi ṅisarvanāmasthānayordīrgha ṛkāraḥ sambhavati yastapareṇa nivarttyeta|| 111. gherṅiti| (7.3.111) `sakhye, patye' iti| sakhipatiśabdau ghisaṃjñakau na bhavataḥ; `śeṣo dhyasakhi' (1.4.7) iti paryudāsāt‌; `patiḥ samāsa eva' (1.4.8) iti niyamācca| `paṭvī' iti| `voto guṇavacanāt‌' (4.1.44) ṅīṣu| atra guṇo na bhavati; `supi ca' (7.3.102) ityataḥ supītyanuvṛtte `kurutaḥ' iti| karotestas‌, upratyayaḥ, dhātorguṇaḥ, raparatvam‌, `ata ut‌ sārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityuttvam‌| atrāpi supītyanuvṛttestasi parato vikaraṇāntasaya na bhavati guṇaḥ|| 112. āṇnadyāḥ| (7.3.112) `nadyāḥ' iti pañcamī, sā cākṛtārthā pūrvatra kṛtārthāyā ṅitītyasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayiṣyati| tena ṅita evāyamāḍāgamo vijñāyate, ityāha--`nadyantādaṅgāduttarasya' ityādi| `kumāryai' ityevamādau `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| atha dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham‌, na aḍevocyeta, `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhyā savarṇadīrghatvena siddhyatyeva; kumāryai, kumāryā ityatra `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatvaṃ prāpnotītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam‌, pararūpatvaṃ hyatra vacanasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; asti hyanyadavacanasya prayojanam‌| kiṃ tat‌? śriyai, śriyā ityatra `sāvekācastṛtīyādirvibhaktiḥ' (6.1.168) ityudāttatvaṃ mā bhūt‌| āgamā ādyudāttā bhavantītyanudāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi| śakyate hyekādeśontādivadbhāvādāgamagrahaṇena grahītum‌| āgamānudāttatvañca yathā pratyayasvaram‌--lavitā, lavitumityādau bādhate, tathā vibhaktasvaramapi bādheta| tasmāt‌ `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhyarthametat‌|| 113. yāḍāpaḥ| (7.3.113) `khaṭvāyām‌' iti| `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhiḥ| khaṭvāyā ityatrākaḥ savarṇe (6.1.101) dīrghoccāraṇam‌--vṛddhisavarṇadīrghatve yathā syātām‌, pararūpatvaṃ mā bhūdityevamartham‌| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? na; asti hyanyadakāroccāraṇasya prayojanam‌| kiṃ tat‌? jñāyai, jñāyā ityatra `sāvekācastṛtīyādirvibhaktiḥ' (6.1.168) ityanenodāttatvaṃ mā bhūt‌, āgamanudāttatvaṃ yathā syāditi| atha khaṭvāmatikrāntāyātikhaṭvāyetyatra kasmānna bhavati, upasarjanahrasvatve kṛte tasya sthānivadbhāvādāvgrahaṇena grahaṇe sati prāpnoti? ityata āha--`atikhaṭvāya' ityādi| yadā tāvat‌ `supi ca' (7.3.102) iti dīrghatvaṃ na kriyate, tadā ṅyāvgrahaṇena dīrghagrahaṇamityetadvavacanānna bhavati| yadā dīrghatvaṃ tadā lākṣaṇikatvānna bhavati; `lakṣaṇapratipadoktayoḥ pratipadoktasyaiva grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.3) iti vacanāt‌|| 114. sarvanāmnaḥ syāḍḍhsvaśca| (7.3.114) yāṭo'pavādaḥ| ākāroccāraṇaṃ sarvasyā ityatra yathā syāt‌, anyathā pararūpatvaṃ prasajyeta| akāroccāraṇasāmarthyānna prasajyeta--ityetacca nāśaṅkanīyam‌, taddhi tasyāmityatra `ūḍidampadādyappumraidyubhyaḥ' (6.1.171) iti vibhaktyudāttatvaṃ mā bhūt‌, āgamānudattatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌|| 115. vibhāṣā dvitīyātṛtayābhyām‌| (7.3.115) asarvanāmārthaṃ vacanam‌| ye tu `vāprakaraṇe tīyasya ṅitsūpasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā. 6) iti sarvanāmasaṃjñāṃ tīyasyopasañcakṣate ta idaṃ sūtraṃ pratyācakṣate; tenaiva siddhatvāt‌| taccopasaṃkhyānamavaśyaṃ karttavyam‌, smāyādayo ṅiti vikalpena yathā syuriti--dvitīyasmai, dvitīyāya, dvitīyasmin‌, dvitīya iti| anye tvanenaiva smāyādayaḥ sidhyantītyupasaṃkhyānameva pratyācakṣate| katham‌? `sarvanāmnaḥ' ityetadihānuvarttate, syāḍiti nivṛttam‌, tenaivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate--sarvanāmno ṅiti yaduktaṃ tadvibhāṣa dvitīyātṛtīyābhyāṃ bhavatīti| tena syāyādayo'payanenaiva bhaviṣyantīti nārtha upasaṃkhyānena|| 116. ṅerāmnadyāmnībhyaḥ| (7.3.116) `ṅeḥ' iti saptamyekavacanasya grahaṇam‌| etacca `striyām‌' ityevamādinirdeśādvijñāyate| `grāmaṇyām‌' iti| grāmaṃ nayatīti `satsūdviṣa' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip‌, `agragrāmābhyāñca' iti ṇatvam‌| `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.72) iti yaṇādeśaḥ| atha kumāryām‌, khaṭvāyām‌, sarvasyāmiti kathaṃ sidhyati, āmi kṛte `hrasvanadyāpo nuṭ‌' (7.1.54) iti nuḍāgamena bhavitavyam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nuṭaḥ paratvādāṭ‌--yāṭ‌--syāṭo bhavanti| teṣa kṛteṣu nuṭaḥ prāptireva nāstīti, na hi dvayorādiliṅgayoḥ samuccaya upapadyate|| 117. idudbhyām‌| (7.3.117) nadīgrahaṇamihanuvarttate| tena cedutau viśiṣyatete nadīsaṃkakau yādidutāviti| yadyevam‌, anarthakamidam‌, pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌? naitadasti; aukaro hi paratvaduttarasūtreṇa syāt‌, asmiṃśca satyāmeva bhavati|| 118. aut‌| (7.3.118) nadīsaṃjñakāt‌ parasya ṅerām‌ pūrveṇa vihitaḥ, ghisajñakāduttareṇāttvasanniyuktamaukāraṃ vakṣyati, tasmāt‌ pāriśeṣyāt‌ tābhyāṃ yadanyadikārorāntaṃ tadihodāharaṇaṃ vijñāyata ityāha--`yagna nadīsaṃjñam‌' ityādi| atra ca sakhipatiśabdāvastryākhyātvānnadīsaṃjñakāvapi na bhavataḥ| ghakhisaṃjñako yathā na bhavatastathā pūrvameva pratipāditam‌|| 119. acca gheḥ| (7.3.119) athāttve kṛte `ajādyataṣṭāp‌' (4.1.4) iti--kṛtau, dhenādityevamādau ṭāp‌ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`aditi taparakaram‌' ityādi| yasmāt‌ taparakaraṇaṃ ṭābnivṛtttayarthaṃ kriyate, tasmāt‌ kṛte'pyattve ṭābna bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| taparakaraṇaṃ hi tatkālāvadhāraṇārtham‌| na cātra bhāvyamānatvādaṇo mātrikatvācca sthānino dīrghatvasya prāptirasti| ato'nyenāpi hetunā yaddorghatvamāpadyate tatpratiṣedhārthamupajāyamānaṃ taṭṭāpo'bhāvamāpādayati| ṭāpi hi satyakaḥ savarṇe (6.1.101) dīrghatvaṃ syāt‌| tathā cānarthakaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ syāt‌| tasmānmā bhūdanarthakamiti kṛte'pyattve ṭāpā na bhavitavyamiti| `audacca dheriti yeṣām‌' ityādi| iha kecit‌ `audacca rgheḥ' ityekaṃ yogaṃ kurvanti; tathā ca satyauttvāttvayoḥ sanniyogaśiṣṭatvādyatrāttvaṃ tatraivottvena bhavitavyam‌| gheścāttvamiti sakhyau, patyāvityatrāttvābhāvādauttvamapi na syāt‌| atastasya doṣasya parīhārāya yeṣāmeka evāyaṃ yogaste pradhānaśiṣṭamauttvamācakṣate| yathā `karttuḥ kyaṅ‌ salopaśca' (3.1.11) ityatra pradhānaśiṣṭamācakṣate kyaṅam‌, akṣavācayaśiṣṭaṃ salopam‌| yathā tatraiva--tatrāsatyapi salope yathā kyaṅ‌ bhavati śyenāyate--ityādau; evamasatyapyattve sakhyau, patyāvityatrauttvaṃ bhavatīti teṣāmabhiprāyaḥ|| 120. āṅo nā'striyām‌| (7.3.120) āṅa iti sthānyantaranirdeśādihārthādvibhaktivipariṇāmo bhavatīti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ yadgheriti prakṛtaṃ tadiha pañcamyantamupajāyata ityāha--`gheruttarasya' ityādi| atha kimaratham‌ `astriyām‌' ityucyate, `āṅo nā puṃsi' ityevocyeta; evamucyamāne trapuṇā jatunetyetanna sidhyatītyetacca nāśaṅkanīyam‌; `iko'ci vibhaktau' (7.1.73) iti numaiva siddhatvāt‌? iti yo manyeta, taṃ nirākarttum‌--`amunā brāhmaṇakulena ityasyopanyāsaḥ| atra hi tyadādyatve kṛte `adaso'serdādu do maḥ' (8.2.80) ityuttvamatve ca| tatra yadi puṃsītyucyate, tato'muneti napuṃsake na sidhyet‌; mubhāvasyāsiddhatvāt‌| numo'bhāvāt‌ `astriyām‌' ityucyamāne napuṃsake'pi nābhāvo bhavatītyamuneti siddhaṃ bhavati| na hi nābhāve karttavye mubhāvasyāsiddhatvam‌; `na mu ne' (8.2.3) iti vacanādatyabhiprāyaḥ|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ saptamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ <7.4> atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ caturthaḥ pādaḥ 1. ṇau caḍyupadhāyā hvasvaḥ| (7.4.1) `caṅpare ṇau parataḥ' iti| caṅ‌ paro yasmāṇṇeriti sa tathoktaḥ| `acīkarat‌' ityādi| kṛñ‌, hṛñ, lūñ‌, pañityetebhyo hetumaṇṇic‌, tato luṅ‌, cliḥ,`ṇiśri' (3.1.48) ityādinā cleścaṅ‌, `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopaḥ| atra dvirvacanopadhāhrasvatvayoḥ prāptayoḥ paratvādupadhāhrasvatvam‌, tato dvirvacanam‌, tataśca ṇau kṛtaṃ sathānivadbhavatīti kṛ, hṛ--ityādikamavikṛtadhāturūpameva dvirucyate| atra kṛ, hṛ--ityetayorabhyāsasya `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityattve kṛte raparatve halādiśeṣe ca tataśca `sabvalladhuni' (7.4.93) ityādinā sanvadbhāvādittvam‌| pū, lū--ityetayorapi hrasvatve kṛte `oḥ puyaṇjyapare' (7.4.80) itīttvam‌| sarvatra `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghatvam‌| `atra dvirvacanopadhāhrasvatvayoḥ prāptayoḥ' ityādi| acīkaravityādiṣūdāharaṇeṣu kṛtākṛtaprasaṅgitvād‌dvirvacanaṃ nityamupadhāhrasvatvamapi, tayorubhayoḥ paratvādupadhāhrasvatvaṃ bhavati, tatra kṛte dvirvacanam‌--ityeṣa kāryāṇāṃ pravṛttikramaḥ| mā bhavānaṭiṭadityatra tu dvirvacanameva nityam‌, na hrasvatvaṃ tu dvitīyasyai kāco dvirvacane kṛte na prāpnoti; pareṇa ṭiśabdarūpeṇa vyavadhānāt‌| tasmānmā bhavānaṭiṭadityatra nityatvād‌dvitīyasyaikāco dvirvacanaṃ prapnoti| dvirvacane hi sati ko doṣaḥ syāt‌? ityata āha--`tathā ca sati' ityādi| evañca dvirvacane kṛte caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasya hrasvabhāvyākāra upadhā bhavati| asati ca hrasvatve mā bhavānaṭiṭaditi rūpaṃ na sidhyati| māyoga āṇnivṛttyarthaḥ| āṭi tu sati nāsti viśeṣaḥ| satyasati vā hrasvatve `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhyā bhavitavyamiti| bhavacchabdaḥ sandehanirāsārthaḥ| `naiṣa doṣaḥ' iti| yo'nantaroktaḥ sa kathaṃ labhyate? ityāha--`oṇeṝditkaraṇam‌' ityādi| `oṇṛ apanayane' (dhā.pā.454) ityetasya ṛditkaraṇasyaitatprayojanam‌--ṛdittvānnāglopi (7.4.2) ityādinā hrasvapratiṣedho yathā syāditi| yadi ca nityamapi dvirvacanamupadhāhrasvatvena na bādhyate, tadauṇaiṝditkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| dvirvacane hi kṛte pareṇa ṇiśabdarūpeṇa vyavadhānādeva hrasvo na bhaviṣyati, kimoṇeṝditkaraṇeneti? ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--nityamapi dvirvacanamupadhāhrasvatvena bādhyata iti; yata oṇeṝdatkaraṇaṃ karoti| `ṇāviti kim‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--ṇigrahaṇe cākṛte luṅcaṅādeśayoḥ kṛtayorṇilope cākṛte vṛddhyāvādeśayoścākṛtayoḥ, alū i-at‌ iti sthita ūkarasya hrasvo mā bhūdatyevamarthaṃ vā ṇigrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ūkārasya vṛddhau kṛtāyāmaukārasaya hrasvo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ vā? etaccobhayamaprayojanam‌; atrāntaraṅgatvādvṛddhyāvādeśābhyāmeva bhavitavyam‌| antaraṅgatvaṃ punastayorṇijmātrāśrayatvāt‌; hrasvasya ca bahiraṅgatvaṃ caṅāśrayatvāditi| `caṅyupadhāyā hrasva ityucyamāne' ityādi| etāvatyucyamāne'sati ṇigrahaṇe caṅpare yadaṅgaṃ tasyopadhāyā hrasvo bhavatītyevamarthaḥ syāt‌| tathā cānavakāśo hrasvo'līlavadityatrāntaraṅgāmapi vṛddhiṃ bādhitvā vacanasāmarthyādṛkārasyaiva syāt‌| athāpi kathañcid‌ vṛddhirna bādhyate; evamapi vṛddhau kṛtāyāmantaraṅgamapyāvādeśaṃ bādhitvaukārasyaiva prasajyeta; anyathā hi vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `adīdapat‌' iti| atra dadāterṇici luṅi caṅi ca kṛte a dā i-at‌ iti sthite vacanaprāmāṇyādanavakāśo hrasvo'ntaraṅgamapi pukaṃ bādhitvā prasajyeta, tasamiṃśca sati pug‌vihatanimittatvānna syāt‌| `apīpacadityādau tu naiva hrasvaḥ syāt‌' iti| caṅi parato yadaṅgaṃ pāciprabhṛti tadīyāyā upadhāyāścākārāderahrasvabhāvinītvāt‌| ādiśabdo'pīpaṭhadityādiparigrahārthaḥ| tasmāṇṇāviti vaktavyam‌| `caṅīti kim‌' iti| eṣo'bhiprāyaḥ--kevale ṇau hrasvo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ caṅītyucyate; naitaccaṅagrahaṇasya prayojanamupapadyate; yasmādācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--ṇāveva kevale hrasvatvaṃ na bhavatīti, yadayam‌ `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvatvaṃ śāsti| tataḥ kārayati, hārayatītyādau na bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| yadyetasmājjñāpakāt‌ kārayatītyādau hrasvo na bhavati, tadā'cīkaradityatrāpi na syāt‌| athātra vacanasāmarthyādbhaviṣyati? evamapi kārayatītyādau syādeva| na hi `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) ityucayamāne satyacīkaradityādau na bhavatītyeva viṣayavibhāgaḥ śakyate vijñātum‌| tasmāt‌ caṅgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| `upadhāgrahaṇaṃ kim‌' iti| evaṃ manyate--alo'ntyasya mā bhūdityevamarthamupadhāgrahaṇaṃ kriyate, etaccāprayojanam‌; caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasyācīkaradityādāvapi ṇāvantaraṅgatvād‌ vṛddhyādiṣu kṛteṣu hrasvabhāvyajantyo na sambhavati yatrājantāṇṇijutpadyate, kiṃ punarapapaṭhavityādau yatra halantāṇṇijutpadyate! tasmādajantyo hrasvabhāvo nāstītyantareṇāpyupadhāgrahaṇaṃ vacanādanavtyasyaivopadhābhūtasya hrasvo bhaviṣyatīti| `acakāṅkṣat‌, avavāñchat‌' iti| `krākṣi vākṣi mākṣi kāṅkṣāyām‌' (dhā.pā.667,668,669)| yadyapyajanto hrasvabhāvī nāsti, tathāpi vacanādanantyasyācokaradityādau yathā bhavati, tathā acakāṅkṣadityādāvapi syāt‌| tasmānmā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityupadhāgrahaṇaṃ kriyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu cāṅgasya yo'c‌ tasya caṅpare ṇau hrasvo vidhīyate, tatra yadyapyanantaro'j‌ na sambhavati, tathāpi `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt‌' (vyā.pa.46) ityekena varṇeneti yena nāvyavadhānam‌, api tu sarvadā vyavadhānameva; tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyādbhavitavyam‌| ekenaiva varṇena vyavadhānaṃ sarvatra sambhavati| saṅghātena tu vyavadhānaṃ sambhavati, na sambhavati ca| ihācakāṅkṣadityādau saṅghātenaiva vyavadhānam‌, ato nāstyeva hrasvaprasaṅga iti kimudhāgrahaṇena? ityāha--`tadetat‌' ityādi| upadhāgrahaṇamavaśyamuttarārthaṃ karttavyam‌| iha tu kriyamāṇe satyacakāṅkṣadityevamartham‌ `yena nāvyavadhānam‌' (vyā.pa.46) ityeṣā paribhāṣā nāśrayitavyā bhavati| upadhāgraṇenaivātra hrasvasya nivarttitatvādityeṣa guṇo labhyate| tenehaiva kṛtam‌, notraratra| `upadhāhrasvatve ṇerṇicayupasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| caṅpare ṇau parato yo ṇistasmin‌ parato'ṅgasyopadhāpā hrasvaḥ upasaṃkhyeyaḥ| `avīvadat‌' iti| vadeḥ `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic‌, tadantādvāditavantaṃ prayojitavāniti punaḥ `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic, tato luṅādiḥ,`ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇa na sidhyati, yāvatā ṇilope kṛte caṅpare ṇāvaṅgasyākāro hrasvabhāvinyupadhā bhavatyeva? ityāha--`yo'so' ityādi| `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) api ṇilopasya hrasvatve karttavye sthānivadbhāvāṇṇijavyavadhānād‌ hrasvo na prāpnoti| tena vā ṇilopenāglopyaṅgametadbhavati--tadetasmāddhetorna harasavatvaṃ prāpnoti| aglopītyādinānantaravakṣyamaṇipratiṣedhāt‌ (7.4.4) `ṇyākṛtinidaśāt‌ siddham‌' ityupasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe--`ṇau iti| ṇyākṛtiriti ṇijātirnirdeśayate, na tu ṇivyaktiḥ| tena vyaktau vyavadhānaṃ na bhavati, na hi jātau; ekatvāṇṇijāteḥ| na hi tayaiva tasyā vyavadhānamupapadyate| nanu cottarayā ṇyākṛtyā jātyādhārabhūtayā ṇivyaktyā ṇijātyāśraye'pi vyavadhānamupapadyata eva? naitat‌; tasyāmapi vyaktau jāteḥ samavāyāt‌| evaṃ tādadvyavadhānaṃ ṇyākṛtyāśraye nāsti| aglopitvamapi nāstyeva; na hyatra ṇijātivyatirekeṇā'nyo'gvidyate, yasya lopenāglopyaṅgaṃ syāt‌| na ca ṇyākṛterlopaśca; tasyāḥ śrūyamāṇatvāt| na hi śrūyamāṇāyā lope lapapadyate; `adarśanaṃ lopa' (1.1.60) iti vacanāt‌| nanu ca jātivyatirekeṇāpi tadāśrayabhūtā vyakatiragvidyata eva; na jātivyaktyorananyatvamiti sāṃkhyoyasiddhāntasyehāśrayaṇāt‌| atha vā--ṇyākṛtinirdeśe satyupadhāhrasvatvasya ṇyākṛtanimittatvenā śroyate| tena gobalīvaradanyāyena tasyā ṇyākṛternimittatvenopāttāyā anyasyāko lopaḥ pratiṣedhanimittatvena vijñāyate, sa ceha nāsti| tasmāṇṇyākṛtinirdeśāt‌ siddham‌|| 2. nāglopiśāsvṛditām‌| (7.4.2) agiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam‌| ako lopo'glopaḥ, sa eṣāmastīti tānyaglopīnyaṅgāni| `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075) ṛdidyeṣāṃ tāni ṛdinti `bādhṛ viloḍane' (dhā.pā.5) ityevamādīni| `amamālat‌, amamātarat‌' iti| `tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe' (ga.sū.187) iti ṇic‌, `ṇāviṣṭhavatkāryaṃ prātipadikasya' (vā.813) itīṣṭhavadbhāvaḥ, `turiṣṭhemeyaḥsu' (6.4.154) iti ṭilopaḥ, tato luṅādiḥ| `atayararājat‌' ityādau, `prātipadikāddhātvarthe bahulamiṣṭhavacca' (ga.sū.186) iti ṇic‌| `anvalulomat‌' iti| `satyāpapāśarūpa' (3.1.25) ityādinā ṇic‌| `ageva kevalo yatra' ityādi| iha dvividhamagalopayaṅgam‌--kvacidageva kevalo lupyate, amamāladityādaukvaciddhalacau, atyararājadityādau| ageva kevalo yatra lupyate tatrāglopasya sthānivadbhāvāt‌ siddham‌| sthānivadbhāve satyaglopasya vyavadhānādeva hrasavaprāptiḥ, tasmānna tadarthamaglopīti vacanam‌| itaratra tu halacorubhayorapyādeśa iti sidhyati, asthānivadbhāvāt‌| ajādeśasaya hi paranimittakasya sthānivadbhāva uktaḥ, na tu halacorādeśasya| tasmādyatra halacorādeśāstadarthamidaṃ vacanam‌| anyārthametat‌ kriyamāṇaṃ yatrāgeva kevalo lupyate tadarthamapi bhaviṣyatīti tadarthamasyodāharaṇamupanyastam‌| `aḍuḍhaukat‌' ita| `kaki vaki śvaki traki ḍhaukṛ traukṛ ṣvaṣka vaska maska ṭikṛ ṭīkṛ tikṛ raghi laghi gatyarthāḥ' (dhā.pā.94,95,96,97,98,99,100,101,102,103,104,105,106,107,108)| `abhyāse cacaṃ' (8.4.54) iti jaśtvam‌--ḍakāraḥ|| 3. bhrājabhāsabhāvadīpajavamīlapīḍāmanyatarasyām‌| (7.4.3) bhrājirayaṃ bhvādāvanudāttet‌ paṭhyate, ātmanepadī ṛkārānubandhaḥ phaṇādiṣu `ṭubhrāju ṭubhrāsu dīptau' (dhā.pā.823,824) iti paṭhyate, phaṇādibhyaḥ purastācca `ejṛbhrejṛ bhrājṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.179,180,181) iti| tantrāntargacakāryārthaḥ phaṇādiṣvavaśyamevāsya pāṭho'ṅgīkarttavya iti tenaiva śabāderapi gaṇakāryasya siddhatvāt‌| anyatrāsya pāṭho'nārṣa eva lakṣyate| `bhāsṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.624), `bhā, vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.612) `dīpī dīptau' (dhā.pā.150), `jīva prāṇadhāraṇe' (dhā.pā.562) `mīla śmīla smīla kṣmīla nimeṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.517,518,519,520), `pīḍa avagāhane' (dhā.pā.1544)--eṣāṃ nitye hrasvatve prāpte vibhāṣeyamārabhyate| `abibhrajat‌' iti| yadhā hrasvatvam‌, tadā pūrvavatsanvadbāvenettvam‌| `abībhavat‌' iti| pūrvavad‌dīrghaḥ| atha bhrājabhāsayoṝditkaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā tayorhi ṛditkaramasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--ṛdittvāt‌ pūrvasūtreṇa hrasvapratiṣedho yathā syāditi| yadi vibhāṣayā ca tayorhrasvatvaṃ vidhīyate tadā ṛditkaraṇamasya vaiyarvyameva? ityata āha--`bhrājabhāsoḥ' ityādi| `apāṇinīyam‌' iti| pāṇineridaṃ pāṇinīyam‌, na pāṇinīyamapāṇinauyamiti; tenānabhyupagamāt‌; na tu tenākṛtatvāt‌| anyathā hi `bādhṛ viloḍane' (dhā.pā.5)--ityevamādīnāmapi ṛditkaraṇamapāṇinīyaṃ syāt‌| pratipāditaṃ hi pūrvam‌ (4.1.106 tamasūtre)--gaṇakāraḥ pāṇinirna bhavatīti| tathā ca--anyo gaṇakāraḥ anyaśca sūtrakāraḥ|| 4. lopaḥ pibaterīccābhyāsasya| (7.4.4) hrasvatve prāpte tadapavādaḥ pibaterlopo vidhauyate, īkāraścābhyāsasyeti| upadhādhikārādupadhāyā eva| paryāyeṇa lopekārau mā bhūtām‌--ityevamarthamadhyāsagrahaṇam‌| `apīpyat‌' iti| `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925), ṇic‌, `śācchāsāhvāvyāvepām‌' (7.3.37) iti yuk‌| nanu ca nityatvāt‌ paratvācca pūrvamupadhālope kṛte'nackatvād‌ dvirvacanena na bhavitavyam‌? ityata āha--`upadhālope kṛte' ityādi| subodham‌| pibrateḥ śtipā nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ--apāpayaditi| `pā rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1056, `pai ovai śoṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.920,921)--ityetayostu nivṛttyarthaḥ sa nopapadyate; tatra hyokasya lugvikaraṇatvādeva na bhaviṣyati, aparasya tu lākṣaṇikatvāt‌|| 5.tiṣṭhaterit‌| (7.4.5) ayamapi hrasvāpavādaḥ| `īccābhyāgasya' (7.4.4) iti nivṛttam‌| śtipā nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛttyartha eva--atāsthapaditi|| 6. jighratervā| (7.4.6) eṣo'pi hrasvāpavādaḥ| atrāpi śtipā nirdeśasya tadeva prayojanam‌--ajāghrapaditi|| 7. uṝt‌| (7.4.7) atra ṛkāraḥ sthānitvenopāttaḥ, tasya cāntaraṅgatvādirarāra eva prāpnuvanti, na hi bahiraṅgo hrasvaḥ, tasmāt‌ teṣāmapavādau vijñāyata ityata āha--`irarārāmapavādaḥ' iti| `upaghāyāśca' (7.1.101) itīkāraḥ, `pugantalaghūpaghasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇo'kāraḥ, `mṛjerbṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114) ityākāraḥ--ityete ca ṛkārasya sthāne `uraṇ‌raparaḥ' (1.1.51) iti raparā bhavanto yatākramamirarāro bhavanti, teṣāmapavādaḥ| `acīkṛtat‌' iti| `kṝta saṃśabdene' (dhā.pā.1653), curādiḥ, ṇic‌| `avīvṛtat‌' iti| `vṛtu varttane' (dhā.pā.758) `amīmṛjat‌' iti| `mṛjū śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1066) hetumaṇṇic‌| nanu cāntaraṅgatvādirarārbhireva bhavitavyam‌, antaraṅgatvaṃ tu punasteṣāṃ ṇjmātrāśrayatvāt‌| ṛkārastu caṅparaṃ ṇicamāśritya bhavatīti bahiraṅgaḥ| tatkathaṃ tenerarāro bādhyante? ityata āha--`vacanasāmarthyāt‌' ityādi| yadyantaraṅgatvādirarāraḥ syuḥ, vacanasya tadā vaiyarthya syāt‌; anavakāśatvāt‌| tasmādantaraṅgā api te bādhyante| `taparakaraṇam‌' ityādi| asati hi taparakaraṇe yatra dīrghaḥ sthānī, tatrāntaratamyāddīrghaḥ prasajyeta tasmā ddīrghe'pi sthānini hrasva eva yathā syādityevamarthaṃ taparakaraṇam‌| nanu `bhāṣyamāno'ṇ‌ savarṇānna grṛhṇāti' (vyā.pa.35) iti dīrghasyāpi sthānino hrasva eva bhaviṣyati, na dīrghaḥ? ityata āha--`na cāyaṃ bhāvyamānaḥ' ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇam‌? ityata āha--`ādeśāntaranivṛttyartham‌' iti| iti| ādeśāntaramirarārādi; tasya nivṛttyarthamīkārasyāsmīyarūpeṇaivābhyanujñāyate, na tvapūrva eva ṛkāro vidhīyate, tatkuto'sya bhāvyamānatā!|| 8. nityaṃ chandasi| (7.4.8) `avīvṛdhat‌' iti| `vṛdhu vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.759) hetumāṇṇic‌, tato luṅādiḥ| nityagrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre vetyetadanuvṛttervijñāpanārtham‌; anyathā hi tatrāpyasyānanuvṛttirvijñāyeta|| 9. dayaterdigi liṭi| (7.4.9) `avadigye' ityādi| `deṅ‌ rakṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.962), liṭ‌, ṅittvādātmanepadam‌, prathapuruṣaḥ, `liṭastajhayoreśirec‌' (3.4.81) ityeśirecau, eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) ityādinā yaṇādeśaḥ| `dayateriti deṅo grahaṇam‌, na tu daya dāna ityasya' iti| nanu ca `daya dānagatirakṣaṇahiṃsādāneṣu' (dhā.pā.481) ityetasya grahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`tasya hi' ityādi| liṭītyucyate, na ca `daya dāne' (dhā.pā.481)--ityetasyānantaro liḍasti; yasmāt‌ tasya `dayāyāsaśca' (3.1.37) ityanenām‌ vihitaḥ| nanu ca `amantre' iti tatrānuvarttate, tato mantra āmo'bhāvāt‌ syādevānantaryam‌? evaṃ manyate--yathādṛṣṭānuvidhiśchandasīti| na ca `daya dāne' (dhā.pā.481) ityetasya mantre digyādeśo dṛśyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| ihāvadigye--ityanavakāśātvād‌ digyādese kṛte paścād‌ dvirvacanena bhavitavyam‌, yathā cakhyāvityatra `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ‌' (2.4.54) iti khyāñādeśasyānavakāśatvāt‌ tatra kṛte paścād‌dvirvacanam‌, tathāvadigye ityatrāpi digyādeśe kṛte paścād‌ dvirvacana kena bādhyeta? iti yaścodayet‌--taṃ pratyāha--`digyādeśena dvirvacanasya bādhanamiṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi labhyate? nityagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| iha pūrvasūtrānnityagrahaṇamanuvarttate, na cātra vibhāṣā prāpnoti, yannivṛttyartha nityagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tasmādanyalliṭi yat‌ kāryaṃ prāpnoti, tannivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate; tenaivamabhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate--`liṭi prāpnuvatāṃ kāryāṇāṃ digyādeśa eva nityaṃ bhavati, nānyatkāryam‌'| ityevaṃ dvirvacananivarttanaṃ bhavati| yaṇādeśastu liṭityucyāyaṃ na vidhīyata iti `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.42) ityaci bhavati|| 10. ṛtaśca saṃyogāderguṇaḥ| (7.4.10) `sasvaratuḥ, sasvaruḥ' iti| `svṛ śabdopatāpayoḥ' (dhā.pā.932), `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityabhyāsasyāttvam‌, raparatvam‌, halādiśeṣaḥ| `dadhvaratuḥ, dadhvaruḥ' iti| `dhvṛ hūrcchane' (dhā.pā.939)| `sasmaratuḥ, sasmaruḥ' iti| `smṛ ādhyāne' (dhā.pā.807)| nanu ca sarvatraiva sābhyāsamaṅgam‌, na ca tat‌ saṃyogādi? naiṣa doṣaḥ, `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam‌' ityeṣo'tra pakṣaḥ, tatra parasyāpyaṅgasaṃjñā bhavatyeva| athāpi `sthāne dvirvacanam‌' ityapyadoṣaḥ; sarvatraiva hi liṭyabhyāsaḥ saṃyogāditvaṃ vihanti, ucyate cedaṃ vacanam‌, tatraivaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ--prāgdvirvacanāt‌ saṃyogāditvamasti, iha ca dvirvacanāt‌ prāk saṃyogāditvamasti| `cikṣipatuḥ, cikṣipuḥ' iti| `kṣi kṣaye' (dhā.pā.236), iyaṅādeśaḥ| `pratiṣedhaviṣaye'pi' ityādi| yaḥ `kṅiti ca' (1.15) ityasaya pratiṣedhasya viṣayo na bhavati thalādiḥ, tatra `sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ' (7.3.84) ityevaṃ guṇaḥ siddhaḥ| tasmādguṇapratiṣedhaviṣaye'pi yathā syādityayamārambhaḥ vṛddhiviṣaye'pi paratvādguṇena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākartumāha--`vṛddhiviṣaye tu' ityādi| guṇasyāvakāśaḥ--sasvaratuḥ, sasvaruriti; ñṇiti vṛddheravakāśaḥ--svārakaḥ, dhvāraka iti; sattvāra, dadhvāretyatrobhayaprasaṅge pūrvavipratiṣedhena vṛddhireva bhavati| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, dīrghasyāpi mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ cet‌? naitadasti; bhavitavyameva hi dīrghasyottarasūtreṇa--`stṛñ‌ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1484), ātastaratuḥ, ātastaruriti| nanu caitasmāt‌ taparakaraṇānna prāpnota, sāvakāśaṃ cottaravacanamasaṃyogādau--`kṝ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1409) nicakaratuḥ, nikaruriti? yadyevam‌, eve tarhi na cedaṃ taparakaraṇam‌, kiṃ tarhi tasināyaṃ nirdeśaḥ| `saṃyogādeḥ' ityādi| ihāṅgaprakaraṇādaṅgaṃ saṃyogāditvena viśiṣyate| na ca karoteḥ saṃyogādyaṅgamiti na prāpnoti, tasmāt‌ saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti karoterapi yathā syādguṇaḥ| `sañcaskaratuḥ, sañcaskaruḥ' iti| `samparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe' (6.1.137) iti suṭ‌, sa ca `aḍabhyāsavyavāye'pi' (6.1.136) iti vacanādabhyāsavyavāye'pi bhavati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamiha guṇo na sidhyati, yāvatā suṭi kṛte `tanmadhyapatitastadgrahaṇena gṛhyate' (vyā.pa.21) iti karotiḥ saṃyogādarbhavati? ityata āha--`atra hi' ityādi| anena suṭo bahiraṅgatāṃ pratipādayati| bahiraṅgatve hi tasya `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) ityantaraṅge guṇe karttavye bahiraṅgasya suṭo'siddhatvāt‌ saṃyogāditvaṃ karoternopapadyate| pūrvaṃ dhāturupasargeṇa yujyate paścāt‌ sādhanena' (jai.pa.vṛ.98) ityasmindarśane dhātūpasargayoḥ kāryamantaraṅgamiti suṭo'pi dhātūpasaryayoḥ kāryatvādantaraṅgatā syāt‌| `pūrva dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate paścādupasargeṇa' (sī.pa.128) ityasmin‌ darśane suḍbahiraṅgo bhavati| tathā hi--asmin‌ darśane nirupasargasyaiva dhātorarthaḥ sādhanena yujyata iti sādhanābhidhāyī pūrva tāvalliṭ‌ karttavyaḥ; tatra kṛte tadāśraye dvirvacane kṛte paścādupasargayoge `aḍabhyāsavayavāye'pi' (6.1.136) iti suṭ‌ kriyate| evañca kriyamāṇe hyanekapadāśritatvāt‌, bahvapekṣatvācca suṭo bahiraṅgatā pratipādyate| guṇastu liḍutpattisamanantarakālameva prāpnoti, nāparaṃ kiñcidapekṣate; ekapadāpekṣatvādalpāpekṣatvāccāntaraṅgaḥ, tataśca tasmin‌ karttavye suṭo'siddhatvāt‌ karotiḥ saṃyogādyaṅgaṃ na bhavati| tasmādasau na prāpnoti| `evañca kṛtvā' ityādi| yata evaṃ suḍbahiraṅgaḥ, evañca kṛtvā'ntaraṅga iṭi karttavye tasyāsiddhatvādasaṃyogāditvāt‌ karoterupaskṛṣīṣṭa, saṃskṛṣīṣṭa--ityatara `ṛtaśca saṃyogādeḥ' (7.2.43) itīḍāgamo na bhavati| etena bahiraṅgataiva suṭaḥ pratipāditā| nanu cāṅgādhikārāt‌ pratyāsatteraṅgāvayava eva saṃyogo gṛhyate, kātpūrvagrahaṇena tatra jñāpitamabhaktatvaṃ suṭaḥ, tataścābhaktatvādevāsaṃyogāditvāt‌ karoteriṇna bhaviṣyati, kimatra bahiraṅgatvenāsiddhatvenopanyastena? satyametat‌; evaṃ manyate--bhavatu nāma karotibhaktatvaṃ suṭaḥ, tathāpyasiddhatvāt‌ tasya saṃskṛṣīṣṭa--ityatreṭprasaṅgo na bhaviṣyatīti saṃyogopadhagrahaṇaṃ karttavyamiti| asyāyamarthaḥ--saṃyogopadhaḥ karotiraṅgaṃ gṛhyate yena tat‌ saṃyogopadhagrahaṇavyākhyānaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānaṃ karttavyam‌--cakāro'tra kriyate, sa ca karoteḥ saṃyogopadhasya samuccayārthaḥ| tena tasyāpi suṭi kṛte saṃyogopadhasya guṇo bhaviṣyatīti|| 11. ṛcchatyatām‌| (7.4.11) `ṛccha gatīndriyapralayamūrttibhāveṣu' (dhā.pā.1296)| artterapyatra praśleṣaḥ; bahuvacananirdeśāt‌| ata evāha--`ṛcchateraṅgasya, ṛ ityetasya, ṛkārāntānāṃ ca' iti| ṛkārāntāḥ--`kṛ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1409), `gṝ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410) ityemādayaḥ| `ānarcchatuḥ, ānarcchuḥ' ityādi| atususau, guṇaḥ, dvirvacanam‌, abhyāsakāryaṃ pūrvavat‌, `ata ādeḥ' (7.4.70) iti dīrghaḥ, `tasmānnuḍ‌ dvihalaḥ' (7.4.71) iti nuṭ| `āratuḥ' āruḥ' iti| pūrvavadabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ, tataḥ pūrvasavarṇeneti| `ṛcchateralaghūpadhatvāt‌' ityādi| alaghūpaghatvaṃ tu tasyāntaraṅgatvāt‌| `che ca' (6.1.73) iti tuki kṛte `saṃyoge guru' (1.4.11) iti gurusaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ gurūpadhatvānna prāpnotīti veditavyam‌| `ṛtāṃ tu' ityādi| ṛ ṛtāṃ tu pratiṣiddha eveti guṇo vidhīyata ityapekṣyate| guṇapratiṣedhastu teṣāṃ `asaṃyogāsliṭ‌ kit‌' (1.2.5) iti kittve sati `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) ityanena veditavyaḥ| `vṛddhiviṣaye tu' ityādi| yathā `ṛtaśca saṃyogāveḥ' (7.4.10) iti vṛddhiviṣaye pūrvavipratiṣedhena vṛddhirevedhyate, tathā ṛṛtāmapīti| guṇasyāvakāśaḥ--nicakaratuḥ, nicakaruriti; vṛddheravakāśaḥ--kārakaḥ, hāraka iti; nicakāra, nijagāretyatra vṛddhiviṣaye pūrvavipratiṣedhena vṛddhirevedhyate|| 12. śṝdṝprāṃ hrasvo vā| (7.4.12) `śṝ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1488) `dṝ vidāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1490) `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1489)--eṣāṃ pūrvasūtreṇa nityo guṇo bhavatyeva| `viśaśratuḥ' iti| hrasvatve kṛte yaṇādeśaḥ| `hrasvavacanam‌' ityādi| asati hrasvagrahaṇe vāścanena vikalpite yasmin‌ pakṣe guṇo nāsti tasmin‌ pakṣe `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvaṃ prasajyeta, `udīṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuttvañca| tasmāt‌ tannivṛttyartha hrasva ityucyate? ṛditi karttavye hrasvagrahaṇamuttarārtham‌| kecit‌ ityādi| kathaṃ punarasya pratyācyamāne viśaśratuḥ--ityevamādīni rūpāṇi sidhyanti? ityāha--`śrā pāke' ityādi| yadyapi `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityakaralope kṛte śrādīnāṃ viśaśraturityevamādīni rūpāṇi sidhyantīti, tathāpyarthamevo bhavati; tadā'yutttamasya pratyākhyānamityāśaṅkyānekārthatvāddhātūnāmityuktam‌| `tathā ca sati' ityādinā pratyādinā pratyākhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe| yadi sūtrasya pratyākhyānaṃ kriyate, kvāsau kṛte viśaśṛṣāniti rūpaṃ na sidhyati, tathā hi--yadi śṛṇāterhrasvo na kriyate, tadā viśaśarvāniti rūpaṃ syāt‌| atha śrāteḥ, viśaśrivāniti| tasmādayukatamasya pratyākhyānam‌|| 13. ke'ṇaḥ| (7.4.13) aṇiti pūrvema ṇakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇam‌; anyathā `ke'caḥ' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| atha vā--aca ityetadapi na brūyāt‌, aca eva hi harasvadīrghalputā bhavanti| `jñakā' iti| jānātīti jñā, `igupadhajñāprīkiraḥ kaḥ' (3.1.135), tadantāṭṭāpa| ajñātā jñeti `prāgivās‌ kaḥ' (5.3.70)| atha vā--anukampitā jñeti `anukampāyām‌' (5.3.76) iti kan‌ kani kṛte tadantāṭṭāp‌| atheha kasmānna bhavati--`kṛdādhārārcikalabhyaḥ kan‌' (da.u.3.18) iti rāterdadhāteśca kan‌, tadantāṭṭāp‌--`rākā, dhākā' ityādi| subodham‌| niranubandhasyeha grahaṇānniranubandhakaparibhāṣayā kano grahaṇena na [nāsti--mudrite] bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`na kapi' ityādi| yadyeṣā paribhāṣopatiṣṭate, tadā `na kapi' (7.4.14) iti pratiṣedho'narthakaḥ syāt‌| sānubandhakatvādeva kapo grahaṇaṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ|| 14. na kapi| (7.4.14) `bahukumārīkaḥ' iti| bahvyaḥ kumāryo yasya saḥ| `nadyṛtaśca' (5.4.156) iti kap‌; anubandhalopaḥ| athātrāsmin‌ hrasvatve pratiṣiddha upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ata eva pratiṣedhānna bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? na; `anantarasya vidhirāvā pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) ityanantarasyaiva hrasvasya hyayaṃ pratiṣedho na sarvasya| kapīti vacanasāmarthyādupasarjanahrasvatvamiti na bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? yatra hyupasarjanahrasvatvasya prāptirasti, `gostriyorupasarjanasya' (1.2.48) iti hrasvaśāsane strīśabdena stryadhikāravihitānāṃ pratyayānāṃ ṭābādīnāṃ grahaṇāt‌| tasmādbahukumārīka ityatropasarjanasya hrasvatvena bhavitavyamityata āha--`gostriyorupasarjanasya' ityādi| kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`samāsārthe hi' ityādi| upasarjanahrasvatvaṃ hi strīpratyayāntasya samāsaprātipadikasaya vidhīyate, taddhidhāne `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) ityataḥ prātipadikagrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ samāsaprātipadikasyaiva strīpratyayāntasyopasarjanahrasvaḥ syāt‌| na ca bahukumārīka ityādau strīpratyayāntaṃ samāsaprātipadisaṃ bhavati; yasmāt‌ `samāsāntāḥ' (5.4.68) ityadhikāra evāyāṃ kabvidhīyate| `samāsāntāḥ' ityatrāntagrahaṇasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--samāsasyānto'vacayo yathā syāditi, sa ca kathaṃ samāsasyāvayavo bhavati? yadi tena saha samāsasaṃjñā bhavati| kathañca tena samāsasaṃjñā bhavati? yadyakṛte samāse samāsārthāduttarapadāt‌ kabbhavati, paścāt‌ kadantena samāso bhavati, nānyathā| tasmāt‌ samāsāntādhikāre kapo vidhānāt‌ samāsārthāduttarapadāt‌ kapi kṛte paścāt‌ samāsena bhavitavyam‌| tataśca strīparatyayāntamiha samāsaparātapadekaṃ na bhavatīti na bhavatyupasarjanahrasvatvam‌| 15. āpo'nyatarasyām‌| (7.4.15) `bahukhaṭvākaḥ' iti| `śeṣādvibhāṣā' (5.4.154) iti kap‌|| 16. ṛdṛśo'ṅi guṇaḥ| (7.4.16) `kṅiti ca' (1.1.5) iti pratiṣedhe prāpte'yaṃ guṇo vidhīyate| `akarat‌' iti| kṛño luḍ‌, cliḥ, `tip‌, `kṛmṛdṛruhibhyaśchandasi' (3.1.59) iti cleraṅa| `asarat‌' iti| `sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.935)| `ārat‌' iti| `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.936), `sarttiśāstyarttibhyaśca' (3.1.56) iti cleraṅ‌, artterajāditvādāṭi kṛte `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ| `adarśat‌' ita `irito vā' (3.1.57) ityaṅ‌| atha guṇagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌| akāra eva nocyeta? naivaṃ śakyam‌; akāra ityucyamāne duśerantyasya syāt‌| guṇagrahaṇe tu sati saṃjñāvidhāne niyama itīka eva sthāne bhavati|| 17. asyatesthu k‌| (7.4.17) `āsthat‌' iti| `asu kṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1209) `asyativaktikhakyātibhyo'ṅ‌' (3.1.52) iti cleraṅādeśaḥ|| 18. śvayateraḥ| (7.4.18) `aśvat‌' iti| `ṭu ośvi gativṛddhyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1010)| `jṝstambhubhrucu' (3.2.58) ityādināṅ dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpatvam‌|| 19. pataḥ pum‌| (7.4.19) `apaptat‌' iti| `śala hula patlṛ gatau (dhā.pā.843,844,845), puṣādināṅa| makāro deśavidhyarthaḥ|| 20. vaca um‌| (7.4.20) `avocat‌' iti| `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1842), `asyatiktikhyātibhyaḥ' (3.1.52) ityādināṅ‌| makārasaya tadeva prayojanam‌|| 21. śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke guṇaḥ| (7.4.21) aprāptaviṣayatvādguṇavidhānasya ṅiti sārvadhātuka etadvidhānam‌| piti tu sāmānyalakṣaṇainaiva guṇaḥ siddhaḥ| loṭ‌, `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) ityāṭi--śayai, śayāvaha ita| tasmādyatra guṇo na prāpnoti tatra vidhīyate| `śerate' iti| adāditvācchapo luk‌ `tmanepadeṣvanataḥ' (7.1.5) iti jhakārasyādādeśaḥ| atra `śīṅo ruṭ‌' (7.1.6) ruḍāgamo bhavati| `śiśye' iti| liṭ‌, `liṭ‌ ca' (3.4.115) ityārdhadhātukasaṃjñā, uttamapuruṣasyaikavacanam‌, prathamapuruṣasyaikavacanaṃ vā| yadā prathamapurusyaikavacanaṃ tadaiś‌, pūrvavadeva dvirvacanam, `eranekāco'saṃyogapūrvasya' (6.4.82) iti yaṇādeśaḥ; anyadeṭ‌, ṭerettvam‌| atha guṇagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na `śīṅaḥ sārvadhātuke eta' ityeṃvocyeta? evaṃ manyate--`śīṅaḥ' iti sānabandhakanirdeśe ṣaṣṭhyucyāritā, nivṛttidharmā cānubandhaḥ tasyetsaṃjñāyāṃ lopena nivṛttau prāptāyāmayamanyaprakāro nivṛtteravajñāyeta| tasya nānyetsaṃjñā nivarttikā, kiṃ tarhi? ekāraḥ| evaṃ tarhi ṅakārasya sthāna ekāra āpadyate| tasmādguṇagrahaṇaṃ tvikamupasthāpayati| ṅakārastu tenaiva hetunā nivarttata iti yadyevam‌, ṅakāro noccārayiṣyate, `jhiyaḥ' iti nirdeśaḥ kariṣyate? naiṣa śakyam‌; evaṃ hi nirdeśe sati yaṅlukyapi syāt‌--śeśīta, śeśyatīti|| 22. ayaṅiya kṅiti| (7.4.22) `śayyate' iti| `sārvadhātuke yak‌' (3.1.67)| `śāśayyate' iti yaṅ‌, paratvānnityatvācca dvirvacanāt‌ prāgayaṅādeśaḥ, tataḥ śayyetyasya dvirvacanam‌, `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityabhyāsasaya dīrghatvam‌| `praśayya' iti| `samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle ktvā' (3.4.21), `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ, `samāse'nañpūrve ktvo lyap‌' (7.1.37) `yem‌' iti| `ñaco yat‌' (3.1.97)| `śayyā' [nāsti--kāśikāyām‌] iti| `sajñāyāṃ samajani' (3.3.99) ityādinā kyap‌|| 23. upasargāddhrasva ūhate| (7.4.23) `samuhya gataḥ' iti| `ūha vitarke' (dhā.pā.648)| yadyapi yajāditvāt‌ kiti samprasāraṇenaitat sidhyati, tathāpyūherapi dīrghasyāśravaṇaṃ tathā syādityevamarthamidaṃ hrasvavidhānam‌| `samīhyate' iti| `īha ceṣṭāyām‌' (dhā.pā.632)| `samūhitaḥ' iti| ktaḥ| `samūhayo'yamarthaḥ' iti| `ṛhalorṇyat‌' (3.1.124)| `aṇa ityeva' ityādi| `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) ityato'ṇgrahaṇamanuvarttate| `ā uhyate ohyate, samohyate' iti| hrasvatvaṃ na bhavati| yadyavgrahaṇamanuvarttate, tadā hrasvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, upasargādūhateruditi vaktavyam‌? nānarthakam‌; uttārārthatvāt--`eteliṅi' (7.4.24) iti vakṣyati, tatra `hrasvaḥ' ityetasyānuvṛttiryathā syāt‌|| 24. eterliṅi| (7.4.24) `udiyāt‌' iti| `iṇ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.1045), āśiṣi liṅa, `skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti sakāralopaḥ| `abhīyāt‌' iti| savarṇadīrghatve'kṛte hrasvaḥ| `āśiṣi liṅi' ityādinā sūtrasya viṣayaṃ darśayati| sārvadhātuke hi liṅi dīrghatvamiṇo na sambhavatīti nātrāsyopayogaḥ| yatrākṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghatva (7.4.25) māpadyate; tatra dīrghatve kṛte'nena hrasvo bhavati| 25. akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ| (7.4.25) `bhṛśāyate' iti| `bhṛśādibhyo bhuvyacverlopaśca halaḥ' (3.1.12) iti kyaṅ‌| `sukhāyate' iti| `sukhādibhyaḥ karttṛvedanāyām‌' (3.1.18) iti kṅ‌| `cīyate' iti| karmaṇi lakāraḥ, `sārvadhātuke yak‌' (3.1.67)| `cecīyate' iti| `guṇo yaṅlukoḥ' (7.4.82) ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ| `toṣṭūyate' iti| `ṣṭuñ‌ stutau' (dhā.pā.1043), `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' (7.4.61) iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ| `cīyāt‌, stūyāt‌' iti| āśiṣi liṅ‌| `prakṛtya' iti| pūrvavallyap‌| sa ca `kṛdatiṅ‌' (3.1.93) iti kṛtsaṃjñakaḥ| nanu ca dīrghaśrutyā'jityetasminnupasthite tenāṅgaṃ viśiṣyate tatra viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirityajantasyāṅgasya dīrghatvena bhavitavyamiti, iha `hrasvasya piti kṛti' (6.1.71) tuki kṛte'jantatā nāsti, tataścānajantatatvādeva dīrghatvena bhavitavyamiti, iha `hrasvasya piti kṛti' (6.1.71) tuki kṛte'jantatā nāsti, tataścānajantatvādeva dīrghatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati, kimetannivṛttyarthenākṛdgrahaṇena? ityata āha--`paratvāt‌' ityādi| tuko'vakāśaḥ--agniciditi, dīrghasyāvakāśaḥ--cīyata iti; prakṛtya, prahṛtaya--ityatrobhayaprāptau sati, asatyakṛdgrahaṇe paratvāddīrghatvena tugbādhyeta| tasmādakṛdgrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌| `cinuyāt‌' iti| vidhyādiliṅ‌, sa ca `tiṅaśitsārvadhātukam‌' (3.4.113) iti sārvadhātukasaṃjñakaḥ| `uruyā, dhṛṣṇuyā' iti| uru dhuṣṇuśabdayostṛtīyaikavacane `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) ityādinā yābhāvaḥ|| 26. cvau ca| (7.4.26) `śucīkaroti' iti| `ubhūtatadbhāve' (5.4.50) ityādinā cviḥ| cakāraḥ pūrvāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ|| 27. rīḍṛtaḥ| (7.4.27) yigrahaṇamanuvarttate, akṛtsārvadhātukayoriti ca| `mātrīyati' iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8)| `pitrīyate' iti| `karttuḥ kyaṅ salopaśca' (3.1.11) iti kyaṅ‌| `cekrīyate' iti| karoteryaṅ‌| `pitryam‌' iti| `pituryacca' (4.3.79) iti yatpratyayaḥ; rīṅādeśe kṛte `yasyeti ca' (6.4.148) itīkāralopaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ kṅitotyucayamāne tatrādeśo bhavati? ityāha--`kṅitītyetadiha nivṛttam‌' iti| yadyevaṃ yigrahaṇasyāpi nivṛttiḥ prāpnoti, tadekayoganirdiṣṭatvāt‌? naitadasti; svaritatvapratibaddhā hi śabdānāmanuvṛttiḥ| iha ca yigrahaṇasyaiva svaritatvaṃ pratijñāyata iti tadevānuvarttate, kṅidgrahaṇasya svaritatvaṃ na pratijñāyata iti na tadihānuvarttate| `cekīryate' iti| `kṛ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1409), `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttve raparatvam‌| `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ| `nijegilyate' iti| `gṝ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410), `lupasada' (3.1.24) ityādinā yaṅ‌, `yo yaṅi' (8.2.20) iti latvaṃ rephasya| atha dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na riṅityevocyeta, `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) itidīrghatvenaiva siddhamiti, tatrāpyayamarthaḥ--uttarasūtre punā riṅgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, etadeva hi tatrānuvarttiṣyate? na sidhyati; nāprāpte dīrghatve riṅārabhyamāṇastasya bādhakaḥ syāt‌| bhavatu nāma ṛkārasya yo dīrghastasya bādhakaḥ, yastu kṛta ādeśe sthānyantarasya prāpnoti tasya kathaṃ bādhakaḥ, na hyasmin‌ prāpte riṅārabhyate? evaṃ tarhi mandadhiyāṃ sukhapratipattyartha dīrghoccāraṇam‌| ṅakāro'ntyādeśārthaḥ|| 28. riṅ‌ śayagliṅakṣu| (7.4.28) atrāpi yigrahaṇam‌, akṛtsārvadhātukaṃ cānuvarttate| tatra sambhavavyabhicārālliṅa eva viśeṣaṇām‌ na śayakoḥ| `ādriyate, ādhriyate' iti| `dṛṅ‌ ādare' (dhā.pā.1411), `dhṛṅ‌ avasthāne' (dhā.pā.1412) āṅpūrvaḥ, tudāditvācchaḥ| `kriyāt‌' iti| `āśiṣi liṅ‌' (3.3.173)| `bibhṛyāt‌' iti| atra bidhyādiliṅ‌, juhotyāditvāt‌ śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌, `bhṛñāmit‌' (7.4.76) itīttvamabhyāsasya| `kṛpīṣṭa' iti| `āśiṣi liṅ‌' (3.3.173)| `uśca' (1.2.12) iti kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ|| 29. guṇo'rtisaṃyogādyoḥ| (7.4.29) `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.936), `ṛ sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098,1099)--ityetayorbhovādikajauhotyādikayorgrahaṇam‌| `chandovat‌ sūtrāṇi bhavanti' (ma.bhā.) ityataḥ `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.73) iti śayo lukaṃ kṛtvā'rttiti nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ; anyathā hi yadyucchatīti nirdeśaḥ kriyeta, evaṃ sati jauhotyādikasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌| athāpīyarttinirdeśaḥ kriyate, evamapi bhauvādikasya grahaṇaṃ na syāt‌| `ṛ' ityetannirdeśastu na kṛtaḥ, vaicitryārthaḥ| pūrveṇa riṅaḥ prāptasyāyamapavādaḥ| `śa ityasambhavānnivṛttam‌' iti| asambhavastvarttisaṃyogādyoraśavikaraṇatvāt‌| `aryate' iti| yak‌| `aryāt‌' iti| āśiṣi liṅ‌| atha saṃskriyate, saṃskriyādityatra kasmānna bhavati, bhavati hi karotirapi suṭi kṛte saṃyogādyaṅgam‌? ityata āha--`ihetyādi| bahiraṅgatvaṃ tu suṭo dvipadāśrayatvāt‌| guṇasya punarantaraṅgatvamekapadāśrayatvāt‌| `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) iti suṭo'siddhatvāt‌ saṃyogāditvamaṅgasya nāsti| athāpi kathañcit‌ suṭasiddhatvaṃ syāt‌, evamapyabhaktatvāt‌ suṭaḥ saṃyogāditvaṃ nāsti, ato guṇo na pravarttate| aṅgādhikārādaṅgāvayavaḥ saṃyogo gṛhyate| na hyatrābhaktatve suṭo'ṅgāvayavaḥ saṃyoga upapadyate| `iyṛyāt‌' iti| `ṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098), vidhyādiliṅ‌| juhotyāditvācchapaḥ śluḥ, `ślau' (6.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌, `arttipiparttyośca' (7.4.77) ityabhyāsasyettvam‌, `abhyāsasyāsavarṇe' (6.4.78) tīyaṅ‌, `liṅaḥ salaupo'nantyasya' (7.2.79) iti salopaḥ| `arttisaṃyogādyorat‌' iti karttavye guṇa grahaṇaṃ vaicitryārtham‌|| 30. yaṅi ca| (7.4.30) pūravema prāptasya rīṅo'yamapavādaḥ| `arāryate' iti| yaṅa guṇaḥ, raparatvam‌| `ajāderdvitīyasya (6.1.2) iti dvirvacanam‌; halādiśeṣaḥ, `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) iti dīrghatvam‌| nanu cārtterahalāditvādyaṅa na prāpnoti? ityata āha--`artteḥ' ityādi| bhavatu nāmopasaṃkhyānādyaṅ‌, rephādeśtu dvirvacanena na bhavitavyam‌, `na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' (6.1.3) iti pratiṣedhāt‌? ityata āha--`na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' iti| uktaṃ hi tatara--yakāraparasya rephasya pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| tasmādrephāderyaṃ ityetasya dvirvacanaṃ bhavati| `jaṅghanyate' iti| `nugato'nunāsikāntasya' (7.4.85) iti nuk‌, `abhyāsācca' (7.3.55) iti kutvam‌|| 31. ī ghradhmoḥ| (7.4.31) atra dīrghoccāraṇaṃ kimartham‌, dīrgho yathā syāt‌, hrasvo mā bhūt‌? naitadasti; hrasvasyāpi hi vidhāne akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ' (7.4.25) ityevaṃ sidhyati, `cvau ca' (7.4.26) iti yathāyogaṃ dīrgho bhaviṣyati? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--`saṃjñāpūrvako vidhiranityaḥ' (vyā.pa.64) iti| tena svāyambhuvamiti siddhaṃ bhavati|| 32. asya cvau| (7.4.32) `cvau ca' (7.4.26) iti dīrghasyāpavādaḥ|| 33. kyaci c‌| (7.4.33) `akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ' (7.4.25) ityasyāyamapavādaḥ| cakāraḥ `asya' (7.4.32) śyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| atha pṝthagyogakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, nāsya `ccikyacoḥ' ityekayoga eva kriyatām‌? ityata āha--`pṛthagyogakaraṇam‌' ityādi| `na cchandasyaputramya' (7.4.35) ityevamādyuttarakāryaṃ kyaci yathā syāt‌, cvau mā bhūt‌--ityevamartho yogavibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ|| 34. aśanāyodanyadhanāyābubhukṣāpipāsāgarthaiṣu| (7.4.34) bhoktumicchā bubhukṣā| pātumicchā pipāsā| gardhanaṃ gardhaḥ| abhikāṅkṣetyarthaḥ|| 35. na cchandasyaputrasya| (7.4.35) `kyaci yaduktaṃ tannabhavati' iti| kiṃ punastat‌? ityāha--`dīrghatvamītvañca' iti| nanu ca `anantarasya vidhirvā bhanata pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) ityanantarasya ītvasya pratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌, na tu vyavahitasya dīrghatvasya? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `aśvādhasyāt‌' (7.4.37) ityaśvāghayorādvacanaṃ jñāpakam‌--dīrghatvasyāpyayaṃ pratiṣedho bhavatīti; anyathā dīrghatvenaiva siddhatvādākārakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `mitrayuḥ' iti| `kyācchandasi' (3.2.170) ityupratyayaḥ; `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ| `aputrādīnāmiti vaktavyam‌' ti| putrādīnāṃ pratiṣedho na bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`kyaci ca' (7.4.33) ityasyānantaraṃ putrasyeti vaktavyam‌, kimarthamidam‌? `nacchandasi' iti pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyati tadbādhanārtham‌| evaṃ `aputrasya' iti nañ‌ uccārayitavyo na bhavati| tadidaṃ `kyaci ca' (7.4.33) ityasyānantaraṃ putrasyeti vaktavye yadihāputrasyeti vacanaṃ tat‌ pūtrādīnāṃ pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamartham‌| etacca putrasyopalakṣaṇatvāllabhyate|| 36. durasyurdraviṇasyurvṛṣaṇyatiriṣaṇyati| (7.4.36) 37. aśvāghasyāt‌| (7.4.37) `etadevādvavacanaṃ jñāpakam‌' ityādi| kathaṃ kṛtvā jñāpakam‌? yadi `na cchandasi' (7.4.35) ityanantarasyaivetvasyāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ tadā'dvacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) ityanenaiva siddhatvāt‌, kṛtañca, tasmādetajjñāpayati--dīrghasyāpyayaṃ pratiṣedho bhavatīti|| 38. devasumnayoryajuṣi kāṭhake| (7.4.38) `na cchandasi' (7.4.35) iti pratiṣedhe prāpte devasumnayoridamārabhyata ādvacanam‌| `kāṭhake' iti| yajuṣa evaitadviśeṣaṇam‌| kaṭhasyedaṃ yajuḥ kāṭhakam‌--`gotracaraṇādvañ‌' (4.3.126)|| 39. kāvyadhvarapṛtanasyaciṃ lopaḥ| (7.4.39) `kāvyantaḥ' iti| `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) lopaḥ| kyajantācchatṛpratyayaḥ, tadantājjasa|| 40. dyatisyatimāsthāmiti kiti| (7.4.40) chandasi, yajuṣi, ṛcīti sarva nivṛttam‌; tena sāmānyenāyaṃ vidhiḥ| `do avakhaṇḍane' (dhā.pā.1148), `ṣo antakarmaṇi' (dhā.pā.1147)| `mā māne' (dhā.pā.1062), `māṅa māne' (dhā.pā.1142), `meṅapraṇidāne' (dhā.pā.961)--`gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' (vyā.pa.124) iti trayāṇāmapi grahaṇam‌| `ṣṭhā gatinivṛttau' (dhā.pā.928)| tatrādyasya `do dadghoḥ' (7.4.46) iti dattve prāpte śeṣāṇāṃ `ghumāsthā' (6.4.66) ityādisūtreṇa īttve prāpta ittvaṃ vidhīyate|| `avadāya' iti| pūrvavat‌ ktvo lyap‌| `avadātā' iti| tṛc‌| dyatisyatati śtipā nirdeśo'yaṃ yaṅalugnivṛttyarthaḥ| tena tayoryathāprāptameva bhavati--dādattaḥ, dādattavān‌, sāsītaḥ, sāsītavān‌| taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham‌, na tu dīrghanivṛttyartham‌| `bhāvyamāno'ṇ‌ savarṇānna gṛhṇāti' (vyā.pa.35) iti dīrghasyāprāpteḥ|| 41. śācchoranyatarasyām‌| (7.4.41) `śo tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1145), `cho chedane' (dhā.pā.1146)| `śyaterittvaṃ vrate nityam‌' iti| brata iti nottarapadaṃ gṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi? viṣayaḥ| vrataviṣaye śyaternityamittvaṃ bhavati| `saṃśito brāhmaṇaḥ' iti| ācāraviśeṣe vratākhye yatnavānevocyate saṃśitavrata iti| saṃśitaṃ yatnena samyak‌ pratipāditaṃ vrataṃ yasya yena vā sa evamucyate| nanu ca vrataviṣaye vidhauyamānenettvenaiva vratasya dyotitatvād‌vrataśabdasya prayogo na prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; anyatra hītvaṃ bhavatyeva, vrate tu nityamākhyāyate, so'yaṃ sāmānyaśabdo bhavati| atra viśeṣārtho vrataśbdaḥ prayujyate| paranipātastvāhitagnyāditvāddraṣṭavyaḥ| `vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt‌ siddham‌ iti| etadāgamavākyena draḍhayitumāha--`devatrātaḥ' ityādi| `traiṅ‌ pālane' (dhā.pā.965), ktaḥ| `nudavidondatrāghrahrībhyo'nyatarasyām‌' (8.2.56) iti saṃjñāviṣaye natvaṃ na bhavatyeva--devaistrāto devatrātaḥ, devaśabdo'tra saṃjñopalakṣaṇārthaḥ| kevalasyāpi trātaśabdasya saṃjñāyāṃ na natvaṃ pratipadyate| evaṃ sajñāyā anyatrobhayaṃ bhavati--trāṇaḥ, prāta iti| `galaḥ' iti| girateḥ pacādyac‌| `gro yaṅi' (8.3.20), `aci vibhāṣā' (8.2.21) iti prāṇyaṅge nityaṃ latvam‌--gala iti| viṣe tu bhavatyeva--gara iti| `grāhaḥ' iti| grāheḥ `vibhāṣā grahaḥ' (3.1.143) iti ṇapratyayaḥ| jalacare nakre nityaṃ ṇapratyayo bhavati--grāha iti| ādityasomādiṣu pacādyajbhavatyeva--graha iti| `itiyoge ca sadvidhirna bhavati' iti| varṣatīti dhāvati, hantīti palāyate iti--`lakṣamahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ' (3.2.123) iti satsaṃjñakau śatṛśānacāvitiyoge na bhavata eva, vyavasthitavibhāṣayā| tatra `nanvorvibhāṣā' (3.2.121) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate--arjayan‌ vasati, adhīyāno vasati| tatrāsatīti yoge nityāveva tau bhavataḥ| nanu cetiśabdenaiva hetvarthasya dyotitatvādvarṣatīti, hantītyevamādau sadvidhirna bhaviṣyati, yatra tvitiśabdo na prayujyate tatra bhavatyeva--arjayan‌ vasatītyādau, tadatra vibhāṣādhikāranantareṇāpi vibhāṣā labhyata eva; ato vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ nānuvarttyameva, tasmādanudāharaṇametad‌vyavasthitavibhāṣāyāḥ? idaṃ tarhyudāharaṇam‌--kariṣyāmīti vrajatīti| atra `lṛṭ‌ śeṣe ca' (3.3.13) iti cakārāt‌ kriyāyāmupapade kriyārthāyāṃ lṛṭ‌, tasya lṛṭaḥ sadvidhirna bhaviṣyatīti; vyavasthitavibhāṣayā| aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇenetiyogādanyatra nityaṃ bhavati--kariṣyantaṃ paśyeti, prathamāsamānādhikaraṇe tu vikalpaḥ--brāhmaṇaḥ kariṣyan‌ brāhmaṇaḥ kariṣyatīti| `mithaḥ' ityādi| mitha iti sahabhāvena| devatrātagalagrāhādayastrāṇagaragrahādibhiḥ sahaikasmin‌ viṣaye vikalpena nānvākhyāyanta ityarthaḥ| `gavākṣaḥ' iti| `sarvatra vibhāṣā goḥ' (6.1.122) ityanuvarttamāne `avaṅ‌ sphoṭāyanasya' (6.1.123) iti vātāyane nityamavaṅ‌ bhavati, prāṇyaṅgo tu go'kṣamityatra na bhavati; anyatrobhayam‌--gavākṣam‌, go'kṣamiti| `saṃśitavrataḥ' iti| vrate nitayamittvam‌| anyatra vikalpena--niśitam‌, niśātaṃ śastram‌| tīkṣṇamityarthaḥ| tadetat‌ sarvaṃ vyavasthitavibhāṣayā labhyate| kvacidvidhireva, kvacit‌ pratiṣedha eva, kvacidubhayamapītyevaṃvidhā vividhārthe sthitāṃ vibhāṣā vyavasthitavibhāṣā| etacca vividhamavasthānamākṛtau padārthe veditavyam‌| tatra hi sarva lakṣyarāśimekīkṛtyābhisaṃkṣipya tadubhayamupadiśyate| vidhiḥ pratiṣedhaśca jātau padārtha ubhayamapi bhavatītyetāvato'rthasya pratipādane śāstrasya vyāpāraḥ| yastu kvacidarthe vidhireva, kvicit‌ pratiṣedha eva, kvacidubhayamityasaṅkareṇa vyavasthānam‌, etaccāvicchinnācāryapāramparyopadeśāllabhyate|| 42. dadhāterhiḥ| (7.4.42) dhumāsthā' (6.4.66) iti sūtreṇettve prāpte dadhāterhirādeśo vidhīyate| śtipā nirdeśo yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ| tena yaṅlugantasya hirādeśo na bhavati--dādhītaḥ, dādhītavān‌, dādhītveti|| 43. jahīteśca ktvi| (7.4.43) pūrvavadīttve prāpte ktvāpratyaye hirādeśo vidhīyate| yadyapi `hi gatau' (dhā.pā.1257) ityasyāpi hitveti sidhyati, tathāpi jahāterikāranivṛttyartha vacanam‌| atha kimarthaṃ jahāteriti śtipā nirdeśaḥ, na `haḥ' evocyate? ityāha--`jahāteḥ' ityādi| etena `ohāṅ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.1089) ityasya nivṛttye nirdeśaḥ kriyata iti darśayati| yadi hi `haḥ' iti nirdeśaḥ syāt‌, tadā tasya sādhāraṇatvājjihāterapi syāt‌| jahāteriti śtipā nirdeśe tu na bhavati| anena jahātireva nirdiśyate, na jihātiḥ| na hi tasyaivaṃvidho nirdeśe yaṅlugantasya na bhavati--jāhātveti| ītvamapyatra na bhavati; tadvidhāvapi śtipā nirdeśāt‌| atra ceṭi kṛte `āto lopa iṭi ca' (3.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ|| 44. vibhāṣā chandasi| (7.4.44) 45. sudhitavasudhitanemadhitadhiṣvadhiṣīya ca| (7.4.45) cakāreṇa chandasītyanukṛṣyate| `iḍāgamo vā' iti| yadeḍāgamastadā `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ| `sudhitam‌' iti, `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) iti samāsaḥ| `vasudhitam‌' iti| viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ| pūrvavadākāralopaḥ| `nemadhitam‌' iti| `sāmi' (2.1.27) iti dvitīyāsamāsaḥ| sāmīti tatrārthagrahaṇamityuktam‌| nemaśabdaścāyaṃ sāmiśabdaparyāyaḥ| `dhiṣva' iti| `thāsaḥ se' (3.4.80), `savābhyāṃ vāmau' (3.4.91) iti vakāraḥ| `dvirvacanābhāvaḥ' iti| `ślau' (6.4.112) ityakāralopaḥ; ghakārasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌--takāraḥ, `dadhastathośca' (8.2.38) ityabhyāsasya bhaṣbhāvena dhakāraḥ| `dhiṣīya' iti| āśiṣi liṅ‌, `iṭo't‌' (3.4.106) ityattvam‌|| 46. do dadghoḥ| (7.4.46) chandasīti nivṛttam‌; pūrvasūtre cakāreṇānukṛṣṭatvāt‌| `dattaḥ dattavān‌' iti| ktaktavatū| `dattiḥ' iti| ktin‌| `dhītaḥ, dhītavān‌' iti| pūrvavadīttvam‌| atha `dadhāterhiḥ' (7.4.42) iti hirādeśaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`gheṭa etadrūpam‌' ityādi| `dheṭ‌ pāne' (dhā.pā.902) ityasya rūpam‌, na dadhāteḥ| tena hirādeśo na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| `dātam‌' iti| `dāp‌ lavane' (dhā.pā.1059) ityetasyaitadrūpam‌; tasya ghusaṃjñā nāsti; `adāp‌' (1.1.20) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| `do dadghoḥ' iti jaśtvenāyaṃ nrdeśaḥ, tatra na jñāyate--kiṃ takakārānto'yamādeśaḥ? āhosviddakārāntaḥ? uta dhakārāntaḥ? atha thakārānta iti vā?--iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`ayamādeśaḥ' ityādi| kathaṃ jñāyate? ityāha--`evaṃ hyuktam‌' ityādi| yadyayamādeśastakārāntaḥ syāt, sudattetyatra `ikaḥ kāśe' (6.3.123) ityanuvarttamāne `dāsti' (6.3.124) itī dīrghatvaṃ syāt‌| atha dakārāntaḥ, tadā `radābhyām‌' (8.2.42) iti niṣṭhānatvaṃ syāt‌| atha dhakārāntaḥ, tadā `jhaṣastathorgho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti jhaṣantāddhatvamāpadyeta niṣṭhātakārasya| `thānte'doṣaḥ' iti| naño'tra praśleṣaḥ| thānte doṣo nāstotyarthaḥ| `tasmāt‌' ityādi| yasmāt‌ triṣu pūrṣakeṣu pakṣeṣu doṣaḥ, tasmātthānto'yamādeśaḥ| udāharaṇe dattaḥ, dattavāniti `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvama--thasya taḥ| `yadi tu' ityādi| dvau pakṣau bhādhye `dasti' (6.3.124) ityatra darśitau--`dā' ityetasmiṃstakārādau, takārānte veti| tatra yadi takārānte `dā' ityetasmin‌ dīrghatvaṃ bhavatīti--eṣa pakṣa āśrīyate, tadaiva dīrghatvaprāptidoṣaḥ| yadi tu takārādau `dā' ityetasmin‌ dīrghatvaṃ bhavatīti--eṣa pakṣa āśrīyate, tadā tānte'pyadoṣaḥ| yatra takārāditvam‌, `dā' ityetasya, tatra dīrghatvaṃ bhavata--nīttam‌, vīttamityādau, na tu sudattādau| tasmāt‌ pākṣiko dīrghaprāptidoṣaḥ| `dāntadhāntayorapi' ityādi| takārādisanniyogena hi dāntadhāntāvādeśāvimau vihitau notsahete tadvighātanimittatāmupagantum‌| tasmāddāntadhāntayorapyadoṣaḥ| `avadattam‌' ityādi| ādikarmaṇi-kriyārambhe| ādibhūtakriyākṣaṇa ityarthaḥ| atra `aca upasargāttaḥ' (7.4.47) iti takārādeśe prāpta ete'vadattādayo nipātyante| `ādikarmaṇi' iti ca sarveṣāṃ viśeṣaṇam‌, na tu pradattamityasyaiva| ādikarmaṇo'nyatra `aca upagargāttaḥ' (7.4.47) iti takārādeśo bhavati, na tu dadbhāvaḥ--avattam‌, vīttam‌, sūttam‌, anūttamiti| `anupasargāḥ' ityādi| atha vā--avādayo dadātiṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñakā eva na bhavanti; tadvācyāyāḥ kriyayā anyā yā kriyā gamirvācyā tadviṣayatvāt‌--avagataṃ dattamavadattamityevamanyatrāvagantavyam‌| tasmād‌ gamiṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñakā ete, na dadātiṃ prati| tathā hyuktam‌--yaṃ prati kriyāyṛktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati gatyupasargasaṃjñakā bhavantīti| tasmādupasargasaṃjñāyā abhāvānnaivātra takāraḥ prasajediti kiṃ nipātanena!|| 47. aca upasargāttaḥ| (7.4.47) dadādeśasyāyamapavādaḥ| `ta ityayamādeśo bhavati' iti| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| prattamityādāvākārasya takāre kṛte dakārasya cartvam‌--takāraḥ `nīttam‌' iti| `dasti' (6.3.124) iti dīrghatvam‌| `avadāttam‌' iti| `daip‌ śodhane' (dhā.pā.924) ityetasyaitadrūpam‌| `āderalaḥ prāpnoti' iti| `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti vacanāt‌| `aca ityetaddvirāvarttayitavyam' iti| `acaḥ' ityetasya dvirāvṛttāvaco'ca iti dve śabdarūpe bhavataḥ| tatraikaṃ pañcamyantam‌; aparaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantam‌| tatraikenopasargo viśiṣyate--ajantādupasargāditi| itareṇāpi sthānī nirdiśyata ityevamākārasyāyamādeśo bhavati| `dvitakāro vā' iti| atha vā--`aca upasargāttaḥ' iti| dvitakāra eva saṃyogādeśo nirdiśyate, tenāsyānekāstvāt‌ sarvasyaiva bhavati, yadi tarhi dvitakārako'yaṃ nirdeśastadā `apo bhi' (7.4.48) ityanenāpi sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti, nekāltvādityāha--`aṣo bhi' ityādi| `apo bhi' ityatra pañcamyantamaca ityanuvarttate, tena satyapyanekāltve `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti pakāramātrasya bhaviṣyati, na sarvasyeti| `dyateḥ' ityādi| dyaterityasyāvakāśaḥ--yatrājanta upasargo na bhavati--nirditam‌, durditamiti; asyādeśasyāvakāśaḥ--ajantādupasargāt‌ paro yo'nyo ghusaṃjñakaḥ--`ḍudāñ‌ dāne' (dhā.pā.1091), avattam‌, parīttamiti; ajantādupasargāduttarasya dyaterubhayaprasaṅge sati takāra eva bhavati vipratiṣedhena--avattam‌, prattamiti|| 48. apo bhi| (7.4.48) `adbhiḥ' iti| `jhalāṃ jaśo'nte' (8.2.39) iti jaśtvam‌--takārasya dakāraḥ| `dvitakārapakṣe tu pūrvasyāpi `jhalāṃ jaśjhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvam--dakāraḥ| `jharo jhari savaṇaṃ' (8.4.65) iti pūrvadakāralopaḥ| `suvaḥ' [`svavaḥ' iti| kāśikā] ityādi| suvas‌, svatavas‌, māsa, uvas‌--ityeteṣāṃ ca bhakārādau paratasta ityayamādeśa iṣyate cchandasi viṣaye| sa ca `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) ityanenaiva labhyata iti veditavyam‌|| 49. saḥ syārdhadhātuke| (7.4.49) atrāpi dvitakārapakṣe'nekāltvāt‌ sarvādeśaḥ prāpnoti, tasmāt‌ `acaḥ' iti| pañ‌camyantamanuvarttanīyamiti| atha vā--`nirdiśyamānasyādeśā bhavanti' (vyā.pa.106) iti sakārasyaiva bhaviṣyati| `vatsyati' iti| `vasanivāse' (dhā.pā.1942)| `jighatsati' iti| adeḥ san‌, `luṅsanorghaslṛ' (2.4.37) iti tasya ghaslādeśaḥ| `vakṣyati' iti| `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1842), `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌| `ghāsaḥ, vāsaḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ‌, `ghañapośca' (2.4.38) ityaderghaslādeśaḥ| `āsse, vasse' iti| `āsa upaveśane' (dhā.pā.1021), `vasa ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1023), anudāttettvādātmanepadam‌, `cāsaḥ se' (3.4.80), adāditvācchapo luk‌| atha `saḥ syatiṅ‌' iti kasmānnoktam‌? naivaṃ śakyam‌; ihāpi na syāt‌--vyativatsīṣṭhā iti|| 50. tāsastyorlopaḥ| (7.4.50) `anadyatane luṭ‌' (3.3.15) tāsiḥ, sip‌| `karttāse' iti| `thāsaḥ se' (3.4.80)| `tvamasi' iti| `sa bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065), pūrvavacchapo luk| `vyatise' iti| `karttari karmavyatīhāre' (1.3.14) ityātmanepadaṃ bhavati| `thāsaḥ se' (3.4.80), `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ| atha `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`asterakārasakārayoḥ' ityādi| akārasakārayorhi luptayoḥ pratyayamātramavaśiṣyate, tadeva padama, ataḥ `sātpadādyoḥ' (8.3.111) iti pratiṣedhāt‌ ṣatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ|| 51. ri ca| (7.4.51) `karttārau, karttāraḥ' iti| luṭ‌, tas‌, jhiḥ, `luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ' (2,4,85) iti taso jheśca yathākramaṃ raurasau bhavataḥ| `adhyetārau, adhyetāraḥ' iti| iṅo ṅittvādatmanepadam‌ ātām‌, jhaḥ tayośca pūrvavadraurasau| aste rephādipratyayo na sambhavatīti nāstyudāharaṇam‌| kecittu--`vyatire' ityudāharaṇaṃ darśayanti; etacca cchabdasyevaṃ prayogo yadyasati tato yuktam‌, atha tu nāstyevaṃ satyayuktam‌| `irayo re' (6.4.76) iti rebhāvaśchandasi vidhīyate, `yathādṛṣṭānuvidhiśchandasi' (vyā.pa.68) iti| cakāraḥ pūrvāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ|| 52. ha eti| (7.4.52) `karttāhe' iti| kṛño luṭ‌, ātmanepedam‌, uttamapuruṣaikavacanam‌, iṭ, ṭeettvam‌| atra sakārasyānena haḥ| `vyatihe' iti| asteḥ `karttari karmavyatihāre' (1.4.14) ityātmanepadam‌, pūrvavadakāralopaḥ| `eti' iti| taparakaraṇaṃ saptamyāmayādeśaparīhārārtham‌| ayādeśe hi sati sandehaḥ syāt‌--kasyāyaṃ nirdeśa iti--kimayādeśasya? athaikārasya?|| 53. yīvarṇayorddīdhīvevyoḥ| (7.4.53) svaritatvāllopo'nuvarttate, na tvanantaro hakāraḥ, tasyāsvaritatvāpratijñānāt‌| yakāre tvikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| yiśca ivurṇaśca tau yovarṇau tayoḥ parataḥ `dīdhīṅ‌ dīptidevanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1076) `vevīṅ‌ vetināṃ tulye' (dhā.pā.1077)--ityanayorlopo bhavati, sa ca `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityantyasya| yakārādau śravaṇe prāpta ivarṇādau `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) iti yaṇādeśe prāpte lopavacanamidam‌| `ādīdhya, āvevya' iti| lyap‌| `ādīdhyata, āvevita' iti| `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityātmanepadam‌, `sārvadhātuke yak‌' (3.1.67)| `ādīdhita, āvevita' iti| `bhāvakarmaṇoḥ' (1.3.13) ityātmanepadam‌, `sārvadhātuke yak‌' (3.1.67)| `ādīdhita, āvevita' iti| tṛc‌| `ādīdhyanamādevyanam‌' iti| lyuṭ‌, `daudhīvevīṭām' (1.1.6) iti guṇaniṣedhādyaṇādeśaḥ| atra yadyapi nimittyoḥ kāryiṇoḥ samānatvam‌, tathāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ na bhavati; asvaratatvāt‌| varṇagrahaṇamivarṇe śrūyamāṇe yathā syāt‌, iha mā bhūt‌--ādīdhayateḥ, āvevayaterṇijantāṇṇavul‌, ādīdhyakaḥ, ādevyakaḥ| atra hi nityatvāṇṇilope kṛte pratyayalopalakṣaṇana (1.1.62) prāpnoti, ato varṇagrahaṇānna bhavati|| 54. sani mīmāghurabhalabhaśakapatapadāmaca iś‌| (7.4.54) `saḥ syārdhadhātuke' (7.4.49) ityataḥ sītyanuvarttate, tacca sona viśeṣaṇam‌| `mīti mīnātiminatyoḥ' iti| `mīñ‌ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1476), `ḍumiñ‌ prakṣepaṇe' (dhā.pā.1250)--ityetayoḥ| nanu ca `mī' ityetasminnuccāryamāṇe minotergrahaṇaṃ nopapadyate? naivam‌; asyāpi `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghatve kṛte mītyevaṃ rūpaṃ bhavati| evamapi lakṣaṇapratipadoktapibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.3) tasya grahaṇaṃ nopapadyate? naitadasti; atra hi ghusaṃjñakatvāt‌ `ghu' ityasya pūrvanipātamakurvataitat‌ sūcitam‌--yathā pūrvanipāta iha nāpekṣyate, tathānyadapi kiñcicchāstrīyaṃ vacanamiti| teneyaṃ paribhāṣā nāpekṣyata iti yuktaṃ minoterapi grahaṇam‌| `mā hi gāmādāgrahaṇeṣvaviśeṣaḥ' iti| meṅaprabhṛtīnāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ trayāṇāṃ grahaṇam‌| `ghu' iti ghusaṃjñakau `dā' `dhā'--ityatau gṛhyate| `rabha rābhasye' (dhā.pā.974), `ḍulabhaṣ‌ prāptau' (dhā.pā.975), `śaklṛ śaktau' (dhā.pā.1261), `śala hula patlṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.843,844,845), `pada gatau' (dhā.pā.1169)--eṣāmacaḥ sthāne sakārādau pratyaye sanīs‌ bhavati| aca ityasya grahaṇaṃ sarvādeśo mā bhūdityevamartham‌| asati hi tasminnanekāltvāt‌ sarvādeśaḥ syāt‌| `pramitsani' iti| `atra lopo'byāsasya' (7.4.58) ityabhyāsalopaḥ, `saḥ syārdhadhātuke' (7.4.49) iti tasya saḥ| `apamitsate' iti| `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam‌| evaṃ āripsate' `ālipsate' ityatrāpi| `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌--bhakārasya pakāraḥ, `tkoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti salopaḥ|| 55. āpjñapyṛdhāmīt‌| (7.4.55) `īpsati' iti| `āplṛ vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1260)| `jñīpsati' iti| `jñā avabodhane' (dhā.pā.1507), ṇic‌, `artti' (7.3.36) ityādinā puk‌, `māraṇatopaṇaniśāmaneṣu jñā' (dhā.pā.811) `micca' iti mitsaṃjñāyāṃ hrasvaḥ, `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopaḥ| `īrtsati' iti| `ṛdhu vṛddhau' (dhā.1271), īkāraḥ, raparatvaṃ ca, śrakārasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌--takāraḥ| iha ca jñāpināṅgenājviśeṣayitavyaḥ, na tvacā jñāpiḥ, vyabhicārābhāvāt‌| na hi jñaparajantatāṃ vyabhicarati| aci tu jñapināṅgena viśiṣyamāṇe sarvasya jñapisambandhino'ca īttvena bhavitavyam‌, tathā ca ṇerapīttve kṛte jñīpsatīti na sidhyedityetaccodyamāśaṅkyāha--`jñaperdvāvacau' ityādi| tatrettvāsyāvakāśo'jādyaḥ, ṇilopasyāvakāśaḥ--kāraṇā, hāraṇā; dvitīyasyāca ubhayaprasaṅge ṇilopa eva bhavati pūrvavipratiṣedhena--jñīpsatīti| `itarasya' iti| akārasya| `ardidhiṣati' iti| laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, raparatvam‌, `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) iti `dhi' ityetad‌dvirucyate| rephasya tu dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati; `na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' (6.1.3) iti pratiṣedhāt‌| abhyāsasya jaśtvam‌--jakāraḥ| takāro mukhasukhārthaḥ|| 56. dambha icca| (7.4.56) contin... 56. dambha icca| (7.4.56) `dhipsati, dhīpsati' iti| `danbhu dambhe' (dhā.pā.1270)| tasya yadā `sanīvantardha' (7.2.49) ityādineṇna kriyate, sani sakārādāvikāraḥ, īkāraśca, `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti kittvādanunāsikalopaḥ, bhakārasya carttve pakāraḥ|| 57. muco'karmakasya guṇo vā| (7.4.57) `mokṣate' iti| `muclū mokṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1430)| `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌; `iṇkoḥ' (8.3.57) iti ṣatvam‌, `karmavatkarmaṇā' (3.1.87) ityadinā karmavadatideśādātmanepadam‌| `svayameva' iti vacanaṃ karmakarttṛtvapradarśanārtham‌| vatsaṃ moktumicchati, sa moktumiṣyamāṇo muktikriyāṃ pratyānukūlyaṃ yadā pratipadyate tadā svatantratvādasmin‌ karmaṇi karttṛtvena vivakṣite mucirakarmako bhavati| atha guṇagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, nodityevocyeta? namu caidaṃ satyokāraścakārasya sthāne `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) prāpnoti, guṇagrahaṇādika eva bhavati, saṃjñāvidhāne niyamāt‌? naitadasti; aca ityanuvarttate| tenāntyasya na bhaviṣyati| evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--aca iti nivṛttamiti| tena `atra lopo'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityatrāto'bhyāsasya lopo na bhavati| sati tvajadhikāre, mā bhūt‌ tasyānuvṛttirapārthiketyaca eva lopaḥ syāt‌|| 58. atra lopo'bhyāsasya| (7.4.58) atretyanena yannirdiśyate taddarśayitumāha--`yadetat‌' ityādi| athātragrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌? `sani mīmā' (7.4.54) ityādau prakaraṇe yathā syāt‌; dadau, dadaturityādau mā bhūditi cet‌? na; yadi hyetat‌ prayojanamabhimataṃ syāt‌ `sani mīmādhurabhalabhaśakapatapadāmaca isabhyāsalopaśca' ityevamuddiśyeta, evamihaiva prakaraṇe bhadiṣyati, nānyatra, tato niṣprayojanamatragrahaṇamityata āha--`sani mīmādhurabhalabha' ityādi| `viṣayāvadhāraṇārtham‌' iti| abhyāsalopaviṣayasya niyamārthamityarthaḥ| tāmeva tasya viṣayaniyamārthatāṃ darśayitumāha--`atraiva' ityādi| atretyanenesādiviṣayo nirdiśyate| isādiviṣaya evābhyāsalopo yathā syāditi niyamena yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayitumāha--`sanvadbhāvaviṣaye na bhavati' iti| `amīmapat‌' iti| `bhīñ‌ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1476) `mīnātiminotidīṅāṃ lyapi ca' (6.1.50) ityāttvam‌, ṇic‌, pūrvavat‌ puk‌, luṅaḥ, cleścaṅ‌, ṇilopaḥ, upadhāhrasvatvam‌, dvirvacanam‌, aṭ‌, `sanvallaghuni caṅpare' (7.4.93) ityādinā sanvadbhāve `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itīttvam‌, `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghaḥ| `adīdapat‌' iti| `ḍudāñ‌ dāne' (dhā.pā.1091) pūrvavaṇṇijādiḥ| atragrahaṇādihābhyāsalopo na bhavati| kathaṃ punaḥ sanyabhyāsalopa ucyamāna iha prāpnoti, yannivṛttyarthamatragrahaṇaṃ kriyate? ityāha--`sanvallaghuni' ityādi| yathaiva hi sanvadbhāvātideśādittvaṃ bhavati, evamabhyāsalopaḥ syāt‌| ihālontyaparibhāṣayā `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) lopena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākartuṃmāha--`sarvasya' ityādi| kathaṃ punaḥ sarvasya labhyate? ityata āha--`tadarthameva' ityādi| etenaivakāreṇa viṣayāvadhāraṇārthatāṃ nirasyati| yadyevam‌, sanvadbhāvaviṣaye'pi prāpnoti? evaṃ manyate--sanvadbhāvaviṣaye'pyabhyāsalopaprasaṅgaḥ parihartu śakyate| tatra sanvaditi sanāśrayakāryamatidiśyate| na cābhyāsalopaḥ sanamevāpekṣate, kiṃ tarhi? isbhāvādikamapi| tadabhāvādasatyapyatragrahaṇe'mīmapadityādiṣvabhyāsalopo na bhaviṣyati| tasmādatiricyata evātragrahaṇamiti na karttavyameva| tat‌ kriyate--sarvasyābhyāsalopo yathā syāditi| kathaṃ punaḥ kriyamāṇe'pyatragrahaṇe sarvasya lopo labhyate? granthādhikyādarthādhikyamityeke| atragrahaṇena mahat‌ sūtraṃ prayaṇataitat‌ sūcitam‌--mahataḥ sthānino'yaṃ lopaḥ karttavyaḥ| evañcāyaṃ mahataḥ sthāninaḥ kṛto bhavati yadi sarvasyābhyāsalopaḥ kriyate, nānyathetyanye| `nānārthake'lontyavidhirityapare' iti| ke punaste? ye viṣayāvadhāraṇārthatāmatragrahaṇasya varṇayanti te veditavyāḥ| anarthakatvamabhyāsasya sthāne dvirvacanapakṣe veditavyam‌| atra hi yasya sthāne yacchabdāntaraṃ vidhīyate tat‌ samastamevārthavat‌| ekadeśastvabhyāso'narthaka eva| dviṣprayogadvirvacanapakṣe'pyanarthāntaravācitvādanarthāntaravācitvādanarthakatābhyāsasya|| 59. hvasvaḥ| (7.4.59) `ḍuḍhaukiṣate, tutraukiṣate' iti| ḍhaukṛ, traukṛ--ityetābhyāmanudāttettvādātmanepadibhyāṃ san‌, `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam‌| `aḍuḍhaukat‌, atutraukat‌' iti| ābhyāmeva ṇyantābhyāṃ luṅ‌, pūrvavaccaṅādikāryam‌| `ḍuḍhauke, tutrauke' iti| liṭa, ekavacanam‌, tasyaiś‌| `abhyāsasyānaci' ityādi| abhyāsasya yat‌ kāryaṃ vidhīyate tadanacipare bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vā caricalipatidadonāmacyākyābhyāsasya' (vā.658) ityāgamavighānasāmarthyāddhalādiśeṣeṇa na bhavitavyam‌| halādiśeṣe hi satyādeśasyāgamasya ca kaśvidviśeṣo nāstītyādeśameva vidadhyāt‌| evañca--abhyāsalopābhāvāt‌ pāriśedhyādaco'nyatraiva bhaviṣyati|| 60. halādiḥ śeṣaḥ| (7.4.60) `halādiḥ' iti| hal‌ cāsāvādiśceti halādiḥ--karmadhārayo'yam‌, na tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ--halāmādirhalādiḥ| yadi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syāt‌, tadāyamarthaḥ syāt‌--abhyāsasya yai halasteṣāmādiḥ śiṣyata iti| tathā ca--ānakṣatuḥ, ānakṣurityatra `akṣū vyāptau' (dhā.pā.654) ityasyājāditvād‌dvitīyasyaikāco'bhāvāt‌ prathamasyaikāco dvirvacane kṛte yadyapyabhyāsādiḥ kakāro na bhavati, tathāpi halādirbhavati, tasya śeṣaḥ prasajyeta| karmadhāraye tu na doṣaḥ, tatrābhyāsāpekṣaṃ halāditvaṃ vidhīyate, na cātra kakāro'bhyāsādiḥ| tasmāt‌ karmadhārayo'yam‌| `jaglau' `mamlau' iti| `glai harvakṣaye' (dhā.pā.903), `mlai gātravināme' (dhā.pā.904), `ādeca upadeśe'śiti' (6.1.45) ityāttvam‌, `āta au ṇalaḥ' (7.1.34) ityauttvam‌| `āṭatuḥ' āṭuḥ' iti| `ata ādeḥ' (7.4.70) ityabhyāsasya dīrghatve kṛte savarṇadīrghatvam‌| nanu ca śeṣo'vasthānam‌, taccāneḥ siddhameva, tatkimartha vidhīyate? ityāha--`ādiśeṣanimitto'yam‌' ityādi| ādiśaṣo nimittaṃ yasya lopasya sa tathoktaḥ| na hyatrādeḥ śeṣo vidhīyate, kiṃ tarhi? tannimitto'yamanāderlopo vidhīyate| siddha eva hyāderavasthāne halādiśeṣa itīdaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ niyamārthaṃ vijñāyate--ādereva halo'vasthānaṃ bhavati, tvanāderiti evamādiśeṣanimittamanāderadarśanaṃ vihitaṃ bhavati| yadi tarhyādiśeṣanimitto'yamanāderlopo vidhīyate, evaṃ satyāduturāṭurityatra lopo na bhavati; nimittābhāvāt‌, abhyāsasya haleva tāvadādirnāsti, kutaḥ punastasya śeṣaḥ? ityata āha--`tatra' ityādi| anādilope karttavye'bhyāsajātirāśrīyate, nābhyāsavyaktiḥ| tena yadyapi sarvāsvabhyāsavyaktiṣu halādirna varttate, tathāpi kvacidapi papācetyādau varttamāno halādiranādeḥ sarvatrāṭatuḥ, āṭurityevamādāvapi nivṛttiṃ karoti; abhyāsajāterabhinnatvāt‌| yaiva hi papācetyādāvabhyāsajātiḥ, saivāṭatuḥ āṭurityādāvapi| `apare tu' ityādi| āṭatuḥ, āṭurityādāvanāderlopaṃ pratipādayitumapare bruvata iti| śeṣaśabdo'yaṃ nāvasthānamātramāha, kiṃ tarhi? nivṛttyā viśiṣṭamavasthānam‌, yadyevam‌, avasthānasya viśeṣyatvāt‌ prādhānyam‌, nivṛttestu viśeṣaṇāvādaprādhānyam‌| tathā ca--paradhānānuyāyitvādaprādhānyaṃ guṇānām‌| yatraivābhyāsasya halāderavasthānaṃ papācetyādau, tatraidānāderhalo nivṛttyā bhavitavyam‌; tataḥ sa eva doṣaḥ--āṭatuḥ, āṭurityādāvanāderhalo nivṛttirna prāpnotīti? ata āha--`tadavasthānam‌' ityādi| yadyapi niśeṣyabhūtaṃ tadavasthānaṃ śeṣaśabdenābhidhīyata ityuktitaḥ pradhānam‌ tathāpyavidheyatvādapradhānam‌| avidheyatvaṃ tu tasya siddhatvāt‌| nivṛttareva viśeṣaṇabhūtāpi vidheyatvāt‌ pradhānam‌| tathā coktam‌--siddhamupakārakaṃ parārthamaṅgam‌, sādhyo'nupakārakastvaṅgīti kṛtvā pradhānam‌| tatra nivṛttau vidheyatvāt‌ pradhānabhūtāyāmayamasya sūtrasyārtho jāyate--`abhyāsasyānāderhalo nivṛttirbhavati' iti| tataścāsau vidheyatvāt‌ prādhānyamāpannā satī kimityāderavidheyāmapradhānabhūtāmanivṛttimapekṣidhyate| kena kāraṇenāpekṣiṣyate? na kenacidityarthaḥ| na hi pradhānasya guṇānuyāyitvaṃ yuktam‌| tasmādasatyapi halāderavasthāne'vāderlopena bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ|| 61. śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ| (7.4.61) pūrveṇa śarāṃ seṣe prāpte khayāṃ śeṣa ārabhyate| anādiśeṣaścāyamādiśeṣaṃ bādhate| na hi śarāmavasthāne khayāṃ śeṣaśabdo viśeṣaṇamupapadyate| sa hi nivṛttyā viśiṣṭamavasthānamāha--ityuktam‌| na cobhayoravasthāne nivṛttyā viśiṣṭamavasthānaṃ bhavati| tasmādādiśeṣasyāyamanādiśeṣo'pavādaḥ| `cuścotiṣati' iti| `ścutirkṣaraṇe' (dhā.pā.41), san‌, iṭ‌| `tiṣṭhāsati' iti| `ṣaṣṭhā gatinivṛttau' (dhā.pā.928)| `pispandiṣate' iti| `spadi kiñciccalane' (dhā.pā.14), anudāttet‌, iditvānnum‌, `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.4.62) ityātmanepadam‌| `sasnau' iti| `ṣṇā śauce' (dhā.pā.1052)| pūrvevaṇṇala autvam‌| `kharpūrvāḥ' ityādi| `ucicchivati' iti| `ucchī vivāse' (dhā.pā.216), san‌ uchiṣ‌ iti sthite dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, tuk‌ ca; tatra varṇāśrayeṇāntaraṅgatvāt‌ tuk‌| tasmān‌ kṛte, dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, cutvañca, tatara paratvāt dvirvacane karttavye cutvasyāsiddhatvād‌dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti chiṣ‌śabdasya| tatra chakārasya śeṣo na prāpnoti; aśarpūrvatvāt‌| na hyaṃ takāraḥ arbhavati, tataśca pūrveṇa halādiśeṣe kṛte satyabhāse takāraḥ śrūryata| athāpīdamasti--`pūrvatrāsiddhoyamadvirvacane' (jai.pa.vṛ.70) iti cutvaṃ paścād‌dvirvacanaṃ kriyate, tathāpi halādiśeṣeṇa chakāre nivṛtte `nimittāpāye naimittikasyāpyapāyaḥ' (vyā.pa.47) iti cutve nivṛtte ucicchiṣatītyatara takāra evābhyāse śrūyeta| tasmāt‌ kharpūrvāḥ khaya iti vaktavyan‌| evaṃ hi sati cchakārasya śeṣe kṛte takāro nivarttata iti na bhavatyaniṣṭaprasaṅgaḥ|| 62. kuhoścuḥ| (7.4.62) `cakhāna' iti| `khanu avadāraṇe' (dha.pā.878), dvirvacanam‌, tasya cutvam‌--chakāraḥ, `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) iti chakārasya cakāraḥ| `jaghāti' iti| `liṭyanyatarasyām‌' (2.4.40) ityaderghaslādeśaḥ, abhyāsasya cutvam‌| nādavato mahāprāṇasya sthāne tādṛśa eva jhakāraḥ, tasyāpi jaśtvam‌--jakāraḥ| `jahāra' iti| `hṛñ‌ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899)| `jihīrṣati' iti| `iko jhal‌' (1.2.9) iti sanaḥ kittvam‌, `ajjhanagamāṃ (6.4.16) iti dīrghatvam‌, `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itottvam‌, raparatvam‌, `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvam‌, hīrṣa-ityasya dvirvacanam‌|| 63. na kavateryaṅi| (7.4.63) pūrveṇa prāptasya cutvasyāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ| `kokūyate' iti| `akṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ' (7.4.25) iti dīrghaḥ, `guṇo yaṅlukoḥ' (7.4.82) ityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ| atha vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ kimarthaḥ, na `koḥ' ityevocyeta? ityata āha--`kavateḥ' ityādi| `kuṅ‌ śabde' (dhā.pā.1401) iti taudādikaḥ, `ku śabde' (dhā.pā.1042) ityādādikaḥ, `kuṅ‌' (dhā.pā.151) iti maudādikaḥ śabdārtha eva; tatra bhauvādikasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌, itarayormā bhūdityevamartho vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ| nanu cānayornivṛtteretat‌ phalam‌--cokūyata ityetadapi rūpaṃ yathā syāditi, etacca `koḥ' ityapi nirdeśe niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā kautereva niranuvandhakasya grahaṇe sati sidhyatyeva, tasmāt‌ `koḥ' ityevaṃ nirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ? naitadevam‌; satyapi hi śabdārthatve bhidyata evaiṣāmabhidheyam‌| tathā hi--kavatistāvadavyaktaśabde varttate--uṣṭraḥ kokūyata iti; kuvatirapyārttasvare varttate--cokūyate bṛṣala iti, poḍita ityarthaḥ; kautistu śabadamātre| tasmādviśiṣyaṭārthasya parigraho yathā syādityevamartho vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ| nanu lugvikaraṇaparibhāṣayā kauterna bhaviṣyatīti, tatkimarthaṃ tannivṛttayarthatā vikaraṇasyopapadyate? evaṃ manyate--kuvatinivṛttyartho'vaśyaṃ vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ karttavyaḥ, so'nyārthaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ kauternivṛttyartho'pi bhavati, tena lugvikaraṇaparibhāṣā (vyā.pa.50) atra kauternivṛttyarthamāśrayitavyā na bhavati| `cukuve' iti| pūrvavat‌ taśabdasyaic‌ `aci śnudhātu' (6.4.77) ityādinovaṅ‌|| 64. kṛṣeśchandasi| (7.4.64) `karīkṛṣyate' iti| `kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā.990) `rīgṛhupadhasya' (7.4.90) iti rīgāgamaḥ|| 65. dādhartidarghartidargharṣibobhūtutetikte'laṣyāpanīphaṇatsaṃsaniṣyadatkarikratkanikradadbharibhraddavidhvatodavidyutattaritrataḥ sarīsṛpataṃvarīvṛjanamarmṛjyāganīgantīti ca| (7.4.65) cakāraśchandasītyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `dhārayateḥ' iti| `dhṛñ‌ dhāraṇe' (dhā.pā.900) `dhṛṅ‌ avasthāne' (dhā.pā.1412) `dhṛṅ‌ avadhvaṃsane' (dhā.pā.960)--ityetāṣāṃ ṇyantānāṃ grahaṇam‌, `dhṛṅo vā' iti| anantaroktayoraṇyantayoḥ| `ślau yaṅluki vā' iti| tatra tāvat‌ `dādhartti iti--yadā dhārayateḥ ślau nipātyate, tadā ṇilopo'bhyāsasya dīrghatvaṃ nipātyate| yadā tu yaṅluki, tadā'nekāctvādyaṅ‌ na prāpnoti, so'pi nipātyate, upadhāhrasvatvañca| ṇilopastvārdhadhātukatvādeva yaṅaḥ `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) ityevaṃ siddhaḥ| bhyāsasya dīrghatvamapi `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityevaṃ siddham‌| `dardharti, dardharṣi' iti| atrāpi yadā dhārayateḥ ślau tadā'bhyāsasya rugāgamo ṇilopaśca| ślustu sarvatra `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.76) ityanenaiva veditavyaḥ| yadā tu yaṅluki, tadā `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityanena dīrghatve prāpte tadabhāvaśca nipātyate| yadā dhṛṅaḥ--dādhartīti ślau nipātyate, tadā dvirvacane kṛte'bhyāsasya dīrghatvaṃ nipātyate| yadā tu tasyaiva dhṛṅo yaṅluki tadā'syāsasya `ṛtaśca' (7.4.92) iti prāptasya rugāderabhāvo nipātyate| `dargharti, dargharṣi' iti| atrāpi yadā dhṛṅ‌, ślau, tadābhyāsasya rugāgamo nipātyate; yadā tu yaṅaluki, tadā pūrvavat‌ prāptasya dīrghasyābhāvo
