nipātyate, na tu rugāgamaḥ; tasya hi `rugrikau ca luki' (7.4.91) ityevaṃ siddhatvāt‌ parasmaipadaṃ ca vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) iti| `bobhūtu' iti| `anyatra' iti| loṭprathamapuruṣasyaikavacanāpekṣamanyatvaṃ veditavyam‌| `bobhavīti' iti| adāditvācchapo luk‌ `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.73) iti bahulavacanatvādbhavati; `yaṅo vā' (7.3.94) iti pakṣe īṭ‌| `tetiṣate' iti| `tijeḥ' iti| `tija niśāne' (dhā.pā.971) ityetasya| nanu ca yaṅo ṅittvāt‌ pratyayalakṣaṇenātmanepadaṃ (1.1.62) siddham‌, etat‌ kimarthaṃ nipātyate? ityāha--`yaṅo ṅittvāt‌' ityādi| jñāpanārthamātmanepadaṃ siddham‌| jñāpanārthamātmanepadaṃ nipātyata iti darśayati| jñāpanasya tu prayojanam‌--anyatra yaṅlugantādātmanepadaṃ na bhavatīti--bhāvaḥ, bobhavītīti| `alarṣi' iti| `ṛ sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098,1099)--ityasya jauhotyādikasya `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityattve kṛte raparatve ca halādiśeṣaḥ prāpnoti, tadapavādau rephasya latvaṃ nipātyate| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ sipā nirdeśo'yamatantramityevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha--`tipyapi' ityādi| `phaṇateḥ' iti| `phaṇa gatau' (dhā.pā.821)--ityetasya| `syandeḥ' iti| `syandū prasravaṇe' (dhā.pā.761)--ityetasya| kimarthaṃ punaḥ sampūrvasyātantratvaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha--`atrāpi hi' ityādi| `karikrat‌' iti| `ḍukṛñ‌ karaṇe' (dhā.pā.1472)| yaṇādeśe kṛte'nṛkārāntatvāt‌ `ṛtaśca' (7.4.92) ityabhyāsasya rigāgamo na prāpnoti, sa nipātyate| `krandeḥ' iti| `kadi kradi kladi āhvāne rodane ca' (dhā.pā.772,773,774) ityetasya| kathaṃ punarjñāyate luṅītyetannipātanam‌? ityāha--`asya hi' ityādi| yasmālluṅantena krandaterartho nirdiśyate, tato jñāyate--luṅayetannipātanamiti| atra cābhyāsasya rīgāgamo nipātyata eva| `vibhartteḥ' iti| `ḍubhṛñ‌ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1087) ityasya| `dhvarateḥ' iti| `dhvṛ hūrcchane' (dhā.pā.939)| `dyuteḥ' iti| `dyuta dīptau' (dhā.pā.741) ityasya| `samprasāraṇābhāvaḥ' iti| `dyutisvāpyoḥ samprasāraṇam‌' (7.4.67) iti samprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti, atastadabhāvo nipātyate| `tarateḥ' iti| `tṝ plavanataraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.969) ityasya| `sṛpeḥ' iti| `gamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.982,983) ityasya| `vṛjeḥ' iti| `vṛjo varjane' (dhā.pā.1812) ityetasya| `marmṛjya' ti| `mṛjū śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1066) ityetasya ṇali rūpam‌| `āganīganti' iti| etadapi saṭi tipi| itikaraṇasya prakārārthatāṃ darśayitumāha--`evamprakārāṇām‌' ityādi| dādharttiprabhṛtīnāmiva yeṣāṃ chandasyalākṣaṇikaṃ kāryaṃ dṛśyate ta evamprakārā dādharttisadṛśā ityarthaḥ| ke punaste? galagarttītyevamādayaḥ| `gṝ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410) ityetasya yaṅluki ślau vā galagarttīti rūpam‌, abhyāsasya carttvāmāvaḥ, halādiśeṣāpavādaḥ, rephasya latvaṃ ca nipātyate|| 66. urat‌| (7.4.66) chandasīti nivṛttam‌; pūrvasūtre ca kārānukṛṣṭatvāt‌| `vavṛte, vavṛdhe, śaśṛdhe' iti| `vṛtu varttane' (dhā.pā.758), `vṛdhu vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.759), `śṛdhu śabdakutsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.760), liṭ‌; tatrādyayoranudāttettvādātmanepadam‌, itaratra svaritettvāt‌; pūrvavadeva dvirvacanam‌, halādiśeṣe ca kṛta ṛvarṇāntatayāmupajātāyāmadbhāvaḥ, raparatvam‌, halādiśeṣaḥ| `narnartti, narinartti, narīnartti' ityevamādau `ṛdupadhasya ca' (7.4.90) iti, `rugrikau ca luki' (7.4.91) iti vā paratvādapavādeṣu kṛteṣu rīgādiṣu ṛvarṇāntābhāvādanena na bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākartumāha--`narnarti' iti|| 67. dyūtisvapyoḥ samprasāraṇam‌| (7.4.67) halādiśeṣe prāpte tasyāpavādau dyutisvāpyoḥ samprasāraṇamārabhyate| `vididyute' iti| `dyuta dīptau' (dhā.pā.741), liṭ‌, anudāttettvādātmanepadam‌; tatra samprasaraṇamanena, `samprasāraṇācca' (6.1.108) iti parapūrvatvam‌| `vyadyutat‌' ti| ṇyantālluṅa; śleścaṅ‌, ṇilopaḥ upadhāhrasvatvam‌, dvirvacanam‌, aḍāgamaḥ| `vididyutiṣate, vididyotiṣate' iti| san‌, `ralo vyupadhāt‌' (1.2.26) ityādinā vikalpena kittvam‌| yadā kittvaṃ nāsti, tadā laghūpadhaguṇaḥ, `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam‌| `susvāpayiṣati' iti| `ñiṣvap‌ śaye' (dhā.pā.1068), ṇic‌, tadantāt‌ san‌| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ṇyantasyodāharaṇamupanyastam‌? ityata āha--`svapirṇyanto gṛhyate' iti| tena ṇyantasyodāharaṇamupadarśitamityabhiprāyaḥ| ṇyantasya grahaṇaṃ svāperiti nirdeśādeva vijñāyate| na hyaṇyāntasyaivaṃvidho nirdeśa upapadyate| api ca--aṇyantasya yo'byāsastasyānenaiva śāstreṇa sampsāraṇaṃ siddham‌| tathā hi--liṭi tāvat‌ `liṭyabhyāsasyobhayeṣām‌' (6.1.17) ityanenaiva siddham‌, sani tu `rudavida' (1.2.8) ityādinā sanaḥ kittve sati vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) kṛtasamprasāraṇa eva supibhūto dvirucyeta, yaṅyapi `svapisyamivyeñāṃ yaṅi' (6.1.19) iti kṛtasamprasāraṇa evāsau dvirucyate| tasmādaṇyantasyānena śāstreṇa samprasāraṇasya siddhatvāt‌ svāpirṇyanto gṛhyate| yadi svāpirṇyanto gṛhyate| tadā svāpayaterṇvul‌--svāpakaḥ, svāpakamicchatīti kyac‌, svāpakīya iti sthite svāpakīyitumicchatīti san‌--sidhvāpakīyiṣati, atrāpi samprasāraṇaṃ prāpnoti? ityāha--`tasya' ityādi| tasya svāperabhyāsasya ni mattaṃ yaḥ pratyayastenānantarye satyavyavadhāna idaṃ samprasāraṇamiṣyate, tena sidhvāpakīyiṣatītyatra na bhavati| na hyabhyāsanimittaṃ yaḥ pratyayaḥ iha sa svāperanantaraḥ; ṇvulā kyacā ca vyavadhānāt‌| kathaṃ punarabhyāsanimittena pratyayenānantarye sati samprasāraṇaṃ labhyate, yāvatā nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ sūtropāttaḥ? evaṃ manyate--abhyāsenābhyāsanimittaṃ yaḥ pratyayaḥ sannidhāpitaḥ, tasya pratyayaviśeṣanimittatvāt‌; tatra lenābhyāsanimittena pratyayena svāpiraṅgaṃ viśiṣyate--abhyāsanimitte pratyaye yadaṅgaṃ svāpiriti| evañca viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāve sakyabhyāsanimitte pratyaye'nantare sati svāperaṅgasya yo'bhyāsastasyaiva samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam‌| na tu vyavahitena pratyayāntareṇa hi yo vyavahitaḥ pratyayaḥ sannabhyāse nimitta tadapekṣayā svāpiraṅgaṃ bhavati, na ca sidhvāpavyavahitena pratyayāntareṇa hi yo vyavahitaḥ pratyayaḥ sannabhyate nimittaṃ tadapekṣayā svāpiraṅgaṃ bhavati, na ca sidhvāpakauyiṣatatyabhyāsanimittaṃ yaḥ pratyayaḥ sa svāreraṅgasyānantaraḥ, yastu svāperanantaro ṇvul‌ tadapekṣayā svāpiraṅga bhavati, na cāsāvabhyāsanimittaṃ bhavati| iha tarhi kasmānna bhavati--svapanaṃ svāpo ghañ‌, svāpaṃ karotati ṇic‌, svāpayitumicachatīti san‌ siṣvāpayiṣatīti? ucyate; akāralopaśya sthānivadbhāvāt‌ svāperyo'bhyāsastasya samprasāraṇena bhavitavyam‌| na cākāralopasya sthānivadbhāve sati svāperabhyāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi śabdāntarasya svāpa ityetasya|| 68. vyatho liṭi| (7.4.68) `vivyathe' iti| `vyatha bhayacalanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.764), anudāttettvādātmanepadam‌| atha yakārasya halādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttyā bhavitavyam‌, vakārasya samprasāraṇena? iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`yakārasya' ityādi| `vāvyathyate' iti| yaṅ‌|| 69. dīrgha iṇaḥ kiti| (7.4.69) iṇo hrasvasyaiva śravaṇe prāpte dīrghatvaṃ vidhīyate| `īyatuḥ īyuḥ' iti| nanu ca paratvāt‌ `iṇo yaṇ‌' (6.4.81) iti yaṇādeśe satyanackatvāt‌ dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnotītyata āha--`iṇo yaṇ‌' ityādi| sthānivadbhāvastu `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) ityanana| sa ca niyatakāle dvirvacana eva karttavye kṛte ca tasminnādeśarūpa evāvatiṣṭhate| `iyāya, iyayitha' iti| ṇali thali ceti yathākramaṃ vṛddhiguṇayoḥ kṛtayoḥ sthānivadbhāvād‌dvirvacanamikāraḥ, tasya `abhyāsasyāsavarṇe, (6.4.78) itīyaṅ‌|| 70. ata ādeḥ| (7.4.70) liṭītyanuvarttate| kidgrahaṇaṃ tu nivṛttam‌| `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) iti pararūpatve prāpte dīrghatvamārabhyate| taparakaraṇaṃ svabhāvata eva yo hrasvastasya dīrgho yathā tenopadeśe vo dīrghastasya hrasvatve kṛte'pi dīrgho na bhavati--`ācchi āyāme' (dhā.pā.209), āccha, ācchatuḥ, āccuriti| liṭ‌, tipo ṇal‌, taso'tum‌, jherus‌, dvirvacane halādiśeṣe `hrasvaḥ' (7.4.59)| kiñca syād‌ yadyatra dīrghaḥ syāt‌? `tasmāsruḍ‌dvihalaḥ' (7.4.71) iti nuṭ‌ syāt‌| `ādeḥ' iti vacanādihāntasya dīrgho na bhavati--papācetyādau|| 71. tasmānnuḍdvihalaḥ| (7.4.71) dvau halau yasya tad‌dvihal‌| `ānaṅga, ānaṅgatuḥ, ānaṅguḥ' iti| `agi ragi lagi gatyarthāḥ' (dhā.pā.146,144,145), idittvānnum‌| `ānañja, ānañjatuḥ, ānañjuḥ' iti| `anjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu' (dhā.pā.1458)| `aiauc‌' (mā.sū.4) ityatra `pratyāhāre varṇeṣu ye varṇaikadeśā varṇāntarasamānākṛtayaḥ, teṣu tatkāryaṃ na bhavati, tacchāyānukāriṇo hi te, na punasta eva; pṛthakprayatnanirvarttyaṃ hi varṇamicchantyācāryāḥ' ityuktvā `nuḍ‌vidhilādeśavināmeṣvṛkāre pratividhātavyam‌' ityuktam‌| tatrāvasaraprāptyā ṛkāre nuṅ‌vidhau pratividhānamāha--`ṛkāraikadeśo rephau halgrahaṇena gṛhyate' iti| `ānudhatuḥ, ānṛdhuḥ' iti| `ṛdhu vṛddhau' (dhā.pā.1271)| kathaṃ punarvarmaātmakānāṃ halā grahaṇenāvarṇātmaka ṛkāraikādeśo repho gṛhyate? dvihalgrahaṇasāmamarthyāditi bhāvaḥ| atra `tasmānnuṭ‌' ityevaṃ vaktvyam‌| na caivaṃ satyāṭatuḥ, āṭurityādau nuṭprasaṅgo bhavati; aśnoterityasya niyamārthatvāt‌--advihalo yadi bhavati nuṭ‌ tadāśnotereva, nānyasyeti| aśnāti nivṛttyarthaṃ tadetannāśaṅkanīyam‌; yadyetāvat‌ prayojanaṃ syāt‌ `nāśnaḥ' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| tasmānniyama evāsya prayojanam‌| tadevamantareṇāpi dvihalgrahaṇaṃ siddhe yato dvihalgrahaṇaṃ karoti tasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--dvihalsamānākṛterapi yathā syāt‌| yasyāpyeko hal‌ mukhyo'vayavo dvitīyastvamukhyastacchāyānukāritvādupacāreṇa halavyapadeśārhaḥ, tasyāpi yathā syādityevamartham‌| etasya kathaṃ lyate? yadyatra dvihala ityevaṃśrutistacchāyānukāriṇyapi ṛkārāvayave rephe varttate, nānyathā| tasmād‌dvihalgrahaṇasāmarthyādatra halgrahaṇena ṛkāraikadeśo repho gṛhyate; anyathā dvihalgrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌|| 72. aśnoteśca| (7.4.72) advihalārtho'yamārambhaḥ| `vyāna śe' iti| `aśū vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1264), anudāttettvādātmanepadam‌, ta, eś‌| aśnoteriti vikaraṇanirdeśaḥ `aśa bhojane' (dhā.pā.1523) ityetasya kraiyādikasya nivṛttaye| cakāro nuḍāgamānukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 73. bhavateraḥ| (7.4.73) `babhūva' iti| `bhuvo vugluṅ‌liṭoḥ' (6.4.88) iti vṛk‌| `anubabhūve' iti| karmaṇyātmanepadam‌| śtipā nirdeśī yaṅlugnivṛttyarthaḥ--vobhāveti|| 74. sasūveti nigame| (7.4.74) `sūteḥ' iti| `ṣūṅ‌ prāṇigarbhavimocane' (dhā.pā.1031)--ityetasya| `suṣuve' iti| ṅittvādātmanepadam‌; uvaṅ‌| itikaraṇamevamprakārāṇāmanyeṣāmupasaṅagrahārtham‌| tena jāgramaḥ, adarśametyādi siddhaṃ bhavati| jāgrama iti jāgartteragnipātyate| adarśameti laṅi dṛśeḥ paśyādeśābhāvaḥ| jāgṛm‌, apaśyāmeti bhāṣāyāmṝ| dādharttyādiṣu sasūvagrahayaṇaṃ na kṛtam‌; vaicitryārtham‌|| 75. ṇijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇaḥ śvau| (7.4.75) bahuvacananirdeśādādyartho gamyata ityata āha--`evām‌' ityādi| `ṇijir‌ śaucapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1093), `vijir‌ pṛthagbhāve' (dhā.pā.1094), `viṣlṛ vyāptau' (dhā.pā.1095)--ityete ṇijādayo jauhotyādikāḥ| `trigrahaṇamuttarārtham‌' iti| `bhṛñāmit‌' (7.4.76) itīttvam‌| trayāṇāmeva yathā syādadhikānāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ trigrahaṇam‌| etadarthamapi kasmānna bhavati? ityata āha--`evām‌' ityādi| yadyatra trigrahaṇaṃ kriyate nijādīnāmante bṛtkaraṇaṃ kimartham‌? etadgaṇakāraḥ praṣṭavyaḥ, na sūtrakāraḥ| `anyo hi gaṇakāro'nyaśca sūtrakāraḥ' ityuktaṃ prāk| gaṇakāreṇāpi vaicitryārthaṃ vṛtkaraṇaṃ kṛtamiti veditavyam‌| vicitrā hi gaṇasya kṛtirgaṇakāreṇa| atha guṇagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, ekāra eva nocyeta? aśakyamevedaṃ vaktum‌; evaṃ hyucyamāne dvevyamapi kaścidvijānīyāt‌--halādiśeṣāpavādo'yaṃ nijādīnāmekara iti| guṇagrahaṇe hi saṃjñāvidhāne niyama itīka eva bhavati, halastu halapādiśeṣeṇa nivṛttirbhavati|| 76. bhṛñāmit‌| (7.4.76) `ḍu bhṛñ‌ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1087), `māṅ‌ māne' (dhā.pā.1088), `ohāṅ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.1089)--ityete bhṛñādayo jauhotyādikā eva| `mimīte, jihīte' iti| `ī halyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itīttvam‌|| 77. artipipartyośca| (7.4.77) `iyarti, piparti' iti| `ṛ sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098,1099) `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1086), juhotyādikatvācchapaḥ śluḥ guṇaḥ dvirvacanam‌, `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityattvam‌, anenettvam‌, raparatvañca| artteḥ `abhyāsasyāsavarṇe' (6.4.78) itīyaṅ‌| athārtigrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā nijādibhyo'yaṃ paraḥ paṭhyate| ye ca nijādibya pare te sarva eva cchāndasāḥ, tathā hi tān‌ paṭhitvā chandasītyuktam‌| chāndasatvāccārteḥ `bahulaṃ chandasi' (7.4.78) ityevaṃ siddham‌? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--bhāṣāyāmapyartteḥ prayogo bhavatīti|| 78. bahulaṃ chandasi| (7.4.78) `viviṣṭi' iti| `vaśa kāntau' (dhā.pā.1080), `bahulaṃ chandasi' (2.4.76) iti śapaḥ śluḥ, vraśascādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌| `vivakti' iti| `vaca paribhāṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1842)| `siṣakti' iti| `saca samavaye' (dhā.pā.997), `saca secane' (dhā.pā.163) iti vā| `jigartti, jighartti' iti| `gṛ ghṛ secane' (dhā.pā.937,938)| sarvatra pūrvavacchapaḥ śluḥ| `jajanam‌, dadhanam‌' iti| `jana janane' (dhā.pā.1105), `dhana dhānye' (dhā.pā.1104)| luṅ‌mipo'm‌, juhotyāditvācchapaḥ śluḥ; `bahulaṃ chandasyāmāṅyoge'pi' (6.4.75) ityaṅ‌niṣedhaḥ|| 79. sanyataḥ| (7.4.79) `pipakṣati' ityādi| paciyajyo rūpe| `pipāsati' iti| pāteḥ, pibatervā| `lulūṣati' iti| `lūñ‌ chedane' (dhā.pā.1483)| `iko jhal‌' (1.2.9) iti kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `sani grahaguhośca' (7.2.12) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌? pāpacyateḥ san‌ pāpaciṣata ityatra mā bhūt‌| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamatra hrasvo na bhavati? dīrghavidhānasāmarthyāt‌| yadi `sani yo'bhyāsaḥ' ityevaṃ vijñāyeta, [vijñāyate-prā.mu. pāṭhaḥ] tato mukhasukhārtham‌|| 80. oḥ puyaṇyajyapare| (7.4.80) `puyaṇji' [nāsti--kāśikā] iti| puyaṇjāmekavadbhāvaṃ kṛtvā saptamyā nirdeśaḥ| `apare' [nāsti--kāśikā] iti| aḥ paro yasmāt‌ puyaṇjastadaparamavarṇaparamityarthaḥ| `pipaviṣate' iti| pūṅ‌ padane' (dhā.pā.966) san‌, `smipūṅrañ‍cvaśāṃ sani' (7.2.74) itīṭ‌, guṇāvādeśau| sthānivadbhāvāt‌ `pū' ityasya dvirvacanam‌, sthānivadbhāvastu `dvirvacane'ci' (1.1.59) ityanena| `pipāvayiṣati' iti| pūṅo ṇyantāt san‌| atrāpi sthānivadbhāvāt‌ `pū' ityetad‌dvirucyate| `bibhāvayiṣati' iti| `bhū sattāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1) ṇyantāt‌ san‌| `yiyāvayiṣati' iti| yauterṇyantāt‌ san‌| `sanauvantaṃ (7.2.49) ityādeneṭh‌| `rirāvayiṣati; lilāvayiṣati' iti| rautilunātibhyāṃ ṇyantābhyāṃ san‌| `jijāvayiṣati' iti| `ju' iti sautro dhātuḥ (3,2,150); `jucaṃkramya' (3.2.150) ityādau pāṭhāt‌| tasmāt‌ ṇyantāt‌ san‌| kathaṃ punaḥ pipādayiṣatītyādāvukārāntatā'bhyāsasya, yāvatā ṇau parato'ntaraṅgatvād‌vṛddhyāvādeśayoḥ kṛtayorvakārāntasyādvirvacanena bhavitavyam‌, sthānivadbhāvādukārāntasya dvirvecanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? na; na hi ṇau kṛtasya sthānivadbhāvo bhavati| ṇeradvirvacananimittatvādityata āha--`etadeva' ityādi| na hi ṇicamantareṇa puyaṇjovarṇaparāḥ sarve sambhavanti| tatra hi yadi ṇau kṛtasya sthānivadbhāvo na syāt‌, tadā yeṣāṃ ṇicamantareṇa puyaṇjo'varṇaparāḥ sarve sambhavati| tatra hi yadi maau kṛtasya sthānivadbhavo na syāt‌, tadā yeṣāṃ ṇicamantareṇāvarṇaparatā na sambhavati, teṣāmuvarṇānto'bhyāso na syāt‌, ucyate cedaṃ `oḥ puyajjayapare' iti vacanam‌| tasmādetajjñāpakam‌--advirvacananimitte'pi ṇau sthānivadbhavatīti| tena tutāvayiṣati, bibhāvayiṣatītyādi siddhaṃ bhavati| keṣāñca punarṇicamantareṇāvarṇaparatā na sambhavati? yakārapakārābhyāmanyeṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva| `pāpaciṣate' iti| `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ, `yasya halaḥ' (6.4.49) iti yakārasya| `tutāvayiṣati' [`avatutāvayiṣati' iti kāśikāpadamañjaryoḥ pāṭhaḥ] iti| `tu' iti saudho dhātuḥ; `turustuśamyamaḥ' (7.3.95) ityādau sūtre pāṭhāt‌| `juhāvayiṣati' iti| `hu dāne' (dhā.pā.1083) ṇyantāt‌ tasmāt‌ san‌| `bubhūṣati' iti| pūrvavadiṅguṇayorabhāvaḥ|| 81. sravatiśrṛṇotidravatipravatiplavaticyavatīnāṃ vā| (7.4.81) `su sru gatau' (dhā.pā.940) `śru śravaṇe' (dhā.pā.942) `du dru gatau' (dā.pā.944,945)`pruṅ‌pluṅ cyuṅ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.957,958,956) `sisrāvayiṣati' ityādi| ebhyo ṇyantebhyaḥ sarvatra san‌| nanu ca sakārādinā varṇenātra yaṇo vyavadhānam‌, atrāvarṇapare yaṇi parata ittvamucyamānaṃ vyavadhāne kathaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`vacanasāmarthyāt‌' iti| savatraiva hi sakārādinaikavarṇena vyavadhānam‌, ucyate cedaṃ vacanam‌, tasmādatra vacanasāmarthyādekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrīyate; anyathā hi vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt| `pūrvasūtreṇa' ityādenā'prāptavibhāṣeyamiti darśayati| `śuśruṣati' [śuśrūyate--kāśikā] iti| pūrvavadiṅguṇayorabhāvaḥ| śtipaḥ nirdeśo dhātunirdeśārthaḥ, na yaṅalagnivṛttyarthaḥ| atra guṇe kṛta ukārāntatābhāvādittvaṃ na bhavatīti| `sosraviṣati'||[nāsti--kīśikā] 82. guṇo yaṅlukoḥ| (7.4.82) abhyasasya guṇo'yaṃ vidhīyate| tena yadyapyatra lukśabdo'yaṃ sāmānyaḥ, tathāpi yaṅluka eva sampratyayo bhavati| na hyatra lukyabhyāsaḥ sambhavatīti matvā''ha--`yaṅi yaṅluki ca' ityādi| `caukruśīti' `kruśa āhvāne' (dhā.pā.856) yaṅ‌, tasya `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti lṛk‌, `yaṅo vā' (7.3.94) itīṭ‌, `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇaniṣedhādyaṅo luki kṛte guṇo na prāpnotīti luggrahaṇam‌| `pugantalaghupadhasya ca' (7.3.86) iti prāpto'pi guṇaḥ `nābhyastasyāci piti sārvadhātuke' (7.3.87) iti niṣidhyate|| 83. dīrgho'kitaḥ| (7.4.83) `yaṃyamyate' iti| `yama uparame' (dhā.pā.984), `nugato'nunāsikāntasya' (7.4.85) iti nuk‌| `nanu ca' ityādinā'kita ityetatpratyācaṣṭe| yaṃyamyata ityatra mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ `akitaḥ' ityucyate| atra hyapavādatvānnuki kṛte'najantatvādeva dīrgho na bhaviṣyatīti nārtho'kita ityanena| `evaṃ tarhi' ityādinā `abhyāsavikāreṣvapavādā notsargān‌ vidhīn‌ bādhante' (vyā.pa.23) ityetāṃ paribhāṣāṃ jñāpayituṃ `akitaḥ' ityetaducyata iti darśayati| `ḍoḍhaukyate' iti| `ḍhaukṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.98) ityasya yaṅi kṛte halādiśeṣe ca `hrasvaḥ' (7.4.59) iti hrasvatvam‌, pūrvasūtreṇa guṇaḥ| tatrāsatyasmin‌ jñāpake pipāsatītyevamādau sāvakāśaṃ hrasvatvaṃ `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityenena sandhyakṣare dīrghatvena bādhyeta| dīrghasya dīrghavidhāne prayojanābhāvāddīrgho na bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? naitat‌; asti hi dīrghasya dīrghavidhāne prayojanam‌, kiṃ tat‌? hrasvo mā bhūditi| evaṃ cāsatyasmin‌ jñāpake `acīkarat‌' ityatrāpyacikṣaṇadityādau sāvakāśamittvam‌ `dorgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghatvena bādhyeta| `mīmāṃsate' ityādāvasatyasmin‌ jñāpake pipakṣatītyādau sāvakāśaṃ `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itīttvaṃ mānbadhādisūtreṇa (3.1.6) vihitena dīrghatvena bādhyate| `ajīgaṇat‌' ityatrāpyasatyāsmen‌ jñāpake papāṭhetyādau sāvakāśo halādiśeṣaḥ `ī ca gaṇaḥ' (7.4.97) itīttvena bādhyate| asmiṃstu sati tarvametanna bādhyate| nanu cāsati prayojane jñāpakaṃ bhavati; asti cāsya prayojanam‌, kiṃ tat‌? dhātukittvamapekṣya jahātermā bhūt‌--jāhāti, jāhetīti? naitadasti; yadi hyetat‌ prayojanaṃ syāt‌, tadā `ahākaḥ' iti pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt‌| kiñca `akitaḥ' ityabhyāsasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavitumarhati, yadyabhyāsāvasthāyāṃ kittvamupajāyate| na ca jahāteḥ kittvamabhyāsamapekṣate, pūrvameva hi tadabhyāsādbhavati| tasmājjahāteḥ--jāhāti, jāhetīti rūpeṇa bhavitavyam‌| tataśca `akitaḥ' iti vacanaṃ jñāpakameva| kitkaraṇaṃ tu jahāteḥ `haśca vrīhikālayoḥ' (3.1.148) ityatra sāmānyagrahaṇāvighātārtham‌| atha dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌; ādityeva noyeta/ naivaṃ śakyam‌, `akitaḥ' ityasya jñāpakatā nopapadyate| sati hi dīrghagrahaṇe nuki kṛte'najantatvādeva hi dīrghasya prāptirnāstīti `akitaḥ' iti pratiṣedhasya jñāpakatvamupapadyate| ākārastu vidhīyamāno'jantasyābhyāsasya syāditi `akitaḥ' ityasya jñāpakatvaṃ na syāt‌| tasmāddīrghagrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 84. nīgvañcusraṃsudhvaṃsubhraṃsukasapatapadaskandām‌| (7.4.84) `vancu cancu tancu tvancu bhruncu gluncu [`muncu' iti prā.mu. nyāsapāṭhaḥ] gatyarthāḥ' (dhā.pā.189-194)| `sransu dhvansu avasraṃsane' (dhā.pā.754,755), `kasa gatau' (dhā.pā.860) `śala hula patlṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.843-845), `skandir‌ gatiśoṣaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.979)| `vanīvacyate' iti| `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityādinānunāsikalopaḥ| `vanīvañcīti' iti| atra na bhavatyanunāsikalopaḥ| yaṅī luptatvāt‌ `na lumatāṅgasya' (1.1.63) iti pratyayalakṣaṇaniṣedhāt‌| atha nīki kṛte hrasvatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? dīrghoccāraṇasāmarthāyat‌|| 85. nugato'nunāsikāntasya| (7.4.85) `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityanena dīrghatve prāpte vacanamidamārabhyate| `tantanyate' ityādīni tamigamiyamiramīṇāṃ rūpāṇi| yadi nuk‌ kriyate, yamyamyate ityādau `naścāpadāntasya jhali' (8.3.24) iti jhalyucyamāno'nusvāro na sidhyati, ajhalparatvāt‌? ityata āha--`nugitye tat‌' ityādi| kathaṃ punarnugityetadanusvāropalakṣaṇārthaṃ śakyate draṣṭum‌? ityāha--`sthāninā hi' ityādi| nukā hi sthāninā'trādeśo'nusvāra upalakṣyate| tasmādanusvāra evāgamo'tra vidhīyate, na tu nuk‌| yamyamyata ityādau yadyapyajhalparatā'sti, tathāpyanusvāraḥ sidhyati| evaṃ `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58) prāpnoti, iṣyate ca pakṣe'nusvārasya śravaṇam‌, tanna sidhyati, apavāntatvāt‌? ityata āha--`padāntavacca' ityādi| padāntavadanusvāro bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--tadantavidhirnavānunāsikāntasyānusvāro bhavatīti nārtho'ntagrahaṇena, tatkriyate--padāntasyānutvārasya yo dharmā sa nuko'pi syādityevamartham‌; tenānusvārasya pakṣe śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| `tetimyate' iti| `tima ṣṭima ārdrībhāve' (dhā.pā.1123,1124)| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā nāsti kiñcidanyadasya vyāvartyamiti sarvatra hrasvābhāvāt‌? ityata āha--`taparakaraṇam‌' ityādi| varttamānasya dīrghasyābhāvādbhūtapūrvasyāpi dīrghasya nivṛttyarthaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| `bābhāmyate' iti| `bhāma krodhe' (dhā.pā.441)|| 86. japajabhadahadaśabhanjapaśāṃ ca| (7.4.86) anunāsikārto'yamārambhaḥ| `japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' (dhā.pā.397,398), `jabhi jṛbhī gātravināme' (dhā.pā.388,389) `daha bhasmīkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.991), `danśa daśane' (dhā.pā.989) `bhavjo āmardane' (dhā.pā.1453), `paśiḥ' sautro dhātuḥ| `jañjapyate' ityādiṣu `daṃdaśyate' iti paryanteṣu `lupasada' (3.1.24) ityādinā yaṅ‌| itaratra sāmānyalakṣaṇena' (3.1.22)|| 87. caraphalośca| (7.4.87) `cara gatau' (dhā.pā.559)| `ñi phalā viśaraṇe' (dhā.pā.516), `phala niṣyattau' (dhā.pā.530)-dvayorapi grahaṇam‌| niṣyattyarthasyākāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, nānubandhaḥ, prayojanābhāvāt‌, tataśca niranubandhakaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.53) niranubandhasya niṣpattyarthasyaivāsya grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, na viśaraṇārthasya? naiṣa doṣaḥ; cakāro'tra kriyate, sa ca viśaraṇārthasya samuccayārtho bhaviṣyati| `cañcūryate' iti| `lupasada' (3.1.24) ityādinā yaṅa| uttarasūtreṇākārasyokāre kṛte `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ| yogabhāga uttarārthaḥ|| 88. utparasyātaḥ|(7.4.88) `abhyāsasya mā bhūt‌' iti| asati paragrahaṇe'bhyāsādhikārādabhyāsasyaiva syādityabhiprāyaḥ| `alo'ntyasya mā bhūt‌' iti| yadi `ataḥ' iti nocyeta, tato'lo'ntya (1.1.52) paribhāṣayā'bhyāsātparasya dhāturūpasya yo'ntyo'l‌ tasya syāditi manyate| atha taparakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā mātrikasya sthāna āntaratamyādvidhīyamāno mātrika eva bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`taparakaraṇam‌' ityādi| asati taparakaraṇa ukāre kṛte cañcūrti, pamphultītyatra `pugantalaghūpadhasya' (7.3.86) iti guṇaḥ syāt‌, sa mā bhūdityevamrathaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ kriyate| nanu cañcūrtītyatra dīrghatvameva guṇasya bādhako bhaviṣyati, tatkimetannivṛttyarthena taparakaraṇena? ityata āha--`dīrghatvam‌' ityādi| asiddhatvaṃ tu `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) ityanena| yadi tarhi lakṣaṇāntareṇa prāpto guṇastaparakaraṇena nivarttate, guṇavaddīrghatvamapi na syāt‌/ naiṣa doṣaḥ; taparakaraṇe hi dīrghatvamapi siddhamiti| tena dīrghasya nivṛttirna śakyate vaktum‌| tathā ca --`ata ut‌ sārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) iti taparakaraṇena dīrghatvamaśakyaṃ nivarttayitumiti manyamānena `na bhakurcchurām‌' (8.2.79) iti karoterdīrghatvapratiṣedha ārabhyate| ata iti taparakaraṇamiha mā bhūt‌--phalantaṃ prayuṅkte phālayati, phālayateḥ kvip‌, tadantāt‌ `ācāre punaḥ sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ' (vā.186?) iti kvip‌, tadantādyaṅ‌--panphālyate, pamphāloti| kathañca prāpnoti? ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvāt‌|| 89. ti ca| (7.4.89) ayaṅalugartho'yamārambhaḥ| `cūrttiḥ' iti| `striyāṃ ktin‌' (3.3.94) pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| `prakṛltāḥ' iti| `niṣṭhā, tadantāṭṭāp‌; jas‌| `vacanasāmarthyādiha nābhisambadhyate' iti| yadīha yaṅluggrahaṇamabhyāsagrahaṇañcābhisambadhyeta, tato vacanasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt‌| pūrveṇaiva yaṅayaṅlukorabhyāsasya siddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|| 90. rīgṛdupadhasya ca| (7.4.90) `varīvṛtyate' ityādīni vṛtivṛdhinṛtīnāṃ (dhā.pā.758,759.1116) rūpāṇi| `rīgṛtvata iti vaktavyam‌' iti| ṛdupadhādanyasyāpi ṛtvato rīgādayo yathā syurityevamartho vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--cakāro'tra kriyate, sa ca ṛdupadhādanyasyāpi ṛtvataḥ samuccayārthaḥ, tena vṛścatiprabhṛtīnāmapi ṛtvatāṃ rīgādayo bhavantīti| `rīgṛtvataḥ' iti sūtraṃ na kṛtam‌; vaicitryātham‌| `ṛdupadhasya' iti taparakaraṇamasandehārtham‌| ukāre parato yaṇādeśe kṛte sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimṛkāropadhasya? atha vā rephopadhasyeti?|| 91. rugrikau ca luki| (7.4.91) 92. ṛtaśca| (7.4.92) lukītyeva| cakāreṇa rīgādayo'nukṛṣyante| `carkarti' iti| `ḍukṛñ‌ karaṇe' (dhā.pā.1472) `jarhati' iti| `hṛñ‌ haraṇe' (dhā.pā.899)| `kirateścākarti' iti| `kṝ vikṣepe' (dhā.pā.1409), ityasya| `kiratim‌' ityādi| kiratigrahaṇamupalakṣaṇārtham‌| tena `gṛ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410) ityevamāderapi ṛkārāntasya grahaṇaṃ veditavyam‌| `carkarītāntam‌' iti| yaṅlugantamityarthaḥ| yaṅluka eva pūrvācāryapraṇītaiṣā saṃjñā `carkarītam‌| iti| `pacati' iti| laṭprathamapuruṣasyaikavacanam‌| etadapyupalakṣaṇārthameva| vacanāntarāṇāmapi hyatra grahaṇam‌| tena `kṝ' ityevamādikamṝkārāntaṃ yo laṭprathamapuruṣaikavacanādau naye-cākartītyevamādīni rūpāṇi prāpayet‌, sampādayeditayrathaḥ. `prāptijñaṃ tamahaṃ manye' iti| prāptiṃ jānātīti prāptijñaḥ| iha tu rugādīnāṃ prakṛtatvāt‌ tatprāptiṃ yo jānāti sa prāptijño veditavyaḥ| manyaṃ-avagacchā| `prārabdhastena saṃgrahaṇaḥ' iti| anena prāptitāyāṃ hetumāha| samyaggṛhyate jñāpaye lakṣaṇamaneneti saṃgrahaḥ-vyākaraṇaśāstram‌| prakarṣeṇārabdhaḥ prārabdhaḥ; bahubhyo bahuśaḥ śravaṇāt‌| kā punarasāṃ prāptiryatparijñānāya prāptijñamavagacchāmītyāha--`tatreyam‌' ityādi| dvayamiha prakṛtam‌--aṅgam‌ abhyāsaśceti| ṛta iti viśeṣaṇamupāttam‌; tatra yadyapyumayaṃ prakṛtaṃ tathāpyṛta ityetadaṅgasyaiva viśeṣaṇam‌, nābhyāsasya| kutaḥ? taparakaraṇasāmarthyāt‌| sarvatraiva hyabhyāsasya `hrasvaḥ' (7.4.59) iti hrasvatvena bhavitavyam‌; ato dīrghasyāmyāsasyābhāvāt‌| yadi `ṛtaḥ' ityedabhyāsasya viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt‌, tadā taparakaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ taparakaraṇasāmarthyādaṅgasyaiva viśeṣaṇamṛta ityetat‌, nābhyāsasya| evañca sati kirateraprāptiḥ; rugādīnāṃ taparakaraṇena vyāvarttitatvāt‌| ādiśabdena rigādīnāṃ parigrahaḥ| `tathā cāprāptiḥ kirate rugādīnām‌' iti bruvartataduktaṃ bhavati--karotiprabhṛtīnāmeva hrasvāntānāṃ pariśeṣyāt‌ prāptiriti|| 93. sanvallaghuni caṅpare'naglope| (7.4.93) `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) ityādinā sūtratrayeṇa yadabhyāsasya sani kāryaṃ bhavati tallaghuni caṅpara ityatidiśyate| `laghuni' `caṅpare' iti| vyadhikaraṇe saptamyau--caṅapare ṇau parato yat‌ pūrvaṃ laghu tasmin‌ parato yo'bhyāsastasya sanvadbhavatīti| `caṅapare' iti bahuvrīhiḥ--caṅ‌ paro yasmāditi taccaṅparam‌; na tu caṅ‌ cāsau paraśceti tatpuruṣa. tena sāmarthyāṇṇyantasyaivāyamatideśo vijñāyate; anyathā hi yadi prakṛtyantasyāyamatideśaḥ syāt‌, tadā `sanvaccaṅi' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| `ananlope' iti| `caṅpare' ityasyaitadviśeṣaṇam‌| agiti pratyāhāragrahaṇam| ako lopo'glopaḥ, sa yasya nāsti tadanaglopam‌| `apīpacat‌' iti| pacerṇit‌, luṅ‌, cleścaṅ‌, upadhāhrasvatvam‌, dvirvacanamabhyāsakāryam‌, halādiśeṣe ca kṛte'nena sanvadbhāvaḥ, `sanyataḥ' (7.4.79) itīttvam‌, uttarasūtreṇa (7.4.94) dīrghatvam‌| `atatakṣat‌, ararakṣat‌' iti| ata rephatakārayoḥ saṃyogaparatvād‌ gurusaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ na bhavati sanvadbhāvaḥ| `ajajāgarat‌' iti| atra jakārākārasya dīrghatvādgurutvam‌| `atra kecit‌' ityādi| teṣāṃ `ajījāgarat‌' iti bhavitavyam‌| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṃ ta evamicchanti, yāvatā laghuni caṅpara ityacyate, vyavahitaścātra laghuni caṅpare? ityata āha--`sarvatraiva' ityādi| `acīkarat‌' ityādāvapi kakārādinā varṇena vyavadhānāllaghorānantaryamabhyāse nāsti; ucyate cedaṃ vacanam‌, ato vacanaprāmāṇyā dvayvadhāna eva sanvadbhāvena bhavitavyam| tataśca yathā `acīkarat‌' ityādau vyavadhāne'pi bhavati, tathehāpi vyavadhāne sanvatkāryeṇa bhavitavyam‌| atha cedvyavadhānānna bhavati, atrāpi na syāditi bhāvaḥ| `tadasat‌' iti| `ajajāgarat‌' ityatra gṛśabdaṃ laghumāśritya yat‌ sanavadbhāvamicchanti, sarvatraivetyādinā ca yat‌ kāraṇamuktam‌, tadubhayamatrāśobhanam‌; ayuktatvāt‌| katham‌? itayāha--`yena' ityādi| ekena varṇena vyavadhānamasti sarvatra| varṇasaṅghātena vyavadhānamasti nāsti ca| tatra `yena nāvyadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt‌' (vyā.pa.46) iti yanniyatabhāvyekena varṇena vyavadhānamaśakyaṃ pariharttum‌, tadevāśrīyate, na tu varṇasaṅgātena| `ajajāgarat‌' ityatra varṇasaṅghātena vyavadhānam‌| yadi tarhi varṇasaṅghātena vyavadhānaṃ nāśrīyate, vyañjanasaṅghātena vyavadhāne na siddhayati? ityabhiprāyeṇāha--`kathamacikṣaṇat‌' ityādi| `kṣaṇu hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1465) ityetasyaitadrūpam‌| atrāpi jñāpakena siddhyatītyata āha--`ācāryapravṛttiḥ' ityādi| kṣaṇotinā ye sadṛśāḥ saṃyogādayasta evañjātīyāḥ| kṣaṇotiprakāraḥ ityarthaḥ| teṣāṃ yadīttvaṃ na syāt‌, tadā tadbādhanārthaṃ `atsmṛdṝtvaraprathabhrada' (7.4.95) ityādināttvaṃ na vidadhyāt‌, vidadhāti ca| tasmādetadevāttvavidhānalakṣaṇamācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--`bhavatyevañjātīyakānāmittvam‌' iti| `ahaṃ papaca' iti| uttame ṇali yadā `ṇaluttamo vā' (7.1.91) iti ṇittvaṃ nāsti tadedaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ bhavati| atra laghuparato'kṣaram‌, na tu caṅparam‌| `acakamata' ityādi| kameścopasaṃkhyānam‌' (vā.208) iti `kamu kāntau' (dhā.pā.443) ityetasmāt‌ prakṛtyantādeva luṅ‌, caṅ‌| `acakathat‌' iti| `katha vākyaprabandhe' (dhā.pā.1851) curādāvadantaḥ| atra `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ| atra tvaglopasya sthānivadbhāve sati vyavadhāne'pi na syāt‌| ataḥ pratyudāharaṇāntaramāha--`dṛṣadamākhyadadadṛṣat‌' iti| `tatkaroti tadācaṣṭe' (vā.200?) iti ṇic‌| `ṇāviṣṭhavat‌ kāryaṃ prātipadikasya' (vā.811) itīṣṭhavadbhāvāṭṭilopaḥ| atrājjhalorlopaḥ, nāka eva kevalasyeti nāstyatra sthānivadbhāvaḥ| anyārthaṃ tvaglopa iti kriyamāṇamacakathadityatrāpi sanvadbhāvaṃ nivarttayatītyasyopanyāsaḥ| `avīvadat‌' iti| vadaterṇyantād‌ vāditavantaṃ prayojitavāniti `hetumati ca' (3.1.26) iti ṇic‌, punarṇicyutpanne `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilope kṛte satyapyaglopyaṅgaṃ bhavati, ato na bhavitavyaṃ sanvadbhāveneti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha--`vāditavantaṃ prayojitavān‌' ityādi| `caṅpare' ityādinā ṇilopasyāglopitvenānāśrayaṇe kāraṇamāha| `caṅapare' ityanena hi sanvadbhāvanimittena ṇijātirākṣiptā| tasmādgobalīvardanyāyena ṇijātirnimittatvenāśrīyate| ato ṇijāteranyasyāko lopaḥ pratiṣedhanimittatvena parigṛhyate, na tu tasyā eva ṇijāteḥ| tasmāṇṇilopasyāglopitvenānāśrayaṇāt‌ tallope'glopyaṅgaṃ na bhavati| ato bhavatyevātra sanvadbhāvaḥ| sanvadityatideśena yathācīkaradityādāvabhyāsasyettvaṃ bhavati tathāmīmapadityādāvapyabhyāsalopena mīmādīnāṃ bhavitavyamiti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`mīmādīnām‌' ityādi| ādiśabdena dhvādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌| `kiñca' ityādinā parīhārāntaram‌| sanvadityatideśena hi sanāśrayaṇeva kāryamatidiśyate| sanāśrayañca kiṃ kāryam‌? yat‌ sanamapekṣate, nāparaṃ kiñcit‌| na ca `atra lope'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityanena vidhīyamāno lopaḥ sanamevāpekṣate, kiṃ tarhi? isbhāvādikamapi| ādiśabdena dhvādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌| `kiñca' ityādinā parohārāntaram‌| sanvadityatideśena hi sanāśrayameva kāryamatidiśyate| sanāśrayañca kiṃ kāryam‌? yat‌ sanamapekṣate, nāparaṃ kiñcit‌| na ca `atra lope'bhyāsasya' (7.4.58) ityanena vidhīyabhāno lopaḥ sanamevāpekṣate, kiṃ tarhi? isbhāvādikamapi| ādiśabdena--`abjñapyṛdhāmīt‌' (7.4.55) itīttvam‌, `muco'karmakasya' (7.4.57) iti guṇaśca parigṛhyate| tena `abhīmapat‌' ityādāvisādeśo na bhavati| abhyāsalope'pi na bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ|| 94. dīrgho laghoḥ| (7.4.94) 95. atsmṛdṝtvaraprathamradastṛspaśām‌| (7.4.95) `smṛ cintāyām‌' (dhā.pā.933), `dṛ bhaye' (dhā.pā.808), `ñi tvarā sambhrame' (dhā.pā.775), `pratha prakhyāne' (dhā.pā.1553), `mrada mardane' (dhā.pā.767), `stṛñ‌ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1484), `spaśabādhanasparśanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.887)| atha `adadarat‌' ityatra `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha--`taparakaraṇasāmarthyāt‌' ityādi| anenaiva hi lakṣaṇena dīrgho auva prāpnoti, yasya nivṛttistaparakaraṇena kriyate; `bhāvyamāno'ṇ‌ savarṇān‌ na gṛhṇāti' (vyā.pā.35)| iti bhāvyamānānāṃ savarṇānāmagrahaṇāt‌ sarvatra sthādino hrasvatvācca| tatra yadi lakṣaṇāntareṇāpi prāpnukto dīrghasya nivarttakaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ na syānnirarttakameva taparakaraṇaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ taparakaraṇasāmarthyāditi kṛte `dīrgho laghoḥ' (7.4.94) iti dīrgho na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|| 96. vibhāṣā veṣṭiceṣṭyoḥ| (7.4.96) `veṣṭa veṣṭane' (dhā.pā.255), `ceṣṭa ceṣṭāyām‌' (dhā.pā.256)--etayorabhyāsasya laghuparatā nāstītyaprāpta eva sanvadbhāva iti anena vibhāṣā'kāro vidhīyate|| 97. ī ca gaṇaḥ| (7.4.97) `gaṇa saṃkhyāne' (dhā.pā.1853) curādāvadantaḥ| tatrākārāt‌ `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) iti lope kṛte'naglopa iti vacanādaprāptayoreva sanbadbhāvadīrghayorivamītvaṃ vidhīyate| cakāro vibhāṣetyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| iti bodhasattvadeśīyācāyaṃ śrījinendravuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāṃ saptamādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ samāptaśca saptamo'dhyāyaḥ <8> <8.1> aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ pādaḥ 1. sarvasya dve| (8.1.1) svaritaliṅgāsaṅgādadhikāratvamasyāvagamyāha--`sarvasya' ityādi| `vakṣyāmaḥ' iti| vyākhyāsyāma ityarthaḥ| `prāk‌ padasya' [`padasya' ityataḥ prāk‌--kāśikā] iti| `padasya' (8.1.16) iti vakṣyamāṇo yo yogastasmāt‌ prāginyarthaḥ| `padasya' (8.1.16) iti vakṣyamāṇasya yogasyānukaraṇametat‌| vibhaktistvanukāryānukaraṇayorbhedasyādivakṣitatvādasatyarthavatve prātipadikatvābhāvānna bhavati, yathā--gavityayamāheti| `sarvasya dve bhavata ityevaṃ tadveditavyam‌' iti| itikaraṇo'rthanirdeśārthaḥ| `sarvasya dve bhavataḥ' iti yo'yamarthaḥ pratīyata etadartharūpaṃ tadvakṣyamāṇaṃ veditavyamityarthaḥ| `vakṣyati' iti| sūtrakāraḥ| `tatra' iti| `nityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) ityatra yoge| iha dvau pakṣau sambhavataḥ--sthāne dvirvacanam‌, dviṣprayogo dvirvacanañceti| kathaṃ kṛtvā? sarvasyeti śabdānuśāsanaprastāvāt‌ sarvasya śabdasyeti gamyate| yad‌ dviśabdaścāyaṃ `ādaśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeye varttante' (he.ga.90) iti saṃkhyeyavacanaḥ, tacceha saṃkhyeyaṃ śabdarūpaṃ vā syāt‌, āvṛttirvā? `dve' ityapi nirdeśo napuṃsakaliṅgena vā syāt‌? strīliṅgena vā? tatra yadā napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśaḥ, tadā śabdarūpe saṃkhyeye| yadi strīliṅgena nirdeśā, tadā śabdasyāvṛttī uccāraṇalakṣaṇe kriye| tatra yadā śabdarūpe vidhīyete tadā sarvasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhīyaṃ sampadyate; aniyatasambandhatvāt‌ `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' (1.1.49) iti nyāyāt‌| asmin‌ darśane `sthāne dvirvacanam‌' ityeṣa pakṣo bhavati| yadā tu dve āvṛttī vidhīyete tadā `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam‌' ityeṣa pakṣo jāyate| asmin‌ darśane sthānyādeśabhāvo nāsti| āvṛttirhi kriyā, tasyāśceha śabdaḥ sādhanam‌| na ca kriyāyāḥ sādhanasya ca sthānyādeśabhāva upapadyate| yadi hi syāt‌, śabdasya sthānino nivṛttidharmatvānnivṛttireva syāt‌; tataśca kriyāyā abhāva eva syāt‌| na hi śabdena vinoccāraṇakriyopapadyate; tasyāḥ śabdadharmatvāt‌| tasmādyadādve āvṛttī vidhīyete tadā `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam‌' ityeṣa pakṣa upajāyate| asmiṃstu pakṣa āvṝttiśabdāpekṣayā sarvasyeti `kart‌tṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' (2.3.65) iti kṛdyogalakṣaṇā karttṛṣaṣṭhī veditavyā| sarvo hi śabda āvarttyamāna evāvṛttikriyāyāḥ karttā bhavati| avādyāṃ pakṣamāśrityaitaduktam‌--sarvasya sthāne dve bhavata iti| kathaṃ punaḥ sthāne dvirvacanapakṣa āśritaḥ? kathaṃ punarnāśrayitavyaḥ? sadoṣatvāt‌| sthāne dvirvacane punaḥ--śvaliṭcchavaliṭ‌, dāgvāgiti `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) ityasiddhatvāt‌ pūrvaṃ ḍhatvādibhyo dvirvacane kṛte ḍhatvādayo'tra na siddhyanti; apadāntatvāt‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyati hyetat‌--`pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' (jai.pa.dṛ.70) iti| api ca nitye'rthe vīpsāyāñca yaḥ śabdo varttate tasya dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate, na ca ḍhatvādiṣvakṛteṣu nityādāvarthe padasya vṛttirupapadyate| tasmāt‌ pūrvaṃ ḍhatvādibhireva bhavitavyam‌; paścād‌dvirvacanenetyeṣa kramaḥ| iha tarhi visaṃvisam‌, musalambhulamityatra `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvaṃ prāpnoti? ayamapyadoṣaḥ; yasmādādeśo yaḥ sakārastasya ṣatvaṃ vidhīyate, na hyatrādeśaḥ sakāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi? tadavayavaḥ| iha tarhi nṛbhirnṛbhirityatra `raṣābhyāṃ no ṇaḥ samānapade' (8.4.1) iti ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti? eṣo'pyadoṣaḥ; kāryiṇo nakarasya rephādinā nimittena yadā sarvadā samānapadasthatvamevaṃ sati ṇatvena prāpnoti? eṣo'pyadoṣaḥ; kāryiṇo nakārasya rephādinā nimittena yadā sarvadā samānapadasthatvamevaṃ sati ṇatvena bhavitavyamiti| kiṃ vaktavyametat‌? na; kathaṃ tarhi anucyamānaṃ labhyate? samānagrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌| yadi hi yatra samānapadasthatvamasamānapadatvañca tatrāpi syāt‌, samānagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| nṛbhiriti śabdasya nakārasya dvirvacana eva kṛte repheṇa nimittena samānapadasthatvam‌, nā'kṛte| tasmādaduṣṭa eva sthāne dvirvacanapakṣa iti yukta evāśrayitum‌| `ke dve' iti| evaṃ manyate--viśiṣṭe dve eveṣyete, iha ca viśeṣānupādānādaniyamena ye kecana śabdarūpe apnuta iti| `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ' (1.1.50) iti paribhāṣayā vyavasthā bhavitavyatītyanenābhiprāyeṇāha--`ye śabdataśca' ityādi| iha keṣāñcit‌ śabdānāṃ śabdata evāntaratamyam‌, yathā--bibhītakādivācināmakṣādiśabdānām‌| keṣāñcidarthata eva, na śabdataḥ, yathā--tarupādapādiśabdānām‌| keṣāñcidubhayata eva, yathā--dvayoḥ pajatiśabdayostiṅatayoḥ| tatobhayathā yatrāntaratamyamasti tatra yathā syādityevamarthamubhayorgrahaṇam‌| etacca `sthāne'ntaratamaḥ' (1.150) iti paribhāṣāyāstamabgrahaṇāllabhyate| te evobhayathā'ntaratame darśayitumāha--`ekasya' ityādi| atha `svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyāśabdasaṃjñā' (1.1.68) iti svarūpagrahaṇād‌dviśabdādeśa eva kasmānna bhavati? dvirvacanena nirdeśāt‌| svarūpagrahaṇe tu sati dviśabdādeśaprasaṅgaḥ| yataścāyaṃ `tasya paramābhreḍitam‌' (8.1.2), `anudāttañca' (8.1.3) ityāha, tato, vijñāyate--na dviśabdādeśa iti| dviśabdādeśe hi sati bhedanibandhanatvāt‌ parasya dviśabdasya cābhinnatvāt‌ paratvameva tāvanna dviśabdādeśe syāt‌, kutaḥ punarāmreḍitasaṃjñā, anudāttatvañca? yadi ca dviśabda ādeśaḥ syāt‌, `avyaktānukaraṇasyāta itau' (6.1.98) ityanuvarttamāne `nāmreḍitasyāntyasya tu yā' (6.1.99) ityāmreḍitāvayavasyācchabdasya pararūpatvapratiṣedho nopapadyate, na dviśabdasyācchabdo'vayavo'sti| etena sarvaśabdasyāpi svarūpagrahaṇaṃ pratikṣiptam‌| yadi hi sarvaśabdasya svarūpagrahaṇaṃ syāt‌, tasyaiva hi dvirvacanaṃ syāt‌| tataśca pūrvavadāmreḍitasambandhino'cchabdasya pararūpatvapratiṣedho nopapadyate, `nityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) ityatra nityagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakaṃ syāt‌| tatra hi nitye'rthe vīpsāyāṃ ca varttamānasya dvirvacanaṃ vidhāsyate| na ca sarvaśabdasya nitye'rthe vṛttirasti, tiṅkṣu nityatā; `avyayakṛtsucsupsu vīpsā' iti vacanāt‌| tasmāt‌ sarvasyetyatrārthagrahaṇam‌| sarvaśabdo'yamiha sakale kalāvati varttate, tena pacatītyādeḥ kṛtsnasya śabdasya dvirvacanaṃ bhavatītyalamatiprasaṅgena| evaṃ tāvat‌ sthāne dvirvacanapakṣamāśritya `sarvasya sthāne dve bhavataḥ' ityuktam‌| idānīm‌ `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam‌' iti pakṣamāśrityāha--`yadā tu' ityādi| tuśabdaḥ pūrvasmāt‌ pakṣādviśevasya pradarśakaḥ, tatrāntaratamyena dve śabdarūpe ādiśyete| iha tu sa eva śabdo dvirāvarttyate, dvirucyata ityarthaḥ| `dve āvṛttī bhavataḥ' iti| dve uccāraṇākriye bhavata ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam‌' iti pakṣa āśrayitavyaḥ? kathaṃ ca nāśrayitavyaḥ? sadoṣatvāt‌| dviṣprayoge hi--`ām‌ pacasi pacasi devadatta' ityatra `āma ekāntaramāmantritamanantike' (8.1.55) iti nighātapratiṣedho na prāpnoti; āmantritasya padadvayena vyavadhānādekāntaratāyā abhāvāt‌| sthāne punardvirvacane hyekapadasyāyamādeśa iti satyapyādeśasya svagate bhede sthānivadbhāvādekatvavyapadeśe satyekīvitaratī bhavatīti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; dharmabhedādupacarito hīha bhedaḥ, svagatastvabheda eva; anyathā vṛttireva na syāt‌| ekasyaiva hi vastuna āvṛttadiḥ kriyate| tasmādbhinnatvādvastuna ihaiva sunaramekāntaratā sidhyati| iha tarhi paunaḥpunyamiti? atra `guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ca' (5.1.124) iti ṣyañ‌ na prāpnoti, paunaḥpunika ityatra ca `kālāṭṭhañ‌' (4.3.11) iti ṭhañ‌ na prāpnoti; aprātipadikatvāt‌| aprātipadikatvaṃ tvarthavatsamudāyānāṃ samāsasyaiveti samāsagrahaṇasya niyamārthatvāt‌| sthāne dvirvacane punaryadyapi subantatayā svāśrayā prātipadikasaṃjñā nāsti, tathāpi sthānivadbhāvāt‌ prātipadikagrahaṇe grahaṇāt‌ prātipadikaṃ bhavati| yadyapi cāsya sthānī pratyayalakṣaṇena subantaḥ; tathāpyapratyayaḥ (1.2.45) iti prātipadikasaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedho na bhavati; prātipadikasaṃjñāyāḥ pratyayalakṣaṇetāpratyaya (1.2.45) iti pratiṣedho na bhavatītyasyārthasya `na ṅisambuddhyoḥ' (8.2.8) ityanena jñāpitatvāt‌| dviṣprayoge dvirvavase'pi na doṣaḥ| atra samāsagrahaṇaṃ hi tulyajātoyasyaiva prātipadikasaṃjñāṃ nivarttayati| kaśca tulyajātīyaḥ? yasya bhedasaṃsargadvāreṇa samudāyārtha upajāyate| kasya caivaṃ vidho'rthaṃ upajāyate? vākyasya| nityādiścāyamarthaḥ padādasthāyāṃ na dṛṣṭa eva| dviruktikāle dṛśyamānaḥ padāntareṇa na bhidyate, nāpi saṃsṛjyata iti kuta evamprakārasya samāsagrahaṇānnivṛttiḥ| atha vā''cāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--bhavatyevaṃjātoyebhyastadvitotpattiriti, yadayaṃ kasyādiṣu kautaskutaśabdaṃ paṭhati| kutaḥ kuta āgata iti `avyayāttyap‌' (4.2.104) iti tyapi prāpte'smādeva nipātanādaṇ‌| sarvasyeti vacanamiha `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) nivṛttyarthaṃ vā syāt‌? ṣaṣṭhyarthapratipattyartha vā? tatra tvalo'ntyanivṛttyarthaṃ tāvannopapadyate| tathā hi--śabdataścārthataścāntaratamābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ śabdarūpābhyāṃ bhavitavyam‌| ye caivamprakāre te niyogato'nekālsvarūpe ityantareṇāpi sarvagrahaṇena `anekālśitsarvasya' (1.1.55) iti| sarvasyaiva bhaviṣyataḥ, nāntyasya| ṣaṣṭhyarthapratapattyarthamapi sarvagrahaṇaṃ nopapadyate| tathā hi--yatra tāvat‌ ṣaṣṭhyuccāryate `parervarjane' (8.1.5) ityādau, tatra ṣaṣṭhyuccāraṇādeva ṣaṣṭhyarthasya pratipattirbhaviṣyati| `nityavīpsamoḥ' (8.1.4) ityatra yadyapi ṣaṣṭhī noccāryate, tathāpi sarvasyeti vacanamantareṇāpi śakyate ṣaṣṭhyartho'vagantum‌| katham‌? `dve' iti hyādeśanirdeśaḥ, ādeśaśca sambandhinamapekṣate, `nityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) iti cārthanirdeśāḥ; na cārthanirdeśe sthānyādeśasambandha upapadyate| tasmānnityadīpsayoryaḥ śabdo varttate tasya dve bhavataḥ--ityevaṃ vākyārthaḥ sthāne dvirvacanapakṣe tāvadavagamyate| yadā `dviṣprayogo dvirvacanam‌' tadāpi vinā sarvasyeti vacanena ṣaṣṭhyartho'vagamyata eva| evaṃ hyāvṛttirhi kriyā, tasyā avaśyaṃ sādhanena sambandhinā bhavitavyam‌; tadāyattatvādātmalābhasya kriyāyāḥ| tasmādyattasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ tasya dve bhavata iti vilpaṣṭaiva ṣaṣṭhyarthapratipattirbhavatītyabhiprāyeṇāha--`sarvasyeti kim‌' iti| `vispaṣṭārtham‌' iti| ya evaṃ na śaknoti sarvādeśaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaṃ vā pratipattum‌, taṃ prati sukhapratipattaye sarvasyetyucyata iti bhāvaḥ| `atha' ityādi| evaṃ manyate--`padasya' ityucyamāne samāsataddhitavākyānāṃ dvirvacananivṛttiḥ kṛtā bhavati; uttaratra ca `padasya' (8.1.16) iti vaktavyaṃ na bhavati| etadeva hi `padasya' iti vacanaṃ tatrānuvarttayiṣyate| anucyamāne `padasya' ityesmin‌, samāsasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ syāt‌--parvaṇiparvaṇi saptasapta parṇānyasya santīti saptaparṇa iti; taddhitasyāpi dvau dvau pādau dadāti `pādaśatasya saṃkhyādeḥ' (5.4.1) ityādinā van‌--dvipadikāṃ dadātīti; vākyasyāpi--grāmegrāme pānīyamiti| padasya' (8.1.16) iti cottaratra na vaktavyaṃ bhavati| `naivaṃ śakyam‌' iti| atra kāraṇamāha--`iha hi' ityādi| `prapacati' iti| vākyametat‌, padasamudāyātmakatvāt‌| atra `padasya' ityucyamāne'sya dvirvacanaṃ na syāt‌| tasmādaśakyaṃ padasyeti vaktum‌| saptaparṇaḥ, dvipadikāṃ dadātītyatra tu padasyetyucyamāne dvirvacanaṃ na bhaviṣyati; samāsataddhitābhyāmevoktatvāt‌| vīpsāyāṃ grāmegrāme pānīyamityatrāpi na bhaviṣyati; avayavadvirvacanenaiva vīpsāyā dyotitatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| `iha' ityādi| `drūha jidhāṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1197), tatastṛc‌, druh‌-tṛ iti sthite ghatvaḍhatve prāpnutaḥ, dvirvacanaṃ ca, tatra `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) iti dvirvacane karttavye yatvaḍhatvayorasiddhatvādakṛtayoreva tayordvirvacanaṃ pūrvaṃ prāpnoti| kṛte tasmin‌ paścāt‌ `vā druhamuhaṣṇuṣṇihām‌' (8.2.33) iti vikalpe satyaniṣṭamapi prāpnoti| nāvaśyamiṣṭameva yadyayaṃ niyamo labhyate| yadaikasya dhatvaṃ bhavati tadā dvitīyasyāpi ghatvena bhavitavyam‌, yadā tvekasya ḍhatvaṃ tadā dvitīyasyāpi ḍhatvena bhavitavyamiti tadeṣṭameva syāt‌| na tveṣa niyamo labhyate; niyamakāraṇābhavāt‌| tasmāt‌ kadācidaniṣṭamapi syāt‌| tatra yadā pūrvottarayorekasya ghatvaṃ bhavatyaparasya ḍhatvam‌, tadāniṣṭamapi prāpnoti| yadobhayorapi ghatvaṃ ḍhatvaṃ vā bhavati, tadeṣṭaṃ syāt‌ tasmādaniṣṭanivṛttyartham‌ `pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' (jai.pa.vṛ.70) iti vaktavyam‌| `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) ityasminnadhikāre bhavaṃ pūrvatrāsiddhīyaṃ nalopādikāryam‌| gahāditvācchaḥ (4.2.138), tato dvirvacanādanyatrāsiddhaṃ bhavati, na tu dvirvacane| atha vā--pūrvatra sapādasaptādhyāyyāmasiddhaṃ pūrvatrāsiddham‌, tadeva nalopādikāryam‌, tatra bhavaṃ pūrvatrāsiddhīyam‌| tat‌ punastasyaiva nalopāderasiddhatvam, tad‌dvirvacanādanyasmin‌ karttavye bhavati, na tu dvirvacana eva| etadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`na mu ne' (8.2.3) ityatra neti yacogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, tena dvirvacane karttavye'siddhatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti| asati cāsiddhatve drūhestṛci kṛte pūrvaṃ vikalpena ghatvam‌, `jhaṣastadhorgho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvam‌, `jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti jaśtvam‌--dhakārasya gakāraḥ, tato dvirvacanam‌--drogdhādrogyoti| yadā tu ghatvaṃ nāsti tadā `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌, pūrvavaddhatvam‌| ṣṭutvañca, `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13) iti pūrvaḍhakāralopaḥ, tato dvirvacanam‌--droḍhādroḍheti; iṣṭameva sidhyati| yadi tarhi `pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' (jai.pa.vṛ.70) ityetadvaktavyam‌; tadā `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.1) ityatra aujaḍhavityasya siddhaye yadvakṣyati--`ḍhatvaṣṭutpaḍhalopādīnāmasiddhatvāṇṇau yaṣṭilopastasya sthānivadbhāvād‌ hat‌ ityetad‌dvirucyate' iti--taddhirudhyate? nāsti virodhaḥ; `pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' (jai.pa.vṛ.70) ityasyāsarvaviṣayatvāt‌| kathaṃ vijñāyate? `ubhau sābhyāsasya' (8.4.21) ityasya sūtrasyārambhāt‌| yadi hi `pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' (jai.pa.vṛ.70) ityetat‌ sarvaviṣayakaṃ syāt‌, evaṃ sati `aniteḥ' (8.4.19) ityanena kṛtaṇatvasya dvirvacanena bhavitavyamiti siddham‌--prāṇiṇiṣatītyādikaṃ rūpam‌, kim‌ `ubhau sābhyāsasya' (8.4.21) ityenena sūtrārambhema? ārabdhañca, tato jñāpate, pūrvatrāsiddhīyamadvirvacane' (jai.pa.vṛ.70) ityetadasarvaviṣayamiti| yastu manyate--āṣṭamikaṃ dvirvacanamabhipretyaitadvakyavyamiti, tadayuktam‌; tasya `suvinirdurbhyaḥ supisūtisamāḥ' (8.3.88) ityatra viṣuṣupurityasya siddhyarthaṃ yadvakṣyati--`ṣupibhūto dvirucyate' iti; tadvirudhyate; yadi hi ṣaṣṭhike dvirvacane karttavye ṣatvasyāsiddhatvaṃ nāsti, evaṃ ṣupibhūtasya dvirvacanaṃ labhyate, nānyathā| tasmāt‌ pūrva eva parīhāraḥ sādhuḥ| `sarvasyetadvā' [`sarvasya' ityetadeva--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| vāśabdaḥ pūrvaprayojanāpekṣayā vikalpārthaḥ| atha vā--naivam‌, vispaṭārtha sarvagrahaṇam‌| kiṃ tarhi? kṛtasarvakāryasya pratipattyartha kṛtam‌| sarvaṃ ḍhatvādikārya yasya tasya pratipattiḥ pratītiryathā syādityevamarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ draṣṭavyama| etat‌ katham‌? sarvaśabdo'yaṃ matvarthīyākārapratyayāntaḥ--sarvaṃ kāryamasyāstīti sarvaḥ, arśaāditvādac‌ (5.2.127), tena kṛtasarvakāryasya dvirvacanaṃ bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati|| 2. tasya paramāmreḍitam‌| (8.1.2) `tasya' itvayavaṣaṣṭhī| tasya dviruktasya yat‌ paramavayavabhūtaṃ śabdarūpaṃ tasyābhreḍitasaṃjñā vidhīyate| atha dviṣprayogadvirvacanapakṣe kathaṃ paramiti vyapadeśaḥ? kathañca na syāt‌? tasya bhedanibandhanatvāt‌| paravyapadeśo hi bhedanibandhanaḥ| na ca dviṣprayogadvirvacanapakṣe śabdabhedo'sti, āvṛttimātraṃ hi tatra bhidyate, na śabdaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; abhinnasyāpi śabdasya dharmabhedādaupacārikamanyatvaṃ bhaviṣyati| bhavati hi dharmabhedādabhinne'pi vastuni bhedavyavahāraḥ| tathā hi vaktāro vadanti--parudbhavān‌ paṭurāsīt‌ paṭutaraścaiṣamo'nya evāsi saṃvṛtta iti| `caura caura' iti| `eṅhrasvātsambuddheḥ' (6.1.69) iti sulopaḥ, `vākyāderāmantritasya' (8.1.8) ityādinā bhartsane dvirvacanam‌, `ārmreḍitaṃ bhartsane' (8.2.95) iti plutaḥ| `dasyo dasyo' iti| `sambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) iti guṇaḥ| atha tasyagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `dve' ityanuvarttiṣyate, tatraivaṃ vijñāyate--dvayoryat‌ paramiti? naivaṃ śakyam‌; `ekāco dve prathamasya' (6.1.1) ityatrāpi paramāmreḍitasaṃjñaṃ syāt‌| tasyagrahaṇe sati yatraitadvakṣyamāṇaṃ dvirvacanaṃ tasya paramiti vijñāyate| tena na bhavatyatiprasaṅgaḥ| āmreḍitamiti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇamanvarthasaṃjñāvijñānārtham‌| āmreḍyata ādhikyenocyata ityāmreḍitam‌| tenehāpi bhavati--aho darśanīyā aho darśanīyā, mahyaṃ rocate mahyaṃ rocata iti| darśanīyatvasya ruceścādhikyaṃ dyotayitumatra draṣṭavyaṃ dvirvacanam‌| etadeva mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇaṃ jñāpakam‌--ādhikyābhidhāne dvirvacanaṃ bhavatīti|| 3. anudāttañca| (8.1.3) prakṛtisvare prāpte parasyānudāttatvamucyate| anudāttaśabdaścātra paraśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyānna śāstrīyamanudāttamāha, kiṃ tarhi? anvartho vijñāyate--avidyamānamudāttamanudāttamiti| śāstrīye hyanudātte gṛhyamāṇe sambandhārthaṃ parasyaiti ṣaṣṭhyuccārayitavyā syāt‌| tathā ca `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) syāt‌| athāpi sarvasyetyanuvarttata, evamapi vacanaprāmāṇyādekakāla eva sarvādeśaḥ prasajyeta| tasmādanvarthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌| `bhuṅaktebhuṅkte' iti| `bhujo'navane' (1.3.66) ityātmanepadam‌| tasmin‌ kṛte sati śiṣṭasvaratvāddhātusvaraṃ bādhitvā pratyayasvaraḥ| śnami kṛte yadyapi tasya svaraḥ satiśiṣṭaḥ, tathāpi `vikaraṇasvaraḥ sārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhate' iti teśabda eva svare prasakte `tasyanudātteviṅadadupadeśāllasārvadhātukamanudāttamah‌ nviṅoḥ' (6.1.186) iti sārvadhātukasyānudāttatvam‌, śnasorallope kṛte `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) iti punasteśabda udāttaḥ, nitye cārthe dvirvacanam‌, tasmin‌ kṛte'nena paramanudāttaṃ bhavati| `paśūnpaśūn‌' iti| `kurbhraśca' (da.u.1-107) ityata `kuḥ' ityanuvarttamāne `arjivṛśikasamyamipaśibādhāmṛjipaśitugdhugdīrghahakārāśca' (da.u.1.112) iti kupratyayaḥ, dṛśe paśiradiśaśca| paśṛśabdaḥ pratyayasvareṇāntodāttaḥ, vibhaktyakāreṇa sahaikādeśaḥ, `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam‌, anena parasyānudāttatvam‌|| 4. nityavīpsayoḥ| (8.1.4) `nitye cārthe vīpsāyāñca' iti| anena `nityadīpsayoḥ' iti saptamīyamarthanirdeśārthā, na tu ṣaṣṭhīyamiti darśayati| yadi hyeṣā ṣaṣṭhī syāt‌, tadā svarūvidhiḥ prasajyeta, tataśca `nityaṃ kroḍājīvikayoḥ' (2.2.17) iti, `pādaśatasya saṃkyādervīpsāyām‌' (5.4.1) ityādinirdeśo nopapadyate| iha nityaśabdo'yaṃ sarvakālabhādino ya ātmākāśādayaḥ, yaṣāmutpattivināśau prayoktṛbhirnopalabhyete, teṣvapi prayujyamāno loke dṛśyate--nitya ātmā, nityamākāśam‌, nityā dyauriti| ābhīkṣṇye'pi--nityaṃ prahasitaḥ, nityaṃ prajalpita iti| tatra yadīha sāmānyena tatra nāma nityatā'bhidheyabhāvena varttate tasya nityārthavācino grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, ātmākāśādiśabdānāmapi dvirvacanaṃ prasajyeta--ityenenābhiprāyeṇāha--`keṣu nityatā' iti| itaro viditābhiprāya āha--`tiṅkṣu nityatā'vyayakṛtsuṇa' iti| avyayāni ca tāni kṛnti ceti karmadhārayaḥ| yadyapyātmākāśādiśabdeṣvapi sarvakālabhāvitvalakṣaṇā nityatā'bhidheyabhāvena varttate, tathāpīha bhāvapradhāneṣu tiṅkṣvavyayakṛtsu cābhīkṣṇyalakṣaṇā yā nityatā saivāśrīyate| ato'tiprasaṅgo na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| nanu ca nityaśabdo'yaṃ sāmānyavacanaḥ| na ca sāmānyaśabdāḥ prakaraṇādikamantareṇa viśeṣe'vasthātumutsahante| na ceha tathāvidhaṃ kiñcit‌ prakaraṇādikamasti, yato viśeṣe'vasthānaṃ syāt‌, tatkuto nityatāviśeṣaparigraho labhyate? iti manyamāna āha--`kuta etat‌' iti| ābhīkṣṇyamiha nityatetyāśrīyata iti śeṣaḥ| vyāpterābhīkṣṇyavacanasya nityaśabdasya grahaṇādihābhīkṣṇyalakṣaṇā nityatā''śrīyate, padasya hi dvirvacanamucyate| tacca padaṃ subantaṃ tiṅantaṃ ca, tatra supsu dīpseti vakṣyati| yadi ca nityaśabdo'yaṃ kūṭasthavacano gṛhyate, tataśca kūṭasthamiti subanteṣvabhidheyabhāvena varttata iti subanthānāmeva dvirvacanaṃ syāt‌, na tiṅantānām‌, nāpyavyayakṛtām‌| ābhīkṣṇyavacanasya tu nityaśabdasya grahaṇe sati nityalakṣaṇadvirvacanamākhyātānāmavyakṛtāṃ ca bhavati| vīpsālakṣaṇañcānyeṣāmiti sarva padajātamanugṛhītaṃ bhavati| tasmādvayāpterābhīkṣaṇyavacanasya nityaśabdasya grahaṇādiha `ābhīkṣṇyaṃ nityatā' ityupapannaṃ bhavati| `ābhīkṣṇyamiha nityatā' (iti)| sā ca tiṅkṣvavyayakṛtsu ceti| kuta etat‌? ityāha--`ābhīkṣṇyaṃ ca` ityādi| ābhīkṣṇyaṃ hi punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttiḥ| tacca sādhyarūpāyāḥ kriyāyā eva sambhavatīti tasyā eva dharmaḥ, na tu dravyasya; tasya siddharūpasyaiva subantenābhidhānāt‌| sā ca kriyā tiṅantādibhirevābhidhīyata iti teṣveva nityatā| kīdṛśī punaḥ sā kriyā? ābhīkṣṇyalakṣaṇena yā nityatvena yogānnityaśabdenocyate, ityāha--`yām‌' ityādi| `anuparaman‌' iti| `viratimakurvan‌' ityarthaḥ| `tannityam‌' iti| tata kriyārūpaṃ vastu nityamityarthaḥ| `prādhānyena' iti| yaduddiśya kriyāpravṛttistat‌ pradhānam‌, tasya bhāvastathā| yadyapi grāmaṃ gantumicchan‌ vṛkṣamūlopasarvaṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ karoti, tathāpi na tannityamiti| etaduktaṃ bhavati--na hyasau prādhānyena tatkaroti; taduddiśyāpravṛtteḥ| tena grāmaṃ gacchan‌ vṛkṣamūlānyupasarpatītyatra satyapyāmabhīkṣaṇye dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| `yāṃ kriyām‌' ityanena hi kriyā dharmiṇī darśitā| `anuparaman‌ karoti' ityanenāpi tasyā ābhīkṣaṇyaṃ dharmaḥ| `pacatipacati' iti| tiṅantasyodāharaṇam‌| `bhuktvābhuktvā, bhojaṃbhojam‌' iti| atra `ābhīkṣaṇye ṇamulca' (3.4.22) iti ktvāṇamulau| `lunīhilunīhi' iti| `kriyāsamabhihāre' (3.4.2) ityādinā loṭ‌, tasya hirādeśaḥ, `loṭdharmāṇau hisvo bhavataḥ' iti (3.4.2) tatroktam‌, tena vikaraṇam‌, [`vikaraṇaḥ'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] `īhalyaghoḥ' (6.4.113) itītvam‌| etāni trīṇyavyayakṛtāmudāharaṇāni| eṣāṃ ktvādīnāṃ `kṛdatiṅ‌' (3.1.93) iti kṛtsaṃjñā| avyayasaṃjñā tu ktvāpratyayasya `katvātosunkasunaḥ' (1.1.40) iti| ṇamulastu `kṛnmejantaḥ' (1.1.39) iti| loṭastu svarādiṣvābhīkṣaṇyasya pāṭhāt‌| nanu caite ktvāṇamṛlloṭaścābhīkṣṇya eva vidhīyante, tatra yathā pāpacyata iti kriyāsamabhihāre vidhīyamānena yaṅā paunaḥpunyasya prakāśitatvād‌dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati, tathā katvādibhirapi tasya prakāśitatvānna bhavitavyam‌| atha prakāśite'pi tasmistu tadbhavati, pāpacyata ityatrāpi syāt‌? ityata āha--`katvāṇamuloḥ' ityādi| bhinnā hi bhāvānāṃ śaktayaḥ| tathā hi--yāmeva kriyāṃ bhārodbahanādikāṃ kaścit‌ sahāyasāpekṣaḥ karoti, tāmevānyaḥ sahāyanirapekṣaḥ, tasmādyadyapi cābhīkṣṇye ktvā ṇamulloṭ‌ ca vidhīyate, tathāpi tairnaivābhīkṣṇyabhivyaktaṃ bhavati| dvirvacanasāpekṣāṇāmeva teṣāṃ paunaḥpunyaprakāśane śaktiḥ, na kevalānām‌| tena bhavatyeva tadantasya dvirvacanam‌; yaṅantu dvirvacananirapekṣasyāpi paunaḥpunyābhivyaktau sāmarthyayamastīti tenaivābhīkṣaṇyasya dyotitatvāt‌ pāpaṇyata ityatra na bhavati| ābhīkṣṇyaprakāśanāya hi dvirvacanamucyate, etacca yaṅaiva prakāśitamiti kiṃ dvirvacanena? nanu ca yaṅantasyāpi kvacid‌dvirvacanamiṣyata eva, tacca yaṅo dvirvacananirapekṣasya yaunaḥpunyaprakāśane śaktau satyāṃ na siddhyati? ityāha--`yadā tu' ityādi| dviprakāraḥ kriyāsamabhihāraḥ paunaḥpunyam‌, bhṛśārthaśca| tatra yadā yaṅantena dvirvacanaṃ bhavati tadā bhṛśārthe yaṅ‌| dvirvacanaṃ tu nasyaiva bhṛśārthasya dharme paunāpunye, na hi tadyaṅā prakāśitam‌; tasya bhṛśārthe viditatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| `kriyāsamabhihāre paunaḥpunyaṃ draṣṭavyam‌| iti| atra yadyapi kriyāsamabhihāraśabdaḥ sāmānyaḥ, tathāpi sāmarthyādabhṛśārthalakṣaṇā eva kriyāsamabhihāre tasya vṛttirvijñāyate, na hi paunaḥpunye'nyasya paunaḥpunyasya sambhavo'sti| atha kathaṃ paunaḥpunye yaṅ‌ bhavati? kathaṃ ca na syāt‌? dvirvacanenāpadādena bādhitatvāt‌| yaṅaḥ ko'vakāśa iti cet‌? bhṛśārtha eva? naiṣa doṣaḥ; padasya hi dvirvacanamucyate, dhātośca yaṅ‌| tathā kāryiṇoratibhedāt‌ kuto bādhā? `nityavīpsayoḥ' ityuktam‌, tatra nityatā tiṅkṣvavyayakṛtsu cetyuktam‌| vīpsā tu na vijñāyate--kvābhidheyabhāvena varttate? iti, atastatparijñānārthaṃ pṛcchate--`atha keṣu vīpsā' iti| itaro viditābhiprāya āha--`supsu vīpsā' iti| supāmeva tadabhivayaktau sāmarthyāt‌| yadi sāmānyena vyāptumicchā vīpsā tadā cikīrṣāśabdasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ prāpnoti, tasya karotikriyayā kaṭādervyāptumicchā tatra vṛttiriti manyamāna āha--`kā punarvīpsā' iti| `vyāptiviśeṣaviṣayā' ityādi| nānādācināmadhikaraṇānāṃ kriyādisambandhena yugapadvyāptirvyāptiviśeṣaḥ, sa viṣayo yasyā icchāyāḥ sā tathoktā| saivaṃvidhā `prayokturicchā vīpsā'| prayokturityanena prayoktṛdharmo vīpsā, nābhidheyadharma iti darśayati| kathaṃ punarvyāptiviśeṣaviṣayetyeṣa viśeṣo labhyate? viśabdaprayogāt‌| yadi hyaviśeṣeṇa vyāptumicchāṃ dīpsā'bhimatā syāt‌, `nityepsayoḥ' ityevaṃ brūyāt‌| `vyāptiviśeṣaviṣayā prayokturicchā vīpsā' ityuktam‌, sa tu viśeṣo'nirdiṣṭasvarūpatvānna vijñāyate, tadajñānacca tadviśiṣṭā vīpsāpi na jñāyata ityataḥ pṛcchati--`kā punaḥ sā' iti| `nānāvācinām‌' ityādi| nānāvācinām‌, adhikaraṇānāmiti--vyadhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhyau| nānā-pṛthagbhūtāḥ, tān‌ vaktuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ śabdānāṃ te nānāvācinaḥ| tatsambandhināmadhikaraṇānāṃ vācyānāmityarthaḥ| `kriyāguṇābhyām‌' iti| karaṇe tīyā| `yugapat‌' iti| ekakālam‌| `prayoktuḥ' iti| vaktuḥ| yo dvirvacanaṃ prayuṅakte tasya| `vyāptum‌' iti| sambandhaviśeṣeṇāptum‌| sākalyena sambandhumityarthaḥ| `icchā' iti| abhilāṣaḥ| `vīpsā' iti| prādisamāsaḥ--viśiṣṭā īpsā vīpsā| `nānābhūtārthavācinām‌' ityādinā anantarektaṃ vākyaṃ vivṛṇoti| yata evaṃvidhā vīpsā, tena cikīrṣetyatra dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| cikīrṣā hi kartturicchā, na prayoktuḥ| yataścaivaṃvidhā vīpsā, tena jātivācināmapi dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati--niṣpanno yava iti| na hi jātiśabdā nānābhūtārthavācinaḥ| yadā tu krameṇa vyāptumicchā tadāpi na bhavati--ayaṃ grāmo ramaṇīyaḥ, ayañca grāmo ramaṇoya iti| dvandvaikaśeṣayorapi na bhavati--asminvane śobhanā dhavakhadirapalāśāḥ, asminvane śobhanā vṛkṣā iti| aśeṣaviśeṣavyāptāvanabhimatāyāmapyevaṃ prayogaḥ kriyata iti sarvaviśeṣābhidhānaṃ [`sarvaviśeṣāvidhānaṃ'--kā.mu. pāṭhaḥ] na bhavati, ataḥ prayokturapyaśeṣān‌ viśeṣān‌ vyāptumicchā na jāyate| bāhulyena tu śobhanatvamāśrityevaṃ vākyaṃ prayoktā prayuṅakte--grāmo grāmo ramaṇīya iti| atra hi dindeśādibhedena bhinnānāṃ grāmāṇāṃ ramaṇīyatvena guṇena prayokturyugapadvyāptumicchā dīpsā| `janapado janapadaḥ' iti| atrāpi janapadānām‌| `puruṣaḥ puruṣe niṣanamupaiti' iti| atra puruṣāṇāṃ nidhanakriyayā| nidhanam‌--vināśa ityarthaḥ| kriyāguṇagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇārtham‌| dravyeṇāpi nānāvācināmadhikaraṇānāṃ yugapadvyāptuṃ prayokturyecchā sā vopsaiva| tena grāme grāme pānīyamityatrāpi dviravacanaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| yastu `dravyasya dravyānteṇa saha sambandho na bhavati, siddharūpatvāt‌' ityāha, tasya yaduktam‌--kriyāguṇadravyaiḥ sākalyena kālādhvanoḥ sambandho'tyantasaṃyogaḥ' iti, tadvacanaṃ vyāhanyate; grāme grāme pānīyamityayaṃ ca śiṣṭaprayogo nopapadyate| atha kathaṃ grāmaśabdo'yaṃ vīpsāyāṃ varttate, yāvatā na tasyā vīpsāḥ-bhidheyā, kiṃ tarhi? janākīrmo bhūkhaṇḍaḥ? satyametat‌; yadyevam‌, tathāpi dvirvacanapratipattidbāreṇa tasyā dyotitatvāt‌ sa tasyāṃ varttata ityucyate| grāmo hi dvirvacanaṃ pratipadyamāno vīpsāṃ dyotayatīti tasyāṃ dyotanadvāreṇa varttate| atha gramo grāma iti kathamekavacanam‌, yāvatā bahutvāddhiprāmāṇāṃ bahuvacanenaiva bhavitavyam‌; atha kṛte dvirvacane? naitadasti; samudāya evātra bahutvamupajāyate, na pratyekam‌? upātaikatvasaṃkhye'vayave'viruddhaṃ hyekatvaṃ bahutvena| tenāvayavādbahuvacana na bhavati| samudāyāt‌ tarhi kathaṃ na bhavati? bahutvasyābagatatvādvīpsayā| sa hi samudāyo vīpsāyāṃ bahutvamantareṇa na sambhavatīti tāṃ prakāśayannāntarīyakatvādbahutvamapi gamayati| tato'vagatārthatvādbahuvacanaṃ na prayujyate| atha yat‌ tiṅantaṃ nityatayā prakarṣeṇa ca yuktam‌, tatra kiṃ kṛte dvirvacane prakarṣapratyayena bhavitavyam‌| atha vā kṛte prakarṣepratyaye dvirvacanena? ityata āha--`yattiṅantam‌' ityādi| atra vipratiṣedho hetuḥ| tatra dvirvacanasyāvakāśo yatra nityārtho vivakṣitaḥ, na prakarṣaḥ--pacatipacatīti; prakarṣapratyayasyāvakāśo yatra prakarṣeṇa yogaḥ, na nityatayā--pacatitarāmiti; yatra tūbhābhyāṃ yogastatra viprataṣedhena dvirvacanaṃ bhavati--pacatipacatitarāmiti| subantamapi tarhi yadvīpsayā prakarṣeṇa ca yuktam‌, tasmādata eva hetoḥ kṛtadvirvacanāt‌ prakarṣapratyayaḥ syāt‌, tataścāḍhyataramāḍhyataramānayeti na siddhyedityata āha-`iha tu' ityādi| yadi subantasyaikakālaṃ vīpsā prakarṣeṇa ca yogaḥ syāt‌, tadā syādayaṃ prasaṅgaḥ, sa na nāsti; yataḥ subantasya prakarṣapratyayena saṃyuktasya paścādvīpsayā yoga iṣyate| katham‌? iha hi vīpsā nāma pauruṣeyo dharma icchāviśeṣaḥ, sa ca tathā prayokturviduṣaḥ pravarttate yathā śabde nāniṣṭamāpadyate, nāpi prayoktari| yadi prakarṣapratyayāt‌ prāk‌ sahabhāvena vā vīpsā syācchabdeniṣṭamāpadyate, taddvāreṇa prayoktaryapi, yathā--helayo helaya iti brūvapsu puruṣeṣu; yajñeṣu cāniṣṭamāpadyate| tasmāt‌ prakarṣayogavivakṣāyā uttarakālaṃ śiṣṭasya prayokturvīpsayā bhavitavyamiti siddhamāḍhyataramāḍhyataramānayeti| aparaḥ prakāraḥ--ihāpi tarhi tata eva hetoḥ kṛte dvirvacane prakarṣapratyayaḥ syāt‌, tataścāḍhyataramāḍhyataramānayeti na siddhyati?--ityetasmin‌ pūrvapakṣa idamāha--`iha tu' ityādi| prakarṣasāhacaryāt‌ prakarṣapratyayaḥ prakarṣaśabdenoktaḥ| vīpsāsāhacaryāddhi dvirvacanaṃ vīpsāśabdena| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--prakarṣapratyayayuktasya dvirvacanena yoga iṣyata iti| atra cāyamabhiprāyaḥ--yena hetunā yugapat‌ prakarṣeṇa nityatayā ca yuktasya pūrvaṃ dvirvacanaṃ bhavati, sa vipratiṣedho'tra nāsti; atulyabalatvāt‌| atulyabalatvaṃ tu prakarṣa pratyayasyāntaraṅgatvāt‌, dvirvacanasya bahiraṅgatvāt‌| tathā hi ṅyāpprātipadikādātiśāyiko bhavati, dvirvacanaṃ tu padasya| `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) iti siddhāsiddhayoścāyukto vipratiṣedhaḥ| tasmāt‌ pahūrvaṃ prakarṣapratyayena subantādbhavitavyam, paścāt‌ tadantasya dvirvacaneneti| nanu cātiśāyiko naivāntaraṅgaḥ, samarthāddhi sa upapadyate, `samarthānāṃ prathamādvā' (4.1.82) ityadhikārāt‌, sāmarthya ca subantenaiva? naitat‌; uktaṃ hi tatraiva (4.1.82) `svārthikapratyayāvadhiścāyamadhikāraḥ prāgdiśo vibhaktiriti (5.3.1) yāvat‌, svārthikeṣvasyopayogo nāsti' iti| svārthikāścatiśāyikāḥ| tasmādantaraṅgatvādutpanne tasmin‌ paścāt‌ subantasya dvirvacanena bhavitavyam‌|| 5. parervarjane| (8.1.5) `pari pari trigarttebhyaḥ' iti| `apaparī varjane' (1.4.88) iti pareḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāyāṃ satyām‌ `pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' (2.3.10) iti pañcamī| `pariṣiñcati' iti| sarvatra siñcatītyarthaḥ| `upasargāt‌ sunoti' (8.3.65) ityādinā ṣatvam‌| `parervarjane'samāse vā' ityādi| parervarjane'rthe'samāse vibhāṣā dvirvacanaṃ bhavatītyetadartharapaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vibhāṣā veṣiṭiceṣṭyoḥ' (7.4.96) ityato maṇḍūkaplutyā vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, tenāsamāse dvirvacanaṃ parervarjane vibhāṣā bhavatīti| `asamāse' iti| vacanāt‌ samāse tu nityameva dvirvacanena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`samāse tu' ityādi| yathā dadhnopasikta odano dadhyodana itīhopasiktaśabdaḥ samāse'ntarbhūtaḥ, tathā `apaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā' (2.1.12) iti samāse kṛte tatra varjanam‌| pariśabdastu samāse'narthaka eva; tena varjane'rthe varttamānasya dvirvacanamucyamānaṃ samāse na bhavati| athāpi pariśabdo varjane'rthe'rthavān‌ syāt‌; evamapi samāsenaiva varjanārthapratyāyitatvānnaiva dvirvacanena bhavitavyam‌| `paritrigarttam‌' iti| samāsādutpannasya soḥ `nāvyayībhāvādato'stvapañcamyāḥ' (2.4.83) ityambhāvaḥ|| 6. prasamupodaḥ pādapūraṇe| (8.1.6) `prasamupodaḥ' iti| `dvandvāccudaṣahāntāt‌ samāhāre' (5.4.106) iti samāsānto na kṛtaḥ; samāsāntavidheranityatvāt‌| `pādapūraṇe' iti| `yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam‌' (2.3.37) iti saptamīyam‌| pādapūraṇasya bhāvenotpattilakṣaṇena dvirvacanasakya bhāvo lakṣyate| nanu ca dvirvacanāt‌ prāk‌ pādapūraṇamasadeva, tat‌ kutastasya bhāvo dvirvacanasya lakṣaṇaṃ syāt‌, na hi tat‌ sattvam‌? asārametat‌; tadutpattirhyatra bhāvaḥ, sā cāniṣpannasattākasyaiva bhavati, na niṣpannasattākasya| na hi mṛttikāvasthāyāṃ santo ghaṭādaya utpadyanteḥ pādaśceha viśeṣānabhidhāne'pi sāmarthyādṛca eva gṛhyate, na ślokasya| laukiko hi ślokaḥ, loke cārthaparatvādanarthakasya prayogo nopapadyate|| 7. uparyadhyadhasaḥ sāmīpye| (8.1.7) `sāmīpye' iti| pratyāsattāvityarthaḥ| etaccoparyādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇam‌| sāmīpyaṃ deśakṛtam‌, kālakṛtañca bhavati| tatra `uparyupari grāmam‌' iti deśakṛtasyodāharaṇam‌| samīpe grāmasyetyarthaḥ| dvitīyātra `ubhasarvatasoḥ kāryā dhiguparyādiṣu triṣu' (vā.118) ityādyupasaṃkhyānāt‌| kālakṛtasyodāharaṇam‌--`uparyupari duḥkham‌' iti| samīpaṃ yad‌duḥkhamacirakālātikrāntamacarakālabhāvi vā tadevamucyate| `atheha[`atha'--nāsti--kāśikā] kasmānna bhavati--upari śiraso ghaṭaṃ dhārayati' iti, asti hyatra ghaṭena śirasaḥ pratyāsttiḥ? ityāha--`upari śiraso ghaṭam‌' ityādi| na hīha śāstre vastunaḥ sattaiva śabdavyutpatteḥ prathānaṃ kāraṇam, kiṃ tarhi? tadvivakṣāpi, sā ceha nāsti| auttarādharyamātrasya vivakṣitatvāt‌| teneha na bhavati dvirvacanam‌| dvitīyayā'pi na bhavitavyam‌, nāmreḍitatvāt‌|| 8. vākyāderāmantritasyāsūyāsammatikopakutsanabhartsaneṣu| (8.1.7) ākhyātaṃ sādhyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyam‌, tasyādirvākyādiḥ| asūyādīnapekṣamāṇasyāpi gamakatvāt‌ samāsaḥ| `asūyāsammatikopakutsanabhartsaneṣu yadi tadvākyaṃ bhavati' iti| etenāsūyādīnāṃ vākyaṃ prati viśeṣaṇabhāvaṃ darśayati| nanu cāmantritasya viśeṣyatvāt‌ prādhānyam‌, vākyasya viśeṣaṇatvādaprādhānyam‌, tatra prādhānyādāmantritaṃ pratyevaiṣāṃ [`pratyeṣāṃ'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] viśeṣaṇatvaṃ yuktam‌? naitadasti; āmantritaviśeṣaṇatve hi sati teṣāmasūyādivṛtterevāmantritasya dvirvacanaṃ syāt‌--asūye asūya ityādau vākye, māṇavaka māṇavaketyādau tu vākye na syāt‌| vākyaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ [vākyaviśeṣaṇatve--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] hyasūyādīnāṃ sarvatra bhavati| tasmādvākyaviśeṣaṇataighāsūyādīnāṃ yukta; vyāpteḥ| kadā punarvākyamasūyādiṣu bhavati? yadā tasmin‌ vākye prayucyamāne asuyādayo gamyante| asahanam‌ akṣāntiḥ| pūjanam‌ śabdena guṇāviṣkaraṇam‌| `ete ca prayoktṛdharmāḥ' iti| yo vākyaṃ prayuṅakte tasyaite dharmā guṇaviśeṣā ityarthaḥ| prayoktṛdharmatvaṃ ca teṣāṃ prayoktari vṛtteḥ| `nābhidheyadharmāḥ' iti| abhidheye teṣāmavṛtteḥ| na hi yathā māṇavakādāvabhidheya ābhirūpyādayo dharmā varttante, tathā'sayādayaḥ| tathā hi--`māṇavakā maṇavaka ābhirūpakā abhirūpaka riktaṃ ta ābhirūpyam‌'--ityevaṃ vākyaprayoge prayoktṛgatā evāsūyādayaḥ pratayante, na tu māṇavakādigatāḥ| `riktam‌' iti| asāramityarthaḥ| `śaktike śaktike' iti| kutsitā śaktā| `prāgivāt‌ kaḥ' (5.3.70), `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ; ṭāp‌, `pratyayasthāt‌' (7.3.44) itīttvam‌, `sambuddhau ca' (7.3.106) ityettvam‌| `ānneḍitasyaiva' iti| bhartsane yaduktamihodāharaṇaṃ tadadhikṛtyaitaduktam‌, na tu `āmreḍitaṃ bhartsane' (8.2.95) ityanenāmreḍitasyaiva plutaḥ kriyate, api tu paryāyeṇa; `bhartsane paryāyeṇa' (vā.930) iti vacanāt‌| `śobhanaḥ khalvasi māṇavaka' ityatrāsti pūjanam‌, na tvāmantritaṃ vākyādi| `udāro devadattaḥ' ityatrāsti pūjanam‌| vākyāditvañcodāraśabdasya, na tvāmantritatvam‌| nanu cāsūyāyāḥ kutsanaṃ kāryam‌, bhartsanaṃ kopasya, tatra kutsanamatsaṃnayodvirvacane kṛte tataḥ pratīyamānābhyāṃ kutsanabhartsanābhyāṃ kopāsūyayorapi pratītirbhaviṣyati; kāryasya kāraṇāvyabhichārāt‌, tasmāt‌ kopāsūyayorgrahaṇaṃ na karttavyameva? naivam‌; na hi kopāsūyāprabhave eva kutsanabhartsane| tathā hi--pitrādayaḥ putrādīnanasayanto'pi kutsayanti, akupyanto'pi bhartsayante| yadyapi tadānīṃ kāyavāgvikāro'sti, tathāpi na tvasāvasūyā, nāpikopaḥ; tayoścaitasikatvāt‌| ataḥ kāryakaraṇabhāvasasyābhāvāt‌ kutsanabhartsanapratītyā kopāsūyayoḥ pratītirnopapadyate| atha kopāsūyāprabhave eva viśiṣṭe kutsanabhartsane, ye te gṛhītvā kopāsūyayoranumānaṃ kariṣyata iti cet‌? na; viśeṣasyāvadhārayitumaśakyatvāt‌| tathā hi--yathā'sayankutsayati tathā'nasūvannapi| yathā kupyannapi bhartsayate tathā'kupyannapi| tasmāt‌ kopāsūyayorapi grahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌|| 9. ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat‌| (8.1.9) yadyaviśeṣeṇaikaśabdasya bahuvrīhivadbhāvo vidhīyate, tadaikamityatrāpi syāditi manyamāno'tiprasaṅgaṃ parijihīrṣurāha--`ekamityetad‌dviruktaṃ bahuvrīhivadbhāvo bhavati' iti| kathaṃ punardviruktamityeva viśeṣo labhyate, yāvatā nāyaṃ sūtropāttaḥ? evaṃ manyate--vīpsā'nuvarttate, [`vīpsāmanuvarttate'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] vīpsāyāñca pūrvameva dvirvacanaṃ vihitam‌| na ca tadekaśabdasyānena bahuvrīhivadbhāvena bādhyate; anyathā hi `ekaikasya prācām‌' (8.2.86) iti nirdeśo nopapadyeta| tasmādvīpsāgrahaṇānuvṛtterdviruktasyaikaśabdasyāyaṃ bahuvrīhavadbhāvo vijñāyata iti| kiṃ punarbahuvrīhivadbhāve prayojanamityāha--`bahuvrīhivattve' ityādi| yadyapi sublṛkpuṃvadbhāvau bahuvrīhāvityevaṃ nocyete, tathāpyetau tatra dṛṣṭāvityasminnatideśe tayoḥ pravṛttiḥ prayojanam‌| `ekaikam‌' iti| vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacane kṛte yatā citragurityādau bahuvrīhau `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti sublugbhavati, tathehāpyatideśena| atideśenaiva samāse prātipadikatvāt‌ suḥ, `ato'm‌' (7.1.24) ityambhāvaḥ| `ekaikayā' iti| pūrvavadvibhakderluk‌, `striyāḥ puṃkt‌' (6.3.34) ityādinā yathā darśanīyabhārya ityatra bahuvrīhau puṃvadbāvo bhavati, tathehāpyatideśena, tṛtīyaikavacanam‌, `āṅi cāpaḥ' (7.3.105) ityettavam‌, ayādeśaḥ| nanu cāsatyapi puṃvadbhāve `vṛddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vṛddhāvapi kṛtāyāmetat‌ sidhyatyeva? yadyapyetat‌ sidhyati, tathāpi gatagatetyetat‌ `ābādhe ca' (8.1.10) iti dvirvacane kṛte na sidhyati| tasmāduttarasūtre puṃvadbhāvo bahuvrīhivadityasyātideśasyaiva prayojanatvenocyate| ekaikayetyetattu `ekamityeṣa napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśo'ntram‌' ityetatsūcayitumuktam‌| atantratvaṃ tu sūtre liṅganirdeśasya `ardhaṃ napuṃsakam‌' (2.2.2) ityatra napuṃsakagrahaṇena jñāpitam‌| yadi sautro nirdeśastantramabhaviṣyat‌, ardhamityatra tata eva nirdeśālliṅgaviśeṣe siddhe napuṃsakamiti nāvakṣyat‌| atha pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaratvamapi prayojanaṃ kasmānnocyeta? viśeṣābhāvā| parasya nighāte kṛte pūrvapadaprakṛtisvara eva bhaviṣyati| yadi tarhi bahuvrīhau yad‌vṛṣṭaṃ tadatidiśyate, sarvanāmasaṃjñāpratiṣedhasvarasamāsāntānāmapyatideśaḥ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`sarvanāmasaṃjñā' ityādi| kathaṃ punarete sarvanāmasaṃjñāpratiṣedhādayaḥ samāsādhikāre vihite bahuvrīhau śakyā vijñātum‌? ucyate; sarvanāmasaṃjñāpratiṣedhastāvat‌ `bahuvrīhau' (1.1.28) ityanuvarttamāne punarbahuvrīhi (1.1.29) grahaṇācca śakyate vijñātum‌| tasya hyatat‌ prayojanamuktam‌--bahuvrīhereva yo bahuvrīhistatra pratiṣedho yathā syāt‌, bahuvrīhivadbhāvena yo bahuvrīhistatara mā bhūditi| evañcārthāt‌ samāsādhikāravihita eva bahuvrīhau pratiṣedho vijñāyate| na hi tato'nyo bahuvrīhireva bahuvrīhīrbhavati; `ekaikasmai' ityāderbahuvrīhivadbhāvena bahuvrīhivattvāt‌| `nañsubhyam‌' (6.2.172) ityanenāpi `bahuvrīhāvidametattadbhyaḥ (6.2.162) ityato bahuvrīhigrahaṇe'nuvarttamāne nañsumyāṃ parasya bahuvrīhāvantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, na tu tayorapi; yasmāt‌ sunañādiha nimittatvenopāttau| na ca nimittayoḥ kāryitvaṃ yuktam‌| yathīktam‌--`nemau [`hayavaraṭ‌' (mā.sū.5) ityetasmin‌ sūtre bhāṣyakāreṇa] rahau kāryiṇau, kiṃ tarhi? nimittamimau dvirvacanasya' iti| tasmādyatra bahuvrīhau nañsūbhāṃ sunañoreva parabhūtatvāt‌ `ābādhe ca' (8.1.10) iti dvirvacanam‌, bahuvrīhivadbhāvaśca| atha vā svaravidhau `samāsasya' (6.1.223) ityataḥ samātagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tena ca bahuvrīhi viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ--samāso yo bahuvrīhiriti| nanu ca nana, susvityatāvapi samāsāveva, asti hyanayoreva bahuvrīhivadbhāvenotpāditā samāsasaṃjñā, tataśca viśiṣyamāṇa'pi samāsagrahaṇe na bahuvrīhau svaraḥ prāpnotītyeva? naiva doṣaḥ; viśiṣyate hi samāsagrahaṇena bahuvrīhiḥ, na kaścidasamāso bahuvrīhirasti, tatra viśeṣaṇasāmarthyāvatideśadbārema yasya samāsasaṃjñā tasya na bhavati| sa ca samāsādhikāre vihito bahuvrīhiriti vijñāyate| nanu ca samāsagrahaṇena bahuvrīhau viśiṣyamāṇe viśeṣaṇasāmarthyādviśiṣṭasya bahuvrīherivaṃ grahaṇamityetādanmātraṃ niścīyate, tatra tu viśiṣṭe bahuvrīhau sandeha eva? ucyate; bhavati vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattiḥ, na hi sandehādalakṣaṇa(vyā.pā.75)mityadoṣaḥ, samāsāntavidhāvapi `samāsācca tadviṣayāt‌' (5.3.106) ityataḥ samāsagrahaṇamanuvarttate| tatra samāsādhikārādeva samāsāntatve vakṣyamāṇānāṃ pratyayānāṃ siddhe samāsagrahaṇānuvṛttiviśiṣṭe samāse samāsāntatvaṃ yathā svādityevamarthaṃ vijñāyate| sa punarviśiṣṭaḥ samāso yaḥ samāsādhikāre vihitaḥ sa eva vyākhyānādveditavyaḥ| atha nanetyatra `nalopo nañaḥ' (6.3.73) iti nalopaḥ kasmānna bhavati, asti tasyāpi bahuvrīhau darśanam‌? naiṣa dīṣaḥ; `nalopo nañaḥ' ityatra hi uttaravadādhikāro'nuvarttate--uttarapade nalopo vidhīyate| nañ‌ ca kāryitvenopāttaḥ, kāryiṇaśceha nimittabhāvo nopapadyata iti naño'nyasminnuttarapade lopena bhavitavyam‌, yathā--abrāhmaṇa iti, na tu tasminneveti kuto nakāralopasya prasaṅgaḥ?|| 10. ābādhe ca| (8.1.10) `ābādhanabhāvādhaḥ' iti| bhāve ghañ‌| yadyatrābādho'bhidheyadharma āśrīyate, tadā bādhitapīḍitāviśabdānāmeva dvirvacanaṃ syāt‌, na tu gatādiśabdānām‌| prayoktṛdharma āśrīyamāṇe sarvatra bhavati| tasmādvyāptivyāyāt‌ prayoktṛdharma evāśrīyate, ityāha--`prayoktṛdharmaḥ' iti| `tatra varttamānasya' iti| dvirvacanapratipattidvāreṇa, bahuvrīhivadbhāvapratipattidvāreṇa ca tatprakāśanāt‌ tatra tasya vṛttirveditavyā, na tu tadabhidhānāt‌| na hi gatādayaḥ śabdā kathañcidābādhanamabhidadhati| cakāro vākyabhedamācaṣṭe| tena dvayamatra vidhīyate--ekena vākyena dvirvacanam‌, apareṇa ca bahuvrīhivadbhāvaḥ| `gatagataḥ' ityādau pūrvavat‌ sorluk‌| `gatagatā' ityādau tu puṃvadbhāvaḥ pūrvavadeva| `priyasya gamanādinā' ityādi| etena prayoktṛdharmatā'bādhasyeti darśayati| ādiśabdena vināśādergrahaṇam‌|| 11. karmadhārayavaduttareṣu| (8.1.11) karmadhārayavat‌ kāryaṃ bhavatītyanena kāryātadeśo'yamityācaṣṭe| kāryātideśasya phalamuttaratra darśayiṣyate| `karmadhārayavattve prayojanam‌' ityādi| tatra suglugbahuvrīhivadbhāve, asminnatideśe ca sādhāraṇaṃ prayojanam‌| puṃvadbhā vastu kvacit‌ sādhāraṇam‌, kvacidasādhāraṇam‌; yatra hi puṃvadbhāvasya praviṣedho nāsti--paṭupaṭvītyādau, tatra sādhāraṇam‌, yatra tu ' na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) ityādinā puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedho'sti--kālakakāliketyādau, tatrā sādhāraṇam‌| tathā hi yasya hi puṃvadbhāvaḥ pratividdhastasyāpi `puṃvatkarmadhāraya' (6.3.42) ityādinā karmadhāraye puṃvadbhāvo vidhīyate| antodāttatvaṃ tvasādhāraṇameva| yasmāt‌ karmadhāraya eva `samāsasya' (6.1.223) ityantodāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, na bahuvrīhau; tatra `bahuvrīhau prakṛtyā pūrvapadam‌' (6.2.1) iti pūrvapadaprakṛtasvarasya samāsāntodāttasyāpavādasya vidhīnāt‌| tatra yadasādhāraṇaṃ prayojanaṃ tadimamatideśaṃ prayojayati, netarat‌| taddhi bahuvrīhivadityatideśasyānuvṛttāvapi siddhyatyeva| sati tvanyārtho'syārambhe bahuvrīhivadityatideśasyānuvṛttirapārthikā; anenaiva sādhāraṇasyāpi siddhatvāt‌| ataḥ sublugādikamapi sādhāraṇaṃ karmadhārayavattve prayojanaṃ na bhavati| `paṭupaṭvī' iti| `voto guṇavacanāt‌' (4.1.44) iti ṅīṣ‌| sa ca pūrvapade puṃvadbhādena nivarttate| `kālakakālikā' iti| ajñātādyarthe `prāgivāt‌ kaḥ' (5.3.70), ṭāp‌, `ke'ṇaḥ' (7.4.13) iti hrasvaḥ, pūrvavadittvam‌| puṃvadbhāvena pūrvapade ṭābittvayornivṛttiḥ| kathaṃ punaratra puṃvadbhāvaḥ, yāvatā `na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) ityasya pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ? ityāha--`kopadhāyāḥ' [`na kopadhāyāḥ' ityādi--prā. mu. pāṭha] ityādi| karmadhāraye hi `puṃvatkarmadhāraya' (6.3.42) ityādināṃ yogena pratiṣedhaviṣayeṇa puṃvadbhāvo vihitaḥ tena kopadhāyā api puṃvadbhāvo bhavatyeva| nanu cābhreḍitānudāttatvamāṣṭikimam‌, samāsāntodāttatvaṃ ca ṣāṣṭhikam‌, ataḥ paratvādābhreḍitānudāttatvenaiva bhavitavyam‌; na caivaṃ sati karmadhārayadityatideśasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt‌, tasya prayojanāntare caritārthatvāt‌? ityata āha--`samāsāntodāttatvamanena' ityādi| śaltrātideśe hi śastredhvatidiṣṭeṣu taireva svadeśasthaiḥ kāryāṇi kriyanta ityābhreḍitānudāttasya samāsāntodāttatvāt‌ paratvaṃ syāt‌| na cāyaṃ śāstrātideśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? kāryātadeśaḥ| kāryātideśe satyatideśaśāstreṇaiva vidhiyate| tasmādantodattatvemeva param‌| atastasmāt‌ paratvādābhreḍitānudāttatvaṃ bādhate| nanu cāntareṇāpyuttaragrahaṇaṃ yathā `pratyayaḥ' (3.1.1) ityevamādīnāmadhikārāṇāmuttaratrāvasthānaṃ bhavati, tathā'syāpi bhaviṣyati; adhikārāṇāmuttaratrānudhṛttidarśanāt‌, tatkikamartham‌ `uttareṣu' iti vacanam‌? ityāha--`adhikāreṇaiva' ityādi| adhikārāṇāṃ kvacillakṣaṇatvasya vyavahāraḥ, yathā `śeṣe' (4.2.92) ityadhikārasya lakṣaṇatvamasti, taccāvispaṣṭam‌; anyeṣvadhikāreṣu `pratyayaḥ' (3.1.1) ityevamādiṣvadṛṣṭatvāt‌| tasmādasya vispaṣṭatvaṃ yathā syādityevamarthamuttareṣviti vacanam‌| etaddhi lakṣaṇatvamasya mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kriyate| yadi tu lakṣaṇasyādhikāreṣvasambhavaḥ syāt‌, uttareṣviti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; vyārttyābhāvāt‌| atha vā--siṃhāvalokitavyāyasyetyavyāhāraḥ| prāyeṇa hyaṇikāraṇamuttaratrānuvṛttirduṣṭeti sihāvalokitanyāyasyāvispaṣṭatā; keṣucit‌ pratyayādiṣvadṛṣṭatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ tasya vispaṣṭīkaraṇārthamuttareṣviti vacanam‌| yadi siṃhāvalokitanyāyena pūrvatrānuvṛtteradhikāraṇāṃ na sambhava eva syāt‌, uttareṣviti vacanamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; vyāvarttyābhāvāt‌|| 12. prakāre guṇavacanasya| (8.1.12) `prakāro bhedaḥ| sādṛśyaṃ ca' iti| ubhayannāpi prakāraśabdasya prayogadarśanāt‌| tatra bhede prayogo dṛśyate--bahubhiḥ prakārairbhuṅkte| bahubhirbhedaiḥ, viśevairbhuṅakta ityarthaḥ| sādṛśye'pi--bāhmaṇaprakāro'yaṃ māṇavakaḥ| brāhmaṇasadṛśa ityarthaḥ| `tadiha sādṛśyaṃ prakāro gṛhyate' iti| kuta etat‌? lakṣyānurodhāt‌| na hi kṛtadvirvacanāt‌ guṇavacanāt‌ padādiha bhedo gamyate, kiṃ tarhi? sādṛśyam‌| atra ca śabdaśaktisvābhāvyaṃ hetuḥ| `prakāre varttamānasya' iti dvirvavacanapratipattidvāreṇa taddyotanāt‌ tatra tasya vṛttirvijñeyā| `paripūrṇaguṇa' ityādi| etenodāharaṇe guṇavacanatya sādṛdaye vṛtti darśayati| upamānaṃ hi sādṛśyam‌| paripūrṇaḥ-sakalaḥ pāṭavādirguṇo yasya sa tathoktaḥ| sa eva nyūnaḥ-asakalo'parisamāpto yasya sa na tathoktaḥ| jātīyarapi prakāravacana eva vidhīyata iti nāprapte tasminnidāmārabhyata iti tadbādhanaṃ prāpnoti? iti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`jātīyaro'nena bādhanaṃ neṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi bādhanaṃ na bhavitavyati? vakṣyamāṇasyānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasyobhayorapi yogayoḥ śeṣabhūtatvāt‌| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ bādhanaṃ neṣyate? ityāha--`paṭujātīyo mṛdujātīya ityapi [ityādi bhavatīti'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] hi bhavati' iti| yastu `paṭupaṭujātīyo mṛdumṛdujātīyaḥ' iti prāyeṇa pustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ sa pramādakṛtaḥ| kutaḥ? ekasya kāryiṇo'nekeṣāṃ kāryāṇāṃ prāptau bādhyabādhakabhāvo bhavati| iha tu paṭudaṭumṛdumṛduśabdābhyāmeva prakārasya dyotitatvāt‌ tayoḥ punardvirvacanaṃ na prapnoti, nāpi jātīyar‌; tasmādapapāṭho'yam‌| `agnirmāṇavakaḥ, gaurvāhikaḥ' iti| agniśabdo gośabdaścānnāprakāre varttate| tathā hyagninā māṇavakasya sūdṛśyaṃ gamyate, gavā ca cāhīkasya| na hi tau guṇavacanau, kiṃ tarhi? dravyavacanau; māṇavakavāhīkayordravyatvāt‌| nanu camāvapi maṇavacanāveva, tathā hi--yajjātayastairuṇyādirguṇo yahno dṛṣṭastajjātīyameva guṇaviśeṣamupādāya so'yamityabhedopacāreṇa sambandhenopamānopameyabhāvena vā'gniśabdo'yaṃ māṇayake varttate; tameva guṇaviśeṣaṃ pratapādayituṃ pravṛttatvāt‌| evaṃ gośabdo'pi yajjātīyo jāḍyādirguṇaḥ sāsnādimati dṛṣṭaḥ, tajjātīyameda guṇaviśeṣamupādāya pūrvoktayoḥ sambandhayoranyatareṇa sambandhena vāhoke varttate, tasyaiva guṇaviśeṣasya pratipādanāya| tasmādguṇaviśeṣe pratipādayituṃ pravṛttāvimāvapi guṇavacanāveva, ityāha--`yadyapyatra' ityādi| yataḥ śabdāt‌ śrutimātreṇa yo'rthaḥ pratiyate sa tasya mukhyo'napacarito'rthaḥ| stvabhedopacārādinā nimittana kathañcidyatvena pratīyate, sa gauṇa iti| upacarita ityarthaḥ| agniśabdāt‌ śrutimātreṇa pāvakaḥ pratīyate, gośabdācca sāsnādimān‌| ato'gniśabdasya pāvako mukhyārthaḥ, gośabdasyāpi vāhikaḥ| mukhyenārthena yāvakādinā gauṇasya māṇavakādeḥ sambandhaḥ| pūrvoktayoḥ sambandhayoranyataro mukhyārthasambandhaḥ| tena hetunā karaṇena vā'vadhato niścito bhedo viśeṣo yasya taikṣṇyajāḍyāderguṇasya sa tathoktaḥ| kathaṃ punastena sambandhena tasya niścayo bhavati? tatpratīnī tatpratateḥ| sa hi guṇaviśeṣastasya sambandhasya hetuḥ; tasmin‌ sati tatsadbhāvāt‌| ataḥ sambandho dviprakāro'pi pratītaḥ san‌ tatpratītiṃjinayati; dhūma ivāgnau| tamevaṃvidhaṃ guṇaviśeṣameva yadyapi mukhyādarthādanyasmin‌ gauṇe'rthe gośabdo'gniśabdaśca pratipādayituṃ pravṛttaḥ, tathāpi sarvakālaṃ guṇavacano na bhavatīti na tad‌dvirucyate, tathā hi--yadāsāvamukhye'rthe sādharmyeṇa māṇavake vāhīke ca prayujyate, tadā guṇavacano na bhavatīti na tad‌dvirucyate, tathā hi--yadāsāvamukhye'rthe sādharmyeṇa māṇavake bāhīke ca prayujyate, tadā guṇavacano bhavati| yadā ca vahnau sāsnādimati ca, tadā jātivacano dravyavacano vā| tatra yadā'gniśabdo'gnitve varttate gośabdo'pi gotve, tadā jātivacanau bhavataḥ| yadā tu jātivacano dravyavacano vā| tatra yadā'gniśabdo'gnitve varttate gośabdo'pi gotvaṃ, tadā jātivacanau bhavataḥ| yadā tu jātyupalakṣite jatimati dravye tadā dravyavacanau| tasmāt‌ sarvakālamaguṇavacanatvānna bhavati tayordvirvacanam‌| etacca gaṇavacagrahaṇāllabhyate| prakāre hi varttamānaḥ śabdaḥ sarva eva guṇavacanaḥ sampadyate, ucyate cedaṃ vacanam‌ guṇavacanasyeti, tatra sarvaprakarṣāvagatirvijñāyate--sādhīyāna yo gumavacana iti| kaśca sādhīyān‌ guṇavacanaḥ? yaḥ [nāstīdaṃ vākyaṃ bhudrite] sarvadā guṇavacanaḥ| yadi tarhi sarvadā yo guṇavacanastasya dvirvacanena bhavitavyam‌; tadā paṭuśabdasyāpi dvirvacanaṃ na prāpnotīti, so'pi yadā pāṭavamātre guṇaviśeṣe varttate tadaiva guṇavacanaḥ; yadā tu tadvati dravye tadā dravyavacana eva? naitata; na hi viśeṣaṇamanabhidadhatā viśeṣyaṃ śakyamabhidhātum‌| ato viśeṣyaṃ dravyamabhidadhatā niyogato viśeṣaṇamavyabhidheyam‌| tasmasddravye'pi varttamānaḥ paṭuśabdastadviśaṣaṇamapi muṇamabhidadhātyeva| iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ--guṇamupasarjanībhūtamabhidadhāti, dravyaṃ tu pradhānabhūtamiti| ānupurvye, ityādi| avīpsārthamidama; vīpsāyā asambhavāt‌| talyajātīyānāṃ hi bhinnānāṃ vīpsā bhavati, yathā--yāmāṇām‌| sarve, hi ve grāmatvajāsyaikayā'dhyāsitatvāt‌ tulyujātīyā digdeśādibhedena bhinnāḥ| `mūle mūle sthūlāḥ' ityādau tu deṇ‌ naḍādonāṃ [`nalādīnām‌--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] ye bhāgasteṣāmekameva mukhyaṃ mūlaṃ yasyādhobhāgāntaraṃ na sanniviṣṭam‌| evakekameva ca mukhyamagraṃ graspoparibhāgāntaraṃ na sanniviṣṭam‌| tathā hi veṇormūlamityakte yasyādhobhāyāntaraṃ nāsti tatraiva pratītirupajāyate| tathā veṇoragramityukte yasyoparibhāgāntaraṃ nāsti tatreva gratītirupajāyate natareva| yastu teṣu mūlavyapadeśo'gravyapadeśaśca, so'pekṣākṛtaḥ, apari sanniviṣṭamapekṣya mūlavayapadeśaḥ, adhaḥsanniviṣṭamapekṣyāgramiti| tasmādyathā sarve grāmāstulyajātīyā na tathā veṇubhāgaḥ bhavanti| grāmāṇāṃ hi na kiñcidapekṣākṛtaṃ grāmatvam‌ bhāgānāṃ tvekasyaiva mukhyaṃ mūlatvamagratvañcānapekṣākṛtam‌| anekeṣāṃ bhāgānāṃ tūbhayam‌| yattadapekṣākṛtameva tasmādbhinnajātīyaḥ bhāgāḥ| na ca bhinnajātīyānāṃ vīpsā bhavati, yathā--sāsnādimatāṃ gadāṃ vāhikānāñca| na hi gorgaurityakte vāhīkagatāpi dīpāsā gamyate| apa caitāvātihārtho vivakṣitaḥ--ānupūrvyeṇa veṇu naḍādayaḥ [`nalādayaḥ'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] sthūlāḥ sūkṣmā veti pratiyate; na tu vīpsā| `rjyaṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ pradeśaya' iti| atrānupūrvyamātraṃ vivakṣitam‌| yaḥ sarveyāṃ jyeṣṭhasta tāvatpradeśaya, tatasatadanyeṣāṃ yo jyaṣṭhantaṃ pradeśayeti| anyathā yadyatra jyeṣṭhānāṃ vīpsā syāt‌ sarvakanīyasaḥ praveśo na syāt‌; tasya vīpsayā'vivayīkṛtatvāt‌, na hyasau jyeṣṭhaḥ| tasmādatrāpi nāsti vīpsā| tenānupūrvye dve bhavata ityedartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--yathā `śeṣe' (4.2.92) iti lakṣaṇañca, adhikāraśca; tathā `sarvasya dve' (8.1.1) ityetadapi lakṣaṇamadhikāraśca| tenānupūrvye dve bhavata
