ityuttaratrāpi dvirvacanavidhau yathāyogameva vyākhyānaṃ karttavyam‌| yadi tarhi `sarvasya dve ityetallakṣaṇamapi, evaṃ sati `nityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) ityāderveyarthatya na bhavati, tatraiva [`tathā hi'--pra.mu.pāṭhaḥ] `nityadīpsayoḥ' ityesādīnāma pa yogānām‌| `asmāt‌ kāṣapiṇādiha bhavadbhyāṃ mā māvaṃ dehi' ita| atra dbāvevetyavadhāryate| dvāveva dehi, naikam‌, nāpi bahunityarthaḥ| vināpi hyevakāraprayogeṇāvadhāraṇe gamyate; vivakṣitatvāt‌, yathā--pārtho dhanurdhara iti| nanu kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇe dīpsā na sambhavati? ityāha--`atra hi' ityādi| anena vīpsāyā abhāva darśayati| kārṣāpaṇau hyanekamāvasamudāyaḥ| na ca sarve māvā dānakriyayā vyāptumiṣyante, api tu dvādedeti nāstyatara vīpsā--māṣaṃ dehi, dvau māṣau dehi, krīn‌ māvān‌ dehīti| ekaṃ māṣaṃ dehi, dvau vā, trīna vā--ityayamatrārtho vivakṣitaḥ, na tvavadhāraṇamiti dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati| `sambhrameṇa' iti| tvarayā| `pravṛttiḥ' iti| pravattanam‌| `ahirahirbudhyasya budhyasva' iti| yadyayaṃ na vudhyate'ha carva nāvabodhayām‌, tato nūna dṛṣṭa [daṣṭaḥ--prā.mu.pāṭha] evāyamahineti matvā sambhrameṇaivaṃ vākya prayukte| `kriyāsamabhihāre dve bhavata iti vaktavyam‌' (vā.886), `ābhīkṣṇye dve bhavata iti vaktavyam‌' (vā.887) ityevaṃ vākyadvayaṃ loḍādibhireva tannityatāyā dyotitatvād‌dvivacanaṃ na prāpnotītyupanyastam‌| `nitya' ityādinā `nityavīpsayoḥ' (8.1.4) ityanenaivātra dvirvacanaṃ siddhamiti darśayati| yathā ca siddha tathā tatraiva `ktvāṇagalorloṭaśca dvirvecanāpekṣayā ityādinā granthena pratipāditam‌| paṭapaṭākaroti' iti| paṭacchapabdasya ḍāci viṣayabhūte'nutpanna eva dvirvacanam‌| tataḥ `avyaktānukaraṇāddvyarjavarārdhādanitau ḍāca' (5.4.57), nityamāmrīḍate ḍāji' (6.1.100) iti takārasya pararūpatvam‌| `paṭapaṭāyate iti| `lohitādiḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣa' (3.1.413), `vā kyaṣaḥ' (1.3.90) ityātmanapadam‌| `ḍhājantasya' iti| bhāviḍājantamabhipretyaivamuktam‌| tasmāt‌ ḍāci viṣayabhūte'nutpanna evaitad‌dvirvacanamiṣyate| ata eva vṛttikāreṇa `avyaktānukaraṇa' (5.4.57) ityādau sūtre uktam‌--ḍācīti viṣayasaptamīyamiti| atra `nityamāmreḍite ḍāci' (6.1.100) iti pararūpavidhānaṃ jñāpakam‌| tatra hya iti, antasyeti, ca varttate| yadi ḍāci parabhūte dvirvacanamiṣyate, tato ḍāci vihite paṭacchabdasya nityatvāṭṭilopenaiva prāgbhavitavyam‌; tathā ca satyacchabdābhāvāt‌ tat‌ parūpaṃ nopapadyate| tasmādviṣayasaptamīyam‌| evaṃ kṛtvā `nityamāmreḍite ḍāci' (6.1.100) ityatra yaduktam‌--`prāk‌ ṭilopād‌dvirvacanamiṣyate' iti, tadupapannaṃ bhavati| evaṃ hi prāk‌ ṭilopād‌dvirvacanaṃ sidhyati; yadi ḍāci viṣayabhūte tatra tadvidhīyate; anyathā hi yadi tasmin‌ parabhūte vidhīyeta, tato nityatvāt‌ prāk‌ ṭilopa eva syāt‌, na tu dvirvacanam‌| `dvitīyākaroti' ityādi| `kṛño dvitīyatṛtīya' (5.4.58) ityādinā ḍāc‌| `tadartham‌' iti| avyaktānukaraṇaḍājantasyaiva dvirvacanaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌| `kecit‌' iti vacanāt‌ kecidbahulamiti na paṭhantītyuktaṃ bhavati| teṣāmayamabhidaprāyaḥ--`sarvasya dve' ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenāvyaktānukaraṇaḍājantasyaivātra dvirvacanaṃ bhaviṣyati, nānyasyeti| tato nārtho bahulagrahaṇasyeti| `pūrvaprathamayoḥ' ityādi| `arthātiśayavivakṣāyām‌' iti| pūrvaprathamaśabdasya vācyasyātiśayaḥ prakarṣaḥ, tasya vivakṣā vaktumicchā, tasyāṃ dve bhavata ityetartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvameva kṛtam‌| `nāprāpte ātiśāyike dvirvacanamidamārabhyamāṇaṃ tasya bādhakaṃ prāpnoti' iti yo manyeta, taṃ pratyāha--`ātiśāyiko'pa dṛśyate' iti| katham‌? `sarvesya dve' (8.1.1) ityanenaiva dvirvacanaṃ vidhīyate| atra vibhāṣādhikārādvikalpena| tena yadā nāsti dvirvacanaṃ tadātiśāyako bhavati| `ḍataraḍatamayoḥ' ityādi| `kiṃyattadoḥ' (5.3.92) ityādinā itajvihitaḥ| ` vā bahūnāṃ jātiparipraśne' (5.3.93) ityādinā ḍatamac‌| samena guṇenāḍhyatvādinā nirūpaṇāyobhādimāvāḍhyāvityevamādiprakārā sā sampradhāraṇā| strīliṅgaśabdhaḥ strīliṅgayogāt‌ strītyuktaḥ| nigadyate'neneti nigadaḥ--`puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa' [`prāyeṇa'--nāsti mudrite] (3.3.118) iti ghaḥ| strīnigado yasya sa strīnigado bhāvaḥ| ḍataraḍatamāntayoḥ strīnigade bhāve varttamānayoḥ śabdayoḥ sampradhāraṇāyāṃ viṣayabhūtāyāṃ dve bhavataḥ| ḍataraḍatamagrahaṇamatropalakṣaṇārtha draṣṭavyam‌| ata eva vakṣyati--`ḍataraḍatamānyāmanyatrāpi dṛśyate' [`hi' ilyadhikam‌--kāśikā] iti| ihāḍhyatvaṃ kasyacit‌ sādhanasambandhakṛtam‌, kasyacidyatnakṛtam‌, kasyacidbhāgyasampatkṛtam| tatrobhāvimāvāḍhyāvityukte pratipattā kiṃkṛtamanayorāḍhyatvamiti pratipadyamānaḥ katarākatarā'nayorāḍhyateti vākyaṃ prayuṅakte, tadāḍhyatā vibhūtiparyāyaḥ strīnigado bhāvaḥ| tatra ca ḍataraḍatamānte varttate; tāṃ praṣṭuṃ pravarttitatvāt‌| `karmavyatihāre' ityādi| karmavyatihāraḥ kriyāvinimayaḥ| ekasyānyabhojanāpadarasyāpītaro bhojanādiḥ| samāsavadbhāvo'nena bahulaṃ vidhīyate| dvirvacanaṃ tu `sarvasya dve' (8.1.1) ityanenaiva siddham‌| sa ca samāsavadbhāvo bahulavacanādanyo'nyaśabde na bhavatyeva| itaretaraśabde tu nityam‌| asamāsapakṣe pūrvapadasya prathamaikavacanaṃ karttavyam‌| `anyo'nyamime brāhmaṇā bhojayanti' iti| anyamityasya dvitīyaikavacanāntasya dvirvacanam‌| atra samāsavadbhāvo nāstīti pūrvapadasya prathamaikavacanam‌| tasya ca `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66), `ato roraplutādaplute' (6.4.113) ityutvam‌; `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), `eṅaḥ padāntādati' (6.1.109) iti pūrvarūpatvam‌--ete vidhayo vidheyāḥ| `anyo'nyasya' iti| ṣaṣṭhyantasya dvirvacanam‌| anyo'nyasambandhinaṃ putrādikaṃ bhojayanti| anyo'pyasyetyarthaḥ| `itaretaraṃ bhojayanti' iti| dvitīyāntasya dvirvacane kṛte dvitīyaikavacanam‌, ami pūrvatvam‌ (6.1.107)| itaretarasya' iti| ṣaṣṭhyantasya dvirvacanam‌| subluki kṛte samāsaprātipadikatvāt‌ punaḥ ṣaṣṭhyekavacanaṃ bhavati| `strīnapuṃsakayoḥ' ityādi| strīnapuṃsakayoryat‌ sarvanāma karmavyatihāre varttate taduttarapadasya vikalpenāmbhāvo vaktavyaḥ| uttarapadasyetyavayavasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī, tenottarapadasya yā vibhaktiravayavabhūtā tasyā ayamādeśo bhavati| sthāne ṣaṣṭhyāṃ hyasyāmanekāltvāt‌ sarvādeśaḥ syāt‌| `anyonyāmime brāhmaṇyo bhojayataḥ' iti| anyāmityasya dvirvacanam‌, vibhakterāmbhāvaḥ, pūrvapadasya bahulavacanādhrasvatvam‌, pūrvavadrutvādi| `anyo'nyam‌' ityatra uttarapadasyāpi pūrvavad‌ hlasvatvādiḥ| `itaretarāṃ bhojayataḥ' iti| samāsavadbhāve sati sarvanāmno vṛttimātre puṃvadbhāvena (jaina.vṛ.103) ṭāpo nivṛttiḥ| evaṃ `itaretaram‌' ityatrāpi|| 13. akṛcchre priyasukhayoranyatarasyām‌| (8.1.13) nañatra vipakṣe varttate'dharmānṛtādivat‌| kṛcchram‌-duḥkham‌, prayatnaḥ-prayāsa ityarthaḥ; sa punaḥ prāṇidharmaḥ| kṛcchravipakṣo'kṛcchram‌; prāṇidharma eva, yasmin‌ sati prayatnamantareṇaiva dānādikriyāṃ sampādayati| tatra varttamānayoḥ priyakhaśabdayordve bhavataḥ| priyapriyeṇa dadāti| vinā prayāsena dadātītyarthaḥ| tṛtayaikavacanāntasya dvirvacane kṛte sublaki ca punastṛtīyaikavacanameva samāsavadbhāvena bhavati| `priyaḥ putraḥ, sukho rathaḥ' iti| nātra priyasukhaśabdau kṛcchravipakṣe prāṇidharmaviśeṣe varttate, kiṃ tarhi? dravyayoḥ| putro hi prīṇātīti kṛtvā priya ityucyate, ratho'pi sukhayatīta kṛtvā sukhaḥ|| 14. yathāsve yathāyatham‌| (8.1.14) `yathāsvam‌' iti| `yathā'sādṛśye (2.1.7) iti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāvaḥ| svaśabdo hīhātmavacanaḥ, ātmīyavacano vā--iti darśayitumāha--`yo ya ātmā' ityādi| `yathāyatham‌' iti| `hrasvo napuṃsake' (1.2.47) iti hrasavaḥ|| 15. dvandvaṃ rahasyamaryādāvacanavyutkramaṇayajñapātraprayogāmivyaktiṣu| (8.1.15) `pūrvapadasyāmbhāvaḥ' ityādi| dvirvacane kṛte dvi-au iti sthite subluki kṛte'mbhāvo'tvañcobhayamapīkārasya kriyate, yathā kramaṃ samudāyāt‌ suḥ, `ato'm‌' (7.1.24) iti kṛte'mi pūrvatvañca (6.1.107), anyathā hi dvandvasiti rūpaṃ ta sidhyet‌| kiṃ punaredeṣu rahalyādidācyeṣu dvandvamiti nipātyate? uta viṣayabhūteṣvityata āha--`tatra' ityādi| rahaḥ-guptiḥ, tatra sādhu rahalyam‌, `tatra sādhuḥ' (4.4.98) iti `prāgdhitādyatta' (4.4.75)| atha vā--rahasi bhavamiti digāditvādyat‌ (4.3.54)| `maryādādacane' iti| maryādaḥ-sthityanatiktamaḥ, tasyā vacanaṃ maryādāvacanam‌| vacanagrahaṇam‌--śabdopāttāyāṃ maryādāyāṃ yathā syāt‌, arthaprakaraṇādinā gamyamānāyāṃ mā bhūt‌| `ācaturam‌' iti| `āṅ‌ maryādābhividhyoḥ' (2.1.13) ityavyayībhāvaḥ; `avyayībhāve śaratprabhṛtibhyaḥ' (5.4.107) samāsāntaṣṭac‌| udāharaṇe bharyādārthamabhivyaktīkarttamāha--`mātā putreṇa' ityādi| mātā hi mithutāya caturaḥ santānajān‌ prāpnoti, na tu tato'dhikān‌ putrapautrapayautratatputrān‌| `maryādārthaḥ' iti| maryādevartho maryādārthaḥ| `prayunakti' iti| upakalpayatītyarthaḥ| `dvandvāni' iti| śītoṣṇādīni sukhaduḥkhahetūnityarthaḥ| [sukhaduḥkhahetūnītyarthaḥ--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] yadi yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, rahasyādigrahaṇamanarthakam‌? nānarthakam‌; prapañcārthatvāt‌| dvandvamityasya vā yogavibhāgasyāsarvaviṣayajñāpanārthatvāt‌|| 16. padasya| (8.1.16) `prāgapadāntādhikārāt‌' iti| `apadāntasya bhūrdhanyaḥ' (8.3.55) ityataḥ prāk‌| anantareṣu yogeṣvāmantritādeḥ subantasya tiṅantasya ca yat‌ kārya vidhīyate tatrāntareṇāpi padādhikāraṃ padasyaiva kāryaṃ labhyate, atastānullaṅdhya yatra padādhikārasyopayogastamevopanyasyata| `vakṣyati--saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' iti| `ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' (1.1.49) iti niyamāt‌ `padasya' ityeṣā sthānaṣaṣṭhī| sthānaṣaṣṭhyāñcāsyān‌ `udāttasvaratayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya' (8.2.4) ityasyāyamartho jāyate--udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ paro yo'nudāttastadantasya padasya svarito bhavatītiḥ tathā cātraiva syāt‌--kumāryāviti, kumārya ityatra na syāt‌| na hyetadudāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ paro yo'nudāttastadantaṃ padam‌, kiṃ tarhi? sakārāntam| `ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) ityatrāpi sthānaṣaṣṭhyāmasyāmayamartho jāyate--udāttānudāttayorya ekadeśastadantasya padasyodātto bhavatīti| tathā cātraiva syāt‌--vṛkṣāviti, vṛkṣā ityatara na syāt‌| na hyatrodāttānudāttayorya ekādeśastadantaṃ padam‌, kiṃ tarhi? sāntamiti yaścodayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`vakṣyamāṇavākyāpekṣayā' ityādi| hetāviyaṃ tṛtīyā| vakṣyamāṇānāṃ vākyānāṃ yā'pekṣā tayā hetubhūtayā padasyādhikṛtasya ṣaṣṭhyarthavyavasthā draṣṭavyā| vyavasthā-niyama ityarthaḥ| vakṣyamāṇāni hi vākyāni kānicit‌ `saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' (8.2.23) ityevamādīni padasyeti sthānavaṣṭhīmapekṣante| kānicit‌ `udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ' (8.2.4) ityevamādīnyavayavaṣaṣṭhīmiti| ata eva parāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhyarthe niyamo bhavati| adhikārā hi parārthā bhavanti| evañcaiṣāṃ parārthatā bhavati yadi te parāpekṣānurodhenārthamātmasāt‌ kurvanti| `kyacit‌' ityādinā tāmeva ṣaṣṭhyarthavyavasthāṃ darśayati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇan‌ `ṣaṣṭho `sthāne yogā' (1.1.49) ityeṣa niyamo'tra na pravarttate? evaṃ manyate--sambandhandhyantarāpekṣayā niyamo'yam‌| yogo hi sambandhaḥ, sa cānekasambandhyādhāraḥ| na cehādhikārasūtre sambandhyantaraṃ vidyate, ato nāstyeva tasyehopasthānamiti|| 17. padāt‌| (8.1.17) `prāk‌ kutsane ca supyagotrādau' ityādi| kuta etat‌? atra kecidāhuḥ--"`supi' (8.1.69) iti yeyaṃ saptamī tathā `padāt‌' ityasyāḥ pañcamyā nimittabhāvasya bādhitatvānnotsahate pravarttitum‌, ato bādhyate pañcasyā nimittabhāvaḥ" iti, etaccāyuktam‌; na hi saptamīpañcamyornimittatve satyāśrīyamāṇe kaścidvirodhaḥ| tatraivamabhisambandhaḥ syāt‌--padāta paraṃ yattiṅantaṃ kutsanavācini subante paratastasminnihanyata iti, tataścehaiva syāt‌--devadattaḥ pacati pūtīti, iha tu na syāt‌--pacati pūtīti| kiñca `canacidivagotrāditaddhitābhreḍitedhvagateḥ' (8.1.57) ityatrāpi padādityasyānuvṛttirna syāt‌| saptamyā `padāt' ityasyāḥ pañcamyāḥ bādhitatvāt‌; tataśca nidyātārthameva sūtre syāt‌| canādiprayoge sati vijñāyeta--tasmāditi| ato'dhikārāṇāṃ pravṛttinivṛttī bhavata iti samādheyam‌| atha vā--padādisyetat‌ pratiṣedhena sambaddham‌| ataḥ `kutsane' (8.1.69) ityatara pratiṣedhe nivṛtte `padāt‌' ityetadapi nivarttate|| 18. anudāttaṃ sarvamapādādau| (8.1.18) `yat‌ te niyatam‌' ityādi| atra `mṛtyo' ityetadāmantritaṃ padaṃ bhavati rajasamityetasmāt‌ padāt‌ paran‌| kintu mṛtyo anavadhṛṣyabhityasya padasyādau varttata iti na bhavati nighātādeśaḥ| asminnasati `āmantritasya ca' (6.1.198) ityāmantrisya ṣāṣṭhikamevādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `rudro viśva' iti| atra `devaḥ'--ityasmātpadāt‌ paraṃ `yuṣmākam‌' ityetat‌ padaṃ bhavati, kintu `yuṣmākaṃ kuladevatā' ityasya pādasyādau varttata iti na bhavati vasādeśaḥ| anantare'pi pratyudāharaṇe `asmākaṃ śatrumarvanaḥ' ityasya pādasyādau varttte'smākamityetatpadam‌| tena `bhagavān‌' ityasmāt‌ padāt‌ parasyāpi tasya nasādeśo na bhavati| `pādagrahaṇenātra ṛkpādaḥ ślokapādaśca gṛhyate' iti| viśeṣānupādānāt‌| atha sarvagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `anudāttaṃ padamekavarṇam‌' (6.1.158) iti padeṣu svarita udātto vaiva eva bhavati; tasya cānudātta ādiṣṭe sarvamevānudāttaṃ padaṃ jāyate? ityāha--`sarvagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| `anūdyamānam‌' ityādinā sarvagrahaṇasya prayojanamācaṣṭe| tad‌dvividhaṃ padam‌--anūdyamānam‌, vidhīyamānañca| tatra yat‌ siddhameva kāryantarārthaṃ saṃkīrtyate nadanūdyamānaṃ padam‌, yattvapūrvameva vidhīyate tadvidhīyamānam‌; tadubhayamapyanudāttaṃ yathā syādityevamarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇam‌| tena kiṃ siddhaṃ bhavati? ityāha--`tena' ityādi| yuṣmadasmadādeśā hi vidhīyamānatvādasiddhasattākāḥ| siddhasya hi vastuno dharmāntaraṃ khasyate kartum‌, yathā--niṣpannarūpasya vāsaso rāgaḥ, nāniṣpannasya; tathā tasyaivānupajātāvasthasya| tatrāsati sarvagrahaṇe yadeva siddhasattākaṃ padamanūdyamānamāmantritādi, tasyaidānudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate, na tu yuṣmadasmadādeśānām‌| sarvagrahaṇe tu sati teṣāmapi vidhīyate| atha kriyamāṇe'pi sarvagrahaṇe kathaṃ yuṣmadasmadādeśānāmapyanudāttatvaṃ śakyaṃ vidhātum‌? na hi tena teṣāṃ vidhānakāle yadasiddhatvaṃ tadapanītam‌? ityata āha--`vākyabhedena' ityādi| sarvagrahaṇasāmarthyādatra vākyabheda ukto bhavati, na hyanyathā sarvagrahaṇasyānudāttatvaṃ śakyaṃ vijñātum‌| tatraikena vākyenādeśā vidhīyante dvitīyena ca teṣāmanudāttatvam‌| kathaṃ tarhi vidhīyamānamityuktam‌, yāvatā vihitānāmeva yuṣmadasmadādeśānāṃ vākyāntareṇānudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate? yadiha prakaraṇe vidhīyamānaṃ tadvihitaṃ saduttarakālamanudāttaṃ yathā syāt‌--ityayaṃ tetrābhiprāyo veditavyaḥ| yadyasiddhasya dhamantiramaśakyaṃ vidhātum‌, tatkathaṃ `luṅalaṅlṛṅkṣvaḍudāttaḥ' (6.4.71) ityatra vidhīyamānasyāṭa udāttatvaṃ vidhīyate? tatrāpi vacanaprāmāṇyādvākyabhedaḥ kṛto bhavet‌--tatraikena vākyenāṅ‌vidhīyate, apareṇa tu vihitasyodāttatvam‌; iha tvasati sarvagrahaṇe vākyabhedo na labhyata ityanudāttatvameva na syāt‌ anudāttavacanasyāmantritādiṣu caritārthatvāt‌| `yuṣmadasmadādeśāśca' iti| caśabdaḥ prayojanāntarasamuccaye| idañcānyat‌ sarvagrahaṇasya prayojanam‌--yuṣmadasmadorvānnāvādaya ādeśā sarvasya subantasya padasya yathā syuriti; anyathā hyasati sarvagrahaṇe `yuṣmadasmadoḥ' (8.1.20) iti ṣaṣṭīnirdeśādvibhaktiṃ vihāya tayoḥ kevalayoreva syuḥ| nanu ca `padasya' (8.1.16) iti varttate, vibhakyantaṃ hi padam‌, tatrāntareṇāpi sarvagrahaṇaṃ sarvasya savibhaktikasyaiva padasya bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`yatrāpi' ityādi| svādau padaṃ svādipadam‌, `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ; tatpunaryasya `svādiṣvasarvanāmasthāne' (1.4.17) iti padasaṃjñā vihitā| asati sarvagrahaṇe yatra vibhaktyantaṃ padaṃ tatraiva savibhaktikasya padasya syuḥ| yatra vibhaktau parataḥ pūrva padaṃ tatra na syuḥ, iṣyante ca tatrāpi sarvasya| tasmādyatrāpi svādipadaṃ caturthīdvivacanādau tatrāpi sarvasya subantasya yathā syuḥ ityevamarthaṃ `sarvam‌' tyuceyate| nanu cāmantritasya padāt‌ parasyānudattatvaṃ vakṣyati| tatra nāprāpte āmantritādyudāttatva idamanudāttatvamārabhyata iti tasyāpadādaḥ, tataśca tena tasmin‌ bādhite prakṛtilvaratvamāmantritalyāpadyeta; sarvagrahaṇāttu sarvasvaraprāptirāmantritānudāttatvena bādhyate, tasmāt‌ sarvasvaraprāptibādhanārthamapi sarvagrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati? nārhatyevaṃ bhavitum‌; anudāttaśabdo hyayamāmantritasamānādhikaraṇaḥ sarvasvaraprāptiṃ bādhiṣyate| na hyādyudāttatve pratiṣiddhe prakṛtisvare kriyamāṇe'nudātta śabdenāmantritamucyate| tasmāt‌ pūrvoktameva sarvagrahaṇasya prayojanam‌|| 19. āmantritasya ca| (8.1.19) `āmantritādyudāttatve prāpta idamucyate| iha padādhikāramātraṃ prakṛtya nighātayuṣmadādeśā vidhīyamānā yatrāpi neṣyante, tatrāpi prasajanti| yatrāpi kvacidiṣa,yante, tatrāpi kvacinna prāpnuvanti, ata etaddoṣaparijihīrṣayā''ha--`samānavākye' ityādi| yasmāt‌ padāt‌ parasyāmantritādernighātādi kāryaṃ vidhīyate, tayoḥ samāna ekasmin‌ vākya ādhārabhūte sati vighātādayo vidhīyanta iti vaktavyam‌| kimartham‌? ityāha--`iha' ityādi| `ayaṃ daṇḍaḥ' iti| atrāstītyetadapekṣate| aprayujyamānamapi gamyata it tathoktam‌| `yatrānyat‌ kriyāpadaṃ nāsti tatrāstirbhavantīparaḥ prayujyate ityaprayujyamāno'pi gamyate' iti, tadevamastītyanena gamyamānena sahitamayaṃ daṇḍa ityekaṃ dhākyam‌, harānenetyaparam‌| tatra yadyekavākye nighātādayo nocyeran‌, tato daṇḍādiśabdādatiṅantāt‌ parasya haretyasya tiṅantasya nighātaḥ prasajyeta| nanu padavidhirayam‌, sa ca sāmarthye sati bhavati, na ceha tadasti, ato'sāmarthyānnidhāto na bhaviṣyatīti cedihāpi tarhi na syāt‌--iha devadatt mātā te kathayati, nadyāstiṣṭhati kūle, śālīnāṃ ta odanaṃ dāsyāmīti| na hyatrehetyanena devadattetyāmantritasyāsti sāmarthyam‌; api ca vidyata evāyaṃ daṇḍo harānenetyatra sāmarthyam, tathā hyaneneti sarvanāmnā yata karaṇena pratyavamuśyate taddharetyetadapekṣate| tacca pratyāsattervaṇḍa evetyasti daṇḍasya haretyetasya ca vyapekṣālakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyam‌| `odanaṃ paca tava bhaviṣyati' iti| odanaṃ pacetyakaṃ vākyam‌, tava bhaviṣyatītyaparam‌| `odanaṃ paca mama bhaviṣyati' iti| atrāpyodanaṃ pacetyekaṃ vākyam‌, mama bhaviṣyatītyaparam‌| tatra yadyekavākye yuṣmadasmadādeśā nocyeran‌, tataḥ pacetyetasmāt‌ padāt‌ parayoryuṣmadasmadostu `temayāvekavacanasya' (8.1.22) iti temayāvādeśo syātām‌, asti hyatrāpi sāmarthyam‌| tathā hi--yuṣmacchabdadācyo'smacchabdavācyaśca yo'rthastatsādhanena pākena tattvāmikaudano bhaviṣyatītyevambhūtā pākasya yuṣmadasmadośca vyapekṣā vidyate| asaḥ samānavākyagrahaṇe tu sati na kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| `iha ca' ityādi| caśabdaḥ samucyaye| idañcāparamattyā iṣṭeḥ prayojanamiti darśayati| `iha devadatta mātā te kathayati' ityekaṃ vākyam‌, `nadyāstiṣṭhati kūle' iti dvitīyam‌| `śālīnāṃ ta odanaṃ dāsyāmi' iti tṛtīyam‌| tatra prathame vākye--ihetyasmāt‌ padāt‌ parasya devadattasyāmantritasyānena nighāto yathāsyāt‌, dvitīye--nadyā itvasmātparasya yuṣmacchabdasya `temayāvekavacanakya' (8.1.22) iti ta ityevamādeśo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ samānavākye nighātādayo veditavyāḥ| asmacchabdādeśodāharaṇamiha nopanyastam‌; yuṣmacchabdādeśodāharaṇenaivāvagamyamānatvāt‌| tātpunaḥ śālaunāmodanaṃ me dehītyevaṃjātīyakaṃ tatra draṣṭavyam‌| kiṃ punaḥ syādyadi samānavākye nighātayuṣmadasmadādeśā nocyeraṇ‌? ityata āha--`āmantritāntam‌' ityādi| prathame tāvadvākye--ihetyetadadhikaraṇapradhānam‌, adhikaraṇañcādheyāpekṣam‌, taccādheyaṃ mātā na tu devadattaḥ| iha te svitā mātā kathayatītyarthaḥ| tasmādihaśabdena nāstidevadattatyasyāmantritasya sāmarthyam‌| dvitīye tu nadyā ityetasmāt‌ paraṃ tiṣṭhatītyetat‌ tiṅantam‌| na ca tasyā nadyā ityanena sāmarthyam‌; kiṃ tarhi? kūla ityasya| tṛtīye'pi--śālīnāmityasmāt‌ padādyuṣmacchabdaḥ paraḥ, ma tu śālīnāmityanena tasya sāmarthyamasti, kiṃ tarhi? odanasyeti| tataḥ sāmarthyābhāvāt‌ tadāśrayā nighātādayo na tyuḥ| `tadāśrayāḥ' iti| ihetyetat‌ padaṃ `nadyā' ityecchālīnāmityetacchāśrayo nimittaṃ yathāṃ te tathoktāḥ| atha vā--tat‌ sāmarthyamāśrayo yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ| asalyāṃ hyasyāmiṣṭau padādadhikārāt‌ padavidhirnighātādi kāryaṃ bhavati, sa ca sāmarthyanibandhanaḥ| tacca sāmarthyamiha nāstīti kuto nighātādeḥ prasaṅgaḥ! tasmādasāmarthye'pi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ samānavākye nighātādi kārya vaktavyam‌|| 20. yuṣmadasmadoḥ ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsthayorvānnāvau| (8.1.20) `ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsyayoḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhyādiṣu yau tiṣṭhatastau tathoktau| `supi sthā' (3.2.4) iti kaḥ| ki punaḥ kāraṇaṃ dvivacanāntayorevodāharaṇa panyastam‌? ityāha--`ekavacanāntabahuvacanāntayoḥ' ityādi| atha sthagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na `yuṣmadasmadoḥ ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitauyāsu' ityevocyeta, ṣaṣṭhyādiṣu vidhīyamānedhvavaśyaṃ yuṣmadasmadostātsthyaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`sthagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| śrūyamāṇā vibhaktirarthaḥ prayojanaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tat‌ tathoktam‌| [`tathoktaṃ bhavati--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] etaduktaṃ bhavati--śrūyamāṇaā ṣaṣṭhyādikā vibhaktirādeśasya nimittaṃ kathaṃ nāma labhyetetyevamarthaṃ sthagrahaṇamiti? tena vibhaktiryatrana śrūyate tatra na bhavatīti--ayaṃ yuṣmatputro'yamasmatputra iti| asati tu sthagrahaṇe luptāyāmapi vibhaktau pratyayalakṣaṇena (1.1.62) syātāmevādeśau| aśrūyamāṇaraṇaṃ punaratra vibhakteḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamāse kṛte `supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ' (2.4.71) iti luptatvāt‌| katham‌? punaḥ sthagrahaṇe śrūyamāṇā [eṣa paṃktibhāgaḥ kā. mudritenopalabhyate] vibhaktirādeśasya nimittatvena labhyate? śrūyamāṇāyāmeva tasyāṃ tātsthyasya sambhavāt‌| atha vā--tiṣṭhatirayamaparihāṇāvarthe varttate, yathā--`samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva' [`na ca saṅkucitaḥ panthāḥ yena vālī hato gataḥ| samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva mā vālipathamanvagāḥ||'] (vā.rā.kiṃ.sa.30.ślo.81) iti| samayaṃ na parijahihītyarthaḥ| tenaivaṃ vijñāyate--ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāmaparijahatoryuṣmadasmadorādedhāviti| evaṃ ca vijñāyamāne śrūyamāṇaiva vibhaktirādeśasya nimittatvenopāttā bhavatīti|| 21. bahuvacanasya vasnasau| (8.1.21) 22. temayāvekavacanasya| (8.1.22) kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhīcaturthyantayorevodāharaṇamupanyastam‌, na dvitīyāntayoḥ? ityāha--`dvitīyāntasya' ityādi|| 23. tvāmau dvitīyāyāḥ| (8.1.23) 24. na cavāhāhaivayukte| (8.1.24) `ebhiryukte' iti| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) ebhiryoga ityarthaḥ| atha vā--`tayoreva kṛtyakta khalarthāḥ' (3.4.70) iti karmaṇi ktaḥ| ebhiryukte sambaddhe| kasmin‌? yuṣmacchabde'smacchabde ca| yadyapi tau dvirvacanāntau prakṛtau, tathāpīha pratyekamabhisambandhādekavacanaṃ kṛtam‌| `tava, mama' iti| `yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅaso'ś‌' (7.1.27), `tavamamau ṅasi' (7.2.96)| `yuvayorāvayoḥ' iti| `yuvāvau dvivacane' (7.2.92)| `yuṣmākamasmākam‌' iti| `sāma ākam‌' (7.1.33)| `tubhyaṃ mahyam‌' iti| `ṅeprathamayoram‌' (7.1.28) ityam‌, `tubhyamahau ṅayi' (7.2.95)| `dhuṣmabhyamasmabhyam‌' iti| `bhyaso bhyam‌' (7.1.30)| `tvāṃ mām‌' iti| `tvamāvekavacane' (7.2.97) iti tvamādeśau, `dvitīyāyāṃ ca' (7.2.87) ityāttvam‌| `yuṣmān‌, asmān‌' iti| `śaso na' (7.1.29), `pūrvavadāttvam‌'| `yuktagrahaṇaṃ sākṣādyogapratipattyartham‌' iti| sākṣādavyavadhānena cādibhiryogaḥ| tasya pratipattiryathā syādityevamartha yuktagrahaṇam‌| kathaṃ punaryuktagrahaṇe sākṣādyogapratipattirbhavati? evaṃ manyate--aparisamāptatvādasya vākyasya tṛtīyānirdeśa eva yuktagrahaṇamadhyāhariṣyati, yathā--`tulyārthe ratulopamābhyām‌' (2.3.72) ityatra| tasmādyuktagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyameva? tat‌ kriyate sākṣādyogapratipattiryathā syāditi| anyastvāha--padavidhirayam‌, padavidhiśca samarthānāmeva bhavati, tatra padavidhitvādeva yoge labdhe yadyuktagrahaṇaṃ kriyate tat‌ sākṣādyogapratipattiryathā syāditi? etaccāyuktam; asāmarthye'pi nighātādikāryaṃ samānavākye bhavatītyuktametat‌| kadā punaścādibhiḥ sākṣādyuṣmadasmadoryogaḥ? yadā tadarthagatān‌ samuccayādīnarthāste dyotayanti| ihaite cādayaḥ samuccayādinā dyotyenārthenārthavantaḥ, tatra yadā yuṣmadasmadanugatāneva samuccayādīn‌ dharmān‌ dyotayanti, tadā cādibhiḥ sākṣādyuṣmadasmadoryogaḥ| yadā tu grāmādisambandhyantaragatāḥ, tadā yuktayogaḥ, na tu sākṣādyogaḥ| tatra yuktayoge pratiṣedho na bhavati--grāmaśca te svaṃ nagarañca me svamiti| tatra grāmaśabdo nagaraśabdaśca caśabdena yuktaḥ; tadarthagastasya samuccayasya tena dyotanāt‌| yuṣmadasmacchabdau tu grāmanagarābhyāṃ yuktau; tayostābhyāṃ svasvāmikatvasambandhasyārthasyeha sambhavāt‌| nanu ca sākṣādyogapratipattyarthaṃ yuktagrahaṇam‌--yuktayukte mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kathaṃ kriyate, na ca cādiyoge pratiṣedha ucyamāno yuktayukte prāpnoti, na hi yaścādibhiryuktayuktena yogaḥ sa cādiyogo bhavati, tatkiṃsākṣādyogapratipattyarthena yuktagrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhyetadeva yuktagrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati--iha pratiṣedhakāṇḍe yuktayukte'pi pratiṣedho bhavatīti| tenottarasūtre yadvakṣyate--`pasyārthairyuktayukte'pi pratiṣedhaḥ' iti tadupapannaṃ bhavati|| 25. paśyārthaiścānālocane| (8.1.25) paśyārthairiti bahuvrīhiḥ| tatra `paśya' iti yadi `pādhradhmādheṭvṛśaḥ śaḥ' (3.1.137) iti karttari śapratyayāntaḥ syāt‌ tato draṣṭrarthairityarthaḥ syāt‌| evaṃ ca `anālocane' iti pratiṣedho durghaṭaḥ syāt‌| tasmādālocanaśabdo'yaṃ bhāvasādhanaḥ--ālocitirālocanamiti| tatra draṣṭrarthairyukta pratiṣedha ucyamānaḥ kaḥ prasaṅgo yadālocanavṛttibhiryukte syāt‌, naiva prāpnoti, sa edho'nālocana iti pratiṣedha ucyamānaḥ kaḥ prasaṅgo yadā locanavṛttibhiryukte syāt‌, naiva prāpnoti, sa evo'nālocana iti pratiṣedhaḥ kathamupapadyate? yadi paśyaśabdo bhāvasādhano bhavati, nānyathā| tasmādata eva nipātanāt‌ `kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam‌' (3.3.113) iti vā bhāve'tra śapratatyayaḥ, tatra `pādhrā' (7.3.78) ityādinā paśyādeśaḥ, dvayorakārayoḥ pararūpatvam‌ (6.1.97)| paśyo'rtho yeṣāṃ te paśyārthā darśanārthā ityarthaḥ| darśanaśabdo'yaṃ cakṣuṣparyāyo'sti, yathā--`akṣṇo'draśanāt‌' (5.4.76) ityatra| ataścakṣudho'pi sampratyayaḥ kasyacinmā bhūdityata āha--`darśanaṃ jñānam‌' iti| taccottaratrālocanaṃ cakṣurjñānamiti, cakṣurjñānasya pṛthagupādānāt‌, tato'nyadvijñāyate| `grāmastvāṃ samīkṣyāgataḥ' ityādikaṃ sākṣādyukta udāharaṇam‌| `grāmastava svaṃ samīkṣyāgataḥ' ityādikaṃ yuktayukte| `samīkṣyāgataḥ' iti| manasā nirūpyāgata ityarthaḥ| `grāmastvā paśyati' iti| cakṣurjñānena tvāṃ paśyātītyarthaḥ| `tathā caivodāhṛtam‌' iti| yādṛśīyamiṣṭistadartharūpamevodāhṛtamityarthaḥ|| 26. sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā vibhāṣā| (8.1.26) sahaśabdo'tra vidyamānavacanaḥ, pṛrvaśabdo vyavasthāvācī| saha vidyamānaṃ pūrva yasyāḥ sā sapūrvā--pañcamyarthe bahuvrīhiḥ, `vopasarjanasya' (6.3.82) iti sahasya sabhāvaḥ| `prathamāyāḥ' iti| pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho.pa.7) tadantagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| ata evāha--`prathamāntāt‌ padāt‌' iti| `yuṣmadasmadorvibhāṣā' ityādi| ādeśaḥ-kathanam‌, andādeśaḥ-anukathanam‌| na anvādeśo'nanvādeśaḥ| tatrānanvādeśe yuṣmadasmadorvibhādhā bhavatīti vaktavyam‌| kimarthamityāha--`iha' ityādi| `sarva eva' ityādi| ye sapūrvāt‌ prathamāntāt‌ padātparayoryuṣmadasmadoḥ prāpnuvantyādeśāḥ, ye ca tato'nye te sava evānatvādeśe vibhāṣā vaktavyāḥ| yadyevam‌ anena vacanenaiva sarvatra vikalpasya siddhatvādapārthakamidaṃ sūtramiti manmamāna āha--`na tarhi' ityādi| `anvādeśārtham‌ iti| yadyetannocyeta, tato'nanvādeśa ityabhidhānāt‌ sapūrvāt‌ prathamāntādanvādeśe vikalpo na syāt‌| tasmāt‌ sapūrvāt‌ prathamāntādanvādeśe'pi vikalpo yathā syādityevamarthaṃ kriyamāṇe'pyupasaṃkhyāne sūtramidaṃ karttavyameva| asmiṃstu kriyamāṇe tadupasaṃkhyānaṃ na karttavyam‌| katham‌? siṃhāvalokitatyāyena vibhāṣāgrahaṇaṃ pūrvatrāpyupatiṣṭhate| satra vyavasthitavibhāṣāgrahaṇādananvādeśe sarvatra vikalpo bhaviṣyati, anvādeśe tu nityaṃ dānnāvādayaḥ, sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā anvādeśe'pi vikalpa iti|| 27. tiṅo gotrādīni kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoḥ| (8.1.27) yathāyathamudāttādiṣu prāpteṣvidamārabhyate| `pacati gotram‌' iti| yaḥ svapuruṣakāreṇa jovikāṃ kalpayitu maśakto gotrakhakakakakyāpanena tāṃ kalpayati sa evamucyate| `pacati' iti| vyaktīkarītītyarthaḥ| `paci vyaktīkaraṇaṃ' (dhā.pā.174) `pacatipacati gotram‌' iti| nitye'rthe dvirvacanam‌| yastvābhīkṣaṇyena gotraṃ khyāpayati sa eva mucyate| `vācyādeśābhāvaśca' iti| `bruvo vaciḥ' (2.4.53) iti vacyādeśaḥ prāpnoti, tasyābhāvo nipātanādava| `vicakṣaṇa' iti| atrāpi `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāña' (2.4.54) iti prāptasya khyāñādeśasyābhāvo nipānādeva veditavyaḥ| `nāmetyetadavā nihanyate' iti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇasyānuvṛtteḥ| na ca tadanuvṛttāvatiprasaṅgo bhavati; vyavasthita vibhāṣāvijñānāt‌| `pakṣe ādyudāttameva bhavati' iti| `nabviṣayasyānisantasya' (phi.sū.2.26) iti nāmaśabdasyādyudāttatvāt‌| `kutsitaṃ gotram‌' iti| `guṅ‌ avyakte śabde' (dhā.pā.949) ityasmādauṇādike ṣṭrani vihite gotramiti bhavati| tasmānnitsvareṇa gotraśabdo'trādyudttaḥ| `pacati pāpam‌' iti| pāpaśbdaḥ kutsane varttate, siṅantācca paro bhavati, na tu gotrādiriti na nihanyate| iha kutsanābhikṣṇyagrahaṇe, etadanudāttaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā syāt‌--tiṅaḥ parāṇi gotrādīnyanudāttāni bhavanti kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoriti, uta gotrādīnāṃ pāṭhaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā syāt‌--etayorarthayorgotrādīni bhavanti, tāni ca tiṅaḥ parāṇyanudāttāni bhavantīti? anayorarthayorgotrādivyapadeśamāsādayantīti yo'sau teṣāṃ prātipadikeṣu viśiṣṭānupūrvīkaḥ pāṭhaḥ, sa eva tayorarthayovaṃrttamānānāṃ bhavatīti yāvat‌| tatra pūrvasmin‌ pakṣe `canacidivagotrāditaddhitāmreḍitedhvagateḥ' (8.1.57) ityatra `kutsane ca supyagotrādau' (8.1.69) ityatra ca kutsanābhīkṣṇyayorapi varttamānānaṃ kāryaṃ prāpnoti; viśeṣānupādānāt‌| itarasmiṃstu pakṣe na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ| yāni hi na kutsanābhīkṣṇyayorvarttante teṣāṃ gotrādivyapadeśa eva nāsti; kutsanābhīkṣṇyavṛttīnāmeva gaṇe paṭhitatvāt‌| etat‌ sarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvā''ha--`kutsanābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇaṃ ca' ityādi| paṭhyata iti pāṭhaḥ, sanniveśaviśeṣaḥ| sadviśeṣaṇameva tadvevitavyam‌| tena kimiṣṭaṃ bhavatītyāha--`tena' ityādi| kathaṃ punarekena yatnena gotrādīnāṃ pāṭhaśca śakyo viśeṣayitumanudāttatvañcaiṣāṃ vidhātum‌? evaṃ manyate--yogavibhāgaḥ karttavyaḥ, tiṅaḥ parāṇi gotrādīnyanudāttāni bhavanti; tataḥ `kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoḥ', gotrādīnītyeva| na cātra dvitīyeyoge vidheyamanyadastīti gotrādīnyeva kutsanābhīkṣṇyagrahaṇena viśiṣyante| atha vā--ubhayathā sūtramācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pratipāditāḥ, ubhayañcaitat‌ pramāṇam‌, ata ubhayaṃ grahīṣyantīti| vṛttigranthastu tiṅantāt‌ padāduttarāṇi gotrādīnītyādiko vākyabhedenaiva neyaḥ--gotrādīni kutsane cāmīkṣṇye ca bhavanti, tānyeva tiṅantāt‌ padāduttarāṇyanudāttāni bhavantīti| nanu ca gotrādayaḥ śabdā gotrādāvevānarthāntare varttante, te kathaṃ kutsanābhīkṣṇyayorvarttaran‌? tameva svārthaṃ yadā tu kutsanābhīkṣṇyaviśiṣṭamācakṣate tadā tayorvartanta ityadoṣaḥ|| 28. tiṅṅatiṅaḥ| (8.1.28) `nīlamutpalam‌' iti| utpalamityetat‌ `navviṣayasyānisantasya' (phi.sū.2.26) ityādyudāttaṃ bhavati| `bhavati pacati' iti| pacatikriyā bhavatītyayamasyārthaḥ| pacatiśabde śaptipāvanudāttau, akāro dhātusvareṇodāttaḥ, `udāttādanudāttasya svaritaḥ' (8.4.66) iti śabakāraḥ svaritaḥ| nanu ca samāsavākye nighātādaya ucyante, idañca vākyameva na bhavati, tat‌ kimetannivṛttyarthenātiṅagrahaṇena? kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇametadvākyaṃ na bhavati? akhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyam‌' ityatra vākyalakṣaṇa ekatvasya vivakṣitatvāt‌, iha cākhyātasya dvitvāt‌? naiṣa dodhaḥ; atrāpyākhyātaṃ yadakārakaṃ tadvivakṣitam‌| taccāsminnekameva bhavatiśabdaḥ, pacatītyetattu kārakam‌| tathā hi bhāṣye uktam‌--`pacatyādayaḥ kriyāḥ [`kriyāḥ bhavanti' nāsti kā. mudrite] bhavanti, kriyāyāḥ kartryo bhavanti' iti| yadapīdamuktam‌--`ekatiṅ‌ padasamūho vākyam‌' iti, atrāpi pradhānaṃ yat‌ tiṅ‌ tadadhikṛtyaikatiṅityuktam‌| atra caikameva tiṅantaṃ pradhānam‌| yadyetat‌, kiṃ tarhi atra tiṅantaṃ tat‌? bhavatīti| pacatītyetat‌ punaḥ sādhanatvādapradhānam‌|| 29. na luṭ‌| (8.1.29) `śvaḥ karttā' iti| karoterluṭ‌, tāsiḥ, `luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ' (2.4.85) ityekavacanasya ḍādeśaḥ, ḍiti ṭilopaḥ| `tāseḥ parasya' ityādi| āgamaḥ pratyayasvareṇādyudāttaḥ| tasya yatra ṭilopo nāsti--irttāro, karttāra ityādau, tatra `nāsyanudāttenṅita' (6.1.186) ityādinā lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatve kṛte tāserevodāttatvaṃ bhavati| yatra tu ṭilopastatra `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ (6.1.161) iti lasārvadhātukamevodāttaṃ bhavati|| 30. nipātairyadyadihantakuvinneccecceṇkaccidyatrayuktam‌| (8.1.30) yadyapi nipātairityetadapekṣamāṇāvāṃ yadādīnāṃ sāmarthyam‌, tathāpi gamakatvādyuktaśabdena samāsa eṣāṃ yukta eva| atha vā--matra na samāsaḥ, vibhaktistvavyayatvādeṣāṃ luptete na śrūyate| yuktagrahaṇaṃ tvihāpi sākṣādyogapratipattyartham‌, tena yuktayukte pratiṣedho na bhavati| etacca prayudāharaṇe'pi spaṣṭīkariṣyāmaḥ| atra yadyatrayorgrahaṇamābhyāṃ pūrvasyāpi tadyuktasya pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamartham‌| yaddhi tataḥ paraṃ tiṅaktaṃ tasya `yad‌vṛttānnityam‌' (8.1.66) ityevaṃ siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, pūrvasya tu tena na sidhyati| tadā hi yadvṛttādibhiḥ pañcamī `tasmādityattarasya' (1.1.67) iti parasyaiva nighātapratiṣedhaṃ pratipādayati, netarasya| `yatkaroti' iti| karotiśabda ukārapratyayasyodāttatvānmadhyodāttaḥ| `nejjihyāyanto narakaṃ patāma' [`nojjihyāyanto'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] iti| paterlaṭ‌, mas‌, śap‌, `ato dīrgho yañi' (7.3.101) iti dīrghaḥ| ṅidadupadeśatvāllasārvadhātukatvādanudāttatve (6.1.186) kṛte dhātutvareṇādyudāttametat‌| `sa ceṭbhuṅakte' iti| `bhujo'navane' (1.3.66) ityātmanepadam‌, rudhāditvātvāt‌ śnam‌| pūrvavallasārvadhātukānudāttatvam‌; `inasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111), `anudāttasya ca yatrodāttalopaḥ' (6.1.161) ityudāttatve kṛte bhuṅkta ityetadantodāttam‌| `sa cedadhīte' iti| iṅ‌ dhātusvareṇodāttaḥ| ṅita iti lasārvadhātukamevānudāttam‌| ādiśabdāpekṣayā nighāte prāpte na pratipadoktaparibhāṣopatiṣṭhate (vyā.pa.3), sāhacaryañca vyavasthākāraṇaṃ na bhavatīti| tena `yāvadyathābhyām‌' (8.1.36) iti yathāśabdasāhacaryādyāvacchabdo'pi nāvyayameva parigṛhyate, kiṃ tarhi? parimāṇaśabdo'pi lākṣaṇikaḥ| yāvato'davān‌ pratigṛhṇīyādityatrāpi nighātaprativedho bhavati| `yattadetebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatum‌' (5.2.39) iti vatubanto'tra yāvacchabdaḥ| `yatra kva ca te mano dakṣaṃ dadhasa uttaram‌' iti| `dadha dhāraṇe' (dhā.pā.8) laṭ‌, dhās‌, `dhāsaḥ se' (3.4.80)| atra yatretyanenaidhikaraṇapradhāne uttaramityetadādheyaṃ yuktam‌, tena yuktaṃ tiṅantam‌, ataḥ sākṣādyogo nāstīti pratiṣedho na bhavati|| 31. na ha pratyārambhe| (8.1.31) nahetyayaṃ nipātasamudāyaḥ pratiṣedhe varttate| tena yuktaṃ tiṅantaṃ pratyārambhaviṣaye na nihanyate| punarārambhaḥ-pratyārambhaḥ| sa ca yatra viṣaye kriyate taddarśayitumāha--`coditasya' ityādi| bhuṅakṣyādhīṣvetyevaṃ coditaṃ vihitaṃ yat‌ karttavyatayopanyastaṃ bhojanādau yadā tat‌ karttuṃ na pravarttate nādriyate, avadhīryata iti yāvat‌; tadā tasyādadhīraṇe'dajñāne sati tamavadhīrayitāramupālabdhuṃ yā icchā tathopālipsayaitasyaiva bhojanāderavadhīritasya pratiṣedhena sambandhaḥ pratyārambhaḥ| `pratyārambhaḥ kriyate' iti| pratiṣedhasambaddhasya punarupanyāsaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| `naha bhokṣyase, nahādhyedhyase' iti| bhujeriṅaśca lṛṭ‌, `thāsaḥ se' (3.4.80) , adupadeśatvāt‌ ṅittvācca tayordhātvorlasārvadhātukamanudāttam‌| syaḥ pratyayasvareṇodāttaḥ| `icchanti' iti| `iṣu icchāyām‌' (dhā.pā.135), tudāditvāccha, `ḍaṣugamiyamāṃ chaḥ' (7.3.77)|| 32. satyaṃ praśne| (8.1.32) satyaśabdo'yamudāharaṇe praśne varttate| pratyudāharaṇe tu ṛtaśabdasyārthe|| 33. aṅgāprātilobhye| (8.1.33) prātilobhyam‌-prātakūlyam‌, anabhimatakāritvamityarthaḥ| tato'nyadaprātilobhyam‌-anukūlatvam‌, abhimatakāritvamiti yāvat‌| tasmin‌ gamyamāne'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ| `aṅga kuru, ṅga paca' iti| aṅgaśabdo'yaṃ nipāta ihānujñāyāṃ varttamāno'prātilobhyaṃ gamayati| karoterloṭi sip‌, `serhyapicca' (3.4.87), dhātorguṇe kṛte `ata utsārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityuttvam‌, `uttaśca pratyayāt‌' (6.4.1-6) iti herluk‌| atrokāraḥ pratyayasvareṇodāttaḥ| `paca' iti| `ato heḥ' (6.4.105) iti luk‌| dhātusvareṇādyudāttametat‌| pratyudāharaṇe'ṅga śabdo'mardhe varttate| `ānulabhye' iti vaktavye'prātilomye iti vacanaṃ vaicitryārtham‌|| 34. hi ca| (8.1.34) cakāro'prātilobhya ityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `sa hi kuru, sa hi paca' iti| hiśabdo'trāvadhāraṇe, hetau vā varttate| pratyudāharaṇe tvamardhe|| 35. chandasyanekamapi sākāṅkṣam‌| (8.1.35) `hi ca (8.1.34) ityeva| sahākāṅkṣayā varttata iti sākāṅkṣam‌| etacca tiṅantasyārthadvārakaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam‌| `ekamapi' iti| hītyanena yukta tiṅantaṃ sākāṅakṣaṃ bhavatīti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| atra ca yo'pyayamekasyānudāttatvapratiṣedhaḥ, so'pi yatrānekatiṅantaṃ hiyuktaṃ tatraida vaditavyaḥ; anyathā yadi yatraikaṃ hiyuktaṃ tatrāyamekasya hiyuktasya nighātapratiṣedho'piśabdaprāyitaḥ syāt‌, sūtramidamanurthakaṃ syāt‌; samānenaikasyā nekasya vā pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌| yathā yatrānekasya hiyuktasya upanipātastatraivaikasyānudāttatvapratiṣedhaḥ, tathā na bhavati vaiyarthyaprasaṅgaḥ; pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpārthatvāt| `kadācit‌' ityādinā tamevānantaroktamarthaṃ vispaṣṭo karoti| `anṛtaṃ hi matto yadati pāpmā enaṃ vipunāti' iti| atra dvayorapi tiṅantayorhetuhetumadbhāve sākāṅkṣatā| pāpmā mada ucyate| yasmādanṛtaṃ matto vadati tasmāt‌ pāpmā enaṃ ṣipunāti śuddhimāpādayati, mattasyānṛtamadoṣa iti kṛtvā| dve api caite hiśabdena yukte; tadarthagatasta hetuhetumadbhāvasya tena dyotetatvāt‌| tatra vadatītyetat‌ pacatītyanena tulyasvaram‌| punātītyetattu vikaraṇasvareṇa madhyodāttam‌| `agnirhi' ityādi| atrāpi hetuhetumadbhāvāt‌ sākāṅkṣatā| yasmādagniragre pūrvamudajayat‌ tasmādagnimindra anuścādudajayat‌| `udajayat‌' iti| utpūrvājjayaterlaṅi rūpam‌| `ekamudajayadityādyudāttatam‌' iti| tadbhaktaspāṭa udāttatvāt‌| `aparamanudāttam‌' iti| tatra nighātapratiṣedhasyāprāpteḥ| `ajā hyanterajaniṣṭa' ityādi| tatrāpi tata eva heto sākāṅkṣatvam‌| tasmādajā hyagnergarbhasya janitāramapaśyat‌ tasmādagnergarbhamajaniṣṭa janitavatī| `janiḥ prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.1149) luṅ‌, `cleḥ sic‌' (3.1.44) iṭ‌, ṣatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌| antarbhāvitavyartho'tra janirveditavyaḥ, anyathā karmatvaṃ garbhasya nopapadyate; akarmakatvāt‌| `apaśyat‌' iti| dṛśerlaṅ‌ pādhrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) paśyadeśaḥ| `ajaniṣṭa' iti| ādyudāttam‌| `apaśyadityanudāttam‌' iti| pūrvavat‌|| 36. yāvadyathābhyām‌| (8.1.36) kimarthaṃ punaridamārabhyate? na `yad‌vṛttānnityam‌' (8.1.66) ityeva siddhamiti yaścodayet‌, taṃ prati--`devadattaḥ pacati yāvat‌', `devadattaḥ pacati yathā'--ityetadudāharaṇadvayamupanyastam‌| eṣo'bhiprāyaḥ--yad‌vṛttāditi pañcamīnirdeśāt‌ `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) iti yatraiva yāvadyathābhyāṃ paraṃ tiṅantaṃ tatraiva pratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌| yatra tu tābhyāṃ pūrvaṃ tatra na syāt‌| iha tu tṛtīyanirdeśāt‌ tatrāpi bhavatīti|| 37. pūjāyāṃ nānantaram‌| (8.1.37) `pūjāyāṃ viṣaye' iti| viṣayagrahaṇe pūjāyāmiti viṣayasaptamīti darśayati| `kiṃ tarhyamudāttameva' iti| dvau pratiṣedho prakṛtamarthaṃ gamayata iti kṛtvā| `yāvat‌ pacati śobhanam‌' iti| stutiratra pūjā, sā ca kriyāyāḥ sādhanasya vā|| 38. upasargavyapetañca| (8.1.38) `upasargavyapetam‌' iti| upasargavyavahitam‌| cakāreṇa `pūjāyām‌' ityanukṛṣyate; anantaramiti cānuvarttate| tatropasargeṇa vyavadhānamāśrīyata iti| sāmarthyāt‌ anantaragrahaṇaṃ śabdāntaravyavadhānanirāsārthaṃ vijñāyate|| 39. tupaśyapaśyatāhaiḥ pūjāyām‌| (8.1.39) nanu `pūjāyāṃ nānantaram‌' (8.1.37) iti pūjāgrahaṇamanuvarttata eva, tatkimarthaṃ pūjāyāmityucyate? ityāha--`pūjāyāmityanuvarttate' ityādi| syādetat‌--tadeva pūjāgrahaṇamihānuvarttamānaṃ nighātapratiṣedhārthaṃ bhaviṣyatīti? ataāha--`taddhi' ityādi| taddhi pūrvatra pūjāgrahaṇaṃ nighātaprahatiṣedhasya pratiṣedhena sambaddham‌| tadanuvṛttau tasyāpyanuvṛttiḥ syāt‌| evañca teṣāṃ nighātapratiṣedhaḥ| luḍādīnāṃ teṣāṃ tuprabhṛtibhiryoge nighātapratiṣedhasya pratiṣedho vijñāyeta| tasmānnighātasya pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamarthaṃ punaḥ pūjāgrahaṇam‌| atrāhagrahayaṇaṃ kimartham‌, canādiṣu (8.1.57) cetyeva siddham‌? na sidhyati; `canacidivagotrāditaddhitāmreḍitevaṣgateḥ' (8.1.57) ityato gateriti tatrānuvṛtteḥ| tathā ca-devadattaḥ prapacatyahetyatra pratiṣedho na syāt‌| parabhūteṣu vā sa pratiṣedha iti pūrvabhūte'baśabde ca na syāt‌--devadatto'ha pacatītiī|| 40. aho ca| (8.1.40) cakāreṇa pujāyāmityanukṛṣyate| atha yogavibhāgaḥ kimartham‌ pūrvasūtra evāhograhaṇaṃ kriyate? ityata āha--`pṛthak‌ṃ' ityādi| pṛthagyoge `śeṣe vibhāṣā' (8.1.41) iti ahetyanenaiva yoge yathā syāt‌, tuprabhṛtīnāṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pṛthagyogakaraṇam‌|| 41. śeṣe vibhāṣā| (8.1.41) `kariṣyasi' ityādi| lṛḍantaṃ syasvareṇa madhyodāttam‌| nanu ca pūjāgrahaṇaṃ pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭam‌| tatra cānukṛṣṭasyehānuvṛtteraviśeṣe bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kiṃ śeṣagrahaṇena? ityata āha--`pūjāyāmityasya' ityādi|| 42. purā ca parīpsāyām‌| (8.1.42) cakāro vibhāṣetyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `parīpsāyāmarthe' iti| gamyamāna iti śeṣaḥ| `parīpsā tvarā' iti| sambhramaḥ-aśupravṛttirityarthaḥ| `adhīṣva māṇavaka' ityādi| tvaritamadhīṣvetyedho'rtho gamyate| tathā hyatra purā vidyotate vidyut‌, purā stanayati staniyuritatyetadubhayamapyadhyayanadiṣayayostvarāyāḥ kāraṇatvenopātam‌| vidyuddyotanādau hi na paṭhitavyaṃ parvadivaseṣviva| etaduktaṃ bhavati--yasmādacirakālabhāvi vidyuddyotanaṃ stanayitnustananaṃ vā'dhyayanantarāyo'to'dhīṣyeti| `purā vidhīyate' iti| `yāvatpurānipātayorlaṭ‌, (3.3.4), anudāttettvādātmanepadam‌| adupadeśāllasārvadhātukānudāttatve (6.1.186) kṛte dhātusvareṇādyudāttametat‌| `purā stanayati' iti| `stana gadī devaśabde' (dhā.pā.1859,1860) curādiṇic‌| adantatvādbṛddhyabhāvuḥ| etadapi pūrvavanmadhyodāttam‌| `purāśabdo'tra bhaviṣyadāsattiṃ dyotayati' iti| bhaviṣyadvidyuddyotanādiradhyayanāntarāyo yastasya pratyāsattiṃ sāmīpyarmācarakālabhāditvaṃ dyotayati| tena tvarā gamyata ityabhiprāyaḥ|| 43. nanvityanujñaiṣaṇāyām‌| (8.1.43) `anujñāyā etaṇā prārthanā' iti| kiñit‌ kartu svayamevodyatasyaivaṃ kriyatāmityanujñānamanujñā| prārthanāyāṃ mūlodāharaṇayoḥ `varttamāne laṭ‌' (3.3.123) iti laṭ‌| pratyudāharaṇe tu bhūte `nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane' (3.2.120) ityanena| itikaraṇa ekanipāto'yamiti pradarśanārthaḥ| nanvanujñeṣaṇāyāmiti hyucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimayamekanipātaḥ? utta nipātadvayamiti? yathā--`nanvorvibhāṣā' (3.2.121) ityatraḥ itikaraṇena tvavacchidyamānamekamevevaṃ śabdarūpamiti gamyate|| 44. kiṃ kriyāpraśne'nupasargamapratiṣaṣiddham‌| (8.1.44) `apratiṣiddham‌' iti| pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣiddham‌| bhāve niṣṭhā| nāsya pratiṣiddhamastītyapratiṣiddham‌| atha vā--karmaṇi niṣṭhā, nividdhaṃ pratiṣiddhamapratiṣiddham‌| arthadvārakañcaitat‌ tiṅo viśeṣaṇam‌| `pūrvaṃ kiṃyuktam‌' iti| tatsamīpe kimaḥ śrūyamāṇatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| `uttaraṃ tu na kiṃyuktam‌' iti| tasyāsamīpe śrūyamāṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ| `apare tvāhuḥ' ityādi| na hi samīpe śruyamāṇatvaṃ kiṃśabdasya śabdāntareṇa sambandhe hetuḥ api tu saṃśayaviṣayatvam‌| yathā cātra pūrvasyākhyātasya, tathā tatparasyāpītyasti tasya yogaḥ kiṃśabdenetyubhayatra pratiṣedhaḥ|| 45. lope vibhāṣā| (8.1.45) kiṃśabdasya prakṛtatvāt‌ tasyaiva lopo vijñāyate, ityāha--kimo lope iti| kiṃśabdasya śāstre na kvacillopo vihitaḥ, ityataḥ pṛcchati--`kva cāsya lopaḥ' iti| adarśanamātrasya `lopaḥ' (1.1.60) iti saṃjñā kṛtā na tu śāstrakṛtasyaivādarśanasyetyabhiprāyeṇāha--`yatra' ityādi| `gamyate cārthaḥ' iti| kutaścidarthaprakaraṇādeḥ| `na ca prayujyate' iti| gamyamānārthatvāt‌| `devadattaḥ pacatyāhosvit‌ paṭhati' iti| atrāyamāhosvicchabdaḥ pakṣāntare varttate| pakṣāntaropanyasanaṃ kimartham‌? praśnaṃ na vyabhicaratauti| atrāprayujyamānasyāpi tasyārtho gamyate| pañatiśabdo'yaṃ pakṣe pacatiśabdena tulyasvaraḥ|| 46. ehimanye prahāse lṛṭ‌| (8.1.46) `ehimanya ityanena' iti| samudāyasyaikatvāt‌ tadapekṣayaikavacanam‌, anyathā hi dve ete ākhyāte iti dvitvād‌dvivacanaṃ syāt‌| `prahāsaḥ' iti| prakṛṣṭo hāsaḥ; parihāsa ityarthaḥ| `ehi manya odanaṃ bhokṣyase' iti| `prahāse ca manyopade' (1.4.106) iti puruṣavyatyayaḥ| bhujerasmadyupapade madhyamaḥ, manyateryuṣmadyupapade uttamaḥ| `evama ehi manye rathena yāsyasi' ityatrāpi puruṣavyatyayo veditavyaḥ| dve api caite lṛṅante syapratyayasvareṇa madhyodātte| `prahāsa iti kim‌? ehi manyasa odanaṃ bhokṣye' iti| atra manyateḥ `yaṣmadyupapade' (1.4.105) ityādinā madhyamaḥ| bhujestu `asmadyuttamaḥ' (1.4.107) ityuttamaḥ| suṣṭhu manyase, sādhu manyase' iti| anena yathābhūtaṃ darśayat‌ prahāsābhāvaṃ darśayati| nanu ca `gatyarthaloṭā lṛṭ‌' (8.1.51) ityādinaiva siddham‌, tat‌ kimartho'yamārambhaḥ? ityata āha--`gatyarthaloṭā' ityādi| `ehimanyeyukte' ityādinā niyamārthatāmasya vyaktīkaroti| kathaṃ punarehimanya ityenena yogena niyamaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ `ehi manyase odanaṃ bhokṣye' ityatra nivṛtti karoti, na hyatara pahītyaneva lṛḍantaṃ yuktam‌, kiṃ tarhi? ehi manyasa ityanena? ityata āha--`ehi manya ityuttmopādānamatantram‌' iti| atantratvaṃ tu tasyopalakṣaṇārthatvāt‌| nanu ca `manyateruttamaḥ' (1.4.106) iti vacanādyuṣmadyupapade manyateruttamenaiva bhavitavyam‌, evañca `ehi eva hi manyatiruttamaḥ' iti| gatārtham‌|| 47. jātvapūrvam‌| (8.1.47) `apūrvam‌' iti| avidyamānaṃ pūrvaṃ yasmāt‌ tadapūrvam‌| atra ca dvayaṃ sambhāvyate--tiṅantasya cedaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt‌, jātuśabdasya veti| tatra yadi tiṅantasya syāt‌ `āhoutāho jānantaran‌' (8.1.49) ityatrānantara grahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌| asyaiva hyapūrvagrahaṇasya tatrānuvṛttestiṅantasyānantarya labhyate; tasmājjātuśabdasyedaṃ viśeṣaṇam‌, ityālocyāha--`jātvityetat‌' ityādi|| 48. kiṃvṛttaṃ ca ciduttaram‌| (8.1.48) `ciduttaram‌' iti| cidityetaduttaraṃ yasmāt‌ tat‌ tathoktam‌| pūrvoktayā notyaitadapi kivṛttasyaiva viśeṣaṇam‌| `kiṃvṛttagrahaṇena tadvibhaktyantam‌' ityādi| `kivṛtte lipsāyām‌' (3.3.6) ityatraitaduktārtham‌| `bhojayati' iti| pūrvavanmadhyodāttamevaitat‌| `kasmaiciddadāti' iti| `abhyastānāmādiḥ' (6.1.189) ityādyudāttametat‌| `kataraḥ' iti| `kiṃyattadornirdhāraṇe' (5.3.92) iti ḍataraca| `katamaḥ' iti| `vā bahūnāṃ jātiparipraśne' (5.3.93) iti ḍatamac‌|| 49. āhoutāho cānantaram‌| (8.1.49) avidyamānamantaraṃ vyavadhānaṃ yasya tadanantaram‌| avyavahitamityarthaḥ| tiṅantaviśeṣaṇametat‌| ānantaryañcāho, utāho--ityetayoḥ śrutatvāt‌ tadapekṣayaiva veditavyam‌| trāpi cakāro'pūrvamityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 50. śeṣe vibhāṣā| (8.1.50) śeṣaḥ sannihitāpekṣaḥ| śeṣatrayañca pūrvasūtre sannihataṃ nighātakāraṇam--āho utāhośabdau, anantara mityetat‌, apūrvamityetacca| tatra na jñāyate--kiṃ kāraṇabhāvāpekṣaḥ śeṣa iti| kimāhoutāhośabdāpekṣaḥ? utānantarabhāvāpekṣaḥ? āhosvidapūrvabhāvāpekṣaḥ?--ityataḥ pṛcchati--`kaśca śeṣaḥ' iti| iha nighātamicchatā tatkāraṇamavaśyamevāpekṣaṇīyam‌| `āho udāho' iti| apūrvamityetadapi, dviścakāreṇānukṛṣṭatvāt‌| tasya hi dvayoryogayoścakāro'nukarṣaṇārtha eva kṛtaḥ| kathaṃ nāmātrāpi tadapekṣā syāditi! anyathā hi samanantarātīti eva sūtre tadanukarṣaṇārthaścakāraḥ kriyate| kiṃvṛttādisūtre (8.1.48) hi svaritatvādeva tadanuvarttata iti| tasmāt‌ pāriśeṣyādanantarabhāvapekṣaḥ śeṣo vijñāyate? ityata āha--`yadanyadanantarāta' iti|| 51. gatyarthaloṭā lṛṇna cetkārakaṃ sarvānyat| (8.1.51) `gaminā samānārthā gatyarthāḥ' iti| arthapradarśanamevaitat‌| evaṃ tu vigrahaḥ karttavyaḥ--gatirartho yeṣāmiti| `gatyarthaloṭā yuktam‌' iti| yogaḥ punanimittanimittarūpaḥ| tayornimittamiti bhāvaḥ| `na cetkārakam‌' ityāderarthaṃ vispaṣṭīkarttumāha--`yatraiva' ityādi| anena loḍantavācyaṃ lṛḍantavācyārthaṃ yat‌ kārakaṃ tasyaivānanyatvamāśritam‌; na śabdātantaravācyasyeti darśayati, evacca pratyāsatterlabhyate| tiṅantasya hi tadeva pratyāsannaṃ kārakaṃ yat‌ tenaivābhidhīyate na śabdāntareṇa; tena śabdāntaravācye bhidyamāne'pi bhavatyeva bhidhātapratiṣedhaḥ| `āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ drakṣyasyenam‌' iti| āgaccheti gatyarthaloṭa, drakṣyasīti lṛḍantam‌; tayoścaikamevātra kārakaṃ devadattaḥ karttā| `drakṣyasi' iti| `sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti' (6.1.58) ityamāgamaḥ; vraścādi sūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si'(8.2.41) iti katvam‌| syapratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttametat‌| evamuttaratrāpi yatra nighātapratiṣedhastatra lṛḍantasya madhyodāttatā veditavyā| `āgaccha devadatta grāmamodanaṃ bhokṣyase' iti| atrāpi tadevābhinnamubhayalakāravācyaṃ karttukārakam‌| karma tu yadyapi bhidyate, tathāpi tacchabdāntaravācyamiti satyapi tbhede bhavatyeva nighātapratiṣedhaḥ| `uhyantāṃ devadattena śālayo yajñadattena bhokṣyante' iti| athātra śālaya ityubhayalakāravācyamabhinnaṃ karmaṃ kārakam‌, kartā tu yadyapi bhidyate, tathāpi sa śabdāntaravācya iti tadbhede'pi nighātapratiṣedho bhavatyeva| `uhyantām‌' iti| vaheḥ karmaṇi loṭ‌, ātmanepadam‌, jhasyāntādeśaḥ, `sārvadhātuke yak‌' (3.1.67) vacyādisūtreṇa (6.1.15) samprasāraṇam‌, ṭeretvam‌ (3.4.79), `āmetaḥ' (3.4.90) ityāmbhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punarihābhinnaṃ kārakam‌, yāvatā śaktiḥ kārakam‌, sā ca pratikriyaṃ bhidyata eva śaktiśaktimatorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvādekaṃ kārakaṃ bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ| `āgaccherdevadatta grāmaṃ drakṣyasyanam‌' iti| atra gatyarthaliṅā lṛṅantaṃ yuktam‌, na gattayarthaloṭā| `āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ paśyasyenam‌' iti| atra gatyarthaloṭā laṅantaṃ yuktam‌, na tu luṅantam‌| `āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ pitā ta odanaṃ bhokṣyate' iti| atra loṅantasya devadattaḥ kartā, lṛḍantasya tu piteti bhidyate kārakam‌| `āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca' ityādi| yathā pūrvopanyasteṣu mūlodāharaṇeṣu yalloḍantasya karttrādi kārakaṃ vācyaṃ tanmātrameva lṛṅantasyāpi, iha tu na tathā| atrāpi [`tatrāpi--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] loṅantasya devadatto yuṣmadartha evapa karttā vācyaḥ, lṛṅantasya tu sa cāsmadarthaśca; tatrāsati sarvagrahaṇa iha nighātapratiṣedho na syāt‌| ata ihāpi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇam‌| atha satyapi sarvagrahaṇe nighātapratiṣedhaḥ kathamevātra bhavati, yāvātā bhidyate loṅantavācyāt‌ kārakāllṛṅantavācyo yo'rthaḥ kārakaṃ kartāta? ityata āha--`lṛṅantavācye hi' ityādi| sarvagrahaṇe sati loḍantavācyaṃ yatkārakaṃ tasmāllṛṅantasya yadi sarvamanyadbhavati, tathāpyevaṃ na nighātapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌, anyathā tu sati bhavatyeva| yadi hi yatrāpi loṅantasya kiñcit‌ tadeva kārakaṃ vācyam‌, lṛṅantasya kiñcit‌ tato'nyatrāpi nighātapratiṣedho na syāt‌, sarvagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt sarvagrahaṇādbhavatyevātra nighātapratiṣedhaḥ| tatraivaṃ syāt‌--asminnapyudāharaṇe lṛṅantasya vācyaṃ yat‌ kārakamanyadeva talloṅantavācyāt‌| ataḥ satyapi sarvagrahaṇe na bhavitavyaṃ nighātapratiṣedheṇa? ityata āha--`iha tu' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 52. loṭ‌ ca| (8.1.52) cakāraḥ pūrvāpekṣayā samuccayārthaḥ| `paśya' iti| antodāttam‌--`ekādeśa udāttenodāttaḥ' (8.2.5) `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) iti guṇagrahaṇe pararūpasyevodāttatvāt‌| `śādhi' iti| `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075), `serhyapicca' (3.4.87) iti sipo hirādeśaḥ, adāditvācchapo luk‌; `śā hau' (6.4.35) iti dhātoḥ śādeśaḥ, `hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ' (6.4.101) iti herdhibhāva-| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttametat‌| evaṃ dṛśyatāmityedapi; `vikaraṇasvarāt‌ sārvadhātukasvaro balīyān‌' iti vacanāt‌| atha pṛthagyogakaraṇaṃ kimartham‌, na pūrvasūtra eva loṅgrahaṇamapi kriyeta? ityata āha--`pṛthak‌' ityādi| uttaratra loṭa eva kāryaṃ yathā syāt‌, lṛṭo mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pṛthagyogakaraṇam‌|| 53. vibhāṣitaṃ sopasargamanuttamam‌| (8.1.53) pūrveṇa nitye pratiṣedhe prāpte vikalpārthaṃ vacanam‌ vibhāṣitaśabdaścāyaṃ vibhāvāśabdena samānārthaḥ| `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114)| `praviśāni' iti| mipaḥ `meniḥ' (3.4.89), `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92) ityād‌|| 54. hanta ca| (8.1.54) cakāraḥ `vibhāṣitaṃ sopasargamanuttamamu' (8.1.53) ityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| `kuru' iti| karoterguṇe kṛte `ata ḍatsārvadhātuke (6.4.110) ityuttvam‌, `utaśca pratyayāt‌' (6.4.106) ityādinā herluk‌| pratyayasvareṇāntodāttametat‌| `hanta prabhuñjāvahai' [`prabhunajāvahai'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] iti| bhujerloṭ‌, vahiḥ, ṭerettvam‌, `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92), śnam‌| atrāpi `nipātairyadyadi' (8.1.30) ityādinā nighātapratiṣedhaḥ| adupadeśāllasārvadhātukasyānudāttatve (6.1.186) kṛte vikaraṇasvareṇa madhyodāttametat‌|| 55. āma ekāntaramāmantritamanantike| (8.1.55) `ekāntaram‌' iti| antarayatītyantaram‌| vyavadhāyakamityarthaḥ| ekaṃ padamantaraṃ yasya tattathoktam‌| ekena nipātena vyavahitamityarthaḥ| `ām‌ pacasi devadattātri iti| nighāte pratiṣiddhe `āmantritasya' (6.1.198) iti dhāṣṭhikamāmantritādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `dūrāddhūte ca' (8.2.84) iti plutaḥ| `āma bho devadattātri' iti| bhavadbhagavadaghavatāmoccāvasya' (8.3.1.vā.2) iti bhavacchabdāvayavasyāvaśabdasyauttvam‌; dakārasya rutvam‌, tasya `bhobhagoadhoapūrvasya' (8.3.17) ityādinā yakāraḥ, tasya `hali sarveṣām‌' (8.3.22) iti lopaḥ| nanu cātra bhoḥśabdasya `āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat‌' (8.1.72) ityavidyamānatvādekāntaratā nopapadyate? ityata āha--`bho ityāmantritāntamapi' ityādi| `bhoḥ' iti sāmānyavacanam‌| atra `bhoḥ' iti yadyapyāmantritam‌, tathāpi nāvidyamānavat‌, `nāmantrite' (8.1.73) ityādinā'vidyamānavadbhāvasya pratiṣedhāt‌| `tadubhayamapyanena kriyate' [tadubhayamanena--kāśikā] iti| kathaṃ punarubhayamapyanena kartuṃ śakyam‌, yāvatānudāttādhikārādanudāttasyaivānena yujyate pratiṣedhaḥ? na śakyate kartumaprakṛtāyā asaṃśabditāyā ekaśruteḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `anantike' (8.1.55) iti nañatra virodhe vartate, adharmānṛtādivat‌| antikaviruddhamanantikam‌| dūramityarthaḥ| dūrāt‌ sambuddhau cakaśrutirucyate;`ekaśruti dūrāt‌ sambuddhau' (1.2.33) iti vacanāt‌| evaṃ hi prapacasi devadattetyevamādiṣvāmantritanighātaṃ kṛtārthaṃ bādhitvā yatrāma ekāntaramāmantritamanantikam‌, tacaikaśrutireva bhavati; yadidaṃ nārabhyeta| ato nāprāptāyāmekaśrutau ivamārabhyata iti tāṃ tāvadbādhate, tatastasyāñca bādhitāyāṃ bādhakābhāvāt‌ prāpnuvat‌ taṃ nighātamapi bādhata eva| kutaḥ? nighātapratiṣedhādhikāre vacanāt‌| ekaśrutipratiṣedhe hi vidhitsite satyekaśrutiprakaraṇa eva (1.2.33-40) pratiṣedhaṃ kuryāt‌, nāma ekāntaramiti; tatrāpyayamarthaḥ--`āmantritamanantike' (8.1.55) iti vaktavyaṃ na bhavati| tasmānnighātapratiṣedhādhikāre vacanānnighātamapi bādhata iti yuktam‌--tadubhayamanena kriyata iti| naiṣa doṣo yadi tarhyaprakaraṇāpannāśabditāpyekaśrutiranena pratiṣidhyate| iha `dūrāddhūte ca' tadubhayamanena kriyata iti| naiṣa doṣo yadi tarhyaprakaraṇāpannāśabditāpyekaśrutiranena pratiṣidhyate| iha `dūrāddhūte ca' (8.2.84) iti yaḥ plutodāttaḥ prāpnoti; so'pi pratiṣidhyate? ityata āha--`plṛtodāttaḥ punaḥ' ityādi| tasmin‌ karttavye'siddhatvāt‌ plutodātto nāstyeva, sa kathaṃ pratiṣidhyeta![`pratiṣidhyate'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] asiddhatvaṃ tu `pūrvatrāsiddham‌' (8.2.4) iti vacanāt‌| 56. yaddhituparaṃ chandasi| (8.1.56) yaddhitavaḥ pare yasmāt‌ tattathoktam‌| `udasṛjo'yam‌' iti| atra hi tiṅantamaṭsvareṇādyudāttam‌| `sṛja visarge' (dhā.pā.1178), laṅ‌ sip‌, tudāditvācchaḥ, `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityuttvam‌, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `uśanti hi' iti| `vaśa kāntau' (dhā.pā.1080) jherantādeśaḥ (7.1.3), pūrvavacchapo luk‌, grahajyādisūtreṇa (6.1.16) samprasāraṇam‌| pratyasvareṇa madhyodāttametat‌| `ākhyasyāmitu' iti| `khyā prakathane' (dhā.pā.1060), cakṣiṅādeśo vā, lṛṅ‌| syapratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttametat‌| `nipātairyadyavihanta' (8.1.30) ityādinā niyamasya kāraṇaṃ darśayi| `vacanam‌' ityādināpyasya vacanasya niyamārthatvam‌| `ebhireva' ityādināpi niyamasaya svarūpam| `nānyaiḥ' iti| anenāpi niyamasya vyavacchedyam‌| `iha' ityādināpi vyavacchedyasya viṣayam‌| `svo hohāvaihi' iti| `ruha bījajanmani prādurbhāve' (dhā.pā.859), loṭ‌, vas‌, śap‌, `āḍuttamasya picca' (3.4.92), `sa uttamasya' (3.4.98) iti sakaralopaḥ| rohāvetyetasmin‌ parabhūte svarityasya `ro ri' (8.3.14) iti rephasya lopo na bhavati; chāndasatvāt‌| tasminnasati pūrvavaduttvam‌| `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87) iti hi guṇe, lomaṇyadhyamapuruṣaikavacane rūpam| kvacit‌-- `jāye svo rohārvaihītyehītyanena gatyarthaloṭā yuktasya' iti pāṭhaḥ, tatrāṅpūrvasyeṇaḥ prayogo veditavyaḥ| atha paragrahaṇaṃ krimartham‌, na `yaddhituṣveva' naivaṃ śakyam‌; saptamīnirdeśe hi nirdiṣyaṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvādanantareṣvevākyavādiṣu bhavatīti niyamo vijñāyate| tato'nantareṣveva padadiṣu bhaviṣyati, na vyavahiteṣviti| tathā cāvyayoganivṛtteniyamenākṛtatvāt‌ svo rohāvaihītyatra syādeva pratiṣedhaḥ|| 57. canacidivagotrāditaddhitāmreḍiteṣvagateḥ| (8.1.57) `ihāpi gotrādayaḥ kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoreva gṛhyante' iti| na kevalaṃ `tiṅo gotrādīni' (8.1.27) ityādo sūtra ityapiśabdārthaḥ| yathā cātrāpi kutsanābhīkṣṇyayoreva gotrādīni gṛhyante, tathā tatraivopapāditam‌| `pacatikalpam‌' iti| `īṣadasamāptau kalpap‌' (5.3.67)| tatra hi `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) ityanuvarttate, `anudāttastaddhita ihodāharaṇamiti kasmānna bhavati? iti praśnāvasare āha--`anyatra taddhitasvareṇa tiṅsvaro vācye, iti taddhitasyodāttatve sati `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam‌ (6.1.158) iti cānudāttatvāpatattiḥ| evañcānyatra nighātaḥ siddha eveti| anudātta eva taddhita ihodāharaṇam‌| `atra ityādi| kathaṃ punarupasargagrahaṇaṃ śakyaṃ draṣṭum‌? uttarasūtre `cādiṣu ca' (8.1.58) iti caśabdenāsya sūtrasya dvitadīyo vyāpāra ucyate, sa ānantaryādgaterityasya viśeṣaṇārtho bhaviṣyati--cādiṣu yo gatiriti| cādiṣviti sāmīpyalakṣaṇamadhikaraṇam‌| kaścādiṣu gatiḥ? cādisamīpe ya uditaḥ| tenāyaṃ prādīnāmevepasargasaṃjñānāṃ pratiṣedho vijñāyate| evaṃ tāvadasmin‌ sūtre gatigrahaṇenopasargasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| `sagatirapi tiṅ‌' iti| atrāpi `cādilope vibhāṣā' (8.1.63) iti sūtrāt‌ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vibhāvetyanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenopasargasaṃjñena gatinā yo gatiḥ saḥ| tasyaivānudāttatvena bhavitavya mityupasarga9syaiva gatergrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| atha vā--dvayorapyetayorbogayoḥ `vibhāṣitaṃ sopasargamanuttamam‌' (8.1.53) ityata upasargagrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutinyāyenānuvarttate, gatigrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; upasargagrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhatvāt‌| nānarthakam‌; vispaṣṭārthatvāt‌| `upasargācchandasi dhātvarthe' (5.1.118) ityatra hyupasargagrahaṇaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇārtham‌| tatrāsati gatigrahaṇe, ihāpyusargagrahaṇaṃ prādyupalakṣaṇārthamiti kasyacit‌ sandehaḥ syāt‌| prādyupalakṣaṇe ca sati ko doṣaḥ? anupasargāṇāmapi prādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ vijñāyeta| tataḥ śuklaukarotītyatra nighātapratiṣedho bhavatyeva| `abhūtatadbhāve' (5.4.50.vā.1) ityādineha cdiḥ, tasya `ūryādicviḍācaśca' (1.4.61) iti gatisaṃjñā, `asya cvau' (7.4.32) itīttvam‌| `yat‌ kāṣṭhaṃ śuklīkaroti' iti| atra `sagatirape tiṅaḥ' (8.1.68) iti nighāto na varttate| tena `nipātairyadyadi' (8.1.30) ityādinā nighātapratiṣedha eva bhavati|| 58. cādiṣu ca| (8.1.58) dvividhāścādayaḥ--gaṇaparipaṭhitāśca, yāvaṅgīkṛtyaitaduktam‌--`cādayo'sattve (1.4.57) iti; sūtrapaṭhitāśca--`na cavāhāhaivāyukte' (8.1.24) iti; tatra pratyāsatterya iha prakaraṇe paṭhitāsteṣāmeva grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌? iti matvā''ha--`cādayo na cadāhāhaiva' ityādi| khādatiśabdaḥ pacatiśabdena tulyasvaraḥ| `prathamasyātra tiṅantasya' ityādinā dvitīyamiha gaterityasya pratyudāharaṇamiti darśayati| caśbado gaterityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| anyaccāsya prayojanamuktameva|| 59. cavāyoge prathamā| (8.1.59) `prathamā tiṅavibhaktiḥ' iti| etena prathameti strīliṅganirdeśo vibhaktyapekṣaḥ sūtre kṛta iti darśayati| prathamātvaṃ tasya punaḥ prathamamuccāraṇādveditavyam‌ `gardaṃbhām̐śca kālayati' iti| `kala vila kṣepe' (dhā.pā.1604-1605) curādiṇic‌| citsvareṇa lakāre'kāra udātta iti madhyodāttametat‌| dvitadīyaṃ tu nihanyata eva| atha yogagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na ca vayorityeva saptamyā nirdeśaḥ kriyeta, yathā `cādiṣa ca' (8.1.58)? ityata āha--`yogagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yathā `cādiṣu ca' (8.1.58) iti saptamyā nirdeśe sati paraireva cādiniryoge pratiṣedho bhavati, na pūrvai; tathehāpi parābhyāmeva cavābhyāṃ yoge syāt‌, na pūrvābhyām‌| tābhyāmapi yoge yathā syādityevamarthaṃ yogagrahaṇam‌| yadi tu cavābhyāmiti tṛtīyayā nirdeśaḥ kriyate, vināpi yogagrahaṇena pūrvābhyāmapi yoge syādeva pratiṣedhaḥ? sandehaparihārārthaṃ tu tathā na kṛtam‌, cavābhyāmityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimayaṃ tṛtīyayā nirdeśaḥ? uta pañcamyeti? pañcamyā nirdeśe ko doṣaḥ syāt‌? paramatābhyāṃ yoge na syāt‌| kathaṃ punardvitīyāditiṅantasya cavābhyāṃ yogaḥ, yattannivṛttyarthaṃ prathamāgrahaṇaṃ kriyeta? ityata āha--`cavāyogo hi' ityādi| iha cayogaḥ samuccaye bhavati, vāyogastu vikalpe| sa ca samuccayo vapikalpaścānekasya dharmaḥ, dvitvādivat‌| ato yatra tau samuccayavikalpau, tatrāvaśyamanekasya dvitīyādeḥ sannidhānena bhavitavyam‌| tasmāt‌ tannivṛttyarthaṃ prathamāgrahaṇam‌|| 60. heti kṣiyāyām‌| (8.1.60) `ācārabhedaḥ' iti| śiṣṭācāravyatikrama ityarthaḥ| `yāti' iti| dhātusvareṇādyudāttaḥ| itikaraṇena haśabdamātralasya nighātakāraṇatvamākhyāyate| asati hi tasmin‌ kṣiyā haśabdasyopādhirvijñāyeta tiṅantasya vā| tathā ca yadā haśabdastiṅantaṃ vā kṣiyāyāṃ na prayujyate, tadā nighātapratiṣedho na syāt‌| itikaraṇe tu sati svarūpamātrapradhāno haśabdo nighātasya kāraṇa bhavatīti asatyāmapi haśabdasya tiṅantasya vā kṣiyāyāṃ vṛttau nighātapratiṣedhaḥ siddho bhavati|| 61. aheti viniyoge ca| (8.1.61) cakāreṇa kṣiyāyāmityetadanukṛṣyate| `nānāprayojanaḥ' iti| anekaprayojana ityarthaḥ| `niyogaḥ' iti| preṣaṇam‌, vyāpāraṇamityarthaḥ| itikaraṇamasya pūrvavadeva prayojanam‌|| 62. cāhalopa evetyavadhāraṇam‌| (8.1.62) `kva cāsya lopaḥ' iti| `lope vibhāṣā' (8.1.45) ityatra yo'bhiprāya praṣṭuruktaḥ sa ihāpi veditavyaḥ| `yatrārtho gamyate' ityādi| atrāpi yastatrābhiprāya itarasyābhihitaḥ sa eva draṣṭavyaḥ| kaḥ punararthastayoḥ prayuktayorapi gamyate? ityāha--`tatra' ityādi| kya punardiṣaye calopaḥ? kva vāhalopaḥ? ityāha--`samānakarttṛke' ityādi| yasmin‌ vyāpāraviśeṣe samāsa ekaḥ karttā sa samānakarttakaḥ| `samānakarttṛke calopaḥ, nānakarttṛke'halopaḥ' iti| nānā karttā yasmin‌ sa nānākarttukaḥ| `devadatta eva grāmaṃ gacchatu, sa devadatta evāraṇyaṃ gacchatu' iti| atra grāmakarmakamaraṇyakarmakañca gamanaṃ yat‌ tasya devadatta eva karttati tat‌ samānakartṛkam‌| cārthaṃ ca darśayitumāha--`grāmaṃ ca' ityādi| atra hi devadatta evāraṇyaṃ gacchatu devadatta eva grāmaṃ gacchatviti devadattasyaiva niyojyasya ganturgrāma eva gantavyatayopadiśyate, yajñadattasya tvaraṇyameva kevalam‌| tenāsatyapyahaśabdasya prayoge tadartho gamyate--grāmaṃ kevalaṃ devadatto gacchatu, araṇyaṃ kevalaṃ yajñadatto gacchatviti| `anavaklṛptau' iti| asambhāvanāyāmityarthaḥ| yo hi devadattasya bhojanaṃ na kvacitsambhāvayati sa eva prayuṅakte--devadatta tadeva bhokṣyase' iti| pararūpatvam‌|| 63. cādilope vibhāṣā| (8.1.63) `sūtranirdiṣṭā gahyante' iti| pūrvataḥ pratyāsatteḥ| atra cavālope `cavāyoge prathamā' (8.1.59) iti prāpte vibhāṣā, pariśeṣāṇāmaprāpte| `bhavanti' iti| pakṣe pratyayasvareṇa madhyodāttaḥ| `yajeta' iti| atra pakṣe'dupadeśāllasārvadhātukasyānudāttatve kṛte dhātokadāttatve satyādyudāttatvam‌|| 64. vaivāveti ca cchandasi| (8.1.64) `āsīt‌' iti| `asa bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065), laṅ‌ adāditvācchayo luk‌, `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) iti āṭ‌, sa codātta ityādyudāttametat‌| itikaraṇasya pūrvoktameva prayojanam‌| cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ| yā dviḥ pacatviha tasyāḥ saṃvatsarasya sasyaṃ pacyate dvirityanena yuktā prathamā tiṅ‌vibhaktiḥ pacatviti vā na nihanyate|| 65. ekānyābhyāṃ samarthābhyām‌| (8.1.65) `samarthābhyām‌' iti| nāyamasyārthaḥ--tiṅantena saṃgatābhyāmiti; anyathā hyasyopādānamanarthakameva syāt‌, `cadāyoge prathamā' (8.1.59) ityato yogagrahaṇānuvṛtterevāsyārthasya labdhatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ samānārthābhyāmityasyāyamarthaḥ| sā ca samānārthatā tiṅantāpekṣayā bhavatīti parasparāpekṣayā veditavyā| `ekā jinvati' iti| jayaterlaṭ‌, `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) iti śnuḥ, `bahulaṃ chandasi' (7.1.8) iti jheradādeśaḥ, `huśnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke' (6.4.87) iti yaṇādeśaḥ| anighātapakṣe sārvadhātukasvareṇa madhyodāttametat‌| satiśiṣṭādapi hi vikaraṇasvarāt‌ sārvadhātukasvaro balīyāniṣyate| `atti' [`anti'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] iti| adeḥ `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌| anighātapakṣe dhātusvareṇādādyuttametat‌| `cākaśīti' iti| `kāśṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.647), asya yaṅlugantasya rūpametat‌| `upātiṣṭhat‌' iti| tiṣṭhaterlaṅa pādhrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) tiṣṭhādeśaḥ| `eka iti saṃkhyāpadametat‌' iti| anena pratyudāharaṇa ekaśabdasyānyaśabdenāsamānārthatāṃ darśayati| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇamanyaśabdenāsamānārthena yogena pratyudāharaṇaṃ na darśitam‌? ityāha--`ekaśabdasya vyavasthārthaṃ ca' ityādi| caśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| anekārthasambhave'rahthāntarādvyavacchisyaikatraivārthe vyavasthānaṃ vyavasthā| ekaśabdasya vyavasthārthameva samarthagrahaṇam‌; nānyaśabdasya vyavasthārtham‌| na hi tasyānekārthaḥ sambhavati| tasmādekaśabdasya vyavasthārthaṃ samarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌| tenaivaikaśabdenāsamarthena yoge yuktaṃ pratyudaharaṇamupadarśayitum‌, nānyaśabdenetyabhiprāyaḥ| kasmāt‌ punarekaśabdavyavasthārthameva samarthagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌? ityāha--`vyabhicāritvāt‌ tasya' iti| ekaśabdo hi yatrārthe'nyatrādau vṛṣṭastaṃ vyabhicarati? tathā hi--sa kvacidanyaśabdasyārthe dṛśyate, kvacitprāthamye, kvacit‌ saṃkhyāyām‌, tasmādasau vyabhicārī| anavasthita ityarthaḥ| tadvyavasthārthaṃ samarthagrahaṇaṃ yuktam‌, nānyaśabdavyavasthārtham‌; tasyākhyabhicāritvāt‌| na hyanyaśabdo yatrārthe dṛṣṭastato'nyatra varttate| nanu ca vyavasthāyā etatphalam‌--anyaśabdasamānārthasyaikaśabdasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syāditi, etaccāntareṇāpi vyavasthākāraṇaṃ samarthagrahaṇamanyaśabdasāhacaryādeva labhyate, tadanarthakaṃ samarthagrahaṇam‌? naitadasti; `nipātairyadyadi' (8.1.30) ityādau sūtre nipātagrahaṇena jñāpitam‌--sāhacaryamiha prakaraṇe vyavasthākāraṇaṃ na bhavatīti|| 66. yad‌vṛttānnityam‌| (8.1.66) `prathamā chandasīti ca nivṛttam‌' iti| tayorvibhāṣāgrahaṇena sambaddhatvāt‌| tasya ceha nityagrahaṇena nivarttitatvāt‌| atastannivattau tatsambaddhayorapi nivṛttirbhavati| vṛttaśabdo'yamihādhikaraṇasādhanam‌--varttate tasminniti vṛttam‌; vṛterakarmakatvāt‌ `kto'dhikaraṇe ca' (3.4.76) ityātadinā'dhikaraṇe ktaḥ| tatpunaradhikaraṇaṃ padādhikārāt‌ padameva vijñāyate, ityāha--`yatra pade yacchabdo varttate' ityādi| yadi yad‌vṛttamityadhikaraṇe ktaḥ, tarhi `adhikaraṇavācinā ca' (2.2.13) iti pratiṣedhāt‌ ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na pravarttate? ata eva nipātanāt‌ samāsa ityadoṣaḥ| `etannāśrīyate' iti| yadyetadāśrīyeta, `yatkāmāste juhumaḥ' ityādau na syāditi bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra paribhāṣā śakyā nāśrayitum‌? vaktavyamevaitat‌--iha paribhāṣā na bhavatīti| `dadāti juhumaḥ' iti| abhyastānāmādiḥ' (6.1.189) ityubhayamapyetadādyudāttam‌| `yatkāmāḥ' iti| yasmin‌ kāma eṣāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| `yadryaṅ‌' iti padam‌ yadañcatīti `ṛtvik‌' (3.2.59) ityādinā kvin‌, `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ, `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti tum‌, saṃyogāntalopaḥ, viṣvagdevayoḥ' (6.3.92) ityadryādeśaḥ, kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62)| `vāti' iti| `vā gatigandhanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1050), adāditvācchapo luk‌| dhātusvareṇādyudāttametat‌| `pavate' iti| `pūṅa pavane' (dhā.pā.966) etadapi pūrvavadādyudāttam‌| ata ṅittvāllasārvadhātukasyānudāttatve kṛte dhātusvara eva bhavati| nanu ca yadvṛttāditi pañcamīnirdeśo'yam‌, yatkāmaste juhamaḥ--ityādiṣu codāharaṇeṣu ta ityādinā padena vyavadhānam‌, ato nirdeṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvādiha nighātapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌? ityāha--`pañcamīnirdeśe'ptra vyavahite'pi kāryamiṣyate' [`vyavahite' ityeva--kāśikā] ici etaccottarasūtre jñāpayiṣyate|| 67. pūjānātpūjitamanudāttaṃ kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ| (8.1.67) `pūjanāt‌' iti| supāṃ supo bhavantīti (7.1.39.vā) bahuvacanasya sthāna ekavacanam‌, ata evāha--`pūjanavacanebhyaḥ' iti| `uttarapadam‌' iti| subantaṃ veditavyam‌| nanu tiṅiti varttate? satyametat‌; uttaratra (8.1.68) tiṅiti vacanādiha subantasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| api ca vakṣyatyetat‌--ihaiva samāse caitadanudāttatvamiti| samāsaśca kāṣṭhādīnāṃ subantenaiva sambhavati, na tiṅanteneti yuktamiha subantasyaiva padasya garahaṇam‌| sarva ete kāṣṭhādayo'dbhutaparyāyāḥ pūjanavacanā bhavanti| adbhutaṃ yo'dhīte sa kāṣṭhādhyāyaka ityucyate| evaṃ dāruṇādiṣu veditavyam‌| iha sarva evaite kāṣṭhādayaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇabhūtāḥ samasyante, na ca kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ samāsaḥ kvacidvihitaḥ, tatkathamatra samāsaḥ? ityāha--`mayūravyaṃsakāditvāt‌ samāsaḥ' iti| `samāse caitat‌' ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| samāsa evetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ samāsa evaitallabhyate? `cādilope vibhāṣā' (8.1.63) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| sā vyavasthitavibhāṣeti vijñānācca| yadyevam‌, kathaṃ vārttikakāreṇoktam‌--malopaśceti, kāṣṭhādiṣu hi yo'kārāntāsteṣāṃ vibhakterambhāve kṛte makāraḥ sambhavati, samāse caitadanudāttatvena bhavitavyam‌, tatra vibhakterabhāvānmakāro na sambhavatīti malopavacanamayuktaṃ syāt‌? ityata āha--`malopaścetyanenāpi' ityādi| evamasmābhiranudāttatvasya viṣaya ākhyātaḥ| malopa ścetyanenāpi sa evākhyāyate; yasmāt‌ samāse malopo na bhavati; vibhakterluptatvāt‌| asamāse vibhakterambhāve kṛte makārasya śravaṇameva bhavati, na tu lopaḥ| athāsamāse malopārthamityetaduktamityeva kasmānna vijñāyate? ityāha--`asamāse[`athāsamāse'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] hi ityādi| atha pūjitagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā pūjanaśabdo'yaṃ pūjitāpekṣatvāt‌ sambandhiśabdaḥ, tena sambandhiśabdatvāt‌ pūjitamarthādupasthāpayati, tantrāntareṇāpi pūjitagrahaṇaṃ pūjitasyaiva parigraho bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`pūjanādeva' ityādi| pūjanagrahaṇādeva pūjitagrahaṇe labdhe pūjitagrahaṇaṃ yat‌ kriyate tasyaitat‌ prayojanam‌--viśiṣṭasyāvyavahitasya pratyāsannasya grahaṇaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌| tenottarasūtre (8.1.68) yat‌ kāṣṭhaṃ devadattaḥ pacatītyatra vyavahitasya na bhaviṣyati| nanu pañcamīnirdeśādeva vyavahitasya na bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`etadeva' ityādi| yādṛśamidaṃ jñāpakaṃ tadanurūpam‌ `yad‌vṛttānnityam‌' (8.1.66) ityatra yatkāmāste juhumaḥ, yadryaṅ‌ vāyurvātītyevamādyudāhṛta mityarthaḥ| etena jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ darśitam‌| athānudāttagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā `anudāttaṃ sarvamapādādau' (8.1.18) ityato'nudāttagrahaṇamanuvartata [`anuvartteta ityāha'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] eva? ityāha--`anudātta iti varttamāne' [`anudāttamiti'--kāśikā] ityādi| taddhyanudāttagrahaṇaṃ `na luṭ‌' (8.1.29) iti pratiṣedhena sambaddham‌, atastadanuvṛttau so'pyanuvarttate| tathā ca sati yasyāmantritādeḥ pūjitasya nighātaprāptirasti tasyāyaṃ kāṣṭhādibhyaḥ parasya nighātapratiṣedho vijñāyeta| tasmāt‌ pratiṣedhanivṛttyarthamanyadihānudāttagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|| 68. sagatirapi tiṅ‌| (8.1.68) `sagatigrahaṇācca gatirapi nihanyate' iti| tulyayoge'tra sahaśabdaḥ| tatrobhayorapi vidhīyamānena kāryeṇa sambandho bhavati| tathā hi saputro bhojyatāmityukte dvayorapi pitāputrayorbhojanena sambandho bhavati| tasmādihāpyagatestiṅantasya ca nighāte ca sambandho vijñāyate| `gatigrahaṇena cātropasargagrahaṇamiṣyate' iti| yathā caitallabhyate tathā pūrvamevākhyātam‌| tiṅgrahaṇaṃ pūrvo nighātaḥ subantaviṣayo yathā vijñāyetetyevamartham‌|| 69. kutsane ca supyagotrādau| (8.1.69) `pacati pūti' iti| patiśabdasaya kriyādiviśeṣaṇatvāt‌ `svamornapuṃsakāt‌' (7.1.23) iti vibhakterluk‌| `pacati, kliśnāti' iti| `kliśū vibādhane' (dhā.pā.1522), kryāditvāt‌ śnā| atra kliśnātītyetat‌ kutsanaṃ bhavati, yo yasya bādhanaṃ karoti tena sa kutsyate| sambandho'pyanayostiṅantayorastyeva| yasmāt‌ pacati tasmāt‌ kliśnātīti| subantaṃ tu kliśnātītyetanna bhavati, asya na bhavati nighātaḥ| `kriyākutsane' ityādi| tiṅante dvayamasti--sādhanam‌, kriyā ca| tatra kriyāyāḥ kutsane'nudāttatvaṃ bhavatītyetadarthamidaṃ vyākhyeyam‌, karttuḥ kutsane mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ ca| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`cādilope vibhāṣā' vibhāṣā' (8.1.63) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanuvarttate| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca sā, tena kriyākutsana eva bhaviṣyati, na karttuḥ kutsana iti| nanu ca kriyāpradhānamākhyātam‌, sādhanaṃ tu tatrāpradhānam‌, tasya kriyāṅgatvāt‌, atra prādhānyādeva patītyevamādinā viśeṣaṇena kriyāyā eva sambandho bhaviṣyati, na guṇabhūtasya kartuḥ, tatkimucyate kriyākutsanamiti? evaṃ manyate--yathaiva kṛdanteṣu dāruṇādhyāyakādiṣu kriyāyāḥ pradhānabhūtāyā api viśeṣaṇena sambandho bhavati, tathā'khyāteṣvaprādhānye'pi sādhanasya viśeṣaṇena sambandhena bhavitavyamiti| `pūtiścānubandhaḥ' ityādi| pūtiśabdaścakārānubandho bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--cakāro'tra krayate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tena pūtiścānubandho bhaviṣyatīti| nanu ca pūtiśabdasya prātipadikatvādapratiṣiddhamevāntodāttatvam‌, kasmāt‌ sa cānubandhaḥ kriyate? na cāyaṃ ktinnantaḥ, pūtirayamiti puṃsā sāmānādhikaraṇyāt‌| tarhyanena cakārānubandhakaraṇenaivaitad‌darśayati--yatra sagatestiṅo'nudāttatvaṃ tatra pūterantodāttatvam‌, anyatrāyamādyudātta eva; tena kriyākutsane'ntodāttaḥ karttavyaḥ, kutsana ādyudātta iti| `tenāyam‌' ityātadinā cānubanadhakatvasya phalaṃ darśayati| `vibhāṣitam‌' ityādi| bahvartha yat‌ tiṅantaṃ tadvibhāṣā'nudāttaṃ bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tvihāpi vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛtteḥ| tena vyavasthitavibhāṣātvaṃ caśritya karttavyam‌| `supi kutsane' ityādi| athamuktārthasaṃgrahaślokaḥ| tatrādyena pādena yaduktaṃ kriyākutsana iti varaktavyamiti tasya saṃgrahaḥ| `malopaḥ' ityādi| nāsmin‌ tiṅ‌ vidyata ityatiṅiti| sa punaḥ prastāvāt‌ [prastādān‌--prā.kā.mudritapāṭhau] kāṣṭhādīnāṃ samāso vijñāyate| tatrātiṅi kāṣṭhādisamāse malopa iṣṭaḥ| etacca malopaścetyanenāyameva viṣaya ākhyāyata ityādinā tūktārtham‌, tadanena samāsa caitadanudāttatvamityādinā yaduktaṃ tatasarvaṃ grahītum‌| atha vā malopa ityanena malopaścetyetadvacanamupalakṣayati| asya coktārthamityanena sambandhaḥ| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--malopaśceti yat‌ kāryaṃ vacanaṃ tanmalopaścetyanenaipityādinā pūrvamevoktaprayojanamiti| `atiṅi' iti| anudāttamityetadvaktavyamiti vṛttabhaṅgabhayānnoktam‌| anuktamapi tasya ślokasya pūrvoktārthasaṃgrahārthatvāt‌ kāṣṭhādīnāma ca pūrvamanudāttasya coktatvādgamyata eva| atiṅīti cānena bahuvrīhiṇā samāsaḥ| tenaitaduktaṃ bhavati--kāṣṭhādīnāṃ samāse'nudāttatvaṃ bhavatīti| śeṣaṃ sugamam‌|| 70. gatirgatau| (8.1.70) `abhyuddharati' iti| abhiśabdasya prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttatve prāpta ucchabde gatau parato'nudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `samudānayati' iti| atrāpi `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80), `upasargāścābhivarjam‌' (phi.sū.4.81) iti sama ādyudāttatve prāpte'nudāttatvaṃ bhavati| kathaṃ punaratrāha--samaśca gatisaṃjñeti yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ pratyeva gatyupasargasajñe bhavata ityuktam‌ (jai.pa.vṛ.99), na cocchabdasya kriyāvācitvam‌? naiṣa doṣaḥ; kriyāviśeṣavācino hi prādayaḥ| kriyāviśeṣaśca kriyaiva| kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyetyuktam‌| upasaga'pi kārakapravṛttiviśiṣyata eva| na [na hyuddharatīti?] hyuttaratīti haratyartha eva kevalaṃ karttṛvyāpāraṃ vyavacchinati| kiṃ tarhi? upasargārtho'pi| atha vā haraṇādarthāntaramevoddharaṇam‌, tasyābhirviśeṣaṇamiti nānupapannā gatisaṃjñā| `devadattaḥ prapacati' iti| devairdāsīṣṭeti `kticktau ca saṃjñāyām‌' (3.3.174) iti ktaḥ; `do dad‌dhoḥ' (7.4.46) iti dadādeśaḥ| `tṛtīyā karmaṇi' (6.2.48) ityādyudāttatve prāpte `kārakāddattaśrutayorevāśiṣi' (6.2.148) iti devadattaśabdo'ntodāttaḥ| `āmandraiḥ' ityādi| atra sarvamasti, na tu mandrogatiriti| tasmin‌ parata āṅo'nudāttatvaṃ na bhavati| asati canudāttatve `nipātā ādyudāttāḥ' (phi.sū.4.80) `upasargaścābhivarjam‌' (phi sū 4.81) ityādyudāttatvameva bhavati| kathaṃ punarāṅo gatisaṃjñā, kriyāyoge hi sati vihitā sā, na cātrāsti kriyāyogaḥ, mandaraśabdasyākriyāvācitvāt‌? ityata āha--`yāhītyetat‌ prati kriyāyogādāṅitveṣa gatiḥ' iti| satyapi vyavadhāne vyavahitāśca (1.4.82) iti gatisaṃjñāvidhānāditi bhavāḥ| syādetat‌, yadyapi yāhītyetat‌ pratyāṅo gatitvam‌, tathāpi mandraśabdaṃ prati nāsyeva tasya gatisaṃjñā, tena yadyapi gatāvityetannocyeta, tathāpi naivehānudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`tasya' ityādi| atrāsyānudāttatvaṃ syādeveti| asya `anāśritapanimittakam‌' ityanena heturuktaḥ| tasyānāśritaparanimittakasyāpi gatāvityasminnasatyenena gatigrahaṇasyābhāvo heturabhihitaḥ| yadi gatāvityennocyeta, tato'nāśritaparanimittamevānudāttatvamuktaṃ syāt‌| na hyasati saptamīnirdiṣṭe gatigrahaṇe paranimittatāśrīyate| tataśca gatirityetāvatyucyamāne yadyapi mandraśabdo gatirna bhavati, tathāpi tasyāṅāśritaparanimittamanudāttatvamiha syādeva| gatāvityasmiṃstu sati na bhavatyeṣa doṣaḥ; gateḥ paranimittasyāśrayaṇāt‌ tasya cehābhāvāt‌|| 71. tiṅi codāttavati| (7.1.71) `yatprapacati yatprakaroti' [yat‌ karoti--mudritakāśikāpāṭhaḥ] iti| `yad‌vṛttānnityam‌' (8.1.66) iti nighātapratiṣedhe kṛte ubhayamapyetat‌ tiṅantamudāttavadbhavati--ekaṃ dhātusvareṇa, aparaṃ pratyayasvareṇa| ihedaṃ tiṅagrahaṇamevamarthaṃ kriyate--tiṅyudāttavati yathā syāt‌, `āmandrairindra haribhiryāhi' ityatra mandraśabde mā bhūdityevamartham‌; etaccāprayojanam‌, yadi sa tatra syāt‌ pūrvasūtre gatāvityetadapārthakaṃ syāt‌| asya hi tatra mandraśabde mā bhūdityevamartham‌; etaccāprayojanam‌, yadi sa tatara syāt‌ pūrvasūtre gatāvityetadapārthakaṃ syāt‌| asya hi tatra mandraśabde parato mā bhūdityetadeva ayojanaṃ vyavasthitam‌| na cānyat‌ tiṅgrahaṇasyeha vyavacchedyamasti| tasmādvyavacchedyābhāvānna karttavyameva tiṅgrahaṇam‌? ityetaccodyamapākarttumāha--`tiṅgrahaṇam‌' ityādi| parimāṇam‌-paricchedaḥ| tadudāttavato yathā syādityevamarthaṃ tiṅgrahaṇam‌| kiṃ panaḥ syāt‌, yadi parimāṇārthaṃ tiṅgrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta? ityata āha--`anyathā hi' ityādi| yadi hi tiṅīti nopyeta tadodāttavatītyetāvatyucyamāne yadyudāttavatīti sāmānyenocyeta, tathāpi pratyāsatteryaṃ prati gatistasyava nighāto vijñāyeta| tataśca dhātāvevodāttavati syāt‌--yat‌ pravacatītyādau, pratyaye tu yat‌ prakarotītyatra na syāt‌| vikaraṇo hyatrodāttavān‌ na dhātuḥ| nanu codātto'tra pratyayaḥ, nodāttavān‌, na hi pratyayādanyaḥ sa udātto'sti yena pratyaya udāttavān‌ syāt‌? naitat‌ sāram‌; yathā syāt‌ [`nāsti--kā.mu.pustake] yatrādyudāttatvamasya vyapadeśivadbhāvena bhavati tathodāttatvamapi syādeva| syādetat‌| pratyayamapi prati prādergatisaṃjñā, tato nāyaṃ doṣaḥ? ityata āha--`yatkriyāyuktāḥ' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt‌ yatkriyāyuktāḥ prādayastaṃ prati teṣāṃ gatyupasargasaṃjñā, tasmāddhātumeva prati gatisaṃjñā, na pratyayam‌| yadi hi pratyayo'pi dhātuvat‌ kriyāvacana syāt‌, tamapi prati prādayo gatisaṃjñāṃ prapadyeran‌| na cāsau kriyāvacanaḥ, tasmānna pratyayaṃ prati prādīnāṃ gatisaṃjñāḥ| `āmante tarhi' ityādi| prapacatitarāmiti `tiṅaśca' (5.3.56) iti tarap‌, tadantāt‌ `kimettiṅ‌' (5.4.11) ityādināmi kṛte satyāmantametadbhavati| na tiṅantam‌| tato yadi tiṅi ceti tiṅagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tasminnāmante parato gatinighāto na prāpnoti| atra' ityādi uttaram‌| atra kecit‌ `kugatiprādayaḥ' (2.2.18) ityāmantena gateḥ samāsaṃ kurvanti, kecinna kurvantyeveti| tatra trayaḥ pakṣāḥ| tatra ya āmantena samāsaṃ kurvanti, teṣāṃ `tatpuruṣa tulyārthatūtīyā' (6.2.2) ityādinā pūrvapadasyāvyayasya prakṛtisvare sati śeṣasya `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam‌' (6.1.158) ityanudāttatvena bhavitavyam‌| ato'kriyamāṇe'pi tiṅgrahaṇe paramāmantamudāttaṃ na bhavatīti gatinighāto naiva sidhyati| tato nāyaṃ doṣastiṅgrahaṇe satyeva, kiṃ tarhi? asatyapi| tena tiṅgrahaṇe kriyamāṇa eva codayituṃ yuktamityabhiprāyaḥ| `atha' ityādi| atha tarabantena gatisamāsaḥ kriyate? evamapyuktameva codyam‌| tathā hi--`tarabantasya gatisamāsaḥ' ityasmin‌ pakṣe prāggatisamāse kṛte pūrvapadasya ca prakṛtisvaratve paścādāmā bhavitavyam‌, tathā ca satiśiṣṭatvādāma evodāttatve sati gateḥ `anudāttaṃ pademekavarjam‌' (6.1.158) ityanenaivānudāttatvaṃ siddham‌, ato nārthaṃ etatsūtravihitena gatinighāteneti| vābhāve vāha codakaḥ--`yeṣāṃ tu' ityādi| `gatikārakīpapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsavacanaṃ prāk‌ subutpatteḥ' (vyā.pa.138) ityatra darśanadvayam‌--`gatyādayo'viśeṣeṇa samasyante kṛdbhiḥ saha saha prāksubutpatteḥ' ityekaṃ darśanam‌; `gatyādayaḥ kṛdbhireva samasyante, nānyapratyayāntaiḥ, taiśca prāksubutpatteḥ' iti dvitīyam‌| tatra yeṣāṃ pūrvaṃ darśanaṃ tānpratyāmante tarhi na prāpnotīti satyamayuktametaccodyam‌| yeṣāṃ tu dvitīyaṃ darśanaṃ tān‌ pratyuraktameva| tathā hi--teṣāmevaṃvidhaviṣaye prapacatitarāmityevaṃprakāre yatra kṛtprayogo nāsti tatra samāsena naiva bhavitavyam‌| atha pṛthaksvaraḥ prāpnoti--praśabdasya `upasargāścābhivarjam‌' (phi.sū.4.81) ityādyudāttatvaṃ prāpnoti, pacatitarāmityatrāpi pratyayasvareṇāma udāttatvam‌? tatra pṛthaksvaraprāptau satyāmanena nighātena prayojanam‌| eṣa ca gatinighātastiṅagrahaṇe kriyamāṇe satyāmantena prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ| itara āha--`tadartha yatnaḥ karttavyaḥ' iti| sa punaratra vyākhyānaviśeṣaḥ| iha cakāraḥ kriyate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāmante'pi nighāto bhaviṣyatīti| `prapacati, prakaroti' iti| `tiṅaṅatiṅa' (8.1.28) iti nighātādubhayamapyetadudāttavanna bhavati|| 72. āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavat‌| (8.1.72) `tasmin‌ sati' ityādinā'vidyamānavadbhavatītyasyārthamācaṣṭe| `avidyamānavat‌' iti| vatinā nirdeśo'yam‌, avidyamānena tulyaṃ varttata ityavidyamānavat‌| vatiśca sādśye bhavati, evañca tasyāvidyamānena sādṛśyaṃ bhavati yadi satyapi tasmiṃstannibandhanaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavati| asati ca tasmin‌ yat‌ kāryaṃ tadattānibandhanaṃ tat‌ satyapi tasmin‌ bhavati| `āmantritanighātena' [āmantritatiṅanighāta--kāśikā--padamaṃjarī ca] ityādinā tasmin‌ sati yatkāryaṃ prāpnoti tadabhāvamavidyamānavadbhāvasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `devadatt yajñadatta' iti| atra pūrvasyāvidyamānatvādasati nighāte yajñadattaśabdasya ṣāṣṭikamevāmantri (6.1.198) tādyudāttatvaṃ bhavati| `devadatta mama grāmaḥ svam‌' ti| `tavamamau ṅasi' (7.2.96) iti tadamamādeśau sāptikau| `ityevamādiṣu' iti| ādiśabdena `devadatta tubhyaṃ dīyate' ityevamādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌, `yuṣmadasmadādeśā na bhavanti' iti| `temayāvekavacanasya' (8.1.22) ityevamādayaḥ| `pūjāyāmanantarapratiṣedhaḥ prayojanam‌' ityādinā tasminnāmantrite'sati yatkāryaṃ prāpnoti tasya satyapi tasmin‌ bhāve'vidyamānavadbhāvasya prayojanaṃ darśayati| `yāvaddevadatta pacasītyatrāpi' ityādi| yatrāpyāmantritaṃ vyavadhāyakamityeṣo'piśabdasyārtho veditavyaḥ| `devadattaḥ pacati' iti| atrāvidyamānatvābhāvat‌ tiṅanighāto bhavatyeva| `pūrvam‌' iti| kiṃ devadatta iti pūrvaṃ paramapi khalu bhavati? na ceha paramastīti nāsti devadattetyasya pūrvatvam‌| tenāmantritādyudāttatve karttavye nāvidyamānavadbhavati| `devadatta pacasi' iti| atra pacasītyetadapekṣayā devadattaśabdasya pūrvatvamastītyavidyamānavadbhāvena tasya bhavitavyam‌, tataścāmantritādyudāttatva tasya na syāt‌| `imaṃ me gaṅge yamune'--ityatra ca gaṅgeśabdasya yamuneśabdenānantaryamapanayan‌ sa nighātanimittabhāvaṃ pratibadhnīyāditi yamuneśabdasya nighāto na syādityetaccodyadvayamāśaṅkyāha--`pūrvatvaṃ ca' ityādi| cakāro'vadhāraṇe, bhinnakramaśca| parāpekṣamevetyevaṃ draṣṭavyam‌| itikaraṇo hetau| yeṣāṃ yadbhāvo yadapekṣavadbhavati teṣāṃ tadbhāvenānūdyamānānāṃ vidhīyamāno dharmastadviṣaya eva pratīyate| tadyathā--putraḥ kāryeṣvavahita iti putrasya putrabhāvaḥ putrāpekṣa iti tasya putrabhāvenānūdyamānasya vidhīyamānaṃ kāryeṣvavahitatvaṃ yadapekṣaṃ putratvaṃ tatkāryeṣvavagamyate, nānyakāryeṣu| pūrvatvaṃ cedaṃ parāpekṣameva| tasmāt‌ tadanūdyāmantritasyāvidyamānavadbhāvo yadapekṣaṃ tatpūrvatvaṃ tasyaiva parasya kārye karttavye bhavati, nānyasya| kiṃviśiṣṭe kārye? svānimitte, anyanimitte yā| svaṃ nimittaṃ yasya tat‌ svanimittam‌, āmantritamityarthaḥ| tasmādanyacchabdāntaraṃ nimittaṃ yasya tadantanimittam‌| yata evaṃ parasyaiva kārye karttavye tadāmantritamavidyamānavadbhavati, na tu svakārye karttavye, tena devadatta pacasautyatrāmantritādyudāttatvaṃ na parasya kāryam‌; kiṃ tarhi? āmantritasyaiva| yataḥ parasya kāryamanudāttatvam‌, tasmiṃstvavidyamānavdabhavatyeva| evaṃ prathamacodyaṃ nirākṛtya dvitīyaṃ nirākarttumāha--`imaṃ me gaṅge yamune' ityādi| atrāpi pūrvatvaṃ ca parāpekṣaṃ bhavatītyeṣa eva hetuḥ| gaṅgeśabdaḥ pūrvamāmantritāntaḥ svayamavidyamānavattvānnimittaṃ na bhavatīti sambandhanīyam‌| kva viṣaye nimittaṃ na bhavati? parasyaiva sumuneśabdasyānudāttatve karttavye| meśabdasya ca nimittabhāvaṃ na pratibadhyātīti gaṅgeśabdaḥ pūrvamāmantrito yamuneśabdasyānudāttatve karttavye vidyamānavattvāditi sarvamapekṣate| iha pūrvaśapabdasya sambandhiśabdatvāt‌ parasya kārye karttavye pūrvasyāmantritasyāvidyamānavadbhāvo vidhīyate| `imaṃ me gaṅge yamune' ittayatra ca yadyapi gaṅgeśabdādanyacchabdāntaraṃ `me' ityetadyamuneśabdasyānudāttasya nimittam‌, tathāpi tadanudāttatvaṃ pasyaivāmantritasya kāryamiti tasminnapi karttavye gaṅgeśabdo'vidyamānavadbhavati| ata eva
