itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `coḥ kuḥ' (8.2.30) iti kutvam‌--gakāraḥ| `sādhulak‌' iti| sādhu lajjāta iti kvip‌| atra padasyādasāne saṃyogaḥ| (7.1.60) iti num‌, sa ca bhavat‌ `masjerantyāt‌ pūrvo numanuṣaṅgasaṃyogādilopārtham‌' (vā. 7) iti vacanādantyājjakārāt‌ pūrvo bhavati, tasya ca `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `taṣṭaḥ' iti| `takṣū tvakṣū tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.655,656) ūdittvāt‌, svaratyādisūtreṇa (7.2.44) vibhāṣiteṭ‌; tena niṣṭhāyāṃ `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `kāṣṭhaśavasthātā' iti| kāṣṭhaṃ śaknotīti kvip‌; kāṣṭhaśaki sthāteti `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ| `tadatra' ityādinā `jhali saṅīti vaktavyam‌' (vā 917) iti yaduktam‌, tat‌ pratyācaṣṭe| taditi vākyopanyāsārthaḥ| `śakeḥ kvibantasya prayoga eva nāsti' iti| śakeḥ `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyate' (3.2.178) iti kvip‌ syāt‌, iha ca `dṛśyate' ityasya grahaṇa evāyamarthaḥ--yatra laukike prayoge kvibantasya prayogo dṛśyate tatra yathā syāditi, na ca loke kāṣṭhaśagityevaṃvidhaḥ śakeḥ kvibantasya prayogo dṛśyate| tataḥ śakeḥ kvibantasya prayoga eva nāsti, ato hetoḥ `jhali saṅīti vaktavyam‌' (vā.917) ityetat‌ pratyākhyātumāha bhāvyakāraḥ--`kāṣṭhāśageva nāsti; kuto'yaṃ kāṣṭhaśaki tiṣṭhet‌' iti| ādhāraparatanva udghanādāvasya vṛttiḥ, ato yatra kāṣṭhaśagādhāra eva nāsti, tatra tadādheyaḥ sthātā sutarāmeva nāsti tasmānna jhali saṅīti vaktavyam‌; vyāvarttyābhāvāt‌| iha kasmānna bhavati--vāksthāteti? saṃyogādilope kutvamyāsiddhatvāt‌| atheha kasmānna bhavati--vāsyārtham‌ kākyartham? ityāha--`dāsyartham‌, kākyartham‌' ityādi| atha skoriti kimartham‌? narnartītyatra mā bhūt‌| nṛteryaṅlugantasya `rugrikau ca luki' (7.4.91) ityabhyāsasya ruki kṛte rūpametat‌| `saṃyogādyoriti kim‌? `payaḥśak‌' iti| kvibantametat‌| sopapadasya hi śakeḥ kvibantasya prayoga eva nāsti| kevalasya tu syādeva| ante ceti kim‌? takṣitā, takṣakaḥ|| 30. coḥ kuḥ| (8.2.30) `jhali padānte ca' iti| `parataḥ' iti pratyekamabhisambadhyate| nanu ca pūrvasūtre cakāreṇa jhalanukṛṣṭa iti tasyehānuvṛttirayuktā? naitadasti; na hi tatra cakāreṇa jhalanukṛṣṭaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? svaritatvādevānuvarttamānasyāntagrahaṇaṃ na bādhakamityatādaccakāreṇa vyākhyātam‌| `vāk‌' iti| vaceḥ `kvibvaci' (vā.288) ityādinā jvip‌, dīrghaśca| `kruñca' iti| iha kecit‌ `kuñca kauṭisyālpībhādayoḥ' (dhā.pā.186) iti sarephaṃ akāropadhaṃ dhātuṃ paṭhanti, `kuñca kauṭilyālpībhāvayoḥ' (dhā.pā.185) ityarekaṃ nakāropadhaṃ pare| tatra pūrvapāṭhaṃ gṛhītvā yaścodayet‌--atha kruñcetyatra kasmān bhavatīti? taṃ pratyāha--`ṝñca' ityādi| anena `jhali saṅīti na vaktavyam‌' iti yat‌ pūrvaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ tasyehārthatāṃ darśayati| `yujikruñcāñca' (3.2.59) iti nipātanādveti| `kruñcetyatra ñakārasya cakāre kutvaṃ na bhavatīti sambandhaḥ| `ñakāropadhasya [ñakāripadasya--kā.mudritapāṭhaḥ] sarephasya pāṭhamabhyupetya prāptau tasyāmevaṃ parihāradvayamuktam‌| ipānīṃ kutvasya prāptireva nāsti; yasmānnāyaṃ ñakaropadhaḥ paṭhyate, kiṃ tarhi? nakāropadha iti darśayitumāha--`nakāropadho vā' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ nakāropadhaḥ paṭhyate? kiṃ tarhi? nakāropadha iti darśayitumāha--`nakāropadho vā' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ nakāropadhaḥ paṭhyate? ityāha--`nakāralope hi'[`sakāralope hi'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| nikucita ityeṣa prayogo'styeva| dhātorniṣṭhāntasya `śnānnalopaḥ' (6.4.23) ityanuvarttamāne-`aniditām‌' (6.4.24) iti nalopādiha nakāralopasya darśanānnakāropadho'yaṃ paṭhyate; anyathā hyeṣa prayogo nopapadyate| na hi ñakāralopasya kiñcillakṣaṇamasti| yadi tarhi kuñceti repharahito nakāropadhaḥ paṭhyate, evaṃ sati kruṅa, kruñcau, kruñcaḥ--iti na sidhyati; ṛtvigityādinā (3.2.59) sūtreṇa hi kvini kṛte `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) iti nalope kuka, kucau, kucaḥ--ityevaṃ prāpnotītyata āha--`yujikruñcām‌' ityādi| syādetat‌--yadyapi nakāralopābhāvo nipātyate, tathāpi nakārasyānusvāre tasya yayi parasavarṇe (8.4.58) ñakāre syādeva kutvam‌? ityata āha--`tatra' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 31. ho ḍhaḥ| (8.2.31) `soḍhā' iti| `ho ḍhaḥ' iti ḍhatve kṛte `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti tṛcatakārasya dhatvam‌, ṣṭutvam‌, `ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ' (8.2.13) `sahivahorodavaṇasya' (6.3.112) ityottvam‌| `jalāṣāṭ‌' iti| jalaṃ sahata iti `bhajo ṇviḥ' (3.2.62), `chandasi sahaḥ' (3.2.63) iti ṇviḥ, upadhāvṛddhiḥ upapadasamāsaḥ, `anyeṣāmapi dṛśyate' (6.3.137) iti pūrvapadasya dīrgha, ḍhakārasya jaśtvam‌--ḍakāraḥ, tasya carttvam‌--ṭakāraḥ, `saheḥ sāḍaḥ saḥ' (8.3.56) iti mūrghanyaḥ| `praṣṭhavāṭ‌' iti| `vahaśca' (3.2.64) iti ṇviḥ| `cuhoḥ kuḍhau' ityekayoga eva karttavye pṛthagyogakaraṇaṃ samasaṃkhyātvapratiṣedhārtham‌| ekayoge tu samasaṃkhyatvājjhalādau kutva padānte ḍhatvaṃ syāt‌|| 32. dāderdhātorghaḥ| (8.2.32) `dagdhā, dagdhum‌' iti| pūrvavaddhatvam‌, ghakārasya jhaśi jhaśatvam‌--gakāraḥ| `kāṣṭhadhak‌' iti| kvibantametat‌| `ekāco baśo bhaṣa' (8.2.37) ityādinā dakārasya bhaṣ‌--dhakāraḥ, ghakārasya jaśtvam‌--gakāraḥ, tasya carttvam‌--kakāraḥ| `dādeḥ' ityucyate, tenādhogityatra ghatvaṃ na sidhyati, adakārāditve'syāvihitatvādityata āha--`dhātoḥ' ityādi| `taddhiśeṣaṇam‌' iti| dāderviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭam‌? avayavaṣaṣṭhyantamiti| avayavasambandhinī yā ṣaṣṭhī tadantamityarthaḥ| `kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? iti| evaṃ sati kimiṣṭhaṃ sādhitaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| `adhogityatrāpi ghakāraḥ siddho bhavati' iti| atrāpi dhātoravayavo yo dādiśabdastadavayavatvādhakārasya| duherlaṅ‌, tip‌, adāditvācchapo luk‌, halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68), pūrdhavadbhaṣbhāvaḥ, aṭ‌| `katham‌' ityādi| dhātoravayavo yo dādiśabdastadavayavasaya hakārasya ghatvaṃ bhavati| evaṃ sati dagdhā, dagdhumityatra ghatvaṃ na kathañcidityarthaḥ| tathā hyatra dhātoravayavo yo dādiśabdo na tasyāvayavo hakāraḥ| yasya tu samudāyasya hakāro'vayavaḥ sa dhātureva, na hakārāvayavaḥ| atrottaramāha--`vyapadeśivadbhāvāt‌' iti| eṣo'pi vyapadeśivadbhāvena dhātorvādiravayavo bhavati| abhede'pi vyapadeśivadvyavahāro loke dṛśyate| tathā hi--śilāpu trakasya śarīram‌, rāhoḥ śira iti ca| `atha vā' ityādi| dhātūpadeśo dhātupāṭhaḥ| tatra yo dādirityevaṃ vijñāyate| kathaṃ punardhātupāṭhe dakārāditvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ labhyate, dhātugrahaṇasāmarthyāt‌| tasya hīdaṃ prayojanaṃ syāt‌--adhātormā bhūditi| etaccāprayojanam‌, na hyadhātordhakārāderjhali vā padānte ca hakāro'vayavaḥ sambhavati, yannivṛttyarthaṃ dhātugrahaṇam‌| tadatiricyamānaṃ dhātūpadeśa eva dakārāditvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavatītyamumarthaṃ gamayati| evaṃ vijñāyamāne yadyapi `dhātoḥ' ityasya `dādeḥ' ityanena sāmānādhikaraṇyam‌, tathāpyadhogityatra ghatvaṃ pravarttata eva; dhātupāṭhe duherdakārāditvāt‌| `tathā ca' ityādi| evañca vijñāyamāne yadyapi dāmalihyaterdakārāditvam‌, tathāpi dāmaliḍityatra na bhavati dhatvam‌'; dhātūpadeśe tasyādakārāditvāt‌| dhātutvaṃ tasya `sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (3.1.32) iti| na kevalamadhogitvatra dhatvaṃ bhavati, api tu dāmaliherapi bhavatītyapiśabdo dyotayati| dāma leḍhoti dāmaliḍiti kvip‌, tadantād‌ dāmalihamilchatīti `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌; (3.1.8) iti kyac‌, kyajantāt‌ kvip‌, `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralopaḥ, `kyasya vibhāṣā' (6.4.50) iti yakārasya ca, `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌, ḍhakārasya jaśtvam‌|| 33. vā druhamuhaṣṇuhaṣṇihām‌| (8.2.33) `drūheḥ' iti| `druha jighāṃsāyam‌' (dhā.pā.1197) ityasya| `itarevām‌' iti| `muha vaicittye' (dhā.pā.1198), `ṣṇuha ud‌giraṇe' (dhā.pā.1199), `ṣṇiha prītau' (dhā.pa.1200)-ityeṣāmaprāpteḥ| punareṣaṃ ghatvaṃ syāt‌, adakārāditvāt‌|| 34. naho dhaḥ| (8.1.34) `upānat‌' iti| `ṇaha bandhane' (dhā.pā.1166) kvip‌, `nahivṛti' (6.3.116) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| evaṃ parīṇat‌' iti| atra ṇatvaṃ tu `upasargādasamāse'pi, (8.4.14) ityādinā| prakriyālāghavārthaṃ dakāre vidhātavye dhakāravidhānam‌--naddhetyatra `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌| dakāre hi tanna syāt‌, dakārasyājhaṣtvāt‌| `radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ' (8.2.42) ityevamarthaṃ ca, nakāro yathā na syāditi|| 35. āhasthaḥ| (8.1.35) `āttha' iti| `bruvaḥ pañcānāmādita āho bruvaḥ' (3.4.84) iti laḍādeśasya sipasthal‌ bruvaścāhādeśaḥ, tasyānena thakāraḥ, tasya `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti carttvam‌--takāraḥ| kimarthamādeśāntaraṃ kriyate, na prakṛtervikāra eva vidhīyate? ityata āha--`ādeśāntarakaraṇam‌' ityādi| yadi dhakāra ādiśyeta, tataḥ `jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ' (8.2.40) iti dhatvaṃ syāt‌, atastannivṛttyarthamādeśāntaraṃ kriyate| `hṛgrahoḥ' ityādi| harateḥ, graheśca yo hakārastasya cchandasi vivaye bhakāro vaktavyaḥ| hakārasyeti vacanaṃ haratyartham‌| grahestu `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) ityeva bhaviṣyati hakārasya| `grabhītā' iti| tṛn‌, iṭ‌, `graho'liṭi dīrdhaḥ' (7.2.37)| `jabhrire' iti| hṛño liṭ‌, `liṭastajhayoreśirec‌' (3.4.81) iti jhasyerec‌; yaṇādeśaḥ, dvirvacanam‌, abhyāsakāryam‌| `udgrābham‌', `nigrābham‌' iti| graheḥ `halaśca' (3.3.121) iti ghañ‌| etattu sarvaṃ `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) iti varṇavyatyayenaiva siddham‌| vaktavyaśabdasya vyākhyeyamityeṣo'rtho veditavyaḥ|| 36. vraścabhrasjasṛjamṛjayajarājabhrājacchaśāṃ ṣaḥ| (8.2.36) `o vraścū chedane' (dhā.pā.1292), `bhrasjo pāke' [`bhrasja' ityeva dhātupāṭhaḥ] (dā.pā.1284), `sṛja visarge' (dhā.pā.1178), mṛjū śuddhau' (dhā.pā.1066), `yaja devapūjāsaṅgatikaraṇadāneṣu' (dhā.pā.1002), `rājū dīptau' (dhā.pā.822), `ṭu bhrājṛ ṭṛbhrāśṛ ṭubhlāśṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.823,824,825)| cha iti cchakārāntāvāṃ grahaṇam‌; śa iti śakārāntānām‌| atra ca śakārasya jaśtve prāpte, itareṣāṃ tu katve tadapavādaḥ ṣakāro vidhīyate| `vraṣṭā' iti| `skoḥ saṃyogādyoḥ' (8.2.29) iti sakāralopaḥ, ūdittvāt‌ pakṣa iḍabhāvaḥ| `mīlabṛṭ‌, dhānābhṛṭ‌ iti| `grahijyā' (6.1.16) iti sūtreṇa samprasāraṇam‌| `sraṣṭā' iti| `sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti' (6.1.58) ityamāgamaḥ| `mārṣṭā' [mārṣṭīti kā. mudritapāṭha] iti| `mṛjervṛddhiḥ' (7.2.114)| `upayaṭ‌' ti| yadeḥ `vijupe chandasi' (3.2.73) iti vic‌| `samrāṭ‌' iti| `mo rāji samaḥ kvau' (8.3.25) iti samo makārasya makārādeśaḥ| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ rājabhrājorjhalyudāharaṇaṃ na pradarśitam‌? ityāha--`rājabhrājoḥ' ityādi| jhalatvaṃ kasmānna bhavatītyāha--`jhalādirābhyām‌' ityādi| ābhyāṃ paro yo jhalādiḥ sa iṭā paryavapadyata itīṅ‌vidhīyate; seṭtvādanayoḥ| itareṣvādyacaturthe| vibhāṣiteṭau, svaratītyādisūtrema (7.2.44) śeṣāstvāniṭaḥ; `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) itīṭṛpratiṣedhāt‌| tasmāt‌ teṣāmubhayārthameva grahaṇam‌| `rāṣṭiḥ bhrāṣṭiḥ' iti| `kvitannābādibhyaśca' (vā.307) iti ktinpratyayaḥ, `titutra' (7.2.9) ityādineṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `śabdaprāṭ‌' iti| śabdaṃ pṛcchatīti `kvivvaci' (vā.288) ityādinā kvip‌, dīrghaśca| atha kimarthaṃ chagrahaṇam‌, yāvatā `cchvoḥ śūḍanūmāsike ca' (6.4.19) iti cchakārasya śakāre kṛte śakārāntatvādeva pṛṣṭa ityādau ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`cchadoḥ śūṭ‌' ityādi| `atra' ityādi| itikaraṇau hetau| tatra hi `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) ityanuvarttate, tena cchagrahaṇaṃ kriyate; anyathā pṛṣṭaḥ, pṛṣṭavānityādyeva sidhyat‌; na tu praṣṭā, praṣṭumityādi; tṛjādāvakṅiti śatvābhāvāt‌| etacca sūtrakāramatenottam‌| kecidācāryāḥ chagrahaṇamiha sūtre pratyācakṣata eva| tathā hi--`cchravo śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) ityatroktam‌--"kecidiha kṅitītyetannānuvarattayanti| kathaṃ dyubhyām‌, dyubhirityūṭhi kṛte? `diva ut‌' (6.1.131) iti taparakaraṇānmātrākālo bhaviṣyatīti| `chaśāṃ ṣaḥ' (8.2.36) ityatra cchagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyam‌, anenaiva hi sarvatra śakāro vidhīyate" iti| `leṣṭā' iti| `liśa alpībhāve' (dhā.pā.1179) `veṣṭā' iti| `viśa praveśane' (dhā.pā.1424)|| 37. ekāco baśo bhaṣ‌ jhaṣantasya sdhvoḥ| (8.2.37) `dhātoḥ' (8.2.32) iti yadīhānuvarttate tadavayavaṣaṣṭhyantamekāco viśeṣaṇam‌| `jhaṣantasya' ityetadapi samānādhikaraṇaṃ tasyaiva viśeṣaṇam‌| `ekācaḥ' ityetadavayavaṣaṣṭhyantaṃ baśaḥ| `tadavayavasya' iti| tasyāvayavastadavayavaḥ| yo'sau dhātoravayava ekāj‌ jhaṣantastasya, tadityanenābhisambadhyate| `jhali parataḥ' ityanena jhalītyanuvarttate (8.2.26), tasya sakāro viśeṣaṇamiti darśayati| kimarthaṃ panarjhalītyanuvarttate? padāntasyetyanuvṛttiryathā syāt‌; anyathā jhalītyasmin‌ nivarttamāne tatsambaddhaṃ padāntagrahaṇamapi nivarttata, tataśca padānte na sidhyet‌| nanu ca svaritatvāt‌ padāntasyesyānuvṛttirbhaviṣyati? tarhyanenāpi prakāreṇākhyāyate mandadhiyāṃ sukhapratipattye| `dhvaśabde ca' iti| atra jhalītyetannāpekṣate, asambhavāt‌| na hi kaścit‌ jhal‌ dhvaśabdo'sti; tasya pratyāhāreṣvasanniveśāt‌| `bhotsyate' [`bhotsyante'--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `budha avagamane' (dhā.pā.858), lṛṭ‌, syaḥ, `khari ca' (8.4.55) iti carttvam‌--takāraḥ, anudāttettvādātmanepadam‌| atra budherdhātorvyapadeśivadbhāvena svarūpamevaikājavayavo jhaṣantaḥ, tadavayavo bakāro baśa, asyāntaratamyādoṣṭhyasya sthāna oṣṭhya eva bhakāro bhaviṣyati| evamanyatrāpi vijñeyam‌| `abhudhvam‌' [`abuddha' iti prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] `ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si' (8.2.41) iti katvam‌, `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti ṣatvam‌| `nyaghūḍhvam‌' iti| `ḍhralope pūrvasya dorgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111)| `dhokṣyate' iti| duho lṛṭ‌, `dāderdhātordhaḥ' (8.2.32), tasya `khali ca' (8.4.55) iti cartvam‌--kakāraḥ| `ajarghāḥ' iti| `gudhu abhikāṅkṣāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1246), yaṅ‌, dvirvacanam‌, halādiśeṣaḥ, `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityatvam‌, `kuhoścuḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam‌, `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) yaṅluk‌, `rugrikau ca luki' (7.4.91) iti ruk‌| jagṛdha iti sthite iṅādayo vidheyāḥ| atra mukhya eva gṛdha ityayaṃ dhātorjhaṣanto'vayavaḥ| `gardabhayateḥ' iti| gardabhaśabdāt‌ tadācaṣṭa iti ṇic‌, `ṇāviṣṭhavat‌ prātipadikasya' (vā.813) iti ṭilopaḥ| atra garvabhītyayaṃ mukhya eva dhātorjhaṣanto'vayavaḥ| `apratyayaḥ' iti| aśrāvipratyayaḥ kvibādirapratyaya ityucyate| `dāmaliṭ‌' iti| atra `hoḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatve kṛte jhaṣantatāyāmupajātāyāmekājgrahaṇādbhaṣbhāṣo na bhavati| nanu cātra dvāvekājavayavau--dakārādirmakārāntaḥ, lakārādirjhaṣantaśca; tayoścāsatyapyekājgrahaṇe naiva bhaṣbhāvaḥ prasajyate| tathā hi-yo jhaṣantastasya vaś‌ na vidyate, yastu dakārādirmakārāntastasya vaś‌ vidyate, jhaṣantatā tu nāsti, tadanarthamekājgrahaṇam‌? ityata āha--`asatyekājagrahaṇe' ityādi| vaśo viśeṣaṇaṃ vyavacchedārtham‌| vyavacchedo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tattatho ktam‌| yadyekājgrahaṇaṃ na syāt‌, tato'nyasyehāśrutatvāt‌, baśastu śrutatvācca sa eva dhātorityanena viśeṣyate na dhātoravayavo vaśiti| evaṃ ca baśo jhaṣantatā na sambhavatīti jhaṣantasyetyanena dhātureva viśeṣyate; anyasyehāsambhavāt‌| tathā cāyaṃ sūtrārthaḥ syāt‌--jhaṣantasya dhātoryo'vayavo baśa tasya jhali sakāre ṣve ca parataḥ padānte ca bhav‌ bhavatīti| asmiṃśca sūtrārthaṃ dāmaliḍityatrāpi prasajyeta| bhavati dakāro'tra baś‌ jhaṣantasya dhātoravayavaḥ| ekāca ityetasmin‌ sati dhātorjhaṣantasyetyetadubhayāntasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, tadapi baśaḥ| tena vṛttikāropadarśita eva sūtrārtho jāyate; tataśca na kiñcidaniṣṭamāpadyate| dāmaliḍityatra hi yo jhaṣanta ekājavayavo lakārādinaṃ tasya baś‌ vidyate, yasya tu vidyate dakārādirmāntasya sa jhaṣanto na bhavati| `krotsyati' iti| `krudha kope' (dhāpā.1189)| `dādadvi' iti| `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) ityabhyāsasya dīrghatvam‌| antagrahaṇamasandehārtham‌| asati hi tasmin‌ sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimatra baśaḥ sthānitvam‌? atha jhaṣaḥ? iti|| 38. dadhastathośca| (8.2.38) dadhāterapyetat‌ kṛtadvirvacanasya rūpamasti| `dadha dhāraṇe' (dhā.pā.8)--ityasya cākṛtadvirvacanasya rūpam‌, tatra tu śapā vyavahitatvādanantarau tatho na sambhavataḥ; tasmāddadhātereva grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha--`dadha iti kṛtadvirvacano dadhātiḥ parigṛhyate' iti| `dhattaḥ, iti| laṭastasthasau, śapaḥ [śapaḥ ślulupi dvirvacanam‌--prā.mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] śluḥ `ślau' (6.1.10) (iti) dvirvacanam‌, `abhyāse carca' (8.4.54) iti jaśtvam‌--dakāraḥ, `śnābhyastayorātaḥ' (6.4.112) ityākāralopaḥ, abhyāsadakārasya bhaṣ‌ dhakāraḥ| dhātudhakārasya cartvam‌--takāraḥ| `dhatse' iti| `thāsaḥ se' (3.4.80) `dhadhve' iti| ṭerettvam‌| `dhadhvam‌' iti| loṭi `savābhyāṃ vāmau' (3.4.91) ityamādeśaḥ| kathaṃ punaratra bhaṣbhāvaḥ; yāvatā dadhāterjhaṣantasya yo daś‌ tasya bhaṣ‌ bhavatītyucyate, atra nāpi jhaṣantatāsti; ākāralopasya `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) iti sthānivadbhāvāt‌; nāpi baś‌, abhyāsajaśatvasyāsiddhatvāt‌? ityata āha--`vacanasāmarthyāt‌' ityādi| `abhyāsajaśtvasyāsiddhatvam‌' iti vacanasāmarthyānna bhavatītya pekṣate| yadyākāralopasya sthānivadbhāvaḥ syādabhyāsajaśtvasyāsiddhatvam‌| evaṃ satyapārthakataivāsya vacanasya syāt‌, na hi dadhāterākāralopena vinā baś‌ syāt‌| tasmādvacanaprāmāṇyādubhayaṃ na bhavati| iha jhalotyanuvarttate, jhaṣantasyeti ca, takārathakārābhyāmanyaḥ sa jhalasti yatra dadhāterjhaṣantasya bhaṣbhāvo neṣyate| tasmāt‌ `tathoḥ' iti vacanamantareṇāpisiddhamiṣṭamityabhiprāyeṇāha--`tathoriti kim‌' iti| `ānantaryāt‌' ityādi| anantarasūtre hi `sdhvoḥ' (8.2.37) ityuktam‌, tataśca `anantaralasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedho vā' (vyā.pa.19) iti sdhvoreva bhaṣbhāvo vijñāyate, na tathoḥ; ataḥ `tathoḥ' ityucyate| yadyevam‌, nimittāntaropā dāne pūrvasya nimittasya nivṛttyā bhavitavyam‌, tataśca tathoreva syāt‌, na sdhvoḥ? ityata āha--`cakāraḥ' ityādi| parihāraḥ|| 39. jhalāṃ jaśo'nte| (8.2.39) `śvaliṭ‌' iti| ḍhatve kṛte jaśtvam‌| athāntagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, nanu `skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) ityato'ntagrahaṇamanuvarttata eva? ityata āha--`antagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| taddhyantagrahaṇaṃ jhalītyanena sambaddham‌, atastadanuvṛttau jhalītyetadapyanuvarttata, tasmādetannivṛttyarthamanyadevāntagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| tena ca vasateḥ--vastā, vastumityatra na bhavati|| 40. jhaṣastathordho'dhaḥ| (8.2.40) `athaḥ' iti| anena dhātupratiṣedho'yaṃ na dhakārapratiṣedha iti darśayati| yadi hi dhakārapratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌, dhakārāt‌ parayostathordhakāro na bhavatīti| tataḥ `matibuddhipūnārthebhyaśca' (3.2.188), `vṛddhiryasyācāmādistad‌vṛddham‌' (1.1.73) ityevamādayo nirdeśā nopapadyeran‌| `alabdha, alabdhāḥ' iti| luṅ‌, tasya tathāsau, `jhalo jhali' (8.2.26) iti sakāralopaḥ| `alīḍha, alīḍhāḥ' iti| ḍhatvaṣṭutvaḍhalopadīrghatvāni karttavyāni|| 41. ṣaḍhoḥ kaḥ si| (8.2.41) `pekṣyati' iti| `piṣlṛ sañcūrṇane' (dhā.pā.1452), lṛṭ‌| `apekṣyat‌' iti| lṛṅ‌| `pipikṣati' iti| san‌, `halantācca' (1.2.10) iti kittvādguṇābhāvaḥ| `pinaṣṭi' iti| rūdhāditvāt‌ śnam‌| `leḍhi' iti| adāditvācchaparo luk‌|| 42. radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ| (8.2.42) `āstīrṇam‌' iti| `stṝñ‌ ācchādane' (dhā.pā.1484)| `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam‌, `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghaḥ| `viśīrṇam‌' iti| `śṝhiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1488)| `nigīrṇam‌' iti| `gṝ nigaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1410)| eṣu `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) itīṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ, `avagūrṇam‌' iti| `gurī udyamane' (dhā.pā.1396)| `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām‌' (7.2.14) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| atha yathā `kṛpo ro laḥ' (8.2.18) ityatra `ra' iti varṇatvāvarṇatvakṛtaṃ bhedamutsṛjya sāmānyasyopādānam‌, tathehāpi, asti ca ṛkāre rephaḥ; tataśca kṛtaḥ kṛtavānityatra bhavitavyameva natveneti yo manyate, taṃ pratyāha--`ra ityatra' ityādi| yadyatra `ra' iti sāmānyamupādīyeta tasmādevaḥ prasaṅgaḥ, na tu raśrutisāmānyamupādīyate, kiṃ tarhi? vyañjanamardhamātrātmakam‌| na ca samānākāro'stīti kuto natvaprasaṅgaḥ? bhavatu nāma sāmānyasyopādānam‌, tathāpi naivātra natvaṃ prasajyata iti darśayitumāha--`sāmānyanirdeśe'pi' ityādi| ṛkāro'tra ye bhāgāstanmadhyavartī repho mātrācaturbhāgātmakaḥ, tatra yo'sau rephātparastṛtīyo bhāgastena vyavadhānānna bhavati| `caritam, muditam' iti| `cara gatyarthaḥ' (dhā.pā.559),`muda harṣe' (dhā.pā.16)| asati hi `ta' iti grahaṇe `radābhyām‌' ityanena niṣṭhā viśeṣyate--radābhyāṃ parā yā niṣṭheti, tataścaritamityādau `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54) iti iṭa eva natvaṃ syāt‌; tasya niṣṭhābhaktatvāt‌| atha `ta' ityucyamāne caritamityādau takārasya kasmānna bhavati? iṭā vyavahitatvāt‌| sa hi pratyayabhaktatvāt‌ pratyayameva na vyavadadhyāt| tadavayavatvaṃ tu vyavadadhyādeva| `parasya mā bhūt‌' iti| asati hi pūrvagrahaṇe yadi hi sannihitayā niṣṭhayā dakāro viśeṣyeta--niṣṭhāyā yo dakāra iti, tato jaśatve kṛte parasyaiva syāt‌--bhinnavadbhyām‌, bhinnavadbhirityādau| atha na viśeṣyeta, tato viśeṣānupādānādyathāpūrvasya bhavati, tathā parasyāpi| tasmāt‌ parasya mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ pūrvagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌| atha kṛtasyāpatyam‌, `ata iñ‌' (4.1.95) kārttirityatra kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`iha' ityādi| vṛddhirhi taddhitaṃ nimittamāśritya bhavatīti bahiraṅgā, natvaṃ tu na kiñcidbāhyaṃ nimittamāśritya bhaviṣyatītyatastadantaraṅgam‌| tasmād‌vṛddherbahiraṅgatvānnatve karttavye rephasyāsiddhatvam‌| nanu ca yadi tarhi bahiraṅgalakṣaṇā sā, tasyā evāsiddhatvena bhavituṃ yuktam‌, na tu rephasyāpi, na hi repho vṛddhirbhavati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; vṛddhyāśrito hi rephaḥ, tato vṛddherbahiraṅgatvādrephasyāpi bahiraṅgatvena bhāvyam‌|| 43. saṃyogāderāto dhātoryaṇvataḥ| (8.2.43) `pradrāṇaḥ' iti| `drā kutsāyāṃ gatau' (dhā.pā.1054)| `kṛtyacaḥ' (8.4.29) iti ṇatvam‌| `mlānaḥ' iti| `mlai gātravināme' [`mlai harṣakṣaye'--iti dhātupāṭhaḥ] (dhā.pā.904)| `cyutaḥ, plutaḥ' iti| `cyuṅ‌ pluṅ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.955,958)| `niryātaḥ' iti| `yā prāpaṇe' (dhā.pā.1049)| `nirvātaḥ' iti| `vā gatigandhanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1050)| atra ryā, rvā-ityetayordhātutvaṃ na bhavati| `ryā' ityayaṃ hi samudāyaḥ saṃyogādiḥ, na cāyaṃ dhātuḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `yā' ityayam‌| evaṃ `rvā' ityayaṃ saṃyogādiḥ, na caiṣa dhātuḥ, kiṃ tarhi? `vā' ityayam‌| nanu ca bahiraṅgamatra saṃyogāditvam‌, dvipadāśrayatvāt‌, natvaṃ tu viparyayādantaraṅgam‌; `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) ityasiddhatvādeva saṃyogāditvasya natvaṃ na bhavatīti kiṃ dhātugrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhi etajjñāpayati--upasargasambandhena yo dharma upajāyate dhātūpasargasamudāyasya sa dhātorataddharmavato'pi kāryāṇi prāpayatīti| tenopāstate guruḥ, abhibhūyate śatruriti karmaṇi lakāraḥ siddho bhavati| atra hyu pasargasambandhena sakarmakatvadharmo jātaḥ| sa ca dhātūpasargasamudāyasya, na dhātumātrasya| tatra yadyayamartho na jñāpyeta, karmaṇi lakāro na syāt‌; dhātorakarmakatvāt‌| asmiṃścārthe jñāpite tu bhavati| `snātaḥ' iti| `ṣṇā śauce' (dhā.pā.1052)|| 44. lvādibhyaḥ| (8.2.44) `jīnaḥ' iti| `jyā vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1499), `grahijyā' (6.1.16) ityādisūtreṇa samprasāraṇam‌, `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghaḥ| `ṛkāralpādibhyaḥ' ityādi| ṛkārāntebhyo lvādibhyaśca paro yaḥ ktin‌ sa niṣṭhā bhavatītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ nu `oditaśca' (8.2.45) ityatra cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvāt‌| yathā ṛkāralpādibhyo niṣṭhātakārasya natvaṃ bhavati, tathā ktino'pi takārasya natvaṃ bhavatīti| `dugvoḥ' iti| `du upatāpe' [`ṭu ṭu upatāpe'--dhātupāṭhaḥ, padamañjaryāṃ tu-`du gatau(944)ityayaṃ dhāturupāttaḥ, na `ṭu ṭu upatāpe' iti] (dhā.pā.1256)| `gu purīṣotsarge' (dhā.pā.1399)| `pūnāḥ' iti vinaṣṭā ityarthaḥ| `pūtaṃ dhānyam‌' iti| vidhūtamityarthaḥ| `sinoteḥ' iti| `viñ‌ bandhane' (dhā.pā.1248) ityetasya| `grāsakarmakarttṛkasya' iti| grāsaḥ karmakartā yasya sa tathoktaḥ| arthadvārakañcedam‌| tasya grāsakarmakarttṛkatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ veditavyam‌| yathā sino grāso bandhanakriyāyāṃ vyañjanaviśeṣayogādānukūlyaṃ pratipadyate, tathā karmaṇo'pi satastasya karttṛtvaṃ vivakṣitamiti karmakarttāsau bhavati| `sino grāsaḥ' ti| svayameva baddha ityarthaḥ| `sitā pāśena sūkarī' iti| samudāyapratyudāharaṇametat‌| avayavapratyudāharaṇaṃ darśayitumāha--`grāso'pi' ityādi| grāso'pi yadi karmaiva bhavati na karmakartā, tadāpi na bhavati; grāsakarmakarttṛkatvamasya tadābhāvāt‌| grāsakarmato hi sa tadānīṃ bhavati grāsakarmakarttṛkaḥ|| 45. oditaśca| (8.2.45) `āpīnaḥ' iti| `pyāyaḥ pī' (6.1.28) iti pībhāvaḥ| `svādaya oditaḥ' iti| te punaḥ `ṣūṅa prāṇiprasave' (dhā.pā.1132) ityādayaḥ `vrīṅ‌ prīṇātyarthe' [vṛṇotyarthe-dhātupāṭhaḥ] (dhā.pā.1140) ityevamantā divādiṣu paṭhyante|| 46. kṣīyo dīrghāt‌| (8.2.46) `kṣiyaḥ' iti| `kṣi kṣaye' (dhā.pā.236), `kṣi nivāsagatyoḥ' (dhā.pā.1407) iti dvayorapi grahaṇam‌; viśeṣānupādānāt‌| `kṣīṇaāḥ kleśāḥ' iti| `kto'dhikaraṇe' ca' (3.4.76) ityādinā'karmakatvāt‌ karttari niṣṭhā, `niṣṭhāyāmaṇyadarthe' (6.4.60) iti dīrghaḥ| `kṣīṇo jālmaḥ, kṣīṇastapasvī' ityādi| `vā''krośadaibhyayoḥ' (6.4.61) iti| nanu ca `kṣiyaḥ' iti nirdeśādeva dīrghasya grahaṇaṃ vijñāyate, tat‌ kiṃ dīrghagrahaṇena? yadi hrasvasyevaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, evaṃ sati paratvāt‌ `gherṅiti' (8.3.111) iti guṇe kṛte kṣeriti nirdeśaḥ syāt‌? ityata āha--`hrasvasyāpi hi' ityādi| yadi niyogato dīrghasyaiva dhātvanukaraṇasyeyaṅā nirdeśaḥ syāt‌, tato'smānnirdeśāddīrghasyedaṃ grahaṇamiti vijñāyate| na ca dīrghasyaiveyaṅā nirveśo bhavati| tathā hi hrasvāntasyāsau dṛṣṭaḥ kṣiyaḥ| `niṣṭhāyāmaṇyadarthe' (6.4.60) ityatrāvasitaṃ hrasvāntasthedamanukarṇam‌, na dīrghāntasyeti? ucyate; yathābhūtasyaivānukartuyuktam‌| hrasvāntasya ca dīrghatvaṃ vidheyam‌| atastasyaivānukaraṇamidamiti vijñāyate| yadi tarhi hrasvāntasyāpi dhātvanukaraṇasyeyaṅā nirdeśo bhavati, `viparābhyāṃ jeḥ' (1.3.19), `vibhāṣā ceḥ' (7.3.58) ityevamādāvapi kasmānna bhavati? iha `viparābhyāṃ jerityevamādau' ityādi| atrāsaṅkalpamityatadadhyāhāryam‌| dhātvanukaraṇasya hi `prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' (vyā.pa.113) itīyaṅā nirdeśo bhavati| dhātvanukaraṇaṃ ca kiṃ bhavitumarhati yena dhātāvanukāryeva sthitam‌? dhātutvaṃ kriyāvācitvalakṣaṇaṃ vivakṣyate| `viparābhyāṃ jeḥ' (1.3.19) ityevamādau tvanukāryagataṃ dhātutvaṃ sadapyavavakṣitatvādasaṅkalpam‌| tasmānnātra dhātvanukaraṇam‌| api tu ṅīprabhṛteḥ kriyāvācinaśca tatsādṛśyaśabdāntarasya ṅītyevamāderyadrūpasāmānyamarthaśūnyaṃ tadanukaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam‌| tasmādadhātvanukaraṇatvānna bhavatīyaṅādeśa ityabhiprāyaḥ| yadi tarhi dhātvanukaraṇa syāt‌, prakṛtivadanukaraṇa bhavatīti, evaṃ satyadhāto (1.2.45) iti prātipadikasaṃjñāpratiṣedho'pi syāt‌, tataśca vibhaktirnopapadyate? vatkaraṇenānukāryeṇārtheṇārthanārthavattvasyāśrayāt‌ prātipadikasaṃjñā bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ|| 47. śyo'sparśe| (8.2.47) `śīnam‌' iti| `śyaiṅ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.963), `dravamūrttisparśayoḥ śyaḥ'(6.1.24) iti samprasāraṇam‌, `halaḥ' (6.4.2) iti dīrghaḥ| `śotaṃ varttate' iti| bhāve niṣṭhā| pūrvatra tu karttari| evaṃ `śīto vādhuḥ' ityādau| `śītamudakamityatra' ityādi| `guṇabhūto'pi' iti| apradhānabhūto'pītyarthaḥ| nanu ca pradhāne kāryasampratyayādapradhānasya natvapratiṣedhādikāryaṃ prati nimittabhāvo nopapadyate? naiṣa doṣaḥ; `asparśe' iti hi yadyayaṃ paryudāsaḥ syāt‌, evaṃ sati śīto vāyurityādau sparśādanyaddravyamastīti natvaṃ syāt‌; na tvayaṃ paryudāsaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ| tena yatra lparśanagandho'sti tatra tadāśrayeṇa natvapratiṣedhena bhavitavyam‌| asti ceha guṇabhūtaḥ sparśaḥ, tena tadāśrayo natvapratiṣedho bhavatyeva| bhavatvevaṃ natvapratiṣedhaḥ, samprasāraṇasya tu guṇabhūtaḥ sparśaḥ kathaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavati? niyamasya tyāgāt‌| iha `alpāctaram‌' (2.2.34) iti niyamaḥ--alpāctaraṃ dvandve pūrvameva prayoktavyamiti; `dravamūrtisparśayoḥ śyaḥ' (6.1.24) ityatra sparśaśabdasyālpāctarasya paranipātaṃ kurvatā'sya niyamasya tvāgaḥ kṛtaḥ| sa kimarthaṃ kṛtaḥ? sparśo'trāniyamena pradhānabhūta upasarjanabhūto vā samprasāraṇasya kāraṇamityasyārthasya sūcanārthaḥ| tena guṇabhūto'pi sparśaḥ samprasāraṇasya nimittaṃ bhavati| sparśaśabdo'yamasti guṇavacanaḥ, asti ca rogavacanaḥ; tadiha viśeṣānupādānādubhayorapi grahaṇam‌| tato roge'pi prāpnotīti pratiśīna ityetanna sidhyediti codyamāśahkyāha--`guṇe ca' ityādi| guṇa evetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarguṇa eva pratiṣedho labhyate? jñāpakāt‌| yadayaṃ `dravamūrttisparśavoḥ śya-' (6.1.24) ityatra samprasāraṇaṃ vidhāya punaḥ `prateśca' (6.1.25) iti vidhatte, tajjñāpayati--śyāyateryatra grahaṇaṃ tatra sparśa upādīyamāno rogaṃ na pratyāyayatīti| yadi hi pratyāyayet‌, punarvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌; pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌| pratipūrvo hi roga eva śyāyatirvattete, nānyatra|| 48. añco'napādāne| (8.2.48) `na cedapādānaṃ tatra bhavati' iti| tatretyanenāñcatiḥ parāmṛśyate| śabdadvāreṇāñcatyarthaṃ evāyamapādānasya pratiṣedhasāmarthyādvijñāyate| na hyañcatāvapādānatvaṃ sambhavati, kiṃ tarhi? tadarthe kriyāviṣayatvāt‌ kārakāṇām‌| tadetaduktaṃ bhavati--na cedañcatyarthe viṣayabhūte'pādānaṃ na bhavatīti| `samaknau' iti| saṅgatāvityarthaḥ| `ancu gatipūjanayoḥ' [`ancū' iti kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ](dhā.pā.188) ityudittvādvibhāṣiteṭ‌| [ityūdittvāt‌--kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] tena `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) iti niṣṭhāyāmiṭ‌pratiṣedhaḥ, `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) ityanunāsikalopaḥ| `udaktamudakam‌' iti| uddhṛtamudakamityarthaḥ| atha vyaktamityatra natavaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`vyaktamityetat‌' ityādi| `añjū vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu' [`ancū' iti| kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] (dhā.pā.1458) ityetasyaitadrūpam‌,[ityetadrūpam‌--kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] nāñcateḥ; tato natvamiha na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|| 49. divo'vijigīṣāyām‌| (8.2.49) `ādyūnaḥ, paridyūnaḥ' iti| avijigīṣurityarthaḥ| `cchavoḥ śūḍanunāsike ca' (6.4.19) iti ūṭh‌| `dyūtaṃ varttate' iti| vijigīṣārtho'tra vivakṣita iti natvaṃ na pravarttate| kathaṃ punariha vijigīṣārthaḥ, yāvatā akṣapātanalakṣaṇakroḍā na pratīyate? ityāha--vijigīṣāyāṃ hi'[ityetadrūpam‌--kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| vijetumicchā vijigīṣā, tasyām‌| tatra kroḍāyāmakṣapātanādi kriyate| tasmādvijigīṣārthe'vatiṣṭhata iti bhāvaḥ| ādiśabdena śalākāpātādergrahaṇam‌|| 50. nirvāṇo'vāte| (8.2.50) `dāteruttarasya' iti| `vā gatigandhanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1050) ityetasmāt‌| `na ca' ityādi| dhātamacikaraṇamādhāro yasya sa tathoktaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati--dhāterdhātoryo'rthaḥ sa yadi dhātena samaveto bhavatītyarthaḥ| `nirvāṇo'gniḥ, nirvāṇaḥ pradīpaḥ' iti| atra svarūpasya yaḥ praśama uparatilakṣaṇaḥ sa dhātvarthaḥ| `eṣa nirvāṇo bhikṣuḥ' iti| atrāpi| atha vā--rāgādiprahāṇaṃ dhātvarthaḥ| `nirvāto vātaḥ' iti| akarmakatvāt‌ karttari niṣṭhā| `nirvātaṃ vātena' iti| atra bhāve| ubhayatrāpyatra gatinirodho dhātvartha-| `nirvāṇaḥ pradīpī vātena' iti| atra vāteneti kartri tṛtīyā| tasmādvāta eva dātyarthasyādhāraḥ, tataśca natvena bhavitavyamiti kasyacidvyāmohaḥ syāt‌, atastānnirākaraṇāyāha--`niryāṇaḥ pradīpaḥ' ityādi| atra nirvāṇaṃdhātvarthaḥ, tacca pradapādhāram‌, na vātādhāram‌| vātādhāre hi tasminnirvāṇa iti yadi karttari niṣṭhā, tadā tayaivābhihitatvāt‌ kartturvātāt‌ tṛtīyā na syāt‌| atha `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' (3.3.114) iti bhāve? evaṃ sasi nirvāṇa iti puṃlliṅgaṃ na syāt‌| tasmāt‌ pradīpa eva karttā dhātvardhasyādhāraḥ| yadyevam‌, kathaṃ vātenetyatra tṛtīyā? ityata āha--`vātastu' ityādi| etenaiṣā tṛtīyā na karttarīti darśayati|| 51. śuṣaḥ kaḥ| (8.2.51) `śuṣa śoṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.1183) ityasmāt‌ parasya niṣṭhātakārasya ṣṭutve prāpte kakāro vidhīyate| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `śuṣkaḥ, śuṣkavān‌' iti| yuktaṃ śuṣvānityetadudāharaṇam‌, śuṣka ityetattvayuktam‌; na hyetadarthe'sya sūtrasyārambho yujyate, `śuṣkadhṛṣṭau' (6.1.206) iti nipātanenaiva siddhatvāt‌? naitadasti; nipātanena hi kakāre sati śuṣkiketyatra `udīcāmātaḥ sthāne yakapūrvāyāḥ' (7.3.46) iti vibhāṣetvaṃ syāt‌, śuṣkajaṅghetyatra ca `na kopadhāyāḥ' (6.3.37) iti puṃvadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ syāt‌; iha tu kakārasya vidhāne sati tasyāsiddhatvādetadubhayaṃ na bhavati| tasmācchuṣka ityetadartho'pyasyārambho yuktaḥ|| 52. paco vaḥ| (8.2.52) `pakvaḥ, pakvavān‌' iti| `ḍupaṭacaṣ‌ pāke' (dhā.pā.996)| yadyevam‌, pakva ityatat‌ `siddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiśca' (2.1.41) iti nipātanādapi hi sidhyati; tathāpi pakvavānityetadarthamidamavaśyamārabdhavyam‌| anyārthaṃ cārabhyamāṇaṃ pakva ityetadartharūpamapi bhavatīti pasvaśabdo'syodāharaṇamupanyastam‌| nipātanadvāreṇa hi tadvyutpattau pratipattigauravaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ|| 53. kṣāyo maḥ| (8.2.53) `kṣai jai vai kṣaye' (dhā.pā.913-915)|| 54. prastyo'nyatarasyām‌| [`prastonyatarasyām‌'--iti prācīnyāsamudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] `prastīmaḥ' iti| `ṣṭyai styai saṅghātaśabdayoḥ' (dhā.pā.911,910)| `styaḥ prapūrvasya' (6.1.23) iti samprasāraṇam‌; pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| iha yadā matvaṃ na bhavati| tadā `saṃyogādeḥ' (8.2.43) ityanena natvena bhavitavyam‌; tataśca prastīnaḥ, prastīnavānitīṣṭaṃ syāt‌--iti kasyacidbhrāntiḥ syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`yadā matvaṃ nāsti' ityādi| kṛte tarhi prathamaṃ samprasāraṇe natvaṃ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`tatra kṛte' ityādi|| 55. anupasargātphullakṣībakṛśollāghāḥ| (8.2.55) `phullaḥ' iti| `ñiphalā viśaraṇe' (dhā.pā.516), `āditaśca' (7.2.16) itīṭ‌pratiṣedhathaḥ, `utparasyātaḥ' (7.4.88) ityuttvam‌| `ktavatvantasyāpyetallatvamiṣyate' iti| kathaṃ punariṣyayāṇamapi labhyate, na hi ktavatvantaḥ śabdaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ? ucyate; iha niṣṭhāyāstakārāntaṃ yacchabdarūpaṃ tasya `phulla' ityetannipātyate, ktavatośca [`ktaktavatośca' iti kāśīmudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] tat‌ tulyam‌| parastu yadi ktavato'rtho vā viśeṣyate? viśeṣyatām, na hi tena samānenāsamānena vā parayojanamasti| tasmāt‌ ktavatvantasyāpyetallatvaṃ bhavati| evamanayaiva yuktyā kṣībakṛśollāghādiṣvapi yannipātyate, tadapi ktavatvantasya prasajyate?[`prasajyeta'--iti kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] naiṣa doṣaḥ; vakṣyamāṇamanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca na jñāyate, tenātiprasaṅgo na bhaviṣyatīti| `kṣīvikṛśibhyām‌' iti| `kṣībṛ made' (dhā.pā.382), `kṛśa tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.382), `kṛśa tanūkaraṇe' (dhā.pā.1227)| `iḍabhāvaśca nipātyate' iti| ktalopasyāsiddhatvādvalādirārdhadhātuko bhavatītīṭ‌ prāpnoti; atastadabhāvaśca nipātyate| `kṛte vā iṭi icchabdalopaḥ' iti| nipātyata iti sambandhaḥ| iḍabhāvāpekṣo vikalpaḥ| atha vā--neḍabhāvo nipātyate| kiṃ tarhi? kṛta iṭīcchabdalopaḥ| `lāgherudo'nya upasargaḥ pratiṣidhyate' iti| utpūrvasya grahaṇasāmarthāyat‌| anyathā hyutpūrvasyopādānamanarthakaṃ syādityabhiprāyaḥ| anupasargādityucyate, tatra parikṛśa iti na sidhyati? ityata āha--`parikṛśa ityatra' ityādi| tanūkaraṇalakṣaṇakriyāyā anyakriyā gamanalakṣaṇā kriyāntaram‌, tena yogo'yam‌, na pariśabdaḥ, atara kṛśiṃ pratyupasargasaṃjñā bhavatīti kṛtvā| `parigataḥ kṛśaḥ' iti| anena taṃ kriyāntarayogaṃ darśayati| atha kimarthaṃ nipātanam‌; yāvatā phulla iti `phulla vikasane' (dhā.pā.532) ityasmāt‌ pacādyaci sidhyati, kṣīberigupadhalakṣaṇe ke--kṣauva iti, kṛśa ityapi kṛśeracaiva, ullarāgha iti--lāgha ityeva pacādyaci siddhyatyeva? satyamevaitat‌; niṣṭhāyāṃ tu phalatiprabhṛtīnāmasatyasminnaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ prāpnoti| atastannivṛttyarthamārabdhadhyametat‌|| 56. nudavidondatrāghrahvībhyo'nyatarasyām‌| (8.2.56) `samunnaḥ, samuttaḥ' iti| `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) iti nalopaḥ| `hrītyasya' [`hrī' ityatasya--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] iti| `hrī lajjāyām‌' (dhā.pā.108530 ityasya| `aprāptraḥ' iti| kenacidavidhānāt‌| `itareṣām‌' iti| tatra `nuda preraṇe' [`ṇuda preraṇe'--dhātupāṭhaḥ] (dhā.pā.1426), `undī kledane' (dhā.pā.1457)--tayoḥ `radābhyām‌' (8.2.42) iti nityaṃ prāpsam‌| `traiṅ‌ pālane' (dhā.pā.965), `ghrā gandhopādāne' (dhā.pā.926)--etayoḥ `saṃyogādeḥ' (8.2.43) ityādinā| `vida vicāraṇe' ityasya videriha grahaṇamidhyate' iti| kathaṃ punarasya grahaṇamiṣyate, śluvikaraṇena hrītyanena [`hrīṇā'--prā.mu pāṭhaḥ] sāhacāryāt‌? naitadasti; śavikaraṇena nudinā sāhacaryāllābhārthasya vidergrahaṇaprasaṅgāt‌? evaṃ tarhyanyatarasyāmityeṣā vyavasthitavibāṣā, tena vicāraṇārthasyaiva bhavitavyam‌, nānyasya; yasyaivaṃ bhavitavyaṃ tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ yuktamiti sa eva gṛhyate| kathaṃ punarjñāyate--vicāraṇārthasya videryahaṇamiṣyate? ityāha--`evaṃ hi' ityādi| iṣyata iti vakṣyamāṇaṃ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| `niṣṭhā' ityanena niṣṭhāntamupalakṣayatiḥ `vetteḥ' ityādi| `vida jñāne' (dhā.pā.1064) ityasya `viditaḥ' ityetadrūpamiṣyate; nityeṭtvāt‌, tasyeṭā niṣṭhātakārasya vyavadhāne sati natvasyāsambhavāt‌| `vidyateḥ' iti| `vida sattāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1171) ityasya śyanvikaratasya [nāsti--kā.mupāṭhe] niṣṭhāntasya `vinnaḥ' ityetadrūpamidhyate; `ekācaḥ' (7.2.10) itīṭpratiṣedhāt‌; `radābhyām‌' (8.2.42) ityādinā ca nityaṃ natvavidhānāt‌| `vintevinnaśca vittaśca' iti| `vida vicāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1450) ityasya niṣṭhāntasyaitadrūpadvyamiṣyate; pūrvavadiṭpratiṣedhāt‌, anena ca sūtreṇa (8.2.56) pakṣe natvavidhānāt‌| `bhogivittaśca vindateḥ' iti| vibdaterityanena lābhārthavidiṃ darśayati| tasya hi `śe mucādīnām‌' (7.1.59) iti numi kṛte vindatītyetadrūpaṃ bhavati| bhogavitta iti--bhoge vitto bhogavittaḥ, `saptamī' (2.1.40) iti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ| bhogagrahaṇaṃ copalakṣaṇamātram‌| pratyayo'yi gṛhyate| `vidlṛ lābhe' (dhā.pā.1432) ityasya bhoge pratyaye cārthe vitta ityetadrūpaṃ niṣṭhāyāmiṣyate; `vito bhogapratyayayoḥ' (8.2.58) iti natvābhāvasya nipātanāt‌, `yasya vibhāṣā' (7.2.15) iti niṣṭhāyāmiṭpratiṣedhācca| vindaterhi kvasau `vibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām‌' (7.2.68) itīṅ‌vibhāṣitaḥ; `bhogavittaśca vindateḥ' iti bruvatā'rthatau bhogapratyayābhyāmanyatra vinna ityetadrūpamiṣyata ityuktaṃ bhavati|| 57. na dhyākhyāpamūrcchimadām‌| (8.2.57) `dhyai cintāyām‌' (dhā.pā.908), `khyā prakathane' (dhā.pā.1060), `cakṣiṅaḥ khyāñ‌' (2.4.54) iti ca--dvayorapi grahaṇam‌| nanu ca cakṣiṅādeśasya sānubandhakatvānniranubandhakagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (vyā.pa.53) na prāpnotīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha hi niṣṭhātakārasya paratvapratipādane pañcamī yuktā, yathā--`radābhyām‌ (8.2.42) iti| tatra pañcamīnirdeśe karttavye yaḥ ṣaṣṭhīnirdeśaḥ kriyate, sa sambandhasāmānyaṃ pratipādayitum‌| na ca sambandhina mantareṇa sambandhasāmānyamupapadyate| na ca sānubandhake parityajyamāne sambandhibhedaḥ sambhavatīti yuktaṃ tasyāpi grahaṇam‌, `pṝ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1489), `murcchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ' (dhā.pā.212), `madī harṣe' (dhā.pā.1208)| eṣu dhyākhyāprabhṛtiṣu--ādyayoḥ `saṃyogādeḥ' (8.2.43) ityādinā natde prāpte, itareṣāmapi `radābhyām‌' (8.2.42) ityādinā, pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate| `pūrttaḥ' iti| `śrayukaḥ kiti' (7.2.11) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ, `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuttvam‌, pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| `mūrttaḥ' iti `rāllopaḥ' (6.4.21) iti cchakāralopaḥ, `āditaśca' (7.2.16) itīṭpratiṣedhaḥ| `mattaḥ' iti| atrāpi `śvīdito niṣṭhāyām‌' (7.2.14) iti|| 58. vitto bhogapratyayayoḥ| (8.2.58) `dhanamasya bahavityarthaḥ' iti| kathaṃ punarbhoge vyatpāditasya dhane vṛttirartho bhavati? ityāha--`ghanaṃ hi' ityādi| anena karmasādhanatvaṃ bhogaśabdasya darśayan‌ dhane'sya vṛttiṃ darśayati| `pratīta ityarthaḥ' iti| etena pratyayaśabdasya karmasādhanatāmācaṣṭe| pratīta iti karmaṇi niṣṭhā| pratīta ākhyāta ityarthaḥ| sa cāyamarthaḥ pratyaye vyutpādyamāne'sya kathaṃ [nāsti--kā.mu.pāṭhe] bhavati, yadi pratyaśabdo'pi karmasādhano bhavati--pratīyata iti pratyayaḥ| tena pratyayaśabdasya karmasādhanatā veditavyā|| 59. bhittaṃ śakalam‌| (8.2.59) `bhittamiti nipātyate' iti| kiṃ nipātyate? radābhyāmiti (8.2.42) natve prāpte tadabhāva iti| `śakalaṃ cettadbhavati' iti| śakalaśabdasya yo'rthaḥ, khamaṇḍa iti yasyāparamabhidhānam‌, bhittaśabdasyāpi yadi sa evārtho bhavatītyarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarbhittaśabdasya śakalamartho bhavati? ityāha--`śakalaparyāyo'yam‌' iti| bhittaśabdaḥ śakalasyaiva paryāyaḥ| tasmādyathā śakalaśabdasya śakalamabhidheyaṃ bhavati, evaṃ bhittaśabdasyāpi| nanu ca śakalaśabdo'yaṃ jātiśabdaḥ; jātiprava-ttinimittamupādāya svābhideye pravṛttatvāt‌; bhittaśabdastu kriyāśabdaḥ, kriyāpravṛttinimittatvāt‌; tathā hi--bhidervidāraṇārthāt‌ kte vihite bhittamiti nipātyate, na ca kriyāśabdo jātiśabdaparyāya upapadyate? ityāha--`atra' ityādi| śabdavyutpattiḥ-śabdasaṃskāraḥ, tasyā evātra bhittaśabde bhidikriyānimittatvām‌; na tu tatpravṛtteḥ; asattvāt‌| jātireva tu tatpravṛtti prati nimittam‌; tasyā vidyamānatvāt‌| tasmācchakalaśabdavadbhittaśabdo'pi jātiśabda eva; na kriyāśabda iti yuktā tasya tatparyāyatā| yadi tarhyasatyevātra bhidikriyā, śabdasaṃskāratvasyāpi sā nimittaṃ nopapadyate? naitadasti; na hyayaṃ niyogo'bhidhīyate--vidyamānaiva kriyā śabdasaṃskārasya nimittaṃ bhavatīti| tathā hi tailapāyikāśabdo yatra prāṇiviśeṣe rūḍhaḥ, tatra tailapānakriyāśabdo'pi nāsti; tathāpi tailapānakriyā tatsaṃskāranimittatvenāśrīyate| kathaṃ punarbhittaśabdo bhidikriyāpravṛttinimittaṃ na bhavati? ityāha--`bhidikriyāvivakṣāyāṃ hi' ityādi| atra bhinnamityasya ca bhittaśakalaśabdābhyāṃ pratyekamabhisambandhaḥ| tena `bhinnaṃ bhittamityeva bhavati' iti| etat‌ prayogadvayamapi bhidikriyādivakṣāyāṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| vidīrṇe hi śakale tasya vidīrṇatāṃ pratipādayituṃ bhinnam‌, bhittamityeṣa prayogo bhidikriyāvivakṣāyāṃ kriyate| yadi ca bhittaśabda kriyāpravṛttinimittaṃ syāt‌, tato bhittaśabdenaiva bhidikriyānimittakena vidīrṇatā śakalasya pratipādyata ityeṣa prayogo nopapadyate, na hi tadasti yasya bhittaśabdenāpratipāditasya bhinnaśabdayogo bhavet‌| bhinnaṃ śakalamityeṣa ca prayogo nopapadyate; śakalavyutpāditena bhittaśabdena bhidikriyānimittakena bhinnaśabdasya bādhitatvāt‌| asti cāyaṃ dvividho'pi prayogaḥ, tasgādbhittaśabdasya bhidikriyānimittatvaṃ na gamyate|| 60. ṛṇamādhamarṇye| (8.2.60) `ṛ ityetasmāt‌' iti| `ṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.1098) ityetasmāt‌, `ṛ gatiprāpaṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.936) ityetasmādvā| `adhama ṛṇe'dhamarṇaḥ' iti| kena punaratra samāsa iti? yāvatā nātra kiñcit‌ samāsalakṣaṇamasti; `saptamiti yogavibhāgāt‌ samāsaḥ' ityetacca na vaktavyam‌, saptamyāḥ pūrvanipātaprasaṅgat‌? ityata āha--`etasmādeva' ityādi| `tadbhāva ādhamarṇyam‌' iti| tat‌ pratidāsyatīti grahaṇakriyābhisambandhaḥ| tadyogādbhāve'sāvadhamarṇa ityucyate| `kālāntara' ityādi| yasmin‌ kāle'dhamarṇo gṛhṇāti tasmāt‌ kālādanya āgāmī kālaḥ kālāntaram‌, tatra yaddeyaṃ tat‌ kālāntaradeyam‌, tena yo vinimayaḥ- viparivarttanam‌, tadupalakṣaṇārthamevādhamarṇagrahaṇamevamupāttam‌, na ca svārthaparatipādanārthameva| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyāyate? ityāha--`uttamarṇa ityapi bhavati' iti| ṛṇe hyeko'dhamarṇo bhavati, yo gṛhītvā pratidāsyatīti; yastu datvā grahauṣyati sa uttamarṇaḥ| tatra yadyādhamarṇyagrahaṇaṃ svārthapratipādanārthamevopāttam‌, tadottamarṇa iti na sidhyet‌, na hyatrādhamarṇyaṃ vivakṣitam‌| tattarhīdaṃ cottamaryarṇe'pi kālāntaradeyavinimayopalakṣaṇārthatvādādhamarṇyagrahaṇe satyetadapi sidhyati, asti hyatra kālāntaradvayavinimayaḥ| tathā hyuttamarṇo'pi prayacchan‌ kālāntare yaddeyaṃ tena vinimayaṃ karoti|| 61. nasattaniṣattānuttapratūrttasūrttagūrttāni chandasi| (8.2.61) `sadeḥ' iti| `ṣadlṛ viśaraṇagatyavasādaneṣu' (dhā.pā.854) ityetasmāt‌| `niṣattaḥ' iti| `sadirapratteḥ' (8.3.66) itiṣatvam‌| `anuttam‌' iti| `undī kledane' (dhā.pā.1457), `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) iti nalopaḥ| `pratūrttam‌' iti| yadā `ñitvarā sambhrame' (dhā.pā.775) ityasya nipātyate, tadā `jvaratvara' (6.4.20) ityādinā vakārasyopathāyāścotvam‌| yadā `urvī turvī thurvī hiṃsārthāḥ' (dhā.pā.569,570,571) ityasya, tadā `rāllopaḥ' (6.4.21) iti rakāralopaḥ, pūrvavaddīrghaḥ| `sūrttam‌' iti| `sṛ gatau' (dhā.pā.935) utvasanniyoge raparatvam‌, pūrvaddīrghaḥ| `gūrttam‌' iti| `gurī udyamāne' [`gūrī'--prā.mu.pāṭha] (dhā.pā.1396)| 62. kvinpratyayasya kuḥ| (8.2.62) `ghṛtaspṛk‌' iti| atra śakārasya vivṛttakaraṇasya śvāsānupradānasyāghoṣasya tādṛśa eva khakāraḥ, tasya jaśtvam‌--gakāraḥ| gakārasyāpi cartvam‌--kakāraḥ| atha pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na kvina ityevocyeta, na hi kvin‌ pratyayatvaṃ vyabhicarati| evamucyamāne lopāpavādaḥ kvina eva kutvaṃ syādityetacca nāśaṅkanīyam‌, tathā hi--kvinniti pratyayagrahaṇaṃ yatra pratyayagrahaṇaṃ pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā (bho.pa.sū.7) kvinnanta upasthāpite kvino lope karttavye kutvasyāsiddhatvāt‌ pūrvaṃ lopenaiva bhavitavyam‌| tasmin‌ sati paścādbhavatkutvaṃ pariśiṣṭasya dhātoreva bhaviṣyiti? ityata āha--`kvinaḥ kuriti vaktavye' ityādi| asati hi pratyayagrahaṇe kvinpratyayāntasyaiva padāntasya syāt‌, mānyapratyayāntasya, tasyāpi ceṣyate| tasmāt‌ pratyayagrahaṇaṃ kriyate| pratyayagrahaṇe sati bahuvrīhirlabhyate| tena bahuvrīhiṇā yasmādvihitaḥ sa dhāturūpalakṣyata iti sarvasya sidhyati| `māno asrāk‌, māno adrāk‌' iti| `sṛja visarge' (dhā.pā.1414) `dṛkṣir‌ prekṣaṇe' (dhā.pā.988), luṅ‌, cleḥ sic‌ (3.1.44), tip‌, `sṛjidṛśorjhalyamakiti' (6.1.58) ityamāgamaḥ, `vadavraja' (7.2.3) ityādinā vṛddhiḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68), aḍāgamaḥ, anena kṛtvam‌| `sṛjidṛśibhyāṃ kvinvihitaḥ' iti| `ṛtvik‌' (3.2.59) ityādinā sṛjeḥ kvinvihitaḥ| dṛśerapi `tyavādiṣu duśeranālocane kañca' (3.2.60) ityanena| kathaṃ punaratrāḍāgamaḥ, yāvatā `na māṅayoge' (6.4.74) iti pratiṣiddho'so? ityata āha-`māṅyoge'pi' ityādi| chāndasau hyetau prayogau| tena satyapi māṅyoge `bahulaṃ chandasyāmāṅyoge'pi' (6.4.75) ityaḍāgamo bhavatyeva| `astisico'pṛkte' (7.3.96) itīṭ‌ tarhi kasmānna bhavati? ityāha-īṭ‌ ca na bhavati' ityādi| pratyayagrahaṇādyathā kvinpratyayasya lugantasya kṛtvaṃ bhavati, dṛgbhyāmityā daudṛśeḥ kvibantasyāpi| `evam‌' ityādi| pratyayagrahaṇāt‌ kvinpratyayo yasmādvihitaḥ, tasyānyapratyayāntasyāpi kutvaṃ bhavatītyasminnarthe vyavasthite rajjusṛṅbhyāmityatrāpi braścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatvaṃ yat‌ prāpnoti tadbādhitvā kṛtvena bhavitavyam‌| `atha tu neṣyate, pratividhānaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| [nāsti--prā.mu.pāṭhe] pratividhānamuttarasūtre vāgrahaṇaṃ yat‌ tadubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣaḥ| vyavasthitavibhāṣā ca, teneha na bhaviṣyatīti| evañca sati rajjusṛbhyām‌, rajjusṛṅbhya iti bhavitavyam‌|| 63. naśervā| (8.2.63) `jīvanaṅāhutiḥ' iti| atrākutvapakṣe vraścādisūtreṇa (8.2.36) ṣatve kṛte jaśtvam‌--ḍakāraḥ|| 64. mo no dhātoḥ| (8.2.64) `padasya' iti varttate| tacca dhātusamānādhikaraṇaṃ makāreṇa viśeṣyate--makārāntasya padasya dhātoriti| `praśān‌, pratān‌ iti| `śamu upaśame' (dhā.pā.1201), `tamu kāṅkṣāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1202), kvip‌, `anunāsikasya kvijhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) ityupadhādīrghatvam‌, halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68)| atheha `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) ti nakāralopaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`natvasya' ityādi|| 65. mvośca| (8.2.65) `aganma' iti| `sa uttamasya' (3.4.98) iti sakāralopaḥ| `jaganvān‌' iti| gamerliṭ‌, kvasuḥ, halṅyādi (6.1.68) saṃyogāntalaupau (8.2.23), `sāntamahataḥ' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ, `gamahana' (6.4.98) ityādinopadhālopaḥ| `chandasyubhayathā' (3.4.117) iti sārvadhātukatvaṃ na bhavati| cakāraḥ `dhātauḥ' ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 66. sasajuṣo ruḥ| (8.2.66) `sajūḥ' iti| `juṣī prītisevanayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1288), saha jaṣata iti kvip‌, upapadasamāsaḥ, `sahasya saḥ saṃjñāyām‌' (6.3.78) iti sabhāvaḥ| rutve kṛte `rvorupadhāyāḥ' (8.2.76) iti dīrghaḥ| sajuvo grahaṇamasakārāntārtham‌| yogaścāyaṃ jaśtvāpavādaḥ|| 67. avayāḥ śvetavāḥ puroḍāśca| (8.2.67) `dāśeḥ' [`dāśateḥ'--kāśikā] iti| `dāśṛ dāne' (dhā.pā.882) ityasmāṇṇvini kṛta iti| vahidāśibhyāṃ `mantre śvetavahokthaśaspuroḍāśo ṇvin‌' (3.2.71) ityanena, yajeśca `āve yajaḥ' (3.2.72) iti ṇvinpratyayāntebhyaḥ sambuddhiḥ, tasyā halaṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68), tataḥ `śvetavāhādīnāṃ ḍaspadasya' (vā.263) iti ḍaspradasya' ṭilopaḥ| kimarthamete nipātyante, yāvatā śvetavobhyām, śvetavobhirityevamādyartham‌ `śvetavāhādīnāṃ ḍaspadasya' ityadaśyamidaṃ vaktavyam‌, ḍasi ca kṛte `sasajuṣo ruḥ' (8.2.66) ityeva siddham‌? ityāha--`śvetavāhādīnām‌' ityādi| naite rutvārtha nipātyante, kiṃ tarhi? sambuddhau dīrghatvārtham| nanu ca drīrghatvamapyeṣāṃ `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) ityeva siddham‌? ityata āha--`atvasantasya ca' ityādi| tatra hi `sarvanāmasthāne cāsambuddhau' (6.4.8) ityataḥ `asambuddhau' ityetadanuvarttate, tena sambuddhau dīrghatvaṃ prāpnotīti, tadarthamete nipātyante| `puroḍāḥ' iti| `mantre śvetavahokthaśas‌' (3.2.71) ityādinaiva sūtadreṇa dakārasya ḍakāro nipātyate| `ukthaśāḥ' iti| `śansu stutau' (dā.pā.728)| ukthāni śaṃsatīti `mantre śvetavaha' (3.2.71) ityādinaiva ṇvin‌, tataḥ pūrvavat‌ sambuddhyādiḥ|| 68. ahan‌| (8.2.68) `nalopaḥ prātipadikāntasya' (8.2.7) iti nalope prāpte vidhīyate| ` ahobhyām‌, ahobhiḥ' iti| `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityutvam‌, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `dīrghāho nidāghaḥ' ["darghāhā"--kāśikā, prācīnamudritanyāsapāṭhaśca] iti| bahuvrīhiḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68), rutvasyāsiddhatvāt‌ `sarvanāmasthāne ca' (6.4.8) ityādinā dīrghaḥ, `bhobhagoadho' (8.3.7) ityādinā rephasya yakāraḥ, tasya `hali sarveṣām‌' (8.3.22) iti lopaḥ| `he dīrghāho'tri' iti| `ato roraplutādaplute' (6.1.113) ityutvam‌; `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), `eṅaḥ padāntāt‌' (6.1.109) iti parapūrvatvam‌| hanterlaṅi tipā halṅyādilope (6.1.68) kṛte tipaśca lukyaḍāgame cāhannityetadrūpaṃ sampadyate, tasmāttasya rutvena bhavitavyam‌? iti kasayacidbhāntiḥ syāt‌, atastannirāsāyāha--`ahan‌' ityādi| upasaṃkhyānaśabdo'tra pratipādane varttate| ahno rūvidhau karttavye rūpādiṣu rutvasya pratipādanaṃ karttavyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--pūrvasūtrādiha cakāro'nuvarttate, sa cānuktasamuccayārthaḥ, tenāhro rūpādiṣu rutvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti| `ahorūpam‌' iti| ahno rūpamiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| kathaṃ punā rātriśabda ucyamānaṃ rutvaṃ rātraśabde bhavati? sthānivadbhāvāt‌, ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvādvā| rātraśabdāsya tu grahaṇaṃ na kṛtam‌, rātriśabdasyāpi yathā syāt‌--gatamaho rātrirāgateti| `aho rathantaram‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| atha vā--asamāsa eva| "ro'supi' ityasyāpavādo rutvam‌' ityādi| ahorūpamityādi yadi samāsaḥ, yadyasamāso vā, sarvathā vibhakterlukā bhavitavyam‌| luki satyahno ravidhau lumatā lupte (1.1.63) pratyayalakṣaṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ| tena supparatvasyābhāvāt‌ `ro'supi' (8.2.69) ityetat‌ prāpnotīti rutvaṃ vidhīyate| kimartham‌? `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityutvaṃ yathā syāt‌| yadi rurudutpannasya syāt‌, utvavidhau `roḥ' ityukārānubandhaviśiṣṭasya rephasyānuvṛtteḥ|| 69. ro'supi| (8.2.69) pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ| rephe'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `ahardadāti' iti| yadyatra rutvaṃ syāt‌ `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityutvaṃ prasajyeta| tasmādro vidhīyate| nanu cātrāpi pratyayalakṣaṇena subasti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ahno ravidhau lumatā lupte pratyayalakṣaṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ| lopaśabdena yatra lopastatra hi pratyayalakṣaṇam‌, yathā--`he dīrghāho'tra| he dīrghāha nidāgha' iti| atra halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68)|| 70. abhnarūdharavarityubhayathā chandasi| (8.2.70) nityaṃ rutve prāpte pakṣe ro'pi yathā syādityevamarthamidam‌| sakārasya rutvaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaḥ--yasmin‌ prāpte repha ucyete, tasya rutpasyobhayathāgrahaṇena pakṣe'bāvo vijñāyeta-ityevamarthañca; itarathā hi dveṣyamapi vijñāyeta| yasmin‌ prāpte rutvamārabhyate tasya jaśtvaṃ pakṣe'bhyanujñāyata iti| `amna eva' iti| rutvapakṣe `bhobhago' (8.3.17) ityādinā yakāraḥ, tasya `lopaḥ śākalyasya' (8.3.19) iti lopaḥ| `pracetasa upasaṃkhyānam‌, aharādīnāṃ patyādiṣūpasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| ubhayatropasaṃkhyānaśabdasaya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--itikaraṇaḥ pradarśanārthaḥ, evamprakāreṣvanyeṣvapyubhayathā bhavati--rutvaṃ vā repho vete| tena pracetaḥśabdasya rājani, aharādīnāñca patyādiṣūbhayatā bhavati| `praceto rājan‌' iti| prakṛṣṭaṃ ceto yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, āmantritaikavacanam‌, rutvam‌, `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityutvam‌, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| ityutvaṃ yathā syāt‌| yadi rurudutpannasya syāt‌, utvavidhau `roḥ' ityukārānubandhaviśiṣṭasya rephasyānuvṛtteḥ|| 69. ro'supi| (8.2.69) pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ| rephe'kāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| `ahardadāti' iti| yadyatra rutvaṃ syāt‌ `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityutvaṃ prasajyeta| tasmādro vidhīyate| nanu cātrāpi pratyayalakṣaṇena subasti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ahno ravidhau lumatā lupte pratyayalakṣaṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ| lopaśabdena yatra lopastatra hi pratyayalakṣaṇam‌, yathā--`he dīrghaho'tra| hi dīrghāha nidāgha' iti| atra halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68)|| 70. amnarūdharavarityubhayathā chandasi| (8.2.70) nityaṃ rutve prāpte pakṣe ro'pi yathā syādityevamarthamidam‌| sakārasya rutvaṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaḥ--yasmin‌ prāpte repha ucyate, tasya rutpasyobhayathāgrahaṇena pakṣe'bhāvo vijñāyeta-ityevamarthañca; itarathā hi dveṣyamapi vijñāyeta| yasmin‌ prāpte rutvamārabhyate tasya jaśtvaṃ pakṣe'bhyanujñāyata iti| `amna eva' iti| rutvapakṣe `bhobhago' (8.3.17) ityādinā yakāraḥ, tasya `lopaḥ śākalyasya' (8.3.19) iti lopaḥ| `pracetasa upasaṃkhyānam‌, aharādīnāṃ patyādiṣūpasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| ubhayatropasaṃkhyānaśabdasya pratipādanamarthaḥ| tatredaṃ pratipādanam‌--itikaraṇaḥ pradarśanārthaḥ, evamprakāreṣvanyeṣvapyubhayathā bhavati--rutvaṃ vā repho veti| tena pracetaḥśabdasya rājani, aharādīnāñca patyādiṣūbhayatā bhati| `praceto rājan‌' iti| prakṛṣṭaṃ ceto yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ, āmantritaikavacanam‌, rutvam‌, `haśi ca' (6.1.114) ityutvam‌, `ādguṇaḥ' (7.1.87)| `pracetā rājan‌' iti| rephe kṛte tasya `ro ri' (8.3.14) iti lopaḥ, `ḍhralope' (6.3.111) ityādinā dīrghaḥ| sambuddhyantodāharaṇaṃ rutvarephayorviśeṣa sampratipādanārtham‌; asambuddhau hi rutvarephayorasiddhatvāt‌ `atvasantasya cādhātoḥ' (6.4.14) iti dīrghatve tulyameva rūpaṃ bhavati| `aharpattiḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `ro'supi' (6.2.69) iti rephe kṛte tasya pakṣe repho vidhīyate| `aha pattiḥ' iti| rephasya visarjanīye kṛte `kupvoḥ ka pau ca' (8.3.37) iti pakṣe upadhmānīyaḥ| `gīrpatiḥ' iti| `gṝ śabde' (dhā.pā.1498)| sampadāditvāt‌ kvip‌, `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itītvam‌, raparatvam‌| `dhūrpatiḥ' iti| dhurveḥ kvip‌, `rāllopaḥ' (6.4.21) iti vakāralopaḥ| atha kimarthaṃ rephasyaiva repo vidhīyate? ityāha--`visarjanīyavādhanārtham‌' ityādi| `kharavasānayoḥ' (8.3.15) iti visarjanīyaḥ prāpnoti, tadvādhanārtha repasyaiva repho vidhīyate|| 71. bhuvaśca mahāvyāhṛteḥ| (8.2.71) bhuvaḥśabdaḥ ṣaṣṭhya tapratirūpakamavyayam‌, tasya nityaṃ rutve prāpte pakṣe repho yatā syādityevamarthamidam‌| cakāra ubhayathetyasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tenottaratrānuvṛttirna bhavati| `bhuvo viśvasya' iti| mūśabdasya ṣaṣṭhyantasya pañcamyantasya vā prayogaḥ| yadyevam‌, lākṣaṇikatvādevāsya [`lākṣaṇikatvādināsya'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] na bhaviṣyati, tatkimennivṛttyarthena mahāvyāhṛtigrahaṇena? evaṃ tarhyetajjñāpayati--anityalakṣaṇā pratipadoktaparibhāṣeti| tena krāpayatītyatara pugāgamaḥ siddho bhavati, nityatve tu tasya na syāt‌, asyākārāntasya lākṣaṇikatvāt‌| kīdṛśī bhuvaḥśabdo mahāvyāhṛtirbhavati? ityāha--`bhuvasityetat‌' ityādi| antarikṣaṃ hi mahat‌, tasya vyāhṛtiḥ-uktitaryasmāt‌; tasmānmahāvyāhṛtirbhavati|| 72. vasusraṃsudhvaṃsvanaḍuhāṃ daḥ| (8.2.72) `vidvadbhyām‌' iti| `videḥ śaturvasuḥ' (7.1.36) iti vasurādeśaḥ| `papivadbhyām‌, papivadbhiḥ' iti| pivateḥ pātervā liṭ‌, kvasuḥ, `vasvekājādghāsām‌' (7.2.67) itīṭ‌, `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ, sthānivadbhāvena `pā' ityetad‌dvirucyate| `ukhāsrat‌, parṇadhvat‌' iti sraṃsidhvaṃsibhyām‌--ukhāyāḥ sraṃsate, parṇāni dhvaṃsata iti kvip‌, `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) iti nalopaḥ| ihedaṃ vasordatvamanavakāśam‌, sarvasya viṣayasya vidhyantareṇāvaṣṭabdhatvāt‌; tathāpi vidvānityādau saṃyogāntalopaḥ prāpnoti, vidvadbhyāmityādau tu rutvam‌| atastadanavakāśatvādyadā rutvaṃ bādhate tadā saṃyogāntalopo'pi tena bādhitavyaḥ, tataśca vidvāniti na sidhyatīti tasya vyāmohaḥ syāt‌, taṃ pratyāha-`rutve nāprāpte' ityādi| `yasminnāprāpte yo vidhirārabhyate sa tasya bādhako bhavati' (vyā.pa.49), na cāprāpte rutva idamārabhyate, atastadeva datvena bādhyate| `saṃyogāntalopastu naivam‌' iti| tuśabdo rutvādviśeṣaṃ darśayati| itikaraṇo hetau| yathā rutvaṃ sarvatra prāpnoti naivaṃ syogāntalopaḥ| sa hi vidvānityādāveva prāpnoti, na vidvadbhacāmityādau| tasmāt‌ tenaiva datvaṃ bādhyate, na tvasau datvena; saṃyogāntalope karttavye dattvasyāsiddhatvādityabhiprāyaḥ| ata yathā `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) ityasya dakāro'trāpavādaḥ, tathā sa [`sa tathā'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] `sāvanaḍuhaḥ' (7.1.82) ityasyāpi kasmānna bhavati, yatā hyavakāśatvāddakāro ḍhatvasya bādhakastathā numo'pi bādhaka eva yuktaḥ? ityata āha--`numastu vidhānasāmarthyānna bhavati' iti| pratipadaṃ hi `sāvanaḍuhaḥ' num‌ vidhīyate, tasya yadyayaṃ dakāro'pavādaḥ syāt‌, numvadhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| `anaḍvān‌' iti| `caturanaḍuhorāmudāttaḥ' (7.1.98) ityām‌, yaṇādeśaḥ, halṅyādi (6.1.68) saṃyogānta (8.2.23) lopau| `he anaḍvan‌' iti| `am sambuddhau' (7.1.99) ityam‌| seṣaṃ pūrvavat‌|| 73. tipyanasteḥ| (8.2.73) `acakāt‌ anvaśāt‌' iti| `cakāsṛ dīptau' (dhā.pā.1074), `śāsu anuśiṣṭau' (dhā.pā.1075), laṅ‌, tip‌, adāditvācchapo luk‌, halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68)| bhavānityanuprayogastipo'bhivyakteye| `ā' iti| `āḍajādīnām‌' (6.4.72) ityāṭ‌, `āṭaśca' (6.1.90) iti vṛddhiḥ, tipo lope kṛte dhātusakārasya rutvam‌, tasya visarjanīyaḥ|| 74. sipi dhāto rurvā| (8.2.74) `acakāstvam‌' iti| rutve kṛte tasya visarjanīyaḥ, tasya `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.3.34) iti sakāraḥ| `tvam‌' iti anuprayogaḥ sipo'bhivyaktaye| atha dhātugrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā sakārāntasyāpi rephadakārāvucyete, na ca sipi sakārāntāddhātoranyadasti? ityata āha--`dhātugrahaṇam‌' ityādi| uttarārthatā cāsva `rvorupadhāyāḥ' (8.2.76) ityatra darśayiṣyate| kriyatāmuttarārthaṃ dhātugrahaṇam‌, rugrahaṇaṃ tu na karttavyam‌; anarthakatvāt‌; dakāre hi vikalpite yathāprāptaṃ rutvaṃ pakṣe labhyata eva? ityata āha--`rugrahaṇaṃ ca' iti| uttarārthamityapakṣate| `daśca' (8.2.75) iti vakṣyati, tatra pakṣe rutvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌| asati hi tasmin‌ yadā datvaṃ na bhavati, tadā yathāprāptaṃ catvaṃ na syāt‌|| 75. daśca| (8.2.75) cakāreṇa `daḥ' (8.2.72) ityanukṛṣyate, tenottaratra tasyānuvṛttirna bhavati| `abhinastvam‌' iti| laṅ‌, rudhāritvāt‌ śnam‌|| 76. rvorupadhāyā dīrgha ikaḥ| (8.2.76) padasyetyeva, dhātoriti ca, tadubhayamiha samānādhikaraṇaṃ rephavakārābhyāṃ viśeṣyate, viśe ṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--`rephavakārāntasya' iti| vakārasyodāharaṇaṃ kasamānna pradarśitam‌? ityāha--`dakāragrahaṇamutarārtham‌' iti| tena vakārāntasyodāharaṇaṃ na pradarśitamiti bhāvaḥ| etadarthaṃ tu tanna bhavati; vakārāntasya padasya dhātorasambhavāt‌| `abibhaḥ' iti| bhṛño laṅ‌, tip‌, guṇaḥ, raparatvam‌, `juhotyādibhyaḥ śluḥ' (2.4.75), dvirvacanam‌, `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityattvam‌, `bhṝñāmit‌' (7.4.76) itīttvam‌, halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68)|| 77. hali ca| (8.2.77) `divyati, caturyati' iti| div‌ catur‌--ityubhayaṃ prātipadikamatra, tena na bhavati| `smeryate' iti| bhāve yak‌, `guṇorttisaṃyogādyoḥ' (7.4.29) iti guṇaḥ| `bhavyam‌' iti| `aco yat‌' (3.1.97) guṇaḥ; `dhātostannimittasyaiva' (6.1.80) ityavādeśaḥ|| 78. upadhāyāñca| (8.2.78) pūrvaṃ rephavakārāntasya ghātordīrghatvavidhānādarephavakārāntārthamidam‌| upadhāyāmiti subvyatyayena ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanasya sthāne saptamyekavacanam‌| `upadhābhūtau' iti| upadhātvaṃ prāptāvityarthaḥ| alo'ntyāt‌ pūrvau iti yāvat‌| `halparo' iti| hal‌ para ābhyāmiti bahuvrīhiḥ| sa punarhal‌ dhātvavayava eva veditavyaḥ| yatra hi pratyayāvayavo rephavakārābhyāṃ halparastatra pūrveṇaiva siddhaḥ| `hūrchitā' iti| `hurccha kauṭilye' (dhā.pā.211)| `mūrcchitā' iti| `murcchā mohasamucchrāyayoḥ' (dhā.pā.212)| nanu ca `aco rahābhyāṃ dve' (8.4.46) iti dvirvacane kṛte repho'tropadhā na bhavati? naitadasti; dīrghatve karttavye dvirvacanasyāsiddhatvācchakāro'traika eva haliti bhavatyevopadhātvaṃ rephasya| `ciriṇoti, jiriṇoti' iti| `ri kṣi ciri jiri dāśa dṛ hiṃsāyām‌' (dhā.pā.1275-1280) svāditvātśnuḥ'| iha `rī gatau' (dhā.pā.1500), `dhī gatiprajanādiṣu' (dhā.pā.1048)-etābhyāṃ liṭ‌, atusi, usi ca, `eranekācaḥ' (6.4.82) iti yaṇādeśaḥ; tasya sthānivadbhāvād‌dvirvacane kṛte `riryatuḥ, riryuḥ; vivyatuḥ vivyu' iti sthite'bhyāsekārasya dīrghasya prāpnoti, halparayo rephavakārayorupadhābhūtatvāt‌| etatkasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`riryatuḥ, riryaḥ' ityādi| sthānivadbhāvaḥ `acaḥ parasmin‌' (1.1.57) ityādinā| nanu ca `na padānta' (1.1.58) ityādinā dīrghavidhau pratiṣidhyate sthānivadbhāvaḥ, tat‌ kutastasyeha sambhavaḥ? naitadasti; parigaṇanaṃ hi tatra kriyate--`svaradīrghayalopeṣu lopājādeśo na sthānivat‌' (kā.vṛ.1.1.58) itiḥ `asiddhatvādvā' ityādi| atra bahiraṅgatvaṃ yaṇādeśasya; aṅgādhikāre vidhīyamānasya pratyayāśritatvāt‌| dīrghatvasya tvantaraṅgatvam‌; prakṛtyāśrayatvāt‌| `asiddhañca bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) iti dīrghatve karttavye yaṇādeśa syāsiddhatvādrephavakārau halparau na bhavatiḥ, tatkuto dīrghatvasya prāptiḥ| iha tarhi caturyiteti dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati, atra hi `caturya' ityasya kyajantasya dhātostṛci parataḥ `ato lopaḥ' (6.4.48) ityakāralope kṛta upadhābhūto repho halparo bhavatītyasti dīrghatvasya prāptiḥ, ityāha--`caturyitetyatrāpi' ityādi| bahiraṅgatvamato lopasyārthadhātukāśraya syāt‌| dīrghasyāntaraṅgatvaṃ pūrvavat‌| tarhi pratidīvnetyatrāpi dīrghatvaṃ na syāt‌| yathaiva hi caturyitetyatra dhātorupadhā repho na bhavati, tathā pratidīvnetyatrāpi vakāraḥ| tathā hi--dīvyetyetāvān‌ dhātuḥ, nakārastu pratyaya sambandhī; na ca diverdhātorvakara upadhābhūtaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? antabhūtaḥ? ityata āha--`pratidīvnetyatra' ityādi| pratipūrvāddivaḥ `kanin‌ yuvuṣitakṣi' (da.u.6.51) ityādinā kavin‌, `allopo'naḥ' (6.4.134) ityakāralopaḥ| nanu ca `acaḥ parasmin‌ pūrvavidhau' (1.1.57) ityallopasya sthāvivadbhāvāddhali parato vakārānto'tra dhāturna bhavati| tatkathaṃ `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvam‌? ityāha--`dīrghavidhau' ityādi| sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhastu `na padānta' (1.1.58) ityādinā| nanvevamapi bahiraṅgalakṣaṇasiddhatvādallopasya naivātra hali parato vakārānto dhāturupapadyate? ityāha--`asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgam‌' ityādi| anāśrayaṇasya tu heturanityatvamasyāḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ| anityatvaṃ tu `nalopaḥ supsvara' (8.2.2) ityādau sūtre tugvidhigrahaṇājjñāpitam‌| atha jivriḥ, kiryorityādau `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvaṃ kasmānna bhavati jivriśabdo'pyayame vaṃ vyutpādyate, `jīryateḥ krin‌ raśca vaḥ' (da.u.1-80) iti| `jṝṣ‌ [`jṝṣa'-dhā.pā.] jhṝṣ‌ [`jhṝṣa'--dhā.pā.] vayohānau' (dhā.pā.1130,1131) ityasmāt‌ krinpratyayaḥ; `ṛta iddhātoḥ' (7.1.100) itīttvam‌, raparatvam‌, rephasya vakāra ādeśaḥ--ityevaṃ vyutpattau jivrirityetasya vakārāntasya dhāto rephe hali parataḥ `hali ca' (8.2.77) ityasti dīrghatvasya prāptiḥ| kiriḥ girirityevamādīnāmapi śabdānāmevaṃ vyutpattiḥ kriyate| `aca iḥ' (da.u. 1-67) ityata ipratyaye'nuvarttamāne `bhujeḥ kicca' (da.u. 1-71) iti ca `kṛgṝśṝpṝkuṭibhidicchidibhyaśca' (da.u. 1-72) itikiratiprabhṛtibhyo dhātubhya ipratyayaṃ vidhāya vyutpādyanta ete| evaṃ hi vyutpattāvosi yaṇādeśe kṛte yakāre hali parato rephāntānāṃ kiriprabhṛtīnāṃ `hali ca' (8.2.77) iti dīrghatvaṃ prāpnoti? ityata āha--`uṇādayo'vyutpannāni' ityādi| nanu ca kiryoḥ, giryorityatra vyutpattipakṣe'pi dīrghatvaṃ na prasajati, na hyatra hali parataḥ kiratigiratī rephāntau, dīrghatve karttavye yaṇādeśasya sthānivadbhāvāt‌ svarāvilopeṣu hi lopājādeśo na sthānivat‌, anyastu sthānivadeva? satyametat‌; abhyupagamyevaṃ parihāra uktaḥ| evaṃ manyate--bhavatyaviśeṣeṇa sthānivadbhāvapratiṣedhaḥ, tathāpi naivātra dīrghatvaṃ prasajyeta; avyutpannatvāduṇādīnāmiti| yadyuṇādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikānīti, na hi tatraiva sūtre vyutpattipakṣaścāśrayituṃ yuktaḥ, yo'pi `āto maninkvanibvaniyaśca' (3.2.74) iti `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2 75) iti kvanippratyayānta pratidivañśabdaṃ vyutpādayeta tasyāpi naiva dīrghatvaṃ sidhyati, `lopovyorvali' (6.1.66) iti vakāralope kṛte dhātoravakārāntatvāditi? karttavyo'tra yatnaḥ| eva kriyate-`hali ca' (8.2.77) ityatra `vyāktaḥ padārthaḥ' ityetaddarśanamāśrīyate| asmiṃśca darśane pratilakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇabhedo bhavatīti yāvanti lakṣyāṇi tāvantyeva lakṣaṇāmyupadiśanti, tatra bhinneṣu lakṣyānurodhāt‌ kvacit‌ pratidīvnetyādau vyutpattipakṣa āśrīyate; kvacit‌ punarjivriḥ, kiryoḥ, giryorityādāvavyutpattipakṣa iti| cakāro halotyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 79. na bhakurcacharām‌| (8.2.79) `hāli ca' (8.2.70) iti dīrghatve prāpte pratiṣedho'yamārabhyate| `dhuryaḥ' iti| `dhuraṃ vahatīti `dhurī yaṅḍhakau' (4.4.77) iti yat‌| `kuryāt‌' iti| karoteliṅ‌, `tanādikṛñbhya u' (3.1.79), dhātorguṇaḥ, raparatvam‌, `ata ut‌ sārvadhātuke' (6.4.110) ityuttvam‌, `ye ca' (6.4.109) ityukāralopaḥ| `kuryāt‌' iti| āśiṣi liṅ‌| karotervikaraṇena nirdeśaścikīrṣatītyatra pratiṣedho mā bhūvityevamarthaḥ|| 80. adaso'serdādu do maḥ| (8.2.80) `aseḥ' itīkāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| avidyamānaḥ sakāro yasya sa tathoktaḥ| yaścaivaṃvidhaḥ sa sakārānto na bhavatītyāha--`asakārāntasya' ityādi| `amum‌' ityādi| adaso'mādiṣu tyadādyatve `ato guṇe' (6.1.97) pararūpatve ca kṛte'si (6.1.107) pūrvatvam‌| auṭi, `vaddhireci' (6.1.88) iti vaddhiḥ| śasi prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrghatvam‌| atra sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā (1.1.50) ekavacane mātrikasya mātrika eva bhavati, anyatra dvimātrikasya dvimātrikaḥ nanu ca mātrikaḥ sūtra upāttaḥ, tatkathaṃ dvimātriko labhyate? `aṇudit‌ savarṇasya cāpratyayaḥ' (1.1.69) iti savaraṇagrahaṇāditi cet‌? na; `bhāvyamāno'ṇ‌ savarṇān‌ na gṛhṇāti' (vyā.pa.35) iti pratiṣedhādityata āha--`bhāvyamāno'pi' ityādi| etacca `ṛta ut‌' (6.1.111) ityatra taparakaraṇena jñāpitam‌| `adasyati' iti| `supa kṣātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8)| `adaso'nosra iti vaktavyam‌' iti| okārasakārarephāṇāṃ dvandvaḥ, avidyamānnā osro'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ| ado'treti napuṃsakatvāt‌ `svamornapuṃsakāpta' (7.1.23) iti sorluk‌, sakārasya rutve `ato roraplutādaplute' (6.1.113) iti rorutvam‌, `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87), `eṅaḥ padāntādati' (6.1.109) iti parapūrvatvam‌| idamīkārapratiṣedhasya pratyudāharaṇam‌| `adaḥ' iti| etattu rephapratiṣedhasya| rutve kṛte visarjanīyaḥ| `tadartham‌' iti| sakārarephayorapi pratiṣedho yathā syādityevamartham‌| `aḥ seryasya' iti| sakāra [nāsti-kā.mu.pāṭhe] uccāraṇārthaḥ| akāraḥ sakārasya yasyetyarthaḥ| `katham‌' ityādi| yadā'daso'dryādeśaḥ kriyate, tadedamadaso'dreśca pṛthaṅmutvaṃ bhavati? utāntyasadeśasya? āhosvidadryādeśaviṣaye na bhavatyeva? ityetat‌ pṛcchati| `adaso'draḥ' ityādi| maśca uśca muḥ, tasya bhāvo mutvam‌| adaso'dreścobhayorapi kecinmutvamicchantītyarthaḥ| vināpi hi cakāreṇa tadartho gamyate| tadyathā--aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśumityādau vākye| katham‌? yathetyāha--`lattvavata' iti| yathā calīklṛpyata ityatra `kṛpo ro laḥ' (8.2.18) iti dhāto rephasya rīśabdasya cobhayorapi latvamicchanti, tadvadadaśaḥ, adreśca mutvam‌| `kecidantyasadeśasya' iti| adryādeśa ikārāntaḥ, tasya kecidutvamicchanti| sa punaradryādeśasambhandhī dakāro rephaśca| `netyeke' iti| apare tu--yadā'daso'dryādeśaḥ kriyate tadā na bhavitavyameva mutvenetīcchanti| atraiva kāraṇamāha--`aserhi dṛśyate' iti| aḥ seryasya so'yamasiḥ, tasyāseḥ| hiśabdo yasyādarthe| yasmāt‌ sakārasya sthāne yasyādaso'kāro bhavati tasya pajḍitairmutvaṃ dṛśyate| na ca kṛtādryādeśasyādasaḥ sakārasya sthāne'tvaṃ bhavati; vibhakteḥ parahasya nimittasyānāvāt‌| tasmāt‌ na tasya mutvena bhavitavyamiti| `yaiḥ' ityādinā ślokasya pūrvārdha vyācaṣṭe| aserati sakārasya pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate-nāsya sirvidyata ityevaṃ vyācakṣāṇaiḥ| `ubhayorapi' iti| adasaḥ, adreśca| `amumuyaṅ‌' ityādi| adoñcatīti ṛtvigityādinā (32.59) sūtreṇāñcateḥ kvin‌, `aniditām‌' (6.4.24) iti nalopaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ, `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌, halṅyādi (6.1.68)saṃyogānta(8.2.23) lopau| ekavacane `kvingratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) iti kutvam‌--nakārasya ṅkāraḥ| anyatra `na ścāpadāntasya jhali' (8.3.24) ityanusvāraḥ, `anusvārasya yapi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58) iti parasavarṇo ñakāraḥ, [`ṅakāraḥ'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] `āsarvanāmnaḥ' (6.3.91) ityataḥ `sarvanāmnaḥ' ityamuvarttamāne `viṣvagdevayīśca ṭeradryañcatau vapratyaye' (6.3.92) ityadaḥ śabdasya ṭeradryādeśaḥ, pūrvasmāddakārāduttarasyotvam‌, dakārasya matvam‌, dvitīyasmādapi dakārādraphasyotvam‌, dakarasya matvam‌--amumuyaṅ‌, amumuyañcāviti bhavati| `yathā' ityādinā latvavadityasthārthamācaṣṭe| `calīklṛpyate' iti| `kṛpū sāmarthye' (dhā.pā.762)| atyantaṃ kalpata iti yaṅ‌, dvirvacanam‌, `urat‌' (7.4.66) ityattvam‌, `halādiḥ śeṣaḥ' (7.4.60), `rīgṛdapadhasya ca' (7.4.90) iti rīk‌, `kuhoścaḥ' (7.4.62) iti cutvam‌, `kupo ro laḥ' (8.2.18) ityubhayorapi latvam‌; `anantyavikāre'ntyasadeśasya' (vyā.pa.63) iti paribhāṣānāśrayaṇāt‌| `ye tu' ityādinā `kecidantyasadeśasya' ityasyārtha kathayanti| `adamuyaṅ‌, adamuyañcau' iti| atrādridakārāderuttarasyotvam‌, adridakārasyaiva ca matvam‌| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat‌| `yeṣāṃ tu'[`teṣāṃ tu'--prā.mu.pāṭhe] ityādinā `eke' ityādervyākhyānam‌| keṣāṃ punastyadādyatvaviṣaya eva mutvena bhavitavyam‌? ye `aḥ seyaṃsya so'yamasistasyāseḥ' ityevaṃ varṇayanti teṣām‌| `atra' iti| adryādeśaviṣaye naiva bhavitavyamiti;tyadādyatvābhāvāt‌| adadryaṅa, adadryāñcau, adadryañcaḥ' iti| pūrvavat‌| mubhāvastu viśeṣaḥ| `amuyā, amuyoḥ' iti| adasastṛtīyaikavacana osi ca paratastyadādyatvam‌, (7.2.102) ṭāp‌, ekādeśaḥ, tasya `antādivacca' (6.1.85) iti pūrvaṃ pratyantavadbhāvo dādudograhaṇenaiva grahaṇam‌| atra yadi dāditi nocyeta tadā `āṅi cāpaḥ' (7.3.105), `osi ca' (7.3.104) iti ṅityetve kṛte tasya cāyādeśe'lontyaparibhāṣayā (1.1.52) yakārasyaivotvaṃ syāt‌| dāditi vacanānna bhavati| uditi taparakaraṇaṃ mukhasukhārtham‌|| 81. eta īdrabahuvacane| (8.2.81) `bahuvacana ityarthavirdeśo'yam‌' iti| anvarthanirdeśa ityarthaḥ| etaduktaṃ bhavati--nedaṃ pāribhāṣikasya bahuvacanasya grahaṇam‌, kiṃ tarhi? anvarthasya grahaṇam‌--bahunāmarthānāmuktiḥ bahuvacanamiti| kiṃ kāraṇamevaṃ vyākhyātam‌? ityāha--`pāribhāṣikasya hi' ityādi| yadi pāribhāṣikasya bahuvacanasyedaṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt‌, amī ityatra na syāt‌| na hyatraikārāt‌ paraṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ bahuvacanamasti| anvarthagrahaṇe tvatrāpi bahunāmaryānāmabhidhānamastīti sidhyati| anvarthagrahaṇaṃ tu vyāptinyāyāllabhyate--eva iti ekārasya sthānivattvaṃ yathā vijñāyeta| `eḥ' ityucyamāne, ikārasyāpi sthānitvamāśaṅkyeta| kiñca syāt‌? adryādeśe kṛte tadavayava syekārasya yaṇādeśo bādhitaḥ syāt‌| īditi takāro mukhasukhārthaḥ|| 82. vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta udāttaḥ| (8.2.82) `vākyagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| asati hi vākyagrahaṇe vākye yāvanti padāni teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva plutaḥ prasajyeta| vākyagrahaṇe tvantyasyaiva bhaviṣyati, nānantyasya| antyasyaiva hi padasya yaṣṭiḥ sa vākyaṭirbhavati, na tvitarasya| tasmādanantyasya padasya plutau mā bhūt‌, antyasyaiva yatā syādityevamartham‌| anantyasya kasmānna bhavati? aniṣṭatvāt‌| na hi padādhikārasya nivṛttiriṣyate, tathā hi prāguktam‌--padādhikāraḥ prāgapadāntādhikārāditi| asatyatvācca; na hi vākyagrahaṇena vākye yāvanti padānti teṣāṃ sarveṣām‌| eka eva hi vākyasya ṭiḥ, sa niyogataḥ padasyāpi bhavati, ato na yuktā vākyasya padādhikāranivṛttyarthatā| atha ṭigrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā'lo'ntyaparibhāṣayaiva (1.1.52) āyuṣmānedhi devadatta3 ityatra ṭeḥ pluto bhaviṣyati? ityatra āha--`ṭigrahaṇam‌' ityādi| asati hi ṭigrahaṇe yathā `hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya' (1.2.47) iti hrasvagrahaṇegha samurtthāpite `acaḥ' (1.2.28) ityetasminnacā prātipadike viśeṣite tasyājantasyaiva hrasvatvaṃ bhavati, nānajantasya--suvāg‌ brāhmaṇakulamiti; tathehāpi plutagrahaṇena `acaḥ' ityetasminnupasthāpite satyacā vākye viśeṣite'jantasyaiva plutaḥ syāt‌, na vyañjanāntasya| ṭigrahaṇe tu sati ṭisaṃjñakenājviśeṣyate, na tvacā ṭisaṃjñakaḥ| yadi hyacā ṭisajñako viśeṣyeta, tato'janto yaṣṭistasya plutaḥ syāt‌; tathā cānarthakaṃ hi ṭigrahaṇaṃ syat‌| vināpi tenācā vākye viśeṣite tasyājantasya pluto bhavannalo'ntyaparibhāṣayā (1.1.52)'ntyasyācaḥ sidhyati| tasmāṭṭigrahaṇasya nānarthakyamiti| ṭisaṃjñakenājviśeṣa,yate--ṭisaṃjñako yo'jiti| evaṃ ca sati vyañjanasyāpi ṭeryo'c‌ tasyāpi plutaḥ sidhyati| `agnici3tta' iti| avyañjanāntasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena--devadatta3 iti| tasmādvyañjanāntasyāpi ṭeracaḥ pluto yathā syādityevamarthaṃ ṭigrahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌| udāttagrahaṇaṃ tu svarāntaranivṛttyartham‌, taccānantodāttaṃ prayojayati; yohyantodāttastatra sthānivadbhāvādevāncodātto bhavati|| 83. pratyabhivāde'śūdre| (8.2.83) `yadabhivādyamāno guruḥ' ityādi| atra sāmānyopakrameṇa viśeṣasyānabhidhānād‌ yaditi napuṃsakaliṅgena nirdeśaḥ| `āyuṣmānedhi devadatta3' iti| idamatrodāharaṇam‌; pratyabhivādavākyatvāt‌| atra `abhivādaye devadatto'ham‌' ityetattu gurorabhivādyamānatāṃ darśayitumupanyastam| abhivādyamāno gururyāmāśiṣaṃ prayuṅkte sa pratyabhivādaḥ| tatrāvaśyaṃ gurorabhivādyamānatā darśayitavyā; anyathā pratyabhivādo na gamyeta| `edhi' iti| bhavetyarthaḥ| `asa bhuvi' (dhā.pā.1065), loṭ‌, madhyamapuruṣaikavacanam‌, `serhyapicca' (3.4.87), dhvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca' (6.4.119) ityettvam‌, `śnasorallopaḥ' (6.4.111) ityakāralopaḥ, `hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ' (6.4.101) iti dhirādeśaḥ| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`sipi dhāto rurvā' (8.2.74) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vetyanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena striyāṃ na bhaviṣyatīti| `asūyake'pi' iti| asūyatītyasūyakaḥ| yo gurumasādhbyā pravṛttyā sāmarṣa karoti sa ucyate'sūyaka iti| `tasmin‌' ityādinā pratiṣedha iṣyamāṇo'pi na vaktavya iti darśayati| yadā hyasāvabhivādayitā'sūyakatvena na nirjñāyate, tadā tenābhivādyo guruḥ pratyabhivādane tasya plutaṃ karotyeva| yadā tu `asūyako'yaṃ māṃ viheḍayitukāmaḥ' ityevaṃ vijñāto bhavati, tadātra pratyabhivādanā nāstyeveti kiṃ pratiṣedhena! kathaṃ punarjñāyate--tatrāsūyakatvena nirjñāte pratyabhivādo nāsti? ityāha--`tathā ca' ityādi| kenāpyavinītenopagamyāvidhinābhiprāyeṇābhivādaye'yaṃ bhoḥ sthālītyevamabhivādite gurustasyāsūyakatvamajñātvā sthāliñśabdo'yamasya saṃjñeti matvā pratyabhivādayan‌ plutaṃ prayuktavān‌--`āyuṣmānedhi sthāli3n‌' iti| atha so'vinīta uktavān‌--naiṣa mama saṃjñā, mayā daṇḍinyāyo vivakṣitaḥ| tato guruḥ plutarahitaṃ pratyabhivādanaṃ kṛtavān‌--`āyuṣmānedhi sthālinniti| punaḥ sa uktavān‌--na na mayā daṇḍinyāyo vivakṣitaḥ, saṃjñā mamaiṣeti; atha sa gururasūyakatvamasya vijñāyonatavān‌--`asūyakastvaṃ jālma, na tvaṃ pratyabhivādamarhasi, bhidyatvaṃ vṛṣala sthālin‌' iti| athābhivādyamāno yadā devadatta kuśalyasi, devadattāyuṣmānedhītyevaṃ pratyabhivādaṃ prayuṅkte tadā kasmāt‌ pluto na bhavati? ityāha--`abhivādanavānye' ityādi| abhivādyate'nenetyabhivādanam‌, abhivādanañca tadvākyañcetyabhivādanavākyam‌| tatra tāvat‌ saṅkorttitaṃ saṃśabditaṃ nāma devadatto'hamityevam‌, gotram‌--vātsyo'hamityevam‌| yadyatra pratyabhivādavākyasyānte-avasāne prayujyate tatrāyaṃ pluta iṣyate| devadatta kuśalyasītyādau tu yadabhivādanavākye saṅkīrtitaṃ nāma devadattaśabdaḥ, tat‌ pratyabhivādanavākyasyādau prayuktam‌, nāvasāne| tasmāt‌ pluto na bhavati| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate? vetyanuvṛtteḥ, vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca, prādhānyādvā| iha hi pradhāne kāryasampratyayāt‌ pradhānasya vākyasyānte varttamānasya ṭeḥ plutena bhavitavyam‌| prādhānyañca padasyārthadvārakam‌| pradhānasyārthasya yadvācakaṃ padaṃ tat‌ pradhānaṃ [`pradhāne'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] cārtho'bhivādayitā, tadanugrahārthatvāt‌ pratyabhivādasya| tathā hyabhivādayituranuguhītāryaṃ guruḥ pratyabhivādaṃ prayuṅakte| tasmādabhivādayitā saṃskāryaḥ, kuśalitā''yuṣmattādīni tasyaiva saṃskārakāṇi| ato'bhivādayitā saṃskāryatvāt‌ pradhānam‌, tasya vācakaṃ padaṃ saṃjñāśabdo gotraśabdaśceti tasyaiva vākyānte varttamānasya ṭeḥ pluto bhavati| yadyapi tiṅantavācyo'rthaḥ sādhyaḥ, na tu tasya sādhyatvamiha prādhānyenāśritam‌, kiṃ tarhi? saṃskārakatvameva, tasmānna tasyāpi prādhānyam‌| `bhorājanyaviśām‌' ityādi| bho iti--svarūpagrahaṇam‌, rājanya iti--kṣatriyanāmnaḥ, viśa iti--vaiśyanāmnaḥ| atra bhoḥśabdasyāprāpte vibhāṣā, asaṃjñāgotraśabdatvāt‌| itareṣāṃ tu prāpte; saṃjñāśabdatvāt‌|| 84. dūrāddhūte ca| (8.2.84) `dūrāt‌' iti| ārāt‌| `dūrāntikebhyo dvitīyā ca' (2.3.35) iti pañcamī| hvānaṃ hūtam‌| bhāve niṣṭhā| dūrādityucyate, dūrañcānavasthitam‌| yavevālasyāpahataṃ prati dūraṃ bhavati tadevotsāhasampannaṃ pratyantikam‌| evaṃ hi kaścit‌ kañcidāha--ya eṣa pārśvataḥ karakastamānayeti| sa āha-utthāya gṛhāṇa, dūraṃ gantuṃ na śakṣyāmīti| ato dūrasyānavasthitatvānna jñāyate--kasyāmavasthāyāṃ plutyā bhavitavyamiti| ata āha--`dūram‌' ityādi| hūtaṃ hvānam‌| tadapekṣaṃ yad‌dūraṃ tadihāśrīyate| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāddhūtāpekṣamiha dūramākṣīyate tasmāt‌ prākṛtāt‌ prakṛtau bhavāt‌ prayatnādyaḥ pratyatnaviśeṣaḥ prākṛtayatnādadhikastasyinnāśrīyamāṇe yatra śabdāhvānaṃ tat‌ śrūyate tad‌dūram| tato na bhavati dūrasyānavasthitatvamitvabhiprāyaḥ| atheha kathaṃ plutaḥ syāt‌--saktūn‌ piva devadatta3 iti? na śabdamātraṃ hūtam‌, api tu śabdaviśedhaḥ, yena parata āgamane niyujyate sa śabdaviśeṣo hūtam‌, na ca tadihāsti? ityata āha--`hūtagrahaṇaṃ ca' ityādi| sambodhanaṃ śabdasādhanaṃ hūtam‌| caśabdastasmādityarthe| tena tatsādhyaṃ sambodhanaṃ lakṣyata iti hūtagrahaṇaṃ sambodhanamātropalakṣaṇaṃ veditavyam‌| ihāyaṃ pluto'pi dūrāt‌ sambodhane vidhīyate; ekaśrutirapi; `ekaśruti dūrāt‌ sambuddhau' (1.2.33) iti; tatraivamekatra prāpnuvatāmanekeṣāṃ bādhāvikalpasamuccayānāmanyatamena bhavitavyam‌, atra na jñāyate--kimetayoḥ samuccayo bhavati? uta vikalpaḥ? āhosvidanyatarasya bādheti? tatparijñānāyāha--`asyāśca' [`asyāṃ ca'--prā.mu. nyāsapāṭhaḥ'] ityādi| bādhayā tāvanna bhavitavyam‌; samānaviṣayatvāt‌| viṣayabhede hi sati bādhyabādhakabhāvo bhavati, tadyathā--`karmaṇyaṇ‌'[`tattathā'--prā.mu.nyāsapāṭhaḥ] (3.2.1), `āto'nupasarge kaḥ' (3.2.3) iti; atra hyekasya viśeṣo viṣayaḥ; aparasya sāmānyamityasti viṣayabhedaḥ| anayostu viśeṣo nāstītyayuktā [`nāstītyuktā--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] bādhā| vikalpo'pyayuktaḥ; asahaprāpteḥ| sahaprāptayorhi vikalpo bhavati, yathā--tacyadādīnām‌| na caikaśrutyapekṣyeha sahaprāptirasti; plutasyāsiddhatvāt‌| tasmātpāriśeṣyāt‌ samādeśa eva bhavati| samāveśaḥ punaratraikasmin‌ vākye pravṛttiḥ, na tvekasminnavayave; diruddhayorekasmin‌ pravṛtterasambhavāt‌| vākyasya tvenekāvayavātmakatvāt‌| ṭeracaḥ plṛto bhavati| avaśiṣṭasya tvekaśrutiriti yujyate samāveśaḥ|| 85. haiheprayoge haihayoḥ| (8.2.85) pūrvasūtreṇa prādhānyād‌ hūyamānasyaiva pluto vihitaḥ| prādhānyaṃ tu tasya tadabhimukhīkaraṇāya vākyaprayogāt‌| ato haihayorna prāpnoti, etadartho'yamārambhaḥ| atha punarhaihayorgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā vināpi tena śrutatvāt‌ tayoreva bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`punaḥ' [`punastvityādi'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| `haiheprayoge' ityucyamāne `vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta udāttaḥ' (8.2.82) ityadhikārādantyayoreva syāt‌, nānantyayoḥ; tayorapi yatā syādityevamarthaṃ punarhaihegrahaṇam‌, haihegrahaṇe prayogagrahaṇaṃ cānarthakayorapi yathā syāt‌| tadā caitāvanarthako yadā''mantritāntam‌| tenaivāmantritārthasyāvagamitatvādarthāntasya dyotyasyābhāvāt‌ tāvanarthakau bhavataḥ| anye tvāhuḥ--nipātasamāhārāvapi tau sto hanta haiha iti| tatrāsati prayogagrahaṇe tayorna syāt‌; lākṣaṇikatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ prayogamātre lākṣaṇikayorapi yathā syādityevamarthaṃ prayogagrahaṇamiti|| 86. guroranṛto'nantyasyāpyaikaikasya prācām‌| (8.2.86) pratyabhivādādiṣu vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta udāttaḥ| sa eva tu ṛkāravarjitasya guroranantyasya pluta ucyate| `avtyasyāpi ṭeḥ' iti| anenāpiśabdaṣṭeḥ tamuccayaṃ karotīti darśayati| yadi hyapiśabdena guroḥ samuccayaḥ kriyate, anantyasyāpi,gurorantyasyāpīti, tadānena gurāvanantye plutaḥ| laghurantyaḥ pūrveṇa pluta eva| tataśca dvayoḥ plutayoḥ śravaṇaṃ yugapat‌ prasajyeta| na ca `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam‌' (6.1.158) iti vacanānna bhaviṣyatīti śakyaṃ vaktum‌; tasmin‌ karttavye plutasyāsiddhatvāt‌| yadā ṭisaṃjñako'piśabdena samuccīyate tadānenaiva sūtreṇāntyasya[sūtreṇānantyasya--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] guroranantyasya ca ṭeḥ pluto vidhīyate| tatraikaikasyeti vacanādyathānantyasya paryāyo na bhavati, tathāntyasyāpīti na bhavati yaugapadyaprasaṅgaḥ| `ekaikagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| yadyekaikagrahaṇaṃ na kriyata, tadā pakṣe yugapadeva sarveṣāṃ prasajyeta| tasmāt‌ paryāyeṇa yathā syādityenamarthamekaikagrahaṇam‌| etacca `yathoddeśaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam‌' (vyā.pa.59) ityāśritya kṛtamiti veditavyam‌| darśanāntare `anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam‌' (6.1.158) ityasyopasthāne sati na plutayordvayoryaugapadyaprasaṅgaḥ| atha prācāmiti kima; yāvataikaikagrahaṇādeva vibhāṣā sidhyet‌? ityata āha--`prācām‌' iti| sarvasya plutasyetyabhiprāyaḥ| ata evāha--`tadanena' ityādi| apāyahetumavimṛśya pravṛttiḥ-sāhasam‌|| 87. omabhyādāne| (8.2.87) `prārambhaḥ' iti| kasya prārambhe? svādhyāyādeḥ|| 88. ye yajñakarmaṇi| (8.2.88) `yejñakarmaṇi' iti| karmaśabdaḥ kriyāvācī| yajñakriyāyāmityarthaḥ| `ye3 yajāmahe' ityatraivāyaṃ pluta iṣyata ityetacca `prācām‌' ityasyānuvṛtteḥ, vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānācca labhyata iti veditavyam‌|| 89. praṇavaṣṭeḥ| (8.2.89) `ka eṣa praṇavo nāma' iti| iha śāstre praṇavasyāparibhāṣitatvālloke cāprasiddhatvāt‌ praśnaḥ| `pādasya vā' [`pādasya celyādinā'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] ityādinā śāstrāntaraparimāṣayā praṇavasvarūpaṃ darśayati| `vāntyamakṣaram‌' iti| svaro'trākṣaraśabdena vivakṣitaḥ| antyatvaṃ punastasyetarasvarāpekṣayaḥ| `upasaṃgṛhya' iti| gṛhītvetyarthaḥ| tadantyamakṣaramādau yasyākṣaraśeṣasya tat‌ tadādi| akṣarañca śeṣañceti [iti--nāsti prā.mu.pāṭhe] samāhāre dvandvaḥ| akṣaraṃ svaraḥ, tasya śeṣaḥ vyañjanam‌, tadāci ca tadakṣaraśeṣañca, tadakṣaraśeṣaṃ yatrāntyāt‌ svarāt‌ paraṃ vyañjanaṃ nāsti tatra sa eva| tadādi tasya bahuvrīheranyapadārthaḥ| vyapadeśivadbhāvena tatrāpi tadādivyapadeśo bhavati| yatrāntyāt‌ svarāt‌ paraṃ vyañjanamasti tatra saha svareṇa vyañjanamanyapadārthaḥ; tadguṇasaṃvijñānasya bahuvrīherihāśritatvāt‌| yo'yamanena granthena ṭisaṃjñaka evokto bhavati tadvyakṣaraśeṣasya lthāne yat‌ trimātranokāram‌, oṅkāraṃ vā vidavāti tat‌ praṇavaṃ kathayanti| `jinvato3m‌' iti| jayateḥ parasya laṭ‌, tasya śatrādeśaḥ, vyatyayena śnupratyayaḥ, yaṇādeśaḥ; jinvanniti sthite'nśabdasyāntyākṣarādeḥ praṇavaḥ| `sumnayo3m‌' iti| sumnaśabdāt‌ kyac‌, `kyācchabdasi' (3.2.170) iti upratyayaḥ, `devasumnayoryajuṣi kāṭhake' (7.4.38) iti ābhāvaḥ, sumnaāyus‌ iti sthite usityasyāntyākṣarādeḥ praṇavaḥ| nanu ca ṭisthānikayoreva trimātrayorokāraukārayoḥ praṇava iti paribhāṣā kṛtā| tatrāntareṇāpi ṭigrahaṇaṃ ṭereva bhaviṣyati, tat‌ kiṃ ṭigrahaṇena? ityata āha--`ṭigrahaṇam‌' ityādi| asatyatra ṭigrahaṇe vyañjanānteṣvalo'ntyaparibhāṣayā'(1.1.52)ntyasyaiva syāt‌| ataṣṭigrahaṇaṃ kriyate--sarvasyaiva ṭeryathā syāditi| `antyasya mā bhūt‌' iti| oṅkārasyānekāltvāt‌ sarvādeśo bhaviṣyatītyokārārthaṃ ṭigrahaṇam‌|| 90. yājyāntaḥ| (8.2.90) ihāntagrahaṇaṃ ṭerityetasya nivarttakaṃ vā syāt‌? viśeṣaṇaṃ vā? pūrvasmin‌ pakṣe'cānte viśeṣite'jantāyā eva yājyāyā plutaḥ syāt‌| itarasmiṃstvantagrahaṇamanarthakam‌, na hyanantyaṣṭiḥ sambhavati; `aco'ntyādi ṭi' (1.1.64) ityasyaiva ṭiśabdarūpaviśaṣasaṃjñāvidhānādityabhiprāyeṇāha--`antagrahaṇaṃ kim‌' iti| itaro'pi viditābhiprāyo'nyadevāntagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayitumāha--`yājyā nāma' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 91. brūhipreṣyaśrauṣaḍvauṣaḍāvahānāmādeḥ| (8.2.91) śrauṣaṭ‌, vauṣaḍiti nipātau; itarāṇi loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanāni| kecittu āvahaśabdo'pi nipāta ityāhuḥ| `preṣya' iti| `īṣu gatau' [divādiṣu `iṣa gatau' ityeva paṭhyate] (dhā.pā.1127), divāditvācchyan‌, upasargākāreṇa saha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| atheha kasmānna bhavati--`āvaha devān‌ yajamānāya' (vā.saṃ.5.12), `āvaha jātavedaḥ' (ā.śrau.sū.1.3.22), `suyajā yaja'? ityāha--`āvaha devān‌' ityādi| ādigrahaṇaṃ vākyādermā bhūditi|| 92. agnītpreṣaṇe parasya ca| (8.2.92) agnimintre ityasminnarthe'gnīṭ‌-ṛtvigviśeṣaḥ, tasya preṣaṇaṃ niyojanamagnītpreṣaṇamityarthaḥ| ādeḥ sannihitatvāt‌ tadapekṣayaiva paro'pi jñāyata ityāha--`tasmādevādeḥ' ityādi| `atraiva' iti| anantarokta udāharaṇadvaya evakāreṇa yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayitumāha--`agnīdagnīn‌ vihara barhistṛṇīhi' iti| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate? ityāha--`tadartham‌' ityādi| yathā ca sarvatra pluto vibhāṣā śakyo vijñātum‌, tathā `guroranṛto'nantyasya' (8.2.86) ityādau sūtre pratipāditam| yadi tarhi sarvatra pluto vibhāṣā vijñāyeta, uttaratra vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanartham‌? na; prapañcārthatvāt‌| atheha kathaṃ plutaḥ--`uddhara3 uddhara, abhihara3 abhihara' iti; svādhyāyakāle hyayaṃplutaḥ, nāgnītpreṣaṇe, na cāyamādeḥ, nāpi `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54), kiṃ tarhi? tato'nyasyaiva? ityata āha-deḥ sannihitatvāt‌ tadapekṣayaiva parorapi jñāyata ityāha--`tasmādevādeḥ' ityādi| `atraiva' iti| anantarokta udāharaṇadvaya evakāreṇa yadvyavacchinnaṃ taddarśayitumāha--`agnīdagnīn‌ vihara barhistṛṇīhi' iti| kathaṃ punaretallabhyate? ityāha--`tadartham‌' ityādi| yathā ca sarvatra pluto vibhāṣā vijñāyeta, uttaratra vibhāṣāgrahaṇamanarthakam‌? na; prapañcārthatvāt‌| atheha kathaṃ plutaḥ--`uddhara3 uddhara, abhihara3 abhiraha' iti; svādhyāyakāle hyayaṃ plutaḥ,
