nāgnītpreṣaṇe, na cāyamādeḥ, nāpi `ādeḥ parasya' (1.1.54), kiṃ tarhi? tato'nyasyaiva? ityata āha--`iha tu' ityādi| vispaṣṭārtham‌|| 93. vibhāṣā pṛṣṭaprativacane heḥ| (8.2.93) `pṛṣṭaprativacanam‌' iti| pṛṣṭasya prativacanam‌-ākhyānaṃ pṛṣṭaprativacanam‌| prativacanaśabdo'yaṃ viruddhe'pi vacane pravarttate--viruddhaṃ vacanaṃ prativacanamiti, pratiśabdo hyatra virodhaṃ dyotayati, yathā--pratimallaḥ, pratigaja iti; vīpsāyāmapi varttate--vacanaṃ vacanaṃ pratīti prativacanam‌, `yathārthe yadavyayam‌' (2.1.6) iti dīpsāyāmavyayobhāvaḥ; samādhāne'pi varttate--yadanenābhihitaṃ tasya mayā prativacanaṃ vihinamiti, samādhirvihita iti gamyate; tatra `prativacane' ityucyamāne sarvatra prasajyeta| tasmāt‌ prativacanaviśeṣārthaṃ pṛṣṭagrahaṇam‌| pṛṣṭasya yat‌ prativacanam‌-arthākhyānaṃ tatraiva yathā syāt‌, anyatra mā bhūditi|| 94. nigṛhyānuyoge ca| (8.2.94) `nigṛhya' iti| lyabantametat‌| `svatāt‌' iti| svāvagamāt‌| `prācyāvanam‌'[`pracyācanam‌'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] iti| apanayanam‌| `āviṣkaraṇam‌' iti| prakāśanam‌| `śrāddham‌' iti| karmaviśeṣaḥ| `evamanuyujyate' iti| evamādiṣkṛtasvamataḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ| cakāro vibhāṣetyasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| tenottaravidhirnityo bhavati|| 95. āmreḍitaṃ bhartsane| (8.2.95) `caura caura3' iti| `vākyāderāmantritasya' (8.1.8) ityādinā bhartsane dvirvacanam‌| yadyapi vākyagrahaṇametadantyasya padasya plutanivṛttyartham‌, tathāpīha vacanasāmarthyādanantyasyāpi bhavati| na hi vākyānte bhartsana āmreḍitaṃ sambhavati, vākyādereva padasya bhartsane dvirvacanavidhānāt‌| `tadartham‌' iti| paryāyeṇa pūrvottarayoḥ padayoryathā syādityevamartham‌; dviruktopalakṣaṇārthañca| āmreḍitasya bhartsanagrahaṇādvijñāyate--tad‌dviruktasya hi yat‌ paraṃ tadāmreḍitam‌| na ca tāvatā bhartsane pravṛttiḥ sambhavati; bhartsanasya dviruktidyotyatvāt‌| tasmād‌dviruktopalakṣaṇārthamāmreḍitagrahaṇaṃ vijñāyate| tad‌dviruktiśca pūrvottaraviṣaye'pīti dvayorapi pluto bhavati| sa ca paryāyeṇa bhavati, na yaugapadyena; bhartsanadyotanaphalatvāt‌ pluteḥ| anyataraplutyaiva ca tadbhartsanasya dyotitatvāt‌|| 96. aṅgayuktaṃ tiṅākāṅkṣam‌| (8.2.96) `ākāṅkṣam‌' iti| ākāṅkṣati apekṣata ityākāṅkṣam‌, pacādyac‌| `aṅga kūja3' ityādi| aṅgakūja 3, aṅga vyāhara 3--ityetadubhayamapi `idānīṃ jñāsyati jālma' ityetadapekṣate| `aṅga devadatta' ityetadapi `midhyā vadasi' ityetat‌| `adhīṣva' ityetadapi `odanaṃ te dāsyāmi' ityetat‌| `naitadaparamākāṅkṣati' iti| vivakṣitārthasya parisamāptatvāt‌| atha yuktagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā padavidhitvādeva yogo vijñāsyate| evaṃ tarhi yuktagrahaṇaṃ kurdannetajjñāpayati--`samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' (2.1.1) ityeṣā paribhāṣā'nityā| tenā'sūryampaśyāni mukhānīti naño'satyapi sūryaśabahdena sāmarthye samāsaḥ siddho bhavati|| 97. vicāryamāṇānām‌| (8.2.97) `pramāṇena vastuparīkṣaṇaṃ vicāraḥ| tena viṣayīkriyamāṇāni vicāryamāṇāni| bahuvacananirdeśo yeṣāmarthagata eva vicāro na svarūpagataḥ, teṣāmapi yathā syādityevamarthaḥ; itarathā hi yeṣāṃ svarūpagato vicārasteṣāmeva syāt‌| na hi mukhye vākye vicāryamāṇe satyarthadvārakaṃ gauṇaṃ yasya vicāryamāṇatvaṃ tasya grahaṇaṃ yuktam‌| `gṛhā3i' iti| gṛha ityatra ekāraḥ, tasya `eco'pragṛhyasya' (8.2.107) ityādinā pūrvārthasyākāraḥ, uttarārdhasya tvikāraḥ| tasyākārasyānena plute bhavati|| 98. pūrvaṃ tu bhāṣāyām‌| (8.2.98) pūrveṇaiva siddhe niyamārthametat‌| tuśabdastviṣṭato'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| asati hi tasmin‌ viparīto'pi niyamo vijñāyeta--bhāṣāyāmeva pūrvamiti| pūrvatvaṃ ca prayogāpekṣam‌| ahirnu3, rajjurnu3--ityetayorvākyāyoryat‌ pūrvaṃ prayujyate tasyaiva ṭeḥ pluto bhavati| iha tu bhāvāgrahaṇāt‌ pūrvayogāśchandasīti vijñāyate|| 99. pratiśravaṇe ca| (8.2.99) pratiśrutiḥ pratiśravaṇam‌| pratipūrvācchṛṇoterbhāve lyuṭ‌, `kugati' (2.2.18) ityādinā tatpuruṣaḥ| pratipūrvasya śaṇotiryadā parānugraho vivakṣyate, tadābhyupagame varttate| atha tvavivakṣā parānugrahasya, tadā pratijñāne| yadā śritiḥ--śravaṇamiti bhāvasādhanena śravaṇaśabdena pratiśabdasya `lakṣaṇenābhipratī ābhimukhye' (2.1.14) ityavyayībhāvaḥ kriyate, tadā śravaṇābhimukhye śravaṇaṃ prati pravṛtta ityarthaḥ| tadiha viśeṣānabhidhānāt‌ sarvasmin‌ pratiśravaṇe vākyasya ṭeḥ pluto bhavati| `devadatta bhoḥ kimāttha3' iti| etacchravaṇābhimukhya udāharaṇam‌| `devatatta bhoḥ' ityāmantritam‌| tapra śravaṇārthamevamāha--`kimāttha3' iti| ekatra śravaṇamuddiśya pravṛttatvādabhimukhaṃ bhavati| abhyupagame tūdāharaṇam‌--`gāṃ me dehi bhoḥ, ahaṃ te dadāmi3' iti| pratijñāne--`nityaḥ śabdo bhavitumarmati' iti| cakāro bhāṣāyāmityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ|| 100. anudāttaṃ praśnāntābhipūjitayoḥ| (8.2.100) agama3' iti| gamerluṅ‌ puvadisūtreṇa (3.1.55) lṛdittvādaṅ‌, sip‌| `agnibhūtā3i' iti, `paṭā3u' iti| sambuddhau parataḥ `hrasvasya guṇaḥ' (7.3.108) iti guṇaḥ, `eco'pragṛhyasya' (8.2.107) ityādinā'kāraḥ, idutau ca| udāharaṇavākye pūrvapadānāmetenaiva plutaḥ, kṛta iti gṛhītvā yaścodayet‌--atha kathamihānantyasyāpi pluto bhavati, yāvatā vākyasya ṭerityanuvarttate iti? taṃ pratyāha--`agnibhūte, paṭo ityetayoḥ' ityādi|| 101. ciditi copamārthe prayujyamāne| (8.2.101) `ciditi' iti| itikaraṇaḥ prayujyamāna ityetacchabdasya viśeṣaṇamityasyārthasya dyotanāva| asati hyetadarthaṃ itikaraṇe hyupamārthe'nyasmin‌ prayujyamāne cicchabdaḥ plavata iti vijñāyeta| tatprajyamānatayātra tasmin‌ viśeṣite vākyasya ṭeḥ plataḥ siddho bhavati| `katathañcidāhaḥ' iti| atra kṛcchre cicchabdo varttate| `agnirmāṇavako bhāyāt‌' iti| agniriva māṇavako dīpyetetyarthaḥ astīhopamārthaḥ, tathāpi cicchabdasya prayogo nāstīti na pluto bhavati| asati tu prayujyamānagrahaṇe ihopamānagatau satyāṃ yadapyanyeṣāmapi sarveṣāmupamānārthānāṃ prayogo gamyate, tathāpi yo'tra cicchabdasya prayogastadāśrayaḥ plutaḥ syādeva| cakārosyaiva plutasya samuccayārthaḥ| samuccayaśca bhedādhiṣṭhāna iti plutānantaramevedamākhyātaṃ bhavati; anyathā pūrvadhveva plutanimitteṣvetasmin‌ viṣaye'nudāttatvamātraṃ vidhīyata iti vijñāyeta|| 102. uparisvidāsīdati ca| (8.2.102) itikaraṇaḥ kāryiṇo nirdeśārthaḥ| kāryaṃ hi vidhātumavaśyaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāsau nirdeṣṭavyaḥ| itikaraṇena veti vārthaḥ pratyavamuśyate| śabdapradhānastvihoparisvidādiśabdaḥ kāryaṃ iṣyata itītikaraṇena nirdiṣṭaḥ pluto yathā vijñāyeta| `adhaḥsvidāsīdityatra' ityādi| atrādhaḥsvidāsīt‌, utoparisvidāsīvityetadvicāryate; tatra pūrvasmin‌ vākye `vicāryamāṇānām‌' (8.2.97) ityādinodāttaḥ plutaḥ, itarasmiṃstvanenānudāttaḥ, tasyaivāpavādaḥ| cakārasya pūrvavadeva prayojanam‌|| 103. svaritamāmreḍite'sūyāsammatikopakutsaneṣu| (8.2.103) asūyādiśabdānāṃ `vākyāderāmantrita' (8.1.8) ityādau sūtre'yaṃ ākhyātaḥ| `māṇavaka3 māṇavaka' ityādau dvirvacanaṃ tenaiva sūtreṇa veditavyam‌| `vāvacanaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| vetyetadvikalpopalakṣaṇam‌| vacanaṃ vyākhyānamityarthaḥ| atraitaduktaṃ bhavati--vikalpavyākhyānaṃ karttavyamiti| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vibhāṣā pṛṣṭapratitivacane heḥ' (8.2.93) ityato maṇḍūkaplutinyāyena vibhāṣāgrahaṇanuvarttate, tena vikalpo bhaviṣyatīti|| 104. kṣiyāśīḥpraiṣeṣu tiṅākāṅkṣam‌| (8.2.104) kṣiyā-ācārabhedaḥ| iṣṭāśaṃsanam‌-āśīḥ| niyogaḥ-praiṣaḥ| ākāṅkṣatyaparaṃ tiṅantameva| kuta etat‌? ākāṅkṣāgrahaṇādeva| subante hi sādhanādāyinī tiṅantasyāvaśyambhāvinī apekṣeti| `dhanaṃ ca tāta' iti| atra lapsīṣṭetyetadapekṣate| `vyākaraṇaṃ ca' iti| atrāpyadhyeṣīṣṭetyetat‌| `lunīhi3' iti| `ī halyadhoḥ' (6.4.113) itītvam‌| `piba' iti| pādhrādisūtreṇa (7.3.78) pibādeśaḥ| `astu' iti| asterloṭ‌, `eruḥ' (3.4.86) ityutvam‌, adāditvācchapo luk‌, etaccāparaṃ tiṅantaṃ nāpekṣate| evaṃ `vihara' ityetadapi|| 105. anantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ| (8.2.105) `antyasya tu' ityādi| tuśabdaḥ padāntarebhyo viśeṣaṃ darśayati| antyasyetyanenāpi svaritaḥ, `anudāttaṃ praśnāntābhipūjitayoḥ' (8.2.100) ityanenāpyanudāttaḥ; tayoścaikatra yaugapadyaṃ na sambhavati| tatra vacanaprāmāṇyādanudātto'pi pakṣe na bhavati, svarito'pi|| 106. plutāvaica iduttau| (8.2.106) `dūrāddhūte ca' (8.2.84) ityevamāvibhirlakṣaṇaiḥ pluto vidhīyamānaḥ `acaśca' (1.2.28) ityasyopasthāne sati yatraiva pluta uktaḥ, tatra tasyaivaicaḥ samudāyātmanaḥ syāt‌, tadavayavayoreveṣyate| sa ca vacanamantareṇa na sidhyatītīdamārabhyate| tasya tu plutasya nimittaṃ dūrāddhūtādevaicaḥ prasaṅga iti pūrveṇa prakaraṇena plutasya prāptau satyāmityarthaḥ| `ai3tikāyan‌, au3pamanyava' iti| atra `guroranṛtīḥ' (8.2.86) ityādinā ecaḥ plute prāpte'nena tadavayavayoridutoḥ plutaḥ kriyate| ai3tikāyana, au3pamanyavetyatra yadyaicoravayavayoridutoḥ plutaḥ kriyate, tatraikārīkārau caturmātrau sārddhatrimātro vā prāpnutaḥ| iha hyaucau samāhāravarṇau; mātrā'varṇasya mātrevarṇovarṇayoḥ| apare tvāhuḥ--ardhamātrā'varṇasya, adhyardhamātrevarṇovarṇayoriti| atra parvasmin‌ darśane'nena plute kṛte sati idutostisro mātrāḥ, avarṇasya caikamātreti catumatriḥ prāpnoti; itaratra tu darśane'varṇasyārdhamātrā, idutīstu tā eva tinna iti sārdhatrimātraḥ prāpnotītyata āha--`atra yadā' ityādi| nanu ca trimātrasya `pluta iti saṃjñā kṛtā, tatkathaṃ dvitrimātrāvapi plṛtau śakyāvanena karttum‌? ityata āha--`plutāvaviti hi' ityādinā| etena laukikasyātra plutasya grahaṇam‌, na pāribhāṣikasyeti darśayati| kutaḥ punaretallabhyate? punaḥ plutagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, loke hi ca pluto vṛddhimānuṣyate| ata evāha--`iduttau vṛddhiṃ gacchata ityarthaḥ' iti| anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ plavatirvṛddhāvapi varttate| nanvevamapyaniyamena vṛddhiḥ prasajyate; iyattānabhidhānāt‌; tataśca yāvatī vṛddhiḥ syāt‌, yāktyā caturmātrārvacau sampadyeyātāmiti? ata [`atrāha'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| plutirvṛddhirityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarayaṃ niyamo labhyate? evaṃ manyate--aica iti plutāpekṣayā ṣaṣṭhī| idutau tathā plavete yathā sa pluta eṅorbhavati; evañcaṃcorbhavati yadi tāvatī vṛddhirbhavati yāvatyā tāvaicau trimātrau sampadyete| akṛtāyāṃ hi vṛddhau aictvameva syāt‌; yuktaparimāṇatvādaicām‌, tataścaicsambandhī pluto na syāditi| `ardhatṛtīyamātrau' iti| ardhatṛtīyaṃ yayormātrayoste'rdhatṛtayamātre, te yayostāvardhatṛtayamātrau| idaṃ tāvadvārttikakāramatamāśritya samādhānamuktam‌| bhāṣyakārasya tviṣṭaiva caturmātratā plutasyeti darśayannāha--`bhāṣye tūktam‌' ityādi| `tatkatham‌' iti| yadi tat‌ bhāvyakārasya mataṃ tat‌ kena prakāreṇa sampadyeta? ityetat‌ pṛcchati| `samparavibhāgapakṣe' ityādinā yathā tat‌ sampadyate tathā darśayati| samapravibhāgapakṣe hyanena sūtreṇedutostrimātraḥ plutaḥ kriyate, tataśca tatsambandhinyo yāsmisro mātrā yā ca pūrvākāramātrā tāḥ sarvāḥ samāhṛtāścatasro mātrā bhavanti| evañca caturmātraḥ pluto bhavati| atra bhāṣyakāradarśane punaḥ plutagrahaṇaṃ sarvatra plutopasaṃgrahārtham‌; anyathā svaritaprakaraṇāt‌ tasyaiva prasaṅge satyevedutorivaṃ plutiḥ syāt‌| punaḥ plutagrahaṇe tūdāttānudāttayorapi bhavati| taparakaraṇaṃ mukhamukhārtham‌|| 107. eco'pragṛhyasyādūrādūdhūte pūrvasyārghasyāduttarasyedutau| (8.2.107) ecaḥ samāhāravarṇāḥ tatra ekārasya okārasya ca pūrveṇa prakaraṇena samudāyasyaiṣa plutaḥ, ecoḥ punaravayavayoridutoḥ| anantarasūtreṇedamārabhyate `viṣayaparigaṇanaṃ karttavyam‌' iti| etadgrahaṇavākyam‌| asya `praśnāntābhipūjita' ityādinā vivaraṇaṃ karoti `karttavyam‌' [vaktavyam‌--kāśikā] iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`anudāttaṃ praśnāntābhipūjitayoḥ' (8.2.100) ityādayo yogā ihānuvarttante, tenānyatra na bhavati| `yathāviṣayam‌' iti| yo yasya viṣayo yathāviṣayam‌--`yathā'sādṛśye' (2.1.7) ityavyayībhāvaḥ, `praśnāntābhipūjitayoḥ' (8.2.100) anudāttaḥ plutaḥ| praśne tu `anantyasyāpi praśnākhyānayoḥ' (8.2.105) iti svaritaḥ, śeṣepūdāttaḥ| `itutau punarudāttāvetau' iti| `ṭerudāttaḥ' (8.2.82) iti cādhikārāt‌| `viṣṇubhūte viṣṇubhūte3' iti| atra `āmreḍitaṃ bhartsane' (8.2.95) iti plutaḥ| `āgaccha bho māṇavaka viṣṇubhūte3' iti| atra `dūrādghate ca' (8.2.84) iti| nanu cāsatyapi parigaṇane naiva plutaḥ prāpnoti; `adūrāddhate' iti vacanāt‌, tatkimarthamidaṃ parigaṇanasya pratyudāharaṇityāha--`parigaṇane ca' ityādi| asati parigaṇane, adūrāddhūta [`adūrāddhūtena bhaviṣyatīti' ityeva--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] ityucyate| asmiṃstu satyetanna vaktavyam‌| parigaṇanādeva hi dūrāddhūte na bhaviṣyatīti| `karttavyam‌' iti| vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`yājyāntaḥ' (8.2.90) ityato'ntagrahaṇamanuvarttate, tenāntasyaiva bhaviṣyatīti| `bhadraṃ karoṣi gauḥ' iti| `abhipūjite' (8.2.100) iti plutaḥ| antagrahaṇānuvṛtteratrāyaṃ vidhirna bhavati, na hyatraitacchabdo'śte, kiṃ tarhi? vyañjanam‌| `śobhane khal‌ staḥ khaṭve3' iti| atrāpi `abhipūjite' (8.2.100) ityeva plutaḥ| `āmantrite `ca' [`ca' nāsti--kāśikā padamañjarī ca] ityādi| plutaścāsau vikāraśceti plutavikāraḥ| plutavyapadeśastvidutoḥ plutasāhacaryāddheditavyaḥ| idutorgrahaṇamaicaḥ pūrvasyottarasya caita ādeśā mā bhūvannityevamartham‌| taparakaraṇamihāpi mukhasukhārtham‌|| 108. tayoyarvāvaci saṃhitāyām‌| (8.2.108) `tayoḥ' iti| anantaravihitāvidutau pratyavamṛśyete| `agnā3yāśā, paṭā3vāśā' iti| agne āśā, paṭo āśā iti sthite `pradnāntābhipūjitadicāryamāṇapratyabhivākhyājyānteṣu' (vā.932) ityeteṣāmanyatamasmin‌ vivakṣite, ecaḥ pūrvasyārthasyākāraḥ plutaḥ, uttarasyārthasyedutau, tayoranena yvau| kimarthaṃ punaretadārabhyate? etau `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityeva sidhyata? ityata āha--`idutorasiddhatvāt‌' ityādi| nanu ca siddhā plutaḥ svarasandhiṣu| yaṇādeśādiṣu yadayam‌ `plutapragṛhyā aci' (6.1.125) iti plutasya prakṛtibhāvamāha; sato hi kāryema bhavitavyam‌, nāsataḥ; plutasya cekaḥ, atastāvapi svaramandhiṣu siddhāveṣa? ityata āha--`athāpi' ityādi| yadīdaṃ nocyeta, tadā `agnā3 i indram‌, paṭā3 u udakam‌ ti sthite ṣāṣṭhikaṃ yaṇādeśaṃ bādhitvā'kaḥ savarṇe dīrghatvaṃ (6.1.101) syāt‌| iha cāgnā3 iti āśā iti sthite `iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca' (6.1.127) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ syāt‌| tasmādyathānayoḥ siddhatvaṃ syāt‌, tathāpi dīrghatvaṃ śākalaviṣiśca mā bhūdityevamarthamidaṃ vaktavyameva| nanu cānyadeva tannivṛttyartha yatnāntaramasti, kiṃ punastaditi cet‌? ucyate; `śko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityatropasaṃkhyāyate--`ikaḥ plutapūrvasya yaṇādeśo vaktavyaḥ śākaladīrghanivṛttyartham‌' (vā.673) iti| tasyopasaṃkhyānamavaśyaṃ karttavyam‌| ya ik‌ bhoḥśabdasya plutaḥ| atra bhoḥśabdāt‌ para ikāro nipātaḥ, na plutavikāraḥ| tasya yaṇādeśa iṣyate, so'sati tasminnupasaṃkhyāne na syāt‌| tasmādavaśyaṃ tat‌ karttavyam‌| yasmiṃśca kriyamāṇe plutavikārayorapīdutostenaiva bhavitavyam‌, tato nedaṃ vaktavyamityata āha--`tathāpi' ityādi| agnā3 iti āśā iti sthite yadi tena ṣāṣṭhikopasaṃkhakyānena yaṇādeśa ihodāttalyekārasya sthāne kriyeta, tasyodāttayaṇsvare karttavye siddhatvādāśāśabdākārasyānudāttasya `udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya' (8.2.4) iti svaritaḥ prasajyeta| āśāśabdaḥ `āśāyā adigākhyā cet‌' (phi.sū.1-18) ityantodāttaḥ| śeṣamapi `anudāttam‌' (6.1.158) ityākāro'nudāttaḥ| tasmādasti svaritatvaparasaṅga iti tannivṛttyarthamidamucyate| `kinta yaṇā' ityādi| saṃgrahaślokadvayam‌| kimiti praśne| tu iti vitarke| `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) iti yaṇādeśena kiṃ na siddhaṃ bhavatīhāgnā3 yāśetyevamādāvudāharaṇe yadācārya idutīryvau vidadhāti! sarvameva siddhamityabhiprāyaḥ| syādetat‌--yaṇādeśo na prāpnoti, tasmin‌ karttavye idutorasiddhatvādityata āha--`tau ca' ityādi| tuśabdo hetau| yadā ik‌ plutapūrvo bhavati tadā tasya syāt‌| tasmāt‌ `ikaḥ plutapūrvasya yaṇādeśo vaktavyaḥ śākaladīrghanivṛttyartham‌' (vā.673) ityupasaṃkhyāne yaṇādeśamapavādaṃ karoti śākaladorghavidhyoḥ| tena hetunā tayoridutoḥ śākaladīrghavidhī na bhaviṣyataḥ| caśabdaḥ samuccaye; bhinnakramaśca pratiṣedhānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| `tau ca mama svarasandhiṣu siddhau'| na ca śākaladīrghavidhī prayojayataḥ| evamapavādaḥ| teṣāṃ śākaladīrghanivṛtteḥ prayojanatve prayojanāntaramāha--`yaṇasvarabādhanameva tu hetuḥ' iti| yaṇādeśāśrayaḥ svaro yaṇasvaraḥ, tasya bādhanaṃ hetuḥ kāraṇam‌| kasya? prakaraṇāt‌ sūtārambhasyaiti gamyate| tuśabdo'vadhāraṇe| yaṇsvabādhanameva tu sūtrārambhasya heturityarthaḥ|| iti bodhisattvadeśīyācārya śrījinendrabuddhipādaviracitāyāṃ kāśikāvivaraṇapañjikāyāmaṣṭamādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ <8.3> athāṣṭamā'dhyāyaḥ tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ 1. matuvaso ru sambuddhau chandasi| (8.3.1) `yudhoḥ' (7.1.1) ityatra dveṣyaparīhārāyoktaṃ tat‌ `matuvasoḥ' ityatrāpi draṣṭavyam‌| `indramarutva' iti| marucchabdānmatup‌, `jhayaḥ' (8.2.10) iti yatvam‌, `ugidacām‌' (7.1.70) iti num‌, halṅyādi (6.1.68) saṃyogānta (8.2.23) lopau, nakārasya rutvam‌, tasya `bhobhago' (8.3.17) ityādinā yakāraḥ, tasyāpi `lopaḥ śākalyasya' (8.3.19) iti lopaḥ| `hariṣo medinaṃ tvā' iti| hariśabdānmatup‌, `chandasīraḥ' (8.2.15) iti vatvam‌, pūrvavannumādi| ayaṃ tvatra viśeṣaḥ--`haśi ca' (6.1.114) iti rorutvam‌, pūrveṇa sa ha `ādguṇaḥ' (6.1.87)| `mīḍhvastokāya' iti| `miha secane' (dhā.pā.992) liṭaḥ kvasuḥ, `dāśvān‌ sahvān‌ mīḍhvāṃśca' (6.1.12) ityadvitvam‌, aniṭtvam‌ upadhādīrghatvañca nipātyate, `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌, rorvisarjanīye kṛte tasya `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.3.34) ti sakāraḥ| śatrādeśasya vasoḥ sambuddhau chandasi diṣaye prayogo nāstīti tasyānudāharam‌| ata eva `ekānubandhakagrahaṇe na dvyanubandhakasya' (vyā.pa.52) ityeṣā paribhāṣā nopatiṣṭhate; ekānubandhakasya sambuddhiparasya cchandasi vasoḥ prayogādarśasāt‌| `vidvān‌' iti| `videḥ śaturvasuḥ' (7.1.36)| `he papivan‌' iti| pāteḥ pibatervā parasya kvasoḥ `vasvekājādghasām‌' (7.2.67) itīṭ‌, `āto lopa iṭi ca' (6.4.64) ityākāralopaḥ sthānivadbhāvād‌dvirvacanam‌| `vana upasaṃkhyānam‌' iti| ananubandhakasya vano'sambavātsāmānyena kvanibbaniporgrahaṇam‌| yaśca matvarthe `kvanibvanipau chandasi vaktavyau' (vā.582?) ityaupasaṃkhyānikaḥ, tasyāpi grahaṇam‌| `prātaritva' iti| `iṇ‌ gatau' (dhā.pā.1045) prātāpūrvaḥ, āto maninkvanibdhanipaśca' (3.2.74) ityanuvarttamāne `anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' (3.2.75) iti kvanip‌, `hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk‌' (6.1.71)| idaṃ tu sampadāditvādinā kvipi tuki tadantanmatupi `jhayaḥ' (8.2.10) iti vatve matvantādeva sidhyatīti nopasaṃkhyānaṃ prayojayati| `vibhāṣā' ityādi| bhavacchabdaḥ `bhāterḍavatuḥ' [`bhāterḍavatup‌'--paṃ.u.1-64] iti ḍavatupratyayānto vyutpāditaḥ| avyutpannaṃ vokārānubandhaṃ prātipadikam‌; itarau tu matvantau| `he bhoḥ' iti| numo rutve kṛte'vaśabdasya sarvasyaiva sthāna okāraḥ kriyate, nālo'ntyasya, `nānrthake'lontyavidhiḥ' (vyā.pa.62) iti kṛtvā| `nupātavijñānāt‌ siddham‌' iti| etadgrahaṇakavākyam‌| `atha vā' iti| asyaiva vivaraṇam‌| `asambaddhāvapi' ityādi| etena nipātatve hetuṃ darśayati| yadyupasaṃkhyānādeva bho ityevamādikaṃ syāt‌, dvivacanabahuvacanayorna syāt‌; sambuddhyabhāvāt‌| striyāñca sambuddhāvapi na syāt‌--bho brāhmaṇīti; atra strīliṅgaviśiṣṭānāmanupādānāt‌| `prātipadikagrahaṇe liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāpi grahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.29) iti cet‌, na; vibhkatau tatpratiṣedhāt‌--vibhaktau yatkāryaṃ viṣīyate tatreyaṃ paribhāṣā pratiṣidhyate; `vibhaktau liṅgaviśiṣṭasyāgrahaṇam‌' (vyā.pa.30) iti vacanāt‌| athāpi na pratiṣidhyate? evamapi bhavatīti sthite ikārasya[`īkārasya'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] rutve kṛte'vaśabdasya caukāre kṛte rutvasyāsiddhatvāt‌ saṃyogāntalopābhāve sati visarjanīye kṛteniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ syāt‌| tasmādasambuddhau, striyāñca darśanānnipātā evaite veditavyāḥ| nipātatvaṃ punareṣāṃ vibhaktipratirūpakatvāt‌, `vibhaktisvarapratirūpakāśca' (ga.sū.16) iti cādiṣu pāṭhāt‌| pavañca bhoḥ śabdasya nipātatvaṃ syāt‌; bhavatervici kṛte guṇe ca vibhaktyante bhoḥśabdasyaiva vidyamānatvāt‌, itarayostu na syāt‌| na hyasatyasmiśupasaṃkhyāne bhagośabdaḥ, aghoḥśabdasca vibhaktyanto'sti, yatpratirūpakau nipātau syātām‌| tasmāt‌ sautrā evaite nipātā veditavyāḥ; `bhobhagoadhoapūrvasya' (8.3.17) ityatra sūtre eṣāṃ pāṭhāt‌| atha vā--upasargavibhaktitvarapratirūpakāśceti cakārasyānuktasamuccayārthatvānnipātatvameṣāṃ veditvayam‌| yadi tarhi nipātatvameṣāmāśrityopasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyākhyāyate, tadā bhoḥśabdaprayoge samostatobhostatrabho ityatra `itarābhyo'pi dṛśyante' (5.3.14) ti bhavadādiyoge vidhīyamānāstasilādayo na sidhyanti? aniṣṭasvādadoṣaḥ| yo hi nipātatvādupasaṃkhyānaṃ pratyācaṣṭe sa bhoḥśabdaprayoge tasilādīnnecchatyeva|| 2. atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu vā| (8.3.2) pūrvatvamidamāpekṣikam‌, ruścehānuvarttate| na ca tadapekṣaṃ pūrvatvamasya vijñāttuṃ śakyate; ita uttaraṃ hyanunāsiko ruśca samanuvṛtterekakālaṃ vidhauyata ityanunāsikavidhānakāle roraniṣpannatvam‌| atastadapekṣayā pūrvatvamidamaśakyaṃ vijñātum‌| tasmādyasya sthāne rutvaṃ vidhīyate tadapekṣayā pūrvatvaṃ vijñāyate, ityāha--`yasya sthāne rurvidhīyate tataḥ pūrvasya' iti| tuśabdaḥ parasmāta kāryiṇaḥ pūrvasya viśeṣaṃ darśayati| parasya rutvakāryam‌, pūrvasya tvanunāsika iti| atha vā--rutvādananāsikasya viśeṣaṃ darśayati| rutvaṃ nityam‌ anunāsikastu vibhāṣeti| achāckadkagaṇaṃ kimartham‌? atra ruprakaraṇe yathā syāditi cenna; adhikārādevaitat‌ siddham‌| yathā hi `anunāsikaḥ pūrvasya' ityadhikṛtamuttaratrānuvarttate, tathā rurityetadapi| tatrāntareṇāpyatreti vacanaṃ ruprakaraṇe bhaviṣyatītyata āha--`atra' ityāgadi| sanniyogaḥ--yaugapadyam‌| yaugapadyam‌| ruṇā saha kathaṃ nāma sa pratīyetetyevamarthamatragrahaṇam‌| avadhāraṇañcātra draṣṭavyam‌--ruṇaiveti| sanniyogamātraṃ hi rutvānunāsikayoḥ; uttaratra dvayorapyanuvṛtteḥ| sthāniūbhedena virodhābhāvādvināpyatragrahaṇena labhyata eva| nanu ruprakaraṇādūrdhvamanunāsikasyāsvaritatvādeva sanniyogo na vijñāsyate, tatkiṃ tadarthenātragrahaṇena? ityata āha--`adhikāraparimāṇāparigrahe hi' ityādi| adhikārasya parimāṇamiyattā, tasya parigrahaḥ-parijñānam‌, niścayaḥ| tasminnasati mandadhībhiḥ pratipattṛbhiḥ kimuttaratrānunāsikasya svaritatvamasti? ahosvinnāsti? iti jātasandehaiḥ `ḍhoḍhe lopaḥ' (8.3.13) ityādāvapi yasya sthāne ḍhalopadikāryaṃ vidhīyate tasmāt‌ pūrvasyānunāsika āśaṅkyeta| atha vāgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatottarasūtre nityagrahaṇādeva vikalpo'sya vijñāsyate? naitadasti; evaṃ hi pūrvasatre vikalpo vijñāyeta| tasmādveti vaktavyam‌? na vaktavyam‌; ācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati--vikalpenāyaṃ vidhirbhavatīti, yadayamuttarasūtre yasyānunāsiko na kṛtastasmādroḥ pūrvasmāt‌ paramanusvārāgamaṃ śāsti| na hi nitye'smin‌ vidhau tat‌ sambhavati, roḥ pūrvasya yasyānunāsiko na kṛta iti| evaṃ tarhi vispaṣṭārthaṃ vāgrahaṇam‌|| 3. āto'ṭi nityam‌| (8.3.3) `devaṃ acchādīvyat‌' iti| atra yo'kārastasminnaṭi parato `dūrghādadi samānapāde' (8.3.9) iti na kārasya rutve kṛte tasmāt‌ pūrvasyākārasyānenānunāsikatvam‌, pūrvavadroryakāraḥ, tasya pūrvadeva lopaḥ| yadi mahāṃ indro ma ojaseti `kecidanusvāramadhīyate' iti vaktavyam‌, tarhi tadyathāsau sidhyatītyata āha--`saḥ' ityādi| vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) ityanena boddhavyaḥ| `yo vā vanaspatīṃ ranu' iti| vanaspatīn‌ anviti sthite `dīrghādaṭi samānapāde' (8.3.9) iti nakārasya rutve kṛte `anunāsikāt‌ paro'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.4) itīkārāt‌ paro'nusvāraḥ `bhavāṃśascarati' iti| `naśchavyapraśāt‌' (8.3.7) iti nakārasya rutvam‌, tasya visarjanīyasya sakāraḥ, tasya `stoḥ ścunā ścuḥ' (8.4.40) iti ścutvam‌| nityagrahaṇaṃ vispaṣṭārtham‌|[`spaṣṭārtham‌'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] pūrveṇaiva vikalpe siddhe satyārambhasāmarthyādeva nityo'yaṃ vidhirvijñāsyate| nanu cāta evāṭi, atha vā'ṭyevātaḥ--ityeva niyamo yathā syādityevamarthaḥ siddhe satyārambhaḥ syāt‌? naitadasti; asati hi vidheye niyamo bhavati| iha tvasti videyam‌, kiṃ tat‌? nityo'nunāsikaḥ| tasmādvidhireva yuktaḥ; na niyamaḥ| tathā coktam‌--`vidhiniyamasambhave vidhireva vyāyān‌' (vyā.pa.130) iti| `ātaḥ' iti takāro'sabdehārthaḥ| `ā ityucyamāne sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimarthaṃ ṣaṣṭhyantasyākārasya kāryino nirdeśaḥ? uttādeśāntasya pthamāntasya? iti|| 4. anunāsikāt‌ pora'nusvāraḥ| (8.3.4) `anyaśabdo'trādhyāhāryaḥ' iti| asati hyanyaśabdasyādhyāhare paraśabdasya dhutatvāt‌ tadapekṣayaivānunāsikādityeṣā pañcamī syāt‌; anyasyeha pañcamīhetorasambhavāt‌| nanu `tasmādityuttarasya' (1.1.67) upasthāne uttaraśabdāpekṣayaiva pañcamau syāt‌? naitadasti; yadi hyalyāḥ paribhāṣāyā ihopasthānaṃ syāt‌ paragrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| tasmāt‌ paraśabdāpekṣayaiva pañcamyā bhavitavyam‌| sā bhavantī ca `anyārāditarartte' (2.3.29) ityādivā sūtreṇa paraśabdayoge digbṛttigā vā syāt‌, anyārthavṛttinā vā? tatra pūrvasmin‌ pakṣe roḥ pūrvasmādanunāsikādeva paro'nusvāro vijñāyeta, na ca tasmāt‌ para iṣyate| itarasmiṃstvayamarthaṃ āpadyeta--anunāsikāt‌ paro bhavatadi, anunāsikādanyo'nuscāro bhavatītyarthaḥ| evañca paragrahaṇanarthakaṃ syāt‌; na hyanunāsikāpekṣayānusvaro'nyatvaṃ vyabhirati| kiñca--śrutatvāt‌ tasyaivānunāsikasyānusvāro vijñāyeta, prakṛtattvādrorvāḥ; aniṣṭañcaitat‌ anyaśabdādhyāhāre tu vasyānunāsiko na kṛtasyasmādeva para iti vijñāyate| tasmādanyaśabdo'trādhyāhāryaḥ| satyapyanyaśabdādhyāhāre tu yasyānunāsiko na kṛtasyasmādeva para iti vijñāyate| tasmādanyaśabdo'trādhyāhāryaḥ| satyapyanyaśābdādhyāhāre yadi paraśabdāpekṣayaiva `anunāsikāt‌' ityeṣā pañcamī syāt‌, sa doṣastadavastha eva syāditi matvā''ha--`tadapekṣayā ceyam‌' ityādi| caśabdo'vadhāraṇe| anyaśabdāpekṣayaiva, na paraśabhdāpekṣayetyarthaḥ| `anunāsikadanyo yaḥ' ityanena tadevānyaśabdāpekṣatvaṃ pañcamyā darśayati| `roḥ pūrvaḥ' ityanenāpi pūrvagrahaṇānuvṛttim‌| pūrvatvañca rutvāpekṣam‌| `yasyānunāsiko na kṛtaḥ' ityanenāpyanyaśabdābhidheyamarthaṃ darśayati| `tataḥ' ityanenāpi pūrvagrahaṇasyārthādiha pañcamyantatayā vipariṇaāmam‌| anyaśabdasya cāvyāhṛtasya pañcamyantatāṃ para ityanenāpi| tasyā anyaśabdasya sambandhinyāḥ pañcamyāḥ paraśabdāpekṣatām‌| `āgamaḥ' ityanenāpyādeśābhāvam‌| paragrahaṇaṃ śakyamakartum‌| anyaśabdasya pañcamyantasyādhyāhare sati pūrvagrahaṇasya cārthāt‌ prathamāntatayā vipariṇāme satyevaṃ vijñāsyate--anunāsikādyo'nyastasmāduttaro yo rustataḥ pūrvo'nusvārāgamo bhavati| evañca vijñāyamāne'satyapi paragrahayaṇe saṃskarttetyādi sidhyatyeva, kiṃ paragrahaṇena? etat‌ kriyate vispaṣṭārtham‌|| 5. samaḥ suṭi| (8.3.5) `mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.23) ityanusvāre prāpte vacanam‌| `sam̐skartā'[`saṃskarteti'--nyāse, padamañjaryāṃ ca mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ] ityādi| karoteḥ sampūrvāt‌ tṛjādayaḥ, `samparyupebhyaḥ karotau bhūṣaṇe' (6.1.137) (iti) suṭ‌, samo makārasya `alo'ntasya' (1.1.52) ityanena rutve tataḥ pūrvasyānunāsikaḥ, rorvisarjanīyaḥ| tasya `vā śari' (8.3.36) iti vikalpena sakāre prāpte visarjanīye ca yathā nityaṃ sakāro bhavati, tathā vṛttau darśitam‌| kathaṃ punarasmin‌ sūtre sakāro nirddiśyate? ityāha--`samaḥ ssuṭi' ityādi| yasmin‌ pakṣe vibhaktisakārasya visarjanīye kṛte `vā śari' (8.3.36) iti sakāro na kriyate, saṃ pakṣamāśrityedamuktam‌; anyathā hi trisakārako'yaṃ nirdeśa iti vaktavyaṃ syāt‌; trayāṇāṃ sakārāṇāṃ sannipātāt‌| eko hi vibhaktisambandhī sakāraḥ, dvitīyastvādeśasambandhī, tṛtīyaḥ suṭasambandhī| yadā tu trisakāraṃ kṛtvā sūtraṃ paṭhyate, tadā dviśabdo'dhikasakāropalaṇārtho draṣṭavyaḥ| yadi tarhi sakāra ādeśo vidhīyate, `saṃskarttā' ityatrānunāsiko na prāpnoti; yasmādatrātragrahaṇaṃ ruṇaiva saha sanniyogapratipattyarthamuktam‌| rugrahaṇasyāsmin‌ prakaraṇe yadvidhīyate tadupalakṣaṇārthatvādadoṣaḥ| `ruṇā saha' iti| ruprakaraṇe yadvidhīyate tena sahetyarthaḥ| yadapi pūrvasmin‌ sūtre vṛtto `roḥ pūrvaḥ' ityuktam‌, tatrāpi rugrahaṇasyāsmin‌ prakaraṇe yadvidhīyate tadupalakṣaṇārthaṃ veditavyam‌; anyathā hi `saṃskartā' iti pakṣe'nusvāro na syāt‌|| 6. pumaḥ svayyampare| (8.3.6) `pumaḥ' iti| puṃsaḥ sakārādavaśiṣṭo yo bhāgastasyāyaṃ nirdaśaḥ, sakārasya saṃyogāntalope kṛte tasyaiva kāryitvāt‌| `ampare' iti| am‌ paro yasmāt‌ sa tathoktaḥ| amiti pratyāhārasya grahaṇam‌, na dvitīyaikavacanasya| kuta etat‌? vyāptinyāyāt‌ `khayi' iti pratyāhāreṇa sāhacaryācca| `puṃścalī' iti| calaḍiti pacādau paṭhyate| tena `cala kampane' (dhā.pā.832) ityasmāt‌ pacādyac‌ ṭidbhavati, `ṭiḍḍhaṇañ‌' (4.1.15) iti ṅīp‌| puṃścalīti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `puṃskāmā' iti| puṃsi kāmo'syā iti bahuvrīhiḥ| atha vā--pumāṃsaṃ kāmayata iti `śīlikāmibhikṣācaribhyo ṇo vaktavyaḥ' (vā.229) iti ṇaḥ; tataṣṭāp‌| atra puṃskāmetyatrodāharaṇe| `sakāra evādeśaḥ' iti| visarjanīyasyetyapekṣate| `vaktavyaḥ' iti| vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`kupvoḥ ka pau ca' (8.3.37) ityatra `vā śari' (8.3.36) ityato vāgrahaṇamanuvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā| tenātrāpi visarjanīyasya sakāra eva bhaviṣyati, na visarjanīyajihvāmūlīyāviti| idaṃ tāvat‌ pūrvasūtre yadā dvisakārapakṣo nāśrīyate, tadā pratividhānamuktam‌| yadā tu tatra `dvisakārako nirdeśaḥ' ityeṣa pakṣa āśrīyate, tadā pratividhātumāha--`dvisakārakanirdeśapakṣe tu' ityādi| nanu ca rurapyanuvarattata eva, tatra yathā sakāro'nuvarttamāno bhavati tathā rurapi pakṣe syāt‌, tataśca rutvapakṣe visarjanīye kṛte jihvāmūloyaḥ syādeva? ityata āha--`rutvaṃ tvanuvarttamānam‌' ityādi| tatraiva kāraṇamāha--`sambandhānuvṛttistasya' ityādi| itikaraṇo hetau, sa hi `matuvaso ru sambuddhau' (8.3.1) ityataḥ svena sambandhinā matupā vasunā ca sambaddha ihānuvarttate| tasmānnotsahate sambandhyantareṇa sambandhamanubhavitum‌| `puṃdāsaḥ' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ--puṃso dāsa iti| karmadhārayo vā| evaṃ `pugavaḥ' iti| atra tu `gorataddhitaluki' (5.4.92) iti ṭac‌ samāsāntaḥ| `puṃkṣīram‌, puṃkṣuram‌' iti| ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ| `khayyami' iti| vaktavye paraghaṇaṃ viparītakalpanānirāsārtham‌| asati paragrahaṇe--ami khayi para iti vijñāyeta, tataśca `pumākhyaḥ, pumācāraḥ' ityatrāpi syāt‌| ataḥ paragrahaṇam‌|| 7. naśchavyapraśān‌| (8.3.7) `sa' iti| nivṛttam‌, rurevānuvarttate; so'pi matuvasubhyāmasambaddha eva; tayorapi nivṛttatvāt‌| `na' iti varṇagrahaṇam‌, tacca prakṛtasya padasya viśeṣaṇam‌, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatītyāha--`nakārāntasya padasya' ityādi| `bhavāṃśchādayati' iti| `jhada apavāraṇe' (dhā.pā.1833), curādiṇic‌| `bhavāṃṣṭīkate' iti| `ṭikṛ ṭīkṛ radhi laghi gatyarthāḥ' (dhā.pā.103,104,107,108)| anudāttattvādātmanepadam‌| `praśān‌' iti| prapūrvācchameḥ kvip‌ `anunāsikasya vivajhaloḥ kṅiti' (6.4.15) iti dīrghaḥ, `mo no dhātoḥ' (8.2.64) iti makārasya nakāraḥ, tasyāsiddhatvānnalopābhāvaḥ| `bhavān‌ tsarukaḥ' iti| tsarau kuśalaḥ, `ākarṣādibhyaḥ kan‌' (5.2.64) iti kanpratyayaḥ|| 8. ubhayatharkṣu| (8.3.8) pūrveṇa nitye prāpte vikalpārtha vacanam‌|| 9. dīrghādaṭi samānapāde| (8.3.9) `samānapāde' iti| karmadhārayāt‌ saptamī| samānaśabdaścāyamekārthe varttamā iha gṛhyate| samāne-ekasmin‌ pāde nimittanimittanorādhārabhata ityarthaḥ| tatraikagrahaṇe karttavye kvacidasamānapāde'pi yathā syāditi samānagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam‌| tenehāpi rurbhavati--yajāmahai yajñiyā indradevāṃ ilāmahai īkṣāṃ anājyaiti| atra bhinnayoḥ pādayornimittanimittinau varttate| atha vā--sādṛśye varttamānaḥ samānaśabdo gṛhyate, anyathā hyekagrahaṇaṃ kuryāt‌| iha ca sādṛśyamubhayorasti pādayoḥ, kriyāpadayostulyārthatvāt‌| yathā yajāmahāyityetat‌, kriyāpadaṃ pūjāyāṃ varttate, tathelāmahāyityetadapi| `īḍa stutau' (dhā.pā.1019), loṭ‌, ṭeretttavam‌, `vaito'nyatra' (3.4.96) itīkārasyaikārahaḥ| dhātorvarṇavyatyayena ḍakārasya lakāraḥ| chāndasatvād‌ hrasvatvam‌|| 10. nṛnpe| (8.3.10) `nṝn‌' iti| `supāṃ suluk‌' (7.1.39) ityādinā ṣaṣṭhyā lukaṃ kṛtva nirdeśaḥ| atha vā-- vibhaktirevātra notpadyate, anukāryānukaraṇayorbhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt‌| yathā-gavityayamāhetyādi| `pe' iti pakāramātrameva nimittatvenopāttam‌; na samudāyaḥ| akārastūccāraṇārthaḥ, anyathā hi yadyakārasamudāyo nimittatyenāśrīyate, tadā nṝḥ pacatītyevamādāveva syāt‌, na tu nṝn‌ prīṇīhītyādau| `aṭi' iti ceha nivṛttam‌; nimittāntaro pādānāt‌| atha tasyaiva nimittasyaitadviśeṣaṇaṃ kasmānna vijñāyate--aṭi parato yaḥ pakāra iti? aśakyamevaṃ vijñātum‌; iha na syāt‌--nṝḥ psāti, nṝḥ plāvayatīti| tasmādasya nivṛttiraṅgrahaṇasya yuktā|| 11. svatavānpāyau| (8.3.11) svatavāniti pūrvavannirdeśau veditavyaḥ| tathā `kān‌' (8.3.12) iti parasūtre'pi| `svatavāḥ, pāyuragne' iti| `dṛksvaḥsavatavasāñchandasi' (7.1.83) numa, halṅyādi(6.1.68) saṃyogānta(8.2.23)lopau|| 12. kānāmreḍite| (8.3.12) `kāṃskān‌' iti| kimaḥ śasi `kimaḥ kaḥ' (7.2.103) iti katvam‌, prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (6.1.102) iti dīrghaḥ, `tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (6.1.103) iti sakārasya nakāraḥ, vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam‌, rutvam‌ visarjanīyaḥ, tasaya `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.3.34) iti saḥ| kathaṃ punaratra sakāraḥ, yāvatā `kupvoḥ ka pau ca' (8.3.37) iti visarjanoyajihvāmūlīyābhyāṃ bhavitavyam‌? ata āha--`asya' ityādi| tatra yadyapi na paṭhyate, tathāpi bhavatyevāniṣṭaprasaṅga iti darśayitumāha--`samaḥ suṭi' ityādi| yadi sakāro'trānuvarttiṣyate, pūrvayoge'pi sarvatraitasmādanuvarttamānāt‌ sakāraḥ prasajyeta? ityāha--`pūrvayogeṣu' ityādi| pūrvayogeṣu hi `samaḥ suṭi' (8.3.5) iti svena sambandhinā samā suṭā ca sambaddhasyaiva tasyānuvṛttiḥ, tato na tasya sambandhyantareṇā sambandho bhavati| kān‌ kāniti vaktavye, āmreḍitagrahaṇam‌--yatra dvirvacanaṃ tatra yathā syāt‌| teneha na bhavati--kān‌ kān paśyatīti| eko'tra kiṃ śabdaḥ praśne, dvitīyastu kutsāyām‌| kān‌ kutsitān‌ paśyatītyarthaḥ|| 13. ḍho ḍhe lopaḥ| (8.3.13) `ḍhe' iti varṇamātraṃ nimittatvenāśrīyate; na varṇasamudāyaḥ| kuta etat‌? vyāptyā| akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| varṇagrahaṇe tu sati līḍhvā, mīḍhvetyādāvapi bhavati; anyathā hi yadi varṇasamudāyo nimittatvenādhīyate tadā lauḍham‌, mīḍhamityādāveva syāt‌, na tu līḍhavetyādau| `līḍham‌' ityādi| `liha āsvādane' (dhāpā.1016) `miha secane' (dā.pā.992), `guhū saṃvarṇe' (dhā.pā.896)--ebhyaḥ [ebhyaḥ `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' iti ṣṭutvam‌--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] ktaḥ, `ho ḍhaḥ' (8.2.31) iti ḍhatvam‌, `jhavastathordho'dhaḥ' 98.2.40) iti dhatvam‌| `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti ṣṭutvam‌, ḍhalopaḥ, ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111) iti dīrghaḥ| kathaṃ punarlīḍhamityādyudāhaṇamupapadyate, yāvatā ḍhakāro'tra paranimittaṃ nāstyeva ḍhalope karttavye ṣṭutvasyāsiddhatvāt‌? ityata--`ṣṭutvasya' iti| ḍhakāro'tra ḍhalopanimittanāśrīyate, na cāsau kvacit‌ siddhaḥ sambhavati yatrānena ḍhalopaḥ karttavyaḥ| tasmād‌ ḍhakārasya nimittatvenāśrayaṇādeva ṣṭutvasya siddhatvaṃ veditavyam‌; anyathā hyasya vacanasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt‌; anavakāśatvāt‌| syādetat‌| śvalīṅḍhaukata ityanena ḍhalopo bhaviṣyati, siddho hyatra ḍhakāraḥ, tat‌ kuto vacanasya vaiyarthyām‌? ityāha`śvaliṅḍhaukte' ityādi| yadyapyatra nimittaṃ ḍhakāraḥ siddhaḥ, tathāpi naiva ḍhalopa upapadyate; jaśtve kṛte kāryiṇo ḍhakārasyābhāvāt‌| nanu ca nirviṣayatvāṅḍhalopo jaśtvāpavādo bhaviṣyati? ityāha--`na ca' ityādi| kuta etat‌? ityāha--`tasya hi' ityādi| yadi hi tasya viṣayo na sambhāvyeta, tato jaśatvāpavādaḥ sakyate vijñātam‌| sambhavati cāsya viṣayo līḍhāṭiḥ, tasmānna śakyau'sau jaśatvāpadāda iti vijñātum‌| kathaṃ punarlīḍhādirasya viṣayaḥ pāvatā yathā śvaliṅḍhaukata ityatra jaśtve kṛte kāryiṇo'sambhavāṅaḍhalopasyā viṣayaḥ, tathā loḍhādāvapavi ṣṭutavasyāsiddhatve sati nimittasyābhāvāt‌| athātra vacanasamārthyāḍaḍhalopena ṣṭutvasyāsiddhatvaṃ bādhyate? itaratrāpi jaśtvaṃ kasmānna bādhyate; tasmādyadi punarlīḍhāviḍhaṃlopasya viṣaya ittareṇāpi tadviṣayeṇa bhavitavyam‌, na tu līḍhādinaivetaratrāpītyata āha--`tatra hi' ityādi| iha `ḍhe' iti saptamīnirdeśā dānantaryamāśritam‌; na tu līḍhādinaivetaratrāpītyata āha--`tatra hi' ityādi| iha `ḍhe' iti saptamīnirdeśā tadviṣayeṇa bhavitadhyam‌, na tu līḍhādinaivetaratrāpītyata āha--`tatra hi' ityādi| iha `ḍhe' iti saptamīnirdeśā dānantaryamāśritam‌; nirdiṣṭagrahaṇasyānantaryārthatvāt‌| tataścānantarye sati ḍhalopena bhavitavyam‌| asti ca loḍhādo śrutikṛtamānantaryam‌, ubhayornimittakāryiṇorḍhakārayoḥ śrayamāṇatvāt‌| tasmādeṣa eva ḍhalopasya viṣayaḥ? satyamihāsatyānantaryaṃ śrutikṛtam‌; anānantaryamapyasti śāstrakṛtam‌; śāstreṇa ṣṭutvasyāsiddhatvopādānāt‌| sati ca tasmin‌ so'pi na ḍhalopasya viṣaya ityata āha--`śāstrakṛtam‌; śāstreṇa ṣṭatvasyāsiddhatvopādānāt‌| sati ca tasmina so'pi na ḍhalopasya viṣaya ityata āha--`śāstrakṛtam‌' ityādi| vidyamānamapi śāstrakṛtamanāntaryaṃ ḍhalopena bādhyate; anyathā hi vacanavaiyardhyaṃ syāt‌| yathā śāstrakṛtamanānantaryaṃ vacanasāmarthyādbādhitvā ḍhalopo bhavati, tathā śyaliṅḍhaukata ityatrāpi śrutikṛtamānānantaryaṃ bādhitvā ḍhalopaḥ syādityāha--`śvaliṅḍhaukata ityatra tu' ityatra tu' ityādi| tuśabdo lauḍhāderasya viśeṣaṃ darśayati| atra līḍhādau hi yadyapi śāstrakṛtamānantaryaṃ nāsti, śrutikṛtaṃ tvasti| iha tu nāpi śrutikṛtamānantaryaṃ dvayorḍhakārayoraśrūyamāṇatvāt‌, nāpi śāstrakṛtam‌, śāstreṇa jaśatvasyāsiddhatvānupāyanāt‌| tasmānnaiva ḍhalopasya viṣayaḥ|| 14. ro ri| (8.3.14) kiṃ punaridaṃ sānubandhakārasya rephasya grahaṇam‌? utta niranubandhakasya? kiñcātra yadi sānubandhakasya grahaṇam‌? siddham‌--agnīrathaḥ, indūratha iti; nīraktaṃ dūraktamiti tu na sidhyati| atha niranubandhakarasya grahaṇam‌? tadā sidhyati--nīraktam‌, dūraktamiti; agnīrathaḥ, indūratha iti na sidhyati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; iha tanteṇācāryaḥ `ro ri' iti dve sūtre uccāritavān‌, tatraikatra sānubandhakasya grahaṇam‌, aparatra niranubandhakasyeti| nīraktamityādau `ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho'ṇaḥ' (6.3.111) iti dīrghatvam‌| iha yadi padasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhī syāt‌, tataḥ `alo'ntyasya' (1.1.52) iti padāntasyaiva [`padāntasya'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] rephasya [ayaṃ bhāgaḥ kā.mu.pāṭhe nāsti]lopaḥ syāt‌--nīraktamityādau| ajardhā ityādau tvapadāntasya[ayaṃ bhāgaḥ kā.mu.pāṭhe nāsti] na syāt‌; viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tvasyāmihāpi bhavatītyetaccetasi kṛtvā''ha--`padsya' ityādi| viśeṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ hi padasyetyasyaivamabhisambandhaḥ kriyate--padasyāvayavo yo rephastasya rephe parato lopo bhavatīti| tenāpadāntasyāpi bhavati| `ajardhāḥ' iti| `ekāco baśo bhav‌' (8.2.37) ityādau sūtra ivaṃ vyutpāditam‌| `apāspāḥ' iti| `sparddha saṅgharṣe' (dhā.pā.3) asamādyaṅ‌, dvirvacanam‌, `śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ' (7.4.61) iti khayaḥ śeṣaḥ, `dīrgho'kitaḥ' (7.4.83) iti dīrghatvam‌, `yaṅo'ci ca' (2.4.74) iti yaṅo luk‌; pāsparddha iti sthite laṅ aḍāpamaḥ, sip‌, `carkarautañca' (dhā.pā.1081) ityādiṣu pāṭhācchapo luk‌, sipo ilṅyādinā (6.1.68) lopaḥ, jaśtvena dhakārasya dakāraḥ, `daśca' (8.2.75) iti tasyaiva dakārasya rutvam‌, tatrānena rephasya lopaḥ, pūrvavaddīrdhatvam‌| yogavibhāgakaraṇamuttarārtham‌, uttarasūtre rephasyānuvṛttiryathā syādityevamartham‌; itarathā hi ḍhakārasyāpi tatarānuvṛttiḥ syāt‌, tataśca tasyāpi visarjanīyaḥ prasajyeta|| 15. kharavasānayorvisarjanīyaḥ| (8.3.15) yadyatra padasyeti viśeṣaṇavaṣṭhī syāt‌--padasyāvayavo yo repha iti, tadā `arkaḥ' ityādānapyapadāntasya rephasyāpi visarjanīyaḥ syāt‌| sthānaṣaṣṭhyā na doṣaḥ; atra hi padaṃ repheṇa viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavati, tena rephāntasaya kāryamucyamānamalo'ntyasyaiva bhavatītyetadālaucca padasayetyeṣā sthāne ṣaṣṭhī; tacca padaṃ repheṇa veśeṣyata ityataddarśayannāha--`rephāntasya padasya' iti| `khari parato'vasāne ca' iti| `pataḥ' ityetat‌ pūrveṇaiva sambadhyate, na pareṇāvasānena,[`pareṇa avasāne--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] tasya paurvāparyābhāvāt‌| tathā hi yena varṇena viramyate so'vasānaṃ syāt‌| viratirvā virāmaḥ-varṇasyānuccāraṇam‌| tena rephāntāt‌ padādyena varṇena virabhyate sa tāvadavasānasaṃjñakaḥ paro na sambhavati; tanmātrasyāprayogāt‌| aprayogastu nirarthakatvāt‌| itaratra tu punaravasānamabhāvarūpam‌| abhāve ca paurvāparyaṃ na sambhavati; tasya varṇadharmatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ tadapi naiva rephāntāt‌ padāt‌ paramupapadyate| kecittu buddhikalpitaṃ paurvāparyamāśritya `avasāne ca' ityānenāpi saha `parataḥ' ityetatsambandhanti| tatra yadi vuddhikalpitaṃ paurvāpargraṃ nāśrīyate, tadā `kharavasānayoḥ' ityekāpyeṣā saptamyadhikaraṇabhedādbhidyate; kharyaupaśleṣike'ñikaraṇe saptamī bhavati--khari parata iti, avasāne tu vaiṣayike'dhikaraṇe saptamī bhavati--avasāne viṣaya iti| yadā tu vṛddhikalpitamabhāve'pi paurvāpayamavasāne'pyāśrīyate, tadobhatrāpi parasaptamyeva| udāharaṇeṣu khari visarjanīye kṛte `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.3.34) iti sakāraḥ, tasya cavarge parataḥ ścutvam‌| ñadheha nṛkuṭyāṃ bhavaḥ, `tatra bhavaḥ' (4.3.53) ityaṇi--nārkuṭaḥ, nṛpaterapatyam‌ `dityādityādityapatyuttarapadāṇṇyaḥ' (4.1.85) iti nārpatya ityatra visarjanīyaḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`iha' ityādi| vṛddhihiṃ bhavādāvarthe vihitaṃ taddhitamāśritya bhavantī bahiraṅgā, tasyāśca bahiraṅgatvāt‌ tadāśrayasyāpi rephasya bahiraṅgatvam‌; vṛddhyāśritatvāt‌, punā rephasya tadbhaktātvāt‌ tannimittātvācca| visarjanīyaktu kharmādhamāśritya bhavatītyantaraṅgaḥ| `asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge' (vyā.pa.42) iti visarjanīye karttavye repho'siddhaḥ, ata iha visarjanīyo na bhavati| nanu ca bṛddhau karttavyāyāṃ visarjanīyoḍabhimato'ntaraṅgo'saddhaḥ, tadasati tasmin‌ `vṛddherbahiraṅgavyapadeśo nopapadyate, tasyāntaraṅgāpekṣakatvāt‌; asati tasmin‌ vṛddherbahiraṅgavyapadeśe rephasyāpi sa na syāt‌| vṛddherbahiraṅgadvārakaṃ hi rephasya bahiraṅgatvam‌; tataścomayāṅgavikalatvāt‌ bahiraṅgaparibhāṣā (vyā.pa.42) nopatiṣṭhata iti yaduktatam‌--`bṛddherbahiraṅgalakṣaṇatvāt‌' iti, tannopapadyate? naitat‌; `na mu ne' (8.2.3) iti kāryāntarārtham‌ `na' iti yogāvibhāgaḥ kṛtaḥ| tena vṛddhau karttavyāyāṃ visarjanīyasyāsiddhatvaṃ na bhaviṣyati| ata eva bahiraṅgaparibhāṣāyāmapi visarjanīyasyāsiddhatvaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti veditavyam‌| `kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam‌' (vyā.pa.58) ityasya darśanasyehāśritatvācca| yuktañcaitat‌, kāryaprayuktatvāddhi saṃjñāparibhāṣasya taddeśataiva nyāyyā| yatra hyanayā'siddhatvaṃ kriyate so'syāḥ kāryadeśaḥ| kva cānayā'siddhatvam‌? visarjanīyavidhau| tasmāt‌ taddeśaiveyam‌; na tu yatropasaṃkhyātā--`vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam‌' (1.4.2) iti, taddeśā; nāpi yatra jñāpitā--`vāha ūru' (6.4.132) ityatra, taddeśā|| 16. roḥ supi| (8.3.16) `payaḥsu, yaśaḥsu' iti| kvacit‌ sakāradvayaṃ paṭhyate| tatra `vā śari' (8.3.36) iti visarjanīyasya sakāraḥ| `sarpiḥṣu' iti| yatra visarjanīyaḥ paṭhyate tatra `numvisarjanīyaśarvyavāye'pi' (8.3.58) iti pratyayasakārasya ṣatvam‌| yatra sarpiṣṣviti ṣakāradvayaṃ paṭhyate, tatra pūrvavadeva visarjanīyasya sakāre kṛte pūrvavadeva pratyayasakārasya vatvam‌, pūrvasya ṣṭutvam‌ (8.4.41)| supīti pratyāhāragrahaṇaśaṅkānirāsāyāha--`supi' ityādi| etacca `khari' ityanuvarttanāllabhyate, na hi saptamībahuvacanadanyaḥ sup‌ kṣarādirasti| mā bhūt‌; kharītyanuvṛtteḥ| saptamyāḥ pakāreṇa pratyāhāragrahaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavatīti? sambhavati [`na sambhavati--kā.mu.pāṭha] tatra kharādiḥ sup‌| yadi syāt‌ kiñca syāt‌? agīḥkaḥ, adhaḥka ityatra niyamādvisarjanīyo na syāt‌| tasmādvyākhyānameva śaraṇam‌| kimarthaṃ punaridam‌, yāvatā nanu siddhaḥ pūrveṇaiva visarjanīyaḥ? ityāha--`siddhe sati' ityādi| viparītaniyamo nāśaṅkanīyaḥ, `kimaḥ kṣepe' (5.4.70) ityādau visarjanīyanirdeśāt‌| `gīrṇu', dhūrṣu' iti| `rthorupadhāyāḥ' (8.2.76) ityādinā dīrghaḥ|| 17. bhobhagoaghoapūrvasya yo'śi| (8.3.17) `bho atra' ityādau `oto gārgyasya' (8.3.20) iti nityo yalopaḥ| gārgyagrahaṇaṃ tatra pūjārtham‌| `bho dadāti' ityādāvapi `hali sarveṣām‌' (8.3.22) iti nitya eva yalopaḥ| athāśgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatā'śo'myaḥ kharyo bhavati tatra kharavasānayorvisargeṇa bhavitavyam‌, kṛte visarṇanīye tasya sthānivadbhāvādrugrahaṇena grahaṇe sati syāditi cet‌? na; jñāpakāt‌| yadayam‌ `atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tu dhā' (8.3.2) ityatra visarjanīyayakāramakṛtvā nirdeśaṃ karoti tajjñāpayati--visarjanīyasya khari yakāro na bhavati| avasāne tarhi syāditi cet‌? na; `saṃhitāyām‌' (8.2.108) ityadhikārāt‌| tasmādantareṇāpyaśvacanamaśyeṇa bhavati, ityata āha--`adagrahaṇamuttarārtham‌' iti| `hali sarveṣām‌' (8.3.22) ityādinā tāmevottarārthatāṃ darśayati| `dṛkṣavṛṭ‌' iti| `ovraścū chedane' (dhā.pā.1292), kvip‌, grahyādinā (6.1.16) samp‌rasāraṇam‌, `skoḥ saṃyogādyorante ca' (8.2.29) iti sakāralopaḥ, cakārasya vraścādinā (8.2.36) cakāraḥ, tasya jaśtvena ḍakāraḥ, tasyāpi cartvam‌--ṭakāraḥ, vṛkṣavṛṭ‌, tamācaṣṭa iti ṇic‌, `ṇāviṣṭhavat‌ prātipadikasya' (dhā.813) itīṣṭhavadbhāḥ, `ṭeḥ' (6.4.155) iti ṭilopaḥ, vṛkṣavayaterṇyantātkvip‌, `ṇeraniṭi' (6.4.51) iti ṇilopaḥ| `vṛkṣav‌ karoti' iti| atrāśgrahaṇādvakarasya kakāre parato lopo na bhavati| ata evāśghrahaṇāt‌ `lopo vyorvali' (6.1.66) iti lopo na bhavatyeva| anyathādagrahaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| yadyuttarārthamaśgrahaṇaṃ syāt‌ tarhi tatraiva karttavyam‌, evaṃ hyanuvṛttyartha svaritatvaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇāha--`atha' ityādi| `uttarārtham‌' iti| `hali sarveṣām‌' (8.3.22) ityasmāt‌ sūtrāduttarasūtre'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tat‌ tathoktam‌| `mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.23) ityādinā tadevottarārthatvaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti| yadi hi `hali sarveṣām‌' (8.3.22) ityatrāśgrahaṇaṃ kriyeta, tataḥ `mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.3.23) ityatra yathā halgrahaṇasyānuvṛttiḥ, tathāśgrahaṇasyāpi syāt‌| tataścāśyeva hali mo'nusvāraḥ syāt‌, na halmātre| yadā tu tatrāśgrahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tadottaratra halmātre'nusvāraḥ sidhyati| punaruttarārthatāmaśgrahaṇasya darśayati--`vyorladhupratyatnataraḥ' ityādi| gatārtham‌|| 18. vyorlaghuprayatnataraḥ śākaṭāyanasya| (8.3.18) `laghuprayatnataraḥ' iti| prayatnaḥ prayatanam‌| `yajayāca' (3.3.90) ityādinā naṅ‌| laghuḥ prayatno yasya sa laghuprayatnaḥ, atiśayena laghuprayatno laghuprayatnataraḥ| kiṃ punaridaṃ laghuprayatnataratvam‌, yadyogāllaghuprayatnataro bhavatītyāha--`laghuprayatnataratvam‌' ityādi| sthānam‌--tālvādi, karaṇam‌--jhvāmūlādi, tayoruccāraṇe śaithilyaṃ laghuprayatnataratvam‌' ityādi| sthānam‌--tālvādi, karaṇam‌--jihvāmūlādi, tayoruccāraṇe śaithilyaṃ ladhuprayatnataratvam‌| udāharameṣvāntaratamyādvakārasya vakāra eva bhavati, yakārasya yakāra eva| śākaṭāyanagrahaṇaṃ pūjārtham‌| anena hi vyorlaghuprayatnataratvaṃ vidhīyate, uttarasūtreṇāpi lopaḥ; tatrobhayovidhānasāmarthyādeva pakṣe vidhirvijñāsyate|| 19. lopaḥ śākalyasya| (8.3.19) otaḥ parayorvyorlopo nityaṃ vakṣyati| tasmādavarṇapūrvayorayaṃ vidhirvajñāyata ityāha--`avarṇapūrvayoḥ' ityādi| `śākalyagrahaṇaṃ vibhāṣārtham‌' (iti)| nanu ca śākaṭāyanasya matena laghuprayatnataro vihitaḥ| tatrānta reṇāpi śākalyagrahaṇaṃ pākṣika eva vidhirvijñāsyate; anyathā hi[`hi'--nāsti kā.mu.pāṭhe] laghuprayatvavidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt‌, tatkiṃśākalyagrahaṇena? ityata āha--`tene' ityādi| asati hi śākalyagrahaṇe vibhāṣārthe laghuprayatnatareṇa mukte nityo lopaḥ syāt‌, tataścālaghuprayatnatarayorvyoḥ pakṣe śravaṇaṃ na syāt‌| śākalyagrahaṇe tu sati lopo vikalpyate| tena tayorapi pakṣe śravaṇaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati| evañca trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti--ekaṃ laghuprayatnatarapakṣe, dvitīyaṃ lopapakṣe, tṛtīyaṃ tūbhayorabhāvapakṣe|| 20. oto gārgyasya| (8.3.20) okārāduttaro vakāro nāsti, padānta iti yakārasyaivāyaṃ vidhirvijñāsyata ityāha--`okārāduttarasya yakārasya' iti| nanu ca pūrvasūtreṇaivaukārāduttarasya yakāralopaḥ siddhaḥ, tatkimarthamidamārabhyate? ityāha--`mityārtho'yamārambhaḥ' iti| gārgyagrahaṇaṃ tarhi kimartham‌? ityāha--`gārgyagrahaṇam‌' ityādi| vyoriha prakaraṇe laghuprayatnatarapakṣevihito lopo'pi, tatkasyārya nityo lopo bādhakaḥ? ityāha--`yo'yam‌' ityādi| atha vā--yadi nityārtho'yamārambhaḥ, pakṣe laghupratyatnataro na syādityata āha--`yo'yam‌' ityādi| lopavikalpasyānantaratvāt‌ tasyaiva nivṛttiryuktā kartumiti bhāvaḥ| `kecittu' ityādi| kathaṃ punariṣyamāṇamapi laghuprayatnatarasya bādhanaṃ bhavati, yāvatānantaratvāllopavikalpasyānena bādhā yuktā? vyoḥ kāryasamudāyasyāpekṣitatvādadoṣaḥ| yadi lopaviphalpamātramapekṣate, tataḥ sa eva bādhyate, na laghuprayatnataraḥ; lopena vyavahitatvāt‌| yadā tu vyoryavasmin‌ prakaraṇe kāryaṃ vihitaṃ tatsamudāyo'pekṣyate, tadā tasyānantaryāt‌ sa eva nivarttyate| taparakaraṇamasandehārtham‌| yato hi `oḥ' ityukte sandehaḥ syāt‌--kimayamokarasya nirdeśaḥ? āhosvidukārasyeti? maivam‌; `bhobhagoaghoapūrvasya' (8.3.17) ityanuvarttate, na bhoḥprabhṛtīnāmukāro'sti, tatkutaḥ sandeṅaḥ? evaṃ tarhi mukhasukhārtham‌|| 21. uñi ca pade| (8.3.21) `lopaḥ śākalyasya' (8.3.19) iti siddhe niyamārtham‌--uñi pada eva, nānyatreti| `avarñapūrvayoḥ' iti| okārapūrvasya vakārasyāsambhavādyakārasya pūrveṇaiva siddhatvādavarṇapūrvayorevāyaṃ lopo vijñāyata ityavarṇapūrvayorityuktam‌| `sa u' iti| tacchabt‌ suḥ, tyadādyatvam‌, `tadoḥ saḥ sāvanantyayoḥ' (7.2.106) iti saḥ, rutvām‌, tasya yakāraḥ, tasyānena lopaḥ| `tantrayutam‌' iti| `tantre' ityetasya saptamyantasya utaśabde niṣṭhānte parato'yādeśaḥ| nanu ca `uñi' [`uñ‌'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] ityucyate, na cāyamuñ‌, ñakārābhāvāt‌ tatkimetannivṛttyarthena padagrahaṇena? ityata āha--`veñaḥ samprasāraṇe' ityādi| samprasāraṇaṃ tu `vacisvapi' (6.1.15) ityādinā| evaṃ tāvaduño nipātasya pratipadoktasyāstitvamanapekṣya padagrahaṇaprayojanaṃ darśitam‌| yadā tu tasyāstitvamapekṣyate, tadā prayojanāntaraṃ darśayitumāha--`uttarārtham‌' iti| `ṅamo hrasvādaci ṅamuṇ‌ nityam‌' (8.3.32) ityeṣa vidhirajādau pade yathā syāt‌, iha mā bhūt‌--paramadaṇḍineti| yadyuttarārtham‌, tatraiva kasmānna kṛtam‌, kaḥ punarevaṃ siti lābhaḥ? svaritatvaṃ na pratijñāyata ityeṣa lābhaḥ| ihāpi kriyamāṇe lakṣaṇapratipadoktaparibhāṣā (vyā.pa.3) nāśrayaṇīyā bhavatīti samānam‌| cakāro'varṇapūrvasyānukarvaṇārthaḥ; kṣanyathā hyoto'nantaratvāt‌ tataḥ parasya yakārasya lopo vijñāyeta? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vijñāyamāne nirarthakamevedaṃ sūtraṃ syāt‌, pūrveṇaiva siddhatvāt‌| nānarthakam‌, niyamārthatvāt‌--uṅi pada eva yathā syāt‌--bho u padaśyatīti| asati hyasminniyamārthe bho yutam‌, bhago yutamityatrāpi nityo lopaḥ syāt‌| yadi tu nipātasyedamuño grahaṇam‌, tadā niyamārthasya vyāvartyatvaṃ nāstīti pūrvāpekṣayā cakāraḥ samuccayārtho draṣṭavapyaḥ| uñīti ñakāro'sandehārthaḥ| asati hi tasmin‌ saptamyā au iti nirdeśaḥ syāt‌| tataśca kimayamukārasya nirdeśaḥ? uttekārasyeti? sandehaḥ syāt‌| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi tasmin‌ kimuñīti nipātasya grahaṇam‌? āhosvidukārādārabhya jhabhañ‌' (mā.sū.8) iti ñakārasyeti sandehaḥ syādeva? naivam‌; idaṃ tāvadbhavān‌ praṣṭavyaḥ--kimuñiti pratyāhare ye'ntargatā halasteṣveva nityo lopaḥ? utānyeṣvapīti? kimatra vaktavyam‌--`anyeṣvapi' iti? tathā hi vakṣyati--`hali sarveṣām‌' (8.3.22) iti| evaṃ tarhi yadyatra pratyāhāragrahaṇabhimataṃ syāt‌ `eauc‌' (mā.sū.4) iti cakāreṇa pratyāharaṃ gṛhṇīyāt‌--uci ca pada iti| halyapi `hali sarveṣām‌' ityanena bhaviṣyatīti| tatrāpyayamarthaḥ--sandehaḥ parihṛto bhavati| atha vā yadyatrokārādīnāmuñā pragatyāharagrahaṇabhimataṃ syāddhalīti lakāreṇa pratyāharaṃ gṛhītvaikamevemaṃ yogaṃ kuryāt‌--`uli ca pade sarveṣām‌' iti| na hi yogavibhāgasya kiñcit‌ prayojanaṃ paśyāmaḥ| tasmānnātrokārādīnāṃ pratyāhāragrahaṇamiṣṭam‌| tataścoño nipātasyaiva grahaṇamityasandigdhametat‌|| 22. hali sarveṣām‌| (8.3.22) `bhobhagoaghoapūrvasva' iti| bhobhagoaghopūrvasya vakārasyāsambhavāt‌| avarṇapūrnastu vakāraḥ sambhavati| tasya tu pūrvameva `hali sarveṣām‌' ityanena lopo na bhavatīti darśitam‌| teneha yakārasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na vakārasya, tasya lopo na bhavatīti darśitam‌--`bhobhagoaghoapūrvasya' (8.3.17) ityādau sūtre| tatrāśgrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌? hali sarveṣāmityayaṃ lopo'śi hali yathā syāt‌, iha mā bhūt‌--vṛkṣa vṛścatīti vṛkṣavṛṭ‌, tamācaṣṭa iti ṇic‌, vṛkṣavavati, vṛkṣavayaterapratyayaḥ vṛkṣav‌--`vakṣav‌ karoti' iti| evamaśgrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ darśayatāmena sūtreṇāśi hali vakārasyāvarṇapūrvasya lopo na bhavatītyuktaṃ bhavati| nanu cāvarṇapūrvasyetyasyānuvṛttirayuktā; pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvāt‌, tatkathamavarṇapūrvasya lopo bhavatīti? naitadasti; `cānukṛṣṭamuttaratr nānuvarttate' (vyā.pa.76) iti prāyikametat‌| kathaṃ jñāyate? `ekājuttarapade ṇaḥ' (8.4.12) ityatra `ṇaḥ' iti prakṛte punarṇagrahaṇam‌, `vā bhāvakaraṇayoḥ' (8.4.10) ityatra `vā' iti yadanuvṛttaṃ tannivṛttyrtha kṛtam‌| yadi cedaṃ prāyikaṃ na syāt‌, punarṇagrahaṇamanartham‌; pūrvasūtre cānukṛṣṭatvādeva hi vāgrahaṇasyānuvṛttirna bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ punarṇagrahaṇena? kṛtañca, tato'vasīyate--cānukṛṣṭaparibhāṣā'nityeti| `śākaṭāyanasyāpi lopo yathā syāt‌' iti| apiśabdācchākalyasyāpi| asati tu sarvagrahaṇe pratyāsannasya gārgyasya matena lopa eva vijñāyeta|| 23. mo'nusvāraḥ| (8.3.23) padasyeti sthānaṣaṣṭhī, tacca padaṃ makāreṇa viśeṣyate, viśeṣaṇena ta tadantavidhirbhavatīti makārāntapadasyānusvāro vidhīyamāno'lo'tyaparibhāṣayā (1.1.52) makārasyaiva vijñāyate, ityāha--`makārāntasya padasya'[`makārasya padāntasya'--kāśikā, padamañjarī ca] padasya' iti|| 24. naścāpadāntasya jhali| (8.3.24) `hali' iti nivṛttam‌, jhalgrahaṇāt‌| cakāro makārānukarṣaṇārthaḥ| asati hi tasminnikārasyāpadāntasya kāryiṇa iha grahaṇānmakāro nivṛtta ityāśaṅkā syāt‌| `payāṃsi' iti| `jaśśasoḥ śiḥ' (7.1.20), `napuṃsakasya jhalacaḥ' (7.1.72) iti num‌, `sāntamahataḥ saṃyogasya' (6.4.10) iti dīrghaḥ| `ākraṃsyate' iti| āṅpūrvāt‌ kramerlṛṭ‌, `āṅ‌ udyamane' (1.3.40) ityātmanepadam‌| `ācikraṃsate' iti| `pūrvavatsanaḥ' (1.3.62) ityātmanepadam‌| evaṃ `athijigāṃsate' ityatrāpi| iṅaḥ sani `iṅaśca' (2.4.48) iti gamirādeśaḥ; `ajjhanagamāṃ sani' (6.4.16) iti dīrghaḥ; dvirvacanam‌, abhyāsakāryam‌| `rājan‌' iti| rājateḥ śatrāntāt‌ sambuddhiḥ, tasyā halṅyādinā (6.1.68) lopaḥ|| 25. mo rāji samaḥ kvau| (8.3.25) `samrāṭ‌' iti| sampūrvādrājateḥ `satsūdviva' (3.2.61) ityādinā kvip‌, vraścādinā (8.2.36) ṣatvam‌, ṣakārasya jaśatvam‌--ḍakāraḥ, tasya cartvam‌--ṭakāraḥ| `sābhrājyam‌' iti| brāhyaṇāditvat‌ vyañ‌| kimarthaṃ punarmakāra uccāryate? ityāha--`makārasya makāravacanam‌' ityādi| `mo'nusvāraḥ' (8.2.23) ityanusvāraḥ prāpnoti, sa mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ makārasya makāro vidhīyate| yadyevam‌, neti pratiṣedhaḥ karttavyaḥ, evaṃ hi laghu sūtraṃ bhavati; vibhaktyanuccāraṇāt‌? evaṃ tarhi nirdeśādhikyena tu makāravidhānenaitat‌ sūcayati--atra prakaraṇe'dhiko hi vidhirbhavatīti| yavalapare yavalā vā bhavantītyupapannaṃ bhavati| `saṃyat‌' iti| yameḥ sampūrvāt‌ kvip‌, `anudāttopadeśa' (6.4.37) ityādinā makāralopaḥ, akārasya `hrasvasya piti kṛti' (6.1.71) iti tuk‌|| 26. he mapare vā| (8.3.26) maḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ| `kim‌ hyalayati' iti| `hvala hyala calane' (dhā.pā.805,806), `jvalahvalahyalanamāmanupasargādvā' (ga.sū.dhā.pā.817 ityasyānantaram‌) iti vā mitsaṃjñā, `mitāṃ hrasvaḥ' (6.4.92) iti hrasvaḥ| `yavalapare' ityādi| yavalāḥ pare yataḥ sa yavalaparastasmin‌ he makārasya vā yavalā bhavantītyetadartharūpaṃ vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ tu pūrvaṃ vihitameva| yavalāścaite bhavanta āntaratamyāt‌ sānunāsikā eva bhavanti| vāvacanāt‌ pakṣe'nusvāro bhavatyeva| atha `he bhaḥ' ityeva kasmānnoktam‌; evaṃ hi paragrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, saptamyaiva hi tadarthaṃ pratipādayiṣyate--makāre parato yo'kāra iti? naitadasti; `he maḥ' ityucyamāne viparyayo'pi vijñāyeta--hakārapare makāra iti, tataśca kimahna ityādāveva syāt‌| akāreṇa vyavadhānānna bhaviṣyatīti cet‌? na; `yena nāvyavadhānaṃ tena vyavahite'pi vacanaprāmāṇyāt‌' (vyā.pa.46) ityekena varṇena vyavadhānamāśrīyate, na punaranekeneti| ādyapakṣe kim‌ hyalayatītyādiṣu kṛtārthaṃ vacanam‌, ato na śakyaṃ vyavadhānamāśrayitumiti cet‌? na; yena hakārapade makāra ityeṣa sūtrārtho gṛhītaḥ, taṃ prati pakṣāntarasyāsambhavāt‌| tasmāt‌ paragrahaṇameva kartvyaṃ viparyayapratītirmā bhūdityevamartham‌|| 27. napare naḥ| (8.3.27) naḥ paro yasmāditi bahuvrīhiḥ| paragrahaṇaṃ nakārapare yathā syādityevamartham‌, anyathā hi `ne naḥ' ityucya māne nakāra eva kevale parato vijñāyeta, na iti nimittāntaropādanād‌ he ityasya nivṛttiḥ? naitadasti; evaṃ hi vacanamidamanarthakaṃ syāt‌| kṛte hyanuttvāre nakāre parataḥ `anusvārasya yayi parasavarṇaḥ' (8.4.58) ityanena nakāraḥ sidhyati? satyam‌; vikalpārthametat‌| atra hi yadānena nakāro na kriyate, tadā vacanasāmarthyāt‌ parasavarṇo na bhavatīti vikalpaḥ sidhyati| tasmāt‌ paragrahaṇa kartvyam‌--napare hakāre yathā syāt‌, kevale mā bhūditi| `kin‌ hnute' iti| `hnuṅ‌ apanayane'; (dhā.pā.1082), adāditvācchapo luk‌| iha keciccodayanti--na iti pratiṣedhaḥ kasmānna vijñāyata iti? etaccāyuktam‌; savisargasya pāṭhāt‌ pratiṣedhavācinaśca nakārasya visargānupapatteḥ| athāpyavisargaḥ paṭhyate? evamapyayuktā pratiṣedhāśaṅkā; prāptyabhāvāt‌|| 28. ṅṇoḥ kukṭuk‌ śari| (8.3.28) ṅaśca ṇaśca tau ṅṇau, kaśca ṭaśca kaṭau, tayorukārakakārābhyāṃ pratyekamabhisambandhaḥ--kukṭgiti| ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ, kakāro deśavidhyarthaḥ| `prāṅk‌ chete' iti| prāṅiti `kvinpratyayasya kuḥ' (8.2.62) ityatra vyutpāditam‌| vaṇ‌ṭ chete' iti| vaṇatervic‌| kimarthaṃ punaḥ pūrvāntādetau kriyete? ityāha--`pūrvāntakaraṇam‌' ityādi| kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ pūrvāntatve cchatvaṃ bhavati, na punaḥ parāditve? ityata āha--`śaścho'ṭi' ityādi| kimarthaṃ punaretaddhi `vijñāyate? [valijñāyeta'--kā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] ityata āha--`iha' ityādi| yadi padāntājjhaya (8.2.10) ityevaṃ tatra na kriyeta, tadā virapśinnityatra cchatvaṃ vijñāyeta, evañca vijñāyamāne na bhavati, na hyatra padānte jhay‌| `viriṣśin‌' iti| vipūrvādrapeḥ `lṛṭaḥ sadvā' [`laṭaḥ'--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] (3.3.14) iti śatrādeśāḥ, `vyatyayo bahulam‌' (3.1.85) iti syapratyayasya sakārasya śakāraḥ, yakārasya cekāraḥ| `prāṅak‌ sāyaḥ' iti| atra parāditve sati `iṇkoḥ' (8.3.57), `ādeśapratyayayoḥ' (8.3.59) iti prāptasya ṣatvasya `sātpadādyoḥ' (8.3.112) iti pratiṣedho na syāt‌; apadāditvāt‌| `vaṇṭ‌ sāyaḥ' iti| atrāpi `ṣṭunā ṣṭuḥ' (8.4.41) iti prāptasya ṣṭutvasya `na padāntāṭṭoranāma' (8.4.42) iti pratiṣedho na syāt‌; apadāntatvāt‌| tasmāt‌ prāṅakcheta ityādau chatvādisidhyartha pūrvāntakaraṇam‌|| 29. ḍaḥ si dhud‌| (8.3.29) `ubhayanirdeśe pañcamīnirdeśo balīyām‌' (śāka.pa.97) iti `ṅaḥ' iti pañcamyā `si' ityasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parikalpitāyāṃ śakārasyaiva dhuḍavidhīyate, ityāha--`ḍakārāntāt‌' ityādi| yadyevam‌, saptamīnirdeśaḥ kimarśaḥ? lāghavārthaḥ| `ṅaḥ so dhuṭ‌' ityucyamāne mādhādhikyāṭ‌ gauravaṃ syāt‌| atha `yasmin‌ vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vyā.pa.127) ityevamarthaḥ saptamīnirdeśaḥ kasmānna vijñāyate? kevalasya sakārasyābhāvādeva tatsiddheḥ, pada ityadhikārāccha| śvaliṭatyāya ityatra dhuṭi kṛte dhakārasya cartvam‌--takāraḥ| prakriyālāghavārthaṃ tu tuṭi vaktavye dhuṅvacanamuttarārtham‌--`naśca' (8.3.30) ityatra dhuḍayathā syāt‌, tuṇmā bhūditi| yadi hi syāt‌, tarhi kim‌? bhavāntsāya ityatra `naśchavyapraśāna' (8.3.7) iti ruḥ prasajyeta? naitadasti; ampara ityatrānavarttate, na cehāmparastakāro'sti| athathehāpi bhūtapūrveṇokāreṇāmparaḥ syāt‌? evamapyasiddhatvāt‌ tuṭo rutvaṃ na bhaviṣyati| tasmāttuḍeva vaktavyaḥ| evaṃ tarhi vaicitryārtha dhuḍavacanam‌| atha kimarthaṃ dhuṭ‌ parādhiḥ kriyate, na dyugeva pūrvāntaḥ kriyeta, evaṃ hi `śi tuk‌' (8.4.31) ityatra tuggrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati, dhugeva hi tatrānuvarttiṣyate? ityata āha--`parādikaraṇam‌' ityādi| yadi pūrvāntaḥ kriyeta, śvaliṭtsāya ityatra dhukaḥ ṣṭutvaṃ syāt‌| parādikaraṇe tu ṭakārasya padāntatvaṃ na vihitamiti `na padāntāṭṭoranam‌' (8.4.42) iti pratiṣedhaḥ sidhyati| tadarthaṃ parādikaraṇam‌|| 30. naśca| (8.3.30) cakāro dhuḍityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ| nanu ca svaritatvādevānuvarttiṣyate, na cottaratrānuvarttiṣyate, āgamāntarasyopādānāt‌, asvaritatvādvā? satyametat‌; pratipattigauravaṃ tu mandadhiyāṃ syāt‌| atha bhavāntsāya ityatra dhuṭaścātve kṛte `naśchavyapraśān‌' (8.3.7) iti ruḥ kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`dhuṭaścartvasya cāsiddhatvāt‌' ityādi| yadi kevalasya catvesya dhuṭo vāsiddhatvaṃ syāt‌, tathāpi rutvaprāpterasambhava eva, kiṃ punarubhayorasiddhatve satīti rutvaprāpteratyantāsabhbhavaṃ darśayitumubhayorgrahaṇam‌| kvacit‌ `ghuṭaścartvasyāsiddhatvāt‌' iti pāṭhaḥ| tatrāpyayamartho veditavyaḥ--vināpi hi cakāreṇa tadartho gamyate, yatāharaharnayamāno vaivasthato gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśumityādau vākye| atha vā--asmi pāṭhe dhuṭo yaccārtvaṃ tasyāsiddhatvādityarthaḥ| nanu dhuḍapyasiddha eva, tat‌ kutaścartvasyāsiddhāvamucyate? punardhuṭo'pi? naitat‌; satyapi dhuṭi vinā cartvena rutvapraptireva nāsti| tato yasmin‌ sati rutvamādāṅakyate, tasyāsiddhatvaṃ yuktanuktamiti bhāvaḥ| kathaṃ punaḥ satyapi cartvasyāsiddhatve rutvamākṣaṅ‌kitam‌, yāvatā'mpare chavi taducyate, na cehāmparatvamasti? bhūtapūrveṇokāreṇāmparatvamastīti yugatamāśaṅakitam‌| nanu ca sāmpratikābhāve bhūtapūrvagatirbhavati, asti sāmpratikatvamanyatrāmparatvaṃ rutvasya? satyametat‌; adhyāropyaivamuktam‌; evaṃ manyate--bhavatu nāma, bhūtapūrveṇokāreṇāmparatvaṃ prasajyata ityāha--`dhuṭaśmartvasyāsiddhatvāt‌' iti|| 31. śi tuk‌| (8.3.31) `śi' iti saptamyakṛtārthā `naḥ' iti pūrvasūtre kṛtārthāyāḥ pañcamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhītvaṃ prakalpayati; `tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya' (1.1.66) iti vacanāt‌, tena nakara evāgamī vijñāyata ityāha--`nakārāntasya' ityādi| atha kimarthaṃ tuk‌ pūrvāntaḥ kriyate, na prakṛto dhuḍeva parādiḥ kriyeta; tathāpi cartvena sidhyati? ityata āha--`pūrvāntakaraṇam‌' ityādi| pūrvāntaḥ-pūrvasyāntaḥ, sa punaḥ prakaraṇāt‌ tugvijñāyate, talpa karaṇam‌-vidhānam‌, chatvaṃ yathā syādityevamartham‌| yadi prakṛto dhuḍeva vidhīyeta, `śaścho'ṭi' (8.4.63) iti cchatvaṃ na syāt‌| tatra ca kāraṇaṃ pūrvamevoktam‌| `yadyevam‌' ityādi| yadi pūrvāntastuk‌ kriyate, kurvañcete--ityatra tukā padāntatāyā rahitatvāt‌ nakārasya `aṭkuṣvāṅ‌' (8.4.2) ityanena ṇatvaṃ prāpnoti, parāditve tveṣa doṣo na bhavati; `padāntasya' (8.4.37) iti ṇatvaparatiṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ| `tatra' ityādinā `na bhābhūpūkamigami' (8.4.34) ityādeḥ sūtrānneti varttamāne `stoḥ ścunā ścaḥ' (8.4.40) iti yogavibhāgaḥ kriyate, tena cavargayoge kurvañcete--ityatra ṇatvaṃ na bhavatyeva| nanu ca kriyamāṇe'pi yogadibhāge ṇatvaṃ prāpnotyeva, yasmādiha cavargayogo nāstyeva, tukaḥ ścutvasyāsiddhatvāt‌? yogavibhāgakaraṇasāmarthyāt‌ ścutvasyāsiddhatve'pi ṇatvapratiṣedho bhaviṣyatītyadoṣaḥ|| 32. ṅamo hvasvādaci ṅamuṇnityam‌| (8.3.32) `imaḥ' iti, `ṅamuṭa' iti ubhayamapi pratyāhāragrahaṇam‌| uḍiti pratyekaṃ ṅakārādibhiḥ sambadhyate| `hrasvāt‌' ityetanṅamo viśeṣaṇam‌, hrasvaviśeṣito'pi ṅam‌ padasya viśeṣaṇam‌, viśeṣaṇena ca tadantavidhirbhavatīti tadantāt‌ padāditi vijñāyate| yadyapi padasyeti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ prakṛtam‌, tathāpi tadihārthāt‌ pañcamyantatayā vipariṇamyate--`ubhayanirdeśe pañcamonirdeśo balīyān‌' (śāka.pa.97) iti| `ṅamaḥ' iti pañcamyā `aci' iti saptamyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ parikalpitāyāmaca evāgamitvaṃ pratipadyate| saptamīnirdeśastu lāghavārthaḥ; uttarārthaścetyetatsarvaṃ cetasi kṛtvā'ha--`hvasvāt‌ paro yo ṅam‌, tadantāt‌' iti| saṃkhyātānudeśo hīha veditavyaḥ; āgamināmāgamānāñca samānatvāt‌| `pratyaṅṅāste' iti| `āsa upaveśane' (dhā.pā.1021), adāditvācchapo luk‌| `kṛvannāste' iti| `kṛṣa vilekhane' (dhā.pā.990) laudādikaḥ, śat‌| atha paramadaṇḍinottamadaṇḍineti `sanmahat‌' (2.1.61) ityādinā samāse kṛte ṅamantāt‌ tṛtīyaikavacane tasya nuṭ‌ kasmānna bhavati; atra hi `yaci bham‌' (1.4.18) iti bhatve'pi samāsasya hrasvādikārāt‌ paro ṅam‌ nakāraḥ, tadantāddaṇḍinetyasmādyā vibhaktistasyāṃ luptāyāmapi pratyayalakṣaṇena (1.1.62) labdhapadasaṃjñatvāt‌ tṛtīyaikavacanamacparaṃ bhavatītyasti ṅamuṭprāptiḥ? ityāha--`paramadaṇḍinā' tyādi| uttarapadatve uttarapadavyapadeśe karttavye satyapadādividhau padāvidhidheranyatra pratyayalakṣaṇaṃ na bhavatīti vākyārthaḥ| asati pratyayalakṣaṇe daṇḍinetyasya padasaṃjñā na bhavati| tataśca padāntāduttarasyocyamāno ṅamuḍāgamo na bhavati| evaṃ tāvat‌ kātyāyanamatena parīhāra uktaḥ| yastu sūtrakāramatena, taṃ darśayitumāha--`atha vā' ityādi| pada ityanuvṛttī satyāmacā pade viśeṣyamāṇe `yasmin‌ vidhistadādāvalgrahaṇe' (vā.14) ityanenājādau pade kāryeṇa bhavitavyam‌, na cātrājādi padamasti, tatkuto nuṭprasaṅgaḥ| atha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, yāvatottarasūtre (8.3.33) vāgrahaṇādeva nityo vidhirvijñāsyate? satyametat‌; pūrvasūtre'pi (8.3.31) nityatvaṃ vijñāyeta| tasmāt‌ pūrvasūtreṣu `he mapare vā' (8.3.26) ityato `vā' itnuvarttata iti jñāpanārthaṃ nityagrahaṇam‌|| 33. maya uño vo vā| (8.3.33) `mayaḥ' iti pratyāhārasya grahaṇam‌, na tu aya vaya `maya' iti dhātoḥ| kuta etat‌? vyāptinyāyāt‌| kimarthamidamucyate, yāvatā `iko yaṇaci' (6.1.77) ityuño vakāraḥ siddha eva, vikalpārthamiti cet‌? syādetat‌--yadi `iko yaṇaci' iti nityaṃ syāt‌, tasmādvikalpārthaṃ vacanamiti? etacca na; `padāntādvā' (6.1.76) ityato vetyanuvarttiṣyate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā vijñāyate| tenoño vikalpena yanmavatītyāha--`pragṛhyatvāt‌' ityādi| pragṛhyatvaṃ punaḥ `uñaḥ' (1.1.17) iti pragṛhyasaṃjñāvidhānāt‌| tasmin‌ sati `plutapragṛhya aci' (6.1.125) iti prakṛtibhāvaḥ prāpnoti, tasmin‌ prāpte vakāro vidhīyate| evamapi `iko yaṇaci' ityasyānantaramuño yaṇ‌ vakāro vidheyaḥ? evaṃ hi va iti na karttavyaṃ bhavati; yaṇaḥ prakṛtatvāt‌| veti vacanaṃ na karttavyaṃ bhavati; `padāntādvā' (6.1.76) ityato vāgrahaṇaṃ maṇḍūkaplutyā'nuvarttate? ityāha--`asiddhatvāt‌' ityādi| tatra hyucyamāne vakārasya [nāsti--kā.mu.pāṭhe] siddhatvāddhali vidhīyanāno'nusvāraḥ syāt‌, na ceṣyate, tasmādihaiva kriyate| iha krimamāṇo mo'nusvāro na bhavati, vatvasyāsiddhatvāt‌|| 34. visarjanīyasya saḥ| (8.3.34) `kharotyanuvarttate' iti| kharavasānayorvisarjanīyaḥ' (8.3.15) ityataḥ anuvṛttiśca maṇḍūkapalatinyāyena, svasambandhānuvṛttyā vā veditavyaḥ; anyathā pūrvasūtre'pi (8.3.33) khari kāryaṃ vijñāyeta|| 35. śarpare visarjanīyaḥ| (8.3.35) śar‌ paro yasmāditi vahuvrīhiḥ| atha paragrahaṇaṃ kimartham‌, na śarītyevocyeta? aśakyamevaṃ vaktum‌, evaṃ hyucyamāne śara eva kevalaṃ nimittabhāvo vijñāyeta, na kharītyanuvṛtteḥ `vā śari' (8.3.36) iti vidhānācca| viparyayastarhi vijñāryeta--śarīti, tathā ca nityaḥ sphoṭaḥ, puruṣaḥ sthūla ityādādeva syāt‌, vāsaḥ kṣīmamityādau tu na syāt‌? tasmādviparyayo mā vijñāyītyevamarthaṃ paragrahaṇam‌| atha kimarthaṃ visarjanīya ityucyate, netyevocyeta, sakārasa hi pratiṣedhe kṛte visarjanīyaḥ svenaiva rūpeṇāvasthāsyate? ityāha--`vimarjanīyasya' ityādi| tasya visarjanīyasaya vikāro jihvāmūlīyādiḥ, tannivṛttyartha visarjanīyagrahaṇam‌; anyathā yadi netyevocyeta, tataḥ `anantarasya vidhirvā bhavati pratiṣedo vā' (vyā.pa.29) iti sakārasyaiva vijñāyeta| tataśca jihvāmūlīyādirvisarjanīyasya vikāraḥ syādeva| visarjanīyagrahaṇe tu tatsāmarthyādeva na bhavati|| 36. vā śari| (8.3.36) 37. kuṣvoḥ ka pau ca| (8.3.37) `visarjanīyaśca' iti| anena visarjanīyānukarṣaṇārthaścakāra iti darśayati| atha vāgrahaṇamanuvacyaṃ jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyau kasmānna vikalpyete, evañca visarjanīyānukarṣaṇārthaścakāro na karttavyo bhavati; ābhyāṃ hi mukte pakṣe visarjanīya eva bhaviṣyati? naivam‌; śapaṃrayoreva hi kupvorevaṃ syāt| aśarparayostu pakṣe `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.3.34) iti sakāraḥ pratajyeta| tasmāccakāraḥ karttavyaḥ| iha kakārapakārayorjihvāmūloyopaṣmānoyayoḥ sūtra uccāraṇāt‌ tathābhūtāvādeśo visarjainīyasya vijñāyete? iti kasyācivāśaṅkā syāt‌, atastāṃ nirākarttumāha--`kakārapakārāvuccāraṇārtho' iti| ābhyāṃ vinā tayoruccārayitumaśakyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| kīdṛśau tāvādeśau? ityata āha--`jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāveva tvādeśau' iti| tuśabda āśaṅkitābhyāṃ samudāyarūpābhyāmādeśābhyāṃ viśeṣaṃ dyotayati| evakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāveva kevalau| na tu samudāyarūpāvityarthaḥ| iha sarvasya viṣayasya vidhyantareṇāvaṣṭabdhatvāt‌ `kupvoḥ ka pau ca' (8.4.37) ityasyānavakāśatvam‌, ato yathā vṛkṣaḥ karotītyādau `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.3.34) itīmaṃ vidhiṃ bādhitvaḥ `kupvoḥ ka pau ca' iti pravarttate, tathā vāsaḥ kṣaumam‌, adbhiḥ psātamityādau `śarpare' (8.3.35) itīmamapi vidhiṃ kasmānna bādhate? iti yo deśayet‌ taṃ pratyāha--`visarjanīyasya' ityādi| `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' (8.3.35) ityetasmin‌ prāpte cāprāpte cedamārabhyate| vāśaḥ kṣaumam‌, adbhiḥ psātamityādau prāpte; vṛkṣa karoti vṛkṣa pacatītyatrāprāpte| `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.3.34) ityetasmiṃstu sarvatra prāpte| evaṃ tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ kharmātre vidhānāt‌ syāt‌, tasyaivedaṃ bādhakam‌; netarasya vidheḥ; taṃ prati bādhakalakṣaṇasyāyogāt‌| syādetat‌--śarpare visarjanīyasya kavargapavargābhyāmanyaḥ śarparaḥ kharavakāśaḥ, `kupvoḥ ka pau ca' (8.3.37) ityasyāśarparau kavargapavargau--vāsaḥ kṣaumam‌, adbhiḥ psatamityatrobhayaṃ prāpnoti, tatra `vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāyam‌' (1.4.2) iti visarjanīyaṃ bādhitvā jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyābhyāṃ bhavituṃ yuktam‌? ityāha--`pūrvatrāsiddhe' ityādi| atraivopapattimāha--`abhāvāduttarasya' iti| dvayostulyabalayoryugapadekatra prāptau virodho bhavati, nacātra yugayat‌ prāptirasti; pūrvasmin‌ karttavye satyasiddhatvāduttarasyāvidyamānatvāt‌| itikaraṇo hetau| yasmāt‌ pūrvatrāsiddhīye nāsti vipratiṣedhaḥ, tasmādvāsaḥ kṣaumam‌, adbhiḥ psātamityatra `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' (8.3.35) ityetadeva bhavati, na jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāviti| `kecit‌' ityādi| vāsaḥ kṣaumam‌; adbhiḥ psātamityatra visarjanīyo yathā syādityevamartha `kupvoḥ ka pau ca' ityatra yogavibhāghaṃ kurvanti--`kupvoḥ' yogaḥ, ` ka pau' iti dvitīyaḥ| tatra pūrvasmin‌ yoge `śarpare visarjanīyaḥ' (8.3.35) ityetadanuvarttate| tena śarparayoḥ kupvorvisarjanīya eva bhavati, na jihvāmūlīyopadhmānīyāviti|| 38. so'padādau| (8.3.38) pūrvasyāyamapavādaḥ| `apadādau' iti| subbyatyayena dvirvacanasya sthāna ekavacanam‌; anyathā hyapadāditvaṃ kupvorviśeṣaṇamiti nopapadyate| dvitve satyapadādyoriti kuryāt‌| `pāśakalpakakāmyeṣu' iti sambhavadarśanam‌, na parigaṇanam‌; vyavacchedyābhāvāt‌| `payaspāśam‌' iti| `yāpye pāśap‌' (5.3.47)| `payaskalpam‌' iti| `īṣadasamāptau kalpap‌' (5.3.37) ityādinā kalapapa| `payaskam‌' iti| ajñātaṃ payaḥ--`ajñāte' (5.3.73) iti kaḥ| `payaskāmyati' iti| `supa ātmanaḥ kyac‌' (3.1.8), `kāmyacca' (3.1.9) iti kāmyac‌| `paya kāmayate' iti| `kamerṇiṅ‌' (3.1.30)| `paya vibati' iti| `pā pāne' (dhā.pā.925) pāghrādi (7.3.78) sūtreṇa pibādeśaḥ| `so'padādāvanavyayasyeti vaktavyamam‌' iti| `so'padādau' ityasmin‌ sūtre'navyayavisarjanīyasya sakārādeśo bhavatītyetadartharūp vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| tatraidaṃ vyākhyānam‌--`vā śari' (8.3.36) ityato vāgrahamanṛvarttate, sā ca vyavasthitavibhāṣā; tenānavyayasyaiva bhaviṣyatīti, nāvyayasya| `roḥ kāmye niyamārtham‌' iti| etad‌ grahaṇakavākyām‌| `roreva' iti| asyaiva vivaraṇam‌| vaktavyaśabdhasyātrāpi sa evārthaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ pūrvapadeva karttavyam‌| `roḥ' iti visarjanīyākṣayā sthānaṣaṣṭhī| roryo visarjanīyastasyetyarthaḥ| `ujabjirupadhmānīyopadhaḥ paṭhyate' iti| iha keṣāñciddarśanamidam‌--`ubaja ārjave' (dhā.pā.1303) iti, upadhmānīyasya tvaśravaṇam‌; kṛtajaśtvanirdeśāt‌| anyeṣāṃ tu darśanam‌ `udja ārjave' ti| tatrādyapakṣa ḍabjeḥ `halaśca' (3.3.121) ti ghañi `cajoḥ ku ghiṇṇayatoḥ' (7.3.52) iti kutve upadhmānīyasya `jhalāṃ jaś‌ jhaśi' (8.4.53) iti bakāre abhyubgaḥ, samubaga ityaniṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ nyāt‌| tasmādupadhyāmīyasya kavarge parataḥ sakāro vaktavyaḥ; sakāre hyupadhmānoyasya kṛte tasya jaśtvena dakāraḥ, evamabhpudgaḥ samudgaḥ--itīṣṭaṃ sidhyati| dvirvacanapratinedho'pyupadhmānīyasya vaktavya eva; anyathā eva; anyathā hyubjijiṣatītyatra `ajāderdvitīyasya' (6.1.2) ityupadhmānīyasya dvirvacanaṃ prasajyeta| itarasmistu darśane--asiddhakāṇḍe bha ubjervaktadavyaḥ, anyathobjijiṣati, ubjitetyādi na sidhyet‌| tathā coktam‌--`asiddhe bha ubjeḥ' iti| asiddhavacanamasiddhatvādbhakārasya| ubjijiṣatītyatra `na ndrāḥ saṃyogādayaḥ' (6.1.3) iti dvitīyasyaikāco dvirvacanapratiṣedho yathā syāt‌| tarhyayaṃ bhakāro vaktavyaḥ? na vaktavyaḥ; nipātanena siddhatvāt‌| kiṃ punarnipātanam‌? `bhujanyujjau pācyupatāpayoḥ' (7.3.61) iti| atra hi tarhi prāpnoti--abhyudgaḥ, samudaga iti? akutvaviṣaye nipātanamityadoṣaḥ| 39. iṇaḥ ṣaḥ| (8.3.39) pūrveṇa sakāre prāpte tadapavādaḥ ṣakāro vidhīyate| `sarpistatra'[`sarpiste'--kāśikā] iti| `visarjanīyasya saḥ' (8.2.34) iti sa eva bhavati| itaḥ prabhṛti yadi ṣakāra evānuvarttate, na sakāro'pi; tadā `namaspurasorgatyoḥ' (8.3.40), `ataḥ kṛkamikaṃsa' (8.3.46) ityādau sakāragrahaṇaṃ kartvyam‌| kriyamāṇe'pi yadi ṣakārastannānuvartate, tadā so'pi, prāpnoti saṅkaraḥ| athetaḥ parabhṛti yadi sakāra evānuvarttate, na ṣakāro'pi, tadā `idudupadhasaya cāpratyayasya' (8.3.41), `dvistriścaturiti kṛtvo'rthe' (8.3.43), `isusoḥ sāmarthye' (8.3.44), `nityaṃ samāse'nuttarapadasthasya' (8.3.45) ityeteṣu yogeṣu ṣakāragrahaṇaṃ kartvyam‌| kriyamāṇe'pi tasmin‌ yadi sakāro'pyanuvarttate, tadā so'pi prāpnoti, eṣo'pi saṅkaraḥ prasajyeta? ityāha--`uttaram‌' ityādi| etena sakāraṣakārayoḥ karaṇaṃ yaddeśitaṃ tannirastam‌| yastu saṅkaradoṣo darśitaḥ, tasyāpyapākaraṇamāha--`tatra' ityādi| kathaṃ punarubhayoruttaratra samamanuvṛttau satyāmeṣa viṣayavibhāgo labhyate? maṇḍūkapalutinyāyenānuvarttamānatvāt‌|| 40. namaspurasorgatyoḥ| (8.3.40) `apadādau' (8.3.38) iti nivṛttm‌| namaḥśabdasya `sākṣātprabhṛtīni ca' (1.4.74) iti gatisaṃjñā, puraḥśabdasya tu `puro'vyayam‌' (1.4.67) ityanena| `pūḥ purau, puraḥ karoti' iti| `pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' (dhā.pā.1086), `bhrājabhrāsa' (3.2.177) ityādinā kvip‌, `udoṣṭhyapūrvasya' (7.1.102) ityuttvam‌, raparatvam‌, svādayaḥ, halṅyādilopaḥ (6.1.68), `rvorupadhāyā dīrghaḥ' (8.2.76) ityekavacane dīrghaḥ| pūḥ, purāvityatrāgatisaṃjñakatvāt‌ purāśabdasya satvaṃ na bhavati, tasminnasati visarjanīya eva syāt‌; pakṣa upadhmānīyo'pi| puraḥ karotītyatrāgatisaṃjñakatvāt‌ sakāro na bhavati, tasminnasati visarjanīya eva bhavati, pakṣe jihvāmūlīyo'pi| namaḥśabdasya tu namaḥkṛtveti pratyudāharaṇaṃ veditavyam‌| vṛttikṛtā tu subodhatvānna darśitam‌|| 41. idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya| (8.3.41) icca ucca tau iduttau| ikārokārāyupadhe yasya sa tathektaḥ| `nidurvahiḥ' ityādi| sambhavadarśanārthametat‌, na parigaṇanam‌; vayāvarttyābhāvāt‌| `mātuḥ karoti, pituḥ karoti' iti| atra yathā na bhavati tathā vakṣyati| `puṃskāmā, muhuḥkāmā' iti| atrāpi yathā na bhavati tathā vakṣyati| `catuṣkapālam‌, catuṣkaṣṭakam‌' iti| catuḥśabdasya kapālakaṇṭakaśabdābhyāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ, samāhāre dvigurvā| `akārāntottarapado [`padadviguḥ'--prā.mu.pāṭhe] dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate' (vā.156) iti strīliṅgatā na bhavati; `pātrādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ' (vā.159) iti vacanāt‌| `mātuḥ karoti, pituḥ karoti' iti deśyam‌| mātupitṛśabdābhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyekavacanam‌; `ṛta ut‌' (6.1.111) ityuttvamekādeśaḥ, raparatvam‌, `rātsasya' (8.2.24) iti salopaḥ, rephasya visarjanīyaḥ| sa ca rephasyāpratyayatvāt‌ pratyayavisarjanīyo na bhavati, ataḥ ṣatvaṃ prāpnoti| tatkasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`kaskādiṣu' ityādi| parohāraḥ| ekādeśaścāso nimitt‌ ceti karmadhārayaḥ| yadyekādeśādiṇo nimittabhūtāt‌ ṣatvaṃ syāt‌, kaskādiṣu bhrātuṣputraśabdasya grahaṇaṃ na kuryāt‌; anenaiva siddhatvāt‌, kṛtaṃ ca, etadeva jñāpayati--ekādeśanimittāt ṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti| `pummuhusāḥ' ityādi| vaktavya iti vyākhyeya ityarthaḥ| tatredaṃ vyākhyānam‌--uttara (8.3.42) sūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamubhayoryogayoḥ śeṣabhūtaṃ vijñāyeta| sā vyavasthitavibhāṣā, tena puṃmuhusorna bhavati| anyeṣāṃ tu nityameva bhaviṣyati| pumityasya prahaṇaṃ rutvādeśapakṣamāśritya kṛtam‌| sakārādeśapakṣe hi visarjanīyābhāvāt‌ pratiṣedhasarjanīya' (8.3.34) iti sakāraḥ| jihvāmūlīyastu yathā na bhavati tathā pūrvameva pratipāditam‌| `muhukāmā' iti| ṣatve pratiṣiddhe jihvāmūlīyo bhavati| kvacit‌ `muhuskāmā' iti| sakāraḥ paṭhyate| tatra yathā puṃskāmetyatra jihvāmūlīyābhāvaḥ prākpratapāditastathehāpi pratipādyaḥ| `naiṣkusyam‌, dauṣpurudhyam‌' iti brāhmaṇāditvāt‌ ṣyañi kṛte tannimittāyāṃ ca vṛddhāvidudupadhatvābhāvāt‌ ṣatvaṃ na prāpnoti| `niśṣkulam‌, duśṣpuruṣaḥ' ityatrāpi `guroranutaḥ' (8.2.86) ityādinā plute vihite naiva tatprāpnoti, idudupadhatvābhāvāditi yo deśayet‌, taṃ pratyāha--`naiṣkulyam‌' ityādi| vuddhe stāvadvahiraṅgatvaṃ taddhitāpekṣatvāt‌, taddhito bhavādyarthāpekṣatvādvahiraṅgaḥ| tena tadāśritā'pi vṛddhirvahiraṅgā bhavati| pluto'pi dūraddhūtāvāvarthe vākyasya vidhīyamānatvādvihiraṅgaḥ, ṣatvaṃ tu varṇasya padasambāndhino didhīyata itayalpāpekṣītyantaraṅgam‌| tenāntaraṅge ṣatve karttavye vṛddhiplutayorthahiraṅgayorasiddhatvāt‌ pradarttata eva ṣatvam‌| [ayaṃ bhāhagaḥ kā.mu.pāṭhe nāsti] taparakaraṇamāśīḥ karoti, goḥ karoti, dhūḥ karotītyatra mā bhūdityevamartham‌||[ayaṃ bhāhagaḥ kā.mu.pāṭhe nāsti] `idudupadhasya' ityādinā dvistriścaturiti grahaṇaṃ pratyācaṣṭe| etaddhi evamarthaṃ kriyate--dvirādīnāmeva visarjanīyasya ṣatvaṃ yathā syāt‌, pañcakṛtvaḥ karotītyatra mā bhūditi| nanu ca `idudupaśrasya' (8.3.41) ityasminnanuvarttamāne kṛtvo'rtho vivayo yasaya padasya tasya yo visarjanīya ityevaṃ kṛtvo'rthaviṣayeṇa padena visarjanīyo yadā viśeṣyate, tadānyasya na prāpnoti; dvirāderanyasyedudupadhasya kṛtvo'rthavṛtteḥ padasyāsambhavāt‌| tasmādantareṇāpi dvirādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌, teṣāmeva hi visarjanīyasya ṣatvaṃ bhaviṣyati| dvistriścaturiti śakyamakartum‌| `kṛtvasujarthe ṣatvaṃ bravīti kasmāt‌' iti| asmin‌ ṣatvaviklapavidhāne hetuṃ kṛtvo'rthavacanasya pṛcchati| kasmāt‌ `kṛtvo'rthe' ityevamuktvemaṃ ṣatvavikalpaṃ bravīti? kiṃ tat‌ prayojanaṃ yato hetoriha ṣatvavikalpavidhau kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| atra vakṣyamāṇa evābhiprāyaḥ| ato hetumāha--`catuṣkapāle' ityādi| asati kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇe catuśkapāle'pi vibhāṣā ṣatvaṃ syāt‌, nityaṃ coṣyate| tasmādatra vibhāṣā ṣatvaṃ mā bhūdityevamarthaṃ kṛtvo'rtha ityucyate| yenābhiprāyeṇa paraṃ pṛṣṭavān‌, tamāviṣkarttumāha--`nanu siddhaṃ tatra pūrveṇa' iti| nānvityabhyupagame| etadanena darśayati--bhavatvanena ṣatvaṃ vibhāṣā, tathāpu pūrvasūtreṇa nityaṃ bhaviṣyati ṣatvamasya śravaṇam‌; yasmādyadāpyanena ṣatvaṃ na bhavati tadāpi pūrvasūtreṇa `idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya' (8.3.41) ityanena catuṣkapāle siddhaṃ ṣatvamiti| `siddhe hyayaṃ vidhatte' iti| siddhe prāpta ityarthaḥ| etadācaṣṭe--`idudupadhasya' ityādinā nitye ṣatve prāpta imaṃ ṣatvavikalpaṃ vidadhāta| nāprāpte tasmādyena nāprāptinyāyena (vyā.pa.49) tasyāyaṃ bādhakaḥ syāditi| tadanena yaduktam‌--`siddhaṃ tatra pūrveṇa' iti, tannirākṛtam‌| tasmādvibhāṣānivṛttyartha kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇam‌| syādetat‌--kṛtvo'rthavivakṣāyāṃ suci kṛte tasya yadā visarjanīyaḥ kriyate tadā pūrveṇa na prāpnoti, apratyayasyeti (8.3.41) pratiṣedhāt‌; tapaśca `siddhe hyayaṃ vidhatte' iti yattannopapadyate, tatkuto hyanena vikalpena nityaṃ ṣatvaṃ bādhyeta? ityāha--`yadāpi kṛtvo'rthe' ityādi| catuḥśabdo varttata iti śeṣaḥ| asya ca `siddhe hyaṃ didhatte caturaḥ ṣatvam‌' ityanena prakṛtena sambandhaḥ| asyārthaḥ--etaduktaṃ bhavani, na kevalaṃ yadā kṛtvo'rthavṛttiścatuḥśabdastadā pūrveṇa prāpte satīmaṃ ṣatvavikalpaṃ vidhatte, api tu yadā kṛtvo'rthastadāpīti| atraivopapattimāha--`lupte kṛtvo'rthoye' ityādi| ityādi| hiśabdo hetau| kṛtvo'rthe bhavaḥ kṛtvo|rthīyaḥ,ka suca, gahāditvācchaḥ| yasmāt‌ `rātsasya' (8.2.24) iti lupte kṛtvo'rthīye rephasyāpratyasya visarjanīyo bhavati tasmāt‌ kṛtvo'rthe'pi pūrveṇa nitye ṣatve prāpta imaṃ ṣatvavikalpaṃ vidhatate| tataśca sarvetra kṛtvo'rthe'pyakṛtvo'rthe'pi nāprāte pūrveṇa ṣatve vikalpa ārabhyata iti tasya bādhaka eva syāt‌| evañcāsati kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇe catuṣkapāle vibhāṣā ṣatvaṃ prasajyeta| tasmāt‌ tannivṛttyarthaṃ kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇamiti [`iti' nāsti--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] sthitametat‌| `evam‌' ityādi| yadi kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇaṃ kriyate, evaṃ tarhi tasmin‌ sati kimidānīṃ dvistriścaturityanena kāryam‌? na kiñcita; vyāvarttyabhāvāt‌| tasmānna karttavyamidamittyevābhiprāyaḥ|[medetyabhiprāyaḥ--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] syādetat‌--asatyasmin‌ pañcakṛtvaḥ karotītyādāvapi vibhāṣā ṣatvaṃ syāt‌, atastannivṛttiranena kriyate iti? ata āha--`anyo hi' ityādi| `idudupadhasya' (8.3.41) ityanuvarttate, `kṛtvo'rthe' iti cocyate, na ca dvirādibhyo'nya idudupadhaḥ kṛtvo'rthe varttate; tasmāt‌ sāmarthyādeṣāmeva bhaviṣyati, nānyeṣāmityanarthakaṃ dvirādīnāṃ grahaṇam‌| `akriyamāṇe' ityādinā asati hi dvirādigrahaṇe yo doṣastaṃ darśayati| yadi dvirādigrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā visarjanīyasya prakṛtasvātsa eva kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇena viśeṣyate--kṛtvo'rthe yo varttate visarjanīya iti| kaḥ punarevaṃ sati doṣaḥ syāt‌? ityata āha--`caturo na sidhyati' iti| `tathā' iti| tathaivaṃ kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇena visarjanīye viśeṣyamāṇe catuḥśabdasya vibhāṣā ṣatvaṃ na sidhyati| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ na sidhyati? ityata āha--`rephasya' ityādi| hiśabdo hetau, yasmāccaturaḥ `rātsasya' (8.2.24) iti sucaḥ sakāre lupte prakṛtyavayavasya rephasya visarjanīyaḥ, tasmānna sidhyati| na hyasau visarjanīyaḥ kṛtvo'rthe varttate| atha kriyamāṇe'pi tasmin‌ kasmādeva dovo na bhavati? ityata āha--`tasmān‌' ityādi| tasmin‌ dvistriścaturityetasmiṃstūpādoyamāne kṛtvorthagrahaṇaṃ catuḥśadasya viśeṣaṇaṃ nyāyaṃ bhavati| tathā hi--tasya śrutatvāt‌ sa eva viśeṣyate, kṛtvo'rtha yo varttate catuḥśabda iti| lupte'pi kṛtvo'rthīye catuḥśabdaḥ kṛtvo'rthe varttata iti na bhavati dvirādigrahaṇe kriyamāṇe'pi doṣaḥ| tasmād‌dvirādigrahaṇaṃ karttavyam‌--kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇaṃ tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā syāt‌| etadapi na bhavati tasya prayojanamiti darśayannāha--`prakṛtaṃ padaṃ tadantam‌' iti| tadantaṃ visarjanīyāntam‌| ataḥ `tasyāpi tadviśeṣaṇaṃ nyāyyam‌' upapattimāha--tadantatvaṃ tu padasya visarjanīyena viśeṣyatvāllabhyate| apiśabdo'vadhāraṇe| tasyaivetyarthaḥ| kuta etat‌? vyāptinyāyāt‌| visarjanīye hi viśeṣyamāṇe caturo na sidhyati, pade tu viśeṣyamāṇe sarvatra bhavati| tasmāt‌ tadeva viśeṣayiṣyāmaḥ--kṛtvo'rthe yadvarttate padamiti| pade viśeṣyamāṇe caturaḥ ṣatvaṃ sidhyatyeva| lupte'pi kṛtvo'rthīye caturityetatpadaṃ kṛtvo'rthe varttata iti| tasmānnārtho dviradigrahaṇeneti ślokavārttakakārema pratyākhyātaṃ dvirādigrahaṇam‌| sūtrakārasya tvayamabhiprāyaḥ--visarjanīyasya kāryitvāt‌ padena viśeṣyamāṇatvācca prādhānyam‌| tatrāsati dvirādigrahaṇe prādhānyādavisarjanīya eva kṛtvo'rthagrahaṇena viśeṣyata ti| tasmiṃstu sati tadupādānasāmarthyāt‌ sākṣāt‌ kṣutatvācca dvirādereva padasyaitadviśeṣaṇam‌, na tu svaritatvādanumitasya visarjanīyasaya| tasmādyuktaṃ dvirādigrahaṇaṃ karttumiti| `evaṃ tu' ityādinā granthena dvistriścaturgrahaṇaṃ sūtrakāramatena sthāpayati| `pūrveṇa' iti| `idudupadhasya' (8.3.41) ityādinā| tatraitat‌ syāt‌--`idudupadhasya' ityasyāvakāśaḥ--niṣkṛtam‌, duṣkṛtamiti; asyāvakāśaḥ--dviṣkarotītyādau; catuṣkarotītyatra paratvāt‌ pūrvavidhiṃ bādhitvā'yameva vikalpo bhaviṣyati? ityata āha--`pūrvatrāsiddhe' ityādi| kiṃ kāraṇaṃ nāstīti? ata āha--`abhāvāduttarasya' iti|| 44. isusoḥ samarthye| (8.3.44) yadi `aciṃśucihusṛyicchādicchṛdibhya isiḥ' (da.u.9-30), `janerusiḥ' (da.u.9-37) ityanuvarttamāne `attiṃpṝvapiyajitanidhānitapibhyo nit‌' (da.u.9.39) ityeṣaṃ sapiṃḥ, yajurādayaḥ śabdā isuspratyayāntā vyutpādyante--iti darśanam‌, tataśca kenacidaprāpta eva ṣatve `kupvoḥ' (8.3.37) ityādinā jihvāmūlīyādiṣu prāpteṣvidaṃ vacanam‌| atha `athādayo'vyutpannāni prātipadikāni' (pu.pa.vṛ.70) iti darśanam‌| tato'prātyayavisarjanīyatvāt‌ `idudupadhasya cāpratyayasya' (8.3.41) iti nitye ṣatve prāpte'yamārambhaḥ| `sāmarthye sati' iti| kupvornimittatvenāśrayaṇāt‌ tadādinaiva śabdāntareṇa saha sāmarthyaṃ veditavyam‌| sarpiṣkarotītyatra sarpiḥ sādhanaṃ karotītyevaṃ sādhyāṃ kriyāmapekṣate, karotītyartho'pi[karotyartho'pi--karotyartho'pi--prā.mu.pāṭhaḥ] sādhyaḥ| sādhanaṃ sarpirityasti sāmarthyam‌| `tiṣṭatu sarpiḥ piba tvamudakam‌' iti| atra sarpirityatra pibetyanena sāmarthyaṃ nāsti| tathā hi--pibetye tadudukamapekṣate, sarpirityetattu tiṣṭatviti| atha paramasapiḥkuṇḍiketyatra vibhāṣayā ṣatvaṃ samāse kasmānna bhavati? ityāha--`sāmarthyamiha' ityādi| dāśabdo'pyarthe varttate; anekārthatvādavyayasya| `na punaḥ' ityasyaikārthībhāva ityanena, ubhaya ityenena ca sambandhaḥ| avadhāraṇaṃ cātra draṣṭavyam‌; vyavacchedaphalakatvāt‌ sarvavākyānām‌| tadayamatrārthaḥ--sāmarthyamiha vyapekṣaivāśrayate, ubhayaṃ tu kathaṃ nāśrayituṃ yuktam‌; na hi sāmānyaśabdāḥ prakaraṇādikamantareṇa viśeṣeṣvavatiṣṭhante, na ceha prakaraṇādikamasti tathāvidhaṃ kiñcidyena vyapekṣālakṣaṇameva sāmarthya grahītavyam‌? naiṣaḥ doṣaḥ; `kāryakālaṃ saṃjñāparibhāṣam‌' (vyā.pa.58) iti, iha `padasya' iti varttate, tatra padādhikārādeva samarthaparibhāṣāyā upasthānāt‌ sāmarthye labdhe yataḥ sāmarthyagrahaṇaṃ kriyagate tasyedaṃ prayojanam‌--iṣṭasāmarthyasya parigraho yathā syāt‌| iha ca vyapekṣālakṣaṇameveṣṭaṃ sāmarthyamiti tadevāśrayituṃ yuktam‌; naikārthībhāvaḥ,
